fields.JP: ホォォオォォオォォォ……

fields.EN:
(The sound of suffering. The
hissing of the Marchens. The
sound of the Jail delighted.)
fields.JP:
（人々の苦しんでる声。嘆いてる声。
　メルヒェンたちの耳障りな鳴き声。
　…それに、ジェイルの悦んでる声）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The sound of suffering. The
hissing of the Marchens. The
sound of the Jail delighted.)

fields.EN:
(How much longer will this go on?
Why are we even here?)
fields.JP:
（…………
　いつまでこんなことが続くんだろう？
　僕たちは、どうして……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How much longer will this go on?
Why are we even here?)

fields.EN:
The color of your eyes... Did
they... do things to you again?
fields.JP:
……目の色がまた……
今日もひどいこと……された？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The color of your eyes... Did
they... do things to you again?

fields.EN:
I'm fine... They made me lick
the walls again. I'm just tired.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫。
今日は舐めさせられただけだから。
……疲れただけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine... They made me lick
the walls again. I'm just tired.

fields.EN:
What about you, Jack? You're
bleeding. They must have done
horrible things to you.
fields.JP:
わたしのことより……ジャック。
あなたこそ、酷いことされたのね。
血が出てるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about you, Jack? You're
bleeding. They must have done
horrible things to you.

fields.EN:
I'm not bleeding as much
anymore. For some reason, the
torturing ended early today.
fields.JP:
もうほとんど止まってるよ。
今日の拷問は、どうしてだか
すぐに終わったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not bleeding as much
anymore. For some reason, the
torturing ended early today.

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's because the Jail
wasn't pleased with today's
bloodshed.)
fields.JP:
（多分、今日はジェイルが
　人が血を流しても
　あんまり悦ばなかったからだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's because the Jail
wasn't pleased with today's
bloodshed.)

fields.EN: Still, we need to patch you up.
fields.LOCALIZED: Still, we need to patch you up.

fields.JP:
アリス、僕の血。
舐めて、早く！

……ええ。
いつも……ありがとう、ジャック……

fields.EN:
Jack, show me your arm. We need to
take care of your wounds.
fields.JP:
ジャック、腕を出して？
あなたも手当てをしなければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, show me your arm. We need to
take care of your wounds.

fields.EN:
You've bled enough from the
torturing. If I take even more of
your blood, it could kill you.
fields.JP:
拷問で血を流させられ、
わたしに血を舐められていたら、
……いまに死んでしまうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've bled enough from the
torturing. If I take even more of
your blood, it could kill you.

fields.EN:
You worry too much, Alice. See?
I'm not bleeding anymore. The
leaves helped quite a bit.
fields.JP:
大袈裟だよ、アリス。
もうほとんど血は止まってるし……
ここの葉っぱって傷に効くみたいだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You worry too much, Alice. See?
I'm not bleeding anymore. The
leaves helped quite a bit.

fields.EN:
Are you two okay? The torturing
is done for today, right?
fields.JP:
……そっちは大丈夫か？
今日の拷問、終わったんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you two okay? The torturing
is done for today, right?

fields.EN:
Oh... Yes. We're fine here. How
about you?
fields.JP:
あ……うん。
僕らは大丈夫。そっちは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... Yes. We're fine here. How
about you?

fields.EN:
Well, they just made me do that
licking thing, so I'm fine. It
does kind of get to you, though.
fields.JP:
ああ。
今日は舐めるやつだったからな。
精神的には削られるけどよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, they just made me do that
licking thing, so I'm fine. It
does kind of get to you, though.

fields.EN:
(The torturing here... What's the
purpose of it all?)
fields.JP:
（ここの拷問……
　一体どんな意味があるんだろうか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The torturing here... What's the
purpose of it all?)

fields.EN:
(Licking the walls... Forced to
scream... Being hurt and
wounded...)
fields.JP:
（『壁を舐めさせられる』『叫ばされる』
　『傷つけられる』……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Licking the walls... Forced to
scream... Being hurt and
wounded...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe there's no meaning to any
of it.)
fields.JP: （意味なんて……ないのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe there's no meaning to any
of it.)

fields.EN:
As long as we're alive, we still
have a chance of escaping
from here...
fields.JP:
……でも、殺されずにいれば……
生き延びるチャンスはあるわ。
いつか、脱出できるかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we're alive, we still
have a chance of escaping
from here...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We'll get out of here one
day, right?
fields.JP:
そうだな。
いつかきっと脱出してみせる。
……だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We'll get out of here one
day, right?

fields.EN: Yup! We're not going to give up!
fields.JP:
うん！
私たち、こんなのに負けちゃいけないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! We're not going to give up!

fields.EN:
Yes... No matter how painful
things are now.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
どんなに今が辛くても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... No matter how painful
things are now.

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how strong
everyone is here... I should keep
my spirits up, too.)
fields.JP:
（みんな……強いなあ。
　僕も、弱気になってたらいけないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how strong
everyone is here... I should keep
my spirits up, too.)

fields.EN:
I'll protect you, Alice... Let's
find a way out of here.
fields.JP:
アリス。
僕は君を守るから。
だからきっと、一緒に脱出しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll protect you, Alice... Let's
find a way out of here.

fields.EN:
Yes... I'll protect you too, Jack...
We'll make it out together...
fields.JP:
ええ。
わたしも……ジャックを守るから
きっと一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'll protect you too, so
just stay by my side.

fields.JP: アアァァァァァアアアァァァ…………

fields.EN:
I can't get used to how horrifying
it sounds...
fields.JP: ……いつ聞いても嫌な音だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't get used to how horrifying
it sounds...

fields.EN:
It sounds like it's satisfied for
today...
fields.JP: 今日はもう、満足したみたいだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds like it's satisfied for
today...

fields.EN:
You can tell what the Jail is
wailing about?
fields.JP: お前、ジェイルの鳴き声の意味がわかるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can tell what the Jail is
wailing about?

fields.EN:
Sort of... Or maybe I'm just
imagining what it's saying.
fields.JP:
昔から何となくだけど……
単なる気のせいかもしれないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sort of... Or maybe I'm just
imagining what it's saying.

fields.EN:
Hmm... You know, that could be
useful one day.
fields.JP:
……ふうん。
それ、何かに役立つかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... You know, that could be
useful one day.

fields.EN:
Useful? Aren't you... creeped out
by it?
fields.JP:
役……立つ？
君……気持ち悪く、ないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Useful? Aren't you... creeped out
by it?

fields.EN:
This world's bizarre as it is. I'm
not surprised by anything at this
point. Use what you got, right?
fields.JP:
ただでさえ出鱈目な世界なんだ。
何が来てもそうそう驚かねぇよ。
それに、使えるもんは何でも使えさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This world's bizarre as it is. I'm
not surprised by anything at this
point. Use what you got, right?

fields.EN:
I see... I never thought of it
like that before. I mean, everyone
else is creeped out by it.
fields.JP:
そっか……
ずっと気持ち悪がられてたから、
そんな風に考えたことなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I never thought of it
like that before. I mean, everyone
else is creeped out by it.

fields.EN:
No problem. Let's just do our best
to survive.
fields.JP:
いや……
まあ、お互い生き延びような
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem. Let's just do our best
to survive.

fields.EN:
Jack? If we're talking about
anything being creepy, it's me.
You know I'm not normal.
fields.JP:
ジャック……気持ち悪いとしたら、
わたしの方が余程気持ち悪いわ。
わたし、おかしいもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? If we're talking about
anything being creepy, it's me.
You know I'm not normal.

fields.EN:
That's not true, Alice. You're not
creepy at all.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ、アリス。
アリスは全然、気持ち悪くなんかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true, Alice. You're not
creepy at all.

fields.EN:
If anything's creepy, it's this
world we're living in.
fields.JP: ……気持ち悪いとしたら、この世界だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything's creepy, it's this
world we're living in.

fields.EN:
(The only reason any of us are
able to hold onto our sanity is
because we support each other.)
fields.JP:
（この不条理な場所で日々を過ごしながら、
　僕たちはお互いの存在だけを頼りに
　どうにか正気を保って生きている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The only reason any of us are
able to hold onto our sanity is
because we support each other.)

fields.EN:
We're okay now, so why don't we
rest? It's important if we want to
survive.
fields.JP:
だからさ、今日はもう休もう？
手当てもしてもらったしさ、
……生き延びるために
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're okay now, so why don't we
rest? It's important if we want to
survive.

fields.JP: ええ……生き延びるために

……！！
何が起きてるのかしら！？

fields.EN:
I don't know! I don't know... but
something weird's happening!
fields.JP:
わからない……！
わからないけど……何か変だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know! I don't know... but
something weird's happening!

fields.EN:
The Marchens are being taken down?!
But how could that be...
fields.JP:
メルヒェンが、やられてる！？
でも、そんなことって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens are dead?! What
happened?!

fields.JP: 甘～いの好きな子だーれかなー？

fields.EN:
Hm? You don't know what it is?
It's Marchen blood.
fields.JP:
ん？　知らないのかな？
メルヒェンの血だよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? You don't know what it is?
It's Marchen blood.

fields.EN:
Marchen blood? This is... Marchen
blood?
fields.JP:
メルヒェンの……血……？
これ……メルヒェンの血なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchen blood? This is... Marchen
blood?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Found you! You must be
Alice.
fields.JP:
あはは。みーつけた♪
君がアリスだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Found you! You must be
Alice.

fields.JP:
え……っ！？　わたし……？
どうしてわたしの名前を？

fields.EN:
The color of your eyes... You're
the one, all right.
fields.JP: その目の色……間違いないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The color of your eyes... You're
the one, all right.

fields.EN:
...Alice.
I came here to recruit you!!
fields.JP:
……アリス。
あなたをスカウトしに来たんだよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, you're the one I've been
looking for!

fields.JP:
じゃあ早速……
よいしょっ……と！

fields.EN:
We can talk later! First, we have
to get out of here!
fields.JP:
話はあとあと！
ここから出るのが先！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can talk later! First, we have
to get out of here!

fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待って！
ジャック！

待てよ！
アリスを離せ……！

はあ……はあ……
待てってば……！

fields.EN: Hmm... We should be safe here.
fields.JP: んー。この辺まで来れば大丈夫かな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmm... We should be safe here.

fields.EN:
Sorry for the rush. Are you okay?
You're not hurt, are you?
fields.JP:
ごめんね、ばたばたしちゃって。
大丈夫？　どっか怪我してない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for the rush. Are you okay?
You're not hurt, are you?

fields.EN:
Wh-Who are you?! Why are you
taking Alice?!
fields.JP:
き……君、誰だよ！？
何でいきなりアリスのこと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Who are you?! Why are you
taking Alice?!

fields.EN:
Hm? Right back at you. Who are
you, anyway? Did you follow me
here?
fields.JP:
ん？　君こそ……誰？
どっからついて来たの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Right back at you. Who are
you, anyway? Did you follow me
here?

fields.EN:
Huh? I was back in the cell with
Alice just now...
fields.JP:
……え？
僕はもともとアリスと一緒の牢獄に
閉じ込められてて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I was back in the cell with
Alice just now...

fields.EN:
Then you suddenly found your
way in and abducted her...
fields.JP:
そこへ君がいきなりやって来て
アリスを拐って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then you suddenly found your
way in and abducted her...

fields.EN:
Wait, why am I answering to you?!
Who are you?! Why'd you take
Alice?!
fields.JP:
……っていうか！
君は何者なんだ！？
どうしてアリスを拐ったりしたんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, why am I answering to you?!
Who are you?! Why'd you take
Alice?!

fields.EN:
Hey! I am not an abductor! I just
came here to bring Alice back with
me!
fields.JP:
拐うなんて失礼だなー！
あたしはアリスを迎えに来たんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! I am not an abductor! I just
came here to bring Alice back with
me!

fields.EN: Bring me back with you? Why?
fields.JP:
わたしを……迎えに？
どうして！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Bring me back with you? Why?

fields.EN:
Well... That's because you're
like me. You're a Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
それはね……
君があたしたちと同じ『血式少女』だからだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... That's because you're
like me. You're a Blood Maiden!

fields.EN:
(Huh? Come to think of it, weren't
this girl's eyes pink earlier?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　そういえばこの子の目、
　さっきはピンク色じゃなかったっけ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Come to think of it, weren't
this girl's eyes pink earlier?)

fields.EN:
(It seems like Alice's eyes are
back to normal, too...)
fields.JP: （そういえばアリスも元に戻ってる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems like Alice's eyes are
back to normal, too...)

fields.EN:
Um... Your eyes were pink earlier,
but...
fields.JP: あの、君の目、さっきピンク色に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Your eyes were pink earlier,
but...

fields.EN:
Oh, that? It fades away after a
while. Looks like yours are back
to normal too, Alice.
fields.JP:
あー。あれなら少ししたら消えるから。
アリスも元に戻ってるっぽいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that? It fades away after a
while. Looks like yours are back
to normal too, Alice.

fields.EN: My eye color... is back to normal?
fields.LOCALIZED: The color of my eyes changed?

fields.EN:
Yup. Marchen blood changes the
color of your eyes to pink. That's
proof that you're a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
そうそう。
メルヒェンの血を浴びたらピンク色になる。
それが『血式少女』のしるしだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Marchen blood changes the
color of your eyes to pink. That's
proof that you're a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
Proof that I'm a Blood Maiden...?
Me...?
fields.JP:
血式……少女の、しるし……？
わたしが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Proof that I'm a Blood Maiden...?
Me...?

fields.EN:
Alice, don't listen to her! We've
never even heard of a 'Blood
Maiden' before! This girl is weird!
fields.JP:
アリス、騙されちゃだめだ！
『血式少女』だなんて、聞いたことない！
この子、どこかおかしいんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, don't listen to her! We've
never even heard of this "Blood
Maiden" before! She sounds shady!

fields.EN:
Well, that's rude! And after I broke
you two out of there...
fields.JP:
おかしいは失礼だなー！
あそこから助け出してあげたのにさー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's rude! And after I broke
you two out of there...

fields.EN:
But, you seem different from
everyone else, and for some
reason, you know Alice...
fields.JP:
……でも、君はみんなとどこか違うし、
どうしてか知らないけど、アリスのことも
知ってるみたいだったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you seem different from
everyone else, and for some
reason, you know Alice...

fields.EN:
I said we'll talk later. You need
to hold your horses... Uh... What
was your name again?
fields.JP:
後でゆっくり説明するって言ったじゃん。
せっかちな子だなあ。
……で、君は何て名前なわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said we'll talk later. You need
to hold your horses... Uh... What
was your name again?

fields.EN:
Well, nice to meet you. Oh, my
name is Akazukin. You can
call me "Sis" if you'd like!
fields.JP:
ま、よろしくね。
そうそう。あたしの名前は赤ずきん。
お姉さんって呼んでいいからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, nice to meet you. Oh, my
name is Red Riding Hood. You can
call me "Sis" if you'd like!

fields.EN:
Akazukin, why are you doing
all this?
fields.JP:
……赤ずきん、さん。
それで、どうして……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, why are you doing
all this?

fields.EN:
We're looking for Blood Maidens in
the Jail. And lo and behold...
fields.JP:
あたしたち、ジェイルにいる『血式少女』を
探してたんだ。
……そして、やっと見つけたのが
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're looking for Blood Maidens in
the Jail. And lo and behold...

fields.EN:
I was so happy to see you! I mean,
we found another one like us!
fields.JP:
もう、嬉しくてさー。
仲間がまた見つかったって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was so happy to see you! I mean,
we found another one like us!

fields.JP:
そう、仲間だよ。
っていうのも……

fields.EN:
It's a Marchen! Let's get out of
here!
fields.JP:
メルヒェンだ！
逃げよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a Marchen! Let's get out of
here!

fields.EN: Came for us, eh? Alice! Use this!
fields.JP:
来たなー！
……アリス、これ使って！
fields.LOCALIZED: Came for us, eh? Alice! Use this!

fields.EN:
A sword?! But I've never used one
before!
fields.JP:
剣！？
わたし、こんなの使ったこと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A sword?! But I've never used one
before!

fields.EN:
You've got no other choice but to
kill it if you want to get out of
here alive. Got it?
fields.JP:
生きてここから出たかったら……
いい？　とにかくあいつをやっつけるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got no other choice but to
kill it if you want to get out of
here alive. Got it?

fields.JP: ね？　やればできたでしょ？

fields.EN:
(They actually did it... Alice and
this girl actually beat a
Marchen... )
fields.JP:
（すごい……あのメルヒェンを倒したなんて……
　アリスとこの赤ずきんって子は、
　ほんとにメルヒェンを倒したんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They actually did it... Alice and
this girl actually beat a
Marchen... )

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how they were
able to move like that in
battle...)
fields.JP:
（それに……今まで見たことないような
　すごい動きだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how they were
able to move like that in
battle...)

fields.JP: 君たちは……『血式少女』っていうのは……

fields.EN:
We Blood Maidens are a little special.
We have the power to fight Marchens
on equal footing.
fields.JP:
あたしたち『血式少女』はね、
メルヒェンとだって互角にやり合える力を持つ
少しだけ特別な存在なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Blood Maidens are about the
only ones who can actually fight
the Marchens.

fields.EN:
We're using our powers so that one
day we can save everyone and get
out of the Jail!
fields.JP:
この力を使って、牢獄からみんなを助け出して、
いつかジェイルを脱け出すんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're using our powers so that one
day we can save everyone and get
out of the Jail!

fields.EN:
...Alice. Let me ask you again.
You'll come with us, right? We're
the same kind of people, after all.
fields.JP:
……アリス。
改めて聞くけど、一緒に来てくれるよね？
あたしたち、同じ種類の人間なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice. Tell me, will you come with
me? You know, you and I are
similar in a way.

fields.JP: ……わたし、あなたと一緒に行くわ
ただし……ジャックと一緒なら

fields.EN:
Oh, what the hell. Saving others
is part of the mission, too. You
wanna tag along, then?
fields.JP:
ま、いっか。
どうせみんなを助けるのも任務のうちだし。
ついて来れば？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, what the hell. Saving others
is part of the mission, too. You
wanna tag along, then?

fields.EN:
Then it's settled. Let's go! The
exit is that way!
fields.JP:
よっし。じゃあ、行くよ！
出口はあっち！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then it's settled. Let's go! The
exit is that way!

fields.EN:
H-Hey...! Aren't you going to save
everyone else here?
fields.JP:
ちょ……他の人たちを
助けるんじゃなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey...! Aren't you going to save
everyone else here?

fields.EN:
I... I haven't forgotten about
them! Not at all!
fields.JP: わ……忘れてなんか、なかったからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I haven't forgotten about
them! Not at all!

fields.EN: C'mon! Let's hurry and save them!
fields.JP: ほら！　さっさと助けちゃおう！
fields.LOCALIZED: C'mon! Let's hurry and save them!

fields.JP: これでここから逃げられるの？

fields.EN:
We don't need to go through all
that torture anymore...
fields.JP: もう、拷問を受けなくて済むんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't need to go through all
that torture anymore...

fields.EN: They're not going to hurt us?
fields.LOCALIZED: They're not going to hurt us?

fields.EN: The exit is that way! Hurry!
fields.JP: 出口はあっち！　急いで！
fields.LOCALIZED: The exit is that way! Hurry!

fields.EN:
(No one's in the cell next
door...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No one's in the cell next
door...)

fields.EN: I wonder if they escaped already.
fields.JP: 隣の牢にいた子たち、もう逃げたのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder if they escaped already.

fields.EN:
Maybe... I'm sure Akazukin-san
freed them before we got here.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
きっと私たちが着く前に
赤ずきんさんが出したのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe... I'm sure Red Riding Hood
freed them before we got here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
All right. Looks like everyone's
free now. Let's head on over to
the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
よっし。全員解放したよね。
じゃあ、解放地区へ向かおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Looks like everyone's
free now. Let's head on over to
the Liberated District.

fields.JP: ええ！　ジャックは大丈夫？

fields.EN:
(We'll finally be able to return
to the human world again...!)
fields.JP:
（僕たち、これでまた
　人間の世界に戻れるんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We'll finally be able to leave
this place!)

fields.EN:
Hey, wait a second. Looks like
we got company!
fields.JP: ちょっと待った！　また来たよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wait a second. Looks like
we got company!

fields.EN:
(Her eyes are back to normal
again...)
fields.JP:
（さっきまでピンクだった目の色が……
　元に戻った……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her eyes are back to normal
again...)

fields.EN:
(When her eyes turned pink after
being tortured, it looked like she
was in pain, but...)
fields.JP:
（拷問を受けて目の色がピンクになった時は
　いつも苦しそうだったのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When her eyes turned pink after
being tortured, it looked like she
was in pain, but...)

fields.EN:
Surprised? But wasn't it fun,
entering your Genocide state?
fields.JP:
びっくりした？
でも、楽しかったでしょ？
『ジェノサイド化』するの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surprised? But wasn't it fun,
entering your Massacre state?

fields.EN:
Genocide...? You mean that fit I
had earlier?
fields.JP:
『ジェノサイド化』って……
今の発作のこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Massacre...? You mean that fit I
had earlier?

fields.EN:
Yup. For some reason, when we're
covered in a lot of Marchen blood,
there are times we enter that state.
fields.JP:
うん、そう。
メルヒェンの血をたくさん浴びると
何故かそうなれる時があってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, that. For some reason, if a
lot of Marchen blood gets on you,
you'll enter that state.

fields.EN:
You can just hack and slash
Marchens like they're nothing! 
After the rush, you revert back.
fields.JP:
いつもよりスパスパーっとメルヒェン倒せるんだ！
だからスッキリすると元に戻るんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can just hack and slash
Marchens like they're nothing! 
After the rush, you revert back.

fields.EN:
So you're telling me that I felt
good after killing those Marchens,
and that's why I'm back to normal?
fields.JP:
え……じゃあ、メルヒェンを倒して
すっきりした気持ちになったから、
わたし、元に戻ったというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling me that I felt
good after killing those Marchens,
and that's why I'm back to normal?

fields.EN: Yup, yup! Doesn't it feel good?
fields.JP:
そうそう。
スカッとしてない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, yup! Doesn't it feel good?

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Alice like this
before...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Alice like this
before...)

fields.EN:
Just because you feel good doesn't
mean that your Corruption's
lifted, so be careful.
fields.JP:
スカッとしたからって
『穢れ』が消えたわけじゃないから……
気を抜かないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just because you feel good doesn't
mean that your Corruption's
lifted, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Corruption? What do you mean by
that?
fields.JP:
『穢れ』……？
それは、どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corruption? What do you mean by
that?

fields.EN: It's best that you not know now...
fields.JP: まだ……知らない方が、いいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's best that you not know now...

fields.EN:
Now then, let's hurry and get out
of here before more Marchens
find us!
fields.JP:
ほらほら！
またメルヒェンに見つかっちゃう前に
さっさと行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's hurry and get out
of here before more Marchens
find us!

fields.JP:
…………ジャック。
何だか様子が変だわ……

fields.EN:
You're right... This place looks
darker than usual...
fields.JP:
ほんとだ。
あたりが暗くなってきたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... This place looks
darker than usual...

fields.EN:
Everyone! The city's just up
ahead! Run with all you've got!
Now!
fields.JP:
みんな！
このまままっすぐ行けば、街に着くから！
全力で走って！　早く！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! The city's just up
ahead! Run with all you've got!
Now!

fields.EN: Just run! Do you want to die?!
fields.JP:
いいから早く走って！
死にたいわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Just run! Do you want to die?!

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、何が起きたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's going on, Red Riding Hood?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It's a Nightmare! It's a monster
that'll keep reviving, even if
it's been knocked down!
fields.JP:
『ナイトメア』だよ！
何度でも蘇る化け物なんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a Nightmare! It's a monster
that'll keep reviving, even if
it's been knocked down!

fields.EN:
A Nightmare?! I've never heard of
anything like that before!
fields.JP:
ナイトメア！？
聞いたことない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare?! I've never heard of
anything like that before!

fields.EN:
There's no way to defeat it! Just
hurry up and run!
fields.JP:
あいつは絶対倒せない！
とにかく今は逃げるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way to defeat it! Just
hurry up and run!

fields.EN:
Our group's been hit! We need to
save them!
fields.JP:
……犠牲が出たわ！
助けなきゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our group's been hit! We need to
save them!

fields.EN:
Leave them! We have to get out of
here, now!
fields.JP: 諦めて！　今はとにかく逃げるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave them! We have to get out of
here, now!

fields.EN:
*huff* *huff* Looks like we got
away... The exit is right ahead.
fields.JP:
はあ……はあ……
どうにか逃げられたみたいだね……！
出口はもうすぐ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*huff* *huff* Looks like we got
away... The exit is right ahead.

fields.EN:
*huff* *huff* That thing... What
was that?! Are Nightmares any
different from Marchens?!
fields.JP:
はあ……はあ……
あれは……『ナイトメア』って何なんだ！？
メルヒェンとは違うの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*huff* *huff* That thing... What
was that?! Are Nightmares any
different from Marchens?!

fields.EN:
A Nightmare is like a boss-class
Marchen. The only thing you can do
is run from it...
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは、メルヒェンの親玉みたいなやつ
なんだ……会ったら逃げるしかない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare is like a boss-class
Marchen. The only thing you can do
is run from it...

fields.EN:
*huff* *huff* We lost some of the
prisoners who were with us... Can
not even a Blood Maiden beat it?!
fields.JP:
はあ……はあ……
やられた人もいたわ……！
血式少女でも倒せないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*huff* *huff* We lost some of the
prisoners who were with us... Can
not even a Blood Maiden beat it?!

fields.EN:
It's impossible... Like I said
before, you can't beat it... It'll
just keep reviving itself...
fields.JP:
……無理だよ。
誰にも倒せないって……何度でも蘇ってくるって
そう言ったじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's impossible... Like I said
before, you can't beat it... It'll
just keep reviving itself...

fields.EN:
So you freed the prisoners,
knowing there was a monster like
that lurking around?!
fields.JP:
あんなのがいるって知ってて
みんなを危険に晒したっていうの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you freed the prisoners,
knowing there was a monster like
that lurking around?!

fields.EN:
What?! Did you want to die
instead?! Or was it better being
locked up in a prison cell?!
fields.JP:
じゃああんた、代わりに死ねば満足だった！？
それともずっと牢屋に閉じ込められてた方が
よかった！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Did you want to die
instead?! Or was it better being
locked up in a prison cell?!

fields.EN:
I didn't expect it! I never thought
it'd appear this close to the exit!
Even I've never been that close to one!
fields.JP:
想定外だったんだってば！
あいつがこんな出口付近に出るなんて！
あたしだってあんなに近づいたの、初めてだし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect it to appear! I've
never seen one that close before!

fields.EN:
But... But how were you planning
on escaping with that kind of
monster around?!
fields.JP:
でも！　……だったら！
あんなのがいるのに、
どうやってここを脱出するっていうの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... But how were you planning
on escaping with that kind of
monster around?!

fields.EN:
No one's ever been able to beat one!
If you encounter one, all you can do
is somehow evade it and run!
fields.JP:
今まであいつを倒せた奴なんていないんだ！
あいつに遭ったら、どうにかかわして
逃げるしかないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one's been able to beat one! We
got lucky this time. It was all we
could do to escape!

fields.EN:
I don't like it... I don't want to
just run away like this, either!
fields.JP:
あたしだって……くやしいよ！
くやしくないわけ、ないじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't like it... I don't want to
just run away like this, either!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: はーーーっ。はーーーっ……

fields.EN:
Shoot! She entered Blood Skelter!
Let's get out of here, Jack!
fields.JP:
まずい！　ブラッドスケルター化した！
ジャック、逃げるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! She entered Blood Skelter!
Let's get out of here, Jack!

fields.EN:
But, Alice...! She looks like
she's in pain! I need to help her!
fields.JP:
でも！　アリスが……！
あんなに苦しそうに！！
アリスを助けなきゃ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, Alice...! She looks like
she's in pain! I need to help her!

fields.EN:
Not now! Alice isn't her usual
self anymore! Stay here any longer
and it'll be good night to you!
fields.JP:
ダメだってば！
今のアリスは正気じゃないんだ！
あんただってやられちゃうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not now! Alice isn't her usual
self anymore! Stay here any longer
and it'll be good night to you!

fields.JP:
じゃあ、どうなるんだよ！？
アリスは……！

fields.EN:
You can't return to normal from
Blood Skelter! She's become a monster
that attacks anyone until she collapses!
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化は元に戻せない！
倒れるまで誰彼構わず攻撃する
化け物になっちゃったんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not going to snap out of it!
She'll attack everything until she
dies... even you!

fields.EN:
That's why... I said you didn't
need to know yet...
fields.JP: だから……まだ知らなくていいって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping she wouldn't end up
like this so soon...

fields.JP: ……あはははははははははははははは……！！

fields.EN:
There's nothing we can do for her now!
That's not Alice anymore!
fields.JP:
ああなったらもう、
あたしたちにはどうにもできない！
あれはもう、アリスじゃないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing we can do for her!
This isn't the Alice you knew
before!

fields.EN:
The only thing we can do is end
her right here and now...
fields.JP: せめて……終わらせてやるしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only thing we can do is end
her right here and now...

fields.JP:
そんなのダメだ！
アリス……！
アリス！　僕だ！　ジャックだ！
ひゃははははははは！　あはははははは……！！

fields.EN:
Alice...! Get a hold... of
yourself...! Alice...!
fields.JP:
……アリス！　目を……覚まして……！
アリス……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice...! Get a hold... of
yourself...! Alice...!

fields.EN:
I don't believe it... She's
back...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe it... She's
back...

fields.EN:
Thank goodness... you're back...
Are you... okay?
fields.JP:
よかった……気がついたんだ……
もう……苦しくない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness... you're back...
Are you... okay?

fields.JP:
ジャック……！
こんな怪我をさせたのは……
わたし……どうして……何てこと……
こんなの……何てこと、ないよ……

fields.EN:
She actually came out of her Blood
Skelter state... I need to report
this to Dad...
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化して元に戻るなんて……
……お父さんに、報告しなきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She actually came out of her Blood
Skelter state... I need to report
this to Dad...

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san...? Alice... is
back to normal, right? Is she...
going to be okay?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん……
アリス……元に戻っただろう？
もう、大丈夫だよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood...? Alice... is
back to normal, right? Is she...
going to be okay?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Can you get up, Jack? Grab a hold
of me.
fields.JP:
ほら、ジャック。歩ける？
あたしにつかまって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you get up, Jack? Grab a hold
of me.

fields.EN:
C'mon, follow me, Alice! The
exit's not too far from here.
fields.JP:
……ほら、アリスも行くよ！
このまま行けば、出口はすぐそこだからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, follow me, Alice! The
exit's not too far from here.

fields.EN:
All right... That should do the
trick.
fields.JP: ……はい。とりあえずもういいわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right... That should do the
trick.

fields.JP:
ありがとうございます
あの……

fields.EN: Is Jack going to be okay?
fields.JP: ジャックの怪我は……大丈夫なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is Jack going to be okay?

fields.EN:
Yes. He was bleeding, but it
wasn't as bad as expected. He does
have mild anemia, though.
fields.JP:
ええ。出血はひどかったようだけど、
見た目程ひどくはないわ。
少し貧血を起こしてるようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. He was bleeding, but it
wasn't as bad as expected. He does
have mild anemia, though.

fields.EN: I stopped the bleeding, so it should subside soon. Still, I think we should treat him properly later, just to be safe.
fields.JP:
止血をしておいたから、出血もじきに止まるわ。
まあ、念のため後できちんと処置をした方が
いいとは思うけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's all patched up, so the
bleeding should subside shortly.
I'll be back to check on him.

fields.EN: Um... Please take care of him!
fields.JP: あの……よろしくお願いします！

fields.EN:
She's doing fine. Not bad for her
first fight. I mean, she did fight
them, right?
fields.JP:
彼女の方は怪我はしてないわ。
初戦にしては上出来じゃない。
……戦ったんでしょ？　彼女
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's doing fine. Not bad for her
first fight. I mean, she did fight
them, right?

fields.EN:
She sure did! Alice was a lot
stronger than I thought! I think
we hit the jackpot with her!
fields.JP:
そーそー！　そーなんだよ！
アリス、思ってたよりずっと凄かったんだ！
すごいめっけものだと思う！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She sure did! Alice was a lot
stronger than I thought! I think
we hit the jackpot with her!

fields.EN:
(I know she rescued us from
prison, but the way she said that
just now felt kind of rude...)
fields.JP:
（確かに牢獄からは救い出してもらったけど……
　『めっけもの』だなんて、
　そういう言い方、嫌だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she rescued us from
prison, but the way she said that
just now felt kind of rude...)

fields.EN:
In any case, let me introduce
them! This girl here is Alice.
She's an actual Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
というわけで、改めて紹介するね！
この子がアリス。
正真正銘の『血式少女』だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, let me introduce
them! This girl here is Alice.
She's an actual Blood Maiden!

fields.EN: The guy here is Jack. He's, um...
fields.JP:
それから、こっちはジャック。
えーと……
fields.LOCALIZED: The guy here is Jack. He's, um...

fields.EN:
Why didn't you leave him here with
the others who escaped? Why
did you bring him here?
fields.JP:
彼は何故、一緒に連れて来たのかね？
逃げてきた人たちと一緒ではなく？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why didn't you leave him here with
the others who escaped? Why
did you bring him here?

fields.EN:
(That's right... It's not like she
came looking for me or anything.)
fields.JP:
（……そうだった。
　僕はアリスのように、求められて来た
　わけじゃないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... It's not like she
came looking for me or anything.)

fields.EN:
Oh, well, about that... Dad, I
have something to report to you!
fields.JP:
そうそう！
そのことでね、お父さんに報告があるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, well, about that... Dad, I
have something to report to you!

fields.EN:
...So you're telling me she ended
her Blood Skelter state by
attacking that boy there?
fields.JP:
……ブラッドスケルター化した彼女が、
この少年を斬りつけたことで正常化した、と？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So you're telling me she ended
her Blood Skelter state by
attacking that boy there?

fields.EN:
It... It's true! Alice won't be
like that anymore! She's not going
to harm anyone!
fields.JP:
ほ……本当なんです！
アリスはもうおかしくなんかありません！
誰も傷つけたりなんか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It... It's true! Alice won't be
like that anymore! She's not going
to harm anyone!

fields.EN:
"Jack-kun," was it? Don't worry. I can
tell she's back to normal.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、だったか。
心配しなくてもいい。
現在の彼女が正常なのはわかっているからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Jack," was it? Don't worry. I can
tell she's back to normal.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
It's no surprise everyone's
doubtful, and I do have more
questions to ask...
fields.JP:
皆が驚くのも無理はないだろうし、
私自身も知りたいことは山程あるのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no surprise everyone's
doubtful, and I do have more
questions to ask...

fields.EN:
In any case... Jack-kun and Alice-kun,
welcome to the Dawn.
fields.JP:
ともかく……この『黎明』へようこそ。
ジャックくん、アリスくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case... Jack and Alice,
welcome to the Dawn.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun; ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
"Dawn" is short for the "Dawn
Liberation Force."
fields.JP: 正式には黎明解放戦線……通称『黎明』だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Dawn" is short for the "Dawn
Liberation Force."

fields.EN:
Think of it as an autonomous
organization formed to oppose the
Marchens in the Jail.
fields.JP:
このジェイル内で
メルヒェン達に対抗するために結成された、
人間たちの自治組織といったところかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think of it as an autonomous
organization formed to oppose the
Marchens in the Jail.

fields.EN:
All the basic functions of a city
can be found here. It's also where
those who escape can survive.
fields.JP:
一応ここは、基本的な街の機能が整っているの。
……逃げるのに成功した人たちの受け皿に
なるためにもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the basic functions of a city
can be found here. It's also where
those who escape can survive.

fields.EN: The functions of a city? Wow...
fields.LOCALIZED: The functions of a city? Wow...

fields.EN:
And this place is the Dawn's
headquarters.
fields.JP:
そして今あなた達がいるここが、
黎明の本部というわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And this place is the Dawn's
headquarters.

fields.EN:
It's the last fortress around for
us humans.
fields.JP: ま、言ってみりゃ人間たちの最後の砦ってとこだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the last fortress around for
us humans.

fields.EN:
"Last" isn't quite accurate. The
Dawn exists to find a way of
escaping from the Jail.
fields.JP:
『最後』はないだろう、製造士くん。
我々黎明は、ジェイルそのものからの脱出を
志しているのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Last" isn't quite accurate. The
Dawn exists to find a way of
escaping from the Jail.

fields.JP: ジェイルからの……脱出ですか！？

fields.EN:
You do know the basics of what the
Jail is, right?
fields.JP:
ジェイルの基礎的な生態に関しては
知っているね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do know the basics of what the
Jail is, right?

fields.EN:
Not in much detail... Only that it's
alive, and that this place formed by
absorbing the city that used to be here...
fields.JP:
あまり詳しくは……。
ここに元々あった街を取り込んでできた
場所で、生きてるってことぐらいしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not in detail, but I heard it
consumed a city that used to be
above ground. That it's alive...

fields.EN:
And also that the Marchens were
originally humans and animals...
fields.JP:
後は、メルヒェンが元は人間や動物だったこと
くらいかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And also that the Marchens were
originally humans and animals...

fields.EN:
Hm... One minor correction. The
Jail's consumption of the organic
and inorganic is called Mimicry.
fields.JP:
ふむ……まず、ジェイルが有機物や無機物を
取り込む現象のことを『擬態』という
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... One minor correction. The
Jail's consumption of the organic
and inorganic is called Mimicry.

fields.EN: To be precise, the Jail sends its own information into the target and transforms it.
fields.JP:
正確には、ジェイルの持つ情報を送り込んで
対象を変容させているのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be exact, the Jail is able to
absorb information from a subject
to alter its own form.

fields.EN:
The clearest example is the Marchens.
Like Alice-kun said, they were once humans
or animals, transformed by the Jail through Mimicry...
fields.JP:
その最たるものがメルヒェンだ。
アリスくんの言う通り、人間や動物だったものが
ジェイルに『擬態』させられ変容した存在……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most prominently affected are the
Marchens. Like Alice said, their
forms were altered by the Jail.

fields.EN:
And there are Nightmares, a higher species
with immortality. They're a major obstacle
to our escape plan.
fields.JP:
そして、その上位種として不死性を持つ
ナイトメアがおり、我々の脱出計画の大きな
妨げとなっているのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leading them are the Nightmares,
who never die. They're the major
obstacle in our plan to escape.

fields.EN:
The Dawn is, so to speak, a
crystal of knowledge for us humans
shut in this dark world.
fields.JP:
黎明は謂わば、
この閉ざされた世界で人間達に残された
叡智の結晶なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Dawn is, so to speak, a
crystal of knowledge for us humans
shut in this dark world.

fields.EN:
Our mission is to use our research
to escape. Through that research,
we discovered the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
我々は日々ジェイルの生態を研究し、
脱出のための方策と力を蓄えている。
その中で発見されたのが『血式少女』なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our mission is to use our research
to escape. Through that research,
we discovered the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens display combat abilities
stronger than ordinary humans—enough
to take on a Marchen alone.
fields.JP:
『血式少女』たちは、通常の人間よりも
強い戦闘能力を発揮する。
メルヒェンを単騎で相手取れる程にね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maidens are humans who
possess supernatural powers, which
allow them to face the Marchens.

fields.EN:
You already know this after
fighting them, right, Alice?
fields.JP:
アリス。
君も戦ってみて、そのことはわかったでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You already know this after
fighting them, right, Alice?

fields.EN:
Do you know about the tower in the
middle of the Jail?
fields.JP:
このジェイルの中心部にそびえ立つ塔が
わかるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you know about the tower in the
middle of the Jail?

fields.EN:
We found out that this tower grows
upward through some special
means.
fields.JP:
あの塔は、ある方法で上へ上へと成長することが
研究でわかったのだよ。……そこで
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found out that this tower grows
upward through some special
means.

fields.EN:
If we can grow it high enough, we
can escape to the surface. That's
where the Blood Maidens come in.
fields.JP:
あの塔を地上まで伸ばし、そこから脱出を試みる。
それが私たちの作戦行動だ。
そして欠かせないのが『彼女』たちの力なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we can grow it high enough, we
can escape to the surface. That's
where the Blood Maidens come in.

fields.EN:
(I can't believe what I'm
hearing... Are they serious? Is
that even possible?)
fields.JP:
（そんな……とてつもない方法が……
　この人たちは本気なんだろうか？
　それとも本当にそんなことが可能なんだろうか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe what I'm
hearing... Are they serious? Is
that even possible?)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun

fields.EN:
You are, without a doubt, a Blood
Maiden. We want you to help us,
and that's why we sent her in.
fields.JP:
君は間違いなく『血式少女』だ。
どうか君の力を我々に貸してほしい。
そのためにあの子を迎えにやったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are, without a doubt, a Blood
Maiden. We want you to help us,
and that's why we sent her in.

fields.EN:
Mind me, I'm getting ahead of
myself. We haven't even made
introductions yet.
fields.JP:
おっと。話が性急に過ぎたか。
こちらの自己紹介もまだだったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind me, I'm getting ahead of
myself. We haven't even made
introductions yet.

fields.EN:
I'm the leader of the research
team, and the oldest one here.
Everyone calls me "Professor."
fields.JP:
私は研究チームのリーダーを務めていてね。
おそらくはここでの最年長になるかな。
『博士』と呼ばれている。皮肉かもしれんがね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm the leader of the research
team, and the oldest one here.
Everyone calls me "Professor."

fields.EN:
The fine lady there is the leader
of the rescue unit, Miko-kun.
fields.JP:
そして、彼女は救護班のリーダーを務める
視子くんだ。彼女は――
fields.LOCALIZED:
The fine lady there is the leader
of the rescue unit, Miko.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN: Ueshima Miko. Nice to meet you again. I'm also responsible for looking after the health of you Blood Maidens. If anything seems wrong, come see me anytime.
fields.JP:
上島視子よ。改めてよろしく。
あなた達『血式少女』の体調管理も務めてるの。
異変があったら、いつでも相談に来て頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko Ueshima. I'm also in charge
of keeping you in good shape. Let
me know if you don't feel well.

fields.EN:
I'm the craftsman here. Come and
see me for weapons and things.
fields.JP:
んで、俺は『製造士』だ。
武器のことは俺に言え
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm the craftsman here. Come and
see me for weapons and things.

fields.EN:
Wow! Unfriendly as usual, aren't
you, Haru-san? Oh, his name's "Haru-san,"
by the way!
fields.JP:
もう！　ハルさんは無愛想だなあ！
この人の名前、ハルさんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow! Unfriendly as usual, aren't
you, Haru? Oh, his name's "Haru,"
by the way!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Hey! Don't blab that or I'll kill you,
you idiot hood!
fields.JP: てめ！　バラすな殺すぞバカ頭巾！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Don't go talkin' for me, you
hooded idiot!

fields.EN:
You don't have to be shy just
because your name sounds cute,
Haru-san! Wait... I'm not an idiot!
fields.JP:
ハルさん、
名前可愛いからって照れなくてもいーじゃん！
ていうかバカ頭巾言うな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to be shy just
because your name sounds cute,
Haru! Wait... I'm not an idiot!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Great to see you finally smile,
Jack. Now then... You already know
me, but I'm Akazukin.
fields.JP:
ジャック、やっと笑ったね。
……で、改めて。あたしは赤ずきん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great to see you finally smile,
Jack. Now then... You already know
me, but I'm Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
I'm the very first Blood Maiden,
so I'm like your older sister. I
hope we can get along!
fields.JP:
最初の血式少女だから、お姉さん。
……よろしくね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm the very first Blood Maiden,
so I'm like your older sister. I
hope we can get along!

fields.EN:
Um, you mentioned you're the "very
first," so does that mean there
are others?
fields.JP:
あの……！
『最初の』ってことは、
血式少女って何人もいるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you mentioned you're the "very
first," so does that mean there
are others?

fields.EN:
What is a "Blood Maiden?" What am
I...?
fields.JP:
それに……『血式少女』って
何なんですか！？
わたし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is a "Blood Maiden?" What am
I...?

fields.EN: What are 'Blood Maidens'? Let's call it an eternal mystery. Are they mutants bestowed upon us by God, or—
fields.JP:
『血式少女』とは何か。
それは永遠の謎とでも言っておこうか。
神が我々に与えた突然変異体なのか、それとも――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just say it's something
we'll never really know. Maybe
it's the will of the gods, or...

fields.EN: If such a thing as God exists, that is.
fields.JP: 神というものが存在するならば、ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that could be a possibility
if there were such a thing as a
god.

fields.EN:
(If there were such a thing as a
god...)
fields.JP: （『神というものが存在するならば』……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If there were such a thing as a
god...)

fields.EN:
Professor? I think you've taken
enough of their time. I'm sure
they're quite tired.
fields.JP:
博士。そろそろいいのでは？
彼らも疲れているでしょうし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? I think you've taken
enough of their time. I'm sure
they're quite tired.

fields.EN:
Ah, you're right. I got a bit
carried away. Well then, Miko-kun,
could you take it from here?
fields.JP:
おお、そうだな。
つい熱くなってしまい、済まなかった。
……視子くん、後は頼んだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, you're right. I got a bit
carried away. Well then, Miko,
could you take it from here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
My pleasure. Jack, Alice. Please
follow me.
fields.JP:
はい。
ジャックとアリスだったわね。
一緒に来てちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
My pleasure. Jack, Alice. Please
follow me.

fields.EN:
Alice-kun... Your questions can be
answered in time. Why don't you
rest first?
fields.JP:
アリスくん。
答えはゆっくりで構わんよ。
まずはゆっくり休みたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... Your questions can be
answered in time. Why don't you
rest first?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun

fields.EN:
Akazukin, can I borrow you
for a moment?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん。ちょっといいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, can I borrow you
for a moment?

fields.EN:
Let's get our questions answered
later. You're back to normal, and
they all seem like nice people.
fields.JP:
……また改めて聞いてみようよ。
君は元に戻ったんだし、
ここの人たちも、悪い人たちじゃなさそうだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get our questions answered
later. You're back to normal, and
they all seem like nice people.

fields.EN: Okay, Jack... If you say so.
fields.JP: ええ……ジャックがそれでいいなら
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, Jack... If you say so.

fields.EN:
And, they're right... You must be
so tired.
fields.JP:
それに……そうね。
あなた、とても疲れている筈だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, they're right... You must be
so tired.

fields.JP: 僕は大丈夫だよ、アリス

fields.EN:
Alice, I'll ask you one more time.
Did you really enter Blood
Skelter?
fields.JP:
アリス。もう一度聞くわ。
……あなた、
本当にブラッドスケルター化したの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, I'll ask you one more time.
Did you really enter Blood
Skelter?

fields.EN: It seems as if that's the case...
fields.LOCALIZED: It seems as if that's the case...

fields.EN:
(She doesn't need to be so
blunt... Alice has suffered
enough already...)
fields.JP:
（そ、そんなにはっきり聞かなくたって！
　アリスはただでさえ苦しんでるのに……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't need to be so
blunt... Alice has suffered
enough already...)

fields.EN:
Um! Is there something you need
from Alice?!
fields.JP: あの！　アリスが何か！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um! Is there something you need
from Alice?!

fields.EN:
Jack. I'm examining Alice right now.
Could you stay out of this and wait?
fields.JP:
ジャック。今はアリスを診ているの。
男の子は顔を出さないで待っててくれるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I'm diagnosing Alice now.
I would appreciate it if you would
stay calm and wait your turn.

fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジャック。
わたしは大丈夫だから……

fields.EN:
I was in pain when it happened,
and I couldn't control myself...
When I came to, I saw Jack...
fields.JP:
あの時……いきなり苦しくてたまらなくなって
自分でも自分が抑えられなくて……
気がついたら、目の前にジャックがいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was in pain when it happened,
and I couldn't control myself...
When I came to, I saw Jack...

fields.EN:
He was bleeding so much from
wounds I'm sure I caused. His
blood was on me too, and...!
fields.JP:
わたしが傷つけたとしか思えない傷を負って、
血をたくさん流してました。
わたしにもその返り血がべったりと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was bleeding so much from
wounds I'm sure I caused. His
blood was on me too, and...!

fields.EN: Jack...! What did I do to you?!
fields.JP:
ジャック……！
わたし、何てことを……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack...! What did I do to you?!

fields.EN:
Calm down. What you experienced
is what happens when someone
enters Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
落ち着いて。
それは『ブラッドスケルター化』が引き起こした
現象なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down. What you experienced
is what happens when someone
enters Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
You could call it the price paid for
the Blood Maidens' superhuman abilities...
their greatest weakness.
fields.JP:
血式少女の超人的な能力との引き換えともいえる
……最大の弱点なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It imparts unimaginable power to
Blood Maidens... In other words,
it's a Blood Maiden's weakness.

fields.EN:
And a Blood Maiden needs a large
amount of Marchen blood on her to
enter a Genocide state.
fields.JP:
まず前提として、血式少女はメルヒェンの血を
大量に浴びることで『ジェノサイド化』できるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And a Blood Maiden needs a large
amount of Marchen blood on her to
enter a Massacre state.

fields.EN:
When the Marchen blood got on you,
did you feel any different?
fields.JP:
あなた、メルヒェンの血を浴びた時
何か心身の異状は感じなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the Marchen blood got on you,
did you feel any different?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it... I started
to lose my mind, and a violence
was growing inside of me...
fields.JP:
……そういえば、何だか心が乱れて……
凶暴な衝動が湧き上がってきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it... I started
to lose my mind, and a violence
was growing inside of me...

fields.EN:
I felt hatred, I wanted to
destroy, I wanted everything to
end...
fields.JP:
憎しみや、破壊したい気持ちが膨らんで、
……全てを終わらせたいような気持ちに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt hatred, I wanted to
destroy, I wanted everything to
end...

fields.EN:
(Alice was keeping all those
feelings inside of her this whole
time...?)
fields.JP:
（アリス……そんな苦しさを
　今まで一人で抱えてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice was keeping all those
feelings inside of her this whole
time...?)

fields.EN:
That's the warning sign of Genocide.
When a Blood Maiden is bathed in Marchen
blood and feels those abnormalities, symptoms appear in her eyes.
fields.JP:
それが『ジェノサイド化』の前兆よ。
メルヒェンの血を浴び、その異状を感じた時、
血式少女の瞳に症状があらわれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a sign of entering
Massacre. You can see the proof in
a Blood Maiden's eyes.

fields.EN:
(Symptoms in the eyes... So the state
where her eyes turn pink—the thing I
thought was a 'fit'—was actually that...)
fields.JP:
（瞳に症状が……『発作』だと思っていた
　目がピンク色になる状態のことだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her eyes... I thought she was
just going into a fit...)

fields.EN:
Entering their Genocide state
draws out the latent power from
within a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイド化することで、
血式少女はより高い戦闘能力を発揮することが
できる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Entering their Massacre state
draws out the latent power from
within a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
But continuously being exposed to
Marchen blood isn't all good.
fields.JP:
でも、メルヒェンの血を浴びて起こるのは、
決して良い作用ばかりではないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But continuously being exposed to
Marchen blood isn't all good.

fields.EN:
It leads to accumulation of
Corruption, which triggers their
Blood Skelter state.
fields.JP:
それが、『穢れ』を受けて発生する現象、
『ブラッドスケルター化』なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It leads to accumulation of
Corruption, which triggers their
Blood Skelter state.

fields.EN:
That's right. When a Blood Maiden is
mentally unstable—for example, after a
major shock—Corruption builds up inside her body.
fields.JP:
そう。血式少女が精神的に不安な状態……
たとえば何か大きなショックを受けたりすると、
体内に『穢れ』が蓄積されるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It gauges the instability of a
Blood Maiden's mental state. A
shock can also raise Corruption.

fields.EN: Once Corruption exceeds a certain threshold, being bathed in blood will make a Blood Maiden lose her reason and go berserk...
fields.JP:
そして『穢れ』の量が一定値を超えた状態で
血を浴びると、理性を失い暴走してしまう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once Corruption reaches a certain
limit, she'll lose her mind and
go on a rampage.

fields.EN:
(So this "Blood Skelter" state is
when a Blood Maiden loses her
sanity?)
fields.JP:
（理性を失った暴走状態……
　それが『ブラッドスケルター化』……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So this "Blood Skelter" state is
when a Blood Maiden loses her
sanity?)

fields.EN:
Alice, what surprised us is that
you came out of Blood Skelter. No
one's been able to do that before.
fields.JP:
私たちが驚いたのはね、アリス。
ブラッドスケルター化した血式少女が
元に戻った例がこれまでに無かったからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, what surprised us is that
you came out of Blood Skelter. No
one's been able to do that before.

fields.EN:
(I see... So that's why Akazukin-san was so surprised. But what
happens when they don't recover?)
fields.JP:
（そうだったんだ……
　だから赤ずきんさんは、あんなに驚いてたんだ。
　でも、だとしたら、元に戻らなかった子は？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So that's why Red Riding
Hood was so surprised. But what
happens when they don't recover?)
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(I want to ask, but I'm scared to
know the answer...)
fields.JP: （聞いてみたい……けど、聞くのが怖い……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to ask, but I'm scared to
know the answer...)

fields.EN:
Is it safe to assume that I'm back
to normal? And I won't harm anyone
else anymore?
fields.JP:
……わたしは、本当に元に戻ったと……
言えるんですか？
わたしはもう、誰かを傷つけたりは……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it safe to assume that I'm back
to normal? And I won't harm anyone
else anymore?

fields.EN:
I can confirm that you are back to
normal.
fields.JP: 確かにあなたは元に戻ったわ。保証する。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can confirm that you are back to
normal.

fields.EN:
When Corruption accumulates, the
irises show distinct symptoms. I
don't see that now.
fields.JP:
『穢れ』が溜まると、瞳の虹彩に兆候が出るの。
でも今のあなたにはそれが残っていない
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Corruption accumulates, the
irises show distinct symptoms. I
don't see that now.

fields.EN: That said, I still can't believe it.
fields.LOCALIZED: That said, I still can't believe it.

fields.EN:
We've developed various medicines
to control Corruption, but none
have ever cured it completely.
fields.JP:
これまで、穢れを制御する試薬までは
開発できたけれど、完全に除去することは
不可能だったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've developed various medicines
to control Corruption, but none
have ever cured it completely.

fields.EN:
Alice. Do you know anything that
may have brought you back?
fields.JP:
アリス。
原因に何か思い当たることはない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice. Do you know anything that
may have brought you back?

fields.EN:
I remember feeling like I wanted
to destroy everything after
licking the walls in the prison...
fields.JP:
わたし……牢獄で受けた舐める拷問の後にも
凶暴な衝動が起きたことがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember feeling like I wanted
to destroy everything after
licking the walls in the prison...

fields.EN:
I suppose I was close to entering
this "Blood Skelter" state you're
talking about.
fields.JP:
多分、ブラッドスケルター化しかけて
いたんだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I was close to entering
this "Blood Skelter" state you're
talking about.

fields.EN:
It's possible that the walls had
Marchen blood on them.
fields.JP:
おそらくジェイルの壁にメルヒェンの血でも
付いてたんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's possible that the walls had
Marchen blood on them.

fields.EN:
And the shocking torture you
experienced raised your level of
Corruption...
fields.JP:
ええ、そして拷問によるショックで体内に
『穢れ』が蓄積された……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the shocking torture you
experienced raised your level of
Corruption...

fields.EN:
I always assumed it was some sort
of fit. Whenever it happened, Jack
would give me a bit of his blood.
fields.JP:
わたしはそれを何かの発作だとばかり思っていて、
その度にジャックが自分の血をわたしに与えて
くれていたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always assumed it was some sort
of fit. Whenever it happened, Jack
would give me a bit of his blood.

fields.EN:
When I lick Jack's blood, for some reason
my mind calms down and the fits subside.
That's how the two of us survived.
fields.JP:
ジャックの血を舐めると、何故か心が静かになって
発作もおさまっていたんです。
わたしたち、そうして二人で生き延びてきました
fields.LOCALIZED:
For some reason, I'm able to calm
down after licking his blood. That
was how we survived in the prison.

fields.JP:
視子。
こりゃ、なかなか興味深いんじゃねえか？

fields.EN:
Yes... I've never heard of
removing Corruption by licking
blood.
fields.JP:
そうね。血を舐めて『穢れ』が除去される
なんて聞いたことがないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I've never heard of
removing Corruption by licking
blood.

fields.EN:
But even if that's true, what does it
have to do with what happened this time...?
fields.JP:
でも、仮にそれが事実だったとして、
今回のこととの因果関係は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, assuming it is fact, there is
still no explanation as to why
it's effective.

fields.JP: あの……ちょっといいですか？

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh. Why, yes... I'm done with
Alice's diagnosis.
fields.JP:
え？　……ええ。
アリスの検査はもう終わったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh. Why, yes... I'm done with
Alice's diagnosis.

fields.EN:
It's just a hunch, but maybe Alice
came to her senses because my
blood splattered on her...
fields.JP:
ひょっとしてなんですけど……
僕の血がアリスにかかったから、
アリスは元に戻った
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a hunch, but maybe Alice
came to her senses because my
blood splattered on her...

fields.JP: ……というのは、考えられませんか？

fields.EN:
If your blood can affect Corruption not
only when licked, but when someone is
bathed in it as well...
fields.JP:
もしあなたの血が、舐めるだけでなく
浴びることでも『穢れ』に何らかの影響を
与えるとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If your blood could somehow affect
Corruption through a form of
contact aside from ingestion...

fields.EN:
Jack? Would you mind if I took some
blood samples from you?
fields.JP:
ジャック、
あなたの血を少し調べさせてもらえるかしら？
採血、させてもらうわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Would you mind if I took some
blood samples from you?

fields.EN:
Oh... Go ahead. I think it worked
because we've known each other
for a long time.
fields.JP:
あ……はい。
実はさっきまで、アリスは幼馴染の僕に安心して
落ち着けたんだとばかり思ってたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... Go ahead. I think it worked
because we've known each other
for a long time.

fields.EN:
But if my blood can assist your
cause, I'd be happy to help...
fields.JP: もし、僕の血が役に立つなら、嬉しいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if my blood can assist your
cause, I'd be happy to help...

fields.EN:
Though, I doubt my blood is
anything special... It's not like
I can fight like Alice can...
fields.JP:
でも、僕の血なんて特別なところがあるのかな……
僕はアリスたちのように、力を出すことだって
できないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though, I doubt my blood is
anything special... It's not like
I can fight like Alice can...

fields.EN:
That's why we're gonna take some
samples, kiddo.
fields.JP: ……ま、だから調べるんだろ、小僧？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we're gonna take some
samples, kiddo.

fields.EN:
Your blood may lead to an amazing
discovery. After all, Corruption
is an issue we need to resolve.
fields.JP:
これで何かがわかれば、誰にとっても良い報告が
できるかもしれないわ。
何しろ『穢れ』は見過ごせない問題なんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your blood may lead to an amazing
discovery. After all, Corruption
is an issue we need to resolve.

fields.EN:
The Professor was part of an early
search unit back in the day, but
there's a lot still unknown.
fields.JP:
……黎明ができたばかりの頃は、博士も調査隊の
一員として、ジェイル探索を行ったそうだけど、
あの中はまだ謎だらけなんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor was part of an early
search unit back in the day, but
there's a lot still unknown.

fields.EN:
(If that's the case, is it even
really possible to escape from
the Jail?)
fields.JP:
（そんな状態で、ジェイル脱出なんてことが
　本当にできるんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If that's the case, is it even
really possible to escape from
the Jail?)

fields.EN:
Hey, kiddo. Is there anything
that's bothering you?
fields.JP:
で、他に何か気になってたことはあるか？
……小僧、お前だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, kiddo. Is there anything
that's bothering you?

fields.EN:
Huh? Me?! Well, nothing in
particular...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Me?! Well, nothing in
particular...

fields.EN:
How about the wailing sounds
coming from the Jail?
fields.JP:
……ジェイルの鳴き声のことは？
ジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about the wailing sounds
coming from the Jail?

fields.EN:
That's right... For some reason,
I think I can hear and understand
the sounds coming from the Jail.
fields.JP:
……そうだ。
僕、昔からジェイルの鳴き声が聞き取れるような
気がしてたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... For some reason,
I think I can hear and understand
the sounds coming from the Jail.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure how to word it...
It's as if I know how it feels,
sort of...
fields.JP:
気持ちがわかるっていうか……
気のせいかもしれないですけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure how to word it...
It's as if I know how it feels,
sort of...

fields.EN:
Whether you think you can hear it
or not isn't important now.
fields.JP: ……ま、気のせいかどうかはこの際いいだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether you think you can hear it
or not isn't important now.

fields.EN:
Don't think too hard on it. Just
relax, all right? Anything else?
fields.JP:
そう思い詰めんなってことだよ
他には何かあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think too hard on it. Just
relax, all right? Anything else?

fields.EN:
Uh, well... The wailing from the
Jail is really annoying. It's like
someone's whispering next to me.
fields.JP:
いえ……その
ジェイルの鳴き声がうるさくて……
ずっと横で誰かに喋られてるみたいで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... The wailing from the
Jail is really annoying. It's like
someone's whispering next to me.

fields.EN:
I see... Well then, put these on.
They should help muffle whatever
it is you're hearing.
fields.JP:
……そうか。
それじゃ、これでも付けとけ。
ヘッドホンだ。こうすれば耳栓の代わりになるだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well then, put these on.
They should help muffle whatever
it is you're hearing.

fields.JP: ヘッドホン……ありがとうございます

fields.EN:
(What a day... Until yesterday, I
wouldn't have been able to imagine
what's happening now.)
fields.JP:
（……何だかいろいろあった日だったな
　昨日はこんなことが起きるなんて、
　思ってなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a day... Until yesterday, I
wouldn't have been able to imagine
what's happening now.)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I've never
slept in such a comfortable bed
before, either...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、
　こんなふかふかなベッドで寝るの、
　初めてだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I've never
slept in such a comfortable bed
before, either...)

fields.EN: (Back in the village where Alice and I grew up, there were no proper beds like this... We made do with beds pieced together from whatever we could find...)
fields.JP:
（昔、アリスと出会って一緒に育った村じゃ、
　こんな立派なベッドは無かったっけ……
　寄せ集めの物でどうにか作った寝床……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Back in the village where Alice
and I were raised, all we had were
a bunch of leftovers.)

fields.EN:
(But after being taken captive by
the Marchens, even those leftovers
felt like a luxury.)
fields.JP:
（でも、メルヒェンに捕まって、
　そんなのも贅沢だったって知ったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But after being taken captive by
the Marchens, even those leftovers
felt like a luxury.)

fields.EN: Alice! Run! I'll hold them off!
fields.JP:
アリス！　先に逃げて！
こいつは僕が食い止めるから……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice! Run! I'll hold them off!

fields.JP:
ジャック！　ジャック！！
目を開けて……！

fields.EN:
(I wasn't able to protect Alice...
I was powerless against the
Marchens, and we were captured...)
fields.JP:
（……あの時、僕はアリスを護れなかった。
　僕が無力なせいで、僕たちはメルヒェンに
　捕まってしまったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wasn't able to protect Alice...
I was powerless against the
Marchens, and we were captured...)

fields.EN:
(Alice... I hope you can at least
have a good night's rest.)
fields.JP: （アリス……ゆっくり休めてるといいけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice... I hope you can at least
have a good night's rest.)

fields.EN:
(Being like this reminds me of
when I was all alone...)
fields.JP:
（……こうしてると、独りぼっちだった頃を
　思い出す……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Being like this reminds me of
when I was all alone...)

fields.EN:
(When I opened my eyes, there was
a dead Marchen in front of me... I
think it had killed my parents...)
fields.JP:
（僕が憶えてる、一番最初の光景。
　目の前でメルヒェンが死んでて……
　両親は多分、そいつに殺されたんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When I opened my eyes, there was
a dead Marchen in front of me... I
think it had killed my parents...)

fields.EN:
(With all that's happened, I've
already forgotten what my parents'
faces looked like...)
fields.JP:
（父さんの顔も、母さんの顔も、
　僕は憶えてない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With all that's happened, I've
already forgotten what my parents'
faces looked like...)

fields.JP: 僕は……誰のことも護れない……

fields.EN: Um... Do your wounds still hurt?
fields.JP:
その……。
傷……まだ痛むかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Do your wounds still hurt?

fields.EN:
You were worried about it? I'm
fine, see? They patched me up
and...
fields.JP:
心配してくれたの？
大丈夫だよ。
ちゃんと治療もしてもらったし、それに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were worried about it? I'm
fine, see? They patched me up
and...

fields.EN:
That's not it! I just wanted to
apologize to you...
fields.JP:
違うの……！
わたし、きちんとあなたに謝りたくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it! I just wanted to
apologize to you...

fields.EN:
If I had just been able to hold
myself back... This wouldn't have
happened to you!
fields.JP:
わたしがあんなことにならなければ……
わたしが自分をしっかり抑えられていれば、
こんなことにはならなかったのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I had just been able to hold
myself back... This wouldn't have
happened to you!

fields.EN:
But, you didn't kill me or
anything, right?
fields.JP: でも、君は僕を殺さなかっただろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you didn't kill me or
anything, right?

fields.EN:
So, let's say it just happened and
move on, okay?
fields.JP: だからもう、このことは言うのはやめよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, let's say it just happened and
move on, okay?

fields.EN:
Oh, and Alice? If you weren't with
me, I don't think I would be alive
right now.
fields.JP:
それにね、アリス。
君がいなかったら僕は今まで生きてこれなかった
……そう思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and Alice? If you weren't with
me, I don't think I would be alive
right now.

fields.EN:
You've always supported me. If
anything, I'm the reason we were
captured.
fields.JP:
君は僕をいつだって支えてくれたし、
あの時だって、僕を置いて逃げなかった。
そのせいで君まで――
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've always supported me. If
anything, I'm the reason we were
captured.

fields.EN:
Stop, Jack. You protected me back
then...
fields.JP:
いいえ、ジャック。
わたし、あの時あなたがわたしを
庇ってくれたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop, Jack. You protected me back
then...

fields.EN:
You protected me when I was all
alone. That's why I can trust you,
and that's why I believe in you.
fields.JP:
独りぼっちで絡まれていたわたしを
庇ってくれたから……
わたし、あなただけは信じられると思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You protected me when I was all
alone. That's why I can trust you,
and that's why I believe in you.

fields.EN: That's why I was able to survive...
fields.JP: ……だから、今まで生きてこれたんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's why I was able to survive...

fields.EN:
I've decided to fight with Akazukin-san and everyone, to
escape from the Jail with you.
fields.JP:
だから……
あなたと一緒にジェイルから脱出するために……
わたし、赤ずきんさんたちと一緒に戦うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've decided to fight with Red
Riding Hood and everyone, to
escape from the Jail with you.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Alice... That means you might
have to go through even more
suffering.
fields.JP:
……アリス。
それじゃ君は、あんなに辛くて苦しそうな目に
いつまた遭うかわからないじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... That means you might
have to go through even more
suffering.

fields.EN:
You could die out there. Why don't
we just live here together like
before?
fields.JP:
それに、死んじゃうかもしれない。
そんなことになるなら、このままここで
生きていこうよ……また、ふたりでさ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could die out there. Why don't
we just live here together like
before?

fields.EN:
I'll be fine. I'm ready for
this... I was scared at first, but
I'm not scared anymore.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。
わたし、心が決まったの。
さっきまで怖かったけれど、もう怖くないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be fine. I'm ready for
this... I was scared at first, but
I'm not scared anymore.

fields.EN: So, please... Will you support me?
fields.LOCALIZED: So, please... Will you support me?

fields.EN:
(I can't protect anyone... I can't
help Alice, either...)
fields.JP:
（僕は、誰も護れない。
　アリスの力にはなれないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't protect anyone... I can't
help Alice, either...)

fields.EN:
Don't overdo it... Can you promise
me that you'll stay alive?
fields.JP:
無茶はしないで……絶対死なないって
約束してくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't overdo it... Can you promise
me that you'll stay alive?

fields.EN:
That said, you're worrying too
much. I was pretty strong back
there, wasn't I?
fields.JP:
……それに、少し大げさだわ。
わたし、結構強かったでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, you're worrying too
much. I was pretty strong back
there, wasn't I?

fields.EN:
Yeah, you're right... You are and
always were strong. I can confirm
that.
fields.JP:
うん……そうだね
アリスはいつだって強いよ。僕が保証する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you're right... You are and
always were strong. I can confirm
that.

fields.EN:
(I'm weak, I don't have any
powers, and I can't do anything,
but...)
fields.JP:
（僕には力なんて無くて、弱くて、
　何もできないけれど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm weak, I don't have any
powers, and I can't do anything,
but...)

fields.EN:
I'll support you, so please do
your best, Alice.
fields.JP: 応援するから……頑張ってね、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll support you, so please do
your best, Alice.

fields.EN:
Hey, it looks like everyone's
gathered.
fields.JP: やあ。みんなが集まってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, it looks like everyone's
gathered.

fields.JP: みんな、お腹をすかせているよ

fields.EN:
I see... They're hungry... Poor
things...
fields.JP: そう……お腹が空いてるの。かわいそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... They're hungry... Poor
things...

fields.EN:
That's right. Guess we've got to
feed them.
fields.JP:
そうさ。
みんなにごはんをあげないといけないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Guess we've got to
feed them.

fields.EN: Yes, we need to feed them...
fields.JP: そうね。ごはんをあげなくちゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, we need to feed them...

fields.EN:
(That's right... I was given a
room here at the Dawn...)
fields.JP:
（……そっか。ええと、『黎明』の……
　きのう僕にあてがわれた部屋、だっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I was given a
room here at the Dawn...)

fields.EN:
(Unlike Alice, I can't be of any
use to them here...)
fields.JP:
（アリスと違って、僕はここの役に立つわけ
　じゃないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Unlike Alice, I can't be of any
use to them here...)

fields.EN:
(Now that I'm fully rested, they
may come and ask me to leave...)
fields.JP:
（じゃあ一晩休んだだろうから、そろそろ
　出てけって言われたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I'm fully rested, they
may come and ask me to leave...)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I'm still in
these rags... I hope that was
okay...)
fields.JP:
（こ……こんな汚い格好で寝ちゃって、
　大丈夫だったのかな……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I'm still in
these rags... I hope that was
okay...)

fields.EN:
(The blanket! Is it dirty?! I hope
they're okay with it...)
fields.JP:
（布団！　布団、汚れてないかな！？
　大丈夫かな！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The blanket! Is it dirty?! I hope
they're okay with it...)

fields.JP: おっはよー！　ジャック！

あ！　お、おはようございます！
赤ずきんさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... G-Good morning, Red
Riding Hood!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Uh, so what's up with you flapping
that blanket all over the place?
Did you wet the bed?
fields.JP:
……って、あんた布団ひっくり返して
何やってんの？　おねしょでもした？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, so what's up with you flapping
that blanket all over the place?
Did you wet the bed?

fields.EN:
Whatever. Now then, here! Your
clothes!
fields.JP:
ま、いいや。
はい、これ着替え！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever. Now then, here! Your
clothes!

fields.JP:
き……着替え、ですか！？
どうして僕なんかに……？

fields.EN:
Huh? You wanna stay in those
rags?
fields.JP: え？　その格好のまんまでいたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You wanna stay in those
rags?

fields.EN:
Uh, well... Why me, though? It's
not like I can be of use here...
fields.JP:
え……いえ……その……
どうして僕なんかに、こんな……？
……僕は、何の役にも立たないのに？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... Why me, though? It's
not like I can be of use here...

fields.EN:
You know, I have no clue what's
going on in that little mind of
yours, but...
fields.JP:
……あんたが何気にしてんのか、
よくわかんないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I have no clue what's
going on in that little mind of
yours, but...

fields.EN:
I gave you your clothes, so hurry
up and put them on! Once you're
ready, come down and see my Dad!
fields.JP:
ま、とりあえず着替え、渡したからね！
準備できたら早くおいで！
お父さんが待ってるからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gave you your clothes, so hurry
up and put them on! Once you're
ready, come down and see my Dad!

fields.JP: ジャック。赤ずきんさんが……あ
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Did Red Riding Hood... Ah...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. Were you about to
change?
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい。
着替え中……だったかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. Were you about to
change?

fields.EN:
Good morning, Alice. I'm fine. I'm
done changing.
fields.JP:
アリス、おはよう。
大丈夫。もう着替え終わってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Alice. I'm fine. I'm
done changing.

fields.EN:
Wow... You've got new clothes,
too! You look great in them!
fields.JP:
わあ……君も服をもらったんだね！
すごく似合ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... You've got new clothes,
too! You look great in them!

fields.EN:
You... think so? You're looking
good too, Jack.
fields.JP:
……そう、かしら？
ジャックも似合っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You... think so? You're looking
good too, Jack.

fields.EN:
I can understand them
treating you well, Alice, but why
me?
fields.JP:
うん。アリスはともかく……どうして僕まで
こんなに良くしてもらえるんだろうって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can understand them
treating you well, Alice, but why
me?

fields.EN:
(Why'd I have to say that? I'll
only upset her...)
fields.JP:
（だめだ。こんな言い方をしたら、
　アリスが困るじゃないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why'd I have to say that? I'll
only upset her...)

fields.EN:
About that, I was wondering how
they had our clothes and rooms
ready so quickly.
fields.JP:
そのことなのだけれど、わたしも思ったの。
服も部屋も、何故こんな風に用意されて
いたのかしらって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
About that, I was wondering how
they had our clothes and rooms
ready so quickly.

fields.EN:
It's as if they knew we were going
to come...
fields.JP:
まるで、あらかじめ私たちが来ることを
知っていたみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's as if they knew we were going
to come...

fields.EN: They knew ahead of time, then?
fields.LOCALIZED: They knew ahead of time, then?

fields.EN:
I think... I mean, they knew my
name prior... I wonder...
fields.JP:
ええ。でなければ……
わたしの名前も初めから知っていたようだったし
……いったいどうして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think... I mean, they knew my
name prior... I wonder...

fields.EN:
One other thing. Just remember
that you're not useless or
anything, Jack.
fields.JP:
……覚えていて、ジャック。
あなたは決して不要な人なんかじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. Just remember
that you're not useless or
anything, Jack.

fields.EN: And I don't mean only to me.
fields.JP:
それはわたしにとって、という意味だけでは
ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need you, just like everyone
here needs you.

fields.EN:
I'll always be there to protect
you.
fields.JP: あなたに何かあった時は、わたしがきっと守る
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll always be there to protect
you.

fields.EN:
Saying this might worry you,
but... I feel like they're hiding
something.
fields.JP:
こう言うと、あなたは気にすると思うけれど……
でも……ここには何か、秘密がある気がするの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Saying this might worry you,
but... I feel like they're hiding
something.

fields.EN:
Something that we shouldn't
just believe in blindly...
fields.JP:
無条件に信じてはいけない何かが……
……だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something that we shouldn't
just believe in blindly...

fields.EN:
Thank you, Alice. I'm sorry for
bothering you like this. I'll be
careful next time.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、アリス。
気を遣わせてごめん……
僕も、気をつけるようにするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Alice. I'm sorry for
bothering you like this. I'll be
careful next time.

fields.EN:
I think we're in the same boat as
they are, trying to escape. Let's
just go along with them for now.
fields.JP:
でも、ここから脱出するという目的は、
今のところ一緒だと思う。
だから……ひとまず、呼び出しに応じよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think we're in the same boat as
they are, trying to escape. Let's
just go along with them for now.

fields.EN:
Yes... Well, it looks like they
want us at the Professor's
laboratory. Let's go.
fields.JP:
……ええ。そうね
博士の研究室……だそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Well, it looks like they
want us at the Professor's
laboratory. Let's go.

fields.JP: あの……昨日はありがとうございました
もー、ふたりとも遅いよー！

いや、構わんよ。
さて、早速だが……

fields.EN:
Do you mind if we take some blood
samples from you, Jack-kun? We want to
see how your blood calms Alice-kun's Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん。採血をさせてもらえるかね？
君の血液がアリスくんのブラッドスケルター化を
鎮めた因果関係を解明したくてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind if we take some blood
samples from you, Jack? We want to
see how it affects Blood Skelter.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-kun on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 | Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Um, well... They took my blood
samples yesterday at the Rescue
Center to experiment with...
fields.JP:
あの、ええと……
実は昨日、救護室で採血したんです。
……僕の血を調べてみるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... They took my blood
samples yesterday at the Rescue
Center to experiment with...

fields.EN:
Haha... You're right. With all
that's happened, I completely
forgot about it.
fields.JP:
……はっはっは。そういえばそうだったか。
何しろ異例なことばかりだったのでね、
私としたことが、すっかり忘れてしまっていたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha... You're right. With all
that's happened, I completely
forgot about it.

fields.EN: Dad, you forget things too easily.
fields.JP: お父さんは意外とそそっかしいからなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Dad, you forget things too easily.

fields.EN:
Come now, that's not true. I
suppose I'll speak with Miko-kun of
her results later, then.
fields.JP:
まぁ、そう言うな。
後で視子くんに結果を聞いてみるとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, that's not true. I
suppose I'll speak with Miko of
her results later, then.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.JP: ……はい。よろしくお願いします

fields.EN:
(Like Alice said, something's
wrong here. How can something like
that not get relayed properly?)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりアリスの言う通りだ。
　そんなことも伝わってないなんて、
　ここは何かがおかしい気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Like Alice said, something's
wrong here. How can something like
that not get relayed properly?)

fields.EN:
Um... Is there anything you expect
from analyzing Jack's blood?
fields.JP:
あの……ジャックの血……
調べたら何か、わかるのでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Is there anything you expect
from analyzing Jack's blood?

fields.EN:
I believe Miko-kun explained it
already, but the Blood Maidens
accrue Corruption...
fields.JP:
おおよそのことは視子くんから聞いたと思うが、
君たち血式少女の持つ『穢れ』の現象……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe Miko explained it
already, but the Blood Maidens
accrue Corruption...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
...Which triggers their Blood
Skelter state, and we've had no
real means to counteract it.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化については、
今まで効果的な打つ手が存在しなかったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Which triggers their Blood
Skelter state, and we've had no
real means to counteract it.

fields.EN: We lost someone from it, too...
fields.JP: ……そのせいで、ひとり犠牲も出たしね……
fields.LOCALIZED: We lost someone from it, too...

fields.JP: また、今度話すよ。ごめん……

fields.EN:
(That's right... Akazukin-san
was trying to avoid the specifics
of Blood Skelter before.)
fields.JP:
（そういえばあの時も、赤ずきんさん……
　『まだ知らなくていい』って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... Red Riding Hood
was trying to avoid the specifics
of Blood Skelter before.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
No, it's best we talk about it
now. We lost a Blood Maiden to
Blood Skelter a while ago...
fields.JP:
いや。話しておいたほうがいいだろう。
かつて不幸にも、ブラッドスケルター化して
しまった血式少女がいたのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's best we talk about it
now. We lost a Blood Maiden to
Blood Skelter a while ago...

fields.EN:
We weren't able to save her. To be
exact, we had no means of saving
her.
fields.JP:
……だが、我々は彼女を救うことが
できなかった。
正確には、救う手立てがなかったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We weren't able to save her. To be
exact, we had no means of saving
her.

fields.EN:
She remained in that state until
the end of her life.
fields.JP:
……彼女は暴走したまま元に戻ることなく、
命を落とした
fields.LOCALIZED:
She remained in that state until
the end of her life.

fields.EN:
All that we gained from it was the
discovery of Blood Skelter and the
risks involved.
fields.JP:
『ブラッドスケルター化』という現象と、
そのリスクを我々にもたらしてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that we gained from it was the
discovery of Blood Skelter and the
risks involved.

fields.EN:
(So then, the same thing could
happen to Alice, too...)
fields.JP:
（じゃあ……アリスもやっぱり……
　そうなるかもしれなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So then, the same thing could
happen to Alice, too...)

fields.EN: Because of that, even though we had gained the Blood Maidens as a weapon, we couldn't achieve meaningful results in exploring the Jail.
fields.JP:
そのため、我々は血式少女という武器を得ながら
ジェイル探索に効果的な結果を出せずにいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because of what happened, we
haven't obtained much in the way
of results from our investigation.

fields.EN:
After all, there's no way I could
risk our beloved children's lives
like that...
fields.JP:
可愛い子供たちを、命の危険に晒すわけには
いかないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, there's no way I could
risk our beloved children's lives
like that...

fields.EN:
That's why we need you, Jack-kun.
Your blood could potentially push
the Dawn to a new level.
fields.JP:
だからジャックくん。
君の血液は、現在の『黎明』の大きな突破口と
なる可能性を秘めているのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we need you, Jack.
Your blood could potentially push
the Dawn to a new level.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Why, yes. We would like to ask for
your cooperation with our
research.
fields.JP: ああ。ぜひとも我々の研究に協力してほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. We would like to ask for
your cooperation with our
research.

fields.EN:
That wouldn't put Jack's life in
danger, right?
fields.JP:
……それは、ジャックの命に危険は
無いんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That wouldn't put Jack's life in
danger, right?

fields.EN:
He is our lifeline. We will treat
him with great care.
fields.JP:
……彼は我々の命綱だからね。
大切に扱わねば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He is our lifeline. We will treat
him with great care.

fields.EN:
C'mon, it'll be okay, Alice! Dad
and Miko-san are both skilled at what
they do!
fields.JP:
大丈夫だって、アリス！
お父さんも視子さんも腕はいいからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, it'll be okay, Alice! Dad
and Miko are both skilled at what
they do!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
She's right, Alice. I'm happy to
know that I can actually help you
and everyone here in some way.
fields.JP:
……そうだよ、アリス。
僕がもし君たちの役に立てるなら、僕はすごく
嬉しいんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Alice. I'm happy to
know that I can actually help you
and everyone here in some way.

fields.EN:
That aside, do you know where you
got your name, Jack-kun?
fields.JP:
……ところでジャックくん。
君は自分の名前の由来を知っているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, do you know where you
got your name, Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Yes. Did your parents give you
that name?
fields.JP:
ああ。両親に付けてもらったのか、
もしくは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Did your parents give you
that name?

fields.EN:
I don't know... I lost my parents
when I was young, and I don't
really remember much from then...
fields.JP:
……知らないんです。
僕、幼い頃に両親を亡くして、
その頃の記憶がほとんど無くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know... I lost my parents
when I was young, and I don't
really remember much from then...

fields.EN:
Well, thank you for coming today.
Akazukin, show them around
the Liberated District, will you?
fields.JP:
ご足労ありがとう、二人とも。
赤ずきん、解放地区内を案内してあげなさい。
何しろ昨日は、それどころではなかったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, thank you for coming today.
Red Riding Hood, show them around
the Liberated District, will you?

fields.EN:
Oh, and before you leave, this
place is my laboratory.
fields.JP:
……そうそう。
ここには既に何度か足を運んでもらっているが、
ここが私の研究室だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and before you leave, this
place is my laboratory.

fields.EN: The Blood Maidens often come here to talk to me about concerns with their abilities or condition.
fields.JP:
血式少女たちの能力や状態の悩みをよくここで
聞いているんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be here if you need to ask
more about the Blood Maidens, or if
you have any concerns.

fields.EN:
Yup! Dad knows and cares about
us more than anybody else here!
