And then it happened... We
encountered Snark...

fields.EN: Our survey team was wiped out there in no time. Thanks to their desperate resistance, I alone somehow made it back alive.
fields.JP:
そこで我々調査隊は、あっけなく全滅した。
彼らの決死の応戦によって、私だけがどうにか
生還した
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our unit was destroyed. Through
everyone's efforts, I was somehow
able to survive...

fields.EN: They said they couldn't afford to lose the Dawn's brains, and they let me escape... I still see that scene in my dreams.
fields.JP:
……黎明の頭脳を失うわけにはいかないと、
彼らはそう言いながら、私を逃がしてくれた……
あの時の光景は、今でも夢にみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said they couldn't allow the
Dawn's leader to die, and ensured
my escape. I still remember it...

fields.EN:
That sounds like a horrible
past...
fields.JP: ……そんな過去があったんですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds like a horrible
past...

fields.EN:
As for "Snark," it had appeared
suddenly and slaughtered everyone.
fields.JP:
……スナークの話に戻ろう。
奴は突然我々の前に現れ、一瞬にして仲間たちを
次々と殺戮していったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for "Snark," it had appeared
suddenly and slaughtered everyone.

fields.EN:
Dad, what is "Snark?" What kind
of weapons did it use?
fields.JP:
お父さん。スナークっていうのは、いったい
どんな奴なの？　武器は！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad, what is "Snark?" What kind
of weapons did it use?

fields.EN: Its appearance... is hard to put into words. It was unlike a human, a Marchen, or a Nightmare—just something bizarre that inspired fear.
fields.JP:
奴の形状は……何とも表現がつかない。
人、メルヒェン、ナイトメア……そのいずれとも
異なる。ただ恐怖感を誘う異様な何かだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't like anything we'd seen
before. I can't explain it... Only
that it was a form of fear itself.

fields.EN:
B-But if that's the case, how will
we know who or what this Snark
is?!
fields.JP:
じゃ……じゃあ、どうやって見分けたらいいのか
わからないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But if that's the case, how will
we know who or what this Snark
is?!

fields.EN: I'm sorry this is all the information I could bring back... I owe an apology to all of you—and to those who died...
fields.JP:
このような情報しか持ち帰れずに済まないと
思っている……
君たちにも、そして死んでいった彼らにも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I can't forgive myself
for not being able to help you or
those who died for me.

fields.EN:
I wasn't trying to blame you...
Please don't get too down on
yourself, Dad...
fields.JP:
そ、そういう意味じゃ……
お父さん、あんまり自分を責めないでよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't trying to blame you...
Please don't get too down on
yourself, Dad...

fields.EN:
Just know that Snark is beyond
the level of Nightmares. I believe
it is the king of Nightmares.
fields.JP:
……ただ、伝えたかったのだ。
スナークとはナイトメアを凌駕する、異質な怪物
……恐らく、ナイトメアたちの王なのだと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just know that Snark is beyond
the level of Nightmares. I believe
it is the king of Nightmares.

fields.EN: And... it seems to understand human language.
fields.JP: そして……人語を解するようだと
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... it can speak our
language...

fields.EN:
So that means it has a high level
of intelligence.
fields.JP: 高い知能を持つ……ということですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means it has a high level
of intelligence.

fields.EN:
Exactly. All I ask of you is to
beware of Snark during your
exploration.
fields.JP:
その通りだ。
……どうか、探索行動の際には、スナークには
注意してほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. All I ask of you is to
beware of Snark during your
exploration.

fields.EN: Got it, Dad, and... I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
うん。わかったよ、お父さん
……ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it, Dad, and... I'm sorry.

fields.EN:
As long as you're all aware and
cautious, that's fine. That's all
from me.
fields.JP:
いや。君たちが危険を理解してくれればいい。
……私からは以上だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're all aware and
cautious, that's fine. That's all
from me.

fields.EN:
Thank you for gathering the
leaves. They're of great help.
fields.JP:
ホオノキの採取、ありがとう。
実際、助かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for gathering the
leaves. They're of great help.

fields.EN:
I'll give your weapons a good
tune-up, so come by later, Akazukin, Alice.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、アリス。
お前らの武器、手入れしてやるから、
後で寄ってけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll give your weapons a good
tune-up, so come by later, Red
Riding Hood, Alice.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
We have the results from your
blood samples.
fields.JP: 君の血液の検査結果が出たよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have the results from your
blood samples.

fields.EN:
How was it? Am I able to help
everyone?
fields.JP:
結果は……どうだったんですか？
僕は、みんなの役に立てるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How was it? Am I able to help
everyone?

fields.EN: ...In short, you're a 'Blood Youth.' This is an unprecedented case, and extremely interesting. I'd like to keep examining you from here on.
fields.JP:
……結論から言えば、君は『血式少年』だ。
今までに無い例で、非常に興味深い。
これからも引き続き、調べさせてもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It turns out you're a Blood Youth,
so to speak. If possible, we'd
like to conduct further research.

fields.JP:
血式少年、ですか……？
じゃあ……！

fields.EN: But a Blood Youth has unusual properties. It's impossible for you to draw out your power through the Blood weapons the Blood Maidens use.
fields.JP:
だが、血式少年とは特殊な性質を持っていてね。
血式少女たちの使用する血式武器では、力を
発揮することは不可能なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you're different from the
Blood Maidens. Your power can't be
utilized through Blood weapons.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: それって……どういうことですか
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
In simplicity, you're not battle-
worthy.
fields.JP: 簡単に言えば、戦力外ということだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In simplicity, you're not battle-
worthy.

fields.EN:
I can't use their weapons?! What's
a Blood weapon?! Why can't I use
one?!
fields.JP:
血式武器が使えないって……！
血式武器って何ですか！？
僕じゃ、どうして使えないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't use their weapons?! What's
a Blood weapon?! Why can't I use
one?!

fields.JP: ハルさん！　視子さん……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Well, ya see, a Blood weapon is
made from the body parts of
Marchens.
fields.JP:
あー。そのな、血式武器っていうのは、
メルヒェンの体組織をパーツに使ってんだよ。
そんで、お前の場合……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, ya see, a Blood weapon is
made from the body parts of
Marchens.

fields.EN:
When your blood goes on one, the
weapon starts to rust immediately.
fields.JP: お前の血をかけると、武器が錆びちまうんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When your blood goes on one, the
weapon starts to rust immediately.

fields.EN:
We believe it has something to do
with how your blood holds purging
properties against Corruption.
fields.JP:
おそらく『穢れ』を浄化する機能が反作用として
働くのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We believe it has something to do
with how your blood holds purging
properties against Corruption.

fields.EN:
Isn't there anything I can do
about it?! Like, maybe use a
normal weapon?
fields.JP:
ど……どうにかならないんですか！？
たとえば……普通の武器、とか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there anything I can do
about it?! Like, maybe use a
normal weapon?

fields.EN: Like the Professor said, there are hardly any weapons like that left. Besides, those things are all about physical strength. An amateur couldn't do anything with one...
fields.JP:
さっき博士も言ってたが、そんなモンは殆ど
残っちゃいねえし、第一ああいうのは体力勝負だ。
素人にゃ何もできねえよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There aren't many normal weapons
here, and you wouldn't stand a
chance against 'em, ya know?

fields.EN:
So... I can't fight alongside
Alice and everyone else...
fields.JP:
僕は……アリスと……みんなと……
戦えないってこと、ですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So... I can't fight alongside
Alice and everyone else...

fields.EN:
B-But, I was useful on the
expedition, right?!
fields.JP:
で、でも……今回だってちゃんと、
みんなの役に立てた、と思うし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, I was useful on the
expedition, right?!

fields.EN: You're battered and bleeding, right? What you're doing is no different from suicide. ...You'll die eventually.
fields.JP:
ボロボロにケガして、血ィ流して……だろ。
そいつは自殺行為と変わんねえ。
……いずれ死ぬ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only after you're bloody... What
you're doing is no different from
committing suicide.

fields.EN: That's right, Jack. Your constitution and your blood are subjects of great interest to us. So...
fields.JP:
そうよ、ジャック。
あなたの体質やその血液は、高い関心対象では
あるの。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Jack. We are aware
of how important you are, down to
your very blood, so...

fields.EN:
But... that doesn't mean a thing
to anyone...
fields.JP: そんなの……意味ないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... that doesn't mean a thing
to anyone...

fields.EN: Everyone has things they're suited for and things they aren't. Know your limits.
fields.JP:
誰にだって向き不向きがあるってことだ。
わきまえろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We all have a purpose to fulfill,
that's all. So, learn to accept
your place, kiddo.

fields.EN:
H-He's right! Battling on the
frontlines isn't the only way to
fight!
fields.JP:
そ、そうだよ！
何も前線で戦うだけが、戦いじゃないんだしさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-He's right! Battling on the
frontlines isn't the only way to
fight!

fields.EN: ...All three of you, go back and rest. That's an order from me—so you can survive this Jail.
fields.JP:
……三人とも、ともかく戻って休むことだ。
これは私からの命令だよ。
このジェイルを……生き抜くためのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, get some rest. Next
time, be sure you follow my orders
if you want to survive the Jail.

fields.EN:
Didn't she beat a Marchen with her
bare hands? There's no way she
could be human.
fields.JP:
コイツ、
メルヒェンを素手でブチ殺したんだろ？
人間技とは思えないよなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't she beat a Marchen with her
bare hands? There's no way she
could be human.

fields.EN:
Maybe she's a monster. I mean, her
eyes turn pink too, you know?
fields.JP:
……バケモノだからじゃねえ？
コイツの目、時々ピンクに光ってるもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she's a monster. I mean, her
eyes turn pink too, you know?

fields.EN:
You killed a Marchen, so stop
acting like you're scared!
fields.JP:
メルヒェン殺した奴が、怯えたフリしたって
白けるだけなんだよなあ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You killed a Marchen, so stop
acting like you're scared!

fields.EN:
C'mon, show us how much of a
monster you are!
fields.JP: バケモンの本性、見せてみろよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, show us how much of a
monster you are!

fields.EN:
Stop it! She's not a monster!
She's a normal human being, just
like everyone else!
fields.JP:
待ってよ！
この子は……バケモノなんかじゃないよ！
おんなじ人間だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it! She's not a monster!
She's a normal human being, just
like everyone else!

fields.EN: ...Move. You're not the one we're here for.
fields.JP: ……どけよ。用があるのはお前じゃねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Move it. We ain't got time for
you.

fields.EN: ...I'm not moving. You guys go away.
fields.JP: ……どかない。お前らこそあっちへ行けよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You move it. Get away from her.

fields.EN: Stop acting like a hero, wimp.
fields.JP:
ひょろっひょろの癖して、意気がってんじゃ
ねえぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop acting like a hero, wimp.

fields.EN: Don't you lay a finger on Alice...
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you lay a finger on Alice...

fields.EN:
Why are you always defending me?
They're going to treat you badly
too, if you keep this up.
fields.JP:
……あなた、どうしていつもわたしを庇うの？
あなたまで、爪弾きにされるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you always defending me?
They're going to treat you badly
too, if you keep this up.

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but you're just
a normal girl.
fields.JP: ……わかんない。でも、君は普通の女の子だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but you're just
a normal girl.

fields.EN:
I'm also not from here, so it
doesn't matter if they treat me
badly.
fields.JP: それに、僕はどうせよそ者だから、いいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm also not from here, so it
doesn't matter if they treat me
badly.

fields.EN:
You don't have to feel sorry for
me.
fields.JP: 同情なんて、しなくてもいいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to feel sorry for
me.

fields.EN:
That's not it. I... just wanted to
be friends with you.
fields.JP: 違うよ。ただ、友達になりたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it. I... just wanted to
be friends with you.

fields.EN:
I've never seen you smile before,
so...
fields.JP:
僕……君が笑ってる顔、
いちども見たことないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen you smile before,
so...

fields.EN:
I don't think I introduced
myself... My name is Alice...
fields.JP:
……アリスよ。
その、きちんと自己紹介したこと、
なかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think I introduced
myself... My name is Alice...

fields.EN:
I knew a smile would look good on
you... My name is Jack...
fields.JP:
笑った顔……思ってたとおり、可愛いや……
……僕は、ジャック……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew a smile would look good on
you... My name is Jack...

fields.EN:
It's a Marchen! Alice! Get away
from me! Run!
fields.JP:
メルヒェンだ……！
アリス！　僕に構わず逃げて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a Marchen! Alice! Get away
from me! Run!

fields.EN: It means nothing if I'm not together with you.
fields.JP: あなたと一緒じゃなければ、意味がないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no meaning in life if I'm
not next to you.

fields.EN:
(I've been helpless all this time.
I want to answer Alice with
something meaningful...)
fields.JP:
（僕はずっと、無力なままだった。
　アリスのあの言葉に応えたいのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've been helpless all this time.
I want to answer Alice with
something meaningful...)

fields.EN: 'Things you're suited for and things you aren't'...

fields.JP: （だったら……僕にできることは……）

fields.EN:
(Alice is already fighting...
Sulking about it isn't going to
help. I need to be of use...)
fields.JP:
（アリスは、アリスの戦いを始めている……
　ここでただ泣いていじけてたら、
　僕は本当の役立たずなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice is already fighting...
Sulking about it isn't going to
help. I need to be of use...)

fields.EN:
(I need to find something that
only I can do!)
fields.JP: （僕も……僕自身にできることを……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to find something that
only I can do!)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: Hm? Oh, it's you. What's up?
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Oh, it's you. What's up?

fields.JP: ハルさん！　お願いします！！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Wh-What?! What the hell is this
about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?! What the hell is this
about?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I'm sorry for startling
you.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I'm sorry for startling
you.

fields.EN:
Well, find a place in all the junk
here and take a seat.
fields.JP:
……まあ、どっかその辺に座れよ。
散らかってて悪いけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, find a place in all the junk
here and take a seat.

fields.EN: Thank you very much. So, um...
fields.JP: ……ありがとうございます。その……
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you very much. So, um...

fields.EN:
If you wanna talk about what was
brought up earlier, my answer to
you is "no."
fields.JP: さっきの話なら、駄目だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you wanna talk about what was
brought up earlier, my answer to
you is "no."

fields.EN: But, Haru-san, I want to fight, too!
fields.JP:
……ハルさん。
僕も……！
僕も、戦いたいんです！
fields.LOCALIZED: But, Haru, I want to fight, too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Everyone in Dawn is fighting to
escape from the Jail.
fields.JP:
ここでは……
黎明では、誰もが戦ってる……
ジェイルから脱け出すための戦いを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone in Dawn is fighting to
escape from the Jail.

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, you, the Blood
Maidens, the Professor, Miko-san...
Everyone is fighting for a cause.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんたち血式少女はもちろん、
あなたや博士、それに視子さんたち……
皆がひとつの目的のために戦ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, you, the Blood
Maidens, the Professor, Miko...
Everyone is fighting for a cause.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; 視子さん => Miko-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Yeah. Everyone has their own way of doing what they can. Just surviving is a battle in itself. ...Why can't you accept that?
fields.JP:
まあな。みんなそれぞれにできるやり方だ。
生き延びるだけでもひとつの戦いなんだ。
……そいつが何故飲めない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yeah. We're each fighting
however we can to survive. Get it
through that thick skull of yours.

fields.EN:
Alice... is jumping into actual
battles. And yet...
fields.JP:
アリスは……戦いの真っ只中に
身を投じようとしているんです。
それなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... is jumping into actual
battles. And yet...

fields.EN:
I'm... I'm not doing anything! I
don't want to be useless anymore!
fields.JP:
僕だけが……僕だけが何もしていない！
何も、できないでいるんだ！
そんなのは……もう嫌なんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... I'm not doing anything! I
don't want to be useless anymore!

fields.EN: It's not like you've done nothing. Your blood may have the potential to give the Blood Maidens strength.
fields.JP:
お前は何もしていないわけじゃない。
お前の血は、彼女たちの力になる可能性を
秘めている
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not useless. Your blood has
the power to help the Blood
Maidens.

fields.EN:
No! Alice and everyone else are
facing real danger while I just
wait around. They might die!
fields.JP:
嫌です！　だって、その間にだってアリスたちは
危険な目に遭って……死んじゃうかもしれない。
そんなの、嫌なんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Alice and everyone else are
facing real danger while I just
wait around. They might die!

fields.EN:
I-I want to fight, too. I want to
fight the Marchens... with Alice!
fields.JP:
僕も……僕も参加したいんです。
メルヒェンとの戦いに。
……アリスと一緒に！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I want to fight, too. I want to
fight the Marchens... with Alice!

fields.EN:
What you're asking is way beyond
my call. Go talk to the Professor.
fields.JP:
……………………
そいつは、俺の裁量の範囲外だ。
博士に言ってみるんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you're asking is way beyond
my call. Go talk to the Professor.

fields.EN:
But I don't think the Professor
will listen to me...
fields.JP:
博士には……
取り合ってもらえないと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I don't think the Professor
will listen to me...

fields.EN:
I wouldn't blame him. But, if you
can't get his permission, there's
nothing I can do for you.
fields.JP:
ま、そうだろうな。
作戦立案者の許可がとれないんじゃ、
俺がどうこうできる筈もないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't blame him. But, if you
can't get his permission, there's
nothing I can do for you.

fields.EN:
That's why I want your help convincing
the Professor, Haru-san!
fields.JP:
だからハルさんには……
博士の説得に力を貸して欲しいんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I wanted you to help me
convince the Professor!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Huh? Whoa, hold it right there.
You want me to help convince the
Professor?
fields.JP:
……はあ？
おいおい、ちょっと待てって！
……博士を説得だって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Whoa, hold it right there.
You want me to help convince the
Professor?

fields.EN: Listen, even if I put in a word for you, there's no way that old man would approve something like that!
fields.JP:
あのなあ、俺が口添えしたからって、
あのオッさんがそんなの許可するわけ
ねえだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down and take a deep breath.
There's no way that geezer would
give you the OK, even if I helped!

fields.EN:
Listen, Jack... I know how you
feel, and I don't blame ya for
wanting to take action.
fields.JP:
……なあ、ジャック。
おまえの気持ちがわからないわけじゃない。
焦る気持ちもわかるつもりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen, Jack... I know how you
feel, and I don't blame ya for
wanting to take action.

fields.EN: You don't even have a proper way to fight, so what are you talking about direct combat with Marchens? You'd be killed in an instant! Instantly!
fields.JP:
戦う手段すら、ろくに持ってねえくせに、
何がメルヒェンとの直接戦闘だ？
おまえなんざ、瞬殺されるぞ！　瞬殺！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How the hell are you planning to
fight the Marchens? You wouldn't
stand a chance!

fields.EN: I know a way to fight them!
fields.JP: 戦う手段なら……あります！
fields.LOCALIZED: I know a way to fight them!

fields.EN:
I have my blood... The blood that
can suppress Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
僕の体を流れる血……。
ブラッドスケルター化を、
鎮めることのできる特殊な血液……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have my blood... The blood that
can suppress Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
Isn't there a way my blood could
help directly in battle?
fields.JP:
この血を……どうにか戦闘に役立てることは
できませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there a way my blood could
help directly in battle?

fields.EN:
Haru-san, you all know it too. You know
that my blood works on more than just
Alice...
fields.JP:
本当はハルさんたちだって、わかってる筈です。
僕の血が効くのが、アリスだけじゃないって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you can help me. You know
that my blood works on the other
Blood Maidens.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.JP:
それは、さっきの探索行動で実証済みなんじゃ
ないんですか！？

fields.EN: So you know, do you, Jack...?
fields.JP:
ジャック……
お前、気づいていたのか……
fields.LOCALIZED: So you know, do you, Jack...?

fields.EN: ...I thought about it. If you had really wanted to stop us from acting on our own, there was no way you couldn't have stopped us.
fields.JP:
……考えたんです。
僕らの独断行動を本気で止めたかったら、
止められないわけがなかったって
fields.LOCALIZED:
If someone wanted to stop us, they
could've used any means necessary
to keep us from going.

fields.EN:
Miko-san said we're not tools, but
still, everyone is risking their
lives to find a way out of here.
fields.JP:
視子さんは、僕らを道具じゃないって言って
くれたけど……でもみんな、危険を冒して
脱出の可能性を探ってるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko said we're not tools, but
still, everyone is risking their
lives to find a way out of here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
For a smart kid, you sure are
hard-headed...
fields.JP:
……お前、案外頑固なうえに、いろいろ
頭、働かせてんのな
fields.LOCALIZED:
For a smart kid, you sure are
hard-headed...

fields.EN:
Haru-san... Please craft a weapon for
me. A weapon that can use my blood
to protect Alice and everyone!
fields.JP:
ハルさん……僕に武器を造ってください。
僕の血を利用した武器を。
アリスたちを守れる武器を……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru... Please craft a weapon for
me. A weapon that can use my blood
to protect Alice and everyone!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
And once the weapon's made, you're
going to convince the old man to
send you into battle, eh?
fields.JP:
……その武器の効用をもって博士を説得し、
戦闘部隊入りを果たそうと……
まあ、そういうわけだな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And once the weapon's made, you're
going to convince the old man to
send you into battle, eh?

fields.EN: Yes. The Professor... doesn't seem to expect anything from me...
fields.JP:
はい。博士は……
僕には何も期待してないみたいだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... This is about the only way
I can convince the Professor to
deploy me with the others...

fields.EN:
Using your blood means that your
body will take a direct hit from
its use. You know that, right?
fields.JP:
血液を利用した武器ということは、
当然、使用者の体に負担をかけることになる。
どう頑張ったって、多かれ少なかれはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using your blood means that your
body will take a direct hit from
its use. You know that, right?

fields.EN:
But you still want to fight beside
Alice, even if it means death?
fields.JP:
……そこまでしても、
アリスと生死を共にしたいんだな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you still want to fight beside
Alice, even if it means death?

fields.EN:
I want to fight beside Alice to
live, not die.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to fight beside Alice to
live, not die.

fields.EN: Gotcha... Let me think about it.
fields.JP:
……………………
わかった。検討してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Gotcha... Let me think about it.

fields.EN:
The Professor and the others know
your blood's real special.
fields.JP:
お前の血液の特殊性については、
さっき博士も言ったように、当然認識している
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor and the others know
your blood's real special.

fields.EN:
I was already contemplating on
using your blood as a weapon, and
so was the Professor, I think.
fields.JP:
お前の血液を武器に利用する……
そのアイディアは、俺だって持っていたさ。
おそらくは博士もだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was already contemplating on
using your blood as a weapon, and
so was the Professor, I think.

fields.EN:
But if that's the case, why didn't
anyone bring it up to me?
fields.JP:
それなら……どうして……
どうして言ってくれなかったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if that's the case, why didn't
anyone bring it up to me?

fields.EN:
The Professor even told me that
I wasn't battle-worthy, and that I
can't use Blood weapons.
fields.JP:
あのとき……僕は……戦力外だって……
武器は使いこなせないって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor even told me that
I wasn't battle-worthy, and that I
can't use Blood weapons.

fields.EN:
The Blood weapons are made
specifically for the Maidens.
That's why you can't use them.
fields.JP:
言った通り、
血式武器は血式少女に特化したものだ。
現状のままでは、お前には使えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood weapons are made
specifically for the Maidens.
That's why you can't use them.

fields.EN: A weapon that uses your blood, one only you can use... while minimizing the damage to your body as much as possible...
fields.JP:
お前の血を利用した、お前にしか使えない……
なおかつ、可能な限り肉体へのダメージを
最小限に保つ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What we'd need to do is make a
weapon for you that'd minimize
your burden at the same time.

fields.EN:
Did you think I could magically
make one appear like that?
fields.JP: そんな武器がすぐに出てくると思うか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you think I could magically
make one appear like that?

fields.EN: That's what I meant when I told you not to rush. The Professor probably didn't want to risk losing you for nothing, either.
fields.JP:
焦るなと言ったのは、そういう意味だ。
博士にしても、無駄にお前を失うリスクを、
冒したくなかったんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I meant when I said
not to fret. The Professor just
didn't want to take any risks.

fields.EN:
After all, you're his valuable
guinea pig, you know...
fields.JP: ……貴重な研究対象としても、な
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, you're his valuable
guinea pig, you know...

fields.EN:
In any case, all I can do is craft
weapons. You're on your own
trying to convince the Professor.
fields.JP:
ま、とにかく……あれだ。
俺にできるのは、武器の開発までだ。
博士の説得は、自分でするんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, all I can do is craft
weapons. You're on your own
trying to convince the Professor.

fields.JP: ……ハルさん、ありがとうございます！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Jack... Don't forget that we're
all fighting to survive, got it?
fields.JP:
ジャック。
生きるために戦うと言ったこと、
……忘れんなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Don't forget that we're
all fighting to survive, got it?

fields.EN:
It's painful not being able to
protect someone you want to
protect...
fields.JP:
まあ……護りたいものを護れないのは、
辛いことだからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's painful not being able to
protect someone you want to
protect...

fields.EN:
Mmm... That should cover all the
major locations. Check them out
when you've got the time.
fields.JP:
んー。だいたいこれで主要なとこ全部かな！
時間があるときにでも、またあちこち
行ってみるといいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... That should cover all the
major locations. Check them out
when you've got the time.

fields.JP: ありがとう、赤ずきんさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm surprised that this place
really does cover all our basic
needs...
fields.JP:
……確かにこの中でほぼ全てがまかなえるのね。
驚いたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised that this place
really does cover all our basic
needs...

fields.EN:
Well, Dad and everyone in Dawn,
even Haru-san, helped to build this
place.
fields.JP:
お父さんたち黎明創成期のメンバーや、一応
ハルさんなんかも、みんなでがんばって
造り上げてきた場所だからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Dad and everyone in Dawn,
even Haru, helped to build this
place.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
We can live a decent life because
of what they all did. That's why
we need to do our best, too.
fields.JP:
あたしたちが今、それなりにまともな暮らしが
できるのも、みんなの努力のおかげなんだ。
だから、あたしたちも、頑張らなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can live a decent life because
of what they all did. That's why
we need to do our best, too.

fields.EN:
You're right... I'll try to do
what I can to help.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
僕も、自分にできることをしたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... I'll try to do
what I can to help.

fields.EN:
Wait a minute! Alice, look over
there...
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って……！
アリス、あそこ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute! Alice, look over
there...

fields.JP:
え？
あ……ホオノキの葉だわ！

fields.EN:
Guess our mission is complete! I
knew it was a good call to have
you both here. Let's get some for Miko-san.
fields.JP:
これで当初の目的も果たせたってわけだね！
やっぱり一人で来なくて正解だったよ。
じゃあ、視子さんのために採って帰ろっか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess our mission is complete! I
knew it was a good call to have
you both here. Let's get them.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Okay. But we have to make sure we
don't strip the tree bare.
fields.JP:
うん。
あまり採り過ぎないようにしないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. But we have to make sure we
don't strip the tree bare.

fields.EN:
Yes. If we leave some, more of
them can grow again.
fields.JP:
そうね。
株を残しておけば、また殖えるかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. If we leave some, more of
them can grow again.

fields.EN:
Oh, c'mon. It's not like we're
farming them. Hm? What's that?
fields.JP:
あはは、山菜じゃないんだからさー
ん？　あそこは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, c'mon. It's not like we're
farming them. Hm? What's that?

fields.EN:
A room...? I don't recall seeing
one there before. Do you, Jack?
fields.JP:
あんな部屋……あったかしら？
ジャックには見覚えがある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A room...? I don't recall seeing
one there before. Do you, Jack?

fields.EN:
A room... You're right, was there
one?
fields.JP:
……部屋？　本当だ……
あんな所に部屋なんてあったっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A room... You're right, was there
one?

fields.EN:
When we were held captive, we
didn't think to keep a careful eye
on our surroundings.
fields.JP:
そうね……
メルヒェンに捕まっていた頃は、
周囲に気を配る余裕もなかったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we were held captive, we
didn't think to keep a careful eye
on our surroundings.

fields.EN:
Yeah... We weren't really thinking
of anything aside from ourselves,
so...
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
ここに閉じ込められていた頃は、
何かに興味を向けることもなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We weren't really thinking
of anything aside from ourselves,
so...

fields.EN:
Hm... So neither of you know...
Now I'm really curious...
fields.JP:
うーん……二人とも知らないか……
気になるなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... So neither of you know...
Now I'm really curious...

fields.EN: All right! Let's go in there!
fields.JP: よし！　とりあえず入ってみよう！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Let's go in there!

fields.EN:
Um, but isn't this a bit too
risky?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but isn't this a bit too
risky?

fields.EN:
Oh, c'mon. Worrying like that
won't get things done! Let's go!
fields.JP:
危険ばっか気にしてちゃ、何も始まらないって！
行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, c'mon. Worrying like that
won't get things done! Let's go!

fields.EN:
(She's a leader all right, but a
pretty reckless one...)
fields.JP:
（この人……リーダーはリーダーでも、
　やっぱり無茶だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's a leader all right, but a
pretty reckless one...)

fields.EN:
I've never seen something so
eerie... Jack, what do you think
it is?
fields.JP:
こんなに奇妙なものがあったなんて……
ジャック……これは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen something so
eerie... Jack, what do you think
it is?

fields.EN:
It's the core Dad used to tell me
about! Yup! That has to be it!
fields.JP:
これがお父さんの言ってた核なんだ！
うん！　絶対、間違いない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the core Dad used to tell me
about! Yup! That has to be it!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Dad told me that there are cores
inside the Jail that impart power
to it.
fields.JP:
お父さんが言ってたんだ。
ジェイルの中にはいくつか核があって、
それがジェイルに力を与えてるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad told me that there are cores
inside the Jail that impart power
to it.

fields.EN:
A Nightmare?! Did it sense we
found this core thing?!
fields.JP:
あの声は……ナイトメア！？
核が見つかったことを察知された……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare?! Did it sense we
found this core thing?!

fields.EN:
Whatever the reason, it's too
late! Let's break it and get the heck
out of here!
fields.JP:
だとしても、もう遅いね！
さっさと壊して逃げ出そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the reason, it's too
late! Let's break it and get the heck
out of here!

fields.EN:
Dad wanted the cores to be
destroyed, so let's smash it up
good, Alice!
fields.JP:
核の破壊こそ……お父さんの望み！
アリス、この核をぶっ潰すよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad wanted the cores to be
destroyed, so let's smash it up
good, Alice!

fields.JP: ……赤ずきんさん！　メルヒェンだ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It's nothing like I've ever seen
before!
fields.JP:
今までのメルヒェンとは違うわ……！
こんなの……見たことがない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing like I've ever seen
before!

fields.EN:
So, you wanna get in the way of us
breaking the core, eh?! Then we'll
have to finish you off first!
fields.JP:
核の破壊を妨害しようっていうわけ！？
じゃあ、あんたから先に始末してやるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you wanna get in the way of us
breaking the core, eh?! Then we'll
have to finish you off first!

fields.EN:
The chick may grow into a small
but strong bird that can fly
straight toward the sun.
fields.JP:
太陽まで真っ直ぐ飛んでいける、強い小鳥に
育つかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The chick may grow into a small
but strong bird that can fly
straight toward the sun.

fields.EN:
Then it can carry the sunlight to
us here?
fields.JP: そしたら、おひさまの光をここまで運んでくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then it can carry the sunlight to
us here?

fields.EN:
That depends on the chick. Oh,
but...
fields.JP:
それはその雛次第だね。
それにね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That depends on the chick. Oh,
but...

fields.EN:
...If the small bird flies too
close to the sun, it will burn
itself to death.
fields.JP:
太陽に近づきすぎた小鳥は、燃え尽きて死んで
しまうんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...If the small bird flies too
close to the sun, it will burn
itself to death.

fields.EN:
I asked Haru-san whether he could
craft a weapon that I could use.
fields.JP:
……実は、僕にも使える武器を作って
もらえないかって、ハルさんに聞いてみたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked Haru whether he could
craft a weapon that I could use.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: ハルさんは……なんて言っていたの？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
He said he'd think about it, but
I wonder if he really would craft
one for me.
fields.JP:
検討する、って言ってくれたけど……
本当に作ってもらえるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said he'd think about it, but
I wonder if he really would craft
one for me.

fields.EN:
It sounds difficult to make since
I'm different from the Blood
Maidens...
fields.JP:
血式少年は血式少女とはいろいろ違うみたい
だし、作るのも難しそうに聞こえたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds difficult to make since
I'm different from the Blood
Maidens...

fields.EN:
Don't feel pressured, Jack.
Everyone knows you're very
important.
fields.JP:
焦ることはないわ、ジャック。
あなたが重要な存在だってことは、
確かめられたわけだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't feel pressured, Jack.
Everyone knows you're very
important.

fields.EN:
I'm actually relieved to know that
Haru-san was thinking about your well-
being.
fields.JP:
それに、ハルさんがあなたの体のことを考えて
くれていることがわかって、少しほっとしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm actually relieved to know that
Haru was thinking about your well-
being.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Thanks, Alice. I understood his
intentions, but...
fields.JP:
ありがとう、アリス。
そのことはわかってるんだけど、つい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Alice. I understood his
intentions, but...

fields.EN:
I was worried when they found
interest in your blood. Worried
about how they would treat you.
fields.JP:
実は、あなたの血にここの人たちが興味を
持ち出した時……心配になったの。
あなたがどんな扱いを受けるのかって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was worried when they found
interest in your blood. Worried
about how they would treat you.

fields.EN:
Yes. The Dawn's goal of escaping
the Jail is such a big one, they
might do anything to attain it.
fields.JP:
ええ。黎明の考えていることは、とても大きな
ことだわ。ジェイルからの脱出だなんて。
そのためなら、きっと何でもする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The Dawn's goal of escaping
the Jail is such a big one, they
might do anything to attain it.

fields.EN:
I don't think they'd do anything
drastic...
fields.JP: か……考えすぎじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think they'd do anything
drastic...

fields.EN:
Would they have sent Akazukin-san out alone, knowing Blood
Skelter means possible death?
fields.JP:
いいえ。いくら慎重に進めているとはいえ、
ブラッドスケルター化が死を意味するならば、
赤ずきんさんを一人で外に出すかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would they have sent Red Riding
Hood out alone, knowing Blood
Skelter means possible death?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Think about what happened. If they
were serious, they could have
stopped us.
fields.JP:
今日の作戦もそう。
本気で止めようとすれば、止められたと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think about what happened. If they
were serious, they could have
stopped us.

fields.EN:
I know they're all desperate, but
if their plan is based on your
sacrifice...
fields.JP:
……わかっているわ。誰もが必死なのだって。
でも……あなたの犠牲が無ければ成功しない
ような計画なら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know they're all desperate, but
if their plan is based on your
sacrifice...

fields.EN:
I'll do all that I can to stop it.
Even if it's something that you
want to happen.
fields.JP:
わたしは絶対に、止めてみせる。
たとえ、あなたのことだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll do all that I can to stop it.
Even if it's something that you
want to happen.

fields.EN:
So please, don't treat your life
so lightly...
fields.JP: だから……自分の命を粗末にしないで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't treat your life
so lightly...

fields.EN:
(So this is what Alice meant when
she said she would protect me...)
fields.JP:
（『僕に何かあった時には守る』ってアリスが
　言ってたのは、そういうことだったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So this is what Alice meant when
she said she would protect me...)

fields.EN:
Thanks, Alice. And I'm sorry. I
guess I was only thinking about
myself back then.
fields.JP:
アリス、ありがとう。……それに、ごめん。
僕は君たちのことを考えてるようで、
自分のことだけ考えてたと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Alice. And I'm sorry. I
guess I was only thinking about
myself back then.

fields.EN: I hated being the only one who was useless. Pretty childish, huh...?
fields.JP:
一人だけ役立たずなんて嫌だ、って。
子供っぽいよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to have a useless
existence here... That probably
sounds pretty childish.

fields.EN:
What you told me is right, Alice.
Both of us, and everyone else
here, we're probably all tools.
fields.JP:
それに、アリスが言ってることは、僕も
正しいと思う。
僕たちも、多分あの人たちも道具なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you told me is right, Alice.
Both of us, and everyone else
here, we're probably all tools.

fields.EN:
Yup... I was pressuring myself,
and I think I still am.
fields.JP:
うん……僕は確かに焦ってたし、正直、
いまでも焦ってるんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I was pressuring myself,
and I think I still am.

fields.EN:
But, I want to do what I can so
that we can both escape the Jail
alive.
fields.JP:
でも、僕は君と一緒に、生きてこのジェイルを
脱出したいから……
だから、自分にもできることをしたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I want to do what I can so
that we can both escape the Jail
alive.

fields.EN:
Escape the Jail alive... You're
not going to go against what
you said just now, right?
fields.JP:
生きて、一緒にジェイルを脱出する……
それは、本当ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Escape the Jail alive... You're
not going to go against what
you said just now, right?

fields.EN:
Of course I won't. It's a promise.
I'm sorry to worry you so much.
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。約束する。
だからその……心配ばかりかけて、ごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I won't. It's a promise.
I'm sorry to worry you so much.

fields.EN:
No, same here... I just have a
knack for saying things on
impulse...
fields.JP:
いいえ。わたしこそ……
言葉ばかり先走ってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, same here... I just have a
knack for saying things on
impulse...

fields.EN:
Um... How about we take a stroll?
Staying inside gets a bit
depressing after a while.
fields.JP:
その……少し、外を歩かない？
ずっと部屋の中では、気が滅入ってしまうもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... How about we take a stroll?
Staying inside gets a bit
depressing after a while.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
If you ask me, I can't agree with
what you said. You know the reason
yourself, right?
fields.JP:
……私の立場から言わせてもらえば、
諸手を挙げて賛成とは言いかねるわ。
理由は言わなくても、わかるわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you ask me, I can't agree with
what you said. You know the reason
yourself, right?

fields.EN:
I'll show you the supporting data
later. That should be convincing
enough evidence for you.
fields.JP:
後で詳細なデータを提出するさ。
それを見りゃ、アンタだって納得する筈だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll show you the supporting data
later. That should be convincing
enough evidence for you.

fields.EN:
They look like they're in an
argument...
fields.JP: なんか……揉めてるみたいだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They look like they're in an
argument...

fields.EN: We should probably head back before those two notice us...
fields.JP:
二人が気づかないうちに、戻った方が
よさそうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We better leave them before they
notice us...

fields.EN:
Well, it is what it is, so I can't
deny it isn't foolproof, but...
Hm?
fields.JP:
なにしろ、モノがモノだからな。
危険がゼロだとは言わない。
それでも……ん！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is what it is, so I can't
deny it isn't foolproof, but...
Hm?

fields.EN:
Hey! Jack! Why the hell are ya
scuttling away like that?!
fields.JP:
……おい、ジャック！
なに、逃げようとしてんだよ？
つれねえな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Jack! Why the hell are ya
scuttling away like that?!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: あら、ジャック。アリスも一緒なのね

fields.EN:
Uh... We just thought you were
busy, so... Haha...
fields.JP:
あ、あの……取り込み中みたいだったから……
あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... We just thought you were
busy, so... Haha...

fields.EN: We didn't want to bother you.
fields.JP: その、お邪魔したみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED: We didn't want to bother you.

fields.EN: Bother? It was just small talk..
fields.JP: なあに……ただの無駄話だよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Bother? It was just small talk..

fields.EN:
Perfect timing. There's something
I wanted to confirm.
fields.JP:
ちょうどいい。
確認しときたいことがあったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect timing. There's something
I wanted to confirm.

fields.JP: ……なんですか、確認したいことって？

fields.EN:
To be specific, it's more like
reconfirming something, but...
fields.JP:
正確には、再確認かな。
いや、たいしたことじゃないんだがな
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be specific, it's more like
reconfirming something, but...

fields.EN:
You remember how you came
to me for help?
fields.JP:
ジャック……お前、
俺んとこ来て頼み込んだよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember how you came
to me for help?

fields.EN:
To get a weapon you could use
to fight the Marchens.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンと戦うための
武器が欲しいと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To get a weapon you could use
to fight the Marchens.

fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと！
ハルさん……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
That you wanted to fight alongside
the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
血式少女たちと共に、
最前線で戦いたいのだと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That you wanted to fight alongside
the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I was just talking about it
earlier with Alice.
fields.JP: ……今も、アリスと話してたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just talking about it
earlier with Alice.

fields.EN:
That I wanted to fight the
Marchens with her and everyone
else...
fields.JP:
僕も……
僕も、アリスたちと一緒に、
メルヒェンと戦いたいって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That I wanted to fight the
Marchens with her and everyone
else...

fields.EN:
So, why did you want to fight
again? I kinda forgot. Refresh my
memory, will ya, Jack?
fields.JP:
それは……何のためだったっけか？
悪りい、忘れちまった。
もう一度、聞かせてくれ……ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, why did you want to fight
again? I kinda forgot. Refresh my
memory, will ya, Jack?

fields.EN:
To live... To stay alive so that
we can escape from the Jail...
fields.JP:
生きるために……
生きてジェイルを脱出するために……です
fields.LOCALIZED:
To live... To stay alive so that
we can escape from the Jail...

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, that's right. Thanks for
reminding me, Jack.
fields.JP:
おっと、そうだったな。
すまない、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, that's right. Thanks for
reminding me, Jack.

fields.EN:
You heard that, Miko? Straight
from Jack himself.
fields.JP:
なあ、視子。
ジャックが、こう言ってんだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard that, Miko? Straight
from Jack himself.

fields.EN:
Why, you... I can't believe you set
me up like that. Now I have to
cooperate.
fields.JP:
……ったく、このオヤジは……
まんまと罠に嵌められたわね。
これじゃ、反対もできないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, you... I can't believe you set
me up like that. Now I have to
cooperate.

fields.EN:
First I want the data. We can talk
about what to do afterwards...
fields.JP:
まずは詳細なデータを。
話は……それからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
First I want the data. We can talk
about what to do afterwards...

fields.EN: Of course. You mind following me?
fields.JP:
ああ、もちろんだ。
……それじゃ、今からでも？
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. You mind following me?

fields.EN:
Sorry, Jack, but we've got some
stuff to take care of.
fields.JP:
……ってなわけで、ジャック。
俺たちは、これからヤボ用だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Jack, but we've got some
stuff to take care of.

fields.EN:
Oh yeah! Stop by my place tomorrow
when you've got the time.
fields.JP:
ああ、そうだ！
明日、お前の手が空いてる時でいい。
俺んとこに顔を出してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah! Stop by my place tomorrow
when you've got the time.

fields.EN:
Oh, and if I'm sleeping, you mind
coming back when I'm awake?
fields.JP:
あー……そうだ。
もし、俺が寝てるタイミングだったら
悪いが出直すようにしてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and if I'm sleeping, you mind
coming back when I'm awake?

fields.EN:
Sure, like you'd really be
awake...
fields.JP: まず、起きないと思うけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, like you'd really be
awake...

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack? Don't be causing too
much trouble to the lil' miss.
fields.JP:
おい、ジャック。
あんまり嬢ちゃんを泣かせんなよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack? Don't be causing too
much trouble to the lil' miss.

fields.JP:
……え！？
そんなこと、しませんよ！

fields.EN:
Unlike some sly man I know, Jack
keeps his promises.
fields.JP:
……ずる賢いおじさま方と違って、
ジャックはきちんと約束してくれましたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unlike some sly man I know, Jack
keeps his promises.

fields.EN:
Sly, eh? Heh, not that I can deny
it.
fields.JP:
ずる賢い、ね。
まあそうでしょうねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sly, eh? Heh, not that I can deny
it.

fields.EN:
In any case, you both be good to
each other, ya hear?
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, you both be good to
each other, ya hear?

fields.EN: Yes... You both get some rest.
fields.JP:
ええ。
……二人とも、今日はもう休みなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... You both get some rest.

fields.EN:
I wonder what they were talking
about.
fields.JP: ところで……何の話、だったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what they were talking
about.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure, really... I can only
hope they were talking about my
weapon.
fields.JP:
それが……僕にも、よくわからない……
僕の武器のことならいいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure, really... I can only
hope they were talking about my
weapon.

fields.EN:
Jack... No pressure, okay? Let's
head back.
fields.JP:
ジャック。焦らないで。
……戻りましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... No pressure, okay? Let's
head back.

fields.EN:
(That's right... Haru-san said to stop
by.)
fields.JP:
（……そういえば、ハルさんが顔を出せって
　言ってたっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... Haru said to stop
by.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
(I think he said he'd be at the
factory... Did I get here too
late?)
fields.JP:
（製造施設に顔を出せって言ってたけど……
　ちょっと遅くなっちゃった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think he said he'd be at the
factory... Did I get here too
late?)

fields.EN: (I wonder if Haru-san is still awake.)
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
(I hear someone talking behind the
door... Does he have a guest?)
fields.JP:
（ドアの向こうから話し声が聞こえる……
　誰か来てるのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hear someone talking behind the
door... Does he have a guest?)

fields.EN: The numbers aren't as alarming as I feared. The hematopoietic stem cells are active at a level far beyond a normal person's. In terms of supply alone... it's more than sufficient for practical use.
fields.JP:
……当初、危惧していたほどの数字ではないわ。
造血幹細胞の活動が常人とは桁違いなの。
供給量のみで見るなら……充分、実用レベルね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The numbers aren't as alarming as
expected. The hemopoietic stroma
level is beyond normal, though...

fields.EN:
I'm thinking of it as something
akin to aerosol with a 60:1 ratio
blend of oxygen, which will...
fields.JP:
……要はエアゾルの親分みたいなもんなんだ。
エアーとの混合比は、およそ６０対１。
連続使用に耐えられるレベルだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm thinking of it as something
akin to aerosol with a 60:1 ratio
blend of oxygen, which will...

fields.EN:
And the sanitary levels of the
drain pipe? Infection at the
insertion point is risky, and...
fields.JP:
……ドレーンパイプの衛生状態は大丈夫なの？
なにしろ使用環境が最悪なんだから……
挿管部位からの感染症リスクが気になるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the sanitary levels of the
drain pipe? Infection at the
insertion point is risky, and...

fields.EN:
It's completely sealed.
Disinfectant is sprayed when
equipped, but if it breaks...
fields.JP:
……挿管部位は完璧にシールしてある。
着脱時には、カプセルから消毒液を噴射しよう。
問題はぶっ壊れた時だが、これはどうにもな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's completely sealed.
Disinfectant is sprayed when
equipped, but if it breaks...

fields.EN: ...Even if the pump fails, the safety device ensures there can be no backflow. But how do we stop the bleeding if that happens?
fields.JP:
……ポンプがイカレても安全装置が働いて、
逆流することだけは絶対にないが、
その場合の止血をどうする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The safety lock will prevent flow-
back, but I'm not convinced it can
stop the hemorrhaging without...

fields.EN: We just finished analyzing the magnolia. It's the best hemostatic agent I know of, and it's passed clinical trials. In small amounts, we can even synthesize its main component.
fields.JP:
……ホオノキの成分分析が終わったとこなの。
私が知る限り最高の止血剤よ。治験もクリア。
少量なら、主成分を合成することもできるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just finished analyzing the
magnolia leaves. It should
synergize if the components...

fields.EN: Perfect. I'll build an emergency hemostatic ampule into the drain pipe. Better make it a cartridge.
fields.JP:
……お誂え向きだな。ドレーンパイプの方に……
緊急用の止血剤アンプルを組み込んでおこう。
そうだな、カートリッジ化しておくか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds like a plan. Then I
can add a cartridge that would
act as an emergency ampule to...

fields.EN:
(It's Miko-san... Whatever they're
talking about is way beyond me...)
fields.JP:
（あ、視子さんだ……
　なんだか難しそうな話をしてる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Miko... Whatever they're
talking about is way beyond me...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(I don't think I can barge in like
this...)
fields.JP: （……ちょっと、入って行きにくいなあ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't think I can barge in like
this...)

fields.EN:
(They seem to be working, so maybe
I should just come back
tomorrow...)
fields.JP:
（仕事の邪魔をしたくないし……
　明日にでも、また出直そうかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They seem to be working, so maybe
I should just come back
tomorrow...)

fields.EN:
(Yeah, I'll just see Haru-san again
then...)
fields.JP:
（ハルさんのところへは、
　明日もう一度、訪ねてみよう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yeah, I'll just see Haru again
then...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
(Still, I wonder what Haru-san and
Miko-san were talking about...)
fields.JP:
（でも……ハルさんと視子さん……
　何を話してたんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, I wonder what they were
talking about...)
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
(Maybe they just had things to
do...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe they just had things to
do...)

fields.JP:
ジャック！　ジャックったら！
ねえ、起きて！

fields.EN: There's an emergency! Akazukin-san went ahead already!
fields.JP:
緊急召集がかかったの！
赤ずきんさんは先に行ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's an emergency! Red Riding
Hood went ahead already!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I don't know... It looks like they
need us at the Rescue Center.
fields.JP:
わからないわ。
救護室に集まるようにってだけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know... It looks like they
need us at the Rescue Center.

fields.JP: わかった。救護室に行こう！
（……いったい、何が起きたんだろう！？）

fields.EN:
Um, we're here about the
emergency...
fields.JP: あの、呼び出しを受けたんですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, we're here about the
emergency...

fields.JP: うう……ナイトメアに見つかって……

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama was caught, and the
only choice we had was to
escape...
fields.JP:
……親指姉様は捕まってしまって、
白雪たちは、逃げるしかできなかったんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina was caught, and the
only choice we had was to
escape...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Judging by how badly injured you
both are, you're lucky to have
escaped at all.
fields.JP:
二人とも、こんなに怪我してるじゃない。
逃げて来れただけ、良かったと思った方がいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Judging by how badly injured you
both are, you're lucky to have
escaped at all.

fields.JP: （何か……大変なことが起きたみたいだ）
（それに……この二人、目がピンクに……）

fields.EN:
You're not only injured, but
exhausted. You won't recover
if you keep moving like that.
fields.JP:
まだ無理に動こうとしちゃ駄目よ。
体力だって消耗している筈だし……
傷口だってすぐに塞がるわけじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not only injured, but
exhausted. You won't recover
if you keep moving like that.

fields.EN:
Don't blame yourselves. You both
did well. You came back alive and
brought valuable information.
fields.JP:
そうだよ二人とも、自分を責めるものじゃない。
君たちはよく頑張ったし、生還もしたのだからね
おかげで得られたものは大きいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't blame yourselves. You both
did well. You came back alive and
brought valuable information.

fields.EN:
We don't know whether Oyayubihime
is dead yet, either. All we know
is that she was captured.
fields.JP:
第一、親指姫が死んだとはまだ限らないだろう？
君たちの報告が確かならば、
彼女は襲われたのではなく、捕まったのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know whether Thumbelina
is dead yet, either. All we know
is that she was captured.

fields.EN:
Yes, but... Oh, please be alive,
Oyayubi-neesama!
fields.JP:
そう……ですけど……
親指姉様、どうか生きてて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but... Oh, please be alive,
dear Sister Thumbelina!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Don't worry. We'll send a rescue
unit right away.
fields.JP: 心配ないよ。すぐに救援を向かわせるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We'll send a rescue
unit right away.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I need you two to
head to the Graveyard area to
save Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
早速で済まんが、二人には『元墓所エリア』に
向かってもらいたい。
親指姫を救出してほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I need you two to
head to the Graveyard area to
save Thumbelina.

fields.JP: もちろんだよ、お父さん！
（赤ずきんさんと、アリスだけ！？）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(It seems like one of them was
caught, and the others barely
escaped a Nightmare...)
fields.JP:
（今の話だと、一人が捕まって、この二人が
　どうにか逃げてきたってことだ。
　……しかも、相手はナイトメアだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems like one of them was
caught, and the others barely
escaped a Nightmare...)

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is keeping up a
strong front, but it's too risky
to have only the two of them go.)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんはああして強がってるけど、
　二人だけで大丈夫なはずが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is keeping up a
strong front, but it's too risky
to have only the two of them go.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, Nemu! Don't worry!
We'll go and beat that Nightmare
and rescue Oyayubi!
fields.JP:
白雪、ネム、安心していいからね！
ナイトメアなんか、あたしたちが軽ーく
ぶっ飛ばして、親指取り戻して来るからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, Sleepy! Don't worry!
We'll go and beat that Nightmare
and rescue Thumbelina!

fields.EN:
Nightmares can't be defeated...
Even with your power, Aka-neesama, I doubt...
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは、倒せない相手です。
赤姉様でも、親指姉様は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmares can't be defeated...
Even with your power, Red Riding
Hood, I doubt...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Hold it right there! Things
changed while you were gone!
fields.JP: それがさ、ちょーっと事情が変わったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold it right there! Things
changed while you were gone!

fields.EN:
While you were on your mission,
they came back after defeating a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
君たちが任務に出た矢先の出来事だったのだが、
彼女たちがナイトメアの討伐に成功したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
While you were on your mission,
they came back after defeating a
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
So there's no need to worry. Just
rest and calm yourselves.
fields.JP: だから君たちは安心して休みたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there's no need to worry. Just
rest and calm yourselves.

Now then... Red Riding Hood,
Alice...

fields.EN:
Please wait! Please let me go with
them!
fields.JP:
待ってください！
僕も同行させてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please wait! Please let me go with
them!

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, I thought I said clearly
that you're not fit for battle.
fields.JP:
……ジャックくん。言ったはずだ。
君は戦力外なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I thought I said clearly
that you're not fit for battle.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I know I can't fight, but if they
enter Blood Skelter...!
fields.JP:
武器を使えないのは、わかってます。
でも、アリスたちがもし、
ブラッドスケルター化したら……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I can't fight, but if they
enter Blood Skelter...!

fields.EN: They're facing a Nightmare! We don't have time to wait until my blood can be put into practical use!
fields.JP:
相手は、ナイトメアなんです！
僕の血の実用化なんて、待ってる暇は無い
はずです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're going to face a Nightmare!
We can't wait for other means to
help them in that state!

fields.EN:
We'll be okay, Jack. We already
beat one, so we won't let that
experience go to waste.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫だよ、ジャック。
この間の実戦経験だってあるし、
あたしらはそんなヘマはおかさないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll be okay, Jack. We already
beat one, so we won't let that
experience go to waste.

fields.EN:
Jack, we'll be fine. Don't forget
the promise we made.
fields.JP:
ジャック、大丈夫よ。
この間の約束……忘れないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, we'll be fine. Don't forget
the promise we made.

fields.EN:
Dad, Shirayuki, Nemu, we'll
get this done in a jiffy!
fields.JP:
じゃあお父さん。白雪にネム。
ちょちょいっと行ってくるからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad, Snow White, Sleepy, we'll
get this done in a jiffy!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
So they really did beat a
Nightmare?!
fields.JP: ナイトメアを倒せたって……本当ですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So they really did beat a
Nightmare?!

fields.EN:
But if that's true, then we could
have beaten it if we had just
tried harder...
fields.JP:
だったら白雪たちも、
もしかしたら……もっと頑張ったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if that's true, then we could
have beaten it if we had just
tried harder...

fields.EN:
This was the first time a
Nightmare was defeated.
fields.JP:
……二人とも。ナイトメアの討伐は、
まだ最初の事例に過ぎないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was the first time a
Nightmare was defeated.

fields.EN: Even the method that stripped it of its immortality is still only a hypothesis based on a single case. There was no way either of you could have known how to do it.
fields.JP:
その不死性を奪った方法についても、
一つの事例だけではまだ仮説の域を出ず、
君たちがその術を知る由も無かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
We still don't know the precise
details of how it was killed, so
neither of you could have known.

fields.EN:
Yes. From my perspective, both of
you retreating was the right call.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
あなたたちの帰投の判断は正しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. From my perspective, both of
you retreating was the right call.

fields.EN: If they can defeat the Nightmare again during this rescue mission, we'll have much stronger confirmation.
fields.JP:
今回の救出作戦で、再びナイトメアを倒す
ことができれば、より確証は増すだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If they can defeat the Nightmare,
then we can gain even more
knowledge on defeating them.

fields.EN:
But... What if they can't beat
it...?
fields.JP: それじゃ……もし、倒せなかったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... What if they can't beat
it...?

fields.EN:
(That's right... What if they
can't defeat it?!)
fields.JP: （そうだ。もし倒せなかったら……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... What if they
can't defeat it?!)

fields.EN:
(The Professor sent them off,
knowing that was an actual
possibility.)
fields.JP:
（その可能性を判ってて、それでも博士は
　二人を行かせたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Professor sent them off,
knowing that was an actual
possibility.)

fields.EN: (I need to go after them, now!)
fields.JP: （……今からでも二人の後を追わなきゃ！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I need to go after them, now!)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: ……どこへ飛び出そうっていうんだ、坊主？

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: Oh? What brings you here, Haru-kun?
fields.JP:
……おや。
どうしたのかね、ハルくん
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? What brings you here, Haru?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
You know how long I was waiting
for ya?
fields.JP: あんまり訪ねて来ないから、待ちくたびれたぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how long I was waiting
for ya?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but now's not the time
to...!
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but now's not the time
to...!

fields.EN:
You really need to get a better
hold of yourself. Jack, is what
you said to me true?
fields.JP:
焦るなって言ったろ。
……ジャック、前に言ったことは本当か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really need to get a better
hold of yourself. Jack, is what
you said to me true?

fields.EN: The help you were wanting from me.
fields.JP: 俺んとこに来て、頼み込んだ時のヤツだ
fields.LOCALIZED: The help you were wanting from me.

fields.EN:
Yes... I want to live, and stay
alive with everyone...
fields.JP:
……はい。
僕は、みんなで生きるために……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I want to live, and stay
alive with everyone...

fields.EN:
Gotcha! Jack-san, excuse me a sec.
It might sting a little, okay?
fields.JP:
あいよ！
ジャックさん、ちょっと失礼するっすよー？
少ーしチクッとするかもっすー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotcha! Don't mind if it stings a
little, okay?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.JP: んー。違和感ないっすかー？

fields.EN: I-I guess... A gun that straps to my arm? It's got something like a tube attached to it...
fields.JP:
う……うん。
腕に装着する……銃？
なんか管みたいなのが付いてるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess... A gun strapped to my
arm? What's this needle here?

fields.JP: ひょっとしてこれ……僕の武器、なんですか！？

fields.EN:
I guess you can call it that. It's
called a Mary Gun. It's a device
that shoots out your blood.
fields.JP:
……まあ、武器っちゃ武器かな。
『メアリガン』っていうんだが、
簡単に言うと、お前の血をその銃で噴射する装置だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can call it that. It's
called a Mary Gun. It's a device
that shoots out your blood.

fields.EN:
Yes. But it isn't used to fight
enemies. It's a device to control
a Blood Maiden's state.
fields.JP:
ええ。でも、わかっているとは思うけど、
これは敵を倒す武器じゃないわ。
血式少女たちの暴走を抑制するための装置よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. But it isn't used to fight
enemies. It's a device to control
a Blood Maiden's state.

fields.EN:
Miko-san...! So, is this what you two
were talking about yesterday?!
fields.JP:
視子さん……！
じゃあ、ふたりが相談してたのって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, is this what you were talking
about yesterday?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Keep in mind, while there's
room for modifications, its power
will come from your very life.
fields.JP:
ああ。
文字通り、お前の生命を削って戦うことになる。
急ごしらえだから、改良の余地は多いっちゃ多いが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Keep in mind, while there's
room for modifications, its power
will come from your very life.

fields.EN:
(So that's why he kept asking me
whether I was sure about what I
said...)
fields.JP: （……それで何度も僕の覚悟を聞いたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that's why he kept asking me
whether I was sure about what I
said...)

fields.EN:
Boss put everything he had into
it! Guess he wanted to give it to
ya right away, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
師匠、超必死で造ってたっすからねー！
よっぽど早くジャックさんに渡したかったんじゃ
ないっすかねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss put everything he had into
it! Guess he wanted to give it to
ya all quick-like!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Haru-san... Miko-san... Thank you very
much!
fields.JP: ハルさん。視子さん……ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru... Miko... Thank you very
much!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(Now I can at least help protect
Alice and the others!)
fields.JP: （これで、少しでもアリスたちの身を守れる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now I can at least help protect
Alice and the others!)

fields.EN: It's only a prototype still at the theoretical testing stage. There's little certainty it's practical... or that his blood will work on every Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
……あくまで理論上の検証段階の試作品よ。
実用に耐えるか確実性は低いわ。
彼の血が全ての血式少女に効果があるかどうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a prototype based off
assumptions. There's no guarantee
it will have any effect.

fields.EN:
Without being able to test it, we
gotta assume that, if his blood
worked on those two, it'll work.
fields.JP:
試しようもねえ。
二人に効きゃ、可能性としちゃ十分だろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Without being able to test it, we
gotta assume that, if his blood
worked on those two, it'll work.

fields.EN:
You know, as a doctor, I can't
approve its use without prior
testing.
fields.JP:
参ったわね……まさか実験無しで
ぶっつけ本番だなんて……
医師としては賛成はしかねるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, as a doctor, I can't
approve its use without prior
testing.

fields.EN:
We've done all the hypothetical
applications we could, so the rest
is for luck to be on our side.
fields.JP:
世の中、何が起きるかわかんねえってことだな。
まあ、あんだけ検証したんだし、
あとは運を天に任せるしかねえだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've done all the hypothetical
applications we could, so the rest
is for luck to be on our side.

fields.EN:
I'll be fine! I just need to make
sure I don't overuse it, right?
fields.JP:
僕なら大丈夫です！
ふらふらするまで使わなければいいんですよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be fine! I just need to make
sure I don't overuse it, right?

fields.EN:
It's not that simple... This is
why I didn't want to disclose it.
fields.JP:
そんな簡単なことじゃ……
だから黙ってたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that simple... This is
why I didn't want to disclose it.

fields.EN:
Everyone's lives are on the line,
and I want everyone to come back
alive. I'm going!
fields.JP:
みんなだって、命をかけて戦ってるんです。
僕は、みんなに生きて帰ってきてほしいんです。
だから……行きます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's lives are on the line,
and I want everyone to come back
alive. I'm going!

fields.EN: You're a boy, after all. Still... don't forget your promise, okay?
fields.JP:
男の子だもんな。
けどまあ……約束、忘れんなよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't stop a boy trying to be
a man. Oh, but don't forget the
promise you made.

fields.EN:
Please wait... If he's going,
we'll go, too!
fields.JP:
待って……ください。
その子が行くなら、白雪たちも行きます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please wait... If he's going,
we'll go, too!

fields.EN: You're still not fully recovered. You should stay here and rest.
fields.JP:
あなたたちはまだ万全じゃないわ。
残って休むべきよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Neither of you are in a state to
move. Just stay here and rest.

fields.EN:
Calm yourselves. I don't want to
lose you both, with how close you
are to entering Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
ああ。心穏やかに休むことだ。
今の状態では、暴走する可能性も高いからね。
私たちは君たちを失いたくないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm yourselves. I don't want to
lose you both, with how close you
are to entering Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter applies to Aka-neesama, too... Our injuries are nothing
to worry about.
fields.JP:
暴走なら……赤姉様たちだって同じです。
白雪たちの怪我なら、すぐに治ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter applies to Sister
Red, too... Our injuries are nothing
to worry about.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
(They're in pain...? Are they
entering Blood Skelter?!)
fields.JP: （この苦しみ方……ブラッドスケルター化！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're in pain...? Are they
entering Blood Skelter?!)

fields.EN: Just spray the two of them with your blood! Stop their rampage!
fields.JP:
いいからこの二人に血を浴びせろ！
こいつらの暴走を止めるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just use it on them! Stop them
from entering Blood Skelter!

fields.EN:
It'll do wonders in convincing
anyone else who has doubts about
you.
fields.JP: ……石頭どもの説得にもちょうどいいだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll do wonders in convincing
anyone else who has doubts about
you.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry. Getting my blood all
over you must be disgusting,
but...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん。
血なんかかけて、気持ち悪かったと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry. Getting my blood all
over you must be disgusting,
but...

fields.EN: It's fine... I was just surprised.
fields.JP: 大丈夫……ちょっとびっくりしただけです
fields.LOCALIZED: It's fine... I was just surprised.

fields.JP: 二人とも……目の色がもうピンクじゃない！

fields.EN: Could I have a closer look?
fields.JP: ……目、ちょっと見せてもらえる？
fields.LOCALIZED: Could I have a closer look?

fields.EN: ...From a quick look, neither of them has any Corruption left.
fields.JP:
……簡単に見た限りでは、
二人とも、穢れは残っていないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Without the proper tools, I can't
say with certainty, but it seems
their Corruption has been removed.

fields.JP: （僕の血は、本当に役に立つんだ……！）
これで説得力も倍増じゃねえの？

fields.EN:
Understood. I'll approve
deployment of Jack, Shirayukihime,
and Nemurihime.
fields.JP:
……よろしい。
ジャック。白雪姫。眠り姫。
三人とも、先行した二人の加勢を認めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I'll approve
deployment of Jack, Snow White,
and Sleeping Beauty.

fields.JP: 親指姉様を取り戻してきます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll go and save dear Sister
Thumbelina!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: （待ってて。アリス、赤ずきんさん……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice, Red Riding Hood, wait
for me!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Boss? Is it just me, or did Jack-san
look happy?
fields.JP:
師匠。
ジャックさん……なんつーか……
嬉しそうだったすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss? Is it just me, or did Jack
look happy?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: I've never seen Jack-san looking that lively before. All that work making it was worth it!
fields.JP:
あんな元気そうなジャックさん、
自分、初めて見たっすよ。
頑張って造った甲斐があったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen him that excited
before. I'm glad I was able to get
it ready!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B46 systematic full-fidelity coverage review

fields.JP: いや……お前、見てただけだろ……

fields.EN:
That ain't true! I cleaned up your
desk, got parts when you needed
'em, and even made tea for ya!
fields.JP:
そんなことないっすよ！
師匠の机周り整えたり、棚から部品取ってきたり、
お茶入れたりいろいろしたっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That ain't true! I cleaned up your
desk, got parts when you needed
'em, and even made tea for ya!

fields.EN:
Sure, whatever... Thanks for the
help.
fields.JP: へいへい。いつも助かってますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, whatever... Thanks for the
help.

fields.EN: I hope he handles it well. The Mary Gun... depending on how it's used, it could become our strongest weapon...
fields.JP:
彼、上手くやってくれるといいけれど。
……メアリガン……
使いようによっては、最強の武器になるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope he fares well. The Mary Gun
could prove to be our strongest
weapon yet.

fields.EN:
And yet, I can't dismiss my
concerns.
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, I can't dismiss my
concerns.

fields.JP: えっ……どういうことっすか！？

fields.EN:
I can only hope that Jack-kun won't
get in the way of the girls...
fields.JP:
ジャックくんが、
彼女たちの足を引っ張ることに
ならねばよいのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope that Jack won't
get in the way of the girls...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
You are aware that the biggest
risk in our plan is the Maidens'
Blood Skelter state, right?
fields.JP:
俺たちの計画に内在する最大のリスクは、
血式少女のブラッドスケルター化だ。
それについてはアンタも認めるよな、博士？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are aware that the biggest
risk in our plan is the Maidens'
Blood Skelter state, right?

fields.EN:
It's true that their rampage is a
constant threat to our plan.
fields.JP:
そうね。
常に付きまとう暴走の危険性……
それが計画の妨げになってるのは確かだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that their rampage is a
constant threat to our plan.

fields.EN:
Not sure how Jack will do, but his
existence helps to control that
state.
fields.JP:
ジャックのやつがどこまでやれるか、
それはわからんが……
あいつの存在は、その抑制に働く
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not sure how Jack will do, but his
existence helps to control that
state.

fields.EN:
Don't you think that in itself is
a major benefit to us?
fields.JP:
……そのメリットは、
計り知れないんじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you think that in itself is
a major benefit to us?

fields.EN:
Worst-case scenario, if Jack bites
the dust, you're not gonna lose a
thing.
fields.JP:
最悪、ジャックがくたばったとしても、
アンタにとっては、大した損失じゃあるまい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worst-case scenario, if Jack bites
the dust, you're not gonna lose a
thing.

fields.EN:
Hey! Why'd you say that, boss?!
I'd be sad if that happened!
fields.JP:
や、自分は悲しいっすよ！
師匠！　ヤな言い方しないで欲しいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Why'd you say that, boss?!
I'd be sad if that happened!

fields.EN:
Are you stupid? I let him go
because I didn't think it would.
That kid won't die so easily.
fields.JP:
アホウ。
そうならないと踏んだから、行かせたんだよ。
あいつが、そう簡単に死ぬタマか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you stupid? I let him go
because I didn't think it would.
That kid won't die so easily.

fields.EN:
Haru-kun? Can you really attest to
that? I doubt you could.
fields.JP:
ハルくん、きみにその保証ができるのかね？
……できまい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru? Can you really attest to
that? I doubt you could.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
Aside from his blood, he's an
ordinary boy that you could find
anywhere.
fields.JP:
彼は特殊な血液を有しているというだけの、
ただの少年に過ぎないのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aside from his blood, he's an
ordinary boy that you could find
anywhere.

fields.EN:
It's not like Jack's blood is the
only reason I think he'll do good.
fields.JP:
……俺は、ジャックの血だけに、
期待してるわけじゃないんでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like Jack's blood is the
only reason I think he'll do good.

fields.EN: With him joining them, the unit will definitely become stronger. That's what I feel.
fields.JP:
あいつが加わることで、必ず部隊は強くなる。
……俺は、そう感じてるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can sense that he'll make
whoever he's paired with stronger
just by being there.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you're holding him
in such high regard. You must
really like him.
fields.JP:
……いつになく入れ込んでるじゃない？
ずいぶん、あの子を気に入ったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you're holding him
in such high regard. You must
really like him.

fields.JP: ……別に、そういうわけじゃねえよ

fields.EN:
It seems you misunderstand me.
I am concerned about Jack-kun's well-
being, as well.
fields.JP:
……どうも誤解があるようだが……
私は、もちろんジャックくんの身も
案じているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems you misunderstand me.
I am concerned about Jack's well-
being, as well.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Just as I'm concerned about my
precious daughters... The Blood
Maidens.
fields.JP:
血式少女……
あの大切な私の娘たちと同様にね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just as I'm concerned about my
precious daughters... The Blood
Maidens.

fields.EN:
Well, I'll be! Guess everyone's
worried about Jack-san just the same!
fields.JP:
……な、なーんだ！
結局、みんなジャックさんのことを、
心配してたってことっすよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'll be! Guess everyone's
worried about Jack just the same!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Ahaha! Jack-san sure is popular! This is what you'd call Jack being the total uke, huh?!
fields.JP:
あはは！　ジャックさん大人気じゃないすか！
これって、あれっすよね！
ジャック総受けってとこっすかね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Jack sure is popular
here! So, I guess one of ya is
gonna make your move on him!
fields.notes: Line-level source-gated honorific restoration; automatic occurrence matching was ambiguous.; B46 systematic full-fidelity coverage review

fields.EN: (I wonder how far Alice and the others have gotten...)
fields.JP: （アリスたち、どの辺まで行ったんだろう？）

あのう……ええと……
ジャックさん、でしたっけ？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I haven't
introduced myself yet.)
fields.JP: （そういえば、自己紹介してなかったっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I haven't
introduced myself yet.)

fields.EN:
Um, I'm Jack. Alice and I joined
recently, and I'm supposed to be
a Blood Youth or something...
fields.JP:
ええと、僕はジャック。
最近アリスと一緒に来たばかりで、
『血式少年』だって博士に言われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm Jack. Alice and I joined
recently, and I'm supposed to be
a Blood Youth or something...

fields.EN:
A Blood Youth? I've never heard of
one before.
fields.JP:
……血式少年、ですか？
聞いたことありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Blood Youth? I've never heard of
one before.

fields.EN: Yeah. They told me they'd never seen anyone like me before. I can't fight like the Blood Maidens, but apparently my blood can purge Corruption.
fields.JP:
うん。初めて見たって、言われた。
血式少女とは違って、戦う力は無いけど、
僕の血は穢れを消す力があるらしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I can't fight like the Blood
Maidens, but it seems I can purge
their Corruption with my blood.

fields.EN:
Our Corruption?! Come to think of
it, that would explain what
happened earlier...
fields.JP:
穢れを……！？
そういえば、さっきも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our Corruption?! Come to think of
it, that would explain what
happened earlier...

fields.EN:
Why, thank you so very much!
What a wonderful gift!
fields.JP:
本当にありがとうございます！
とっても……素敵な力、ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, thank you so very much!
What a wonderful gift!

fields.EN:
(It's good to hear someone
actually praise me like that...)
fields.JP: （そんな風に言ってもらえると、嬉しいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's good to hear someone
actually praise me like that...)

fields.EN:
Oh, um... My name is Shirayukihime. I
have two sisters, Oyayubihime and
Nemu-chan.
fields.JP:
ええと……白雪姫っていいます。
捕われた親指姉様……親指姫とネムちゃんとは
三姉妹なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... My name is Snow White. I
have two sisters, Thumbelina and
Sleepy.

fields.EN:
Oh, this here is Nemu-chan. Nemurihime. I'm looking forward to
working with you!
fields.JP:
そして、この子がネムちゃん……眠り姫です。
どうぞ、よろしくお願いします……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, this here is Sleepy. Sleeping
Beauty. I'm looking forward to
working with you!

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime and Nemurihime...
Got it! Well, let's hurry and save
Oyayubihime-san!
fields.JP:
白雪姫に眠り姫、だね。よろしく！
親指姫さんのこと、絶対に助け出そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White and Sleeping Beauty...
Got it! Well, let's hurry and save
Thumbelina!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
W-Well, let's get going, shall we?
We need to catch up to Aka-neesama's unit!
fields.JP:
そ……それじゃあ、行きましょう！
赤姉様たちに追いつかないとです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, let's get going, shall we?
We need to catch up to Sister
Red's unit!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: アアアァァァァァアアアアア……

fields.EN:
The Jail... I can't seem to get
used to those eerie sounds...
fields.JP:
……ジェイル……
いつも気味が悪い音です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail... I can't seem to get
used to those eerie sounds...

fields.JP: （……今は、何かを欲しがってるみたいだ……）

fields.EN:
C'mon... This thing isn't budging
a bit!
fields.JP: あー。こいつ、びくともしないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon... This thing isn't budging
a bit!

fields.JP: アリス？　赤ずきんさん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: Y-You guys came too?! Jack, what's going on here?!
fields.JP:
あ……あんたたちまで！？
ジャック。これ、どういうことなわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you girls doing here?!
Jack! What's going on?!

fields.EN:
Huh... Mary Gun, eh? I guess that
old man actually is working.
fields.JP:
へえ……メアリガンか……
あのおっさん、ちゃんと仕事してるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... Mary Gun, eh? I guess that
old man actually is working.

fields.EN:
Please, Aka-neesama... It seems
Haru-san was doing his very best.
fields.JP:
赤姉様はまたそういう……
ハルさん、一生懸命だったみたいですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, Sister Red... It seems
Haru was doing his very best.
fields.notes: Line-level source-gated honorific restoration; automatic occurrence matching was ambiguous. | Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! I'm just joking! If
anything, I'm surprised about what
happened.
fields.JP:
あはは！　冗談だって！
ただ、急展開だからさ。
ちょっとびっくりしたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! I'm just joking! If
anything, I'm surprised about what
happened.

fields.EN:
But, I'm actually glad you're
here, Jack. Ain't that right,
Alice?
fields.JP:
でもさ。正直ジャックが来てくれて、心強いよ
……ね、アリス？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I'm actually glad you're
here, Jack. Ain't that right,
Alice?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: But... please, Jack. It really is your first time using the Mary Gun in actual combat.
fields.JP:
でも……お願い、ジャック。
メアリガンを実戦に使うのが初めてなのは、
本当だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I know you want to use the
Mary Gun in battle, but...

fields.EN: Please be careful when using it.
fields.JP: どうか……慎重に使ってちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED: Please be careful when using it.

fields.JP: うん……わかったよ、アリス

fields.EN:
Oh, but Jack-san's Mary Gun helped us
when we entered Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
でも……ジャックさんのメアリガンのおかげで、
白雪たちはブラッドスケルター化から
救われました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but Jack's Mary Gun helped us
when we entered Blood Skelter.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Alice-san. We'll support
Jack-san, too!
fields.JP:
アリスさん……
白雪たちも、ジャックさんをしっかり
サポートします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Alice. We'll support
Jack, too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Thank you, Shirayukihime-san, Nemurihime-san, was it? I heard about you
from Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
ええ。……白雪姫さんと、眠り姫さんね。
あなたたちのことは、赤ずきんさんから
話してもらったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Snow White, Sleeping
Beauty, was it? I heard about you
from Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 赤ずきん => Red Riding Hood-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1; 白雪姫 => Snow White-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 | Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I hope we can all get along. Now
then, let's go and save
Oyayubihime-san.
fields.JP:
……どうぞよろしく
親指姫さんを、みんなで救出しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope we can all get along. Now
then, let's go and save
Thumbelina.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yes! We heard about you, Alice-san,
from Jack-san, too... I'm sure we'll
get along very well!
fields.JP:
はい！　白雪たちも、アリスさんのことを
ジャックさんから……
よろしくお願いします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! Oh, and we heard about you
from Jack, too... I'm sure we'll
get along very well!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 | Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
All right! Guess that's it for the
formalities!
fields.JP: あはは！　自己紹介の手間が省けたね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Guess that's it for the
formalities!

fields.EN: Let's all do our best, okay?
fields.JP: よっし……みんな、がんばろう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's all do our best, okay?

fields.EN:
(I'm glad we were able to make it
in time...)
fields.JP: （やっぱり、合流できてよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad we were able to make it
in time...)

fields.EN:
Oh, but check it out... We can't
get through this dang wall.
fields.JP:
でも……見てよ、この有り様。
この壁、何やってもびくともしないんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but check it out... We can't
get through this dang wall.

fields.EN:
We've tried different things, but
we can't seem to find a way
through.
fields.JP:
ええ……ふたりでいろいろ試してみたけれど、
どうにもならないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've tried different things, but
we can't seem to find a way
through.

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime? Nemurihime? Do
you have any means to get us
through here?
fields.JP:
白雪姫。眠り姫……
ふたりには……何か、できそうなこと、ある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
