Snow White? Sleeping Beauty? Do
you have any means to get us
through here?

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime's Blood ability, Poison
Bomb, places a bomb on the floor
that affects a certain range.
fields.JP:
白雪姫の血式能力【ポイズンボム】は、
床に毒爆弾を置くことで、周囲に影響のある
爆発を発生させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White's Blood ability, Poison
Bomb, places a bomb on the floor
that affects a certain range.

fields.EN:
Test it out if you find
destructible walls or anything
that could be affected by poison.
fields.JP:
壊せそうな壁や毒が効きそうな対象が
あったら試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Test it out if you find
destructible walls or anything
that could be affected by poison.

fields.EN: But be careful: if you're nearby when it explodes, you'll take damage too.
fields.JP:
ただし、爆発する時に近くにいると
自分もダメージを食らうので
気をつけましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that staying near the bomb
will hurt your party, so be
careful.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime's Blood ability,
Rose Arrow, shoots a thorn arrow
forward 7 squares.
fields.JP:
眠り姫の血式能力【ローズアロー】は、
前方７マスに向かって、
イバラの矢を放ることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty's Blood ability,
Rose Arrow, shoots a thorn arrow
forward 7 squares.

fields.EN:
Use it on things that are located
in the distance, or on other
objects of interest.
fields.JP:
手では届かない怪しいものや
遠くに狙えるものがあったら試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it on things that are located
in the distance, or on other
objects of interest.

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime, Nemurihime, I
want to try something out. Could
you help?
fields.JP:
試したいことがあるんだ。
白雪姫、眠り姫。協力してもらえる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, Sleeping Beauty, I
want to try something out. Could
you help?

fields.EN: All right! Now we can go on!
fields.JP: よーし！　これで先へ進めるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Now we can go on!

fields.JP: メルヒェンたちが、こんなに！？

fields.EN:
We'll help too! We can all do
this, together!
fields.JP:
白雪たち……みなさんと力を合わせることが
できると思います……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll help too! We can all do
this, together!

fields.EN: Looks like that was the last one!
fields.JP: ……残った奴は、もういないようだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like that was the last one!

fields.JP: （僕のメアリガンが、実戦で役に立ったんだ……！）

fields.EN: Great work, everyone! For a team fighting together for the first time, you were amazingly in sync!
fields.JP:
みんな、よくやったよ……！
初めてのチームとは思えないくらい、息も
ぴったりだった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good work, everyone! For being a
fresh new team, it all turned out
pretty well!

fields.EN:
I feel stronger, just having you
here like this.
fields.JP: あなたが来てくれて、こんなに心強いなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel stronger, just having you
here like this.

fields.EN:
Only now can I tell how much
stronger I feel by having
allies...
fields.JP:
それに……仲間がいるって、こんなに心強い
ことだったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only now can I tell how much
stronger I feel by having
allies...

fields.EN:
Um, Alice? You're making it sound
like I wasn't enough.
fields.JP:
ちょっとアリス。
それ、あたしだけじゃ心細いってこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Alice? You're making it sound
like I wasn't enough.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! You need to lighten up a
bit.
fields.JP: あはは……アリスはすぐ真に受けるなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! You need to lighten up a
bit.

fields.EN:
But you're right... Having allies
is a good thing.
fields.JP:
……そうだよ。
仲間って、すごくいいものなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you're right... Having allies
is a good thing.

fields.EN:
Guess what, Jack? Now you really
are one of us.
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
これであんたは、押しも押されもしない、
あたしらの仲間だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess what, Jack? Now you really
are one of us.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
That also means that I'm not going
to forgive you if you die on me.
fields.JP: だから……死んだら許さないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means that I'm not going
to forgive you if you die on me.

fields.EN:
I don't want any of my allies or
my friends to die.
fields.JP: ……あたしは、仲間の誰にも死なれたくないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want any of my allies or
my friends to die.

fields.EN:
I understand. I'll be sure to use
the Mary Gun carefully.
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。
メアリガンも、慎重に使う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand. I'll be sure to use
the Mary Gun carefully.

fields.EN:
All right! Oyayubi may be upset at
how late we are in saving her, so
let's hurry up and move!
fields.JP:
よーし。
それじゃあ、親指を助けに行こう！
あの子、待ちくたびれて怒ってるかもよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Thumby may be upset at
how late we are in saving her, so
let's hurry up and move!

fields.EN:
That's a core! Wait... What's that
next to it...?
fields.JP:
あれは……核だわ！！
そしてその傍にあるのは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a core! Wait... What's that
next to it...?

fields.EN:
A cell? It looks like someone's
inside...
fields.JP: 牢だ……誰か閉じ込められてる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A cell? It looks like someone's
inside...

fields.JP: 親指だ！　間違いないよ！

fields.EN: Oyayubi! We're here to save you!
fields.JP: 親指！　助けに来たよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thumby! We're here to save you!

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP:
白雪……赤姉！？
それに、ネムも……！
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Everyone's here to rescue you!
Thank goodness you're safe...
fields.JP:
みんなで助けに来たんです！
親指姉様、無事でよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's here to rescue you!
Thank goodness you're safe...

fields.EN:
I don't sense any Nightmares
nearby.
fields.JP: 近くにナイトメアはいないみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't sense any Nightmares
nearby.

fields.JP: 親指姫さん……怪我はしていない？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Is it possible that the creature
who captured you was Snark?
fields.JP:
君を捕まえたのって、ひょっとして
スナークじゃ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it possible that the creature
who captured you was Snark?

fields.EN:
We've just joined the Dawn, and we
came here with everyone to save
you, Oyayubihime-san.
fields.JP:
僕らは、黎明の新入りなんだ。
その……親指姫さんのことが心配で
同行させてもらったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've just joined the Dawn, and we
came here with everyone to save
you, Thumbelina.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm not hurt, and I sure didn't
lose to any lousy Nightmare.
fields.JP:
……怪我はないわ。
このわたしがナイトメアなんかに
やられるわけないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not hurt, and I sure didn't
lose to any lousy Nightmare.

fields.EN:
(I'm sure she must have been
scared... It's brave of her to say
that, all things considering.)
fields.JP:
（『ナイトメアにやられるわけない』って……
　怖かっただろうに、気丈な子だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure she must have been
scared... It's brave of her to say
that, all things considering.)

fields.EN:
Oh, and there's a Marchen standing
guard here. It looks different
from any I've seen before.
fields.JP:
あと……見張りのメルヒェンがいるわ。
今までのとは違う見た目の奴が
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and there's a Marchen standing
guard here. It looks different
from any I've seen before.

fields.EN:
Looks different...? Maybe it's
guarding the core.
fields.JP:
見た目が違う……？
……核の守護者かもしれないわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks different...? Maybe it's
guarding the core.

fields.EN:
All right, let's beat that thing
up first. Oyayubi, you wait right
there!
fields.JP:
よし。じゃあまずはそいつをやっつけてからだね。
親指、ちょっとそこで待ってて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's beat that thing
up first. Thumby, you wait right
there!

fields.EN:
Aka-nee, be careful. Whatever
it is, it's really strong!
fields.JP:
赤姉、気をつけて。
あいつ、強いわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red, be careful. Whatever
it is, it's really strong!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Just sit back and let us handle
it!
fields.JP: ま、あんたは安心して見てて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just sit back and let us handle
it!

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Now then, time to break open the
cell. Stand back, Oyayubi...
fields.JP: じゃ、牢を壊すよ……親指、下がってて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, time to break open the
cell. Stand back, Thumby...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama! I'm so glad
you're safe!
fields.JP:
親指姉様……！！
無事で良かったです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina! I'm so glad
you're safe!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: ふ……ふたりとも、大げさなのよ

fields.EN:
But, thanks, everyone. I knew
you'd come and save me...
fields.JP:
……みんな、ありがと。
助けに来てくれるって、信じてた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, thanks, everyone. I knew
you'd come and save me...

fields.EN:
Well, doing this was a cinch for
us!
fields.JP:
ま、あたしらみんなにかかりゃ、
こんなのちょろいって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, doing this was a cinch for
us!

fields.EN:
I'm honestly surprised. That was an
amazing fight...
fields.JP:
正直、びっくりしたわよ。
見事な戦いぶりだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm honestly surprised. That was an
amazing fight...

fields.EN:
Oh, and a couple more have joined
the ranks since last time! She's
Alice, and the guy there is Jack.
fields.JP:
そうそう。あんたが捕まってる間に、
新しい仲間ができたよ！
こっちがアリスで、こっちがジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and a couple more have joined
the ranks since last time! She's
Alice, and the guy there is Jack.

fields.EN:
Alice, and... Jack. I'm sorry for
all the trouble.
fields.JP:
アリスと……ジャック……ね。
その……迷惑かけたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, and... Jack. I'm sorry for
all the trouble.

fields.EN: It's no trouble... Akazukin-san rescued us from a prison cell too. I hope we'll get along from here on.
fields.JP:
迷惑なんて……わたしたちも、赤ずきんさんに
独房から救出されたのだもの。
これから、どうぞよろしく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no problem at all. We were
saved by Red Riding Hood from a
prison cell, too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration; B46 systematic full-fidelity coverage review

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama... Jack-san saved us
from our rampage and brought us
here.
fields.JP:
親指姉様。ジャックさんが白雪たちを
暴走から救ってくれて……
ここまで連れてきてくれたんですよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina... Jack saved us
from our rampage and brought us
here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Aka-nee... This... Jack person
here is...?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red... This... Jack person
here is...?
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Um... Well, there's a lot going on
with him...
fields.JP: えーと、ちょっと色々あってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Well, there's a lot going on
with him...

fields.EN:
We can talk later once we get
back. Let's smash the core first,
okay?
fields.JP:
ま、とりあえず核ぶっ壊しちゃうよ！
話は帰ってからでもできるし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can talk later once we get
back. Let's smash the core first,
okay?

fields.EN:
It's just like I thought... We can
do this!
fields.JP: やっぱりそうだ……いけるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just like I thought... We can
do this!

fields.EN:
Everyone! Just a little more! We
can beat it!
fields.JP:
みんな……あと一息だよ！
あと一息で、あいつを倒せる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Just a little more! We
can beat it!

fields.EN:
Aka-nee, you're going to have
to explain what's happening later!
fields.JP: 赤姉……後でちゃんと説明しなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red, you're going to have
to explain what's happening later!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: ほんとに……倒しちゃった……！？
ナイトメアが、消えていきます……！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Yeah... The first one wasn't just a coincidence. This is another major achievement...!
fields.JP:
うん……
最初のは『たまたま』じゃなかったんだ。
これも大きな成果だよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... The one we beat wasn't by
chance. This battle is going to
help us a lot!

fields.EN:
Dad's going to be so happy to hear
this!
fields.JP: お父さん、喜んでくれるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad's going to be so happy to hear
this!

fields.EN:
(But he also doesn't mind their
lives being at stake, so long as
it brings "results.")
fields.JP:
（みんなの犠牲だって構わないと思ってる……
　そういう『成果』だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But he also doesn't mind their
lives being at stake, so long as
it brings "results.")

fields.EN:
(And that's why I need to be with
them... To prevent them from
sacrificing themselves...)
fields.JP:
（でも、そのために……みんなを犠牲にしないために、
　僕はどうにかこの中に加わったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And that's why I need to be with
them... To prevent them from
sacrificing themselves...)

fields.EN:
I'm glad everyone's safe... Really
glad...
fields.JP:
みんな、無事でよかった……
ほんとによかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad everyone's safe... Really
glad...

fields.JP: ジャック……あなた、顔色が……！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(Maybe... I used too much... of my
blood...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe... I used too much... of my
blood...)

fields.JP:
……ジャック……
気がついたのね……

fields.EN:
You lost consciousness after the
Nightmare battle. You must have
overexerted yourself.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアと戦った後、気を失ったの。
無理をし過ぎたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You lost consciousness after the
Nightmare battle. You must have
overexerted yourself.

fields.EN:
Miko-san said that it's just anemia
and not to worry. She also patched
you up a bit...
fields.JP:
視子さんは、『ただの貧血だから心配ない』と
言っていたわ……
応急処置もしてくれたみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko said that it's just anemia
and not to worry. She also patched
you up a bit...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Everyone brought you here. I'm
just happy you're awake now...
fields.JP:
……全員であなたをここまで連れてきたの。
無事に目も覚ましたことだし……
本当によかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone brought you here. I'm
just happy you're awake now...

fields.EN:
I didn't think I was pushing
myself, but... I guess I just
caused trouble for everyone.
fields.JP:
無理した気はなかったんだけど……
それじゃ結局、迷惑かけちゃったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't think I was pushing
myself, but... I guess I just
caused trouble for everyone.

fields.EN:
Everyone could fight because
you were there. No one had to
worry about Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
あなたがいたから、みんな戦えたわ。
ブラッドスケルター化に怯えずに済んだの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone could fight because
you were there. No one had to
worry about Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
Everyone appreciates what you did.
None of them thought you were
trouble...
fields.JP:
みんな……あなたに感謝しているわ。
迷惑だなんて、誰一人思っていない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone appreciates what you did.
None of them thought you were
trouble...

fields.EN:
Um, Alice...? Have you been
watching over me the whole time I
was brought here?
fields.JP:
アリス、その……
ひょっとして、ずっと看病しててくれたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Alice...? Have you been
watching over me the whole time I
was brought here?

fields.EN:
I only did what was expected.
We've survived all this time by
supporting each other like this.
fields.JP:
……当然のことをしただけだわ。
わたしたち、ずっと助け合って生きてきた
じゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only did what was expected.
We've survived all this time by
supporting each other like this.

fields.EN: So, are you feeling all right now?
fields.JP: それで、調子はどうなのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, are you feeling all right now?

fields.EN: ...Why did you pause between my name and '-san'?
fields.JP: ……何で名前と『さん』の間に間が空くのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you pause between my
name?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry... It's just that
I'm not used to saying your name
yet...
fields.JP: あ、ごめん。まだ呼びなれなくて、つい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry... It's just that
I'm not used to saying your name
yet...

fields.EN: Fine... You better get used to it.
fields.JP: ま、いいわ。早く慣れなさいよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Fine... You better get used to it.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. Jack just woke up,
so...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい。
ジャックはようやく目覚めたばかりで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. Jack just woke up,
so...

fields.EN:
You may have heard from Alice,
but I have a message from the
Professor.
fields.JP:
アリスも聞いてるかもしれないけど、
博士からの伝言を伝えに来たのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may have heard from Alice,
but I have a message from the
Professor.

fields.EN: The Dawn rates your accomplishments in this operation highly and wants to formally welcome you as an operation member from now on.
fields.JP:
黎明は今回のあんたの功績を高く評価し、
今後は正式に作戦メンバーとして迎えたい
……ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Dawn found your work
"commendable," and want you to
take part in our missions.

fields.EN:
So, they acknowledged what I did,
then... That's good to hear, and I
owe it all to Haru-san...
fields.JP:
よかった……認めてもらえたんだ……
ハルさんのおかげだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, they acknowledged what I did,
then... That's good to hear, and I
owe it all to Haru...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Yes... Now we can fight together
without worrying...
fields.JP:
ええ……
これからは、一緒に戦えるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Now we can fight together
without worrying...

fields.EN: Haru said he'd like you to come by when you have time. He wants to adjust the Mary Gun so you won't collapse so easily...
fields.JP:
ハルが、暇なときに顔出してほしいって
言ってたわ。メアリガンの調整をしたいそうよ。
そうそうぶっ倒れないようにしないと、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru said for you to come see him.
Something about a "Mary Gun."
Guess he figured you'd be up.

fields.JP: ありがとう、親指姫さん
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san (remove localized English title); B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: ...You don't need the '-san.' Anyway, I've delivered the message...!
fields.JP:
……『さん』は要らないわよ。
ともかく、確かに伝えたから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Drop the "Miss." Anyway, that's
about it from me.

fields.EN:
For being the youngest, you're
pretty mature.
fields.JP:
……親指姫は末っ子なのに、
何だかすごくしっかりしてるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
For being the youngest, you're
pretty mature.

fields.EN:
I'm the oldest! And don't you
forget that!
fields.JP:
わたしは長女よ！
勘違いしないでよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm the oldest! And don't you
forget that!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry! You were the shortest
of the three, so I thought...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
三人の中で一番小さいから、つい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry! You were the shortest
of the three, so I thought...

fields.EN:
Why, you...! The next time you
call me short is the day you're
gonna bite the dust!
fields.JP:
むっかーーーーー！！
その言葉、もう一度言ったら殺すわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, you...! The next time you
call me short is the day you're
gonna bite the dust!

fields.EN:
Wh-What I meant to say was that
you're really composed because
you're the oldest of the three!
fields.JP:
ぼ……僕が言いたかったのは、
君がしっかりしてるなあってだけで……！
それ……君が長女だったからなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What I meant to say was that
you're really composed because
you're the oldest of the three!

fields.JP: 助けてくれて……ありがとっ！

fields.EN:
Um... Does your cheek hurt? It's
all red.
fields.JP:
その……頬、痛くない？
赤くなってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Does your cheek hurt? It's
all red.

fields.EN:
I'm fine. It sounded worse than it
was. I hope she's not that mad...
fields.JP:
うん。音が大きかった割には痛くなかったし。
……怒らせちゃったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. It sounded worse than it
was. I hope she's not that mad...

fields.EN:
(But, she didn't seem like a bad
person at all.)
fields.JP: （でも、悪い子じゃなさそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, she didn't seem like a bad
person at all.)

fields.EN:
Heh... I think it's the first time
I've seen you smile like that since
we came here.
fields.JP:
……ふふ。
あなた、ここに来て初めてそんな顔で笑ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I think it's the first time
I've seen you smile like that since
we came here.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yup. Looks like we don't have much
time left! Let's hurry and break
the core!
fields.JP:
うん。ぐずぐずしてらんないね！
核をやっちゃおう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Looks like we don't have much
time left! Let's hurry and break
the core!

fields.EN: Wh-What do you mean by that?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Wh-What do you mean by that?!

fields.JP: ヒィァァァアアアアア！

fields.EN:
I'll explain later! Everyone, get
ready!
fields.JP:
話はあと！　みんな……構えて！
あいつが来るよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll explain later! Everyone, get
ready!

fields.EN:
Wait...! You can't be serious,
Aka-neesama!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...! You can't be serious,
dear sister!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: ジャック……気をつけてね！

fields.EN:
Huh?! Whaaaat?! Put down that
Nightmare?!
fields.JP:
え！？　えええっ！？
ナイトメアを……本気なの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Whaaaat?! Put down that
Nightmare?!

fields.EN:
That's exactly what I said! The
Nightmare can be defeated!
fields.JP:
当たり前！
あいつは……倒せるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's exactly what I said! The
Nightmare can be defeated!

fields.JP: 白雪たちも、がんばります……！

fields.EN:
The little birdies returned. Looks
like your precious little birdie
that was lost is back, too.
fields.JP:
小鳥たちが帰ってきたね。
君が心配してた、迷子の小鳥も無事だったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The little birdies returned. Looks
like your precious little birdie
that was lost is back, too.

fields.EN:
Yes. The three friendly little
birdies.
fields.JP: そう。仲のいい、三羽の小鳥たちだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The three friendly little
birdies.

fields.EN:
You know everything, don't you,
Blue Bird-san?
fields.JP: 青い鳥さん、何でも知ってるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know everything don't you,
blue bird?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Well, it is my duty to relay the
sun's message to you.
fields.JP: 君に太陽の言葉を届ける役目があるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is my duty to relay the
sun's message to you.

fields.EN:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.
fields.JP:
さあ。今日の食べ物を運んできたよ。
森の朝露に、生命の木の実
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.

fields.EN:
The forest's morning dew and a
fruit from the Tree of Life...
fields.JP: 森の朝露に、生命の木の実……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The forest's morning dew and a
fruit from the Tree of Life...

fields.EN:
They're gifts from the sun. Go
ahead. Eat and drink as you will.
fields.JP:
太陽からの贈り物だよ。
いつものように、飲んでお食べ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're gifts from the sun. Go
ahead. Eat and drink as you will.

fields.JP: ありがとう。青い鳥さん……
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.JP:
ああ……私だよ。
おはよう、ジャックくん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP:
博士。
あ……おはようございます！

fields.EN: Did you have a good night's rest?
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you have a good night's rest?

fields.EN:
That's good to hear. Now then,
could you come by my laboratory in
about 15 minutes?
fields.JP:
それは、よかった。
研究室まで、ご足労願いたいのだが、
そうだな……１５分後でどうかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear. Now then,
could you come by my laboratory in
about 15 minutes?

fields.EN: Very well. I'll see you then.
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well. I'll see you then.

fields.EN:
(I wonder what he wants. I know. I
should go there with Alice.)
fields.JP:
（今日の召集は、何なんだろう？
　そうだ……アリスと一緒に行こう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what he wants. I know. I
should go there with Alice.)

fields.EN:
(No one's answering... Maybe she
went ahead already.)
fields.JP:
（呼び出しても出ない……
　先に行っちゃったのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No one's answering... Maybe she
went ahead already.)

fields.EN:
Now that I'm ready, I should get
going. Hm...?
fields.JP:
支度も終わったことだし、
そろそろ出かけようかな……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I'm ready, I should get
going. Hm...?

fields.EN:
Shoot! Look at the time! I need to
hurry!
fields.JP:
うわ！　もう、こんな時間！？
急がなきゃ、遅刻しちゃうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! Look at the time! I need to
hurry!

fields.EN: Oh, honestly! What on earth is this?!
fields.JP:
……ああ、もうっ！
いったい全体、何なんですの！？

ご……ごめんなさい！
け、怪我はなかったですか！？
わたくしは、何ともありませんでしてよ

fields.EN:
There's nothing "good" about this!
Now all that cleaning I've done
was for nothing!
fields.JP:
これっぱかしも、良くありませんわ！
せっかく、わたくしがお掃除したところが、
台無しになってしまったじゃないですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing "good" about this!
Now all that cleaning I've done
was for nothing!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... Um, I'll help clean
the place later. I'm kind of in a
rush...
fields.JP:
そ……そっか。ごめんなさい……
あの、よかったら後で手伝います。
いまちょっと急いでて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... Um, I'll help clean
the place later. I'm kind of in a
rush...

fields.EN: My, how appalling... Are young gentlemen these days all planning to make their escape that way?!
fields.JP:
まあ、呆れましたわね……
昨今の若い殿方は、
そうやって逃げを打つつもりですのね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How sad it is to know that the
young ones nowadays all make
excuses for their actions.

fields.EN:
Um, no! I really, really need to
go! I'll help later!
fields.JP:
いや、ほ……本当ですってば！！
後で手伝いますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, no! I really, really need to
go! I'll help later!

fields.EN:
My, that was a joke. You don't
need to help me at all.
fields.JP:
冗談ですわよ。
お手伝いなんか必要ありませんもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, that was a joke. You don't
need to help me at all.

fields.EN:
I was still cleaning anyway. And
I doubt you have the proper skills
to clean the area to my standards.
fields.JP:
どうせ、後でやり直さなきゃなりませんもの。
貴方がわたくしと同じレベルのお掃除スキルを
持っていらっしゃるようには見えませんし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was still cleaning anyway. And
I doubt you have the proper skills
to clean the area to my standards.

fields.EN: Oh, um... Okay. If you say so...
fields.JP:
あ、ああ……うん。
そうかも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, um... Okay. If you say so...

fields.EN: How long do you intend to stand there dazed? Weren't you in a hurry?
fields.JP:
いつまで、ボーッと立ってらっしゃるつもり
でして？　急いでいるのではありませんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there anything else? I thought
you mentioned you were in a rush?

fields.EN:
Shoot! That's right! Thank you for
reminding me!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! That's right! Thank you for
reminding me!

fields.EN:
Um! My name is Jack! If you need
any help, please feel free to let
me know!
fields.JP:
あの……僕の名前はジャック！
手が足りない時には、声をかけてください！
お掃除、手伝いますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um! My name is Jack! If you need
any help, please feel free to let
me know!

fields.EN:
(I really need to run... Am I
going to make it there in time?!)
fields.JP:
（こりゃ、走ってかなきゃ……
　もう、間に合わないぞ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I really need to run... Am I
going to make it there in time?!)

fields.EN: My, my. Look at him go...
fields.JP: あらあら、お廊下で全力疾走……
fields.LOCALIZED: My, my. Look at him go...

fields.EN:
Hm... "Jack-san," was it? He doesn't 
look very reliable.
fields.JP:
……ジャックさん、ね。
あまり頼りになりそうにない方ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... "Jack," was it? He doesn't 
look very reliable.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Well... He seemed pleasant, at
least.
fields.JP:
まあでも……
感じのいい方でしたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... He seemed pleasant, at
least.

fields.JP:
……す、すみません！
お、遅れました！

fields.EN:
Well now, if it isn't the early
bird... Hey, everyone! Jack-sama is
finally here!
fields.JP:
あーら、これはまた……
お早いご登場で。
みんなー、ジャック様のご出勤よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, if it isn't the early
bird... Hey, everyone! Sir Jack is
finally here!
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ジャック様 => Jack-sama (remove localized English title)

fields.EN: Jack... I knocked several times, but you wouldn't wake up... I should have gone in to get you. I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
ジャックったら……
何度もノックしたのに起きなかったから……
迎えに行けばよかったわ……ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knocked on your door a few
times, but you didn't answer, so I
thought you went ahead. I'm sorry.

fields.EN:
Don't apologize. It's my fault for
not waking up earlier... Sorry to
worry you, Alice...
fields.JP:
ううん。僕がちゃんと起きてれば……
ごめん、アリス……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't apologize. It's my fault for
not waking up earlier... Sorry to
worry you, Alice...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki would have liked to
sleep a bit more, as well...
fields.JP: 白雪も、もうちょっと寝てたかったです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White would have liked to
sleep a bit more, as well...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Looks like you just
dropped a few points in popularity
here!
fields.JP:
あー……。ははは！
せっかく上がった株を下げちゃったねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Looks like you just
dropped a few points in popularity
here!

fields.EN:
He's still not adjusted to using
the Mary Gun. It's no surprise
that he's still tired.
fields.JP:
メアリガンにまだ体が慣れていないのよ。
疲れが残っていても無理はないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's still not adjusted to using
the Mary Gun. It's no surprise
that he's still tired.

fields.EN:
W-We know that! We're just teasing
him. That's all.
fields.JP:
そ、そのくらいわかってるわよ！
ちょっとからかっただけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We know that! We're just teasing
him. That's all.

fields.EN: Um... I... I'm sorry I'm late...
fields.JP:
う……あ、あの……会議に遅れてしまって……
すみません……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... I... I'm sorry I'm late...

fields.EN:
Hahaha... You slept well, Jack-kun? No, you're
not late. You're right on time. Jack-kun...
take a seat.
fields.JP:
ははは。よく眠れたようだね、ジャックくん？
いや、遅刻ではないよ。時間ちょうどだ。
ジャックくん……席につきたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha... At least you slept well,
Jack. We were just going to start,
so why don't you take a seat?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-kun on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN: Even if he recovers quickly, his body still can't keep up with the stamina drain from using the Mary Gun. We'll have to consider improvements, won't we, craftsman-san?
fields.JP:
回復が早いとはいえ、メアリガン使用での
体力消耗に、体がついていかないのよ。
改良の余地も考えなくてはね、製造士さん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if he can recuperate, his
body isn't able to keep up with
the Mary Gun yet. Any ideas?
Hm... I'll have to look into it.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's get the meeting
started. I doubt we have much time
to waste.
fields.JP:
……ということで、早く始めましょう。
時間の無駄だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's get the meeting
started. I doubt we have much time
to waste.

fields.EN:
Hm, looks like everyone's in
attendance now. Well, let's begin
then, shall we?
fields.JP:
さて、それでは全員が揃ったところで……
さっそく始めるとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, looks like everyone's in
attendance now. Well, let's begin
then, shall we?

fields.EN: Thanks to the efforts of you Blood Maidens, the Dawn has finally succeeded in destroying the second core.
fields.JP:
君たち血式少女の活躍によって、
私たち黎明はついに……
ふたつ目の核を破壊することに成功した
fields.LOCALIZED:
First off, we're happy to report
that the Blood Maidens were able
to destroy two cores so far.

fields.EN:
With the destruction of the cores,
the tower, or rather the "Jail
Tower," has grown.
fields.JP:
そして、私が予想していたとおり、
核の破壊は『監獄塔』を伸長させ……
いや、成長を促したと言うべきだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With the destruction of the cores,
the tower, or rather the "Jail
Tower," has grown.

fields.EN: At present, the Jail Tower has grown to nearly twice the height it was before the cores were destroyed... Our plan was correct.
fields.JP:
現在、『監獄塔』は核の破壊前と比較して、
二倍近くの高さにまで成長している……
我々の計画は正しかったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As expected, the Jail Tower has
doubled in height since the
destruction of the first core.

fields.EN: The plan we've worked toward for so long—our long-held dream of escaping this Jail—is suddenly becoming a reality.
fields.JP:
これまで長い時をかけ進めてきた悲願……
このジェイルからの脱出計画が、
一気に現実のものになろうとしているのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our plan has hinged upon this
theory, and now they are
accelerating toward fruition.

fields.EN:
Um... Why does the Tower grow when
the cores are destroyed?
fields.JP:
あ、あのう……
核を破壊すると、どうして塔が成長するん
ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Why does the Tower grow when
the cores are destroyed?

fields.EN: (Was that an out-of-place question? Still, the Jail seems to hate having its cores destroyed...)
fields.JP:
（場違いな質問だったかな……？
　でも、ジェイルは核を壊されるのを嫌がってる
　みたいだし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does everybody know already? I
mean, it seemed like the Jail
hated having them destroyed.)

fields.EN:
(I sure hope Oyayubihime doesn't
get angry with my question...)
fields.JP: （親指姫あたりに、また怒られそう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sure hope Thumbelina doesn't
get angry with my question...)

fields.EN:
That's something I want to know,
too. Good question, Jack.
fields.JP:
確かにそうよね……わたしもそれ、気になるわ！
ジャック、冴えてるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's something I want to know,
too. Good question, Jack.

fields.EN:
Yes... Shirayuki wishes to know,
as well.
fields.JP: ……そうですね。白雪も気になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Snow White wishes to know,
as well.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... The others are
curious about it, too.)
fields.JP: （……よかった。みんなも気になってたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... The others are
curious about it, too.)

fields.EN:
C'mon, everyone. Don't interrupt
Dad. I'm sure he was just about to
touch on it.
fields.JP:
みんなそうやって、お父さんの話を邪魔して……
ちゃんと話してくれるってば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, everyone. Don't interrupt
Dad. I'm sure he was just about to
touch on it.

fields.EN:
Now, now. I think I got so carried
away delivering the good news,
that I got ahead of myself.
fields.JP:
ははは。構わんよ。
私としたことが、順調な結果に興奮しすぎて
話を急いでしまったようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now. I think I got so carried
away delivering the good news,
that I got ahead of myself.

fields.JP: それじゃ……お父さん、どうしてなの？

fields.EN: This is increasingly supporting my hypothesis: each cell area appears to grow around its own unique core.
fields.JP:
私の仮説が裏付けられつつあるといえるのだが、
各独房エリアは、それぞれ固有の核を基軸に
成長を遂げていると考えられるのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each of the areas are growing
based on these cores. Or at least,
that's my theory.

fields.EN:
In other words, the areas are
expanding. If left alone, these
areas could expand even further.
fields.JP:
つまり……横への成長だね。
このまま放置すれば、あるいはだが……
独房エリアはより広がっていくとも考えられる
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, the areas are
expanding. If left alone, these
areas could expand even further.

fields.EN: Exactly. This also affects our plan. I believe each core controls the supply of nutrients that makes the Jail grow, but...
fields.JP:
ああ。我々の計画にもね。
何故なら、それぞれの核がジェイルを成長させる
養分の管理を司っていると考えられるのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The cores also hinder our plans.
I believe it's because these cores
control the growth of the Jail.

fields.EN: At this rate, the efficiency of supplying nutrients to the Tower is extremely poor.
fields.JP:
このままでは、塔への養分の供給の効率が
非常に悪いのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Left alone, the Jail's growth is
balanced across all areas, making
the Tower's growth more subtle.

fields.EN:
So if we destroy the cores, the
Jail's energy can concentrate
more on the Jail Tower?
fields.JP:
つまり……核を破壊すれば、ジェイルの養分が
塔の成長に回されるということかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if we destroy the cores, the
Jail's energy can concentrate
more on the Jail Tower?

fields.EN:
Precisely. The destruction of the
cores immediately grew the tower,
proving my theory.
fields.JP:
その通りだよ。核の破壊による塔の成長が、
その仮説を裏付けてくれたというわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Precisely. The destruction of the
cores immediately grew the tower,
proving my theory.

fields.EN:
I suppose it's no different from
trimming plants to help them grow.
fields.JP: ま、植物の剪定と同じ原理ってわけだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it's no different from
trimming plants to help them grow.

fields.EN:
Plants...? The Jail is like a
plant?
fields.JP: 植物って……そういうものなんですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plants...? The Jail is like a
plant?

fields.EN: As you know, the Jail is a living organism. When part of the human body is impaired, other functions compensate for it... It's the same principle.
fields.JP:
知っての通り、ジェイルは生命体だからね。
人間もどこか疾患を得ると、他の機能がそれを
補強するシステムがある……それと同じだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail is a living organism, so
to speak. I see it working no
differently than the human body.

fields.EN:
I also believe our Blood Team here
works similarly as well.
fields.JP:
私は、君たち血式部隊もそうした存在だと
考えているのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also believe our Blood Team here
works similarly as well.

fields.EN: They are a new evolutionary form produced by humanity to oppose this Jail. I tell Akazukin that often.
fields.JP:
このジェイルに対抗するために、人類が生んだ
新たなる進化形態だ。
赤ずきんにはよく話しているね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were born with powers to
face the Jail. I say this all the
time to Red Riding Hood, yes?
fields.notes: B12 source-form character identity restoration; B46 systematic full-fidelity coverage review

fields.EN:
Yup! In other words, we're the key
to our own escape!
fields.JP: うん。つまり、あたしたちが突破口なんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! In other words, we're the key
to our own escape!

fields.EN: We were born to face the Jail...
fields.JP:
わたしたちが……ジェイルに対抗するために
進化した存在……
fields.LOCALIZED: We were born to face the Jail...

fields.EN:
Of course, whether that's good or
bad to each of you is another
story.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, whether that's good or
bad to each of you is another
story.

fields.EN:
If Shirayuki can help us escape,
that's great!
fields.JP:
白雪たちが突破口になれるのなら、とても
嬉しいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Snow White can help us escape,
that's great!

fields.EN:
Don't burden yourselves. It's not
like you're the only ones who need
to fight.
fields.JP:
ま、気楽に考えとけ。
戦ってるのはお前らだけじゃないんだからな。
全て背負う必要はねえぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't burden yourselves. It's not
like you're the only ones who need
to fight.

fields.EN:
Ahaha! Haru-san, you may not look it, but
you're surprisingly considerate!
fields.JP:
あはは！　ハルさんってそう見えて、
意外と気を遣ってくれるんだよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha! I knew you'd say something
like that! It's so the opposite of what
you look like you'd say!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
And how exactly do I "look" to
you...
fields.JP: 『そう見えて』って、どう見えてんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And how exactly do I "look" to
you...

fields.EN:
Don't worry! We just want to do
what we can!
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。あたしたちは、あたしたちに
できることをしたいだけなんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry! We just want to do
what we can!

fields.EN:
So, Dad? What'd you want to say
again?
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Dad? What'd you want to say
again?

fields.EN: Yes. I think we should seize this opportunity and push the plan forward all at once... before anything unexpected happens.
fields.JP:
ああ。私はここで……この機を逃さずに、
一気に計画を推し進めるべきだと考えるのだよ。
……なにか予想外のことが起こる前にだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yes. I'm thinking of using
this opportunity to gain footing
before anything unexpected occurs.

fields.JP: たとえば……スナークの妨害だよ

fields.EN: (Snark... The terrifying being that massacred Dawn's survey team fifteen years ago...)
fields.JP:
（『スナーク』……
　十五年前、黎明の調査隊を皆殺しにした
　恐ろしい存在……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snark... The thing that wiped out
most of the Dawn 15 years ago...)

fields.EN:
(But if we don't know who or what
it is, how are we going to face
it if we encounter it?)
fields.JP:
（正体もわからないのに、どうやって対抗すれば
　いいんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if we don't know who or what
it is, how are we going to face
it if we encounter it?)

fields.EN: There is also the risk of an unexpected over-adaptation by the Jail in response to destroying the cores—in other words, the ecology we've learned may change.
fields.JP:
他にも、核の破壊によるジェイルの予想外の
過剰適応……つまり、私たちが掴んだジェイルの
生態が変化してしまう恐れもある
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's also possible that, if we
take our time, the Jail may adapt
to the destruction of the cores.

fields.JP: ジェイルの過剰適応、ねえ……

fields.EN: Destroying a core is the first result of its kind we've achieved. Honestly, nothing that happens now would surprise me.
fields.JP:
核の破壊なんて、初めて出せた結果だもの。
確かに、何が起きても驚かないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The destruction of the cores is
fairly new to us. It may yield
different results down the line.

fields.EN:
Indeed. Which is why I'd like to
expedite the destruction of cores
in each of the areas.
fields.JP:
そういうことだ。
一刻も早く、各独房エリアの核破壊を目指したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. Which is why I'd like to
expedite the destruction of cores
in each of the areas.

fields.EN: So I apologize, but this may force you into harsher consecutive battles than ever before... Please forgive me.
fields.JP:
そこで、君たちには申し訳ないのだが……
これまでにない苛酷な連戦を強いることにも
なるだろう……許して欲しい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's where you all come in. I'm
sorry, but I'm going to have to
ask you to fight again...

fields.EN: However, Jack-kun joining the fighting has reduced the danger of going berserk almost completely and allowed us to break out of the dead end we were in...
fields.JP:
ただ、これはジャックくんの参戦により、
暴走の怖れが限りなく減少し、これまでの
袋小路から脱することができた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, Jack's presence
in battle has minimized the risks
associated with Blood Skelter.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun; B46 systematic full-fidelity coverage review

fields.EN:
In that sense, we could say that
now is the best time to act.
fields.JP: あらゆる意味で、今がチャンスなのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that sense, we could say that
now is the best time to act.

fields.EN:
There's no need to apologize.
All of us are in this together!
We'll do anything for you, Dad!
fields.JP:
そんなの……謝る必要なんてない！
全部、皆のためを思ってのことだもん！
お父さん……あたし達、何だってするよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no need to apologize.
All of us are in this together!
We'll do anything for you, Dad!

fields.EN:
That's right! I'm happy to
actually be helping everyone in
some way!
fields.JP:
うん……！
僕にできることがあって、むしろ嬉しいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! I'm happy to
actually be helping everyone in
some way!

fields.EN:
Sure, let's do this! Fighting's a
cinch to us, right?!
fields.JP:
そうね！　やってやろうじゃない？
連戦なんて、お茶の子さいさいよ！
……ねえ、みんな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, let's do this! Fighting's a
cinch to us, right?!

fields.EN:
Yes! Shirayuki is ready and
willing! I'm with everyone!
fields.JP:
はい！　白雪は大丈夫です！
みなさんと一緒ですから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! Snow White is ready and
willing! I'm with everyone!

fields.EN: I suppose this all makes sense...
fields.JP: ……そうね。理にかなっているもの
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose this all makes sense...

fields.EN:
Um... I think Nemu-chan feels the
same way!
fields.JP: あ！　ネムちゃんも同じ気持ちだと思います！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I think Sleepy feels the
same way!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! It's because Nemu can
sleep anywhere that she feels
safe!
fields.JP: あはは。ネムは安心すると寝ちゃうからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! It's because Sleepy can
sleep anywhere that she feels
safe!

fields.EN:
Now, onto the real subject...
There are two areas into which
we've explored rather deeply.
fields.JP:
……そこで本題だ。
黎明のこれまでの探索が比較的進んでいる
エリアが二箇所あるのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, onto the real subject...
There are two areas into which
we've explored rather deeply.

fields.EN:
One is the Temple area, having
once housed a shrine, and which is
located past the City Streets.
fields.JP:
ひとつは『旧寺院エリア』と呼んでいてね。
『元街道沿いエリア』の奥に位置しており、
元々は神社であった場所だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One is the Temple area, having
once housed a shrine, and which is
located past the City Streets.

fields.EN:
The other is Downtown, the former
entertainment district, which is
located past the Graveyard area.
fields.JP:
もうひとつが、『元繁華街エリア』だ。
『元墓所エリア』から奥に入った位置にあり、
かつてはこの街の歓楽街だった地域だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other is Downtown, the former
entertainment district, which is
located past the Graveyard area.

fields.EN:
Both are strategically important.
At least from my point of view.
fields.JP:
双方とも戦略的重要性において差はない。
私は、そう考えているのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both are strategically important.
At least from my point of view.

fields.EN:
That said, I'd like to ask all of
you your opinions on which area to
clear first.
fields.JP:
どちらを先に攻略すべきか、
君たちの意見を聞かせてもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I'd like to ask all of
you your opinions on which area to
clear first.

fields.EN: You mean you want us to decide?
fields.JP: あたしたちが、順番を決めるってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean you want us to decide?

fields.EN: Yes. You're the ones going into the field and risking your lives. I want your opinions to determine our next objective.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。
現場に赴き、命懸けで戦うのは君たち自身だ。
君たちの意見で、攻略目標を決定したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. You're the ones who are out
there fighting. I want to be able
to respect your opinions.

fields.EN:
The only difference is the order
you're gonna tackle them, but
choose wisely.
fields.JP:
まあ、結局順番が前後するだけなんだが、
慎重に決めるんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only difference is the order
you're gonna tackle them, but
choose wisely.

fields.EN:
(Which would help make things
easier for us later on? Hm...)
fields.JP:
（……どっちを先に攻略すると、
　僕たちにとって有利なんだろう？
　うーん……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which would help make things
easier for us later on? Hm...)

fields.EN:
Dad, the only difference is which
is done first, right? If that's
the case, I'm fine with either.
fields.JP:
お父さん、早いか遅いかの違いだけだよね？
どうせ、両方ともぶっ潰すんだし……
あたしは、どっちでもかまわないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad, the only difference is which
is done first, right? If that's
the case, I'm fine with either.

fields.EN:
Same here. I don't see much of a
difference between them.
fields.JP:
右に同じね。
どっちもどっちって感じだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. I don't see much of a
difference between them.

fields.EN:
Well... Shirayuki feels the same
way, too.
fields.JP:
そうですねー……
白雪もどっちでもいいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... Snow White feels the same
way, too.

fields.EN:
Old man... Maybe it's faster if
you decide.
fields.JP:
……オッさん。あんたが決めた方が
早いんじゃねえか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Old man... Maybe it's faster if
you decide.

fields.EN: Alice-kun? Jack-kun? What about you two?
fields.JP:
アリスくん、ジャックくん。
君たちは、どう思うかね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice? Jack? What about you two?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun; ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I'm not very familiar with the
Jail, so I'm not too sure which to
do first...
fields.JP:
まだジェイルの地理に明るくないので、
どちらがいいとまでは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not very familiar with the
Jail, so I'm not too sure which to
do first...

fields.EN:
Same here... I feel either one
wouldn't make much of a
difference.
fields.JP:
僕も……同じです。
どちらが先でもいいんじゃないかと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here... I feel either one
wouldn't make much of a
difference.

fields.EN:
Why don't you decide, Jack? Not
that it matters much.
fields.JP:
ジャックが決めちゃっていいよ。
どっちが先でも後でも、そう変わらないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you decide, Jack? Not
that it matters much.

fields.EN:
Huh?! Me?! Would it really be
okay for me to decide this?!
fields.JP:
え！？　……僕が！？
そんな適当に決めちゃっていいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Me?! Would it really be
okay for me to decide this?!

fields.EN:
Why, yes. Shirayuki thinks it
would be fine if you made the
decision, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
ええ。白雪はジャックさんの判断なら
間違いないと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. Snow White thinks it
would be fine if you made the
decision, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I suppose that's fine. Your choice
won't make a huge impact. So hurry
it up, will you?
fields.JP:
そうね。さして重要な問題でもなし……
あんた、決めちゃいなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that's fine. Your choice
won't make a huge impact. So hurry
it up, will you?

fields.EN:
Jack, which one do you want us to
clear first?
fields.JP: ……ジャック、どっちを先にする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, which one do you want us to
clear first?

fields.JP:
それじゃ……
『旧寺院エリア』にしませんか？

fields.EN:
If it's located past where we were
captured, we may know a bit more
about its surroundings.
fields.JP:
僕やアリスが捕われてたエリアの奥なら、
少しは土地勘が働くかもしれないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's located past where we were
captured, we may know a bit more
about its surroundings.

fields.EN:
Well, I'm not so sure about that,
but if you say so...
fields.JP:
それはどうかわからないけれど……
でも、ジャックがそう言うなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm not so sure about that,
but if you say so...

fields.EN:
Sure, why not? I'm used to heading
in that direction!
fields.JP:
うん！　まあいいんじゃない？
確かにそっち方面なら、道中行き慣れてるしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, why not? I'm used to heading
in that direction!

fields.EN: Very well. Head to the Temple area. Your objective is to find and destroy the core. Don't forget that.
fields.JP:
よろしい。それでは諸君……
『旧寺院エリア』へ向かってもらいたい
……目的は核の発見と破壊だ。忘れないように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. Head to the Temple
area. Your objective is to destroy
the core. Understood?

fields.EN:
Ah! How forgetful of me. I forgot
to relay to you the most important
news...
fields.JP:
おお、いかんいかん。
大事なことを伝え忘れていたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! How forgetful of me. I forgot
to relay to you the most important
news...

fields.EN:
The cores' destruction has made
it possible to enter the Tower,
though I wouldn't recommend it.
fields.JP:
核を破壊したことによって、
『塔』内部への侵入も可能になったようだよ。
ただ、不用意に近づかない方がいいかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The cores' destruction has made
it possible to enter the Tower,
though I wouldn't recommend it.

fields.EN:
After all, there's no telling what
danger awaits.
fields.JP: どんな危険が待ち受けているか、わからないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, there's no telling what
danger awaits.

fields.JP:
それじゃ……
『元繁華街エリア』にしませんか？

fields.EN:
It's in the direction where we
saved Oyayubihime, so it could be
a lucky direction for us.
fields.JP:
……この間、親指姫を助けに行った方向だし、
何だかツイてそうな気がするかな、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's in the direction where we
saved Thumbelina, so it could be
a lucky direction for us.

fields.EN: You care quite a lot about luck, don't you...?
fields.JP: あんたって結構、ツキとか気にするのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's pretty sentimental
reasoning, wouldn't you say?

fields.EN:
Well, you did say that you didn't
see much of a difference between
the two areas...
fields.JP:
親指姫だって、どっちでもいいって言ったじゃ
ないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you did say that you didn't
see much of a difference between
the two areas...

fields.EN: Hmm. I guess that's fine. That kind of thing might actually be real, too.
fields.JP:
うーん。まあいいんじゃない？
そういうのも実際、あるかもしれないしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess that's okay.
Sometimes you just need to go with
your gut.

fields.EN: Very well. Head to the Downtown area. Your objective is to find and destroy the core. Don't forget that.
fields.JP:
よろしい。それでは諸君……
『元繁華街エリア』へ向かってもらいたい
……目的は核の発見と破壊だ。忘れないように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. Head to the Downtown
area. Your objective is to destroy
the core. Understood?

fields.EN:
Ah! How forgetful of me. I forgot
to relay to you the most important
news...
fields.JP:
おお、いかんいかん。
大事なことを伝え忘れていたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! How forgetful of me. I forgot
to relay to you the most important
news...

fields.EN:
The cores' destruction has made
it possible to enter the tower,
though I wouldn't recommend it.
fields.JP:
核を破壊したことによって、
『塔』内部への侵入も可能になったようだよ。
ただ、不用意に近づかない方がいいかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The cores' destruction has made
it possible to enter the tower,
though I wouldn't recommend it.

fields.EN:
After all, there's no telling what
danger awaits.
fields.JP: どんな危険が待ち受けているか、わからないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, there's no telling what
danger awaits.

fields.EN: Look at the time! I'm late again!
fields.JP:
もう、こんな時間！？
……また、遅刻だ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Look at the time! I'm late again!

fields.JP: お……おはようございます

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack-kun. Good morning. Sorry to
bother you, but would you mind
heading over to my laboratory?
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックくん。おはよう。
目を覚ましたところで、
研究室まで来てもらえるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack. Good morning. Sorry to
bother you, but would you mind
heading over to my laboratory?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry, Professor! I'll be
right there!
fields.JP:
す、すみません……博士！
今すぐ行きます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry, Professor! I'll be
right there!

fields.EN:
The meeting is about to start, so
I'll be waiting.
fields.JP:
もうすぐ会議の始まる時間だ。
待っているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The meeting is about to start, so
I'll be waiting.

fields.EN:
(Everyone's probably mad at me for
being late...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone's probably mad at me for
being late...)

fields.EN:
(No... I can still make it before
the meeting starts!)
fields.JP: （いや、今ならまだ間に合うはずだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... I can still make it before
the meeting starts!)

fields.EN: All right! Time to get a move on!
fields.JP: よーし、研究室まで猛ダッシュだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Time to get a move on!

fields.JP: 申し訳ありません……遅れました……

fields.EN:
*sigh* I'm starting to see a
pattern...
fields.JP:
はは……
こりゃあ、恒例になりつつあるねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I'm starting to see a
pattern...

fields.EN:
Wow, for having such an innocent-
looking face, you're pretty brazen.
fields.JP:
あんたって人畜無害な顔して、
案外、図太いのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow, for having such an innocent-
looking face, you're pretty brazen.

fields.EN:
Oh, come now. He did barely make
it in time.
fields.JP:
まあ、いいじゃないですか。
ギリギリ時間には間に合ってるんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come now. He did barely make
it in time.

fields.EN:
And why do you look so bitter,
Nemu?
fields.JP: ネムが悔しがってどうすんのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And why do you look so bitter,
Sleepy?

fields.EN:
I must admit, it was bold of you
to be here later than me. I won't
lose to you next time.
fields.JP:
わらわより遅いなんて、
なかなか太い根性ですね～
次は負けませんから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must admit, it was bold of you
to be here later than me. I won't
lose to you next time.

fields.EN:
Please don't make this into a
competition, Princess Lazy.
fields.JP: グータラ姫まで寝坊を競わないでよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't make this into a
competition, Princess Lazy.

fields.EN:
(I feel like I just set off some
kind of challenge ...)
fields.JP:
（な……なんか僕のせいで、変な勝負が
　始まってる気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like I just set off some
kind of challenge ...)

fields.EN:
(Well, at least Kaguyahime looks a lot
better now...)
fields.JP:
（でも……かぐや姫、元気になったみたいで
　よかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, at least Kaguya looks a lot
better now...)

fields.EN:
Jack-san is quite literally spilling
his blood in battle. I am not
surprised that he is tired.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは文字どおり血を流しながら
戦っていらっしゃるんですのよ？
ひどくお疲れになって当然ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is quite literally spilling
his blood in battle. I am not
surprised that he is tired.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(Cinderella and Shirayukihime are so
kind... I really should try to
wake up earlier...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラと白雪姫は優しいな……
　でも、好意に甘えないで、寝坊しないように
　しないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella and Snow White are so
kind... I really should try to
wake up earlier...)

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right. Let me
think of a nutritional meal for
Jack.
fields.JP:
確かにそうかもしれんね。
栄養価の高い食事でも考えておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right. Let me
think of a nutritional meal for
Jack.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's begin. Jack-kun,
please take a seat.
fields.JP:
まあ、そろそろ始めようか。
ジャックくん、席につきたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's begin. Jack,
please take a seat.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Jack... I woke up late
too, so I didn't have the time to
check on you...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、ジャック……
わたしも寝坊して、時間ギリギリだったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Jack... I woke up late
too, so I didn't have the time to
check on you...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. It's my fault,
anyway...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. It's my fault,
anyway...

fields.EN:
While I'm glad we're all meeting
today, there isn't anything in
particular to discuss.
fields.JP:
……と言ったところで、
今日は特に話し合うこともないのだがね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
While I'm glad we're all meeting
today, there isn't anything in
particular to discuss.

fields.EN:
So, are we just here to keep you
company?
fields.JP: じゃあオッさん、もったいぶるなよな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, are we just here to keep you
company?

fields.EN:
C'mon, cut the Professor some
slack. It's important to see
everyone all together, too.
fields.JP:
いーじゃん、そのくらい。
やっぱ、全体の取りまとめって大事なんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, cut the Professor some
slack. It's important to see
everyone all together, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah, yeah... Well, go on. What
is it?
fields.JP:
へいへい。
……それで今日は何だって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, yeah... Well, go on. What
is it?

fields.EN:
Firstly... Thank you, everyone.
I wanted to express my gratitude
as a representative of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
……ああ。まずは君たち、よくやってくれた。
黎明を代表し、感謝の言葉を述べる。
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Firstly... Thank you, everyone.
I wanted to express my gratitude
as a representative of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
Things have been moving well, and
I believe our escape from the Jail
will come sooner than later.
fields.JP:
これまで、非常に順調に進んでいるからね。
我々がジェイルを脱出する日も……
そう先のことではないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things have been moving well, and
I believe our escape from the Jail
will come sooner than later.

fields.EN:
So I will be needing your help in
destroying the other cores. What
else is there... Any questions?
fields.JP:
もうひとつの核の破壊についても、
総力を挙げ挑んでもらいたい。
それでは他に何かあるかね？　なければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I will be needing your help in
destroying the other cores. What
else is there... Any questions?

fields.EN:
(I wonder if Clara told the
Professor about how the Nightmare
spoke...)
fields.JP:
（……そうだ。ナイトメアが喋った件、
　くららから伝わってるかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Clara told the
Professor about how the Nightmare
spoke...)

fields.JP:
……ん？
なんだね、ジャックくん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP:
あの、この間…ナイトメアが、
喋ったことについてなんですが……

fields.EN:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.
fields.JP:
ああ……その件なのだがね……
それは驚いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.

fields.EN:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.
fields.JP:
よかった……
ちゃんとくららが伝えてくれたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.

fields.EN:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?
fields.JP:
何だ、くららがどうかしたのか？
……視子、知ってるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?

fields.EN:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Akazukin-san
told them...)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　くららじゃなかったのか。
　じゃあ、赤ずきんさんあたりかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Red Riding Hood
told them...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: あれは、ほんとびっくりしたよね！

fields.EN: Yes... Until now, we'd been told that Nightmares don't speak...
fields.JP:
そうですよね……
今まで、ナイトメアは喋らないものだって
聞いていましたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'd been hearing all this
time that Nightmares aren't able
to communicate.

fields.EN:
Do Nightmares possess any form of
intelligence?
fields.JP: ナイトメアは……知能を持っているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do Nightmares possess any form of
intelligence?

fields.EN:
Hm... This report was beyond
anything I had hypothesized in the
past.
fields.JP:
あ……ああ。
実は、私にも予想外の話でね。
報告を受けて驚いていたのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... This report was beyond
anything I had hypothesized in the
past.

fields.EN:
Let me see... I'll need to... Put
my thoughts together first. Allow
me to get back to everyone later.
fields.JP:
そうだな……もう少し……
もう少し、考えをまとめてからに……
させてもらえないだろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see... I'll need to... Put
my thoughts together first. Allow
me to get back to everyone later.

fields.EN:
(Something doesn't feel right with
those three...)
fields.JP: （……なんだろう、この三人の空気……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Something doesn't feel right with
those three...)

fields.EN:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Downtown area!
fields.JP:
それでは諸君……
『元繁華街エリア』へ向かってくれたまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Downtown area!

fields.EN:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Temple area!
fields.JP:
それでは諸君……
『旧寺院エリア』へ向かってくれたまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Temple area!

fields.EN:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Downtown area!
fields.JP:
それでは諸君……
『元繁華街エリア』へ向かってくれたまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Downtown area!

fields.EN:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Temple area!
fields.JP:
それでは諸君……
『旧寺院エリア』へ向かってくれたまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well... Your next target is
in the Temple area!

fields.EN:
All right, let's head on over to
the Temple!
fields.JP:
……それじゃ、早速
『旧寺院エリア』に向かおっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's head on over to
the Temple!

fields.EN: You should stop! You absolutely should not go there!
fields.JP:
それは、やめたほうがいいです！
絶対、やめるべきです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might I suggest you not?! In fact,
none of us should go there, ever!

fields.EN:
Kaguya?! It's surprising to see
you out of your room.
fields.JP:
かぐや！？
部屋から出てくるなんて、珍しいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya?! It's surprising to see
you out of your room.

fields.EN:
(She doesn't feel like the same
person we met before...)
fields.JP: （何だかこの前会った時と様子が違うな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't feel like the same
person we met before...)

fields.JP: どうしたのかね、かぐや？

fields.EN:
Oh, I know... You've finally
motivated yourself to work,
haven't you?
fields.JP:
ははーん。
さてはようやく働く気になったのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I know... You've finally
motivated yourself to work,
haven't you?

fields.EN:
That would be a great help,
Kaguya!
fields.JP: かぐやさん、大助かりです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would be a great help,
Kaguya!

fields.EN:
That's not it, and I don't want to
work! Just listen to me. Don't go
there!
fields.JP:
そうじゃないです！
働きたくないです！
とにかく駄目なんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it, and I don't want to
work! Just listen to me. Don't go
there!

fields.EN:
Kaguya, what's with that
attitude?! This isn't the time or
the place for your selfishness!
fields.JP:
かぐや、何その態度！
ワガママもいい加減にしなって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, what's with that
attitude?! This isn't the time or
the place for your selfishness!

fields.EN:
Well then, let me ask... Why are
you so adamant about us not going
there?
fields.JP:
じゃあさ、聞くけど。
何でそんなに駄目だって言うわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, let me ask... Why are
you so adamant about us not going
there?

fields.EN:
Professor... Is the area we're
heading to extremely dangerous?
fields.JP:
博士……
もしかして、とても危険なエリアなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Is the area we're
heading to extremely dangerous?

fields.EN:
No. Our reports have determined
that it isn't much different from
previous areas we've been through.
fields.JP:
……いいや。
調査の限りでは、これまでのエリアと
大差無かった筈だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Our reports have determined
that it isn't much different from
previous areas we've been through.

fields.EN:
Huh. Then would she have her own
weird reasoning for it?
fields.JP:
まあ……またしょうもない理由でも
あったんじゃねえか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh. Then would she have her own
weird reasoning for it?

fields.EN:
I wouldn't be surprised, since it
came from Princess Lazy.
fields.JP: ま、グータラ姫ならありえるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't be surprised, since it
came from Princess Lazy.

fields.EN:
Mmm... So, can I assume we
shouldn't worry, and head on out?
fields.JP:
んー。ってことは、
ごちゃごちゃ考えてたってしょーがないって
ことかな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... So, can I assume we
shouldn't worry, and head on out?

fields.EN:
Exactly. We'll head in, hit them quick,
and come right back!
fields.JP:
そうそう。
ここはサクッと行ってサクッと攻めて
さっさと戻って来ればいいんだって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good. Let's just hurry, get the
job done, and come back, pronto!
fields.notes: B14 remove localization-only pronto verbal tic

fields.EN: All right! Let's get this going!
fields.JP:
よーし！
じゃあみんな、張り切って行ってこよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Let's get this going!

fields.JP: だが、くれぐれも用心はすることだよ

fields.EN:
(Who or what is this "Snark" that
the Professor seems to be so
worried about?)
fields.JP:
（博士がここまで警戒しているスナークって、
　一体どんな存在なんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Who or what is this "Snark" that
the Professor seems to be so
worried about?)

fields.EN:
A wall of fire! We can't get past
it!
fields.JP:
……炎の壁！
これでは……先へ進めないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A wall of fire! We can't get past
it!

fields.EN:
This is too much! To think we've
come this far just to be thwarted
by that!
fields.JP:
……もう！
せっかく、こんなところまで来ましたのに……
何てことですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is too much! To think we've
come this far just to be thwarted
by that!

fields.EN:
Hah! That's nothing! I'm sure it's
not impossible to get past.
fields.JP:
……ハン！
こんなの、大したことないじゃない！
突破不可能ってわけじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hah! That's nothing! I'm sure it's
not impossible to get past.

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose, but I'm pretty
sure it would incinerate us before
we made it through...
fields.JP:
確かに、その通りではあるんですけど……
それで力尽きてしまうかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose, but I'm pretty
sure it would incinerate us before
we made it through...

fields.EN:
Hmm... This isn't good at all...
Shoot.
fields.JP: んー。確かにちょっと困ったね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... This isn't good at all...
Shoot.

fields.EN:
Speaking of shoot, maybe I should
use the Mary Gun... No, that
wouldn't work, would it? Heh...
fields.JP:
……ぼ……僕のメアリガンじゃ……
さすがに駄目だよね……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of shoot, maybe I should
use the Mary Gun... No, that
wouldn't work, would it? Heh...

fields.JP:
あんた……
無理に和ませようとしなくてもいいわよ

fields.LOCALIZED: What should we do, Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: Uh... How about we head back?
fields.JP:
あー…………
こりゃ、引き揚げかなー
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh... How about we head back?

fields.JP:
……あ、赤姉！？
本気で言ってんの？
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Do you mean we should leave
first and prepare ourselves
against it?
fields.JP: 断念して出直す……ってことかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mean we should leave
first and prepare ourselves
against it?

fields.EN:
W-Well, if that's the case, I
guess that's fine...
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if that's the case, I
guess that's fine...

fields.EN:
We're going to get through this,
one way or the other. That is for
certain.
fields.JP:
……んなわけないじゃん。
もちろん、ここの攻略はするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to get through this,
one way or the other. That is for
certain.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
It's just that I thought of a
better way of getting through it
than roasting ourselves.
fields.JP:
ここでさ、皆で仲良く火傷するよか、
もっと、全然いい方法があると思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I thought of a
better way of getting through it
than roasting ourselves.

fields.EN:
You mean there is a way to get
through?
fields.JP: そんな方法が……あるというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean there is a way to get
through?

fields.EN:
Yup. We're going to drag Kaguya
over here!
fields.JP: うん。かぐやを引っ張ってくるのさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. We're going to drag Kaguya
over here!

fields.EN:
Huh? Kaguya?! What are you
planning on doing with Princess
Lazy?
fields.JP:
……え？　かぐや！？
あのグータラ姫を連れてきて、
どうしようってのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Kaguya?! What are you
planning on doing with Princess
Lazy?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I think you're
forgetting that Kaguya's ability
would allow us to get through.
fields.JP:
ふふ。忘れてました。
かぐやさんの能力を使えば、
こんな炎の壁なんて全然大丈夫ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I think you're
forgetting that Kaguya's ability
would allow us to get through.

fields.EN:
You got that right! I know it's a
pain to head all the way back,
but let's go.
fields.JP:
そーゆーこと。
面倒だけど、いったん引き揚げよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got that right! I know it's a
pain to head all the way back,
but let's go.

fields.EN:
Um... Akazukin-san? Are you
sure that'll work?
fields.JP:
あの……赤ずきんさん。
でもそれ……大丈夫かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Red Riding Hood? Are you
sure that'll work?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I see what you mean. She isn't
very cooperative.
fields.JP: そうね……協力的とは言い難いものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see what you mean. She isn't
very cooperative.

fields.EN:
Well, yeah... And she won't give
in to force, either. We're gonna
have to praise her to high heaven.
fields.JP:
うん、まあねー……
力尽くでどうにかできる子じゃないから……
皆で、かぐやのご機嫌をとるしかないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yeah... And she won't give
in to force, either. We're gonna
have to praise her to high heaven.

fields.EN:
Sorry, but I'm definitely not doing
that!
fields.JP: わたしはそんなの、御免ね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, but I'm definitely not doing
that!

fields.EN:
No problem. We have the perfect
candidate to do it for us!
fields.JP:
まあ、かぐやのご機嫌とりについては、
適任者がいるじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem. We have the perfect
candidate to do it for us!

fields.JP: ジャック。期待してるからね？

fields.EN:
Ahaha! Okay guys, time to retreat!
Let's head on back to the Dawn!
fields.JP:
あはは！
……ってことで、戦略的撤退！
みんなー、黎明本部に帰るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha! Okay guys, time to retreat!
Let's head on back to the Dawn!

fields.JP:
（そんな……
　じょ……冗談だよね……？）

fields.EN:
...And so, I was hoping you would
help us.
fields.JP:
……というわけで、ぜひ君の力を貸して
ほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...And so, I was hoping you would
help us.

fields.EN:
And we don't have to worry about
Blood Skelter anymore because we
have Jack now.
fields.JP:
ジャックのおかげで、ブラッドスケルター化の
心配もなくなったわけだしさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And we don't have to worry about
Blood Skelter anymore because we
have Jack now.

fields.EN:
See? Your reasoning against
working is starting to lose ground,
no?
fields.JP:
ほらほら～。あんたの働きたくない言い訳、
だんだん外堀埋まってきてるよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? Your reasoning against
working is starting to lose ground,
no?

fields.EN:
Huh... You really are a bother,
aren't you, Jack?
fields.JP: はあ。ジャックも迷惑な人ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... You really are a bother,
aren't you, Jack?

fields.EN:
My! The audacity! You were using
Blood Skelter as a reason for your
slovenly lifestyle?!
fields.JP:
まあ！　呆れましたわ！
ブラッドスケルター化まで言い訳に使って
たんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My! The audacity! You were using
Blood Skelter as a reason for your
slovenly lifestyle?!

fields.EN:
Bother...? Like you can talk,
using Blood Skelter as an excuse
all this time.
fields.JP:
迷惑ってあんた……
ブラッドスケルター化を言い訳にしてる人間が
いう言葉じゃないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bother...? Like you can talk,
using Blood Skelter as an excuse
all this time.

fields.EN:
Come, now... You could give me a
little slack.
fields.JP: 別にどうでもいいじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come, now... You could give me a
little slack.

fields.JP: わらわたちは、『人間』じゃないんですし～

fields.EN: Wha-?! What do you mean by that?!
fields.JP: は！？　それ、どーいう意味よ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha-?! What do you mean by that?!

fields.JP: わらわたちは『バケモノ』ですから～

fields.EN:
H-Hey, Kaguya... No one's ever
said that or thought it before.
Just quit letting it bother you.
fields.JP:
も、もー、かぐやは。
誰もそんなこと思ってないって言ってるじゃん。
いいかげん気にするの、やめなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, Kaguya... No one's ever
said that or thought it before.
Just quit letting it bother you.

fields.EN:
Those who have lived a quiet, calm
life wouldn't understand.
fields.JP: 所詮ぬくぬくと育てられた人には、わかりません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those who have lived a quiet, calm
life wouldn't understand.

fields.EN:
Hey... What's with that attitude
of yours?
fields.JP: あんた……そういう言い方、ないんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey... What's with that attitude
of yours?

fields.EN:
Then let me rephrase it. I have no
obligation to work, so I don't
want to work.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、言葉を変えます～。
わらわは別に、働く義務は負ってませんので、
働きたくないんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then let me rephrase it. I have no
obligation to work, so I don't
want to work.

fields.EN:
But... Without your help, we
can't move forward in our plans to
escape the Jail.
fields.JP:
でも……かぐやさんの手助けがないと、
先へ進めない……
ジェイル脱出計画が進まないんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Without your help, we
can't move forward in our plans to
escape the Jail.

fields.EN:
It can't be helped... We'll just
have to find another way through.
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわ。
何か他の方法を探しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped... We'll just
have to find another way through.

fields.JP: そうだね。しょうがないか……

fields.EN:
Please do so. I'd like to get back
to my nap soon.
fields.JP:
そうしてください～
わらわはそろそろお昼寝したいですし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please do so. I'd like to get back
to my nap soon.

fields.EN:
(How can I convince Kaguyahime-san to lend
us a hand?)
fields.JP:
（……どうしたら、かぐや姫さんに力を貸して
　もらえるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How can I convince Kaguya to lend
us a hand?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I don't want to work until the
five treasures come together.
fields.JP: 五つの宝物が揃わないと、わらわは働きたくないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to work until the
five treasures come together.

fields.EN:
That again... You really are a
greedy princess, you know that?
fields.JP:
まーた出たよそれ。
ワガママ姫なんだからー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That again... You really are a
greedy princess, you know that?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: まだ何かあるんですか～？

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime-san, you said before that you
didn't want to work until we got you
five treasures, right?
fields.JP:
かぐや姫さん、前に言ったよね？
五つの宝物が揃わないと、働きたくないって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I recall correctly, you said
you didn't want to work until we
got you five treasures.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: If we get them, will you help?
fields.JP: それを持ってきたら……協力してもらえるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: If we get them, will you help?

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose I could think
about it...
fields.JP: ……まあ、考えてみてもいいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose I could think
about it...

fields.EN:
Great! We'll see if we can find
them, then!
fields.JP: わかった……じゃあ、探してみるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great! We'll see if we can find
them, then!

fields.JP: はあ……まあ精々がんばってください～
かぐや姫さん、ありがとう……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Now then, if you're done, please
leave.
fields.JP: 用が済んだら、いいかげん出て行ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, if you're done, please
leave.

fields.EN:
I feel like we're doing more than
we should, but I have to hand it
to you for getting that out of her.
fields.JP:
かえって手間が増えた気もするけど……
でも、あのグータラ姫からそれだけ
引き出せたのは、褒めてあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like we're doing more than
we should, but I have to hand it
to you for getting that out of her.

fields.EN:
But, where are those treasures
she wants?
fields.JP: でも、それはどこにあるんでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, where are those treasures
she wants?

fields.JP: ふっふっふ……アリスも思いついた？

fields.EN:
Yup. The reason why she wanted to
stop us from going was because of
them!
fields.JP:
そう。あの子があれだけあたしらの出撃を止めた
理由……そこだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. The reason why she wanted to
stop us from going was because of
them!

fields.EN:
So, the treasures she's referring
to are in the Temple area?
fields.JP:
つまり……『旧寺院エリア』に
その宝物があるってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the treasures she's referring
to are in the Temple area?

fields.EN: That's very likely. ...Let's go back and look for it!
fields.JP:
その可能性は高いね。
……戻って探してみよう！
fields.LOCALIZED: I think so. C'mon, let's go!

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san! I found one!
That makes four!
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん、ありました！
……四つ目です！　見つけました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood! I found one!
That makes four!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
おおー。
ジャック、でかした！

fields.EN:
Jack-san... Very nice work. I was
planning to find it myself... How
frustrating!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……なかなか、やりますわね。
わたくしが見つけるつもりでしたのに……
くやしいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very nice work... Though, I'm
quite jealous that you found it
before I did.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
As expected of you, Jack-san.
You did well to find this. Shirayuki
would have missed it for sure!
fields.JP:
さすが、ジャックさんです。
こんなの、よく見つけられましたねー。
白雪だったら見落としてますよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How wonderful. Of course you were
able to find it. Snow White would
have missed that for sure!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: いや、運がよかったんだよ……

fields.EN:
In any case, good work. I was
getting tired of all this
treasure-hunting.
fields.JP:
なんにせよ、よかったわ。
もう、宝物探しにはうんざりしてたとこだしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, good work. I was
getting tired of all this
treasure-hunting.

fields.EN: So, is that all of them?
fields.JP: ……これで全部、揃ったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, is that all of them?

fields.EN:
No, we still have one more to go.
But the last one's going to be
tough. I have no clue where it is.
fields.JP:
いや……まだ最後のひとつが残ってる。
最後のやつは、ちょっと難問だねー。
皆目、見当がつかないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, we still have one more to go.
But the last one's going to be
tough. I have no clue where it is.

fields.EN:
Whaaaat?! We're still doing this?!
Come on, now! Four should be more
than enough!
fields.JP:
えええ～～～！　まだ続けるの～～～！？
四つも集めれば充分じゃない？
もう、たくさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaaaat?! We're still doing this?!
Come on, now! Four should be more
than enough!

fields.EN: I agree. I'm becoming tired as well...
fields.JP:
そうですわね。
わたくしも……ちょっと疲れましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I agree. I'm becoming tired as well...

fields.EN:
Well, we did go and search every
place we thought the treasure
would be found.
fields.JP:
そうですね。
宝物がありそうな場所は、
これで全部あたってしまったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we did go and search every
place we thought the treasure
would be found.

fields.EN:
Mmm... But if we don't get all
five, I don't think Kaguyahime-san will
help...
fields.JP:
うーん……でも全部集めないと、
かぐや姫さん、協力してくれないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... But if we don't get all
five, I don't think Kaguya will
help...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.LOCALIZED: What should we do, Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Augh! This is starting to piss me
off! We're done! I'm gonna beat
her up and make her cooperate!
fields.JP:
……なんか、ムカついてきた！
宝物集めはもういいや！
かぐやをブン殴って、言うことをきかせる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! This is starting to piss me
off! We're done! I'm gonna beat
her up and make her cooperate!

fields.JP:
……ええっ！？
ちょ、ちょっと待って……

fields.EN:
Great idea, Aka-nee! We
should've done that to begin with!
fields.JP:
赤姉、冴えてるじゃない！
最初から、そうすりゃ良かったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great idea, Sister Red! We
should've done that to begin with!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
I agree with that method as well.
Kaguya does need to learn a lesson
or two!
fields.JP:
わたくしは、それでも構いませんわよ。
かぐやさん、ご無体すぎますもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree with that method as well.
Kaguya does need to learn a lesson
or two!

fields.EN:
If that tactic had a real chance
of working, wouldn't you have done
it earlier?
fields.JP:
まあ、力尽くで何とかなるようだったら、
宝探しなんてしていないと思うのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that tactic had a real chance
of working, wouldn't you have done
it earlier?

fields.EN:
*sigh* Yeah... It's just that
Kaguya has been a lot more
stubborn than usual...
fields.JP:
はあ……そうなんだよねえ……
かぐや、いつになく頑固でさー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Yeah... It's just that
Kaguya has been a lot more
stubborn than usual...

fields.EN:
Um, how about we ask Kaguyahime-san
for a hint on the whereabouts of
the last treasure?
fields.JP:
あの、ヒント……
ヒントを出して貰うってのはどうですか？
かぐや姫さんに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, how about we ask her for some
tips on the whereabouts of the
last treasure?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I mean, it isn't fair having to
look for them without any real
leads.
fields.JP:
こんなの、フェアじゃないですよね？
ろくな情報もないまま、
闇雲に宝物を探さなきゃならないなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, it isn't fair having to
look for them without any real
leads.

fields.EN:
Tell Kaguyahime-san it isn't a fair contest
and make her give us a hint about
the last treasure...
fields.JP:
公正な勝負になってないって言って、
かぐや姫さんにヒントを出させるんです。
最後の宝物の場所について……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I'm thinking maybe we could
use that as the basis for getting
tips on the last one.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I'm not so sure that'll work...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not so sure that'll work...

fields.EN:
Yup. I'm not sure about that,
either...
fields.JP: だよね。そんなにうまくいくかなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I'm not sure about that,
either...

fields.EN:
Well, maybe she can accept the
four that we have as a good-faith
gesture that we did our best?
fields.JP: じゃあ、せめてこの四つで誠意を示すとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, maybe she can accept the
four that we have as a good-faith
gesture that we did our best?

fields.JP: それ、もっと駄目そうな気がするんだけど……

fields.EN:
Might as well try what we can!
It's not like we've got any better
ideas.
fields.JP:
……ま、やってみよっか！
他にアイディアもないことだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might as well try what we can!
It's not like we've got any better
ideas.

fields.EN:
Let's head back to headquarters!
We'll jump straight into
negotiations with Kaguya.
fields.JP:
これより、黎明本部に帰還する！
……帰って、かぐやと交渉だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's head back to headquarters!
We'll jump straight into
negotiations with Kaguya.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It doesn't matter how often you
visit. I have no intention of
working.
fields.JP:
何度来ても無駄です～。
わらわは働かないですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't matter how often you
visit. I have no intention of
working.

fields.JP: でもさ、これを見てほしいんだ

fields.EN:
We found four of them, but we
can't find the fifth one...
fields.JP:
四つまでは見つけられたんだけど、
最後の一つがどうしても見つからなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found four of them, but we
can't find the fifth one...

fields.EN:
Before we get into that, what are
these, anyway? Why do you want so
many of them?
fields.JP:
っていうかさ、そもそもこの宝物ってなんなの？
なんでこんなのがほしいのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before we get into that, what are
these, anyway? Why do you want so
many of them?

fields.EN:
Huh?! You made us search for these
things, and you don't even know
what they're for?!
fields.JP:
は！？　人に探させといて、なんなの？
その言い草！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! You made us search for these
things, and you don't even know
what they're for?!

fields.EN:
Now, now. These are important to
you, right?
fields.JP:
まあまあ。
でも、かぐやにとって大事な物ってことは
確かなんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now. These are important to
you, right?

fields.EN:
C'mon, Kaguya. You have to help
us. We'll find the last one, I
promise.
fields.JP:
ねえ、かぐや。
頼むから力を貸してよ。
最後の一つも絶対見つけてあげるからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, Kaguya. You have to help
us. We'll find the last one, I
promise.

fields.EN:
