We need your help. After all this,
you'd better help us, or else.
fields.JP:
あんたの力が必要なのよ。
こっちが頭下げてんだから、あんたもいい加減
協力しなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need your help. After all this,
you'd better help us, or else.

fields.EN:
But you don't have the fifth one,
and I need that...
fields.JP:
でも五つ目が揃ってないじゃないですか～
無理なものは無理です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you don't have the fifth one,
and I need that...

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime-san? Can you at least give us
a lead on where the last one is?
fields.JP:
かぐや姫さん。
だったらその最後の一つの在り処について、
何か情報をもらえないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya? Can you at least give us
a lead on where the last one is?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: That's what you call relying on others~. Why don't you just give up already~?
fields.JP:
それを甘えって言うんです～。
きっぱり諦めたらどうですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not even trying. Why don't
you all just give up already?

fields.EN:
But we need your help to clear our
mission!
fields.JP:
でも、今度の任務を成功させるには、
どうしても君の力が必要なんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we need your help to clear our
mission!

fields.EN: Even the smallest clue will do. We'll find it, no matter what...!
fields.JP:
どんな小さなことでもいいんだ。
絶対見つけて来るから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to tell us exactly
where it is, but can you at least
give us a tip?

fields.EN: Why do you want to work like this?
fields.JP: ……何故そんなに働こうとするんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why do you want to work like this?

fields.EN:
This... may not be the answer
you're looking for, but...
fields.JP:
……あなたの本当に望んでいる答えとは違うかも
しれないけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This... may not be the answer
you're looking for, but...

fields.EN:
You must know this better than I
do, but we're going to escape this
place by destroying all the cores.
fields.JP:
全ての核を破壊して、ここから脱出するためよ。
あなたの方が、新入りのわたしより
よく知ってると思うけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must know this better than I
do, but we're going to escape this
place by destroying all the cores.

fields.EN:
Why escape? It's nice and safe
here.
fields.JP:
別に脱出しなくてもいいじゃないですか～。
ここにいれば安全なんですし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why escape? It's nice and safe
here.

fields.EN:
The Jail is alive. There's no
guarantee that this place is going
to stay safe.
fields.JP:
ジェイルは生きてるんだ。
ここがいつまで安全かなんて、保証は無いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail is alive. There's no
guarantee that this place is going
to stay safe.

fields.EN:
The Jail isn't a place humans
should be living in! You should
know that.
fields.JP:
それに、ジェイルの中なんて、
僕たち人間がいるべき場所じゃないよ！
それは君だってわかってる筈だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail isn't a place humans
should be living in! You should
know that.

fields.EN: Let's get out of here together, with everyone we've rescued!
fields.JP:
助け出された人たちもみんな一緒に、
ここから脱出しようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's all get out of here,
together!

fields.EN:
What a bunch of do-gooders...
This is such a chore...
fields.JP:
みなさん、お人よしなんですね～。
いちいちめんどくさいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a bunch of do-gooders...
This is such a chore...

fields.EN:
Kaguya, please... Please give us
at least a hint as to where we can
find the fifth one!
fields.JP:
かぐやさん、お願いします。
五つ目のヒント、教えてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, please... Please give us
at least a hint as to where we can
find the fifth one!

fields.EN:
Don't you think it's wonderful,
knowing you're needed?
fields.JP:
……誰かに必要とされることは、
素晴らしいことではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you think it's wonderful,
knowing you're needed?

fields.EN:
I don't need to be needed. If you
don't have them all, then I need
you all to leave.
fields.JP:
わらわは必要とされたくないの。
全部揃わないなら大人しく下がってください
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't need to be needed. If you
don't have them all, then I need
you all to leave.

fields.EN:
As for the four you found, I'll
hold on to them...
fields.JP: 四つの宝物は、わらわがあずかっておきます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for the four you found, I'll
hold on to them...

fields.JP: おとなしく渡してください～

かぐや姫さん……！
そんな無理やり……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: （集めた宝物がいきなり光りだした！？）

fields.EN:
...The last one we were looking
for?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The last one we were looking
for?!

fields.EN:
Kaguya... Don't tell me you've
been hiding the last one with
you...
fields.JP: かぐや。あんたまさか、隠してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya... Don't tell me you've
been hiding the last one with
you...

fields.EN:
I... wasn't hiding it. I've had it
with me for a long time.
fields.JP:
これは……隠してたんじゃありません。
この宝物は、わらわが物心ついた時から
持っていたもので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... wasn't hiding it. I've had it
with me for a long time.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean you weren't
hiding it!
fields.JP: そんなの、隠してたことに変わりないじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean you weren't
hiding it!

fields.EN:
What is it with you?! Do you know
how much trouble we went through
just to get those?!
fields.JP:
あんた、何でそういうことするの！？
わたしたちがどれだけ一生懸命探したと
思ってるわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it with you?! Do you know
how much trouble we went through
just to get those?!

fields.EN:
You're really that against helping
us? Even after Dad... We've done
so much for you?!
fields.JP:
……そんなにあたし達に協力するのが嫌なんだ？
お父さんだってみんなだって、
あんなに良くしてくれてるのに！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're really that against helping
us? Even after Dad... We've done
so much for you?!

fields.EN: I-I'm sure she has a good reason!
fields.JP: き、きっと何か事情があるんですよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I'm sure she has a good reason!

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime-san! Please, you have to help
us!
fields.JP:
かぐや姫さん……！
どうか、協力してください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya! Please, you have to help
us!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: You don't know anything! You're just a stupid soft-hearted do-gooder!
fields.JP:
……何も知らないくせに！
お人よしの馬鹿のくせに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You all know nothing! And you!
You're just a stupid busybody!

fields.JP: そなたたちが出て行かないなら……！

fields.EN:
Well, she needs to cool herself
off.
fields.JP: 少し、頭を冷やすといいんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she needs to cool herself
off.

fields.JP: でも……どこへ行ったんでしょう
どうせすぐ戻ってくるわよ

fields.EN: But Kaguya-san hasn't opened her heart to anyone here... She may not have anywhere to go.
fields.JP:
でも……かぐやさん、
ここの人たちにも心を開いていませんし……
居場所、無いんじゃないでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Kaguya hasn't opened up to any
of us. She doesn't have anyone to
rely on...

fields.EN:
Yes... With how she is now,
there's no telling what could
happen.
fields.JP:
……ええ、取り乱したあまり、
もし何か起きてしまったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... With how she is now,
there's no telling what could
happen.

fields.EN:
Let's go! We can't leave her
alone. Isn't that right, Akazukin-san?! She's one of us!
fields.JP:
とにかく探そうよ！
このままじゃ駄目だよ……ね、赤ずきんさん！
仲間なんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go! We can't leave her
alone. Isn't that right, Red
Riding Hood?! She's one of us!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Okay, let's do this! Let's bring
that idiot back here!
fields.JP:
……よっしゃ！
とにかくあのバカを連れ戻すとしよっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's do this! Let's bring
that idiot back here!

fields.EN:
Oh, what brings you here, kid? You
look all flustered.
fields.JP:
やあ、どうしたんだ、小僧？
血相変えて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, what brings you here, kid? You
look all flustered.

fields.EN:
Whoa! Well now, looks like you've
got an entourage. So, what's
happening here?
fields.JP:
……おっと！
ははは。こりゃ、団体さんだな。
みんな、どうしたんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Well now, looks like you've
got an entourage. So, what's
happening here?

fields.EN:
Mr. Kadowaki! Um... Have you seen
Kaguyahime-san around?
fields.JP:
門脇さん！
あの……かぐや姫さんを見ませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mr. Kadowaki! Um... Have you seen
Kaguya around?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh, you mean that truant? Yes,
I did see her.
fields.JP:
……ん？　サボリ魔かい？
ああ、見たよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, you mean that truant? Yes,
I did see her.

fields.JP: どこで見かけたんですの？

fields.EN: Do you know where she was going?
fields.JP: どこに行ったか……知りませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you know where she was going?

fields.EN:
I don't know what's happening here,
but that truant went out to one
of the areas just now.
fields.JP:
どうしたんだい……いったい？
あのサボリ魔なら、つい今しがただけど、
門を越えて独房エリアに向かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what's happening here,
but that truant went out to one
of the areas just now.

fields.JP:
独房エリアに向かわれたんですの！？
……おひとりで！？

fields.EN:
Hey! You're supposed to be a
gatekeeper! Why'd you let her
through?!
fields.JP:
はあ？　あんた門番でしょ？
なんで止めないのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! You're supposed to be a
gatekeeper! Why'd you let her
through?!

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Well, my job is to stop
enemies from entering. I have no
say on people leaving.
fields.JP:
ははは。そう言われてもなあ。
オレの仕事は外敵の侵入を阻むことだからね。
門から外に出ていくヤツは管轄外だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Well, my job is to stop
enemies from entering. I have no
say on people leaving.

fields.EN:
Princess Lazy is one hell of a
pain... Of all the places to run
away to...
fields.JP:
グータラ姫、最悪……
いくら何でも、ふつう本部から逃走する！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess Lazy is one hell of a
pain... Of all the places to run
away to...

fields.EN:
Is she that adamant about not
wanting to work?
fields.JP: どんだけ働きたくなかったんだっての……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she that adamant about not
wanting to work?

fields.EN:
She seems determined to not help
us out at all...
fields.JP: そんなにしてまで協力を拒むなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She seems determined to not help
us out at all...

fields.EN:
But isn't it weird for her to have
run off alone?
fields.JP:
でも……変じゃないですか？
ひとりで独房エリアに向かうなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But isn't it weird for her to have
run off alone?

fields.EN:
He's right. That place is
dangerous, and it isn't like her
to go out like that.
fields.JP:
そうですよ。危険すぎますよ。
かぐやさんらしくないです
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right. That place is
dangerous, and it isn't like her
to go out like that.

fields.EN:
Maybe there's a reason she
went out...
fields.JP: 何か……理由があるんじゃ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there's a reason she
went out...

fields.EN:
Let's go after her! We might still
be able to catch her along the
way!
fields.JP:
後を追いましょう！
今なら、まだ追いつけるかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go after her! We might still
be able to catch her along the
way!

fields.EN:
Huh? You mean all of you? Well,
I wish I could help, but I can't
because I'm on duty.
fields.JP:
ええっ……これから全員でかい？
あっはっは！　大ごとだな、こりゃ……
オレは無理だよ？　勤務中だし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You mean all of you? Well,
I wish I could help, but I can't
because I'm on duty.

fields.EN:
Mr. Kadowaki, do you know in which
direction Kaguyahime-san headed?
fields.JP:
門脇さん。かぐや姫さんは、どの方向に
向かったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mr. Kadowaki, do you know in which
direction Kaguya headed?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Hm... Let's see... I think she was
moving toward the City Streets.
fields.JP:
ああ……ええと……
『元街道沿いエリア』の方だったかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Let's see... I think she was
moving toward the City Streets.

fields.JP: ……ってことは、あそこに行ったのね！

fields.EN:
Let's head to the Temple and find
Kaguya!
fields.JP:
みんな。『旧寺院エリア』に向かうよ！
かぐやを追いかけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's head to the Temple and find
Kaguya!

fields.EN:
It's Kaguya! She's not that far
off!
fields.JP: かぐやだ！　そう遠くないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's Kaguya! She's not that far
off!

fields.EN:
She's probably being attacked by
Marchens!
fields.JP: きっと、メルヒェンに襲われてるんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's probably being attacked by
Marchens!

fields.EN:
I heard the scream from over
there!
fields.JP: こっちの方から聞こえたわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard the scream from over
there!

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's go and help
Kaguya!
fields.JP:
かぐやを助けるよ！
みんな……いいね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's go and help
Kaguya!

fields.JP: やってやろうじゃない！
かぐや姫さん！　大丈夫！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ま、危機一髪ってとこだね！

fields.EN:
It was pretty irresponsible of you
to come here.
fields.JP: 全く、無茶してくれるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was pretty irresponsible of you
to come here.

fields.EN: Well, at least she's safe now.
fields.JP: やれやれ。無事で何よりですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, at least she's safe now.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Why are you all so kind to me?! I
don't want your kindness!
fields.JP:
…………
どうしてわらわにそんなに優しくするの！？
そんなに優しくしないで！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you all so kind to me?! I
don't want your kindness!

fields.EN: Why aren't you all yelling at me?
fields.JP: ……どうしてわらわを怒らないんですか
fields.LOCALIZED: Why aren't you all yelling at me?

fields.EN: Because we're friends... I've wanted to run away like that many times myself...
fields.JP:
だって、仲間なんだし……
僕も飛び出したくなったこと、
何度もあったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're one of us. You're our
friend... I've done similar things
in the past, too

fields.EN:
Friend... See? That's what I don't
like about you...
fields.JP:
……『仲間』……
そなたのそういうところ……嫌いです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friend... See? That's what I don't
like about you...

fields.EN:
Before I knew I was a Blood
Maiden, I used to fight the
Marchens attacking my village.
fields.JP:
……血式少女なのだと知る前のことです。
わらわは育った村で、何も知らぬまま
時折襲い来るメルヒェンを退治してました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before I knew I was a Blood
Maiden, I used to fight the
Marchens attacking my village.

fields.EN:
I thought the villagers were my
friends, so I did what I could to
protect them.
fields.JP:
……育ててくれた人間たちを、
仲間だと思ったからです。
彼らを守りたかったのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought the villagers were my
friends, so I did what I could to
protect them.

fields.EN:
They were actually scared and
didn't like you...
fields.JP: ……気味悪がられ、怖がられたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They were actually scared and
didn't like you...

fields.EN: They called me a 'monster child' and bullied me... And of the five treasures I'd had for as long as I could remember, they took all but one...
fields.JP:
『化物の子』と呼ばれ、虐められ……
物心ついた時から持っていた五つの宝物も
一つを除いて取り上げられて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They called me a monster, and
even took all of my treasures,
except for one.

fields.EN:
...That I would never help humans
again. They can just die, for all
I care.
fields.JP:
……人間どものためになど、
死んでも働いてやるもんか。
あいつらは勝手に苦しんで、勝手に死ねばいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
...That I would never help humans
again. They can just die, for all
I care.

fields.EN:
Kaguya... Is that how you really
feel?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya... Is that how you really
feel?

fields.EN:
I sort of know what you mean.
I saw with my own eyes how
badly Alice was treated before.
fields.JP:
君の気持ち、少しわかると思う。
アリスもやっぱり人に虐められてて、
僕は……そんな姿をずっと見てたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sort of know what you mean.
I saw with my own eyes how
badly Alice was treated before.

fields.EN:
But Jack was there to protect me.
And now, we have even more
friends.
fields.JP:
……でもジャックは、
いつもわたしを庇ってくれたわ。
そして今は、仲間たちがいる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Jack was there to protect me.
And now, we have even more
friends.

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime-san? Can you please help us?
We want you to fight alongside us.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫さん、改めてお願いできないかな？
僕たちと一緒に戦ってほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya? Can you please help us?
We want you to fight alongside us.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: It doesn't have to be for humans. Do it for the other Blood Maidens, girls just like you...
fields.JP:
人間のためじゃなくたっていいんだ。
君と同じ、血式少女のみんなのために……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't have to be for the
"humans." Do it for the Blood
Maidens, and for those who care.

fields.EN:
Of course, I don't really have the
right to say that, especially
since I can't fight myself.
fields.JP:
その、戦えない僕が偉そうに言えたことじゃ
ないかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, I don't really have the
right to say that, especially
since I can't fight myself.

fields.EN:
You're everyone's lifeline. It's
not good to demean yourself like
that.
fields.JP:
……そなたはみんなの命綱じゃないですか
変な謙遜、かっこ悪いです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're everyone's lifeline. It's
not good to demean yourself like
that.

fields.EN:
You're all so annoyingly
persistent. I'll work, but you'd
better make it easy for me.
fields.JP:
みんなしつこくて仕方ないので、働いてやります～
精々わらわに楽をさせてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all so annoyingly
persistent. I'll work, but you'd
better make it easy for me.

fields.EN:
Thank you so much, Kaguyahime-san! We
really appreciate it!
fields.JP: ありがとう！　かぐや姫さん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so much, Kaguya! We
really appreciate it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: かぐや姫さん => Kaguya-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: ...It's a pain, so you don't need the '-san'~.
fields.JP: ……面倒臭いので、『さん』は要らないです～
fields.LOCALIZED: A simple thank you is enough.

fields.EN:
All right, then! Everyone, let's
get this train back on track!
fields.JP:
よーし！
それじゃあみんな、張り切って行こー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, then! Everyone, let's
get this train back on track!

fields.EN:
You have more to say, Princess
Lazy?
fields.JP: まだ何かあるの？　グータラ姫さんは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have more to say, Princess
Lazy?

fields.EN:
I saw some Marchens taking people
away just past here. What do you
want to do?
fields.JP:
メルヒェンたちがここの奥の方へ、
捕えた人間たちを連れて行くのを見ました～
どうしますか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw some Marchens taking people
away just past here. What do you
want to do?

fields.EN:
Yup! She's right! Thanks for letting
us know, Kaguya!
fields.JP:
うん。そうだね！
よく教えてくれたね、かぐや
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! She's right! Thanks for letting
us know, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
We're members of the Dawn. We're
here to save you.
fields.JP:
僕たちは『黎明』のチームです。
みんなを助けに来ました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're members of the Dawn. We're
here to save you.

fields.EN:
Really?! Were our prayers heard by
the sun?!
fields.JP:
本当！？　本当なの！？
私たちの祈りが太陽に届いたのかしら！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! Were our prayers heard by
the sun?!

fields.EN:
How do you know they're real?
There's no way little brats like
them would make it this far.
fields.JP:
本当かどうか、わかったもんじゃねえぞ。
ガキどもだけで、何でこんなとこまで来れんだよ？
変じゃねえか
fields.LOCALIZED:
How do you know they're real?
There's no way little brats like
them would make it this far.

fields.EN:
I-I guess... They do have weird
weapons, and I've never seen
those kinds of clothes before...
fields.JP:
そ……そうよね。
見たことない武器を持ってるし……
格好だって見たことないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess... They do have weird
weapons, and I've never seen
those kinds of clothes before...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. We're humans, just
like you. We just have special
powers, that's all.
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ。
わたしたちは、あなたたちと同じ人間……。
ただ、少しだけ戦う術があるだけだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We're humans, just
like you. We just have special
powers, that's all.

fields.EN:
Just wait right there. We'll get
you out.
fields.JP: ……待ってて、すぐにここから解放するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just wait right there. We'll get
you out.

fields.EN: Just like Alice said! We're fighting those things so everyone can escape from here together!
fields.JP:
アリスの言う通りだって。
あたしたち、あいつらと戦ってるんだよ！
みんなでここから脱出するためにね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's like she said! We're here to
fight those monsters and get you
all to safety!

fields.EN:
Now then, let's crack this place
open!
fields.JP: さーて、いっちょ派手に壊しますかー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's crack this place
open!

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, you don't want to
hurt the people inside...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん……
中の人まで壊さないでくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, you don't want to
hurt the people inside...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: You think I'd do such a thing?
fields.JP: あたしがそんなミスするわけないじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: You think I'd do such a thing?

fields.JP: みなさん、少し下がっててくださーい

ナイトメア！？
こんな時に……！

fields.EN:
Wh-What?! The place got dark!
What's going on?!
fields.JP:
な……何！？　あたりが暗くなったわ！
何が起きてるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?! The place got dark!
What's going on?!

fields.EN:
This isn't good! Let's pull back
for a moment!
fields.JP:
まずいよ！
いったん退くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't good! Let's pull back
for a moment!

fields.JP:
嫌！　行かないで！
私たちを見捨てる気！？

fields.EN:
We won't! We'll be back! The
monster coming won't hurt you
folks!
fields.JP:
違うって！
あいつはあんた達のことは傷つけない！
絶対戻ってくるから待ってて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We won't! We'll be back! The
monster coming won't hurt you
folks!

fields.EN:
Lies! I knew it! You're all here
just to get our hopes up, only to
leave us behind!
fields.JP:
嘘だ！
やっぱり俺たちに期待させといて
見捨てる気なんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lies! I knew it! You're all here
just to get our hopes up, only to
leave us behind!

fields.EN:
Look at their eyes! They're
glowing! You guys! Don't let them
fool you! They're monsters!
fields.JP:
よく見たら目が変な色に光ってるじゃないか！
みんな、騙されるな！　こいつらは化け物だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at their eyes! They're
glowing! You guys! Don't let them
fool you! They're monsters!

fields.EN: That's right! They're allies of those Marchens! Pretending to be human...!
fields.JP:
そうだ！
こいつらメルヒェン共の仲間なんだ！
人間のふりをしやがって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! They're Marchens!
Damn it! Trying to fool us by
acting like humans, eh?!

fields.EN: That's not true! We're not monsters! Believe us! We'll get everyone outside, no matter what...!
fields.JP:
違うよ！　化け物なんかじゃない！
僕たちを信じてよ！
絶対みんなを外に連れてくから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it! We're not monsters!
Just believe us! We'll get you out
of here!

fields.EN:
There's no way we can believe you!
This place went dark right when
you got here!
fields.JP:
信じられるわけないでしょ！
あんたらが来てから、こんな風に真っ暗に！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we can believe you!
This place went dark right when
you got here!

fields.EN:
They're monsters, yet they even
used Michiru-sama's teachings...!!
fields.JP:
化け物のくせに
ミチル様の教えまで利用して……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet they heard the teachings
of Lady Oohime, and tried to use
them against us!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
This has nothing to do with her!
Wait... Where did you hear about
Michiru?!
fields.JP:
何言ってんの！
ミチルのことなんか関係ないじゃない！
何であんた達がミチルのこと知ってるのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This has nothing to do with her!
Wait... Where did you hear about
Michiru?!

fields.EN: You heard that, everyone?! They called that person by name without an honorific! That's proof they're monsters!
fields.JP:
聞いたかみんな！
あの方のことを呼び捨てにしたぞ！
こいつらが化け物な証拠だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard that?! They called Lady
Oohime by another name! It's proof
that they're heathens!

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime, it's okay... They won't
hurt you.
fields.JP:
……かぐや姫、大丈夫。
彼らはあなたを傷つけられないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, it's okay... They won't
hurt you.

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's get out of here,
now!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's get out of here,
now!

fields.EN:
Hurry! We don't stand a chance
against it yet!
fields.JP: 早く！　まともに立ち合ったら終わりです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurry! We don't stand a chance
against it yet!

fields.EN:
Then we'll find an opening and get
away from it!
fields.JP: ……こうなったら、隙を突いてかわすしか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we'll find an opening and get
away from it!

fields.JP: （ナイトメアが……かぐや姫の名前を……！？）
今はかわすことに集中して！！

fields.EN: I wonder if we're safe now...
fields.JP: どうにか……逃げ切れたかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder if we're safe now...

fields.EN: Yup... I think we lost it.
fields.JP: うん……なんとか撒くことができたね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup... I think we lost it.

fields.JP:
かぐや姫……大丈夫？
怪我はなかったかしら？

fields.EN: Those people back there didn't mean any harm. When we were locked up, we were terrified too, and desperate to escape...
fields.JP:
さっきの人たちもさ、悪気はないんだよ。
僕らも牢にいたときは、すごく怖かったし、
逃げたくてたまらなかったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The people back there didn't mean
what they said. They were just
scared...

fields.EN:
You're right. They were just
scared... I suppose...
fields.JP:
確かに……そうね。
彼らはただ怖かっただけ……そう言えなくも
ないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. They were just
scared... I suppose...

fields.EN: What bothers me more is the Order of the Sun. Did those people really come all the way out here to proselytize...?
fields.JP:
むしろ、気になったのはタイヨウ教団のことね。
あの人たち……ここまで布教に来たということ
なのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What bothered me was how they knew
about the Order of the Sun. Did
the Order come here before us?

fields.EN:
But even if they did, they're not
armed. How could they even get
this far?
fields.JP:
でも、武装もしていない様子の彼らが、
どうやって……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But even if they did, they're not
armed. How could they even get
this far?

fields.EN:
Hmm... I don't know.
Unfortunately, I don't know very
much about them...
fields.JP:
んー、どうだろうね。あたしもあの教団のことは
隅から隅まで知ってるわけじゃないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... I don't know.
Unfortunately, I don't know very
much about them...

fields.JP: でも、お姉様たちは、いい人たちです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our sister and the others there
are all good people!
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Speaking of which, Oyayubihime...
Did you know Michiru-san? Earlier...
fields.JP:
そういえば、親指姫はミチルさんと親しいの？
さっき……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of which, Thumbelina...
Did you know Michiru? Earlier...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Oh, that. My sister and I were taken in and raised by that order. That's how we came to know Michiru and the others.
fields.JP:
ああ。そのことなら……
私たち姉妹は、あの教団に拾われて育ったのよ。
だから、ミチルたちとも馴染みってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We three were adopted by
by them. I've known Michiru for a
long time.

fields.EN:
The place was so lively and
bright, back when we were little.
fields.JP:
白雪たちが小さい頃は、とっても和気藹々とした
ところでした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place was so lively and
bright, back when we were little.

fields.EN:
(The Order of the Sun... I didn't
expect them to have preached their
teachings this far...)
fields.JP:
（タイヨウ教団……どこか不思議な人たちだと
　思ってたけど、ここまで教えが広がってる
　なんてすごいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Order of the Sun... I didn't
expect them to have preached their
teachings this far...)

fields.EN:
By the way, um... Did Shirayuki
hear correctly?
fields.JP:
そういえばですけど……
あの、さっきの……白雪の聞き違いですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, um... Did Snow White
hear correctly?

fields.EN:
The Nightmare said Kaguya's name,
didn't it?
fields.JP:
……喋りましたよね、ナイトメア？
かぐやさんの名を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare said Kaguya's name,
didn't it?

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime? We should probably
stop right there.
fields.JP:
白雪姫。今はその話はよしましょう。
かぐや姫が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White? We should probably
stop right there.

fields.EN:
(That makes it two Nightmares
now... Does it have a transceiver,
too?)
fields.JP:
（これで２体目…
　もしかして……あのナイトメアも
　トランシーバーを持ってるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That makes it two Nightmares
now... Does it have a transceiver,
too?)

fields.EN:
Come on, guys! It doesn't matter
whether that Nightmare can speak
or not!
fields.JP:
あー！　もー！
ナイトメアが喋ろうとどうだろうと……
そんなの、どっちでもいいわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, guys! It doesn't matter
whether that Nightmare can speak
or not!

fields.EN:
She's right. Our goal is to find
the core and destroy it before we
encounter the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
……親指の言うとおりだね。
今は核を見つけ出して、破壊するのが先だよ
いつまたナイトメアと出くわすかわかんないしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Our goal is to find
the core and destroy it before we
encounter the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
That's right. I'm sorry... It's my
fault for getting us sidetracked.
fields.JP:
そうね……ごめんなさい。
わたしが話を始めてしまったのがいけなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. I'm sorry... It's my
fault for getting us sidetracked.

fields.EN: You can't help being curious. Alice, you're too considerate.
fields.JP:
気になったものは仕方ないじゃない。
アリスは気を遣いすぎなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no need to worry about
it, Alice. You just happen to be
observant.

fields.EN:
But that aside, I'm getting real
peeved that we had to run away
like that!
fields.JP:
それより……こんな風にコソコソ
逃げ回らなきゃならないなんて……
こっちの方がよっぽど腹がたつわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that aside, I'm getting real
peeved that we had to run away
like that!

fields.EN:
That's right! Might I propose that
we find and destroy the core
quickly?
fields.JP:
そうですわね！　一刻も早く核を見つけて、
壊してしまいませんこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! Might I propose that
we find and destroy the core
quickly?

fields.EN: All right! Then we know what to do. Staying alive comes first, after all...
fields.JP:
よっし！　それじゃあやることは決まってる。
命あっての物種っていうからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it! We all know what to do.
We just have to be careful to not
drop the ball.

fields.EN:
Everyone, our main goal is to
destroy the core. Alice, Jack...
Please support Kaguya.
fields.JP:
みんな、いいね。今は核の破壊が最優先だよ。
アリス、ジャック……
かぐやのフォローをお願い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, our main goal is to
destroy the core. Alice, Jack...
Please support Kaguya.

fields.EN:
Let's go and find that core before
we run into the Nightmare again!
fields.JP:
じゃ、行くよ！
ナイトメアと出くわす前に……核を見つけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go and find that core before
we run into the Nightmare again!

fields.EN:
All right! We can face that
Nightmare once we destroy it!
fields.JP:
よし！　これを破壊すれば、
ナイトメアとも渡り合えるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! We can face that
Nightmare once we destroy it!

fields.EN:
Watch and learn, Princess Lazy.
There's nothing to be afraid of!
fields.JP:
見てなさいよ、グータラ姫。
私たち、何も怖がることなんてないんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Watch and learn, Princess Lazy.
There's nothing to be afraid of!

fields.EN:
The Nightmare! It's coming after
us!
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアだ！
僕たちを追って来たんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare! It's coming after
us!

fields.EN: Don't worry, there's still some distance! Everyone, hit the core before it gets here! We'll overwhelm it all at once! Got it?!
fields.JP:
大丈夫、まだ距離がある！
みんな！　奴が来る前に核を叩くよ！
一気に畳みかける！　いいね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry! We still have time!
Let's go and smash the core. Got
it?!

fields.EN: It's okay, Kaguya-san! That's a Marchen guarding the core!
fields.JP:
かぐやさん、大丈夫です！
核を守ってるメルヒェンです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Kaguya! It's just how
the Marchens protect the core!

fields.EN:
Let's do this! I'm gonna finish it
off quick, and smash that thing!
fields.JP:
待ってなさい！　
あんたなんて瞬殺して、核をぶっ壊してやるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's do this! I'm gonna finish it
off quick, and smash that thing!

fields.JP: ええ！　腕がなりますわよ！

……かぐや姫！
わたしの後ろに……
アアアアァァアァアア……！

fields.EN:
It's okay. The Jail's just wailing
because we destroyed the core.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。
核を壊されて、ジェイルが悲鳴を上げたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay. The Jail's just wailing
because we destroyed the core.

fields.EN: Seriously... I was shocked when I first heard it. It's downright creepy.
fields.JP:
全く……最初に聞いた時にはびっくりしたわよ。
気味が悪いったらないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was pretty freaky when I heard
it the first time, and it still
is. I have no sympathy.

fields.EN:
I suppose it's normal to forget
that the Jail is an actual being.
fields.JP: ジェイルが生き物だって、忘れがちですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it's normal to forget
that the Jail is an actual being.

fields.EN:
Well, whatever the Jail is, an
actual being or not, I don't really
care.
fields.JP:
ま、ジェイルが生き物だろうとなんだろうと
関係ないし、どうでもいいけどね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, whatever the Jail is, an
actual being or not, I don't really
care.

fields.EN:
Mmm...! Don't... let your guard
down...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...! Don't... let your guard
down...

fields.EN:
Save the small talk for later!
With the core broken, I'm sure
that Nightmare's coming for us!
fields.JP:
無駄話はあと！
きっと、核が壊されたのに気づいて
ナイトメアが来るよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Save the small talk for later!
With the core broken, I'm sure
that Nightmare's coming for us!

fields.JP:
……そうね！
警戒しながら行きましょう

fields.EN:
(We need to see if there are more
prisoners further in!)
fields.JP:
（奥にも囚われてる人が
　いないか確認しなきゃ…！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need to see if there are more
prisoners further in!)

fields.EN:
Wha--?! It got dark all of a
sudden...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha--?! It got dark all of a
sudden...

fields.JP: グァアアオオォォォオオオオ！

fields.EN: Looks like we'll have to face it!
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like we'll have to face it!

fields.JP: ケチョンケチョンにして差し上げますわ！
（また……かぐや姫を見て、喋った……）

fields.EN:
Kaguya, don't worry! Just leave it
to us!
fields.JP:
かぐや、気にしちゃ駄目！
あたしらに任せて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, don't worry! Just leave it
to us!

fields.EN:
It'll be fine, Kaguyahime! Everyone,
let's...
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ、かぐや姫……！
みんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be fine, Kaguya! Everyone,
let's...

fields.EN:
There's something else we should
be worrying about...!
fields.JP: それどころじゃ……ないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's something else we should
be worrying about...!

fields.JP: オオオォオオォォォォオオオ！！
と、とにかく……この中へ逃げよう！
む、むちゃくちゃですわ……！

fields.EN:
At this rate, it'll destroy us
along with the tower!
fields.JP:
このままでは……
この建物ごと、やられてしまうわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this rate, it'll destroy us
along with the tower!

fields.EN: You don't have to tell us that!
fields.JP: 言われなくてもわかってるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't have to tell us that!

fields.JP:
（ど……どうしたらいいんだ……
　どうしたら……）

fields.EN:
If this tower can bear its
attacks, we can head to the top,
and...!
fields.JP:
この塔が持ちこたえてくれれば……
……あるいは塔の上から……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this tower can bear its
attacks, we can head to the top,
and...!

fields.EN: Okay! Let's go up the tower!
fields.JP: よし！　昇ってみよう……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! Let's go up the tower!

fields.JP:
……！
でも、もしこの塔が崩れてしまったら……

fields.EN:
She's right! We don't know if this
place will hold!
fields.JP: そうよ！　何の確証もないのにそんな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! We don't know if this
place will hold!

fields.EN:
If we stay here, we'll be killed!
We need to climb the tower!
fields.JP:
このままじゃ、どのみちやられるだけだ！
……昇ろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we stay here, we'll be killed!
We need to climb the tower!

fields.EN:
All right, it's settled! Let's
hurry on up!
fields.JP:
よし、決まり！
みんな、急ぐよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, it's settled! Let's
hurry on up!

fields.JP: ずいぶん古い物みたいだけど……

fields.EN:
If we use this, we may be able to
beat it!
fields.JP:
これを使えば……！
もしかしたら、あいつを倒せるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we use this, we may be able to
beat it!

fields.EN:
Well, how are you planning on
using it?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, how are you planning on
using it?

fields.EN: I see... That just may work!
fields.JP: なるほど……いけるかもしれないね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... That just may work!

fields.EN:
Not "may"... We're going to make
it work!
fields.JP:
『いけるかも』ではないです。
やるんです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not "may"... We're going to make
it work!

fields.JP: グァアアオオォォォオオオオ！

fields.EN:
We don't have much of a choice
now!
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have much of a choice
now!

fields.EN:
I want to end this quickly and go
back to slacking off!
fields.JP: わらわは……早く終えてサボりたいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to end this quickly and go
back to slacking off!

fields.JP: みんな！　効いてるよ！

fields.EN:
You just can't get used to looking
at it.
fields.JP: 何度見ても、気持ちのいいものではないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You just can't get used to looking
at it.

fields.EN:
I'll shut that lousy mouth of
yours!
fields.JP: その煩い口、すぐに黙らせてあげるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll shut that lousy mouth of
yours!

fields.EN:
Just a little more, everyone!
Let's finish this!
fields.JP:
あと一息だよ！
みんな！　いけるね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a little more, everyone!
Let's finish this!

fields.EN:
We're bringing you back to the
Liberated District, where there
are others like yourselves.
fields.JP:
むこうに向かえば、人間の街……
『解放地区』に着きます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're bringing you back to the
Liberated District, where there
are others like yourselves.

fields.EN:
You folks stay close to us!
There's no telling what else is
lurking around the corner!
fields.JP:
いい？　あたしらから絶対離れないでよ！
まだ何があるかわかんないからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You folks stay close to us!
There's no telling what else is
lurking around the corner!

fields.EN: Okay! We knew you'd save us!
fields.JP:
わかりました……！
助けてくれると信じてたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! We knew you'd save us!

fields.EN:
Praise be! Salvation by the hands
of the Sun God! Thank you!
fields.JP:
太陽の神の思し召しだ！
ありがとう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Praise be! Salvation by the hands
of the Sun God! Thank you!

fields.EN:
Stay together! Try to stay as
close to each other as you can!
fields.JP:
……ばらけないでくださいね！
できるだけ固まってください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stay together! Try to stay as
close to each other as you can!

fields.EN:
All right. Looks like everyone's
accounted for.
fields.JP: よし。これで全員集まったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Looks like everyone's
accounted for.

fields.JP: じゃあみんな、行こっか！

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, we were able to
save all these people.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫が教えてくれたおかげで、
たくさんの人が助かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, we were able to
save all these people.

fields.EN:
Yes! All that's left is to make
sure they arrive safely back at
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
はい……！
全員無事に解放地区まで到着してほしいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! All that's left is to make
sure they arrive safely back at
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
But I don't blame Princess Lazy
here for hating people. They 
completely turned on a dime...
fields.JP:
でもまあ……グータラ姫が人嫌いになる気持ちも
わかる気がするわ。
すっごく現金っていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I don't blame Princess Lazy
here for hating people. They 
completely turned on a dime...

fields.EN:
They just weren't able to control
their emotions.
fields.JP: みんな、気持ちがいっぱいいっぱいなんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They just weren't able to control
their emotions.

fields.EN:
I still don't like people very
much, but...
fields.JP:
……わらわはやっぱり、人間は苦手です。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still don't like people very
much, but...

fields.EN:
...Since you all seem to be
lacking in many respects, I
suppose I can lend a hand.
fields.JP:
……そなたたちがどうにも頼りないので、
協力してあげないこともないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Since you all seem to be
lacking in many respects, I
suppose I can lend a hand.

fields.EN:
Let's hurry back... I haven't done
any slacking at all today...
fields.JP:
早く帰りましょう～。
わらわは早くダラダラしたいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hurry back... I haven't done
any slacking at all today...

fields.EN:
You should've seen it! The
Nightmare just became a giant!
fields.JP:
……それにしても、びっくりしたよ！
ナイトメアが巨大化するなんてさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should've seen it! The
Nightmare just became a giant!

fields.EN:
I can't believe you were able to
beat it...
fields.JP: お前ら、よく倒したよな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you were able to
beat it...

fields.EN:
I suppose it's proof that their
teamwork and individual abilities
are developing.
fields.JP:
チームワークも実力も、確実にアップ
しているという証ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it's proof that their
teamwork and individual abilities
are developing.

fields.EN: It was nothing compared to us!
fields.JP:
ま、わたしたちにかかりゃ、ざっと
こんなもんよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: It was nothing compared to us!

fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ！
その通りですわ！

fields.EN:
And it also looks like Princess
Lazy is finally ready to get
working!
fields.JP:
グータラ姫も働く気になってくれたみたい
だしね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it also looks like Princess
Lazy is finally ready to get
working!

fields.EN:
I must request that you not call
me "Princess Lazy"...
fields.JP:
それならその『グータラ姫』というの、
やめてもらえませんか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must request that you not call
me "Princess Lazy"...

fields.EN:
C'mon, you have to admit, you
are pretty lazy.
fields.JP:
何よー。
グータラはグータラじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, you have to admit, you
are pretty lazy.

fields.EN:
I'm so glad everyone was able to
make it back safely...
fields.JP:
……本当によかったわ。
みんな無事で帰ってこれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so glad everyone was able to
make it back safely...

fields.EN:
Indeed. You've accomplished our
mission of destroying the core,
but...
fields.JP:
……その通りだよ。
核の破壊を成功させたことは、もちろん大きな
成果だ。しかし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. You've accomplished our
mission of destroying the core,
but...

fields.EN:
I'm particularly happy about your
involvement, Kaguyahime. You'll play
an integral part in our success.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫。君が参加する気になってくれたことは
本当に喜ばしいよ。
彼女たちにとって、何よりの力になるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm particularly happy about your
involvement, Kaguya. You'll play
an integral part in our success.

fields.EN:
But if it gets boring, I'll go
home...
fields.JP: ……飽きたらまたサボりますから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if it gets boring, I'll go
home...

fields.EN:
Too bad. Once you're in, you
can't leave. That's what it means
to be part of the Blood Team!
fields.JP:
残念でしたー。
一度入ったらもう抜けられないのが血式部隊でね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad. Once you're in, you
can't leave. That's what it means
to be part of the Blood Team!

fields.EN:
What the heck... That sounds so
evil...
fields.JP:
何なんですか～
その悪の組織みたいなのは～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the heck... That sounds so
evil...

fields.EN:
Hahaha! I suppose that impression
isn't too far off.
fields.JP:
はっはっは……
当たらずとも遠からずかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! I suppose that impression
isn't too far off.

fields.EN:
What the hell are you saying, old
man?!
fields.JP: おいオッさん。肯定すんのかよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the hell are you saying, old
man?!

fields.JP: ……みんな、嬉しそうだったわね

fields.EN: So adults smile like that, too...
fields.JP: 大人の人たちも、あんな顔で笑うんだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED: So adults smile like that, too...

fields.EN: If only we could keep this up...
fields.JP:
こんな風に、ずっとうまく行くと
いいんだけどな……
fields.LOCALIZED: If only we could keep this up...

fields.EN:
What is it? I hear noise from down
there...
fields.JP:
……何かしら？
向こうがずいぶん騒がしいようだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it? I hear noise from down
there...

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Hello, there! You two are
as friendly as usual, aren't you?
fields.JP:
ははは。やあ、お二人さん。
いつも仲がいいねえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Hello, there! You two are
as friendly as usual, aren't you?

fields.EN: Um... What's with all the noise?
fields.JP: あの……何の騒ぎなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... What's with all the noise?

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh, that? Looks like some
party's going on down at the Order
of the Sun.
fields.JP:
ん？　……ああ、あれか。
タイヨウの方でお祭り騒ぎが起きてるみたいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, that? Looks like some
party's going on down at the Order
of the Sun.

fields.EN:
Not sure what they're doing, nor
do I care much.
fields.JP:
何をやってるのかまでは知らないし、
興味もないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not sure what they're doing, nor
do I care much.

fields.EN:
If it bothers you, why don't you
go and look? Call it a date or
something. Hahaha!
fields.JP:
何なら、見に行ってみたらどうだい？
デートのついでにね。ははは
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it bothers you, why don't you
go and look? Call it a date or
something. Hahaha!

fields.EN: Alice? You want to go and check?
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice? You want to go and check?

fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Aaah! I can't believe I'm seeing
the grace of Lady Oohime right in
front of my eyes!
fields.JP: ああ……大陽女様のお姿をこの目で……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaah! I can't believe I'm seeing
the grace of Lady Oohime right in
front of my eyes!

fields.EN:
Welcome to the Order of the Sun.
You are all our family. The sun
shines itself upon you.
fields.JP:
ようこそ、タイヨウへ……
今日からみんな、家族です。
お日様の光はみんなを照らしたがってます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Welcome to the Order of the Sun.
You are all our family. The sun
shines itself upon you.

fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN: Everyone, you've done well to make it this far alive. Lady Oohime knows all about how you kept your faith in the sun even while imprisoned.
fields.JP:
皆、よくぞ生きてここまで来られました。
囚われの中でも太陽への信仰を忘れずにいたことを
大陽女様は全てご存知でいらっしゃいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
We are happy to see you here. Lady
Oohime knows that you've all kept
your faith despite your trials.

fields.EN:
Join us now, and pray for the day
when the Sun God will burn that
which is shrouded above us.
fields.JP:
これからは我々とともに、太陽の神がこの天幕を
焼き落とす日を祈り待ちましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Join us now, and pray for the day
when the Sun God will burn that
which is shrouded above us.

fields.JP: ミチル様……ありがたや、ありがたや……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime... What grace...
What grace...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
They're the prisoners who just
escaped... They really did seem to
believe in the Order of the Sun...
fields.JP:
これは……さっきの牢獄から逃げてきた……
そういえば、タイヨウ教団の教えを信じてたっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're the prisoners who just
escaped... They really did seem to
believe in the Order of the Sun...

fields.EN:
I guess it's only natural to see
them here instead of in the city,
but...
fields.JP:
そうね。街ではなく、ここに来るのは当然のこと
なのかもしれないわね。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it's only natural to see
them here instead of in the city,
but...

fields.EN:
We didn't know about the Order of
the Sun until we came here, right?
fields.JP:
わたしたち、ここへ来るまでタイヨウ教団なんて
知らなかったわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't know about the Order of
the Sun until we came here, right?

fields.EN:
Yeah... Never heard about them or
their teachings before.
fields.JP:
……うん。太陽の神なんて教えも、聞いたこと
なかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Never heard about them or
their teachings before.

fields.EN:
Then how did they know about the
Order in such a faraway place,
like where they were imprisoned?
fields.JP:
それなのに何故、あんなに深いエリアにまで
教えが広まっていたのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then how did they know about the
Order in such a faraway place,
like where they were imprisoned?

fields.EN:
Maybe the Order began to
evangelize more after we came
here?
fields.JP:
僕らがここに来たあとに広まったってこと
なのかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe the Order began to
evangelize more after we came
here?

fields.EN:
I don't know... But there's
something unsettling about this
Order...
fields.JP:
わからないわ。
でも、この教団には……何かがある気がするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know... But there's
something unsettling about this
Order...

fields.EN:
I completely forgot to report
about the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
うん。そういえばナイトメアのこと、
報告し忘れたなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I completely forgot to report
about the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I think
everyone else forgot, too.
fields.JP:
そういえば……
わたしもだけれど、他の子たちも忘れてた
みたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I think
everyone else forgot, too.

fields.EN:
It might be important, so let me
go and report it now.
fields.JP:
……重要なことのような気がするし、
僕、報告してくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It might be important, so let me
go and report it now.

fields.JP: それなら、わたしも行くわ

fields.EN:
Alice? Have you ever felt this
before?
fields.JP: そういえば……アリスはこういうことってある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? Have you ever felt this
before?

fields.EN:
This urge to climb upward... Like,
there's something way above us
that I need to reach.
fields.JP:
……時々、なんだか強い衝動が湧くんだ。
塔を昇らなきゃ……ううん、昇りたいって。
昇れば何かあるような気がするって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This urge to climb upward... Like,
there's something way above us
that I need to reach.

fields.EN:
Is that what made you decide to
climb the tower before?
fields.JP:
……それで、あの塔を昇ってみる判断を
したというの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that what made you decide to
climb the tower before?

fields.EN:
Fortunately we made it out alive,
but I was prepared to never see
you again.
fields.JP:
結果的に救われたけれど、あの時はもう、
あなたと会えないかと思ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fortunately we made it out alive,
but I was prepared to never see
you again.

fields.EN: I'm sorry if I worried you...
fields.JP: 心配かけちゃって、ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry if I worried you...

fields.EN:
That's why I can relate to
Cinderella being so attached to
her earrings.
fields.JP:
だから……シンデレラのイヤリングへの執着も
何だかわかるような気がしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I can relate to
Cinderella being so attached to
her earrings.

fields.EN:
You know, I have this habit of
pushing meaningless arguments onto
others rather forcibly.
fields.JP:
わたし……時々、自分でも驚いてしまうような
きついことを……意味のない正論めいたことを
人に押し付けてしまう癖があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I have this habit of
pushing meaningless arguments onto
others rather forcibly.

fields.EN:
That's not true. You're just doing
your best to make the right
choices.
fields.JP:
気にしすぎだよ。
アリスは、正しい判断をしようと頑張って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. You're just doing
your best to make the right
choices.

fields.EN:
No. Hearing conversations without
a motive or a reason just seems to
bother me.
fields.JP:
いいえ、違うの。
話の道筋が見えないことや、筋が通らないことが
とても気になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Hearing conversations without
a motive or a reason just seems to
bother me.

fields.EN:
I kept thinking, maybe I'm just
hard-headed, but it felt a bit
like the urge you just mentioned.
fields.JP:
わたしが石頭なのだとばかり思っていたのだけれど、
あなたの言う衝動と、どこか似ているような
気がしたものだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept thinking, maybe I'm just
hard-headed, but it felt a bit
like the urge you just mentioned.

fields.EN:
Maybe this is the kind of trait
found in Blood Maidens, and
in your case, Blood Youths.
fields.JP:
……これも、血式少年や血式少女である、
特徴のひとつ、なのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe this is the kind of trait
found in Blood Maidens, and
in your case, Blood Youths.

fields.EN:
Maybe the others have similar
kinds of traits or attachments.
It may be good to think about.
fields.JP:
ひょっとしたら、他のみんなにもあるのかな？
……少し、考えてみようか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe the others have similar
kinds of traits or attachments.
It may be good to think about.

fields.EN:
I suppose. It could help us find
out who we really are.
fields.JP:
……ええ。そうね
わたしたちが何者なのか、もっとよくわかるのかも
しれないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. It could help us find
out who we really are.

fields.EN:
Whew, that was a close one...
I was about to crash into you!
fields.JP:
ふーっ。危なかった……
危うくぶつかるとこだったっす……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew, that was a close one...
I was about to crash into you!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I was talking to Alice
and wasn't paying attention.
fields.JP: ごめん。話に夢中になってて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I was talking to Alice
and wasn't paying attention.

fields.EN:
Prolly my fault! I just have a
knack for running into people!
fields.JP:
いやいやっす！
自分そそっかしくて、よく人にぶつかるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Prolly my fault! I just have a
knack for running into people!

fields.JP: ……で、お二人は何の話をしてたっすか？

fields.EN:
Well, we forgot to report
something to the Professor, so we
were going to go and see him.
fields.JP:
ああ……ちょっと博士たちに報告し忘れちゃった
ことがあってさ……
それ、伝えなきゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we forgot to report
something to the Professor, so we
were going to go and see him.

fields.EN:
Well, the Professor and the others
are talking hard stuff now. I
don't think they'll let ya in.
fields.JP:
それが博士たちみんな、難しい話に入っちゃった
んすよねー
だから今行っても、入れてもらえないっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the Professor and the others
are talking hard stuff now. I
don't think they'll let ya in.

fields.EN:
That's why I was gonna use this
chance to clean up my boss's work
room.
fields.JP:
それで自分、いまのうちに師匠の作業部屋を
片付けようかと思ったんす
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was gonna use this
chance to clean up my boss's work
room.

fields.EN:
Mmm... If I don't let them know, I
might forget about it...
fields.JP:
うーん……
話しておかないと、またうっかり忘れそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... If I don't let them know, I
might forget about it...

fields.EN:
Whoops! That's right! I need to go
and serve 'em all some tea.
fields.JP:
あー。でも、適当なとこでお茶出しもあるし……
段取りどうすっかなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoops! That's right! I need to go
and serve 'em all some tea.

fields.EN:
I know! Do you mind relaying a
message to them?
fields.JP:
そうだ、くらら。
それじゃ、伝言をお願いしてもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Do you mind relaying a
message to them?

fields.EN:
Huh?! Me?! I can't relay any hard
stuff, you hear?
fields.JP: え！？　自分、難しいことは無理っすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Me?! I can't relay any hard
stuff, you hear?

fields.EN:
Well, it's pretty simple. Can you
let them know that the Nightmare
we fought was able to speak?
fields.JP:
あ、ううん。簡単なことなんだけど……
実は、今日戦ったナイトメアが喋ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's pretty simple. Can you
let them know that the Nightmare
we fought was able to speak?

fields.JP:
ナイトメアがっすか……
へー。でも、そんなこともあるんすねー

fields.EN:
Yes. We were told before that the
Nightmares couldn't speak, so we
thought we needed to report this.
fields.JP:
ええ。今まで、ナイトメアは人語を話さないって
聞いていたから、伝えないとって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. We were told before that the
Nightmares couldn't speak, so we
thought we needed to report this.

fields.JP: 了解っす！　伝えておくっすよ！

fields.EN:
Nothing to it! Now then, if y'all
would excuse me!
fields.JP:
お安い御用っすよ！
それじゃ、自分はこれで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing to it! Now then, if y'all
would excuse me!

fields.EN: At least we can relax now.
fields.JP: でも、これで安心して休めるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: At least we can relax now.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Let's just head back to our
rooms.
fields.JP: うん。それじゃあ部屋に戻ろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Let's just head back to our
rooms.

fields.JP: じゃあ……おやすみ、アリス
今日は、いろいろあったよなあ……

fields.EN:
(A talking Nightmare... Kaguyahime's
past... The Order of the Sun...)
fields.JP:
（喋るナイトメアのことはもちろんだけど、
　かぐや姫の過去とか、タイヨウ教団とか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A talking Nightmare... Kaguya's
past... The Order of the Sun...)

fields.EN:
(Something new pops up each
time... Not that thinking about
it will do anything right now.)
fields.JP:
（ひとつわかったと思えば、更によくわからない
　ことが起きて……
　今考えても、仕方ないことだらけだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Something new pops up each
time... Not that thinking about
it will do anything right now.)

fields.EN:
(At least Kaguyahime is a lot closer
to everyone, so I guess that's
good.)
fields.JP:
（でも……かぐや姫、少しだけ歩み寄ってくれて
　よかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At least Kaguya is a lot closer
to everyone, so I guess that's
good.)

fields.EN:
The two birdies returned to their
nest.
fields.JP: 小鳥が二羽、巣に戻ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The two birdies returned to their
nest.

fields.EN:
Yes. They're going to bring the
light from the sun, right?
fields.JP: そうね。おひさまの光を運んでくれるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. They're going to bring the
light from the sun, right?

fields.EN:
I wonder which birdie will be the
first to reach it?
fields.JP: どの小鳥が一番先に、太陽に辿り着くんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder which birdie will be the
first to reach it?

fields.EN:
Looks like we have a lot of them
now. Do you have enough food for
them?
fields.JP:
みんなもたくさん集まってきたね
みんなのごはんは、足りてるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we have a lot of them
now. Do you have enough food for
them?

fields.EN:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew
and a fruit from the Tree of Life.
fields.JP:
君にも今日のごはんを運んできたよ。
森の朝露に、生命の木の実
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew
and a fruit from the Tree of Life.

fields.EN:
Go ahead. Eat and drink as you
normally do...
fields.JP: さあ、飲んでお食べ……いつものように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead. Eat and drink as you
normally do...

fields.JP:
よーし。
じゃあ『元繁華街エリア』、がんばろー！

fields.EN:
Heh! *pant* *pant* Excuse me for
being late!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ！
皆様！　お待ちあそばせ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh! *pant* *pant* Excuse me for
being late!

fields.EN:
Oh my, look at everyone! Behold!
I shall join you on your expedition!
fields.JP:
あらあら、お揃いですわね！
お喜びあそばせ！
このわたくしも同行して差し上げましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, look at everyone! Behold!
I shall join you on your expedition!

fields.EN:
(Huh? Isn't she the person I
bumped into earlier?)
fields.JP: （えっ？　この人確か、廊下で……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Isn't she the person I
bumped into earlier?)

fields.EN:
Cinderella! When did you get
back?!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ……！
あんたいつの間に戻ってたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella! When did you get
back?!

fields.EN:
(Cinderella-san? So she wasn't a maid,
then. Is she a Blood Maiden, too?)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラさんっていうのか……
　お掃除の人じゃなかったんだ。
　……この人も血式少女なのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella? So she wasn't a maid,
then. Is she a Blood Maiden, too?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Thank goodness you're alive... You
really shouldn't worry us like that...
fields.JP:
……生きてて……よかった……
あんまり、心配させないでください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness you're alive... You
really shouldn't worry us like that...

fields.EN:
She's right, Cinderella. We were
worried that you wouldn't
return...!
fields.JP:
その通りだよ、シンデレラ。
もう戻って来ないのではないかと、
それは心配していたのだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Cinderella. We were
worried that you wouldn't
return...!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... To be honest, I tried
to avoid thinking of you...
fields.JP:
ほんとだよ……あたし、ごめん。
実のところ、あんたのこと
あんまり考えないようにしてた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... To be honest, I tried
to avoid thinking of you...

fields.EN: Even though I kept telling myself you'd be okay, whenever I thought you might never come back... I felt like I wouldn't even be able to carry out the mission in front of me...
fields.JP:
あんたのことだから大丈夫って思っても、
もう帰ってこないかも……って思ったら、
目の前の作戦もこなせなくなりそうでさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I thought you'd be fine,
you may not have returned. I
needed to prioritize, and...

fields.EN: Anyway, I'm so glad you're back!
fields.JP: だから……また会えて、ほんとによかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, I'm so glad you're back!

fields.EN:
C-Come now. No need to make such a
fuss over it. I can defeat
Marchens by myself.
fields.JP:
そ……そんな……大げさですわ。
わたくしだってメルヒェン退治くらい
ちゃーんとできますのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Come now. No need to make such a
fuss over it. I can defeat
Marchens by myself.

fields.EN:
(So she is a Blood Maiden. Wait...
Are her eyes shifting colors...?)
fields.JP:
（そうか。この人も血式少女なんだ。
　でも……目の色が時々ピンク色に……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So she is a Blood Maiden. Wait...
Are her eyes shifting colors...?)

fields.EN:
Excuse me, but what's going on
here?
fields.JP: あの……話の流れが見えないのだけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, but what's going on
here?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Her name is Cinderella.
She's one of us.
fields.JP:
あ……ああ。
この子はシンデレラ。あたしたちの仲間なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Her name is Cinderella.
She's one of us.

fields.EN:
When I went to get you, she went
out on her own, and didn't return
for a long time.
fields.JP:
それが、アリスたちを迎えに行ってる間に、
独断で探索活動に向かったまま、
ずっと帰ってこなかったんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I went to get you, she went
out on her own, and didn't return
for a long time.

fields.EN:
We were worried about her because
we all assumed that she... you
know?
fields.JP:
だから……ひょっとしたらって、
みんな心配してたってわけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were worried about her because
we all assumed that she... you
know?

fields.EN: She went on her own?! Why?
fields.JP:
独断で……！？
何故、そんなことを……
fields.LOCALIZED: She went on her own?! Why?

fields.EN:
It couldn't be helped. The
Professor hadn't given me approval
to deploy.
fields.JP:
仕方ないではありませんの。
博士がわたくしの出撃を認めてくださらない
ものですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It couldn't be helped. The
Professor hadn't given me approval
to deploy.

fields.EN:
I wanted to demonstrate my
abilities so the Professor would
allow me to go out on missions.
fields.JP:
……わたくし、成果を示したかったんですわ。
そうすればきっと、博士も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to demonstrate my
abilities so the Professor would
allow me to go out on missions.

fields.EN:
Your abilities aren't important.
You should know that you came
back from sheer luck alone.
fields.JP:
成果どころじゃない……
あなたが戻ってこれたのは、僥倖に過ぎないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your abilities aren't important.
You should know that you came
back from sheer luck alone.

fields.EN:
Of all the...! Wait... Who are
you?!
fields.JP:
あ……あなた、初めて見る顔ですけど、
一体何なんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all the...! Wait... Who are
you?!

fields.EN:
Acting so high and mighty... I
doubt you know anything about us!
fields.JP:
偉そうに仰って下さいますけど、
いったい、わたくしたちの何を知って……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Acting so high and mighty... I
doubt you know anything about us!

fields.EN:
I do know. I know the danger of
entering Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
知っているわ。
……ブラッドスケルター化の恐怖を
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do know. I know the danger of
entering Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
She's Alice, and she's another
Blood Maiden like us.
fields.JP: アリスは、あたしたちと同じ血式少女なんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's Alice, and she's another
Blood Maiden like us.

fields.EN:
Cinderella, she's just saying that
because she's concerned about you,
so...
fields.JP:
シンデレラ。
アリスだって、あんたを思って言ったんだよ。
だからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, she's just saying that
because she's concerned about you,
so...

fields.EN:
I truly am sorry for any trouble
caused by my actions...
fields.JP:
……みなさんにご心配をおかけしたことは、
申し訳ありませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I truly am sorry for any trouble
caused by my actions...

fields.EN:
But... I wanted to show that I
could be of value here.
fields.JP:
でも……
わたくし本当に、役に立ちたかったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I wanted to show that I
could be of value here.

fields.EN:
(I know how she feels... What
she's going through must be
similar to what I went through...)
fields.JP:
（この子の気持ち、僕にもわかる気がする。
　僕もこの間まで、すごく焦ってた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know how she feels... What
she's going through must be
similar to what I went through...)

fields.EN:
That's fine, Cinderella. What's
important is that you're back here
alive.
fields.JP:
……もういいよ、シンデレラ。
君はこうして生きて戻ってきたのだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine, Cinderella. What's
important is that you're back here
alive.

fields.EN:
Even if I wanted to reprimand you,
it looks like Alice-kun already did
that for me.
fields.JP:
叱っておきたいことも、アリスくんが代わりに
言ってくれたしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I wanted to reprimand you,
it looks like Alice already did
that for me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun

fields.EN: I'm... sorry for saying all that.
fields.JP: ……その、出過ぎたことを言ってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm... sorry for saying all that.

fields.EN:
That's fine. It has more meaning
coming from you, versus the
guys who do nothing on the field.
fields.JP:
まあ、理屈だけこねてる俺たちより、
実際に体験した奴の言葉の方が重いだろ。
いいんじゃねえの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. It has more meaning
coming from you, versus the
guys who do nothing on the field.

fields.EN:
Um, I sort of understand
Cinderella-san's and Alice's
feelings...
fields.JP:
あの、僕……シンデレラさんの気持ちも
アリスの気持ちもわかる……と思うから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I sort of understand
Cinderella's and Alice's
feelings...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: I think everyone just wants to help someone and doesn't want to see their friends die... That's all...
fields.JP:
きっとみんな、誰かの役に立ちたいし、
仲間に死なれたくない……
それだけだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella wanted to help, and
Alice doesn't want anyone to die.

fields.EN:
Well... As I said earlier, I am
truly sorry.
fields.JP: ……その、ほんとにすみませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... As I said earlier, I am
truly sorry.

fields.EN:
Oh, and I returned quite a while
ago. I suppose it means something
that I had gone unnoticed.
fields.JP:
ところで……わたくし、ずいぶん前から戻って
ましたんですの。
わたくし、やっぱり影が薄いんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I returned quite a while
ago. I suppose it means something
that I had gone unnoticed.

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Hahaha... We had a lot
of stuff going on and we just got
caught in the flurry!
fields.JP:
あ……あはは！
いやまあちょっと色々あってさ、
バタバタしてたんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Hahaha... We had a lot
of stuff going on and we just got
caught in the flurry!

fields.EN:
And, what do you mean by "a lot of
stuff?"
fields.JP: 色々とは……何かあったんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, what do you mean by "a lot of
stuff?"

fields.EN:
What you just explained to me is
very difficult to fathom...
fields.JP: ……にわかに信じられないことばかりですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you just explained to me is
very difficult to fathom...

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised. It's actually
keeping us up at night, trying
to figure out what's happening.
fields.JP:
そうでしょうね。
おかげで私たちもずっと寝不足というわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised. It's actually
keeping us up at night, trying
to figure out what's happening.

fields.EN:
Jack? You had the Mary Gun fixed,
right? If Haru-san knows what he's doing,
the burden on you should be lighter, but...
fields.JP:
……ジャック。昨日メアリガンの調整をしたわね？
ハルさんの腕が確かなら、若干、体への負担は
軽くなったと思うけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? You had the Mary Gun fixed,
right? I'm sure the burden on you
is lighter now, but...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
Do you mind using it on her to
test it out?
fields.JP:
試し代わりにといっては何だけど、この子に
使ってみてもらえるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind using it on her to
test it out?

fields.EN:
Yes. From the looks of it, you
have a bit of Corruption built up.
Jack, would you?
fields.JP:
ええ。様子を見る限り、あなたには明らかに
穢れが溜まっているわ
……ジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. From the looks of it, you
have a bit of Corruption built up.
Jack, would you?

fields.JP: （やっぱり視子さんも気付いてたんだ）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP:
あ、あの……シンデレラさん。
……ちょっとすみません
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: I feel... a lot better now.
fields.JP:
……わたくし……
何だか気持ちがいきなり軽くなりましたわ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I feel... a lot better now.

fields.EN: Is this what Jack-san's blood does?
fields.JP: これが……ジャックさんの血の効果、ですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is this what Jack's blood does?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Yes... It's how I've been able to
revert back from Blood Skelter
all this time.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
おかげでわたしは、ブラッドスケルター化から
元に戻ることができたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... It's how I've been able to
revert back from Blood Skelter
all this time.

fields.EN:
This means that you can help us
from now on. I'm sorry to have
kept you waiting.
fields.JP:
……つまり、シンデレラ。
ずいぶん焦らせてしまったようだが、
君も今後は存分に活躍できるのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This means that you can help us
from now on. I'm sorry to have
kept you waiting.

fields.EN:
Yup! So no adventuring out on your
own like that again, okay?
fields.JP:
だからもう、
勝手に探索に行っちゃ駄目だからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! So no adventuring out on your
own like that again, okay?

fields.EN:
Um, why was Cinderella-san held back
from joining missions?
fields.JP:
あの。
シンデレラさんは、どうして今まで……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, why was Cinderella held back
from joining missions?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Well, Cinderella is an expert in
close-range combat, so she keeps
getting Marchen blood on her.
fields.JP:
あー。シンデレラの得意な戦い方は、
どっちかっていうと近接格闘戦なんだよ。
だから、メルヒェンの血をモロに浴びやすいわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Cinderella is an expert in
close-range combat, so she keeps
getting Marchen blood on her.

fields.EN: But now it's a worry of the past.
fields.JP: でも、もう心配は要らないですね……
fields.LOCALIZED: But now it's a worry of the past.

fields.EN:
I can't believe she wouldn't use
such a valid reason to slack off
from duty...
fields.JP:
堂々とサボる口実がありますのに、
勝手に働きたいなんて変わってます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe she wouldn't use
such a valid reason to slack off
from duty...

fields.JP: ……ジャックさん。お礼を言わせて頂きますわ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I was just doing what I could,
that's all...
fields.JP:
僕は……自分にできることを
しただけだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just doing what I could,
that's all...

fields.EN:
Um... Do you mind if I ask why you
were cleaning up when we first
met?
fields.JP:
あの……
そういえば、どうして掃除なんかしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Do you mind if I ask why you
were cleaning up when we first
met?

fields.EN:
Cleaning?! What in the world are
you thinking, not reporting to us
sooner?!
fields.JP:
……掃除！？
あんた報告もしないで、何やってんのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cleaning?! What in the world are
you thinking, not reporting to us
sooner?!

fields.EN:
W-Well, it's not my fault! It's
the dirt and grime that's to
blame!
fields.JP:
そ……それは……ここがあちこち汚いのが
いけないんですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, it's not my fault! It's
the dirt and grime that's to
blame!

fields.EN:
I was on my way back here to help
you all, but I couldn't bear
seeing how dirty the place was...
fields.JP:
やはり援軍が必要かと戻って参りましたら、
本部ときたら、それはもう埃だらけで……
綺麗にせずにはいられませんでしたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was on my way back here to help
you all, but I couldn't bear
seeing how dirty the place was...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry you had to do that. Come
to think of it, I don't think we'd
cleaned the place up in a while.
fields.JP:
……それは済まないことをしたね。
確かにこのところ、多くのことが起きていて
清掃が行き届いていなかったかもしれんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry you had to do that. Come
to think of it, I don't think we'd
cleaned the place up in a while.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
I'll check on our resources and
assign some people to help clean
the area.
fields.JP:
……本部の人員フローを見直して、清掃を
行き届かせるよう、手配します
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll check on our resources and
assign some people to help clean
the area.

fields.EN:
W-Well, I guess that's fine, but
next time, report back to us
first, all right?
fields.JP:
ま、まあさ、あんたの気持ちはわかるけど……
これからは先に報告してからにしてよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I guess that's fine, but
next time, report back to us
first, all right?

fields.EN:
Now then, let's get going! You
too, Cinderella-san!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ改めて……出発しましょう！
……シンデレラさんも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's get going! You
too, Cinderella!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Why, yes! My presence will surely
prove to be an asset to you all!
fields.JP:
ええ……！
わたくしが加わったからには、戦力倍増
でしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes! My presence will surely
prove to be an asset to you all!

fields.JP: あはは！　元気になったようだね！

fields.EN:
Now then, what does this place
hold for us?
fields.JP:
さーてと。
ここはどんな場所なことやら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, what does this place
hold for us?

fields.JP: やっぱり……気味が悪いですね……
（今日はジェイルは眠いみたいだ……）

fields.EN:
The Dawn already searched this
area a bit, right?
fields.JP: 黎明の調査は、ある程度入っているのよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Dawn already searched this
area a bit, right?

fields.EN:
Yup, but we should be careful
nonetheless.
fields.JP:
まあね。
でも、油断しないに越したことはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, but we should be careful
nonetheless.

fields.EN:
Especially with this tomboy on
our team.
fields.JP:
まして、こーんなじゃじゃ馬が一緒
なんだしねー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially with this tomboy on
our team.

fields.JP:
わたくし、じゃじゃ馬なんかじゃありません
ことよ！？

fields.EN:
How ironic that it comes from
Oyayubi...
fields.JP: 確かに親指に言われたくはないと思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How ironic that it comes from
Thumby...

fields.EN:
Huh?! Look who's talking, Princess
Lazy!
fields.JP:
は！？
グータラ姫にも言われたくないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Look who's talking, Princess
Lazy!

fields.EN:
With Jack-san here, there's no fear of
Blood Skelter. I can do anything
now!
fields.JP:
ジャックさんのおかげで、暴走を怖れずに
進めるいま……わたくしに不可能は
ありませんわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Jack here, there's no fear of
Blood Skelter. I can do anything
now!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Oh, um... Sure, if you say so...
fields.JP: あはは……お手柔らかにね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, um... Sure, if you say so...

fields.EN:
I thought they didn't appear close
to the entrance!
fields.JP: こんな入り口の近くじゃ、出てこない筈じゃ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought they didn't appear close
to the entrance!

fields.EN:
In any case, there's nothing we
can do about it now.
fields.JP: でも、出遭ってしまったものは仕方ないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, there's nothing we
can do about it now.

fields.EN:
Yup, let's just try and avoid it
somehow!
fields.JP:
ああ。
みんな……今はどうにかやり過ごすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, let's just try and avoid it
somehow!

fields.JP:
はあ……はあ……
どうにか振り切ったわね……

fields.EN:
I couldn't believe it appeared so
close to the entrance...
fields.JP: まさか……あんな場所で遭遇するなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't believe it appeared so
close to the entrance...

fields.JP: 疲れるからやめてほしいです～

fields.EN:
Well, it's good that everyone's
safe.
fields.JP: まあ……全員無事でよかったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's good that everyone's
safe.

fields.JP:
わたくし……
イヤリングを無くしてしまいましたわ……！

fields.EN: Oh, is that it? You scared me...
fields.JP:
何だ、びっくりした……
何が起きたのかと思ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, is that it? You scared me...

fields.EN:
B-But...! My earring! My shoe-
shaped, glass earring!
fields.JP:
で……でも……！
わたくしのイヤリングが……
ガラスの靴のイヤリングが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But...! My earring! My shoe-
shaped, glass earring!

fields.EN:
Well, we were running like heck
back there. Why don't you have
Haru-san make you a duplicate?
fields.JP:
……逃げるので精一杯だったしねー
でもさ、似たやつハルさんに作ってもらえば
いいんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we were running like heck
back there. Why don't you have
Haru make you a duplicate?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP:
そうですの……駄目なんですの……！
わたくし……わたくし……

fields.EN: Is it that precious to you?
fields.JP: そんなに大切なもの、なんだ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it that precious to you?

fields.EN:
Yes... Yes, it is! Without that,
I... I...
fields.JP:
ええ……そうなんですの……！
あれが無いと、わたくし……わたくし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Yes, it is! Without that,
I... I...

fields.EN:
Everyone, please...! Please find
my earring!
fields.JP:
皆さん、お願いしますわ……
どうか、イヤリングを探してくださいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, please...! Please find
my earring!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: Hmm. But... we don't know when we might run into another Nightmare, do we?
fields.JP:
うーん。でもさ……
いつまたナイトメアに出くわすか、
わかんない状況なんだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... But you know there's a
Nightmare on the lookout, right?

fields.EN:
What's the big deal about one
earring? We'll find it later,
so...
fields.JP:
ねえ、シンデレラ。
イヤリング一個無いから何だっていうのよ？
後で絶対探してあげるからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the big deal about one
earring? We'll find it later,
so...

fields.EN:
Not later! You wouldn't
understand! You've always been
cute, ever since the beginning!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、駄目なんですの！
所詮、最初から可愛いあなたには、
わたくしの気持ちなんてわからないんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not later! You wouldn't
understand! You've always been
cute, ever since the beginning!

fields.EN:
What do you mean "cute?!" I'm the
eldest of the three sisters, you
know?!
fields.JP:
……何それ。ていうか可愛いって何よ！
これでも姉妹の長女なんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean "cute?!" I'm the
eldest of the three sisters, you
know?!

fields.EN: Everyone's worried about you, so what's with that attitude?! Do you realize you're holding everyone back?!
fields.JP:
大体、みんなが心配してるのに、何なのその態度！
あんたみんなの足引っ張ってるのわかってんの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And what's with your attitude?!
This isn't the time or the place
to worry about that!

fields.EN:
S-Oyayubi-neesama, please! You
too, Cinderella-san! Please calm down!
fields.JP:
お、親指姉様……！
シンデレラさんも、落ち着いてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sister Thumbelina, please! You
too, Cinderella! Please calm down!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP:
わ……わたくしのことなんか、もう見捨てて
くださいまし！

fields.EN:
I'm useless and unsightly! I'm no
different from scum now! I don't
deserve to live!
fields.JP:
役立たずで醜いわたくしなんか、クズ同然ですわ！
生きている価値なんて無いんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm useless and unsightly! I'm no
different from scum now! I don't
deserve to live!

fields.EN:
Hah! You're right about the
useless part, especially with the
way you're acting now!
fields.JP:
はん……あんたのそういうとこ、
確かに役立たずかもしれないわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hah! You're right about the
useless part, especially with the
way you're acting now!

fields.JP: ちょっと親指。落ち着きなって……

fields.EN:
There's no such thing as
"deserving to live."
fields.JP: 生きている価値が無い人なんて、いないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no such thing as
"deserving to live."

fields.EN:
Everyone has something they rely
on.
fields.JP:
それに……自分を支えてくれるものは
誰にだってある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone has something they rely
on.

fields.EN:
I'm sure everyone has something
they hold close...
fields.JP:
きっと……
自分だけのこだわりは、誰でも持っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure everyone has something
they hold close...

fields.EN:
That said, we're risking death
searching for your earring without
first learning about this area.
fields.JP:
でも……この場所をよく知らないままでは、
わたしたちはイヤリングを見つけるどころか
全滅してしまうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, we're risking death
searching for your earring without
first learning about this area.

fields.JP: 全滅……わたくしのせいで、全滅……ですの

fields.EN:
How about we explore the area and
search for your earring at the
same time?
fields.JP:
だから……この中を調査しながら、
イヤリングを探す……
それならどうかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we explore the area and
search for your earring at the
same time?

fields.EN:
W-Well, I suppose that would
work...
fields.JP:
ま……まあ、そういうことなら
仕方ないんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I suppose that would
work...

fields.EN:
For having no facial expressions
at all, you're surprisingly sweet.
fields.JP:
アリスもさ、いっつも澄ました顔してるくせに
意外と甘いんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
For having no facial expressions
at all, you're surprisingly sweet.

fields.EN:
It's just because I can relate to
Cinderella-san...
fields.JP:
わたしも……シンデレラさんの気持ちが
わかる気がするだけよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just because I can relate to
Cinderella...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
W-Well, it's not like I don't
understand her feelings at all,
you know?
fields.JP:
ま、まあ……わたしだって、
わからないとは言わないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, it's not like I don't
understand her feelings at all,
you know?

fields.EN:
True... Shirayuki can relate as
well...
fields.JP: そうですね……白雪もわかります……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... Snow White can relate as
well...

fields.EN:
If I could find an easy way out of
all this, I would.
fields.JP: わらわは楽をしたいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I could find an easy way out of
all this, I would.

fields.EN:
Well, it's not like I can say
much, either.
fields.JP: まあ……あたしも実際、人のこと言えないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's not like I can say
much, either.

fields.EN:
Okay, so we'll search the area and
keep an eye out for her earring.
Is that all right, Cinderella?
fields.JP:
それじゃ、ここを探索しながら探す。
……シンデレラ、それでいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, so we'll search the area and
keep an eye out for her earring.
Is that all right, Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Why, of course! Um, thank you...
Thank you so very much...
fields.JP:
……もちろんでしてよ！
その、ありがとうございます……
本当に、ありがとうございます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, of course! Um, thank you...
Thank you so very much...

fields.EN:
If we're gonna do this, we'll need
you to stay sharp, got it? Let's
go!
fields.JP:
じゃあまず、あんたもしゃっきりすることね。
……行くわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're gonna do this, we'll need
you to stay sharp, got it? Let's
go!

fields.EN:
It's not here... I can't find it
anywhere!
fields.JP: ない……どこにもありませんわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not here... I can't find it
anywhere!

fields.JP: わたくしの……イヤリング……

fields.EN:
Cinderella-san... We're still
searching, so I'm sure we'll find
it!
fields.JP:
シンデレラさん……これだけ探してるんだ。
きっと、見つかるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella... We're still
searching, so I'm sure we'll find
it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
It will be fine! Shirayuki will
do her best to find it!
fields.JP:
大丈夫です。見つかります！
白雪たち、もっともっと探しますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It will be fine! Snow White will
do her best to find it!

fields.EN:
This is why I had everyone else
do the searching for me...
fields.JP:
まあ宝物は、
探すより探させる方が好きですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is why I had everyone else
do the searching for me...

fields.JP: それ、あんただけだから……

fields.EN:
Well, if we finish what we have
to do first, then we can look for
it as long as we want.
fields.JP:
まあ、ほんとは用事を済ましてから、
ゆっくり探すべきなんだろうけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if we finish what we have
to do first, then we can look for
it as long as we want.

fields.EN:
True... There's no telling when
the Nightmare will appear again.
fields.JP:
……確かに、いつまたナイトメアと
遭遇するかはわからないものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... There's no telling when
the Nightmare will appear again.

fields.EN:
It seems as if I'm simply a
burden to you all... I am truly
sorry...
fields.JP:
わたくし……
結局足手まといですわね……
すみません、ですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if I'm simply a
burden to you all... I am truly
sorry...

fields.EN:
Oh, come on, now! If you really
think so, then give us a break
and stop pouting already.
fields.JP:
も……もう！
そう思ったら、ちょっとはしゃっきり
しなさいよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on, now! If you really
think so, then give us a break
and stop pouting already.

fields.JP: あんた、いつもの自信はどうしたのよ！？

fields.EN:
It's no use... I can't seem to get
a hold of myself...
fields.JP:
駄目なんですの……
どうしてか、駄目なんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use... I can't seem to get
a hold of myself...

fields.EN:
I think I know how you feel. After
all, I'd probably feel the same
way if I lost my hood.
fields.JP:
ま……まあさ、あたしもフードが無いと
すっごく不安になるからさ。
あんたの気持ちはわかると思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I know how you feel. After
all, I'd probably feel the same
way if I lost my hood.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
But unlike before, you have
everyone here with you now, so
it'll be all right.
fields.JP:
でもさ。今はみんなついてるんだ。
あんたは大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But unlike before, you have
everyone here with you now, so
it'll be all right.

fields.EN:
That's right, Cinderella-san. You have
to get yourself feeling better
first.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、シンデレラさん。
まず君が元気を出さなきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Cinderella. You have
to get yourself feeling better
first.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san
Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san
Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ジャックさん！　大丈夫ですか！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
あ……ありがとう！
助けてくれたんだ……

fields.EN:
I can't believe it snuck up on us
from behind! Let's hurry and get
away from it, now!
fields.JP:
……背後を取られるなんて、油断したよ！
みんな……いまのうちに退くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe it snuck up on us
from behind! Let's hurry and get
away from it, now!

fields.EN:
My earring... I found it! It's over
there!
fields.JP:
イヤリング……ありましたわ！
そこ……そこに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My earring... I found it! It's over
there!

fields.EN:
There...? It's stuck on the
Nightmare!?
fields.JP:
そこって……
ナイトメアに引っかかってる……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There...? It's stuck on the
Nightmare!?

fields.EN: N-No! You can't face it yet!
fields.JP: だ、駄目です！　今は無理です！
fields.LOCALIZED: N-No! You can't face it yet!

fields.JP: 無理なんかじゃありませんわ……！
無理なんだってば！　わからず屋！

fields.EN:
It's no good! It's going to
attack!
fields.JP: 駄目だ！　襲ってくる……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no good! It's going to
attack!

fields.EN:
I guess it can't be helped. Looks
like we'll have to escape the hard
way!
fields.JP:
仕方ない。いちかばちか……隙を突いて
逃げるしかないね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it can't be helped. Looks
