like we'll have to escape the hard
way!

fields.EN:
*huff* *huff* Looks like we were
able to get away again...
fields.JP:
はあ……はあ……
今度もどうにか逃げられたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*huff* *huff* Looks like we were
able to get away again...

fields.EN:
At least we're all getting a good
leg workout...
fields.JP: 逃げ足が鍛えられそうですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least we're all getting a good
leg workout...

fields.EN:
Um... But you're riding on Bamboo
One, Kaguya...
fields.JP:
ふふ……かぐやさんはバンブー一号に
乗ってるじゃないですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... But you're riding on Bamboo
One, Kaguya...

fields.EN:
That Nightmare... It's as if it
was toying with us.
fields.JP:
あのナイトメア……わたしたちを
いたぶってるみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare... It's as if it
was toying with us.

fields.EN:
That's possible... Under normal
circumstances, we really wouldn't
be able to escape so many times.
fields.JP:
……言えてるね……
普通だったら、こんなに何度も逃げられる筈が
ないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's possible... Under normal
circumstances, we really wouldn't
be able to escape so many times.

fields.EN:
W-Well, if that is the case, I
should be able to strike it with
ease!
fields.JP:
そ……それなら……
その余裕に一撃かましてやりますわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if that is the case, I
should be able to strike it with
ease!

fields.EN:
I know where the earring is now.
All that needs to be done is to
defeat it and get it back.
fields.JP:
イヤリングの在処はわかったんですもの。
あいつを倒して、取り返すまでですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know where the earring is now.
All that needs to be done is to
defeat it and get it back.

fields.EN:
You're still talking about that
earring?!
fields.JP: あんた、まだそんなこと言ってんの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're still talking about that
earring?!

fields.EN:
Yes, but I feel much better now!
I'm sorry for the trouble I caused
earlier.
fields.JP:
みなさま、ご迷惑をおかけしましたわ……！
わたくし……ようやく気持ちが落ち着いたん
ですの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but I feel much better now!
I'm sorry for the trouble I caused
earlier.

fields.EN:
If you would, please tell me what
I should do in order to defeat it!
fields.JP:
あいつを倒すために……
みなさまのご指示に従いますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you would, please tell me what
I should do in order to defeat it!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
You better not forget what you
just said, Cinderella!
fields.JP: シンデレラ。その言葉、忘れないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You better not forget what you
just said, Cinderella!

fields.EN:
Change in plans! First, let's find
the core and break it!
fields.JP:
作戦行動、切り替え！
まずはこのエリアの核を探して、
そいつを叩くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Change in plans! First, let's find
the core and break it!

fields.EN:
We'll face the Nightmare after
that. Got it?!
fields.JP: ナイトメアは……それからだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll face the Nightmare after
that. Got it?!

fields.EN: So, this is what a core is?
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is what a core is?

fields.EN:
Pretty eerie when you first see
it, right?
fields.JP: 初めて見ると、なかなか気持ち悪いものですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pretty eerie when you first see
it, right?

fields.EN:
Yes... But if we can destroy it,
the Nightmare will become
vulnerable and we can defeat it!
fields.JP:
ええ。そしてこの核を破壊すれば、
ナイトメアを倒すことができるの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... But if we can destroy it,
the Nightmare will become
vulnerable and we can defeat it!

fields.EN:
If so, let us hurry and do our
duty!
fields.JP:
それなら……早いに越したことは
ありませんわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, let us hurry and do our
duty!

fields.EN:
But... there's also a guardian
that protects the core.
fields.JP: でも……核には番人がいます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... there's also a guardian
that protects the core.

fields.EN:
Nothing to it! We'll just have to
get rid of it.
fields.JP: そんなもの、とっとと片付けちゃえばいいのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing to it! We'll just have to
get rid of it.

fields.EN:
What timing. Looks like we've got
company...
fields.JP: ほーら。おいでなすった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What timing. Looks like we've got
company...

fields.EN:
Everyone! Don't let your guard
down!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Don't let your guard
down!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Surprised you, didn't
it? For some reason, the Jail
screams when you destroy a core.
fields.JP:
あはは。びっくりした？
核を壊すと、何故かジェイルは悲鳴を
上げるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Surprised you, didn't
it? For some reason, the Jail
screams when you destroy a core.

fields.JP: そ……そういえば、そうでしたわね

fields.EN:
Now we can wrap this up by making
your wish come true.
fields.JP:
でも、これで……
ようやくあんたの念願が叶うってわけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can wrap this up by making
your wish come true.

fields.EN:
We're going to beat that monster
and get your earring back!
fields.JP:
だから……！
あいつを倒して、大事なものを取り返せるん
じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to beat that monster
and get your earring back!

fields.JP: （そんな、照れなくてもいいのに……）

fields.EN:
Oh, my! So, now we can defeat that
Nightmare!
fields.JP:
え……ええ！
これで……ナイトメアを倒せますのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my! So, now we can defeat that
Nightmare!

fields.EN:
Looks like you're all ready and
willing.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're all ready and
willing.

fields.EN:
If you were just about to get your
treasure back, you'd feel the
same way, too.
fields.JP:
あんたも自分の手で宝物を取りに行けば、
きっとわかるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were just about to get your
treasure back, you'd feel the
same way, too.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and hunt us a
Nightmare!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、いっちょナイトメア探しに
行きますか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and hunt us a
Nightmare!

fields.EN:
My earring! Thank goodness... It's
still there.
fields.JP:
わたくしのイヤリング……！
よかった……まだ無事でしたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My earring! Thank goodness... It's
still there.

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Don't you worry! Now, then! Let's
do this!
fields.JP:
わかってる！
みんな！　やるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry! Now, then! Let's
do this!

fields.EN:
Yes... It is time to return what
rightly belongs to me!
fields.JP: ええ……返していただきますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... It is time to return what
rightly belongs to me!

fields.JP: キィィィァァアアアア！！
恨まないでくださいまし！
キィィィァァアアアア……
このナイトメア、まさか……

fields.EN:
(It's... speaking into a square
object near its mouth...)
fields.JP:
（何か四角いものを口の傍に……
　それに向かって喋ってる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's... speaking into a square
object near its mouth...)

fields.JP: ジャックさん……無茶はやめてください！！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Jack... Jack! Are you all right?!
fields.JP: ジャック……ジャック、無事なの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack... Jack! Are you all right?!

fields.EN:
Here... Cinderella-san. Your earring
is... safe and sound...
fields.JP:
はい。シンデレラさん……
イヤリング、壊れずに済んだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here... Cinderella. Your earring
is... safe and sound...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.JP: ジャックさん……どうして……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
You... said it was something
precious to you...
fields.JP: だって……君の大事な物じゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You... said it was something
precious to you...

fields.EN:
(Oh, yeah... Where's that thing
the Nightmare dropped?)
fields.JP:
（そういえば……さっきナイトメアが落とした
　四角いものは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, yeah... Where's that thing
the Nightmare dropped?)

fields.JP: （……ばらばらになっちゃったみたいだ……）
（それに……確かにスナークって…………）

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Jack! Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP: ジャック！　しっかりして……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! Get a hold of yourself!

fields.EN:
(Miko-san...? So I'm back at the
Dawn...?)
fields.JP: （視子さん……？　じゃあここは、黎明の……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Miko...? So I'm back at the
Dawn...?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: ジャックさん……よかった……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I'm so glad you're awake. I
wouldn't have forgiven myself if
something worse happened...
fields.JP:
もう目を覚まさなかったら……
わたくし、どうしようって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so glad you're awake. I
wouldn't have forgiven myself if
something worse happened...

fields.EN:
You're overreacting, Cinderella.
Jack wasn't hurt that badly.
fields.JP:
……大げさよ、シンデレラ。
ジャックの怪我の方は、たいしたことはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're overreacting, Cinderella.
Jack wasn't hurt that badly.

fields.EN:
But... his face... It was so
pale...
fields.JP: でも……あんなに顔色が真っ白で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... his face... It was so
pale...

fields.EN:
He's just anemic, that's all.
We've patched him up, so all he
needs to do now is rest.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。ただの貧血よ。
処置も済ませたし、彼の体質ならしばらく休めば
起きあがれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's just anemic, that's all.
We've patched him up, so all he
needs to do now is rest.

fields.EN: I see... That's good to hear.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... That's good to hear.

fields.EN:
(How pathetic... They carried me
back here again...?)
fields.JP:
（僕……また運び込まれたのか……
　情けないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How pathetic... They carried me
back here again...?)

fields.EN:
Um... Were you watching over me
this whole time? If so, thanks...
fields.JP:
あの……
ひょっとして、ずっと看病しててくれたの？
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Were you watching over me
this whole time? If so, thanks...

fields.EN:
Um, well... Yes, I suppose... Um,
let me go and get Alice-san!
fields.JP:
え……ええ、まあ……
あの、アリスさん、呼んできますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... Yes, I suppose... Um,
let me go and get Alice!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
She's quite sensitive and knows
how to read the room.
fields.JP: あの子、そんなに野暮な子じゃないと思うわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's quite sensitive and knows
how to read the room.

fields.EN: Wh-What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: ど、どういうことですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wh-What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
I heard what happened. I'm
guessing you stayed here so you
could give your thanks, right?
fields.JP:
何があったのかは聞いたわ。
あなた、彼にお礼が言いたくて付き添ってたん
でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard what happened. I'm
guessing you stayed here so you
could give your thanks, right?

fields.EN:
Why did you protect my earring
like that? It wasn't worth risking
your life, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
どうして、ナイトメアの下敷きになってまで、
イヤリングを守ってくれたんですの……？
ジャックさんの命には、代えられませんのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you protect my earring
like that? You could have died
from the Nightmare falling on you.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
You see, I have this urge to
climb up the Tower...
fields.JP:
実は僕にも、変な衝動みたいなものがあるんだ。
……わけもなく、塔に昇りたいっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see, I have this urge to
climb up the Tower...

fields.EN:
It's an urge that's different from
wanting to escape from here...
fields.JP:
それは……脱出したい気持ちとはまた別って
いうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's an urge that's different from
wanting to escape from here...

fields.EN:
That's why I could relate to you
wanting your earring back. I just
wanted to get it back for you.
fields.JP:
だから……君がイヤリングが無いと、どうしても
不安でたまらなくなる気持ち、わかる気が
するんだ……だから、放っておけなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I could relate to you
wanting your earring back. I just
wanted to get it back for you.

fields.EN:
I haven't asked everyone yet, but
I'm sure they all have something
they're really attached to.
fields.JP:
全員に聞いたわけじゃないけど、他のみんなにも
そういうこだわりみたいなものがあるんじゃ
ないかって、思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't asked everyone yet, but
I'm sure they all have something
they're really attached to.

fields.EN:
So if everyone has something like
that, you shouldn't worry about it
at all, Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
だから、シンデレラさんは気にしないで
いいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if everyone has something like
that, you shouldn't worry about it
at all, Cinderella.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.JP: その……『シンデレラ』で構いませんわ

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I truly appreciate what
you have done! Now then, if you'll
excuse me!
fields.JP:
それでも……やっぱり、感謝しますわ！
それでは、ごめんあそばせ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I truly appreciate what
you have done! Now then, if you'll
excuse me!

fields.EN:
Just a thought, but one day, one
of the girls is probably going to
stab you...
fields.JP:
あなた、
いつかあの子たちの誰かに刺されるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a thought, but one day, one
of the girls is probably going to
stab you...

fields.EN:
Ever since you joined, a lot of
things have happened outside of
our plans to escape.
fields.JP:
あなたが加わってから、いろいろなものが
動き始めたと思うわ。
脱出計画はもちろんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since you joined, a lot of
things have happened outside of
our plans to escape.

fields.EN:
The girls are coming together
nicely. Their teamwork is much
better than before.
fields.JP:
ばらばらだった、あの子たちの関係もね。
いいチームになってきたと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The girls are coming together
nicely. Their teamwork is much
better than before.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure if you're implying
that I'm helping, but if so, thank
you...
fields.JP:
僕のせいなのかはわからないけど、それなら
嬉しいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure if you're implying
that I'm helping, but if so, thank
you...

fields.EN:
Okay, we're done. Your vitals
check out fine. You're free to go
back to your room.
fields.JP:
はい。検査終わり。
血圧も脈拍も、もう問題無いわ。
部屋に戻って大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, we're done. Your vitals
check out fine. You're free to go
back to your room.

fields.JP: ゆっくり休んで、体力を回復なさい
……ありがとうございます、視子さん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(I can't seem to stand up
straight... I feel a bit dizzy...)
fields.JP:
（体に力が入らない……
　なんだか……フワフワした感じがする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't seem to stand up
straight... I feel a bit dizzy...)

fields.EN:
Hey, there. Get it together, kid.
You're all wobbly.
fields.JP:
おいおい……
しっかりしろよ、小僧。
足元がフラついてるぞ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, there. Get it together, kid.
You're all wobbly.

fields.EN:
I heard you fell or something. Are
you okay?
fields.JP:
聞いたぞ。
ひっくり返ったんだって？
もう、平気なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard you fell or something. Are
you okay?

fields.JP: はい。ご心配をおかけしました

fields.EN:
You need to eat and stay healthy.
Well, not that there's much to eat
here. Hahaha!
fields.JP:
元々おまえは細っこいからなあ……
日頃からガッツリ食っとかないと、もたないぞ。
まあ、ロクな食いモンもないけどな！　ははは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to eat and stay healthy.
Well, not that there's much to eat
here. Hahaha!

fields.EN:
Whoa! Just a second. Looks like I
got a call.
fields.JP:
……おおっと！
ちょっと待ってくれ、連絡が入ったみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Just a second. Looks like I
got a call.

fields.EN:
Hello? Kadowaki here. I can hear
you loud and clear.
fields.JP:
あー、もしもし！
こちら門脇……感度良好です！
どうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello? Kadowaki here. I can hear
you loud and clear.

fields.EN:
Yes... Everything is fine....
Roger that!
fields.JP:
ええ、異常なしです。
……了解です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Everything is fine....
Roger that!

fields.EN:
Sorry to cut you off there. So...
What were we talking about
again?
fields.JP:
悪いな、急な連絡で。
で、何の話だったっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to cut you off there. So...
What were we talking about
again?

fields.JP: 門脇さん、なんですか……それ？

fields.EN: You mean this? It's a transceiver.
fields.JP:
ああ、これかい？
トランシーバーだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean this? It's a transceiver.

fields.EN:
You don't know, eh? Well, it's a
communication device used to
speak with others far away.
fields.JP:
そうか……お前らは知らなくても当然か。
一言で言えば……まあ……無線通話機だな。
離れた相手と通話することができるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know, eh? Well, it's a
communication device used to
speak with others far away.

fields.EN:
Wow... That's amazing! Can you use
it anywhere?
fields.JP:
へえ……すごいですね！
それって、どこでも使えるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... That's amazing! Can you use
it anywhere?

fields.EN:
Sure thing! You can pretty much
use it anywhere in the Jail!
fields.JP: ああ、たとえば独房エリアだって楽勝さ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing! You can pretty much
use it anywhere in the Jail!

fields.EN:
That must be useful. Maybe it
could be used during battle, too.
fields.JP:
いいですね。
戦闘でも役に立ちそうだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must be useful. Maybe it
could be used during battle, too.

fields.EN: Huh? Ah, did I get your hopes up? Sorry, but this is extremely valuable.
fields.JP:
ん？　あー、期待させちゃったかな。
悪い、これは大変な貴重品なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, but this is a really
important device, and we have to
be very careful with it.

fields.EN:
We don't have many of these at
the Dawn. Can't risk getting one
broken during battle, you know?
fields.JP:
黎明にも、もう何台も残ってないからな。
戦闘で壊されたらたまらないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have many of these at
the Dawn. Can't risk getting one
broken during battle, you know?

fields.EN: I see... I guess you're right.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... I guess you're right.

fields.EN:
And, look! Another call! Hahaha!
Must be a sign for me to quit
talking.
fields.JP:
……おっ！
また連絡が入ったみたいだ。
ははは！　無駄話はやめろってことかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, look! Another call! Hahaha!
Must be a sign for me to quit
talking.

fields.EN: Oh, then... If you'll excuse me.
fields.JP:
あ、それじゃ……
僕はこれで……失礼します
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, then... If you'll excuse me.

fields.EN:
Sorry to have you leave like this.
Well, take care and see you
again!
fields.JP:
あぁ、悪いな……気を遣わせて。
それじゃあ、またな！
気をつけてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to have you leave like this.
Well, take care and see you
again!

fields.EN:
(That strange sound... was from
the transceiver... I'm pretty sure
I heard it somewhere before...)
fields.JP:
（さっきの変な……トランシーバーの音……
　やっぱりどこかで聞いた気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That strange sound... was from
the transceiver... I'm pretty sure
I heard it somewhere before...)

fields.EN:
(It's... speaking into a square
object near its mouth...)
fields.JP:
（何か四角いものを口の傍に……
　それに向かって喋ってる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's... speaking into a square
object near its mouth...)

fields.EN:
(That sounds like the sound I
heard when we defeated the
Nightmare... The shape is also...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアを倒したときに聞こえた音に
　似てる……それにあの形……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That sounds like the sound I
heard when we defeated the
Nightmare... The shape is also...)

fields.EN:
(Could it be that the Nightmare
was using...)
fields.JP:
（もしかして……
　あの時、ナイトメアが持っていたのは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Could it be that the Nightmare
was using...)

fields.EN:
(I've been getting into a bad
habit of linking everything to the
Marchens and the Nightmares...)
fields.JP:
（最近……どんなことでも……
　メルヒェンや……ナイトメアに、
　結びつけて考えちゃうみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've been getting into a bad
habit of linking everything to the
Marchens and the Nightmares...)

fields.EN:
A-Alice...? Thanks... I was about
to fall there...
fields.JP:
ア……アリス。
ありがとう……転ぶところだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Alice...? Thanks... I was about
to fall there...

fields.EN:
I knew it was the right idea to
look for you. Cinderella told me
you woke up.
fields.JP:
……迎えに来てみて、よかったわ。
あなたが意識を取り戻したって、
シンデレラが教えてくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it was the right idea to
look for you. Cinderella told me
you woke up.

fields.EN: I'm sorry if I made you worry...
fields.JP: 心配かけちゃって、ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry if I made you worry...

fields.EN:
Don't worry about it... Let's just
head back. You should rest.
fields.JP:
いいえ。いいのよ……
今日は、早く休んだほうがいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry about it... Let's just
head back. You should rest.

fields.EN:
I still feel a bit dizzy... I'd
better go to sleep...
fields.JP:
やっぱりくらくらする……
早く寝よう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still feel a bit dizzy... I'd
better go to sleep...

fields.EN:
(I'm pretty sure that the
Nightmare said, "Snark"...)
fields.JP:
（あのとき確かにナイトメアは
　『スナーク』って口にした……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm pretty sure that the
Nightmare said, "Snark"...)

fields.EN:
(If that Nightmare was using a
"transceiver" thing, that
means...)
fields.JP:
（……もしあのナイトメアが持っていたのが
　トランシーバーだったとしたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If that Nightmare was using a
"transceiver" thing, that
means...)

fields.JP: おはようございます……え？
ミチルさんに……陽司さん……？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN: I'm just as surprised as you are.
fields.JP: あたしも来てみてびっくりしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm just as surprised as you are.

fields.EN:
But... Shirayuki is happy to see
onee-sama-tachi.
fields.JP: でも……お姉様たちと会えて、白雪は嬉しいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is happy to see our
dear sister and brother again.
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
It's not often we go to the Order
of the Sun, so it's great to see
them here!
fields.JP:
なんだかんだ忙しくて、なかなかタイヨウの方に
顔出せないし……こんな機会でもないとね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not often we go to the Order
of the Sun, so it's great to see
them here!

fields.EN:
I mean, we could go there, but
doing that would scare the
believers.
fields.JP: ま、信者さんたち怖がらせてもまずいしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, we could go there, but
doing that would scare the
believers.

fields.EN:
(So the three of them don't go
there because of that?)
fields.JP:
（三人とも、
　気にしてて訪ねてなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So the three of them don't go
there because of that?)

fields.EN:
Come by anytime. Michiru-sama
would love to see you three. You
were all raised there, you know?
fields.JP:
君たちが良ければ、訪ねて来てくれ。
ミチル様の気晴らしにもなるだろうし、
何より君たちが育った場所なのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come by anytime. Lady Michiru
would love to see you three. You
were all raised there, you know?
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ミチル様 => Michiru-sama (remove localized English title)

fields.EN:
Yes. Everyone is welcome to come
by!
fields.JP:
うん。いつでもきてね。
ほかのみんなも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Everyone is welcome to come
by!

fields.JP: はいっ！　お姉様、お兄様……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, dear sister, dear
brother!
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Guess it's like going back home,
then.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess it's like going back home,
then.

fields.EN:
It's nice to have a place to go
home to...
fields.JP: ……帰れる場所があるというのは、いいことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nice to have a place to go
home to...

fields.EN:
True. Of course for us, this is
the place we call home now...
fields.JP:
……そうですわね。もっとも、わたくしたちに
とっては、ここがそうですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. Of course for us, this is
the place we call home now...

fields.EN:
I'd rather not move one inch from
here...
fields.JP: わらわはここから一歩も動きたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd rather not move one inch from
here...

fields.EN:
Too bad that's not going to
happen. Isn't that right, Dad?
fields.JP:
そういうわけにはいかないなあ。
……ね、お父さん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad that's not going to
happen. Isn't that right, Dad?

fields.EN:
Indeed. After all, I need you to
go and investigate a particular
area for me.
fields.JP:
ああ。これから、ある独房エリアの調査に
向かってもらいたいのでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. After all, I need you to
go and investigate a particular
area for me.

fields.EN:
We've received a special work
order from none other than these
two here.
fields.JP: 実は、こちらのお二人からの調査依頼があってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've received a special work
order from none other than these
two here.

fields.EN:
Ah! So, that's why they're here
today...!
fields.JP:
何でこの人たちがここにいるのかと思いましたら、
そういうわけだったんですのね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! So, that's why they're here
today...!

fields.EN:
It looks like there's a strange
rumor about a particular area.
Hitsuka-san?
fields.JP:
……何でも、ある独房エリアについて、
奇妙な噂が流れているそうなんだ。
……陽司さん。説明を頼みますよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like there's a strange
rumor about a particular area.
Hitsuka?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
Very well... We've heard strange
rumors about two different areas.
fields.JP:
では……。
これは、二箇所の独房エリアでの不可思議な事象
なのですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well... We've heard strange
rumors about two different areas.

fields.EN:
There are children wandering
around the labyrinth... Waiting
to be found...
fields.JP:
迷宮の中で彷徨う子たちがいるの……
あの子たちは、見つけてもらうのを待ってる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are children wandering
around the labyrinth... Waiting
to be found...

fields.EN:
We came here to discuss this,
assuming it was something that
should be shared with you.
fields.JP:
……このように大陽女様の御言葉により、
こちらへご相談すべき内容ではないかと
判断したのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here to discuss this,
assuming it was something that
should be shared with you.

fields.EN:
To be honest, the way he thinks
still kinda bothers me...
fields.JP: ……こういうとこが正直、馴染めないんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, the way he thinks
still kinda bothers me...

fields.EN: C'mon, don't let it bother ya.
fields.LOCALIZED: C'mon, don't let it bother ya.

fields.EN: Let me explain the rumors I heard.
fields.JP: 噂の内容というのは、このようなものです
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me explain the rumors I heard.

fields.EN:
First, there's a rumor of a girl
walking with a Nightmare in the
Dorm area.
fields.JP:
一つは、『旧学生街エリア』にて、ナイトメアと
連れ立って歩く少女の姿を見たと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, there's a rumor of a girl
walking with a Nightmare in the
Dorm area.

fields.EN:
A Nightmare?! You've gotta be
kidding!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアと！？
そんな馬鹿なことってあるわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare?! You've gotta be
kidding!

fields.EN: And the Old Student District... Didn't Father say that investigation teams had repeatedly gone missing there in the past?!
fields.JP:
しかも『旧学生街エリア』っていったら、
過去に調査隊が何度も行方不明になってるって
お父さん、言ってなかったっけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad? Isn't the Dorm where we lost
some members that were sent in to
investigate the place?

fields.EN:
Yes. And those who returned said
they hit a dead end, so we stopped
our exploration of that area.
fields.JP:
ああ。行方不明者が後を絶たず、戻れた者も
何故か先へは進めないと言うのでね。
いったん調査を打ち切った場所なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. And those who returned said
they hit a dead end, so we stopped
our exploration of that area.

fields.EN:
To think that there might be a
girl there, walking around with a
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
そんな場所に、ナイトメアと連れ立った女の子
だなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To think that there might be a
girl there, walking around with a
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Are you sure about the rumor? I'm
not gonna have anyone risk their
lives over some stupid hoax.
fields.JP:
それ……嘘じゃないんだろうね？
いい加減な話のために、みんなの命を危険に
晒すわけにはいかないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure about the rumor? I'm
not gonna have anyone risk their
lives over some stupid hoax.

fields.EN:
We're just as doubtful as you are,
but the rumor came from a person
who just returned from there.
fields.JP:
途方に暮れているのは、こちらも同じだ。
ただし、そこから生還した者がいたらしく、
脱出者たちの間で噂になっているのでね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're just as doubtful as you are,
but the rumor came from a person
who just returned from there.

fields.EN:
Of course, you could probably
dismiss the rumor as a simple
horror story, but...
fields.JP:
それだけならば、まことしやかな怪談話として
受け取ることもできようが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, you could probably
dismiss the rumor as a simple
horror story, but...

fields.EN:
It's not a horror story. A child
has lost their way... Who
doesn't know there's a way out.
fields.JP:
怪談じゃないの。出口がわからなくなった子……
それに、出口があるって知らない子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not a horror story. A child
has lost their way... Who
doesn't know there's a way out.

fields.JP: ……やっぱ、あたしにはわかんないや

fields.EN:
It's true. I understood what Blue Bird-san...
what the bird told me. The things in
the labyrinth are those children.
fields.JP:
本当なの。青い鳥さん……鳥さんが
教えてくれたこと、わたしにはわかったの。
迷宮にあるものってあの子たちなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. Blue bird tells me all.
I know what it says. There are
children in the labyrinth.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
They're waiting to be found. Their
exit from... the labyrinth...
Labyrinth, labyrinth, labyrinth...
fields.JP:
あの子たちは、見つけてくれるのを待ってるの。
あの子たち、出口を……迷宮からの……
迷宮、迷宮迷宮迷宮迷宮迷宮……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're waiting to be found. Their
exit from... the labyrinth...
Labyrinth, labyrinth, labyrinth...

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama?! I haven't seen her
like this in awhile...
fields.JP:
ミチル様……！？
こんな風には滅多に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru?! I haven't seen her
like this in awhile...
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ミチル様 => Michiru-sama (remove localized English title)

fields.EN:
Maybe she's tired... May I suggest
you let Lady Oohime rest for a
bit?
fields.JP:
……ご心労がたたったのではないですか？
大陽女さんを少し休ませて差し上げては？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she's tired... May I suggest
you let Lady Oohime rest for a
bit?

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama... Please, sit here.
Take a deep breath...
fields.JP:
……ミチル様。さあ、ここに座って……
……ゆっくり息を吸って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru... Please, sit here.
Take a deep breath...
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ミチル様 => Michiru-sama (remove localized English title)
Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... What's this "Blue Bird-san"
she was talking about?)
fields.JP:
（あんなに取り乱すなんて……
　それに、『青い鳥さん』って……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... What's this "blue bird"
she was talking about?)
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry to have interrupted our
discussion. Now, about the other
rumor...
fields.JP:
……話を中断して申し訳ありません。
一つ目の話は以上です。もう一つは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to have interrupted our
discussion. Now, about the other
rumor...

fields.EN:
The second rumor is something one
of our members actually
encountered at the Waterside.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』での話です。
こちらは教団員が実際に目撃遭遇しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
The second rumor is something one
of our members actually
encountered at the Waterside.

fields.EN:
Encountered? Why would you call it
a rumor, then?
fields.JP:
……目撃？
なのに不可思議だなんて、不思議な話ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Encountered? Why would you call it
a rumor, then?

fields.EN:
As you may know, we do not possess
the power to free the captives.
The Dawn is our only hope.
fields.JP:
ご存知でしょうが……我々教団は、囚われた
人々を解放できるだけの力を持ちません。
あなたたち黎明の力が唯一の頼みです
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you may know, we do not possess
the power to free the captives.
The Dawn is our only hope.

fields.EN:
But we sought to send word of
their salvation to come, and sent
missionaries throughout the Jail.
fields.JP:
しかし、せめて大陽女様の御言葉……救済を
彼らに届けられればと、各エリアの入り口
付近まで足を運ぶ活動を開始したのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we sought to send word of
their salvation to come, and sent
missionaries throughout the Jail.

fields.EN:
(I see... So that's why the
prisoners from back then knew
about the Order of the Sun...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……それで、かぐや姫のいたところでも
　タイヨウの教えを……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So that's why the
prisoners from back then knew
about the Order of the Sun...)

fields.EN:
That's insane! You need to at
least have someone accompany
you!
fields.JP:
でも、無茶だよそんなの……！
せめて、誰か護衛を連れてかないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's insane! You need to at
least have someone accompany
you!

fields.EN:
Does the Dawn have the resources
to do that? Do you approve of our
activities?
fields.JP:
そのような人員を割く余裕が、黎明にあるの
でしょうか？
教団の活動に賛同して頂けるとでも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does the Dawn have the resources
to do that? Do you approve of our
activities?

fields.EN:
We deeply felt the prisoners'
hardships after welcoming escapees
from the City Streets, so...
fields.JP:
『元街道沿いエリア』からの脱出者たちを
受け入れて、痛感したのです。
彼らの絶望と心の傷は、とても深いのだと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We deeply felt the prisoners'
hardships after welcoming escapees
from the City Streets, so...

fields.EN:
Back to the subject, there's an
unusual golden hairball there that
is killing the Marchens.
fields.JP:
……話を戻しましょう。
そのエリアには金の毛玉の化け物が出現し、
メルヒェンを襲撃しているようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back to the subject, there's an
unusual golden hairball there that
is killing the Marchens.

fields.EN:
A golden hairball? You better not
be pulling our leg.
fields.JP:
金の毛玉の化け物！？
ちー。あんたまで変なこと言わないでよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A golden hairball? You better not
be pulling our leg.

fields.EN:
Golden hairball... That sounds
quite interesting...
fields.JP: 金の毛玉ですか～。面白そうですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Golden hairball... That sounds
quite interesting...

fields.EN: That creature is extremely agile and apparently stole food from the missionaries... At the very least, we can be sure it's a living creature.
fields.JP:
その化け物は非常に敏捷で、教団員の食料を
奪い去って行ったとのこと……
少なくとも、生物であることは確かなようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever it is, it's fast and
cunning and steals provisions
from our missionaries.

fields.JP: お父さん、『旧河川・沼エリア』って……？

fields.EN:
Similar to the Dorm, it's located
quite a distance away. We haven't
really gotten around there yet.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』と同じく、かなり奥地にあたる
場所になる。黎明の探索も手が回っていないのが
現状だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Similar to the Dorm, it's located
quite a distance away. We haven't
really gotten around there yet.

fields.EN:
So, I guess Dad doesn't know
anything about this golden
hairball thing.
fields.JP:
じゃあお父さんでも、その毛玉のことは
わかんないのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I guess Dad doesn't know
anything about this golden
hairball thing.

fields.EN:
These rumors are not only scaring
the people, but from Michiru-sama's words,
I feel there are others seeking salvation.
fields.JP:
これらの噂話が人々に不安を与えていることも
さることながら、ミチル様のお言葉から、
救済を望んでいる者がいるのではと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
These rumors are not only scaring
the people, but I feel there are
more out there seeking salvation.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
If possible, I would like to ask
the Dawn to investigate these
rumors and save those found.
fields.JP:
真相の解明と、独房エリアからの救助……
可能ならば、黎明にお願いしたい。
これが、本日の用件です
fields.LOCALIZED:
If possible, I would like to ask
the Dawn to investigate these
rumors and save those found.

fields.EN:
Hm... I was actually thinking of
having those locations
investigated anyway.
fields.JP:
ふむ……その両エリアの探索は、いずれ
行わねばならないとは、考えておりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I was actually thinking of
having those locations
investigated anyway.

fields.EN:
But isn't it risky to act on just
rumors?
fields.JP: でも、こんな怪しい話だけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But isn't it risky to act on just
rumors?

fields.EN:
Compared to before, our force is
much stronger now. Akazukin. Can you deploy?
fields.JP:
しばらく前と比べ、我らの戦力も充実している。
赤ずきんや。行けるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Compared to before, our force is
much stronger now. Red Riding
Hood. Can you deploy?

fields.JP: ……もちろんだよ！　ね、みんな！
（赤ずきんさん、乗せられやすいなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is pretty easy to
convince...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Very well, then. We will accept
your request.
fields.JP: では、お受けしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well, then. We will accept
your request.

fields.EN:
I thank you very much. Now then,
if you'll excuse us...
fields.JP:
……感謝します。
では、私たちはこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thank you very much. Now then,
if you'll excuse us...

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama? Are you able to
stand?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru? Are you able to
stand?
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ミチル様 => Michiru-sama (remove localized English title)

fields.EN:
Let's review what we know so
far...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's review what we know so
far...

fields.EN:
The Dorm is past the Temple area,
and is where the rumor of a girl
and a Nightmare originated.
fields.JP:
ひとつは『旧学生街エリア』での目撃談。
ここは『旧寺院エリア』の更に奥地にあり、
一度調査は放棄されている
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Dorm is past the Temple area,
and is where the rumor of a girl
and a Nightmare originated.

fields.EN:
The Waterside is past the Downtown
area, and is the rumored site of a
golden hairball.
fields.JP:
ひとつは『旧河川・沼エリア』での謎の生物。
ここは『元繁華街エリア』の更に奥地にあり、
実質上、未調査に近い
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Waterside is past the Downtown
area, and is the rumored site of a
golden hairball.

fields.EN:
Which of the two would you like
to explore first?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which of the two would you like
to explore first?

fields.EN:
I'm quite interested in the golden
hairball... I'd like everyone to
go there and get it for me.
fields.JP:
わらわは金の毛玉に興味があります～。
みんなで行って、取ってきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite interested in the golden
hairball... I'd like everyone to
go there and get it for me.

fields.EN:
What the heck are you saying,
Princess Lazy? You're coming
with us, too!
fields.JP:
何言ってんのよ、グータラ姫。
あんたも当然行くのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the heck are you saying,
Princess Lazy? You're coming
with us, too!

fields.EN:
I'm a bit nervous about the place
where people were getting lost...
fields.JP: 行方不明者が出た方は、少し不安ですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a bit nervous about the place
where people were getting lost...

fields.EN:
Well, I'm interested in going to
places we haven't been yet!
fields.JP:
人跡未踏のエリアといいますと、
興味がありますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm interested in going to
places we haven't been yet!

fields.EN:
But we really haven't gone to
either of those places, so I don't
think that changes much.
fields.JP:
どちらも実質未調査に近いということは……
条件はあまり変わらないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we really haven't gone to
either of those places, so I don't
think that changes much.

fields.EN: Well... personally, I think the Dorm area is riskier. It wasn't merely unexplored—we couldn't investigate it at all.
fields.JP:
そうだな……俺個人の考えで言えば、
『旧学生街エリア』の方がリスクが高い。
未調査というより調査不可能だったわけだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, in my opinion, the Dorm
area's more risky. We lost guys
over there, remember...

fields.EN: Speaking of that, in the Waterside area they've sighted a creature believed to be neither a Marchen nor a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
それを言ったら、『旧河川・沼エリア』では
メルヒェンともナイトメアとも異なると
思われる生物が目撃されているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Waterside has that strange
thing roaming around. There's no
telling what might happen.

fields.EN:
So, that means both would be a
pain. Why don't we just forget
about them?
fields.JP:
つまり、どちらも面倒臭いということですね～
両方行くのをやめたらどうですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that means both would be a
pain. Why don't we just forget
about them?

fields.EN:
B-But, we did say we were going
to investigate...
fields.JP: で……でも、もう引き受けちゃったからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, we did say we were going
to investigate...

fields.EN:
You mean the Professor said he
would investigate...
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean the Professor said he
would investigate...

fields.EN:
Come now, we're going to have to
venture there one day, anyway.
fields.JP: まあ、いずれ必要な調査ではあるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, we're going to have to
venture there one day, anyway.

fields.EN:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?
fields.JP:
……そうだ。君たち……
今回はチームを分けてみないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?

fields.EN: And why do you suggest that?
fields.JP: それは……どうしてですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: And why do you suggest that?

fields.EN:
With Kaguyahime and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.
fields.JP:
なに、せっかくかぐや姫とシンデレラという
強力な戦力が行動可能になったわけだしね。
今の君たちなら、何も全員で行くこともあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Kaguya and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.

fields.EN:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦も続いたところだ。
一方のチームが調査に赴いている間、もう一方は
ささやかだが休暇を取るのも良いかと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.

fields.EN:
But, that won't give Jack any time
to rest...
fields.JP: ……それでは、ジャックは休めないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that won't give Jack any time
to rest...

fields.EN:
You could say his load would be
lighter with fewer people to worry
about in the party.
fields.JP:
人数が少ない方が、彼の負担も減るとは
考えられるけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could say his load would be
lighter with fewer people to worry
about in the party.

fields.EN:
But giving everyone but Jack a
chance to rest lacks parity and
may contribute to lower morale.
fields.JP:
彼だけ休暇無しという不公平さは、チームの
士気を下げかねないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But giving everyone but Jack a
chance to rest lacks parity and
may contribute to lower morale.

fields.EN:
Sure, we got more hands on deck,
but those areas are new to us.
Why shorthand the group now?
fields.JP:
確かに戦力は充実したとはいえ、今回のエリアは
いわば下調べ無しのぶっつけ本番だ。
ここで戦力の出し惜しみもあるまい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, we got more hands on deck,
but those areas are new to us.
Why shorthand the group now?

fields.EN:
And if it's about rest, just give
them a huge-ass vacation after
everything's done.
fields.JP:
……休暇をやりたいなら、ケチケチせずに
作戦終了後にたっぷりくれてやったらどうだ、
オッさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if it's about rest, just give
them a huge-ass vacation after
everything's done.

fields.EN:
I'm fine taking a vacation right
now... Forever...
fields.JP: わらわは今すぐずっと休暇でいいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine taking a vacation right
now... Forever...

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you're thinking
about us, Dad... Like, really,
really happy.
fields.JP:
お父さんがあたしたちのことを考えて
言ってくれたのはわかってるんだ……
すごく嬉しいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you're thinking
about us, Dad... Like, really,
really happy.

fields.EN:
But we're finally coming together
as a solid team. I'd rather have
everyone work together as one.
fields.JP:
でも、せっかくこのメンバーで、チームが
固まってきてるしね。
せっかくなら、あたしはみんなで行きたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we're finally coming together
as a solid team. I'd rather have
everyone work together as one.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! You're right. I was
getting a bit ahead of myself here
again.
fields.JP:
ははは。君たちの言う通りだよ。
私としたことが、少し浮かれてしまっていた
ようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! You're right. I was
getting a bit ahead of myself here
again.

fields.EN:
Well, back on topic. Which
location do you want to
investigate first?
fields.JP:
では、話を戻そう。
君たちはどちらを先に調査すべきだと思うかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, back on topic. Which
location do you want to
investigate first?

fields.EN:
Mmm... To be honest, both are
pretty risky, but...
fields.JP:
うーん。ま、ぶっちゃけどっちが先でも
リスクはあるってことなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... To be honest, both are
pretty risky, but...

fields.EN:
I'd like to check out the
Waterside. It sounds pretty
challenging!
fields.JP:
あたしは『旧河川・沼エリア』かな。
なんていうか、挑みがいがありそうだしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd like to check out the
Waterside. It sounds pretty
challenging!

fields.EN:
I don't care... Both sound
tiring... If I had a choice, I'd
rather not go to either...
fields.JP:
面倒臭いからどっちでもいいです～
むしろ行きたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't care... Both sound
tiring... If I had a choice, I'd
rather not go to either...

fields.EN:
As for me, I'd prefer the Dorm.
Those kids getting lost in the
labyrinth seems interesting!
fields.JP:
私はそうね……
『旧学生街エリア』がいいかしら。
帰らずの迷宮っていうのが気になるしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for me, I'd prefer the Dorm.
Those kids getting lost in the
labyrinth seems interesting!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki would like to see the
girl walking around with the
Nightmare at the Dorm, as well.
fields.JP:
白雪は、『旧学生街エリア』です。
ナイトメアと仲良しな女の子が気になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White would like to see the
girl walking around with the
Nightmare at the Dorm, as well.

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! I prefer the Waterside
myself! Leave that golden ball to
me!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ……
わたくしは『旧河川・沼エリア』ですわね！
化け物退治ならお任せあそばせ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! I prefer the Waterside
myself! Leave that golden ball to
me!

fields.EN:
I'm interested in what's happening
at the Dorm.
fields.JP:
わたしは……『旧学生街エリア』ね。
何が起きているのか、気になるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm interested in what's happening
at the Dorm.

fields.EN:
So aside from one person who
doesn't want to go at all, we're
tied. How about you, Jack?
fields.JP:
……ってことは、約一名の棄権者を除けば
三対三か……
ジャックはどっちが先がいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So aside from one person who
doesn't want to go at all, we're
tied. How about you, Jack?

fields.EN:
...The Dorm. There could be more
people getting lost there as we
speak.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』かな……？
こうしている間にも、また行方不明者が出ると
大変だって思うし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Dorm. There could be more
people getting lost there as we
speak.

fields.EN: All right! The Dorm it is!
fields.JP: それじゃ、『旧学生街エリア』に決定だね！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! The Dorm it is!

fields.JP: えっ！？　そんな簡単に決めていいの！？

fields.EN:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?
fields.JP:
全員が意見を出した上で多数決なんだから、
いいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?

fields.EN:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Dorm area.
fields.JP:
では、君たちにはまず『旧学生街エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Dorm area.

fields.EN: Yup! Off to the Dorm we go!
fields.JP: うん……じゃあ、『旧学生街エリア』へ出発！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Off to the Dorm we go!

fields.EN:
...The Waterside area. Who knows
what other problems this golden
hairball thing could cause.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』かな……？
毛玉の化け物だなんて、誰か被害者が出ると
危ないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Waterside area. Who knows
what other problems this golden
hairball thing could cause.

fields.EN: All right! Waterside area it is!
fields.JP: それじゃ、『旧河川・沼エリア』に決定だね！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Waterside area it is!

fields.JP: えっ！？　そんな簡単に決めていいの！？

fields.EN:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?
fields.JP:
全員が意見を出した上で多数決なんだから、
いいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
We took a democratic vote here.
Fair, right?

fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ……
その通りですわ！

fields.EN:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Waterside.
fields.JP:
では、君たちにはまず『旧河川・沼エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'd like to ask you all
to head to the Waterside.

fields.EN: Yup! Off to the Waterside we go!
fields.JP: うん……じゃあ、『旧河川・沼エリア』へ出発！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Off to the Waterside we go!

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.
fields.JP:
……みんな揃ったようだね。
では、話を始めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.

fields.EN:
Thank you all for investigating
the Dorm, and for destroying the
area's core.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』での調査および核の破壊……
本当によくやってくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you all for investigating
the Dorm, and for destroying the
area's core.

fields.EN: Yup! We all did our best!
fields.JP: うん。みんな本当にがんばったからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! We all did our best!

fields.EN:
We reported our results to the
Order of the Sun, and Oohime
seemed quite pleased.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団とも調査結果を伝え、協議したよ。
真相を知り、大陽女さんも非常に安心された
様子だった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We reported our results to the
Order of the Sun, and Oohime
seemed quite pleased.

fields.EN:
But, I have to say I am very sad
about what happened to Hansel-kun.
fields.JP:
同時に、ヘンゼルくんのことは、大変心を
痛められていたと伝えておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have to say I am very sad
about what happened to Hansel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヘンゼルくん => Hansel-kun

fields.EN:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Gretel-kun as a
member of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
また、既に伝わっているかもしれないが、
ここにいるグレーテルくんが、
我々の正式なメンバーとなった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Gretel as a
member of the Dawn.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルくん => Gretel-kun

fields.EN:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.
fields.JP:
彼女が間違いなく、血式少女であるという
検査結果も出たわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.

fields.EN:
Though, to be honest, I'm quite
surprised that there was a Blood
Maiden living out in that area.
fields.JP:
正直、驚きね。
あのエリアに血式少女が住んでいたなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though, to be honest, I'm quite
surprised that there was a Blood
Maiden living out in that area.

fields.EN:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.
fields.JP:
ここでまた、新たに仲間を迎えられるのは、
大きな喜びだ。みんな、本当にありがとう
どうか、彼女を迎えてやってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.

fields.EN:
I suppose I should say that I'm
looking forward to being here
with all of you.
fields.JP: 改めて、どうぞよろしくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I should say that I'm
looking forward to being here
with all of you.

fields.EN: Yup! You're one of us now!
fields.JP: うん。あんたはもう、あたしたちの仲間だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! You're one of us now!

fields.EN:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?
fields.JP:
さて。前置きはここまでとなる
君たちは、もう一つの任務を覚えているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?

fields.EN:
I need you to check on the rumor
about the golden hairball running
around the Waterside area.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』での謎の生物の目撃……
その真相を確認してもらいたいのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need you to check on the rumor
about the golden hairball running
around the Waterside area.

fields.EN:
Heh... So, I suppose this marks
my first mission as a Blood
Maiden.
fields.JP:
ふふ……これが私の
……血式少女としての、初任務というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... So, I suppose this marks
my first mission as a Blood
Maiden.

fields.EN:
Just as a reminder, we need you to
work with us, and not on your own.
fields.JP:
わかっているとは思うけれど、独断による行動は
謹んで頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just as a reminder, we need you to
work with us, and not on your own.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. This will be my first
time working as part of a group.
It should be quite interesting.
fields.JP:
ええ、わかってるわ。
初めての集団行動……何もかもが興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. This will be my first
time working as part of a group.
It should be quite interesting.

fields.EN:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...
fields.JP:
連続した任務となり、君たちには負担を強いる
ことになるが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、お父さん。
それが、あたしたち血式部隊の仕事なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.

fields.EN:
There could be others in danger as
we speak, so just leave it to us.
fields.JP:
それに……こうしてる間にも、誰か被害者が
出たらいけないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There could be others in danger as
we speak, so just leave it to us.

fields.EN:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...

fields.EN:
Now, please make your way over to
the Waterside.
fields.JP:
では、君たちには早速『旧河川・沼エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, please make your way over to
the Waterside.

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.
fields.JP:
……みんな揃ったようだね。
では、話を始めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's here. Now
then, let's begin.

fields.EN:
Thank you all for investigating
the Waterside and for destroying
the area's core.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』での調査および核の破壊
……本当によくやってくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you all for investigating
the Waterside and for destroying
the area's core.

fields.EN:
Well, I think Jack was the major
player in this victory.
fields.JP: まあ……ジャックの手柄も大きいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think Jack was the major
player in this victory.

fields.JP: じゃっく、すきーーーー！！

fields.EN:
We reported our results to the
Order of the Sun, and Oohime
seemed quite pleased.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団とも調査結果を伝え、協議したよ。
真相を知り、大陽女さんも非常に安心された
様子だったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We reported our results to the
Order of the Sun, and Oohime
seemed quite pleased.

fields.EN:
They thanked us and said that
they could now relieve their
followers of their anxiety.
fields.JP:
信者の人たちの不安も、これで取り除けると
感謝しておられた
fields.LOCALIZED:
They thanked us and said that
they could now relieve their
followers of their anxiety.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルは気にしなくていいんだよ

fields.EN:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Rapunzel-kun as a
member of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
また、ここにいるラプンツェルくんが、
我々の正式なメンバーとなった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I would like to
officially welcome Rapunzel as a
member of the Dawn.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルくん => Rapunzel-kun

fields.EN:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.
fields.JP:
彼女が間違いなく、血式少女であるという
検査結果も出たわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have the final results
confirming that she's a Blood
Maiden.

fields.EN: I've got her equipment all ready.
fields.JP: 装備の方も、調整しといたぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: I've got her equipment all ready.

fields.JP: うう……ねむねむ……ふく、きらい……

fields.EN:
She can actually converse with
Nemu?!
fields.JP: この子、ネムと会話ができてるわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She can actually converse with
Sleepy?!

fields.EN:
Well, for some reason, she's been
quite attached to Nemurihime
from the start.
fields.JP:
うん。最初から眠り姫には心を許してた
みたいだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, for some reason, she's been
quite attached to Sleeping Beauty
from the start.

fields.JP: ねむねむ、すきーーーー！

fields.EN:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.
fields.JP:
ここでまた、新たに仲間を迎えられるのは、
大きな喜びだ。みんな、本当にありがとう
どうか、彼女を迎えてやってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's truly a joy to have another
join us. Thank you, and please
welcome her with open arms.

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、なかまになったよ！

fields.EN: Yup! You're one of us now!
fields.JP: うん。あんたはもう、あたしたちの仲間だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! You're one of us now!

fields.EN:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?
fields.JP:
さて。前置きはここまでとなる
君たちは、もう一つの任務を覚えているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, on to the next subject.
I take it you remember your other
mission, yes?

fields.EN:
I need you to check on the rumor
about the disappearances of the
children at the Dorm area.
fields.JP:
『旧学生街エリア』での謎の少女の目撃……
行方不明者の続出……
その真相を確認してもらいたいのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need you to check on the rumor
about the disappearances of the
children at the Dorm area.

fields.EN: Jack? Good food to eat there?
fields.JP: じゃっく、そこ……おいしいものある？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Good food to eat there?

fields.EN: Okay! I eat Jack when hungry!
fields.JP: じゃあ、おなかすいたらじゃっくたべるー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! I eat Jack when hungry!

fields.EN: Um... That's not a good idea...
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... That's not a good idea...

fields.EN:
Then... We'll bring rations with
us. Would that work for you,
Rapunzel-san?
fields.JP:
ええと……
何か傷まないものを持って行きましょう。
ね、ラプンツェルさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then... We'll bring rations with
us. Would that work for you,
Rapunzel?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.EN:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...
fields.JP:
連続した任務となり、君たちには負担を強いる
ことになるが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, though, that I feel
bad for placing such a burden upon
you all without much rest...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、お父さん。
それが、あたしたち血式部隊の仕事なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Dad. It's our duty as
members of the Blood Team to
handle these things.

fields.EN:
That place is dangerous. A lot of
our guys went missing there, so be
careful.
fields.JP:
調査不可能と判断されたエリアだ。
お前らまで行方不明にならねえように
気をつけろよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That place is dangerous. A lot of
our guys went missing there, so be
careful.

fields.EN:
Thanks! We'll be careful, Haru-san.
And don't worry... We're used to
reckless missions and things!
fields.JP:
ありがと。気をつけるよ、ハルさん。
それに……無茶な任務は慣れてるしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks! We'll be careful, Haru.
And don't worry... We're used to
reckless missions and things!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm really sorry to have you all
go through this...

fields.EN:
Now, please make your way over to
the Dorm.
fields.JP:
では、君たちには早速『旧学生街エリア』へ
向かってもらいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, please make your way over to
the Dorm.

fields.EN:
Hm... So this is the Dorm...
Doesn't seem so different from the
other areas.
fields.JP:
ふーん。ここが『旧学生街エリア』なのね。
ぱっと見じゃ、他のエリアとあんまり違う
ようにも思えないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... So this is the Dorm...
Doesn't seem so different from the
other areas.

fields.EN:
True. But it's still known for
disappearances, so we'd better be
careful.
fields.JP:
そうね……でも、不可思議な事件が起きている
場所であることには変わりないわ。
警戒して進まなければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. But it's still known for
disappearances, so we'd better be
careful.

fields.EN:
Yup. Be sure to keep an eye out
for anything weird.
fields.JP:
うん。何か変わったところがないか、
気を配って探索した方がいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Be sure to keep an eye out
for anything weird.

fields.EN:
Maybe this is where everyone runs
away to when they want to play
hooky.
fields.JP:
実はだらだらしたくて逃げ込む場所が、
ここだってことはないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe this is where everyone runs
away to when they want to play
hooky.

fields.JP: さ……さすがにそれはないんじゃないかな……

fields.EN:
If anyone would do that, it'd be
you, Princess Lazy...
fields.JP:
ていうか、それ……グータラ姫くらいなもの
だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anyone would do that, it'd be
you, Princess Lazy...

fields.JP: オオオオォォォォォォオオオオオオ……

fields.EN:
There it goes again. It sounds
creepier than usual. Like
something is about to appear...
fields.JP:
……今日は一段と気味が悪い声ですね。
何か出そうです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There it goes again. It sounds
creepier than usual. Like
something is about to appear...

fields.EN:
A-Appear?! I-It better not be a
ghost!
fields.JP: おお、お化けなんて出ないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Appear?! I-It better not be a
ghost!

fields.JP: おばけ？　それおいしい？

fields.EN: Are ghosts supposed to be scary?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are ghosts supposed to be scary?

fields.EN:
N-Not at all! No way! They're
absolutely not scary!
fields.JP:
い、いや！　怖くないよ！
怖くないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Not at all! No way! They're
absolutely not scary!

fields.JP: （ジェイルはお腹が空いてるみたいだ……）
オオオオォォォォォォオオオオオオ……

fields.EN:
(The sound coming from the Jail is
more disturbing than ever... I'd
better keep my headphones on...)
fields.JP:
（ジェイルの声、今日は一段と耳障りだ……
　ヘッドホン、はめておこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The sound coming from the Jail is
more disturbing than ever... I'd
better keep my headphones on...)

fields.EN:
I'm surprised seeing Aka-nee
freak out like this...
fields.JP: 赤姉の意外な弱点を発見って感じね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised seeing Sister Red
freak out like this...
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
S-Stop it... I... I just got
startled, that's all...
fields.JP: い、いや……びっくりしただけだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it... I... I just got
startled, that's all...

fields.EN: It can talk! It's not a ghost!
fields.JP:
喋りましたよ！
幽霊じゃありません……！
fields.LOCALIZED: It can talk! It's not a ghost!

fields.EN:
L-Like I said, I'm not afraid of
ghosts...
fields.LOCALIZED:
L-Like I said, I'm not afraid of
ghosts...

fields.EN:
Um... My name is Jack. The girls
here are...
fields.JP:
あ……あの、僕はジャック。
一緒にいるみんなは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... My name is Jack. The girls
here are...

fields.EN:
Isn't it proper etiquette to first
introduce yourself before
inquiring about others?
fields.JP:
人に名前を聞くときには、まず自分から名乗る
ものよ。違うかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it proper etiquette to first
introduce yourself before
inquiring about others?

fields.JP:
……それもそうね。
私の名前はグレーテルよ

fields.EN: Hello, Gretel. My name is Alice.
fields.JP:
そう。グレーテルというのね。
わたしはアリスよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hello, Gretel. My name is Alice.

fields.EN:
Um... Isn't she the girl from the
rumors?
fields.JP:
あの……あの人が、噂になってる女の子じゃ
ないでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Isn't she the girl from the
rumors?

fields.EN:
I see! Then we can ask her about
what's happening here.
fields.JP:
……そうか！
だったら、事情を聞いてみれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see! Then we can ask her about
what's happening here.

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? There's something we
want to ask you...
fields.JP:
あの、グレーテル……
実は、君に聞きたいことが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? There's something we
want to ask you...

fields.JP: ワープしたんじゃないかと思います～

fields.EN:
Warped?! What do you mean by
that?!
fields.JP: ……ワープ？　どういうことよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Warped?! What do you mean by
that?!

fields.EN:
There's always a method to move
objects.
fields.JP:
物が移動する時には、必ず何か方法がある
ものです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's always a method to move
objects.

fields.EN:
Vanishing like that could only
mean she used some tool or
special power.
fields.JP:
あんな風に一瞬で消えるとしたら、何か道具か、
特殊な能力を使ったとしか考えられません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Vanishing like that could only
mean she used some tool or
special power.

fields.EN:
But I didn't notice any item use,
so I believe it was her special
power.
fields.JP:
でも、道具を使った素振りはありませんでした。
つまり、あの子は特殊な能力を持っているのだと
思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I didn't notice any item use,
so I believe it was her special
power.

fields.JP: かぐやさん、鋭いですね……！

fields.EN:
I may be lazy, but that doesn't
mean I'm delusional. There's no
such thing as ghosts.
fields.JP:
わらわはこう見えても現実主義者ですから～
幽霊なんているわけありませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may be lazy, but that doesn't
mean I'm delusional. There's no
such thing as ghosts.

fields.EN:
And of course you're a master
at using tools to avoid putting
effort into anything.
fields.JP:
さすが、サボるためなら道具でも何でも使って
努力を惜しまないだけあるわよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And of course you're a master
at using tools to avoid putting
effort into anything.

fields.EN:
Regardless of how she did that, I
guess it's safe to assume she
isn't a normal human...
fields.JP:
具体的な方法はともかく……
普通の人間ではなさそうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless of how she did that, I
guess it's safe to assume she
isn't a normal human...

fields.EN:
Well, if that is her special
power, wouldn't that make her a
Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
でも……特殊な能力ということになりますと、
あの方は血式少女ということになりますの
ですかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that is her special
power, wouldn't that make her a
Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
If she is, why would there be
rumors of her hanging out with a
Nightmare?
fields.JP:
でも、もし血式少女なんだとしたら、
どうしてナイトメアと一緒にいるって噂が
出るんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she is, why would there be
rumors of her hanging out with a
Nightmare?

fields.EN:
True... There's no way anyone
could befriend a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
……それはそうよね。人と仲良くするナイトメア
なんて、ありえないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... There's no way anyone
could befriend a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
And if she is a Blood Maiden, I'm
sure that would have been known
to us by now already.
fields.JP:
血式少女だとしたら、今まで誰にも発見されず、
保護もされていないなんて、考えられません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if she is a Blood Maiden, I'm
sure that would have been known
to us by now already.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, the Dawn
discovered me and Jack in that
prison cell, too.
fields.JP:
わたしとジャックも、黎明に発見してもらって
牢獄を出ることができたのだものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, the Dawn
discovered me and Jack in that
prison cell, too.

fields.EN:
Yup. And we only arrived so late
because we didn't have the power
to free you earlier...
fields.JP:
うん。むしろ二人の場合は遅かったくらい……。
投獄されてたっていうのが大きかったけど、
あたしらの力不足だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. And we only arrived so late
because we didn't have the power
to free you earlier...

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, you don't need
to worry about that...
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんが気にすることじゃないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to get down on
yourself over that.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens go through a lot in
their lives. I'm just one of the
lucky ones.
fields.JP:
みんな知ってることだけど、血式少女は決して
恵まれた境遇で生きてこれるわけじゃない。
あたしなんかは恵まれ過ぎてたくらいなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens go through a lot in
their lives. I'm just one of the
lucky ones.

fields.EN:
So it's kind of unfortunate that
not all of them meet nice people
like everyone in the Dawn...
fields.JP:
くやしいけど……みんながみんな、
黎明の人たちみたいにいい人ばかりじゃ
ない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it's kind of unfortunate that
not all of them meet nice people
like everyone in the Dawn...

fields.EN:
That's why I'm doing my best to
find Blood Maidens, not just for
help, but to protect them.
fields.JP:
だから……戦力の充実ってだけじゃなくて
早く保護するためにも……あたしたちは
血式少女の情報を集めて、探してるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I'm doing my best to
find Blood Maidens, not just for
help, but to protect them.

fields.JP: んーーーーーラプンツェルはーーー？

fields.EN:
Sorry! Uh, you kinda slipped
through the cracks!
fields.JP:
ごめん！
あんたは完全にノーチェックだったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry! Uh, you kinda slipped
through the cracks!

fields.EN:
Well, but in her case, she was
attacking people, not being
attacked.
fields.JP: 虐められるどころか、むしろ人を襲ってたしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, but in her case, she was
attacking people, not being
attacked.

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
In any case, does that mean she
isn't a Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
……だとすれば、あの方は血式少女ではないと
いうことになりますのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, does that mean she
isn't a Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
I don't think we can say that yet.
After all, this area hasn't been
fully explored yet, right?
fields.JP:
そうとも言えないわね。
何しろここは今まで、人の手が及ばなかった
場所なのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think we can say that yet.
After all, this area hasn't been
fully explored yet, right?

fields.EN:
Well, based on what we know, we
don't have much information on
hand to make that call.
fields.JP: まあ……今のところは何とも言えないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, based on what we know, we
don't have much information on
hand to make that call.

fields.EN: But, if she is a Blood Maiden...
fields.LOCALIZED: But, if she is a Blood Maiden...

fields.EN: "If she is a Blood Maiden," what?
fields.JP: 血式少女だとしたら……何よ？
fields.LOCALIZED: "If she is a Blood Maiden," what?

fields.EN:
Wouldn't it be a possibility that
she's being forced by the
Nightmare to follow its orders?
fields.JP:
ナイトメアに脅されて、言うことを聞かされてる
……ってことはないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it be a possibility that
she's being forced by the
Nightmare to follow its orders?

fields.EN:
But we're still not sure whether
Nightmares even have the capacity
to do that, right?
fields.JP:
でも、ナイトメアにそこまでの知能があるの
か、甚だ疑問ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we're still not sure whether
Nightmares even have the capacity
to do that, right?

fields.EN:
Maybe Jack-san was trying to say it
could be... Snark?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんが言いたいのは、『スナーク』の
こと……じゃないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Jack was trying to say it
could be... Snark?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Y-Yes, that's right, but... Maybe
I'm overthinking it...
fields.JP:
う、うん……実はそうなんだけど……
少し、考えすぎかもしれないよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes, that's right, but... Maybe
I'm overthinking it...

fields.EN:
Let's go and look for Gretel
first. No use speculating amongst
ourselves now..
fields.JP:
とりあえずはさ、グレーテルだっけ？
あの子を探してみようよ。
ここで話してたってしょうがないんだしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go and look for Gretel
first. No use speculating amongst
ourselves now..

fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック……
もしかしたらなのだけど、この場所は……

fields.EN:
Yeah... It looks like we've been
wandering around the same places
over and over again...
fields.JP:
うん……
どうも、さっきから何度も同じ場所を
ぐるぐる回っているみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It looks like we've been
wandering around the same places
over and over again...

fields.EN:
I knew it... I thought there was
something strange here...
fields.JP:
やっぱ、そうか……
そんな気がしてたんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... I thought there was
something strange here...

fields.JP: ぐるぐるだねーーーーーーーーー！
要するに……迷子ってわけね……

fields.EN:
Looks like we've bitten off more
than we can chew... I am very
quickly becoming bored...
fields.JP:
ミイラ取りがミイラになるってやつですね～
わらわはだんだん飽きてきました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we've bitten off more
than we can chew... I am very
quickly becoming bored...

fields.EN: Kaguyahime-san, this is no time to take it easy. Even we have limits to our stamina...
fields.JP:
かぐやさん。呑気にしてる場合じゃありません
ですわ。わたくしたちにも体力の限界という
ものがございますもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, this is no time to joke.
We need to hurry, as we can only
do this for so long.

fields.EN:
I suppose... I wouldn't want my
Bamboo One to run out of fuel
after all...
fields.JP:
そう言われればそうですね～
わらわのバンブー一号も、燃料切れになったら
困りますし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose... I wouldn't want my
Bamboo One to run out of fuel
after all...

fields.EN: Is that all you're worried about?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that all you're worried about?!

fields.JP: ラプンツェルはげんきだよーーーー！

fields.EN:
Shirayuki has been keeping an eye
out, but it looks like we keep
ending up in the same place.
fields.JP:
白雪も、少し前に気がついてから
だいぶ注意していたんですけど……
やっぱり、同じ場所に出てしまうんですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White has been keeping an eye
out, but it looks like we keep
ending up in the same place.

fields.EN:
And it doesn't look like we took
any wrong turns, either...
fields.JP:
そうね。
道を間違えたというわけではなさそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it doesn't look like we took
any wrong turns, either...

fields.EN:
I've been thinking... Maybe
there's some unusual power that's
affecting this area.
fields.JP:
さっきから考えていたんだけど……
このエリアには……何か……
特殊な力が働いてるんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been thinking... Maybe
there's some unusual power that's
affecting this area.

fields.EN:
I can't really place it, but...
Um... Like some power to mess with
our sense of direction?
fields.JP:
なんていうか……ええと……
方向感覚を麻痺させるような力、っていうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't really place it, but...
Um... Like some power to mess with
our sense of direction?

fields.EN:
If that's true, we'll never get
out of here! Whatever shall we
do?!
fields.JP:
そんなワケのわからない力が働いてたら、
ここから永遠に抜け出せないではありませんの！
どうしたらいいんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's true, we'll never get
out of here! Whatever shall we
do?!

fields.EN:
Hm... A magical labyrinth, so to
speak... We may as well keep
moving ahead.
fields.JP:
……神秘の迷宮というわけね。
でも、ここでこうしていても仕方ないわ。
とにかく先に進んでみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... A magical labyrinth, so to
speak... We may as well keep
moving ahead.

fields.EN:
Yup, not like we have a choice.
Let's just keep an eye on our
surroundings and move on.
fields.JP:
うん、それしかなさそうだね。
注意しながら進んでみようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, not like we have a choice.
Let's just keep an eye on our
surroundings and move on.

fields.JP:
おおーーーー！
ここ、さっききたところだーーーー！

fields.EN:
It's no good! We can't get out of
here! We're doomed to roam around
here forever, like zombies!
fields.JP:
ダメですわ！　迷宮を抜けられませんわ……
ここで全員ミイラになるまで、
わたくしたち、ずっと彷徨う運命なんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no good! We can't get out of
here! We're doomed to roam around
here forever, like zombies!

fields.EN:
Shut up already! Crying won't do
us any good! I don't like this
either, you know?!
fields.JP:
やかましいです～！
泣いたって何の解決にもならないです～！
わらわだって、面倒くさいのは嫌いです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up already! Crying won't do
us any good! I don't like this
either, you know?!

fields.EN:
Augh! You're just as loud as she
is! Shut up!
fields.JP:
あー……もう！
あんたの声の方がうるさいっつーの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! You're just as loud as she
is! Shut up!

fields.EN:
Hahahahaha! Round and round and
round!
fields.JP:
あはははははははは！
ぐるぐるぐるぐるーーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahahaha! Round and round and
round!

fields.EN: You! Rugrat! You shut up, too!
fields.JP: 野生児。あんたもうるさいっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You! Rugrat! You shut up, too!

fields.EN:
Please calm down, Oyayubi-neesama. Everyone is confused
and worried.
fields.JP:
親指姉様、落ち着いてください。
みんな不安なんですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please calm down, Sister
Thumbelina. Everyone is confused
and worried.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Shirayuki's got that right.
There's no sense in bickering with
each other now.
fields.JP:
白雪の言う通りだね。
ここであたしらがケンカしたって、何も解決
しないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White's got that right.
There's no sense in bickering with
each other now.

fields.JP:
……ジャック？
どうかしたの？

fields.EN:
I was just thinking there must be
a clue on how to get out of
here...
fields.JP:
何か……きっと何か……
この迷宮を抜け出すためのヒントが
あるんじゃないかって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just thinking there must be
a clue on how to get out of
here...

fields.JP: ヒントってどういうことですか～？

fields.EN:
Well, if whoever did this wanted
to harm us, they could've set
traps all over the place.
fields.JP:
うん。たとえばだけど……本当に僕らをどうにか
しようと思ってるなら、もっと危険な罠なんかが
仕掛けられててもいいと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if whoever did this wanted
to harm us, they could've set
traps all over the place.

fields.EN:
I feel like this is more of a
prank. Watching us struggle and
enjoying it.
fields.JP:
つまり、なんていうか……この迷宮は誰かの
悪戯みたいな感じがするっていうか、
僕らが困るのを喜んでるみたいだっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like this is more of a
prank. Watching us struggle and
enjoying it.

fields.EN:
If you ask me, it's a pretty weak
prank. But still a major pain,
regardless.
fields.JP:
そう言われてみれば……
単なる嫌がらせって言えなくもないわよね。
迷惑この上ないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you ask me, it's a pretty weak
prank. But still a major pain,
regardless.

fields.EN:
Right. The lost members who came
here probably couldn't find their
way out, and...
fields.JP:
うん。過去のエリア調査隊が未帰還なのは、
この迷宮を抜け出せなかったからだと思う。
おそらく全滅してるんじゃないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. The lost members who came
here probably couldn't find their
way out, and...

fields.EN:
Are you saying the lost members
of the Dawn were accidentally
killed by a prank?!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、エリア調査隊は……
悪戯で全滅させられたというの？
さしたる悪意もなく……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you saying the lost members
of the Dawn were accidentally
killed by a prank?!

fields.EN:
I can't confirm it, but it sure
feels that way...
fields.JP: はっきりとは言えないけど、そんな気がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't confirm it, but it sure
feels that way...

fields.EN:
Whether it is a prank or not, it's
still dangerous. After all, death
seems to be the only way out...
fields.JP:
それじゃ、いくら悪戯でもやっぱり
危険は危険ですね……
相手が死んでもやめないんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether it is a prank or not, it's
still dangerous. After all, death
seems to be the only way out...

fields.EN:
Right. If this was done in
innocence, it seems worse than
intentional evil, in a way...
fields.JP:
ええ。自覚の無い悪意とも言えるわ。
それが一番たちが悪いものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. If this was done in
innocence, it seems worse than
intentional evil, in a way...

fields.JP: いたずらなら、ラプンツェルまけないよ！

fields.EN:
But if it is a prank, there should
be a trick behind all this.
fields.JP:
……そうですね～
悪戯なら、必ずタネも仕掛けもあるはずです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if it is a prank, there should
be a trick behind all this.

fields.EN:
Whoever the perpetrator is, they'd
need an easy way out themselves.
Such is the way of the lazy.
fields.JP:
仕掛けた本人が嵌って抜け出せなくなったら、
元も子もありませんから～
これ、サボりの秘訣です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoever the perpetrator is, they'd
need an easy way out themselves.
Such is the way of the lazy.

fields.JP: ……あんたが言うと、妙に説得力があるのよね

fields.EN:
Well, she's right. There has to be
a way out of this if we assume
this is some sort of prank.
fields.JP:
うん。そうなんだよ。これがもし本当に悪戯の
類なら……この迷宮を抜け出す仕組みも、
必ず用意してある筈だと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she's right. There has to be
a way out of this if we assume
this is some sort of prank.

fields.EN:
Well, let's look for clues, then.
If you notice something, be sure
to speak up.
fields.JP:
それじゃ……とりあえず、そのヒントを探し
ながら進もう。
何か気になることがあったら、報告すること！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's look for clues, then.
If you notice something, be sure
to speak up.

fields.EN:
I suppose having an objective
helps instead of wandering around
aimlessly.
fields.JP:
そうですわね。どうせ歩き詰めなんですもの。
目的があった方がいいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose having an objective
helps instead of wandering around
aimlessly.

fields.EN:
But not even knowing what we're
looking for will make it
challenging.
fields.JP:
気になるものっていっても、意外とわからない
ものよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But not even knowing what we're
looking for will make it
challenging.

fields.EN: But... there has to be something.
fields.JP: でも……何かきっとあるはずです
fields.LOCALIZED: But... there has to be something.

fields.EN:
Yes, so long as this labyrinth
isn't naturally created, or the
creator isn't completely insane...
fields.JP:
ええ……この迷宮自体が自然発生的なものか、
仕掛けた張本人の気が触れていない限りはね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so long as this labyrinth
isn't naturally created, or the
creator isn't completely insane...

fields.JP: アリスもさらっとそういうこと言わない～！

fields.EN:
It looks like it was placed there
by someone. See? There's a
trail...
fields.JP:
あの石、誰かが置いたものなんじゃないかな？
ほら、あっちの方にまでずっと続いてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it was placed there
by someone. See? There's a
trail...

fields.EN:
You're right. It looks
intentional. I can't believe we
didn't notice that until now.
fields.JP:
本当だわ……明らかに人為的な置き方ね……！
ずっと気づかなかったなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. It looks
intentional. I can't believe we
didn't notice that until now.

fields.EN:
I was expecting something
flashier. Geez... We should've
noticed it sooner.
fields.JP:
私たち、最初からもっと派手なのを探しちゃって
いたってわけね。くやしいけど、まんまと
やられたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was expecting something
flashier. Geez... We should've
noticed it sooner.

fields.EN:
Well, I don't think anyone
expected something as plain and
simple as that...
fields.JP:
……そうだね。まさかこんな地味なやつだとは、
なかなか気がつかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I don't think anyone
expected something as plain and
simple as that...

fields.EN:
Jack-san, you're so helpful when it
comes to the plain and simple!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
地味なのも時には役に立つんですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you're so helpful when it
comes to the plain and simple!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Let's follow those stones and see
where they lead us.
fields.JP: ひとまず、あの置き石に沿って進んでみようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's follow those stones and see
where they lead us.

fields.JP: じゃあ、仕切り直しってことで……出発！
さっきの子……グレーテルだ……！

fields.EN:
All right! This time she's not
getting away!
fields.JP: よーし。今度こそ、とっ捕まえて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! This time she's not
getting away!

fields.EN:
I don't think it's a good idea to
surprise her.
fields.JP: 驚かさない方がいいと思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think it's a good idea to
surprise her.

fields.EN: Why don't we try talking to her?
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we try talking to her?

fields.JP:
……ねえ、君。
グレーテル……だよね？

fields.EN:
I didn't expect you to get out of
there, let alone get to me.
fields.JP:
……ここまでよく辿り着いたものね
あそこから抜け出せるなんて思わなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect you to get out of
there, let alone get to me.

fields.EN:
You set that place up as a trap,
didn't you?
fields.JP: ……あなたが仕組んだ罠だったのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You set that place up as a trap,
didn't you?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure I agree. After all,
anyone would know their own
home well enough, no?
fields.JP:
さあ……どうかしら？
誰だって自分の家の中は熟知しているもの
でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure I agree. After all,
anyone would know their own
home well enough, no?

fields.EN:
Home? That's a very odd example
to use!
fields.JP: 家、ですの？　変な例えはおよしあそばせ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Home? That's a very odd example
to use!

fields.EN:
Odd? I don't understand what you
find odd about what I said.
fields.JP: どこが変な例えなのか、理解できないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Odd? I don't understand what you
find odd about what I said.

fields.EN:
Have you... been here all this
time?
fields.JP: 君……ずっとここにいるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Have you... been here all this
time?

fields.EN: Why, yes. This is my home.
fields.JP: ええ。そうよ。ここは私の家なのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Why, yes. This is my home.

fields.EN:
H-Home...? But, this place is
crawling with Marchens!
fields.JP:
い……家って……
メルヒェンがうようよしてるのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Home...? But, this place is
crawling with Marchens!

fields.EN:
Indeed. They can be noisy at
times, but as a whole, they're
quite cute.
fields.JP: ええ。時々騒がしいけれど、可愛いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. They can be noisy at
times, but as a whole, they're
quite cute.

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't think anyone eats
them.
fields.JP: いや、普通食べないから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't think anyone eats
them.

fields.EN:
Anyway... You said the Marchens
are cute? Who are you?
fields.JP:
と、ともかく……メルヒェンが可愛いって……
……あんた、何者なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway... You said the Marchens
are cute? Who are you?

fields.JP: 私？　私はナイトメアよ

fields.EN:
A Nightmare?! But you don't look
like one...
fields.JP:
ナイトメア……！？
だってあんた、どう見たって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare?! But you don't look
like one...

fields.EN:
We heard a rumor that there was
a girl here that walks with a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
実は、こういう噂を聞いたんだ。
このジェイルの中で、ナイトメアと一緒にいる
女の子がいるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We heard a rumor that there was
a girl here that walks with a
Nightmare.

fields.EN: Could that be you, by any chance?
fields.LOCALIZED: Could that be you, by any chance?

fields.EN:
I don't understand what you're
saying, but I suppose that could
pertain to me.
fields.JP:
……………………
あなたの言っていることがよく解らないのだけど
……そういうことになるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand what you're
saying, but I suppose that could
pertain to me.

fields.EN: I've been living with Hansel-niisan since I was born.
fields.JP:
私、生まれた時からずっと、
ヘンゼル兄さんと暮らしてきたんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been living with my brother,
Hansel, since I was born.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan? You mean there's another
person here besides you?
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんって……
もう一人、人間がいるってことになるんでしょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel? You mean there's another
person here besides you?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP:
……人間？
私とヘンゼル兄さんは、ナイトメアよ？
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san
Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: ウン……ボクラハナイトメアダ……

fields.EN:
(She's able to converse with a
Nightmare?!)
fields.JP: （ナイトメアとこの子……会話をしてる！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's able to converse with a
Nightmare?!)

fields.EN:
Is there something unusual about
our being able to speak with each
other? You all speak, don't you?
fields.JP:
私たちが喋ることに、何か変なことでもあると
いうの？　あなたたちだって喋るじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there something unusual about
our being able to speak with each
other? You all speak, don't you?

fields.EN:
It's a Nightmare! Everyone, be
careful!
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアだ！
みんな、気をつけて！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a Nightmare! Everyone, be
careful!

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん……みんな、待って！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Why are you stopping us?! It's a
Nightmare!
fields.JP: 何言ってんのよ！　ナイトメアよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you stopping us?! It's a
Nightmare!

fields.EN:
I see. So you all really are
intruders. Our enemies.
fields.JP:
……そう。
やはり、あなたたちは侵入者……私たちの敵なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So you all really are
intruders. Our enemies.

fields.EN:
Please wait! Aren't you a Blood
Maiden?!
fields.JP:
……待ってよ！
君は、血式少女じゃないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please wait! Aren't you a Blood
Maiden?!

fields.EN:
Blood Maiden? I don't understand
