what you're saying. In any case,
intruders bear no good will.
fields.JP:
血式少女？
……何を言っているのかわからないわ。
もっとも、侵入者にろくな者はいないものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maiden? I don't understand
what you're saying. In any case,
intruders bear no good will.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN: Let's be rid of them now.
fields.JP: 追い払ってしまいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's be rid of them now.

fields.JP: ジャック。ここは引くよ！

fields.EN:
Jack! Now's not the time! Be
mindful of the situation!
fields.JP:
ジャック……今は無理だわ！
状況を見極めて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Now's not the time! Be
mindful of the situation!

fields.JP: どうにか……逃げ切りましたね……

fields.EN:
Wh-What was that?! What's with
that girl and the Nightmare?!
fields.JP:
な……何なの！？
あの子とあのナイトメア！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What was that?! What's with
that girl and the Nightmare?!

fields.EN:
It seemed as if the Nightmare was
protecting her...
fields.JP:
あのナイトメア……あの子を守ってるように
見えましたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seemed as if the Nightmare was
protecting her...

fields.JP:
じゅるるる……
あのないとめあ、おいしそうだった……
い……いや、食べちゃ駄目だから……

fields.EN:
She called it her brother...
Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さんって……言ってましたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She called it her brother...
Hansel.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
And, that Nightmare was answering
back to her. It seems it possesses
some level of intelligence.
fields.JP:
あのナイトメアも、きちんとあの子と受け答えを
していたわ……
あのナイトメアには、それだけの知性があるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that Nightmare was answering
back to her. It seems it possesses
some level of intelligence.

fields.JP: ん……あの子、馬鹿じゃない…………

fields.EN:
Nemu! You shouldn't call a
Nightmare a "kid!"
fields.JP:
ネムはナイトメアのことまで『あの子』だなんて
言うんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy! You shouldn't call a
Nightmare a "kid!"

fields.EN:
One thing's for sure. The rumor
about the girl and the Nightmare
is definitely about them.
fields.JP:
でも……ひとつはっきりしたことがあるわ。
目撃された『ナイトメアと一緒に歩く女の子』
……それは、あの子たちのことで間違いないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
One thing's for sure. The rumor
about the girl and the Nightmare
is definitely about them.

fields.EN:
It seems as if they were acting of
their own free will.
fields.JP:
見たところ……誰にも強制されているようでは
なかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if they were acting of
their own free will.

fields.EN:
And also that they don't feel a
thing about those who died here.
fields.JP:
そして、ここで多くの人が死んだことについて、
何ら痛痒を感じてはいないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And also that they don't feel a
thing about those who died here.

fields.EN:
W-Wait a second, Alice. Isn't it a
bit early to come to that
conclusion?
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ、アリス。
そこまで決めつけるのは早すぎると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait a second, Alice. Isn't it a
bit early to come to that
conclusion?

fields.EN:
Conclusion? I'm sorry. That wasn't
my intention...
fields.JP:
決めつける……？
ごめんなさい……そうなのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Conclusion? I'm sorry. That wasn't
my intention...

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I mean, we still don't
know what's going on with that
Gretel girl.
fields.JP:
あ、ううん。まだグレーテル……あの子の事情は
よくわかっていないからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I mean, we still don't
know what's going on with that
Gretel girl.

fields.EN:
Not only that... I feel like that
girl is a Blood Maiden, too.
fields.JP:
それに……僕はやっぱり、あの子は血式少女じゃ
ないかと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only that... I feel like that
girl is a Blood Maiden, too.

fields.EN:
After all, it's hard to imagine a
normal person living here from
birth, with a Nightmare, no less.
fields.JP:
ただの人間が、生まれた時からずっと
こんなところでナイトメアと暮らせるのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, it's hard to imagine a
normal person living here from
birth, with a Nightmare, no less.

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
If we're on the subject of "hard
to imagine," the same goes for
the Nightmare, as well!
fields.JP:
それを言うなら……あのナイトメアだって
とびきり変ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're on the subject of "hard
to imagine," the same goes for
the Nightmare, as well!

fields.EN:
But if they're fine together,
shouldn't we just leave them be?
fields.JP:
本人たちがいいなら、わらわは別に
いいと思いますけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if they're fine together,
shouldn't we just leave them be?

fields.EN:
Not really... Our mission does
include finding the area's core
and destroying it.
fields.JP:
でも……そうも言ってらんないんだよねー。
ほら、あたしたちの任務には、エリアの核を
見つけて破壊することも含まれてるしさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not really... Our mission does
include finding the area's core
and destroying it.

fields.EN: We should just leave them alone...
fields.JP: 放っておいてやってもいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: We should just leave them alone...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki feels the same way,
too.
fields.JP:
白雪も……あのふたりを見てたら、そんな気が
します……
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White feels the same way,
too.

fields.EN:
It looks like they think we're
their enemies now.
fields.JP:
白雪たちはすっかり、敵だと思われてしまった
ようですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like they think we're
their enemies now.

fields.EN:
What the hell are you saying?!
That Nightmare is our enemy! One
that'll do anything to kill us!
fields.JP:
白雪。あんた何言ってんの！？
ナイトメアは敵よ！？
私たちを容赦なく殺そうとする敵じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the hell are you saying?!
That Nightmare is our enemy! One
that'll do anything to kill us!

fields.EN:
It didn't look like it was going
to chase us, but there's no
telling what'll happen next time.
fields.JP:
まあ、確かにしつこく追ってくる気配は無いよ。
でも、次に出会ったら、どうなるかはわからない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't look like it was going
to chase us, but there's no
telling what'll happen next time.

fields.EN:
If only there was a way to speak
a bit more with that girl and the
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
せめて、あの子やナイトメアと、もう少し話が
できれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only there was a way to speak
a bit more with that girl and the
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
How about we look for the core
first? A mission is a mission,
after all.
fields.JP:
ともかく、核を見つけちゃわない？
任務は任務なんだしさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we look for the core
first? A mission is a mission,
after all.

fields.EN:
True... We can stop the Nightmare
from reviving, but that alone
doesn't mean it'll die.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
核を破壊すればナイトメアの再生は止められる。
でも、殺すことにつながるわけじゃないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... We can stop the Nightmare
from reviving, but that alone
doesn't mean it'll die.

fields.EN:
There's no telling what's going to
happen, so we'd better have a
fallback plan ready.
fields.JP:
問題を先送りにするようだけど、どう話が転がるか
わかんないわけだしさ……
活路は用意しておかないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what's going to
happen, so we'd better have a
fallback plan ready.

fields.EN:
Yes... There's a good chance we
won't get through to them.
fields.JP: ええ……決裂の可能性は、十分にあるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... There's a good chance we
won't get through to them.

fields.EN:
(They're right... We can't risk
dying here...)
fields.JP:
（確かに……僕らまで全滅するわけには
　いかないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're right... We can't risk
dying here...)

fields.EN:
Okay... Let's go and find the
core.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... Let's go and find the
core.

fields.EN:
There it is! That must be the
core!
fields.JP:
……あったわ！
あっちに見えるの、きっと核よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There it is! That must be the
core!

fields.JP: ええ！　やりましたわね！

fields.EN:
Despite being a labyrinth, the
structure itself isn't much
different from the other areas.
fields.JP:
……迷宮になっているとはいえ、
基本的には他の場所と造りは同じということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite being a labyrinth, the
structure itself isn't much
different from the other areas.

fields.EN:
But there's no eerie-looking eye
here...
fields.JP:
でも……ここにはあの気持ちの悪い
大きな『眼』がありませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's no eerie-looking eye
here...

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, you're right!
Nice catch, Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
言われてみれば……！
白雪、いいとこに気がつくじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you're right!
Nice catch, Snow White!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki only noticed because
she's been looking at the walls
this entire time.
fields.JP: 白雪、迷路の中でも壁ばかり見ていたので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White only noticed because
she's been looking at the walls
this entire time.

fields.EN:
You're too modest. You've been
keeping an eye out for us all this
time. That's how you noticed it.
fields.JP:
いいえ。あなたはとても優しくて、いつも
わたしたちのことを見守ってくれているもの。
だから、よく気がつくのだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're too modest. You've been
keeping an eye out for us all this
time. That's how you noticed it.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki isn't modest...
Everyone is much more modest
than I am...
fields.JP:
白雪、優しくなんかありません……
本当に優しいのは、皆さんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White isn't modest...
Everyone is much more modest
than I am...

fields.EN:
Could you accept the compliment
already?
fields.JP: あんたはすぐそうやって謙遜するんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could you accept the compliment
already?

fields.EN:
In any case, we do know that this
place is a few notches weirder
than any of the other areas.
fields.JP:
ともかく、ここがとびきり変な場所だってことは
確かってことよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we do know that this
place is a few notches weirder
than any of the other areas.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. But it would be good to
know what those eyes are for.
fields.JP:
ええ。問題は、あの『眼』がいったい何かという
ことですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. But it would be good to
know what those eyes are for.

fields.EN:
I'm curious as to why it isn't in
this area...
fields.JP: このエリアに無い理由も気になりますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious as to why it isn't in
this area...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I've been bothered by
them for a while, too...
fields.JP:
うん。僕もあの『眼』のことは、ずっと
気になっていたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I've been bothered by
them for a while, too...

fields.EN:
Why don't we just smash the core
first? There must be something
protecting it, like the others.
fields.JP:
ま……まあ、とりあえず核をやっちゃおうよ。
仕組みが他とだいたい同じってことは、
ここを護ってる奴もそこらにいる筈だしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we just smash the core
first? There must be something
protecting it, like the others.

fields.EN:
Guess so. It's not a good idea to
just chit-chat the day away.
fields.JP:
そうね。こんなところで無駄話をしてるのは、
ちょっと不用心ってものよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess so. It's not a good idea to
just chit-chat the day away.

fields.EN:
I see some intruders planning
something interesting here.
fields.JP:
面白そうなことをしているこそ泥さんも
あったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see some intruders planning
something interesting here.

fields.EN:
And why would they want to destroy
the core?
fields.JP: 核を壊して、どうしようというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And why would they want to destroy
the core?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but it's our duty to do
so.
fields.JP: 悪いけど、仕事なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but it's our duty to do
so.

fields.EN:
Answered like a true intruder.
Barging into one's house, calling
it a "duty."
fields.JP:
こそ泥さんはこそ泥さんね。
ひとの家を荒らして、仕事と言うのだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Answered like a true intruder.
Barging into one's house, calling
it a "duty."

fields.EN:
Gretel? Do you have a minute?
We just want to talk to you.
fields.JP:
グレーテル……
僕たち、君と少し話がしたいんだ。駄目かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel? Do you have a minute?
We just want to talk to you.

fields.JP: この子、少し借りていくわね

fields.EN:
(Wh-What the...?! My stomach feels
like it's turning inside out...)
fields.JP:
（な……何だ、この感じ……！？
　お腹の中がひっくり返る感じっていうか……
　心もとないっていうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What the...?! My stomach feels
like it's turning inside out...)

fields.EN: Wh-Where am I?! What was that?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Wh-Where am I?! What was that?!

fields.EN:
Well, it's a secret. No one would
answer or explain to an intruder,
would they?
fields.JP:
さあ……内緒。
こそ泥さんに手の内は見せられないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's a secret. No one would
answer or explain to an intruder,
would they?

fields.JP: 僕たちは泥棒なんかじゃ……！

fields.EN:
If you really think this is your
home, then I suppose me being
an intruder is right.
fields.JP:
でも……ここを家だと思ってるなら、
僕らが荒らしてるって言われても、
無理は無いんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you really think this is your
home, then I suppose me being
an intruder is right.

fields.EN:
I've never seen an intruder act in
humility before. Do you think that
will get you off the hook?
fields.JP:
わざわざ荒らしに来て恐縮する泥棒さんなんて、
初めて見たわね。
でも……それが許されると思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen an intruder act in
humility before. Do you think that
will get you off the hook?

fields.EN:
So, our members who went missing
were...
fields.JP:
じゃあ……調査隊が行方不明になったのって、
やっぱり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, our members who went missing
were...

fields.EN:
Anyone would defend themselves
from intrusion, no?
fields.JP: 誰だって自衛はするものでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyone would defend themselves
from intrusion, no?

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? What do you want with
me?
fields.JP:
あの、グレーテル？
それで僕を一体……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? What do you want with
me?

fields.EN:
Hm... What to do? We have so much
time since your friends won't be
able to reach this place easily...
fields.JP:
さあ……どうしようかしら？
お仲間もそうそう追っては来れないでしょうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... What to do? We have so much
time since your friends won't be
able to reach this place easily...

fields.EN:
Relax. That's a joke. I just want
to speak with you.
fields.JP:
嘘よ。少しお話がしたいだけ。
……安心していいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Relax. That's a joke. I just want
to speak with you.

fields.JP: あなたが一番、お話ししやすそうだから

fields.EN:
Oh, I see. Um, I did want to speak
with you, too.
fields.JP:
……そ、そうなんだ。
あ、でも、僕も話がしたかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. Um, I did want to speak
with you, too.

fields.EN:
You're a strange one. Brave, yet
open. Inquisitive, yet gullible.
fields.JP:
……あなたはおかしな人ね。
勇敢なくせに、とても無防備。
知りたいくせに疑うことを知らない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a strange one. Brave, yet
open. Inquisitive, yet gullible.

fields.EN:
Foolhardy, then? If you see
Nightmares as enemies, you should
have your guard up against me.
fields.JP:
ならば蛮勇なのかしら？
ナイトメアと敵対しているのならば、
この私にももっと警戒しなければ駄目よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Foolhardy, then? If you see
Nightmares as enemies, you should
have your guard up against me.

fields.EN:
So, what's this "eye" you were all
talking about?
fields.JP:
ねえ、さっきあなたたちが話してた
『眼』って何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what's this "eye" you were all
talking about?

fields.EN:
We're not sure, but there's always
a wall in each area with an eye on
it. Almost like it's watching us.
fields.JP:
それは……僕らにもよくわからないんだけど、
他のエリアには必ず壁にあって……
なんだか僕らを見てるみたいにみえるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not sure, but there's always
a wall in each area with an eye on
it. Almost like it's watching us.

fields.EN:
Next question. What's a "Blood
Maiden?" It seems as if your
friends are "Blood Maidens," too.
fields.JP:
それじゃ、本題だけど……『血式少女』って、何？
聞いている限り、あなたのお仲間が『血式少女』
なのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next question. What's a "Blood
Maiden?" It seems as if your
friends are "Blood Maidens," too.

fields.EN:
Yes, but all we know is that Blood
Maidens are powerful, and heal
faster than normal people.
fields.JP:
うん……でも、僕らにもよくわからないんだ。
ただ……普通の人よりも力が強いし、怪我の治りも
早いんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but all we know is that Blood
Maidens are powerful, and heal
faster than normal people.

fields.EN:
Also, Marchen blood makes them
stronger. It changes their form
and the color of their eyes.
fields.JP:
それから……メルヒェンの血で、強くなる……
っていうか、目の色がピンクになって、
姿が変わるっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, Marchen blood makes them
stronger. It changes their form
and the color of their eyes.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... What I'm saying must
sound confusing.
fields.JP: ごめん……こんな説明じゃ、よくわからないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... What I'm saying must
sound confusing.

fields.JP: （や、やっぱ困らせちゃったかな……）

fields.EN:
From what I've just heard, it's
quite possible I'm a Blood Maiden,
as well.
fields.JP:
……話を聞く限り、私が血式少女である可能性は
十分に考えられるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what I've just heard, it's
quite possible I'm a Blood Maiden,
as well.

fields.EN:
Well then, come with us! Come and
join us in our fight!
fields.JP:
それならやっぱり、僕たちと一緒に行こうよ！
それで、一緒に戦おうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, come with us! Come and
join us in our fight!

fields.JP:
戦う……？
一体、何と戦うというのかしら？

fields.EN:
We're with the Dawn, and we're
trying to find a way to escape
from the Jail!
fields.JP:
僕たち……黎明は、僕たちを閉じ込めている
このジェイルから、みんなで地上に抜け出そうと
してるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're with the Dawn, and we're
trying to find a way to escape
from the Jail!

fields.EN:
That's why we're destroying the
cores, to grow the Tower and
reach the surface.
fields.JP:
そのために核を破壊して、
あの高い塔を成長させて……
そうしたら、そこから地上に行けるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we're destroying the
cores, to grow the Tower and
reach the surface.

fields.EN:
You and your friends are very
kind.
fields.JP:
……お人好しなのね。
あなたも……お仲間たちも
fields.LOCALIZED:
You and your friends are very
kind.

fields.EN:
Oh? You didn't know? The Marchens
are also nurturing this realm and
the Tower you just mentioned.
fields.JP:
あら。まさか知らないのかしら？
メルヒェンたちもね、この場所とあのタワーを
育てているのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You didn't know? The Marchens
are also nurturing this realm and
the Tower you just mentioned.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. It seems you're all
working toward the same goal.
fields.JP:
ええ。……だとしたら、あなたたちは
同じ目的のために努力していることになるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. It seems you're all
working toward the same goal.

fields.EN:
Doesn't that intrigue you? I'm
surprised that thought didn't dawn
on any of you at all.
fields.JP:
とても面白いことだと思わないかしら？
……いいえ。あなたたちが今まで
そこに思い至らなかったことが不思議なくらい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't that intrigue you? I'm
surprised that thought didn't dawn
on any of you at all.

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? Do we need to fight
Hansel? He seems close to you,
so...
fields.JP:
あの、グレーテル……
ヘンゼルとはどうしても戦わなきゃいけないのかな？
君とはすごく仲が良さそうだし……ひょっとしたら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? Do we need to fight
Hansel? He seems close to you,
so...

fields.EN:
Aren't Nightmares your enemies?
If so, my brother Hansel-niisan is your
enemy, too.
fields.JP:
だってあなたたちにとって、ナイトメアは
敵なのでしょう？
ならばヘンゼル兄さんにとっても敵だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aren't Nightmares your enemies?
If so, my brother Hansel is your
enemy, too.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
B-But I don't think we have to
fight all of them. If we destroy
the core, we can leave this place.
fields.JP:
で……でも、必ずしも戦う必要はないと思うんだ。
核さえ壊せれば、僕らはそのままここから
立ち去るから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But I don't think we have to
fight all of them. If we destroy
the core, we can leave this place.

fields.JP: あなたは本当に、お人好しなのね

fields.EN:
The exit is there. Go straight,
and you'll be back to where you
were.
fields.JP:
お帰りはあちら。
まっすぐに行けば、さっきのところに戻れるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The exit is there. Go straight,
and you'll be back to where you
were.

fields.JP: ジャック……！　どこにいるの……！？
おーい！　ジャックー！

fields.EN:
(She actually did return me to
where everyone else was... I'd
better hurry on back!)
fields.JP:
（ほんとだ……みんなのいるところと近い場所に
　帰してくれたんだ……。
　とにかく、みんなのところへ行こう！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She actually did return me to
where everyone else was... I'd
better hurry on back!)

fields.EN:
Jack... I couldn't protect him...
Jack! What am I supposed to do?!
fields.JP:
ジャック……わたし……守れなかった……
ジャック、どうしたらいいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I couldn't protect him...
Jack! What am I supposed to do?!

fields.EN: I wonder where he was taken.
fields.JP: どこへ連れてかれたんでしょうね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder where he was taken.

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Wait up! Where are you
going?!
fields.JP: ちょ……一人でどこ探そうってのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Wait up! Where are you
going?!

fields.EN:
Jack...! I... I promised to him
that we'd escape together!
fields.JP:
でも、ジャックが……！
わたし……一緒にここを脱出するって……
生きて脱出するって約束したのだもの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...! I... I promised to him
that we'd escape together!

fields.EN:
Stop, Alice-san! Don't go wandering
out alone!
fields.JP:
駄目ですわ、アリスさん！
お一人では危険極まりないですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop, Alice! Don't go wandering
out alone!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP: でも、こうしている間にも……！

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored
Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Just calm down. Jack would never
forgive himself if something
happened to you!
fields.JP:
……とりあえず落ち着きなよ、アリス。
あんたに何かあったら、それこそジャックが
悲しむよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just calm down. Jack would never
forgive himself if something
happened to you!

fields.EN: We can all look for him, together.
fields.JP: だからさ、みんなで探そう
fields.LOCALIZED: We can all look for him, together.

fields.EN:
That's right. Um, y-you're not the
only one w-worried about him, you
know?
fields.JP:
そうよ。あんただけじゃなくて……
わ、私たちだって心配してるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Um, y-you're not the
only one w-worried about him, you
know?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. You're right... Let's
go look for Jack.
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
そうね……ジャックを探しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. You're right... Let's
go look for Jack.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
If that Gretel does something to
our lifeline, she's gonna get it!
fields.JP:
それにしてもあのグレーテルって子、
あたしらの命綱に何かしたら、承知しないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that Gretel does something to
our lifeline, she's gonna get it!

fields.EN:
It all happened in an instant...
What did she want with him?
fields.JP:
……一瞬のことだったわね。
あの子はジャックに一体、何をするつもりなの
かしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It all happened in an instant...
What did she want with him?

fields.EN:
You know, it's partially his
fault, too! He kept protecting
her, and now look what happened!
fields.JP:
だいたいジャックもジャックなのよ！
妙にあの子に肩入れしたりしてるから、
ああやって攫われたりするのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, it's partially his
fault, too! He kept protecting
her, and now look what happened!

fields.EN:
Jack-san won't be separated from us,
will he?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……白雪たちから離れたり
しませんよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack won't be separated from us,
will he?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Jack-san is too kind! That is why this
happened!
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは……優しすぎるんですわ！
だからこんなことに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is too kind! That is why this
happened!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Things are a chore without him
around. His disappearance is a
major pain.
fields.JP:
ジャックがいないと、いろいろ不便です～
こういう抜け駆けは迷惑です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things are a chore without him
around. His disappearance is a
major pain.

fields.EN:
She took Jack! Rapunzel get him
back!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、とられたーーーーーーーー！
ラプンツェル、とりかえす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She took Jack! Rapunzel get him
back!

fields.EN:
But looking around randomly is
only going to get us in trouble...
fields.JP:
……といっても、闇雲に探したって
相手の術中にはまるだけだろうしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But looking around randomly is
only going to get us in trouble...

fields.EN:
Indeed. We should search for him
quite carefully.
fields.JP: ええ。慎重に探す必要がありますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. We should search for him
quite carefully.

fields.EN:
Yes. If we end up in that
labyrinth again, we could all end
up dead.
fields.JP:
はい。またあの迷宮に入り込んでしまって、
もし仕掛けが変わっていたら……
白雪たちも全滅してしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. If we end up in that
labyrinth again, we could all end
up dead.

fields.EN:
Let's just search around here
first.
fields.JP: まずは、この辺りから探していきましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just search around here
first.

fields.EN:
Jack! If you can hear us, come on
out!
fields.JP:
ジャックー！
いたら出てきなさいよーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! If you can hear us, come on
out!

fields.JP: みんな、心配かけてごめん……！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: じゃっくだーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Glad to see you back. I figured
you'd find us, one way or the
other!
fields.JP:
無事合流できてよかったよ。
あんたのことだから、ちゃんと戻ってくるとは
信じてたけどね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad to see you back. I figured
you'd find us, one way or the
other!

fields.JP: ほんとに……よかったです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is so relieved to see
you...

fields.EN:
Jack, are you all right? Are you
hurt?
fields.JP:
ジャック、大丈夫？
その……怪我はない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, are you all right? Are you
hurt?

fields.EN:
I'm fine. She didn't do anything
to me...
fields.JP: うん。別に何もされてないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. She didn't do anything
to me...

fields.EN:
It seems like Gretel's interested
in us. She asked me a lot of
questions.
fields.JP:
グレーテルは、僕らに興味があるみたいなんだ。
いくつか質問されたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like Gretel's interested
in us. She asked me a lot of
questions.

fields.EN:
I see... So that means there's a
good chance she's a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
……ってことは、血式少女の可能性が高いって
わけだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So that means there's a
good chance she's a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
But what should we make of the
Marchens working toward the same
goal as we are?
fields.JP:
メルヒェンたちとわたしたちが、同じ目的のために
動いていたなんて……どう考えればいいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what should we make of the
Marchens working toward the same
goal as we are?

fields.EN:
Um, before that, we still don't
know her motive, right? You need
to ask the right questions.
fields.JP:
……っていうか、結局相手の考えてることは
たいしてわかんなかったってわけよね？
もっとちゃんと聞き出しなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, before that, we still don't
know her motive, right? You need
to ask the right questions.

fields.EN:
Actually, there is something we
know now, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP: いいえ、親指姫。ひとつわかったことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, there is something we
know now, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
We know that regardless of her
intellect, she's the type to do
anything to attain her goal.
fields.JP:
彼女がそれなりの知性を持っているにも関わらず、
目的のためには手段を選ばない類の人間である
ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We know that regardless of her
intellect, she's the type to do
anything to attain her goal.

fields.EN:
But, she explained how anyone
would protect their home from
intruders.
fields.JP:
でも、自分の家を踏み荒らされたら、誰だって
抵抗するんじゃないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she explained how anyone
would protect their home from
intruders.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean she should kill
everyone. Her relationship with
that Nightmare isn't our concern.
fields.JP:
いいえ。全滅までさせる必要はなかったはず……
つまり、たとえ彼女が血式少女であっても、
あのナイトメアとどういう関係であっても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean she should kill
everyone. Her relationship with
that Nightmare isn't our concern.

fields.EN:
In other words, there's nothing
stopping us from destroying that
core.
fields.JP:
こちらが核を破壊することにためらう理由は、
もう何もないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, there's nothing
stopping us from destroying that
core.

fields.EN:
I guess you're right. After all,
she did abduct one of our
members...
fields.JP:
ま、それもそうよね。こっちは仲間を攫われた
わけなんだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're right. After all,
she did abduct one of our
members...

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! She needs to learn what
it means to make enemies of us!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ……！
わたくしたちを敵に回したらどうなるか……
存分に味わっていただかなくては！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! She needs to learn what
it means to make enemies of us!

fields.EN:
Um, everyone? I appreciate the
enthusiasm, but getting riled up
is only going to hurt us.
fields.JP:
あー、みんな。気持ちはわかるけどさ、
熱くなったら、相手の思う壺だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, everyone? I appreciate the
enthusiasm, but getting riled up
is only going to hurt us.

fields.EN:
Remember, our mission is to find
out what's happening here, and
destroy the core.
fields.JP:
あたしらの任務は、ここで起きてることの真相を
突き止めること……そして、核を破壊することだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember, our mission is to find
out what's happening here, and
destroy the core.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's get to work! First
we get rid of the guardian, then
we destroy the core! Got it?!
fields.JP:
というわけで、作戦行動に移るよ！
まずは核の守護者を叩いて、核を破壊しよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's get to work! First
we get rid of the guardian, then
we destroy the core! Got it?!

fields.EN:
There...! The Marchen guarding the
core!
fields.JP: いた……核を護ってるメルヒェンだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There...! The Marchen guarding the
core!

fields.JP: それじゃ、とっとと核を壊すわよ！

fields.EN:
That's the first time I've heard
the Jail wail like that.
fields.JP: ジェイルがこんな風に鳴くの、初めて聞いたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the first time I've heard
the Jail wail like that.

fields.EN:
Looks like you've done your duty
here.
fields.JP: 仕事は果たした、というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you've done your duty
here.

fields.EN: How long have you been there?!
fields.LOCALIZED: How long have you been there?!

fields.EN:
How in the world are you able to
appear and vanish like that?!
fields.JP:
あんた、一体どうやって、
現れたり消えたりしてるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How in the world are you able to
appear and vanish like that?!

fields.EN:
I thought I told Jack this, but
it's a secret. No one answers to
intruders, yes?
fields.JP:
内緒……と、ジャックに言ったはずだけど？
こそ泥さんに手の内は見せられないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I told Jack this, but
it's a secret. No one answers to
intruders, yes?

fields.EN:
I suppose that was Hansel-niisan's life
support.
fields.JP:
……これが、ヘンゼル兄さんの生命維持装置
だったというわけね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that was Hansel's life
support.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Jack, do you remember telling me
that the destruction of the core
makes the Tower grow?
fields.JP:
あなたが話してくれたのよ、ジャック。
核を破壊することが、あのタワーを成長させることに
繋がっているのだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, do you remember telling me
that the destruction of the core
makes the Tower grow?

fields.EN:
From what you said, it's easy to
assume that the core supplies
energy to the Jail and Nightmares.
fields.JP:
その言葉からすれば、核がジェイルやナイトメアへの
エネルギー供給を担っていることは容易に
推察できるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what you said, it's easy to
assume that the core supplies
energy to the Jail and Nightmares.

fields.JP: 謝らないわよ。なぜなら……

fields.EN:
Why, yes. This was your duty,
wasn't it?
fields.JP: ええ……あなたたちの仕事なのだものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. This was your duty,
wasn't it?

fields.EN:
No. It's because you let people
die on a whim.
fields.JP:
いいえ。あなたが面白半分に、人を見殺しに
してきたからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. It's because you let people
die on a whim.

fields.EN:
That's not true. I didn't let them
die. Hansel-niisan simply killed the
intruders who found their way in.
fields.JP:
あら。見殺しにしたんじゃないわ。
勝手に侵入してきた侵入者たちを、
ヘンゼル兄さんと一緒に始末したの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. I didn't let them
die. Hansel simply killed the
intruders who found their way in.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
You...! That's not how you treat
humans like yourself!
fields.JP:
あなた……！
同じ人間に対してすることではないでしょう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You...! That's not how you treat
humans like yourself!

fields.EN:
If a Nightmare protects an area,
then I'm also a Nightmare guarding
my home. Race doesn't matter.
fields.JP:
エリアを護る存在がナイトメアならば、
私もここ……私たちの家を護るナイトメアよ。
種族ではなく、在り方としてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If a Nightmare protects an area,
then I'm also a Nightmare guarding
my home. Race doesn't matter.

fields.EN:
You're Alice, right? You should
know what I'm talking about.
fields.JP:
あなた……アリスなのでしょう？
ならば、それがわからないあなたではない筈よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're Alice, right? You should
know what I'm talking about.

fields.EN:
What do you mean... Of course
I don't.
fields.JP:
あなたの言っている意味……
残念ながら、全くわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean... Of course
I don't.

fields.EN:
Listen carefully. You intruded
into our home and killed many of
my cute, little Marchens.
fields.JP:
いいこと？
あなたたちは、私たちの家を荒らし、私の可愛い
メルヒェンたちをたくさん殺したわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen carefully. You intruded
into our home and killed many of
my cute, little Marchens.

fields.JP:
メ……メルヒェンが可愛いって……この方、
正気ですの！？

fields.EN:
Marchens are deplorable to you,
no? If so, there's nothing I can
say to change your mind.
fields.JP:
あなたたちにとって、メルヒェンは害をなす
存在なのでしょう？
ならば、仕方のないことだと言えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchens are deplorable to you,
no? If so, there's nothing I can
say to change your mind.

fields.EN:
We acted in the same manner.
No... We acted justly, since you
were the ones intruding here.
fields.JP:
私たちのしてきたことは、それと全く同じ……
いいえ。それよりもはるかに筋が通っているわ。
私たちは、私たちの家を護っただけだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We acted in the same manner.
No... We acted justly, since you
were the ones intruding here.

fields.EN:
I suppose there's nothing I can
say to get through to you...
fields.JP: 立場の違い……というわけね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there's nothing I can
say to get through to you...

fields.EN:
Why, yes. You're correct. I'm
happy that you finally understand.
fields.JP:
ええ。そういうことね。
ようやく理解してもらえて嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. You're correct. I'm
happy that you finally understand.

fields.EN:
Gretel... Can we somehow get to
know each other better?
fields.JP:
グレーテル……
僕たち、どうにかわかり合えないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel... Can we somehow get to
know each other better?

fields.JP: わかり合うって……一体、何を？

fields.EN:
You may be a Nightmare, but you're
also a Blood Maiden, just like us.
fields.JP:
君はナイトメアなのかもしれない。
でも……僕らと同じ、血式少女でもあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be a Nightmare, but you're
also a Blood Maiden, just like us.

fields.EN:
Well, in my case, I'm a Blood
Youth...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, in my case, I'm a Blood
Youth...

fields.EN:
You said we're interesting, and
you asked me about the Blood
Maidens out of interest, right?
fields.JP:
君はさっき、僕らのことを興味深いって
言ったよね？　血式少女のことだって、
気になるから聞いたんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said we're interesting, and
you asked me about the Blood
Maidens out of interest, right?

fields.EN:
We won't fight Hansel, so why
don't you come with us and see
what we do?
fields.JP:
だから……ヘンゼルとは戦わないから……
君も僕たちと一緒に来て、せめて
僕たちについて調べるっていうのは、どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We won't fight Hansel, so why
don't you come with us and see
what we do?

fields.EN:
Jack? What in the world are you
saying?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? What in the world are you
saying?!

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're trying to
seduce her!
fields.JP: あんた、なんでこの子口説いてんのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're trying to
seduce her!

fields.JP: 無様な口説き方もあったものです～

fields.EN:
She's right. That's not how you
seduce others. You really are too
kind.
fields.JP:
……確かに無様な口説き方ね。
お人好しにも程があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. That's not how you
seduce others. You really are too
kind.

fields.EN:
Hm... Knowledge is alluring...
Knowledge of your own existence,
and of this absurd world...
fields.JP:
そうね……知ることはとても魅力的なこと……
自分自身の存在について……この不条理な世界に
ついて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Knowledge is alluring...
Knowledge of your own existence,
and of this absurd world...

fields.EN:
Knowledge may be better than
keeping my role here as a
Nightmare...
fields.JP: 時には、ナイトメアとしての役割よりも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowledge may be better than
keeping my role here as a
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Still, I was born and raised with
Hansel-niisan. We've been
together all this time.
fields.JP:
けれど、私はヘンゼル兄さんに育てられ、
そしてずっと一緒に生きてきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I was born and raised with
my brother, Hansel. We've been
together all this time.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan is my precious brother, and
this is my precious home. I have
no intention of leaving.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは大切な家族だし、ここは私の
大切な生家よ。だから、ここから離れるつもりは
ないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel is my precious brother, and
this is my precious home. I have
no intention of leaving.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Leave. If you leave now, I'll let
you all go out of respect to his
unique kindness.
fields.JP:
……お行きなさい。このまま立ち去るのなら、
このお人好しに免じて、特別に見逃してあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave. If you leave now, I'll let
you all go out of respect to his
unique kindness.

fields.EN:
But if we meet again... You know
what will happen, yes?
fields.JP: でも……次に出会ってしまったら……わかるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we meet again... You know
what will happen, yes?

fields.JP:
待ってよ、グレーテル！
君は本当は……！

fields.EN: Should we... just head back like this?
fields.JP: わたしたちは……このまま帰るべきなのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED: Should we just leave her alone?

fields.EN:
Shirayuki doesn't want to fight
her...
fields.JP: 白雪も……なんだか戦いたくないです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White doesn't want to fight
her...

fields.EN:
But if we leave, whoever decides
to come here will become her next
victim...
fields.JP:
でも……わたくしたちは見逃されたとしても、
今後訪れる人はきっと、犠牲になりますわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we leave, whoever decides
to come here will become her next
victim...

fields.EN:
I was thinking the same thing.
There's no way humans can ever get
along with Nightmares.
fields.JP:
私も同じ意見ね。所詮、人間とナイトメアは
共存なんかできないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was thinking the same thing.
There's no way humans can ever get
along with Nightmares.

fields.JP: ……あたしも親指たちと同意見かな

fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Sure this place is weird, and that
Hansel Nightmare may be different
from the others.
fields.JP:
確かにここは、何もかもがおかしな場所だし、
ヘンゼルってナイトメアも例外的な奴なのかも
しれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure this place is weird, and that
Hansel Nightmare may be different
from the others.

fields.EN:
But, like Cinderella said, this
place is dangerous nonetheless.
fields.JP:
でも、シンデレラの言った通り、ここが危険な
場所であることは変わらない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, like Cinderella said, this
place is dangerous nonetheless.

fields.EN:
And like Dad said, there's no
telling what might happen here. If
Snark had something planned...
fields.JP:
それに……お父さんが言った通り、いつ何が
起きるか見当もつかないんだ。
スナークがもし、何か企んだら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like Dad said, there's no
telling what might happen here. If
Snark had something planned...

fields.EN:
...There's a chance that girl will
be in danger, too. Is that what
you wanted to say?
fields.JP:
……あの子にも危険が及ぶ可能性は高い……
というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...There's a chance that girl will
be in danger, too. Is that what
you wanted to say?

fields.EN:
It's just a guess. That she hasn't
entered Blood Skelter yet is
probably due to sheer luck.
fields.JP:
あくまで、あたしの考えだけどね。
あの子だって、今までブラッドスケルター化
しなかったのは、運が良かったに過ぎないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a guess. That she hasn't
entered Blood Skelter yet is
probably due to sheer luck.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルもそのぶらなんとかしてないよ！

fields.EN:
Ahaha... I don't think we need to
worry much about you, but you were
just as lucky as she was.
fields.JP:
あはは……あんたはその心配は少なそうだね。
でも、あんただって運が良かっただけだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha... I don't think we need to
worry much about you, but you were
just as lucky as she was.

fields.JP: ううーーーーずるーい！

fields.EN:
Now, now, I didn't mean it like
that...
fields.JP: ずるくない、ずるくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, I didn't mean it like
that...

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, the Dawn won't be
able to care for Hansel. He may
just become a new test subject.
fields.JP:
それに残念ながら、黎明だってヘンゼルのことまで
保護はできないよ。できるとすれば、実験体として
だろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, the Dawn won't be
able to care for Hansel. He may
just become a new test subject.

fields.EN:
So, I want to make sure we solve
any potential problems that could
hit us in the future.
fields.JP:
だから……
あたしは、後顧の憂いは潰しておきたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I want to make sure we solve
any potential problems that could
hit us in the future.

fields.EN:
Even if it means Gretel-san would 
hate us for our actions?
fields.JP: グレーテルさんに恨まれても……ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if it means Gretel would 
hate us for our actions?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
If anybody's going to be hated,
it'll be me.
fields.JP: ……その時は、あたしが恨まれるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anybody's going to be hated,
it'll be me.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: グレーテル……ミンナガキタヨ……

fields.EN:
Looks like we meet again. And to
think I gave you a free pass out
of here.
fields.JP:
結局、また出会ってしまったわね。
せっかく見逃してあげると言ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we meet again. And to
think I gave you a free pass out
of here.

fields.EN:
We decided this would bring
about the best results.
fields.JP: これが、最善の形を話し合った結果なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We decided this would bring
about the best results.

fields.EN:
Yes, I expected you to come to
this conclusion.
fields.JP: ええ。アリスなら当然の答えよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I expected you to come to
this conclusion.

fields.EN:
Stop right there... I'm the one
who made the call.
fields.JP: 待ってよ。決めたのは……あたしだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop right there... I'm the one
who made the call.

fields.JP: あなたが？　ふうん……そうなの

fields.EN:
So if you're going to begrudge
anyone, it's me.
fields.JP: だから……恨むなら、あたしにしなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if you're going to begrudge
anyone, it's me.

fields.EN:
Begrudge? You expect me to harbor
human emotion? I'm surprised that
you're speaking as if you'll win.
fields.JP:
恨むだなんて、人間的な感情を押し付けるのね。
しかも、勝つ気でいるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Begrudge? You expect me to harbor
human emotion? I'm surprised that
you're speaking as if you'll win.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
I will... protect... Gretel... and
our home...
fields.JP: ボクハ、グレーテルト、コノイエヲ、マモルヨ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will... protect... Gretel... and
our home...

fields.JP: ココハ……ボクタチノ、ダイジナ、イエダ
ジャック！　ぼんやりしてるんじゃないわよ！
そうよ……行きましょう、赤ずきんさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right... Let's go, Red
Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: グレーテルハ、サガッテテ
グレーテル……ドコ……グレ……テ……ル……
ヘンゼル兄さん……私はここにいるわ
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: グレ……テ……ル……ブジ……ヨカッタ……

fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White can't do this anymore!

fields.EN:
Get a hold of yourself! There's no
turning back now!
fields.JP:
今更後に引けないわよ！
しっかりしなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Get a hold of yourself! There's no
turning back now!

fields.EN:
She's right. It's rude to Hansel
to be sorry now. He fought for
what was precious to him.
fields.JP:
そうよ……哀れみなど、ヘンゼルに失礼だわ。
彼は、大切なもののために戦ったのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. It's rude to Hansel
to be sorry now. He fought for
what was precious to him.

fields.EN:
We're doing the same... for what's
precious...
fields.JP: わらわたちも……大切なもののために
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're doing the same... for what's
precious...

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: ヘンゼル兄さん……よく頑張ったわ……
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: 大丈夫よ……ヘンゼル兄さん……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be fine, dear brother Hansel.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: ゴメン……グ……レーテ……ル……ゴメン……

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: やっぱり……そうでしたのね……

fields.EN:
Thank you for all you've done,
Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP: ……今までありがとう、ヘンゼル兄さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for all you've done,
dear brother.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Thank... you... for being...
with... me... I'm... sorry...
fields.JP:
イッショニイテクレテ、アリガトウ……
……ズット……ゴメンネ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank... you... for being...
with... me... I'm... sorry...

fields.EN:
(They really cared for each other,
just like any other family...)
fields.JP:
（このふたりは……ほんとにお互いを大事に思ってる
　家族、だったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They really cared for each other,
just like any other family...)

fields.JP: （……本当にこれしかなかったのかな……）

わーーー！　じゃっくのちだーーーー！
とってもおいしいのーーー！

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I thought you were
going to go on a rampage, so...
fields.JP:
いきなりごめん……その、暴走するかも
しれないと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I thought you were
going to go on a rampage, so...

fields.EN:
With how she is now, I wouldn't be
surprised if she entered Blood
Skelter. Nice call, Jack.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。今のこの子なら、
ブラッドスケルター化してもおかしくないよ。
ジャック、よく気が付いたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how she is now, I wouldn't be
surprised if she entered Blood
Skelter. Nice call, Jack.

fields.EN:
Everyone else noticed, too. If
anything, this is about all I can
do for her...
fields.JP:
みんなだって気付いてたみたいだし、
僕にはこのくらいしかできないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone else noticed, too. If
anything, this is about all I can
do for her...

fields.EN: I see. So this is your power.
fields.JP: ……そう。それがあなたの力なのね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. So this is your power.

fields.EN:
True. Despite my lack of emotions,
I felt something swelling inside
me that I had never felt before.
fields.JP:
確かに……感情など持たないと思っていた
この私が、その奔流に呑まれそうになったわ。
今までにない衝動だった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. Despite my lack of emotions,
I felt something swelling inside
me that I had never felt before.

fields.EN:
I suppose there were emotions
inside me, after all.
fields.JP: 私にも、そんなことはあるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there were emotions
inside me, after all.

fields.EN:
It can't be helped... You lost
someone you loved...
fields.JP: 無理もないよ……肉親を亡くしたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped... You lost
someone you loved...

fields.EN:
No. I'm referring to the emotion
of succumbing to my animalistic
behavior as a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
いいえ。興味深いと思ったのよ。
自分でも知らなかった、血式少女としての習性が
……そして、体験したことのない感情の動きが
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I'm referring to the emotion
of succumbing to my animalistic
behavior as a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
I know this isn't the time to say
this, but we'd prefer you not to
call your powers "animalistic"...
fields.JP:
こんな時に言いたかないけど、
『習性』とか、動物みたいに言わないでよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know this isn't the time to say
this, but we'd prefer you not to
call your powers "animalistic"...

fields.EN:
That's an odd comment. We are
creatures like any other, and
merely categorized within it.
fields.JP:
あら。私たち生物は、遍く動植物かその中間に
分類される筈でしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an odd comment. We are
creatures like any other, and
merely categorized within it.

fields.EN:
*sigh* I know you're not evil, but
you're a bit on the weird side...
fields.JP:
はあ……あんたは悪人なんじゃなくて、
変わってるってことだけはわかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I know you're not evil, but
you're a bit on the weird side...

fields.EN:
I have a feeling trying to
understand you is gonna pose a
huge challenge...
fields.JP:
意思の疎通って意味では、そっちの方が
厄介かもしれないけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a feeling trying to
understand you is gonna pose a
huge challenge...

fields.EN:
That can simply be resolved by
sharing information on our
differences.
fields.JP:
生育環境の違いに由来する、情報の不足が
解消されれば、特に問題はないと思うけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
That can simply be resolved by
sharing information on our
differences.

fields.EN:
That sounds quite tasteless,
coming from the side who brought
this about.
fields.JP:
殺した側がそれを言うのは、野暮というもの
じゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds quite tasteless,
coming from the side who brought
this about.

fields.EN:
However, it is kind... I do
appreciate that you recognized me
and my brother as a "family."
fields.JP:
……本当にお人好しね。
でも、肉親と言ってくれて感謝するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, it is kind... I do
appreciate that you recognized me
and my brother as a "family."

fields.EN:
Yes... I suppose I felt "sad," but
Hansel-niisan seemed satisfied with the
results, so...
fields.JP:
そうね……思ったよりは悲しかったけれど……
でも、ヘンゼル兄さんは納得していたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I suppose I felt "sad," but
Hansel seemed satisfied with the
results, so...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Why, yes. Satisfied that I will
leave our home to live a normal
life as I should.
fields.JP:
ええ。私がこの家から離れて、本来在るべき
生き方を選ぶことを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. Satisfied that I will
leave our home to live a normal
life as I should.

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan said that he was fine with
you all defeating him. He has
entrusted me to you.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは、あなたたちが自分を倒せた
のなら、それでいいと言ってくれたの。
あなたたちに……託してくれたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel said that he was fine with
you all defeating him. He has
entrusted me to you.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
As such, I have decided I will
accompany you.
fields.JP: だから私は、あなたたちと行くわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As such, I have decided I will
accompany you.

fields.EN:
H-Hey, wait! I thought you said
you were going to live here and
protect this place?!
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ！
あんたさっき、ここを守って生きてるって
言ってたじゃない！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, wait! I thought you said
you were going to live here and
protect this place?!

fields.EN:
Yes, but this is an empty house
now. The brother and sister that
were once here are now gone.
fields.JP:
ええ。でも、ここはもう空き家になったわ。
住んでいた兄と妹は、いなくなってしまったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but this is an empty house
now. The brother and sister that
were once here are now gone.

fields.EN:
So you're saying that your role
here is done?
fields.JP: つまり、ここでの役割は終わったというのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're saying that your role
here is done?

fields.EN:
Yes. Siblings can bind each other
together at times. Hansel-niisan had
known that all along.
fields.JP:
ええ。兄妹というものは、時に互いを縛り合う
もの……ヘンゼル兄さんも、そのことは
理解していたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Siblings can bind each other
together at times. Hansel had
known that all along.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
I have an interest in my existence
as a Blood Maiden and in the
existence of this world.
fields.JP:
私は、私という存在……血式少女というもの……
そして、この不条理な世界の在り方に
とても興味があるの。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have an interest in my existence
as a Blood Maiden and in the
existence of this world.

fields.EN:
If you all don't mind, I would be
interested in joining you as... a
Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
あなたたちさえ構わなければ、迎えてもらえない
かしら。……血式少女として
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you all don't mind, I would be
interested in joining you as... a
Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
It turns out there was no reason
against Gretel joining us, so
she's a member of the Dawn now.
fields.JP:
……結局、拒む理由もないってことで、
グレーテルを黎明に迎えることになったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It turns out there was no reason
against Gretel joining us, so
she's a member of the Dawn now.

fields.EN:
She's different, and while the
others had varying thoughts on
it... I hope everyone gets along.
fields.JP:
風変わりな子だし、微妙な反応の子もいたし
……みんなとうまくやっていけるかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's different, and while the
others had varying thoughts on
it... I hope everyone gets along.

fields.EN: (After everything that's happened, maybe it'd be stranger if she could just come to terms with it. Honestly, I'm still confused myself...)
fields.JP:
（あれだけの経緯があれば、すんなり割り切れる
　方が無理なのかもしれないし、僕も正直、
　まだ戸惑ってるんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised she's so calm about
what she went through... It seems
like I'm more concerned than her.)

fields.EN:
(I'm interested to know what the
Professor and Michiru-san are talking
about with Gretel...)
fields.JP:
（……博士たちやミチルさんたちが、
　グレーテルとどういう話し合いをしてるのかも
　気になる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm interested to know what the
Professor and Michiru are talking
about with Gretel...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, how did she
know so much about us?)
fields.JP:
（それに……僕たちのことを、あの子はどうして
　あんなに知ってるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, how did she
know so much about us?)

fields.EN:
(In particular, it seemed as if
she already knew Alice pretty
well...)
fields.JP:
（特にアリスとは、どこか判り合っているように
　さえ見えた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In particular, it seemed as if
she already knew Alice pretty
well...)

fields.EN:
(Her approach to Alice is
completely different from the way
Alice and I interact...)
fields.JP:
（僕とアリスが作り上げてきた信頼関係とは、
　もっと全然違う何かなような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her approach to Alice is
completely different from the way
Alice and I interact...)

fields.EN:
That was tiring, but the
discussion was quite interesting.
fields.JP: ……疲れたけど、興味深い会話ではあったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was tiring, but the
discussion was quite interesting.

fields.EN:
Oh? What's with the surprised
expression?
fields.JP: あら。何をびっくりした顔をしているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? What's with the surprised
expression?

fields.EN:
It's because you came in here all
of a sudden!
fields.JP: き……君がいきなり部屋に入ってきたからだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because you came in here all
of a sudden!

fields.EN:
Is there a problem? I did open
and close the door according to
its function.
fields.JP:
……何か、不都合なことでもあるのかしら？
私はきちんと扉を開閉して入ってきたわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a problem? I did open
and close the door according to
its function.

fields.EN:
Um... Most people knock before
coming in...
fields.JP:
いや……普通、他人の部屋に入るときには、
ノックしてから入るんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Most people knock before
coming in...

fields.EN:
Hm... I must say, that's a
bothersome custom. However, I'll
remember that.
fields.JP:
ふうん……面倒臭い風習があるのね。
でも、忘れないよう心がけるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I must say, that's a
bothersome custom. However, I'll
remember that.

fields.EN: Th-Thanks... So, how did it go?
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう。それで……
話し合いはどうだったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Th-Thanks... So, how did it go?

fields.EN:
They confirmed my admission as a
Blood Maiden, and said they would
prepare a room for me later.
fields.JP:
ええ。正式に血式少女として加わることが
認められたわ。
私の部屋とやらも、追って用意されるそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They confirmed my admission as a
Blood Maiden, and said they would
prepare a room for me later.

fields.EN:
Until then, I'll be rooming with
Alice.
fields.JP:
ひとまず、アリスのところに間借りすることに
なったみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until then, I'll be rooming with
Alice.

fields.EN:
Yes. I don't know their reasoning,
but I'm glad I'll be with someone
I can get along with.
fields.JP:
ええ。選定の基準はよくわからないけれど、
気の合う相手でよかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I don't know their reasoning,
but I'm glad I'll be with someone
I can get along with.

fields.EN:
(Get along with... If Alice heard
that, she'd probably deny it
completely...)
fields.JP:
（『気の合う相手』って……アリスが聞いたら、
　全力で否定しそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Get along with... If Alice heard
that, she'd probably deny it
completely...)

fields.EN:
I-I see... Well, that's good. It's
best to be in a place where you
can rest easily.
fields.JP:
そ、そう……よかったね。
少しでもゆっくり休めた方がいいもんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see... Well, that's good. It's
best to be in a place where you
can rest easily.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you'll need some time
to settle in. Why don't you take a
rest? You've been through a lot.
fields.JP:
じゃあその……しばらく落ち着かないだろうけど、
ゆっくり休むといいよ。
その……いろいろあったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you'll need some time
to settle in. Why don't you take a
rest? You've been through a lot.

fields.EN:
That was my plan. But before
that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was my plan. But before
that...

fields.EN:
We're... outside of the Liberated
District?
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're... outside of the Liberated
District?

fields.EN:
I wanted to speak with you in
private. There are a number of
questions I'd like answered.
fields.JP:
……あなたとだけ話したかったの。
知りたいことが山ほどあるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to speak with you in
private. There are a number of
questions I'd like answered.

fields.JP: あなたがお人好しだから

fields.EN:
I'm still analyzing the others,
so I didn't want them to overhear
us.
fields.JP:
……他の人たちのことは、まだ分析中だから
立ち聞きなどされたくなかったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still analyzing the others,
so I didn't want them to overhear
us.

fields.EN: You don't trust them yet, do you?
fields.JP: ……みんなのこと、やっぱり疑ってるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't trust them yet, do you?

fields.EN:
No. I just don't know them well
enough.
fields.JP: いいえ。まだよく知らないだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I just don't know them well
enough.

fields.EN:
From what I've seen, the fact that
you didn't want to kill Hansel-niisan
brands you as someone... unique.
fields.JP:
でも、彼らの説明を聞いた限り、あの状況で
ヘンゼル兄さんを倒したくないと言うなんて、
あなたはとても異質なのじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what I've seen, the fact that
you didn't want to kill Hansel
brands you as someone... unique.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
I'm... sorry about what happened
to him.
fields.JP: ヘンゼルのこと……ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... sorry about what happened
to him.

fields.EN:
There's no need to apologize.
Everything ended as it should
have.
fields.JP:
いいえ。気にしていないわ
在るべき形に収まっただけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no need to apologize.
Everything ended as it should
have.

fields.EN:
I really don't understand what
you're saying...
fields.JP:
君の言ってること、やっぱりよくわからないん
だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't understand what
you're saying...

fields.EN:
I don't know myself well either,
but how many can truly say they
know themselves well?
fields.JP:
私も私のことなどよくわからないわ。
でも……自分のことをよく知っている人なんて、
どれだけいるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know myself well either,
but how many can truly say they
know themselves well?

fields.EN:
The people of the Dawn are hiding
something. I can tell because
their stories are too orderly.
fields.JP:
黎明の人たちは、みんな何かを隠しているのね。
一見、話が整然としすぎているから、
それがわかるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The people of the Dawn are hiding
something. I can tell because
their stories are too orderly.

fields.EN:
I believe the members of the Blood
Team are aware of that. Your
flustered attitude is proof of it.
fields.JP:
あら。あなたを含め、血式少女たちの全てが
それに気付いていないとは思わないわ。
現に今、あなたは動揺している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe the members of the Blood
Team are aware of that. Your
flustered attitude is proof of it.

fields.EN:
They're all good people here, so I
don't want to doubt them...
fields.JP:
みんないい人たちだから……
できれば……疑いたくなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're all good people here, so I
don't want to doubt them...

fields.EN:
(Why am I saying this to someone
I don't know very well?)
fields.JP:
（僕はどうして、まだよく知らないこの子に
　こんなことを話してるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why am I saying this to someone
I don't know very well?)

fields.EN:
Strong emotions can cloud one's
eyes from the truth. Everyone
seems to be trapped by emotions.
fields.JP:
強い感情は、真実に対して目を曇らせるものよ。
そして、あなたのお仲間たちのほとんどが、
強い感情に囚われているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strong emotions can cloud one's
eyes from the truth. Everyone
seems to be trapped by emotions.

fields.EN:
All the Blood Maidens have a
particular attachment to
something. Am I wrong?
fields.JP:
血式少女はみんな、
何かにこだわりを持っている。
……違うかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the Blood Maidens have a
particular attachment to
something. Am I wrong?

fields.EN:
You see, I have this urge to
climb up the Tower...
fields.JP:
実は僕にも、変な衝動みたいなものがあるんだ。
……わけもなく、塔に昇りたいっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see, I have this urge to
climb up the Tower...

fields.EN:
It's an urge that's different from
wanting to escape from here...
fields.JP:
それは……脱出したい気持ちとはまた別って
いうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's an urge that's different from
wanting to escape from here...

fields.EN:
That's why I could relate to you
wanting your earring back. I just
wanted to get it back for you.
fields.JP:
だから……君がイヤリングが無いと、どうしても
不安でたまらなくなる気持ち、わかる気が
するんだ……だから、放っておけなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I could relate to you
wanting your earring back. I just
wanted to get it back for you.

fields.EN:
I haven't asked everyone yet, but
I'm sure they all have something
they're really attached to.
fields.JP:
全員に聞いたわけじゃないけど、他のみんなにも
そういうこだわりみたいなものがあるんじゃ
ないかって、思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't asked everyone yet, but
I'm sure they all have something
they're really attached to.

fields.EN:
(That's right... I had thought
about that before, too...)
fields.JP: （そうだ……確かに僕はそう感じたことがある）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I had thought
about that before, too...)

fields.EN:
But... Alice is different. She's
hindered more by logic than by
emotions.
fields.JP:
でも……アリスはあの中では異質な存在ね。
感情よりもむしろ理に囚われ、それ故に時として
足を掬われる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Alice is different. She's
hindered more by logic than by
emotions.

fields.EN:
Her attachment is rooted in logic.
In that sense, she bears greater
similarity to me.
fields.JP:
血式少女としてのこだわりが、感情よりも理に
根差しているのね。
……私と近しいとするならば、その点よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her attachment is rooted in logic.
In that sense, she bears greater
similarity to me.

fields.EN:
(Is that why Gretel thought they
could both get along? Is it
something they can both sense?)
fields.JP:
（それで……ふたりはどこかわかり合ってた
　感じがあったのかな……
　そういうのって、肌で感じるものなのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that why Gretel thought they
could both get along? Is it
something they can both sense?)

fields.EN:
But, Alice... She was captured so
that she could be with me...
fields.JP:
でも、アリスは……僕のために一緒に牢獄に
囚われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, Alice... She was captured so
that she could be with me...

fields.EN:
Yes... Her reason of being with
you is the same as the reason I
was with Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
ええ。私がヘンゼル兄さんと留まって
いたのと、同じ理由ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Her reason of being with
you is the same as the reason I
was with my brother, Hansel.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN: My hypothesis is that Alice seeks order even in an irrational world and tries to discern its true nature. I seek the optimal solution for my objective...
fields.JP:
私の仮説でいえば、アリスは条理無き世界でも
条理を求め、世界の本質を見極めようとする。
私は、目的のための最適解を探求する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice will seek logic even in an
illogical world, to see the truth
behind the world, as do I.

fields.EN:
The directions we face may be
different, but we share the same
outlook on lacking emotions.
fields.JP:
方向性は違えど、人間感情に乏しいことは
認めるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The directions we face may be
different, but we share the same
outlook on lacking emotions.

fields.EN:
The surprise and joy at knowing
selfless love, feeling it swell
within us, is invaluable.
fields.JP:
だからこそ……無償の愛に対する驚きと喜び、
自らの感情が揺れ動く感覚は、何にも代え難い
宝石のように映るものなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The surprise and joy at knowing
selfless love, feeling it swell
within us, is invaluable.

fields.EN:
Yes... An invaluable treasure
that we don't deserve.
fields.JP: そう……自分には勿体無い程の煌めき……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... An invaluable treasure
that we don't deserve.

fields.EN:
I don't understand what you're
saying...
fields.JP: 僕にはよくわからないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand what you're
saying...

fields.EN:
Oh? I believe your urge is
something that is different from
nature or emotions, as well.
fields.JP:
そうかしら？　あなたの持つ衝動も、生理的、
感情的なものに根ざすものではないと
思うのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I believe your urge is
something that is different from
nature or emotions, as well.

fields.EN:
Yours comes from a desire to know.
Unusual, given your kindness. Or,
maybe it's because you're kind.
fields.JP:
あなたの衝動の根本は『知りたい』ということ。
お人好しなのに、とても不思議ね？
それとも……お人好しだから、なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yours comes from a desire to know.
Unusual, given your kindness. Or,
maybe it's because you're kind.

fields.EN:
True... I do want to know a lot of
things, but...
fields.JP: 確かに僕は、いろんなことを知りたいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... I do want to know a lot of
things, but...

fields.EN:
(I see... I want to escape because
I want to know... I want to climb
the Tower to see what lies ahead.)
fields.JP:
（……そうか。知りたいから脱出したい……
　その先に何があるのか知りたいから、
　僕は上に昇りたいのかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... I want to escape because
I want to know... I want to climb
the Tower to see what lies ahead.)

fields.EN:
Let me ask, how do you know so
much about us?
fields.JP:
でも、どうして君は、僕らのことをそんなに
よく知ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask, how do you know so
much about us?

fields.EN:
That's easy. It's all based on
accumulated knowledge derived from
research and analysis.
fields.JP:
それは簡単なこと……たゆまぬ調査と分析による
知識の蓄積に基づいた仮説だからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's easy. It's all based on
accumulated knowledge derived from
research and analysis.

fields.EN:
I have plenty of books in my home,
and all the time in the world to
read them.
fields.JP:
私の家には、腐るほど『本』があったわ。
……ここにはさすがに負けるけれど。
そして、それを読む時間も無限にあったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have plenty of books in my home,
and all the time in the world to
read them.

fields.EN:
Within these books were story
characters with the same names as
ours, each with a unique goal.
fields.JP:
中には、私たちと『同じ名前』を持つ人物が
登場する『童話』があって、彼らはそれぞれ
固有の行動原理を持っていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Within these books were story
characters with the same names as
ours, each with a unique goal.

fields.EN:
Stories...?! With the same name as
ours...?!
fields.JP:
童……話……！？
僕たちと……同じ名前……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stories...?! With the same name as
ours...?!

fields.EN:
If this absurd world sought to
have the Blood Maidens exist...
fields.JP:
もし、この不条理な世界の要請で、私たち
血式少女という存在が生まれたのならば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this absurd world sought to
have the Blood Maidens exist...

fields.EN:
...It's of interest that we share
the same attachments as our
stories' counterparts.
fields.JP:
童話の人物たちと同じ名を持った私たちが
それに連なる衝動を持っていることは、とても
興味深いことだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...It's of interest that we share
the same attachments as our
stories' counterparts.

fields.EN:
Until now, I could analyze only
myself, but now that I've met
everyone, I've obtained proof.
fields.JP:
今までは、私個人に対する分析に過ぎなかった
けれど、みんなと出会って、仮説がひとつ
裏付けられたというわけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until now, I could analyze only
myself, but now that I've met
everyone, I've obtained proof.

fields.EN:
Does that mean our names have a
greater meaning than we think?
fields.JP:
それは……僕らの名前が思ったより大きな
意味を持ってるってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean our names have a
greater meaning than we think?

fields.EN:
I suppose you could say that. Now
then, back on the subject of the
Dawn...
fields.JP:
まあ、そういうことでもいいわ。
ところで、本題の黎明の人たちに話を戻すけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you could say that. Now
then, back on the subject of the
Dawn...

fields.EN:
Not one of them explained the
Marchens' motives. Nothing aside
from the dangers they pose to us.
fields.JP:
彼らはメルヒェンたちの行動の目的について……
誰一人として説明しなかったわ。
ただ、『人間に危害を加える』という以外はね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not one of them explained the
Marchens' motives. Nothing aside
from the dangers they pose to us.

fields.EN:
(She's right... I haven't heard an
explanation from anyone,
either...)
fields.JP: （確かに、誰もその話はしていない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right... I haven't heard an
explanation from anyone,
either...)

fields.EN:
The Jail harbors desires so it can
grow. The Marchens sense that,
so they work to satisfy the Jail.
fields.JP:
ジェイルは成長するための欲求を持っているの。
メルヒェンは、それを感知しては、
満たそうとして活動しているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail harbors desires so it can
grow. The Marchens sense that,
so they work to satisfy the Jail.

fields.EN:
This is quite easy to deduce with
a little observation.
fields.JP:
そんなこと、少し観察していればすぐに
わかろうというものなのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is quite easy to deduce with
a little observation.

fields.EN:
I see... So then the torturing we
experienced in prison was for
that...
fields.JP:
そうなんだ……
……じゃあ僕らが受けてたあの拷問も、
そのために……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So then the torturing we
experienced in prison was for
that...

fields.EN:
Blood is its nutrition. Screams
are its lullaby. Licking satisfies
its libido.
fields.JP:
血は養分。叫び声は子守唄。
舌での愛撫は性的な満足……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood is its nutrition. Screams
are its lullaby. Licking satisfies
its libido.

fields.EN:
They themselves satisfied the
Jail's desires back at home.
fields.JP:
私の『家』では、
彼らはそれを自律的に行っていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They themselves satisfied the
Jail's desires back at home.

fields.EN:
They themselves? You mean, the
Marchens where you lived were
doing those things on their own?
fields.JP:
自律的にって……君の住んでいた場所では、
メルヒェンが自分たちで……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They themselves? You mean, the
Marchens where you lived were
doing those things on their own?

fields.EN:
Why, yes. It kept them busy, at
least enough to not attack me.
fields.JP:
そうね……少なくとも、私は襲われることなく
暮らしていたもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. It kept them busy, at
least enough to not attack me.

fields.EN:
If what the Marchens are doing is
sufficient, why are they capturing
and torturing humans?
fields.JP:
メルヒェンだけで問題ないなら……
どうしてわざわざ人間を捕らえて拷問なんか
してたんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If what the Marchens are doing is
sufficient, why are they capturing
and torturing humans?

fields.EN:
I heard from others that the
Nightmares mercilessly attack
humans, but that's not so.
fields.JP:
たとえば、ナイトメアは人間を容赦なく襲う敵
だと聞いたけれど、そんなことはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard from others that the
Nightmares mercilessly attack
humans, but that's not so.

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan had never attacked humans
until he determined they were
intruders to be eliminated.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは、人間に敵意なんて
持っていなかったもの
敵対的な侵入者だと判断した場合を除いてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel had never attacked humans
until he determined they were
intruders to be eliminated.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
And I never believed Hansel-niisan to be
any different from the other
Nightmares.
fields.JP:
それに私は、ヘンゼル兄さんが特殊な存在
だったとは考えてはいないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I never believed Hansel to be
any different from the other
Nightmares.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
I believe the other Nightmares
were able to speak too, yes?
fields.JP:
他所のナイトメアも、言葉を喋ったことがある
のでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe the other Nightmares
were able to speak too, yes?

fields.EN:
But if they're no different, then
why were your Marchens and Hansel
different from the others?
fields.JP:
でも、他と変わらないならなんで、
君が住んでいた場所のメルヒェンや
ヘンゼルだけ他の奴らとは違うんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if they're no different, then
why were your Marchens and Hansel
different from the others?

fields.EN:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have the
"eye" you made mention of before?
fields.JP:
他のエリアには必ずあった『眼』が、
あの場所にはなかったことが関係あるとは
思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have the
"eye" you made mention of before?

fields.EN:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
some time.
fields.JP:
もう一つ言えば……あの場所には、
ずっと誰も入ってこれなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
some time.

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail to monitor
us.
fields.JP:
黎明の誰かがジェイルと通じていて、
ジェイルの中や私たちのことを監視している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail to monitor
us.

fields.EN: Has that ever occurred to you?
fields.JP: ……そうは思ってみたことはない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Has that ever occurred to you?

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, that would
explain why something didn't feel
right here...)
fields.JP:
（でも確かに……そう考えれば、
　これまで感じた違和感に説明がつく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, that would
explain why something didn't feel
right here...)

fields.EN:
I'm thoroughly interested in
knowing who this person is, and
what motivations lie beneath.
fields.JP:
その『誰か』が誰なのか……
目的はどこにあるのか……とても興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm thoroughly interested in
knowing who this person is, and
what motivations lie beneath.

fields.EN:
Let's just say that it's safe to
assume there's more information
in the Dawn than you expect.
fields.JP:
いずれにせよ……あの施設の中は、あなたの思う
以上に情報が収集管理されていると思って
間違いないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just say that it's safe to
assume there's more information
in the Dawn than you expect.

fields.EN:
Your discussions there should only
be what you don't mind sharing, or
indeed, what you wish to be known.
fields.JP:
だから……あの施設で会話をするのなら、
与えても差し支えない……または、与えたい
内容にするべきね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your discussions there should only
be what you don't mind sharing, or
indeed, what you wish to be known.

fields.EN:
So from your point of view, the
Dawn is pretty suspicious, then?
fields.JP:
……君の目から見て、黎明はそれだけ胡散臭い
ってことなんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So from your point of view, the
Dawn is pretty suspicious, then?

fields.EN:
Actually, I would do the same.
They wish to control information.
I wish to control theirs, too.
fields.JP:
いいえ。それが私の趣味と重なるからなのよ。
彼らが私たちの情報を把握したいなら、私も
同じことをして、さらには出し抜きたいだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, I would do the same.
They wish to control information.
I wish to control theirs, too.

fields.EN: I suppose... What was meant to be research for a purpose eventually became research for its own sake—a hobby.
fields.JP:
そうね……目的のための調査研究だった筈が、
いつしか調査研究自体が趣味になってしまった
……そんなところなのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could say their previous goals
have now dwindled to something
akin to a pastime.

fields.EN:
All you need to do is enjoy using
them and myself to seek the truth.
fields.JP:
あなたは彼らと私……その両方を利用して、
真実を追求すると、楽しいと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All you need to do is enjoy using
them and myself to seek the truth.

fields.JP: ……君の気持ちは、やっぱり理解しにくいね

fields.EN:
Oh? I've already told you I'm not
rooted in emotions. You'll get
used to me soon enough.
fields.JP:
あら。感情が私を動かす基盤ではないことは、
さっき話したつもりよ。
あなたもじきに慣れるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I've already told you I'm not
rooted in emotions. You'll get
used to me soon enough.

fields.EN:
Oh, by the way, you said you were
a Nightmare. What made you think
that?
fields.JP:
あ。そういえば……
君は自分のことをナイトメアだと言ってたけど、
どうしてそう思ってたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, by the way, you said you were
a Nightmare. What made you think
that?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? It's because Hansel-niisan called himself a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんが、自分のことをナイトメアだと
言っていたからにきまっているでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? It's because my
brother, Hansel, called himself a
Nightmare.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
But the people at the Dawn created
the name "Nightmare"...
fields.JP:
でも……『ナイトメア』っていうのは、
黎明の人たちがそう名付けたって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the people at the Dawn created
the name "Nightmare"...

fields.EN: Create? Maybe they just knew it.
fields.JP: 名付けたのではなく、知ったのかもしれないわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: Create? Maybe they just knew it.

fields.EN: What are we fighting for then...?
fields.JP: ……僕らは何のために戦ってるんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are we fighting for then...?

fields.EN: That's what I would like to know.
fields.JP: それは、私こそが知りたいことだわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: That's what I would like to know.

fields.EN:
And, if the Blood Maidens harbor
danger within themselves, what'll
happen to them after our escape?
fields.JP:
それに血式少女は、常に暴走の危険を孕んでいる
そうだけど、もし脱出できたとしたら……
そんな厄介な存在を、どうするつもりかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, if the Blood Maidens harbor
danger within themselves, what'll
happen to them after our escape?

fields.EN:
As long as I use my blood, I can
stop Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化は……
僕の血があれば、止めることができるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as I use my blood, I can
stop Blood Skelter...

fields.EN:
Do you have an eternal supply of
blood?
fields.JP: あなたの血は無限にあるとでもいうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you have an eternal supply of
blood?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. It looks like I've
toyed with you too much.
fields.JP: からかい過ぎたみたいね。ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. It looks like I've
toyed with you too much.

fields.EN:
But do remember that their plan's
execution wouldn't hold without
your existence.
fields.JP:
でも、あなたがいなければ、この作戦自体
成立しなかったのではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But do remember that their plan's
execution wouldn't hold without
your existence.

fields.EN:
You're right... Their plan took
motion only after they found out
the effects of my blood.
fields.JP:
確かに……僕の血の効果がわかってから、
作戦が本格的にできるようになったって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... Their plan took
motion only after they found out
the effects of my blood.

fields.EN:
It's also possible that they were
planning to use the Blood Maidens
as expendables.
fields.JP:
あるいは……使い捨てながら進むつもり
だったのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's also possible that they were
planning to use the Blood Maidens
as expendables.

fields.EN:
That... crossed my mind before,
but I tried not to think about
it...
fields.JP:
……時々、そんな気もしたけど、なるべくそうは
考えたくなかったことだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That... crossed my mind before,
but I tried not to think about
it...

fields.EN:
According to my research, Blood
Maidens are a rare existence, and
even rarer to find alive.
fields.JP:
……私の研究では、血式少女と呼ばれる存在が
出現するのはごく稀なことの筈……
無事に生き延び、成長するケースは更に稀なこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
According to my research, Blood
Maidens are a rare existence, and
even rarer to find alive.

fields.EN:
Even more so in a place where
humans see Marchens as enemies.
fields.JP:
人間をメルヒェンが敵視している場所なら、
尚更そうなるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even more so in a place where
humans see Marchens as enemies.

fields.EN:
And yet, the Dawn is able to
gather all of these Blood Maidens
so efficiently.
fields.JP:
なのに、黎明は、どうしてこうも効率よく
血式少女たちを集められたのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, the Dawn is able to
gather all of these Blood Maidens
so efficiently.

fields.EN: And they even made plans that didn't hesitate to use such precious Blood Maidens as expendable...
fields.JP:
しかも、そんなに貴重な血式少女を使い捨てに
することも辞さないような作戦立案……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could support the theory that
they had previously planned to use
Blood Maidens as expendables...

fields.JP: ふふ……ここは本当に興味深いわね

fields.EN: So, what is it you want to say?
fields.JP: 君がいいたいのは……どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what is it you want to say?

fields.EN:
I believe there are a number of
expectations at work.
fields.JP:
おそらく、複数の思惑が錯綜しているだろうと
いうことよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe there are a number of
expectations at work.

fields.EN:
Analyzing them and unraveling them
is stimulating my curiosity.
fields.JP:
それを分析し、解きほぐしていく作業も
とても知的好奇心を掻き立てられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Analyzing them and unraveling them
is stimulating my curiosity.

fields.EN:
I've said it a number of times
now, but I really don't understand
you...
fields.JP: ……やっぱり君の気持ちはよくわからないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've said it a number of times
now, but I really don't understand
you...

fields.EN:
But no one really knows how one
feels, and that's what makes
things interesting, no?
fields.JP:
あら。人の気持ちなんて誰もわからないし、
わからないから面白いのではないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But no one really knows how one
feels, and that's what makes
things interesting, no?

fields.EN:
(Not knowing makes things
interesting... That's something I
can't comprehend.)
fields.JP:
（わからないから面白い……か。
　僕にはなかなかそう思えないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not knowing makes things
interesting... That's something I
can't comprehend.)

fields.EN:
Um... Do you know anything about
"Snark?"
fields.JP: あのさ、『スナーク』って、君は知ってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Do you know anything about
"Snark?"

fields.JP:
……『スナーク』？
いいえ、知らなかったわ

fields.EN:
That is, not until you brought it
up to me just now.
fields.JP: ……さっき説明を受けるまではね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is, not until you brought it
up to me just now.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's return. I don't
want the others to be suspicious
of us.
fields.JP:
さて、そろそろ戻って休みましょうか。
みんなに怪しまれるといけないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's return. I don't
want the others to be suspicious
of us.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Thanks for sharing what
you know.
fields.JP: うん。……いろいろ話してくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Thanks for sharing what
you know.

fields.EN:
One suggestion... I think it will
prove interesting if you keep what
we shared here secret.
fields.JP:
ここで話したこと……
しばらく秘密にしておいた方が、面白いと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One suggestion... I think it will
prove interesting if you keep what
we shared here secret.

fields.EN:
So this is the Waterside! I can't
wait to show you my prowess!
fields.JP:
ここが『旧河川・沼エリア』ですのね！
腕が鳴りますわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is the Waterside! I can't
wait to show you my prowess!

fields.EN:
Ahaha! Don't get too excited and
trip over yourself!
fields.JP:
あはは！　張り切りすぎて転んだりしない
ようにね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha! Don't get too excited and
trip over yourself!

fields.EN:
So, what do you think this
hairball thing is?
fields.JP:
それにしても……
毛玉って、いったい何なんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what do you think this
hairball thing is?

fields.EN:
Gonna guess it's a Marchen. I bet
it's hairy all over.
fields.JP:
まあ、メルヒェンなんじゃないの？
きっと、全身毛むくじゃらのヤツなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gonna guess it's a Marchen. I bet
it's hairy all over.

fields.EN:
But, wasn't this hairball
attacking Marchens, too?
fields.JP:
でも……目撃者からの情報では、
その毛玉はメルヒェンも襲ってるんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, wasn't this hairball
attacking Marchens, too?

fields.EN: Maybe a large carnivore wandered in~
fields.JP: 大型肉食獣でも紛れ込んだんじゃないですか～

fields.EN:
You're not taking this seriously
at all, are you?
fields.JP: ……あんた、真面目に考える気ないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not taking this seriously
at all, are you?

fields.EN:
All I'm interested in is taking
things easy and having someone
bring me my treasures.
fields.JP:
誰かが取ってきてくれる宝物と楽をすることしか
興味ありません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I'm interested in is taking
things easy and having someone
bring me my treasures.

fields.EN:
Well, I don't care what it is. All
we need to do is to capture it and
figure things out from there!
fields.JP:
……ま、私も何だってかまわないけどね。
ふん捕まえて、正体を確かめればいいのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I don't care what it is. All
we need to do is to capture it and
figure things out from there!

fields.EN:
I haven't heard of Marchens
fighting each other before. I
wonder what it's like...
fields.JP:
確かに……メルヒェン同士が争うという話は
聞きませんわよね……
でもそうすると……どんな生物なのですかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't heard of Marchens
fighting each other before. I
wonder what it's like...

fields.EN:
I think there's another
possibility for what it is...
fields.JP:
可能性って意味では……
もうひとつ、あると思いますけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think there's another
possibility for what it is...

fields.EN:
It could have something to do with
the fact that no Blood Maidens
have been discovered here.
fields.JP:
あら、はっきり言えばいいのに。
このエリアで血式少女が未発見であることと、
無関係とは思えないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could have something to do with
the fact that no Blood Maidens
have been discovered here.

fields.EN:
Yes... We only heard "hairball,"
so it made us assume...
fields.JP:
ええ。毛玉という突拍子も無い情報から、
そうではないという先入観を持ちがちなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We only heard "hairball,"
so it made us assume...

fields.EN:
That a Blood Maiden would never
be described by such a word...
fields.JP:
……血式少女がそんな風に奇怪な姿な
はずが無い、というね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That a Blood Maiden would never
be described by such a word...

fields.EN:
W-Well I guess no ordinary human
could survive out there... That
thought never crossed my mind.
fields.JP:
ま……まあ、普通の人間じゃ、生き抜くことすら
無理だろうしね。
確かに、そっちの方向は考えてもみなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well I guess no ordinary human
could survive out there... That
thought never crossed my mind.

fields.EN:
It's only a possibility, so
there's no telling what it could
be until we find it.
fields.JP:
可能性ってだけだし、見つけてみるまでは
わからないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only a possibility, so
there's no telling what it could
be until we find it.
Hm? What's the matter, Snow White?

fields.EN: Let's just go and search the area!
fields.JP: ともかく……探してみましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just go and search the area!

fields.EN:
Wh-What's the matter, Princess
Lazy? You startled me.
fields.JP:
きゅ……急に何よ、グータラ姫。
びっくりするじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
