Wh-What's the matter, Princess
Lazy? You startled me.

fields.JP: あれは……黄金の輝きです～

fields.EN:
Wait... Are you talking about
that? That can't possibly be
any kind of treasure.
fields.JP:
ひょっとして……あれのことですの？
あんなものをお宝だと勘違いするようでは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Are you talking about
that? That can't possibly be
any kind of treasure.

fields.EN:
Wait! Isn't that the very hairball
we've been searching for?!
fields.JP:
みなさん、あれこそわたくしたちが探している
毛玉ではありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! Isn't that the very hairball
we've been searching for?!

fields.EN:
That's what I've been trying to
say.
fields.JP: だからわらわがそう言ったじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I've been trying to
say.

fields.EN:
It sure looks like it... Seems
like gold is about the only thing
you notice, Princess Lazy.
fields.JP:
確かに……そのようね。
グータラ姫、あんた黄金が絡むといい仕事
するじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure looks like it... Seems
like gold is about the only thing
you notice, Princess Lazy.

fields.EN:
It seems my value has dropped
significantly...
fields.JP: わらわの評価も地に落ちたものです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems my value has dropped
significantly...

fields.EN:
In your case, the only special
value you had was being able to
float.
fields.JP: あんたの場合、元から浮いてんのは本体だけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In your case, the only special
value you had was being able to
float.

fields.EN:
And to think this is coming from
someone so tiny...
fields.JP: ちびっこいそなたに言われたくありません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
And to think this is coming from
someone so tiny...

fields.EN:
Now, now. Save the small talk for
later. We've got our target in
front of us.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、とりあえずじゃれ合いは後にしてよ。
ようやく目標を見つけたんだからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now. Save the small talk for
later. We've got our target in
front of us.

fields.EN:
It looks like it's eating
something...
fields.JP: 何か……食べてるようですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's eating
something...

fields.EN:
All that hair is making it hard to
see... Is that a Marchen?
fields.JP:
毛だらけで何が何だかですけど……
メルヒェンですのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that hair is making it hard to
see... Is that a Marchen?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I wouldn't mind
dissecting that hairball to see
what's inside.
fields.JP:
ふふ……あの毛玉……解剖して
中身を確認してみたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I wouldn't mind
dissecting that hairball to see
what's inside.

fields.JP: 解剖しちゃ駄目だから！？

fields.EN:
Mmm... I can't seem to make it out
from here...
fields.JP: うーん。ここからだと、なかなか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I can't seem to make it out
from here...

fields.EN:
What is it eating? I don't recall
there being much food around...
fields.JP:
何を食べているのかしら……？
独房エリアの中で、まともな食料なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it eating? I don't recall
there being much food around...

fields.EN: Oh? There was always quite a bit.
fields.JP: あら。いろいろあるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? There was always quite a bit.

fields.EN:
Maybe it's eating something it
took from the people it attacked.
fields.JP: 人間から奪った食料ってとこかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's eating something it
took from the people it attacked.

fields.EN:
I have to say, it does look sort
of like a human...
fields.JP:
でも……よく見ると、
人間に見えなくもないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, it does look sort
of like a human...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I think so, too. Maybe we
should talk to it.
fields.JP:
うん……僕もそう見える……
話しかけてみようか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I think so, too. Maybe we
should talk to it.

fields.EN:
We need to be careful, or else it
could run away.
fields.JP:
ですね。
気をつけないと、逃げられちゃうかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to be careful, or else it
could run away.

fields.EN:
It stood up! It's shaped like a
human!
fields.JP:
立ち上がったわ！
やっぱり人間の姿をしているわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It stood up! It's shaped like a
human!

fields.JP: だから言わんこっちゃないんです～
あんた、何も言ってないでしょ！

fields.EN: Let's just hurry and go after it!
fields.JP: と……とりあえず、後を追おうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just hurry and go after it!

fields.EN:
We need to make sure it doesn't
get away...
fields.JP: 今度は逃げられないようにしませんと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to make sure it doesn't
get away...

fields.EN:
Don't surprise it, okay? Approach
it slowly...
fields.JP:
いい？　驚かせちゃだめよ？
そーっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't surprise it, okay? Approach
it slowly...

fields.EN:
I can just drop on it from above
on my Bamboo One, and...
fields.JP: わらわがバンブー一号で上空から……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can just drop on it from above
on my Bamboo One, and...

fields.EN: That'll make it run away for sure!
fields.JP: それ、逃げられるやつだから！
fields.LOCALIZED: That'll make it run away for sure!

fields.EN:
Now look at what you've done! It
noticed us!
fields.JP: ほら、気付かれちゃったじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now look at what you've done! It
noticed us!

fields.EN: You're the only loud one here...
fields.JP: 大声を出したのはそなたです～
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the only loud one here...

fields.EN:
It seems as if that hairball
mellowed out a bit...
fields.JP: あの毛玉……何だか和んだようですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if that hairball
mellowed out a bit...

fields.JP: 眠の癒しパワー、恐るべしですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's amazing how Sleepy can put
others at ease...

fields.EN:
Um... We're sorry to have
surprised you like that...
fields.JP: あの……驚かせてごめんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... We're sorry to have
surprised you like that...

fields.EN:
It looks like it's raising its
guard...
fields.JP: 警戒されたみたいだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's raising its
guard...

fields.JP: これ、あげないんだからね！！
あっ！　また逃げられた！

fields.EN:
And it's all because you surprised
it, Jack!
fields.JP: ジャックがびっくりさせるからよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it's all because you surprised
it, Jack!

fields.EN:
What's surprising about that? It
had a mouth, after all.
fields.JP: 口があれば、喋っても不思議じゃないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's surprising about that? It
had a mouth, after all.

fields.JP: 声からすると、女の子みたいですね～
金髪の女の子……いいですわね……

fields.EN:
But, what a shame that she's so
unkempt...
fields.JP:
なのに……小汚くしているなんて、
もったいないですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, what a shame that she's so
unkempt...

fields.EN: Hey, that's not the point here...
fields.JP: いや、今はそういう問題じゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, that's not the point here...

fields.EN:
But it did speak, so I think it's
safe to say it's human.
fields.JP:
けれど、喋ったということは、人間に間違い
ないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it did speak, so I think it's
safe to say it's human.

fields.JP: あら。ナイトメアだって喋るわよ？
いや、どう見てもナイトメアじゃないから……

fields.EN:
All right. Change of plans. We're
going to capture... No, bring her
under our protection.
fields.JP:
ともかく、作戦変更だね。
化け物退治から、あの子の捕獲……
いや、保護に移行しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Change of plans. We're
going to capture... No, bring her
under our protection.

fields.JP: それは、あの子が望んでることなのかしらね？

fields.EN:
And how exactly would we know for
sure without asking her first?
fields.JP:
捕まえて、意思を確認するまではわからない
ことだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And how exactly would we know for
sure without asking her first?

fields.EN:
(Alice and Gretel's interactions
make my stomach ache...)
fields.JP:
（この二人のやり取り……何だか胃が痛く
　なるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice and Gretel's interactions
make my stomach ache...)

fields.EN:
But, won't she run away again?
It was quite apparent that her
guard was up...
fields.JP:
でも、また逃げられちゃいませんか？
はっきり警戒されちゃったみたいですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, won't she run away again?
It was quite apparent that her
guard was up...

fields.EN:
No need to apologize. Apart from
Nemurihime, I doubt anyone
else had a chance with it.
fields.JP:
いいえ。眠り姫は例外として、他に誰が話し
かけても、結果は同じだったと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to apologize. Apart from
Sleeping Beauty, I doubt anyone
else had a chance with it.

fields.EN:
That sounds amazingly convincing
coming from you, Alice-san.
fields.JP:
アリスさんがおっしゃると、説得力があります
わね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds amazingly convincing
coming from you, Alice.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN: And what do you mean by that?
fields.JP: それは、どういう意味かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: And what do you mean by that?

fields.JP:
あ……あのさ！
こういうのはどうかな……？
良い考えでもあるんですか～？

fields.EN:
...So, that's my plan. What do
you think?
fields.JP: ……っていう段取りを考えてみたんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So, that's my plan. What do
you think?

fields.EN:
The plan you came up with is a lot
nastier than you look...
fields.JP:
あんた……見かけによらず、えげつない手を
考えるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The plan you came up with is a lot
nastier than you look...

fields.EN:
But, this should work! Let's do
it!
fields.JP: ……いや、いけるよ！　その手でいこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this should work! Let's do
it!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh! Listen up, Oyayubi.
The ends always justify the
means!
fields.JP:
くっくっく……親指、覚えときな。
作戦ってのはね、成功すれば正義なんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh! Listen up, Thumby.
The ends always justify the
means!

fields.EN:
Well, now. I believe we can
finally agree on something.
fields.JP: あら。意外なところで意見が合うわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, now. I believe we can
finally agree on something.

fields.EN:
(They're not exactly complimenting
my plan, are they?)
fields.JP: （な……何だか微妙な評価だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're not exactly complimenting
my plan, are they?)

fields.EN:
All right! It's time to put our
plan to capture that hairball into
action!
fields.JP:
よーし。それじゃあ今から、毛玉捕獲作戦を
開始しよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! It's time to put our
plan to capture that hairball into
action!

fields.JP:
（よし……まずは眠り姫に寝たふりをして
　もらって……）

fields.EN:
This is so tiring... Let's hurry
up and get it over with...
fields.JP: めんどくさいから、早く終わらせましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is so tiring... Let's hurry
up and get it over with...

fields.EN:
(Now to sprinkle the candies
around Nemurihime...)
fields.JP: （眠り姫の周囲に、お菓子をばら撒く……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now to sprinkle the candies
around Sleeping Beauty...)

fields.EN:
(Then trail some candies leading
away from her, and...)
fields.JP: （それをもう少し先までつなげて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then trail some candies leading
away from her, and...)

fields.EN:
(It looks like she noticed the
candies...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like she noticed the
candies...!)

fields.JP: （よし、そのまま眠り姫の傍まで……）

fields.EN: We'll beat her to a pulp!
fields.JP: ケチョンケチョンにして差し上げますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll beat her to a pulp!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: （よし！　眠り姫のところへ逃げ込んだ！）
うーー！！　ううーーーー！！

fields.EN:
Stay calm for awhile, okay? We
just want to talk.
fields.JP:
……少し大人しくして頂戴？
あなたとお話がしたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stay calm for awhile, okay? We
just want to talk.

fields.JP: うううーーーーーーー！！
……さっきは確かに、言葉を話したのに……

fields.EN: Maybe we can give her something.
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe we can give her something.

fields.EN:
How sly of you to reel a child in
with candy... As expected from
you, Jack...
fields.JP:
食べ物で釣るとは考えましたね～
さすがジャックです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How sly of you to reel a child in
with candy... As expected from
you, Jack...

fields.EN:
Can you please stop? You're making
me sound like I'm a terrible
person...
fields.JP:
自分がすごく汚い人間に思えてくるから、
もう許してほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please stop? You're making
me sound like I'm a terrible
person...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Now do you see how
much effort I have to put in to
keep these girls in line, Jack?
fields.JP:
あはは。この子たちをまとめる苦労、
ジャックも少しはわかってくれた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Now do you see how
much effort I have to put in to
keep these girls in line, Jack?

fields.JP:
はあ……
あたしもリタイアしたくなってきたよ……

fields.EN:
So, what specifically are we going
to give her?
fields.JP: それで、何をあげるんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what specifically are we going
to give her?

fields.EN: Well... I think candy is good.
fields.JP:
そうだなあ……
……お菓子……とか、どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Well... I think candy is good.

fields.EN:
Candy?! You're going to give her
something that good?!
fields.JP: お菓子！？　そんないいものあげちゃうの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Candy?! You're going to give her
something that good?!

fields.EN:
Ah, candy! Splendid idea. No one
can resist the allure of candy.
fields.JP:
……お菓子……！
お菓子に転ばない人はいないわ……
なかなか考えたわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, candy! Splendid idea. No one
can resist the allure of candy.

fields.EN:
Well, let's see if she takes it.
Um... Here... You want it?
fields.JP:
ともかく、あげてみるよ。
……えーと……これ、食べる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's see if she takes it.
Um... Here... You want it?

fields.JP: おいしい！　もっとほしい！！

fields.EN:
Um, this is all I have right now,
but... Can we talk after you eat?
fields.JP:
えーと……今はこれだけしかないんだけど……
これ食べたら話、聞かせてくれるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, this is all I have right now,
but... Can we talk after you eat?

fields.JP:
うんうん！
いいひと！　いいひと！

fields.EN:
(I feel terrible, hooking her with
food...)
fields.JP:
（物で釣ってるみたいで、気がひけるなあ……
　いや、物で釣ってるんだよなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel terrible, hooking her with
food...)

fields.JP:
わああーーーーーーーー！！
おいしいものだーーーー！！

fields.EN:
You have to say "thank you"
when you get something from
someone.
fields.JP:
人からものをもらったら、ありがとうって
言うのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to say "thank you"
when you get something from
someone.

fields.EN:
You're welcome. My name is Jack.
Nice to meet you.
fields.JP:
うん。どういたしまして。
僕の名前はジャックっていうんだ。
よろしくね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're welcome. My name is Jack.
Nice to meet you.

fields.EN:
So, you caught a child with candy,
and now you're seducing her?!
fields.JP: 子供をお菓子で釣って口説いてるわ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you caught a child with candy,
and now you're seducing her?!

fields.EN: I don't think he's seducing her.
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think he's seducing her.

fields.JP:
んー、ラプ……ラプンツェル！
じゃっく、いいひと！！

へえ……ラプンツェルかあ。
あ。あたしはねー

う！？　うう……！！
じゃっくーーーー！！

fields.EN: Don't be scared. They're with me.
fields.JP: あ、みんな僕の仲間だから、怖くないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be scared. They're with me.

fields.EN:
They're my friends, so I was
hoping you could be my friend,
too.
fields.JP:
みんな、僕の友達だから……
君も友達になってくれると嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're my friends, so I was
hoping you could be my friend,
too.

fields.EN:
Urrrh... If I be your friend...
you give me tasty thing again?
fields.JP:
うーーーううう……
ともだち、なったら……おいしいのまたくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrrh... If I be your friend...
you give me tasty thing again?

fields.EN:
I don't have any more on me now,
but I'll give you more when we get
back.
fields.JP: ……今はもう無いけど、帰ったらあげるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have any more on me now,
but I'll give you more when we get
back.

fields.EN:
Okay! I be your friend! Rapunzel
go home with you!
fields.JP:
じゃあともだち、なるーー！
ラプンツェルもいっしょにかえるーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I be your friend! Rapunzel
go home with you!

fields.EN:
Oh, um... What were you eating
earlier?
fields.JP:
あ……あのさ。
さっきは何、食べてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... What were you eating
earlier?

fields.JP: あれ！　いつもたべてるやつ！

fields.EN:
That...? Excuse me, but the only
thing there is the wall.
fields.JP: あれ……って、壁しかありませんわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That...? Excuse me, but the only
thing there is the wall.

fields.JP: うん！　かべたべてた！！

fields.EN: You were... eating the Jail wall?!
fields.JP: ジェイルの……壁を、ですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: You were... eating the Jail wall?!

fields.EN:
You didn't know? It's quite
delicious.
fields.JP: あら。なかなかいけるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't know? It's quite
delicious.

fields.EN:
S-So then that pink thing around
your mouth is...!
fields.JP:
じゃ、じゃあ……口の周りに
付いてる、ピンクのものって……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So then that pink thing around
your mouth is...!

fields.JP:
くちのまわり？
ごしごし……ぺろっ……

fields.EN: Look at the color of her eyes...!
fields.LOCALIZED: Look at the color of her eyes...!

fields.JP: ……けっしきしょうじょ？　めのいろ？

fields.EN:
I was actually thinking that maybe
there was Marchen blood on the
wall...
fields.JP:
ひょっとしたらって思ってたんだけど
……メルヒェンの血が壁についてたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was actually thinking that maybe
there was Marchen blood on the
wall...

fields.EN:
Marchen tasty! But thing you gave
me taste better!
fields.JP:
メルヒェン、おいしいの！
でも、さっきもらったもののほうが、おいしいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchen tasty! But thing you gave
me taste better!

fields.EN:
Marchen... I never thought of
that.
fields.JP: メルヒェン……その発想はなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchen... I never thought of
that.

fields.JP: メルヒェン……美味しいんですか……

fields.EN: Hey, you! Don't get any ideas!
fields.JP: そこ！　変な興味持たない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you! Don't get any ideas!

fields.EN:
W-Well, I have to admit, Marchen
blood does taste a bit on the
sweet side...
fields.JP:
ま……まあ、メルヒェンの血は
確かに甘いかもだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I have to admit, Marchen
blood does taste a bit on the
sweet side...

fields.EN:
But the sweetness from it isn't
the good kind...
fields.JP: でも……決して良い甘さではないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the sweetness from it isn't
the good kind...

fields.EN:
Oh, um! Did you live here,
Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
あ！　あのさ……！
ラプンツェルはずっとここにいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um! Did you live here,
Rapunzel?

fields.EN: Yup! Rapunzel here all the time!
fields.JP: うん！　ラプンツェル、ずっとここにいたー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Rapunzel here all the time!

fields.JP: 他に何か、覚えていることはある？
んーーーーわかんない

fields.EN: Ooh! A place Rapunzel was before!
fields.JP: あ！　まえにラプンツェルいたとこ、ある！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooh! A place Rapunzel was before!

fields.JP: そこは……こことは別の場所なのかしら？

fields.EN:
Is she trying to say that she was
in a different location within
this area?
fields.JP:
この場所の……別のところということで
ございますかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she trying to say that she was
in a different location within
this area?

fields.JP: そう！　ここ、べつのところ！

fields.EN:
So, you've been living here alone
all this time...
fields.JP: ずっとここで、一人で生きてきたんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you've been living here alone
all this time...

fields.EN:
Well, it's not like it's an
inconvenience. There's food and
sufficient things of interest.
fields.JP:
あら。特に困ったことは無いわよ？
食料もあるし、それなりに興味深いし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's not like it's an
inconvenience. There's food and
sufficient things of interest.

fields.JP: いや、君はそうかもしれないけどさ……

fields.EN:
That's right. You'll be pretty in
an instant! We should wipe your
face, too!
fields.JP:
そう。綺麗になりますわよ？
ちゃんと顔も拭いた方がいいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You'll be pretty in
an instant! We should wipe your
face, too!

fields.JP: まあまあ！　これはいけませんわ！
あああんたは、あっち向いてなさいよ！
この子……服を着ていないのよ……

fields.EN:
Shoot... I should've noticed
earlier, looking at her...
fields.JP:
あー。まあ、ちょっと考えりゃ
想像はついたことだったけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot... I should've noticed
earlier, looking at her...

fields.EN:
Clothes? What's that? Rapunzel
okay now.
fields.JP:
ふく？　それなに？
ラプンツェルへいきだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clothes? What's that? Rapunzel
okay now.

fields.EN:
Well, we can't let you go without
clothes...
fields.JP: そういうわけにもいかないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we can't let you go without
clothes...

fields.EN:
Indeed! It's only natural for a
girl to want to be pretty!
fields.JP:
そうでしてよ！
女の子は綺麗にするのがたしなみですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! It's only natural for a
girl to want to be pretty!

fields.EN:
I know! Jack, go back to
headquarters and get some clothes
for her, now!
fields.JP:
そうだわ！
ジャック。あんた、一度本部に戻って
この子の服、取って来なさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Jack, go back to
headquarters and get some clothes
for her, now!

fields.EN:
Huh?! Me?! B-But I don't know
anything about girls' clothes.
Shouldn't one of you go instead?
fields.JP:
え！？　僕！？
で、でも、女の子の服なんて、わからないよ……
君たちの誰かが行った方がいいんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Me?! B-But I don't know
anything about girls' clothes.
Shouldn't one of you go instead?

fields.EN:
Guys are basically predators, you
know?
fields.JP: 男子はケダモノですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guys are basically predators, you
know?

fields.JP: ジャックはケダモノではないわ……

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! You tell him, Kaguya! In
any case, it's better for us girls
to keep watch on her, so... Go!
fields.JP:
あははは！　かぐやも言うねえ！
ま、確かに女の子が見てた方がいいかもね！
……というわけで、よろしく頼むよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! You tell him, Kaguya! In
any case, it's better for us girls
to keep watch on her, so... Go!

fields.JP: ジャックはケダモノではないわ……

わ……わかったよ。
じゃあ、行ってくるね

fields.EN:
If he's going, I'll go with him,
too. There's no telling what Jack
might encounter on his way back.
fields.JP:
それなら、わたしも一緒に行ってくるわ。
ジャック一人では、応戦に困るもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
If he's going, I'll go with him,
too. There's no telling what Jack
might encounter on his way back.

fields.EN:
Okay then... Take care of him,
Alice!
fields.JP: それじゃ、アリスもよろしく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay then... Take care of him,
Alice!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I'm just fulfilling a
role that's needed.
fields.JP: いいえ。ただの役割分担だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'm just fulfilling a
role that's needed.

fields.EN:
Be sure none of you go on a
rampage while we're away.
fields.JP:
あなたたちはその間、
暴走しないよう気をつけることね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure none of you go on a
rampage while we're away.

fields.EN: Be careful on your way back.
fields.JP: お二人とも、気をつけてくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Be careful on your way back.

fields.JP: じゃっく……どっかいっちゃうの！？
あ……すぐに戻ってくるよ

fields.EN:
Yup... Really, really. You just
wait here with everyone else,
okay?
fields.JP:
うん。ほんとにほんとだから、
みんなと一緒に待っててね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Really, really. You just
wait here with everyone else,
okay?

fields.EN: Rapunzel... Bear with me a bit...
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、ちょっと我慢して？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel... Bear with me a bit...

fields.EN:
I know it doesn't feel good, but I
need to do this so that you don't
get into trouble while I'm away.
fields.JP:
気持ち悪かったかもしれないけど……
僕がいない間に、君が苦しい目に遭うといけない
から……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it doesn't feel good, but I
need to do this so that you don't
get into trouble while I'm away.

fields.JP:
おいしいーーーーーー！
これなに！？

fields.EN:
That's Jack's blood. He splashed
his blood on you so that you won't
go on a rampage.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックの血だよ。
あんたが暴走するといけないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Jack's blood. He splashed
his blood on you so that you won't
go on a rampage.

fields.EN: Jack's blood tasty! I like Jack!
fields.JP:
じゃっくのち、おいしいーーーー！
じゃっくすきーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack's blood tasty! I like Jack!

fields.EN:
(I feel like she's saying that she
likes me as food...)
fields.JP:
（食べ物として『好き』って言われてるような
　気がするんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like she's saying that she
likes me as food...)

fields.JP: じゃ、じゃあ……行ってくるよ
じゃっく、ぜったいもどってくる？

fields.EN:
Yup... I'll really come back, so
wait here and don't eat anything
weird, you hear?
fields.JP:
うん。絶対戻ってくるから、
変なもの食べないで待ってるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I'll really come back, so
wait here and don't eat anything
weird, you hear?

fields.JP: うん。たべないでまってる！

fields.EN:
Huh... I'm surprised how close
she is to Jack already.
fields.JP:
へえ……この子、ずいぶん
ジャックに懐いちゃったじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... I'm surprised how close
she is to Jack already.

fields.JP: ジャックは優しいもの

fields.EN:
Alice? Is there something the
matter?
fields.JP: ……アリス、何だか機嫌、悪くない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? Is there something the
matter?

fields.JP:
いいえ、別に……
早く行ってきましょう

fields.EN:
Huh? What's the matter, you two?
On a date perhaps? Hahahaha!
fields.JP:
あれ？　どうしたんだい、お二人さん！
さてはデートかな？　あはははは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's the matter, you two?
On a date perhaps? Hahahaha!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Towa-san! We really
need to run!
fields.JP:
永遠さん、ごめんなさい！
ちょっと急いでて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Mr. Kadowaki! We really
need to run!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN: Hm? They're sure in a hurry.
fields.JP: 何だろう？　せわしないなあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? They're sure in a hurry.

fields.EN:
Oh? Jack and Alice. What happened
to the mission?
fields.JP:
あら……ジャックにアリス。
作戦はどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Jack and Alice. What happened
to the mission?

fields.EN:
Perfect timing! We were just
heading to the laboratory!
fields.JP:
ちょうどよかった……！
いま、研究室に行こうと思ってたんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect timing! We were just
heading to the laboratory!

fields.JP: ……どうしたんだよ、そんなに慌てて？

fields.EN:
We found another one! A new Blood
Maiden!
fields.JP: 見つかったんです！　新しい血式少女が！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found another one! A new Blood
Maiden!

fields.EN:
Yes. The rumored hairball was a
Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
ええ。毛玉と呼ばれていたものの正体が、
血式少女だったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The rumored hairball was a
Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
W-We came back... to get her some
clothes...
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We came back... to get her some
clothes...

fields.EN:
She's not wearing anything, and...
with Jack around...
fields.JP:
その子、何も着ていなくて……
その、ジャックの目の毒だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not wearing anything, and...
with Jack around...

fields.JP: えーと、それで……どのくらいの子なんだ？

fields.EN:
Um, we can discuss the details
later...
fields.JP: あの、詳しいことは後で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, we can discuss the details
later...

fields.JP: どのくらいのサイズの子かって聞いてんだよ

え、ええと……
確か、背の高さはこれくらいで……
よし。ちょっと待ってろ

fields.EN:
Here are Oyayubi's spare
clothes. They should work for now.
fields.JP:
親指のやつ用のスペアなんだが、
ま、とりあえずはこれで事足りるだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here are Thumbelina's spare
clothes. They should work for now.

fields.EN:
You know, you could've just
brought her back with ya...
fields.JP:
全く、一度連れて戻ってくるって手も
あっただろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, you could've just
brought her back with ya...

fields.EN:
But if we did that, we couldn't
bring Jack along with us.
fields.JP:
でも、あの状態でジャックと同行させる
わけには……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we did that, we couldn't
bring Jack along with us.

fields.EN:
Hm? Ah... I guess you could say
that.
fields.JP: あー。まあそういう考え方もあるねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Ah... I guess you could say
that.

fields.JP: では、行きましょうか、ジャック

（……親指姫用なら、
　確かに大きさ的には合いそうだけど……）

fields.EN:
(It also looks like it was fitted
specifically for that girl...)
fields.JP: （何だかあの子のために作られたような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It also looks like it was fitted
specifically for that girl...)

fields.EN:
Speak up. If you've got something
else to say, spill it.
fields.JP: おい、まだ注文があるんなら、はっきり言えよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speak up. If you've got something
else to say, spill it.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: 僕らの服……ハルさんが作ってたんですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you made our
clothes!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
W-Well, they're like pieces of
armor... So what?
fields.JP:
お、おう。一応防具を兼ねてるからな。
それがどうかしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, they're like pieces of
armor... So what?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... It's just that you had
them ready for us when we arrived,
too.
fields.JP:
あ、いえ、僕とアリスがここに来た時も
すぐに用意してもらえたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... It's just that you had
them ready for us when we arrived,
too.

fields.EN: Yeah, it was quite a job. Honestly, I couldn't get around to yours, so I ended up just reinforcing Dawn's standard-issue clothes.
fields.JP:
ああ、結構大変だったんだぜ？
ま、正直お前さんの分までは手が回らなくてな。
黎明の汎用服を補強しただけになっちまったが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, a real pain. I didn't have
time to make yours from scratch,
so I used what we already had.

fields.EN:
(He used something that was there
for mine... But what about
Alice's?)
fields.JP: （僕のは汎用……じゃあ、アリスの服は？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He used something that was there
for mine... But what about
Alice's?)

fields.EN:
Oh, but I was surprised you had
them ready the next morning!
fields.JP:
あの、それでもすごいですよ！
ここに来た次の日の朝に、もう用意されてる
なんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I was surprised you had
them ready the next morning!

fields.EN:
Alice's clothes really looks good
on her, like they were made just
for her...
fields.JP:
アリスの服なんて、すごく似合ってて、
まるでアリスのために……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice's clothes really looks good
on her, like they were made just
for her...

fields.EN:
You ain't got the time to talk
like this, right? Hurry up and
take that back with ya!
fields.JP:
いいからさっさと行けよ！
そいつ、待ってんだろーが！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You ain't got the time to talk
like this, right? Hurry up and
take that back with ya!

fields.JP:
は、はい……！
行こう、アリス

fields.EN:
I'm sorry we're late! We brought
some clothes!
fields.JP:
遅くなってごめん……！
服、持ってきたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry we're late! We brought
some clothes!

fields.EN: Were you good while we were away?
fields.JP: あなた、おとなしくしていたかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Were you good while we were away?

fields.JP:
うんっ！
ラプンツェル、いいこでまってたよ！

fields.EN:
We'll ask that you wait over
there, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
では、ジャックさんはあちらでお待ちください
ましね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll ask that you wait over
there, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: あ、そっか……うん。わかったよ

fields.EN:
Now then, Rapunzel-san, let's get
these clothes on you.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ラプンツェルさん。
服を着ちゃいましょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, Rapunzel, let's get
these clothes on you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.EN:
Marvelous! I knew you had that
brilliance in you!
fields.JP:
す……素晴らしいですわ！
やはり宝の持ち腐れでしたのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marvelous! I knew you had that
brilliance in you!

fields.EN:
You're so cute in it! It looks
really good on you!
fields.JP:
すっごく可愛い……！
すっごく似合ってるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so cute in it! It looks
really good on you!

fields.EN:
Yup. You're such a pretty girl,
Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
うん。ラプンツェルって、こんなに綺麗な
女の子だったんだね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. You're such a pretty girl,
Rapunzel!

fields.EN:
Don't surprise her like that,
Jack-san!
fields.JP: びっくりしますよね、ジャックさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't surprise her like that,
Jack!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I'm more surprised at how he can
sweet talk a girl so shamelessly.
fields.JP:
私は、そこまで臆面もなく女の子を褒められる
ジャックの神経の方にびっくりするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm more surprised at how he can
sweet talk a girl so shamelessly.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised at how he reacted
when all she did was clean herself
up and put on clothes...
fields.JP:
私は、身なりを整えただけで、これだけ
反応が変わることの方が驚きだわ
確かに……身だしなみは礼儀として大切だけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised at how he reacted
when all she did was clean herself
up and put on clothes...

fields.EN:
My sentiments exactly. It's
interesting how important visual
cues are.
fields.JP:
それは同感ね。
視覚情報が情報として侮れないということは
勉強になったけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sentiments exactly. It's
interesting how important visual
cues are.

fields.JP: ふく、なんだかへんだよ？

fields.EN:
That's because you're not used to
wearing them yet. Rapu-Rapu's such a
pretty girl with them on!
fields.JP:
それは着慣れないからですわ。
ラプラプも女の子なのですから、これからは
綺麗にしているべきですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because you're not used to
wearing them yet. Rappy's such a
pretty girl with them on!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
You can have greater confidence,
as well!
fields.JP: そうすれば、自分に自信が持てますもの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can have greater confidence,
as well!

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、つよいじしんあるよ！

fields.EN:
That's not what I was trying to
say...
fields.JP: ……そういう意味ではないんですのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not what I was trying to
say...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel has a place I was. I
wanna go there!
fields.JP:
……ラプンツェル、まえにいたとこあるの。
そこいきたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel has a place I was. I
wanna go there!

fields.EN:
A place where you were? You mean
where you were born and raised?
fields.JP:
前にいたところ……それは、生まれ育った場所、
という意味かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A place where you were? You mean
where you were born and raised?

fields.EN:
Yup! Born! Place Rapunzel was! I
wanna show everyone!
fields.JP:
そう！　うまれたとこ！
ラプンツェルがまえにいたとこ！
みんなにみせたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Born! Place Rapunzel was! I
wanna show everyone!

fields.EN:
It seems like she wants to show us
where she lived.
fields.JP: 生まれ育った場所に案内してくれるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like she wants to show us
where she lived.

fields.JP: うん！　あんないしたい！

fields.EN:
But... I forgot where... I wanna
find...
fields.JP:
でも、ばしょわかんなくなった……
みつけたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I forgot where... I wanna
find...
What should we do, Sister Red?
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: We've accomplished our first objective. Now we need to find this area's core...
fields.JP:
まず、第一の目的は果たしたとして、
あとはここの核を探し出すわけだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We already completed part of the
mission. All that's left is to
destroy the core...

fields.EN:
Let's see... Um, Rapu? Why don't
we look for your place while we
look for what we came for?
fields.JP:
そうだなあ……じゃあさ、ラプ。
あたしたちの探し物もしながらでよければ、
一緒に探そうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... Um, Rappy? Why don't
we look for your place while we
look for what we came for?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: うん！　いっしょにさがす！

fields.EN:
Are you sure about this...? It
sounds like a chore...
fields.JP:
本当にいいんですか～？
面倒くさそうですよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure about this...? It
sounds like a chore...

fields.EN:
We could find out more about her,
so I think it's worth it.
fields.JP:
この子のことがもっとわかるかもしれないしさ、
まったく無意味じゃないと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We could find out more about her,
so I think it's worth it.

fields.EN:
I think so, too. It's nice to know
that she at least remembers where
she was born.
fields.JP:
僕もそう思うな。
生まれた場所を覚えてるなんて、いいことだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think so, too. It's nice to know
that she at least remembers where
she was born.

fields.EN:
That's true. Come to think of it,
we don't even remember where we
were born.
fields.JP:
そうですね。考えたら白雪たち、
生まれた場所って覚えてないですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true. Come to think of it,
we don't even remember where we
were born.

fields.EN:
I remember quite clearly. After
all, I've always been with Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
私はよく覚えてるわよ？
ヘンゼル兄さんといつも一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember quite clearly. After
all, I've always been with Hansel.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: あんたは例外中の例外！

fields.EN:
Quit pouting, Princess Lazy. Let's
hurry this up! We have to do this,
one way or the other.
fields.JP:
グータラ姫もそう渋い顔してないでさ、
とっとと探しましょ！
どうせやんなきゃいけないことなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quit pouting, Princess Lazy. Let's
hurry this up! We have to do this,
one way or the other.

fields.EN: I suppose... I guess we do...
fields.JP:
……そうですね。
どうせしなければいけないことですね
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose... I guess we do...

fields.EN:
It's unusual to see you so
compliant.
fields.JP: 珍しく物わかりがいいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's unusual to see you so
compliant.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Well then, we'd better
hurry up before Kaguya changes her
mind!
fields.JP:
あはは。じゃあ、かぐやの気が変わらないうちに
早速出発しよっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Well then, we'd better
hurry up before Kaguya changes her
mind!

fields.JP: うん！　しゅっぱーつ！

fields.EN:
It's dangerous, so stay close to
us.
fields.JP: 一人で行ったら危ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous, so stay close to
us.

fields.EN:
Wait... She did live here... Maybe
it isn't so dangerous?
fields.JP:
……いえ、住んでいたのだもの。
危なくないのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... She did live here... Maybe
it isn't so dangerous?

fields.JP: とにかく、行ってみようよ

fields.EN:
Rapunzel? Is this where you were
born?
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、ここが君の生まれた場所なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel? Is this where you were
born?

fields.EN:
Felt like same place, but not...
This not Rapunzel's place...
fields.JP:
けはい、にてるとおもったけど、ちがった……
ラプンツェルいたとこ、ここじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Felt like same place, but not...
This not Rapunzel's place...

fields.EN:
See? We can't find it. Looking
around is tiring, so we should
just forget about it.
fields.JP:
見つからないんじゃないですか～
面倒臭いから諦めるといいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? We can't find it. Looking
around is tiring, so we should
just forget about it.

fields.JP: やだ！　もっとさがす！

fields.EN:
Kaguya, I understand the concept
of being lazy, but can't you word
it a little better?
fields.JP:
かぐやさん、面倒臭い精神はわかりませんけど、
もう少し言い方があるのではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, I understand the concept
of being lazy, but can't you word
it a little better?

fields.JP: ま……まあ、もっと探せばいいじゃない！

fields.EN: Grrrr...! The one gets in my way!
fields.JP:
ぐるるるる……！！
こいつ、じゃまするやつだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Grrrr...! The one gets in my way!

fields.EN:
This makes things easier for us!
Don't let your guard down,
everyone!
fields.JP:
……ちょうど手間が省けたよ！
みんな、油断しないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This makes things easier for us!
Don't let your guard down,
everyone!

fields.EN: Now then, time to smash that core!
fields.JP: じゃあ、とっとと核をやるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, time to smash that core!

fields.JP: よっし！　一丁上がりだね！

fields.EN:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
with ease!
fields.JP: これで、いつナイトメアが来ても楽勝ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
with ease!

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and look for
the place she wants to show us!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、この子の探してる場所とやらも、
とっとと探しに行きましょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and look for
the place she wants to show us!

fields.JP: ……ん？　あんた何してんのよ？

fields.EN: Yes. It's dead, so it's safe now.
fields.JP: ええ。もう死んでいるから、大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. It's dead, so it's safe now.

fields.EN:
(Even if she lived here, seeing
death may still be shocking to
her.)
fields.JP:
（いくらここで生きてきたっていっても、
　やっぱりショックだったのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if she lived here, seeing
death may still be shocking to
her.)

fields.EN:
Um, well... There's a thing called
a Nightmare here, and to beat
it...
fields.JP:
あ……ええと、
ここの中にはナイトメアっていうのがいてね、
それを倒すためには……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... There's a thing called
a Nightmare here, and to beat
it...

fields.EN:
Ahahahaha! No blood comes out when
dead!
fields.JP:
あははははっ！
したいだと、ちがでないー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahahahaha! No blood comes out when
dead!

fields.EN:
Why did you do that? This
Marchen's dead already.
fields.JP:
君……どうしてそんなことするの？
もうこのメルヒェンは死んでるんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you do that? This
Marchen's dead already.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel like playing! I check
inside!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルね、あそんでるのー！
なかしらべるーー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel like playing! I check
inside!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Investigate the
unknown. She seems to understand
that naturally.
fields.JP:
ふふ……知らないものがあれば調査する。
なかなか見所のある子ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Investigate the
unknown. She seems to understand
that naturally.

fields.EN: I don't think that applies to her.
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think that applies to her.

fields.EN:
That's not a very good thing to
do.
fields.JP: そういうの、あんまり良くないことなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not a very good thing to
do.

fields.EN:
We fight them as enemies, and it
ends when they die. So, you
shouldn't play with their bodies.
fields.JP:
相手は敵だから倒すけど、
倒した後はもう襲って来ないだろ？
だから、死体で遊んじゃいけないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We fight them as enemies, and it
ends when they die. So, you
shouldn't play with their bodies.

fields.EN:
Mmm... If Jack says no, then I
stop.
fields.JP: んーーーじゃっくがだめならやらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... If Jack says no, then I
stop.

fields.EN:
(She doesn't understand, does
she? Oh well...)
fields.JP:
（この子、絶対わかってないよな……
　まあ、しょうがないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't understand, does
she? Oh well...)

fields.EN:
Mind you, I don't think it's a
good idea to nip a person's
curiosity in the bud.
fields.JP:
他人の知的好奇心の芽を摘むのは
良いことではないと思うのだけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind you, I don't think it's a
good idea to nip a person's
curiosity in the bud.

fields.EN:
I don't think she was doing that
out of curiosity...
fields.JP: あれ、知的好奇心じゃないわよ……多分
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think she was doing that
out of curiosity...

fields.EN:
Having the wrong kind of curiosity
doesn't necessarily make someone
a good adult.
fields.JP:
間違った知的好奇心を持ってても、
ろくな大人にならないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Having the wrong kind of curiosity
doesn't necessarily make someone
a good adult.

fields.EN:
Hm, "good adult." Will that make
a person's life interesting?
fields.JP:
ろくな大人ね……
そんなもの、生きていて本当に楽しいのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, "good adult." Will that make
a person's life interesting?

fields.EN:
You're going to end up getting
hunted by Snark.
fields.JP: スナークに狩られますよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to end up getting
hunted by Snark.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Snark... I wouldn't
mind hunting it down so that I
could research it thoroughly.
fields.JP:
スナークね……
むしろ私が狩って、
心ゆくまで研究材料にしたいものね……ふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Snark... I wouldn't
mind hunting it down so that I
could research it thoroughly.

fields.EN:
Well, no use staying here any
longer. There's no telling when
the Nightmare's gonna show up.
fields.JP:
ま、長居は禁物だよ。
いつナイトメアが出るかわかんないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, no use staying here any
longer. There's no telling when
the Nightmare's gonna show up.

fields.EN:
Yes... Since we're searching the
place, we may as well find the
Nightmare ourselves.
fields.JP:
ええ……ここの探索を続ける以上、
こちらから見つけて倒したいものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Since we're searching the
place, we may as well find the
Nightmare ourselves.

fields.EN:
Ohohoho! Indeed! We shall
strike it first!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほほ！
そうですわ！　先手必勝しかありませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! Indeed! We shall
strike it first!

fields.JP: それじゃ……先へ進もうか

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem like it's noticed
us yet.
fields.JP: まだこちらには気づいてないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem like it's noticed
us yet.

fields.EN:
We can do this! We can strike the
Nightmare from behind!
fields.JP:
……いけるわ！
今ならナイトメアの背後を衝ける！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can do this! We can strike the
Nightmare from behind!

fields.JP: ゴァァァアアアアアアオオオオオ！！
おおおーーーーーーーー！！

fields.EN:
It's angry that we destroyed the
core!
fields.JP: 核を破壊されて、怒り狂ってますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's angry that we destroyed the
core!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel can no kill before,
so run and hide...
fields.JP:
こいつ、ころせないから、
ラプンツェル、にげたりかくれたりしてた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel can no kill before,
so run and hide...

fields.EN:
Now Rapunzel can kill, so I
kill!
fields.JP:
ころせるようになったから、ラプンツェル
こいつ、ころす！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now Rapunzel can kill, so I
kill!

fields.JP: ゴァァァアアアアアアオオオオオ！！

fields.EN:
Let's hit it while we have the
chance. Is everyone ready?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hit it while we have the
chance. Is everyone ready?

fields.EN: All right! Let's get this started!
fields.JP:
よーし！
じゃあ、さっそく始めようか！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Let's get this started!

fields.JP:
おおおーーーーーーーー！！
かたち、かわった！！

fields.EN: I see... So it is like Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP: そう……やはりヘンゼル兄さんと同じなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So it is like my brother,
Hansel.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: がるる……こいつ、よわってきたよ！！

fields.EN: Ohohohoho! I will end it myself!
fields.JP:
ほーっほっほっほ！
いまとどめを刺して差し上げましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohohohoho! I will end it myself!

fields.EN:
Keep your eyes on it! Don't let
your guard down!
fields.JP: 油断は駄目よ……気を引き締めて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep your eyes on it! Don't let
your guard down!

fields.JP: グォォオオァァァアア……！！
……みんな！　ケリをつけるよ！
はあ……はあ……みんな、お疲れ！

fields.EN:
That thing didn't stand a chance
against us!
fields.JP: 私たちにかかりゃ、ざっとこんなもんよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That thing didn't stand a chance
against us!

fields.EN:
(It's broken to pieces, but it's
exactly what I thought... A
transceiver!)
fields.JP:
（バラバラに壊れてるけど、やっぱり
　トランシーバーだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's broken to pieces, but it's
exactly what I thought... A
transceiver!)

fields.EN:
Rapunzel-san, you did great for your
first battle against a Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルさん、初めてなのに、
がんばりましたね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
For this being your first battle
against a Nightmare, you did
great!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.JP:
これ、なくなっちゃうよ！？
どーして！？

fields.EN:
A Nightmare disappears when it
dies.
fields.JP: ナイトメアは、死ぬと消えてしまいますのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Nightmare disappears when it
dies.

fields.EN:
In your case, I'll take it you
mean differently.
fields.JP: ……あんたの場合は、きっと別の意味よね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In your case, I'll take it you
mean differently.

fields.JP: うう……なくなっちゃった……

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. When we get
back, let's eat something good,
okay?
fields.JP:
仕方ないよ。
帰ったら、何かおいしいものを食べようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. When we get
back, let's eat something good,
okay?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Jack's really become an
onii-chan now, huh?
fields.JP: あはは。ジャックはすっかりお兄ちゃんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Looks like Jack's her
surrogate brother already.
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.JP: こ、今度はどうしたのかしら？
ねーねーじゃっく、じゃっく！
どうしたの、ラプンツェル？

fields.EN:
We may have finally found her
place! Let's go, everyone!
fields.JP:
探してた場所を見つけたのかもしれない！
みんな、行ってみよう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may have finally found her
place! Let's go, everyone!

fields.EN: You want to play with it?
fields.JP: ……ひょっとして、これで遊びたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: You want to play with it?

fields.JP: ううん！　ちがう！　ちがう！

fields.EN:
It looks like it's been dead for
awhile.
fields.JP: あらあら、ずいぶん古い死体ですこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's been dead for
awhile.

fields.JP: ほとんど風化しているわね……

fields.EN:
Um... It looks like its stomach
was ripped open.
fields.JP: あ。この死体、お腹が裂けてませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... It looks like its stomach
was ripped open.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I've come
across Marchen carcasses like this
before.
fields.JP:
そういえばこういうメルヒェンの死体、
たまに見かけるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I've come
across Marchen carcasses like this
before.

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、これがどうかしたの？

fields.EN:
Here! Here! Found place! Where
Rapunzel was!
fields.JP:
ここなの！　ここ！　みつけたの！
ラプンツェルのいたとこ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here! Here! Found place! Where
Rapunzel was!

fields.EN:
Maybe she's saying that this
carcass is acting as a kind of
landmark?
fields.JP:
……つまり、このメルヒェンの死体が
目印ってことなのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she's saying that this
carcass is acting as a kind of
landmark?

fields.JP: きがついたら、ラプンツェルここにいたんだよ！
いやああああああああああああ！！
あああああ……っ！　ああああああ！！

かぐや！　どうしたの！？
かぐや……！！

fields.EN:
Are you sure you're all right? You
shouldn't push yourself...
fields.JP:
本当に大丈夫ですか？
無理はしない方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you're all right? You
shouldn't push yourself...

fields.EN:
Yeah, I think we should return
and rest already.
fields.JP: うん、帰って休んだ方がいいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I think we should return
and rest already.

fields.EN:
All right! We're done here, so
it's time we head home!
fields.JP:
よし、みんな帰るよ！
ここでの目的は果たしたからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! We're done here, so
it's time we head home!

fields.EN:
Why did Princess Lazy call me out
here? I want to rest, too.
fields.JP:
全くグータラ姫ったら、こんなとこに呼び出して
どういうつもりよ。疲れてるってのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did Princess Lazy call me out
here? I want to rest, too.

fields.EN: Huh? Jack?! What's going on here?!
fields.JP:
……って、ジャックまで！？
いったいどういうことよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Jack?! What's going on here?!

fields.EN:
Sleeping late isn't good for one's
beauty, you know?
fields.JP: 夜更かしは美容の大敵ですのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping late isn't good for one's
beauty, you know?

fields.EN:
*sigh* And just when I was about
to turn in, too...
fields.JP: まったく、寝ちゃうとこだったよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* And just when I was about
to turn in, too...

fields.JP: あの……何かあったんですか？

fields.EN: Jack, what's the meaning of this?
fields.JP: ジャック、これは一体どういうことなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, what's the meaning of this?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry to bother you at this
hour, but I really needed to talk
to everyone...
fields.JP:
みなさん、こんな時間にすみません。
でも、どうしても話したいことがあるんです。
実は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to bother you at this
hour, but I really needed to talk
to everyone...

fields.JP: かぐや姫、ちょっと待って

fields.EN:
W-Where...? Outside of the
Liberated District...?
fields.JP: こ、ここは……解放地区の外……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Where...? Outside of the
Liberated District...?

fields.EN:
Quite a pain, but I suppose this
is part of what being "friends" is
all about.
fields.JP:
全く、世話を焼かされるわね……と、言いたい
ところだけど……これが『仲間』の醍醐味
なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite a pain, but I suppose this
is part of what being "friends" is
all about.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, and... Thank you,
Gretel.
fields.JP: ごめん……ありがとう、グレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, and... Thank you,
Gretel.

fields.JP: グレーテル……あんた、何やったのよ！？
あいっかわらず可愛くないわね……！

fields.EN:
Yes, you should have. Now then,
you're free to talk here without
anyone eavesdropping.
fields.JP:
可愛くなくて結構よ。
ここでなら余計な人たちに聞かれずに
話ができるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you should have. Now then,
you're free to talk here without
anyone eavesdropping.

fields.EN:
Think of it as a pajama party for
the Blood Team. Be sure to keep
everything here a secret.
fields.JP:
血式部隊のパジャマパーティってところね？
だから……ここでの話は、誰にも内緒……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think of it as a pajama party for
the Blood Team. Be sure to keep
everything here a secret.

fields.EN:
I believe Jack would prefer that
as well.
fields.JP: ジャックは、そうしたいんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe Jack would prefer that
as well.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I think it's better that
way. Isn't that right, Kaguyahime?
fields.JP:
うん。多分……その方がいいと思うんだ。
だよね、かぐや姫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I think it's better that
way. Isn't that right, Kaguya?

fields.EN:
Um... You mind filling us in on
the details?
fields.JP: えーと、一体何の話なわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You mind filling us in on
the details?

fields.EN:
What I'm going to say is probably
going to bring a lot of suffering
to everyone here.
fields.JP:
これから話すことは、みなさんにとって
とてもつらい話だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I'm going to say is probably
going to bring a lot of suffering
to everyone here.

fields.EN:
But... I wanted to talk about it
myself...
fields.JP:
でも……このことは、わらわの口から……
話したかったんです。
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I wanted to talk about it
myself...

fields.EN:
After all, you're all my
friends...
fields.JP: ……そなたたちは、わらわの仲間ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, you're all my
friends...

fields.EN:
Did you all feel something when
Rapunzel showed us her "place?"
fields.JP:
そなたたちは『ラプンツェルのいた場所』に
ついて、何か感じませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you all feel something when
Rapunzel showed us her "place?"

fields.JP: ラプンツェルのいたとこー！

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Did you feel anything when you saw
that dead Marchen with its open
stomach?
fields.JP:
……あの、お腹の裂けたメルヒェンの死体を見て、
何か感じませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you feel anything when you saw
that dead Marchen with its open
stomach?

fields.EN:
You mean like the ones we find
around every so often?
fields.JP:
たまに独房エリアの中でも見かけていたもの……
ですよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean like the ones we find
around every so often?

fields.EN:
Do any of you remember your
younger days?
fields.JP: そなたたちは、幼い頃のことは覚えてませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do any of you remember your
younger days?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは、きちんと正しいことを話した
んです。気付いた時には『ここ』……
……あのメルヒェンの裂けた胎の中にいたと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.

fields.JP: うん！　そこにいたよ！

fields.EN:
We Blood Maidens were born from
Marchens in the form of humans.
We're monsters just like them.
fields.JP:
……わらわたち血式少女やそなたは、
メルヒェンから産まれながら、人の形を持つ存在
……まさに化物の子なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Blood Maidens were born from
Marchens in the form of humans.
We're monsters just like them.

fields.EN:
You're joking, right? This is no time
to be joking.
fields.JP:
嘘、でしょ？
そんな冗談……笑えないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're joking, right? This is no time
to be joking.

fields.EN:
I was told this by a person who I
thought was my parent, when I was
placed under the Professor's care.
fields.JP:
わらわはある日、わらわを取り上げた人間……
親と思っていた人から、それを教えられました。
それを聞かされたのは、博士に引き取られる時です
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was told this by a person who I
thought was my parent, when I was
placed under the Professor's care.

fields.EN:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.
fields.JP:
厄介払いするように、厄介な物の説明でも
するように、彼らは博士にそれを話しました。
博士はただ、興味深げに聞いていました
fields.LOCALIZED:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.

fields.EN:
The Professor explained the Jail
to me, but I didn't care. All I
knew was that I wasn't a human.
fields.JP:
博士はもっといろいろと、ジェイルの擬態能力など
説明してくれましたが、どうでもいいんです。
人間じゃないことには変わりないからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor explained the Jail
to me, but I didn't care. All I
knew was that I wasn't a human.

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...
fields.JP:
……ずっと信じたくなかった……
でも、あの光景を見て、もう自分を
ごまかすことができなくなりました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...

fields.JP: 僕らは……人間じゃなかったんだ……

fields.EN:
S-So, Dad kept that secret from us
all this time?
fields.JP:
そ……それじゃ、お父さんはそのこと、
知ってて黙ってたってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So, Dad kept that secret from us
all this time?

fields.JP: ねえさまたち……何も言ってなかった……

fields.EN: Perhaps the Professor kept quiet because he was afraid you'd get hurt. Michiru and the others were probably the same.
fields.JP:
博士は、そなたが傷つくのを怖れて、黙っていた
のではないでしょうか。
ミチルたちもおそらくは同じです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe the Professor kept it a
secret out of kindness. I believe
that applies to Michiru as well.

fields.EN:
This may sound silly, but I was
jealous of how you were all
sheltered out of love.
fields.JP:
……慰めに過ぎませんが、そんな愛情を貰えた
そなたたちが、わらわは羨ましいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
This may sound silly, but I was
jealous of how you were all
sheltered out of love.

fields.EN: That's not how I see it.
fields.JP: 私には、そうは思えないけど
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not how I see it.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Even if you're a newcomer, that's
no excuse for saying something bad
about Dad!
fields.JP:
いくら新入りだからって、お父さんやみんなの
ことを悪く言ったりしないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you're a newcomer, that's
no excuse for saying something bad
about Dad!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Akazukin-san... You
too, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP: 落ち着いて、赤ずきんさん……親指姫も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Red Riding Hood... You
too, Thumbelina.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
How can I stay calm after hearing
that?! Are you okay with what you
just heard, Alice?!
fields.JP:
落ち着いてなんか、いらんないよ！
アリスはこんなこと言われて、平気なわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can I stay calm after hearing
that?! Are you okay with what you
just heard, Alice?!

fields.EN:
I know you have doubts about
the Dawn, Gretel. Even so, don't
try to rile them up.
fields.JP:
グレーテル、あなたが黎明を疑っている
ことは知っているわ。
でも……彼女たちへの挑発はやめなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you have doubts about
the Dawn, Gretel. Even so, don't
try to rile them up.

fields.EN:
I'm not riling them up. I'm just
implying that it's worse not being
told the truth.
fields.JP:
挑発なんかじゃないわ。
知らされないことが時にはもっとも残酷なのだと
私は言っているだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not riling them up. I'm just
implying that it's worse not being
told the truth.

fields.EN:
Yes... I would have appreciated
being told this earlier...
fields.JP: ええ。わたくしは……知らせてほしかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I would have appreciated
being told this earlier...

fields.EN:
I heard that I was saved from a
Nightmare by the Professor.
fields.JP:
わたくし、ナイトメアと一緒にいたところを
博士に助けられたと、そう聞きましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard that I was saved from a
Nightmare by the Professor.

fields.EN:
I was also told much more about
myself than that.
fields.JP: いいえ……他にもいろいろと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was also told much more about
myself than that.

fields.EN: To think all of it was a lie...
fields.JP: それが、全部嘘だったなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: To think all of it was a lie...

fields.EN:
M-Maybe the Professor was being
kind and didn't want anyone to get
hurt...
fields.JP:
そ……それはさ、やっぱり博士はみんなに
傷ついてほしくなかったんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Maybe the Professor was being
kind and didn't want anyone to get
hurt...

fields.EN: You be quiet for a moment, Jack-san!
fields.JP: ジャックさんは黙っててくださいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED: You be quiet for a moment, Jack!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
First of all, Jack-san, how can you
and Alice-san be so calm about this?!
fields.JP:
だいたい、ジャックさんもアリスさんも……
どうしてそんなに冷静でいられるんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, how can you and Alice be so
calm about this?!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): アリス => Alice-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 | Line-level source-address restoration: localized EN omitted or structurally rewrote a JP name+honorific.

fields.EN:
I-I'm not calm... I'm in shock,
just like everyone else, but...
fields.JP:
れ……冷静なんかじゃないよ。
僕だってショックだったよ……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not calm... I'm in shock,
just like everyone else, but...

fields.EN:
It just made sense to us, that's
all. It explains why we were
shunned by others.
fields.JP:
ええ。どちらかというと、腑に落ちたの。
わたしたちがどうして人間から疎まれたのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just made sense to us, that's
all. It explains why we were
shunned by others.

fields.EN:
We were shunned because we
weren't human... We were something
different from them.
fields.JP:
わたしたち……人間ではなかったから……
彼らにとって異物だったから、疎まれたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were shunned because we
weren't human... We were something
different from them.

fields.EN:
This can't be true! Dad and
everyone in the Dawn, none of them
are shunning us at all!
fields.JP:
そんな……！　お父さんも黎明のみんなも、
あたしたちのことを疎んでなんかいない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can't be true! Dad and
everyone in the Dawn, none of them
are shunning us at all!

fields.EN:
She has to be right... If not, all
that we've been doing is...
fields.JP: じゃないと……あたしたち、何のために……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has to be right... If not, all
that we've been doing is...

fields.EN:
Kaguya has held back a lot of her
thoughts and feelings all this
time.
fields.JP:
かぐやさんは、これまでずっとこんな気持ちを
ひとりで抱えていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya has held back a lot of her
thoughts and feelings all this
time.

fields.EN:
But she decided to tell us, even
if it meant it would hurt, because
we're friends...
fields.JP:
それでも、仲間だから……
だからこんな辛い役目を引き受けてくれたんじゃ
ないですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she decided to tell us, even
if it meant it would hurt, because
we're friends...

fields.EN:
In that case, we shouldn't be
arguing amongst ourselves like
this...
fields.JP:
それなのに……白雪たちがいがみあっては
いけないと思います……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case, we shouldn't be
arguing amongst ourselves like
this...

fields.EN:
Jack showed me that I was able to
keep sane here because everyone
accepted me as a friend.
fields.JP:
わらわは……ジャックに教えられました。
みなさんがいたから、仲間として受け入れて
くれたから、わらわは正気でいられたのだと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack showed me that I was able to
keep sane here because everyone
accepted me as a friend.

fields.EN:
I'm just happy to have met all of
you... People similar to me...
People I can trust...
fields.JP:
わらわは、そなたたちと出会えて……
同じ境遇を分かち合えて……
誰よりも信頼できる仲間を得られて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy to have met all of
you... People similar to me...
People I can trust...

fields.EN:
That's why I don't care whether
we're humans or not.
fields.JP:
だから、人間だとか、そうではないとか……
そんなことはどうでもいいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I don't care whether
we're humans or not.

fields.EN:
Even if you hate me for telling
the truth, I wanted to share it,
along with my gratitude.
fields.JP:
たとえそなたたちに嫌われても、この事実を
わらわたちだけで分かち合いたかった……
そして、感謝の気持ちを伝えたかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you hate me for telling
the truth, I wanted to share it,
along with my gratitude.

fields.EN:
I may be pushing my feelings onto
you, but I'll take all you have
onto me. Let's help each other.
fields.JP:
わらわの気持ちの押し付けかもしれません……
でも、今度はわらわがみなさんを受け止めたい。
わらわたちは、互いに助け合えるのだと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may be pushing my feelings onto
you, but I'll take all you have
onto me. Let's help each other.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... I'm supposed to be
leading everyone, and look at
what's happened...
fields.JP:
……ごめん、みんな。
ほんとはあたしが一番しっかりしなきゃ
いけないのに、取り乱してさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I'm supposed to be
leading everyone, and look at
what's happened...

fields.EN:
I may have been insensitive,
too...
fields.JP:
わたしも……その、無神経だったのかも
しれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may have been insensitive,
too...

fields.EN:
Like I said before, your logic
could hinder you.
fields.JP:
言ったでしょ、アリス。
あなたの正論は、時としてあなたの足を掬うって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said before, your logic
could hinder you.

fields.JP: 聞いていないわ、そんなことは
あら。そうだったかしら？

fields.EN:
But, you're right... What I should
have said was...
fields.JP:
でも……そうね。
わたしはこう言うべきだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you're right... What I should
have said was...

fields.EN:
I wanted to live because Jack and
all of you were with me.
fields.JP:
誰よりも、ジャックとあなたたちがいたから、
わたしは、生きていこうと思えたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to live because Jack and
all of you were with me.

fields.EN:
I want everyone to do what they
can for themselves to escape, and
to live life as they see fit.
fields.JP:
誰のためでもない、わたしたち自身のために、
このジェイルを脱出して、その先を生きようと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want everyone to do what they
can for themselves to escape, and
to live life as they see fit.

fields.JP: わたくしたちが……いたから……？
誰のためでもない、あたしたち自身のために……

fields.EN:
That has been my intention from
the very beginning.
fields.JP: 私は初めからそのつもりだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That has been my intention from
the very beginning.

fields.EN:
But if you all weren't so kind, I
probably wouldn't have mentioned
it.
fields.JP:
でも、あなたたちがお人好しでなかったら、
こんなふうに内緒話に手を貸したりしなかった
かもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if you all weren't so kind, I
probably wouldn't have mentioned
it.

fields.JP:
……かぐや。誰もかぐやのことを嫌いになんか
ならないよ

fields.EN: Of course we wouldn't hate you...
fields.JP: その……当たり前じゃない、そんなの
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course we wouldn't hate you...

fields.EN:
You were right to tell us. For
being lazy, you sure put effort in
keeping everything secret.
fields.JP:
それに、虐めの件といいこの件といい、
グータラ姫のくせに、水臭いのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were right to tell us. For
being lazy, you sure put effort in
keeping everything secret.

fields.EN:
Dunno what, but Rapunzel likes
everyone!
fields.JP: よくわかんないけど、ラプンツェル、みんなすき！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dunno what, but Rapunzel likes
everyone!

fields.EN:
Yup! We have each other for
support! Who we are isn't an
issue!
fields.JP:
うん。あたしたちにはあたしたちがいる！
生まれなんか、関係ないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We have each other for
support! Who we are isn't an
issue!

fields.EN: But I'm glad this all turned out okay...
fields.JP:
……最初は戸惑ったけど、でも……
やっぱりこの形でよかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: But I'm glad this all turned out okay...

fields.EN:
(We're a short distance away from
the Liberated District. We really
have been through a lot...)
fields.JP:
（もうすぐ開放地区だ。
　今回もいろいろあったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're a short distance away from
the Liberated District. We really
have been through a lot...)

fields.EN:
I wonder what happened to
Princess Lazy?
fields.JP: ……グータラ姫のやつ、どうしちゃったのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what happened to
Princess Lazy?

fields.JP: あれから、一言も喋らないわね……

fields.EN:
For someone who's so quick
to ask others for things, she has
been very quiet...
fields.JP:
いつもはどうでもいい要求はするくせに……
水臭いですわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For someone who's so quick
to ask others for things, she has
been very quiet...

fields.JP: かぐや？　どーしたの？

fields.EN:
Isn't there anything we can do for
her?
fields.JP: 白雪たちに何かできること、無いでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't there anything we can do for
her?

fields.EN:
But she hasn't really told us
anything...
fields.JP: あの子、肝心なことは何も言ってくれないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she hasn't really told us
anything...

fields.EN:
I'll talk with her. Maybe it'll
help for her to speak with
someone.
fields.JP:
……僕が話を聞いてみるよ。
ひょっとしたら、少し話した方が
楽になるかもしれないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk with her. Maybe it'll
help for her to speak with
someone.

fields.EN:
True... It's probably best to have
Jack speak to her in private.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
みんなで聞こうとするより、
ジャックだけの方がいいかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... It's probably best to have
Jack speak to her in private.

fields.EN:
We're counting on you, Jack. We'll
head back first.
fields.JP:
ジャック、よろしくね。
あたしたちは先に帰ってるからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're counting on you, Jack. We'll
head back first.

fields.EN:
You don't have to talk if you
don't want to. I just wanted to
make sure you were okay.
fields.JP:
あ。無理に喋らないで。
様子、どうかなって思っただけだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to talk if you
don't want to. I just wanted to
make sure you were okay.

fields.EN:
Jack... Will you listen to me for
a minute?
fields.JP:
……………………
ジャック……
わらわの話を聞いてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Will you listen to me for
a minute?

fields.EN:
Are you sure? What I'm about to
say may hurt you, Jack...
fields.JP:
ジャックには、辛い話になるかもしれません。
……それでも聞いてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? What I'm about to
say may hurt you, Jack...

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm sure it must be
important if it's something you
want to share.
fields.JP:
……うん。
かぐや姫がそんな風に言うからには、
きっと大事なことだと思うから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm sure it must be
important if it's something you
want to share.

fields.EN:
Did you sense anything when you
saw that Marchen earlier with its
stomach open?
fields.JP:
……あの、お腹の裂けたメルヒェンの死体を見て、
何か感じませんでしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you sense anything when you
saw that Marchen earlier with its
stomach open?

fields.EN:
Just that I've seen them every so
often. Come to think of it, you've
been like this ever since then.
fields.JP:
……たまに見かけたなあって……
そういえば君、あれを見てから、様子が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just that I've seen them every so
often. Come to think of it, you've
been like this ever since then.

fields.EN:
To be exact, it hit me when I
heard Rapunzel's words. Everything
I had denied came together...
fields.JP:
正確には……あの子の言葉を聞いてから、です
……全てが繋がってしまったんです。
わらわが知っていた……認めたくなかったことが
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be exact, it hit me when I
heard Rapunzel's words. Everything
I had denied came together...

fields.EN:
Jack, do you remember your
childhood? The time before you met
Alice?
fields.JP:
ジャックは覚えていませんか？
そなたの幼かった頃のことを。
……そなたがアリスと出会った、その前のことを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, do you remember your
childhood? The time before you met
Alice?

fields.EN:
A time before I arrived at the
village...
fields.JP: 僕が……村に辿り着いた、その前のこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A time before I arrived at the
village...

fields.EN:
(That dead Marchen killed my
parents... No... Wait...)
fields.JP:
（いや……でもあれは確か、両親を殺した
　メルヒェンの死体で……でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That dead Marchen killed my
parents... No... Wait...)

fields.EN:
I don't remember anything about my
parents...
fields.JP: ……僕は、両親のことを何も覚えてない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't remember anything about my
parents...

fields.EN:
Jack... You're different from us.
But you are a Blood Youth.
fields.JP:
ジャック。そなたはわらわたちとは違う。
でも、そなたもまた、血式少年です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You're different from us.
But you are a Blood Youth.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは、きちんと正しいことを話した
んです。気付いた時には『ここ』……
……あのメルヒェンの裂けた胎の中にいたと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel was right when she said
that was her place. That she came
from that Marchen's belly.

fields.EN:
We Blood Maidens were born from
Marchens in the form of humans.
We're monsters just like them.
fields.JP:
……わらわたち血式少女やそなたは、
メルヒェンから産まれながら、人の形を持つ存在
……まさに化物の子なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Blood Maidens were born from
Marchens in the form of humans.
We're monsters just like them.

fields.EN:
The Professor explained the Jail
to me, but I didn't care. All I
knew was that I wasn't a human.
fields.JP:
博士はもっといろいろと、ジェイルの擬態能力など
説明してくれましたが、どうでもいいんです。
人間じゃないことには変わりないからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor explained the Jail
to me, but I didn't care. All I
knew was that I wasn't a human.

fields.EN:
I was told this by a person who I
thought was my parent, when I was
placed under the Professor's care.
fields.JP:
わらわはある日、わらわを取り上げた人間……
親と思っていた人から、それを教えられました。
それを聞かされたのは、博士に引き取られる時です
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was told this by a person who I
thought was my parent, when I was
placed under the Professor's care.

fields.EN:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.
fields.JP:
厄介払いするように、厄介な物の説明でも
するように、彼らは博士にそれを話しました。
博士はただ、興味深げに聞いていました
fields.LOCALIZED:
They spoke to the Professor about
me as if I were a burden, and he
listened with interest.

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...
fields.JP:
……ずっと信じたくなかった……
でも、あの光景を見て、もう自分を
ごまかすことができなくなりました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it. But I
now can't turn a blind eye to what
I saw...

fields.JP: 僕らは……人間じゃなかったんだ……

fields.EN:
(So my first memory being that
image... The reason why I know how
the Jail feels...)
fields.JP:
（僕の最初の記憶が、あの光景だったこと……
　何故かジェイルの気持ちがわかること……
　それは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So my first memory being that
image... The reason why I know how
the Jail feels...)

fields.EN:
I knew Alice and I were different,
but I thought it was just because
of the way this strange world was.
fields.JP:
僕にもアリスにも、普通と違うところがあって、
でも、ただ……めちゃくちゃな世界だから
そんなこともあるんだって思い込んでいたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew Alice and I were different,
but I thought it was just because
of the way this strange world was.

fields.JP: だから、やっと納得がいった気がするよ……
そなたは……ショックではないんですか？

fields.EN:
It's not that I'm not a little
surprised, but deep down, I think
I already knew...
fields.JP:
ショックじゃないわけじゃないけど……
でも今は、どこかでわかってた気もするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that I'm not a little
surprised, but deep down, I think
I already knew...

fields.EN:
You're much stronger than I
expected...
fields.JP: ……そなたは意外に……強い、んですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're much stronger than I
expected...

fields.EN:
I'm not strong. It's just that it
bugged me, wondering why we were
the way we were...
fields.JP:
強いんじゃないよ。
ただ、僕らはどうしてこんな風なんだろうって
ずっとおさまりが悪かったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not strong. It's just that it
bugged me, wondering why we were
the way we were...

fields.JP: だから多分、それだけだよ

fields.EN:
That's all...? Is that it? You're
not concerned that we're not
human?
fields.JP:
……それだけ……
そんなに簡単なことで、いいんですか？
わらわたちは人間ではなくても、いいんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's all...? Is that it? You're
not concerned that we're not
human?

fields.EN:
Well, because of that, we're able
to fight to escape the Jail,
and...
fields.JP:
だって、そのおかげでこのジェイルを脱出できる
かもしれない力を持ってるんだし、それに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, because of that, we're able
to fight to escape the Jail,
and...

fields.JP: だから、君たちにも出会えたんじゃないか

fields.EN: You truly are a strong person...
fields.JP: ……そなたはやはり、強い人です……
fields.LOCALIZED: You truly are a strong person...

fields.EN:
That's not true. Everyone's been
really friendly with us. I'm sure
we don't need to worry.
fields.JP:
そんなこと……
ほら、博士たちだって、僕らに良くしてくれるし、
多分、そんなに気にすることはないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. Everyone's been
really friendly with us. I'm sure
we don't need to worry.

fields.EN:
They're friendly with us because
they see us as useful tools...
fields.JP:
彼らが良くしてくれるのは、
わらわたちが役に立つ道具だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're friendly with us because
they see us as useful tools...

fields.EN: ...I can't see humans any other way anymore. This is the first time I've ever opened my heart this much...
fields.JP:
……わらわには、もうそんな風にしか
人間のことを見られないんです。
これだけ心を打ち明けたのも、今が初めて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see most humans as suspicious...
In fact, this is the first time
I've opened up to anyone.

fields.EN:
Jack? Can you please keep this our
secret?
fields.JP:
……だからジャック。
この話は、みんなには黙っていてくれませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Can you please keep this our
secret?

fields.EN:
I know I'm asking for a lot after
saying all this to you, but I
don't want to hurt anyone...
fields.JP:
そなたに打ち明けてしまって、虫のいい話だと
思います。
でも……みんなを傷つけたくないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm asking for a lot after
saying all this to you, but I
don't want to hurt anyone...

fields.EN:
Even with the way I am, all of you
are my only friends...
fields.JP:
これでもわらわにとっては……
みんなは初めてできた、唯一の仲間なんです。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even with the way I am, all of you
are my only friends...

fields.EN:
I can see Akazukin being
hurt the most if she knew about
this...
fields.JP:
特に赤ずきんは、隠し事があったと知ったら
とても傷つくはず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can see Red Riding Hood being
hurt the most if she knew about
this...

fields.EN:
You're a really kind person,
Kaguyahime.
fields.JP: かぐや姫は、ほんとはとても優しい子なんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a really kind person,
Kaguya.

fields.JP: きゅ……急に、何を言うんですか

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel, but I
think it's best to share this with
everyone.
fields.JP:
君が隠しておきたい気持ちは、すごくわかる。
でも……僕は話した方がいいと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel, but I
think it's best to share this with
everyone.

fields.EN:
Why? Are you sure you understood
what I told you?
fields.JP:
どうしてですか？
やっぱりわかってくれていないんじゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Are you sure you understood
what I told you?

fields.EN: No. I think both you and I were saved because we met everyone.
fields.JP:
違うよ。
僕も君も、みんなに出会えたから救われたんじゃ
ないかなって、僕は思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but we all were saved because
we met each other.

fields.EN: So... if you tell them yourself instead of leaving it to the others... then this time, you can be the one to accept everyone...!
fields.JP:
だから……他の人たちじゃなくて、
君の口から話せば……
今度は、君がみんなを受け止めてあげれば……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this should come from you, and
no one else. You'll need to listen
to what they have to say, too.

fields.EN:
Jack...? Are you going to take
responsibility?
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
そなたは責任を取ってくれるんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...? Are you going to take
responsibility?

fields.EN:
You aren't thinking of making me
say all this and take on the
entire burden, are you?
fields.JP:
まさかわらわだけに話させ、
みんなを受け止めさせる気なんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You aren't thinking of making me
say all this and take on the
entire burden, are you?

fields.EN:
You're right... Let's talk to them
together.
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... Let's talk to them
together.

fields.EN:
I... I'm friends with everyone
here, right? Even with how
obnoxious and reclusive I am...
fields.JP:
わらわは……そなたたちの仲間、なんですよね？
わがままを言っても、人間が嫌いでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I'm friends with everyone
here, right? Even with how
obnoxious and reclusive I am...

fields.EN:
Of course you're our friend! I've
thought of you as a friend ever
since we met.
fields.JP:
……当たり前だよ！
僕は最初から、君を大事な仲間だって思ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course you're our friend! I've
thought of you as a friend ever
since we met.

fields.EN: Not just you—everyone. I think having all of you here, accepting me as one of your friends, is what kept me from giving up.
fields.JP:
君だけじゃなくて、ほかのみんなも……
みんながいて、仲間として受け入れてくれたから
僕はくじけずに済んでるんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only me, but all of us...
We're all friends. I think that's
why we can do what we're doing.

fields.EN:
But won't they hate me for
disclosing such a horrible story?
fields.JP:
みんなは、わらわが何か、嫌な話をしても
嫌わないでくれるでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But won't they hate me for
disclosing such a horrible story?

fields.EN:
If this is something from your
heart that you truly want to share
with everyone, it'll be fine.
fields.JP:
それが、かぐや姫がどうしても聞いてほしい、
真面目な話だったら……きっとそんなことはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this is something from your
heart that you truly want to share
with everyone, it'll be fine.

fields.EN:
At the very least, you know I
don't hate you.
fields.JP: 少なくとも、僕は嫌わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, you know I
don't hate you.

fields.JP:
わかりました。
ありがとう、ジャック

fields.EN:
D-Do you mind if you stay by my
side for a moment?
fields.JP:
それでは……
その間、傍にいてもらえませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Do you mind if you stay by my
side for a moment?

fields.EN:
It's just that... seeing your face
eases my nerves a bit...
fields.JP:
その……そなたの顔を見ると、
いい具合に気が抜けますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that... seeing your face
eases my nerves a bit...

fields.JP: （かぐや姫、何を言うつもりなんだろう……？）

fields.EN:
We still have another objective to
clear for the mission.
fields.JP: 今回の使命は、まだもうひとつ残ってます
fields.LOCALIZED:
We still have another objective to
clear for the mission.

fields.EN:
I don't want this to affect
everyone when we haven't even
finished yet.
fields.JP:
先に話してしまって、作戦行動に影響が出て
しまったら、困ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want this to affect
everyone when we haven't even
finished yet.

fields.EN:
So, I'm thinking of waiting until
we've completed our mission.
fields.JP:
ですから、作戦行動が完了するまで、
待とうと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'm thinking of waiting until
we've completed our mission.

fields.EN:
I'll speak with everyone when we
return to the Dawn...
fields.JP: 黎明に戻ったら……話したいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll speak with everyone when we
return to the Dawn...

fields.EN:
But, I think it's best to speak
amongst ourselves, since it's a
pretty serious topic and all.
fields.JP:
でもきっと、仲間たちだけで話したほうが
いいと思うんだ。
かぐや姫の真面目な話なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I think it's best to speak
amongst ourselves, since it's a
pretty serious topic and all.

fields.EN: Yup... If only a bit tired.
fields.JP: ……うん。みんな、ちょっと疲れてるけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup... If only a bit tired.

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised. You've had to
handle two missions in a row.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦行動がふたつも続いたんだもの。
無理もないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised. You've had to
handle two missions in a row.

fields.EN:
Indeed. But your efforts have led
the Tower to grow again. We're
near the final stage of our plan.
fields.JP:
そうだね。君たちの活躍のおかげで、
『監獄塔』も更なる成長を遂げたよ。
計画もいよいよ大詰めにかかっている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. But your efforts have led
the Tower to grow again. We're
near the final stage of our plan.

fields.EN:
What you've done is amazing.
You're the hope of everyone here
in the Jail. Thank you.
fields.JP:
本当に素晴らしいよ。
君たちはこのジェイルに閉じ込められた人々の
まさに希望だよ。本当にありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you've done is amazing.
You're the hope of everyone here
in the Jail. Thank you.

fields.EN:
Now then, the reason I had
everyone come here this morning
despite being tired is...
fields.JP:
さて。疲れているところを押して、
今朝集まってもらったのは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, the reason I had
everyone come here this morning
despite being tired is...

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、げんきだよーー！！

fields.EN:
Ah, yes. We have obtained further
evidence from our meetings with
Rapunzel-kun and Gretel-kun.
fields.JP:
ああ。このラプンツェルくんと
グレーテルくんの証言から、新たに
確証が取れたことがあってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yes. We have obtained further
evidence from our meetings with
Rapunzel and Gretel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルくん => Rapunzel-kun; グレーテルくん => Gretel-kun

fields.EN: I'd had the hypothesis for some time, but it was based on only one case, and even that was hearsay. That's why I held back from mentioning it until now...
fields.JP:
仮定としては以前から持っていたのだが、
それはほんの一例に過ぎず、しかも伝聞だった。
そのため、今まで話すのを控えていた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been holding back on talking
about this because I didn't have
firm evidence to support it.

fields.EN:
This may hurt you all, but I don't
want to hide it any longer.
fields.JP:
君たちには辛い話かもしれないが、隠し事は
したくないのでね……聞いてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
This may hurt you all, but I don't
want to hide it any longer.

fields.EN: ...Marchens born from the mimicry of pregnant humans carried children in their wombs who remained human.
fields.JP:
……人間の妊婦が擬態させられた
ことで生まれたメルヒェンは、胎内に
人間のままの子を宿していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that Marchens created
by the Jail's mimicry of pregnant
humans doesn't affect the infant.

fields.EN:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.
fields.JP:
つまり、いくらジェイルでも胎内の子まで
擬態させることは不可能だったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.

fields.EN:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.
fields.JP:
そのメルヒェンたちは、そのまま胎内で
子を育て……胎を破って生まれてきた
子たちは、人間には無い能力を備えていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.

fields.EN:
So we're a cross-breed between
Marchens and humans. A species
called "Blood Maidens."
fields.JP:
……つまり、私たちはメルヒェンと人間との
ハーフ……違うわね。
血式少女という生物というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we're a cross-breed between
Marchens and humans. A species
called "Blood Maidens."

fields.JP: 君は明晰だね。グレーテルくん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルくん => Gretel-kun

fields.EN:
Thank you for the praise. I
believe that's my... Let's see...
What did you call it, Professor?
fields.JP:
お褒めいただき、ありがとう。
おそらくは、それが私の……ええと……
博士、あなたは何と言っていたかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for the praise. I
believe that's my... Let's see...
What did you call it, Professor?

fields.JP: ……血式リビドー。博士が名付けたものよ

fields.EN:
Yes. Each of you holds a unique
attachment to something.
fields.JP:
ええ。あなたたちにはそれぞれ、何か特有の
こだわりのようなものがあるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Each of you holds a unique
attachment to something.

fields.EN:
You mean how I'm attached to my
shoe-shaped glass earrings, or how
I like cleaning?
fields.JP:
わたくしの……ガラスの靴のイヤリングや
お掃除のようなことですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean how I'm attached to my
shoe-shaped glass earrings, or how
I like cleaning?

fields.EN:
So my being attached to my hood
is...?!
fields.JP: じゃあ……あたしのフードへのこだわりも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So my being attached to my hood
is...?!

fields.EN:
Yes. Until recently, I thought Blood
Maidens had a volatile mental
state within them.
fields.JP:
ああ。これまでは血式少女として、不安定な
精神状態を併せ持っているものだと考えて
いたのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Until recently, I thought Blood
Maidens had a volatile mental
state within them.

fields.EN:
But after speaking with Gretel-kun, I
thought of that being a special
trait of a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
グレーテルくんとの対話で、それが血式少女と
しての特質なのではないかと考えたのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after speaking with Gretel, I
thought of that being a special
trait of a Blood Maiden.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルくん => Gretel-kun

fields.EN:
(How much information did Gretel
share with the Professor...?)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルは、博士にどこまで話したん
　だろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How much information did Gretel
share with the Professor...?)

fields.EN:
That trait isn't a weakness, nor
is it something that needs to be
fixed. Simply a characteristic.
fields.JP:
それはあなたたちの克服すべき欠点でもなければ、
弱点でもないわ。個性の一環と考えていいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That trait isn't a weakness, nor
is it something that needs to be
fixed. Simply a characteristic.

fields.EN:
You know, like how everyone has
a unique aspect to their
personality.
fields.JP:
まあ何だ。誰しも多かれ少なかれ、こだわりは
持ってるもんだしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, like how everyone has
a unique aspect to their
personality.

fields.EN:
That's all I have to share now,
