but... Are you all okay? Is this
silence one of disbelief?
fields.JP:
私の話は以上だが……君たちは大丈夫かね？
それとも驚きのあまり、沈黙しているのかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's all I have to share now,
but... Are you all okay? Is this
silence one of disbelief?

fields.EN:
We found out after hearing what
Rapunzel-san said.
fields.JP:
白雪たち、ラプンツェルさんのお話から、
全てがわかっていたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found out after hearing what
Rapunzel said.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.EN:
We also talked amongst ourselves,
too...
fields.JP:
それでも、白雪たちは白雪たちだって、
みんなで話し合ったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also talked amongst ourselves,
too...

fields.JP: うん。あたしたちは大丈夫だよ、お父さん

fields.EN:
I see... I suppose my children
were a lot stronger than I
thought.
fields.JP:
……そうか。それは頼もしい娘たちや息子を
持ったものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I suppose my children
were a lot stronger than I
thought.

fields.JP: ええ。むしろこちらが驚いたわ

fields.EN:
Well, they've been through a lot
already. I bet stuff like this
wouldn't make 'em flinch at all.
fields.JP:
お前らもなんだかんだもう、歴戦の勇士だしな。
これくらいのことじゃ、びくともしねえだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, they've been through a lot
already. I bet stuff like this
wouldn't make 'em flinch at all.

fields.EN:
You are all precious members of
the Dawn, and even more so like
family to us all.
fields.JP:
君たちが我々黎明の大切な一員であり、
私たちが家族のような存在であることには
変わり無いからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are all precious members of
the Dawn, and even more so like
family to us all.

fields.EN:
We're about to head into our final
stage. I'll be asking for your
help, even more than before.
fields.JP:
……これからが、大詰めだ。
君たちには更に活躍してもらわなければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're about to head into our final
stage. I'll be asking for your
help, even more than before.

fields.EN:
Now then, rest well and take it
easy for today as you please.
fields.JP:
今日のところはゆっくりと休息を取って、
英気を養ってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, rest well and take it
easy for today as you please.

fields.JP: うん！　あたしたち……がんばるよ！

fields.EN:
(What the Professor shared with
us is worded differently, but it's
the same as what Kaguyahime said.)
fields.JP:
（博士が話してくれたことは、言葉は違うけど
　かぐや姫の話と同じ内容だった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the Professor shared with
us is worded differently, but it's
the same as what Kaguya said.)

fields.EN:
(But why now? He said we're in the
final stage...)
fields.JP:
（でも……どうして今こんな話をしたんだろう？
　これからが大詰めだって言ってたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But why now? He said we're in the
final stage...)

fields.EN:
(If we were shocked beyond belief,
it would've negatively affected
whatever plan was in the works...)
fields.JP:
（僕たちが立ち直れないくらい
　ショックを受けたら……その後の作戦行動に
　影響が出るかもしれないのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we were shocked beyond belief,
it would've negatively affected
whatever plan was in the works...)

fields.EN:
Thank you for your time. You are
now dismissed.
fields.JP:
すっかり時間を取らせてしまったね。
さあ、みんな戻って休むといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for your time. You are
now dismissed.

fields.EN:
I was... surprised you were
getting along so well with the
Professor.
fields.JP:
あ、うん。
博士とあんなに意気投合してるなんて、
びっくりしたなって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was... surprised you were
getting along so well with the
Professor.

fields.JP: ……あなたは何でも面白がるのね

fields.EN:
Why, yes. I believe it's because
my curiosity and inquisitiveness
is my Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
ええ。知的好奇心こそが、私の血式リビドー
なんだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. I believe it's because
my curiosity and inquisitiveness
is my Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
I wonder what your Blood Libido
could be, Alice...
fields.JP:
……アリス。あなたの血式リビドーは
何なのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what your Blood Libido
could be, Alice...

fields.EN: I don't know, and I don't care.
fields.JP: さあ……知らないし、興味も無いわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know, and I don't care.

fields.EN:
You must still be wandering within
your deceptive dream.
fields.JP: あなたはまだ、欺瞞の夢の中を彷徨っているのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must still be wandering within
your deceptive dream.

fields.EN:
From my perspective, it's you
who's toying with deception.
fields.JP:
……わたしには、あなたこそ欺瞞を弄んでいる
ように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From my perspective, it's you
who's toying with deception.

fields.JP: （……また、この二人の言い合いが始まった……）

fields.EN:
I'm just honest. But, I won't deny
that my method has become my
motive.
fields.JP:
私はいつだって正直よ？
でも……そうね。手段が目的になっていることは
否定はしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just honest. But, I won't deny
that my method has become my
motive.

fields.EN:
And, your very nature is similar
to mine, and quite possibly
Jack's.
fields.JP:
けれど、あなたの本質は、私ととても似ているわ。
おそらく……ジャックもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, your very nature is similar
to mine, and quite possibly
Jack's.

fields.EN:
I'll accept being somewhat similar
to you, but don't drag Jack into
this.
fields.JP:
確かに、わたしとあなたはどこか似ているのかも
しれないわ。でも……ジャックを巻き込まないで
頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll accept being somewhat similar
to you, but don't drag Jack into
this.

fields.EN:
Oh? I was merely offering you both
the highest praise.
fields.JP: あら。私にとっては最大の賛辞なのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I was merely offering you both
the highest praise.

fields.EN:
I'm not a narcissist in the
slightest.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a narcissist in the
slightest.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry I didn't notice you. Is
there something you need?
fields.JP:
……気付かなくてごめんなさい。
どうしたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry I didn't notice you. Is
there something you need?

fields.JP: （……あ、もうみんな帰っちゃったんだ……）

……すみません！
何でもありません……！

fields.EN:
She seemed very serious... I
wonder what's wrong.
fields.JP:
何か思いつめていたようだけれど……
何かあったのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She seemed very serious... I
wonder what's wrong.

fields.EN:
I'm sure she'll let us know if
it's really important.
fields.JP:
……本当に困ったことがあったら、
きっと話してくれるんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure she'll let us know if
it's really important.

fields.EN:
Considering your relationship,
that may be possible.
fields.JP: あなたたちの関係なら……そうかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering your relationship,
that may be possible.

fields.EN: Now then, let's leave, shall we?
fields.JP: 私たちも、戻りましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, let's leave, shall we?

fields.EN:
(Even if we could rest, it's not
like I really want to...)
fields.JP:
（いきなり休めって言われても……
　かえって手持ち無沙汰だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if we could rest, it's not
like I really want to...)

fields.EN:
(That's right... I forgot about
how the Nightmare has a
transceiver, too...)
fields.JP:
（……そういえば、今回のナイトメアも
　トランシーバーを持っていた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I forgot about
how the Nightmare has a
transceiver, too...)

fields.JP:
（やっぱり、スナークと連絡を取り合って
　いたんだろうか……）

fields.EN:
(But, why? There are so many
things I don't know yet...)
fields.JP:
（でも、何のために……？
　……わからないことばかりだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, why? There are so many
things I don't know yet...)

fields.EN: Huh...? Who is it...? Come in.
fields.JP:
え……？　誰だろう……
はーい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh...? Who is it...? Come in.

fields.EN:
Um... I really need to talk to
someone...
fields.JP:
その……やっぱり誰かに話したくて。
話さなくちゃいけないって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I really need to talk to
someone...

fields.EN:
But I can't bring this up to
Aka-neesama or Oyayubi-neesama or
Nemu-chan...!
fields.JP:
でも、赤姉様には絶対に言えなくて……
親指姉様やネムちゃんにも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I can't bring this up to
Sister Red or Thumbelina or
Sleepy...!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you want to talk
about, but let's calm down first.
We can talk after.
fields.JP:
よくわからないんだけど……とりあえず、
落ち着いてよ。話だったら聞くからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you want to talk
about, but let's calm down first.
We can talk after.

fields.JP: うう……ありがとうございます

fields.EN:
Why did the Professor bring that
up now?
fields.JP:
博士は、なんでこのタイミングであんなことを
言ったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did the Professor bring that
up now?

(Snow White was having the same
thoughts...)

fields.EN:
He said he obtained evidence from
Rapunzel-san and Gretel-san...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルさんやグレーテルさんの話から
確証が取れたからって言ってましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said he obtained evidence from
Rapunzel and Gretel...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san; グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
But if we didn't hear it first
from Kaguya, we would have all
been in shock and disbelief.
fields.JP:
もし白雪たちが、かぐやさんから話を聞いて
いなければ、すごくショックを受けたと
思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we didn't hear it first
from Kaguya, we would have all
been in shock and disbelief.

fields.EN:
But what we spoke about then
shouldn't be known by anyone in
the Dawn besides us.
fields.JP:
でも、あの場所で話したことは黎明のひとは
知らないはずで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what we spoke about then
shouldn't be known by anyone in
the Dawn besides us.

fields.EN:
(She's right... The Professor said
he didn't want to hide it anymore,
but... something isn't right...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……隠し事はしたくないって言ってた
　けど、何かが引っかかる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right... The Professor said
he didn't want to hide it anymore,
but... something isn't right...)

fields.EN:
To add, it seemed as if both Haru-san
and Miko-san were aware of it.
fields.JP:
それに、話の内容はハルさんや視子さんも
知ってるみたいでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, it seemed as if both Haru
and Miko were aware of it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
The weird feeling I've been having
all this time is starting to feel
all too real...
fields.JP:
なんだか、これまで薄々感じていた違和感が、
心の中で大きくなるみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The weird feeling I've been having
all this time is starting to feel
all too real...

fields.EN:
To be honest, there's a number of
things that bother me...
fields.JP:
……実は、僕もいろいろ不審に思ってたことは
あったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, there's a number of
things that bother me...

fields.EN:
I'm not sure either, but the Dawn
is hiding something from us.
Gretel said the same thing, too.
fields.JP:
僕にもまだはっきりとはわからないんだけど、
確かに黎明の人たちはみんな、何かを隠してる。
グレーテルもそう言ってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure either, but the Dawn
is hiding something from us.
Gretel said the same thing, too.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
That's why I'm keeping an eye out
for what's happening around us.
fields.JP:
僕も、ここで何が起きてるのかを、もっと
注意してみるようにするつもりなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I'm keeping an eye out
for what's happening around us.

fields.EN:
That said, just like Alice
mentioned, let's do our best for
ourselves, and escape from here.
fields.JP:
だけど……アリスも言ってたけど……
僕たちは僕たちのために、ここからの脱出を
成功させようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, just like Alice
mentioned, let's do our best for
ourselves, and escape from here.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Shirayuki will become stronger
so that, when the time comes, she
can support everyone...
fields.JP:
……白雪、もっと強くなります。
その時が来たら、みんなを支えられるように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White will become stronger
so that, when the time comes, she
can support everyone...

fields.EN:
(I need to wake up... They're
calling to get everyone
together...)
fields.JP:
（……あ。集合の合図だ。
　起きなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to wake up... They're
calling to get everyone
together...)

fields.EN:
Hahaha! If you woke up, you don't
need to answer me.
fields.JP:
ははは。一度で起きてくれたのなら、
特に返事をしてくれなくても構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! If you woke up, you don't
need to answer me.

fields.EN:
(It's still early... I wonder
what's up...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても……まだずいぶん早い時間だけど、
　何かあったのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's still early... I wonder
what's up...)

fields.EN:
The nest is filled with little
birdies.
fields.JP: 巣の中は、小鳥たちでいっぱいになったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The nest is filled with little
birdies.

fields.JP: そう。もうみんな寂しくないのね

fields.EN:
I'm sure the birdies will grow
strong and leave the nest.
fields.JP:
小鳥たちはみんな強く育って、やがて巣を
旅立つことだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure the birdies will grow
strong and leave the nest.

fields.EN: It's fate. All we can do is watch.
fields.JP:
それが運命だからね。僕らには見守ることしか
できないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's fate. All we can do is watch.

fields.JP: 空を覆う天幕が降りてきたね

fields.EN:
The sun is beyond the heavens,
right?
fields.JP: 天幕の向こうに、おひさまはいるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun is beyond the heavens,
right?

fields.EN:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.
fields.JP:
そうさ。さあ、今日のごはんだよ
森の朝露に、生命の木の実
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.

fields.EN:
Blue Bird-san. I want to see the sun
with you, Blue Bird-san.
fields.JP:
青い鳥さん。わたし、
青い鳥さんといっしょに
おひさまが見たいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blue bird? I want to see the sun
with you, blue bird.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Yes. I'm sure that will bring the
finale to the story's first
chapter.
fields.JP:
そうだね。それが物語の第一幕の
フィナーレとなることだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I'm sure that will bring the
finale to the story's first
chapter.

fields.EN:
Go ahead. Eat and drink as you
normally do...
fields.JP: さあ、飲んでお食べ……いつものように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead. Eat and drink as you
normally do...

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone's here. How
does everyone feel?
fields.JP:
さて……みんな揃ったようだね。
疲れは取れたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's here. How
does everyone feel?

fields.JP: うん……あたしはね。ラプは……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: ごはんおいしかったー！
ワレも大変美味であった……

fields.EN:
Seems like all is well. How about
you, Gretel?
fields.JP: 問題無いとして、グレーテルは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like all is well. How about
you, Gretel?

fields.EN:
I'm fine. In fact, I've been
reading the Professor's research
with interest.
fields.JP:
ええ。博士の研究を興味深く拝見させて
もらってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. In fact, I've been
reading the Professor's research
with interest.

fields.EN:
You've done more than just read.
Your insight has advanced our
knowledge of the Jail's mimicry.
fields.JP:
それどころではないよ。君の頭脳は
非常に優秀で、示唆に富んでいるよ。
ジェイルの擬態能力についても、一層……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've done more than just read.
Your insight has advanced our
knowledge of the Jail's mimicry.

fields.EN:
Oh? Guess she was a pretty awesome
find for you then, huh, old man?
fields.JP:
ほう……それじゃ、思わぬめっけものじゃ
ねえの、オッさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Guess she was a pretty awesome
find for you then, huh, old man?

fields.EN: Yes. I was an awesome find.
fields.JP: ええ。めっけものだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I was an awesome find.

fields.EN:
She doesn't possess respectful
traits such as humility.
fields.JP: 彼女に謙遜の美点などないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't possess respectful
traits such as humility.

fields.EN:
Humility is useless. Hm, perhaps I
can be the Professor's assistant
when we reach the surface.
fields.JP:
謙遜など、無意味だもの。
そうね……地上へ出たら、博士の助手にして
もらおうかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humility is useless. Hm, perhaps I
can be the Professor's assistant
when we reach the surface.

fields.EN:
Ah... I guess all is well with
her, too...
fields.JP: あー。まあ、こっちも問題無いとして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... I guess all is well with
her, too...

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is trying to
keep a strong front... Maybe it's
because she's the senior here...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん、元気そうに振舞ってる。
　やっぱり、みんなのお姉さんだから……
　頑張ってるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is trying to
keep a strong front... Maybe it's
because she's the senior here...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ジャック。あんたはどう？

fields.EN: We can't afford seeing you fall.
fields.JP:
この中で一番倒れがちっていったら、あんた
でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: We can't afford seeing you fall.

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I'm fine. I was able
to get some rest.
fields.JP:
あ……うん。僕も大丈夫だよ。
ゆっくり休めたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I'm fine. I was able
to get some rest.

fields.JP: じゃあ全員問題なしだね！

fields.EN: That's a broad assumption to make!
fields.JP:
それ……
ものすごくアバウトじゃありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED: That's a broad assumption to make!

fields.EN:
Hahaha! So you're all rested. I'm
happy to know how strong you all
are despite the news I shared.
fields.JP:
ははは。全員元気なことはわかったよ。
ショックもあっただろうに、強い子たちで
嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! So you're all rested. I'm
happy to know how strong you all
are despite the news I shared.

fields.EN:
Speaking of which, do you mind if
I ask a question?
fields.JP:
ところで……
ひとつ伺っても構いませんですかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of which, do you mind if
I ask a question?

fields.JP: お。どうした、シンデレラ？

fields.EN:
I understand that Hansel-san was
Gretel-san's onii-sama. But...
fields.JP:
ヘンゼルさんがグレーテルさんのお兄様だった
のはわかりましたわ。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand Hansel being Gretel's
brother, but...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヘンゼルさん => Hansel-san; グレーテルさん => Gretel-san | Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Is there a reason why the other
Nightmares were able to speak?
fields.JP:
他のエリアでもナイトメアが喋ったのは何故なの
でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a reason why the other
Nightmares were able to speak?

fields.EN:
It was surprising to me because
I've been told all this time that
Nightmares couldn't speak.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは人間の言葉なんて話せないって
聞いていたので、それはびっくりしました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was surprising to me because
I've been told all this time that
Nightmares couldn't speak.

fields.EN:
Ah, well, we didn't have many
options but to run when we
encountered a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
あー、あれだ。ナイトメアっていったら、
出会ったら何が何でも逃げるしかない相手だった
からな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, well, we didn't have many
options but to run when we
encountered a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
So we never had the chance to
observe them speaking.
fields.JP:
これまではあいつらに喋らせるようなとこまで
持ってけなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we never had the chance to
observe them speaking.

fields.JP: （ハルさん……何か誤魔化してる？）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: Until we learned that destroying the cores was the key to defeating Nightmares, it's fair to say we understood almost nothing about their ecology.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。核の破壊がナイトメア討伐の糸口
だと知るまでは、ナイトメアの生態はほぼ全く
解明されなかったといっていいからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We hardly knew anything about the
Nightmares until we found out
about the cores in the areas.

fields.EN:
We're only now finding out various
things from your missions and
information from Gretel-kun.
fields.JP:
それが君たちの活躍、そしてグレーテルくんから
の情報のおかげで、多くのことがわかってきたと
いうわけなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're only now finding out various
things from your missions and
information from Gretel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルくん => Gretel-kun

fields.EN:
Unlike Marchens, we didn't know
Nightmares vanished upon death.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンとは違って、死ぬと消滅することすら
わかっていなかったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unlike Marchens, we didn't know
Nightmares vanished upon death.

fields.EN:
And now we know that Nightmares
possess a level of intelligence,
though nothing complex.
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアには、決して高くはないものの、
一定の知能が備わっているようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And now we know that Nightmares
possess a level of intelligence,
though nothing complex.

fields.EN:
Gretel-kun's example proves that, 
depending on the Nightmare, some
form of relationship is possible.
fields.JP:
グレーテルくんの事例のように、特定の状況……
いや、ナイトメアの性質次第では、固有の関係を
築く場合もあるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's example proves that, 
depending on the Nightmare, some
form of relationship is possible.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルくん => Gretel-kun

fields.EN:
I didn't see anything unusual
about Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
……ヘンゼル兄さんは、特に変わっていたとは
思えないのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't see anything unusual
about my brother, Hansel.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
On the contrary. From what I
heard, wasn't he quite calm and
gentle?
fields.JP:
いや、私の知る限り、非常に温和な性格の個体
だったのではないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary. From what I
heard, wasn't he quite calm and
gentle?

fields.EN: I suppose. Hansel-niisan was very kind.
fields.JP:
そうね……ヘンゼル兄さんは、とても優しい兄
だったものね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose. Hansel was very kind.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN: So, Dad? What's up for today?
fields.JP: それでお父さん、今日の本題は？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, Dad? What's up for today?

fields.EN:
I need you to search the Station
Grounds. It used to be the center
of transit for the city.
fields.JP:
今度の探索地は『元駅構内エリア』になる。
かつてここにあった街の交通の中心となって
いた場所なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need you to search the Station
Grounds. It used to be the center
of transit for the city.

fields.EN:
It's located past the Waterside
and the Dorm.
fields.JP:
『旧河川・沼エリア』や『旧学生街エリア』の
更に奥に位置する、非常に奥まった位置に
なるのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's located past the Waterside
and the Dorm.

fields.EN: That's where you found me, right?
fields.JP: ……それ、あたしが拾われたって場所だよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: That's where you found me, right?

fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yup. Dad and his leader found me
there. I've been raised by the
Dawn ever since.
fields.JP:
うん。昔いた『隊長』って人とお父さんが、
あたしを見つけたんだって。それからあたしは、
黎明で育てられたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Dad and his leader found me
there. I've been raised by the
Dawn ever since.

fields.EN: ...He died in the tragedy fifteen years ago.
fields.JP: ……亡くなったわ。十五年前の惨劇でね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He died after the tragedy that
occurred 15 years ago.

fields.EN: (The tragedy fifteen years ago... when they headed for the Tower and were wiped out by Snark...)
fields.JP:
（十五年前の惨劇って……タワーを目指して
　スナークに全滅させられたっていう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Tragedy 15 years ago? Isn't that
when they went to the Tower and
were attacked by Snark?)

fields.EN:
So we've searched the area before,
but being that it's the farthest
location, it's very dangerous.
fields.JP:
……そのようなわけで、『元駅構内エリア』は
過去に探索をしているのだが、最奥部に位置する
だけあって、危険度は非常に高い
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we've searched the area before,
but being that it's the farthest
location, it's very dangerous.

fields.EN:
Whatever's there may just eat you
up in one gulp.
fields.JP: お前なんか、ぺろっと食っちまうんじゃねえか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever's there may just eat you
up in one gulp.

fields.JP: じゃあラプンツェルがそれたべるよ！

fields.EN:
There shall be nothing to fear, so
long as I am there!
fields.JP: ワレがいれば、何の問題もなかろうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There shall be nothing to fear, so
long as I am there!

fields.EN:
Guess we'll need to be extra
cautious, then...
fields.JP: ……十分に警戒が必要だということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we'll need to be extra
cautious, then...

fields.EN:
Yes. Search efforts back then were
impossible. My unit leader saved
me on more than one occasion.
fields.JP:
ああ。当時も探索には困難を極めたものだった
からね。私も何度隊長に命を救われたことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Search efforts back then were
impossible. My unit leader saved
me on more than one occasion.

fields.EN:
Be very careful. I want each and
every one of you back alive.
fields.JP:
くれぐれも念には念を入れて進んでもらいたい。
私たちは君たちに、誰一人として欠けることなく
戻って来てほしいと願っているからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be very careful. I want each and
every one of you back alive.

fields.EN:
By my calculations, if we can
destroy that area's core...
fields.JP:
……先ほど、このエリアが最奥部だと言ったと
思うが、それはつまり――
fields.LOCALIZED:
By my calculations, if we can
destroy that area's core...

fields.EN:
...The Tower will grow high enough
for us to escape.
fields.JP:
理論上、このエリアの核を破壊すれば、タワーが
脱出可能な高度に達することになるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Tower will grow high enough
for us to escape.

fields.JP: じゃあ……今回の作戦が成功すれば……！

fields.EN:
Yes... We can finally begin our
ascension of the Tower. The time
for humanity to strike will begin.
fields.JP:
……ああ。いよいよ脱出計画の開始となり、
タワーを目指すこととなる。
……人類の反撃の始まりだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We can finally begin our
ascension of the Tower. The time
for humanity to strike will begin.

fields.EN:
Then that's even more reason not to waste time here!
We'll go, take care of it, and come right back!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ尚更、そんなとこでグズグズしてる
ヒマなんてないじゃない！
余裕で行って帰ってこなくちゃね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we shouldn't be wasting time
here like this! We need to get
this over and done with, pronto!
fields.notes: B14 remove localization-only pronto verbal tic

fields.EN:
It's nice to see you in high
spirits, but please do be careful.
fields.JP:
張り切ってくれるのは頼もしいが、
くれぐれも気をつけて行ってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nice to see you in high
spirits, but please do be careful.

fields.EN:
Yup! We'll do our best. Everyone,
once you're ready, head to the
lobby!
fields.JP:
うん。みんな……がんばろうね。
各自、準備ができたらロビーに集合だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We'll do our best. Everyone,
once you're ready, head to the
lobby!

fields.EN:
(There's a ton of things to
consider, but I'd better focus on
this mission!)
fields.JP:
（考えなきゃいけないことは山程あるけど、
　今はこの作戦に集中しよう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's a ton of things to
consider, but I'd better focus on
this mission!)

fields.EN:
Stop by my place later. I wanna
check out your Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
行く前に俺んとこに寄ってくれ。
メアリガンの調子を見てやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop by my place later. I wanna
check out your Mary Gun.

fields.EN: Boss! I'll put it this way, kay?
fields.JP: 師匠！　これ片付けとくっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Boss! I'll put it this way, kay?

fields.EN:
This should do it... Now ya don't
have to worry about it falling
apart during the mission.
fields.JP:
……ま、こんなとこだろ。
これで探索中に壊れる心配はねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This should do it... Now ya don't
have to worry about it falling
apart during the mission.

fields.JP: ありがとうございます、ハルさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone's excited.
But that also means it'll be that
much easier to lose balance.
fields.JP:
みんな……特に赤ずきんや親指の奴は、
妙に張り切ろうとしてるようだが……
そういうのはポッキリ行きやすい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone's excited.
But that also means it'll be that
much easier to lose balance.

fields.EN:
That geezer probably didn't want
rumors flying around, but bringing
it up affected everyone, no doubt.
fields.JP:
オッさんも、変な推測が広がるよりはと考えたん
だろうが、何もこんな時にバラさんでもな……
当人なら動揺して当然だろうに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That geezer probably didn't want
rumors flying around, but bringing
it up affected everyone, no doubt.

fields.EN:
Going to battle thinking you'll
die is one thing, but trying to
hide it with excitement is worse.
fields.JP:
そんなもんを抱えて戦地に行くのは、死にに行く
ようなもんだが……自分を騙して鼓舞する方が、
より始末に悪い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going to battle thinking you'll
die is one thing, but trying to
hide it with excitement is worse.

fields.EN:
The Professor's like a dry stick,
so I'm not surprised he didn't
think about it.
fields.JP: ハカセ、朴念仁っすからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor's like a dry stick,
so I'm not surprised he didn't
think about it.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you've got stuff on your
mind too, but can ya keep an eye
out for them?
fields.JP:
お前もお前で大変だろうが、気をつけて見て
やってほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you've got stuff on your
mind too, but can ya keep an eye
out for them?

fields.EN:
You really are observant of
everyone, Haru-san...
fields.JP: ハルさん……みんなのこと、よく見てるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are observant of
everyone, Haru...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Boss is always worried about you
folks!
fields.JP:
師匠はみんなのこと、いつもすっごく心配してる
っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss is always worried about you
folks!

fields.EN:
Hey, Clara! If you're done, go and
mind the store. Can't believe
you're still scuttling around...
fields.JP:
おい、くらら。片付け終わったら店戻れ。
何かにつけてちょろちょろ来やがって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Clara! If you're done, go and
mind the store. Can't believe
you're still scuttling around...

fields.EN:
C'mon, Boss. What's with the cold
treatment? I'm your assistant,
y'know?
fields.JP:
もー。師匠、つれないっすよー。
自分、師匠の助手っすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, Boss. What's with the cold
treatment? I'm your assistant,
y'know?

fields.EN: You're a very kind person, Haru-san.
fields.JP: ハルさんは優しい人なんですね
fields.LOCALIZED: You're a very kind person, Haru.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
You're all we've got. You're our
lifeline. I can't have any one of
you die on us, that's all...
fields.JP:
……お前らは俺たちの大事な命綱だからな。
誰一人として死なれちゃ困る……それだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all we've got. You're our
lifeline. I can't have any one of
you die on us, that's all...

fields.EN:
For some reason, Haru-san, I feel like I can
believe what you say, but...
fields.JP:
……ハルさんの言葉は、どうしてか
信じられるような気がするのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For some reason, I can believe in
what you say to me, but...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Haru-san, you and Miko-san knew too,
didn't you? That we weren't human...
fields.JP:
……ハルさんや視子さんも、やっぱり知ってたん
ですよね？　僕たちが人間じゃないってこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You and Miko knew, didn't you?
That we weren't human...
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 視子 => Miko-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 | Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN: ...Yeah. But like the Professor said, nobody has ever remembered that before, and none of us actually witnessed you being born.
fields.JP:
……まあな。けど、博士も言ってたように、
今までそのことを覚えてる奴もいなけりゃ、
生まれる現場を見たわけじゃねえしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... But like that geezer said,
we didn't know for sure, and we're
not certain how you were all born.

fields.EN:
We only knew that mimicry's effect
leaves the inside untouched. Not
being human is a bit of a stretch.
fields.JP:
けど第一、擬態は母体止まりで、中の胎児はその
まんまだ。人間じゃないってのは、極論だろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
We only knew that mimicry's effect
leaves the inside untouched. Not
being human is a bit of a stretch.

fields.EN:
But, everyone probably wanted to
believe they were the same as
everyone else in the Dawn...
fields.JP:
でも……みんな多分、自分が黎明のみんなと同じ
人間だって、信じたかったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, everyone probably wanted to
believe they were the same as
everyone else in the Dawn...

fields.JP: 『みんな多分』って、お前は違うのか？

fields.EN:
I'm like Alice... I've always felt
something was different about me,
so knowing this just felt normal.
fields.JP:
僕は……アリスもそうだけど、いつもどこか
人とは違うって違和感を持ってたから……
かえって腑に落ちた感じなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm like Alice... I've always felt
something was different about me,
so knowing this just felt normal.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel and Gretel are exactly as
you see them...
fields.JP: ラプンツェルやグレーテルはあの調子だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel and Gretel are exactly as
you see them...

fields.EN:
I don't think ya need to worry
about anything you said, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
自分、ジャックさんたちが気にするようなこと、
なんもないと思うっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think ya need to worry
about anything you said, Jack!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Same here. You're all no different
than before to me. Doesn't matter
if you're human or not.
fields.JP:
だな……ま、俺にとっちゃ、お前らはお前らだ。
人間だろうとハーフだろうと、変わりゃしねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. You're all no different
than before to me. Doesn't matter
if you're human or not.

fields.EN:
Is that because we're useful to
you as weapons?
fields.JP: ……僕らが兵器として役に立つからですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that because we're useful to
you as weapons?

fields.EN:
Who knows? And, don't go cornering
me into saying otherwise. You're
embarrassing me.
fields.JP:
さあな……ま、弱ってんのを利用して、あんまり
恥ずかしいこと大人に言わせんなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? And, don't go cornering
me into saying otherwise. You're
embarrassing me.

fields.EN:
But I keep thinking about what's
going to happen to us once we
escape. Since we're not human.
fields.JP:
……でも、時々考えちゃうんです。
僕らが人間じゃないとしたら……ここから抜け
出した後、どうなるんだろうって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I keep thinking about what's
going to happen to us once we
escape. Since we're not human.

fields.EN:
You'll all probably live a normal
life, no different from before.
fields.JP: これまで通り、普通に生きてくんだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll all probably live a normal
life, no different from before.

fields.EN:
C'mon, Jack-san! You keep worryin'
over nothing! All we gotta do is
work together and try our best!
fields.JP:
もー！　ジャックさんはすぐ悩んじゃうっすね！
みんなで力を合わせてがんばるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, Jack! You keep worryin'
over nothing! All we gotta do is
work together and try our best!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Uh, Clara? I know you wanna help,
but get back to the store already.
Don't keep the customers waiting.
fields.JP:
あー。くらら。いいこと言ってるつもりだろうが
いい加減店に戻れって。
いっつも客待たせてるだろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, Clara? I know you wanna help,
but get back to the store already.
Don't keep the customers waiting.

fields.EN:
Even if we escaped, will Alice and
the others be able to live without
worry among the humans?
fields.JP:
人間だけの世界に出られたとして……
アリスたちは人間に虐められずに済むのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if we escaped, will Alice and
the others be able to live without
worry among the humans?

fields.EN:
No use thinking about it now. Save
it for later after you escape from
here alive.
fields.JP:
……ま、そん時ゃそん時考えろ。
全部、生きて出てからの話だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No use thinking about it now. Save
it for later after you escape from
here alive.

fields.EN: Whoa! Ya caught me off guard!
fields.JP: うわあ！　びっくりした！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! Ya caught me off guard!

fields.JP: ……！！　お前、いつの間に入ってきた！？

fields.EN:
It's a secret. It's more
interesting that way. Of course,
I'm guessing you already knew.
fields.JP:
内緒よ。その方が面白いでしょう？
……もっとも、あなたたちはわかってるのかも
しれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a secret. It's more
interesting that way. Of course,
I'm guessing you already knew.

fields.EN:
I dunno what you're talking
about...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I dunno what you're talking
about...

fields.EN:
Being inquisitive is fine, but
keep it civil. There's no telling
what you'll get yourself into.
fields.JP:
ま、知的好奇心はいいが、悪趣味も程々に
しとけよ。火傷じゃ済まねえかもしれんからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being inquisitive is fine, but
keep it civil. There's no telling
what you'll get yourself into.

fields.EN:
Oh, you're worrying about me? But
I wonder who's going to be shoved
into the oven at the end?
fields.JP:
あら。心配してくれるのね。
でも、最後にかまどにくべられるのは誰かしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're worrying about me? But
I wonder who's going to be shoved
into the oven at the end?

fields.EN: Keep in mind I just warned ya...
fields.LOCALIZED: Keep in mind I just warned ya...

fields.EN:
Well then, who really are you?
Aren't you interested in knowing
that too, Jack?
fields.JP:
……それで、あなたは何者なの？
ジャックも興味があるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, who really are you?
Aren't you interested in knowing
that too, Jack?

fields.EN:
I'm just here to keep y'all in top
order. That's why I need and want
you all to come back alive.
fields.JP:
俺はお前らのメンテ要員だよ。
だから、どんな時でも生きて戻ってもらいたいと
思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just here to keep y'all in top
order. That's why I need and want
you all to come back alive.

fields.EN:
Boss is a bit hard to get used to,
but he's a really talented middle-
aged guy!
fields.JP:
師匠は、ちょっとこじらせてるけど凄腕の
おっさんっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss is a bit hard to get used to,
but he's a really talented middle-
aged guy!

fields.EN:
I see. I suppose that information
should do for now.
fields.JP: そう。今はそれでもいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. I suppose that information
should do for now.

fields.EN: Let me say one more thing.
fields.JP: ついでにもう一つ、忠告してやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me say one more thing.

fields.EN:
Always try to outwit us, even me.
Don't trust anyone or anything.
fields.JP:
精々、裏をかくことだ。俺の裏もな。
……何も信用するな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Always try to outwit us, even me.
Don't trust anyone or anything.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Don't think there's anything else
to talk about. Hurry up and get
going.
fields.JP: もういいだろ。ほら、行ってこい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think there's anything else
to talk about. Hurry up and get
going.

fields.EN:
Hm... So this is where I was
found...
fields.JP: ふーん。ここがあたしが拾われた場所かあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... So this is where I was
found...

fields.EN:
I see... Quite an interesting
place, indeed!
fields.JP:
成る程……ここが貴様の……
興味深き場所もあるものぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Quite an interesting
place, indeed!

fields.EN:
You're quite lucky to have been
found this deep within the Jail.
fields.JP:
こんな奥深くで発見されるなんて、
本当に運が良かったですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're quite lucky to have been
found this deep within the Jail.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I wonder if my mom's
rolling around inside? You know,
like Rapu's...
fields.JP:
んー。ひょっとしたらこの中に、あたしの
母さんも転がってんのかな？
……ラプみたいにさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I wonder if my mom's
rolling around inside? You know,
like Rappy's...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san is trying to act
excited, just like Haru-san said...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん……ハルさんが言ってた通り、
　無理に元気そうに振舞ってるみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood is trying to act
excited, just like Haru said...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; ハルさん => Haru-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ラプンツェルのかあさん？

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... You really
shouldn't say something tasteless
like that.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん。そういう趣味の悪い話は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... You really
shouldn't say something tasteless
like that.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ホォォォォォオオオオオオオ！
い、一段と大きな声だったわね！

fields.EN:
That caught me off guard! I don't
think I've heard anything so loud
before.
fields.JP:
びっくりしましたわ……！
こんな大きな声、初めてではありませんこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That caught me off guard! I don't
think I've heard anything so loud
before.

fields.EN:
It seems like the Jail is happy
for some reason...
fields.JP:
……ジェイルは何だか、喜んでるみたいに
感じるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like the Jail is happy
for some reason...

fields.EN:
I wonder if something good happens
to the Jail when the Tower grows?
fields.JP:
タワーが成長すると、ジェイルにとっても
良いことがあるんでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if something good happens
to the Jail when the Tower grows?

fields.EN:
That's an interesting thought,
linking the Jail's joy to
potential benefits it can gain.
fields.JP:
面白い仮説ね……
ジェイルが歓喜するということは、ジェイルに
とって、利益となっているということ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an interesting thought,
linking the Jail's joy to
potential benefits it can gain.

fields.EN: What a strange coincidence that the Jail's interests align with Dawn's objective. Just thinking about why sends a thrill through me...
fields.JP:
ジェイルの利益と黎明の目的が一致するなんて、
奇妙な偶然の一致もあったものね。
その理由を考察しただけでぞくぞくするわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find it ironic that benefits to
the Jail match up with the Dawn's.
Interesting, indeed.

fields.EN:
Interesting or not, it does sound
too convenient that they match.
fields.JP:
ぞくぞくはしないけれど、確かに偶然というには
出来すぎている気がするわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting or not, it does sound
too convenient that they match.

fields.EN:
It's almost like there's something
about the Jail that we don't know
about mixed into our escape plan.
fields.JP:
わたしたちが知らされていないジェイルの生態が
あらかじめこの計画に組み込まれているような
気もしてくるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's almost like there's something
about the Jail that we don't know
about mixed into our escape plan.

fields.EN:
But why would anyone hide
information from us?!
fields.JP: 知らされてないって、何のためによ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But why would anyone hide
information from us?!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... I think I'm just
getting too excited for my own
good.
fields.JP:
……ごめん。あたし、張り切りすぎてて
ちょっとテンパってるみたいだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I think I'm just
getting too excited for my own
good.

fields.JP: さーてと。リラックス、リラックス……

fields.EN:
Losing control of yourself means
death on the battlefield, that is,
if I'm not there.
fields.JP:
戦場では気負いが死を招こうというもの。
まあ、ワレがいれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Losing control of yourself means
death on the battlefield, that is,
if I'm not there.

fields.EN:
It's okay, Akazukin-san. We're
all here, so everything will work
out fine.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、赤ずきんさん。
みんな一緒なんだから……いつものように
絶対うまくいくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay, Red Riding Hood. We're
all here, so everything will work
out fine.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yup. You're right... We're all
together.
fields.JP: うん。そうだね……みんな一緒なんだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. You're right... We're all
together.

fields.EN:
That's right. Be happy that I made
the effort to be here, too.
fields.JP:
そうですよ～。
このわらわだって、わざわざ足を運んでるん
ですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Be happy that I made
the effort to be here, too.

fields.EN:
Not much of an effort with how
you're not even walking...
fields.JP: あんたは歩いてないじゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not much of an effort with how
you're not even walking...

fields.EN:
(Good... It looks like she's a bit
more relaxed now.)
fields.JP: （よかった……少し肩の力が抜けたみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good... It looks like she's a bit
more relaxed now.)

fields.EN:
If there is something the
Professor didn't tell us, I'm sure
it's for good reason.
fields.JP:
博士たちが言ってないことがあったとしても、
きっと事情があると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there is something the
Professor didn't tell us, I'm sure
it's for good reason.

fields.EN:
Like, maybe he doesn't want to
present his findings without solid
evidence.
fields.JP:
まだはっきりしてないことは、軽々しく
伝えられないとかさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, maybe he doesn't want to
present his findings without solid
evidence.

fields.JP: ええ。それはありうるわ

fields.EN:
That said, I wonder what's really
going to happen when the Tower
grows to its fullest...
fields.JP:
その上で思うんだけど……タワーが成長すると、
どんなことが起きるんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I wonder what's really
going to happen when the Tower
grows to its fullest...

fields.EN:
Are you saying that based on the
idea that the Dawn wasn't able to
anticipate certain recent events?
fields.JP:
それは、黎明にとって想定外の事態が起きる
可能性を言ってるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you saying that based on the
idea that the Dawn wasn't able to
anticipate certain recent events?

fields.EN:
Yeah. If the growth of the Tower
is making the Jail happy...
fields.JP:
うん。本当にタワーが成長することでジェイルが
喜んでるんだとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. If the growth of the Tower
is making the Jail happy...

fields.EN:
Maybe we're doing something that
we really shouldn't be doing...
fields.JP:
ひょっとしたら、僕らはとんでもないことを
引き起こそうとしてるんじゃないかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we're doing something that
we really shouldn't be doing...

fields.EN:
Plants grow towards the sun...
Same with the Jail...
fields.JP:
……植物は、太陽に向かって伸びるの……
ジェイルも同じ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plants grow towards the sun...
Same with the Jail...

fields.JP: うんっ！　みんなおっきくなりたいもん！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Looks like Michiru's
habits are rubbing off on you,
huh, Nemu?
fields.JP:
あはは。
ネム、あんたミチルの影響受けすぎてない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Looks like Michiru's
habits are rubbing off on you,
huh, Sleepy?

fields.EN:
It's no use thinking about it now!
I mean, no one really knows what
this weird place is.
fields.JP:
でも……そうよね！
今から考えたって始まらないわよ！
こんなワケのわかんない生き物のことなんかさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use thinking about it now!
I mean, no one really knows what
this weird place is.

fields.EN:
You got that right! Let's just
trust Dad and the Dawn!
fields.JP:
そういうこと！
今はお父さんと黎明のみんなを信じようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got that right! Let's just
trust Dad and the Dawn!

fields.EN:
Indeed. We need more information,
and this is a prime opportunity to
learn about how the Jail operates.
fields.JP:
そうね。結果が出るまで結論は出ないのだし、
ジェイルの生態を知る、またとないチャンス
なんだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. We need more information,
and this is a prime opportunity to
learn about how the Jail operates.

fields.EN:
I think maybe you're on a
different track...
fields.JP: それはそれでズレてると思うんですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think maybe you're on a
different track...

fields.JP: ホォォォォォオオオオオオオ！

fields.EN:
Yikes! Stupid Jail and its stupid
noise...
fields.JP:
ひゃっ！！
全く、本当にでっかい声です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes! Stupid Jail and its stupid
noise...

fields.EN:
(Whatever the situation, we need
to stay focused. I better put on
my headphones...)
fields.JP:
（何にしても……気を散らしちゃ駄目だ。
　ヘッドホンをはめておこう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whatever the situation, we need
to stay focused. I better put on
my headphones...)

fields.EN:
All right! Let's keep our guard up
and get moving!
fields.JP: ともかく……気を引き締めて進もう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Let's keep our guard up
and get moving!

fields.EN: A Marchen was holding onto it.
fields.JP: メルヒェンが抱え込んでたのね
fields.LOCALIZED: A Marchen must have dropped it.

fields.JP:
なになに？
今度はどんなことが書いてあったの？

fields.EN: This must be about you, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP: これ……赤ずきんさんのことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This must be about you, Red Riding
Hood...
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: "The first child was found here. According to the captain, despite being just a baby, she defeated a Marchen with her bare hands and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
　によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
　メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
"Further research needs to be
conducted, but to me she's only
a cute little baby in need."
fields.JP:
『彼女の生態について研究の余地は多いが、
　私には一人の可愛い赤ん坊に見える』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Further research needs to be
conducted, but to me she's only
a cute little baby in need."

fields.EN:
From the way it's written, it
sounds like the Professor wrote
this...
fields.JP: 文章からすると……これ書いたの、博士よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the way it's written, it
sounds like the Professor wrote
this...

fields.EN:
It looks like you've been loved
for a long time, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん……昔から愛されていたんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like you've been loved
for a long time, Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: 赤姉ったら、照れてるの？
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
You said the Professor found you.
Is that what's bothering you?
fields.JP:
あなたを発見したのは博士だと、あなたはさっき
言ってたけど……そのことかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said the Professor found you.
Is that what's bothering you?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, you mentioned
it before...
fields.JP: ……そういえば、そんな風に言ってましたね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you mentioned
it before...

fields.EN:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...
fields.JP:
う……うん。あたし、確かにお父さんから
そう聞いたんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...

fields.EN:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.
fields.JP:
『発見した時、メルヒェンを前にしても笑ってた、
　勇敢な赤ん坊だったよ』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.

fields.JP: だ……だから……きっと……あはは……

fields.EN:
It was a long time ago, so I bet
Dad remembered things a bit
differently!
fields.JP:
そうだよ。昔のことだから、お父さんきっと、
勘違いして覚えてたんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a long time ago, so I bet
Dad remembered things a bit
differently!

fields.EN:
You're probably right. I bet the
Professor will say he forgot about
it or something.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。後で博士に聞いてみれば、
きっと『うっかりしてた』ってことになるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're probably right. I bet the
Professor will say he forgot about
it or something.

fields.EN:
(Am I really saying that because I
believe it, or...?)
fields.JP: （僕は、本当にそんな風に思ってるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Am I really saying that because I
believe it, or...?)

fields.EN:
Yup. I guess... I mean, Dad is
pretty forgetful...
fields.JP:
うん。そうだよね……お父さん、意外とうっかり
してるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I guess... I mean, Dad is
pretty forgetful...

fields.EN:
Oh? But, aren't memos left behind
by those who've been through the
areas before?
fields.JP:
あら。でもメモは過去に探索した誰かが残した
ものだろうって話じゃなかったかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But, aren't memos left behind
by those who've been through the
areas before?

fields.EN:
You're right. If that's the case,
why didn't the Professor mention
that he wrote memos?
fields.JP:
言われてみれば、そうよね。
博士ったら、自分が書いたって、どうして
言わなかったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. If that's the case,
why didn't the Professor mention
that he wrote memos?

fields.EN:
Even if he's scatterbrained, I'm
quite sure he would remember that
he's written memos before.
fields.JP:
それに、いくらボケボケだからといっても、
自分が見つけたのかどうかくらい、
覚えてるような気がしますよね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if he's scatterbrained, I'm
quite sure he would remember that
he's written memos before.

fields.EN:
Coming from you, it's not very
convincing...
fields.JP: あんたが言っても説得力ないけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming from you, it's not very
convincing...

fields.EN:
I refuse to be told that by a dolt
like you, Oyayubi.
fields.JP: 単純バカな親指には言われたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I refuse to be told that by a dolt
like you, Thumby.

fields.EN:
P-Please! This isn't the time or
the place to argue!
fields.JP:
も……もうっ！
こんなところでじゃれ合いはやめてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please! This isn't the time or
the place to argue!

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Dad wouldn't... *huff* *huff* lie
to me... *huff* Why...?
fields.JP:
嘘なんか……はあ……はあ……
……お父さん……はあ……何で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad wouldn't... *huff* *huff* lie
to me... *huff* Why...?

fields.EN:
She's hyperventilating. We need to
find a bag for her... If not...
Nemurihime, hold her head.
fields.JP:
過呼吸の発作よ。誰か、袋のようなものを持って
たら、口に当てて。無ければ……
眠り姫、彼女の頭を抱きかかえてあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's hyperventilating. We need to
find a bag for her... If not...
Sleeping Beauty, hold her head.

fields.EN:
Akazukin. Take a deep
breath and breathe out slowly.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん。ゆっくりでいいわ。
自分の吐いた息を吸うように、深く呼吸するの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood. Take a deep
breath and breathe out slowly.

fields.EN: It looks like she's calmed down.
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks like she's calmed down.

fields.EN:
But, she looks like she's in pain.
What happened to Aka-neesama?
fields.JP:
でも……すごく辛そうです……
赤姉様、どうしちゃったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she looks like she's in pain.
What happened to Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Hyperventilation can occur from
panic or stress. You can control
it with your breathing pattern.
fields.JP:
過呼吸の発作……強い精神的な負荷がかかって
処理しきれなくなった時に起きるものよ。
こうして呼吸を整えることで治まるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hyperventilation can occur from
panic or stress. You can control
it with your breathing pattern.

fields.EN:
I guess you do come in handy
sometimes.
fields.JP: あなた……時には役にたつのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you do come in handy
sometimes.

fields.EN:
I read it before in a medical
journal, but it's the first time
I've actually seen it occur.
fields.JP:
家にいた頃、暇つぶしに読んでた医学書が
たまたま役に立っただけよ。
実例は初めて目にしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read it before in a medical
journal, but it's the first time
I've actually seen it occur.

fields.JP: あの～。いったん戻りませんか～？

fields.EN:
Not that I want to slack off...
It's just a reasonable suggestion
based on what's happening.
fields.JP:
サボりたいわけじゃないです～。
合理的な提案をしただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that I want to slack off...
It's just a reasonable suggestion
based on what's happening.

fields.EN: True... It may be best to have Akazukin-san rest for awhile...
fields.JP:
……確かに、赤ずきんさんは少し休ませたほうが
いいと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... It may be best to have Red
Riding Hood rest for awhile...
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yes. And we can't have her rest
here. It's too dangerous.
fields.JP:
そうね。休ませるにしても、このままここに
留まるのは危険が大きいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. And we can't have her rest
here. It's too dangerous.

fields.JP:
……みんな……はあ……
あたし……大丈夫……だから……

fields.EN:
Stop it, Aka-nee. You need to
rely on us too, you know?
fields.JP:
何言ってんのよ、赤姉。
少しは私たちにも頼んなさいっつーの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it, Sister Red. You need to
rely on us too, you know?
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
If she can stand, then she should
be able to walk slowly with a bit
of support.
fields.JP:
立てるようなら、支えられてゆっくり歩けば
移動できるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she can stand, then she should
be able to walk slowly with a bit
of support.

fields.EN: All right then... Let's head back.
fields.LOCALIZED: All right then... Let's head back.

fields.JP: あなたたち……どうしたの！？

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP:
赤ずきん！？
……とにかく横になって……そっと……

fields.EN:
I see. Well, it's a good thing
Gretel knew how to handle the
situation.
fields.JP:
……そう。グレーテルが応急措置の方法を知って
いてよかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well, it's a good thing
Gretel knew how to handle the
situation.

fields.EN:
One wrong move and it could
have left severe side effects or
worse.
fields.JP:
措置を間違えれば、大変なことになった可能性も
ゼロではないし、症状として定着してしまう
場合だってあるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
One wrong move and it could
have left severe side effects or
worse.

fields.EN:
I guess we still experience the
same symptoms as humans,
even if we are monsters...
fields.JP: ……化け物でも、人間と同じ病にはかかるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we still experience the
same symptoms as humans,
even if we are monsters...

fields.EN:
Don't be stupid. You're not
monsters. You're humans, just
like we are.
fields.JP:
馬鹿なこと言わないで。
あなたたちは化け物じゃないわ。私たちと同じ
……人間よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be stupid. You're not
monsters. You're humans, just
like we are.

fields.EN: Even though you've thoroughly examined and researched our bodies...
fields.JP:
わらわたちの体を、そなたは散々調べて研究
しているのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming from someone who's
diagnosed us on a daily basis...

fields.EN:
Why, yes. I diagnose and conduct
research on you. It's my duty as a
doctor and for everyone here.
fields.JP:
ええ。検査もするし、研究もするわ。
優先順位はあれど、解放地区全ての人たちのね。
医師として当然の務めだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. I diagnose and conduct
research on you. It's my duty as a
doctor and for everyone here.

fields.EN:
I think you may be misunderstood.
Each person is different and
possesses various traits.
fields.JP:
それに、何を勘違いしているのか知らないけど、
人にはそれぞれ体質も得手不得手もある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you may be misunderstood.
Each person is different and
possesses various traits.

fields.EN:
Just like Kadowaki's honesty and
strength, or Oohime's ability to
become a source of solace.
fields.JP:
体力と正直さを持つ門脇くんが門番に適任な
ように、大陽女さんの人柄がある種の人の心の
癒しになっているように、そして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just like Kadowaki's honesty and
strength, or Oohime's ability to
become a source of solace.

fields.EN:
(So, that's what Miko-san thinks about
Michiru-san's role...)
fields.JP:
（視子さん……ミチルさんのことも、そんな風に
　認めてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, that's what Miko thinks about
Michiru's role...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
As for me, I'm acting as a doctor
out of admiration for my mentor in
the medical field.
fields.JP:
たまたま先生に憧れ、医療現場に触れてきた
私などが、医療の真似事をしているようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for me, I'm acting as a doctor
out of admiration for my mentor in
the medical field.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
To be honest, I can't quite fathom
why it's important to be a human.
fields.JP:
正直、人間であることが何故それ程重要なのか、
私には理解できないのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, I can't quite fathom
why it's important to be a human.

fields.EN:
What Miko means is that we each
identify ourselves based on our
perceived existences with others.
fields.JP:
視子が言いたいのは、私たちを在り方として同種
と認めているということなのね。
……私が自らをナイトメアと規定していたように
fields.LOCALIZED:
What Miko means is that we each
identify ourselves based on our
perceived existences with others.

fields.EN:
In any case, I think you made the
right call coming back here, even
if it meant the extra effort.
fields.JP:
……ともかく、ここまで運んで来るのも大変
だったと思うけど、引き上げたのは良い判断
だったと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I think you made the
right call coming back here, even
if it meant the extra effort.

fields.EN:
After all, there are no real places
in the Jail that we can call safe.
fields.JP:
独房エリアでは、どこも安心して休むことは
できないだろうしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, there are no real places
in the Jail that we can call safe.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Maybe we should call the Professor
here, Miko.
fields.JP: 視子、博士を呼んできたほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we should call the Professor
here, Miko.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Akazukin. The
Professor is out right now.
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい、赤ずきん。
博士はいま、留守にしてるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Red Riding Hood. The
Professor is out right now.

fields.EN:
(We're on an important mission,
and the Professor is away...?)
fields.JP:
（……こんな大事な作戦中だっていうのに……
　博士はどうしてここにいないんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're on an important mission,
and the Professor is away...?)

fields.EN: I guess it can't be helped...
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess it can't be helped...

fields.EN: ...In any case, rest for now, and don't go back to the Cell Area until you've recovered enough. It should have drained your strength too.
fields.JP:
……ともかく今は安静にして、独房エリアに
出るのは、十分に回復してからにするのよ。
体力も奪われてる筈だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, let her rest. You can
go back to that area after you've
fully recovered.

fields.EN:
Looks like I've just burdened
everyone...
fields.JP: ……みんな、迷惑かけちゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like I've just burdened
everyone...

fields.EN:
Don't let it bother you. You're
just trying to do too much, Sister
Aka-nee.
fields.JP:
そんなの気にすることないのよ。
赤姉はしっかりしようとしすぎよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't let it bother you. You're
just trying to do too much, Sister
Red.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: Are you fine getting up already?
fields.JP: もう起き上がって大丈夫なんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you fine getting up already?

fields.EN:
Yup... I feel a lot better now
that I was able to get some sleep
in.
fields.JP:
うん。
ちょっと眠ったら、だいぶすっきりしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I feel a lot better now
that I was able to get some sleep
in.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: You look a lot better now, too!
fields.JP: 顔色も戻ったようだしな！
fields.LOCALIZED: You look a lot better now, too!

fields.EN:
What really happened to me? I
never thought I'd be sick over
something like that...
fields.JP:
でも、あたし……どうしちゃったんだろ。
あんなことぐらいで、すっごく息が苦しく
なってさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What really happened to me? I
never thought I'd be sick over
something like that...

fields.EN:
Your hyperventilating was probably
triggered by stress beyond your
mental threshold.
fields.JP:
精神的な負荷が閾値を超えると、時として起きる
発作のようなものだそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your hyperventilating was probably
triggered by stress beyond your
mental threshold.

fields.EN:
She's just saying that you were
holding onto too much pain
inside.
fields.JP:
あなたが、辛い気持ちを溜め込みすぎていた……
ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's just saying that you were
holding onto too much pain
inside.

fields.JP: あたしが？　そんなのあるかなあ？

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised. We've been through a lot.
Akazukin-san, maybe you were pushing
yourself without realizing it...
fields.JP:
いろいろあったしさ、無理はないよ。
赤ずきんさんも、気付かないうちに無理してたん
じゃないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised. We've been
through a lot. I'm sure you became
overwhelmed without knowing it.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Why, yes. We also did learn about
where we Blood Maidens came from.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
血式少女の生まれのこともありましたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. We also did learn about
where we Blood Maidens came from.

fields.EN:
And when you think about it, the
memo, the history of the Dawn, all
of it came from the Professor.
fields.JP:
はい。今回のメモのことだって、考えてみたら
これまで聞いてきた黎明の歴史は、全部博士から
伝わったものなんですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And when you think about it, the
memo, the history of the Dawn, all
of it came from the Professor.

fields.EN:
What?! Are you saying that Dad
purposely lied to everyone?!
fields.JP:
じゃあ何！？　それじゃ、お父さんがわざと
みんなに嘘を教えてるってわけ？！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Are you saying that Dad
purposely lied to everyone?!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
That's not what I wanted to imply!
I just thought the Professor may
have remembered things wrong.
fields.JP:
そ、そうじゃなくて……！
博士にだって、記憶違いくらいあるんじゃ
ないかって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not what I wanted to imply!
I just thought the Professor may
have remembered things wrong.

fields.EN:
H-He's really busy, so I wouldn't
be surprised if he forgot bits of
information, too...
fields.JP:
い……忙しくて言い忘れることだって
あるかもしれませんし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-He's really busy, so I wouldn't
be surprised if he forgot bits of
information, too...

fields.EN:
Ah... I see. You're right. I guess
that's it...
fields.JP:
あ……そっか。そうだよね。
……そういうことなのかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... I see. You're right. I guess
that's it...

fields.EN: I'm sorry for yelling at you, Shirayuki...
fields.JP: 大声出しちゃってごめん、白雪
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for yelling at you, Snow
White...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. Shirayuki knows very
well how much you like the
Professor...
fields.JP:
いいえ。赤姉様は博士が大好きなだけ
ですし、白雪、わかってますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. Snow White knows very
well how much you like the
Professor...

fields.EN:
Um, Akazukin-san? What do you
mean by "that's it?"
fields.JP: その、赤ずきんさん……『そういうこと』って？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Red Riding Hood? What do you
mean by "that's it?"
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Well, I think I got all flustered
knowing that Dad didn't really
tell me everything.
fields.JP:
あーいや。あたしさ、実はお父さんがちゃんと
話してくれてなかったの、思ったよりこたえてた
みたいなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think I got all flustered
knowing that Dad didn't really
tell me everything.

fields.EN:
I guess I was holding in all of my
feelings like you said, Alice.
fields.JP: アリスの言う通り、溜め込んじゃってたのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I was holding in all of my
feelings like you said, Alice.

fields.EN:
I'm quite envious that you have
someone you can be so attached
to.
fields.JP:
羨ましいわね、そんな風に強くこだわれるような
対象があるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite envious that you have
someone you can be so attached
to.

fields.EN:
Why not find someone like that
now?
fields.JP: これから作ればいいんですよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not find someone like that
now?

fields.EN:
I was able to overcome my problems
because I found friends to whom I
could entrust my life.
fields.JP:
わらわはあの時、みなさんの……命を預けられる
仲間の存在があったから、乗り越えられたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was able to overcome my problems
because I found friends to whom I
could entrust my life.

fields.EN:
Of course, I had never experienced
having friends before, so I wasn't
sure how to handle myself then.
fields.JP:
……そんなの、わらわには初めての存在なので、
正直扱いに困ります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, I had never experienced
having friends before, so I wasn't
sure how to handle myself then.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're actually
saying that.
fields.JP: あんたがそんな風に言うなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're actually
saying that.

fields.EN:
Friends you can entrust your life
to...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends you can entrust your life
to...

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェル、みんなとなかまだよ！

fields.EN:
Let's continue our mission. Time
to get back out to the Station
Grounds!
fields.JP:
……みんな、作戦を続行しよう。
『元駅構内エリア』に向かうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's continue our mission. Time
to get back out to the Station
Grounds!

fields.EN:
Our objective... Destroy the last
core!
fields.JP: 目的は……最後の核の破壊だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our objective... Destroy the last
core!

fields.EN:
So that's what a core looks
like...
fields.JP: これが……核というモノか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's what a core looks
like...

fields.EN:
We can finally make our escape
after we destroy it. Is everyone
ready?
fields.JP:
これを破壊すれば、あたしたちはやっと念願の
脱出作戦に移れるんだ。
みんな……準備はいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can finally make our escape
after we destroy it. Is everyone
ready?

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san... she's back to being
the usual Akazukin-san...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん……いつもの赤ずきんさんに
　戻った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Red Riding Hood is
back to her normal self...)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 赤ずきん => Red Riding Hood-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: 僕は、いつでも大丈夫だよ！

fields.EN:
I don't want to waste my whole
day, so let's get this over with.
fields.JP: 面倒臭いので、とっとと終わらせましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to waste my whole
day, so let's get this over with.

fields.JP: いつでもいいわよ、赤姉！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ready when you are, Sister Red!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
I'm surprised at how elated I feel
right now...
fields.JP: 不思議な高揚感もあったものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised at how elated I feel
right now...

fields.EN:
Right on time... We're gonna crush
that core and the Nightmare, and
buy our ticket out of here.
fields.JP:
……おいでなすったね。
こいつも核もナイトメアも、全部ぶっ潰して
あたしらはここを脱出するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right on time... We're gonna crush
that core and the Nightmare, and
buy our ticket out of here.

fields.EN:
Everyone! Let's hit them before
they make their move!
fields.JP: みんな……先手必勝で行くよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Let's hit them before
they make their move!

fields.JP: ワレに任せておくが良い！
……みなさん、核を破壊しましょう！

fields.EN:
This should make the tower grow to
where we want it to...
fields.JP: ……これで、塔は目標の高さまで伸びたのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
This should make the tower grow to
where we want it to...

fields.EN:
I can't believe we finally did
it...
fields.JP: こんな日が、本当に来るなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe we finally did
it...

fields.EN:
(Back when I came with Alice to
the Dawn, the plan they shared
with us sounded impossible...)
fields.JP:
（確かに、アリスと黎明に来たばかりの時は、
　途方もないような計画だって思ってたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Back when I came with Alice to
the Dawn, the plan they shared
with us sounded impossible...)

fields.EN:
(We didn't even expect to have
so many others here with us now,
either...)
fields.JP:
（それに……こんな風に仲間ができるなんて、
　思ってもいなかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We didn't even expect to have
so many others here with us now,
either...)

fields.EN: Jack? What are you smiling about?
fields.JP: ジャック。あんた何にやにやしてんのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? What are you smiling about?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's just proof that
everyone likes you.
fields.JP: あはは……みんなに好かれてる証拠だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's just proof that
everyone likes you.

fields.EN:
All we need to do is clean this
place up, then head back to
headquarters.
fields.JP:
この最後の独房エリアも、後始末をして帰還する
だけになったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we need to do is clean this
place up, then head back to
headquarters.

fields.EN: We made it this far because everyone joined forces. I'm truly glad all of you are here.
fields.JP:
ここまで来れたのも、みんなが力を合わせた
からだね。……みんながいてくれてよかったって
心から思ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were only able to do this
because everyone worked together
as a team. I'm really glad.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
That said, I still want to believe
in Dad...
fields.JP:
でも……あたしはお父さんのことも信じたいって
……そう思ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I still want to believe
in Dad...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ……あなたはそれでいいと、私は思うわ

fields.EN:
There are some answers that
only come from believing.
fields.JP:
信じることからしか生まれない解答もあるんだと
……そう、思うもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are some answers that
only come from believing.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's finish the
cleanup!
fields.JP: それじゃ……後始末とやらに行きましょうか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's finish the
cleanup!

fields.EN:
Yup! Our opponent is probably the
last Nightmare there is. Let's get
going!
fields.JP:
ああ！　相手はおそらく最後のナイトメアだ。
みんな……気を引き締めていくよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Our opponent is probably the
last Nightmare there is. Let's get
going!

fields.JP: ぐるるる……えもののけはい……！

fields.EN:
So, that's the last Nightmare!
Hmph! Nothing to it!
fields.JP:
……これが最後のナイトメアってわけね！
ふん。どうってことないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that's the last Nightmare!
Hmph! Nothing to it!

fields.EN:
How unfortunate that this is the
last battle we'll engage in...
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unfortunate that this is the
last battle we'll engage in...

fields.EN:
I hope it doesn't talk like the
others!
fields.JP: どうか喋らないでくださいましね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope it doesn't talk like the
others!

fields.EN:
We'll just have to kill it before
it can speak.
fields.JP: 喋る前にやっつければいいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll just have to kill it before
it can speak.

fields.JP: ガルルルルゥウウウウウ！！
白雪たち、負けませんから……！

fields.EN:
Now then, time for me to enjoy
this moment!
fields.JP: せめて……楽しませてもらおうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, time for me to enjoy
this moment!

fields.EN: That was easier than I thought...
fields.LOCALIZED: That was easier than I thought...

fields.EN:
So, transformations differ
depending on the Nightmare...
fields.JP: ……ナイトメアによって、形態変化は異なるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, transformations differ
depending on the Nightmare...

fields.EN:
I wonder which of its forms is its
true form...
fields.JP:
通常の姿と今の姿……どちらが本来の姿
なのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder which of its forms is its
true form...

fields.EN:
Hey, save the observations for
later.
fields.JP: ちょっと……研究は後にしなさいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, save the observations for
later.

fields.JP: ギャオオオオォォォォオオオ！！

fields.EN:
Let's keep layering our attacks
on it!
fields.JP: このまま一気に畳みかけますわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's keep layering our attacks
on it!

fields.JP: そうだね……みんな、いくよ！
ギャオオォォォォオオン……！！
みんな……とどめといこう！

fields.EN:
What happens when the Jail Tower
grows? You know, don't you?
fields.JP:
ジェイルが成長したら、どうなるのかしら？
あなたは知ってるのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happens when the Jail Tower
grows? You know, don't you?

fields.EN:
If you don't want to say it, fine.
I guess we'll have to kill all the
Marchens here, then.
fields.JP:
言わないつもりなら、それでもいいわ。
そしたら、ここのメルヒェンたちを皆殺しに
するけれどね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't want to say it, fine.
I guess we'll have to kill all the
Marchens here, then.

fields.EN:
I know you have intelligence and
can speak our language.
fields.JP:
あなたが知能を持ち、言葉を話せることは
知っているのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you have intelligence and
can speak our language.

fields.JP: ギャォォオオァァァアア……！！

fields.EN:
(We're going to die...? After all
we've been through?!)
fields.JP:
（僕たち、ここで全滅するのか！？
　ここまで……来たのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're going to die...? After all
we've been through?!)

fields.EN:
(But... Why... Why am I not scared
of it...?)
fields.JP:
（でも……なんだろう……不思議と怖さは
　感じない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But... Why... Why am I not scared
of it...?)

fields.JP: このままじゃ、囲まれるわ！

fields.EN:
Even in numbers, grunts are no
match to me!
fields.JP: かような雑魚ども、蹴散らしてくれるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even in numbers, grunts are no
match to me!

fields.EN: Let's just get rid of them, now!
fields.JP: とにかく、こいつらをやるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just get rid of them, now!

fields.EN:
Looks like that was the last of
them...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like that was the last of
them...

fields.JP: こんなの、らくしょうだよ！
さっきの……スナーク、だよね？

fields.EN:
Yes... If we believe in what that
Nightmare said.
fields.JP: ええ。ナイトメアの言葉からすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... If we believe in what that
Nightmare said.

fields.EN:
It's probably true. After all,
I've never seen a creature like
that before.
fields.JP:
間違いないでしょうね。
あんな生物は初めて見たもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably true. After all,
I've never seen a creature like
that before.

fields.EN:
How can I word it...? It was
eerie, and... it gave me
goosebumps.
fields.JP:
どう言ったらいいんですかしら。
すごく不気味で……鳥肌が立ちましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can I word it...? It was
eerie, and... it gave me
goosebumps.

fields.EN:
(Strange... I didn't sense
anything like that from it...)
fields.JP: （でも僕は、なぜか怖さを感じなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Strange... I didn't sense
anything like that from it...)

fields.JP: あれ……おいしくなさそう……

fields.EN: You're not supposed to eat it!
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not supposed to eat it!

fields.EN: I wonder why it let us go...
fields.JP: でも、何であたしらを見逃したんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder why it let us go...

fields.JP: ワレに恐れをなしちゃ……

fields.EN:
I'm curious as to why it killed
the Nightmare...
fields.JP:
配下のはずのナイトメアを
殺したことも気になります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious as to why it killed
the Nightmare...

fields.EN: Maybe to stop it from speaking.
fields.JP: 口止め……じゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe to stop it from speaking.

fields.EN:
It did happen when Gretel started
asking the Nightmare questions.
fields.JP:
確かに、グレーテルがナイトメアを尋問し始めた
とたんの出来事だったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It did happen when Gretel started
asking the Nightmare questions.

fields.EN:
So, the Nightmare was about to
say something that Snark didn't
want it to.
fields.JP:
つまり……あのナイトメアはスナークにとって
都合の悪いことを言いかけたということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the Nightmare was about to
say something that Snark didn't
want it to.

fields.EN:
If it doesn't want us to know, couldn't it just kill
Rapunzel and the others?
fields.JP:
しられたくないなら、ラプンツェルたちころせば
すむよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If not want us to know, it kill
us, too.
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_05612.

fields.EN:
You're a lot smarter than you
look...
fields.JP: あんた……意外と賢いじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a lot smarter than you
look...

fields.JP:
だってあいつ、ぜんぜんこわくないもん。
きっと、よわいよ

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェルも怖くなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)

fields.EN: No way! That's the one that massacred everyone from Dawn fifteen years ago!
fields.JP:
そんなはずないじゃん！
十五年前、黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
相手だよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No way! That thing killed the
members of the Dawn 15 years ago!

fields.EN:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.
fields.JP: でも、卑怯な相手なのは間違いないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
死にそうなナイトメアをいきなり後ろから
刺すなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.

fields.EN:
In any case, I lost my opportunity
to question it on the growth of
the Jail.
fields.JP:
いずれにせよ、尋問は中断され
ジェイルの成長に関する情報は得られなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I lost my opportunity
to question it on the growth of
the Jail.

fields.EN:
So that means that the growth of
the Jail is something it didn't
want us to know about?
fields.JP:
……ってことは……ジェイルが成長すると
何が起きるかって、そんなにあたしらに
知られたくないってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means that the growth of
the Jail is something it didn't
want us to know about?

fields.EN:
I sure hope what Jack said before
isn't going to happen. You know,
that something bad may happen.
fields.JP:
あんまり考えたくないけど、ジャックの言ってた
とんでもないことが起きる可能性があるって
ことかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure hope what Jack said before
isn't going to happen. You know,
that something bad may happen.

fields.EN:
But, what is going to happen,
exactly?
fields.JP: 何が……起きるっていうんでしょう～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, what is going to happen,
exactly?

fields.EN:
And like Gretel said, if what the
Jail wants matches with what the
Dawn wants...
fields.JP:
そしてグレーテルが言ってた通り、
それが黎明の目的と一致してるとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like Gretel said, if what the
Jail wants matches with what the
Dawn wants...

fields.EN:
(With how we are now, there's no
way I can bring up what Gretel
said before...)
fields.JP:
（以前グレーテルが言ったこと……
　そんなことを今言ったら、せっかくみんな
　元気になったのに、また……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With how we are now, there's no
way I can bring up what Gretel
said before...)

fields.EN:
That means... we have a traitor
among us...
fields.JP: それは……裏切り者がいるということです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means... we have a traitor
among us...

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you noticed that,
Shirayukihime.
fields.JP: まさか、あなたが気づいてたなんてね、白雪姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you noticed that,
Snow White.

fields.EN:
Something had felt off for a while.
But maybe part of me didn't want to believe it.
fields.JP:
以前から違和感は感じてました。
でも、どこかで信じたくなかったのかも
しれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something didn't feel right
before. But deep down, Snow White
didn't want to believe it.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki didn't want to hurt
anyone with her thoughts...
fields.JP:
きっと、白雪が気が付いてしまったことで、
誰かに傷ついてほしくなかったんです。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White didn't want to hurt
anyone with her thoughts...

fields.EN:
But, if something terrible does
happen... If everyone died because
Shirayuki didn't say anything...
fields.JP:
もし、本当に大変なことが起きてしまうなら……
白雪が言えなかったせいで、みんなが死んじゃう
ようなことが起きるなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, if something terrible does
happen... If everyone died because
Snow White didn't say anything...

fields.JP: その方が、白雪は嫌です

fields.EN:
It's easy to assume that someone
has been working in tandem with
the Jail. It would all make sense.
fields.JP:
人間の社会の誰かがジェイルと通じていると
考えれば、全てはつじつまが合うこと……
とても簡単に推測できることよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's easy to assume that someone
has been working in tandem with
the Jail. It would all make sense.

fields.EN:
But I think we all wanted to avoid
that thought so we could stay on
the humans' side.
fields.JP:
そこに思い至らなかったのは、やはり……
無意識に避けていたから……人間たちと
繋がっていたいからなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I think we all wanted to avoid
that thought so we could stay on
the humans' side.

fields.EN:
O-Of course... the Dawn is... like
family to us...
fields.JP: あ……当たり前だよ。黎明は……家族だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course... the Dawn is... like
family to us...

fields.EN: Oh? Neither Shirayukihime nor I... nor Jack ever said the traitor was someone from Dawn, did we?
fields.JP:
あら。私も白雪姫も……そしてジャックも、
その裏切り者が黎明の誰かだとは一言も言って
ないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Are you confirming that the
traitor could be from the Dawn?

fields.EN:
W-Well then, who do you think it
could be?
fields.JP:
じゃ、じゃあ……誰だと思うの？
その裏切り者って奴は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well then, who do you think it
could be?

fields.EN: Is that all you have to report?
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that all you have to report?

fields.EN:
Thank you for taking care of Akazukin. You made the right
call.
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんの処置を適切に行ってくれて、
本当にありがとう。君たちの判断も適切だったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for taking care of Red
Riding Hood. You made the right
call.

fields.EN:
Where were you when I was here,
Dad?
fields.JP: お父さんは、どこへ行ってたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where were you when I was here,
Dad?

fields.EN:
Ah, I was monitoring the Tower's
growth. I'm so sorry I couldn't be
beside you when you needed me...
fields.JP:
ああ。塔の伸長について、計測していたのだよ。
突発的な事態だったとはいえ……
辛い時に傍にいてやれなくて済まなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I was monitoring the Tower's
growth. I'm so sorry I couldn't be
beside you when you needed me...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I know you were doing
something important.
fields.JP: ううん。お父さんは大事な仕事をしてたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I know you were doing
something important.

fields.EN:
Everyone else was with me, so all
was well!
fields.JP: それに……みんながついててくれたしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone else was with me, so all
was well!

fields.EN: I see... I'm glad to hear that.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... I'm glad to hear that.

fields.EN:
(I couldn't tell them who I
suspected... To be honest,
everyone could be a suspect...)
fields.JP:
（……結局、誰を疑ってるかは言えなかった。
　正直なところ、みんな怪しく思えるし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I couldn't tell them who I
suspected... To be honest,
everyone could be a suspect...)

fields.EN:
(And, if that place was being
monitored, it would've been best
to not have discussed it there...)
fields.JP:
（それに……あの場所も『監視』されているなら
　……まだ、誰にも言わない方がいい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, if that place was being
monitored, it would've been best
to not have discussed it there...)

fields.EN:
Now then, about the Tower's
growth...
fields.JP: さて、塔の伸長を計測していたと言ったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, about the Tower's
growth...

fields.EN:
With the destruction of the last
core, the Tower has reached our
goal height. Very well done.
fields.JP:
君たちが最後の核を破壊してくれたおかげで、
塔は見事に目標の高さまで成長したよ。
……本当によくやってくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With the destruction of the last
core, the Tower has reached our
goal height. Very well done.

fields.EN:
You also mentioned that you met
Snark, and I'm glad you all made
it back alive...
fields.JP:
また、スナークと遭遇したと聞いたが、
それにも関わらず、無事に生還できたことも
本当によかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also mentioned that you met
Snark, and I'm glad you all made
it back alive...

fields.EN: It was easy! It was weak!
fields.JP:
らくしょうだったよ！
たぶん、あいつよわいし
fields.LOCALIZED: It was easy! It was weak!

fields.EN:
Hey, rugrat! Don't try to eat
everything, or else one day you're
gonna get eaten!
fields.JP:
おい、野生児。
何でも食おうとして食われんなよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, rugrat! Don't try to eat
everything, or else one day you're
gonna get eaten!

fields.JP:
『あたぼう』だなんて言葉……
一体どこで覚えてきたのかしら……

fields.EN:
That word doesn't fit her
character very well...
fields.JP: 確かにお嬢には似合わぬな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That word doesn't fit her
character very well...

fields.EN:
Speaking of learning, do you mind
answering something for us?
fields.JP: ところで博士。ひとつ教えてもらえないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of learning, do you mind
answering something for us?
