fields.EN:
We found a memo in the area.
Why did you hide the fact that
you wrote memos, too?
fields.JP:
独房エリアで見つけたメモなのだけど……
何故あなたが書いたことを隠していたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found a memo in the area.
Why did you hide the fact that
you wrote memos, too?

fields.EN:
(That's right... The memo we
found previously was, without a
doubt, written by the Professor.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……この間見つけたメモの内容は、
　明らかに博士が書いたものだった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... The memo we
found previously was, without a
doubt, written by the Professor.)

fields.EN: "The first child was found here. According to our leader, despite being only an infant, she defeated a Marchen with her bare hands and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
"Further research needs to be
conducted, but to me she's only
a cute little baby in need."
fields.JP:
『彼女の生態について研究の余地は多いが、
私には一人の可愛い赤ん坊に見える』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Further research needs to be
conducted, but to me she's only
a cute little baby in need."

fields.EN:
It's quite obvious you wrote this,
didn't you, Professor?
fields.JP: 文章からすると……これ書いたの、博士よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's quite obvious you wrote this,
didn't you, Professor?

fields.EN:
W-Well, it's not that I was hiding
it, but...
fields.JP: い……いや、隠していたわけではないのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, it's not that I was hiding
it, but...

fields.EN:
Is that so? Were you aware of how
saddened Akazukin was upon
finding out you hid it from her?
fields.JP:
あら、そうだったの？
赤ずきんったら、あなたに隠し事をされたって
それは落ち込んでいたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that so? Were you aware of how
saddened Red Riding Hood was upon
finding out you hid it from her?

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry, Akazukin. To
be honest, I completely forgot
about the memos I wrote.
fields.JP:
それは済まなかったね、赤ずきん。
実のところ……あのメモのことはほとんど
忘れかけていてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry, Red Riding Hood. To
be honest, I completely forgot
about the memos I wrote.

fields.EN:
I wrote and discarded them as I
learned new things. They really
were memos, no more, no less.
fields.JP:
なにぶん大昔に書き捨てたようなものでは
あったし、内部の構造も常に変化するしね。
ほんの覚え書きのようなものだったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wrote and discarded them as I
learned new things. They really
were memos, no more, no less.

fields.EN:
I have this habit of writing down
what comes to mind, and it led to
me often being scolded by Mother.
fields.JP:
私は思いついたことをメモして放っておく癖が
あってね、昔からお母さんによく叱られていた
ものだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have this habit of writing down
what comes to mind, and it led to
me often being scolded by Mother.

fields.EN:
She was a member of the Dawn who
died in the incident 15 years ago.
fields.JP: ……十五年前に命を落とした、黎明のメンバーよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was a member of the Dawn who
died in the incident 15 years ago.

fields.EN:
The women who were in charge of
supplies and keeping rules were
called "Mothers."
fields.JP:
食料の確保や分配をおこなったり、身近な
ルールを整えていた女性がそう呼ばれていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The women who were in charge of
supplies and keeping rules were
called "Mothers."

fields.EN:
I was surprised to know those
memos helped your missions, but
I figured it wasn't relevant...
fields.JP:
それが思わぬ形で君たちの役に立っていたことも
驚きだったが、今更言い出せなくてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was surprised to know those
memos helped your missions, but
I figured it wasn't relevant...

fields.EN:
Dad... You really have to tell us
stuff like that sooner, you know?
fields.JP:
お父さーん。そういうことはちゃんと言っといて
よねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dad... You really have to tell us
stuff like that sooner, you know?

fields.EN:
Can you explain why the memo's
contents didn't match what Akazukin was told?
fields.JP:
……じゃあ、メモの内容が赤ずきんの記憶と
違ったことは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you explain why the memo's
contents didn't match what Red
Riding Hood was told?

fields.JP: いや、よくないよ。赤ずきん
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it's okay, Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
I met you in the infirmary where
you were being cared for after
being brought back by our leader.
fields.JP:
君と出会ったのは、医務室だったのだがね……
隊長が連れ帰った君を『先生』と『お母さん』が
一生懸命面倒を見ていてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I met you in the infirmary where
you were being cared for after
being brought back by our leader.

fields.EN:
When I went in, you looked at me
and smiled. Your smile was so
bright, and it warmed my heart.
fields.JP:
様子を見に行った私と目が合った時、君は
にっこりと笑ったのだよ。
しみじみと心温まる笑顔でね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I went in, you looked at me
and smiled. Your smile was so
bright, and it warmed my heart.

fields.EN:
I was filled with such emotion...
I felt like I had physically found
you myself. How embarrassing...
fields.JP:
感動のあまり、思わず自分が発見したかのような
錯覚を覚えてしまったんだろうね……
いやはや、何とも恥ずかしい話だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was filled with such emotion...
I felt like I had physically found
you myself. How embarrassing...

fields.EN:
S-Stop it already... You're making
me feel embarrassed, too...
fields.JP: や、やっぱもういいよ……照れくさくなってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it already... You're making
me feel embarrassed, too...

fields.EN:
W-Well then, let's get back on
topic.
fields.JP: さ……さて、それでは話を戻そうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well then, let's get back on
topic.

fields.EN:
With your efforts, we can now
begin our escape. Many lives are
at stake, so we must be careful.
fields.JP:
君たちの活躍で、いよいよ脱出計画を開始できる。
だが、なにぶん大勢の人間の命がかかっている。
慎重に進めなくてはならない
fields.LOCALIZED:
With your efforts, we can now
begin our escape. Many lives are
at stake, so we must be careful.

fields.EN:
I would like to ask all of you to
rest and prepare for the mission
to come.
fields.JP: 一同、十分に疲れを取り、作戦に備えてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would like to ask all of you to
rest and prepare for the mission
to come.

fields.EN:
(As expected, no one brought up
the subject of a possibility of a
traitor...)
fields.JP:
（結局……
　『裏切り者』の話は、誰も口にしなかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As expected, no one brought up
the subject of a possibility of a
traitor...)

fields.JP: 太陽が近づいてきたね

fields.EN: Yes. But no one can see it yet.
fields.JP: そうね。みんなの目にはまだ見えないけど
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. But no one can see it yet.

fields.EN:
Two lost birdies made it back to
the nest.
fields.JP: 迷い鳥が二羽、巣に辿り着いたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Two lost birdies made it back to
the nest.

fields.EN:
The golden light and the golden
birdie told me that.
fields.JP: 金の光、金の小鳥さんが教えてくれたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The golden light and the golden
birdie told me that.

fields.EN:
I wonder how high those birdies
can fly.
fields.JP: あの小鳥たちはどこまで高く飛べるだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how high those birdies
can fly.

fields.EN:
The birdies don't have fake wings,
and won't burn. The birdie will
fly straight forward.
fields.JP:
作り物の羽根でもなく、燃え尽きることもない、
まっすぐに飛ぶ小鳥たちよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The birdies don't have fake wings,
and won't burn. The birdie will
fly straight forward.

fields.JP: そうあることを願うね

fields.EN:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.
fields.JP:
さあ。今日の食べ物を運んできたよ。
森の朝露に、生命の木の実
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I brought you today's
meal. The forest's morning dew and
a fruit from the Tree of Life.

fields.EN:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
normally do...
fields.JP: さあ、飲んでお食べ……いつものように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
normally do...

fields.EN:
Yes, I will. The ambrosia you've
brought to me.
fields.JP:
ええ。頂くわ。これは、あなたがわたしのために
運んでくれるアムブロシア……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I will. The ambrosia you've
brought to me.

fields.EN:
Special, select flesh from the
Jail.
fields.JP: ……特別に上等な、ジェイルの肉体だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Special, select flesh from the
Jail.

fields.EN:
Good child... I knew you would be
a wonderful maiden of the sun.
fields.JP: いい子だね。さすが僕の見込んだ、太陽の巫女だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good child... I knew you would be
a wonderful maiden of the sun.

fields.EN:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
will... Though, perhaps you don't
need it any longer.
fields.JP:
……さあ、飲んでお食べ。
もっとも、もう君には必要ないかもしれないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go ahead. Drink and eat as you
will... Though, perhaps you don't
need it any longer.

fields.JP:
（ん……朝か。
　何だか外が騒がしいけど……）

fields.EN:
Um... What seems to be the
problem?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... What seems to be the
problem?

fields.EN:
Hi, Jack. There's a bit of a
ruckus going on inside the
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックか。
解放地区内でちょっとした騒ぎが起きててね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi, Jack. There's a bit of a
ruckus going on inside the
Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Everyone's heading over to the
laboratory now.
fields.JP: みんな、研究室に詰めかけてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's heading over to the
laboratory now.

fields.JP: あの……何かあったんですか！？

fields.EN:
Are we under siege?! What is
going on?!
fields.JP:
討ち入りか！？
何が起きておる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are we under siege?! What is
going on?!

fields.EN:
It seems as though the Order of
the Sun made a move inside the
Liberated District...
fields.JP:
この解放地区内……正しくはタイヨウ教団で
おかしな動きが起きているようなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as though the Order of
the Sun made a move inside the
Liberated District...

fields.EN:
Towa rushed here to let us know
that a group of followers have
left the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
さっき永遠の奴が大慌てで報せに来たんだが……
信者たちが大挙して門を出てったらしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Towa rushed here to let us know
that a group of followers have
left the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
But don't they usually preach
their teachings in those areas,
anyway?
fields.JP:
でも……彼らはよく、独房エリアに布教に
出かけているのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't they usually preach
their teachings in those areas,
anyway?

fields.EN:
The thing is, the number of people
who left is way more than we
expect are missionaries.
fields.JP:
それが、いつも布教に出かける人数じゃなかった
って話なんだよな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The thing is, the number of people
who left is way more than we
expect are missionaries.

fields.EN:
So we came here to notify the
Professor, but we couldn't find
him anywhere...
fields.JP:
それで、念のためここに来たら……博士の姿が
見当たらなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we came here to notify the
Professor, but we couldn't find
him anywhere...

fields.EN:
I saw the Professor earlier, and
he said he was gonna go and check
things out.
fields.JP:
博士なら、出てくとこにちょうど鉢合わせて、
状況を確認するって言ってたんすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw the Professor earlier, and
he said he was gonna go and check
things out.

fields.EN:
If the matter wasn't urgent, it'd
be fine, but it's a problem when
it's something like this...
fields.JP:
何もない時ならともかく、こんな時に自分で
動かれると、困るのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the matter wasn't urgent, it'd
be fine, but it's a problem when
it's something like this...

fields.EN:
I wonder what he might have gone
to check on.
fields.JP: 何を確認しに行ったのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what he might have gone
to check on.

fields.JP: グレーテル！　不謹慎よ！

fields.EN:
Miko-san, we'll go and see what's
happening at the Order of the Sun!
fields.JP:
視子さん、僕らもタイヨウ教団の様子を見に
行ってきます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, we'll go and see what's
happening at the Order of the Sun!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: ほんとに……人がほとんどいない……

fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Lady Oohime and the others should
be at that Tower outside.
fields.JP: 大陽女様たちならあの塔にいるはずだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime and the others should
be at that Tower outside.

fields.EN:
Huh?! The Jail Tower?! The others
went there, too?!
fields.JP:
えっ！？　『監獄塔』に！？
じゃあ、他の人たちも！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! The Jail Tower?! The others
went there, too?!

fields.EN:
Yes. Our Lady Oohime gave word
to everyone to head to the Tower.
fields.JP:
ああ。さっき、大陽女様からお導きが
あったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Our Lady Oohime gave word
to everyone to head to the Tower.

fields.EN:
Everyone listened and left, but I
wasn't as convinced, so I stayed
behind.
fields.JP:
みんな塔を目指して出て行ったけど、
あたしはどうもねえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone listened and left, but I
wasn't as convinced, so I stayed
behind.

fields.EN: The followers went to the Tower...
fields.JP: 信者の人たち……塔に向かったなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: The followers went to the Tower...

fields.EN:
It's hard to believe Michiru-san would
send her followers off like
that...
fields.JP:
でも……ミチルさんたちがそんな指示を出す
なんて、あまり思えないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hard to believe Michiru would
send her followers off like
that...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised to hear you say
that, given how you seem to
support them.
fields.JP:
ジャックはあの人たちに肩入れしているよう
だものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised to hear you say
that, given how you seem to
support them.

fields.EN:
I don't necessarily support them,
this is really weird, regardless.
I mean, it's dangerous outside.
fields.JP:
肩入れってわけじゃないけど……何か変だよ。
どんな危険があるかもわからないのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't necessarily support them,
this is really weird, regardless.
I mean, it's dangerous outside.

fields.EN:
Are you sure that was what Lady
Oohime told everyone to do?
fields.JP: それ、ホントにミチルの指示なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure that was what Lady
Oohime told everyone to do?

fields.EN: They both left early this morning after telling us to "wait here until the sun shines," but Lady Oohime alone returned a short while ago...
fields.JP:
早朝に『太陽が照らすまでここで待つように』と
言い残してお二人で出て行かれたんじゃが、
先ほど大陽女様だけ引き返してこられての……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime and another left in
the morning, telling us to "wait
until the sun shines."

fields.EN:
I couldn't see her face under her
hood, but Lady Oohime did return
to us earlier.
fields.JP:
ああ。フードを閉じていらしたのでお顔は
見えなかったが、間違いなく大陽女様だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't see her face under her
hood, but Lady Oohime did return
to us earlier.

fields.EN:
It was then she pointed to the
Tower and shared with us her word.
fields.JP: そして、塔を指差して導かれたんじゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was then she pointed to the
Tower and shared with us her word.

fields.EN:
With how nutty she can get, I'm
not surprised she did such a
thing.
fields.JP:
あの頭のぶっ飛んだ人なら、
別に不思議じゃないって思うけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how nutty she can get, I'm
not surprised she did such a
thing.

fields.EN:
But, normal people climbing the
Tower? It's not the same as going
out on their normal missions.
fields.JP:
でも……普通の人が塔になんか昇ったら……
独房エリアに布教に行くのとは、訳が違うと
思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, normal people climbing the
Tower? It's not the same as going
out on their normal missions.

fields.EN:
I wanna go and see what's at the
Tower!
fields.JP:
とう、なにがあるのか
わくわくするよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanna go and see what's at the
Tower!

fields.EN:
So to be blunt, no one knows
what's really going on, then.
fields.JP:
つまり、何があるか見当もつかないってことです
よね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So to be blunt, no one knows
what's really going on, then.

fields.EN:
Right. Not to mention that place
is where the tragedy occurred 15
years ago...
fields.JP:
ええ。しかも……十五年前に大惨劇が起きたと
いう場所ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Not to mention that place
is where the tragedy occurred 15
years ago...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki doesn't think onee-sama-tachi
would order everyone to go somewhere
so dangerous.
fields.JP:
……そんな危ない場所に行けとみんなに命じる
なんて、お姉様たちがするとは白雪は思えません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White doesn't think dear
sister would send her followers
to such a dangerous place.
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Well, being that you three were
raised here, I don't blame you for
covering for Michiru.
fields.JP:
まあ、ここで育った白雪たちなら、ミチルたちの
肩を持っても当たり前だけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, being that you three were
raised here, I don't blame you for
covering for Michiru.

fields.EN:
But at least we know something
strange is happening.
fields.JP: 何か変なことが起きてるのは、間違いないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But at least we know something
strange is happening.

fields.EN:
You know, the Professor may have
gone to the Tower, too.
fields.JP: それに……博士も塔に向かってるかもしれないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, the Professor may have
gone to the Tower, too.

fields.EN:
That's right... All Clara said was
that he'd go and "check things
out."
fields.JP: そういえば……状況を確認しに行くって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... All Clara said was
that he'd go and "check things
out."

fields.EN: Let's go to the Tower, everyone!
fields.JP: みんな、塔に行ってみようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's go to the Tower, everyone!

fields.EN:
B-But, we don't know exactly
what's going on, and we haven't
received any directives yet. What do you think, Akazukin-san?
fields.JP:
で……でも、いまどうなっているかの調査もまだ
ですし……指示も出てませんわ。
赤ずきんさんはどう思いまして？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, we don't know exactly
what's going on, and we haven't
received any directives yet.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yes. Who has to go and figure out
what's going on?
fields.JP: あら。今更誰が調査をするというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Who has to go and figure out
what's going on?

fields.EN:
That's right! We're the only ones
who can actually find out what's
happening!
fields.JP:
そうだよ。今調査ができる力があるとしたら、
僕たちしかいないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We're the only ones
who can actually find out what's
happening!

fields.EN:
If I might add, I think it's about
time we start making decisions for
ourselves.
fields.JP:
それに……わたしたちは自分たちで判断すべき
時期に来ているのだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I might add, I think it's about
time we start making decisions for
ourselves.

fields.JP: 自分たちで……判断すべき時期……？

fields.EN:
Yes. We don't know who could be
a traitor and what their motives
may be, right?
fields.JP:
ええ。誰が『裏切り者』で何が目的なのか、
わからないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. We don't know who could be
a traitor and what their motives
may be, right?

fields.EN:
But there are no traitors in the
Dawn!
fields.JP: 黎明には……裏切り者なんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there are no traitors in the
Dawn!

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... Let's forget
about traitors for a moment.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん。
裏切り者のことは、ひとまず置いておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... Let's forget
about traitors for a moment.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
This is urgent. If we ignored this
now, it could very well lead to
worst possible scenario.
fields.JP:
これは異常な事態よ。放っておいたら
何が起きるかわからない……
最悪の惨事すら考えられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is urgent. If we ignored this
now, it could very well lead to
worst possible scenario.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルも、やなよかんするー！

fields.EN:
So the only ones who can save
anyone would be us...
fields.JP:
馬鹿を助けられるとしたら、あたしたちだけって
ことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So the only ones who can save
anyone would be us...

fields.EN:
That's right. There may be
casualties, even as we speak. The
Professor could be one, too.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。こうしてる間にも、被害者は出てるかも
しれない……その中には博士もいるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. There may be
casualties, even as we speak. The
Professor could be one, too.

fields.EN:
So we need to go now, and make our
way to the Tower!
fields.JP: だから、一刻も早く……塔へ向かおう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we need to go now, and make our
way to the Tower!

fields.JP: ぐるる……ここ、いっぱいえものいるね！

fields.EN:
Michiru and her followers were
insane to even think of coming
to a place full of Marchens...
fields.JP:
こんなにメルヒェンに溢れてるってのに、
ミチルたち、やっぱどうかしちゃったんじゃない
かしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru and her followers were
insane to even think of coming
to a place full of Marchens...

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm worried about the
followers, too...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm worried about the
followers, too...

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're fine. At least
for now.
fields.JP: 大丈夫だと思うわ。……今はまだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're fine. At least
for now.

fields.EN: Huh? What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Assuming those two are our
"traitors," the Marchens won't
harm them, right?
fields.JP:
もし『裏切り者』があの二人だったなら……
メルヒェンたちは敵じゃないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Assuming those two are our
"traitors," the Marchens won't
harm them, right?

fields.EN:
Are you calling Michiru a
traitor?!
fields.JP: ミチルたちが裏切り者だっていうの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you calling Michiru a
traitor?!

fields.EN:
I'm merely offering the
possibility. It has nothing to do
with how I feel about them.
fields.JP:
可能性は、一つ一つ挙げて検証するものよ。
私個人の感情とは関係ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm merely offering the
possibility. It has nothing to do
with how I feel about them.

fields.EN: So if they aren't, then what?
fields.JP: それじゃ、そうじゃない場合は……何故ですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So if they aren't, then what?

fields.EN:
Then they were lured here by the
"traitor," to be used for their
purposes.
fields.JP:
『裏切り者』にとって利用できるから……
利用するためにここに誘導したから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then they were lured here by the
"traitor," to be used for their
purposes.

fields.EN:
That's what you're going to say,
right?
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what you're going to say,
right?

fields.EN:
As expected from you, Alice.
You're absolutely right.
fields.JP: さすがアリスね。その通りよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As expected from you, Alice.
You're absolutely right.

fields.EN:
The problem is whether it really was
onee-sama-tachi who brought everyone here...
fields.JP:
問題は、みんなを連れてきたのが本当に
お姉様たちなのかってことです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The problem is whether dear sister
actually was the one to ask her
people to follow her.
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN: Well said, rookie detective. But that's an emotional argument. It has no direct bearing on whether the followers live or die.
fields.JP:
あら。頼もしいじゃない、新米探偵さん。
でもそれも感情論よ。信者の生死には直接関係
ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, though motivated by
your kindness. They have no direct
relationship with the traitor.

fields.EN:
True, but the followers' goals do
align with the traitor's, even
without a relationship with them.
fields.JP:
そうですね。別のお話でした。
でも、『裏切り者』の正体と目的には重要な違い
だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
True, but the followers' goals do
align with the traitor's, even
without a relationship with them.

fields.JP: ええ。その通りだと思うわ

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime is mentally stronger
now than before...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White is mentally stronger
now than before...)

fields.EN:
Regardless, if everyone is still
safe, then we need to find them as
soon as we can!
fields.JP:
でも、みんながまだ無事だとしたら……
一刻も早く、見つけなきゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, if everyone is still
safe, then we need to find them as
soon as we can!

fields.JP: それでは早速、進もうぞ！

fields.EN:
Hm? It's no time to be playing
with Marchen carcasses.
fields.JP: ん？　メルヒェンの死体なら遊んじゃ駄目だよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? It's no time to be playing
with Marchen carcasses.

fields.EN:
I think she wants you to check
something on the ground over
there.
fields.JP:
そうです～。
あそこに何か落ちてます～。
調べてみたほうがいいと思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think she wants you to check
something on the ground over
there.

fields.JP: ご、ごめん。ラプンツェル……
……これは……ずいぶん古びてるけど……

fields.EN:
There are a lot of weapons here...
This brownish stain... Is it
blood?
fields.JP:
武器がたくさん……それに、この茶色い染みは、
血、かしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a lot of weapons here...
This brownish stain... Is it
blood?

fields.EN:
Not smell like Marchen blood or
Jack's!
fields.JP:
これ、メルヒェンともじゃっくともちがう
ちのにおいだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not smell like Marchen blood or
Jack's!

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Yeah. I think this is where the
members of the Dawn were killed
15 years ago...
fields.JP:
うん。多分……多分だけど……
十五年前、ここで黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
んだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I think this is where the
members of the Dawn were killed
15 years ago...

fields.EN:
It would explain all these old
weapons on the ground here...
fields.JP:
じゃなきゃ、ここにだけこんなに古い武器が
落ちてるわけない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would explain all these old
weapons on the ground here...

fields.EN:
We're able to be here now because
of them, right...?
fields.JP: みなさんのおかげで、白雪たちは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're able to be here now because
of them, right...?

fields.EN:
Uh... We can feel sad about them
later. I believe we have other
matters to attend to.
fields.JP:
あ。あー。
哀しむのは後でもできます～。
わらわたちには、すべきことがあるはずです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... We can feel sad about them
later. I believe we have other
matters to attend to.

fields.EN:
(Everyone's a lot stronger than
before now...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone's a lot stronger than
before now...)

fields.EN:
(But, what about me? I feel like
my urge to climb is the only thing
getting stronger...)
fields.JP:
（僕は、どうなんだろう。
　上に昇らなければ……そんな欲求ばかりが
　強くなってく気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, what about me? I feel like
my urge to climb is the only thing
getting stronger...)

fields.EN:
(No... It's not a urge anymore.
It's more like... a mission.)
fields.JP:
（……欲求なんてものじゃない。
　使命、みたいな感じだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... It's not a urge anymore.
It's more like... a mission.)

fields.JP: これ、トランシーバーだよね？

fields.EN:
Yup. Well, not a working one,
anyway.
fields.JP:
うん。……まあ、もう使い物にならない
だろうけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Well, not a working one,
anyway.

fields.EN:
(Transceiver... A device that
connects Snark to the
Nightmares...)
fields.JP:
（トランシーバー……スナークとナイトメアを
　結ぶ鍵の一つ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Transceiver... A device that
connects Snark to the
Nightmares...)

fields.EN:
(This isn't from a Nightmare, but
it may be worth checking out...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアが持ってたものじゃないけど、
　調べてみたら何かわかるかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't from a Nightmare, but
it may be worth checking out...)

fields.EN: Do you mind if I borrow this?
fields.JP: これ、借りていっても……いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if I borrow this?

fields.EN: ...If you're the one carrying it, Jack, I think everyone who died would be happy too.
fields.JP:
……ジャックが持ってるなら、死んだみんなも
喜ぶんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure its previous owner would
be happy to have you make use of
it.

fields.JP: ありがとう、赤ずきんさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Lady Oohime... So, we're finally
able to see the sun...
fields.JP: 大陽女様……いよいよ太陽に会えるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime... So, we're finally
able to see the sun...

fields.EN:
The day when the sunlight burns
through the heavens is finally
drawing near.
fields.JP: 太陽の光が天幕を焼く日がついに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The day when the sunlight burns
through the heavens is finally
drawing near.

fields.EN:
So, you all wanted to see the sun
too, Marchens?
fields.JP:
メルヒェン……あんたたちも、
太陽が見たかったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you all wanted to see the sun
too, Marchens?

fields.EN:
Michiru-san is leading humans
and... Marchens?!
fields.JP: ミチルさんがメルヒェンと人間を引き連れて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oohime is being followed by humans
and... Marchens?!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.JP: ええ。陽司さんがいないわね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
Not only that, the Marchens aren't
attacking anyone... They actually
look... happy?
fields.JP:
それに、メルヒェンが……人間に危害を加える
どころか、楽しそうにしているわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only that, the Marchens aren't
attacking anyone... They actually
look... happy?

fields.EN: What in the world is going on...?
fields.LOCALIZED: What in the world is going on...?

fields.EN:
It looks like a "cherry blossom"
tree, a plant that supposedly
existed a long time ago.
fields.JP:
『桜』という木のようね。
以前の世界には存在した木ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like a "cherry blossom"
tree, a plant that supposedly
existed a long time ago.

fields.EN:
(I feel a sense of nostalgia and
sorrow coming from deep within
me...)
fields.JP:
（体の奥底が揺さぶられるような、
　この、懐かしくて哀しい感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a sense of nostalgia and
sorrow coming from deep within
me...)

fields.EN:
(It's almost as if we're being
told who we are...)
fields.JP:
（まるで、僕らが何者なのかを伝えて
　くれるような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's almost as if we're being
told who we are...)

fields.EN:
Why do I know this tree...? So
nostalgic... I loved the flowers
on it, and... I feared the moon.
fields.JP:
わらわは……何故かこの木を知ってます。
とても……懐かしい……
……この花を愛で……月を怖れた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why do I know this tree...? So
nostalgic... I loved the flowers
on it, and... I feared the moon.

fields.EN: Mmm...? All my hair was cut off...
fields.JP:
うーーーー？
かみのけ、きられると、ぜんぶとられた……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mmm...? All my hair was cut off...

fields.JP: ほう……奇妙な感覚を覚えるな……

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but... I think I
know the reason behind my habit...
fields.JP:
何故かしら……わたし、自分の衝動の理由が
理解できる気がするわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but... I think I
know the reason behind my habit...

fields.EN:
I was always trying to hide and
escape from things...
fields.JP:
わたし、いつも何かから隠れたかったんだ……
でも、脱け出したかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was always trying to hide and
escape from things...

fields.EN:
Mmm... I didn't want to wake up...
But, I wanted to wake up...
fields.JP:
……ん……ボク、目覚めたくなかった……
……目覚めたかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I didn't want to wake up...
But, I wanted to wake up...

fields.EN:
The reason I thought I needed to
dress in luxury to show my value
was...
fields.JP:
わたくし……身を飾らないと価値が無いと思って
いた理由は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason I thought I needed to
dress in luxury to show my value
was...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... No wonder I'm so
rational...
fields.JP: ふふ。私、それは合理的な筈よね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... No wonder I'm so
rational...

fields.EN:
(Everyone is feeling the same
thing... This weird feeling...)
fields.JP: （みんなも感じてるんだ……この感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone is feeling the same
thing... This weird feeling...)

fields.EN:
Shirayuki was refused by
someone... Their feelings were
symbolized by... a mirror.
fields.JP:
白雪は……誰かから手酷く拒絶されたん
ですね……その象徴が、鏡……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White was refused by
someone... Their feelings were
symbolized by... a mirror.

fields.EN:
I kept thinking I was everyone's
older sister, and that I needed to
be reliable...
fields.JP:
あたしは……みんなのお姉さんだから、しっかり
しなきゃって思ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept thinking I was everyone's
older sister, and that I needed to
be reliable...

fields.EN:
But, something scary happened
once, when I was interested in
something...
fields.JP:
でも……ほんとは、何かに興味を持ったら、
怖いことが起きるって……止められてて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, something scary happened
once, when I was interested in
something...

fields.EN:
So this is what you were talking
about, Gretel.
fields.JP:
グレーテル。あなたが言ったのは、
このことだったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is what you were talking
about, Gretel.

fields.EN:
Did you finally wake up from your
dream, Alice?
fields.JP: ようやく夢から醒めたの、アリス？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you finally wake up from your
dream, Alice?

fields.EN:
Who knows? But at least I know
now why I sought consistency in my
dreams.
fields.JP:
さあ。どうかしら。でも……何故かわかるわ。
わたしは夢にまで整合性を求める存在なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? But at least I know
now why I sought consistency in my
dreams.

fields.EN:
Jack, how about you? Do you know
why you feel your desires far more
strongly than logic can explain?
fields.JP:
ジャック。あなたもわかった？
あなたの衝動が、感情に根ざしているわけでは
ないといった意味が
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, how about you? Do you know
why you feel your desires far more
strongly than logic can explain?

fields.EN:
It's because... I need to do it
for my existence...
fields.JP:
それは……僕が、僕自身の存在理由として
しなければいけないことだからだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because... I need to do it
for my existence...

fields.JP: みんな、思い出したのね

fields.EN: Michiru! I'm so glad you're safe!
fields.JP: ミチル……あんた……無事だったのね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Michiru! I'm so glad you're safe!

fields.EN: Michiru-san... Why did you come here?
fields.JP: ミチルさん……どうしてここへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Michiru... Why did you come here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
I came to pray here because this
place is the end of everything and
the beginning of everything.
fields.JP:
お祈りをするため。
ここは全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came to pray here because this
place is the end of everything and
the beginning of everything.

fields.JP: （ミチルさんの雰囲気が、今までと違う……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
The end of everything and the
beginning of everything...
fields.JP: 『全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The end of everything and the
beginning of everything...

fields.EN:
I tried to stop her, but she said
she needed to come here, that "the
time has come."
fields.JP:
僕は止めたんだが、どうしてもと……
『刻が来たから』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried to stop her, but she said
she needed to come here, that "the
time has come."

fields.EN:
I didn't want to bring Chiaki here
with me because I only came to put
the bird into its cage.
fields.JP:
本当は、千昭は連れて来たくなかったの。
だってわたしは、鳥を籠に入れに
来たんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to bring Chiaki here
with me because I only came to put
the bird into its cage.

fields.EN:
(The bird into its cage...? What
does she mean by that?)
fields.JP: （鳥を籠に入れる……どういう意味なんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The bird into its cage...? What
does she mean by that?)

fields.EN:
This place is the end and the
beginning of everything. So if 
something is to revive...
fields.JP:
ここは全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所。
だから、もし何かが蘇るとしたら……ここ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is the end and the
beginning of everything. So if 
something is to revive...

fields.EN:
Something...? Are you referring
to yourself, by any chance?
fields.JP: 『何か』って……自分のこと、ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something...? Are you referring
to yourself, by any chance?

fields.EN:
That's right, my sweet child, Shirayuki. Just as I remembered
myself, so did all of you.
fields.JP:
そうよ、しらゆき。優しい子。
わたしがわたしのことを思い出したように、
あなたたちも何かを思い出したはずね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, my sweet child, Snow
White. Just as I remembered
myself, so did all of you.

fields.EN: As in, we remembered who we are...
fields.JP: それは……自分が何者か、ということね
fields.LOCALIZED: As in, we remembered who we are...

fields.EN:
Yes. My existence is rooted in
this location, but all of you are
slightly different.
fields.JP:
ええ。わたしはこの場所に根ざした存在だけど、
あなたたちは、ちょっとだけ違うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. My existence is rooted in
this location, but all of you are
slightly different.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I still don't
understand what you're saying.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、あんたの言ってることはやっぱり
わけわかんない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I still don't
understand what you're saying.

fields.EN:
Don't tell me your followers are
climbing the Tower because of
what you prophesized?
fields.JP:
信者たちがこの塔を昇ってるのも、
そのわけのわからない預言のせいなわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me your followers are
climbing the Tower because of
what you prophesized?

fields.JP: わたし……みんなには『待ってて』って……
でも、そう……そういうことなのね……

fields.EN:
Michiru, you said your existence
is rooted here, right?
fields.JP:
ミチル……あなたはさっき、自分が
この場所に根ざした存在だと言ったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru, you said your existence
is rooted here, right?

fields.JP: そして私たちは、それとは少し違う存在だとも

fields.EN: Thanks to that, everything that had only been conjecture until now has fallen into place.
fields.JP:
おかげで、これまで推論でしかなかったものが
全て繋がったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to what you've said, my
theories seem to have connected.

fields.EN:
You're right. You're an existence
rooted to who was here in this
location.
fields.JP:
そうね……あなたは、
ここに『いたもの』に根ざした存在
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. You're an existence
rooted to who was here in this
location.

fields.EN:
And we're probably an existence
rooted to what was here as well.
fields.JP:
……そして私たちは恐らく、
ここに『あったもの』に根ざした存在
fields.LOCALIZED:
And we're probably an existence
rooted to what was here as well.

fields.JP: （ここに『いたもの』と『あったもの』……？）

fields.EN:
Gretel, what are you talking
about?
fields.JP: グレーテル、君は一体何を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, what are you talking
about?

fields.EN:
Oh, you don't know? She's saying
that she's an existence created by
the Jail's mimicry.
fields.JP:
わからない？
この人は、自分はジェイルに擬態させられた
存在だと言ってるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you don't know? She's saying
that she's an existence created by
the Jail's mimicry.

fields.EN:
I didn't want you to find out,
Chii...
fields.JP: ちーちゃんには、知られたくなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want you to find out,
Chii...

fields.EN:
Chiaki... I'm sorry to have
burdened you. You're my one and
only brother. Please, believe me.
fields.JP:
千昭。今まで苦しめて、ごめんね。
でも、あなたはわたしの大切な、たったひとりの
弟なの。だから、わたしのこと、信じて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chiaki... I'm sorry to have
burdened you. You're my one and
only brother. Please, believe me.

fields.EN:
I know the warm and gentle
sunlight I felt, and the wishes of
the young lives that existed here.
fields.JP:
わたしはここに存在した幼き命たちの想いを、
その身に浴びた柔らかな陽の光の暖かさを
知っている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know the warm and gentle
sunlight I felt, and the wishes of
the young lives that existed here.

fields.EN:
I also personally know the desire
behind the growth of the Tower,
and the breath of life.
fields.JP:
そして、この塔の空へ伸びようとする想いと
生命の息吹をも我が身のように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also personally know the desire
behind the growth of the Tower,
and the breath of life.

fields.EN:
Those who believe my words climb
the Tower higher, ever so higher.
And at the very top...
fields.JP:
私の言葉を信じた人たちは、この塔を高く高く
昇っていくわ。そして、塔の上には……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those who believe my words climb
the Tower higher, ever so higher.
And at the very top...

fields.EN:
At the very top of this tree...
are treasures and an evil giant.
fields.JP: この樹の上には……宝物と、悪い巨人……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very top of this tree...
are treasures and an evil giant.

fields.EN:
(I feel something welling up
inside of me again...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel something welling up
inside of me again...)

fields.EN:
What awaits those who continue is
an ill fate... My role is to stop
them.
fields.JP:
そう。彼らを待っているのは、悪い運命……
そして、それを止めるのが、わたしの役割
fields.LOCALIZED:
What awaits those who continue is
an ill fate... My role is to stop
them.

fields.EN:
That's why I need to go on. Let's
go together, Chii.
fields.JP:
だから……先に行くね。
ちーちゃん、一緒に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I need to go on. Let's
go together, Chii.

fields.EN:
I don't really understand what
happened here, but she went to
save her believers, right?
fields.JP:
意味が……よくわかりませんでしたけど、
彼女は信者を救いに行きましたのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really understand what
happened here, but she went to
save her believers, right?

fields.EN:
It seems so. It also sounds like
there's some kind of disaster
waiting at the very top.
fields.JP:
ええ、恐らく。
塔の上に何か災厄が待っているんだわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems so. It also sounds like
there's some kind of disaster
waiting at the very top.

fields.EN:
If something bad's gonna happen,
we need to go up there, too!
That's why we came here!
fields.JP:
悪いことが起きようっていうなら、
あたしたちも行かなきゃ！
あたしたち、そのために来たんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If something bad's gonna happen,
we need to go up there, too!
That's why we came here!

fields.EN:
Interesting... Very interesting!
I cannot allow this trickster to
get away with it!
fields.JP:
面白い……面白くなってきたな！
ワレをたばかるモノは捨て置けぬわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting... Very interesting!
I cannot allow this trickster to
get away with it!

fields.JP: 赤ずきん……本当にいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood, are you sure?

fields.EN:
Ah, but if you feel like you need
to go, that must be your truth.
fields.JP:
いえ。あなたが行く必要があるとそう感じたなら
それが真実ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but if you feel like you need
to go, that must be your truth.

fields.EN:
Let's get going! Now it's my turn
to save everyone!
fields.JP:
じゃあ行くよ！
今度はあたしが……あたしたちが助け出す番だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get going! Now it's my turn
to save everyone!

fields.EN: I'm surprised it didn't notice us.
fields.JP: でも、よく僕らの気配に気づかなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm surprised it didn't notice us.

fields.EN:
Maybe it has already finished its
work.
fields.JP: 仕事が終わった、といったとこじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it has already finished its
work.

fields.JP: あれは……誰かが倒れてるんですの……？
まだ、息があるかもしれないわ……！

fields.EN:
Horrible... Look at all these
people...
fields.JP:
……ひどい状態だ……
しかも、何人も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Horrible... Look at all these
people...

fields.EN:
It's quite apparent that their
lives have ended.
fields.JP: どう見ても、生命活動を終えているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's quite apparent that their
lives have ended.

fields.EN:
Calm down. Your emotions are
going to get the better of you. I
simply stated facts.
fields.JP:
落ち着いて。感情論は身を滅ぼすわ。
私は状況を正確に述べただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down. Your emotions are
going to get the better of you. I
simply stated facts.

fields.JP:
赤姉様……！
落ち着いてください……
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
It just means that we're in a very
dangerous place.
fields.JP:
いま白雪たちは、それだけ危険なところに
いるんだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means that we're in a very
dangerous place.

fields.EN:
What we need to do now is stay
calm and protect ourselves from
harm.
fields.JP:
……今わたしたちに必要なのは、
わたしたち自身が冷静になって、危機から
身を守ることだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What we need to do now is stay
calm and protect ourselves from
harm.

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... It's not like
no one is distraught by this.
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんさん。
誰も……この人たちの姿に動揺していないわけ
ではないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... It's not like
no one is distraught by this.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Like m'lady said, none are
disregarding the brave who
perished here.
fields.JP: お嬢の言う通り……勇者を侮蔑して良い筈がない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like m'lady said, none are
disregarding the brave who
perished here.

fields.EN:
But who are they? They don't look
like members of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
……この人たち、何者なんだろ？
黎明の人じゃないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But who are they? They don't look
like members of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
They all look about the same age
as us, too...
fields.JP: 歳も、あたしたちと同じくらい……みたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They all look about the same age
as us, too...

fields.EN:
So that means there are more who
were trying to climb the Tower...
fields.JP:
わらわたちと同じように……塔を目指した人が
いたということですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means there are more who
were trying to climb the Tower...

fields.EN:
Can we... at least bury them? They
don't deserve to be left like
this...
fields.JP:
その……せめて、埋めて差し上げませんこと？
このままでは、可哀想ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can we... at least bury them? They
don't deserve to be left like
this...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We can at least do that
much, right?
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
せめてそのくらいは、してあげてもいいよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We can at least do that
much, right?

fields.EN: Yeah. I think that's a good idea.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I think that's a good idea.

fields.EN:
At least they can rest in peace
under this beautiful tree...
fields.JP:
……ここなら……この綺麗な木の下でなら……
せめて安らかに眠れるんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least they can rest in peace
under this beautiful tree...

fields.EN:
I don't know who you all are,
but... please do rest in peace.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
どこの誰かは知らないけど……せめてゆっくり
休んでほしいもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know who you all are,
but... please do rest in peace.

fields.EN: Wait! Bury this with them, too!
fields.JP: ちょっと待って！　これも一緒に……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait! Bury this with them, too!

fields.EN:
The belongings we found... of the
dead Dawn members...
fields.JP: ……それは……昔の黎明の人たちの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The belongings we found... of the
dead Dawn members...

fields.EN:
Well, I know I'm getting
emotional, but I just want to at
least bury them while we're at it.
fields.JP:
あー。感情的って言われるかもしれないけどさ、
せっかくだから埋葬してあげたいなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I know I'm getting
emotional, but I just want to at
least bury them while we're at it.
That's so like you, Sister Red.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: I hope the believers are all okay.
fields.JP: 信者さんたち……大丈夫でしょうか
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope the believers are all okay.

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're fine. I doubt
they would be harmed if they
were gathered here with a motive.
fields.JP:
多分……大丈夫だと思うよ。
目的があって集めた信者たちを、ただ傷つける
ことはしないだろうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're fine. I doubt
they would be harmed if they
were gathered here with a motive.

fields.EN:
That's right, Shirayuki. It's no
use thinking about it now.
fields.JP: そうよ、白雪。今考えたって仕方ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Snow White. It's no
use thinking about it now.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm not going to be swayed
anymore. I'm going to get this
done, no matter what.
fields.JP:
あたしはもう、迷わない。
必ず決着をつけるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to be swayed
anymore. I'm going to get this
done, no matter what.

fields.EN:
Let's go! We'd better find the
core before we meet that
Nightmare!
fields.JP:
じゃ、行くよ！
ナイトメアと出くわす前に……核を見つけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go! We'd better find the
core before we meet that
Nightmare!

fields.EN: Um... I think I found it...
fields.JP: あの～、見つけたみたいです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... I think I found it...

fields.EN: What did you say, Princess Lazy?
fields.JP: どうしたのよ、グータラ姫？
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you say, Princess Lazy?

fields.JP: あれ、核じゃないでしょうか～

fields.EN:
The cherry blossom tree...? Oh,
over there?! Good work!
fields.JP:
その桜ってやつの……あそこね！
……なかなかやるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The cherry blossom tree...? Oh,
over there?! Good work!

fields.JP: おお。でかしたぞ、かぐや！

fields.EN:
I just found it while I was
wandering around.
fields.JP: サボってブラブラしてただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just found it while I was
wandering around.

fields.EN:
There's no telling what's going to
happen to the Jail if we destroy
this. But, the Nightmare...
fields.JP:
……これを壊したら、ジェイルに何が起きるか
わからない。でも、ナイトメアがいる以上……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what's going to
happen to the Jail if we destroy
this. But, the Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Why, yes, we don't have much of a
choice. We can't be defeated now!
fields.JP:
ええ。
ここでやられたら元も子もありませんもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes, we don't have much of a
choice. We can't be defeated now!

fields.EN:
Yup... We'll think about that
later...
fields.JP: ん……あとはその時考える……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... We'll think about that
later...

fields.EN:
I'm quite curious to see how the
Jail will react.
fields.JP: ジェイルの変化も興味深いしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite curious to see how the
Jail will react.

fields.EN:
You can't seem to hold yourself
back, can you?
fields.JP: あんたはいちいち、一言余計だっつーの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't seem to hold yourself
back, can you?

fields.JP: ご丁寧に守護者までいるってわけか……！
来たよ……みんな、用意はいいね！
いっちょあがりーーー！！

fields.EN: Now then, let's break the core!
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, let's break the core!

fields.EN: Yup! We've got no time to waste!
fields.JP:
そうだね！
ぐずぐずしてる暇はないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! We've got no time to waste!

fields.JP: アアアアァァアァアア……！！
あら。ずいぶん大きな悲鳴だこと

fields.EN:
Yeah... Maybe it's because we're
inside the Tower, or maybe...
fields.JP: うん……塔の中だからなのか、それとも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Maybe it's because we're
inside the Tower, or maybe...

fields.EN:
(What's going on? I can't sense
what the Jail is feeling...)
fields.JP:
（何だろう……？
　ジェイルが何を考えてるのか、わからない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's going on? I can't sense
what the Jail is feeling...)

fields.EN:
This sound... I can't get used to
it at all...
fields.JP: この声……何度聞いても慣れませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This sound... I can't get used to
it at all...

fields.EN:
I don't give a damn about the Jail
wailing! Let's just keep going!
fields.JP:
ジェイルの悲鳴なんか、知ったこっちゃないわ！
この調子でガンガンいきましょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't give a damn about the Jail
wailing! Let's just keep going!

fields.EN:
Yes. That is, if we can continue
without encountering the
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
ええ。ナイトメアと遭遇せずに、先へ進めれば
いいのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. That is, if we can continue
without encountering the
Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Heh... Fear not! I shall protect
m'lady from the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ふ……ナイトメアなど恐るるに足らず！
お嬢はワレが護ろうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Fear not! I shall protect
m'lady from the Nightmare!

fields.JP: ないとめあ、ぼっこぼこにしてやるよ！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I guess you're right.
I don't expect things to go easy
for us.
fields.JP:
あはは……確かにそうそう都合よくはいかない
だろうしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I guess you're right.
I don't expect things to go easy
for us.

fields.EN:
But, we did destroy the core, so
let's keep this up!
fields.JP: 核は壊したんだ。攻めの姿勢で行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we did destroy the core, so
let's keep this up!

fields.EN:
The next time we see the
Nightmare, it'll be the end of it!
fields.JP: 出会った時が向こうの最期……いいね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The next time we see the
Nightmare, it'll be the end of it!

fields.JP: キェェェェアアアァアア……！

fields.EN: I will pry it of its live...!
fields.JP: ワレが狩り取ってくれようじょ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I will pry it of its live...!

fields.JP: キェェェェアアアァアア……！

fields.EN:
I don't want to bother with it
anymore, so let's end this
quickly.
fields.JP: めんどくさいから、早く終わらせましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to bother with it
anymore, so let's end this
quickly.

fields.JP: ふん……大したことないわね！

fields.EN:
I wouldn't mind observing it a
little longer.
fields.JP: もう少し観察したかったのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't mind observing it a
little longer.

fields.EN:
I shall lead you to eternal
slumber!
fields.JP: ワレ、汝に永劫の安息を与えん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall lead you to eternal
slumber!

fields.JP: とどめ……刺させて頂きましてよ！
キァァァアアアァアア……！

fields.EN:
It may curse itself in hell for
getting in our way.
fields.JP:
ワレの行手を阻んだこと……
地獄で後悔するがよい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It may curse itself in hell for
getting in our way.

fields.JP: ないとめあ、やっつけたー！

fields.EN:
Whew... Guess we can keep moving
now.
fields.JP: ふう。これで安心して先へ進めるってもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Guess we can keep moving
now.

fields.JP: ふう、さすがにバテますわね……

fields.EN:
Aka-neesama, should we rest for a
while?
fields.JP: 赤姉様、一休みしますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red, should we rest for a
while?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Mmm... I guess we're all a bit
beat, but...
fields.JP:
うーん……
確かにちょっとキツいんだけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess we're all a bit
beat, but...

fields.EN:
Nah, let's just get this over
with! I dunno why, but I feel like
we need to keep moving!
fields.JP:
やっぱり、一気に進もう！
なんかね……なんか……
そうしなきゃいけない気がするんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nah, let's just get this over
with! I dunno why, but I feel like
we need to keep moving!

fields.EN:
I feel the same way, too. We can't
let the rabbit escape.
fields.JP:
わたしもそう思うわ。
いま手を緩めたら、ウサギ穴から逃げて
しまうもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel the same way, too. We can't
let the rabbit escape.

fields.EN:
Yeah... What we're really after is
at the very top!
fields.JP:
うん……僕らが追ってるものは、はるか上に
あるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... What we're really after is
at the very top!

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、げんきだよー！

fields.EN: Fate tells me to continue onward.
fields.JP:
運命がワレに語りかけている……
前に進めと
fields.LOCALIZED: Fate tells me to continue onward.

fields.JP: わたしもまあ、どうってことないわ

fields.EN:
Well then, I suppose we need to
keep moving, then.
fields.JP: それなら……行くしかありませんわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I suppose we need to
keep moving, then.

fields.EN:
If Aka-neesama says so, Shirayuki
will do her best!
fields.JP:
……赤姉様がそう言うなら
白雪もがんばります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Sister Red says so, Snow White
will do her best!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: うん！　行こう……みんなで！

fields.EN:
It looks like we can't go any
further...
fields.JP: ……このままじゃ、上に昇れないみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we can't go any
further...

fields.EN:
I can't do anything, even with my
tools at our disposal...
fields.JP:
わらわの七つ道具を駆使しても、どうにも
しようがないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't do anything, even with my
tools at our disposal...

fields.EN:
Uh, your tools were meant to help
you slack off, so I doubt they'd
be of much help...
fields.JP:
あんたのはもともとサボるためのくだらない道具
でしょうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, your tools were meant to help
you slack off, so I doubt they'd
be of much help...

fields.EN:
Even with my indomitable power,
I cannot penetrate this barrier.
How vexing, indeed.
fields.JP:
ワレの威力をもってしても、この障壁が破れぬ
とは、世界は広いというべきか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even with my indomitable power,
I cannot penetrate this barrier.
How vexing, indeed.

fields.EN:
Guess we can't go up like this...
Now what?
fields.JP:
ともかく……このままじゃ上には行けないね。
どうしたもんかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we can't go up like this...
Now what?

fields.JP:
じゃっく、むずかしいかおしてるけど、
どうしたの？

fields.EN:
You know, I just feel something
strange...
fields.JP: 実はさ、変な予感がするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I just feel something
strange...

fields.EN: A baby's gonna come out of you?
fields.JP: じゃっく、こどもうみそう？
fields.LOCALIZED: A baby's gonna come out of you?

fields.EN:
I feel something dangerous beyond
our imagination is waiting...
fields.JP:
ここを昇れば、きっとこれまでにないくらいの
危険が待ってる。
でも、昇らなきゃいけない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel something dangerous beyond
our imagination is waiting...

fields.EN:
But, we still need to keep
climbing, or else we can't finish
what we came here for...
fields.JP: じゃないと、終わらせられないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we still need to keep
climbing, or else we can't finish
what we came here for...

fields.EN:
Oh, is that it? We already know
we're in for it.
fields.JP: 何言ってんのよ。危険ならとっくに承知の上よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that it? We already know
we're in for it.

fields.EN:
Yes. We decided that we'd face
anything that comes for us!
fields.JP:
はい。それでも立ち向かおうって、
みんなで決めたじゃないですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. We decided that we'd face
anything that comes for us!

fields.EN:
I kind of know what you mean
about the "finish" part...
fields.JP:
でも……わかる気がする
『終わらせなきゃ』ってこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kind of know what you mean
about the "finish" part...

fields.EN:
I want to finish whatever we're
here for, of my own will.
fields.JP:
わらわも……終えるんじゃなくて、わらわの
意志で終わらせたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to finish whatever we're
here for, of my own will.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I'm ready for
anything.
fields.JP: ……ふふ。私はいつでも用意はできてるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I'm ready for
anything.

fields.EN:
I sense the time has come for
us to pay back what is due for
all the lines!
fields.JP:
ワレも感じるぞ。
嘘の対価を払わせる時が到来しているとにゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sense the time has come for
us to pay back what is due for
all the lines!

fields.EN:
Yes... Dreams are meant to be
awakened from. That much is
certain.
fields.JP:
……ええ。最後は必ず夢から醒めるものだもの。
いいえ。そうしなければいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Dreams are meant to be
awakened from. That much is
certain.

fields.EN:
We'll know everything if we keep
moving.
fields.JP: ……先へ進めばきっと、全てがわかるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll know everything if we keep
moving.

fields.JP: みんなも……同じなんだね……

fields.EN:
(It's coming from the transceiver
I found here earlier...)
fields.JP:
（何かわかるかと思って持ってきた
　トランシーバーだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's coming from the transceiver
I found here earlier...)

fields.EN:
The transceiver is picking up
something! I can't believe it
still works...
fields.JP:
トランシーバーが何か受信したんだ！
こんな古いのに、まだ生きてたなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The transceiver is picking up
something! I can't believe it
still works...

fields.EN:
I wonder what it's picking up...
Try and see if you can answer it,
Jack.
fields.JP:
でも……誰からだろ？
ジャック、答えてみてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it's picking up...
Try and see if you can answer it,
Jack.

fields.JP:
こ……こう？
ええと……もしもし？

fields.EN: Hello?! Hey, can you hear me?!
fields.JP:
おい、聞こえるか？
……聞こえてんだな！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hello?! Hey, can you hear me?!

fields.JP: （この声……何だか聞き覚えがあるような……）

fields.EN: Is that you, Jack? I'm, uh...
fields.JP:
その声、ジャックか？
俺は……あー
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that you, Jack? I'm, uh...

fields.EN:
...Someone who died and came back
to life.
fields.JP: 『死んで蘇った者』ってやつかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Someone who died and came back
to life.

fields.EN: Died and came back to life?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Died and came back to life?!

fields.EN:
I see... A brave one who has seen
the depths of the abyss...
fields.JP:
成る程……黄泉の国を垣間見た存在か……
かような勇者がいるとはな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... A brave one who has seen
the depths of the abyss...

fields.EN:
What a subtle way to introduce
oneself.
fields.JP: ……何とも微妙な自己紹介ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a subtle way to introduce
oneself.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Sounds pretty lively over
there!
fields.JP: ははは。そっちは賑やかだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Sounds pretty lively over
there!

fields.EN:
No need to apologize. I actually
wanted to thank you.
fields.JP:
謝る必要はないさ。
むしろ、お礼を言いたいくらいなんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to apologize. I actually
wanted to thank you.

fields.EN:
You're the ones who buried us,
right? We were able to revive
because of that.
fields.JP:
俺たちの死体をあの場所に埋葬してくれたのは
お前たちだろ？
おかげで蘇れたんだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the ones who buried us,
right? We were able to revive
because of that.

fields.JP:
あ……あたしらが埋葬って……
ひょっとして、さっきの……！？

fields.EN:
Let me guess. You can't get to the
upper floor either, right?
fields.JP:
お前らも今、上階への入り口で足止めを
くらってる……違うか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me guess. You can't get to the
upper floor either, right?

fields.EN:
"Either?" So that means you
couldn't get through?
fields.JP: お前らもってことは、君たちも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Either?" So that means you
couldn't get through?

fields.EN:
Yeah. Our objective should be the
same, so how about we lend each
other a hand?
fields.JP:
ああ。俺たちの目的は同じはずだ。
どうだ、協力し合わないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Our objective should be the
same, so how about we lend each
other a hand?

fields.JP:
確かにそうかもしれないけど……
でも……

fields.EN:
Since Jack isn't the type to say
it, I'll say it for him.
fields.JP:
ジャックが言いにくそうだから、私が代わりに
言ってあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since Jack isn't the type to say
it, I'll say it for him.

fields.EN:
We don't know who you are, so we
can't just trust you outright.
fields.JP:
あんたが何者かわかんない以上、無条件には信用
しきれないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know who you are, so we
can't just trust you outright.

fields.EN:
Jack, be a man! It's not like we
have the luxury of putting
our lives at risk, you know?
fields.JP:
……ジャック。あんたもしっかりしなさいよ。
あたしたち、もう後がないのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, be a man! It's not like we
have the luxury of putting
our lives at risk, you know?

fields.EN:
(I have to hand it to Oyayubihime
for being able to say that, and
she's right...)
fields.JP:
（親指姫らしく、さらっと言ってのけたけど……
　でも、ほんとにその通りなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to hand it to Thumbelina
for being able to say that, and
she's right...)

fields.EN:
(This is a battle to end
everything once and for all, so we
can't take any chances...)
fields.JP:
（僕らにとって、これは『終わらせる』ための戦い
　なんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is a battle to end
everything once and for all, so we
can't take any chances...)

fields.EN:
By the way, what do you mean when
you said that you revived because
you were buried?
fields.JP:
君……僕らが埋葬したから蘇ったって、
どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, what do you mean when
you said that you revived because
you were buried?

fields.EN:
You know about the Jail's mimicry,
right?
fields.JP: ……ジェイルの擬態能力は知ってるな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know about the Jail's mimicry,
right?

fields.EN:
We're reincarnated forms of the
members of the Dawn who died here
long ago.
fields.JP:
今の俺たちは、かつてここで死んだ
黎明の人間たちの『転生体』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're reincarnated forms of the
members of the Dawn who died here
long ago.

fields.EN:
Reincarnated forms?! Wh-What do
you mean by that?!
fields.JP:
『転生体』……！？
ぜ……全然わかんないんだけど……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Reincarnated forms?! Wh-What do
you mean by that?!

fields.EN:
It's true that we died, but the
Jail's core mimicked us, bringing
us back to life.
fields.JP:
俺たちは確かに一度死んだ。
だが、あの場所にあったジェイルの核に
『擬態』させられて蘇ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that we died, but the
Jail's core mimicked us, bringing
us back to life.

fields.EN:
The memories of those who owned
those weapons were transferred to
our forms.
fields.JP:
お前らが一緒に埋葬した武器の
元の持ち主たちの想いと記憶を宿す形でな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memories of those who owned
those weapons were transferred to
our forms.

fields.EN:
So our reincarnated forms are an
existence created by mimicry with
the same memories as the fallen.
fields.JP:
『転生体』ってのは、『擬態』によって
想いを宿した存在のことさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So our reincarnated forms are an
existence created by mimicry with
the same memories as the fallen.

fields.EN:
I see. You died in this tower, and
revived with the soul of a fallen
member of the Dawn.
fields.JP:
つまり……あなたたちはこの塔で死んだ、
黎明の人たちの魂を宿しているというわけね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. You died in this tower, and
revived with the soul of a fallen
member of the Dawn.

fields.EN:
(A reincarnated form with
memories... Like our memories of
characters from various stories.)
fields.JP:
（想いを宿す、転生体……そうか。
　やっぱり、僕らは童話の主人公の……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A reincarnated form with
memories... Like our memories of
characters from various stories.)

fields.EN:
Um, I still don't get it. I mean,
I've never heard of such a thing
before.
fields.JP:
いやその……やっぱよくわかんないんだけど？
ていうか、そんな例って知らないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I still don't get it. I mean,
I've never heard of such a thing
before.

fields.EN:
About 15 years ago, I found a baby
at the Station Grounds.
fields.JP:
昔……十五年前のことだが、俺は『元駅構内
エリア』で、ひとりの赤ん坊を拾ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
About 15 years ago, I found a baby
at the Station Grounds.

fields.EN:
That baby killed a Marchen with
her bare hands. Her name was
"Akazukin."
fields.JP:
メルヒェンを素手で倒した、
その赤ん坊の名前は……『赤ずきん』
fields.LOCALIZED:
That baby killed a Marchen with
her bare hands. Her name was
"Red Riding Hood."

fields.EN:
Back then, I was a leader of my
unit.
fields.JP: そして俺は、『隊長』と呼ばれていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back then, I was a leader of my
unit.

fields.EN:
What he's saying is known only
by a select few in the Dawn. I
think he's telling the truth.
fields.JP:
黎明でも一部の者しか知らない情報……
どうやら間違いなさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What he's saying is known only
by a select few in the Dawn. I
think he's telling the truth.

fields.EN:
But, that doesn't mean we can
trust him...
fields.JP: でもだからって、それが信じる理由には……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that doesn't mean we can
trust him...

fields.EN:
You wanted to know who I was,
right? How about you, Jack?
fields.JP:
俺が何者か……だったな。
……なあ、お前はジャックなんだよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wanted to know who I was,
right? How about you, Jack?

fields.EN: How do you know my name...?
fields.LOCALIZED: How do you know my name...?

fields.EN: I see. You're together. Good. Doesn't my voice sound familiar to either of you?
fields.JP:
そうか、ちゃんと一緒にいるんだな。よかった。
二人とも、俺の声に聞き覚えないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can hear her with you. That's
good. Are you sure neither of you
remember my voice?

fields.EN:
As long as we're alive, we still
have a chance of escaping
from here...
fields.JP:
……でも、殺されずにいれば……
生き延びるチャンスはあるわ。
いつか、脱出できるかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we're alive, we still
have a chance of escaping
from here...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We'll get out of here one
day, right?
fields.JP:
そうだな。
いつかきっと脱出してみせる。
……だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We'll get out of here one
day, right?

fields.EN: Yup! We're not going to give up!
fields.JP:
うん！
私たち、こんなのに負けちゃいけないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! We're not going to give up!

fields.EN:
Yes... No matter how painful
things are now.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
どんなに今が辛くても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... No matter how painful
things are now.

fields.EN:
You're the person who was in the
prison cell next to us?
fields.JP: 僕らが囚われてた牢獄で、隣の牢にいた子？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the person who was in the
prison cell next to us?

fields.EN:
Finally remembered, eh? Glad to
hear you're both safe.
fields.JP:
思い出してくれたか？
お前たちも元気でいてくれてうれしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally remembered, eh? Glad to
hear you're both safe.

fields.EN:
Of course, we did die once
already.
fields.JP: まあ、俺たちは一度死んじまったけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, we did die once
already.

fields.JP: （だから、どこかで聞いた声だって……！）

fields.EN:
Now listen up. It's hard to notice
from the outside, but this tower
is structured with dual spirals.
fields.JP:
いいか。この塔は、外から見ても分からないが、
実は二重の螺旋構造になってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now listen up. It's hard to notice
from the outside, but this tower
is structured with dual spirals.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Think of it as a beanstalk.
They link various floors, like the
floor where the tree is.
fields.JP:
ああ。二つの塔が豆の木みたいに絡み合ってるんだ。
それがところどころ内部で繋がってる。
桜のあるフロアとかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Think of it as a beanstalk.
They link various floors, like the
floor where the tree is.

fields.EN:
(I see... So that means we climbed
up one side of the tower.)
fields.JP:
（そうだったんだ……つまり僕たちは、
　その片方の塔を昇ってたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So that means we climbed
up one side of the tower.)

fields.EN:
We're on the other side, and I
think we need to synchronize what
we do to climb to the top.
fields.JP:
ここからは、俺たちのいる塔とお前たちのいる塔、
二手から同時に攻めないと昇れないのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're on the other side, and I
think we need to synchronize what
we do to climb to the top.

fields.EN:
C'mon, just give us a chance and
help us so that we can help you.
fields.JP: 頼む……騙されたと思って、一度協力してみてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, just give us a chance and
help us so that we can help you.

fields.EN: Got it. What do you need us to do?
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. What do you need us to do?

fields.EN:
Well, there are buttons on our
portal numbered 2, 3, and 4, and
we don't know which to press.
fields.JP:
よし。まず、こっちの扉には３つのボタンがある。
それぞれ、２、３、４と書かれてるんだが、
どれを押せばいいのか分からねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, there are buttons on our
portal numbered 2, 3, and 4, and
we don't know which to press.

fields.EN:
Does your portal have anything
like that in particular?
fields.JP: そっちに何か、手がかりはないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does your portal have anything
like that in particular?

fields.EN:
We don't have any buttons on our
portal...
fields.JP: こっちには、ボタンなんてないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have any buttons on our
portal...

fields.EN:
I see... I'm sure there has to be
something over there. Do you mind
searching for a bit?
fields.JP:
そうか……
すまん、もう少し探してみてくれないか？
きっとそっちにも何かあると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I'm sure there has to be
something over there. Do you mind
searching for a bit?

fields.EN:
Sure. I'll contact you as soon as
we find something.
fields.JP: 分かった。何か見つけたら連絡するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. I'll contact you as soon as
we find something.

fields.EN:
Great. Hope to hear back from you
soon.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great. Hope to hear back from you
soon.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for making the decision
without checking with everyone...
fields.JP: ……ごめん、みんな。勝手に決めちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for making the decision
without checking with everyone...

fields.EN:
That's fine. Let's just search the
place like they asked. I want to
at least give them a chance.
fields.JP:
いいわ。
とりあえず言われた通りにしてみましょう。
私は……信じてみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. Let's just search the
place like they asked. I want to
at least give them a chance.

fields.EN:
Alice... Okay, let's look for
clues, then!
fields.JP:
アリス……
うん、分かった。手がかりを探そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... Okay, let's look for
clues, then!

fields.EN:
(Hm, clues... Could there be any
on this floor?)
fields.JP:
（でも……手がかりなんてどこにあるんだろう？
　このフロアのどこかにあるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm, clues... Could there be any
on this floor?)

fields.JP: 何かあそこに書いてますね～

fields.EN: You're right! Let's see... 'How many legs does a human have in the morning, afternoon, and evening?' What does that mean? Isn't it two?
fields.JP:
あ、本当だ！　えっと……
『人間の足は、朝、昼、夜でそれぞれ何本？』
……どういうことだろう？　２本じゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right! Let's see... "How
many legs does man have in the
morning, evening, and night?"

fields.EN:
I have no clue what that means.
Why don't we get our partners to
figure it out?
fields.JP:
難しいことは分かんないよー。
とりあえず、あっちに考えてもらおうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no clue what that means.
Why don't we get our partners to
figure it out?

fields.EN: I guess. Let me give them a call.
fields.JP: そうだね。とりあえず連絡してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess. Let me give them a call.

fields.EN:
We found an etching that says,
"How many legs does man have in
the morning, evening, and night?"
fields.JP:
うん。変な文章を見つけたよ。
『人間の足は、朝、昼、夜でそれぞれ何本か』
……どういうことか、分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found an etching that says,
"How many legs does man have in
the morning, evening, and night?"

fields.EN:
Hm... Just a second. I got someone
here that's good with those kinds
of things.
fields.JP:
さぁ……ちょっと待ってろ。
こっちにはそういうのが得意なヤツがいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Just a second. I got someone
here that's good with those kinds
of things.

fields.EN:
Thanks. In the meanwhile, we'll
head on back to the portal.
fields.JP:
うん、わかった。
その間にこっちはさっきの扉に戻っておくよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks. In the meanwhile, we'll
head on back to the portal.

fields.EN: The one on our side opened, too!
fields.LOCALIZED: The one on our side opened, too!

fields.EN: How did you open the portals?
fields.LOCALIZED: How did you open the portals?

fields.EN:
The time of day represents man's
life. A baby walks on 4, then 2 as
he grows, then 3 with a cane.
fields.JP:
朝は赤ん坊、昼は大人、夜は老人。
四つん這いで４本足、２本足、杖をついて３本足。
だから、４、２、３の順番が正解だとよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The time of day represents man's
life. A baby walks on 4, then 2 as
he grows, then 3 with a cane.

fields.EN:
We're going to head to the top
from here. Do you mind helping us
out?
fields.JP:
俺たちはこのまま最上階を目指す。
……手を貸してくれるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to head to the top
from here. Do you mind helping us
out?

fields.EN: Yes, I see no problem at all.
fields.JP: ええ。迷う必要はないわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I see no problem at all.

fields.EN:
I'm good with that, too! Let's
work together for now.
fields.JP: あたしも賛成だね！　ひとまず共闘しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm good with that, too! Let's
work together for now.

fields.EN:
Guess we'll believe in you. We'll
get through this place together.
fields.JP: ……君を信じるよ。一緒に進もう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we'll believe in you. We'll
get through this place together.

fields.JP: よし！　じゃあ行くぜ！

fields.EN:
Hey, looks like we came to
another closed portal. How
about on your side?
fields.JP:
よぅ。また開かない扉があった。
そっちはどうだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, looks like we came to
another closed portal. How
about on your side?

fields.EN:
Same here. So, I should look for
clues again, right?
fields.JP:
こっちもだよ。
また手がかりを探せばいいんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. So, I should look for
clues again, right?

fields.EN:
All right. Let's search the place
for clues!
fields.JP: よし。手がかりを探そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Let's search the place
for clues!

fields.JP:
あったわね…。今度は……
『旅人のマントを脱がせよ』？
ぬ！？　マントを脱がせる……！？

fields.EN:
It doesn't make much sense to us,
but maybe it means something to
them? Let me get in contact...
fields.JP:
やっぱりこっちじゃ意味が分からないけど……
向こうならわかるかな？
とりあえず、連絡しよう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't make much sense to us,
but maybe it means something to
them? Let me get in contact...

fields.EN:
Yeah. We found another etching
that says, "Remove the traveler's
cloak." Does that ring a bell?
fields.JP:
うん。読むよ。
『旅人のマントを脱がせよ』
……分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We found another etching
that says, "Remove the traveler's
cloak." Does that ring a bell?

fields.EN:
Wait a second. Let me ask my
team...
fields.JP: ちょっと待て。相談する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second. Let me ask my
team...

fields.EN:
Okay. In the meanwhile, we'll head
on back to the portal.
fields.JP:
うん、わかった。
その間にこっちはさっきの扉に戻っておくよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. In the meanwhile, we'll head
on back to the portal.

fields.EN:
Got it! The portal on our side
opened!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it! The portal on our side
opened!

fields.EN: It opened on our side, too!
fields.LOCALIZED: It opened on our side, too!

fields.EN:
Good... We just have a little ways
to go!
fields.JP: いいぞ……あと一息で昇り切れる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good... We just have a little ways
to go!

fields.EN:
By the way, what did that etching
mean?
fields.JP: ところで、今度の答えは何だったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, what did that etching
mean?

fields.EN:
Our buttons were the sun, clouds,
rain, and wind. So, how do you get
a traveler to remove their cloak?
fields.JP:
こっちには、太陽、雲、雨、風のボタンがあった。
旅人のマントを脱がせるにはどうすればいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our buttons were the sun, clouds,
rain, and wind. So, how do you get
a traveler to remove their cloak?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Use the wind to blow it
off?
fields.JP: うーん……風で吹き飛ばす？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Use the wind to blow it
off?

fields.EN:
That'll just make the traveler
hold onto their cloak more
tightly.
fields.JP: それだと旅人はマントを強く押さえるだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That'll just make the traveler
hold onto their cloak more
tightly.

fields.EN:
The answer was the sun. The
sun's heat would make the traveler
remove their cloak themselves.
fields.JP:
正解は、太陽で照らす。
そうすると気温が上がって、暑くなった旅人が
自分からマントを脱ぐのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The answer was the sun. The
sun's heat would make the traveler
remove their cloak themselves.

fields.EN:
From what I've heard, yes. Well,
at least that's what the adults
said.
fields.JP: らしいぜ。大人たちが言うにはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what I've heard, yes. Well,
at least that's what the adults
said.

fields.EN:
Sun... I wonder if we'll get to
see the sun soon.
fields.JP:
太陽か……
もうすぐ僕たちも見られるのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sun... I wonder if we'll get to
see the sun soon.

fields.EN:
I forgot to ask, but did you guys
there kill the Nightmare that
killed us?
fields.JP:
……そういえば、俺たちを殺したナイトメア、
お前たちが倒してくれたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I forgot to ask, but did you guys
there kill the Nightmare that
killed us?

fields.EN:
Yes, though all I did was provide
support.
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね。
……といっても、僕はサポートしただけだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, though all I did was provide
support.

fields.EN:
How did you do that? We gave it
all we had and it didn't budge.
fields.JP:
一体どうやって？
どんなに攻撃しても死ななかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you do that? We gave it
all we had and it didn't budge.

fields.EN:
There are cores in the Jail that
support the Nightmares. Destroying
them makes them vulnerable.
fields.JP:
ええと、核ってのはジェイルやナイトメアに
栄養を送ってて、壊すとナイトメアを
倒せるようになるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are cores in the Jail that
support the Nightmares. Destroying
them makes them vulnerable.

fields.EN: I see... So that's the trick!
fields.JP: そうか、やっぱりそうだったのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... So that's the trick!

fields.EN:
If only we'd known that 15 years
ago, then maybe we would've
survived.
fields.JP:
十五年前にも、それを知ってれば
全滅しなくてすんだのかもしれないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we'd known that 15 years
ago, then maybe we would've
survived.

fields.EN:
(That must be coming from the
leader's memory...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That must be coming from the
leader's memory...)

fields.EN:
Wait... Weren't you killed by
Snark? It sounds like you were
killed by a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
あれ……？
でも、確か十五年前は、ナイトメアじゃなくて
スナークに襲われて全滅したんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Weren't you killed by
Snark? It sounds like you were
killed by a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Isn't Snark the leader of the
Nightmares? A being that's white
and a bit frail-looking.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアの親玉でしょ？
なんかこう、白っぽくてひょろっとした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't Snark the leader of the
Nightmares? A being that's white
and a bit frail-looking.

fields.EN: No... There's no doubt it was that same Nightmare fifteen years ago. There's no way I'd mistake the one that killed me, right?
fields.JP:
いや……間違いなく、
十五年前もあのナイトメアだった。
自分が殺された相手を間違えるはずないぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, we were definitely killed by a
Nightmare. There's no way we'd
forget who killed us.

fields.JP: ど、どういうことでしょう……？

fields.EN:
How unusual... Our fear of this
"Snark" is coming from something
which didn't even exist to them.
fields.JP:
……不思議な話もあったものね。
恐怖の象徴として語られるスナークの
恐怖の根拠となる話が間違いだったなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unusual... Our fear of this
"Snark" is coming from something
which didn't even exist to them.

fields.JP:
スナーク、こわくないよ！
よわっちいもん

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, you said that
before, too.
fields.JP: 前にもそんなことを言っていましたね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, you said that
before, too.

fields.EN:
That Snark thing killed the
Nightmare, but only from behind as
it was already about to die...
fields.JP:
確か……そう、死にそうなナイトメアを
スナークが後ろから刺し殺した後でしたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Snark thing killed the
Nightmare, but only from behind as
it was already about to die...

fields.EN: (Even if the survey team being wiped out fifteen years ago wasn't Snark's doing... what would that mean...?)
fields.JP:
（十五年前に調査隊が全滅したのが
　スナークのせいじゃなかったとして……
　それにどんな意味があるんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So they didn't die because of
Snark? What is going on here?)

fields.EN:
Don't let it bother you, Jack. We
just need to do what we came
here for, isn't that right?
fields.JP:
気にする必要ないわ、ジャック。
私たちは『終わらせる』ために進むだけ。
……そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't let it bother you, Jack. We
just need to do what we came
here for, isn't that right?

fields.EN:
Exactly! No use thinking about
something we don't have an answer
to!
fields.JP:
そうそう。
こんなとこでくよくよ考えてたって
答えなんか出ないしね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly! No use thinking about
something we don't have an answer
to!

fields.EN:
I believe she's right. If
anything, the truth we seek lies
in wait ahead of us.
fields.JP:
それが正しいと思うわ。
真実はすぐそこ……この先にあるのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe she's right. If
anything, the truth we seek lies
in wait ahead of us.

fields.EN:
Well then, let's all go and see
what this "truth" is!
fields.JP: ……よし、お互い、真実を見つけようぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, let's all go and see
what this "truth" is!

fields.EN: We'll see you at the top!
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll see you at the top!

fields.EN:
So, this is the top of the
Tower...?
fields.JP: ここが……この塔の最上階ですのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is the top of the
Tower...?

fields.EN:
Whatever! We're going to get this
done, one way or another!
fields.JP: ただで済むとは思えないわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever! We're going to get this
done, one way or another!

fields.JP:
おおーーーー！
さいじょうかいーーーー！！

fields.EN:
So, how does it feel, "climbing to
the top?"
fields.JP:
ジャック、『高いところ』に昇って
どんな気分かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how does it feel, "climbing to
the top?"

fields.EN:
(Again...! I feel something
swelling deep inside me...!)
fields.JP:
（まただ…………！
　また、体の奥底から何かが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Again...! I feel something
swelling deep inside me...!)

fields.EN:
There should be a giant here we
need to beat.
fields.JP: ……ここには倒さなきゃいけない巨人がいる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
There should be a giant here we
need to beat.

fields.EN:
I think this is my Blood Libido...
To find the core and Nightmare
here...
fields.JP:
……多分これは、僕の血式リビドーで……
きっとここにも核やナイトメアが存在するって
ことなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this is my Blood Libido...
To find the core and Nightmare
here...

fields.JP:
（そう、僕は…………いや、
　僕らは『転生体』だったんだ……！）

fields.EN:
(We were all born from a strong
desire...)
fields.JP:
（あの場所にあったものに込められた……
　強い想いを宿して生まれた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We were all born from a strong
desire...)

fields.EN:
I finally know after coming
here... We exist to end this
story...
fields.JP:
塔の最上階まできて……ようやくわかった。
僕は……僕たちは、物語を終わらせるための存在
なんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I finally know after coming
here... We exist to end this
story...

fields.EN:
I merely hypothesized from 
examining my desire. I also wasn't
preoccupied with being human.
fields.JP:
答えを知っていたわけではないわ。私はただ、
自分の欲求を検証し、仮説を立てていただけ……
もとから『人間』である執着なんてないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I merely hypothesized from 
examining my desire. I also wasn't
preoccupied with being human.

fields.EN:
I'm still awake in this dream...
Which is why I want to escape from
here...
fields.JP:
わたしは……夢の迷宮の中でも、目醒めたままの
存在だから……望むのね。この迷宮から抜け出す
ことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still awake in this dream...
Which is why I want to escape from
here...

fields.EN:
I was attached to my earrings
because I was seeking a day to
remove them from me...
fields.JP:
わたくしもまた……そうでしたのね。
このガラスのイヤリングこそわたくしの囚われ……
脱ぎ捨てる日を希ってたんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was attached to my earrings
because I was seeking a day to
remove them from me...

fields.EN: Mmm... A day for me to wake up...
fields.JP: ん……ボクも、目覚める日を……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mmm... A day for me to wake up...

fields.EN:
I don't want to return to the
moon, and I won't.
fields.JP:
わらわは月に帰るのは嫌です～
だから、嫌だって言ってやります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to return to the
moon, and I won't.

fields.EN: Not so lazy anymore, are you?
fields.JP: 『面倒くさいから』……じゃないのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Not so lazy anymore, are you?

fields.EN:
My days of hiding and finding a
reason to escape ends here.
fields.JP: わたしも、隠れて逃げ回る日を、終えるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My days of hiding and finding a
reason to escape ends here.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki didn't need to wake
up if that would prevent anyone
from being hurt...
fields.JP:
白雪は……目を覚まさなくてもよかったんです。
それでみんなが傷つかないなら……でも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White didn't need to wake
up if that would prevent anyone
from being hurt...

fields.EN: But I suppose it wasn't enough.
fields.JP: きっとそれじゃ、駄目なんです
fields.LOCALIZED: But I suppose it wasn't enough.

fields.EN:
I need to find a way to escape
too, without waiting for help...
fields.JP:
……そうだね。あたしも待ってないで、抜け出さ
なきゃいけないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to find a way to escape
too, without waiting for help...

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
So, everyone... Let's end this
crazy story together!
fields.JP:
だからさ……みんなで終わらせようよ！
このふざけた物語をさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, everyone... Let's end this
crazy story together!

fields.EN:
Yeah. We are who we are. We'll end
this so that we can have a new
beginning!
fields.JP:
うん。
僕らがどんな存在でも、僕らは僕らだから……
行こう。終わらせて……始めるために！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We are who we are. We'll end
this so that we can have a new
beginning!

fields.EN:
We found it! There really is a
core here...
fields.JP:
見つけた……核だ！
ほんとにあったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found it! There really is a
core here...

fields.EN:
Oh? What folly, sitting there
while we prepare for its demise.
fields.JP:
ほう……まさにワレらに破壊されんとしている
というのに、呑気に脈打っておるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? What folly, sitting there
while we prepare for its demise.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh! Grrrr...! We're
gonna eat you!
fields.JP:
ふっふっふー。がるるる……
これからみんなで、たべちゃうよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh! Grrrr...! We're
gonna eat you!

fields.EN:
I don't think you should try and
provoke it like that, or else
you're going to bring trouble.
fields.JP:
そうやって刺激して、いろいろ呼び寄せても
知りませんよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think you should try and
provoke it like that, or else
you're going to bring trouble.
