fields.EN:
Ohohoho! Well then, we'll just
destroy everything here!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ！
その時は全滅するまででしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohoho! Well then, we'll just
destroy everything here!

fields.EN:
Um, destroy everything except us,
okay?
fields.JP: 全滅しちゃ駄目でしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, destroy everything except us,
okay?

fields.EN:
But she's right! We're going to
beat anything that stands in our
way!
fields.JP:
そうよ！　何が来たってみんなあたしたちが
やっつけてやるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she's right! We're going to
beat anything that stands in our
way!

fields.EN:
This is the last core, right?
There's no way we're going to let
it sit there like that!
fields.JP:
だって……きっとこれが、最後の核なんでしょ？
引けるわけないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is the last core, right?
There's no way we're going to let
it sit there like that!

fields.EN: Yes... This is the last core...
fields.JP:
はい……これが……
最後の核、なんですよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... This is the last core...

fields.JP:
ええ……おそらくは。
もっとも……

fields.EN:
No... If the core we destroyed in
the area expanded the Jail...
fields.JP:
いえ……独房エリアで破壊してきた核が、
ジェイルを拡げるためのものだとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... If the core we destroyed in
the area expanded the Jail...

fields.EN:
...That means all our missions
simply focused the power from
the cores to this tower.
fields.JP:
今までの作戦が、ジェイルの養分をこの塔に
集中させるためのものだとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...That means all our missions
simply focused the power from
the cores to this tower.

fields.EN:
If so, what are the cores in the
lower level and the one here for?
fields.JP:
下層にあった核とこの核は、いったい何のために
あるのかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, what are the cores in the
lower level and the one here for?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, wasn't the
Tower high enough for us to
escape?
fields.JP:
そういえば、脱出できる高さには成長したはず
なんですよね～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, wasn't the
Tower high enough for us to
escape?

fields.EN:
Well, it isn't surprising to find
integral parts of the Jail here,
too.
fields.JP:
まあ……各主要箇所に生体としての主要パーツが
存在するのは、不思議ではないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it isn't surprising to find
integral parts of the Jail here,
too.

fields.EN:
W-Wait a minute! You're making
it sound like this place is going
to grow again!
fields.JP:
そ……それじゃ、まだ成長する気じゃない
でしょうね！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait a minute! You're making
it sound like this place is going
to grow again!

fields.EN:
Well, not that we'd know since
we can't communicate with the
Jail.
fields.JP:
そればかりはジェイル本体にでも聞いてみないと
わからないんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, not that we'd know since
we can't communicate with the
Jail.

fields.EN:
Oh? Come to think of it, we have
someone here who understands the
Jail. Isn't that right, Jack?
fields.JP:
あら？　でもジェイルの気持ちがわかる人なら
いるわよ。ねえ、ジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Come to think of it, we have
someone here who understands the
Jail. Isn't that right, Jack?

fields.EN:
It's not like I can communicate
with it... All I can do is sort of
tell what it's feeling...
fields.JP:
僕は……何となく気持ちがわかるだけで、別に
会話なんかができるわけじゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I can communicate
with it... All I can do is sort of
tell what it's feeling...

fields.EN:
(What the...? I can't feel the
Jail's fear or hear its wailing...
This emotion I'm picking up is...)
fields.JP:
（どうしてなんだろう……
　いつもみたいにジェイルが怯えてない。
　ジェイルから伝わってくるこの感情は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the...? I can't feel the
Jail's fear or hear its wailing...
This emotion I'm picking up is...)

fields.EN:
I sense... joy from the Jail.
Extreme joy...
fields.JP:
ジェイルから……喜びみたいなものを
感じるんだ……それも、すごく嬉しそうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sense... joy from the Jail.
Extreme joy...

fields.EN:
Does the Jail want its cores to
be destroyed?
fields.JP: ジェイルは核を破壊されたい、のかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does the Jail want its cores to
be destroyed?

fields.JP: オオオォォォォォオオオオオオ！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Looks like it's
answering you, Jack.
fields.JP: ふふ……ジャックの言葉に答えてるみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Looks like it's
answering you, Jack.

fields.EN: S-Stop it! You're creeping me out.
fields.JP: や……やめなさいよ！　気持ち悪いわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: S-Stop it! You're creeping me out.

fields.JP: うん……なんだか不気味だ……

fields.EN:
(I don't want the sound bothering
me, so I'd better put the
headphones on.)
fields.JP:
（気が散るといけないし……ヘッドホンを
　付けておこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want the sound bothering
me, so I'd better put the
headphones on.)

fields.EN:
But if the core is here, then
there should be a guardian and
Nightmare here, too.
fields.JP:
でも……ここに核があるってことは、守護者の
メルヒェンもナイトメアもいるってことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if the core is here, then
there should be a guardian and
Nightmare here, too.

fields.EN:
And if we don't beat them, we
can't continue our search for the
others here.
fields.JP:
そいつらを倒さなきゃ、僕らは先へ進めないし、
ここに来てるはずの人たちも探せない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if we don't beat them, we
can't continue our search for the
others here.

fields.EN:
Yup. Not like thinking will get us
anywhere now. Let's just smash
that core!
fields.JP:
……だね。
どうせいま考えたって何もわかんないんだし、
今は核をやることを考えよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Not like thinking will get us
anywhere now. Let's just smash
that core!

fields.EN:
I feel like Akazukin isn't
really thinking this through, but
I guess there's no other choice.
fields.JP:
いろいろすっ飛ばしてる気がするのが赤ずきん
らしいですが、たしかにこの際、仕方ないです～
やるしかないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like Red Riding Hood isn't
really thinking this through, but
I guess there's no other choice.

fields.EN:
Hmph! We'll just get rid of
whatever guardian is here, and
smash that core to pieces!
fields.JP:
フン。とっととここの番人とやらを倒して、
コイツをぶっ壊すわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! We'll just get rid of
whatever guardian is here, and
smash that core to pieces!

fields.EN:
Okay, is everyone ready? Let's do
this!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、みんな準備はいい？
……行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, is everyone ready? Let's do
this!

fields.EN: Hah! Nothing to it! Now, then...
fields.JP:
ハッ！　大したことなかったわね。
さあて、お次は……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hah! Nothing to it! Now, then...

fields.EN:
Heh... I shall end its misery in a
single stroke.
fields.JP: フッ……我が一撃のもとに屠ってみせよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I shall end its misery in a
single stroke.

fields.JP:
ラプラプ……
一体どうしたんですの？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: あれ！　こあからなんかでてる！！

fields.EN:
Huh?! Wh-What the...?! Vines...
Or are they tentacles...?
fields.JP:
……え！？
な、何ですの……これ……！！
ツタみたいなものがニョロニョロと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Wh-What the...?! Vines...
Or are they tentacles...?

fields.EN:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!
fields.JP: 核が……メルヒェンを……食べてる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!

fields.EN:
It looks like it's a special
function specific to that core.
fields.JP:
これは……今までの核にはなかった、
この塔特有の機能なのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's a special
function specific to that core.

fields.EN:
Maybe it's absorbing the Marchen
that was guarding it... for
nourishment.
fields.JP:
自分を守護していたメルヒェンを吸収して、
何をしようというのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's absorbing the Marchen
that was guarding it... for
nourishment.

fields.EN:
In any case, we should stand back
until the core's done moving..
fields.JP:
ともかく……核の動きが収まるまで、
離れていた方がよさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we should stand back
until the core's done moving..

fields.JP: おおー。たべおわったー！

fields.EN: Hey, Aka-Aka? Can we break it now?
fields.JP:
ねーあかあか。
もうこいつこわしていいー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Reddy? Can we break it now?

fields.JP: （……完全に動きがおさまったみたいだ……）

fields.EN:
I'm actually interested in seeing
what will happen after it's
destroyed.
fields.JP:
これを壊したら、何が起こるのか……
とても興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm actually interested in seeing
what will happen after it's
destroyed.

fields.EN:
Okay then! Let's smash that core,
but be careful!
fields.JP:
……よし！　核をやろう！
みんな、慎重にね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay then! Let's smash that core,
but be careful!

fields.EN:
There is no means for it to stand
against my divine movements!
fields.JP: ワレの神速の攻撃に……抗う術なし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is no means for it to stand
against my divine movements!

fields.JP: アアァァァァァアアア……！
アアアァァァァァアアアアア……！！

fields.EN:
Wh-Wh-What's going on?! Why
does it shake so?!
fields.JP: なな何事ぞ！？　地面が揺れておるぞ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Wh-What's going on?! Why
does it shake so?!

fields.EN:
It looks like the Tower is growing
again...
fields.JP: ええ、塔がまた成長しているのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like the Tower is growing
again...

fields.EN:
What's going to happen if it keeps
growing?!
fields.JP: これ以上伸びたら、何が起きるんだろう……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's going to happen if it keeps
growing?!

fields.JP: 何が起きたって……いいじゃない！

fields.EN:
That's right! We already know what
we have to do!
fields.JP:
そうですよ！
白雪たちのやることは決まってます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We already know what
we have to do!

fields.JP: ……ジャック！　ナイトメアよ！
ヴォオアァァアァアア……！

fields.EN: Yes, we've been waiting for you!
fields.JP: ええ。お待ちしてましてよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, we've been waiting for you!

fields.EN:
What a chore... Let's hurry up and
get rid of it already.
fields.JP: 面倒くさい奴……とっとと片付けましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a chore... Let's hurry up and
get rid of it already.

fields.EN:
Hmph! You don't need to tell us,
Princess Lazy!
fields.JP: フン！　グータラ姫に言われるまでもないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! You don't need to tell us,
Princess Lazy!

fields.JP: ヴォオアァァアァアア……！

fields.EN:
Okay! Let's do this! We're not
gonna lose to you!
fields.JP:
よし！　迎え討つよ！
あたしたちが、お前なんかに負けるかっての！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Let's do this! We're not
gonna lose to you!

fields.EN: We did it! Just a little more...!
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it! Just a little more...!

fields.EN:
A little more... Just a little
more!
fields.JP: もう少しよ……もう少しで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A little more... Just a little
more!

fields.EN:
So, trembling in fear of my
absolute power, are yule...
fields.JP: 我が武力の前に怖気じゅいた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, trembling in fear of my
absolute power, are yule...

fields.JP: とっとと死にやがれです～

fields.EN:
Yes, it's time to put an end to
it!
fields.JP: ええ！　行けましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's time to put an end to
it!

fields.JP: ヴォォォォアァァアァアア……！

fields.EN:
That's right! We need to find the
followers!
fields.JP: そうですわ！　信者の皆さんを……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We need to find the
followers!

fields.EN:
But, isn't this the top floor? I
don't see any of them around.
fields.JP:
でも、ここが最上階なんでしょ？
信者なんて見あたらないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, isn't this the top floor? I
don't see any of them around.

fields.JP: さっきまで、あんなのなかったです～

fields.EN:
It looks like the Tower grew
another floor.
fields.JP:
どうやら、塔が成長したことでさらに上の階が
できたようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like the Tower grew
another floor.

fields.EN: Yes, and... I bet Snark is there.
fields.JP:
ええ。
そして……多分、スナークもそこにいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, and... I bet Snark is there.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルが、ばりばりたべちゃうよ！

fields.EN: End this, once and for all...
fields.LOCALIZED: End this, once and for all...

fields.EN:
I'm going to scold it with all I
have, then...!
fields.JP:
わたくし、そいつを思いっきり罵倒して
やりますのよ。そして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to scold it with all I
have, then...!

fields.JP: シンデレラは少し肩の力を抜くといいです～

fields.EN: Heh, heh. Are you ready, Akazukin?
fields.JP:
……ふふ。
赤ずきん、あなたはいいのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh. Are you ready, Red
Riding Hood?

fields.EN:
Yup. There's nothing holding me
back now.
fields.JP: うん。怖がることなんて、何もないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. There's nothing holding me
back now.

fields.JP: このあたりにはいないようね……

ミチル……！
それにちーも……

fields.EN:
Thank goodness. Looks like
everyone's safe.
fields.JP:
みんな無事みたいね。
よかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness. Looks like
everyone's safe.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
You all disappeared suddenly, so
we came by the Tower to check.
fields.JP:
あなたたちが急にいなくなったから
塔の近くまで様子を見に来たのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You all disappeared suddenly, so
we came by the Tower to check.

fields.EN:
Then we saw the followers climbing
the Tower with some Marchens, and
went into full alert.
fields.JP:
タイヨウの信者がメルヒェンどもと一緒に
塔を昇ってくのを見てな。只事じゃねえって
話になったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we saw the followers climbing
the Tower with some Marchens, and
went into full alert.

fields.EN:
We decided to follow them, and
that's when we met Michiru-san and
the others.
fields.JP:
それで後を追っていたら、ミチルさんたちと
会ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We decided to follow them, and
that's when we met these two.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
(Michiru and Chiaki went in by
themselves?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Michiru and Chiaki went in by
themselves?)

fields.EN:
Haru-kun and the others found me while
I was following the followers
entering the Tower.
fields.JP:
私は、信者を追って塔に来ていたところを
ハルくんたちに拾われてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru and the others found me while
I was following the followers
entering the Tower.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
Wait... The Marchens were with the
followers?
fields.JP: ……メルヒェンが、信者の人たちと一緒に？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... The Marchens were with the
followers?

fields.EN:
Well, my sister said that she saw
the followers and Marchens going
up the Tower together.
fields.JP:
それが、姉さんがメルヒェンと教団員を率いて
この塔を昇っているのを見たと言われてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, my sister said that she saw
the followers and Marchens going
up the Tower together.

fields.JP: どうも話が噛み合わないんだ

fields.EN:
I couldn't see their faces very
well, but I'm pretty sure that was
Michiru-san.
fields.JP:
顔は見えなかったけれど、あれは間違いなく
ミチルさんだったと思うのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't see their faces very
well, but I'm pretty sure that was
Michiru.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
That's impossible. She was with me
all along.
fields.JP:
姉さんはずっと僕といたんです。
そんなことはありえませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's impossible. She was with me
all along.

fields.EN:
In any case, it's fortunate that
we were all able to meet here.
fields.JP: まあしかし、こうして全員が会えてよかった。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, it's fortunate that
we were all able to meet here.

fields.EN:
I-I suppose. With all the Marchens
around, it's good that everyone's
safe.
fields.JP:
そ、そうですよね。塔の中にはメルヒェンが
たくさんいるのに、みんな無事だった
だけでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I suppose. With all the Marchens
around, it's good that everyone's
safe.

fields.EN:
Like Shirayukihime said, the Tower
is filled with Marchens...
fields.JP:
白雪姫の言うとおり、この塔はメルヒェンで
いっぱいだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like Snow White said, the Tower
is filled with Marchens...

fields.EN:
If so, how did everyone make it
here without being attacked?
fields.JP:
それなのに、なぜみんなはメルヒェンに
襲われずにここまで来れたんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, how did everyone make it
here without being attacked?

fields.EN:
I would assume evaluating what
Snark's goals are would answer
that query.
fields.JP:
それは……スナークの目的がどこにあるのかを
考えれば、おのずと答えが出るのでは
ないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would assume evaluating what
Snark's goals are would answer
that query.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Why did we, Michiru, and the
members of the Dawn come to this
tower?
fields.JP:
私たちやミチルたち、そして黎明のひとたちが
この塔に来たのはなぜだったかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did we, Michiru, and the
members of the Dawn come to this
tower?

fields.EN:
(That's because everyone came
after the followers who went up
this tower...)
fields.JP:
（それは、信者のひとたちがこの塔を昇った
　からだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's because everyone came
after the followers who went up
this tower...)

fields.EN:
(We destroyed the cores along the
way, and the Jail emitted a sound
of joy...)
fields.JP:
（そして、それを追ってきた僕らが
　核を全部壊したことで、ジェイルが喜びの
　声を上げた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We destroyed the cores along the
way, and the Jail emitted a sound
of joy...)

fields.EN:
(I see... If both of them were
needed to attain Snark's goals,
then...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……この二つがスナークの目的に
　必要な要素だったとしたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... If both of them were
needed to attain Snark's goals,
then...)

fields.EN:
(No... What if those two were the
goals that Snark wanted?)
fields.JP:
（いや……むしろこの二つ以外には
　必要なかったんだとしたら……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... What if those two were the
goals that Snark wanted?)

fields.EN:
Now that Snark's achieved its
goal, it doesn't care about
anything else...?
fields.JP:
目的を叶えるための条件がそろった今……
その他はどうでも……よかった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that Snark's achieved its
goal, it doesn't care about
anything else...?

fields.EN:
Splendid, Jack. In that case,
there's only one thing to do.
fields.JP:
すばらしいわ、ジャック。
……ならば、なすべきことは一つね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Splendid, Jack. In that case,
there's only one thing to do.

fields.EN:
Yeah... It's time for us to
discover the truth that we've been
looking for.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
とうとう真実を突き止める時が来たんだ。
僕らにとっても、ここにいるみんなにとっても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It's time for us to
discover the truth that we've been
looking for.

fields.JP: 真実とは……どういうことかね？

fields.EN:
There have been too many odd
events until now. We figured that
the escape plan was just a ruse.
fields.JP:
いままで、おかしなことが多すぎた……
だから、僕たち、考えたんです。
この脱出計画は、聞いていた通りのものじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There have been too many odd
events until now. We figured that
the escape plan was just a ruse.

fields.EN:
There's probably a traitor among
us. And that traitor is using the
escape plan for their own goals.
fields.JP:
きっとこの中に裏切り者がいる。
そして脱出計画の裏で、そいつの目的が同時に
進行してるんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's probably a traitor among
us. And that traitor is using the
escape plan for their own goals.

fields.EN:
What's on the surface isn't always
the truth, just like our
existences.
fields.JP:
表面に見えてるものが、必ずしも真実な
わけじゃない。
……私たちの存在がそうであったようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's on the surface isn't always
the truth, just like our
existences.

fields.EN:
Your existences? What are you
talking about?
fields.JP:
あなたたちの存在が……？
一体どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your existences? What are you
talking about?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh. You're all strong little
birdies.
fields.JP: ふふ。みんなはやっぱり、強い小鳥さんたちね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh. You're all strong little
birdies.

fields.EN: We really didn't want to notice...
fields.JP:
できることなら……気づかずにいたかった
です……
fields.LOCALIZED: We really didn't want to notice...

fields.EN:
But, we also needed to know the
truth...
fields.JP: でも……見据えなきゃいけないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we also needed to know the
truth...

fields.EN: I may be a newcomer, but I won't tolerate lies or broken promises!
fields.JP: ワレは新参者だが、嘘と違えた約束は許せんぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am still new here, but I will
not accept lies!

fields.EN:
I'm ready to go back to taking
things easy, which is why I want
to finish this up soon.
fields.JP:
わらわは楽をしたいです。
だから、面倒なことはさっさと終わらせたい
です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm ready to go back to taking
things easy, which is why I want
to finish this up soon.

fields.EN:
I'm simply tired of fooling others
and being fooled.
fields.JP: わたくし、騙すのも騙されるのももう沢山ですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm simply tired of fooling others
and being fooled.

fields.EN:
Yes... I don't mind using others,
but I won't stand being used by
them.
fields.JP:
……そうね。利用はしても、利用されるのは
まっぴらよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I don't mind using others,
but I won't stand being used by
them.

fields.EN:
We have a traitor here, and that's
probably who this Snark is!
fields.JP:
……裏切り者は僕らの中にいる。
そして……多分、そいつこそがスナークなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have a traitor here, and that's
probably who this Snark is!

fields.EN: Oh? So, Snark is amongst us?
fields.JP: ほう……つまり、スナークがここにいると……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? So, Snark is amongst us?

fields.EN:
Yes. Snark was watching us and the
Jail while communicating with the
Nightmares.
fields.JP:
はい。スナークは、常に僕らとジェイルを監視
しながらナイトメアとも連絡を取り合っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Snark was watching us and the
Jail while communicating with the
Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Despite our reservations, we
believed in the escape plan and
continued with our missions.
fields.JP:
そして僕らはどこか違和感を感じながらも、
この計画はジェイルから脱出するためのものだと
信じて行動し続けたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite our reservations, we
believed in the escape plan and
continued with our missions.

fields.EN:
And all the while, there was a
different plan in the works...
fields.JP: この計画に別の意味があるとは気づかずに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And all the while, there was a
different plan in the works...

fields.EN:
Things wouldn't have changed if
it weren't for the information we
gathered to detain Snark.
fields.JP:
これまではそうね。でもようやく、スナークを
捕らえるための情報が揃ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things wouldn't have changed if
it weren't for the information we
gathered to detain Snark.

fields.EN:
That's why we want to find the
truth, and have every one of us
escape here alive.
fields.JP:
だから……真実を突き止めて、みんなでここを
出よう。ここにいる人たちも、僕たちも……
できれば全員そろって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we want to find the
truth, and have every one of us
escape here alive.

fields.JP: 『ここ』ってのは、ジェイルのことか？

fields.EN:
From this absurd story. Everyone
here knows we must have wandered
into some strange story.
fields.JP:
この、でたらめな物語の中からです。
みんなもわかってる筈です。何かおかしな
物語の中に迷い込んでしまったって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
From this absurd story. Everyone
here knows we must have wandered
into some strange story.

fields.EN:
A story is complete when the book
is closed. That's why we need to
end this one.
fields.JP:
物語とは閉じて初めて完成するものだもの。
だからわたしたちは、この物語を終わらせ
なければ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A story is complete when the book
is closed. That's why we need to
end this one.

fields.EN:
All the characters are here now.
All that's left is for us to
discover Snark and end it.
fields.JP:
……役者は全て揃ったわ。
スナークを狩りましょう。物語を終えるために
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the characters are here now.
All that's left is for us to
discover Snark and end it.

fields.EN: But then, who is this traitor?
fields.JP: でもそれじゃあ……誰が裏切り者だというの？
fields.LOCALIZED: But then, who is this traitor?

fields.EN:
You say it. You're the existence
that possesses the strongest will
to end this story.
fields.JP:
あなたが話すといいわ。
何故なら、あなたが物語を終える意志を
最も強く持つ存在だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You say it. You're the existence
that possesses the strongest will
to end this story.

fields.EN:
Yes. My feelings are the same as
yours, Jack.
fields.JP: ええ。私たちの気持ちは、あなたと一つよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. My feelings are the same as
yours, Jack.

fields.EN: We won't get in your way.
fields.JP: わらわたちは、話の邪魔をしませんから～
fields.LOCALIZED: We won't get in your way.

fields.JP: さっさとカタをつけちゃいなさい！

じゃあ、僕の考えだけど……
『裏切り者』は……
タイヨウ教団の中にいる

fields.EN:
I... didn't want to believe it,
but I think it's someone in the
Dawn.
fields.JP:
考えたくなかったけど……ここにいる
黎明の中の誰かだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... didn't want to believe it,
but I think it's someone in the
Dawn.

fields.EN: You mean one of them here?
fields.JP: 黎明の……この人たちの中の誰かだって？
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean one of them here?

fields.EN:
Yes... Only those in the Dawn knew
about the escape plan and what the
Jail is.
fields.JP:
はい……脱出計画の内容とジェイルの生態を
熟知しているのは、黎明の人たちですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Only those in the Dawn knew
about the escape plan and what the
Jail is.

fields.EN:
It makes sense that someone in the
Dawn would pull the strings to 
manipulate the plan.
fields.JP:
計画を操作するなら、黎明の中にいるのが
一番効率的だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
It makes sense that someone in the
Dawn would pull the strings to 
manipulate the plan.

fields.EN: So then, who is this traitor?
fields.JP: それなら、裏切り者……スナークは、誰？
fields.LOCALIZED: So then, who is this traitor?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: Me?! Where'd you get that from?
fields.LOCALIZED: Me?! Where'd you get that from?

fields.EN:
I didn't want to come to that
conclusion, but...
fields.JP:
僕も……
こんな結論は出したくありませんでした。
……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to come to that
conclusion, but...

fields.EN:
Haru-san, you had our clothes ready
when we first came, right? Even
without knowing us...
fields.JP:
ハルさんは、僕ら新入りが加わった時、
この服を用意してくれましたよね？
それも……すぐに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You had our clothes ready when we
first came, right? Even without
knowing us...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN: Uh, Jack? The hell are you saying?
fields.JP: ジャック。何が言いたいんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, Jack? The hell are you saying?

fields.EN:
It bothered me... It happened with
Alice, and then with Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
どうしても引っかかったんです。
アリスの時……それにラプンツェルの時も
fields.LOCALIZED:
It bothered me... It happened with
Alice, and then with Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
The clothes were also treated with
special defensive functions for
us.
fields.JP:
僕らが黎明に来た次の日の朝に、もう
僕とアリスの服が用意されていました。
しかも、防御機能を持つ特別な服が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The clothes were also treated with
special defensive functions for
us.

fields.EN:
The clothes for Rapunzel matched
her perfectly, despite your claim
that they were Oyayubihime's.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルに至っては、間に合わせとして
用意してくれた服が何もかもぴったりだった。
親指姫の服のスペアだって言ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The clothes for Rapunzel matched
her perfectly, despite your claim
that they were Thumbelina's.

fields.EN:
It was as if you already knew
ahead of time that Rapunzel was
going to join us...
fields.JP:
はじめから……ラプンツェルが来るのが
わかってたみたいに
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was as if you already knew
ahead of time that Rapunzel was
going to join us...

fields.EN: Yup! It was perfect for Rapunzel!
fields.JP: うん。ラプンツェルにぴったりだったー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! It was perfect for Rapunzel!

fields.EN:
That was when I became certain
you were suspicious, Haru-san...
fields.JP:
ハルさんが決定的に怪しいと思ったのは、
その時でした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was when you became my
primary suspect...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
And those huge eyes out there have
something to do with the Dawn's
control room, right?
fields.JP:
独房エリアにある巨大な『眼』……
黎明にあるモニター室と関係があるんじゃ
ないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And those huge eyes out there have
something to do with the Dawn's
control room, right?

fields.JP: お前ら……あれを知ってたのか……

fields.EN:
You can tell what's going on out
there, right? If so, preparing
our clothes would be easy.
fields.JP:
あれを使えば、独房エリアのことが手に取る
ようにわかりますよね？
それなら、あらかじめ服の用意くらい簡単だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can tell what's going on out
there, right? If so, preparing
our clothes would be easy.

fields.EN:
Well, it's just that there are a
lot of things we needed to
prepare...
fields.JP: いや……まあ、大人にゃいろいろあるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's just that there are a
lot of things we needed to
prepare...

fields.EN:
There! Again! You keep trying to
avoid telling us the truth, Haru-san!
fields.JP:
ハルさんは、いつもそうやってはぐらかして
ばかりだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There! Again! You keep trying to
avoid telling us the truth, Haru!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Haru-san, I also heard that, for some reason,
you aren't often targeted by Marchens.
fields.JP:
それに……ハルさんは何故かメルヒェンに
襲われにくいって聞きました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also heard that, for some
reason, you're not often targeted
by Marchens.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
You avoided the conversation then,
too...
fields.JP: どうしてかは、はぐらかされましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You avoided the conversation then,
too...

fields.EN:
Haru-san, is that because you're working
with the Jail?
fields.JP:
それは……ハルさんが、ジェイルと通じているから
なんじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because you're working with
the Jail. Isn't that right?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
During our meetings, Haru-san, I felt like
you were covering for the Professor...
fields.JP:
作戦会議の時……何度かハルさんが
博士を庇ってるような気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
During our meetings, it felt as if
you were covering for the
Professor.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Haru-san, if you were the traitor, why would
you cover for the Professor...?
fields.JP:
……ハルさんが裏切者だったとして……
なんで博士を庇うんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were the traitor, why would
you cover for the Professor?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Fine... Maybe I am this traitor
you're looking for.
fields.JP: ……確かに俺は『裏切者』なのかもしれねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... Maybe I am this traitor
you're looking for.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Well, a traitor to the old man
over there.
fields.JP: ……そこのオッさんにとってはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, a traitor to the old man
over there.

fields.EN:
The reason I knew all about you
was because I've known him for a
long time.
fields.JP:
俺がお前らの情報をあらかじめ知ってたのも
何もかも、そいつとある意味昔のよしみ
だったからだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason I knew all about you
was because I've known him for a
long time.

fields.EN: I also knew the Jail, too.
fields.LOCALIZED: I also knew the Jail, too.

fields.EN:
The Jail?! Who exactly are you,
Haru-san? Professor?
fields.JP:
……ジェイルとも！？
博士やハルさんって、いったい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail?! Who exactly are you,
Haru? Professor?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
We're beings that came from a
different planet.
fields.JP: 俺らはこの星とは別の場所から来た、異物なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're beings that came from a
different planet.

fields.EN:
I've been trying to change the
Professor's mind all this time.
fields.JP:
俺は……最後の最後まで、
博士の考えを変えようと思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been trying to change the
Professor's mind all this time.

fields.EN:
I tried to tell him that we should
live here like everyone else.
fields.JP:
共に、ありのままのこの星で生きないかと、
俺なりに呼びかけてたんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried to tell him that we should
live here like everyone else.

fields.EN:
Professor... You were Blue Bird-san
all along.
fields.JP: 博士……あなたが青い鳥さんだったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're the blue bird then,
Professor.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.
Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Yes... Snark. Boojum. The one who
was controlling me.
fields.JP:
そう……スナーク。ブージャム。
わたしを、操ってたひと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Snark. Boojum. The one who
was controlling me.

fields.EN:
Haru-san... Did you know all along?
That the food Blue Bird-san brings
was safe?
fields.JP:
ハルさん……あなたも知ってたの？
青い鳥さんの運んでくる食べ物が、大丈夫だって
ことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru... Did you know all along?
That the food the blue bird brings
was safe?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ハル => Haru-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 | Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
The food that the Professor fed to
her, so that he could control her
to do his bidding...
fields.JP:
博士が大陽女さんに食べさせてた物さ。
……自分の思い通りに操るためにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The food that the Professor fed to
her, so that he could control her
to do his bidding...

fields.EN:
Don't tell me... He served her
food mimicked by the Jail?
fields.JP: まさか……ジェイルが擬態した食べ物を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me... He served her
food mimicked by the Jail?

fields.EN:
To clarify, the components of the
Jail don't have any adverse
effects to the human brain.
fields.JP:
だが実のところ、ジェイルの成分にこの星の
人間の脳を破壊する効用なんてないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To clarify, the components of the
Jail don't have any adverse
effects to the human brain.

fields.EN:
You only saw the transformations
humans went through when the Jail
landed on this planet.
fields.JP:
ジェイルがこの星に着床した時点での
人間の変化しか、あんたは見てない筈だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You only saw the transformations
humans went through when the Jail
landed on this planet.

fields.EN:
But, things change... I noticed it
when I saw the Order of the Sun's
crops.
fields.JP:
いつのまにか変わっていたのさ……俺は、
タイヨウ教団の畑の作物を見て気づいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, things change... I noticed it
when I saw the Order of the Sun's
crops.

fields.EN:
The Jail was adapting to this
planet's environment.
fields.JP: ……ジェイルは適応を進めてたんだ、この星に
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail was adapting to this
planet's environment.

fields.EN: ...It reduced its toxicity to life on this planet. Now, at worst, it only causes side effects comparable to a tranquilizer with little risk of dependence.
fields.JP:
……この星の生物への毒性を弱めたんだよ。
今じゃせいぜい、依存性の少ない精神安定剤
程度の副作用しかもたらさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It alleviated its negative effect
on the planet's beings. All it can
offer now are calming properties.

fields.EN:
Weird, considering how batty your
Lady Oohime became.
fields.JP:
……大陽女さんがおかしくなってたのが
不思議なくらいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Weird, considering how batty your
Lady Oohime became.

fields.EN:
Now then, maybe it's time we end
all this. End this, ever since you
replaced Professor Tohjima.
fields.JP:
そろそろ、けじめをつける時なんじゃねえのか？
……十島博士に成り代わった頃からの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, maybe it's time we end
all this. End this, ever since you
replaced Professor Tohjima.

fields.EN: What do you mean...? Dad is...
fields.JP:
それ……どういう意味？
もしかして……お父さんは……
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean...? Dad is...

fields.EN:
The Professor who gave you your
red hood died 15 years ago.
fields.JP:
……お前に、赤いフードを最初に
被せてくれた博士は、十五年前に死んだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor who gave you your
red hood died 15 years ago.

fields.EN:
The Professor died then?! So, the
person who killed my mentor
was...?!
fields.JP:
博士が……十五年前の惨劇で……！
では『先生』を殺したのも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor died then?! So, the
person who killed my mentor
was...?!

fields.EN:
You knew this all along?! Why
didn't you tell us earlier?!
fields.JP: あなたはそれを知ってて、どうして……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew this all along?! Why
didn't you tell us earlier?!

fields.EN:
I'm a traitor. I had changed my
outlook on this since that
tragedy.
fields.JP:
……俺は『裏切者』だって言ったろ。
気が変わったきっかけがそれだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a traitor. I had changed my
outlook on this since that
tragedy.

fields.EN:
I doubted his efforts to
reconstruct our planet here, even
at the expense of others' lives.
fields.JP:
言い訳にもなりゃしねえが、そこまでして
滅んだ星を再生させてどうする……って思ってな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubted his efforts to
reconstruct our planet here, even
at the expense of others' lives.

fields.EN:
So then the seeds on Haru-san's
desk...
fields.JP: じゃあ……ハルさんの机にあった、あの種は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So then the seeds on Haru's
desk...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Those are seeds from my planet.
Well, they were just in my pocket,
and I couldn't discard them.
fields.JP:
俺の元いた星の植物の種だ。
たまたまポケットに入ってたんでな……
どうしても捨てられなかったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those are seeds from my planet.
Well, they were just in my pocket,
and I couldn't discard them.

fields.EN:
I know his pain, not being able to
protect our planet... That's why I
wanted him to have redemption.
fields.JP:
……こいつの気持ちは痛いほどわかった。
自分の星を守れなかった無念……
だから……贖罪の機会をやりたかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know his pain, not being able to
protect our planet... That's why I
wanted him to have redemption.

fields.EN:
(So that's what Haru-san meant when
he said it's painful not being
able to protect what you wanted.)
fields.JP:
（ハルさんの言ってた、『護りたいものを
　護れないのは、辛いことだからな』って……
　そういう意味だったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that's what Haru meant when
he said it's painful not being
able to protect what you wanted.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
(That would also explain why he
went out of his way to make the
Mary Gun for me...)
fields.JP:
（だから……あんなに親身になって、
　メアリガンを造ってくれたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That would also explain why he
went out of his way to make the
Mary Gun for me...)

fields.JP: ……スナーク、今からでも考え直さないか？
視子さん……あなたしか考えられません
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...
fields.JP:
僕も……
こんな結論は出したくありませんでした。
……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...

fields.EN:
Miko-san, you knew about me and the
Blood Maidens more than anyone here.
fields.JP:
視子さんは僕ら血式少年や血式少女たちの
体質を誰よりもよく知ってるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew about me and the Blood
Maidens more than anyone here.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
You also assisted with research
on the Marchens and probably even
on the Jail with the Professor.
fields.JP:
博士のメルヒェン研究を手伝ってる。
それだけじゃなく、きっとジェイル全般の
研究にも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also assisted with research
on the Marchens and probably even
on the Jail with the Professor.

fields.EN:
That's because I needed to attend
to the research as a doctor.
fields.JP:
それは……医師として、必ず現場に役立つ
研究内容だからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because I needed to attend
to the research as a doctor.

fields.EN:
But Miko-san, it wouldn't be a stretch
to imagine you'd know how to
communicate with the Jail.
fields.JP:
だから……ジェイルと通じる術も、視子さんなら
持っていても不思議じゃない筈です
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it wouldn't be a stretch to
imagine you'd know how to
communicate with the Jail.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
And in your position, Miko-san, it
wouldn't be unusual to be the one
overseeing that control room...
fields.JP:
それに、視子さんの立場なら、
あのモニター室の主でもおかしくないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And with your position, it
wouldn't be unusual to be the one
overseeing that control room...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Control room? What are you talking
about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Control room? What are you talking
about?

fields.EN:
Stop acting! You should know,
especially with how often you're
there at the laboratory!
fields.JP:
ご、ごまかさないでください！
普段から研究室に出入りしてる人なら、
注意深く見てれば気が付くはずだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop acting! You should know,
especially with how often you're
there at the laboratory!

fields.EN:
If it's because of that, there are
others who'd know, too. What makes
you think it has to be me?
fields.JP:
でも……複数人が気付くようなものだとしたら、
どうして私がそこの主だと断定できるの？
その論拠は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's because of that, there are
others who'd know, too. What makes
you think it has to be me?

fields.EN:
A control room in the
laboratory... I didn't know there
was one there...
fields.JP:
……注意深く見れば気付く筈のモニター室、ね。
そんなものがあったなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
A control room in the
laboratory... I didn't know there
was one there...

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I only know now
because you told me.
fields.JP: でも残念ながら、私は知らないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I only know now
because you told me.

fields.EN:
But I suppose it's my fault as a
researcher for not being keen
enough to observe my environment.
fields.JP:
つい目先の物事に囚われて、広い視野を
持てなかった……研究者としても失格ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I suppose it's my fault as a
researcher for not being keen
enough to observe my environment.

fields.EN:
Now then, if what you said is
true, isn't the Professor also a
suspect to you?
fields.JP:
でもそれを言うなら、あなたが今言ったことは
どれも博士にも当てはまるんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, if what you said is
true, isn't the Professor also a
suspect to you?

fields.EN:
And if I was this "traitor" like
you said, why would you disclose
that in front of everyone?
fields.JP:
そもそも私が『裏切者』だとして……
こんなところにみんなを集めて一体何を
しようとしてるというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if I was this "traitor" like
you said, why would you disclose
that in front of everyone?

fields.EN:
B-But, Miko-san... you didn't report
my blood test results, and you were
always skeptical of the Professor...
fields.JP:
で、でも視子さんは……以前に僕の血を
採血したときも博士に報告してなかったし、
博士の言動に対して、いつも懐疑的で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, you didn't report my blood
test results, and you were always
skeptical of the Professor...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
You also seemed skeptical of our
escape from the Jail...
fields.JP:
ジェイルからの脱出についても、どこか疑いを
持っていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also seemed skeptical of our
escape from the Jail...

fields.EN:
You looked at Michiru-san with doubt,
too...
fields.JP:
ミチルさんのことも、すごく冷ややかに見て
いて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You looked at Michiru with doubt,
too...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
I won't deny any of that. I'm not
the trusting type of person.
fields.JP:
……それは、否定はしないわ。
人を無条件に信じることなんて、私にはできない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't deny any of that. I'm not
the trusting type of person.

fields.EN:
But, that's a normal trait sought
for in researchers.
fields.JP: ……でもそれは、研究者なら当然のことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that's a normal trait sought
for in researchers.

fields.EN:
I understand that you doubt
everyone here, and that in itself
doesn't bother me.
fields.JP:
……あなたたちが全ての人を疑ってみる
姿勢は当然のことよ。
その点で腹を立てたりはしないわ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand that you doubt
everyone here, and that in itself
doesn't bother me.

fields.EN:
What bothers me is that you didn't
think it out well enough. It could
prove life-threatening, you know?
fields.JP: ただ、詰めが甘ければ命取りになるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What bothers me is that you didn't
think it out well enough. It could
prove life-threatening, you know?

fields.EN: I can agree with that, as well.
fields.LOCALIZED: I can agree with that, as well.

fields.EN:
Well then, you should've said
something earlier.
fields.JP: だったら、助け舟出すなりなんなりしなさいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, you should've said
something earlier.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Miko-san. I must have
judged you with what I felt,
without any solid facts.
fields.JP:
……すみません、視子さん。
僕は、あなたから受ける感じで、むりやり決め
つけていたのかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Miko. I must have
judged you with what I felt,
without any solid facts.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
And what exactly did you feel
about me?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And what exactly did you feel
about me?

fields.EN:
Maybe he interpreted your
indifferent attitude as a form of
silent aggression toward us.
fields.JP:
視子の冷淡さを、私たちに対する潜在的な敵意だと
感じていた、ということじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe he interpreted your
indifferent attitude as a form of
silent aggression toward us.

fields.EN:
I'm not used to talking about
myself, but...
fields.JP:
……個人的なことを話すのは、あまり慣れて
いないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not used to talking about
myself, but...

fields.EN:
Fifteen years ago, I lost my
mentor, Dr. Ueshima. I saw her as
a mother, and was inspired by her.
fields.JP:
私は……十五年前に亡くなった『先生』……
上島先生のことを、それこそ母のように慕っていた。
その博愛精神に強く心を打たれてもいたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fifteen years ago, I lost my
mentor, Dr. Ueshima. I saw her as
a mother, and was inspired by her.

fields.EN:
I sought to be like her, but I
must have mistaken her ways...
fields.JP:
彼女のようになりたいと願っていたけど……
間違えてしまったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sought to be like her, but I
must have mistaken her ways...

fields.EN:
I assumed I needed to see everyone
objectively so that I could treat
them with fairness.
fields.JP:
彼女のように全ての人と等しく向き合うには、
……他人と等しく距離を置かねばならないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assumed I needed to see everyone
objectively so that I could treat
them with fairness.

fields.EN:
I suppose Dr. Ueshima was
just equally kind to everyone...
fields.JP:
上島先生は、
誰に対しても温かな人だったのにね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose Dr. Ueshima was
just equally kind to everyone...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
To be honest, I've been observing
you with interest, Miko.
fields.JP:
視子。正直なところ、あなたのことは興味深く
観察させてもらっていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, I've been observing
you with interest, Miko.

fields.EN:
You try to act in logic, when you
are really an emotional person. It
explains many of your actions.
fields.JP:
論理的に振舞おうとしていながら、実は感情的。
だから、行動に矛盾も多い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You try to act in logic, when you
are really an emotional person. It
explains many of your actions.

fields.EN:
I'm guessing that made Jack
suspect you.
fields.JP:
なによりその点が、ジャックに疑念を抱かせたん
じゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing that made Jack
suspect you.

fields.EN:
I suppose. I have to admit that I
despised any and all things that
went against reason.
fields.JP:
……そうね。それは否めないわね。
理性に逆らうものを無条件で嫌悪してきたと、
そう認めるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. I have to admit that I
despised any and all things that
went against reason.

fields.EN:
I noticed something odd with the
Professor's approach toward
humanity while I worked with him.
fields.JP:
私は……博士と関わる中で、彼の人道性への
ある種の鈍感さに気づいたわ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I noticed something odd with the
Professor's approach toward
humanity while I worked with him.

fields.EN:
I assumed it was simply his nature
as a researcher. No... I tried to
assume that was it.
fields.JP:
……でもそれは、私にもある研究者特有のものだと
思っていた……ううん、思い込もうとしていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assumed it was simply his nature
as a researcher. No... I tried to
assume that was it.

fields.EN:
The same way I doubted the Order.
I was suspicious of Michiru for
reasons I couldn't place.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団への疑念も同じ……
ミチルという個人を見ようとはせずに、
その背後に何らかの黒幕がいるのだと疑っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The same way I doubted the Order.
I was suspicious of Michiru for
reasons I couldn't place.

fields.EN:
Like Gretel said, I probably
didn't want to acknowledge the
illogical aspects of my thinking.
fields.JP:
きっと……グレーテルが看破した通り、
自分の理性的ではない部分を直視したくなかった
のね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like Gretel said, I probably
didn't want to acknowledge the
illogical aspects of my thinking.

fields.EN:
Um... Miko-san, why didn't you disclose
your doubts with everyone earlier?
fields.JP:
あの……視子さんはどうして、
自分の持つ疑いを誰にも言わなかったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Why didn't you disclose your
doubts with everyone earlier?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
...As a researcher, I was curious
to see the results of the Jail's
growth.
fields.JP:
ジェイルが成長した結果をこの目で確認したい
という、研究者としての興味があったのは事実よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...As a researcher, I was curious
to see the results of the Jail's
growth.

fields.EN: ...But the truth is, until we found out what the target of our suspicions was after and reached a definitive answer, there was nothing we could do...
fields.JP:
……でも本当は、
疑念の対象の目的を探り、決定的な回答を
出すまで何も打つ手が無い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I allowed myself to have these
doubts without looking for an
answer to them.

fields.EN:
Or rather, I found reasons to not
take action.
fields.JP: 手を打つべきではないと考えていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or rather, I found reasons to not
take action.

fields.EN:
As someone picking up where
Dr. Ueshima left off, I wanted to
fulfill her wishes.
fields.JP:
私は……上島先生を継ぐ人間として、あの時
亡くなった人たちの悲願を叶えたかった。
fields.LOCALIZED:
As someone picking up where
Dr. Ueshima left off, I wanted to
fulfill her wishes.

fields.EN:
But being too careful prevented me
from acting on my doubts...
fields.JP:
でも慎重を期するあまり、疑念に対する行動に
踏み切れなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But being too careful prevented me
from acting on my doubts...

fields.EN: ...Deep down, I hated death itself for taking Ueshima-sensei and the others... and I was afraid I'd be consumed by those feelings...
fields.JP:
……きっと私の中では、上島先生たちを奪った
死をとても憎んでいて……そんな自分の感情に
呑まれるのを怖れていたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Deep down, I wanted to hate the
Doctor's murderer. But I feared
being consumed by such emotions.

fields.EN:
That's probably why I kept turning
a blind eye, even though I wanted
to see what was going on.
fields.JP:
だから、全てをこの目で見ようとしていながら、
目を背けていたんだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's probably why I kept turning
a blind eye, even though I wanted
to see what was going on.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
I suppose now is the time for me
to take action...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose now is the time for me
to take action...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: それは……どういう意味かね？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
You may not know, but I have a
picture...
fields.JP:
あなたは知らないでしょうけど、
私は……一枚の写真を持っているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not know, but I have a
picture...

fields.EN:
When I was a child, I begged to
get a picture of Dr. Ueshima.
fields.JP:
子供の頃、上島先生の写真がどうしても
欲しくて、無理に頼み込んでもらったものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I was a child, I begged to
get a picture of Dr. Ueshima.

fields.EN:
The picture is a picture of the
Dawn's primary members 15 years
ago.
fields.JP:
それは、古ぼけた記念写真。
十五年前、黎明幹部で撮った……ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The picture is a picture of the
Dawn's primary members 15 years
ago.

fields.EN:
I didn't know you had something
like that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you had something
like that...

fields.EN:
In there is a picture of the
Doctor, Mother, chief, leader, and...
one other I didn't know...
fields.JP:
写っているのは、
『先生』『お母さん』『棟梁』『隊長』
……そして、私の知らない男性が一人。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In there is a picture of the
Doctor, Mother, chief, leader, and...
one other I didn't know...

fields.EN:
I've never met that person before,
but I believe that was Professor
Tohjima.
fields.JP:
私は会ったことがなかったけれど……
恐らくそれが……十島博士
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never met that person before,
but I believe that was Professor
Tohjima.

fields.EN:
If so, you don't look like the
person in the picture.
fields.JP: でもその姿は、あなたではなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, you don't look like the
person in the picture.

fields.EN:
I've kept that thought to myself,
and never said a word...
fields.JP:
ずっと……心に抱えていたけど……
口には出せなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've kept that thought to myself,
and never said a word...

fields.EN:
I'm glad you had the intelligence
to stay silent, Miko-kun.
fields.JP:
君が沈黙するだけの知性の持ち主で良かったよ。
視子くん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you had the intelligence
to stay silent, Miko.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
If you replaced the Professor 15
years ago, then you must have been
the one who killed Dr. Ueshima.
fields.JP:
十五年前の惨劇であなたが博士と成り代わった
のだとしたら……上島先生を殺したのは、
あなたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you replaced the Professor 15
years ago, then you must have been
the one who killed Dr. Ueshima.

fields.EN:
If only I had the courage to kill
you...
fields.JP:
私に……
あなたを殺すだけの勇気があったなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I had the courage to kill
you...

fields.EN:
How troublesome to have logic
exercise control over your
emotions.
fields.JP: 理性という名の感情とは、厄介なものだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How troublesome to have logic
exercise control over your
emotions.

fields.EN:
Still, your intelligence is
beneficial to us. But I couldn't
care less what your plans are.
fields.JP:
それでも……あなたの頭脳は有益なものよ。
何を目論んでいるのかはどうでもいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, your intelligence is
beneficial to us. But I couldn't
care less what your plans are.

fields.EN:
If you're willing to change your
ways and head down the right
path, then...
fields.JP: ……今からでもそれを、正しい方向に活かすなら
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're willing to change your
ways and head down the right
path, then...

fields.EN:
I wonder what the right path truly
is...
fields.JP: ……正しい方向とは、何だろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what the right path truly
is...

fields.EN:
...The Order of the Sun. I believe
it's either Michiru-san or Chiaki-san.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ教団……ミチルさんか千昭さん
なんじゃないかと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
...The Order of the Sun. I believe
it's either Michiru or Chiaki.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN:
You're accusing us for being
traitors? What brings you to that
thought?
fields.JP:
僕らが……裏切者だというのかい？
いったい、何故……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're accusing us for being
traitors? What brings you to that
thought?

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...
fields.JP:
僕も……
こんな結論は出したくありませんでした。
……でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe it,
but...

fields.EN:
Why did you create the Order of
the Sun, Michiru-san?
fields.JP:
ミチルさんは、なぜタイヨウ教団を
作ったんでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you create the Order of
the Sun, Michiru?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
Why did you try to expand your
missions out to the different
areas?
fields.JP:
なぜ独房エリアに行って布教してまで、
信者を増やそうとしていたんでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you try to expand your
missions out to the different
areas?

fields.EN:
That's to bring salvation by the
sun to...
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's to bring salvation by the
sun to...

fields.EN:
Didn't you have a separate motive
for wanting to expand the Order of
the Sun?
fields.JP:
本当は何か別の目的があって、そのために
教団を大きくしたんじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't you have a separate motive
for wanting to expand the Order of
the Sun?

fields.EN:
The very believers of which are
currently in this tower.
fields.JP: そして信者の人たちは今、この塔にいる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The very believers of which are
currently in this tower.

fields.EN:
Chiaki-san, I also believe you would
do anything to help Michiru-san.
fields.JP:
それに、千昭さんは……ミチルさんを助ける
ためなら、きっと何でもする人だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chiaki, I also believe you would
do anything to help Michiru.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN:
Even if it meant standing up
against every other person in the
world...
fields.JP:
たとえ……それが人類全てを敵に回すことで
あっても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if it meant standing up
against every other person in the
world...

fields.EN:
I won't deny that. But, there's no
way to save my sister.
fields.JP:
……それは否定しないよ。
でも、姉を救う術などないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't deny that. But, there's no
way to save my sister.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN:
Chiaki. I'm fine. You don't need
to save me.
fields.JP:
千昭。もう大丈夫。
救う必要なんてなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chiaki. I'm fine. You don't need
to save me.

fields.EN:
I'm still the same sister you knew
before. Of course, I didn't notice
it myself, either.
fields.JP:
わたし、ずっとあなたが知ってるわたしの
ままだったの。
自分でも気づかなかったけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still the same sister you knew
before. Of course, I didn't notice
it myself, either.

fields.EN:
I caught Blue Bird-san. I don't
need mimicry any more.
fields.JP:
青い鳥さんは捕まえたもの。
もう、擬態はいらないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I caught the blue bird. I don't
need mimicry any more.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.JP:
擬態……ですって？
どういうこと……？

fields.EN: What were once a boy and a girl. The Jail's seed swallowed them both and gave shape to the girl's feelings...
fields.JP:
かつて少年と少女であったもの。
ジェイルの種は二人を呑み込み、
少女の想いを形造った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's seed consumed what was
once a boy and a girl, and granted
the girl her desires.

fields.EN: A yearning for the sun. An affirmation of the world. And the strong desire to remain older sister and younger brother...
fields.JP:
陽を乞い願う想い。世界への肯定。
そして姉と弟であり続けようとする
強い想い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She sought the sun. The world.
For the boy and the girl to be
siblings forever.

fields.JP: わたしたち……あの時に死んでいたのね

fields.EN:
The Jail's seed revived me, and
you as well, along with my desire.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの種がわたしを蘇らせたの。
そして、わたしの想いに引っ張られて、
あなたも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's seed revived me, and
you as well, along with my desire.

fields.EN:
Michiru-san... are you saying you and the
others were made to mimic the Jail and revived
as reincarnations...?
fields.JP:
ミチルさんたちは……ジェイルに擬態
させられて転生体として蘇ったって……
……そういうことなんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling us that both of
you were mimicked and revived by
the Jail in reincarnated forms?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN: This is a story of the beginning.
fields.LOCALIZED: This is a story of the beginning.

fields.EN:
The seed fell onto the storybook
I was reading, and rooted itself,
creating from it the new world.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの種は、
わたしが読んでた絵本の上に落ちて、
……そしてこの世界に根付いたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The seed fell onto the storybook
I was reading, and rooted itself,
creating from it the new world.

fields.EN:
The place where all ends and all
begins. Everyone in the preschool
died with us.
fields.JP:
全てが終わり、全てが始まった場所……
幼稚園にいた人たちは、わたしたちも含めて
その時に死んでしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place where all ends and all
begins. Everyone in the preschool
died with us.

fields.EN:
I am who I was back then, and also
the dreams of all of the children.
fields.JP:
今のわたしは、かつてわたしだったものと、
そこにいた子供たちの夢みたいなもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am who I was back then, and also
the dreams of all of the children.

fields.EN:
And, I was probably the first to
revive. Which is why I was special
to you...
fields.JP:
そして多分、最初に蘇った存在……
だからあなたにとって、特別だったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I was probably the first to
revive. Which is why I was special
to you...

fields.EN:
Isn't that right, Blue Bird-san? No...
Professor?
fields.JP: そうでしょ、青い鳥さん……いいえ、博士
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't that right, blue bird? No...
Professor?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
What are you talking about, Lady
Oohime?
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about, Lady
Oohime?

fields.EN:
It seemed easier to act as if I
lost my sanity.
fields.JP: わたし、おかしくなってたふりをしてたみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seemed easier to act as if I
lost my sanity.

fields.JP: おかしくなってた、ふり……？

fields.EN:
To mimic the expectations Blue
Bird-san had for me.
fields.JP:
青い鳥さんの期待する想いを受けて……
自分でも気づかないうちに擬態してたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To mimic the expectations the blue
bird had for me.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
As for the food you gave me... It
had no effect.
fields.JP:
あなたのくれた食べ物には……
なんの効果もなかったのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for the food you gave me... It
had no effect.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Chiaki. I keep bringing
you pain.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、千昭。
わたし、あなたを苦しめてばかりだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Chiaki. I keep bringing
you pain.

fields.EN:
That's not true, Sister... I was
able to do all I've done because
of you.
fields.JP:
姉さん……そんなことないよ。
姉さんがいたから、僕は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true, Sister... I was
able to do all I've done because
of you.

fields.EN:
Professor? The place Chii made
wasn't made for you.
fields.JP:
博士……ちーちゃんが作ってくれたあの場所は、
あなたのための場所じゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? The place Chii made
wasn't made for you.

fields.EN:
It was made for the people who
want to see the sun.
fields.JP: お日様に会いたい人たちのための場所……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was made for the people who
want to see the sun.

fields.EN:
So, can you return them? Return
to me my precious people who
were there?
fields.JP:
だから……返して。
あの場所にいた、わたしの大事な人たちを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, can you return them? Return
to me my precious people who
were there?

fields.EN:
You said earlier that you caught
the blue bird.
fields.JP: ……君は先ほど、青い鳥を捕まえたといったが
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said earlier that you caught
the blue bird.

fields.EN:
But you have to remember that
you can't say so without first
putting it in its cage.
fields.JP: 鳥は籠に入れるまで、捕まえたとは言わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you have to remember that
you can't say so without first
putting it in its cage.

fields.EN:
...Like I wasted precious time
over all of your prattle.
fields.JP:
無駄話をしている間に、貴重な時間も失われた
ようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Like I wasted precious time
over all of your prattle.

fields.EN:
Your assumptions weren't correct,
but you still arrived at the
truth.
fields.JP:
君たちの推測は正しくなかったが……
結果的に真実には辿り着いた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your assumptions weren't correct,
but you still arrived at the
truth.

fields.EN:
Regardless, our old story ends
here.
fields.JP: しかし、古い物語はここまでなのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, our old story ends
here.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Old stories must be discarded to
bring about the new.
fields.JP: 新たな物語のためには、古い物語は不要なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Old stories must be discarded to
bring about the new.

fields.JP: これは……連れてこられた信者たちの……！？

fields.EN:
Sister! They must be somewhere on
this floor!
fields.JP: このフロアのどこかだ！　姉さん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister! They must be somewhere on
this floor!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN:
I'll go after them! You keep your
eyes on the Professor!
fields.JP: 俺が追う！　お前らは博士の方を頼む！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll go after them! You keep your
eyes on the Professor!

fields.EN:
Such a commotion... Nothing can
stop me now.
fields.JP:
やれやれ、せわしないことだ。
もう手遅れだというのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Such a commotion... Nothing can
stop me now.

fields.JP: 博士……あなた、何をする気なの！？

fields.EN:
"Planning?" No. My work here is
done.
fields.JP: するのではない、したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Planning?" No. My work here is
done.

fields.EN:
All I need to do now is greet the
beginning of the new story.
fields.JP:
後は、迎えるだけだ。
新しい物語の始まりをね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I need to do now is greet the
beginning of the new story.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.
fields.JP: さて。用済みの玩具には退場願おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.

fields.EN:
Oh? A gun that actually works...
Everyone, be careful...
fields.JP:
あら、使える銃なんてあったのね。
……みんな、気をつけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? A gun that actually works...
Everyone, be careful...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.
fields.JP:
なに、このままじっとしていてくれれば何も
しないよ。面倒だからね。
何なら塔を降りてくれても構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark!
fields.JP:
……みんな。
博士を……スナークを追おう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark!

fields.EN:
I feel like the Professor... Snark
is past this portal.
fields.JP: たぶん、この扉の先に博士……スナークがいる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like the Professor... Snark
is past this portal.

fields.EN: So, this is the last battle...
fields.JP: これが、最後の戦いなのね
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is the last battle...

fields.EN:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?
fields.JP:
この扉を開けたら、もう後戻りはできないわ。
ジャック、準備はいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?

fields.EN:
Well, I suggest you prepare
yourself, then.
fields.JP: それなら、準備をすませてくるといいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suggest you prepare
yourself, then.

fields.JP: ジャック、どこへ行くの？

fields.EN:
We should head after the Professor
and leave the followers to Haru
and Miko.
fields.JP:
信者のことはハルと視子に任せて、
私たちは博士を追うべきだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should head after the Professor
and leave the followers to Haru
and Miko.

fields.EN:
Yeah, you're right... Okay! Let's
go after the Professor!
fields.JP:
そうか、そうだね。
……よし、博士を追おう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you're right... Okay! Let's
go after the Professor!

fields.JP: それは……博士だと思います

fields.EN: Do you think so too, Akazukin?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん。君もそう思うのかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think so too, Red Riding
Hood?

fields.EN:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?
fields.JP:
……さて、君たちが私を疑う理由を聞かせて
もらえるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?

fields.EN:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.
fields.JP:
それは、作戦があまりに博士の計画通りに
進みすぎたからです。
あたかも、何が起こるかを知っていたように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.

fields.EN:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.
fields.JP:
……ほう？
周到な調査が実を結んだのであれば、
それはむしろ喜ばしいことだと思うが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.

fields.EN:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.
fields.JP:
それに、ジェイルはいま……とても悦んでます。
僕らに核を破壊されたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.

fields.EN:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?
fields.JP:
まるで、計画通りに成長することが、
嬉しいみたいに。
……そんな偶然って、あるんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Thinking is more important than
actual evaluation. Now then, let's
think this out a moment, shall we?
fields.JP:
考察を検証することも必要ということだ。
では、今の疑念を逆説的に考えてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking is more important than
actual evaluation. Now then, let's
think this out a moment, shall we?

fields.EN:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.
fields.JP:
脱出計画はジェイルの生態を利用したものだ。
ジェイルの本能に沿っていた方が計画が
円滑に進む…………どうかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.

fields.EN:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?
fields.JP:
ジェイルの生態が先にあり、それを最大限
活用する形で計画が立案されたと考えれば、
特に違和感はないと思うが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?

fields.EN:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?
fields.JP:
じ、じゃあ博士は、核を壊すとジェイルが
悦ぶって知ってたってことですよね。
……どうして知ってるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?

fields.EN:
After long hours of research, not
to mention the additional
discoveries that were reported.
fields.JP:
これまでの研究の蓄積によるものだよ。
無論、君たちのおかげでわかったことも
随時脱出計画に反映している
fields.LOCALIZED:
After long hours of research, not
to mention the additional
discoveries that were reported.

fields.EN:
But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.
fields.JP:
でも、黎明が『知っている』ことと
『知らない』こと、その境目が不自然過ぎるわ。
……恣意的ですらあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.

fields.EN: For example, the 'core'... Especially with a creature we'd never seen before, I don't think that could be known from hypotheses alone.
fields.JP:
たとえば『核』のこと……初めて見る生物なら
なおさら、仮説だけで知ることができるとは
思えないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, determining an
accurate theory about the cores'
function shortly after hearing it.

fields.EN:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.
fields.JP:
そうね。これまで人類が蓄積してきた生物相の
知識に沿ったものであるならともかく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.

fields.EN:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?
fields.JP:
……それは、黎明全体に対する疑念であって、
私個人に対するものではないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?

fields.EN:
Yes. In that sense, Miko and the
others are at fault for keeping
silent about their doubts.
fields.JP:
ええ。その点は視子たちの怠慢を責めるべきね。
あなた個人の疑念となるべき内容を黙認して
いたのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. In that sense, Miko and the
others are at fault for keeping
silent about their doubts.

fields.EN:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?
fields.JP: それとも……視子やハルも共犯なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?

fields.EN:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko-san
and Haru-san seemed to be hiding
something from us...)
fields.JP:
（共犯……確かに、視子さんやハルさんには、
　何かを隠しているような感じを受けてた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko
and Haru seemed to be hiding
something from us...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san; ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
共犯と疑われても仕方ないのかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.
fields.JP:
十島博士は、十五年前の惨劇を唯一生き延びた
ジェイルの権威……その見識を信じたい気持ちも
あったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.

fields.EN:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.
fields.JP:
何より、計画が成功したらジェイルに何が
起きるのかを知りたかった……
研究者としての好奇心ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.

fields.EN:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.
fields.JP:
それだけのために、ずっと見て見ぬ振りをしてた
んですか～？
わらわ以上の怠慢ぶりですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.

fields.EN:
I suppose. It would be difficult
to use logic in my defense when I
had acted based on trust...
fields.JP:
……そうね。
博士を信じたい気持ちと疑念を黙認する気持ち。
どちらも理性とは程遠い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. It would be difficult
to use logic in my defense when I
had acted based on trust...

fields.EN:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.
fields.JP: 研究者として失格だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.

fields.EN:
Miko-kun, it doesn't concern me that
you had your doubts while working
with me here.
fields.JP:
視子くん。君がどういう思惑で研究に携わって
いたとしても、私は構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, it doesn't concern me that
you had your doubts while working
with me here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの実態を追求するために
力を貸してくれていた同志であることに、
変わりはないのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.

fields.EN:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru-kun. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
そしてハルくん。それは君もだ。
君は私と同様に、ジェイルの成長を待望して
くれていた……そうだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.
fields.JP:
……違う。
俺は……あんたを止めようと、ずっと
あがいてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.

fields.EN:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.
fields.JP:
おや……そうだったのかね？
てっきり、私と想いを同じくしてくれている
同志だと思っていたのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.

fields.JP: それはいささか残念な話だね。

fields.EN:
Haru-kun, would calling you a "traitor" to me
be too much of an exaggeration...? Of course,
I'm joking.
fields.JP:
ハルくんが、私にとっての
『裏切り者』だと言ったら……少し大げさかな？
……無論、冗談ではあるがね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would calling you a traitor be too
much of an exaggeration...? I'm
joking, of course...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう……
　このままじゃ、博士を追い詰められない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)

fields.EN:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?
fields.JP:
話が逸れてしまったが……私に対する疑いは、
以上かね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?

fields.EN:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……！
　以前、独房エリアで拾ったメモに違和感を
　感じたことがあったはず）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)

fields.EN:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?
fields.JP:
僕らが見つけたあの不思議なメモ……
それを書いたのは博士でした
fields.LOCALIZED:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?

fields.EN: But, you kept that a secret.
fields.JP: でも、あなたはそれを僕らに隠していた
fields.LOCALIZED: But, you kept that a secret.

fields.EN:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.
fields.JP:
あの時も言ったが、隠していたわけではないよ。
私が忘れていたということで決着がついたと
記憶しているが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.

fields.EN:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)

fields.EN: That memo was referring to Akazukin-san, wasn't it?
fields.JP: これ……赤ずきんさんのことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That memo was referring to Red
Riding Hood, wasn't it?
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: "The first child was found here. According to the captain, despite being just a baby, she defeated a Marchen with her bare hands and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
　によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
　メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...
fields.JP:
う……うん。あたし、確かにお父さんから
そう聞いたんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...

fields.EN:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.
fields.JP:
『発見した時、メルヒェンを前にしても笑ってた、
　勇敢な赤ん坊だったよ』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.

fields.EN:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
『元駅構内エリア』で見つけたメモの内容は、
赤ずきんさんが博士から聞いていた内容と
食い違ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
The memo said that the leader found
Akazukin-san, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.
fields.JP:
『隊長』が見つけた赤ずきんさんのことを、
さも自分が見つけたかのように伝えていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo said that the leader
found her, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(If he wasn't there when Akazukin-san was found, why would
he say that he was...?)
fields.JP:
（……でも、赤ずきんさんを見つけた時に
　その場にいなかったのなら、なんで自分が
　見つけたなんて言ったんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If he wasn't there when Red
Riding Hood was found, why would
he say that he was...?)
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)
fields.JP:
（確か博士は、記憶違いだったって言い訳してた
　けど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)

fields.EN: (His memory was wrong, so he thought he'd found her himself... and he'd forgotten there was a memo recording the truth.)
fields.JP:
（記憶違いで自分が見つけたと思ってて、
　その真実が書かれたメモの存在を忘れてた）

fields.EN:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)
fields.JP:
（本当にそんなことがあるのかな……？
　二つのアクシデントが重なるなんて、
　偶然にしてはできすぎてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Jack-kun? You've
been pretty quiet.
fields.JP:
どうしたね、ジャックくん。
急に黙ってしまったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Jack? You've
been pretty quiet.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.
fields.JP:
これも繰り返しになるが、
その件は私の記憶違いだったのだよ。
疑念を抱かせてしまったのは申し訳ないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.

fields.EN:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)
fields.JP:
（どうすれば……一体どうすれば、
　この違和感を立証できるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)

fields.EN:
Isn't this enough, Jack-kun? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん……もう充分ではないかね？
こんなところで無駄な時間を使っている暇は、
私にはないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't this enough, Jack? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: Later, take your time and think it through by yourself, following my advice. That should clear up most of your doubts.
fields.JP:
後でゆっくり、私のアドバイスに沿って
一人で考えてみるといい。
それで大体の疑念が解消されるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think about my earlier advice. I'm
sure that will clear any doubts
you may have toward me.

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)
fields.JP:
（そうか……！
　たった一つだけ、このアクシデントが
　偶然じゃなくなるケースがある……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)

fields.JP: 博士、あなたは……本当は誰ですか？

fields.EN:
What if my doubts about the memo
were true?
fields.JP:
あなたのアドバイスを元に考えてみたんです。
メモに対する疑念が、逆にどれも『真実』だと
したらって
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if my doubts about the memo
were true?

fields.EN:
You did find Akazukin-san with
the leader.
fields.JP:
……あなたは『隊長』と一緒に、
赤ずきんさんを見つけていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did find Red Riding Hood with
the leader.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.
fields.JP:
そして、博士がメモを残していたことを
知らなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.

fields.EN:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.
fields.JP:
答えは一つです。
あなたは、博士ではない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.

fields.EN:
You were someone else in the party
when Akazukin-san was found.
fields.JP:
そして、赤ずきんさんが発見された時の
調査に同行していた誰かだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were someone else in the party
when Red Riding Hood was found.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Tohjima?
fields.JP:
それでは聞こう。
どうやって、私が十島でないことを立証する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Tohjima?

fields.EN:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)
fields.JP:
（博士が偽者であることを立証できる何か。
　僕は、それを提示できるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)

fields.EN:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ある！
　今の博士と、本物の博士を比較できるものが
　僕の持ち物の中に……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)

fields.EN:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...
fields.JP:
それにしても……こんなもの独房エリアに
落ちてるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...

fields.EN: I wonder who wrote this memo...
fields.JP: このメモ、いったい誰が書いたのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder who wrote this memo...

fields.EN:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.
fields.JP:
かなり綺麗な字だよね……！
あたし、そんなに字がうまくないから
……ちょっとうらやましいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.

fields.EN:
From the looks of it, it seems
like the person who wrote it was
very studious.
fields.JP:
ええ。筆跡を見る限り、ずいぶんと几帳面な
人が書いたように思えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the looks of it, it seems
like the person who wrote it was
very studious.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.JP:
そんなものを私に突きつけて、
一体どうしようと言うんだね？

え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……

fields.EN:
I haven't been this disappointed
in you, Jack.
fields.JP: ジャック……あなたにはガッカリしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't been this disappointed
in you, Jack.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.EN:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!
fields.JP:
それは、博士が書いてくれた
ホオノキの葉のメモ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!

fields.EN:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.
fields.JP: そんなものがあったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.

fields.EN:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)
fields.JP:
（そう。これは唯一、今の博士が書いた
　ものなんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)

fields.EN:
