Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.
fields.JP: ええ。こういう形状の葉を付けるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.

fields.EN:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.
fields.JP:
まあ……
葉の形状が外の世界にあるホオノキに似てるから
黎明でそう呼んでるだけなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.

fields.EN:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...
fields.JP:
これ……お父さんが書いたやつだね！
相変わらず字がへたくそだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...

fields.EN:
Compare this with the memo about Akazukin-san. You can clearly tell
that the handwriting is different.
fields.JP:
これと、赤ずきんさんのことが書かれたメモ……
比べれば、明らかに筆跡が違うことがわかります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can clearly tell that your
memo and what we found are
different.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Tohjima!
fields.JP:
これが、あなたが十島博士ではないことの
証拠です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Tohjima!

fields.EN:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?
fields.JP:
なかなかの名推理だが……
証拠としては弱いのではないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?

fields.EN:
I was hurt badly in the tragedy 15
years ago. Miko-kun cared for me, so
she would remember my wounds.
fields.JP:
私は、十五年前の惨劇で大怪我を負ってね。
治療してくれた視子くんは知っているが、
顔にあるのもその時の傷だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hurt badly in the tragedy 15
years ago. Miko cared for me, so
she would remember my wounds.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...
fields.JP: え、ええ……それは確かにそうだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...

fields.EN:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.
fields.JP:
これまで皆には黙っていたのだが……
その時の後遺症で、私の右手は若干不自由でね。
以前のようには動かないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.

fields.EN:
That's the reason my handwriting
looks different. I only didn't
want to bring up my past injuries.
fields.JP:
筆跡が違うように見えるのはそのせいだろう。
保身のために過去の失態を自ら語るなど、
恥ずべきことかもしれんがね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the reason my handwriting
looks different. I only didn't
want to bring up my past injuries.

fields.EN:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack-kun?
fields.JP: ジャックくん……わかってくれたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)
fields.JP:
（どんなに追求しても、
　あの手この手でかわされる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)

fields.EN:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)

fields.EN:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.
fields.JP:
まだよ、ジャック。
あなたはもう一つ武器を持っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.

fields.EN:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.
fields.JP:
思い出して。なぜ黎明に裏切り者がいると
思ったのか……私との会話を……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.

fields.EN:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)

fields.EN:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?
fields.JP:
他のエリアには必ずあった『眼』が、
あの場所にはなかったことが関係あるとは
思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?

fields.EN:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.
fields.JP:
もう一つ言えば……あの場所には、
ずっと誰も入ってこれなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.
fields.JP:
黎明の誰かがジェイルと通じていて、
ジェイルの中や私たちのことを監視している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.

fields.EN: Has that ever occurred to you?
fields.JP: ……そうは思ってみたことはない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Has that ever occurred to you?

fields.EN:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)
fields.JP: （あの時は意識してなかったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルは、あの『眼』を監視と結びつけて
　考えていた……そう考えれば……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)

fields.EN:
Professor? Do you know what those
"eyes" in the different areas are
for?
fields.JP:
博士……独房エリアにある巨大な『眼』……
あれがなんだか知っていますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? Do you know what those
"eyes" in the different areas are
for?

fields.EN:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)
fields.JP:
（多分あの『眼』は、ある場所に大きく
　関係してるはず……その場所は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『僕の部屋』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack-kun, I'm very
disappointed in you.
fields.JP:
私にはそうは思えないが？
……ジャックくん、これ以上失望させないで
くれたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack, I'm very
disappointed in you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP:
え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……
ジャック……あなたを信じてたのに……

fields.EN:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.
fields.JP:
……博士。
僕とアリスは以前、研究室の奥で不思議な
部屋を見つけました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.

fields.EN:
The room showed screens of various
areas. I believe those images were
captured through the eyes.
fields.JP:
独房エリアのあちこちが映ってる部屋です。
それは恐らく、独房エリアの壁にある
『眼』から見えるものを映していた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The room showed screens of various
areas. I believe those images were
captured through the eyes.

fields.EN:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!
fields.JP: あなたは、あの部屋で全てを見ていたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!

fields.JP:
あの、この間…ナイトメアが、
喋ったことについてなんですが……

fields.EN:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.
fields.JP:
ああ……その件なのだがね……
それは驚いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.

fields.EN:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.
fields.JP:
よかった……
ちゃんとくららが伝えてくれたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.

fields.EN:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?
fields.JP:
何だ、くららがどうかしたのか？
……視子、知ってるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?

fields.EN:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Akazukin-san
told them...)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　くららじゃなかったのか。
　じゃあ、赤ずきんさんあたりかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Red Riding Hood
told them...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
You knew about the Nightmare
before we even reported it to you.
fields.JP:
あなたは、ナイトメアが喋ったことを
僕らが報告していないのに知っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew about the Nightmare
before we even reported it to you.

fields.EN: ...Marchens born from the mimicry of pregnant humans carried children in their wombs who remained human.
fields.JP:
……人間の妊婦が擬態させられた
ことで生まれたメルヒェンは、胎内に
人間のままの子を宿していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that Marchens created
by the Jail's mimicry of pregnant
humans doesn't affect the infant.

fields.EN:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.
fields.JP:
つまり、いくらジェイルでも胎内の子まで
擬態させることは不可能だったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.

fields.EN:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.
fields.JP:
そのメルヒェンたちは、そのまま胎内で
子を育て……胎を破って生まれてきた
子たちは、人間には無い能力を備えていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.

fields.EN:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.
fields.JP:
そして逆に、僕らが血式少女の出生の秘密を
知った時には、タイミングよく博士から
話があった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.

fields.EN:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguyahime spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!
fields.JP:
それは……黎明の外で、僕らがかぐや姫から
秘密を聞いたことを知らなかったからだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguya spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!

fields.EN:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……あの時はなぜあのタイミングで
　博士が喋ったのかわからなかったけど、
　今ならわかる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)

fields.EN:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.
fields.JP:
独房エリアでラプンツェルの話から
僕らが秘密に気づけば、それをあえて
黙っていた博士に疑念が向く
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.

fields.EN:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?
fields.JP:
あなたはそれを恐れた。
違いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?

fields.EN:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.
fields.JP:
なるほど……
見事な考察だ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.

fields.EN:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.
fields.JP:
あの『眼』は、ジェイルの調査をする者の
安全を期すために設置したものだとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.

fields.EN:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.
fields.JP:
かつての調査隊が、各独房エリアの調査を
進めると共に、あの『眼』を設置したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.

fields.EN:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.
fields.JP:
一見、筋が通っているように聞こえるわね。
私の家には、確かにあの『眼』はなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.

fields.EN:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.
fields.JP: 黎明が調査を断念した……私の家には、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.

fields.EN: Does that make sense to you?
fields.LOCALIZED: Does that make sense to you?

fields.EN:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)
fields.JP:
（どんなに証拠を突きつけても
　通用しない……どうすればいいんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)

fields.EN:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?
fields.JP:
ジャック、今の話……何かおかしいわ。
あれだけ大量の『眼』を、そんなにすんなり
設置できるものかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?

fields.EN:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ここであきらめちゃだめだ。
　これは、絶対に負けられない戦いなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)

fields.EN:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと時間をとられてしまったが、
理解してもらえたようで私も嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.

fields.EN:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?
fields.JP:
……いいえ、まだです。
仮に調査隊があの『眼』を取り付けたとして、
なぜジェイルはされるがままだったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?

fields.EN:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?
fields.JP:
なぜメルヒェンやナイトメアは、
あの『眼』を壊そうとしなかったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?

fields.EN:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!
fields.JP:
それこそが、あなたがジェイルと通じている
大きな証拠だ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!

fields.EN:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.
fields.JP:
スナークは、ナイトメアとトランシーバーで
連絡をとっていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.

fields.EN:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...
fields.JP:
恐らく……メルヒェンに人間を捕らえさせ、
拷問にかけるために
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...

fields.EN:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!
fields.JP: 拷問の目的は、ジェイルを成長させるためだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!

fields.EN:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.
fields.JP: 脱出計画との目的とも一致しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: 何のことかね、ハルくん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
They... Jack did the best he
could.
fields.JP: こいつらは……ジャックはよくやった
fields.LOCALIZED:
They... Jack did the best he
could.

fields.JP: ここまでお前を追い詰めたじゃねえか

fields.EN:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.
fields.JP:
俺は、今の今までお前が考えを翻すのを
期待していたんだが……どうやら
無駄だったみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.

fields.EN:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.
fields.JP:
……失ったものは二度と戻って来ない。
あきらめるんだ、スナーク
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.

fields.EN:
This whole scheme of creating a
team to abuse after finding Akazukin has gone too far.
fields.JP:
お前は、赤ずきんを発見したことで、
使い捨てになる実働部隊の可能性に気づき、
十五年前の策略を思いついた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This whole scheme of creating a
team to abuse after finding Red
Riding Hood has gone too far.

fields.EN:
You replaced Professor Tohjima,
you came up with this escape
plan...
fields.JP:
それを実行して十島博士に成り代わり、
脱出計画を立案したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You replaced Professor Tohjima,
you came up with this escape
plan...

fields.EN:
And things went well in finding
new Blood Maidens to do your
bidding.
fields.JP:
なるほど、お前は血式少女たちを効率的に
集め導いていった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And things went well in finding
new Blood Maidens to do your
bidding.

fields.EN:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.
fields.JP:
以前、血式部隊を二手に分けようとしたのは、
そろそろ仕上げにかかり、用済みだと考えた
からだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.

fields.EN:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?
fields.JP:
……そうだ。君たち……
今回はチームを分けてみないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?

fields.EN: And why do you suggest that?
fields.JP: それは……どうしてですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: And why do you suggest that?

fields.EN:
With Kaguyahime and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.
fields.JP:
なに、せっかくかぐや姫とシンデレラという
強力な戦力が行動可能になったわけだしね。
今の君たちなら、何も全員で行くこともあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Kaguya and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.

fields.EN:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦も続いたところだ。
一方のチームが調査に赴いている間、もう一方は
ささやかだが休暇を取るのも良いかと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.

fields.EN:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...
fields.JP:
やれやれ……獅子身中の虫とは、
まさにこのことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...

fields.JP: お父さん……否定、してくれないんだ……

fields.EN: ...Let me say this one last time.
fields.JP: ……最後にもう一度だけ言わせてもらう

fields.EN:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.
fields.JP:
考え直せ。全ては変化していくんだ。
何もかもがお前の掌中にあるわけじゃない。
この星と共に生きることを考えろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.

fields.EN:
What are you talking about, Haru-san?
What do you mean by "planet"...?
fields.JP:
……何の話ですか、ハルさん。
『この星』って、まるで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about, Haru?
What do you mean by "planet"...?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...
fields.JP:
ああ。俺たちは、とある滅んだ星から
ここに流れ着いたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...

fields.EN:
He was controlling the creature
found on our planet, so that it
would mature to do his bidding.
fields.JP:
こいつは、勝手知ったる同じ星の生物を
操ってたんだ。こいつの願う完成形に向けて
育つようにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was controlling the creature
found on our planet, so that it
would mature to do his bidding.

fields.JP: にわかには……信じられない話だわ……

fields.EN:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.
fields.JP:
だが、ジェイルはこの星との共生を選んだ。
もう物語は終わったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.

fields.EN:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?
fields.JP: ……まだ終わっていないと言ったら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?

fields.EN:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.
fields.JP:
……君には失望したよ。
やはり、私にとっての裏切者は君だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.
fields.JP: さて。用済みの玩具には退場願おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.

fields.EN:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!
fields.JP:
使える銃がまだ残っていたなんて……！
みんな、気をつけて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.
fields.JP:
なに、このままじっとしていてくれれば何も
しないよ。面倒だからね。
何なら塔を降りてくれても構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.

fields.EN:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.
fields.JP: 私は私で、目的を叶えることにしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.

fields.EN:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...
fields.JP:
お父さんが昔のお父さんじゃなくても、
あたしにとっては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...

fields.EN:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Akazukin. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.
fields.JP:
君には大いに感謝しているよ、赤ずきん。
私の計画は、君のおかげで大きく前進
することになったのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Red Riding Hood. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.

fields.EN:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...
fields.JP: ……みんな。博士を……スナークを追おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...

fields.EN:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.
fields.JP:
待て。お前たちに一つ伝えておかなきゃ
ならんことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.
fields.JP:
奴の目的は、この塔……ジェイルの『受精』に
よる、世界の塗り替えだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.

fields.EN:
He's trying to revive what was
lost on our planet.
fields.JP:
滅んじまった俺たちの星を蘇らせようと
してるのさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's trying to revive what was
lost on our planet.

fields.EN:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?
fields.JP:
それがジェイルの『受精』とどういう関係が
あるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?

fields.EN:
A new life is born through
insemination. A brand new core...
fields.JP:
『受精』によって誕生するのは、新たな生命……
真新しい、最大級の『核』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A new life is born through
insemination. A brand new core...

fields.EN:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.
fields.JP:
そしてジェイルの核は『擬態』する。
『想い』という無形のものさえも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.

fields.EN:
Yes, just like how the Jail
brought to life characters from
storybooks...
fields.JP:
そうね。このジェイルが童話の絵本たちの想いを
擬態することで生まれたように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, just like how the Jail
brought to life characters from
storybooks...

fields.EN:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...
fields.JP:
そして、わたしがそれを読んだ子供たちの想いを
擬態させられて生まれた存在なように
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...
fields.JP: お前……『転生体』だったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...

fields.EN:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...
fields.JP:
あの始まりの場所で、はっきりとわかったの。
今のわたしの生は、あの場所……幼稚園があった
場所から始まったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...

fields.EN:
It seems I was mimicked to life
without my knowledge by the blue
bird... by Snark...
fields.JP:
でも、自分でも気づかないうちにさらに
擬態していたのね……
青い鳥……スナークの操り人形として……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I was mimicked to life
without my knowledge by the blue
bird... by Snark...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、千昭……わたし、あなたのことを
苦しめてばかりのお姉さんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...

fields.EN:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...
fields.JP:
……スナークは、新たに生まれる核に擬態させる
つもりなのね。
あの人の望む世界を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...
fields.JP:
ああ。
俺はこの星との共生を考え、最後の最後まで
あいつの考えを変えさせようとしたんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...

fields.EN:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.
fields.JP:
そのせいでお前たちにも迷惑をかけたな
……本当にすまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!
fields.JP:
さあ、急ごう！
あいつが最後の仕上げに使おうとしてるのは
……信者たちの命だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!
fields.JP:
おそらく、このフロアのどこかに監禁されてる
筈だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『研究室』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『血式兵器製造所』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『タイヨウ本部』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『浄化場』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!

fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Wh-What's going on?! There are two
Michiru-sama?!
fields.JP:
こ……これはどういうこと？
ミチル様が二人……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's going on?! Another Lady
Oohime?!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect them to mimic
Michiru.
fields.JP: まさか、ミチルに擬態してるなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect them to mimic
Michiru.

fields.JP: あら、歯ごたえないですね～
ほかにもたくさんいる！！

fields.EN:
Let's first get rid of the
Marchens!
fields.JP: まずはメルヒェンをかたづけましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's first get rid of the
Marchens!

fields.EN:
All who face me will be
obliterated!
fields.JP: 瞬く間に殲滅しようぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All who face me will be
obliterated!

fields.JP: みんな……これで自由だよ！
い、いきなり入ってきて、なんなんだ……！

fields.EN:
Who was that Michiru-sama just now...?
Why were there two of them, and why
was one cut down?!
fields.JP:
さっきまでのミチル様はなんだったの……？
なんで二人になったの……？
なんで斬られたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wasn't that Lady Oohime?! Why were
there two of them, and why was one
killed?!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
I-I can't believe you killed those
harmless Marchens!
fields.JP:
そ、それに、害のないメルヒェンを
殺しおって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I can't believe you killed those
harmless Marchens!

fields.EN:
Wake up, everyone! You've all been
fooled!
fields.JP:
あんたたち、まだ気づかないの？
自分たちが騙されてたって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wake up, everyone! You've all been
fooled!

fields.EN:
She didn't show her face or even
speak to you. It was a fake, for
crying out loud!
fields.JP:
顔を見せないし、喋らない。
あんなの、どう見たって偽者じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She didn't show her face or even
speak to you. It was a fake, for
crying out loud!

fields.JP: もう少し、自分たちで考えようとしなさいよ！

fields.EN:
H-How do you know that she was a
fake?!
fields.JP:
な、なんであの大陽女様が偽者だったなんて
わかるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-How do you know that she was a
fake?!

fields.EN:
Th-That's right! She led us to
safety here! The Marchens didn't
lay a finger on us!
fields.JP:
そ、そうよ！
ここまで安全に導いてくださったのよ？
メルヒェンだって私たちに手出ししなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's right! She led us to
safety here! The Marchens didn't
lay a finger on us!

fields.EN:
You're telling us to believe you
when you all barged in here like
monsters, killing the Marchens?!
fields.JP:
むしろ……いきなりやってきてメルヒェンを
惨殺した、化け物のような奴らを信じろと
いう方が無理じゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're telling us to believe you
when you all barged in here like
monsters, killing the Marchens?!

fields.EN:
Listen! We don't have time! I need
you all to follow us!
fields.JP:
みな聞いてくれ。時間がないのだ。
今は私たちに従ってほしい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen! We don't have time! I need
you all to follow us!

fields.EN:
And who's to say that you're not a
monster, too?! You must be one of
them!
fields.JP:
こんな奴らとつるんでるなんて、
お前らも化け物の一味なんじゃないか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And who's to say that you're not a
monster, too?! You must be one of
them!

fields.EN:
Lady Oohime must have been a
fraud in the first place! Where is
this "sun," anyway?!
fields.JP:
そもそも、大陽女なんて女の話が最初から
怪しかったのよ！
太陽なんてどこにあるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime must have been a
fraud in the first place! Where is
this "sun," anyway?!

fields.EN:
If you're really a messenger of
the sun, prove it! Show us the
sun!
fields.JP:
太陽の使者だとか言うなら、いますぐ太陽を
呼んでみなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're really a messenger of
the sun, prove it! Show us the
sun!

fields.EN:
That's right! If you're supposed
to save us, save us right now!
fields.JP:
そうじゃ！
わしらを救うというなら、今ここで救ってくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! If you're supposed
to save us, save us right now!

fields.EN:
Heh... Sad, sad humans... See
how their expectations turn to
hatred in a heartbeat?
fields.JP:
ふうん……盲目な人間て愚かしいわね。
期待が転じると憎しみに変わるなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Sad, sad humans... See
how their expectations turn to
hatred in a heartbeat?

fields.EN:
You heard that?! She called us
"sad humans!" They have to be
monsters!
fields.JP:
おい聞いたか！
今そこの女が『人間が愚か』なんて言ったぞ！
やっぱり化け物なんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard that?! She called us
"sad humans!" They have to be
monsters!

fields.EN:
Eeeek! A-Are they going to kill
us?!
fields.JP:
ひ、ひいい！
私たちも斬り殺されるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eeeek! A-Are they going to kill
us?!

fields.JP: あー。どうしたもんかな……
愚かな輩が、何を寝ぼけたことを

fields.EN:
Blindly following, blindly
fearing. And always acting like
victims. Foolish blind reliance...
fields.JP:
なすがままに従い、なすがままに怯え、いざ
救われれば、今度は被害者として振る舞う。
他力本願もいいところ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blindly following, blindly
fearing. And always acting like
victims. Foolish blind reliance...

fields.EN:
You should all live your own lives
after you escape from here. Do
what you want with us later.
fields.JP:
そなたたちはここを脱出した後、思い描く
暮らしをすればよい。
わらわたちを排除したければすればいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should all live your own lives
after you escape from here. Do
what you want with us later.

fields.EN:
But if all you can do is believe
without taking action, stay here
and perish.
fields.JP:
……しかし、自らの判断を持たず、信じること
すら全うできぬ役立たずは、このまま死ねばいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if all you can do is believe
without taking action, stay here
and perish.

fields.EN:
Everyone... It's okay if you don't
believe in me.
fields.JP:
みんな……わたしを信じられないなら、
信じなくても構いません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone... It's okay if you don't
believe in me.

fields.EN:
Even so, I ask that you let me
save your lives.
fields.JP:
……たとえそうだとしても、
あなたたちの命を守らせてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I ask that you let me
save your lives.

fields.JP: そして、もう少しだけ時間をください

fields.EN:
I promise I will bring the
sunlight to you all. That is my
wish, and my role in this life.
fields.JP:
わたしは必ず、太陽の光をみんなに
届けます。それがわたしの一番の希い……
わたしの役割だから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promise I will bring the
sunlight to you all. That is my
wish, and my role in this life.

fields.JP:
ミチル様が……わしらを裏切るはずが
なかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime would never betray
us...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
I need to ask you all to follow
their instructions. First, we must
escape from here.
fields.JP:
皆さん。私たちと黎明の方たちの指示に従って
ください。まずはここから出ましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to ask you all to follow
their instructions. First, we must
escape from here.

fields.EN:
*sigh* That was a sad sight to
see...
fields.JP: はあ……こういうものなのかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* That was a sad sight to
see...

fields.EN:
I find it interesting to see them
succumb to mob mentality from
their lack of identity.
fields.JP:
この盲目的な主体性のなさ……群集心理の
テストケースとして、とても興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find it interesting to see them
succumb to mob mentality from
their lack of identity.

fields.EN:
In any case, it's better than
being stuck talking to them.
fields.JP: ま、事態が膠着してるよりゃ、いいんじゃねえの
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, it's better than
being stuck talking to them.

fields.EN:
All right! We'll protect you on
our way out! Stay together!
fields.JP:
よし、みんな！　脇は俺たちが守る！
はぐれないように固まって進んでくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! We'll protect you on
our way out! Stay together!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
We'll make sure they get out safe.
So, you mind stopping him for me?
fields.JP:
こいつらは俺たちが逃す。
だから、あとを頼んでもいいか？
……あいつを止めてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll make sure they get out safe.
So, you mind stopping him for me?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: Don't you die on me, you hear?
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you die on me, you hear?

fields.JP: 誰に向かって言ってんのよ！

fields.EN:
You should be careful on the way
back, old man!
fields.JP: 中年こそ道中を気をつけるがよいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should be careful on the way
back, old man!

fields.EN:
We may depart elsewhere, but none
of us die in our stories.
fields.JP:
わたしたちの物語は、誰も死なないわ。
どこかに旅立つ場合はあってもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may depart elsewhere, but none
of us die in our stories.

fields.EN:
There will always be a place for
you to return so long as we're
here, so please...
fields.JP:
わたしたちがいる限り、あなたたちの帰る場所は
あるわ。だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There will always be a place for
you to return so long as we're
here, so please...

fields.JP: 戻ってきます。……みんなで

fields.EN:
I don't have the right to say
this, but... Good luck.
fields.JP:
こんなこと言えた義理ではないけど……
頑張って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have the right to say
this, but... Good luck.

fields.EN: We'll see all of ya later!
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll see all of ya later!

fields.JP: ヒヤヒヤしちゃいました……

fields.EN: You did well back there, Kaguya!
fields.JP: かぐやさん、かっこよかったですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You did well back there, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
Well, it's just because I wanted
to get it off my chest.
fields.JP: まあでも、すっきりしました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's just because I wanted
to get it off my chest.

fields.JP: ……ええ。あなたは立派だったわ

fields.EN:
I could only say it with all of
you here with me. But I won't take
responsibility if we're chased...
fields.JP:
み、みんながいたから……
つい言ってしまっただけです～
本当に追い立てられても責任取れません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could only say it with all of
you here with me. But I won't take
responsibility if we're chased...

fields.EN:
Oh? But it seems as if they will
prepare a place for us to return.
fields.JP:
あら。帰る場所はちゃんと用意してくれる
みたいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But it seems as if they will
prepare a place for us to return.

fields.EN:
Let's get going! We need to finish
this, once and for all!
fields.JP:
さあ、行くよ！
あたしたちは、決着を付けなきゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get going! We need to finish
this, once and for all!

fields.EN:
I feel like the Professor... Snark
is past this portal.
fields.JP: たぶん、この扉の先に博士……スナークがいる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like the Professor... Snark
is past this portal.

fields.EN: So, this is the last battle...
fields.JP: これが、最後の戦いになるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is the last battle...

fields.EN:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?
fields.JP:
この扉を開けたら、きっと後戻りはできない。
ジャック、準備はいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we go through, there's no
turning back. Are you ready, Jack?

fields.EN:
Okay. Let me know once you're
ready.
fields.JP:
わかったわ。
準備がすんだらまた声をかけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Let me know once you're
ready.

fields.EN:
If we beat Snark, this story will
probably end...
fields.JP:
……みんな。もしスナークを倒せたら、
多分、この物語は終わるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we beat Snark, this story will
probably end...

fields.EN:
We were reincarnated from stories.
Heroes and heroines of tales. Our
purpose is to end our stories.
fields.JP:
僕たちは、絵本に込められた想いの転生体。
童話の主人公の転生体だ。
主人公の役目は、物語を終わらせること……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were reincarnated from stories.
Heroes and heroines of tales. Our
purpose is to end our stories.

fields.EN:
If that's what we were born for,
then...
fields.JP:
もしそのために僕らが生まれたんだと
したら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's what we were born for,
then...

fields.EN:
...Once the story is over, we'll
probably disappear.
fields.JP:
物語が終わったら……僕らは
役目を終えて、消えて無くなっちゃうの
かもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Once the story is over, we'll
probably disappear.

fields.EN:
At least that's what I feel like
will happen...
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least that's what I feel like
will happen...

fields.EN:
We won't disappear. We're just
going to wake up from a dream.
fields.JP:
消えて無くなったりはしないわ。
ただ、一つの夢から醒めるだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We won't disappear. We're just
going to wake up from a dream.

fields.EN:
I'm sure we'll wake up as normal
boys and girls...
fields.JP: きっと……ただの男の子と女の子としてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we'll wake up as normal
boys and girls...

fields.EN: Ohohoho! There is nothing to fear!
fields.JP:
をーっほっほっほ！
怖れることなどありまして？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohohoho! There is nothing to fear!

fields.EN:
Someday, I'll be able to discard
my glass shoes!
fields.JP:
わたくしだっていつかは、
ガラスの靴など捨てますのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Someday, I'll be able to discard
my glass shoes!

fields.EN:
I don't need treasures anymore...
I won't return to the moon, and
I'll find what I want myself.
fields.JP:
わらわも、もう宝物は要らないです～
月の国には帰らずに、欲しいものは自分で
探します～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't need treasures anymore...
I won't return to the moon, and
I'll find what I want myself.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You sure you can do
that, Princess Lazy?
fields.JP:
ふふ。
グータラ姫。あんた、そんなことできんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You sure you can do
that, Princess Lazy?

fields.EN:
I'm not going to be held captive
anymore! I'm going to escape this
cramped place!
fields.JP:
わたしだって、
いっつも囚われ役なんてまっぴらよ！
狭い場所からはもう脱け出してみせるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to be held captive
anymore! I'm going to escape this
cramped place!

fields.EN:
I wouldn't mind being any ordinary
girl. I won't be afraid of mirrors
anymore.
fields.JP:
どこにでもいる普通の女の子もいいかも
しれません。だから、鏡なんてもう怖れません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't mind being any ordinary
girl. I won't be afraid of mirrors
anymore.

fields.EN:
When Rapunzel goes outside,
she's gonna be an adult!
fields.JP:
おそとにでたら。……いつかね。
ラプンツェルはおとなになるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Rapunzel goes outside,
she's gonna be an adult!

fields.EN:
Oh, and I'm gonna catch someone
I like and make babies!
fields.JP:
それでね、すきなひとをつかまえて、
ふたりのこどもをうむよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I'm gonna catch someone
I like and make babies!

fields.EN:
I shall lead the Marchens and
disappear... No! I won't
disappear...
fields.JP:
ワレはメルヒェンたちでも連れて消えてくさ……
……うぐっ。いや、どこにも行かないでやろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall lead the Marchens and
disappear... No! I won't
disappear...

fields.EN:
Yup. I don't need my hood anymore.
I'm gonna beat that bad wolf
myself.
fields.JP:
……うん。あたしももうフードは要らない。
悪いオオカミは、こっちからとっちめてやるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I don't need my hood anymore.
I'm gonna beat that bad wolf
myself.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh. Well then, I suggest we
hurry and toss our bad father into
the oven so we can all return.
fields.JP:
ふふ。だから悪いお父さんはかまどに放り込んで、
……帰らなくてはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh. Well then, I suggest we
hurry and toss our bad father into
the oven so we can all return.

fields.EN:
Yes. And, once we awaken, we'll
need to make sure we avoid other
rabbit holes...
fields.JP:
ええ。そして……夢から覚めても
別のウサギ穴がないか、気をつけなければね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. And, once we awaken, we'll
need to make sure we avoid other
rabbit holes...

fields.EN:
I'm going to cut down this
tower... And end this old
story...
fields.JP:
……僕もこの高い塔を切り倒すんだ。
そして、古い物語を終わらせて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to cut down this
tower... And end this old
story...

fields.EN:
We can all live together, happily
ever after!
fields.JP: みんなでかえって、またいっしょにくらす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can all live together, happily
ever after!

fields.EN: This is the top of the tower...?
fields.LOCALIZED: This is the top of the tower...?

fields.EN: There's no moon in the sky...?!
fields.LOCALIZED: There's no moon in the sky...?!

fields.EN:
Well, it seems you've all come.
How futile...
fields.JP:
やあ、みんな。やはり来てしまったのかね。
無為なことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems you've all come.
How futile...

fields.EN:
Oh? You're still going to call me
"Dad?"
fields.JP: おや。まだその名で呼んでくれるのかね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You're still going to call me
"Dad?"

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, the Jail has
matured very well.
fields.JP:
君たちのおかげで、このジェイルは非常に
効率良く成長してくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, the Jail has
matured very well.

fields.EN:
Michiru also brought results
beyond my expectations, regardless
of what happened.
fields.JP:
そしてミチルも、経緯はどうあれ
私の望む以上の結果をもたらしてくれたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru also brought results
beyond my expectations, regardless
of what happened.

fields.EN:
I intended for you all to become
the final source of nutrients, but
the followers were good specimens.
fields.JP:
本来君たちは、『受精』に必要な最後の養分と
なる予定だったのだが……一部の信者で代用
できたのはうれしい誤算だったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I intended for you all to become
the final source of nutrients, but
the followers were good specimens.

fields.JP:
見たまえ。
これがその成果だ

fields.EN:
Wh-What...? What's that huge egg
thing?
fields.JP:
な……何？
そのでかい卵みたいなの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What...? What's that huge egg
thing?

fields.EN:
The insemination was a success,
and a new core... A new source of
life has been born.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの『受精』は果たされ、
こうして新たな核……生命の源が誕生したと
いうわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The insemination was a success,
and a new core... A new source of
life has been born.

fields.JP: 『受精』って……まさか、あの白い月が……

fields.EN:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."
fields.JP:
その通りだ。
君たちがジェイルと呼んでいたものは雄型でね、
あの月こそが雌型なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."

fields.EN:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.
fields.JP:
そして……ここにその果実を得ることができた。
君たちには礼を言おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.

fields.EN:
So that egg was what you wanted?
What are you going to do with it?
fields.JP:
その卵が、あなたの目的だったというのね？
それで何をするつもりなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that egg was what you wanted?
What are you going to do with it?

fields.EN:
It hurts... I can't breathe...
Why... is this... happening to
me...?
fields.JP:
痛い……苦しい……
どうして……こんなことに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It hurts... I can't breathe...
Why... is this... happening to
me...?

fields.EN:
They tricked me...? Aaah... My
blood... My bones...
fields.JP:
私は騙されたの……？
ああ……血が……骨が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They tricked me...? Aaah... My
blood... My bones...

fields.EN:
I won't... forgive you for...
what... happened... to me...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't... forgive you for...
what... happened... to me...

fields.JP: 信者の人たちを……殺したのね……！

fields.EN:
Ah, "murder" is such a barbaric
term. Consider them sacrifices to
bring life to the core.
fields.JP:
やれやれ。『殺す』とは野暮なことを……
彼らはこの核に宿すべき魂……尊い犠牲と
なったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, "murder" is such a barbaric
term. Consider them sacrifices to
bring life to the core.

fields.EN:
Blind faith bears desire, and
desires become the source of life
to bring about a new god.
fields.JP:
盲信こそは強き『想い』……強き『想い』こそが
新たな神を生むに相応しき魂の源……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blind faith bears desire, and
desires become the source of life
to bring about a new god.

fields.JP: 神とはまた、使い古された概念ね

fields.EN:
Yet, it is an existence that will
become the foundation to a new
order.
fields.JP: しかし、新しき秩序の礎となるべき存在だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet, it is an existence that will
become the foundation to a new
order.

fields.EN:
I won't let you do that! We're
going to defeat you and put an
end to your plans!
fields.JP:
そんなことさせない……！
お前を倒して、野望も食い止めてみせる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't let you do that! We're
going to defeat you and put an
end to your plans!

fields.JP: それは、御免こうむりたいね

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...
fields.JP:
残念なことに、私は戦闘能力を有していない。
……だからこそ、裏で糸を引いていたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...

fields.EN:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.
fields.JP:
長い時間をかけてゆっくりと、全てが私の
思い通りに進むように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.

fields.JP: （そうか、そういうことだったんだ……）

だってあいつ、ぜんぜんこわくないもん。
きっと、よわいよ

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェルも怖くなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)

fields.EN: No way! That's the one that massacred everyone from Dawn fifteen years ago!
fields.JP:
そんなはずないじゃん！
十五年前、黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
相手だよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No way! That thing killed members
from the Dawn 15 years ago!

fields.EN:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.
fields.JP: でも、卑怯な相手なのは間違いないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
死にそうなナイトメアをいきなり後ろから
刺すなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.

fields.EN:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)
fields.JP:
（僕が怖さを感じなかったことも、
　ラプンツェルだけが気づいていたことも
　……正しかったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)

fields.JP:
（スナークに戦闘能力はない。
　もしスナークとしての行動中に見つかって、
　戦いになったら困るから……）

fields.EN:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)
fields.JP:
（だから、スナークは恐ろしく強い、
　絶対に手を出すなって嘘をついてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)

fields.EN:
One other thing... You're too
late.
fields.JP: それに、もう手遅れなのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing... You're too
late.

fields.JP:
ウラギラレタ……フミニジラレタ……
ミステラレタ……
イタイ……アツイ……ナニモミエナイ……
ツライ……クルシイ……タスケテ……

fields.EN:
That's right. What you hear are
the voice of hatred, of fear, of
despair. All found within you.
fields.JP:
そうだ。君たちの中にもある声……
恐怖と絶望……憎しみの声だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. What you hear are
the voice of hatred, of fear, of
despair. All found within you.

fields.EN:
The sacrificed souls have been
compressed, and with the dark
voices, a new god is born!
fields.JP:
生贄の魂が凝縮され……
この暗き声を糧に、新たな神が生まれる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sacrificed souls have been
compressed, and with the dark
voices, a new god is born!

fields.EN:
...A new god the humans and I have
created.
fields.JP: 私と人間たちが生み出した、新たな神だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...A new god the humans and I have
created.

fields.EN:
Now, then... I will need your
stories to end so I can usher in a
new world!
fields.JP:
さあ。新しい世界のために、古い物語は退場して
くれたまえ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, then... I will need your
stories to end so I can usher in a
new world!

fields.EN:
Right... You have no right to end
us, Snark.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
スナーク、退場を決めるのはあなたではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right... You have no right to end
us, Snark.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki won't forgive you...
For deceiving everyone... For
treating everyone like tools...!
fields.JP:
ずっとみんなを騙してたこと……
みんなを使い捨ての道具のように扱ったこと……
白雪は、許しません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White won't forgive you...
For deceiving everyone... For
treating everyone like tools...!

fields.EN:
I shall bring judgment by death to
the traitor!
fields.JP: 裏切り者には、死の制裁を与えん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall bring judgment by death to
the traitor!

fields.EN:
I hate your soul... No... Your
very existence that made your
soul into what it is now!
fields.JP:
わらわが憎むのは、その魂……いいえ、
魂をそこまで追い詰めたそなたの存在……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hate your soul... No... Your
very existence that made your
soul into what it is now!

fields.EN:
Yes... Humans are inherently
weak, but they can become
stronger!
fields.JP:
ええ……ひとの心は弱いもの……
でも、強くもなれるんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Humans are inherently
weak, but they can become
stronger!

fields.EN:
If you weren't here, my brother
Hansel-niisan might still be alive.
fields.JP:
あなたがいなければ、ヘンゼル兄さんも
生きられたかもしれないのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you weren't here, my brother
Hansel might still be alive.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
I'm going to crush you, along with
that creature of yours!
fields.JP:
あんたなんか……そいつとまとめて
ブッ潰してやる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to crush you, along with
that creature of yours!

fields.JP: ぐるる……ぜんぶ、しとめる……！！

fields.EN:
I'm ready... I need to slice open
the big bad wolf!
fields.JP:
……もう心は決まってる。
悪い狼は、切り刻んでやらなきゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm ready... I need to slice open
the big bad wolf!

fields.EN:
How disappointing... It would have
been easier if all of you were
consumed.
fields.JP:
やれやれ。手間をかけさせずに、
おとなしく食われていれば良いものを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How disappointing... It would have
been easier if all of you were
consumed.

fields.JP: ウオオォォォォオオオッ……！！

fields.EN: Did he die with it? Or maybe...
fields.JP:
一緒に死んだのかしら？
それとも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Did he die with it? Or maybe...

fields.EN:
The Tower...! We have to get out
of here, now!
fields.JP:
塔が……！
みんな、早くここを出よう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Tower...! We have to get out
of here, now!

fields.EN:
It's probably wilting from the
insemination...
fields.JP: ……受精を済ませて、枯れていくんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably wilting from the
insemination...

fields.JP:
もう一度伸長することは……望めないの
かしら……？

fields.EN:
No one knows what's gonna
happen to this world after the
Jail completes its insemination.
fields.JP:
この世界に適応したジェイルの受精後が
どうなるかなんて、誰にもわからねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one knows what's gonna
happen to this world after the
Jail completes its insemination.

fields.JP: だが、普通に考えりゃ無理だろうな……

fields.EN:
So how are we supposed to get
out of here?!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、わたしたちはどうやってここから
抜け出せばいいのよ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So how are we supposed to get
out of here?!

fields.EN:
What we just did... Has merely
brought about death to
everyone...?
fields.JP:
僕たちのしてきたことは……人々を死なせる
だけの結果に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What we just did... Has merely
brought about death to
everyone...?

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. By the time
you got to the prison, it was all too
late.
fields.JP:
仕方ねえよ……牢に駆けつけた時は、
もう全てが終わってたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. By the time
you got to the prison, it was all too
late.

fields.EN:
Then, was what we did all for
nothing...?
fields.JP: わたくしたちの今までは……何だったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then, was what we did all for
nothing...?

fields.EN:
I want to believe that none of it
was a waste!
fields.JP: 無駄じゃないって……信じたいのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to believe that none of it
was a waste!

fields.EN:
Michiru-san? Please continue to preach
about the sun.
fields.JP:
……ミチルさんは、太陽のことを……
これからもずっと話し続けてください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru? Please continue to preach
about the sun.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
No matter how small, it still is a
source of hope to everyone...
fields.JP:
どんなに小さくても……
みんなの……希望、なんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how small, it still is a
source of hope to everyone...

fields.EN: I won't let it end here...
fields.JP: こんなことで……負けるもんか……
fields.LOCALIZED: I won't let it end here...

fields.EN:
That's right. Defeat comes only to
those who accept defeat!
fields.JP: そうだ。敗北を認めた時こそ、真の敗北だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Defeat comes only to
those who accept defeat!

fields.EN:
I'm sure there's something we can
do...
fields.JP: きっと、まだ何かできることがあるはずだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there's something we can
do...

fields.EN:
Well, Pandora's box did have Hope
left inside it.
fields.JP:
……そうね。災厄の箱に最後に残ったものは
希望だというわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Pandora's box did have Hope
left inside it.

fields.EN:
Yes. No matter how deep the
labyrinth, there's always a way
out.
fields.JP:
ええ。どんなに入り組んだ迷宮でも、
出口は必ずあるものだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. No matter how deep the
labyrinth, there's always a way
out.

fields.EN:
That's right, Aka-nee... We
came here to stop his plans!
fields.JP:
そうよ。赤姉……
わたしたち、あいつの企みは潰したんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Sister Red... We
came here to stop his plans!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You're right. I was
just about to give up there... We
did at least complete one thing...
fields.JP:
へへ……そうだった。忘れるとこだったよ……
あたしたち、ひとつくらいはできたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You're right. I was
just about to give up there... We
did at least complete one thing...

fields.EN:
No matter how many times we're
beat or how many times we're put
to despair...
fields.JP:
どんなに打ちのめされても……
どんなに絶望に叩き落とされたって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how many times we're
beat or how many times we're put
to despair...

fields.EN:
We're going to escape from the
Jail, once and for all!
fields.JP:
必ずみんなで……ここから、
この監獄の世界から抜け出してみせる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to escape from the
Jail, once and for all!

fields.EN: Are we at the very top...?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are we at the very top...?

fields.JP: ここがほんとのてっぺんだね！

fields.EN: Look at how close the moon is!
fields.JP: 白い月が……こんなに近くに……！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Look at how close the moon is!

fields.EN:
The top of the tower... is in
contact with the moon...?
fields.JP:
あれは……塔の先端が白い月に触れて
輝いてる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The top of the tower... is in
contact with the moon...?

fields.EN:
Ah, I see you're all here. I must
say, you all brought about
something quite unexpected.
fields.JP:
やあ、みんな。
ずいぶんと予定外なことをしてくれたようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see you're all here. I must
say, you all brought about
something quite unexpected.

fields.EN:
I should have fired the gun
earlier. That last bit of mercy I
felt didn't do me any good.
fields.JP:
やはり、先ほど撃っておけばよかったか。
最後の最後……ほんの一滴の慈悲が仇になった
ようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should have fired the gun
earlier. That last bit of mercy I
felt didn't do me any good.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised to hear you say
that, considering you never had a
drop of mercy in you...
fields.JP:
勝手なこと言って……
慈悲なんてこれっぽっちもなかったくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised to hear you say
that, considering you never had a
drop of mercy in you...

fields.EN:
We have all the means to put you
down. Give up now, while you
still have the chance.
fields.JP:
あなたを狩る道具は全て揃ってる。
だから……諦めるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have all the means to put you
down. Give up now, while you
still have the chance.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I have the means
to put you all down, too. Didn't
I say I had no more use for you?
fields.JP:
残念ながら、私の方も全てが整ったのだよ。
君たちは用済みだと言ったろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I have the means
to put you all down, too. Didn't
I say I had no more use for you?

fields.EN: You were originally meant to become the final nutrients needed for insemination... but it was a welcome miscalculation that the Marchens guarding the core could substitute for you.
fields.JP:
本来君たちは、『受精』に必要な最後の養分と
なる予定だったのだが……核を守護する
メルヒェンで代用できたのはうれしい誤算だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were all to be nutrients for
the insemination, but I'm happy
that the Marchens sufficed.

fields.EN: The Marchens guarding the core... were substitutes?
fields.JP: 核を守護するメルヒェンで……代用？

fields.EN:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!
fields.JP: 核が……メルヒェンを……食べてる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core... is eating the
Marchen?!

fields.EN:
It looks like it's a special
function specific to that core.
fields.JP:
これは……今までの核にはなかった、
この塔特有の機能なのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's a special
function specific to that core.

fields.EN:
Maybe it's absorbing the Marchen
that was guarding it... for
nourishment.
fields.JP:
自分を守護していたメルヒェンを吸収して、
何をしようというのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's absorbing the Marchen
that was guarding it... for
nourishment.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you were able to use
a single Marchen to replace all of
us.
fields.JP:
私たちの代用が、
たかだか一体のメルヒェンだなんて
ずいぶんと大ざっぱな計算をしていたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you were able to use
a single Marchen to replace all of
us.

fields.EN:
But that was only possible because
of all of you. Your work nurtured
the Jail far more than I expected.
fields.JP:
そうではないよ。
これは、君たちの活躍によって、
ジェイルが想定以上に育ったからなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that was only possible because
of all of you. Your work nurtured
the Jail far more than I expected.

fields.EN:
How ironic, seeing your efforts
bring about the very existence
which will reap you of your lives.
fields.JP:
皮肉なものだね。
私に導かれた君たちの命がけの頑張りが、
君たち自身の命を救うことになるとは
fields.LOCALIZED:
How ironic, seeing your efforts
bring about the very existence
which will reap you of your lives.

fields.EN:
Anger isn't needed here. On the
contrary, you should all be
rejoicing.
fields.JP:
怒るのは野暮だよ。
むしろ、喜びたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anger isn't needed here. On the
contrary, you should all be
rejoicing.

fields.EN:
Behold! The insemination is about
to begin!
fields.JP:
今、まさにこの刻、『受精』が始まろうと
しているのだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Behold! The insemination is about
to begin!

fields.EN:
(The top of the tower and the moon
are shining...!)
fields.JP: （くっ！　塔の先端と白い月が光って……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The top of the tower and the moon
are shining...!)

fields.EN:
Wh-What's with that huge egg
thing?!
fields.JP:
な……何！？
そのでかい卵みたいなの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's with that huge egg
thing?!

fields.EN: This is the new "core"... the one and only source of life.
fields.JP:
これこそ、新たな『核』……
唯一無二の生命の源だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, this is the new core... The
source of life for all.

fields.EN: It... was created from the moon?
fields.JP: まさか、あの白い月から……？
fields.LOCALIZED: It... was created from the moon?

fields.EN:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."
fields.JP:
その通りだ。
君たちがジェイルと呼んでいたものは雄型でね、
あの月こそが雌型なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. The Jail is what you would
call a "male," and the moon, a
"female."

fields.EN:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.
fields.JP:
そして……ここにその果実を得ることができた。
君たちには礼を言おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see here are their
results. Many thanks to you all.

fields.EN:
What if I propose that you leave
that core to nature?
fields.JP: たとえばその『核』を、自然に任せたとしたら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if I propose that you leave
that core to nature?

fields.EN:
Ah, but all it would do is mimic
whatever is around it when it
hatches, just like the Jail did.
fields.JP:
どうもこうもない。これが孵る際、
適当にその辺のものを擬態させながら成長する
だけだ……ジェイルのようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but all it would do is mimic
whatever is around it when it
hatches, just like the Jail did.

fields.EN:
I see. So this world and our
existence were created out of your
control.
fields.JP:
そう……この世界や私たちの存在は、
あなたの企図したものではないわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So this world and our
existence were created out of your
control.

fields.EN:
Yes, but through it, I discovered
that the Jail can mimic even
imaginary beings from stories.
fields.JP:
ああ、しかし良い示唆は与えたくれた。
童話などという、観念的なものまでを
ジェイルが擬態できるようになったのだとね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but through it, I discovered
that the Jail can mimic even
imaginary beings from stories.

fields.EN:
So, that made you think of using
it to change the world?
fields.JP:
それで、それを利用して世界を塗り替えようと
考えたんですか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that made you think of using
it to change the world?

fields.EN:
You spoke with him...? What an
unimaginative thing to say, though
it sounds like him to say that.
fields.JP:
……あの男に聞いたのか。
あの男らしい堅実な発想だが、実につまらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You spoke with him...? What an
unimaginative thing to say, though
it sounds like him to say that.

fields.EN:
This world has already changed in
a way. If so, your desire must be
something purer.
fields.JP:
そうね。世界は既に塗り替えられてしまって
いるといってもいいものね。だとしたら、
あなたの望みはもっと純粋なもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This world has already changed in
a way. If so, your desire must be
something purer.

fields.EN:
That would mean what you seek is a
purer form of order, with all
contaminants removed.
fields.JP:
不純な要素を排除し、より純粋な秩序を求めよう
というのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean what you seek is a
purer form of order, with all
contaminants removed.

fields.EN:
Very insightful, Gretel. Though I
must say I despise you for that...
fields.JP:
君はいつも察しがいいね、グレーテル。
……だが私は、君のそんなところがたまらなく
嫌いだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very insightful, Gretel. Though I
must say I despise you for that...

fields.EN:
Now then, it's time we end the
prattle. I have work to do.
fields.JP:
さて、お話はそろそろおしまいにしよう。
私にはまだやるべきことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, it's time we end the
prattle. I have work to do.

fields.EN:
We came here to stop you! To
defeat you and end this story!
fields.JP:
やらせないわ……！
あなたを倒して、このばかげた物語を
終わらせてみせる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here to stop you! To
defeat you and end this story!

fields.EN:
Alice... I'm honored to hear your
enthusiasm, but I'm afraid I must
decline your offer.
fields.JP:
アリス……お誘いはとても光栄だが……
今回は遠慮しておくとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... I'm honored to hear your
enthusiasm, but I'm afraid I must
decline your offer.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...
fields.JP:
私は戦闘能力を有していないのでね。
……だからこそ、裏で糸を引いていたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I have no battle
prowess to speak of. I prefer to
work behind the curtain...

fields.EN:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.
fields.JP:
長い時間をかけてゆっくりと、全てが私の
思い通りに進むように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Patiently pulling strings to bring
about the ending I've wanted for
the longest time.

fields.JP: （そうか、そういうことだったんだ……）

だってあいつ、ぜんぜんこわくないもん。
きっと、よわいよ

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェルも怖くなかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel didn't fear it in any
way, either...)

fields.EN: No way! That's the one that massacred everyone from Dawn fifteen years ago!
fields.JP:
そんなはずないじゃん！
十五年前、黎明の人たちが皆殺しに遭った
相手だよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No way! That thing killed members
from the Dawn 15 years ago!

fields.EN:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.
fields.JP: でも、卑怯な相手なのは間違いないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least we know it acts in a foul
manner.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.
fields.JP:
そうですわ。
死にそうなナイトメアをいきなり後ろから
刺すなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I can't believe it struck
the Nightmare from behind when
it was already so close to death.

fields.EN:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)
fields.JP:
（僕が怖さを感じなかったことも、
　ラプンツェルだけが気づいていたことも
　……正しかったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't feel fear, either.
Rapunzel's instincts were
right...)

fields.JP:
（スナークに戦闘能力はない。
　もしスナークとしての行動中に見つかって、
　戦いになったら困るから……）

fields.EN:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)
fields.JP:
（だから、スナークは恐ろしく強い、
　絶対に手を出すなって嘘をついてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That explains why he created
an image of fear around "Snark,"
so that no one would face him...)

fields.EN:
The blind souls meant to feed the
core... Its intended source of
desire was lost, thanks to you.
fields.JP:
『核』に宿らせるべき盲目な魂……
『想い』の源は、君たちによって失われた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The blind souls meant to feed the
core... Its intended source of
desire was lost, thanks to you.

fields.EN:
Considering how strenuous it was
to lead Michiru here, that was a
terrible loss, indeed.
fields.JP:
ここまでミチルを導くのは大変な労力を
要したというのに、大変な損失だったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering how strenuous it was
to lead Michiru here, that was a
terrible loss, indeed.

fields.EN:
But that means nothing to me
now. The reason...?
fields.JP:
だが、もはやそれも問題ではない。
……なぜならば
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that means nothing to me
now. The reason...?

fields.EN:
I will become the soul to live
within the core!
fields.JP: この私自身が宿れば良いのだから……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will become the soul to live
within the core!

fields.EN:
There are tentacles coming out of
the core!
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are tentacles coming out of
the core!

fields.EN:
Now then, my dear core... Guide
me! A new story will now unfold!
fields.JP:
さあ、『核』よ。私を導くが良い！
新たな世界の幕開けだ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, my dear core... Guide
me! A new story will now unfold!

fields.JP: ヴオオオオォォォォオオオァ！！
マサカ、ココデ邪魔ガ入ルトハ……！！
おおー！　ゆれてるー！！
一体、何がどうなってるの！？

fields.EN:
We're... standing on the broken
pieces from the tower...
fields.JP: 崩れた瓦礫が浮いて……足場になってる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're... standing on the broken
pieces from the tower...

fields.JP: あれは……ジェイルなのか！？

fields.EN: I-It's like some kind of monster!
fields.JP: ま、まるで化け物みたいです……！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-It's like some kind of monster!

fields.EN:
What you see there is what you
once called "Snark."
fields.JP:
……あれは、あなた方がスナークと
呼んでいたものです
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see there is what you
once called "Snark."

fields.EN:
Snark merged himself with the
Jail, and brought about a new
awakening.
fields.JP:
スナークはあの塔……雄型のジェイルと
一体化し、新たな目覚めを迎えました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark merged himself with the
Jail, and brought about a new
awakening.

fields.EN:
The Jail's new core conceived two
desires and divided upon its
hatching.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの新たな『核』は、
二つの想いを同時に受け入れて
分裂孵化したのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's new core conceived two
desires and divided upon its
hatching.

fields.EN:
Snark's desire was absorbed by
the Tower, transforming it into a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
スナークの想いは、あの塔を取り込んで
……ナイトメアに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark's desire was absorbed by
the Tower, transforming it into a
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
The other desire of saving the
world was transformed into a girl,
which is who you see here.
fields.JP:
そして、この世界を救いたいという
想いは……一人の少女を変容させ、
私となったのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other desire of saving the
world was transformed into a girl,
which is who you see here.

fields.JP: あんたは一体、何者なわけ？

fields.EN: Jack? Do you remember my voice?
fields.JP:
それは……ジャック、私の声に聞き覚えは
ありませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Do you remember my voice?

fields.EN:
"We'll see you at the top!"
I believe I made that promise with
you.
fields.JP:
絶対、頂上で会おうね！
……そう、約束したでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"We'll see you at the top!"
I believe I made that promise with
you.

fields.EN:
I am a reincarnated form of that
girl. To be exact, I am the hope
that was imparted upon her.
fields.JP:
私は、あの少女の転生体。
正確に言うと、あの少女に託された希望たちの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am a reincarnated form of that
girl. To be exact, I am the hope
that was imparted upon her.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
ドコヘ逃ゲタカト思エバ、
ソンナトコロニイタカ……！！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
What you see was created from
the desire to destroy. Left alone,
it'll bring death to this planet.
fields.JP:
……あの者の根源的な願いは『破壊』。
このままにしておけば、この世界はいずれ
その願いに呑み込まれ、死の星と化すでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you see was created from
the desire to destroy. Left alone,
it'll bring death to this planet.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: 浅ハカナ考エデ私ヲ語ルナ……！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
DESTRUCTION LEADS TO REVIVAL. I AM
GOD, AND I WILL CREATE A NEW
WORLD!
fields.JP:
『破壊』ハ『再生』ヘト繋ガッテイル。
私ハ神トナリ、創世ノ礎トナルノダ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
DESTRUCTION LEADS TO REVIVAL. I AM
GOD, AND I WILL CREATE A NEW
WORLD!

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
Blind ambition to become a god...
How shallow.
fields.JP: 神への野望……実に浅はかな考えね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blind ambition to become a god...
How shallow.

fields.EN: We're going to finish you here!
fields.JP: 僕らは……お前の息の根を止める！！
fields.LOCALIZED: We're going to finish you here!

fields.EN:
B-But, what are we supposed to
do...?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, what are we supposed to
do...?!

fields.EN: I will create a path to him...
fields.JP:
……私が道を造ります。
それを使ってあれの元へ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I will create a path to him...

fields.JP: わかった。いろいろありがとう！
ナイトメア・ジェイル
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
I AM GOD. I AM THE ONE TO BRING
ORDER TO THE NEW WORLD!
fields.JP: 我ハ神……新世界ニ秩序ヲモタラス者ナリ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I AM GOD. I AM THE ONE TO BRING
ORDER TO THE NEW WORLD!

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
Yes... A fitting end to this crazy
story.
fields.JP: ええ……狂った物語に、ふさわしい結末を
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... A fitting end to this crazy
story.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ヴオオオオォォォォオオオァ！！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: オオオォオオォォォォオオオ……！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
I see that the curtains have
closed.
fields.JP: 幕は下りた、というべきか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see that the curtains have
closed.

fields.EN: Our footing is falling apart, too!
fields.JP: 足元の瓦礫が崩れてきます……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Our footing is falling apart, too!

fields.EN:
It seems I used too much of my
power...
fields.JP:
……少し、疲れました。
どうやら……力を使い過ぎてしまった
ようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I used too much of my
power...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... Being newly born, my
power is highly unstable...
fields.JP:
……申し訳ありません。
生まれたばかりで……まだ……
力が不安定なのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... Being newly born, my
power is highly unstable...

fields.EN:
Hurry! Over here! I may be able to
maintain at least some footing...
fields.JP:
早く……この瓦礫の上に……！
一つだけならば……あるいは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurry! Over here! I may be able to
maintain at least some footing...

fields.JP: みんな、その瓦礫に急いで！！
（まずい！　赤ずきんさんが！！）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: （まずい！　ラプンツェルが！！）
（このままじゃ、地面に激突する……！！）

fields.EN:
(There... There has to be a
way...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There... There has to be a
way...!)

fields.JP: （いくつか使えそうなものが……！）

（だ……駄目だ！
　どうにもならない……！）

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Akazukin-san...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、赤ずきんさんだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save Red Riding
Hood...!)
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ジャック！　ジャック！！
どうして、あたしのことなんか庇って……
こんなのって、こんなのってないよーっ！

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Alice...!)
fields.LOCALIZED: (If I can at least save Alice...!)

fields.JP: ジャック……あなた、どうして……

fields.EN:
You promised... You promised we'd
make it out of here alive!
fields.JP:
一緒に……生きようって……
約束したじゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You promised... You promised we'd
make it out of here alive!

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Oyayubihime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Thumbelina...!)

fields.JP:
死んじゃったら……もう
どうにもならないじゃない……

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Shirayukihime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save Snow
White...!)

fields.JP:
え……そんな……
ジャックさん……どうして……？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.LOCALIZED: Why did you save Snow White...?

fields.EN:
What is Shirayuki supposed to
do...? Jack-san...
fields.JP:
白雪は……これからどうすれば
いいんですか……ジャックさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is Snow White supposed to
do...? Jack...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: (If I can at least save Nemurihime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save Sleeping
Beauty...!)

fields.JP:
ジャック……ボク……
…………どうして…………！

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Cinderella...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、シンデレラだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Cinderella...!)

fields.JP:
ジャックさん……！
どうして……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Kaguyahime...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Kaguya...!)

fields.EN:
I... I will bring you in as my
retainer...
fields.JP:
…………そなたを……
わらわの従者にしてあげます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I will bring you in as my
retainer...

fields.EN:
Let's go together... to the
moon...
fields.JP: 一緒に……月まで連れて行きますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go together... to the
moon...

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Gretel...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、グレーテルだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Gretel...!)

fields.EN: How stupid of you to save me.
fields.JP:
馬鹿ね……私は、自分の命なんてどうでも
よかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED: How stupid of you to save me.

fields.EN:
But, do know that I felt solace in
being with you...
fields.JP:
……ただ、あなたと一緒にいることが
心地よいと感じていたのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, do know that I felt solace in
being with you...

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Rapunzel...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、ラプンツェルだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Rapunzel...!)

fields.EN:
Guess we can't make babies
now...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess we can't make babies
now...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel had a lot of fun with
you. It was always fun being with
you...
fields.JP:
でもラプンツェル、たのしかったよ。
いちばん……たのしかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel had a lot of fun with
you. It was always fun being with
you...

fields.EN:
(If I can at least save
Hameln...!)
fields.JP: （せめて、ハーメルンだけでも……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I can at least save
Hameln...!)

fields.EN: Fool... Why did you save me?
fields.LOCALIZED: Fool... Why did you save me?

fields.EN:
What meaning is there to this
victory?
fields.JP: ……こんな勝利に、意味などあるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What meaning is there to this
victory?

fields.EN:
A victory without the one whom I
dreamt of sharing...
fields.JP:
喜びを分かち合う者の……
おらぬ勝利など……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A victory without the one whom I
dreamt of sharing...

fields.EN:
(All right! The thrust slowed the
fall!)
fields.JP: （よし！　逆噴射で勢いを殺した！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All right! The thrust slowed the
fall!)

fields.JP: おーい。街の連中も集めてきたよー！

fields.EN:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.
fields.JP: タイヨウのみんなも、そろってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.

fields.EN:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?
fields.JP:
おい。
本部から持ち出すものは、他にもう無いか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?

fields.EN:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.
fields.JP:
ええ。薬品と医療器具と資料と……
あなたと違って身軽なものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.

fields.EN:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...
fields.JP: 全然身軽じゃねえだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...

fields.EN:
I'm gonna help carry her stuff,
too!
fields.JP: 姉さん、持つの手伝うっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna help carry her stuff,
too!

fields.EN:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.
fields.JP:
しっかし、全部終わったってのに、
資料まで残さず持ち出すとは、真面目だねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.

fields.EN:
I like to be prepared. I have to
say that you're not like that
comrade of yours.
fields.JP:
あなたが不真面目なのよ。
同郷だったっていうあの人とは大違いね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like to be prepared. I have to
say that you're not like that
comrade of yours.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.
fields.JP:
まあ……あいつは良くも悪くもクソ真面目だった
からな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.

fields.EN: So much so that he lost his way...
fields.JP: 真面目すぎて、歪んじまったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: So much so that he lost his way...

fields.EN:
Um, Haru-san, so where exactly did
you and the Professor come from?
fields.JP:
あの、ハルさんと博士って……どこから
来たんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so where exactly did you and
the Professor come from?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title. | Line-level restoration of a source name/honorific omitted or rewritten in localized English.

fields.EN:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.
fields.JP:
……落ち着いたらおいおい話してやるよ。
ま、突拍子も無い話だ。
どのみちこの物語にはふさわしくねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.

fields.EN: Way to put on airs, Boss!
fields.JP: 師匠のもったいぶりー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Way to put on airs, Boss!

fields.EN:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.
fields.JP:
大人はもったいぶるんだよ。
ガキどもと違って、持ってるもんが少ねえからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.

fields.EN:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.
fields.JP:
……ま、お前ら風に言うなら、
遠い星の王子様が、住んでた小さな星を失って、
大事な花だけ持ってやって来た……そんな話さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.

fields.EN:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!
fields.JP:
うわ！　自分のこと王子様とか言ってるし……
ちょっと引いたっすよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!

fields.EN:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...
fields.JP: 例えって言ったろ。シメるぞガキ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...

fields.EN:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!
fields.JP:
ひゃー！
自分、あっち見てくるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!

fields.EN:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.
fields.JP:
確かに突拍子も無い話ね。
……落ち着いたら詳細を聞きたいところだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.

fields.JP: そうね。興味深い事例だわ……

fields.EN:
Whoa! Where'd you come from?! Damn
those ears of yours...
fields.JP:
うお、いきなり出てきやがって。
お前、地獄耳だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Where'd you come from?! Damn
those ears of yours...

fields.EN:
Did you expect anything less? I
did share his intellect. Now,
may I suggest we cooperate, Miko?
fields.JP:
ええ。彼の頭脳を継ぐのは私だもの。当然よ
視子、改めて連携を提案するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you expect anything less? I
did share his intellect. Now,
may I suggest we cooperate, Miko?

fields.EN:
Why, yes, that sounds like an
excellent idea.
fields.JP: そうね。有意義な提案だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes, that sounds like an
excellent idea.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Jack... You felt sorry for me
there, didn't ya? You need a
beating?
fields.JP:
ジャック。お前いま、同情しただろ？
お前もシメるぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You felt sorry for me
there, didn't ya? You need a
beating?

fields.EN:
Wha-?! I didn't feel sorry! H-Hey!
P-Please, stop!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？　してませんってば！
わあっ！　ほ、ほんとにシメないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! I didn't feel sorry! H-Hey!
P-Please, stop!

fields.EN:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.
fields.JP: ……ジャック。お前には感謝してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.

fields.JP: おーい、永遠。こっちは準備できたぞー！

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Finally! Guess now we
can begin our exodus!
fields.JP:
ははは。待ってましたよ。
まあ、ちょっとした民族大移動ですからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Finally! Guess now we
can begin our exodus!

fields.JP: ……みんな！　みんなは準備はいい？

fields.EN:
I will now lead everyone to the
surface. This will mark my final
mission.
fields.JP:
これから私は、みなさんを地上へと導きます。
それが私の最後の仕事……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will now lead everyone to the
surface. This will mark my final
mission.

fields.EN: Um... What about your companion who climbed the other tower with you? I don't see anyone like that here...
fields.JP:
あ、あの！
君と一緒にもう一つの塔を昇った、あの人は？
見当たらないみたいだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what happened to the others
who climbed the Tower with you?
I don't see them around.

fields.EN:
They have already moved to a
safe place... I plan on going
there after this, too.
fields.JP:
……彼らはすでに、安全な場所へ移動しています。
このあと、私も彼らの所へ帰ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
They have already moved to a
safe place... I plan on going
there after this, too.

fields.EN:
(That's good to hear. I guess I'll
get a chance to meet them next
time.)
fields.JP:
（良かった……
　また、いつか会えるかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's good to hear. I guess I'll
get a chance to meet them next
time.)

fields.JP: かみさま、いなくなっちゃうの？

fields.EN:
I'm not a god, but I will be
watching over you all with hope of
the world's revival.
fields.JP:
私は神様ではないわ。
世界の再生を願いながら、どこかでずっと
あなたたちを見守っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a god, but I will be
watching over you all with hope of
the world's revival.

fields.EN:
You are the ones to create this
new story. Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
新しい物語を始めるのはあなたたち……
そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are the ones to create this
new story. Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
The old story is coming to an end,
and the time for a new beginning
has come.
fields.JP:
旧い物語は幕を下ろし、
始まりの刻が巡ってきたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The old story is coming to an end,
and the time for a new beginning
has come.

fields.EN:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.
fields.JP:
新たに開いた頁の先に広がる世界が
どのような姿であろうと、陽は沈み、また昇る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.

fields.EN:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.
fields.JP:
そんな世界に、希望の欠片が潜まぬ筈がない
……そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.

fields.EN: I want to bring sunlight to everyone... so I'll stay with Chii and keep watching over everyone. Okay?
fields.JP:
わたしは、みんなにお日様を届けたいから……
ちーちゃんとずっと一緒に、みんなのことを
見守るの。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I deliver everyone to the
sun, Chii and I will watch over
everyone.

fields.JP: ねー、ちじょうってどんなとこ？
今となっては、ここの誰もがわからないわね

fields.EN:
That's why we're heading there,
right?
fields.JP: だから行くのよ。そうでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we're heading there,
right?

fields.EN:
We're going to be together, so
it'll be fine. We'll survive.
fields.JP:
みんなと一緒なんだから……どんなところだって
生きていけるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to be together, so
it'll be fine. We'll survive.

fields.EN:
Yup. After all, I trained
everyone! Not like we'd lose to
anything now!
fields.JP:
そうだね。あたしの鍛えたみんなだもん。
そんじょそこらじゃ負けないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
