Yup. After all, I trained
everyone! Not like we'd lose to
anything now!

fields.EN:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.
fields.JP:
地上に行くのに空へと昇るなんて……
どんな感じなんでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.

fields.EN:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.
fields.JP:
新しい世界には、新しい謎がたくさん
あるはず……楽しくないわけがないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.

fields.EN:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experience it
again...
fields.JP:
ワレは一度、身をもって体験したこと……
二度も体験できりゅとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experience it
again...

fields.JP: うんっ！　ラプンツェル、たのしみー！

fields.EN:
Leave this lost world and go to
where the sun shines...
fields.JP:
お行きなさい。
予め失われたこの世界から、陽の差す場所へ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave this lost world and go to
where the sun shines...

fields.EN: A new beginning to a new story...
fields.JP: 新しい物語の、始まりね……
fields.LOCALIZED: A new beginning to a new story...

fields.EN:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...
fields.JP:
これからみんなで、新しい物語を
始めていくんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...

fields.EN:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.
fields.JP: けれど、夢の終わりは、別の夢の始まり
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.

fields.EN:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?
fields.JP: ……誰かにそう聞いたことはないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?

fields.EN:
That was a close call... Are you
okay, Alice?
fields.JP:
一時はどうなることかと思ったよ……
アリスは大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a close call... Are you
okay, Alice?

fields.EN:
Stupid! Stupid! Stupid! I can't
believe how stupid you are!
fields.JP:
馬鹿馬鹿馬鹿！
なんて馬鹿なことしたのよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stupid! Stupid! Stupid! I can't
believe how stupid you are!

fields.JP:
アリス！？　落ち着いて！
もう大丈夫だよ、助かったんだ……！
そんなのわかってるわ！

fields.EN:
What were you going to do if you
lost all your blood using the
Mary Gun like that?!
fields.JP:
あんな風にメアリガンをめいっぱい使って、
血を使い果たしてしまったら、
どうするつもりだったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What were you going to do if you
lost all your blood using the
Mary Gun like that?!

fields.EN:
We finally made it this far...
We're so close to finding our way
out of this story's labyrinth!
fields.JP:
せっかくここまで来たのに……
物語の迷路から抜け出すことができたのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We finally made it this far...
We're so close to finding our way
out of this story's labyrinth!

fields.EN:
If you died on me... It wouldn't
make any sense for me to live!
fields.JP:
ここでもしあなたが死んだりしたら
わたしは……何のために生きてきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you died on me... It wouldn't
make any sense for me to live!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for worrying you like
that, Alice. But... I wanted to
save you...
fields.JP:
アリス、心配かけてごめん。
でも……どうしても助けたかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for worrying you like
that, Alice. But... I wanted to
save you...

fields.EN:
It's the same with me. I can't
imagine you dying on me.
fields.JP:
僕だって、こんなことでアリスが死ぬなんて
我慢ならなかったからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's the same with me. I can't
imagine you dying on me.

fields.EN:
Remember that we promised we'd
have a tea party once we made it
out alive?
fields.JP:
一緒に生き延びて、お茶会をするって……
そう約束、しただろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember that we promised we'd
have a tea party once we made it
out alive?

fields.EN:
Alice, I was able to fight all
this time because you were with
me.
fields.JP:
アリス、君がいつも一緒にいてくれたから、
僕は最後まで戦えたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, I was able to fight all
this time because you were with
me.

fields.EN:
Me, too... I was able to search
for a way out of the labyrinth in
my mind because of you.
fields.JP:
わたしだって……あなたがいてくれたから、
迷路の出口を探し続けることができた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me, too... I was able to search
for a way out of the labyrinth in
my mind because of you.

fields.EN:
That's not all. My world is filled
with joy because you're with me.
It made me want to live.
fields.JP:
それだけじゃないわ。あなたがいてくれたから
……世界がとても豊かになったわ。生き延びる
だけじゃない。生きようって思えたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not all. My world is filled
with joy because you're with me.
It made me want to live.

fields.EN: It's the same with me, too.
fields.JP: 僕も……そうかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED: It's the same with me, too.

fields.EN:
That's why we were able to have
such precious friends like we do
now.
fields.JP:
だから……仲間というかけがえのない存在も
得ることができたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we were able to have
such precious friends like we do
now.

fields.EN:
It's so beautiful to know that
there are people we can trust...
fields.JP: 誰かを信じられるって……素敵なことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so beautiful to know that
there are people we can trust...

fields.JP: じゃっくー！　ありすー！
全員、無事だったようね……
（みんな無事で本当によかった……）

fields.EN:
Can we continue to support each
other? Just like this?
fields.JP:
わたしたち……これからも、支え合って
いけるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can we continue to support each
other? Just like this?

fields.EN:
Now we can have a huge tea party
with everyone!
fields.JP:
今度こそ、
みんなで盛大にお茶会をやろうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can have a huge tea party
with everyone!

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
Yes... A new story, with everyone
together...
fields.JP: ……ええ。新しい物語は、みんなで一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... A new story, with everyone
together...

fields.EN:
Ugggh... I thought I was gonna die
just now!
fields.JP: はああ……死ぬかと思った……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugggh... I thought I was gonna die
just now!

fields.EN: (I can still feel Akazukin-san's weight in my arms...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんの重み……離れてもまだ
　腕に残ってる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can still feel Red Riding
Hood's weight in my arms...)
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Looks like you saved me again,
Jack...
fields.JP: ……ジャックには、また助けられちゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you saved me again,
Jack...

fields.EN:
But, of all the things you
could've done...
fields.JP: でも、あんな無茶なやり方して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, of all the things you
could've done...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but that was the best
I could come up with. I'm glad it
worked.
fields.JP:
ごめん。
でも、あれしか思いつかなかったんだ。
ちゃんと助けられてよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but that was the best
I could come up with. I'm glad it
worked.

fields.EN:
Looks like you're the one saving
me all the time...
fields.JP: あたし、ジャックに助けられてばっかりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're the one saving
me all the time...

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, I think
I was able to bear Dad's betrayal
because of you, Jack.
fields.JP:
……お父さんに裏切られたことだって、
ジャックがいたから受け止められたんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, I think
I was able to bear Dad's betrayal
because of you, Jack.

fields.EN:
If I'd been alone, I probably
wouldn't have made it out with
everything that's happened...
fields.JP:
あたしだけだったら、一人でいっぱいになって
破裂しちゃってたかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I'd been alone, I probably
wouldn't have made it out with
everything that's happened...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Thinking about Dad still feels
weird to me...
fields.JP:
……まだ、お父さんのことを考えると
いろんな気持ちでわけわかんなくなる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking about Dad still feels
weird to me...

fields.EN:
He killed everyone who found me,
then he cared for me... I loved
him with all I had...
fields.JP:
あの人は、あたしを大事にしてくれた
本物のお父さんのことを殺した奴で、
でも、長い間、ずっと大好きで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He killed everyone who found me,
then he cared for me... I loved
him with all I had...

fields.EN:
I can't forgive him, but I can't
not love him. It's all a jumble. I
can't just hate him.
fields.JP:
許せない気持ちと、好きだった気持ちが
混ざり合ってて、ただ憎むって感じに
ならないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't forgive him, but I can't
not love him. It's all a jumble. I
can't just hate him.

fields.EN: That's very much like you, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP: ……僕は、それも赤ずきんさんらしいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's very much like you, Red
Riding Hood...
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It was because Akazukin-san is
like that that I learned how wonderful
it is to care about your friends...
fields.JP:
そういう赤ずきんさんだから僕も、
仲間を大切にするのが素敵なことだって……
知ることができたと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned how wonderful it is to
care about your friends, how to
care for others, from you.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Jack... I wasn't doing anything
special.
fields.JP:
ジャック……
あたしはそんな大したことしてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I wasn't doing anything
special.

fields.EN:
I think Akazukin-san taught me
what I need to do to protect what's important.
Strength, kindness, and... pain.
fields.JP:
僕は、大切なものを守るために何をするべきか、
赤ずきんさんから教わった気がするんだ。
強さも、優しさも、それに……辛さも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned what I needed to protect
those special to me. I learned
strength, kindness, and pain...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
So if remembering it gets painful,
Akazukin-san... don't pretend to be strong.
At least tell me.
fields.JP:
……だから、赤ずきんさんが思い出して辛く
なったら……強がったりしないで、せめて
僕にだけは言ってほしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I want you to at least
share that burden, and not try to
hide it behind a strong front.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
...Because I want you to stay true to yourself,
Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんさんには、
赤ずきんさんらしくいてほしいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to be who you really
are, Red Riding Hood...
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 赤ずきん => Red Riding Hood-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Jack, I want you to take better
care of yourself.
fields.JP:
でも……ジャックには、
自分のことをもっと大事にしてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I want you to take better
care of yourself.

fields.EN:
You do the darndest things when
the pressure's on, and that hurts
my heart.
fields.JP:
ここぞって時にいきなり無茶するからさ、
心配で胸が苦しくなる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do the darndest things when
the pressure's on, and that hurts
my heart.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I'm sorry if I worried you...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry if I worried you...

fields.EN:
Well, next time let me know.
Discuss with me what you want to
do first!
fields.JP:
だからさ、一言でいいから……
何かする前にあたしに相談して！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, next time let me know.
Discuss with me what you want to
do first!

fields.EN:
I want you to talk to me more than
before. I am older than you, after
all.
fields.JP:
ジャックの考えてること、
もっとあたしに相談してほしいんだ。
これでも年上なんだから、さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to talk to me more than
before. I am older than you, after
all.

fields.EN:
Uh, but you seem to know what I'm
thinking before I even say
anything...
fields.JP:
いつも何も言わなくても、
見抜かれちゃってるんだけどな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but you seem to know what I'm
thinking before I even say
anything...

fields.EN:
F-Fine! I'll be sure to rely on
you more, Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
じゃ、じゃあこれからは、赤ずきんさんのこと
もっと頼りにするようにするよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine! I'll be sure to rely on
you more, Red Riding Hood!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Very good. Well then, let's do a
lot more together, okay?
fields.JP:
……よろしい。
また一緒にいろいろやろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good. Well then, let's do a
lot more together, okay?

fields.EN:
(Why do I feel like she's going to
make me do something
unreasonable...?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだか無茶なことをさせられそうな
　気が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why do I feel like she's going to
make me do something
unreasonable...?)

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP:
よかった！
みんな、無事だったんだ……！

fields.EN:
We've got a lot to do now... Guess
I need to get back in shape and do
more sisterly stuff!
fields.JP:
これからいろいろ立て直して……
まだまだお姉さんとして頑張んなきゃね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've got a lot to do now... Guess
I need to get back in shape and do
more sisterly stuff!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
You said it! We're going to help
each other out, just like before.
After all, we're a family now.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
これからもみんなで……助け合っていこう。
あたしたちは……家族なんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said it! We're going to help
each other out, just like before.
After all, we're a family now.

fields.JP:
はあ……はあ……！
助か……った？

親指姫……！
よかった、君も無事で……！
……これでやっと、全部終わったのね

fields.EN:
That was way too risky! I can't
believe you used your Mary Gun
like that!
fields.JP:
あんた、いくらなんでも無理しすぎ！
あんなにメアリガンを使って……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was way too risky! I can't
believe you used your Mary Gun
like that!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry! But, that was about
all I could do...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん！
でも、あの時はああするしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry! But, that was about
all I could do...

fields.EN:
Well, maybe, but... I-In any case,
you had me worried there! Stupid!
fields.JP:
確かに、そうだけど……
も、もう……めちゃくちゃ心配したんだから！！
この馬鹿！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, maybe, but... I-In any case,
you had me worried there! Stupid!

fields.EN:
But, um... Th-Thanks... I really
appreciate what you did... I'm
just glad you're safe...
fields.JP:
でも、その……あ、ありがとう……
本当に……感謝してるわ。
あんたが無事で、よかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, um... Th-Thanks... I really
appreciate what you did... I'm
just glad you're safe...

fields.EN: I'm glad that you're safe, too...
fields.JP: 僕も……君が無事で本当によかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad that you're safe, too...

fields.EN:
It isn't like me to be like this.
I can't seem to keep it together
when you're around, you know?!
fields.JP:
……って、こんなの、わたしらしくないわよね。
な、なんかあんたの前だと調子狂っちゃうわ！
ほ、本音が出ちゃうっていうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't like me to be like this.
I can't seem to keep it together
when you're around, you know?!

fields.EN:
That isn't true... I think you're
no different now than usual,
Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
……そんなことないよ。
その方が、親指姫らしいと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That isn't true... I think you're
no different now than usual,
Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
You've supported me all this time,
and I know you cared about me,
too...
fields.JP:
君には、今までたくさん支えられて、
心配もしてもらってたと思うんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've supported me all this time,
and I know you cared about me,
too...

fields.EN:
Heh... Now I remember... Back
when we first met, you mistook me
for the youngest sister.
fields.JP:
……そういえば最初は、
末の妹だと勘違いされたり、色々あったわよね。
まったく……ふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Now I remember... Back
when we first met, you mistook me
for the youngest sister.

fields.EN:
Heh... I'm sorry about that. But
it dawned on me afterward how
dependable you really are.
fields.JP:
あはは……あの時はごめんね。
……でも後で、思ったんだ。
しっかりした優しいお姉さんなんだなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I'm sorry about that. But
it dawned on me afterward how
dependable you really are.

fields.EN:
Well, um... I think you helped me
a lot, too...
fields.JP:
わたしも……あんたには、色々助けてもらった
気がしてるわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, um... I think you helped me
a lot, too...

fields.EN:
You know, just like what happened
here...
fields.JP: さっきだって、そうなのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, just like what happened
here...

fields.EN:
S-So, um... I know this story
ended, but... I want you to be
with me for...
fields.JP:
だ、だから……なんていうか……
この物語は終わったけど……その……
わたしは、あんたと一緒に……ずっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So, um... I know this story
ended, but... I want you to be
with me for...

fields.JP:
おーい！！
ジャック、親指～！
みんなも……無事に逃げられたみたいね

fields.EN:
Uh, sorry! What was it you were
saying, Oyayubihime?
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ！
親指姫……さっき、何を言いかけたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, sorry! What was it you were
saying, Thumbelina?

fields.EN: Huh? Um... Well... I want to be...
fields.JP:
えっ？
そ、それは……その…
あんたと一緒に……ごにょごにょ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Um... Well... I want to be...

fields.EN:
Aaaugh! I just said that I want us
to stay friends, got that?! What a
dolt!
fields.JP:
……あーーもう！！
これからもよろしくねって言ったのよ！
この鈍感バカ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaugh! I just said that I want us
to stay friends, got that?! What a
dolt!

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Okay, sure. We'll always
be together.
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……こちらこそ、よろしくね。
これからも、ずっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Okay, sure. We'll always
be together.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! Hmph...! W-Well I guess if
that's what you want, then...
Um... Th-Thanks, Jack.
fields.JP:
なっ！？　ふ、ふん……
あんたがどうしてもって言うなら……
よ、よろしく、ジャック……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Hmph...! W-Well I guess if
that's what you want, then...
Um... Th-Thanks, Jack.

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! You're right! It's time
for us to get writing!
fields.JP:
ふふ。そうね……
わたしたちみんなの、新しい物語の始まりよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! You're right! It's time
for us to get writing!

fields.EN:
Th-That was close...! Are you
okay, Shirayukihime?
fields.JP:
あ、危なかった……！
……白雪姫、大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That was close...! Are you
okay, Snow White?

fields.JP:
はい……！
い、生きてます……！

fields.EN:
But more importantly, Jack-san...
You're bleeding!!
fields.JP:
それより、ジャックさんこそ……
血が……！！
fields.LOCALIZED: But, look at you! You're bleeding!
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Heh... It's okay... I
just feel a bit dizzy, that's
all...
fields.JP:
あはは、だ、大丈夫……
ちょっと貧血気味なだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Heh... It's okay... I
just feel a bit dizzy, that's
all...

fields.EN:
Bleeding can lead to other
problems! Please, take better care
of yourself...
fields.JP:
貧血は万病の元です！
無理はしないでください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bleeding can lead to other
problems! Please, take better care
of yourself...

fields.JP:
白雪姫……
心配してくれてありがとう……

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is the one who should
be thanking you...
fields.JP:
……お礼を言わなくちゃいけないのは、
白雪の方です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is the one who should
be thanking you...

fields.EN:
You risked yourself like this,
just to save Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
こんな危険な目に遭ってまで……
白雪を助けてくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You risked yourself like this,
just to save Snow White...

fields.EN: And, it's all thanks to you...
fields.JP: 君のおかげだよ、白雪姫……
fields.LOCALIZED: And, it's all thanks to you...

fields.EN:
You always supported everyone,
which made us want to do better. I
think that's why we all made it.
fields.JP:
君が支えていてくれたから、
僕は頑張れた……そしてみんなも、
辛いことを乗り越えられたと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always supported everyone,
which made us want to do better. I
think that's why we all made it.

fields.EN:
But, I did learn that... this was
Shirayuki's role...
fields.JP:
ただ、気付いたんです。
これが……白雪の役目なんだなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I did learn that... this was
Snow White's role...

fields.EN:
I always thought to myself that
Shirayuki was a plain and
ordinary girl...
fields.JP:
白雪は自分のこと、ずっとただの地味な、
冴えない子だと思ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always thought to myself that
Snow White was a plain and
ordinary girl...

fields.EN:
Because you believed in me, Jack-san, I found
the courage to tell everyone about the traitor
and finally gained confidence in myself.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんが、信じてくれたから……
裏切り者のことをみんなに話す勇気を持てて、
やっと自分に自信が持てたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You believed in me, and that gave
me the courage and the strength to
talk about the traitor before.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Even if Shirayuki doesn't stand
out, she wants to do what only she
can do to make everyone happy.
fields.JP:
たとえ目立つ何かが無くても……
白雪にも、白雪にしかできないことがあって、
それでみんなが幸せになってくれれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if Snow White doesn't stand
out, she wants to do what only she
can do to make everyone happy.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is happy just doing
that...
fields.JP: それで、白雪は満足なんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is happy just doing
that...

fields.EN: You're not plain at all, Shirayukihime. In fact, you're...
fields.JP:
白雪姫は、全然地味なんかじゃないよ。
だって、こんなに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not plain at all, Snow
White. In fact, you're...

fields.JP: ジャックー！　白雪姫ー！
よかった、みんな無事で……！

fields.EN: Yeah, guess we all made it.
fields.JP: うん、これで一安心だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, guess we all made it.

fields.EN:
Um, Jack-san...? If I feel afraid or
feel uneasy, will you be by my
side?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……また不安になったら、
傍にいてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Jack...? If I feel afraid or
feel uneasy, will you be by my
side?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I have to ask the same to you,
too... Though in my case, I might
just worry you more...
fields.JP:
僕こそ……これからもいっぱい、心配させちゃう
かもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to ask the same to you,
too... Though in my case, I might
just worry you more...

fields.JP: なんですか、ジャックさん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
That's right... It's time to begin
a new story with everyone in it!
fields.JP:
そうですね……これからは白雪たちみんなの、
新しい物語なんですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... It's time to begin
a new story with everyone in it!

fields.JP:
ふう……！！
な、なんとか助かった……！
眠り姫……よかった、無事で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty...? Thank goodness
you're safe...

fields.EN: I'm fine... But not you, Jack...
fields.JP:
……ボクはだいじょうぶ……
でも……ジャックが駄目……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm fine... But not you, Jack...

fields.JP:
いっぱい……ムリした……
だから……

fields.EN:
Thanks for worrying about me, but
I'm okay.
fields.JP:
心配してくれてありがとう。
でも、僕も大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for worrying about me, but
I'm okay.

fields.EN:
But, I'm really okay. Sure, it was
risky, but what better time than
that to do my very best?
fields.JP:
でも、本当に大丈夫なんだ。
確かに少し無理したかもしれないけど、
頑張りどころだったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I'm really okay. Sure, it was
risky, but what better time than
that to do my very best?

fields.EN:
Heh... With you at stake, there's
no way I could've let you go.
fields.JP:
特にさっきは、君を助けなくちゃって
無我夢中で……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... With you at stake, there's
no way I could've let you go.

fields.EN:
You took us by surprise! That was
the most insane thing I've ever
seen you do!
fields.JP:
びっくりです～
ウルトラＣにも程があります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You took us by surprise! That was
the most insane thing I've ever
seen you do!

fields.EN:
Oh, uh... Are you sure you're
okay? Are you feeling sleepy?
fields.JP:
あ……それより、大丈夫？
そろそろ、眠くなってきたんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh... Are you sure you're
okay? Are you feeling sleepy?

fields.EN:
Mmm... It's okay... I'm not sleepy
anymore... The curse... Wore
off...
fields.JP:
……ん……大丈夫……もう、眠くない……
……魔法、解けたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... It's okay... I'm not sleepy
anymore... The curse... Wore
off...

fields.EN:
I see... So that means your story
ended...
fields.JP: そっか……物語は、終わったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So that means your story
ended...

fields.EN:
Yup... Now I can see... My
prince...
fields.JP:
ん……
王子様の顔……ずっと、見てられる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Now I can see... My
prince...

fields.EN:
Prince...? No... Jack is my...
precious friend...
fields.JP:
王子様、じゃない……ジャック……
ボクの……大事な仲間……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Prince...? No... Jack is my...
precious friend...

fields.EN:
Oh, I see. You're my precious
friend, too.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
僕にとっても、君はかけがえのない仲間だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. You're my precious
friend, too.

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN: I guess we got out of this alive.
fields.JP: どうやら生きてるみたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess we got out of this alive.

fields.EN:
In any case, I need to ask you to
not do such a risky thing like
that again.
fields.JP:
それにしても……
あんな無茶はもう金輪際やめてほしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I need to ask you to
not do such a risky thing like
that again.

fields.EN:
Even if I were saved, if you died,
it would have all been for
nothing.
fields.JP:
わらわを助けたところで、ジャックが死んで
しまっては元も子もないではありませんか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I were saved, if you died,
it would have all been for
nothing.

fields.EN:
What would I have done if you
died...?
fields.JP: そなたが死んだら、わらわは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What would I have done if you
died...?

fields.EN: But, I really wanted to save you.
fields.JP: でも、どうしても君を助けたかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: But, I really wanted to save you.

fields.EN:
The moment that crossed my mind,
I had already jumped and you were
in my arms.
fields.JP:
そう思った瞬間、もう飛び出してて……
気づいたら君を抱きしめてた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moment that crossed my mind,
I had already jumped and you were
in my arms.

fields.JP: 君が無事で、本当によかった……

fields.EN:
I'm tired of getting angry
already, so I'll just let you
go this time...
fields.JP:
怒るのも面倒臭いので、
今回だけは許してあげます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm tired of getting angry
already, so I'll just let you
go this time...

fields.EN:
*sigh* I can't believe how
emotional I am now... How times
have changed...
fields.JP:
ふう……わらわがここまで感情的になるとは……
時代も変わったものです
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I can't believe how
emotional I am now... How times
have changed...

fields.EN:
I suppose change is what I really
wanted. In fact, I have changed
quite a bit from before.
fields.JP:
でも、変わっていくのが在るべき姿なのかも
しれませんね。わらわ自身……ずいぶん
変わったと思いますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose change is what I really
wanted. In fact, I have changed
quite a bit from before.

fields.EN:
You already know how afraid of
humans I was. No... More like how
I hated humans...
fields.JP:
知ってるでしょうが、わらわはずっと人間が
怖かったのです……いえ、嫌いでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
You already know how afraid of
humans I was. No... More like how
I hated humans...

fields.EN:
I still can't say for certain that
I like them...
fields.JP: 多分、今でも好きにはなれないでしょう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still can't say for certain that
I like them...

fields.EN:
But this last battle, and telling
the followers what was on my mind,
lessened my fear...
fields.JP:
けれど、最後の戦いの前に、タイヨウ信者に
気持ちをぶちまけたことで、恐怖心は薄らいだ
気がしますし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this last battle, and telling
the followers what was on my mind,
lessened my fear...

fields.EN:
And I feel like I can look forward
now with friends like you. I owe
it all to you, Jack.
fields.JP:
何より、そなたたちという仲間の存在のおかげで
わらわは前に進む気になれたんです。
ジャック、そなたのおかげです
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I feel like I can look forward
now with friends like you. I owe
it all to you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Same here. You kept everything
inside and stayed lazy, so I was
able to try my hardest, and...
fields.JP:
僕だって……かぐや姫がいろんなことを背負って
全力でダラダラしていてくれたから……
だから、僕もみんなも、自分を見失わずに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. You kept everything
inside and stayed lazy, so I was
able to try my hardest, and...

fields.EN:
Wait a sec... That doesn't sound
like I appreciated what you did...
fields.JP:
……あれ？　感謝してるのに、なんだかそう
聞こえないよね。これじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a sec... That doesn't sound
like I appreciated what you did...

fields.EN:
That's fine. I don't plan on
changing my lazy ways, which, of
course, means I'll need a servant.
fields.JP:
ふふっ。それでいいんですよ～
わらわはこれからもダラダラするつもりですし、
それには下僕が欠かせませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. I don't plan on
changing my lazy ways, which, of
course, means I'll need a servant.

fields.EN: Huh...? What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh...? What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: ジャック……！　かぐや姫……！

fields.EN: Hey, you two! Are you okay?!
fields.JP: おーい、二人とも！　無事だったんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you two! Are you okay?!

fields.EN: It looks like everyone made it...
fields.JP: みんなも無事で、ほっとしました～
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks like everyone made it...

fields.EN: Yeah, I'm glad we all made it...
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I'm glad we all made it...

fields.EN:
Jack... I suppose my story ends
without me leaving where I am now.
fields.JP:
ジャック……わらわはこの地上に
留まったまま、物語を終えられたのですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I suppose my story ends
without me leaving where I am now.

fields.EN:
That must mean we can all be
together again.
fields.JP: これからも、みんな一緒にいられるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must mean we can all be
together again.

fields.JP: うん……もちろんだよ。それに……

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
The old story met a different
ending, leading to a new story for
us to tell...
fields.JP:
古い物語とは別の結末から始まる……
わらわたちみんなで始める物語です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The old story met a different
ending, leading to a new story for
us to tell...

fields.EN:
Jack... Thank you for letting me
stay a part of this world...
fields.JP:
ジャック……
この世界に引き止めてくれてありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Thank you for letting me
stay a part of this world...

fields.JP:
ふう……
な、なんとか……助かったみたいだね……

fields.EN:
That was close... I knew it was a
risk, but... Wh...at...?
fields.JP:
かなり危なかったし、イチかバチかだったけどね
……あ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was close... I knew it was a
risk, but... Wh...at...?

fields.EN:
Jack-san! Are you all right?! You look
sick!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……！　大丈夫ですの！？
顔色が悪いですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Are you all right?! You look
sick!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Sorry... Thank you, Cinderella. I almost fell over... Heh.
fields.JP:
ごめん……ありがとう、シンデレラ。
ちょっと転んじゃうとこだった……あはは
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... I'm okay now,
Cinderella. I was just tripping
over myself. Heh...

fields.EN:
Don't "heh" me! You... You really
are stupid!
fields.JP:
あははじゃありませんわ！
貴方……馬鹿ですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't "heh" me! You... You really
are stupid!

fields.EN:
I wasn't worth enough to have you
risking your life like that...
fields.JP:
……わたくしなんかに……
そこまでする価値はありませんのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't worth enough to have you
risking your life like that...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
You're much more important than
you think! I wanted to save you!
fields.JP:
君に助ける価値がないなんて……そんなわけない
じゃないか。僕は、君を助けたかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're much more important than
you think! I wanted to save you!

fields.EN:
I wanted to save you for who you
are, Cinderella. I want you to
live...
fields.JP:
それは……君が君だから、シンデレラだから……
だから助けたいって……生きててほしいって……
だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to save you for who you
are, Cinderella. I want you to
live...

fields.EN:
So please, don't say anything like
that again!
fields.JP:
だから……これからは、
自分に価値がないなんて思わないでよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't say anything like
that again!

fields.EN:
You're a very precious person to
me and everyone else!
fields.JP:
シンデレラは、僕にとってもみんなにとっても
かけがえのない存在なんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a very precious person to
me and everyone else!

fields.EN:
You keep teaching me things, Jack-san.
You keep telling me that I'm fine,
and with a smile...
fields.JP:
……ジャックさんには、いつも教えられて
ばかりですわね。わたくしはわたくしでいいと、
いつも笑って言ってくださるんですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep teaching me things, Jack.
You keep telling me that I'm fine,
and with a smile...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Caring for myself means the same
thing as treating everyone around
me with care...
fields.JP:
自分を大切にすることが、みんなを大切に思うと
いうことなんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Caring for myself means the same
thing as treating everyone around
me with care...

fields.EN:
You teach me a lot, too. What it
means to be truly strong and
kind...
fields.JP:
僕だって……シンデレラには教えられてるんだ。
本当に強くて優しいって、どういうことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You teach me a lot, too. What it
means to be truly strong and
kind...

fields.EN:
I'm still grateful for the time
you tore your dress to treat my
wounds...
fields.JP:
大事なドレスを破ってまで、手当てしてくれた
こと……いまでも感動してるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still grateful for the time
you tore your dress to treat my
wounds...

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Oh, um... That isn't
so big of a deal.
fields.JP:
ふふ。あんなこと……大したことじゃ
ありませんわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Oh, um... That isn't
so big of a deal.

fields.EN:
Well... One day, I want to wear a
beautiful dress again for you to
lay your eyes on...
fields.JP:
でも……そうですわね。
いつかまた、綺麗な服を着たわたくしを見て
ほしいんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... One day, I want to wear a
beautiful dress again for you to
lay your eyes on...

fields.JP: ジャック！　シンデレラ！

fields.EN: Hey, you two! Are you all right?!
fields.JP:
二人ともーー！
無事だったみたいだねー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you two! Are you all right?!

fields.EN:
It looks like everyone escaped
safely...
fields.JP: みなさん……無事に脱出できたんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like everyone escaped
safely...

fields.EN:
The story here has ended, but it
seems we're not alone...
fields.JP:
物語が終わっても……僕たちは、一人じゃ
ないんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The story here has ended, but it
seems we're not alone...

fields.EN: Indeed... I will always be here...
fields.JP:
そうですわ……
わたくしも……いつもここにいますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Indeed... I will always be here...

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN: ...Yes. I'm sure... all of us will cry and laugh more naturally... It'll be a wonderful story...
fields.JP:
……そうですわね。きっと……
わたくしたちみんな、もっと自然に泣いたり
笑ったりしていく……素敵な物語ですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure the new story will be
filled with beautiful, happy
tears.

fields.EN: And... You will be with us, too...
fields.JP: そして……そこには貴方がいますのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: And... You will be with us, too...

fields.EN: It should be fine now, Gretel.
fields.JP: もう大丈夫だよ、グレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED: It should be fine now, Gretel.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Looks like we're
finally grounded.
fields.JP: あはは、やっと地に足がついた感じがするね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Looks like we're
finally grounded.

fields.EN:
Heh, indeed. In more ways than
one..
fields.JP:
ふふ……そうね。
実際、足が地面に着いたものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, indeed. In more ways than
one..

fields.EN: I'm just glad you're safe, Gretel.
fields.JP: でも、グレーテルが無事で本当によかった……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm just glad you're safe, Gretel.

fields.EN: One wrong move and we'd both have died, yet you still tried to save me. You're quite the odd one...
fields.JP:
一歩間違えれば、もろともに死ぬほかないと
いうのに、私を助けようだなんて物好きも、
大概なものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite surprised you would risk
your life to save me. You must
have developed an acquired taste.

fields.EN:
Why, yes. When I fell, you leaped
at just the right angle to catch
me in midair.
fields.JP:
ええ。私が落下を開始したとき、
あなたは的確に跳躍し、適切な角度で降下し、
そして最適のタイミングで私をキャッチした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. When I fell, you leaped
at just the right angle to catch
me in midair.

fields.EN:
I'm impressed you thought to use
the Mary Gun like that. If only I
could have recorded it all...
fields.JP:
メアリガンを使うなんて思い付きも、
あなたにしては上出来だったわね。
一部始終を記録しておきたかったくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm impressed you thought to use
the Mary Gun like that. If only I
could have recorded it all...

fields.EN:
Wow... You're so calm that it's
scaring me...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... You're so calm that it's
scaring me...

fields.EN:
I'm just kidding. In all honesty,
I wasn't in the right mindset to
think of any of that.
fields.JP:
……冗談よ。
そんなこと考えてる余裕もなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just kidding. In all honesty,
I wasn't in the right mindset to
think of any of that.

fields.EN:
(Huh? This may be the first time
I've seen Gretel like this...)
fields.JP:
（あれっ？　しおらしいグレーテルなんて、
　初めて見るかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? This may be the first time
I've seen Gretel like this...)

fields.EN:
How unusual... I'm here now with
a sense of relief that I'm alive.
fields.JP:
でも、不思議なものね。
生きてて良かったと思ってる自分がいるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unusual... I'm here now with
a sense of relief that I'm alive.

fields.EN:
After Hansel-niisan's departure, my only
goal in life was to observe
everyone.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんと別れてこのかた、
私はただ、あなたや他の人たちを観察する
ことだけが生き甲斐のようだったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
After Hansel's departure, my only
goal in life was to observe
everyone.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
And I didn't care much about my
own well-being.
fields.JP:
そもそも……
自分の生死に興味なんか無かったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I didn't care much about my
own well-being.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I wonder whose fault
this is.
fields.JP: ふふふ。誰のせいかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I wonder whose fault
this is.

fields.EN: Huh... Why are you looking at me?
fields.JP: えっ……どうしてこっち見るの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh... Why are you looking at me?

fields.EN:
Hm... If you don't know, that's
fine, too.
fields.JP:
ふうん。
気付かないのならそれでもいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... If you don't know, that's
fine, too.

fields.EN:
I think I was able to fight
because of you, Gretel...
fields.JP:
……僕も、グレーテルのおかげで
ここまで戦って来れたんだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I was able to fight
because of you, Gretel...

fields.EN:
You taught me the importance of
keeping my emotions in check. To
calmly make the right decisions.
fields.JP:
一時の感情に流されずに、冷静に物事を考えて
判断するよう、君に教わったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You taught me the importance of
keeping my emotions in check. To
calmly make the right decisions.

fields.EN:
Well, it doesn't seem like that,
considering how quickly you moved
to action when I fell.
fields.JP:
その割には、私が足を踏み外したときの
素早さといったらなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it doesn't seem like that,
considering how quickly you moved
to action when I fell.

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I just acted on
impulse, and...
fields.JP: あ、あれは……その、無我夢中で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I just acted on
impulse, and...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I'm actually
appreciative of what you've done.
fields.JP: ふふ。これでも感謝してるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I'm actually
appreciative of what you've done.

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack. Thanks to you,
I'm still here, alive.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう、ジャック。
あなたのおかげで、私はここにいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack. Thanks to you,
I'm still here, alive.

fields.EN:
(What...? She sounds amazingly
gentle right now...)
fields.JP: （えっ、なんだろう。この素直さは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What...? She sounds amazingly
gentle right now...)

fields.EN: If we'd mistimed the Mary Gun by even 0.1 seconds, we'd have hit the ground at terminal velocity by now...
fields.JP:
あのときメアリガンを使うタイミングを
コンマ1秒でも間違えてたら、今頃私たちは
終末速度で地面と接触することで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were off by even a fraction
of a second, we would have
accelerated straight downward...

fields.EN:
(Nope... This is the Gretel I
know, all right...)
fields.JP:
（いや、やっぱりグレーテルはグレーテル
　だった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nope... This is the Gretel I
know, all right...)

fields.JP: じゃっくーーーぐれーーー！
無事でよかったですー！

fields.EN: Looks like everyone made it, too.
fields.JP: どうやら、みんなも無事のようね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like everyone made it, too.

fields.EN:
I have no intention of dying ahead
of you.
fields.JP: 私、あなたより先に死ぬ気はないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of dying ahead
of you.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: だって私、あなたを研究し尽くしてないもの

fields.EN:
Uh, I'm still your research
subject...?
fields.JP: ああ、僕はまだ研究対象なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I'm still your research
subject...?

fields.JP:
『まだ』ではなく、
『これからも』、『ずっと』よ

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about
to begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about
to begin.

fields.EN:
I suppose it's not like me to say
this, but... Yes, you're right.
fields.JP: 言うだけ野暮だけれど……でも、そうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it's not like me to say
this, but... Yes, you're right.

fields.EN:
We've finally escaped from the
dark forest, and everyone has made
it back home.
fields.JP:
私たちはようやく暗い森から抜け出して、
みんなのいる家に辿り着いたんだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've finally escaped from the
dark forest, and everyone has made
it back home.

fields.EN:
And, that also marks the beginning
of a new story...
fields.JP: それも、新しい物語の始まりね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that also marks the beginning
of a new story...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, did it hurt? Maybe I
squeezed you too hard...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、痛いところはない？
……強く抱っこしちゃったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, did it hurt? Maybe I
squeezed you too hard...

fields.JP: じゃっく、ラプンツェルをたすけてくれた

（ラプンツェルが
　僕を心配してくれるなんて……）
じゃっく、たすけてくれてありがとう

ううん。
僕がラプンツェルを助けたかったんだ

fields.EN:
I would be sad if you died,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP: ラプンツェルがいなくなったら悲しいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would be sad if you died,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's sad if you died too,
Jack!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、じゃっくいなくなったら
かなしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's sad if you died too,
Jack!

fields.EN:
I like Jack, so I want you with
me!
fields.JP: じゃっくだいすきだから、いっしょにいたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like Jack, so I want you with
me!

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェル、おとなになるよ！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(What a relief... Looks like
everyone's safe...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... Looks like
everyone's safe...)

fields.EN:
Whoa! That's dangerous, jumping
on me like that!
fields.JP:
わわっ！
急に飛びつくと、危ないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! That's dangerous, jumping
on me like that!

fields.JP: へへへ……じゃっくのにおい……

fields.EN:
What's gonna happen when the
story's done, Jack?
fields.JP: じゃっく、おはなしおわったらどうなるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's gonna happen when the
story's done, Jack?

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.JP: あたらしい、ものがたり？
うん。僕らみんなの物語だよ

fields.EN:
Okay! Rapunzel's gonna be with
Jack forever!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ラプンツェル、じゃっくとずーっと
いっしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Rapunzel's gonna be with
Jack forever!

fields.EN:
That's right. We'll be together,
and you can grow up to become an
adult, just like everyone else.
fields.JP: そうだね。一緒にゆっくり、大人になっていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. We'll be together,
and you can grow up to become an
adult, just like everyone else.

fields.EN: Whew... Th-That was a close one...
fields.JP:
ふう……！！
あ、危なかったね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Whew... Th-That was a close one...

fields.EN:
What are you saying? That was
exhilarating!
fields.JP: 何を言うか。ワレは爽快であったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying? That was
exhilarating!

fields.JP: そ、そっか……それはよかったよ

fields.EN:
But, I have to admit that I didn't
expect myself, the Demon King, to
be saved by you...
fields.JP:
しかし、その……この魔王ともあろう者が
よもや助けられるとはな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have to admit that I didn't
expect myself, the Demon King, to
be saved by you...

fields.EN:
I don't really remember what I
did, but all that came to mind
was that I couldn't let you go.
fields.JP:
とっさの事だったから、よく覚えてないけど……
君だけは、離しちゃいけないって、
そう思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really remember what I
did, but all that came to mind
was that I couldn't let you go.

fields.EN:
I did bring you to where we were,
and I do want you to see more than
what you saw down there.
fields.JP:
君を地下から連れ出しちゃったし……
君にはもっと、いろんなものを見て欲しいからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did bring you to where we were,
and I do want you to see more than
what you saw down there.

fields.EN:
Jack... Without you, I would not
have been here...
fields.JP:
ジャック。貴様がいなければ……
ワレはきっと、ここにいなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Without you, I would not
have been here...

fields.EN:
W-Well, not in a physical sense.
I mean that I wouldn't have been
alive like this.
fields.JP:
そ、その……地下にいたという意味ではないぞ？
いまここに、生きて立っていなかったという……
そういう意味だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, not in a physical sense.
I mean that I wouldn't have been
alive like this.

fields.JP: ……大袈裟ではにゃい……こほん、ない

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, I have friends
now. Precious friends...
fields.JP:
貴様のおかげで……ワレには仲間ができた。
大切な仲間が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, I have friends
now. Precious friends...

fields.EN:
I spent my whole life alone, and I
now know what it's like to have
friends I care about...
fields.JP:
ずっと一人で過ごしてきたこのワレが……
仲間というものの意味を知り、それがワレにとり
存外に大切であることを知ったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I spent my whole life alone, and I
now know what it's like to have
friends I care about...

fields.EN:
I'm sure I was quite peculiar to
you when we first met.
fields.JP:
ジャック。初めて出会った頃のワレは、
さぞかし奇妙なことであったろうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure I was quite peculiar to
you when we first met.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You're a great and
wonderful Demon King, Hameln!
fields.JP:
あはは。ハーメルンは、立派な……
素敵な魔王だと思うよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You're a great and
wonderful Demon King, Hameln!

fields.JP:
ま、まあ……当然のことでありゅな！
ううっ……

fields.EN: Heeeey! Are you two all right?!
fields.JP: おーい！　二人ともーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Heeeey! Are you two all right?!

fields.JP: ジャック！　ハーメルン！

fields.EN: It seems as if everyone is safe.
fields.JP: どうやら皆、無事だったようだな
fields.LOCALIZED: It seems as if everyone is safe.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I'm so glad they're
safe...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I'm so glad they're
safe...

fields.EN:
Hmph... I extend my thanks to you
once more, Jack.
fields.JP: ……フッ。ジャック、改めて礼を言おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... I extend my thanks to you
once more, Jack.

fields.EN:
Thank you for grabbing my hand
during my fall. I didn't know the
joy of having one's hand grabbed.
fields.JP:
落ちるワレの手を取ってくれたこと……
手を繋いでもらうというのは、あれ程までに
幸せなものであったのだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for grabbing my hand
during my fall. I didn't know the
joy of having one's hand grabbed.

fields.EN:
You've got it slightly wrong
there. Hands aren't meant to be
grabbed. They're meant to be held.
fields.JP:
違うよ、ハーメルン。
手は……どっちかからじゃなくて、一緒に繋ぐ
ものなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got it slightly wrong
there. Hands aren't meant to be
grabbed. They're meant to be held.

fields.EN:
Ah, I see... Another lesson
learned. I'm grateful to have met
everyone... especially you...
fields.JP:
そうだな……また一つ教わったな……
ワレは会えてよかった……お嬢にも、みんなにも
……そして、なにより貴様にな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see... Another lesson
learned. I'm grateful to have met
everyone... especially you...

fields.EN:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの物語は終わったけど……
僕たちはこれから、新しい物語を作っていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's story ended, but our
story... Our new story is about to
begin.

fields.EN:
Our story... A story that will see
everyone together, forever.
fields.JP: ワレらみんなの……誰もどこにも去らぬ物語だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our story... A story that will see
everyone together, forever.

fields.EN: Yup. We can finally go home...
fields.JP: うん。やっと帰れたんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. We can finally go home...

fields.EN:
Well then, the new story will
begin with a party where you and
I will be together...
fields.JP:
では、物語はこのように始めよう。
まずはワレと貴様で、宴を開く……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, the new story will
begin with a party where you and
I will be together...

fields.JP: それは……博士だと思います

fields.EN: Do you think so too, Akazukin?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん。君もそう思うのかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think so too, Red Riding
Hood?

fields.EN:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?
fields.JP:
……さて、君たちが私を疑う理由を聞かせて
もらえるかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, tell me what led you to
suspect me of being a traitor?

fields.EN:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.
fields.JP:
それは、作戦があまりに博士の計画通りに
進みすぎたからです。
あたかも、何が起こるかを知っていたように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because your plans went so
smoothly. As if all of it had been
orchestrated from the beginning.

fields.EN:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.
fields.JP:
……ほう？
周到な調査が実を結んだのであれば、
それはむしろ喜ばしいことだと思うが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I was actually quite pleased
to see that our hard work and
research were paying off.

fields.EN:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.
fields.JP:
それに、ジェイルはいま……とても悦んでます。
僕らに核を破壊されたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not all. The Jail is very
pleased now... Pleased to see us
destroy the cores.

fields.EN:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?
fields.JP:
まるで、計画通りに成長することが、
嬉しいみたいに。
……そんな偶然って、あるんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pleased in a way that it seemed
like it wanted to grow as well.
Is that merely a coincidence?

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
Thinking is more important than
actual evaluation. Now then, let's
think this out a moment, shall we?
fields.JP:
考察を検証することも必要ということだ。
では、今の疑念を逆説的に考えてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking is more important than
actual evaluation. Now then, let's
think this out a moment, shall we?

fields.EN:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.
fields.JP:
脱出計画はジェイルの生態を利用したものだ。
ジェイルの本能に沿っていた方が計画が
円滑に進む…………どうかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The escape plan is based on the
ecology of the Jail. Aligning our
plans with its behavior is vital.

fields.EN:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?
fields.JP:
ジェイルの生態が先にあり、それを最大限
活用する形で計画が立案されたと考えれば、
特に違和感はないと思うが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it only be natural to
come up with a plan utilizing that
knowledge?

fields.EN:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?
fields.JP:
じ、じゃあ博士は、核を壊すとジェイルが
悦ぶって知ってたってことですよね。
……どうして知ってるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means you knew that the Jail
wanted the cores destroyed. How
would you know that?

fields.EN:
After long hours of research, not
to mention the additional
discoveries that were reported.
fields.JP:
これまでの研究の蓄積によるものだよ。
無論、君たちのおかげでわかったことも
随時脱出計画に反映している
fields.LOCALIZED:
After long hours of research, not
to mention the additional
discoveries that were reported.

fields.EN:
But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.
fields.JP:
でも、黎明が『知っている』ことと
『知らない』こと、その境目が不自然過ぎるわ。
……恣意的ですらあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what the members of the Dawn
knew and didn't know is too
unusual... Arbitrary, even.

fields.EN: For example, the 'core'... Especially with a creature we'd never seen before, I don't think that could be known from hypotheses alone.
fields.JP:
たとえば『核』のこと……初めて見る生物なら
なおさら、仮説だけで知ることができるとは
思えないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, determining an
accurate theory about the cores'
function shortly after hearing it.

fields.EN:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.
fields.JP:
そうね。これまで人類が蓄積してきた生物相の
知識に沿ったものであるならともかく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... We can only theorize off
of known biota based on knowledge
in line with our own observations.

fields.EN:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?
fields.JP:
……それは、黎明全体に対する疑念であって、
私個人に対するものではないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what you're saying is more in
relation to the Dawn itself rather
than me individually, correct?

fields.EN:
Yes. In that sense, Miko and the
others are at fault for keeping
silent about their doubts.
fields.JP:
ええ。その点は視子たちの怠慢を責めるべきね。
あなた個人の疑念となるべき内容を黙認して
いたのだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. In that sense, Miko and the
others are at fault for keeping
silent about their doubts.

fields.EN:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?
fields.JP: それとも……視子やハルも共犯なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, maybe Miko and Haru are
your cohorts?

fields.EN:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko-san
and Haru-san seemed to be hiding
something from us...)
fields.JP:
（共犯……確かに、視子さんやハルさんには、
　何かを隠しているような感じを受けてた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cohorts... It's true that Miko
and Haru seemed to be hiding
something from us...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san; ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
共犯と疑われても仕方ないのかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose it can't be helped
if we were suspected as cohorts.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.
fields.JP:
十島博士は、十五年前の惨劇を唯一生き延びた
ジェイルの権威……その見識を信じたい気持ちも
あったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the only one who survived the
tragedy 15 years ago, his vast
knowledge seemed trustworthy.

fields.EN:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.
fields.JP:
何より、計画が成功したらジェイルに何が
起きるのかを知りたかった……
研究者としての好奇心ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a researcher, I also wanted to
know what would happen to the Jail
once the plan succeeded.

fields.EN:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.
fields.JP:
それだけのために、ずっと見て見ぬ振りをしてた
んですか～？
わらわ以上の怠慢ぶりですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're telling us that you
turned a blind eye because of
that? Pretty lazy, if you ask me.

fields.EN:
I suppose. It would be difficult
to use logic in my defense when I
had acted based on trust...
fields.JP:
……そうね。
博士を信じたい気持ちと疑念を黙認する気持ち。
どちらも理性とは程遠い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose. It would be difficult
to use logic in my defense when I
had acted based on trust...

fields.EN:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.
fields.JP: 研究者として失格だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can say I'm not fit to
be a researcher.

fields.EN:
Miko-kun, it doesn't concern me that
you had your doubts while working
with me here.
fields.JP:
視子くん。君がどういう思惑で研究に携わって
いたとしても、私は構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, it doesn't concern me that
you had your doubts while working
with me here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの実態を追求するために
力を貸してくれていた同志であることに、
変わりはないのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I see you as a comrade
who helped to uncover the truths
behind the Jail.

fields.EN:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru-kun. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
そしてハルくん。それは君もだ。
君は私と同様に、ジェイルの成長を待望して
くれていた……そうだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that applies to you as well,
Haru. You were waiting to see the
Jail's growth. Isn't that right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.
fields.JP:
……違う。
俺は……あんたを止めようと、ずっと
あがいてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I've been trying to stop you
from the start.

fields.EN:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.
fields.JP:
おや……そうだったのかね？
てっきり、私と想いを同じくしてくれている
同志だと思っていたのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that so? All this time, I
thought we shared the same goals.

fields.JP: それはいささか残念な話だね。

fields.EN:
Haru-kun, would calling you a "traitor" to me
be too much of an exaggeration...? Of course,
I'm joking.
fields.JP:
ハルくんが、私にとっての
『裏切り者』だと言ったら……少し大げさかな？
……無論、冗談ではあるがね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would calling you a traitor be too
much of an exaggeration...? I'm
joking, of course...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう……
　このままじゃ、博士を追い詰められない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... I can't get
the Professor to confess...)

fields.EN:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?
fields.JP:
話が逸れてしまったが……私に対する疑いは、
以上かね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we've derailed for a
moment. Now then... Is there
anything else?

fields.EN:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……！
　以前、独房エリアで拾ったメモに違和感を
　感じたことがあったはず）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right! There was something
strange about the memo we
found...!)

fields.EN:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?
fields.JP:
僕らが見つけたあの不思議なメモ……
それを書いたのは博士でした
fields.LOCALIZED:
The unusual memo we found before
was written by you, wasn't it?

fields.EN: But, you kept that a secret.
fields.JP: でも、あなたはそれを僕らに隠していた
fields.LOCALIZED: But, you kept that a secret.

fields.EN:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.
fields.JP:
あの時も言ったが、隠していたわけではないよ。
私が忘れていたということで決着がついたと
記憶しているが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe I mentioned it then, but
I wasn't hiding anything. I simply
forgot about it.

fields.EN:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urgh...! There has to be
something else... That's
right...!)

fields.EN: That memo was referring to Akazukin-san, wasn't it?
fields.JP: これ……赤ずきんさんのことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That memo was referring to Red
Riding Hood, wasn't it?
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: "The first child was found here. According to the captain, despite being just a baby, she defeated a Marchen with her bare hands and smiled at everyone."
fields.JP:
『最初の子はここで発見したという。隊長の話
　によれば、赤子の身でありながら、素手で
　メルヒェンを倒し、皆を見て微笑んだそうだ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"The first infant was found here.
Our leader said that she killed a
Marchen with her bare hands."

fields.EN:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...
fields.JP:
う……うん。あたし、確かにお父さんから
そう聞いたんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, at least that's what Dad
told me...

fields.EN:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.
fields.JP:
『発見した時、メルヒェンを前にしても笑ってた、
　勇敢な赤ん坊だったよ』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that I was a brave baby
who smiled, even when facing a
Marchen.

fields.EN:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
『元駅構内エリア』で見つけたメモの内容は、
赤ずきんさんが博士から聞いていた内容と
食い違ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo we found at the Station
Grounds differed from what you
told Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
The memo said that the leader found
Akazukin-san, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.
fields.JP:
『隊長』が見つけた赤ずきんさんのことを、
さも自分が見つけたかのように伝えていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The memo said that the leader
found her, whereas what you said
made it seem like you found her.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(If he wasn't there when Akazukin-san was found, why would
he say that he was...?)
fields.JP:
（……でも、赤ずきんさんを見つけた時に
　その場にいなかったのなら、なんで自分が
　見つけたなんて言ったんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If he wasn't there when Red
Riding Hood was found, why would
he say that he was...?)
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)
fields.JP:
（確か博士は、記憶違いだったって言い訳してた
　けど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true that the Professor said
he just forgot...)

fields.EN: (His memory was wrong, so he thought he'd found her himself... and he'd forgotten there was a memo recording the truth.)
fields.JP:
（記憶違いで自分が見つけたと思ってて、
　その真実が書かれたメモの存在を忘れてた）

fields.EN:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)
fields.JP:
（本当にそんなことがあるのかな……？
　二つのアクシデントが重なるなんて、
　偶然にしてはできすぎてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that even possible? It can't
be a coincidence that both of
these issues would be mistaken...)

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Jack-kun? You've
been pretty quiet.
fields.JP:
どうしたね、ジャックくん。
急に黙ってしまったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Jack? You've
been pretty quiet.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.
fields.JP:
これも繰り返しになるが、
その件は私の記憶違いだったのだよ。
疑念を抱かせてしまったのは申し訳ないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm repeating myself, but
I'm sorry for my forgetfulness and
for fostering doubt among you all.

fields.EN:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)
fields.JP:
（どうすれば……一体どうすれば、
　この違和感を立証できるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What can I do to prove my
doubts...?)

fields.EN:
Isn't this enough, Jack-kun? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん……もう充分ではないかね？
こんなところで無駄な時間を使っている暇は、
私にはないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't this enough, Jack? I don't
think we have any more time to
spare here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: Later, take your time and think it through by yourself, following my advice. That should clear up most of your doubts.
fields.JP:
後でゆっくり、私のアドバイスに沿って
一人で考えてみるといい。
それで大体の疑念が解消されるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think about my earlier advice. I'm
sure that will clear any doubts
you may have toward me.

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、一つアドバイスをしよう。
考察が盲目的にならないためには、
一度その考察を逆説的に考えてみるといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give you a word of advice.
In order to prevent bias, consider
a different perspective.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)
fields.JP:
（そうか……！
　たった一つだけ、このアクシデントが
　偶然じゃなくなるケースがある……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There is something that'll
explain what happened not being
a coincidence!)

fields.JP: 博士、あなたは……本当は誰ですか？

fields.EN:
What if my doubts about the memo
were true?
fields.JP:
あなたのアドバイスを元に考えてみたんです。
メモに対する疑念が、逆にどれも『真実』だと
したらって
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if my doubts about the memo
were true?

fields.EN:
You did find Akazukin-san with
the leader.
fields.JP:
……あなたは『隊長』と一緒に、
赤ずきんさんを見つけていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did find Red Riding Hood with
the leader.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.
fields.JP:
そして、博士がメモを残していたことを
知らなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you didn't remember leaving a
memo behind.

fields.EN:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.
fields.JP:
答えは一つです。
あなたは、博士ではない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only way that both could be
possible is... you're not the
Professor.

fields.EN:
You were someone else in the party
when Akazukin-san was found.
fields.JP:
そして、赤ずきんさんが発見された時の
調査に同行していた誰かだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were someone else in the party
when Red Riding Hood was found.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Tohjima?
fields.JP:
それでは聞こう。
どうやって、私が十島でないことを立証する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask you a question, then.
How can you prove that I'm not
Professor Tohjima?

fields.EN:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)
fields.JP:
（博士が偽者であることを立証できる何か。
　僕は、それを提示できるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do I have something that could
prove the Professor here is fake?)

fields.EN:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ある！
　今の博士と、本物の博士を比較できるものが
　僕の持ち物の中に……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I do...! I have something with me
that I can use as proof!)

fields.EN:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...
fields.JP:
それにしても……こんなもの独房エリアに
落ちてるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect something like
this to be found in this area...

fields.EN: I wonder who wrote this memo...
fields.JP: このメモ、いったい誰が書いたのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder who wrote this memo...

fields.EN:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.
fields.JP:
かなり綺麗な字だよね……！
あたし、そんなに字がうまくないから
……ちょっとうらやましいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is written nicely. I'm a
bit jealous... My penmanship is
pretty horrible.

fields.EN:
From the looks of it, it seems
like the person who wrote it was
very studious.
fields.JP:
ええ。筆跡を見る限り、ずいぶんと几帳面な
人が書いたように思えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the looks of it, it seems
like the person who wrote it was
very studious.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.JP:
そんなものを私に突きつけて、
一体どうしようと言うんだね？

え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……

fields.EN:
I haven't been this disappointed
in you, Jack.
fields.JP: ジャック……あなたにはガッカリしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't been this disappointed
in you, Jack.

fields.EN: This is proof that you're a fake!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あなたが偽者である証拠はこれです！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is proof that you're a fake!

fields.EN:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!
fields.JP:
それは、博士が書いてくれた
ホオノキの葉のメモ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the memo Professor wrote
about the magnolia leaves!

fields.EN:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.
fields.JP: そんなものがあったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you had such a thing
with you.

fields.EN:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)
fields.JP:
（そう。これは唯一、今の博士が書いた
　ものなんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the only item that was
written by the Professor
himself...!)

fields.EN:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.
fields.JP: ええ。こういう形状の葉を付けるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The leaves look like this
drawing.

fields.EN:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.
fields.JP:
まあ……
葉の形状が外の世界にあるホオノキに似てるから
黎明でそう呼んでるだけなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we just call them magnolia
leaves because they look similar
to the ones in the outside world.

fields.EN:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...
fields.JP:
これ……お父さんが書いたやつだね！
相変わらず字がへたくそだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This looks like Dad's! Yikes, his
penmanship is sloppy as usual...

fields.EN:
Compare this with the memo about Akazukin-san. You can clearly tell
that the handwriting is different.
fields.JP:
これと、赤ずきんさんのことが書かれたメモ……
比べれば、明らかに筆跡が違うことがわかります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can clearly tell that your
memo and what we found are
different.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Tohjima!
fields.JP:
これが、あなたが十島博士ではないことの
証拠です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is proof that you're not
Professor Tohjima!

fields.EN:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?
fields.JP:
なかなかの名推理だが……
証拠としては弱いのではないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite interesting... But isn't
that evidence too insufficient to
be considered proof?

fields.EN:
I was hurt badly in the tragedy 15
years ago. Miko-kun cared for me, so
she would remember my wounds.
fields.JP:
私は、十五年前の惨劇で大怪我を負ってね。
治療してくれた視子くんは知っているが、
顔にあるのもその時の傷だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hurt badly in the tragedy 15
years ago. Miko cared for me, so
she would remember my wounds.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...
fields.JP: え、ええ……それは確かにそうだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... He did get badly injured
back then...

fields.EN:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.
fields.JP:
これまで皆には黙っていたのだが……
その時の後遺症で、私の右手は若干不自由でね。
以前のようには動かないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't bring it up before, but
since that time, my right hand
doesn't move as much as before.

fields.EN:
That's the reason my handwriting
looks different. I only didn't
want to bring up my past injuries.
fields.JP:
筆跡が違うように見えるのはそのせいだろう。
保身のために過去の失態を自ら語るなど、
恥ずべきことかもしれんがね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the reason my handwriting
looks different. I only didn't
want to bring up my past injuries.

fields.EN:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack-kun?
fields.JP: ジャックくん……わかってくれたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that answer your doubts,
Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)
fields.JP:
（どんなに追求しても、
　あの手この手でかわされる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's finding excuses for
everything I'm pitting against
him...)

fields.EN:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Isn't there anything else I can
say...?)

fields.EN:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.
fields.JP:
まだよ、ジャック。
あなたはもう一つ武器を持っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not yet, Jack. You still have one
more thing with you.

fields.EN:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.
fields.JP:
思い出して。なぜ黎明に裏切り者がいると
思ったのか……私との会話を……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember what we talked about...
Remember why I thought there
was a traitor in the Dawn.

fields.EN:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The conversation with Gretel... I
remember now!)

fields.EN:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?
fields.JP:
他のエリアには必ずあった『眼』が、
あの場所にはなかったことが関係あるとは
思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did it ever dawn on you that the
area I was in didn't have that
"eye" you made mention of before?

fields.EN:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.
fields.JP:
もう一つ言えば……あの場所には、
ずっと誰も入ってこれなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. No one had been
able to enter that area for quite
a while.

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.
fields.JP:
黎明の誰かがジェイルと通じていて、
ジェイルの中や私たちのことを監視している……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe someone in the Dawn is
working with the Jail and is
monitoring us.

fields.EN: Has that ever occurred to you?
fields.JP: ……そうは思ってみたことはない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Has that ever occurred to you?

fields.EN:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)
fields.JP: （あの時は意識してなかったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It didn't dawn on me back then,
but...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルは、あの『眼』を監視と結びつけて
　考えていた……そう考えれば……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Gretel already connected
the eye with being monitored... If
so...)

fields.EN:
Professor? Do you know what those
"eyes" in the different areas are
for?
fields.JP:
博士……独房エリアにある巨大な『眼』……
あれがなんだか知っていますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor? Do you know what those
"eyes" in the different areas are
for?

fields.EN:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)
fields.JP:
（多分あの『眼』は、ある場所に大きく
　関係してるはず……その場所は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The eye is strongly connected to
its location...)

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『僕の部屋』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to my room at the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack-kun, I'm very
disappointed in you.
fields.JP:
私にはそうは思えないが？
……ジャックくん、これ以上失望させないで
くれたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't think that's
correct. Jack, I'm very
disappointed in you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP:
え？　あ、あれ？
えーと……
ジャック……あなたを信じてたのに……

fields.EN:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.
fields.JP:
……博士。
僕とアリスは以前、研究室の奥で不思議な
部屋を見つけました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and I found an unusual room
in the laboratory.

fields.EN:
The room showed screens of various
areas. I believe those images were
captured through the eyes.
fields.JP:
独房エリアのあちこちが映ってる部屋です。
それは恐らく、独房エリアの壁にある
『眼』から見えるものを映していた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The room showed screens of various
areas. I believe those images were
captured through the eyes.

fields.EN:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!
fields.JP: あなたは、あの部屋で全てを見ていたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were monitoring everything
from that room!

fields.JP:
あの、この間…ナイトメアが、
喋ったことについてなんですが……

fields.EN:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.
fields.JP:
ああ……その件なのだがね……
それは驚いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Well, that caught me by
surprise.

fields.EN:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.
fields.JP:
よかった……
ちゃんとくららが伝えてくれたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, good... So Clara was
able to relay the information to
you.

fields.EN:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?
fields.JP:
何だ、くららがどうかしたのか？
……視子、知ってるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about Clara? Do you know
something, Miko?

fields.EN:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Akazukin-san
told them...)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　くららじゃなかったのか。
　じゃあ、赤ずきんさんあたりかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? He didn't hear it from
Clara? Maybe Red Riding Hood
told them...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
You knew about the Nightmare
before we even reported it to you.
fields.JP:
あなたは、ナイトメアが喋ったことを
僕らが報告していないのに知っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew about the Nightmare
before we even reported it to you.

fields.EN: ...Marchens born from the mimicry of pregnant humans carried children in their wombs who remained human.
fields.JP:
……人間の妊婦が擬態させられた
ことで生まれたメルヒェンは、胎内に
人間のままの子を宿していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that Marchens created
by the Jail's mimicry of pregnant
humans doesn't affect the infant.

fields.EN:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.
fields.JP:
つまり、いくらジェイルでも胎内の子まで
擬態させることは不可能だったのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, it's impossible
for the Jail to use mimicry on the
infant carried by its mother.

fields.EN:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.
fields.JP:
そのメルヒェンたちは、そのまま胎内で
子を育て……胎を破って生まれてきた
子たちは、人間には無い能力を備えていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those Marchens continue to nurture
their infants until they burst
out, possessing special powers.

fields.EN:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.
fields.JP:
そして逆に、僕らが血式少女の出生の秘密を
知った時には、タイミングよく博士から
話があった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oddly enough, you also spoke about
the origin of the Blood Maidens
just after we found out.

fields.EN:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguyahime spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!
fields.JP:
それは……黎明の外で、僕らがかぐや姫から
秘密を聞いたことを知らなかったからだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You brought it up, not knowing
that Kaguya spoke to us about it
outside of the Dawn!

fields.EN:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……あの時はなぜあのタイミングで
　博士が喋ったのかわからなかったけど、
　今ならわかる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know why the Professor
brought it up back then, but now I
do...)

fields.EN:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.
fields.JP:
独房エリアでラプンツェルの話から
僕らが秘密に気づけば、それをあえて
黙っていた博士に疑念が向く
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we learned about Rapunzel's
origin, we would have suspected
you for keeping it secret.

fields.EN:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?
fields.JP:
あなたはそれを恐れた。
違いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't want us to doubt you.
Isn't that right, Professor?

fields.EN:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.
fields.JP:
なるほど……
見事な考察だ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Your assumptions are
quite valid.

fields.EN:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.
fields.JP:
あの『眼』は、ジェイルの調査をする者の
安全を期すために設置したものだとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those eyes are there to monitor
the safety of our units
investigating the Jail.

fields.EN:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.
fields.JP:
かつての調査隊が、各独房エリアの調査を
進めると共に、あの『眼』を設置したのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We placed those eyes in the areas
during our expeditions long ago.

fields.EN:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.
fields.JP:
一見、筋が通っているように聞こえるわね。
私の家には、確かにあの『眼』はなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That statement seems reasonable. I
don't recall seeing any eyes
around my home.

fields.EN:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.
fields.JP: 黎明が調査を断念した……私の家には、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corroborated by the Dawn ceasing
its deployment of units there.

fields.EN: Does that make sense to you?
fields.LOCALIZED: Does that make sense to you?

fields.EN:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)
fields.JP:
（どんなに証拠を突きつけても
　通用しない……どうすればいいんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything I'm pitting against
him isn't working... What should I
do?)

fields.EN:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?
fields.JP:
ジャック、今の話……何かおかしいわ。
あれだけ大量の『眼』を、そんなにすんなり
設置できるものかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... That doesn't make sense.
Is it even possible to set up that
many eyes so easily?

fields.EN:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……ここであきらめちゃだめだ。
　これは、絶対に負けられない戦いなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I can't give up.
I can't end it like this...)

fields.EN:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと時間をとられてしまったが、
理解してもらえたようで私も嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems we spent quite some time
discussing this, but I'm glad to
know we're all in agreement now.

fields.EN:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?
fields.JP:
……いいえ、まだです。
仮に調査隊があの『眼』を取り付けたとして、
なぜジェイルはされるがままだったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not yet... If those eyes were
installed there by us, why did the
Jail allow it?

fields.EN:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?
fields.JP:
なぜメルヒェンやナイトメアは、
あの『眼』を壊そうとしなかったんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why didn't the Marchens or the
Nightmares try to destroy those
eyes?

fields.EN:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!
fields.JP:
それこそが、あなたがジェイルと通じている
大きな証拠だ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's further proof that you were
working with the Jail!

fields.EN:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.
fields.JP:
スナークは、ナイトメアとトランシーバーで
連絡をとっていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snark was communicating with the
Nightmares using a transceiver.

fields.EN:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...
fields.JP:
恐らく……メルヒェンに人間を捕らえさせ、
拷問にかけるために
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe that was done so that
you could command the Marchens
to capture humans...

fields.EN:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!
fields.JP: 拷問の目的は、ジェイルを成長させるためだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...And torture them to spur the
Jail's growth!

fields.EN:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.
fields.JP: 脱出計画との目的とも一致しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would match the escape plan's
objective as well.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: 何のことかね、ハルくん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
They... Jack did the best he
could.
fields.JP: こいつらは……ジャックはよくやった
fields.LOCALIZED:
They... Jack did the best he
could.

fields.JP: ここまでお前を追い詰めたじゃねえか

fields.EN:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.
fields.JP:
俺は、今の今までお前が考えを翻すのを
期待していたんだが……どうやら
無駄だったみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping you would change your
mind, but I suppose that isn't
going to happen.

fields.EN:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.
fields.JP:
……失ったものは二度と戻って来ない。
あきらめるんだ、スナーク
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't replace what was lost.
Just give it up, Snark.

fields.EN:
This whole scheme of creating a
team to abuse after finding Akazukin has gone too far.
fields.JP:
お前は、赤ずきんを発見したことで、
使い捨てになる実働部隊の可能性に気づき、
十五年前の策略を思いついた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This whole scheme of creating a
team to abuse after finding Red
Riding Hood has gone too far.

fields.EN:
You replaced Professor Tohjima,
you came up with this escape
plan...
fields.JP:
それを実行して十島博士に成り代わり、
脱出計画を立案したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You replaced Professor Tohjima,
you came up with this escape
plan...

fields.EN:
