And things went well in finding
new Blood Maidens to do your
bidding.
fields.JP:
なるほど、お前は血式少女たちを効率的に
集め導いていった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And things went well in finding
new Blood Maidens to do your
bidding.

fields.EN:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.
fields.JP:
以前、血式部隊を二手に分けようとしたのは、
そろそろ仕上げにかかり、用済みだと考えた
からだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing you wanted to
separate them because you thought
you were done with their services.

fields.EN:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?
fields.JP:
……そうだ。君たち……
今回はチームを分けてみないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. Why don't you all separate
into teams this time?

fields.EN: And why do you suggest that?
fields.JP: それは……どうしてですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: And why do you suggest that?

fields.EN:
With Kaguyahime and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.
fields.JP:
なに、せっかくかぐや姫とシンデレラという
強力な戦力が行動可能になったわけだしね。
今の君たちなら、何も全員で行くこともあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Kaguya and Cinderella in the
group now, you won't all need to
move together like before.

fields.EN:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.
fields.JP:
大きな作戦も続いたところだ。
一方のチームが調査に赴いている間、もう一方は
ささやかだが休暇を取るのも良いかと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is still far off. I think
it would make sense to have a team
head in while the other rests.

fields.EN:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...
fields.JP:
やれやれ……獅子身中の虫とは、
まさにこのことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...

fields.JP: お父さん……否定、してくれないんだ……

fields.EN: ...Let me say this one last time.
fields.JP: ……最後にもう一度だけ言わせてもらう

fields.EN:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.
fields.JP:
考え直せ。全ては変化していくんだ。
何もかもがお前の掌中にあるわけじゃない。
この星と共に生きることを考えろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.

fields.EN:
What are you talking about, Haru-san?
What do you mean by "planet"...?
fields.JP:
……何の話ですか、ハルさん。
『この星』って、まるで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about, Haru?
What do you mean by "planet"...?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...
fields.JP:
ああ。俺たちは、とある滅んだ星から
ここに流れ着いたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here from a different
planet that was destroyed long
ago...

fields.EN:
He was controlling the creature
found on our planet, so that it
would mature to do his bidding.
fields.JP:
こいつは、勝手知ったる同じ星の生物を
操ってたんだ。こいつの願う完成形に向けて
育つようにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was controlling the creature
found on our planet, so that it
would mature to do his bidding.

fields.JP: にわかには……信じられない話だわ……

fields.EN:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.
fields.JP:
だが、ジェイルはこの星との共生を選んだ。
もう物語は終わったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Jail decided to coexist
with this planet. Our story ended
there.

fields.EN:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?
fields.JP: ……まだ終わっていないと言ったら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if I said our story hasn't
ended yet?

fields.EN:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.
fields.JP:
……君には失望したよ。
やはり、私にとっての裏切者は君だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You disappoint me, Haru. You
truly are a traitor.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.
fields.JP: さて。用済みの玩具には退場願おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.

fields.EN:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!
fields.JP:
使える銃がまだ残っていたなんて……！
みんな、気をつけて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.
fields.JP:
なに、このままじっとしていてくれれば何も
しないよ。面倒だからね。
何なら塔を降りてくれても構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.

fields.EN:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.
fields.JP: 私は私で、目的を叶えることにしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.

fields.EN:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...
fields.JP:
お父さんが昔のお父さんじゃなくても、
あたしにとっては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...

fields.EN:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Akazukin. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.
fields.JP:
君には大いに感謝しているよ、赤ずきん。
私の計画は、君のおかげで大きく前進
することになったのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Red Riding Hood. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.

fields.EN:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...
fields.JP: ……みんな。博士を……スナークを追おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, let's go after the
Professor. No... After Snark...

fields.EN:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.
fields.JP:
待て。お前たちに一つ伝えておかなきゃ
ならんことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. There's one other thing you
all need to know.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.
fields.JP:
奴の目的は、この塔……ジェイルの『受精』に
よる、世界の塗り替えだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
His objective is to change the
world using this tower... Using
the Jail for insemination.

fields.EN:
He's trying to revive what was
lost on our planet.
fields.JP:
滅んじまった俺たちの星を蘇らせようと
してるのさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's trying to revive what was
lost on our planet.

fields.EN:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?
fields.JP:
それがジェイルの『受精』とどういう関係が
あるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What does that have to do with
the Jail's insemination?

fields.EN:
A new life is born through
insemination. A brand new core...
fields.JP:
『受精』によって誕生するのは、新たな生命……
真新しい、最大級の『核』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A new life is born through
insemination. A brand new core...

fields.EN:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.
fields.JP:
そしてジェイルの核は『擬態』する。
『想い』という無形のものさえも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's core uses mimicry to
bring shape to things, even
desires.

fields.EN:
Yes, just like how the Jail
brought to life characters from
storybooks...
fields.JP:
そうね。このジェイルが童話の絵本たちの想いを
擬態することで生まれたように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, just like how the Jail
brought to life characters from
storybooks...

fields.EN:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...
fields.JP:
そして、わたしがそれを読んだ子供たちの想いを
擬態させられて生まれた存在なように
fields.LOCALIZED:
And like how I was born from the
desires of the children who read
those storybooks...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...
fields.JP: お前……『転生体』だったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're a reincarnated form,
then...

fields.EN:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...
fields.JP:
あの始まりの場所で、はっきりとわかったの。
今のわたしの生は、あの場所……幼稚園があった
場所から始まったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found out where I came from...
I came from where a preschool once
stood long ago...

fields.EN:
It seems I was mimicked to life
without my knowledge by the blue
bird... by Snark...
fields.JP:
でも、自分でも気づかないうちにさらに
擬態していたのね……
青い鳥……スナークの操り人形として……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I was mimicked to life
without my knowledge by the blue
bird... by Snark...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、千昭……わたし、あなたのことを
苦しめてばかりのお姉さんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Chiaki, for all the
suffering I've caused you. I'm
such a bad sister...

fields.EN:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...
fields.JP:
……スナークは、新たに生まれる核に擬態させる
つもりなのね。
あの人の望む世界を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Snark is planning to use the
Jail's mimicry on the new core.
To bring about a new world...

fields.EN:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...
fields.JP:
ああ。
俺はこの星との共生を考え、最後の最後まで
あいつの考えを変えさせようとしたんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I tried to convince him to
change his ways and coexist with
this world, but...

fields.EN:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.
fields.JP:
そのせいでお前たちにも迷惑をかけたな
……本当にすまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess I made more trouble than I
fixed... Sorry, everyone.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!
fields.JP:
さあ、急ごう！
あいつが最後の仕上げに使おうとしてるのは
……信者たちの命だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hurry! He's gonna finish
this up by using the followers'
lives!

fields.EN:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!
fields.JP:
おそらく、このフロアのどこかに監禁されてる
筈だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they're being held
somewhere on this floor!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『研究室』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Laboratory in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『血式兵器製造所』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Blood Factory in
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『タイヨウ本部』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Order's HQ in the
Liberated District!

fields.EN:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
……博士。
あの『眼』は開放地区の『浄化場』と
大きく関係しています！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor... Those eyes are
connected to the Purging Center in
the Liberated District!

fields.EN:
This is a story before the closing
of a story... A fragment of a
story that may have existed.
fields.JP:
これは物語が閉じられる前の物語……
あったかもしれない、もう一つの物語の欠片。
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a story before the closing
of a story... A fragment of a
story that may have existed.

fields.JP: どうやら、みんな揃ったみたいね

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't think you needed to
squeeze everyone in here.
fields.JP:
なにも、この部屋に全員集める必要は
なかったんじゃねえのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't think you needed to
squeeze everyone in here.

fields.JP: 息苦しくてかなわねえよ……

fields.EN:
It's just more efficient to speak
with everyone at once.
fields.JP:
メンバー全員に話しておいた方が、
説明が一度で済むでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just more efficient to speak
with everyone at once.

fields.EN:
Um, and what is it that you wanted
to talk about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, and what is it that you wanted
to talk about?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry. I gathered everyone
here to ask a favor.
fields.JP:
ああ、ごめんなさい。
あなたたちにお願いしたいことが
あって来てもらったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry. I gathered everyone
here to ask a favor.

fields.EN:
What I'm going to talk about is
what I heard from the refugees, so
I'm not sure how accurate it is...
fields.JP:
避難民たちからの情報でね、
どの程度信頼できるのかは正直
わからないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I'm going to talk about is
what I heard from the refugees, so
I'm not sure how accurate it is...

fields.EN:
...It seems as if there's an
underground cavern somewhere
in the Jail.
fields.JP: 独房エリアに地下洞窟があるっていう話なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
...It seems as if there's an
underground cavern somewhere
in the Jail.

fields.EN:
And if that's true, that means
there's an uncharted area the Dawn
is unaware of.
fields.JP:
もし、本当の話なら……
黎明では把握していないエリアになる
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if that's true, that means
there's an uncharted area the Dawn
is unaware of.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised there would be an
area that the Dawn wouldn't know
about.
fields.JP:
黎明でも把握してない場所があるなんて、
驚きですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised there would be an
area that the Dawn wouldn't know
about.

fields.EN:
The only areas the Dawn knows are
those we sent our units to. There
may be others still unknown.
fields.JP:
まあぶっちゃけ、黎明が把握しているのは、
過去の調査隊が発見したものだけだからな。
知らない場所があっても不思議じゃねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only areas the Dawn knows are
those we sent our units to. There
may be others still unknown.

fields.EN:
That almost sounds like we're only
relying on what was done in the
past.
fields.JP:
なによそれ。
つまり、ほとんど昔の人頼みだって話じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That almost sounds like we're only
relying on what was done in the
past.

fields.EN:
It just means that the casualties
from 15 years ago were that
profound...
fields.JP:
それは……十五年前の事件が黎明に及ぼした
人的被害が、それだけ甚大だったという
ことなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means that the casualties
from 15 years ago were that
profound...

fields.EN: After that, most of our work was follow-up investigation. Our only real achievements were researching the Blood Maidens and organizing their unit...
fields.JP:
その後の活動はほとんど追跡調査のみで、
唯一の成果といったら、血式少女の研究と
その部隊の編成くらいだったものね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We chose to conduct research in
well-traversed areas, building our
knowledge of the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Well, gotta hand it to you. With
all of you around, we were finally
able to get out of that rut.
fields.JP:
まあ、お前らのおかげで、ようやくまた
ぼちぼち歩みを進めることができてるってな。
……感謝してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, gotta hand it to you. With
all of you around, we were finally
able to get out of that rut.

fields.EN:
It sounds fake, coming from you...
In fact, your gratitude sounds
cold and unnerving...
fields.JP:
そなたが言うと嘘くさいです～
むしろ寒いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds fake, coming from you...
In fact, your gratitude sounds
cold and unnerving...

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah... So, what we wanted to
ask was for y'all to go and
investigate the area.
fields.JP:
あ、ああ……
んで、手間をとらせて悪いんだけどな……
お前らに調査を頼みたいわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah... So, what we wanted to
ask was for y'all to go and
investigate the area.

fields.EN:
I believe you are referring to my
castle - the underground
labyrinth!
fields.JP:
それはおそらく、ワレの城たる地下迷宮の
ことではなかろうか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe you are referring to my
castle - the underground
labyrinth!

fields.EN:
That's possible, since the
information we received was a bit
unreliable in terms of positions.
fields.JP:
確かに……その可能性もあるわね。
避難民の情報ではエリアの位置があいまい
だったから、断定はできないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's possible, since the
information we received was a bit
unreliable in terms of positions.

fields.EN:
But from what they said, they
heard an eerie voice coming from
underneath.
fields.JP:
話によれば、地下の奥底から、
うめき声みたいなものが聞こえてくると
いうのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But from what they said, they
heard an eerie voice coming from
underneath.

fields.EN:
That sounds more like a horror
story...
fields.JP: なんだか……怖いお話ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds more like a horror
story...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... There may be something
in wait for us to discover.
fields.JP:
ふふ。何か意外なものが、
見つかるかもしれないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... There may be something
in wait for us to discover.

fields.EN:
What the...?! Stop saying it as if
it's going to get us!
fields.JP:
何言ってるんですか～！
不吉なこと言わないでください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?! Stop saying it as if
it's going to get us!

fields.EN:
Oh, come on, it's probably
nothing.
fields.JP: どうせ、大したことないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on, it's probably
nothing.

fields.EN:
Adventure to labyrinth! We need
lunches!
fields.JP:
めーきゅーたんけんだね！
おべんとうがいるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Adventure to labyrinth! We need
lunches!

fields.EN:
Well, I guess we can check the
place out!
fields.JP: ま、そういうことなら仕方ないね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess we can check the
place out!

fields.EN:
Don't get too excited. Who knows
what danger lies ahead...
fields.JP:
面白半分は良くないわ。
思わぬ危険が待ち受けているのかも
しれないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't get too excited. Who knows
what danger lies ahead...

fields.EN:
Why, yes, that is quite possible.
You all need to be very careful,
you hear?
fields.JP:
ええ、その可能性も否定できないわ。
十分に注意してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes, that is quite possible.
You all need to be very careful,
you hear?

fields.EN:
(Eerie voice... I wonder what
that's about...)
fields.JP: （うめき声……一体何がいるんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Eerie voice... I wonder what
that's about...)

fields.EN:
Oh? I'm surprised to find a place
like this in my abode!
fields.JP:
ほう……我が迷宮にこのような場所が
あったとは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I'm surprised to find a place
like this in my abode!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオオオォオ……！

fields.EN:
Yikes! I hear some sort of moaning
coming from far away...
fields.JP:
ひっ！
遠くからうめき声が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes! I hear some sort of moaning
coming from far away...

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm not getting good vibes
from this... What a chore...
fields.JP:
あー、すごく嫌な予感がします～。
面倒臭いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm not getting good vibes
from this... What a chore...

fields.JP: ええ。ナイトメアの気配を感じるわ……
ラプンツェルもかんじるー！！

fields.EN:
Huh? The heck are you saying? It's
not like we know it's really a
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
はあ？　あんたたち、何言ってんのよ。
まだなんなのか、わからないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? The heck are you saying? It's
not like we know it's really a
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
No... There's a Nightmare here...
I can sense it, too...
fields.JP:
いいえ…‥いるわ、ナイトメアが。
わたしも感じるもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... There's a Nightmare here...
I can sense it, too...

fields.EN:
How dare it live without my
knowledge! It must be punished!
fields.JP: ワレの許可なしに住み着くとは……許せんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare it live without my
knowledge! It must be punished!

fields.EN:
Well, if it's a Nightmare, there's
nothing to worry about.
fields.JP:
あら。でもナイトメアなら、怖れることは
ないじゃありませんの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if it's a Nightmare, there's
nothing to worry about.

fields.EN:
Right! All we have to do is beat
it to a pulp!
fields.JP:
まあ、そうね。
邪魔なヤツはぶっ潰すのみよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! All we have to do is beat
it to a pulp!

fields.EN:
But if there's a Nightmare, that
means there's a core too, right?
What should we do, Aka-neesama?
fields.JP:
……ナイトメアがいるってことは……
当然、核も存在するってことですよね？
赤姉様、どうしましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if there's a Nightmare, that
means there's a core too, right?
What should we do, Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Well, our gals here are saying
they sense something, so it must
be true. Let's look for that core.
fields.JP:
勘の鋭い連中が口を揃えて言ってるんだから、
まず間違いないね……
とりあえず、核を探そう。奥へ進むよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, our gals here are saying
they sense something, so it must
be true. Let's look for that core.

fields.EN:
I thought the area felt different
than usual, but I guess a core
being here doesn't change...
fields.JP:
他のエリアとはどこか雰囲気が違うと思って
ましたけど、やっぱり核はあるんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought the area felt different
than usual, but I guess a core
being here doesn't change...

fields.EN:
I can't believe something like
that existed within my abode!
fields.JP:
このようなモノが、我が迷宮にも存在していた
とは……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe something like
that existed within my abode!

fields.EN:
Now that we've found it, I guess
we need to take care of it. What a
chore...
fields.JP:
見つけてしまったものは仕方ないです～。
面倒臭いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we've found it, I guess
we need to take care of it. What a
chore...

fields.EN:
It doesn't matter where we found
it. If we find one, we destroy it.
Simple as that!
fields.JP:
どこにあろうと関係ないじゃない？
核は見つけ次第、破壊……それだけよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't matter where we found
it. If we find one, we destroy it.
Simple as that!

fields.JP: ぐるるる……！　ばんにん、きたよ！！

fields.EN: My, my, how quick it is.
fields.LOCALIZED: My, my, how quick it is.

fields.EN: I guess this is the same, too...
fields.JP: そうなりますよね、やっぱり……
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess this is the same, too...

fields.JP: みんな、気を引き締めて！

fields.EN: All right then. Let's do this!
fields.JP: そうだね……みんな、こっちから行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right then. Let's do this!

fields.JP: ジョォォオオオオオオ……！
今のは……ジェイルの鳴き声？

fields.EN:
But, it sounded different than
usual...
fields.JP: なんだか、いつもと声が違う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it sounded different than
usual...

fields.EN:
W-Well, no use thinking at this
point! At least we can beat the
Nightmare now!
fields.JP:
ま、まあいいじゃない！
これでナイトメアを倒せることには
変わりないんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, no use thinking at this
point! At least we can beat the
Nightmare now!

fields.EN:
We should be careful, just in
case.
fields.JP: とりあえず、油断はしない方がよさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should be careful, just in
case.

fields.EN:
Right! Let's keep an eye out for
anything!
fields.JP: そうだね、慎重に行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! Let's keep an eye out for
anything!

fields.JP:
すんすん……ないとめあ、いない……
……ちかくにいるはずなのに

fields.EN:
Hmph... Let me beckon it here.
Nightmaaaaaare!
fields.JP:
ふ……ワレがひとつ呼んでみよう。
ナイトメ…‥あああああああッ～～～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Let me beckon it here.
Nightmaaaaaare!

fields.EN:
The place turned dark all of a
sudden!
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place turned dark all of a
sudden!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオオオォオ……！

fields.EN: So, are you able to talk?
fields.JP: ねえ。あなた……話はできる？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, are you able to talk?

fields.JP: ヒォォォオオオオオオォオ……！

fields.EN:
Gretel! This is no time to be
talking!
fields.JP:
グレーテル！
そんなことしてる場合じゃないってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel! This is no time to be
talking!

fields.EN:
Oh, but inquisitiveness shouldn't
be constrained by time.
fields.JP: あら。どんな時にでも探究心は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but inquisitiveness shouldn't
be constrained by time.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi! Get ready! Alice and
Gretel! Attack from the sides!
Everyone else, support us!
fields.JP:
親指！　ナイトメアを抑えて！
アリス！　グレーテル！　両翼から攻撃！
ジャックは前衛三人のフォローを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby! Get ready! Alice and
Gretel! Attack from the sides!
Everyone else, support us!

fields.EN: Let's do this! Bring it on!
fields.JP:
上等だわ！
やってやろうじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's do this! Bring it on!

fields.EN:
Hameln, you're free to do what
you want as long as you don't go
overboard!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは……無茶しない範囲内で
好きにしてよし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, you're free to do what
you want as long as you don't go
overboard!

fields.EN:
It looks like it's going to go
down soon!
fields.JP: よし。相手は弱ってきたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like it's going to go
down soon!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオォォオ……！

fields.EN: H-Hey wait! Wait up, you coward!
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと……コラ！
ま、待ちなさいよ！　卑怯者！
fields.LOCALIZED: H-Hey wait! Wait up, you coward!

fields.EN:
Hmph... It must have succumbed to
fear in my presence!
fields.JP: フッ……ワレの武威を怖れたのであろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... It must have succumbed to
fear in my presence!

fields.JP: それにしても、変なナイトメアですね～

fields.EN:
It responded differently from the
others we've faced before.
fields.JP: これまでのナイトメアとは、反応が違うわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It responded differently from the
others we've faced before.

fields.EN: S-So what should we do now?
fields.JP: そ……それで、どうするんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: S-So what should we do now?

fields.EN:
We're gonna chase it down! Let's
go, everyone!
fields.JP:
当然、追いかけるさ！
みんな！　追撃するよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're gonna chase it down! Let's
go, everyone!

fields.JP: ヒォォォォオオオオォオ……
ないとめあ、みつけたぞーーーー！

fields.EN:
You're one troublesome fellow,
aren't you?
fields.JP: ずいぶん手間をかけさせてくれたじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're one troublesome fellow,
aren't you?

fields.JP: わはははは！　観念するがよいぞ！

fields.EN:
It's hurt, but be careful... Let's
finish it off!
fields.JP:
相手は手負いだ……みんな、注意して。
一気にケリをつけるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hurt, but be careful... Let's
finish it off!

fields.JP: オォォォォオオオオォオ……！！
オォォォォォォオォォ……

fields.EN:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアは倒せたけど……
　なんだろう、この釈然としない感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)

fields.JP: これで、一件落着ですね

fields.EN:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...
fields.JP:
それより……ずいぶん奥まで来てしまい
ましたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...

fields.EN:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...
fields.JP: 戻るのが大変そうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.
fields.JP:
……あー。降りたり昇ったり、ずいぶん
走らされたからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.

fields.EN:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?
fields.JP:
さすがに地下じゃなさそうだし、
どの辺りなんだろ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?

fields.EN:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.
fields.JP:
その辺りをブチ抜いたら、
どこかのエリアに出られるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.

fields.EN:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...
fields.JP: そういうことなら、ワレが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...

fields.EN:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ！
そんなことしたら、あちこち崩れたりする
かもしれないし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.

fields.JP: グレーテル、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.
fields.JP:
このエリアには……他と違う点がいくつか
あったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.

fields.JP: まず、ここだけ地下にありますね～

fields.EN:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.
fields.JP:
それに、核を壊した時のジェイルの鳴き声が、
いつもと違いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.

fields.EN:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.
fields.JP: ナイトメアは、戦ってる途中に逃げ出したしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.

fields.EN: Yes, it looks like a window.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, it looks like a window.

fields.EN:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.
fields.JP:
瓦礫で埋まってますけど。
ここって建物の中だったんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.

fields.JP: そうすると……ますますどの辺りなんだろ？

fields.EN:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...
fields.JP:
この鉄の板をどかせば……
こっちから外が見えるかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...

fields.EN:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.
fields.JP: うん。みんなでどかそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.

fields.EN:
The sky... I haven't seen that
kind of color coming from the sky
before...
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sky... I haven't seen that
kind of color coming from the sky
before...

fields.EN:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?

fields.EN:
Yes. It looks like the place is
connected to it.
fields.JP:
ええ。
しかも……二本繋がっているように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It looks like the place is
connected to it.

fields.JP: これって……なんなんですか……

fields.EN:
This place is starting to creep
me out...
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is starting to creep
me out...

fields.JP: うう……なんだかここ、こわいよ

fields.EN:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?
fields.JP:
塔が繋がってるなんて……ジェイルが育つと
ああなるんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?

fields.EN:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　さっきどかした鉄板……
何か文字が書いてあるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!

fields.EN:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.
fields.JP:
これって、駅の標識なんだよ！
錆び付いてボロボロになってるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.

fields.EN:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...
fields.JP:
大きな文字なら……
どうにか読めそうだわ……ええと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...

fields.EN:
Could it be that we're... actually
outside of the Jail?
fields.JP:
もしかして、ここは……
私たちのジェイルの……外……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that we're... actually
outside of the Jail?

fields.JP: まさか……いやでも、そんなことって！

fields.EN:
So even if we escape from the
Jail, the surface is covered in
Jails, too?!
fields.JP:
何よこれ！　ジェイルから出られても、
外の世界もジェイルだらけだってこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So even if we escape from the
Jail, the surface is covered in
Jails, too?!

fields.EN:
(I didn't expect the surface to be
like some paradise, but...)
fields.JP:
（外の世界が素晴らしい場所だなんて、
　そこまでは思ってなかったけど、でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't expect the surface to be
like some paradise, but...)

fields.JP: どうかしたの、ジャック？

fields.EN:
It looks like some sort of
entrance... Where does this lead
to?
fields.JP:
何かの……入り口みたいなんだ。
どこに繋がってるんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like some sort of
entrance... Where does this lead
to?

fields.EN: Yes... And, it looks quite deep...
fields.JP: 本当ね……結構、深そうだわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... And, it looks quite deep...

fields.JP: おいしいものあるかな！
あんた、ほんとに食い意地張ってるわよね……

fields.EN:
Hm, but I wonder where it goes.
This wasn't in any of the Dawn's
reports...
fields.JP:
でも……何なのかしら。
黎明からの情報にもなかったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but I wonder where it goes.
This wasn't in any of the Dawn's
reports...

fields.EN:
Instead of assuming, I suggest
we simply see where it leads.
fields.JP: あれこれ詮索するより、調べた方が早いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead of assuming, I suggest
we simply see where it leads.

fields.JP: たんけん！　たんけん！

fields.EN: Ohohoho! I am up to the challenge!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほほ！
望むところですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohohoho! I am up to the challenge!

fields.EN:
So, we're going inside...? It's a
bit scary...
fields.JP:
……この中に入っていくんですか？
怖そうですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we're going inside...? It's a
bit scary...

fields.EN: I don't want to do extra work...
fields.JP: 余計な仕事はしたくないです～
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't want to do extra work...

fields.EN:
We may find out something useful
if we search an area we've never
seen before.
fields.JP:
でも……未知の領域を調査すれば、
更に何かがわかるかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may find out something useful
if we search an area we've never
seen before.

fields.EN: Okay then! Let's check it out!
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね！
それじゃ、行ってみようか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay then! Let's check it out!

fields.EN:
Huh... I didn't know there was an
area like this underground...
fields.JP:
へえ……地下にこんな空間が広がってたなんて
全然知らなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... I didn't know there was an
area like this underground...

fields.EN: Yes. The place is so spacious...
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. The place is so spacious...

fields.JP: あははははっ！　ひろーい！！
こら、ラプは走らないの！
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
やだー！
ラプンツェルあそびたーいー！

fields.EN:
Rapu-Rapu! There's no telling what's
lurking here!
fields.JP:
ラプラプ！
何が出るかわからないですわよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy! There's no telling what's
lurking here!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: うん！　ねむねむとて、つなぐ！

fields.EN: I'm so glad Nemu is here...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so glad Sleepy is here...

fields.EN:
I wonder if the Jail's growth
created this underground area...
fields.JP:
でも……こんなところがあったなんて、
ジェイルは地下にも成長してるのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if the Jail's growth
created this underground area...

fields.EN:
Who knows? I at least know
there's a lot more we need to find
out about this place.
fields.JP:
どうかしら……
ともかく、まだまだ謎が多いことは確かね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? I at least know
there's a lot more we need to find
out about this place.

fields.EN: Yeah... Let's keep our guard up.
fields.JP: うん。油断しないように進もう
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah... Let's keep our guard up.

fields.EN:
Do you think you can really stop
us?
fields.JP: そんなもの、この私に通用すると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think you can really stop
us?

fields.EN:
Please wait! Her eyes are glowing
pink!
fields.JP:
待ってください！
この人の目、ピンクに光ってます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please wait! Her eyes are glowing
pink!

fields.EN:
You're right! So she's another
Blood Maiden?! If you're a Blood
Maiden, we're not your enemies!
fields.JP:
ほんとだ……！
じゃああんたも血式少女じゃない！？
だったらあたしたち、敵じゃないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right! So she's another
Blood Maiden?! If you're a Blood
Maiden, we're not your enemies!

fields.EN:
Um, we're really not your enemies.
Uh... How can I get through to
you?
fields.JP:
あの……僕たち、本当に敵なんかじゃないんだ。
ええと……どうすれば伝わるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, we're really not your enemies.
Uh... How can I get through to
you?

fields.EN:
Oh? There's only one thing to do
if you can't be heard.
fields.JP:
あら。道理が通じない相手なら、やることは
一つよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? There's only one thing to do
if you can't be heard.

fields.EN:
How about we punish her a bit? We
just have to make her listen to
us.
fields.JP:
お仕置きというのはいかがなものかしら……
でも、話を聞いてくれない人には、聞く耳を
持たせるまでね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we punish her a bit? We
just have to make her listen to
us.

fields.EN: W-Wait a sec! Um, you too!
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっとみんな待ってよ！
その……きみも！
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Wait a sec! Um, you too!

fields.EN:
Jack! Just don't stand there!
She's ready to fight!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　ボヤボヤしてんじゃないわよ！
相手はやる気よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Just don't stand there!
She's ready to fight!

fields.JP:
そうだね！
みんな……油断するんじゃないよ！

fields.EN:
Tch...! I can't believe I've
tasted defeat...
fields.JP: くっ……このワレが敗北を喫するとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...! I can't believe I've
tasted defeat...

fields.EN:
W-We're sorry to have ganged up
on a girl like you...
fields.JP: お……女の子に大勢で……すみません
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We're sorry to have ganged up
on a girl like you...

fields.EN:
Um, I don't think we had a
choice...
fields.JP: い……いや、仕方なかったと思うけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I don't think we had a
choice...

fields.EN:
D-Don't call me a gyrl! I am
Hameln! The Demon Kyngh!
fields.JP:
お……おんにゃのこと言うでない！
ワレはハーメルン。魔王でありゅぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't call me a gyrl! I am
Hameln! The Demon Kyngh!

fields.JP: こ……小娘ども！　頭が高いわ！

fields.EN:
I don't think that attitude of
yours is fitting, when you took
the first swing and lost to us.
fields.JP:
だいたいあなたが戦闘を仕掛けてきて、
わたしたちに負けたのでしょう？
なのに、その態度は無いのではないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think that attitude of
yours is fitting, when you took
the first swing and lost to us.

fields.EN:
I-Indeed... I did lose... Well
then, take my head if you
please...
fields.JP:
い……いかにも……ワレは敗北した……
故に、この首でも何でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-Indeed... I did lose... Well
then, take my head if you
please...

fields.JP: いいから普通に話しなさい

fields.EN:
...I see. So there are no cores
here, or Nightmares, for that
matter...
fields.JP:
……そう。このエリアには核も無ければ、
ナイトメアもいないのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I see. So there are no cores
here, or Nightmares, for that
matter...

fields.EN:
What you mention is something I
have never seen before here,
m'lady.
fields.JP:
お嬢の言うそれらのものは、残念ながら
ワレは見たことも聞いたこともなくてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you mention is something I
have never seen before here,
m'lady.

fields.EN:
What a strange and unusual
place...
fields.JP: ……不思議な場所もあったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a strange and unusual
place...

fields.EN:
Oh? Let me rephrase that to "a
boring place."
fields.JP: あら。つまらない場所の間違いじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Let me rephrase that to "a
boring place."

fields.EN:
What?! You, the aloof one called
Gretel! Is where you came from
interesting?!
fields.JP:
何！？
グレーテルとやら。上階は面白いのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! You, the aloof one called
Gretel! Is where you came from
interesting?!

fields.EN:
I'd prefer you to call me "m'lady"
as well. Or you can me "princess,"
if you'd like.
fields.JP:
ねえ。私のこともお嬢とか姫とか呼んで
くれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd prefer you to call me "m'lady"
as well. Or you can me "princess,"
if you'd like.

fields.JP: あなた……また人をからかって……

fields.EN:
The only one I shall address as
m'lady is the one called Alice!
Behold her elegant form!
fields.JP:
わ……ワレがお嬢と呼ぶのは、このアリスのみ！
この気高く凛とした様を見よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only one I shall address as
m'lady is the one called Alice!
Behold her elegant form!

fields.EN:
I thought I told you to speak
normally...
fields.JP: その……あなたも普通に話しなさいと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I told you to speak
normally...

fields.EN:
You heard that?! She's calling
Alice "m'lady!"
fields.JP: あいつ……アリスのことお嬢ですって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard that?! She's calling
Alice "m'lady!"

fields.EN:
Despite her holier-than-thou
attitude, maybe she's born to be
a subordinate. Alice-san accepts it pretty naturally, too.
fields.JP:
偉そうなのに、下僕体質なんでしょうか～
アリスさんも普通に受け入れてますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite her holier-than-thou
attitude, maybe she's born to be
a subordinate.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.

fields.EN:
S-Stop it, you two... She can hear
us.
fields.JP:
や……やめなよ、ふたりとも。
きっと聞こえてるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it, you two... She can hear
us.

fields.EN:
Are you all what you call a
"friend?"
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you all what you call a
"friend?"

fields.JP: え？　うん、僕たちは仲間だけど……？

fields.EN:
I will become this "friend" of
yours to protect m'lady! Rejuice!
fields.JP:
喜ぶが良いぞ！
このワレはお嬢を守護すべく、貴様らの仲間と
なってやりょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will become this "friend" of
yours to protect m'lady! Rejuice!

fields.EN:
With my powers at your disposal,
ruling the world shall be within
your grasp!
fields.JP:
このワレの強力な力をもってすれば、
しぇかい……世界征服も夢では無い！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
With my powers at your disposal,
ruling the world shall be within
your grasp!

fields.EN:
Thanks for becoming our friend.
Um, hahaha...
fields.JP: 仲間になってくれてありがとう……ははは
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for becoming our friend.
Um, hahaha...

fields.EN:
In that case, ruling the world is
out of the question. Just be a
normal friend like anybody else.
fields.JP:
だから、世界征服なんかしなくていいの。
仲間になるなら普通に仲間になりなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case, ruling the world is
out of the question. Just be a
normal friend like anybody else.

fields.EN:
I-If that's what you say, m'lady!
It shall be d-d-d-done!
fields.JP:
お、お嬢がそうおっしゃりゃりぇ……
御意！！　……と
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-If that's what you say, m'lady!
It shall be d-d-d-done!

fields.EN:
That's what happens when you wear
such a long cloak...
fields.JP:
もう……そんなに長いものを着て
いきなり立ち上がるからよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what happens when you wear
such a long cloak...

fields.EN:
Um... Maybe it's just me, but she
could be an incredible klutz...
fields.JP:
この方……ひょっとして、とってもドジっ子
じゃありませんこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Maybe it's just me, but she
could be an incredible klutz...

fields.EN:
Despite her looks, she seems to be
a nice person.
fields.JP: 見た目と違って、案外いい人そうですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite her looks, she seems to be
a nice person.

fields.JP: オォォォォォォオォォ……

fields.EN:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアは倒せたけど……
　なんだろう、この釈然としない感覚……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We beat the Nightmare, but this
all feels too weird...)

fields.JP: これで、一件落着ですね

fields.EN:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...
fields.JP:
それより……ずいぶん奥まで来てしまい
ましたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems we went in pretty
far chasing after it...

fields.EN:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...
fields.JP: 戻るのが大変そうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's going to be a pain, heading
back...

fields.EN:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.
fields.JP:
……あー。降りたり昇ったり、ずいぶん
走らされたからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We did go up and down and
all over.

fields.EN:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?
fields.JP:
さすがに地下じゃなさそうだし、
どの辺なんだろ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't look like we're
underground now, but... Where are
we, exactly?

fields.EN:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.
fields.JP:
その辺をブチ抜いたら、
どこかのエリアに出られるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can get to a different
area if we just punch a hole
someplace.

fields.EN:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...
fields.JP: そういうことなら、ワレが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that's what you want,
then...

fields.EN:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.
fields.JP:
ちょ……ちょっと待ってよ！
そんなことしたら、あちこち崩れたりする
かもしれないし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hold on there! If you do that,
there's no telling whether this
place is going to cave in.

fields.JP: グレーテル、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.
fields.JP:
このエリアには……他と違う点がいくつか
あったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were a few things different
here from other areas.

fields.JP: まず、ここだけ地下にありますね～

fields.EN:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.
fields.JP:
それに、核を壊した時のジェイルの鳴き声が、
いつもと違いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The wailing from the Jail was
different when we destroyed the
core earlier, too.

fields.EN:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.
fields.JP: ナイトメアは、戦ってる途中に逃げ出したしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, the Nightmare ran
from us during battle.

fields.EN: Yes, it looks like a window.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, it looks like a window.

fields.EN:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.
fields.JP:
瓦礫で埋まってますけど。
ここって建物の中だったんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's rubble all over the place,
but I guess this is inside some
sort of structure.

fields.JP: そうすると……ますますどの辺なんだろ？

fields.EN:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...
fields.JP:
この鉄の板をどかせば……
こっちから外が見えるかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can see outside if we
move this steel plate...

fields.EN:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.
fields.JP: うん。みんなでどかそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Everyone, come and lend a
hand.

fields.EN:
The sky... I haven't seen that
kind of color coming from the sky
before...
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sky... I haven't seen that
kind of color coming from the sky
before...

fields.EN:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's... the Jail Tower, isn't
it?

fields.EN:
Yes. It looks like the place is
connected to it.
fields.JP:
ええ。
しかも……二本繋がっているように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It looks like the place is
connected to it.

fields.JP: これって……なんなんですか……

fields.EN:
This place is starting to creep
me out...
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is starting to creep
me out...

fields.JP: うう……なんだかここ、こわいよ

fields.EN:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?
fields.JP:
塔が繋がってるなんて……ジェイルが育つと
ああなるんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Connected to the Tower...? So
is this what happens when it
grows?

fields.EN:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　さっきどかした鉄板……
何か文字が書いてあるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! There's something written on
the steel plate we just moved!

fields.EN:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.
fields.JP:
これって、駅の標識なんだよ！
錆び付いてボロボロになってるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all rusty and falling apart,
but it's a train station sign.

fields.EN:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...
fields.JP:
大きな文字なら……
どうにか読めそうだわ……ええと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least the larger words are
still legible... Let me see...

fields.EN:
Could it be that we're... actually
outside of the Jail?
fields.JP:
もしかして、ここは……
私たちのジェイルの……外……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that we're... actually
outside of the Jail?

fields.EN:
It doesn't feel like we're outside
at all... It almost feels like we
moved into another Jail...
fields.JP:
そうよ……この雰囲気、
ジェイルの外というよりは
中の方が近い気がするんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't feel like we're outside
at all... It almost feels like we
moved into another Jail...

fields.EN:
This is supposed to be what
the outside of the Jail is like?
fields.JP:
これがジェイルの外だって言うなら、
こんなのってないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is supposed to be what
the outside of the Jail is like?

fields.EN:
All I see here is a world without
any hope...
fields.JP:
この不気味な光景はどう見ても
希望に満ちてなんかいない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I see here is a world without
any hope...

fields.EN:
It's too early to give up hope.
We still don't know what that
place is yet.
fields.JP:
希望を手放すにはまだ早いよ。
あれが何なのか、僕たちはまだ何も知らない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's too early to give up hope.
We still don't know what that
place is yet.

fields.EN:
True. We would need to examine
the place to determine that
tower's true identity.
fields.JP:
そうね。調べてみないことには、
あの塔が監獄塔なのかどうかも……
分かりはしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. We would need to examine
the place to determine that
tower's true identity.

fields.JP: 確かに、それはそうですけれど……

fields.EN:
I can only hope searching that
place won't make us worse
than how we are now...
fields.JP:
調べた結果、余計につらい現実を
突きつけられそうな気もするけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope searching that
place won't make us worse
than how we are now...

fields.EN:
A certain part of me wants to
turn the blind eye to what we
saw...
fields.JP:
ここに通じている道を塞いで、
見なかったことにしたいですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A certain part of me wants to
turn the blind eye to what we
saw...

fields.EN:
I understand that feeling, but
then again, we need to know
what that really is...
fields.JP:
でも……気持ちは分かりますが、
それでは何の解決にもなりませんよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand that feeling, but
then again, we need to know
what that really is...

fields.EN:
Jack's right. We have to first
search the place before we come
to any conclusions.
fields.JP:
ジャックの言うとおり、
調べてみないことには何も始まらないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's right. We have to first
search the place before we come
to any conclusions.

fields.EN: ...Yeah, you're right. We've come this far; turning back isn't an option.
fields.JP:
……うん、そうだね。ここまで来たんだし、
引き返すって選択肢はないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, and we made it this far.
No way am I going back empty
handed.

fields.EN:
We shall find out soon enough
what that place holds.
fields.JP: 行ってみればすぐに分かる話だぞ、貴様ら
fields.LOCALIZED:
We shall find out soon enough
what that place holds.

fields.EN:
I can only hope we do find out
something good...
fields.JP: 少しでもいい結果が出るといいですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope we do find out
something good...

fields.EN: That's what we call having hope.
fields.JP: きっと希望に繋がるって、そう思おうよ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's what we call having hope.

fields.EN:
(Why is that place so familiar...?
What is going on?)
fields.JP:
（なんだろうこの既視感……？
　不思議な感覚がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is that place so familiar...?
What is going on?)

fields.JP: じゃあみんな、行こうか
この場所はいったい何……？

fields.EN:
The tower is really different than
the tower we know...
fields.JP:
わたしたちの知っている監獄塔とは
随分と雰囲気が違うわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The tower is really different than
the tower we know...

fields.EN: No telling what we'll find here...
fields.JP:
いったい何が出るか
分かったもんじゃないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: No telling what we'll find here...

fields.EN:
We may even encounter Marchens
we've never met before.
fields.JP:
そうだね。見たこともない
メルヒェンがいるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may even encounter Marchens
we've never met before.

fields.EN:
Just make sure you all have
your guard up, you hear?
fields.JP:
みんな、何が出るか
分からないから油断しないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just make sure you all have
your guard up, you hear?

fields.EN:
Why yes, we should approach this
place very carefully.
fields.JP: ええ。慎重に慎重を重ねて進まないとですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, we should approach this
place very carefully.

fields.JP: みんなはなれちゃだめだよ！

fields.EN:
I shall crush anything that stands
in our way.
fields.JP: 何が出ようとワレが殲滅してやるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shall crush anything that stands
in our way.

fields.EN:
I can only hope we won't need to
resort to violence here...
fields.JP:
戦わないで済むなら
それに越したことはないんだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope we won't need to
resort to violence here...

fields.JP: とにかくみんな、注意して進みましょう

fields.EN:
The future...
may change the past...
fields.JP:
未来が……過去を……
変えるときがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The future...
may change the past...

fields.JP: （今聞いたことがあるような声が……）

fields.EN:
I was not made... to lie...
I was not made... to lie...
fields.JP:
私は……ウソをつけれるように……
作られてません、私は……
ウソをつけれるように……作られてません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was not made... to lie...
I was not made... to lie...

fields.EN:
I wonder if there are more
towers like these elsewhere.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、こんな風に
様々な場所に監獄塔があるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if there are more
towers like these elsewhere.

fields.EN:
If there's more than one,
then there's likely to be more
somewhere out there.
fields.JP:
２つめが見つかった以上、
可能性としては大いにあり得るわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there's more than one,
then there's likely to be more
somewhere out there.

fields.EN:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?
fields.JP:
だとしたら……
世界はどうなってるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what the heck is
happening around the world?

fields.EN:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...
fields.JP:
もしかしたら地上なんて……
もう存在しないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there is no "world"
on the surface any more...

fields.EN:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!
fields.JP:
だ、駄目っ！
希望をしっかり持たないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, stop it!
We can't just give up!

fields.EN:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.
fields.JP: でも考察はするべきよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's still worth considering
as a possibility.

fields.JP: ねえ……ジャックはどう思う？

fields.EN:
After it!
Jack, back us up!
fields.JP:
追うわよみんな！
ジャックは援護お願いっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
After it!
Jack, back us up!

fields.EN:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!
fields.JP:
そっち行ったよ！
囲むんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!

fields.EN: Very well, I shall intercept it!
fields.JP: それならわたしが先回りいたしますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well, I shall intercept it!

fields.JP:
……ぐご……づがまる……
がご……わげには……

なっ！？
予想外に小回りが効きますわね！

fields.EN:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、進路を塞ぐだけでいい！
あまり１人で先行しないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!

fields.EN:
Tch! Dang it, it's fast!
It's already that far ahead of us!
fields.JP:
くっ！
もうあんな先に…！
逃げ足の速いやつ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! Dang it, it's fast!
It's already that far ahead of us!

fields.JP: お前はさっきのナイトメア……っ！

fields.EN:
Everyone! Over here!
I found the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
みんな、こっちだよっ！　
ナイトメアを見つけたっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Over here!
I found the Nightmare!

fields.JP: あっ！　このっ！　逃げるなっ！！

fields.EN:
(That Nightmare...
doesn't want to fight us...?)
fields.JP:
（このナイトメア……もしかしたら、
　僕らと争う気はないんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That Nightmare...
doesn't want to fight us...?)

fields.JP:
白雪、ネム！
回り込んで退路を塞ぐのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White! Sleepy!
Block its path!

fields.EN:
Did you think you could get away
from me?
fields.JP: ワレから逃げられるとでも思ったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you think you could get away
from me?

fields.EN:
So, acting all weak to frame
us, eh? What a farce.
fields.JP:
命乞い……？
ナイトメアが何を企んでるんだか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, acting all weak to frame
us, eh? What a farce.

fields.EN:
(No... That Nightmare is
sincerely asking for mercy...)
fields.JP:
（いや、このナイトメア……
　本気で命乞いをしているんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... That Nightmare is
sincerely asking for mercy...)

fields.JP: 問答無用！　覚悟するのだっ！
待ちなさいハーメルン

fields.EN:
What is it?
I was getting to the good part.
fields.JP:
なんなのだグレーテル。
今がいいところなのではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it?
I was getting to the good part.

fields.EN:
That's what I wanted to stop.
Something is not quite right
with this Nightmare.
fields.JP:
だからそれを止めなさいと言っているの。
このナイトメア、明らかに様子がおかしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I wanted to stop.
Something is not quite right
with this Nightmare.

fields.EN: I feel the same way, too.
fields.LOCALIZED: I feel the same way, too.

fields.EN:
Well, sure, it runs a lot and
is acting like it wants us to
spare it, but...
fields.JP:
逃げ出したり命乞いしたり、
確かに他のナイトメアとは違うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, sure, it runs a lot and
is acting like it wants us to
spare it, but...

fields.EN:
No telling if that's a trap,
right?
fields.JP:
でもそれが罠じゃないとは
言い切れないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No telling if that's a trap,
right?

fields.EN:
If it can communicate, then it
could be possible it lured us
all the way here.
fields.JP:
話すだけの知能があるなら、
地下洞窟からここまで誘い出した、
なんてこともあるかもですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it can communicate, then it
could be possible it lured us
all the way here.

fields.EN:
But it looks scared...
Why don't we give it a chance?
fields.JP:
でも……すごく怯えてるように見えるよ。
ちょっとだけでも話を聞いてみない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it looks scared...
Why don't we give it a chance?

fields.JP: 私もこのナイトメアに興味があるわ

fields.EN: If we're going to kill it, we can wait until after we've heard it out, can't we?
fields.JP:
だから殺すなら、話を聞いてからでも
遅くはないと思うのだけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can finish it after we try to
communicate with it.

fields.EN: Hmph... This is a waste of time.
fields.JP: うぬぅ……まどろっこしいな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph... This is a waste of time.

fields.EN:
Oh, but the moment I see it do
something funny, it's gonna
get it.
fields.JP: けど怪しいそぶりを見せたらすぐに殺すよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but the moment I see it do
something funny, it's gonna
get it.

fields.EN:
I'll keep my guard up just in
case, too.
fields.JP: いつでも対処できるように身構えておくわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll keep my guard up just in
case, too.
Thanks for giving it a chance.

fields.EN: Say, why are you so scared...?
fields.JP: ……ねえ、君は何にそんなに怯えているの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Say, why are you so scared...?

fields.JP:
わだ……じぎちち…………
だだがうの……ぎらい…………

そっぢ……おぞってぐるがら……
わだじ……んぎぃ……にげだ……

fields.EN:
So you're saying you wouldn't
do anything if we don't fight you?
fields.JP:
わたしたちが襲わなければ
何もしなかったっていうんですの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're saying you wouldn't
do anything if we don't fight you?

fields.EN:
I've never seen such a cowardly
Nightmare before.
fields.JP:
こんなに臆病な
ナイトメアなんて初めて見たわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen such a cowardly
Nightmare before.

fields.EN:
Mmhe... Lhn...g... aagho...
hhe...re... Ggh...
Wha...ndur... thhe...re...
fields.JP:
……わだじ……ずっどまえ……
ごごがら…………そっぢに……
ぎ……ぎぎ……まよいごんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmhe... Lhn...g... aagho...
hhe...re... Ggh...
Wha...ndur... thhe...re...

fields.EN:
So it isn't a Nightmare from that
underground cavern then.
fields.JP:
あの地下洞窟のナイトメアって
わけじゃなかったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it isn't a Nightmare from that
underground cavern then.

fields.EN:
Well, I wouldn't be surprised that
it got lost there with how
expansive that place is...
fields.JP:
確かにあの地下洞窟はあまりにも
広大でしたからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I wouldn't be surprised that
it got lost there with how
expansive that place is...

fields.EN:
Bhe...frre... lhho...stt... mhe...
ahtk...ed... bai... Marrsh...en...
sayv... Lhitt..le... Meer...mad...
fields.JP:
ぎちち……どうぐづでまようまえ……
わだじ……メルヒェンに……おぞわれだ……
……にんぎょびめ……だずげでぐでだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bhe...frre... lhho...stt... mhe...
ahtk...ed... bai... Marrsh...en...
sayv... Lhitt..le... Meer...mad...

fields.JP: ああいや、何でもないよ……

fields.EN:
Shh...e... saahv...d... mhe...
Bht... sooo... sch...rd...
fields.JP:
だずげで……ぐでだのに……
わだじ……ごわぐで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shh...e... saahv...d... mhe...
Bht... sooo... sch...rd...

fields.JP:
でも……んぎぎ……にんぎょびめ……
やざじく……じでぐれで………

ぞれがら……ずごじずつ……ぎぎ……
……ながよぐ……なっで…………

fields.EN:
This Ningyohime must have
been a very kind person.
fields.JP:
にんぎょひめって子は
とっても優しい人だったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This Little Mermaid must have
been a very kind person.

fields.EN:
Yh...ss... Bht... I... ddhnt...
sahe... th...nkks... Ggh...
Shhee... naw... gh...ne....
fields.JP:
うん……で……でも……
いっがいも……おれい……いえないまま……
ぎぎぎ……いなぐなっぢゃっだ……がら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yh...ss... Bht... I... ddhnt...
sahe... th...nkks... Ggh...
Shhee... naw... gh...ne....

fields.EN:
Ggh... Ssoh... I... whant...
seee... hher... agh...nn...
ssahee... tha....kksss...
fields.JP:
みちち……だがら……
も……いぢど……あっで……
おれい……いいだい……
fields.LOCALIZED:

Jack? Do you know the people

Wait up!

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.LOCALIZED:
(There has to be something that
will trigger her memory...
But what?!)

Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

Wait... So Jack really knows it...
no... her?!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

ジャック……僕の記憶を

Jack... Thank you for bringing my
memories back...

She doesn't exist in this world anymore...
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんは
この世界ではもう……いないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She...
She doesn't exist in this world...
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN: I see... So this is the world after Princess and I spent time together with everyone...
fields.JP:
そうか……ここは僕と姫が
みんなと一緒に過ごした後の世界……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... This world is the future
of the other world where I spent
my time with Princess...

fields.EN: Yes... Which is why I'm human.
fields.JP: うん……だから僕は人間の姿だしね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... Which is why I'm human.

fields.EN:
Um, Jack? We would appreciate it
if you would explain to us what
is happening here...
fields.JP:
ね、ねえジャック……
そろそろわたしたちにも何なのか
説明してほしいのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Jack? We would appreciate it
if you would explain to us what
is happening here...

fields.EN:
Yeah...
You're making my head spin...
fields.JP:
そうだよ……何が何だかさっぱり
分からないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah...
You're making my head spin...

fields.EN:
Indeed. With what happened,
I believe you're responsible
of telling us what is happening.
fields.JP: ええ。説明責任を果たしてほしいところね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. With what happened,
I believe you're responsible
of telling us what is happening.

fields.EN:
I'll explain later, but for now,
I need you all to let me handle
this for a bit.
fields.JP:
後でちゃんと説明するから、
だからもう少しだけ僕に任せてほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll explain later, but for now,
I need you all to let me handle
this for a bit.

fields.EN:
Say, Tsuu? You reincarnated once
by sacrificing yourself to the
Witchcraft, right?
fields.JP:
ねえ、つう。
つうは『白い核』……『ウィッチクラフト』に
自ら飛び込んで、１度転生したんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? You reincarnated once
by sacrificing yourself to the
Witchcraft, right?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
What happened at the very end?
I wasn't with you then, so please
tell me what happened.
fields.JP:
なら……その結末は覚えてる？
最後の最後、僕は一緒にいなかったから
分からないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happened at the very end?
I wasn't with you then, so please
tell me what happened.

fields.EN:
You remembering the previous
world must mean that you returned
this world to its true form...
fields.JP:
でもこうして前の世界の記憶を今
持てるということは……もう１度
この世界に戻したってことなのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remembering the previous
world must mean that you returned
this world to its true form...

fields.EN:
So, the world you experienced
may not have been the best, but
I'm sure it was worthwhile...
fields.JP:
だから言いにくいけど、決して幸せな
世界ではなかったんじゃないかって、
そう思うんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the world you experienced
may not have been the best, but
I'm sure it was worthwhile...

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I suppose... It was far from
a happy ending, though...
fields.JP: そうだね……幸せな終わりではなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose... It was far from
a happy ending, though...

fields.JP: やっぱりそうなんだね……

fields.EN:
But now that you're here,
don't sacrifice yourself to the
Witchcraft any more.
fields.JP:
じゃあつう、
もう『ウィッチクラフト』に飛びこんじゃ駄目だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now that you're here,
don't sacrifice yourself to the
Witchcraft any more.

fields.EN:
But without that, I can't get to
the world where Princess is
still alive...
fields.JP:
でも、それだと姫が
生きている世界に辿り着けないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But without that, I can't get to
the world where Princess is
still alive...

fields.EN:
About that... There may be a way
to bring Ningyohime-san back to
life.
fields.JP:
それなんだけど……もしかしたら
人魚姫さんを生き返らせることが
できるかもしれないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
About that... There may be a way
to bring Little Mermaid back to
life.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP:
そ、それは本当なのか！？
ジャック！！

fields.EN:
Yeah, we saw Mamoru come back to
life in this world.
fields.JP:
うん。僕たちはこの世界でマモルたちが
蘇ったのを見たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we saw Mamoru come back to
life in this world.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Wait... Mamoru and the others
were dead in this world?
fields.JP:
こっちではマモルたちは
死んでいたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Mamoru and the others
were dead in this world?

fields.EN:
That's right. But they came back
to life with the Jail's core.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ。でもジェイルの核のおかげで
生き返らせられたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. But they came back
to life with the Jail's core.

fields.EN: There's a core here too, right?
fields.JP: この都庁のジェイルにも核はあるんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a core here too, right?

fields.EN:
Then maybe, with Ningyohime-san's body
and this mic that still holds Ningyohime-san's
strong feelings...
fields.JP:
ならさ、人魚姫さんの遺体と、
人魚姫さんの想いが強く残った
『このマイク』があればもしかしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, we may be able to bring her
back with Little Mermaid's body
and her precious mic...
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 人魚姫 => Little Mermaid-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
You may be right...
I think this could work!
fields.JP:
それなら確かに姫を……
……生き返らせられるかも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be right...
I think this could work!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
But, where is her body?
Didn't she pass away awhile ago?
fields.JP:
ただ……姫の亡骸なんてあるの……？
もうずっと前に死んじゃったんだよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, where is her body?
Didn't she pass away awhile ago?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure, but Ningyohime-san is a
Blood Maiden, so maybe her body was
kept preserved someplace.
fields.JP:
そうだね、そこの確証はない。
でも人魚姫さんは数少ない血式少女だ。
もしかしたら残してくれてるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure, but she is a Blood
Maiden, so maybe her body is
kept preserved someplace.
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm sorry that I don't have any
tangible fact over my assumption,
but it's worth the try, right?
fields.JP:
こんな細い糸をたぐるような話でごめんね。
だけど、方法が他にないなら賭けてみても
いいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry that I don't have any
tangible fact over my assumption,
but it's worth the try, right?

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Yes...
I'll do what I can so long as
there's still hope.
fields.JP:
そう……だね……
少しでも希望があるなら……
僕はそれに賭けたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
I'll do what I can so long as
there's still hope.

fields.EN:
Why don't we head back to Dawn
and look for her body?
fields.JP:
じゃあ１度黎明に戻ってさ、
確認しに行こうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we head back to Dawn
and look for her body?

fields.EN:
Oh, and stay with me. That way
I can take care of you in case
something happens.
fields.JP:
その間に暴走しないように、
つうも僕と一緒に来てね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and stay with me. That way
I can take care of you in case
something happens.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Well now, it looks like our
position has changed.
fields.JP: な……何だか昔と逆になっちゃったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, it looks like our
position has changed.

fields.EN:
Um... My brain is crying for help.
You mind filling us with details?
fields.JP:
あのー……そろそろ本気でワケが
分からないから説明してほしいんだけどー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... My brain is crying for help.
You mind filling us with details?

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I don't blame you for getting
confused with all that's
happening now.
fields.JP:
突然すぎて……
分からないことだらけだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame you for getting
confused with all that's
happening now.

fields.JP: そのナイトメアはなかまになったの？
そうだよ、ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
Well, at least I can tell she
doesn't mean any harm...
fields.JP:
まあ……害がないことは
理解しましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, at least I can tell she
doesn't mean any harm...

fields.EN:
I can't help you two without
proper information, so do you mind
telling me what is going on?
fields.JP:
さすがに私も推測の材料が足りなすぎるわ。
だからしっかりと説明してもらいましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't help you two without
proper information, so do you mind
telling me what is going on?

fields.EN:
Sure, I'll explain what I can
as we head back to Dawn.
fields.JP:
うん、黎明に戻るまでの間に
ちゃんと説明するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, I'll explain what I can
as we head back to Dawn.

fields.EN: You all mind we leave for Dawn?
fields.JP: だからみんな、１度戻らせてほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: You all mind we leave for Dawn?

fields.EN: This sounds pretty serious, so I guess we should head back for now.
fields.JP:
結構深刻な話のようだし、
仕方ない、一旦戻ろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems like you've got a
pretty wild agenda in mind, so
we may as well head back.

fields.JP: ジャックがそう言うなら……

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN: Now then, lead the way, Jack.
fields.JP: じゃあジャック……よろしく頼むよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, lead the way, Jack.

fields.EN:
Will do.
We still have hope on our side.
fields.JP: うん。希望は捨てずに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do.
We still have hope on our side.

fields.EN:
That's all that I can share
right now...
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's all that I can share
right now...

fields.EN:
I was in that other world
separate from ours.
fields.JP:
これが僕の知ってる
もう１つの時間軸の世界だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was in that other world
separate from ours.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
It's a world that was created
by me.
fields.JP: 僕のせいで生み出された……世界だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a world that was created
by me.

fields.EN:
Well now, that was way more than
what I expected. I still don't
understand what I just heard...
fields.JP:
さすがにスケールが大きすぎて……
ちょっとお姉さん理解できないや……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that was way more than
what I expected. I still don't
understand what I just heard...

fields.EN: I do think the two of you probably aren't lying, but...
fields.JP:
２人が嘘を言ってないだろうとは、
まあ……思うのですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you wouldn't lie to us,
but...

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
ぜんぜんわからなかった！

fields.EN:
What an interesting story...
I suppose I was the only one who
understood here.
fields.JP:
ワレは理解したが……
あえて多くは語るまい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What an interesting story...
I suppose I was the only one who
understood here.

fields.EN:
You didn't understand a single
bit, did you?
fields.JP: いや、絶対理解してないでしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't understand a single
bit, did you?

fields.EN: I don't understand everything either... but I can at least understand that a world on a different timeline definitely existed.
fields.JP:
わたしもすべては理解できないけど……
でも違う時間軸の世界が確かに存在したって
ことだけは理解できるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only thing I know is that
there's some kind of parallel
world out there.

fields.EN:
Yes, and that both of them
retained their memories from
that world.
fields.JP:
そうね。そしてそこの世界の記憶を
再び２人は保持してる……ということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and that both of them
retained their memories from
that world.

fields.EN:
Glad someone sort of understands
what I said.
fields.JP: それだけ分かってくれればありがたいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad someone sort of understands
what I said.

fields.JP: わらわはさっぱりです～

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? You and Ningyo-chan
know Shirayuki and the others
here, right?
fields.JP:
でもおつうちゃんも、話に出てくる
人魚ちゃんも、白雪たちのことを
知っていますよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? You and Little Mermaid
know Snow White and the others
here, right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP: 分かってくれてありがとう、白雪……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I'm happy you could
deduce that from what little
we shared.

fields.EN:
Well, you said things that would
never be known if you didn't
know us from before.
fields.JP:
だって初対面の人では絶対に
分からないことまで知ってるんですもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you said things that would
never be known if you didn't
know us from before.

fields.EN:
True. Tsuu holds information
that proves her statements.
fields.JP:
確かに信じざるを得ない情報を
つうは持っているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. Otsuu holds information
that proves her statements.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
But, I haven't received all the
details needed to fully understand
the situation.
fields.JP:
でもまだ完全に理解できるだけの
情報をもらってないわ。だからまた
改めて説明してもらうわよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I haven't received all the
details needed to fully understand
the situation.

fields.EN:
Yes, every detail helps, so do you
mind going into the smaller
details now?
fields.JP:
ええ、詳細が気になるから
ちゃんと説明してくれるわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, every detail helps, so do you
mind going into the smaller
details now?

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Before I go on...
Jack? Why were you able to
recall your memory?
fields.JP:
それにしてもジャック……
君は何故、思い出せたんだい……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before I go on...
Jack? Why were you able to
recall your memory?

fields.EN: Oh, it's because of this mic.
fields.JP:
ああ、それはつうの
持っていたマイクのおかげなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's because of this mic.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
That's Princess's mic!
My special treasure!
fields.JP: それは姫のマイク……僕の宝物……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Princess's mic!
My special treasure!

fields.EN:
You dropped it back where we
met when you ran away.
fields.JP:
つうが都庁のジェイルで
逃げる時に落としていったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You dropped it back where we
met when you ran away.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but my curiosity got
the best of me. I listened to you
and Ningyohime-san's recording.
fields.JP:
その時に悪いけど調べさせてもらったら、
人魚姫さんの歌や、つうたちの会話が
聞こえてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but my curiosity got
the best of me. I listened to you
and Little Mermaid's recording.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: それで、すべて思い出したんだ

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
That's why I thought I could
bring your memory back, too.
fields.JP:
だから僕と同じように、つうにも
あの時に関わる思い出の品を見せれば、
きっと思い出すんじゃないかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I thought I could
bring your memory back, too.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised it was found
in this world...
fields.JP:
そんなものが
こっちの世界にもあるなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised it was found
in this world...

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I guess deep down, I didn't want
to get rid of my memories, even
after resetting the world...
fields.JP:
きっと世界をリセットできても、
思い出だけは消したくないって……
心のどこかで願ってたんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess deep down, I didn't want
to get rid of my memories, even
after resetting the world...

fields.EN:
And because of that, we could
connect like this again.
fields.JP:
そのおかげで僕もつうも、
もう１度こうして繋がることができたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And because of that, we could
connect like this again.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Yes, but if you killed me back
there, you wouldn't have to go
through all this hassle...
fields.JP:
そうだけど……でも僕のことなんて
思い出さず、あの時に殺してしまえば
こんな面倒にはならなかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but if you killed me back
there, you wouldn't have to go
through all this hassle...

fields.JP: そんなこと言わないでよ、つう！
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: You're my partner and my friend.
fields.JP:
つうは大事な仲間……
ううん、相棒なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: You're my partner and my friend.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP:
君という奴は、いったいどこまで
お人好しなんだい……

fields.EN:
Oh, and I still need to repay you
for what I "owe."
fields.JP:
それに僕、まだつうに
『借り』を返してないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I still need to repay you
for what I "owe."

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Heh...
I haven't heard that
word in awhile.
fields.JP: ははっ……懐かしいフレーズだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
I haven't heard that
word in awhile.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and search for
Ningyohime-san's body.
fields.JP:
じゃあつう、一緒に
人魚姫さんの遺体を探しに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and search for
Little Mermaid's body.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ジャック……そのことなんだけど

fields.EN:
I know where her body is...
I was there when she was
buried...
fields.JP:
実はあたし……知ってるんだ。
埋葬した時にその場にいたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know where her body is...
I was there when she was
buried...

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP: ど、どこなんだ赤ずきん！

fields.EN:
I still don't get what you two are
planning, but I can at least tell
you're both serious.
fields.JP:
正直、あたしには何が何だか
よく分からない部分も多いけど、
２人が真剣なのは分かってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still don't get what you two are
planning, but I can at least tell
you're both serious.

fields.EN:
So, I'll help you with what
I can...
fields.JP: だから今から案内する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'll help you with what
I can...

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP: それはこの黎明にあるのかい……？

fields.EN:
Yup... To be precise, a bit away
from headquarters. We made a
grave for her outside.
fields.JP:
うん。黎明の外れ……
誰も行かない場所にね、お墓を作ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... To be precise, a bit away
from headquarters. We made a
grave for her outside.

fields.EN:
Just a thought, but what happens
if she was cremated?
fields.JP:
疑問なのだけど、火葬していたら
ジャックの考える計画はどうなるのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a thought, but what happens
if she was cremated?

fields.EN:
Um... I'm not sure...
We'd have to try to find out.
fields.JP:
それは……ごめん、
やってみないと分からないや……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I'm not sure...
We'd have to try to find out.

fields.JP: その点に関しては大丈夫だよ

fields.EN:
She retained her Blood Skelter
form at death, so Dawn opted to
study her body whole and intact.
fields.JP:
人魚はブラッドスケルター状態で死んだ。
それは当時としては貴重なものだったから、
検査のために火葬はしてないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She retained her Blood Skelter
form at death, so Dawn opted to
study her body whole and intact.

fields.EN:
I see...
She was Dawn's valuable specimen.
fields.JP: なるほど。大事な検体ってわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
She was Dawn's valuable specimen.

fields.EN:

It's the same Princess that

１０年も前なのよね？

この髪の色……そうか、

人魚姫さんは生き返るかも

The Marchens here were a lot

こっちのジェイルでも

私達が知っているナイトメアとは

僕の知る限り、もう都庁に核はない、

fields.EN:

つうまだ希望は途絶えてないよ！

今度は相手もやる気まんまんみたいね！

この先で何が起きるのか、
私はとても興味があるわ。
だから負けてはいられないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we will lose.
I'm getting quite intrigued in
seeing what lies ahead for us.

fields.EN:
She's right! There's no way we
can lose now! Time to finish it!
fields.JP:
そうだよ、負けてなんていられない！
一気に本体を叩くよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! There's no way we
can lose now! Time to finish it!

fields.JP: ナイトメアが消えていく……

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP: よかった……みんな無事で……

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
You really are kind and caring,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
本当におつうちゃんは
仲間想いですね……
fields.LOCALIZED: You really are kind and caring.
fields.notes: Line-level restoration of a source name/honorific omitted or rewritten in localized English.

fields.EN:
You're making it hard for us
to refute that you were with
us in that other world.
fields.JP:
いつかどこかでわらわたちと
仲間だったって、本当に思えてきますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're making it hard for us
to refute that you were with
us in that other world.

fields.EN:
I'm sure we were all friends,
and we still are.
Ain't that right, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
本当に仲間だったんだよ。
昔も今もね……ね、おつう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we were all friends,
and we still are.
Ain't that right, Otsuu?

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(What a relief... It looks like
everyone is accepting Tsuu,
just like in the other world.)
fields.JP:
（よかった……みんな、
　つうのことをあの世界みたいに
　認め始めている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... It looks like
everyone is accepting Otsuu,
just like in the other world.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP:
アァァァァァ……
アァァァァァァァァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
The Jail's wailing like never
before!
fields.JP: ジェイルが一際大きく鳴いて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's wailing like never
before!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
The Jail's desire has been
fulfilled!
fields.JP: ジェイルの欲望が……満たされたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's desire has been
fulfilled!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Its fulfilment must have
extended the tower to its limit!
fields.JP:
きっと欲望が満たされたことで、
監獄塔が……最大まで伸びたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Its fulfilment must have
extended the tower to its limit!

fields.EN:
If that's so, then that white
core... The Witchcraft may
have been born!
fields.JP:
監獄塔が最大まで伸びたのなら……
『白い核』……『ウィッチクラフト』が
産まれたかもしれない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's so, then that white
core... The Witchcraft may
have been born!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
We can...
bring Princess back to life!
fields.JP: 姫を……姫を生き返らせるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can...
bring Princess back to life!

fields.EN:
All right, let's hurry and
get going!
fields.JP: よし、みんな屋上に急ごう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's hurry and
get going!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN: We finally made it to the top...
fields.LOCALIZED: We finally made it to the top...

fields.EN:
A white core...
It's exactly how Jack explained it
to be.
fields.JP:
『白い核』……
ジャックやつうの話していたとおりね
fields.LOCALIZED:
A white core...
It's exactly how Jack explained it
to be.

fields.EN:
I'm glad it's the same as
I thought it to be...
fields.JP: うん……予想通りでよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad it's the same as
I thought it to be...

fields.EN:
So, we may be able to bring
Ningyo back to life
with it?
fields.JP:
これで人魚は
生き返るかもしれないんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we may be able to bring
Little Mermaid back to life
with it?

fields.EN:
Tsuu... Can you let me handle
Ningyohime-san's body and her
microphone?
fields.JP:
つう、人魚姫さんの遺体とマイク、
僕に預けてくれないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Can you let me handle
Little Mermaid's body and her
microphone?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Mamoru's group came back to life.
I'm sure it will work this time,
too.)
fields.JP:
（マモルたちだって生き返ったんだ
　きっと今回だって上手くいくさ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mamoru's group came back to life.
I'm sure it will work this time,
too.)

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
That may not be enough to bring
her back to life.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら……それだけじゃ
想いが足りないかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That may not be enough to bring
her back to life.

fields.EN:
I know what you mean, but we don't
have anything else that can link us
to Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
絶対の確証はないから、
気持ちは分かるけど……でもこれ以上
人魚姫さんに繋がるものはないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what you mean, but we don't
have any other items that can
link to her existence.
fields.notes: Line-level restoration of a source name/honorific omitted or rewritten in localized English.; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN: I will offer myself to the core.
fields.JP: 僕が……僕自身が核に身を捧げるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I will offer myself to the core.

fields.JP: な、何を言ってるんだよ、つう！！

fields.EN:
He's right! It defeats all purpose
if you sacrifice yourself now
after all we've been through!
fields.JP:
そうだよ、せっかくここまで来たのに、
あんたがいなくなったら意味ないじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right! It defeats all purpose
if you sacrifice yourself now
after all we've been through!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
But, we only have one chance,
and I can't have it fail.
fields.JP:
でも……チャンスは１度きり……
失敗はできない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we only have one chance,
and I can't have it fail.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP: 僕は絶対に姫を助けたいんだ……

fields.EN:
If an item that can prove her
existence is needed, Tsuu
would be the perfect item to use.
fields.JP:
捧げる想いの強さが成功率に関わるのなら、
人魚姫のことを考え続けたつうは
確かに最適と言えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If an item that can prove her
existence is needed, Otsuu
would be the perfect item to use.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: そうかもしれないよ！　けど……！

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Thank you, Akazukin.
Thank you, everyone...
fields.JP: ありがとう……赤ずきん……みんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Red Riding Hood.
Thank you, everyone...

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
But, this is something I wanted
all along... Please...
Let me sacrifice myself...
fields.JP:
でもこれは……僕がずっと
叶えたかった願いなんだ……
だからどうか……やらせてほしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this is something I wanted
all along... Please...
Let me sacrifice myself...

fields.EN:
But...!
After finally being able to meet
you...!
fields.JP:
そんな……せっかく再会できたのに、
そんなのって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...!
After finally being able to meet
you...!

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
But, you understand me, right?
fields.JP:
ごめんね……でもジャックなら……
分かってくれるだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
But, you understand me, right?

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
So please, let me fulfill my wish.
I want to be the one to
bring Princess back.
fields.JP:
だから……どうか願っててほしいんだ……
僕の想いが……姫に届く奇跡を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, let me fulfill my wish.
