I want to be the one to
bring Princess back.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
If that's what she wants, then
we need to honor her wish, Jack.
fields.JP:
分かってあげよう、ジャック。
これがこの子のしたいことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's what she wants, then
we need to honor her wish, Jack.

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
You better make this miracle
happen! Got it?
fields.JP:
その代わり、絶対に奇跡を起こすこと！
いい、分かった！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You better make this miracle
happen! Got it?

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Princess is so young...
She's so light, and...
so cute...
fields.JP:
幼い姫の身体……
こんなにも軽くて……愛おしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess is so young...
She's so light, and...
so cute...

fields.JP: つう……いってらっしゃい……
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.
fields.JP:
はっはっは、何があろうと
僕が必ずや守ってみせましょう、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you said it with
such a straight face...
fields.JP: そんな臆面もなく言われると恥ずかしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you said it with
such a straight face...

fields.EN:
You're going to make me stay.
You're someone special to me,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
もう決めたの。おつうちゃんは
わたしにとって大事なひと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to make me stay.
You're someone special to me,
Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.
fields.JP: だからわたしは、一緒に行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.

fields.EN:
I love you more than anything.
I pray that we will meet again
one day in the future...
fields.JP:
姫、僕もあなたを愛しています。
……いつか未来の果てで、お会いしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you more than anything.
I pray that we will meet again
one day in the future...

fields.EN:
Yes... And when we meet,
we'll be joined in matrimony again.
fields.JP:
はい……ふつつか者ですが、
末永くよろしくお願い致します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... And when we meet,
we'll be joined in matrimony again.

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: ジャック……それにみんな……！

fields.EN:
Huh...? What?!
You're right... I'm... human?
fields.JP:
へ……？　うわぁっ！？
本当だ、人間になれてる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? What?!
You're right... I'm... human?

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
She's back...
She's really, really back!
fields.JP: 本当に……人魚を生き返らせた……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's back...
She's really, really back!

fields.EN:
It also looks like she's
grown to our ages.
fields.JP:
しかも……わたしたちと
同い年くらいに成長した姿で……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also looks like she's
grown to our ages.

fields.JP: ここまでとは……正直思わなかったわ

fields.EN:
Tsuu's wish brought about
a miracle...!
fields.JP: つうの願いが奇跡を起こしたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu's wish brought about
a miracle...!
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Truly, the power of Otsuu-chan's love!
fields.JP: まさにおつうちゃんの愛の力ですね！
fields.notes: Line-level restoration of a source name/honorific omitted or rewritten in localized English.

fields.JP: ん……あれ……おつうちゃんだ……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: I... wasn't I supposed to have jumped into the core? No... wasn't I supposed to have died in the correct world?
fields.JP:
わたし……核に飛び込んだはずじゃ……？
ううん、正しい世界で死んだはずじゃ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I went into the...?
No, wait. Didn't I die and...?

fields.EN:
Huh? Otsuu-chan's here...
Everyone's here, too...?!
fields.JP:
あれ、おつうちゃんがいて……
みんなもいる……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Otsuu's here...
Everyone's here, too...?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
You're in another world, and
everyone's safe, Ningyohime-san!
fields.JP:
ここはもう次の世界で、
みんなも無事なんだよ、人魚姫さん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're in another world, and
everyone's safe, Little Mermaid!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: そうなの……おつうちゃん……？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yes... and we're able to meet
like this in the proper world
we should be in!
fields.JP:
うん……そうだよ……
姫が願った、正しい時間軸の世界で……
僕も姫もまた出会えたんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... and we're able to meet
like this in the proper world
we should be in!

fields.EN:
I see... So Otsuu-chan, everyone,
and I were able to return to the
proper world together...
fields.JP:
そっか……わたしもおつうちゃんも、
そしてみんなも一緒の正しい世界に
来られたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So everyone was able
to return to the proper world
with us, too.
fields.notes: Line-level restoration of a source name/honorific omitted or rewritten in localized English.

fields.EN:
That's right!
And, it's all because of Jack
and our friends!
fields.JP:
そうだよ姫……！
ジャックやみんなのおかげなんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right!
And, it's all because of Jack
and our friends!

fields.EN:
(They finally met... I couldn't
have wished for any better.)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They finally met... I couldn't
have wished for any better.)

fields.JP:
ニンギョ……
本当に、ニンギョなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid...
Is that really you?

fields.JP:
もしかして……
おねーちゃん……？

fields.EN:
Ningyo...!
Y-You're so much older now!
fields.JP:
ああ、ニンギョ……！
こんなに、こんなに大きくなって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid...!
Y-You're so much older now!

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry! I was your sister,
but I wasn't able to save you
back then...!
fields.JP:
ごめんねニンギョ、あたし、おねーちゃんなのに、
あの時、あんたを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry! I was your sister,
but I wasn't able to save you
back then...!

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Sis. That wasn't your
fault. We're back together again,
so we're all good now.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫だよ、おねーちゃん。
あれはおねーちゃんが悪いんじゃないし、
それに、こうやってまた会えたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Sis. That wasn't your
fault. We're back together again,
so we're all good now.

fields.EN:
Really?
You're going to forgive me?
fields.JP:
本当に？
あたしを、許してくれるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?
You're going to forgive me?

fields.EN:
Of course! So please, I want
to see you smile, Sis.
fields.JP:
うん！
だから、笑ってよ、おねーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! So please, I want
to see you smile, Sis.

fields.EN:
Gotcha...
I am your sister after all!
fields.JP:
……わかった。
あたしは、あんたのおねーちゃんだもんね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotcha...
I am your sister after all!

fields.EN:
Jack, what did you mean by
"everyone's safe" earlier?
fields.JP:
しかし、ジャックの言う『みんなも無事』……？
いったいどういうことでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, what did you mean by
"everyone's safe" earlier?

fields.EN:
That was a bit peculiar, if not
disturbing...
fields.JP: いまいち要領を得ませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a bit peculiar, if not
disturbing...

fields.EN:
What happened to us in this
other world anyway?
fields.JP:
違う時間軸とやらでは
何があったっていうのよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happened to us in this
other world anyway?

fields.JP: ワレにもちゃんと説明せぬか！

fields.EN:
But, there's no reason to
dwell on that awful past.
fields.JP: でも……それを思い出す必要なんてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, there's no reason to
dwell on that awful past.

fields.EN:
Yes...
That was just a bad dream...
fields.JP:
そうだね……あれはきっと
『悪い夢』だったんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
That was just a bad dream...

fields.EN:
We're living in the present.
That's all that's important now.
fields.JP:
僕たちは『今』を生きている。
それでいいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're living in the present.
That's all that's important now.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Now then,
let's head back home...
fields.JP:
じゃあ戻ろうみんな。
僕たちの帰るべき場所へ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then,
let's head back home...

fields.EN: We can return to the surface now.
fields.JP: これでやっと僕たちは地上に戻れるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: We can return to the surface now.

fields.EN:
I was worried how we were
going to get to the surface,
but...
fields.JP:
でも、一時はどうやって
地上に戻るのかって思ったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was worried how we were
going to get to the surface,
but...

fields.EN:
I didn't expect Hikari-san to have
the power to make that happen.
fields.JP:
ヒカリさんの力で
それが可能だなんて驚いたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect Hikari to have
the power to make that happen.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN:
She's also willing to do
everything to get everyone back
to the surface.
fields.JP:
どうやらみんなを地上に戻すって
張り切ってくれてるみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's also willing to do
everything to get everyone back
to the surface.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, she said for
me to let her know when I'm
ready, but...
fields.JP:
準備ができたら声かけてほしい、
って伝えられたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, she said for
me to let her know when I'm
ready, but...

fields.EN:
Once we get to the surface, it's
going to be difficult coming back
here...
fields.JP:
……地上に脱出すれば、もちろんここには
簡単には戻ってこられない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we get to the surface, it's
going to be difficult coming back
here...

fields.EN:
I better make sure I got
everything checked and ready
to go...
fields.JP: 何かやり残したことはないかなぁ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better make sure I got
everything checked and ready
to go...

fields.JP: おーい。街の連中も集めてきたよー！

fields.EN:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.
fields.JP: タイヨウのみんなも、そろってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone under the Order of the
Sun is ready.

fields.EN:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?
fields.JP:
おい。
本部から持ち出すものは、他にもう無いか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you sure there's nothing left
to bring with us?

fields.EN:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.
fields.JP:
ええ。薬品と医療器具と資料と……
あなたと違って身軽なものよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Unlike you, I only have to
bring my medicines, materials,
and medical tools.

fields.EN:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...
fields.JP: 全然身軽じゃねえだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't sound different from
how much I'm gonna bring with
me...

fields.EN:
I'm gonna help carry her stuff,
too!
fields.JP: 姉さん、持つの手伝うっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna help carry her stuff,
too!

fields.EN:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.
fields.JP:
しっかし、全部終わったってのに、
資料まで残さず持ち出すとは、真面目だねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotta say though, I'm impressed
you're gonna bring the materials
even after everything's done.

fields.EN:
I like to be prepared. I have to
say that you're not like that
comrade of yours.
fields.JP:
あなたが不真面目なのよ。
同郷だったっていうあの人とは大違いね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like to be prepared. I have to
say that you're not like that
comrade of yours.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.
fields.JP:
まあ……あいつは良くも悪くも
クソ真面目だったからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Well, he was a bit too
hard-headed, for better or worse.

fields.EN: So much so that he lost his way...
fields.JP: 真面目すぎて、歪んじまったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: So much so that he lost his way...

fields.EN:
Um, Haru-san, so where exactly did
you and the Professor come from?
fields.JP:
あの、ハルさんと博士って……どこから
来たんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so where exactly did you and
the Professor come from?
fields.notes: Line-level source-address restoration: source name/honorific was omitted or replaced by a pronoun/title. | Line-level restoration of a source name/honorific omitted or rewritten in localized English.

fields.EN:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.
fields.JP:
……落ち着いたらおいおい話してやるよ。
ま、突拍子も無い話だ。
どのみちこの物語にはふさわしくねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk about it once we get
settled. It's so out of this world
that it doesn't fit this story.

fields.EN: Way to put on airs, Boss!
fields.JP: 師匠のもったいぶりー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Way to put on airs, Boss!

fields.EN:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.
fields.JP:
大人はもったいぶるんだよ。ガキどもと
違って、持ってるもんが少ねえからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That what adults do. Unlike brats,
we have a lot more baggage.

fields.EN:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.
fields.JP:
……ま、お前ら風に言うなら、遠い星の
王子様が、住んでた小さな星を失って、大事
な花だけ持ってやって来た……そんな話さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess my story's about a prince
from a faraway planet losing his
place, and bringing along a rose.

fields.EN:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!
fields.JP:
うわ！　自分のこと王子様とか
言ってるし……ちょっと引いたっすよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eew! He called himself a prince!
Way to overstate yourself!

fields.EN:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...
fields.JP: 例えって言ったろ。シメるぞガキ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's just an analogy, you little
brat...

fields.EN:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!
fields.JP:
ひゃー！
自分、あっち見てくるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Uh, I just remembered I
needed to go and check on
something!

fields.EN:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.
fields.JP:
確かに突拍子も無い話ね。
……落ち着いたら詳細を聞きたいところだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That did come out of nowhere.
But you've piqued my interest.
I'd like to hear more later.

fields.EN:
Now then, I better get back
to work.
fields.JP: さてと、俺も作業に戻るか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I better get back
to work.

fields.EN:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.
fields.JP: ……ジャック。お前には感謝してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I really appreciate what
you've done.

fields.JP:
いや、何でもねえよ。
じゃあまた後でな

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Instead of telling others to help,
Akazukin should take
care of her own stuff...
fields.JP:
まったく赤ずきんの奴、
暇なら手伝えとか……自分の荷物くらい
自分でまとめればいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead of telling others to help,
Red Riding Hood should take
care of her own stuff...

fields.EN:
Tsuu, Ningyohime-san...
Are you two ready?
fields.JP:
つう……それに人魚姫さんも。
２人は準備は大丈夫なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, Little Mermaid...
Are you two ready?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
We're done. It's not like we
had many things to take with us.
fields.JP:
わたしたちはそんなに準備もないから、
すぐに終わったんだー
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're done. It's not like we
had many things to take with us.

fields.EN:
Guess what Akazukin
asked us to do?
fields.JP: そしたら赤ずきんの奴がさぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess what Red Riding Hood
asked us to do?

fields.EN:
Oh, but that's just Sis treating
us like how she used to.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃん、すぐに前と変わらず
わたしたちに接してくれるように
なったんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but that's just Sis treating
us like how she used to.

fields.EN:
That also means that Otsuu-chan is
arguing with her again...
fields.JP:
それってつまり、おつうちゃんといつも
言い合ってる関係ってことで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means that Otsuu is
arguing with her again...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Looks like you're having fun,
Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP: 楽しそうだね、人魚姫さん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're having fun,
Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Yup! It's the same as before!
fields.JP:
うん！　だってそれがわたしたちの
日常だったんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! It's the same as before!

fields.EN:
Princess...
Well, it's not that I don't like
the old Akazukin, but...
fields.JP:
姫…………まあ僕も
いつもの赤ずきんがいいけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess...
Well, it's not that I don't like
the old Red Riding Hood, but...

fields.JP:
はいみなさん、
どいてどいてっすー！

fields.EN:
Look at all this luggage...
Everyone else is bickering
over how much to take with them.
fields.JP:
ほんとみんな、すごい荷物だな……
あっちじゃ積むの積まないので揉めてるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all this luggage...
Everyone else is bickering
over how much to take with them.

fields.EN:
At least no one
is in despair now.
fields.JP:
でもこれまでみたいに悲壮感とか、
そういう雰囲気じゃないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least no one
is in despair now.

fields.EN:
Yeah, everyone is full of life.
I never thought I'd see a day
with everyone smiling like this.
fields.JP:
うん、生き生きとしてる。
まさか黎明の人たちのこんな笑顔が
見られるなんて、夢みたいだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, everyone is full of life.
I never thought I'd see a day
with everyone smiling like this.

fields.EN:
Yup, it was hard to imagine
that, especially back then...
fields.JP:
うん、あの頃からしたら、
想像もできなかったことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, it was hard to imagine
that, especially back then...

fields.EN: This time, everyone at Dawn is alive too.
fields.JP:
今度はちゃんと、
黎明のみんなも生きててくれてるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even the members of Dawn
look happy and excited.

fields.EN:
Hey, there you are.
I've got something to ask
you guys.
fields.JP:
お、いたいた。なあお前ら、
ちょっと聞きたいことがあるんだけどよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, there you are.
I've got something to ask
you guys.

fields.JP:
マモル……それにみなさん。
……何かあったの？

fields.EN:
No, there was something we
wanted to confirm.
fields.JP:
いや、どうしても
確認しておきたいことがあってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, there was something we
wanted to confirm.

fields.EN:
Everyone heard that there's
plenty of Jails out on the
surface, but is that true?
fields.JP:
いや、地上にもジェイルはある、
みたいな話は聞いてるんだけどよ……
本当にわんさかあるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone heard that there's
plenty of Jails out on the
surface, but is that true?

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Mmm... Not sure about "plenty,"
but the odds are likely there
may be more up there.
fields.JP:
うーん……わんさかかどうかは
分からないけど、別のジェイルがある
確率は高いと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Not sure about "plenty,"
but the odds are likely there
may be more up there.

fields.EN:
Beyond the underground cavern was
the Metropolitan Building Jail, so
there could be more out there.
fields.JP:
実際、地下洞窟の先には
『都庁』のジェイルがあるわけだし、
他のジェイルもあると考えていいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beyond the underground cavern was
the Metropolitan Building Jail, so
there could be more out there.

fields.EN:
Yes... So, it's possible there are
other Jails on the surface.
fields.JP:
うん……他にもあるなら、
地上に出てもジェイルはあるよね、きっと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... So, it's possible there are
other Jails on the surface.

fields.EN:
You don't look well...
Is something wrong?
fields.JP: 少し浮かない顔に見えるけど、どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't look well...
Is something wrong?

fields.EN:
Our unique situation means our lives
are similar to Marchens. So now
we need to be near a core to live.
fields.JP:
僕たちは訳あってメルヒェンみたいな
存在になってしまったんだ。だから、
核の近くじゃないと生きていけない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our unique situation means our lives
are similar to Marchens. So now
we need to be near a core to live.

fields.EN:
That's right...
You're all mimicked creatures...
fields.JP:
そうか、みんなは
擬態化した存在……だったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right...
You're all mimicked creatures...

fields.EN:
Indeed. So, if there really are
more Jails up there, we'll be
able to live on the surface, too.
fields.JP:
そうだ。だからその情報が正しければ、
僕たちは地上に出ても生き残れる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. So, if there really are
more Jails up there, we'll be
able to live on the surface, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah, but we're not sure if that's
a good thing or a bad thing yet.
fields.JP: ただそれを喜んでいいか分かんなくてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but we're not sure if that's
a good thing or a bad thing yet.

fields.EN:
Like, doesn't that mean we'd
still have to kill Marchens
just like before?
fields.JP:
だってそれだとよ、地上に出ても
またメルヒェンぶっ殺す日々の
始まりってわけだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, doesn't that mean we'd
still have to kill Marchens
just like before?

fields.EN: I just feel like it'd be wrong to the others for us to be happy about that.
fields.JP:
それを喜ぶのはさ、
他のみんなに悪いかなって思うわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one's exactly eager to do
that anymore, you know?

fields.EN:
Like, I'm all happy and stuff,
because it's not like I wanna
die or anything.
fields.JP:
そりゃ俺っち、内心嬉しいぜ？
心の中じゃいっつも死にたくねえって
思ってたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, I'm all happy and stuff,
because it's not like I wanna
die or anything.

fields.EN:
But ya know, I'm an adult so
I'm not gonna break down and
and cry in happiness, ya dig?
fields.JP:
ただそれを『やったぜラッキー、フゥー！』
ってやらないくらいは俺っちも大人なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But ya know, I'm an adult so
I'm not gonna break down and
and cry in happiness, ya dig?

fields.EN:
I don't see the big deal.
You're all alive, right?
fields.JP:
……僕はいいと思うけどな。
だってみんな生きていたいんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see the big deal.
You're all alive, right?

fields.EN:
Same here. You don't need to
proclaim to everyone how
happy you are, you know?
fields.JP:
わたしも、あえてみんなの前で
言わなければ、喜んだっていいと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. You don't need to
proclaim to everyone how
happy you are, you know?

fields.EN:
They're right. Plus, there's
always the chance we'll need
to return in the future.
fields.JP:
そうだよみんな。それにこれから先、
戻るチャンスだってきっとあると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're right. Plus, there's
always the chance we'll need
to return in the future.

fields.EN:
Yes, Jack's right. Opportunity
comes only to those who stay
alive.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックの言うとおりだ。
生きていればチャンスは絶対にある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, Jack's right. Opportunity
comes only to those who stay
alive.

fields.EN:
We didn't give up, which is why
we're here today.
fields.JP:
だって僕たちも諦めなかったから、
今こうしてここにいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't give up, which is why
we're here today.

fields.EN:
Of course, we went through
a lot ourselves, sometimes
regretting our choices...
fields.JP:
そりゃあ何度も挫けたし、
遠回りもしたけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, we went through
a lot ourselves, sometimes
regretting our choices...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yes, what you two went through
was quite something...
fields.JP:
……そうだね、あれはとても長い
遠回りだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, what you two went through
was quite something...

fields.EN:
But, everything you went
through was necessary to
bring you to this moment here.
fields.JP:
でも、全然無駄なことじゃなかったよ。
むしろ必要なことだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, everything you went
through was necessary to
bring you to this moment here.

fields.EN:
We've all been through the
ringer, but it led us here.
fields.JP:
みんな、僕たちは最悪を経験して、
それでこうして今ここにいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've all been through the
ringer, but it led us here.

fields.EN:
Now that you've survived the
worst, I'm sure good things
are headed your way.
fields.JP:
だから、こう思おうよ。
悪いことの後には幸せが待ってる、って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you've survived the
worst, I'm sure good things
are headed your way.

fields.EN:
Heh, you're right. We saw rock
bottom, so we can only go
up from here!
fields.JP:
……へっ、そうだな。
俺たちはもう最悪を経験した。
なら後は上がるっきゃねーな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, you're right. We saw rock
bottom, so we can only go
up from here!

fields.EN:
We all went through a lot to
get here. We can't give up now.
fields.JP:
何度もつまずいて、
ようやくここまで来たんだもん。
めげてなんかいられないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We all went through a lot to
get here. We can't give up now.

fields.EN:
Yup! We're not gonna let
hope go so easily!
fields.JP:
うん。もう簡単に
希望を捨てたりなんてできないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We're not gonna let
hope go so easily!

fields.EN:
The sun rises after the storm, eh?
Nice way to wrap things up.
fields.JP:
悪いことの後には幸せが待ってる……か。
いいこと言ってくれるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun rises after the storm, eh?
Nice way to wrap things up.

fields.EN:
Indeed. It lacks scientific proof,
but oddly enough, it sounds
coherently true...
fields.JP:
ああ。非論理的だが、
どこかそう思わせてくれるから不思議だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. It lacks scientific proof,
but oddly enough, it sounds
coherently true...

fields.EN:
Nice words, Jack! You were
always a winner in my book!
fields.JP:
さすがジャッくん、
あたしゃやる子だって信じてたよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice words, Jack! You were
always a winner in my book!

fields.EN:
You know, your words seem to
move people, just like they used
to when we were imprisoned.
fields.JP:
監獄にいた時からそうだったけどよ、
なんかお前の言葉には力があるな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, your words seem to
move people, just like they used
to when we were imprisoned.

fields.EN:
You too, Otsuu, Ningyohime.
I can't believe your words would
be so moving, too.
fields.JP:
それにおつうと人魚姫も。
会って間もないってのに、
不思議な奴らだぜ、まったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Otsuu, Little Mermaid.
I can't believe your words would
be so moving, too.

fields.EN:
Heh... You took what we
said to heart?
fields.JP:
はは、そんなに簡単に
僕たちを信じてくれるのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... You took what we
said to heart?

fields.EN:
At first, we were thinking of
looking for another core down
here.
fields.JP:
……最初はよ、俺たちはこのまま地下から
別の核を見つけようって決めてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first, we were thinking of
looking for another core down
here.

fields.EN:
You know how Hikari brought
you and Ningyohime to
convince us to follow you, right?
fields.JP:
けど、ヒカリがおまえと人魚姫を
連れてきてくれて、一緒に行こうって
言ってくれただろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how Hikari brought
you and Little Mermaid to
convince us to follow you, right?

fields.EN:
It was a bit forceful, but we
decided to follow you girls.
fields.JP:
あの時は強引だなと思いつつも、
説得されてついてきたわけだけどよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a bit forceful, but we
decided to follow you girls.

fields.EN:
It felt like old friends were
trying to convince me,
so I decided to believe in you.
fields.JP:
その、なんつーかまるで
昔の仲間に説得された気持ちになってよ。
だからつい信じちまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt like old friends were
trying to convince me,
so I decided to believe in you.

fields.EN:
Yup, we're old friends all right!
Right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
うん、昔っから仲間なんだよ！
ね、おつうちゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, we're old friends all right!
Right, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yeah! I'm sure we were old
friends that helped each other
from before!
fields.JP:
ああ！　僕たちはきっと昔、
どこかで助け合って生きてきた
仲間なんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! I'm sure we were old
friends that helped each other
from before!

fields.EN:
Uh-huh, so what's with you
two holding hands all
happy and everything?
fields.JP:
ありゃりゃ、手ぇ取り合って
喜んじゃってまあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh-huh, so what's with you
two holding hands all
happy and everything?

fields.EN:
Speaking of... Hikari, how come
you brought Otsuu and Ningyohime to us?
fields.JP:
ところでヒカリは、どうしておつうと
人魚姫を連れてきてくれたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of... Hikari, how come
you brought Otsuu and Little
Mermaid to us?

fields.EN: Those two came to me and said, "We're definitely all going together."
fields.JP:
２人がね、私に声をかけてくれたの。
絶対みんなで行こう、って
fields.LOCALIZED:
They spoke with me, and we
decided to go see you together.

fields.EN:
I told them how I turned into an
angel, and they learned what
happened to everyone.
fields.JP:
私が天使になった経緯を知って、
マモルたちの状態も全部知って……
その上で言ってくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told them how I turned into an
angel, and they learned what
happened to everyone.

fields.EN:
Then they said that we should
all work together...
fields.JP:
『それなら尚更、
　みんなで手を取りあおうよ』って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then they said that we should
all work together...

fields.EN:
I didn't know who they were, but
their words were caring and
opened my eyes to hope.
fields.JP:
全然知らない人たちだったのに、
何かとても懐かしく感じちゃってね？
それで希望が湧いてきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know who they were, but
their words were caring and
opened my eyes to hope.

fields.JP:
へっ、ヒカリもだったのか。
何か不思議だな

fields.EN:
I think everyone can tell now
that those two are very unique.
fields.JP:
あの２人が不思議な存在というのは、
みんな感じていることみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think everyone can tell now
that those two are very unique.

fields.EN:
Stop making it sound like you
were in the know from before...
fields.JP: 何をしたり顔で言ってんのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop making it sound like you
were in the know from before...

fields.EN:
I was simply giving an
observation...
fields.JP: 僕は客観的に意見を述べただけであって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was simply giving an
observation...

fields.EN:
I had my eyes on them before
they got big, ya know!
fields.JP:
自分、あいつらが売れる前から
ずっと目ぇつけてたんで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had my eyes on them before
they got big, ya know!

fields.EN:
Heh heh. Just like you to act
like you were the first
on the spot.
fields.JP:
あーいるいる。
前から知ってましたってアピールする奴
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh. Just like you to act
like you were the first
on the spot.

fields.EN:
Yeah, but it's not like we knew
them from before or anything.
fields.JP: ってか前からは知らねえだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but it's not like we knew
them from before or anything.

fields.EN:
Hey, there you are!
We're all ready on our side!
fields.JP:
あ、いたいた！
みんな！　こっちは準備できたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, there you are!
We're all ready on our side!

fields.JP: じゃあみんな、僕たちも行こう！

fields.EN: I'll send everyone to the surface.
fields.JP:
それじゃあこれから、
みんなを地上に送るね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll send everyone to the surface.

fields.JP: かみさまもいっしょにいく？

fields.EN:
Yup! I sure am!
Oh, but I'm not a "god," okay?
fields.JP:
うん！　一緒に行くよ！
それと、私は神様なんかじゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I sure am!
Oh, but I'm not a "god," okay?

fields.EN:
But the power you hold is akin
to that of a god...
fields.JP: ……でも、そう思えるくらいの素敵なチカラ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the power you hold is akin
to that of a god...

fields.EN:
Heh heh, so the curtains will
close on the old story to hail
the new story to come...
fields.JP:
ふふ、ついに旧い物語は幕を下ろし、
始まりの刻が巡ってきたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, so the curtains will
close on the old story to hail
the new story to come...

fields.EN:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.
fields.JP:
新たに開いた頁の先に広がる世界が
どのような姿であろうと、
陽は沈み、また昇る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless of the new chapter
unfurling a new world, the sun
will set and rise as usual.

fields.EN:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.
fields.JP:
そんな世界に、希望の欠片が潜まぬ筈がない
……そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, there will always be a
fragment of hope hidden within
that world.

fields.EN:
Yes! I'm sure it'll be a world
filled with hope! Everyone
already showed that to me!
fields.JP:
うん！　希望しかないよ、きっと！
私はそうみんなに教わったもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! I'm sure it'll be a world
filled with hope! Everyone
already showed that to me!

fields.EN: I want to bring sunlight to everyone too... so I'll stay with Chii and keep watching over everyone. Okay?
fields.JP:
わたしも、みんなにお日様を
届けたいから……ちーちゃんとずっと
一緒に、みんなのことを見守るの。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I deliver everyone to the
sun, Chii and I will watch over
everyone.

fields.JP: ねー、ちじょうってどんなとこ？
今となっては、ここの誰もがわからないわね

fields.EN:
Otsuu, you don't really know
much about the surface, do you?
fields.JP:
おつうたちは地上について、
何か知ってたりしねえのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you don't really know
much about the surface, do you?

fields.EN: I don't know that much about the surface, though.
fields.JP: さすがに地上のことまで詳しくは知らないよ

fields.EN:
I can explain a lot about what's
down here, though.
fields.JP: むしろ地下の方ならとっても詳しいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can explain a lot about what's
down here, though.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? Remembering what you went
through down here isn't going
to bring a smile to your face...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、そこで思い出して
へこまないでってば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? Remembering what you went
through down here isn't going
to bring a smile to your face...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Well, I for one am interested in
what you went through, Tsuu.
fields.JP:
つう、後で地下の生活について詳しく
話を聞かせてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I for one am interested in
what you went through, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Quick to the subject as usual...
fields.JP: 相変わらず食いつきの早いことで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Quick to the subject as usual...

fields.EN:
Most humans hold fear of the
unknown, but in this case...
fields.JP:
まあ人間は『分からない』ものに
恐怖を覚えるものだが、今回は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most humans hold fear of the
unknown, but in this case...

fields.EN:
Right, we want to hurry and
see what's in store for us.
fields.JP: そうね、早くこの目で見てみたいって思うね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, we want to hurry and
see what's in store for us.

fields.EN:
Count us in, too.
That's why we're all going up
to the surface, right?
fields.JP:
同じく。
だから行くのよ。そうでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Count us in, too.
That's why we're all going up
to the surface, right?

fields.EN:
As long as we're together,
we can go anywhere.
fields.JP:
みんなと一緒なんだから……
どんなところだって生きていけるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we're together,
we can go anywhere.

fields.EN:
That's right, and don't forget who
trained all of you! We'll be able
to take on anything!
fields.JP:
そうだね。あたしの鍛えたみんなだもん。
そんじょそこらじゃ負けないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, and don't forget who
trained all of you! We'll be able
to take on anything!

fields.EN:
Ya know, as a newbie here, I'm
counting on ya Blood Maidens!
fields.JP:
新参者のあっしとしては、めっちゃ
頼りにしてまっせ、血式少女のみなはん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya know, as a newbie here, I'm
counting on ya Blood Maidens!

fields.EN:
Heh heh, don't you worry!
"Sis and the Blood Maidens"
are here for everyone!
fields.JP:
うんうん、みーんなまとめて
お姉さんと血式少女の仲間たちで
守ってあげるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, don't you worry!
"Sis and the Blood Maidens"
are here for everyone!

fields.EN:
Don't make up a group name
like that...!
fields.JP: 何だかそのグループ名は釈然としない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't make up a group name
like that...!

fields.JP: まあまあ、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Oh my, I can't wait to see what
lies on the surface!
fields.JP:
それにしても本当に、
地上には何が待ってるのかしら。
ふふ、楽しみですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, I can't wait to see what
lies on the surface!

fields.EN:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.
fields.JP:
地上に行くのに空へと昇るなんて……
どんな感じなんでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it's like, climbing
up to the sky to reach the
surface.

fields.EN:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.
fields.JP:
新しい世界には、新しい謎がたくさん
あるはず……楽しくないわけがないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The new world will have its own
mysteries. Of course it's going
to be interesting there.

fields.JP: うんっ！　ラプンツェル、たのしみー！

fields.EN:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experynce it
again...
fields.JP:
ワレは一度、身をもって体験したこと……
二度も体験できりゅとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I experienced this once before...
I didn't expect to experynce yit
agayne...

fields.EN:
I-I didn't slyrr!
Unbelievable! You still say that
don't you?!
fields.JP:
か、噛んでなどおりゃにゅわ！！
久しぶりに会ったと思えば失礼な奴らめ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I didn't slyrr!
Unbelievable! You still say that
don't you?!

fields.EN:
I didn't believe we'd see the
day we'd be able to talk like this
again!
fields.JP:
またこうしてこのやり取りができるとは……
あたい感激だわ～～～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't believe we'd see the
day we'd be able to talk like this
again!

fields.EN: So you all met Hameln in this world too.
fields.JP:
みんなはこっちの世界でも
ハーメルンに会ってるんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good to know Hameln still
slurs in this world too.

fields.JP: ふふふ、じゃあみんないくよ

fields.EN:
Surface, eh...?
Well, here's to hoping we get
along up there, too!
fields.JP:
いよいよ地上か……
おまえら、向こうでもよろしくな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surface, eh...?
Well, here's to hoping we get
along up there, too!

fields.EN:
Of course!
We'll always be together!
fields.JP: もちろん！　みんな一緒だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course!
We'll always be together!

fields.EN:
Yes, and we're going to make
our way to a new future!
fields.JP: ああ！　みんなで未来を切り拓こう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and we're going to make
our way to a new future!

fields.EN: A new beginning to a new story...
fields.JP: 新しい物語の、始まりね……
fields.LOCALIZED: A new beginning to a new story...

fields.EN:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...
fields.JP:
これからみんなで、新しい物語を
始めていくんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to create a new story
with everyone...

fields.EN:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.
fields.JP: けれど、夢の終わりは、別の夢の始まり
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the end of one dream marks the
beginning of another.

fields.EN:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?
fields.JP: ……誰かにそう聞いたことはないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've heard that before, haven't
you?

fields.EN: Can I bother you for a moment?
fields.LOCALIZED: Can I bother you for a moment?

fields.JP: ええ、入ってちょうだい

fields.EN:
(It feels a bit weird visiting her
like this...)
fields.JP:
（訪ねてみたはいいものの、改まって話すと
　なると、なんかくすぐったいな…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It feels a bit weird visiting her
like this...)

fields.JP: その……新しい部屋はどう？

fields.EN:
Compared to the prison cell, much
better. Nothing could have been
worse than where we were.
fields.JP:
いいに決まってるわ。
なにしろ前は牢獄だったじゃない。
あれより悪いとこなんかないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Compared to the prison cell, much
better. Nothing could have been
worse than where we were.

fields.EN:
Y-You're right. Sorry for the
weird question.
fields.JP: そ、そうだね。変なこと聞いちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're right. Sorry for the
weird question.

fields.EN:
But, how can I word this...
Doesn't the place look drab?
fields.JP:
でも、なんだろう。
……まだ殺風景な感じがしない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, how can I word this...
Doesn't the place look drab?

fields.EN:
Yeah... It's your room now, so why
not decorate the place?
fields.JP:
うん。
折角の自分の部屋だし、
飾り付けしてみるのもいいんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It's your room now, so why
not decorate the place?

fields.EN: I'm not the type to decorate...
fields.JP:
……部屋を飾るだなんて、
そんなのわたしの柄じゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not the type to decorate...

fields.EN:
(Alice never was into those kind
of things... I guess you could say
she's not into showcasing...)
fields.JP:
（アリスは昔からそういうとこ無頓着だよなあ。
　……女の子っぽくないっていうか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice never was into those kind
of things... I guess you could say
she's not into showcasing...)

fields.EN:
(Well, with what she's been
through, I don't blame her...)
fields.JP:
（環境が環境だったから、
　しょうがないのかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, with what she's been
through, I don't blame her...)

fields.EN: That aside, are you okay, Jack?
fields.JP:
……それより、ジャック。
傷はもういいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: That aside, are you okay, Jack?

fields.JP: うん。もうなんともないよ

fields.EN:
You know how quickly my bleeding
stops, right?
fields.JP:
アリスも以前から知ってるように、
僕は出血してもわりとすぐに止まるだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how quickly my bleeding
stops, right?

fields.EN:
I remember those times I used to
feel angry, and I'd bite onto your
finger for your blood.
fields.JP:
昔は何もわからず、身体の奥がかあっとなると、
やみくもにあなたの指先に噛み付いて血を舐めて
いたりしたものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember those times I used to
feel angry, and I'd bite onto your
finger for your blood.

fields.EN:
Yeah, and then I just started to
cut my finger for you.
fields.JP:
僕もそのうち自分から指を切って
血を出したりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and then I just started to
cut my finger for you.

fields.EN:
I sucked on it almost like it was
a pacifier...
fields.JP: おしゃぶりするみたいに舐めさせてもらったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sucked on it almost like it was
a pacifier...

fields.EN:
Um... I-I mean, I had no weird
intentions when I did that, you
know?!
fields.JP:
……って、ち、違うわ！
そういう意味じゃなくて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I-I mean, I had no weird
intentions when I did that, you
know?!

fields.EN:
(Seeing Alice blush is making me
blush, too...)
fields.JP:
（アリスが赤くなるもんだから、
　僕もつられてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seeing Alice blush is making me
blush, too...)

fields.EN:
Whatever the reason, licking your
blood seemed to calm me down. I
felt as if my anger melted away.
fields.JP:
あの頃から、あなたの血を舐めると
ほっとしたものだったわ。
猛る心が癒されていく感じがした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the reason, licking your
blood seemed to calm me down. I
felt as if my anger melted away.

fields.EN:
And I've been reliant on you ever
since then...
fields.JP:
わたし……あなたが安心をくれているのだと
ばかり、思っていたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I've been reliant on you ever
since then...

fields.EN:
(I wonder if Alice is still
regretting going into Blood
Skelter...)
fields.JP:
（アリス……ブラッドスケルター化のこと、
　まだ悔やんでるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Alice is still
regretting going into Blood
Skelter...)

fields.EN:
Alice? Why don't we stop the
conversation here?
fields.JP:
もう、その話はやめようって言っただろ。
アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? Why don't we stop the
conversation here?

fields.EN:
I'm actually proud that I've been
able to help you in some way.
fields.JP:
僕は、自分が君の役に立ててたってわかって、
すごく……誇らしいんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm actually proud that I've been
able to help you in some way.

fields.JP: ……誇らしいだなんて、変なジャック

fields.EN:
I really hated myself for not
being of any use...
fields.JP:
僕は、役立たずな自分のことが、
ほんとに嫌だったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really hated myself for not
being of any use...

fields.EN:
That's not true, not even a
little.
fields.JP:
あなたが役立たずだったことなんて、
一度もないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true, not even a
little.

fields.EN:
Let's just find our way out of
here together, okay?
fields.JP:
……だから、これからも一緒に……
ここを脱出しましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just find our way out of
here together, okay?

fields.EN:
Alice... You're right. Let's
escape from here, together.
fields.JP:
アリス……。
そうだね……一緒に脱出しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... You're right. Let's
escape from here, together.

fields.EN:
Alice-san, that's one fine specimen
yer looking at!
fields.JP:
アリスさん。
それ、かなりの掘り出し物っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, that's one fine specimen
yer looking at!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
(What is she looking at? I've
never seen her so happy before...)
fields.JP:
（何を夢中になって見ているんだろう。
　あんな嬉しそうな顔、見たことないかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What is she looking at? I've
never seen her so happy before...)

fields.EN:
(I have to admit, this place is
always filled with weird stuff...)
fields.JP:
（それにしてもこの道具屋、いつ来ても
　わけのわからない物で溢れ返ってるなあ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to admit, this place is
always filled with weird stuff...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder where she gets the
supplies to stock up.)
fields.JP: （これだけの物、どこで仕入れて来るんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder where she gets the
supplies to stock up.)

fields.JP: あ、ジャックさん！　まいどっす！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Alice? What are you looking at?
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice? What are you looking at?

fields.JP:
（『ひゃっ』！？
　こ、こっちがびっくりした……）

fields.EN:
Heh... Looks like you finally
noticed. So, what were you looking
at?
fields.JP:
あはは……やっと気が付いた
何をそんなに真剣に見てたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Looks like you finally
noticed. So, what were you looking
at?

fields.EN:
Yeah. It's pretty old and it
doesn't look like it can be used
properly anymore.
fields.JP:
ええ。
まあ、だいぶボロボロだし、
使い物になるかどうかも怪しいってところね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. It's pretty old and it
doesn't look like it can be used
properly anymore.

fields.EN:
Rare wouldn't describe it. It's a
miracle that every piece is still
here in the set.
fields.JP:
珍しいなんてものじゃないわ。
１客も欠けていないだけでも奇跡なのに、
各種ポットもぜんぶ揃っているなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rare wouldn't describe it. It's a
miracle that every piece is still
here in the set.

fields.EN:
And, look at this line. It's not
often you see such a well-balanced
line like this.
fields.JP:
それに見て、このカップの子持ち線。
これだけの均等なラインを引いているのは
滅多にないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, look at this line. It's not
often you see such a well-balanced
line like this.

fields.EN:
(Even though she said it was
pretty old, she's talking about it
with such passion...)
fields.JP:
（さっきボロボロだって言ってたのに、
　随分と熱心に話すんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even though she said it was
pretty old, she's talking about it
with such passion...)

fields.EN:
(I didn't know Alice knew so much
about dishware...)
fields.JP:
（でも、アリスって……
　そんなに食器に詳しかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know Alice knew so much
about dishware...)

fields.EN:
I'm curious... Do you want it,
Alice?
fields.JP: もしかして……アリスはこれが欲しいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious... Do you want it,
Alice?

fields.EN:
Wh-What are you saying?
There's no meaning in buying a set
meant for five people. To start...
fields.JP:
な、なにを言ってるの。
こんなの５客もあったって意味ないでしょう。
だいたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What are you saying?
There's no meaning in buying a set
meant for five people. To start...

fields.EN:
N-Nevermind... Um, I'll see you
later...
fields.JP: も、もういいわ……それじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Nevermind... Um, I'll see you
later...

fields.EN:
(It sure looked like she wanted
it...)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても、欲しいようにしか
　見えないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It sure looked like she wanted
it...)

fields.JP: えーと……これはいいものなの？

fields.EN:
Hey! Everything I've got here's
good stuff!
fields.JP:
むー。ウチに悪いものなんか、
いっこも置いてないっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Everything I've got here's
good stuff!

fields.EN:
Didn't ya hear Alice-san? That's one
rare find you ain't gonna see just
anywhere!
fields.JP:
それに、アリスさんの説明、
ちゃんと聞いてたっスか？
そうそうお目にかかれない掘り出し物っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't ya hear Alice? That's one
rare find you ain't gonna see just
anywhere!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
So, how about you be a man and buy
it as a gift for Alice-san?
fields.JP:
ここは一丁、
アリスさんへのプレゼントにどうっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how about you be a man and buy
it as a gift for Alice?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP: あ、ジャック。どうしたの？

fields.EN:
Well... I wanted to give this to
you.
fields.JP:
あのさ……これなんだけど。
受け取ってもらえるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I wanted to give this to
you.

fields.JP:
ど、どうしたの、いきなり……
それに……これ……！

fields.EN:
It's what you were looking at back
at the store. I wanted to get it
for you, so...
fields.JP:
この間、君が道具屋で見てたやつだよ。
プレゼント、しようと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's what you were looking at back
at the store. I wanted to get it
for you, so...

fields.EN:
No, that's not it... Why did you
get it for me?
fields.JP: そうじゃなくて、どうしてわたしに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not it... Why did you
get it for me?

fields.EN:
You know how I'm weak and can't
fight? Without you, I wouldn't
have made it this far.
fields.JP:
僕は弱っちくて、戦闘もからきしダメだし、
君がいなければとっくに死んでたかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how I'm weak and can't
fight? Without you, I wouldn't
have made it this far.

fields.EN:
Why I'm still alive, and why I
wanted to fight alongside everyone
was because of you, Alice.
fields.JP:
そんな僕が今まで生きてこられたのも、
一緒に戦おうって思えるようになったのも、
みんなアリスのおかげなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why I'm still alive, and why I
wanted to fight alongside everyone
was because of you, Alice.

fields.EN:
So this is, um... A thank you
gift, sort of?
fields.JP: だから、その……、お礼、みたいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is, um... A thank you
gift, sort of?

fields.EN:
When I saw the tea set, I felt an
urge to have a tea party. And I
suddenly knew things about it...
fields.JP:
販売所でこのティーセットを見かけたとき、
なぜかお茶会を開きたいって気持ちが湧いて……
知りもしないはずの、茶器の知識まで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I saw the tea set, I felt an
urge to have a tea party. And I
suddenly knew things about it...

fields.EN:
I was trying to figure out how I
knew so much, and ended up just
staring at it.
fields.JP:
何故なのだろう、と思って、
ついこれをじっと見てしまったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was trying to figure out how I
knew so much, and ended up just
staring at it.

fields.EN:
(That sounds almost like the
strange urge I have...)
fields.JP:
（それ……僕のわけのわからない衝動と
　同じようなものなのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That sounds almost like the
strange urge I have...)

fields.EN:
And, I was also thinking of being
able to drink tea with you one
day...
fields.JP:
でも……
いつか、これであなたとお茶を飲めたら
いいなって思っていたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I was also thinking of being
able to drink tea with you one
day...

fields.EN: Do you remember this hair pin?
fields.JP: 覚えてるかしら？　この髪留め……
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you remember this hair pin?

fields.EN:
Yeah. The one I gave to you a long
time ago, right?
fields.JP: ……うん。昔、僕があげたもの、だよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. The one I gave to you a long
time ago, right?

fields.EN:
Yes. It's the very first thing you
gave me, Jack. You can't imagine
how happy I was.
fields.JP:
ええ。ジャックがいちばん最初にくれたものよ。
……とても嬉しかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It's the very first thing you
gave me, Jack. You can't imagine
how happy I was.

fields.EN:
In fact, I'm always happy that you
keep looking after me.
fields.JP:
あなたがわたしを気にかけてくれていること、
いつも嬉しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I'm always happy that you
keep looking after me.

fields.EN:
Jack... You are the one who
supports me.
fields.JP:
ジャック、
あなたこそわたしを支えてくれてるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You are the one who
supports me.

fields.EN: Stop it... You're making me blush.
fields.JP: なんか、そう言われると照れちゃうな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop it... You're making me blush.

fields.EN:
I might not look good with this
hair pin, but I wear it so I don't
forget what you've done for me.
fields.JP:
わたしなんかには似合わないかもしれないけど、
この髪留めをつけてるのは、あなたへの
感謝の気持ちを忘れないためでもあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I might not look good with this
hair pin, but I wear it so I don't
forget what you've done for me.

fields.EN:
Oh, come on! You look good with
it on!
fields.JP:
似合わないだなんて！
そんなことないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on! You look good with
it on!

fields.EN:
Really! I think it looks perfect
on you. I'm happy that you have it
with you all the time.
fields.JP:
ほんとに！　君にぴったりだと思うよ。
君がいつもつけててくれて、僕だって嬉しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really! I think it looks perfect
on you. I'm happy that you have it
with you all the time.

fields.JP:
そうなの……？
その……ありがとう

fields.EN:
Once we escape from the Jail, we
should have a tea party. No, we
can even have one right now!
fields.JP:
それから、ジェイルを脱出したら、
このティーセットでお茶会を開こうよ。
いや、いますぐだって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we escape from the Jail, we
should have a tea party. No, we
can even have one right now!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Now, that's a bit too
soon.
fields.JP: ふふ。それはまだ早すぎるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Now, that's a bit too
soon.

fields.EN:
Jack, thank you... I really
couldn't be happier.
fields.JP:
ジャック。
ありがとう、嬉しいわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, thank you... I really
couldn't be happier.

fields.EN: I'm happy to see you happy.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm happy to see you happy.

fields.EN:
(Seeing her this happy was worth
it.)
fields.JP:
（こんなに喜んでもらえるなんて、
　……やっぱりあげてよかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seeing her this happy was worth
it.)

fields.EN:
That's what I wanted to ask you.
You locked yourself up in your
room right after you returned.
fields.JP:
どうしたの、じゃないわ。
戻るなり、すぐ部屋に閉じ篭って
しまうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I wanted to ask you.
You locked yourself up in your
room right after you returned.

fields.EN:
You look pale... Are you all
right?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You look pale... Are you all
right?

fields.EN:
Really? I don't think there's
anything wrong with me.
fields.JP:
そうかな？
いつも通りだと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I don't think there's
anything wrong with me.

fields.EN: (I'm a little anemic, but I can't let her worry about me...)
fields.JP:
（少し貧血気味だけど、
　心配させるわけにはいかないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sure I feel a bit dizzy, but it's
nothing for Alice to be worried
about...)

fields.EN:
It sure doesn't look like you're
okay...
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure doesn't look like you're
okay...

fields.EN:
(I can't let Alice see through me
now... I need to be the one to
protect her...)
fields.JP:
（弱気なところを悟られてはダメだ。
　今度は僕がアリスを守らなきゃ
　いけないんだから…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't let Alice see through me
now... I need to be the one to
protect her...)

fields.EN:
Maybe you've been overexerting
yourself too frequently.
fields.JP: 最近、少し無理しすぎではないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe you've been overexerting
yourself too frequently.

fields.EN:
It's just that I can't be resting
all the time while you're out there
fighting, Alice.
fields.JP:
それに、アリスたちが必死に戦っているのに、
僕だけ休んでもいられないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I can't be resting
all the time while you're out there
fighting, Alice.

fields.EN:
So there's nothing to worry about.
You're such a worrywart, Alice.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、心配要らないよ。
アリスは心配性だなあ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there's nothing to worry about.
You're such a worrywart, Alice.

fields.EN:
As long as you're okay, I'm fine.
I'll see you later, then...
fields.JP:
……そう、大丈夫ならいいわ。
それじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're okay, I'm fine.
I'll see you later, then...

fields.EN:
(I was only trying to ease her
worries, but did I do it
wrong...?)
fields.JP:
（安心させようと思っただけなんだけど、
　何か、間違えちゃったかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was only trying to ease her
worries, but did I do it
wrong...?)

fields.EN:
(She looks like she's in a bad
mood...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks like she's in a bad
mood...)

fields.EN:
Um, about last time... I'm sorry
if it sounded rude. I just wanted
to keep you from worrying.
fields.JP:
その……この間はごめん。
君があんまり心配するから、
安心させようと思ったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, about last time... I'm sorry
if it sounded rude. I just wanted
to keep you from worrying.

fields.JP: 安心なんかできないわ！！

fields.EN:
I'm fighting out there for
everyone, for myself, and... for
you.
fields.JP:
わたしは……わたしは戦ってる。
みんなのため、わたしのため、
あなたのため……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fighting out there for
everyone, for myself, and... for
you.

fields.EN:
Jack... If you get hurt, or
worse... then all that fighting
would mean nothing!
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたがもし倒れたら、
わたしが戦う意味なんてなくなるの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... If you get hurt, or
worse... then all that fighting
would mean nothing!

fields.EN:
Please! Please don't overdo it...
I want to support you just as much
as you want to support me.
fields.JP:
お願い、もう無理はしないで。
あなたがわたしの支えであるように、
わたしもあなたの支えになっていたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please! Please don't overdo it...
I want to support you just as much
as you want to support me.

fields.EN:
If you're tired or hurt, let me
know. At least rely on me when
we're together!
fields.JP:
キツいときは言って。
せめて二人のときくらいはわたしを頼って……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're tired or hurt, let me
know. At least rely on me when
we're together!

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Alice like this
before...)
fields.JP: （アリスがこんな顔をするのは初めてだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Alice like this
before...)

fields.EN:
I kept thinking I was a burden,
and I still do.
fields.JP:
僕はすっかり自分がお荷物だと思ってた
いまさら違うって言われても、なかなか
そう思えなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept thinking I was a burden,
and I still do.

fields.EN:
Ever since I was little, I've been
relying on you, and I kept making
matters worse in battle...
fields.JP:
小さいときから君に頼り切っていて、
戦いでも足手まといで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since I was little, I've been
relying on you, and I kept making
matters worse in battle...

fields.EN:
Now that I can finally help, I
just want to hold a stronger
front and tell you it's my turn.
fields.JP:
……ようやく君の役に立てると思って、
今度は僕が君を助ける番だって思って、
強がってみせてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I can finally help, I
just want to hold a stronger
front and tell you it's my turn.

fields.EN:
But, you're right... If things get
tough, I'll rely on you. If things
are fun, I'll share them with you.
fields.JP:
……そうだよ。
つらいことがあれば、君に頼る。
楽しいことがあれば、君と分かち合う
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you're right... If things get
tough, I'll rely on you. If things
are fun, I'll share them with you.

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, I can't
believe I haven't been doing
that already...
fields.JP:
それだけのこと、
どうして僕はできなかったんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, I can't
believe I haven't been doing
that already...

fields.EN:
Even after being with you for so
long...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even after being with you for so
long...

fields.EN:
(I should have opened up to her
to begin with...)
fields.JP:
（……最初から、ちゃんと話せば
　よかったんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should have opened up to her
to begin with...)

fields.EN:
Wh-What are you saying? There's
no need to thank me.
fields.JP:
な、なに言ってるの。
お礼なんか言う必要ないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What are you saying? There's
no need to thank me.

fields.EN:
Promise me that you're not going
to bear so much of a burden on
yourself.
fields.JP:
でも、約束よ。
我慢するのは、もうやめて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Promise me that you're not going
to bear so much of a burden on
yourself.

fields.EN:
(I didn't know Alice's hands were
so small and warm, and... so
reliable...)
fields.JP:
（アリスの手、こんなに温かかったんだ。
　それに……小さいのに、頼もしい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know Alice's hands were
so small and warm, and... so
reliable...)

fields.EN:
(I've never noticed this about
her. I guess I haven't changed
much since I was a kid...)
fields.JP:
（そんなことにも気がつかなかったなんて、
　僕は、ほんとうに子供だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never noticed this about
her. I guess I haven't changed
much since I was a kid...)

fields.EN:
Okay, but that applies to you,
too.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, but that applies to you,
too.

fields.JP: ……中央の塔もだいぶ高くなってきたね

fields.EN:
Yes. It makes the moon look eerier
than ever. As if it's beckoning
the Tower toward it...
fields.JP:
ええ。
そのぶん月の輝きが、殊更不気味に感じるわね。
まるで塔を手招きしているような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It makes the moon look eerier
than ever. As if it's beckoning
the Tower toward it...

fields.EN:
It also seems like it knows the
Jail's desires...
fields.JP:
ジェイルの欲求をわかってるみたいなのも、
なんだか気味が悪いし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also seems like it knows the
Jail's desires...

fields.EN:
But the Professor said that we're
just about ready to escape from
here.
fields.JP:
……でもさ、博士が言ってたよね。
脱獄できる目処はついてきたって。
……もう、間もなくだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Professor said that we're
just about ready to escape from
here.

fields.EN:
We're a lot stronger now, and we
can face the Marchens and the
Nightmare on level ground!
fields.JP:
僕らもさ、
メルヒェンたちにも手こずらなくなってきたし、
ナイトメアにだって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're a lot stronger now, and we
can face the Marchens and the
Nightmare on level ground!

fields.EN:
True. I think we're a lot more
adept in battle now. You're a lot
more reliable than before, too.
fields.JP:
そうね。戦いにも慣れてきたと思うわ。
……あなたもだいぶ逞しくなってきたと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. I think we're a lot more
adept in battle now. You're a lot
more reliable than before, too.

fields.EN:
You stay calm, even when we enter
Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
わたしたちがブラッドスケルター化しても、
冷静に対応できるようになったじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You stay calm, even when we enter
Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
I guess I'm not as panicky as
before. So, I'm really acting
calmer, then?
fields.JP:
……確かに以前はすぐパニクってたかもしれないな。
今は結構、冷静にできてる……よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I'm not as panicky as
before. So, I'm really acting
calmer, then?

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Don't let it go to
your head.
fields.JP: ふふ。過信は禁物だけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Don't let it go to
your head.

fields.EN:
(But Alice is right. I should stay
focused. There's no telling what
might happen.)
fields.JP:
（でも、アリスの言う通り、過信は禁物だ。
　まだ何が起きるかわからないんだから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But Alice is right. I should stay
focused. There's no telling what
might happen.)

fields.EN:
Is the Jail's wailing still
bugging you?
fields.JP: ……ジェイルの鳴き声は、相変わらず煩いの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is the Jail's wailing still
bugging you?

fields.EN:
As usual. But the headphones help
muffle the sound, so it's not as
bad as before.
fields.JP:
相変わらず、かな。
ヘッドホンのお陰でほとんど気にならないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
As usual. But the headphones help
muffle the sound, so it's not as
bad as before.

fields.EN:
You wear them here too sometimes,
but can you hear us? I see you put
them on when there are arguments.
fields.JP:
……あなた時々、ここでもそれを着けてるけれど
人の声も遮ることができるの？
思えば、誰かしら揉めてる時が多いような……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wear them here too sometimes,
but can you hear us? I see you put
them on when there are arguments.

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, it's not like I'm wearing
them to avoid getting into
arguments and things...
fields.JP:
え？　ぼ、僕は別に、
みんなの口喧嘩に巻き込まれたくないとか、
そんな風に思ってるわけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, it's not like I'm wearing
them to avoid getting into
arguments and things...

fields.EN: Hm? Who said anything about that?
fields.JP:
あら。
誰もそんなことを言ってはいないのだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Who said anything about that?

fields.EN:
You can be mean sometimes,
Alice...
fields.JP: もう。アリスは意地悪だなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can be mean sometimes,
Alice...

fields.EN:
I keep an ear out for anything
important, and I'm always
listening to you, Alice.
fields.JP:
でも、大事な話はちゃんと聞いてるし、
アリスの言葉はいつだって、
聞き逃さないようにしてるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I keep an ear out for anything
important, and I'm always
listening to you, Alice.

fields.EN:
You know, I'm able to fight like
this because of you, Jack.
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
あなたがいたからここまで戦って来れたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I'm able to fight like
this because of you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Where did that come from? I think
you're doing great because
everyone's working as a team.
fields.JP:
どうしたの、いきなり？
そんなの、みんなが力を合わせてるからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where did that come from? I think
you're doing great because
everyone's working as a team.

fields.EN:
Heh... That sounds so like you.
But really, it's because of you.
Thank you.
fields.JP:
ふふ。そういうところは相変わらずね。
……ほんとうに、あなたのお陰なのよ。
ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... That sounds so like you.
But really, it's because of you.
Thank you.

fields.JP:
……僕だって、同じだよ。
ありがとう、アリス

fields.EN:
Say, what are you going to do when
you get to the surface?
fields.JP:
ねえ。
地上に出られたら、ジャックはどうするの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, what are you going to do when
you get to the surface?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'll probably stroll around
the area or something.
fields.JP:
うーん。
まずはそこらじゅう、見て回りたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'll probably stroll around
the area or something.

fields.EN:
After all, we don't know what the
world is like on the surface.
fields.JP:
塔の上にどんな世界があるのか、
僕たちは何も知らないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, we don't know what the
world is like on the surface.

fields.EN:
I'm sure there's a lot to see and
do once we get up there.
fields.JP:
きっと、わくわくするような世界が広がって
るんじゃないかって、思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there's a lot to see and
do once we get up there.

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You're going to
be with me, too!
fields.JP:
……どうしたの？
その時は、アリスも一緒に行こうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You're going to
be with me, too!

fields.JP:
わたしも……？
一緒に行っても……いいの？

fields.EN:
Well, unless there's something
else you wanted to do.
fields.JP:
あ……君が別のことをしたいんじゃなければ、
の話だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, unless there's something
else you wanted to do.

fields.EN:
No... I want to see the world up
there with you!
fields.JP:
そんな……
わたし、あなたと一緒に世界を見たいわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I want to see the world up
there with you!

fields.EN:
We're going to climb that tower
and get to the surface. Then we're
going to see the world together.
fields.JP:
僕たちは生き延びて、あの塔を昇って、
地上に出るんだ。
そして一緒に世界中を見て回る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to climb that tower
and get to the surface. Then we're
going to see the world together.

fields.JP:
……ね？
今からわくわくすると思わない？

fields.EN:
Yes... It sounds like a dream come
true.
fields.JP:
……ええ、そうね。
まるで、夢のようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... It sounds like a dream come
true.

fields.EN:
It isn't a dream. I'm sure it'll
happen soon.
fields.JP:
夢じゃないんだ。
きっと、もうすぐ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't a dream. I'm sure it'll
happen soon.

fields.JP:
そうね。
きっと、もうすぐ……

fields.EN:
(That's right... We're going to
escape from here, together.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ。
　もうすぐ僕たちは、ここを脱出するんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... We're going to
escape from here, together.)

fields.JP: （あれ、あそこにいるのはもしかして？）

（やっぱり、アリスだ。
　でも、一緒にいるのは……）

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel...? That's unusual. I
never see those two together...)
fields.JP:
（……ラプンツェル、だよね？
　ふたりでいるなんて、珍しい気が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel...? That's unusual. I
never see those two together...)

fields.JP:
あのね、ラプンツェル。
それは食べ物ではないの

うー？
たべものだよー？

fields.EN:
You found it on the ground. It's 
not good to eat.
fields.JP:
道ばたで拾ったものでしょう？
食べるものではありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
You found it on the ground. It's 
not good to eat.

fields.JP: じゃあ、ありすがたべる！

そー。ありすがたべる！
もったいないの！

fields.EN:
Waste... Well, I guess it would be
wasteful, but...
fields.JP:
もったいない……
もったいないのかもしれないけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waste... Well, I guess it would be
wasteful, but...

fields.EN:
Listen, Rapunzel. You're not
supposed to eat things that fell
on the ground.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、いいこと？
落ちているものは食べてはいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen, Rapunzel. You're not
supposed to eat things that fell
on the ground.

fields.EN:
Aww... If Alice no eat, Rapunzel
gonna eat! Food is food!
fields.JP:
えー。ありすがたべないなら
ラプンツェルがたべるー！
たべものはたべものなのーーーー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aww... If Alice no eat, Rapunzel
gonna eat! Food is food!

fields.JP: ありすわかんないーーー

fields.EN:
Um... You look like you need some
help.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You look like you need some
help.

fields.JP:
じゃーっくーーーー！！
あのねありすがねーー！

fields.EN: She's a handful, that's for sure.
fields.LOCALIZED: She's a handful, that's for sure.

fields.EN:
I saw that you were having
trouble, but why are you two
together in the first place?
fields.JP:
困ってるのは見えたけど……
君たちだけで一緒だなんて、どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw that you were having
trouble, but why are you two
together in the first place?

fields.EN:
I thought it would help for her to
get out of her room and take a
walk outside.
fields.JP:
気晴らしになるかと思って散歩させてたのよ。
部屋に閉じ篭りっぱなしも良くないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it would help for her to
get out of her room and take a
walk outside.

fields.EN:
But I didn't want her to walk
around by herself. There's no
telling what she would do.
fields.JP:
かといってひとりだけじゃ、
何をしでかすかわかったものじゃないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I didn't want her to walk
around by herself. There's no
telling what she would do.

fields.JP:
これ！
じゃっくたべる！

fields.EN:
(Whoa... What is this...? Forget
it being food or not, I'm not even
sure what it's made of...)
fields.JP:
（うわあ……なんだこれ……
　食べ物どころか成分もわからないもの
　渡されちゃったよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa... What is this...? Forget
it being food or not, I'm not even
sure what it's made of...)

fields.EN: Um, and the wall! So tasty!
fields.JP:
あのね。それでね。
かべ！
おいしかった！
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, and the wall! So tasty!

fields.EN: Stop talking about the Jail walls.
fields.JP: ジェイルの壁の話はやめなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop talking about the Jail walls.

fields.EN:
How about Nightmare? That was
good, too!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ないとめあ？
あれもおいしかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about Nightmare? That was
good, too!

fields.JP: （さすがに食べてないと思うよ……）
じゃっくもおいしかった！

fields.EN:
Wait a minute! When did you eat
Jack?!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って！
いつジャックを食べたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute! When did you eat
Jack?!

fields.JP:
やめて！
僕は食べ物じゃないよ！

fields.EN:
He's right, Rapunzel. He's not
food. Let him go.
fields.JP:
そうよ、ラプンツェル。
それは食べるものじゃないの。
離れなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right, Rapunzel. He's not
food. Let him go.

fields.EN: How come I can't eat him?
fields.JP: どうしてたべちゃだめなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: How come I can't eat him?

fields.JP: アリスのものだからだよ

fields.EN:
Mmm... Alice should eat Alice's
stuff.
fields.JP:
そっかー。
ありすのものはありすがたべる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Alice should eat Alice's
stuff.

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san... Can you please
stop saying meaningless things
like that?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん、意味のわからない冗談は
ほどほどにしていただけるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... Can you please
stop saying meaningless things
like that?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Oooh! Scary... Don't go into Blood
Skelter on me now...
fields.JP:
おーこわ。
こんなところで『覚醒』されちゃかなわないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! Scary... Don't go into Blood
Skelter on me now...

fields.EN:
Rapu, come over here. Let Big
Sister get you some super sweet
treats for you.
fields.JP:
ラプ、こっちおいで。
お姉さんがとびっきり甘いお菓子をあげよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, come over here. Let Big
Sister get you some super sweet
treats for you.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Well, see you two around. Thanks
for keeping watch over her.
fields.JP:
じゃあね、おふたりさん。
子守り、ご苦労様～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, see you two around. Thanks
for keeping watch over her.

fields.EN:
Whew... She was more obnoxious
than I expected.
fields.JP:
ふう。
ほんとに騒々しいったらありゃしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... She was more obnoxious
than I expected.

fields.EN:
I just thought that you looked
like you were having fun, despite
what you just said.
fields.JP:
いや、迷惑っぽく言うわりには、
けっこう楽しそうに見えたなあと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just thought that you looked
like you were having fun, despite
what you just said.

fields.EN:
W-Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt
to have experiences like that
sometimes.
fields.JP:
ま、まあ……
たまには、こういうのも悪くはないかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt
to have experiences like that
sometimes.

fields.EN:
But, only sometimes. If I had to
go through that all the time, I'm
not sure I could make it.
fields.JP:
……たまには、よ。
いつもこれじゃ先が思いやられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, only sometimes. If I had to
go through that all the time, I'm
not sure I could make it.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Of course I know you'd
never be the type to look after
others, so no need to tell me.
fields.JP:
あはは。
念を押さなくてもわかってるって。
アリスが実は世話好きなこととか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Of course I know you'd
never be the type to look after
others, so no need to tell me.

fields.JP: か……からかうのはやめて頂戴

fields.EN:
(I suppose something like this is
good sometimes.)
fields.JP: （ほんとに、こういうのも悪くないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose something like this is
good sometimes.)

fields.EN:
(Now that I've had a good look
around, her room seems a lot
cleaner than before.)
fields.JP:
（ふふっ。
　それにしてもここに来た頃に比べると
　随分部屋も綺麗になったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I've had a good look
around, her room seems a lot
cleaner than before.)

fields.EN:
(Back then the room looked pretty
drab, and she had her clothes all
over the place.)
fields.JP:
（あの頃はほんと殺風景な部屋で、
　服もそこらに放りっぱなしだったし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Back then the room looked pretty
drab, and she had her clothes all
over the place.)

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, what is this
soapy smell...?)
fields.JP:
（そう言えば、
　さっきからしてるこの香りは石けん！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, what is this
soapy smell...?)

fields.EN:
Jack! Are you all right?! You're
bleeding!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　大丈夫！？
血が出てるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Are you all right?! You're
bleeding!

fields.JP: だ、大丈夫だよ、これくらいなら……

ア……アリス！！
な、なにをして……

fields.EN:
What do you mean what? I'm licking
your wound.
fields.JP: なにって、傷口を舐めてあげ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean what? I'm licking
your wound.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... It's just an old
habit...
fields.JP: ご、ごめんなさい。つい昔の癖で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... It's just an old
habit...

fields.EN:
No! I'm the one who should
apologize! I'm sorry for coming in
without letting you know first!
fields.JP:
いや！
謝らなきゃならないのはこっちだよ！
返事もないのに勝手に入ってごめん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I'm the one who should
apologize! I'm sorry for coming in
without letting you know first!

fields.EN:
I mean, sure, we used to share the
same cell for a long time, but now
we're in separate rooms!
fields.JP:
そりゃ、小さい時から同じ監獄に放り込まれて
たけど、部屋も今は別々なんだし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, sure, we used to share the
same cell for a long time, but now
we're in separate rooms!

fields.EN:
It was insensitive of me to
forget, and saying I lack common
sense is an understatement...!
fields.JP:
だいたい僕は鈍感っていうか、
デリカシーに欠けると言うか、
気遣いができなくて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was insensitive of me to
forget, and saying I lack common
sense is an understatement...!

fields.EN:
Like, I need to be respectful of
everyone! Wow, if only I could've
told myself earlier! Um, sorry!
fields.JP:
親しき仲にも礼儀ありって言うよね！
まったく、さっきの僕に言ってやりたいよ！！
ほんとごめん……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, I need to be respectful of
everyone! Wow, if only I could've
told myself earlier! Um, sorry!

fields.EN:
Y-You don't need to make so many
excuses...
fields.JP: ……そんなに謝られるとわたしも困るわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't need to make so many
excuses...

fields.EN:
It's my fault, too. I shouldn't be
walking around with just a towel
over me, even it is my room.
fields.JP:
い……いくら自分の部屋だからって、
お風呂からあがってタオル一枚で
ふらつくものじゃないもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's my fault, too. I shouldn't be
walking around with just a towel
over me, even it is my room.

fields.EN:
Um... I'm sorry if I made this all
feel awkward...
fields.JP: その……気まずい思いをさせてごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I'm sorry if I made this all
feel awkward...

fields.EN:
(Huh?! I'm pretty sure it's all my
fault for coming in like this...)
fields.JP:
（ええ！？
　悪いのは全面的に僕のほうだと
　思うんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh?! I'm pretty sure it's all my
fault for coming in like this...)

fields.JP: いや、アリスが謝るようなことはないよ！

fields.EN: But, I did make you feel bad...
fields.JP:
でも……
あなたに不快な思いをさせてしまったのだし……
fields.LOCALIZED: But, I did make you feel bad...

fields.EN:
(Well, not really... Wait... What
am I thinking?!)
fields.JP:
（不快ってことは全然ないんだけどな……
　って、何考えてるんだ僕は！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, not really... Wait... What
am I thinking?!)

fields.EN:
I don't want you to stop coming
because of this...
fields.JP:
こんなことであなたが、その、
あまり来てくれなくなるのは嫌だなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want you to stop coming
because of this...

fields.JP: 大丈夫、そんなことはないから！

fields.EN:
Yes! I'll be sure to knock until
you actually answer, though.
Okay?
fields.JP:
うん。今度からはちゃんとノックの返事を
確認してから入るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! I'll be sure to knock until
you actually answer, though.
Okay?

fields.EN:
Um, so... Do you mind putting your
clothes on? My neck is starting to
hurt...
fields.JP:
だからその……服、着てくれないかな？
あっち向いてるからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so... Do you mind putting your
clothes on? My neck is starting to
hurt...

fields.EN:
...So, I'm telling you that you
lack common sense and logic.
fields.JP:
だから、あなたには常識や倫理観と言うものが
欠けていると言っているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So, I'm telling you that you
lack common sense and logic.

fields.EN:
There's no value in needlessly
criticizing others.
fields.JP:
無闇に他人を批判したって、得るものなんか
無いでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no value in needlessly
criticizing others.

fields.JP: （アリスと…グレーテルが言い争ってる？）

fields.EN:
I can obtain valuable data through
the reactions from the criticism.
Very fundamental to my analyses.
fields.JP:
批判し、その反応を見ることで、
判断するのに必要なデータが得られるわ。
観察と分析は初歩の初歩よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can obtain valuable data through
the reactions from the criticism.
Very fundamental to my analyses.

fields.EN:
Even so, you need to read the air
around you, too.
fields.JP:
それにしても、
その場の雰囲気とか流れとかあるでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, you need to read the air
around you, too.

fields.EN: Oh? It's a fundamental rule to eliminate extraneous factors. Forget that, and you'll make a fatal mistake.
fields.JP:
あら？　夾雑物は排除するのが鉄則よ。
それを忘れると、致命的な間違いを犯すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Allowing unsubstantial variables
to interfere often leads to
negative consequences.

fields.EN:
So tell me, what kind of
consequences occur when you
read the air around you?
fields.JP:
少しくらい空気を読んだところで、
どんな致命的なことが起きるって言うのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So tell me, what kind of
consequences occur when you
read the air around you?

fields.EN:
Oh, my... I know of humans who
entered my home and died from
"reading the air."
fields.JP:
ふふ。起きるわよ？
かつて私の家に侵入してきた人間たちは、
あなたの言う空気を読んで死んでいったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... I know of humans who
entered my home and died from
"reading the air."

fields.EN:
I have no intention of dying like
them.
fields.JP: 私はまだ死ぬつもりはないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of dying like
them.

fields.EN:
That leads to me taking action as
needed. I see no problem in taking
steps to ensure my survival.
fields.JP:
だから私は観察し、判断し、行動する。
生きるために最善を選ぶのに何の躊躇があって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That leads to me taking action as
needed. I see no problem in taking
steps to ensure my survival.

fields.EN:
So are you saying that, if you
don't have the funds, you'll take
things for your own survival?
fields.JP:
じゃああなたは、もしお金がなければ、
生きるためなら欲しいモノを勝手に奪い取って
いいと思っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So are you saying that, if you
don't have the funds, you'll take
things for your own survival?

fields.EN:
But, it's a common rule to
purchase things with money!
fields.JP:
欲しいモノがあったらお金で買うのがルール
じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it's a common rule to
purchase things with money!

fields.EN:
Onee-chan-tachi, it's okay now. She didn't
really dine and dash or anything...
fields.JP:
お姉ちゃんたち、もういいよ～。
ホントに食い逃げされたワケじゃないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, it's okay... She really didn't
try to leave without paying the
bill or anything...
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
(All that talk over not paying a
bill?! Well, I guess it is a
problem, but...)
fields.JP:
（深刻な話だと思ったら、食い逃げ未遂！？
　いやまあ……深刻っちゃ深刻だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All that talk over not paying a
bill?! Well, I guess it is a
problem, but...)

fields.EN:
Um, you're both scaring my
customers away, standing there
like that...
fields.JP:
そこで立ってられると、
お客さんが怖がって寄ってくれないからさ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you're both scaring my
customers away, standing there
like that...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh, you're pretty hard-
headed, aren't you?
fields.JP: ふふふ、大した堅物なのね、あなた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh, you're pretty hard-
headed, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Wouldn't you say we're breaking
the Jail's rules? Should we abide
by its expectations?
fields.JP:
ジェイル全体からすれば、私たちが脱獄しようと
していることもルール違反ではないのかしら？
あなたはそのルールにも従うべきだと思うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't you say we're breaking
the Jail's rules? Should we abide
by its expectations?

fields.EN:
You're mixing up two separate
topics here.
fields.JP: それとこれと一緒にするほうがどうかしてるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're mixing up two separate
topics here.

fields.EN: On what are you basing that claim?
fields.JP:
一緒にしてはいけないとすれば、
その根拠はどこにあるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: On what are you basing that claim?

fields.JP: あきれてものが言えない……

fields.EN:
(Despite the way Alice is looking
right now, it almost seems as if
she's enjoying this...)
fields.JP:
（アリスってば頭抱えてるけど、
　そんなに嫌っているわけでもなさそうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite the way Alice is looking
right now, it almost seems as if
she's enjoying this...)

fields.EN:
(Gretel looks like she's enjoying
this interaction, too...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルのほうはじゃれてるようにも
　見えるし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel looks like she's enjoying
this interaction, too...)

fields.EN:
Oh, Jack. What are you doing
there? Come and join our
conversation.
fields.JP:
あら、ジャック。
そんなとこにいないで、こっちに来なさいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Jack. What are you doing
there? Come and join our
conversation.

fields.EN:
Jack?! How long have you been
here?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack?! How long have you been
here?!

fields.EN:
You heard what we were talking
about, right? You know who's right
here, don't you?
fields.JP:
話、聞こえてたでしょう？
ジャックなら、どちらが正しいことを
言ってるか、わかるわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard what we were talking
about, right? You know who's right
here, don't you?

fields.EN:
Gretel keeps coming up with excuse
after excuse...
fields.JP:
グレーテルったら、次から次へと
屁理屈ばかりで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel keeps coming up with excuse
after excuse...

fields.EN:
Um, well... It just looked like
you two were getting along, so...
fields.JP:
え、いや、その…
ぼ、僕から見ると、二人は割と
仲いいのかなあって…
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... It just looked like
you two were getting along, so...

fields.EN: You've got to be kidding me!
fields.LOCALIZED: You've got to be kidding me!

fields.EN:
Jack's analysis of the situation
is apt. I do get along well with
everyone, you know?
fields.JP:
ジャックは正しく物事を観察しているようね。
私は誰とも仲がいいわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's analysis of the situation
is apt. I do get along well with
everyone, you know?

fields.EN:
And where exactly do you get the
confidence to say that?!
fields.JP: あなたもどこからその自信が出てくるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And where exactly do you get the
confidence to say that?!

fields.EN: Nee-chan-tachi, give me a break already...
fields.JP: 姉ちゃんたち、勘弁してくれよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, girls... Can you stop it
already...?
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Um... Maybe you should both go
someplace else.
fields.JP:
あ、あの……
どこかに移ったほうがいいんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Maybe you should both go
someplace else.

fields.EN:
Oh, and... I have something to do,
so...
fields.JP: あと……ぼ、僕、帰っていいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and... I have something to do,
so...

fields.EN:
(I guess they do go well
together...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、なんだかんだで気が合うんだよ、
　この二人って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess they do go well
together...)

fields.EN:
Um, okay, but let's move someplace
else.
fields.JP: と、とにかくどこかに移ろうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, okay, but let's move someplace
else.

fields.EN: Um, uh... I'm coming in, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
あ……ええと……
赤ずきんさん、お邪魔します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh... I'm coming in, Red
Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Hey, you sound pretty tense. Come
right in!
fields.JP:
おー、何かしこまってんのさ。
入って入って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you sound pretty tense. Come
right in!

fields.JP:
（す、すごい…。
　色々なトレーニンググッズが……。）
で。ジャック。体の調子はどうなの？

fields.EN:
I think so... I'm sorry if I
caused you any trouble...
fields.JP:
もう大丈夫、かな……
何だかかえって心配かけちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think so... I'm sorry if I
caused you any trouble...

fields.EN:
Seriously... That's quite a thing
Haru-san made for you.
fields.JP:
全く……無茶苦茶なもん作るよね、
ハルさんは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously... That's quite a thing
Haru made for you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Well, I asked him to
make a weapon for me, and he ended
up making me the Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
あ、ううん。メアリガンは……武器は、
僕からお願いして、作ってもらったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Well, I asked him to
make a weapon for me, and he ended
up making me the Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
Why don't you have a seat? You
need to take things a bit easier.
fields.JP:
……まあ、座りなよ。
病み上がりなんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you have a seat? You
need to take things a bit easier.

fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんのベッド、
　赤ずきんさんの匂いがする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood's bed smells just
like her...)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 赤ずきん => Red Riding Hood-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I gotta hand it to you for using
that thing without a second
thought.
fields.JP:
あんなものをためらいもせず身につけるなんて、
あんた、本当にすごいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gotta hand it to you for using
that thing without a second
thought.

fields.EN:
Once a Blood Maiden enters Blood
Skelter, they can never return.
There's no way to stop it...
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化した血式少女は、
二度と人には戻らなかった……
……自分じゃ止められないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once a Blood Maiden enters Blood
Skelter, they can never return.
There's no way to stop it...

fields.EN:
That's why we fought with the fear
