(She may be rough at times, but
she's really kind to her
sisters...)
fields.JP:
（ふふ……いつもは厳しいけど、
　二人の前では優しいお姉さんなんだな。
　……そりゃそうだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She may be rough at times, but
she's really kind to her
sisters...)

fields.EN:
Oh, but what should we do if they
don't turn out well? We can't give
them to someone else...
fields.JP:
あ、でも……もし失敗しちゃったら、
その分はどうしましょう？
皆にあげるわけにもいかないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but what should we do if they
don't turn out well? We can't give
them to someone else...

fields.EN:
No problem! We'll just give them
to Jack! He's a guy, so I'm sure
he'll eat anything!
fields.JP:
それなら大丈夫よ！
ジャックのやつに食べさせればいいじゃない。
一応男なんだし、きっとよく食べるでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem! We'll just give them
to Jack! He's a guy, so I'm sure
he'll eat anything!

fields.EN: That also sounds like a plan!
fields.LOCALIZED: That also sounds like a plan!

fields.EN:
(I'll just assume I didn't hear
anything. She'll get mad if she
finds out I overheard...)
fields.JP:
（い、今のは聞かなかったことにしとこう……
　聞かれてたって知ったら、絶対怒る……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll just assume I didn't hear
anything. She'll get mad if she
finds out I overheard...)

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, I'm fine! I can do it
myself.
fields.JP:
もう……白雪！　
ほんとに大丈夫だって！
わたし一人でも、出来るから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, I'm fine! I can do it
myself.

fields.EN:
No, Oyayubi-neesama! This is your
first time wearing one, so Shirayuki will help!
fields.JP:
ダメですよ、親指姉様！
何せ、初めてなんですから……
ちゃんと白雪がお手伝いします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, dear sister! This is your
first time wearing one, so Snow
White will help!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
What's the big deal...? It's just
a bra... And you know, I'm the
older one here...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな、大げさな……
たかがブラジャーなのに……
っていうか、わたしの方が姉なんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the big deal...? It's just
a bra... And you know, I'm the
older one here...

fields.EN:
Big deal?! It is a big deal! Let's
measure you first!
fields.JP:
たかがじゃありません！
女の子にとっては、大切なことです！
というわけで、まずはサイズを測りましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Big deal?! It is a big deal! Let's
measure you first!

fields.EN:
Huh? What the...?! Just let me
share whatever you're wearing!
fields.JP:
え？　な、なんでそうなるのよ！？
ブラなんて、白雪のと同じのでいいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What the...?! Just let me
share whatever you're wearing!

fields.EN:
I hate to say this, but... I think
my bras are... a bit too big for
you.
fields.JP:
親指姉様……とっても言いにくいんですけど、
白雪のでは、サイズがきっと合いません。
主に余ってしまう的な意味で、です
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hate to say this, but... I think
my bras are... a bit too big for
you.

fields.EN:
D-Don't say it so bluntly! And that's not true!
Here, let me borrow your bra!
fields.JP:
なっ……はっきり言うんじゃないわよ！
それに、そんなことないわよ！
ちょっとあんたのブラ、貸してみなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Hey! That's not true! Hand
it over!
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: ええっ！？　親指姉様、それは……
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP:
……ひゃんっ！？
そんな強引に……ダメですっ……！

ああっ……姉様、そんなっ……
だめですぅっ……！

はあ、はあ……
よし！　取れた！

fields.EN: I can't believe you took it off...
fields.JP:
姉様……
人のブラを無理矢理脱がすなんて、
ひどいです……
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't believe you took it off...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! I'm sorry. But just you
watch! It's going to fit me...
perfectly...
fields.JP:
あはは、ごめんごめん！
まあ見てなさいって！
きっとピッタリだか……ら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! I'm sorry. But just you
watch! It's going to fit me...
perfectly...

fields.EN:
Oh, my... See? It's way too big
for you.
fields.JP:
あらあら……
ほらぁ。ブッカブカじゃないですか。
だから言ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... See? It's way too big
for you.

fields.EN:
It... It can't be... I'm supposed
be the older one... This can't be
happening...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな……
わたしの方が姉なのに……
こんな理不尽なことって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It... It can't be... I'm supposed
be the older one... This can't be
happening...

fields.EN:
It's fine, Oyayubi-neesama! You just
need to find one that fits you! I
mean, your shape is just right!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫ですよ、親指姉様！
ちゃんとサイズがピッタリなのを着ければ！
白雪なんかより、形いいんですから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, dear sister! You just
need to find one that fits you! I
mean, your shape is just right!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP:
う、ううう……
ほ、本当に……？

fields.EN:
Yes! But, the right size is
important. Let me take your
measurements, okay?
fields.JP:
も、もちろんです！
ね？　サイズって大事でしょう？
だから……まずは測りましょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! But, the right size is
important. Let me take your
measurements, okay?

fields.EN:
I-I guess you're right! I'm
counting on you, Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
そ、そうね……！
白雪、頼んだわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess you're right! I'm
counting on you, Snow White!

fields.EN:
Yes! Now then, stay still... Let
me get this around you...
fields.JP:
はい！じゃあじっとしててくださいね……
今測りますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! Now then, stay still... Let
me get this around you...

fields.JP:
う、うん……ひゃんっ！？
ちょ、ちょっと白雪、くすぐったいって！

fields.EN:
Just a little more... I'll be done
soon, so please bear with me.
fields.JP:
はいはい……すぐ終わりますから、
ちょっとガマンしててくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a little more... I'll be done
soon, so please bear with me.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for being late,
Oyayubihime! I bought what you...
asked... for...?
fields.JP:
ごめん、親指姫。遅くなっちゃって！
言われたもの、買ってきた……よ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for being late,
Thumbelina! I bought what you...
asked... for...?

fields.EN:
Aaaaaaaaaaah! I-I'm so sorry! I-I
didn't know you were...!
fields.JP:
…………うわーーーーっ！！！
ごごご……ごめん！！？？
そそ、そんなつもりじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaaaaaaaaah! I-I'm so sorry! I-I
didn't know you were...!

fields.EN:
D-Oyayubi-neesama! P-Please! Your
clothes! Jack-san! Look away, now!
fields.JP:
お、親指姉様。
とりあえず服を……！！
ジャックさんは向こうを向いてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Dear sister! P-Please! Your
clothes! Jack! Look away, now!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
And... How much longer are you
going to be standing there like
that?
fields.JP:
……で？
いつまでそこで突っ立ってんのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... How much longer are you
going to be standing there like
that?

fields.EN:
Huh? Um, well... Oh, I know! Let
me leave what you asked for over
here...
fields.JP:
え？　いやその、えっと……
あ、そうだ……！
た、頼まれたもの、ここに置いておくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Um, well... Oh, I know! Let
me leave what you asked for over
here...

fields.JP: いいから早く出てけーーーーっ！！！！！

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Oyayubi-neesama?
Are you okay?
fields.JP:
親指姉様、どうしたんですか？
大丈夫ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, dear sister?
Are you okay?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, it's nothing. I just
can't seem to get used to that
tight feeling around my chest ...
fields.JP:
え？　う、ううん、何でもないわ。
肩の、その……紐が、
まだちょっと慣れなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, it's nothing. I just
can't seem to get used to that
tight feeling around my chest ...

fields.EN: Ah... that. You'll get used to it after a while. It does hurt a little at first, though...
fields.JP:
あ……例のアレ、ですね。
しばらくすればきっと慣れますよ。
最初はちょっと痛いですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're talking about that...
It just takes a while to get used
to.

fields.JP: そ、そういうもんなのかしら……

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Oyayubihime?
Are you hurt?
fields.JP:
……親指姫、どうしたの？
もしかして、ケガでもしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Thumbelina?
Are you hurt?

fields.JP:
あ、アリス……ううん！　
な、なんでもないわ！

fields.EN:
Really? I overheard something
about your chest feeling tight...
fields.JP:
そう……？
でも、肩の辺りが痛いって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I overheard something
about your chest feeling tight...

fields.EN:
It's really nothing! S-See?
Everything's fine!
fields.JP:
ぜ、全然！
ほらこの通り、なんともないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's really nothing! S-See?
Everything's fine!

fields.JP: アリスさん、アリスさん……
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): アリス => Alice-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
Um, well... Oyayubi-neesama just started
wearing a bra recently...
fields.JP:
その、実はですね……
親指姉様は最近、
ブラジャーを着けるようになったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... My sister just started
wearing a bra recently...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP:
ブラジャー、ですって……？
親指姫が……！？

fields.EN:
Yes, and... it seems like she's
not used to the band yet...
fields.JP:
はい。それでまだ、
肩紐が慣れないらしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and... it seems like she's
not used to the band yet...

fields.EN:
I-I don't believe it... I'm not
wearing one, and she's already...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこと……
わたしだって、まだ着けてないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I don't believe it... I'm not
wearing one, and she's already...

fields.EN:
Can I ask you something,
Oyayubihime?
fields.JP: ……親指姫、ちょっといいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can I ask you something,
Thumbelina?

fields.EN:
Huh? Wh-What is it? You look so
serious...
fields.JP:
え？　ど、どうしたのよ？
急に真剣な顔して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Wh-What is it? You look so
serious...

fields.EN:
I heard you... started wearing
bras...
fields.JP:
あなた……
ブラジャーを着け始めたんですって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard you... started wearing
bras...

fields.EN:
Um... Alice-san? That's a bit too
straightforward, isn't it?
fields.JP:
あのーアリスさん……
いきなりそれはちょっと直すぎるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Alice? That's a bit too
straightforward, isn't it?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Wha-?! What's it to you?! I can
wear whatever I want, you know?!
fields.JP:
なっ……そ、それがどうしたってのよ！？
わたしの勝手でしょ、そんなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! What's it to you?! I can
wear whatever I want, you know?!

fields.EN:
Why yes, but... Do you mind
if I... confirm?
fields.JP:
ええ、もちろんそうだけれど……
少し……確認させてもらえるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, but... Do you mind
if I... confirm?

fields.EN:
Don't worry. It'll be quick. I
just need to feel it a bit...
fields.JP:
大丈夫、すぐ終わるわ。
ちょっと触らせてくれるだけでいいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. It'll be quick. I
just need to feel it a bit...

fields.EN:
Wh-What in the world are you
saying?! W-What's with those
hands of yours?! Stop it!
fields.JP:
な、なんでそうなるのよ！？
……って、その手つきは何！？
思いっきり触る気満々なんですけど！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What in the world are you
saying?! W-What's with those
hands of yours?! Stop it!

fields.EN:
How did hers get so big? Maybe
it's my nutritional intake...
fields.JP:
どうして大きくなるのかしら……
やっぱり、これまでの栄養状態とか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did hers get so big? Maybe
it's my nutritional intake...

fields.EN:
I'm growing too, but... That's
right... I don't need to worry...
I just need to confirm...
fields.JP:
わたしだって、成長してるはずなのに……
……そうよ、焦ることはないわ。
まず、状況の確認を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm growing too, but... That's
right... I don't need to worry...
I just need to confirm...

fields.EN:
Eek! Now you're freaking me out!
H-Hey wait! T-Touching me isn't
going to do any good!
fields.JP:
ひっ……なんか怖い！？
ちょ、ちょっと待って……！？
さ、触ったって、何もわかんないわよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eek! Now you're freaking me out!
H-Hey wait! T-Touching me isn't
going to do any good!

fields.JP: いいえ……きっと無駄ではないわ……

ア、アリスさん、落ち着いてください！
アリスさんってば！！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
(Well, there goes me going into
the cafeteria. If I heard right, I
wouldn't dare step inside now...)
fields.JP:
（食堂が騒がしいと思って来たはいいけど……
　結局会話の内容がきわどすぎて、
　一歩も入れなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, there goes me going into
the cafeteria. If I heard right, I
wouldn't dare step inside now...)

fields.EN:
(That was a close call... Who
knows what would've happened if
I got here earlier...)
fields.JP:
（もう少し早くここに来てたら……
　確実に巻き込まれてたな。
　あぶないあぶない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was a close call... Who
knows what would've happened if
I got here earlier...)

fields.EN:
Whew... Finally... Got away...
What was that about?
fields.JP:
ふう……やっと逃げ切れたわ。
まったく、何なのよ一体……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Finally... Got away...
What was that about?

fields.EN:
Um... Jack? What are you doing
here?
fields.JP: ……ってジャックあんた、何やってんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Jack? What are you doing
here?

fields.EN:
Whoa! Th-Oyayubihime?! Oh, um...
I wasn't doing anything, really.
fields.JP:
わっ！？
お、親指姫……！！
い、いや別に、何も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Th-Thumbelina?! Oh, um...
I wasn't doing anything, really.

fields.JP: ……さっきの話……聞いてなかったでしょうね？

fields.EN:
Um, uh... I don't know what you're
talking about. I was... just
passing by!
fields.JP:
な、何の事、かな……
僕、たまたま今通りかかっただけだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh... I don't know what you're
talking about. I was... just
passing by!

fields.EN: ...I see. If you heard anything, forget every last bit of it. Otherwise... you'll die.
fields.JP:
……そう。……もし聞いてたのなら、
全てキレイさっぱり忘れる事ね。
でないと……死ぬ事になるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... If you heard anything,
forget it. All of it... Or else,
you may lose your life...

fields.EN: Lighten up. It's just... a joke.
fields.LOCALIZED: Lighten up. It's just... a joke.

fields.EN:
(S-She sure doesn't look like
she was joking!)
fields.JP: （……め、目が笑ってないんですけど！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-She sure doesn't look like
she was joking!)

fields.EN:
(So tired... Being anemic is such
a pain...)
fields.JP:
（まだ、身体がだるいや……
　貧血って、けっこうきついんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So tired... Being anemic is such
a pain...)

fields.EN: Um... Jack-san, are you in here?
fields.JP:
あの……
ジャックさん、いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Jack, are you in here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
あ、君は……
白雪姫……一体どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Snow White? What's the
matter?

fields.EN:
You used a lot of blood, so I came
to visit to make sure you were
okay.
fields.JP:
ちょっと心配になって……
お見舞いに来たんです。
たくさん血を使ってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You used a lot of blood, so I came
to visit to make sure you were
okay.

fields.EN:
You came to see me because of
that?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You came to see me because of
that?

fields.EN: Yes. I hope I'm not bothering you.
fields.JP:
はい。
もしかして今、お邪魔でしたか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I hope I'm not bothering you.

fields.JP:
い、いや、そんな事はないよ！
ありがとう……！

fields.EN:
(It's nice to know someone's
worried about me...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's nice to know someone's
worried about me...)

fields.EN:
Oh, where are my manners... Let me
get you some tea.
fields.JP:
あ……ごめんね、気が利かなくて。
今お茶を出すから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, where are my manners... Let me
get you some tea.

fields.EN: P-Please stay still, Jack-san! Shirayuki will get the tea ready!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさんはじっとしててください！
白雪がやります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please stay still, Jack! Snow
White will get the tea ready!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Are you sure? Thanks... You're so
kind.
fields.JP:
そ、そう……？
ありがとう。優しいんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? Thanks... You're so
kind.

fields.EN:
It's nothing. It's all part of
coming to visit and making sure
you're okay!
fields.JP:
いえ！
そのためのお見舞いですから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing. It's all part of
coming to visit and making sure
you're okay!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... Are you really
okay? Maybe I can get more ice for
you...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさい……
だ、大丈夫ですか……？
もう少し、冷やしたほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... Are you really
okay? Maybe I can get more ice for
you...

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine. It's just a burn.
Compared to what we go through in
battle, this is nothing.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫……軽いヤケドだから。
いま薬も塗ってもらったし、
この前の戦いに比べたら、全然平気だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine. It's just a burn.
Compared to what we go through in
battle, this is nothing.

fields.EN:
*sob* I did it again... Shirayuki
is so useless...
fields.JP:
うう……またやってしまいました……
白雪は本当に役立たずです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob* I did it again... Snow White
is so useless...

fields.JP:
（また、って……
　もしかしてこの子って
　けっこうドジなんじゃ……）

fields.EN:
D-Don't worry about it! Let's just
enjoy some tea together. I'll go
and make some more for us.
fields.JP:
き、気にしないで！
ほ、ほら……お茶飲もう？
いま淹れ直すからさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't worry about it! Let's just
enjoy some tea together. I'll go
and make some more for us.

fields.EN:
Th-Thank you very much! You really
are kind, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとうございます……！
ジャックさんは優しい方なんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thank you very much! You really
are kind, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Do you think so? But you're really
kind, too.
fields.JP:
そ、そうかな……？
白雪姫だって優しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think so? But you're really
kind, too.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is a plain girl...
Oyayubi-neesama, Nemu-chan, Aka-neesama are all unique, unlike me...
fields.JP:
白雪は……地味なだけです。
親指姉様も、ネムちゃんも、赤姉様も
みんな個性的ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is a plain girl...
Sister Thumbelina, Sleepy, Sister
Red are all unique, unlike me...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(I suppose... But... she's making
it sound like they're just
oddballs...)
fields.JP:
（た、確かにそれはそうかも……
　っていうか、キャラが濃いってだけじゃ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose... But... she's making
it sound like they're just
oddballs...)

fields.EN:
Um, but I'm not very unique
compared to them, either.
fields.JP:
でも……僕だってあの中にいたら、
そんなに個性的な方じゃないと思うよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but I'm not very unique
compared to them, either.

fields.EN:
Well, their personalities are very
distinct, in a good way. Compared
to them, I'm just...
fields.JP:
うん、みんな良い意味で、
すごく強烈だからね。
それに比べたら、僕なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, their personalities are very
distinct, in a good way. Compared
to them, I'm just...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Let us "plain" people do our best!
fields.JP:
私達……
お互い『地味』同士がんばりましょうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let us "plain" people do our best!

fields.EN:
I'm so happy I have someone like
me now. I hope we can get along
even better!
fields.JP:
うふふ……
なんだか仲間ができたみたいで嬉しいです。
これからもよろしくお願いしますね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so happy I have someone like
me now. I hope we can get along
even better!

fields.JP:
う、うん……
これからもよろしく……！

fields.EN:
(What kind of group am I a part of
now...?)
fields.JP: （なんだか変な仲間に入れられたような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What kind of group am I a part of
now...?)

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Shirayuki?
Oh, that... It's okay. Just kick
it like... so.
fields.JP:
どうしたの、白雪？
ああ……アレが落ちてたのね。
大丈夫よ。ほら、こうして蹴飛ばしちゃえば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Snow White?
Oh, that... It's okay. Just kick
it like... so.

fields.JP: ね、もう無くなっちゃったでしょ？

fields.EN:
Oh, Jack-san... I'm sorry! You don't
have to worry about me!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……
ごめんなさい、気になさらないでください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Jack... I'm sorry! You don't
have to worry about me!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
そう……？
今の、確か……鏡だったような……？

fields.EN:
W-Well, Shirayuki has been scared
of mirrors for a long time...
fields.JP:
じ、実は……
白雪は、昔から……鏡が怖いんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, Snow White has been scared
of mirrors for a long time...

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm not sure why, but
looking at mirrors makes me
feel anxious...
fields.JP:
はい……理由はわからないんですけど、
なんだか鏡を見ると不安になってきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm not sure why, but
looking at mirrors makes me
feel anxious...

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's like that strange urge
I have...)
fields.JP:
（……僕の、あのわけのわからない気持ちと
　なんだか似てる、のかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's like that strange urge
I have...)

fields.EN:
Oh, but it's fine! My sisters are
with me. Now then, let's go!
fields.JP:
あ、でも……本当に大丈夫ですから！
姉様たちもいますし……
今は先を急ぎましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but it's fine! My sisters are
with me. Now then, let's go!

fields.EN:
I'll be sure to remember that
you're not good with mirrors. I
can help, too.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、僕も覚えておくよ。
君が鏡が苦手だってこと……
僕も気をつけてれば、もっと心配ないと思うしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be sure to remember that
you're not good with mirrors. I
can help, too.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much, Jack-san. I'm
happy to hear you say that.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……ありがとうございます。
そう言ってもらえるだけで嬉しいです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much, Jack. I'm
happy to hear you say that.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's not a big deal.
Um, but doesn't that make it hard
to get ready in the morning?
fields.JP:
あはは、大げさだよ……
でも、鏡が見れないと、大変じゃない？
その、身だしなみとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's not a big deal.
Um, but doesn't that make it hard
to get ready in the morning?

fields.EN:
Yes, but that's all right. My
sisters stay close to me and make
sure I look fine.
fields.JP:
はい……でも、それは大丈夫なんです。
姉様たちが、いつもそばにいて
チェックしてくれますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but that's all right. My
sisters stay close to me and make
sure I look fine.

fields.EN:
I appreciate everything my sisters
do for me... Now then, let's go!
fields.JP:
姉様たちにはいつも感謝しっぱなしです……！
さ、行きましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate everything my sisters
do for me... Now then, let's go!

fields.EN:
(They really do get along well
together...)
fields.JP: （この姉妹、ほんとに仲が良いんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They really do get along well
together...)

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime? What's she doing?
She doesn't look very good right
now...)
fields.JP:
（あ、白雪姫……どうしたんだろ？
　なんだか元気がなさそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White? What's she doing?
She doesn't look very good right
now...)

fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……
いえ、何でもないんです。
ただちょっと……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: You have something on your mind?
fields.LOCALIZED: You have something on your mind?

fields.EN:
Just sadness... every so often. My
sisters are so cute, yet Shirayuki is so drab and plain...
fields.JP:
……時々、ふと悲しくなるんです。
親指姉様もネムちゃんもとっても可愛いのに、
白雪だけ地味だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just sadness... every so often. My
sisters are so cute, yet Snow
White is so drab and plain...

fields.EN:
Th-That's not true! Sure, they're
cute, but you're just as cute!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこと……！
確かに二人も可愛いけど、白雪姫だって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not true! Sure, they're
cute, but you're just as cute!

fields.EN:
It's all right, it's all right.
You don't need to console me. Shirayuki really is plain. She knows.
fields.JP:
いいんですいいんです。
無理にフォローして下さらなくても。
実際白雪は、地味ですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all right, it's all right.
You don't need to console me. Snow
White really is plain. She knows.

fields.EN:
(But I really was telling the
truth... How can I get through
to her? I know!)
fields.JP:
（フォローじゃないんだけどなあ……
　どう言えばいいんだろ……そうだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I really was telling the
truth... How can I get through
to her? I know!)

fields.EN:
You have such a cute and soft aura
to you! You really don't need to
be down on yourself.
fields.JP:
白雪姫だって、なんていうか……
ふんわりしててかわいいよ！
だからそんなに落ち込まなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have such a cute and soft aura
to you! You really don't need to
be down on yourself.

fields.EN:
Huh...? Soft? Do you mean that I'm
fat? Oh, of course... Yes, I
suppose so...
fields.JP:
えっ、それって……
太ってるってこと、ですか……？
やっぱり……そう、ですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? Soft? Do you mean that I'm
fat? Oh, of course... Yes, I
suppose so...

fields.EN:
It was bothering me... I'm not
only plain, but I'm also fatter
than my sisters...
fields.JP:
実は……ちょっと気にしてたんです。
白雪は姉様たちと比べて太ってるなって……
ただでさえ地味なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was bothering me... I'm not
only plain, but I'm also fatter
than my sisters...

fields.JP: （し、しまった……なんか誤解されてる？）

fields.EN: N-No! I meant soft as in, um...
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！
ふんわりってそういう意味じゃなくて、
なんていうか……えーと……
fields.LOCALIZED: N-No! I meant soft as in, um...

fields.EN:
Um... You know? Aura... The air
around you! You have a soft and
gentle aura, and...
fields.JP:
そ、その……そう、雰囲気！
雰囲気が優しいっていうか、
柔らかいっていうか、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You know? Aura... The air
around you! You have a soft and
gentle aura, and...

fields.EN:
Right! It's nice and calm being
next to you, and you're cute,
and... So, yeah!
fields.JP:
そう！　一緒にいて落ち着くというか、
可愛らしいというか……
と、とにかく、そういうことだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! It's nice and calm being
next to you, and you're cute,
and... So, yeah!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Regardless of the
reason, I'm just happy to hear
someone say that to me...
fields.JP:
ふふふ……なんだかんだで、
そんな風に言ってもらえると、
嬉しいなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Regardless of the
reason, I'm just happy to hear
someone say that to me...

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. I feel a bit
better now. You really are kind,
Jack-san.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます……
少し自信が出てきました。
……やっぱりジャックさんは優しい方ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. I feel a bit
better now. You really are kind,
Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I see... So being plain means
that I'm calm...
fields.JP:
そうなんですね……
地味って、落ち着くってことなんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So being plain means
that I'm calm...

fields.EN:
(I... don't think that's what I
was getting at. Is she what you'd
call a "natural?")
fields.JP:
（っていうか、そういう話じゃなかったような？
　やっぱりちょっと天然……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I... don't think that's what I
was getting at. Is she what you'd
call a "natural?")

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime...? What are you doing
here?
fields.JP:
あ、白雪姫……
ここにいたんだ。何やってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White...? What are you doing
here?

fields.EN:
Hello there, Jack-san... I wasn't...
doing anything.
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……こんにちは。
いえ、なんでもないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello there, Jack... I wasn't...
doing anything.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(Is she down on herself again? It
seems more severe this time...)
fields.JP:
（元気がない……また落ち込んでるのかな？
　でも、この前よりもなんだか深刻そうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she down on herself again? It
seems more severe this time...)

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You don't look
well.
fields.JP:
……どうしたの？
なんだか、元気がなさそうだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You don't look
well.

fields.EN:
You really are kind, Jack-san... I'm
fine. It's all Shirayuki's fault.
fields.JP:
……ジャックさんは、本当に優しいですね。
大丈夫です。白雪が悪いので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are kind, Jack... I'm
fine. It's all Snow White's fault.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Aka-neesama told me, given how
clumsy I am, I should worry about
myself before others.
fields.JP:
この間……赤姉様に言われたんです。
人の心配する前に自分の心配をしなって。
白雪が、いつもドジだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red told me, given how
clumsy I am, I should worry about
myself before others.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I see... I'm sure she said it
because she cares about you,
and...
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……
でもそれは、きっと君の事を心配して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I'm sure she said it
because she cares about you,
and...

fields.EN:
See? There. Everyone's worried
about me. Oyayubi-neesama,
Nemu-chan, everyone...
fields.JP:
そうなんです。そこなんです。
親指姉様や、ネムちゃんにも、
いつも心配ばかりかけてるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? There. Everyone's worried
about me. Dear Sister Thumbelina,
Sleepy, everyone...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Shirayuki wasn't confident
before, but now she knows she must
be the worst girl around...
fields.JP:
もともと自信はなかったけど、
きっと自分が思ってる以上に、
白雪はダメな子なんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White wasn't confident
before, but now she knows she must
be the worst girl around...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki's not good at
anything... Maybe it's better here
without her around...
fields.JP:
取り柄もないし……
白雪なんて、いない方がよかったのかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White's not good at
anything... Maybe it's better here
without her around...

fields.EN:
That's not true! Don't say things
like that.
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことないよ！
取り柄がないとか、
いない方がいいだなんて、そんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true! Don't say things
like that.

fields.EN:
Well then, what is Shirayuki good
at?
fields.JP: ……じゃあ、白雪の取り柄って、何ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, what is Snow White good
at?

fields.EN:
(She has a lot of good traits, but
it's a bit embarrassing to praise
her aloud...)
fields.JP:
（そんなの、もちろんたくさんあるけど……
　改めて言えって言われると、なんだか
　妙に照れるというか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has a lot of good traits, but
it's a bit embarrassing to praise
her aloud...)

fields.EN:
You don't have to force
yourself... I knew it. There's
nothing good about Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
……無理しなくても、いいですよ。
やっぱりそうなんですね……
白雪には何も良いところは無いんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to force
yourself... I knew it. There's
nothing good about Snow White...

fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！
そうじゃなくて、その……

fields.EN:
No, nothing... Could you please
leave me alone for a moment?
fields.JP:
……いいんです。
しばらく一人にしてください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, nothing... Could you please
leave me alone for a moment?

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime... Okay, I understand.
I'll see you later.
fields.JP:
白雪姫……
ごめん、わかったよ……
じゃあ、行くね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White... Okay, I understand.
I'll see you later.

fields.EN:
(I wasn't able to say a single
thing to her... I wasn't able to
cheer her up. I'm such an idiot.)
fields.JP:
（結局、何も言えずじまいだった……
　何でもっと気の利いた事が
　言えなかったんだろ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wasn't able to say a single
thing to her... I wasn't able to
cheer her up. I'm such an idiot.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if Shirayukihime is feeling
better now. Maybe I should leave
her alone, but...)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫、まだ落ち込んでるのかな……？
　そっとしといた方がいいのかもしれないけど、
　でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Snow White is feeling
better now. Maybe I should leave
her alone, but...)

fields.EN:
(No use thinking now. I'd better
go and apologize to her.)
fields.JP:
（……考えてもしょうがないか。
　まずはちゃんと謝らなくっちゃ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No use thinking now. I'd better
go and apologize to her.)

fields.EN:
Jack-san...? What brings you here? I
was just about to get ready to
step out.
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん。
……どうしたんですか？
今、ちょっと外出の準備中でして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...? What brings you here? I
was just about to get ready to
step out.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Uh, I'm sorry! Um... You're going
someplace?
fields.JP:
あ、ごめん……！
……どこかに出かけるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I'm sorry! Um... You're going
someplace?

fields.EN:
Yes... I was going to go to the
city on an errand for Oyayubi-neesama.
fields.JP:
ええ……親指姉様のお使いで、
街に行くところだったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I was going to go to the
city on an errand for Sister
Thumbelina.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP:
その……
何か、ご用ですか？

fields.EN:
(She feels so distant... I need to
fix this now!)
fields.JP:
（……なんだか、よそよそしい？
　なら、なおさらちゃんと話さなくちゃ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She feels so distant... I need to
fix this now!)

fields.EN:
Um... Do you mind if I come with
you?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、その……
僕も一緒に行っていいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Do you mind if I come with
you?

fields.EN:
Huh? But... You don't need to
force yourself. I'm not worth
it...
fields.JP:
え？　でも……
無理に付き合わなくていいですよ。
こんな自分に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But... You don't need to
force yourself. I'm not worth
it...

fields.EN:
(I knew it... She's still holding
onto that...)
fields.JP: （やっぱり、この間の事、気にしてるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I knew it... She's still holding
onto that...)

fields.EN:
Um, well... I, uh... I have to go
to the city, too! Is it okay if I
tag along?
fields.JP:
なんていうか、その……
そう！　僕も街に用事があるんだ。
ダメ……かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... I, uh... I have to go
to the city, too! Is it okay if I
tag along?

fields.EN:
W-Well, if that's the case, I
suppose it's fine...
fields.JP:
そ、そういう事なら、
別に構いませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if that's the case, I
suppose it's fine...

fields.JP: ……お使い、思ったより、早く終わったね

fields.EN:
Speaking of... What did you need
to do here, Jack-san?
fields.JP:
……そういえば、
ジャックさんの用事は、何だったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of... What did you need
to do here, Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
えっ？
あ、いや、それはその……
あ、白雪おねえちゃんだー！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 白雪おねえちゃん -> Shirayuki-onee-chan

fields.EN:
Why, hello there. Have you been a
good boy?
fields.JP:
……あら、こんにちは。
元気でしたか？
ちゃんと良い子にしてますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, hello there. Have you been a
good boy?

fields.EN:
Yup! I'm fine! But onee-chan,
you don't look too good...
fields.JP:
うん！　ボクはげんき！
でも、おねえちゃんは、
なんだかげんきなさそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I'm a good boy! But... you
don't look too good.
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN: *giggle*... That's not so. Shirayuki is always doing well. See?
fields.JP:
うふふ、そんな事はないですよ。
白雪はいつでも元気です。
ほら、この通り！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... That's not so. Snow
White is always doing well. See?

fields.EN: Okay! Heh, heh! That's good, then!
fields.JP:
そっかー！　えへへ！
よかったー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! Heh, heh! That's good, then!

fields.EN:
Oh, I know! A good boy deserves a
good treat!
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ……！
元気な子には、これをあげますね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I know! A good boy deserves a
good treat!

fields.EN:
Oooh! An apple! Yaaay! I love
apples! Thank you, onee-chan!
fields.JP:
あー！　リンゴーー！
やったー！　ボク、リンゴだいすき！
ありがとう、おねえちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! An apple! Yaaay! I love
apples! Thank you!
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Heh... My pleasure. I'll bring
more the next time I come around,
okay?
fields.JP:
うふふ……ならよかったです。
また街に来た時には、
リンゴを持ってきますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... My pleasure. I'll bring
more the next time I come around,
okay?

fields.EN:
(I can't believe she's so down on
herself with how kind and well-
liked she is...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりこの子、
　すごく優しい子じゃないか……
　取り柄がないなんて、そんな事ないのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe she's so down on
herself with how kind and well-
liked she is...)

fields.JP: じゃあまたね、おねえちゃん！
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
Yes, see you... Be a good boy,
okay?
fields.JP:
ええ、また……
良い子にしてるんですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, see you... Be a good boy,
okay?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm so sorry! I see that boy
quite often in the city, so I
just...
fields.JP:
あ、ごめんなさい……！
よく街で会う子だったから、つい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm so sorry! I see that boy
quite often in the city, so I
just...

fields.JP: この間は、その……本当にごめん！

fields.EN:
I was just... embarrassed last
time, and couldn't tell you about
your good qualities...
fields.JP:
白雪姫には良いところがたくさんあるのに、
うまく言えなくて……
その……照れちゃってたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just... embarrassed last
time, and couldn't tell you about
your good qualities...

fields.EN:
W-Well... But there's nothing good
about Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな……
白雪に良いところなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... But there's nothing good
about Snow White...

fields.EN:
You're a really kind person. I
knew that, and... I took it for
granted...
fields.JP:
君は……こんなに優しい子なのに。
それは知ってたはずなのに……
僕は……それに甘えてしまってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a really kind person. I
knew that, and... I took it for
granted...

fields.EN:
But... I'm not kind or anything...
Shirayuki is...
fields.JP:
そんなこと……
優しいなんて、何もすごくないですよ。
白雪なんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I'm not kind or anything...
Snow White is...

fields.EN:
That's not true! I think your
kindness is something to be proud
of!
fields.JP:
そんな事ないよ！
それは立派な取り柄だと思う……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true! I think your
kindness is something to be proud
of!

fields.EN:
But... Oyayubi-neesama and
Nemu-chan have better qualities than
I do...
fields.JP:
でも……
親指姉様やネムちゃんの方が、
良いところはたくさんありますし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Sister Thumbelina and
Sleepy have better qualities than
I do...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
They're not clumsy like me, and
they actually help others! Shirayuki is...
fields.JP:
そそっかしくないし、
みんなの役に立ってますし…！
それに比べたら、白雪なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're not clumsy like me, and
they actually help others! Snow
White is...

fields.EN:
I see... You're comparing yourself
with Oyayubihime and Nemurihime...
fields.JP:
そっか、君は……親指姫や眠り姫と、
自分を比べていたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... You're comparing yourself
with Thumbelina and Sleeping
Beauty...

fields.JP:
えっ？
な、なんでそんな事……

fields.EN:
You said you were jealous last
time, right?
fields.JP:
だって、この間……
『うらやましい』って言ってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said you were jealous last
time, right?

fields.EN:
Yeah... But, you've got it all
wrong. You don't need to compare
yourself to your sisters.
fields.JP:
……うん。でも、それは違うよ。
いくら姉妹だからって、
誰かと比べる必要なんてない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... But, you've got it all
wrong. You don't need to compare
yourself to your sisters.

fields.EN: Those two are certainly unique, but I don't think your thoughtfulness toward others is any less than theirs.
fields.JP:
あの二人は、確かに個性的だけど……
君の誰かを思いやる気持ちは、
二人に決して劣ってないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, they're unique, but I don't
think your thoughtfulness is any
less unique.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Your kindness is something special
that comes from you. Or, at least
that's what I think.
fields.JP:
白雪姫の優しさは、形には見えないけど、
誰にも真似できないよ。
少なくとも僕は……そう思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your kindness is something special
that comes from you. Or, at least
that's what I think.

fields.EN:
W-Well... Thank you very much. I
feel so much better now after
hearing that from you.
fields.JP:
そ、そんな事……ありがとうございます。
嬉しい……
なんだか、とても楽になりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... Thank you very much. I
feel so much better now after
hearing that from you.

fields.JP: そっか……それならよかった……

fields.EN:
Um... Shirayuki is sorry, too.
Sorry for how she treated you back
then...
fields.JP:
その……白雪こそ、ごめんなさい。
この間は、突っぱねてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Snow White is sorry, too.
Sorry for how she treated you back
then...

fields.EN:
And still, you thought about me
and said those things... You
really are kind, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
なのに、そんな風に言ってくれるなんて……
ジャックさんも、本当に優しいんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And still, you thought about me
and said those things... You
really are kind, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
*giggle*... And you respond just
like Shirayuki...
fields.JP:
うふふ、そのリアクション……
なんだか白雪そっくりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... And you respond just
like Snow White...

fields.EN:
I suppose I was thinking a bit too
much. Shirayuki is Shirayuki and
no other.
fields.JP:
そうですね……ちょっと考えすぎてました。
白雪は白雪ですもんね。
他の人と比べても仕方ないです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I was thinking a bit too
much. Snow White is Snow White and
no other.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much, Jack-san... Shirayuki may be clumsy, but she hopes
you'll stay friends with her.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……本当にありがとう。
そそっかしい白雪ですが……
これからも、よろしくお願いします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much, Jack... Snow
White may be clumsy, but she hopes
you'll stay friends with her.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Hello there, Jack-san! What brings you
here today?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……こんにちは！
今日はどうしたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello there, Jack! What brings you
here today?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Nothing special, but... I just
wanted to see you, that's all.
fields.JP:
いや、用事があったわけじゃないんだけど……
ちょっと、顔が見たくなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing special, but... I just
wanted to see you, that's all.

fields.EN: I-I see... Th-Thank you very much!
fields.JP:
そ、そうだったんですか……
あ、ありがとうございます……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I see... Th-Thank you very much!

fields.EN:
Well, it's good to see you, um...
doing better now.
fields.JP:
でも……よかった！
なんていうか、その、最近、元気そうで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's good to see you, um...
doing better now.

fields.EN:
I've... gained a bit of confidence
since then. Well, not that
anything has really changed...
fields.JP:
あれから……ちょっと自信が持てたんです。
前と、何が変わった訳でもないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've... gained a bit of confidence
since then. Well, not that
anything has really changed...

fields.EN:
And, I think it's all because of
you, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
きっと、その……
それも、ジャックさんのおかげだと思います！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I think it's all because of
you, Jack!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... That's not true. Oh, I
know!
fields.JP:
あはは……そんなことないよ。
……そうだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... That's not true. Oh, I
know!

fields.EN:
Um, well... While you're confident,
why don't you take a look in the
mirror?
fields.JP:
あ……いや。
それなら、その……
せっかくだから、鏡を見てみない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... While you're confident,
why don't you take a look in the
mirror?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure how to word it, but
now is your chance to see
yourself. Are you still scared?
fields.JP:
その……うまく言えないけれど。
今だから、君にちゃんと自分を見て欲しいんだ。
……ダメかな？　やっぱり、怖い……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure how to word it, but
now is your chance to see
yourself. Are you still scared?

fields.EN:
I understand... I am scared a bit,
but... I'll give it a try!
fields.JP:
……わかりました。
正直言って、ちょっと怖いですけど……
やってみます……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand... I am scared a bit,
but... I'll give it a try!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's strange for you to be
thanking me, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
ふふ……ジャックさんがお礼を言うのは
おかしいですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's strange to hear
you thank me for this.

fields.JP: そ、それもそうだね……あはは……

fields.EN:
But, um... Please be next to me,
okay?
fields.JP:
……でも、その……
ちゃんとそばにいてくださいね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, um... Please be next to me,
okay?

fields.EN:
Okay... I-I can do this...!
There...!
fields.JP:
よ～し……！
が、がんばります……！
えいっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I-I can do this...!
There...!

fields.EN:
(She really must be scared of
mirrors if she has to pump herself
up like that...)
fields.JP:
（か、鏡と向き合うだけで
　ここまで気合いを入れるなんて……
　本当に、よっぽど怖いんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She really must be scared of
mirrors if she has to pump herself
up like that...)

fields.EN:
S-Shirayukihime?! Are you okay?
Does it still scare you?
fields.JP:
し、白雪姫！
大丈夫？
やっぱり怖かった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Snow White?! Are you okay?
Does it still scare you?

fields.EN:
I knew it... I am plain-looking...
It looks like I have a bit of fat
on me, too...
fields.JP:
やっぱり、地味です……
そして、やっぱり……
ちょっと太ってるような気がします……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... I am plain-looking...
It looks like I have a bit of fat
on me, too...

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないと思うけど……

fields.EN:
(What a relief... It seems like it
didn't scare her.)
fields.JP: （怖かったんじゃなくて、よかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... It seems like it
didn't scare her.)

fields.EN:
(Wait... That's not the point
right now!)
fields.JP: （いやでも、気になるのはそこなの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... That's not the point
right now!)

fields.EN:
Um, I am a bit surprised. I think
this is the first time I've been
able to see myself in a mirror!
fields.JP:
……でも、ちょっと驚いてます。
こんなにちゃんと鏡を見られたのは、
生まれて初めてかも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I am a bit surprised. I think
this is the first time I've been
able to see myself in a mirror!

fields.EN:
I'm sure it's because you were by my side,
Jack-san... Thank you!
fields.JP:
きっと、ジャックさんが
そばにいてくれたからです……
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's because you were here
with me. Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... By the way, you're not
plain at all, Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
あはは……
でも、白雪姫は全然地味じゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... By the way, you're not
plain at all, Snow White.

fields.EN:
Um... That smile of yours is...
really charming.
fields.JP:
その……
笑顔の白雪姫は、すごく、素敵だと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... That smile of yours is...
really charming.

fields.JP: あ、ありがとうございます……

fields.EN:
(I can't believe what I said!
That's so embarrassing!)
fields.JP:
（って、何を恥ずかしい事を
　言ってるんだ……僕は！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe what I said!
That's so embarrassing!)

fields.EN:
So... I guess that means you're the only plain
one left, Jack-san. Hee hee...
fields.JP:
……じゃあこれで、地味なのは
ジャックさんだけになりましたね。
うふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So... I guess that means you're
the only plain one here then.
*giggle*...

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're saying that
to me...
fields.JP: いや、僕だけになるのは、ちょっとそれは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're saying that
to me...

fields.EN:
(I'm a little surprised myself... I can joke this
naturally. Maybe it's because it's this girl...)
fields.JP:
（でも、自分でもちょっと驚いた……
　こんなに自然に冗談が言えるなんて、
　相手がこの子だからなのかもな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised myself over how
casually I'm speaking now... Maybe
it's because it's Snow White...)

fields.EN:
Jack-san? Um, please keep your eyes on
Shirayuki.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
これからも、白雪を見ててくださいね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Um, please keep your eyes on
Snow White.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(That caught me off guard... Did
she mean what I think she did?)
fields.JP:
（び、びっくりした……今のは、
　ど、どういう意味だろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That caught me off guard... Did
she mean what I think she did?)

fields.EN:
(What was that?! That came from
the hallway...)
fields.JP:
（なな、なんだ今の声は！？
　廊下から聞こえてきたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What was that?! That came from
the hallway...)

fields.EN: You! What did you mean by that?!
fields.JP:
ちょっと貴方！！
それはどういう意味ですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: You! What did you mean by that?!

fields.EN:
Y-You don't have to be so
surprised...
fields.JP: そ、そんなに驚かなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't have to be so
surprised...

fields.EN:
Surprised?! I'm furious! I can't
believe you called me "plain!"
fields.JP:
驚くというか、心外ですわ！！
どうして貴方とわたくしが同類なんですの！？
しかも、『地味仲間』だなんて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surprised?! I'm furious! I can't
believe you called me "plain!"

fields.JP:
え、だって……！
シンデレラさんって、
意外と庶民的なところがあるというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But... You seem to have
qualities similar to what you see
from commoners...

fields.EN:
You keep saying the word "waste,"
and you're quite straightforward.
fields.JP:
すぐに『もったいない』って言いますし、
それに……けっこう生真面目なところも
あるじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep saying the word "waste,"
and you're quite straightforward.

fields.EN:
So, I just thought you were
inherently plain... And, that you
were like me...
fields.JP:
だからきっと、
根は地味な方なんじゃないかって……
……白雪とは仲間だって思ったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I just thought you were
inherently plain... And, that you
were like me...

fields.EN:
Are you picking a fight with me?!
I can't believe how rude you are!
fields.JP:
わたくしに喧嘩を売ってらっしゃいますの！？
何をサラッと失礼なこと、
おっしゃってますのかしら！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you picking a fight with me?!
I can't believe how rude you are!

fields.EN:
I definitely don't want to fight,
but... was it really that rude?
fields.JP:
喧嘩だなんてそんな……
し……失礼、でしたか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I definitely don't want to fight,
but... was it really that rude?

fields.EN:
(I see... She wanted to be friends
with Cinderella, but something
went terribly wrong...)
fields.JP:
（な、なるほど、そういうことか……
　きっと単純に、仲良くなりたいんだな。
　……完全に何かが間違ってるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... She wanted to be friends
with Cinderella, but something
went terribly wrong...)

fields.EN:
In any case! You have no reason or
right to call me out for being
plain!
fields.JP:
と、とにかく！
貴方に地味だなんて言われる筋合いは
ありませんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case! You have no reason or
right to call me out for being
plain!

fields.JP: そうですか……すみません……

fields.EN:
Wh-What's with that look on your
face?! Stop acting like you're
sad!
fields.JP:
な、何ですの、その表情は……？
今さら急にしおらしくなったって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's with that look on your
face?! Stop acting like you're
sad!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki just wanted to become friends with
Cinderella-san... But if you didn't want that,
I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
白雪は……ただシンデレラさんと
仲良くなりたかっただけなんです。
でも……嫌だったら、すみません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White just wanted to be
friends with you... I'm sorry if
that's not what you wanted...

fields.EN:
I-I didn't say I didn't want to be
friends... I'm... fine with that.
fields.JP:
べ、別に……
い、嫌だなんて言ってませんわよ……
仲良くなるのは、別にかまいませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I didn't say I didn't want to be
friends... I'm... fine with that.

fields.EN:
W-We are on the same team, so it's
not like I hate you. But, if you
insist on becoming friends...
fields.JP:
も、元々わたくし達は仲間ですし……
貴方のこと、別に嫌いじゃありませんですし？
どうしてもって仰るなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We are on the same team, so it's
not like I hate you. But, if you
insist on becoming friends...

fields.EN:
R-Really? Thank goodness! I'm so
happy!
fields.JP:
ほ、本当ですか！？
……よかった……！
嬉しいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Really? Thank goodness! I'm so
happy!

fields.EN:
I have to say, though, what you
said isn't what someone would say
to make friends.
fields.JP:
でも、それで仲良くなろうだなんて、
普通伝わりませんですことよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, though, what you
said isn't what someone would say
to make friends.

fields.EN:
Calling people plain, or saying
they're like commoners, or
scrooges, or arrogant, or...
fields.JP:
人のことを地味だとか庶民的だとか
もったいない精神のカタマリだとか
貧乏くさいとか、見栄っ張りだとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calling people plain, or saying
they're like commoners, or
scrooges, or arrogant, or...

fields.EN:
(I don't think she said that
much...)
fields.JP: （……そこまで言ってなかったと思うけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't think she said that
much...)

fields.EN:
If someone was told that, they
would want to keep themselves far
away!
fields.JP:
そんな風に言われて、
普通、仲良くしたがってるだなんて
伝わると思いまして！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If someone was told that, they
would want to keep themselves far
away!

fields.JP:
はっ……！
言われてみれば……

fields.EN:
Maybe Shirayuki ended up praising something
you're self-conscious about, Cinderella-san...
fields.JP:
白雪、もしかして
シンデレラさんの気にしていること……
ほめてしまったんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess Snow White was praising
the qualities that bother you.

fields.EN:
B-Bother?! Me?! Wait... You were
trying to praise me?
fields.JP:
わ……わたくし、気にしてなんか……！
……ていうか、ほめてましたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-Bother?! Me?! Wait... You were
trying to praise me?

fields.EN:
Oh, and that "Plain Alliance"
you proposed is such a backwards-
sounding thing!
fields.JP:
と、ともかくですわ！
『地味同盟』ってなんなんですの！？
最初から後ろ向きな響きじゃありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and that "Plain Alliance"
you proposed is such a backwards-
sounding thing!

fields.EN:
Plain Alliance doesn't sound
good...? Backward... I see...
fields.JP:
地味同盟……ダメですか？
……後ろ向き……そうですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plain Alliance doesn't sound
good...? Backward... I see...

fields.EN:
F-Fine! I get it! I just have to
join this "Plain Alliance" of
yours, right?!
fields.JP:
……も、もう！　わ、分かりましたわ……
入ればいいんでしょう？
その『地味同盟』とやらに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine! I get it! I just have to
join this "Plain Alliance" of
yours, right?!

fields.EN:
(She's going to join after all
that?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's going to join after all
that?)

fields.EN:
Really?! I-I'm so happy! Thank you
so very much!
fields.JP:
本当ですか！？
うう……嬉しいです！
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! I-I'm so happy! Thank you
so very much!

fields.EN:
You don't have to be that happy...
Um, can't you at least reconsider
the name?
fields.JP:
そ、そこまで喜ばなくても……
あと、その名前……どうにかなりませんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to be that happy...
Um, can't you at least reconsider
the name?

fields.EN:
Huh? I think it's a good name... Oh! Then
Cinderella-san, you come up with a name!
fields.JP:
え？　良い名前だと思うんですけど……
あ、そうだ！
じゃあ、シンデレラさんが名前考えてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I thought it was good, but...
I know! Why don't you come up with
a name that you'd like?

fields.EN:
Huh? M-Me? Well... How about the
"Gracious Ladies All-For-One
Club?"
fields.JP:
え？　わ、わたくしが？
そうですわね……じゃあ、
『清楚なお嬢様運命共同体』とか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? M-Me? Well... How about the
"Gracious Ladies All-For-One
Club?"

fields.EN:
That's so cute! But, it is a bit
long, and... Jack-san is in it, too.
fields.JP:
わあ、可愛いですね！
でも、ちょっと長いかもしれませんし、
ジャックさんも居ますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's so cute! But, it is a bit
long, and... Jack is in it, too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: （やっぱり僕も入ってるんだ……）

fields.EN:
Oh, Jack? I suppose "Ladies"
wouldn't work then. Hm...
fields.JP:
まあまあ、ジャックもですの……？
それでは『お嬢様』はダメですわね……
う～ん……それでは何がいいかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Jack? I suppose "Ladies"
wouldn't work then. Hm...

fields.EN:
(I was worried there for a moment,
but it looks like it all ended
well...)
fields.JP:
（一時はどうなるかと思ったけど……
　なんだかんだで仲良くやれそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was worried there for a moment,
but it looks like it all ended
well...)

fields.EN:
(I feel so tired all of a
sudden... I'd better go back to my
room and rest...)
fields.JP:
（ほっとしたら疲れた……
　……部屋に戻ろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel so tired all of a
sudden... I'd better go back to my
room and rest...)

fields.EN:
(What's the matter with Shirayukihime? It's unusual to hear her
wanting to see me in her room...)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫、どうしたんだろう？
　自分から、部屋に来てくれだなんて……
　珍しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the matter with Snow
White? It's unusual to hear her
wanting to see me in her room...)

fields.EN:
Jack-san! I'm so sorry to have you
come here!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん！
急に呼び出したりして、すみません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! I'm so sorry to have you
come here!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: No, that's fine. Um... What is it?
fields.JP:
ううん、大丈夫だよ。
それより……どうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: No, that's fine. Um... What is it?

fields.EN: W-Well... I had a favor to ask...
fields.JP:
そ、その……
実は、お願いがあるんです……
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Well... I had a favor to ask...

fields.EN:
I got a pretty dress, and... I was
hoping you could see it...
fields.JP:
この間、お洋服をもらったんですけど……
それを見てほしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got a pretty dress, and... I was
hoping you could see it...

fields.JP:
へえ……！
でも、なんでまた僕に……？

fields.EN:
W-Well, I wanted a boy's opinion
on whether it looks good or not...
Is that okay?
fields.JP:
そ、その……似合うかどうか、
男性の意見も欲しくて……
ダメ、ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I wanted a boy's opinion
on whether it looks good or not...
Is that okay?

fields.EN:
I see... Sure! If you're fine with
me.
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……！
僕なんかでよければ、もちろんいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Sure! If you're fine with
me.

fields.JP:
本当ですか？
ありがとうございます！

（とは言ったものの、
　なんかちょっと緊張するなあ……）

fields.EN:
Okay! Let me go and change, then.
But, be sure you look away! No
peeking!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、さっそく着替えますね！
……ちょっと向こう向いててください！
の……覗いちゃダメですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Let me go and change, then.
But, be sure you look away! No
peeking!

fields.EN:
(I wonder how much longer it's
going to take...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder how much longer it's
going to take...)

fields.EN: I'm done! You can turn around now!
fields.JP:
き、着ました……！
もうこっちを向いて大丈夫です！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm done! You can turn around now!

fields.EN:
(I need to give her my honest
opinion, but this is going to be
so embarrassing...)
fields.JP:
（ちゃんと感想言わなくちゃ……
　なんだか恥ずかしいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to give her my honest
opinion, but this is going to be
so embarrassing...)

fields.EN:
H-How is it? It feels a bit tight
at the top, though...
fields.JP:
ど、どうですか……？
ちょっときついような気がします……
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-How is it? It feels a bit tight
at the top, though...

fields.EN:
(S-Sure, she looks good, but...
Her breasts are...!)
fields.JP:
（ど、どうって……もちろん似合ってるけど、
　その前に、ボタンが……
　け、けっこう胸がちらっと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-Sure, she looks good, but...
Her breasts are...!)

fields.EN:
Um, uh! Y-You look real good! But,
um... I think it's best to pull up
the top part...
fields.JP:
あ、あはは！　す、すごく似合ってるよ！
でも、その……
ぼ、ボタンはちゃんと上まで閉めた方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh! Y-You look real good! But,
um... I think it's best to pull up
the top part...

fields.JP:
えっ？
……きゃっ！！？
す、すみません……！！

fields.EN:
N-No! I'm sorry for saying such a
thing!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
変な事言って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No! I'm sorry for saying such a
thing!

fields.EN: Aaaah! I need to cover up! Yikes!
fields.JP:
あわわわ……早く閉めないと……！
……ひゃああっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aaaah! I need to cover up! Yikes!

fields.JP: （み、見るなジャック！　見ちゃダメだ！）

fields.EN:
Urrh... I guess it was too small
for Shirayuki... It must be
because I'm fat...
fields.JP:
うう……白雪には小さかったみたいです……
やっぱり……太ってるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I guess it was too small
for Snow White... It must be
because I'm fat...

fields.EN:
No, that's fine... I've known it
all along... Heh... Heh, heh,
heh...
fields.JP:
いえ、いいんです。
知ってましたから……
うふ、うふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's fine... I've known it
all along... Heh... Heh, heh,
heh...

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... She must
have snapped!)
fields.JP:
（や、やばい……自虐を通り越して
　変なテンションになってる……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... She must
have snapped!)

fields.EN:
Heh... Uh, um... By the way... Who
bought you that?
fields.JP:
あはは……そ、そういえば……
その服……誰からもらったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Uh, um... By the way... Who
bought you that?

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: Huh?! I-I see! Is that so?
fields.JP:
え！？　そ、そうなの！？
それは……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! I-I see! Is that so?

fields.EN:
(Well, duh! It's no wonder it's
too small! I can't believe what
Oyayubihime did here!)
fields.JP:
（いや、そりゃ小さいだろ！
　っていうか、親指姫も何でそんなことを！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, duh! It's no wonder it's
too small! I can't believe what
Thumbelina did here!)

fields.EN:
C'mon! You can do better than
that!
fields.JP: ほらほら！　もっと気合入れて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon! You can do better than
that!

fields.EN:
(Hm? Akazukin-san and Shirayukihime are running... Wait...
They're coming right at me!)
fields.JP:
（ん？　あれは……赤ずきんさんと、白雪姫？
　なんで走って……
　ってか、なんかこっちに来るし！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Red Riding Hood and Snow
White are running... Wait...
They're coming right at me!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Hey! Jack! Perfect timing! Join
us!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャック！
ちょうどいいところにいた！
あんたも一緒にやるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Jack! Perfect timing! Join
us!

fields.EN:
*huff* *huff* Jack-san...! You're
going to join us? Thank you!
fields.JP:
はあはあ……ジャックさん……！
ありがとうございます！
付き合ってくれるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*huff* *huff* Jack...! You're
going to join us? Thank you!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
All right! Ten more laps, and
you're coming too, Jack!
fields.JP:
よーし……それじゃあ、
ジャックも一緒に、あと１０周だね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Ten more laps, and
you're coming too, Jack!

fields.EN:
Y-Yes...! Shirayuki can do more
as long as Jack-san is with us!
fields.JP:
は……はい！
ジャックさんも一緒なら、白雪、がんばります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes...! Snow White can do more
as long as Jack is with us!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Nice! That's what I wanna hear!
fields.JP: よーし！　いい心がけだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice! That's what I wanna hear!

fields.EN:
(I have no idea what's going on,
but now I can't get away from
them...!)
fields.JP:
（な、なんかよく分からないけど、
　いつの間にか巻き込まれてる！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have no idea what's going on,
but now I can't get away from
them...!)

fields.EN:
Okay! Not bad for the first day!
Let's have a break!
fields.JP:
よーし！
ま、初日だし、今日はこんなもんかな
ちょっと休もっか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Not bad for the first day!
Let's have a break!

fields.EN:
(I ended up running, but what is
this all about? Some sort of
special training exercise?)
fields.JP:
（ついつい一緒に走っちゃったけど、
　な、なんなんだ一体……？
　何かのトレーニングなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I ended up running, but what is
this all about? Some sort of
special training exercise?)

fields.EN:
(But I have to hand it to Akazukin-san. She didn't even break
a sweat...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、さすが赤ずきんさん。
　息も切らしてないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I have to hand it to Red
Riding Hood. She didn't even break
a sweat...)

fields.EN:
S-Shirayukihime? What's going on?
Were you forced to join Akazukin-san's training?
fields.JP:
し、白雪姫……これは一体？
赤ずきんさんのトレーニングに
君も巻き込まれたとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Snow White? What's going on?
Were you forced to join Red Riding
Hood's training?
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Shirayuki wanted to build up her
stamina! It's definitely not for
losing weight!
fields.JP:
なんていうか……
白雪も、体力を付けようと思って！
決してダイエットの為じゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White wanted to build up her
stamina! It's definitely not for
losing weight!

fields.EN:
(She isn't trying hard to hide
her motive, is she? I'd better
keep quiet for now...)
fields.JP:
（いや、思いっきりバレバレだけど、
　ここはツッコまないでおこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She isn't trying hard to hide
her motive, is she? I'd better
keep quiet for now...)

fields.EN:
Huh? You wanted to build up your
stamina?
fields.JP:
え……？
なんだ白雪、あんた力を付けたかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You wanted to build up your
stamina?

fields.JP: え？　いえ、えっと、それはその……

fields.EN:
Then you need to eat more! To the
cafeteria we go!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、沢山食べなくっちゃね！
そうと決まれば、食堂に行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then you need to eat more! To the
cafeteria we go!

fields.JP:
えええっ！？
いえ、白雪はいいです！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha--?! No! Snow White is fine!

fields.EN:
Nope! You need to eat at least
five extra servings! C'mon, stand
up!
fields.JP:
もう。ダメだよ、ちゃんと食べなくちゃ！
５杯はおかわり絶対だからね！
ほら、立って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope! You need to eat at least
five extra servings! C'mon, stand
up!

fields.JP:
ひいいいいいっ！？
違うんです！　違うんです～！！
ジャックさん、助けて～！！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: La-la-la! It's off to eat we go!
fields.JP:
ふんふ～ん♪
ご飯ご飯、っと♪
fields.LOCALIZED: La-la-la! It's off to eat we go!

fields.EN:
(She should have just fessed up
that she was doing all this to
lose weight...)
fields.JP:
（素直にダイエットしたいって
　言えばよかったのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She should have just fessed up
that she was doing all this to
lose weight...)

fields.EN:
(Wait, now that I think about it,
Akazukin-san must know that.
She's just having fun with her...)
fields.JP:
（っていうか……
　赤ずきんさんも絶対気付いてて
　悪ノリしてるよな、あれ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, now that I think about it,
Red Riding Hood must know that.
She's just having fun with her...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
（あ。眠り姫だ……
　こんなところで、何してるのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleeping Beauty? What is she
doing here?)

fields.EN:
(Seems like she isn't doing
anything in particular. Is she
just loafing around?)
fields.JP:
（見たところ、何もしてなさそうだけど……
　日向ぼっこかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like she isn't doing
anything in particular. Is she
just loafing around?)

fields.EN:
H-Hi there, Nemurihime. What
are you doing here?
fields.JP:
や……やあ、眠り姫。
こんなところで、何してるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hi there, Sleeping Beauty. What
are you doing here?

fields.EN:
Heh... The weather's pretty nice,
isn't it? Are you getting some
sun?
fields.JP:
あはは……今日は珍しく、良い天気だね……
日向ぼっこかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... The weather's pretty nice,
isn't it? Are you getting some
sun?

fields.EN:
(What am I saying? This place
doesn't have much weather to begin
with...)
fields.JP:
（て……天気なんかここじゃ変わらないのに、
　何を言ってるんだ、僕は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What am I saying? This place
doesn't have much weather to begin
with...)

fields.EN:
(Is she ignoring me? Wait...
Ignoring me?!)
fields.JP:
（もしかして……スルー？
　む、無視されてる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she ignoring me? Wait...
Ignoring me?!)

fields.EN:
(Why is she ignoring me? Did I do
something to her?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんで無視されるんだろう……
　僕、嫌われてるのかな？
　何かまずい事したっけ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is she ignoring me? Did I do
something to her?)

fields.JP:
（……え？
　っていうか、もしかして……寝てる！？）

fields.EN:
(What a relief... I thought I did
something wrong... Huh, she sure
does sleep a lot...)
fields.JP:
（ほっとしたような、拍子抜けのような……
　……でも、よく寝てるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief... I thought I did
something wrong... Huh, she sure
does sleep a lot...)

fields.EN:
(I'd better leave before I wake
her up...)
fields.JP:
（起こしちゃ悪いし、
　ここはひとまず退散しよう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd better leave before I wake
her up...)

fields.JP:
（ま、まずい！
　起こしちゃった……？）

fields.EN:
S-Sorry! You were sleeping,
weren't you?
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
やっぱり……寝てたんだよ、ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry! You were sleeping,
weren't you?

fields.EN: I-I see... Do you come here often?
fields.JP:
そ……そっか。
屋上にはよく来るの？
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I see... Do you come here often?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... So I guess I just came
at the right time. Did you sleep
well?
fields.JP:
あはは……
じゃあ、たまたまなんだね。
よく眠れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... So I guess I just came
at the right time. Did you sleep
well?

fields.JP: そっか、それはよかった……

fields.EN:
(I'd better not bother her for too
long if she was having a good
rest just now...)
fields.JP:
（せっかくよく寝てたんなら、
　あまり話しかけるのも悪いよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd better not bother her for too
long if she was having a good
rest just now...)

fields.EN:
W-Well, I'll be going. Oh, but
make sure you go back inside
before you catch a cold!
fields.JP:
じゃ……じゃあ、僕はそろそろ行くね。
あ……風邪ひくといけないし、
キリの良いところで帰るんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I'll be going. Oh, but
make sure you go back inside
before you catch a cold!

fields.EN:
(She's a unique one, all right...
She was sleeping so soundly...
She was really cute, too...)
fields.JP:
（なんだか、変わった子だなあ……
　でも、気持ち良さそうに眠ってたな。
　可愛らしい寝顔で……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's a unique one, all right...
She was sleeping so soundly...
She was really cute, too...)

fields.EN:
I woke up... and there... Jack...
My prince...?
fields.JP:
目が覚めたら……いた……
ジャック……
……王子……さま？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I woke up... and there... Jack...
My prince...?

fields.JP:
（こんなとこで座り込んでるけど……
　ひょっとして、寝てるのかな？）

fields.EN:
(It's good she's sleeping, but I
can't leave her here like this...)
fields.JP:
（よく眠るのはいいとして、
　さすがにこんな所じゃ……
　ほっとくわけにもいかないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's good she's sleeping, but I
can't leave her here like this...)

fields.EN:
Okay... I'd better carry her back
to her room...
fields.JP:
よし……
と、とりあえず、眠り姫の部屋まで運ぼう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I'd better carry her back
to her room...

fields.EN:
Sorry... Just need to get under
here...
fields.JP: ごめん。ちょっとだけ動かすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry... Just need to get under
here...

fields.EN:
(Whoa! She's a lot lighter than I
thought!)
fields.JP:
（わ……！
　やっぱり女の子って軽いんだな……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa! She's a lot lighter than I
thought!)

fields.EN:
(Nemurihime smells so good...
My heart's pounding... I'd better
get her to her room, quick!)
fields.JP:
（眠り姫……甘くていい匂いがする……
　な、なんだかドキドキしてきた……
　早く運ばないと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleeping Beauty smells so good...
My heart's pounding... I'd better
get her to her room, quick!)

fields.JP:
ふう……
これでよし、と……

fields.EN:
(Now that I have time to look
around, her room seems to be
filled with plants and vines...)
fields.JP:
（この部屋…改めて見ると
　植物やツタだらけだな…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I have time to look
around, her room seems to be
filled with plants and vines...)

fields.EN:
(It's interesting, but I shouldn't
wake her up just to ask her
about it. I'll save it for later.)
fields.JP:
（気になるけど……
　さすがに起こしてまで聞くのも
　悪いし……また今度にしよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's interesting, but I shouldn't
wake her up just to ask her
about it. I'll save it for later.)

fields.EN: Okay, guess I'll be going now...
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, guess I'll be going now...

fields.EN:
(My feet got caught in the
vines... I need to get them off of
me...)
fields.JP:
（つ、ツタが足に絡まった！？
　ど、どうにか外して……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My feet got caught in the
vines... I need to get them off of
me...)

fields.EN:
(D-Did I wake her...? I should get
out of here... What? It's dark
all of a sudden! What gives?!)
fields.JP:
（お……起こしちゃったかな？　
　早くどかないと……って……
　目の前が真っ暗！？　な、なんで！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(D-Did I wake her...? I should get
out of here... What? It's dark
all of a sudden! What gives?!)

fields.EN:
(What're these huge, soft things
sandwiching my face? Wait...! Are
these her b-breasts...?!)
fields.JP:
（柔らかくて、大きい何かが顔に……
　……はっ！？　ま、まさかこれって……
　眠り姫の、む、胸……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What're these huge, soft things
sandwiching my face? Wait...! Are
these her b-breasts...?!)

fields.EN:
Nemurihime? Are you there?
You need to keep your door closed.
fields.JP:
……眠り姫？　いるのかしら？
駄目じゃない。
部屋のドアを開けっ放しにしては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty? Are you there?
You need to keep your door closed.

fields.EN:
I bet she's just sleeping... But
it isn't safe to do this, even if
we're at the headquarters!
fields.JP:
もう……どうせ寝てるんだろうけど。
いくら本部内とはいえ……
さすがに無用心すぎるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet she's just sleeping... But
it isn't safe to do this, even if
we're at the headquarters!

fields.JP:
……ぶはっ！
や、やっと顔が出せた……！

ジャック……！！
あ、あんた……

fields.EN:
Alice?! Oyayubihime?! No! This
isn't what you think!
fields.JP:
……あ、アリスと親指姫！？
違うんだ！　これはその……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice?! Thumbelina?! No! This
isn't what you think!

fields.EN:
Of all the people... Lewd scum!
Prepare yourself!
fields.JP:
まさか……あんたがこんな……
スケベ野郎だったなんてね……！
びっくりだわ……覚悟なさい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all the people... Lewd scum!
Prepare yourself!

fields.EN:
It's really not what you think!
You have to hear me out!
fields.JP:
ち、違うんだって！！
まずは僕の話を……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's really not what you think!
You have to hear me out!

fields.EN:
J-Jack... Jack was... No...
This... This has to be a dream...
fields.JP:
ジャ……ジャックがそんなこと……
嘘よ……これはきっと……夢だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Jack... Jack was... No...
This... This has to be a dream...

fields.EN: (Dang it! This isn't good at all!)
fields.LOCALIZED: (Dang it! This isn't good at all!)

fields.EN: Hm...? Why am I... on the bed...?
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm...? Why am I... on the bed...?

fields.EN:
You were sleeping in the hallway,
so I brought you here without
waking you up...
fields.JP:
君が廊下で寝てたから、
そっと運んだつもりだったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were sleeping in the hallway,
so I brought you here without
waking you up...

fields.EN:
But, then I tripped on that vine
there, and... I'm sorry to wake
you up like this...
fields.JP:
その、そこのツタに引っかかって転んじゃって
……起こしてごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, then I tripped on that vine
there, and... I'm sorry to wake
you up like this...

fields.EN:
Don't you be trying to get out of
this with that kind of lie! Isn't
that right, Nemu?
fields.JP:
そんな苦しい嘘をついたって駄目よ！
ねえ、ネム
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you be trying to get out of
this with that kind of lie! Isn't
that right, Sleepy?

fields.EN:
In my dream... Jack carried me...
I think... he fell...
fields.JP:
……夢の中で……
ジャックが……運んでくれた……
……転んでた……かも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In my dream... Jack carried me...
I think... he fell...

fields.EN:
S-So that's what happened? Hmph!
What a troublemaker! You should've
said so earlier!
fields.JP:
そ、そういうことだったの……
ふん！　紛らわしいのよまったく！
そうならそうと早く言いなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So that's what happened? Hmph!
What a troublemaker! You should've
said so earlier!

fields.EN:
Yes... I knew Jack wasn't that
kind of person, but... I wish you
had told us about it...
fields.JP:
そうね……ジャックはそんな事はしないと
わたしはわかっていたのだけど……
ちゃんと言ってほしかったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I knew Jack wasn't that
kind of person, but... I wish you
had told us about it...

fields.EN:
(It looks like they understand
what happened, but why does it
feel like I'm being scolded...?)
fields.JP:
（ご、誤解は解けたはずなのに、
　なんで僕は怒られてるんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like they understand
what happened, but why does it
feel like I'm being scolded...?)

fields.EN: And... there. That should do it...
fields.JP:
よいしょっ……
これで、よしと……
fields.LOCALIZED: And... there. That should do it...

fields.EN:
(It seems like I'm always carrying
Nemurihime from the hallway
back to her room. Same old story.)
fields.JP:
（あの日以来、廊下で寝てる眠り姫を
　見かけるたびにこうして運んでるけど……
　すっかり慣れちゃったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems like I'm always carrying
Sleeping Beauty from the hallway
back to her room. Same old story.)

fields.EN:
It's really mesmerizing how well
she can sleep through all this...
fields.JP:
それはそれとして、いつ見ても
惚れ惚れする眠りっぷりだなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's really mesmerizing how well
she can sleep through all this...

fields.EN:
(Did she just respond to me? Can
she hear me, even if she's
asleep?)
fields.JP:
（反応があった！？
　もしかして……眠ってても
　一応聞こえてはいるのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did she just respond to me? Can
she hear me, even if she's
asleep?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she'll answer me if I ask
her something...)
fields.JP:
（今、何か聞いてみれば、
　返事が返ってくるかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she'll answer me if I ask
her something...)

fields.EN: Can I... ask you a question?
fields.JP: 眠り姫……ちょっと聞いてもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Can I... ask you a question?

fields.EN:
About your room... Why is it like
this? Was the interior too harsh
before?
fields.JP:
君の、この部屋なんだけど……
その……どうしてこんな感じなの？
インテリアに凝ってる……とか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
About your room... Why is it like
this? Was the interior too harsh
before?

fields.EN:
Oh, no? So, it's just that you
like plants?
fields.JP:
あ、違うんだ……
じゃあ、単純に植物が好きなのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, no? So, it's just that you
like plants?

fields.EN:
I see... I guess the plants would
help you sleep better.
fields.JP:
そっか……
植物があった方が、きっとよく眠れるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I guess the plants would
help you sleep better.

fields.EN:
(I'm actually having a
conversation with her! I wonder if
she'll forget when she wakes up.)
fields.JP:
（会話が成り立ってる……！
　でも、これって起きた時には
　やっぱり忘れてるのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm actually having a
conversation with her! I wonder if
she'll forget when she wakes up.)

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, that? I said that I was
mesmerized with how you can sleep
so soundly.
fields.JP:
え？　……ああ、さっきの……！
『惚れ惚れする眠りっぷりだ』って
言ったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, that? I said that I was
mesmerized with how you can sleep
so soundly.

fields.EN:
(What happened? Maybe she is
really awake...)
fields.JP:
（……どうしたんだろう？
　ひょっとして、本当はやっぱり
　起きてたんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What happened? Maybe she is
really awake...)

fields.EN:
(This sensation... D-Don't tell
me... Her breasts, again...?!)
fields.JP:
（こっこの感触……
　ま、まさかまた胸が……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This sensation... D-Don't tell
me... Her breasts, again...?!)

fields.EN:
When I... woke up... I was... 
mesmerized, too...
fields.JP:
あの時……目が覚めた時……
ボクも……惚れ惚れした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I... woke up... I was... 
mesmerized, too...

fields.JP:
……えっ？
それって、どういう……

fields.EN:
(Mmm... She... smells so good...
W-What am I thinking?! I-I need to
get away!)
fields.JP:
（あ、眠り姫……甘い匂いがする……
　……って、何やってんだ僕は！？
　と、とりあえず離れないと！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mmm... She... smells so good...
W-What am I thinking?! I-I need to
get away!)

fields.EN:
Aaagh! *huff* *huff* S-Nemurihime? What did you mean when
you...
fields.JP:
……ぷはっ！　はあ、はあ……
ね、眠り姫……？
今のは一体どういう意味……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaagh! *huff* *huff* S-Sleeping
Beauty? What did you mean when
you...

fields.EN:
(Was she just talking in her
sleep? Sh-Shoot... I can't get my
heart to stop pounding...)
fields.JP:
（ただの寝言だったのかな……？
　そ、それにしても……
　あードキドキした……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Was she just talking in her
sleep? Sh-Shoot... I can't get my
heart to stop pounding...)

fields.EN:
(We're gaining more friends as we
clear the missions, but a lot of
weird things keep popping up...)
fields.JP:
（任務をこなせばこなすほど、
　仲間は増えていくけど、
　同時にわからない事も増えていく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're gaining more friends as we
clear the missions, but a lot of
weird things keep popping up...)

fields.EN:
(What is the Jail for? What about
the Marchens and the Nightmares?
What Gretel said bothers me, too.)
fields.JP:
（……ジェイルって、何の為にあるんだろう？
　メルヒェンも、ナイトメアも……
　グレーテルの言葉も気になるし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What is the Jail for? What about
the Marchens and the Nightmares?
What Gretel said bothers me, too.)

fields.EN:
(Also, what about the thing about
us being a crossbreed of humans
and Marchens?)
fields.JP:
（僕らが人間とメルヒェンとの間の
　ハーフだってことも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Also, what about the thing about
us being a crossbreed of humans
and Marchens?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe there are more secrets in
this world that we haven't
discovered yet...)
fields.JP:
（この世界には……僕らには知らされてない
　秘密が、まだあるんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe there are more secrets in
this world that we haven't
discovered yet...)

fields.EN:
(No use thinking now... First
things first. I need to focus on
getting out of here!)
fields.JP:
（今は考えても仕方ないか……それよりも、
　今は脱出のことを考えなくちゃ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No use thinking now... First
things first. I need to focus on
getting out of here!)

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, Nemurihime? I'm
sorry! I didn't notice you!
fields.JP:
え？　あ、眠り姫……？
ご、ごめん！　気付かなかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, Sleeping Beauty? I'm
sorry! I didn't notice you!

fields.EN:
Oh, it's nothing! Nothing at
all... I just wanted to get a
breath of fresh air outside...
fields.JP:
あ……な、なんでもないよ！
大したことじゃないんだ。
ちょっと外の空気に触れたくなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, it's nothing! Nothing at
all... I just wanted to get a
breath of fresh air outside...

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry if I disturbed your
nap! That's why you come here,
right? W-Well, I better get going.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんね昼寝の邪魔して！
眠り姫、そのためにここに来てたんだよね。
ぼ、僕はそろそろ行くね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry if I disturbed your
nap! That's why you come here,
right? W-Well, I better get going.

fields.EN: Keep yourself warm, okay? See you!
fields.JP:
風邪、ひかないようにね。
それじゃあ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Keep yourself warm, okay? See you!

fields.EN:
(Wh-What was that about? She
seemed angry. I've never seen her
like that before...)
fields.JP:
（ど、どうしたんだろう……？
　なんだか、怒ってたような……？
　あんな眠り姫、初めてかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What was that about? She
seemed angry. I've never seen her
like that before...)

fields.EN:
(I can't seem to get my thinking
straight... Maybe I should speak
with someone else. But... who?)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、考えがうまくまとまらない……
　いっそ、誰かと話した方がいいのかな……？
　でも……どこから誰と話せば……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't seem to get my thinking
straight... Maybe I should speak
with someone else. But... who?)

fields.EN:
(Hm...? Who could it be at this
hour?)
fields.JP:
（ん……？
　こんな時間に……誰だろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm...? Who could it be at this
hour?)

fields.EN:
S-Nemurihime? What brings
you here so late?
fields.JP:
ね、眠り姫……？
ど、どうしたの、こんな時間に……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sleeping Beauty? What brings
you here so late?

fields.EN:
(S-She's mad...? Come to think of
it, is she still mad from the last
time?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんか怒ってる……？
　そういえば、この間のこと……
　もしかして、まだ気にしてるのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-She's mad...? Come to think of
it, is she still mad from the last
time?)

fields.JP:
うわわっ……！？
ね、眠り姫！？

fields.EN:
(S-She's making me use her lap as
a pillow?!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-She's making me use her lap as
a pillow?!)

fields.JP: （こ、このままって言われても……）

fields.EN:
(W-Well, it does feel good now...
I feel as if I'm at peace now...
But...)
fields.JP:
（た、確かに……ものすごく気持ちいい……

　でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(W-Well, it does feel good now...
I feel as if I'm at peace now...
But...)

fields.EN:
(Feel so... sleepy... I haven't
felt... this sleepy... in ages...)
fields.JP:
（あ……なんだか眠気が……

　からかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Feel so... sleepy... I haven't
felt... this sleepy... in ages...)

fields.JP:
（あれ……？
　僕、寝ちゃってたのか……？）

fields.EN:
(I still have my head on her lap?!
Did she stay like that the entire
time I was asleep?!)
fields.JP:
（って、まだ膝枕されてるし！？
　まさか眠り姫、
　僕が寝てる間ずっとこのまま……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I still have my head on her lap?!
Did she stay like that the entire
time I was asleep?!)

fields.EN:
Why...? Why are you doing this for
me?
fields.JP:
どうして……こんな事……？
僕のために、ここまで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...? Why are you doing this for
me?

fields.EN:
Don't... keep things to
yourself... I'm... here, too...
fields.JP:
……かかえ……こまない……
