fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't... keep things to
yourself... I'm... here, too...

fields.EN:
(She was worried about me back
then... And I didn't notice it at
all...)
fields.JP:
（あの時も、心配してくれてたんだ……
　なのに僕は気がつかなくて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She was worried about me back
then... And I didn't notice it at
all...)

fields.EN:
(She was worried about me all
along... Maybe she noticed that I
don't talk about my feelings.)
fields.JP:
（眠り姫は、ずっと気にかけてくれたのに……
　僕は誰にも相談できないような気でいて、
　みんなのこと、拒絶してたのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She was worried about me all
along... Maybe she noticed that I
don't talk about my feelings.)

fields.EN:
Thank you, Nemurihime...
You're right. I'll make sure I
don't bottle everything up.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、眠り姫……
……そうだね。これからは
一人で抱え込まないようにするよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Sleeping Beauty...
You're right. I'll make sure I
don't bottle everything up.

fields.EN:
So, would it be all right if I
spoke with you again once I have
my thoughts in order?
fields.JP:
だから、考えがもう少しまとまったら……
話を聞いてもらってもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, would it be all right if I
spoke with you again once I have
my thoughts in order?

fields.EN:
Oh, were you about to go to sleep?
I'm sorry, but... I came to thank
you...
fields.JP:
あ、ね、寝るところだったらごめん。
実はその……
ちゃんと、お礼を言わなきゃなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, were you about to go to sleep?
I'm sorry, but... I came to thank
you...

fields.EN:
Well, we haven't really had much
conversation before, but... that's
why I came.
fields.JP:
あはは……確かに僕たち、会話らしい会話って、
そんなにしてないんだよね。
……でも、だからこそなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we haven't really had much
conversation before, but... that's
why I came.

fields.EN:
I felt like... you taught me a lot
of things, Nemurihime.
fields.JP:
眠り姫には、なんだか色んな事を教えられた
ような……そんな気がしてさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt like... you taught me a lot
of things, Sleeping Beauty.

fields.EN:
Not only through the words you
say, but...
fields.JP: 言葉だけじゃなくて、なんていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only through the words you
say, but...

fields.EN:
I'm not sure how to word this,
but... I feel like being with you
is saving me somehow...
fields.JP:
うまく言えないけど……眠り姫といると、
気持ちが、救われるというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure how to word this,
but... I feel like being with you
is saving me somehow...

fields.JP: だから、その……ありがとう

fields.EN:
Ah... S-Sorry this was all so
sudden! I guess I made this into a
bigger deal than I had to... Haha!
fields.JP:
あ……い、いきなりごめんね！
ちょっと大げさだよね……あはは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... S-Sorry this was all so
sudden! I guess I made this into a
bigger deal than I had to... Haha!

fields.EN:
(This is pretty embarrassing,
saying this upfront to her...)
fields.JP:
（なんていうか、こうして改めて言うと
　て、照れてくるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is pretty embarrassing,
saying this upfront to her...)

fields.EN:
I woke up... Prince... You were
there, Jack...
fields.JP:
寝てるとき、おきたら……
王子様……ジャックがいた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I woke up... Prince... You were
there, Jack...

fields.JP:
え、ええっ！？
お、王子様……！？

fields.EN:
Waking up... can change the
world...
fields.JP:
起きることで……
世界が変わること、あるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waking up... can change the
world...

fields.EN:
(I think I know what she means.
It must be like what I felt the
last time.)
fields.JP:
（なんか、わかる気がする……
　きっとあの時の僕と、同じだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think I know what she means.
It must be like what I felt the
last time.)

fields.EN:
(When I woke up from sleeping on
her lap, I felt refreshed... Like 
something changed inside me...)
fields.JP:
（彼女に膝枕してもらって、目が覚めた時……
　驚くくらい気持ちが穏やかになって……
　少し、何かが変わった気がしたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When I woke up from sleeping on
her lap, I felt refreshed... Like 
something changed inside me...)

fields.EN:
You're right... I think I know
what you mean...
fields.JP:
……そうだね。
なんだか、わかる気がするよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... I think I know
what you mean...

fields.EN:
(She looks sleepy all the time,
but seeing her smile like that
every so often is saving my soul.)
fields.JP:
（いつも眠そうだけど……
　こうして笑った顔をたまに見ると、
　救われた気持ちになるんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks sleepy all the time,
but seeing her smile like that
every so often is saving my soul.)

fields.EN:
(Hm? Nemurihime and Rapunzel?
I know they're good friends, but I
wonder what they do together.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　眠り姫とラプンツェルだ……
　そういえばあの二人って仲いいけど、
　普段何やってるんだろ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Sleeping Beauty and Rapunzel?
I know they're good friends, but I
wonder what they do together.)

fields.EN:
Rapunzel likes Nemu-Nemu's boobs!
So soft and cuddly!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、ねむねむのおっぱいすきーー！
ふかふかでどきどきするよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel likes Sleepy's boobs!
So soft and cuddly!

fields.EN:
(Wha-?! What is Rapunzel saying?!
Well sure, everyone likes boo...
What the heck am I thinking?!)
fields.JP:
（なっ！？　ラプンツェル、なんて事を！？

fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wha-?! What is Rapunzel saying?!
Well sure, everyone likes boo...
What the heck am I thinking?!)

fields.JP:
いいのーーー！？
やったーーー！！
うん。もふもふするーー！！

fields.EN:
(Wha-?! She buried her face

fields.LOCALIZED:

into...! S-So that's what she
meant...)

fields.EN: Heh, heh! So cuddly! So soft!

えへへ！　ふわふわーー！！

fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, heh! So cuddly! So soft!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel likes being here! So
soft! Feels so good! Smells so
good!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルねー、ここにいるのすきー！！
やわらかくてきもちよくて、
いいにおいがするんだー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel likes being here! So
soft! Feels so good! Smells so
good!

fields.EN:
(I'm so jealous... No! That's not
what I meant! Um, they're so cute
together...)
fields.JP:
（う、うらやましい……じゃなくて！

fields.LOCALIZED:

what I meant! Um, they're so cute
together...)

fields.JP:
あれ？
なんだか、ねむくなってきちゃった……

Okay... I'm gonna sleep with

じゃあ、ねむもいっしょにねよー……
すー……すー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I'm gonna sleep with
Slee...py... Zzz... Zzz...

fields.EN:

fields.LOCALIZED:
(They seem like total opposites,
and when they talk, it's not much

fields.JP: （なんだか、お母さんと子供みたいだな……）

fields.EN:

cold like that? I'd better bring
them a blanket...)
fields.JP:
（で、でも……そこでそのまま寝るのは

　仕方ない、毛布持ってくるか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, aren't they going to catch a
cold like that? I'd better bring
them a blanket...)

fields.EN:
Whew... Finally back... Urrh... So
dizzy...
fields.JP:
ふう……やっと帰れた……
う……頭が……クラクラする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Finally back... Urrh... So
dizzy...

fields.EN:
(I may have used too much blood...
But I can't let this hold me
back... I need to do my best...)
fields.JP:
（さすがに……血を使いすぎたかな……
　でも、このくらいでへばってちゃダメだ……
　もっと、頑張らないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I may have used too much blood...
But I can't let this hold me
back... I need to do my best...)

fields.EN:
(But I should... lie down or
something... I'm sure... I'll be
okay...)
fields.JP:
（と、とりあえず……少し横になって……
　そうすればきっと……大丈夫……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I should... lie down or
something... I'm sure... I'll be
okay...)

fields.EN:
(What...? I feel something... Is
this a dream...?)
fields.JP: （なんだろう……この感触……夢かな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What...? I feel something... Is
this a dream...?)

fields.JP:
（温かくて……落ち着くな……
　誰かが……頭を撫でてくれてるような……）

……あ……
僕……いつの間に眠って……？

fields.EN:
Wait... Nemurihime?! Wh-What
are you doing here?!
fields.JP:
って、やっぱり眠り姫！？
ど、どうしてここに……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Sleeping Beauty?! Wh-What
are you doing here?!

fields.EN:
(W-Was I sleeping on her lap
again?!)
fields.JP:
（し、しかも……
　また膝枕されてるし……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(W-Was I sleeping on her lap
again?!)

fields.EN:
(She was patting my head all this
time...? Wait... H-Her breasts
are... so close!)
fields.JP:
（ずっと頭を撫でてくれてたのか……

　ち、近い……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She was patting my head all this
time...? Wait... H-Her breasts
are... so close!)

fields.EN:
S-Sorry! I-I'm fine already... I
need to get up...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんね……！
も、もう大丈夫だから……早く起きないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry! I-I'm fine already... I
need to get up...

fields.JP:
眠り姫……？
どうしたの……？

fields.EN:
(Wh-What does she mean by that? Is
she telling me to stay put? B-But
her breasts...)
fields.JP:
（ど、どういう意味だろう…･･･？

fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What does she mean by that? Is
she telling me to stay put? B-But
her breasts...)

fields.EN:
Um... Why am I sleeping on your
lap? And... why do you look so
sad?
fields.JP:
その……どうして……膝枕を？
それに……なんで……
そんな悲しそうなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Why am I sleeping on your
lap? And... why do you look so
sad?

fields.EN:
Don't overdo... Jack... suffer...
means... I suffer, too...
fields.JP:
……むり……だめ……
ジャック……つらそう……
ボクも……つらい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't overdo... Jack... suffer...
means... I suffer, too...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... Guess I made you
worried again.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、眠り姫……
僕、また心配かけちゃってたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... Guess I made you
worried again.

fields.EN:
(I doubt I can sleep again with
how close her breasts are to my
face...)
fields.JP:
（む、胸が近すぎてドキドキして
　眠れそうにないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I doubt I can sleep again with
how close her breasts are to my
face...)

fields.EN:
I see! So, you want to know, do
you?! Very well! I shall tell you
an epic tale from the underground!
fields.JP:
そうかそうか……そんなに聞きたいか！
ならば話してやろう！
ワレの地下での活躍ぶりをな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see! So, you want to know, do
you?! Very well! I shall tell you
an epic tale from the underground!

fields.EN:
(I-Is that Hameln? Who is she
talking to?)
fields.JP:
（い、今の声は……ハーメルン？
　誰と話してるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I-Is that Hameln? Who is she
talking to?)

fields.EN:
What honesty! I am quite moved!
Praise thee!
fields.JP:
素直な奴じゃな、実に感心！！
褒めてつかわすぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What honesty! I am quite moved!
Praise thee!

fields.EN:
Let's see... I shall first explain
to you how the Marchens feared
and refeered me... Wait...
fields.JP:
そうじゃな……まずはワレがいかに
メルヒェンどもに恐れられ、
うまやわわれ……あれ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... I shall first explain
to you how the Marchens feared
and refeered me... Wait...

fields.EN:
Indeed! Revere! The Marchens
byowed... bowed at the mere sight
of me!
fields.JP:
そうそう、尊敬！　それじゃ！
ワレが道を歩いただけで連中は
ひれふしゅ……ひれ伏せておったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! Revere! The Marchens
byowed... bowed at the mere sight
of me!

fields.EN:
(She's actually listening to
her...? It even looks like she's
enjoying the conversation...)
fields.JP:
（ちゃ、ちゃんと聞いてる……！？
　しかも、わりと楽しそう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's actually listening to
her...? It even looks like she's
enjoying the conversation...)

fields.EN:
Very good, indeed! The others
don't appreciate my blessed words
as you have...
fields.JP:
お主のリアクションは素直でよいな！
他の者どもは、ワレがせっかく話しておるのに、
全然まともに聞こうとしないのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good, indeed! The others
don't appreciate my blessed words
as you have...

fields.EN:
How unfortunate, as my tales are
quite interesting, and... Ah...
Aaah...?!
fields.JP:
ワレの冒険談はたいそう面白いというのに……
っと……おっとと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unfortunate, as my tales are
quite interesting, and... Ah...
Aaah...?!

fields.JP: お、おわわ……バランスが崩れ……

fields.EN:
Ah... Ah, thank you... You saved
me! What a brave princess you are!
fields.JP:
お……おお、すまん……
貴様のおかげで救われたぞ！
なんと勇敢な姫であろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Ah, thank you... You saved
me! What a brave princess you are!

fields.EN:
(I'm surprised how well they get
along... It's almost as if they're
long-time friends...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだか意外と相性が良いというか……
　仲良さそうに見えてきたぞ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised how well they get
along... It's almost as if they're
long-time friends...)

fields.EN:
Ahem! Now then, allow me to
continue. Hm?
fields.JP:
ごほん！　
……では、話を続けるか。
……む？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahem! Now then, allow me to
continue. Hm?

fields.EN:
(Shoot! She's starting to doze
off! Hameln isn't going to like
this...!)
fields.JP:
（げっ！　う、うとうとしてる！？
　まずい、ハーメルンが怒ったら……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot! She's starting to doze
off! Hameln isn't going to like
this...!)

fields.EN:
Worry not. Come and lean upon me.
How calm and happy you look when
you are asleep...
fields.JP:
そう遠慮せずに、ワレにもたれよ。
気持ち良さそうに眠りおってからに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worry not. Come and lean upon me.
How calm and happy you look when
you are asleep...

fields.EN:
(She's not mad about it? Actually,
it looks like Hameln is happy to
be leaned on...)
fields.JP:
（怒らない……！？
　それどころか、わりと嬉しそうにもたれ
　かからせてる！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not mad about it? Actually,
it looks like Hameln is happy to
be leaned on...)

fields.EN:
(Huh... I didn't expect the two of
them to be like that...)
fields.JP:
（へえ……なんだか、
　二人の意外な一面を見たなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh... I didn't expect the two of
them to be like that...)

fields.EN:
I'm a bit surprised seeing you
treating her so nicely like that!
fields.JP:
君っていいとこあるんだね……
ちょっとびっくりしちゃったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a bit surprised seeing you
treating her so nicely like that!

fields.EN:
Shhh! Quiet, you fool! Are you
trying to wake the princess from
her slumber?!
fields.JP:
しーーーっ！！
大きな声を出すな！　姫を起こす気か！？
この愚か者めが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shhh! Quiet, you fool! Are you
trying to wake the princess from
her slumber?!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable! Why, I should have
expected someone like you to
lack such tact!
fields.JP:
まったく……！！
これだから無神経な輩は……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable! Why, I should have
expected someone like you to
lack such tact!

fields.EN:
(Um, but her voice is louder than
mine...)
fields.JP:
（で、でも……今の大声の方が
　起きちゃうんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Um, but her voice is louder than
mine...)

fields.EN:
(That's right... Gretel told me to
come to her room when I have the
time.)
fields.JP:
（そういえばグレーテルに、時間があったら
　部屋に来てって言われてたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... Gretel told me to
come to her room when I have the
time.)

fields.EN: (I wonder what she wants with me.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wonder what she wants with me.)

fields.JP: 僕だよ、ジャックだけど……

fields.EN: What did you want with me?
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you want with me?

fields.JP: （えっ？　突然何の話なんだろう？）
ええと……興味深いって、どのへん？

fields.EN:
There are a number of facilities
here with no substantial value
other than enriching one's life.
fields.JP:
何をする訳でもない、ただ生きるだけのために、
いくつもの施設がある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a number of facilities
here with no substantial value
other than enriching one's life.

fields.EN:
Each seems logically designed,
but their lack of cohesiveness
appears to go unnoticed.
fields.JP:
それぞれが一見合理的な設計をされているように
見えて、実はバラバラに存在しているだけ。
そして誰もそのことに頓着していないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each seems logically designed,
but their lack of cohesiveness
appears to go unnoticed.

fields.EN:
Despite having such complicated
facilities in the Jail, no one has
even the slightest concern.
fields.JP:
ここまで複雑に入り組んだものをジェイルの中に
作っておきながら、みな無意識にそれぞれを行き
来して暮らしている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite having such complicated
facilities in the Jail, no one has
even the slightest concern.

fields.EN:
(I guess how the people live
here seems peculiar to Gretel.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりグレーテルには、人間の暮らしって
　変なものに見えるのかなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess how the people live
here seems peculiar to Gretel.)

fields.EN:
To add, the humans here follow
abstract rules without question
and coexist under an order.
fields.JP:
それに、ここには多くの人間が存在するのに、
意味のわからない細かな規則に無批判に従って
統制され、共存しているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, the humans here follow
abstract rules without question
and coexist under an order.

fields.EN:
Everything here is quite
interesting. I'm glad I came here.
fields.JP:
どれもこれも興味深いことよ。
ここに来て良かったと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everything here is quite
interesting. I'm glad I came here.

fields.JP:
そ、そうかな？
ええと……ありがとう……？

fields.EN:
(Why am I thanking her? Wait...
Was she actually praising?)
fields.JP:
（……って、僕がお礼を言うようなことだっけ？
　ていうか、今のって褒めてたの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why am I thanking her? Wait...
Was she actually praising?)

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... You're quite
interesting as well.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
あなたもとても興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... You're quite
interesting as well.

fields.EN:
Yes. Your blood... is quite
interesting.
fields.JP:
そう。あなたのその血。
とても気になるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Your blood... is quite
interesting.

fields.EN:
Ah, but don't worry. I'm not
planning anything that would
be dangerous.
fields.JP:
ああ、心配要らないわ。
危ないことなんかしないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but don't worry. I'm not
planning anything that would
be dangerous.

fields.EN:
(But that would mean she's
planning something...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But that would mean she's
planning something...)

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I hope this will all
go well, Jack.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
よろしくね、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I hope this will all
go well, Jack.

fields.EN:
(She's interested in my blood?
I can already feel the danger...)
fields.JP:
（血が気になるって……やっぱり身の危険しか
　感じないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's interested in my blood?
I can already feel the danger...)

fields.EN:
I can't get used to these
utensils... Spoons, chopsticks,
whatnots...
fields.JP:
どうにも慣れないのよ。
この『スプーン』だとか『ハシ』だとかいう
道具にはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't get used to these
utensils... Spoons, chopsticks,
whatnots...

fields.EN:
Then how were you eating your food
before?
fields.JP:
慣れないって、
今までどうやって食事していたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then how were you eating your food
before?

fields.EN: Why, with my hands of course.
fields.JP: あら。私には手があるもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Why, with my hands of course.

fields.EN:
Huh... It sounds pretty crude,
eating with your bare hands.
fields.JP: へえ。手づかみだなんて粗野ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... It sounds pretty crude,
eating with your bare hands.

fields.EN:
Crude? What do you mean by
"crude?"
fields.JP:
粗野？
粗野って、どういう意味かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Crude? What do you mean by
"crude?"

fields.JP: えっ、それ本気で言ってるわけ？

どうしたの、赤ずきんさん？
楽しそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with the cheer, Red Riding
Hood?
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I got me some dessert today!
fields.JP: 今日はデザート貰ったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I got me some dessert today!

fields.JP:
……デザート？
デザートとはどういうものなの？

fields.EN: Desserts are food stuff like this!
fields.JP: デザートってのはね、こーゆうやつ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Desserts are food stuff like this!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! I got them as a gift
after I finished a mission out in
the city!
fields.JP:
へっへっへ！
街でさ、一仕事したらお礼にくれたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! I got them as a gift
after I finished a mission out in
the city!

fields.EN:
I don't like working, but sweets
are always welcome in my book.
fields.JP: 働くのは嫌ですけど、甘いものはほしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't like working, but sweets
are always welcome in my book.

fields.EN:
Um, please work... Uh, but I only
got one. Sorry, folks.
fields.JP:
いや、あんたはちょっとは働きなよ……。
ていうか、一個しかないんだ。
ごめんねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, please work... Uh, but I only
got one. Sorry, folks.

fields.EN:
Fine... I'm going to scab off of
someone else.
fields.JP: 誰かにねだってくるからいいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'm going to scab off of
someone else.

fields.EN:
So, you only have one... If so,
I'll just gaze at it.
fields.JP:
そう……ひとつしかないのね。
それなら私は眺めているだけでいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you only have one... If so,
I'll just gaze at it.

fields.EN:
(I wonder if that's how she
researches things...)
fields.JP: （これも「研究」の一環なのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if that's how she
researches things...)

fields.EN:
That looks delicious...
I might be a little jealous.
fields.JP:
おいしそうです……
ちょっとうらやましいかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
That looks good... Snow White is a
little envious...

fields.EN:
(That's not an expression I see
every day. She looks a bit more
childish than usual...)
fields.JP:
（なんか、あんまり見たことない表情だな。
　いつもと違って、子供みたいな顔っていうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's not an expression I see
every day. She looks a bit more
childish than usual...)

fields.EN:
Honeycomb toffee... I've heard
about it before. I believe it uses
a rare ingredient called "sugar."
fields.JP:
カルメ焼き……聞いたことがあるわ。
そう、原料の砂糖はとても貴重な素材のはず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honeycomb toffee... I've heard
about it before. I believe it uses
a rare ingredient called "sugar."

fields.EN:
You know about sweets, Gretel-san?
Do you like sweets?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、お菓子に詳しいんですね！
お好きなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know about sweets, Gretel?
Do you like sweets?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Why, yes. If I didn't have self-
restraint, I would have taken that
from her for my own satisfaction.
fields.JP:
ええ。私に理性がなかったら、
とっくに奪い取って残らず食べているところよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. If I didn't have self-
restraint, I would have taken that
from her for my own satisfaction.

fields.EN:
I guess that's just how much you
like sweets...
fields.JP: そ、そんなに好きなんですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that's just how much you
like sweets...

fields.EN:
Urgh... H-How about I give you
half, then?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh... H-How about I give you
half, then?

fields.EN:
I'm a bit irritated to be offered
crumbs, but I'm not sure how much
longer I can contain my urge...
fields.JP:
あなたにお情けを頂戴するのは癪に触るけど、
いつまでこの衝動を抑えていられるか
わからないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a bit irritated to be offered
crumbs, but I'm not sure how much
longer I can contain my urge...

fields.EN:
That doesn't sound much like
someone giving thanks...
fields.JP:
それ、人に感謝する時の言葉ではないと
思うのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't sound much like
someone giving thanks...

fields.JP: では、一口いただくわね

fields.EN:
(I haven't seen a smile like that
before!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't seen a smile like that
before!)

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you can smile like
that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you can smile like
that...

fields.EN:
What is this sensation I feel
percolating inside me? It's
melting away all my desires...
fields.JP:
何かしらこの感覚……
身体の奥底からわき上がってくるの……
あらゆる衝動が溶けてゆくわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is this sensation I feel
percolating inside me? It's
melting away all my desires...

fields.EN:
Ah, I see... So this is my Blood 
Libido...
fields.JP:
……ああ、これが……
これが私の血式リビドーなのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see... So this is my Blood 
Libido...

fields.EN:
I'm happy to know you're enjoying
it... Hahaha...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなに喜んでもらえてよかったよ……
あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy to know you're enjoying
it... Hahaha...

fields.EN:
Huh? So sweets are what we need
to keep you down, then.
fields.JP: へー、お菓子で釣れるのね、あんた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? So sweets are what we need
to keep you down, then.

fields.EN:
If Gretel-san can enjoy sweets like
that, then she must be a nice
person.
fields.JP:
でも……お菓子で素直に喜べるんですから、
グレーテルさんって、いい人なんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Gretel can enjoy sweets like
that, then she must be a nice
person.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP:
（みんなと馴染みにくいかなと思ってたけど、
　案外すんなりとけ込めそうかも……）
ふふ……なんていう恍惚感かしら……

fields.EN:
(Whoops... Looks like I disturbed
her reading...)
fields.JP: （って、本を読むのに夢中になってるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoops... Looks like I disturbed
her reading...)

fields.EN:
Ah, welcome. You can sit anywhere
over there.
fields.JP:
ああ、いらっしゃい。
そのへんにどうぞお座りなさいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, welcome. You can sit anywhere
over there.

fields.JP: あの……何を読んでいるの？

fields.EN:
Jack, let me ask you this... What
is the biggest problem in making
sweets?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック。
ここでお菓子を作るのに最大の問題は
なんだと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, let me ask you this... What
is the biggest problem in making
sweets?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Not having the right
cooking tools and utensils?
fields.JP: うーん、調理器具が足りないことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Not having the right
cooking tools and utensils?

fields.EN:
It's that the ingredients are hard
to come by.
fields.JP: 原料が手に入りにくいってことなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's that the ingredients are hard
to come by.

fields.EN:
I thought it would be easier to
make the ingredients myself, so
I began researching it, but...
fields.JP:
それなら原料そのものから作ればいいと思って、
研究しているのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it would be easier to
make the ingredients myself, so
I began researching it, but...

fields.EN:
(It's pretty extreme, wanting to
make the ingredients, but I guess
she really does like sweets.)
fields.JP:
（原料から作ればいいって、
　強引だけど、それだけ好きなんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's pretty extreme, wanting to
make the ingredients, but I guess
she really does like sweets.)

fields.EN:
Huh? You're not going to read
that anymore?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You're not going to read
that anymore?

fields.EN:
Correct. It's time now for me to
read research reports.
fields.JP: ええ。レポートを読んで研究する時間よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct. It's time now for me to
read research reports.

fields.EN:
(That's... a report that the
Professor wrote.)
fields.JP: （これは……博士の書いたレポートだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's... a report that the
Professor wrote.)

fields.EN:
(And that's... What is that? It
looks like a difficult read...)
fields.JP:
（こっちは……？
　なんだろ？　この小難しい内容の本……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And that's... What is that? It
looks like a difficult read...)

fields.EN:
You're able to change gears pretty
quickly. Don't sweets come to mind
every so often?
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと切り換えが早いんだね。
お菓子のこと、つい考えちゃったりしないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're able to change gears pretty
quickly. Don't sweets come to mind
every so often?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It's only obvious that
I can control my Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
血式リビドーくらい、制御できて当然でしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It's only obvious that
I can control my Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
Losing oneself to Blood Libido is
no different from someone
indulging in orgasm.
fields.JP:
血式リビドーに負けるということは、
のべつまくなしに自慰をしているようなものだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Losing oneself to Blood Libido is
no different from someone
indulging in orgasm.

fields.EN:
Um, uh... What...? Are you sure
about that...?
fields.JP: えっ、えっと、そ……そういうものなのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, uh... What...? Are you sure
about that...?

fields.EN:
Why the blushing? Ah, that's
right. Show me your arm. Your
blood should be flowing well now.
fields.JP:
何を赤くなっているの？
あ、ちょうどいいわ。腕を出して頂戴。
そんなに血の巡りがいいんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why the blushing? Ah, that's
right. Show me your arm. Your
blood should be flowing well now.

fields.EN: What are you planning on doing?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you planning on doing?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Why, I'm going to
draw your blood, of course.
fields.JP: ふふ。血を抜くにきまってるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Why, I'm going to
draw your blood, of course.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Don't worry. I have
the proper tools with me. This
will be my first time using them.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
道具はあるから心配要らないわよ。
やるのは初めてだけどね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Don't worry. I have
the proper tools with me. This
will be my first time using them.

fields.EN: There's a lot to worry about!
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a lot to worry about!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised Miko-san actually let
you borrow all those tools.
fields.JP: 大体そんな道具、視子さんがよく貸してくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised Miko actually let
you borrow all those tools.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Easy...? Wait... You took them
without her approval?!
fields.JP: 楽勝って……勝手に持ち出してきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Easy...? Wait... You took them
without her approval?!

fields.EN:
Well now, if we can't get your
blood, how about I examine your
pupils? I have tools for that.
fields.JP:
そうねえ、採血がだめなら、
瞳孔の検査をしましょう。
そっちの道具もあるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, if we can't get your
blood, how about I examine your
pupils? I have tools for that.

fields.EN:
Um, no! I-I have something to do,
so I'll see you!
fields.JP: い、いや、僕は用事があるからこの辺で……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, no! I-I have something to do,
so I'll see you!

fields.EN:
Oh, really? Too bad for me. You
are quite an interesting specimen,
after all.
fields.JP:
そう……残念ね……
これほど興味深い研究対象もないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really? Too bad for me. You
are quite an interesting specimen,
after all.

fields.EN:
(I suppose her research is all for
a reason...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、何でも研究したがるのも、
　ちゃんと理由があってのことなんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose her research is all for
a reason...)

fields.EN:
(I'm starting to wonder that maybe
her inquisitiveness and curiosity
is her real Blood Libido.)
fields.JP:
（……む、むしろ、その知的好奇心のほうが
　グレーテルの『血式リビドー』なんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm starting to wonder that maybe
her inquisitiveness and curiosity
is her real Blood Libido.)

fields.EN:
(In any case, I'll have to be
careful...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In any case, I'll have to be
careful...)

fields.JP: （あれ？　あそこにいるの、グレーテル？）

fields.EN:
Gretel? Are you looking for
something?
fields.JP:
グレーテル！
何か探しているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel? Are you looking for
something?

fields.JP: 別に、そんなのではないわ

fields.EN:
But it looked like you were
looking around a bit...
fields.JP: あちこち見回していた様子だったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it looked like you were
looking around a bit...

fields.EN:
Why, yes. I was simply observing
the people here.
fields.JP: ええ、人間を観察していたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. I was simply observing
the people here.

fields.EN:
Did you find someone worth
observing?
fields.JP: 観察するような興味深い人間がいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you find someone worth
observing?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Not in particular, but
each one of these people here is
refreshing to watch.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。誰か個人のことではないわ。
ここの人間はとても新鮮ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Not in particular, but
each one of these people here is
refreshing to watch.

fields.EN:
Much better than the ones who
barged into my home...
fields.JP:
そういえば……
あの家にいたころ、そこに勝手に入ってきた
人間たちの言動ときたらなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Much better than the ones who
barged into my home...

fields.EN:
(Home... Is she referring to the
Dorm?)
fields.JP:
（あの家って……
　『旧学生街エリア』のことか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Home... Is she referring to the
Dorm?)

fields.EN:
Cowards with a smidgen of hope,
who succumbed to fear and in the
end, were engulfed in despair.
fields.JP:
微かな希望と臆病さが入り交じり、それはやがて
恐怖に変わると、すぐに諦めとなって……
最後には絶望に終わるの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cowards with a smidgen of hope,
who succumbed to fear and in the
end, were engulfed in despair.

fields.EN:
There were also those who tried
to kill me the moment they saw
my frail figure.
fields.JP:
……私が弱々しそうに見えたのね、
真っ先に私を殺そうと向かってきた人間もいたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were also those who tried
to kill me the moment they saw
my frail figure.

fields.EN:
Did you really go through
something like that?!
fields.JP: そんな目にも遭ってたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you really go through
something like that?!

fields.EN:
Why, yes. But Hansel-niisan
would always help me in those
instances.
fields.JP:
ええ。
いつもヘンゼル兄さんが助けてくれたけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. But my brother, Hansel,
would always help me in those
instances.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP:
助けるって、それはつまり、その……
その人たちは……

fields.EN:
They all died. Every last one of
them.
fields.JP: 死んだわよ。一人残らず
fields.LOCALIZED:
They all died. Every last one of
them.

fields.EN:
Why do humans fight fate, despite
knowing their chance of victory is
close to nil?
fields.JP:
客観的に勝率ゼロに等しい状況下であっても、
人間はなぜ戦い、その運命に抗おうとするの
かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why do humans fight fate, despite
knowing their chance of victory is
close to nil?

fields.JP: うん。なにか言い争ってるね

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Their actions are
identical to the ones who invaded
my home.
fields.JP:
……ふふふ。
あの人たちの言動、私の家に入ってきた人間たち
と同じだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Their actions are
identical to the ones who invaded
my home.

fields.EN:
Humans look for reasons to
maintain their lives, even if
their lives serve no purpose.
fields.JP:
人間は、自身の人生に特別な意義を持たなくても
原始的生命存続そのものに、価値を見いだして
いるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humans look for reasons to
maintain their lives, even if
their lives serve no purpose.

fields.EN:
They cling with such tenacity...
I suppose that's how they're able
to live as long as they do.
fields.JP:
だからだわ。
あれほどの執念と情念とでもって、
生き延びるために生き延びようとするのは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They cling with such tenacity...
I suppose that's how they're able
to live as long as they do.

fields.EN:
Why are you saying that with so
much joy?
fields.JP: どうして君は、そんなことを楽しそうに話すの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you saying that with so
much joy?

fields.EN:
Is it wrong to try and live? Do
you hate humans?
fields.JP:
生き延びることは悪いことなの？
君は、人間が嫌いなの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it wrong to try and live? Do
you hate humans?

fields.EN:
Let me ask you this... Why are you
interpreting my words in that way?
fields.JP:
……どうしてあなたはそのような捉え方を
するの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me ask you this... Why are you
interpreting my words in that way?

fields.EN:
I was simply praising how humans
vigorously fight for life.
fields.JP:
私は人間の旺盛な生命力を買っているのよ。
私は人間を褒めているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was simply praising how humans
vigorously fight for life.

fields.EN:
But the way you worded it is just
horrible...
fields.JP: でも、そんな言い方、あんまりだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the way you worded it is just
horrible...

fields.EN:
Jack... It seems as if you're
easily swayed by your emotions.
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたって、表面的な感情に囚われすぎている
のではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... It seems as if you're
easily swayed by your emotions.

fields.EN: If killing someone is necessary to survive, I won't hesitate. Whether the other party is human or not, that truth doesn't change.
fields.JP:
生き延びるために必要であれば、相手を殺すこと
も厭わない。それは人間であろうとなかろうと、
変わりのない真実なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Survival means doing anything to
live, even killing someone. That's
true of all living beings.

fields.EN:
(Is she holding a grudge against
us for killing Hansel...?)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、グレーテルはヘンゼルを殺された
　ことを恨んでいるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she holding a grudge against
us for killing Hansel...?)

fields.EN:
(She still calls that area her
home, too... I guess the Dawn
isn't her home...)
fields.JP:
（あの場所をいまだに『家』と呼んでるし……
　黎明はいまだに、グレーテルの『家』じゃ
　ないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She still calls that area her
home, too... I guess the Dawn
isn't her home...)

fields.EN: Oh? And where are you going?
fields.JP:
あら？
どこへ行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? And where are you going?

fields.EN:
It seems I'm missing something
critical, after all...
fields.JP:
私にはやはり、
何か欠けているものがあるのかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I'm missing something
critical, after all...

fields.EN:
If so, what is this odd feeling I
have deep inside me?
fields.JP:
だとすれば……
この胸の底に小さくわだかまっているものは何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, what is this odd feeling I
have deep inside me?

fields.EN:
Do you know what this feeling is,
Jack?
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたはそれを知っているの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you know what this feeling is,
Jack?

fields.EN:
(It's been hard to look at Gretel
after I ran off from our
conversation like that...)
fields.JP:
（あんなこと聞いて逃げてきちゃったし、
　いまさら会いに行くのも気が重いなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been hard to look at Gretel
after I ran off from our
conversation like that...)

fields.EN:
(But I need to clear the air with
her somehow...)
fields.JP: （でも、誤解があるなら解いておかないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I need to clear the air with
her somehow...)

fields.EN:
What are you doing over there,
Jack?
fields.JP:
そこで何をしているの？
ジャック……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing over there,
Jack?

fields.EN:
Did you come to see me? If so,
you should have gone in..
fields.JP:
私の部屋に入るつもりだったの？
それなら入ればいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you come to see me? If so,
you should have gone in..

fields.EN:
I can't just go inside without
your permission.
fields.JP:
そんな！
勝手に入る訳にはいかないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't just go inside without
your permission.

fields.EN: Oh? I go wherever I want, anytime.
fields.JP:
そう？
私なら、入りたい時には勝手に入るわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? I go wherever I want, anytime.

fields.EN:
(That's disturbing to hear... I'd
better lock my door when I step
out...)
fields.JP:
（あっさり言ってるし……
　部屋を出る時は鍵かけておかなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's disturbing to hear... I'd
better lock my door when I step
out...)

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel...? I'm sorry I left in
the middle of our conversation
before...
fields.JP:
グレーテル。その……
この間は話の途中で勝手に帰ってごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel...? I'm sorry I left in
the middle of our conversation
before...

fields.EN:
Conversation? Ah, that. I thought
you maybe had a stomachache.
fields.JP:
話の途中で？
……ああ、あの時のこと。
急にお腹でも壊したのかと思ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Conversation? Ah, that. I thought
you maybe had a stomachache.

fields.EN:
See?! You keep saying things to
provoke others! That's why
everyone misunderstands you!
fields.JP:
君はそうやってすぐ皮肉っぽく茶化すから
誤解されるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See?! You keep saying things to
provoke others! That's why
everyone misunderstands you!

fields.EN:
And you also seem to get emotional
all the time.
fields.JP: あなたもそうやってすぐに感情的になるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you also seem to get emotional
all the time.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I suppose my comment
just now came from emotion, too.
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
私の今の言い方も、感情的だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I suppose my comment
just now came from emotion, too.

fields.EN:
(Huh? It's pretty unusual for her
to apologize...)
fields.JP:
（え？
　グレーテルが謝るなんて、珍しいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? It's pretty unusual for her
to apologize...)

fields.EN:
I was thinking afterward... How I
lack understanding of human
emotions.
fields.JP:
あのあと、考えたのよ。
私にはやっぱり何かが欠けていて、人間の感情に
対する理解や共感が足りないみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was thinking afterward... How I
lack understanding of human
emotions.

fields.JP: それは……そうかもしれないけど、でも……

fields.EN:
But, you tried to understand us,
which is why you're with us now...
fields.JP:
でも君は理解しようとしてくれてるし、
実際僕たちのことを考えて行動してくれてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you tried to understand us,
which is why you're with us now...

fields.EN: Or, at least that's what I hope.
fields.LOCALIZED: Or, at least that's what I hope.

fields.EN: Maybe that's because your pure curiosity drives you to pursue the principles behind human behavior and the roots of emotion...!
fields.JP:
それは多分、君の純粋な好奇心が、人間の
行動原理とか感情の根っことかを追求してて
……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think the emotions you're
looking for come from a primal,
human curiosity.

fields.EN:
That curiosity makes you want to
know and understand others.
fields.JP:
それはきっと……
君が対象をきちんと理解したいからなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That curiosity makes you want to
know and understand others.

fields.EN:
But the way you analyze things
comes across as cold, which is
why others see you as uncaring...
fields.JP:
でも、冷静に分析しようとするあまり、
周りには冷たく見えてしまうだけなんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the way you analyze things
comes across as cold, which is
why others see you as uncaring...

fields.EN: Wait... Um, what was my point?
fields.JP:
って、あれ？
……僕は何を言いたいんだっけ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait... Um, what was my point?

fields.EN:
Anyway... I'm sure you just want
to get to know and understand
others!
fields.JP:
だからつまり……君はちゃんと相手のことを
理解したがってるんだよ……きっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway... I'm sure you just want
to get to know and understand
others!

fields.EN:
Quite interesting... You truly are
a fascinating specimen.
fields.JP:
面白いことを考えるのね。
やっぱりあなたは大変興味深い研究対象だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite interesting... You truly are
a fascinating specimen.

fields.EN:
(Finally, it looks like I got
through to her.)
fields.JP: （……どうにか、ちゃんと話せてよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Finally, it looks like I got
through to her.)

fields.EN:
Wait... Hold on there! What's that
in your hand?!
fields.JP:
……って！　ちょっと待ってよ！
その手に持っているのは……何！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Hold on there! What's that
in your hand?!

fields.EN: Why, it's a syringe, of course.
fields.LOCALIZED: Why, it's a syringe, of course.

fields.EN:
I know that! I'm asking you why
you pulled it out!
fields.JP:
それはわかってるよ！
なんでそんなものを持ち出してきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that! I'm asking you why
you pulled it out!

fields.EN:
You seem very excited. Wouldn't
your increased blood flow make this
the best time to draw a sample?
fields.JP:
あら、だっていい具合に興奮してきて
血行も良くなってることだし、
今日はうまく採れると思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem very excited. Wouldn't
your increased blood flow make this
the best time to draw a sample?

fields.EN:
I see. Well. After all I did to
procure those things from Miko-san...
fields.JP:
そう……
視子さんのとこからいろいろ調達してきたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well. After all I did to
procure those things from Miko...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you took more stuff
from her again!
fields.JP: また勝手に持ち出してきたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you took more stuff
from her again!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I have an interest in
tools, too.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
人間だけでなく、道具にだって興味はあるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I have an interest in
tools, too.

fields.EN:
And the only way to observe the
value of a tool is to use it.
Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
そして道具なら、使ってみて初めてその真価が
わかるというものでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the only way to observe the
value of a tool is to use it.
Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
W-Well, sure, but...! No, you're
absolutely right! So, then... See
you!
fields.JP:
う、うん、そうだね！
ほんとその通りだよね！
じゃ……またね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, sure, but...! No, you're
absolutely right! So, then... See
you!

fields.EN:
Oh? He's in such a hurry... I
wouldn't have minded conversing
with him further.
fields.JP:
あら……もう少し話していたかったのに、
せっかちなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? He's in such a hurry... I
wouldn't have minded conversing
with him further.

fields.EN:
Well... I suppose what he said is
right.
fields.JP:
……まあ、そうね。
ジャックの言う通りなのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I suppose what he said is
right.

fields.EN:
But what could I do to appear less
cold to others?
fields.JP:
もう少し冷淡に見えないようにするには、
どうすればいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what could I do to appear less
cold to others?

fields.EN: Maybe I could send a gift?
fields.JP: 贈り物でもしてみようかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe I could send a gift?

fields.EN:
I know. I'll make some sweets.
Hm... Pudding... That sounds good.
I've read a recipe already, so...
fields.JP:
そう、何か甘いお菓子でも作ってみましょう。
プリン？　いいわね。
作り方の本はこの間読んだことだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. I'll make some sweets.
Hm... Pudding... That sounds good.
I've read a recipe already, so...

fields.EN:
(*yawn*... What time is it...?
Maybe I'll get something to drink
before heading back to bed...)
fields.JP:
（ふああ……変な時間に起きちゃったな……
　何か飲んでまた寝よう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(*yawn*... What time is it...?
Maybe I'll get something to drink
before heading back to bed...)

fields.EN:
I see. Your theory is quite
interesting. We should dissect the
sample to verify it.
fields.JP:
なるほど。その仮説は興味深いね。
ぜひサンプルを解体して検査してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Your theory is quite
interesting. We should dissect the
sample to verify it.

fields.EN:
Oh, but dissection is meaningless.
Isn't there a way to observe
blood flow without killing it?
fields.JP:
あら。解体してしまっては無意味だと思うわ。
生きた状態での血液循環から、どうにか
観察できないものかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but dissection is meaningless.
Isn't there a way to observe
blood flow without killing it?

fields.JP: （あれ？　博士とグレーテルだ）

fields.EN: So unless the blood is circulating while the subject remains alive, you can't obtain precise data—is that what you're saying?
fields.JP:
……つまり、個体の生命活動が保たれた状態での
血液循環でなければ、厳密なデータは揃わないと
いうことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, are you saying you need the
sample to be alive in order to
acquire the proper data?

fields.EN:
Why, yes. It's structured
differently from humans, but mere
blood clots wouldn't do us good.
fields.JP:
ええ。人間とは構造が異なるのだもの。
ただの血糊では駄目
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. It's structured
differently from humans, but mere
blood clots wouldn't do us good.

fields.EN:
(I feel a bit uneasy hearing the
words "dissect" and "blood clot"
coming from them...)
fields.JP:
（『解体』だの『血糊』だの、物騒な言葉が
　聞こえてくるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a bit uneasy hearing the
words "dissect" and "blood clot"
coming from them...)

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right. I'll get
started right away.
fields.JP: 一理あるね。早速試してみようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right. I'll get
started right away.

fields.EN:
(The Professor's leaving... I
guess he's going back to do more
research.)
fields.JP:
（あ、博士が帰ってく。
　これからまた研究なのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Professor's leaving... I
guess he's going back to do more
research.)

fields.EN:
You were talking about research
until this late?
fields.JP: こんなに夜遅くまで研究の話？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were talking about research
until this late?

fields.EN:
Why yes. Research in relation
to our... sample.
fields.JP: そうよ、研究。……サンプルのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. Research in relation
to our... sample.

fields.JP: サンプルって、もしかして……

fields.EN:
Yes. The blood of a captured
Marchen. We were discussing its
composition.
fields.JP:
ええ。捕えてきたメルヒェンの血液よ。
その成分について話をしていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The blood of a captured
Marchen. We were discussing its
composition.

fields.EN:
I shared my theory, but it stands
quite inferior to the Professor's
analysis and insight.
fields.JP:
私も仮説を立ててみたのだけれど、
さすがに博士の分析と洞察力には
一籌を輸する他ないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shared my theory, but it stands
quite inferior to the Professor's
analysis and insight.

fields.JP: ふふ。とても興味深いわ……

fields.EN:
(Interesting...? She's talking
about the Marchen blood, isn't
she?)
fields.JP: （興味深いって……メルヒェンの血液が？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Interesting...? She's talking
about the Marchen blood, isn't
she?)

fields.JP: （グレーテル……さすがに疲れてるのかな？）
そ……そうだ。ちょっと待ってて

fields.EN:
(Um... If no one touched it, it
should still be in the fridge...)
fields.JP:
（えーと……誰かに食べられてなければ、
　冷蔵庫のこの辺に……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Um... If no one touched it, it
should still be in the fridge...)

fields.EN:
You want it? I... happened to have
one.
fields.JP:
……これ、食べる？
あ。あの、偶然手に入ったものなんだけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want it? I... happened to have
one.

fields.EN:
The shape, the color, the aroma...
That's it, all right. And just as
I wanted to make some, too.
fields.JP:
この形、色つや、香り……
私が作ろうと思ったものと寸分違わない、
どこからどう見てもプリンのようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The shape, the color, the aroma...
That's it, all right. And just as
I wanted to make some, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I don't think it's
anything else but a pudding...
fields.JP:
うん……
プリン以外の何物でもないと思うよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I don't think it's
anything else but a pudding...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... It was soft of you to
bother bringing me anything.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
わざわざ私にこんなものを持ってくるなんて、
あなたも随分とお人好しなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... It was soft of you to
bother bringing me anything.

fields.EN:
(Huh? Did she say that she wanted
to make one?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？
　今さっきグレーテルも作ろうと思ったと
　言ってなかったっけ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Did she say that she wanted
to make one?)

fields.EN:
(How much longer is she going to
just stare at it?)
fields.JP: （……いつまで観察してるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How much longer is she going to
just stare at it?)

fields.EN: I'm glad to see you enjoying it.
fields.JP: ……喜んでもらえたみたいで、よかった
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad to see you enjoying it.

fields.EN:
Jack, why are you doing so much
for me?
fields.JP:
ジャック。
あなたは私のためにどうして
ここまでしてくれるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, why are you doing so much
for me?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Because I wanted to see
the expression on your face.
fields.JP:
うーん。
……そんな顔を見たかったから、かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Because I wanted to see
the expression on your face.

fields.EN:
My face? You seem to pay great
attention to my face...
fields.JP:
私の顔？
それくらいいつでも見ているはず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My face? You seem to pay great
attention to my face...

fields.EN:
You don't smile like that very
often, do you?
fields.JP: 君って、そんな風にはめったに笑わないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't smile like that very
often, do you?

fields.EN:
Yeah... It looks so natural on
you...
fields.JP: うん。なんか素直な感じっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It looks so natural on
you...

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... How surprising... I
didn't know I could express myself
this way. How did this come about?
fields.JP:
ふふふ。
不思議なものね、私にこんな顔ができるなんて。
どうやったらこうなるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... How surprising... I
didn't know I could express myself
this way. How did this come about?

fields.EN: It would be nice to always see it.
fields.JP: いつもそういう顔、してればいいのに
fields.LOCALIZED: It would be nice to always see it.

fields.EN:
Because of you, my research has
shown great advancement. I'd like
to ask you to help me further.
fields.JP:
……ジャック、あなたのお陰で私の研究は
とても進展しているの。
これからも協力をお願いするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because of you, my research has
shown great advancement. I'd like
to ask you to help me further.

fields.JP: ……もちろん、研究対象としてね

fields.EN:
Urgh... Stop calling me a
specimen...
fields.JP: うう。研究対象って言うのはやめてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh... Stop calling me a
specimen...

fields.EN:
Let's see... I want to ask one
other question.
fields.JP: そうね。もう一つ聞きたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... I want to ask one
other question.

fields.EN:
I actually want to ask about that
brain of yours...
fields.JP:
私はむしろ、あんたの頭の中について
聞きたいわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I actually want to ask about that
brain of yours...

fields.EN:
Oh? So you find it interesting? I
would be more than happy to
speak about it.
fields.JP:
あら。興味を持ってくれるのね。
幾らでも話してあげるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So you find it interesting? I
would be more than happy to
speak about it.

fields.EN:
(It's unusual to see Gretel with
those three...)
fields.JP:
（……珍しいな。
　グレーテルがあの三人と一緒にいるなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's unusual to see Gretel with
those three...)

fields.EN:
Hey, guys, what are you talking
about?
fields.JP: やあみんな。何を話してるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, guys, what are you talking
about?

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack. I was conducting some
research on these three.
fields.JP:
あら、ジャック。
この子たちのことについて研究していたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack. I was conducting some
research on these three.

fields.EN:
Huh? This was research? Shirayuki
thought we were just having a
friendly conversation...
fields.JP:
えっ。研究だったんですか！？
白雪はてっきり、普通にお喋りしてるのかと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? This was research? Snow White
thought we were just having a
friendly conversation...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. What you said is
right, too.
fields.JP: 大丈夫よ。白雪の言ってることが正しいから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. What you said is
right, too.

fields.EN:
Oh? But all matters of data
acquisition are part of research.
fields.JP: あら。知識を得る行為の全ては研究よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But all matters of data
acquisition are part of research.

fields.EN:
Heh... So, causing trouble with
your research again?
fields.JP:
あはは。
また得意の『研究』で困らせているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... So, causing trouble with
your research again?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... How rude. I'm not
troubling any of them. Isn't that
right?
fields.JP:
ふふふ、失礼なこと言うわね。
困らせてなんかいないわよ。ねえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... How rude. I'm not
troubling any of them. Isn't that
right?

fields.EN:
*sigh* I can't believe how
confident you are in saying
that...
fields.JP:
はあ。
どこから出てくるのよ、その自信……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I can't believe how
confident you are in saying
that...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki enjoys speaking with
you, Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
白雪は……
グレーテルさんとのお喋り、楽しいですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White enjoys speaking with
you, Gretel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Say, Jack... Don't they possess
starkly different personalities
despite being sisters?
fields.JP:
ねえジャック。
この子たち、姉妹だと言うわりには、
性格が違いすぎていると思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack... Don't they possess
starkly different personalities
despite being sisters?

fields.EN:
True. But, I think that's what
makes them great as sisters.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
でもそれがいいんだと僕は思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. But, I think that's what
makes them great as sisters.

fields.EN:
Exactly. That's why researching
them is worthwhile. They are
wonderful specimens.
fields.JP:
その通りよ。
だからこそ研究のしがいがあるの。
大変興味深い検体だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. That's why researching
them is worthwhile. They are
wonderful specimens.

fields.EN:
Like I said a thousand times, stop
calling us "specimens."
fields.JP:
だーかーら。
検体って言うの、やめなさいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said a thousand times, stop
calling us "specimens."

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime is surprisingly keen
and adept at offering support
without calling attention to it.
fields.JP:
親指姫は意外と細かいことに気付くし、
それを誇示することはないけれど、
陰でフォローするのは得意に見えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina is surprisingly keen
and adept at offering support
without calling attention to it.

fields.EN:
But her actions don't always
match her intentions. She appears
to be putting up a strong front.
fields.JP:
ただし言動が意図するところと一致しないことが
あるように思えるわ。
そうね……企図せぬ敵対行為というのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But her actions don't always
match her intentions. She appears
to be putting up a strong front.

fields.EN:
Um... Are you trying to pick a
fight with me?
fields.JP:
……ねえ。
あんた、もしかして喧嘩売ってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Are you trying to pick a
fight with me?

fields.EN:
She could be antinomic by nature.
Or perhaps have difficulty in
expressing her affection.
fields.JP:
……思春期特有の二律背反かしら？
あるいは愛情表現が下手なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She could be antinomic by nature.
Or perhaps have difficulty in
expressing her affection.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama can be a
bit awkward sometimes. But she is
very kind.
fields.JP:
親指姉様は、ちょっと不器用ですからね。
でも、本当はとっても優しいんですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear Sister Thumbelina can be a
bit awkward sometimes. But she is
very kind.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Awkward... I see. A very accurate
description.
fields.JP: 不器用……そうね。適切な表現だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Awkward... I see. A very accurate
description.

fields.EN:
Th-Oyayubihime! They aren't saying
that to hurt you! They're, um...
praising you!
fields.JP:
お、親指姫！
二人とも悪気は無いんだよ！
褒めてる！　そうだよ！　むしろ褒めてる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thumbelina! They aren't saying
that to hurt you! They're, um...
praising you!

fields.EN:
Why, yes. Shirayukihime is a kind
person, after all. Your awkward
affection is precious to them.
fields.JP:
ええ。白雪姫は思いやりのあるいい子だもの。
不器用な愛情を姉妹に注ぐ親指姫を、
とても大切に思っているだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. Snow White is a kind
person, after all. Your awkward
affection is precious to them.

fields.EN: Oh, my... You're making Shirayuki blush...
fields.JP: そ、そう言われると……白雪、照れます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... You're making Snow
White blush...

fields.EN:
You also know that kindness can
become violent, and that's why you
hold back so much.
fields.JP:
……優しさが時に暴力になるということを
知っているし、だからこそ臆病になり、
全てを裡に抱え込んでしまうのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also know that kindness can
become violent, and that's why you
hold back so much.

fields.EN:
But what you should fear most
aren't mirrors or your childish
body stature.
fields.JP:
だけどあなたが恐れるべきは、鏡でも子供っぽい
身体のバランスでもないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what you should fear most
aren't mirrors or your childish
body stature.

fields.JP: や、やっぱり太ってます！？

fields.EN:
The kindness that makes you care
for others is the very thing that
eats away at you from the inside.
fields.JP:
まして、誰かを傷つけることでもない……
あなた自身の優しさが、あなたを裡から蝕む
ことじゃないのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The kindness that makes you care
for others is the very thing that
eats away at you from the inside.

fields.EN:
Uh, just so you know, you're not
going to leave here pretty if you
hurt Shirayuki, you hear?
fields.JP:
ちょっとあんたねえ。
白雪を傷つけたら承知しないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, just so you know, you're not
going to leave here pretty if you
hurt Snow White, you hear?

fields.EN:
Hurt? All I'm doing is stating my
observations of the situation.
fields.JP:
傷つける？
私は気付いた問題点を提示しているだけよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurt? All I'm doing is stating my
observations of the situation.

fields.EN:
(Uh, more like tossing grenades
left and right...)
fields.JP:
（むしろ、見境なく爆弾投げつけてるように
　見えるんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, more like tossing grenades
left and right...)

fields.EN:
As for Nemurihime, one would
assume she's being protected, but
in reality, she's protecting you.
fields.JP:
そうそう、眠り姫は見たところ寝てばかりね。
あなたたちに護られているようでいて護っている
面白い存在……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for Sleeping Beauty, one would
assume she's being protected, but
in reality, she's protecting you.

fields.EN:
Well, it's true that Nemu's like
that...
fields.JP:
まあ……確かにネムはそういうとこ、
あるのかもしれないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's true that Sleepy's like
that...

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, you really notice all kinds of
things... both the good and bad sides of us...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんって、実はいろいろ見てるん
ですね……
白雪たちの良いところも悪いところも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised by how observant
you are... It's like you know
everything about us, good and bad.

fields.EN:
Oh? But good and bad are one and
the same.
fields.JP:
あら。
美点と欠点なんて表裏のものじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? But good and bad are one and
the same.

fields.EN:
For example, I believe Nemurihime has already gone through
puberty.
fields.JP:
美点と欠点といえば……
眠り姫ときたら、もう育つ時期は過ぎたと
思うのだけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, I believe Sleeping
Beauty has already gone through
puberty.

fields.EN:
(Puberty...? Wh-What specifically
is she referring to...?)
fields.JP:
（それ以上育つって、な、なんのことを言ってる
　のかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Puberty...? Wh-What specifically
is she referring to...?)

fields.JP:
そ、育つ時期って……！
グレーテル！　あんたまさか……

fields.EN:
Wha-?! So, that is what I think it
means?!
fields.JP: ええっ！　やっぱりそういう意味なんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! So, that is what I think it
means?!

fields.EN:
What's to be flustered about? I'm
just sharing a biological analysis
of Nemurihime's...
fields.JP:
何を動揺しているのかしら？
私はただ、生物学的に眠り姫の……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's to be flustered about? I'm
just sharing a biological analysis
of Sleeping Beauty's...

fields.EN:
I can't believe how Nemurihime is able to sleep through
this like it's no biggie...
fields.JP:
こ、こんな状況でも寝ていられるなんて、
眠り姫って、結構大物なんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe how Sleeping
Beauty is able to sleep through
this like it's no biggie...

fields.EN:
Biggie?! I can't believe you
said that looking at...! You
pervert!
fields.JP:
『大物』って……
何を見て言ってるのよ！　この変態！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Biggie?! I can't believe you
said that looking at...! You
pervert!

fields.EN:
Oh? So you're interested in
such topics... are you, Jack?
fields.JP:
ふうん、そう。
ジャックはそちらに興味津々なのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So you're interested in
such topics... are you, Jack?

fields.EN:
Of course not! Hey! You're the
one who said something about
biology and stuff!
fields.JP:
そ、そんな訳ないだろ！？
グレーテルだってさっき『生物学的に』とか
言ってたじゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not! Hey! You're the
one who said something about
biology and stuff!

fields.JP: いやっ！　ジャックのくせに不潔よ！

fields.EN: I don't find you filthy at all.
fields.JP: あら、私は不潔だとは思わないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't find you filthy at all.

fields.EN:
It's even written that youths find
interest in well-developed chests
and hips, proof of maturity.
fields.JP:
年頃の男子が女子のよく発達した胸部や臀部に
興味を抱くのは、極めて自然で正常な発達段階に
ある証拠だと、書物にあったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's even written that youths find
interest in well-developed chests
and hips, proof of maturity.

fields.EN: What book did you get that from?
fields.JP: あんた、どこで何の本を読んで来たのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: What book did you get that from?

fields.EN:
Jack, you're free to continue your
observation of the Blood Maidens'
breasts.
fields.JP:
だからジャックは、これからも正々堂々と
私たち血式少女の胸……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you're free to continue your
observation of the Blood Maidens'
breasts.

fields.JP:
わー！！
もういい！　もういいから！！

fields.EN:
Jack-san, is that how you were looking at us
all this time...?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんってそういう目で白雪たちを
見ていたんですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were looking at us with that
in mind all this time...?

fields.EN:
Wake up and say something,
Nemurihime!
fields.JP: 眠り姫、寝てないでなんか言ってよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wake up and say something,
Sleeping Beauty!

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime and Oyayubihime, we may
encounter interesting results by
placing emphasis on your breasts.
fields.JP:
白雪姫、親指姫。
私たちももっと胸元を強調してみると、
更に面白い研究結果が出るかもしれないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White and Thumbelina, we may
encounter interesting results by
placing emphasis on your breasts.

fields.EN:
I read that underdeveloped parts
stimulate one's imagination,
another sign of a youth maturing.
fields.JP:
未発達の部位がむしろ想像力を刺激する場合も
あるということだし、そうした嗜好も広範的には
男子の発達段階に含まれるそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read that underdeveloped parts
stimulate one's imagination,
another sign of a youth maturing.

fields.JP: うわっ！　それますます変態じゃない！

fields.EN:
I suppose Shirayuki can give it a
try...
fields.JP: 白雪……試してみようかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose Snow White can give it a
try...

fields.JP: （お願い！　僕で遊ぶのやめて！）

fields.EN:
(Gretel said she needed to see me,
but... I wonder what it's about.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルが、用があるから来てって
　言ってたけど……何だろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel said she needed to see me,
but... I wonder what it's about.)

fields.EN:
I've been waiting for you. Now,
hurry.
fields.JP: 待っていたわ、早く入って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been waiting for you. Now,
hurry.

fields.EN:
I brought the Mary Gun like you
asked, but why do you need it?
fields.JP:
メアリガンも持ってきたけど、
こんなのどうするの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I brought the Mary Gun like you
asked, but why do you need it?

fields.JP:
……うるさいわね。
何なの、その大声？

fields.EN:
Clothes! Clothes! Why aren't you
wearing your clothes?!
fields.JP:
服！　服！
なんで服着てないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clothes! Clothes! Why aren't you
wearing your clothes?!

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? Because I took
them off, of course.
fields.JP:
……脱いだからにきまってるでしょう？
わかりきったことを聞かないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? Because I took
them off, of course.

fields.EN:
Oh? Why are you leaving? I'm
not done with you yet.
fields.JP:
あら？
ちょっと、なんで出て行こうとするの？
まだ用事は終わってないのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Why are you leaving? I'm
not done with you yet.

fields.EN:
Well then, at least put something
on! Anything!
fields.JP: そしたらせめて服を着て！　服を！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, at least put something
on! Anything!

fields.EN:
That I cannot do. It would make no
sense if my intention is to have
you splatter your blood on me.
fields.JP:
それは駄目ね。
あなたの血を私の身体にかけてもらおうと思って
呼んだのだから、服を着たら意味ないじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That I cannot do. It would make no
sense if my intention is to have
you splatter your blood on me.

fields.EN: What is this really all about?
fields.JP: ……なんでそんなこと思いついたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is this really all about?

fields.EN:
Your blood can neutralize a Blood
Maiden's Blood Skelter state.
fields.JP:
あなたの血にはブラッドスケルター化した
血式少女を鎮静化させる効果があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your blood can neutralize a Blood
Maiden's Blood Skelter state.

fields.EN:
I have a hypothesis on what takes
place when your blood covers one,
so I wish to evaluate the results.
fields.JP:
それなら、その血を全身いっぱいに浴びたら
どうなるのか、仮説を立ててみたの。
だから……検証したいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a hypothesis on what takes
place when your blood covers one,
so I wish to evaluate the results.

fields.EN: I don't think you need to do that!
fields.JP: その必要はないと思うよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think you need to do that!

fields.EN:
But unproven hypotheses
essentially equate to mere
imagination.
fields.JP:
あら。
実験によって検証されない理論は、ただの妄想に
過ぎないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But unproven hypotheses
essentially equate to mere
imagination.

fields.JP:
だめだよ！
離して！　グレーテル！！

fields.EN:
Heeeey! Quiet in there! What's
all this commo...tion...
fields.JP:
おーい、うるさいよ！
何騒いでんの、あんたらは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heeeey! Quiet in there! What's
all this commo...tion...

fields.EN:
(Dear lord, this is only going to
get worse...)
fields.JP: （ああっ、なんだかめんどくさいことに…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Dear lord, this is only going to
get worse...)

fields.EN:
Sorry... Um... I didn't realize
you two were so close...
fields.JP:
……悪い。
そういう仲だとは気付かなかったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry... Um... I didn't realize
you two were so close...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
No, don't worry. I won't say a
word, so you go back to... You
know.
fields.JP:
いや、いいって。気にしなくて大丈夫だからさ。
誰にも言わないから安心してよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, don't worry. I won't say a
word, so you go back to... You
know.

fields.EN: No! It's not what you think!
fields.JP: 違うから！　ぜんっぜん違うから！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! It's not what you think!

fields.EN:
If she joins us, we can observe
what happens when we both lick
the blood off of each other.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんにも混ざってもらいましょう。
みんなで血まみれになって、舐めあいっこしたら
どうなるか、実験するのにいい機会だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she joins us, we can observe
what happens when we both lick
the blood off of each other.

fields.EN:
An excellent idea, don't you
think?
fields.LOCALIZED:
An excellent idea, don't you
think?

fields.JP: そ、そうは思えないけど……

fields.EN: Um... Can I ask what you're doing?
fields.JP: ……あのさ。それであんたは何してるわけ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Can I ask what you're doing?

fields.EN:
I'm taking your clothes off. I
must say, it's surprising how
intricate your clothing is...
fields.JP:
服を脱がしてあげてるの。
意外とめんどうな構造してるのね、この服……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm taking your clothes off. I
must say, it's surprising how
intricate your clothing is...

fields.EN:
It's surprising how strong you
are!
fields.JP: あたしはあんたの力が結構あるのが意外だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's surprising how strong you
are!

fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんを助けるべき？　だよね？
　でも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should help Red Riding Hood,
right? But...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Jack! Don't just stand there! Do
something!
fields.JP: ジャック！　見てないで助けてよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Don't just stand there! Do
something!

fields.EN:
Don't move... Your underwear is
going to tear.
fields.JP: 動かないで、下着も破れてしまうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't move... Your underwear is
going to tear.

fields.EN:
H-Hey! If you tear my hood, I'm
seriously going to kill you!
fields.JP: ちょ……フード破ったらぶっ殺すからね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! If you tear my hood, I'm
seriously going to kill you!

fields.EN:
(Uh... I don't think your hood is
the major issue here...)
fields.JP: （……ていうか、気にするのフードなの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh... I don't think your hood is
the major issue here...)

fields.JP: （……赤ずきんさん、やっぱりごめん！）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Hey! Jack! Don't run! Please, save
me!
fields.JP:
こらーっ！　ジャーック！
逃げるな！　逃げないでーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Jack! Don't run! Please, save
me!

fields.JP:
（あれ、ラプンツェルだ。
　あんなとこに座り込んで、何食べてるの
　かな？）

fields.EN:
Ah, Rapunzel. What's that you have
there?
fields.JP: あら、ラプンツェル。……それは何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Rapunzel. What's that you have
there?

fields.EN:
Sweets! I got at the city! They
said I'm small and doing my best!
fields.JP:
おかし！
まちでねー、ちっちゃいのによくがんばってる
ねーって、もらった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sweets! I got at the city! They
said I'm small and doing my best!

fields.JP: ふうん。それは良かったわね
これ、ラプンツェルのだよ？

fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.JP: うう……もういっこあげる

fields.EN:
...Guree, this is the last one.
You can have it...
fields.JP:
……ぐれー、これ、さいごのいっこ。
あげる……
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretty? Last one I have. Here...
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.JP: おかし、もうなくなっちゃった……

fields.EN:
(She's gone... That must have made
Gretel feel bad...)
fields.JP:
（行っちゃった……
　これじゃ、さすがにグレーテルも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's gone... That must have made
Gretel feel bad...)

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how happy she
looks eating them!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how happy she
looks eating them!)

fields.EN:
(She's horrible... I can't believe
she actually pressured Rapunzel
into giving her food...)
fields.JP:
（よ、容赦無い……
　いや、あのラプンツェルに眼力で勝つなんて
　……しかも食べ物のことで……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's horrible... I can't believe
she actually pressured Rapunzel
into giving her food...)

fields.EN:
(That was no different from seeing
the power balance in an animal
hierarchy...)
fields.JP: （や、野生の世界を垣間見た気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was no different from seeing
the power balance in an animal
hierarchy...)

fields.EN:
I wonder how Rapunzel's doing...
I need to teach her about the
Dawn...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、どうしてるかな？
黎明のこと、色々教えてあげないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how Rapunzel's doing...
I need to teach her about the
Dawn...

fields.EN:
Wait... Is this Rapunzel's room?
The door is splintered... Does it
even open?
fields.JP:
あれ、ラプンツェルの部屋ってここだっけ……？
ドアがなんかぼろぼろだけど……開くかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Is this Rapunzel's room?
The door is splintered... Does it
even open?

fields.EN:
It's so dark... Rapunzel? Are you
here?
fields.JP:
真っ暗だ……
ラプンツェル、いないのかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so dark... Rapunzel? Are you
here?

fields.JP:
ぐるる……！
ハグッハグッ！

fields.EN: Whoa! A pink light in the dark?!
fields.JP:
うわっ！
暗闇にピンク色の光が……！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! A pink light in the dark?!

fields.EN:
W-Wait! Rapunzel! Where are you?!
Are you all right?!
fields.JP:
……そ、そうだ！
ラプンツェル、どこにいるの！？
大丈夫！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait! Rapunzel! Where are you?!
Are you all right?!

fields.EN:
The stuff around your mouth... Is
that... Marchen blood? Were you...
eating a Marchen?
fields.JP:
……もしかして、その口についてるの、
メルヒェンの血……？
……メルヒェンを食べたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The stuff around your mouth... Is
that... Marchen blood? Were you...
eating a Marchen?

fields.EN:
No more for Jack. Rapunzel ate
all...
fields.JP:
じゃっくのぶん、ないよ……？
ラプンツェル、ぜんぶたべちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No more for Jack. Rapunzel ate
all...

fields.EN:
I don't want any! And you
shouldn't be eating Marchens!
fields.JP:
いらないよ！
メルヒェンは食べちゃだめだってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want any! And you
shouldn't be eating Marchens!

fields.EN:
We have a lot of other foods here,
so no eating Marchens or the Jail,
you hear?!
fields.JP:
ここはちゃんとした食べ物があるんだから、
メルヒェンもジェイルも食べちゃだめなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have a lot of other foods here,
so no eating Marchens or the Jail,
you hear?!

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェル、おなかすいた……

fields.EN:
(Wh-What now? Why is she staring
at me?)
fields.JP:
（……な、なんだ？
　じっと見られてるぞ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What now? Why is she staring
at me?)

fields.JP: じゃっくーーーたべるーーー！

待って！
ラプンツェル、止まって……！

ううううう…………
じゃっくたべるの、まってる……

fields.EN:
H-Hold on there! H-Here! Have some
sweets!
fields.JP:
そ、そうじゃなくて……！
……ほら、お菓子を食べて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hold on there! H-Here! Have some
sweets!

fields.JP:
おかしだ！
すごくおいしいやつ……！

fields.EN:
(I need to do something about her
Corruption...)
fields.JP: （穢れの方もなんとかしないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to do something about her
Corruption...)

fields.EN:
Here, Rapunzel... Come and lick my
blood...
fields.JP:
ほら、ラプンツェル。
僕の血も舐めて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, Rapunzel... Come and lick my
blood...

fields.JP:
うん！
なめるーーーーー！
……じゃっく、すごくおいしいよ

fields.EN:
O-Only lick! You can't eat me, you
hear?!
fields.JP:
ち、血を舐めるだけだからね！
僕のことは食べちゃだめだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Only lick! You can't eat me, you
hear?!

fields.EN:
If Jack say no, then not eat
Jack...
fields.JP:
……じゃっくがだめなら、
じゃっくたべない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Jack say no, then not eat
Jack...

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... It looks like
Rapunzel's calmed down...)
fields.JP:
（よかった……
　ラプンツェル、落ち着いたみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... It looks like
Rapunzel's calmed down...)

fields.EN: Do you want some more sweets?
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you want some more sweets?

fields.EN:
(Look at how cute she is, with the
crumbs around her mouth...)
fields.JP:
（口をお菓子だらけにして、
　可愛いなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at how cute she is, with the
crumbs around her mouth...)

fields.EN:
(Though I have to admit, it's
pretty sad that I have to rely on
the sweets to make her listen...)
fields.JP:
（お菓子で言うこと聞かせてるのが、
　我ながら情けないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Though I have to admit, it's
pretty sad that I have to rely on
the sweets to make her listen...)

fields.JP: おいしーーーーーーー！

fields.EN: Nope, I don't have any more.
fields.LOCALIZED: Nope, I don't have any more.

fields.JP: じゃっくたべるの、だめなんだよね！

fields.EN:
That's right. Glad you remembered
that... Haha...
fields.JP:
……そうだよ。
よく覚えたね……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Glad you remembered
that... Haha...

fields.JP: じゃっく、これ、いらない

fields.EN:
Come to think of it... Rapunzel,
what happened to the door? It's
splintered all over...
fields.JP:
そういえば……
ラプンツェル、ドアはどうしたの？
結構傷んでたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it... Rapunzel,
what happened to the door? It's
splintered all over...

fields.JP: んーーーーーーーーー？

fields.EN:
Don't tell me... Did you try to
eat the door?
fields.JP:
……もしかして、
ドアを食べようとした……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me... Did you try to
eat the door?

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
どあなんてたべないよ！

fields.EN:
(Well, that's a relief... Guess I
jumped the gun there...)
fields.JP:
（ほっ……。
　なんだ、僕の早とちりか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that's a relief... Guess I
jumped the gun there...)

fields.JP: どあ、おいしくなかったから！

fields.EN:
I knew it! Even if the door tasted
good, you're not supposed to eat
it!
fields.JP:
やっぱり！
ドアは美味しくても食べちゃだめ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it! Even if the door tasted
good, you're not supposed to eat
it!

fields.EN:
The door isn't food, so I'm going
to have Haru-san fix it, okay?
fields.JP:
ドアは食べ物じゃないから、
ハルさんに直してもらおうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The door isn't food, so I'm going
to have Haru fix it, okay?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: はるはる、どあなおせるの？

fields.EN:
That's right. Haru-san, Alice, the
Professor, and everyone has an
important role, so don't eat them.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。ハルさんもアリスも博士も、
みんな大事な役目があるから、
食べちゃだめだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Haru, Alice, the
Professor, and everyone has an
important role, so don't eat them.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: But... I can't eat you yet...
fields.LOCALIZED: But... I can't eat you yet...

fields.EN:
I-I guess that would work for
now...
fields.JP:
ま、まあいっか……
今はそれでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess that would work for
now...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel? You're just like
everyone else. You're a member of
the Dawn now.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、みんなとおなじ、
黎明の仲間になったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel? You're just like
everyone else. You're a member of
the Dawn now.

fields.EN:
Of course! And, you're not
supposed to eat your fellow
members and friends, okay?
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ！
仲間は食べちゃだめなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! And, you're not
supposed to eat your fellow
members and friends, okay?

fields.EN: (I sure hope she does get it...)
fields.LOCALIZED: (I sure hope she does get it...)

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、おはよう……

fields.EN:
A yellow hairball...? Oh, yeah...
It's Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……黄色い毛玉……？
あ、ラプンツェルか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A yellow hairball...? Oh, yeah...
It's Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Wake up, Rapunzel. I came for you.
We need to go and meet with
everyone.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、起きて。
もうみんな集まってるから、呼びに来たよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wake up, Rapunzel. I came for you.
We need to go and meet with
everyone.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! You're naked?! Where are
your clothes, Rapunzel?!
fields.JP:
……って、裸……！？
ラプンツェル、服はどうしたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! You're naked?! Where are
your clothes, Rapunzel?!

fields.EN: Hair is warm so no need clothes.
fields.JP:
かみのけ、あったかいから、
ふくいらないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hair is warm so no need clothes.

fields.EN:
But you live with other people
now, so you'll need to put your
clothes on, Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはみんなで住んでるから、
着ないとだめだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you live with other people
now, so you'll need to put your
clothes on, Rapunzel!

fields.JP: えーーーーーーーーー？

まったくもう……。
……えっと、ラプンツェルの服は……

fields.EN:
Here they are! Go ahead and put on
your clothes, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……あった！
ほら、ラプンツェル、服を着て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here they are! Go ahead and put on
your clothes, Rapunzel.

fields.EN: Wha-?! No! I-I'm a guy, you know?
fields.JP:
ええっ！？
僕はだめだよ！
こ、これでも、男だし……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha-?! No! I-I'm a guy, you know?

fields.EN:
(All I have to do is look away...
Don't look... Don't look...)
fields.JP:
（目を逸らして……。
　見ないように……見ないように……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All I have to do is look away...
Don't look... Don't look...)

fields.JP:
きゃはははっ！
じゃっくの手、あったかいね……！

fields.EN:
S-Sorry! D-Did I touch--?! B-But,
I'm not looking, okay?!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
へんなとこさわったかも！？
……で、でも、見てないからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry! D-Did I touch--?! B-But,
I'm not looking, okay?!

fields.EN:
(I have to hurry before someone
sees me...!)
fields.JP:
（はやくしないと、
　誰かにこんなところ見られたら……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to hurry before someone
sees me...!)

fields.EN:
Good! You look much better like
that! Now then, let's comb your
hair.
fields.JP:
うん！
その方がずっといいよ……！
じゃあ髪の毛もとかしちゃおうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! You look much better like
that! Now then, let's comb your
hair.

fields.EN:
(What a relief! It's a good thing
no one saw that...)
fields.JP:
（よかった……！
　誰にも見られなくて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a relief! It's a good thing
no one saw that...)

fields.EN:
Wh-What?! Why are you grabbing
me...?
fields.JP:
……な、なに、どうしたの？
急にしがみついてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?! Why are you grabbing
me...?

fields.JP: ううーーーじゃっくーーー

んんっ……？
じゃっくもこどもがほしいんだね！

fields.EN:
Huh?! Um, sure, babies are cute,
but...
fields.JP: えっ！？　確かに子供は可愛いけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! Um, sure, babies are cute,
but...

fields.EN:
W-Well, I'm not old enough to
think about that yet, but once I
grow up and escape from here...
fields.JP:
そ、そうだなあ……
まだそこまでは考えてないけど、
脱獄して、大きくなったら、いつか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I'm not old enough to
think about that yet, but once I
grow up and escape from here...

fields.EN:
Jack's heartbeat fast. Rapunzel,
too! I want babies!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、どきどきしてるよ。
ラプンツェルもこどもほしいと、
どきどきするんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's heartbeat fast. Rapunzel,
too! I want babies!

fields.EN:
(Huh?! Wait... She's talking about
in the future, right?!)
fields.JP:
（えっ！？
　将来の夢、とかじゃなくて！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh?! Wait... She's talking about
in the future, right?!)

fields.EN:
W-Wait up! My heart's beating fast
because I didn't want anyone to
see me put your clothes on!
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ……！
ドキドキしてるのは、服着せてるとこを誰かに
見られたらどうしようってだけで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait up! My heart's beating fast
because I didn't want anyone to
see me put your clothes on!

fields.EN:
Jack wants to make babies when
heart beats, right?
fields.JP:
でも、じゃっくも、
どきどきするとこどもつくりたくなるよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack wants to make babies when
heart beats, right?

fields.JP: ……ほら、どきどきがおおきくなったよ！

fields.EN:
(Why is Rapunzel wanting babies
when she's like a huge baby
herself?!)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェル、まだ小さいっていうか、
　知らないことばっかりなのに、
　何で子供が欲しいなんて……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is Rapunzel wanting babies
when she's like a huge baby
herself?!)

fields.JP:
あっ！
アリス、赤ずきんさん、親指姫も……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Alice, Red Riding Hood, and
Thumbelina...?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
You two were taking forever, so we
came to get you two.
fields.JP:
いつまでたっても来ないから、
見に来ちゃったわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two were taking forever, so we
came to get you two.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Seems like Rapu's
really attached to you now!
fields.JP:
はははっ！
随分とラプに懐かれたなあ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Seems like Rappy's
really attached to you now!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Rapunzel put clothes on with Jack.
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、じゃっくとふくきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel put clothes on with Jack.

fields.EN:
And then Jack's heartbeat was
fast!
fields.JP:
……そしたら、
じゃっくのしんぞうがどきどきした！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And then Jack's heartbeat was
fast!

fields.EN:
Um... You're making it sound
like...
fields.JP:
な、なんか、
誤解を生む言い方してない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You're making it sound
like...

fields.EN:
Jack... She's a child... Don't
tell me you...?
fields.JP:
……ジャック。
あなた、子供にまさか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... She's a child... Don't
tell me you...?

fields.EN:
I don't support that kind of
thing, you know...
fields.JP:
あたしはあんまり感心しないなー、
そーいうの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't support that kind of
thing, you know...

fields.EN:
Y-You have it all wrong! I was
trying not to look, and...!
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！
僕は、見ないようにって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You have it all wrong! I was
trying not to look, and...!

fields.EN:
Jack! Let's make babies together
next time!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、
こんどはいっしょに、こどもつくろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Let's make babies together
next time!

fields.EN:
Ah, wait! Wh-What do you mean by
babies...?!
fields.JP:
あ、まって……！
子供ってどういうこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, wait! Wh-What do you mean by
babies...?!

fields.JP: 僕は何もしてないってばーー！
みこしってるーーーーー？
何かしら？　ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
(It's Rapunzel and Miko-san... I
wonder what they're talking
about...)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルと視子さんだ。
　何を話してるんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Rapunzel and Miko... I
wonder what they're talking
about...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、こどもうみたいんだ
……こども、どうやってつくるの？

fields.EN:
(What in the world is Rapunzel
saying?!)
fields.JP: （ラプンツェル、なんてことを……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the world is Rapunzel
saying?!)

fields.EN:
Why, if it isn't Jack. What are
you squatting there for?
fields.JP:
あら、ジャック。
そんなところに座り込んだりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, if it isn't Jack. What are
you squatting there for?

fields.EN: Miko! How do you make babies?
fields.JP:
みこ！
こども、どうやってつくるのーー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Miko! How do you make babies?

fields.EN:
One day when you're older, you
might meet a person who'll end up
being your special someone...
fields.JP:
……大人になったら、ラプンツェルに
教えてくれる人が現れるわ。
それは運命の人なのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
One day when you're older, you
might meet a person who'll end up
being your special someone...

fields.JP: ううーーーーーーーー

fields.EN:
Hey, hey! Jack! Jack knows how to
make babies, right?
fields.JP:
ねえねえ！　じゃっく！
じゃっくは、こどものうみかたしってるよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, hey! Jack! Jack knows how to
make babies, right?

fields.EN:
Jack wants babies, too! We can
make babies together!
fields.JP:
じゃっくもこどもほしいんだもんね！
いっしょにつくろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack wants babies, too! We can
make babies together!

fields.EN:
If you don't know, it just means
it's still too early for you,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……ま、まだ知らないってことは、
ラプンツェルにはまだ早いってことだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't know, it just means
it's still too early for you,
Rapunzel.

fields.JP: じゃっく、ほんとはしってる！

fields.EN: Rapunzel! Don't kick me like that!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル……！
いきなり蹴らないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel! Don't kick me like that!

fields.EN:
Oh, my... If you want to find the
right person, you're going to need
to grow up first, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
あらあら……。
ラプンツェルはまず、大人にならないとね。
運命の人と会いたかったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my... If you want to find the
right person, you're going to need
to grow up first, Rapunzel.

fields.EN: I can make babies if I grow up?
fields.JP: おとなになったら、こどもできるの？
