fields.LOCALIZED: I can make babies if I grow up?

fields.JP: おとなになるの、どうするの！？

fields.EN:
First, don't kick your friends.
Next, eat all your food and wear
your clothes.
fields.JP:
まず、友達を蹴ったりぶったりしないことね。
それから、綺麗にごはんを食べて
きちんと服を着て……
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, don't kick your friends.
Next, eat all your food and wear
your clothes.

fields.EN:
You should do something about your
hair, too. Maybe cut it shoulder-
length. It'll look pretty.
fields.JP:
髪の毛もスッキリした方がいいわね。
背中まで切って、綺麗にまとめて……。
今よりもっと美人になるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should do something about your
hair, too. Maybe cut it shoulder-
length. It'll look pretty.

fields.JP: ど、どうしたの？　ラプンツェル

かみのけ、きらない！
かみのけやだ！
ラプンツェル、落ち着いて……！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel go bye-bye! No one wants
Rapunzel no hair!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルいなくなっちゃうよおっ！
かみのけないと、
みんなラプンツェルいらないの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel go bye-bye! No one wants
Rapunzel no hair!

fields.JP: これが、この子の血式リビドーなのね……
こんな小さい子なのに……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel? No one is going to cut
your hair, so calm down.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
髪の毛は切らないから、落ち着いて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel? No one is going to cut
your hair, so calm down.

fields.JP:
うえええん
かみのけやだあああ！

fields.EN:
(What do I do... She won't stop
crying...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do I do... She won't stop
crying...)

fields.EN:
Jack tease me! Not telling how to
make babies!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、いじわるするもん……！
こどものうみかた、おしえてくれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack tease me! Not telling how to
make babies!

fields.EN:
O-Okay! I'll tell you! I won't cut
your hair, and I'll tell you how
to make babies!
fields.JP:
お、教えてあげるから……！
髪の毛も切らないし、子供の作り方も教える！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay! I'll tell you! I won't cut
your hair, and I'll tell you how
to make babies!

fields.JP:
う、うん……！
嘘はつかないよ！

fields.EN:
*sniff* *sniff* You teach me how
to make babies?
fields.JP:
ひっく……ひっく……
こどものうみかた、おしえてくれる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sniff* *sniff* You teach me how
to make babies?

fields.EN: When we get out of the Jail...
fields.JP: ……ジェイルから出られたらだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED: When we get out of the Jail...

fields.JP: （な、泣き止んでくれたみたいだ……！）

fields.EN: Promise, Jack! We go and escape!
fields.JP:
やくそくだよ、じゃっく！
だつごくしようね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Promise, Jack! We go and escape!

fields.EN: Then we can make babies together!
fields.JP: そしたら、いっしょにこどもつくろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then we can make babies together!

fields.EN: Wha-?! Th-That's not what I meant!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？
ぼ、僕は、そんなつもりじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha-?! Th-That's not what I meant!

fields.JP:
じゃっくがラプンツェルの
うんめいのひとってことだよね！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel gonna make babies with
Jack!
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、じゃっくとこどもつくるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel gonna make babies with
Jack!

fields.EN: (W-Well, Rapunzel looks happy, so maybe I should just leave it alone... It'll probably only last for now anyway...)
fields.JP:
（……ま、まあ、ラプンツェルが嬉しそうだから
　何も言わないでおこうかな……。
　……今だけだろうし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's happy, so I guess I can
leave it at that... I'm sure
she'll forget about it later...)

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, are you around? I
brought you some sweets, so
let's...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、いるー？
お菓子を持ってきたから、一緒に食べ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, are you around? I
brought you some sweets, so
let's...

fields.JP: じゃっくがきたーーーーーー！

fields.EN: I got us some sweets...! Urgh!
fields.LOCALIZED: I got us some sweets...! Urgh!

fields.JP: いくよーーーーーーー！

fields.EN:
(L-Let go...! Can't... breathe!
I'm going... to die...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(L-Let go...! Can't... breathe!
I'm going... to die...!)

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I'm
still alive...)
fields.JP: （よかった……まだ生きてるみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I'm
still alive...)

fields.EN:
*cough* S-So why are we on the
roof?
fields.LOCALIZED:
*cough* S-So why are we on the
roof?

fields.EN:
Of course it is! *cough* I thought
I was going to die there!
fields.JP:
してるよ！　……げほっ
死ぬかと思ったよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course it is! *cough* I thought
I was going to die there!

fields.JP:
すきってことだね！
……じゃっく、すき？

fields.EN:
Jack likes Rapunzel? Wanna make
babies?
fields.JP:
じゃっく、ラプンツェルのことすき？
こどもつくりたい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack likes Rapunzel? Wanna make
babies?

fields.JP:
ま、まって……げほっ
……それ、どういうこと？

fields.EN:
Aka-Aka said that heart beating fast
means you like a person.
fields.JP:
あかあかが、
『ドキドキするのは、
　相手のことを好きってことだよ』だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Reddy said that heart beating fast
means you like a person.

fields.EN:
(Unbelievable, Akazukin-san!
I can't believe she said that!)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんは、
　他人事だと思って面白がって！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Unbelievable, Red Riding Hood!
I can't believe she said that!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Kaguya said that you make babies
with person you like.
fields.JP:
あとね、かぐやーが
『子は好きなおのこと作るのです～』
っていってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya said that you make babies
with person you like.

fields.EN:
(In Kaguyahime's case, I bet she just
got tired and said that to shoo
her away...)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫は、何度も聞かれて
　面倒臭くなったんだんだろうなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In Kaguya's case, I bet she just
got tired and said that to shoo
her away...)

fields.EN:
Let's make babies, Jack! We like
and both hearts beating faster!
fields.JP:
じゃっく、こどもつくろ！
すきってどきどきいってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's make babies, Jack! We like
and both hearts beating faster!

fields.EN:
Um... My heart's beating quickly
because you dragged me around the
place, Rapunzel...
fields.JP:
……あのね、このドキドキは、
ラプンツェルが僕を引きずって
思いっきり走ったからだからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... My heart's beating quickly
because you dragged me around the
place, Rapunzel...

fields.EN:
Jack's heart beats fast last time
when Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
じゃっく、このまえもどきどきしてたよ。
ラプンツェルにふくきせたとき……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's heart beats fast last time
when Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
W-Well, that was because I was
anxious about whether someone was
going to see us...
fields.JP:
あ、あの時は、
誰か来たらどうしようって、緊張してたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, that was because I was
anxious about whether someone was
going to see us...

fields.JP:
じゃっくがラプンツェルすきなの、
だめなの……？

fields.EN: N-No! That's not what I meant!
fields.JP: ち、違うよ……そういう意味じゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: N-No! That's not what I meant!

fields.EN: Other side of like is not like...
fields.JP: ……すきのはんたいは、きらいなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Other side of like is not like...

fields.EN:
You've got this all wrong,
Rapunzel!
fields.JP: 違うんだってば、ラプンツェル……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got this all wrong,
Rapunzel!

fields.JP:
（どうしよう……
　ラプンツェルに誤解されちゃった……）

fields.EN:
(I can't eat all these sweets I
brought for her alone...)
fields.JP:
（お菓子もいっぱい持ってきたのに、
　一人じゃ食べきれないよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't eat all these sweets I
brought for her alone...)

fields.JP:
（今日こそ、
　ラプンツェルに謝らなきゃなあ……）

fields.EN: I'm sorry about the last time...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry about the last time...

fields.EN:
(Maybe she'll feel better if I pat
her on the head...)
fields.JP:
（頭を撫でてみたら、
　機嫌直してくれるかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she'll feel better if I pat
her on the head...)

fields.EN:
I worded myself badly then. Come,
show me your face...
fields.JP:
僕だって、言い方が悪かったんだよ
ほら、顔を上げて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I worded myself badly then. Come,
show me your face...

fields.JP:
やだっ！
かみのけきらないで！

fields.EN:
Jack can not like Rapunzel, but
not cut my hair!
fields.JP:
じゃっくがラプンツェルきらいでも、
かみのけきらないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack can not like Rapunzel, but
not cut my hair!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry! I just wanted to pat
you on the head because your hair
is so pretty!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……！
……綺麗な髪の毛だから、
撫でたくなっただけなんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry! I just wanted to pat
you on the head because your hair
is so pretty!

fields.JP: （か、かえって驚かせちゃった……）

fields.EN:
Waaaah! I'm sorry, Jack! So not
cut my hair!
fields.JP:
わあああん！
じゃっく、ごめんなさい！
だからかみのけきらないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waaaah! I'm sorry, Jack! So not
cut my hair!

fields.EN:
(She's so small in my arms... I
made such a small child cry...!)
fields.JP:
（……僕は、
　抱きしめるとこんなに小さな女の子を
　泣かせてしまったんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so small in my arms... I
made such a small child cry...!)

fields.EN:
Jack's heart beats fast, but not
like Rapunzel...
fields.JP:
じゃっく、どきどきしてるけど、
ラプンツェルのこときらい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's heart beats fast, but not
like Rapunzel...

fields.EN:
That's because I'm not sure I got
through to the Rapunzel I like.
fields.JP:
それは、好きなラプンツェルに謝りたいけど、
ちゃんと伝わるかわからなくて、
緊張してるからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because I'm not sure I got
through to the Rapunzel I like.

fields.JP: じゃっく、ラプンツェルのこと、すきなの……？

fields.EN:
Of course. Alice, Akazukin,
Oyayubihime, Haru-san, Miko-san... Everyone
likes you!
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。
アリスも赤ずきんも親指姫もハルさんも
視子さんも、僕はみんなが好きだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. Alice, Red Riding Hood,
Thumbelina, Haru, Miko... Everyone
likes you!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Rapunzel likes Jack, too... Likes
Clara, Alice, Aka-Aka, everyone...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもじゃっくすき……
くららもありすもあかあかも、みんなすき……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel likes Jack, too... Likes
Clara, Alice, Reddy, everyone...

fields.EN:
Yes, there are plenty of likes out
there. I like my friends, and
you're one of them, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
うん。いろんな好きがあって、僕は仲間が好きで、
ラプンツェルも、その好きの中に入ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, there are plenty of likes out
there. I like my friends, and
you're one of them, Rapunzel.

fields.JP: じゃっく、ラプンツェルのこときらいじゃない！

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I
got through to her.)
fields.JP: （よかった。誤解が解けたみたいだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... Looks like I
got through to her.)

fields.EN: Jack? Your heart still beats fast.
fields.JP: じゃっく、またどきどきしてるよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Your heart still beats fast.

fields.EN:
That's because I feel relieved
after apologizing to you,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
これは、緊張が解けたドキドキ。
ラプンツェルに謝れたからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because I feel relieved
after apologizing to you,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Heart beats fast even if not for
like?
fields.JP: すき、じゃないのにどきどきするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heart beats fast even if not for
like?

fields.EN:
Yup. There are lots of reasons for
that. Of course, liking someone is
one of them.
fields.JP:
うん。
ドキドキには、いろんな理由があるんだよ。
もちろん、『好き』のドキドキもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. There are lots of reasons for
that. Of course, liking someone is
one of them.

fields.EN:
Say, Rapunzel? Why don't we look
for all sorts of likes together?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ラプンツェル。
これから色んなドキドキを二人で探していこうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Rapunzel? Why don't we look
for all sorts of likes together?

fields.EN:
Yup! I wanna have lots of
heartbeats with Jack!
fields.JP:
うん……！
じゃっくといっぱいどきどきしたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I wanna have lots of
heartbeats with Jack!

fields.EN: You made me a friend again...
fields.JP: なかなおりしてくれたから……
fields.LOCALIZED: You made me a friend again...

fields.EN:
It was my fault, so don't worry.
You just be yourself, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
僕も悪かったんだから、もう気にしないで。
ラプンツェルはラプンツェルらしくいてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was my fault, so don't worry.
You just be yourself, Rapunzel.

fields.JP:
うん……！
じゃっくがいうなら、そうする！

fields.EN:
Friends again, so Rapunzel gonna
make Jack wear clothes!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、なかなおりしたから、
ラプンツェルがじゃっくにふくきせるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends again, so Rapunzel gonna
make Jack wear clothes!

fields.EN: Whoa! D-Don't take my clothes off!
fields.JP:
うわあああ！
服を脱がさないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! D-Don't take my clothes off!

fields.EN:
Why no? Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel, too.
fields.JP:
なんでー？
じゃっくも、
ラプンツェルにふくきせてくれたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why no? Jack put clothes on
Rapunzel, too.

fields.JP: そ、それは、ラプンツェルが……

fields.EN:
(...Because she wouldn't put her
clothes on. But, I better think on
it before I hurt her again...)
fields.JP:
（……そうしないと服を着ないって
　言ったからだけど、伝え方を
　気をつけないと、また傷つけるかも……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...Because she wouldn't put her
clothes on. But, I better think on
it before I hurt her again...)

fields.EN:
R-Rapunzel? Um... Can you put
clothes on me?
fields.JP:
ラ、ラプンツェル。
……僕に、服を着せてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Rapunzel? Um... Can you put
clothes on me?

fields.JP:
……うんっ！
じゃっくのふく、きせる！

fields.EN: Uh, but just this once, okay?
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, but just this once, okay?

fields.EN:
Hey... Your heart is beating
fast... How come?
fields.JP:
あれ、どきどきしてるよ？
なんでーーーーー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey... Your heart is beating
fast... How come?

fields.EN:
Embarrassed so your heart beats
fast? Why?
fields.JP:
はずかしいのどきどき、
なんでーーーーー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Embarrassed so your heart beats
fast? Why?

fields.EN:
You're a girl and I'm a guy,
that's why!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは女の子で、
僕は男だからっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a girl and I'm a guy,
that's why!

fields.JP:
わかんないや！
えーーーーーーーーい！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, please! Be a bit more
gentle! You're going to tear my
clothes!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、丁寧にお願い！
破れちゃうから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, please! Be a bit more
gentle! You're going to tear my
clothes!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh! Jack and Rapunzel
get along!
fields.JP:
あははははっ！
じゃっくとラプンツェルは、
なかよしだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh! Jack and Rapunzel
get along!

fields.EN: Rapunzel, do you want more sweets?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
お菓子はもういらない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel, do you want more sweets?

fields.JP: じゃっくとおはなしする！

fields.EN:
Okay... What do you want to talk
about?
fields.JP: じゃあ……どんなお話する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... What do you want to talk
about?

fields.EN:
Urrh... I'm sorry... Rapunzel
can't talk good...
fields.JP:
うー。ラプンツェル、
おはなしうまくなくてごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I'm sorry... Rapunzel
can't talk good...

fields.JP:
えっ？
そんなことは……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel all alone, so never
talk...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、ずっとひとりだったから……
おはなし、しなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel all alone, so never
talk...

fields.EN:
Just say what you want to slowly.
I'm not great at it, either. Which
is why I get into trouble...
fields.JP:
ゆっくり落ち着いて話せばいいよ。
僕も話は下手だし……。
……だからよく誤解させちゃうんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just say what you want to slowly.
I'm not great at it, either. Which
is why I get into trouble...

fields.EN:
I like listening to you talk,
Rapunzel. So I hope you can talk
a bit more with me.
fields.JP:
僕、ラプンツェルの話を聞くの好きだよ。
だからもっと聞きたいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like listening to you talk,
Rapunzel. So I hope you can talk
a bit more with me.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel likes Jack's talks! Likes
talking with Jack!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、じゃっくのはなし、すき！
じゃっくとはなすの、すき……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel likes Jack's talks! Likes
talking with Jack!

fields.EN:
Um, what did you do for fun when
you were alone, Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
……あのさ。ラプンツェルは、
一人の時はどんなふうに遊んでいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what did you do for fun when
you were alone, Rapunzel?

fields.EN: Fun? You mean like Jack and Clara?
fields.JP: あそぶって、じゃっくやくららみたいに？
fields.LOCALIZED: Fun? You mean like Jack and Clara?

fields.JP: メルヒェンのしたいとあそんでたよ

fields.EN:
Sorry. I think I asked the wrong
question... You were alone, after
all...
fields.JP:
ごめんね、変なこと聞いたかも……
ラプンツェルはずっと一人だったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I think I asked the wrong
question... You were alone, after
all...

fields.EN:
No, okay! Fun to play with dead
Marchens!
fields.JP:
ううん！
メルヒェンしぬと、おもしろかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, okay! Fun to play with dead
Marchens!

fields.EN:
But more fun playing with everyone
in Dawn!
fields.JP:
でも、あそぶのは、
れいめいのみんなのほうがたのしい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But more fun playing with everyone
in Dawn!

fields.EN:
Are you happy you came here,
Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
……ラプンツェルは、
ここにきてよかったと思ってる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you happy you came here,
Rapunzel?

fields.JP:
うんっ！
ごはんもおかしもおいしいから。
……それにね……

fields.EN:
Very excited to talk and play with
everyone! But not the same as
heart beat fast!
fields.JP:
みんなとおはなしして、あそぶの、
わくわくするんだ……！
どきどきじゃなくて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very excited to talk and play with
everyone! But not the same as
heart beat fast!

fields.EN:
I see... Well, it's exciting
listening to your stories too,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
そっかあ……。
僕も今、ラプンツェルの話をきいて
わくわくしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well, it's exciting
listening to your stories too,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN: Rapunzel and Jack are the same!
fields.JP: ラプンツェルとじゃっく、おんなじだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel and Jack are the same!

fields.JP:
……だつごくしたら、
みんなどうなるのかなあ……
……ラプンツェル、またひとりになるのかな

fields.EN:
But, you'll be escaping with
everyone else, too...
fields.JP: みんなで脱獄するのに、なんで……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you'll be escaping with
everyone else, too...

fields.EN:
But, no one wants to be with
Rapunzel...
fields.JP:
だって、みんな、ラプンツェルと
いっしょにいるのいやだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, no one wants to be with
Rapunzel...

fields.JP:
えっ？
そんなこと誰も思ってないよ……！

fields.EN:
But Rapunzel keeps doing
trouble... Jack always worry...
fields.JP:
……ラプンツェル、
いつもみんなにめいわくかけてるのに？
じゃっくも、いつもこまってるもん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Rapunzel keeps doing
trouble... Jack always worry...

fields.EN:
(It looks like Rapunzel's paying
attention a lot more than before.
I guess she's maturing every day.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェル、
　そんなこと考えるようになってたんだ……。
　少しずつ大人になってるんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Rapunzel's paying
attention a lot more than before.
I guess she's maturing every day.)

fields.EN:
Um, Rapunzel? I worry you too,
right? And sometimes what everyone
says confuses me, too.
fields.JP:
……あのね、ラプンツェル
僕もラプンツェルを困らせることあるよね。
みんなが言うことに、戸惑うこともあるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Rapunzel? I worry you too,
right? And sometimes what everyone
says confuses me, too.

fields.JP:
うーーーーーー……
……たまに……
なんでかわかんないことある……

fields.EN:
Right? Causing trouble and helping
go hand-in-hand. That's what it
means to be together.
fields.JP:
だよね？　お互いに迷惑をかけるのが、
助け合うってことなんだよ。
それが、一緒にいるってことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? Causing trouble and helping
go hand-in-hand. That's what it
means to be together.

fields.EN:
Being together means causing
trouble all the time?
fields.JP:
いっしょにいると
ずっとめいわくかけるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being together means causing
trouble all the time?

fields.EN:
It doesn't bother anyone, and
everyone likes you, which is why
everyone wants to be with you.
fields.JP:
それが嫌じゃないから、
ラプンツェルのことが好きだから、
みんなラプンツェルと一緒にいるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't bother anyone, and
everyone likes you, which is why
everyone wants to be with you.

fields.EN: Jack is okay being with Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
じゃっくはラプンツェルといっしょにいるの、
いやじゃないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack is okay being with Rapunzel?

fields.EN:
Yup... I like you, and so does
everyone else...
fields.JP:
うん。嫌じゃないよ。
みんなだって、そう思ってるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I like you, and so does
everyone else...

fields.EN:
I wish Rapunzel can be with
everyone...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、
ずっとみんなといっしょがいいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wish Rapunzel can be with
everyone...

fields.EN:
I want to be with you too when we
escape, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
僕も、脱獄しても、
ずっとラプンツェルと一緒にいたいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to be with you too when we
escape, Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel... is gonna be with you
forever, Jack!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも……。
ずっといっしょにいようね、じゃっく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel... is gonna be with you
forever, Jack!

fields.EN:
Thanks, and... I'm sure we'll all
get along!
fields.JP:
ありがとう！
これからもよろしくね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, and... I'm sure we'll all
get along!

fields.EN:
I dunno why, but... Heart beats
fast with Jack... But not the same
fast as fun playing...
fields.JP:
なんでだろう……
じゃっくにわくわくじゃなくてどきどきする……
しらないどきどきだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I dunno why, but... Heart beats
fast with Jack... But not the same
fast as fun playing...

fields.JP:
なんでもないよ！
……じゃっく、あそぼー！

fields.EN:
Okay! I promised yesterday that
we'd play on the roof, so let's
go!
fields.JP:
いいよ！
屋上で遊ぼうって、昨日約束してたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I promised yesterday that
we'd play on the roof, so let's
go!

fields.EN:
How come? Not the same fast,
but... I don't wanna ask Jack...
fields.JP:
……なんでかなあ……
しらないどきどきなのに、じゃっくに、
なんのどきどきなのか、ききたくない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How come? Not the same fast,
but... I don't wanna ask Jack...

fields.JP: ねむねむ、いいにおいする……

fields.EN:
Smells like marshmallows!
Rapunzel likes marshmallows!
fields.JP:
ましゅまろのにおいだ！
ラプンツェル、ましゅまろすき！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Smells like marshmallows!
Rapunzel likes marshmallows!

fields.EN:
You're saying that because of how
she feels, aren't you?
fields.JP:
……それはどっちかっていうと、
感触じゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're saying that because of how
she feels, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Well, she is attached
to Nemurihime... To her
breasts in particular...
fields.JP:
あはは。
しっかり抱きついてるもんなあ……
……眠り姫の胸に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Well, she is attached
to Sleeping Beauty... To her
breasts in particular...

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: あーーーーーーーーん

もぐもぐ……
もぐもぐ……

fields.EN:
What kind of sweets does Nemu-Nemu
like? Dawn's sweets all so tasty!
fields.JP:
ねむねむはどんなおかしがすき？
れいめいのおかし、ぜんぶおいしいね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What kind of sweets does Sleepy
like? Dawn's sweets all so tasty!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel found a flower just like
Nemu-Nemu!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、このまえ、
ねむねむみたいなおはなをみつけたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel found a flower just like
Sleepy!

fields.EN:
It had two big, round petals!
White and jiggly!
fields.JP:
おおきなまるいはなびらがふたつあったの！
しろくて、ふるふるってふるえてた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It had two big, round petals!
White and jiggly!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's about the only one who
can get away with saying that...
fields.JP: ……ラプンツェルだから許される会話ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's about the only one who
can get away with saying that...

fields.EN:
Yup... Don't think anyone else
would be able to...
fields.JP: 他の奴じゃ、ちょっとこれはできないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Don't think anyone else
would be able to...

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: ねむねむねむねむねむ！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: これ、会話って言えるの……？

fields.EN:
As long as they understand each
other...
fields.JP: 通じ合ってるからいいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as they understand each
other...

fields.EN:
I suppose so... I haven't heard
Nemu talk this much before.
fields.JP:
確かに通じ合ってるわよね。
ネムもいつもより喋ってるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose so... I haven't heard
Sleepy talk this much before.

fields.EN:
Well, guess Nemu tamed the
wild...
fields.JP: 野生児が、ネムにはよく懐いてるなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, guess Sleepy tamed the
wild...

fields.EN:
Tamed... That's a pretty accurate
term...
fields.JP: まあ、懐いてるって表現がぴったりよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tamed... That's a pretty accurate
term...

fields.EN:
Speaking of, I heard that Jack
isn't her master or anything. He's
Rapunzel's food...
fields.JP:
そういえば、ジャックは飼い主じゃなくて、
ラプンツェルの食料らしいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of, I heard that Jack
isn't her master or anything. He's
Rapunzel's food...

fields.JP: ああ、そんな感じするわよね……
あ、みんなここにいたんだ

fields.EN: What are you talking with Nemurihime about?
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、眠り姫とお話してるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking with Sleeping
Beauty about?

fields.JP: だめーーーーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Jack was pushed back by
Rapunzel?!
fields.JP: ジャックがラプンツェルに押しのけられた！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack was pushed back by
Rapunzel?!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's playing with Nemu-Nemu!
You go away, Jack!
fields.JP:
いまはラプンツェルがねむねむとあそぶの！
じゃっく、あっちいって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's playing with Sleepy!
You go away, Jack!

fields.EN: Guess Jack got in her way there...
fields.JP: ジャックが邪魔にされるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Guess Jack got in her way there...

fields.JP: 可哀相に……ジャックのやつ……

fields.EN:
Um, you two are having fun seeing
what's happening, aren't you?
fields.JP: ……あのさ、二人とも面白がってるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you two are having fun seeing
what's happening, aren't you?

fields.JP: あら？　そんなことないわよ？

fields.EN:
*sigh* Whatever... Guess I'll see
you all later...
fields.JP:
はあ……もういいよ……
それじゃあ、またね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Whatever... Guess I'll see
you all later...

fields.JP: ねむねむだーーいすきーーー

fields.EN:
(Look at the time... I'd better
get to sleep...)
fields.JP:
（……あ。もういい時間だ。
　早く寝ないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at the time... I'd better
get to sleep...)

fields.EN:
(I haven't read books since I got
here, so I think I may have been
reading a bit too much...)
fields.JP:
（本なんて、ここに来るまで読めなかったから、
　つい夜更かししちゃったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't read books since I got
here, so I think I may have been
reading a bit too much...)

fields.EN:
(Well, at least I should be...
able to sleep... easily now...)
fields.JP: （でも……すぐに寝られそう……かな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, at least I should be...
able to sleep... easily now...)

fields.EN:
Why are you here this late? You
have to go and sleep in your room.
fields.JP:
……こんな時間にどうしたの？
駄目だよ、自分の部屋で寝なきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you here this late? You
have to go and sleep in your room.

fields.JP: んーーじゃっくとねる……

fields.EN:
I dunno... But, don't want to be
alone...
fields.JP:
わかんない……
……でも、ひとりやだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I dunno... But, don't want to be
alone...

fields.EN: I see... Only for tonight, okay?
fields.JP:
……そっか。
じゃあ、今日だけだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... Only for tonight, okay?

fields.EN:
(I guess she had a bad dream...
Well, she is still a kid...)
fields.JP:
（……やっぱり、怖い夢でも見たのかな？
　ま……まあ、まだ子供だし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess she had a bad dream...
Well, she is still a kid...)

fields.JP: ええと……これで眠れそう……？

fields.EN:
Mmm... Weird... Rapunzel was
always alone...
fields.JP:
……んー。
ラプンツェル、ずっとひとりだったのに
なんでかなあ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Weird... Rapunzel was
always alone...

fields.EN:
Maybe it's because you're slowly
growing into an adult.
fields.JP:
……それは、ラプンツェルが少しずつ、
大人に近付いてるんじゃないのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's because you're slowly
growing into an adult.

fields.EN:
I'm not an adult yet, but I think
they like to be with someone.
fields.JP:
僕もまだ大人じゃないけど、だから、
誰かと一緒にいるようになるんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not an adult yet, but I think
they like to be with someone.

fields.EN:
Mmm... It's good being with
Jack...
fields.JP:
んー……
じゃっくといっしょなのはいいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... It's good being with
Jack...

fields.JP:
よかった……
……ラプンツェル、お休み

fields.EN:
(Heh... Look at her sleeping...
She looks like any other kid...)
fields.JP:
（ふふ、穏やかな寝顔に……
　こうしてると、普通の子供だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh... Look at her sleeping...
She looks like any other kid...)

fields.JP: （ラプンツェル、まだ寂しいのかな……？）

fields.EN:
(I need to sleep... Time to
sleep...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to sleep... Time to
sleep...)

fields.JP: （痛っ……！　か、噛むのはやめて……！）

（……なんだろう？
　今度は抱きついてきた……）
……じゃっくといっしょ、うれしいな

（そうだ……！
　ラプンツェルは寂しいだけなんだ……！）

fields.EN:
Jack smells like what Rapunzel
likes...
fields.JP:
……じゃっくは、
ラプンツェルがすきなにおいがする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack smells like what Rapunzel
likes...

fields.EN:
Huh? Or, do I like Jack's smell?
Hm...
fields.JP:
……あれえ？
じゃっくのにおいだから、すきなのかなあ……
どっちだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Or, do I like Jack's smell?
Hm...

fields.JP:
……どっちでもいいや……
じゃっくの、おいしいにおい……
うう……ほとんど寝られなかった……

（……そういえば、
　ラプンツェル、いつ帰ったんだろう？）

fields.EN:
Wha--?! I got bite marks all over
me!
fields.JP: ああっ！　体中、歯形だらけだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha--?! I got bite marks all over
me!

fields.EN:
(What am I going to do about
this...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What am I going to do about
this...?)

fields.JP: おおーーーーーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel! Stop fooling around with
Kaguyahime's device! It's dangerous!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル！
かぐや姫の乗り物に触ったら危ないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel! Stop fooling around with
Kaguya's device! It's dangerous!

fields.EN:
Oh, but it isn't very dangerous.
All it does is float.
fields.JP:
あら、大したことないんじゃありませんこと？
浮いているだけですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but it isn't very dangerous.
All it does is float.

fields.JP: おおーーーーーーーーー？

fields.EN:
How does Kaguya's sitting thing
move?
fields.JP:
かぐやののってるの、
どうやってうごくの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How does Kaguya's sitting thing
move?

fields.EN:
It's no use telling you. I'm the
only one who can move it.
fields.JP:
知っても無意味です～
わらわしか動かせませんし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use telling you. I'm the
only one who can move it.

fields.JP: どうやってうごかすのーーー？

fields.EN:
Ohohohoho! I suppose not even
Kaguya can handle Rapu-Rapu!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほ！
さすがのかぐやさんも、
ラプラプには逆らえませんわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohohoho! I suppose not even
Kaguya can handle Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
困ります～
放っておいてほしいです～
ラプンツェル、もうそれくらいに……

fields.EN:
If she's that interested, why
don't you let her ride it?
fields.JP:
……いっそのこと、
乗せて差し上げたらいかがですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she's that interested, why
don't you let her ride it?

fields.EN:
Please don't ride it...! Please
get off...!
fields.JP:
乗らないでください～！
降りてください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't ride it...! Please
get off...!

fields.JP:
おおっ！
なんかいっぱいある！
あちこち触らないでください～

わわっ！
たかくなった！
じゃーこんどは……えいっ！
ラプラプ、およしあそばせ！
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
きゃはははは！
えいっ！

危ない！
シンデレラ、伏せて！

fields.EN:
Th-This isn't good! We need to
stop Rapunzel...!
fields.JP:
た、大変だ！
ラプンツェルを止めなきゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-This isn't good! We need to
stop Rapunzel...!

fields.JP: これ、たのしーーーーー！

fields.EN:
Here she comes... If I can just
get on it...
fields.JP:
こっちに来るぞ……
なんとか飛び乗れば……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here she comes... If I can just
get on it...

fields.JP: じゃっくだーーーーー！
えーーーーーーーーーい！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel! Don't jump on my stomach
like that!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル……
いきなりお腹に乗らないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel! Don't jump on my stomach
like that!

fields.JP:
おおっ！
じゃっく、どきどきしてるよ

fields.EN:
It's because I was scared and
because I'm hurt!
fields.JP: 怖かったし、痛いからだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because I was scared and
because I'm hurt!

fields.EN:
Aaah... Look at all this mess... I
need to clean the place up!
fields.JP:
ああっ……あちこちこんなに……！
お片づけしなければいけませんわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaah... Look at all this mess... I
need to clean the place up!

fields.EN:
Urrh... My Bamboo One... I'm never
going to leave my room now...
fields.JP:
うう……わらわのバンブー一号……
もう部屋から出ません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... My Bamboo One... I'm never
going to leave my room now...

fields.JP:
……ん？　なんだこれ？
ほうきだ……
（ひょっとして、シンデレラのかな？）
あ、ごめん……ジャックだけど……

fields.EN: Oh, Jack-san... Please, come right in.
fields.JP:
まあ……ジャックさんでしたの。
どうぞ、お入りになって？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Jack... Please, come right in.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: それで、一体何のご用ですの……

fields.EN:
Oh, so this is your broom, then. I
found it in the hallway.
fields.JP:
あ、やっぱりこのほうき、
シンデレラのなんだね。
廊下に置いてあったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so this is your broom, then. I
found it in the hallway.

fields.EN:
I-I-I can't believe what I've
done...! How embarrassing! I am so
sorry!
fields.JP:
わわわっ……わたくしとしたことが……
お恥ずかしいですわ！
申し訳ございませんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I-I can't believe what I've
done...! How embarrassing! I am so
sorry!

fields.EN:
I... wanted to thank you for
protecting me from the Nightmare.
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
この間は、その……
ナイトメアから守っていただきまして、
本当にありがとうございましたわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... wanted to thank you for
protecting me from the Nightmare.
Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
The pleasure's mine. Um, I hope we
can become better friends, too!
fields.JP:
ど、どういたしまして……
こちらこそ、改めてこれからもよろしく……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The pleasure's mine. Um, I hope we
can become better friends, too!

fields.EN:
By the way, those glass shoe
earrings look really good on you!
fields.JP:
そういえば、そのガラスの靴のイヤリング……
確かに、よく似合ってるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, those glass shoe
earrings look really good on you!

fields.JP: あ……ありがとうございますですわ……

fields.EN:
Speaking of...! Are you all right?
You used a great deal of your
blood, didn't you?
fields.JP:
あっ！　そういえば……！
貧血はもう大丈夫ですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of...! Are you all right?
You used a great deal of your
blood, didn't you?

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, yeah... I'm still a bit
dizzy, but I'm fine. Thanks.
fields.JP:
え？　ああ、うん……
まだちょっとフラフラするけど……
大丈夫だよ、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, yeah... I'm still a bit
dizzy, but I'm fine. Thanks.

fields.EN:
I know what would help you now!
Eating liver and seaweed would be
good!
fields.JP:
わたくしが貧血の対処法を教えて差し上げますわ！
貧血にはレバーがいいんですのよ！
あと、ひじきもオススメですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what would help you now!
Eating liver and seaweed would be
good!

fields.EN:
Also, be sure you loosen your
buttons and belt when you sleep
to improve your blood flow!
fields.JP:
あと、寝る時はシャツのボタンやベルトを
緩めるのを忘れてはなりませんわね。
血流を良くしないといけませんもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, be sure you loosen your
buttons and belt when you sleep
to improve your blood flow!

fields.JP:
へ、へえ……そうなんだ。
ありがとう……

fields.EN:
(She seems to be familiar with
folk remedies. In a way, she looks
almost too graceful to know...)
fields.JP:
（や、やたら民間療法に詳しい……
　なんだか見た目のイメージと違うな……
　ぱっと見、かっこいい人なのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She seems to be familiar with
folk remedies. In a way, she looks
almost too graceful to know...)

fields.EN:
If you feel ill or tired, by all
means, please consult me! I know
quite a bit that would help!
fields.JP:
他にも体調面で困った事がありましたら、
何でもお聞きになってくださいまし！
わたくし、そういうのは詳しいんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you feel ill or tired, by all
means, please consult me! I know
quite a bit that would help!

fields.EN:
(Given how earnest she is, she has
to be kind, too... right?)
fields.JP:
（でもこんなに一生懸命言ってくれてるんだ、
　きっと優しい人……なんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Given how earnest she is, she has
to be kind, too... right?)

fields.EN:
Hm? What's that on the ground? A...
hair ornament?
fields.JP:
ん？　また何か落ちてる。
これは……髪飾り……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's that on the ground? A...
hair ornament?

fields.EN:
(I recall Cinderella having one on
like this...)
fields.JP:
（確か、シンデレラがこんなのを
　付けてたような……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I recall Cinderella having one on
like this...)

fields.EN:
(Guess she drops things pretty
often... It seems to conflict with
how put together she looks...)
fields.JP:
（案外よく物を落とすんだな……
　しっかりしてそうに見えるのに……)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess she drops things pretty
often... It seems to conflict with
how put together she looks...)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Uh, yeah... Can I come in? In the
hallway I found a...
fields.JP:
あ、うん……入ってもいいかな？
実は廊下で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, yeah... Can I come in? In the
hallway I found a...

fields.EN:
Please don't open the door! I
don't want to see anyone right
now!
fields.JP:
……開けないでくださいまし！
誰とも会いたくないんですの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't open the door! I
don't want to see anyone right
now!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... It's just that I
found a hair ornament and thought
that maybe it belonged to you.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……
ただ、さっき廊下で髪飾りを拾ったから、
君のじゃないかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... It's just that I
found a hair ornament and thought
that maybe it belonged to you.

fields.EN:
How clumsy of me! I-I'm truly
sorry...!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさいまし……
わたくしったら……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How clumsy of me! I-I'm truly
sorry...!

fields.EN: Uh, okay... Um, so this is yours?
fields.JP: う、ううん……これ、君のだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, okay... Um, so this is yours?

fields.EN:
Ah... Yes... Thank goodness! I'm
so glad you found it!
fields.JP:
あ……ああ……よかった……！！
本当に……よかったですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Yes... Thank goodness! I'm
so glad you found it!

fields.JP: み、見つかってよかったね……？

fields.EN:
Thank you so very much, Jack-san. I
thought I had lost it
irrevocably...
fields.JP:
……ジャックさん、本当にありがとうございます。
わたくし……無くしてしまったのかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so very much, Jack. I
thought I had lost it
irrevocably...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
So, it must be pretty important to
you...
fields.JP: そんなに大事なものだったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it must be pretty important to
you...

fields.EN:
Th-That's not it... Well, it is
important, but...
fields.JP:
ち、違うんですの……
大事といえば、大事なのですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not it... Well, it is
important, but...

fields.EN:
I can't seem to explain it very
well, but... I've always been like
this...
fields.JP:
何故かは分からないのですけれど……
昔からわたくし……こうなんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't seem to explain it very
well, but... I've always been like
this...

fields.EN:
I get anxious the moment something
I wear goes missing... I begin
feeling unsightly and useless...
fields.JP:
自分が身に着けているものが一つでも欠けると、
どうしようもなく不安になって……
自分が醜い役立たずに思えてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get anxious the moment something
I wear goes missing... I begin
feeling unsightly and useless...

fields.EN:
I know it's strange, too. After
all that trouble I've caused,
and now this... I'm very sorry...
fields.JP:
自分でも変だとは分かっているんですの。
この間も、それでご迷惑をおかけしたのに……
本当にすみませんですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's strange, too. After
all that trouble I've caused,
and now this... I'm very sorry...

fields.EN:
You don't need to apologize... You
remember how I told you that I
have a strange urge, too?
fields.JP:
そんな……謝ることなんてないよ。
僕にもあるって言ったよね。
そういう、自分でもよく分からない衝動が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to apologize... You
remember how I told you that I
have a strange urge, too?

fields.EN:
Everyone said they have something
like that, too.
fields.JP: みんなだって、そう言ってたしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone said they have something
like that, too.

fields.EN:
That's why I know how you feel.
But, I've never thought of you as
useless or unsightly.
fields.JP:
……だから、気持ちは分かるんだ。
でも……僕はいつだって、
シンデレラは役立たずでも、醜くもないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I know how you feel.
But, I've never thought of you as
useless or unsightly.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
So, I'm not sure how to word it,
but... I'm sure you're okay as-is!
fields.JP:
だからその……うまく言えないけれど。
大丈夫だよ、きっと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'm not sure how to word it,
but... I'm sure you're okay as-is!

fields.JP: あ、ありがとうございます……

fields.EN:
Oh my, if it isn't Jack-san... What a
coincidence!
fields.JP:
あら。ジャックさん……
奇遇ですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, if it isn't Jack... What a
coincidence!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Huh? What's that in your hand?
fields.JP:
あれ？
手に持ってるそれは……何？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What's that in your hand?

fields.EN:
Ah, this? These are some sweets I
picked up the last time. Something
called "cookies."
fields.JP:
ああ……これですの？
これはこの間手に入れたお菓子ですわ。
クッキー、というものらしいのですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, this? These are some sweets I
picked up the last time. Something
called "cookies."

fields.EN:
Oh, cookies! I'm surprised you got
your hands on those!
fields.JP:
へー、クッキーかあ！
お菓子なんてよく手に入ったね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, cookies! I'm surprised you got
your hands on those!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... I'm surprised myself.
I wonder what they taste like.
fields.JP:
ふふ……わたくしもびっくりしましたのよ。
一体、どんな味がするのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... I'm surprised myself.
I wonder what they taste like.

fields.EN:
Heeeey! I know them! Cookies! So
good!
fields.JP:
あーーー！！
それしってるー！　くっきー！！
いいなーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heeeey! I know them! Cookies! So
good!

fields.EN:
Uh, Rapunzel? No. Those are
Cinderella's...
fields.JP:
あ、ラプンツェル。
ダメだよ、それはシンデレラの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, Rapunzel? No. Those are
Cinderella's...

fields.JP:
ラプラプ……
……これ、欲しいんですの？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
うん！
ラプンツェル、おかしだいすきーー！

そうですの……
でしたら、差し上げましてよ！

やったーー！！
ありがとーー！！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Make sure to savor
them. They aren't easy to come by,
after all...
fields.JP:
うふふ……
ゆっくり味わって食べるんですのよ。
なかなか手に入らないんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Make sure to savor
them. They aren't easy to come by,
after all...

fields.EN:
Yup! See you, Cinderella! Jack!
Thanks!
fields.JP:
うんーー！
じゃあね、シンデレラ、じゃっく！
ありがとーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! See you, Cinderella! Jack!
Thanks!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... Look at her so
happy... What innocence...
fields.JP:
ふふ……あんなにはしゃいで……
本当に、無邪気な方ですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... Look at her so
happy... What innocence...

fields.EN:
You're really okay with giving them
away?
fields.JP: シンデレラ、よかったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're really okay with giving them
away?

fields.EN:
It's fine... Did you see how happy
she was? This was for the best.
fields.JP:
別にかまいませんわ……
あんなに喜んでいらっしゃるんですもの！
……これでよかったんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine... Did you see how happy
she was? This was for the best.

fields.EN:
You're so kind, always thinking
about others...
fields.JP:
シンデレラは、いつも皆の事考えていて……
優しいんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so kind, always thinking
about others...

fields.JP:
いいえ……
そんなんじゃありませんの……

fields.EN:
You may have noticed that I'm
quite self-involved, so it's only
proper that I treat others kindly.
fields.JP:
わたくしはご覧のとおり見栄っ張りですし、
高慢ちきですもの……
他の方には、このくらい優しくしないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may have noticed that I'm
quite self-involved, so it's only
proper that I treat others kindly.

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm so sorry... P-Please
forget what I just said!
fields.JP:
あ、すみませんですわ……
な、なんでもありませんの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm so sorry... P-Please
forget what I just said!

fields.JP: ……僕は、そんな事ないと思うけど……

fields.EN:
If you were thinking of making
someone happy, and you made them
happy, it's because you were kind!
fields.JP:
シンデレラはみんなが喜ぶ事を考えて、
本当にそれをやってるんだから……
ほんとに優しいんだと思うよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were thinking of making
someone happy, and you made them
happy, it's because you were kind!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Ah... S-Sorry if that sounded too
forceful...
fields.JP:
あ……ご、ごめん！
偉そうな事言っちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... S-Sorry if that sounded too
forceful...

fields.EN:
No... Thank you very much! You
are... quite unique, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
いえ……ありがとうございます……！
ジャックさんって、その……
不思議な方なんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Thank you very much! You
are... quite unique, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
You listened to my thoughts, and
made me feel better ever so
quickly...
fields.JP:
わたくしの思い込みをきちんと聞いて下さって、
なのに、こんなに簡単に、そこから楽にして
下さるんですもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You listened to my thoughts, and
made me feel better ever so
quickly...

fields.EN:
You're the first I've met who has
been able to do that...
fields.JP: こんな方には、初めてお会いしましてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the first I've met who has
been able to do that...

fields.EN:
Oh, I know! I'm sure I had it in
my pocket...
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ！
確か、ポケットの中に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I know! I'm sure I had it in
my pocket...

fields.EN:
Here it is! I actually got this
recently...
fields.JP:
……あった！
実は僕も、この間ちょうど手に入れたんだ。
これ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here it is! I actually got this
recently...

fields.EN:
Is that... a chocolate? Why, and
it's shaped like a flower, too...
How cute!
fields.JP:
これは……確か、チョコレートでしたかしら？
まあ……それも、お花みたいな形。
なんだか可愛らしいですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that... a chocolate? Why, and
it's shaped like a flower, too...
How cute!

fields.EN: Yeah! Well... Will you accept it?
fields.JP:
うん……！
……これ、もらってくれないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Well... Will you accept it?

fields.EN:
What...? B-But... are you sure?
It isn't very easy to come by...
fields.JP:
えっ……？
で、でも……い、いいんですの？
せっかく手に入ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...? B-But... are you sure?
It isn't very easy to come by...

fields.EN:
I just thought it would be better
for you to have it... So, I want
you to have it, Cinderella.
fields.JP:
なんていうか……僕よりも、
シンデレラの方が似合いそうだなと思って……
だから、もらってほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just thought it would be better
for you to have it... So, I want
you to have it, Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Th-Thank you very much! Jack-san...
I couldn't be happier!
fields.JP:
あ……ありがとうございます！
ジャックさん……！
嬉しいですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thank you very much! Jack...
I couldn't be happier!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(Heh... I haven't seen Cinderella
this happy before...)
fields.JP:
（ふふ……
　こんなに素直に喜んでるシンデレラ、
　初めてみたな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh... I haven't seen Cinderella
this happy before...)

fields.EN:
Cinderella? It's me, Jack. Can I
come in?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ジャックだけど……
入ってもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella? It's me, Jack. Can I
come in?

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack-san! You've come! P-Please
wait a moment!
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……！
来てくださったんですのね！
……しょ、少々お待ちになって下さいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack! You've come! P-Please
wait a moment!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Thank you for waiting. Please,
come in!
fields.JP:
お待たせいたしましたわ……
どうぞ、お入りになって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for waiting. Please,
come in!

fields.EN: Jack-san! Please take a look at this!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん！
これをご覧になってくださいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! Please take a look at this!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Wow...! That's such a beautiful
dress! Where'd you get that?
fields.JP:
わあ……！
綺麗なドレスだね！
一体どうしたの、それ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow...! That's such a beautiful
dress! Where'd you get that?

fields.EN:
I found it in town the other day. Jack-san,
I really wanted you to see it...
fields.JP:
この間、街に行った時に見つけたんですわ。
それでぜひ……
ジャックさんにも見て頂きたかったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found it at the city. And... I
wanted you to see it.

fields.EN:
I see... I'm sure it'll look good
on you, Cinderella!
fields.JP:
そうなんだ……。
確かにシンデレラなら、すごく似合いそうだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I'm sure it'll look good
on you, Cinderella!

fields.EN:
*giggle*... I heard that everyone
used to wear clothing like this
back in the day, before the Jail!
fields.JP:
ふふ……ジェイルが無かった昔の時代は、
みんな、こんなお洋服を
着てらしたんですって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*giggle*... I heard that everyone
used to wear clothing like this
back in the day, before the Jail!

fields.EN:
If I could wear such a beautiful
dress like this, I'm sure I'll...!
fields.JP:
わたくしも、こんな素敵な服さえ着ていれば、
もっと、もっと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I could wear such a beautiful
dress like this, I'm sure I'll...!

fields.EN:
(Is this another one of
Cinderella's traits? She's already
beautiful as she is...)
fields.JP:
（これも、シンデレラの強迫観念なのか……？
　別に今のままだって、十分綺麗なのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this another one of
Cinderella's traits? She's already
beautiful as she is...)

fields.EN:
Next time... I'll try wearing this! And when I
do, Jack-san, I'd like you to...!
fields.JP:
今度……これを着てみますわね！
またその時は、ジャックさんに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next time, I'll try it on, so I'd
like you to...!

fields.JP:
……シンデレラ。
少し聞いてほしいんだけど……

fields.EN:
Oh? What is it? You look very
serious...
fields.JP:
あら……どうしましたの？
急に神妙な顔をして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? What is it? You look very
serious...

fields.EN:
That dress is beautiful, and I
think it would look great on you,
but...
fields.JP:
確かにそのドレスは綺麗だし、
シンデレラにもきっと似合うと思う。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That dress is beautiful, and I
think it would look great on you,
but...

fields.EN:
You're already beautiful as you
are. No one could deny that.
fields.JP:
別に……着飾ったりなんかしなくても、
シンデレラは綺麗だよ。
それに、誰も認めてくれないなんて事もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're already beautiful as you
are. No one could deny that.

fields.EN:
So, I don't think you need to do
this much... You're good just the
way you are.
fields.JP:
だから……その、そんなに無理したり、
しなくてもいいと思うんだ。
そのままの君で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I don't think you need to do
this much... You're good just the
way you are.

fields.EN:
What... What do you know? You
wouldn't know how I feel...
fields.JP:
貴方に……貴方に何がわかりますの？
わたくしの気持ちの、何が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What... What do you know? You
wouldn't know how I feel...

fields.EN:
Huh...? Sorry! I-I wasn't trying
to...
fields.JP:
え……ごめん……！
僕は、そんなつもりじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? Sorry! I-I wasn't trying
to...

fields.EN:
And here I thought that you...
That you would understand me!
fields.JP:
貴方なら、貴方だけは……
理解してくださると思ってましたのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And here I thought that you...
That you would understand me!

fields.EN:
I think I've had enough... Please
leave!
fields.JP:
もういいですわ……
……少し、一人にしてくださいまし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I've had enough... Please
leave!

fields.EN:
(I thought I said it for her own
good, but it looks like I only
hurt her...)
fields.JP:
（良かれと思って言ったはずなのに……
　結局、傷つけてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought I said it for her own
good, but it looks like I only
hurt her...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I worded it too strongly to
Cinderella... She looked so
sad...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、この間……
　シンデレラに強く言いすぎたのかな……？
　シンデレラ、すごく悲しそうな顔してた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I worded it too strongly to
Cinderella... She looked so
sad...)

fields.EN:
(She must have been suffering all
this time. And then I come along
and push my feelings onto hers...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラだって、きっとずっと悩んでたんだ。
　それなのに僕は、自分の気持ちを押し付けて
　しまったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must have been suffering all
this time. And then I come along
and push my feelings onto hers...)

fields.JP:
きゃあっ！　メルヒェンよ！
メルヒェンが……！

め、メルヒェン！？
なんで、こんなところに！？
おい！　みんな逃げろ！

fields.EN:
Where the hell is the Dawn when
you need them?!
fields.JP: 黎明の連中は何やってんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where the hell is the Dawn when
you need them?!

fields.EN:
(What should I do?! Can I take
care of this myself?!)
fields.JP:
（どうする……！？
　僕一人でなんとかなるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What should I do?! Can I take
care of this myself?!)

fields.EN:
(No... I should get everyone to
safety first!)
fields.JP:
（いや、それよりも街の人達を早く
　避難させないと！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... I should get everyone to
safety first!)

fields.JP: （とりあえず、表通りに出ないと……！）

fields.EN:
(Tch! I let my guard down! My
arm...! Wh-What should I do?! At
this rate...!)
fields.JP:
（くっ、油断した……！
　腕が……ど、どうする……！？
　このままじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Tch! I let my guard down! My
arm...! Wh-What should I do?! At
this rate...!)

fields.JP:
（くそっ……
　こ、こんなところで……！！）
メルヒェンが倒れたぞ！
あの女の子が倒してくれたの！

fields.EN:
A member of the Dawn?! Just in the
nick of time!
fields.JP: 黎明の人か！　ありがたい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A member of the Dawn?! Just in the
nick of time!

fields.EN:
That was close...! Jack-san, are you
all right?!
fields.JP:
危ないところでしたわ……！
ジャックさん、ご無事でして！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was close...! Jack, are you
all right?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
う、うん……！
ありがとう、助かったよ……

fields.EN:
Jack-san...! Look at that gash on your
arm!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、貴方……！
腕を怪我しているじゃありませんの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...! Look at that gash on your
arm!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
It's okay... The cut isn't deep,
so...
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だよ……
傷はそこまで深くないし、このくらい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay... The cut isn't deep,
so...

fields.JP: ……少しお待ちになってくださいまし……！

し、シンデレラ！？
そのドレスは！

……いいんですわ。
それより少しじっとしててくださいましね……！

fields.EN:
That should do it... The bleeding
will subside, so it won't get any
worse.
fields.JP:
……これでよし、ですわ。
出血さえ止まれば、そこまで大事には
至りませんもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should do it... The bleeding
will subside, so it won't get any
worse.

fields.EN:
It's only temporary, but you
should be fine now.
fields.JP:
……応急処置ですけれど、
これで、ひとまずは安心ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only temporary, but you
should be fine now.

fields.EN:
Thank you... But... Wasn't that
dress important to you?
fields.JP:
ありがとう……
でもその服……大切なものだったんじゃ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you... But... Wasn't that
dress important to you?

fields.EN:
What are you saying?! Caring for
your wounds is more important!
fields.JP:
何を言ってますの！？
今は、貴方の手当ての方が大切でしてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?! Caring for
your wounds is more important!

fields.EN:
It's not only your looks... Your
heart is beautiful, too...
fields.JP:
君は……見た目だけじゃなくて、
何よりも、心が綺麗なんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not only your looks... Your
heart is beautiful, too...

fields.EN:
What? Th-That came out of
nowhere...!
fields.JP:
えっ？
な、何を突然……仰いますの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Th-That came out of
nowhere...!

fields.EN:
(Wh-What did I just say?! That was
embarrassing!)
fields.JP:
（な、何を言ってるんだ僕は……
　めちゃくちゃ恥ずかしいぞ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What did I just say?! That was
embarrassing!)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Come to think of it... Why did you
have that dress with you?
fields.JP:
でも、そういえば……
何でシンデレラはあの服を持ってたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it... Why did you
have that dress with you?

fields.JP:
そ、それは、その……
試そうとしたんですの

fields.EN:
Jack-san, I've been thinking about what you
said to me the other day... and I realized
something.
fields.JP:
この間、ジャックさんがおっしゃった事……
わたくしなりに考えましたの。
それで……気付いたんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought about what you said to
me before, and then I realized...

fields.EN:
I realized that you really said that because
you were thinking of me, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは、本当にわたくしのためを思って
ああ言ってくださったんだ、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That you were saying it, thinking
about me...

fields.EN:
That's why I was testing myself to
see if I could let go of my dress.
If I could overcome myself...
fields.JP:
だから、自分を乗り越えようと……
服を本当に手放せるのか、
試そうとしていたんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was testing myself to
see if I could let go of my dress.
If I could overcome myself...

fields.EN:
Cinderella... I'm sorry for
cornering you like that...
fields.JP:
シンデレラ……
そこまで思い詰めさせてしまって、ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella... I'm sorry for
cornering you like that...

fields.EN: No... this was fine. In the end, something unexpected happened, so we never found out the result...
fields.JP:
いえ……これでよかったんですのよ。
結局、思わぬ事になってしまったので、
結果は分からずじまいでしたけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... It's completely fine. There
was no telling what might have
happened...

fields.EN:
Everyone has a particular
attachment, so... you don't have
to force yourself away from it...
fields.JP:
こだわりは、僕たち誰もが持ってるものだし……
……だから、無理しなくてもいいと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone has a particular
attachment, so... you don't have
to force yourself away from it...

fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
確かに、そうかもしれませんわね……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Whatever the case, I appreciate
what you said to me.
fields.JP:
それでもわたくし、やっぱり感謝してますのよ？
ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the case, I appreciate
what you said to me.

fields.EN:
Let's do our best together, one
step at a time... So, I hope we
can get along better.
fields.JP:
……お互い、ゆっくり、頑張っていこう？
改めて、これからも、よろしくね。
シンデレラ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's do our best together, one
step at a time... So, I hope we
can get along better.

fields.JP: ええ……わたくしこそ、ですわ……

fields.EN:
(Cinderella? What's she doing over
there? She looks really stressed
out...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラだ……どうしたんだろう？
　何だか思いつめてるみたいだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella? What's she doing over
there? She looks really stressed
out...)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Well... I can't seem to hold back
the urge to become more
beautiful...
fields.JP:
実は、その……
また、綺麗になりたい衝動が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I can't seem to hold back
the urge to become more
beautiful...

fields.EN:
(Looks like she's still suffering
over it... If only there was
something I could do for her...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、まだ苦しめられてるんだな……
　僕に何か出来る事があればいいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like she's still suffering
over it... If only there was
something I could do for her...)

fields.EN:
It just comes in spurts... But
I finally found out recently...
fields.JP:
……時々、発作のようにやってくるんですの。
でも……最近、気付いたことがありますのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just comes in spurts... But
I finally found out recently...

fields.EN:
That my desire to be more
beautiful was because I wanted to
show myself to someone...
fields.JP:
最近わたくしが思う、綺麗になりたいという
気持ちは……
誰かに、それを見せたいということなんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That my desire to be more
beautiful was because I wanted to
show myself to someone...

fields.EN:
S-So, I was just thinking about
that...
fields.JP:
だ、だからその……
その事についてずっと考えてましたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So, I was just thinking about
that...

fields.EN:
Is there a specific "someone"
you're referring to?
fields.JP:
でも、じゃあその見せたい相手って……
一体誰なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a specific "someone"
you're referring to?

fields.EN:
(Huh? Did I ask her something
strange?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　も、もしかして……
　変な事聞いちゃったかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Did I ask her something
strange?)

fields.EN:
Well... How can I word this...?
It's someone always close to me...
More like, in front of me...
fields.JP:
えっと……その……
……いつも近くにいるというか……
というか、目の前に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... How can I word this...?
It's someone always close to me...
More like, in front of me...

fields.EN:
(Why is she mumbling...? I can't
hear her voice with how softly
she's speaking...)
fields.JP:
（急に声が小さくなって……どうしたんだろ？
　よく聞こえないけど……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is she mumbling...? I can't
hear her voice with how softly
she's speaking...)

fields.JP:
ジャ……
ジャックさん、貴方ですわ……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
*cough* I-In any case! I will
strive to be ever more beautiful
both on the outside and inside!
fields.JP:
ごほん！　と、とにかく……！
わたくしはこれまで以上に！
心も見た目も誰よりも綺麗になりましてよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*cough* I-In any case! I will
strive to be ever more beautiful
both on the outside and inside!

fields.EN:
I-I see...! Okay! I'm rooting for
you!
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……！
うん、僕も応援してるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see...! Okay! I'm rooting for
you!

fields.EN:
*sigh* I can't believe how dim he
is...
fields.JP:
はあ……
いくらなんでも鈍感すぎますわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I can't believe how dim he
is...

fields.JP:
えっ？
今、何か言った？

fields.EN:
N-Nothing at all! You're hearing
things!
fields.JP:
な、なんでもありませんわ！
気のせいではありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Nothing at all! You're hearing
things!

fields.EN: (I-I don't really understand what happened, but... Cinderella looks so full of life...! I'm glad she seems to be feeling more positive...!)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだかよくわからないけど……
　シンデレラ、生き生きしてるな……！
　前向きになれたみたいでよかった……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not sure what happened, but
at least she's back to her old
self.)

fields.EN:
Wha-?! Wh-What's that sound?!
Where did it come from?!
fields.JP:
わっ！？　な、なんだ今の音は！？
ど、どこから！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Wh-What's that sound?!
Where did it come from?!

fields.JP:
これは……ラプンツェルの部屋からだ……！
一体、何があったんだ！？

ラプンツェル！？
一体、何を……

あはははーーー！！
かみのけくるくるーーー！！

fields.EN:
(C-Cinderella? What's she doing?
Are they roughhousing...?)
fields.JP:
（し、シンデレラ？
　な、何をやってるんだ！？
　まさか、何か乱暴なことを……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(C-Cinderella? What's she doing?
Are they roughhousing...?)

fields.JP: くるくるくるくるーーー！！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... My, my, Rapu-Rapu! Time
for payback! Pinchy, pinch!
fields.JP:
ふふふ……
もう、ラプラプったら……！
仕返しですわよ。ぷにぷにぷに！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... My, my, Rappy! Time
for payback! Pinchy, pinch!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
あははははは！！
ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！

fields.EN:
(Wh-What are they doing? It looks
like... they're both having fun.)
fields.JP:
（な、何やってるんだ……？
　どっちも、ものすごく楽しそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What are they doing? It looks
like... they're both having fun.)

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I must say, your skin
is so smooth... I'm quite jealous...
fields.JP:
ふふふ……それにしても、ラプラプのお肌は
本当につるっつるですのね……
うらやましいですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I must say, your skin
is so smooth... I'm quite jealous...

fields.EN:
Cinderella's smooth, too! See?
Pinch, pinch, pinch!
fields.JP:
シンデレラだって、つるつるだよーー！！
ほらー。ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella's smooth, too! See?
Pinch, pinch, pinch!

fields.EN:
Eep! That tickles...! Heh, heh...
Now you've done it! Pinch, pinch,
pinch!
fields.JP:
きゃっ！？　くすぐったい……
うふふ……やってくれましたわね！
ぷにぷにぷにぷに！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eep! That tickles...! Heh, heh...
Now you've done it! Pinch, pinch,
pinch!

fields.JP:
きゃははは！！
ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！

ふふふ……
ぷにぷにぷにぷにーー！！

fields.EN:
(They're really cute, but... I'll
just assume I didn't see this.
Better move before they see me...)
fields.JP:
（こ、これは……なんか微笑ましいけど、
　見なかった事にした方が良さそうだな……
　そっと退散しよう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're really cute, but... I'll
just assume I didn't see this.
Better move before they see me...)

fields.JP:
あ、じゃっくだ！！
じゃっくー！！

fields.EN:
Ah... Oh my... Jack-san! What are you
doing here?
fields.JP:
あ、あら、ジャックさん……！
一体何故こんなところに……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... Oh my... Jack! What are you
doing here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: じゃっくもいっしょにぷにぷにやろー！！

fields.EN:
Huh?! N-No, I'm fine! I-I'll see
you both later!
fields.JP:
えっ！？
い、いや僕はいいよ！！
じゃ、じゃあまたね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! N-No, I'm fine! I-I'll see
you both later!

fields.JP:
じゃっく、いっちゃった……
へんなのーー！！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(They were having fun, but there's
no way I could've joined them...)
fields.JP:
（楽しそうだったけど、
　あれに混ざるのは……いくらなんでも、
　ハードルが高すぎるよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They were having fun, but there's
no way I could've joined them...)

fields.JP: ジャックさん、いらっしゃいまして？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
あ、シンデレラ……！
どうしたの？

fields.EN:
Well... I wanted to show you
something!
fields.JP:
その……
実は、見て頂きたいものがあるんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I wanted to show you
something!

fields.JP:
じゃーん！！
これですわ！

fields.EN:
That's...! What is it...? It looks
like a bullet...
fields.JP:
これは……何？
筒みたいな形だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's...! What is it...? It looks
like a bullet...

fields.JP:
ふふふ……
これは、『口紅』ですわ！

口紅……？
何に使うものなの？

fields.EN:
I'm... not sure. I heard it was
something called "cosmetics," used
by girls long ago.
fields.JP:
それが……わたくしにもわかりませんの。
昔の女性がしていたという、『お化粧』に
関係のあるものらしいんですけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... not sure. I heard it was
something called "cosmetics," used
by girls long ago.

fields.EN:
"Cosmetics?" Used by girls long
ago...? You sure know a lot...
fields.JP:
『おけしょう』？
へえ、昔の女の人が……
っていうか、よくそんなこと知ってるね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Cosmetics?" Used by girls long
ago...? You sure know a lot...

fields.EN:
(Now that I think about it, there
are a lot of things from long ago
I don't know about...)
fields.JP:
（昔は、僕たちの知らないものが
　たくさんあったんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I think about it, there
are a lot of things from long ago
I don't know about...)

fields.EN:
It was in this old magazine.
Unfortunately, I couldn't read
much with how it's torn all over.
fields.JP:
この古雑誌に載ってましたの。
ところどころ破れていて、
詳しいことがわからないのが残念ですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was in this old magazine.
Unfortunately, I couldn't read
much with how it's torn all over.

fields.EN:
I see... So, why did you want to
show me that?
fields.JP:
そっか……
でも、何でまた、僕にこれを？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So, why did you want to
show me that?

fields.EN:
Well, it seems as if this lipstick
needs to be applied to your lips
using your fingers.
fields.JP:
実は……『口紅』は、誰かに
『指で唇に塗ってもらう』ものらしいんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems as if this lipstick
needs to be applied to your lips
using your fingers.

fields.EN:
Fingers...? Lips...? Wait... Y-You
don't mean...?!
fields.JP:
指で……唇に……？
って、ええっ！？
ま、まさか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fingers...? Lips...? Wait... Y-You
don't mean...?!

fields.EN:
That's exactly it! I... I want you to put the
lipstick on me, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
そのまさか、ですわ！
わたくし……是非ジャックさんに、
口紅を塗って欲しいんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I wanted you to... apply
the lipstick onto my lips!

fields.JP:
そそそ、そんな……！
急に言われても……！
いや、そ……そんな事はないけど……

fields.EN:
Well then, if you could!
Please...!
fields.JP:
……それでは、さっそく……
お願いいたしますわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, if you could!
Please...!

fields.EN:
(W-Why did she close her eyes?!
Well, not that having them open
would have been any better...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんで目を閉じるんだ……！？
　いや、開けられてても、
　それはそれで困るけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(W-Why did she close her eyes?!
Well, not that having them open
would have been any better...)

fields.EN:
O-Okay... I'm going to put it
on...
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay... I'm going to put it
on...

fields.EN:
It... It's fine! It's just that it
tickled... I'm fine!
fields.JP:
な、何でもありませんわ！
ただ、少しくすぐったくて……
でも、大丈夫ですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It... It's fine! It's just that it
tickled... I'm fine!

fields.JP:
そ、そっか……
じゃあ、続きを……
（な、なんかドキドキするんですけど……）

fields.EN:
(Cinderella's lips are so soft...
What am I thinking?! I need to
focus here...!)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラの唇……や、柔らかい……
　って、何考えてんだ僕は！
　ちゃんとやらないと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella's lips are so soft...
What am I thinking?! I need to
focus here...!)

fields.EN: Really?! Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
本当でして！？
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED: Really?! Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
Heh, well... I didn't do
anything...
fields.JP:
いや、そんな大げさな……
あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, well... I didn't do
anything...

fields.EN: S-So how is it? Does it look good?
fields.JP:
ど、どうですかしら……？
似合っていまして……？
fields.LOCALIZED: S-So how is it? Does it look good?

fields.EN:
(She looks beautiful... And a bit
more mature... So this is what
cosmetics do...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんか……
　いつもより大人っぽいというか……
　綺麗だなあ……これが、化粧か……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks beautiful... And a bit
more mature... So this is what
cosmetics do...)

fields.EN:
Uh... N-No! Nothing! You look
really great!
fields.JP:
え……い、いや、なんでもないよ！
よく、似合ってるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... N-No! Nothing! You look
really great!

fields.EN:
Th-Thank you very much! I'm so
happy to hear that!
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとうございます……！
嬉しいですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thank you very much! I'm so
happy to hear that!

fields.EN:
These cosmetic things are really
something!
fields.JP: 化粧って、すごいんだね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
These cosmetic things are really
something!

fields.EN:
It seems that girls from back then
used to use these often. See? It
says so right here...
fields.JP:
昔の女性はみんな、していたらしいんですの。
ほら、この古雑誌にも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems that girls from back then
used to use these often. See? It
says so right here...

fields.EN: Hm? Let me see... Huh? It says...
fields.JP:
へえ、どれどれ……ん？
これって……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Let me see... Huh? It says...

fields.EN:
I guess you can put the lipstick
on yourself... The picture here
shows her using it herself...
fields.JP:
……く、口紅って……
別に人に塗ってもらわなくてもいいんだね……
この雑誌の中の人、自分で塗ってるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can put the lipstick
on yourself... The picture here
shows her using it herself...

fields.EN:
Why, yes... And, it seems you
don't need to smear it on your
finger first...
fields.JP:
え、ええ……
しかも、別に指で塗らなくてもいい……
みたいですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes... And, it seems you
don't need to smear it on your
finger first...

fields.EN:
Um... Heh, heh! Guess we had that
all wrong...
fields.JP:
あ、あはは……！
早とちりしちゃったね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Heh, heh! Guess we had that
all wrong...

fields.JP:
そ、そうですわね……
ご、ごめんなさいまし……！

fields.EN:
(Now that I think about it, that
should've been obvious... But,
what an experience that was...)
fields.JP:
（そ、そりゃそうだよね、よく考えたら……
　それにしても、ドキドキしたなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that I think about it, that
should've been obvious... But,
what an experience that was...)

fields.EN:
(That's Cinderella, Shirayukihime,
and... Gretel? They all look so
serious...)
fields.JP:
（あれは……
　シンデレラに、白雪姫に……グレーテル？
　真剣な顔して、何話してるんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's Cinderella, Snow White,
and... Gretel? They all look so
serious...)

fields.EN:
Food contains something called
"calories," and it relates
strongly to fashion!
fields.JP:
……よろしくて？
食べ物には、カロリーというものがあって……
これがおしゃれとは密接な関係がありますのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Food contains something called
"calories," and it relates
strongly to fashion!

fields.JP: ふむふむ……なるほどです……！

fields.EN:
That's a bit vague. How do they
relate?
fields.JP:
……いまいちよく分からないわ。
どう関係しているのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a bit vague. How do they
relate?

fields.EN:
Well, if you consume too many
calories, you'll grow fat! The
horror!
fields.JP:
だって……カロリーを摂りすぎると、
太ってしまいますのよ……！
ああ、なんて恐ろしい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you consume too many
calories, you'll grow fat! The
horror!

fields.EN:
That really is scary! I'd better be
careful of what I eat!
fields.JP:
そ、それは恐ろしいですね……！
摂りすぎないようにしないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That really is scary! I'd better be
careful of what I eat!

fields.EN:
That still doesn't make sense. How
does being fat relate to fashion?
fields.JP:
……やはり理解できないわね。
太るのと『おしゃれ』には、
何の関係があるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That still doesn't make sense. How
does being fat relate to fashion?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? You need to keep
your figure in order to enjoy
fashion!
fields.JP:
そんなの、決まってますわ。
おしゃれをしたいなら、
まずは体型が何よりも大事だからですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? You need to keep
your figure in order to enjoy
fashion!

fields.EN:
What?! I knew it... You're
right... Urrh... I need to lose
more weight...
fields.JP:
がーん……！
やっぱり、そうですよね……
うう……もっと痩せないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I knew it... You're
right... Urrh... I need to lose
more weight...

fields.EN: So... is there some benefit to being "fashionable"? Otherwise, I can't see why you'd have to try this hard...
fields.JP:
で……『おしゃれ』になると何か得をするの？
でないと、そこまで必死にならなければならない
理由が見出せないのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what are the benefits of this
"fashion?" It all sounds
needlessly vain.

fields.EN:
(I see... She's teaching Gretel
about fashion... That's going to
be tough...)
fields.JP:
（な、なるほど……
　グレーテルに『おしゃれ』について
　教えてるのか……大変そうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... She's teaching Gretel
about fashion... That's going to
be tough...)

fields.EN:
It isn't a matter of benefits!
It's only natural to want to be as
attractive as possible.
fields.JP:
得とか損とかの問題ではありませんわ！
魅力的になりたいというのは、
女性なら皆持っている願望ではありませんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't a matter of benefits!
It's only natural to want to be as
attractive as possible.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, that doesn't apply
to me. It's not needed for my
survival.
fields.JP:
残念ながら、
そういった願望は私にはないわね。
だって、生存に必要なものとは思えないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, that doesn't apply
to me. It's not needed for my
survival.

fields.EN:
W-Well, that's sort of an end-all
conclusion...
fields.JP: そ、それを言ったら身も蓋もないですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, that's sort of an end-all
conclusion...

fields.EN:
*sigh* What don't you understand
about what I explained to you?
fields.JP:
はあ……
何でわかって頂けないのかしら……
わたくしの説明がいけませんのかしら……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* What don't you understand
about what I explained to you?

fields.EN:
Well now, what are you three
talking about?
fields.JP: あら、三人揃って……何の話をしているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, what are you three
talking about?

fields.EN:
Oh, Alice-san! You came at just the
right time! We were talking about
fashion with Gretel-san, and...
fields.JP:
あ、アリスさん……
ちょうどいいところに来ましたわ！
今、グレーテルさんに『おしゃれ』について……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Alice! You came at just the
right time! We were talking about
fashion with Gretel, and...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP:
おしゃれ？
おしゃれ……って、何かしら？

fields.EN:
You like cute things, don't you,
Alice-san? Fashion is... to be cute!
fields.JP:
アリスさんは、可愛いものが好きですわよね？
おしゃれとは……そう、ずばり……！
『可愛い』ことですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You like cute things, don't you,
Alice? Fashion is... to be cute!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
You're losing me with each
explanation...
fields.JP: ますます理解できなくなったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're losing me with each
explanation...

fields.EN:
I like cute things, but... what
does that have to do with this
"fashion" thing?
fields.JP:
可愛いものは好きだけど……
それが『おしゃれ』と何の関係があるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like cute things, but... what
does that have to do with this
"fashion" thing?

fields.EN:
Those who pay attention to fashion
become cute and beautiful!
fields.JP:
女の子がおしゃれをすると、
可愛く、そして綺麗になるんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those who pay attention to fashion
become cute and beautiful!

fields.EN:
Become cute? As in, like a plush
doll? Is that what this is about?
fields.JP:
……可愛く？
ぬいぐるみみたいに、ということかしら？
……そうなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Become cute? As in, like a plush
doll? Is that what this is about?

fields.EN:
N-No, that's not the point... It
means wearing beautiful dresses
and adorning oneself!
fields.JP:
い、いえ、そういう事ではなくて……
もっと、綺麗なドレスで着飾ったりとか、
そういう事ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No, that's not the point... It
means wearing beautiful dresses
and adorning oneself!

fields.EN:
The "cute" Alice mentioned applies
to others, but this "fashion"
applies to yourself, right?
fields.JP:
アリスの言った『可愛い』は、
自分以外の対象物に対してでしょう？
でも、おしゃれはあくまで自分の話なのよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The "cute" Alice mentioned applies
to others, but this "fashion"
applies to yourself, right?

fields.EN:
So, you're telling me that I
should be cute like a plush doll?
I never thought of that before...
fields.JP:
自分がぬいぐるみみたいに、
可愛くなるということ？
あまり考えたことはないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're telling me that I
should be cute like a plush doll?
I never thought of that before...

fields.EN:
In the first place, the subjective
quality of "cute" doesn't stand
without an observer. If so...
fields.JP:
そもそも、『可愛い』という感情自体が、
他者の存在なくして成立しないわ。
という事は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the first place, the subjective
quality of "cute" doesn't stand
without an observer. If so...

fields.EN:
Then the "cute" here applies
toward the concept that you wish
to be looked upon as being cute?
fields.JP:
つまり、自分以外の誰かから、
自分の事を『可愛い』と思われたい、
という事かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then the "cute" here applies
toward the concept that you wish
to be looked upon as being cute?

fields.EN:
I deduce that's the case here...
It still bewilders me as to why
one would want that validation.
fields.JP:
……理屈で言えば、そういう事になるわね。
なぜ他人からの無意味な評価を得たいのか、
私には理解できないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I deduce that's the case here...
It still bewilders me as to why
one would want that validation.

fields.EN:
I don't mind the idea of being
cute, but I'm not sure how "cute"
and "fashion" correlate.
fields.JP:
ええ。普通に『可愛い』でいいようにも思うわ。
それに、『可愛くなる』ことと『おしゃれ』の
関係が、どうしてもよくわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind the idea of being
cute, but I'm not sure how "cute"
and "fashion" correlate.

fields.EN:
True. If the objective is simply
to be seen as cute, fashion itself
isn't a mandatory element.
fields.JP:
そうね。『可愛い』と思われたいという目的だけ
ならば、なにも『おしゃれ』という手段が必須
だとは考えられないのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. If the objective is simply
to be seen as cute, fashion itself
isn't a mandatory element.

fields.EN:
I have no idea what you two are
talking about. Isn't that right,
Cinderella-san?
fields.JP:
ふ、二人とも……何を言ってるのか
白雪には分からないです……
シンデレラさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no idea what you two are
talking about. Isn't that right,
Cinderella?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Yes... My head is starting to
throb... Wait... What is "fashion"
again?
fields.JP:
ええ……なんだかわたくしまで、
頭が痛くなってきましたわ……
おしゃれって、一体……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... My head is starting to
throb... Wait... What is "fashion"
again?

fields.JP: ラプンツェルにはわかるよーー！！

fields.EN:
Rapu-Rapu?! Since when...?! Why are
you...?!
fields.JP:
ラプラプ！！？
いつの間に……
って、その格好はなんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy?! Since when...?! Why are
you...?!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
やっぱり、はだかがいちばんだよーーー！！
あははははーー！！

fields.EN:
W-Wait up! Rapu-Rapu! Don't be running
around like that!
fields.JP:
ま……待ちなさい、ラプラプ！！
そんな格好で、はしたない！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait up! Rappy! Don't be running
around like that!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I suppose we can discuss more
about this later. First, we need
to stop her!
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわ……
この話はまた今度にしましょう。
皆で取り押さえなければ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we can discuss more
about this later. First, we need
to stop her!

fields.JP: まったく……面倒なことね

だ、ダメですよー！
ラプンツェルさーん！！

fields.EN:
(Well... Hm... I'll just pretend
nothing happened here...)
fields.JP:
（え……ええと……
　何も見なかったし聞かなかったってことで
　いいかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well... Hm... I'll just pretend
nothing happened here...)

fields.EN:
(It looks like she's calling for
help! Did something happen?!)
fields.JP:
（誰かを呼んでるみたいだ……！
　ひょっとして、何かあったのかな！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like she's calling for
help! Did something happen?!)

fields.JP: かぐや姫！　どうしたの！？

fields.EN:
That voice... Jack? Perfect
timing. Please come in...
fields.JP:
あ、その声は……ジャックですね～。
ちょうど良かったです～。入ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That voice... Jack? Perfect
timing. Please come in...

fields.EN:
(She sounded a lot calmer than I
thought...)
fields.JP: （あ、案外落ち着いてたみたいだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sounded a lot calmer than I
thought...)

fields.JP: あのう、一体どうしたの？

fields.EN:
(Urgh! Look at how messy her room
is! I'm not even sure how she got
this place so messy!)
fields.JP:
（っていうか……この部屋散らかりすぎ！
　どうしたらここまで散らかせるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urgh! Look at how messy her room
is! I'm not even sure how she got
this place so messy!)

fields.EN:
Can you please get that book over
there...?
fields.JP: ああ。そこにある本を取ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you please get that book over
there...?

fields.EN:
I didn't want to move and get it
myself. It was very troubling...
fields.JP:
どうしてもこの場所から動きたくなくて……
とても困っていたのです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to move and get it
myself. It was very troubling...

fields.EN:
I usually can reach things on my
own, but I couldn't today, even
with this magical hand of mine...
fields.JP:
いつもなら自分で取るんですよ～？
この『魔法の手』で……でも、届かなくて～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I usually can reach things on my
own, but I couldn't today, even
with this magical hand of mine...

fields.EN:
"Magical hand?" You mean that toy
thing you have there?
fields.JP:
ま……『魔法の手』？
そのおもちゃの手みたいなものが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Magical hand?" You mean that toy
thing you have there?

fields.EN:
It's one of my special tools that
help me be lazy... I use it to
grab things...
fields.JP:
わらわのさぼり七つ道具の一つです～
こうやって……
物を取る時に使うんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's one of my special tools that
help me be lazy... I use it to
grab things...

fields.EN:
(She has more of these? She really
is lazy...)
fields.JP:
（こ、こんなものがあと六つも……？
　筋金入りのめんどくさがりだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has more of these? She really
is lazy...)

fields.JP:
なかなか役に立つじゃないですか～
ちょっと見直しました～

fields.EN:
Um, but you could've done this
yourself...
fields.JP:
……っていうか、
さすがにこのくらいは、自分で取ろうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but you could've done this
yourself...

fields.JP: 嫌です、めんどくさいです～

fields.EN:
I know! Why don't you clean my
room while you're at it?
fields.JP:
……あ、そうだ！
ついでに、この部屋を片付けてくれませんか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! Why don't you clean my
room while you're at it?

fields.EN:
You seem like the clean type...
You should put your cleaning
skills to the test here...
fields.JP:
そなたが几帳面そうだからです～
掃除は、得意な人がやるべきです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem like the clean type...
You should put your cleaning
skills to the test here...

fields.JP: はあ……もう、仕方ないなあ……

fields.EN:
(I sometimes hate myself for being
so compliant...)
fields.JP:
（と、言いつつ……
　ついついやってしまう僕も僕だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sometimes hate myself for being
so compliant...)

fields.EN:
Whew... That should do it. I'm
done cleaning.
fields.JP:
ふう……よし、こんなもんかな。
片付け、終わったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... That should do it. I'm
done cleaning.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. You really
are quite something... I knew you
had it in you...
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～。
そなたはなかなか見所がありますね～
わらわの目に狂いはなかったです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. You really
are quite something... I knew you
had it in you...

fields.EN:
Never mind that... Thanks, and I'm
counting on you...
fields.JP:
まあいいじゃないですか～。
これからも、よろしくです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never mind that... Thanks, and I'm
counting on you...

fields.EN:
Huh? Um, right... Well, I'll be
leaving, then.
fields.JP:
え？　う、うん……よろしく……！
それじゃあ、僕はこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Um, right... Well, I'll be
leaving, then.

fields.EN:
(Again? She wants me to clean her
room again, doesn't she?)
fields.JP:
（また今度って……
　まさか、次も掃除させられるんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Again? She wants me to clean her
room again, doesn't she?)

fields.EN: Uh, so what's this about again?
fields.JP: えーと……それで、今日は一体何の用？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, so what's this about again?

fields.EN:
A massage... My shoulders have
been a bit stiff recently...
fields.JP:
今日はマッサージです～
最近ちょっと肩が凝ってるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
A massage... My shoulders have
been a bit stiff recently...

fields.EN:
Huh... Why me, though? And I doubt
you even move enough to get your
shoulders stiff...
fields.JP:
はあ……なんで僕がそんな事を……
だいたい君は肩が凝るほど、動いてないと
思うんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... Why me, though? And I doubt
you even move enough to get your
shoulders stiff...

fields.EN:
*sob* You're so mean...! You don't
believe me, do you?
fields.JP:
うっうっうっ……ひどいです～！
わらわを疑うのですね～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob* You're so mean...! You don't
believe me, do you?

fields.EN:
That's an eye dropper in your
hand, right? You also sounded too
dramatic. It won't work on me...
fields.JP:
……その手に持ってるの、目薬だよね？
セリフもやたら棒読みだし……
嘘泣きはよそうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an eye dropper in your
hand, right? You also sounded too
dramatic. It won't work on me...

fields.EN:
It's not an eye dropper... It's
one of my lazy tools, "Angel
Tears."
fields.JP:
目薬じゃありません～。
さぼり七つ道具の一つ、通称『天使の涙』です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not an eye dropper... It's
one of my lazy tools, "Angel
Tears."

fields.JP:
はあ……わかったよ。
マッサージ、やるよ……

fields.EN:
I like how you're a fast learner,
Jack.
fields.JP: ジャックは物分りが良くて助かります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like how you're a fast learner,
Jack.

fields.EN:
(It feels like I've been doing her
bidding since the day I cleaned
her room...)
fields.JP:
（なんだかあれ以来、
　いいようにこき使われてる気が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It feels like I've been doing her
bidding since the day I cleaned
her room...)

fields.EN:
(Well, I guess it's worth it,
considering how much friendlier
we are now...)
fields.JP:
（まあ、少しは打ち解けられた気がするのは
　よかったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, I guess it's worth it,
considering how much friendlier
we are now...)

fields.EN:
Ah, there... You're good at
massaging, Jack... Ah, it feels so
good...
fields.JP:
あ～、そこそこ……
ジャックはマッサージがうまいですね～
あ～、気持ちいいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, there... You're good at
massaging, Jack... Ah, it feels so
good...

fields.JP: そ、そっか……それならよかった……

fields.EN:
(N-Now I'm getting nervous... I
can feel my heart pounding...)
fields.JP:
（さ、さすがにこれは、
　ちょっとドキドキするなあ……）
