fields.LOCALIZED:
(N-Now I'm getting nervous... I
can feel my heart pounding...)

fields.EN:
Um, Kaguyahime, do you mind if I ask you
something? Why do you use people
like this?
fields.JP:
ところで、かぐや姫はどうして、その……
そんなに人をこき使うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Kaguya, do you mind if I ask you
something? Why do you use people
like this?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? I don't want to
do anything myself. I just want to
be lazy, that's all.
fields.JP:
……そんなの決まってるじゃないですか～。
自分で何もしたくないからです～。
つまりサボりたいからです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? I don't want to
do anything myself. I just want to
be lazy, that's all.

fields.EN:
I'm not even sure why you would
ask me a question with such an
obvious answer...
fields.JP:
それにしても、その質問……
何を今さらって感じですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not even sure why you would
ask me a question with such an
obvious answer...

fields.EN:
Well, I thought it was the
opposite. You know, you slack off
so that you're able to use others.
fields.JP:
いや、てっきり……僕は逆だと思って。
人をこき使いたいから、サボってるのかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I thought it was the
opposite. You know, you slack off
so that you're able to use others.

fields.EN:
That's completely against the
spirit behind laziness. You have
a lot to learn, young one.
fields.JP:
……そんな不純な動機で、
わらわがサボるわけないです～。
そなたがサボりを語るのは、百年早いですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's completely against the
spirit behind laziness. You have
a lot to learn, young one.

fields.EN:
S-Sorry... So, why do you want to
slack off so often, then?
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん……
じゃあ、なんでそんなにサボりたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry... So, why do you want to
slack off so often, then?

fields.EN:
Why? That's a weird question to
ask.
fields.JP:
……なんで？
また妙なことを聞きますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? That's a weird question to
ask.

fields.EN:
Well, it almost felt as if you
didn't want to get involved in
trying to save the captives.
fields.JP:
いや、その……やっぱりかぐや姫は僕たちの、
人間を助ける為の作戦には、
加わりたくないのかと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it almost felt as if you
didn't want to get involved in
trying to save the captives.

fields.EN:
You don't have to have a reason to
slack off!
fields.JP: ……サボりたい気持ちに理由なんてありません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to have a reason to
slack off!

fields.EN:
(That caught me off guard... I
didn't expect her to be so
straightforward with her answer.)
fields.JP:
（びっくりした……
　ここまできっぱり答えるとは思わなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That caught me off guard... I
didn't expect her to be so
straightforward with her answer.)

fields.EN:
Me being lazy is similar to Akazukin and her hood. Everyone
has their traits and quirks.
fields.JP:
……わらわの面倒くさがりは、赤ずきんのフード
みたいなものです。
誰だって持ってるこだわりです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me being lazy is similar to Red
Riding Hood and her hood. Everyone
has their traits and quirks.

fields.EN:
Jack... You have something too,
don't you? You know, a strange
trait or an urge and things...
fields.JP:
ジャック……そなたにだってあるでしょう？
そういうこだわりは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You have something too,
don't you? You know, a strange
trait or an urge and things...

fields.EN:
Mmm... Well, I guess I have the
urge to climb as high as I can...
fields.JP:
う～ん……そうだなあ……
高いところに昇りたい……気持ち？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Well, I guess I have the
urge to climb as high as I can...

fields.EN:
Pfft...! Hahahaha! Guess you're no
different than a monkey...
fields.JP:
……ぷっ。あははは……
『バカと煙は何とやら』というやつですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pfft...! Hahahaha! Guess you're no
different than a monkey...

fields.EN:
Hey! And after I answered your
question, too! Fine... I'm
leaving!
fields.JP:
むっ……せっかく答えたのに……
じゃあもういいよ。今日は僕はもう帰るから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! And after I answered your
question, too! Fine... I'm
leaving!

fields.JP:
えっ？
あ……ちょっと待ってください～！

fields.EN:
I just felt like teasing you...
I'm sorry for laughing about it...
fields.JP:
……ちょっとからかいたくなっただけです。
笑って……その、悪かったです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just felt like teasing you...
I'm sorry for laughing about it...

fields.EN:
Huh? Uh, well... I'm not that
angry or anything...
fields.JP:
えっ？
い、いや……別に、そんなに怒ってないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Uh, well... I'm not that
angry or anything...

fields.EN:
(I know she's not a bad person,
but... She really has a unique
personality...)
fields.JP:
（うーん……悪い子じゃないんだ、悪い子じゃ！
　ちょっと独特な性格だけで……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's not a bad person,
but... She really has a unique
personality...)

fields.EN:
You're so much of a subordinate
that I just poked a little fun at
you...
fields.JP:
ジャックがあまりにも下僕向きだから……
ちょっとバカにしてしまいました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so much of a subordinate
that I just poked a little fun at
you...

fields.EN:
(*sigh* Well, there goes the
idea that she's not a bad
person...)
fields.JP:
（はあ……
　心の中とはいえ、フォローして損した……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(*sigh* Well, there goes the
idea that she's not a bad
person...)

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime, are you around? I brought
you what you asked for...
fields.JP:
……かぐや姫、いる？
頼まれてたもの、持ってきたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, are you around? I brought
you what you asked for...

fields.EN:
(Huh? Her room feels a bit
different...)
fields.JP:
（……あれ？
　なんだかいつもと部屋の様子が違うような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Her room feels a bit
different...)

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime isn't in her room?! This
is way too weird! I need to go and
find her!)
fields.JP:
（あのかぐや姫が、部屋にいないなんて！
　これはただ事じゃないぞ！
　とにかく探さないと……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya isn't in her room?! This
is way too weird! I need to go and
find her!)

fields.EN:
(The roof... Nah, she wouldn't be
here, would she?)
fields.JP:
（屋上か……
　まさかこんなところにいるわけないよなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The roof... Nah, she wouldn't be
here, would she?)

fields.EN:
(And there she is... Huh? What is
she doing?)
fields.JP:
（って、いたし！？
　……あれ？　何やってるんだろ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And there she is... Huh? What is
she doing?)

fields.EN:
(She's sighing...? Does she have
a problem? I bet it can't be that
bad...)
fields.JP:
（溜め息ついてる……？　何か悩んでるのかな？
　……ろくな悩みじゃなさそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's sighing...? Does she have
a problem? I bet it can't be that
bad...)

fields.JP: あの、かぐや姫……どうしたの？

fields.EN: Oh, Jack... What brings you here?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャック……
こんなところで何やってるんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Jack... What brings you here?

fields.EN:
I was just about to ask the same
thing. I was looking for you since
I couldn't find you in your room.
fields.JP:
いや、それはこっちのセリフだよ……
部屋にいないから、どうしたのかと思って……
それでずっと探してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just about to ask the same
thing. I was looking for you since
I couldn't find you in your room.

fields.EN:
You're a strange one... I can't
believe someone actually came to
look for me...
fields.JP:
……そなたは変な人ですね～。
わざわざ、わらわなんかを探しに来るなんて～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a strange one... I can't
believe someone actually came to
look for me...

fields.EN:
Every so often, I just get sick
and tired of being here...
fields.JP: ……たまに、ここの中が息苦しくなるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Every so often, I just get sick
and tired of being here...

fields.EN:
I-I see... Well, I don't blame you
with how we're here in the Jail.
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……
確かにジェイルの中じゃ、そうなっちゃうよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see... Well, I don't blame you
with how we're here in the Jail.

fields.EN:
I just feel like there's no place
I can call home. That applies to
being with the Dawn, too...
fields.JP:
なんていうか……どこにいても、
自分の居場所ではないような気がするんです。
それは黎明の中にいても、同じで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just feel like there's no place
I can call home. That applies to
being with the Dawn, too...

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but it just
feels that way...
fields.JP:
……自分でも、何故かはよくわからないんです
けどね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but it just
feels that way...

fields.EN:
Is it because you feel like you're
being forced to work?
fields.JP:
それはやっぱり……
無理やり働かされてるって思ってるから……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it because you feel like you're
being forced to work?

fields.EN:
(Maybe she doesn't see us as
friends, or even allies...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり僕たちはまだ、仲間だと思って
　もらえてないのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she doesn't see us as
friends, or even allies...)

fields.EN:
It seems as if being a Blood
Maiden is painful to you.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫にとって、血式少女っていう境遇は
辛いものだったみたいだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if being a Blood
Maiden is painful to you.

fields.EN:
No, that's not it. That's not it,
but...
fields.JP:
いえ、それは全然違います……
そういうわけではないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not it. That's not it,
but...

fields.EN:
It's just that I feel like I need
to go someplace...
fields.JP:
時々、わらわには……どこか行かなければ
ならない場所が、あるような気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I feel like I need
to go someplace...

fields.EN:
And yet, I don't want to... I
would rather stay here with
everyone...
fields.JP:
でも、決してそこに行きたいわけじゃなくて……
みんなとは、むしろ……一緒にいたいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, I don't want to... I
would rather stay here with
everyone...

fields.JP: ううん、そんなことないよ……

fields.EN:
(Wha-?! S-She's leaning on me?!
The scent of incense on her is so
nice...)
fields.JP:
（わわっ……い、いきなり寄りかかって……！
　お香みたいないい匂いが……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wha-?! S-She's leaning on me?!
The scent of incense on her is so
nice...)

fields.EN:
Can I... stay like this for a
little while...?
fields.JP: 少しだけ……ここにいてほしいです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can I... stay like this for a
little while...?

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime, what's the matter? You
don't look well...
fields.JP:
かぐや姫、どうしたの？
なんだか元気ないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, what's the matter? You
don't look well...

fields.EN:
Jack... Have you noticed how
everyone didn't seem quite here,
so to speak?
fields.JP:
ジャック……みんなの様子、
やっぱりおかしくはないでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Have you noticed how
everyone didn't seem quite here,
so to speak?

fields.EN:
(She must be talking about our
origins...)
fields.JP: （あ……！　僕たちの出生のこと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must be talking about our
origins...)

fields.EN:
Everyone is acting like
everything's fine, but they aren't
the same as before...
fields.JP:
みんな、元気なふりをして振舞っていますが、
やっぱりどこか不自然なような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone is acting like
everything's fine, but they aren't
the same as before...

fields.EN: (Finding out you were born from a Marchen's womb... I guess it would be stranger not to be shocked.)
fields.JP:
（自分がメルヒェンの胎から産まれたなんて、
　確かにショックじゃない方がおかしいかも
　しれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not surprised, especially
after finding out that we were
born from Marchens...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I'm not shocked
about it... Maybe there's
something wrong with me...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルはともかく……僕はどうして
　そんなにショックじゃないんだろう？
　僕の方が……変なんだよな、きっと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I'm not shocked
about it... Maybe there's
something wrong with me...)

fields.EN:
Maybe I shouldn't have said
anything... I should have left it
to the Professor to disclose...
fields.JP:
……わらわは言うべきではなかったんでしょうか。
あんなことは、博士に任せておけばよかったんで
しょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I shouldn't have said
anything... I should have left it
to the Professor to disclose...

fields.EN:
Don't think like that, Kaguyahime.
It's not your fault that everyone
feels a bit different now...
fields.JP:
……そんなことないと思うよ、かぐや姫。
みんなが落ち込んでたとしても、それは君の
せいじゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think like that, Kaguya.
It's not your fault that everyone
feels a bit different now...

fields.EN: Please don't try to console me!
fields.JP: 慰めはよしてください！
fields.LOCALIZED: Please don't try to console me!

fields.EN:
Ever since I spoke about it, no
one's fought me on anything, no
matter what I ask for...
fields.JP:
あの日から、みんな……わらわがどんなワガママ
を言っても、何も言わないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since I spoke about it, no
one's fought me on anything, no
matter what I ask for...

fields.EN:
They're probably compliant to what
I say because they're worried
about me...
fields.JP:
それは……わらわに気を遣っているからなんじゃ
ないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're probably compliant to what
I say because they're worried
about me...

fields.EN:
All because I spoke before the
Professor could...
fields.JP:
わらわが……博士より先に、みんなに話して
しまったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All because I spoke before the
Professor could...

fields.EN:
Is that a bad thing? Everyone is
just thinking about you.
fields.JP:
それは……嫌なこと、なの……？
みんなはきっと、君のことを思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that a bad thing? Everyone is
just thinking about you.

fields.EN:
Of course it's a bad thing! They
aren't their usual selves! I don't
want them to worry about me!
fields.JP:
当たり前です！　そんなのみんなじゃないです！
わらわになんか、気を遣わないでほしいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course it's a bad thing! They
aren't their usual selves! I don't
want them to worry about me!

fields.EN:
At this rate... No...! Why...? Why
did this...
fields.JP:
このままだと……いつか……ああもう……！！　
何で……何でこんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this rate... No...! Why...? Why
did this...

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you're going
through now, but why not accept
everyone's thoughts?
fields.JP:
よくわからないんだけど……
みんなの気持ちを少しは考えてあげたら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you're going
through now, but why not accept
everyone's thoughts?

fields.EN:
That's not the point! I just...!
How can I word this...
fields.JP:
そうじゃなくて！
わらわはただ……ああ、どう言えば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the point! I just...!
How can I word this...

fields.EN:
So you just want them to keep
worrying about you and doing
everything you say?
fields.JP:
じゃあ……みんなが君のワガママに、いつも
付き合えって言うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you just want them to keep
worrying about you and doing
everything you say?

fields.EN:
I'm sure they'd all want to think
about it. Why don't you give them
some space for a while?
fields.JP:
みんなだってきっと、考えたいんだよ。
今は、そっとしといてあげなよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure they'd all want to think
about it. Why don't you give them
some space for a while?

fields.EN:
Why...? How can you say that,
of all people?
fields.JP:
どうして……？
どうしてそなたがそんなことを言うんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...? How can you say that,
of all people?

fields.EN:
After all the discussions I've had
with you! I thought you'd
understand!
fields.JP:
そなたには、あれだけ……
色んなことを話したのに……！
きっと、わかってもらえると思ったのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all the discussions I've had
with you! I thought you'd
understand!

fields.EN:
Let me think about it... You don't
need to come here anymore.
fields.JP:
一人で考えます……
もうしばらくここには来なくていいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me think about it... You don't
need to come here anymore.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I wasn't trying
to...
fields.JP: ご、ごめん……そんなつもりじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I wasn't trying
to...

fields.EN:
(I should have just listened to
her...)
fields.JP:
（もっと……ちゃんと聞かなきゃいけなかった
　んだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should have just listened to
her...)

fields.EN:
(And I knew she was the type to
keep her feelings to herself,
too...)
fields.JP:
（……かぐや姫は、自分で抱え込んじゃう子
　だって、知ってたはずなのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And I knew she was the type to
keep her feelings to herself,
too...)

fields.EN:
(I need to let Kaguyahime know how I
feel...)
fields.JP:
（……かぐや姫にちゃんと、自分の気持ちを
　伝えなくちゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to let Kaguya know how I
feel...)

fields.EN:
What is it? I thought I told you
not to come by anymore.
fields.JP:
……何の用ですか？
来ないくていいって、言ったはずです
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it? I thought I told you
not to come by anymore.

fields.EN:
Um, I'll do anything you want, so
can you tell me what you want
me to do?
fields.JP:
あのさ……何でもいいから僕に、ワガママを
言ってくれないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'll do anything you want, so
can you tell me what you want
me to do?

fields.EN:
Seriously, anything. I want you
to make me do stuff so that you
can slack off however you want!
fields.JP:
何でもいいからさ……
僕にワガママを言って、ダラダラしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously, anything. I want you
to make me do stuff so that you
can slack off however you want!

fields.EN:
I have no idea what you're trying
to get at. Please leave...
fields.JP:
……何を言っているのか、さっぱりわかりません。
出てってください……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no idea what you're trying
to get at. Please leave...

fields.EN:
To be honest, you've been acting
strange!
fields.JP: だって、最近の君は、どう考えてもおかしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, you've been acting
strange!

fields.JP:
……おかしい？　わらわが？
どこがですか？

fields.EN:
You come to the cafeteria to get
your own food, and you do things
yourself now. You're scaring us!
fields.JP:
自分で食堂に食事に来るし、
借りたものも自分で返しに行くし……
みんなびっくりしてるじゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You come to the cafeteria to get
your own food, and you do things
yourself now. You're scaring us!

fields.EN:
To add, this room is so clean now.
This isn't like you, Kaguyahime!
fields.JP:
しかも部屋も綺麗に片付いてるし、
そんなの、かぐや姫らしくないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, this room is so clean now.
This isn't like you, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
Well now, you're making it sound
like I'm a lazy person...
fields.JP:
……それじゃ、まるで……わらわが、
普段はダメな人みたいじゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, you're making it sound
like I'm a lazy person...

fields.EN:
That's right! Being lazy was who
you were! Isn't that right?
fields.JP:
……そうだよ！
そのダメな人を自分でやってるのが、
かぐや姫なんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! Being lazy was who
you were! Isn't that right?

fields.EN:
You were worried about everyone,
but now you're worrying everyone
with what you're doing!
fields.JP:
みんなのことが心配だって言ってた本人が、
みんなに心配かけてどうするんだよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were worried about everyone,
but now you're worrying everyone
with what you're doing!

fields.EN:
So you came to tell me I'm causing
problems? You must have a lot of
time on your hands...
fields.JP:
……つまり、わらわが迷惑だと、わざわざ
言いに来たんですか。暇ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you came to tell me I'm causing
problems? You must have a lot of
time on your hands...

fields.EN:
No... I came here because I was
worried about you...
fields.JP:
違うよ……
僕が、君のことが心配なんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I came here because I was
worried about you...

fields.EN:
We keep hurting each other with
words... I can't even imagine
being with you on missions now!
fields.JP:
こんなんじゃ、気持ちがすれ違ってばかりで、
危なっかしくて、一緒に作戦行動だって
できないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We keep hurting each other with
words... I can't even imagine
being with you on missions now!

fields.EN:
Please let me apologize for not
listening back then... I just want
you back to your normal lazy self.
fields.JP:
この間……ちゃんと話を聞かなかったのは謝る。
ただ僕は……君にもっと、普通にダラダラ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please let me apologize for not
listening back then... I just want
you back to your normal lazy self.

fields.JP: ぼ、僕……何か変なこと……言った？

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... Well, I assume what
you said makes sense. I suppose I
was acting strange.
fields.JP:
ふふ……確かに。
そなたの言うとおりかもしれませんね。
わらわも、どうかしてました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... Well, I assume what
you said makes sense. I suppose I
was acting strange.

fields.EN:
Very well. I will be lazy again.
As you said, it's better to have
everyone else do things for me.
fields.JP:
それでは、わらわはダラダラします～。
そなたの言うとおり、みんなに任せて楽を
するのもアリですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. I will be lazy again.
As you said, it's better to have
everyone else do things for me.

fields.EN:
S-So you just want to slack
off...?
fields.JP: や、やっぱりサボりたいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So you just want to slack
off...?

fields.EN:
It's a chore having someone know
who you are. That's why I gave up
and slacked off when I could.
fields.JP:
……人に自分のことをわかってもらうのは、
面倒くさいです。だから、いつも諦めてて
サボってたんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a chore having someone know
who you are. That's why I gave up
and slacked off when I could.

fields.EN:
But I thought you would understand
me, Jack...
fields.JP:
でも、ジャック。そなたにだけはわかって
ほしいって……わかってくれると思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I thought you would understand
me, Jack...

fields.EN:
I suppose my laziness got the
better of me. I should have said
what I wanted to say.
fields.JP:
こんなところにも、サボり癖が出たんですね。
本当に伝えたいことは、ちゃんと言わなければ
伝わらないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose my laziness got the
better of me. I should have said
what I wanted to say.

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you came here
despite what happened. Thank
you...
fields.JP:
でも、それでもこうして来てくれて……
わらわは嬉しかったです。
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you came here
despite what happened. Thank
you...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry that I didn't try to
hear you out back then...
fields.JP:
僕こそ……君はちゃんと言おうとしてたのに、
聞こうとしなくてごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry that I didn't try to
hear you out back then...

fields.EN:
When I realized the truth, I
resolved to support everyone as
much as I could...
fields.JP:
もともと……先に真実を知っていたわらわが、
みんなの支えになろうと自分で決めたこと
だったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I realized the truth, I
resolved to support everyone as
much as I could...

fields.EN:
But instead, it seems as if I made
everyone worried. I should have
just said to not worry about me.
fields.JP:
みんなに水臭いって自分で言えばよかったのに、
かえって気を遣わせる結果になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But instead, it seems as if I made
everyone worried. I should have
just said to not worry about me.

fields.EN:
I suppose things don't go so well
when you're not used to doing
something...
fields.JP:
……やっぱり、慣れないことはするものでは
ありませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose things don't go so well
when you're not used to doing
something...

fields.EN:
That's not true. I'm sure everyone
cares about you, too.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。
みんな、君のことを大事に思ってるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. I'm sure everyone
cares about you, too.

fields.JP: ……それにしても、そなたはお人よしですね～

fields.EN:
With how I acted toward you, you
could have used that to get the
better of me.
fields.JP:
八つ当たりをしたのはわらわなんですから、
ここでわらわに恩を売っておかない手は
ありませんのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how I acted toward you, you
could have used that to get the
better of me.

fields.EN:
I have no intention of doing that.
I was just worried about you.
fields.JP:
そんなつもりはないよ……
僕はただ、君が心配で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of doing that.
I was just worried about you.

fields.JP: そうですか？　それじゃあさっそく……

fields.EN:
After moving around so much, I'm
very tired now... I need you to
massage me...
fields.JP:
最近動きすぎていたので、疲れました～
マッサージをお願いします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
After moving around so much, I'm
very tired now... I need you to
massage me...

fields.EN: Jack? Please get me that book...
fields.JP: ジャック、その本を取ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? Please get me that book...

fields.JP: ありがとうございます～

fields.EN:
All right. Guess the rest is to
clean up your room.
fields.JP:
うん。
あと、部屋の片付けもやっとくね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. Guess the rest is to
clean up your room.

fields.EN:
Why aren't you complaining about
my neediness and my requests?
fields.JP:
そなたは、どうして最近……わらわのワガママに
対して、何も文句を言わないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why aren't you complaining about
my neediness and my requests?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Maybe I'm just getting used
to this?
fields.JP:
う～ん……
きっと、慣れてきたんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Maybe I'm just getting used
to this?

fields.EN:
Getting used to this? What a
splendid answer! You're such a
good subordinate!
fields.JP:
慣れ……
なんて素晴らしい答えでしょう……！
わらわは良い下僕を持ちました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting used to this? What a
splendid answer! You're such a
good subordinate!

fields.EN:
I think that's praise, but I'm not
too happy about it...
fields.JP:
そ、その褒め方、
全然嬉しくないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that's praise, but I'm not
too happy about it...

fields.EN:
Oh, and can I ask you one more
thing?
fields.JP:
……それと、
もう一つ、聞いてもいいですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and can I ask you one more
thing?

fields.EN:
If I need to go somewhere, will
you try and stop me?
fields.JP:
もし……わらわが、
どこかに行かなければならなくなったら……
わらわを引き止めてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I need to go somewhere, will
you try and stop me?

fields.EN:
(I wonder if this has to do with
what we spoke about on the
roof...)
fields.JP:
（これ……この前の屋上での話と、
　何か関係があるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if this has to do with
what we spoke about on the
roof...)

fields.EN:
You don't need to go anywhere,
Kaguyahime.
fields.JP: ……かぐや姫はどこにも行く必要はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to go anywhere,
Kaguya.

fields.EN:
If you go away, things won't be
the same around here...
fields.JP:
その……もしどこかに行っちゃったら……
生活に、張り合いがないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you go away, things won't be
the same around here...

fields.EN:
(I think this is the first time
I've seen her smile like that...)
fields.JP: （こんな素直な笑顔、初めて見たかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think this is the first time
I've seen her smile like that...)

fields.EN:
I have no intention of leaving my
faithful subordinate behind.
fields.JP:
……わらわも、下僕の生きがいを奪う趣味は
ないですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of leaving my
faithful subordinate behind.

fields.EN:
But if something does happen,
I'll leave it to you...
fields.JP: だから……いざという時は、任せました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if something does happen,
I'll leave it to you...

fields.EN:
Sure... I'll do what I can and
stop you from going anywhere.
fields.JP:
うん……
どこにも行かないように、引き止めるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure... I'll do what I can and
stop you from going anywhere.

fields.JP: よっ！　おはよ、かぐや！
こんにちはー、かぐやさん……！

fields.EN:
Your room is very clean. Are you
using Jack to do things for you
again?
fields.JP:
意外と片付いてるわね……
もしかして、またジャックをこき使っている
のかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your room is very clean. Are you
using Jack to do things for you
again?

fields.EN:
Hahaha... I just got used to it. I
have to say, it's unusual to see
everyone gathered like this.
fields.JP:
ははは……
なんか、もう慣れちゃったというか……
でも珍しいね。こうして、親睦会だなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha... I just got used to it. I
have to say, it's unusual to see
everyone gathered like this.

fields.EN: And of all places, my room...
fields.JP: しかも、何でわらわの部屋で……
fields.LOCALIZED: And of all places, my room...

fields.EN:
It's because you have the largest
room! C'mon, don't hog the place
to yourself!
fields.JP:
だってここが一番広いんだもん。
ま、いいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because you have the largest
room! C'mon, don't hog the place
to yourself!

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose it's all right...
And I won't need to move around as
much like this, too...
fields.JP:
……まあ、別にいいですけど～。
わらわも動く手間が省けましたし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose it's all right...
And I won't need to move around as
much like this, too...

fields.JP: （かぐや姫、満更でもなさそうだ……）

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, there's
something I've been wanting to
ask...
fields.JP: そういえば、前から気になってたんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, there's
something I've been wanting to
ask...

fields.EN:
With your lazy lifestyle, how do
you not get fat?
fields.JP:
そんなにダラダラしているのに、
何故かぐやさんは、太らないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
With your lazy lifestyle, how do
you not get fat?

fields.EN:
(That's a heck of a question to
ask...)
fields.JP: （い、いきなりぶっ込んだ質問だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's a heck of a question to
ask...)

fields.EN:
Do you have a secret? Or maybe
you're exercising behind our
backs.
fields.JP:
何か太らない秘訣があるんですの？
実はみんなの知らないところで、運動して
らっしゃるとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you have a secret? Or maybe
you're exercising behind our
backs.

fields.EN: Princess Lazy would never do that!
fields.JP: グータラ姫に限って、ありえないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Princess Lazy would never do that!

fields.EN: Yes, I doubt that's the case.
fields.JP: ええ、それはありえないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I doubt that's the case.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised to hear you all say
that, but... I'm not thin at all.
I'm quite fat.
fields.JP:
なんだか勝手な事言われてますけど……
わらわは普通に太ってますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised to hear you all say
that, but... I'm not thin at all.
I'm quite fat.

fields.JP:
はあ？
全然そうは見えないんだけど！

fields.EN:
She's right! You're not fat at
all!
fields.JP:
そうですよ！
全然太ってませんよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! You're not fat at
all!

fields.JP: 別にどうでもいいじゃないですか～
確かめましょう、真相を！
ふっふっふ。観念なさい！

まさか……こんな事って！？
嘘でしょ……？

（わわわ……！
　み、見ちゃダメだ……！）

fields.EN:
Impossible... I can't believe hers
are larger than mine...
fields.JP: 嘘よ……まさかわたしより大きいなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Impossible... I can't believe hers
are larger than mine...

fields.EN:
I-I won't believe it! It can't
be...!
fields.JP:
わたしは、わたしは信じないわよ……！
こんなのって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I won't believe it! It can't
be...!

fields.EN:
I-I suppose her attire kept her
endowments secret... Still, hiding
it from us is quite rude!
fields.JP:
か、隠れ巨乳というやつですわね……
それにしても……過度な謙遜は嫌味でしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I suppose her attire kept her
endowments secret... Still, hiding
it from us is quite rude!

fields.EN:
You're not fat at all... If
anything, you're skinny...
fields.JP:
っていうか、
やっぱり全然太ってないじゃないですか……
むしろ痩せてるじゃないですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not fat at all... If
anything, you're skinny...

fields.EN: I-I want to be left alone!
fields.JP: や……やっぱり一人が一番いいです～！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I want to be left alone!

fields.EN:
Wh-Why, you...! I can't believe
you didn't leave earlier! Get out!
fields.JP:
あ、あ、あんたね……！
こういう時は、空気読んで出て行きなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Why, you...! I can't believe
you didn't leave earlier! Get out!

fields.JP: 問答無用！！　出てけーーー！！

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Jack? Did you
come to receive orders from me?
If so, good for you.
fields.JP:
どうしたんですか、ジャック？
わらわのワガママを聞きに来たんですか～？
良い心がけですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Jack? Did you
come to receive orders from me?
If so, good for you.

fields.JP: いや、そういうわけじゃないんだけど……

fields.EN:
Here. Akazukin-san told me to
give these to you.
fields.JP:
はい、これ。
赤ずきんさんがかぐや姫にって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here. Red Riding Hood told me to
give these to you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yeah, Akazukin-san said they
didn't look good on her, so...
fields.JP:
うん、赤ずきんさんが、
自分には似合わないからあげるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, Red Riding Hood said they
didn't look good on her, so...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: って、あれ？　どうしたの？

fields.EN:
I get bad vibes about the things
she "gives away"... Like she's
trying to make me exercise...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんが持ってくるものって……
悪い予感しかしないんですよね～
運動させるためとか、思惑がありそうで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get bad vibes about the things
she "gives away"... Like she's
trying to make me exercise...

fields.JP: はは……それはさすがに、考えすぎだよ

fields.EN:
Mmm... Well, it does look good, so
I suppose I can keep it...
fields.JP:
う～ん……
まあ、見た目は良さそうですし、
もらってあげてもいいですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Well, it does look good, so
I suppose I can keep it...

fields.EN:
(Despite what she says, she looks
pretty happy...)
fields.JP:
（とは言いつつ、
　なんだかんだで嬉しそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite what she says, she looks
pretty happy...)

fields.EN:
Well then, please put it on me,
Jack.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ジャック……
そなたがこれを着せてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, please put it on me,
Jack.

fields.EN:
It's a chore for me to put on
clothes that I'm not used to...
fields.JP:
だって、慣れない洋服を一人で着るの、
面倒くさいじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a chore for me to put on
clothes that I'm not used to...

fields.EN:
This is part of your job as a
subordinate. Now, hurry.
fields.JP:
これも下僕の役目ですよ～
ほら、早く～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is part of your job as a
subordinate. Now, hurry.

fields.EN: (What in the world am I doing?!)
fields.LOCALIZED: (What in the world am I doing?!)

fields.EN:
Ah, this feels like it's nice and
snug...
fields.JP: あ、これ……サイズはぴったりですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, this feels like it's nice and
snug...

fields.EN:
(It's too exposing! I need to look
away! Look away, Jack!)
fields.JP:
（っていうか、色々見えそうなんですけど……！
　って、ダメだ、見るな！
　目を逸らすんだ、ジャック！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's too exposing! I need to look
away! Look away, Jack!)

fields.JP:
……お、終わった！
こ、これでどうかな……？

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. It's a lot
better than I expected.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～。
思ったより、けっこう良い感じですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. It's a lot
better than I expected.

fields.EN:
(That was way too much for
me...!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was way too much for
me...!)

fields.EN:
But, um... Isn't it a bit
short...?
fields.JP:
でもこれ、その……
ちょっと、短すぎるような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, um... Isn't it a bit
short...?

fields.JP: い、いやその……なんというか……

fields.EN:
I know it's not like me to say
this, but I wish to step out of my
room now... You, come with me.
fields.JP:
……わらわにしては珍しく、
部屋から出てみたくなりました～
そなたも、付いてきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's not like me to say
this, but I wish to step out of my
room now... You, come with me.

fields.EN:
(Well, it isn't often that she
wants to step out of her room, so
I guess I can cover for her!)
fields.JP:
（でも、せっかくかぐや姫が珍しく部屋から
　出たいって言ってるんだし……
　ここは僕がなんとかするしか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, it isn't often that she
wants to step out of her room, so
I guess I can cover for her!)

fields.EN:
How refreshing... I suppose it's
good to change clothes every so
often...
fields.JP:
……なんだか、新鮮です～。
たまにはいつもと違う服を着るのもいいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How refreshing... I suppose it's
good to change clothes every so
often...

fields.EN: I-I see... Good for you... Haha...
fields.JP: そ、そう……よかったよ……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I see... Good for you... Haha...

fields.JP: う、ううん……なんでもないよ！

fields.EN:
(H-Her underwear is about to peek
out from under her skirt... But I
can't just tell her that...)
fields.JP:
（さ、さっきから……
　ぱ、パンツが見えそうなんですけど……
　でもそんな事言えないし……どうしよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(H-Her underwear is about to peek
out from under her skirt... But I
can't just tell her that...)

fields.EN:
(It can't be helped... I'll act as
a shield and cover her front!)
fields.JP:
（し、仕方ない……こうなったら、
　僕が盾になって前方を守るしか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It can't be helped... I'll act as
a shield and cover her front!)

fields.EN:
What's with that glare? Pretty
scary, if you ask me...
fields.JP:
……どうしたんですか～？
そんなに怖い顔できょろきょろして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with that glare? Pretty
scary, if you ask me...

fields.EN:
Huh? Uh, well... I was just
thinking that things looked
different with you around, Kaguyahime.
fields.JP:
え？　い、いやその……かぐや姫と一緒だと、
黎明の中もいつもと違う感じに見えて、
新鮮だなーって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Uh, well... I was just
thinking that things looked
different with you around, Kaguya.

fields.EN:
Th-That's a strange thing to
say... If that's true, then you
don't need to make such a face.
fields.JP:
へ、へんな人ですね～
それなら別に、怖い顔をする必要はないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's a strange thing to
say... If that's true, then you
don't need to make such a face.

fields.JP:
あ、白雪じゃないですか～。
こんにちは～

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Kaguya? You're
not in your usual kimono...
fields.JP:
かぐやさん、どうしたんですか？
いつもは着物なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Kaguya? You're
not in your usual kimono...

fields.EN:
Do I look strange in this? Maybe I
shouldn't have tried it on.
fields.JP:
……やっぱり変ですか～？
着替えなければよかったです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do I look strange in this? Maybe I
shouldn't have tried it on.

fields.EN:
Not at all! I was just surprised
at how beautiful you are!
fields.JP:
違います！
あんまり素敵なので驚いたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all! I was just surprised
at how beautiful you are!

fields.EN:
Well now, that's just as
embarrassing...
fields.JP: それはそれで、恥ずかしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that's just as
embarrassing...

fields.EN:
(That's right! She's beautiful,
but...! Her underwear is about to
show...)
fields.JP:
（そう、素敵なんだ……！
　しかもパンツが見えそうなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right! She's beautiful,
but...! Her underwear is about to
show...)

fields.EN:
Um, Jack-san? What are you trying to
look at?
fields.JP:
あの、ジャックさん、
なんでそんなにきょろきょろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Jack? What are you trying to
look at?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
（え？　……あ！
　かぐや姫のパンツが見えてる……！）

fields.EN:
N-No, Shirayukihime! I-I was... Um...
Uh, you're misunderstanding me!
fields.JP:
ち、違うんだ白雪姫！
こ、これはその……
と、とにかく、多分……誤解なんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No, Snow White! I-I was... Um...
Uh, you're misunderstanding me!

fields.JP: は……は……破廉恥ですーーーー！！！

ちょ、ちょっと待って！！
し、白雪姫……

fields.EN:
What's with her? It looked like
she was crying...
fields.JP:
……白雪、どうしたんでしょう～？
なんか泣いてましたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with her? It looked like
she was crying...

fields.JP: さ、さあ……なんでだろうね……
（うう……あれは絶対、何か誤解された……）

fields.EN:
Heh, heh, heh... The filth here
has no chance against me!
fields.JP:
ふふふ……こんな汚れ、
わたくしの手にかかれば瞬殺ですわよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh, heh... The filth here
has no chance against me!

fields.EN:
(Cinderella and Kaguyahime? Now that's
a pair you don't see every day...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラとかぐや姫……？
　なんだか、珍しい取り合わせだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella and Kaguya? Now that's
a pair you don't see every day...)

fields.JP: それにしても……理解不能です～

fields.EN:
Why are you always cleaning,
Cinderella?
fields.JP:
シンデレラは、いつも掃除をしてますけど、
何故なんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you always cleaning,
Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Why? Ohohohoho! Value cannot be
found in spaces or people without
cleanliness!
fields.JP:
何故って……をーっほほほほ！
住空間も人も、綺麗でなければ価値なんてない
からでございましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Ohohohoho! Value cannot be
found in spaces or people without
cleanliness!

fields.EN:
But living a normal life brings
about filth. So, you keep cleaning
each time the place gets dirty?
fields.JP:
普通に暮らしてれば、どうせ汚れるのに、
汚しては綺麗にする繰り返しですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But living a normal life brings
about filth. So, you keep cleaning
each time the place gets dirty?

fields.EN:
Also, saying there's no value is
masochistic...
fields.JP:
……綺麗にしてないと価値がないなんて、
なんだか自虐の極みですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, saying there's no value is
masochistic...

fields.EN: Wha--?! What did you just say...?!
fields.JP:
ムッ……
これは面白いことをおっしゃいますわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha--?! What did you just say...?!

fields.JP:
（こ、これは……もしかして、
　一触即発というやつなんじゃ……！？）

fields.EN:
Did I say something strange? Oh...
You missed a spot in the
kitchen...
fields.JP:
わらわが、何かおかしい事言いましたっけ～？
あ……キッチンのそこ、まだ汚れてますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did I say something strange? Oh...
You missed a spot in the
kitchen...

fields.JP:
えっ！？　ど、どこですの！？
たわし、たわしは……！？

fields.EN:
It's right there. Let me get it
like... so.
fields.JP:
たわしなら、ここにあります～。
よいしょ……っと～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's right there. Let me get it
like... so.

fields.JP: そ……その道具は一体何ですの！？

fields.EN:
It's one of my special lazy tools,
the "Cat's Paw." I can use this to
rake what I want toward me...
fields.JP:
わらわのさぼり七つ道具、『猫の手』です～。
これがあれば、取りたい物をこっちに
寄せることが出来るんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's one of my special lazy tools,
the "Cat's Paw." I can use this to
rake what I want toward me...

fields.JP:
な、なんて便利な……！
……なかなかやりますわね……！

fields.EN:
See? That's why I don't see why
you would want to toil in cleaning
the place...
fields.JP:
だから、理解不能なんです～。
どうしてわざわざ面倒くさい掃除なんかして、
綺麗にしようとするのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? That's why I don't see why
you would want to toil in cleaning
the place...

fields.EN:
It's so that I know that the place
is clean!
fields.JP: 綺麗にしたという……実感ですわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so that I know that the place
is clean!

fields.EN:
The easier the better. If it's
just the results you're after,
just have Jack clean instead.
fields.JP:
結果が出るなら楽な方がいいです～。
ジャックに掃除してもらうとか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The easier the better. If it's
just the results you're after,
just have Jack clean instead.

fields.EN: Jack-san... I feel sorry for Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
それはジャックさんがお気の毒な気が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Poor soul... I feel sorry for
Jack.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
(Whew... Thank goodness Cinderella
has common sense...)
fields.JP: （……ほっ……シンデレラが常識人でよかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whew... Thank goodness Cinderella
has common sense...)

fields.EN:
All you're doing is forcing him to
work! Instead of playing with his
feelings, why not clean yourself?
fields.JP:
そういうのを無茶振りっていうんですのよ！
そうして人の気持ちを試すよりは、お掃除の方が
無害ではなくて？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All you're doing is forcing him to
work! Instead of playing with his
feelings, why not clean yourself?

fields.EN:
I'm not forcing him. He actually
finds fulfillment in working for
me.
fields.JP:
無茶振りではないです～。
ジャックはわらわのために働くことに、
やりがいを見出してますから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not forcing him. He actually
finds fulfillment in working for
me.

fields.EN:
Now I really feel sorry for
Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがますますお気の毒になって
きましたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I really feel sorry for
Jack...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: （僕も自分が気の毒に思えてきた……）

fields.EN:
You also said that I'm playing
with his feelings, didn't you?
fields.JP:
しかも……わらわが人の気持ちを試していると、
そう言うんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also said that I'm playing
with his feelings, didn't you?

fields.EN:
Why, thank you... Back on the
subject... Am I wrong?
fields.JP:
あら、ありがとうございます……
それで、違うんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, thank you... Back on the
subject... Am I wrong?

fields.EN:
No. You're pretty sharp... Oh,
here's the detergent...
fields.JP:
いえ。そなた、なかなか鋭いですね～
ああ、洗剤です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You're pretty sharp... Oh,
here's the detergent...

fields.EN:
Thank you... You're very
thoughtful, aren't you...
fields.JP:
……助かりますわ。
貴方、意外と気が付きますのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you... You're very
thoughtful, aren't you...

fields.EN:
I'm extremely observant because
I don't like to move.
fields.JP:
わらわは普段から動かないぶん、
物事の観察は得意ですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm extremely observant because
I don't like to move.

fields.EN:
I see...! I suppose that's one way
of looking at things. How
enlightening.
fields.JP:
なるほど……！
そういう考え方もあるんですのね。
目から鱗ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...! I suppose that's one way
of looking at things. How
enlightening.

fields.EN:
Same here... You have a keen eye
yourself...
fields.JP:
それはこちらこそです～。
そなたこそ、なかなかの眼力じゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here... You have a keen eye
yourself...

fields.EN:
Ohohohoho! I do take pride in my
keenness!
fields.JP:
をーっほほほほ！
わたくし、見る目は自信ありましてよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohohohoho! I do take pride in my
keenness!

fields.EN:
Oh, there's another spot over
there...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, there's another spot over
there...

fields.EN:
Oh my, how could I not have
noticed?! Much obliged!
fields.JP:
あら。気付きませんでしたわ！
はかどりましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, how could I not have
noticed?! Much obliged!

fields.EN:
It's fun watching someone work...
Oh, there are more dry rags over
there...
fields.JP:
人が働くのを見るのは良いものです～
空拭き用の雑巾ならそちらに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fun watching someone work...
Oh, there are more dry rags over
there...

fields.JP: （……案外ウマが合ってるような……？）

fields.EN:
It feels strange having friends,
but I suppose it's not half bad...
fields.JP:
仲間がいるって、なんだか変な感じですね～
でも、悪い気はしないものです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels strange having friends,
but I suppose it's not half bad...

fields.JP: ええ……わたくしも同感でしてよ！

fields.EN:
(Guess there's nothing to worry
about here...)
fields.JP: （心配する必要、なさそうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess there's nothing to worry
about here...)

fields.EN:
(That girl... Hameln, was it? She
was a pretty random recruit. I
wonder what kind of girl she is.)
fields.JP:
（あの子……ハーメルンだっけ。
　なんだかよくわからないまま仲間になったけど
　……どんな子なんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That girl... Hameln, was it? She
was a pretty random recruit. I
wonder what kind of girl she is.)

fields.EN: Who goes there? State your name!
fields.LOCALIZED: Who goes there? State your name!

fields.JP:
あ、ご、ごめん……
ジャックだけど……

fields.EN:
Aah... That weak-looking... Hmph!
Come in!
fields.JP:
ああ……あの時の、軟弱そうな……。
ふん、入るがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... That weak-looking... Hmph!
Come in!

fields.JP: は、はあ……それじゃ、お邪魔します

fields.EN:
(Why is she standing up on
there?! And "late"? Was she
waiting for someone?!)
fields.JP:
（ど、どうして仁王立ちしてるの！？
　しかも『遅い』って、待ってたの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is she standing up on
there?! And "late"? Was she
waiting for someone?!)

fields.EN:
How rude of you to not come
earlier to greet me!
fields.JP:
今の今までこのワレに挨拶がないとは……
何事か！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude of you to not come
earlier to greet me!

fields.JP:
（や、やっぱり誰か来るまで待ってたの！？
　ひょっとしてずっとその体勢で！？）

fields.EN:
Hmph! I suppose I can at least
praise you for coming heyare.
fields.JP:
ふん……！
だが、こうして来た事自体は褒めてやりゅ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I suppose I can at least
praise you for coming heyare.

fields.EN:
(Whoops... She slurred at the very
end...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoops... She slurred at the very
end...)

fields.EN:
Um... You joined us, so... I just
came by to say hi.
fields.JP:
ええと、なんていうか……仲間になったんだし、
これからよろしく……それを言いに来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You joined us, so... I just
came by to say hi.

fields.EN:
I-I see. Very well. You shall
witness the greatness of my true
powyer... Power...
fields.JP:
そ、そうか。ご苦労であった……
わが真の力、大いに役立てるが良いじょ……ぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see. Very well. You shall
witness the greatness of my true
powyer... Power...

fields.EN:
Uh, before that, what happened to
the clothes that were supplied to
you?
fields.JP:
っていうか……あの、服は……？
さっき、支給されたはずだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, before that, what happened to
the clothes that were supplied to
you?

fields.EN:
Hmph! I have no need for them!
This is my proper attire...
Whoops... My true form!
fields.JP:
ふん！　あんなものは必要ないわ！
これがワレに相応しい制服……じゃなかった、
然るべき、真の姿だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I have no need for them!
This is my proper attire...
Whoops... My true form!

fields.EN:
O-Oh... So, you prefer what you're
wearing now...
fields.JP: そ、そう……気に入ってるんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Oh... So, you prefer what you're
wearing now...

fields.EN:
(It looks like parts she got from
Marchens that she stitched
together...)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても、メルヒェンのパーツを繋げてるだけ
　なんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like parts she got from
Marchens that she stitched
together...)

fields.EN:
Um, do you mind if I ask you a
question?
fields.JP: ところでさ……ひとつ聞きたかったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind if I ask you a
question?

fields.EN:
What is it?! State yourself! I
shall allow one query!
fields.JP:
……何だ、申してみよ！
特別に許可してやろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it?! State yourself! I
shall allow one query!

fields.EN:
Uh, well... Why do you speak to
everyone like a superior?
fields.JP:
……なんで、その……
そんな偉そうな喋り方なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... Why do you speak to
everyone like a superior?

fields.EN:
Hmph... Isn't it obvious?! It is
because I am your superyey!
fields.JP:
ふ……そんなの、決まっておろう！
ワレが偉いからでありゅ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Isn't it obvious?! It is
because I am your superyey!

fields.EN:
(She speaks in a haughty way, but
it doesn't seem like she's stuck-
up... She seems nice.)
fields.JP:
（この子って、偉そうにはしてるけど、
　別に本当に威張ってるわけじゃなさそうだな。
　悪い子じゃなさそうだし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She speaks in a haughty way, but
it doesn't seem like she's stuck-
up... She seems nice.)

fields.EN:
Hm... Your presence here bespeaks
great potential. I look forward to
seeing more from you, Jack!
fields.JP:
ふむ……しっかり挨拶に来るあたり、
貴様はなかなか見所があるな。
これからもよろしく頼むぞ、ジャックよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Your presence here bespeaks
great potential. I look forward to
seeing more from you, Jack!

fields.EN:
Yes, same here! If you need
anything at all, feel free to let us
know!
fields.JP:
うん。こちらこそ……！
もし困った事とかあったら、何でも僕やみんなに
言ってね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, same here! If you need
anything at all, feel free to let us
know!

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! That is not necessary!
Leave it all to me, and...! Uh,
oh...!
fields.JP:
……ふはははは！！
そんなものは必要ない。
ワレに全て任せておけば……あ、あれっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! That is not necessary!
Leave it all to me, and...! Uh,
oh...!

fields.EN:
Whew... This room is quite
dangerous...
fields.JP:
……ふう……
この部屋の仕組み……侮れぬな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... This room is quite
dangerous...

fields.EN:
Especially when you're standing
on the chair like that... Be
careful, okay?
fields.JP:
そんなところに立ったら、転んじゃうから……
気を付けてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially when you're standing
on the chair like that... Be
careful, okay?

fields.EN:
Hmph... That you saved me has
raised my expectations of you. You
have my thanks, Jack!
fields.JP:
ふん……ワレを危機から救うとは……
やはり見所があるな。
褒めてつかわすぞ、ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... That you saved me has
raised my expectations of you. You
have my thanks, Jack!

fields.EN: Feel free to come by anytime!
fields.JP: ちょくちょく遊びに来るが良いぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Feel free to come by anytime!

fields.EN:
(Guess she's not that hard to
speak with once you get the hang
of it...)
fields.JP: （コツさえ掴めば、話しやすい子なのかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess she's not that hard to
speak with once you get the hang
of it...)

fields.JP:
（ハーメルン……？
　なんだか、妙にそわそわしてるな……）

fields.EN:
I don't know! I don't know at all!
Why is everyone walking out of
order?!
fields.JP:
……分からぬ……どうしても分からぬ！！
なぜ皆、バラバラに歩いておるのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know! I don't know at all!
Why is everyone walking out of
order?!

fields.EN:
It wasn't like this in my
underground abode! I can't get
used to it at all!
fields.JP:
ワレが地下の迷宮にいた頃は、こうではなかった！
こんなのは、初めてで……慣れん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't like this in my
underground abode! I can't get
used to it at all!

fields.EN: How did you walk down there?
fields.JP: じゃあ、今まではどうやって歩いてたのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: How did you walk down there?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious?! I was marching
with the Marchens!
fields.JP:
そんなの、決まっておろう！
メルヒェンたちと整列して行進していたのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious?! I was marching
with the Marchens!

fields.EN: I'm not so sure about that...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not so sure about that...

fields.EN:
(So that's the reason why she
looked nervous?)
fields.JP: （それでそわそわしてたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that's the reason why she
looked nervous?)

fields.EN:
(So the Marchens underground
weren't enemies to Hameln...)
fields.JP:
（地下のメルヒェンは、ハーメルンの敵じゃ
　なかったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So the Marchens underground
weren't enemies to Hameln...)

fields.EN:
Look at everyone here! Everyone is
walking randomly! How can I be at
ease with everyone like thiysh!
fields.JP:
……それが何だ、貴様らは！
揃いも揃ってテキトーに歩きおって！
これじゃさっぱり落ち着かんではにゃいか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at everyone here! Everyone is
walking randomly! How can I be at
ease with everyone like thiysh!

fields.EN:
Hmm... But if something happened
while we're walking in order, our
reaction time would be delayed.
fields.JP:
う～ん。でも何かあった時、変にまとまってると
動きが鈍くなると思うんだけどなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... But if something happened
while we're walking in order, our
reaction time would be delayed.

fields.EN:
Hm... I suppose that makes
sense...
fields.JP: ふむ……それも一理あるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I suppose that makes
sense...

fields.EN:
Is there anything else we can do
to help?
fields.JP: 他にはどうすると落ち着く、とかある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there anything else we can do
to help?

fields.EN:
If possible... holding hands,
um... seems to help... Augh! This
is so embarrasshing!
fields.JP:
で、できれば手を繋ぐと……その……
落ち着くはずだ……って、ええい！
みなまで言わすでにゃい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If possible... holding hands,
um... seems to help... Augh! This
is so embarrasshing!

fields.EN:
Hm... The attitude of a king, but
the fear response of a child...
That's surprising.
fields.JP:
ふーん、普段は王様気取りなのに、
こういう時は手を繋ぎたいだなんて……
なんだか意外ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... The attitude of a king, but
the fear response of a child...
That's surprising.

fields.EN:
It is pretty unexpected... Or
cute, rather...
fields.JP:
確かに、ちょっと意外ですね……
ちょっと可愛らしいというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is pretty unexpected... Or
cute, rather...

fields.EN:
Tch...! S-Say any more and I shall
burn you all with hellfire!
fields.JP:
くっ……！
そ、それ以上言うと、地獄の業火で焼くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...! S-Say any more and I shall
burn you all with hellfire!

fields.EN:
Hmm... Holding hands with Marchens
while walking in order...
fields.JP:
うーん。それにしても……
メルヒェンと手をつないで整列かあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... Holding hands with Marchens
while walking in order...

fields.EN:
Hm? Does that bother you? They are
cute, you know?
fields.JP:
あら。そうかしら？
なかなかあれで可愛いのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Does that bother you? They are
cute, you know?

fields.JP: メルヒェンおいしいよ！

fields.EN:
(Hameln wasn't eating the
Marchens? That's pretty surprising
to me...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンはメルヒェンを食べて
　いなかったんだ……むしろ意外だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln wasn't eating the
Marchens? That's pretty surprising
to me...)

fields.EN:
Of course we wouldn't know! I, at
least, have not met a Marchen that
didn't attack before!
fields.JP:
襲ってこないメルヒェンなんて、出会ったこと
ありませんし、わかりませんわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course we wouldn't know! I, at
least, have not met a Marchen that
didn't attack before!

fields.EN:
A friendly Marchen...? It would be
nice if there were some like
that...
fields.JP:
友好的なメルヒェンですか～
いたらいいかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
A friendly Marchen...? It would be
nice if there were some like
that...

fields.EN:
You're only saying that so that
you wouldn't have to fight...
fields.JP: あんたの場合はどうせサボるためでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're only saying that so that
you wouldn't have to fight...

fields.EN:
But perhaps they would be useful
if they worked for us...
fields.JP: 働いてもらうと便利そうじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But perhaps they would be useful
if they worked for us...

fields.EN:
Hearing you girls talk is starting
to make my head spin...
fields.JP:
な、何だかあんた達と話してたら、頭が
こんがらがってきたよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hearing you girls talk is starting
to make my head spin...

fields.EN:
If there are friendly Marchens,
all that remains is whether we can
find common ground with them.
fields.JP:
確かにそうなると、生物としての利害の一致が
見出せるかどうかになってくるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there are friendly Marchens,
all that remains is whether we can
find common ground with them.

fields.JP: よ、余計こんがらがるから……！

fields.EN:
Well, when they die, they become
part of my clothing, so they
aren't all that bad.
fields.JP:
いや、死ねばこうして衣類にもなってくれるし、
悪い奴らではないぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, when they die, they become
part of my clothing, so they
aren't all that bad.

fields.EN:
(Does that mean that there are
useful Marchens, too...?)
fields.JP:
（メルヒェンにも、有害なのと違うのがいるって
　ことだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does that mean that there are
useful Marchens, too...?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe like Gretel and Hansel? If
so, it would mean that someone's
ordering them to attack humans.)
fields.JP:
（それは……グレーテルとヘンゼルみたいな
　ものなのかな？　そうすると、やっぱり誰かが
　人間を襲えと命令してることになる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe like Gretel and Hansel? If
so, it would mean that someone's
ordering them to attack humans.)

fields.JP: ん？　どうかしたか、ジャック？

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry... I was just thinking a
bit about the Marchens...
fields.JP:
あ、ごめん……ちょっとメルヒェンについて
考えちゃってて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry... I was just thinking a
bit about the Marchens...

fields.JP: 貴様は変わった奴だな……

fields.EN:
(Uh, of all the people who would
say that to me...)
fields.JP: （いや……君には言われたくないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, of all the people who would
say that to me...)

fields.EN:
Okay, Hameln-san. Why don't we hold
hands?
fields.JP:
……じゃあ、ハーメルンさん……
一緒に、手を繋ぎましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, Hameln. Why don't we hold
hands?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP: そうですわね！　楽しそうですもの！
む、むう……そこまで申すのなら……

fields.EN:
Okay, then Shirayuki will hold
your right hand!
fields.JP: じゃあ、白雪は右手ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then Snow White will hold
your right hand!

fields.EN: I will hold your left hand!
fields.JP: ではわたくしは左手を……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I will hold your left hand!

fields.JP:
ふ、ふん……
く、苦しゅうない……！

fields.EN:
Ahhh... I can already feel the
tension easing inside me...
fields.JP: はー。何とも心が安らぐな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahhh... I can already feel the
tension easing inside me...

fields.JP:
（ふふ……ハーメルン、あんなに嬉しそうな
　顔して……）

fields.EN:
(I suppose that's her Blood Maiden
trait then...)
fields.JP:
（でも……これも血式少女特有のこだわり
　なのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose that's her Blood Maiden
trait then...)

fields.EN:
Hameln... I thought I heard you
calling for me. Is something
wrong?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン……何か困ったことでもあった？
確か呼ばれてたと思ったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln... I thought I heard you
calling for me. Is something
wrong?

fields.EN:
Ah, it's you... Well then, come
in...
fields.JP:
ああ……貴様か……
まあ、とりあえず入るがよい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, it's you... Well then, come
in...

fields.EN:
(What's the matter with her? She's
not her usual self today...)
fields.JP:
（どうしたんだろう？　いつもと何だか様子が
　違う気がするけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the matter with her? She's
not her usual self today...)

fields.EN:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... Is she feeling down?)
fields.JP:
（こんなハーメルン、初めて見た……
　ひょっとして落ち込んでる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't seen her like this
before... Is she feeling down?)

fields.EN:
Um, what's the matter? You don't
seem well. Is there a problem?
fields.JP:
あの……どうしたの？
元気がないけど、何か悩み事とか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what's the matter? You don't
seem well. Is there a problem?

fields.EN:
W-Well... Um... It's hard for me
to say this, but...
fields.JP:
じ、実はな……その……
少々、言いにくいのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... Um... It's hard for me
to say this, but...

fields.EN:
(Is she having that big of a
problem?)
fields.JP: （そ、そんな深刻な悩みなのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she having that big of a
problem?)

fields.EN:
I've been waiting forever now,
but... Clara hasn't brought me my
pipe yet...
fields.JP:
くららの奴が……いつまで経っても
笛を持ってきてくれないのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been waiting forever now,
but... Clara hasn't brought me my
pipe yet...

fields.EN:
She promised me she would give
me one, and... I was eagerly
awaiting her arrival...
fields.JP:
くれると約束していたのに……
ワレは楽しみにしていたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She promised me she would give
me one, and... I was eagerly
awaiting her arrival...

fields.EN:
Maybe she just forgot. Clara has
a knack for forgetting things.
fields.JP:
……うっかり忘れてるだけじゃないかな？
くらら、結構忘れっぽいし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she just forgot. Clara has
a knack for forgetting things.

fields.EN:
Ah, but... Something doesn't feel
right... I'm getting bad vibes
from this...
fields.JP:
ああ。しかし……どうも腑に落ちぬ……
何故だか胸がざわざわするのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but... Something doesn't feel
right... I'm getting bad vibes
from this...

fields.EN:
I know it isn't anything major,
and that she has no ill
intentions, however...
fields.JP:
このような些細な約束で、しかも……
相手には悪意がないのもわかっているのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it isn't anything major,
and that she has no ill
intentions, however...

fields.EN:
If this was a promise of an
important nature, what would have
happened to me by now?
fields.JP:
もしこれが、もっと重大な約束だったら……
ワレは一体、どうなってしまうのだろうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this was a promise of an
important nature, what would have
happened to me by now?

fields.EN:
(If it were me making that promise
with her, I wouldn't want to worry
her like this...)
fields.JP:
（だったら……せめて僕は、そんな不安な思いは
　させたくないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If it were me making that promise
with her, I wouldn't want to worry
her like this...)

fields.EN:
Um... I'll promise you that I
won't break any promises with you.
fields.JP:
あのさ……僕は約束を破ったりしないって、
約束するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I'll promise you that I
won't break any promises with you.

fields.EN:
Heh... Well, it does sound strange
that I'm promising a promise.
fields.JP:
……『約束を破らない』っていう約束も、
なんか変かもしれないけど……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Well, it does sound strange
that I'm promising a promise.

fields.EN:
Hm... The promise has been sealed!
Be wary of what will happen if you
break it, Jack!
fields.JP:
ふ……それでは約束成立だな！
破ったら承知せぬから、よく覚えておけ！
ジャックよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... The promise has been sealed!
Be wary of what will happen if you
break it, Jack!

fields.EN:
Heh... A promise... A promise with
Jack!
fields.JP:
えへへ……約束……
ジャックと約束したぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... A promise... A promise with
Jack!

fields.EN:
(Hameln looks really happy... I
better make sure I keep that
promise.)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルン……嬉しそうでよかった……
　約束、絶対に守らなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln looks really happy... I
better make sure I keep that
promise.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if this is her Blood
Libido that Gretel was talking
about...)
fields.JP:
（でも……これも、グレーテルの言ってた
　『血式リビドー』ってやつなのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if this is her Blood
Libido that Gretel was talking
about...)

fields.EN:
Speaking of, why do you want the
pipe?
fields.JP:
そういえば……
ところで、なんでそんなに笛が欲しいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of, why do you want the
pipe?

fields.EN:
W-Well... It's because... I want
to sing and dance with everyone...
Is that a problem?!
fields.JP:
そ、それはだな……
み、みんなと一緒に歌ったり踊ったり……
したいのだ……悪いか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... It's because... I want
to sing and dance with everyone...
Is that a problem?!

fields.EN:
Not at all. I'm sure you'll be
able to do that soon!
fields.JP:
ううん。そんなことないよ。
いつか、きっとできるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I'm sure you'll be
able to do that soon!

fields.EN:
W-Well then... I suppose you will
suffice for now!
fields.JP:
……だ、だから……今日のところは……
貴様で我慢してやることにした！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well then... I suppose you will
suffice for now!

fields.EN:
What's the matter? Now, your hands
to my hip...
fields.JP: ……どうしたのだ？　さあ、ワレの腰に手を
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? Now, your hands
to my hip...

fields.EN:
I will show you how to waltz. See,
you move your foot like... so.
fields.JP:
ワルツ、という踊りの作法なのだ。
……いいか？　こう、足を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will show you how to waltz. See,
you move your foot like... so.

fields.EN: Heh... Not bad at all, Jack.
fields.JP: ふふ……なかなか筋がいいぞ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh... Not bad at all, Jack.

fields.EN:
(I have no idea whether I'm really
dancing well or not, but...)
fields.JP: （うまく踊れてるのか、わからないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have no idea whether I'm really
dancing well or not, but...)

fields.JP: （ハーメルンの歌声、綺麗だな……）
みんな、あんまり離れちゃ駄目だからねー！
うーーー。おなかすいたー

fields.EN:
And, no catching Marchens or
eating the Jail.
fields.JP:
メルヒェン獲りに行ったりジェイル食べたり
するのも駄目だからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, no catching Marchens or
eating the Jail.

fields.JP: うー。あかあかきびしーー
fields.LOCALIZED: Urrh... Red Riding Hood so mean...

fields.EN: Rapu-Rapu, I brought us some sweets!
fields.JP: ラプラプ、お菓子持ってきましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rappy, I brought us some sweets!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(Heh... Everyone looks a bit more
relaxed now...)
fields.JP: （はは……みんなもほっとしてるみたいだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh... Everyone looks a bit more
relaxed now...)

fields.EN:
(I feel a bit tired, though... I
guess it was great timing that we
got to rest for now...)
fields.JP:
（でも……ちょっと疲れたな……
　休憩取れて助かったかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a bit tired, though... I
guess it was great timing that we
got to rest for now...)

fields.JP: （すごく悲しそうな顔してる……）

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You should stay
close to everyone...
fields.JP: どうしたの？　あんまり離れないほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You should stay
close to everyone...

fields.EN:
Everyone says... that my way of
battling is not good. But I don't
know what they mean by that...
fields.JP:
みんなが……口を揃えて言うのだ。
ワレの戦い方が、なっていないと……
だが……ワレには何が不味いのか、わからぬ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone says... that my way of
battling is not good. But I don't
know what they mean by that...

fields.EN:
They said that... I'm causing
disorder with my lack of
teamwork...
fields.JP:
その……ワレだけ、チームワークが悪いと……
皆の輪を乱していると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said that... I'm causing
disorder with my lack of
teamwork...

fields.EN:
(It's true that she tends to go in
solo, but it's not like everyone's
fighting in unison all the time.)
fields.JP:
（確かにハーメルンはスタンドプレーが多いけど
　……でもみんな別に、めちゃくちゃ息を合わせて
　るってわけでもないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true that she tends to go in
solo, but it's not like everyone's
fighting in unison all the time.)

fields.EN: What... What am I supposed to do?!
fields.JP:
ワレは……ワレは一体どうすれば良いのだ……？
さっぱり分からぬ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What... What am I supposed to do?!

fields.EN:
(Wait... Maybe it looks like Hameln isn't trying
to join everyone?)
fields.JP:
（……あ。ひょっとしたら、ハーメルンがみんなの
　輪に入ろうとしてないように見えてるんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... Is she trying to fit
in...?)
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: 何だ？　何でも申すが良い

fields.EN:
Maybe they're saying that you
should fight with us as an ally
and not as an enemy.
fields.JP:
周りにいるのは敵じゃなくて、味方だってことを
意識して戦えってこと……じゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe they're saying that you
should fight with us as an ally
and not as an enemy.

fields.JP: ……貴様は一体、何を言っているのだ？

fields.EN:
I joined you all. Of course I know
you are my allies!
fields.JP:
……このワレが、仲間になると言ったのだ。
貴様らが味方だという事くらい、分かっておるに
決まっておろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I joined you all. Of course I know
you are my allies!

fields.EN:
Um, that's not what I was trying
to say... I just think that they
still don't know you well, and...
fields.JP:
えっと、そういう事じゃなくて……
多分まだみんな、ハーメルンのことが、ちゃんと
わかってないというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, that's not what I was trying
to say... I just think that they
still don't know you well, and...

fields.EN:
Don't know me?! I am one with
you all! And yet, what is it that
you don't know about me?!
fields.JP:
わかっていないだと！？
……ワレは、間違いなく貴様らの仲間だ！
なのに……一体何がわからんというのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't know me?! I am one with
you all! And yet, what is it that
you don't know about me?!

fields.EN:
O-Of course we know that! But,
you only joined us recently, so...
fields.JP:
そ、それはもちろんわかってるよ！
でも、まだ仲間になって日が浅いから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course we know that! But,
you only joined us recently, so...

fields.EN:
You feel a bit distant from us
both in battle and in your daily
life... But we can get to...
fields.JP:
普段の生活や作戦でも、まだ微妙に距離を感じてる
んじゃって……でも、それはこれから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You feel a bit distant from us
both in battle and in your daily
life... But we can get to...

fields.EN:
Enough! Distance?! Daily life?! I
have no idea what you are trying
to say!
fields.JP:
……もうよい！！
距離だの生活だの……ワレにはさっぱりわからぬ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough! Distance?! Daily life?! I
have no idea what you are trying
to say!

fields.EN:
(How else was I supposed to
approach her...?)
fields.JP: （……どう言えばよかったんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How else was I supposed to
approach her...?)

fields.JP:
（ハーメルン、あの時以来ずっと元気がない
　気がする……）

fields.EN:
(I wonder how I can get through to
her...)
fields.JP: （……どう言ったらうまく伝わるかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder how I can get through to
her...)

fields.EN:
Urrh... I can't figure it out! Not
one bit!
fields.JP:
むううう……ぬう……
やはり我にはさっぱり分からん！
分からんぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I can't figure it out! Not
one bit!

fields.EN:
(What's with those stacks of
manga? The titles look like
they're about friendship...)
fields.JP:
（ま、漫画の山……？
　しかもなんだかやたら熱血友情っぽい？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's with those stacks of
manga? The titles look like
they're about friendship...)

fields.EN:
Hm, it's you, Jack. What are you
doing standing over theyur? Come
in.
fields.JP:
む……ジャックか。
何をそんなところで突っ立っていりゅ？
……入ってよいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, it's you, Jack. What are you
doing standing over theyur? Come
in.

fields.EN:
These? I borrowed them from
Gretel.
fields.JP:
これか？
これはな……グレーテルに借りたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
These? I borrowed them from
Gretel.

fields.EN:
(I knew Gretel had a lot of books
with her, but I didn't expect her
to have manga, too...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテル、確かに本はいっぱい持ってる
　けど……漫画もあったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I knew Gretel had a lot of books
with her, but I didn't expect her
to have manga, too...)

fields.EN:
W-Well... I wanted to know what
this "teamwork" was about...
fields.JP:
そ、それはだな……
チームワークというのが一体何なのか……
その、ワレも知りたくてだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... I wanted to know what
this "teamwork" was about...

fields.EN:
But...! I can't figure out what
it is, no matter how many times I
read about it!
fields.JP:
……だが！！
何度読んでも……どういう事なのか、
やはりさっっっっぱり分からぬ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...! I can't figure out what
it is, no matter how many times I
read about it!

fields.EN:
I've been alone from birth, so I
have no idea what else to refer
to.
fields.JP:
ワレは……生まれてからずっと、一人だった故、
何を参考にすれば良いのか分からぬのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been alone from birth, so I
have no idea what else to refer
to.

fields.EN:
I, too, know that I need to
change, but... I don't know how...
fields.JP:
もちろん、このままではいけないとも思う……
だが、何をどうすれば良いのか、分からぬのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I, too, know that I need to
change, but... I don't know how...

fields.EN:
(She's trying her best to figure
things out...)
fields.JP: （この子なりに、必死で考えてたんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's trying her best to figure
things out...)

fields.EN:
Hameln, um... I'm sorry about last
time...
fields.JP: ハーメルン。……この間は……ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, um... I'm sorry about last
time...

fields.EN:
I couldn't explain myself very
well, and... I think I confused
you with what I said.
fields.JP:
この前はなんだか、うまく説明できなくて……
君を混乱させちゃったみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't explain myself very
well, and... I think I confused
you with what I said.

fields.EN:
I was already confused to start
with. That was no fault of
yours...
fields.JP:
ワレが勝手に混乱した故、別に気にしてなど
おらぬが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was already confused to start
with. That was no fault of
yours...

fields.EN:
(I guess she's really honest at
heart...)
fields.JP: （基本的には素直な子、なんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess she's really honest at
heart...)

fields.EN:
Everyone thinks of you as their
friend, Hameln... I feel the same
way, too...
fields.JP:
みんな、ハーメルンの事は……
ハーメルンが思ってる以上にちゃんと仲間だって
思ってるよ。もちろん僕だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone thinks of you as their
friend, Hameln... I feel the same
way, too...

fields.EN:
Yes, but... I think everyone wants
you to rely on them a bit more.
And they want to rely on you, too.
fields.JP:
うん。ただ……
きっと皆、君にもっと頼ってほしいんだよ。
そして、君を頼りたいとも思ってる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but... I think everyone wants
you to rely on them a bit more.
And they want to rely on you, too.

fields.EN:
Really...? But, I don't understand
that concept very well...
fields.JP:
頼り……頼られる……？
だが……ワレは……それがどういうことなのか、
よくわからなくてな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really...? But, I don't understand
that concept very well...

fields.EN:
As the greatest among you all, my
leading the charge would protect
everyone else.
fields.JP:
たとえば……最強のワレが前面に立って戦えば、
結果的にはみんなを守れるのではないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the greatest among you all, my
leading the charge would protect
everyone else.

fields.EN:
You are strong, but that doesn't
mean you're immortal, right?
fields.JP:
確かに君は強いけど、それでも不死ってわけ
じゃないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are strong, but that doesn't
mean you're immortal, right?

fields.JP: む……それは確かに、そうだが……

fields.EN:
That's why everyone's worried
about you. No one wants to see
you hurt, or even worse, die...
fields.JP:
だから、みんなはそんな君を心配してるんだよ。
ハーメルンだけがひどい怪我をしたり、死んだり
なんか、誰もしてほしくないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why everyone's worried
about you. No one wants to see
you hurt, or even worse, die...

fields.EN: Of course, I feel the same way...
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course, I feel the same way...

fields.EN:
We don't know what kind of enemies
we're going to have to face.
That's why we should help each other.
fields.JP:
これからだって、どんな強敵が現れるか、
わからないし……
だからこそ、みんなで協力し合いたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know what kind of enemies
we're going to have to face.
That's why we should help each other.

fields.EN:
Is that what it means to be this
"friend" you mentioned?
fields.JP: ……それが、仲間、ということなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that what it means to be this
"friend" you mentioned?

fields.EN:
(Did I finally get through to
her...?)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did I finally get through to
her...?)

fields.EN:
Jack... I want you to follow me to
a certain place. Will you come
with me?
fields.JP:
……ジャックよ。
貴様に、一緒に来てほしい場所がある。
……ついてきてくれるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I want you to follow me to
a certain place. Will you come
with me?

fields.EN:
I found this place while I was
strolling the area. It is my
favorite special place.
fields.JP:
この間、散歩していて見つけたのだ。
……ワレのお気に入りの場所なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found this place while I was
strolling the area. It is my
favorite special place.

fields.EN:
I see... But, why are you showing
me a place that's special to you?
fields.JP:
そうなんだ……！
でも、どうしてそんな大切な場所に、僕を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... But, why are you showing
me a place that's special to you?

fields.EN:
I learned through the manga I read
that a special place is needed to
come to a resolution with friends.
fields.JP:
な、仲間と和解し誓い合う時には、
『とっておきの場所』でするのだと……
そう、漫画で学んだのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned through the manga I read
that a special place is needed to
come to a resolution with friends.

fields.EN:
That's why I brought you here...
So that I can pledge myself as a
"friend."
fields.JP: だから、その……改めて仲間の誓いをしたいのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I brought you here...
So that I can pledge myself as a
"friend."

fields.EN:
Thanks, and... I hope we all can
be the best of friends!
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ……！
これからも、よろしく……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, and... I hope we all can
be the best of friends!

fields.EN:
I appreciate it, Jack... Now then,
let's join hands!
fields.JP:
感謝するぞ、ジャック……
よし！　では、手を握ろうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate it, Jack... Now then,
let's join hands!

fields.EN:
Why are you blushing? Are you
prepared to deny my wish?
fields.JP:
何を照れておるのだ？
ワレがこうしたいのだ……よいだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you blushing? Are you
prepared to deny my wish?

fields.EN:
(Her hands are soft and small... I
can tell she's no different from
any other girl...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンの手、小さくて、柔らかい……
　こういうところは、普通の女の子と変わらない
　んだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her hands are soft and small... I
can tell she's no different from
any other girl...)

fields.EN:
In all honesty, I still don't know
what it means to be friends, given
my solitary life.
fields.JP:
ずっと一人で生きてきたワレにはきっとまだ、
仲間というものが、正直、よく分かっておらぬ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In all honesty, I still don't know
what it means to be friends, given
my solitary life.

fields.EN: I once met some humans underground. They were a group of five who said they were companions trying to escape together.
fields.JP:
以前、地下で人間に会ったことがある。
五人組で、共に脱獄を目指す仲間だと言っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Previously, I met humans in my
abode who said they were friends
seeking to escape...

fields.EN:
I didn't understand what they were
talking about, as I had not had
anyone around to call friends.
fields.JP:
その時は、そいつらの言うことが全く分からなかった。
するとそいつらは、仲間がいないから分からないんだ、
と言った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't understand what they were
talking about, as I had not had
anyone around to call friends.

fields.EN: But... I understand how you and everyone else care about me. Someday, I must apologize to everyone too...
fields.JP:
だが……ワレを大切に思ってくれているという、
貴様やみんなの気持ちは承知した。
いずれ、みんなにも謝らねばな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand everyone is concerned
about me, and I appreciate that.
One day, I will let everyone know.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sure everyone would love
to hear that from you!
fields.JP: うん……きっとみんな、喜ぶよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sure everyone would love
to hear that from you!

fields.EN:
And you, Jack... I give you this
sight as proof of my friendship to
you. We shall escape together!
fields.JP:
そして、ジャック……
この景色を、我々の友情の証としよう。
共に、必ずや脱獄を果たそうぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you, Jack... I give you this
sight as proof of my friendship to
you. We shall escape together!

fields.EN:
Say, Jack... Might I ask you a
question?
fields.JP: なあ……ジャック。一つ聞いてもよいか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack... Might I ask you a
question?

fields.JP: （ハーメルン、何だか不安そうだ……）

fields.EN:
After we escape, what will happen
to us?
fields.JP:
もし、脱獄に成功したら……
その後、我々はどうなるのだろうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we escape, what will happen
to us?

fields.EN:
I promised you that we will escape
here, and I set that as my goal...
fields.JP:
ワレは、貴様にこの間誓った……
この監獄からの、脱獄を。
だから、それを目標にこれまでやってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promised you that we will escape
here, and I set that as my goal...

fields.EN:
But, what happens when we succeed?
What should I live for? The
thought is bearing down on me...
fields.JP:
だが……それが終わったら、ワレはどうなる？
何を目標に生きれば良い？
それを考えていると、ふと不安になってな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, what happens when we succeed?
What should I live for? The
thought is bearing down on me...

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel... I get
anxious thinking about it
sometimes, too...
fields.JP:
僕も……君の気持ちはわかるよ。
時々、不安になることもあるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel... I get
anxious thinking about it
sometimes, too...

fields.EN:
I see... So what lies in wait
beyond that?
fields.JP:
貴様もやはり、そうか……
我々は、この先一体……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So what lies in wait
beyond that?

fields.EN:
I don't know what to expect after
we escape, but I feel like
something is going to change...
fields.JP:
……ここを出た後のことなんかわからないし、
よくわからないけど、何かが大きく変わって
しまいそうな、そんな気もするんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what to expect after
we escape, but I feel like
something is going to change...

fields.EN:
What I do know is that we will
always be friends. That won't
change a bit.
fields.JP:
でも、一つだけはっきりしてる事がある。
それは……僕たちが仲間だって事だよ。
ここを出た後でも、それは変わらないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I do know is that we will
always be friends. That won't
change a bit.

fields.EN:
So maybe you can hold that thought
until after we escape. It isn't
careful planning, that's for sure.
fields.JP:
だから……その先の事は、その時に考えれば
いいんじゃないかな？
行き当たりばったりかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So maybe you can hold that thought
until after we escape. It isn't
careful planning, that's for sure.

fields.EN:
Hahahahaha! You're right! I can't
believe I was concerned over such
a simple matter.
fields.JP:
ふ……ふははははは……！
確かに、貴様の言うとおりだ。
ワレは何を簡単な事で悩んでいたのだろうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahahaha! You're right! I can't
believe I was concerned over such
a simple matter.

fields.EN:
And to think that I never worried
about the future at all before.
fields.JP:
よくよく考えてみれば、ワレはこれまで、
未来について心配した事など、
生まれてこの方、今まで一度もなかったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And to think that I never worried
about the future at all before.

fields.EN:
But now, I have everyone with
me... I have you... There is
nothing to concern myself with!
fields.JP:
しかも、今は貴様や、仲間達がいる……
何故不安になる必要があろうか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now, I have everyone with
me... I have you... There is
nothing to concern myself with!

fields.EN:
I think you were concerned because
you have friends you care about
now. It's the same for me, too...
fields.JP:
……馬鹿馬鹿しくなんかないよ。
不安になるのは、大切な仲間ができたからだと
思う。僕もそうだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you were concerned because
you have friends you care about
now. It's the same for me, too...

fields.EN:
Jack... You are very kind, aren't
you?
fields.JP:
ジャック……
貴様は、どこまでも優しいのだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... You are very kind, aren't
you?

fields.JP:
……そ、そうだ！
ワレは良い事を思いついたぞ！！

fields.EN:
Once we escape, we shall hold a
grand banquet!
fields.JP:
いつか、ここを脱出した暁には……
ワレと共に盛大な宴を挙げよう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we escape, we shall hold a
grand banquet!

fields.JP: それは良いアイデアだね……！

fields.EN:
O-Of course, it will be for the
two of us...
fields.JP:
も、もちろん……
わ、ワレと貴様の二人だけでな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course, it will be for the
two of us...

fields.JP:
う、ううん、そんなことない！
そうだね……！

fields.EN:
Hm, now I have something to look
forward to after the escape!
Hahahaha!
fields.JP:
ふ……そう考えると、
脱出した後も楽しみになってきおったわ！
はははは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, now I have something to look
forward to after the escape!
Hahahaha!

fields.EN:
Um... Hameln-san? Do you mind if I bother
you for a bit?
fields.JP:
あ、あのう……ハーメルンさん。
ちょっとよろしいですこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Hameln? Do you mind if I bother
you for a bit?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Hm? You mean now? As you can
see, I am currently enjoying my
mail...
fields.JP:
む……何だ、藪から棒に……？
ワレは今食事中だじょ……もぎゅ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? You mean now? As you can
see, I am currently enjoying my
mail...

fields.EN:
(Cinderella? Is she wanting to eat
with Hameln?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、シンデレラだ。
　ハーメルンとご飯を食べたいのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella? Is she wanting to eat
with Hameln?)

fields.EN:
Um, I'll leave if you're busy
now...
fields.JP: その……差し出がましければすみませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'll leave if you're busy
now...

fields.JP: ん……？　いいからしゃっしゃと申せ

fields.EN:
If you would like, would you mind
if I washed your clothes for you?
fields.JP:
わたくしでよければ、貴女のその服を、
洗って差し上げましてよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you would like, would you mind
if I washed your clothes for you?

fields.EN:
Wh-What?! Are you saying that my
clothes are filthy?!
fields.JP:
な……なん……だと！？
それは貴様……まさか、
ワレの衣装が汚いとでも言うつもりか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?! Are you saying that my
clothes are filthy?!

fields.EN:
Th-That's not what I meant... I
just...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな事は……
わたくしはただ、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not what I meant... I
just...

fields.EN:
Then what are you trying to tell
me?!
fields.JP:
でなければ、何故そんなことを申すのだ！？
おかしいではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then what are you trying to tell
me?!

fields.EN:
Yes! You're right! Everyone is
bothered by your dirtiness!
fields.JP:
……ええ！　その通りでしてよ！！
みなさん、迷惑してますわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! You're right! Everyone is
bothered by your dirtiness!

fields.EN:
This is a cafeteria! Have the tact
to at least think about the people
here!
fields.JP:
だいたいここは食堂ですのよ！
少しはそういうことをお気遣いなさっても
よろしいのではありませんこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a cafeteria! Have the tact
to at least think about the people
here!

fields.JP: （こ、これは、間に入ったほうが……！？）
そんなにワレは汚い……のか……？

fields.EN:
I don't believe it... I didn't
notice it at all... How
shameful...
fields.JP:
なんということだ……全く気付かなかった……
このワレが……そのような醜態を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe it... I didn't
notice it at all... How
shameful...

fields.EN:
Um, did I make it sound that
bad...? It's just that...
fields.JP:
あ……そ、そこまでは言ってませんわよ……
わ、わたくしはただ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, did I make it sound that
bad...? It's just that...

fields.JP:
……貴女のその服が、だいぶ傷んでいるよう
でしたから……

fields.EN:
I wanted to wash them and patch
them up for you...
fields.JP: ただ、洗って、繕って差し上げたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to wash them and patch
them up for you...

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry for raising my
voice...
fields.JP:
わたくし、ついカっとなってしまいまして……
すみませんですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry for raising my
voice...

fields.EN:
No, I am the one to apologize. It
seems I doubted you, despite your
profound kindness...
fields.JP:
いや、ワレの方こそ悪かった……
貴様は……とても優しいのだな。
なのに、すまぬ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I am the one to apologize. It
seems I doubted you, despite your
profound kindness...

fields.JP: そ、そんなことはないですわ……！

fields.EN:
(I guess it turned out for the
best... I feel like they each got
through to each other.)
fields.JP:
（な、なんとかなった……！？
　むしろ仲良くなれそうな感じだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess it turned out for the
best... I feel like they each got
through to each other.)

fields.EN:
Very well, then. I would like you
to handle my clothes for me. Just
a moment...
fields.JP:
……では、宜しく頼もう。
……少し待っておれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well, then. I would like you
to handle my clothes for me. Just
a moment...

fields.EN:
Y-You shouldn't be taking off your
clothes in such a public place!
fields.JP:
お、女の子がこんなところで
服を脱いではいけませんですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You shouldn't be taking off your
clothes in such a public place!

fields.EN:
Odd... You were the one who wanted
to wash my clothes. So, here...
fields.JP:
妙な事を……
洗いたいと言ったのは貴様ではないか。
だから今、こうしてだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
