Odd... You were the one who wanted
to wash my clothes. So, here...

fields.EN:
(Sh-Should I stop her?! B-But that
means I would see her... Uh, but I
did see her already...)
fields.JP:
（ぼ、僕も止めた方がいいのか……！？
　でも、それもずっと見てたようで……
　いや……見てたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sh-Should I stop her?! B-But that
means I would see her... Uh, but I
did see her already...)

fields.EN:
(I know! I'll just slowly back
away, and...)
fields.JP: （よし！　ここは、ひっそりと立ち去って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know! I'll just slowly back
away, and...)

fields.EN:
What do you think you're doing?!
If you saw what happened, go in
and stop it!
fields.JP:
あんた、何コソコソ逃げようとしてんのよ！？
見てたんなら、さっさと止めなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you think you're doing?!
If you saw what happened, go in
and stop it!

fields.EN:
You too, Hameln! This isn't the
place to take your clothes off in!
fields.JP:
アンタもよ、ハーメルン！
ここで服を脱ぐなっつーの！
そういう場所じゃないんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Hameln! This isn't the
place to take your clothes off in!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I don't know why
you need to yell like that,
though...
fields.JP:
す、すまぬ……
しかし、そんなに大きな声を出さなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I don't know why
you need to yell like that,
though...

fields.EN:
Your voice is louder than this
most of the time!
fields.JP: アンタの普段の声のほうがよっぽど大きいわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your voice is louder than this
most of the time!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable! It's like I'm
surrounded by a bunch of idiots!
fields.JP:
まったく、どいつもこいつも……！
バカばっかりなんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable! It's like I'm
surrounded by a bunch of idiots!

fields.JP:
をーほほほほほ！
さすが親指姫さんの一喝ですわね！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
You too, Cinderella! You're not as
tough as you look!
fields.JP:
アンタもよ、シンデレラ。
こう見えて弱腰なんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Cinderella! You're not as
tough as you look!

fields.JP: うう……すみませんですわ……
ほら、マント引きずってるわよ

fields.EN:
Now stop bothering me from eating
my food, you hear?
fields.JP:
まったく、
食事くらい落ち着いてさせなさいよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now stop bothering me from eating
my food, you hear?

fields.EN:
(Got to hand it to Oyayubihime for
putting things in order...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Got to hand it to Thumbelina for
putting things in order...)

fields.JP: ひゃぁぁあああああああっ！！？

（今の声は……ハーメルン！？
　何があったんだ！？）

ハーメルン！？
どうしたの……！？

fields.EN:
(What in the world is she doing,
using her power?! What's going on
here?!)
fields.JP:
（めちゃくちゃ興奮してる……？
　ていうか、普通に能力使ってるし！？
　な……何があったんだ！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the world is she doing,
using her power?! What's going on
here?!)

fields.EN:
I will end your life, you
worthless bug! You will
pay for surprising me!
fields.JP:
絶対……殺す……！！
身の程知らずの虫ケラめ……！！
ワレを驚かせた事を、後悔するがよい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will end your life, you
worthless bug! You will
pay for surprising me!

fields.EN:
B-Bug...? Wait... Is this all
about a bug?
fields.JP:
む……虫？
もしかして……部屋に虫が出たの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-Bug...? Wait... Is this all
about a bug?

fields.EN:
Damn you, bug! How dare you come
at me from behind! I shall kill
you! Die!
fields.JP:
くそう、虫ケラめ！
いきなり背後からとは卑怯な……！！
絶対殺す！　とにかく殺す！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn you, bug! How dare you come
at me from behind! I shall kill
you! Die!

fields.EN:
C-Calm down, Hameln! P-Parts of
your room are on fire!
fields.JP:
お、落ち着いてハーメルン！！
部屋ちょっと燃えてるし！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Calm down, Hameln! P-Parts of
your room are on fire!

fields.EN:
(How can someone who lived among
Marchens be so scared of bugs?)
fields.JP:
（……っていうか、メルヒェンを子分にしてた
　ような子が、何で虫に怯えてるわけ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How can someone who lived among
Marchens be so scared of bugs?)

fields.EN:
It's probably gone already! J-Just
hold off on the flames, and...
fields.JP:
た、多分虫はもう、どこかに行っちゃったよ！
とりあえず、その炎を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably gone already! J-Just
hold off on the flames, and...

fields.EN:
No! I have not confirmed its
carcass yet! Where are you?! Bug!
fields.JP:
ダメだ！！
奴の死骸をまだ確認できておらん！！
どこだ！　虫ケラめ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I have not confirmed its
carcass yet! Where are you?! Bug!

fields.EN:
(She's not listening! I need to at
least put out the fire in here!)
fields.JP:
（ダメだ、聞く耳持ってくれない……！
　とりあえず、火の方をなんとかしなくちゃ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not listening! I need to at
least put out the fire in here!)

fields.EN:
I know! I'll get water from the
bathroom...!
fields.JP:
……そうだ！　
風呂場に行けば、水が……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! I'll get water from the
bathroom...!

fields.EN:
All right! This should do! And...
there!
fields.JP:
よし、これで……！！
それっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! This should do! And...
there!

fields.JP:
ひゃあっ！！？
つ、冷たいいぃい！？

……あ……あれ……？
ジャックではないか……

fields.EN:
Finally got the fire doused... Are
you okay now?
fields.JP:
よかった……火も消えたし、
なんとか落ち着いた……みたいだね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally got the fire doused... Are
you okay now?

fields.JP: ジャック……わ、ワレは、一体……

fields.EN:
(H-Her clothes are hardly covering
anything! I-I need to look away!)
fields.JP:
（って、この格好……ほとんど裸だし……！？
　とにかく……み、見ちゃダメだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(H-Her clothes are hardly covering
anything! I-I need to look away!)

fields.JP:
もしかして、ジャックが……
ワレを助けてくれたのか？

fields.EN:
Uh, well... "Rescue" isn't really
the right word to use...
fields.JP:
い、いや……助けたっていうか……
なんというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... "Rescue" isn't really
the right word to use...

fields.EN: Well done, Jack! I praise thee!
fields.JP:
……よくやったジャック！！
褒めて遣わすぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well done, Jack! I praise thee!

fields.EN:
Uh, but I didn't... Um, before
that...
fields.JP:
い、いや、そんな事は……
っていうか、あの、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but I didn't... Um, before
that...

fields.EN:
What's the matter? You seem quite
flustered.
fields.JP:
どうした？
何を慌てておるのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter? You seem quite
flustered.

fields.JP: い、いや……なんでもないです……！

fields.EN:
(Well, it's because I can't look
at you like that now...)
fields.JP: （……め、目のやり場に困るんですけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, it's because I can't look
at you like that now...)

fields.JP: （あれ？　アリスと……ハーメルンだ）

……む！？
これは……お嬢ではないか……！

fields.EN:
Oh, Hameln? It's unusual to see
you here.
fields.JP:
あら、ハーメルン。
こんなところで会うなんて、奇遇ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Hameln? It's unusual to see
you here.

fields.EN:
S-So true! But... What, may I ask,
are you doing here?
fields.JP:
そ、そうであるな……！
しかし……こんな所で、一体何を？
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-So true! But... What, may I ask,
are you doing here?

fields.EN: I was just taking a walk...
fields.JP: 何って……ただの散歩だけれど……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I was just taking a walk...

fields.EN:
Wha--?! This is no place for a
lady such as yourself to walk
through alone!
fields.JP:
なっ！？
こんな危ない通りで女性が一人で散歩だなどと
……危険すぎるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha--?! This is no place for a
lady such as yourself to walk
through alone!

fields.EN:
Hm? You're making it sound like
this place is dangerous. I don't
see it that way...
fields.JP:
え？　ここって、そんなに危ないの？
そんなイメージはなかったけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? You're making it sound like
this place is dangerous. I don't
see it that way...

fields.EN:
Very well! Let me escort you for
safety!
fields.JP:
よし！　ワレが……お供して差し上げよう！
安心するがよいぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well! Let me escort you for
safety!

fields.JP:
え……？
そ、それはどうも……ありがとう……

fields.EN: It just dawned on me, but...
fields.JP:
……その。
ふと思ったのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED: It just dawned on me, but...

fields.EN:
You said it wasn't a place for a
lady to walk through, but...
you're a girl, too.
fields.JP:
さっき、女性の一人歩きは危ないって
言ってたけれど……よく考えたら、
あなたも、女の子よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said it wasn't a place for a
lady to walk through, but...
you're a girl, too.

fields.EN:
Hmph! But I am the Demon King!
Guarding m'lady is my messhon!
fields.JP:
ふ……ワレは、魔王だ！
よって、お嬢を守るのは我が義務じょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! But I am the Demon King!
Guarding m'lady is my messhon!

fields.EN:
The shoes in the storefront would
surely suit you, m'lady! Might I
suggest you try them on?
fields.JP:
あの店に置いてあるあの靴……
きっとお嬢に似合おうぞ！
試してみてはいかがか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The shoes in the storefront would
surely suit you, m'lady! Might I
suggest you try them on?

fields.EN:
Huh? Do you think so? Well, they
do look cute, but I'm not sure
they would fit my feet...
fields.JP:
え？　そ……そうかしら？
確かに、可愛い靴だけれど……
足のサイズ、合うかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Do you think so? Well, they
do look cute, but I'm not sure
they would fit my feet...

fields.EN:
Ah, feet! M'lady! With all this
walking, you must be tired now!
fields.JP:
はっ……足といえば！
お嬢！　そろそろ疲れたのではないか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, feet! M'lady! With all this
walking, you must be tired now!

fields.JP:
え……？
い、いえ、別にそんなには……

fields.EN:
A-Are you sure?! You need not
force yourself...
fields.JP:
ほ、本当でありゅか！？
無理をしているのでは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Are you sure?! You need not
force yourself...

fields.EN:
A-Are you all right? Your mantle's
caught on the wall!
fields.JP:
あ、あなたこそ……大丈夫！？
マントが壁に引っかかっているわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Are you all right? Your mantle's
caught on the wall!

fields.EN:
I-I am fine! A-Are you all right,
m'lady?!
fields.JP:
わ、ワレは……大丈夫だ！
それより、お嬢はご無事か！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I am fine! A-Are you all right,
m'lady?!

fields.JP:
え？
わ、わたしは大丈夫だけど……

fields.EN:
Look at you... You scraped
yourself... Heh... You're such a
handful, Demon King.
fields.JP:
……ちょっと擦りむいてるじゃない。
ふふ……手のかかる魔王様ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at you... You scraped
yourself... Heh... You're such a
handful, Demon King.

fields.EN:
Here, let me look at your feet.
I'll patch you up.
fields.JP:
ちょっと、足を見せてみなさい。
手当てしてあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, let me look at your feet.
I'll patch you up.

fields.EN:
I guess I can't keep my eyes off
of you for a second...
fields.JP:
まったく、なんだかんだ目が離せないのよね。
この子は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can't keep my eyes off
of you for a second...

fields.EN:
(I'd better not interrupt their
private time together...)
fields.JP:
（せっかく仲良さそうだし……
　邪魔するのはよくないかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd better not interrupt their
private time together...)

fields.EN:
Tsuu and Ningyohime-san must
feel uneasy right now...
Not like they have privacy, too...
fields.JP:
つうと人魚姫さん、きっと前と
環境が違ってて落ち着かないだろうな……
部屋も足りなくて、２人一緒だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Little Mermaid must
feel uneasy right now...
Not like they have privacy, too...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
They won't outright complain about
being in the same room, so maybe
I should bring it up from my side.
fields.JP:
でも不便でも気をつかって
何も言わなそうだし、ここは僕の方から
率先して聞いてあげないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They won't outright complain about
being in the same room, so maybe
I should bring it up from my side.

fields.EN:
This is getting awkward...
I mean, it's not like we've had
a lot of time talking as humans...
fields.JP:
でもなんだか緊張するな……
お互い人間の姿でしゃべるのが
久しぶりだからかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is getting awkward...
I mean, it's not like we've had
a lot of time talking as humans...

fields.JP: そこに誰かいるんですか？
あっ！　ジャックさん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Whoa! Ningyohime-san!
S-Sorry to have bothered you!
fields.JP:
わわっ、人魚姫さん！
と、突然お邪魔してごめん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Little Mermaid!
S-Sorry to have bothered you!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I was just wondering if everything
was okay, especially with how
so much has changed...
fields.JP:
その、新しい環境で
何か困ってないかな、なんて思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just wondering if everything
was okay, especially with how
so much has changed...

fields.EN: Yes, I've had no trouble at all.
fields.JP: ううん、全然こまってないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I've had no trouble at all.

fields.EN:
Oh, perfect timing! I wanted to have a proper
talk with you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
でもちょうどよかった！
わたしもジャックさんと改めて
お話したかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but perfect timing!
I wanted to talk to you about
something.

fields.JP:
だからタイミングバッチリ！
さ、入って

fields.EN:
Um, what's this you want to
talk about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what's this you want to
talk about?

fields.EN:
I'm so happy to spend my time
with Otsuu-chan and everyone.
fields.JP:
ここ数日ね、おつうちゃんや
血式少女のみんなと一緒に過ごして、
わたしとっても幸せなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so happy to spend my time
with Otsuu and everyone.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
And it helps that you're still in human form,
Jack-san.
fields.JP:
それにジャックさんも
人間の姿のままでいてくれてるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also helps seeing you in
human form.

fields.EN:
Well, I didn't fall down into
some underground area in
this world.
fields.JP:
ここでは崖から
落ちたりはしてないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I didn't fall down into
some underground area in
this world.

fields.EN: Right? So, I wanted to thank you.
fields.JP: だからね、改めてお礼を言いたかったの。
fields.LOCALIZED: Right? So, I wanted to thank you.

fields.EN:
Thank you for bringing me back
to life.
fields.JP:
わたしを蘇らせてくれて、
本当にありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for bringing me back
to life.

fields.EN:
Oh no!
I didn't do anything!
fields.JP:
そ、そんな！
僕なんて全然たいしたことしてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no!
I didn't do anything!

fields.EN:
It only happened because the
others were willing to listen to
me...
fields.JP:
血式少女のみんなが
僕のお願いを聞き入れてくれたからで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It only happened because the
others were willing to listen to
me...

fields.EN:
The only one who knows me in
this world is Sis.
fields.JP:
この世界でわたしのことを知っている人は、
血式少女ではおねーちゃんだけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only one who knows me in
this world is Sis.

fields.EN:
No one knew about Otsuu-chan,
and yet everyone pitched in
to help...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんに至っては誰も
知らなかったはず……なのに、
みんな動いてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one knew about Otsuu,
and yet everyone pitched in
to help...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
That all came about because
of you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
それはひとえに、
ジャックさんのおかげ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That all came about because
of you, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
If you hadn't acted, Jack-san, neither
Otsuu-chan nor I would be here now.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんが動いてくれなかったら、
わたしもおつうちゃんも、今ここにいないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you didn't take action, neither
me or Otsuu would be here.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN: So, thank you so very much.
fields.JP: だから、本当にありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, thank you so very much.

fields.EN:
No problem at all. I'm happy
that both of you are here now.
fields.JP:
う、うん……
僕も２人とまたこうして再会できて、
本当に嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem at all. I'm happy
that both of you are here now.

fields.EN:
I guess all that adventuring with
Nightmare Jack-san wasn't all for
naught.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのジャックさんと探索した
日々は、無駄じゃなかったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess all that adventuring with
Nightmare Jack wasn't all for
naught.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Yeah, we're here now because
of what we went through back
in the other world.
fields.JP:
うん、あの時があったから、
今の僕たちがあるんだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we're here now because
of what we went through back
in the other world.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... Ningyohime-san hasn't
changed at all.)
fields.JP:
（よかった、人魚姫さん、
　全然変わってないや）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness...
She's no different than before.)

fields.EN:
(I thought the new environment
she's in would make her anxious,
but I guess she's fine.)
fields.JP:
（環境が違うから不安かなって思ったけど、
　どうやら大丈夫みたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought the new environment
she's in would make her anxious,
but I guess she's fine.)

fields.JP: あの、今回は本当にさ、その……

fields.EN:
Well, um... I'm sorry I didn't
have the chance to say it,
but...
fields.JP:
いやぁ、僕もバタバタしてて、
その、ちゃんと言えなくて……
悪かったんだけど、さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, um... I'm sorry I didn't
have the chance to say it,
but...

fields.EN:
Well, I'm just happy we can talk
like this together.
fields.JP:
う、うん。またこうして
僕もつうと一緒にいられて、
その……嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm just happy we can talk
like this together.

fields.EN:
Uh, so...
Hope we get along here, too.
fields.JP: その、これからもまた……よろしく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, so...
Hope we get along here, too.

fields.JP: う、うん……僕の方こそ、よろしく……
何で今さら照れてるの、２人とも

fields.EN:
Oh, um, it's just that I regained
my memories back when I was a
Nightmare, and...
fields.JP:
い、いやちょっと僕がナイトメアだった
時のこと思い出しちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um, it's just that I regained
my memories back when I was a
Nightmare, and...

fields.EN:
I wasn't necessarily bright back
then, and I was living with her,
so...
fields.JP:
あの時は知性なんてなかったけど、
その、一緒の部屋で暮らしてたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't necessarily bright back
then, and I was living with her,
so...

fields.JP: そ、その言い方はやめてくれ！

うああ、ごめん
つう！
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
So, uh, it feels like remembering
childhood days... You know? It's
just embarrassing to remember.
fields.JP:
その……どこか幼い頃を
知ってるみたいで、恥ずかしいというか……
なんだか複雑な気持ちなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, uh, it feels like remembering
childhood days... You know? It's
just embarrassing to remember.

fields.EN:
Ah, I see. Since you were a Nightmare then,
Jack-san, you would've seen Otsuu-chan as she
really is.
fields.JP:
ああ、なるほど。
確かにナイトメアのジャックさんだったら、
素のおつうちゃんを見てるよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. You were able to see
Otsuu as how she is when you
were a Nightmare.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
How about it, Otsuu-chan? Is Otsuu-chan acting
awkward because you're embarrassed too?
fields.JP:
どうなの、おつうちゃん？
やっぱりおつうちゃんも照れくさいから
ぎこちなくなってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, is that why you're embarrassed
too, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
W-Well, I guess?
But beyond that...
fields.JP: そ、それも確かにあるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I guess?
But beyond that...

fields.EN:
I feel awkward because I was the
cause of everything back then...
fields.JP:
けど、前の世界はすべて、
僕が原因だったんだ……って思うと、
特にジャックには申し訳なくて、さ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel awkward because I was the
cause of everything back then...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. If it wasn't for the
other world, I wouldn't be here
with you two.
fields.JP:
つう……僕は何も恨んでないよ。
むしろあの世界があったから、今こうして
僕たちは一緒にいられるんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. If it wasn't for the
other world, I wouldn't be here
with you two.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
He's right, Otsuu-chan. You did all
that for me too, right? No need to
put yourself down like that.
fields.JP:
そうだよおつうちゃん……
わたしのためにしてくれたことでしょ？
それならそんなに抱え込まないで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right, Otsuu. You did all
that for me too, right? No need to
put yourself down like that.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Thanks... Hearing you two just
lifted the heavy burden on me...
fields.JP:
……２人がそう言ってくれると、
救われた気持ちになるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks... Hearing you two just
lifted the heavy burden on me...

fields.EN:
So, about being embarrassed...
What kind of embarrassing thing
happened, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
それで、照れくさいってのは
どんなことがあったのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, about being embarrassed...
What kind of embarrassing thing
happened, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
You have to bring it up again,
don't you?!
fields.JP: 流れたと思ったのに掘り返すの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to bring it up again,
don't you?!

fields.EN:
I was just embarrassed how Jack
knew what I was thinking with how
our dreams were linked...
fields.JP:
……い、いやジャックには夢を通じて僕の
考えていたことがバレていたって思うと、
恥ずかしいっていうか、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just embarrassed how Jack
knew what I was thinking with how
our dreams were linked...

fields.EN:
No, I mean... my thoughts were completely
out in the open too...
fields.JP:
いや、僕の考えも完全に
ダダ漏れだったっていうか、その……
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
(She knows how I kept thinking
about wanting to protect Alice...)
fields.JP:
（僕もずっとアリスを守りたいって
　ことばかり考えていたのが
　伝わってるんだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She knows how I kept thinking
about wanting to protect Alice...)

fields.EN:
(Yikes! The more I think about
it, the more embarrassing it is!)
fields.JP:
（うわ！　今さらだけど、
　すごく恥ずかしいなこれ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yikes! The more I think about
it, the more embarrassing it is!)

fields.EN:
You two are worrying about the same thing.
You're kind of like siblings.
fields.JP:
同じことで悩んでて、
何か２人とも兄弟みたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two are like brothers with how
you both are thinking alike.
fields.notes: B12 P0 gender-neutral 兄弟 restored as sibling(s)

fields.EN: That... makes a lot of sense.
fields.JP: ……そう言われると何だか納得するかも
fields.LOCALIZED: That... makes a lot of sense.

fields.EN:
I guess we are thinking about
the same kind of things.
fields.JP: 確かに同じことで悩んでるね、僕たち
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we are thinking about
the same kind of things.

fields.notes: B12 P0 gender-neutral 兄弟 restored as sibling(s)

fields.EN:
That doesn't exactly represent us
two, but... Hope we get along
even better, Jack.
fields.JP:
何だか変な関係な気もするけど、
これからもよろしくな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't exactly represent us
two, but... Hope we get along
even better, Jack.

fields.JP: 僕の方こそよろしく、つう

fields.EN:
That's a nice handshake!
Like a sibling pact?
fields.JP:
いい握手だね！
兄弟の契り、みたいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, a handshake!
So, it's like being soul brothers!
fields.notes: B12 P0 gender-neutral 兄弟 restored as sibling(s)
Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Jack... I need to talk with you
later on things not to disclose...
fields.JP:
……後で姫やみんなに
話してはいけない話をしに行くから、
時間空けといてくれ……ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I need to talk with you
later on things not to disclose...

fields.EN:
You mean how you were secretly practicing
prince-like lines in your room to make
Ningyohime-san happy...?
fields.JP:
それってつうが部屋でこっそり、
人魚姫さんが喜びそうな王子さまセリフの
練習をしていたこととか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean about how you were
secretly practicing your lines to
make you sound like a prince?

fields.JP: （本当にそういう内容だったの……）

fields.EN:
(I was wondering where everyone
went... What are they doing at
the cafeteria?)
fields.JP:
（みんなどこ行ったかって思ったら、
　食堂に集まってたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was wondering where everyone
went... What are they doing at
the cafeteria?)

fields.EN:
You and Otsuu are really comfy
with each other, but how comfy
are you two? Spill it.
fields.JP:
それで？　おつうと人魚ってすっごく
仲いいけどさ、どういう関係なのよー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You and Otsuu are really comfy
with each other, but how comfy
are you two? Spill it.

fields.EN:
Uh, um... Before we continue,
do you mind if I call you how
I used to?
fields.JP:
あ、あのっ……その前に、
また昔と同じ呼び方しても、いい……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, um... Before we continue,
do you mind if I call you how
I used to?

fields.EN:
Of course! Call me onee-sama,
aneue, whatever you like!
fields.JP:
もちろん！　おねーさまでも
姉上でも何でも呼んで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! You can call me
"dear sister" or "Sis" or
anything!
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.JP: あはは！　かわいい奴めー

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, what did Otsuu call me
by?
fields.JP: で？　おつうはあたしを何て呼んでたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, what did Otsuu call me
by?

fields.JP: 赤ずきんは赤ずきんだ
ほんとだーじゃっく、こっちこっち

fields.EN:
Looks like everyone is having
fun.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like everyone is having
fun.

fields.EN:
We were just talking with Otsuu-chan
and Ningyo-chan! Isn't that right,
Oyayubi-neesama?
fields.JP:
今おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃんの
話を聞かせてもらってるんです！
ね、親指姉様？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were just talking with Otsuu
and Mermie! Isn't that right,
sister Thumbelina?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan | Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama | B30 exact-paired source identity cleanup

fields.EN:
Yeah, it just feels weird that
they know us, you know?
fields.JP:
ええ、なんか２人はわたしたちを
知ってるというのが不思議な感じよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it just feels weird that
they know us, you know?

fields.JP: とても興味深いわよね

fields.EN:
So, how come you two are so
friendly with each other?
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how come you two are so
friendly with each other?

fields.EN:
It's because she saved my life
and showed me what kindness
really is.
fields.JP:
僕が最初に出会って、命を助けられて、
そして最も優しさをもらった人だからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because she saved my life
and showed me what kindness
really is.

fields.EN:
That's not true. I survived when I was little
because Otsuu-chan treated me with kindness.
fields.JP:
それはわたしの方だよ。
おつうちゃんが優しくしてくれたから、
幼いわたしは生き延びられたんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. She saved me
by treating me with kindness.

fields.EN:
That was back when you were
a Nightmare, right?
fields.JP: それはナイトメアの時の……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was back when you were
a Nightmare, right?

fields.EN:
Yes, and if I didn't meet Princess
back then, I'm sure I would've
perished as a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。あの時姫に出会わなかったら、
僕はきっとナイトメアのままどこかで
のたれ死んでただろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and if I didn't meet Princess
back then, I'm sure I would've
perished as a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
So that's how you two met?
What an unusual meeting of
fate.
fields.JP:
それが出会いだったんですか～
奇妙なご縁もあるんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's how you two met?
What an unusual meeting of
fate.

fields.EN:
Princess saved me from the
Marchens who were attacking me.
fields.JP:
最初は、僕がメルヒェンに
襲われてるところを姫が
助けてくれたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess saved me from the
Marchens who were attacking me.

fields.EN:
I was cowardly back then, and
stayed away from Princess in fear,
even though she saved me...
fields.JP:
でも、その時の僕は臆病で、
助けてもらったのに姫を
怖がってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was cowardly back then, and
stayed away from Princess in fear,
even though she saved me...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. I did enter my
Genocide state, you know? Oh, and
you're the one who saved me.
fields.JP:
しょうがないよ、あの時のわたしは
ジェノサイド化してたんだから。
それに、助かったのはわたしの方だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. I did enter my
Massacre state, you know? Oh, and
you're the one who saved me.

fields.EN:
You saved me from my solitude
by staying with me, even if it was
from afar.
fields.JP:
あの時孤独だったわたしと、
遠巻きにでも交流を続けてくれたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You saved me from my solitude
by staying with me, even if it was
from afar.

fields.EN:
To repay Princess for what she's
done, I left food for her to which
she responded with her singing.
fields.JP:
その後、僕は姫に何かお礼がしたくて、
出会った場所に食料を置いてみたんだ。
そうしたら、歌声でお返しをしてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
To repay Princess for what she's
done, I left food for her to which
she responded with her singing.

fields.EN:
That was about all I could do.
I'm sorry I was too scared to
show myself to you...
fields.JP:
できることがあれしかなかったから……
あの時は、怯えて顔も出せずにごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was about all I could do.
I'm sorry I was too scared to
show myself to you...

fields.EN:
That can't be helped.
I was a Nightmare after all.
fields.JP:
それも仕方ない。あの時の僕は、
ナイトメアだったんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That can't be helped.
I was a Nightmare after all.

fields.EN:
Singing! That's so wonderful!
Such a great way to show your
gratitude!
fields.JP:
歌ですか！　いいですね、そのお返し。
何だかとても素敵です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Singing! That's so wonderful!
Such a great way to show your
gratitude!

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I recall
hearing Ningyohime's singing
from that microphone.
fields.JP:
おお、そういえばマイクとやらに
人魚姫の歌声らしきものが入っておったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I recall
hearing Little Mermaid's singing
from that microphone.

fields.EN:
I was a bit farther away, so I
couldn't hear, but was her singing
as beautiful as I think it is?
fields.JP:
白雪、あの時は後ろの方にいたので
ちゃんと聞けなかったのですが、やっぱり
人魚ちゃんは歌、上手いんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was a bit farther away, so I
couldn't hear, but was her singing
as beautiful as I think it is?

fields.EN:
Why, of course!
I would pay anything to get
to hear her sing!
fields.JP:
それはもちろん！
姫の歌は何を犠牲にしても聴く価値のある
最っ高のものさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, of course!
I would pay anything to get
to hear her sing!

fields.EN: Really? Well then, let's hear it.
fields.JP: へぇ～、それはぜひ聴かせてもらいたいね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? Well then, let's hear it.

fields.EN:
O-Otsuu-chan!
Please, you're making it difficult
for me!
fields.JP:
お、おつうちゃん！
ハードル上げないでよ～！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Otsuu!
Please, you're making it difficult
for me!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
おねーちゃん、
それはまた今度ってことで……

fields.EN: Ooh! Otsuu, why you a prince?
fields.JP:
そういえば、おつうーはどうして
おうじさまなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooh! Otsuu, why you a prince?

fields.EN:
That's something I wanted to
ask, too.
fields.JP: それは私も興味があるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's something I wanted to
ask, too.

fields.JP: ほらほら、教えなさいよー

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san can be a bit
pushy at times...)
fields.JP: （赤ずきんさん、ぐいぐい行くなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood can be a bit
pushy at times...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Oh, uh, it just means that we're
so close to each other that it's
like we're married...
fields.JP:
そのっ、おしどり夫婦って言葉くらいに
仲良くいたいねって意味で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh, it just means that we're
so close to each other that it's
like we're married...

fields.EN:
No... Um, we took our vows in
marriage...
fields.JP: ……ううん、夫婦の契り……交わした仲です
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Um, we took our vows in
marriage...

fields.EN: Uh, I don't know what to say...
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, I don't know what to say...

fields.EN:
Love can take different forms.
I don't see anything wrong with
what you just told me.
fields.JP:
そうね。でも愛のカタチは人それぞれ、
素敵なことじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Love can take different forms.
I don't see anything wrong with
what you just told me.

fields.EN:
This was back in the other world
I presume.
fields.JP: それは『前の』世界で、かしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was back in the other world
I presume.

fields.EN:
Yeah... My wish to see Princess
again came true, so I offered my
hand in marriage when we met.
fields.JP:
うん……そうだよ。念願叶って
姫に再会できたんだ、だから出会った時に
プロポーズを……したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... My wish to see Princess
again came true, so I offered my
hand in marriage when we met.

fields.EN:
But Otsuu-chan asked me to take
her as my wife.
fields.JP:
でもね、おつうちゃんってば
『お嫁さんにして下さい』って言うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Otsuu asked me to take
her as my wife.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: I'm not exactly the husband type, and having two brides would be... so I blurted out, 'Then become my prince.'
fields.JP:
わたしはお婿さんって感じじゃないし、
お嫁さん２人じゃ……って思って、とっさに
『だったら王子さまになって』って言ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not the husband-type,
so I just asked her to become
my prince.

fields.EN:
Oh, so is that why Otsuu is trying
to act like a prince?
fields.JP:
それでおつうは王子さまな感じに
振る舞ってるんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so is that why Otsuu is trying
to act like a prince?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san is more the princely type
don't you think, Jack?
fields.JP:
確かにおつうさんの方が
王子さまっぽいわよね、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu is more the princely type
don't you think, Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
Yeah, but despite her looks, she's
very much like any normal girl...
fields.JP:
そうだね。でも、こう見えても
つうは意外と女の子っぽいとこ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but despite her looks, she's
very much like any normal girl...

fields.EN:
Excuse me, Jack?!
I-I would never exhibit such...
fields.JP:
ジャック！？　何を言ってるんだ！？
ぼ、僕にそんなとこあるわけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, Jack?!
I-I would never exhibit such...

fields.EN:
Jack... How much of Otsuu-san
do you really know?
fields.JP:
ちょっとジャック、あなたおつうさんの
そんな深いところまで知ってるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... How much of Otsuu
do you really know?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
S-Sorry! B-But, didn't I explain
to you about the other world?!
fields.JP:
ごご、ごめん！　ってかアリスには
説明しといたよね！？　前の世界のこと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry! B-But, didn't I explain
to you about the other world?!

fields.EN:
That's right. You were a Nightmare
and Otsuu-san needed to be with you
to prevent you from going wild.
fields.JP:
そ、そうね。ジャックは前の世界では
ナイトメアで、おつうさんのそばじゃないと
暴走の可能性があったのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You were a Nightmare
and Otsuu needed to be with you
to prevent you from going wild.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
Um, when it comes to going wild
you were a bit of that, Alice...
fields.JP:
ま、まあどっちかというと
暴走したのはアリスだった感あるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, when it comes to going wild
you were a bit of that, Alice...

fields.EN:
Um, I'm not sure what happened,
but... I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
なんだかわからないけれど……
それはごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm not sure what happened,
but... I'm sorry.

fields.EN:
Heh heh, it's nothing for you
to apologize about. I'm just happy
I can talk to you like this now.
fields.JP:
はははっ、今のアリスが謝ることじゃないよ。
君とこんな風に話せるなんて嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, it's nothing for you
to apologize about. I'm just happy
I can talk to you like this now.

fields.JP: そうだね、おつうちゃん

ねえ、他のみんなは
どんな感じだったの？

fields.EN:
You were reliable as ever, but
Otsuu-chan kept trying to calm you down
to avoid getting into trouble.
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんは頼りがいのある感じ
だったけど、いつもおつうちゃんに
危なっかしいって言われてたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were reliable as ever, but
Otsuu kept trying to calm you down
to avoid getting into trouble.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I see...
In other words, she was the same.
fields.JP: なるほど、変わらないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
In other words, she was the same.

fields.EN: H-Hey, I don't get into trouble!
fields.JP: あ、危なっかしくなんてないっての！
fields.LOCALIZED: H-Hey, I don't get into trouble!

fields.EN:
Gretel was always calm, and gave
us a lot of sound decisions, even
in the harshest of times.
fields.JP:
グレーテルは冷静でいつも
戦況を見極めてくれたり、たくさんの
助言をくれたりしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel was always calm, and gave
us a lot of sound decisions, even
in the harshest of times.

fields.EN:
You were also very inquisitive,
and kept bugging Otsuu-chan for
answers.
fields.JP:
好奇心が強くて、おつうちゃん
いつも質問攻めにあってたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were also very inquisitive,
and kept bugging Otsuu for
answers.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I wouldn't have expected
any less of myself.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't have expected
any less of myself.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel... referred to Princess
as looking delicious...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは姫のこと
美味しそうって言ってたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel... referred to Princess
as looking delicious...

fields.EN:
How'd you know Rapunzel
think that!
fields.JP:
じつはラプンツェルも
ずっとそうおもってたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How'd you know Rapunzel
think that!

fields.EN:
Same here too, huh?
...
Please don't eat me...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here too, huh?
...
Please don't eat me...

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime was a hard worker,
and would always help whenever
possible.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫はすごい働き者で、
いつも助けられてたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya was a hard worker,
and would always help whenever
possible.

fields.EN: I see... So I'm the same, too.
fields.JP:
なるほど、今とまったく
変わらないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... So I'm the same, too.

fields.EN: Uh, not by a long shot...
fields.JP: いや、全っっっ然違うじゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, not by a long shot...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi would often argue,
but she would always help at the
most crucial of times.
fields.JP:
親指とは反発しあったりもしたけど、
いざという時はすごく助けてもらったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby would often argue,
but she would always help at the
most crucial of times.

fields.EN:
It feels weird hearing myself
being praised when it wasn't me...
fields.JP:
知らない自分を褒められるのって、
何だかこそばゆいわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird hearing myself
being praised when it wasn't me...

fields.EN:
You're relied on anywhere!
Shirayuki is so proud!
fields.JP:
親指姉様はどこでも頼りにされますね！
白雪も嬉しいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're relied on anywhere!
Snow White is so proud!

fields.EN:
Of course, Shirayuki-chan and Nemu-chan
were kind to us all the time!
fields.JP:
もちろん、白雪ちゃんやねむちゃんも、
わたしたちにとっても優しくしてくれたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, Snow White and Sleepy
were kind to us all the time!

fields.EN:
I'm just happy to see you three
so friendly with each other...
fields.JP:
でも、３人ともとっても
仲よさそうでよかったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy to see you three
so friendly with each other...

fields.EN:
Why wouldn't we?
We would never get into a
fight with each other!
fields.JP:
あったりまえじゃないの。
わたしたちがケンカなんてするわけ
ないじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why wouldn't we?
We would never get into a
fight with each other!

fields.JP: ワレはっ！　ワレはどうだったのだ！？

fields.EN:
Hameln...
Are you the Demon King?
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは……
今、もしかして魔王かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln...
Are you the Demon King?

fields.EN:
How did you know?!
Yes, I am the Demon King Hameln!
fields.JP:
うむ、よく分かったな！
ワレは魔王ハーメルンであるぞー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you know?!
Yes, I am the Demon King Hameln!

fields.EN:
I see...
Which means you're no different
from the Hameln we knew.
fields.JP: なるほど……君はほんとに変わらないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Which means you're no different
from the Hameln we knew.

fields.EN: What?! What do you mean by that?!
fields.JP: なにっ！？　ど、どういうことなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! What do you mean by that?!

fields.EN:
The Hameln we knew was a
hero that we placed our trust on.
fields.JP:
あっちではハーメルンは勇者だったよ。
とっても頼りになった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Hameln we knew was a
hero that we placed our trust on.

fields.JP: なんと！　勇者であるか！！

fields.EN:
Well now, that puts her on the
opposite spectrum of things.
fields.JP:
それまた随分と違うじゃない
今と真逆だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that puts her on the
opposite spectrum of things.

fields.EN:
No, she's the same. Amazingly
the same... In fact, the only
thing different is her attire.
fields.JP:
いや、同じだよ。
ほんと、びっくりするくらいそのままだ。
変わったのは衣装ぐらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, she's the same. Amazingly
the same... In fact, the only
thing different is her attire.

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but the look on
Otsuu's face is strangely rude...
fields.JP:
なぜか、おつうのワレを見る目が
ひじょーに失礼に感じるのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but the look on
Otsuu's face is strangely rude...

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
She's just trying to say that
she's happy Haa-chan is Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
ふふっ……
ハーちゃんはハーちゃんのままで嬉しい
って言いたいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
She's just trying to say that
she's happy Hammy is Hammy.

fields.EN:
Hm... I see...
Well, fyne then.
fields.JP: む、むぅ……そうか。にゃらいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I see...
Well, fyne thyen.

fields.EN:
Oh, and the Hameln back in the
other world kept slurring, too.
fields.JP:
ああ、そういえば、
向こうでもハーメルンは
噛み噛みだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and the Hameln back in the
other world kept slurring, too.

fields.EN:
I see why you said she's the
same now.
fields.JP: なるほど、まったく変わらないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see why you said she's the
same now.

fields.EN:
Same as usual, even in another
world...
fields.JP: 変わらないのね……どこに行っても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same as usual, even in another
world...

fields.EN:
You're all making fun of me,
aren't you?!
fields.JP: やっぱりバカにされてる気がするぞ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all making fun of me,
aren't you?!

fields.JP: あとは誰か聞いてない人いるー？

fields.EN:
Wh-What about me?
It's quite unnerving to be the
very last one...
fields.JP:
わ、わたくしですわ。
最後だと何だか緊張しますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What about me?
It's quite unnerving to be the
very last one...

fields.EN:
Cinderella...
You're the most surprising out
of everyone.
fields.JP:
シンデレラは……
実は一番ビックリしてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella...
You're the most surprising out
of everyone.

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm surprised how grown
you are with all the curves in
the right areas...
fields.JP:
うん……すごい大人になってて
スタイルも良くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm surprised how grown
you are with all the curves in
the right areas...

fields.EN:
The Cinderella in the other world
went missing during her youth
while in Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
あっちのシンデレラは、
幼い頃にブラッドスケルター化して
そのまま失踪してしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Cinderella in the other world
went missing during her youth
while in Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
A long while passed, and when we
found her, she was still in her
youthful form.
fields.JP:
そして長い時間が経った後、
幼い姿のまま発見されたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A long while passed, and when we
found her, she was still in her
youthful form.

fields.EN:
So, this is the first time we've seen you
grown up, Cinderella-san...
fields.JP:
だから、シンデレラさんの
成長した姿を見るのは、初めてなんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is the first time we've
seen you grown...

fields.EN:
But, hearing your tone of speech
shows how you cared about the
others.
fields.JP:
でもそうやって思って下さるだけで、２人が
どれだけ仲間想いか、よく分かりましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, hearing your tone of speech
shows how you cared about the
others.

fields.EN:
But this all happened because
of me... I was the cause of
everything...
fields.JP:
……違うんだ。これは僕のせいなんだ……
僕が身勝手に願ったせいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this all happened because
of me... I was the cause of
everything...

fields.EN:
I think I said it before, but
your train of thought is wrong.
fields.JP:
つう、この前も言ったけど
それは違うと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I said it before, but
your train of thought is wrong.

fields.EN:
Both you and Ningyohime-san
wouldn't be here with us without
that other world.
fields.JP:
あの世界を願わなければ、
つうも人魚姫さんも今ここにいないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both you and Little Mermaid
wouldn't be here with us without
that other world.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
The result we see is because of
the courage and love you've shown.
What you did was with reason.
fields.JP:
それはつうの勇気と愛が
生み出した結果だと思う……だから、
まったく無駄なんてなかったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The result we see is because of
the courage and love you've shown.
What you did was with reason.

fields.EN:
That's right, Otsuu-chan. If it weren't for
that other world, we wouldn't exist in this
proper world.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、おつうちゃん。
あっちの世界がなければ、わたしたちは
この正しい世界に存在していないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's right. We wouldn't be in
this world if it wasn't for the
other world.

fields.EN:
So please, don't try to bring
yourself down over it.
fields.JP: だから、もう自分を責めなくていいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't try to bring
yourself down over it.

fields.EN:
Um... Not sure what this is all
about, but we're all here now,
so don't worry already!
fields.JP:
えーっと……よく分からないけど、
今あたしたちはみんな無事だしさ、
気にすんなって感じかな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Not sure what this is all
about, but we're all here now,
so don't worry already!

fields.EN:
My, she's right. I don't care who
I was or what happened to me
back in the other world.
fields.JP:
そうですわ、あっちの世界の
わたくしがどんなことになっていても、
今のわたくしは気にしませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, she's right. I don't care who
I was or what happened to me
back in the other world.

fields.EN:
Did you hear that, Tsuu?
You can smile already, you know?
fields.JP:
……そういうことだよ、つう。
だからほら、笑ってよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you hear that, Otsuu?
You can smile already, you know?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: アリスどこ行ったんだろう……

fields.EN:
So, what is it that you wanted
to talk about, Gretel, Alice?
fields.JP:
それでグレーテル、アリス、
改まって話って何……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what is it that you wanted
to talk about, Gretel, Alice?

fields.EN:
We wanted to ask you some
things in case you knew.
fields.JP:
もし知ってることがあったら
教えてもらおうと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
We wanted to ask you some
things in case you knew.

fields.EN:
You mean about the other world?
If so, we'll try to answer the
best as we can.
fields.JP:
わたしたちに分かることなら、
もちろんお話しするけれど……
前の世界のお話？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean about the other world?
If so, we'll try to answer the
best as we can.

fields.EN: No, it's about the white core.
fields.JP: いいえ、白い核についてよ
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it's about the white core.

fields.EN: Do you mind if I join?
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if I join?

fields.EN:
Why, please do. It seems like
you know about it, too.
fields.JP:
ぜひお願いするわ。
あなたも色々と知っていそうだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, please do. It seems like
you know about it, too.

fields.EN:
I'll answer what I can.
So, what about the white core?
fields.JP:
僕に答えられることなら、もちろん。
それで……白い核について、だっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll answer what I can.
So, what about the white core?

fields.EN:
I believe it's also referred to as
the "Witchcraft" based on your
and Tsuu's conversation.
fields.JP:
ええ。あの時のジャックとつうの
会話から推察するに『ウィッチクラフト』
とも言うようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe it's also referred to as
the "Witchcraft" based on your
and Otsuu's conversation.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
That name came to me from the
core back when I was wandering the
underground cavern.
fields.JP:
『ウィッチクラフト』という言葉は、
僕が地下洞窟をさまよっていた時に核から
流れてきた情報なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That name came to me from the
core back when I was wandering the
underground cavern.

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it,
that could've come from Snark's
information.
fields.JP:
今思えば……あれは
スナークの情報だったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it,
that could've come from Snark's
information.

fields.EN:
That could be possible. Well, for
the sake of simplicity, I'll just
refer to it as the "white core."
fields.JP:
なるほど。それはあり得そうな話ね。
まあ今は『白い核』で通させてもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That could be possible. Well, for
the sake of simplicity, I'll just
refer to it as the "white core."

fields.EN:
Ultimately, it brought about the
revival of Ningyohime, and
turned Tsuu into a human.
fields.JP:
今回、結果として人魚姫は蘇り、
そしてつうはナイトメアの姿から
血式少女の姿になったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ultimately, it brought about the
revival of Little Mermaid, and
turned Otsuu into a human.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
So, does this white core really
hold the power to do such things?
fields.JP:
『白い核』というのはそれほどまでに
凄まじい力を持っているというの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, does this white core really
hold the power to do such things?

fields.EN:
It basically granted your wish,
right? If so, the power it holds
is astounding.
fields.JP:
願いを叶える力……というわけよね。
これが本当ならすごいことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It basically granted your wish,
right? If so, the power it holds
is astounding.

fields.EN:
Even if it asked for the body
of the deceased, it could bring
that one back to life.
fields.JP: 遺体が必要とはいえ、死者を蘇らせる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if it asked for the body
of the deceased, it could bring
that one back to life.

fields.EN:
It also holds the power to
transform or reincarnate
Nightmares into humans.
fields.JP:
そしてナイトメアから人間へと
変身、あるいは生まれ変わらせる力。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also holds the power to
transform or reincarnate
Nightmares into humans.

fields.EN:
In either case, the power it
exhibited is beyond any mortal's.
fields.JP:
どれをとっても人間には
決して不可能な異常な力よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In either case, the power it
exhibited is beyond any mortal's.

fields.EN:
Mmm... It's true that I turned
into a human, and that Princess
came back to life.
fields.JP:
うーん……確かにグレーテルの言うとおり、
僕は人間の姿になれたし、姫は蘇ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... It's true that I turned
into a human, and that Princess
came back to life.

fields.EN:
But, that was just luck. The core
isn't as convenient as you two
may be thinking.
fields.JP:
でもそれは、正直運がよかっただけなんだ。
本来は２人が思ってるほど万能じゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that was just luck. The core
isn't as convenient as you two
may be thinking.

fields.EN: But your wish really did come true, Otsuu-san.
fields.JP: でも実際におつうさんの願いは叶ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: But it did grant your wish, right?

fields.EN:
Do you both know what the Jail
is from a biological standpoint?
fields.JP:
……２人はジェイルが生物学上、
何に分類されるか分かるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you both know what the Jail
is from a biological standpoint?

fields.EN:
I believe you and Rapunzel
ate the Jail's walls.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルやあなたは確か、
ジェイルの壁食べてたわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe you and Rapunzel
ate the Jail's walls.

fields.EN:
Indeed. To add, the walls don't
seem to be any type of animal
protein.
fields.JP:
そうね、食料にしていたわね。
そして動物性タンパク質という
感じでもなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. To add, the walls don't
seem to be any type of animal
protein.

fields.EN:
I suppose the Jail is some type
of flora?
fields.JP:
ということは、
ジェイルは植物なのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose the Jail is some type
of flora?

fields.EN:
Yes, it's a flora all right. It is
something called a "Theophil"
that grows to become a Jail.
fields.JP:
そう、ジェイルは植物なんだ。
元は「テオフィル」と呼ばれる種で、
それが成長することでジェイルになる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's a flora all right. It is
something called a "Theophil"
that grows to become a Jail.

fields.EN:
It feels weird thinking that
some plant is keeping us
down here...
fields.JP:
僕たちを閉じ込めているものが
植物だなんて不思議だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird thinking that
some plant is keeping us
down here...

fields.EN:
It's hard to believe, but it makes
sense when you consider the tower
is a stamen and the moon a pistil.
fields.JP:
にわかに信じ難い話だけど、監獄塔を雄しべ
白い月を雌しべとするとしっくりくると思うんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hard to believe, but it makes
sense when you consider the tower
is a stamen and the moon a pistil.

fields.EN:
Flora can differ in growth
depending on the environment.
fields.JP:
そして植物は生育環境によって
様々な個体差が生まれる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Flora can differ in growth
depending on the environment.

fields.EN:
It's like how there are varying
types and sizes of apples.
fields.JP:
例えば同じリンゴでも良いもの悪いもの、
大きいもの小さいものがあるようにさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's like how there are varying
types and sizes of apples.

fields.EN:
So let's say what you said is
true... Are you suggesting that we
happened to be in a good Jail?
fields.JP:
じゃあそれぞれのジェイルに
個体差があって、今回はたまたま
良いジェイルだったということ……かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So let's say what you said is
true... Are you suggesting that we
happened to be in a good Jail?

fields.EN:
I think Snark's strong desire
made him fuse with the Jail,
but...
fields.JP:
……スナークはきっと『強い力』を願って、
結果ジェイルと融合したけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think Snark's strong desire
made him fuse with the Jail,
but...

fields.EN:
I don't think his form was
something that he wished for...
fields.JP:
あれは確かに望んであの姿になったわけじゃ
ないんだと思うな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think his form was
something that he wished for...

fields.EN:
So, the Jail's environmental state
wasn't the most desirable?
fields.JP: ここのジェイルは生育状況が悪かったと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the Jail's environmental state
wasn't the most desirable?

fields.EN:
Yeah... Whatever the case,
I doubt that was the desired
result...
fields.JP:
うん……ちゃんとした
願いの結果ではなかったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Whatever the case,
I doubt that was the desired
result...

fields.EN:
Interesting. I suppose it's true
that Snark didn't want to
fuse with the Jail.
fields.JP:
まあ確かに、スナークが望んだのは
別にジェイルとの融合ではなかった
かもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting. I suppose it's true
that Snark didn't want to
fuse with the Jail.

fields.EN:
I haven't seen the Snark in this
world, so I can't confirm, but...
fields.JP:
こっちのスナークのことは
直接見ていないから断言はできないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't seen the Snark in this
world, so I can't confirm, but...

fields.EN:
Like Jack said, I'm sure the
environment wasn't well, so his
desire wasn't properly reflected.
fields.JP:
ジャックの言うとおり、
きっとジェイルの生育環境が悪くて、
願いが正しく反映されなかったんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like Jack said, I'm sure the
environment wasn't well, so his
desire wasn't properly reflected.

fields.EN:
Does that mean the Metropolitan
Building Jail was special?
fields.JP: じゃあ都庁のジェイルが特別よかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean the Metropolitan
Building Jail was special?

fields.JP: うん……おそらくそうだと思う

fields.EN:
That Jail was formed from the many
desires stemming from the
Festival of the Weaver.
fields.JP:
何故なら都庁のジェイルは
色々な人々の願いがこもった『七夕』が
擬態化してできたジェイルだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Jail was formed from the many
desires stemming from the
Festival of the Weaver.

fields.EN:
Festival of the Weaver... I read
about it before. People would tie
their wishes to a tree, was it?
fields.JP:
七夕……何かの本で読んだことあるわ。
願い事を書いたものを木にくくりつける、
だったかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Festival of the Weaver... I read
about it before. People would tie
their wishes to a tree, was it?

fields.EN:
Yes... It's an age-old tradition
where people wrote their wishes
to be tied onto some tree.
fields.JP:
うん……そうだね。
それは古来の風習で、多くの人が
願い事を一斉に吊すんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... It's an age-old tradition
where people wrote their wishes
to be tied onto some tree.

fields.EN:
In other words, I believe that
Jail held greater powers because
of all the wishes it formed from.
fields.JP:
つまり『願い』に関して、
他のどのジェイルよりも強い力を
持っていたんだと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, I believe that
Jail held greater powers because
of all the wishes it formed from.

fields.EN:
As a result, it exhibited stronger
powers as it was a manifestation
of wishes...
fields.JP:
その結果、本来よりも『願い』の力を
発揮できた……というわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a result, it exhibited stronger
powers as it was a manifestation
of wishes...

fields.EN:
I don't have any proof, but that's
the best assumption I can come
up with.
fields.JP:
確証はないけど……
それが最も説明をつけられるはずだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have any proof, but that's
the best assumption I can come
up with.

fields.EN:
To add, cores hold special
properties reminiscent of each
Jail they are in.
fields.JP:
それに核だって
ジェイルごとに特色があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, cores hold special
properties reminiscent of each
Jail they are in.

fields.EN:
Some cores will grant wishes
right, whereas others may twist
wishes, and more...
fields.JP:
願いを正しく叶えようとする核、
願いを曲解して叶えようとする核、
願いの上辺だけを叶える核……様々さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some cores will grant wishes
right, whereas others may twist
wishes, and more...

fields.EN:
Which is why there was a chance
we could've turned into some
kind of monster...
fields.JP:
だから僕や姫が化け物になって
生まれ変わってもおかしくなかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why there was a chance
we could've turned into some
kind of monster...

fields.EN:
We did wish for the world to be
back to how it was, and that
didn't come out perfectly, too.
fields.JP:
前の世界の時だって、僕と姫で
『元の世界に戻ってほしい』と願ったけど、
それも完璧ではなかったしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did wish for the world to be
back to how it was, and that
didn't come out perfectly, too.

fields.EN:
Maybe Otsuu-chan and I both still had
something we couldn't let go of...
fields.JP:
それは……わたしもおつうちゃんも、
どこかに未練があったのかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that was because we may
have had regrets deep inside
of us...

fields.EN:
I see... So it isn't as convenient
as we thought.
fields.JP:
なるほど……決して
万能なんかじゃないわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So it isn't as convenient
as we thought.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, it's too volatile
to control.
fields.JP:
それどころか、不安定すぎて
こちらの思うようには到底扱えなさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, it's too volatile
to control.

fields.EN:
It just so happened that
Otsuu-chan's gamble came out good.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは賭けに勝った……
ということなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just so happened that
Otsuu's gamble came out good.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Yes... That's one way to word it.
fields.JP: うん……そういうことになるね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... That's one way to word it.

fields.EN:
I know it's weird for me to say
this, but I don't want you to take
such a gamble again, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
その、わたしが言えたことではないけど……
おつうちゃん、もうこの先絶対に、
そんな無茶はしないで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's weird for me to say
this, but I don't want you to take
such a gamble again, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yes, nothing that will bring
grief to you, my princess.
I promise.
fields.JP:
うん……姫を悲しませたくないからね。
もう無茶はしないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, nothing that will bring
grief to you, my princess.
I promise.

fields.EN:
If the cores are that volatile,
there's no telling what can be
found on the surface.
fields.JP:
でもそんな不安定なものが
地上に上がってもまだあるかもしれないのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the cores are that volatile,
there's no telling what can be
found on the surface.

fields.EN:
I guess it just means we need to
prepare ourselves well.
fields.JP:
これは一層、
気を引きしめないといけないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it just means we need to
prepare ourselves well.

fields.EN:
I appreciate you understanding
the dangers behind the white core.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、アリス。
正しく白い核の怖さを認識してくれて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate you understanding
the dangers behind the white core.

fields.EN:
No, it's thanks to you for telling us properly,
Otsuu-san.
fields.JP:
ううん、ちゃんと教えてくれた
おつうさんのおかげよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In turn, I appreciate you telling
us about it.

fields.EN:
I'm really glad you and Ningyohime-san
joined us, Otsuu-san. Having you both here is
reassuring, right, Gretel?
fields.JP:
本当におつうさんと人魚姫さんが
加わってくれてよかった。とても心強いわ。
ね、グレーテル？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy you and Little Mermaid
joined us. You're both of great
help, isn't that right, Gretel?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 人魚姫 => Little Mermaid-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I can at least say you two have
piqued my interest even further.
fields.JP:
そうね、２人のおかげでとても楽しいわ。
まだまだ私の好奇心を刺激してくれるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can at least say you two have
piqued my interest even further.

fields.EN:
You really aren't different at all
no matter what world you're in...
fields.JP:
グレーテルは昔も今も
ほんっとブレないよなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really aren't different at all
no matter what world you're in...

fields.EN: Heh heh, that's the Gretel-san I know.
fields.JP:
ふふ、それでこそ
グレーテルさんって感じだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh heh, that's the Gretel I know.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: 褒め言葉として受け取っておくわ

fields.EN:
With everyone here, I think we
can overcome any obstacles.
fields.JP:
……今の僕たちなら、
どんな困難でも乗り越えていけそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With everyone here, I think we
can overcome any obstacles.

fields.EN:
I can't agree with you more.
It's a miracle we converged like
this after all.
fields.JP:
そうだね、こうしてまた
奇跡的に巡り会えたんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't agree with you more.
It's a miracle we converged like
this after all.

fields.EN:
We faced a lot, but we did make
it through all of them.
fields.JP:
これまでも困難ばかりだったけど、
わたしたちは全部乗り越えてきたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We faced a lot, but we did make
it through all of them.

fields.EN:
And, I'm sure there are more
to come, but nothing will falter
the hope I feel within me.
fields.JP:
まだまだ困難はあるだろうけど、
今は希望しか感じないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I'm sure there are more
to come, but nothing will falter
the hope I feel within me.

fields.EN:
If you saw the future of the other
world, then I would love to see
what the future holds here.
fields.JP:
別世界の観測ができたのなら、
次はこの先の未来を観測してみたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you saw the future of the other
world, then I would love to see
what the future holds here.

fields.EN:
We're going to make it to the
surface, and see what the
future holds for us above!
fields.JP:
みんなで地上に出て、
新しい未来をこの目で見るんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to make it to the
surface, and see what the
future holds for us above!

fields.EN:
What the...?! A Marchen's voice
from inside the laboratory?!
fields.JP:
…………！
……メルヒェンの声！？
研究室の中から聞こえたぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?! A Marchen's voice
from inside the laboratory?!

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack-kun. What seems to be the
problem?
fields.JP:
おお……ジャックくん。
どうしたんだね……いきなり？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack. What seems to be the
problem?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP:
……ん？
ああ、これのことかね？

fields.EN: M-Miko-san! What is going on here?!
fields.LOCALIZED: M-Miko! What is going on here?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: Oh, Jack. Why are you here?
fields.JP:
……ああ……ジャック。
どうして、研究室に……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Jack. Why are you here?

fields.EN:
Wait... Are you examining the
Marchen? Isn't it dangerous?!
fields.JP:
これって、もしかして……
メルヒェンを調べてるんですか？
……き、危険はないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Are you examining the
Marchen? Isn't it dangerous?!

fields.EN:
Why, yes. That's why we have it
strapped down. It can't harm us.
fields.JP:
ええ……
ガッチリ拘束してあるから大丈夫よ。
今は何もできないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, yes. That's why we have it
strapped down. It can't harm us.

fields.EN:
Ah, my dear Marchen-kun... It'll be
quick, so stay nice and still...
fields.JP:
ああ、メルヒェンくん……
いい子だから、もう少し我慢しておくれ。
すぐ済むからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, my dear Marchen... It'll be
quick, so stay nice and still...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メルヒェンくん => Marchen-kun

fields.EN:
Good... Good! We're done. It
didn't hurt, did it? You did well,
my dear Marchen-kun.
fields.JP:
よおし……よし……！
これで終わりだ……痛かったね？
よく頑張ったね、メルヒェンくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good... Good! We're done. It
didn't hurt, did it? You did well,
my dear Marchen.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メルヒェンくん => Marchen-kun

fields.EN:
Professor, the sample extraction
is complete.
fields.JP:
……博士。
サンプルの採取、終わりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor, the sample extraction
is complete.

fields.EN:
Ah, thank you, Miko-kun. Once you
analyze the sample, report the
results to me.
fields.JP:
ああ……ありがとう、視子くん。
サンプルの分析結果が出たら、
私のところまで提出してくれたまえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, thank you, Miko. Once you
analyze the sample, report the
results to me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
Hopefully the results will help us
in learning more about the
mysteries of the Jail.
fields.JP:
この分析結果が……
ジェイルの神秘に迫る鍵になればいいのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hopefully the results will help us
in learning more about the
mysteries of the Jail.

fields.EN:
Um, I'll excuse myself now. I'm
sorry for barging in earlier...
fields.JP:
あの……それじゃ、僕は失礼します。
突然、押し掛けてしまって……
すいませんでした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'll excuse myself now. I'm
sorry for barging in earlier...

fields.EN:
Ah, yes. I'm sorry to have worried
you, Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
おお、そうかね。
心配をかけて済まなかったね、ジャックくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yes. I'm sorry to have worried
you, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Oh, that's right... I'm not ready
yet, but there is a favor I wanted
to ask from you.
fields.JP:
そうそう……
君に協力をお願いしたいことがあったんだが、
まだこちらの準備が整ってなくてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's right... I'm not ready
yet, but there is a favor I wanted
to ask from you.

fields.EN:
Can you stop by the laboratory
again later?
fields.JP: 折を見て、研究室に顔を出してくれないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you stop by the laboratory
again later?

fields.EN:
Yes, and it can be when you have
the time. When I'm ready, I'll
give you more details.
fields.JP:
ああ、君の手が空いている時で構わんよ。
その時に準備が出来ていたら、協力をお願いしたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it can be when you have
the time. When I'm ready, I'll
give you more details.

fields.EN:
Understood. I'll come by again
later.
fields.JP:
……わかりました。
それじゃ、また来ます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I'll come by again
later.

fields.EN:
You may need to try a few times,
but there's a hot cup of tea in it
for you. Now, if you'll excuse me.
fields.JP:
何度か無駄足を踏ませるかもしれんが……
その時には、お茶でもご馳走しよう。
それじゃあ、頼むよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may need to try a few times,
but there's a hot cup of tea in it
for you. Now, if you'll excuse me.

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack! What'cha doing,
standing around here like that?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックじゃん！
どしたの、こんなとこで？
ボンヤリしちゃってさー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack! What'cha doing,
standing around here like that?

fields.JP:
あ……赤ずきんさん……
あの実は……今さっき……
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood? Well, I was...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
……ふーん。
そんなことがあったんだー

fields.EN:
I know it sounds kind of strange,
but...
fields.JP:
……うまく言えないけど……
なんだか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it sounds kind of strange,
but...

fields.EN:
Oh, Dad seemed weird, right? Like
some sort of mad scientist?
fields.JP:
あ。お父さんが、異常な感じだった？
マッドなサイエンティストに見えた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Dad seemed weird, right? Like
some sort of mad scientist?

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! Dad is usually like that
when it comes to the Jail or the
Marchens.
fields.JP:
あはは！　お父さんはさ……
ジェイルやメルヒェンのことになると、
いっつも、あの調子なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! Dad is usually like that
when it comes to the Jail or the
Marchens.

fields.EN:
I mean, he is a research nut, so
to speak.
fields.JP: お父さんは研究バカだからねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, he is a research nut, so
to speak.

fields.EN:
(I wonder if all researchers are
like that...)
fields.JP: （研究者って……ああいうものなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if all researchers are
like that...)

fields.JP: 博士……あの、ジャックですけど……

fields.EN:
Jack-kun? Ah, what timing! I was just
about to call you here.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、ナイスタイミングだよ！
今、君を呼ぼうと思っていたところでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Ah, what timing! I was just
about to call you here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Is it about that favor you wanted
to ask?
fields.JP: ……あ、前に言ってた……協力の件ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it about that favor you wanted
to ask?

fields.EN:
Indeed! I'm sorry to have kept you
waiting, but I just finished my
test preparations.
fields.JP:
そうなんだよ！
やっと実験環境が用意できてね。
待たせて済まなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I'm sorry to have kept you
waiting, but I just finished my
test preparations.

fields.EN:
Now then, can you go to the Rescue
Center? Miko-kun will give you the
details.
fields.JP:
早速だが、今すぐ救護室へ行ってくれないか。
詳しい説明は視子くんから聞いて欲しい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, can you go to the Rescue
Center? Miko will give you the
details.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子くん => Miko-kun

fields.EN:
(What are they planning to do
there?)
fields.JP: （救護室って……何をさせられるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What are they planning to do
there?)

fields.EN:
Don't worry. We just need some
blood samples. We didn't have the
proper equipment earlier.
fields.JP:
なに、心配いらないよ、採血をするだけだ。
実験環境の構築が遅れていただけだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We just need some
blood samples. We didn't have the
proper equipment earlier.

fields.EN:
Understood. I'll head to the
Rescue Center.
fields.JP: ……わかりました。救護室ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I'll head to the
Rescue Center.

fields.EN:
(Just blood samples? That's not
so bad. I thought they were
planning some huge experiment.)
fields.JP:
（なんだ……採血か。
　もう、すっかり慣れちゃったな。
　もっと大変な実験なのかと思った）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just blood samples? That's not
so bad. I thought they were
planning some huge experiment.)

fields.EN:
Miko-san? It's me, Jack. The Professor
told me to come and see you.
fields.JP:
視子さん、ジャックです。
博士に言われてきました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko? It's me, Jack. The Professor
told me to come and see you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: アリス！　君も呼ばれたの？

fields.EN:
Yes. The Professor told me to come
here to give a blood sample.
fields.JP:
ええ。
博士に採血に行くようにって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The Professor told me to come
here to give a blood sample.

fields.EN:
Hold on for just a moment. Let me
make some space...
fields.JP:
二人とも、ちょっと待っててね。
今、そのへんを片付けるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on for just a moment. Let me
make some space...

fields.EN:
Unbelievable... I can't believe he
sent you both over when I'm not
even finished preparing yet...
fields.JP:
まったく……まだ準備の途中なのに……
あの人はせっかちなんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable... I can't believe he
sent you both over when I'm not
even finished preparing yet...

fields.EN:
Okay, done. Both of you, can you
sit over there?
fields.JP: さ、いいわよ。二人ともその椅子にかけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, done. Both of you, can you
sit over there?

fields.EN:
Now then, your arms. Let me just
get some blood samples...
fields.JP:
それじゃ、腕を出してちょうだい。
採血させてもらうわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, your arms. Let me just
get some blood samples...

fields.EN:
Sure. Um... What are the blood
samples for?
fields.JP:
はい。あの……
これって何のための採血なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. Um... What are the blood
samples for?

fields.JP: え、博士から聞いてない？

fields.EN:
No. He just said that he needed
my blood sample...
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. He just said that he needed
my blood sample...

fields.EN:
It's not right you don't know the
reasons for the sampling. Let me
explain instead.
fields.JP:
説明もなしに採血されたら……不安よね？
ごめんなさい。私から説明するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not right you don't know the
reasons for the sampling. Let me
explain instead.

fields.EN:
We're currently working on
developing an antibody that could
counter Corruption.
fields.JP:
実は『穢れ』に対する抗体を
開発できないかと考えているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're currently working on
developing an antibody that could
counter Corruption.

fields.EN:
An antibody to counter
Corruption... Is that something
that can be made from my blood?
fields.JP:
『穢れ』に対する抗体……
僕の血から抗体を作るんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
An antibody to counter
Corruption... Is that something
that can be made from my blood?

fields.EN:
No. We wish to develop an antibody
that produces the same effect as
the ones found in your blood.
fields.JP:
いいえ、ちがうわ。
あなたの血液中の抗体を分析して、
同様の効果を持つ薬剤を開発したいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. We wish to develop an antibody
that produces the same effect as
the ones found in your blood.

fields.EN: Um, then what is my blood for?
fields.JP: あの……それでは、わたしの血は？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, then what is my blood for?

fields.EN:
Jack's antibodies exhibit stable
effects when used on a particular
Blood Maiden. That's you, Alice.
fields.JP:
ジャックの血液中の『穢れ』抗体が、
もっとも安定して作用する血式少女が……
アリス……あなたなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's antibodies exhibit stable
effects when used on a particular
Blood Maiden. That's you, Alice.

fields.EN: It's the ideal blood sample for the experiment. If we can develop a substitute drug for the antibodies, we can reduce the burden on Jack.
fields.JP:
実験には最適な血液サンプルなのよ。
抗体の代替薬品を開発することができれば、
ジャックの負担を減らすことができるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll need the best samples for
testing. A working antibiotic may
help alleviate the load for Jack.

fields.EN:
Um, but isn't it faster to just
extract the antibodies in my
blood?
fields.JP:
あの……よくわからないんですけど……
僕の血から抗体を分離するほうが、
もしかして……近道なんじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but isn't it faster to just
extract the antibodies in my
blood?

fields.JP: そうかもしれないわね。でも……

fields.EN:
It's not like you have all the
blood in the world to spare!
fields.JP: あなたの血は無限にあるわけじゃないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like you have all the
blood in the world to spare!

fields.EN:
Exactly. You need to take better
care of yourself. Now then, let's
get this done, shall we?
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
自分の体も少しは気遣ってね。
さあ、それじゃ採血しましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. You need to take better
care of yourself. Now then, let's
get this done, shall we?

fields.EN:
I'm going to take a bit more than
usual... Don't move... Does it
hurt...?
fields.JP:
ちょっと多めに採るわよ……
二人とも腕を動かさないでね。
痛くない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to take a bit more than
usual... Don't move... Does it
hurt...?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry we have to have you go
through this so often...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry we have to have you go
through this so often...

fields.EN:
No, that wasn't what I was
implying...
fields.JP: いえ、そういう意味じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that wasn't what I was
implying...

fields.EN:
And, it is to help develop the
antibiotic.
fields.JP: 抗体開発のためですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it is to help develop the
antibiotic.

fields.EN:
I wouldn't expect answers anytime
soon if I were you... It will take
some time to develop...
fields.JP:
期待されると……ツライわね。
おそらく、試薬の開発には……
莫大な時間を必要とするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't expect answers anytime
soon if I were you... It will take
some time to develop...

fields.EN:
I'm sure we could offer more
direct support to you all if we
spent this time differently...
fields.JP:
その時間を他に振り向ければ……
もっと……より意味のある形で、
あなたたちのフォローができるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we could offer more
direct support to you all if we
spent this time differently...

fields.EN:
Okay, we're done. Thank you for
your time.
fields.JP:
はい、終わったわよ。
お疲れ様……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, we're done. Thank you for
your time.

fields.EN:
Let's see... These are for the
Professor...
fields.JP: こっちは後で博士に提出する分……と
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see... These are for the
Professor...

fields.EN:
(Huh? Are they going to use our
blood for something else?)
fields.JP:
（あれ……？
　抗体の分析とは別に、何かするんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Are they going to use our
blood for something else?)

fields.EN:
What is the Professor planning to
use our blood for?
fields.JP:
博士は僕とアリスの血を使って、
どんな研究をするんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is the Professor planning to
use our blood for?

fields.EN:
I don't know. You'll have to ask
the Professor that. Now, then...
fields.JP:
それは博士に聞いてちょうだい。
私は知らないのよ。
さてと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know. You'll have to ask
the Professor that. Now, then...

fields.EN:
I should put the samples through
gas chromatography first... Better
do it before the Professor asks...
fields.JP:
サンプルをガスクロマトグラフィーにかけて、
報告書の作成か……
博士にせっつかれる前に提出しなきゃね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should put the samples through
gas chromatography first... Better
do it before the Professor asks...

fields.EN: Sounds like a lot of work...
fields.LOCALIZED: Sounds like a lot of work...

fields.EN:
Oh, not at all. I'm sorry if it
sounded like I was complaining.
But...
fields.JP:
ああ、そうでもないのよ。
ごめんなさい……グチっぽかったわね。
ただ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, not at all. I'm sorry if it
sounded like I was complaining.
But...

fields.EN:
Sometimes I'm scared to find out
what he really wants to know...
fields.JP:
あの人が本当は何を知りたがってるのか、
時々怖くなることがあるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sometimes I'm scared to find out
what he really wants to know...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Well, I'll do what I can to
support you, so... thanks, and get
a good night's rest...
fields.JP:
ま……そのぶん私は、あなたたちのサポートに
全力を尽くすつもりよ。
ありがとう……お疲れ様
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'll do what I can to
support you, so... thanks, and get
a good night's rest...

fields.EN:
(I wonder what the Professor is
researching that he'd need Alice's
and my blood samples...)
fields.JP:
（博士……この間採血した、僕とアリスの
　血液サンプルで、いったいどんな研究を
　してるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what the Professor is
researching that he'd need Alice's
and my blood samples...)

fields.EN:
Ah, Jack... What brings you to the
laboratory?
fields.JP: あら、ジャック……研究室に用事なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Jack... What brings you to the
laboratory?

fields.EN:
Oh, nothing really... I was just
curious about what the Professor
was researching.
fields.JP:
ううん、そうじゃないんだけど……
博士の研究が気になって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, nothing really... I was just
curious about what the Professor
was researching.

fields.EN:
I see. Same here. Miko-san did say it
was going to take a while to come
up with an antibiotic...
fields.JP:
そう……わたしも気になっていたの。
視子さんの抗体代替薬は時間かかりそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Same here. Miko did say it
was going to take a while to come
up with an antibiotic...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: Yeah, Miko-san did say that, didn't she?
fields.JP: うん、そんなこと言ってたよね……視子さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, she did say that, didn't
she?

fields.EN:
I just hope our blood helps the
Professor, too...
fields.JP:
博士も、僕らの血を何かに役立ててくれたら、
うれしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just hope our blood helps the
Professor, too...

fields.EN:
Say, Jack? Since we're here, why
don't we ask him?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック。
ちょうど良い機会ですもの……
これから博士に聞いてみましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? Since we're here, why
don't we ask him?

fields.EN:
Sounds good. I guess it wouldn't
hurt, as long as we don't disturb
whatever he's doing...
fields.JP:
そうだね。
研究の邪魔をしないように……
ちょっとだけなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds good. I guess it wouldn't
hurt, as long as we don't disturb
whatever he's doing...

fields.EN: Ah, Jack-kun and Alice-kun, what timing.
fields.JP:
おお。ジャックくん、アリスくん……
いいところに来たね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, Jack and Alice, what timing.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun; ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Is there something you need from
us?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there something you need from
us?

fields.EN:
Take a look at this petri dish
here...
fields.JP: このシャーレを見たまえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take a look at this petri dish
here...

fields.EN:
It looks like... some kind of
flesh...
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like... some kind of
flesh...

fields.EN:
Doesn't ring a bell, does it? The
flesh you see here is from the
core you brought back.
fields.JP:
……わからないかね？
これはね……このシャーレの中の肉片は……
君たちが持ち帰ってくれた核なのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't ring a bell, does it? The
flesh you see here is from the
core you brought back.

fields.EN: It looks like it's still alive...
fields.JP: 何だか、生きているみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks like it's still alive...

fields.EN:
Indeed. The core continues to live
inside this petri dish!
fields.JP:
そうとも。
このシャーレの中で核は生き続けているのだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. The core continues to live
inside this petri dish!

fields.EN:
Look at how it can stay alive,
even as a simple piece of flesh.
fields.JP:
こんな肉片になってもだよ？
驚異の生命力だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at how it can stay alive,
even as a simple piece of flesh.

fields.EN:
And, in these vials are the blood
samples we got from the both of
you.
fields.JP:
そして……この試験管に入っているのが、
先日、採血した君たちの血液だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, in these vials are the blood
samples we got from the both of
you.

fields.EN: Now then, take a closer look...
fields.JP: いいかね？　よおく見ていたまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, take a closer look...

fields.EN:
First I will add a single drop of
Jack-kun's blood into the dish...
fields.JP:
まずジャックくんの血液を、シャーレの中の
肉片に少量……ほんの少量を注ぐよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
First I will add a single drop of
Jack's blood into the dish...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
The core shrinks and wails with
Jack's blood. Sad, considering
the core can't escape the dish.
fields.JP:
このように核は悲鳴をあげて収縮する……
ふふ……シャーレの中に逃げ場などないのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core shrinks and wails with
Jack's blood. Sad, considering
the core can't escape the dish.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll add Alice-kun's
blood...
fields.JP: そして……今度はアリスくんの血を注ぐ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll add Alice's
blood...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun

fields.EN:
Something is... growing out from
the core...
fields.JP: 何か……核から伸びているわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something is... growing out from
the core...

fields.JP: アリスの血を……飲んでる……！？

fields.EN:
Yes. The core reacts negatively to
Jack-kun's blood, whereas it seems to
accept Alice-kun's.
fields.JP:
そうだ。ジャックくんの血液には拒絶反応を
示したが、アリスくんの血液は好みのようだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The core reacts negatively to
Jack's blood, whereas it seems to
accept Alice's.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun; ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Did you notice? Not only does the
core mimic the characteristics of
organic and inorganic materials...
fields.JP:
……見たかね？
このように核は有機物や無機物を吸収し、
それらの特性を獲得するのみならず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you notice? Not only does the
core mimic the characteristics of
organic and inorganic materials...

fields.EN:
...Its will can also be
reconstructed as well! This is the
truth behind mimicry!
fields.JP:
その組成を再構築することすら可能なのだよ！
そして、これが『擬態』の本質なのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Its will can also be
reconstructed as well! This is the
truth behind mimicry!

fields.EN:
So that's mimicry... It's the
first time I've seen something
like that...
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's mimicry... It's the
first time I've seen something
like that...

fields.EN:
Since the Jail's maturation, it
has stabilized to the point where
it doesn't mimic as actively.
fields.JP:
そうだろうとも。ジェイルが成長を遂げて安定
してからは、ここ……内部に対する擬態活動は
活発ではないようだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since the Jail's maturation, it
has stabilized to the point where
it doesn't mimic as actively.

fields.EN:
But that applies to the inside of
the Jail, which shows slower
growth than the outside.
fields.JP:
おそらく外部への拡張は続いているのだろうが、
現存する内部の成長はごく緩やかなものになった
のだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that applies to the inside of
the Jail, which shows slower
growth than the outside.

fields.EN:
Yes, the inside seems to have come
to the end of its growth cycle,
similar to any other creature.
fields.JP:
あらゆる生物が、成体期には成長がほぼ止まった
かのように見えるように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, the inside seems to have come
to the end of its growth cycle,
similar to any other creature.

fields.EN:
If we can influence the core's
mimicry, we may be able to control
the Jail to help with our escape!
fields.JP:
核の擬態活動に介入制御することができれば……
ジェイルを自由に操作できるかもしれん……
ジェイル攻略のひとつの可能性だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we can influence the core's
mimicry, we may be able to control
the Jail to help with our escape!

fields.EN:
(I'm not surprised at Alice's
reaction after seeing that...)
fields.JP:
（アリス……あんなものを見せられたら
　無理もない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not surprised at Alice's
reaction after seeing that...)

fields.EN:
Um, Professor? I don't see that
Marchen that was held here
before...
fields.JP:
あの、博士……
この間、拘束されてたメルヒェンは……
もういないみたいですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Professor? I don't see that
Marchen that was held here
before...

fields.EN:
Oh, that? We were done with it, so
I handed it over to Towa-kun to take
care of it.
fields.JP:
……ああ、あれかね？
あれは、もう用が済んだからね。
永遠くんに頼んだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that? We were done with it, so
I handed it over to Towa to take
care of it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 永遠くん => Towa-kun

fields.EN: (What did he ask him to do?)
fields.JP: （門脇さんにって……何を頼んだんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What did he ask him to do?)

fields.EN:
That aside, doesn't this stimulate
your interest? How much of Alice-kun's
blood is needed for it to mimic?
fields.JP:
そんなことより……興味が湧かないかね？
どのくらいの血液を与えれば……この核が
アリスくんの擬態として機能するか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, doesn't this stimulate
your interest? How much of Alice's
blood is needed for it to mimic?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスくん => Alice-kun

fields.EN:
