Jack, let's leave. I'm... a bit
tired.
fields.JP:
ジャック、もう失礼しましょう。
その、少し疲れたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, let's leave. I'm... a bit
tired.

fields.EN: Ah, I can't blame you. You don't often get to see research results this stimulating.
fields.JP:
ああ、無理もないだろうね。
これだけ刺激的な研究成果も、なかなか見られる
ものではないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, how rude of me. Seeing such
inspiring results is something
that may be too much to handle.

fields.EN:
We're sorry to have bothered you,
Professor...
fields.JP: 博士……研究中、お邪魔しました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're sorry to have bothered you,
Professor...

fields.EN:
Ah, come back at any time. I do
have many more interesting things
to show.
fields.JP:
ああ。また、いつでも遊びきてくれたまえ。
もっと……興味深いこともあるのでね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, come back at any time. I do
have many more interesting things
to show.

fields.EN:
I'm sure that was something quite
important to his experiments,
but... it wasn't very pleasant.
fields.JP:
たぶん、大事な研究なんだろうけど……
あんまり、気分のいいものじゃなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure that was something quite
important to his experiments,
but... it wasn't very pleasant.

fields.EN:
The flesh in the dish... The
Marchen laughed with my voice...
fields.JP:
……わたしの声で笑っていたわ。
シャーレの中で……メルヒェンが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The flesh in the dish... The
Marchen laughed with my voice...

fields.EN:
I'm fine... It's just that... it
scared me...
fields.JP:
……大丈夫よ
ただ少し……ゾッとしただけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine... It's just that... it
scared me...

fields.EN:
Say, Jack? You heard the Professor
say that he handed the Marchen
over to Mr. Kadowaki, right?
fields.JP:
……ねえ、ジャック。
さっき博士はメルヒェンの処理を、
門脇さんに頼んだって言っていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? You heard the Professor
say that he handed the Marchen
over to Mr. Kadowaki, right?

fields.EN:
Yeah. It sounded as if he handed
it over to be discarded or
something...
fields.JP:
うん。
研究に使った後の……なんて言うか……
廃棄物的なニュアンスだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. It sounded as if he handed
it over to be discarded or
something...

fields.EN:
Is there such a facility like that
around where Mr. Kadowaki is
stationed? A disposal facility...?
fields.JP:
あそこに……門脇さんのところに、
そんな設備があったかしら？
メルヒェンを廃棄処理するような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there such a facility like that
around where Mr. Kadowaki is
stationed? A disposal facility...?

fields.EN:
Even if the Marchen was weakened,
it still is a threat, so I doubt
it was just let loose.
fields.JP:
でもさ……いくら弱ってるとはいえ、
相手はメルヒェンだから……。
適当に放置しとくことはないんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if the Marchen was weakened,
it still is a threat, so I doubt
it was just let loose.

fields.EN:
Of course you're right, but... it
just bothered me.
fields.JP:
……ええ、そうは思わないわ。
ただ、何だか気になったものだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course you're right, but... it
just bothered me.

fields.EN:
(The Professor seems to put all
his emphasis into research with
everything else left for last...)
fields.JP:
（確かに博士は研究第一で、用が済んだら
　後のことはどうでもいいように見える……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Professor seems to put all
his emphasis into research with
everything else left for last...)

fields.EN:
(He's so different when he's like
that. Definitely not like when he
cares for Akazukin-san...)
fields.JP:
（研究者って、そういうものなのかもしれない
　けど……赤ずきんさんや僕たちを気遣って
　くれる姿とは、同じ人とは思えない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's so different when he's like
that. Definitely not like when he
cares for Red Riding Hood...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Maybe we should speak with Mr.
Kadowaki...
fields.JP:
…………
門脇さんに聞いてみようか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we should speak with Mr.
Kadowaki...

fields.EN:
Hm? What's the matter, kiddo?
Something wrong with the Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
ん？　どうした、小僧……
メアリガンの調子でも悪いか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's the matter, kiddo?
Something wrong with the Mary Gun?

fields.JP: え？　いえ、そんなことないです！

fields.EN:
Um... I was just sort of passing
by, that's all...
fields.JP: ええと……取り立てて用事はないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I was just sort of passing
by, that's all...

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... You must be busy.
I'll get going.
fields.JP:
……す、すいません……
忙しいですよね……帰ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... You must be busy.
I'll get going.

fields.EN:
C'mon, take it easy! I was kicking
back a bit, too. I've got time to
talk.
fields.JP:
まあ、そう言うなよ！
俺もサボってたとこだ。しばらく付き合えよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, take it easy! I was kicking
back a bit, too. I've got time to
talk.

fields.EN:
C'mon, sit down. I'll check your
Mary Gun while we're at it.
fields.JP:
そこ、座れよ。
ついでにメアリガンの調子をみてやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, sit down. I'll check your
Mary Gun while we're at it.

fields.EN:
Now then... Hm... Looks like the
Mary Gun is okay.
fields.JP:
どら？
んー……メアリガンは問題なさそうだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then... Hm... Looks like the
Mary Gun is okay.

fields.EN:
You want to say something, don't
ya? Go ahead. Spill it.
fields.JP:
……なんか言いたいことがあるんだろ？
話してみろよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want to say something, don't
ya? Go ahead. Spill it.

fields.EN:
Um... Haru-san, what do you think about
Michiru-san?
fields.JP:
あの……ハルさんはミチルさんのこと……
どう思いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... What's your thoughts on
Michiru?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ミチル => Michiru-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
Michiru? Ah, you mean Oohime? Why
do you ask?
fields.JP:
ああ、大陽女さん……ね。
どうしてだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru? Ah, you mean Oohime? Why
do you ask?

fields.EN:
Miko-san seemed to dislike Michiru-san, so...
Haru-san, I was wondering what you think
of her...
fields.JP:
視子さんは……ミチルさんのことを
嫌ってるようだったから……
ハルさんはどう思ってるのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko doesn't seem to like Michiru,
so I wanted to ask how you felt
about her...
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ミチル => Michiru-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1; 視子 => Miko-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
Ah... In Miko's case, let's just
say it's a woman's intuition.
fields.JP:
あー。
あいつの場合、女の第六感ってやつだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... In Miko's case, let's just
say it's a woman's intuition.

fields.EN: Um, I'm not sure I follow...
fields.JP: あの……意味がわからないんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, I'm not sure I follow...

fields.EN:
Miko's a scientist to the core, so
she doesn't take kindly to folks
harping on about the illogical.
fields.JP:
……まあ、視子は学者だからな。
ああいった非論理的な手合いとは、
相性が悪いんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko's a scientist to the core, so
she doesn't take kindly to folks
harping on about the illogical.

fields.EN:
But Miko-san said herself that they
support the Dawn by growing and
cooking food supplies.
fields.JP:
でも、炊き出しや食糧の生産供給なんかで、
黎明の不足を補ってくれてるって……
視子さん、そうも言ってたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Miko said herself that they
support the Dawn by growing and
cooking food supplies.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
She has her pride as someone who
supports others, so maybe she just
looks at them as rivals.
fields.JP:
あいつも肩に力が入ってるところがあるからな。
ライバル意識みたいなもんなんじゃねえの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has her pride as someone who
supports others, so maybe she just
looks at them as rivals.

fields.EN:
Ah, but don't tell Miko what I
said. She'd kill me if she found
out.
fields.JP:
……おっかねえから、俺がそんな風に言ってた
なんて、視子にはバラすなよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but don't tell Miko what I
said. She'd kill me if she found
out.

fields.EN:
But, I have to admit... That
order, and in particular, Oohime,
is shady as hell.
fields.JP:
まあ、あの教団や……とりわけ大陽女さんが、
胡散臭えってのは事実だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have to admit... That
order, and in particular, Oohime,
is shady as hell.

fields.EN:
I'm sure Miko just feels uneasy
about them because she has no
definitive evidence against them.
fields.JP:
けど、確かな証拠を見つけられないんで、
視子も苛ついてるんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Miko just feels uneasy
about them because she has no
definitive evidence against them.

fields.EN:
U-Um... Does that mean Miko-san doubts
the Order of the Sun?
fields.JP:
あ、あの……それって、
視子さんがタイヨウを疑ってるってことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you made it sound as if she's
doubting the Order of the Sun.

fields.EN:
Since you're new here, I'm sure
you're able to see them and Oohime
without bias...
fields.JP:
組織の中枢メンバーじゃない、おまえなら……
下手な先入観を持たずにあの教団や大陽女さんを
見ることができるかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since you're new here, I'm sure
you're able to see them and Oohime
without bias...

fields.EN: What do you mean by that, Haru-san?
fields.JP:
ハルさん……
それって、どういう意味なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that, Haru?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Anyway, I'm done checking your
Mary Gun.
fields.JP: よし！　メアリガンの点検終了だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, I'm done checking your
Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
Stop by anytime, Jack. You being
here gives me a good reason to
slack off.
fields.JP:
ま、気軽に顔出せよ、ジャック。
おまえが来ると、サボりのいい口実になるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop by anytime, Jack. You being
here gives me a good reason to
slack off.

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't really want to be
blamed for it...
fields.JP: サボりの口実になるのはちょっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't really want to be
blamed for it...

fields.EN: Heh, heh... Lighten up, would ya?
fields.JP: はは。そう堅苦しく考えるなって
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, heh... Lighten up, would ya?

fields.EN:
(That sounded as if Haru-san wanted
me to observe the Order of the Sun
myself...)
fields.JP:
（ハルさん……僕自身の目で、タイヨウ教団を
　観察してみろって言ってるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That sounded as if Haru wanted
me to observe the Order of the Sun
myself...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Hiya, Jack-san! What brings ya here
today?
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん！
今日はどうしたんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hiya, Jack! What brings ya here
today?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Oh, nothing really... I'm just
taking a stroll. You look pretty
busy today.
fields.JP:
ううん、特に用事はないんだけど……
ちょっと時間ができたから。
……なんだか、忙しそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, nothing really... I'm just
taking a stroll. You look pretty
busy today.

fields.EN:
Yup! I'm putting together all the
things Boss wanted here...
fields.JP:
そうなんすよ。
師匠から頼まれた品物を、
こうやって揃えてるんすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I'm putting together all the
things Boss wanted here...

fields.EN:
Can ya believe it? He wants little
ol' me to take them to him! I'm
no delivery person, y'know?!
fields.JP:
これ全部、後で師匠んとこまで届けるんすよ？
うちはデリバリーサービスはやってないっつの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can ya believe it? He wants little
ol' me to take them to him! I'm
no delivery person, y'know?!

fields.EN: Guess I'm just a gofer to him...
fields.JP: ……まあ、体のいい使いっ走りっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Guess I'm just a gofer to him...

fields.EN:
(Despite what she's saying, she
really is attached to Haru-san...)
fields.JP:
（くらら、憎まれ口は叩いてても、ハルさんに
　すごく懐いてるんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite what she's saying, she
really is attached to Haru...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Well, I guess having that scary
face of his roaming about would be
bad... Even Marchens avoid him.
fields.JP:
でもまあ、あのコワモテがお買い物ってのも、
黎明の風紀に悪そうっすからね……
メルヒェンも裸足で逃げ出すってくらいっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess having that scary
face of his roaming about would be
bad... Even Marchens avoid him.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Now that's too much!
Marchens wouldn't avoid Haru-san, even
if he did look scary.
fields.JP:
あはは……それは、ひどいよ！
いくら、ハルさんが相手でも、
さすがにメルヒェンは逃げないんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Now that's too much!
Marchens wouldn't avoid Haru, even
if he did look scary.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
You'd think I'm joking, right?
Well, I'm not. I heard it directly from my older sister...
fields.JP:
や、まんざら冗談でもないんすよ、これ。
自分、姉貴から直接聞いたんすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd think I'm joking, right?
Well, I ain't. In fact, I got that
info from Big Sis Red.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Well, the avoiding part may be a
bit too much, but Boss isn't
really targeted by 'em.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンが逃げ出すってのは、
ちょっとオーバーっすけど……
襲われにくいってのは本当らしいっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the avoiding part may be a
bit too much, but Boss isn't
really targeted by 'em.

fields.EN:
You heard it from Akazukin-san?
You can't be serious, though.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんから？　本当なのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard it from Red Riding Hood?
You can't be serious, though.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Well, Boss was part of a search
unit before the Blood Team. If
Sis says it, it's gotta be true.
fields.JP:
以前は師匠も調査隊に入ってたんすよ。
血式部隊が本格的に活動する前ですけど……
同行してた姉貴が言うんだからマジっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Boss was part of a search
unit before the Blood Team. If
Sis says it, it's gotta be true.

fields.EN:
I kinda do feel for the Marchens.
I mean, I'd rather chase cute
girls than an old guy like him!
fields.JP:
まあ、自分はメルヒェンの気持ちもわかるっすね。
どうせ襲うなら、あんなオッさんよりも、
美少女の方がいいに決まってるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kinda do feel for the Marchens.
I mean, I'd rather chase cute
girls than an old guy like him!

fields.EN:
Uh, can Marchens tell the
difference between cute girls and
old guys like him?
fields.JP:
……メルヒェンって、美少女とオッさんの区別
なんてするの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, can Marchens tell the
difference between cute girls and
old guys like him?

fields.EN:
Ah! You said it too, Jack-san! I'll tell Boss
while I'm running errands that you called him
an old man!
fields.JP:
あー！　ジャックさんも言ったっすね！
自分、パシリついでに師匠に伝えとくっす！
ジャックさんがオッさんって言ってたって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! You said it! I'm gonna tell
Boss that you called him an oldie!

fields.JP: え！？　ちょ、ちょっと待ってよ！

fields.EN:
Heh, heh! I'm just pullin' your
leg. Well, I'd best be going now!
fields.JP:
あはは！　冗談っすよ。
じゃ、自分はこれで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh! I'm just pullin' your
leg. Well, I'd best be going now!

fields.EN:
(Is it even possible to not get
targeted by Marchens?)
fields.JP:
（でも、メルヒェンに襲われにくいなんて、
　本当にあるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is it even possible to not get
targeted by Marchens?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I'll speak with Haru-san
about it...)
fields.JP: （ハルさんに、聞きに行ってみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I'll speak with Haru
about it...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
I see... Marchens not targeting
me, eh?
fields.JP:
……なるほど。
メルヒェンが俺を襲わない……ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Marchens not targeting
me, eh?

fields.JP: ハルさんは……気づいていたんですか？

fields.EN:
Sort of. Well, I'm not so sure
about it, but maybe...
fields.JP:
まあな……
俺にも、確かなことはわからないんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sort of. Well, I'm not so sure
about it, but maybe...

fields.EN:
Maybe it's because I'm good-
looking? Even the Marchens know
not to waste a guy like me.
fields.JP:
いい男だからじゃねぇか？
メルヒェンも殺すのが惜しいってな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's because I'm good-
looking? Even the Marchens know
not to waste a guy like me.

fields.EN:
Stop with the silent treatment.
Say something.
fields.JP: ……なんか言えって。気まずいだろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop with the silent treatment.
Say something.

fields.EN:
At the very least, the "old guy"
part is totally wrong.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、くららの言ってたやつは
違うと断言したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, the "old guy"
part is totally wrong.

fields.EN:
Oh, uh... I'm sure she meant it as
a joke.
fields.JP: あはは……それも冗談だと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh... I'm sure she meant it as
a joke.

fields.EN:
But if Miko heard what you said,
knowing her, she'd go right into
research about it.
fields.JP:
しかし、今のおまえの言葉を視子が聞いたら、
大真面目に研究を始めそうで怖いな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if Miko heard what you said,
knowing her, she'd go right into
research about it.

fields.EN:
Ah! Maybe you'll become our
secret anti-Marchen weapon!
fields.JP: 対メルヒェンの秘密兵器ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! Maybe you'll become our
secret anti-Marchen weapon!

fields.EN:
Give me a break. No way I'm gonna
get dissected by the Professor and
Miko.
fields.JP:
いやいや。
博士と視子に斬り刻まれるのはごめんだな。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Give me a break. No way I'm gonna
get dissected by the Professor and
Miko.

fields.EN:
In any case, that's one weird
rumor. Next time, bring me
something more my speed, ya hear?
fields.JP:
しかしまあ、妙なとこで妙なネタにされてる
もんだな。今度はもっとシブいやつで頼むぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, that's one weird
rumor. Next time, bring me
something more my speed, ya hear?

fields.EN:
(Haru-san will never tell me anything
more. He'll just try to steer the
conversation elsewhere.)
fields.JP:
（こういう反応の時のハルさんは、
　どう切り込んでも絶対に喋らない……
　はぐらかされるだけだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haru will never tell me anything
more. He'll just try to steer the
conversation elsewhere.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
(Hm... Marchens being able to
choose who they want to attack
or not...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても……メルヒェンが襲う相手を、
　個別認識している事なんてあるんだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm... Marchens being able to
choose who they want to attack
or not...)

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack. Came down to get your
Mary Gun tuned?
fields.JP:
おう、ジャック。
毎度、お馴染みメアリガンの調整か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack. Came down to get your
Mary Gun tuned?

fields.EN:
Sure, if it'll give me a chance to
slack off.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, if it'll give me a chance to
slack off.

fields.EN:
Looks like you're learning how
things work around here. C'mon,
gimme your arm. I'll check it out.
fields.JP:
おまえも言うようになったな。
どれ……腕を出せよ。
一応、メアリガンも診とくか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're learning how
things work around here. C'mon,
gimme your arm. I'll check it out.

fields.JP:
……そんなわけで、
博士も、とても喜んでくれて……

fields.EN:
Um, Haru-san... do you and the Professor
not get along?
fields.JP:
あの、ハルさんって……
もしかして、博士と仲が悪いんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you and the Professor not
get along?

fields.EN:
The way you react when I talk
about the Professor is unusual.
Almost as if you didn't care...
fields.JP:
なんだか……博士の話になると、
日頃とは受け答えが違う気がして……
まるで、どうでもいいみたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The way you react when I talk
about the Professor is unusual.
Almost as if you didn't care...

fields.EN:
Really? We were the best of
friends a long time ago.
fields.JP:
……そうか？
大の仲良しだよ、昔からな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? We were the best of
friends a long time ago.

fields.EN:
I wonder if we'll really be able
to escape from the Jail.
fields.JP: ……ジェイル脱出なんて、本当に出来るのかね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if we'll really be able
to escape from the Jail.

fields.EN: Don't you want to escape, Haru-san?
fields.JP:
ハルさんは……
ここから脱出したくないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you want to escape, Haru?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Whether I do or not doesn't really
change much for me...
fields.JP:
……まあ、してもしなくても、
似たようなもんだっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether I do or not doesn't really
change much for me...

fields.EN:
Oh, but I guess I'd be out of a
job.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I guess I'd be out of a
job.

fields.EN:
(This isn't the usual Haru-san... He's
a key member of the Dawn, but it's
like he doesn't want to escape...)
fields.JP:
（これは、いつもの軽口じゃない……
　ハルさんは黎明の中枢にいるのに、
　ジェイル脱出を望んでない……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't the usual Haru... He's
a key member of the Dawn, but it's
like he doesn't want to escape...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
In any case, I'm planning on
supporting you guys and gals as
needed.
fields.JP:
ま、なんにせよ……
俺は、お前らを支えていくつもりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I'm planning on
supporting you guys and gals as
needed.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Just leave the calibration of your
Mary Gun to me.
fields.JP: こいつのメンテも任しとけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just leave the calibration of your
Mary Gun to me.

fields.EN:
And... done! Come by to slack off
again anytime.
fields.JP:
ほい、点検終わったぜ！
また、いつでもサボりに来いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... done! Come by to slack off
again anytime.

fields.EN:
You're not going to say anything
else to me?
fields.JP: 何も……話してはくれないんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not going to say anything
else to me?

fields.EN:
Wipe off that sad-looking mug of
yours, and just keep your eyes
straight ahead.
fields.JP:
ま、お前は前だけ見てろ。
不景気なツラしてねえでな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wipe off that sad-looking mug of
yours, and just keep your eyes
straight ahead.

fields.EN:
(Maybe Haru-san has different plans
from the Professor...)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたら、ハルさんには……
　博士とは別の思惑があるのかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Haru has different plans
from the Professor...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Blood pressure is normal... Looks
like the results came back fine,
despite your long captivity.
fields.JP:
……血圧は正常ね。簡易血液検査の方でも、
特に悪い数値は出てなかったし……大丈夫。
長い間収監されていたにしては、健康体よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood pressure is normal... Looks
like the results came back fine,
despite your long captivity.

fields.EN: I see. That's good to know.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. That's good to know.

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel, wanting
to protect her, but you need to be
careful. You could die, you know.
fields.JP:
あなたがあの子を護りたい気持ちはわかるわ。
でも、無茶なことを続ければ、いずれ死ぬ……
気をつけてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel, wanting
to protect her, but you need to be
careful. You could die, you know.

fields.JP: 別に……アリスのことだけじゃ……

fields.EN:
I just want to be of use to
everyone...
fields.JP: ただ……僕も、みんなの役に立ちたいだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just want to be of use to
everyone...

fields.EN:
Let me give it to you straight. I
sense potential in you, so I want
you to be more cautious.
fields.JP:
はっきり言うわ。
これは独断だけど、あなたには可能性を感じて
いるの。だからこそ、慎重に振舞ってほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me give it to you straight. I
sense potential in you, so I want
you to be more cautious.

fields.JP: ありがとう……ございます……

fields.EN:
(I think this is the first time
someone's thought about me like
that...)
fields.JP:
（そんな風に言ってもらえたのは、初めてかも
　しれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think this is the first time
someone's thought about me like
that...)

fields.EN:
Um, so I went to the Order of the
Sun, and... they're quite unique.
fields.JP:
その……タイヨウ教団に行ってみました。
不思議なところですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so I went to the Order of the
Sun, and... they're quite unique.

fields.EN:
Lady Oohime was really mysterious,
and Hitsuka-san sounded pretty mean...
fields.JP:
大陽女さんって人は、何だか不思議な人ですし、
陽司さんってどこか怖いし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime was really mysterious,
and Hitsuka sounded pretty mean...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
But I could tell everyone there
admired them, kind of like some
religious cult...
fields.JP:
でも……みんなあの人たちを敬ってる感じで……
宗教団体って、そういう場所なのかなあって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I could tell everyone there
admired them, kind of like some
religious cult...

fields.EN:
I see... Well, I won't stop you
from going, especially after I
urged you to check them out...
fields.JP:
そう……まあ、行くなとは言えないしね。
私も、『行ってみれば』なんて言っちゃったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Well, I won't stop you
from going, especially after I
urged you to check them out...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I seem to get emotional
when the conversation is about
the Order...
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
教団のことになると、どうも感情的になる
きらいがあるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I seem to get emotional
when the conversation is about
the Order...

fields.EN:
I've wondered about this before... Miko-san,
do you dislike those people?
fields.JP:
前も少し思ったんですけど……視子さんはあの人
たちのことが嫌いなんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been wondering... Why don't
you like them?

fields.EN:
It's not that I don't like them...
It's more that I just can't get
along with them.
fields.JP:
嫌いというか……
ああしたものが苦手なのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that I don't like them...
It's more that I just can't get
along with them.

fields.EN:
I'm a researcher, so I only accept
data I can physically confirm.
That's why I look for the truth.
fields.JP:
私は研究者だから、自分の目やデータで確認した
ものしか信じられないし、そうして真実に到達
しようとしているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a researcher, so I only accept
data I can physically confirm.
That's why I look for the truth.

fields.EN: That's why I don't understand the point of passing down this longing for the sun when they can barely even remember it themselves.
fields.JP:
だから、覚えてるかどうかも怪しいような太陽
への憧れを、ああして語り伝えることの意義が、
私には理解できないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really understand them,
with their evangelism and their
baseless admiration of the sun.

fields.EN:
But... Isn't it okay, as long as
there are people out there who
can be saved by their words?
fields.JP:
でも……それで気持ちが救われる人がいるなら、
誰かの役には立ってるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Isn't it okay, as long as
there are people out there who
can be saved by their words?

fields.EN:
They cook for and trade various
products with us. Everything
requires cooperative work.
fields.JP:
教団は炊き出しをしたり、黎明と食べ物の物々
交換をしに来たりするけど……何をするにしても
労働力というものは要るのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They cook for and trade various
products with us. Everything
requires cooperative work.

fields.EN:
That said, I feel like they're
gathering believers for labor.
fields.JP:
その労働力を確保するために、信者を集めて
いるのではないか……そんな風に思えることすら
あるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I feel like they're
gathering believers for labor.

fields.EN:
But if that's what needs to be
done to live, then...
fields.JP: でも、そうしてみんなで生きていくためなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if that's what needs to be
done to live, then...

fields.EN:
Then they should just say so, and
find people to work for them. 
That's my opinion, at least.
fields.JP:
それならそう言って希望者を募ればいい……
そう考えるのは、私の職業病なのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then they should just say so, and
find people to work for them. 
That's my opinion, at least.

fields.EN:
Not to mention, I'm curious about
how they can actually grow food
like that in this situation.
fields.JP:
それに……この状況で、どうやってあんな風に
作物を生産できるというのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention, I'm curious about
how they can actually grow food
like that in this situation.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: ……それは、どういう意味ですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.JP: （視子さん……何を言おうとしたんだろう……？）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
With how questionable that Oohime
is, Hitsuka is pretty much the
acting leader of the Order.
fields.JP:
……それに、あの大陽女のオツムのゆるさじゃ、
横にいる陽司って人があの教団の実質的なトップ
だと考えて間違いないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how questionable that Oohime
is, Hitsuka is pretty much the
acting leader of the Order.

fields.EN: Historically, though, religious organizations always have human and social backing... They aren't something a single person can run entirely alone.
fields.JP:
でも歴史上、宗教団体の成立には人的、社会的な
バックボーンが必ず存在するもの……
純粋に個人が一手に担えるものではないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we examine history, all
religious orders have someone that
acts as the group's backbone.

fields.EN:
You can't maintain order alone.
Someone has to be supporting
Oohime and Hitsuka from behind.
fields.JP:
通常なら、大陽女や陽司の背後には、必ずそれを
支持・援助し、かつ利用しようとする人たちが
いる筈なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't maintain order alone.
Someone has to be supporting
Oohime and Hitsuka from behind.

fields.EN:
And in complying with that person,
whoever has the most charisma is
pushed to the leader position.
fields.JP:
そして、いわばそうした人たちの要請を受ける
形で、ある種のカリスマ性を持つ人物が教祖と
して押し上げられてくるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And in complying with that person,
whoever has the most charisma is
pushed to the leader position.

fields.EN:
So that's how it was...? That's history from
the old world, right? Miko-san, you really know
a lot...!
fields.JP:
そういうものなんですか……！
それ、昔の世界の歴史ですよね？
視子さんはいろいろ詳しいんですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that how it works? I'm
surprised you have so much
historical knowledge!

fields.EN:
I've just had the time to read
various materials from times past.
fields.JP:
遺された資料を読む時間だけはあったから……
それだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've just had the time to read
various materials from times past.

fields.EN:
As far as I know, the Order came
from nowhere. There's no trace of
anyone supporting its beginnings.
fields.JP:
……でも私の知る限りでは、あの教団はある時
突然誕生したの。大陽女や陽司に所属母体や
支持者がいたという情報も無いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As far as I know, the Order came
from nowhere. There's no trace of
anyone supporting its beginnings.

fields.EN:
That's the basis for why they seem
suspicious to me...
fields.JP: だから……胡散臭すぎるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the basis for why they seem
suspicious to me...

fields.EN:
Couldn't you say that they're
there because the people are
seeking the sun?
fields.JP:
みんなが太陽を求めてるから……じゃ、
駄目なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Couldn't you say that they're
there because the people are
seeking the sun?

fields.EN:
I suppose... The sun was touted as
a god by the ancients, so I guess
it's universal across all ages...
fields.JP:
……そうね。まあ太陽は昔から神として崇められ
ていたしね。こんな状況じゃ、ああいうのも必要
なのかもしれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose... The sun was touted as
a god by the ancients, so I guess
it's universal across all ages...

fields.EN:
But, know this... You can't find
salvation from the Jail through
religion...
fields.JP:
でも宗教なんかじゃ、このジェイルからは救われ
ないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, know this... You can't find
salvation from the Jail through
religion...

fields.EN:
Looks like your heart rate is
higher than normal. Your urine
samples are of concern, as well...
fields.JP:
……少しいつもより心拍数が早いわね。
尿検査でも少し気になる値があるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like your heart rate is
higher than normal. Your urine
samples are of concern, as well...

fields.EN:
Does that mean I won't be able to
use the Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
それって、メアリガンが使えなくなるって
ことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean I won't be able to
use the Mary Gun?

fields.EN:
Your results don't point to
that, but your reaction does...
fields.JP:
特にどれも正常値は超えてないわ。
どちらかというと、あなたの今のその反応よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your results don't point to
that, but your reaction does...

fields.EN:
You're stressed... I can't believe
how much more stressed you are now
than when you first arrived!
fields.JP:
……ストレスが溜まってるのよ。
ここへ来たばかりの頃より、ストレス度が
上がってるってどういうこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're stressed... I can't believe
how much more stressed you are now
than when you first arrived!

fields.EN:
It's not like I know I'm stressed,
you know?
fields.JP: じ、自分では自覚ないんですけど！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I know I'm stressed,
you know?

fields.EN: Honestly... I understand the Mary Gun has given you a strong sense of duty. But don't confuse the means with the objective.
fields.JP:
まったく……メアリガンを得て、あなたが
使命感を強く感じているのはわかるわ。
でも、手段と目的を取り違えては駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable... I understand your
stance now that you have the Mary
Gun, but you need to stay focused.

fields.EN:
Remember your promise with Haru-san?
The Mary Gun was made for the sole
purpose of keeping everyone alive.
fields.JP:
ええ、そう。ハルさんとも約束した筈でしょう。
メアリガンはあなたたちが生き残るための手段に
過ぎないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember your promise with Haru?
The Mary Gun was made for the sole
purpose of keeping everyone alive.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: You're not alive for the Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
メアリガンのためにあなたが生きてるわけじゃ
ないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not alive for the Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
But, this is the only way I can
help...
fields.JP: でも……僕にできることは、それくらいしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, this is the only way I can
help...

fields.EN:
Too serious. You should learn a
thing or two from Kaguya.
fields.JP:
……真面目すぎ。
少しはかぐやを見習うべきかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too serious. You should learn a
thing or two from Kaguya.

fields.EN:
You need to relax. Keep up this
pace, and you'll just drop. Enjoy
life a little.
fields.JP:
肩に力が入りすぎなのよ。
その気負いだけでいずれ潰れるわ。
……少しは生きることも楽しみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to relax. Keep up this
pace, and you'll just drop. Enjoy
life a little.

fields.EN:
...Miko-san, I don't think I want to hear that
from you...
fields.JP: ……視子さんには言われたくない気が……
fields.LOCALIZED: And this is coming from you...

fields.EN:
So, you can still make snide
remarks? Good. You're excused.
fields.JP:
……ま、軽口が出てくるならいいわ。
お疲れさま
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you can still make snide
remarks? Good. You're excused.

fields.JP: ありがとうございます。……あの

fields.EN:
Miko-san, your surname is 'Ueshima,' right?
That means you have memories of your family.
I'm kind of jealous...
fields.JP:
視子さんって、『上島』って苗字がありますよね。
それってやっぱり、家族の記憶があるってことです
よね。なんだかうらやましいなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your last name is "Ueshima,"
right? That means you must have
memories about your family.

fields.EN:
It's true that I'm one of the very
few here who actually knows
their last name.
fields.JP:
確かに……今ではこの世界で苗字を名乗っている
人は少ないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that I'm one of the very
few here who actually knows
their last name.

fields.EN: I barely remember my parents either. They probably died when the world became like this... By the time I realized it, I was an orphan.
fields.JP:
親の記憶なんて、私にもほとんどないわ。
こんな世界になった時におそらく両親は死んだ
のね……気づいた時には孤児だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I don't have any memories of
my parents. I supposed my parents
died when this place was born.

fields.EN:
(I'm a bit leery to ask this now,
but...)
fields.JP: （それじゃ……聞いてみたら悪いかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm a bit leery to ask this now,
but...)

fields.JP: あの、それじゃあ『上島』って……

fields.EN:
That's the last name of my mentor,
the person I admired.
fields.JP:
ふふ……そうね。
これは……私の師匠というか、憧れていた人の
苗字なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the last name of my mentor,
the person I admired.

fields.EN:
What my true last name was isn't
of importance now.
fields.JP:
私にとって元の苗字なんて、覚えていたところで
意味は無いものだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What my true last name was isn't
of importance now.

fields.EN:
And, I wanted to carry on her
will, so I just decided to use her
last name as mine...
fields.JP:
あの人の意思を継ぎたくて、勝手に名乗ってると
いったところかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I wanted to carry on her
will, so I just decided to use her
last name as mine...

fields.EN:
I see... So where is this person
now?
fields.JP:
そうだったんですか……
その人は、今は……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So where is this person
now?

fields.EN:
She died 15 years ago during a
mission to the Tower.
fields.JP: 死んだわ。十五年前、塔の攻略作戦でね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She died 15 years ago during a
mission to the Tower.

fields.EN:
I bet you feel bad for asking, but
don't. They're just facts. It's a
part of the Dawn's history now.
fields.JP:
悪いことを聞いたと思ってるんでしょうけど、
気にしてないわ。事実だもの。
黎明の歴史に過ぎないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you feel bad for asking, but
don't. They're just facts. It's a
part of the Dawn's history now.

fields.EN:
(She must be in pain... Especially
since she took that person's
name...)
fields.JP:
（でも、悲しくないはずがない……じゃなければ
　名前を受け嗣いだりなんか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must be in pain... Especially
since she took that person's
name...)

fields.EN:
The Professor spoke about it
before, but that incident nearly
dismantled the Dawn.
fields.JP:
博士も話していたけれど、あの時黎明は中枢を
一度に失い、一度崩壊しかけたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor spoke about it
before, but that incident nearly
dismantled the Dawn.

fields.EN:
Doctor Ueshima and key members
of the Dawn died at the Tower,
leaving only the Professor.
fields.JP:
通称『先生』……上島先生を含め、黎明の中枢を
担っていた人は、みんな塔で戦死したわ。
……博士の生命と頭脳を未来に託してね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doctor Ueshima and key members
of the Dawn died at the Tower,
leaving only the Professor.

fields.EN:
Then Miko-san, you've known the Professor
since long ago...
fields.JP:
じゃあ……視子さんは、昔から博士とは知り合い
だったんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you've known the Professor from
that long ago...

fields.EN:
I was still a child back then, and
I only assisted Dr. Ueshima with
her duties.
fields.JP:
……あの頃はまだ小さな子供で、大人たちに
混じって、先生の手伝いをしてただけだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was still a child back then, and
I only assisted Dr. Ueshima with
her duties.

fields.EN: But the people around me back then gradually died in battle during the Jail research... and now I've ended up in charge here.
fields.JP:
でも、その頃の周りの人たちも、ジェイル研究の
間にだんだん戦死していって……今では私が
ここの責任者になってしまったというわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But since then, other researchers
have died one-by-one, and now I'm
left to carry the load.

fields.EN:
Yes... I suppose it would be a lie
to say that I've recovered from it
already.
fields.JP:
……そうね。気持ちの整理がついているといったら
嘘になるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I suppose it would be a lie
to say that I've recovered from it
already.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Last time, Haru-san was saying
something about escaping here not
mattering much to him...
fields.JP:
このあいだ、ハルさんが『脱出してもしなくても
似たようなもん』って言ってたんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Last time, Haru was saying
something about escaping here not
mattering much to him...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Is Haru-san against escaping from the
Jail?
fields.JP:
ハルさんはジェイル脱出計画には反対……
なんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is Haru against escaping from the
Jail?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
I just think that old man is
trying to be cynical or something.
fields.JP:
ま、あのオッさんはただ斜に構えてるだけだと
思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just think that old man is
trying to be cynical or something.

fields.EN:
But as for what will happen when
the Tower grows high enough, our
being able to escape or not...
fields.JP:
ただ……塔が目標の高さまで成長し切った時に、
いったい何が起きるのか……本当にそこから
脱出できるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But as for what will happen when
the Tower grows high enough, our
being able to escape or not...

fields.EN:
...Is just us betting on the best
outcome. After all, this will be
the first time for everyone.
fields.JP:
それは全て、可能性に賭けているとしか
言いようがないのも本当ね。
何しろ、前例が無いんだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Is just us betting on the best
outcome. After all, this will be
the first time for everyone.

fields.EN:
There are a lot of things we don't
know about the Jail yet, like the
talking Nightmares...
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが喋れることがわかったり……
ジェイルにはまだ、わからないことだらけ
だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are a lot of things we don't
know about the Jail yet, like the
talking Nightmares...

fields.EN:
Yes, and sometimes I think maybe
there was a more efficient way of
approaching things from the onset.
fields.JP:
……そうね。実はもっと前提から……
つまり、他により効率の良い方法があるんじゃ
ないかって、時々思うことはあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and sometimes I think maybe
there was a more efficient way of
approaching things from the onset.

fields.EN:
But we are limited on resources,
so our only option is to continue
focusing on our plan.
fields.JP:
でも、私たちの調査能力は限られているし、
現状、全てのリソースをこの計画に注いでるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we are limited on resources,
so our only option is to continue
focusing on our plan.

fields.EN:
So unless we have solid proof
against it, we need to carry it
out with all we have.
fields.JP:
だから……反証を持たない以上は、この計画に
沿って進めるしかないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So unless we have solid proof
against it, we need to carry it
out with all we have.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(So Miko-san does have her doubts
about the plan...)
fields.JP: （視子さんも疑問は持ってたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So Miko does have her doubts
about the plan...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
I guess that's the general gist of
what Haru-san was getting at.
fields.JP:
ハルさんが言ってたのも、そんな感じのことじゃ
ないかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that's the general gist of
what Haru was getting at.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
I'm such a horrible adult for
instilling anxiety in someone on
the front-lines like yourself.
fields.JP:
ふふ。前線で戦ってるあなたに、こんな不安を
与えるような愚痴を言ってたら、大人失格ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm such a horrible adult for
instilling anxiety in someone on
the front-lines like yourself.

fields.EN:
We want to know the truth, too.
Thank you very much.
fields.JP:
僕たちだって、本当のことを知っていきたいん
です。だから……ありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
We want to know the truth, too.
Thank you very much.

fields.JP: お役に立ったなら、光栄よ
ほらぁ……ダメだよ、目を離しちゃあ！
……あれ？　何か起きてるのかな？

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
C'mon, it looks like it can still
move. It was about to get away!
fields.JP:
ほら。コイツ、まだ動けるみたいじゃない。
逃げちゃうとこだったよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, it looks like it can still
move. It was about to get away!

fields.JP:
……あっははは！
すまんすまん！
このオレとしたことが……
赤ずきんさん！　門脇さん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: あの……何があったんですか？
ああ。ジャックにアリスか

fields.EN:
Ah, the kid and the newcomer!
Well, this is embarrassing...
fields.JP:
おお、小僧に新入りか！
いやあ、こいつはみっともないとこを
見られちまったなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, the kid and the newcomer!
Well, this is embarrassing...

fields.JP: 永遠……あんた、いい加減名前覚えなよ……

fields.EN:
(I thought he didn't like us, but
I guess it's just that he didn't
remember our names...)
fields.JP:
（少し嫌われてるのかと思ったけど、
　名前、覚えるのが苦手なだけだったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought he didn't like us, but
I guess it's just that he didn't
remember our names...)

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Well, not a major issue,
but...
fields.JP:
ははは。
いやあ、別に大したことじゃないんだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Well, not a major issue,
but...

fields.EN:
Huh... So a Marchen that was
supposed to be discarded, becoming
a runaway isn't a major issue, eh?
fields.JP:
へぇ……廃棄処理予定のメルヒェンが
逃げ出そうとしてたんだけど……
大したことじゃないんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... So a Marchen that was
supposed to be discarded, becoming
a runaway isn't a major issue, eh?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Where's your sense of duty? You
should know that Marchens sent
from Dad need to be discarded.
fields.JP:
あんた、ちょっと職務怠慢。
お父さんのとこからメルヒェン引き上げたら、
速攻で処分するってのが決まりでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where's your sense of duty? You
should know that Marchens sent
from Dad need to be discarded.

fields.EN:
Sure, fine, it's all my fault.
Dad, Dad, Dad. Is that all you can
say?
fields.JP:
……はいはい、オレが悪うございました！
ははは！　お父さん、お父さん、お父さん……。
寝ても覚めても、お父さんか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, fine, it's all my fault.
Dad, Dad, Dad. Is that all you can
say?

fields.EN:
(Is he purposely going easy
against the Marchen? It's as if he
was playing with it...)
fields.JP:
（この人……
　わざと手加減して痛めつけてる……！？
　まるで嬲ってるみたいな……でも、まさか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is he purposely going easy
against the Marchen? It's as if he
was playing with it...)

fields.EN:
If there's something you want to
say, say it to my face.
fields.JP: 言いたいことがあるなら、はっきり言いなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there's something you want to
say, say it to my face.

fields.EN:
Ah, really? Okay then. You see
this Marchen here? I'm tired of
these types already!
fields.JP:
おお、そうか？　そんなら、言わしてもらうわ。
このメルヒェンな……
このタイプには、もう飽き飽きしてんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, really? Okay then. You see
this Marchen here? I'm tired of
these types already!

fields.EN:
They don't even put up a fight!
All they do is moan. If you really
want me to work...
fields.JP:
抵抗するわけでもねえし、反応も悪いときた！
せいぜいが哀れっぽい声を上げるぐらいでな。
オレに真っ当な仕事をさせたかったらよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They don't even put up a fight!
All they do is moan. If you really
want me to work...

fields.EN:
...Bring me one that's worth
killing! Get me one that's going
to motivate me to actually work!
fields.JP:
もっと殺し甲斐のあるヤツを連れて来いよ！
オレの勤労意欲をアップさせるような、
目新しくて長く楽しめるようなヤツをよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Bring me one that's worth
killing! Get me one that's going
to motivate me to actually work!

fields.JP:
…………ハ！
やっぱビョーキだよ、あんた

fields.EN:
Well then, I'll finish this one
off myself.
fields.JP: ……なら、コイツはあたしが始末しとく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'll finish this one
off myself.

fields.EN:
Now, hold on there! This one is
better than nothing. I'm going to
kill it myself!
fields.JP:
……おっと、待った！
こんなカスでも、ないよりゃマシだ。
もちろん……オレが殺るさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, hold on there! This one is
better than nothing. I'm going to
kill it myself!

fields.JP:
…………
はぁ、好きにしなよ。
行こう……ジャック、アリス

fields.EN:
Mr. Kadowaki, we'll be leaving
now...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mr. Kadowaki, we'll be leaving
now...

fields.EN:
Sorry for the ruckus. Must have
been a bad day. Come back again
later. I'll just get back to work.
fields.JP:
ああ。また、ゆっくり遊びに来いよ。
今日は、日が悪かったみたいだからな。
……オレは職務に励むとするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for the ruckus. Must have
been a bad day. Come back again
later. I'll just get back to work.

fields.EN:
I heard that Mr. Kadowaki was
handling the Marchens that the
Professor finished studying...
fields.JP:
博士が研究に使った後のメルヒェンは……
門脇さんが処理してるって聞いたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard that Mr. Kadowaki was
handling the Marchens that the
Professor finished studying...

fields.EN: He's playing with them, isn't he?
fields.LOCALIZED: He's playing with them, isn't he?

fields.EN:
Yup, pretty much. That's... his
pastime...
fields.JP:
うん、大抵はそう。
あれ、あいつの趣味なんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, pretty much. That's... his
pastime...

fields.JP: あの、博士はこのことは？

fields.EN:
He just lets Towa handle
everything, so...
fields.JP: 永遠に全部任せてるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He just lets Towa handle
everything, so...

fields.JP:
だっははははは……！
うあっはははははは…
ははは…いてぇええぇ…！

fields.EN: He's really not a bad person...
fields.JP: 普段は悪い奴じゃないんだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED: He's really not a bad person...

fields.EN:
Come on! You can do better than
that!
fields.JP: ほら！　もっと暴れろよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on! You can do better than
that!

fields.EN:
(Even if it was a Marchen, that
was really disturbing...)
fields.JP:
（いくら相手がメルヒェンでも……こういうのは
　……気分がいいもんじゃないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if it was a Marchen, that
was really disturbing...)

fields.EN: Say, Jack? Let's stop him already.
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャック……もう、いいじゃない？
止しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Say, Jack? Let's stop him already.

fields.EN:
You know how the captured Marchens
are being disposed of now, right?
fields.JP:
黎明が捕獲したメルヒェンを、
どう処理しているのかについては……
もう充分にわかったでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how the captured Marchens
are being disposed of now, right?

fields.EN:
You mean how Mr. Kadowaki is
killing them for pleasure?
fields.JP: ……門脇さんが、面白半分に虐殺してる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean how Mr. Kadowaki is
killing them for pleasure?

fields.EN:
It didn't seem like that back
then, but I wonder if that's
really true.
fields.JP:
あの時はそんな風に見えたけど……
本当に、そうだったのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't seem like that back
then, but I wonder if that's
really true.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Something didn't feel right about
Mr. Kadowaki and Akazukin-san
back then.
fields.JP:
……あの日、門脇さんも赤ずきんさんも、
ちょっと様子がおかしかった気がしてさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something didn't feel right about
Mr. Kadowaki and Red Riding Hood
back then.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
When Mr. Kadowaki noticed us
watching them argue, it felt like
he...
fields.JP:
二人が言い合いしてるところに、
ちょうど僕らが行き合わせたもんだから、
門脇さんも……何て言うか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Mr. Kadowaki noticed us
watching them argue, it felt like
he...

fields.JP: ……露悪的な反応になってしまった？

fields.EN:
Yeah... It just felt like that. It
sure wasn't the same Mr. Kadowaki
that we know.
fields.JP:
……うん。
そんな感じだったんじゃないかと思うんだ。
いつもの門脇さんらしくなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It just felt like that. It
sure wasn't the same Mr. Kadowaki
that we know.

fields.EN: I'm not so sure about that...
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not so sure about that...

fields.EN:
We didn't really see the Marchen
being killed or anything, either.
fields.JP:
結局、僕らはメルヒェンが処理されるところを、
見たわけじゃないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't really see the Marchen
being killed or anything, either.

fields.EN:
I just think we should know how
the captured Marchens are being
discarded...
fields.JP:
黎明が捕獲したメルヒェンを、
最終的にどんな風に処理しているのか……
ちゃんと知っておきたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just think we should know how
the captured Marchens are being
discarded...

fields.EN:
I see... I guess we should learn a
bit more about it.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
知っておくべきかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I guess we should learn a
bit more about it.

fields.EN: Let's go and ask Mr. Kadowaki.
fields.JP: うん。門脇さんに直接聞いてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's go and ask Mr. Kadowaki.

fields.EN:
Hey, there! Hahaha! Nice to see
you two together again! What
brings you here?
fields.JP:
やあ、お二人さん！
ははは！　いつも仲がいいね！
オレに、なんか用かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, there! Hahaha! Nice to see
you two together again! What
brings you here?

fields.JP: （……やっぱり、いつもの門脇さんだ）

fields.EN:
Sure thing! Is it okay we talk
while I feed her?
fields.JP:
ああ、かまわないよ。
コイツに餌をやりながらでいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing! Is it okay we talk
while I feed her?

fields.EN:
I didn't know you owned a cat,
Mr. Kadowaki.
fields.JP:
その猫、どうしたんですか？
門脇さんが飼っているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you owned a cat,
Mr. Kadowaki.

fields.EN:
I don't own her. She was chased
by a Marchen and ran in here.
fields.JP:
いや、オレが飼ってるってわけじゃない。
ちょっと前にメルヒェンに追われて、
ここに逃げ込んできてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't own her. She was chased
by a Marchen and ran in here.

fields.EN:
So she's more like the Dawn's pet.
Our guys here put together some
scraps for her to eat.
fields.JP:
黎明本部全体で飼ってるようなもんさ。
有志が協力して、乏しい食糧配給から、
コイツの食い扶持を捻出してるのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So she's more like the Dawn's pet.
Our guys here put together some
scraps for her to eat.

fields.EN:
She doesn't have a name yet. Got
any suggestions?
fields.JP:
まださ。
現在、募集中なんだ。
いい名前、無いかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't have a name yet. Got
any suggestions?

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Just let me know if you
come up with a good one!
fields.JP:
ははは。
思いついたらでいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Just let me know if you
come up with a good one!

fields.EN:
Maybe I can help bring some food
for her, too...
fields.JP:
……わたしも協力しようかしら……
猫ちゃんの餌……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I can help bring some food
for her, too...

fields.EN:
Really? That would help a lot! Did
you hear that? Hey now, eat
slowly. Tastes good, right?
fields.JP:
そうか？　助かるよ！
よおし、よし……うまいか？
ゆっくり食えよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? That would help a lot! Did
you hear that? Hey now, eat
slowly. Tastes good, right?

fields.EN:
(I can't imagine Mr. Kadowaki
acting like how he did before...)
fields.JP:
（門脇さん……
　やっぱり、いつもあんなことする人には
　思えない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't imagine Mr. Kadowaki
acting like how he did before...)

fields.EN:
So, what is it again? You wanted
to ask me something, right?
fields.JP:
……それで何だい？
オレに、なんか用があったんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what is it again? You wanted
to ask me something, right?

fields.EN: Um... What do you usually do with Marchens once you're done researching them? Like the one from the other day...
fields.JP:
あの……研究の済んだメルヒェンって、
いつもどんな風に処理しているんですか？
この間のやつもそうですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
About the Marchens... Do you
usually treat them like that? You
know, like the last one...

fields.EN:
I hurt it until it couldn't move,
then cut it to pieces, so all's
good now!
fields.JP:
この間のヤツなら、
動けなくなるまで痛めつけてから、
バラバラに斬り刻んでやったから安心していいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hurt it until it couldn't move,
then cut it to pieces, so all's
good now!

fields.EN:
I'm pretty much in charge of
handling all the Marchens to be
discarded.
fields.JP:
ここでのメルヒェンの廃棄処理は、
オレに一任されていてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm pretty much in charge of
handling all the Marchens to be
discarded.

fields.EN:
You should've seen the one before
that! It lasted a while! Not as
much energy, but boy was it fun!
fields.JP:
この間のヤツなんかは、案外しぶとくてね！
思ったよりは、楽しめたよ。
まあ、新味には欠けるけどね。ははは！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should've seen the one before
that! It lasted a while! Not as
much energy, but boy was it fun!

fields.EN:
Why don't you just end it quickly?
Why go through all the hassle?
fields.JP:
……どうして、一思いに殺さずに……
そんなに……手間をかけるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you just end it quickly?
Why go through all the hassle?

fields.EN:
Oh, come on! Stop with that face
of yours! They're our enemies, and
they deserve to be treated so.
fields.JP:
なんだよ、おい！？　そんな顔するなって！
あいつらは人類の敵じゃないか。なあ？
何をしたって構わないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on! Stop with that face
of yours! They're our enemies, and
they deserve to be treated so.

fields.EN:
But, torturing them like that
isn't necessary...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, torturing them like that
isn't necessary...

fields.EN:
Hey, that's not fair! You folks
get to have all the fun, but not
me? This place is a real bore.
fields.JP:
おいおい！　お前らばっか楽しんでないで、
オレにも少しはストレス解消させてくれよ？
ここは娯楽も少ないんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, that's not fair! You folks
get to have all the fun, but not
me? This place is a real bore.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Um, sorry to have bothered
you, Mr. Kadowaki...
fields.JP:
うん……
あの、門脇さん、それじゃ……
お仕事中、邪魔してすいませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Um, sorry to have bothered
you, Mr. Kadowaki...

fields.EN:
Hm? No problem! I was just taking
a break anyway!
fields.JP:
ん？
ああ、気にするなよ！
休憩時間みたいなもんだ。なあ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? No problem! I was just taking
a break anyway!

fields.EN:
Next time, send me a new one to
kill! I'm counting on you!
fields.JP:
今度は是非、新種を刻んでみたいね！
よろしく頼むぜ、お二人さん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next time, send me a new one to
kill! I'm counting on you!

fields.EN:
No, I'm sorry... I wanted to learn
more, too...
fields.JP:
いいえ、わたしも……
わたしも、知りたかったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm sorry... I wanted to learn
more, too...

fields.EN:
(I don't understand why he's
doing that... Why isn't anyone
stopping him?)
fields.JP:
（門脇さんのことが、よくわからない……
　どうしてみんな止めないんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't understand why he's
doing that... Why isn't anyone
stopping him?)

fields.JP:
（……みんな、同じように思ってるんだろうか？
　誰か、知ってる人はいないのかな……？）

fields.EN:
Keep your arm still... It may hurt
a bit.
fields.JP:
……そのまま腕を動かさないでね？
ちょっとだけ痛いかもしれないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep your arm still... It may hurt
a bit.

fields.EN:
I changed the winged needle on the
drain pipe to an indwelling one.
It should make it easier to use.
fields.JP:
メアリガンのドレーンパイプの挿管部を、
翼状針から留置針へ交換しておいたわ。
脱着がいくぶん楽になる筈よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I changed the winged needle on the
drain pipe to an indwelling one.
It should make it easier to use.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much. That needle
hurt a bit, so this helps a lot.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
実は針、ちょっと痛かったから……助かります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much. That needle
hurt a bit, so this helps a lot.

fields.EN:
I suggested modifying the needle,
but that old man said that guys
should be able to bear it...
fields.JP:
針の改良を提案したら、あの不良中年、
『男ならちょっとくらい痛くたって我慢しろ』
だなんて言ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suggested modifying the needle,
but that old man said that guys
should be able to bear it...

fields.EN:
What is he going to do if things
like this negatively affect the
missions?
fields.JP:
実際に作戦行動に支障を来したら
どうするつもりなのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is he going to do if things
like this negatively affect the
missions?

fields.EN: Heh... That does sound like Haru-san.
fields.JP: あはは……まあ、ハルさんらしいですよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh... That does sound like Haru.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
If you see any swelling, be sure
to let me know.
fields.JP: まあ、炎症が出るようなら、すぐに報告して
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you see any swelling, be sure
to let me know.

fields.EN:
We're done here. Is there
something else that's bothering
you?
fields.JP:
……処置は済んだわよ？
なに？　どこか具合でも悪い？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're done here. Is there
something else that's bothering
you?

fields.EN:
...No, that's not it. Um... Miko-san, do you
know about the disposal of Marchens?
fields.JP:
……いえ、そうじゃないんです。
あの……視子さんは……
メルヒェンの廃棄についてご存知ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, sort of... Um, what do you
know about how the Marchens
are being disposed?

fields.EN:
Ah, you must be talking about
Kadowaki... You saw it?
fields.JP:
ああ……その話？
門脇くんの件ね。
……あれを見ちゃったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, you must be talking about
Kadowaki... You saw it?

fields.EN:
I know what you want to say. I'm
not very proud of what's going on,
either.
fields.JP:
あなたの言いたいことはわかるわ。
私も、あれは感心しない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what you want to say. I'm
not very proud of what's going on,
either.

fields.EN:
The Marchens may be our enemies,
but... to play with them like that
until their death is...
fields.JP:
確かにメルヒェンは僕らの敵だけど……
あれは……無意味な嬲り殺しです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens may be our enemies,
but... to play with them like that
until their death is...

fields.EN:
It feels much different coming
from someone actually fighting
the Marchens, but... you're right.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンと戦ってる子の口から聞くと
新鮮だけど……
……ま、それはそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels much different coming
from someone actually fighting
the Marchens, but... you're right.

fields.EN:
That's no different from the
torturing the Marchens do to the
humans they capture.
fields.JP:
あれじゃ、まるで……
投獄した人間にメルヒェンがやってる拷問と
同じじゃないかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's no different from the
torturing the Marchens do to the
humans they capture.

fields.EN:
Um... Miko-san, could you ask Kadowaki-san
to stop? If it came from Miko-san, maybe he...
fields.JP:
あの……視子さんから門脇さんに、
やめてもらうように言ってもらえませんか？
視子さんの言葉なら、門脇さんも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it possible for you to tell Mr.
Kadowaki to stop? Maybe he would
listen to you.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I won't do that.
And you don't say anything to him
anymore, either.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、それはお断りよ。
あなたも彼に余計なことを言わないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I won't do that.
And you don't say anything to him
anymore, either.

fields.EN:
No matter what anyone says,
nothing can be done.
fields.JP:
誰が何を言ったところで、
どうにもならないことだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter what anyone says,
nothing can be done.

fields.EN:
Kadowaki's parents were badly
mutilated by the Marchens right in
front of him as a child.
fields.JP:
彼はね、門脇くんは……まだ幼い頃、
目の前で両親をメルヒェンに殺されてるのよ。
ご遺体は……ひどい状態だったそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kadowaki's parents were badly
mutilated by the Marchens right in
front of him as a child.

fields.EN:
Most members of the Dawn went
through similar experiences, and
each try to overcome their trauma.
fields.JP:
……黎明にいる人間のほとんどは、
彼と似たような体験をしているわ。
各々が、そのトラウマを克服しようとしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most members of the Dawn went
through similar experiences, and
each try to overcome their trauma.

fields.EN:
So you're saying Mr. Kadowaki's
way of killing the Marchens is his
way of overcoming that trauma?
fields.JP:
じゃあ……メルヒェンの虐殺を続けることが……
門脇さんのトラウマを克服する手段……
……と、いうことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're saying Mr. Kadowaki's
way of killing the Marchens is his
way of overcoming that trauma?

fields.EN:
In his case, when his parents were
killed, a part of his mind
broke...
fields.JP:
まあ……そうね。
両親を殺害された時、
彼の心はちょっと壊れちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
In his case, when his parents were
killed, a part of his mind
broke...

fields.EN:
He's able to somehow maintain his
sanity by doing what he does out
there.
fields.JP:
彼は、あの虐殺を繰り返すことで、
どうにか精神のバランスを保っているってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's able to somehow maintain his
sanity by doing what he does out
there.

fields.EN:
He isn't as tough as he looks.
I do know that stopping him will
only worsen his condition.
fields.JP:
門脇くんは、見た目ほどタフじゃないのよ。
これは断言してもいいけど……
彼を制止すれば、より事態は悪化するわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He isn't as tough as he looks.
I do know that stopping him will
only worsen his condition.

fields.EN:
Yes. And, if that happens, there's
no telling how it will affect all
of us here.
fields.JP:
ええ。それが……具体的にどんな形で、
私たちの身に降りかかるかわからないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. And, if that happens, there's
no telling how it will affect all
of us here.

fields.EN:
So it's best to leave him alone
like that?
fields.JP:
それじゃ、このままにしておくのが……
一番、いい方法なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it's best to leave him alone
like that?

fields.JP: そういうことになるわね

fields.EN:
I think you've spent enough time
here already. You should go back
now, Jack.
fields.JP:
今日は、無駄話しすぎたわ。
もう、いいわよ、ジャック。お疲れさま
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you've spent enough time
here already. You should go back
now, Jack.

fields.JP: それじゃ、自分はちょっと……

fields.EN: Are you going to Haru-san's place?
fields.JP: ひょっとして……ハルさんのところに行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you going to Haru's place?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Figured my assistant duties need
answering to! Gets pretty busy
when ya got two jobs.
fields.JP:
そろそろ助手の仕事の方も溜まってそうっす
からね。二足のわらじは大変っすよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Figured my assistant duties need
answering to! Gets pretty busy
when ya got two jobs.

fields.EN:
By the way, is Haru-san like your dad
or something?
fields.JP:
ひょっとして……くららって、ハルさんと
親子か何かなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, is Haru like your dad
or something?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: そ……そんなわけないじゃないっすか！！
（っていうか……どうして照れてるの？）

fields.EN:
I was an orphan, and Boss picked
me up and took me under his care.
fields.JP:
自分……孤児だったっすけど、師匠に拾われた
んすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was an orphan, and Boss picked
me up and took me under his care.

fields.EN: Huh... Guess Haru-san has a soft side.
fields.JP: へえ……ハルさん、いいとこあるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh... Guess Haru has a soft side.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
I learned how to fidget with
gadgets, making chump change
fixing things in the city.
fields.JP:
自分……解放地区の街で、見よう見まねで
ちょっとした修理なんかで小銭稼いでたっす
けど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I learned how to fidget with
gadgets, making chump change
fixing things in the city.

fields.EN:
But that wasn't enough for me to
buy food, so I was a bad egg,
stealin' and things...
fields.JP:
それだけじゃ食えなくて、スリとかをやって
どうにか生きてたんすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that wasn't enough for me to
buy food, so I was a bad egg,
stealin' and things...

fields.EN:
Then one day, I tried to snatch
some cash from the Boss, and
he caught me red-handed.
fields.JP:
それでまあ、その日もせっせとスリに励んでたっす
けど、たまたま相手が師匠でして……まんまと
捕まったんすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then one day, I tried to snatch
some cash from the Boss, and
he caught me red-handed.

fields.EN:
Yeah, Haru-san doesn't sound like the
type to let something like that
slide.
fields.JP:
ハルさん、そういうとこぼんやりしてなさそう
だもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, Haru doesn't sound like the
type to let something like that
slide.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Right? He lectured me, then let me
go, but I was so mad that I kept
trying to steal money from him.
fields.JP:
そうなんすよー。その時は説教されて解放されたん
すけど、なんか悔しくて……自分、何度もリベンジ
したんすよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? He lectured me, then let me
go, but I was so mad that I kept
trying to steal money from him.

fields.EN:
And you were caught each time,
right?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you were caught each time,
right?

fields.JP: そうなんす……あれは口惜しいっすね……

fields.EN:
After all that, he decided to
bring me in here.
fields.JP:
で、なんだかんだで、最終的に引き取られる
ことになったんす
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all that, he decided to
bring me in here.

fields.EN:
Haru-san looks intimidating at first glance.
Didn't you think it might be dangerous to keep
challenging him?
fields.JP:
ハルさんて一見コワモテだけど、
何度もリベンジしたら危なそうだとか
思わなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you kept approaching
him, especially with how gruff he
looks.

fields.EN:
Well, I just thought... he could
do anything he wants with me...
fields.JP: 師匠になら……何されてもいいかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I just thought... he could
do anything he wants with me...

fields.JP: えっ？　ひょっとして……

（くららは、ほんとにハルさんのことが好き
　なんだな……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Y-Ya better not tell Boss what I
said!
fields.JP: い、今の話……師匠には内緒っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Ya better not tell Boss what I
said!

fields.EN:
Hey, this looks like something
Alice would like...
fields.JP: あ。これ、アリスが好きそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, this looks like something
Alice would like...

fields.EN:
Why not get it for her? I'll make
it cheap! Go ahead and splurge!
fields.JP:
お安くするっすから、ドーンとプレゼントしちゃ
どうっすか？　ドーンと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not get it for her? I'll make
it cheap! Go ahead and splurge!

fields.EN:
Uh, I don't have that much money
to splurge...
fields.JP:
『ドーンと』ってあたりで、僕の財布じゃ無理
そうなのがわかるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I don't have that much money
to splurge...

fields.JP: そこが男の甲斐性っすよ！

fields.EN:
Um, I'm not really a boss, so I'm
fine...
fields.JP: 僕……甲斐性ないからいいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm not really a boss, so I'm
fine...

fields.EN:
You ain't gonna nab good gals like
that! C'mon, splurge!
fields.JP:
そんなこと言ってちゃ女の子にモテないっすよ！
さあ、ドドーンと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You ain't gonna nab good gals like
that! C'mon, splurge!

fields.EN:
(She has an edge against me... I'd
better change the subject.)
fields.JP:
（こ、このままじゃマズイ……なんとか
　話題を変えないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has an edge against me... I'd
better change the subject.)

fields.EN:
B-By the way, remember you told
me how you came here?
fields.JP:
そ、そういえばさ、
以前に、なんだかんだで黎明に引き取られたって
言ってたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-By the way, remember you told
me how you came here?

fields.EN:
I wouldn't mind hearing how you
joined the Dawn!
fields.JP:
なんだかんだって、実際どんなことがあったのか
聞きたいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't mind hearing how you
joined the Dawn!

fields.JP: いきなりどうしたんすか？

fields.EN:
Y-You know? The Dawn only brings
people here as official staff
members, so...
fields.JP:
ほ、ほら、黎明ってどうやら関係者っていうか、
スタッフって形しか迎えてないみたいだから、
少し気になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You know? The Dawn only brings
people here as official staff
members, so...

fields.EN:
Yeah, that's true. Now that I can say it,
Jack-san, I was a little surprised when you
showed up.
fields.JP:
あー。確かにそういうとこあるっすねー。
今だから言うと、ジャックさんが来た時には、
ちょっと意外だったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you're right. To be honest,
when ya came here, I was a bit
surprised.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it was surprising for me
too, and... I felt out of place...
fields.JP:
うん……
僕も意外だったし、肩身も狭かったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it was surprising for me
too, and... I felt out of place...

fields.EN:
I was impressed that everyone saw your ability
right from the start, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
むしろ、みんな最初っからジャックさんの能力
見抜いてたんだなって、感心したっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was impressed how everyone knew
about your powers just by lookin'
at ya!

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... I'm not so sure about
that.
fields.JP: あはは……それは、どうなんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... I'm not so sure about
that.

fields.EN:
(They only started treating me
differently once they heard how my
blood stopped Alice's Skelter...)
fields.JP:
（でも確かに……僕の血がアリスの暴走を止めた
　って話が出てから、対応が変わったような
　気はする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They only started treating me
differently once they heard how my
blood stopped Alice's Skelter...)

fields.EN:
In my case, I bet the Boss saw how
awesome of a girl I am, and...
fields.JP:
まあ自分の場合は……きっと師匠が、自分を
いい女だって見抜いて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In my case, I bet the Boss saw how
awesome of a girl I am, and...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Aren't ya gonna say
something?! Don't make me finish
that on my own!
fields.JP:
な、何かツッコんでくださいっすよ！
置いてけぼりは惨めじゃないっすか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Aren't ya gonna say
something?! Don't make me finish
that on my own!

fields.EN:
Well, to be honest, I'm not sure
why the Dawn is letting me stay
here.
fields.JP:
まあ正直なところ、なんで自分が黎明に置いて
もらえることになったのかは、よくわかって
ないんすよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, to be honest, I'm not sure
why the Dawn is letting me stay
here.

fields.EN:
Maybe Haru-san asked the Professor
to keep you here?
fields.JP:
やっぱり、ハルさんが博士に口利きして
くれたのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Haru asked the Professor
to keep you here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Speaking of the Professor, he
asked me where my name came
from when I first got here.
fields.JP:
うーん……あ！
そういえば、引き取られたばっかの頃に、
博士から自分の名前の由来を聞かれたっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of the Professor, he
asked me where my name came
from when I first got here.

fields.EN:
(Oh, wait. He asked me that,
too...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, wait. He asked me that,
too...)

fields.EN:
Anyway, do you know where you got
your name, Jack-kun?
fields.JP:
……ところでジャックくん。
君は自分の名前の由来を知っているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, do you know where you got
your name, Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Yes. Did your parents give it to
you?
fields.JP:
ああ。両親に付けてもらったのか、
もしくは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Did your parents give it to
you?

fields.EN:
I don't know... I lost my parents
when I was young, and I don't
really remember much from then...
fields.JP:
……知らないんです。
僕、幼い頃に両親を亡くして、
その頃の記憶がほとんど無くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know... I lost my parents
when I was young, and I don't
really remember much from then...

fields.EN:
He looked really disappointed when
I told him my grandma gave me my
name.
fields.JP:
それで、死んだ婆ちゃんがつけてくれたって
言ったらすごくガッカリされたんす
fields.LOCALIZED:
He looked really disappointed when
I told him my grandma gave me my
name.

fields.EN:
(Is there something about where
we got our names that matters to
him...?)
fields.JP:
（名前の由来に……
　一体どんな意味が……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is there something about where
we got our names that matters to
him...?)

fields.EN:
I told the Boss afterwards, and he
said to not let it bother me, and
that he'd teach me his trade...
fields.JP:
そのことを後で師匠に言ったら、
気にしなくていい、お前は手先が器用だから
俺が仕込んでやる……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told the Boss afterwards, and he
said to not let it bother me, and
that he'd teach me his trade...

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, guess
that means the Professor didn't
really want me here.
fields.JP:
……今思うと、自分を黎明に置いとくのを
博士に反対されたってことだったんすかね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, guess
that means the Professor didn't
really want me here.

fields.EN:
Well, that just means I need to
become a full-fledged Blood Weapon
craftsman!
fields.JP:
こーなったら、一人前の血式武器製造士に
なるしかないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that just means I need to
become a full-fledged Blood Weapon
craftsman!

fields.EN:
I'm gonna make the Professor wanna
keep me here!
fields.JP: それで、博士に自分を認めさせてやるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna make the Professor wanna
keep me here!

fields.EN:
I'm sure you'll be able to be one,
Clara. I'm rooting for you!
fields.JP:
くららなら、絶対なれると思うよ。
僕も応援するよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you'll be able to be one,
Clara. I'm rooting for you!

fields.EN:
Wh-What's with the cheer?! Not
like I'm gonna make it free for
ya!
fields.JP:
な、何すかいきなり？
おだてたって、お代は負けないっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's with the cheer?! Not
like I'm gonna make it free for
ya!

fields.EN:
Clara, do you have this in any
other colors?
fields.JP: くらら、これと色違いのやつってある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, do you have this in any
other colors?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Looks like I'm out of
stock... You don't like that
color?
fields.JP:
えーと……今は品切れっすねー
色違いじゃないと駄目なんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Looks like I'm out of
stock... You don't like that
color?

fields.EN:
Well, Kaguyahime asked me to get this
for her, but she said she wanted
a particular one...
fields.JP:
実は、かぐや姫に買い物を頼まれたやつなんだ
けど……この色がいいっていうのがあるんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Kaguya asked me to get this
for her, but she said she wanted
a particular one...

fields.EN:
Jack-san, maybe you're surprisingly suited
to being a servant?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんって、案外下僕体質の持ち主じゃ
ないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, seems like you've got the
talent for being a first-class
gofer...

fields.EN: Huh? Um, I don't think so...
fields.JP: えっ。そ、そんなことはないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Um, I don't think so...

fields.EN:
You gotta be like the Boss or the
Professor and let others do your
work for ya!
fields.JP:
もっと博士や師匠みたいにドーンと人をパシらせ
てくださいっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gotta be like the Boss or the
Professor and let others do your
work for ya!

fields.EN:
Ugh, that reminds me... I can't
believe they want me to do all
this...
fields.JP:
……ったく忙しいのに、どんだけいろいろ人を
コキ使うつもりっすかねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, that reminds me... I can't
believe they want me to do all
this...

fields.JP: また……いろいろ配達なの？

fields.EN:
Um, I was going to ask you
something, but if you're busy, I
can come back later...
fields.JP: あの、忙しかったら今度にするけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I was going to ask you
something, but if you're busy, I
can come back later...

fields.EN:
I was wondering about the
Professor and Haru-san... They don't
seem to get along very well.
fields.JP:
博士とハルさんって、どういう関係なのかなって
思ってさ……すごく関係がいいようには見えない
気がするっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was wondering about the
Professor and Haru... They don't
seem to get along very well.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm not sure how they know
each other. Boss just says he's
known the Professor a long time.
fields.JP:
うーん。自分も詳しいことは知らないっすねー。
師匠も、昔からの知り合いだってくらいしか
言わないっすしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm not sure how they know
each other. Boss just says he's
known the Professor a long time.

fields.EN:
Yeah, he doesn't really touch on
that subject much. I wonder how
long ago he means...
fields.JP:
確かにあんまり話してくれないよね。
昔からって、どれくらいなんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, he doesn't really touch on
that subject much. I wonder how
long ago he means...

fields.JP: それも詳しくは聞いたことないっすね……

fields.EN:
If the Professor's the only key
member who survived, those old
guys probably go way back.
fields.JP:
博士は初期の黎明中枢の唯一の生き残りだって
ことっすし、師匠もオッさんだから、まあ古株
ってとこだと思うっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Professor's the only key
member who survived, those old
guys probably go way back.

fields.EN:
But it doesn't seem like the Boss
likes talking about it...
fields.JP:
なんかあんまり話したがってないように見える
んすよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it doesn't seem like the Boss
likes talking about it...

fields.EN:
So, he doesn't tell you either,
then...
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, he doesn't tell you either,
then...

fields.JP: ど、どういうことっすか？

fields.EN:
You know... Clara is the closest to Haru-san,
so I thought maybe he'd tell Clara more things.
fields.JP:
ほら……くららはハルさんと一番親しいだろう
から、くららにはいろいろ話すのかなって
思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know? I thought he would speak
with you more freely, given how
close you are to him.

fields.EN:
Y-You're not getting a discount
just because you're flattering me!
fields.JP: お……おだてたって何も出ないっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're not getting a discount
just because you're flattering me!

fields.EN:
But, I see what you're gettin'
at...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I see what you're gettin'
at...

fields.EN:
Boss and the Professor are kinda
similar, but... different in some
ways.
fields.JP:
師匠と博士って、どこか同じ匂いがするんすけど
……なんか違うんすよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss and the Professor are kinda
similar, but... different in some
ways.

fields.JP: 同じ匂いだけど……何か違う？

fields.EN:
Mmm... I guess it's almost like
how one stinks and the other just
smells like an old man...
fields.JP: うーん……加齢臭と老人臭の違いっすかね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess it's almost like
how one stinks and the other just
smells like an old man...

fields.EN:
Stinks and smells like an old
man... Got it. I'll let Haru-san know
that.
fields.JP:
加齢臭と老人臭……
それ、ハルさんにも言っとくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stinks and smells like an old
man... Got it. I'll let Haru know
that.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
H-Hey! P-Please, you can't do that
to me!
fields.JP: ちょ！　それは勘弁してくださいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! P-Please, you can't do that
to me!

fields.EN:
(But, I guess Clara can sense
something strange about them...)
fields.JP:
（くららも二人の間の違和感みたいなものを
　感じてるんだなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, I guess Clara can sense
something strange about them...)

fields.EN:
(The Order of the Sun... I guess
it's best for me to see for myself
what they're about...)
fields.JP:
（タイヨウ教団か……どういう人たちなのかは、
　たしかに自分の目で確かめるのが一番だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Order of the Sun... I guess
it's best for me to see for myself
what they're about...)

fields.EN:
(But this feels almost like I came
to spy on them...)
fields.JP: （で、でも……何だかスパイみたいで嫌だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But this feels almost like I came
to spy on them...)

fields.EN:
(I hope they don't chase me out
like last time...)
fields.JP: （この前みたいに追い返されたらどうしよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope they don't chase me out
like last time...)

fields.JP:
あ、ジャック。
遊びに来てくれたの？

fields.EN:
Um, have you always been
cooperating with the Dawn like
this?
fields.JP:
あのう……黎明のみんなとは、前から
こんな風に協力し合ってるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, have you always been
cooperating with the Dawn like
this?

fields.EN:
Ooh! I need to show you something!
Over here, here!
fields.JP:
それより……見て見て！
こっちこっち……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! I need to show you something!
Over here, here!

fields.EN:
(Hitsuka-san won't like seeing me
holding hands with her like
this...)
fields.JP:
（こんな風に手を引っ張られてるとこを
　陽司さんに見られたら、大騒ぎになるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hitsuka won't like seeing me
holding hands with her like
this...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
Look! Cabbage, carrots, um... I
think those are radishes. Oh,
and...
fields.JP:
キャベツに、にんじんに、えーと……
あっちは大根？　あと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look! Cabbage, carrots, um... I
think those are radishes. Oh,
and...

fields.EN:
(Look at all those vegetables...
I've never seen so many in my
life...)
fields.JP:
（作物がこんなにたくさん……
　こんなの、初めて見た……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at all those vegetables...
I've never seen so many in my
life...)

fields.EN:
Everyone must have worked hard
to grow them. So, you share them
with the Dawn, too?
fields.JP:
……ここの人たちがいっしょうけんめい育てて、
それを黎明にも配ってくれてたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone must have worked hard
to grow them. So, you share them
with the Dawn, too?

fields.EN:
Correct! But, we can grow more if
the sun comes out.
fields.JP:
あたりー。
でもね、お日様が出れば、もっともっと育つよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct! But, we can grow more if
the sun comes out.

fields.EN:
The sun... I've never seen it
before.
fields.JP: お日様……僕、見たことないんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun... I've never seen it
before.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will soon. You're
going to bring it to us.
fields.JP:
お日様、きっともうすぐ見られるよ。
……あなたが運んできてくれるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will soon. You're
going to bring it to us.

fields.EN:
Jack? Do you like the beginning
or the end of a story?
fields.JP:
ジャックはね、お話の始めと終わり、
どっちが好き？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? Do you like the beginning
or the end of a story?

fields.EN:
I like the beginning. It makes me
excited to see what's going to
happen next.
fields.JP:
わたしはお話の始めが好き。これから何が
起きるのか、わくわくさせてくれるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like the beginning. It makes me
excited to see what's going to
happen next.

fields.EN:
But, before you can start a story,
you need to close out the old one.
fields.JP:
でも、物語を始めるためには、前の物語を
閉じなければならないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, before you can start a story,
you need to close out the old one.

fields.EN:
Heh, heh... That'll be our little
secret. You go home quietly. Or
else Chii is going to be very mad.
fields.JP:
ふふふ。いまのは二人だけの内緒。
ジャックはこっそり帰るのよ？
でないと、ちーちゃんに怒られちゃう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, heh... That'll be our little
secret. You go home quietly. Or
else Chii is going to be very mad.

fields.JP: ちーちゃん！　こんなの見つけたよー

fields.EN:
Michiru-sama, please don't call me
that...
fields.JP: ミチル様。その呼び方は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Michiru, please don't call me
that...
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ミチル様 => Michiru-sama (remove localized English title)

fields.JP: それより、誰かいたような……？

fields.EN:
Michiru was talking with the
veggies. I asked them to grow
bigger. Heh, heh...
fields.JP:
みちる、野菜さんとお話ししてたの。
大きく育ってねって……ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru was talking with the
veggies. I asked them to grow
bigger. Heh, heh...

fields.EN:
(Looks like I got away in the nick
of time...)
fields.JP: （……どうにか見つからずに済んだみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like I got away in the nick
of time...)

fields.JP: （……あの人、『姉さん』って言ってたな……）

fields.EN:
Looks like you're able to be out
and about. So, do you feel okay
using the Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
……貧血の方は問題ないようね。
どう？　メアリガンの使用で異状は感じない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're able to be out
and about. So, do you feel okay
using the Mary Gun?

fields.EN: Yes. I think it's working great!
fields.JP: はい。順調だと思います！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I think it's working great!

fields.EN:
That's good to hear. You do come
by here periodically, so I'm sure
it will be fine, but be careful.
fields.JP:
……ならいいわ。
定期的な検査にもきちんと来てくれてるし、
これからも注意深く使ってちょうだいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear. You do come
by here periodically, so I'm sure
it will be fine, but be careful.

fields.JP: わかりました……ところで

fields.EN:
I went to the Order of the Sun and
saw their fields...
fields.JP:
あの、このあいだタイヨウ教団の畑を見せて
もらったんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I went to the Order of the Sun and
saw their fields...

fields.EN:
I'm surprised how they can
actually grow so many things in
the Jail!
fields.JP:
ジェイルの中でも、あんなに作物が育つん
ですね！　びっくりしました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised how they can
actually grow so many things in
the Jail!

fields.EN:
Of course they wouldn't grow.
There's no sun.
fields.JP: 育つわけないじゃない。……陽も射してないのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course they wouldn't grow.
There's no sun.

fields.EN:
Most vegetation require sunlight
to grow. The vegetation in turn
feeds the chickens and cows.
fields.JP:
たいがいの植物は、太陽の光を浴びて育つのよ。
そして、それを食べて鶏や牛は育つの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most vegetation require sunlight
to grow. The vegetation in turn
feeds the chickens and cows.

fields.EN:
Whether we like it or not, we have
to live in unison with what the
Jail can provide.
fields.JP:
私たちは好むと好まざると、ジェイルと共棲して
いくしかないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether we like it or not, we have
to live in unison with what the
Jail can provide.

fields.EN:
I'm quite pleased at how sharp
you are. I don't need to be so
blunt about things.
fields.JP:
察しがいいようで助かるわ。
はっきりとした言葉を使わずに済むものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite pleased at how sharp
you are. I don't need to be so
blunt about things.

fields.EN:
I want you to keep this to
yourself. I'd hate to see anyone
here fold under the truth.
fields.JP:
でも、公言はしないでもらいたいの。
想像力の働かない人は多かれ少なかれいるし、
そんな人たちのショックまで負いたくないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to keep this to
yourself. I'd hate to see anyone
here fold under the truth.

fields.EN:
One other thing... It's said that
continued intake of the Jail can
adversely affect one's mind.
fields.JP:
もう一つ。これは知ってるかしら？
ジェイルの細胞を摂取し続けると、知能が衰えると
言われているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing... It's said that
continued intake of the Jail can
adversely affect one's mind.

fields.EN:
Remember, that's also why we're
trying to escape as soon as
possible...
fields.JP: ……だから、時間との戦いでもあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember, that's also why we're
