acknowledge what's happening?

fields.EN:
Of course I understand. They are
our believers, after all. They
must have gone to the Tower.
fields.JP:
……いや。もちろん状況は把握しているよ。
教団内のことだからね。おそらく彼らが向かって
いるのは、あの塔だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I understand. They are
our believers, after all. They
must have gone to the Tower.

fields.EN:
They probably went there because
I told them that's where
everything began...
fields.JP:
きっと、『始まりの場所』だから……
そう、わたしが話したから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They probably went there because
I told them that's where
everything began...

fields.EN:
It's not your fault. I should have
stopped them from going there.
fields.JP:
姉さんのせいじゃないよ。
僕がもっと強く禁止すべきだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not your fault. I should have
stopped them from going there.

fields.EN:
Um, what is this "where everything
began" thing about?
fields.JP: あの……『始まりの場所』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, what is this "where everything
began" thing about?

fields.EN:
That tower leads to where
everything began... Where we all
originated from...
fields.JP:
あそこは……『始まりの場所』なの……
わたしたちの全てが、始まった場所……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That tower leads to where
everything began... Where we all
originated from...

fields.EN:
(I guess she means the center of
the Jail...)
fields.JP: （……ジェイルの中心部って意味なのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess she means the center of
the Jail...)

fields.EN:
Some of our believers revere the
Tower, thinking they could offer
themselves there to greet the sun.
fields.JP:
どうやらそれを神聖視する向きが、一部の中には
あるようでね。そこに身を捧げに行けば、太陽を
迎えられると考えたようなんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some of our believers revere the
Tower, thinking they could offer
themselves there to greet the sun.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but you're losing me
here...
fields.JP: すみません……よく、わからないです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but you're losing me
here...

fields.EN: I'm the same. What's the point of going to some specific place...? Especially when we don't even know how dangerous it is inside.
fields.JP:
僕だって同じさ。たかだか特定の場所に行って、
何になる……。しかも中がどれだけ危険かも
わからないのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just as confused as you are.
That they would even go to such
a dangerous place...

fields.EN:
The "sun" my sister speaks about
is merely a figment of hope for
the people.
fields.JP:
太陽は……あくまで姉の唱えた希望の象徴なんだ。
なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The "sun" my sister speaks about
is merely a figment of hope for
the people.

fields.EN: Chiaki-san... you don't believe in the sun...?
fields.JP: 千昭さんは……太陽を信じていないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't believe in the sun...?

fields.EN: All I believe in is my sister.
fields.JP: ……僕の信じているものは、姉だけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: All I believe in is my sister.

fields.EN:
The sun doesn't want any
sacrifices...
fields.JP: お日様は、犠牲なんてほしくないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun doesn't want any
sacrifices...

fields.EN:
I really don't know what's
happening... This came out of
nowhere all of a sudden...
fields.JP:
……このところ、突然起き始めたんだ。
きっかけは……わからない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't know what's
happening... This came out of
nowhere all of a sudden...

fields.EN:
Blue Bird-san didn't say anything. The sun
wouldn't say something like that either...
fields.JP:
青い鳥さんは何も言ってないの。
お日様だって、そんなこと言わないの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The blue bird doesn't tell me
anything. The sun wouldn't say
such things, either.

fields.EN:
I wish to go and catch the blue
bird, but...
I don't know where it is...
fields.JP:
みちる、とりさんつかまえにいきたいな……
でも、とりさんのいばしょ、わからないの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wish to go and catch the blue
bird, but...
I don't know where it is...

fields.EN:
Blue bird... Bird... Birdie,
birdie, birdie...
fields.JP:
あおいとりさん……とりさん……
とりとりとりとり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blue bird... Bird... Birdie,
birdie, birdie...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
Dear sister! It's okay! Please,
calm down...
fields.JP:
姉さん……大丈夫だから……！
落ち着いて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear sister! It's okay! Please,
calm down...

fields.EN:
Jack... I'll stop everyone. You... please find
Blue Bird-san...
fields.JP:
ジャック……わたし、みんなを止める。
ジャックは……青い鳥さんを探して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I'm going to stop them...
Jack... Please find the blue
bird...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... She's not faring so
well. I want to give her some time
to rest now.
fields.JP:
……すまない。姉の状態が良くないようだ。
少し休ませたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... She's not faring so
well. I want to give her some time
to rest now.

fields.EN:
Ah, yes... I'm sorry to have
bothered you...
fields.JP:
あ……はい。
疲れさせちゃって、すみません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yes... I'm sorry to have
bothered you...

fields.EN:
I'll do what I can to stop this
from occurring again, though my
only option now is force...
fields.JP:
ここの人間には、禁止を徹底しておくよ。
もっとも……ここの出入りを厳重にするほか
方法はないかもしれないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll do what I can to stop this
from occurring again, though my
only option now is force...

fields.EN:
I'll let everyone in the Dawn
know, too. I'll come back if there
are any updates.
fields.JP:
僕もみんなに話しておきます。
それじゃ……また来ます
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll let everyone in the Dawn
know, too. I'll come back if there
are any updates.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: Thank you for not suspecting us.
fields.JP: 僕たちを疑わないでくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you for not suspecting us.

fields.EN:
I just didn't think either of you
would ever lead them to do such a
thing.
fields.JP:
そんなことを命令する人たちには……
どうしても思えなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just didn't think either of you
would ever lead them to do such a
thing.

fields.EN:
My sister's dream was to save
everyone... Why are they throwing
away their lives like this?!
fields.JP:
……誰もが救われることが姉の夢なのに……
何故、自分から命を捨てようと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sister's dream was to save
everyone... Why are they throwing
away their lives like this?!

fields.JP: ちーちゃん。なかないで……？

fields.EN:
"Mimicry is a basic ability of the
Jail."
fields.JP:
『擬態はジェイルの基本的な特性の一つだと
考えられる』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Mimicry is a basic ability of the
Jail."

fields.EN:
"Proof of it can be seen in random
wall designs taken from the human
world."
fields.JP:
『その証拠に、ジェイルの壁面には、かつて
我々人間の世界を構築していた物の断片が、
整合性を持たず出鱈目に表出している』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Proof of it can be seen in random
wall designs taken from the human
world."

fields.EN:
This is way above what I can
understand...
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is way above what I can
understand...

fields.EN:
Looks like there are scribbles
related to some kind of research.
fields.JP: ある種の研究内容のメモね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like there are scribbles
related to some kind of research.

fields.EN: So... What is it trying to say?
fields.JP: それで……これ、どういう意味なんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So... What is it trying to say?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I guess it's just saying
that stuff before the Jail
appeared is all over the place.
fields.JP:
うーん。昔の世界の物が、そこらにデタラメに
あるってこと……かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I guess it's just saying
that stuff before the Jail
appeared is all over the place.

fields.EN:
Sounds legit! Nice use of your
brains there!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds legit! Nice use of your
brains there!

fields.EN:
So, I guess those huge eyes around
the place are things mimicked from
long ago.
fields.JP:
……ってことは、たまに見るでっかい目玉も、
昔の世界にあったものの擬態ってことかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I guess those huge eyes around
the place are things mimicked from
long ago.

fields.EN:
Ooh! That's what I was thinking,
too!
fields.JP: あ！　あたしもそれ、考えたんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! That's what I was thinking,
too!

fields.EN:
But, if that came from long ago,
does that mean the world back then
was just as strange as it is now?
fields.JP:
でも……昔の世界にあったものだとすると……
昔の世界も変な世界だったんでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, if that came from long ago,
does that mean the world back then
was just as strange as it is now?

fields.EN: What's it say?! Come on, show it!
fields.JP: 何が書いてあるの？　見せなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What's it say?! Come on, show it!

fields.EN:
"I appreciate Mother packing me
warm rations. If only she didn't
nag so much..."
fields.JP:
『お母さんの持たせてくれる携帯食料は保温が
考えられ有難いが、口煩いのは玉に瑕だ』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"I appreciate Mother packing me
warm rations. If only she didn't
nag so much..."

fields.EN:
"Just today, she scolded me about
how dangerous it was going on
expeditions with the team leader."
fields.JP:
……『今日は隊長と二人で探索に出るところを
発見され、危険だと叱られてしまった』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Just today, she scolded me about
how dangerous it was going on
expeditions with the team leader."

fields.JP: どう見ても愚痴ですね～

fields.EN:
I bet whoever's mother that was
must have been a real pain...
fields.JP:
お母さんって、よっぽど口煩い人だったん
ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet whoever's mother that was
must have been a real pain...

fields.EN:
I can relate, since I'm often
scolded and nagged as well...
fields.JP:
わらわなんか、叱られてばかりになる気が
します～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can relate, since I'm often
scolded and nagged as well...

fields.JP: あんた、自分のことよくわかってるじゃない

fields.EN:
I'm just a supporter of taking
things easy, so I'd rather not
partake in unnecessary action.
fields.JP:
わらわのサボりは主義なので、主義と主義の
仁義なき戦いになりそうだと言ったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just a supporter of taking
things easy, so I'd rather not
partake in unnecessary action.

fields.EN:
Hm... But judging by the memo, I
get the impression that whoever
this person is was pretty cute.
fields.JP:
でも……そうね。どちらかというと、これを
書いた人がとても可愛い人のような印象を
受けるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... But judging by the memo, I
get the impression that whoever
this person is was pretty cute.

fields.EN:
Yes. It doesn't really sound like
whining. More like something the
person wrote in passing.
fields.JP:
ええ……愚痴を吐き出してるというより、
日々あったことを仕事の合間に書いたような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It doesn't really sound like
whining. More like something the
person wrote in passing.

fields.EN:
Well, I guess... It does feel cute
and fuzzy.
fields.JP:
うん……そうだね。
何ていうか、あったかい気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess... It does feel cute
and fuzzy.

fields.EN:
True. I can tell how the person
respected and cared for their
mother.
fields.JP:
そうですね。この人のお母さんに対する優しい
気持ちのようなものを感じる気がします
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. I can tell how the person
respected and cared for their
mother.

fields.EN:
It also sounds like the person
actually enjoyed being nagged.
fields.JP:
そうですわね。叱られたことを楽しんでいる
ような感じがしますもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also sounds like the person
actually enjoyed being nagged.

fields.JP: なるほどね……それにしても

fields.EN:
In any case, whoever those two
were, they were courageous for
going out themselves.
fields.JP: 二人で探索なんて勇気あるわよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, whoever those two
were, they were courageous for
going out themselves.

fields.JP: それは、あたしも思った……

fields.EN:
But it's written like the person
was caught in a bit of mischief...
Must have been a nice person.
fields.JP:
でも……そんなことも悪戯が見つかっちゃった
みたいに言ってるの、確かに楽しい人だったん
だろうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's written like the person
was caught in a bit of mischief...
Must have been a nice person.

fields.EN:
Yup... That person's probably gone
already, but it would've been nice
to meet whoever it was...
fields.JP:
そうだね……もういない人なんだろうけど……
会ってみたかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... That person's probably gone
already, but it would've been nice
to meet whoever it was...

fields.EN:
(A memo... I wonder what it
says...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A memo... I wonder what it
says...)

fields.EN: Well... Let me read it out...
fields.JP: うん……とりあえず読むね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well... Let me read it out...

fields.EN:
"There was an unusual girl at the
orphanage. When I met her, she
spoke about the 'sun'."
fields.JP:
『孤児院の中に、不思議なことを話す少女が
いるという。覗きに行ったところ、彼女は見た
ことのない筈の太陽について熱心に語っていた』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"There was an unusual girl at the
orphanage. When I met her, she
spoke about the 'sun'."

fields.EN:
"I could tell she was a very
delicate person. It made me feel
like I should watch over her."
fields.JP:
……『直接彼女と話したかったが、とても繊細な
子のようだ。そっと見守ってやりたいと思う』
fields.LOCALIZED:
"I could tell she was a very
delicate person. It made me feel
like I should watch over her."

fields.EN:
The sun... Wait... Is this about
Michiru?!
fields.JP: 『太陽』って……これ、ミチルのこと！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sun... Wait... Is this about
Michiru?!

fields.EN:
Was Lady Oohime raised in an
orphanage?
fields.JP: 大陽女さんは、孤児院で育った人なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Was Lady Oohime raised in an
orphanage?

fields.EN:
Michiru-san is about the only person
you can associate the sun with, so
I'm pretty sure this is about her.
fields.JP:
太陽のお話をされる方なんて、ミチルさんくらい
のものですし……間違いない気はしますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru is about the only person
you can associate the sun with, so
I'm pretty sure this is about her.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
From what I know, no one in the
Dawn is aware of Michiru's past
before the Order.
fields.JP:
でも、あたしが覚えてる限りじゃ、黎明の人が
タイヨウ以前のミチルのことを知ってたって
話は聞かないなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From what I know, no one in the
Dawn is aware of Michiru's past
before the Order.

fields.EN:
It's possible that someone who
died in the incident 15 years ago
wrote it...
fields.JP:
ということは、これを書いたのは十五年前に
死んでしまった人たちの誰かなのかもしれない
ですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's possible that someone who
died in the incident 15 years ago
wrote it...

fields.EN:
I feel bad saying this with
everyone here, but... I can't seem
to get along with the Order...
fields.JP:
親指たちには悪いんだけど……
正直さ……あたし、ちょっとタイヨウって苦手
なんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel bad saying this with
everyone here, but... I can't seem
to get along with the Order...

fields.EN: There's nothing to feel bad about.
fields.JP: ……そんなの、別に気にしなくていいわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: There's nothing to feel bad about.

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん……それは、どうして？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why is that, Red Riding Hood?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Mmm... I dunno. I just think that,
you know, how can anyone save
someone saying stuff like that?
fields.JP:
んー。どうしてかな。
あんな夢みたいなことで、誰か救われんのかなー
って、思っちゃうんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I dunno. I just think that,
you know, how can anyone save
someone saying stuff like that?

fields.EN:
I said this to Dad, and then he
said...
fields.JP: でも、そう言ったら……お父さん、言ってたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said this to Dad, and then he
said...

fields.JP: 『神はどのような世界にも必要なものだよ』って

fields.EN:
Heh... I thought so, too. He also
said...
fields.JP:
あはは。あたしもそう思う。
あと、こんなことも言ってたかなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I thought so, too. He also
said...

fields.EN:
"A god is hope, a god is symbolic,
and a god is where one returns."
I have no clue what he meant.
fields.JP:
『神とは希望であり、象徴であり、あるいは還る
　場所でもある』って。……よくわかんないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
"A god is hope, a god is symbolic,
and a god is where one returns."
I have no clue what he meant.

fields.EN:
(What the...? I better ask someone
about it later...)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう、
　後で誰かに聞いてみようかな…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the...? I better ask someone
about it later...)

fields.EN:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.
fields.JP: 物資販売所では、アイテムを売買できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.

fields.EN:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.
fields.JP:
アイテムは物語の進行に応じて追加されるため、
時折り確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.

fields.EN:
You can accept work orders from
the people living in the Liberated
District at the Order's HQ.
fields.JP:
タイヨウ本部では、解放地区の人々からの
依頼を受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can accept work orders from
the people living in the Liberated
District at the Order's HQ.

fields.EN:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.
fields.JP:
依頼を達成すると報酬が得られるため、
積極的に受けてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.

fields.EN:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.
fields.JP:
依頼は物語の進行に応じて追加されるため、
時折り確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.
fields.JP:
研究室では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の能力を強化できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.

fields.EN:
You can also expand skill slots
and change jobs.
fields.JP:
『スキル枠拡張』では所持スキル数の増加、
『職業変更』では現在の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also expand skill slots
and change jobs.

fields.EN:
Lower then increase Blood Maidens'
levels once more with "Blood Devolution."
fields.JP:
『血式退化』では、血式少女のレベルを下げて
再び育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lower then increase Blood Maidens'
levels once more with "Blood Devolution."

fields.EN:
Use Blood Crystals to increase
the number of skill slots in
"Expand Skill Slots."
fields.JP:
スキル枠拡張では、『血晶』を使用して
所持するスキル数を増やすことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Blood Crystals to increase
the number of skill slots in
"Expand Skill Slots."

fields.EN:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.
fields.JP:
スキル枠を拡張したら、
メニューの『スキルセット』で忘れずに
スキルをセットしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.

fields.EN:
Use Job Rights and Blood Crystals
to change a Blood Maiden's job.
fields.JP:
職業変更では、『職業権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Job Rights and Blood Crystals
to change a Blood Maiden's job.

fields.EN:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the job chosen.
fields.JP:
職業を変更すると、レベルを保持したまま
職業に応じたステータスに変化します
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the job chosen.

fields.EN:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".
fields.JP:
また、その職業で習得可能なスキルが
新たに追加されるため、『スキルメイク』を
確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".

fields.EN:
You gain Job Rights each time you
raise the Blood Maiden's level to
a certain point.
fields.JP:
職業権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Job Rights each time you
raise the Blood Maiden's level to
a certain point.

fields.EN:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.
fields.JP:
血式退化では、『退化権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女のレベルを下げられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.

fields.EN:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.
fields.JP:
血式退化を行うと、
項目に書かれた数値分、レベルが下がります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.

fields.EN:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.
fields.JP:
また、下げたレベルに応じて、
ＣＰやステータス上昇ボーナスが得られます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.

fields.EN:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.
fields.JP:
血式退化することで、強さを底上げした状態で
血式少女を育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.

fields.EN:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.
fields.JP:
退化権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen gear at the
"Blood Weapon Factory" by using
Blood Crystals gained in battle.
fields.JP:
血式兵器製造所では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、装備品を強化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen gear at the
"Blood Weapon Factory" by using
Blood Crystals gained in battle.

fields.EN:
Your gear can be strengthened 9
times.
fields.JP: 装備品の強化は、最大９回まで行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your gear can be strengthened 9
times.

fields.EN:
You can purge a Blood Maiden's
Corruption using Jack's blood
through "Purge."
fields.JP:
浄化では、ジャックの血液を使用して、
血式少女に溜まった『穢れ』を浄化することが
できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can purge a Blood Maiden's
Corruption using Jack's blood
through "Purge."

fields.EN:
By purging, you gain resistance
to Corruption and bonuses to the
Blood Maiden's maximum HP or SP.
fields.JP:
浄化すると、『穢れ耐性』がアップするほか、
HPかSPの上限値にボーナスが付与されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By purging, you gain resistance
to Corruption and bonuses to the
Blood Maiden's maximum HP or SP.

fields.EN:
The effects of purging stay until
either the Blood Maiden is KO'd,
or you leave the dungeon.
fields.JP:
浄化の効果は、血式少女が戦闘不能になる、
もしくは次にダンジョンから帰還するまでの間
持続します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The effects of purging stay until
either the Blood Maiden is KO'd,
or you leave the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Use the Left Stick to move the
screen, and rub Jack's blood on
the Blood Maiden to purge.
fields.JP:
浄化は、左スティックで画面を動かし、
血式少女に振りかけたジャックの血液を
こすって体に塗りこむことで行います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the Left Stick to move the
screen, and rub Jack's blood on
the Blood Maiden to purge.

fields.EN:
The purge is successful if you
can rub all of the blood spots into
her body within a set amount of time.
fields.JP:
制限時間内に全て塗りこむことができれば、
浄化成功です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The purge is successful if you
can rub all of the blood spots into
her body within a set amount of time.

fields.EN:
Once successful, you can skip the
rubbing portion for that Blood
Maiden when conducting a purge.
fields.JP:
一度成功した血式少女は、次回から
行為を省略して浄化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once successful, you can skip the
rubbing portion for that Blood
Maiden when conducting a purge.

fields.EN:
You can use the skip feature for
the purging process on multiple
Blood Maidens to save time.
fields.JP:
省略浄化は、複数の血式少女にまとめて
行うこともできるので、活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can use the skip feature for
the purging process on multiple
Blood Maidens to save time.

fields.EN:
Free Purge is a mode where you
can conduct a purge without a
time limit.
fields.JP:
フリー浄化は、時間制限なしで
じっくり浄化できるフリーモードです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Free Purge is a mode where you
can conduct a purge without a
time limit.

fields.EN:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.
fields.JP:
ただし、成功しても
『穢れ耐性』アップなどの恩恵は得られません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.

fields.EN:
You can select "Work Orders",
"Affection Check", "Manage Storage",
"Library", or "Voice Select" from Jack's Room.
fields.JP:
ジャックの部屋では、
『依頼確認』『好感度チェック』『格納庫整理』
『ライブラリ』を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can select "Work Orders",
"Affection Check", "Manage Storage",
"Library", or "Voice Select" from Jack's Room.

fields.EN:
Access "Work Orders" to
confirm the work orders you've
accepted at the Order's HQ.
fields.JP:
『依頼確認』では、タイヨウ本部で受けた
依頼を確認することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Work Orders" to
confirm the work orders you've
accepted at the Order's HQ.

fields.EN:
Access "Affection Check" to see
the affection level between Jack
and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
『好感度チェック』では、ジャックに対する
血式少女の好感度を確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Affection Check" to see
the affection level between Jack
and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Access "Manage Storage" to store
and remove items from storage.
fields.JP:
『格納庫整理』では、
所持アイテムを格納庫に預けたり、
格納庫から取り出したりできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Manage Storage" to store
and remove items from storage.

fields.EN:
Access "Library" to view the Jail
Creature Manual, character
profiles, and the tutorial.
fields.JP:
『ライブラリ』では、ジェイル内生物の図鑑、
キャラクターのプロフィール、チュートリアルを
確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Library" to view the Jail
Creature Manual, character
profiles, and the tutorial.

fields.EN:
You can also view work orders, the Jail
Creature Manual, Profile, and the tutorial
from "Library" in the Main Menu screen.
fields.JP:
依頼、ジェイル内生物図鑑、プロフィール、
チュートリアルは、メニューにある
『ライブラリ』でも確認することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also view work orders, the Jail
Creature Manual, Profile, and the tutorial
from "Library" in the Main Menu screen.

fields.EN:
You can give "Surprise Items" to
any of the Blood Maidens in their
rooms.
fields.JP:
血式少女の部屋では、血式少女に
『サプライズアイテム』を渡すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can give "Surprise Items" to
any of the Blood Maidens in their
rooms.

fields.EN:
There are two types of surprise
items - gifts and interior items.
fields.JP:
サプライズアイテムには、
『プレゼント』と『インテリア』の２種類あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are two types of surprise
items - gifts and interior items.

fields.EN:
You can raise a Blood Maiden's
affection by giving them items
that they like.
fields.JP:
その血式少女の好みのアイテムを渡すことで、
好感度がアップします
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can raise a Blood Maiden's
affection by giving them items
that they like.

fields.EN:
Raising a Blood Maiden's affection
can trigger various events, and
can affect the ending as well.
fields.JP:
好感度を上げると様々なイベントが発生し、
エンディングにも影響を与えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Raising a Blood Maiden's affection
can trigger various events, and
can affect the ending as well.

fields.EN:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.
fields.JP:
また、インテリアは、
血式少女の部屋が実際に模様替えされます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.

fields.EN:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンには、宝箱や採取ポイントなど
アイテムを入手できる場所が存在するほか、
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.

fields.EN:
There are also various gimmicks,
such as levers to open portals,
and perilous traps.
fields.JP:
レバーで開く扉やダメージを受けるトラップなど、
さまざまなギミックが存在します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are also various gimmicks,
such as levers to open portals,
and perilous traps.

fields.EN:
Areas traversed are shown in the mini
map towards the left. Press the Left
Stick to swap the map size.
fields.JP:
歩いた場所の情報は、画面左の『ミニマップ』に
表示され、タッチパッドボタンを右クリックする
ことで、ミニマップのサイズ切り替えもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Areas traversed are shown in the mini
map towards the left. Press the Left
Stick to swap the map size.

fields.EN:
Press the Y Button then Down Button
to access the Detailed Map.
fields.JP: また、□ボタンで『詳細マップ』の確認もできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button then Down Button
to access the Detailed Map.

fields.EN:
You can access Auto-Pilot in the
Detailed Map by selecting the
location you wish to move to.
fields.JP:
詳細マップで開示済の場所を指定すると、
その場所まで自動で移動してくれる
オートパイロットを実行できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can access Auto-Pilot in the
Detailed Map by selecting the
location you wish to move to.

fields.EN:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.
fields.JP:
オートパイロットは階層をまたいで
使用可能なため、うまく活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.

fields.EN:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、イベントが起こるポイントや
アイテムが採取できるポイント、ヒントとなる
看板など、さまざまなアイコンがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.

fields.EN:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるアイコンを見極め、
スムーズに探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.

fields.EN:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン探索中に
メモの形をしたアイコンに触れると
戦闘が始まります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.

fields.EN:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.
fields.JP:
戦闘に勝利することで、
ダンジョンを進む際のヒントが書かれた
『メモ』を手に入れることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.

fields.EN:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."
fields.JP:
手に入れたメモは、アイテムの
『その他』のタブでいつでも確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."

fields.EN:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.
fields.JP:
ジェイルには、『食欲』『性欲』『睡眠欲』の
三つの欲求があり、満たしてやることで
さまざまな恩恵を受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.

fields.EN:
The desires' gauges are displayed
at the top-right corner, and
change as they are fulfilled.
fields.JP:
三つの欲求は画面右上に表示されており、
欲求が満たされると徐々にゲージが溜まって
いきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The desires' gauges are displayed
at the top-right corner, and
change as they are fulfilled.

fields.EN:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.
fields.JP:
『食欲』は、戦闘中に敵の弱点を突くなどして
『血しぶき』を発生させることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.

fields.EN:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.
fields.JP:
『性欲』は、ダンジョン内にある
宝箱や採取ポイント、エモーションポイントを
調べることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.

fields.EN:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.
fields.JP:
『睡眠欲』は、まれに発生するジェイルの
睡眠タイム中に、ダメージを受けずに
行動することで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.

fields.EN:
When any of the 3 desires reach
their limits, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.
fields.JP:
いずれかの欲求のゲージがＭＡＸになると
『ジェイルボーナス』が発生し、
ボーナス内容のルーレットが開始されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
When any of the 3 desires reach
their limits, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.

fields.EN:
You gain special benefits,
depending on the roulette's
results.
fields.JP:
ルーレットが止まった項目の内容によって、
さまざまな恩恵を受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain special benefits,
depending on the roulette's
results.

fields.EN:
The moon icon on the left of the
desires' gauges shows which will
be filled faster during that time.
fields.JP:
また、三大欲求の左にある月のアイコンは、
ジェイルが最も求めている欲求を表しており、
満たすことで多めにゲージが上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moon icon on the left of the
desires' gauges shows which will
be filled faster during that time.

fields.EN:
You can also use the Mary Gun inside
the dungeon, and switch to the Blood
Maidens' abilities with the Right Stick.
fields.JP:
『メアリガン』は、ダンジョン内でも
使用することができ、右スティックで
血式能力から切り替えることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also use the Mary Gun inside
the dungeon, and switch to the Blood
Maidens' abilities with the Right Stick.

fields.EN:
Jack can use the Mary Gun to
shoot his blood out in the
direction the party is facing.
fields.JP:
主人公の血液を消費することで
前方に血をかけることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack can use the Mary Gun to
shoot his blood out in the
direction the party is facing.

fields.EN:
Try shooting blood on various
objects or suspicious areas.
fields.JP:
色々なものに
血をかけてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try shooting blood on various
objects or suspicious areas.

fields.EN:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、
床の先に鎖が伸びている場所があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.

fields.EN:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to get across
to the other side.
fields.JP:
その鎖に乗ると、不安定な足場を進んでいく
『綱渡りギミック』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to get across
to the other side.

fields.EN:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.
fields.JP:
綱渡り中は自動で前進していきますが、
常に『右スティック』でバランスを取る必要が
あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.

fields.EN:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるバーの中心に
ポイントが来るように右スティックを傾けながら
進んでいきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.

fields.EN:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities the Blood Maidens can
use inside the dungeon.
fields.JP:
『血式能力』は、血式少女がダンジョン内で
発動できる特殊能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities the Blood Maidens can
use inside the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Toggle through abilities with the
Right Stick, and activate them
with the B Button.
fields.JP:
使用できる能力は画面左下に表示されており、
右スティックの左右で切り替え、×ボタンで
発動できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toggle through abilities with the
Right Stick, and activate them
with the B Button.

fields.EN:
Note that you will use SP when
activating each Blood Ability.
fields.JP: また、能力の発動にはＳＰを消費します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you will use SP when
activating each Blood Ability.

fields.EN:
Some dungeons require certain
Blood Abilities in order to clear
the area.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンを進むために『必須な能力』も
ありますので、探索に行き詰ったら
能力を見直してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some dungeons require certain
Blood Abilities in order to clear
the area.

fields.EN:
Alice's Blood Ability, "Wonder Hole," creates a point
where you can save and escape from the dungeon.
fields.JP:
アリスの血式能力【ワンダーホール】は、
「セーブ」「ダンジョンからの脱出」ができる
ポイントを設置する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice uses "Rabbit Hole." This
creates a save point and an
escape route out of the dungeon.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ワンダーホール → Wonder Hole; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Save points in dungeons can only be placed in
certain locations, so use Wonder Hole saves
to help you progress through your exploration.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内のセーブポイントは配置場所が
限られているため、ワンダーホールでのセーブを
活用して探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can only set save points in
certain areas, so create save
points as you find them.

fields.EN:
Placing a new Wonder Hole automatically removes
the one you placed previously.
fields.JP:
新たなワンダーホールを設置すると、
以前に設置したものは自動的に消滅します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that setting a new Rabbit
Hole will erase any previous
Rabbit Hole that was set.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ワンダーホール → Wonder Hole; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Akazukin can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの血式能力【ボディニッパー】は、
様々なものを切ることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.
fields.JP:
切れそうな対象の前でボディニッパーを使うと、
新しい道が開けたり、アイテムを入手できたり
します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.

fields.EN:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.
fields.JP:
探索に行き詰った場合には、
ボディニッパーで切れる場所を探してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.
fields.JP:
白雪姫の血式能力【ポイズンボム】は、
時限式の毒爆弾を設置することで、
爆発を発生させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.

fields.EN:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to rot vegetation that
might be in the way.
fields.JP:
壊せそうな壁を吹き飛ばすだけでなく、
行く手をふさぐ植物を腐らせることもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to rot vegetation that
might be in the way.

fields.EN:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.
fields.JP:
ただし、爆発時に近くにいると、
自分達もダメージや毒を受けてしまうため
注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.
fields.JP:
眠り姫の血式能力【ローズアロー】は、
前方７マス先に向かって、
イバラの矢を放つことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.
fields.JP:
行けない場所にあるスイッチを押したり、
遠くから何かを狙わなければならない場合
などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.
fields.JP:
親指姫の血式能力【プチプリンセス】は、
所持している特定のアイテムを小さくする
ことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.

fields.EN:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.
fields.JP:
何かを小さくする必要があったり、
小さくすることで便利になりそうなアイテムが
ある場合に発動してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.

fields.EN:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.
fields.JP:
また、小さくしたアイテムは、
元の大きさに戻すことも可能です
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.

fields.EN:
Note that you can't un-shrink
consumable items.
fields.JP:
ただし、消費アイテムは一度小さくすると
元には戻りません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you can't un-shrink
consumable items.

fields.EN:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.
fields.JP:
シンデレラの血式能力【１２ダッシュ】は、
１２秒間、自分達の移動速度を上げることが
できる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.

fields.EN:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.
fields.JP:
急ぐ必要がある場合や、普段のスピードでは
通れない場所がある場合に試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.

fields.EN:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただし、壁や物にぶつかってしまうと、
少しの間動けなくなるため注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫の血式能力【タケプロテクター】は、
１０秒間だけ、あらゆるトラップのダメージを
無効化する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.

fields.EN:
You can also nullify one attack
from a Nightmare during "Chase."
fields.JP:
また、『虐殺鬼ごっこ』中に、ナイトメアからの
攻撃を一度だけ無効化することもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also nullify one attack
from a Nightmare during "Chase."

fields.EN:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ダメージを受けずに進みたい場合や
ナイトメアから逃げ切りたい場合などに
能力を活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's Blood Ability, "Hair!," extends her hair
4 squares ahead and lets her grab objects.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの血式能力【ヘアー】は、
前方４マス先に向かって髪を伸ばし、
物をつかむことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel uses "Hair Flair." This
lets you reach items 5 squares in
the direction you're facing.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ヘアー/ヘアー！ → Hair!; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, or when you need to
grab a hold of something.
fields.JP:
手が届かない場所にある宝箱を開けたり、
何かにつかまったりしなければならない場合
などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, or when you need to
grab a hold of something.

fields.EN:
Gretel's Blood Ability, "Bread Portal," lets her throw
breadcrumbs 3 squares ahead and use them to warp.
fields.JP:
グレーテルの血式能力【ブレッドポータル】は、
前方３マス先に向かってパンくずを投げ、
それを利用してワープする能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel uses "Bread Portal." This
creates a warp point 3 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.
fields.JP:
能力を発動してパンくずを投げた後、
もう一度能力を発動することで
パンくずの場所にワープできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.

fields.EN:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.
fields.JP:
歩きでは行けない場所に
渡りたい場合などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.

fields.EN:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの血式能力【磁力ピッコロ】は、
笛の音色で磁力を発生させ、
物を引き寄せることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.

fields.EN:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 7 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.
fields.JP:
正面の３列、距離７マスに効果があります。
引き寄せられそうな物を見つけた場合に
試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 7 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.

fields.EN:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.
fields.JP:
放浪商人は、ダンジョン探索中に
希に出会う、怪しい商人です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.

fields.EN:
The merchant sells rare items that
can't normally be purchased at the
store.
fields.JP:
購入できる品々は、物資販売所では買えない
装備品やめずらしいアイテムばかりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The merchant sells rare items that
can't normally be purchased at the
store.

fields.EN:
Win battles by defeating all
enemies. The battle ends if
everyone in your party is KO'd.
fields.JP:
戦闘では、全ての敵を倒すと勝利、
パーティメンバー全員が戦闘不能になると
ゲームオーバーになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win battles by defeating all
enemies. The battle ends if
everyone in your party is KO'd.

fields.EN:
The turn order is determined by
the character's agility, from
highest to lowest.
fields.JP:
戦闘が始まると、全キャラクターで
ＡＧＩの高い順に行動がまわってきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The turn order is determined by
the character's agility, from
highest to lowest.

fields.EN:
Jack has 3 special commands: Wait,
Guard, and Item.
fields.JP:
主人公には、
『待機』『守る』『アイテム』の
専用コマンドがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack has 3 special commands: Wait,
Guard, and Item.

fields.EN: "Guard" lets you protect one selected Blood Maiden once before your next turn. The protected Blood Maiden takes no damage.
fields.JP:
『守る』は、次の行動順までに一度だけ、
指定した血式少女を守ることができます。
守られた血式少女はダメージを受けません
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Guard" allows you to select one
Blood Maiden to guard. If it
works, she won't take any damage.

fields.EN:
There is a chance that Jack will
be stunned, preventing him from
acting for a number of turns.
fields.JP:
ただし、その代償として、
高確率で主人公が『気絶』してしまい、
数回行動できなくなってしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is a chance that Jack will
be stunned, preventing him from
acting for a number of turns.

fields.EN:
If Jack is stunned several times, he will be KO'd
and unable to act for the rest of that battle,
so be careful.
fields.JP:
さらに、何度か気絶すると『戦闘不能』となり、
その戦闘中は一切行動できなくなってしまうため
注意が必要です
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is also a chance Jack will
be KO'd.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
"Wait" skips Jack's turn, and
"Escape" gives the party a
chance to run from battle.
fields.JP:
『待機』は順番のパス、
『アイテム』はアイテムの使用、
『逃げる』は逃走を試みるコマンドです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Wait" skips Jack's turn, and
"Escape" gives the party a
chance to run from battle.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.
fields.JP:
血式少女には、
『攻撃』『スキル』『防御』『逃げる』の
コマンドがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.

fields.EN:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.
fields.JP:
『攻撃』は通常攻撃、
『スキル』はＳＰを使用した特殊攻撃
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.

fields.EN:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" allows you
the chance to run from battle.
fields.JP:
『防御』は敵からのダメージ軽減、
『逃げる』は逃走を試みるコマンドです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" allows you
the chance to run from battle.

fields.EN:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.
fields.JP:
敵を全て倒して勝利すると、
『経験値』や『血晶』が手に入るほか、
アイテムや武器が手に入ることもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.

fields.EN:
One of the most basic things to
remember during battle is to
attack enemy weak points.
fields.JP:
戦闘の基本要素に
『属性攻撃で敵の弱点を突く』という
テクニックがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
One of the most basic things to
remember during battle is to
attack enemy weak points.

fields.EN:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Air > Earth > Water > Fire
fields.JP:
属性は火、風、土、水の４種類あり、
『火は風に強い』『風は土に強い』
『土は水に強い』『水は火に強い』関係です
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Air > Earth > Water > Fire

fields.EN:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."
fields.JP:
敵を弱点属性で攻撃すると、
大きなダメージを与えられるだけでなく、
『血しぶき』を発生させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."

fields.EN:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生すると、
血式少女の『返り血アイコン』が少しずつ
満たされていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.

fields.EN:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Genocide" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンがＭＡＸになると、次の行動順に
強力な『ジェノサイドモード』に変身します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Massacre" mode.

fields.EN:
During Genocide mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードでは、ステータスが上昇し、
強力な専用スキルも使用できるため、
積極的に狙っていきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
During Massacre mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.

fields.EN:
They will exit Genocide mode after
a set amount of turns.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードは、
数回行動すると解除されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
They will exit Massacre mode after
a set amount of turns.

fields.EN:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."
fields.JP:
血しぶきは、
大ダメージを与えて倒す『オーバーキル』や
『クリティカル』などでも発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."

fields.EN:
You can "Lick" a Blood Maiden when
their Blood Splatter icon is
filled.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生し、血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』が溜まっている場合に、
それを『舐める』ことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can "Lick" a Blood Maiden when
their Blood Splatter icon is
filled.

fields.EN:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."
fields.JP:
『誰の血を舐めるのか』を選択することで、
その血式少女の『魂血スキル』が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."

fields.EN:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.
fields.JP:
『魂血スキル』は、
基本的に補助回復系の癒しの技です
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.
fields.JP:
血を舐められた血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』は、０に戻ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.

fields.EN:
Use Genocide mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.
fields.JP:
『ジェノサイドモード』で強くなるか、
『魂血スキル』で体勢を立て直すか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Massacre mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.

fields.EN:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.
fields.JP:
血しぶきを戦況によってどう使い分けるかが
戦闘の鍵を握っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.

fields.EN:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.
fields.JP:
血式少女は、パーティメンバーの戦闘不能、
大ダメージを受けるなど、心が乱れることで
『穢れ』が溜まっていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.

fields.EN:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.
fields.JP:
『穢れ』が溜まると、
返り血アイコンが次第に『濁った色』へと
変化していきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.

fields.EN:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンが濁った状態でＭＡＸになると、
暴走状態である『ブラッドスケルターモード』に
変身してしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードの血式少女は、
敵・味方の見境なく攻撃を行います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter mode ceases when the
Maiden is KO'd, when the battle
ends, or by using the Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードは、
『メアリガン』『戦闘終了』『戦闘不能』
でしか解けることはありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter mode ceases when the
Maiden is KO'd, when the battle
ends, or by using the Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
The murkier the Blood Splatter
icon, the greater your chances of
entering Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンの濁りが濃いほど
ブラッドスケルターモードになる可能性が
高いため、アイコンの状態には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The murkier the Blood Splatter
icon, the greater your chances of
entering Blood Skelter mode.

fields.EN:
Jack can use the Mary Gun to
conduct Purge or Life Purge.
fields.JP:
主人公の専用コマンド『メアリガン』では、
主人公の血液を使用して、
『浄化』と『命がけ浄化』ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack can use the Mary Gun to
conduct Purge or Life Purge.

fields.EN:
Using Purge will allow Jack to
remove the murkiness of a Blood
Maiden's Blood Splatter icon.
fields.JP:
『浄化』では、選んだ血式少女の
返り血アイコンの濁りを消すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using Purge will allow Jack to
remove the murkiness of a Blood
Maiden's Blood Splatter icon.

fields.EN:
Using Life Purge will allow Jack
to take a Blood Maiden out of
Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
『命がけ浄化』では、
『ブラッドスケルターモード』になってしまった
血式少女の状態を元に戻すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using Life Purge will allow Jack
to take a Blood Maiden out of
Blood Skelter mode.

fields.EN:
Note that using the Mary Gun
while your remaining blood is low
may stun Jack.
fields.JP:
ただし、『血液残量』が少ない状態で
メアリガンを使用すると、『気絶』してしまう
場合があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that using the Mary Gun
while your remaining blood is low
may stun Jack.

fields.EN:
The lower the blood amount, the
more easily he can be stunned, so
recover by using "Create Blood."
fields.JP:
血液残量が少ないほど気絶しやすいため、
『造血』で主人公の血液残量を回復しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The lower the blood amount, the
more easily he can be stunned, so
recover by using "Create Blood."

fields.EN:
Also note that the maximum amount
of blood is increased as Jack
levels up.
fields.JP:
また、血液残量の最大値は、
主人公のレベルが上がることでアップします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also note that the maximum amount
of blood is increased as Jack
levels up.

fields.EN:
Use Jack's blood wisely by
balancing the Blood Maiden's state
with Jack's remaining blood.
fields.JP:
血式少女の返り血アイコンの状態と、
主人公の血液残量のバランスを見極めながら
メアリガンを使用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Jack's blood wisely by
balancing the Blood Maiden's state
with Jack's remaining blood.

fields.EN:
Press the Y Button when selecting
your command to use Auto-Battle.
fields.JP:
コマンド選択時に□ボタンを押すと、
オート戦闘をおこなうことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button when selecting
your command to use Auto-Battle.

fields.EN:
Press the Left Stick to toggle
between the Auto-Battle
types available.
fields.JP:
タッチパッドボタンの右クリックで、
オート戦闘のタイプを切り替えられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Left Stick to toggle
between the Auto-Battle
types available.

fields.EN:
Holding the R Button during
battle effects lets you skip the
effect to make the battles faster.
fields.JP:
また、戦闘演出中にＲ１ボタンを押し続けている間は、
戦闘演出をスキップして高速戦闘ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Holding the R Button during
battle effects lets you skip the
effect to make the battles faster.

fields.EN:
These help to expedite battles,
but be careful using them when
facing powerful enemies.
fields.JP:
とても便利な機能ですが、
強敵との戦闘で使用する際には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These help to expedite battles,
but be careful using them when
facing powerful enemies.

fields.EN: There are various effects in battle, such as Poison, Paralysis, stat boosts, and more.
fields.JP:
戦闘では、毒、麻痺やステータスＵＰなど、
さまざまな状態効果が存在します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are various effects that can
be used in battle, such as Poison,
Stun, stat boosts, and more.

fields.EN:
Each effect is displayed in the
Blood Maiden's stat window, so
keep an eye on what's in effect.
fields.JP:
効果は各血式少女のステータスウィンドウに
表示されるため、状態効果アイコンを
意識しながら戦闘を行いましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each effect is displayed in the
Blood Maiden's stat window, so
keep an eye on what's in effect.

fields.EN:
There are invincible creatures
called "Nightmares" in each
dungeon protecting the area.
fields.JP:
各ダンジョンには、『ナイトメア』と呼ばれる
無敵の看守が徘徊しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are invincible creatures
called "Nightmares" in each
dungeon protecting the area.

fields.EN:
Nightmares bring darkness with
them, so if the dungeon becomes
dark, be careful!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは暗闇をまとっているため、
ダンジョン探索中に周囲が暗くなってきたら
警戒が必要です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmares bring darkness with
them, so if the dungeon becomes
dark, be careful!

fields.EN:
If you encounter a Nightmare,
"Chase" will begin.
fields.JP:
もし暗闇の中でナイトメアに遭遇してしまうと、
恐怖の『虐殺鬼ごっこ』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter a Nightmare,
"Chase" will begin.

fields.EN:
Once Chase begins, the Nightmare
will chase the party until
everyone dies.
fields.JP:
虐殺鬼ごっこが発生すると、
ナイトメアは『プレイヤーが全滅』するまで
どこまでも追いかけてきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once Chase begins, the Nightmare
will chase the party until
everyone dies.

fields.EN:
If you can run far away from the
Nightmare, the chase will end,
and things will go back to normal.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアを引き離すことができれば
『逃亡成功』となり、通常の探索に戻ることが
できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can run far away from the
Nightmare, the chase will end,
and things will go back to normal.

fields.EN:
If you encounter Marchens during
a Chase, a special battle will
occur.
fields.JP:
また、虐殺鬼ごっこ中にメルヒェンに出会うと、
『ブッキングバトル』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter Marchens during
a Chase, a special battle will
occur.

fields.EN: You cannot move until you defeat the Marchens, and the Nightmare will keep attacking you, so defeat the Marchens quickly.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンを倒すまで移動できず、
ナイトメアからも攻撃を受けてしまうため、
速やかにメルヒェンを倒しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare will attack while
you're fighting the Marchens, so
defeat them as fast as you can.

fields.EN:
Note that the Blood Splatter that
occurs in battle may splatter the
blood onto the dungeon, too.
fields.JP:
戦闘中に発生する『血しぶき』は、
血式少女だけでなくダンジョンにも付着します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that the Blood Splatter that
occurs in battle may splatter the
blood onto the dungeon, too.

fields.EN:
The blood splatter will light the
area, so it helps to cause blood
splatters whenever possible.
fields.JP:
血しぶきは暗闇を照らす道しるべとなるため、
普段から発生を狙っていくのも効果的です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The blood splatter will light the
area, so it helps to cause blood
splatters whenever possible.

fields.EN:
If the Nightmare catches up to you
during a Chase, you may need to
face it in battle.
fields.JP:
鬼ごっこ中にナイトメアに追い詰められると、
戦って切り抜けるしかなくなる場合があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Nightmare catches up to you
during a Chase, you may need to
face it in battle.

fields.EN:
Press the A Button while standing
next to the Nightmare to enter
battle.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアに隣接して○ボタンを押すと、
戦闘に突入します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the A Button while standing
next to the Nightmare to enter
battle.

fields.EN:
You can knock down a Nightmare by
destroying its parts.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは、部位を破壊することができると
『ノックダウン』状態になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can knock down a Nightmare by
destroying its parts.

fields.EN:
While the Nightmare is knocked
down, you can select "Move" to
end the battle and escape from it.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアのノックダウン中に
『移動する』コマンドを選ぶと、戦闘が終了し、
ナイトメアを乗り越えて逃げることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
While the Nightmare is knocked
down, you can select "Move" to
end the battle and escape from it.

fields.EN:
Destroying "cores" in the dungeon
allows you to defeat Nightmares
in that dungeon.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内にある『核』を破壊すると、
ナイトメアの討伐が可能になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Destroying "cores" in the dungeon
allows you to defeat Nightmares
in that dungeon.

fields.EN:
If you encounter a Nightmare after
you destroy a core, you will enter
battle to defeat the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
核の破壊後にナイトメアと遭遇すると、
ナイトメアを倒すための『討伐戦』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter a Nightmare after
you destroy a core, you will enter
battle to defeat the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
You won't be able to escape from
this battle, so be sure you're
well-prepared.
fields.JP:
討伐戦では、ナイトメアから逃げることは
できないため、あらゆる手段を駆使して
勝利をつかみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You won't be able to escape from
this battle, so be sure you're
well-prepared.

fields.EN:
There are giant Nightmares that
you won't encounter in the dungeon
using a special battle map.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアの中にはフロア内で
遭遇せずに、専用マップで戦闘を
行う【巨大ナイトメア】が存在します。
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are giant Nightmares that
you won't encounter in the dungeon
using a special battle map.

fields.EN:
Maps are separated into floors,
and each floor allows you to
destroy parts of the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
マップはいくつかのフロアに分かれており
各フロアで一部位づつナイトメアを
攻撃していきます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maps are separated into floors,
and each floor allows you to
destroy parts of the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Defeating these parts may drop
crystals, which can be used
against them.
fields.JP:
部位を破壊すると、
結晶が出現することがあります。
それが弱点となります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Defeating these parts may drop
crystals, which can be used
against them.

fields.EN:
You can also find various
gimmicks, so utilize gimmicks to
gain an advantage in battle.
fields.JP:
専用マップには特殊なギミックがあります。
ギミックを作動させると、
バトルを有利に進めることができます。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also find various
gimmicks, so utilize gimmicks to
gain an advantage in battle.

fields.EN:
You can view important information
and adjust settings through the
menu.
fields.JP:
メニューでは、様々な情報を確認したり、
設定したりすることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view important information
and adjust settings through the
menu.

fields.EN:
"Items," "Skills," and "Equipment"
allow you to view details of each
and use them as needed.
fields.JP:
『アイテム』では各種アイテムの使用、
『スキル』ではスキルの使用や確認、
『装備』では装備の変更が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Items," "Skills," and "Equipment"
allow you to view details of each
and use them as needed.

fields.EN:
"Customize Skills" lets you set
new Skills and Blood Abilities.
fields.JP:
『スキルカスタム』では、
新たなスキルの習得やセットができるほか、
血式能力の設定もできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Customize Skills" lets you set
new Skills and Blood Abilities.

fields.EN:
Customizing skills is important
in strengthening a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
血式少女の強化をおこなうための
最重要項目のため、忘れずに利用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customizing skills is important
in strengthening a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
"Formation" lets you set party
members and partners.
fields.JP:
『編成』では、パーティメンバーの設定や
戦闘のサポートメンバーの設定が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Formation" lets you set party
members and partners.

fields.EN: "Status" lets you check each Blood Maiden's abilities. "Library" lets you review accepted requests, enemy information, tutorials, and more.
fields.JP:
『ステータス』では血式少女の能力の確認、
『ライブラリ』では、受注した依頼や敵の情報、
チュートリアルなどを確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Library" lets you view work
orders, enemy details, and the
tutorial.

fields.EN:
"System" lets you save and load
data, change settings, and return
to the title screen.
fields.JP:
『システム』では、
データのセーブやロード、環境設定ができる
ほか、タイトル画面に戻ることもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"System" lets you save and load
data, change settings, and return
to the title screen.

fields.EN:
There are 5 categories of items:
Item, Equipment, Surprise Items,
Blood Crystals, and Others.
fields.JP:
アイテムには、『道具』『装備』
『サプライズアイテム』『血晶』『その他』の
５つのカテゴリーがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 5 categories of items:
Item, Equipment, Surprise Items,
Blood Crystals, and Others.

fields.EN:
"Item" lets you use items,
"Equipment" lets you access a
Blood Maiden's gear.
fields.JP:
『道具』は探索に役立つアイテム、
『装備』は血式少女の装備品です
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Item" lets you use items,
"Equipment" lets you access a
Blood Maiden's gear.

fields.EN:
"Surprise Items" lets you give
items to the Blood Maidens to
increase their affection for you.
fields.JP:
『サプライズアイテム』は、
血式少女に渡すことで親密度をアップできる
アイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Surprise Items" lets you give
items to the Blood Maidens to
increase their affection for you.

fields.EN:
"Blood Crystals" are needed to
change a Blood Maiden's job,
strengthen gear, and more.
fields.JP:
『血晶』は、血式少女の職業変更や
装備品の強化などに必要なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Crystals" are needed to
change a Blood Maiden's job,
strengthen gear, and more.

fields.EN:
"Others" contains items that are
necessary in order to progress
through the game.
fields.JP:
『その他』は、物語を進めていく上で
重要なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Others" contains items that are
necessary in order to progress
through the game.

fields.EN:
The max number of item types you
can hold in "Item," "Equipment,"
and "Surprise Items" is 9,999.
fields.JP:
アイテムの所持数の限界は、
『道具』『装備』『サプライズアイテム』を
あわせて９９種類までです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The max number of item types you
can hold in "Item," "Equipment,"
and "Surprise Items" is 9,999.

fields.EN:
If you have more than 9,999 item
types, store any excess in Jack's
room using "Manage Storage."
fields.JP:
もし９９種類を超えてしまう場合には、
ジャックの部屋にある『格納庫』にアイテムを
保管しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have more than 9,999 item
types, store any excess in Jack's
room using "Manage Storage."

fields.EN:
Under the Equipment menu there
are 4 types of gear: Weapons, Head
Gear, Body Armor, and Accessories.
fields.JP:
メニューの装備では、
『武器』『頭の防具』『体の防具』『装飾品』の
４種類を血式少女に装備させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Under the Equipment menu there
are 4 types of gear: Weapons, Head
Gear, Body Armor, and Accessories.

fields.EN:
Some equipment can only be used
by certain jobs.
fields.JP:
装備品には、血式少女の職業によって
装備できるものとできないものがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some equipment can only be used
by certain jobs.

fields.EN:
Jobs that can't use any particular
equipment can't be selected.
fields.JP:
その職業では装備できない装備品は、
選択することができません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jobs that can't use any particular
equipment can't be selected.

fields.EN:
You can obtain equipment from
battle rewards, treasure, and from
the Wandering Merchant.
fields.JP:
装備品は、宝箱や戦闘の報酬で手に入るほか、
放浪商人から購入することもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can obtain equipment from
battle rewards, treasure, and from
the Wandering Merchant.

fields.EN:
You can set the skills to be used
by the Blood Maidens through
"Skill Set."
fields.JP:
スキルセットでは、血式少女が使用する
スキルをセットすることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can set the skills to be used
by the Blood Maidens through
"Skill Set."

fields.EN:
Be sure you set the skills you
learn through "Skill Creation."
fields.JP:
『スキルメイク』で新たなスキルを習得したら
必ずセットするようにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure you set the skills you
learn through "Skill Creation."

fields.EN:
Toggle the job you want to set
a skill to by selecting a skill
slot and pressing the X Button.
fields.JP:
セットしたい『スキル枠』を選択した状態で
△ボタンを押すと、職業を切り替えることが
できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toggle the job you want to set
a skill to by selecting a skill
slot and pressing the X Button.

fields.EN:
Customize your very own set of
skills by combining the skills you
learn from the jobs available.
fields.JP:
さまざまな職業で習得したスキルを
自由に組み合わせてカスタマイズしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customize your very own set of
skills by combining the skills you
learn from the jobs available.

fields.EN:
You can learn new skills for the
Blood Maidens to use through the
"Skill Creation" menu.
fields.JP:
スキルメイクでは、血式少女に
『新たなスキル』を習得させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can learn new skills for the
Blood Maidens to use through the
"Skill Creation" menu.

fields.EN:
To learn skills, you will need a
set amount of "CP," which can be
gained through leveling up.
fields.JP:
スキルの習得には、
レベルアップで得られる『ＣＰ』を使用します
fields.LOCALIZED:
To learn skills, you will need a
set amount of "CP," which can be
gained through leveling up.

fields.EN:
You can only use skills that are
preset, so be sure to set them
prior to use.
fields.JP:
習得したスキルは『スキルセット』で
セットしないと使用できないため、
必ずセットするようにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can only use skills that are
preset, so be sure to set them
prior to use.

fields.EN:
You can change the order of Blood
Abilities when checking Blood
Ability slots.
fields.JP:
血式能力スロットでは、
『血式能力』の並び替えができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can change the order of Blood
Abilities when checking Blood
Ability slots.

fields.EN:
Customize the order to your
liking, such as ordering them by
frequency of use.
fields.JP:
使う頻度の高い能力を並べるなど、
自分好みにカスタマイズしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customize the order to your
liking, such as ordering them by
frequency of use.

fields.EN:
You can select "Party Formation"
or "Partner" through the
"Formation" menu.
fields.JP:
編成では、『パーティ編成』と
『コンビネーション』の設定ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can select "Party Formation"
or "Partner" through the
"Formation" menu.

fields.EN:
"Party Formation" lets you change
and shift members within your
party.
fields.JP:
『パーティ編成』では、
パーティメンバーの追加や除外を行えるほか、
メンバー同士の配置入れ替えもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Party Formation" lets you change
and shift members within your
party.

fields.EN:
You can also press the Y Button
to toggle allies on the front and 
rear lines.
fields.JP:
また、□ボタンで
前衛、後衛を切り替えることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also press the Y Button
to toggle allies on the front and 
rear lines.

fields.EN:
Those in the front deal and
receive full physical damage to
and from enemies.
fields.JP:
前衛は物理攻撃が１００％の威力を発揮しますが、
敵からの物理ダメージも１００％受けます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the front deal and
receive full physical damage to
and from enemies.

fields.EN:
Those in the rear deal and receive
half the physical damage to and
from enemies.
fields.JP:
後衛は物理攻撃の威力が半減する反面、
敵からの物理ダメージを半分に抑えられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the rear deal and receive
half the physical damage to and
from enemies.

fields.EN:
Depending on the weapon type,
those in the rear may be able to
deal full damage to enemies.
fields.JP:
武器の種類によっては後衛からでも１００％の
ダメージを発揮することができるものもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Depending on the weapon type,
those in the rear may be able to
deal full damage to enemies.

fields.EN:
"Partner" lets you assign Blood
Maidens to support members in
the party.
fields.JP:
『コンビネーション』では、
それぞれのパーティメンバーに
サポートの血式少女を設定できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Partner" lets you assign Blood
Maidens to support members in
the party.

fields.EN:
Assigned Blood Maidens offer
support through attacking enemies
or healing their partners.
fields.JP:
サポートメンバーに設定した血式少女は、
戦闘中に攻撃や回復の補助をしてくれます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Assigned Blood Maidens offer
support through attacking enemies
or healing their partners.

fields.EN:
Be sure to assign partners once
you have enough Blood Maidens in
your party.
fields.JP:
血式少女が増えてきたら、
コンビを組ませて戦闘を有利に進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to assign partners once
you have enough Blood Maidens in
your party.

fields.EN:
You may discover "torn novel
pages" during your dungeon
expedition.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンの探索中に、
『ノベルの切れ端』を発見することがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may discover "torn novel
pages" during your dungeon
expedition.

fields.EN:
They unlock the novel version of
the story, found through the title
screen under "Bonus" > "Novel."
fields.JP:
『ノベルの切れ端』を手に入れると、
タイトル画面の『ＢＯＮＵＳ』内『ＮＯＶＥＬ』から
ノベル版の物語を読むことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
They unlock the novel version of
the story, found through the title
screen under "Bonus" > "Novel."

fields.EN:
The novel version of "Mary
Skelter: Nightmares" takes place
from another character's POV.
fields.JP:
ノベル版の
【神獄塔 メアリスケルター～光の在処～】では
同じ時間軸、別主人公の冒険譚が描かれています
fields.LOCALIZED:
The novel version of "Mary
Skelter: Nightmares" takes place
from another character's POV.

fields.EN:
The novel unfolds as you find the
torn pages, allowing you to read
it to the end of the prologue.
fields.JP:
読める範囲は『ノベルの切れ端』を入手する
ごとに広がり、最終的に序章の最後まで
読めるようになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The novel unfolds as you find the
torn pages, allowing you to read
it to the end of the prologue.

fields.JP:
ＢＯＮＵＳでは、
『ノベル』『ギャラリー』『ミュージック』
『キャラクター』『イベント』の鑑賞ができます

fields.EN:
You can read the prologue to the
novel version of "Mary Skelter:
Nightmares" under "Novel."
fields.JP:
『ノベル』では、ノベル版
【神獄塔 メアリスケルター～光の在処～】の
序章を読むことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can read the prologue to the
novel version of "Mary Skelter:
Nightmares" under "Novel."

fields.EN:
You can watch movies and view CGs
in the "Gallery," and listen to
BGM through "Music."
fields.JP:
『ギャラリー』では、ムービーやＣＧなどの閲覧、
『ミュージック』では、ＢＧＭの試聴ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can watch movies and view CGs
in the "Gallery," and listen to
BGM through "Music."

fields.EN:
You can view character
illustrations under "Characters."
fields.JP:
『キャラクター』では、キャラクターのイラストを
鑑賞することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view character
illustrations under "Characters."

fields.EN:
You can view various heroine
events under "Heroine Memories."
fields.JP:
『ヒロインメモリーズ』では、
ヒロインとの思い出を回想できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view various heroine
events under "Heroine Memories."

fields.EN:
All areas are connected to other
areas.
fields.JP: 全てのエリアは、地続きに繋がっています
fields.LOCALIZED:
All areas are connected to other
areas.

fields.EN:
For example, the City Streets are
connected to the Graveyard and
the Temple.
fields.JP:
例えば元街道沿いエリアは、
「元墓所エリア」「旧寺院エリア」に繋がっており
ダンジョン内のどこかから行くことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, the City Streets are
connected to the Graveyard and
the Temple.

fields.EN:
Check for "sign" icons within the
dungeon to see how you can get
from one area to another.
fields.JP:
どこから新たなエリア行けるのかは、
ダンジョン内の「看板」アイコンで確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Check for "sign" icons within the
dungeon to see how you can get
from one area to another.

fields.EN:
Any areas you've already reached
can be directly accessed from the
map.
fields.JP:
また、一度たどり着いたエリアは、
全体マップから直接移動できるようになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Any areas you've already reached
can be directly accessed from the
map.

fields.EN:
(A large piece of fabric?
I've seen this before...)
fields.JP:
（大きな布？
　なんでだろう、どこかで見たことがあるような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A large piece of fabric?
I've seen this before...)

fields.EN:
(It's not unusual, but...
I guess I can hold onto it.)
fields.JP:
（珍しいものでもないんだけど、
　ひとまず拾っておこうかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's not unusual, but...
I guess I can hold onto it.)

fields.JP: 『テーブルクロス』を入手した

fields.EN:
(What's this...?
Looks like some kind of earphone.)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう、
　不思議な形のイヤホンがある）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's this...?
Looks like some kind of earphone.)

fields.EN:
(Doesn't seem like it'll come
in handy, but I guess I can hold
onto it...)
fields.JP:
（何かに使えそう……でもないんだけど、
　ひとまず拾っておこうかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Doesn't seem like it'll come
in handy, but I guess I can hold
onto it...)

fields.EN:
(I'm sure it's just the standard
fare garbage that litters prison
areas, but...)
fields.JP:
（独房エリアによく落ちてる
　ゴミの一つなんだろうけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure it's just the standard
fare garbage that litters prison
areas, but...)

fields.EN: (I guess I can hold onto it...)
fields.LOCALIZED: (I guess I can hold onto it...)

fields.JP: （なんだろう、なんか光ってるな？）

fields.EN:
(It looks like some kind of
capsule...)
fields.JP:
（拾ってはみたけど……
　これフタかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like some kind of
capsule...)

fields.EN:
(Hm, opening it disclosed some
kind of... crayon?)
fields.JP: （フタをとったら赤いクレヨンみたいのがでてきた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm, opening it disclosed some
kind of... crayon?)

fields.EN:
(I saw this back when I was a
kid! It's some kind of
make-believe plaything.)
fields.JP:
（これって子供のころに見たことある！
　おままごとのおもちゃだよね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I saw this back when I was a
kid! It's some kind of
make-believe plaything.)

fields.JP: （ん……？　なんでか思わず手に取っちゃった）

fields.EN:
(It's not like I'm going to be
using it...)
fields.JP: （こんなもの使わないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's not like I'm going to be
using it...)

fields.JP: 『おままごとセット』を入手した

fields.EN:
(I wonder if it's something
special. I guess I can hold
onto it.)
fields.JP:
（何か貴重なものなのかな？
　ひとまず持っておこう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if it's something
special. I guess I can hold
onto it.)

fields.EN:
You got a vial of
"vanilla essence."
fields.JP: 『バニラエッセンス』を入手した
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got a vial of
"vanilla essence."

fields.JP:
（珍しい！
　綺麗なままの洋服がある）

fields.EN:
(I'm sure someone would want it
back at the Liberated District.)
fields.JP:
（解放地区に持っていけば、
　欲しい人もいるかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure someone would want it
back at the Liberated District.)

fields.JP:
（なんだろう……
　なんか懐かしい気がする）
『赤色のフード付きパーカ』を入手した

fields.EN:
(A square wooden case...
Maybe it'll tip us off to
something.)
fields.JP:
（四角い木製ケース……
　何か探索のヒントになるものかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A square wooden case...
Maybe it'll tip us off to
something.)

fields.EN:
(There's a whole lot of
pens inside...)
fields.JP: （なんか沢山ペンが入ってるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's a whole lot of
pens inside...)

fields.EN:
(I feel like I've seen this
before... Hm...)
fields.JP:
（僕はなぜかこれを見たことがある気がする。
　気のせい……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like I've seen this
before... Hm...)

fields.EN:
You got a set of
"manga drawing pens."
fields.JP: 『マンガ描きセット』を入手した
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got a set of
"manga drawing pens."

fields.EN:
All right...
I don't see any enemies around.
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right...
I don't see any enemies around.

fields.EN: Now's our chance to make our move.
fields.JP: 今なら、一気に辿りつける
fields.LOCALIZED: Now's our chance to make our move.

fields.JP: でも改めて不気味な場所だね……

fields.EN:
I can only hope everyone
is safe...
fields.JP:
捕まってる人たち、
無事だといいけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope everyone
is safe...

fields.EN:
I can at least tell they're alive,
and a lot of them, too.
fields.JP:
気配はある。生き残ってる人はきっと
いっぱいいるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can at least tell they're alive,
and a lot of them, too.

fields.EN: (Even if I can sense people, they're all prisoners, and all I can hear are their moans...)
fields.JP:
（人の気配がするって言っても、
　それはみんな囚人たちで、
　聞こえるのは呻き声だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Doesn't mean they're safe,
judging from the moans and
shrieks I keep hearing...)

fields.EN:
This is a bit scary, but...
I'll do my best.
fields.JP: 怖いけど、でも……頑張らないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a bit scary, but...
I'll do my best.

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.
fields.JP:
ご安心ください、姫。
何があろうと僕が必ず守ってみせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you said it with
such a straight face...
fields.JP: そんな臆面もなく言われると恥ずかしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you said it with
such a straight face...

fields.JP: でもありがとう……おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
That smile on your face is all
I need from you, my dear Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
君のその笑顔が何よりのご褒美さ。
……僕の人魚姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
That smile on your face is all
I need from you, my dear Little
Mermaid.

fields.EN:
That said, Akazukin
sure is taking her sweet time.
fields.JP: それにしても赤ずきんの奴、遅いな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, Red Riding Hood
sure is taking her sweet time.

fields.EN:
Heh, sorry about that.
I just didn't expect so many of
those monsters around.
fields.JP:
いやー悪い悪い、
敵の数、意外に多くてさー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, sorry about that.
I just didn't expect so many of
those monsters around.

fields.EN:
It doesn't help with you going in
weapon ablaze...
fields.JP:
ハデに暴れすぎなんだよ、赤ずきんは。
おかげで他の敵にも気づかれる
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't help with you going in
weapon ablaze...

fields.EN:
Now, now, Otsuu-chan.
Sis did take care of them, so we
can go in nice and safe now.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、おつうちゃん。
おねーちゃんがいてくれたから、
迂回しないで済んだんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, Otsuu.
Sis did take care of them, so we
can go in nice and safe now.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yup! I like my approach simple,
straight, and to the point!
No beating around the bush!
fields.JP:
そうそう、ちんたら回り道するくらいなら、
あたしは正面突破したいねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I like my approach simple,
straight, and to the point!
No beating around the bush!

fields.EN:
I was trying to say that you
rushing in without us could
be dangerous for everyone...
fields.JP:
はぐれたら危険が増すって言ってるんだ
ったく、もう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was trying to say that you
rushing in without us could
be dangerous for everyone...

fields.EN:
(The Jail Tower is eerie
as usual...)
fields.JP: （監獄塔は今日も不気味だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Jail Tower is eerie
as usual...)

fields.EN:
(I was told that this land was
once a bustling city filled with
people...)
fields.JP:
（本当ならここはとても賑やかな街で……
　人でいっぱいだったって、本当かな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was told that this land was
once a bustling city filled with
people...)

fields.JP:
（日本、だっけ。
　大人たちが言ってた……）

fields.EN:
(They said there was no chasm like
this, and that it wasn't covered
in all this weirdness.)
fields.JP:
（こんな底の見えない
　巨大な穴なんて開いてなかったし、
　無数の奇怪なオブジェもなかったって）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They said there was no chasm like
this, and that it wasn't covered
in all this weirdness.)

fields.EN:
(And, what's with that tower?
It seems to grow ever closer to
that white moon up above.)
fields.JP:
（何よりあの塔だ……空の白い月に
　向かって伸びるあの監獄塔。
　今の地獄の象徴……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, what's with that tower?
It seems to grow ever closer to
that white moon up above.)

fields.EN:
(Those who lived in the city are
held captive only to be tortured
by creatures called "Marchens.")
fields.JP:
（昔、街で暮らしていた人々は、
　今では『メルヒェン』というバケモノに
　捕えられて、拷問され続けている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Those who lived in the city are
held captive only to be tortured
by creatures called "Marchens.")

fields.EN:
(I doubt anyone really remembers
what this city was once called.)
fields.JP:
（街の名前なんて、
　もう誰も覚えてないんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I doubt anyone really remembers
what this city was once called.)

fields.EN:
(The living prison, Jail...
I wonder if we can really
survive here...)
fields.JP:
（難攻不落の生きる監獄『ジェイル』……
　僕たちは生き延びられるだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The living prison, Jail...
I wonder if we can really
survive here...)

fields.JP: ホォォォウ……ホォォォォ……
（ジェイル……お腹が空いているのか？）
おつうちゃん、ねえおつうちゃんってば
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
...Are you okay, Otsuu-chan? Are you feeling
sick anywhere?
fields.JP:
……大丈夫、おつうちゃん？
どこか具合でも悪い？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you... all right?
You don't look well...

fields.EN:
Ah, I'm fine, my princess.
Absolutely fine!
fields.JP:
あ、ああ大丈夫だよ、姫。
全然元気だから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I'm fine, my princess.
Absolutely fine!

fields.EN:
You haven't been sleeping much,
have you? Why not go and beat some
monsters up? Should wake you up.
fields.JP:
おつう、寝不足なんじゃないの～？
少し暴れてきたら？　目ぇ覚めるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You haven't been sleeping much,
have you? Why not go and beat some
monsters up? Should wake you up.

fields.JP: 赤ずきんと一緒にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not like you, Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
Oh, now you hurt your big sister's
feelings.
fields.JP: ああひどい、お姉さん傷つくわー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, now you hurt your big sister's
feelings.

fields.EN:
Joking aside... pay attention.
Fighting without a clear head
is pretty darn dangerous.
fields.JP:
でもまあ、本当にボケたまま戦いになったら
危険でしょ？　しゃっきりしなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Joking aside... pay attention.
Fighting without a clear head
is pretty darn dangerous.

fields.EN:
Y-You don't have to tell
me that.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't have to tell
me that.

fields.EN: This will all work out, right?
fields.LOCALIZED: This will all work out, right?

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, my princess.
We're only a few steps away from
meeting the Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよ姫。
目的の血式少女までは、もう少しです
すぐに終わりますからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, my princess.
We're only a few steps away from
meeting the Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
Acting like a prince only in front
of Ningyo, huh?
fields.JP:
ほんっと、おつうは
人魚の前でだけは王子さまだよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Acting like a prince only in front
of Mermie, huh?

fields.EN:
What? Do you want to
be treated the same?
fields.JP: 赤ずきんもそうしてほしいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Do you want to
be treated the same?

fields.EN:
I can only hope that our newly
found Blood Maiden is safe...
fields.JP:
新しい血式少女の方、
無事だといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope that our newly
found Blood Maiden is safe...

fields.EN:
If she really is a Blood Maiden
she should easily be able to
take some torture.
fields.JP:
仮にも血式少女、
拷問くらい気合いで乗り切ってるって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she really is a Blood Maiden
she should easily be able to
take some torture.

fields.EN:
I doubt she's like you...
Now then, to the cell where our
Blood Maiden awaits, so that...
fields.JP:
だから赤ずきんと一緒にするなって。
さ、血式少女のいる牢獄へ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt she's like you...
Now then, to the cell where our
Blood Maiden awaits, so that...

fields.EN:
I knew they wouldn't let us
through that easily!
fields.JP:
やっぱタダでは通らせては
くれないみたいだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew they wouldn't let us
through that easily!

fields.JP: 姫、決して僕の後ろから出ないで下さいね？
さあ、どこからでもかかってこい！

fields.EN:
To think that these creatures
are roaming the area...
fields.JP: こんなのがいつも徘徊してるなんてな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To think that these creatures
are roaming the area...

fields.EN: Yeah, I'd rather do without them.
fields.JP: そうだね、あまり見慣れたくはないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I'd rather do without them.

fields.EN:
You know, maybe it's easier if
we just head straight to our
destination.
fields.JP:
いっそまっすぐ突撃した方が、
まだマシかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, maybe it's easier if
we just head straight to our
destination.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean we'll fight
every one of them.
fields.JP: おい、無用な戦闘は避けるからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean we'll fight
every one of them.

fields.EN:
Hey, don't worry about it.
You really are a worrywart...
fields.JP:
分かってるってー。
おつうは心配性だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, don't worry about it.
You really are a worrywart...

fields.EN:
What I'm trying to say is to not
drag my princess into danger.
fields.JP: 姫を危険に巻き込むなって言ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I'm trying to say is to not
drag my princess into danger.

fields.EN:
Like I said, don't worry!
Sis here is gonna protect you
two. I promise!
fields.JP:
分かってるって！　人魚もおつうも、
お姉さんが絶対守ってあげるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
