Like I said, don't worry!
Sis here is gonna protect you
two. I promise!

fields.EN:
(If we fail,
I'll be captured, too.)
fields.JP:
（失敗したら、僕もここの
　囚人になってしまうんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we fail,
I'll be captured, too.)

fields.EN:
(Just thinking about it makes me
want to puke...)
fields.JP: （想像するだけでも吐きそうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just thinking about it makes me
want to puke...)

fields.EN:
Well, if we keep things up,
I'm sure we'll find and rescue
the Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
でもこの調子なら、新しい血式少女の人も
無事に助け出せるよ、きっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if we keep things up,
I'm sure we'll find and rescue
the Blood Maiden!

fields.EN:
Well said. Let's head towards the
cell with caution.
fields.JP:
それは確かに。
でも油断しないで牢屋に向かおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said. Let's head towards the
cell with caution.

fields.EN:
After all, we are facing creatures
who seem to find pleasure in
torturing others...
fields.JP:
なんせ相手は話の通じない
拷問好きの集団だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all, we are facing creatures
who seem to find pleasure in
torturing others...

fields.EN:
(I pray the Blood Maiden
is safe...)
fields.JP:
（新しい血式少女が
　無事でいてくれるのを願うよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I pray the Blood Maiden
is safe...)

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
My princess, are you okay?
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
姫、怪我は……ないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
My princess, are you okay?

fields.EN:
Forget about me, Otsuu-chan...! Are you in
pain? Does something hurt?!
fields.JP:
わたしのことよりおつうちゃんの方が……！
苦しいの？　それともどこか痛いの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't mind me! Look at you!
Are you okay? Are you hurt?!

fields.EN:
Heh, don't you worry, Ningyo.
Otsuu should be back to normal
shortly.
fields.JP:
はは、大丈夫だ人魚、
おつうはすぐに戻るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, don't you worry, Mermie.
Otsuu should be back to normal
shortly.

fields.EN:
Urh... Ah...
I think I'm fine now...
fields.JP:
うっ……はぁ……。
どうやら戻った、みたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urh... Ah...
I think I'm fine now...

fields.EN:
Thank goodness... Otsuu-chan! If anything
happened to you, I...!
fields.JP:
よかった……おつうちゃん……！
おつうちゃんに何かあったらわたし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Thank goodness!
If something terrible happened
to you, I'd...!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
Sorry to keep you worried there.
I'm fine, really...
fields.JP:
心配かけてごめんね、姫。
僕はほら、大丈夫だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to keep you worried there.
I'm fine, really...

fields.EN:
I have to say, it felt... weird.
I can't seem to get used to this.
fields.JP:
にしても何だか変な感覚……
やっぱりこれ、慣れないなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, it felt... weird.
I can't seem to get used to this.

fields.EN:
Me too...
Entering Genocide state isn't
something I can get used to...
fields.JP:
そうだね……
わたしも、ジェノサイド化は
いまだに慣れないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too...
Entering Massacre state isn't
something I can get used to...

fields.EN:
Just the thought of someone seeing
me like that is so embarrassing...
fields.JP:
自分のあんな姿を見られるなんて……
思い出すだけでも恥ずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just the thought of someone seeing
me like that is so embarrassing...

fields.EN:
Hahaha!
I must say, you're quite cute
even while blushing!
fields.JP:
はははっ、
姫の恥じらう姿も可愛らしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha!
I must say, you're quite cute
even while blushing!

fields.JP:
そ、そう……？
ありがとう、おつうちゃん……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Huh, but I still don't know why
you can return to normal after
killing your opponent...
fields.JP:
しっかし何で、
殺したいと思った相手を倒すと
元に戻るんだろうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, but I still don't know why
you can return to normal after
killing your opponent...

fields.JP: 確かにどうしてだろう……

fields.EN:
It's a terrible thought to think
that the urge to kill resides
inside you...
fields.JP:
そんな衝動が自分の中にある……
なんて思いたくはないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a terrible thought to think
that the urge to kill resides
inside you...

fields.EN:
Don't you worry. I can assure you
that you do not have that urge
within you.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。それだけはないって……
うん、僕は断言できる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry. I can assure you
that you do not have that urge
within you.

fields.EN:
It's a bit sad that we know
so little about ourselves...
fields.JP:
わたしたちの身体のことなのに、
まだまだ分からないことだらけだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a bit sad that we know
so little about ourselves...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, my princess.
I'll be by your side as we learn
the secrets of ourselves!
fields.JP:
心配しないで姫。
ゆっくり解明していけばいい。
僕がついているからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, my princess.
I'll be by your side as we learn
the secrets of ourselves!

fields.EN:
Yes, I'll be counting on you,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
うん、頼りにしてるね、
おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'll be counting on you,
Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
In any case, I think we should try
to avoid entering our Genocide
state.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、このジェノサイド化……
あまり使わない方がいいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I think we should try
to avoid entering our Massacre
state.

fields.EN:
Well, we don't know what it is,
right? Who knows what else
could happen...
fields.JP:
まだ解明できてない部分があるし、
何が起こるか分からないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we don't know what it is,
right? Who knows what else
could happen...

fields.EN:
It frightens me to think that we
may not be able to return back
to our normal selves...
fields.JP:
自分がジェノサイド化したまま、
元に戻れなくなったらって思うと……
わたしはとても怖いな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It frightens me to think that we
may not be able to return back
to our normal selves...

fields.EN:
Oh, you're thinking too much
again, Ningyo! Don't worry!
fields.JP:
だーいじょうぶだって！
考えすぎだよ、人魚はー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're thinking too much
again, Mermie! Don't worry!

fields.EN:
If something happens, Sis will be
by your side to help, no matter
what!
fields.JP:
それに何かあっても
お姉さんがついてるから
心配しなさんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If something happens, Sis will be
by your side to help, no matter
what!

fields.EN:
Yes, Akazukin aside,
you can be assured I will always
be there for you, my princess.
fields.JP:
まあ赤ずきんはともかく、
いつだって僕がそばにいるから、
心配しないでいいよ、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, Red Riding Hood aside,
you can be assured I will always
be there for you, my princess.

fields.EN:
(Fighting while in our Genocide
state is very useful, but...)
fields.JP:
（確かにジェノサイド化は
　便利かもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Fighting while in our Massacre
state is very useful, but...)

fields.EN:
(...as mentioned, there's no
telling what will happen,
and by then, it may be too late.)
fields.JP:
（だけど、姫の言う通り、
　何が起こるか分からない。
　起きてからじゃ遅いんだ、きっと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...as mentioned, there's no
telling what will happen,
and by then, it may be too late.)

fields.EN:
(We need to be very selective
when using this power...)
fields.JP: （使う場面は慎重に選ばないとな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need to be very selective
when using this power...)

fields.EN:
Our Genocide power is one thing,
but this "licking" is another that
I'd rather do without...
fields.JP:
ジェノサイド化もそうだけど……
『舐める』っていうのも慣れないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our Massacre power is one thing,
but this "licking" is another that
I'd rather do without...

fields.EN:
Yeah, but it's pretty important
when facing them Marchens.
fields.JP:
でもまーメルヒェンに
勝つためには大事だよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but it's pretty important
when facing them Marchens.

fields.EN:
Ah, you're bleeding from your
arm again, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
あ、おつうちゃん、
まだ腕から血が出てるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, you're bleeding from your
arm again, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
わっ！？
姫、ななっ、何をっ！？

fields.EN:
Hm? I was just going to lick the
blood coming out.
fields.JP:
何って……血が出てたから、
舐めようとしたのだけど……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? I was just going to lick the
blood coming out.

fields.EN:
Th-Thank you, my princess!
B-But there are no Marchens here,
so let me just wipe it off myself!
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう姫！
でももうメルヒェンもいないし、
こ、これくらいハンカチでふくよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Thank you, my princess!
B-But there are no Marchens here,
so let me just wipe it off myself!

fields.EN:
S-Sorry, Otsuu-chan! I couldn't get the
sense of battle out of me, so...
fields.JP:
ごめんねおつうちゃん！
戦いの延長のつもりで、つい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry, Otsuu! I couldn't get the
sense of battle out of me, so...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: わたしったら、なんて恥ずかしい……

fields.EN:
Th-There's nothing to be
embarrassed about! You tried to
act in a means of helping me.
fields.JP:
は、恥ずかしいことなんてあるもんか！
だって姫は僕のために……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-There's nothing to be
embarrassed about! You tried to
act in a means of helping me.

fields.EN: Yup, no need to be embarrassed.
fields.JP: そうそう、照れることなんてないよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, no need to be embarrassed.

fields.EN: After all, you two are married, right? Right, Tsuuuuuuu?
fields.JP:
なんたって２人は夫婦だもんね～？
ねー、おつうー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, you two are lovey-dovey.
Ain't that right, Otsuuuuuuu?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes! W-We're just like husband
and wife! Nothing strange about
our actions! Not one bit!
fields.JP:
そ、そうさ！
僕と姫は夫婦なんだから！
こんなの当たり前のことなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes! W-We're just like husband
and wife! Nothing strange about
our actions! Not one bit!

fields.EN:
Oh? Is big sis here seeing things
wrong? You look pretty darn
embarrassed. Hmmmm?
fields.JP:
そんなこと言って、
恥ずかしがってるように見えるのは
お姉さんの気のせいかなぁ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Is big sis here seeing things
wrong? You look pretty darn
embarrassed. Hmmmm?

fields.EN:
Y-You've got that wrong!
You really should get your eyes
checked, Akazukin!
fields.JP:
きき、気のせいに決まってるだろ！
赤ずきん、目が悪くなったんじゃないのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You've got that wrong!
You really should get your eyes
checked, Red Riding Hood!

fields.EN:
Too bad for you. My eyes are so
good that I can see the tower
in here from a mile away.
fields.JP:
見えてます～
監獄塔の向こうまでバッチリ見えてます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad for you. My eyes are so
good that I can see the tower
in here from a mile away.

fields.EN:
Stop it already, Akazukin!
I'm going to really get mad!
fields.JP: あーもう、いい加減怒るぞ赤ずきんっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it already, Red Riding Hood!
I'm going to really get mad!

fields.EN:
Heh, sorry there. C'mon,
I was just playing with you.
No need to get so upset.
fields.JP:
はは、ごめんごめんっ。
もーそんなに怒らないでよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, sorry there. C'mon,
I was just playing with you.
No need to get so upset.

fields.EN:
Hee hee... Even in a place like this,
Otsuu-chan, you and onee-chan never change...
fields.JP:
ふふ、こんな場所なのに、
おつうちゃんもおねーちゃんも
相変わらずだなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, you two don't change
one bit, no matter where you are
do you?

fields.EN:
That's right! We shouldn't prattle
here too long! Let's go!
fields.JP:
そうだよ、こんな場所なんだよ！
ほら、先を急ごう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We shouldn't prattle
here too long! Let's go!

fields.EN:
Heh, I guess I'll save the teasing
until we get back home then.
fields.JP:
ふふん、じゃあ帰ったらじっくりと
２人をいじらせてもらおっかなー♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, I guess I'll save the teasing
until we get back home then.

fields.EN:
Like I said, I'm really going
to go mad on you, Akazukin!
fields.JP: 本当に怒るぞ、赤ずきん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said, I'm really going
to go mad on you, Red Riding Hood!

fields.EN:
Sis sure looks like she's
having fun.
fields.JP: おねーちゃん、楽しそうだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis sure looks like she's
having fun.

fields.JP: まったく、赤ずきんのやつ……

（――とはいえ、実際のところ
　姫は今どう思っているんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what Little Mermaid is
thinking...)

fields.EN:
(Sure, we're bound in matrimony,
but that was when we were
little kids...)
fields.JP:
（夫婦になったとはいえ、
　あの時は随分と幼かったし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sure, we're bound in matrimony,
but that was when we were
little kids...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she isn't taking our vows
seriously because we were kids...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり幼い頃の契りだから、
　本気じゃなかったりするのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she isn't taking our vows
seriously because we were kids...)

fields.EN:
(No... She always keeps her
promises. There's no way she
would have forgotten...!)
fields.JP:
（いや、姫は約束を守る子だ。
　そんなことはない……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No... She always keeps her
promises. There's no way she
would have forgotten...!)

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、行くよー？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(Now is not the time for me to be
thinking about such a thing.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、それは後回しだ。
　こんな場所で考えることじゃない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now is not the time for me to be
thinking about such a thing.)

fields.EN:
I can feel the air here getting
worse. Definitely not something
I want to be in for too long.
fields.JP:
今までよりも更に吐き気が出そうな
空気に変わってきたしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can feel the air here getting
worse. Definitely not something
I want to be in for too long.

fields.EN:
You're right...
The air has changed...
fields.JP: 確かに、雰囲気が変わったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
The air has changed...

fields.EN:
Maybe this means that we're
getting closer to the cell the
Blood Maiden is held captive...
fields.JP:
そうだね……これは血式少女の人がいる
牢屋も近いかもしれないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe this means that we're
getting closer to the cell the
Blood Maiden is held captive...

fields.JP: よし……ようやく牢獄に着いたぞ

fields.EN:
Sure makes things easy when all
three of us Blood Maidens are
tackling the mission.
fields.JP: やっぱり血式少女が３人もいると早いね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure makes things easy when all
three of us Blood Maidens are
tackling the mission.

fields.EN:
Just means things are moving
in our favor... I think.
fields.JP:
これはあたしたちに
風が吹いてる……はずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just means things are moving
in our favor... I think.

fields.EN:
You know, there are a lot of
cells here...
fields.JP: でも、けっこうな牢屋の数だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, there are a lot of
cells here...

fields.EN:
A Marchen guarding the cells?
I guess it's making its rounds.
fields.JP:
門番のメルヒェン……
ああして見回っているんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Marchen guarding the cells?
I guess it's making its rounds.

fields.EN: Isn't there any way to avoid it?
fields.JP: 何とかしてやり過ごせないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Isn't there any way to avoid it?

fields.EN:
We could go into one of the cells
near us when it moves away, or
one of us can act as decoy...
fields.JP:
……遠ざかった隙に手前の牢屋から入るか、
あるいは１人囮になって引きつけるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We could go into one of the cells
near us when it moves away, or
one of us can act as decoy...

fields.EN:
Well, we need to think about
escaping too, so...
fields.JP: 脱出も考えるとなると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we need to think about
escaping too, so...

fields.EN:
What would you do if you knew
where the sick feel in the air
is coming from?
fields.JP:
吐き気を催す匂いの元凶があったら、
どうすればいいと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What would you do if you knew
where the sick feel in the air
is coming from?

fields.EN:
If avoiding it won't change
anything, we might as well
get rid of it.
fields.JP:
待ってても何も変わらないなら、
さっさと倒しちゃえばいいってことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If avoiding it won't change
anything, we might as well
get rid of it.

fields.EN:
Damn it! There's no strategy
at all here!
fields.JP:
くそっ……作戦も何も
あったもんじゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! There's no strategy
at all here!

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、わたしたちも行こう！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
That Akazukin is
one heck of a troublemaker!
fields.JP: まったく赤ずきんの奴……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Red Riding Hood is
one heck of a troublemaker!

fields.EN:
Hmph! Like it had
any chance against me!
fields.JP:
ふん、あたしに
勝てるとでも思ったのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Like it had
any chance against me!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...
It could've caused us major hurt.
fields.JP:
まったく、無茶をして……
ケガしたらどうするつもりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...
It could've caused us major hurt.

fields.EN:
Heh, did you think I would lose
to this grunt of a Marchen?
fields.JP:
ふん、この程度のメルヒェン相手に、
あたしが負けるわけないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, did you think I would lose
to this grunt of a Marchen?

fields.EN:
I'm trying to say that it could've
hurt my princess! You're like a
rock, so I could've cared less.
fields.JP:
姫がケガでもしたら大変だと言ってるんだ
赤ずきんは無駄に頑丈そうだから心配してない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm trying to say that it could've
hurt my princess! You're like a
rock, so I could've cared less.

fields.EN:
Geez! Otsuu-chan, onee-chan, don't fight
in a place like this!
fields.JP:
もうっ、おつうちゃんもおねーちゃんも、
こんなところでケンカしないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, stop it, both of you!
This is no time to be fighting!

fields.EN:
Well, let's get looking for our
new Blood Maiden to be.
fields.JP:
ともかく、今のうちに、
新しい血式少女を探そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's get looking for our
new Blood Maiden to be.

fields.EN: I'll check from the far end then.
fields.JP: じゃああたしは奥から順に見て回るよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll check from the far end then.

fields.JP: おねーちゃん、気をつけてね？

fields.EN:
Don't you worry about me!
I can take care of myself!
fields.JP:
あたしを誰だと思ってるの！
心配しなさんな～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry about me!
I can take care of myself!

fields.EN: I wonder if she'll be okay...
fields.JP: おねーちゃん……大丈夫かな
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder if she'll be okay...

fields.EN:
Please, put a smile on
your face. Your sad expression
is not befitting of you.
fields.JP:
んっ……姫、どうか笑ってください。
あなたに悲しい顔は似合わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, put a smile on
your face. Your sad expression
is not befitting of you.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Akazukin is very strong.
I'm sure she will be fine.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんなら大丈夫ですよ、姫。
彼女は強いから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood is very strong.
I'm sure she will be fine.

fields.EN:
Now, let's get searching from
the cells here.
fields.JP: さあ、僕たちは手前から見ていきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, let's get searching from
the cells here.

fields.JP: こんなにたくさんの人が囚われて……

fields.EN:
Yes... Whoever is behind this
must be punished.
fields.JP: うん……本当に許せないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Whoever is behind this
must be punished.

fields.EN:
Princess, let's splash this blood
on everyone.
fields.JP:
姫、この血を
全員に振りかけていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, let's splash this blood
on everyone.

fields.EN: Marchen blood... I see! A Blood Maiden's eyes turn pink when she's splashed with Marchen blood!
fields.JP:
メルヒェンの血……そっか！
血式少女ならメルヒェンの血を浴びると、
瞳がピンク色になるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see! A Blood Maiden reacts to
Marchen blood by her eyes turning
pink, so it will help us find her!

fields.EN:
Precisely. It lacks elegance, but
we really don't have much time.
We'll apologize to them later.
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
少し乱暴なやり方だけど今は時間がない。
囚人たちには我慢してもらおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Precisely. It lacks elegance, but
we really don't have much time.
We'll apologize to them later.

fields.EN:
Let's start right away then!
I'll check the other cells!
fields.JP: じゃあわたしたちも手分けして探そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's start right away then!
I'll check the other cells!

fields.EN:
I'll save you all, but please,
bear with me for a moment...
fields.JP:
みなさん、助けますから、
少しの間じっとしていてくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll save you all, but please,
bear with me for a moment...

fields.JP: それと、ちょっとばかり失礼します

fields.EN:
Yikes! What the...?!
What did you just splash on me?!
fields.JP:
きゃっ！　いきなり何！？
私の顔に何をかけたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes! What the...?!
What did you just splash on me?!

fields.EN:
Eek!
Wh-What's with this pink liquid?!
fields.JP:
ヒィッ！？
な、なにこのピンク色の液体！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eek!
Wh-What's with this pink liquid?!

fields.EN:
Don't you worry. It's nothing
harmful, but I do need you to
bear with me here.
fields.JP:
安心してください。害はないですよ。
申し訳ないですけど、
ちょっと我慢して下さいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry. It's nothing
harmful, but I do need you to
bear with me here.

fields.EN:
Hm... Not her...
Not her, either...
How about her?
fields.JP:
うーん、この子は違うな。
この人も……違う。
じゃあこっちの子は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Not her...
Not her, either...
How about her?

fields.EN: What the hell is this about?!
fields.JP: おまえいきなり何しやがる！
fields.LOCALIZED: What the hell is this about?!

fields.EN:
D-Don't worry, Mamoru.
She just caught me off guard.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だよマモル。
ちょっとビックリしただけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't worry, Mamoru.
She just caught me off guard.

fields.EN:
She just splashed you with
who-knows-what!
And, you! What the hell are...
fields.JP:
得体の知れない液体かけられて、
大丈夫、じゃねーよ。
そこのお前、いったい何を――
fields.LOCALIZED:
She just splashed you with
who-knows-what!
And, you! What the hell are...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about that, my lady.
That liquid is of no harm, really.
Here, wipe your face with this.
fields.JP:
驚かせてすみません、レディ。
その液体は害のあるものではありません。
さ、どうぞこれでお顔をお拭きください
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about that, my lady.
That liquid is of no harm, really.
Here, wipe your face with this.

fields.EN:
Yeah, and this is coming from
the person who caused all
this mess!
fields.JP:
ってか紳士ぶってやがるけど、
最初にぶっかけたのおまえだからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and this is coming from
the person who caused all
this mess!

fields.EN:
Now then, my lady, I'll come and
save you when my duties have
been fulfilled.
fields.JP:
ではレディ、
用事が済んだらちゃんと助けに来るから、
それまで待っていてくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, my lady, I'll come and
save you when my duties have
been fulfilled.

fields.EN: Hey! I was talking to you!
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! I was talking to you!

fields.EN:
Alice! Look at you!
Hurry, lick my blood!
fields.JP:
アリス酷い顔色じゃないか！
さあ、僕の血を舐めるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice! Look at you!
Hurry, lick my blood!

fields.EN:
B-But, Jack...
I'm just a burden to you...
fields.JP: で、でもまたジャックに迷惑を……
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, Jack...
I'm just a burden to you...

fields.JP: そんなことないよ！　ほら早く！

fields.EN:
(What are those two doing?
Hm, no matter. I have more
pressing matters to attend to.)
fields.JP:
（あの２人は何をしているんだ……？
　……まあいい、僕はさっさと探すだけだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What are those two doing?
Hm, no matter. I have more
pressing matters to attend to.)

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、見つけたって本当！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
So pink and pretty!
She's the Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
綺麗なピンク色……！
じゃあこの人が血式少女なのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So pink and pretty!
She's the Blood Maiden!

fields.JP:
あ、あのっ、
君たちはいったい何者なんだい……？

fields.EN:
We're Dawn's Blood Maidens.
We came looking for new allies.
fields.JP:
わたしたちは黎明の血式少女隊。
新しい仲間を探して、ここに来たんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're Dawn's Blood Maidens.
We came looking for new allies.

fields.EN: Alice, was it? We came for you.
fields.JP:
それでそこの――アリス、だっけ。
彼女を迎えに来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice, was it? We came for you.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens? Allies?
What are you talking about?
fields.JP:
血式少女隊？　仲間？
わたしが何だっていうの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens? Allies?
What are you talking about?

fields.EN: Otsuu? You found the Blood Maiden?
fields.JP: おつう、血式少女見つけたって！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu? You found the Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
Whoa! Good work!
Her eyes are nice and pink!
fields.JP: わ、本当ね！　瞳の色がとってもピンク！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Good work!
Her eyes are nice and pink!

fields.EN:
All right then!
You're coming with big old sis!
fields.JP: よっし！　じゃあお姉さんと一緒に行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right then!
You're coming with big old sis!

fields.EN:
Ahh! What are you...?!
Let me go!
fields.JP:
きゃっ！？　いきなり何するの！
ちょっと下ろしてってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahh! What are you...?!
Let me go!

fields.JP: おねーちゃんどこ行くの！？

fields.EN:
Wait up, Akazukin!
She's too happy to notice
anyone else! Follow her!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待て赤ずきん！
ああもう、喜びすぎて周りが見えてない！
姫、後を追いましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait up, Red Riding Hood!
She's too happy to notice
anyone else! Follow her!

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry!
Let me assure you Alice-san will
be all right.
fields.JP:
そこのあなた、本当にごめんなさい……！
アリスさんは絶対無事ですから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry!
Let me assure you Alice will
be all right.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
I don't know what's going on,
but... let Alice go!
fields.JP:
な、よく分からないけど、
アリスを返してくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what's going on,
but... let Alice go!

fields.JP:
ちょっと！
下ろしてってばぁっ！

fields.EN:
I guess we're safe here.
Alley-oop...
fields.JP:
この辺りまでくればもう大丈夫かなー？
よいしょ、っと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we're safe here.
Alley-oop...

fields.EN:
Now then, let me get those
shackles off of you.
fields.JP: じゃあ手錠壊すから、ちょっと手を出して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let me get those
shackles off of you.

fields.EN: Y-You're going to let me free?
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-You're going to let me free?

fields.EN:
Of course!
That's why I saved you!
fields.JP:
当たり前じゃない！
そのために助けたんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course!
That's why I saved you!

fields.JP: やっと、追いつき、ました……

fields.EN:
Akazukin!
Stop moving around like that!
That was dangerous!
fields.JP:
赤ずきん！　いきなり単独で動くな！
危険じゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood!
Stop moving around like that!
That was dangerous!

fields.EN:
Well gee, I was just so happy.
I mean, we've lost a lot of
Blood Maidens, so you know...
fields.JP:
いや、最近血式少女が減ってばかりだから、
嬉しさのあまりつい、ね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well gee, I was just so happy.
I mean, we've lost a lot of
Blood Maidens, so you know...

fields.EN:
You're always like this!
You should really learn to stay
calm and focused.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんはいつだってそうだ！
まったく、少しは落ち着きを
覚えたらどうなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're always like this!
You should really learn to stay
calm and focused.

fields.EN:
Now, now, Otsuu-chan.
We did save Alice-san here.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、おつうちゃん。
こうして無事にアリスさんと
出会えたことだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, Otsuu.
We did save Alice here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP: この人たち……いったい何なの……？

fields.EN:
Yeah, we did save...
Alice, was it?
Guess our work here's done!
fields.JP:
まあこうしてアリス……だっけ？
を無事に助け出すことが出来たわけだし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we did save...
Alice, was it?
Guess our work here's done!

fields.EN:
He's the person who was
imprisoned with Alice-san.
Didn't you notice?
fields.JP:
アリスさんと
一緒に牢に囚われてた方ですよ！
気づいてなかったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's the person who was
imprisoned with Alice.
Didn't you notice?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Of course not!
Not like I was interested.
fields.JP: うん、興味なかったからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not!
Not like I was interested.

fields.EN:
Jack, was it?
I'm so sorry for our comrade's
rude behavior.
fields.JP:
ジャック君、といったね。
連れが酷いことをしてすまないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, was it?
I'm so sorry for our comrade's
rude behavior.

fields.JP: ……いったい君たちは何者なの？

fields.EN:
We came here to liberate the
prisoners.
fields.JP:
わたしたちは囚われている人々を
解放するために、ここにやってきたのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came here to liberate the
prisoners.

fields.EN:
And, to find the Blood Maiden
who was captive.
fields.JP: そして同時に、血式少女を探しにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, to find the Blood Maiden
who was captive.

fields.EN: Are you telling me I'm one of you?
fields.JP: まさか、それがわたしだというの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you telling me I'm one of you?

fields.EN:
Yup! You're a Blood Maiden. The
very one we've been looking for!
fields.JP:
うん！　アリスはやっと見つけた、
貴重な新しい血式少女なんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! You're a Blood Maiden. The
very one we've been looking for!

fields.EN:
The Marchen blood that was on you
turned your eyes pink, which is
proof of you being a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンの血を浴びて
瞳がピンク色になっている……
それが何よりの証拠なのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchen blood that was on you
turned your eyes pink, which is
proof of you being a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
Marchen blood?!
You splattered her with that?!
fields.JP:
メルヒェンの血！？
なんてものをアリスにかけたのさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchen blood?!
You splattered her with that?!

fields.EN:
C'mon, that's the only way we
could find out who
the Blood Maiden was.
fields.JP:
しょうがないじゃん、
それしか見分ける方法ないんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, that's the only way we
could find out who
the Blood Maiden was.

fields.EN:
Regardless, we would like
to ask Alice to come and
fight alongside us.
fields.JP:
だから、できるならアリスには
僕たちと一緒に来て、戦って欲しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, we would like
to ask Alice to come and
fight alongside us.

fields.EN:
Of course, you can come along
with us too, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
もちろん、ジャックさんも
ご一緒で大丈夫ですからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, you can come along
with us too, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
This is all happening so suddenly.
I'm not sure how to respond...
fields.JP:
そう言われても……
突然すぎて、何て答えていいか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is all happening so suddenly.
I'm not sure how to respond...

fields.EN:
In the first place, what's the
deal with this "Blood Maiden"
thing anyway?
fields.JP:
そもそも血式少女なんて
聞いたこともないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the first place, what's the
deal with this "Blood Maiden"
thing anyway?

fields.EN:
We would love to explain,
but it seems we have an undesired
guest here...
fields.JP:
しっかりとご説明したいところですが、
どうやらそれどころでは
なくなってしまったようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We would love to explain,
but it seems we have an undesired
guest here...

fields.JP: メルヒェンが来ちゃったね

fields.EN:
Marchen...?
Alice, we need to run!
fields.JP:
メルヒェン……？
アリス、早く逃げよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchen...?
Alice, we need to run!

fields.EN:
No, it's too late... It pains for
me to ask this, but it would
help if you fought with us.
fields.JP:
……いや、もう遅い。
悪いけど一緒に戦ってくれると助かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's too late... It pains for
me to ask this, but it would
help if you fought with us.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
A sword?!
I've never used one before!
fields.JP:
け、剣っ！？
こんなもの、わたし使ったことないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A sword?!
I've never used one before!

fields.EN:
Don't worry!
You should be able to use it fine!
fields.JP:
大丈夫！
アリスなら絶対に上手く使えるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry!
You should be able to use it fine!

fields.EN: O-Okay, I'll try my best then.
fields.JP:
わ、わかったわ
やるしかなさそうだもの、頑張ってみる
fields.LOCALIZED: O-Okay, I'll try my best then.

fields.EN:
That's amazing, Alice!
I didn't know you were so strong!
fields.JP:
すごいよアリス！
まさかこんなに強かったなんて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's amazing, Alice!
I didn't know you were so strong!

fields.EN:
Alice-san, your swordsmanship was beautiful
to watch.
fields.JP:
アリスさん、
とても綺麗な剣さばきでしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, your swordsmanship was
quite something to watch.

fields.EN:
See? I knew you'd be able to
use the sword fine.
fields.JP: ね？　やればできたろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? I knew you'd be able to
use the sword fine.

fields.EN:
But why...?
I never used a sword before...
fields.JP:
どうして……？
わたし、剣なんて持つの初めてなのよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But why...?
I never used a sword before...

fields.EN:
That's because you're a Blood Maiden just
like us, Alice-san.
fields.JP:
それはアリスさんが
わたしたちと同じ、血式少女だからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because you're one of us.
You're a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens are special people
who can fight the Marchens.
fields.JP:
血式少女とは少し特別な人間で、
メルヒェンと戦うことのできる存在です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens are special people
who can fight the Marchens.

fields.EN:
Which is why you were able to
face the Marchen on fair ground.
fields.JP:
実際に戦ってみて分かっただろう？
互角に渡り合えるってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why you were able to
face the Marchen on fair ground.

fields.EN: But there aren't many Blood Maidens. That's why we want to find as many as we can and welcome them as companions.
fields.JP:
でも血式少女の数は多くありません。
だから１人でも多く見つけて、
仲間に迎え入れたいのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, there aren't that many Blood
Maidens around. That's why we're
looking for more to help us.

fields.EN:
Yup! So that's why we want you
to join us, Alice!
fields.JP:
そういうこと！　だからアリス、
あたしたちの仲間になってよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! So that's why we want you
to join us, Alice!

fields.EN:
I appreciate you helping us,
but... I'm not sure I'm up to it.
fields.JP:
助けてくれたのは嬉しいけど、
わたしに務まるかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate you helping us,
but... I'm not sure I'm up to it.

fields.EN:
Alice...? Your eyes aren't pink
anymore...
fields.JP: あ、アリスの瞳の色……戻ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice...? Your eyes aren't pink
anymore...

fields.EN:
We're sorry to have brought
confusion upon you two
in such a manner.
fields.JP:
お二人とも、いきなりのことで
混乱させてしまってすみません。
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're sorry to have brought
confusion upon you two
in such a manner.

fields.EN:
But, may I suggest we first
escape from here before we go
into further detail?
fields.JP:
まずはみんなでここを脱出してから、
改めて説明いたします
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, may I suggest we first
escape from here before we go
into further detail?

fields.EN: All right, let's get out of here!
fields.JP: それじゃあ早く脱出しようか
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, let's get out of here!

fields.EN:
But, what about the other
prisoners?
fields.JP: え、他の囚人のみんなはそのままなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, what about the other
prisoners?

fields.EN: W-We'll save them! Sure we will!
fields.JP: も、もちろん助けるつもりだったさ！
fields.LOCALIZED: W-We'll save them! Sure we will!

fields.EN:
Oh, I can't believe you both
forgot about the others!
fields.JP:
も、もうみんなして
こんな大事なこと忘れるなんて～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I can't believe you both
forgot about the others!

fields.EN:
Y-You forgot about them too,
didn't you, Ningyo?
fields.JP: に、人魚だって実は忘れてたでしょ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You forgot about them too,
didn't you, Mermie?

fields.EN: Uh, let's go back to the cells!
fields.JP: と、とにかくすぐに牢獄に戻ろう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, let's go back to the cells!

fields.EN:
Everyone!
We're here to save you!
fields.JP: みなさん！　今助けますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone!
We're here to save you!

fields.EN:
Please follow behind us!
We'll make sure you all escape
from here safe!
fields.JP:
わたしたちの後に続いて避難を！
絶対に全員、連れて行きますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please follow behind us!
We'll make sure you all escape
from here safe!

fields.EN:
C'mon now, in order!
You! No pushing!
fields.JP:
ほら順序よく動いて！
そこ、押さないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon now, in order!
You! No pushing!

fields.EN:
At this rate, we should be able to
get them all out smoothly.
Isn't that right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
この調子なら
スムーズに助け出せそうだね、
おつうちゃん。
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this rate, we should be able to
get them all out smoothly.
Isn't that right, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
……おつうちゃん？
どうかしたの？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, uh, nothing.
Nothing at all.
fields.JP: あ、ああ姫。何でもないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, uh, nothing.
Nothing at all.

fields.EN:
(Mamoru and Hikari, was it?
Where did they go?)
fields.JP:
（マモルとヒカリ……だったか。
　彼らはどこに……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mamoru and Hikari, was it?
Where did they go?)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうさん => Otsuu-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Did you see a boy around my
age inside this cell here?
fields.JP:
今この牢の中に、
僕と同じくらいの男の子いませんでした？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you see a boy around my
age inside this cell here?

fields.EN:
(Looks like Jack knows him.
I'm sure he made his way
out already.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックの知り合いみたいだな。
　きっと解放された中にいるだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Jack knows him.
I'm sure he made his way
out already.)

fields.EN:
All right! We got them all out,
so it's time to get out of here!
fields.JP: よし！　全員解放したから脱出するよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! We got them all out,
so it's time to get out of here!

fields.EN: We'll guide you to the Liberated District now! Whatever you do, don't leave the line!
fields.JP:
それじゃあこれから
解放地区まで案内するから！
絶対に列から出ないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll take you all to the
Liberated District,
so make sure you keep up!

fields.EN:
I can't find the boy in our
group...
fields.JP:
隣の牢の子、
この中にやっぱりいないみたいだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't find the boy in our
group...

fields.EN:
We better get going too, Jack.
We can only hope your friend
has escaped safely.
fields.JP:
さあ、僕たちも行くよジャック。
彼らはどうやら自分たちで逃げたみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We better get going too, Jack.
We can only hope your friend
has escaped safely.

fields.JP:
そう……ですね。
じゃあアリス、行こう

fields.EN:
Alice-san looks so tired...
I guess it's only natural since
it was her first battle.
fields.JP:
アリスさん……すごく疲れてる。
初めての戦闘だったから
無理もないよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice looks so tired...
I guess it's only natural since
it was her first battle.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Why don't you rest for a bit,
Alice-san?
fields.JP: アリスさん、少し休みましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you rest for a bit,
Alice?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
I believe my dear princess is
right. You should take a breather.
fields.JP:
そうだね、姫の言うとおり
少し休んだ方がいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe my dear princess is
right. You should take a breather.

fields.EN:
They're right, Alice.
At this rate, you're going to
just burn yourself out.
fields.JP:
そうだよアリス！
少し休まないと身体が持たないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're right, Alice.
At this rate, you're going to
just burn yourself out.

fields.EN:
I'm fine... It's okay.
I actually want to keep moving.
fields.JP:
わたしなら、全然、大丈夫よ。
むしろ動き足りないくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine... It's okay.
I actually want to keep moving.

fields.EN:
Jack, can I borrow you for
a moment?
fields.JP: ジャック、ちょっといいかな。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, can I borrow you for
a moment?

fields.EN: As you can see, Alice is pushing herself right now. She doesn't want to put everyone else in danger.
fields.JP:
ご覧の通り、アリスは今無理をしてる。
他のみんなを危険に晒したくないからだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's quite clear that Alice is
lying. She simply wants everyone
to escape as far as possible.

fields.EN:
I think she should rest,
but based on circumstances
she's right.
fields.JP:
僕も休んだ方がいいと思うけど、
状況的にはアリスの判断が正しい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think she should rest,
but based on circumstances
she's right.

fields.EN:
So, I want to ask that you
stay next to her for support.
fields.JP:
だからせめてジャック、
君がアリスに寄り添ってあげてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I want to ask that you
stay next to her for support.

fields.EN:
Yes, it would be best if you can
offer her physical and mental
support.
fields.JP:
そうね、少しでも
そばで元気づけてあげてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it would be best if you can
offer her physical and mental
support.

fields.EN:
Understood.
I'd be more than happy to help.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood.
I'd be more than happy to help.

fields.EN:
Oh well... Tell you what?
I'll take care of things from here
so you just rest up, you hear?
fields.JP:
……仕方ないね、ここから先は
お姉さんに任せて休んでなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well... Tell you what?
I'll take care of things from here
so you just rest up, you hear?

fields.JP: そんな、わたしは大丈夫よ！

fields.EN:
Don't you worry! Sure, you're more
a burden than help now, but you'll
help us down the line for sure!
fields.JP:
遠慮しないの！　今は足手まといでも、
そのうち強くなるよ、大丈夫！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry! Sure, you're more
a burden than help now, but you'll
help us down the line for sure!

fields.EN:
So just let big old sis here
protect you, my dear kiddo.
fields.JP:
だから未熟な後輩よ、
今はお姉さんに守られなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So just let big old sis here
protect you, my dear kiddo.

fields.EN:
Oh, and Otsuu?
I don't think it's a good idea to
have Jack next to Alice.
fields.JP:
でもおつう、
ジャックはアリスのそばに
いない方がいいんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and Otsuu?
I don't think it's a good idea to
have Jack next to Alice.

fields.EN:
Well, Jack being next to her is
going to distract her more than
anything.
fields.JP:
だってジャックがそばにいたら、
アリスはきっと余計に気をつかうでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Jack being next to her is
going to distract her more than
anything.

fields.EN:
That's not gonna help her rest.
He'll make matters worse because,
well... you know?
fields.JP:
それじゃアリスは全然休まらないよ。
だから今はそばにいたら逆効果というか、
役に立たないと言うか――
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not gonna help her rest.
He'll make matters worse because,
well... you know?

fields.EN:
Who are you to say he's going
to make things worse?
fields.JP:
ジャックが役に立たないって、
どうしてあなたが勝手に決めつけるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who are you to say he's going
to make things worse?

fields.EN:
You don't know how often he's
saved me and supported me!
fields.JP:
ジャックがどれだけ
わたしを救ってくれているか、
あなたに分かってたまるもんか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know how often he's
saved me and supported me!

fields.EN:
Just having him near me calms me
and makes me feel warm inside!
fields.JP:
ジャックがそばにいてくれるだけで
どれだけ心が穏やかになるか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just having him near me calms me
and makes me feel warm inside!

fields.EN:
Waking up to Jack saying "good
morning" is all I need to live
through another day!
fields.JP:
目が覚めてジャックがそばで
『おはよう』って言ってくれる、
それがどれだけ生きる力をくれたか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waking up to Jack saying "good
morning" is all I need to live
through another day!

fields.EN:
He's far from someone who will
make matters worse for me!
fields.JP:
ジャックは
役立たずなんかじゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's far from someone who will
make matters worse for me!

fields.EN:
I guess I assumed wrong about how
you felt and your relationship.
Really, I'm so sorry...
fields.JP:
アリスの気持ちも、
２人の関係も知らないのに無神経に……
……本当にごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I assumed wrong about how
you felt and your relationship.
Really, I'm so sorry...

fields.EN:
Are you even listening to me?!
Jack is all that I live for!
Any more from you and I'll...!
fields.JP:
聞いてるの！？　ジャックはわたしのすべて、
わたしの生きる意味そのもの！
それを否定するならわたしはあなたを――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you even listening to me?!
Jack is all that I live for!
Any more from you and I'll...!

fields.JP:
アリスさん……
どうかそこまでにしてあげて下さい
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry...
I just lost it there...
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
わたし、ついカッとなってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry...
I just lost it there...

fields.EN:
No need to apologize. I'm the
one to apologize. Sorry for saying
what I said earlier.
fields.JP:
いや、悪いのはあたしだよ。
何も知らないのに、勝手なこと言って
ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to apologize. I'm the
one to apologize. Sorry for saying
what I said earlier.

fields.EN:
Alice? What she said may not have
been worded well, but she intended
for the best. Will you...?
fields.JP:
アリス、言葉は悪かったけど、
赤ずきんも君を心配してのことなんだ。
どうか許してやってくれないか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? What she said may not have
been worded well, but she intended
for the best. Will you...?

fields.EN:
...Yes, of course. But Akazukin-san,
please don't speak badly of Jack anymore...
fields.JP:
……ええ、もちろん。
だけど赤ずきんさん、どうかもう
ジャックのことを悪く言わないで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'll forgive her...
But please, don't say ill of Jack
again...

fields.EN:
Sure, I promise.
I won't say anything bad about
him, ever.
fields.JP:
うん。誓うよ。
もう絶対に悪く言ったりしない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, I promise.
I won't say anything bad about
him, ever.

fields.EN: Then you two, shake hands and make up. Once we escape, let's get to know each other better and all get along, okay?
fields.JP:
じゃあ２人とも、仲直りの握手です。
脱出したらもっと互いのことを知って、
みんな仲良くなりましょうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you both shake hands as
an act of friendship? We can get
to know each other better later.

fields.EN:
Sure... Um...
Sorry, and here's to later...
fields.JP:
はい……その、
よろしくお願いします……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure... Um...
Sorry, and here's to later...

fields.EN:
Will do, and let's get to know
each other better, Alice.
fields.JP: こちらこそよろしくね、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do, and let's get to know
each other better, Alice.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness that resolved
without bad blood.)
fields.JP: （よかった……どうにか収まった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness that resolved
without bad blood.)

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how furious
Alice was there though.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、
　アリスがこんなに怒るなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how furious
Alice was there though.)

fields.EN:
(I guess it just shows Alice's
affection towards Jack.)
fields.JP:
（それだけ、ジャックのことが
　大切で、好きってことなんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess it just shows Alice's
affection towards Jack.)

fields.EN:
All right, we're almost there!
Just a bit more folks!
fields.JP:
よし、もうすぐ出口だよ！
みんな頑張れ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, we're almost there!
Just a bit more folks!

fields.EN:
Huh? What's with the white mist?
What's going on?
fields.JP:
あれ、急に辺りが白く霧がかってきたわ……
どういうことなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's with the white mist?
What's going on?

fields.EN:
Everyone! We just need to get
through here to reach safety!
Run! Run with all you've got!
fields.JP:
みなさん！　このまままっすぐ行けば
人里に辿り着きますっ！
だから全速力で走って！　逃げるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! We just need to get
through here to reach safety!
Run! Run with all you've got!

fields.EN: If you don't want to die, run!
fields.JP:
死にたくなかったら
いいから走って！
fields.LOCALIZED: If you don't want to die, run!

fields.EN:
What's that white thing?!
It's coming at us,
Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
真っ白い何かが近づいてくる……！
あれは何なの赤ずきんさんっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's that white thing?!
It's coming at us,
Red Riding Hood!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: もしかして新手のメルヒェン……！？

fields.EN:
Worse!
It's way worse than any Marchen!
fields.JP:
あれはメルヒェンよりももっと
タチの悪い奴だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worse!
It's way worse than any Marchen!

fields.EN: It's a monster called a Nightmare that comes back to life again and again. Explanations later—run!
fields.JP:
何度でも蘇る化け物『ナイトメア』だよ。
細かい説明は後だ！　逃げるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a Nightmare that can't be
beat! I'll talk later, so just
run for it!

fields.JP:
あと少しなのに……
どうして……

fields.EN:
Ningyo, just run!
Alice! Don't let go of Jack!
fields.JP:
ほら人魚、走って！
アリスもジャックの手を離しちゃ駄目だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mermie, just run!
Alice! Don't let go of Jack!

fields.EN: No! It's going to get us!
fields.LOCALIZED: No! It's going to get us!

fields.EN:
It won't die no matter what!
We have to run!
fields.JP:
あいつは死なないから、
何があっても逃げるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It won't die no matter what!
We have to run!

fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
何とか、逃げ切ったな……

fields.EN:
Yeah, we're out from the
prison area...
fields.JP:
でもこれで何とか、
独房エリアから脱出ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we're out from the
prison area...

fields.EN:
But, there are more there
that didn't make it!
fields.JP: まだ逃げ遅れてる人たちが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, there are more there
that didn't make it!

fields.JP: 姫！　行ってはいけない！

fields.EN: That's right, Ningyo! We barely escaped with our lives as it is. Going back would only increase the casualties!
fields.JP:
そうだよ人魚！
今だって命からがらだったんだし、
戻っても犠牲が増えるだけよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Mermie!
We barely made it out alive.
Going back isn't the best idea!

fields.EN:
But! I can't just leave the
others there...
fields.JP:
でも、置いていくなんて……
やっぱりできません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But! I can't just leave the
others there...

fields.EN:
Everyone!
We need to drag her back!
fields.JP: みんな、人魚を連れ戻すよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone!
We need to drag her back!

fields.EN:
Everyone! I'll gather its
attention, so please run!
fields.JP:
みなさん！　わたしが引きつけている間に
早く逃げて下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! I'll gather its
attention, so please run!

fields.EN:
There's nothing to be afraid of...
You there! Come at me!
fields.JP:
大丈夫、怖くなんてないんだから……！
さあナイトメア、わたしはここです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing to be afraid of...
You there! Come at me!

fields.EN:
If I lose, even more will lose
their lives...
fields.JP:
わたしが負けたら、
もっと多くの人が死んじゃう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I lose, even more will lose
their lives...

fields.EN:
Haaaah!
Get away from my princess!
fields.JP:
うおぉぉぉっ！
姫に何をするっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haaaah!
Get away from my princess!

fields.JP: おつうちゃん！　みんな！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yes, there's no way we could let
someone as brave and kind as
you perish here!
fields.JP:
ええ、勇敢で優しいあなたを
死なせたりなんかしないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, there's no way we could let
someone as brave and kind as
you perish here!

fields.EN:
Everyone! Over here!
Let's get out of here!
fields.JP:
みなさん！　こっちです！
今のうちに走って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Over here!
Let's get out of here!

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack-san!
That should save all the remaining
prisoners here!
fields.JP:
ありがとうジャックさん……！
これで残された人たちは
みんな助かりました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack!
That should save all the remaining
prisoners here!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Which means we just need to take
you to safety, Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP: あとは人魚姫さんを助けるだけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means we just need to take
you to safety, Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Then I will be the bait.
I'll attract the Nightmare's
attention, so get her out of here.
fields.JP:
だったら、僕が囮になって
ナイトメアを引きつける。
その間に姫を救い出してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I will be the bait.
I'll attract the Nightmare's
attention, so get her out of here.

fields.JP:
分かったわ、おつう。
気をつけるのよ

fields.EN:
Once I bring Ningyo, you take her
and Jack, and get out of here.
Got it, Alice?
fields.JP:
あたしが人魚を連れ戻してくるから、
そうしたらジャックと人魚を連れて
アリスは先に逃げなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I bring Mermie, you take her
and Jack, and get out of here.
Got it, Alice?

fields.EN: Otsuu and I will definitely catch up with you afterward.
fields.JP:
あたしはおつうと一緒に
後から絶対に追いつくから、さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me and Otsuu will find our
way out ourselves!

fields.JP:
ええ、分かったわ。
赤ずきんさんも無茶しないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. Please be careful,
Red Riding Hood!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Looks like we have a plan then.
Let's do this!
fields.JP:
よし、決まったね。
じゃあ行くぞっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we have a plan then.
Let's do this!

fields.EN: Good! Its attention is off Ningyo! Now's my chance!!
fields.JP:
よし！　人魚から注意が逸れたっ！
今のうちっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! It's going away from Mermie!
Now's my chance!

fields.EN: Okay, Ningyo, you're safe. While Otsuu keeps it occupied, let's get back to Alice and the others—
fields.JP:
よし人魚、無事ね。
じゃあおつうが奴を引きつけてくれてる間に
アリスたちのところまで――
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did well, Mermie.
Let's get you out of here while
Otsuu has its attention...

fields.EN:
Hey! Where are you going?!
Alice! Run!
It's going after you!
fields.JP:
あっ！　待て化け物！
アリス、そっち行ったぞ！
一旦逃げるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Where are you going?!
Alice! Run!
It's going after you!

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine... Alice.
This is nothing compared to the
torture we went through...
fields.JP:
へ……平気だよアリス。
こんなの、いつもの拷問と同じだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine... Alice.
This is nothing compared to the
torture we went through...

fields.EN:
But... I'm sorry...
Looks like I knocked your
hairpin off...
fields.JP:
でも……ごめん、
はずみで髪飾りを取っちゃったね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I'm sorry...
Looks like I knocked your
hairpin off...

fields.EN:
Never mind that!
Look at you!
fields.JP:
そんなこといいから！
ケガしてるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never mind that!
Look at you!

fields.EN:
Otsuu and I will handle the
Nightmare. Ningyo, go to Jack!
fields.JP:
人魚、ナイトメアは
あたしとおつうで引き受ける！
ジャックのところに行ってあげて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and I will handle the
Nightmare. Mermie, go to Jack!

fields.EN:
Jack! I'm so sorry...!
It's all my fault for not being
able to avoid it...!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　わたしが動けなかった
ばかりにごめんなさい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! I'm so sorry...!
It's all my fault for not being
able to avoid it...!

fields.EN:
Alice-san, let me take care of Jack-san.
I'll need you to follow me, too.
fields.JP:
アリスさん、わたしが
ジャックさんを連れて行きます。
あなたも一緒についてきて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, let me take care of Jack.
I'll need you to follow me, too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san
Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Please hold onto the hairpin,
Jack. I want you to put that
on me later.
fields.JP:
ジャック、その髪飾り預かっていて。
後であなたに付けて貰いたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please hold onto the hairpin,
Jack. I want you to put that
on me later.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san...
Please take care of Jack.
fields.JP:
人魚姫さん、ジャックのこと、
よろしくお願いします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid...
Please take care of Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
No, Alice-san!
You're not fit to fight now!
fields.JP:
駄目ですアリスさん！　あなたは
もうまともに動ける状態ではありません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, Alice!
You're not fit to fight now!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
How dare you hurt Jack!
Aaaaaaaah!
fields.JP:
よくもジャックを傷つけたわね！
うぁぁぁぁぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you hurt Jack!
Aaaaaaaah!

fields.EN:
How dare you...
Dare you! Dare you! Dare you!
fields.JP:
よくもよくもよくもよくも
よくもおおおおおおっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you...
Dare you! Dare you! Dare you!

fields.JP: うあぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！
はぁーーーっ、はぁーーーっ……
アリス……あんたいったい……！

fields.EN:
Genocide...? No...
I've never seen anything like
that before...
fields.JP:
ジェノサイド化……ううん、違う……！
こんなの、見たことありません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Massacre...? No...
I've never seen anything like
that before...

fields.EN:
Alice! Calm down!
I know you're angry that Jack was
hurt, but we need to run, and...
fields.JP:
アリス落ち着け！
ジャックが傷つけられた怒りは分かるけど、
今は逃げないと――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice! Calm down!
I know you're angry that Jack was
hurt, but we need to run, and...

fields.EN:
Akazukin!
Move out of the way!
That's not the usual Alice!
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、離れろ！
アリスの様子がおかしい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood!
Move out of the way!
That's not the usual Alice!

fields.EN:
Alice?! What in the...?!
Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
アリス、どうして！？
自分を見失っちゃったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice?! What in the...?!
Get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: きゃっははははははっ！
ナイトメアを圧倒してる……！

fields.EN:
What should we do, Akazukin?! Can't we at least get my
princess and Jack out of here?!
fields.JP:
どうする赤ずきん！
今のうちに姫とジャックだけでも
逃がせないか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should we do, Red Riding
Hood?! Can't we at least get my
princess and Jack out of here?!

fields.EN:
Yeah, but we can't do that with
how unpredictable Alice is now!
fields.JP:
そんなこと言ったって、
アリスの動きが読めないじゃん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but we can't do that with
how unpredictable Alice is now!

fields.EN:
This is just too much!
What... What should we do?!
fields.JP:
乱戦すぎてもう訳が分からないよ……！
どうしたら、どうしたら……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is just too much!
What... What should we do?!

fields.EN:
Yikes! What a day!
I don't know what to do!
fields.JP:
わわっ！　もうヤだ！
何なのワケわかんないっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes! What a day!
I don't know what to do!

fields.EN:
Alice!
Get a hold of yourself!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice!
Get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: ひゃはっ！　あはははははっ！！

fields.EN:
Tch... We need to calm Alice
down somehow...
fields.JP:
くっ、どうしたらアリスは
元に戻るんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... We need to calm Alice
down somehow...

fields.JP:
（あのナイトメア……
　姫のことを狙っている……？）

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
Jack-san... Are you all right?
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
ジャックさん、ご無事ですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
Jack... Are you all right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: はい……何とか、生きてます……

fields.EN:
At least I'll get you out of here, Jack-san...
Come on, let's go...
fields.JP:
せめてジャックさんだけでも
逃がします……さあ、行きましょう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll get you out of here...
Let's go...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration
Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Are you all right, my princess?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you all right, my princess?

fields.EN:
This place is quite dangerous.
So please, leave here with
Jack at once, or else...
fields.JP:
さあ、ここは危険です。
早くジャックを連れて逃げて下さい
じゃないと――
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is quite dangerous.
So please, leave here with
Jack at once, or else...

fields.JP: きゃはっ！　きゃははははっ！！

fields.EN:
...we will be in a greater
predicament!
fields.JP: 本当に危険ですからっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...we will be in a greater
predicament!

fields.JP: アリス、もう止めるんだ！！

fields.EN:
Jack! Don't go!
There's no way to stop her now!
fields.JP:
ジャック、出てきてはいけない！
僕ももうアリスを止めきれない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! Don't go!
There's no way to stop her now!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうさん => Otsuu-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: ア、アリスなんてことを！

しまった！
衝撃で地面が崩れ……！

fields.EN:
Otsuu! Ningyo! Jack!
How could this happen...!
fields.JP:
おつう！　人魚！　ジャック！
なんで……みんな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Mermie! Jack!
How could this happen...!

fields.EN:
Tsuu... Urgh...
I can't reach her...
fields.JP:
つう……さん……
くっ……遠すぎて届かない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Urgh...
I can't reach her...
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Is this it...?
If so, then...
fields.JP:
もう、ダメなのか……
なら、せめて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this it...?
If so, then...

fields.EN: At least... this girl in my arms...
fields.JP: せめて、この腕の中の女の子だけは……

fields.EN:
Wh-Where am I?
What is this place...?
fields.JP:
どこだ……ここは……？
見たことない場所だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Where am I?
What is this place...?

fields.EN:
That's right...
I fell down, and... Ouch!
fields.JP:
そうか……
僕は崖から落ちて……づっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right...
I fell down, and... Ouch!

fields.EN:
Tch... It's not bad, but...
My body aches all over.
Well, at least I'm alive.
fields.JP:
ぐっ……骨は折れてない……けど、
身体中が軋んでるみたいだ。
でも、命があっただけマシか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... It's not bad, but...
My body aches all over.
Well, at least I'm alive.

fields.EN:
I can't believe I'm just aching
after falling from up there...
fields.JP:
随分高いところから落ちたみたいなのに、
よく助かったもんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe I'm just aching
after falling from up there...

fields.EN:
(What in the world was going
on with Alice though?)
fields.JP:
（それにしてもアリスのあの状態は、
　いったいなんだったのだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the world was going
on with Alice though?)

fields.EN:
(I've never seen a transformation
like that before, even among the
Blood Maidens I know.)
fields.JP:
（あんなの、血式少女隊の僕も
　知らない変化だったぞ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen a transformation
like that before, even among the
Blood Maidens I know.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe Alice is special.
Or maybe there's more to being
a Blood Maiden...)
fields.JP:
（アリスが特殊なのか、
　それともまだ僕も知らない何かが
　血式少女にはあるのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Alice is special.
Or maybe there's more to being
a Blood Maiden...)

fields.EN:
No matter. I better think of what
to do now.
fields.JP:
まあいいか。今はそれよりも
これからどう動くかを考えないとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter. I better think of what
to do now.

fields.JP:
それにしてもこの場所……
なんだろう……懐かしい感じがする。

fields.EN:
Wait a minute. I was here with...
Princess...? Akazukin...?
fields.JP:
そうだ、僕はここで誰かと……
姫？　赤ずきん……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute. I was here with...
Princess...? Red Riding Hood...?

fields.EN:
She should be down here too,
with Jack!
fields.JP:
確か一緒に落ちたはずだ、
姫もジャックも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She should be down here too,
with Jack!

fields.EN:
Where are you, my princess?!
Princess!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where are you, my princess?!
Princess!

fields.EN:
Princess! Are you here?!
Answer me!
fields.JP:
姫っ！　生きているんだろ！？
お願いだ！　返事をしてくれー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess! Are you here?!
Answer me!

fields.EN:
Why...?
Why aren't you answering me...?
fields.JP:
どうして……
どうして返事がないんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...?
Why aren't you answering me...?

fields.EN:
Where could they have gone?
Please, show yourselves...
fields.JP:
姫もジャックもどこに行ったんだよ……
頼むよ、出てきてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where could they have gone?
Please, show yourselves...

fields.EN:
Princess... Please be safe...
I promise I will not leave your
side ever again.
fields.JP:
姫……お願いだから無事でいてくれ……
もう２度と離れないって誓うから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess... Please be safe...
I promise I will not leave your
side ever again.

fields.EN:
No...
I need to stay strong...
fields.JP: 駄目だ、弱気になるな僕……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No...
I need to stay strong...

fields.EN:
I need to find her...
I will protect my princess...
fields.JP:
……必ず見つけなきゃ。
姫は僕が守るんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to find her...
I will protect my princess...

fields.EN:
Princess, don't you worry...
I will find you, I promise...
fields.JP:
姫、待ってて下さい……
絶対に見つけ出しますからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, don't you worry...
I will find you, I promise...

fields.EN:
My princess must be crying.
I'm the only one who can wipe
her tears clean.
fields.JP:
そうだ……姫はきっと泣いてる。
その涙を拭ってやれるのは、きっと
僕だけなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess must be crying.
I'm the only one who can wipe
her tears clean.

fields.EN: I need to find her, quick...
fields.JP: だから早く見つけてあげないと……
fields.LOCALIZED: I need to find her, quick...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
It's princess!
I can hear her voice!
fields.JP: 間違いない、姫の声だっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's princess!
I can hear her voice!

fields.JP: 姫！　どこにいるんだ、姫！

fields.EN:
Jack-san...! I patched you up,
so please... just hold on
awhile longer!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……！
応急手当はしましたから、
もう少しの辛抱です……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack...! I patched you up,
so please... just hold on
awhile longer!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I'm sure help is on its way...
So please, stay with me!
fields.JP:
もう少しできっと、助けが来ますから……
だから頑張って……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure help is on its way...
So please, stay with me!

fields.EN:
Get a hold of yourself...!
You want to meet Alice-san again,
right?!
fields.JP:
気をしっかり……！
アリスさんにまた会いたいでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Get a hold of yourself...!
You want to meet Alice again,
right?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san
Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, what should I do?!
Jack-san... Jack-san is...!
fields.JP:
どうしよう、おつうちゃん……！
ジャックさんが、ジャックさんが……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, what should I do?!
Jack... Jack is...!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I covered his wounds, but his
bleeding... It's not stopping!
fields.JP:
傷口は何とか塞いだの。
なのに、血が止まらないの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I covered his wounds, but his
bleeding... It's not stopping!

fields.JP: このままじゃジャックさんが……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(It's clear he's not going to make
it. Nothing I do will help...)
fields.JP:
（素人目で見てもひどい傷だ……
　僕にはどうすることも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's clear he's not going to make
it. Nothing I do will help...)

fields.EN:
Please, Otsuu-chan...
I want to help Jack-san!
fields.JP:
ねえおつうちゃん、
わたし、ジャックさん助けたいよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, Otsuu...
I want to help Jack!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I-I would love to do so too,
but...
fields.JP:
そ、それは僕だって助けたい……
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I would love to do so too,
but...

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Did you find a way
out of here by any chance?
fields.JP:
……ねえおつうちゃん、ここに来るまでに、
崖の上に出る道とか見なかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Did you find a way
out of here by any chance?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
If we carry Jack-san back to the Dawn right
away, he might make it!
fields.JP:
ジャックさんを背負って
すぐに黎明に戻れば、なんとかなるかも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we carry and take him back to
Dawn, he may survive!

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I didn't find any
path out of here.
fields.JP: いや、僕が来た方にはそんな道はなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I didn't find any
path out of here.

fields.JP: じゃあ、あっちの方角なら！

fields.EN:
T-Then I'll go look, so Otsuu-chan, keep an
eye on Jack-san!
fields.JP:
そ、それじゃあわたしが探してくるから、
おつうちゃんはジャックさんを看てて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, let me go and look
around! Please keep watch of him,
Otsuu!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
Coming here was quite dangerous,
and it isn't safe...
fields.JP:
ここに来るまでの道のりも……
充分に危険だったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming here was quite dangerous,
and it isn't safe...

fields.EN:
(I can't leave her alone here...
But at this rate...)
fields.JP:
（こんな危険な場所に、
　姫を残して行きたくない。
　だけど、このままじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't leave her alone here...
But at this rate...)

fields.EN:
Let me go and find a way out...
You stay here. If in danger,
hide somewhere with Jack.
fields.JP:
だから僕が……道を探してくるよ……
姫はここにいて。いざとなったら
ジャックと二人でどこかに隠れるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me go and find a way out...
You stay here. If in danger,
hide somewhere with Jack.

fields.EN:
(Even if I do find a way out,
I'm not sure Jack will be
able to make it to Dawn...)
fields.JP:
（今から道を探しに行って……
　仮に見つかったとして、
　黎明までジャックが持つのかどうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if I do find a way out,
I'm not sure Jack will be
able to make it to Dawn...)

fields.EN:
(But, I can't leave her here
in danger's way...)
fields.JP:
（でもここで更に姫まで
　危険にさらすわけにはいかない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, I can't leave her here
in danger's way...)

fields.EN:
(I don't want Jack to die,
but...)
fields.JP:
（もちろんジャックは
　死なせたくないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want Jack to die,
but...)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
自分が……も、っと……
強かっ……たら……

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're still
thinking about Alice...
fields.JP:
ジャック、君はそんな状態でも
アリスのことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're still
thinking about Alice...

fields.JP:
ジャックさん……！
あなたはちゃんと守れてましたよ……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Alice-san is safe!
So you need to go and see her!
fields.JP:
だからアリスさんは無事です！
会いに行ってあげなければ駄目ですよぅ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice is safe!
So you need to go and see her!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP:
ジャックさん駄目です、
意識をしっかり持って……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: 何だこの不気味な弦は……！

fields.EN:
What...? Vines are growing from
Jack-san's body...?
fields.JP:
どういうことなの……？
ジャックさんの身体を覆うこの弦は何……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...? Vines are growing from
Jack's body...?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Is this... Jack-san's power?
Or is it...?
fields.JP:
これはジャックさんの力なの、
それとも……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this... Jack's power?
Or is it...?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I don't know what it is, but
we should get rid of them before
the vines cover him completely!
fields.JP:
姫、よくわからないが、早く解かないと
ジャックが弦に完全に取り込まれてしまう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what it is, but
we should get rid of them before
the vines cover him completely!

fields.EN:
Jack-san, wake up!
Your body is being...!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん目を覚まして……！
じゃないとあなたの身体がどんどん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, wake up!
Your body is being...!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Tch...! The vines keep sprouting
out of him...!
fields.JP:
くっ……むしってもむしっても、
次から次へと弦が生えてくる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...! The vines keep sprouting
out of him...!

fields.EN:
Urrh...! No matter how many
I pull, they keep growing back!
fields.JP: うぅっ……弦が多くて取り切れない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...! No matter how many
I pull, they keep growing back!

fields.EN:
Please! Don't cover over Jack-san's
body! Don't!
Nooooo!
fields.JP:
ねえ、お願いだから
ジャックさんを閉じ込めないで！
いやぁぁぁっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please! Don't cover over Jack's
body! Don't!
Nooooo!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Excuse me here, my princess!
I'll slice them off!
fields.JP:
姫、ちょっとごめん！
弦を叩っ切る！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me here, my princess!
I'll slice them off!

fields.EN:
Let go of Jack!
Damn it! Damn it! Damn it!
fields.JP:
ジャックを放せ！
くそっ、くそっ、くそっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let go of Jack!
Damn it! Damn it! Damn it!

fields.EN:
It's no use! They just keep
growing back no matter what!
fields.JP:
駄目だ、斬っても斬っても
やっぱりすぐに新しいのが生えてくる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use! They just keep
growing back no matter what!

fields.EN:
Please, oh please!
Don't take over Jack-san's body!
fields.JP:
お願いだからジャックさんを
閉じ込めないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, oh please!
Don't take over Jack's body!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(The vines are bloating Jack's
flesh, and changing his body's
shape and size...)
fields.JP:
（弦にまとわりつかれた
　ジャックの皮膚が肥大して……
　どんどん変形していく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The vines are bloating Jack's
flesh, and changing his body's
shape and size...)

fields.EN: What in the world is happening?!
fields.JP: これから何が始まるって言うんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What in the world is happening?!

fields.JP:
いやあっ、ジャックさん！
ジャックさん……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
It's no use! He's bloating even
larger now! We can't stop it!
fields.JP:
駄目だ、肥大化が止まらない……！
それにどこまでも変形して……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use! He's bloating even
larger now! We can't stop it!

fields.JP:
（どんどんおぞましい感じに
　ジャックが変わっていく……！）

fields.EN:
This isn't Jack-san...!
I-I can't watch...!
fields.JP:
こんなの、もうジャックさんじゃない……！
わたしもう、見ていられないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't Jack...!
I-I can't watch...!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ジャック、君はいったい……

それじゃあまるで……
ナイトメアじゃないか……

ですよね……？
ジャックさんなんですよね……？
fields.notes: Line-level source-gated honorific restoration; automatic occurrence matching was ambiguous.

fields.JP: いったいどうしてそんな姿に……

fields.EN:
Princess, please stand back.
Don't go near him...
fields.JP:
姫、下がっていて下さい
……近づいたら、危険だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, please stand back.
Don't go near him...

fields.EN:
(There's no denying... He took on
the form of a Nightmare!)
fields.JP:
（だってこの姿はどう見ても
　ナイトメア……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no denying... He took on
the form of a Nightmare!)

fields.EN:
Hey! Don't you dare lay a finger
on my princess, you hear?!
fields.JP:
おい！　姫に指一本でも触れてみろ
タダじゃ済まさないぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Don't you dare lay a finger
on my princess, you hear?!

fields.JP: （そうだ、僕は必ず姫を守るんだ……）

fields.EN:
(I need to "repay" my debt by
protecting Ningyohime...!)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫を守るっていう
　『恩返し』を成し遂げるんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to "repay" my debt by
protecting Little Mermaid...!)

fields.EN:
(What the...? My head...
My chest... It hurts...!)
fields.JP:
（急に頭がクラクラして……
　胸も……苦しいっ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the...? My head...
My chest... It hurts...!)

fields.JP:
（くっ……こんな時に……
　また起きてしまうなんて……！）

fields.EN:
(Calm yourself...
If I faint here, who will protect
my dear princess...!)
fields.JP:
（落ち着け、落ち着け……
　僕が倒れたら誰が姫を守るんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Calm yourself...
If I faint here, who will protect
my dear princess...!)

fields.EN:
(I need to protect her
at all costs!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to protect her
at all costs!)

fields.EN:
(I can sense something odd in
my mind, but... it feels warm and
cozy...)
fields.JP:
（頭に……ぐちゃぐちゃの思考が……
　でもほんの少し……温かい……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can sense something odd in
my mind, but... it feels warm and
cozy...)

fields.EN:
(Is this coming from Jack...?
This warmth... is his soul?)
fields.JP:
（これはジャックの感覚……？
　この温かさは……彼の残った心……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this coming from Jack...?
This warmth... is his soul?)

fields.EN: Wait... Is it really you, Jack?
fields.JP: まさか、ジャック……君なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait... Is it really you, Jack?

fields.EN:
(I don't sense any hostility from
him. It doesn't seem like he'll
attack, but...)
fields.JP:
（襲ってくる気配はない。
　敵意はなさそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't sense any hostility from
him. It doesn't seem like he'll
attack, but...)

fields.EN:
(Wait... Come to think of it,
the pain and dizziness is...
gone?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、そういえば眩暈も動悸も、
　いつのまにか収まってる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... Come to think of it,
the pain and dizziness is...
gone?)

fields.EN:
Say, Jack?
Can you hear me?
fields.JP:
なあ、ジャック
僕の声が聞こえるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack?
Can you hear me?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: ジャック！　やっぱり君は……！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……あ゛り、ず……
ま゛も……る……ちぎぎぎ……

fields.EN:
(Jack... So, your soul is still
residing within you...)
fields.JP:
（ジャック……君はやっぱり
　まだ心が残って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack... So, your soul is still
residing within you...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづう……んぎちち……
……いぎで……みみみ……
ナイトメア・ジャック

……よがっ……た……
みちち……んぎぎっ……

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm alive.
Your thought is appreciated.
fields.JP:
……ああ、生きてたよ。
心配してくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm alive.
Your thought is appreciated.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan?
You can speak with Jack-san?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
ジャックさんとお話ができるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu?
You can speak with Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I don't know why, but...
I suppose I can...
fields.JP:
自分でも不思議なんだけど……
どうやらそうみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know why, but...
I suppose I can...

fields.JP: 完全には分からないけれどね……

fields.EN:
But, I do know Jack has no
intention of harming us.
It looks like we're safe for now.
fields.JP:
でもジャックに敵意がないことは分かった。
今のところ、危険性はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I do know Jack has no
intention of harming us.
It looks like we're safe for now.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I see...
I suppose that's a bit of a relief.
fields.JP:
そっか……
それは少しだけ、よかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I suppose that's a bit of a relief.

fields.EN:
Not that we should be happy
about this...
fields.JP: 手放しでは喜べないけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that we should be happy
about this...

fields.EN: (That said, I don't know whether it'll stay safe like this, or if it's only being quiet for now...)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、ずっと安全なのか、
　今だけおとなしいだけなのか、
　分からないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know if he'll be like
this the whole time, or maybe
turn on us down the line...)

fields.EN:
(His words are hard to tell,
and I can't really comprehend
him fully.)
fields.JP:
（言葉も拙くて、
　いまいち要領を得ないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(His words are hard to tell,
and I can't really comprehend
him fully.)

fields.EN:
(There's so little going for
him to make me fully trust him...)
fields.JP:
（完全に心を許すには、
　根拠が心許ないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's so little going for
him to make me fully trust him...)

fields.EN:
This is all happening so
suddenly. I have no idea
what's going on here...
fields.JP:
短い間に色々ありすぎて、
わたし、もうよく分からないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is all happening so
suddenly. I have no idea
what's going on here...

fields.EN:
True. It's best to determine what
is really going on, but first we
need to find a safer place.
fields.JP:
確かに、しっかりと状況確認したいですね。
ですが姫、ここは危険のようだ。
ひとまず安全な場所を探しましょう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. It's best to determine what
is really going on, but first we
need to find a safer place.

fields.EN: Jack! Aren't you going to come?
fields.JP: どうしたジャック、早く行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! Aren't you going to come?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

……ぼ……にぎぎ……
いっ……しょ……みちちい……？

fields.EN:
There's no need to worry.
Now come, let's go!
fields.JP:
もしかして遠慮してるのか？
いいからほら、行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no need to worry.
Now come, let's go!

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I understand
Jack like this...?)
fields.JP:
（でもどうして僕が、
　ジャックの感覚を理解できるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I understand
Jack like this...?)

fields.EN:
(I don't know why, but what I do
know is that I will protect my
princess no matter what...)
fields.JP:
（分からない……でも、何があろうと
　姫だけは絶対に守るんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know why, but what I do
know is that I will protect my
princess no matter what...)

fields.EN:
I know it's late to ask, but
are you all right, my princess?
fields.JP:
今さらだけど姫、
どこも怪我はしてないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's late to ask, but
are you all right, my princess?

fields.EN:
I'm fine. Actually, you look
worse than I do, Otsuu-chan.
Are you okay?
fields.JP:

fields.EN:
(I guess that's how it feels
to be... a Nightmare...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's how it feels
to be... a Nightmare...)

fields.EN:
Is this place... a prison...?
I guess we won't find
the exit around here.
fields.JP:
ここは……牢獄かな？
だとしたら出口はこっちじゃないかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this place... a prison...?
I guess we won't find
the exit around here.

fields.JP: そうだな、引き返そうか……

fields.EN:
You're the one we saw
earlier!
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one we saw
earlier!

fields.EN:
You're... the two who were
in prison, right?
fields.JP: 君たちは……確か上で捕まってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're... the two who were
in prison, right?

fields.JP: こんな場所までどうやって……！？

fields.EN:
Thank goodness!
Looks like we're saved!
fields.JP:
あぁ～助かったでござる～！
拙者助かったでござる～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness!
Looks like we're saved!

fields.EN:
I can't believe there are
more imprisoned here!
fields.JP:
こんなところに
捕まってる人たちがいたなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe there are
more imprisoned here!

fields.EN:
Looks like our luck hasn't run
out yet. Can you let us out...?
fields.JP:
まだ俺たちにもツキは残ってるみたいだな。
ちょうどいい、ここから出し……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like our luck hasn't run
out yet. Can you let us out...?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
う、うしっ、後ろっ、化け物っ……！！
ナイトメア・ジャック
ひぃぃ何か喋ったぁぁぁっ！！

fields.EN:
Hey! Look behind you!
You got a monster there!
fields.JP:
おい！　気づいてねえのか！？
後ろに化けもんいるってんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Look behind you!
You got a monster there!

fields.EN: Please, make a run for it!
fields.LOCALIZED: Please, make a run for it!

fields.EN:
Ah... It's all right, everyone. Jack-san isn't
scary.
fields.JP:
ああ……大丈夫ですよ、みなさん。
ジャックさんは怖くありませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, we're fine, everyone.
There's nothing to be afraid of.

fields.EN: Yes. Jack is a Nightmare, but... he's kind. He's harmless.
fields.JP:
そう、ジャックはナイトメアだけど……
優しいんだ。害はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Jack may have become a
Nightmare, but he's still as kind
as he was before.

fields.EN:
Wait...
I heard that name before...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
I heard that name before...

fields.EN:
Don't tell me he's that guy who
was in the cell next to us?
fields.JP: もしかして、俺たちの隣の牢にいた奴か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me he's that guy who
was in the cell next to us?

fields.EN:
There should've been a girl
called Alice with him, but...
Is that really Jack?
fields.JP:
アリスって女が一緒にいたんだが……
……そのジャックか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There should've been a girl
called Alice with him, but...
Is that really Jack?

fields.JP: そういえば知り合いだったみたいだね

fields.EN:
We only spoke behind the walls,
so we never had the chance to
see anyone's face.
fields.JP:
お互い壁越しに話してただけで、
顔も見たことがなかったけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We only spoke behind the walls,
so we never had the chance to
see anyone's face.

fields.EN:
Still, you're hard pressed to find
someone who's willing to talk
in this god-forsaken place.
fields.JP:
だが、こんなクソッタレな場所じゃ、
話ができるってだけで貴重な相手だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, you're hard pressed to find
someone who's willing to talk
in this god-forsaken place.

fields.EN:
We talked about how we would
escape from this place one day...
fields.JP:
いつかここを脱獄してやるって、
ずっと話してたよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We talked about how we would
escape from this place one day...

fields.JP:
ってことは本当に
そのジャックなんだな？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Don't worry. You were friends
with them once before.
fields.JP:
大丈夫、心配しなくていいよ
彼らは以前の君と……友人だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. You were friends
with them once before.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That's some makeover he has
there... What the hell happened?
fields.JP:
短い間にずいぶんな変わりようじゃねえか。
いったい何があったんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's some makeover he has
there... What the hell happened?

fields.EN: I guess that's about all I can say...
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess that's about all I can say...

fields.EN:
I see. So the ones who were
causing all the stir up there
were you folks.
fields.JP:
そうか、あの暴れてた人間たちは
おまえらだったんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So the ones who were
causing all the stir up there
were you folks.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens, eh?
I heard of them through rumors,
but actually seeing one is...
fields.JP:
血式少女……ね。
噂には聞いてたが、おまえらが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens, eh?
I heard of them through rumors,
but actually seeing one is...

fields.EN:
Say, are you sure the thing
behind you is Jack?
fields.JP:
ねえ、その子、
本当にあのジャックなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, are you sure the thing
behind you is Jack?

fields.EN:
We don't know why this happened,
but we do know for sure that the
Nightmare here is Jack-san.
fields.JP:
こうなった理由は分からないですけど、
でもこのナイトメアは確かに
ジャックさんなんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know why this happened,
but we do know for sure that the
Nightmare here is Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Guess I shouldn't be surprised
coming from this warped world...
fields.JP: こんな世界なら……何でもあり、か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess I shouldn't be surprised
coming from this warped world...

fields.EN:
Well, at least I was right about
you. You're definitely one tough kid.
fields.JP:
ジャック、やっぱりおまえは
俺の見込んだ通り、勇気のある奴だったよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, at least I was right about
you. You're definitely one tough kid.

fields.EN:
Too bad you turned into that
ugly-looking thing, but...
Here's hoping we get along.
fields.JP:
そんな姿になっちまったのは残念だけどよ、
でもまあ――よろしくな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad you turned into that
ugly-looking thing, but...
Here's hoping we get along.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Let me open the cell.
Stand back...
fields.JP:
今から牢を開ける。
少し下がっててくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me open the cell.
Stand back...

fields.EN:
That makes it twice you let us
out. Thank you.
fields.JP:
２回も助けてくれて
本当にありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That makes it twice you let us
out. Thank you.

fields.EN:
Yeah, what a lifesaver.
Thanks a million.
fields.JP:
ああ、助かったぜ。
ありがとな、おまえら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, what a lifesaver.
Thanks a million.

fields.EN:
Why don't you save the thanks
until we get out of here. There's
no telling when we'll be attacked.
fields.JP:
礼を言うのはまだ早いよ。どこから
メルヒェンが襲ってくるか分からない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you save the thanks
until we get out of here. There's
no telling when we'll be attacked.

fields.EN:
Damn it! There goes being happy
about getting out of the cell!
fields.JP: くそっ、牢から出てすぐこれかよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! There goes being happy
about getting out of the cell!

fields.EN:
Everyone, please stay behind me
and Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
みなさん、わたしとおつうちゃんの
後ろに隠れてて下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, please stay behind me
and Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Wait just a second, my princess...
Something's not right...
fields.JP:
……いや、ちょっと待ってくれ姫。
なにか様子がおかしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait just a second, my princess...
Something's not right...

fields.EN:
