What's with that Marchen?
What's it doing?
fields.JP: なんだ……このメルヒェンの動きは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with that Marchen?
What's it doing?

fields.JP: どこかに案内しようとしてる……？

fields.EN:
(Could it be a trap?
It's risky to assume it's safe
following it...)
fields.JP:
（罠か……？
　ついていくのは危険だろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Could it be a trap?
It's risky to assume it's safe
following it...)

fields.EN:
(But with everyone tired, and with
more in the party, I'd rather like
to avoid unnecessary battles...)
fields.JP:
（けど僕も姫も疲労が溜まっている上に、
　さらには民間人を抱えている。
　できるなら不要な戦闘は避けたい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But with everyone tired, and with
more in the party, I'd rather like
to avoid unnecessary battles...)

fields.EN: I dunno. It doesn't look very smart.
fields.JP: あまり知性があるようには見えねえよな
fields.LOCALIZED: I dunno. It doesn't look very smart.

fields.EN:
Say, Marchen?
Are you trying to lead us
because of Jack here?
fields.JP:
なあメルヒェン、
もしかしてジャックがいるからなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Marchen?
Are you trying to lead us
because of Jack here?

fields.EN:
I suppose we don't have much
of a choice. Let's see where it
wants to take us.
fields.JP:
仕方ない。
……ついて行ってみるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we don't have much
of a choice. Let's see where it
wants to take us.

fields.EN:
It's not like there are many of
them around, so can't we make
a run for it?
fields.JP:
なぁ、メルヒェンは多くないし、
今なら逃げられるんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like there are many of
them around, so can't we make
a run for it?

fields.EN:
I wouldn't count on it.
Look behind you...
fields.JP:
いや、止めておいた方がいいね。
後ろ見てみなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't count on it.
Look behind you...

fields.EN:
Huh, so there are a lot more
of them looking from afar...
fields.JP:
なるほど、遠巻きに
たくさん見てやがるのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, so there are a lot more
of them looking from afar...

fields.EN:
We'll find the right timing to
run, but now is not the time.
fields.JP:
いつかは逃げるけど、もう少し待とう。
チャンスはいつか来る
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll find the right timing to
run, but now is not the time.

fields.EN:
Well, why don't we use our time
now to introduce ourselves then?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、今のうちに
自己紹介でもしませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, why don't we use our time
now to introduce ourselves then?

fields.EN:
This isn't exactly the best time
to make introductions, you know?
fields.JP: 自己紹介って……緊張感ねえなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't exactly the best time
to make introductions, you know?

fields.EN:
No, I think it's a splendid idea.
Not knowing who you are makes it
difficult to work together.
fields.JP:
いや、いざという時に名前も分からないと、
連携の取りようもない。いい案だと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I think it's a splendid idea.
Not knowing who you are makes it
difficult to work together.

fields.JP: 必要性はまあ、分かるんだけどよ……

fields.EN:
...So let me see. The lady there
is Kaede, and the guy with the
ponytail is Itsuki.
fields.JP:
――では、そちらの女性がカエデ、
ポニーテールの人がイツキ、だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So let me see. The lady there
is Kaede, and the guy with the
ponytail is Itsuki.

fields.EN:
Yeah, thanks for saving us
back there.
fields.JP: 本当に助かったよ、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, thanks for saving us
back there.

fields.EN:
The person with the hairband is
Takumi-san, and you two are Mamoru-san
and Hikari-chan, right?
fields.JP:
そしてヘアバンドの人がタクミさん、
で、マモルさんにヒカリちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The person with the hairband is
Takumi, and you two are Mamoru
and Hikari, right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: タクミさん => Takumi-san; マモルさん => Mamoru-san; ヒカリちゃん => Hikari-chan

fields.EN: Don't ya forget about me, okay?
fields.JP: あたいのこと、覚えといてよね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't ya forget about me, okay?

fields.EN:
Let me see...
You're Ningyohime, she's
Otsuu-kun, and that's... Jack, right?
fields.JP:
そっちが、おつうくんに人魚姫、
そしてジャック……だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see...
You're Little Mermaid, she's
Otsuu, and that's... Jack, right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Why yes, pleased to meet
everyone...
fields.JP:
はいっ、よろしくお願いします
みなさん――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, pleased to meet
everyone...

fields.EN:
The Marchens are...
filing in order?
fields.JP: メルヒェンが整列を始めた……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens are...
filing in order?

fields.JP: ふふ……来たか、人間どもよ

fields.EN:
Welcome to my labyrinth.
I have been waiting for you.
fields.JP:
ようこそ、ワレの迷宮へ。
ワレは貴様たちを待っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Welcome to my labyrinth.
I have been waiting for you.

fields.EN:
A Marchen? No... It's...
She's speaking our language.
fields.JP:
メルヒェン……？
……待て、人間の言葉を喋っている……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Marchen? No... It's...
She's speaking our language.

fields.EN:
But, she's controlling all these
Marchens...
fields.JP: でもメルヒェンを従えているよ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she's controlling all these
Marchens...

fields.JP: 君はいったい何者なんだ？

fields.EN: Hm, you ask who I am?
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm, you ask who I am?

fields.EN:
So, you are asking...
for my name, are you?
fields.JP:
それは……
ワレの『名前』を聞いておるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you are asking...
for my name, are you?

fields.EN:
(I can't let her think she has the
upper hand. I need to be strong!)
fields.JP:
（弱いと思われたら終わりだ、
　ここは強気に攻めるべき……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't let her think she has the
upper hand. I need to be strong!)

fields.EN:
That's right!
State your name, now!
fields.JP: そうだ！　名前と素性を明かしてもらおう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right!
State your name, now!

fields.EN:
Hm... I suppose this is what
my "name" is supposed to be,
but I am not sure myself.
fields.JP:
ふむ……実を言うと、
これが本当にワレの名前なのか、
自信はないのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I suppose this is what
my "name" is supposed to be,
but I am not sure myself.

fields.EN:
Yes, I am the lord of this
labyrinth. I am Hameln,
the great Demon Kyng!
fields.JP:
そうだ、ワレはこの迷宮を支配する者……
魔王ハーメルンと呼びゅぎゃよい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I am the lord of this
labyrinth. I am Hameln,
the great Demon Kyng!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
I didn't hear you well.
Could you repeat that?
fields.JP:
……ごめん、もう１回
言ってもらってもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I didn't hear you well.
Could you repeat that?

fields.EN:
I am Hameln,
the great Demon Lyyrd!
fields.JP: そうだ、ワレはこの迷宮を支配しゅるもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am Hameln,
the great demyon lyyrd!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
To add, she slurred more
than her first try...
fields.JP: しかも今度は前半で噛んじゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, she slurred more
than her first try...

fields.EN:
Um, can I ask you something,
Hameln?
fields.JP: ちょっといいか、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, can I ask you something,
Hameln?

fields.EN:
You can't say a single word
well, can you?
fields.JP: 一言でも噛めるんだねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't say a single word
well, can you?

fields.EN:
What are you doing here?
I'm assuming you're the one who
sent the Marchen to lead us here.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンはここで何をしてるんだ？
それに僕たちを連れてこさせたのは
君だよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing here?
I'm assuming you're the one who
sent the Marchen to lead us here.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I ordered them to
gather you humans here.
fields.JP:
いかにも。こやつらに命じて、
人間どもを集めさせたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I ordered them to
gather you humans here.

fields.JP: 何が目的で人間を集めてるんだ？

fields.EN:
(I suppose it's to torture us
like all the others...)
fields.JP:
（やはり拷問とか、
　そういう目的なんだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose it's to torture us
like all the others...)

fields.EN:
As you can see, there are no
other humans here. I was playing
with them for my entire life.
fields.JP:
見ての通り、ここには人間がおらぬ。
ワレはここで生まれてからずっと
こやつらと遊んでおったのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you can see, there are no
other humans here. I was playing
with them for my entire life.

fields.EN:
But, none of them can speak.
I was getting quite bored when
I found this...
fields.JP:
なんせこやつらは言葉が通じぬ。
いい加減に退屈になってきたところで、
ワレはこんなモノを見つけた
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, none of them can speak.
I was getting quite bored when
I found this...

fields.EN:
I read this to learn that these
"humans" can speak. Hence,
I had them lead you all here.
fields.JP:
これを読んで、人間という
言葉が通じるヤツらがいることを知った。
それでこやつらに連れてこさせたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read this to learn that these
"humans" can speak. Hence,
I had them lead you all here.

fields.EN:
You will all become my slaves,
and will play tag with me...
forevyr!
fields.JP:
つまり貴様らは、ワレの下僕として
一緒に『鬼ごっこ』で遊ぶ必要があるにょだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will all become my slaves,
and will play tag with me...
forevyr!

fields.EN: Way to slip your line there.
fields.JP: 肝心なところで噛むね
fields.LOCALIZED: Way to slip your line there.

fields.EN:
So, when you say "tag"
what are you really trying
to say?
fields.JP:
で、鬼ごっこって言うけど、このメンツで
どういう感じで遊ぶつもりなんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, when you say "tag"
what are you really trying
to say?

fields.EN:
What? You don't know the rules
to the game? Let me show you...
You there! Run!
fields.JP:
なんだルールを知らんのか？
なら教えてやる！　おいお前、逃げろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You don't know the rules
to the game? Let me show you...
You there! Run!

fields.EN:
(She really does have control
over these Marchens...)
fields.JP: （メルヒェンに本当に命令できるんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She really does have control
over these Marchens...)

fields.EN:
Listen well!
You will run like shown!
I will then chase after you!
fields.JP:
いいか？　貴様らはこうやって逃げる！
ワレはそれを追いかける！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen well!
You will run like shown!
I will then chase after you!

fields.EN:
Once I catch you,
I will crush you like so...!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I catch you,
I will crush you like so...!

fields.EN:
Simple, yes?
You run and I chase.
fields.JP: とまあ、ワレに捕まったらこうなる遊びだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simple, yes?
You run and I chase.

fields.JP: おいおい、勘違いしすぎだろ……

fields.EN:
What?! I learned it from this
manga! It must be correct!
fields.JP:
何を言う、漫画に描いてあったのだ！
これが正しい遊び方に決まっておる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I learned it from this
manga! It must be correct!

fields.EN:
Her eyes... changed color!
Is she a Marchen?
fields.JP:
目の色まで変わってるし……！　本当に
この子、メルヒェンとかじゃないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her eyes... changed color!
Is she a Marchen?

fields.EN:
No... Her eyes turned pink after
being exposed to Marchen blood.
She's...
fields.JP:
いえ、メルヒェンの返り血で
ピンク色に変化したあの瞳は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... Her eyes turned pink after
being exposed to Marchen blood.
She's...

fields.EN:
Yes, Hameln is...
a Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
ああ、間違いない。
ハーメルンは血式少女だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, Hameln is...
a Blood Maiden!

fields.JP:
血式少女？
本当かよ、それ！

fields.EN:
What are you all pratting about?
Now, let's play by letting me
crush you all!
fields.JP:
何をごちゃごちゃ話しておる？
さあ、楽しく叩き潰させてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you all pratting about?
Now, let's play by letting me
crush you all!

fields.JP: これ、やばいパターンよね……？

fields.EN:
We should teach her what the
proper rules are.
fields.JP: ちゃんとルールを教えた方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should teach her what the
proper rules are.

fields.JP:
そ、そうですね。
早く訂正しないと……！

fields.EN:
Run as far as you can!
It's not fun if I catch you
too quickly!
fields.JP:
ちゃんと遠くまで逃げるのだぞ！
すぐ終わってはつまらぬからな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Run as far as you can!
It's not fun if I catch you
too quickly!

fields.EN: Then I'll count ten seconds and chase you! Oooone...
fields.JP:
では１０秒数えたら追いかけるぞ！
いーち…………
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to count to ten.
Ready? One...

fields.EN:
My princess, I doubt we have time.
She started to count.
fields.JP:
姫、あいつカウント始めてしまった！
もう訂正してる時間はない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess, I doubt we have time.
She started to count.

fields.EN:
I suppose we should run while
we still can. Let's hurry!
fields.JP:
みんな、こうなったら
逃げるしかない！　行くぞっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we should run while
we still can. Let's hurry!

fields.JP: 姫！　みんなの先導を頼む！
僕は最後尾からついてくから！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Thank you, Jack. You escape with everyone too. I'm counting on you... to take care of them.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジャック。
君も一緒に逃げてくれ。
みんなを……頼む
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack.
But, you run ahead with them.
Please stay with them.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
どこか隠れるとこないの！？

fields.EN:
No such place here!
Just keep running!
fields.JP:
そんなものない！
いいから走れ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No such place here!
Just keep running!

fields.JP: くっ……走るのは苦手だってのに……

fields.EN:
You folks really have to get some
exercise. All the girls here are
way healthier than you.
fields.JP:
あんたねぇ、ちったぁ体力つけなよ。
こんな女の子にまで負けてんじゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
You folks really have to get some
exercise. All the girls here are
way healthier than you.

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
I'd rather... focus on...
my aptitudes... thank you...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
I'd rather... focus on...
my aptitudes... thank you...

fields.EN:
Do your best! I'm sure we'll be
safe once we get out of here!
fields.JP:
頑張って！　逃げ切ったら
きっと帰れるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do your best! I'm sure we'll be
safe once we get out of here!

fields.JP: とは言っても……もう、足が……
イツキ！　転んでんじゃねえ、起きろっ！！

fields.EN:
N-Never mind me!
Just keep running!
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕のことはいいっ！
気にせず逃げるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Never mind me!
Just keep running!

fields.EN:
Oh? So, you're first, eh?
Guess you're my first prey!
fields.JP:
おや、最初は貴様か！
では捕まえるぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So, you're first, eh?
Guess you're my first prey!

fields.EN:
Stop!
I won't let you kill him!
fields.JP:
止まって下さい！
この人は殺させはしませんっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop!
I won't let you kill him!

fields.EN:
Princess! Bravado and
foolhardiness are two
separate things!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess! Bravado and
foolhardiness are two
separate things!

fields.EN:
It doesn't matter who I get!
Here I go!
fields.JP: 誰でもよい！　では行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't matter who I get!
Here I go!

fields.EN:
Damn it! I'll face you, Hameln!
Here I gooooo!
fields.JP:
くそっ、僕が相手だハーメルン！
うおおおおっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! I'll face you, Hameln!
Here I gooooo!

fields.JP:
ふはははは！
なかなかやるではないか！

fields.EN:
But it seems I am the true victor!
Take th--... Eep!
fields.JP: だがこれでワレの勝ちだ――ぶぎゅっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it seems I am the true victor!
Take th--... Eep!

fields.JP: はっ、自分のマント踏んでコケやがったっ！

fields.EN:
Oww...
I can't believe I just did that...
fields.JP:
いたたた……ワレとしたことが
ドジを踏んでしまうとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oww...
I can't believe I just did that...

fields.JP: みんな、今のうちに逃げるぞ！

fields.EN:
My princess, please don't
do that again.
That was too close for comfort.
fields.JP:
姫、もうあんなことはしないでくれ。
さっきは肝を冷やした
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess, please don't
do that again.
That was too close for comfort.

fields.EN:
There were other methods
available to save Itsuki back
there.
fields.JP:
あんな風にかばおうとしなくても、
イツキを助ける方法はあるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were other methods
available to save Itsuki back
there.

fields.EN:
So please, I don't want you to
ever sacrifice yourself like that
again.
fields.JP:
だからもう、自分を犠牲になんて
しないでほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, I don't want you to
ever sacrifice yourself like that
again.

fields.JP:
そうだよね……
ごめんなさい、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I will protect you
and those you want to protect.
fields.JP:
姫も、姫が守りたい者も
僕がしっかりと守ってみせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I will protect you
and those you want to protect.

fields.JP: ……だから、もう無茶はしないでくれ

fields.EN:
So, how much farther do we have
to run? I'm running outta gas...
fields.JP:
ちょっと、どこまで走ればいいの～
もう限界……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how much farther do we have
to run? I'm running outta gas...

fields.EN:
Y-Yes, I don't think I can
hold up much longer...
fields.JP:
さ、さすがにっ、
私もそろそろキツいかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes, I don't think I can
hold up much longer...

fields.EN:
Until we run from her!
C'mon, let's keep going!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンから逃げ切るまで！
ほら頑張って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until we run from her!
C'mon, let's keep going!

fields.EN:
That would be encouraging if we
only knew where our goal was...
fields.JP:
そうは言ってもな、
終わりが見えないんじゃあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would be encouraging if we
only knew where our goal was...

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! Good! Gooood!
Run like there's no tomorrow!
fields.JP:
ふっははははっ！　いいぞいいぞ！
もっと逃げてみせるのだー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! Good! Gooood!
Run like there's no tomorrow!

fields.EN: She's already caught up to us!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンのやつ、
もう追いついて来やがった！
fields.LOCALIZED: She's already caught up to us!

fields.EN:
Hey, Otsuu!
How about we split and go our
separate ways?
fields.JP:
おいおつう！
バラバラに逃げるってのはどうだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu!
How about we split and go our
separate ways?

fields.EN:
Not bad of an idea!
It's better than everyone
getting caught at once!
fields.JP:
それ、いいかも。
このまま全員やられるよりは、
生存率は上がるだろうし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not bad of an idea!
It's better than everyone
getting caught at once!

fields.EN:
But, that also means that
someone will die for sure!
fields.JP:
それだと誰かが犠牲になる
確率も跳ね上がる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, that also means that
someone will die for sure!

fields.EN:
She's right!
We can't let a single person die!
fields.JP:
そうです！
絶対に誰も犠牲にしてはいけません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right!
We can't let a single person die!

fields.EN:
Well yeah, but there's no
other way now!
fields.JP:
んなこと言ったって、
他にいい案ないんだろうが……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well yeah, but there's no
other way now!

fields.EN:
Even so, we will somehow
protect and save everyone!
fields.JP:
そうですが、
それでもみなさんは絶対に守ります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, we will somehow
protect and save everyone!

fields.EN:
I understand my princess's
feelings all too well, and I'd
like to comply, so...
fields.JP:
まあ、姫の気持ちは痛いほど分かるし、
僕もできればそうしたいし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand my princess's
feelings all too well, and I'd
like to comply, so...

fields.EN:
Me and my princess will
buy us all some time.
fields.JP:
そうだね、少なくとも僕と姫が
時間は稼ぐからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me and my princess will
buy us all some time.

fields.JP: だからみんな一緒に逃げるんだ

fields.EN:
(I'll protect my princess.
Simple as that.)
fields.JP:
（僕が姫を守る。
　それですべては丸く収まる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll protect my princess.
Simple as that.)

fields.EN:
Oh? So now you two are going
to face me?
fields.JP: おや、今度は貴様ら２人が相手か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? So now you two are going
to face me?

fields.EN:
Stop it already, Hameln!
This isn't tag!
fields.JP:
おいハーメルンいい加減にしろ！
こんなのは鬼ごっこじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it already, Hameln!
This isn't tag!

fields.EN:
We'll teach you the proper rules
of tag, so please stop!
fields.JP:
鬼ごっこのちゃんとしたルール、
教えてあげますから、だから止まって下さい
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll teach you the proper rules
of tag, so please stop!

fields.EN:
That's right!
Stop with all this already!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　もうこんな
意味のないことをするな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right!
Stop with all this already!

fields.EN:
I told you I wanted to play.
This is to pass my time, so
there's no stopping now!
fields.JP:
言ったろう、これは遊びだ。
ワレの退屈しのぎだ。意味は充分にあるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you I wanted to play.
This is to pass my time, so
there's no stopping now!

fields.EN:
I'll listen to what you have to
say after I'm done!
fields.JP:
貴様らの知ってるルールとやらは、
これが終わったらちゃんと聞いてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll listen to what you have to
say after I'm done!

fields.EN:
So just stay still, and take
what's coming!
fields.JP:
だから今はおとなしく
ワレに捕まるがいいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So just stay still, and take
what's coming!

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
N-Not bad at all...
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
や、やるではないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
N-Not bad at all...

fields.EN:
This tag game is very fun!
Let's continue!
fields.JP:
だが鬼ごっこというものは楽しいものだな！
もっと一緒に遊ぼうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This tag game is very fun!
Let's continue!

fields.EN:
I can't believe she still has the
strength in her to continue...
fields.JP: 無尽蔵か、ハーメルンの体力は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe she still has the
strength in her to continue...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. We were
moving all about, fighting for our
lives until now...
fields.JP:
しょうがないよ、こっちは今日１日、
ずっと命懸けの戦いだったんだもん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. We were
moving all about, fighting for our
lives until now...

fields.EN:
Come now! Don't tell me you're
done already!
fields.JP:
ほらどうした！　まさかもう終わりなんて
言うのではあるまいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now! Don't tell me you're
done already!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ジャック……
まさか、戦うつもりなのか？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: (If Jack and I hold it back together, we might at least be able to let everyone escape.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックと二人で食い止めたら、
　みんなを逃がすくらいはできる
　かもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I may be able to save everyone
else with Jack's help.)

fields.EN: (But what will happen to Jack and me after that...)
fields.JP:
（だけど、その後で僕やジャックが
　どうなってしまうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, afterwards, what to do
about me and Jack...)

fields.EN:
You do know that we change
roles the moment you tag
someone, right?!
fields.JP:
鬼ごっこは誰かを捕まえたら
その時点で鬼は交代だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do know that we change
roles the moment you tag
someone, right?!

fields.EN:
Come to think of it...
I do recall reading about that.
fields.JP:
そういえば……
そんなルールだったかもしれぬ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it...
I do recall reading about that.

fields.EN:
Well then, come and get me!
When you do, it's our turn
to chase after you!
fields.JP:
だから俺を捕まえろ！
それでおまえの鬼は終わりだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, come and get me!
When you do, it's our turn
to chase after you!

fields.EN:
Are you mad, Mamoru?!
She's going to...!
fields.JP:
おいマモルどういうつもりだ！
そんなことしたら君が！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you mad, Mamoru?!
She's going to...!

fields.EN:
Shut up!
You're not in the best of state
too, you know!
fields.JP:
うるせえ！
おまえだってもうボロボロだろうが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up!
You're not in the best of state
too, you know!

fields.EN:
Don't, Mamoru!
You're not going to make it!
fields.JP:
駄目だよマモル！
絶対に駄目なんだからっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't, Mamoru!
You're not going to make it!

fields.EN:
If you're going to bait her,
I will too!
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're going to bait her,
I will too!

fields.EN:
No, I'll do it!
Let an adult show you
how it's done!
fields.JP:
いや、ならあたし！
ここは大人に任せるもんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'll do it!
Let an adult show you
how it's done!

fields.EN:
It would demean my manhood
letting a lady sacrifice herself
in place of me. I will do it.
fields.JP:
女性を犠牲にしてまで
生き延びるのはあまりにも格好悪いな。
……僕が捕まろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would demean my manhood
letting a lady sacrifice herself
in place of me. I will do it.

fields.EN:
Uh, so I guess I have to... um,
kinda follow along too, eh?
fields.JP:
や、やっぱこの流れ……
……乗らないと、ダメ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, so I guess I have to... um,
kinda follow along too, eh?

fields.EN:
I-I-I can put myself up
t-t-to danger, too!
fields.JP:
じじ、自分だってっ、
ぎ、ぎぎ犠牲になる覚悟は
あるんだからっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I-I can put myself up
t-t-to danger, too!

fields.EN:
Don't try to put up a front
if you're scared!
fields.JP: 怖いんなら無理しないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't try to put up a front
if you're scared!

fields.EN:
A-And you ain't?!
L-Like I have a choice!
fields.JP:
そ、そりゃあ怖いさ！
でもっ、でもさあ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-And you ain't?!
L-Like I have a choice!

fields.EN:
All of you, shut up!
I'm the one who said it first,
so leave her to me!
fields.JP:
うるせえおまえら！　俺が言い出したんだ、
いいから俺に任せろっての！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All of you, shut up!
I'm the one who said it first,
so leave her to me!

fields.EN:
Like I said, if you're going to
face her, I will too!
fields.JP:
だからマモルが犠牲になるのは
絶対に駄目なの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said, if you're going to
face her, I will too!

fields.EN:
Why you...!
I said it first, so I'll do this!
fields.JP:
あめぇ！　こういうのは
早い者勝ちなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why you...!
I said it first, so I'll do this!

fields.JP: やばい！　みんな逃げるんだ！

fields.EN:
What the...?!
How'd you close in so fast?!
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?!
How'd you close in so fast?!

fields.EN:
I need to ask you something.
Why isn't everyone running?
fields.JP:
少し疑問なのだが……
どうして貴様らは皆、逃げない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to ask you something.
Why isn't everyone running?

fields.EN:
My minions will run the moment
danger strikes without regard for
each other.
fields.JP:
ワレの下僕どもは、いつだって
危険になれば互いを見捨てていくぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My minions will run the moment
danger strikes without regard for
each other.

fields.EN:
There's no way we'd leave one
of us behind. We're all in this
together - friends, you know?
fields.JP:
置いて逃げるなんてするわけねえだろ。
だって俺たちは仲間なんだからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we'd leave one
of us behind. We're all in this
together - friends, you know?

fields.EN:
Yeah, friends.
We're not like your
Marchen buddies.
fields.JP:
そうだ仲間だ。
メルヒェンどもと一緒にすんじゃねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, friends.
We're not like your
Marchen buddies.

fields.EN:
Friends... I'm quite surprised
what was drawn in the manga
actually exists...
fields.JP:
仲間……まさか漫画に描いてあったものが
実在するとは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends... I'm quite surprised
what was drawn in the manga
actually exists...

fields.EN:
Friends, are you?! Delightful!
I would love to have friends
like you, too!
fields.JP:
貴様らは仲間なのか！
いいのぅ！　ワレもそんな仲間がほしいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends, are you?! Delightful!
I would love to have friends
like you, too!

fields.EN:
Uh... Come to think of it, I think
I saw someone down that way
who wanted to be your friend.
fields.JP:
あー……さっきあっちで見たわ、
おまえの仲間になりたいってやつ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Come to think of it, I think
I saw someone down that way
who wanted to be your friend.

fields.JP: マモル、嘘はよくないよ
ばかっ、ヒカリ言うなっての！

なんだと！
今のは嘘だったと言うにょか！？

fields.EN:
Oh man... Cute...
I think I'm falling for her...
fields.JP: やだ……なにこの子、かわいい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh man... Cute...
I think I'm falling for her...

fields.EN:
Hm... Where can I go to get
these "friends" anyway?
fields.JP:
むぅ……ではどこに行けば
ワレも仲間に出会えるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Where can I go to get
these "friends" anyway?

fields.EN:
Ah! That's right!
I can become friends with you!
fields.JP:
はっ……！　そうだ！
貴様らの仲間になればいいのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! That's right!
I can become friends with you!

fields.EN: It doesn't seem like she's lying.
fields.JP: 嘘は……言ってないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED: It doesn't seem like she's lying.

fields.JP: とはいえ、この変わりようは……

fields.EN:
I always wanted this "friend"
thing ever since I read it in
the manga.
fields.JP:
漫画で『仲間』というものを見てからな、
ワレはずっといいなと思っておったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always wanted this "friend"
thing ever since I read it in
the manga.

fields.EN:
Well, I suppose we are friends
now! Great to meet you!
fields.JP:
だから今からワレは貴様らの仲間だ！
よろしくな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose we are friends
now! Great to meet you!

fields.EN:
Oh, but I suppose my status
would change being your friend...
fields.JP:
ああ、仲間になるにあたって、
ワレは肩書きを変えねばならんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I suppose my status
would change being your friend...

fields.EN:
I was the great Demon King, but
now I shall be a hero to protect
and guide you all!
fields.JP:
さっきは迷宮の支配者『魔王』と言ったが、
今からワレは皆を守り導く『勇者』だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was the great Demon King, but
now I shall be a hero to protect
and guide you all!

fields.EN:
Now I'm interested in
reading the manga she read...
fields.JP:
いったいどんな漫画を読んで
育ったの、この子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I'm interested in
reading the manga she read...

fields.EN:
Uh, well... I suppose all's
well that ends well...
fields.JP:
ま、まあ鬼ごっこが終わるなら、
とりあえずは……いいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, well... I suppose all's
well that ends well...

fields.EN:
Having someone as strong as
her join us is quite assuring.
fields.JP:
一緒に行動するとなれば、
これほど頼もしい人はいないですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Having someone as strong as
her join us is quite assuring.

fields.EN:
Well then, Hameln...
We welcome you as our friend.
fields.JP:
じゃあハーメルン、
これから僕たちは『仲間』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, Hameln...
We welcome you as our friend.

fields.EN:
Now, as our friend, you need
to remember to not use
force against us, okay?
fields.JP:
いいかい、じゃあこれからは
仲間を殴ったりしちゃ駄目だからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, as our friend, you need
to remember to not use
force against us, okay?

fields.EN:
Friends are supposed to help
each other at all times.
fields.JP:
仲間は助け合うものであって、
決して傷つけてはいけませんよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends are supposed to help
each other at all times.

fields.EN:
Hm! Understood!
I am a hero now, so I will
protect and guide you all!
fields.JP:
うむ！　分かっておる！
なんたってワレは『勇者』！
皆を守り導く者だからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm! Understood!
I am a hero now, so I will
protect and guide you all!

fields.EN:
What a weird turn of events...
Oh well...
fields.JP:
成り行きで変なことになったけど……
……まあいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a weird turn of events...
Oh well...

fields.EN:
This place is quite dark...
Were you seriously living here?
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと暗い道だな……
本当にこんな場所に住んでるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is quite dark...
Were you seriously living here?

fields.JP: うむ！　心配せずについて来るがいい！

fields.EN:
I've got no complaints as long
as we can find a place to rest.
fields.JP:
安全に休めるんなら
どこだっていいさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've got no complaints as long
as we can find a place to rest.

fields.EN:
I wonder what Hameln-chan's home is
like...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンちゃんの家って
どんな感じなんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what Hammy's home is
like...

fields.JP: ワレの名はハーメルンチャンではない！

fields.EN:
She's using a nickname.
It's used to imply that you're
a friend.
fields.JP:
『ちゃん』づけは親しみの証だ。
つまり仲間の証ってことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's using a nickname.
It's used to imply that you're
a friend.

fields.EN:
I see!
Well then, you are all free
to call me "Hameln-chan" as you wish!
fields.JP:
なんと！　そうであったか！　ならば許す！
『ハーメルンちゃん』と呼ぶがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see!
Well then, you are all free
to call me "Hammy" as you wish!

fields.EN: Yeah, but I won't call you that.
fields.JP:
まあ俺はちゃんづけで
呼ばねえけどな
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, but I won't call you that.

fields.EN:
This party's a bit rowdier now...
Hey, I can see light up ahead.
fields.JP:
一気に騒がしくなったなぁ……
……っと、先が明るくなってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
This party's a bit rowdier now...
Hey, I can see light up ahead.

fields.EN:
We're here!
This is my home!
fields.JP:
着いたな！
ここがワレの家だぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're here!
This is my home!

fields.EN:
It's spacious, and the sights
are just something...
fields.JP:
吹き抜けになってて
すごく、いい景色……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's spacious, and the sights
are just something...

fields.EN:
Man, this place is open. I can
see the Jail Tower from here.
fields.JP:
遠くに監獄塔まで見えるのか。
すげえ広々と感じるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man, this place is open. I can
see the Jail Tower from here.

fields.EN:
Ah, so we're at a subway
platform.
fields.JP: なるほど、地下鉄のホームか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, so we're at a subway
platform.

fields.EN:
I must say, this place is quite
relaxing considering we're
deep down under.
fields.JP:
これは確かに、
地の底の中では快適だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, this place is quite
relaxing considering we're
deep down under.

fields.EN:
It's an old kind of vehicle powered by
electricity, Hikari-chan.
fields.JP:
昔の電気で動く乗り物だよん、
ヒカリちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
There used to be things called
"trains" that used to move
with electricity.

fields.EN:
I see. An ancient ruin.
I'm surprised you found such
a place, Hameln.
fields.JP:
なるほど、昔の施設跡か。
よく見つけたな、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. An ancient ruin.
I'm surprised you found such
a place, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Heh heh!
This is my go-to place!
fields.JP: ふふふ、ワレのとっておきの場所だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh!
This is my go-to place!

fields.EN:
Looks like we can rest safely
here. Thank you, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ここなら安心して休めそうだ。
ありがとうハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we can rest safely
here. Thank you, Hameln.

fields.EN:
We are friends, after all!
I will protect and guide you!
fields.JP:
なんたって仲間だからな！
守り導くのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We are friends, after all!
I will protect and guide you!

fields.JP: やべーチョロイぞこいつ

fields.EN:
Hey! Don't say that!
She's letting us rest here,
you know?
fields.JP:
こーら！　休ませてくれてるんだから
そういうこと言わないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Don't say that!
She's letting us rest here,
you know?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, Mamoru-san, are you and
the others residents of the Liberated District?
fields.JP:
そういえば、マモルさんたちも
解放地区の住人なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, aren't
you folks residents of the
Liberated District?

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh, me and Hikari lived
in a small village near the
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
ん？　ああ俺とヒカリは
解放地区の近くにあった集落出身だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, me and Hikari lived
in a small village near the
Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Me and four-eyes here lived
in the Liberated District.
fields.JP: あたしとこの眼鏡は解放地区にいたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me and four-eyes here lived
in the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
I'd prefer you to call me by
name...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd prefer you to call me by
name...

fields.EN:
Well, I was there too!
In fact, I was working as a
member of Dawn's dev team!
fields.JP:
オレっちも解放地区で、
黎明の製造班にいたんだぜ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was there too!
In fact, I was working as a
member of Dawn's dev team!

fields.EN:
You can count on me to work
on your weapons and things.
fields.JP:
武器とか必要なら寄ってくれよな～
用立てするぜ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can count on me to work
on your weapons and things.

fields.EN:
Oh, you were with Dawn?!
Maybe we've met before.
fields.JP:
まあ！　黎明にいらしたんですか！
もしかしたらどこかで
お会いしていたかもしれませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you were with Dawn?!
Maybe we've met before.

fields.EN:
If we're talking about Dawn,
then four-eyes was a former
member of the research team.
fields.JP:
それを言うなら、この眼鏡は
黎明の元・研究班だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're talking about Dawn,
then four-eyes was a former
member of the research team.

fields.EN: Former? What are you doing now?
fields.JP: 元？　じゃあ今は違うんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Former? What are you doing now?

fields.JP:
イツキさんとも
お会いしていたかもしれませんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe we've met before too then.

fields.EN:
So, you and Otsuu-chan are from the
Liberated District then?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃんは、
解放地区にいたんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you and Otsuu are from the
Liberated District then?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: ――それでみんなに出会ったんだ

fields.EN:
That was rough... Otsuu-chan, Ningyo-chan,
you both went through a lot...
fields.JP:
大変だったね、
おつうちゃんも人魚ちゃんも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite something...
You both went through a lot.

fields.EN:
We're just glad we were able
to help you folks.
fields.JP:
みなさんだけでも
助けることができてよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're just glad we were able
to help you folks.

fields.EN:
Mind you, we're still underground,
but thanks. You're a lifesaver.
fields.JP:
まだ地の底だけどな。
でも助かったぜ、本当
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind you, we're still underground,
but thanks. You're a lifesaver.

fields.EN:
I'm sure there is more to talk
about, but may I suggest we
take a rest already?
fields.JP:
話題に事欠かないけど、
みんな、ひとまず休まないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there is more to talk
about, but may I suggest we
take a rest already?

fields.EN:
True. I think I'm about to drop.
We can head back to the
Liberated District after we rest.
fields.JP:
そうだね。僕もそろそろ限界だよ。
少し休んで、そしたら解放地区へ戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. I think I'm about to drop.
We can head back to the
Liberated District after we rest.

fields.JP: 『解放地区』とはどんなところなのだ？

fields.EN:
It's where our friends live,
Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
わたしたちの仲間が
たくさんいる場所だよ、ハーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's where our friends live,
Hammy.

fields.JP: なんと！　まだ仲間がいるのか！？

fields.EN:
Astounding!
I want to go there, too!
fields.JP:
それはすごい！
ワレはぜひとも解放地区に行きたいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Astounding!
I want to go there, too!

fields.JP: え、ハーメルンついて来んの？

fields.EN:
Of course!
I am your friend after all!
fields.JP:
もちろんだ！
なんせワレは貴様らの仲間だからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course!
I am your friend after all!

fields.EN:
I don't see why not. So long as
she understands what being a
friend is about. Yawn...
fields.JP:
いいんじゃないか……？
仲間の概念が分かってくれさえすれば、
心強いことは間違いないし……ふぁあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see why not. So long as
she understands what being a
friend is about. Yawn...

fields.EN:
If you say so...
Guess we got a troublemaker
in the group now.
fields.JP:
おつうがそう言うなら仕方ねぇ。
……ったく、うるせぇのが増えちまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you say so...
Guess we got a troublemaker
in the group now.

fields.EN:
It'll be a lot more lively now,
that's for sure.
fields.JP: 賑やかになりそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be a lot more lively now,
that's for sure.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
What...?
Is something wrong with him?
fields.JP:
なんだ……？
彼の様子がおかしいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...?
Is something wrong with him?

fields.JP: もしかして、寝てるんじゃない？
こっちも寝ちゃったねぇ

fields.EN:
Well, Otsuu-chan and Jack-san were
doing a lot back there.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんもジャックさんも、
ずっと頑張ってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Otsuu and Jack were
doing a lot back there.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Let's let them sleep.
Like, I think we should go to
sleep, too.
fields.JP:
寝かせてあげましょう。
ってかあたしたちも少し寝ようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's let them sleep.
Like, I think we should go to
sleep, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah, may as well sleep while
we still have the chance.
fields.JP: だな。寝られる時に寝ておかないとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, may as well sleep while
we still have the chance.

fields.JP:
ふふ、おやすみなさい、
おつうちゃん……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
ん……？
どうしたハーメルン
ナイトメア・ジャック
ふああ、おはようハーメルンちゃん……

fields.EN:
How much longer are you going
to sleep?! This is so boring!
fields.JP:
いつまで寝ておるのだ！
いい加減にワレは退屈だぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How much longer are you going
to sleep?! This is so boring!

fields.EN:
Ah, it looks like we've been
asleep for quite a while.
fields.JP: ああ……けっこう寝てたみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, it looks like we've been
asleep for quite a while.

fields.EN:
Takumi, you better wake up or
else Hameln is going to wake you
up with force.
fields.JP:
タクミ、そろそろ起きないと
ハーメルンにぶっ叩かれるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Takumi, you better wake up or
else Hameln is going to wake you
up with force.

fields.JP:
ウッス！
自分、メッチャ起きてるであります！

fields.EN:
I can't believe you all needed
to sleep that long.
fields.JP: まったく、貴様らは体力がないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you all needed
to sleep that long.

fields.EN:
By the way, the clothes you're
wearing are so beautiful, Hameln-chan!
fields.JP:
それにしてもハーメルンちゃん、
また随分と素敵な服だね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, the clothes you're
wearing are so beautiful, Hameln!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンちゃん => Hameln-chan

fields.EN:
Yes, it gives you a much different
look. You look great in it.
fields.JP:
うん、前と全然印象が違うね。
とても似合ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it gives you a much different
look. You look great in it.

fields.EN:
Doesn't it! I am a hero, so I have
to wear the proper attire!
fields.JP:
そうであろう！　ワレはもう勇者だからな！
相応の服に着替えさせてもらったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't it! I am a hero, so I have
to wear the proper attire!

fields.JP: 形から入るタイプかよ……

fields.EN:
Leave her be.
I think looks are important, too.
fields.JP:
まあいいじゃないか。
見た目は大事だと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave her be.
I think looks are important, too.

fields.EN:
At least it's a lot easier to
speak with her now.
fields.JP:
断然、今の方が話しかけやすい
雰囲気してるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least it's a lot easier to
speak with her now.

fields.EN:
Well, here's to hoping we all
get along, Haa-chan.
fields.JP: 改めてよろしくね、ハーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, here's to hoping we all
get along, Hammy.

fields.EN:
All right, I think it's best we
get going now, but before
doing so...
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあみんな、
そろそろ出発しようと思うんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, I think it's best we
get going now, but before
doing so...

fields.EN:
Mamoru? You folks didn't fall
down here, did you?
fields.JP:
マモル、君たちはまさか
崖を落ちてきたわけじゃないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru? You folks didn't fall
down here, did you?

fields.EN:
Hell no. We found a bridge
while running that led us
down here.
fields.JP:
そりゃあな。俺たちは上で
この地下洞窟に繋がる橋を見つけたんだ。
で、こっちに逃げてきたってわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell no. We found a bridge
while running that led us
down here.

fields.EN:
That also means that we can get
back up from there. No worries.
Itsuki knows the way back.
fields.JP:
だからそこを通れば、上に戻れる。
なに、道は覚えてる……イツキが
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means that we can get
back up from there. No worries.
Itsuki knows the way back.

fields.EN:
Thanks for passing the buck to
me, but... yes, I do remember the
way back.
fields.JP:
自信満々に僕に頼るのはどうかと思うが、
確かに覚えているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for passing the buck to
me, but... yes, I do remember the
way back.

fields.EN:
All right! Let's head on back to
the Liberated District!
fields.JP:
よし！　じゃあ今度こそ
解放地区に戻れるな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Let's head on back to
the Liberated District!

fields.JP: やっとここまで戻ってこられた……！

fields.EN: It felt like forever getting here.
fields.JP:
こうしてみると、
ずいぶん長かったような気がするね
fields.LOCALIZED: It felt like forever getting here.

fields.JP:
ん……？
姫、何かおかしくないか？

fields.EN:
I don't recall the place being
in such a bad state, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
覚えてる限りこんなに破壊されて
なかったよね、おつうちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall the place being
in such a bad state, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Isn't it because you girls were
fighting the Marchens?
fields.JP:
おまえらがメルヒェンと戦ったから
じゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it because you girls were
fighting the Marchens?

fields.EN:
I don't think that's the cause
of all this.
fields.JP: いや、そうじゃないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think that's the cause
of all this.

fields.EN:
It looks like a force greater than
what any lone battle can exhibit
rampaged through here...
fields.JP:
戦闘の痕跡というより大きな力が
ここを通り、破壊していった。
そういう風に見える
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like a force greater than
what any lone battle can exhibit
rampaged through here...

fields.EN:
(Itsuki's right. I'm quite sure
we didn't cause this much
destruction in our battles...)
fields.JP:
（イツキの言う通りだ。
　あの時の戦闘ではこんな破壊は
　なされてなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Itsuki's right. I'm quite sure
we didn't cause this much
destruction in our battles...)

fields.JP: いったい何があったって言うんだ……？

fields.EN:
I-I'm not getting good vibes
from this...
fields.JP: な、なんか不気味な雰囲気だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not getting good vibes
from this...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Hikari.
I'm with you.
fields.JP:
安心しろヒカリ。
俺がついてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Hikari.
I'm with you.

fields.EN:
I don't sense any other presence
here, but we better keep an eye
out on our surrounding.
fields.JP:
この辺りに他の気配はないけど、
用心するに越したことはない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't sense any other presence
here, but we better keep an eye
out on our surrounding.

fields.JP: だからみんな、気をつけて戻ろう
みなさん、解放地区見えました！

fields.EN:
Mmm! Smell the fresh air
of freedom!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm! Smell the fresh air
of freedom!

fields.EN:
I must say, it feels very good
to be in a familiar place.
fields.JP:
見慣れた場所に来ると、
やはり安心感が違うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, it feels very good
to be in a familiar place.

fields.EN:
Let's go and let everyone know
we're back!
fields.JP: みんな！　早く無事を知らせに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go and let everyone know
we're back!

fields.JP: ……待ってくれ、何かおかしいぞ

fields.EN:
This isn't looking good...
Let's go!
fields.JP: 嫌な予感がする……みんな、急ごう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't looking good...
Let's go!

fields.JP: 誰か！　無事な方はいませんかー！
なんだってこんなことに……！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん！
待ってってばぁ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Everyone, stay away from here!
It could be dangerous!
fields.JP: 危ないからみんなは外で待ってて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, stay away from here!
It could be dangerous!

fields.EN: I can't just leave you like this, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
そんな、おつうちゃんを
放っておけないよ！

fields.EN:
Yeah, now's the time we work
together as a team.
fields.JP:
ああ、こんな時だからこそ
固まって行動すべきだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, now's the time we work
together as a team.

fields.JP: どうしたのだ、おつうは

fields.EN:
Are you sure you want to come
with us? I can guarantee you that
there's nothing good ahead.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、ここから先はきっと
楽しいことは１つもない。それでも来る？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you want to come
with us? I can guarantee you that
there's nothing good ahead.

fields.EN:
Of course I'll come.
I am your friend after all.
fields.JP:
もちろんだ。
何があってもワレは仲間だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I'll come.
I am your friend after all.

fields.EN:
Thank you...
I'm counting on you.
fields.JP: ありがとう。その言葉、信じる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
I'm counting on you.

fields.JP: おいおつう！　ちょっと落ち着け！
無事でいてくれ、みんな――
ハルさん！　視子さん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
This can't be happening...
Haru-san... Miko-san...
fields.JP:
嘘ですよね……
ハルさん、視子さん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can't be happening...
Haru... Miko...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(Haru-san's eyes were gouged out,
and Miko-san's limbs are torn apart.)
fields.JP:
（両目がないのが……ハルさん。
　四肢がないのが……視子さん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haru's eyes were gouged out,
and Miko's limbs are torn apart.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(They don't look like them at
all, but my mind is telling me
that it's them...)
fields.JP:
（どこからどう見ても記憶の
　２人とはかけ離れているのに、
　間違いなく２人と断言できてしまう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They don't look like them at
all, but my mind is telling me
that it's them...)

fields.EN:
(No matter how I look at things,
they're... dead!)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても、
　死んでるって断言できてしまう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No matter how I look at things,
they're... dead!)

fields.EN: What a horrible way to die...
fields.JP: ひでえ殺し方しやがる……
fields.LOCALIZED: What a horrible way to die...

fields.EN: Who would've done such a thing?!
fields.JP: いったい誰がこんなことを……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Who would've done such a thing?!

fields.EN:
Now calm down, Otsuu.
Whoever did this is still nearby.
fields.JP:
落ち着くんだ、おつう。
この人たちを襲った者はまだ近くにいるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now calm down, Otsuu.
Whoever did this is still nearby.

fields.EN:
I'm guessing based on the bleeding
and the warmth of the corpses.
It could be possible that...
fields.JP:
ああ。血の流れ方と体温でおおよそね。
もしかしたらまだ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm guessing based on the bleeding
and the warmth of the corpses.
It could be possible that...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I can't leave her alone!
Everyone, wait here!
fields.JP:
おつうを１人にはできねえ！
みんなはここで待ってろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't leave her alone!
Everyone, wait here!

fields.JP: それならなおさら、私たちも行くよ！

fields.EN:
It's dangerous no matter where
we are!
fields.JP: ここに残っても危険なのは変わりない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous no matter where
we are!

fields.EN:
No! Whoever or whatever
caused all this is nearby!
fields.JP:
ここを壊滅させたやつが
すぐそこにいるんだ！　来るな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Whoever or whatever
caused all this is nearby!

fields.EN:
Let me say that it's more
dangerous to leave the weak
out here in the open.
fields.JP:
むしろ非戦闘員だけ残していく方が
危ないと思うけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me say that it's more
dangerous to leave the weak
out here in the open.

fields.EN:
But, she's worrying the heck
out of me!
fields.JP:
そうは言ってもよ、
やっぱり心配なんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she's worrying the heck
out of me!

fields.EN:
We're going to lose Otsuu if we
keep arguing like this, so I will
protect everyone here.
fields.JP:
迷っている間におつうは行ってしまうぞ。
心配するな、貴様らはワレが守ってやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to lose Otsuu if we
keep arguing like this, so I will
protect everyone here.

fields.EN:
Thanks, Hameln!
I'm counting on you!
fields.JP:
くそっ……ハーメルン、
よろしく頼むぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Hameln!
I'm counting on you!

fields.JP:
そこのおまえ！
その人から離れろ！

血……もっと……たく
……さん……ぎ……出ろ……

fields.EN:
Damn it... I can't even avenge
my dad and mom...
Urgh...
fields.JP:
グゾッ……親父やお袋の……
仇……いづか取りたがっだのによぉ……
あっ、が……がぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it... I can't even avenge
my dad and mom...
Urgh...

fields.JP:
今助けます！
うぉぉぉぉぉっ！

うわっ！！
なっ……なんだこの威力……！

fields.EN:
Tch! I can't get near it.
I can't even find an opening!
fields.JP:
くっ……しかもこいつ意外と
隙がなくて近づけない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! I can't get near it.
I can't even find an opening!

fields.JP:
ほら……シ……ぬの……
ぐげげ……ね……え…………

fields.EN:
Mr. Kadowaki!
Please, get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
門脇さん！？　
しっかりして下さい門脇さんっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mr. Kadowaki!
Please, get a hold of yourself!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 内臓が……引っ張り出されてる……

fields.EN:
Hm... That one there is quite
formidable...
fields.JP:
そやつ……けっこう
ヤバめな雰囲気を放っておるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... That one there is quite
formidable...

fields.EN:
Aaaaah!
We gotta get outta here!
fields.JP:
ひぃぃぃっ！
アイツ絶対やばいって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaaah!
We gotta get outta here!

fields.EN:
Yeah, we better run while
we still can!
fields.JP: おい、逃げた方がいいぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we better run while
we still can!

fields.EN:
I've never seen a Nightmare
like that before...
fields.JP:
何……このナイトメア……
こんなおぞましいの、初めて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen a Nightmare
like that before...

fields.EN:
You all stand back.
I will take care of it.
fields.JP:
貴様らは下がっておれ。
ここはワレが引き受けよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You all stand back.
I will take care of it.

fields.EN:
I'm joining, too.
I'll make it pay for what
it's done.
fields.JP:
僕もやる。
絶対に後悔させてやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm joining, too.
I'll make it pay for what
it's done.

fields.EN:
(I have to be careful...
It's way stronger than anyone
I've ever fought before...)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ……これまで戦ってきたどの敵も
　比較にならないほど強そうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to be careful...
It's way stronger than anyone
I've ever fought before...)

fields.EN:
Be careful, Otsuu.
One wrong move and it's over.
fields.JP:
おつう、気をつけろ。
気を抜くとやられかねぬぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be careful, Otsuu.
One wrong move and it's over.

fields.EN:
Understood.
You be careful too, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ああ、分かってる。
ハーメルンも気をつけてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood.
You be careful too, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Foolish!
Turning its back on us?!
fields.JP: ふははは！　背を向けるとは愚かな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Foolish!
Turning its back on us?!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン！
追わなくていい！！

fields.EN: You don't need to go after it...
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't need to go after it...

fields.JP: むぅ……おつうが言うなら仕方あるまい

fields.EN:
Our top priority is to make sure
that everyone's safe...
fields.JP:
今は、みんなが無事であることの方が
大事だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our top priority is to make sure
that everyone's safe...

fields.EN: (I don't understand... We should have welcomed a new Blood Maiden into our group and celebrated together...)
fields.JP:
（意味が分からない……本当なら
　僕たちは新しい血式少女を仲間にして、
　喜び合っていたはずなのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's going on? I was supposed
to come back with a new Blood
Maiden who would join us.)

fields.EN:
(There are no happy faces to
greet us back... What am
I supposed to do...?)
fields.JP:
（なのになんでこんなことに……
　いったいどうすればいいんだよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There are no happy faces to
greet us back... What am
I supposed to do...?)

fields.JP:
門脇さん！
お願い目を覚まして！
うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！

fields.EN:
Why?! Why was everyone killed?!
Why...?! Why?!
fields.JP:
なんで！？　どうしてみんな
殺されなければいけないの！？
なんで……なんでよぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why?! Why was everyone killed?!
Why...?! Why?!

fields.EN:
I can't take this anymore!
Everyone I cared about! Dead!
I don't want this...!
fields.JP:
もういや……！
大好きなみんながいなくなるの、
もういやだよぉ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't take this anymore!
Everyone I cared about! Dead!
I don't want this...!

fields.EN:
You taught me that we should
hug each other when things are
going bad.
fields.JP:
つらい時はこうやって抱きしめるって、
姫が教えてくれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You taught me that we should
hug each other when things are
going bad.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
ふ、う……うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁんっ！！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
All I could do was to embrace
Ningyohime crying in sorrow.
fields.JP:
泣きじゃくる人魚姫を、
僕はただ抱きしめることしか出来なかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I could do was to embrace
Little Mermaid crying in sorrow.

fields.EN:
How much time has passed?
Everyone was speechless.
fields.JP:
いったいどのくらいの時間
そうしていただろう。
誰もが、無言だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
How much time has passed?
Everyone was speechless.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime calmed down,
and we went searching the area
from end to end.
fields.JP:
そして人魚姫が落ち着いてから、
僕たちは解放地区を隅まで見て回った
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid calmed down,
and we went searching the area
from end to end.

fields.EN:
I feared for the worst, and it
became a reality. There were
no survivors.
fields.JP:
半ば予想はしていたけど、
生き残った人は誰もいなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feared for the worst, and it
became a reality. There were
no survivors.

fields.EN:
Every human, every animal...
Everything with life was killed
as if in sheer hatred.
fields.JP:
まるで命ある者をすべて憎むかのように、
人も動物も、何もかも皆殺しだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Every human, every animal...
Everything with life was killed
as if in sheer hatred.

fields.EN:
I can only assume that Nightmare
I saw did all this...
fields.JP:
これもすべて、あの謎のナイトメアが
やったこと――なのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only assume that Nightmare
I saw did all this...

fields.EN:
And now, I sigh with relief that
we didn't fight it after looking
at the destruction it caused.
fields.JP:
破壊の痕を見る限り、
正直あの場で戦いにならなくて
良かったと思うばかりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And now, I sigh with relief that
we didn't fight it after looking
at the destruction it caused.

fields.EN:
If we fought, someone would have
died. We all could have died...
fields.JP:
戦っていれば、間違いなく僕たちの誰か、
あるいは全員が殺されていただろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we fought, someone would have
died. We all could have died...

fields.EN:
To be safe, we sealed the paths
to the City Streets where we
believe the Nightmare ran off to.
fields.JP:
だから念のため謎のナイトメアが
逃げたと思われる、元街道沿いから
別の場所への道は完全に塞いでおいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be safe, we sealed the paths
to the City Streets where we
believe the Nightmare ran off to.

fields.EN:
The only areas that connect are
the Liberated District, Hameln's
Cave, and the Graveyard area.
fields.JP:
元街道沿いから行けるのは、
今はこの破壊されつくした解放地区や
ハーメルンの洞窟、元墓所エリアくらいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only areas that connect are
the Liberated District, Hameln's
Cave, and the Graveyard area.

fields.EN: We should be safe... for now.
fields.JP:
少なくともこれで当面の安全は確保できた
……はずだ
fields.LOCALIZED: We should be safe... for now.

fields.EN:
Dawn's structures were mostly
toppled and reduced to rubble.
fields.JP:
黎明の建物は損傷が酷く、
そのほとんどが瓦礫となって
崩れてしまっていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dawn's structures were mostly
toppled and reduced to rubble.

fields.EN:
We can't search inside, and we
couldn't find the assumed body
of our professor.
fields.JP:
おかげで内部の捜索はできていない。
黎明の実質的な長でもある博士の遺体は
見つからずじまいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't search inside, and we
couldn't find the assumed body
of our professor.

fields.EN:
I'm sure he would have offered
us a glimmer of hope, even in
the darkness we're in...
fields.JP:
博士がいてくれたら、こんな状況でも
もっと希望を持てただろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure he would have offered
us a glimmer of hope, even in
the darkness we're in...

fields.EN:
I would have wanted to wallow in
sadness, but doing so would do
nothing for our cause.
fields.JP:
絶望に沈み、この先どうすればいいのか、
何も思いつかないような有様だったけど
ここにいても何も進展はしない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would have wanted to wallow in
sadness, but doing so would do
nothing for our cause.

fields.JP: それだけは確かだった

fields.EN:
Heh... I suppose this is what it
truly means to be in despair.
fields.JP: 何て言うか……はは、絶望的だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I suppose this is what it
truly means to be in despair.

fields.EN:
Otsuu...
You rest a bit, you hear?
fields.JP: おつう、おまえ少しは休め
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu...
You rest a bit, you hear?

fields.EN:
Strange... I can't sleep.
I don't even feel tired.
fields.JP:
なんだろうね、眠れないんだ。
疲れも何も感じないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strange... I can't sleep.
I don't even feel tired.

fields.EN:
Mamoru, shouldn't you be
beside Hikari?
fields.JP:
それよりもマモルは
ヒカリのそばにいてあげないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, shouldn't you be
beside Hikari?

fields.EN:
The village you came from was
probably... um...
fields.LOCALIZED:
The village you came from was
probably... um...

fields.EN:
You can tell it to me straight.
Without doubt the place is
probably destroyed.
fields.JP:
いいさ、言葉を選ばなくて。
全滅だったのは事実だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can tell it to me straight.
Without doubt the place is
probably destroyed.

fields.EN:
Kaede is with Hikari now.
Sometimes it's best to let
girls have a one-on-one.
fields.JP:
ヒカリには今、カエデがついてくれてる。
女同士の方がいいこともある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede is with Hikari now.
Sometimes it's best to let
girls have a one-on-one.

fields.EN:
Well, she asked to be left alone
for a while, so I decided to honor
her request...
fields.JP:
うん……１人になりたいって、
だからそっとしておくことにしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she asked to be left alone
for a while, so I decided to honor
her request...

fields.EN:
If only there was something
good to talk about now...
fields.JP:
こういう時、少しでも何か
希望が持てる話題があるといいのにな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only there was something
good to talk about now...

fields.EN:
Well, we couldn't even find
Professor's body, too...
fields.JP:
黎明の博士の遺体も
見つからなかったしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we couldn't even find
Professor's body, too...

fields.JP: あれだけ探してなかったんだもんな……

fields.EN:
Hame-chan, it's harder to have
a smile on our face now,
you know?
fields.JP:
ハメちゃん、さすがに今
元気になれってのは無理だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy, it's harder to have
a smile on our face now,
you know?

fields.EN:
Hm, but being down like this
isn't going to change matters.
fields.JP:
むぅ、だが落ち込んでても
何も変わらないではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but being down like this
isn't going to change matters.

fields.EN:
Now is the time we stand proud!
We must let our passion aflame,
and begin our retaliation!
fields.JP:
そう、ここからだ！
ここからワレらの反撃が始まるって感じで
闘志を燃やそうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now is the time we stand proud!
We must let our passion aflame,
and begin our retaliation!

fields.JP: だから無理だって言ってんだろ

fields.EN:
Hm... No here, no there.
So, what will make you come back
to your normal self thyen?!
fields.JP:
ぬう……あれもムリ、これもムリ！
じゃあいったいどうしたら貴様らは
元気になるって言うにょだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... No here, no there.
So, what will make you come back
to your normal self thyen?!

fields.EN:
You're all alive, aren't you?!
You can do anything
if you're alive!
fields.JP:
貴様らはまだ生きてるではないか！
生きていれば何とかなる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all alive, aren't you?!
You can do anything
if you're alive!

fields.EN:
You got that from your manga,
didn't you?
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got that from your manga,
didn't you?

fields.EN: Indeed! Those words hit me hard!
fields.JP:
うむ！　あのセリフには
心が震えたぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Indeed! Those words hit me hard!

fields.EN:
Sheez...
So those aren't your words then.
fields.JP: んだよ、漫画のセリフかよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sheez...
So those aren't your words then.

fields.EN:
Hear me out. Are you sure everyone
was killed? You don't know for
sure, do yyew?!
fields.JP:
や、待てっ、
それに本当に全員死んだのか！？
まだ分からにゃいではにゃいか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hear me out. Are you sure everyone
was killed? You don't know for
sure, do yyew?!

fields.EN:
Heh...
You're slurring too much, Hameln-chan.
fields.JP:
はは……ハーメルンちゃん、
噛みすぎだよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
You're slurring too much, Hammy.

fields.JP: ヒカリ！　もういいのか？

fields.EN:
Yup, a bit...
I'm sorry to be such a burden...
fields.JP:
うん……だいぶよくなったよ。
みんな、心配かけてごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, a bit...
I'm sorry to be such a burden...

fields.EN:
I overheard, but what Hameln said
is true. We need to pick ourselves
up and think of the future.
fields.JP:
聞こえてたけど、
ハーメルンの言うことも一理あるよ。
みんな、少し前向きに考えない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I overheard, but what Hameln said
is true. We need to pick ourselves
up and think of the future.

fields.JP: カエデ！　よくぞ言った！

fields.EN:
So, are we sure there are no
survivors?
fields.JP:
ねえ、本当に誰も
生き残っていないのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, are we sure there are no
survivors?

fields.EN:
We couldn't find the bodies of
any of the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
血式少女たちの遺体は、
誰一人としてありませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
We couldn't find the bodies of
any of the Blood Maidens.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I'm fine...
I'm sorry to have worried you all.
fields.JP:
もう大丈夫だから……
ごめんなさい、みなさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine...
I'm sorry to have worried you all.

fields.EN:
Heh... Well, guess we still got
some juice in us.
fields.JP:
へっ……みんな意外と
前向きじゃねえか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Well, guess we still got
some juice in us.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime? Otsuu?
Do you mind continuing where
you each left off?
fields.JP:
じゃあ人魚姫、おつう、
話の続きをお願いできるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid? Otsuu?
Do you mind continuing where
you each left off?

fields.EN:
Yes. There were actually more of
us in Dawn.
fields.JP:
はい――わたしたちのような血式少女は、
黎明にまだ何人かいたのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. There were actually more of
us in Dawn.

fields.EN:
But, we didn't find their bodies
there at all.
fields.JP:
だけど誰一人の遺体も、
あの場所にはなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we didn't find their bodies
there at all.

fields.EN:
Which means that it's highly
likely that they escaped and
went into hiding.
fields.JP:
ということは、生き残って
どこかに避難した可能性が高いんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that it's highly
likely that they escaped and
went into hiding.

fields.EN:
If we can somehow find them,
I'm sure we will be able to face
the Marchens again.
fields.JP:
ですから彼女たちに合流できれば、
もっとメルヒェンたちに
対抗できるようになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we can somehow find them,
I'm sure we will be able to face
the Marchens again.

fields.EN:
I see, and that would help us
retaliate against those monsters
again.
fields.JP:
なるほど、それこそが
反撃の糸口になる……ってことだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see, and that would help us
retaliate against those monsters
again.

fields.EN:
Yes. I'd like to suggest we use
this place temporarily as a base
to find the other Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
うん。だからひとまずここを拠点に、
血式少女たちを探したいと思うんだけど、
どうかな、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I'd like to suggest we use
this place temporarily as a base
to find the other Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Your story holds hope and a
decent level of reality.
I'm in agreement with you.
fields.JP:
だいぶ現実的で希望の持てる話だ。
僕は賛成だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your story holds hope and a
decent level of reality.
I'm in agreement with you.

fields.EN:
Me too.
We need to have the right people
to fight again.
fields.JP:
あたしも賛成。
まず戦力を増やさないとね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too.
We need to have the right people
to fight again.

fields.EN:
Heck, I'm all in if it means that
we're gonna build better defenses.
fields.JP:
あっしも、守りが堅くなるなら
喜んで手伝いやすぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heck, I'm all in if it means that
we're gonna build better defenses.

fields.EN:
Me too!
There's still hope left.
fields.JP: 私も！　希望が見えてきたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too!
There's still hope left.

fields.EN:
All right then, let's go and
find every single one of them!
fields.JP: 上等だ、全員見つけてやろうぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right then, let's go and
find every single one of them!

fields.EN:
I guess we're all in agreement.
Haa-chan? Do you mind if...
fields.JP:
ってことなんだけど、
ハーちゃん……この場所いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we're all in agreement.
Hammy? Do you mind if...

fields.EN:
Hahaha! No need to say more!
You are free to use my place
as you please!
fields.JP:
ふはは！　もちろん構わぬ！
ワレの隠れ家、存分に使うがよいぞ貴様ら！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! No need to say more!
You are free to use my place
as you please!

fields.EN:
Thank you...
We're in your debt, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ありがとう……
恩に着るよ、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
We're in your debt, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Now then! Let us depart and
search for those friends of yours!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ貴様ら！
その仲間になりそうな奴らを
共に見つけようぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then! Let us depart and
search for those friends of yours!

fields.JP:
（よかった……
　これでひとまず希望が見えた）

fields.EN:
(Still, that Nightmare I saw back
at Dawn was odd...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、
　あの黎明で出会ったナイトメア……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, that Nightmare I saw back
at Dawn was odd...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's just me, but when it
ran, I felt a surge of evil run
through my body...)
fields.JP:
（気のせいだろうか、あいつが逃げる時
　とてもネガティブな……言い知れない
　負の感情を感じた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's just me, but when it
ran, I felt a surge of evil run
through my body...)

fields.JP: （いったいあいつは何者なんだろうか……）

fields.EN:
(I need to run...
They're going to kill me...)
fields.JP:
（逃げなきゃ……
　捕まったら殺される……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to run...
They're going to kill me...)

fields.EN:
(But why?
Why is everyone after me...?!)
fields.JP:
（でも何故？
　どうしてみんな追ってくるの……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But why?
Why is everyone after me...?!)

fields.EN:
(What did I do?
Why are they coming after me?!)
fields.JP:
（私が何をしたって言うの？
　何で追われなきゃいけないの……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What did I do?
Why are they coming after me?!)

fields.JP:
（ようやく、あの人間たちを
　振り切ることができた……）

（嬉しいな……どんなに探しても
　見つけられなかったのに……）

fields.EN:
(It's been a while since I saw
people, but no one was in there.)
fields.JP:
（でも久々に人間を見たけれど、
　あの中には……いなかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been a while since I saw
people, but no one was in there.)

fields.JP: おい起きろっ、ジャックってば
ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Heh, I'm surprised that you'd
be dreaming, Jack.
fields.JP:
はは、ジャックも夢見るんだな
ビックリしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, I'm surprised that you'd
be dreaming, Jack.

fields.EN:
(I'm glad I was with him.
After all, I'm able to share his
thoughts and feelings.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックの意思が感覚として分かるの、
　僕だけだもんな。同居してよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad I was with him.
After all, I'm able to share his
thoughts and feelings.)

fields.EN:
I know it wasn't a good dream,
but...
fields.JP:
決していい夢では
なかったかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it wasn't a good dream,
but...

fields.EN:
I'm sure you'll dream something
better soon, Jack.
fields.JP:
いつかいい夢が
見られるといいな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you'll dream something
better soon, Jack.

fields.EN:
In any case, looks like the
day finally arrived.
fields.JP:
それにしてもジャック、
ようやくこの日が来たな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, looks like the
day finally arrived.

fields.EN:
We're finally ready to search for
the lost Blood Maidens. No telling
what would happen if we're late.
fields.JP:
ついに今日から血式少女の捜索開始だ。
遅刻したらみんなに何言われるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're finally ready to search for
the lost Blood Maidens. No telling
what would happen if we're late.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Jack, I'm a bit busy now.
fields.JP: ジャック、今ちょっと手が離せない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, I'm a bit busy now.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Just a moment, Jack. Wrapping
this around me is a lot more
painstaking than it looks... Oof!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待っててジャック。
このさらしを巻くってのが
思いのほか面倒でさ……んしょっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a moment, Jack. Wrapping
this around me is a lot more
painstaking than it looks... Oof!

fields.EN:
This takes... so much of...
my time... every morning!
fields.JP: 毎朝……すごく、手間がかかる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This takes... so much of...
my time... every morning!

fields.EN:
But, I can't avoid it.
I am a prince after all.
fields.JP:
でも手は抜けない。
なんたって僕は王子さまだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I can't avoid it.
I am a prince after all.

fields.JP:
よし、できた。
どうだい？　ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I can't believe it's been weeks
since all that happened...
fields.JP:
それにしても
あれからもう数週間経ったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe it's been weeks
since all that happened...

fields.EN:
So, how are things, everyone?
I did suggest making this our
base, but are there any issues?
fields.JP:
で、どうだったみんな。
ここを拠点にするって言ってはみたけど、
住むには難しいかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how are things, everyone?
I did suggest making this our
base, but are there any issues?

fields.EN:
It's great that there are no
enemies, but it's lacking a lot
in terms of general living.
fields.JP:
敵がいないって意味ではいい場所だが、
居住のために作られた施設でもない。
住むにはいろいろ足りねぇだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's great that there are no
enemies, but it's lacking a lot
in terms of general living.

fields.EN:
If so, we could use this place to
sleep, and look for what we need
back at the Liberated District...
fields.JP:
じゃあ最悪、ここは寝床だけにして、
必要なものは、また解放地区に探しに行く
しかないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, we could use this place to
sleep, and look for what we need
back at the Liberated District...

fields.JP: ……おまえの意見はどうなんだ、イツキ

fields.EN:
Well, it seems as if we can use
this location as a base just fine.
fields.JP:
ざっと見た感じだが、
何とか拠点にできると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems as if we can use
this location as a base just fine.

fields.EN:
We do need to modify the place
a bit, though. In particular, we
need a decent area to sleep in.
fields.JP:
まあ……かなりの大改造が
必要な点は否めないがな……
主に寝床を作るという意味で
fields.LOCALIZED:
We do need to modify the place
a bit, though. In particular, we
need a decent area to sleep in.

fields.EN:
Electricity and water sources are
available, so fixing them up
a bit should make them work fine.
fields.JP:
最低限必要な電気と水道は生きてたから、
ちょっと修理すれば使えるようになるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Electricity and water sources are
available, so fixing them up
a bit should make them work fine.

fields.EN: Heh heh! Leave that to me!
fields.JP: ふっふっふ、拙者に任せておくがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh heh! Leave that to me!

fields.EN:
So, finally a time and place for
Takumi to shine.
fields.JP: お、タクミもついに輝く時が来たか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, finally a time and place for
Takumi to shine.

fields.EN:
I've always been shining!
Like, shining all the time!
fields.JP:
輝いてるよ！？
ボクチンいつだって輝きっぱなしだよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've always been shining!
Like, shining all the time!

fields.EN:
Oh, we know that.
We're counting on you, Takumi.
You too, Kaede, Itsuki!
fields.JP:
分かってるって。
頼りにしてるからね、タクミ。
それにカエデもイツキも！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, we know that.
We're counting on you, Takumi.
You too, Kaede, Itsuki!

fields.EN:
Did you hear that, my princess?!
It looks like there is hope
after all!
fields.JP:
姫、よかったな！
これで希望がさらに見えてきた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you hear that, my princess?!
It looks like there is hope
after all!

fields.JP: そうだね……おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I believe building a place to
sleep will be quite difficult.
fields.JP:
それで、さっきも言ったように、
住居を作るのが最も大変だと思う。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe building a place to
sleep will be quite difficult.

fields.EN:
Which means you need some
muscles, right? Leave that to me
and Takumi.
fields.JP:
つまりは力仕事だな。
まかせとけ俺とタクミでどうにかする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means you need some
muscles, right? Leave that to me
and Takumi.

fields.EN:
We're about the only ones
here who can flex their muscles.
fields.JP:
力仕事に向いてそうなのは、
俺たちくらいしかいねぇだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're about the only ones
here who can flex their muscles.

fields.EN:
Uh, but I have to fix up the
infrastructure here. Why don't you
ask someone else?
fields.JP:
あたいはインフラの整備があるし？
他を頼ってほしいな～なんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but I have to fix up the
infrastructure here. Why don't you
ask someone else?

fields.JP: んなこと言っても他に誰が……

fields.EN:
Hm? What is it?
Why are you looking at me?
fields.JP:
……ん？　なんだおまえたち。
ワレの顔をじろじろ見て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What is it?
Why are you looking at me?

fields.EN:
Hameln, you're really strong,
aren't you?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、お前確か
すっごい力持ちだったよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, you're really strong,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
Indeed! I do boast having
impressive strength!
fields.JP: その通り、力には自信があるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I do boast having
impressive strength!

fields.JP: よしよし、労働力確保だ

fields.EN:
Huh? You're going to let a little
girl do manual labor? Horrible.
fields.JP:
えー、マモルこんなちっちゃな女の子を
肉体労働にかり出すの？　ひどいなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You're going to let a little
girl do manual labor? Horrible.

fields.EN:
Hey, she may be a runt,
but she's way stronger than
any of us here.
fields.JP:
見てくれは小さくても、
こいつには俺たちじゃ比べものに
ならないくらいの力がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, she may be a runt,
but she's way stronger than
any of us here.

fields.EN:
Don't you remember what she
did back when we played tag?
fields.JP:
ヒカリだって見ただろう？
あの鬼ごっこの時に
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you remember what she
did back when we played tag?

fields.EN:
There's no reason not to have
Hameln help us.
fields.JP: ハーメルンを使わない手はないぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no reason not to have
Hameln help us.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you're talking
about, but I can help if you want.
fields.JP:
なんか知らんが、
手伝えることなら手伝ってやるぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you're talking
about, but I can help if you want.

fields.EN:
That's great, Hameln!
I'll check with you later!
fields.JP:
助かるぜハーメルン！
あとでよろしくな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's great, Hameln!
I'll check with you later!

fields.EN:
I'll go ahead and get the
electricity and water fixed,
while Hame-chan does her part!
fields.JP:
ハメちゃんが頑張ってくれてる間に
電気と水道はばっちり直しとくぜ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll go ahead and get the
electricity and water fixed,
while Hammy does her part!

fields.EN:
Good! With this "electricity"
thing, I can read my manga
in a brighter area, correct?
fields.JP:
うむ！　その電気とやらがあれば漫画を
もっと明るい場所で読めるのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! With this "electricity"
thing, I can read my manga
in a brighter area, correct?

fields.EN:
Now, now, let her be. It's important to
Hameln-chan.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、いいじゃない。
ハーメルンちゃんには大事なことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, let her be.
It must be important to her.

fields.EN:
The infrastructure's taken care of.
What do we do once everything's set up?
fields.JP:
インフラ整備の件はこれでいいとして、
体制が整ったあとはどうする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Assuming we have the
infrastructure operational,
what do we do afterward?

fields.EN:
Our main objective is to survive.
Once that's secured, we should
look for the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
当面の目的は、生き延びること。
それから他の血式少女を探す
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our main objective is to survive.
Once that's secured, we should
look for the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN: Both are gonna take some time.
fields.JP: どっちも長丁場になりそうだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Both are gonna take some time.

fields.EN:
I'm prepared for it.
That's why we should set up our
base here.
fields.JP:
覚悟はしてる。
そのためにここに拠点を作るんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm prepared for it.
That's why we should set up our
base here.

fields.EN:
We should also set roles for
each of us since we're in it
for the long haul.
fields.JP:
長く共同生活を送るためにも
おのおの役割を決めておいた方がいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should also set roles for
each of us since we're in it
for the long haul.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it wouldn't be efficient if
we all went searching together.
fields.JP:
また全員でぞろぞろ探索しに行くってのも
あまり効率的とは言えねえしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it wouldn't be efficient if
we all went searching together.

fields.EN:
I assume it would be best for me,
my princess, and Jack to search
for the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
僕と姫、それにジャックは
血式少女たちの捜索でいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume it would be best for me,
my princess, and Jack to search
for the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I will go, too!
My power should prove useful!
fields.JP:
もちろんワレも同行するぞ！
この力、必要であろう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will go, too!
My power should prove useful!

fields.EN:
That's true, but we need someone
to guard the area.
fields.JP:
それはありがたいけど、
ここの安全は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true, but we need someone
to guard the area.

fields.EN:
I can take care of that while
you all go out on your search.
fields.JP:
お前らがいない間は、
俺が警備を引き受ける
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can take care of that while
you all go out on your search.

fields.EN:
I'll also keep an eye out on
the area. You never know if one
of them comes wandering in here.
fields.JP:
ついでに、この辺の探索もやっておく。
生き残った連中が迷い込んでくるかも
しれねぇしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll also keep an eye out on
the area. You never know if one
of them comes wandering in here.

fields.EN:
Are you sure you can handle
all that?
fields.JP:
大丈夫なのか？
そんなに一人で抱えこんで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you can handle
all that?

fields.EN:
Don't you worry.
It's just something that comes
with guard duty.
fields.JP:
んなこと言われなくても分かってるって。
探索つっても、門番と警備のついでに、
その辺を見てまわるだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry.
It's just something that comes
with guard duty.

fields.EN:
And, I'll make a run for it
if something ain't going right.
fields.JP: ヤバイと思ったらとっとと逃げるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I'll make a run for it
if something ain't going right.

fields.EN:
You girls are gonna need as much
muscle as possible, especially
with all those Marchens out there.
fields.JP:
それに、おまえらはメルヒェンどもが
ウヨウヨいるとこに行くことになるんだ。
戦力は少しでも多い方がいいだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls are gonna need as much
muscle as possible, especially
with all those Marchens out there.

fields.EN:
I guess you're going to be
carrying a great load for us while
we're gone...
fields.JP:
そうか……
僕たちがいない間はマモルにかなり
負担をかけてしまうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're going to be
carrying a great load for us while
we're gone...

fields.EN:
Don't you worry.
I like keeping myself busy
anyway.
fields.JP:
気にすんなっての。
元々こういう方が性に合ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry.
I like keeping myself busy
anyway.

fields.EN:
I can leave my minions here if it
will help ease worries!
fields.JP: 心配なら、ワレの下僕を残しておくぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can leave my minions here if it
will help ease worries!

fields.EN:
Then I'll work on improving your weapons,
Otsuu-chan — yours and everyone else's!
fields.JP:
じゃあワイは、そんなおつうちゃんたちの
武器の改良やな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna be modifying you
girls' weapons!

fields.EN:
You're gonna be all over me after
seeing my mad mod skills that
I learned courtesy of Dawn!
fields.JP:
黎明で学んだ血式武器の改良技術、
見たらきっと惚れてまうで！
四の五の言わんとワイに任せとき～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're gonna be all over me after
seeing my mad mod skills that
I learned courtesy of Dawn!

fields.EN:
I suppose I can use my experience
that I amassed from researching
the Jail and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
僕は……これまでの経験を生かして、
ジェイルと血式少女の研究……でいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I can use my experience
that I amassed from researching
the Jail and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
You'd be the successor to
Professor.
fields.JP: 博士の遺志を継いで、ってところだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd be the successor to
Professor.

fields.EN: I guess you can call it that.
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess you can call it that.

fields.EN:
I'm sure I can offer invaluable
information to you Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
きっと有用な情報を
君たち血式少女に提供しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure I can offer invaluable
information to you Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I'm gonna prep daily necessities
and stuff that may help out on
your search.
fields.JP:
あたしは生活用品から探索に役立つもの、
色々な道具の配給と整理をやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna prep daily necessities
and stuff that may help out on
your search.

fields.EN:
Yeah, you totally look the type
of keeping things in order.
fields.JP: あーなんか整列させるの上手そうだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you totally look the type
of keeping things in order.

fields.EN:
You got it! And, if anyone dares
puts the goods out of place,
I'm gonna kick their behinds!
fields.JP:
分かってるじゃんっ。
そうだよ、ちゃんと並ばないヤツは
いつだって蹴っ飛ばしてやるからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it! And, if anyone dares
puts the goods out of place,
I'm gonna kick their behinds!

fields.EN:
Um... Well, I guess I can...
fetch water?
fields.JP:
えーじゃあ私は
どうしようかなぁ……水汲みとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Well, I guess I can...
fetch water?

fields.EN:
I can do that.
You can be our go-to doctor.
fields.JP:
そんなん俺がやるっつーの。
おまえは救護室とかだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can do that.
You can be our go-to doctor.

fields.EN:
Huh?!
But, I only know how to patch up
minor injuries and things!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？
私、簡単な手当てくらいしかできないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?!
But, I only know how to patch up
minor injuries and things!

fields.EN:
Even that's a major help in
this place. I'll make sure you have
the stuff you need later.
fields.JP:
それができるだけでも、
ここではありがたいってこと。
必要な物資は後で届けるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even that's a major help in
this place. I'll make sure you have
the stuff you need later.

fields.EN:
Hikari, each one has an aptitude,
and having you man our infirmary
would be of great help to all.
fields.JP:
そうだなヒカリ、適材適所だ。
君が救護室にいてくれれば、
みんな救われると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari, each one has an aptitude,
and having you man our infirmary
would be of great help to all.

fields.EN:
Okay then...
If everyone says so.
I'll do my best.
fields.JP:
……分かった。
みんながいいなら私、頑張るね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay then...
If everyone says so.
I'll do my best.

fields.EN:
Everyone...
Thank you so very much.
fields.JP:
みなさん、
本当にありがとうごさいます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone...
Thank you so very much.

fields.EN:
No need to thank us.
We're all in this together.
fields.JP:
礼なんか言うなって。
助け合いなんて仲間なら当たり前だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to thank us.
We're all in this together.

fields.EN:
Hahaha! We have a plan now!
Well, it is time I announce the
name of our base of operations!
fields.JP:
ふはは、決まったようだな！
では最後にこの拠点の名前を発表するのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! We have a plan now!
Well, it is time I announce the
name of our base of operations!

fields.JP:
お……おう、
一応聞いておいてやるよ
いいか貴様ら聞いて驚け――

その名も『ハーメルン解放地区』！
どうだ、カッコよかろう！！

fields.EN: I'm not sure where to start...
fields.JP: どこからどう突っ込んでいいのかな
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not sure where to start...

fields.EN:
I don't recall us liberating
anything here...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall us liberating
anything here...

fields.EN:
I suppose you could say
Hameln was liberated from her
labyrinth...
fields.JP:
まあハーメルンが世に解き放たれた
という意味ではギリギリ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you could say
Hameln was liberated from her
labyrinth...

fields.EN:
I bet she just wanted to toss
the word "Liberated District" in.
fields.JP: 解放地区って言いたかっただけだろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet she just wanted to toss
the word "Liberated District" in.

fields.JP: そんにゃことはにゃいぞ！！

fields.EN:
Huh, you may be right, Mamoru...
I mean, did you hear Hameln-chan's
super slur?
fields.JP:
あ、図星なんだ……
すっごい噛んじゃってるし
ハーメルンちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, you may be right, Mamoru...
I mean, did you hear Hammy's
super slur?

fields.JP: ぜんぜん噛んでにゃい！！

fields.EN:
Well, we are borrowing her place,
so I guess we can call it that.
fields.JP:
まあハーメルンの住まいを間借りしてるし、
名前はそれでいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we are borrowing her place,
so I guess we can call it that.

fields.EN:
Hmph! You should accept the fact
that you all like that name!
fields.JP:
ふ、ふんっ、気に入ったのなら
素直に言えばよいものを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! You should accept the fact
that you all like that name!

fields.EN:
In any case it's settled...
Hameln Liberated District it is!
fields.JP:
まあよい、
ではハーメルン解放地区で決定だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case it's settled...
Hameln Liberated District it is!

fields.JP: ハーメルン解放地区、ねえ……

fields.EN:
I'm surprised myself that I'm
already getting used to it...
fields.JP:
まあ、言い慣れるとこれはこれで
しっくりきてしまうのが恐ろしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised myself that I'm
already getting used to it...

fields.EN:
All right, I'm ready.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Jack.
fields.JP:
よし、着替え完了。
おまたせ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, I'm ready.
Sorry to keep you waiting, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Yes, it's time we begin our
expeditions. Let's do our best.
fields.JP:
ああ、今日から本格的に捜索開始だ。
一緒に頑張ろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's time we begin our
expeditions. Let's do our best.

fields.EN:
