All that worries me now is
Ningyohime... She hasn't been
herself recently...
fields.JP:
さて、人魚姫は大丈夫かな……
色々ありすぎて、最近塞ぎがちだったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that worries me now is
Little Mermaid... She hasn't been
herself recently...

fields.EN:
I need to support her
no matter what...
fields.JP: ちゃんと僕がそばにいてあげないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to support her
no matter what...

fields.JP:
みんな、すまない。
遅くなった

fields.EN:
Looks like we have everyone here
now. Let's begin.
fields.JP:
これで全員揃ったな。
では始めようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we have everyone here
now. Let's begin.

fields.JP:
さて今日から早速、血式少女の
捜索になるわけだが……

fields.EN:
You mentioned that we should
search the Aquarium Ruins
first, right?
fields.JP:
うん。まずは元解放地区から近い
水族館跡エリアって話だったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mentioned that we should
search the Aquarium Ruins
first, right?

fields.EN:
You girls haven't gone there
before?
fields.JP: そこは未知の場所だったりするのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls haven't gone there
before?

fields.EN:
No, we did long ago,
though there's no telling how
bad the place is now.
fields.JP:
昔、探索したことあるよ。
でもこうなってしまった今は、
安全とは言いがたいだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, we did long ago,
though there's no telling how
bad the place is now.

fields.EN:
Indeed. Which is why I would
like to ask for you all to be
very careful out there.
fields.JP:
ああ。だから探索チームは、
決して無理をしないでほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. Which is why I would
like to ask for you all to be
very careful out there.

fields.EN: We'll be careful. If we go down, we won't be able to bring the Blood Maidens back together.
fields.JP:
僕たちが倒れたら、もう血式少女を
再結集させられなくなるからね。
気をつけるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course we will. After all,
if we perish, there wouldn't
be anyone else left to fight.

fields.EN:
That's not it, Otsuu-chan. That matters too,
but more than anything, we just want everyone
to come back safely.
fields.JP:
そうじゃないよ、おつうちゃん。
そのことも大事だけど、何より
みんな無事で帰ってきてほしいだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just so you know, it's beyond
just losing. We simply want you
all to be safe.

fields.EN:
Yeah, no one wants to see
anyone hurt like before anymore.
fields.JP:
ああ、これ以上仲間が傷つくのは、
もう見たくないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, no one wants to see
anyone hurt like before anymore.

fields.EN:
And yet, we need to rely on
you all again. I'm truly sorry
you have to go through all this.
fields.JP:
それでも君たちに託すしかないのが、
本当に申し訳ないのだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, we need to rely on
you all again. I'm truly sorry
you have to go through all this.

fields.EN:
Ah, I see. I didn't know you
all felt that way. I'm sorry.
We'll be back safe, I promise.
fields.JP:
そっか……うん、ごめん。
心配してくれてありがとうみんな。
ちゃんと無事で帰ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see. I didn't know you
all felt that way. I'm sorry.
We'll be back safe, I promise.

fields.EN: I'm sure you'll keep your promise.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sure you'll keep your promise.

fields.EN:
By the way, how many of them
Blood Maidens are lost right now?
fields.JP:
それで探すっていう血式少女は、
何人いるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, how many of them
Blood Maidens are lost right now?

fields.EN:
Besides me and Princess,
there were six others in Dawn.
fields.JP: 僕と姫を除いて、黎明にはあと６人いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides me and Princess,
there were six others in Dawn.

fields.EN:
Akazukin is one of them.
She's the one who was back there
when we freed Mamoru.
fields.JP:
まずは『赤ずきん』……
マモルたちの解放に行った時に
一緒に行動してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood is one of them.
She's the one who was back there
when we freed Mamoru.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, we lost her in all
the chaos back then...
fields.JP:
でも、あの時の混乱で
離れ離れになっちゃってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, we lost her in all
the chaos back then...

fields.EN: I only saw them from a distance, but they were all incredibly strong, so I'm sure she'll be okay.
fields.JP:
遠目に見ただけだけど、
全員すげえ強かったから、
きっと大丈夫だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember her hacking away
at the Marchens, so I'm pretty
sure she's okay.

fields.EN: Yup, I'm sure of it, too!
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, I'm sure of it, too!

fields.EN:
Of course, the other person
who was there that went missing
is Alice.
fields.JP:
それとこれも同じく、
一緒に行動していた『アリス』。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, the other person
who was there that went missing
is Alice.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ジャック……ああ、分かってるよ
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
As you can see, Alice is very
important to Jack, so I would like
to find her as soon as possible.
fields.JP:
この通り、アリスはジャックの大切な人だ。
だから必ず見つけ出してあげたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you can see, Alice is very
important to Jack, so I would like
to find her as soon as possible.

fields.EN:
Well, I was next to them back in
the cell, so I wouldn't mind
having her back, too.
fields.JP:
俺らも長いことお隣さんだったからな。
他人事とは思えねぇよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was next to them back in
the cell, so I wouldn't mind
having her back, too.

fields.JP: うん。もう家族みたいなものだよね！

fields.EN:
We also had Kaguyahime.
I recall her staying behind at
the Dawn headquarters.
fields.JP:
そして次が『かぐや姫』。
彼女は黎明に残っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also had Kaguya.
I recall her staying behind at
the Dawn headquarters.

fields.EN:
Finally, the three sisters,
Oyayubihime, Shirayukihime, and
Nemurihime, to make six.
fields.JP:
そして『親指姫』『白雪姫』『眠り姫』の
三姉妹で、６人だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally, the three sisters,
Thumbelina, Snow White, and
Sleeping Beauty, to make six.

fields.EN:
But I'm not sure whether those
sisters would help our cause
or not.
fields.JP:
まあ、親指姫たち三姉妹は
協力してくれるか分からないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm not sure whether those
sisters would help our cause
or not.

fields.EN:
A bit...
In any case, I'll do my best.
fields.JP: ちょっとね……とにかく最善は尽くすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A bit...
In any case, I'll do my best.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will. As for the
Aquarium Ruins, is there anywhere
there they could hide?
fields.JP:
そうしてくれると信じてるよ。
それで、水族館跡エリアには潜伏できそうな
場所ってのはあるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will. As for the
Aquarium Ruins, is there anywhere
there they could hide?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm not sure there are
any really good hiding spots
there.
fields.JP:
うーん……潜伏できそうな場所って
言われると難しいけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm not sure there are
any really good hiding spots
there.

fields.EN:
But, it is close to the former
Liberated District, so someone may
have run away there.
fields.JP:
でも元解放地区から近い水族館跡エリアは
逃げ込むのに最適とも言えるから、
もしかしたら誰かいるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it is close to the former
Liberated District, so someone may
have run away there.

fields.EN: If no one fled this way, the Aquarium Ruins—the only area we can reach—look promising.
fields.JP:
こっち側に誰も逃げてきてないなら、
唯一行ける水族館跡エリアは
期待できそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since no one came this way,
I think it's safe to say someone
may be in hiding there.

fields.EN:
Looks like we have a bit of
hope now.
fields.JP:
よっしゃ、作戦が決まると
希望が出てくるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we have a bit of
hope now.

fields.EN:
Well then, we'll depart as soon
as we're ready.
fields.JP:
じゃあ準備ができ次第、
僕たちは出発するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, we'll depart as soon
as we're ready.

fields.JP:
あ……う、うん
大丈夫だよ、わたしは

fields.EN:
Everyone's doing their best,
so I need to do my best, too.
fields.JP:
みんな頑張ってるし、
わたしも負けてられないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's doing their best,
so I need to do my best, too.

fields.EN:
Is there something on your mind
that you'd like to talk about,
Princess?
fields.JP:
姫、何か抱えてるなら
僕に相談をしてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there something on your mind
that you'd like to talk about,
Princess?

fields.EN:
Oh, no. Nothing at all.
I'm fine, really.
fields.JP:
ううん、本当に大丈夫だよ。
何も心配要らないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, no. Nothing at all.
I'm fine, really.

fields.JP:
そうか？
それならいいんだけど……

fields.EN:
(It's hard to see her faking such
an obvious front like that...)
fields.JP:
（その明るい振る舞いが
　空元気だって分かるだけに、つらいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's hard to see her faking such
an obvious front like that...)

fields.EN:
(Ningyohime can be a bit
stubborn at times, but...)
fields.JP:
（でもこういう時の人魚姫、
　頑固だからなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Little Mermaid can be a bit
stubborn at times, but...)

fields.EN:
Please remember that I'm always
here by your side, Princess.
fields.JP:
いつだって僕は姫の味方だからね。
それだけは忘れないでほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please remember that I'm always
here by your side, Princess.

fields.EN:
The place is so quiet
and spooky...
fields.JP:
なんだか静まりかえってて
不気味だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place is so quiet
and spooky...

fields.EN: There may be a Nightmare around.
fields.JP:
ここにもナイトメアが
いるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED: There may be a Nightmare around.

fields.EN:
We know too well how dangerous
Nightmares are, but we need to be
careful of the Marchens, too.
fields.JP:
それに最近ナイトメアに
出会いすぎて麻痺してるけど、
メルヒェンだって気をつけないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
We know too well how dangerous
Nightmares are, but we need to be
careful of the Marchens, too.

fields.EN: Hah! I will crush them with ease!
fields.JP:
なに、そんな奴ら
ワレがすぐに粉砕してくれる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hah! I will crush them with ease!

fields.EN:
I'm counting on you.
But, we need to avoid battles that
can be avoided, okay?
fields.JP:
頼りにしてる……
けど、無駄な戦闘は避けないと
駄目だからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm counting on you.
But, we need to avoid battles that
can be avoided, okay?

fields.EN:
Hmph!
You don't need to tell me that!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph!
You don't need to tell me that!

fields.EN:
Either the prisoners were
relocated, or they're already...
fields.JP:
囚人はどこかに連れ去られたか……
それとももう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Either the prisoners were
relocated, or they're already...

fields.EN:
Whatever the reason, it looks
like the place is deserted now.
fields.JP:
どっちにしろ、ここはもう
捨てられたようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the reason, it looks
like the place is deserted now.

fields.EN:
It feels weird, especially since
this is where I met
Ningyohime...
fields.JP:
でも、ここで出会ったんだよな……
人魚姫とは
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird, especially since
this is where I met
Little Mermaid...

fields.EN:
Oh? She lived here, did she?
How interesting!
fields.JP:
ほう、人魚姫はここに住んでいたのか！
これは興味が湧くな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? She lived here, did she?
How interesting!

fields.EN:
So, how did you make home
out of this place?
fields.JP:
やっぱりワレのように
隠れ家を作っていたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how did you make home
out of this place?

fields.EN:
Ah, I see. Then how did you and
Otsuu meet?
fields.JP:
そうか、ないのか……
では、おつうとはどのような感じで
仲間になったのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I see. Then how did you and
Otsuu meet?

fields.JP: さあワレに話すがいい！

fields.EN:
I'll tell you later when we return
to our base, Haa-chan...
fields.JP:
……今は作戦中だから、
また拠点に戻ったら話すね、ハーちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll tell you later when we return
to our base, Hammy...

fields.EN:
Hm, is that so?
I trust you will keep your word.
fields.JP:
むぅ、そうであるか……
じゃあ約束だぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, is that so?
I trust you will keep your word.

fields.EN:
(Princess isn't well after all...
She's been like that for quite
some time now...)
fields.JP:
（姫……やっぱり元気がないな。
　ここのところずっとだから心配だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Princess isn't well after all...
She's been like that for quite
some time now...)

fields.EN:
Promise you'll tell me later!
Promise!
fields.JP: 絶対、絶対聞かせてもらうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Promise you'll tell me later!
Promise!

fields.JP: ちょっと待って、みんな
どうかしたの、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 辺りが白くなってきた……！

fields.EN:
Princess? I'm quite delighted
that you're hugging me like this,
but I can't move...
fields.JP:
姫？　嬉しいけど
そんなに抱きつかれたら動けない――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess? I'm quite delighted
that you're hugging me like this,
but I can't move...

fields.EN:
No...
I don't want to fight those
monsters anymore...
fields.JP:
やだよ……
もうこんな化け物戦いたくないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No...
I don't want to fight those
monsters anymore...

fields.EN:
(She's shaking...
I can even hear her heartbeat
pounding in frenzy...)
fields.JP:
（姫……こんなに震えて……
　それに心臓の音もすごい
　激しく伝わってくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's shaking...
I can even hear her heartbeat
pounding in frenzy...)

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just come and stand behind me.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよ姫。
さあ僕の後ろに下がっていてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just come and stand behind me.

fields.EN:
There's nothing for you to be
afraid of.
fields.JP:
はは、何にも怖いことなんて
ありませんからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing for you to be
afraid of.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: You two, give me a little time. There's something I want to try.
fields.JP:
２人とも、ちょっと試したい
ことがあるから、少し時間をくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to test something out,
so let me handle this.

fields.EN:
You! Nightmare!
We have no intention of bringing
harm to you!
fields.JP:
そこのナイトメア！
僕たちは君に危害を加える気はない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You! Nightmare!
We have no intention of bringing
harm to you!

fields.EN:
(I was able to communicate with
Jack, so maybe I can communicate
with it, too!)
fields.JP:
（ジャックとは意思の疎通が図れたんだ、
　僕ならできるかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was able to communicate with
Jack, so maybe I can communicate
with it, too!)

fields.EN: Please, can you let us pass?
fields.JP:
だからどうかここを
通してくれないだろうか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Please, can you let us pass?

fields.EN:
There's no reason for us to
fight!
fields.JP:
僕たちは敵対する理由は
きっとないはずだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no reason for us to
fight!

fields.JP: グ、グルゥゥゥゥゥァアッ！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Tch...
I guess it was worth the try...
fields.JP:
くっ……期待したけど、
駄目だったか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch...
I guess it was worth the try...

fields.EN:
(Does that mean there's something
different about Jack?)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりジャックだけが
　特別なんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does that mean there's something
different about Jack?)

fields.JP: 貴様、ワレを誰だと思っておる……

fields.EN:
Insolent fool!
I will crush you!
fields.JP: この無礼者め、叩き潰してくれる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Insolent fool!
I will crush you!

fields.EN:
Hameln!
There's no way to kill it!
fields.JP:
ハーメルン！
そいつは何をやっても死なないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln!
There's no way to kill it!

fields.EN: You never know until you try!
fields.JP:
そんなこと、やってみなければ
分からないのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: You never know until you try!

fields.JP:
なっ！？
傷がすぐに塞がったぞ！？

だから言っただろう！
そいつは不死身なんだって！

fields.EN:
So what now?!
You better not be telling me
to run!
fields.JP:
じゃあどうすればいいのだ！？
まさか戦うなとでも言うつもりか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So what now?!
You better not be telling me
to run!

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, that's all
we can do! We need to run!
fields.JP:
ああ、そうだ。
コイツからは逃げるしかない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, that's all
we can do! We need to run!

fields.JP: ぬぬ……ワレが背中を向けるなど……！

fields.EN:
I understand how you feel,
but we need to run, now!
fields.JP:
気持ちは分かるけど、
今は逃げるぞハーメルン！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand how you feel,
but we need to run, now!

fields.EN:
Princess, let's go. There's no
way we can end our lives here.
fields.JP:
姫、さあ行くよ。こんなところで
終わるわけにはいかないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, let's go. There's no
way we can end our lives here.

fields.JP:
みんなどうしてあんなことに……
もうイヤ……イヤだよぅ……！

fields.EN:
We did so much, and yet everyone
keeps dying! Dying...!
fields.JP:
あんなに頑張っていたのに
みんな死んじゃう、死んじゃうよぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did so much, and yet everyone
keeps dying! Dying...!

fields.EN:
(That seals it... What she saw
back at Dawn traumatized her
badly.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりこの間の黎明での出来事に、
　かなりのショックを受けている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That seals it... What she saw
back at Dawn traumatized her
badly.)

fields.EN:
Hey, Otsuu!
I thought we were running!
fields.JP:
おいおつう！
逃げるのではなかったのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu!
I thought we were running!

fields.EN:
Please stand up, Princess.
We can't die here for the sake
of all that the others have done.
fields.JP:
ほら姫、立って。
ここで死んだらそれこそ
全員無駄死にだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please stand up, Princess.
We can't die here for the sake
of all that the others have done.

fields.EN:
You're right...
I'm so sorry, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
そう……だよね。
ごめんね、おつうちゃん。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I'm so sorry, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Tch! How degrading!
The next time we meet,
I will make you pay!
fields.JP:
くっ、なんという卑怯なやつめ！
いつか絶対その無礼を後悔させてやるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! How degrading!
The next time we meet,
I will make you pay!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン、今だ！
こっちに来い！
まったく遅いぞおつう！

fields.EN:
Sorry about that.
Now, let's run!
fields.JP:
ああ、すまない！
じゃあとりあえず逃げるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry about that.
Now, let's run!

fields.JP: ようやく、振り切れたな……

fields.EN:
I can't believe that thing can't
be defeated...
fields.JP: まさかあんな卑怯なやつがいるとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe that thing can't
be defeated...

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, that's the truth.
We just have to make sure we
avoid encountering it again.
fields.JP:
認めたくないけど、仕方ないんだ。
なんとか鉢合わせないように、
探索を続けていくしかない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, that's the truth.
We just have to make sure we
avoid encountering it again.

fields.EN:
How I want to get this
expedition over with soon.
fields.JP: 早めに終わらせたいところだね、まったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
How I want to get this
expedition over with soon.

fields.EN:
Princess?!
Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP: 姫！　しっかりするんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess?!
Get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: はぁーっ……はぁーっ……ふふっ
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
She's not entering her
Genocide state...
It's like Alice's...
fields.JP:
これは、ジェノサイド化じゃない
アリスの時と同じ未知の変化……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not entering her
Massacre state...
It's like Alice's...

fields.JP:
姫！　人魚姫！
気をしっかり持つんだ！
はははっ……あはっ、ははっ……っ！

fields.EN:
I'm here for you.
Please, calm down...
fields.JP:
僕がついてるから。
大丈夫だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm here for you.
Please, calm down...

fields.JP: きゃはっ！　きゃはははっ！！
た、助かったハーメルン
ははっ……はは、はっ……あはぁっ

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what's happening, but
what I do know is that she isn't
the same Ningyohime I know.
fields.JP:
よくは分からないが、
人魚姫はまともではないようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what's happening, but
what I do know is that she isn't
the same Little Mermaid I know.

fields.EN:
Don't worry!
She's just panicking, that's all!
fields.JP:
これは、違うんだ……！
姫は一時的にちょっとパニックに
なってしまってるだけなんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry!
She's just panicking, that's all!

fields.EN:
I understand you wanting to cover
for her, but her eyes says
otherwise.
fields.JP:
仲間だからな、おつうがそう思いたい
気持ちは分かるぞ。だが人魚姫の目は
そうは言っておらん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand you wanting to cover
for her, but her eyes says
otherwise.

fields.EN:
I don't want to strike her too,
but if we don't do something
we'll both perish!
fields.JP:
ワレも攻撃などしたくはないが、
黙っていたらやられるぞ、おつう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to strike her too,
but if we don't do something
we'll both perish!

fields.EN:
Please, stop...
Princess, please calm down...
fields.JP:
そんな、２人ともやめてくれ……
姫、頼むから正気に戻ってよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, stop...
Princess, please calm down...

fields.JP: きゃはっ！　きゃははっっっ！！

fields.EN:
What the...?!
What's with her power?!
fields.JP:
おい貴様、本当にいつもの人魚姫か！？
なんだこの強さは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?!
What's with her power?!

fields.EN:
Tch! I can't keep up...!
Why you...! Urgh!
fields.JP:
くっ……なんという動きっ……
このっ……うぐっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! I can't keep up...!
Why you...! Urgh!

fields.EN: Don't worry, it's just a scratch.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ、おつう。
こんなものかすり傷だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry, it's just a scratch.

fields.EN:
I'll buy some time for you,
so do something, quick!
fields.JP:
だからワレが時間を稼いでいるうちに、
どうするか早く決断するのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll buy some time for you,
so do something, quick!

fields.EN:
Tch... Princess, you have to
come to your senses!
Hameln's our friend!
fields.JP:
くっ……姫、どうか戻ってよ……！
ハーメルンは仲間だろ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... Princess, you have to
come to your senses!
Hameln's our friend!

fields.JP:
きゃはっ……ぁぁぁ……
…………きゃははははははっ！！
そっち行ったぞ、おつう！

それでも僕は
姫を攻撃なんてできない……！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ジャック……！
僕を、庇ってくれたのか……
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎちち……おづ……う……
み……まま……もももも……

fields.EN:
Urgh...!
I can feel his pain!
fields.JP: くっ……！！　痛みの感覚が……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh...!
I can feel his pain!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... That must have
hurt... You're bleeding badly...
fields.JP:
ごめんな……痛かったろう……！
血もこんなに噴き出して……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... That must have
hurt... You're bleeding badly...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu! Look!
Little Mermaid is...

fields.JP:
あれ……わた、し……
今何を……？

姫……元に……
戻ってくれたのか……？

fields.EN:
I don't know what happened, but
it's no surprise that she'd pass
out with the power she showed.
fields.JP:
よく分からぬが、
あれほどの力をいきなり振るえば、
反動で気絶してもおかしくはないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what happened, but
it's no surprise that she'd pass
out with the power she showed.

fields.EN:
Hameln...
I'm sorry, but can we return to
the base?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン……悪いんだけど、
一旦拠点に戻ってもいいかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln...
I'm sorry, but can we return to
the base?

fields.EN:
There's no way she can come
with us with how she is now.
fields.JP:
このまま姫を連れて行く
わけにもいかないし、何より心配なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way she can come
with us with how she is now.

fields.EN:
I'm glad you brought it up.
I would've suggested the same.
fields.JP:
もちろんであるぞ。
貴様が言い出さなかったら
ワレが言い出すところだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you brought it up.
I would've suggested the same.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime is our friend,
so keeping her safe is our top
priority.
fields.JP:
なんせ仲間のピンチだからな。
人魚姫のことが最優先であるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid is our friend,
so keeping her safe is our top
priority.

fields.JP: ありがとうハーメルン……

fields.EN:
She's just unconscious,
that's all. But it'd be best for
her to rest for a while.
fields.JP:
気絶してるだけだから、大丈夫。
今はそっとしておこうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's just unconscious,
that's all. But it'd be best for
her to rest for a while.

fields.EN:
You scared us when you were
heaving Ningyohime back.
fields.JP:
いきなり人魚姫を背負って
戻ってきた時は肝を冷やしたぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You scared us when you were
heaving Little Mermaid back.

fields.EN:
In any case, we're glad you're
all safe.
fields.JP: 本当、無事でよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we're glad you're
all safe.

fields.EN:
Hey, Otsuu.
So, what happened back at the
Aquarium Ruins?
fields.JP:
おい、おつう。
水族館跡エリアでいったい何があった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Otsuu.
So, what happened back at the
Aquarium Ruins?

fields.EN:
That made it the second time
I've seen that transformation,
and I still don't know what it is.
fields.JP:
見るのはこれで二度目だけど、
やっぱり僕の知らない変化だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That made it the second time
I've seen that transformation,
and I still don't know what it is.

fields.EN:
But that's not the point.
The point is, I couldn't do
anything to help...
fields.JP:
いや、そんなことどうでもいい
僕には何もできなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's not the point.
The point is, I couldn't do
anything to help...

fields.EN:
All I could do was watch as
she went mad...!
fields.JP:
姫がおかしくなっていくのを、
ただ見ていることしかできなかったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I could do was watch as
she went mad...!

fields.EN:
Calm down.
It's not your fault.
fields.JP: 落ち着け。おまえのせいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down.
It's not your fault.

fields.EN:
Actually, I found records of
a similar phenomena that you
just described.
fields.JP:
……その現象に該当するだろう記述、
つい最近見たぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, I found records of
a similar phenomena that you
just described.

fields.EN:
Yes. I believe I have it right
here with the other documents we
recovered from Dawn. Let's see...
fields.JP:
ああ。確か元・解放地区から持ってきた
博士の資料の中に……あ、あった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I believe I have it right
here with the other documents we
recovered from Dawn. Let's see...

fields.EN:
C-Calm down, Otsuu.
Let me get the papers together.
fields.JP: お、落ち着けおつう、ちゃんと教えるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Calm down, Otsuu.
Let me get the papers together.

fields.EN:
It says here that Blood Maidens
enter a state called "Genocide"
when they are covered with blood.
fields.JP:
……まず血式少女には、血を多く浴びると
覚醒する『ジェノサイド化』がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
It says here that Blood Maidens
enter a state called "Massacre"
when they are covered with blood.

fields.EN:
That I know. Every Blood Maiden
who joined was taught that.
fields.JP:
ああ、それは知っている。
血式少女なら絶対に教わることだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That I know. Every Blood Maiden
who joined was taught that.

fields.EN:
It also says that there's one
other state to the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
そしてそれとは別に実はもう１つ、
血式少女には隠された現象がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also says that there's one
other state to the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
It's called "Blood Skelter."
Do you know this?
fields.JP:
それが『ブラッドスケルター化』……
だそうだ。聞いたことはあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's called "Blood Skelter."
Do you know this?

fields.EN:
What...?
I never heard that before...
fields.JP:
知らない……！
そんなの、聞いたこともない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...?
I never heard that before...

fields.EN:
One enters Blood Skelter when
they accumulate "Corruption,"
often through intense stress.
fields.JP:
『ブラッドスケルター化』は、
極度のストレスにより溜まる『穢れ』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
One enters Blood Skelter when
they accumulate "Corruption,"
often through intense stress.

fields.EN:
So, it seems like Blood Maidens
awaken into that state when they
have too much Corruption in them.
fields.JP:
この『穢れ』が蓄積されている状態で、
覚醒すると発生してしまう、と記されている
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems like Blood Maidens
awaken into that state when they
have too much Corruption in them.

fields.EN:
Does that mean that Ningyohime was under intense stress
the whole time?
fields.JP:
ってことは、人魚姫は極度のストレスに
さらされ続けていたってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean that Little
Mermaid was under intense stress
the whole time?

fields.EN:
I believe so...
She was quite reclusive after the
destruction of Dawn.
fields.JP:
心当たりは……ある。
黎明での出来事から姫は
塞ぎっぱなしだったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe so...
She was quite reclusive after the
destruction of Dawn.

fields.EN:
So, her body kept accumulating
this Corruption thing...
fields.JP:
それで人魚姫はその『穢れ』ってやつを
溜め込んじまったってことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, her body kept accumulating
this Corruption thing...

fields.EN:
Based on records and what has
happened thus far, I assume this
applies to all Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
記述と実際の出来事、
話を総合すると、これは君たち血式少女に
おそらく共通しているものだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Based on records and what has
happened thus far, I assume this
applies to all Blood Maidens.

fields.JP:
なんだよ……そんなの僕、
全然知らなかったよ……

fields.EN:
But, why wouldn't the Professor
tell us that? I thought he trusted
us...
fields.JP:
どうして博士はそれを僕たちに
公表してくれなかったんだ？
僕たちは信用されてな――
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, why wouldn't the Professor
tell us that? I thought he trusted
us...

fields.EN:
About that, the Professor has
a classified file regarding
an experimental subject "S."
fields.JP:
博士の資料には、
被検体Ｓについてという項目がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
About that, the Professor has
a classified file regarding
an experimental subject "S."

fields.EN:
I read through it, and...
I'm not surprised the Professor
didn't disclose the information.
fields.JP:
その記述を見る限り、確かにこれは
公表できたものではないかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read through it, and...
I'm not surprised the Professor
didn't disclose the information.

fields.JP: 何よ、もったいつけた言い方すんなっての
そうだぜ、早く言えっての

fields.EN:
I wasn't planning on holding back
the information, but...
fields.JP:
そんなつもりはないんだが……
まあいい。そこにはこう書いてある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't planning on holding back
the information, but...

fields.EN:
It stated that the experiment he
had planned was dangerous, so he
didn't move forward with it.
fields.JP:
まず、危険なため実験には
踏み切れなかったらしい。
その上での被検体Ｓ、という記述だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It stated that the experiment he
had planned was dangerous, so he
didn't move forward with it.

fields.EN:
Yet, he had this classified, which
would mean that Blood Skelter was
something out of coincidence.
fields.JP:
つまりは偶然ブラッドスケルター状態が
発現してしまったのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet, he had this classified, which
would mean that Blood Skelter was
something out of coincidence.

fields.EN: And what does that mean? ...In the end, all we've been able to do is observe.
fields.JP:
それが意味するところは何か？
……結局観測しか出来てないってことさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, this is all
speculation, but...

fields.EN: What are you trying to say?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you trying to say?

fields.EN:
There's no known way of exiting
Blood Skelter. The file has that
written in bold letters.
fields.JP:
何も分かっていないということだ。
元に戻る方法は『現在のところナシ』と
はっきり記されている
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no known way of exiting
Blood Skelter. The file has that
written in bold letters.

fields.EN:
Wait...
So, if someone enters
Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
じゃあ１度『ブラッドスケルター化』
してしまったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
So, if someone enters
Blood Skelter...

fields.JP: もう戻らないってのか？

fields.EN:
You have to be kidding...
We hold that risk inside of us?
fields.JP:
なんだよそれ……
そんな性質を秘めているっていうのか、
僕たち血式少女っていうのは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to be kidding...
We hold that risk inside of us?

fields.EN:
Wait! Me too?!
That's quite a pain.
fields.JP:
もしかしてワレもなのか！？
それはちと……困る
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! Me too?!
That's quite a pain.

fields.EN:
Wait a second. Princess is back to
normal. She's already out of this
Blood Skelter thing, right?
fields.JP:
待ってくれ。姫は今、
落ち着きを取り戻している。
それでもブラッドスケルター中なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second. Princess is back to
normal. She's already out of this
Blood Skelter thing, right?

fields.EN:
I can't say for sure.
I suppose she is "out" of it,
but it could come back again.
fields.JP:
それは……どうだろう。
症状的には解除されたと言いたいけど、
でも潜伏してるだけかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't say for sure.
I suppose she is "out" of it,
but it could come back again.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but that's about all
I can say for now.
fields.JP: はっきりと言えなくてすまない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but that's about all
I can say for now.

fields.EN:
But, she is okay now, right?
That means she's all right.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、今は大丈夫なんだろ？
なら人魚姫はもう大丈夫だろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she is okay now, right?
That means she's all right.

fields.EN: Yup, I'm sure she's okay now.
fields.JP: うん、人魚姫は戻っているよ、絶対
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, I'm sure she's okay now.

fields.EN:
I would love to say that, too.
But, I want to be sure as one
wrong move could spell doom.
fields.JP:
もちろんそう思いたいけどな。
でもこればかりは、下手に判断すると
取り返しがつかなくなる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would love to say that, too.
But, I want to be sure as one
wrong move could spell doom.

fields.EN:
So, you're assuming it's
still inside her then...
fields.JP: 仮に潜伏していたら……ってことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're assuming it's
still inside her then...

fields.EN:
I would like to get her state
clarified for the sake of her
and everyone.
fields.JP:
姫を安心させるためにも、
はっきりとさせてあげたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would like to get her state
clarified for the sake of her
and everyone.

fields.JP: わたしなら、もう大丈夫です

fields.EN:
Princess?!
What are you doing here?!
fields.JP: 姫！　どうして起きてきたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess?!
What are you doing here?!

fields.EN: You should rest a bit longer.
fields.JP: そうだよ、今は安静にしていた方がいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You should rest a bit longer.

fields.EN:
She's right. I can tell you what
we conversed later, so please
rest a bit more.
fields.JP:
この話は後で必ず君にも伝える。
だから今は休んでおいた方がいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. I can tell you what
we conversed later, so please
rest a bit more.

fields.EN:
No, I want to explain what
happened to me...
fields.JP:
いいえ、今お話ししたいのです。
わたしに起こったこと、ぜんぶ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I want to explain what
happened to me...

fields.EN:
I suppose arguing isn't an option.
Fine... But, I need you to rest if
you don't feel well, understood?
fields.JP:
仕方ない。では具合が悪くなったら
すぐに横になるんだ。　いいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose arguing isn't an option.
Fine... But, I need you to rest if
you don't feel well, understood?

fields.EN:
It's... hard to explain.
This "Blood Skelter" I overheard
brought darkness to my soul.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化、
というものになった時、わたしは
言い知れぬ心の闇に飲まれました
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's... hard to explain.
This "Blood Skelter" I overheard
brought darkness to my soul.

fields.EN:
I felt my body flaring up,
and my vision started to blur.
I couldn't tell what was going on.
fields.JP:
頭の芯がのぼせたように熱くて、
目の前のことがぼんやりとしか
認識できない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt my body flaring up,
and my vision started to blur.
I couldn't tell what was going on.

fields.EN:
What I could tell was that
I felt the urge to... destroy.
fields.JP:
残った感情は、
目の前のものを破壊し尽くしたい。
ただ、それだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I could tell was that
I felt the urge to... destroy.

fields.EN:
But when Jack-san's blood splattered
on me, I felt the darkness
disappearing from within me...
fields.JP:
ですが、偶然にも
ジャックさんの血を浴びた瞬間、
そんな心の闇がすっと消えていったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when Jack's blood splattered
on me, I felt the darkness
disappearing from within me...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
My sense of destruction was
quelled, and I was able to
remember who my friends were again.
fields.JP:
破壊衝動は収まり、ちゃんと大事なひとを
大事だと思えるように戻ったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sense of destruction was
quelled, and I was able to
remember who my friends were again.

fields.EN:
That's why I was able to somehow
avoid harming Otsuu-chan and Haa-chan...
fields.JP:
だからおつうちゃんも
ハーちゃんも、傷つけずに済んだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was able to somehow
avoid harming Otsuu and Hammy...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
So, Jack's blood was the catalyst
in bringing you back to normal?
fields.JP: ジャックの血が、人魚姫を正常に戻した？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Jack's blood was the catalyst
in bringing you back to normal?

fields.EN:
It looks like you saved me again.
Thank you, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、また助けてくれたのね。
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like you saved me again.
Thank you, Jack...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
So, we're talking about the blood
from Nightmares?
fields.JP: つまりはナイトメアの血ってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we're talking about the blood
from Nightmares?

fields.EN:
Well, let's extract blood from
Jack. You think he'd mind if
I did that, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
よし、ジャックの血を採取してみよう。
おつう、採血しても大丈夫だな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's extract blood from
Jack. You think he'd mind if
I did that, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Well...
It seems he's okay with that.
fields.JP: ああ、うん……大丈夫、みたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...
It seems he's okay with that.

fields.EN:
Very well.
Jack, just bear with me...
fields.JP: じゃあジャック、ちょっと血をもらうぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well.
Jack, just bear with me...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack said you can take more
blood from him.
fields.JP:
ジャックが、
もっと血を採ってもいいってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack said you can take more
blood from him.

fields.EN:
No, this should suffice.
Thank you, Jack.
fields.JP:
いや、これだけで大丈夫だ。
ありがとうジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, this should suffice.
Thank you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Now then... Otsuu? Hameln?
Show me your palms.
fields.JP:
じゃあおつう、ハーメルン。
２人ともちょっと手を出してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then... Otsuu? Hameln?
Show me your palms.

fields.EN:
There...
Do you feel anything different
with his blood on your hands?
fields.JP:
どうだ？　手にかけられて、
何か変化はあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There...
Do you feel anything different
with his blood on your hands?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I think I feel a bit
lighter?
fields.JP:
うーむ……何か軽くなったような気が
するようなしないような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I think I feel a bit
lighter?

fields.EN:
I guess I feel a bit better
inside, like a bit of stress
is going away.
fields.JP:
なんとなく心の淀んだ感じが
なくなった気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I feel a bit better
inside, like a bit of stress
is going away.

fields.EN:
I suppose neither of you are in
Blood Skelter, so there's no way
to confirm its effects yet.
fields.JP:
まあブラッドスケルター化してないから、
はっきりとは分からない……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose neither of you are in
Blood Skelter, so there's no way
to confirm its effects yet.

fields.EN:
But I can tell it did
something to me.
fields.JP: でもやっぱり効果はある気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I can tell it did
something to me.

fields.EN:
(And, even if it had some effect,
I'd rather not have this used
as some form of means...)
fields.JP:
（でも効果があるとしても、
　あまりしたくないかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, even if it had some effect,
I'd rather not have this used
as some form of means...)

fields.EN:
(After all, I could tell how Jack
felt while his blood was being
extracted from him...)
fields.JP:
（血を抜かれたジャックの心が、
　揺さぶられているのを
　感じてしまうとね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After all, I could tell how Jack
felt while his blood was being
extracted from him...)

fields.EN:
We don't have the proper
equipment, so I can't evaluate
his blood sample.
fields.JP:
今は機材がないから、ジャックの
血液成分を分析することができない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have the proper
equipment, so I can't evaluate
his blood sample.

fields.EN:
But, my theory is that it does
have some effect on Corruption
based on your feedback.
fields.JP:
だが人魚姫やおつうの話を総合すると、
穢れに対して一定の消失効果に期待が持てる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, my theory is that it does
have some effect on Corruption
based on your feedback.

fields.EN:
I'll make sure we don't rely too
much on Jack's blood, so I'd love
to test his blood out further.
fields.JP:
だから深追いしない程度に、
これから試していってもらえないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll make sure we don't rely too
much on Jack's blood, so I'd love
to test his blood out further.

fields.EN:
Right... But we need to make sure we don't
borrow too much of Jack-san's blood...
fields.JP:
そうですね……でもジャックさんの血を
借りすぎないようにしないとですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, as long as we don't draw
too much blood from him...

fields.EN:
Yes, I'd rather not inconvenience
Jack as much as possible.
fields.JP:
うん、なるべくならジャックに
迷惑はかけたくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'd rather not inconvenience
Jack as much as possible.

fields.EN:
Drawing blood out is one thing,
but doing so does take a toll on
his mental state.
fields.JP:
血を抜くって行為はもちろんだけど、
何より精神的負担をかけてしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Drawing blood out is one thing,
but doing so does take a toll on
his mental state.

fields.EN:
Yes, and I don't think we want
to abuse Jack-san's kindness...
fields.JP:
優しいジャックさんに
そんな負担はかけたくないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I don't think we want
to abuse Jack's kindness...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I guess the best thing is
for us to avoid entering our
Blood Skelter state.
fields.JP:
だから『ブラッドスケルター化』には
細心の注意を払うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess the best thing is
for us to avoid entering our
Blood Skelter state.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That's an impressive
way to sleep...
fields.JP: 相変わらずジャックは器用に寝るなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an impressive
way to sleep...

fields.EN:
I better get some rest, too.
Lack of sleep is
no laughing matter.
fields.JP:
僕もそろそろ寝ないとな。
寝不足なんて笑えないしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better get some rest, too.
Lack of sleep is
no laughing matter.

fields.EN:
I suppose it'd be best to
leave Princess behind on the
next expedition.
fields.JP:
やはり次の探索には
姫は連れて行かない方がいいよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it'd be best to
leave Princess behind on the
next expedition.

fields.EN:
If she goes berserk like the last
time, she'll start blaming
herself again.
fields.JP:
またブラッドスケルター化したら、
たぶん姫は更に自分を責めるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she goes berserk like the last
time, she'll start blaming
herself again.

fields.EN:
Even if she doesn't go wild,
just being out there can bring
back bad memories.
fields.JP:
たとえブラッドスケルター化しなくても、
探索に行けば色々嫌なことを
思い出させてしまいそうだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if she doesn't go wild,
just being out there can bring
back bad memories.

fields.JP: おつうちゃん……起きてるよね？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 姫？　うん、起きてるよ

fields.EN:
Is there a problem?
If you're having trouble sleeping,
I can...
fields.JP:
どうしましたか、姫。
眠れないのでしたら僕がそばに――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a problem?
If you're having trouble sleeping,
I can...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan...
I'm going out on the next
expedition no matter what.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……わたし、
次の探索行くからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu...
I'm going out on the next
expedition no matter what.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Are you sure? You're not in the
best shape possible yet.
You don't need to overdo yourself.
fields.JP:
……大丈夫なのかい？　まだ体調
戻ってないなら、無理しなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? You're not in the
best shape possible yet.
You don't need to overdo yourself.

fields.EN:
...I understand that you don't want me to go,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
……おつうちゃんがわたしを
行かせたくないのは分かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand that you'd rather
have me stay behind...

fields.EN:
I won't deny that...
I don't want you to come with us.
fields.JP:
……うん。
僕は姫を次の探索には行かせたくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't deny that...
I don't want you to come with us.

fields.EN:
I don't want to see you get hurt.
So, can you please stay behind,
for me?
fields.JP:
もう姫が傷つくのは見たくないんだ。
だからどうか、残ってくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to see you get hurt.
So, can you please stay behind,
for me?

fields.EN:
I'm really happy you feel that way,
Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんのその気持ち、
とっても嬉しいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really appreciate your thoughts.
I really do...

fields.EN: But Otsuu-chan, when you and I first met...
fields.JP:
でもね、わたしとおつうちゃんが
初めて出会ったあの時……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, do you remember what you
said when we first met?

fields.EN:
You were the one who said you wanted us to
become husband and wife, right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
夫婦になりたいって言ってくれたのは、
おつうちゃんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said that you wanted us
to become a family, right?
A husband and wife...

fields.EN:
Well, yes, but what does
that have to...
fields.JP:
それはそうだけど、
どうして今その話を……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yes, but what does
that have to...

fields.EN:
People become husbands and
wives so that they become as one.
fields.JP:
夫婦というものは、いつ如何なる時でも
一緒にいなければいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
People become husbands and
wives so that they become as one.

fields.EN:
That also means that, no matter
what happens, they need to stay
together.
fields.JP:
だからたとえどんな困難にぶつかろうとも、
一緒に乗り越えなければいけないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means that, no matter
what happens, they need to stay
together.

fields.EN:
That's what it means to be
bound together as a family.
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what it means to be
bound together as a family.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃんの
プロポーズは本気だったって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You proposed to me back then,
to become husband and wife.

fields.EN:
You are serious about it, right?
Or, am I just being delusional?
fields.JP:
そう思ってるのは
わたしだけじゃ……ないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are serious about it, right?
Or, am I just being delusional?

fields.EN:
Well then, I'm going with you.
We need to overcome the perils
together, right?
fields.JP:
じゃあわたしも探索に行く。
一緒に、この困難を乗り越えよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I'm going with you.
We need to overcome the perils
together, right?

fields.EN:
You're going to make me stay.
You're someone special to me,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
もう決めたの。おつうちゃんは
わたしにとって大事なひと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to make me stay.
You're someone special to me,
Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.
fields.JP: だからわたしは、一緒に行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the more reason why I need
to go with you.

fields.EN:
(Once she has her mind set,
nothing will make her budge...)
fields.JP:
（姫はこうなったら
　決して譲らないんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once she has her mind set,
nothing will make her budge...)

fields.EN:
Fine... I'll prove to you that my
proposal was serious. We'll
go on the expedition together.
fields.JP:
……分かったよ。
夫婦の誓いが本物だと証明する。
姫、一緒に探索に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'll prove to you that my
proposal was serious. We'll
go on the expedition together.

fields.JP:
本当にっ？
ありがとう、おつうちゃんっ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Whoa! Princess! Calm down!
You're going to wake Jack up.
fields.JP:
わわっ、姫っ！？　そんなにはしゃいだら
ジャックが起きちゃうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Princess! Calm down!
You're going to wake Jack up.

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I was just so happy, so...
fields.JP: ごめんなさい、嬉しくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I was just so happy, so...

fields.EN:
You're right. It'd be wrong to wake Jack-san while
he's sleeping.
fields.JP: 寝ているジャックさんを起こしちゃ悪いよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. I don't want to
wake him up either.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Then, Otsuu-chan, see you tomorrow.
Good night.
fields.JP:
じゃあおつうちゃん、
また明日ね。おやすみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, good night.
See you in the morning.

fields.EN:
I haven't seen her smile like
that in a while...
I guess this ended well for now.
fields.JP:
姫に少し笑顔が戻ったな……
なら、これでよかったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't seen her smile like
that in a while...
I guess this ended well for now.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, Dawn told
me that I proposed to her
because of my Blood Libido, but...
fields.JP:
でも夫婦になろうって話、
後で黎明では『血式リビドー』の
せいだって言われたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, Dawn told
me that I proposed to her
because of my Blood Libido, but...

fields.EN:
There's no way I proposed to
her just because of my primal
urge within me...
fields.JP:
そんな血式少女の個々の衝動が
僕に夫婦になろうって言わせただなんて、
あるわけないじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way I proposed to
her just because of my primal
urge within me...

fields.EN:
I proposed to her because it
was Princess, and she also
knows that.
fields.JP:
だって僕は相手が姫だったから
言ったんだし、姫だって
そう思ってくれてる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I proposed to her because it
was Princess, and she also
knows that.

fields.EN:
That's right... It's not because
of my Blood Libido...
fields.JP:
そう、これは決して
『血式リビドー』なんてものじゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right... It's not because
of my Blood Libido...

fields.EN:
Then again, maybe it does have
to do with how I can't seem to
fight back against her...
fields.JP:
だからこそ、あんな風に
姫に言われると弱いよなぁ……僕
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, maybe it does have
to do with how I can't seem to
fight back against her...

fields.EN:
In any case...
I did propose to her, but...
fields.JP:
そうだよな……
僕と姫は夫婦を誓い合ったんだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case...
I did propose to her, but...

fields.EN:
Thinking back, I can't believe
I asked her for her hand in
marriage like that...
fields.JP:
にしても、今思うと何でいきなり僕は
あんな大胆なことを言えたんだろう～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking back, I can't believe
I asked her for her hand in
marriage like that...

fields.EN:
Thinking about it is so
embarrassing...!
fields.JP:
思い出すほどなんて言うか、
恥ずかしい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking about it is so
embarrassing...!

fields.JP: よし、みんな準備はいいな？
ふはは、ワレは待ちくたびれたぞ！
大丈夫……準備はできてるよ

fields.EN:
(She seemed so happy last night,
but I guess the pressure is still
hard on her.)
fields.JP:
（昨日の夜は喜んでいたけど、いざ出発
　となるとやっぱり不安なんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She seemed so happy last night,
but I guess the pressure is still
hard on her.)

fields.JP:
（まあいいさ。一緒に乗り越える、
　そう決めたんだから）

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Itsuki?
Did we forget something?
fields.JP:
どうしたイツキ、慌てて追いかけてきて。
僕たち忘れ物はないぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Itsuki?
Did we forget something?

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff... I just... wanted
to show everyone some things we
found from the Professor's files.
fields.JP:
ぜぇっ……ぜぇっ……
いや、博士の新しい資料を見つけたから、
出る前に見せておきたいと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff... I just... wanted
to show everyone some things we
found from the Professor's files.

fields.EN:
Yeah, it had something about
a "core" found in each prison
area.
fields.JP:
ああ。資料によると、各ダンジョンの
独房エリアにはどうやら『核』と
呼ばれるものがあるらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it had something about
a "core" found in each prison
area.

fields.EN:
It says that you can make the
Nightmare there vulnerable
by destroying this "core" thing.
fields.JP:
で、その核を破壊すると、
なんとナイトメアの不死性を消せると……
そう記載されているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It says that you can make the
Nightmare there vulnerable
by destroying this "core" thing.

fields.EN:
What luck! I'm glad you brought
this up to us before we left.
fields.JP:
それってかなりすごい発見じゃないか！
出発前に聞いておけてよかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What luck! I'm glad you brought
this up to us before we left.

fields.EN:
Yeah, that's why I came after you
guys. Figured this could mean
life or death, y'know?
fields.JP:
ああ。これを知ると知らないとじゃ
生死を分けるからな……だから追ってきた。
間に合ってよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, that's why I came after you
guys. Figured this could mean
life or death, y'know?

fields.EN:
Hm... So that means I can
now eke judgment out of that
insolent fool before.
fields.JP:
ほう……あの無礼者に
ワレの鉄槌をついに喰らわせてやれるのだな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... So that means I can
now eke judgment out of that
insolent fool before.

fields.EN:
Well done, Itsuki!
I praise thee!
fields.JP:
イツキよ！
褒めてつかわそうっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well done, Itsuki!
I praise thee!

fields.EN:
There is hope after all,
especially now that we know we can
actually defeat those monsters!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアを倒す手段がある……
一気に希望が湧いてきたな、みんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is hope after all,
especially now that we know we can
actually defeat those monsters!

fields.JP:
ふははっ！
やってやろうぞ、おつう！

fields.EN:
Don't worry!
We're going to do this, together!
fields.JP:
ううん、大丈夫！
一緒に乗り越えようね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry!
We're going to do this, together!

fields.EN:
Oh? Seems like she's ready, too!
No need to stall any longer!
fields.JP:
おっ、人魚姫もやる気ではないか！
では乗り込むぞ貴様ら！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Seems like she's ready, too!
No need to stall any longer!

fields.EN:
(Is Princess really going to be
okay? But, she was serious about
what she said last night...)
fields.JP:
（大丈夫かなぁ……姫。
　でも昨日の夜のあれは、
　本気だったしな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is Princess really going to be
okay? But, she was serious about
what she said last night...)

fields.JP: よし、今度こそ出発だみんな！

fields.EN:
You should speak louder
if you want people to hear you.
fields.JP:
言いたいことがあるなら、
ちゃんと言った方がいいのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should speak louder
if you want people to hear you.

fields.EN:
Speak louder...?
Well, there isn't anything I want
to say right now.
fields.JP:
言いたいこと……？
ううん、特にないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speak louder...?
Well, there isn't anything I want
to say right now.

fields.EN:
That's odd. You sure look like
you have something on your mind.
What is it?
fields.JP:
それにしては随分と
元気がなさ過ぎるのだ。
ちゃんと言った方がいいのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's odd. You sure look like
you have something on your mind.
What is it?

fields.EN:
Well, nothing...
Nothing that needs to be said...
fields.JP:
ううん、本当に
言いたいことないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, nothing...
Nothing that needs to be said...

fields.EN:
Come now! All you need to do
is to raise your voice and
yell what's inside you!
fields.JP:
駄目だー！
とにかく、大きな声を出して
叫んでみれば分かるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now! All you need to do
is to raise your voice and
yell what's inside you!

fields.EN:
That's right! It feels great to
let all that's inside you go!
You can say whatever you please!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　大声で叫ぶとな、
とってもスッキリとするのだ！
言葉は何だっていいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! It feels great to
let all that's inside you go!
You can say whatever you please!

fields.EN:
If it's embarrassing,
then I extend my offer
to yell with you!
fields.JP:
そして１人が恥ずかしいと言うなら、
ワレが特別に一緒にやってやるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's embarrassing,
then I extend my offer
to yell with you!

fields.EN:
Say anything!
Yelling, by itself, will make you
feel better!
fields.JP:
とにかく何でもいいのだ！
叫べばそれでスッキリだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say anything!
Yelling, by itself, will make you
feel better!

fields.EN:
Okay, let me try...
Um, can you yell with me then?
fields.JP:
……分かった、やってみる。
一緒にお願いしてもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let me try...
Um, can you yell with me then?

fields.EN:
Of course!
Now, copy what I say,
but in your own words!
fields.JP:
もちろんだ！
ではワレをマネて叫ぶのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course!
Now, copy what I say,
but in your own words!

fields.JP: ワレこそは勇者ハーメルンであるぞー！
わ、われこそは勇者人魚姫であるぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I am the hero,
Little Mermaid!

fields.EN:
What?! I'm the hero!
That's not your title!
fields.JP:
なっ！？　勇者はワレなのだ！
人魚姫は使っては駄目なのだー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I'm the hero!
That's not your title!

fields.EN:
I am the great hero,
Hameln!
fields.JP: ワレこそは大勇者ハーメルンであるぞー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the great hero,
Hameln!

fields.EN:
I am the great hero,
Ningyohime!
fields.JP: われこそは大勇者人魚姫であるぞー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the great hero,
Little Mermaid!

fields.EN:
You're the one who said to
copy you...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンが真似ろって
言ったんだろうに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one who said to
copy you...

fields.EN:
And... do you mind if I ask what
you're both doing?
fields.JP: というか、２人とも何をしてるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... do you mind if I ask what
you're both doing?

fields.JP: な！　スッキリするであろう！？

fields.EN:
You're right...
Why was I all down on myself
earlier?
fields.JP:
……そうだよね！
わたし何を１人で悩んでいたんだろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
Why was I all down on myself
earlier?

fields.EN:
Well, all is good so long as what
you do brings a smile to your
face, Princess.
fields.JP: でも姫が笑顔になったのなら……よかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all is good so long as what
you do brings a smile to your
face, Princess.

fields.EN:
Oh?!
Otsuu, perhaps that there is...
fields.JP:
おおっ！？
おつう、もしかしてあれではないのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh?!
Otsuu, perhaps that there is...

fields.EN:
Yes...
That has to be the core!
fields.JP:
……これだ。
これが核に違いない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
That has to be the core!

fields.JP: ついに見つけたんだね！

fields.EN:
All we have to do now is destroy
it so that we can make the
Nightmare vulnerable!
fields.JP:
あとはこの核を破壊すれば、
僕たちはナイトメアに勝てるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we have to do now is destroy
it so that we can make the
Nightmare vulnerable!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack? What's the matter?
Is there something bothering you?
fields.JP:
ジャック……？　どうしたんだ？
何か気になることでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack? What's the matter?
Is there something bothering you?

fields.EN:
Don't you dare lay a finger on
Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP: おつうちゃんに手を出すなーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you dare lay a finger on
Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: すごい馬鹿でかい声だな……！

fields.EN:
Hahaha! And, I suppose it is
because of me!
Well done, Ningyohime!
fields.JP:
ふはは、ワレの教えのタマモノだな！
いいぞ人魚姫っ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! And, I suppose it is
because of me!
Well done, Little Mermaid!

fields.EN:
I'm not going to lose any more
of those precious to me...!
fields.JP:
もう、わたしは目の前の大事なひとを
決して失ったりしない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to lose any more
of those precious to me...!

fields.EN: So, Otsuu-chan, let's all fight together!!
fields.JP: だからおつうちゃんたち、一緒に戦おう！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Everyone, let's get rid of it!

fields.EN:
Well said, Ningyohime!
I shall fight alongside you!
fields.JP:
よく言ったぞ人魚姫！
ワレとともに戦おうではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, Little Mermaid!
I shall fight alongside you!

fields.EN:
I suppose there's no way to hold
my dear princess back once she's
like this...
fields.JP:
まったく、姫はこういう時
頑固だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there's no way to hold
my dear princess back once she's
like this...

fields.EN:
And...
I wouldn't want it any other way!
fields.LOCALIZED:
And...
I wouldn't want it any other way!

fields.JP: 姫、動きのキレが違ってたよ

fields.EN:
Indeed!
I knew I could count on you!
fields.JP: うむ。一緒に戦っていて頼もしかったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
I knew I could count on you!

fields.EN:
Really? Th-Thank you...
This is so embarrassing...
fields.JP:
そう？　あ、ありがとう……
でも、ちょっと恥ずかしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Th-Thank you...
This is so embarrassing...

fields.EN:
Now then, let's get rid of this
core before the Nightmare
shows up.
fields.JP:
よし、ナイトメアが来る前に
核を破壊しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's get rid of this
core before the Nightmare
shows up.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
Is it because...
we destroyed the core?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it because...
we destroyed the core?

fields.EN:
I suppose so...
It sounded like the Jail
was wailing...
fields.JP:
たぶんそうだろう……
これはきっとジェイルの悲鳴だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose so...
It sounded like the Jail
was wailing...

fields.EN:
Okay...
We should be able to defeat
the Nightmare now.
fields.JP:
よし……これでナイトメアを
倒せるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay...
We should be able to defeat
the Nightmare now.

fields.JP: ふはは、次に会った時が楽しみだぞ……！

fields.EN: Let us go, and find that...
fields.JP: よし、じゃあ早速倒しにだな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Let us go, and find that...

fields.EN:
Haa-chan!
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん、
今回は本当にありがとう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy!
Thank you so very much!

fields.JP:
な、なんだいきなり。
ワレは何もしておらぬぞ……？

fields.EN:
That's not true!
You helped me, a lot!
fields.JP:
ううん、そんなことないよ！
ハーちゃんにわたし、すっごく助けられたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
You helped me, a lot!

fields.JP: ワレはいつのまに助けてたのだ！？

fields.EN:
I was nervous about the Nightmare,
Blood Skelter, and things...
fields.JP:
ナイトメア、それにブラッドスケルター……
色んなことでわたし、ずっと不安だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was nervous about the Nightmare,
Blood Skelter, and things...

fields.EN:
Do you remember when you told
me to yell along with you?
fields.JP:
でもハーちゃんが一緒に大声で叫ぼう、
って言ってくれた時にね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember when you told
me to yell along with you?

fields.EN:
It was then it dawned on me that
I don't need to carry all my
worries alone.
fields.JP:
わたし、どうして
一人で悩んでいたんだろうって思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was then it dawned on me that
I don't need to carry all my
worries alone.

fields.EN:
That's why I yelled back then
with all my heart that I was
going to protect Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
だからね、ハーちゃんに習って
大きな声で『おつうちゃんを守りたい！』
って想いを口にしたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I yelled back then
with all my heart that I was
going to protect Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
And you know what?
All that worry and anxiety I had
just went away like nothing.
fields.JP:
そうしたらね？　今までの不安が嘘みたいに
すーっと心が軽くなったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you know what?
All that worry and anxiety I had
just went away like nothing.

fields.EN:
I see...
So, you overcame your inner
worries and fears...
fields.JP: そっか……不安に打ち勝ったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
So, you overcame your inner
worries and fears...

fields.EN:
I sure did! I made sure I yelled
loud, and guess what? I was able
to move freely like never before.
fields.JP:
色んな不安に勝てたよ。声に出せたよ。
すくんでた身体、動いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure did! I made sure I yelled
loud, and guess what? I was able
to move freely like never before.

fields.EN:
Yes, and I can vouch that you were
amazingly strong and beautiful
like never before.
fields.JP:
うん。姫はこれまでで最高に強く、
頼もしく、そして格好良かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I can vouch that you were
amazingly strong and beautiful
like never before.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: See? Even Jack agrees with me.
fields.JP: ほら、ジャックも「その通りだ」って
fields.LOCALIZED: See? Even Jack agrees with me.

fields.EN:
And it's all thanks to Haa-chan.
Thank you for teaching me how to
overcome my anxieties.
fields.JP:
本当にハーちゃんのおかげだね。
不安は必ず出るもので、解消するもの……
それに気づかせてくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
And it's all thanks to Hammy.
Thank you for teaching me how to
overcome my anxieties.

fields.EN:
Uh... Wh-Why, of course!
I knew my words would help you!
fields.JP:
そ、そうであろう、そうであろう！
いやはや、ワレの助言はバッチリだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Wh-Why, of course!
I knew my words would help you!

fields.EN:
You don't know what she's saying
right, Hameln?
fields.JP: ハーメルン、絶対分かってないだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know what she's saying
right, Hameln?

fields.EN:
Of course I do!
I know exactly whyat she's saying!
fields.JP:
わ、分かっておるわ！
そにょくらいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I do!
I know exactly whyat shez shaying!

fields.EN:
(There she goes again...
Yeah, she's completely clueless.)
fields.JP:
（あ、噛んでる。
　やっぱ分かってないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes again...
Yeah, she's completely clueless.)

fields.EN:
What was all that worrying about?
If only I knew sooner.
fields.JP:
あーあ。こんな簡単なことだったなんて。
もっと早く気づいてればよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was all that worrying about?
If only I knew sooner.

fields.EN:
No, I think you found out at the
best of times.
fields.JP: いや、最高のタイミングだったさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I think you found out at the
best of times.

fields.EN:
Oh, but I need to apologize
to you, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
で、でもね、わたしおつうちゃんに
謝らなくちゃいけないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I need to apologize
to you, Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I don't believe there's anything
for you to apologize about.
fields.JP: 謝ることなんて何もないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe there's anything
for you to apologize about.

fields.EN:
Well... You know when I said
we were going to go through
this together?
fields.JP:
ううん……この前わたし、
夫婦は困難を一緒に乗り越えるって、
そう言ったでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... You know when I said
we were going to go through
this together?

fields.EN:
And yet, Otsuu-chan, I couldn't properly
tell you how worried I was...
fields.JP:
なのにわたし、おつうちゃんに
ちゃんと不安を打ち明けられなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, I didn't tell you how
worried I was inside...

fields.EN:
That was really unfair and wrong.
I'm so sorry...
fields.JP:
それはとてもずるいことなの。
本当に、ごめんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was really unfair and wrong.
I'm so sorry...

fields.EN:
Don't worry. You just kept your
thoughts to yourself so that
I wouldn't be worried.
fields.JP:
いいよ。不安を打ち明けたら
きっと僕も不安に駆られるって、
そう思ったんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. You just kept your
thoughts to yourself so that
I wouldn't be worried.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, let me apologize
to you for having you worried
about me.
fields.JP:
こっちこそ、そんな風に
気を遣わせてしまってごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, let me apologize
to you for having you worried
about me.

fields.EN: You didn't do anything wrong, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP: おつうちゃんは何も悪くないよ！

fields.EN:
Okay, then I think we're even.
From here forward, we can go
through this all together.
fields.JP:
じゃあ……これからは互いに今まで以上に
助け合っていくってことにしようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then I think we're even.
From here forward, we can go
through this all together.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……！
うん、約束する！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
むっ……！
辺りが急に霧がかってきたぞ……！

fields.EN:
That means the Nightmare
is nearby...
fields.JP:
ということは
ついにナイトメアに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means the Nightmare
is nearby...

fields.JP: 感動の再会ってやつだな

fields.EN:
W-We are going to fight it,
right?
fields.JP: も、もちろん戦うんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We are going to fight it,
right?

fields.EN:
Yes... We destroyed the core,
so all that's left is to see if we
can really defeat it now.
fields.JP:
ああ。核を破壊したんだ、
ナイトメアに勝てるかどうか
試してみようじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We destroyed the core,
so all that's left is to see if we
can really defeat it now.

fields.EN:
I've been waiting for this...
I despise running or losing.
fields.JP:
待ちわびたぞ、この時を……
ワレは逃げるのも負けるのも大嫌いなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been waiting for this...
I despise running or losing.

fields.EN:
How ironic... I'm with you, too.
I'm also the kind of person who
wants to repay what is due.
fields.JP:
奇遇だな。僕もだ。
受けた借りは必ず返す主義なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How ironic... I'm with you, too.
I'm also the kind of person who
wants to repay what is due.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That's right, Jack...
We're not going to lose. We both
have someone we hold precious.
fields.JP:
そうだね、ジャック。
僕らは負けない。負けられない。
お互い、大切な人がいるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Jack...
We're not going to lose. We both
have someone we hold precious.

fields.EN:
I guess we're here, so we may
as well try and beat it...
fields.JP:
そう、だね……ここまで来たら、
やっつけてやりたいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we're here, so we may
as well try and beat it...

fields.EN:
I want to prove that normal
people can beat it, too!
fields.JP:
人間にもできるんだって、
証明したいよ、わたし……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to prove that normal
people can beat it, too!

fields.EN:
Well said. We're going to prove
that the Professor's research
was correct.
fields.JP:
ああ。博士の遺した研究の成果を、
僕たちが実現するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said. We're going to prove
that the Professor's research
was correct.

fields.JP: 潰した部位が、復活しない……！

fields.EN: We can crush it to smithereens!
fields.JP:
ぶっ潰すことができる、
というわけだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: We can crush it to smithereens!

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、ハーちゃん！
やっつけよう！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: もちろんだぞ、人魚姫っ！

fields.EN:
Yeah, let's finish it
once and for all!
fields.JP: ああ！　一気に攻めきろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, let's finish it
once and for all!

fields.EN:
Yes, we did...
We really did it, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
うん……倒したよ……
おつうちゃん……倒したんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we did...
We really did it, Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
We really, really beat that
Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ついに、ついにナイトメアを
倒せたんだね、わたしたち！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We really, really beat that
Nightmare!

fields.EN:
Indeed!
This is quite the victory for us!
fields.JP: うむっ！　完璧に倒したなっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
This is quite the victory for us!

fields.EN: Even that immortal Nightmare isn't immortal anymore...!
fields.JP:
不死身のナイトメアも、
これでもう不死身じゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This proves that the Nightmares
aren't invulnerable!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……よがっ……
み゛ん……ぶぶぶ、じ……

fields.EN:
Well said, Jack.
We're alive and we couldn't
have asked for any better.
fields.JP:
……ああ。そうだね、ジャック。
僕らは生きてる。それが一番の結果だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, Jack.
We're alive and we couldn't
have asked for any better.

fields.EN:
We need to let everyone know
about this as soon as possible!
fields.JP:
解放地区のみんなにも
はやく教えてあげたいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to let everyone know
about this as soon as possible!

fields.JP: うんっ！　早く伝えに行こう！

fields.EN:
We shall return triumphant!
This will mark the beginning of
Hameln, the legendary hero!
fields.JP:
ふふん、そうだな、伝えねばなるまいな！
勇者ハーメルン伝説の始まりを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We shall return triumphant!
This will mark the beginning of
Hameln, the legendary hero!

fields.EN:
I'm sure all will be pleased!
After all, they will be witness to
the beginning of a legend!
fields.JP:
皆きっと喜ぶであろうな！
伝説の幕開けに立ち会えることに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure all will be pleased!
After all, they will be witness to
the beginning of a legend!

fields.EN:
I'm sure everyone will be
surprised with how cool you were.
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん格好良かったもんね。
みんなも驚くと思うよっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure everyone will be
surprised with how cool you were.

fields.EN:
Um, let me remind you that
we're not returning to glorify
you, Hameln...
fields.JP:
いや、伝えるのは
ハーメルン伝説じゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, let me remind you that
we're not returning to glorify
you, Hameln...

fields.EN:
We're returning to report back
that we put down the Nightmare.
fields.JP: ナイトメア討伐についてだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're returning to report back
that we put down the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Hahaha!
Of course, do not worry, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
ふはははっ！
細かいことは気にするな、おつう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha!
Of course, do not worry, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
(Speaking of, we couldn't
communicate with the Nightmare,
but I could read its emotions...)
fields.JP:
（そういえばここのナイトメア、
　会話はできなかったけど
　なんとなく感情は読み取れたな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Speaking of, we couldn't
communicate with the Nightmare,
but I could read its emotions...)

fields.EN:
(In fact, when the Nightmare fell,
I was able to feel its negative
emotions flow through me...)
fields.JP:
（うん……間違いない。
　ナイトメアが倒れる時、
　一気に負の感情が流れてきたからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In fact, when the Nightmare fell,
I was able to feel its negative
emotions flow through me...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I'm able to
understand their feelings...)
fields.JP:
（いったい僕のこの能力は
　なんなんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I'm able to
understand their feelings...)

fields.EN:
Oh, by the way, I don't think
I saw any Blood Maidens in this
area at all.
fields.JP:
あっ……そういえば
この水族館跡エリアには血式少女、
いなかったね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, by the way, I don't think
I saw any Blood Maidens in this
area at all.

fields.EN:
The place is close to the former
Liberated District, so maybe they
went into hiding deeper inside.
fields.JP:
元解放地区に近すぎるから、
危険と判断してもっと奥に逃げたのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The place is close to the former
Liberated District, so maybe they
went into hiding deeper inside.

fields.EN:
Fear not, Ningyohime!
With my strength, I'm sure we will
converge with them soon!
fields.JP:
なに、心配するでない人魚姫！
ワレらは強い！　すぐに合流できるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fear not, Little Mermaid!
With my strength, I'm sure we will
converge with them soon!

fields.EN:
I guess you're right...
We will find them, right?
fields.JP:
そうだよね……
きっとすぐに再会できるよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you're right...
We will find them, right?

fields.EN:
We sure will. We also have hope
now that we know that we can
defeat Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ああ、絶対に見つけられるさ。
僕たちはナイトメアを倒せるって
希望を手に入れたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We sure will. We also have hope
now that we know that we can
defeat Nightmares.

fields.EN:
That just means greater hope
awaits us in the future.
fields.JP:
だから、もっと大きな希望に
手が届くに決まってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That just means greater hope
awaits us in the future.

fields.EN:
Just bear with it a bit longer,
my comrades. We'll find you all
soon enough!
fields.JP:
待っててくれ、血式少女隊のみんな。
絶対に探し出してみせるから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just bear with it a bit longer,
my comrades. We'll find you all
soon enough!

fields.EN:
(It's been a long while since
I visited the Tocho Metropolitan
Building...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、都庁なんて懐かしいなぁ……
　もうどれくらいぶりだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been a long while since
I visited the Tocho Metropolitan
Building...)

fields.EN:
(I remember taking naps here.
The breeze felt really good.)
fields.JP:
（この場所でよくお昼寝したっけ。
　たまに吹く風が気持ちいいんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember taking naps here.
The breeze felt really good.)

fields.EN:
(I also liked how you had great
views from here.)
fields.JP: （で、あっちは眺めがよくて好きだったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I also liked how you had great
views from here.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if the scenery has
changed? I should go and take
a look.)
fields.JP:
（まだちゃんと残ってるかな。
　ちょっと見に行ってみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if the scenery has
changed? I should go and take
a look.)

fields.JP:
のごっでで……い……ぎぎ……
……ほじ……いな……

fields.EN:
(Looks like nothing changed.
Good to know...)
fields.JP:
（ちゃんとお気に入りの場所も残ってた。
　変わってなくて……よかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like nothing changed.
Good to know...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I should scope the
area out a bit...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう、
　もう少し見て回ろうかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I should scope the
area out a bit...)

fields.JP: この場所はいったい何……？

fields.EN:
(After finally getting here,
I have to take flight again!)
fields.JP:
（せっかく都庁に着いたのに、
　どうしてまだ逃げないといけないの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After finally getting here,
I have to take flight again!)

fields.EN:
(Then again, if I stay here any
longer they'll find me.
I need to get away...)
fields.JP:
（でもここにいたら見つかってしまう。
　悔しいけど、ここを離れないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then again, if I stay here any
longer they'll find me.
I need to get away...)

fields.EN:
There's no telling what's in
store, so keep your guard up!
fields.JP:
みんな、何が出るか
分からないから油断しないでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what's in
store, so keep your guard up!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
やっと起きたか、ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That must've been some dream.
You were really deep in sleep.
fields.JP:
本当にジャックはよく寝るなぁ。
また夢を見ていたみたいだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must've been some dream.
You were really deep in sleep.

fields.EN:
Well, the day's starting,
so get yourself ready.
I got myself ready, too.
fields.JP:
さあ、目をしゃっきりさせるんだ。
僕は着替え終わったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the day's starting,
so get yourself ready.
I got myself ready, too.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

づう……ぐぎぎ……
ぼぐ…………いげ……ぐる……

fields.EN:
True, not like there's anything
for you to ready.
Well, let's go then.
fields.JP:
まあジャックは準備ないもんな。
じゃあ行こうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
True, not like there's anything
for you to ready.
Well, let's go then.

fields.EN:
Good morning.
So, about today, what should...
fields.JP:
おはようみんな。
今日の探索なんだけど、どうする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning.
So, about today, what should...

fields.EN:
Hahaha! It is all thanks to me!
All praise me!
fields.JP:
ふはは！　ワレのおかげであるぞ！
皆の者、ひざまづくがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! It is all thanks to me!
All praise me!

fields.EN:
Why, may I ask, are you standing
on the chair like that, Hameln?
fields.JP:
どうしたんだハーメルン、
椅子の上になんか立って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, may I ask, are you standing
on the chair like that, Hameln?

fields.EN:
Hark!
I have attained greatness again!
fields.JP: おつうよ、またワレは活躍してしまったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hark!
I have attained greatness again!

fields.EN:
Um, do you mind explaining
what's going on, Princess?
fields.JP: どういうことなんだ、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, do you mind explaining
what's going on, Princess?

fields.EN:
Well, it looks like Haa-chan just
got us new information.
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんがね、
新しい情報を持ってきてくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it looks like Hammy just
got us new information.

fields.EN:
To be specific, her familiar
apparently got some info
for us.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは使い魔を
使役しているようなんだが、
そいつが情報を仕入れてきてくれたらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be specific, her familiar
apparently got some info
for us.

fields.EN:
There's been someone sighted
at the Dorm area.
fields.JP: 旧学生街エリアで人影を目撃した、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's been someone sighted
at the Dorm area.

fields.EN:
Why, of course!
My familiar is very skilled,
just lyke me!
fields.JP:
もちろんだ！
ワレの使い魔は優秀なのでありゅ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why of course!
My familiar is very skilled,
just lyke meh!

fields.EN:
Yeah, so she's been like this
from the moment she woke up.
fields.JP:
だもんで、コイツは朝からずっと
調子に乗ってやがるってわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, so she's been like this
from the moment she woke up.

fields.EN: All praise be to the hero, Hameln!
fields.JP:
貴様ら、勇者ハーメルンを
たたえるがいいー！
fields.LOCALIZED: All praise be to the hero, Hameln!

fields.EN:
In any case, that's great news.
So, Hameln, do you know who
this someone is?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、お手柄だな。
どんな風貌だったとか、分かるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, that's great news.
So, Hameln, do you know who
this someone is?

fields.EN:
W-Well, not really.
It was "someone" for sure though.
fields.JP:
そ、そこまでは分からぬ。
人影だったとしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, not really.
It was "someone" for sure though.

fields.EN: Y-You dare spit on me, Mamoru?!
fields.JP: わ、ワレを侮辱するのか、マモル！
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-You dare spit on me, Mamoru?!

fields.EN: Come now, stop fighting, you two.
fields.JP: こーら、２人ともケンカしないの
fields.LOCALIZED: Come now, stop fighting, you two.

fields.EN:
Regardless, it is Haa-chan who
brought us the information.
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんのおかげなのは
間違いないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, it is Hammy who
brought us the information.

fields.EN:
Before going further...
Please get off the chair, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、
とりあえず僕の椅子から降りてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before going further...
Please get off the chair, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Whatever the case, at least we
have a great lead now!
fields.JP: でもでも、すっごい有力情報だよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever the case, at least we
have a great lead now!

fields.EN:
Hopefully we can put it
to good use.
fields.JP: この調子でどんどんいきたいところだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hopefully we can put it
to good use.

fields.EN:
Oh hey, before I forget...
You mind taking this with you?
fields.JP:
そうだ、これ出来上がったから
持って行ってくんな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh hey, before I forget...
You mind taking this with you?

fields.JP: ……銃？　でも反対側の先は注射？

fields.EN: Ningyo-chan asked me to make this. It sticks a needle into Jack, draws up his blood, and shoots it like a water gun.
fields.JP:
人魚ちゃんに頼まれてたモン。
ジャックに針を刺して血を吸い上げて、
水鉄砲の要領で飛ばす装置
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lil' Mermaid asked me to make
it. You draw blood from Jack with
it, then shoot it like a pistol.

fields.EN:
There's no telling when we'll
go into Blood Skelter, right?
fields.JP:
わたしたち、いつまた
ブラッドスケルター化するか
分からないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling when we'll
go into Blood Skelter, right?

fields.EN:
True... I'm quite sure we're going
to need to rely on Jack's blood
down the line.
fields.JP:
そうだね、ジャックの血を借りる時が
この先もまだまだあると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... I'm quite sure we're going
to need to rely on Jack's blood
down the line.

fields.EN:
Jack-san is kind enough to harm
himself to share his blood
with us.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん優しいから、
きっと自分で自分を傷つけて、
血をわけてくれると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is kind enough to harm
himself to share his blood
with us.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
But that also means he's in
pain, and seeing that is just
too much.
fields.JP:
でもそれはとても痛みを伴うでしょう？
見てるだけでも痛ましいのだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that also means he's in
pain, and seeing that is just
too much.

fields.EN:
I see. So the needle acts as a
syringe to draw blood, which
should ease the pain.
fields.JP:
なるほどね。
注射のようにして吸い上げる……、
上手にやれば痛みはないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So the needle acts as a
syringe to draw blood, which
should ease the pain.

fields.EN: Hm, Jack was in pain for sure.
fields.JP: 確かにジャック、少し痛がっていた
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm, Jack was in pain for sure.

fields.JP:
（それをちゃんと分かって、
　気遣ってくれてたなんて）

fields.EN:
Thank you, Princess.
Thank you, Takumi.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、姫。
そしてタクミ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Princess.
Thank you, Takumi.

fields.EN:
No prob at that! That's my job!
So yeah, put it to good use,
will you?
fields.JP:
それがしの仕事は完璧でござる！
……ってことで、まあ活用してくれな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No prob at that! That's my job!
So yeah, put it to good use,
will you?

fields.EN:
I'll be sure to take
good care of it.
fields.JP: 大事に使わせてもらうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be sure to take
good care of it.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I wonder who that
someone is at the Dorm area.
fields.JP:
それにしても旧学生街エリア、
誰がいるんだろうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I wonder who that
someone is at the Dorm area.

fields.EN:
If that "someone" is alone,
odds are likely that someone
is a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
情報にあった人影が単独なら、
ほぼ確実に血式少女だと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that "someone" is alone,
odds are likely that someone
is a Blood Maiden.

fields.JP: おねーちゃんだといいなぁ……

fields.EN:
Our dear sister Akazukin!
She's really reliable!
fields.JP:
はい！　赤ずきんおねーちゃんです。
とっても頼りになるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our dear sister Red Riding Hood!
She's really reliable!

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, you mean that girl
we saw back when we escaped,
right?
fields.JP:
ああ、最初の脱獄の時、
遠目に見たうちの１人か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, you mean that girl
we saw back when we escaped,
right?

fields.EN:
She made sure we got as far as we
could back then. It'd be great if
we can converge with her.
fields.JP:
なんだかんだ、赤ずきんが
僕たちを引っ張ってくれていたからね。
正直、いてくれたらかなり心強いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She made sure we got as far as we
could back then. It'd be great if
we can converge with her.

fields.EN:
I sure hope that will happen.
It does feel a bit uneasy without
her around...
fields.JP:
そうだね……おねーちゃんがいない
今は少し不安……かな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure hope that will happen.
It does feel a bit uneasy without
her around...

fields.EN:
I guess that means she's trusted
by you all.
fields.JP:
へえ～、すごい頼りになる
お姉さんなんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that means she's trusted
by you all.

fields.EN:
If someone like that can join,
then this place will become even
more safer.
fields.JP:
そんな人が加わってくれたら、
この場所もさらに安心だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If someone like that can join,
then this place will become even
more safer.

fields.JP: どうした？　ハーメルン

fields.EN:
Who is this Akazukin?!
How dare she gather all your
trust!
fields.JP:
ワレを差し置いて頼られるなんて、
なんなのだ、その赤ずきんという奴はー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who is this Red Riding Hood?!
How dare she gather all your
trust!

fields.EN:
I am the hero here! Hameln!
I'm supposed to be your hero!
fields.JP:
ワレという勇者がいるのに！
ワレという勇者がいるのにーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the hero here! Hameln!
I'm supposed to be your hero!

fields.JP: お、落ち着くんだハーメルン

fields.EN:
Well, we're counting on you
too, Hameln.
fields.JP: ハーちゃんも頼りにしてるから、ね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we're counting on you
too, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Hmph... Is that so?
I guess that just means that
person will be my rival!
fields.JP:
ふっ……そうか、
これがライバルという奴なのだな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... Is that so?
I guess that just means that
person will be my rival!

fields.EN:
Just you wait, Akazukin!
My sworn rival!
fields.JP:
待っておれ、赤ずきん！
我がライバルよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just you wait, Red Riding Hood!
My sworn rival!

fields.EN: So, this is the Dorm area...
fields.JP: ここが旧学生街エリア……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, this is the Dorm area...

fields.JP: ここも何だか不気味だね……

fields.EN:
Something about this place
just isn't right...
fields.JP: 雰囲気も今までと全然違うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something about this place
just isn't right...

fields.JP: なんだ貴様ら、怖じ気づいたのか？

fields.EN:
Do not fear! I am here!
Don't leave everything to me!
fields.JP:
ワレがいるのだ！
泥船に乗ったつもりでいるがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do not fear! I am here!
Don't leave everything to me!

fields.EN:
That would have been assuring
if only you left out the "don't."
fields.JP: 泥船じゃ不安倍増じゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would have been assuring
if only you left out the "don't."

fields.EN:
I-I was just testing you!
That was totally not me making
a myshtake!
fields.JP:
い、今のは貴様らを試しただけだ！
決して間違えたわけではにゃい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I was just testing you!
That was totally not me making
a myshtake!

fields.JP: 間違えたわけではない！

fields.EN:
Oh, we know what you were
trying to say. We'll be sure to
rely on you, Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
分かってるよハーちゃん。
大船に乗ったつもりでいるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, we know what you were
trying to say. We'll be sure to
rely on you, Hammy.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
Place your burdens upon me!
fields.JP: そうであるぞ、ワレを頼るがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
Place your burdens upon me!

fields.EN:
In any case, I've never been here
before, so let's be careful.
fields.JP:
だけど、このエリアには今まで
入ったことがない。慎重に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I've never been here
before, so let's be careful.

fields.EN:
Okay. There's no telling what's
in store for us here.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
何が起こるか分からないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. There's no telling what's
in store for us here.

fields.EN:
Well said!
Let us be very careful!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ貴様ら！
慎重に行くのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said!
Let us be very careful!

fields.EN:
Uh, do you mind sticking to your
words? Don't go ahead of us
like that!
fields.JP:
言ったそばからハーメルン、
そんなに１人で先行しないでくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, do you mind sticking to your
words? Don't go ahead of us
like that!

fields.EN:
This place could be a death trap.
We really need to be more careful.
fields.JP:
いつだって死が隣り合わせなんだ。
だから僕たちはもっと慎重にならないと。
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place could be a death trap.
We really need to be more careful.

fields.EN:
I want to make sure we make it
out alive, so I'm counting on
you... Hameln, the hero.
