fields.JP:
少なくともナイトメアは今は倒せない。
いつでも逃げられるようにしてないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we can beat
the Nightmare now, so we need to
be ready to run at any moment.

fields.EN: That Nightmare is looking at us!
fields.JP: しかもナイトメアの方だぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That Nightmare is looking at us!

fields.EN:
Everyone! If it comes our way,
we're going to run, got it?!
fields.JP:
みんな、ナイトメアがこっちに
来るようなら、すぐ逃げるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! If it comes our way,
we're going to run, got it?!

fields.JP: 危ないところだったね……

fields.EN:
All is well as long as
we're safe...
fields.LOCALIZED:
All is well as long as
we're safe...

fields.EN:
(Why did that Nightmare run
off like that?)
fields.JP:
（でもどうして、あのナイトメアは
　急に逃げ出したんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why did that Nightmare run
off like that?)

fields.EN:
(And, what's with the emotions
coming from it?)
fields.JP:
（それにあのナイトメアから
　流れてきた感情……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, what's with the emotions
coming from it?)

fields.EN:
(I sensed it being surprised
and... sad?)
fields.JP:
（あの感情は驚き……
　それと……悲しみ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sensed it being surprised
and... sad?)

fields.EN:
Say, Tsuu?
What do you plan on doing with
that hairy monster?
fields.JP:
ねえ、つう。
それであの毛玉の化け物は
どう対処するつもり？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu?
What do you plan on doing with
that hairy monster?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: ということは、人間なのか……？

fields.EN:
I suppose that could explain
why it has so much hair.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、あの毛玉は
髪の毛ということになるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that could explain
why it has so much hair.

fields.EN:
(It's trying to keep us back...
What to do...)
fields.JP:
（すっごい威嚇してる……
　どうしようか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's trying to keep us back...
What to do...)

fields.EN:
Come now, there's nothing to
be afraid of. Do you want some
candy?
fields.JP:
ほら、怖くないよ。
お菓子、食べる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, there's nothing to
be afraid of. Do you want some
candy?

fields.EN: Don't worry, we won't hurt you.
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry, we won't hurt you.

fields.JP: ほーらいい子いい子ー

ん～～～～～！
いいひと！　いいひと！
さすがとしか言えない……
あなたはなんてお名前なの？

はぐはぐ……ラプ……
……ラプンツェル！

fields.EN:
Okay, so Rapu-chan then.
Where did you come from, Rapu-chan?
fields.JP:
じゃあラプちゃんだね。
ラプちゃんはどこから来たのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, so Rappy then.
Where did you come from, Rappy?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
どこでもない！
ずっと、ここ！

fields.EN:
So, she wandered around
this area all by herself?
fields.JP:
ずっと独房エリアを１人で
彷徨っていたのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, she wandered around
this area all by herself?

fields.EN:
To add, she tried to fight
that Nightmare by herself.
fields.JP:
１人でナイトメアに
真っ向から立ち向かえるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, she tried to fight
that Nightmare by herself.

fields.EN:
Tsuu, you don't suppose she's
a Blood Maiden, do you?
fields.JP:
つう、ラプンツェルは
血式少女なのではないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you don't suppose she's
a Blood Maiden, do you?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
That's what I thought, too.
No, that has to be it.
fields.JP: 僕も思った……それ以外あり得ないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I thought, too.
No, that has to be it.

fields.EN:
Princess? Do you mind splashing
a bit of this Marchen blood?
fields.JP:
姫、ちょっとメルヒェンの血を
その子にかけてもらってもいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess? Do you mind splashing
a bit of this Marchen blood?

fields.JP: 分かった、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
That proves it...
Rapunzel is a Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
よし、ラプンツェルは
確かに血式少女だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That proves it...
Rapunzel is a Blood Maiden!

fields.EN:
Okay, well, Rapu-chan?
How about you come with us?
fields.JP:
じゃあラプちゃん、
わたしたちと一緒に行かない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, well, Rappy?
How about you come with us?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
She doesn't seem to understand
what you just said.
fields.JP: あまりよく分かってないみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't seem to understand
what you just said.

fields.EN:
You... Look like fish...
Look tasty...
fields.JP:
なんか……おさかなみたい。
おいしそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You... Look like fish...
Look tasty...

fields.EN:
Uh, despite the reason, it seems
like she's attracted to her.
fields.JP: 理由はともあれ……さらに懐いたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, despite the reason, it seems
like she's attracted to her.

fields.EN:
And, it also looks like she'll
follow us now!
fields.JP: 何だか着いてきそうな雰囲気ではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it also looks like she'll
follow us now!

fields.JP: じゃあこのまま出発しましょう

お魚って……
まぁ……いいけれど……
じゃあラプちゃん、一緒に――
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: やだ、ラプちゃん服着てないじゃない！

fields.EN:
There's no way we can have her
around naked...
fields.JP:
さすがにその状態で
連れ回すのは何だか気が引けるね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way we can have her
around naked...

fields.EN:
So, it looks like you were
able to find a Blood Maiden
quite easily.
fields.JP:
なるほど、今回は早速
血式少女を見つけられたんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it looks like you were
able to find a Blood Maiden
quite easily.

fields.EN:
Lucky you! We're so on a roll
it makes me wanna shout!
fields.JP:
最近ツキまくってるじゃないのー！
アタシ感動しちゃう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lucky you! We're so on a roll
it makes me wanna shout!

fields.EN:
I'm happy that a new member joins
Hameln's heroic party!
fields.JP:
勇者ハーメルンの仲間が
また増えてワレは嬉しいぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that a new member joins
Hameln's heroic party!

fields.EN:
I hate to dampen things, but it
isn't all good news.
We met "that" Nightmare...
fields.JP:
でも嬉しいニュースばかりではないんだ。
出たんだ……あのナイトメアが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hate to dampen things, but it
isn't all good news.
We met "that" Nightmare...

fields.EN:
You mean the one that destroyed
Dawn?
fields.JP: もしかして黎明を滅ぼしたナイトメアか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean the one that destroyed
Dawn?

fields.EN:
I see...
It ran off to that area, eh?
fields.JP:
なるほど、そっちの方に
逃げてやがったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
It ran off to that area, eh?

fields.EN:
It went deeper in, so I'm sure
we'll encounter it again if we
search the area thoroughly.
fields.JP:
奥へ逃げていったから、
あのエリアを探索するのであれば、
また遭遇する可能性は充分あるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It went deeper in, so I'm sure
we'll encounter it again if we
search the area thoroughly.

fields.EN:
I put some clothes I had on hand
on Rapu-chan!
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんに服、
適当に見繕ったよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I put some clothes I had on hand
on Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Huh...
Rapunzel looks quite cute in that.
fields.JP:
へえ……ラプンツェル、
ちゃんとすればとても可愛いじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...
Rapunzel looks quite cute in that.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
You're not the same as before!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
You're not the same as before!

fields.EN:
She looks so good and sweet
that I'd almost wanna eat her!
fields.JP:
確かに、アタシ
食べちゃいたいくらいだわ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She looks so good and sweet
that I'd almost wanna eat her!

fields.JP:
おーーーー
ひとがいっぱいーーーー

fields.EN:
That looks so good on you,
Rapu-chan!
fields.JP: ラプちゃん洋服似合ってるよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That looks so good on you,
Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
えへへ～～～
ありがとーーーーー

fields.EN:
Say, Rapunzel?
Do you mind if I ask you about that
Nightmare you fought back there?
fields.JP:
なあラプンツェル、
ちょっとあの謎のナイトメアについて
聞いてもいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Rapunzel?
Do you mind if I ask you about that
Nightmare you fought back there?

fields.EN:
You know, that monster you were
fighting?
fields.JP: ラプちゃんが戦ってた化け物のことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, that monster you were
fighting?

fields.EN:
That thing! Thing came by and
made plenty problems!
fields.JP:
あいつ！　さいきんやってきて、
あばれてたあいつ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That thing! Thing came by and
made plenty problems!

fields.JP:
ああ、そいつのことだと思う。
続けてくれ、ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
Um, more bad problem was
with other one!
fields.JP: あのね、もともとヤなやつはべつにいた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, more bad problem was
with other one!

fields.EN:
Is she talking about the
Nightmare... I mean, the monster
that's stationed there?
fields.JP:
あのエリアに最初からいた
ナイトメア……化け物のことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she talking about the
Nightmare... I mean, the monster
that's stationed there?

fields.EN:
That monster so strong!
Rapunzel was always in danger!
fields.JP:
でもあいつはもっとつよくて……
ラプンツェル、いつもあぶなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That monster so strong!
Rapunzel was always in danger!

fields.EN:
Monster was killing everything...
So bad...
fields.JP:
あいつ、あいついがいの
うごいてるやつぜんぶ……ころしてた……
すごくたいへんだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Monster was killing everything...
So bad...

fields.EN:
I see... It must have been tough.
Well, you're fine with us now.
fields.JP:
そっか……大変だったね。
もう大丈夫だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... It must have been tough.
Well, you're fine with us now.

fields.EN:
I see... That sounds just like
what happened with Dawn.
Hm, killing everything in sight...
fields.JP:
なるほど……黎明の時と同じだな。
とにかく目につくものすべて殺す……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... That sounds just like
what happened with Dawn.
Hm, killing everything in sight...

fields.EN:
Since Nightmares are connected
with an area's core, I doubt it
can wander outside of its locale.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは核と繋がっているから、
普通はエリアから出てこないと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since Nightmares are connected
with an area's core, I doubt it
can wander outside of its locale.

fields.EN:
Right. The core makes the Nightmare
impossible to kill.
fields.JP:
核のおかげで不死性が
保たれているんだもんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. The core makes the Nightmare
impossible to kill.

fields.EN:
And yet, that Nightmare can
move between areas...
Quite intriguing...
fields.JP:
だが、あのナイトメアはエリア間を
移動する……。いったい何なのだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
And yet, that Nightmare can
move between areas...
Quite intriguing...

fields.EN:
You don't suppose that
Nightmare is "Snark?"
fields.JP:
もしかしてあのナイトメアこそ
『スナーク』なんじゃないか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't suppose that
Nightmare is "Snark?"

fields.JP: スナーク？　なんだ、そりゃ

fields.EN:
It's called the king of
Nightmares. It's the strongest of
all the Nightmares around.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアの王……と言われる
最強クラスのナイトメアのことさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's called the king of
Nightmares. It's the strongest of
all the Nightmares around.

fields.EN:
Strongest?! Are you saying that
it's stronger than me?!
fields.JP:
最強！？　なんだと、
ワレよりも強いというのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strongest?! Are you saying that
it's stronger than me?!

fields.EN:
At the very least, we have no
chance against it in our current
state.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、今の僕たちじゃ
太刀打ちできないんじゃないかな。
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least, we have no
chance against it in our current
state.

fields.EN:
I recall hearing about this
"Snark" creature from before.
fields.JP:
僕もそのスナークについては
多少聞きかじっているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall hearing about this
"Snark" creature from before.

fields.EN:
It was the very one that killed
the founding members of
Dawn...
fields.JP:
なんせ昔、黎明の初期メンバーを
惨殺した奴だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was the very one that killed
the founding members of
Dawn...

fields.EN:
Yes... I heard it was strong and
equally vicious and merciless...
fields.JP:
ああ……恐ろしいほどの強さと
残虐性を持った奴らしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I heard it was strong and
equally vicious and merciless...

fields.EN:
The only one who survived the
attack was the Professor.
He's currently lost, too.
fields.JP:
その時に生き残ったのは博士だけ。
そしてその博士もこの間の黎明壊滅の時に
行方不明だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only one who survived the
attack was the Professor.
He's currently lost, too.

fields.EN:
That sounds just like what
happened back there at the
Dawn place.
fields.JP: そう聞くと、やり口が似てるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds just like what
happened back there at the
Dawn place.

fields.EN:
At the very least,
I can deduce that the Nightmare
holds tremendous power.
fields.JP:
確かにあのナイトメア、
計り知れない力を有していそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At the very least,
I can deduce that the Nightmare
holds tremendous power.

fields.EN:
And, it's roaming around freely.
Isn't that dangerous...?
fields.JP:
そんな化け物が、
自由に動き回ってるんだ……
なんかとても怖いよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it's roaming around freely.
Isn't that dangerous...?

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I'll be sure to
protect our place here.
fields.JP:
心配すんなって。この解放地区は
俺がしっかり守ってやるからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'll be sure to
protect our place here.

fields.EN:
Even so, I doubt we stand much
chance with our current
defenses...
fields.JP:
とはいえ、そんな奴相手に
解放地区の守備を固めたところで
どれだけ効果があるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I doubt we stand much
chance with our current
defenses...

fields.EN:
Great work, Brainiac!
Way to dampen the mood!
fields.JP:
バカっ！　こういう時に
そんな更にテンション下がるようなこと
言うんじゃねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great work, Brainiac!
Way to dampen the mood!

fields.EN:
Humans are always at a
disadvantage here, so we have to
at least stay strong in our heart!
fields.JP:
いつだってあたしたち人間が
分が悪いってのは分かってんだよ。
だからせめて心では負けるなっての！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humans are always at a
disadvantage here, so we have to
at least stay strong in our heart!

fields.EN:
So if anything, now is the time
to liven up the mood, you hear?
fields.JP:
だーかーら、こういう時はもっと
明るいこと話すもんなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if anything, now is the time
to liven up the mood, you hear?

fields.EN:
Okay! How about we get a bit
more info from Rapu-chan on who
she is?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ハイ！
新しい仲間であるラプちゃんのこと、
もっと知りたいなー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! How about we get a bit
more info from Rappy on who
she is?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Ooh, that sounds good!
I wouldn't mind getting to know
her better, too!
fields.JP:
わ、いいですね！
わたしも聞きたいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, that sounds good!
I wouldn't mind getting to know
her better, too!

fields.JP: ラプちゃんの生まれはどこ？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Dunno! When I realized it, I was there!
fields.JP:
わかんない！
きづいたらあそこにいたーーー！
な、なんという予想外の答え……

fields.EN:
Okay, then what kind of things
did you eat out there?
fields.JP: じゃあ何食べて生きてたんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then what kind of things
did you eat out there?

fields.JP:
なに……たべて……？
……えーっとね……あれ！

fields.EN:
W-Wall?
You mean the Jail's wall?
fields.JP:
か、かべって……
ジェイルの壁のことかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wall?
You mean the Jail's wall?

fields.JP: うん！　かべたべてた！

fields.EN:
Oh, you didn't know?
It's quite delectable.
fields.JP: あら。なかなかいけるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you didn't know?
It's quite delectable.

fields.JP: お前も食べてたのかよ……
あとはメルヒェン！　おいしいよ！

fields.EN:
I see...
That never dawned on me.
fields.JP: なるほど……その発想はなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
That never dawned on me.

fields.EN:
Um, that doesn't need to
dawn on you...
fields.JP: いや、そこ感心するとこじゃねえから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, that doesn't need to
dawn on you...

fields.EN:
Well, to be fair, I knew the Jail's
walls and Marchen blood were
sweet, but you shouldn't eat them.
fields.JP:
確かにジェイルの壁もメルヒェンの血も、
甘いとは思ったけどよ……あれは
なんていうか、ヤバイ味だぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, to be fair, I knew the Jail's
walls and Marchen blood were
sweet, but you shouldn't eat them.

fields.JP: あはは！　ここたかーい！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……のぼっだら……
あ……あぶな……ぎぎよ……

ラプンツェル、
ジャックに登っちゃ駄目だって
ここきにいったーーー！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh well...
At least Jack doesn't seem
to mind at all.
fields.JP:
ジャックもなんだか
楽しそうだし……まあいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well...
At least Jack doesn't seem
to mind at all.

fields.EN:
Ooh! Rapunzel was trying
to make babies!
fields.JP:
でねーー？　ラプンツェル、
こどもつくるのがんばってたの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Rapunzel was trying
to make babies!

fields.EN:
Uh...
Did I just hear her right?
fields.JP: あ……あたしの聞き間違いじゃないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh...
Did I just hear her right?

fields.JP:
でもなかなかできないのー！
ラプンツェル、もっとがんばるの！！

fields.EN:
Mmm... I hope she's trying
to say something else...
fields.JP:
うーん……これはさすがに
ちょっと理解できないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I hope she's trying
to say something else...

fields.EN:
I guess I can ask her about
that another time.
fields.JP: 今度またちゃんと、聞くことにしようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can ask her about
that another time.

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan?
Are you planning on bringing
Rapunzel along on the next outing?
fields.JP:
ねえおつうちゃん、
次の探索、ラプちゃんは連れて行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu?
Are you planning on bringing
Rapunzel along on the next outing?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Well, I would feel terrible
dragging such a young child
to the dangers outside...
fields.JP:
そこなんだけど……
幼い子を連れて行くのは
少しかわいそうな気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I would feel terrible
dragging such a young child
to the dangers outside...

fields.EN:
But, she was able to fight a
Nightmare by herself.
She could prove really helpful.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはあの
ナイトメアと渡り合っているのよ？
充分な戦力だと思うけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she was able to fight a
Nightmare by herself.
She could prove really helpful.

fields.EN:
I suppose...
It's not like we have the luxury
anyway...
fields.JP:
それもそうだな……
今はなりふり構ってる場合でもないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose...
It's not like we have the luxury
anyway...

fields.EN:
All right, let's bring her
with us, and...
Welcome to the party, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
……じゃあ連れて行くことにしよう。
改めてよろしくな、ラプンツェル
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's bring her
with us, and...
Welcome to the party, Rapunzel.

fields.JP: うん！　よろしくーーーー！！

fields.EN:
Yes. Now we can fight the
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ああ。これで
ようやくナイトメアと戦えるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Now we can fight the
Nightmare.

fields.EN: Look! The guardian of the core!
fields.JP: ほれ、核の番人が出てきたぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Look! The guardian of the core!

fields.JP: うーー！　うぅぅぅーー！！

fields.EN:
If things get dangerous, get
behind me, Rapu-chan!
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、危なくなったら
わたしの後ろに来るんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If things get dangerous, get
behind me, Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Work as a team, and we'll be
able to get through just fine!
fields.JP:
みんな、お互いに
カバーしあって突破するぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Work as a team, and we'll be
able to get through just fine!

fields.EN:
That was supposed to be the
guardian? What a joke.
fields.JP:
これで番人とは
随分と笑わせてくれるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was supposed to be the
guardian? What a joke.

fields.JP:
気が合うな！
まったくそのとおりなのだ
でもハーメルン、疲れてないか？
そ、そんなことにゃいのだ！

fields.EN:
Fine... I'll just assume you're
not tired.
fields.JP:
まあ、疲れてない……
……ということにしておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'll just assume you're
not tired.

fields.EN: All right, let's destroy the core.
fields.JP: よし、それじゃあ核を破壊するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, let's destroy the core.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
Now we can face the Nightmare in
this area.
fields.JP:
これでこのエリアも
ナイトメアに立ち向かっていけるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can face the Nightmare in
this area.

fields.EN:
I can't wait to face it!
Let's go!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアと戦う時が楽しみだ。
では行くぞ貴様らー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't wait to face it!
Let's go!

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Ahaha! Blood all over!
So much blood! So fun!
fields.JP:
あははっ！　ちがいっぱいっ！
いっぱいでてくるっ！　たのしいー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahaha! Blood all over!
So much blood! So fun!

fields.EN:
Wha-?! What are you doing with
that dead Marchen?!
fields.JP:
なっ……！　メルヒェンの死体で
何をやっているの……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! What are you doing with
that dead Marchen?!

fields.EN:
She's stabbing it repeatedly...
Is she... playing?
fields.JP:
何度も突き刺して……
もしかして遊んでいる……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's stabbing it repeatedly...
Is she... playing?

fields.JP:
いっしょにやるー？
たのしいよー！！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
We needed to kill that Marchen
so that we can live, but...
fields.JP:
確かに、わたしたちは生きるために
そのメルヒェンを殺す必要があったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We needed to kill that Marchen
so that we can live, but...

fields.EN:
The Marchen fought only to protect
the Jail. We just fought because
it was for survival.
fields.JP:
でもメルヒェンもジェイルを守るという
掟のためにわたしたちを襲っただけ。
互いに生きるために行っていることなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchen fought only to protect
the Jail. We just fought because
it was for survival.

fields.EN:
Fighting can't be helped now,
but once everything is done...
Please, leave it alone.
fields.JP:
ぶつかり合うのは仕方ない。
でも戦いが終わったら……
もうそれ以上汚すのは、やめてあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting can't be helped now,
but once everything is done...
Please, leave it alone.

fields.EN:
Indeed! Stabbing is a weak
choice. It's faster to simply
burn it to smithereens!
fields.JP:
うむ、何度も刺すのはまどろっこしい。
パパッと焼き尽くすのがいいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! Stabbing is a weak
choice. It's faster to simply
burn it to smithereens!

fields.EN:
On the contrary, repeated stabbing
is useful in ensuring that the
target is indeed dead.
fields.JP:
いいえ、ちゃんと生命活動が停止したか、
確認のために刺し続けるのは有効よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, repeated stabbing
is useful in ensuring that the
target is indeed dead.

fields.EN:
Uh, that's not what Princess
wanted to try and relay...
fields.JP:
いや、姫が言ってるのは
そういうことじゃないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's not what Princess
wanted to try and relay...

fields.EN:
(If Princess heard those two
they would be in for a scolding
of their lives...)
fields.JP:
（まったく、姫に聞こえてたら
　２人とも怒られてるぞ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If Princess heard those two
they would be in for a scolding
of their lives...)

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, all I ask is that you
respect life and what used to
contain that life.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、どうか命、
それ自体には敬意を持ってあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, all I ask is that you
respect life and what used to
contain that life.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Um... Um...
No stabby if it's dead?
fields.JP:
んっと、んっと、
しんだらもうさしちゃだめ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Um...
No stabby if it's dead?

fields.EN:
Okay! Rapunzel won't stab
dead Marchens!
fields.JP:
わかった！　ラプンツェル、
もうしんだメルヒェンささないっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Rapunzel won't stab
dead Marchens!

fields.EN:
Very good, Rapu-chan.
That's a good girl.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんはいい子ね。
よしよし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good, Rappy.
That's a good girl.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Mmm...!
I likey getting my head rubbed!
fields.JP:
ん～～～！
あたまナデナデされるの、すきー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...!
I likey getting my head rubbed!

fields.EN:
Oh my, your beautiful hair is
all dirty now.
fields.JP:
あらら、ラプちゃんせっかくの
綺麗な髪の毛が汚れちゃってるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, your beautiful hair is
all dirty now.

fields.EN:
You have blood and... some
debris stuck in there.
fields.JP:
血はべっとり付いてるし、
小さな瓦礫の破片も絡んじゃってる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have blood and... some
debris stuck in there.

fields.JP:
えっ！？　うそっ！？
やだやだやだーーーー！

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, don't spit on your hair
like that!
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん髪の毛にツバなんて
つけちゃ駄目だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, don't spit on your hair
like that!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Wanna clean...
Sob... Wanna keep clean...
fields.JP:
きれいにしないと……
ぐすっ、きれいにしないと……っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanna clean...
Sob... Wanna keep clean...

fields.EN:
(I see... Rapunzel doesn't know
any other way of cleaning
herself.)
fields.JP:
（そうか……ラプンツェルはそれ以外、
　綺麗にする方法を知らないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... Rapunzel doesn't know
any other way of cleaning
herself.)

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, just use a handkerchief.
Here, let me wipe you clean.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、そういう時は
ハンカチを使うといいよ。
ほら、拭いてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, just use a handkerchief.
Here, let me wipe you clean.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
ほんとう？　
うぅ、人魚ありがと……！

fields.EN:
I need to keep hair clean...
Rapunzel can't make babies
if dirty...
fields.JP:
かみのけすてきにしないと
ラプンツェル、こどもつくれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to keep hair clean...
Rapunzel can't make babies
if dirty...

fields.EN: I recall you saying that before.
fields.JP: 前も言ってたね、そんなこと
fields.LOCALIZED: I recall you saying that before.

fields.EN: Why do you want babies, Rapu-chan?
fields.JP: ラプちゃんはどうしてこどもがほしいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why do you want babies, Rappy?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I don't think your hair is
important. It's just that...
you're not ready for babies yet.
fields.JP:
その、髪の毛のことよりも
身体がまだ産むには早いんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think your hair is
important. It's just that...
you're not ready for babies yet.

fields.EN:
Urrh...
I need to keep hair clean...
fields.JP:
うぅ……とにかく、
かみのけはきれいにしておかないとなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...
I need to keep hair clean...

fields.EN:
Even at her age she wants babies,
so she tries to keep her
hair clean...
fields.JP:
まだ幼いのに、こどもを作りたい、
そのために髪の毛をきれいにする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even at her age she wants babies,
so she tries to keep her
hair clean...

fields.EN:
I assume that may be Rapunzel's
Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
それこそがラプンツェルの
血式リビドーなんじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume that may be Rapunzel's
Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
A forced sense of urgency that
others can't relate to. Her
desire seems to fit that bill.
fields.JP:
他人には理解しがたい強迫観念。
まさに今のラプンツェルの話がそうだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
A forced sense of urgency that
others can't relate to. Her
desire seems to fit that bill.

fields.EN:
I see...
I guess it can't be helped then.
fields.JP: なるほど……それじゃあ仕方ないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I guess it can't be helped then.

fields.EN:
Wanting to keep herself clean
almost sounds like Cinderella.
fields.JP:
身なりをきれいにしたがるって、
なんだかシンデレラみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanting to keep herself clean
almost sounds like Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Hm? Who's that?
Don't tell me that person is
more noticeable than me...
fields.JP:
ん？　誰だそいつは？　まさかワレより
偉くて目立ってる……などとは言うまいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Who's that?
Don't tell me that person is
more noticeable than me...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Hameln.
Not many can stand up to being
as "noticeable" as you...
fields.JP:
安心するんだ、ハーメルンより
目立つ奴はなかなかいない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Hameln.
Not many can stand up to being
as "noticeable" as you...

fields.EN:
Indeed!
I am the most noticeable
one around!
fields.JP:
そうであるかー！
ワレがいっちばん目立つのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
I am the most noticeable
one around!

fields.EN:
I see we're turning the blind eye
to whether that's a good thing or
bad thing.
fields.JP: 偉いかどうかは伏せるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see we're turning the blind eye
to whether that's a good thing or
bad thing.

fields.EN:
Trust me, neither of them hold
"good" noticeable qualities...
fields.JP: いや、どっちも偉いとかないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Trust me, neither of them hold
"good" noticeable qualities...

fields.EN:
You've piqued my interest.
Who is this "Cinderella?"
fields.JP:
でも私も少し気になってきたわ。
シンデレラとは何者？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've piqued my interest.
Who is this "Cinderella?"

fields.EN:
She's a Blood Maiden who was
always well-dressed and held
a big heaping of pride.
fields.JP:
シンデレラは昔いた血式少女で……
いつも自信満々で、身だしなみには
特に気をつかう奴だったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's a Blood Maiden who was
always well-dressed and held
a big heaping of pride.

fields.EN:
Hm, and I assume she is one
of those who went missing?
fields.JP: ふむ、そやつも今回はぐれてしまったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, and I assume she is one
of those who went missing?

fields.EN:
Not exactly... Cinderella went
missing before the attack on Dawn.
fields.JP:
いや……シンデレラはもっと昔……
幼い頃に行方不明になってしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not exactly... Cinderella went
missing before the attack on Dawn.

fields.EN:
After she went missing, everyone
started to leave Dawn to join
the Order of the Sun...
fields.JP:
……しかもその後に他のみんなも
黎明を抜けてタイヨウ教団に
行ってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After she went missing, everyone
started to leave Dawn to join
the Order of the Sun...

fields.EN:
You make it sound like you
lost quite a number of allies.
fields.JP: そんなに仲間がいなくなってしまったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You make it sound like you
lost quite a number of allies.

fields.EN:
Yes... Most of the Blood Maidens
left. It was quite saddening...
fields.JP:
うん。一気に血式少女がいなくなって
とても悲しかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Most of the Blood Maidens
left. It was quite saddening...

fields.EN:
And, what is this
"Order of the Sun?"
fields.JP: タイヨウ教団とは何なのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, what is this
"Order of the Sun?"

fields.EN:
Everyone, I think it's best we
concentrate our efforts on finding
and defeating the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
みんな、とりあえずこの話は一旦止めて、
ナイトメアを倒すことに集中しないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, I think it's best we
concentrate our efforts on finding
and defeating the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
It's not a good idea to hang
around the prison area for long,
too.
fields.JP:
独房エリアに留まり続けるのは
あまり得策とは思えないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not a good idea to hang
around the prison area for long,
too.

fields.EN:
You're right!
Off we go to kill the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
それもそうだな！
さっさとナイトメアをぶっ殺しに行くのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right!
Off we go to kill the Nightmare!

fields.JP:
ら、ラプちゃん、
そんな言葉づかいは駄目だよ
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Fine...
Let's go and hunt down the
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
……仕方ないわね。
まずはナイトメアの討伐にいきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
Let's go and hunt down the
Nightmare.

fields.JP: ここで一気にケリをつけるぞ、みんな

fields.EN:
Will do, Otsuu.
I'll end its misery.
fields.JP:
もちろんだ、おつう。
ワレが蹴散らしてくれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do, Otsuu.
I'll end its misery.

fields.JP:
ラプちゃん、わたしたちから
離れちゃだめだよ
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Rapunzel hate it!
It keeps getting up!
fields.JP:
あいつ、なんどきずつけてもなおるから、
ラプンツェルきらい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel hate it!
It keeps getting up!

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Rapunzel.
We destroyed its core, so it
can be defeated now.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ、ラプンツェル。
さっき核を破壊したから、
もう不死性は失われている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Rapunzel.
We destroyed its core, so it
can be defeated now.

fields.EN:
It just means we can
kill it!
fields.JP: たおせる、ということだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means we can
kill it!

fields.JP:
たおせる……？
やっつけられる……？

fields.EN:
That's right. The Nightmare can't
heal itself anymore.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。あのナイトメアは、
もう傷は治らないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. The Nightmare can't
heal itself anymore.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean it's weak
though.
fields.JP:
だからといって、攻撃が弱くなった
わけではないけれどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean it's weak
though.

fields.EN:
Gretel's right. It's not like
it got weak or anything.
fields.JP:
グレーテルの言うとおりだ。倒せるように
なっただけで、雑魚になったわけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's right. It's not like
it got weak or anything.

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、みんな、
油断せずに行くぞ！

fields.EN:
We did it!
We destroyed a part of its body!
fields.JP: やった、部位を破壊できたよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did it!
We destroyed a part of its body!

fields.EN:
Hmph!
Nothing is impossible with me!
fields.JP: うむ、ワレにかかればこのくらい余裕なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph!
Nothing is impossible with me!

fields.EN:
We can beat meanie!
So good!
fields.JP:
やなやつ、たおせそう！
すごいすごい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can beat meanie!
So good!

fields.EN:
Working in unison should end
this quick.
fields.JP:
このまま上手く連携を取って、
さっさと撃破してしまいましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Working in unison should end
this quick.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, we're just a bit away
from beating that "meanie!"
Let's do this!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、やなやつ、
もうちょっとで倒せるぞ！　頑張ろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, we're just a bit away
from beating that "meanie!"
Let's do this!

fields.JP: うんっ！　ラプンツェルがんばるーー！！
よし、みんな畳みかけるんだ！
たおした、たおしたーーーーっ！！

fields.EN:
Looks like it was no match
against us.
fields.JP: 僕たちの連携には敵わなかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like it was no match
against us.

fields.EN:
No Nightmare can stand in
my way!
fields.JP:
ワレの前ではナイトメアなど
塵も同じなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No Nightmare can stand in
my way!

fields.EN:
I suppose this covers the search
around this prison area.
fields.JP:
これでこの独房エリアも
探索は終わったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose this covers the search
around this prison area.

fields.JP: でも全然見つからないね……

fields.EN: What did you expect to find?
fields.JP: 何が見つからないのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you expect to find?

fields.EN:
I was hoping we'd find the lost
Blood Maidens and the Professor.
Where could they have gone...?
fields.JP:
黎明にいた他の血式少女や博士です……
こんなに探しているというのに、
まだ誰も見つかりません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping we'd find the lost
Blood Maidens and the Professor.
Where could they have gone...?

fields.EN: It will be all right, Princess.
fields.LOCALIZED: It will be all right, Princess.

fields.EN: It's a long way from Dawn's former Liberated District. Everyone just hasn't made it here, that's all.
fields.JP:
ここは黎明の元解放地区からは
かなり遠い。だからみんな来てないだけさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This area is a fair distance away
from the old Dawn headquarters.
This place is a bit too far for them.

fields.EN:
There are more places to search,
so I'm sure they ran there.
fields.JP:
まだ探索してない場所はいっぱいある。
きっとそっちの方に逃げているんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are more places to search,
so I'm sure they ran there.

fields.EN:
It's a bit too early to go into
despair if you haven't searched
all there is yet.
fields.JP:
探索してない場所があるのなら、
悲しむのはまだ早いと言えるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a bit too early to go into
despair if you haven't searched
all there is yet.

fields.EN:
We have a lot more people than
before now! Just follow me and
I'm sure all will end well!
fields.JP:
仲間は増えていってるのだ！
くよくよせずにワレについて来るがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have a lot more people than
before now! Just follow me and
I'm sure all will end well!

fields.JP:
そうだね……
うん、みんなありがとう……

fields.EN:
Let's go search a different
location. We're bound to find
someone elsewhere.
fields.JP:
また別の場所を探索しよう。
そしてみんなを見つけ出すんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go search a different
location. We're bound to find
someone elsewhere.

fields.EN:
(That said, it's strange that we
haven't met a single Blood Maiden
with the Dawn yet.)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、こんなにも黎明の
　血式少女隊のメンバーがいないなんて、
　あの時以来だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That said, it's strange that we
haven't met a single Blood Maiden
with the Dawn yet.)

fields.EN:
(I remember back when I cried
when Cinderella and the three
sisters went missing...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラや親指姫たち三姉妹が
　急にいなくなったあの時……
　よく陰で泣いたっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember back when I cried
when Cinderella and the three
sisters went missing...)

fields.EN:
(I don't want to go through that
ever again. I will find my lost
friends...)
fields.JP:
（もうあんな思いはしたくない。
　絶対に他の仲間と合流するんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want to go through that
ever again. I will find my lost
friends...)

fields.EN:
I'm sure Akazukin and the
others are alive. We'll find them
sooner than later.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんも他のみんなも、絶対に生きてる。
諦めずに探せば、いつか再会できるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Red Riding Hood and the
others are alive. We'll find them
sooner than later.

fields.EN:
Yes... Yes, we will, Otsuu-chan.
I won't give up hope!
fields.JP:
そう……そうだよね、おつうちゃん。
諦めちゃ駄目だよね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Yes, we will, Otsuu.
I won't give up hope!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Oho! What willpower!
I can't be losing to you!
fields.JP:
おお、燃えておるな人魚姫。
ワレも負けてはおれぬな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! What willpower!
I can't be losing to you!

fields.EN:
We have more Blood Maidens than
before, and Hameln Liberated
District is growing by the day.
fields.JP:
新しい血式少女は増え、
ハーメルン解放地区もだんだん発展してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have more Blood Maidens than
before, and Hameln Liberated
District is growing by the day.

fields.EN:
There's nothing to worry about.
Let's keep things going!
fields.JP:
そうだ、悲観する要素なんてないんだ。
だからみんな、これからも頑張ろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing to worry about.
Let's keep things going!

fields.JP:
（どうしてそんなにしつこく
　追ってくるの……！）

fields.EN:
(Do they hate me that much?!
I didn't do anything!)
fields.JP:
（そんなに私が憎いの？
　私は何もしてないのに……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do they hate me that much?!
I didn't do anything!)

fields.EN:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!
fields.JP:
そっち行ったよ！
囲むんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's trying to run!
Surround it!

fields.EN: Very well, I shall intercept it!
fields.JP: それならわたくしが先回りいたしますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well, I shall intercept it!

fields.JP:
……ぐご……づがまる……
がご……わげには……

なっ！？
予想外に小回りが効きますわね！

fields.EN:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、進路を塞ぐだけでいい！
あまり１人で先行しないで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella! Just block its path!
Don't get ahead of yourself!

fields.EN:
(Why...?
What did I do to deserve this?!)
fields.JP:
（どうして……
　私が何をしたって言うの……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why...?
What did I do to deserve this?!)

fields.JP:
（お願いだから、
　もう放っておいて……！）

fields.EN:
(They kept coming and coming.
So tired...)
fields.JP: （何度も何度も……もう疲れたよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They kept coming and coming.
So tired...)

fields.JP:
ぎ……ぎぎ……
やず……みだい……

fields.EN:
(Why...?
Why is everyone coming after me?)
fields.JP:
（もう嫌だ……
　みんなが私を追いかけてくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why...?
Why is everyone coming after me?)

fields.EN:
(There's no one here as kind
as Ningyohime...)
fields.JP:
（ここには……人魚姫みたいに
　優しい人間がいない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no one here as kind
as Little Mermaid...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづう……おぎで……
ぎぎ……ねぇ……おぎで……

fields.EN:
Hrm... What's the matter, Jack?
It's still early...
fields.JP:
ん……どうしたんだジャック……
まだ起きる時間じゃないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hrm... What's the matter, Jack?
It's still early...

fields.EN:
Shoot! I need to hurry!
Who knows what they'll say to
me if I'm late!
fields.JP:
ヤバい、早くしないと遅刻する！
遅れたらみんなに何て言われるか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! I need to hurry!
Who knows what they'll say to
me if I'm late!

fields.EN:
Thanks, Jack!
If you didn't wake me up,
I would've been late for sure!
fields.JP:
助かったよジャック、
起こしてくれなかったらもっとヤバかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Jack!
If you didn't wake me up,
I would've been late for sure!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
どう……いだじまじで……おづう……

fields.EN:
I need to get myself wrapped...
Seriously, thank you, Jack.
fields.JP:
早くサラシ巻かないと……
ほんと、ありがとうなジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to get myself wrapped...
Seriously, thank you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Good morning, Hameln...
Uh, why are you standing on
the chair again?
fields.JP:
おはようハーメルン、って……
また椅子の上に立ってどうした？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Hameln...
Uh, why are you standing on
the chair again?

fields.EN:
Sounds like she has a super
announcement. What a show-off,
right?
fields.JP:
大発表とやらがあるんだとよ。
ったく、すぐに調子に乗りやがる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like she has a super
announcement. What a show-off,
right?

fields.EN:
Oh? Is that how you treat someone
with important information to
share?
fields.JP:
お、いいのか貴様そんな態度を取って。
せっかくワレが有力な情報を授けて
やろうというのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Is that how you treat someone
with important information to
share?

fields.EN:
Yeah, especially when you're
itching to give that information.
fields.JP:
喋りたくてさっきから
ウズウズしてんじゃねーか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, especially when you're
itching to give that information.

fields.EN: Fine, Mamoru! Then I won't tell you!
fields.JP: ではマモル、貴様には教えてやりゃにゅ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine! I won't share the
information with you, Mamyoru!

fields.JP: あーやっぱこの流れ落ち着くわー

fields.EN:
Don't say it like I do this
all the time!
fields.JP: 定番みたいに言うでないわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't say it like I do this
all the time!

fields.JP:
ねージャックー
ちょっとうでだしてー
ナイトメア・ジャック

らぶ……づぇる……
んぎぎ……ご、ごう……？

ありがとー！
わーおちるー！　のぼらないとー！

fields.EN:
Looks like she's having fun
fooling around with Jack.
fields.JP:
こっちはこっちで
ぶら下がって遊んでやがるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's having fun
fooling around with Jack.

fields.EN: Best of friends already, I see.
fields.JP: ジャックとはすっかり仲良しだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Best of friends already, I see.

fields.EN:
Excuse me, but can you tell us
what you want to share?
fields.JP:
で、早く話してくれないかしら。
話が進まないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, but can you tell us
what you want to share?

fields.EN:
She's right.
Hameln, do you mind telling us
what you want to share?
fields.JP:
そうだな。ハーメルン、
そろそろ教えてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right.
Hameln, do you mind telling us
what you want to share?

fields.EN:
Please tell us!
Oh great lord Hameln-sama!
fields.JP: 教えて下さいハーメルンさまっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please tell us!
Oh great lord Hameln!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさま => Hameln-sama

fields.EN:
Oho! So you all want to know,
do you? I knew you all would!
fields.JP:
おお聞きたいか！？
そうだろう、そうだろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! So you all want to know,
do you? I knew you all would!

fields.EN:
Well, my familiar brought me new
information! This time, it's about
an area filled with dead Marchens!
fields.JP:
実はワレの使い魔がまた情報を
仕入れてきたのだ。今度はメルヒェンの
死体が大量にあるエリアという話なのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, my familiar brought me new
information! This time, it's about
an area filled with dead Marchens!

fields.JP: メルヒェンの死体が……たくさん？

fields.EN:
There have been battles all
around the Jail, and it's normal
to see dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
うむ、ここ最近はジェイルのいたるところで
大規模な争いが起きているようでな、
メルヒェンの死体は、まあ珍しくはない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There have been battles all
around the Jail, and it's normal
to see dead Marchens.

fields.EN:
So, this particular area has more
dead bodies than elsewhere?
fields.JP:
だけどそのエリアは他に比べても
尋常じゃない数の死体があると……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this particular area has more
dead bodies than elsewhere?

fields.EN:
Precisely, Otsuu!
Odd, don't you think?
fields.JP:
そういうことだ、おつう。
これは何かあると思わぬか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Precisely, Otsuu!
Odd, don't you think?

fields.JP: そうだね……確かに気になるな

fields.EN:
Normal humans aren't able to kill
Marchens so easily.
fields.JP:
そもそも普通の人間は、
メルヒェンを簡単には殺せない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normal humans aren't able to kill
Marchens so easily.

fields.EN: That's why I think it's worth investigating what caused all those dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
だから大量のメルヒェンの死体の原因は、
探る価値があると思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that there's good
reason to check that area out.

fields.EN:
You're not going to say that
there's a high likelihood of
finding a Blood Maiden?
fields.JP:
血式少女の可能性が高い、
とは言わないのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not going to say that
there's a high likelihood of
finding a Blood Maiden?

fields.EN:
It could also be that mysterious
Nightmare, so I can't assume
that's so.
fields.JP:
謎のナイトメアの可能性もあるからね。
断定はできないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could also be that mysterious
Nightmare, so I can't assume
that's so.

fields.EN:
Well, we don't know who may
be the cause of the deaths, but...
fields.JP:
そいつのせいかどうかは
分からないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we don't know who may
be the cause of the deaths, but...

fields.EN:
I do feel like something is direly
wrong throughout the Jail since
we lost Dawn...
fields.JP:
黎明がなくなってから、ジェイル全体に
異質な何かが蠢いているような、
そんな不気味な感覚がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do feel like something is direly
wrong throughout the Jail since
we lost Dawn...

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right. I don't
know what Dawn was like, but I
can sense something is different.
fields.JP:
そうね、黎明は知らないけど、
以前に比べたら空気感が変わったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right. I don't
know what Dawn was like, but I
can sense something is different.

fields.EN:
It's almost as if there's a giant
bug crawling behind a thin wall.
A bit unnerving, yes?
fields.JP:
壁の１枚向こうを巨大な芋虫が
這いずり回ってるような……
そんな不快な空気よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's almost as if there's a giant
bug crawling behind a thin wall.
A bit unnerving, yes?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel don't like the feel
now, too.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもさいきん
なんかいやーなかんじしてたよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel don't like the feel
now, too.

fields.EN:
If all the Blood Maidens here are
sensing the same thing, then it
must mean something is happening.
fields.JP:
それぞれ別の場所で暮らしていた血式少女が
みんな同じことを言うってことは……
きっと正しいんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If all the Blood Maidens here are
sensing the same thing, then it
must mean something is happening.

fields.EN:
I guess it means that we need
to be even more careful than
before.
fields.JP:
じゃあ今まで以上に警戒して
探索に当たった方がいいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it means that we need
to be even more careful than
before.

fields.EN:
Yes, so be sure not to let your
guard down.
fields.JP: そうだな。油断しないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so be sure not to let your
guard down.

fields.EN:
Okay, let's head out to that area
with the dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
じゃあそのメルヒェンの死体が
大量にあるエリアに行ってみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's head out to that area
with the dead Marchens.

fields.EN:
I think it's plausible that the
deaths were caused by Blood
Maidens.
fields.JP:
人間の仕業、とりわけ血式少女の
可能性が高そうだものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's plausible that the
deaths were caused by Blood
Maidens.

fields.EN:
Don't forget about that
mysterious Nightmare.
Be very careful out there.
fields.JP:
さっきも言ったが、
謎のナイトメアの可能性もある。
充分に気をつけてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't forget about that
mysterious Nightmare.
Be very careful out there.

fields.EN: So, Haa-chan, which area is this?
fields.JP:
それでハーちゃん、
今度はどこのエリアなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, Hammy, which area is this?

fields.EN:
All right. All the Blood Maidens
and Jack will head there.
fields.JP:
じゃあ血式少女全員、
それとジャックで準備して向かおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right. All the Blood Maidens
and Jack will head there.

fields.JP: みんな、本当に気をつけてね……？

fields.EN:
Don't worry.
We'll be back soon enough.
fields.JP:
すぐに戻るから、
心配しないで待っていてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry.
We'll be back soon enough.

fields.EN:
So, this is the Temple area...
Quite the difference in
environment.
fields.JP:
ここが旧寺院エリアね……
なるほど、随分と雰囲気が変わるものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this is the Temple area...
Quite the difference in
environment.

fields.JP: え、そうかなラプちゃん……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
きゃははっ……
はははははーーーっ！！

fields.EN:
It sounds like someone
is in battle.
fields.JP: 誰かが戦ってるようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounds like someone
is in battle.

fields.EN:
The roars I'm hearing are
pretty ferocious...
fields.LOCALIZED:
The roars I'm hearing are
pretty ferocious...

fields.EN:
It could be that mysterious
Nightmare... Let's keep our
guards up.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの時のように、
あの謎のナイトメアの可能性もある。
警戒しながら行こう、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could be that mysterious
Nightmare... Let's keep our
guards up.

fields.EN:
Look at all these
dead Marchens...
fields.JP:
メルヒェンの死体の数、
だんだん増えてきてるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all these
dead Marchens...

fields.EN:
I guess it means that we're
getting close to the cause of
their deaths.
fields.JP: 元凶に近づいているってことだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it means that we're
getting close to the cause of
their deaths.

fields.JP: あっ、あそこ、だれかいる！

fields.EN: That's quite a battle going on.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと激しい戦いを
繰り広げているな
fields.LOCALIZED: That's quite a battle going on.

fields.EN:
I think it's safe to assume that
whoever is fighting is the cause
of all these dead Marchens.
fields.JP:
どうやら今戦っている者が
ここまでのメルヒェンの死体を
築き上げたようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's safe to assume that
whoever is fighting is the cause
of all these dead Marchens.

fields.EN: Who in the world could it be?
fields.LOCALIZED: Who in the world could it be?

fields.JP: きゃはっ！　きゃははははっ！！
こんな場所にいたのか……！
なんだ、知っておるのか？

fields.EN:
That's Kaguyahime...
A member of Dawn's
Blood Maidens!
fields.JP:
あいつはかぐや姫……
黎明の血式少女隊で一緒だった仲間だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Kaguya...
A member of Dawn's
Blood Maidens!

fields.EN:
I see. So I guess we can finally
meet someone you used to know.
fields.JP:
そうか、ついに貴様らの昔の
仲間に会えたのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So I guess we can finally
meet someone you used to know.

fields.EN:
Yes, but...
I can't be too happy just yet...
fields.JP:
ああ……
でも手放しでは喜べないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but...
I can't be too happy just yet...

fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん！
わたしです、人魚姫です！
きゃーーーーっはぁっ！

fields.EN:
It's no use...!
Kaguya is in Blood Skelter!
fields.JP:
駄目、声届かない……かぐやちゃん、
ブラッドスケルター化してる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use...!
Kaguya is in Blood Skelter!

fields.EN:
I see that the reports I read are
quite accurate... I believe it
also said that it can't be cured.
fields.JP:
資料で読んだとおりね。
確か、現状治せないと書いてなかったかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see that the reports I read are
quite accurate... I believe it
also said that it can't be cured.

fields.EN:
Not quite. She should return
to normal with Jack's blood.
fields.JP:
いや、ジャックの血を浴びせれば
元に戻るはずなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not quite. She should return
to normal with Jack's blood.

fields.EN:
Yes, that's how I was saved
the last time, too.
fields.JP:
はい。以前のわたしが
それで助かりましたから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, that's how I was saved
the last time, too.

fields.EN:
Well then, let's get this
over with.
fields.JP: じゃあさっさとやってしまいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, let's get this
over with.

fields.EN:
Easier said than done. It took
a lot from me to even stop Ningyohime back then.
fields.JP:
そうは言っても、なかなかに難しいのだ。
なんせ以前こうなった人魚姫は、
ワレでも大変だったぐらいだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Easier said than done. It took
a lot from me to even stop Little
Mermaid back then.

fields.EN:
That girl! Coming here!
Grr! Grrrrr!
fields.JP:
あのにんげん、こっちくる！
うぅーー！　うぅぅーーーーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That girl! Coming here!
Grr! Grrrrr!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン！
２人で止めるぞ！
了解なのだ！　貴様らは下がっておれ！

きゃはははははっ！
はっはぁーーーーっ！

fields.EN:
(Way to remind me of how
powerful Blood Skelter is...)
fields.JP:
（ブラッドスケルター化……
　やはりすごい力だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Way to remind me of how
powerful Blood Skelter is...)

fields.EN:
(Kaguya isn't a close range
fighter, but her blows are
still amazingly powerful...)
fields.JP:
（近距離戦が苦手なかぐやでも、
　一撃が重い……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya isn't a close range
fighter, but her blows are
still amazingly powerful...)

fields.EN:
Say, Kaguya? I know you put
a lot of effort into things, but
how about going easy on us?
fields.JP:
なあかぐや……頑張り屋の君も
こんな時くらい手を抜いてはどうかな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Kaguya? I know you put
a lot of effort into things, but
how about going easy on us?

fields.EN:
Kaguya! It's me, Ningyohime!
Please, get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん！
お願い思い出して、人魚姫です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya! It's me, Little Mermaid!
Please, get a hold of yourself!

fields.EN:
It's no use...!
Our words aren't reaching her!
fields.JP: 駄目か……やっぱり声は届かないか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use...!
Our words aren't reaching her!

fields.EN:
What now? Do you want me to
find an opening so that I can
use Jack's blood?
fields.JP:
で、どうする気？　隙を見て
ジャックの血をかければいいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What now? Do you want me to
find an opening so that I can
use Jack's blood?

fields.EN:
No... It's going to be difficult
to try and splatter Jack's blood
on her like this...
fields.JP:
いや、この状態だと
避けられてしまう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... It's going to be difficult
to try and splatter Jack's blood
on her like this...

fields.EN:
Jack does have a limit to how much
blood he can spare. I'd rather
pacify her before using his blood.
fields.JP:
ジャックの血も無限じゃない。
何とかしておとなしくさせた上で
血をかけたいところだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack does have a limit to how much
blood he can spare. I'd rather
pacify her before using his blood.

fields.JP: くっ、すばしっこい奴め！
きゃはははっ！　っきゃはぁっ！！

fields.EN:
I don't want to harm Kaguya...
But at this rate...
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんを傷つけたくはない……
でもこのままじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to harm Kaguya...
But at this rate...

fields.EN:
Princess, it can't be helped...
We need to prepare for the
worst...
fields.JP: 姫、仕方ない。覚悟を決めよう――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, it can't be helped...
We need to prepare for the
worst...

fields.EN:
The worst is that we stop her
without killing her!
fields.JP:
絶対にかぐやを殺さずに
無力化する覚悟を！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The worst is that we stop her
without killing her!

fields.EN:
Kaguya! Sorry, but we may have to
bruise you a bit! Here we go!
fields.JP:
かぐや！　多少の傷は勘弁してくれ！
じゃあ行くぞっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya! Sorry, but we may have to
bruise you a bit! Here we go!

fields.EN: We got her down for a bit...
fields.JP: 何とか、かぐやを無力化できたな……
fields.LOCALIZED: We got her down for a bit...

fields.EN:
We didn't harm her too bad.
I doubt she'll die or anything.
fields.JP:
深手は負わせていないはずよ。
命に別状はないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't harm her too bad.
I doubt she'll die or anything.

fields.EN:
Fighting without using your
full force is amazingly tiring...
fields.JP: 手を抜いて戦うのも疲れるものなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting without using your
full force is amazingly tiring...

fields.EN:
All right, let's splash her with
Jack's blood while we still can!
fields.JP:
よし、今のうちに
ジャックの血をかけるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's splash her with
Jack's blood while we still can!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Jack-san...
We'll borrow a bit of your blood
again...
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、ごめんなさい……
少し血をお借りしますね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Jack...
We'll borrow a bit of your blood
again...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

い……いよ……
づづづ……かって……

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, I'm going to pour Jack-san's
blood on Kaguya, so please hold
her down!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
ジャックさんの血をかけるから、
かぐやちゃんを押さえておいて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I'm going to pour Jack's
blood on Kaguya, so please hold
her down!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
You got it!
Leave it to me, Princess!
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it!
Leave it to me, Princess!

fields.JP:
あぁぁっ……！
うがぁぁぁぁぁっ……！！
おとなしくするんだ、かぐや！

fields.EN:
Please... Come back to us...
Kaguya...!
fields.JP:
これで戻ってきて……
かぐやちゃん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please... Come back to us...
Kaguya...!

fields.EN: Get a hold of yourself, Kaguya!
fields.JP: そうだ、戻ってこいかぐや！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Get a hold of yourself, Kaguya!

fields.JP:
おつう、さん……？
人魚、姫……さん……？

fields.EN: I'm so glad you're back, Kaguya!
fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、無事でよかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so glad you're back, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
It seems Jack's blood can revert
the Blood Skelter state even when
it has been a while...
fields.JP:
長いことブラッドスケルター化しても
ジャックの血で元に戻るのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems Jack's blood can revert
the Blood Skelter state even when
it has been a while...

fields.EN:
I was a bit worried about that.
There was no assurance that it
could reverse a prolonged state.
fields.JP:
僕もそこが不安だったんだ。
絶対の特効薬という保証はなかったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was a bit worried about that.
There was no assurance that it
could reverse a prolonged state.

fields.JP: 元に戻ってくれて、本当によかった……

fields.EN:
I'm... fine...
I can still... fight...
fields.JP:
大丈夫……わらわは……
まだやれる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... fine...
I can still... fight...

fields.EN:
Please... Please...
Let me stay here... please...
fields.JP:
だから……お願い……
……ここに……いさせて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please... Please...
Let me stay here... please...

fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん！？
ねえ目を開けてっ！！

fields.EN:
It's okay, Princess.
She just lost consciousness.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ、姫。
かぐやは気を失っただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay, Princess.
She just lost consciousness.

fields.EN: Oh, I see... What a relief...
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see... What a relief...

fields.EN:
Still, it doesn't mean she's fine.
We should head back right away.
fields.JP:
でもかぐやが危ない状態には違いない。
みんな、１度拠点に戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, it doesn't mean she's fine.
We should head back right away.

fields.EN:
You're right.
It's dangerous to carry her
around here like this.
fields.JP:
そうだな。
このまま連れて歩くのは危険すぎるしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right.
It's dangerous to carry her
around here like this.

fields.EN:
Yup! So hungry, too!
Rapunzel wanna go home!
fields.JP:
うん、おなかすいたー！
ラプンツェルかえるー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! So hungry, too!
Rapunzel wanna go home!

fields.EN:
I agree. It makes sense to heal
her before heading out on our
expedition again.
fields.JP:
戻ってこのひとを治してからの方が、
結果的には探索も進むわね。異論ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree. It makes sense to heal
her before heading out on our
expedition again.

fields.EN:
It's settled.
Let's go back and get Kaguya
checked by Hikari.
fields.JP: よし、じゃあ戻ってヒカリに看てもらおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's settled.
Let's go back and get Kaguya
checked by Hikari.

fields.EN:
A day passes as Hikari
watches over Kaguyahime...
fields.JP: ヒカリにかぐや姫を預けた次の日……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A day passes as Hikari
watches over Kaguya...

fields.EN:
Well, it's great that you were
finally able to meet one of the
girls you used to be with!
fields.JP:
にしても昔の仲間と再会できたってのは
最高にいいニュースじゃねえか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's great that you were
finally able to meet one of the
girls you used to be with!

fields.JP: うん、ようやく再会できたよ
かぐやちゃん、大丈夫かなぁ……

fields.EN: Why don't you go and check on her?
fields.JP: 心配なら見てくればいいじゃん
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you go and check on her?

fields.EN:
I don't want to wake her up
in case she's sleeping.
fields.JP:
でももし寝ていたら
起こしてしまうかもしれませんし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to wake her up
in case she's sleeping.

fields.EN:
C'mon, you should rest a
bit more...
fields.JP: 無理しちゃ駄目だって～
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, you should rest a
bit more...

fields.EN:
Good morning, Kaguya.
Are you okay?
fields.JP:
おはようかぐや。
もう動いて大丈夫なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Kaguya.
Are you okay?

fields.EN:
No you're not.
It's only been a day.
fields.JP:
大丈夫じゃないよぉ～
まだ昨日の今日だよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No you're not.
It's only been a day.

fields.EN:
Well, I can tell you're a bit
better than yesterday, that's for
sure.
fields.JP:
まあ一晩経って、少しは
よくなったように見えるけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I can tell you're a bit
better than yesterday, that's for
sure.

fields.EN:
I'm sure sitting down to talk
is okay.
fields.JP: 少し喋るくらいはいいんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure sitting down to talk
is okay.

fields.JP: もう、しょうがないなぁ……

fields.EN:
It has been a while,
Otsuu-san, Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
……改めてお久しぶりです、
おつうさん、人魚姫さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It has been a while,
Otsuu, Little Mermaid...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
And... thank you everyone for
saving me...
fields.JP:
そしてみなさんも……
助けて下さってありがとうございます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... thank you everyone for
saving me...

fields.EN: May I ask where I am?
fields.JP:
それで、ここはいったい
どこなのでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: May I ask where I am?

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、それはね――

fields.EN:
I see... So Otsuu-san, Mamoru-san, and the
others built this new Liberated District...
fields.JP:
なるほど……それでおつうさんたちと
マモルさんたちで、新たに解放地区を
作り上げたというのですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So, this is the new
Liberated District built by
all of you here.

fields.EN:
How wonderful...
A new beacon of hope for mankind.
fields.JP:
なんて素晴らしい……
人類にはまだまだ希望がありますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How wonderful...
A new beacon of hope for mankind.

fields.EN:
Hell yeah! We're not done for yet!
It's our turn to fight and win
back what we lost!
fields.JP:
おうよ、俺たち人間は
まだまだ負けちゃいねえ。
ってかこっから大逆転だぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell yeah! We're not done for yet!
It's our turn to fight and win
back what we lost!

fields.EN: Sorry to ask while you're still recovering, Kaguya, but can you tell us what happened up to this point?
fields.JP:
それで病み上がりのところ
悪いんだけどさ、かぐや。
これまでの経緯を教えてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to ask, but do you mind
telling us what happened?

fields.EN:
I know it will pain you, but we
need as much information as
possible on what you went through.
fields.JP:
つらいかもしれないが、
黎明壊滅からの君の動向を
どうか話してくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it will pain you, but we
need as much information as
possible on what you went through.

fields.EN: On the day Dawn was annihilated... we fought a mysterious Nightmare, trying somehow to protect everyone.
fields.JP:
黎明が壊滅したあの日……
あたしたちは何とかみんなを守ろうと、
謎のナイトメアと戦いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We fought against a mysterious
Nightmare on that very day
Dawn fell...

fields.EN:
Nothing we tried could stop it.
If we kept fighting, we all would
have been killed...
fields.JP:
ですがどうしても勝てませんでした。
このままでは全員殺されてしまう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing we tried could stop it.
If we kept fighting, we all would
have been killed...

fields.EN:
It was then that Akazukin-san
gave me orders to run.
fields.JP:
そんな時でした。
赤ずきんさんがあたしに、
逃げるよう指示を出したのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was then that Red Riding Hood
gave me orders to run.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
We didn't have the luxury of
selecting a rally point.
All we could do was scatter.
fields.JP:
落ち合う場所すら決める時間はなく、
とにかくバラバラに逃げる、それだけで
あたしたちは精一杯でした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't have the luxury of
selecting a rally point.
All we could do was scatter.

fields.EN:
I ran, and ran, and ran...
I ran as far as I could...
fields.JP:
あたしは逃げて……
逃げて逃げて、とにかく逃げて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I ran, and ran, and ran...
I ran as far as I could...

fields.EN:
I went through various areas,
but none felt safe. I was afraid
the entire time, and by then...
fields.JP:
色々な独房エリアに行きました。
でもどこにも安らげる場所はなく……
不安で不安で、気づいたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I went through various areas,
but none felt safe. I was afraid
the entire time, and by then...

fields.JP: ブラッドスケルター化してた、か

fields.EN:
I see...
I'm sorry to have made you recall
all that.
fields.JP:
なるほど……
つらい話をさせてすまないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I'm sorry to have made you recall
all that.

fields.EN:
It's okay. You all saved my life.
Talking about what happened
is the least I can do.
fields.JP:
いいえ。こうやって
助け出してくださったんです、
お話くらい、いくらでも構いません
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay. You all saved my life.
Talking about what happened
is the least I can do.

fields.EN:
What you said brings me hope.
Now I'm sure that Akazukin
is alive out there!
fields.JP:
でもこれでさらに希望が見えた。
赤ずきんは絶対に生きてる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you said brings me hope.
Now I'm sure that Red Riding Hood
is alive out there!

fields.EN:
You're right!
I'm sure she's safe!
fields.JP: そうだね！　絶対生きてるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right!
I'm sure she's safe!

fields.EN:
Let's head on back out to the
Temple area.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあもう１度、
旧寺院エリアの探索に向かうとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's head on back out to the
Temple area.

fields.EN:
Kaguya, I'm sure you're tired,
so just stay and rest for a while...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、かぐやちゃんは疲れ果てて
いるだろうから、安静にしててもらって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, I'm sure you're tired,
so just stay and rest for a while...

fields.EN:
We should head out with the
same members.
fields.JP:
そうね、昨日と同じ
メンバーで臨みましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should head out with the
same members.

fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待って下さいみなさん！
あたしも行きますっ！

fields.EN:
What are you saying?!
You need to rest.
fields.JP:
何言ってるのかぐやちゃん！
寝てなきゃ駄目だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?!
You need to rest.

fields.EN:
S-See? I'm not hurt at all!
I will go with you no matter what!
fields.JP:
ほ、ほら怪我も疲れもありません……！
だから絶対に行きます……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-See? I'm not hurt at all!
I will go with you no matter what!

fields.JP: すっごくつらそうに見えるのは気のせい？
ぜ、ぜんぜんそんなことはないのですよ～

fields.EN:
Heh... Kaguya has always been
like this. So earnest, right?
fields.JP:
ふふ、かぐやちゃんは昔から
こんな感じで真面目なんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Kaguya has always been
like this. So earnest, right?

fields.EN:
But, there's no need for you to
force yourself right now.
fields.JP:
でもかぐやちゃん、
今は無理しなくていいんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, there's no need for you to
force yourself right now.

fields.EN:
Just leave it up to us this time,
okay?
fields.JP: 今回はわたしたちに任せて、ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just leave it up to us this time,
okay?

fields.JP: いえ……行きます、行きますよ……！

fields.EN:
(Hard to imagine that Kaguya
used to be super lazy...)
fields.JP:
（かぐやの奴、もっと昔は
　あんなにグータラだったのにな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hard to imagine that Kaguya
used to be super lazy...)

fields.EN:
(I'm not sure what happened,
but she went from lazy to serious
all of a sudden.)
fields.JP:
（何があったか知らないけど、ある日を境に
　急に真面目で積極的になったよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not sure what happened,
but she went from lazy to serious
all of a sudden.)

fields.EN:
W-Well, I slept a whole night!
Why, I've never felt better!
fields.JP:
ほ、ほら一晩ぐっすり寝ましたし！
今のあたしは絶好調ですし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I slept a whole night!
Why, I've never felt better!

fields.EN:
I'm fine, really!
I will go with all of you no
matter what you say!
fields.JP:
とにかく大丈夫です！
あたしはみなさんについていくと
決めたのです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, really!
I will go with all of you no
matter what you say!

fields.EN:
How delightful! I like your
unwavering will!
You shall come with us!
fields.JP:
気に入った！　根性があってよいぞ！
おつうよ、連れて行ってやろうではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How delightful! I like your
unwavering will!
You shall come with us!

fields.JP: かぐや……何か思い詰めてないか？

fields.EN:
I was going to mention that, too.
I sense some anxiety coming
from you.
fields.JP:
ええ、不安が見え隠れしている
気がするのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was going to mention that, too.
I sense some anxiety coming
from you.

fields.EN:
You really shouldn't push
yourself, Kaguya...
fields.JP:
本当に無理しちゃ駄目だよ、
かぐやちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really shouldn't push
yourself, Kaguya...

fields.JP: まあ……そこまで言うなら……

fields.EN:
Good! You will follow in my
path towards dominance!
fields.JP:
よし！　ではワレとともに
覇道を突き進むぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! You will follow in my
path towards dominance!

fields.EN:
Uh, we have no intention of
attaining dominance...
fields.JP:
いや、覇道とか
突き進むつもりはないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, we have no intention of
attaining dominance...

fields.EN:
Everyone, hold it right there.
Marchens...
fields.JP:
みんな、ストップ。
……メルヒェンの群れだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, hold it right there.
Marchens...

fields.EN:
(Hm...
Kaguya isn't at her best yet...)
fields.JP: （かぐやはまだ本調子じゃないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm...
Kaguya isn't at her best yet...)

fields.EN:
Let's see...
How about we find another
way through?
fields.JP: どうする？　迂回する？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see...
How about we find another
way through?

fields.EN:
I believe it's simpler to just
get through them by force.
fields.JP:
あのくらい、突破してしまえば
いいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe it's simpler to just
get through them by force.

fields.JP: メルヒェンやっつけるー！

fields.EN:
You're getting me worried, but
if everyone is okay with that...
fields.JP:
……心配だけど、
みんなが大丈夫と言うなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're getting me worried, but
if everyone is okay with that...

fields.EN:
That was a lot easier
than I thought.
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a lot easier
than I thought.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
They didn't stand a chance!
fields.JP:
あのくらいの敵、
余裕すぎるくらいだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
They didn't stand a chance!

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、うごきたりない！

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you're forcing yourself,
aren't you?
fields.JP: かぐや、やっぱり無理してるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you're forcing yourself,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
N-Not at all...
I'm totally fine...
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことないです。
あたしは全然平気ですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Not at all...
I'm totally fine...

fields.JP:
そうは言っても、
どう見てもつらそうだし……

fields.EN:
I just did a bit too much there.
I'll get my fighting sense back
right away.
fields.JP:
ちょっと勢い余って
激しい攻撃を繰り出してしまっただけです。
すぐに感覚取り戻しますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just did a bit too much there.
I'll get my fighting sense back
right away.

fields.EN:
If you aren't at your best,
then you should go back.
We don't want you to burden us.
fields.JP:
調子悪いなら足手まといだから、
戻って休んでた方がいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you aren't at your best,
then you should go back.
We don't want you to burden us.

fields.EN:
True... You may have the will to
move forward, but being useless
won't help us. Go and rest!
fields.JP:
そうだな、根性あっても
役立たずだったら意味はないしな！
今は休むがよいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... You may have the will to
move forward, but being useless
won't help us. Go and rest!

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine! I may not look it,
but I haven't felt this good
before!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫です！　みなさんには
本調子に見えないかもしれませんが、
実はあたし絶好調なんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine! I may not look it,
but I haven't felt this good
before!

fields.EN:
So please, you can count
on me...!
fields.JP:
ですからこの先、
おおいに期待して下さいね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, you can count
on me...!

fields.JP: ねえ姫、やっぱりかぐやの奴……
うん、やっぱり何か隠してるよね……
（かぐやが疲労してるのは明白だ……）
（でも、どうしてそれを隠すんだ……？）

fields.EN:
Now, let's get going!
I'm going ahead of you all!
fields.JP:
さあ行きましょう！
ほら、あたし先行っちゃいますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, let's get going!
I'm going ahead of you all!

fields.EN:
She seems fine for now,
so I suppose we can respect
her want to move forward.
fields.JP:
まあ今のところ大丈夫だし、
ここは本人の意思を尊重しようか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She seems fine for now,
so I suppose we can respect
her want to move forward.

fields.EN:
I suppose...
Well, I'll keep an eye on
Kaguya, just in case.
fields.JP:
仕方ないね……じゃあわたし、
かぐやちゃんのことしっかり見ておくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose...
Well, I'll keep an eye on
Kaguya, just in case.

fields.JP: またメルヒェンの群れだわ
まったく、わんさか沸くのだな

fields.EN:
Let's make our way through
by getting rid of them.
fields.JP:
迂回なんて言わずに、
さくっと倒してしまいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's make our way through
by getting rid of them.

fields.EN:
Are you sure you're fine
with that, Kaguyahime?
fields.JP: かぐや姫はそれでいいのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you're fine
with that, Kaguya?

fields.EN:
W-Why of course!
Now, let's get going...
fields.JP:
も、もちろんです！
さあ蹴散らしましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Why of course!
Now, let's get going...

fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん……
やっぱり何かおかしい……

fields.EN:
She's hiding something all right.
Hopefully nothing bad will come
from it...
fields.JP:
ああ、何か隠してる。
変なことにならなければいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's hiding something all right.
Hopefully nothing bad will come
from it...

fields.JP: よし貴様ら、ワレに続くのだ！

fields.EN:
Fine...
Let's just get rid of them!
fields.JP: 仕方ない、とりあえず倒そう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
Let's just get rid of them!

fields.JP: 今回もワレの敵ではなかったな！！
かぐや、やっぱりこれ以上は……

fields.EN:
What are you saying?
I'm... absolutely... fine...
fields.JP:
何を言ってるんですか……
あたしは全然……平気ですって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying?
I'm... absolutely... fine...

fields.JP: もういいよ、かぐやちゃん！

fields.EN:
It's obvious that you're pushing
yourself too hard. Any further
and things will go for the worse!
fields.JP:
どう見てもかぐやちゃん、無理してる。
これ以上戦ったら、危ないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's obvious that you're pushing
yourself too hard. Any further
and things will go for the worse!

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you're worried
about me, but... I'm...
I'm really fine... Really...
fields.JP:
心配してくれるのはっ……嬉しいですが……
あたしは……本当に大……丈夫です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you're worried
about me, but... I'm...
I'm really fine... Really...

fields.EN:
I'm happy that you're trying
to do your best for us, but...
fields.JP:
わたしたちを気づかって
無理してくれてるのは嬉しいよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy that you're trying
to do your best for us, but...

fields.EN:
It's going to hurt all of us
if you get sick or injured...
fields.JP:
でもかぐやちゃんが疲労で倒れたり、
動きが鈍って怪我でもしたら……
その方が嫌だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's going to hurt all of us
if you get sick or injured...

fields.EN:
We can move on without you,
so please go back and rest.
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん抜きでも、わたしたち
頑張るから。だから戻って休んで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can move on without you,
so please go back and rest.

fields.JP:
えっ……？
ど、どうしたのかぐやちゃん……？

fields.EN:
You're planning on getting
rid of me, aren't you?!
fields.JP:
そうやってわらわだけ、
捨てるつもりなんでしょう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're planning on getting
rid of me, aren't you?!

fields.EN:
(She sounds like she's back
to normal now...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sounds like she's back
to normal now...)

fields.EN:
Getting rid...?
Absolutely not.
Why would we...?
fields.JP:
捨てる、って……
そんなつもりないよ……
どうしてそんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting rid...?
Absolutely not.
Why would we...?

fields.EN: You all get to keep pushing forward! Meanwhile, you'll make me a subject of creepy experiments, call me useless, and send me back to the herd!
fields.JP:
あなたたちだけそうやって頑張って！
わらわは不気味な実験の被験体にしたり、
役立たずだ、って群れに帰すんでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You all keep pushing yourselves,
but you're going to use me as a
guinea pig and let me loose after!

fields.EN:
Wh-What are you talking about?
I was just worried that you're
pushing yourself too far...
fields.JP:
な、何を言っているの？
わたしはただ、かぐやちゃんの身体が
心配だったから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What are you talking about?
I was just worried that you're
pushing yourself too far...

fields.EN:
Stop it!
All this caring is hurting me
more than anything!
fields.JP:
きれいごとは止めて！
あなたたちのその心配が
わらわを苦しめてるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it!
All this caring is hurting me
more than anything!

fields.JP: それにどうして気づかないの！？

fields.EN:
Wait, Kaguya!
What in the world are you saying?!
fields.JP:
待て、かぐや！
君はいったい何を言ってるんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, Kaguya!
What in the world are you saying?!

fields.EN:
I'm going to be abandoned
if I don't leave results!
fields.JP:
結果を残さなければ、
わらわは捨てられてしまうのです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to be abandoned
if I don't leave results!

fields.EN:
What's going on?
Kaguya, calm down and tell us
what's on your mind.
fields.JP:
どういうことだ……？
かぐや、ちょっと順を追って
説明してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's going on?
Kaguya, calm down and tell us
what's on your mind.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but Princess and
I would like some private time
with Kaguya...
fields.JP:
……ごめん、みんな。
ちょっと僕と姫とかぐや、
３人だけで話がしたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but Princess and
I would like some private time
with Kaguya...

fields.EN:
Fine with me.
I have a feeling this is something
I shouldn't get involved in.
fields.JP:
構わないわよ。
何やら立て込んでるみたいだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine with me.
I have a feeling this is something
I shouldn't get involved in.

fields.EN:
Thank you.
We'll go over there for a moment.
fields.JP:
助かるよ。
じゃあちょっと向こうで話してくる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you.
We'll go over there for a moment.

fields.EN:
Okay, what was all that about?
You said something about being
a guinea pig and being abandoned.
fields.JP:
それで、さっきのはいったい
どういう意味なんだ？　実験体とか
捨てられるとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, what was all that about?
You said something about being
a guinea pig and being abandoned.

fields.EN:
You remember how Cinderella-san
and the sisters went missing?
fields.JP:
昔、シンデレラさんがいなくなって、
そして後を追うように三姉妹が
いなくなったでしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember how Cinderella
and the sisters went missing?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
That's what made me act like
I was all serious and earnest.
fields.JP:
そのせいでわらわは、こんな風に
頑張り屋のキャラを作らなければ
いけなくなったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what made me act like
I was all serious and earnest.

fields.EN:
If not, they would've done their
experiments on me, or would've
sent me back to where I came from.
fields.JP:
そうしないと不気味な実験を受けさせたり、
元いた里に捨てに行くぞって言われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If not, they would've done their
experiments on me, or would've
sent me back to where I came from.

fields.EN:
I needed to fake my front
as someone useful in
order to survive...
fields.JP:
だからわらわは、前向きで積極的な、
役に立ってるんだぞってキャラを見せて
何とか生きてきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I needed to fake my front
as someone useful in
order to survive...

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, that was
about the time when you
started to change...
fields.JP: その時から……だったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, that was
about the time when you
started to change...

fields.EN:
I only tried my best to survive.
If I had a choice, I wouldn't have
done all this.
fields.JP:
ええ。そうしなければ生きられないから
頑張っているだけで、本当は嫌々なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only tried my best to survive.
If I had a choice, I wouldn't have
done all this.

fields.EN:
(So, this was all faked.
Guess her general laziness was
in her all along.)
fields.JP:
（キャラを作ってただけで、
　グータラ気質は変わってなかったのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, this was all faked.
Guess her general laziness was
in her all along.)

fields.EN:
(But, why bring up Cinderella
and the Oyayubihime sisters?)
fields.JP:
（でもシンデレラや親指姫たち
　三姉妹のせいって……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, why bring up Cinderella
and the Thumbelina sisters?)

fields.EN:
So please, don't sabotage
me like that.
fields.JP:
だから嫌なのに頑張ってるわらわを
蹴落とすような真似はしないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't sabotage
me like that.

fields.EN:
Of all the...!
We're not trying to sabotage
anything!
fields.JP: そんなつもりはない！　心外だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all the...!
We're not trying to sabotage
anything!

fields.EN:
But you were trying everything to
stop me from doing my best!
fields.JP:
だって現にあなたたちはわらわを
頑張らせないように仕向けてるじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you were trying everything to
stop me from doing my best!

fields.EN:
That's not true!
We were going to have you come
with us after you got better!
fields.JP:
そんなことはないよ！
具合をよくしてもらってから、一緒に
行動するつもりだったの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
We were going to have you come
with us after you got better!

fields.EN:
Sure, and I'm supposed to believe
that? You know, this is a waste of
time. I'm going on ahead.
fields.JP:
どうでしょうね？
まあこんな話をしていても疲れるだけです。
わらわは先に進むとします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, and I'm supposed to believe
that? You know, this is a waste of
time. I'm going on ahead.

fields.EN:
Hey, wait! Kaguya!
You've got the nerve to...!
fields.JP:
おい待てかぐや！
今のはあんまりじゃないか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wait! Kaguya!
You've got the nerve to...!

fields.EN:
Don't let her bother you.
You did nothing wrong.
fields.JP:
あまり気にしちゃ駄目だからね。
姫は何も悪くないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't let her bother you.
You did nothing wrong.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Still, it is true that I hurt
Kaguya...
fields.JP:
でも、わたしがかぐやちゃんを
傷つけていたのは事実だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, it is true that I hurt
Kaguya...

fields.EN:
I guess you can hurt people without meaning
to, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
思いもよらないことで人を傷つけてしまう、
なんてことがあるんだね、おつうちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess good intentions don't
always mean they're good for
others...

fields.EN:
(What was thought to be helpful
turned out to be hurting Kaguya...)
fields.JP:
（良かれと思ってやったことが、
　かぐやを傷つけていた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What was thought to be helpful
turned out to be hurting Kaguya...)

fields.EN:
(Good intentions don't
always mean they're good...)
fields.JP: （たとえそんなつもりはなくても……か）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good intentions don't
always mean they're good...)

fields.JP: 行っちゃったわね、かぐや姫

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Maybe there was
something behind the scenes at
Dawn that you're not aware of...
fields.JP:
ふふふ、黎明では何か、
あなたたちが知らない事柄が
動いていたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Maybe there was
something behind the scenes at
Dawn that you're not aware of...

fields.EN:
(There are a lot of things
I don't know about...)
fields.JP:
（確かに僕の知らないこと、
　いっぱいある……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There are a lot of things
I don't know about...)

fields.EN: What the hell is going on...?
fields.JP: いったい何だっていうんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: What the hell is going on...?

fields.JP:
おおっ！
やっと核に辿り着いたな！

fields.EN:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
here!
fields.JP:
これでこのエリアのナイトメアも
倒せるようになるな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we can defeat the Nightmare
here!

fields.EN:
I see... So destroying that will
make it possible for us to
kill the Nightmare...
fields.JP:
なるほど……この核とやらを破壊すれば、
ナイトメアを倒せるのですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So destroying that will
make it possible for us to
kill the Nightmare...

fields.EN:
There must be a guardian
around here. Be careful.
fields.JP:
きっと番人がいるはずだ。
みんな気をつけて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There must be a guardian
around here. Be careful.

fields.EN:
All we need to do is to defeat
that Marchen? If so, leave this
to me!
fields.JP:
あのメルヒェンを倒せばいいのですね？
ならばわらわにお任せ下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we need to do is to defeat
that Marchen? If so, leave this
to me!

fields.EN:
Kaguya! Don't face it alone!
There's no telling what it
can do!
fields.JP:
かぐや！　１人で突っ込むな！
何があるか分からないんだぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya! Don't face it alone!
There's no telling what it
can do!

fields.EN:
You're only saying that so
that I'd back off!
fields.JP:
そんなこと言って、
またわらわに何もさせない気なんでしょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're only saying that so
that I'd back off!

fields.JP:
むこうからも
もういっぴきでたーーーー！

fields.EN:
I need to show results!
I need to take care of it on
my own!
fields.JP:
わらわも成果を上げるのです……！
これは誰にも譲りません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to show results!
I need to take care of it on
my own!

fields.EN:
Kaguya isn't aware of the other
one there!
fields.JP: かぐやの奴め、気づいておらぬ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya isn't aware of the other
one there!

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん！　後ろっ！！

fields.EN:
Otsuu!
You shielded me from it?!
fields.JP:
おつう！？
あなた、わらわをかばって……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu!
You shielded me from it?!

fields.EN:
Hah, this is nothing...
Thank goodness you're safe...
fields.JP:
こんなのたいしたことないさ……
それより君が無事ならよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hah, this is nothing...
Thank goodness you're safe...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Hey, Otsuu! Are you all right?!
fields.JP: おいおつう！　大丈夫か！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Otsuu! Are you all right?!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづ……おづ、う……
ぎぎぎ……だだ、だいじょ……

心配してくれてありがとうジャック。
僕は大丈夫だよ……

fields.EN:
Why...?
Why would you put yourself
in harm's way?
fields.JP:
どうして……？
動けなくなったら困るのは
おつうでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...?
Why would you put yourself
in harm's way?

fields.EN:
I have no clue what's making you
so jittery, but...
fields.JP:
かぐや……君が何を恐れているのか、
それは分からないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no clue what's making you
so jittery, but...

fields.EN:
We're friends...
Of course I'll do what I can to
save you...
fields.JP:
一緒に戦う仲間なんだ、
助けるのは当たり前だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're friends...
Of course I'll do what I can to
save you...

fields.EN:
Oh, and I don't want
Ningyohime to cry, too...
fields.JP: それに人魚姫も悲しむしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I don't want
Little Mermaid to cry, too...

fields.EN:
I'm okay!
Let's... get rid of them!
fields.JP:
みんな、僕は大丈夫だ……！
一気に倒しきるぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm okay!
Let's... get rid of them!

fields.EN:
Well said, Otsuu!
Let's end this quick!
fields.JP:
よく言ったおつう！
ならばさっさと片付けるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said, Otsuu!
Let's end this quick!

fields.EN:
Yes, so that we can patch
Otsuu-chan up right away!
fields.JP:
そして早くおつうちゃんを
手当てしましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so that we can patch
Otsuu up right away!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
ぐるるるるる……！
やなやつ、たおす……！
まったく、世話が焼けるわね

fields.EN:
Concentrate on the battle
at hand, Kaguya...
fields.JP:
かぐや、とにかく今は
戦いに集中するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Concentrate on the battle
at hand, Kaguya...

fields.EN:
Oh, and by the way...
You owe me for this!
fields.JP: そしてこれは貸しだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and by the way...
