Considering that state of mind,
I wouldn't be surprised if that
one went missing.
fields.JP:
それだと失踪しても
おかしくない……であろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering that state of mind,
I wouldn't be surprised if that
one went missing.

fields.JP: うん、それが最も納得がいくな……

fields.EN:
Wait, isn't it possible that
Cinderella-san went into Blood
Skelter...
fields.JP:
シンデレラさんが
ブラッドスケルター化して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, isn't it possible that
Cinderella went into Blood
Skelter...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Then returned a month later
to strike?
fields.JP:
それで１ヶ月後に戻ってきて
襲った……ということはないのでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then returned a month later
to strike?

fields.EN:
That would negate the concept
of the killer with blue hair.
fields.JP:
それなら『青髪の少女』という
証言はおかしいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would negate the concept
of the killer with blue hair.

fields.EN:
Oh...! I see...
Blood Skelter turns the hair
to white...
fields.JP:
あっ！　そうか……
ブラッドスケルター状態では
髪は白く染まりますもんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh...! I see...
Blood Skelter turns the hair
to white...

fields.EN:
Hm, I guess the concept of
Cinderella going missing because
of Blood Skelter makes sense.
fields.JP:
でもなるほど、
ブラッドスケルター化して
失踪したっていうのはありそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I guess the concept of
Cinderella going missing because
of Blood Skelter makes sense.

fields.EN:
In any case, we still don't know
the truth behind all that
happened...
fields.JP:
とはいえ、まだ全然
謎は解けていないよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, we still don't know
the truth behind all that
happened...

fields.EN:
That's right, Princess.
Which is why we need to search
a bit more on the subject.
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね姫。僕たちは
まだまだ調査しなければいけないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Princess.
Which is why we need to search
a bit more on the subject.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi, there must be more
to Cinderella's disappearance.
fields.JP:
親指、この通りシンデレラの失踪には
まだ色々な謎が残されている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, there must be more
to Cinderella's disappearance.

fields.EN:
So please, I ask that you don't
run in like before trying to
kill her.
fields.JP:
だから、勝手に暴走して
殺すようなことなんてしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, I ask that you don't
run in like before trying to
kill her.

fields.EN:
Yes, I don't think you want to
kill someone who hasn't been
trialed either way.
fields.JP:
まだまだ白とも黒とも
断定できない状況だものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I don't think you want to
kill someone who hasn't been
trialed either way.

fields.EN:
F-Fine...
I'll hold back until we get this
all straightened out...
fields.JP:
わ……分かったわよ……ちゃんと
真実が分かるまでは控えるわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine...
I'll hold back until we get this
all straightened out...

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go and look
for Cinderella.
fields.JP:
それじゃあみんな、
シンデレラの捜索を再開しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go and look
for Cinderella.

fields.EN:
What... What's going on...?
What am I doing...?
fields.JP:
分からない……なにも……
わたし、もうどうしていいか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What... What's going on...?
What am I doing...?

fields.JP: よかった、やっと見つけた……！
ここって……核の部屋ですか？

fields.EN:
Perfect! We may as well destroy it
while we still can!
fields.JP:
おお、これはちょうどいいな！
核も砕いてしまおうぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect! We may as well destroy it
while we still can!

fields.EN:
We can do that later.
First we need to get Cinderella!
fields.JP: 核は後、まずはシンデレラを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can do that later.
First we need to get Cinderella!

fields.EN:
All right, let's approach her
carefully.
fields.JP: みんな、油断しないで近づこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's approach her
carefully.

fields.EN:
I can only hope she won't
attack us...
fields.JP: 襲ってこないでほしいですけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope she won't
attack us...

fields.JP: さて、どう出てくるのかしらね……
もう、いったい何なんですの……

fields.EN:
I didn't do anything...
And yet, you all pounce on me
like some animal...!
fields.JP:
わたしは何もしていませんわ……！
それなのによってたかって、どうして
ひどいことをするんですのよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't do anything...
And yet, you all pounce on me
like some animal...!

fields.EN:
I don't even...
I... I... *sob* Aaaaaah...
fields.JP:
何が何だか分からなくて、
わたし、わたし……ふぇぇぇん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't even...
I... I... *sob* Aaaaaah...

fields.EN:
What the...?
What is wrong with her?
fields.JP:
またさっきと違う……
もう、いったいどうなってるのよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?
What is wrong with her?

fields.EN:
She doesn't sound the same
as before...
fields.JP:
確かに……さっきとは
まるで別人だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't sound the same
as before...

fields.EN:
This sounds closer to what
I'd expect from Cinderella-san...
fields.JP:
これが本来のシンデレラさんの性格に
近い気はしますが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This sounds closer to what
I'd expect from Cinderella...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
What are we going to do, Otsuu?
Jump her?
fields.JP:
どうするの、おつう！
捕まえてもいいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are we going to do, Otsuu?
Jump her?

fields.EN:
Wait a second. If she's willing to
listen, then we can ease her a bit
before we...
fields.JP:
ちょっと待ってくれ。
話ができるならまずシンデレラの
緊張を解いてから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second. If she's willing to
listen, then we can ease her a bit
before we...

fields.JP:
あれー！？
こっちにもシンデレラー！

えっ……いったい
どういうことなんですの……？
シンデレラさんが……もう１人……！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Huh?!
What the heck is really going on?!
fields.JP:
はぁっ！？
意味が分からないっての！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?!
What the heck is really going on?!

fields.EN:
This is... way beyond what
I would've expected to happen.
fields.JP:
さすがにこれは……
わらわの予想を遙かに超えてきました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is... way beyond what
I would've expected to happen.

fields.JP:
どうしてわたしが
もう１人いるんですの……？

fields.EN:
So that means...
You were copying me...
fields.JP:
もしかして、あなたが
わたしの真似をして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means...
You were copying me...

fields.EN:
That's why I was going through
all of this...
fields.JP:
わたしがつらい目にあわされたのは、
つまりそういうことだったんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was going through
all of this...

fields.JP:
こんなの、あんまりですわ……！
ふぇぇぇぇん……！！

fields.EN:
W-Wait a moment!
I'm the real Cinderella!
fields.JP:
ち、ちがいますわ……！
わたしが本物ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait a moment!
I'm the real Cinderella!

fields.EN:
I-I can't believe you wouldn't
trust me... *sob*
fields.JP: どうして、信じて……うっ、ひぐ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I can't believe you wouldn't
trust me... *sob*

fields.JP: いったいどうなっておるのだー！！

fields.EN:
Wh-Which one is real?!
What should we do, Otsuu-chan?!
fields.JP:
ど、どっちが本物！？
ねえどうしようおつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Which one is real?!
What should we do, Otsuu?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
No need to worry, Princess.
I have a plan.
fields.JP:
心配しないで大丈夫だよ、姫。
僕に考えがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to worry, Princess.
I have a plan.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Cinderella always had her
glass slipper charm with her
at all times...
fields.JP:
シンデレラはいつも
ガラスの靴のペンダントを
大事に身につけている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella always had her
glass slipper charm with her
at all times...

fields.EN:
It's a one-of-a-kind with
none other like it in the world.
fields.JP:
それは一点物で、
世界に１つだけのものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a one-of-a-kind with
none other like it in the world.

fields.EN:
Which means that the real
Cinderella should have that
with her!
fields.JP:
だから本物はガラスの靴の
ペンダントを持っている方だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that the real
Cinderella should have that
with her!

fields.EN:
W-Well, if that's the case,
I have it with me... like so!
fields.JP:
そっ、それでしたらわたし持ってますわ！
ほらっ、これでしてよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if that's the case,
I have it with me... like so!

fields.EN:
What about you?
Show me your pendant.
fields.JP:
そっちの君は？
ペンダント、持っているなら出してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about you?
Show me your pendant.

fields.EN:
I-I don't have it with me...
I think I must have dropped
it along the way...
fields.JP:
ありませんわ……さっきどこかに
落としてしまったんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I don't have it with me...
I think I must have dropped
it along the way...

fields.EN:
So then the one with the pendant
here is the real...
fields.JP:
じゃあペンダントを持ってる
こっちが本物……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So then the one with the pendant
here is the real...

fields.EN:
Not quite. The one without the
pendant is the real Cinderella.
fields.JP:
……いや、逆だよ親指。
持っていない方が本物のシンデレラだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not quite. The one without the
pendant is the real Cinderella.

fields.JP: わたしを……信じてくれるんですの……？

fields.EN:
What do you mean?!
I showed you my pendant,
didn't I?!
fields.JP:
どういうことですの！？
わたしはちゃんとペンダントを
持ってるじゃないの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean?!
I showed you my pendant,
didn't I?!

fields.EN:
You did, but I actually have
the charm part with me.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、ペンダントは
僕が持っているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did, but I actually have
the charm part with me.

fields.EN:
Cinderella dropped it when
she ran off.
fields.JP:
さっきシンデレラが逃げた時
落としていったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella dropped it when
she ran off.

fields.EN:
I doubt her crying when she
tried to run was faked.
fields.JP:
泣きながら必死に逃げ出した
あれが演技だとは思えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt her crying when she
tried to run was faked.

fields.EN:
That's her plan!
Don't let her deceive you, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
それこそがニセモノの罠ですわ！
騙されちゃダメですわおつう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's her plan!
Don't let her deceive you, Otsuu!

fields.EN:
I was thinking what the world
would look like to Cinderella...
fields.JP:
……ブラッドスケルター化して
何年も彷徨っていたとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was thinking what the world
would look like to Cinderella...

fields.EN:
Especially after she roamed
for years under Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
その目には今、世界はどう
映っているんだろうって考えたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially after she roamed
for years under Blood Skelter...

fields.EN: Why, I was glad you freed me...
fields.JP:
それはもちろん、
解けてよかったって……
fields.LOCALIZED: Why, I was glad you freed me...

fields.EN: No. It definitely isn't just that. She must be suffering from the gap of those years she spent without her memories.
fields.JP:
違う。絶対それだけじゃないよ。
記憶のない数年間のギャップに、
間違いなく苦しめられるはずなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. That's not it. If anything,
she would've been suffering
from all the time she lost...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
All those around you would be
older than you without your
knowing. How horrifying is that?
fields.JP:
周りの知ってる人がみんな
知らない間に歳を取っている……
こんなに怖いことはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All those around you would be
older than you without your
knowing. How horrifying is that?

fields.EN:
Cinderella dropped her charm in
fear, and is still in fear.
Who can blame her?
fields.JP:
ペンダントを落としたシンデレラは、
さっきも今もずっと怖がっていた。
……ああ、怖いだろうさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella dropped her charm in
fear, and is still in fear.
Who can blame her?

fields.EN:
I'm sure what I imagine to be
fear isn't even close to what
she's feeling...
fields.JP:
僕の想像なんか及ばないほどに、
怖くて仕方がないだろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure what I imagine to be
fear isn't even close to what
she's feeling...

fields.EN:
Well, you're right...
I'm sure she's scared...
fields.JP:
うん……そうだよね……
怖いに決まってるよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you're right...
I'm sure she's scared...

fields.EN:
You have the whole pendant,
and aren't showing any fear...
You're the fake.
fields.JP:
だからペンダントを持っている上に
恐怖に鈍感な君こそ、ニセモノだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have the whole pendant,
and aren't showing any fear...
You're the fake.

fields.EN:
It was also quite unnatural for
you to call her by her name,
"Otsuu," without any hesitation.
fields.JP:
本当なら躊躇うはずなのに、
ついさっき『おつう』と簡単に
呼んでいたものね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was also quite unnatural for
you to call her by her name,
"Otsuu," without any hesitation.

fields.EN:
You were simply too good
mimicking her, you fake.
fields.JP: 順応が過ぎるんだよ……ニセモノ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were simply too good
mimicking her, you fake.

fields.JP: メルヒェンを呼びました！

fields.EN:
So, getting nervous now that
we saw through your identity!
fields.JP:
化けの皮を剥がされて
ずいぶんと焦っているようだな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, getting nervous now that
we saw through your identity!

fields.EN:
Huh?
She's... running towards the core?
fields.JP: え、核の方に走っていく……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?
She's... running towards the core?

fields.EN:
I don't know what she's up to,
but I won't let her get there!
fields.JP:
何をする気か知らないけど、
させないわよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what she's up to,
but I won't let her get there!

fields.JP: 危険だ！　止まれ親指！

fields.EN:
Look! All those vines are
starting to cover the fake and
the Marchen!
fields.JP:
おい！　ニセモノのシンデレラと
メルヒェンが核の蔦に絡まっていくぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look! All those vines are
starting to cover the fake and
the Marchen!

fields.EN:
It's covering them just like
what happened to Jack-san!
fields.JP:
ジャックさんの時みたいに
どんどん絡まっていく……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's covering them just like
what happened to Jack!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
The Marchen is using the power
of the core to mimic the fake
Cinderella!
fields.JP:
メルヒェンが核の力でニセモノの
シンデレラに擬態化してるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchen is using the power
of the core to mimic the fake
Cinderella!

fields.EN: Another one from behind the core?!
fields.JP: 核の後ろからさらにもう１人……！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Another one from behind the core?!

fields.JP: なかなかの悪趣味だな……！

fields.EN:
Fake Cinderellas...
I'll eliminate you all!
fields.JP:
ニセモノシンデレラ……！
１匹残らず排除してやる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fake Cinderellas...
I'll eliminate you all!

fields.EN:
(So, I guess some of the
Cinderellas we saw were mimics.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラは擬態化されて、
　数人いたってことか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, I guess some of the
Cinderellas we saw were mimics.)

fields.EN:
(Is this just a mere coincidence,
or is someone or something
behind all this?)
fields.JP:
（これはたまたまなのか？
　それとも誰かの思惑が絡んでいる？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this just a mere coincidence,
or is someone or something
behind all this?)

fields.EN:
Tsuu, I suggest you do your
pondering at another time.
fields.JP: つう、考えごとは後になさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I suggest you do your
pondering at another time.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I understand.
All right, let's get rid of those
fakes!
fields.JP:
そうだね、悪かった。
よし、ニセモノ３人全員倒すぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand.
All right, let's get rid of those
fakes!

fields.EN:
Even if they were mimics,
fighting three Cinderellas at
once was quite tiring...
fields.JP:
さすがシンデレラの擬態……
３人もいるときつかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if they were mimics,
fighting three Cinderellas at
once was quite tiring...

fields.EN: What is really going on here?
fields.JP:
どうしてこんなことに
なったんでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is really going on here?

fields.EN:
I don't want to fight anyone that
looks like my friend ever again...
fields.JP:
でももうニセモノとはいえ、
仲間の姿をした者と戦いたくないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to fight anyone that
looks like my friend ever again...

fields.EN:
Let's hold the talking a bit,
and get rid of the core.
fields.JP:
みんな、話は後にしてとりあえず
核を破壊しようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's hold the talking a bit,
and get rid of the core.

fields.EN:
I don't want the core to cause
more of those mimics again.
fields.JP:
万が一にもこれ以上
擬態化されても面倒だものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want the core to cause
more of those mimics again.

fields.EN: Very well, let me destroy it.
fields.JP: よし、ではワレが破壊しよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well, let me destroy it.

fields.EN:
That should be it for all those
fake Cinderellas...
fields.JP:
これでもうシンデレラのニセモノは
現れないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should be it for all those
fake Cinderellas...

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: 敵っ、瀕死っ、けど生きてるっ……！
くっ……防御が間に合わなっ……！

fields.EN:
Don't you lay a finger on
Oyayubihime!
fields.JP: 親指姫に何するんですのーーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you lay a finger on
Thumbelina!

fields.EN:
Good, it disappeared...
I guess that does it.
fields.JP:
よかった、消滅したし……
今度こそ大丈夫だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good, it disappeared...
I guess that does it.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime, are you okay?
You shouldn't let your guard
down... like... that...
fields.JP:
親指姫、大丈夫……？
気を抜いたらダメでしてよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, are you okay?
You shouldn't let your guard
down... like... that...

fields.EN:
Cinderella?!
Hey, get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ！？
ちょっと、しっかりしなさいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella?!
Hey, get a hold of yourself!

fields.JP: 動かさないで親指ちゃん！

fields.EN:
Thank goodness...
She just went unconscious.
fields.JP: ……大丈夫、気を失ってるだけみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness...
She just went unconscious.

fields.EN:
Are you really sure?
She's not... dead, is she?
fields.JP:
本当？　死んで……ないわよね？
絶対に大丈夫よね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you really sure?
She's not... dead, is she?

fields.EN: She's just out cold, that's all.
fields.JP: 気を失ってるだけだってば、親指ちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED: She's just out cold, that's all.

fields.JP: それなら、いいんだけど……

fields.EN: All right, now I destroy the core!
fields.JP: よし、では今度こそ破壊するぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, now I destroy the core!

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
That should prevent the mimics
from appearing again.
fields.JP:
これでもう紛らわしいニセモノが
現れることもないですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should prevent the mimics
from appearing again.

fields.EN:
Yes, I believe so.
I think we're good now.
fields.JP: そうだね。ひとまず安心、かな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I believe so.
I think we're good now.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

みん……な……ちぎぎ……
ぎぎ……よがだ……

fields.EN:
Yes, Jack, it's a good thing no
one was badly hurt.
fields.JP:
誰も大怪我しなくて
本当によかったな、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, Jack, it's a good thing no
one was badly hurt.

fields.EN:
You know, there is one thing
that's bothering me.
fields.JP: そういえば１つ疑問があるのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, there is one thing
that's bothering me.

fields.JP: どうしたんだ、ハーメルン？

fields.EN:
Why was Oyayubihime the only one
that girl seemed to have accepted
on first sight back then?
fields.JP:
どうしてそこのおなごは、親指姫だけは
最初から疑わずに信じきっていたのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why was Thumbelina the only one
that girl seemed to have accepted
on first sight back then?

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, Oyayubi-chan was
the only one she doubted.
fields.JP:
言われてみれば親指ちゃんだけは
疑われてなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, Thumby was
the only one she doubted.

fields.EN:
It's probably because we were
best of friends long ago...
fields.JP: きっと昔はとても仲良かったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably because we were
best of friends long ago...

fields.EN:
Or, maybe it's because you haven't
changed a bit since then.
fields.JP: 見た目がまるで成長していないからでは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, maybe it's because you haven't
changed a bit since then.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! You don't know what I was
like back then, Gretel!
fields.JP:
なっ……！　グレーテル、
あんたわたしの昔なんて知らないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! You don't know what I was
like back then, Gretel!

fields.EN: Comparing you with your two younger sisters, I think it's only natural to reach that conclusion, don't you?
fields.JP:
妹２人とあなたを見比べれば、
その推測に行き着くのは当然だと思うけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Comparing you with your
sisters led me to that conclusion.

fields.EN:
I see! Now I get it!
Whew, I feel better now!
fields.JP:
なるほど！　そういうことだったか！
そうかそうかー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see! Now I get it!
Whew, I feel better now!

fields.EN:
Well, I can only hope you grow,
Oyayubihime.
fields.JP: 親指姫よ、ちゃんと成長するのだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I can only hope you grow,
Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
How rude!
I am growing just fine!
fields.JP:
２人とも失礼ね！
わたしだって成長してるってのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude!
I am growing just fine!

fields.EN:
In the first place... Hameln!
You're just as small as me!
fields.JP:
ってかハーメルン、
あんただって充分ちっさいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the first place... Hameln!
You're just as small as me!

fields.JP: 小さくなんかにゃいわ！

けんかはだめって
ヒカリンがいってたー！

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? I think we should
bring Cinderella-san back with us
so she can rest.
fields.JP:
ねえ、おつうちゃん。ひとまず拠点に戻って
シンデレラさんを休ませてあげよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? I think we should
bring Cinderella back with us
so she can rest.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san; おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
You're right, Princess.
I think that's the right call.
fields.JP:
そうだね、姫。
僕もそれがいいと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right, Princess.
I think that's the right call.

fields.EN:
But, we need to stop those
two first...
fields.JP: じゃああの２人を止めたら戻ろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we need to stop those
two first...

fields.EN:
I'll take care of her,
so you all go and rest, you hear?
fields.JP:
後は任せて！
みんなもお疲れ様っ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll take care of her,
so you all go and rest, you hear?

fields.EN:
(I'll let Hikari do her work on
Cinderella. I'm sure she's in safe
hands. But...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラのことはヒカリに任せよう。
　きっと上手くケアしてくれるはずだ。
　それより気になるのは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll let Hikari do her work on
Cinderella. I'm sure she's in safe
hands. But...)

fields.JP: あ、あの……白雪、思ったんですけど……

fields.EN:
Could it be that the one who killed
onii-sama was that fake Cinderella-san...?
fields.JP:
もしかしてお兄様を殺したのは……
あのニセモノのシンデレラさんでは
ないでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe the fake Cinderella
was the one who killed
our dear brother...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san | Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN: Yeah, I was thinking that, too.
fields.JP: うん。僕もそうじゃないかって思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I was thinking that, too.

fields.EN:
Cinderella in Blood Skelter would
have caused more casualties than
just Hitsuka-san.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化したシンデレラ
だったら、きっと陽司さんだけじゃなく
周りの人たちも殺されていたと思うし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella in Blood Skelter would
have caused more casualties than
just Hitsuka.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
The fake was also quite sly,
so I doubt it would've killed
without reason.
fields.JP:
それにニセモノのシンデレラは
思いのほか狡猾な奴だった。
意味なく皆殺しはしない気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
The fake was also quite sly,
so I doubt it would've killed
without reason.

fields.EN:
I suppose you could be right,
though that's speculation
at this point.
fields.JP:
そうね。ただその可能性もゼロではないのが
もどかしいところではあるけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you could be right,
though that's speculation
at this point.

fields.EN:
Hmph! No matter.
We'll interrogate her once
she wakes up.
fields.JP:
ふん、目が覚めたら
洗いざらい聞き出すんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! No matter.
We'll interrogate her once
she wakes up.

fields.EN: Um... She will be okay, right?
fields.JP: シンデレラ、本当に大丈夫よね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... She will be okay, right?

fields.EN:
Why don't you go and see her
if you're worried?
fields.JP: 心配なら救護室行ってくればいいのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you go and see her
if you're worried?

fields.EN:
I-I'm not worried!
I just... don't want our suspect
to die and things.
fields.JP:
し、心配なんてしてないわよ！
ただ重要参考人として死なれちゃ
困るだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not worried!
I just... don't want our suspect
to die and things.

fields.EN:
F-Fine! I'll go and see her!
Satisfied?!
fields.JP:
わ、分かったわよ！
後で見舞いに行くから！
それでいいでしょ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine! I'll go and see her!
Satisfied?!

fields.EN:
That's good to hear,
isn't it, Nemu-chan?
fields.JP: よかったね、ネムちゃんっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear,
isn't it, Sleepy?

fields.EN:
So what exactly were those fake versions of
Cinderella-san, anyway?
fields.JP:
でもニセモノのシンデレラさんって、
結局何だったんでしょうね～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might I ask what those fakes
were all about?

fields.EN:
I would assume they were born
from the core that was there.
fields.JP:
おそらくあの核が原因なのは
間違いないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would assume they were born
from the core that was there.

fields.EN:
Well, it did create all those
mimics...
fields.JP: 目の前で擬態化を見せられたもんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it did create all those
mimics...

fields.EN:
I think it's safe to say that
the core must have reacted to
Cinderella to create her mimics.
fields.JP:
うん、きっと核がシンデレラに反応して
擬態を作り上げてしまったんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's safe to say that
the core must have reacted to
Cinderella to create her mimics.

fields.EN:
I also assume it did that simply
because she was closest to the
core, just like Jack.
fields.JP:
そうね。ジャックと同じで、
たまたま核の近くにいたから……
が一番しっくりくるわね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also assume it did that simply
because she was closest to the
core, just like Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……ぼぐ……ど…………
ぼな、じ……？

fields.EN:
Yes, it was just a matter of
coincidence, just like you.
fields.JP:
ジャックと同じく、きっと偶然
そうなってしまったってことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it was just a matter of
coincidence, just like you.

fields.EN:
You're making it sound like it
was a freak accident.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ運悪く事故に遭った
ということですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're making it sound like it
was a freak accident.

fields.EN: I suppose you could call it that.
fields.JP: うん、そんなところだと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose you could call it that.

fields.EN:
(So, why was Cinderella there
in the first place...?)
fields.JP:
（でも、そもそも……シンデレラはどうして
　あんな独房エリアに行ったんだ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, why was Cinderella there
in the first place...?)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if she had a reason
for being there...)
fields.JP:
（あの場所に何か用でも
　あったんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if she had a reason
for being there...)

fields.EN: I hope Cinderella-san is all right...
fields.JP: シンデレラさん、大丈夫かな……
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope Cinderella is all right...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Well, she did wake up,
so I'm sure she'll be better.
fields.JP:
まあ目覚めはしたんだ、
そのうち回復するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she did wake up,
so I'm sure she'll be better.

fields.EN:
Her condition can't be helped,
especially when considering she's
been in Blood Skelter for so long.
fields.JP:
長年ブラッドスケルター化
していたのだから、仕方ないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her condition can't be helped,
especially when considering she's
been in Blood Skelter for so long.

fields.EN:
Hikarin was scary!
Yelling to stay in bed!
fields.JP:
ヒカリンちょっとこわかったね！
ぜったいあんせーだーって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikarin was scary!
Yelling to stay in bed!

fields.EN:
Not that I want to speak with
her, but... I need her to recover
before I talk to her.
fields.JP:
早く回復してくれないと、
話が聞けないじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that I want to speak with
her, but... I need her to recover
before I talk to her.

fields.EN: Isn't there anything we can do?
fields.JP:
白雪たちに何かできることは
ないのでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Isn't there anything we can do?

fields.EN:
It's best to leave Cinderella to
Hikari.
fields.JP:
シンデレラの方は
ヒカリに任せておくしかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's best to leave Cinderella to
Hikari.

fields.EN:
Indeed. What we can do though
is to dominate this area during
her recovery!
fields.JP:
うむ、ワレらにできるのは
シンデレラが回復するまでに
ここを制圧することくらいだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. What we can do though
is to dominate this area during
her recovery!

fields.EN:
The white in the area is
starting to thicken...
fields.JP: 白い闇が濃くなってきたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The white in the area is
starting to thicken...

fields.JP:
よし、見つけた！
みんな、一気にいくぞ！
くくっ、これで丸裸も同然であるな！

fields.EN:
As long as we can destroy its
key part we'll be able to win!
fields.JP:
部位を破壊さえしてしまえば、
もうこっちのものですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we can destroy its
key part we'll be able to win!

fields.EN:
We still don't what it has up
its sleeve, so don't let your
guard down!
fields.JP:
でもまだ何があるか分からない。
最後まで気を抜かないで行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We still don't what it has up
its sleeve, so don't let your
guard down!

fields.JP: ナイトメアが消滅していく……
うむ、ワレらの完全勝利であるな！

fields.EN:
I suppose there's no reason for
us to search this prison area now.
fields.JP:
これでもう、
この独房エリアの探索は終わりだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there's no reason for
us to search this prison area now.

fields.EN:
Um... Why don't we...
go back to the base?
fields.JP:
じゃ……じゃあみんな、
１度拠点に戻らない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Why don't we...
go back to the base?

fields.EN:
You're right. Cinderella should be
a lot better now, too.
fields.JP:
そうだね。そろそろシンデレラの
容態も回復してきたかもしれないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Cinderella should be
a lot better now, too.

fields.EN:
I can only hope she is at least
feeling a bit better than before.
fields.JP:
少しでも元気になってて
くれたらいいですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope she is at least
feeling a bit better than before.

fields.JP: じゃあ一旦拠点に戻ろう、みんな！
おかえり、おつうくん！　みんな！
あっ！　シンデレラさん！！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Otsuu... Ningyohime...
And Kaguya, I assume?
fields.JP:
おつう……人魚姫……
それにかぐや……ですのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Little Mermaid...
And Kaguya, I assume?

fields.EN: Yes, I'm glad you remembered us.
fields.JP:
ああ、そうだよ。
分かってもらえて嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I'm glad you remembered us.

fields.EN:
Why shouldn't I?
It was just that you've all grown,
so it just feels weird.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと分かりますわよ。
みんな成長していたから、
最初は少し戸惑っただけですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why shouldn't I?
It was just that you've all grown,
so it just feels weird.

fields.JP: よかった、シンデレラさん……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: So you all did grow, didn't you?
fields.JP:
みんな、本当に大人になって
しまったんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED: So you all did grow, didn't you?

fields.EN:
But, I was at least able to tell
who you were right away,
Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
でも親指姫だけは、
すぐにあなただと分かりましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I was at least able to tell
who you were right away,
Thumbelina.

fields.JP: ともかく、みんなありがとう

fields.EN:
Um, I'm not sure if I should be
happy about what you said, but...
I guess that's fine.
fields.JP:
な、なんか引っかかるけど……
それで正しく認識できたのならいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm not sure if I should be
happy about what you said, but...
I guess that's fine.

fields.JP: 身体の方はもう大丈夫なのか？

fields.EN:
I heard from Hikari how bad of
a state I was in.
fields.JP:
ヒカリから聞きましたわ。
今がいつで、わたしがどんな状況だったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard from Hikari how bad of
a state I was in.

fields.EN:
I think she needs a bit more time
to recollect herself, so don't go
too hard on her.
fields.JP:
それでもまだ混乱してる部分もあるから、
優しくフォローしてあげてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think she needs a bit more time
to recollect herself, so don't go
too hard on her.

fields.EN:
(In fact, I already know what to
ask her first.)
fields.JP:
（最初にする質問は
　もう僕の中で決めている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In fact, I already know what to
ask her first.)

fields.EN:
Cinderella? What happened that
day when you disappeared?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ。
あの日……君が消えた日に、
いったい何があったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella? What happened that
day when you disappeared?

fields.EN:
The Professor kept saying to
himself how he wished there were
seven Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
昔から博士がよく言ってたんですの。
血式少女は『７人』いればよかった……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor kept saying to
himself how he wished there were
seven Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I wasn't very good at training,
and I could tell I wasn't as good
as you or Ningyohime...
fields.JP:
そしてわたしは、おつうや人魚姫が
当たり前にこなしていく訓練を、
上手くできなかったんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't very good at training,
and I could tell I wasn't as good
as you or Little Mermaid...

fields.EN:
As the days passed, I kept feeling
the pressure pile on me...
fields.JP:
わたしは毎日感じる焦りに
どんどん追い詰められていきましたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the days passed, I kept feeling
the pressure pile on me...

fields.EN:
Then it dawned on me that Dawn
would kick me out if I didn't make
results soon.
fields.JP:
このまま成績を残せないままだと、
わたしはいつか捨てられてしまう、って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then it dawned on me that Dawn
would kick me out if I didn't make
results soon.

fields.EN:
You'd think, but I did hear what
the Professor said, so someone was
bound to have been let go...
fields.JP:
でもそう聞こえてしまったんですもの。
だから血式少女が７人以上になったら、
誰か捨てられる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd think, but I did hear what
the Professor said, so someone was
bound to have been let go...

fields.EN:
The first person to have been let
go would've been me...
fields.JP:
そしてそれは、落ちこぼれの
わたしで決まりだったんですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The first person to have been let
go would've been me...

fields.EN:
I didn't want to believe what
I heard, but it's fact.
Then one day...
fields.JP:
わたしだって信じたくなかった。
でも聞いてしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to believe what
I heard, but it's fact.
Then one day...

fields.EN:
...I heard Hitsuka-san say the same.
"Why do you need seven Blood
Maidens?"
fields.JP:
陽司さんが、
『なぜ血式少女は７人必要なんだ……』
と呟くのを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I heard Hitsuka say the same.
"Why do you need seven Blood
Maidens?"
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
That made you believe what
the Professor said?
fields.JP: それで、信じてしまったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That made you believe what
the Professor said?

fields.EN:
That was all that I needed to
confirm my doubts.
fields.JP:
わたしにとって、
その言葉は決定的だったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was all that I needed to
confirm my doubts.

fields.EN: The quota for Blood Maidens was seven. I wasn't needed. My anxiety boiled over, and I left the Dawn and headed for the Prison area.
fields.JP:
血式少女の定員は７人。わたしはいらない。
焦りが爆発したわたしは黎明を抜けだし、
独房エリアに向かったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seven Blood Maidens was all Dawn
needed. At that point, I decided
to go to the prison area.

fields.EN:
I figured that, if I killed the
Marchens there, Dawn would
accept me and keep me there.
fields.JP:
多くのメルヒェンを倒せば、
もう一度認めてもらえる。
不要なモノではなくなる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured that, if I killed the
Marchens there, Dawn would
accept me and keep me there.

fields.EN:
I can now say how stupid my
decision was back then...
fields.JP:
自分で言うのもなんですが、
馬鹿なことをしたものだと思いますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can now say how stupid my
decision was back then...

fields.JP: そんな経緯だったのか……

fields.EN: Is that all? Don't you remember what happened after that?
fields.JP:
それだけ？
後のことは覚えていないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that it?
Isn't there anything else?

fields.EN:
I do recall I wandered into the
Downtown area, and was tangled
in those vines you saw.
fields.JP:
元繁華街エリアに飛び込んだわたしは、
色々彷徨って……そしてあの変なツタに
絡まれてしまったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do recall I wandered into the
Downtown area, and was tangled
in those vines you saw.

fields.EN:
You mean the vines that grew
from the core, right?
fields.JP: 核から伸びるあの蔦のことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean the vines that grew
from the core, right?

fields.EN:
I was able to escape from it,
but I was so scared that I just
ran off in a hurry.
fields.JP:
絡まれたのは少しだけだったけど、
わたしは怖くて怖くて、そこから必死に
逃げ出したんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was able to escape from it,
but I was so scared that I just
ran off in a hurry.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but...
that's about all I remember.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい……
覚えているのはここまでですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but...
that's about all I remember.

fields.EN:
I guess that must have triggered
you into Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
その時にブラッドスケルター化した、
ということなのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that must have triggered
you into Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
I didn't know you went through
all that... I'm sorry I couldn't
notice what was going on...
fields.JP:
あんたがそんなに焦っていたなんて……
全然気づけなくてごめんね、シンデレラ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you went through
all that... I'm sorry I couldn't
notice what was going on...

fields.EN:
No, don't apologize.
I was weak at heart, that's all...
fields.JP:
いいえ、わたしが悪いんですの。
焦りに……ううん、弱い自分に
負けてしまったのですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, don't apologize.
I was weak at heart, that's all...

fields.EN:
By the way, did something happen
to Hitsuka-san?
fields.JP:
そういえば……陽司さんに
何かあったんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, did something happen
to Hitsuka?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
Uh... Hitsuka-san was killed by an
evil Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ひ、陽司さんは悪いナイトメアに
殺されちゃったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Hitsuka was killed by an
evil Nightmare.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.JP: そうだったんですのね……

fields.EN:
I heard from Hikari how Dawn was
destroyed by a mysterious
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
さっきヒカリから黎明が謎のナイトメアに
壊滅させられたって聞きましたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard from Hikari how Dawn was
destroyed by a mysterious
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
So, that Nightmare must have
killed Hitsuka-san...
fields.JP:
陽司さんはその時に亡くなられて
しまったんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that Nightmare must have
killed Hitsuka...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
(That's not right, but at this
point there's no reason in
correcting her.)
fields.JP:
（本当はそれも違うけど……
　この際、訂正にたいした意味はない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's not right, but at this
point there's no reason in
correcting her.)

fields.EN:
(I have to make sure she doesn't
find out that her fake killed
Hitsuka...)
fields.JP:
（ニセモノのシンデレラが殺した、
　という部分にさえ気づかれなければ
　それでいいんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to make sure she doesn't
find out that her fake killed
Hitsuka...)

fields.EN:
Going back, where did the concept
of seven Blood Maidens come from?
fields.JP:
でもどうして
血式少女は７人限定なのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going back, where did the concept
of seven Blood Maidens come from?

fields.EN: There are ten of us here.
fields.JP:
血式少女など、
今ここに１０人もいるのだが？
fields.LOCALIZED: There are ten of us here.

fields.EN:
True, we're well over the seven
Blood Maidens the Professor
mentioned...
fields.JP:
確かに……とっくに７人は
オーバーしていますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
True, we're well over the seven
Blood Maidens the Professor
mentioned...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I think Cinderella-san
misunderstood the Professor.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、それはシンデレラさんの
勘違いなんじゃないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I think Cinderella
misunderstood the Professor.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.JP: そんな……わたしは確かにこの耳で……

fields.EN: The Professor did say "seven" at the time, but...
fields.JP:
確かに博士はその時７人って
言ってたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor did talk a lot about
having seven Blood Maidens, but...

fields.EN:
I'm pretty sure he was trying to
say that we needed at least seven
Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
正確には『最低７人』って
言っていたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm pretty sure he was trying to
say that we needed at least seven
Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
After you left, another potential
Blood Maiden came, and he did
say he's glad to have more join.
fields.JP:
実際にその後に血式少女の疑惑が
ある子が来たけれど、その時だって
１人でも多い方がいいって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After you left, another potential
Blood Maiden came, and he did
say he's glad to have more join.

fields.JP: そ、それ……本当なんですの……？
うん……本当にそう言ってたよ

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I do recall
the Professor saying that
he'd rather have more than less.
fields.JP:
確かに、多くて困ることはないって
わらわも聞いたような気がします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I do recall
the Professor saying that
he'd rather have more than less.

fields.JP: そ……そうだったん……ですのね……

fields.EN:
So, all this could've been avoided
if I just stayed calm...
fields.JP:
わたしがもっと冷静でしたら……
回避できた事態だったんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, all this could've been avoided
if I just stayed calm...

fields.EN:
Tsuu is right. The way you heard
it was ambiguous enough to
misunderstand his words.
fields.JP:
つうの言うとおり、それなら
勘違いしてしまう可能性はあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu is right. The way you heard
it was ambiguous enough to
misunderstand his words.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Hm. I am intrigued how all that
happened seems to be linked in
a way leading to some conclusion.
fields.JP:
……だけどこの事故が興味深いのは、
まるで様々な事情が連鎖しながら何かに
帰結しているかのように感じることね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. I am intrigued how all that
happened seems to be linked in
a way leading to some conclusion.

fields.EN: Oh? It's exactly what I said.
fields.JP: 別に、そのままの意味よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? It's exactly what I said.

fields.JP: （グレーテルの言うとおりだ……）

fields.EN:
(Kaguya took action because the
three sisters and Cinderella
left Dawn.)
fields.JP:
（かぐやは三姉妹やシンデレラが
　黎明を抜けたから、あの性格になった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya took action because the
three sisters and Cinderella
left Dawn.)

fields.EN:
(The three sisters left Dawn
after assuming Cinderella killed
Hitsuka.)
fields.JP:
（そして三姉妹は誤解とはいえ、
　シンデレラに大事な人を殺されたことで
　黎明を抜けた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The three sisters left Dawn
after assuming Cinderella killed
Hitsuka.)

fields.EN: (Cinderella mistakenly thought there would be a selection among the Blood Maidens. The pressure built up, and in the end she went berserk.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラは血式少女同士の選定が
　あると勘違いして、それがプレッシャーに
　変わり、結果暴走してしまった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella misunderstood the
Professor's words, leading her to
leave Dawn.)

fields.EN:
(Everything is connected, and in
the worst way possible...)
fields.JP:
（本当に連鎖している……
　それも不幸が、だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything is connected, and in
the worst way possible...)

fields.EN:
(All these are linking to each
other, leading each involved to
the worst of results...)
fields.JP:
（連鎖が続き、不幸が不幸を呼ぶこれは、
　もはや不幸な事故……いや災害レベルだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All these are linking to each
other, leading each involved to
the worst of results...)

fields.EN:
(So, if this link continues,
how worse can things go...?)
fields.JP:
（もしもこの連鎖がまだ続くなら……
　いったいどこまで膨らむのだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So, if this link continues,
how worse can things go...?)

fields.JP:
わたしは……なんて
バカだったんでしょう……

fields.EN:
Cinderella, don't be so hard on
yourself...
fields.JP: シンデレラ……気にしちゃダメよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, don't be so hard on
yourself...

fields.EN:
All right, folks. Looks like
Cinderella needs some rest,
so off you go.
fields.JP:
みんな、シンデレラも疲れが
出てるみたいだから、また今度にしよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, folks. Looks like
Cinderella needs some rest,
so off you go.

fields.JP: えーまだおはなしするー！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
シンデレラー
ねえねえ、おはなししよーよ！

fields.EN: Huh? Oh, um... why of course.
fields.JP: えっ、はっ、はいですわっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Oh, um... why of course.

fields.EN:
I said, no.
Maybe after Cinderella takes
a nap, okay?
fields.JP:
こーら、ダメだっての。
シンデレラが少しお昼寝し終わったら、ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said, no.
Maybe after Cinderella takes
a nap, okay?

fields.EN:
Then Rapunzel sleep with her!
Nap time!
fields.JP:
じゃあラプンツェルもいっしょにねるー！
おひるねおひるねー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then Rapunzel sleep with her!
Nap time!

fields.EN:
Eek! P-Please don't drag me
into bed like this!
fields.JP:
ひゃっ！？　ちょっと、ベッドに
引きずり込まないでくださいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eek! P-Please don't drag me
into bed like this!

fields.JP:
わ、分かりましたから
落ちついて下さいまし……！
ボクも……眠くなって、きた……

fields.EN:
Oh, fine...
Only today, got it, Rapu-chan?
fields.JP:
もう、しょうがないなあ……
ラプちゃん、今日だけだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, fine...
Only today, got it, Rappy?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Hikari sure has a lot on her plate.
fields.LOCALIZED: Hikari sure has a lot on her plate.

fields.EN:
I'm sure Cinderella-san will get well
faster with Rapu-chan around.
fields.JP:
でもラプちゃんの横にいた方が
シンデレラさんも早く元気になりそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Cinderella will get well
faster with Rappy around.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Indeed! Now then, get well soon,
Cinderella.
fields.JP:
そうかもな！　ではシンデレラ、
早く元気になるのだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! Now then, get well soon,
Cinderella.

fields.EN: I guess we can call it a day then?
fields.JP: じゃあ解散でいいですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess we can call it a day then?

fields.JP:
そうだね、今日は解散しようか。
それじゃあみんな――

fields.EN:
Sorry, are the Blood Maidens
still around?
fields.JP: 悪い、血式少女は全員まだ残ってるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, are the Blood Maidens
still around?

fields.EN:
Don't surprise me like that...
Yes, everyone's still here.
fields.JP:
ビックリした……
うん、全員まだいるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't surprise me like that...
Yes, everyone's still here.

fields.JP: いったいどうしたんですか？
それは俺から説明する

fields.EN:
Is it about that mysterious
Nightmare?
fields.JP:
またあの謎のナイトメアでも
出現したのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it about that mysterious
Nightmare?

fields.EN:
No, but it could be worse news
than that...
fields.JP:
いや、襲撃じゃない……
けどある意味、もっと悪い知らせかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, but it could be worse news
than that...

fields.JP: ――博士の遺体が、ついに見つかった

（いやだ……
　もう追われたくない……）

fields.EN:
(Where is Ningyohime...?
Where could she have gone...?)
fields.JP:
（ああ、人魚姫に会いたい……
　彼女はどこに行っちゃったんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Where is Little Mermaid...?
Where could she have gone...?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she's lost in the
cavern I was at...)
fields.JP:
（もしかして同じように
　洞窟に迷ってしまったんじゃ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she's lost in the
cavern I was at...)

fields.EN:
(But, I wandered in that place
for 10 years...)
fields.JP:
（でも１０年以上も彷徨ったのに、
　洞窟では会わなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, I wandered in that place
for 10 years...)

fields.EN:
(Or, maybe she wandered off
to the Metropolitan Building,
like I did now...)
fields.JP:
（いや、もしかして……
　自分が偶然この場所に戻ってきたように、
　人魚姫もこの都庁に……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Or, maybe she wandered off
to the Metropolitan Building,
like I did now...)

fields.JP:
ぎぎ……ぞれだど…………
うれじ……な……ぐぐげ……

fields.EN:
(That could be it...
I still have hope...)
fields.JP:
（そうかもしれない……
　少し希望が見えてきたかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That could be it...
I still have hope...)

fields.EN:
(I'm sure Ningyohime would
like this place...)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫もきっと、この場所の景色が
　素敵だと思うはずなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure Little Mermaid would
like this place...)

fields.JP: お前はさっきのナイトメア……っ！

（なっ……！
　せっかく逃げ切ったと思ったのに……！）

fields.EN:
Everyone! Over here!
I found the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
みんな、こっちだよっ！　
ナイトメアを見つけたっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone! Over here!
I found the Nightmare!

fields.EN:
(I finally came back here...
I can't have them get me!)
fields.JP:
（ここで倒されてたまるか……！
　せっかく都庁に戻ってきたんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I finally came back here...
I can't have them get me!)

fields.JP: あっ！　このっ！　逃げるなっ！！

fields.EN:
(Where is Ningyohime...?
I want to see her again...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、人魚姫に会いたい……
　会いたいよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Where is Little Mermaid...?
I want to see her again...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
*yawn* Good morning, Jack.
Looks like you woke me up
just at the right time. Thank you.
fields.JP:
ふぁぁ……おはよう、ジャック。
ん、ちょうどいい時間だ、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
*yawn* Good morning, Jack.
Looks like you woke me up
just at the right time. Thank you.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……ど……
いだじ……まじ……で……

fields.EN:
Now, I need to change, so
you mind turning away?
fields.JP:
じゃあ着替えるから
ちょっと向こうを向いててくれ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, I need to change, so
you mind turning away?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ジャックなら別にいいって気もするけどね

fields.EN: Urh, this sash is so tight...
fields.JP: やっぱりサラシはきついなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Urh, this sash is so tight...

fields.EN:
I'd be more than happy to
give my endowments to
someone else...
fields.JP:
こんなモノ、誰か欲しい人に
分けてあげたいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd be more than happy to
give my endowments to
someone else...

fields.EN:
(That's the least of my
worries, though.)
fields.JP:
（……って、今はそんなことを
　気にかけてる余裕なんてないけどね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's the least of my
worries, though.)

fields.EN:
(It's been a few days since
hearing news of the
Professor's death...)
fields.JP:
（博士の死亡報告から数日が経ってる。
　いい加減、考えないといけない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been a few days since
hearing news of the
Professor's death...)

fields.EN:
(He was the beacon of hope
for those at Dawn...)
fields.JP:
（元黎明の者たちにとって……
　博士は希望のようなものだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He was the beacon of hope
for those at Dawn...)

fields.EN:
(No one really talked much
about it, but many couldn't
hide their disbelief...)
fields.JP:
（そんな人がいなくなったんだ。
　たとえ口には出さなくても、
　ショックは大きい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No one really talked much
about it, but many couldn't
hide their disbelief...)

fields.EN:
(No matter how we feel,
the truth doesn't change...)
fields.JP:
（だけど、悔やもうが落ち込もうが、
　事実だけは変わらない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No matter how we feel,
the truth doesn't change...)

fields.EN:
(The truth that the Professor
is no more...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The truth that the Professor
is no more...)

fields.EN: What did you say again, Mamoru?
fields.JP: ――もう１度言ってくれるか？　マモル
fields.LOCALIZED: What did you say again, Mamoru?

fields.JP: 黎明の博士の遺体が、見つかったんだ

fields.EN:
Wh-What are you saying, Mamoru-san?
You're joking... right?
fields.JP:
な、何を仰るんですかマモルさん。
さすがに冗談……ですよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What are you talking about?
You're joking, right?

fields.EN:
O-Of course. Besides, Mamoru-san, you don't know
what the Professor looks like, do you?
fields.JP:
そ、そうですよ。それにマモルさんは
博士の顔をご存じないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course he's joking.
In the first place, you don't know
who the Professor is.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but...
I can vouch for his death...
fields.JP: 申し訳ないが……僕がしっかり確認した
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but...
I can vouch for his death...

fields.EN:
We formed a squad to search for
materials at Dawn, and...
fields.JP:
黎明から無事な資料を発掘したくて、
マモルに頼んで発掘隊を結成したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We formed a squad to search for
materials at Dawn, and...

fields.JP: その際に、博士を発見したんだ……

fields.EN:
That would mean everyone we
knew at Dawn is...
fields.JP:
ではこれで黎明の人たちは……
みなさん……亡くなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean everyone we
knew at Dawn is...

fields.EN:
I see... Itsuki was a member of
Dawn, so he's probably right.
fields.JP:
そうか……黎明にいたイツキが
言うんだから、間違いないんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Itsuki was a member of
Dawn, so he's probably right.

fields.EN:
(Not finding his body left a
bit of hope, but...)
fields.JP:
（博士が見つからないことは、
　逆に希望が残されているって
　ことでもあったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not finding his body left a
bit of hope, but...)

fields.JP: （だが結果は残酷なものだった……）

fields.EN:
There are so many things
happening that I'm not sure
I follow, but...
fields.JP:
色々なことが起こりすぎて、
頭がついていけないですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are so many things
happening that I'm not sure
I follow, but...

fields.EN:
I suppose I can't apologize
to the Professor now for running
away from Dawn...
fields.JP:
でも、わたしが黎明を飛び出したことは、
もう謝れないんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I can't apologize
to the Professor now for running
away from Dawn...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: If only I didn't leave Dawn...
fields.JP: わたしが黎明に残っていれば……
fields.LOCALIZED: If only I didn't leave Dawn...

fields.EN: If you'd stayed in Dawn, not only the Professor but you would have died too. That's how powerful that Nightmare was.
fields.JP:
君が黎明に残っていたら、
博士だけじゃなく君も死んでいただろう。
それくらいあのナイトメアは強い
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were there, you would've
probably been killed, too.
That Nightmare is that powerful.

fields.EN:
I'm sure the Professor was
relieved that you left before it
struck.
fields.JP:
だから博士はきっと、
君が外に飛び出しててよかったって、
そう思ってるはずだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure the Professor was
relieved that you left before it
struck.

fields.EN:
If no Blood Maidens were left,
nothing could be done, so I'm
sure he's happy we're alive.
fields.JP:
血式少女がいなければ
何もかも成り立たないんだから、
きっとそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If no Blood Maidens were left,
nothing could be done, so I'm
sure he's happy we're alive.

fields.JP: それで……博士はどの辺りに？

fields.EN:
We were removing debris inside
Dawn's headquarters.
fields.JP:
僕たちは少しずつ破壊された黎明内部の
ガレキを撤去していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were removing debris inside
Dawn's headquarters.

fields.EN:
We were able to go deep through
the remains of the structure.
fields.JP:
それで、ここに来てようやく
奥に入ることができたんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were able to go deep through
the remains of the structure.

fields.EN:
That's when we found his body.
He must have hid himself in
the storage.
fields.JP:
博士は隠れることを選択したんだろう、
かなり奥の倉庫で見つかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's when we found his body.
He must have hid himself in
the storage.

fields.EN:
That probably went against him.
His body was found under a
huge monitor and equipment.
fields.JP:
隠れた場所が逆にまずかった。
大きなモニターや機材の下じきに
なっちまってたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That probably went against him.
His body was found under a
huge monitor and equipment.

fields.EN:
And, after hiding himself in
assumed safety, too...
fields.JP: そんな……せっかく隠れられたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, after hiding himself in
assumed safety, too...

fields.EN:
The way the structure was,
I'm not surprised.
fields.JP:
あの建物の破壊っぷりは
尋常じゃなかったからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The way the structure was,
I'm not surprised.

fields.EN:
I suppose his death was
inevitable regardless of his
choice.
fields.JP:
どこに逃げても結果は
変わらなかったかもしれぬな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose his death was
inevitable regardless of his
choice.

fields.EN:
So, this Professor must have been
quite the genius with in-depth
knowledge of the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
……博士というのは血式少女などの
有能な研究者だったのよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, this Professor must have been
quite the genius with in-depth
knowledge of the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
If so, his death is quite
unfortunate as his knowledge
is gone with him.
fields.JP:
だとすると、その知識が失われたことは
本当にもったいないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, his death is quite
unfortunate as his knowledge
is gone with him.

fields.EN:
Yes... The Professor knew about
Blood Skelter. There's no telling
what else he could have known.
fields.JP:
うん……ブラッドスケルター化まで
知っていた博士だ、それ以外のことだって
もっと知ってたはずなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... The Professor knew about
Blood Skelter. There's no telling
what else he could have known.

fields.EN:
He may have had information
about Snark or how the core
affects the Jail...
fields.JP:
たとえば『スナーク』が何者なのか、
あるいは核と監獄塔の関係性とか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He may have had information
about Snark or how the core
affects the Jail...

fields.EN:
That's definitely some information
we'd like to know.
fields.JP: 確かにそれらは知っておきたいところだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's definitely some information
we'd like to know.

fields.EN:
I'd hate to call it being lucky,
but we did discover a number
of documents on his body.
fields.JP:
不幸中の幸い……というと言葉は悪いが、
博士の遺体と共に多くの資料が発掘できた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd hate to call it being lucky,
but we did discover a number
of documents on his body.

fields.EN:
I'll make sure we put it to good
use, and recover what the
Professor knew.
fields.JP:
だから博士の持っていた知識は、
僕がそれを元に解明していくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll make sure we put it to good
use, and recover what the
Professor knew.

fields.EN:
I suppose it's a peculiar
way of having his legacy live on.
fields.JP:
意思を受け継ぐ、と言うのは
大仰かもしれないけれどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it's a peculiar
way of having his legacy live on.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will do good.
Please, do your best for the
sake of our lost Professor...
fields.JP:
いいえ、そんなことありません。
どうか博士の分までお願いします……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will do good.
Please, do your best for the
sake of our lost Professor...

fields.EN:
We're counting on you, Itsuki.
You're about the only person who
can unravel whatever is in there.
fields.JP:
博士の研究資料を理解できるのは、
もうイツキしかいない。
どうかよろしく頼むよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're counting on you, Itsuki.
You're about the only person who
can unravel whatever is in there.

fields.EN:
Sis would be sad knowing that
the Professor is gone...
fields.JP:
でも……博士が亡くなったって知ったら、
きっとおねーちゃん悲しむね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis would be sad knowing that
the Professor is gone...

fields.EN:
Yes... Akazukin-san was especially attached to
the Professor, after all...
fields.JP:
そうですね……赤ずきんさんは
博士のことを特に慕っていましたからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... She was particularly
attached to him after all...

fields.EN:
Regardless, we need to try and
find her as soon as possible...
fields.JP:
でも……何にせよ赤ずきんの奴、
早く見つけてあげないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, we need to try and
find her as soon as possible...

fields.EN:
(We need to keep our heads
up, even with the Professor gone.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ。博士はもういないけど、
　絶望に浸ってる場合じゃないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need to keep our heads
up, even with the Professor gone.)

fields.EN:
(We'll focus on finding Akazukin and Alice, then try to grow
the Jail Tower...)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんやアリスを探して合流する、
　そして監獄塔を伸ばすことに集中する）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We'll focus on finding Red Riding
Hood and Alice, then try to grow
the Jail Tower...)

fields.EN:
(The Jail Tower is steadily
rising. I'm sure we'll make
our way out of this place...)
fields.JP:
（うん、監獄塔は伸びているんだ。
　脱獄する手はずは進んでいるはず……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Jail Tower is steadily
rising. I'm sure we'll make
our way out of this place...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづ……う……
げ、んぎ……ぐぎ……い……？

大丈夫だよ、ジャック。
僕は元気だよ

fields.EN:
Princess is safe with us,
and we should be able to get
out of this place soon.
fields.JP:
姫のことは守れているし、
脱獄の時も近づいてきているからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess is safe with us,
and we should be able to get
out of this place soon.

fields.EN:
(Even if we don't escape, I'm
actually fine staying here so long
as Ningyohime is with me...)
fields.JP:
（実のところ、人魚姫がいれば僕は別に
　脱獄せずこのまま暮らしても……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if we don't escape, I'm
actually fine staying here so long
as Little Mermaid is with me...)

fields.EN:
(What am I thinking?!
Princess must want to escape from
here! Get a grip, Otsuu!)
fields.JP:
（……って何を考えてるんだ僕は！
　姫だって脱獄することを望んでいるはず、
　そんな逃げ腰になってどうする！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What am I thinking?!
Princess must want to escape from
here! Get a grip, Otsuu!)

fields.EN:
Jack, I'll do my best to get
everyone out of here safely.
fields.JP:
……ジャック、僕は絶対にみんなで
脱獄を成功させるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I'll do my best to get
everyone out of here safely.

fields.EN:
It's still early, but Itsuki must
be there, so I guess I can...
fields.JP:
まだ集合時間には早いけど、
イツキはもういるだろうから
少し話でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's still early, but Itsuki must
be there, so I guess I can...

fields.JP:
（ん、あれは……
　ラプンツェルとシンデレラ）
シンデレラ、こっちこっちー！

fields.EN:
Oh my, Rapu!
Please do wait a moment!
fields.JP: ラプ、ちょっと待って下さいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, Rappy!
Please do wait a moment!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Now you will feel my wrath!
Touchy-touchy!
fields.JP:
つかまったら罰ゲームでしてよ！
ぷーにぷにぷにぷに～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now you will feel my wrath!
Touchy-touchy!

fields.JP:
きゃはははっ！
ぷにぷに、くすぐったい～！

ラプンツェルもおかえしの
ぷにぷにぷにぷに～！
きゃっ！？　ラプずるいですわ～！
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness...
It looks like Cinderella is back
to her old self.)
fields.JP:
（よかった、シンデレラ……
　ずいぶんと明るさを取り戻したみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness...
It looks like Cinderella is back
to her old self.)

fields.EN:
(And, all because of Rapunzel.
The power of children, I suppose.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルと仲良くなったから……
　子供の力ってすごいな、本当に）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And, all because of Rapunzel.
The power of children, I suppose.)

fields.EN:
(Odd, considering Cinderella
is actually supposed to be older
than me...)
fields.JP:
（まぁ……本来なら僕よりも
　シンデレラの方が年上だったけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Odd, considering Cinderella
is actually supposed to be older
than me...)

fields.EN:
Ah! Otsuu!
Good morning to you!
fields.JP:
あっ！　おつうっ！
おはようですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! Otsuu!
Good morning to you!

fields.EN:
Good morning... Hm?
Is something wrong, Cinderella?
fields.JP:
おはよ、２人とも。
ん……何か用かいシンデレラ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning... Hm?
Is something wrong, Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Why yes. There's something I need
to ask of you.
fields.JP:
ええ、おつうに
お願いしたいことがあるんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. There's something I need
to ask of you.

fields.EN:
I would like to have you let
me join your expeditions.
fields.JP:
わたしもおつうたちの探索パーティに
入れてほしいんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would like to have you let
me join your expeditions.

fields.EN:
It hasn't been that long since you
recovered. You don't need to
force yourself.
fields.JP:
ここに来てまだそう時間も経ってないんだ
まだまだ戸惑うこともあるだろう？
無理をすることは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It hasn't been that long since you
recovered. You don't need to
force yourself.

fields.EN:
Oh, I am still anxious and scared
of this reality I am in. Staying
in bed may not be a bad idea...
fields.JP:
……おつうの言うとおり、
本当はまだ現実は怖くて不安だらけで……
ずっとベッドの中にいたい気分でしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I am still anxious and scared
of this reality I am in. Staying
in bed may not be a bad idea...

fields.EN:
But when I suggested to
Rapu for us to stay here together
she declined.
fields.JP:
でもラプにいっしょに
留守番しようって言ったら、
首を横にふって言うんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when I suggested to
Rappy for us to stay here together
she declined.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
She said... "Rapunzel like
everyone! Wanna help!
Don't wanna stay behind!"
fields.JP:
『ラプンツェルはみんながとっても
　だいすきだから、ちからになりたい！
　るすばんしない！！』って
fields.LOCALIZED:
She said... "Rapunzel like
everyone! Wanna help!
Don't wanna stay behind!"

fields.JP:
おーシンデレラが
ラプンツェルっぽい！

fields.EN:
Hearing a young child like her
say that snapped me out of my
anxiety.
fields.JP:
それで、こんな年下の子が頑張ってるのに、
わたしはいつまでグズグズしてるんだろう
……そう思ったんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hearing a young child like her
say that snapped me out of my
anxiety.

fields.EN:
Hence, I have decided to stop
wallowing in my fears.
fields.JP:
だからもう、落ち込むのは
一旦やめにしたんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hence, I have decided to stop
wallowing in my fears.

fields.EN:
Staying behind will only dampen
my feelings.
fields.JP:
それに留守番ばかりだときっと、逆に
落ち込んでしまう気がしますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Staying behind will only dampen
my feelings.

fields.EN:
Therefore, I want you to take
me with you folks!
fields.JP:
だからどうか、わたしを一緒に
連れてってほしいんですの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Therefore, I want you to take
me with you folks!

fields.EN:
(Well, she did jump Dawn thinking
that she wasn't of use...)
fields.JP:
（自分がいらない子だって思われるのが
　怖くて、黎明を飛び出したんだもんな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, she did jump Dawn thinking
that she wasn't of use...)

fields.EN:
(Leaving her behind may not be
for the best...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラを心配して残していく、
　っていうのも逆効果かもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Leaving her behind may not be
for the best...)

fields.EN:
(I can't use her youthful appearance
as a reason to not take her
when Rapunzel is with us...)
fields.JP:
（それにシンデレラより年下の
　ラプンツェルがパーティにいる以上、
　幼さを理由に置いてもいけないし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't use her youthful appearance
as a reason to not take her
when Rapunzel is with us...)

fields.EN:
But, promise me one thing...
We won't treat you like some
burden, even if you're struggling.
fields.JP:
でも１つだけ約束してくれ。
僕たちはシンデレラの調子が悪くても、
決して邪魔に扱うようなことはしない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, promise me one thing...
We won't treat you like some
burden, even if you're struggling.

fields.EN:
In turn, I want you to tell us
when you are in a bind or can't
handle things, got it?
fields.JP:
だからキツかったり無理そうだと思ったら、
必ず僕たちに相談してほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In turn, I want you to tell us
when you are in a bind or can't
handle things, got it?

fields.EN:
I suppose that's fair...
I won't hold back from discussing
my thoughts with you.
fields.JP:
……分かりましたわ。
もう１人で悩みを抱えたりしない。
ちゃんと相談しますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that's fair...
I won't hold back from discussing
my thoughts with you.

fields.EN:
Good, then I'll ask everyone
if they will let you join us.
fields.JP:
よし、それならパーティに入れるように、
僕からみんなに言ってみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good, then I'll ask everyone
if they will let you join us.

fields.JP: あ……ありがとうですわ、おつうっ！
でたー！　おつうのあいことばー！！
な、なんだよその合言葉って

fields.EN:
Mmm...
You say that word a lot.
fields.JP: んとね、おつうはよくいってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...
You say that word a lot.

fields.EN:
You haven't changed a bit,
have you?
fields.JP:
変わってませんわね、おつう
昔っからそうでしたわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You haven't changed a bit,
have you?

fields.EN:
I "owe" you so much that
I'm scared to see what it will
take to pay you back.
fields.JP:
わたしもかなりの『貸し』をもらってて、
取り立てがこわかったくらいですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I "owe" you so much that
I'm scared to see what it will
take to pay you back.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! I'm not like that!
It's not like you really
owe me anything!
fields.JP:
ええっ！？　無理矢理取り立てとか、
そんなひどいことしてないよ、僕！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! I'm not like that!
It's not like you really
owe me anything!

fields.EN:
Heh heh, I'm just fooling with
you. I know it all comes from
your kindness.
fields.JP:
ふふ、冗談ですわ。
いつでもおつうは優しかったですわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, I'm just fooling with
you. I know it all comes from
your kindness.

fields.EN:
*sigh* Stop toying with me like this...
Let's get going, shall we?
fields.JP:
もう……からかうなっての……
さ、行くぞ２人ともっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Stop toying with me like this...
Let's get going, shall we?

fields.EN:
So, I want to bring Cinderella
with us, but are there any
objections?
fields.JP:
――というわけで、シンデレラを
一緒に連れて行きたいんだけど、どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I want to bring Cinderella
with us, but are there any
objections?

fields.EN:
I have no objections!
She does have the heart to
come with us!
fields.JP:
ワレはいいと思うぞ！
そやつは芯が強いしな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no objections!
She does have the heart to
come with us!

fields.EN:
As Otsuu-chan said, as long as she tells us
properly if she thinks she can't do it...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんの言うとおり、ちゃんと
無理だと思ったら報告してくれるなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, as long as she tells us
openly if something is wrong,
then...

fields.EN:
Why yes, if she does that,
I don't see why she can't join us.
fields.JP: そうですね、それなら白雪も賛成です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, if she does that,
I don't see why she can't join us.

fields.EN:
At least it's safer to see her
within proximity than not.
fields.JP:
ま、目の届くところにいた方が
逆に安心かもしれないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least it's safer to see her
within proximity than not.

fields.EN:
You'd be happy having her
with you, right, Oyayubi-chan?
fields.JP:
一緒にいた方が
親指ちゃんも嬉しいもんね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd be happy having her
with you, right, Thumby?

fields.JP:
んなっ……！？
そんなこと、ないわよ！

fields.EN:
I'm fine, but I may change my
stance if she doesn't report
properly and promptly.
fields.JP:
私も別に反対はしないけど、
報告を怠ったらその限りではない、
と言っておくわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, but I may change my
stance if she doesn't report
properly and promptly.

fields.JP: まあ通常運転ってとこだけど……

fields.EN:
It will be all right, Cinderella-san.
Let's go together.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよシンデレラさん。
一緒に行きましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It will be all right, Cinderella.
Let's go together.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.JP: あ、ありがとうですわ、みんな！

fields.EN:
All right, then our next
destination is... Where...?
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあ次は
どこに行くんだっけ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, then our next
destination is... Where...?

fields.EN:
Deep past the Downtown area...
The Station Grounds...
fields.JP:
元繁華街エリアの奥……
……元駅構内エリア、だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Deep past the Downtown area...
The Station Grounds...

fields.EN:
I don't think you girls went there
yet.
fields.JP: そこはまだ探索してなかったはずだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think you girls went there
yet.

fields.EN:
We sure didn't.
Everyone, let's get ready to go!
fields.JP:
そうだね、そこはまだだ。
じゃあみんな、準備ができたら出発だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We sure didn't.
Everyone, let's get ready to go!

fields.EN:
This area looks quite different,
just like the other areas.
fields.JP: 今度のエリアもまた、様相が違うわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This area looks quite different,
just like the other areas.

fields.EN:
Yes, and the air here doesn't
feel right...
fields.JP:
そうだね。それに今までよりも
張り詰めた空気を感じる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and the air here doesn't
feel right...

fields.EN:
Maybe there are strong Marchens
roaming this area.
fields.JP:
もしかしたらメルヒェンも
強いのがうろついているかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there are strong Marchens
roaming this area.

fields.EN:
Yeah, we should be extra careful
searching this place.
fields.JP:
うん。今まで以上に
気をつけて探索した方がいいみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we should be extra careful
searching this place.

fields.JP: シンデレラさん、大丈夫？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Why yes, but...
I was just taken aback at how
spooky this area looks.
fields.JP:
ええ、大丈夫ですわ。ただ……
不気味な場所だなって思っただけですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, but...
I was just taken aback at how
spooky this area looks.

fields.EN:
No problem!
Rapunzel and everyone here!
fields.JP:
だいじょうぶー！
ラプンツェルもみんなもいるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem!
Rapunzel and everyone here!

fields.EN:
Yeah, there's nothing to worry about
with our party. Heck, we haven't even
encountered a Nightmare yet.
fields.JP:
そうよ、これだけの大所帯で、
しかもまだナイトメアにも遭遇してないのに、
今から不安がってちゃ駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, there's nothing to worry about
with our party. Heck, we haven't even
encountered a Nightmare yet.

fields.EN:
Good! Keep your spirit up,
Cinderella! No enemy can stand
in the way of Hameln's partee!
fields.JP:
その意気であるぞシンデレラよ！
我が勇者ハーメルン一行に敵はにゃいっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good! Keep your spirit up,
Cinderella! No enemy can stand
in the way of Hameln's partee!

fields.EN:
It looks like you slurred a bit
there.
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like you slurred a bit
there.

fields.EN:
Pay attention to the surroundings,
not me!
fields.JP:
そのツッコミの素早さは
戦いで生かさんか馬鹿者っ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pay attention to the surroundings,
not me!

fields.EN:
Why yes, if only your slurring
could also help us survive
out here.
fields.JP:
そうね、噛んでしまうことも
戦いで生かせればよかったのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, if only your slurring
could also help us survive
out here.

fields.EN:
Th-That aside, it looks like the
tower grew again...
fields.JP:
そ、それはそうと監獄塔、
また伸びた気がしないか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That aside, it looks like the
tower grew again...

fields.EN:
Everyone is really picking on
Hameln, aren't they?
fields.JP: みんな、今日は一段とツッコむね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone is really picking on
Hameln, aren't they?

fields.EN:
But Hameln is right. It looks
like the tower grew again.
fields.JP:
でも確かにハーメルンの言うとおり、
監獄塔はさらに伸びた気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Hameln is right. It looks
like the tower grew again.

fields.EN:
Yes, the tower's silhouette
is a bit different than before.
fields.JP:
ええ。前より周りの景色と
シルエットがズレてる感じがするわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, the tower's silhouette
is a bit different than before.

fields.EN:
Right?! And this is all because
of me and the rest of you!
fields.JP:
そうであろう！　これはやはり
ワレと貴様らの活躍のおかげだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right?! And this is all because
of me and the rest of you!

fields.EN:
Yeah, it's growing all right...
I feel like we're really close
to escaping from this place.
fields.JP:
うん、監獄塔は伸びている。
脱獄の時は着実に近づいてきてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, it's growing all right...
I feel like we're really close
to escaping from this place.

fields.EN: So, we can bid farewell soon then?
fields.JP:
もう少しでこのジェイルとも
おさらばできますかね～？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, we can bid farewell soon then?

fields.EN:
I'm sure we will. That's why
we've been putting all our
effort into what we're doing.
fields.JP:
できるわよ。そのために
わたしたちは頑張っているんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we will. That's why
we've been putting all our
effort into what we're doing.

fields.EN:
So, we'll be able to see what
the surface is like soon...
fields.JP:
それでは……白雪たちは、
いつか地上を見られるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we'll be able to see what
the surface is like soon...

fields.EN:
Oooh! Rapunzel wanna see
top, too!
fields.JP:
おー！　ちじょうっての、
ラプンツェルもみてみたいー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! Rapunzel wanna see
top, too!

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will, Rapu.
We just need to do our best.
fields.JP:
見られますわラプ。
わたしたちが頑張れば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will, Rappy.
We just need to do our best.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……ぼぐ、も……
……ぐげ……がんば……ぎぐ……

fields.EN:
I know you're doing your
best too, Jack.
fields.JP: ジャックも頑張るってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you're doing your
best too, Jack.

fields.EN:
How unusual. He's often quiet
when everyone is around.
fields.JP:
珍しいわね、みんなでいる時は
黙ってることが多いのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unusual. He's often quiet
when everyone is around.

fields.EN:
It just means that Jack-san is
really looking forward to things.
fields.JP:
それだけ、ジャックさんも
やる気に溢れているってことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just means that Jack is
really looking forward to things.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
A virtue befitting for one to
be called my friend!
fields.JP: それでこそワレの仲間だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A virtue befitting for one to
be called my friend!

fields.EN:
All right, let's get this area
searched!
fields.JP:
よし、みんなこのエリアの探索も
頑張っていこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's get this area
searched!

fields.EN:
I don't see anything of interest
so far...
fields.JP:
今のところ特に
目を引くものはないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see anything of interest
so far...

fields.JP: 出会うのもメルヒェンくらいのものだな

fields.EN:
(I guess this is a good thing, so
that Cinderella can get used to
the exploration...)
fields.JP:
（まあシンデレラが慣れるには
　ちょうどいいかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess this is a good thing, so
that Cinderella can get used to
the exploration...)

fields.JP: シンデレラさん、先に進みますよ？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.JP: ああっ、ごめんなさいですわ！

どうしたのーシンデレラー？
なにかみつけたー？

fields.EN:
On the contrary, I'm not seeing
what I was expecting...
fields.JP:
いえ、見つけたというより……
見つからないといいますか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, I'm not seeing
what I was expecting...

fields.JP: うーん、どういういみー？
もしかしてメルヒェンのことか？

fields.EN:
Maybe it's just coincidence,
but we've encountered way less
than what I was expecting.
fields.JP:
ええ……たまたまかもしれませんけど、
想像よりぜんぜん少ないと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's just coincidence,
but we've encountered way less
than what I was expecting.

fields.EN:
I thought so, too. I feel like
there aren't as many Marchens
here.
fields.JP:
それ、わたしも思った。何だかこの辺り、
メルヒェン少なくないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought so, too. I feel like
there aren't as many Marchens
here.

fields.EN: I think the answer lies ahead...
fields.JP: その答えなら……こっちにあるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I think the answer lies ahead...

fields.EN:
Hm? What are you talking
about, Gretel...
fields.JP:
ふん、グレーテルよ、
貴様何をもったいぶって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What are you talking
about, Gretel...

fields.JP: ……って何だこれはーーーーっ！？

fields.EN:
Urgh...! What's with all these
dead Marchens?!
fields.JP:
うげ……何なの、
このメルヒェンの死体の山……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh...! What's with all these
dead Marchens?!

fields.JP: ちょっとこれは尋常じゃない数だぞ……！

fields.EN:
It's exactly what you see.
Piles of dead Marchens.
Quite the sight, yes?
fields.JP:
文字通り、死体の山ね。
なかなかお目にかかれるものではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's exactly what you see.
Piles of dead Marchens.
Quite the sight, yes?

fields.EN:
The only things capable of doing
this are Nightmares, and...
fields.JP:
こんなことができるのって、
ナイトメアかあるいは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only things capable of doing
this are Nightmares, and...

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
それってもしかして……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: きゃはははははははぁっ！！
やっぱりブラッドスケルター化してるか……

fields.EN: Otherwise, even as a Blood Maiden, she probably couldn't have survived on her own.
fields.JP:
そうでないと血式少女とはいえ、
１人で生き残れてはいないでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that's the only
feasible way to survive out here.

fields.EN:
If I wasn't in Blood Skelter,
I would probably have been
dead, too.
fields.JP:
わたしもそうでなかったら
死んでたに違いありませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I wasn't in Blood Skelter,
I would probably have been
dead, too.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean we should
appreciate entering Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
だからってブラッドスケルター化に感謝、
なんて絶対したくないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean we should
appreciate entering Blood Skelter.

fields.JP: まーあれとめるのめんどうだもんねー

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: うん、そうだねネムちゃん！

fields.EN:
So, that's Akazukin...
My rival to be!
fields.JP:
あやつが赤ずきん……
ワレの生涯のライバルであるか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that's Red Riding Hood...
My rival to be!

fields.EN: I'll bring you back for sure, Sis!
fields.JP:
おねーちゃん……
絶対に元に戻してあげるからね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll bring you back for sure, Sis!

fields.EN:
Princess, calm down.
We'll do this, together.
fields.JP:
姫、肩の力抜いて。
みんなでやれば絶対に大丈夫だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, calm down.
We'll do this, together.

fields.JP:
う、うん……！
ありがとう、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
All right!
Let's bring her back to normal!
fields.JP:
よし、みんな！
赤ずきんを元に戻すぞっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right!
Let's bring her back to normal!

fields.JP:
きゃはっ、きゃはっ、
きゃははははぁぁぁぁぁっっっ！！
やったっ！　動きが鈍りました！

fields.EN:
Quite the rival indeed!
Very strong!
fields.JP:
さすがワレのライバル、
なかなかに強かったぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite the rival indeed!
Very strong!

fields.EN:
Princess! I'll hold her down,
so hurry and get Jack's blood!
fields.JP:
姫っ！　押さえ込むから
その隙にジャックの血を！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess! I'll hold her down,
so hurry and get Jack's blood!

fields.EN:
Okay! Leave it to me!
Jack-san? I'll borrow some of
your blood.
fields.JP:
うんっ！　任せてっ！！
ジャックさん、血をお借りしますっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Leave it to me!
Jack? I'll borrow some of
your blood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎゃきゃっ！
きゃっはぁっ！！

くっ……！
暴れるな赤ずきんっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Tch! Stay still, Red Riding Hood!

fields.EN:
I can't believe how strong
she is!
fields.JP:
２人がかりだというのに、
何て馬鹿力なのだ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe how strong
she is!

fields.EN:
Damn it...!
We can't hold her down much
longer...!
fields.JP:
やばいっ……！
もう押さえきれない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it...!
We can't hold her down much
longer...!

fields.JP:
おねーちゃんっ！
正気に戻ってっ！！

fields.EN:
Damn it... I'm sorry!
We couldn't hold her down...
fields.JP:
くそっ……
押さえきれなかった、ごめん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it... I'm sorry!
We couldn't hold her down...

fields.EN: No, Otsuu-chan, are you and Haa-chan okay?!
fields.JP:
ううん、おつうちゃんと
ハーちゃんは大丈夫！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine.
Are you two all right?

fields.EN:
I'm fine as well, but...
What power!
fields.JP:
ワレなら余裕であるぞ……
しかし……なんて奴だ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine as well, but...
What power!

fields.JP:
きゃきゃっ……
きゃはははははっ……！！
待って赤ずきんさんっ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Well now, she runs quite fast,
doesn't she?
fields.JP: 逃げ足もまた、尋常じゃなく素早いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, she runs quite fast,
doesn't she?

fields.EN:
She was strong from before,
so I shouldn't be surprised of
her power...
fields.JP:
元の赤ずきんの身体能力を考えれば、
しょうがないことかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was strong from before,
so I shouldn't be surprised of
her power...

fields.EN: I'm just happy she's still alive.
fields.JP: でも、おねーちゃん生きてた……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm just happy she's still alive.

fields.EN:
She may have gotten away,
but we can nab her again.
fields.JP:
今は逃げられたけど、
まだチャンスはいくらでもあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She may have gotten away,
but we can nab her again.

fields.EN:
There will always be a chance to
bring her back as long as she's
alive.
fields.JP:
そうです、生きててくれさえすれば、
あとは元に戻せばいいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
There will always be a chance to
bring her back as long as she's
alive.

fields.EN:
Hmph! The next time we meet,
we will bring her back to sanity,
and make her join my party!
fields.JP:
ふっ、次こそ正気に戻して
ワレの配下に加えてくれようぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! The next time we meet,
we will bring her back to sanity,
and make her join my party!

fields.EN: Right! Next time, we have to return her to normal and save her!
fields.JP:
そうだね！
次こそ元に戻して救ってやらないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds good.
We're going to save her!

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, everyone, let's go after her
right away!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、みんな、
すぐに後を追おう！

fields.EN:
Say, Ningyohime?
What kind of person is my rival,
Akazukin?
fields.JP:
のう、人魚姫。
ワレのライバルである赤ずきんは、
いったいどんな奴なのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Little Mermaid?
What kind of person is my rival,
Red Riding Hood?

fields.EN:
Well, she's very caring, and would
come running to us when
we needed help.
fields.JP:
そうだね……面倒見がよくて、
困ってるといつも助けてくれたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, she's very caring, and would
come running to us when
we needed help.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san is attached to her
to the extent of calling Akazukin-san her sister.
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんは赤ずきんさんのこと、
『おねーちゃん』って呼ぶくらい
慕ってますもんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid is attached to her
to the extent of calling Red
Riding Hood her sister.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 人魚姫 => Little Mermaid-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 | Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
She's not related in blood like
us sisters.
fields.JP:
わたしたちみたいな
本当の姉妹じゃないのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not related in blood like
us sisters.

fields.EN:
That doesn't matter, Oyayubi-neesama!
I just call her my sister out of
respect!
fields.JP:
もうっ、いいじゃないですか親指姉様！
敬意の表れなんですからっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't matter, Thumbelina!
I just call her my sister out of
respect!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Oh, um...
I wasn't trying to speak bad
about you two...
fields.JP:
うっ……別に悪いなんて
言ってないわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um...
I wasn't trying to speak bad
about you two...

fields.EN:
Now, now...
Let's calm down a bit.
fields.JP: まあまあ、２人とも落ちついて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now...
Let's calm down a bit.

fields.EN:
Oh, and Sis can be a bit rough,
but she's really strong and
really reliable!
fields.JP:
それでね、おねーちゃんは
ちょっと猪突猛進なところもあるけど、
すっごく強くて頼れる人なの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and Sis can be a bit rough,
but she's really strong and
really reliable!

fields.EN:
As long as Sis is here, we have
nothing to worry about!
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんが一緒にいてくれれば、
怖いものなんてないくらいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as Sis is here, we have
nothing to worry about!

fields.EN:
Oho? You're making it sound
like she's quite a person...
fields.JP:
ほ、ほう……それはまた
ずいぶんと頼りがいがありそうな
感じであるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho? You're making it sound
like she's quite a person...

fields.EN:
Why yes! She is quite a person,
just like you, Haa-chan!
fields.JP:
そうだね、ハーちゃんみたいに
頼れる人だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes! She is quite a person,
just like you, Hammy!

fields.EN:
Hm, I see...
Very befitting to be my rival!
fields.JP:
いやぁなるほど……さすがは
ワレのライバルといったところだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I see...
Very befitting to be my rival!

fields.EN:
And, as reliable as me?
She must be some kind of hero,
like me!
fields.JP:
ワレに匹敵するほどの頼りがい……
それだと大勇者クラスだな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, as reliable as me?
She must be some kind of hero,
like me!

fields.JP: うっわ調子に乗ってる……

fields.EN:
Leave her be. She's actually a lot
easier to handle that way.
