fields.JP:
いいのよあれで。
あの状態の方が扱いやすいから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave her be. She's actually a lot
easier to handle that way.

fields.EN:
Oh, I met Sis and Otsuu for the
first time at the same place.
fields.JP:
そうそう、おねーちゃんと
初めて会ったのはね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I met Sis and Otsuu for the
first time at the same place.

fields.EN:
I first met Otsuu-chan by sheer
coincidence at the Aquarium
Ruins.
fields.JP:
昔、水族館跡エリアでわたしと
おつうちゃんが運命的に出会って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I first met Otsuu by sheer
coincidence at the Aquarium
Ruins.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
A few days later, Sis and the
folks at Dawn came down to
bring us in their fold.
fields.JP:
それで数日もしないうちに、
おねーちゃんと黎明の人たちが来て
保護してくれたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few days later, Sis and the
folks at Dawn came down to
bring us in their fold.

fields.JP: ほう、そんな出会いだったのか！
そういえばそうだったね

fields.EN:
Hee hee... Otsuu-chan, you weren't very eager
back then, were you?
fields.JP:
ふふっ……あの時、おつうちゃんは
何故だか乗り気じゃなかったよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... If I recall correctly,
you weren't that willing to
join Dawn, right?

fields.EN:
Why wouldn't I be hesitant?
It's not like I knew Akazukin or Dawn, you know?
fields.JP:
仕方ないじゃないか。
あの頃は赤ずきんも黎明も
知らなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why wouldn't I be hesitant?
It's not like I knew Red Riding
Hood or Dawn, you know?

fields.EN:
Well, to be fair, I haven't really
associated much with anyone
besides you, Princess.
fields.JP:
いや、赤ずきんたちだけじゃない。
僕は姫以外の人と、ほとんど話した
こともなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, to be fair, I haven't really
associated much with anyone
besides you, Princess.

fields.EN:
Oh, that's right. You sure were
cautious of everyone back then.
fields.JP:
そっか。だから最初はあんなに、
みんなのこと警戒してたんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's right. You sure were
cautious of everyone back then.

fields.EN:
Well, so long as you were
with me, then...
fields.JP:
そう、僕は人魚姫と一緒なら、
他のことなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, so long as you were
with me, then...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Never mind.
Thanks, Jack.
fields.JP:
あ、いや、大丈夫。なんでもないんだ。
ありがとう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Never mind.
Thanks, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
どうした、照れておるのかおつうよ

fields.EN:
I was just remembering that day
I was able to meet Princess.
fields.JP:
姫と運命的な出逢いを果たしたあの日の
ことを少し思い出していただけさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just remembering that day
I was able to meet Princess.

fields.EN:
Such beauty! Such grace!
Seeing her struck my heart,
making me kneel...
fields.JP:
目の前に現われた可憐な少女！
その姿に心奪われた僕は、
思わずその場に膝をつき……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Such beauty! Such grace!
Seeing her struck my heart,
making me kneel...

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan! Stop it!
This is embarrassing...
fields.JP:
もうっ、おつうちゃんってば！
恥ずかしいよぉ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu! Stop it!
This is embarrassing...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I see... So, it sounds like layers
of coincidences led you to
meet everyone.
fields.JP:
なるほどね……偶然の出会いが
立て続けに起きたってわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So, it sounds like layers
of coincidences led you to
meet everyone.

fields.EN:
Yes.
It's almost like destiny at work.
fields.JP: そうなの。運命的でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes.
It's almost like destiny at work.

fields.EN:
Tsuu meets Ningyohime,
then right after that, Akazukin appears...
fields.JP:
つうと人魚姫が出会い、
そしてすぐに赤ずきんがやって来る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu meets Little Mermaid,
then right after that, Red Riding
Hood appears...
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I suppose "destiny" is an apt
word to use.
fields.JP: なるほど、確かに運命的ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose "destiny" is an apt
word to use.

fields.EN:
Yes, it's almost like it was
only yesterday...
fields.JP:
ええ、本当にあの日のことは
忘れないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's almost like it was
only yesterday...

fields.EN:
That must mean you three will
meet!
fields.JP: ではまた３人再会しないとであるな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must mean you three will
meet!

fields.EN: Yes, it should be soon enough.
fields.JP: それはもうすぐですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, it should be soon enough.

fields.EN:
Let us hurry,
and go find Aka-neesama.
fields.JP: ええ、早く赤姉様を助けに行きましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let us hurry,
and go find sister Red.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP:
よし、じゃあみんな、
先を急ごうか

fields.EN:
All right, now we have a chance
of defeating the Nightmare here.
fields.JP:
よし、これで
このエリアのナイトメアを倒せるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, now we have a chance
of defeating the Nightmare here.

fields.EN:
What are we waiting for?
Let's just crush that thing.
fields.JP:
じゃあとっとと壊して
サクサク進むわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are we waiting for?
Let's just crush that thing.

fields.EN:
Oh, but don't get too careless.
You don't want to get caught
off guard again.
fields.JP: 油断してるとまた足下すくわれるわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but don't get too careless.
You don't want to get caught
off guard again.

fields.EN:
I-I'm not going to let my guard
down!
fields.JP: ゆっ、油断なんてしてないっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not going to let my guard
down!

fields.EN:
Are those... the same vines
that got me tangled before?
fields.JP:
もしかしてこれ……
わたしが絡め取られたツタと同じ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are those... the same vines
that got me tangled before?

fields.JP: 大丈夫……ボクたちが……いるよ……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel is here, too!
Cinderella is gonna be okay!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもいるよ！
あんしんしてシンデレラ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel is here, too!
Cinderella is gonna be okay!

fields.EN:
I shouldn't make myself
sound so worried...
fields.JP: またわたしは弱気になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shouldn't make myself
sound so worried...

fields.EN:
Thank you, everyone.
I'll be fine.
fields.JP:
みんな、ありがとうですわ。
わたしは大丈夫です……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, everyone.
I'll be fine.

fields.EN:
Now then, let us destroy it
quick.
fields.JP: ではさっさと制圧してしまおうではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let us destroy it
quick.

fields.JP: あら、何とかのひとつ覚えってやつですね～
さっさと倒しちゃおう、みんな！

fields.EN:
We can't take too much time here.
Let's dispatch it quickly,
and search for Akazukin!
fields.JP:
うん、赤ずきんを追うためにも、
こんなところで時間を食ってられない。
みんな、やるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't take too much time here.
Let's dispatch it quickly,
and search for Red Riding Hood!

fields.JP: ふん、歯ごたえのない奴らだな

fields.EN:
I wasn't burdening anyone,
was I?
fields.JP:
わたし……足手まといじゃ、
なかったですわよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't burdening anyone,
was I?

fields.EN:
Cinderella, you did fine.
I'm sure you'll do fine later,
too.
fields.JP:
シンデレラはちゃんと動けていた。
これなら大丈夫さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, you did fine.
I'm sure you'll do fine later,
too.

fields.JP: そう……ならよかった、ですわ……

fields.EN: Now then, time to crush the core.
fields.JP: よし、では核を破壊するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, time to crush the core.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

今回もまた、
ジェイルが悲鳴を上げているわね

fields.EN:
I can only hope this will make
the tower grow again.
fields.JP:
これで監獄塔がまた伸びてくれると
いいのですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope this will make
the tower grow again.

fields.EN:
(I would like to know if this will
make the tower rise, too.)
fields.JP:
（そうだな、そこが
　気になるところではある……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I would like to know if this will
make the tower rise, too.)

fields.EN:
I'm sure the tower will grow with
this. Now then, let's head on back
to our search for Akazukin.
fields.JP:
きっと伸びてくれるさ。
それより今は赤ずきんを追おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure the tower will grow with
this. Now then, let's head on back
to our search for Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
It seems as if both Akazukin and the Nightmare are a
bit further ahead of us.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんもナイトメアも、
どうやらもっと奥の方にいるようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if both Red Riding
Hood and the Nightmare are a
bit further ahead of us.

fields.EN:
I would assume so, too.
Let's head on out.
fields.JP:
おそらくそうだと思う。
よしみんな、出発しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would assume so, too.
Let's head on out.

fields.EN:
Um, Rapu?
I don't hear anything...
fields.JP: ラプ……何も聞こえないですわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Rappy?
I don't hear anything...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: No. When Rapunzel is like this, all five of her senses are incredibly sharp. She probably didn't mishear it.
fields.JP:
いや、こういう時のラプンツェルは
五感がすごく研ぎ澄まされてるんだ。
聞き間違いじゃないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's senses are quite
exceptional. I'm sure we can trust
what she hears.

fields.JP: たっ、確かに聞こえますっ！
うぅぅああああああああっ！！
くっ……よりによってナイトメア……！

fields.EN:
We already destroyed the core,
so look...
fields.JP:
でも私たちはさっき
核を破壊したわ。ほら見て
fields.LOCALIZED:
We already destroyed the core,
so look...

fields.EN:
The Nightmare's protective parts
are destroyed already...?
fields.JP:
ナイトメアの部位が……
すべて破壊され尽くしているだと……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare's protective parts
are destroyed already...?

fields.EN:
I have to hand it to Akazukin. Her power hasn't faltered
a bit!
fields.JP:
さすが赤ずきん……
尋常じゃない強さだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to hand it to Red Riding
Hood. Her power hasn't faltered
a bit!

fields.EN:
This is no time to be praising
her! She's badly hurt!
fields.JP:
感心してる場合じゃないよ！
おねーちゃんだってもうボロボロだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is no time to be praising
her! She's badly hurt!

fields.EN:
True... She won't last much
longer at this rate.
fields.JP:
確かに、あのままだと
赤ずきんの奴やばいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... She won't last much
longer at this rate.

fields.EN:
(To add, she'll probably keep
fighting until her very end.)
fields.JP:
（きっとあのままじゃ
　死ぬまで戦い続けるだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(To add, she'll probably keep
fighting until her very end.)

fields.JP: ギャルル！！　ギャルルルっ！！

fields.EN: We need to save her, now!
fields.JP: 早く助けに入らないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED: We need to save her, now!

fields.EN:
But, we can't just go in there
blindly! We'll get caught in the
heat of battle!
fields.JP:
でも迂闊に飛び込んだら
こっちだってタダじゃ済まないわよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, we can't just go in there
blindly! We'll get caught in the
heat of battle!

fields.EN:
Do you have any good ideas,
Gretel-san?
fields.JP:
何かいい策はありませんか、
グレーテルさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you have any good ideas,
Gretel?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, the situation is
grim. Odds are likely Akazukin will die before we intervene.
fields.JP:
正直この状態だともう手遅れね。
分断させる間に赤ずきんが死にかねないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, the situation is
grim. Odds are likely Red Riding
Hood will die before we intervene.

fields.EN:
Hence, my plan is simple.
You do know what I am going to
say, right, Tsuu?
fields.JP:
だから話は簡単よ。
ねえ、つう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hence, my plan is simple.
You do know what I am going to
say, right, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Yes... We jump in blindly with
all we have, and immobilize both
Akazukin and the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ああ。飛び込んで一気に制圧する。
赤ずきんも、ナイトメアも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We jump in blindly with
all we have, and immobilize both
Red Riding Hood and the Nightmare.

fields.JP: そんな、無策っていうのよソレ！

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-chan, we'll be fine as long
as we all work together in
unison.
fields.JP:
わたしたちがしっかり連携を取れれば
大丈夫だよ、親指ちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby, we'll be fine as long
as we all work together in
unison.

fields.EN:
She's right. This is
a lot simpler than I thought.
fields.JP:
そのとおり。
うむ、簡単な話だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. This is
a lot simpler than I thought.

fields.EN:
We don't have time.
We need to go in, now.
fields.JP:
時間がないんだ。
みんなで一気に制圧するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have time.
We need to go in, now.

fields.EN:
Everyone, follow Tsuu's orders.
That should suffice.
fields.JP:
とにかく全員がつうの指示に従うこと。
それさえできれば大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, follow Otsuu's orders.
That should suffice.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Tsuu? I leave it up to you who
you want to go for first.
fields.JP:
どっちを先に制圧するかは
つう、あなたに任せるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? I leave it up to you who
you want to go for first.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
All right, let's move in!
We're going to save
Akazukin!
fields.JP:
よし、全員一気に制圧！
赤ずきんを助けるぞっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's move in!
We're going to save
Red Riding Hood!

fields.JP: これで終わりだナイトメアっ！！

fields.EN:
We did it!
We defeated it!
fields.JP: やった！　倒しましたわっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did it!
We defeated it!

fields.EN: Okay! I have her down now!
fields.JP: よしっ、今度こそ押さえ込んだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! I have her down now!

fields.JP: うがぁっ……あぁぁぁぁぁっ……！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Please! Come back to us, Sis!
fields.JP:
お願い！　元に戻って
おねーちゃぁぁぁぁんっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Please! Come back to us, Sis!

fields.EN:
Huh? Hey, what's the matter,
Ningyo? You look... so... Ah...
fields.JP:
ははっ、どうしたのよ……人魚……
そんな顔……しちゃっ、て……うっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Hey, what's the matter,
Mermie? You look... so... Ah...

fields.EN:
Look at all her scars...
We need to take her back with
us to care for her wounds...
fields.JP:
でも身体中ボロボロだよ……
すぐに拠点に連れ帰って手当てしないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all her scars...
We need to take her back with
us to care for her wounds...

fields.EN:
Yes, we should.
Let's get her back so that Hikari
can take a look at her.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
一刻も早くヒカリに診てもらおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we should.
Let's get her back so that Hikari
can take a look at her.

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Princess. She's a lot
tougher than she looks. There's
no way she'd die from this.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、姫。赤ずきんはタフだから、
これくらいで死にやしないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Princess. She's a lot
tougher than she looks. There's
no way she'd die from this.

fields.EN:
You're right...
I'm sure she'll be fine...
fields.JP: そう、だよね……大丈夫だよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I'm sure she'll be fine...

fields.EN:
Hameln, can you use your familiar
to let Hikari know what's going
on?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、使い魔で
ヒカリに連絡しといてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, can you use your familiar
to let Hikari know what's going
on?

fields.EN:
Done, and done.
She should be in safe hands once
we return.
fields.JP:
もう伝令は出した。
戻ればすぐに受け入れてくれるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Done, and done.
She should be in safe hands once
we return.

fields.EN:
Nice job, Hameln.
All right, let's head on back.
fields.JP:
さすがハーメルン。
よし、じゃあすぐに戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice job, Hameln.
All right, let's head on back.

fields.EN:
It feels like a lot of time has
passed... Ouch...
fields.JP:
……何かとっても久しぶりな気がする……
って、いたたた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels like a lot of time has
passed... Ouch...

fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん！　さすがにベッドから
出るのは許可できません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood!
Please stay in bed!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: You're supposed to be on strict bed rest, remember...? And everyone, no long conversations, okay...?
fields.JP:
もう、本当は絶対安静なんですからね……？
みんなも、長話は駄目だよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to let yourself rest.
Oh, and everyone, please
try to go easy on her.

fields.JP: うん。ありがとうヒカリ

fields.EN: Sis... I so wanted to see you!
fields.JP: おねーちゃん……会いたかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sis... I so wanted to see you!

fields.EN: Whoa, Ningyo! Don't jump on me like that!
fields.JP:
うわぁ、こら人魚！
そんな飛びつかないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Mermie! Heel!
Don't jump on me like that!

fields.EN:
I'm glad you're all right,
Akazukin. With that said,
would you mind...
fields.JP:
本当に無事でよかったよ赤ずきん。
で、早速で悪いけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you're all right,
Red Riding Hood. With that said,
would you mind...

fields.EN: Yeah. I understand. Well, no—there's a lot I don't know, but I do understand that something happened to me.
fields.JP:
うん。分かってる。
あ、いや、分からないことだらけだけど、
自分に何かあったことだけは理解してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, I know what you want to ask.
Uh, well, not exactly, but I can at
least share what I know.

fields.EN:
Before anything, you mind telling
me what happened? I'll tell you
what I know afterward.
fields.JP:
あたしに、いったい何があったか教えて。
あたしも覚えてることは話すからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before anything, you mind telling
me what happened? I'll tell you
what I know afterward.

fields.JP:
まずはそうだな……
僕たちが赤ずきんとはぐれてからだけど――

fields.EN: And that's how we finally reunited with Akazukin.
fields.JP:
――というわけで、
ようやく赤ずきんと合流できたんだ
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
わたしたちの話、
信じて……もらえるんですの？

fields.EN:
Uh, if you were lying, I'd expect
you to be more convincing. This is
so unbelievable it is believable.
fields.JP:
あまりにも突拍子もなさ過ぎだもん。
ウソをつくならもっとマシな話を、
思いつくでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, if you were lying, I'd expect
you to be more convincing. This is
so unbelievable it is believable.

fields.EN:
Like, Cinderella's in front of me,
and the three sisters are here, too.
fields.JP:
シンデレラのその姿とか、
親指たちがいること……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, Cinderella's in front of me,
and the three sisters are here, too.

fields.EN:
Uh, and I see a lot of others
I haven't met before...
fields.JP: 初めましてな人たちもわんさかいるし、
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, and I see a lot of others
I haven't met before...

fields.EN:
Oh, and I know for a fact that
Otsuu and Ningyo would never
lie to me.
fields.JP:
なにより、おつうや人魚が、
あたしにウソをつくわけがないって、
信じてるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I know for a fact that
Otsuu and Mermie would never
lie to me.

fields.EN:
It's your turn now.
Is there anything you can share?
fields.JP: 赤ずきんは、どこまで覚えてるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's your turn now.
Is there anything you can share?

fields.EN:
I do know that Dad... I mean...
The Professor died.
fields.JP:
あたしはお父さん……
博士が死んだってことは知っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do know that Dad... I mean...
The Professor died.

fields.EN: I saw him with my own eyes.
fields.JP: なんせこの目で見たからね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I saw him with my own eyes.

fields.JP:
（赤ずきんは博士の
　亡骸を見ているのか……）

fields.EN:
Akazukin... You can drop
the subject if you want.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん……
つらいなら無理に思い出さなくても
いいんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood... You can drop
the subject if you want.

fields.JP:
心配しないで、おつう。
あたしは大丈夫だからさ

fields.EN:
What I went through is nothing
compared to what everyone in
Dawn went through.
fields.JP:
黎明のみんなに比べれば、
あたしのつらいなんて、
全然つらいうちに入らないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I went through is nothing
compared to what everyone in
Dawn went through.

fields.EN:
Especially considering how
some of them died...
fields.JP:
あんな風に無残に死んでいった、
みんなに比べたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially considering how
some of them died...

fields.EN:
We tried to let everyone escape
by having me and the others who
could fight act as decoys.
fields.JP:
最初はあたしや戦える連中が囮になって、
戦えない人たちを先に逃がそうとした
fields.LOCALIZED:
We tried to let everyone escape
by having me and the others who
could fight act as decoys.

fields.JP: でも、間に合わなかった。

fields.EN:
I ran back when I saw Dawn's
headquarters crumble...
fields.JP:
黎明の建物が破壊されたのを見て、
急いで戻ると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I ran back when I saw Dawn's
headquarters crumble...

fields.EN:
And there were so many
dead bodies everywhere...
fields.JP:
目の前にみんなの、
無残な死体があって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And there were so many
dead bodies everywhere...

fields.EN:
I just felt this surge of anger
run through me, and...
fields.JP:
凄まじい怒りの感情が
一気に沸き上がって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just felt this surge of anger
run through me, and...

fields.EN:
Akazukin, calm down.
You're still recovering.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、少し落ち着け。
まだ本調子じゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, calm down.
You're still recovering.

fields.EN:
(I felt hatred coming from her
unlike anything before...)
fields.JP:
（今、赤ずきんから、
　危険なくらいの憎悪を感じた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I felt hatred coming from her
unlike anything before...)

fields.EN:
(I can only assume her hatred and
anger was even greater back when
she saw everyone dead...)
fields.JP:
（実際に博士たちの亡骸を目の当たりに
　した時はこれ以上に、激しい怒りが
　赤ずきんを襲ったんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can only assume her hatred and
anger was even greater back when
she saw everyone dead...)

fields.EN:
Next thing I know, well, I see
you guys like this.
fields.JP:
で、気づいたらあんたたちの顔が、
目の前にあったってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next thing I know, well, I see
you guys like this.

fields.JP: いったい、あたしはどうなったの？
赤ずきんはブラッドスケルター化したんだ

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter? You mean the thing
you brought up about Dad's
research?
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化って……
さっきおつうが話してくれた、
お父さんの研究にあったっていうやつ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter? You mean the thing
you brought up about Dad's
research?

fields.EN:
Yes, you recall what happened
to Alice, right?
fields.JP:
うん、赤ずきんも見ただろう。
アリスが突然暴れ始めたのを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you recall what happened
to Alice, right?

fields.EN: Oh... So that happened to me?
fields.JP: そっか……あたしもあんな風に……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... So that happened to me?

fields.EN:
Well... Sorry if I caused you all
trouble back there.
fields.JP: みんな……迷惑かけてごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... Sorry if I caused you all
trouble back there.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I'm just happy that
you're safe.
fields.JP:
ううん、いいの。
おねーちゃんが無事でいてくれて、
わたしはすごく嬉しいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'm just happy that
you're safe.

fields.EN:
Princess is right. We're just
happy you're back with us again.
fields.JP:
姫の言う通りだよ。
こうして赤ずきんが戻って来た。
今はそれで充分だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess is right. We're just
happy you're back with us again.

fields.JP: 人魚、おつう……ありがとね

fields.EN:
So, why didn't Dad let
anyone know about
Blood Skelter?
fields.JP:
でもお父さんはどうして、
ブラッドスケルター化について
教えてくれなかったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, why didn't Dad let
anyone know about
Blood Skelter?

fields.EN:
I'm sure things would've been
a lot different if we knew about
it beforehand.
fields.JP:
それさえ知っていたら、
もう少しマシな今になってたかも
しれないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure things would've been
a lot different if we knew about
it beforehand.

fields.EN: I'm sure he had his plans.
fields.JP:
博士にはきっと、
何か考えがあったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sure he had his plans.

fields.EN:
I think that maybe his research
wasn't ready to be disclosed yet.
fields.JP: きっとまだ研究の途中だったんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that maybe his research
wasn't ready to be disclosed yet.

fields.EN:
It's true that there are still
many mysteries regarding
Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
確かにブラッドスケルター化は
研究が恐ろしく困難だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that there are still
many mysteries regarding
Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
And, we only recently developed
a means of recovering from
it by using Jack's blood.
fields.JP:
それこそ博士にはジャックの血という
特効薬はなかったんだしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, we only recently developed
a means of recovering from
it by using Jack's blood.

fields.EN:
Even so, we're lucky the data
we recovered from his research
provided useful information.
fields.JP:
むしろ、それでも地道に研究を続けて、
これだけの資料を遺してくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, we're lucky the data
we recovered from his research
provided useful information.

fields.EN:
The Professor's research and
Jack's blood saved you.
fields.JP:
彼の研究成果とジャックの血が、
君を救ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor's research and
Jack's blood saved you.

fields.EN: So, I guess Dad sort of saved me.
fields.JP: そっか、お父さんはあたしを……
fields.LOCALIZED: So, I guess Dad sort of saved me.

fields.JP: なのに、ナイトメアがお父さんを……
全部あのナイトメアのせいだ……

fields.EN:
I'm not going to let it live...
Die... Die... Die...
fields.JP: 許さない許さない許さない許さない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to let it live...
Die... Die... Die...

fields.EN:
Otsuu? I want to kill that
Nightmare that struck Dawn.
fields.JP:
ねえおつう、あたしはあの
黎明を襲ったナイトメアを殺したい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? I want to kill that
Nightmare that struck Dawn.

fields.EN:
I want to avenge Dad and
everyone's deaths.
fields.JP:
お父さんやみんなの仇を、
絶対に討ってやるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to avenge Dad and
everyone's deaths.

fields.EN:
So, I'm gonna be joining up
with you guys.
fields.JP:
だからさ、あたしもすぐに
戦いに参加するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'm gonna be joining up
with you guys.

fields.EN:
I'm going to kill that Nightmare
and reduce it to a pulp.
fields.JP:
あのナイトメアをぐちゃぐちゃに
殺すために、あたしはすぐに参加する
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to kill that Nightmare
and reduce it to a pulp.

fields.EN:
I'm going to kill...
Kill the Nightmare!
fields.JP: 絶対……絶対にぶっ殺してやるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to kill...
Kill the Nightmare!

fields.EN:
(Could I fault her reaction?
She was bonded close to
Dawn and the Professor.)
fields.JP:
（無理もない……誰よりも博士や
　黎明の人たちを慕っていたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Could I fault her reaction?
She was bonded close to
Dawn and the Professor.)

fields.EN:
(But, it's a bit dangerous having
Akazukin express her
hatred in such a way...)
fields.JP:
（でも、憎しみを剥き出しにしている
　赤ずきんはどこか危うい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, it's a bit dangerous having
Red Riding Hood express her
hatred in such a way...)

fields.EN:
I suppose things would've been
different if we knew what
Blood Skelter was all about...
fields.JP:
確かに、ブラッドスケルター化のことさえ
先に知っていたら……って思っちゃうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose things would've been
different if we knew what
Blood Skelter was all about...

fields.EN:
True... I know it can't be helped,
and it is what it is, but...
fields.JP:
うん……やっぱり僕も、
仕方ないことだと分かってても
そう考えずにはいられないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True... I know it can't be helped,
and it is what it is, but...

fields.JP:
（だってそれをもし知っていたら……
　あの明るかった赤ずきんのままで
　いられたかもしれないんだから……）

ぎぎ……ばや……ぐ……
いが…………なぎゃ…………

fields.EN: (This is all I can do now...)
fields.LOCALIZED: (This is all I can do now...)

fields.EN:
(I need to head up...
I need to hurry and go up...!)
fields.JP:
（だから上へ……
　早く上へ行くんだ……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to head up...
I need to hurry and go up...!)

fields.JP:
（もしかしたら……
　叶うかもしれないんだから……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I head up...
then my wish may come true...!)

fields.EN:
(The Metropolitan Building area
isn't fully grown yet...)
fields.JP:
（この都庁ジェイルは、
　まだ完全には伸びきっていない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Metropolitan Building area
isn't fully grown yet...)

fields.EN:
(After all the time getting
up here, too...!)
fields.JP:
（せっかくここまで
　上がってきたっていうのに……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After all the time getting
up here, too...!)

fields.JP:
（いや、駄目だ！
　ここで諦めてたまるもんか！！）

（この血をもって
　ジェイルよ育て、育て……！）

fields.EN:
(Go high... Reach the heavens!
Grant me the Witchcraft!)
fields.JP:
（とどけ、とどけ……天までとどけ！
　産まれろ大きなウィッチクラフト！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Go high... Reach the heavens!
Grant me the Witchcraft!)

fields.EN:
Yes. You've already searched
the Jail enough to say there
aren't many places left to search.
fields.JP:
ああ。これまで多くの独房エリアを
探索してきて、残りはそう多くない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. You've already searched
the Jail enough to say there
aren't many places left to search.

fields.EN:
I believe Alice is the only other
Blood Maiden remaining, yes?
fields.JP:
そして残す血式少女も、
アリスという少女だけだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe Alice is the only other
Blood Maiden remaining, yes?

fields.EN:
True. I haven't heard anything
else of any other Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
他に血式少女の可能性がある、
という人間の情報は確かに聞かないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. I haven't heard anything
else of any other Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
If so, I suggest searching for
Alice, while checking out the
tower. Sounds good?
fields.JP:
であれば、ここらでアリスの捜索と並行して
監獄塔の調査も視野に入れてみる……
……というのはどうだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, I suggest searching for
Alice, while checking out the
tower. Sounds good?

fields.EN:
We've been putting emphasis on
protecting ourselves, so this time
we're going on the offensive, huh?
fields.JP:
今までは守ってばかりだったが、
少しずつ攻めに転じようってことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've been putting emphasis on
protecting ourselves, so this time
we're going on the offensive, huh?

fields.EN:
Heh...
Sounds like my kind of plan.
fields.JP: へっ……嫌いじゃねえぜ、そういうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
Sounds like my kind of plan.

fields.EN:
We do have a lot of the Blood
Maidens with us now, so I guess
we can take things a step further.
fields.JP:
そうだね、血式少女は
順調に集まってくれてる。
ここらで動き出してもいいと思うね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We do have a lot of the Blood
Maidens with us now, so I guess
we can take things a step further.

fields.EN:
Of course, nothing too drastic.
We can take things safely and
one step at a time, too.
fields.JP:
もちろん無理のない程度でいい。
慎重に攻めていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, nothing too drastic.
We can take things safely and
one step at a time, too.

fields.JP: 分かった、その計画でいこう

fields.EN:
If this goes well, then we'll
be able to finally get a place
where we can sleep safe, right?
fields.JP:
これが上手くいけば、安眠できる
世界がゲットできるってわけっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this goes well, then we'll
be able to finally get a place
where we can sleep safe, right?

fields.EN:
Uh, you can sleep anywhere...
Not like you've been sleepless
or anything...
fields.JP:
今だってタクミは充分に
爆睡してるじゃねーか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you can sleep anywhere...
Not like you've been sleepless
or anything...

fields.EN:
Things seem a lot more
hopeful than ever before.
fields.JP: でもほんと、希望が見えてきたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things seem a lot more
hopeful than ever before.

fields.EN:
Yeah, back then we didn't have the
luxury of checking out the tower.
fields.JP:
うん。最初の頃は
監獄塔の調査どころじゃなかったしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, back then we didn't have the
luxury of checking out the tower.

fields.EN:
It took a bit to find this place,
and to get everything set up,
right?
fields.JP:
この場所を見つけるのも、
立て直していくのも大変だったでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It took a bit to find this place,
and to get everything set up,
right?

fields.EN:
Yes... But we found this place
only because Hameln offered the
location to us.
fields.JP:
そうだね……でもこの場所に
拠点を構えることができたのは、
ハーメルンのおかげだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... But we found this place
only because Hameln offered the
location to us.

fields.EN:
Indeed! I was graceful enough to
offer my personal abode!
fields.JP:
うむ、これもひとえにワレが
住処を提供してやったおかげである！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I was graceful enough to
offer my personal abode!

fields.EN:
Well, it is true that we wouldn't
be here without Hameln...
fields.JP:
まあハーメルンの助けがなかったら、
僕たちは今ここで暮らせてないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is true that we wouldn't
be here without Hameln...

fields.EN:
Merun lets Rapunzel and
Jack play together!
fields.JP:
メルンのおかげでラプンツェルは
こうしてジャックとあそべるのー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy lets Rapunzel and
Jack play together!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Rapu, you sure like riding
on Jack's shoulder, don't you?
fields.JP:
ラプはジャックの肩に乗るの、
本当に好きですわねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, you sure like riding
on Jack's shoulder, don't you?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Well, it's only possible to see
everyone so light-hearted because
our new base has been growing.
fields.JP:
ま、こんな平和な光景も、この新しい拠点が
しっかりと発展してくれたおかげだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's only possible to see
everyone so light-hearted because
our new base has been growing.

fields.EN:
So, do we know exactly how to get
to the Jail Tower's entrance?
fields.JP:
それで、監獄塔の入り口は
どこにあるのか分かってるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, do we know exactly how to get
to the Jail Tower's entrance?

fields.EN:
Yes, you can access the entrance
from the City Streets area or
through the Graveyard area.
fields.JP:
ああ、１つは『元街道沿いエリア』で、
もう１つは『元墓所エリア』にある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you can access the entrance
from the City Streets area or
through the Graveyard area.

fields.EN:
That means the closest way in
would be through the City
Streets area.
fields.JP:
そして最も近いのは、
元街道沿いエリアにある入り口だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means the closest way in
would be through the City
Streets area.

fields.EN:
It's been a long while since
I heard that area's name.
fields.JP:
何だか久しぶりに聞いたね、
その場所の名前
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's been a long while since
I heard that area's name.

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, it's where we all sort
of got separated.
fields.JP:
そっか、あたしたちがバラバラに
なったあの場所か……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, it's where we all sort
of got separated.

fields.EN:
Yeah... It's also where we met
Jack and Alice.
fields.JP:
うん……それと、ジャックとアリスに
初めて出会ったあの場所だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It's also where we met
Jack and Alice.

fields.EN:
Don't forget that we were kept
in prison there, too.
fields.JP:
俺たちだって
あそこに捕えられていたんだぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't forget that we were kept
in prison there, too.

fields.EN:
Yeah, at first you suddenly splashed that
strange liquid on me, Otsuu-kun.
fields.JP:
そうそう、最初はおつうくんに
いきなり得体の知れない液体かけられたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember how you splashed
that weird liquid thingy on me.

fields.EN:
No, I'm not mad! If you and the others hadn't
been there, Otsuu-kun, I probably wouldn't
be alive.
fields.JP:
ううん、怒ってないってば！
おつうくんたちがいなかったら、
私きっと生きてなかったもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no, I'm not angry or anything!
If you girls weren't there we
wouldn't have made it out alive.

fields.EN:
So, I guess we're going there
again, eh?
fields.JP: そっか……あの場所に行くんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I guess we're going there
again, eh?

fields.EN:
We're not stopping by the old
Liberated District, right?
fields.JP:
……まさか元解放地区に
立ち寄ったりなんてしないよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not stopping by the old
Liberated District, right?

fields.EN:
Don't worry about that.
We won't go by there.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、大丈夫だ。
あの場所には立ち寄らないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry about that.
We won't go by there.

fields.EN:
To add, the direction to which
the Nightmare ran is blocked.
I doubt anything has changed.
fields.JP:
それに、謎のナイトメアが
逃げた方向の道は塞いでしまったからね。
元解放地区の近くすら通らないかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, the direction to which
the Nightmare ran is blocked.
I doubt anything has changed.

fields.EN:
She's right. You'll have to find
a different way through the area.
fields.JP:
そうだ。元街道沿いエリアと言っても、
別のルートを走破することになるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. You'll have to find
a different way through the area.

fields.EN:
Yes, so there's no real reason
for us to go through the old
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
うん。だから元解放地区は、
今回は無関係だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so there's no real reason
for us to go through the old
Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Wait a sec. Wasn't there an
entrance along the Art Alley area?
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って、旧芸術通りエリアの方にも
監獄塔への入り口はあったじゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a sec. Wasn't there an
entrance along the Art Alley area?

fields.EN:
That's right. Wouldn't it be faster to go
toward where onee-sama-tachi are?
fields.JP:
そうですよ、お姉様たちがいる方から
行けば近いんじゃないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Isn't it faster to
just go through there?
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii kinship form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
I thought you folks would know
better since you already searched
that area.
fields.JP:
あなたたち、一緒にあの場所の調査には
行ったのだから分かるでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you folks would know
better since you already searched
that area.

fields.EN:
There was a wall that prevented
you from heading towards the
tower's entrance, yes?
fields.JP:
あの監獄塔の入り口は、
壁のせいで正面に回りこめない造りに
なっていたでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There was a wall that prevented
you from heading towards the
tower's entrance, yes?

fields.EN: Yeah. So to get around to the front of the Jail Tower, we have no choice but to head for the two entrances I mentioned.
fields.JP:
ああ、だから監獄塔正面に
回り込むには、さっき言った２つの
入り口に向かうしかないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, so the only way to get to the
entrance is through the two areas
I mentioned.

fields.EN:
I see... So I guess we'll be
heading through the
City Streets then.
fields.JP:
なるほど……では元街道沿いエリアに
向かうということで決定ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... So I guess we'll be
heading through the
City Streets then.

fields.EN:
Well, you know about how things
may have been different if we knew
about Blood Skelter?
fields.JP:
いや……あの時さ、ちゃんと
ブラッドスケルター化のことを
知っていれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you know about how things
may have been different if we knew
about Blood Skelter?

fields.EN:
Maybe things would've been
different with how we approached
Alice, too...
fields.JP:
そうしたら、アリスに対してもっと違う、
的確な対応ができたんじゃないかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe things would've been
different with how we approached
Alice, too...

fields.JP: おねーちゃんのせいじゃないよ……

fields.EN:
She's right. What happened then
was unavoidable.
fields.JP:
そうだぞ赤ずきん。
あれは仕方のないことだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. What happened then
was unavoidable.

fields.JP: それに……もう過ぎてしまったことだよ
（確かに僕だって、何回もそう思った……）

fields.EN:
(Maybe we could have avoided
what happened back then if we
knew about Blood Skelter.)
fields.JP:
（ブラッドスケルター化のことを
　知ってさえいれば、悲劇を回避
　できたかもしれない……って）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe we could have avoided
what happened back then if we
knew about Blood Skelter.)

fields.EN:
We simply didn't know anything
then... That's all...
fields.JP:
あの時は僕たちは何も知らなかった……
……知らなかったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We simply didn't know anything
then... That's all...

fields.EN:
Yup... The best we can do now is
pray that Alice-san is okay.
fields.JP:
うん……今はただ、
アリスさんが無事であることを祈ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... The best we can do now is
pray that Alice is okay.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック
おい、落ちつくんだジャック！

（どうしたんだ……！？
　ジャックの心に激しい感情が入り乱れて
　これは、愛しさと……焦燥……？）

fields.EN:
(He hasn't reacted like this
before, even when we brought
Alice's name up...)
fields.JP:
（今まではアリスの名を聞いても、
　動揺することはなかったのに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He hasn't reacted like this
before, even when we brought
Alice's name up...)

fields.EN:
(I guess he was worried
about Alice all along.)
fields.JP:
（いや、違う。
　本当はずっとアリスのことが
　気がかりだったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess he was worried
about Alice all along.)

fields.EN:
(Despite his changed form, he
still thinks and cares of Alice.)
fields.JP:
（こんな姿になってしまって、
　言葉もろくに話せなくなっても、
　ジャックはアリスを想い続けている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite his changed form, he
still thinks and cares of Alice.)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack, it'll be all right.
We'll find Alice for sure.
fields.JP:
……ジャック、大丈夫だ。
アリスは必ず見つける
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, it'll be all right.
We'll find Alice for sure.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I owe you one for saving Princess.
I will repay what I owe,
I promise.
fields.JP:
気にするな。
君は身を挺して姫を守ってくれた。
僕は、借りは必ず返す主義だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I owe you one for saving Princess.
I will repay what I owe,
I promise.

fields.EN:
(I won't let anything separate
Jack and Alice...)
fields.JP:
（ジャックとアリス……
　二人の絆を壊させやしない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I won't let anything separate
Jack and Alice...)

fields.EN:
I know it wasnt that long ago,
but it almost feels like it's been
ages...
fields.JP:
そんなに大昔のことじゃないのに、
なんかとても懐かしい気持ちになる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it wasnt that long ago,
but it almost feels like it's been
ages...

fields.EN:
That simply means we've
been through a lot since then.
fields.JP:
それだけ僕たちにとって、
長く険しい道のりだったってことさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That simply means we've
been through a lot since then.

fields.EN:
Yup... I remember how we had
to do our best to survive...
fields.JP:
うん……大変だったね
いつだって死と隣り合わせで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... I remember how we had
to do our best to survive...

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.
fields.JP:
ご安心ください、姫。
何があろうと僕が必ず守ってみせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, my princess.
I'll protect you no matter what.

fields.EN:
Heh... I haven't heard you
say that for awhile...
fields.JP:
あ、そのセリフ……
ふふっ、懐かしいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I haven't heard you
say that for awhile...

fields.EN:
I'll say it as many times as you
please. I will protect you...
no matter what.
fields.JP:
……何度だって言うよ、姫。
何があろうと、僕が必ず守ってみせる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll say it as many times as you
please. I will protect you...
no matter what.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sure you will.
Thank you...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sure you will.
Thank you...

fields.EN:
Hm, those two are
as usual it seems.
fields.JP: うむ、２人は相変わらずだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, those two are
as usual it seems.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're saying that
out in the open like this.
fields.JP: 人目もはばからず何やってんのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're saying that
out in the open like this.

fields.EN:
Yes, your investment in her is
quite intriguing.
fields.JP: 本当、興味深い関係性ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, your investment in her is
quite intriguing.

fields.EN:
That aside, we need to be wary
of Marchens around the area.
fields.JP:
とにかくみんな、
不意のメルヒェンに気をつけて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, we need to be wary
of Marchens around the area.

fields.EN:
Not very good at changing
the subject, are you?
fields.JP: 話逸らすの、下手ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not very good at changing
the subject, are you?

fields.EN:
(Usually Akazukin would
be the one to say something
snarky, but...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、前はこういう時、
　赤ずきんが絶対ちゃちゃを入れたのに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Usually Red Riding Hood would
be the one to say something
snarky, but...)

fields.EN:
(I know why she isn't doing
that now...)
fields.JP: （いや、理由は分かってるけどね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know why she isn't doing
that now...)

fields.JP: ナイトメアが来ましたわ……！

fields.EN:
We didn't find the core yet,
so...
fields.JP:
みんな、今回はまだ
核を見つけていない、だから――
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't find the core yet,
so...

fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
出たなナイトメア……！

fields.EN:
Stop it, Akazukin!
We can't beat the Nightmare yet!
fields.JP:
おいやめるんだ赤ずきん！
今のナイトメアには勝ち目はない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it, Red Riding Hood!
We can't beat the Nightmare yet!

fields.EN:
I'll kill it...!
I'll kill all Nightmares!
fields.JP:
殺してやる……！
ナイトメアは全部殺してやるっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll kill it...!
I'll kill all Nightmares!

fields.JP: 落ちつくんだ赤ずきん！

fields.EN:
Lemme go!
I need to kill it!
fields.JP: 放して！　あいつを殺さないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lemme go!
I need to kill it!

fields.EN:
Oh? Still in Blood Skelter?
I suppose we need to draw some
blood from Jack for you then.
fields.JP:
あら、もしかしてまだ
ブラッドスケルター状態だって言うなら、
ジャックの血を借りなければならないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Still in Blood Skelter?
I suppose we need to draw some
blood from Jack for you then.

fields.EN:
Shut up! I'm fine!
Just let me go!
fields.JP:
うるさい！　あたしは正気だ！
だから放せってば！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up! I'm fine!
Just let me go!

fields.EN:
If you're fine, then you know
there's no way to beat it now!
fields.JP:
だったら今はナイトメアが倒せないって
分かるでしょう、おねーちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're fine, then you know
there's no way to beat it now!

fields.EN:
Tch... Next time...
I'll kill that Nightmare!
fields.JP:
くっ……次は……
次は絶対殺してやるっ……ナイトメア……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... Next time...
I'll kill that Nightmare!

fields.EN:
All right, everyone!
Let's make a run for it!
fields.JP:
よしみんな！
ナイトメアから逃げきるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, everyone!
Let's make a run for it!

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
We somehow lost it...
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
何とか逃げ切れましたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
We somehow lost it...

fields.JP: 今回も……きつかったです……

fields.EN:
Tch! I can't believe all we can
do is run from that thing!
fields.JP:
くっ……ナイトメアを目の前にしながら、
逃げるしかできないなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch! I can't believe all we can
do is run from that thing!

fields.JP:
（赤ずきん……あんなに
　目を血走らせて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood's eyes are
completely bloodshot...)

fields.EN:
(I know hatred disappears
slowly, but her hatred seems
to be growing stronger...)
fields.JP:
（憎しみが簡単に消えないのは分かる。
　でも赤ずきんのは……膨らみ続ける
　一方な気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know hatred disappears
slowly, but her hatred seems
to be growing stronger...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
I'm really sorry, but...
fields.JP:
ごめんねみんな……
申し訳ないって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I'm really sorry, but...

fields.EN:
I can't hold myself back...
I can't hold back the anger
when I see that Nightmare...
fields.JP:
でも、どうしても止められないの。
ナイトメアを見ると怒りが湧いて来て
自分が抑えられなくなる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't hold myself back...
I can't hold back the anger
when I see that Nightmare...

fields.EN:
I know I can't beat it yet.
But, this urge to kill just
rises up from inside me!
fields.JP:
倒せないなんて頭では分かってるんだ。
でも、殺してやりたい衝動が、身体を勝手に
動かしてしまうの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I can't beat it yet.
But, this urge to kill just
rises up from inside me!

fields.EN:
I believe your feelings are just,
Aka-neesama. The Nightmares have
taken much from us...
fields.JP:
赤姉様の怒りは、
とてもまっとうな感情だとは思います。
大切な人の仇ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe your feelings are just,
sister Red. The Nightmares have
taken much from us...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
But, it isn't like you to charge
at it knowing you can't win...
fields.JP:
でも、倒せないって分かってて
突撃するなんておねーちゃんらしくない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it isn't like you to charge
at it knowing you can't win...

fields.EN:
Aka-nee, you're our leader.
I know how you feel, but...
fields.JP:
あ、赤姉はみんなのリーダーみたいな
存在じゃないの。気持ちは分かるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red, you're our leader.
I know how you feel, but...
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
My anger isn't only towards
Nightmares. I'm angry about
myself, too.
fields.JP:
この怒りは……ナイトメアだけじゃない。
あたし自身にも向かってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My anger isn't only towards
Nightmares. I'm angry about
myself, too.

fields.EN:
I always rushed into action
without worry, and that was
because I knew I was strong.
fields.JP:
前のあたしは、いつも自信満々で
すぐ先走って迷惑をかけてた
それだけ腕に自信があったんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always rushed into action
without worry, and that was
because I knew I was strong.

fields.EN:
I thought I would be the one to
protect Dawn, but look what
happened...
fields.JP:
黎明はあたしが守る、なんて思ってた。
なのに、結果はご覧の通りさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I would be the one to
protect Dawn, but look what
happened...

fields.EN:
I couldn't protect anyone,
so instead, I'm going to kill
all Nightmares!
fields.JP:
そうだ、あたしは何も守れなかった
だから……今度こそ……！
あいつらを皆殺しにしてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't protect anyone,
so instead, I'm going to kill
all Nightmares!

fields.JP:
あ……ご、ごめん。
あたしはまた……

fields.EN:
How pathetic not being able to
hold yourself back! And you call
yourself my rival?!
fields.JP:
我慢ができないとは、
ワレのライバルのくせに情けないぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How pathetic not being able to
hold yourself back! And you call
yourself my rival?!

fields.EN:
Oh? You're not the best at
holding things back too, you know?
fields.JP:
あら、ハーメルンも充分
自分を制御できてない気がするけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You're not the best at
holding things back too, you know?

fields.JP: そ、そんなことはないっ！

fields.EN:
Heh... Hameln's right. I can't
hold myself back, even if I know
I'm causing trouble to everyone.
fields.JP:
はは、ハーメルンの言うとおり、
みんなに迷惑がかかると分かってても
あたしは我慢すらできない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Hameln's right. I can't
hold myself back, even if I know
I'm causing trouble to everyone.

fields.EN:
(It looks like she's trying to
absolve herself of how she
wasn't able to help...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……赤ずきんは無意識に
　無力な自分ごと精算したくて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like she's trying to
absolve herself of how she
wasn't able to help...)

fields.JP: 赤ずきんの気持ちは分かるよ

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean I agree with
you, though. You only looked like
you were heading in to die.
fields.JP:
でも共感まではできない。だって、
死にたがっているようにすら見えるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean I agree with
you, though. You only looked like
you were heading in to die.

fields.EN:
You dying isn't going to absolve
you of anything. Remember that.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんがいなくなっても、
何も精算することはできないんだ
それだけは覚えておいてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You dying isn't going to absolve
you of anything. Remember that.

fields.JP: おつうちゃんの言う通りだよ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I can only hope you don't go
jumping into danger like before.
fields.JP:
せめて自ら危険に飛び込んでいくような
ことだけはしないでほしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope you don't go
jumping into danger like before.

fields.EN:
I don't know what I'd do if
you were to die...
fields.JP:
だってわたしは、
おねーちゃんが死んじゃうのなんて
絶対イヤだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what I'd do if
you were to die...

fields.EN:
Everyone likes you, Aka-nee.
Don't waste your life in vain.
fields.JP:
そうよ。みんな赤姉のことが
大好きなんだから、命を粗末にしないでよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone likes you, sister Red.
Don't waste your life in vain.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
If you sincerely care for others,
you should care for yourself
no differently.
fields.JP:
仲間のことを大切に思うなら、
まずは自分のことを大切にするべきね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you sincerely care for others,
you should care for yourself
no differently.

fields.EN:
They're right, Akazukin.
Just stay calm, and take better
care of yourself.
fields.JP:
そうだぞ赤ずきん。
もうそんな判断はしないで、
自分を大事にしてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're right, Red Riding Hood.
Just stay calm, and take better
care of yourself.

fields.EN:
Everyone is important to me,
so I'll take care of myself
in just the same way.
fields.JP:
あたしはみんなが大切。だから
自分のことも、ちゃんと大切にする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone is important to me,
so I'll take care of myself
in just the same way.

fields.EN:
Please do. We're stronger than
ever now that you're here.
fields.JP:
よろしく頼むよ。赤ずきんがいれば
百人力なんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please do. We're stronger than
ever now that you're here.

fields.EN:
(She's not like her former
self now...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり赤ずきんの奴、
　相当影が濃くなってるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not like her former
self now...)

fields.EN: (Someone close to her was brutally murdered, so I can't blame her, but...)
fields.JP:
（親しい人を無残に殺されたんだ、
　仕方ないけれど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose seeing your loved ones
dead would tarnish your very
self, but...)

fields.EN:
(I really hope she comes back
to her usual lively self again...)
fields.JP:
（でもやっぱり、僕は以前の
　赤ずきんに戻ってほしいよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I really hope she comes back
to her usual lively self again...)

fields.EN:
Something somewhere got
twisted when Dawn... No...
Even before...
fields.JP:
みんながどこか歪みを抱えるように
なってしまったのは……黎明が……
いや、それよりずっと前から……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something somewhere got
twisted when Dawn... No...
Even before...

fields.JP: あら、何を考えているのかしら？

fields.EN:
Well, I was just thinking why
everyone changed so much...
fields.JP:
いや……どうしてみんな、こんなに
以前と変わってしまったんだろうって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was just thinking why
everyone changed so much...

fields.EN: Ah... you mean the chain of unfortunate accidents that happened to the Blood Maidens, which we discussed before.
fields.JP:
ああ……以前話した、血式少女に起きた
不幸な事故の連鎖についてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, we're going back to the
subject of how everything is
linked, yes?

fields.EN:
It was just that, maybe there is
something that caused all this.
fields.JP: 何か原因があるのかな、なんて思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was just that, maybe there is
something that caused all this.

fields.EN:
Kaguya, why did you have to put up
a front like before again?
fields.JP:
かぐやはどうして
あんな風にキャラクターを作らなければ
ならなくなったんだっけ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, why did you have to put up
a front like before again?

fields.EN:
Well, it was because Cinderella-san
and the Oyayubihime-san sisters all
went missing.
fields.JP:
それは……シンデレラさんがいなくなり、
さらには親指姫さんたち三姉妹まで
いなくなってしまったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it was because Cinderella
and the Thumbelina sisters all
went missing.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san; 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
What?! So you're saying we
caused your problems?!
fields.JP:
何よ、わたしたちの
せいだって言いたいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! So you're saying we
caused your problems?!

fields.EN:
N-Not at all!
That's not what I was...
fields.JP:
ちっ、違いますっ！
そういう意味じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Not at all!
That's not what I was...

fields.EN:
Calm down, Oyayubi. No one
is blaming you for anything.
fields.JP:
落ち着け親指。
君たちのせいだって言ってるわけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Thumby. No one
is blaming you for anything.

fields.EN:
What she wanted to say was that
your disappearance triggered her
anxiety.
fields.JP:
正しく言えば親指姫たちのせいではなく、
親指姫たちがいなくなったことによる
不安のせい、ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What she wanted to say was that
your disappearance triggered her
anxiety.

fields.EN:
That's why Kaguya made a fake
front to avoid being kicked out
of Dawn.
fields.JP:
それで残されたかぐやちゃんは、
捨てられないようにキャラクターを
作らなきゃいけなかったんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why Kaguya made a fake
front to avoid being kicked out
of Dawn.

fields.EN:
So, what led you sisters
to do all of that again?
fields.JP:
じゃあ親指たち三姉妹が
あんな風になってしまったのは……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what led you sisters
to do all of that again?

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: あんな風、ってどんな風よ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
She's referring to how you keep
questioning others with doubt,
just like that.
fields.JP: 貴様のその疑り深い性格のことであろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's referring to how you keep
questioning others with doubt,
just like that.

fields.EN:
If I recall correctly, you kept
questioning and doubting every
single thing we said.
fields.JP:
なんせワレたちの話を信じないで、
いちいちケチをつけてきたものな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I recall correctly, you kept
questioning and doubting every
single thing we said.

fields.EN:
Only now I learned that you
weren't like that before.
fields.JP:
聞けば昔はああではなかった、
というではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only now I learned that you
weren't like that before.

fields.EN:
That was only because I was
worried about Shirayuki and Nemu!
fields.JP: あれは白雪とネムが心配で……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was only because I was
worried about Snow White and Sleepy!

fields.EN:
And that was causing a lot of
problems to everyone else. That's
why we went against you!
fields.JP:
それでみなさんに迷惑をかけるから、
白雪たちは反発したんですよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that was causing a lot of
problems to everyone else. That's
why we went against you!

fields.JP: けんかはだめだってばー！

fields.EN:
Yes, we're trying to analyze the
situation, so it'd be best we hold
our thoughts to ourselves.
fields.JP:
そうね、話が進まないから
いちいちけんか腰にならないでほしいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we're trying to analyze the
situation, so it'd be best we hold
our thoughts to ourselves.

fields.EN: We're simply examining possible causes. So everyone, don't make a fuss just because someone's name comes up. Understood?
fields.JP:
単純に原因を考察しているだけよ。
だからみんな、名前が挙がっても
騒がないこと。いいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, the next person we call out,
please be a bit more calm.
Understood?

fields.EN:
Yes, we're not doing this to
place blame or anything.
fields.JP:
うん、責めたり糾弾したりする
つもりじゃないからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we're not doing this to
place blame or anything.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's go back to what
happened to the Oyayubi sisters.
fields.JP:
もう一度、親指たちに起こったことから、
辿ってみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's go back to what
happened to the Thumbelina sisters.

fields.JP:
親指姉様が変わってしまったのは、
シンデレラさんがいなくなったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina changed because
Cinderella disappeared.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP:
違……う……
それ……誤解、だった……！

fields.EN:
Yes, you're fine, Cinderella.
We made the wrong call
accusing you.
fields.JP:
ええ。シンデレラ、あんたは悪くない。
わたしが勝手に勘違いしたせいだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you're fine, Cinderella.
We made the wrong call
accusing you.

fields.EN:
No one is at fault, yet it looks
like all sorts of bad are linking
together...
fields.JP:
さっきから……お互いに罪はないのに、
勝手に不幸が連鎖していくんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one is at fault, yet it looks
like all sorts of bad are linking
together...

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime's misfortune to the
three sisters' misfortune,
and then on to Cinderella...
fields.JP:
かぐや姫は三姉妹がいなくなったから
三姉妹はシンデレラがいなくなったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya's misfortune to the
three sisters' misfortune,
and then on to Cinderella...

fields.EN:
Well, my misunderstanding of
the Professor's words led me
to my misfortune.
fields.JP:
わたしが博士の言葉を
変にとらえてしまったせいですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, my misunderstanding of
the Professor's words led me
to my misfortune.

fields.EN: I misunderstood 'seven Blood Maidens are needed' as meaning anyone beyond seven—eight or more—would be discarded...
fields.JP:
『血式少女は７人必要』という
言葉を、８人以上は切り捨てるものだと
かんちがいしてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought the Professor only
needed seven Blood Maidens.
Which is why...

fields.EN:
...she caved in to pressure
and left Dawn.
fields.JP:
そのプレッシャーでシンデレラは
黎明を飛び出してしまった、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
...she caved in to pressure
and left Dawn.

fields.EN:
I see... That makes sense.
Cinderella wasn't faring very
well with us back then.
fields.JP:
なるほどね……
あの頃のシンデレラは確かにまだ不慣れで、
成績はよくなかったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... That makes sense.
Cinderella wasn't faring very
well with us back then.

fields.EN:
But if that's the case, then her
pressure was caused by us.
fields.JP:
でもそうすると、
シンデレラのプレッシャーの原因は、
結局は僕たちなんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if that's the case, then her
pressure was caused by us.

fields.EN:
Hm... But, if you all knew about
Blood Skelter, none of this
would've happened, yes?
fields.JP:
ふむ……そもそもなのだが、
ブラッドスケルターのことを知っておれば
こじれはしなかったのではないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... But, if you all knew about
Blood Skelter, none of this
would've happened, yes?

fields.EN:
Well yes, but...
I'm surprised you actually think
about things.
fields.JP:
ごもっともだけど……
あんたに言われるとはビックリね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well yes, but...
I'm surprised you actually think
about things.

fields.EN:
That's quite rude!
Of course I think!
fields.JP:
無礼な奴だな！
ワレだってそのくらい分かるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite rude!
Of course I think!

fields.EN:
The Professor had some knowledge
of Blood Skelter, but still lacked
the details.
fields.JP:
博士はブラッドスケルター化について、
手がかりまでは掴んでいたみたいだけど、
はっきりとは分かっていなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Professor had some knowledge
of Blood Skelter, but still lacked
the details.

fields.EN:
Which is why he didn't let us
know, right, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
だから安易には公表できなかった……
そうだよね、おつう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why he didn't let us
know, right, Otsuu?

fields.EN:
Yeah... He could've only
researched so far without
Jack's blood.
fields.JP:
うん。ジャックの血もない状況では、
調べるにも限界があるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... He could've only
researched so far without
Jack's blood.

fields.EN:
No one here if Jack blood
not here! Right, Jack?
fields.JP:
じゃっくのちがなかったら、
いまみんなでここにいないもんね！
ねーじゃっく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one here if Jack blood
not here! Right, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぐぎ……あり……が……
らぶん……ぜる……

fields.EN:
I know it can't be helped,
but...
fields.JP:
でも……こんなこと言っても
仕方ないのは分かってるんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it can't be helped,
but...

fields.EN:
If only we knew about Blood
Skelter beforehand...
fields.JP:
やっぱり、ブラッドスケルター化を
知っていればって思っちゃうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we knew about Blood
Skelter beforehand...

fields.EN:
Yes... If we did know that, then
we may have been able to help
Alice back then.
fields.JP:
まあね……それを知っていたら、
アリスがブラッドスケルター化した時だって
ちゃんと対処できたかもしれないからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... If we did know that, then
we may have been able to help
Alice back then.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ああ、ごめんジャック。
なんでもないんだよ
もしもをいくつ並べても意味はないわ

fields.EN:
I know, but I still wonder how
things would've been if we
would've known...
fields.JP:
だとしても、思ってしまうんだ。
もしもあの時、ああしていれば、
……失わずにすんだんじゃないかって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, but I still wonder how
things would've been if we
would've known...

fields.EN:
(If we would've known then
we could've saved many from
their pains...)
fields.JP:
（知っていれば救えたって
　ことは事実だから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we would've known then
we could've saved many from
their pains...)

fields.EN:
(Just thinking about this makes
me feel like we're all at
fault...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、こんな風に考えていくと
　自分たちが責められてる気分になる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just thinking about this makes
me feel like we're all at
fault...)

fields.EN:
(I almost feel as if not knowing
is a sin in itself...)
fields.JP:
（まるで気づけなかったことが
　罪なんじゃないかって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I almost feel as if not knowing
is a sin in itself...)

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, we haven't
encountered that mysterious
Nightmare since...
fields.JP:
そういえば最近はあの
謎のナイトメアに遭遇しないですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, we haven't
encountered that mysterious
Nightmare since...

fields.JP: かぐやーはあいつにあいたいのー？

fields.EN:
O-Of course not! If we don't have
to, I'd rather not see it again.
fields.JP:
ま、まさかっ！　遭わずに済むなら
それがいいに決まってます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course not! If we don't have
to, I'd rather not see it again.

fields.EN:
I can only hope we don't bump
into it ever again.
fields.JP:
曲がり角で突然バッタリ、
なんてことが起こらないでほしいものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only hope we don't bump
into it ever again.

fields.JP: そ、そんな恐ろしい敵なんですの……？

fields.EN:
Yeah... Even with all of us here
I'm sure some of us would
fall against it...
fields.JP:
うん……戦えばこの中から死人が出ても
おかしくないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Even with all of us here
I'm sure some of us would
fall against it...

fields.JP: 確かに尋常じゃなく強かったね

fields.EN:
Which is why I was sort of glad
you girls weren't there when
the Liberated District fell.
fields.JP:
だから正直なところ、前の解放地区が
壊滅させられた時、おつうたちがいなくて
よかったって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why I was sort of glad
you girls weren't there when
the Liberated District fell.

fields.EN:
If you and Ningyo were gone,
who knows what I would've done...?
fields.JP:
おつうや人魚まで失ってたら、
あたしはもう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you and Mermie were gone,
who knows what I would've done...?

fields.EN:
(We were oddly fortunate enough
to be in the underground caverns
back then.)
fields.JP:
（不幸中の幸いというべきか、
　その時、僕たちは地下洞窟エリアにいた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We were oddly fortunate enough
to be in the underground caverns
back then.)

fields.EN:
(That kept us away from that
mysterious Nightmare, but...)
fields.JP:
（おかげで謎のナイトメアに出くわさずに
　すんだのだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That kept us away from that
mysterious Nightmare, but...)

fields.EN:
Something about it is different
from all the other Nightmares
we've faced thus far.
fields.JP:
あいつは、これまで戦ってきた
どのナイトメアとも違う気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something about it is different
from all the other Nightmares
we've faced thus far.

fields.EN:
You're right... It was
unbelievably strong, and spread
destruction like it was nothing.
fields.JP:
そうだね。あんなに容赦も躊躇もなく
破壊の限りを尽くせるなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... It was
unbelievably strong, and spread
destruction like it was nothing.

fields.EN:
Even I knew it was quite
formidable just by looking at it.
fields.JP:
確かにワレも見ただけで
こいつはかなりの強敵だと思えたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even I knew it was quite
formidable just by looking at it.

fields.EN:
Well, it's not just its power...
I can't really explain it, though.
fields.JP:
あいつの破格の強さもそうなんだけど、
僕はもっと別の何かを感じる。
上手く説明できないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's not just its power...
I can't really explain it, though.

fields.EN:
I think you've got the right
thought there.
fields.JP: そのカンは間違っていないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you've got the right
thought there.

fields.EN:
The actions it took are much
different from the others.
An anomaly, even among them.
fields.JP:
あれの行動パターンは他のナイトメアと
あまりに違う。かなり異質な存在だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The actions it took are much
different from the others.
An anomaly, even among them.

fields.EN:
Yes... I mean, normal Nightmares
don't leave their designated area,
right?
fields.JP:
そうですよね……だって普通ナイトメアは、
根城にしてるエリアから出ないんですよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I mean, normal Nightmares
don't leave their designated area,
right?

fields.EN:
Yes, and that was the only
Nightmare to be found out of
an area...
fields.JP:
あの謎のナイトメア以外には
見たことはないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and that was the only
Nightmare to be found out of
an area...

fields.EN:
You make it sound like you've met
it a number of times, but you
haven't fought it yourself?
fields.JP:
でもさ、おつう。聞いたかぎりじゃ、
あんたたちは何度も遭遇してるんでしょ？
なのに、一度も戦ったことないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You make it sound like you've met
it a number of times, but you
haven't fought it yourself?

fields.EN:
That's because we ran knowing
we can't defeat it...
fields.JP: それは、戦っても勝てないから逃げて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because we ran knowing
we can't defeat it...

fields.EN:
No, wait...
We're not the ones running...
It was the Nightmare running...
fields.JP:
……いや、違う。
逃げているのは僕たちじゃない。
謎のナイトメアの方だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, wait...
We're not the ones running...
It was the Nightmare running...

fields.EN:
For some reason, that Nightmare
starts running the moment it
sees us...
fields.JP:
あのナイトメア、
何故か僕たちが目の前に現れると
いつも逃げていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For some reason, that Nightmare
starts running the moment it
sees us...

fields.EN: Maybe it knows how strong I am.
fields.JP: ワレの強さを見抜いたのかもしれんな
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe it knows how strong I am.

fields.EN:
I doubt that...
Still, that is peculiar...
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんの強さを見抜いたとかは
ないと思うけど、確かに不思議だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt that...
Still, that is peculiar...

fields.EN:
That really is odd considering the
destruction it brings...
fields.JP:
確かに、動くものは破壊しなければ
気が済まなそうな奴なのにね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That really is odd considering the
destruction it brings...

fields.EN:
Maybe it has something to do
with us?
fields.JP: もしかして僕たちに何かある……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it has something to do
with us?

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
That's just a hunch.
I wish we really knew the truth.
fields.JP:
それが分かれば苦労しないさ。
何なら気のせいかもしれないしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's just a hunch.
I wish we really knew the truth.

fields.EN: But that might be really important. Try to remember anything you can.
fields.JP:
でもそれ、もしかしたらかなり
重要なことかもしれないじゃない。
何でもいいから思い出しなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you said may be pretty darn
important. Try and think of why
it would run from us.

fields.EN:
Even if you can think of
something, there's no way you can
prove it against that Nightmare...
fields.JP:
でも仮に何か思い当たることがあっても、
あの謎のナイトメア相手に実証しようなんて
無謀が過ぎると思います……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you can think of
something, there's no way you can
prove it against that Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki thinks so, too.
If we don't have to encounter it,
I'd rather not.
fields.JP:
それは白雪もそうだと思います。
遭わずに済むなら、遭いたくはないです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White thinks so, too.
If we don't have to encounter it,
I'd rather not.

fields.EN:
C'mon, don't chicken out! It
killed our Dad, you know? We
need to mete vengeance against it!
fields.JP:
そんな弱気でどうするの。
奴はお父さんたちを殺したのよ？
仇を討とうとは思わないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, don't chicken out! It
killed our Dad, you know? We
need to mete vengeance against it!

fields.JP: 赤ずきん、落ち着けって

fields.EN:
Sorry...
I got a little heated.
fields.JP: ごめん……つい、頭に血が上って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry...
I got a little heated.

fields.EN:
What Akazukin said earlier
is right. We should think of why
it ran from us.
fields.JP:
でも赤ずきんの言うとおり、
何かを思い出せるなら、いつか遭遇した
時に役に立つかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What Red Riding Hood said earlier
is right. We should think of why
it ran from us.

fields.EN:
Did anyone sense anything peculiar
when seeing that Nightmare?
fields.JP:
誰かあの謎のナイトメアを見て、
感じたこととかないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did anyone sense anything peculiar
when seeing that Nightmare?

fields.JP: すばやくてこわいやつだった……

fields.EN:
That's unusual hearing you call
a Nightmare "scary."
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルがナイトメアを
怖いと言うのは珍しいけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's unusual hearing you call
a Nightmare "scary."

fields.EN:
Hm, for some reason it sounded
like it was speaking.
fields.JP:
そういえば、ほんの少しだが
言葉を喋っておった気がするのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, for some reason it sounded
like it was speaking.

fields.EN:
Why yes... So maybe it's like
Jack-san or Hansel-san?
fields.JP:
確かに……じゃあジャックさんや
ヘンゼルさんに近い存在なのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes... So maybe it's like
Jack or Hansel?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヘンゼルさん => Hansel-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
But it didn't seem like we could
communicate with it...
fields.JP:
けれど意思疎通ができそうな
感じには見えませんでしたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it didn't seem like we could
communicate with it...

fields.EN:
If it could talk then I'm sure we
could learn more about it.
fields.JP:
会話ができれば謎も少しは
解けるかもしれませんのにね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it could talk then I'm sure we
could learn more about it.

fields.EN:
That Nightmare is like a mass of
living hatred, but right when it
tries to run away...
fields.JP:
そういえば、あのナイトメア、
逃げるまでは、まるで憎悪の塊って
感じだったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare is like a mass of
living hatred, but right when it
tries to run away...

fields.EN: But when it actually fled, that oppressive feeling suddenly vanished. It almost seemed like it was afraid of something...
fields.JP:
でも、いざ逃げるって時には、
重苦しい感情がすっと消え去ってた。
まるで、なにかに怯えてるようにも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I could feel its tension ease,
which is then replaced with a
sense of anxiety and fear.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you can sense all
that from the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
あのナイトメアから
よく気持ちが読み取れますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you can sense all
that from the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
You "think" you felt that, right?
Not like what you said can be
proven.
fields.JP:
あくまで『気がする』でしょ？
仮に確信があっても、わたしたちに
それ証明できないでしょうしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You "think" you felt that, right?
Not like what you said can be
proven.

fields.JP:
まあ……そう言われれば
そうなんだけどね……

fields.EN:
We don't need to prove anything
yet. What's important is that we
share what information we have.
fields.JP:
現段階では実証しようと
しなくてもいいわ。些細な情報でも
共有しておくことが大事なのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't need to prove anything
yet. What's important is that we
share what information we have.

fields.EN:
Well, not that I'm interested in
how a Nightmare feels.
fields.JP:
ま、ナイトメアの気持ちなんて
どうだっていいけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, not that I'm interested in
how a Nightmare feels.

fields.EN:
In particular, that Nightmare is
gonna be killed by me anyway.
fields.JP:
特にあのナイトメアは、
どうせいつか殺すんだしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In particular, that Nightmare is
gonna be killed by me anyway.

fields.EN:
If anyone notices anything, by all
means share it with others.
Now, should we be going?
fields.JP:
まあ何か思い当たる節を発見したら、
その時に発表し合うようにして、
今は先に進みましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anyone notices anything, by all
means share it with others.
Now, should we be going?

fields.EN:
Yes, it's not wise to stay here
for too long.
fields.JP:
そうだね。いつまでもここに
留まって考察してても危険だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's not wise to stay here
for too long.

fields.JP: ……じゃあみんな、先に進もうか

fields.EN:
So this is where the core
was...
fields.JP:
なるほど、核は
こんなところにあったのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is where the core
was...

fields.EN:
So, that's the core thing you
were talking about.
fields.JP:
なるほど、これが
おつうたちが言ってた核ってやつね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, that's the core thing you
were talking about.

fields.EN:
Yes, and destroying it will
remove the Nightmare's
invincible state.
fields.JP:
ああ。これさえ壊せば、
ナイトメアの不死性は消えるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and destroying it will
remove the Nightmare's
invincible state.

fields.EN:
If only we destroyed
it back then...
fields.JP:
前に来た時にこれを壊せていたら
よかったんだけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we destroyed
it back then...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped, Princess.
We didn't know anything about
the core's existence then.
fields.JP:
仕方ないさ、姫。
あの時は核のことも知らなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped, Princess.
We didn't know anything about
the core's existence then.

fields.EN: Let's just get rid of it already.
fields.JP: とにかく、さっさと壊そう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just get rid of it already.

fields.EN:
Wait, Akazukin!
There's usually a guardian that
guards the...
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、待て！
核はだいたい番人のメルヒェンが……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, Red Riding Hood!
There's usually a guardian that
guards the...

fields.JP: ワレも負けてはおれぬ！
ああもう、ハーメルンまで……！

fields.EN: All right, everyone! Let's follow those two!
fields.JP: 仕方ない、みんな！　２人に続くぞ！
番人はもういないみたいだね

fields.EN: Hmph! Some use that guardian was!
fields.JP: ふん、立ち塞がるだけ時間の無駄だっての
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph! Some use that guardian was!

fields.EN:
Akazukin got rid of it
easily...
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、圧倒的でしたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood got rid of it
easily...

fields.EN: Indeed! Very fitting of my rival!
fields.JP:
さすがはワレのライバル、
このくらいでなくてはな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Indeed! Very fitting of my rival!

fields.JP: このくらい、全ッ然たいしたことないよ

fields.EN:
Well, let's destroy the core
before more Marchens come
this way.
fields.JP:
また敵が来る前に、
早く核を破壊しましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, let's destroy the core
before more Marchens come
this way.

fields.EN:
You're right.
Akazukin, will you do the
honors?
fields.JP:
それもそうだね。
赤ずきん、よろしく頼む
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right.
Red Riding Hood, will you do the
honors?

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！
相変わらず不気味な悲鳴ですね……

fields.EN:
So, I guess that means that the
tower grew again?
fields.JP:
これでまた監獄塔が
伸びてるといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I guess that means that the
tower grew again?

fields.EN:
(What's this...?! Emotions...?
But, it's not from Jack...)
fields.JP:
（この流れ込んでくる感覚は……
　ジャックじゃない……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's this...?! Emotions...?
But, it's not from Jack...)

fields.EN:
(Could it be the emotions from
the Nightmare of this area?)
fields.JP:
（ということは、ここのエリアの
　ナイトメアの感覚か……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Could it be the emotions from
the Nightmare of this area?)

fields.EN:
(I can feel its suffering with the
destruction of the core...)
fields.JP: （核を破壊したから……苦しんでる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can feel its suffering with the
destruction of the core...)

fields.EN:
(It's hard to sense a Nightmare's
emotion when it's far away or
when I'm thinking of Jack...)
fields.JP:
（遠くにいたり、意識がジャックに
　逸れてると気が付きにくいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's hard to sense a Nightmare's
emotion when it's far away or
when I'm thinking of Jack...)

fields.JP: おつう……？　どうした、の……？

fields.EN:
Oh, it's just that I sensed the
Nightmare here suffering.
fields.JP:
いや、ナイトメアが苦しんでるのが
伝わってきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, it's just that I sensed the
Nightmare here suffering.

fields.EN:
Really? You sure you're not
making that up?
fields.JP:
本当に……？
気のせいなんじゃないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? You sure you're not
making that up?

fields.JP: 気のせいじゃないと思うな

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan is the only one who can
understand Jack-san, after all.
fields.JP:
だっておつうちゃんだけが
ジャックさんの言葉や心をちゃんと
分かってあげられてるんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu is the only one who can
understand Jack, after all.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
True. She is the only one who
can truly understand his
broken words.
fields.JP:
そうね、つうはジャックの
たどたどしい言葉を他の人より
理解しているわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. She is the only one who
can truly understand his
broken words.

fields.EN:
That's why Jack is in your room,
right?
fields.JP:
だからこそ、一緒の部屋で
過ごしているんだしね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why Jack is in your room,
right?

fields.EN:
So, how come you're the only one
who can sense that?
fields.JP:
でもどうしておつうだけ
ナイトメアの感覚が分かるんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how come you're the only one
who can sense that?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure...
I just know, for some reason...
fields.JP:
どうしてと言われても、
何故か分かってしまうとしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure...
I just know, for some reason...

fields.EN:
It's kinda weird you would be
the only one who has that kind
of power.
fields.JP: おつうにだけ備わっているなんて謎よね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's kinda weird you would be
the only one who has that kind
of power.

fields.EN:
But aren't all of us Blood Maidens
sort of like a mystery, too?
fields.JP:
でもそれを言うなら、
わたしたち血式少女の存在自体が
謎なんじゃないですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But aren't all of us Blood Maidens
sort of like a mystery, too?

fields.JP: 確かに、それは言えてるかも

fields.EN:
Indeed. No ordinary human
can enter Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化なんて
普通の人間には起こらないことだものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. No ordinary human
can enter Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, weren't we
told that we don't have parents?
fields.JP:
そういえば昔、わたしたちには
両親がいないって話になったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, weren't we
told that we don't have parents?

fields.EN:
Yes...
Or at least, I don't recall having
any parents at all.
fields.JP:
そうだね……
少なくとも僕には両親との記憶が一切ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...
Or at least, I don't recall having
any parents at all.

fields.EN:
I don't recall anything of the
sort, either...
fields.JP:
確かに明確に記憶を
持ち合わせてはいないですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall anything of the
sort, either...

fields.EN:
Rapu? Hameln? Gretel?
How about you three?
fields.JP:
ラプやハーメルン、
それにグレーテルはどうなんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy? Hameln? Gretel?
How about you three?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Parents? Dunno!
Rapunzel was always alone!
fields.JP:
りょうしん？　よくわからないけど、
ラプンツェルはひとりだったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Parents? Dunno!
I was always alone!
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_20580.

fields.EN:
I don't have parents, either.
I was a loner from birth,
destined to be a hero!
fields.JP:
ワレも両親などはおらぬぞ？
生まれた時から勇者を宿命づけられた、
孤高の存在というやつよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have parents, either.
I was a loner from birth,
destined to be a hero!

fields.EN:
I thought you called yourself
"Demon King"...
fields.JP: 最初は魔王だったくせに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you called yourself
"Demon King"...

fields.EN:
I don't ever recall having
parents. The only one I was
related to was my brother Hansel-niisan.
fields.JP:
私にだって両親はいないわ。
ヘンゼル兄さんはナイトメアだったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't ever recall having
parents. The only one I was
related to was my brother Hansel.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
So that means none of us have
ever had parents...
fields.JP:
じゃあみなさんも両親が
いらっしゃらないんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that means none of us have
ever had parents...

fields.EN: By the time I knew, I was alone.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、
気づいた時には１人だったな
fields.LOCALIZED: By the time I knew, I was alone.

fields.EN:
By the time you knew...
Hm, what about me?
fields.JP:
気づいた時……か。
僕はどうだったかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time you knew...
Hm, what about me?

fields.EN:
Hm... Princess...
The earliest I can remember was
wanting to meet Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
……うん、姫だ。
僕は意識を持った瞬間から、
ただ人魚姫に会いたいと思っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Princess...
The earliest I can remember was
wanting to meet Little Mermaid.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Ahahaha!
Now that's the Otsuu I know!
fields.JP:
あははははっ！
さすがおつうって感じだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahahaha!
Now that's the Otsuu I know!

fields.EN:
You know, that's on par with
some shady lurker!
fields.JP:
生まれた時からなんて、
それってもうストーカーの領域よー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, that's on par with
some shady lurker!

fields.EN:
How rude.
It's called love. Love.
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude.
It's called love. Love.

fields.JP: 確かに、それは筋金入りね……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel like Ningyo,
but not like Otsuu!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもにんぎょ
だいすきだけど、おつうーにはまけたー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel like Fishy,
but not like Otsuu!

fields.EN:
Heh! Guess she's too much
for even Rapu to comprehend!
fields.JP: あはは、ラプも相手が悪かったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh! Guess she's too much
for even Rappy to comprehend!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
But I like everyone!
That good!
fields.JP:
でもみんなだいすきだから
それでいいー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I like everyone!
That good!

fields.EN:
Yup, big sis here likes having
good kids like you around.
fields.JP:
うんうん、いい子たちばっかりで
お姉さん嬉しいよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, big sis here likes having
good kids like you around.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness... It's been ages
since I've seen her smile.)
fields.JP:
（よかった……久しぶりに
　赤ずきんの笑顔が見られた気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... It's been ages
since I've seen her smile.)

fields.EN:
(If only she could keep that
up the whole time...)
fields.JP:
（これからもこんな風にいつもの
　赤ずきんでいてくれたらいいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If only she could keep that
up the whole time...)

fields.JP: ん？　どうしたグレーテル
……別に、少し考えごとをしていただけ
それより、そろそろ先に進んではどう？

それもそうだね。
よしみんな、行こうか
しっ、白い闇が出ましたわ……！
ほう……ようやく現れおったな、ナイトメア

fields.EN:
It's our turn now!
Get ready to die, Nightmare!
fields.JP:
今度こそこっちの番だ……！
死ぬ覚悟はいいか、ナイトメア……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's our turn now!
Get ready to die, Nightmare!

fields.EN:
Akazukin, need I remind
you to stay calm?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、分かってると思うけど冷静にね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, need I remind
you to stay calm?

fields.EN:
I'm fine, Otsuu.
I haven't been this calm
in awhile!
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよおつう。
あたしはこの上なく冷静だよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, Otsuu.
I haven't been this calm
in awhile!

fields.EN:
Take a good look cuz I'm gonna
make that Nightmare suffer dearly!
fields.JP:
ちゃんとナイトメアが苦しむ殺し方を
するから、よく見てなさい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take a good look cuz I'm gonna
make that Nightmare suffer dearly!

fields.EN: Sis, please don't run in alone.
fields.JP: おねーちゃん、１人で行かないでね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sis, please don't run in alone.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, we need to
destroy its protective parts
first before defeating it.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、まずは周りの部位を
破壊して弱らせるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, we need to
destroy its protective parts
first before defeating it.

fields.EN:
Once we get rid of its defenses
then we can all take it down for
good.
fields.JP:
そうしたら一気にみんなで
畳みかけることができる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once we get rid of its defenses
then we can all take it down for
good.

fields.EN:
I look forward to further
greatness from you, my fine rival!
fields.JP:
期待しておるからな、
ワレの永遠のライバル赤ずきん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I look forward to further
greatness from you, my fine rival!

fields.EN:
All right, let's destroy
its parts!
fields.JP:
じゃあみんな、
上手く連携して部位を破壊しよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's destroy
its parts!

fields.EN:
We did it! That Nightmare won't
stand a chance against us now!
fields.JP:
やったわ！　これであの
ナイトメアは丸裸も同然よ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did it! That Nightmare won't
stand a chance against us now!

fields.EN:
Pathetic... It looks even more
despicable than before.
fields.JP:
不様な姿……見苦しいのが
より見苦しくなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pathetic... It looks even more
despicable than before.

fields.EN:
I'm quite impressed. Despite your
anger degrading your finesse,
you still exhibit great power.
fields.JP:
しかしさすがワレのライバルだな。
怒りで動きは粗くなっておるが、
それでもあの強さだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite impressed. Despite your
anger degrading your finesse,
you still exhibit great power.

fields.EN:
And that makes victory much
easier for us.
fields.JP: おかげで勝利が目前になったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that makes victory much
easier for us.

fields.EN:
Now's our chance!
Let's take it down for good!
fields.JP:
よし、みんなの連携も上手く取れてる
今がチャンスだ！　一気に行こう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now's our chance!
Let's take it down for good!

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: これでようやく倒したね……

fields.EN:
Yeah, and it looks like we're
finally able to move on...
fields.JP:
うん……最初の雪辱を
ようやく果たしたってところだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and it looks like we're
