finally able to move on...

Red Riding Hood,
are you all right?

fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
あたしは……大丈夫……

fields.EN:
We could only run the last
time, but I guess we now know
how to take them down...
fields.JP:
以前は逃げるしかなかったのに、
ナイトメア……本当に倒せるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We could only run the last
time, but I guess we now know
how to take them down...

fields.EN:
Now I can avenge Dad's death...
Hahahahahaha!
fields.JP:
これならお父さんたちの仇を取れる……
はは……ははははっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I can avenge Dad's death...
Hahahahahaha!

fields.JP: さて、監獄塔は伸びたか？

fields.EN:
Mmm... We're too close to the
tower, so it's hard to tell...
fields.JP:
うーん……ここからだと
ちょっと近すぎてよく分かりませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... We're too close to the
tower, so it's hard to tell...

fields.EN:
Why not just head there?
We were heading there anyway.
fields.JP:
行ってみれば分かるんじゃない？
どうせ今から向かうんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not just head there?
We were heading there anyway.

fields.EN:
So, we finally get to see what
the inside looks like...
fields.JP:
ついに監獄塔に足を
踏み入れるんですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we finally get to see what
the inside looks like...

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
You don't look so well.
fields.JP:
どうしたシンデレラ。
浮かない顔をしおって
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
You don't look so well.

fields.EN:
It's just that the idea of the
place teeming with Marchens
and Nightmares is...
fields.JP:
ここよりもさらにたくさんの
メルヒェンやナイトメアがいるのかなって
思って……それで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that the idea of the
place teeming with Marchens
and Nightmares is...

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Cinderella.
We have an impressive party now,
and we'll be extra careful there.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、シンデレラ。
ちゃんと慎重に行くし、それにこっちには
これだけ血式少女が揃っているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Cinderella.
We have an impressive party now,
and we'll be extra careful there.

fields.EN:
Yup... Yup...
I'll... do my best...
fields.JP:
うん……うんっ……
だい……じょうぶ……ボクもがんばる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... Yup...
I'll... do my best...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, too!
We do good together, Nemu-Nemu!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも！
ねむねむ、いっしょにがんばろーね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, too!
We do good together, Sleepy!

fields.EN:
Nice. Looks like our morale's
pretty good.
fields.JP:
いいね、みんな気合い
入ってきたんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice. Looks like our morale's
pretty good.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki will do her best
to not falter before entering
the tower!
fields.JP:
白雪も、監獄塔に入る前から
気持ちで負けないように頑張ります……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White will do her best
to not falter before entering
the tower!

fields.JP:
よし、じゃあみんな、
先に進もう

fields.EN:
Beyond here is the entrance to
the Jail Tower...
fields.JP: ここを越えたら監獄塔の入り口だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beyond here is the entrance to
the Jail Tower...

fields.EN:
In other words, that place is the
main base of all the Marchens
and Nightmares...
fields.JP:
この先が奴らメルヒェンやナイトメアの
本拠地ってことだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, that place is the
main base of all the Marchens
and Nightmares...

fields.EN:
That also means our escape from
here lies ahead!
fields.JP:
ワレたちの悲願の脱獄も
もうすぐそこって感じであるな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That also means our escape from
here lies ahead!

fields.EN:
I assume that the front entrance
would be heavily guarded.
fields.JP:
ただ監獄塔の正面はさすがに
厳重な警戒がされているでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume that the front entrance
would be heavily guarded.

fields.EN:
Yes... Unlike the rear entrance,
it's safe to assume the place will
be filled with enemies.
fields.JP:
うん。以前の監獄塔の裏口と違って、
こっちは敵がたくさんいるって考えた方が
いいと思う。慎重に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Unlike the rear entrance,
it's safe to assume the place will
be filled with enemies.

fields.EN:
We need to be careful, especially
you, Akazukin. Please don't
attack any Nightmare randomly...
fields.JP:
特に赤ずきん、たとえナイトメアを
見つけても突っ込んでいかないでくれよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to be careful, especially
you, Red Riding Hood. Please don't
attack any Nightmare randomly...

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine! I'll do my best
to keep my cool.
fields.JP:
わ、分かってるってば！
冷静さを保つよう努力するって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine! I'll do my best
to keep my cool.

fields.EN: I was wondering where Alice-san is...
fields.JP: ……アリスさんどこにいるのかなって思って
fields.LOCALIZED: I was wondering where Alice is...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
We searched all over, and we still
can't find Alice-san.
fields.JP:
これまで色々な場所探索してきたけど、
アリスさんだけがまだ見つかってない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We searched all over, and we still
can't find Alice.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP: だからちょっと心配で……
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
It's fine, Jack.
I'm sure she's fine.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよジャック。
心配いらないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, Jack.
I'm sure she's fine.

fields.EN:
If this "Alice" person is alive,
it is highly likely she is also in
Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
アリスという人が生きているなら、
おそらくブラッドスケルター化してるはず
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this "Alice" person is alive,
it is highly likely she is also in
Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Yes, and if she is in that state,
then it's likely she's roaming
different areas.
fields.JP:
うん。そしてその状態なら
色々なエリアを動き回ってる可能性もある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and if she is in that state,
then it's likely she's roaming
different areas.

fields.EN:
I think it's just sheer
coincidence that we haven't
encountered her yet.
fields.JP:
これまで見つかってないのは、
偶然鉢合わせてないだけだと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's just sheer
coincidence that we haven't
encountered her yet.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right... I'm sure Alice-san is
still alive and well somewhere.
fields.JP:
そう……だよね。きっとアリスさんは
今もどこかでちゃんと生きてるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right...
I'm sure she's alive and well
somewhere.

fields.EN:
Even if we enter the tower, we're
not going to just escape as-is.
fields.JP:
うん。僕たちはこれから監獄塔に入るけど、
このまま脱獄するわけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if we enter the tower, we're
not going to just escape as-is.

fields.EN:
We need to bring Mamoru's group
with us when we escape.
fields.JP:
脱獄する時はちゃんと
マモルたちも連れてこねばならぬしな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to bring Mamoru's group
with us when we escape.

fields.EN:
Hameln's right, so we need to
go in to secure a safe route
for everyone back at the base.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの言うとおり、
拠点の人たちを連れて行くルートの
確保も必要だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln's right, so we need to
go in to secure a safe route
for everyone back at the base.

fields.EN:
We'll look for Alice, too.
Don't worry, Princess.
fields.JP:
アリスだってもちろんちゃんと捜索する。
だから心配しなくても大丈夫だよ、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll look for Alice, too.
Don't worry, Princess.

fields.JP: うん……ありがとう、おつうちゃん……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
But seriously, where in the world
could she be?
fields.JP: でも実際、アリスはどこにいるんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But seriously, where in the world
could she be?

fields.EN:
I wouldn't be surprised if she
was really nearby.
fields.JP: 意外と近くにいたりするかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't be surprised if she
was really nearby.

fields.EN: In any case, we'll find Alice.
fields.JP: とにかく、絶対にアリスは見つけるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: In any case, we'll find Alice.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ジャック！？
お、おい、どうしたんだ！？
ナイトメア・ジャック
ぎぎ……ぎごぐごごあ゛あ゛あ゛っ！

fields.EN:
Calm down!
What is wrong with you?!
fields.JP:
落ち着け！　いったい何でそんなに……
焦ってるんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down!
What is wrong with you?!

fields.EN:
Jack's voice...
Jack... Where is he?
fields.JP:
そう、あれはジャックの声だった。
ジャック、ジャックはどこ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's voice...
Jack... Where is he?

fields.EN:
*yawn* Look at the time...
I better get myself ready...
fields.JP:
ふぁぁ……もうこんな時間か……
そろそろ起きないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*yawn* Look at the time...
I better get myself ready...

fields.EN:
I didn't have any strange dreams
last night... That's unusual.
fields.JP:
今日は変な夢を見なかったな。
珍しいこともあるもんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't have any strange dreams
last night... That's unusual.

fields.JP: （あれ、そういえばジャックは……？）

fields.EN:
Ah, that's right.
He's in Alice's room.
fields.JP:
あ、そうか。
今日はアリスの部屋にいるんだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, that's right.
He's in Alice's room.

fields.EN:
So, we have all the Blood Maidens
accounted for now!
fields.JP:
ついに探してた血式少女が
全員揃ったのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we have all the Blood Maidens
accounted for now!

fields.EN:
Why yes! We were finally able
to find Alice-san!
fields.JP:
そうなんです！
やっとアリスさんとも合流できました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes! We were finally able
to find Alice!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
So, you're Alice!
Looks like we finally meet!
fields.JP:
そうか、お前がアリスか！
やっと会えたな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're Alice!
Looks like we finally meet!

fields.EN:
I know we've never seen you
before, but it feels like we've
known each other forever.
fields.JP:
初めましてのようで、
初めましてじゃないね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know we've never seen you
before, but it feels like we've
known each other forever.

fields.EN:
Well, there's no way you could
tell who we are with our faces.
You remember my voice?
fields.JP:
まあ顔なんて絶対分からねえだろうが、
でも俺たちの声に覚えはねえか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, there's no way you could
tell who we are with our faces.
You remember my voice?

fields.EN:
That's right! We were the ones who
were in the cell next to you!
fields.JP:
そうだよ！　牢屋の中での
お隣さんだよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! We were the ones who
were in the cell next to you!

fields.EN:
Thanks a million. Because of you
and Jack, we were able to somehow
keep our spirits up to survive.
fields.JP:
あの時はありがとな。お前たちのおかげで
こっちも生きる気力を失わずにいられた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks a million. Because of you
and Jack, we were able to somehow
keep our spirits up to survive.

fields.EN: So, you guys all know each other.
fields.JP:
そうか、マモルたちはアリスと
知り合いだったか
fields.LOCALIZED: So, you guys all know each other.

fields.EN:
Hell, we may not have met
face-to-face, but we were the best
of friends.
fields.JP: 顔は知らずとも友情は育んだぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hell, we may not have met
face-to-face, but we were the best
of friends.

fields.EN: Oh my, what a wonderful reunion!
fields.JP: ふふ、素敵な再会ですね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh my, what a wonderful reunion!

fields.EN:
Jack came here with you, Otsuu-san, Mamoru,
and everyone else, didn't he?
fields.JP:
おつうさんたちやマモルみんなで、
この新しい拠点にやって来たんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
He came with all of you
here, didn't he?

fields.EN:
Alice... Promise me you'll stay
calm. Jack is...
fields.JP:
……アリス。どうか心を落ち着けて
聞いてほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... Promise me you'll stay
calm. Jack is...

fields.EN:
Are you trying to say that this
Nightmare here is Jack?
fields.JP:
じゃあこのナイトメアが
ジャックだっていうの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you trying to say that this
Nightmare here is Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ジャック……！
ああっ……こんなになってしまって……！

fields.EN:
It must have hurt...
You must have suffered...
fields.JP:
痛かったでしょう……
苦しかったでしょう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must have hurt...
You must have suffered...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry I couldn't protect you!
Jack... Jack...!
fields.JP:
あなたを守れなくてごめんなさい……！
ジャック……ジャック……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry I couldn't protect you!
Jack... Jack...!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack-san... is really responding to you,
Alice-san.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……
アリスさんにちゃんと応えてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is... trying his best to
console you.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
Jack... Are you trying to...
hold me?
fields.JP:
ジャック……わたしを
抱きしめてくれるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... Are you trying to...
hold me?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Even if he is a Nightmare now,
there's no way he would forget
you, Alice!
fields.JP:
へっ、どんな姿になったって、
お前がアリスを忘れるわけねえよな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if he is a Nightmare now,
there's no way he would forget
you, Alice!

fields.EN:
*sob* Stop it...
You're making me cry...
fields.JP: うぅ～あたしこういうの弱いのよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob* Stop it...
You're making me cry...

fields.EN:
I'm so happy you're both
together now!
fields.JP: よかったね、アリス、ジャック……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so happy you're both
together now!

fields.EN: He's more of a man than I thought.
fields.JP:
ふん、ジャックってば
男らしいじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED: He's more of a man than I thought.

fields.JP:
よかったねじゃっく！
ありすもよかったー！

fields.EN:
(I can feel his emotions flowing
like a tide...)
fields.JP:
（アリスへの感情が大波のように
　押し寄せてくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can feel his emotions flowing
like a tide...)

fields.EN:
(This is the strongest I've ever
felt of his emotions since we
were together...)
fields.JP:
（これまでずっとジャックと
　過ごしてきたけど、こんなに強い反応は
　これまでで初めてだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the strongest I've ever
felt of his emotions since we
were together...)

fields.EN:
(I can sense his love and
affection, but...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can sense his love and
affection, but...)

fields.EN:
(I feel... resolve.
A sense of determination...)
fields.JP:
（この奮い立つような感覚は……
　何だ……使命感……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel... resolve.
A sense of determination...)

fields.EN:
I see...
Alice must be that special to you.
fields.JP:
そうかジャック……
君はそこまでアリスを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Alice must be that special to you.

fields.EN:
I-I shouldn't be doing this in
front of everyone...
fields.JP: わ、わたしってばみんなの前で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I shouldn't be doing this in
front of everyone...

fields.EN:
Oh, you can embrace Jack for as
long as you like.
fields.JP:
あら、そのまま抱擁なさってて
構いませんよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you can embrace Jack for as
long as you like.

fields.EN:
Yeah, go for it! Hell, why don't
you just kiss him or whatever?
No need to worry about us!
fields.JP:
そうだよ、やっと再会できたんだ、
人目なんて気にせずキスでも何でも
すればいいんだって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, go for it! Hell, why don't
you just kiss him or whatever?
No need to worry about us!

fields.EN:
Kaede, might I remind you that
you need to have a bit more tact.
fields.JP:
カエデ、君はもう少しデリカシーと
いうものをだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede, might I remind you that
you need to have a bit more tact.

fields.EN:
C'mon, shut it.
I'm just telling her to do what
she wants.
fields.JP:
うっさいねー
好きにさせてあげなよって言ってんの
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, shut it.
I'm just telling her to do what
she wants.

fields.EN: Guys, can you please not fight?
fields.JP: そっちでケンカしないでくれよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Guys, can you please not fight?

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack.
Do you mind letting me go for
a moment?
fields.JP:
ジャック、ありがとう。
ちょっとだけ腕ほどいてもらっていい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack.
Do you mind letting me go for
a moment?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
So, Alice? You mind telling us
how you survived out there?
fields.JP:
それでアリス、君は今まで
どうやって生き延びてきたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Alice? You mind telling us
how you survived out there?

fields.EN:
You were in Blood Skelter,
but how did you get yourself
out of it?
fields.JP:
最後はブラッドスケルター化してたのに、
どうやってそれが解けたんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were in Blood Skelter,
but how did you get yourself
out of it?

fields.EN:
You got out of Blood Skelter?
Do you mind elaborating?
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化が解けた？
それは私もぜひ話を聞きたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got out of Blood Skelter?
Do you mind elaborating?

fields.EN:
I don't remember anything after I got separated
from you and the others, Otsuu-san...
fields.JP:
おつうさんたちとはぐれた後のことは、
記憶が全くなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't remember much since
I was separated from everyone...

fields.EN:
It can't be helped.
You were already in Blood
Skelter back then.
fields.JP:
それは仕方ないよ。
アリスはそういう状態だったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped.
You were already in Blood
Skelter back then.

fields.EN:
By the time I noticed,
I was in a place I'd never been
before.
fields.JP:
次に気づいた時には、
全然知らない場所にいたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time I noticed,
I was in a place I'd never been
before.

fields.EN:
I didn't know what was going on
with the weird surroundings...
fields.JP:
突然目が覚めて……知らない景色だし、
何が何だか訳が分からなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know what was going on
with the weird surroundings...

fields.EN:
But, I thought to myself that
I needed to return, so I searched
around until I reached the exit.
fields.JP:
それでも戻らなければって思って、
慎重に進みながらどうにか
出口に辿り着いたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I thought to myself that
I needed to return, so I searched
around until I reached the exit.

fields.EN:
When I stepped out and turned
around, I noticed...
fields.JP:
それで外に出て振り返ってみて――
その時にようやく気づいたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I stepped out and turned
around, I noticed...

fields.EN:
...I was in the Jail Tower all
this time.
fields.JP:
わたしがいたところは
監獄塔だったんだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I was in the Jail Tower all
this time.

fields.EN:
You were in there?!
But, what about the Marchens?!
fields.JP:
監獄塔の中にいたんですか！？
メルヒェンとかはいなかったんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were in there?!
But, what about the Marchens?!

fields.EN:
They were around, but I hid
myself and kept low.
fields.JP:
出くわしたけど、
上手く隠れたりして何とか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They were around, but I hid
myself and kept low.

fields.EN:
Oh, so you avoided them
as much as possible to escape.
fields.JP:
なるほど、頑張ってどうにか
逃げてきたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so you avoided them
as much as possible to escape.

fields.EN:
I don't think that's a conclusion
we can come to yet.
fields.JP:
まだそうだと決めつけるには
早い気もするけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think that's a conclusion
we can come to yet.

fields.EN:
So after I left, I wandered the
area a bit, and that's when I met
you, Otsuu-san...
fields.JP:
それで監獄塔を出た後に
道が分からなくて彷徨っていたら……
おつうさんたちに出会ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So after I left, I wandered the
area a bit, and that's when I met
you, Otsuu...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
I'm interested in how you were
able to get out of Blood Skelter,
but you don't know, do you?
fields.JP:
どうしてブラッドスケルター化が
解けたのかがきになるところだけど……
どうやら答えは持ち合わせていないみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm interested in how you were
able to get out of Blood Skelter,
but you don't know, do you?

fields.EN: Hey... after I lost my memory... what happened?
fields.JP:
ねえ……わたしの記憶がなくなった後……
いったい何があったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what happened to me back then?

fields.EN:
You entered Blood Skelter after
seeing Jack being attacked by
the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
ジャックがナイトメアに攻撃されて、
アリスは怒りでブラッドスケルター化して
しまったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You entered Blood Skelter after
seeing Jack being attacked by
the Nightmare.

fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化……？
さっきも出た言葉だけど、それは……？

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens can enter a unique
state called Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
血式少女にはブラッドスケルター化っていう
特殊な状態があってね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens can enter a unique
state called Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Once you enter it, you lose your
memory and go berserk.
fields.JP:
その状態になってしまうと、
我を忘れて暴走してしまうの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you enter it, you lose your
memory and go berserk.

fields.EN:
That kept you, the Nightmare,
and the rest of us apart.
fields.JP:
それでナイトメアとアリスと僕たちで
三つ巴のような形になってしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That kept you, the Nightmare,
and the rest of us apart.

fields.EN:
And from there, we all sort of
got separated.
fields.JP: それで散り散りになっちゃったんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And from there, we all sort of
got separated.

fields.EN:
We didn't know how to bring you
back, so we couldn't do anything
for you...
fields.JP:
あの時はまだアリスを元に戻す術を
知らなかったから、何もできなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't know how to bring you
back, so we couldn't do anything
for you...

fields.EN: What in the world have I done?!
fields.JP: ああ、わたしはなんてことを……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What in the world have I done?!

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san, Ningyohime-san, Akazukin-san... I'm truly sorry... I've done
something I can never take back...!
fields.JP:
おつうさん、人魚姫さん、
赤ずきんさん……本当にごめんなさい……
わたしは取り返しのつかないことを……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry, everyone...
I can't believe how much trouble
I caused for all of you!

fields.EN:
It's fine, Alice. We're all alive,
and we're happy you're alive, too.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、アリス。
僕たちは無事に生き延びられたんだから。
君が無事でよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, Alice. We're all alive,
and we're happy you're alive, too.

fields.EN: Alice-san, are you hurt or anything?
fields.JP: アリスさん、怪我とかは大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice, are you hurt or anything?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
C'mon, we're all safe, right?
We can check her out later!
fields.JP:
こうして無事に再会できたんだから
細かいことは気にしない気にしない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, we're all safe, right?
We can check her out later!

fields.EN:
You were the last person Otsuu was
looking for! It's good to know
everyone is safe and sound now!
fields.JP:
おつうたちが探してた仲間は貴様で最後だ！
無事に集まれてよかったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were the last person Otsuu was
looking for! It's good to know
everyone is safe and sound now!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you're not saying
your usual hero thingy.
fields.JP: 勇者の一行がどうとか言わないのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you're not saying
your usual hero thingy.

fields.JP: でも今は言わなくていいわよ
メルン、いっちゃだめー！

fields.EN:
So as you can see, we've got
a very lively crew now.
fields.JP:
とまあ、こんな感じで
賑やかなメンバーになったもんでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So as you can see, we've got
a very lively crew now.

fields.JP: 改めてよろしく頼むよ、アリス

fields.EN:
Now then, we're going to be
heading back to the tower, but...
fields.JP:
さて、じゃあもう一度
監獄塔に向かおうかと思うんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, we're going to be
heading back to the tower, but...

fields.EN:
You were trying to get there?
If so, you can't enter the tower
from the City Streets area.
fields.JP:
もしかして監獄塔に行こうとしていたの？
それなら元街道沿いエリアからは入れないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were trying to get there?
If so, you can't enter the tower
from the City Streets area.

fields.JP: あっちは結局行き止まりだったから……

fields.EN:
If so, then I suppose you'll have
to enter through the Graveyard
area.
fields.JP:
となると、元墓所エリアの方から
入るしかないみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, then I suppose you'll have
to enter through the Graveyard
area.

fields.EN: So there's only one way through...
fields.JP:
結局まともな入り口は１つ……
ということなのね
fields.LOCALIZED: So there's only one way through...

fields.EN:
So long as we can get through,
one way is more than enough.
fields.JP:
まあちゃんと入り口が残されてるなら、
この際どこだって構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So long as we can get through,
one way is more than enough.

fields.EN:
Alice, we'll eventually be heading to
the Jail Tower, but what about you?
fields.JP:
アリス、僕らは元墓所エリアから
監獄塔へ向かうけど君はどうしたい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, we'll eventually be heading to
the Jail Tower, but what about you?

fields.EN:
By the way, Jack always comes
with us on our expeditions.
fields.JP:
ちなみにジャックは
いつも僕たちと一緒に行動してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, Jack always comes
with us on our expeditions.

fields.EN: For Jack's sake, I want to go. Please take me exploring with you.
fields.JP:
ジャックのためにも、わたし行きたいわ。
どうか一緒に探索に連れてって
fields.LOCALIZED: If Jack's going, I want to go too.

fields.EN:
I'm glad you said that.
I'm looking forward to your
company, Alice.
fields.JP:
そう言ってくれると嬉しいよ。
じゃあよろしくね、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you said that.
I'm looking forward to your
company, Alice.

fields.EN:
Now then, I think we can call it
a day.
fields.JP: じゃあみんな、今日は一旦解散しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I think we can call it
a day.

fields.EN:
Otsuu, do you have a moment?
I need to speak with you...
in private.
fields.JP:
おつう、ちょっといいか？
この後２人で話したいことがあるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, do you have a moment?
I need to speak with you...
in private.

fields.EN:
We have everyone together,
and we've searched pretty
far and wide now.
fields.JP:
みんなも揃ったし、
探索だってずいぶん進んだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have everyone together,
and we've searched pretty
far and wide now.

fields.EN:
The Jail Tower is growing
steadily, too. It looks like we
can make our escape soon.
fields.JP:
それに監獄塔は順調に伸びていっている。
段々と脱獄も現実的になってきたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail Tower is growing
steadily, too. It looks like we
can make our escape soon.

fields.EN:
(Of course, there's still a lot
to think about...)
fields.JP:
（まあそれでも、まだ考えるべきことは
　たくさんある……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Of course, there's still a lot
to think about...)

fields.EN:
(In any case, I better focus
on our expedition to the
Graveyard area.)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、今は元墓所エリアの
　探索に集中しないとな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In any case, I better focus
on our expedition to the
Graveyard area.)

fields.EN:
It looks like we're going to need
to split into two parties.
fields.JP:
ちょっとここは
二手に分かれないと無理そうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like we're going to need
to split into two parties.

fields.EN:
I'd rather not do that, but given
the circumstance, I suppose
there's no choice.
fields.JP:
なるべくなら別行動は避けたいけど……
そうも言ってられないみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd rather not do that, but given
the circumstance, I suppose
there's no choice.

fields.EN:
All right, let's split our party
into two.
fields.JP: 仕方ない、パーティを２つに分けようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, let's split our party
into two.

fields.EN: I'll lead one of the parties.
fields.JP:
じゃあ僕の方の組と、
もう１組パーティを作ろう
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll lead one of the parties.

fields.EN:
Any thoughts on how you're
planning to split the party?
fields.JP: 分け方に関しては何かある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Any thoughts on how you're
planning to split the party?

fields.EN:
Well, being that Alice is still
coming to, I think it's best she
joins my party.
fields.JP:
そうだね……アリスはまだ
実戦を開始したばかりだし、
僕の方に入ってもらおうかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, being that Alice is still
coming to, I think it's best she
joins my party.

fields.EN:
Jack is with you, so that makes
sense. His presence also makes
her safe against Corruption.
fields.JP:
そうね。つうの方にはジャックもいる。
いざとなれば穢れも取れるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is with you, so that makes
sense. His presence also makes
her safe against Corruption.

fields.EN:
I suppose that means you're
going to keep them away from
battles.
fields.JP:
そうすると、ジャックとアリスを除いて
パーティを分けるって感じ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that means you're
going to keep them away from
battles.

fields.EN: Yes, I think that's for the best.
fields.JP:
そうだね。アリスには悪いけど、
今回はそれでいこう
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I think that's for the best.

fields.EN:
Thank you.
I appreciate the thought.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。むしろ
気づかってくれて感謝するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you.
I appreciate the thought.

fields.EN:
So not including them, I suggest
having six in your party, with the
other party having five.
fields.JP:
ではその２人は今回は数に含まないとして、
その上でつうのパーティが６人、
別の組が５人でどうかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So not including them, I suggest
having six in your party, with the
other party having five.

fields.EN:
So including Jack and Alice, that
means Otsuu will have eight, and
the other five? Sounds okay to me.
fields.JP:
見た目はおつうのパーティ８人で
別の組が５人ってことね。いいんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So including Jack and Alice, that
means Otsuu will have eight, and
the other five? Sounds okay to me.

fields.EN: I'll let you decide the members.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll let you decide the members.

fields.EN:
Understood.
Oh, but before that... Here...
fields.JP:
分かった。っと、その前に……
みんな、これを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood.
Oh, but before that... Here...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、この機械は何？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Transceivers.
Takumi gave them to me.
fields.JP:
トランシーバーさ。
出る前にタクミに渡された
fields.LOCALIZED:
Transceivers.
Takumi gave them to me.

fields.EN:
I see. This would make it possible
for us to communicate from afar.
fields.JP:
なるほど、これなら離れてても
連絡がちゃんと取れますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. This would make it possible
for us to communicate from afar.

fields.EN:
Oh? Takumi can come in handy
once in a while.
fields.JP:
ほう、タクミの奴も
たまにはやるな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Takumi can come in handy
once in a while.

fields.EN:
He did his best to repair them.
He could only get two to work, so
we'll each hold onto one of them.
fields.JP:
頑張って直してくれたみたいだ。
とはいえこれは２つしかないから、
それぞれのパーティに１つずつだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He did his best to repair them.
He could only get two to work, so
we'll each hold onto one of them.

fields.JP: よし、それじゃあパーティを決めようか

fields.EN:
All right.
I think this should do it.
fields.JP: よし、じゃあこのパーティで行くとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right.
I think this should do it.

fields.JP: 互いに無理しないようにね！
ここは慎重に行きましょう
気をつけて行きましょうね～

fields.EN: Don't go too crazy, you hear?
fields.JP: 無理しないで行くからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't go too crazy, you hear?

fields.EN:
Let's do our best and make
it through safe!
fields.JP: では無事にここを抜けましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's do our best and make
it through safe!

fields.EN: Let's not let our guard down!
fields.JP: では油断せず行きましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's not let our guard down!

fields.EN:
All right, take care!
If we want to regroup, let's
rendezvous back here again!
fields.JP:
じゃあそれぞれ気をつけて行こう！
またパーティを選び直したい時は
みんなでここに戻ろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, take care!
If we want to regroup, let's
rendezvous back here again!

fields.EN:
Alice, I think Jack went to your
room yesterday, but...
fields.JP:
そういえばアリス、昨日ジャックは
そっちの部屋に行ったと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, I think Jack went to your
room yesterday, but...

fields.JP: 昨晩は一緒にいてどうだった？

fields.EN:
It was great having some time
with him.
fields.JP: 久しぶりに一緒に過ごせて、嬉しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was great having some time
with him.

fields.EN:
He even rushed to try and help
me when I slipped a bit.
fields.JP:
ジャックったら
わたしがちょっとつまづいただけで
慌てて手を差し伸べてくれるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
He even rushed to try and help
me when I slipped a bit.

fields.EN:
Oh, and when I was looking out
the window, he gently placed his
hand on my head.
fields.JP:
それから、窓の外見てたら、
寂しそうって思ったのか
そっと頭に手を置いてくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and when I was looking out
the window, he gently placed his
hand on my head.

fields.EN:
His hands are quite big now,
but he tried his best to pat me
lightly.
fields.JP:
前より迫力のある手ではあるけど、
すごく優しく撫でてくれたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
His hands are quite big now,
but he tried his best to pat me
lightly.

fields.EN: That sounds like Jack all right.
fields.LOCALIZED: That sounds like Jack all right.

fields.EN:
Sure, he's turned into a Nightmare
and doesn't look anything like
before...
fields.JP:
確かにジャックはナイトメアになって、
見た目は変わってしまったけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, he's turned into a Nightmare
and doesn't look anything like
before...

fields.EN:
But, I could tell nothing has
changed inside... He's as kind
as he ever was.
fields.JP:
それでも昔と変わらない優しさを
持ってるって……そう感じたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I could tell nothing has
changed inside... He's as kind
as he ever was.

fields.EN: I see... That's good to hear.
fields.JP: そうか……それならよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... That's good to hear.

fields.EN:
Oh, but it is a bit difficult
trying to communicate with him.
fields.JP:
でも……やっぱり言葉を交わしたり、
意思疎通を図るのは難しいわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but it is a bit difficult
trying to communicate with him.

fields.EN:
I feel bad for not understanding
him fully, especially since I know
how kind he is...
fields.JP:
あの優しいジャックだって分かるほど、
どうしようもなくつらく感じてしまうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel bad for not understanding
him fully, especially since I know
how kind he is...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ん？　どうしたんだいジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……みち……おな、おなが……
……ずず……た……

fields.EN:
Ah, that's right. So sorry.
Let me get you something to eat.
fields.JP:
ああ、そっかごめんごめん。
今あげるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, that's right. So sorry.
Let me get you something to eat.

fields.EN:
Now where was that ration again?
Oh, here it is... Here, Jack.
fields.JP:
カンパンはどこだっけ…………あった。
ほらジャック、受け取ってくれよっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now where was that ration again?
Oh, here it is... Here, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you understand
what Jack is saying.
fields.JP:
すごいわ……
ジャックの言葉がちゃんと分かるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you understand
what Jack is saying.

fields.EN:
I'm jealous that you can communicate with
Jack, Otsuu-san.
fields.JP:
ジャックと意思疎通ができるなんて、
おつうさんが羨ましいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, I'm envious you can
communicate with Jack just fine.

fields.EN:
I can't help him now,
since I don't understand
what he's trying to say...
fields.JP:
わたしはジャックがしてほしいこと、
分かってあげられないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't help him now,
since I don't understand
what he's trying to say...

fields.EN:
For some reason, I can sense
a Nightmare's emotions.
fields.JP:
僕には、なぜかナイトメアの感情が
伝わってくるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For some reason, I can sense
a Nightmare's emotions.

fields.EN:
I could sense great joy coming
from Jack when he saw you.
fields.JP:
ジャックはアリスに出会えた時、
すごく強い『喜び』を発したよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could sense great joy coming
from Jack when he saw you.

fields.EN:
He was really happy being able
to meet you again.
fields.JP:
アリスと再会できて嬉しい、って。
すごく喜んでいるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was really happy being able
to meet you again.

fields.EN: Jack was that happy, was he...
fields.JP:
そう……ジャックったら
そんなに喜んでくれていたのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack was that happy, was he...

fields.EN:
I'm satisfied to know that he
still has feelings for me...
fields.JP:
そうジャックが思ってくれてるなら……
……今はそれで充分だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm satisfied to know that he
still has feelings for me...

fields.EN:
If you ever feel sad or lonely,
think about the situation
this way...
fields.JP:
もしこの先また寂しいって思うようなら、
こう考えてみればいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you ever feel sad or lonely,
think about the situation
this way...

fields.EN:
A real man doesn't say much.
Am I right?
fields.JP:
真に頼りがいのある男は、
あえて多くを口にしないのだ！　って
fields.LOCALIZED:
A real man doesn't say much.
Am I right?

fields.EN:
Heh... I don't think Jack is that
much of a man, per se.
fields.JP:
あははっ、ずいぶん硬派な感じの男性ね。
ちょっとジャックのイメージじゃないかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I don't think Jack is that
much of a man, per se.

fields.EN:
But, I can sense his kindness,
even without words. I guess that's
one way of looking at things.
fields.JP:
でもそうね、言葉にできずとも
ジャックの優しさは感じられるんですもの、
捉え方を変えて接していってみるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I can sense his kindness,
even without words. I guess that's
one way of looking at things.

fields.JP: うん、その調子だよ、アリス

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu-san.
I feel a lot better already.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、おつうさん。
少し自信出てきたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu.
I feel a lot better already.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN: I guess we should be going.
fields.JP: じゃあ先に進みましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess we should be going.

fields.EN:
Maybe that will get us a bit
further.
fields.JP:
もしかしてこれが
先に進むためのものかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that will get us a bit
further.

fields.EN:
I sure hope so... But, this also
means that the other route
could have a switch, too.
fields.JP:
そうだと思いたいね……
でもだとすると、別のルートにも
スイッチがある気がするけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sure hope so... But, this also
means that the other route
could have a switch, too.

fields.EN:
Hello, Tsuu here.
Did you by any chance find a
switch around the area?
fields.JP:
もしもし、こちらつう。
そっちにスイッチは見当たらないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello, Otsuu here.
Did you by any chance find a
switch around the area?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, we found a switch here,
too!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん！
こっちにもスイッチあったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, we found a switch here,
too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: おつう、スイッチ発見したぞ！
スイッチあったわよ、つう。
スイッチあったよーーーーーー！

fields.EN: Yes, we did find a switch.
fields.JP: スイッチありましたよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, we did find a switch.

fields.JP: スイッチってこれね？　あったわよ！

fields.EN: We found a switch too, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: スイッチありました、おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: We found a switch too, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: So this is the switch... I found it, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
スイッチって……これですわね。
ありましたわ、おつう！

fields.EN: Otsuu, we found a switch, too.
fields.JP: おつう、スイッチ見つけたよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, we found a switch, too.

fields.EN:
All right, then let's press it at
once. I have a feeling that should
do the trick.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあ同時に押そう。
きっとそういう仕掛けだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, then let's press it at
once. I have a feeling that should
do the trick.

fields.EN: Then I'll count down. Three... two... one...
fields.JP:
じゃあカウントダウンするぞ。
３……２……１……
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the count of three.
One... Two...

fields.EN:
Looks like it worked. If that's
all there is, then I guess we'll
meet on the other side.
fields.JP:
成功だね。じゃあそっちのみんなも、
もしこれで終わるようなら、この先で
合流しようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like it worked. If that's
all there is, then I guess we'll
meet on the other side.

fields.JP: もしもーし、そっちはどう？
また出たか、謎のナイトメアめ！

fields.EN:
It looks like that Nightmare has
appeared...!
fields.JP:
こんなところで
あのナイトメアが出るなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like that Nightmare has
appeared...!

fields.JP: すごいやなナイトメアでたー！
ひっ……あの謎のナイトメア……！
まずい……謎のナイトメア……！
ナイトメア……謎の……出たっ……！

fields.EN:
It looks like that mysterious
Nightmare appeared!
fields.JP: 謎のナイトメアってのが出たみたいですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like that mysterious
Nightmare appeared!

fields.EN:
It's that mysterious Nightmare!
I'll kill it!
fields.JP:
出たな謎のナイトメア……
ぶっ殺してやる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's that mysterious Nightmare!
I'll kill it!

fields.JP: まさか、またあの謎のナイトメアが出たのか！？
もしもしっ！　応答せよ！　応答せよっ！

fields.EN:
Yeah... It looks like the other
party encountered that mysterious
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
うん、あっちのパーティが
どうやらとても危険なナイトメアに
遭遇したみたいなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... It looks like the other
party encountered that mysterious
Nightmare...

fields.JP: それなら今すぐ行かないと……！

fields.EN:
Yes, let's get there as quick
as possible!
fields.JP:
そうだね、すぐにあっちの
パーティの元に行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, let's get there as quick
as possible!

fields.EN:
Say, don't you think it's better
we head back to where we
split into the two parties?!
fields.JP:
ねえ、一旦分岐路まで
戻った方が確実じゃない！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, don't you think it's better
we head back to where we
split into the two parties?!

fields.EN:
I can hear their voices from
down here, so I'm sure we'll
meet them ahead!
fields.JP:
奥から声が聞こえるから、
この先で繋がってるはずなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can hear their voices from
down here, so I'm sure we'll
meet them ahead!

fields.EN:
We'll make our stand here
until Otsuu-chan comes!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんたちが来るまで、
絶対に持ちこたえてみせる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll make our stand here
until Otsuu comes!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Looks like our only option is
to fight!
fields.JP: 戦うしかなさそうだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like our only option is
to fight!

fields.EN:
It's dangerous to turn our
backs against it. I suppose
we need to hold our ground.
fields.JP:
背中を向けるのも危険だわ。
つうたちが来るまでやるしかなさそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous to turn our
backs against it. I suppose
we need to hold our ground.

fields.JP: とってもやなやつ……たたかうっ！！

fields.EN:
I'm sure Otsuu-san and everyone will
be here shortly! We have to
do our best!
fields.JP:
おつうさんたちも
じきに駆けつけるはずです……！
ここは踏ん張りましょう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Otsuu and everyone will
be here shortly! We have to
do our best!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
I guess it isn't planning to let
us go that easily!
fields.JP: どうやら見逃してはくれなさそうね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it isn't planning to let
us go that easily!

fields.JP: やっ……やるしかありませんっ！

頑張って……もちこたえるしか……
……なさそう……！

fields.EN:
It seems quite powerful...
However there's no choice left 
but to fight!
fields.JP:
とても強そうですけど……
やるしかなさそうですわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems quite powerful...
However there's no choice left 
but to fight!

fields.EN:
So, we finally meet!
I've been waiting for this!
fields.JP:
ようやく会えたね……
あたしも探してたところだっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we finally meet!
I've been waiting for this!

fields.EN:
Tch!
It doesn't seem like they can
get away!
fields.JP:
くっ……！
みんな逃げ切れなさそうだな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch!
It doesn't seem like they can
get away!

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, everyone!
I'm going on ahead!
fields.JP: 悪いアリス！　みんな！　先に行くよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, everyone!
I'm going on ahead!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
Ggh... Die... Die...
Eeeevr...ne... Ggh... Dddie...!
fields.JP:
ぐぎげ……シ……シね……
みんな……ぎぎ……シ…………！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ggh... Die... Die...
Eeeevr...ne... Ggh... Dddie...!

fields.JP:
（壁がえぐれて……！
　相変わらずものすごい攻撃だ……！）

fields.EN:
(Damn it... They won't hold
against that for long!)
fields.JP:
（くそっ、あんなのいくらももたない！
　もう現段階でギリギリだっ！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn it... They won't hold
against that for long!)

fields.JP:
みんなっ！　加勢するっ！
うおぉぉぉぉぉぉっ！

fields.EN:
Nnnew... Mmovve... Mmea...t...
Die... Ggh... Ddiieee...!
fields.JP:
あだらシい……うごぐ……にぐ……
シね……ぐぎ……おまえ……も……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nnnew... Mmovve... Mmea...t...
Die... Ggh... Ddiieee...!

fields.EN:
(I can't push it back!
But, I can't draw back now!)
fields.JP:
（なんて力だ……！
　でもここで退くわけにはいかない……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't push it back!
But, I can't draw back now!)

fields.EN:
(I need to... take its attacks...
until everyone arrives...!)
fields.JP:
（全員揃うまで……せめてこうして
　攻撃を受け止めて足止めするんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to... take its attacks...
until everyone arrives...!)

fields.JP: いいかげんにしろ……ナイトメアっ！
やっと追いついた……っておつうさんっ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
I'm fine...!
I'm able to... take its attacks!
fields.JP:
大丈夫だっ……！
何とか攻撃は受け止めてる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine...!
I'm able to... take its attacks!

fields.EN:
(Everyone's here!
I think we have a chance now!)
fields.JP:
（これで全員揃った……！
　ならどうにかなるかも……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone's here!
I think we have a chance now!)

fields.EN:
Otsuu, hold its attention!
I'll slice it open right now!
fields.JP:
おつう、そのまま押さえ込んでおいて！
今からあたしが斬り裂いてあげるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, hold its attention!
I'll slice it open right now!

fields.EN:
I will go in, too!
Everyone, follow us!
fields.JP:
赤ずきんとワレで一気に詰める！
他の者はそれに続くのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will go in, too!
Everyone, follow us!

fields.EN:
Got it! Cinderella!
We're following them in, now!
fields.JP:
了解っ……！　シンデレラっ！
わたしたちが続くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it! Cinderella!
We're following them in, now!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama!
Shirayuki and Nemu-chan will charge,
too!
fields.JP: 親指姉様、白雪とネムちゃんも行きます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina!
Snow White and Sleepy will charge,
too!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Oh, fine! The four of us are going!
fields.JP:
ああもう、仕方ないわね！
４人で行くわよ！
じゃ……まスるな……ぐぎぎぎ……！
くっ……こうもたやすく受け止めるか……！
しかも２人同時攻撃なのに……！
まだ攻撃は続いてんのよ！

fields.EN:
Wha-?!
It can fend against all
four of them at once?!
fields.JP:
なっ……！
４人の連携すら押し返すのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?!
It can fend against all
four of them at once?!

fields.EN:
Princess! Rapunzel! Kaguya!
Draw back! Make distance!
fields.JP:
姫、ラプンツェル、かぐや！
それ以上追撃しなくていい！
一旦距離を取るんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess! Rapunzel! Kaguya!
Draw back! Make distance!

fields.JP: わ、分かったよおつうちゃん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 大丈夫ですか、みなさん……！
ラプンツェルもうおこった……！

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how
strong it is!)
fields.JP:
（こんなにも強いのか、
　このナイトメアは……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how
strong it is!)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おづう……ぐぎぎ……
だい……じょ……ぶ……？

fields.EN:
Thank you, I'm fine.
At least for now...
fields.JP:
ジャック……ありがとう。
大丈夫だよ、今はね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, I'm fine.
At least for now...

fields.JP: ぎぎっ……ぎぎゃぉぉぉぉぉぉ！
待てっ！　逃げるなっ！

fields.EN:
Hmph! I bet it got scared of
how strong we were and how it
was outnumbered!
fields.JP:
ふん、ワレたちの強さと人数に
恐れをなして逃げたのであろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I bet it got scared of
how strong we were and how it
was outnumbered!

fields.EN: I'm actually relieved it ran off.
fields.JP: でも正直、今は逃げてくれて助かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm actually relieved it ran off.

fields.EN:
Yes, it was a precarious situation
with our party split into two.
fields.JP:
そうですわね……ちょうどパーティが
分かれてたから焦りましたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it was a precarious situation
with our party split into two.

fields.EN:
That was very, very dangerous...
I'd rather like to not go through
this ever again...
fields.JP:
今回はいつも以上に
ピンチだって思いましたよ～
もう勘弁ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was very, very dangerous...
I'd rather like to not go through
this ever again...

fields.JP: 今のはやっぱり何かおかしい……

fields.EN:
I know... Why did it run away when
it was apparent it had the
upper hand?
fields.JP:
そうですね……どうして有利だったのに
ナイトメアは逃げたんでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know... Why did it run away when
it was apparent it had the
upper hand?

fields.EN:
Something isn't quite correct...
I suppose its actions are the key
to resolving its oddity.
fields.JP:
確かに不自然に思えるわね……
これは考察すべきポイントかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something isn't quite correct...
I suppose its actions are the key
to resolving its oddity.

fields.EN:
Why think? We're going to fight
it again anyway.
fields.JP:
そんなこと考えなくても、
どうせいつかは戦うのだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why think? We're going to fight
it again anyway.

fields.JP: まあそれはそうかもしれないけどさ……

fields.EN:
(I felt something from it, but
it isn't the same as before...)
fields.JP:
（でも今のナイトメアの気持ち……
　今までと違ってた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I felt something from it, but
it isn't the same as before...)

fields.EN:
(A stronger sense of surprise
and hesitation...)
fields.JP:
（今までにないほどの強い『驚き』と……
　それと、いつもと同じ『戸惑い』……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A stronger sense of surprise
and hesitation...)

fields.EN:
(Does its hesitation have
something to do with Jack and
Alice...?)
fields.JP:
（『戸惑い』は……もしかして
　ジャックとアリスに向いている……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does its hesitation have
something to do with Jack and
Alice...?)

fields.EN:
(That could be it... I noticed
those feelings when it first
noticed them...)
fields.JP:
（そうだよな……ジャックとアリスに
　気づいた時にこの感情が出たし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That could be it... I noticed
those feelings when it first
noticed them...)

fields.EN:
(In fact, it stopped attacking
the moment it saw those two...)
fields.JP:
（何より、ジャックとアリスに
　気づいた瞬間から攻撃が止んだんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In fact, it stopped attacking
the moment it saw those two...)

fields.EN:
If we must fight it again,
next time it will be victory
for us!
fields.JP:
貴様ら、また戦うことになったら、
その時は絶対に勝利するぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we must fight it again,
next time it will be victory
for us!

fields.EN:
Yes... We'll make sure we take
it down together.
fields.JP:
そうですわね……
次こそしっかりと連携決めてやりますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... We'll make sure we take
it down together.

fields.EN:
Yeah, we'll hammer it with our
attacks so that it won't have a
chance to fight back!
fields.JP:
うん、あいつに攻撃させる暇を与えない
くらい完璧な連携、やってやろうじゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we'll hammer it with our
attacks so that it won't have a
chance to fight back!

fields.JP: 赤ずきんも、次こそやってやろうな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's do this, Red Riding Hood!

fields.EN:
Kill... Kill...
I'll kill it the next time...!
fields.JP:
殺してやる……殺してやる……
次こそ絶対にあいつをぶっ殺してやる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kill... Kill...
I'll kill it the next time...!

fields.EN:
There's no purpose in staying
here. May I suggest we continue
with our exploration?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ずっとここにいてもしょうがないわ。
気を取り直して探索を再開しましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no purpose in staying
here. May I suggest we continue
with our exploration?

fields.EN:
(I can't seem to get my thoughts
straight with all of this...)
fields.JP: （うーん、考えがまとまらない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't seem to get my thoughts
straight with all of this...)

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Wha-?! Oh, uh... Sorry.
Let's get going.
fields.JP:
ハッ！？　……ああっ、ごめん。
うん、先を急ごう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Oh, uh... Sorry.
Let's get going.

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Be sure you let
me know if you notice something.
fields.JP:
ふふ、何か分かったなら
後で教えてね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Be sure you let
me know if you notice something.

fields.EN: Yeah, I'll let you know for sure.
fields.JP:
うん、分かったことがあったら
ちゃんと報告するよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I'll let you know for sure.

fields.JP: やっと核を見つけたわね……

fields.EN:
Yes, and destroying that somehow
makes the Jail Tower grow.
fields.JP:
ああ、あれを壊して
監獄塔を伸ばしていくんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and destroying that somehow
makes the Jail Tower grow.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it...
I remember seeing something like
it when I woke up...
fields.JP:
そういえば……わたしが目覚めた時も、
これとそっくりの核があったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it...
I remember seeing something like
it when I woke up...

fields.EN: You woke up next to... a core?
fields.LOCALIZED: You woke up next to... a core?

fields.EN:
Alice... You mind telling us more
about that later?
fields.JP: アリス……その話、後で詳しく聞かせてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice... You mind telling us more
about that later?

fields.EN:
Yes, our priority is to first
destroy the core.
fields.JP: そうね、まずは核を破壊しましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, our priority is to first
destroy the core.

fields.EN:
But, does destroying this core
let us have a chance against that
Nightmare?
fields.JP:
これを壊せば……さっきの異常な強さの
ナイトメアとも戦えますの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, does destroying this core
let us have a chance against that
Nightmare?

fields.JP: いや……たぶん違うと思う

fields.EN:
That Nightmare roamed into
a number of areas, so I doubt the
core here is related to it.
fields.JP:
さっきのナイトメアは別にこの
元墓所エリアに限らず出没してきたから、
おそらくは対応してないでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare roamed into
a number of areas, so I doubt the
core here is related to it.

fields.EN:
So, it must be for the other
Nightmare here...
fields.JP:
じゃあもう１体の方の
ナイトメアだけなんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it must be for the other
Nightmare here...

fields.JP: 残念だけど仕方ないね……

fields.EN:
Not a problem.
We just have to kill them all.
fields.JP: そんなの、ぜんぶ殺せばいいだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not a problem.
We just have to kill them all.

fields.EN:
I agree with you.
Defeat them all, and the problem
is solved.
fields.JP: ワレも同意見だな。ぜんぶ倒せば済む話だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree with you.
Defeat them all, and the problem
is solved.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's show it our
power!
fields.JP:
さあ、まずはこいつに
ワレらの強さを見せてやろうではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's show it our
power!

fields.JP: 相変わらず血の気が多いわね

fields.EN:
"Dependable" is the apt word
to use, Gretel.
fields.JP:
そこは『頼もしい』と
言うべきであるぞ、グレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Dependable" is the apt word
to use, Gretel.

fields.EN:
I'm not going to let Hameln
take the stage away from me!
fields.JP:
わたしもハーメルンに
負けていられませんわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to let Hameln
take the stage away from me!

fields.EN:
That's the spirit!
Now then, let's go!
fields.JP:
気合い充分だな……！
よしみんな、僕たちも続くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the spirit!
Now then, let's go!

fields.EN:
Looks like we can destroy the
core now.
fields.JP: 今回も無事に核を壊せそうですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we can destroy the
core now.

fields.JP: では核を破壊するとしよう
アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
But this means we can face the
Nightmare here.
fields.JP:
でもこれで、ナイトメアに出会っても
立ち向かうことができますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this means we can face the
Nightmare here.

fields.JP:
うんっ……
逃げ続けなくて……すむ……

fields.EN:
I have to say, it sure feels good
to destroy a core.
fields.JP:
核を破壊することほど
安心感が増す瞬間はないわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, it sure feels good
to destroy a core.

fields.EN: Tsuu, do you have a minute?
fields.JP: つう、ちょっといいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, do you have a minute?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: ん、どうしたんだグレーテル

fields.EN:
I forgot to ask, but what did you
talk about with Itsuki?
fields.JP:
聞きそびれていたのだけど、
出発前にイツキと何を話していたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I forgot to ask, but what did you
talk about with Itsuki?

fields.JP: ……本当は知っているんだろう？

fields.EN:
We talked whether something other
than Jack's blood can heal someone
from Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
……ブラッドスケルター化が
ジャックの血以外で治るのかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We talked whether something other
than Jack's blood can heal someone
from Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
He asked me if maybe we found a
new cure or something.
fields.JP:
もしかして別の治療法が見つかったのか
って聞いてきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He asked me if maybe we found a
new cure or something.

fields.EN:
What he said bothered Shirayuki,
too...
fields.JP: それ、白雪も気になってました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What he said bothered Snow White,
too...

fields.JP: わたしも。不思議でしょうがないよ

それでつう、
あなたは何と答えたのかしら？

fields.EN: I said I didn't find anything.
fields.JP: もちろん見つかってない、って答えたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I said I didn't find anything.

fields.EN:
I also told him that if I do
find a cure, I'd let him know.
fields.JP:
そんな別の治療法なんて見つかってないし、
見つかったとしたら報告してる、ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also told him that if I do
find a cure, I'd let him know.

fields.EN:
Gretel-san? You don't know of any
other cure, would you?
fields.JP:
ですよね……グレーテルさんも、
別の治療法なんて少しも知りませんよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel? You don't know of any
other cure, would you?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Of course not. I do, though, have
a theory, and when confirmed,
I will let you all know.
fields.JP:
もちろん。憶測の段階なら胸に秘めるけど、
断定できる情報に昇華したら提供するわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. I do, though, have
a theory, and when confirmed,
I will let you all know.

fields.EN:
Really, I wonder what the question
was about...
fields.JP: いったいどういうことなんだろうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really, I wonder what the question
was about...

fields.EN:
Oh, Itsuki also seemed bewildered
seeing Alice safe without
any real injuries.
fields.JP:
イツキはアリスがあそこまで
一切怪我がない『無事な姿』なのも
不思議だって言ってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Itsuki also seemed bewildered
seeing Alice safe without
any real injuries.

fields.EN:
That's right...
She was in Blood Skelter,
but wasn't hurt or anything.
fields.JP:
言われてみればそうですね……
ブラッドスケルター化しておいて、
まったく傷ついていませんでしたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right...
She was in Blood Skelter,
but wasn't hurt or anything.

fields.EN:
To add, her clothes were identical
to back then without any blemishes
or tears...
fields.JP:
それどころか、出会った時と服装も
まったく一緒で、破れたり汚れたりも
してないんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, her clothes were identical
to back then without any blemishes
or tears...

fields.EN:
Injuries can heal on their own,
but I doubt clothes can
do the same.
fields.JP:
傷は放っておいても治ったりするけど、
服の損傷は放っておいても直らないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Injuries can heal on their own,
but I doubt clothes can
do the same.

fields.EN:
Do you recall whether Alice's
clothes were damaged when we
last saw her?
fields.JP:
最後にアリスと一緒にいた時、
アリスの服装は破れてたりしたっけ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you recall whether Alice's
clothes were damaged when we
last saw her?

fields.EN:
Mmm... I don't remember...
Not that it's something I'd be on
the lookout for.
fields.JP:
うーん……覚えてないなぁ……
意識してなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I don't remember...
Not that it's something I'd be on
the lookout for.

fields.EN:
Yeah... I doubt I would've kept
an eye on her clothes, too...
fields.JP:
そうだよね……僕も意識してなかったから
覚えてないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I doubt I would've kept
an eye on her clothes, too...

fields.EN:
Isn't it possible that she was in
Blood Skelter, but miraculously
avoided having her clothes torn?
fields.JP:
となるとブラッドスケルター化したものの、
奇跡的に服が損傷しなかったって
可能性は捨てきれないんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it possible that she was in
Blood Skelter, but miraculously
avoided having her clothes torn?

fields.EN:
That's possible if she didn't meet
any enemies while in Blood
Skelter.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化した時に無事で、
その後も敵と出会ってなければ、
充分その可能性はあるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's possible if she didn't meet
any enemies while in Blood
Skelter.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, if she kept
sewing tools with her, then she
could've mended smaller tears.
fields.JP:
それに荷物の中に裁縫道具があれば、
多少破れたくらいなら直せるでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, if she kept
sewing tools with her, then she
could've mended smaller tears.

fields.EN:
I guess we have no answers...
Well, maybe we can come back to
it later.
fields.JP:
答えは出ないね……じゃあとりあえず
その件は置いておこうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we have no answers...
Well, maybe we can come back to
it later.

fields.EN:
So, do any of you think that there
may be a way to cure someone
without the use of Jack's blood?
fields.JP:
ねえ、みんなはジャックの血以外の
ブラッドスケルター化の治療法が
あると思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, do any of you think that there
may be a way to cure someone
without the use of Jack's blood?

fields.EN:
Well... I do think there's a
chance of that, but...
fields.JP:
そうだな……もしかしたらあるのかも、
とは思ってしまったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... I do think there's a
chance of that, but...

fields.EN:
If there is another way, then it
can become another beacon of
hope for us.
fields.JP:
そうだね。もし別の治療法があるのなら、
それもまた１つの希望になるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there is another way, then it
can become another beacon of
hope for us.

fields.EN:
Hypothetically speaking, what's
the chance of someone curing Blood
Skelter by being near a core?
fields.JP:
例えばだけど……
核の近くに行くとブラッドスケルター化が
治る、なんていうのはどうかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hypothetically speaking, what's
the chance of someone curing Blood
Skelter by being near a core?

fields.EN:
Hm... But, that goes against what
happened with Cinderella,
wouldn't it?
fields.JP:
なるほど……でもそれだと、
シンデレラの時はどうなんだって
話になるんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... But, that goes against what
happened with Cinderella,
wouldn't it?

fields.EN:
We fought near cores before, but
I don't recall seeing anything
unusual then...
fields.JP:
それ以外にも今まで核の近くで
戦ったりしたけれど、まったくそんな
兆候を見せたことはなかったよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We fought near cores before, but
I don't recall seeing anything
unusual then...

fields.EN:
I suppose that's a far-fetched
hypothesis then.
fields.JP: そうよね。確かに考えづらいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose that's a far-fetched
hypothesis then.

fields.EN:
How about getting cured if
you go to the Jail Tower?
fields.JP:
監獄塔に行くと治る……
なんてことはありませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about getting cured if
you go to the Jail Tower?

fields.EN:
I'm not convinced simply going
there will cure someone's
Blood Skelter state.
fields.JP:
行っただけで治る、というのは
さすがに考えにくいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not convinced simply going
there will cure someone's
Blood Skelter state.

fields.EN:
Okay, then what about the core
in the tower? Maybe it has
healing powers.
fields.JP:
じゃあ監獄塔の核に
治療する力がある……とか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then what about the core
in the tower? Maybe it has
healing powers.

fields.EN:
Hm, I guess that could be a
possibility.
fields.JP:
そうね、それについては
もしかしたらあるかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I guess that could be a
possibility.

fields.EN:
That is if the core there has
different properties than the
cores in the other areas.
fields.JP:
他の独房エリアとは違う性質を、
監獄塔の核が兼ね備えているのであれば、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is if the core there has
different properties than the
cores in the other areas.

fields.EN:
So, we're pretty much inconclusive
whether there is a different way
to cure ourselves or not.
fields.JP:
じゃあ現段階では
治療法があるかもしれないし、
ないかもしれない……と
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, we're pretty much inconclusive
whether there is a different way
to cure ourselves or not.

fields.EN:
Or, we can say that the
possibility of a cure may exist.
fields.JP:
どっちの可能性もある、
としか言えないってことだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, we can say that the
possibility of a cure may exist.

fields.EN:
Itsuki did mention that Alice's
unusual state made it difficult
for him to trust her words.
fields.JP:
ただ、イツキはそれらアリスの
置かれた状況や状態を考える限り、
話も半信半疑でしか聞けないって言ってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki did mention that Alice's
unusual state made it difficult
for him to trust her words.

fields.EN:
Might I add that I find it odd
that she would be at
the Jail Tower in the first place.
fields.JP:
それに疑問はまだあるわ。
どうしてブラッドスケルター化したアリスは
監獄塔になんて行ったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might I add that I find it odd
that she would be at
the Jail Tower in the first place.

fields.EN:
She was near the core, too...
That's usually a place guarded
well by the guardian...
fields.JP:
監獄塔の……それも核の近くですもんね。
普通なら番人がいる、危険な場所です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was near the core, too...
That's usually a place guarded
well by the guardian...

fields.EN:
Could everything just be a matter
of coincidence?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could everything just be a matter
of coincidence?

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter takes our mind from
reality, so it's entirely possible
things unimaginable may happen.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化した状態は、
いわば暴走状態だ……だから僕たちの
想像もつかない行動を取る可能性はある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter takes our mind from
reality, so it's entirely possible
things unimaginable may happen.

fields.EN:
I wonder if that state actually
brings out our primal instincts
to go to the tower...
fields.JP:
あるいは何か本能的なものだったり
するんでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if that state actually
brings out our primal instincts
to go to the tower...

fields.EN:
But if that's the reasoning,
Cinderella should have been there,
too.
fields.JP:
それだとシンデレラも
そこにいなければ辻褄が合わないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if that's the reasoning,
Cinderella should have been there,
too.

fields.EN:
Same with Kaguyahime and Akazukin. They should've been there,
too.
fields.JP:
それにかぐや姫や赤ずきんだって、
監獄塔に向かっていなければいけないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same with Kaguya and Red Riding
Hood. They should've been there,
too.

fields.EN:
Maybe they were on their way
there...
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、監獄塔に
向かっている最中だった……とか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe they were on their way
there...

fields.EN:
I doubt they have the cognitive
reasoning to do that besides
fighting and running.
fields.JP:
戦うか逃げるか……それだけの
ことしかできない気はするけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt they have the cognitive
reasoning to do that besides
fighting and running.

fields.EN:
(Run... Is there any reason why
Blood Skelter would induce us
to run?)
fields.JP:
（逃げる……？
　あの状態で逃げたい
　場面なんてあるんだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Run... Is there any reason why
Blood Skelter would induce us
to run?)

fields.EN:
I guess there aren't any real
answers yet...
fields.JP: こちらも行き詰まってしまいましたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess there aren't any real
answers yet...

fields.EN:
I'm sure we'd know more if we had
more Blood Skelter case samples.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化のサンプルが
もっとあれば、分かるかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we'd know more if we had
more Blood Skelter case samples.

fields.EN:
I'll say this beforehand, but
we're not going to induce Blood
Skelter for the sake of research.
fields.JP:
一応言っておくけど、実証を得るために
誰かがブラッドスケルター化するのはナシだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll say this beforehand, but
we're not going to induce Blood
Skelter for the sake of research.

fields.EN:
Yes, that would be taking things
a bit too far...
fields.JP: さすがにそこまではできないよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, that would be taking things
a bit too far...

fields.EN:
If we have the proper equipment
and facilities, it's entirely possible,
but... No matter.
fields.JP:
設備と状況が整えば、それも必要な
ことだとは思うけど……まあいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we have the proper equipment
and facilities, it's entirely possible,
but... No matter.

fields.JP: 謎は深まるばかりですね……

fields.EN:
Even so, unlike before, I can feel
like we're actually unraveling
mysteries instead.
fields.JP:
でも以前に比べたら、
何かこう、謎のほころびって言うのかな、
そういうのが見えてきてる気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, unlike before, I can feel
like we're actually unraveling
mysteries instead.

fields.EN:
Yes... At the very least, we know
more than before now.
fields.JP:
そうだね……確かに少しずつだけど
分かってきてる気がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... At the very least, we know
more than before now.

fields.EN:
Yup, so we should continue to have
conversations like this to find
out more.
fields.JP:
うん、諦めずにこれからも
こうやって話し合っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, so we should continue to have
conversations like this to find
out more.

fields.EN:
Alice, are you ready to face the
Nightmare here? Get psyched!
fields.JP:
アリスよ、次はいよいよナイトメアと
戦うぞ！　気合いを入れるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, are you ready to face the
Nightmare here? Get psyched!

fields.EN:
Why yes, of course.
I'll win for sure.
fields.JP:
ええ、もちろん。
……絶対に勝つつもりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, of course.
I'll win for sure.

fields.JP: へえ、すごいやる気じゃない、アリス
よし、そろそろ出発しようみんな

fields.EN:
There's no telling when the
Nightmare will strike, so let's
keep our guards up.
fields.JP:
いつナイトメアに遭遇しても
おかしくない。だから慎重に行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling when the
Nightmare will strike, so let's
keep our guards up.

fields.EN:
The white darkness is starting
to fill the area...
fields.JP:
闇が濃くなってきたわね。
白くて深い闇が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The white darkness is starting
to fill the area...

fields.JP: ナイトメアはすべて殺す……！

fields.EN:
Destroying the core means that
we can fight the Nightmare now,
right?
fields.JP:
核を破壊したから、
もうナイトメアとも戦えるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Destroying the core means that
we can fight the Nightmare now,
right?

fields.EN:
It feels so odd that the Nightmare
looks weak in comparison to the
other one we fought...
fields.JP:
さっきのナイトメアを経験してしまうと、
こっちの方のナイトメアが弱そうに
見えてしまうから不思議ですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels so odd that the Nightmare
looks weak in comparison to the
other one we fought...

fields.EN: It may be weaker than the Nightmare we just fought, but it's still a formidable enemy. If you let your guard down, you'll die.
fields.JP:
確かにさっきのナイトメアよりは
弱いかもしれないけど、充分強敵よ。
油断なんてしたら死ぬわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that doesn't mean it's weak.
You better not let your guard
down or else.

fields.EN:
I may have lost against that other
Nightmare, but I won't lose
to this one!
fields.JP:
さっきのナイトメアにはおくれを取ったが、
今回はそうはいかぬぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may have lost against that other
Nightmare, but I won't lose
to this one!

fields.EN:
To add, we have a lot in our party
now. There's no way we'll lose!
fields.JP:
そうだね、今は心強い仲間が全員揃ってる。
だから僕たちが負けることはない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, we have a lot in our party
now. There's no way we'll lose!

fields.JP: みんな、準備はいいか？　行くぞっ！！
グギィィィィィィーッ！！
ずいぶんと見た目が変わったわね……

fields.EN:
You can say that what you see
here is its true form.
fields.JP: これが本体……と言っていいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can say that what you see
here is its true form.

fields.JP: ぐるるる……あともうちょっとだよ……！
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぼ……ぐも……まも……ぎぎ……
あり…………す……ぐぎ……もる……
ジャックもやる気だな……！
よし、一気に倒してしまおう！！
アリス！　そっちに行ったぞ！
うん、アリスがトドメを刺したんだ
すごくいい……動きだった……

fields.EN:
Alice was all "boom" and
"zoom" all over!
fields.JP: うん、ありすズバーっていったね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice was all "boom" and
"zoom" all over!

fields.EN:
It's amazing considering you've
only awoken as a Blood Maiden
recently...
fields.JP:
これで血式少女なりたてだって
言うんだからビックリよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's amazing considering you've
only awoken as a Blood Maiden
recently...

fields.EN:
It makes my life easy, so...
Uh, no... You're so dependable.
fields.JP:
これならあたしも楽……いや、
とっても心強いですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It makes my life easy, so...
Uh, no... You're so dependable.

fields.EN:
I did it...
I did it, Jack!
fields.JP: 倒せた……倒せたわ、ジャック……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did it...
I did it, Jack!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おめ……ど……ぎぎぎ……
……あり……す…………でど……

fields.EN:
Jack, pat my head...
Are you praising me? Thank you...!
fields.JP:
ジャック、頭撫でて……
褒めてくれてるの？　ありがとう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you pat my head to...
praise me? Thank you...!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

んぎぎ……
あ゛り゛……ず……

fields.EN:
I wouldn't have made it if you
didn't protect me. Thank you...
fields.JP:
さっきジャックが守ってくれなかったら、
わたしとても危なかったわ。
本当にありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't have made it if you
didn't protect me. Thank you...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

あ゛り゛……ず……んぎぎぎ……
ま゛も゛れ……だ……ま゛も゛……れだ

ジャックさん、
いつもより嬉しそうですね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I can tell they're in their own
zone now...
fields.JP: 完全に２人の世界って感じがしますわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can tell they're in their own
zone now...

fields.EN:
(I can feel his happiness
surging through me...)
fields.JP: （このとても大きな喜びの感情……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can feel his happiness
surging through me...)

fields.EN:
(I can tell Jack is completely
enamored with Alice...)
fields.JP:
（ジャック、きっと完全にアリスに
　心を奪われているな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can tell Jack is completely
enamored with Alice...)

fields.EN:
Even without your connection to him,
Otsuu-chan, everyone can tell how happy
Jack-san is right now.
fields.JP:
さすがに今のジャックさんの喜びようは、
おつうちゃんじゃなくてもみんな分かるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think everyone can tell
Jack is happy now.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
You're right about that.
Jack is really pleased.
fields.JP:
そうだね、姫。
ジャックの奴、本当に嬉しそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right about that.
Jack is really pleased.

fields.EN:
Heh... I'm so glad we found Alice-san.
I haven't seen Jack-san so joyful
before.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ジャックさんがあそこまで
喜ぶなんてね。アリスさんが見つかって
本当によかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I'm so glad we found Alice.
I haven't seen Jack so joyful
before.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm sure it must have been
stressful to him not being able
to find her.
fields.JP:
うん……ここまでずっと見つからなくて、
ジャックもつらかっただろうからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm sure it must have been
stressful to him not being able
to find her.

fields.EN: And now, his wish has come true.
fields.JP: ようやく報われたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: And now, his wish has come true.

fields.EN:
I'm quite surprised to see a
Nightmare able to express himself
so noticeably.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアなのにあそこまで
感情を分かりやすく表現できるなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite surprised to see a
Nightmare able to express himself
so noticeably.

fields.EN:
I have to remind you that
Jack was once a human.
fields.JP: ジャックは元々人間だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to remind you that
Jack was once a human.

fields.EN:
Indeed. Which is why he is
able to react like that.
fields.JP:
そうね。だからこそ……
あんな風になれるのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. Which is why he is
able to react like that.

fields.EN:
Jack and Alice were the main
players this time!
I praise thee!
fields.JP:
今回の功労者はまさしく
ジャックとアリスであるな！
褒めてつかわすぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack and Alice were the main
players this time!
I praise thee!

fields.EN:
You really have to tone down your
holier-than-thou attitude...
fields.JP:
だからなんであんたはいっつも
上から目線なのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really have to tone down your
holier-than-thou attitude...

fields.EN:
Oh, let me remind you that I am
the leader, and you are all
members of Hero Hameln's party!
fields.JP:
ふふん、知りたいか？
それはだなーこのパーティが
勇者ハーメルン一行であるからだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, let me remind you that I am
the leader, and you are all
members of Hero Hameln's party!

fields.JP: おー！　メルンかっこいー！　えらそー！

fields.EN:
In any case, keep doing your
best, Alice!
fields.JP:
というわけでアリスよ、
これからも精進するのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, keep doing your
best, Alice!

fields.EN:
Hameln... I don't think she's
listening to you.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、
たぶんアリスたち聞いてない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln... I don't think she's
listening to you.

fields.EN:
Jack, don't ever leave me like
that again...
fields.JP:
ジャック、これからはもう
離れちゃ嫌よ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, don't ever leave me like
that again...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I can... I think I understand what
you're saying now...
fields.JP:
分かる……ジャックがなんて言おうと
してるのか、わたし今なら分かるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can... I think I understand what
you're saying now...

fields.EN:
Haa-chan is her usual self
no matter the situation, right?
fields.JP:
もう、ハーちゃんってば
相変わらずだなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy is her usual self
no matter the situation, right?

fields.EN:
(I'm just happy Jack's wish came
true...)
fields.JP: （本当にジャックが報われてよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm just happy Jack's wish came
true...)

fields.EN:
(But, I can feel his happiness
swelling beyond what he can
contain...)
fields.JP:
（でもこの喜びの感情……
　とてつもなく大きく膨れ上がって
　しまっている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, I can feel his happiness
swelling beyond what he can
contain...)

fields.EN: (These emotions... they've grown so much that even Jack himself can't control them...)
fields.JP:
（これ……感情が肥大しすぎて、
　ジャック自身にも制御できない
　ほどの規模だぞ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is he able to control his
emotions?)

fields.JP: （取り越し苦労だとは思うけど……）
姫っ！　どうしたんだっ！？
ぐすっ……ひっぐ……おつうちゃん……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: いま人魚の悲鳴が聞こえたけど！？

fields.EN:
What in the world was that?!
What's going on?!
fields.JP:
ちょっとちょっと、なんなのよ！
いったい何があったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What in the world was that?!
What's going on?!

fields.EN: What a way to greet the morning...
fields.JP: まったく、朝から騒々しいわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: What a way to greet the morning...

fields.EN: What seems to be the problem?
fields.JP: いったい何があったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What seems to be the problem?

fields.JP: それが……僕にもよく分からないんだ

fields.EN:
I'll help you, so please, tell me
what's wrong.
fields.JP:
姫、つらいだろうけど理由を話してくれ
僕がきっと力になってみせるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll help you, so please, tell me
what's wrong.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……
マイクが……マイクが壊れちゃったの！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I turned the switch on, but it
didn't work... It was fine
earlier... I can't sing like this!
fields.JP:
スイッチを入れても音が出なくて……
探索に行く前は壊れてなかったのに……
これじゃわたし歌えないよぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I turned the switch on, but it
didn't work... It was fine
earlier... I can't sing like this!

fields.EN:
Um, excuse me?
I don't understand what's
happening here.
fields.JP:
ちょっと、なんなの。
わたしたちにも説明しなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, excuse me?
I don't understand what's
happening here.

fields.EN:
Princess's Blood Libido is to
sing. Hence, her microphone is
really precious to her.
fields.JP:
姫の血式リビドーは歌う事なんだ。
だから、歌うために必要なマイクは、
姫にとってとても大切な物なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess's Blood Libido is to
sing. Hence, her microphone is
really precious to her.

fields.EN:
(Isn't there something I can do?
A way to stop her tears...)
fields.JP:
（どうにか……どうにかできないか？
　何か姫の涙を止める方法はないのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Isn't there something I can do?
A way to stop her tears...)

fields.EN:
*yawn*
What's with all the commotion?
Something wrong here, sweeties?
fields.JP:
ふぁあああ……
みんなこんな朝早くにどうしたの～？
なんかあったのかしらん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*yawn*
What's with all the commotion?
Something wrong here, sweeties?

fields.EN:
What perfect timing.
A person that may be able to help
is here.
fields.JP:
あら、ちょうどいいところに、
なんとかできそうな人が来たわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What perfect timing.
A person that may be able to help
is here.

fields.EN:
Uh? What?
Are ya talking about me?
fields.JP:
はい？　なになに？
オイラのこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh? What?
Are ya talking about me?

fields.EN:
Takumi, can you please fix
Princess's microphone?!
I'm sure you can, right?!
fields.JP:
タクミ、今すぐ姫のマイクを直してくれ！
もちろんできるだろう！？
いいやできないとは言わせないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Takumi, can you please fix
Princess's microphone?!
I'm sure you can, right?!

fields.JP: え？　え？　どういうこと？
いいから早く直してくれ！

fields.EN: Otsuu, you need to calm down!
fields.JP: 気持ちは分かるけど、少し落ち着きなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, you need to calm down!

fields.JP: う……親指……そうだね。ごめん

fields.EN:
You're apologizing to the wrong
person.
fields.JP: 謝る相手はわたしじゃないでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're apologizing to the wrong
person.

fields.EN:
Uh, sure, whatever...
Um, so what's this about a mic?
You mind showing it to me?
fields.JP:
いや、それはいいんだけど……
えっと、マイクを直してほしいって？
ちょっと見せてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, sure, whatever...
Um, so what's this about a mic?
You mind showing it to me?

fields.JP: どうだい？　直せるかい？

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, no.
Not with the parts I have on hand.
fields.JP:
残念だけど、今は無理ね
手持ちの部品じゃ足りないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, no.
Not with the parts I have on hand.

fields.EN:
That means if you have the parts
you can fix it, right?
Where can we find them?
fields.JP:
ということは、部品があれば直せるのね
何処にあるか心当たりはある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That means if you have the parts
you can fix it, right?
Where can we find them?

fields.EN:
You may be able to find 'em at the
former Liberated District.
fields.JP:
元解放地区に行けば、
あるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be able to find 'em at the
former Liberated District.

fields.EN:
You heard that?
You know what to do, right?
fields.JP:
だ、そうよ。
目的地は決まったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard that?
You know what to do, right?

fields.EN:
Right...
Let's go to the former Liberated
District to find the parts!
fields.JP:
……ああ、そうだね
元解放地区に部品を取りに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right...
Let's go to the former Liberated
District to find the parts!

fields.EN:
All right!
Now that that's settled, let's get going!
fields.JP:
よし！
そうと決まればさっさと行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All righty!
Let's get going, pronto!
fields.notes: B14 remove localization-only pronto verbal tic

fields.EN:
Princess, leave this all to me.
I promise you I'll get your
mic fixed.
fields.JP:
姫、僕に任せてください。
マイクは必ず直してみせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, leave this all to me.
I promise you I'll get your
mic fixed.

fields.EN:
Th-That's not it...
Um, you don't need to fix it.
fields.JP:
そ、そうじゃなくて……
マイク、直さなくて大丈夫だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That's not it...
Um, you don't need to fix it.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for all that commotion,
but... really, I'm fine...
fields.JP:
ごめんね、さっきは取り乱して……
でも、もう大丈夫だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for all that commotion,
but... really, I'm fine...

fields.EN:
I can sing without it, so please
don't burden yourselves with this.
fields.JP:
マイクが無くても歌うことはできるから
みんなに迷惑はかけられないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can sing without it, so please
don't burden yourselves with this.

fields.JP: 何を言ってるんだ、迷惑なもんか

fields.EN:
She's right. You always help us,
so this is the least we can do.
fields.JP:
そうよ、人魚姫にはいつも助けられてるもの
これくらい迷惑の内に入らないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. You always help us,
so this is the least we can do.

fields.EN:
You worry too much, Ningyo.
Just ask us for help, that's all.
fields.JP:
人魚は気にしすぎなんだって。
素直にあたしらに頼ればいいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You worry too much, Mermie.
Just ask us for help, that's all.

fields.EN:
But... Sis, I thought you wouldn't
want to go back there because of
all the bad memories...
fields.JP:
でも、だって……おねーちゃん、
黎明の仲間のこと思い出すから、
元解放地区には行きたくないかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... Sis, I thought you wouldn't
want to go back there because of
all the bad memories...

fields.EN:
Nothing to it for my sweet and
cute little sister.
fields.JP:
可愛い妹のためならそのくらい、
いくらでも我慢できる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing to it for my sweet and
cute little sister.

fields.EN:
To add, we're talking about Blood
Libido here. We all know the pain
we go through because of it.
fields.JP:
それに、血式リビドーなら話は別だ
それがどれだけ苦しいか、あたしらが
一番よく分かってるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, we're talking about Blood
Libido here. We all know the pain
we go through because of it.

fields.JP:
みんな……っ
ありがとう……っ

fields.EN:
We're only doing what's right.
We are friends, after all.
fields.JP:
当たり前のことをしてるだけですよ
僕たちは、仲間なのですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're only doing what's right.
We are friends, after all.

fields.EN:
Now then, let's head out to
the former Liberated District!
fields.JP:
よし、それじゃあ準備ができたら
元解放地区に向かおう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, let's head out to
the former Liberated District!

fields.EN:
I think that's about all we
need for parts.
fields.JP:
言われてた部品、
だいたい集まったんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that's about all we
need for parts.

fields.EN: Well, should we head back then?
fields.JP: では、そろそろ戻りますか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, should we head back then?

fields.EN:
Just a second. I want to bring
back as many as possible,
just in case.
fields.JP:
いや、念のため少し多めに
部品を持って帰りたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a second. I want to bring
back as many as possible,
just in case.

fields.EN:
Fine...
Well, let me go search for parts
over there...
fields.JP:
しょうがないですね～
では～、わらわは向こうの方を
探してきます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
Well, let me go search for parts
over there...

fields.JP: じゃあ、あたしはあっちの方探してくる

みんな、
本当にありがとう……！
わたしも、行ってくるね！
さて、僕もがんばらないと！
よし、このくらいあれば十分だろう

fields.EN:
I better go and gather everyone
together.
fields.JP: そろそろ、みんなを呼んでみるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better go and gather everyone
together.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Thanks, Jack.
You found me parts...
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャック。ありがとう
部品を集めてくれたんだね……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Jack.
You found me parts...

fields.EN:
That's amazing!
Look at how many you found!
Great work, Jack!
fields.JP:
すごいじゃないか！
こんなにたくさん集めるなんて！
お手柄だよジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's amazing!
Look at how many you found!
Great work, Jack!

fields.EN:
I'm sure Princess's mic can be
fixed now. I'm sure she'd be
happy, too!
fields.JP:
これだけあれば、きっとマイクも直る。
姫も喜んでくれるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Princess's mic can be
fixed now. I'm sure she'd be
happy, too!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Thank you again, Jack.
You truly are a great friend.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジャック。
君は僕の……大切な友達だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you again, Jack.
You truly are a great friend.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

おつうちゃーん！
ジャックさーん！

fields.EN:
Looks like they're back.
We should get going.
fields.JP:
……みんな戻って来たみたいだ。
さあ、帰ろう。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like they're back.
We should get going.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
タクミ！　材料持ってきたよ！

fields.EN:
Good work, girls... Huh?
Uh, a bit too much?
fields.JP:
おつかれー……って、
持ってき過ぎじゃない！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good work, girls... Huh?
Uh, a bit too much?

fields.EN:
We gathered as many as we
could, just in case. I'm sure this
is enough to fix it, right?
fields.JP:
万が一を考えて余分に集めてきたんだ。
これだけあればさすがに直せないなんて、
言わないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We gathered as many as we
could, just in case. I'm sure this
is enough to fix it, right?

fields.EN:
Whoa, thanks for the pressure.
Guess you can't control yourself
if it's about Ningyo-chan.
fields.JP:
うわー、プレッシャーかけるなー
相変わらず人魚ちゃんのこととなると、
暴走するのねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa, thanks for the pressure.
Guess you can't control yourself
if it's about Lil' Mermaid.

fields.EN:
Eh, whatever.
Just leave the rest to me!
fields.JP:
ま、いいわ
あとは私に任せなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eh, whatever.
Just leave the rest to me!

fields.EN:
I'm sure it'll be fine.
Takumi's a weirdo, but he is
skilled.
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ。タクミは変人だけど、
腕は確かだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure it'll be fine.
Takumi's a weirdo, but he is
skilled.

fields.EN:
Of course! Perfection at its
finest! Here ya go. Ningyo-chan's
prized possession.
fields.JP:
もちろんよ。我ながらいい仕事したぜー
はい、人魚ちゃんの大事なもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! Perfection at its
finest! Here ya go. Lil' Mermaid's
prized possession.

fields.EN:
Wow...!
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP: わぁ……！　ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow...!
Thank you so very much!

fields.JP: なーに、いいってことよ！

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, try pressing the button
over there.
fields.JP:
あ、そうそう、ちょっとそこの
ボタン押してみ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, try pressing the button
over there.

fields.EN:
I fixed the recording feature on
the mic while I was at it.
fields.JP:
そいつは録音機能だよ。
ついでに直しといたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I fixed the recording feature on
the mic while I was at it.

fields.EN:
I didn't know the mic had
such a feature.
fields.JP: そのマイクそんな機能付いてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know the mic had
such a feature.

fields.JP: わたしも知らなかった……

fields.EN:
It's pretty darn old, so prolly
it was broken when ya first
