ハーメルン、あなたあの教祖の
言葉を覚えてるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, do you remember what
the leader of the Order said?

fields.EN:
You mean the one at the entrance?
Didn't she say something about
a child led by the Blood Maidens?
fields.JP:
監獄塔の入り口におった奴だな。
確か『血式少女に導かれた子』だったか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean the one at the entrance?
Didn't she say something about
a child led by the Blood Maidens?

fields.EN:
Yes. I could tell that she knew
something special about Tsuu.
fields.JP:
そう。あの教祖はつうに何か特別な力が
あると、そう考えている様子だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I could tell that she knew
something special about Otsuu.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Tsuu is... unique. After all,
she was able to communicate
with Jack.
fields.JP:
確かにつうには不思議な力がある。
ジャックと意思疎通ができたりしたのも、
その一つなのでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu is... unique. After all,
she was able to communicate
with Jack.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: で、それがどうしたと言うのだ

fields.EN:
I want to place my bets on Tsuu
and whatever it is that makes her
"special."
fields.JP:
私は、それに賭けてみようと思うの。
つうの『特別な力』とやらにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to place my bets on Otsuu
and whatever it is that makes her
"special."
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Don't you think this situation is
strange? It's like everything's
designed to keep Tsuu alive.
fields.JP:
ここまでの状況も不思議だと思わない？
あらゆる要素がつうを生かそうと
しているかのよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you think this situation is
strange? It's like everything's
designed to keep Otsuu alive.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Thinking back, it almost feels
like our future was predetermined
by some fate.
fields.JP:
そう思うと、まるで今までの出来事が
『あらかじめ決められた運命』のように
感じてしまうのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking back, it almost feels
like our future was predetermined
by some fate.

fields.EN:
So, your choice to place your
bets on her is also part of it?
fields.JP:
貴様が……賭けをしようと考えている、
それすらも……か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, your choice to place your
bets on her is also part of it?

fields.EN:
Why yes. The answer I came to
is probably something that was
determined by fate, too.
fields.JP:
ええそうよ。私がこの局面で
ひねり出した考え、それですらきっと
もう決まっていたことなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. The answer I came to
is probably something that was
determined by fate, too.

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you're trusting
something that isn't factual.
fields.JP:
驚いたぞグレーテル、
貴様がそのようなあやふやなものを
選択するとはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you're trusting
something that isn't factual.

fields.JP:
論理的ではないと？
……ふふ、案外そうでもないのよ？

fields.EN:
I analyzed our options and
concluded that no other
choices remain.
fields.JP:
何故なら、これ以外の選択肢が
私たちには残されていないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I analyzed our options and
concluded that no other
choices remain.

fields.EN: With all of us at our limits, we have no moves left. If this keeps up, we'll just be backed into a corner little by little.
fields.JP:
すべてが限界の私たちに打つ手はなく、
このままではじわじわと詰んでいくだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're at our limits, so whatever
we do, we're destined for failure.

fields.EN:
But, I believe we still have a
chance by betting on Tsuu. The
probabilities remain grim, though.
fields.JP:
それならつうの『特別な力』とやらに
賭けた方がまだ勝算があると判断したの。
針の穴を通すような確率かもしれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I believe we still have a
chance by betting on Otsuu. The
probabilities remain grim, though.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP:
なるほどな。だが人魚姫まで
眠らせたのは何故なのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... But, why Little Mermaid?

fields.EN:
In any case, my bet won't work
if we die here now.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、この作戦も
ここで私たちが死ねば何の意味もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, my bet won't work
if we die here now.

fields.EN:
I need a powerful partner to help
protect Tsuu and Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアからつうと人魚姫を守るには、
強力で頼もしいパートナーが必要なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need a powerful partner to help
protect Otsuu and Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I see! So that's where I come in!
fields.JP:
なるほど、そこで
ワレの出番というわけだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see! So that's where I come in!

fields.EN:
Exactly.
I'm counting on you, Hameln.
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
頼りにしてるわ、ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly.
I'm counting on you, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Leave it to me!
Now, let us go, Gretel!
fields.JP:
任せておけ！
では共に行くぞ、グレーテル！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave it to me!
Now, let us go, Gretel!

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan, I suppose
we are siblings after all...
fields.JP: ……やはり私もヘンゼル兄さんの妹なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear brother Hansel, I suppose
we are siblings after all...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
I took a stand for the future,
just like you...
fields.JP: だって、未来のために立ち向かうんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I took a stand for the future,
just like you...

fields.JP:
（僕は……そうか、
　意識を失ってたのか……）

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem to be around...
Princess, what happ-...
fields.JP:
は、いないみたいだ……。
姫……いったい何が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem to be around...
Princess, what happ-...

fields.JP:
うぅ……ハーちゃん……
死んじゃ嫌だよ……！

fields.EN:
Your hand... so warm...
I'm sorry... Please... hold my
hand... a bit stronger...
fields.JP:
人魚姫の……手……あ、温かいな……
すまぬが、もう少し……強く握、って……
は……くれぬだ……ろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your hand... so warm...
I'm sorry... Please... hold my
hand... a bit stronger...

fields.JP: 何故か、とても……寒くて……な……

fields.EN:
Okay... I'll hold real tight...
So please... Don't die!
fields.JP:
うん、握る……ぎゅっと握るから、
だから死なないでハーちゃん……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I'll hold real tight...
So please... Don't die!

fields.EN:
Oh...? Otsuu... You're awake...
I'm sorry, but... could you hold...
my other hand...?
fields.JP:
おお、おつうも……目が覚めたか……
すまぬが……おつう、も……反対の手……
握って……くれぬ、だろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh...? Otsuu... You're awake...
I'm sorry, but... could you hold...
my other hand...?

fields.JP: ああ、もちろんだハーメルン……！

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... My hands...
are so... bloody...
fields.JP:
こん、な……血まみれの手で……
ぐっ……悪い、が……な……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... My hands...
are so... bloody...

fields.EN: There's nothing to be sorry about!
fields.JP: 何も悪いことなんてないさ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: There's nothing to be sorry about!

fields.EN:
I... I wasn't... a hero...
I was... the Demon King...
to the end...
fields.JP:
……ワレは……最後……
勇者ではなく……魔王……であった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I wasn't... a hero...
I was... the Demon King...
to the end...

fields.EN:
I couldn't... save Gretel...
What kind of... hero...
is that...?
fields.JP:
グレーテルを……守れなかった、その時……
そんな勇者など……いらぬ、と……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't... save Gretel...
What kind of... hero...
is that...?

fields.EN:
I then... became the... Demon
King... to... destroy all...
fields.JP:
敵を容赦なく倒す……魔王になって
……やると……そう……思ったのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I then... became the... Demon
King... to... destroy all...

fields.EN:
But, it was then... I finally...
knew what... Mamoru meant...
by being... a friend...
fields.JP:
でも、その時……マモルたちが
言ってた……『仲間』が……やっと……
分かった気が……した、のだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it was then... I finally...
knew what... Mamoru meant...
by being... a friend...

fields.JP:
おい目を開けろハーメルン！
開けろってばぁっ！！

ハーちゃん……ハーちゃん……！
うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁん！！

うわぁぁぁん……ハーちゃん……！
グレーテルさん……あぁぁぁ……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Open your eyes!
I never asked for this to happen!
fields.JP:
目を開けてよ……！
こんなのやだよ、ねえ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Open your eyes!
I never asked for this to happen!

fields.EN:
Why did they do this?!
We could've fought against it
together!
fields.JP:
どうして２人とも……そんな無茶を……！
僕たちみんなで立ち向かえば
よかったじゃないか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did they do this?!
We could've fought against it
together!

fields.JP:
ひぐっ……もうやだ……
……えぐっ……うぁぁ……！

fields.EN:
(Is there any meaning in having
a future with no one around?)
fields.JP:
（こんな、みんないなくなった未来に
　意味なんてあるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is there any meaning in having
a future with no one around?)

fields.JP: なんで……こんなことに……うぅ……

fields.EN:
(That's right... Now's my time to
finally repay what I owe...)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……今こそ
　『僕の恩返し』の時なんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... Now's my time to
finally repay what I owe...)

fields.EN:
(I want to wipe Princess's tears.
I promised her I'd protect her.)
fields.JP:
（姫の涙を拭ってやりたい。
　守るって、決めたじゃないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to wipe Princess's tears.
I promised her I'd protect her.)

fields.EN:
(But, how can I stop her tears?
How can I pay back what I owe
to her?)
fields.JP:
（どうすれば涙を拭ってあげられる？
　どうすれば恩を返せる？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, how can I stop her tears?
How can I pay back what I owe
to her?)

fields.EN:
(She saved me all this time...
It's now or never for me to
do what I can for her!)
fields.JP:
（僕はずっと助けられてきた……
　今ここで人魚姫に恩を返さなくて
　いつ返すって言うんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She saved me all this time...
It's now or never for me to
do what I can for her!)

fields.EN:
(Owe... Repay what I owe...
I will repay all that
is due to her!)
fields.JP:
（恩返しを……姫に恩返しを、
　絶対に恩返しをするんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Owe... Repay what I owe...
I will repay all that
is due to her!)

fields.JP: あがぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: What's wrong, Otsuu-chan?! Stay with me!!
fields.JP:
どうしたのおつうちゃん、
しっかりして！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happened?!
Please stay with me!!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I couldn't bear it if I lost you too,
Otsuu-chan...!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんまでいなくなったら
わたしもう耐えられないよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What am I going to do if
I lose you now?!

fields.JP:
……なんでみんな
こんなことになってしまったの……？

fields.EN:
I should've died in everyone's
place if I knew this was
going to happen...
fields.JP:
みんなが死ぬくらいなら
わたしが代わりに死ねばよかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should've died in everyone's
place if I knew this was
going to happen...

fields.JP:
ひ……め…………
……うっ……うあぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

fields.EN: (Everyone was left on the verge of death because of Nightmare Alice...!)
fields.JP:
（みんなナイトメア・アリスのせいで
　瀕死になってしまった……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything went for the worse
because of Nightmare Alice!)

fields.EN:
(What would've happened if
Alice didn't enter Blood
Skelter in the first place?)
fields.JP:
（そもそもあの時、アリスが
　ブラッドスケルター化しなかったら？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What would've happened if
Alice didn't enter Blood
Skelter in the first place?)

fields.EN:
(What if Jack didn't turn into
a Nightmare?)
fields.JP:
（あの時ジャックが
　ナイトメアにならなければ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What if Jack didn't turn into
a Nightmare?)

fields.EN:
(Was Cinderella at fault for
the peculiar predicament
between the three sisters?)
fields.JP: （三姉妹の境遇はシンデレラのせいでは？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Was Cinderella at fault for
the peculiar predicament
between the three sisters?)

fields.EN:
(Were we the ones who made
Cinderella enter Blood Skelter?)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラがブラッドスケルター化
　したのは、僕たちのせいでは？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Were we the ones who made
Cinderella enter Blood Skelter?)

fields.JP:
（あれ、みんなが
　幸せに暮らしている世界！？）
うあぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(I remember now...
I understand everything now...)
fields.JP:
（すべて思い出した……
　……だからもう、すべて理解できる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember now...
I understand everything now...)

fields.EN:
(Everything... What the cause of
everything is... What this world
truly is...)
fields.JP:
（これまでに起きた出来事の原因も……
　この『世界』についても、すべて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everything... What the cause of
everything is... What this world
truly is...)

fields.JP:
あぐぁぁあっ……ぐぅぅっ……！
……うがぁぁぁぁっ……！！

fields.EN:
What can I do to help
Otsuu-chan?!
fields.JP:
どうすれば苦しそうなおつうちゃんを
助けてあげられるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What can I do to help
Otsuu?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Otsuu-chan!
I can't do anything...!
fields.JP:
ごめんね、おつうちゃん……！
わたし何もできなくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Otsuu!
I can't do anything...!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(It's no use... It's coming...
I can't show myself to Princess.)
fields.JP:
（ああ、駄目だ……来る……。
　この先はもう、姫には見せられない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's no use... It's coming...
I can't show myself to Princess.)

fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
大丈、夫だよ……姫……

おつうちゃん……！
まだ起き上がっちゃ駄目だよ……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
いいんだ……それよりも姫、
よく聞いてほしい……

fields.EN: I'll do something about this now... so don't ever follow me...
fields.JP:
今から僕が何とかするから……
だから絶対に追いかけてきちゃ駄目だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll do something about all this,
so... don't look at me...

fields.EN:
What do you...?
Ah... Wait! Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
それって、どういう……
あっ、待っておつうちゃん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you...?
Ah... Wait! Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 絶対に覗いちゃ駄目だからね！！

おつうちゃん……
何を……する気なの……？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
この方向は……
もしかして上に向かった……？

fields.EN:
Why did she tell me not to
look at her? Is she trying to tell
me not to come after her?
fields.JP:
覗いては駄目？　どういうことなの……？
追いかけてはいけないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did she tell me not to
look at her? Is she trying to tell
me not to come after her?

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、
すごい必死な感じだった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I could tell was that she was
really serious...

fields.EN:
But even if she tells me not to... I can't just
leave Otsuu-chan when she's suffering so much...
fields.JP:
でも、駄目だなんて言われても……
あんな苦しそうなおつうちゃんを
放ってはおけないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's no way I can just
leave her... Her suffering
was so immense...

fields.EN:
I need to find her...
I need to find Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
行かなきゃ……
追いかけなきゃ、おつうちゃんを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to find her...
I need to find Otsuu...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
どうしよう、おつうちゃん
ここにもいない……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
あっ……！　あれは……
また別のナイトメア……！？

fields.EN:
It found me!
I-I need to run...!
fields.JP:
見つかっちゃった……！
どうしよう、逃げないと――
fields.LOCALIZED:
It found me!
I-I need to run...!

fields.EN: I told you not to look at me...
fields.JP: 絶対に覗いちゃ駄目だと言ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you not to look at me...

fields.EN:
I should've known better that you
would come after me.
fields.JP: でも、姫は見ちゃうよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should've known better that you
would come after me.

fields.EN:
You're so kind and strong. You
like singing, and you sometimes
make the boldest of decisions...
fields.JP:
優しくて強い。
歌が大好きで……
ときどき、無茶をする
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so kind and strong. You
like singing, and you sometimes
make the boldest of decisions...

fields.EN:
I loved and adored
all that you were.
fields.JP: そんな君が愛しくて、大好きだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I loved and adored
all that you were.

fields.JP: もしかして……おつうちゃん……？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
That's right, Princess.
I'm Tsuu, the one you bonded
to in matrimony...
fields.JP:
そうだよ、姫。
君と夫婦の契りを交わした、つうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right, Princess.
I'm Otsuu, the one you bonded
to in matrimony...
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
What's happening...? Were you a Nightmare,
Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
今何が起きてるの……？
おつうちゃんはナイトメアだったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's going on?
Were you... a Nightmare?

fields.EN:
This is all too much...
Please, tell me what's going on.
fields.JP:
いきなりすぎて全然分からないよ……
お願い、ちゃんと教えて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is all too much...
Please, tell me what's going on.

fields.EN:
I know what I'll say will sound
unbelievable, but please listen
with an open mind.
fields.JP:
突拍子もない話に
聞こえるかもしれないけど……
どうか聞いてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know what I'll say will sound
unbelievable, but please listen
with an open mind.

fields.EN:
I... was a Nightmare that traveled
from the future to the past to
save you.
fields.JP:
……僕は姫を救うために、未来から
過去へと飛んだナイトメア……だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... was a Nightmare that traveled
from the future to the past to
save you.

fields.EN:
I used to live as a Nightmare at
a place called the Metropolitan
Building, "Tocho."
fields.JP:
元々は『都庁』と呼ばれる場所で、
僕はナイトメアとして生きていた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I used to live as a Nightmare at
a place called the Metropolitan
Building, "Tocho."

fields.EN:
It seems I was born without the
powers of a Nightmare.
I was weak...
fields.JP:
僕は中途半端なナイトメアに生まれた
みたいで、力なんて全然なかった。
ひ弱だったんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I was born without the
powers of a Nightmare.
I was weak...

fields.EN:
The Marchens where I was
were all powerful, and soon
they chased me out.
fields.JP:
しかも都庁のメルヒェンはどいつも強く、
僕は段々と居場所を失っていったんだ。
ナイトメアがメルヒェンに追われたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Marchens where I was
were all powerful, and soon
they chased me out.

fields.EN:
As I ran, I came upon the Aquarium
Ruins, and that's where I met
Ningyohime...
fields.JP:
そして逃げるように遠くに出かけた僕は、
たまたま水族館跡エリアに迷い込んで……
そして『人魚姫』に出会ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As I ran, I came upon the Aquarium
Ruins, and that's where I met
Little Mermaid...

fields.EN:
You treated me kindly, even in
this unsightly state.
fields.JP:
こんな化け物の姿の僕に、
姫はとても親切にしてくれたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You treated me kindly, even in
this unsightly state.

fields.EN: But I was a coward. I kept running away, worried that Princess might be frightened of me or come to hate me...
fields.JP:
だけど僕は臆病で、姫に怖がられたり
嫌われたりしたらどうしよう……って、
ずっと逃げていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I kept avoiding you, too shy
to say anything, too scared of
being despised by you...

fields.EN:
But after some time passed,
I decided to talk to you,
and searched for you for days.
fields.JP:
今日こそは声をかけようって思って、
いったい何日が過ぎただろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after some time passed,
I decided to talk to you,
and searched for you for days.

fields.EN:
By the time I mustered the courage
to speak, you went missing.
fields.JP:
ついに勇気を振り絞った時には、
姫はもう水族館跡エリアからいなくなってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time I mustered the courage
to speak, you went missing.

fields.EN:
Having no reason to stay anymore,
I decided to return to my abode.
But I couldn't find my way back.
fields.JP:
それで仕方なく都庁に帰ろうとしたけど……
帰り道が分からなくなってしまったんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Having no reason to stay anymore,
I decided to return to my abode.
But I couldn't find my way back.

fields.EN:
I lost my way into the underground
cavern, and soon became a
wandering Nightmare...
fields.JP:
そして僕は、地下洞窟を彷徨う
ナイトメアになっていった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lost my way into the underground
cavern, and soon became a
wandering Nightmare...

fields.EN:
Time passed, then one day
I finally met some humans, but
they quickly moved in to attack.
fields.JP:
そんなある日、僕は久しぶりに
人間に出会ったんだけど……
その人間たちは僕を見るなり襲ってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Time passed, then one day
I finally met some humans, but
they quickly moved in to attack.

fields.EN: Those humans were Akazukin and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
それが赤ずきんたち、
その時の血式少女たちだったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those humans were Red Riding
Hood and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised they attacked.
Look at me... I probably would've
done so, too.
fields.JP:
まあその時は今よりも化け物の姿だったから、
襲ってくるのも仕方ないよね……
今ならその気持ちはよく分かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised they attacked.
Look at me... I probably would've
done so, too.

fields.EN:
Of course, back then, I thought
to myself how horrible humans
were...
fields.JP:
その時はなんて酷い
人間たちだろうって思ったけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, back then, I thought
to myself how horrible humans
were...

fields.EN:
So... Did you fight Sis?
What happened?
fields.JP:
それで……おねーちゃんたちとは
どうなったの？　戦ったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So... Did you fight Sis?
What happened?

fields.EN:
I used fakes of me as bait
and ran. There was no way
I could take them all on at once.
fields.JP:
いいや、偽者を囮にしてひたすら逃げたよ。
敵うわけないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I used fakes of me as bait
and ran. There was no way
I could take them all on at once.

fields.EN:
I kept running, and soon I came
back to the Metropolitan Building.
That's when I heard...
fields.JP:
でたらめに逃げる内に都庁に出たんだけど、
赤ずきんたちが追いかけてきて、
そこで聞いたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept running, and soon I came
back to the Metropolitan Building.
That's when I heard...

fields.EN:
...that you died from entering
Blood Skelter at the Aquarium
Ruins.
fields.JP:
姫は、水族館跡エリアで
ブラッドスケルター化して
死んだ……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
...that you died from entering
Blood Skelter at the Aquarium
Ruins.

fields.EN:
The moment I heard that, I made
the Metropolitan Building grow
as fast as I could.
fields.JP:
それを聞いた僕はいてもたっても
いられなくなって、都庁のジェイルを
成長させた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moment I heard that, I made
the Metropolitan Building grow
as fast as I could.

fields.EN:
An area that grows large enough
produces a special core that can
mimic one's wish perfectly.
fields.JP:
成長したジェイルは大きな核を生み出す。
『願いを最大限擬態化してくれる』という、
特別な核をね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
An area that grows large enough
produces a special core that can
mimic one's wish perfectly.

fields.EN:
We Nightmares call this
special core, "Witchcraft."
fields.JP:
それを僕たちナイトメアは、
『ウィッチクラフト』って呼んでいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Nightmares call this
special core, "Witchcraft."

fields.EN:
You know how we tried to
escape by making the Jail
Tower grow, right?
fields.JP:
今まで僕たちは、監獄塔を伸ばして
脱獄するって考えていただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how we tried to
escape by making the Jail
Tower grow, right?

fields.EN:
The Jail Tower grows in tandem
with the Jail, but that alone
isn't enough to escape.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの成長に伴って、
監獄塔は確かに伸びるよ。
でもそれで脱獄なんてできないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail Tower grows in tandem
with the Jail, but that alone
isn't enough to escape.

fields.EN:
Of course, maybe a Witchcraft
core would have been born to
grant the wish.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、脱獄を願えば叶う何かに
擬態化してくれるかもしれないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, maybe a Witchcraft
core would have been born to
grant the wish.

fields.JP: まあ、今となってはどうでもいい話さ

fields.EN:
In any case, I was able to grow
the tower to reach the moon to
inseminate it.
fields.JP:
結末はすごく単純だ。僕は監獄塔を伸ばし、
上の月に届かせて、受精させた。
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I was able to grow
the tower to reach the moon to
inseminate it.

fields.EN:
That brought about a Witchcraft
core, to which I earnestly prayed...
fields.JP:
そして産まれたウィッチクラフト……
大きな核に強く願ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That brought about a Witchcraft
core, to which I earnestly prayed...

fields.JP: そっか……そう願ってくれたんだね……

fields.EN:
Yes, and it worked. I became a
Blood Maiden in this world before
you died at the Aquarium Ruins.
fields.JP:
気付けば僕は血式少女となって、
姫が死んでしまう前の水族館跡エリアにいた。
この世界は、そこから始まってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it worked. I became a
Blood Maiden in this world before
you died at the Aquarium Ruins.

fields.EN:
The reason I came here...
Well, I don't think I need to
explain much else now...
fields.JP:
そして今、僕がここに来たのは……
つまりはそういうことだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason I came here...
Well, I don't think I need to
explain much else now...

fields.EN:
I came to pray upon
this Witchcraft core again...
fields.JP:
強い願いを擬態化して叶えてくれる、
このウィッチクラフトに……
願いに来たんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came to pray upon
this Witchcraft core again...

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan... what were you going to wish for?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは、
何を願うつもりだったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, what are you planning to
wish for?

fields.EN:
I may be able to bring back
someone from the dead so long
as their body is within range.
fields.JP:
死体があれば、人は蘇らせることが
できるかもしれないんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may be able to bring back
someone from the dead so long
as their body is within range.

fields.EN:
I want to bring everyone that died
back to life.
fields.JP: だから、死んでいったみんなを蘇らせたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to bring everyone that died
back to life.

fields.EN: ...What about the people from Dawn? No, not just them—what about everyone else who's been brutally murdered up to now?
fields.JP:
……黎明の人は？
ううん、それだけじゃない、
他に今まで惨殺された人は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What about the members of Dawn?
Or how about all the people who
died in the past?

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Was everyone happy
in a world where I wasn't alive?
fields.JP:
ねえ、おつうちゃん。
わたしが生きてない時間軸では、
みんなは幸せだった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Was everyone happy
in a world where I wasn't alive?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: お願い、ちゃんと答えて

fields.EN:
Yes... Or, at least I think they
were happy.
fields.JP: うん……幸せだったと、思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Or, at least I think they
were happy.

fields.EN:
Cinderella was an adult, and the
bad air between the sisters
didn't exist.
fields.JP:
その時間軸では
幼いままのシンデレラもいないし、
仲の悪そうな三姉妹もいなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella was an adult, and the
bad air between the sisters
didn't exist.

fields.EN:
Alice and Jack were humans, and
they all were working together.
fields.JP:
何より、アリスもジャックも人間のままで、
みんなと行動を共にしていたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and Jack were humans, and
they all were working together.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, do you mind if I
come closer?
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、側に行ってもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, do you mind if I
come closer?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
P-Princess!
You shouldn't come near me now...
fields.JP:
ひ、姫……！？
僕、今はこんな姿だから近づかない方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess!
You shouldn't come near me now...

fields.EN: I want to hug you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: 抱きしめさせて、おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to hug you, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Thank you for doing all that
you've done for me.
fields.JP:
わたしのためにそこまでしてくれて、
本当にありがとうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for doing all that
you've done for me.

fields.EN:
What you did filled my life
with happiness.
fields.JP:
おかげで、わたしは
いっぱいいっぱい幸せだったよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What you did filled my life
with happiness.

fields.EN:
Which is why I don't think you
should wish to reverse what has
happened.
fields.JP:
でもね、こんな風に、
なかったことにしちゃうのはダメだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why I don't think you
should wish to reverse what has
happened.

fields.EN:
I think we all do our best when
fate gives us things that
can't be changed.
fields.JP:
取り返しがつかなくて、
だから精一杯にがんばろうって思える――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think we all do our best when
fate gives us things that
can't be changed.

fields.EN:
That's what it means to live
in the "present."
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what it means to live
in the "present."

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? You should wish for
something else.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが願うべきは、
もっと違うことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? You should wish for
something else.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Let's return this world to the way it was meant
to be. Let's live properly, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
この世界を、本来あるべき姿に戻そう
正しく生きよう、おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should return this world to
its proper order. We should live
as fate originally intended.

fields.EN:
No... No, no, no!
I don't want to lose you!
fields.JP:
いやだ……いやだいやだ！
姫を失うなんて絶対にいやだっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... No, no, no!
I don't want to lose you!

fields.EN:
I don't want to lose you
ever again!
fields.JP: 僕はもう二度と姫を失いたくないんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to lose you
ever again!

fields.EN:
But we can't leave all the Blood
Maidens, the members of Dawn,
everyone dead, right?
fields.JP:
じゃあ黎明のみんな、解放地区のみんな……
血式少女のみんなは死んだままでいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we can't leave all the Blood
Maidens, the members of Dawn,
everyone dead, right?

fields.EN:
Is a future without a single one
of them a happy future, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
誰かが欠けている未来でも、
おつうちゃんは幸せだって言えるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is a future without a single one
of them a happy future, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
But...!
Of course I want them all alive...
fields.JP:
それはっ……！
……そんなの、もちろんいやだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...!
Of course I want them all alive...

fields.EN:
I was only concerned about you...
But, I found out that I also cared
about everyone we were with...
fields.JP:
前は、姫さえいればいいって思ってた……
だけど……気づいたらみんなのことも
大好きで、すごく大事で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was only concerned about you...
But, I found out that I also cared
about everyone we were with...

fields.EN: There's no one I love more than you, Princess. That's certain. But... I love everyone else too much to want to lose them...
fields.JP:
姫が一番大好きだ、それは絶対だ。
でも、でもみんなも失いたくないくらい
大好きなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no one I love more than
you, Princess. But, I don't want
all of our friends to remain dead...

fields.EN: What am I supposed to do?!
fields.LOCALIZED: What am I supposed to do?!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: That's how I feel about you...
fields.JP: これがわたしの、きもちだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's how I feel about you...

fields.EN: You feel the same about me...
fields.LOCALIZED: You feel the same about me...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、愛してるよ……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
So, my dear prince, the time has
come for you to repay me for
what you owe.
fields.JP:
けどね、恩を返してほしい時が来たの。
ねえ、わたしの王子さま
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, my dear prince, the time has
come for you to repay me for
what you owe.

fields.EN:
Indeed...
I am your prince, after all.
fields.JP:
……そうだったね。
僕は君の王子さまだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed...
I am your prince, after all.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm your prince. I'm the
perfect prince to protect you,
and to grant your wish.
fields.JP:
そう、僕は王子なんだ。姫を守り、
姫の願いを叶える、そんな完璧な王子なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm your prince. I'm the
perfect prince to protect you,
and to grant your wish.

fields.EN:
Oh, and I also know there's no way
I can change your mind once you've
made a choice.
fields.JP: それに、こうなったら姫は頑固だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I also know there's no way
I can change your mind once you've
made a choice.

fields.EN:
Sorry to be such
a stubborn princess.
fields.JP: わがままな姫で、ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to be such
a stubborn princess.

fields.EN:
Well now, a bit of stubbornness
makes you cuter, my dear princess.
fields.JP:
なーに、多少わがままな方が
可愛らしいというものですよ、姫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, a bit of stubbornness
makes you cuter, my dear princess.

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I love you more than anything.
I pray that we will meet again
one day in the future...
fields.JP:
姫、僕もあなたを愛しています。
……いつか未来の果てで、お会いしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you more than anything.
I pray that we will meet again
one day in the future...

fields.EN:
Yes... And when we meet,
we'll be joined in matrimony again.
fields.JP:
はい……ふつつか者ですが、
末永くよろしくお願い致します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... And when we meet,
we'll be joined in matrimony again.

fields.EN:
It's time we depart.
Please, watch your step...
fields.JP:
さあ、出発しましょう。
お足元にお気をつけて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's time we depart.
Please, watch your step...

fields.EN:
Bring to us the true
"present" of this world...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bring to us the true
"present" of this world...

fields.EN:
No! Don't come any closer!
Please! It hurts!
fields.JP:
いやっ、こないでっ！
おねがいっ、いたいってばぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Don't come any closer!
Please! It hurts!

fields.EN:
I can't believe you're all ganging
up on such a little girl!
You're all gonna pay!
fields.JP:
こんな小さな子に
１０体でよってたかって……許さない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you're all ganging
up on such a little girl!
You're all gonna pay!

fields.EN:
Shoot! There's too many!
If this keeps up...!
fields.JP:
くそっ……数が多い……！
このままじゃやられる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! There's too many!
If this keeps up...!

fields.JP:
……あはっ、あははははは！
あーっはっはっは！
あはっ……！　死ね死ね死ねぇっ！
あははっ！　あははははははっ！

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...
That was tiring, but... thank
goodness she's safe, I think...
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
結構しんどかったけど……
でも助けられてよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff...
That was tiring, but... thank
goodness she's safe, I think...

fields.EN:
It's gonna be all right!
We'll get you back and get
Miko to patch you up!
fields.JP:
だ……大丈夫！　すぐに帰って、
ミコに手当てしてもらうから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's gonna be all right!
We'll get you back and get
Miko to patch you up!

fields.EN:
Who are you...?
Are you my dear sister...?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who are you...?
Are you my dear sister...?

fields.JP: あたし、赤ずきんだよ。あんたは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me? I'm Red Riding Hood.
And you?

fields.JP: わたし……わたしは、人魚姫……

fields.EN:
Don't you worry! We'll meet up
with Haru, and take you back
to Dawn!
fields.JP:
安心して。すぐにハルと合流して、
黎明に連れてってあげるから。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry! We'll meet up
with Haru, and take you back
to Dawn!

fields.EN:
Hey! Look!
We just have to go around that
corner, and...
fields.JP:
あっ！　あそこだ！
あとはあの角を曲がれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Look!
We just have to go around that
corner, and...

fields.EN:
More of them...?!
Sorry! Can you wait over here,
Ningyo?
fields.JP:
またいっぱいきた……！
ごめんニンギョ、おろすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
More of them...?!
Sorry! Can you wait over here,
Little Mermaid?

fields.EN:
I'm... okay...!
Let big sis' here handle this!
fields.JP:
だいっ……じょうぶっ……！
おねーちゃんが、守ってあげるから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... okay...!
Let big sis' here handle this!

fields.JP: っ！　ニンギョに、触るなあああああっ！

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff... Finally, done...
Ningyo, are you...
all... right...?
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
よし、ぜんぶ倒した……
ニンギョ、だい……じょう、ぶ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff... Finally, done...
Little Mermaid, are you...
all... right...?

fields.EN:
Ningyo... your legs...
They turned into... a fish tail?
fields.JP:
ニンギョ……あんた、足が……
魚の尾っぽになって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid... your legs...
They turned into... a fish tail?

fields.EN:
Ouch! What are you doing,
Ningyo?!
fields.JP: 痛いっ！　何するの、ニンギョ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch! What are you doing,
Little Mermaid?!

fields.JP: ガゥ！　ガァァァァッ！！

fields.EN:
Aagh! S-Stop it! That hurts!
Ningyo!
fields.JP:
ぎゃあっ！　やめて、
やめてよニンギョ！　痛いよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aagh! S-Stop it! That hurts!
Little Mermaid!

fields.JP: グガァァァァァァァッ！！
い……いやだああああああああああっ！

ちっちゃい……
おねー……ちゃん……？

そ、そっか…………
よかっ……た……

fields.EN:
She wasn't a Marchen.
She was definitely a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP: メルヒェンではないな。血式少女だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wasn't a Marchen.
She was definitely a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
I can't believe we found a Blood
Maiden. But then you let her die.
I'm disappointed in you, Haru-kun.
fields.JP:
新たな血式少女を見つけたと思ったら、
まさか死なせてしまうとは……ハルくん、
君がついていながら、残念だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe we found a Blood
Maiden. But then you let her die.
I'm disappointed in you, Haru.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun

fields.EN:
According to Akazukin,
this girl, Ningyohime, had an
awakening we're not aware of.
fields.JP:
しかし、どういう事だろうな……
赤ずきんの話によると、この人魚姫は、
私達がまだ知らない覚醒の仕方をしたようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
According to Red Riding Hood,
this girl, Little Mermaid, had an
awakening we're not aware of.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I didn't actually
see it myself, but...
fields.JP:
ああ。俺も見たわけじゃねぇから
何とも言えないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I didn't actually
see it myself, but...

fields.EN:
...From what I heard, even though she adored Akazukin,
she attacked without warning and couldn't be reasoned with.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんを慕ってたはずなのに、問答無用で
襲ってきて、言葉も通じなかったって話だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...From what I heard, despite the
girl's fondness for Red,
she still jumped her.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Could it be that there's another
level to the awakening?
A true awakening, so to speak?
fields.JP:
覚醒にはもう一段階ある……？
正の覚醒と負の覚醒……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that there's another
level to the awakening?
A true awakening, so to speak?

fields.EN:
Based on what Akazukin
reported, Ningyohime was
covered in Marchen blood.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの話では、
人魚姫はメルヒェンの血を浴びた。
それは確かなようです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Based on what Red Riding Hood
reported, Little Mermaid was
covered in Marchen blood.

fields.EN:
She was also quite frightened.
Maybe that could be playing a role
in what happened.
fields.JP:
あとは異様なまでに怯えていたようです。
もしかしたら、それが関係している可能性も
あるかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was also quite frightened.
Maybe that could be playing a role
in what happened.

fields.EN:
Duh, like, a young girl witnessing
a bloodbath, that would scare the
wits out of anyone.
fields.JP:
あんな幼い子が目の前で
血まみれの殺し合いを見せられたんだ、
怯えるのもしょうがねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Duh, like, a young girl witnessing
a bloodbath, that would scare the
wits out of anyone.

fields.EN:
Miko's suggestion is worth noting.
Maybe the girl's mental stability
was broken from the bloodshed.
fields.JP:
いや、考慮の余地はある。
血を浴びすぎて、殺戮を見せつけられて……
心の均衡でも崩れたか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko's suggestion is worth noting.
Maybe the girl's mental stability
was broken from the bloodshed.

fields.EN:
If so, she may have entered an
uncontrollable state. Let us call
it "Blood Skelter" for now...
fields.JP:
だとしたら、この異常な制御不能状態は、
さしずめ『ブラッドスケルター状態』……
……といったところか
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, she may have entered an
uncontrollable state. Let us call
it "Blood Skelter" for now...

fields.JP: なるほど、ブラッドスケルター……ね

fields.EN:
I suppose I should conduct further
research using Marchen blood to...
fields.JP:
これはメルヒェンの血を使って、
さらなる実験をする必要があるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose I should conduct further
research using Marchen blood to...

fields.EN:
Excuse me, but I noticed that
Ningyohime's body isn't
rotting at all...
fields.JP:
そういえば、この人魚姫の死体……
一向に腐りませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, but I noticed that
Little Mermaid's body isn't
rotting at all...

fields.EN:
Indeed.
That is also quite peculiar.
fields.JP: そうだ、ここも異常な点だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed.
That is also quite peculiar.

fields.EN:
Could it be that it is because
she died during Blood Skelter?
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、ブラッドスケルター化
してる状態で死んだからか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could it be that it is because
she died during Blood Skelter?

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.
Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(It looks like she ate the
food I left for her...)
fields.JP:
（今日も、私が用意したごはん、
　食べてくれたみたい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like she ate the
food I left for her...)

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(I'm so happy she took it...
I sure wouldn't mind talking
with her...)
fields.JP:
（嬉しいなあ……でももっと
　ちゃんとお話をしてみたいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm so happy she took it...
I sure wouldn't mind talking
with her...)

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(I feel like the longer I wait,
the more I'll regret it...)
fields.JP:
（何だか早くしないと
　後悔しそうな気がするし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like the longer I wait,
the more I'll regret it...)

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(Well then, I'll try talking to
her tomorrow!)
fields.JP:
（よし、決めた！
　明日こそあの子に話しかけよう！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well then, I'll try talking to
her tomorrow!)

fields.notes: Canonical name-tag: ナイトメア・つう => Nightmare Tsuu.

fields.JP:
ぎぎ……あじだ……
だのじ、み……ぎちち……だな……

fields.EN: みなさん、解放地区見えました！
fields.JP: みなさん、解放地区見えました！
fields.LOCALIZED: みなさん、解放地区見えました！

fields.EN: ……待ってくれ、何かおかしいぞ
fields.JP: ……待ってくれ、何かおかしいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: ……待ってくれ、何かおかしいぞ

fields.EN: 嫌な予感がする……みんな、急ごう！
fields.JP: 嫌な予感がする……みんな、急ごう！
fields.LOCALIZED: 嫌な予感がする……みんな、急ごう！

fields.EN: 無事でいてくれ、みんな――
fields.JP: 無事でいてくれ、みんな――
fields.LOCALIZED: 無事でいてくれ、みんな――

fields.EN: ハルさん！　視子さん！
fields.JP: ハルさん！　視子さん！
fields.LOCALIZED: ハルさん！　視子さん！

fields.EN:
嘘ですよね……
ハルさん、視子さん……
fields.JP:
嘘ですよね……
ハルさん、視子さん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
嘘ですよね……
ハルさん、視子さん……

fields.EN:
（両目がないのが……ハルさん。
　四肢がないのが……視子さん）
fields.JP:
（両目がないのが……ハルさん。
　四肢がないのが……視子さん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
（両目がないのが……ハルさん。
　四肢がないのが……視子さん）

fields.EN:
（どこからどう見ても記憶の
　２人とはかけ離れているのに、
　間違いなく２人と断言できてしまう……）
fields.JP:
（どこからどう見ても記憶の
　２人とはかけ離れているのに、
　間違いなく２人と断言できてしまう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
（どこからどう見ても記憶の
　２人とはかけ離れているのに、
　間違いなく２人と断言できてしまう……）

fields.EN:
（どう見ても、
　死んでるって断言できてしまう……！）
fields.JP:
（どう見ても、
　死んでるって断言できてしまう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
（どう見ても、
　死んでるって断言できてしまう……！）

fields.EN: いったい誰がこんなことを……！
fields.JP: いったい誰がこんなことを……！
fields.LOCALIZED: いったい誰がこんなことを……！

fields.EN:
そこのおまえ！
その人から離れろ！
fields.JP:
そこのおまえ！
その人から離れろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
そこのおまえ！
その人から離れろ！

fields.EN: ううぉぉぅうううぉぉおお……
fields.JP: ううぉぉぅうううぉぉおお……
fields.LOCALIZED: ううぉぉぅうううぉぉおお……

fields.EN: あがぁぁああぁあああ……
fields.JP: あがぁぁああぁあああ……
fields.LOCALIZED: あがぁぁああぁあああ……

fields.EN:
門脇さん！？　
しっかりして下さい門脇さんっ！！
fields.JP:
門脇さん！？　
しっかりして下さい門脇さんっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
門脇さん！？　
しっかりして下さい門脇さんっ！！

fields.EN:
何……このナイトメア……
こんなおぞましいの、初めて……
fields.JP:
何……このナイトメア……
こんなおぞましいの、初めて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
何……このナイトメア……
こんなおぞましいの、初めて……

fields.EN:
貴様らは下がっておれ。
ここはワレが引き受けよう
fields.JP:
貴様らは下がっておれ。
ここはワレが引き受けよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
貴様らは下がっておれ。
ここはワレが引き受けよう

fields.EN:
僕もやる。
絶対に後悔させてやる
fields.JP:
僕もやる。
絶対に後悔させてやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
僕もやる。
絶対に後悔させてやる

fields.EN: ふはは！　背を向けるとは愚かな！
fields.JP: ふはは！　背を向けるとは愚かな！
fields.LOCALIZED: ふはは！　背を向けるとは愚かな！

fields.EN:
ハーメルン！
追わなくていい！！
fields.JP:
ハーメルン！
追わなくていい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
ハーメルン！
追わなくていい！！

fields.EN:
（意味が分からない……本当なら
　僕たちは新しい血式少女を仲間にして、
　喜び合っていたはずなのに……）
fields.JP:
（意味が分からない……本当なら
　僕たちは新しい血式少女を仲間にして、
　喜び合っていたはずなのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
（意味が分からない……本当なら
　僕たちは新しい血式少女を仲間にして、
　喜び合っていたはずなのに……）

fields.EN:
（なのになんでこんなことに……
　いったいどうすればいいんだよ……）
fields.JP:
（なのになんでこんなことに……
　いったいどうすればいいんだよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
（なのになんでこんなことに……
　いったいどうすればいいんだよ……）

fields.EN:
門脇さん！
お願い目を覚まして！
fields.JP:
門脇さん！
お願い目を覚まして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
門脇さん！
お願い目を覚まして！

fields.EN: うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！
fields.JP: うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: うわぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！

fields.EN:
なんで！？　どうしてみんな
殺されなければいけないの！？
なんで……なんでよぉ……！
fields.JP:
なんで！？　どうしてみんな
殺されなければいけないの！？
なんで……なんでよぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
なんで！？　どうしてみんな
殺されなければいけないの！？
なんで……なんでよぉ……！

fields.EN:
もういや……！
大好きなみんながいなくなるの、
もういやだよぉ……！！
fields.JP:
もういや……！
大好きなみんながいなくなるの、
もういやだよぉ……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
もういや……！
大好きなみんながいなくなるの、
もういやだよぉ……！！

fields.EN:
つらい時はこうやって抱きしめるって、
姫が教えてくれたんだ
fields.JP:
つらい時はこうやって抱きしめるって、
