fields.JP: さあ、どこからでもかかってこい！
fields.LOCALIZED: さあ、どこからでもかかってこい！

fields.EN: こんなのがいつも徘徊してるなんてな……
fields.JP: こんなのがいつも徘徊してるなんてな……
fields.LOCALIZED: こんなのがいつも徘徊してるなんてな……

fields.EN: そうだね、あまり見慣れたくはないね
fields.JP: そうだね、あまり見慣れたくはないね
fields.LOCALIZED: そうだね、あまり見慣れたくはないね

fields.EN:
いっそまっすぐ突撃した方が、
まだマシかもね
fields.JP:
いっそまっすぐ突撃した方が、
まだマシかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
いっそまっすぐ突撃した方が、
まだマシかもね

fields.EN: おい、無用な戦闘は避けるからな？
fields.JP: おい、無用な戦闘は避けるからな？
fields.LOCALIZED: おい、無用な戦闘は避けるからな？

fields.EN:
分かってるってー。
おつうは心配性だなぁ
fields.JP:
分かってるってー。
おつうは心配性だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
分かってるってー。
おつうは心配性だなぁ

fields.EN: 姫を危険に巻き込むなって言ってるんだ
fields.JP: 姫を危険に巻き込むなって言ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: 姫を危険に巻き込むなって言ってるんだ

fields.EN:
分かってるって！　人魚もおつうも、
お姉さんが絶対守ってあげるから！
fields.JP:
分かってるって！　人魚もおつうも、
お姉さんが絶対守ってあげるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
分かってるって！　人魚もおつうも、
お姉さんが絶対守ってあげるから！

fields.EN:
（失敗したら、僕もここの
　囚人になってしまうんだよな……）
fields.JP:
（失敗したら、僕もここの
　囚人になってしまうんだよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
（失敗したら、僕もここの
　囚人になってしまうんだよな……）

fields.EN: （想像するだけでも吐きそうだ……）
fields.JP: （想像するだけでも吐きそうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: （想像するだけでも吐きそうだ……）

fields.EN:
でもこの調子なら、新しい血式少女の人も
無事に助け出せるよ、きっと！
fields.JP:
でもこの調子なら、新しい血式少女の人も
無事に助け出せるよ、きっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
でもこの調子なら、新しい血式少女の人も
無事に助け出せるよ、きっと！

fields.EN:
それは確かに。
でも油断しないで牢屋に向かおう
fields.JP:
それは確かに。
でも油断しないで牢屋に向かおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
それは確かに。
でも油断しないで牢屋に向かおう

fields.EN:
なんせ相手は話の通じない
拷問好きの集団だからね……
fields.JP:
なんせ相手は話の通じない
拷問好きの集団だからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
なんせ相手は話の通じない
拷問好きの集団だからね……

fields.EN:
（新しい血式少女が
　無事でいてくれるのを願うよ……）
fields.JP:
（新しい血式少女が
　無事でいてくれるのを願うよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
（新しい血式少女が
　無事でいてくれるのを願うよ……）

fields.EN: よし……ようやく牢獄に着いたぞ
fields.JP: よし……ようやく牢獄に着いたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: よし……ようやく牢獄に着いたぞ

fields.EN: やっぱり血式少女が３人もいると早いね
fields.JP: やっぱり血式少女が３人もいると早いね
fields.LOCALIZED: やっぱり血式少女が３人もいると早いね

fields.EN:
これはあたしたちに
風が吹いてる……はずよ
fields.JP:
これはあたしたちに
風が吹いてる……はずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
これはあたしたちに
風が吹いてる……はずよ

fields.EN: でも、けっこうな牢屋の数だね……
fields.JP: でも、けっこうな牢屋の数だね……
fields.LOCALIZED: でも、けっこうな牢屋の数だね……

fields.EN:
門番のメルヒェン……
ああして見回っているんだね……
fields.JP:
門番のメルヒェン……
ああして見回っているんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
門番のメルヒェン……
ああして見回っているんだね……

fields.EN: 何とかしてやり過ごせないかな……？
fields.JP: 何とかしてやり過ごせないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED: 何とかしてやり過ごせないかな……？

fields.EN:
……遠ざかった隙に手前の牢屋から入るか、
あるいは１人囮になって引きつけるか……
fields.JP:
……遠ざかった隙に手前の牢屋から入るか、
あるいは１人囮になって引きつけるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
……遠ざかった隙に手前の牢屋から入るか、
あるいは１人囮になって引きつけるか……

fields.EN: 脱出も考えるとなると……
fields.JP: 脱出も考えるとなると……
fields.LOCALIZED: 脱出も考えるとなると……

fields.EN:
吐き気を催す匂いの元凶があったら、
どうすればいいと思う？
fields.JP:
吐き気を催す匂いの元凶があったら、
どうすればいいと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
吐き気を催す匂いの元凶があったら、
どうすればいいと思う？

fields.EN:
待ってても何も変わらないなら、
さっさと倒しちゃえばいいってことよ
fields.JP:
待ってても何も変わらないなら、
さっさと倒しちゃえばいいってことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
待ってても何も変わらないなら、
さっさと倒しちゃえばいいってことよ

fields.EN: あっ、赤ずきんっ！　飛び出すなって！
fields.JP: あっ、赤ずきんっ！　飛び出すなって！
fields.LOCALIZED: あっ、赤ずきんっ！　飛び出すなって！

fields.EN:
くそっ……作戦も何も
あったもんじゃない……！
fields.JP:
くそっ……作戦も何も
あったもんじゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
くそっ……作戦も何も
あったもんじゃない……！

fields.EN: おつうちゃん、わたしたちも行こう！
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、わたしたちも行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED: おつうちゃん、わたしたちも行こう！

fields.EN: まったく赤ずきんの奴……！
fields.JP: まったく赤ずきんの奴……！
fields.LOCALIZED: まったく赤ずきんの奴……！

fields.EN:
(I wanted to see Princess,
but wouldn't barging in to her
room seem a bit tactless?)
fields.JP:
（姫に会いたくて部屋の前まで来たけど、
　いきなり来たら迷惑じゃないかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wanted to see Princess,
but wouldn't barging in to her
room seem a bit tactless?)

fields.EN:
(Coming here every day may
be too much for her, too...)
fields.JP:
（それに、毎日何度も何度も訪ねてるし、
　さすがに気持ち悪がられるんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Coming here every day may
be too much for her, too...)

fields.EN:
Mmm...
A good reason to visit her...
fields.JP: うーん……何かいい理由は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...
A good reason to visit her...

fields.JP: あれ？　おつうちゃん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, did you come to see me?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、もしかしてわたしに
会いに来てくれたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you come to see me?

fields.EN:
Huh?!
N-Not at all! I just happened
to pass by.
fields.JP:
えっ！？
い、いや、たまたま通りかかっただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?!
N-Not at all! I just happened
to pass by.

fields.EN:
Uh... Th-That's right!
I-I was just going to go back
to my room!
fields.JP:
えっと……そ、そう！
ち、ちょうど部屋に戻るところだったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Th-That's right!
I-I was just going to go back
to my room!

fields.EN:
But Otsuu-chan, you already passed your room,
didn't you?
fields.JP:
でも、おつうちゃんの部屋、
もう通り過ぎてるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you do know you already
went past your room, right?

fields.EN:
Th-That aside, how are things,
Princess?!
fields.JP: ひ、姫の方こそいったいどうしたんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-That aside, how are things,
Princess?!

fields.EN:
Were you planning on coming
to see me, perhaps?
fields.JP:
もしかして、僕に会いに行こうと
してたのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Were you planning on coming
to see me, perhaps?

fields.EN:
I wanted to talk with Otsuu-chan, so I was
coming to see you. I was surprised to find you
in front of my room.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんとお話したくて、
会いに行こうとしたら部屋の前に
いるんだもん。びっくりしちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to talk with you, so
it was a surprise seeing you
here in front of my room.

fields.EN:
So if Otsuu-chan came because you wanted to
talk with me too, that would've made me happy...
fields.JP:
だから、おつうちゃんも
わたしとお話したくて来てくれたのなら、
嬉しかったんだけどなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would've been great if you
actually came by to see me.

fields.EN:
I see... Otsuu-chan is going back to your room
already. That's too bad...
fields.JP:
そっかぁ、おつうちゃんは、
もう部屋に戻っちゃうんだ。
残念だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're heading back, right?
Mmm... Too bad.

fields.EN:
I'd be so happy if Otsuu-chan said you wanted
to talk with me.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんがわたしと話したいって、
そう言ってくれたらとっても嬉しいのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would've been soooo happy if
you said you came to talk to me.

fields.EN:
I give up!
Yes! I came because I wanted to
see you, Princess.
fields.JP:
降参だ！
本当は、姫に会いたくて来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I give up!
Yes! I came because I wanted to
see you, Princess.

fields.EN:
Really?! Why didn't you say so
earlier?! Come on in!
Let me brew you some tea.
fields.JP:
ほんと！　嬉しい！
じゃあ、部屋に入って！
美味しいお茶を淹れてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! Why didn't you say so
earlier?! Come on in!
Let me brew you some tea.

fields.EN:
As you command, my dear princess.
I will follow you to your bidding.
fields.JP:
仰せのままに、姫。
どこへなりとも、一生ついていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you command, my dear princess.
I will follow you to your bidding.

fields.EN:
(Unbelievable... She toyed with
my heart ever so easily...)
fields.JP:
（まったく、そうやって君は、
　僕の心をいとも簡単に弄ぶんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Unbelievable... She toyed with
my heart ever so easily...)

fields.EN:
(But, that is also what makes
her so attractive.)
fields.JP:
（だけど、そのちょっと意地悪なところも、
　すごく魅力的だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, that is also what makes
her so attractive.)

fields.EN:
(Taken advantage by love...
An apt description of me indeed.)
fields.JP:
（惚れた弱み、なんて言うけど、
　全くその通りだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Taken advantage by love...
An apt description of me indeed.)

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness!
I made it in time!)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness!
I made it in time!)

fields.JP:
（ああ……
　いつ聞いても姫の歌はいい……）

fields.EN:
O-Otsuu-chan?!
Since when were you there?!
fields.JP:
お、おつうちゃん！？　
いつからそこに居たの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Otsuu?!
Since when were you there?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: I just came a short while ago.
fields.LOCALIZED: I just came a short while ago.

fields.EN:
Aw...
I thought you wouldn't notice.
fields.JP:
も、もう……
今日こそは気づかれないと思ったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw...
I thought you wouldn't notice.

fields.EN:
Did you think I wouldn't notice?
I would follow you no matter
where you would go.
fields.JP:
僕が姫の美声を聞き逃すわけがないだろう？
たとえ地球の裏側に居ても、
こうして駆けつけるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you think I wouldn't notice?
I would follow you no matter
where you would go.

fields.EN:
That aside, do you mind singing
a bit more for me?
fields.JP:
それよりも、もっと僕に歌を
聴かせてくれないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, do you mind singing
a bit more for me?

fields.EN:
Geez, Otsuu-chan! You keep saying embarrassing
things, so that's enough for today!
fields.JP:
もう！　おつうちゃんが恥ずかしいこと
ばっかり言うから、今日はお終いです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Stop it with all your
sweet talk! No more for you!

fields.EN:
That's quite unfortunate.
But... are you sure about that?
fields.JP:
それは本当に残念だ。
でもいいのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite unfortunate.
But... are you sure about that?

fields.EN:
I'm sure you want to sing a bit
more, yes?
fields.JP: 本当はまだ歌い足りないんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you want to sing a bit
more, yes?

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないもん

fields.EN:
I've been with you for as long as
forever. I know you're lying just
by the expression on your face.
fields.JP:
僕が普段どれだけ姫の事を見ていると
思っているんだい？　顔を見れば、
それくらい分かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been with you for as long as
forever. I know you're lying just
by the expression on your face.

fields.EN:
Geez... You can be mean sometimes,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
もう……
おつうちゃんはたまにいじわるだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
You really know how to tease
others, don't you?

fields.EN:
I am still very much a child, you
know? That's why I have this knack
for teasing the girl I love.
fields.JP:
僕は子供っぽいからね。
だから、大好きな女の子に、
ついいじわるしてしまうんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am still very much a child, you
know? That's why I have this knack
for teasing the girl I love.

fields.EN:
Hey...!
Okay then. Just one song, though.
fields.JP:
……もう。
分かった。そこまで言うなら歌ってあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey...!
Okay then. Just one song, though.

fields.JP: もう……ずるいなぁ、おつうちゃんは
ナイトメア・ジャック

ちぎぎ……うだ……
うぎ……ぎぎ……

fields.EN: Did you come to listen too, Jack?
fields.JP: ジャックも聴きに来たのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you come to listen too, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぢぎ……うぎぎ……
ぎぎ……ぎ……
ジャック、踊ってるのかい？
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……だのじい……
ぎぎ……ぎ……
ははっ、なかなか上手じゃないか

fields.EN:
Princess, it's me.
Can I come in?
fields.JP:
姫、僕だけど。
入っていいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, it's me.
Can I come in?

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん？
うん、どうぞ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Hi, Otsuu-chan.
What brings you here today?
fields.JP:
いらっしゃい。おつうちゃん。
今日はどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi, Otsuu.
What brings you here today?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
There's something I wanted to
show you.
fields.JP: 姫に、見てもらいたい物があって来たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's something I wanted to
show you.

fields.EN:
I wrote some lyrics to the song
you always sing.
fields.JP:
実は、いつも姫が歌ってる歌に、
歌詞をつけてみたんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wrote some lyrics to the song
you always sing.

fields.EN: Really? You mind if I take a look?
fields.JP: そうなんだ。読んでもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? You mind if I take a look?

fields.EN:
Sure. I can only hope you'll
like what I have there...
fields.JP:
もちろん。
喜んでくれるといいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. I can only hope you'll
like what I have there...

fields.EN:
Let's see...
"My dear prince, your eyes gracing
me fills my heart..."
fields.JP:
えっと……わたしの好きな王子様。
あなたに見つめられるだけで
わたしの胸は――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see...
"My dear prince, your eyes gracing
me fills my heart..."

fields.EN:
So, how is it?
I wrote it based on the view of
a prince.
fields.JP:
どうかな？
王子様をテーマに書いてみたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how is it?
I wrote it based on the view of
a prince.

fields.EN:
It actually sounds more like it's
being read in the view of a
princess.
fields.JP:
王子様っていうより、
お姫様の気持ちって感じかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It actually sounds more like it's
being read in the view of a
princess.

fields.EN:
Hee hee... But I think that's just like you,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
ふふ……
でも、とってもおつうちゃんらしいと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
But it's soooo like you.

fields.EN:
Thank you. I'm happy you went
through the trouble to write this,
but it's a bit embarrassing.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。とっても嬉しいよ。
でも、歌うのはちょっと照れくさいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I'm happy you went
through the trouble to write this,
but it's a bit embarrassing.

fields.JP: ええっ！？　ど、どうして！？

fields.EN: The lyrics are too cute for me...
fields.JP: だって、わたしには可愛すぎるもの
fields.LOCALIZED: The lyrics are too cute for me...

fields.EN:
C-Cute...? S-So, you're telling
me that my lyrics are as sweet
as strawberries?
fields.JP:
か、可愛い……そんなばかな……
この僕が書いた歌詞が、
甘々ストロベリーだと言うのかい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Cute...? S-So, you're telling
me that my lyrics are as sweet
as strawberries?

fields.JP: あまあまストロベリー！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Ningyo! Where sweets?!
Rapunzel want some!
fields.JP:
にんぎょ！　おかしはどこ！？
ラプンツェルもたべたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fishy! Where sweets?!
Rapunzel want some!

fields.EN:
Huh? S-Sweets?
Oh, um... I don't have any with
me now...
fields.JP:
え？　お、お菓子？
えーっと……今お菓子はないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? S-Sweets?
Oh, um... I don't have any with
me now...

fields.EN:
Huh? But, I hear sweet
strawberries.
fields.JP:
えー？　だってさっき、
かしがあまあまストロベリーってきこえた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But, I hear sweet
strawberries.

fields.EN:
Oh, it was just a comparison to
the lyrics I wrote.
fields.JP:
それはお菓子のことじゃなくて、
僕の歌詞のことだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, it was just a comparison to
the lyrics I wrote.

fields.JP:
どういうことー？
かしっておかしのことじゃないの？

fields.EN:
Um... The sweets we were talking
about is this...
fields.JP:
えっと……さっきわたしが言ってた
『かし』は、食べ物じゃなくてこれの事なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... The sweets we were talking
about is this...

fields.EN:
It's words for a song.
It's called "lyrics."
fields.JP:
歌に言葉をのせたもの。
それが歌詞っていうのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's words for a song.
It's called "lyrics."

fields.EN:
"My dear prince... your eyes...
gracing... me fills... my heart...
with... sweet choc...olates..."
fields.JP:
わたしのすきなおうじさま
あなたにみつめられるだけで、
むねにチョコレートのようなあまさが――
fields.LOCALIZED:
"My dear prince... your eyes...
gracing... me fills... my heart...
with... sweet choc...olates..."

fields.EN:
R-Rapunzel!
Keep it down, will you?!
fields.JP:
ら、ラプンツェル！
声に出さなくていいから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Rapunzel!
Keep it down, will you?!

fields.JP: （うう、急に恥ずかしくなってきた！）
ラプちゃん、どうだった？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
チョコとかイチゴとかでてきて、
とってもおいしそうだったよ！

fields.EN:
Heh, you're right.
Just like Otsuu-chan, nice and sweet.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そうだね。
おつうちゃんらしくて可愛いよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, you're right.
Just like Otsuu, nice and sweet.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Urrh... I'll be back next time
with a piece befitting of a true
prince!
fields.JP:
うう……つ、次はかっこいい王子様風の
歌詞を作って来るから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... I'll be back next time
with a piece befitting of a true
prince!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel wanna real sweets
next time.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、つぎはたべもののほうの
『かし』がいいなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel wanna real sweets
next time.

fields.EN:
(I finally got the bracelet
I asked Takumi to make for me.
Now, to find Princess...)
fields.JP:
（タクミに頼んでいたブレスレットが
　ようやく完成した。
　さっそく姫にプレゼントしに行こう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I finally got the bracelet
I asked Takumi to make for me.
Now, to find Princess...)

fields.JP: （さて、姫はどこにいるのかな……）

fields.EN:
It's okay to play, but you really
have to keep things a bit cleaner
around here.
fields.JP:
もう……遊ぶのはいいですけど、
あんまり散らかしちゃだめですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay to play, but you really
have to keep things a bit cleaner
around here.

fields.JP: う……ごめんなさいですわ

fields.EN:
Just be careful the next time.
Now then, let's play.
fields.JP:
次から気をつけてくれればいいんですよ
じゃあ……何して遊びましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just be careful the next time.
Now then, let's play.

fields.JP: ちゃんとごめんなさいできたご褒美にね

fields.EN:
I'm not a child, so I'm not that
interested in playing...
fields.JP:
わたくし子供じゃありませんから、
遊んでほしくなんてありませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a child, so I'm not that
interested in playing...

fields.EN:
Oh, that's too bad. I wanted to play with you,
Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
そっか、残念だなぁ。
わたしはシンデレラさんと
遊びたいんだけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, too bad. And just when
I wanted to play with you.

fields.EN:
B-But, if you really want to play
then I suppose I can oblige!
fields.JP:
ま、まあ、人魚姫がどうしてもと言うなら
考えてあげなくもなくってよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But, if you really want to play
then I suppose I can oblige!

fields.EN:
(She's there, but the timing isn't
great with the others around.)
fields.JP:
（姫を見つけたはいいけど、
　ちびっこたちの前じゃムードがなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's there, but the timing isn't
great with the others around.)

fields.JP: ありがとうにんぎょ！　たのしかったよ！

fields.EN:
Well, it wasn't as bad
as I expected...
fields.JP: まあ、楽しくないこともなくってよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it wasn't as bad
as I expected...

fields.EN: Yup, let's play again next time!
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, let's play again next time!

fields.JP:
（どうやらちびっこたちは満足して、
　帰って行ったみたいだな）

fields.EN:
Ningyohime!
I have a favor to ask!
fields.JP:
人魚姫～！　
ちょっとお願いしたいことがあるんです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid!
I have a favor to ask!

fields.JP: あれ？　かぐやちゃんと……おつうちゃん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(Wha-?! Of all the times
Kaguya has to intervene!)
fields.JP:
（くっ……！
　かぐや、なんてタイミングの悪い！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wha-?! Of all the times
Kaguya has to intervene!)

fields.EN:
Oh, you're here too, Otsuu.
Perfect timing.
fields.JP:
おつうも一緒にいるんですね～。
丁度いいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're here too, Otsuu.
Perfect timing.

fields.EN:
My room is quite messy now,
and I was hoping you'd help.
fields.JP:
わらわの部屋がちょっと散らかってて、
片付けるのを手伝ってほしいんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
My room is quite messy now,
and I was hoping you'd help.

fields.JP: そ、それくらい自分でやりなよ！

fields.EN:
Oh, but I do take pride that my
room is so messy that no person
can get the place clean.
fields.JP:
自慢じゃないですが、
一人だと一生終らない自信があります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I do take pride that my
room is so messy that no person
can get the place clean.

fields.EN:
Uh, that's nothing you should
be proud about...
fields.JP: 本当に自慢にならないよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's nothing you should
be proud about...

fields.EN:
So how about it? Can you help?
Oh, and I will repay you for
helping me clean.
fields.JP:
なので、お手伝いをお願いします～。
あ、お礼ならしますから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So how about it? Can you help?
Oh, and I will repay you for
helping me clean.

fields.JP: わたしはべつに構わないけど……

fields.EN:
Fine...
You owe me one, got it?
fields.JP:
……わかったよ。
これは貸しだからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
You owe me one, got it?

fields.EN:
Thank you very much.
I knew I could count on you too,
Otsuu.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～
やっぱり、おつうは頼りになりますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much.
I knew I could count on you too,
Otsuu.

fields.EN: W-We have to clean this place up?
fields.JP: こ、これを片付けるのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: W-We have to clean this place up?

fields.JP: あ、足の踏み場も無いね……

fields.EN:
I told you the place can't be
cleaned.
fields.JP:
わらわひとりじゃ一生終らないって、
言ったじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you the place can't be
cleaned.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect you to have
explained your room literally...
fields.JP: まさか、言葉通りの意味だったとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect you to have
explained your room literally...

fields.EN:
If we three work together,
I'm sure we'll get this done!
fields.JP:
さ、三人でやればすぐに終わるよ！
が、がんばろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we three work together,
I'm sure we'll get this done!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...!
Again, you owe me one!
fields.JP:
ああ、もう！
これは貸しだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...!
Again, you owe me one!

fields.EN:
Thank you so very much.
I'll come and ask for your help
when my room gets messy again.
fields.JP:
今日は本当に助かりました～
また、散らかってきたら
よろしくお願いしますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so very much.
I'll come and ask for your help
when my room gets messy again.

fields.JP: そうなる前に自分で掃除しろ！

fields.EN:
She ran away...
Lazy as usual, I guess...
fields.JP:
逃げた……
結局、怠け者のまんまじゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She ran away...
Lazy as usual, I guess...

fields.EN:
Well, that's done, so now back to
talking with...
fields.JP:
……まぁ、いい。
これでやっと落ち着いて姫と話が――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's done, so now back to
talking with...

fields.EN:
Ah! There you two are!
I've been looking for you girls!
fields.JP:
おお！　こんなところにいたか！
二人とも探したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah! There you two are!
I've been looking for you girls!

fields.JP: ハーちゃん、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
I found out that heroes need a
legendary sword!
fields.JP:
実はな、勇者には伝説の剣というものが
必要だという事が分かったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found out that heroes need a
legendary sword!

fields.EN:
Yes! Unfortunately, I have none
on me! So, I was going to search
for one.
fields.JP:
うむ！
しかし困ったことに、我は持っていない！
それで、探しに行こう思うのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes! Unfortunately, I have none
on me! So, I was going to search
for one.

fields.EN:
Maybe next time...
I'm a bit tired after doing some
clean-up earlier.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、また今度にしてくれないか。
ちょっとさっきの掃除で疲れててね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe next time...
I'm a bit tired after doing some
clean-up earlier.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Hm... Well, it can't be helped if
you're tired! By all means, go and
rest in your room!
fields.JP:
ふむ……疲れてるのなら仕方ないな！
ゆっくり部屋で休むといいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Well, it can't be helped if
you're tired! By all means, go and
rest in your room!

fields.EN:
Yeah... I'll do that.
Well, see you both tomorrow.
fields.JP:
うん……そうさせてもらうよ。
それじゃ、また明日ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... I'll do that.
Well, see you both tomorrow.

fields.JP: ふむ。よっぽど疲れていたようだな

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Haa-chan, but I need to
go after Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
ハーちゃん、わたしちょっと、
おつうちゃんのところに行ってくる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Hammy, but I need to
go after Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 二人ともどうしたのだ……？
（はぁ……今日は本当に間が悪い）

fields.EN:
(I know Princess is kind, and
that's what I like about her.)
fields.JP:
（姫が誰にでも優しいのは分かってる。
　そこが好きっていうのもあるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know Princess is kind, and
that's what I like about her.)

fields.EN:
(But if only she kept her eyes on
me just for a short moment...
Or, am I being greedy?)
fields.JP:
（もう少しだけ僕のこと見てほしい――
　そう思うのは、わがままなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if only she kept her eyes on
me just for a short moment...
Or, am I being greedy?)

fields.EN:
I guess I can give her this
later...
fields.JP:
このプレゼントは……
また今度、渡せばいいか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can give her this
later...

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff...! Otsuu-chan... I finally found
you!
fields.JP:
ハァハァ……！
おつうちゃん……やっと見つけた！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, I noticed you were a bit
fidgety, but was there something
you wanted?
fields.JP:
だって……おつうちゃん……
ずっとそわそわしてて……
……わたしに、なにか用が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I noticed you were a bit
fidgety, but was there something
you wanted?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan
Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、プレゼント交換しようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we swap gifts with each
other?

fields.JP: じゃあ、まずわたしからね？
ひ、姫？　いったいどういう……

fields.EN:
Shhh, quiet.
You're going to miss my gift.
fields.JP:
ほら、静かに。
わたしのプレゼント、聞き逃しちゃうよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shhh, quiet.
You're going to miss my gift.

fields.EN:
(I can already feel my sullen
feeling melting away...)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう……さっきまでの気持ちが、
　全部溶けていく気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can already feel my sullen
feeling melting away...)

fields.JP: （僕は姫のことが好きなんだな……）
……ご清聴、ありがとうございました

fields.EN:
Thank you...
What a wonderful gift.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
最高のプレゼントだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
What a wonderful gift.

fields.EN:
That's great to hear.
So, Otsuu-chan, now it's your turn.
You do have a gift for me, right?
fields.JP:
本当？　
じゃあ、次はおつうちゃんの番だね。
プレゼント、用意してあるんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's great to hear.
So, now it's your turn.
You do have a gift for me, right?

fields.EN:
You can read me like a book,
can't you, Princess?
fields.JP: ……姫はなんでもお見通しだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can read me like a book,
can't you, Princess?

fields.EN:
Heh heh! How much do you think I usually
keep my eyes on you, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
ふふふ、そうだよ。
わたしが普段どれだけ、
おつうちゃんのことを見てると思ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! You know me!
I always have my eyes on you,
you know?

fields.JP: 本当に、姫には敵わないな……

fields.EN: Well, here's my gift to you.
fields.JP: これが僕からのプレゼントだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, here's my gift to you.

fields.JP:
わぁ……！
これ、ブレスレット？

fields.EN:
I had Takumi make it. I thought
it would look great on you.
fields.JP:
タクミに作ってもらったんだ。
姫に似合うかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had Takumi make it. I thought
it would look great on you.

fields.EN:
Thank you...!
It'll be my treasure!
fields.JP:
うれしい……
ずっと大事にするね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...!
It'll be my treasure!

fields.EN:
(And you're my treasure...
Well, that's embarrassing to say
even if I am her prince...)
fields.JP:
（僕も一生、君を大事にするよ――
　なんて、さすがに王子様でも照れくさい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And you're my treasure...
Well, that's embarrassing to say
even if I am her prince...)

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan?
Why do you like me?
fields.JP:
ねえねえ、おつうちゃん。
何でそんなにわたしの事が好きなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu?
Why do you like me?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: うーん、なんとなく聞いてみたくなったの

fields.EN:
(Don't fret, Otsuu...
This question was expected the
moment we bonded in marriage.)
fields.JP:
（だが、慌てることはない。
　夫婦ならこの類の質問は必ず来ると
　思っていたよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't fret, Otsuu...
This question was expected the
moment we bonded in marriage.)

fields.JP:
あ、ごめんね。
答えにくい質問だったかな……

fields.EN:
Not at all. I was just trying to
get my thoughts straight with all
the things that I like about you.
fields.JP:
そんなことあるわけないだろう？
姫の好きなところはたくさんあり過ぎて、
何から言おうか迷っていたのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I was just trying to
get my thoughts straight with all
the things that I like about you.

fields.EN:
Let me go one-by-one here.
I love your beautiful singing,
kind heart, appearance...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、一つ一つ答えていくよ。
綺麗な歌声に、優しい心、外見も
余すことなく僕は好きだし、それに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me go one-by-one here.
I love your beautiful singing,
kind heart, appearance...

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
I have a lot more to say?
fields.JP:
どうしたんだい？
まだ全然答えてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
I have a lot more to say?

fields.EN:
I appreciate your words, but
that's not what I wanted to
hear.
fields.JP:
褒めてくれるのは嬉しいけど、
今わたしが聞いてるのは、
そういうことじゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate your words, but
that's not what I wanted to
hear.

fields.EN: W-What do you mean by that?
fields.JP:
そ、そういうことじゃないって、
どういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: W-What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, you know how you asked me to
marry you the very first time we met?
fields.JP:
ほら、おつうちゃんって
初めて会ったときにいきなり、
結婚してって言ってきたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how you asked for
my hand in marriage the very
first time we met?

fields.EN:
How come?
Because I love you.
fields.JP:
何でって……
それこそ好きだからとしか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How come?
Because I love you.

fields.EN:
Well, that's nice, but...
How can you fall in love when
we've only just met?
fields.JP:
それは……そうなんだろうけど、
初対面で、普通そこまで好きになるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's nice, but...
How can you fall in love when
we've only just met?

fields.EN:
To be honest, it took me a while before I really
started to like you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
正直、わたしがおつうちゃんのことを
好きになったのはしばらく経ってからだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, it took me a while
for me to really like you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: えっ！？　そうだったの！？

fields.EN:
Besides, Otsuu-chan, I seem to remember you
knew my name even though I hadn't introduced
myself...
fields.JP:
それに、わたしが名乗ってないのに、
おつうちゃんはわたしの名前を
知ってた気がするし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, how come you
knew my name when we've only met
for the first time back then?

fields.EN:
Maybe I'm remembering things
wrong since it was a while back.
fields.JP:
でも、ずっと昔のことだし、
ただの勘違いなのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I'm remembering things
wrong since it was a while back.

fields.EN:
(Now that she mentioned it,
I seem to have loved her since
forever.)
fields.JP:
（言われてみれば、
　僕はこの意識が芽生えた時から、
　姫の事が好きだったような気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that she mentioned it,
I seem to have loved her since
forever.)

fields.EN:
(I don't really recall much from
memory, and I don't have a reason,
but my feelings for her are true.)
fields.JP:
（それ以前の記憶はない。
　理由も分からない。
　だけど、僕にとっては大切な感情だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't really recall much from
memory, and I don't have a reason,
but my feelings for her are true.)

fields.EN:
I'm sure there was something
that happened, but I think we can
sum it all up as being fate.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、
何かきっかけがあるのかもしれないけど、
それも含めて、きっと運命だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there was something
that happened, but I think we can
sum it all up as being fate.

fields.EN:
What's important is now.
My love towards you will never
change, no matter what.
fields.JP:
それに、大事なのは今だ。
僕が姫のことが好きなのは、
この先、何があっても変わらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's important is now.
My love towards you will never
change, no matter what.

fields.EN:
Well, I'm just happy we're having
this conversation, since it's been
a while since we talked like this.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そうだね。
でも、最近こんな風に昔を思い出すことが
無かったから、嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm just happy we're having
this conversation, since it's been
a while since we talked like this.

fields.EN:
We've been too busy to reminisce
how long we've been together
in matrimony.
fields.JP:
最近忙しかったからね。
それにしても、もう夫婦になって
結構経つんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've been too busy to reminisce
how long we've been together
in matrimony.

fields.EN:
Yup, it's been a long while
all right...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, it's been a long while
all right...

fields.EN:
I'll say it again - I love you.
I will always be with you.
I will protect you no matter what.
fields.JP:
改めて誓うよ。僕は姫が好きだ。
だから、僕は一生君の側にいる。
何があっても絶対守る
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll say it again - I love you.
I will always be with you.
I will protect you no matter what.

fields.EN:
Yes, and I wouldn't expect
anything less, my prince...
fields.JP:
はい。こちらこそ、よろしくお願いします。
……わたしの王子様
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and I wouldn't expect
anything less, my prince...

fields.EN:
Say, you mind if I ask what kind of
wedding you two had?
fields.JP:
そう言えば、おつうと人魚姫は
どんな結婚式をしたのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, you mind if I ask what kind of
wedding you two had?

fields.EN:
You two are married, right? I read
in a manga that people who marry
have weddings.
fields.JP:
うむ！　おつうと人魚姫は夫婦なのだろう？
夫婦になるには結婚式をしないといけないと、
どこかの漫画に書いてあったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two are married, right? I read
in a manga that people who marry
have weddings.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, I don't think
we had a wedding.
fields.JP: そういえば結婚式はしてないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, I don't think
we had a wedding.

fields.EN:
Well, we were destined by fate
to be together from the very
beginning.
fields.JP:
僕たちは出会った瞬間から強い運命で
結びついていたからね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we were destined by fate
to be together from the very
beginning.

fields.JP: そんな必要もなかったというわけさ

fields.EN: I see. So, what about now?
fields.JP:
なるほどな。
では、これからするのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. So, what about now?

fields.EN:
Not that we'll have one right
away. There are just way
too many things we're missing.
fields.JP:
と言っても、今すぐじゃないけどね。
結婚式をするには、足りないものが
多すぎるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that we'll have one right
away. There are just way
too many things we're missing.

fields.EN:
I see. We don't have churches,
wedding dresses, or ministers
around.
fields.JP:
そういえばそうだな。
ここには、教会もウェディングドレスも
無ければ、神父もいないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. We don't have churches,
wedding dresses, or ministers
around.

fields.EN:
Right? If we're going to hold a
wedding, I want to do it after the
escape in the best way possible.
fields.JP:
そういうことだ。
どうせやるなら脱獄してから、
皆を呼んで最高の結婚式をするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? If we're going to hold a
wedding, I want to do it after the
escape in the best way possible.

fields.EN:
Another good reason for me
to want to escape from this place.
fields.JP: そのためにも、一日でも早く脱獄しないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another good reason for me
to want to escape from this place.

fields.EN:
That went well... Hameln seemed
quite interested. If only we could
hold our wedding now...
fields.JP:
なんて、ハーメルンには強がってみたけど、
姫との結婚式……したかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That went well... Hameln seemed
quite interested. If only we could
hold our wedding now...

fields.EN:
I want to have a wedding with you too,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: わたしもおつうちゃんと結婚式したい
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to have a wedding, too.

fields.JP: ひ、姫！？　なんでここに！？

fields.EN:
We're husband and wife.
Is it surprising to see me here?
fields.JP:
だって夫婦だもの
いつも一緒でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're husband and wife.
Is it surprising to see me here?

fields.EN:
I suppose not.
I can't argue your logic.
fields.JP: そう言われると反論の余地もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose not.
I can't argue your logic.

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
So, Otsuu-chan, aren't we going to have our
wedding?
fields.JP:
ふふふっ。
それでおつうちゃん、結婚式しないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
So, we're not going to have our
wedding?

fields.EN:
I'd love to have one, but what
I said to Hameln isn't a lie. We
simply don't have the means here.
fields.JP:
したいけどさ、ハーメルンに
言ったことも嘘じゃないんだよ。
実際ここには、結婚式に必要なものがない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd love to have one, but what
I said to Hameln isn't a lie. We
simply don't have the means here.

fields.JP:
そうかな？
わたしはそうは思わないよ

fields.EN:
A wedding is where an exchange of
vows is done, right? Then all we
need is the pair to be here.
fields.JP:
結婚式は互いに愛を誓いあうものでしょ？
なら、愛し合ってる二人がいれば、
それでいいとわたしは思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A wedding is where an exchange of
vows is done, right? Then all we
need is the pair to be here.

fields.EN: You're right... We'll have a proper wedding after we escape. For now, let's have a wedding just for the two of us here.
fields.JP:
確かに……そうだね。
ちゃんとした結婚式は脱獄した後にして、
今ここで、二人だけの結婚式をしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. We can have a formal
wedding after our escape. Shall we
exchange our vows for now?

fields.EN:
I vow to love you, Princess,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.
fields.JP:
僕は姫を……
人魚姫だけを一生愛し続けることを、
ここに誓います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vow to love you, Princess,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.

fields.EN:
I vow to love you, Otsuu-chan,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんを愛し続けることを、
ここに誓います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vow to love you, Otsuu,
and care for you as long as
we both shall live.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 僕と結婚してください

どうやら僕たち、
勘違いしてたみたいだね

fields.EN: ...Yeah. We've already had a wedding just for the two of us like this.
fields.JP:
……だね。
だって、この二人だけの結婚式は
もうしてたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... We already held a wedding
like this before.

fields.EN:
I vowed to be your prince
when we first met.
fields.JP:
初めて会ったあの時、
僕は君だけの王子になることを誓った
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vowed to be your prince
when we first met.

fields.EN: And I accepted your proposal, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: わたしはおつうちゃんの求婚を受け入れた
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I accepted you to be my
husband.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Let's keep this little wedding just between the two of us a secret from everyone, and do it again sometimes.
fields.JP:
この二人だけの結婚式は、
みんなに内緒でたまにしようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we have our exchange
of vows in private again?

fields.EN: As you wish, my dear princess...
fields.JP: よろこんで、僕のお姫様……
fields.LOCALIZED: As you wish, my dear princess...

fields.EN: Now, let's hear it as promised!
fields.JP: では、約束通り話してもらおうか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, let's hear it as promised!

fields.JP:
約束……？
なにかしてたっけ？

fields.EN:
You promised to me that you'd
tell me about how you and Ningyohime met!
fields.JP:
水族館跡エリアで、おつうと人魚姫の二人が
どうやって出会ったか、教えてくれると
約束しただろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You promised to me that you'd
tell me about how you and Little
Mermaid met!

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you're going to
break the promise...
fields.JP: まさか……約束を破るのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you're going to
break the promise...

fields.EN: I... suppose I did promise that.
fields.JP: そ、そういえばそんな約束もしてたね
fields.LOCALIZED: I... suppose I did promise that.

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Haa-chan.
She won't break promises.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、ハーちゃん。
約束を破るつもりはないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Hammy.
She won't break promises.

fields.JP: ならば、早く話すがよい！

fields.EN:
Um... I don't know since when,
but I've been at the Aquarium
Ruins for as long as I remember.
fields.JP:
えっと……わたしは気づいたら
水族館跡エリアに居たの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... I don't know since when,
but I've been at the Aquarium
Ruins for as long as I remember.

fields.EN:
Then one day, I was being
chased by a Marchen when...
fields.JP:
それで、ある時メルヒェンに
襲われそうになって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then one day, I was being
chased by a Marchen when...

fields.EN: I arrived gallantly to save her!
fields.JP: そこを僕が華麗に助け出したというわけさ
fields.LOCALIZED: I arrived gallantly to save her!

fields.EN:
Oh? That sounds like something
from a manga! So then what?!
fields.JP:
ほう！　まるで漫画のようだな！
それで、どうなったのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? That sounds like something
from a manga! So then what?!

fields.EN:
After Otsuu-chan saved me, she suddenly
asked for my hand in marriage.
fields.JP:
助けてくれたおつうちゃんは、
初対面のわたしにいきなり、
結婚して欲しいって言ってきたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
After Otsuu saved me, she suddenly
asked for my hand in marriage.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
So soon? I thought marrying is
something done between lovers.
fields.JP:
いきなりか？
結婚とは、愛し合ってる二人が
するものじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So soon? I thought marrying is
something done between lovers.

fields.EN:
Yup, I was so surprised,
that I just rambled asking
Otsuu to become my prince.
fields.JP:
うん。だから、わたしびっくりしちゃって。
思わず『王子様になって欲しい』って、
答えちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, I was so surprised,
that I just rambled asking
Otsuu to become my prince.

fields.EN:
That would explain why Otsuu
is like that in front of you.
fields.JP:
なるほど。
それで、おつうは人魚姫の前だと
あんな感じなんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would explain why Otsuu
is like that in front of you.

fields.EN: And so we exchanged our vows, and I became Princess's prince—and hers alone.
fields.JP:
そうして二人は夫婦の契りを交わし、
僕は晴れて姫だけの王子となったのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we exchanged our vows,
and I became her prince.

fields.EN:
I see...
But what you did was quite weird,
Otsuu.
fields.JP:
なるほど……。
だが、やはりおつうの行動が謎だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
But what you did was quite weird,
Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Did you meet Ningyohime before
her rescue?
fields.JP:
おつうは人魚姫とどこかで
出会っていたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you meet Little Mermaid before
her rescue?

fields.EN:
No. I was in love with her
before I knew it.
fields.JP:
いや、会ってないよ。
ただ、気が付いたら
もう姫の事が好きだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I was in love with her
before I knew it.

fields.JP:
だから、ずっとずっと会いたくて
仕方なかった

fields.EN:
Once I saw her, I couldn't hold
back my urge, so I asked her
to marry me.
fields.JP:
それで、実際に会ったら感極まって、
気づいたら求婚してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I saw her, I couldn't hold
back my urge, so I asked her
to marry me.

fields.EN: I see, I see... I know what someone like Otsuu is called!
fields.JP:
なるほどなるほど……
我は、おつうみたいのを
なんて呼ぶか知っているぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I know what you are now!

fields.EN:
Hm, you searched aimlessly for
someone you didn't know but you
liked, right?
fields.JP:
うむ。よく知りもしない人を、
一方的な好意で探し回っていたのだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, you searched aimlessly for
someone you didn't know but you
liked, right?

fields.EN:
Wait...
What are you trying to get at?
fields.JP: いや、ちょっと待て……それって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...
What are you trying to get at?

fields.EN: Yes! Someone like Otsuu is called a stalker, right? I read it in a manga!
fields.JP:
うむ！　おつうみたいなのを
ストーカーと言うのだろう？
漫画に描いてあったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're like one of those creepers!
I saw it in one of the manga
before!

fields.EN: No! Don't lump me in with people like that!
fields.JP: 違う！　僕をそんなのと一緒にするな！

fields.EN:
Now that I think about it, most
people won't ask someone to marry
them the moment they meet someone.
fields.JP:
でも今思えば、普通は会ってすぐに、
結婚を申し込んだりしないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I think about it, most
people won't ask someone to marry
them the moment they meet someone.

fields.JP: つまり、ストーカー王子か
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see!
You're the prince of creepers!

fields.EN:
I-It's okay, Otsuu-chan! Even if you're a
stalker, I still love you!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だよ！　おつうちゃん！
たとえおつうちゃんがストーカーでも、
おつうちゃんのことは大好きだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't worry, Otsuu!
I like you for who you are,
even if you are a creeper!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=3

fields.EN:
Huh? What? Why?
Otsuu-chan! Are you all right?!
fields.JP:
え？　え？　なんで？
おつうちゃんしっかりー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What? Why?
Otsuu! Are you all right?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(I'm not sure if I should be
happy or sad...)
fields.JP:
（嬉しいけど……
　素直に喜べない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not sure if I should be
happy or sad...)

fields.JP:
あの……じゃあ、久しぶりに
お願いしてもいい？

fields.EN:
You're so clingy.
But, sure, c'mon.
fields.JP:
人魚は甘えん坊だなぁ。
いいよ、おいで
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so clingy.
But, sure, c'mon.

fields.EN:
(Hm? I hear Princess's voice from
Akazukin's room.
What are they doing?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　赤ずきんの部屋から、
　姫の声が聞こえる。
　……なにしてるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? I hear Princess's voice from
Red Riding Hood's room.
What are they doing?)

fields.EN:
Akazukin, do you mind
if I come in for a moment?
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、ちょっといいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, do you mind
if I come in for a moment?

fields.JP: おつうか？　入っていいぞー
今ここから姫の声が……なぁっ！？
見ての通り取り込み中だよ
おつうちゃんが血を吐いた！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Ouch...
This was a bit too much for her.
fields.JP:
あちゃぁ……
おつうには刺激が強すぎたかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch...
This was a bit too much for her.

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine...
I'm totally and completely fine!
fields.JP:
ま、まだだよ……
このくらいのことじゃ僕は負けない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine...
I'm totally and completely fine!

fields.EN:
Th-There must be a reason
behind this... Why were you and
Akazukin cuddling?!
fields.JP:
な、何か理由があるはずだ……
姫！　どうして赤ずきんと
抱き合ってるんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-There must be a reason
behind this... Why were you and
Red Riding Hood cuddling?!

fields.EN:
Um, well... We've been doing
this a lot from before.
fields.JP: その、実は昔から……よくしてもらってたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... We've been doing
this a lot from before.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Wow, this is too much for me.
fields.JP: さ、流石にかわいそうになってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow, this is too much for me.

fields.EN:
Aah...! Wh-What should I...?!
Otsuu-chan... Otsuu-chan...!
fields.JP:
あわわっ！　ど、どうしよう！
おつうちゃんが、おつうちゃんが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah...! Wh-What should I...?!
Otsuu... Otsuu...!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
C'mon now, relax.
Breathe in... Breathe out...
fields.JP:
ったく、話が進まないでしょ
ほら、深呼吸
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon now, relax.
Breathe in... Breathe out...

fields.EN:
Breathe in... Mmm...
Breathe out... Aah...
fields.JP:
う、うん……すー、はー……
す－、はー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Breathe in... Mmm...
Breathe out... Aah...

fields.EN:
Now then...
Hey, snap out of it, Otsuu.
fields.JP:
さてと、そんじゃ次はこっちだ。
おーい、生き返れー。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then...
Hey, snap out of it, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Your imagination is getting the
better of you.
fields.JP:
別に、おつうが想像してるような
事じゃないからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your imagination is getting the
better of you.

fields.EN:
Really, really.
Ningyo, you have to explain a bit
better.
fields.JP:
本当だって。
人魚もちゃんと説明しなきゃダメでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really, really.
Mermie, you have to explain a bit
better.

fields.EN:
Uh... Before that, you mind
letting go of each other...?
fields.JP: ていうか……いつまで抱き合ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Before that, you mind
letting go of each other...?

fields.JP: それで、なんで抱き合ってたの？

fields.EN:
Um, well... I always cuddled with
Sis ever since I was little.
fields.JP:
えっとね、その……
小さいころからさっきみたく、
おねーちゃんに甘えてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... I always cuddled with
Sis ever since I was little.

fields.EN:
I know this is embarrassing, but
I come to Sis to do this every so
often.
fields.JP:
恥ずかしいんだけど、
今でもたまにおねーちゃんに、
甘えたくなるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know this is embarrassing, but
I come to Sis to do this every so
often.

fields.EN:
I know Sis is going through a lot,
so I tried to restrain myself,
but...
fields.JP:
おねーちゃんも大変だったから、
ずっと我慢してたんだけど、
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know Sis is going through a lot,
so I tried to restrain myself,
but...

fields.EN:
I asked her anyway, and she
said okay, so... well...
fields.JP:
さっき話してたら、
いいよって言ってくれて、
つい……その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked her anyway, and she
said okay, so... well...

fields.EN:
W-Well, I guess that's fine.
I may be your husband, but I'm
not your sister after all.
fields.JP:
ま、まぁ……それなら、しょうがない
僕は夫だけど、姉にはなれないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I guess that's fine.
I may be your husband, but I'm
not your sister after all.

fields.EN:
Got it? So yeah, you can stop
with your jealousy thing.
fields.JP:
っと、いうことだよ。
だからさ、そんな嫉妬するなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it? So yeah, you can stop
with your jealousy thing.

fields.EN:
Hey, how about you get clingy to
me like before? Sis is always
ready for more clingy.
fields.JP:
あ、なんなら、おつうも昔みたいに甘える？
お姉さんは大歓迎だぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, how about you get clingy to
me like before? Sis is always
ready for more clingy.

fields.EN:
S-Stop it! I'm not a kid anymore!
In the first place, I'm not
clingy!
fields.JP:
い、いいよ、もうそんな年じゃない！
だいたい、僕はそんなに甘えたり
しなかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop it! I'm not a kid anymore!
In the first place, I'm not
clingy!

fields.JP: え～？　そうだったかなぁ

fields.EN:
I remember you came to my room
crying one night, and...
fields.JP: ほら、夜中に泣きながらあたしの部屋に――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember you came to my room
crying one night, and...

fields.JP: わーーっ！　わーーっ！

fields.EN: Aww, it was gonna be good.
fields.JP: なんだよ、ここからがいいところなのに
fields.LOCALIZED: Aww, it was gonna be good.

fields.EN:
J-Just stop already!
Fine! I owe you one,
so please, stop!
fields.JP:
お、覚えてろよー！
これは貸しだからなーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Just stop already!
Fine! I owe you one,
so please, stop!

fields.EN:
Um... that secret of yours you mentioned
earlier, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
あ、あの……さっきの、
おつうちゃんの秘密って……

fields.EN:
Mmm... I don't mind continuing
where I left off, but...
fields.JP: んー、話してもいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I don't mind continuing
where I left off, but...

fields.JP: おねーちゃん、お願いします！

fields.EN:
Okay, but to be fair, I'll tell
Otsuu everything about you,
even the secret stuff.
fields.JP:
あたしが知ってる人魚の秘密も、
おつうに話してもいいならね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, but to be fair, I'll tell
Otsuu everything about you,
even the secret stuff.

fields.JP:
（ノック……？
　こんな時間に誰だろう……）

fields.EN: Do you mind if I come in...?
fields.JP: わたしだけど……入っていい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if I come in...?

fields.JP: こんばんは、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Uh, sure...
What brings you here at this hour,
Princess?
fields.JP:
こ、こんばんは姫。
こんな時間にどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, sure...
What brings you here at this hour,
Princess?

fields.EN:
Um... Do you mind if I sleep with
you tonight?
fields.JP: えっと……今日、一緒に寝てもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Do you mind if I sleep with
you tonight?

fields.EN:
Um, well... I, uh... Huh?!
A-Are you serious?
fields.JP:
いや、でもあの、え、えぇっ！？
その、い、いいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... I, uh... Huh?!
A-Are you serious?

fields.EN:
Tee-hee, you're getting too flustered,
Otsuu-chan. We're just sleeping together, okay?
fields.JP:
ふふっ、おつうちゃん慌てすぎだよ。
一緒に寝るだけだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tee-hee, oh, stop it.
I just want to sleep with you,
that's all.

fields.EN:
(I'm supposed to be
calm in this situation?!)
fields.JP: （本当はちっとも落ち着いてないけどね！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm supposed to be
calm in this situation?!)

fields.JP: それで……一緒に寝てもいい？

fields.EN:
Uh, I'm honored, but...
Is everything okay, Princess?
fields.JP:
えっと、それは実に光栄なんだけど、
姫……なにかあったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I'm honored, but...
Is everything okay, Princess?

fields.EN:
Oh, uh, if you don't want to
talk about it, then...
fields.JP: あ、いや、嫌なら無理に言わなくても――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh, if you don't want to
talk about it, then...

fields.EN:
You remember how I entered
Blood Skelter the last time,
right?
fields.JP:
……この前わたし、
ブラッドスケルター化したでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember how I entered
Blood Skelter the last time,
right?

fields.EN:
Yes...
Back at the Aquarium Ruins.
fields.JP:
うん……
水族館跡エリアのことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:

ずいぶん辛気臭い話をしていたからな！
ワレの笛で吹き飛ばしてやったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I played my pipe to clear the air
in here!

fields.EN:
Huh, I actually kinda feel
better already!
fields.JP:
そう言われてみれば……
なんかやる気出てきたぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, I actually kinda feel
better already!

fields.EN:
You're right...
I feel strangely good now...
fields.JP:
ほんとだ……
不思議と身体が軽くなった気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I feel strangely good now...

fields.EN:
Hahaha!
Do you want another tune from me?
fields.JP: ふふん、ならもう一回吹くか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha!
Do you want another tune from me?

fields.EN: Oh, do you mind if I try, too?
fields.JP: あ、それならあたしに吹かせて
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, do you mind if I try, too?

fields.JP:
む、別に構わないぞ！
ほら、貸してやろう

お、ありがとね！
じゃ、さっそく……

fields.EN: Uh... I can't get it to play...
fields.JP: ハァハァ……あれぇ、音が出ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh... I can't get it to play...

fields.EN:
Mmm...
Maybe only Blood Maidens can
play it?
fields.JP:
うーん……。
もしかして血式少女しか鳴らせないとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...
Maybe only Blood Maidens can
play it?

fields.EN: Do you mind if I try?
fields.JP: それなら、わたしが試してみてもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if I try?

fields.JP: じゃあはい、人魚ちゃん
ちょ、ちょっと待ったっ！

fields.EN:
Uh, I just thought we should get
going! We spent enough time
here, you know?
fields.JP:
いや、結構時間が経ったからさ！
そろそろ出発した方がいいんじゃないかなって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I just thought we should get
going! We spent enough time
here, you know?

fields.EN:
It won't take long for her
to try and blow the pipe.
fields.JP:
別に少し笛を吹くくらい、
いいのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It won't take long for her
to try and blow the pipe.

fields.EN: No! She can't blow the pipe!
fields.JP: ダメだよ！　姫が吹くのはダメ！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! She can't blow the pipe!

fields.JP: え？　ど、どうしておつうちゃん

fields.EN:
Well, uh...
You're going to be using it after
Kaede and Hameln...
fields.JP:
えっと、その……
カエデやハーメルンが吹いた後だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, uh...
You're going to be using it after
Kaede and Hameln...

fields.EN:
Wait... Are you telling me that
we're filthy or something?
fields.JP: それって、あたしたちがばっちいってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Are you telling me that
we're filthy or something?

fields.EN:
I'm not filthy at all!
I brush my teeth every day!
fields.JP:
ワレはばっちくないぞ！
ちゃんと毎日歯磨きしておるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not filthy at all!
I brush my teeth every day!

fields.EN:
That's not what I wanted to imply,
but...
fields.JP: いや、決してそういう意味では……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not what I wanted to imply,
but...

fields.EN:
It's because they'd be indirectly
kissing her, right?
fields.JP: ……もしかして、間接キスだから？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because they'd be indirectly
kissing her, right?

fields.EN:
Ohoho? So, the dear prince
here doesn't want the chastity of
the princess's lips taken, eh?
fields.JP:
ほほう……？
王子様は姫の唇を誰にも渡したくないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohoho? So, the dear prince
here doesn't want the chastity of
the princess's lips taken, eh?

fields.JP: は、ははは……そんなわけないじゃないか

fields.EN: So, Ningyo-chan can blow the pipe then?
fields.JP: じゃあ、人魚ちゃんが吹いてもいいよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, Mermie can blow the pipe then?

fields.EN:
C-Come on!
Let's hurry and get going!
fields.JP:
も、もういいだろう！
ほら！　早く探索に行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C-Come on!
Let's hurry and get going!

fields.JP: おつうか……入ってよいぞ

fields.EN:
I just came to see how you
were doing.
fields.JP: ちょっと様子見に来たんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just came to see how you
were doing.

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, feel free to stay as long
as you like.
fields.JP:
そうか……
まぁ、ゆっくりしていくがよい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, feel free to stay as long
as you like.

fields.JP: （あれ？　なんだか元気ないな……）

fields.EN:
Is there a problem?
You don't sound so well...
fields.JP:
……なにかあったの？
なんか元気ないみたいだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a problem?
You don't sound so well...

fields.EN:
Oh, just a hunch.
So, what's the problem?
fields.JP:
分かるさ。
それで、何があったんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, just a hunch.
So, what's the problem?

fields.EN:
I just felt like I wasn't being
enough of a hero to protect you
all...
fields.JP:
勇者として仲間を守る。
それが出来ていない気がしてな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just felt like I wasn't being
enough of a hero to protect you
all...

fields.EN:
That's not true.
You've been helping us a lot.
fields.JP:
そんなことはないさ。
ハーメルンにはいつも助けられてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true.
You've been helping us a lot.

fields.EN:
But it feels like the others are
helping more than I am.
fields.JP:
だが、ワレより貴様らの方が、
ずっと役に立っている気がするのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it feels like the others are
helping more than I am.

fields.EN:
I don't understand what Gretel
says, but it sounds like she's
smarter than me.
fields.JP:
グレーテルはワレより頭の良いことを
言っておるような気がするし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand what Gretel
says, but it sounds like she's
smarter than me.

fields.EN:
Kaguya is a lot more prudent
than me.
fields.JP: かぐやもワレよりしっかりしておる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya is a lot more prudent
than me.

fields.EN:
You too, Otsuu. You've been
keeping everyone in check better
than me.
fields.JP:
おつうだってそうだ。
なんだかんだで、みんなをまとめておる
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Otsuu. You've been
keeping everyone in check better
than me.

fields.EN:
See? You girls have been doing
more than me!
fields.JP:
そうだ……。
ワレよりおつう達の方が
役に立っている気がするのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? You girls have been doing
more than me!

fields.EN:
I'm not helping that much.
In fact, I hardly think I've been
contributing as much as I'd like.
fields.JP:
僕は役に立ってなんかいないさ。
まだまだ、ぜんぜん足りない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not helping that much.
In fact, I hardly think I've been
contributing as much as I'd like.

fields.EN:
I promised to protect everyone.
Is it still all right for me to
rely on others?
fields.JP:
ワレがみんなを守ると約束したのだ。
なのに、皆に頼ってしまってよいのだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promised to protect everyone.
Is it still all right for me to
rely on others?

fields.EN:
You're burdening yourself too
much. You don't need to carry
everyone's load.
fields.JP:
とにかく、考えすぎだよ
ハーメルンだけが頑張ることはないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're burdening yourself too
much. You don't need to carry
everyone's load.

fields.EN:
I don't?
So you mean I'm not needed?
fields.JP:
ワレが頑張らなくていい？
つまり、ワレである必要はない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't?
So you mean I'm not needed?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
Just forget what I said...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
Just forget what I said...

fields.EN:
I'm fine. I just need some
time to think. You mind leaving
me alone for a bit?
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ。だが……少し一人で考えたい。
今日は帰ってくれぬか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. I just need some
time to think. You mind leaving
me alone for a bit?

fields.EN: (I meant to keep Hameln from pushing herself too hard, but it looks like I only made her worry even more...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンが気負いすぎないように、
　言ったつもりだったんだけど、
　余計に悩ませちゃったみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess my words just made
matters worse...)

fields.EN:
(It looks like Hameln is still
in her rut...)
fields.JP: （ハーメルン、まだ悩んでいるみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Hameln is still
in her rut...)

fields.EN:
(I'd like to help her out,
but I don't want to stress her
out like the last time...)
fields.JP:
（相談に乗ってあげたいけど、
　また迂闊なことを言って、
　余計に悩ませたら悪いし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd like to help her out,
but I don't want to stress her
out like the last time...)

fields.JP: はぁ……どうしたもんかな
溜息なんかついて……どうかしたの？

fields.EN:
It's nothing you need to concern
yourself with.
fields.JP:
いいえ、姫がお気になさるようなことでは
ありませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing you need to concern
yourself with.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan? If you have something
on your mind, say it.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……。
何か悩み事があるならちゃんと話して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? If you have something
on your mind, say it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right...
It's just that something's been
bothering me...
fields.JP:
姫……そう、だね。
ごめん、少し気になってることがあってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right...
It's just that something's been
bothering me...

fields.JP: それって、ハーちゃんのこと？

fields.EN:
Haa-chan hasn't been herself lately.
Do you know anything about it, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんここ最近何か悩んでるよね。
おつうちゃんは何か知っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy hasn't been herself lately.
Do you know anything about it?

fields.EN:
She's concerned over how she
can't fulfill her promise of
protecting us.
fields.JP:
……僕たちのこと守るっていう約束を、
出来ていないと悩んでいるらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's concerned over how she
can't fulfill her promise of
protecting us.

fields.EN:
Why is she concerned?
She's been nothing short of
a blessing to us.
fields.JP:
そんなことない。
ハーちゃんは、頼りになる仲間よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why is she concerned?
She's been nothing short of
a blessing to us.

fields.EN:
I wanted to relay that to her, but
I worded it in a way that made
her more concerned...
fields.JP:
僕もそう言ったつもりなんだけど……
どうも伝え方が悪かったみたいで、
余計に悩ませちゃったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to relay that to her, but
I worded it in a way that made
her more concerned...

fields.EN: So that's why you look worried, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: だから、おつうちゃん困った顔してるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why you have that
frown on your face?

fields.JP:
（はぁ……。
　僕はどうすればいいんだろう）

おつう！　止まるのだ！
そこには――！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: おつうちゃん！　ハーちゃん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: なっ！？　だ、大丈夫ですか！？
安心しろ！　ワレもおつうも無事だ！
まったく、人騒がせです～
ハーメルン、ありがとう助かったよ

fields.EN:
Unbelievable!
We're already in enemy territory!
Keep your guard up!
fields.JP:
まったく！　ボーっとするな！
もうここは敵地なのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable!
We're already in enemy territory!
Keep your guard up!

fields.JP:
うん……ごめん。
君の言う通りだ

fields.EN:
Thank goodness you're safe...
As usual, thanks for protecting
us from harm, Haa-chan.
fields.JP:
本当に無事でよかった……ハーちゃん、
いつも守ってくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness you're safe...
As usual, thanks for protecting
us from harm, Hammy.

fields.EN:
As usual? Is that true?
Am I actually of use?
Am I really protecting everyone?
fields.JP:
いつも……？　そうなのか？
ワレはみんなをちゃんと守れているのか？
役に立っているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
As usual? Is that true?
Am I actually of use?
Am I really protecting everyone?

fields.EN:
I'm happy you're always willing
to carry all my load.
fields.JP:
いつも喜んで面倒なことをしてくれるから、
助かってますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy you're always willing
to carry all my load.

fields.EN:
You do offer yourself to me
as a valuable specimen.
fields.JP: あなたはいつも実験体になってくれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do offer yourself to me
as a valuable specimen.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure if you're praising
me or not, Gretel...
fields.JP: ……グレーテルのそれは褒めておるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure if you're praising
me or not, Gretel...

fields.EN:
Why yes, I am praising you.
You're of great help.
fields.JP:
ええ、もちろん。
役には立っているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I am praising you.
You're of great help.

fields.EN:
You may not have noticed, but
you've been helping us and
protecting us all along!
fields.JP:
つまり、ハーちゃんが気づいてないだけで、
わたしたちはいつもハーちゃんに
たくさん守られているんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not have noticed, but
you've been helping us and
protecting us all along!

fields.EN:
You just saved Otsuu-chan just now,
too! Isn't that right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
今だっておつうちゃんを、
守ってくれたじゃない！
ね、おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You just saved Otsuu just now,
too! Isn't that right, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Right, and we wouldn't have made
it this far without you, Hameln.
fields.JP:
そうさ、ハーメルンがいたから、
僕たちはここまで来れたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, and we wouldn't have made
it this far without you, Hameln.

fields.EN:
I-I see...
So I am keeping my promise!
I am of help to you all!
fields.JP:
そ、そうか……
ワレはちゃんと約束を守れているのか！
役に立っているんだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see...
So I am keeping my promise!
I am of help to you all!

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! I suppose it is my
duty to protect you all as a hero!
fields.JP:
うむ！　はーっはっはっはっ！
ならばこれからも勇者としてみんなを
守ってやろうではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! I suppose it is my
duty to protect you all as a hero!

fields.EN:
Amazing...
To think she was all down on
herself just a while ago...
fields.JP:
まったく……。
さっきまで落ち込んでたのに単純なやつだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Amazing...
To think she was all down on
herself just a while ago...

fields.EN:
But you have to admit that her
personality has helped us
more than once.
fields.JP:
でも、ハーちゃんのそういうところに、
わたしたちは助けられてるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you have to admit that her
personality has helped us
more than once.

fields.JP:
ふっ……
まあ、そういうことにしておくか

fields.EN:
Otsuu, I need to talk with
you, but you mind if I come in?
fields.JP:
おつう、少し話があるのだが……
入っていいか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I need to talk with
you, but you mind if I come in?

fields.JP:
ハーメルンかい？
どうぞ、入っていいよ
それで？　話ってなに？
……ワレは、このままでいいのだろうか？

fields.EN:
That came out of nowhere...
You still don't think you're of
help to us?
fields.JP:
これまた急な話だね
まだ、仲間を守れてないと思ってるのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That came out of nowhere...
You still don't think you're of
help to us?

fields.EN:
That's not it.
Well, not exactly...
fields.JP: そうではない。そうではないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it.
Well, not exactly...

fields.EN: I know I'm protecting everyone as a hero. But at the same time, everyone is protecting me too. Is that really okay...?
fields.JP:
勇者としてみんなを守れているのは分かった、
だが、同時にみんなに守られてもいるのだ。
本当にそれで、いいのだろうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I am of help as a hero,
but that's only because I'm
being protected by everyone.

fields.EN:
I promised to protect everyone,
but wouldn't being protected
myself counter my promise?
fields.JP:
ワレは勇者として仲間を守ると約束した。
他のみんなに守られているようでは、
約束を守れていないのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promised to protect everyone,
but wouldn't being protected
myself counter my promise?

fields.EN:
(Is Hameln's persistence in
keeping a promise part of her
Blood Libido...?)
fields.JP:
（もしかして『約束を守る』ということも
　ハーメルンの血式リビドーなのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is Hameln's persistence in
keeping a promise part of her
Blood Libido...?)

fields.EN:
You don't like it when we
protect you?
fields.JP: 僕たちに守られるのは嫌かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't like it when we
protect you?

fields.EN:
Not at all, but that doesn't
seem to go well with the promise
I made...
fields.JP:
嫌、というわけでは無い。
だが、それでは約束が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all, but that doesn't
seem to go well with the promise
I made...

fields.EN:
Say, Hameln...
Are promises important to you?
fields.JP:
ねぇ、ハーメルン。
約束って大事？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Hameln...
Are promises important to you?

fields.EN:
Of course they are!
Promises are meant to be kept!
fields.JP:
大事に決まっているだろう。
約束は守るのが当然なのだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course they are!
Promises are meant to be kept!

fields.EN:
I see. How about we make another
promise then?
fields.JP:
わかった。
なら、もう一つ別の約束をしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. How about we make another
promise then?

fields.EN:
A promise that doesn't have you
constantly protecting us as
a hero...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンが一方的に僕たちを守る、
勇者としての約束じゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A promise that doesn't have you
constantly protecting us as
a hero...

fields.EN:
I want you to promise me that
we'll escape from here, and that
we will each protect each other.
fields.JP:
一緒にこのジェイルを脱獄をするんだ。
そのために仲間を守り、仲間に守られる。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to promise me that
we'll escape from here, and that
we will each protect each other.

fields.EN:
That's right. This is our promise
with you, as friends.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。
これはハーメルンと僕たちの……
仲間同士の約束だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. This is our promise
with you, as friends.

fields.JP: そうか……それが仲間なのか

fields.EN:
Very well! If so, I have
a promise I want to make with
you as a friend!
fields.JP:
ようやく分かった！　ならば、おつう！
ワレは仲間としてもう一つ約束したい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well! If so, I have
a promise I want to make with
you as a friend!

fields.EN:
I want us to have a grand dance
party once we escape! I will
take care of the music!
fields.JP:
仲間として脱獄できた暁には、
みんなで盛大にダンスパーティをしよう！
無論、演奏はワレが担当する！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want us to have a grand dance
party once we escape! I will
take care of the music!

fields.EN:
Hahaha! That really came out of
nowhere. Good. Now we have
one more thing to look forward to.
fields.JP:
ははは、なにそれ。
でもいいね。
脱獄した後の楽しみが一つ増えたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! That really came out of
nowhere. Good. Now we have
one more thing to look forward to.

fields.EN:
Right?! It will be fun!
Hence, we must all make it out
of the Jail alive!
fields.JP:
だろう！？　楽しみであろう！？
絶対にここから全員無事に脱獄せねばな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right?! It will be fun!
Hence, we must all make it out
of the Jail alive!

fields.EN:
Yes, we'll make it out of here,
each and every one of us.
fields.JP:
うん、誰ひとり欠けることなく、
全員無事に脱獄しよう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we'll make it out of here,
each and every one of us.

fields.JP:
ハーちゃん、そこちがっ……
ダメだってっ……ひゃんっ！？

fields.EN:
Hm...
This is harder than I thought...
fields.JP: むぅ……なかなか難しいのだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...
This is harder than I thought...

fields.EN:
(Princess and Hameln?
What are they doing in there?)
fields.JP:
（姫とハーメルンの声？
　ハーメルンの部屋で何をしてるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Princess and Hameln?
What are they doing in there?)

fields.EN:
Hameln, I thought I heard
Princess's voice in...
fields.JP: ハーメルン、今姫の声が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, I thought I heard
Princess's voice in...

fields.JP:
ふ、ふたりとも！　
いったい、何してるんだ！？

fields.EN:
Oh, um...
It isn't what it seems.
fields.JP:
あ、えっと、あのね？
これは違うの。違うからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um...
It isn't what it seems.

fields.EN:
What are we doing?
Isn't it obvious?
fields.JP:
何と言われても……
見てわかるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are we doing?
Isn't it obvious?

fields.EN:
It only looks like you're both
embracing each other!
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕には抱き合ってるようにしか
見えないけど！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It only looks like you're both
embracing each other!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Otsuu-chan.
There's a good reason behind
all this.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、落ち着いて？
これには事情があるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Otsuu.
There's a good reason behind
all this.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I-I am calm! I-I would never
lose myself with this.
Yes. I'm calm all right. Calm...
fields.JP:
ぼ、ぼぼ、僕は落ちついてるよ姫。
こんなことで取り乱すわけがないじゃないか。
ああ……落ち着いているとも、僕は冷静だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I am calm! I-I would never
lose myself with this.
Yes. I'm calm all right. Calm...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
What are you blabbing about?
You're acting quite weird today.
fields.JP:
というか、何を言っているのだ？
今日のおつうは変だぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you blabbing about?
You're acting quite weird today.

fields.EN:
N-Never mind me!
Just let go of her!
fields.JP: と、とにかく！　ふたりとも離れてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Never mind me!
Just let go of her!

fields.EN:
You didn't need to pry us apart
like that.
fields.JP: なにも、強引に引きはがすことないではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You didn't need to pry us apart
like that.

fields.EN:
So...
Why were you two... hugging?
fields.JP:
……それで？
結局、二人は何で抱き合ってたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So...
Why were you two... hugging?

fields.EN:
Haa-chan wanted to dance, so I was
just being her partner.
fields.JP:
ハーちゃんがダンスをしてみたいって言ったから、
付き合ってあげてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hammy wanted to dance, so I was
just being her partner.

fields.EN:
Indeed! I need to make sure I can
dance when the time comes!
fields.JP:
うむ！　いずれみんなと踊るときに、
上手くできなかったらかっこ悪いからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed! I need to make sure I can
dance when the time comes!

fields.EN:
But I didn't expect dancing to be
so hard! I was tripping over
myself a number of times!
fields.JP:
しかし、ダンスとはなかなか難しいのだな！
このワレが転びそうになってしまった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I didn't expect dancing to be
so hard! I was tripping over
myself a number of times!

fields.EN:
Oh, I see.
So that's why you two were
hugging each other like that.
fields.JP:
ああ、なるほど。
それで姫が抱きとめたってわけか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see.
So that's why you two were
hugging each other like that.

fields.EN:
I told you it's not what it
seemed...
fields.JP: だから、誤解だって言ったでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you it's not what it
seemed...

fields.EN:
Indeed so. But, I'm a bit jealous
that you were able to dance
with her before me, Hameln.
fields.JP:
ああ、どうやらそうみたいだ。
だけど、ずるいな。
僕を差し置いて姫と踊るなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed so. But, I'm a bit jealous
that you were able to dance
with her before me, Hameln.

fields.EN: Why don't you dance with her then?
fields.JP: なら、次はおつうと人魚姫が一緒に踊るか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you dance with her then?

fields.EN:
Gladly! I would be honored to
escort my dear princess!
fields.JP:
ああ、願ってもないことさ！
姫のエスコートとは光栄の極みだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gladly! I would be honored to
escort my dear princess!

fields.JP: もう、おつうちゃんったら
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Then leave the music to me!
fields.JP: ならば演奏はワレに任せろ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then leave the music to me!

fields.EN:
I did expect this to happen
the moment Hameln said
she'd handle the music.
fields.JP:
正直、ハーメルンが演奏するって言った時点で、
こうなる予感はしてたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did expect this to happen
the moment Hameln said
she'd handle the music.

fields.EN:
I must say, the mood is a bit
lacking, but...
Would you like to dance?
fields.JP:
少々ロマンチックさに欠けるけど……
姫、わたくしめと踊っていただけますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must say, the mood is a bit
lacking, but...
Would you like to dance?

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! How's that?!
Catch me if you can!
fields.JP:
ふはははは！！　どうだ！
捕まえられものなら捕まえてみるがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! How's that?!
Catch me if you can!

fields.JP: あははははー！！　まてー！　メルンー！

fields.EN:
Like I'd wait!
Come at me with all you got!
fields.JP:
待てと言われて待つやつなどおらん！
ワレを捕まえたければ力づくでこい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I'd wait!
Come at me with all you got!

fields.JP:
いったなー！
これでもくらえーっ！！
ぬおっ！？　ちょっとびっくりした！

fields.EN:
Hmph! Your attacks may hit hard,
but it is of no use if they
don't land on me!
fields.JP:
ふふん！　貴様の攻撃は確かに重いが、
当たらなければどうということはないのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Your attacks may hit hard,
but it is of no use if they
don't land on me!

fields.EN:
I'll hit you!
Here I go!
fields.JP:
つぎはぜったいあてるからね！
いくよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll hit you!
Here I go!

fields.JP: ふはははっ！　来るがよい！
（あの二人を止めた方がいいんだろうか）

fields.EN:
(No, I better not... "The wise man
does not expose himself needlessly
to danger," they say.)
fields.JP:
（……いや、やめておこう。
　君子危うきに近寄らずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No, I better not... "The wise man
does not expose himself needlessly
to danger," they say.)

fields.EN:
(That's... Cinderella?
Why is she staring at them?
Does she want to join them?)
fields.JP:
（あれは……シンデレラ？
　ハーメルン達の方をじっと見てる。
　もしかして、一緒に遊びたいのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's... Cinderella?
Why is she staring at them?
Does she want to join them?)

fields.EN:
P-Please, don't scare me like
that! You made me jump!
fields.JP:
い、いきなり話しかけないでください！　
びっくりするじゃないですか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please, don't scare me like
that! You made me jump!

fields.EN:
It's not like I crept up to you
or anything. So, why don't
you join them?
fields.JP:
ぼーっとしていたのは君だろう？
それより、一緒に遊んできたらどうだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I crept up to you
or anything. So, why don't
you join them?

fields.EN:
M-Me? Join them?
I-I am an adult, mind you!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことありませんわ！
わたしは大人ですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Me? Join them?
I-I am an adult, mind you!

fields.EN:
But you were staring at
them pretty intensely...
fields.JP:
それにしては、ずいぶんと熱心に
見つめていたようだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you were staring at
them pretty intensely...

fields.EN:
W-Well... I was just looking
at them to make sure they won't
cause any trouble!
fields.JP:
そ、それは……
あんなにさわいでたら後が大変だと思って
見ていただけですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well... I was just looking
at them to make sure they won't
cause any trouble!

fields.EN:
Right? So it's not like I want to
join them in their game of
chase or anything like that!
fields.JP:
でしょう？　だから、決して、わたしも一緒に
追いかけっこしたいとか思っていませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? So it's not like I want to
join them in their game of
chase or anything like that!

fields.EN:
(That's what she says...
She's peeking through the corner
of her eyes at them...)
fields.JP:
（どう見ても一緒に遊びたそうにしてるんだよなー。
　今も、ちらちらハーメルン達の方見ているし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's what she says...
She's peeking through the corner
of her eyes at them...)

fields.EN:
Hm?
If it isn't Otsuu and Cinderella.
fields.JP: んん？　おつうとシンデレラではないか。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm?
If it isn't Otsuu and Cinderella.

fields.JP: どうやら、見つかったみたいだね

fields.EN:
What are you two doing here?
If you have the time, how about
a game of chase?
fields.JP:
こんなところで何をしているのだ？
暇なら貴様らも混ざるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you two doing here?
If you have the time, how about
a game of chase?

fields.JP:
ねー！　ねー！
いっしょにあそぼー！

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I have something
to take care of.
fields.JP:
すまない。
僕は、この後少し用事があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I have something
to take care of.

fields.JP: そうか……ならば仕方あるまい

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. In my place, Cinderella
can play with you two.
fields.JP:
ごめんね。
代わりにシンデレラが遊んでくれるってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. In my place, Cinderella
can play with you two.

fields.JP:
ほんとう！？
シンデレラ、あそんでくれる！？

fields.EN: With your speed, you'll be a worthy opponent! Come at me, both of you!
fields.JP:
貴様の健脚ならば敵として不足はない！
さあ、二人がかりでかかってくるがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your speed should prove quite
challenging! Now then, come at
me at once!

fields.JP:
いったなー！
シンデレラ、ぜったいつかまえようね！
え！？　ちょっ、ちょっと待って――
ふはははは！　さらば！
いくよー！　シンデレラ！

fields.EN:
F-Fine! I suppose I can help!
Wait up, Hameln!
fields.JP:
も、もう！　仕方ありませんわね！
待ちなさい！　ハーメルン！
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine! I suppose I can help!
Wait up, Hameln!

fields.JP: まったく、手間のかかる子だ

fields.EN:
Here we go, Rapu!
Let's see you take our super
combo attack!
fields.JP:
行くわよ！　ラプ！
くらいなさい！　わたしたちの合体技を！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here we go, Rappy!
Let's see you take our super
combo attack!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
A super combo attack?!
That sounds pretty cool!
fields.JP:
が、合体技だと！？　
なんだそのロマン溢れる響きは！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A super combo attack?!
That sounds pretty cool!

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel's curling herself
into a ball... Wait...)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルがボールみたいに
　丸くなって……まさかっ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel's curling herself
into a ball... Wait...)

fields.JP: ゴールデンシュートッッ！！

（け、蹴った！　ハーメルンに向かって
　ラプンツェルをシンデレラが蹴り飛ばした！）
あははははははははっ！！

fields.EN:
Urgh!
I-I didn't expect that!
But, don't you underestimate me!
fields.JP:
ぬおぉっ！？
ま、まさかそんな手で来るとは！
だが、ワレを舐めるなよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh!
I-I didn't expect that!
But, don't you underestimate me!

fields.JP:
う……けほっ、けほっ……
ど、どうだ、この程度へっちゃらなのだ

fields.EN:
I'm amazed you were able to
take that!
fields.JP: 今のを耐えるとは……やりますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm amazed you were able to
take that!

fields.EN:
I am the greatest!
Do you expect anything less?!
fields.JP: この程度、最強のワレには通じぬ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the greatest!
Do you expect anything less?!

fields.EN:
(They're causing more mayhem
playing than fighting...)
fields.JP: （やれやれ、遊んでるだけで大惨事だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're causing more mayhem
playing than fighting...)

fields.EN:
Hey!
What is going on here?!
fields.JP: こらー！　いったい何騒いでるんですか～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey!
What is going on here?!

fields.JP: と、とっても怒ってますわよ！？

fields.EN:
Look at all the mess you
girls made! Shame on you!
fields.JP:
もう！　いけませんよ！
こんなに散らかして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at all the mess you
girls made! Shame on you!

fields.EN:
Urrh... Sorry. I guess we went
a bit too wild there.
fields.JP:
ぬぅ、すまないな。
ちょっとやりすぎてしまったようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Sorry. I guess we went
a bit too wild there.

fields.EN:
Well, if you're going to play,
you need to make sure you're
not causing trouble to others.
fields.JP:
そうですよ～。
人に迷惑をかけるような遊びはいけません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you're going to play,
you need to make sure you're
not causing trouble to others.

fields.EN:
Mmm... We'll clean up the
mess we caused...
fields.JP:
うむ、なので……散らかした分は
自分たちで片付けようと思うのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... We'll clean up the
mess we caused...

fields.EN:
It's fine that you play, but keep
it down a bit. Now then, if
you'll excuse me...
fields.JP:
遊ぶにしても、ほどほどにしてくださいね～？
それではわらわは戻ります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine that you play, but keep
it down a bit. Now then, if
you'll excuse me...

fields.EN:
That went well...
I guess we better call it a day.
fields.JP:
怒られてしまったな。
仕方ない今日はここまでにするか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That went well...
I guess we better call it a day.

fields.EN:
(Cinderella looks like she wanted
to play a bit longer.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラのあれは、
　もう少し遊びたかったって顔だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella looks like she wanted
to play a bit longer.)

fields.EN:
Why don't you have a game where
you see who can clean the place
up the best?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、こういうのはどうかな？
誰が一番キレイに掃除できるか競争するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you have a game where
you see who can clean the place
up the best?

fields.EN:
Oho! That sounds interesting!
Very well! I will show you I am
also the greatest at cleaning!
fields.JP:
ほう……？　面白そうだな！　いいだろう！　
掃除でもワレが最強だということを教えてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! That sounds interesting!
Very well! I will show you I am
also the greatest at cleaning!

fields.JP: ラプンツェルもまけないよー！
シンデレラもやるよね？

fields.EN:
O-Of course! As an adult,
there is no way I can lose here!
fields.JP:
も、もちろんですわ！
大人のわたしが負けるわけありませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course! As an adult,
there is no way I can lose here!

fields.JP: （まったく、手間のかかる子たちだ）

fields.EN:
I think I'll grab a drink to cool
myself down. Hm...?
fields.JP: さて風呂上りに飲み物でも……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I'll grab a drink to cool
myself down. Hm...?

fields.JP: いや、こんなところにかぐやの乗り物が

ほんとうだ。
確か、バンブー1号だっけ

fields.EN:
Um...
Maybe I can ride on it...
fields.JP:
……な、なぁ。
今ならこっそり乗れるのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um...
Maybe I can ride on it...

fields.EN:
She's going to get angry if you
touch it without her permission.
fields.JP: 勝手に触ったら怒られるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's going to get angry if you
touch it without her permission.

fields.EN:
Oh, come now. It'll be quick.
I always wanted to ride on it.
fields.JP:
なに、ちょっとだけ。
実は前から乗ってみたかったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come now. It'll be quick.
I always wanted to ride on it.

fields.JP: はぁ……一応、僕は止めたからね

fields.EN:
Hmph! No harm done if she
doesn't find out!
fields.JP: ふふん、バレなければ大丈夫だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! No harm done if she
doesn't find out!

fields.EN:
(I can already see where this
is going...)
fields.JP: （やれやれ、この先の展開が想像がつくな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can already see where this
is going...)

fields.JP: で、誰にバレなければ大丈夫なんですか～？

ぬおっ！　か、かぐや！？
いつからそこにいたのだ！？

fields.EN:
It started around when you began touching my
Bamboo One, Hameln-san.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさんが、わたしのバンブー1号を
ペタペタ触っていたあたりからです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just about when you started
touching around with my
Bamboo One.

fields.EN: Tch! I want to ride on it!
fields.JP: ……くっ、こうなれば一瞬だけでも！
fields.LOCALIZED: Tch! I want to ride on it!

fields.EN:
Oh, not giving up, are you?
I won't let you...!
fields.JP:
そこで諦めないんですか！？
そうはさせません～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, not giving up, are you?
I won't let you...!

fields.EN:
H-Hey...
It's dangerous riding around
on it here.
fields.JP: ちょっ、こんなところで走ったら危ない――
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey...
It's dangerous riding around
on it here.

fields.EN:
Are you two all right?!
Oh... Uh...
fields.JP:
二人とも大丈夫か！？
って……うわぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you two all right?!
Oh... Uh...

fields.EN:
Oww...
I didn't expect you to ram
into me...
fields.JP: あたたた……まさか、体当たりとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oww...
I didn't expect you to ram
into me...

fields.EN:
Eek! P-Please!
Get your face off of me!
fields.JP:
はぁぅ……っ、ちょ、ちょっと！
変なところでしゃべらないでください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eek! P-Please!
Get your face off of me!

fields.EN:
Hrm?!
S-Stop touching me like that!
fields.JP:
んんっ！？
そ、そっちこそ変なところを触るな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hrm?!
S-Stop touching me like that!

fields.EN:
Eep! It's not like I want
to touch you there!
fields.JP:
ひゃぁんっ！？
さ、触りたくて触ってるんじゃないです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eep! It's not like I want
to touch you there!

fields.EN: (This is way worse than I expected.)
fields.JP: （こ、これ以上はいろいろダメな気がする！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (This is way worse than I expected.)

fields.JP:
ひゃっ！？　
おつうさんもどこ触ってるんですか～！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
If you want to get all touchy,
do that with Ningyohime-san!
fields.JP:
そういうのはわらわじゃなくて、
人魚姫さんとしてください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to get all touchy,
do that with Little Mermaid!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
P-Princess?!
W-Wait! She has nothing to do
with what's going on here!
fields.JP:
ひ、姫と……っ！？
って、違う！　姫は関係ないだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess?!
W-Wait! She has nothing to do
with what's going on here!

fields.EN: J-Just get us out of this!
fields.JP: な、何でもいいから早く助けてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED: J-Just get us out of this!

fields.JP: あれー、みんなで何してるのー？

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel?!
I have a bad feeling about this.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェル……！
　嫌な予感が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel?!
I have a bad feeling about this.)

fields.EN:
Ooh! I know!
Everyone playing!
Rapunzel wanna play, too!
fields.JP:
あー！　分かった！
みんなであそんでるんだ！
ラプンツェルもまぜて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! I know!
Everyone playing!
Rapunzel wanna play, too!

fields.EN: W-Well, I need to get going...
fields.JP: じ、じゃあ、僕もういくから……
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Well, I need to get going...

fields.EN:
Y-You're leaving us like this?!
We're supposed to be friends!
fields.JP:
み、見捨てるつもりか！？
ワレらは仲間だろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're leaving us like this?!
We're supposed to be friends!

fields.EN:
Friends need to face their share
of trial and tribulation too,
so... Um, good luck!
fields.JP:
仲間だからこそあえて苦難の道を行く……
