というわけで、がんばって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends need to face their share
of trial and tribulation too,
so... Um, good luck!

fields.JP:
うわぁっ！？
か、かぐや姫！？　放してくれ！

fields.EN:
Heh heh... You're not getting
away so easily! We're all in this
together!
fields.JP:
ふふふ……逃がしませんよ～！
こうなったら一蓮托生です～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... You're not getting
away so easily! We're all in this
together!

fields.JP: ラプンツェルも、なかまにいれてー！！
あはははは！　どーーんっ！！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
You remember the set of pens we
gave to Hameln? I wonder what
she's doing with them now.
fields.JP:
ほら、前にマンガ描きセットをハーメルンに
あげただろ？　あれからどうなったかなって、
ふと気になったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember the set of pens we
gave to Hameln? I wonder what
she's doing with them now.

fields.EN:
She wanted to draw her own manga,
but I wouldn't be surprised if
she's gotten bored by now.
fields.JP:
マンガを描くって張り切ってたけど、
今ごろもう飽きちゃってたりしてな。
あはは
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wanted to draw her own manga,
but I wouldn't be surprised if
she's gotten bored by now.

fields.JP: おつうー！！　おーつーうー！！

fields.EN:
There you are! I've been
looking all over for you!
fields.JP:
こんなところのいたのだな！
探したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you are! I've been
looking all over for you!

fields.JP:
ハーメルン！？
すごい勢いで走ってきたね

fields.EN:
Heh heh! I couldn't hold myself
back! I wanted to show you
something...
fields.JP:
むふふ、はやる気持ちをおちゃえ
きれなくてな。貴様にどーしても
見せてやりたいものがあるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! I couldn't hold myself
back! I wanted to show you
something...

fields.JP:
なんと！　ついにワレは
マンガを描いたのだー！！

fields.EN:
Oh? You did make your own manga!
That's pretty amazing!
fields.JP: おお、有言実行したんだ！　すごいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You did make your own manga!
That's pretty amazing!

fields.EN:
Drawing manga was a bit too hard.
Drawing out the borders of each
scene was a major pain.
fields.JP:
でも実を言えば、最初からマンガを
描くのはハードルが高すぎた。
コマ割りというのがくせ者なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Drawing manga was a bit too hard.
Drawing out the borders of each
scene was a major pain.

fields.EN:
So I decided to draw myself
a picture first! Ta-da!
fields.JP:
だからまずはイラストというのを
描いてみたぞ！　じゃじゃーん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I decided to draw myself
a picture first! Ta-da!

fields.EN: This is a drawing of the hero I came up with!
fields.JP: これはワレが考えた勇者の絵だ！

fields.EN:
(...surprisingly good!
I guess it's rude to think that,
but...)
fields.JP:
（意外にうまい！
　いや、意外なんて言ったら失礼だけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...surprisingly good!
I guess it's rude to think that,
but...)

fields.EN:
So, how is it?
I'm open to any candid remarks!
fields.JP: どうだ？　正直に感想を言うがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how is it?
I'm open to any candid remarks!

fields.EN:
It looks really good! You're
amazing, Hameln! I can't believe
you've never done this before!
fields.JP:
うまい！　上手だよ、ハーメルン！
初めて描いたとは思えないくらい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks really good! You're
amazing, Hameln! I can't believe
you've never done this before!

fields.EN:
Oho! I knew it!
I thought I drew it pretty well
myself!
fields.JP:
おおっ、やはりそうか！
ワレもかなりうまく描けたと
思っていたのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! I knew it!
I thought I drew it pretty well
myself!

fields.EN:
It still lacks the finesse of my
holy grail manga, but I'm sure
I'll get better with practice!
fields.JP:
聖なる書物・マンガの絵にはまだまだ
及ばぬが、これから練習しゅれば
絶対もっとうまくなるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It still lacks the finesse of my
holy grail manga, but I'm sure
I'll get better with practice!

fields.EN:
You're right. In any case, I'm
surprised you had the knack
for drawing, Hameln.
fields.JP:
うん、きっとそうだね。
ハーメルンにこんな才能が
あったなんて驚いたなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. In any case, I'm
surprised you had the knack
for drawing, Hameln.

fields.EN: All that manga reading paid off!
fields.JP: マンガをたくさん読み込んできたおかげだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: All that manga reading paid off!

fields.EN:
I still have a lot ahead of me.
I need to draw backgrounds,
borders, dialogues, and more.
fields.JP:
だが、人物を描くだけではマンガはできぬ。
コマ割りも、背景も、いろいろ描けなければ
ならぬのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still have a lot ahead of me.
I need to draw backgrounds,
borders, dialogues, and more.

fields.EN:
I need to improve...
I have stories drawn out in my
mind, too!
fields.JP:
ワレはこのままでは駄目だ。
マンガにしたいストーリーは
たくさん考えているというのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to improve...
I have stories drawn out in my
mind, too!

fields.EN:
(Hameln is actually thinking
this time... I guess that's how
much she likes manga.)
fields.JP:
（おお、ハーメルンが珍しく
　難しいことを考えている。
　それほどマンガが好きなんだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln is actually thinking
this time... I guess that's how
much she likes manga.)

fields.EN:
If you want to portray your story,
you do have other options
besides manga.
fields.JP:
あ、でもさ。ストーリーを表現するなら、
なにもマンガだけが表現方法じゃないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to portray your story,
you do have other options
besides manga.

fields.JP: む？　それはどういうことだ？

fields.EN:
For example, since we know you
can draw, you can make storybooks
or even slide shows.
fields.JP:
たとえば、絵が描けるなら
絵本だっていいし、
紙芝居だってアリだと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, since we know you
can draw, you can make storybooks
or even slide shows.

fields.EN:
Hm, storybooks and slide shows?
I suppose I can do those, too.
But...
fields.JP:
ふむ、絵本に紙芝居か。
それならワレにでも描けそうだな。
だがなぁ、うーむ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, storybooks and slide shows?
I suppose I can do those, too.
But...

fields.EN:
Don't they both sound a bit
too kiddie?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't they both sound a bit
too kiddie?

fields.EN:
Well, I guess those are
targeted at younger audiences.
fields.JP:
あー、まぁ、たしかにマンガより
対象年齢が低いかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess those are
targeted at younger audiences.

fields.EN:
Still, those are options you can
take to express what you have
in mind.
fields.JP:
だけどハーメルンがなにを考えて、
なにを描きたいのか、それを誰かに伝える
手段の一つではあると思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, those are options you can
take to express what you have
in mind.

fields.EN:
Of course, keeping at it with
manga is definitely an option,
too.
fields.JP:
もちろん、もっと練習してマンガ一本で
がんばるっていうのもいいと思うけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, keeping at it with
manga is definitely an option,
too.

fields.EN:
Hm... What you mentioned
is worth exploring...
fields.JP:
……いや、貴様の提案はけんとーしゅる
価値があるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... What you mentioned
is worth exploring...

fields.EN:
I do want to draw mangas, but that
was only because I wanted to
express the story I had in mind.
fields.JP:
ワレはマンガを描きたいが、
マンガを描きたいのは、考えた
ストーリーを表現したいからだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do want to draw mangas, but that
was only because I wanted to
express the story I had in mind.

fields.EN:
What excited me the most reading
my holy grail manga was its
intense story!
fields.JP:
聖なる書物・マンガでワレが
一番コーフンしたのは、絵よりもなによりも、
熱いストーリーなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What excited me the most reading
my holy grail manga was its
intense story!

fields.EN:
I can feel your excitement,
Hameln!
fields.JP: おお、ハーメルンが燃えている……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can feel your excitement,
Hameln!

fields.EN:
You know, you're right, Otsuu.
I shall consider storybooks and
slide shows as an option.
fields.JP:
おつう、貴様の言う通り、
絵本や紙芝居という方法も
けんとーしてみるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, you're right, Otsuu.
I shall consider storybooks and
slide shows as an option.

fields.EN:
I will continue practicing my
manga drawing skills, but
now I have options!
fields.JP:
もちろんマンガの修行も続けるつもりだ。
だがマンガにこだわる必要はにゃいと
わかったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will continue practicing my
manga drawing skills, but
now I have options!

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu!
You are of great inspiration!
All right! I'll do this!
fields.JP:
ありがとう、おつう！
貴様のおかげだ！
よし！　やるぞ！　ワレは！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu!
You are of great inspiration!
All right! I'll do this!

fields.JP: その意気だよ、ハーメルン！

fields.EN:
Urrrh!
My battle has just begun!
fields.JP:
ぬおおおっ！
ワレの戦いはまだ始まったばかりだー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrrh!
My battle has just begun!

fields.EN:
Look at her go... It was worth
it giving her the drawing pens.
Isn't that right, Jack?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、すごく楽しそうだな。
マンガ描きセットを拾ってよかったね、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at her go... It was worth
it giving her the drawing pens.
Isn't that right, Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh, but I hope her "my battle
has just begun" phrase won't
raise any bad flags for her...
fields.JP:
でも、「戦いはまだ始まったばかり」って……。
なんとなく縁起が悪いフレーズな気がするのは
なんでだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I hope her "my battle
has just begun" phrase won't
raise any bad flags for her...

fields.JP: ここがグレーテルの部屋か……
おつうちゃん、もしかして緊張してる？

fields.EN:
Well, it is my first time here.
Let me see if she's in...
fields.JP:
初めて来たから、少しね。
……よし、じゃあノックするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it is my first time here.
Let me see if she's in...

fields.EN:
Um, it's me, Tsuu. Princess is
with me, too. Can we come in?
fields.JP:
あの……僕だよ。つう。姫も一緒だ。
入ってもいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, it's me, Otsuu. Princess is
with me, too. Can we come in?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP:
おじゃまします……って、あれ？
ヘンゼルはいないのか？

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan is playing with Jack
right now.
fields.JP: ええ、ヘンゼル兄さんはジャックと遊んでいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel is playing with Jack
right now.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: ヘンゼルとジャックが……一緒に遊ぶ……

fields.EN:
It's good that Jack-san has a
friend now.
fields.JP: ジャックさんにお友だちができてよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's good that Jack has a
friend now.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I have to say, just thinking about
them playing together is quite
astounding...
fields.JP:
想像しただけでも、すごい強烈な光景だけどね。
ははは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to say, just thinking about
them playing together is quite
astounding...

fields.EN:
I'm intrigued how Nightmares
come together like that.
Now then, what brings you here?
fields.JP:
ナイトメア同士、なにか惹かれ合うものが
あるみたいね。興味深いわ。
……それで、なにか用があって来たんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm intrigued how Nightmares
come together like that.
Now then, what brings you here?

fields.EN: Uh, can we come in first?
fields.JP: じゃあ、ちょっと失礼して……
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, can we come in first?

fields.JP: それで、二人してなにか用かしら？

用っていうほどじゃないんだけど、
なんていうか……

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, we came to see if you were having
trouble getting used to this place. Right,
Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんが慣れない環境で困っていないか、
様子を見に来たんです。ね？　おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were just making sure you're
okay. I mean, I'm sure this is all
new to you. Right, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
What she said. Are you okay
with how things are here?
fields.JP:
うん、そうなんだ。
ここでの暮らしはどうかな。
なにか不自由はない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What she said. Are you okay
with how things are here?

fields.EN:
If there is anything, please feel
free to let us know.
fields.JP: なにかあれば、遠慮せず相談してくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there is anything, please feel
free to let us know.

fields.EN:
I'm glad we came to check on Gretel-san.
You were worried about her, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
ふふ、やっぱり様子を見に来てよかったね。
おつうちゃん、グレーテルさんのこと
心配してたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's good we came to check on
her. You were all worried about
her anyway.

fields.EN:
You're the one who asked me to
come here with you. As kind as
usual, aren't you?
fields.JP:
でも、様子を見に行こうって誘ってくれたのは
姫のほうだった。やっぱり姫は優しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one who asked me to
come here with you. As kind as
usual, aren't you?

fields.EN:
I only gave you a little push because you
looked like you wanted to go, Otsuu-chan.
You're the kind one here.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが行きたそうにしてたから、
わたしが背中を押しただけだよ。
優しいのはおつうちゃんのほうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I just nudged you a bit since
it looked like you wanted to go.
So you're the kind one here.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I assume you're in your own
world right now...
fields.JP:
……なるほど。
これが二人の世界というものなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume you're in your own
world right now...

fields.EN:
Wha-?! I'm sorry!
It's not that we forgot about...
fields.JP:
うわ、ごめん！
別に君のこと忘れてたわけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! I'm sorry!
It's not that we forgot about...

fields.EN:
Your relationship is no different
from that of a partnership of
the opposite sex.
fields.JP:
あなたたちの仲の良さは、
まるで『つがい』のようだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your relationship is no different
from that of a partnership of
the opposite sex.

fields.EN:
I assumed such courtship was only
possible between a male and
female, but I suppose I was wrong.
fields.JP:
オスとメスでつがいになるものだと
思っていたけれど、メス同士でも
つがいになるものなのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assumed such courtship was only
possible between a male and
female, but I suppose I was wrong.

fields.JP: つ、つがいだなんて、そんな！

fields.EN:
Hm...
So, why are you two so close
to each other?
fields.JP: ふぅん？　では、なぜそんなに仲がいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...
So, why are you two so close
to each other?

fields.JP: おつうちゃんとわたしは、夫婦なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're actually wed locked as
husband and wife.

fields.JP: ……説明が漠然としていて、よくわからないわ

fields.EN:
I just happened to ask for
Princess's hand in marriage
when we first met.
fields.JP:
僕が初めて姫に会ったとき、
「お嫁さんにしてください」って言ったんだ。
つい、勢いで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened to ask for
Princess's hand in marriage
when we first met.

fields.EN:
You mean on first sight? Were you
in heat? Would you have asked for
anyone's hand in marriage then?
fields.JP:
つまり初対面で求愛行動をしたということ？
発情期で誰でもよかったということかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean on first sight? Were you
in heat? Would you have asked for
anyone's hand in marriage then?

fields.EN:
No. It was only because it was
Princess. I guess you can say she
was special to me before we met.
fields.JP:
違うよ。姫じゃなかったら
そうは言わなかった。気がついたときから、
姫のことは特別だったっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. It was only because it was
Princess. I guess you can say she
was special to me before we met.

fields.EN:
I knew that she was the person
of fate upon seeing her.
fields.JP: 僕の運命の人だって、直感でわかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew that she was the person
of fate upon seeing her.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 姫は？　あのときどう思った？

fields.EN:
Well, it did take me by surprise.
But, it didn't sound bad to me
at all.
fields.JP:
いきなりお嫁さんにしてほしいなんて
言われたから、びっくりしちゃった。
でも、全然嫌じゃなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it did take me by surprise.
But, it didn't sound bad to me
at all.

fields.EN:
By the time I knew it, I asked
Otsuu-chan to become my prince instead
of being my wife.
fields.JP:
だからわたしも思わずおつうちゃんに、
「お嫁さんじゃなくて王子様になって」
ってお願いしたんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the time I knew it, I asked
Otsuu to become my prince instead
of being my wife.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
That doesn't make sense... In any
case, I can already see that logic
won't explain your relationship.
fields.JP:
お嫁さんと王子様では、まったく別物だけど……。
あなたたちの馴れ初めを論理的に解釈することは
難しそうだ、ということだけはわかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't make sense... In any
case, I can already see that logic
won't explain your relationship.

fields.EN:
But it also interests me how logic
won't work here... Primal urges?
Emotions? Quite interesting...
fields.JP:
でも、論理的でないところも面白い……。
言葉では簡単に説明することができない感情、
行動理由……。素晴らしいわ、あなたたち
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it also interests me how logic
won't work here... Primal urges?
Emotions? Quite interesting...

fields.EN:
You both interest me to no end
as specimens.
fields.JP: 観察対象として、ますます興味が湧いてきたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You both interest me to no end
as specimens.

fields.EN:
So, have you both had intercourse
already?
fields.JP: ねえ、あなたたちはすでに性交渉はしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, have you both had intercourse
already?

fields.EN:
What's with your flustering?
I just wanted to confirm facts.
fields.JP:
なにを動揺しているの？
私は事実を確認しただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with your flustering?
I just wanted to confirm facts.

fields.EN:
W-We have a very clean and pure
relationship! We wouldn't...!
fields.JP:
ぼ、僕達は、清らかな、関係だから！
そういうことは、全然……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We have a very clean and pure
relationship! We wouldn't...!

fields.EN:
Oh, not yet? If you do decide to
have intercourse, do let me sit
in so that I can observe.
fields.JP:
まだなの？　だったら初めてのときは、
私も同席させてもらってもいいかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, not yet? If you do decide to
have intercourse, do let me sit
in so that I can observe.

fields.EN:
S-Stop that! Things like that
aren't something you show to
others publicly!
fields.JP:
こ、困るよ！
そもそも、そういうのは誰かに見せる
ようなことじゃないと思うし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Stop that! Things like that
aren't something you show to
others publicly!

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、論点がずれてる……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I'll observe away from your view.
I can even blend myself into the
surrounding if that would help.
fields.JP:
邪魔にならないように見ているわ。
なんなら、背景に同化してもいいけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll observe away from your view.
I can even blend myself into the
surrounding if that would help.

fields.EN:
That's not the point!
You know, we're done!
Let's get going!
fields.JP:
そういう問題じゃないんだってば。
とにかく、この話はこれでおしまい！
じゃあ、僕達はこれで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the point!
You know, we're done!
Let's get going!

fields.JP: あの、グレーテルさん、失礼します！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Hm, interesting... "Wife" and
"prince"... Could those words be
rooted to their Blood Libido?
fields.JP:
……お嫁さんに、王子様。
それも血式リビドー由来の言葉だったのかしら。
面白い二人。研究意欲を掻き立てられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, interesting... "Wife" and
"prince"... Could those words be
rooted to their Blood Libido?

fields.EN:
It also intrigues me that they
don't have an explanation of
the "why" to their attraction.
fields.JP: それに、「気がついたときから」ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also intrigues me that they
don't have an explanation of
the "why" to their attraction.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens... There's so much
to research here... Heh heh...
fields.JP:
『血式少女』か……。
色々と調べることが多そうね。ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens... There's so much
to research here... Heh heh...

fields.EN:
Hm? Look over there...
Gretel's... smiling?!
fields.JP:
……ん？　うわ。姫、あれを見て。
グレーテルがすごく笑ってる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Look over there...
Gretel's... smiling?!

fields.EN:
You're right...
I wonder if she had something
nice happen.
fields.JP: 本当だ。なにかいいことでもあったのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I wonder if she had something
nice happen.

fields.EN:
Nice would be an understatement to
describe her smile. I'd even say
it's an omen of something to come.
fields.JP:
いや、いいことがあったなんてレベルじゃないよ。
あのグレーテルがあんな満面の笑みを浮かべる
なんて、天変地異の前触れじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice would be an understatement to
describe her smile. I'd even say
it's an omen of something to come.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, it looks like Gretel-san is eating
something...
fields.JP:
ねえ、おつうちゃん。グレーテルさん、
なにか食べてるみたいだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Otsuu? It looks like she's
eating something.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
*munch* *munch*
What are you two doing there?
*munch* *munch*
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……あら。
二人とも、そんなところでなにを
コソコソしているの？　もぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* *munch*
What are you two doing there?
*munch* *munch*

fields.EN:
Uh, um... We noticed you were
smiling, so we were just wondering
if everything was all right.
fields.JP:
ああ、うん。
グレーテルがあんまりいい笑顔だったから、
どうしたのかなと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, um... We noticed you were
smiling, so we were just wondering
if everything was all right.

fields.EN:
*munch* I'm just eating sweets.
What a delight. *munch*
fields.JP:
お菓子を食べていたの。もぐもぐ。
至福のときとは、このことを言うのねもぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* I'm just eating sweets.
What a delight. *munch*

fields.EN:
(She's talking while eating...
She must really like those
sweets...)
fields.JP:
（話してる間も食べるのをやめようとしない……。
　どれだけ好きなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's talking while eating...
She must really like those
sweets...)

fields.EN:
I thought sweets were a rarity
down here. Where did you get them?
fields.JP:
だけど、お菓子ってすごく貴重ですよね。
どこで手に入れたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought sweets were a rarity
down here. Where did you get them?

fields.JP: もぐもぐ、これはヘンゼル兄さんにもらったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got them *munch* from *munch*
my brother, Hansel. *munch*
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: ヘンゼルさんにもらったって……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヘンゼルさん => Hansel-san

fields.EN:
To be specific, *munch*
I picked these from his body.
*munch*
fields.JP:
正確には、ヘンゼル兄さんの体の一部を
もらったということよ。もぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be specific, *munch*
I picked these from his body.
*munch*

fields.EN:
(Urp...
I wish I didn't hear that...)
fields.JP: （う、グロいことを想像してしまった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Urp...
I wish I didn't hear that...)

fields.JP: もぐもぐ、ええ、もぐもぐもぐ……
はは、よっぽどおいしいみたいだね

fields.EN:
You're going to have to find
your own as these are mine.
*munch* *munch*
fields.JP:
これは私の分だから、あげられないわよ？
もぐもぐ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to have to find
your own as these are mine.
*munch* *munch*

fields.EN:
W-We're fine, thank you.
Right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
わ、わたしたちは大丈夫です。
ね？　おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-We're fine, thank you.
Right, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Y-Yes...
We're not hungry, so... have fun.
fields.JP:
う、うん。
僕達は大丈夫だから、気にせず食べてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes...
We're not hungry, so... have fun.

fields.EN:
(There's no way I want to eat
them, especially now that I know
she got them from Hansel's body.)
fields.JP:
（っていうか元がヘンゼルの体だと思うと、
　ちょっとな。どんなにおいしいとしても、
　全然食欲が湧かない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way I want to eat
them, especially now that I know
she got them from Hansel's body.)

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you like sweets.
I didn't expect you to like them
that much.
fields.JP:
……それにしても、本当にお菓子が好きなんだな。
いつもの君とは大違いで意外だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you like sweets.
I didn't expect you to like them
that much.

fields.EN:
Why, anything sweet is good to me.
I'm instinctively attracted to the
consuming of sweets. *munch*
fields.JP:
ええ。お菓子が……甘い物が好きなの。
甘い物を食べている間は幸福感に満ちているわ。
本能が求めていると言っても過言ではないほど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, anything sweet is good to me.
I'm instinctively attracted to the
consuming of sweets. *munch*

fields.EN:
*munch* I suppose this is my
*munch* Blood Libido.
I can't stop *munch* it.
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……これが私の血式リビドー
なんでしょうね。もはや運命として
受け入れるしかないわもぐもぐ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* I suppose this is my
*munch* Blood Libido.
I can't stop *munch* it.

fields.EN:
(Even if it was her Blood Libido,
I'm a bit worried all those sweets
will add to her weight...)
fields.JP:
（でも、いくら血式リビドーだからって
　甘い物食べまくってたら、太るんじゃないか？
　大丈夫かな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if it was her Blood Libido,
I'm a bit worried all those sweets
will add to her weight...)

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel-san? May I suggest that you
move a bit after eating?
fields.JP:
あ、あの、グレーテルさん。
食べたあとは、そのー、運動とか
したほうがいいかもしれません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? May I suggest that you
move a bit after eating?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
(Looks like Princess was thinking
the same thing as me.)
fields.JP: （あ、姫も僕と同じこと心配したんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Princess was thinking
the same thing as me.)

fields.EN:
Move? As in exercise? I suppose
a balance is needed here.
I'll keep that in mind.
fields.JP:
運動？　たしかに適度な運動は
健康にいいというわね。心に留めておくわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Move? As in exercise? I suppose
a balance is needed here.
I'll keep that in mind.

fields.JP: うん、それがいいと思う……

fields.EN:
Mmm... Where could Princess
have gone?
fields.JP:
うーん、いないなぁ、姫。
どこに行ったんだろう……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Where could Princess
have gone?

fields.EN:
There she is! But... what is she
doing with Gretel and Hikari?
fields.JP:
いた！　……でも、なにをしてるんだろう。
姫とグレーテルとヒカリの組み合わせって、
あんまりないような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There she is! But... what is she
doing with Gretel and Hikari?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
There you are, Princess.
So, what are you three doing here?
fields.JP:
やあ、姫。探したよ。
三人でなにをしてたんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you are, Princess.
So, what are you three doing here?

fields.EN:
Hikari-chan and I were about to show
Gretel-san how to bake some sweets.
fields.JP:
わたしとヒカリちゃんで、グレーテルさんに
お菓子作りを教えてたところなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were about to show Gretel
how to bake some sweets.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
(I'm actually more surprised that
Gretel is going to make sweets...)
fields.JP:
（そもそもグレーテルが料理するって、
　似合わないというか意外というか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm actually more surprised that
Gretel is going to make sweets...)

fields.EN:
Heh heh... You look surprised
seeing me here, learning how to
make sweets.
fields.JP:
ふふ、私が料理なんて似合わない、
とでも言いたげな顔ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... You look surprised
seeing me here, learning how to
make sweets.

fields.EN:
Not at all. I just didn't expect
you to be the cooking type.
So, why now?
fields.JP:
別にそんなことはないって。
ちょっと意外だっただけだよ。
……だけど、どうしてお菓子作りを？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I just didn't expect
you to be the cooking type.
So, why now?

fields.EN:
Simple. Because Hansel-niisan can't
regenerate anymore with the
destruction of the core.
fields.JP:
理由はいたってシンプルよ。
ヘンゼル兄さんの核が破壊されて、
体が修復されなくなってしまったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simple. Because Hansel can't
regenerate anymore with the
destruction of the core.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN: Unlike before, I can't have him endlessly supply me with his body... sweets... anymore, so from now on I'll have to manage on my own.
fields.JP:
今までのように、体を……甘い物を
無限に提供してもらえるわけではなくなったから、
これからは自力でどうにかしなければいけないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to find a different way to
get my sweets since the supply
isn't endless as before.

fields.EN:
(She sure is calm, even if it is
about Hansel. I guess that's just
Gretel being Gretel...)
fields.JP:
（ヘンゼルのことなのに、相変わらずクールだな。
　まぁ、グレーテルらしいといえば、
　らしいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sure is calm, even if it is
about Hansel. I guess that's just
Gretel being Gretel...)

fields.EN:
I suppose my want for sweets is
my purpose here. Is there anything
else you want to know?
fields.JP:
体が甘い物を欲するから。
それ以上の理由がいるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose my want for sweets is
my purpose here. Is there anything
else you want to know?

fields.JP: ああ、なるほど……。すごく君らしいね

fields.EN:
How about you, Otsuu-kun? We don't
have very many ingredients,
but you wanna make some sweets?
fields.JP:
おつうくんも一緒に作ってみる？
あまり材料がないから大したものは作れないけど、
気晴らしになるかもよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about you, Otsuu? We don't
have very many ingredients,
but you wanna make some sweets?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun

fields.EN:
No, I'm fine. Thank you.
I'll just watch.
fields.JP:
いや、僕は遠慮しておこう。
ここで見学させてもらうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine. Thank you.
I'll just watch.

fields.EN:
(Heh heh... And, if timing proves
right, I may snitch a bite
just a bit.)
fields.JP:
（あわよくば、お菓子が出来上がったら
　つまみ食いでもさせてもらおうかな。ふふ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh heh... And, if timing proves
right, I may snitch a bite
just a bit.)

fields.EN:
So, Gretel-san, first put a little bit
of salt in the bowl.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、グレーテルさん。
そこのボウルに塩を少々入れて
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, Gretel, first put a little bit
of salt in the bowl.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
How many grams are you speaking
of here?
fields.JP: 少々って何グラムのこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many grams are you speaking
of here?

fields.JP: えっと、だいたい一つまみくらいかな
（グレーテル、納得できなさそうな顔してるなぁ）

fields.EN:
Next, add some egg yolk and
stir it for a bit.
fields.JP: 次に卵黄を加えてまんべんなく混ぜて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next, add some egg yolk and
stir it for a bit.

fields.EN:
How long do you mean by
"a bit?"
fields.JP: まんべんなくって、具体的にどれくらいのこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How long do you mean by
"a bit?"

fields.EN:
Let me show you. Here...
Just whisk it like this, and...
fields.JP:
じゃあ、わたしがお手本を見せますね。
こうやってぐるぐるかき混ぜて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me show you. Here...
Just whisk it like this, and...

fields.EN:
There... That should do it.
Next we add the flour like so...
fields.JP:
……うん、これくらいです。
さらにこっちの粉を加えて、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
There... That should do it.
Next we add the flour like so...

fields.EN:
With that done, let's use this
spatula to lightly mix the flour
and the base...
fields.JP:
これが終わったら、次はゴムベラで
ざっくりと混ぜ合わせて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that done, let's use this
spatula to lightly mix the flour
and the base...

fields.EN:
Describe what you mean by "lightly
mix." Are you implying we
shouldn't mix it at all?
fields.JP:
ざっくり混ぜるってなに？　よく混ぜればいいの？
それともあまり混ぜないほうがいいの？
表現がざっくりしすぎているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Describe what you mean by "lightly
mix." Are you implying we
shouldn't mix it at all?

fields.JP: それはだから、なんて言えばいいのかな……

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, we'll take care of the mixing, so
could you warm the milk?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、そっちは
わたしたちがやっておきますから、
この牛乳を温めてくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tell you what. We'll take care of
the mixing, so can you go ahead
and warm the milk?

fields.EN:
Understood. To what temperature
do you need the milk warmed to?
fields.JP: わかったわ。何度に加熱すればいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. To what temperature
do you need the milk warmed to?

fields.JP: ひと肌くらいでいいですよ

fields.EN:
Room temperature? Temperature
differs depending on the room.
fields.JP:
……ひと肌とは、何度のこと？
体温は人によって個人差があるでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Room temperature? Temperature
differs depending on the room.

fields.JP: あう……それはそうなんですけど……

fields.EN:
The details have been very vague.
Is the making of sweets conducted
this loosely?
fields.JP:
さっきから感覚的な表現が多くて困るわ。
お菓子作りとは、なんて曖昧さに
満ちたものなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The details have been very vague.
Is the making of sweets conducted
this loosely?

fields.EN:
Just a matter of observation, but
if you keep that up, you're not
going get any sweets made.
fields.JP:
見学者として言わせてもらうけど、
細かいこと気にしてたら、
いつまで経ってもお菓子ができないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a matter of observation, but
if you keep that up, you're not
going get any sweets made.

fields.JP: ……！　たしかにその通りだわ

fields.EN:
I don't blame you for being
specific. I mean, that is you
after all.
fields.JP:
なんでもきっちり数字で理解したくなるのは、
君の性格なんだろうけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame you for being
specific. I mean, that is you
after all.

fields.EN:
Hm, I suppose I'm not meant to be
making my own sweets. But I can't
let that thwart my endeavor.
fields.JP:
そうね。お菓子作りは性に合わないの
かもしれない。……でも、それを言い訳にして
お菓子作りを断念するわけにはいかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I suppose I'm not meant to be
making my own sweets. But I can't
let that thwart my endeavor.

fields.EN:
Wow! I can see you're really
serious about this!
fields.JP: すごい。気合いがみなぎってる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow! I can see you're really
serious about this!

fields.EN:
We'll help you as much as we
can, Gretel-san! Let's do this!
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、わたしたちも応援します！
一緒にがんばりましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll help you as much as we
can, Gretel! Let's do this!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
(Those two are taking Gretel's
words too positively. She's saying
that because she wants sweets...)
fields.JP:
（いや、単に食欲に突き動かされてるだけ
　だよね。二人ともなんか感動してるけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Those two are taking Gretel's
words too positively. She's saying
that because she wants sweets...)

fields.EN:
(Still, the concept she's willing
to go through all this for sweets
must prove she really likes them.)
fields.JP:
（でもグレーテルが曖昧な表現を
　受け入れてまでお菓子作りを優先させるなんて、
　よっぽど甘い物が好きなんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, the concept she's willing
to go through all this for sweets
must prove she really likes them.)

fields.EN:
Hm? What are you girls doing
here?
fields.JP:
おっ？
貴様ら、こんなところに集まって
なにをしているのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What are you girls doing
here?

fields.EN:
Hameln? Princess and Hikari are
teaching Gretel how to make
sweets.
fields.JP:
あ、ハーメルン。
人魚姫とヒカリが、グレーテルに
お菓子作りを教えてるんだ。僕は見学
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln? Princess and Hikari are
teaching Gretel how to make
sweets.

fields.EN:
Sweets, you say? That sounds fun!
Here, let me taste-test it for
you girls.
fields.JP:
なに、菓子作りだと？
面白そうなことをしているな。
どれ、ワレが味見をしてやろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sweets, you say? That sounds fun!
Here, let me taste-test it for
you girls.

fields.JP: ハーちゃん、まだ作ってる途中だよ

fields.EN:
Yup. Eating batter raw is only
going to make your tummy sore.
fields.JP:
そうそう。
生地の状態で食べたら、お腹壊しちゃうよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Eating batter raw is only
going to make your tummy sore.

fields.EN:
Hmph! My stomach can handle
anything! Now, hand me over
that bowl of batter!
fields.JP:
ふふん、それしきのことで
下すようなワレの腹ではないわ！
その生地を寄越すがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! My stomach can handle
anything! Now, hand me over
that bowl of batter!

fields.EN:
Uh, I... have to go now.
I'll see you all layter...
fields.JP:
で、では、ワレはこれで……、
し、しちゅれいするぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, I... have to go now.
I'll see you all layter...

fields.JP: さ、お菓子作りを再開しましょう

fields.EN: (Gretel was terrifying just now...! She was absolutely serious about killing me. It wasn't just an empty threat.)
fields.JP:
（さっきのグレーテル、すごく怖かった……！
　あの殺気は絶対本気だったぞ。
　殺すって、ただの脅し文句じゃなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She scared the daylights out of
me! She really meant what
she said there!)

fields.EN:
(I better not snitch a bite.
I don't want to die yet...)
fields.JP:
（僕もつまみ食いしようと思ってたけど、
　やっぱりやめておこう。
　命は惜しいもんな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better not snitch a bite.
I don't want to die yet...)

fields.EN:
I'm worried about Gretel.
She's been like that for days
now...
fields.JP:
……グレーテルのこと、心配だな。
近頃、ずっと一人でぼんやりしてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm worried about Gretel.
She's been like that for days
now...

fields.EN:
I guess what happened to Hansel-san
was too much for her to fathom...
fields.JP:
やっぱり落ち込んでるのかな。
ヘンゼルさんのこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess what happened to Hansel
was too much for her to fathom...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヘンゼルさん => Hansel-san

fields.EN:
I suppose she has emotions
just like any one of us...
fields.JP:
あやつでも、しぇ、しぇ……センチメンタル、
になることがあるのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose she has emotions
just like any one of us...

fields.EN:
Should we just leave her alone?
Maybe I should talk to her...
No, wait...
fields.JP:
そっとしてあげたほうがいいのかな。
それとも話を聞いて励ましたほうが……
いや、いらぬおせっかいになったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Should we just leave her alone?
Maybe I should talk to her...
No, wait...

fields.EN:
If you're going to spend time
wondering, spend it on action!
Here, let me show you...
fields.JP:
くよくよ悩むくらいなら、
さっさと行動を起こせばいいだろう。
よし、ワレが手本を見せてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're going to spend time
wondering, spend it on action!
Here, let me show you...

fields.EN: W-Wait! Gretel might be hurt, so maybe you shouldn't just rush in like that...
fields.JP:
わわ、ちょっと待った！
グレーテルは傷ついてるかもしれないんだから、
そんないきなり行かないほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! Just a second!
This might not be the best time
to be bothering Gretel...

fields.JP: ……でも、わたしもハーちゃんに賛成だな

fields.EN:
I'm sure Gretel-san is hurt, but I think she's
just as lonely too. It's like she's all alone...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんはきっと傷ついてるけど、
それと同じくらい孤独を抱えてるんだと思う。
一人ぼっちになっちゃったみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure she's hurt, but I also
think she's also suffering from
solitude...

fields.EN:
Yup, but maybe she might not see
that. That's why we should try and
approach her from our side.
fields.JP:
うん。だけど今は心に余裕がなくて、
それを忘れちゃってるかもしれない。だから
わたしたちから寄り添った方がいいと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, but maybe she might not see
that. That's why we should try and
approach her from our side.

fields.EN:
We don't need to talk to her.
Just be by her side in her time
of need. Don't you think so?
fields.JP:
たくさん言葉をかけたりしなくたって、
傍にいるだけで、なにか違うかもしれないでしょ？
……普通はそうだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't need to talk to her.
Just be by her side in her time
of need. Don't you think so?

fields.EN:
I'm amazed at how quickly you were
able to come to a conclusion over
something I couldn't figure out.
fields.JP:
……姫。君はすごいな。
僕が迷っていたことに、
すぐに答えを見つけてしまうんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm amazed at how quickly you were
able to come to a conclusion over
something I couldn't figure out.

fields.EN:
You couldn't decide because you're kind,
Otsuu-chan. Now, let's go see Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが迷っていたのは、
おつうちゃんが優しいからだよ。
さ、グレーテルさんのところに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You weren't able to make a
decision because you're kind.
Now, let's go see Gretel.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
Tsuu? Ningyohime, Hameln?
What brings you three here?
fields.JP: ……つう？　人魚姫に、ハーメルンまで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? Little Mermaid, Hameln?
What brings you three here?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Um, if you don't mind, can we
join you?
fields.JP:
あの、お邪魔じゃなければ、
一緒にいてもいいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, if you don't mind, can we
join you?

fields.EN:
What were you doing here all
by yourself? Were you suffering
or something?
fields.JP:
一人でなにをしてたんだ？
やっぱり落ち込んでるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What were you doing here all
by yourself? Were you suffering
or something?

fields.EN:
Suffering?
What are you talking about?
fields.JP: ？　落ち込む……？　なんのことかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Suffering?
What are you talking about?

fields.EN:
Um, I know it's difficult with
what happened to Hansel-san,
but we're here for you.
fields.JP:
その、ヘンゼルさんがあんなことに
なっちゃって……。やっぱり辛いですよね。
わたしたちでよければ、いつでも力になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I know it's difficult with
what happened to Hansel,
but we're here for you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヘンゼルさん => Hansel-san

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan?
Oh, you mean how he's dead?
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんがって……。
ああ、死んでしまったこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel?
Oh, you mean how he's dead?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
(Wow, she's taking it well.
I'd even say she's borderline
cold-hearted...)
fields.JP:
（なんだかすごくドライだな。
　冷たいっていうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow, she's taking it well.
I'd even say she's borderline
cold-hearted...)

fields.EN:
I don't see why I should suffer
over my Hansel-niisan's
death.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんが死んだからといって、
私が落ち込む理由にはならないと思うけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see why I should suffer
over my dear brother Hansel's
death.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
You don't need to put up a front.
You're free to say what you...
fields.JP:
強がらなくてもいいんだよ？
僕達の前でくらい、本音で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to put up a front.
You're free to say what you...

fields.EN:
Hansel-niisan died. He isn't here now.
That's the fact.
fields.JP:
ヘンゼル兄さんは死んだ。もういない。
それがすべてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hansel died. He isn't here now.
That's the fact.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
But, aren't you sad?
Your brother died.
fields.JP:
そんな……本当に悲しくないのか？
兄と慕っていたヘンゼルが、死んだんだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, aren't you sad?
Your brother died.

fields.EN: Actually, I think it's something to be glad about. Hansel-niisan didn't die in vain.
fields.JP:
むしろ喜ばしいことだと思うわ。
ヘンゼル兄さんは無駄死にしたわけじゃ
なかったのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, I'm very happy
that he died with a cause.

fields.EN:
You could've worded it better!
He died for the sake of everyone!
fields.JP:
その言い方はないんじゃないか？
ヘンゼルは仲間を助けるために
犠牲になったんだぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could've worded it better!
He died for the sake of everyone!

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、落ち着いて
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
No, I won't! Gretel, I expected
more from you! Hansel was more
of a human than you!
fields.JP:
落ち着いてられないよ！
グレーテルの態度はあまりにも薄情だ！
これならヘンゼルのほうがまだ人間らしかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I won't! Gretel, I expected
more from you! Hansel was more
of a human than you!

fields.EN:
I don't understand why you're
seemingly upset.
fields.JP:
なぜあなたがそんなに激昂するのか、
理解できないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand why you're
seemingly upset.

fields.EN: Hmm. So to Gretel, Hansel was like a servant? I wouldn't be particularly sad if one of my servants died either.
fields.JP:
ふーむ、つまりグレーテルにとって、
ヘンゼルは下僕のようなものだったということか？
ワレも、下僕が死んでも別に悲しまないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Hansel was more a subordinate
than a brother? I wouldn't be sad
if that was so, too.

fields.EN:
That's not true either. I suppose
what I feel is something
incomprehensible to others.
fields.JP:
……その感情とも違うと思うわ。
人には理解されない感情ということかしら。
もしくは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true either. I suppose
what I feel is something
incomprehensible to others.

fields.JP: あっ、言うだけ言って行っちゃった……
ハハハ！　相変わらずマイペースなのだな！

fields.EN:
(What in the world did I say to
her? She's as usual, and yet
I got angry over her demeanor.)
fields.JP:
（……でも、さすがに言いすぎたかな。
　グレーテルが変わってるのは今に始まったこと
　じゃないのに、ついカッとなっちゃった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the world did I say to
her? She's as usual, and yet
I got angry over her demeanor.)

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, Gretel-san doesn't seem sad about
Hansel-san's death, but I don't think that's
because she's cold-hearted.
fields.JP:
……おつうちゃん、グレーテルさんは
ヘンゼルさんの死を悲しんでいないみたいだけど、
それは冷たいからじゃないと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? It doesn't look like Gretel
is sad, but I don't think it's
because she's cold-hearted.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1; おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
Gretel-san just thinks differently from us.
She's actually a kind person.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんはわたしたちとは
違う考え方をしているだけで、
本当は優しい人なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's kind as anyone else, but
it's just that she thinks very
differently from us.

fields.EN:
What do you mean by that,
Princess?
fields.JP: 姫？　それってどういう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean by that,
Princess?

fields.JP: それはそうと、おつうちゃん
（あれ？　もしかして、怒ってる？）

fields.EN:
You could've worded yourself
better. That really came out bad.
fields.JP:
さっきの言い方はひどくなかった？
もっと違う言い方があったと思うんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could've worded yourself
better. That really came out bad.

fields.JP: う……それは自分でも思った。反省してる

fields.EN:
Well, make sure you say that
to her next time.
fields.JP: 今度会ったら、ちゃんと謝ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, make sure you say that
to her next time.

fields.EN:
What? You're already being
used and abused by Ningyohime?
fields.JP: なんだ、おつうは人魚姫の尻に敷かれてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You're already being
used and abused by Little Mermaid?

fields.JP: いや、そういうわけじゃ……

fields.EN:
Well, I don't know the details,
but... good luck!
fields.JP: まあよくわからんが、がんばるが良い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I don't know the details,
but... good luck!

fields.EN:
Haha... Um, thanks?
I guess I feel better now?
fields.JP:
はは、ありがとう……。
すごく薄い励ましだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha... Um, thanks?
I guess I feel better now?

fields.EN:
(But why did Gretel say what she
said? What does Princess mean
by saying Gretel is kind?)
fields.JP:
（……グレーテルはなんであんなことを
　言ったんだろう。それに、姫が言ってた
　本当は優しい人って、いったい……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But why did Gretel say what she
said? What does Princess mean
by saying Gretel is kind?)

fields.JP: （……なんだか、胸がもやもやする）

うーん、うーん……。
どう謝ればいいんだろう……

fields.EN:
"Gretel, I'm sorry about the
last time."
fields.JP: グレーテル、この間は悪かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Gretel, I'm sorry about the
last time."

fields.EN:
Mmm... That doesn't sound
right. Maybe a bit more casual...
fields.JP:
……うーん、なんか違う気がするな。
もっとこう、さらっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... That doesn't sound
right. Maybe a bit more casual...

fields.JP: グレーテル！　この間はごめん！

fields.EN:
Ugh, that won't work. It shouldn't
sound too casual... Something a
bit more heartfelt...
fields.JP:
あああ、絶対違う。
こんな軽い感じで言っちゃ駄目だよな……。
もっと真心を伝えられるような感じで、こう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, that won't work. It shouldn't
sound too casual... Something a
bit more heartfelt...

fields.JP: グレーテル。この間のことなんだけど

fields.EN:
That's quite rude, calling me
and being surprised seeing me.
fields.JP:
人の名前をぶつぶつ呼んでいたかと思えば、
急に驚いたりして。忙しい人ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite rude, calling me
and being surprised seeing me.

fields.JP:
（この間は言いすぎたと思って、
　地味にずっともやもやしてたんだよな。
　でも謝る練習を、まさか本人に見られるなんて）

fields.EN:
(Wh-What should I say?
I'm not ready to talk with her
yet...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんて切り出そう。
　まだ心の準備ができていないのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What should I say?
I'm not ready to talk with her
yet...)

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel? Uh, about the last
time... I'm sorry for what I said
then, so...
fields.JP:
あ、あのさ、グレーテル、そのー、
この間のことなんだけど、
悪かったなって反省してて、だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel? Uh, about the last
time... I'm sorry for what I said
then, so...

fields.EN:
Last time?
What are you talking about?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Last time?
What are you talking about?

fields.EN:
You know, when I ranted over
Hansel's death and how you
didn't seem like you cared.
fields.JP:
いや、だから、ヘンゼルが死んだのに
君が悲しんでなくて、
それを僕が責めちゃったことだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, when I ranted over
Hansel's death and how you
didn't seem like you cared.

fields.EN:
(That's it?! After all I was
worried about that's all she
has to say?!)
fields.JP:
（そ、そんなことって！
　こっちはずっともやもやしてたのに、
　すごくサラッと流された……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's it?! After all I was
worried about that's all she
has to say?!)

fields.EN:
I was actually thinking about
what you told me then.
fields.JP:
一応、あれからあなたの言い分のことも
考えてみたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was actually thinking about
what you told me then.

fields.EN:
Huh? You were?
I thought you didn't care.
fields.JP:
え……そうなのか？
どうでもいいのかと思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You were?
I thought you didn't care.

fields.EN:
Caring isn't the right term. I was
thinking of why I wasn't sad
over Hansel-niisan's death.
fields.JP:
無関心なわけではないから。
……なぜヘンゼル兄さんの死が悲しくないのか、
自分の感情を突き詰めて考えてみたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Caring isn't the right term. I was
thinking of why I wasn't sad
over Hansel's death.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
My analysis is that I wasn't sad
because I felt proud of
Hansel-niisan's death.
fields.JP:
その結果、私はヘンゼル兄さんの死を誇りに
思っているから、悲しくないのだ、とわかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My analysis is that I wasn't sad
because I felt proud of
Hansel's death.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Why yes. Death has little meaning
here, but he died with a purpose.
How can I not be proud?
fields.JP:
ええ。この監獄内で、ほとんどの死は意味を
持たない。だけどヘンゼル兄さんは意味のある
死を遂げた。それはとても誇らしいことだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. Death has little meaning
here, but he died with a purpose.
How can I not be proud?

fields.EN:
So my feeling of pride overcame
my feeling of sorrow,
or so I believe...
fields.JP:
だから、誇りはあっても悲しみはないの。
……少なくとも、自覚できるほどは
fields.LOCALIZED:
So my feeling of pride overcame
my feeling of sorrow,
or so I believe...

fields.EN:
(She values purpose over death
itself. I guess that's one way of
approaching death...)
fields.JP:
（死んだこと自体より、
　どう死んだかが大事なんだ。死に対して、
　そんな考え方もあるのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She values purpose over death
itself. I guess that's one way of
approaching death...)

fields.EN:
I doubt I could keep my composure
if he died without meaning. Not
that I can find out now, though.
fields.JP:
仮にヘンゼル兄さんが無駄死にしていたら、
私も冷静でいられたかはわからないわ。
仮定の話なんて、それこそ無意味だけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt I could keep my composure
if he died without meaning. Not
that I can find out now, though.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about the last time,
Gretel. I got all angry without
really understanding you.
fields.JP:
グレーテル……この間は悪かった。
君のことをなんにもわかっていなかったのに、
一方的に怒ったりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about the last time,
Gretel. I got all angry without
really understanding you.

fields.EN:
Not to worry. It was simply that
we didn't interface well then.
fields.JP:
構わないわ。意思の疎通がうまく
いかなかっただけのことだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to worry. It was simply that
we didn't interface well then.

fields.EN:
That said, I actually need to
apologize to you.
fields.JP: それより、私のほうこそごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I actually need to
apologize to you.

fields.JP: （あのグレーテルが、素直に謝った……！？）

fields.EN:
I wasn't able to properly orate my
feelings to you. Hence, it was my
fault we didn't interface well.
fields.JP:
この間は自分の感情をうまく言語化でき
なかったから。意思の疎通に齟齬が生じたのは、
私のせいだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't able to properly orate my
feelings to you. Hence, it was my
fault we didn't interface well.

fields.EN:
I thought I was observant, but
I suppose I still need to learn
how to properly relay my feelings.
fields.JP:
いろいろなことを観察しているつもりだけど、
自分の感情すら言語化できないようでは、
私もまだまだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I was observant, but
I suppose I still need to learn
how to properly relay my feelings.

fields.EN:
I can at least say I feel a lot
closer to you than before now.
fields.JP: ……なんだか、前より君と近づけた気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can at least say I feel a lot
closer to you than before now.

fields.EN:
Is that so? I can't fathom how
you can say that without proper
measurements.
fields.JP:
そう？　何センチ近づいたかなんて、
測らなければわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that so? I can't fathom how
you can say that without proper
measurements.

fields.EN:
Uh, that's not what I was driving
at, but... You're good as how
you are now.
fields.JP:
ははっ、そういうことじゃないよ。
……でも、そういう君でいいんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's not what I was driving
at, but... You're good as how
you are now.

fields.EN: Hm? Well, if you say so.
fields.JP: ？　あなたがいいなら、それでいいけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Well, if you say so.

fields.EN:
(I sort of understand what
Princess meant when she said that
Gretel is kind.)
fields.JP:
（あのとき姫が、グレーテルは優しい人
　だって言った理由が、わかった気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sort of understand what
Princess meant when she said that
Gretel is kind.)

fields.EN:
(Don't worry, Hansel.
We'll be here by Gretel's side...)
fields.JP:
（ヘンゼル、グレーテルには僕達がついてるから、
　安心してくれ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't worry, Hansel.
We'll be here by Gretel's side...)

fields.EN: Gretel, do you have a moment?
fields.JP: グレーテル、ちょっといいかい
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel, do you have a moment?

fields.EN:
I would have appreciated it if
you would have let me answer
you before you opened the door.
fields.JP:
……せめてこちらの応答を待ってから
扉を開けてほしかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would have appreciated it if
you would have let me answer
you before you opened the door.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I did knock before
coming in... So, do you have
some time to spare?
fields.JP:
ごめん。でもノックはしたよ。
今、時間はあるかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I did knock before
coming in... So, do you have
some time to spare?

fields.EN:
I was busy reading, so maybe
tomorrow.
fields.JP:
今は読書に集中したいんだけど。
また後日にしてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was busy reading, so maybe
tomorrow.

fields.EN:
Oh, really? That's too bad.
I just came to share some sweets
that I happened to get.
fields.JP:
そうか、もったいないなぁ。
せっかくお菓子が手に入ったから、
お土産に持って来たのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really? That's too bad.
I just came to share some sweets
that I happened to get.

fields.EN:
Now, where are the sweets?
You brought them here for me, yes?
fields.JP:
さあ、お菓子を早く。
私へのお土産なんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, where are the sweets?
You brought them here for me, yes?

fields.EN:
*munch* *munch*
Mmm... This tastes good.
Thank you, Tsuu.
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……ごっくん。
はぁ、おいしかった……。
ありがとう、つう
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* *munch*
Mmm... This tastes good.
Thank you, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Well, I did owe you. I have to
say I'll never get bored looking
at you eat so happily.
fields.JP:
まあ、貸し、だからね。
っていうか君、お菓子食べるときは本当に
幸せそうだなぁ。見ていて飽きないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I did owe you. I have to
say I'll never get bored looking
at you eat so happily.

fields.EN:
Oh? My exact same sentiments
to you.
fields.JP: あら、見ていて飽きないのはあなたのほうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? My exact same sentiments
to you.

fields.EN:
I find it quite interesting
observing your relationship with
Ningyohime, but...
fields.JP:
そう、あなた。
人魚姫との関係も興味があるけれど、
それよりも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find it quite interesting
observing your relationship with
Little Mermaid, but...

fields.EN:
I'm just as interested in how you
are able to read a Nightmare's
feelings.
fields.JP:
あなたはなぜナイトメアの感情がわかるのかしら。
私でさえヘンゼル兄さんの感情は
わからなかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just as interested in how you
are able to read a Nightmare's
feelings.

fields.EN: And by reading the books called 'fairy tales' that relate to us, I can understand the reasons behind the Libidos of various Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
それに、私たちに関係する『童話』と
呼ばれる書物を読むと、様々な血式少女の
リビドーの理由がわかるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, reading the many fairytales
have made me understand the
reasons behind our libido.

fields.EN:
But in your case, you don't have
any real Blood Libido... I suppose
"marriage" may be yours, but...
fields.JP:
それなのに、あなただけは血式リビドーが
ないに等しい……。辛うじて、『お嫁さん』
という想いはあったようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But in your case, you don't have
any real Blood Libido... I suppose
"marriage" may be yours, but...

fields.EN:
You got it wrong, Gretel.
I do have a Blood Libido.
It's "repayment."
fields.JP:
……違うよ、グレーテル。
僕にもちゃんと血式リビドーがある。
……『恩返し』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it wrong, Gretel.
I do have a Blood Libido.
It's "repayment."

fields.EN:
I can feel myself getting tense
each time my urge to repay what
I owe rises...
fields.JP:
僕は恩返しをしたいというリビドーがあるけれど、
それを考えると動悸が激しくなるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can feel myself getting tense
each time my urge to repay what
I owe rises...

fields.EN:
That's why I keep saying that I
"owe" someone. That way, I can
"repay" the person later.
fields.JP:
だから誰かに感謝されたときは『貸し』だと
あらかじめ宣言しておいて、いざ恩を感じたときは
『貸しを返された』って考えるようにしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I keep saying that I
"owe" someone. That way, I can
"repay" the person later.

fields.EN:
I see. So that's why you told me
that you "owed" me one earlier.
Very interesting indeed...
fields.JP:
だからさっきも、『貸し』だと強調していたのね。
ややこしい精神構造だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So that's why you told me
that you "owed" me one earlier.
Very interesting indeed...

fields.EN:
That's the only way it feels
like I repaid what was due
properly.
fields.JP:
でも、恩を感じないようにするには
そうするしかないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the only way it feels
like I repaid what was due
properly.

fields.EN:
But in the story, "The Grateful
Crane," the crane showed its true
form while repaying...
fields.JP:
それにしても、まだわからないことがあるわ。
鶴の恩返しの話では、『恩返し』のために
本性をさらけ出すことになっているけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But in the story, "The Grateful
Crane," the crane showed its true
form while repaying...

fields.EN:
If so, do you have a "true form"
that lies inside you?
fields.JP:
あなたの『本性』……そんなものが
あるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, do you have a "true form"
that lies inside you?

fields.JP: あはは、どうなんだろう……

fields.EN:
One other thing. You seem overly
attracted to Ningyohime for
no apparent reason.
fields.JP:
それにあなたは、客観的に納得できる理由なく
人魚姫に執着しているように見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One other thing. You seem overly
attracted to Little Mermaid for
no apparent reason.

fields.EN:
I feel as if I can learn your true
nature if I research on your
attachment to Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
ない、なんて言い切れる？　人魚姫への執着、
その辺りを詳しく調べていけば、あなたの本質を
知ることに繋がるんじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel as if I can learn your true
nature if I research on your
attachment to Little Mermaid.

fields.JP: 考えただけで、わくわくするわ

fields.EN:
(I'm attached to Princess?
My true nature? Is there something
about me that I don't know of?)
fields.JP:
（僕は人魚姫に執着している？
　それに、僕の本質って？
　……僕が知らない僕がいるということなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm attached to Princess?
My true nature? Is there something
about me that I don't know of?)

fields.JP: （なんだか、嫌だな。気味が悪い……）

fields.EN:
My attachment to her is based
on love, that's all...
fields.JP:
その……人魚姫への気持ちは、『愛』なんだよ。
執着じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
My attachment to her is based
on love, that's all...

fields.EN:
Love has no reason.
There is no reason needed to love.
fields.JP:
たしかにこの気持ちに理由はないけれど、
だからこそ『愛』なんだ。
誰かを愛するのに理由なんて必要ないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Love has no reason.
There is no reason needed to love.

fields.EN:
Hm... I don't understand that
emotion well, but that is quite
intriguing.
fields.JP:
ふぅん……？
私にはよくわからない感情だけど、
それも含めて興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I don't understand that
emotion well, but that is quite
intriguing.

fields.EN:
Heh... I guess anything can be
intriguing to you...
fields.JP:
ははは、君にとってはなんでも
研究対象になっちゃうんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I guess anything can be
intriguing to you...

fields.EN:
(Love... My feelings towards
Princess is love, right?)
fields.JP:
（……『愛』か。人魚姫に対するこの気持ちは、
　本当に『愛』……なんだよな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Love... My feelings towards
Princess is love, right?)

fields.EN: How much longer will this take?
fields.JP: いつまで悩んでいるつもり？
fields.LOCALIZED: How much longer will this take?

fields.JP:
せ、急かすんじゃない！
今考えているところだ！

fields.EN:
(Hm? Gretel and Hameln?
What are they doing there?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　グレーテルとハーメルンだ。
　テーブル挟んでなにをしてるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Gretel and Hameln?
What are they doing there?)

fields.EN:
You don't have any other place
to put your stone. The whole
board is white already.
fields.JP:
もう石を打てる場所もほとんどないわよ。
盤上が真っ白けね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have any other place
to put your stone. The whole
board is white already.

fields.EN:
I-I'm not giving up until the
very end!
fields.JP:
そ、それでも最後までワレは
勝負を投げたりしないんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not giving up until the
very end!

fields.EN:
(They're just playing Othello...
Where did they find it anyway?)
fields.JP:
（ああ、オセロをしてるのか。
　どこかから見つけてきたんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're just playing Othello...
Where did they find it anyway?)

fields.JP: うーん、うーん……よし、ここだ！

fields.EN:
Hahaha! How's that?!
I made a whole lot black!
fields.JP:
ふっふっふ、どうだ！
たくさん黒にひっくり返してやったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! How's that?!
I made a whole lot black!

fields.EN: Then I'll place a white piece here...
fields.JP: なら、私はここに白を打って、と……

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem like you have
any other place to put your stone
so I guess I'll keep going.
fields.JP:
次はあなたの番だけど、
打てる場所がないから、
また私の番になるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem like you have
any other place to put your stone
so I guess I'll keep going.

fields.JP: のおおぉお！？　な、なんたることだ！！

fields.EN:
And... there. I win again.
That makes it ten wins in a row.
fields.JP: はい、おしまい。これで私の十戦十勝ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... there. I win again.
That makes it ten wins in a row.

fields.EN:
Ngh! Why are you so good at this?!
Wait! You're not cheating,
are you?!
fields.JP:
うぐぐ、貴様、なぜそんなに強いのだ。
なにかズルをしてるのではあるまいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ngh! Why are you so good at this?!
Wait! You're not cheating,
are you?!

fields.EN:
Cheat? I doubt that, especially
when I've handicapped myself
by giving you the four corners.
fields.JP:
あら、ズルなんてしてないわ。
むしろ最初に四隅にあなたの黒石を置いて、
ハンデまでつけてあげたじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cheat? I doubt that, especially
when I've handicapped myself
by giving you the four corners.

fields.JP: ……ということは、どういうことなのだ？
単純にあなたが弱いということじゃない？

fields.EN:
(I can hear Hameln taking damage
inside her body...)
fields.JP: （あ。ハーメルンの心が血を吐いた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can hear Hameln taking damage
inside her body...)

fields.EN:
F-Fine... So I'm weak at this
game... I suppose I have to
accept that.
fields.JP:
はあ、はあ、いや、たしかに
この白黒ゲームにおいては、ワレは弱い。
それは素直に認めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine... So I'm weak at this
game... I suppose I have to
accept that.

fields.EN:
But, why am I so weak? Why
can't I beat you? How can I get
better at this game?!
fields.JP:
だが、なぜこんなにも弱いのだ？
なぜ貴様には勝てないのだ？
ワレはどうすれば強くなれるのだ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, why am I so weak? Why
can't I beat you? How can I get
better at this game?!

fields.EN:
Simple. You're weak because
you're not thinking about your
next move.
fields.JP:
答えは簡単よ。
あなたは先のことを考えずに
石を打っているから弱いの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simple. You're weak because
you're not thinking about your
next move.

fields.EN:
But I am! Like, where I can
place my stone to flip as
many of them as possible!
fields.JP:
先のことなら考えているぞ。
どこに置けば何個ひっくり返せるかとな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I am! Like, where I can
place my stone to flip as
many of them as possible!

fields.EN:
You only put them where you can
flip numbers. You need to think
steps ahead of just one move.
fields.JP:
それよ、弱い理由は。あなたはそのとき
一番多くの石を返せる場所に打つでしょ。
何手も先を読まなければ勝てないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You only put them where you can
flip numbers. You need to think
steps ahead of just one move.

fields.EN:
Remember how you lost turns
because you couldn't place
your stones?
fields.JP:
さっきもそうだったけれど、
あなた、対戦中に何度も打てる場所が
なくなるときがあったでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember how you lost turns
because you couldn't place
your stones?

fields.EN:
I simply read where you and
I would place our stones, and
moved in a way you lose turns.
fields.JP:
たとえば、「ここに打ったら、次はこう
打たれるかもしれない。そうすれば次に
自分が打てる場所がなくなる」と予測するの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I simply read where you and
I would place our stones, and
moved in a way you lose turns.

fields.EN:
If you do the same, you should
do much better.
fields.JP:
そうしていけば、さっきみたいな失敗は
しなくなるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you do the same, you should
do much better.

fields.JP: おおっ、なるほど！　貴様、すごいな！

fields.EN:
I'm not sharing anything
special in particular...
fields.JP: これくらいは普通でしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sharing anything
special in particular...

fields.JP: オセロ師匠と呼んでもよいか！？

fields.EN:
So all I need to do is watch
out! Haha! I demand a rematch,
Gretel!
fields.JP:
よし、そこさえ注意すればワレが
恐れるものなどなにもない！
グレーテル、貴様に再戦を申し込む！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So all I need to do is watch
out! Haha! I demand a rematch,
Gretel!

fields.JP: 受けて立つわ。どうせまた私が勝つけれど

fields.EN:
(It looks like Gretel is having
fun. Those two actually pair
well together...)
fields.JP:
（……グレーテル、なんだかんだ言って
　けっこう楽しそうだな。
　あの二人、意外に仲が良いのかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like Gretel is having
fun. Those two actually pair
well together...)

fields.EN:
(I feel a bit sorry for Hameln,
though. I don't see her winning
against Gretel at all...)
fields.JP:
（でもハーメルンは百戦してもグレーテルに
　勝てないだろうな。そう思うとちょっと
　不憫だけど、まぁ、いいか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel a bit sorry for Hameln,
though. I don't see her winning
against Gretel at all...)

fields.JP:
あれ、グレーテル？
なんか様子が……

グレーテルさん？
そんなにフラフラして、大丈夫？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: いや、全然大丈夫って感じじゃないよ

fields.EN:
Look at you... You're all pale.
Are you sure you're...?
fields.JP: それに顔色も悪いわ。無理してるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at you... You're all pale.
Are you sure you're...?

fields.EN:
I'm fine.
Please... leave me alone...
fields.JP:
大丈夫だと……言っているでしょ。
……放っておい……て
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine.
Please... leave me alone...

fields.EN:
Gretel-san?!
G-Get a hold of yourself!
fields.JP: グレーテルさん！？　た、倒れちゃった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel?!
G-Get a hold of yourself!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
What's with the commotion?
Is something the matter?
fields.JP: 騒がしいですわね。なにかありましたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with the commotion?
Is something the matter?

fields.EN:
Gretel-san looks really sick...
She just fell over just now.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんが具合悪いみたいで、
急に倒れちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel looks really sick...
She just fell over just now.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Oh my, that's not good!
We should take her to her room!
fields.JP:
まあ、大変ですわ！
早く部屋にお連れしないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, that's not good!
We should take her to her room!

fields.EN:
Right. Will you help us carry Gretel-san to her
room?
fields.JP:
そうね。グレーテルさんの部屋まで運ぶの、
手伝ってくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind helping us carry
her to her room?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: あ、目を覚ましましたわ

fields.EN:
I'm... in my room?
Why are you all here?
fields.JP: ここは……私の部屋？　なぜあなたたちが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm... in my room?
Why are you all here?

fields.EN: Gretel-san, you collapsed in the hallway.
fields.JP: グレーテルさん、廊下で倒れちゃったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You lost consciousness
in the hallway.

fields.EN:
Otsuu, Alice, and myself found
you and brought you here.
fields.JP:
そこにわたしが通りかかって、
おつうとアリスの三人がかりで
運んであげましたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, Alice, and myself found
you and brought you here.

fields.EN:
It was a good thing you came
by, Cinderella.
fields.JP: シンデレラが来てくれて助かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a good thing you came
by, Cinderella.

fields.EN:
Yes, it would've been a bit
difficult with just me and Otsuu-san.
fields.JP:
そうね。おつうさんとわたしの二人だけじゃ
ちょっと大変だったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it would've been a bit
difficult with just me and Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
I see...
I'm sorry for the bother.
fields.JP: そうだったの……。迷惑をかけたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
I'm sorry for the bother.

fields.JP: 体調はもういいんですの？

fields.EN:
Why yes, I feel much better now
that I had time to rest.
fields.JP:
ええ、しばらく横になったおかげで、
だいぶ元気よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I feel much better now
that I had time to rest.

fields.EN:
You surprised us when you just
fell back there.
So, what happened?
fields.JP:
だけど、びっくりしたわ。
突然倒れるんだもの。どうしてあんな
ふらふらな状態になっていたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You surprised us when you just
fell back there.
So, what happened?

fields.EN:
I was conducting research for
two days straight without sleep.
fields.JP:
……つい、研究に没頭してしまったの。
二日ほど連続で徹夜してしまったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was conducting research for
two days straight without sleep.

fields.EN:
Just hearing that is making
me feel tired already...
fields.JP:
聞いただけで、眠くなって
しまいそうですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just hearing that is making
me feel tired already...

fields.EN:
I went to the cafeteria to get a
bite, but I suppose I passed out
on my way back here.
fields.JP:
徹夜明けでなんとか食堂で軽食をとったあと、
部屋に戻ろうとして、力尽きてしまった
というわけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I went to the cafeteria to get a
bite, but I suppose I passed out
on my way back here.

fields.EN:
I need to learn what my limits
are. This was a nice case sample
to experience.
fields.JP:
自分の限界というものを的確に
把握していなければならないということね。
いい勉強になったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to learn what my limits
are. This was a nice case sample
to experience.

fields.JP: （またずいぶん淡々と言うなぁ……）

fields.EN:
That's so you, Gretel-san.
Well, I'm just glad you're feeling
better now.
fields.JP:
まったく、グレーテルさんらしいわ。
まぁ、元気そうでホッとしたけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's so you, Gretel.
Well, I'm just glad you're feeling
better now.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
For a second there I thought you
were badly ill. Well, it's good
it wasn't anything terrible.
fields.JP:
拍子抜けですわね。
悪い病気だったらどうしようかと
思いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For a second there I thought you
were badly ill. Well, it's good
it wasn't anything terrible.

fields.JP: うん。大したことなくてよかった

fields.EN:
Hm?
Why are you all seemingly
relieved?
fields.JP: ？　あなたたちは安堵しているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm?
Why are you all seemingly
relieved?

fields.EN:
That's because we were worried
about you, of course.
fields.JP: 当たり前ですわ。心配しましたもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because we were worried
about you, of course.

fields.EN:
Gretel-san?
You still don't seem well...
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん？
やっぱりまだ具合が悪いんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel?
You still don't seem well...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
No, I'm fine. It was just that
your reactions were unexpected
with how worried you all were.
fields.JP:
いえ、大丈夫よ。
……ただ、意外だっただけ。
あなたたちは私を心配したのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine. It was just that
your reactions were unexpected
with how worried you all were.

fields.EN:
Wait. You didn't know we
were worried about you?
fields.JP: もしかして、わかってなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. You didn't know we
were worried about you?

fields.JP: ええ。でもようやく気づいたわ

fields.EN:
Most people would know that
naturally... You really are
a strange one.
fields.JP:
普通、すぐわかることですわよ。
やっぱり変わり者ですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most people would know that
naturally... You really are
a strange one.

fields.EN:
I heard worry can take a toll
on one's body.
fields.JP:
心配という感情は、心の負担になり、
肉体にも悪影響を及ぼすと聞いたことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard worry can take a toll
on one's body.

fields.EN:
Which means I caused harm
to you all by making you all
worried. I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
私のせいで、あなたたちの心に
負担をかけてしまったということね。
……ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means I caused harm
to you all by making you all
worried. I'm sorry...

fields.JP: あのグレーテルさんが……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
I hope this isn't a bad
omen to come...
fields.JP: 空から槍が降るかもな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope this isn't a bad
omen to come...

fields.EN:
That sounded rude...
I do apologize if I feel
I am in the wrong.
fields.JP:
なにやら失礼な物言いをされた
気がするけれど。私だって、
悪いと思えば謝罪くらいするわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounded rude...
I do apologize if I feel
I am in the wrong.

fields.EN:
Gretel is... quite unique,
isn't she?
fields.JP:
……グレーテルって、けっこう
面白い方ですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel is... quite unique,
isn't she?

fields.EN:
Unique? I wasn't necessarily
joking there.
fields.JP:
それは私がユニークだということ？
私はジョークを言ったつもりはないわよ

Okay. So Fishy not a fish...
She flower and cake!

fields.EN: So, I can eat her if she cake?
fields.JP: おかしだったら、たべていい？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, I can eat her if she cake?

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
Rapu-chan is a nice girl.
fields.JP: ふふ、ラプちゃんは素直な子だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
Rappy is a nice girl.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I know her youth is contributing
to her naivety, but that making
her hungry isn't a good thing...
fields.JP:
言葉をそのまま真に受けてしまうのは
幼いから仕方ないにしても、
欲望に忠実なのは困ったものだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know her youth is contributing
to her naivety, but that making
her hungry isn't a good thing...

fields.EN:
Well, all we need to do is
to teach her things.
fields.JP:
わたしたちで、これからいろいろ
教えてあげればいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all we need to do is
to teach her things.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right, Princess.
It won't be easy, but we'll have
to do our best.
fields.JP:
そうだね、姫。
大変そうだけど、地道にやるしかなさそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right, Princess.
It won't be easy, but we'll have
to do our best.

fields.JP: ねーねー、おしえておしえてーー！
ねーねーヒカリン、ねーってばーー！！
こんにちは、ラプちゃん、ヒカリちゃん
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I see Rapunzel is causing a
commotion, but is there a problem?
fields.JP: ラプンツェルが騒いでるけど、どうかしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see Rapunzel is causing a
commotion, but is there a problem?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-kun! Ningyohime!
Perfect timing!
Can you two help?
fields.JP:
ああ、おつうくん、人魚姫！
いいところに来てくれた。
ちょっと助けてほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Little Mermaid!
Perfect timing!
Can you two help?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Otsuu? Ningyo?
Know how to make babies?
fields.JP:
おつうとにんぎょは、
こどものつくりかた、しってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? Fishy?
Know how to make babies?

fields.EN:
Oh, I see... Hikari-chan, Rapu-chan asked you
"the" question, so you're in a pickle, right?
fields.JP:
あー、なるほど。
ヒカリちゃんはラプちゃんにそれを聞かれて、
困ってたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see... Rappy's asking you
"the" question, so you're in a
pickle, right?

fields.EN:
She was bound to ask it at some point.
It's also the one question that
adults have problems answering.
fields.JP:
小さい子どもが一度は聞いてくる質問だね。
周囲の大人はいかに答えるかで
頭を悩ませるわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was bound to ask it at some point.
It's also the one question that
adults have problems answering.

fields.EN:
She keeps bugging me about it.
Any thoughts?
fields.JP:
しつこく聞かれて、困っちゃって。
なんて教えればいいと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She keeps bugging me about it.
Any thoughts?

fields.EN:
Um, Rapunzel wanna make babies.
How make babies?
fields.JP:
ねー、ラプンツェル、こどもつくりたいんだ。
どうやったらつくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Rapunzel wanna make babies.
How make babies?

fields.JP: ……ラプンツェルが？　子どもを？

fields.EN:
(That's right... I forgot her
Blood Libido was her want of
making babies herself. Hm...)
fields.JP:
（そ、そうだった。子どもを作りたい
　っていうのがラプンツェルの
　血式リビドーだったっけ。うーん……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right... I forgot her
Blood Libido was her want of
making babies herself. Hm...)

fields.JP: ……赤ちゃんは、コウノトリが運んでくるんだよ

fields.EN:
(Well, there goes the truth...
She'll find out eventually,
so that should work for now.)
fields.JP:
（安直な嘘をついてしまった……。
　でもラプンツェルもいつかは真実を知る
　だろうし、今はこう言っておいてもいいよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, there goes the truth...
She'll find out eventually,
so that should work for now.)

fields.EN: Yes, storks bring babies to us.
fields.JP:
うん。赤ちゃんはみんな、
そうして生まれてくるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, storks bring babies to us.

fields.EN:
Ooh! So storks won't drop
babies when they fly?
fields.JP:
へーー！　でも、コウノトリは
あかちゃんおとさないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! So storks won't drop
babies when they fly?

fields.JP: （な、なんでそんなところだけ現実的なんだ？）

fields.EN:
Uh, storks are... very strong,
so they can handle.
fields.JP: あー、コウノトリは力持ちだから大丈夫なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, storks are... very strong,
so they can handle.

fields.EN:
Ooh! Storks super!
So stork come to Rapunzel, too?
fields.JP:
へーー！　コウノトリってすごいね！
じゃあ、ラプンツェルのところにも来るかな、
コウノトリ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Storks super!
So stork come to Rapunzel, too?

fields.EN:
If you're a good girl then maybe
it'll come when you're an adult.
fields.JP:
いい子にしていたら、いつか……
大人になったころに、来るんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're a good girl then maybe
it'll come when you're an adult.

fields.EN:
Yaaay!
I be good girl then!
fields.JP:
わあーーい！
それじゃあ、いい子にしてるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yaaay!
I be good girl then!

fields.JP: ほっ、なんとか誤魔化せた……
おつうちゃん、お疲れ様
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうくん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun

fields.JP: それはあり得ないわね

fields.EN:
G-Gretel-san?
You heard what she said?
fields.JP:
グ、グレーテルさん？
話聞いてたんですか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
G-Gretel?
You heard what she said?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: ぐれー、ありえないって、なにが？
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
I'm referring to how a stork
brings babies.
fields.JP:
コウノトリが赤ちゃんを運んでくる
という話よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm referring to how a stork
brings babies.

fields.EN:
H-Hey, Gretel!
What are you doing?!
fields.JP: ちょ、グレーテル！　余計なことは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, Gretel!
What are you doing?!

fields.EN: Extra? I only told the truth. No matter how you look at it, the idea that storks bring babies leaves nothing but questions.
fields.JP:
余計なこと？　私は本当のことを言ったまでよ。
コウノトリが赤ちゃんを運んでくるだなんて、
あらゆる角度から考察しても疑問しか残らないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just going to share the facts.
Storks bringing babies is
simply illogical.

fields.EN:
Really?
So, where babies come from?
How you make babies?
fields.JP:
そうなの……？
それじゃあ、あかちゃんはどこからくるの？
どうやったらこどもができるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?
So, where babies come from?
How you make babies?

fields.EN:
Ah, a question in relation to
reproduction. First, you need
a male and female to...
fields.JP:
生殖についての質問ということね。
まず、男性器を女性器に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, a question in relation to
reproduction. First, you need
a male and female to...

fields.EN:
Whoa! Stop it right there!
Too much info!
fields.JP: わああっ、そこまで！　それ以上は言うな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Stop it right there!
Too much info!

fields.EN:
She doesn't need to know this!
Not now!
fields.JP: なんでそんなに本気で説明しようとするの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't need to know this!
Not now!

fields.EN:
She has the right to know the
truth. Why are you all hiding the
truth from her?
fields.JP:
真実を説明するのに理由なんていらないわ。
あなたたちこそ、なぜ本当のことを
説明しないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has the right to know the
truth. Why are you all hiding the
truth from her?

fields.EN:
(Gretel doesn't see our reason
of why we're avoiding the
subject...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、そうか。グレーテル的には、
　そもそもどうして僕達が子どもの作り方を
　隠そうとしているのかが理解できないのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel doesn't see our reason
of why we're avoiding the
subject...)

fields.EN:
Uh... It's because acquiring
knowledge has its steps.
fields.JP:
……あー、ほら、知識を得るには
順序も大切だからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... It's because acquiring
knowledge has its steps.

fields.EN:
It wouldn't make sense to teach
something without the proper
foundation, right?
fields.JP:
なんの予備知識もなしに
いきなり難しいことを教えたら、
かえって混乱するだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wouldn't make sense to teach
something without the proper
foundation, right?

fields.EN:
Making babies is a complex matter,
so she'd understand better once
she's old enough to understand.
fields.JP:
子どもの作り方はある意味複雑な話だから、
もう少し大人になってからのほうが
よく理解できると思うんだ。うん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Making babies is a complex matter,
so she'd understand better once
she's old enough to understand.

fields.EN:
You're right. It is quite possible
she would be confused without
the proper biological knowledge.
fields.JP:
……たしかに一理あるわね。
あらかじめ生物学的な知識がなければ、
混乱が生じてしまう可能性があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. It is quite possible
she would be confused without
the proper biological knowledge.

fields.EN:
Which would mean that it will
prove better for her future
to not know the details yet.
fields.JP:
将来のより深い理解のために、
今はあえて教えないということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which would mean that it will
prove better for her future
to not know the details yet.

fields.EN:
Say, stork not right?
So, how you make babies?
fields.JP:
ねー、コウノトリもちがうの？
だったら、こどもってどうやったらつくれるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, stork not right?
So, how you make babies?

fields.JP:
ううーーーー！！
ラプンツェル、ほんとのほんとに、
こどもつくりたいのにーー！！

fields.EN:
Uh, what should we do?
I thought we got through this
too and then...
fields.JP:
ああ、どうしよう。
せっかく納得しかけてくれたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, what should we do?
I thought we got through this
too and then...

fields.EN:
We can't rely on the stork story
anymore...
fields.JP: コウノトリの話は、もう使えないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't rely on the stork story
anymore...

fields.EN:
Wanting to make babies...
What a troublesome Blood
Libido to have...
fields.JP:
子どもを作りたいって、
なんて厄介な血式リビドーなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanting to make babies...
What a troublesome Blood
Libido to have...

fields.EN:
Her hair is a lot cleaner now.
I remember how hard it was
just to comb her.
fields.JP:
髪、ずいぶんきれいになってきたね。
梳かし始めは大変だったっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her hair is a lot cleaner now.
I remember how hard it was
just to comb her.

fields.EN:
We're almost done, so just
stay with it a bit longer, okay?
fields.JP: もうすぐ終わるから、大人しくしてるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're almost done, so just
stay with it a bit longer, okay?

fields.EN:
That's unusual...
Are you cleaning her hair?
fields.JP:
あれ、珍しいね。
ラプちゃんの髪を梳かしてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's unusual...
Are you cleaning her hair?

fields.EN:
Well, her hair was kinked and
tangled, so we're just combing
her now.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの髪がすごく絡まってたから、
梳かしてあげることにしたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, her hair was kinked and
tangled, so we're just combing
her now.

fields.EN:
You can't imagine how hard it is
to comb her long hair. Thankfully,
she's been patient with us.
fields.JP:
長いから大変だよ。
でも本人が大人しくしてくれるから、助かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't imagine how hard it is
to comb her long hair. Thankfully,
she's been patient with us.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's long hair important.
I need it clean, so I do my best.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、ながいかみ、だいじ。
だからきれいになるの、がんばる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's long hair important.
I need it clean, so I do my best.

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry!
Looks like you got a kink here...
fields.JP: あ、ごめん！　櫛が引っかかっちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry!
Looks like you got a kink here...

fields.EN:
I'm okay...
Make hair plenty clean for me.
fields.JP:
……へいき。
だから、もっときれいきれい、して？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm okay...
Make hair plenty clean for me.

fields.EN:
You got it!
I'll be a bit more careful.
fields.JP: わかった。あたしももっと気をつけて梳かすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it!
I'll be a bit more careful.

fields.EN:
Well now, that's good you're
able to keep in the pain.
fields.JP: へぇ、痛くても我慢するなんて偉いな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well now, that's good you're
able to keep in the pain.

fields.EN:
Heh heh!
First time get hair combed.
So happy hair getting pretty.
fields.JP:
えへへ……。
くしでかみとかすの、はじめて。
きれいになるの、うれしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh!
First time get hair combed.
So happy hair getting pretty.

fields.EN:
Huh? Wait a minute...
So how were you keeping your
hair clean all this time?
fields.JP:
え？　それじゃあラプちゃん、
今までは髪をどうしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Wait a minute...
So how were you keeping your
hair clean all this time?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel make clean with
spit. All pretty.
fields.JP:
じぶんできれいにしてた。
つばつけて、きれいきれいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel make clean with
spit. All pretty.

fields.EN:
S-Spit?
That sounds just like what a
cat would do...
fields.JP:
つ、つばで？
そんな、猫じゃないんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Spit?
That sounds just like what a
cat would do...

fields.EN:
Hahaha!
You really are the wild one!
fields.JP: ははっ、本当に野生児だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha!
You really are the wild one!

fields.EN:
Rapunzel hair important.
I wanna make hair longer.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのかみ、すごーくだいじ。
もっとながーく、のばすんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel hair important.
I wanna make hair longer.

fields.EN: It's long enough as it is.
fields.JP: 今でも十分長いじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED: It's long enough as it is.

fields.EN:
Nope! More long!
I need hair for babies!
fields.JP:
ううん、もっとながくするの！
いつかこどもをつくるのに、いるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope! More long!
I need hair for babies!

fields.EN:
You need your hair for babies...?
I'm not getting you.
fields.JP:
子どもを作るのに必要……？
どういうことだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need your hair for babies...?
I'm not getting you.

fields.EN:
Someone gonna use this hair
to make babies with Rapunzel!
I think...
fields.JP:
いつかだれかが、このかみをつかって、
ラプンツェルとこどもをつくってくれるの！
……そんなきがするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Someone gonna use my hair
to make babies with me!
I think...
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_24287.

fields.EN:
(I don't understand what
she's saying, but I guess that's
part of her Blood Libido...)
fields.JP:
（よくわからないけど、
　それも血式リビドーなのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't understand what
she's saying, but I guess that's
part of her Blood Libido...)

fields.EN:
Hm, so your hair is something
really important to you then.
fields.JP:
