ふぅん？　とにかく、髪は君にとって
すごく大事なものなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, so your hair is something
really important to you then.

fields.EN:
I guess that also means that
she's a lot more used to
us now, letting us touch her hair.
fields.JP:
そんな大事な髪を任せてくれるなんて、
私たちにもずいぶん慣れてくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess that also means that
she's a lot more used to
us now, letting us touch her hair.

fields.EN:
Heh, I guess we should feel
honored.
fields.JP: まったくだ。光栄なことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, I guess we should feel
honored.

fields.EN:
You're such a good girl staying
still the whole time. Look...
Your hair is nice and pretty now.
fields.JP:
よく大人しくしてたね。
ほら、髪が見違えるようにきれいになったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're such a good girl staying
still the whole time. Look...
Your hair is nice and pretty now.

fields.JP: わーい！　ありがとーーーー！！

fields.EN:
Do you mind if we touch your
hair?
fields.JP: わたしたちも触っていい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind if we touch your
hair?

fields.EN:
Wow! It's soooo smooth!
And soft, too!
fields.JP:
わあ、すごくさらさら！
それでいてふんわりしていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow! It's soooo smooth!
And soft, too!

fields.EN:
It feels really good!
Your hair is so beautiful.
fields.JP:
すごくいい手触りだな！
ラプンツェルってこんなにきれいな髪だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels really good!
Your hair is so beautiful.

fields.EN:
(Look at her blush...
She's just like any other girl
caring for their hair.)
fields.JP:
（珍しくて照れてるみたいだ。
　なんだかいつもより女の子らしく見えるな。
　髪は女の命、ってことかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at her blush...
She's just like any other girl
caring for their hair.)

fields.JP: うーー！　ひどいひどいー！！
あ、あの、申し訳ございませんですわ

fields.EN: What are you two fighting about?
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you two fighting about?

fields.EN:
Well, it seems as if I angered
Rapu.
fields.JP:
それが、その、わたしがラプを
怒らせてしまったのですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it seems as if I angered
Rappy.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Cinderella so mean!
She said cut Rapunzel's hair!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ひどいんだよ！
ラプンツェルのかみ、きれっていうの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella so mean!
She said cut my hair!
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_24307.

fields.EN:
I just thought she would look
cute with shorter hair...
fields.JP: でも、そのほうがかわいいと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just thought she would look
cute with shorter hair...

fields.EN:
No! Rapunzel hair important!
Cut my hair so mean!
You meanie!
fields.JP:
そんなのしらない！
ラプンツェルのかみ、だいじ！　きれなんて、
ひどいひどいひどいーーーー！！！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Rapunzel hair important!
Cut my hair so mean!
You meanie!

fields.JP: シンデレラの、ばかーーーー！！！！
ラプンツェル！　そこまで言うことないだろ？
待って、シンデレラ！　ああ、行っちゃった……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, you didn't need to
say that. Cinderella was
apologizing.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、シンデレラは
謝ってたじゃないか。それなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, you didn't need to
say that. Cinderella was
apologizing.

fields.EN: Wha-?! Wh-Why am I about to cry too?
fields.JP:
うわ、な、なんでこっちまで
泣きそうになってるんだ？
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ラプンツェルのこと、
きらいになっちゃったよね……

fields.EN:
(She's sad that Cinderella hates
her now? Well, she shouldn't have
said what she said earlier.)
fields.JP:
（愛想をつかされたと思って、
　泣きそうになってるのか。だったら最初から
　あんな態度とらなきゃいいのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's sad that Cinderella hates
her now? Well, she shouldn't have
said what she said earlier.)

fields.EN:
Rapu, you do know that Cinderella
didn't suggest you to cut your
hair because she hates you, right?
fields.JP:
ラプ、シンデレラも悪気があったわけじゃ
ないのよ。それはわかる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, you do know that Cinderella
didn't suggest you to cut your
hair because she hates you, right?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Sure, maybe she lacked some tact,
but you didn't need to say you
hate her, right?
fields.JP:
あの子の言い方もよくなかったかも
しれないけど、あんたも言いすぎよ。
それもわかるわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, maybe she lacked some tact,
but you didn't need to say you
hate her, right?

fields.EN:
You don't want to cut your hair
that much?
fields.JP: ラプ、そんなに髪切るの嫌なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't want to cut your hair
that much?

fields.EN:
I don't wanna... Thinking to cut
hair made me all mad...
fields.JP:
うん、やだ……。かみきるってかんがえたら、
すごくいやで、あたまのなか、
わーってなっちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna... Thinking to cut
hair made me all mad...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel thought Cinderella understood her...
So she got all mad...
fields.JP:
……シンデレラ、ラプンツェルのこと
わかってくれてるとおもってた。
それなのに、っておもったら、なんか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought Cinderella know me...
So I get all mad...
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_24327.

fields.EN:
So you were hurt even more
because you trusted her.
fields.JP: 気を許していた分、余計に傷ついたってことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you were hurt even more
because you trusted her.

fields.EN:
I don't wanna cut hair...
If I cut hair, then I no need
Cinderella...
fields.JP:
……かみ、きりたくないもん。
かみ、きるくらいなら、シンデレラと
なかよくしなくてもいいもん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna cut hair...
If I cut hair, then I no need
Cinderella...

fields.EN:
(That's a harsh statement, but
I can tell she doesn't mean it.)
fields.JP:
（とは言っても、シンデレラに
　未練があるの見え見えだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's a harsh statement, but
I can tell she doesn't mean it.)

fields.EN:
Cinderella likes you, so she gave
you her suggestion. She didn't
tell you to cut your hair.
fields.JP:
ねえ、ラプ。シンデレラはあんたが好きだから、
自分がいいと思うことをアドバイスしてくれた
だけなの。別に髪は切らなくていいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella likes you, so she gave
you her suggestion. She didn't
tell you to cut your hair.

fields.EN:
You know you went too far there,
right? You want to become friends
with her again, right?
fields.JP:
本当はあんたも言いすぎたって
わかってるんでしょ？　シンデレラと
仲直りしたいと思っているんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know you went too far there,
right? You want to become friends
with her again, right?

fields.EN:
You not wanting to cut your hair,
and you wanting to be friends are
both something you can tell her.
fields.JP:
髪を切りたくないのも、仲直りしたいのも
『素直な気持ち』なら、シンデレラと
もう一度きちんと話してみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You not wanting to cut your hair,
and you wanting to be friends are
both something you can tell her.

fields.EN:
I'm sure it'll be fine.
You're still young, so you can
make mistakes.
fields.JP:
きっと大丈夫よ。
それにね、小さい頃は失敗していいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure it'll be fine.
You're still young, so you can
make mistakes.

fields.EN:
Everyone grows through mistakes.
What's important is that you don't
make the same mistake again.
fields.JP:
みんな失敗したり間違えたりしながら
大きくなるの。そこで大事なのは、
次は同じ失敗をしないことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone grows through mistakes.
What's important is that you don't
make the same mistake again.

fields.EN:
I'm sure Cinderella would be happy
to know that she made you do a
mistake, which will make you grow.
fields.JP:
そうすれば、失敗されたほうの人も
嬉しいはずよ。ラプンツェルの成長を
手伝えたことになるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Cinderella would be happy
to know that she made you do a
mistake, which will make you grow.

fields.EN:
No make same mistake...
Rapunzel make mistake not
saying why I no like cut hair...
fields.JP:
おなじしっぱいをしない……。
ラプンツェルのしっぱいは、すなおに
はなせなかったこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No make same mistake...
Rapunzel make mistake not
saying why I no like cut hair...

fields.EN:
Okay! I talk with Cinderella
next time!
fields.JP:
……わかった！
こんどシンデレラにあったら、
ちゃんとおはなしする！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I talk with Cinderella
next time!

fields.EN:
That's the spirit!
You do your best, okay?
fields.JP: 偉い！　がんばるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the spirit!
You do your best, okay?

fields.JP: うん！　おやゆび、ありがとー！
やれやれ、世話が焼けるわね

fields.EN:
Kudos to you, Oyayubi.
That was pretty darn amazing.
fields.JP:
今回は君に任せっきりになっちゃったな。
……親指、君ってすごいんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kudos to you, Thumbelina.
That was pretty darn amazing.

fields.EN:
No, I was just thinking you really are
an onee-chan. I kind of respect that.
fields.JP:
いや、やっぱり君は『お姉ちゃん』なんだなぁと
思ったんだ。ちょっと尊敬した
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I was just surprised that you
can act like an older sister.
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN: (It's Rapunzel and Cinderella...! Could this be the first time they've properly faced each other since then?)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルとシンデレラだ……！
　もしかして、あのあと二人でちゃんと
　顔合わせるのって、初めてなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Rapunzel and Cinderella...
They haven't talked with each
other yet?)

fields.EN:
(I don't know why, but I hid
myself seeing them...
What to do...?)
fields.JP:
（咄嗟に物陰に隠れちゃったけど、
　出ていくタイミングを完全に逃した……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know why, but I hid
myself seeing them...
What to do...?)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about what I said to
you the last time...
fields.JP:
……先日はひどいことを言って、
申し訳ありませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about what I said to
you the last time...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel was bad!
You not bad, Cinderella!
fields.JP:
わるかったのはラプンツェルなの！
シンデレラ、わるくないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel was bad!
You not bad, Cinderella!

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I didn't wanna cut my hair.
I got all mad inside.
Rapunzel was bad...
fields.JP:
かみきるのがいやで、すごくいやで、
あたまのなかぐちゃぐちゃになっちゃった。
でも、それはラプンツェルのせいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't wanna cut my hair.
I got all mad inside.
Rapunzel was bad...

fields.EN: Rapunzel thought Cinderella understood how Rapunzel feels about her hair.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのかみのこと、
シンデレラはわかってくれてるって、
かってにおもってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel thought Cinderella
know what Rapunzel likes.

fields.EN:
But when you said cut hair,
I got sad and mad, so I
said all that...
fields.JP:
でもちがったんだっておもったら、
すごくかなしくて、おこっちゃって、
それでつい、あんなこといっちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when you said cut hair,
I got sad and mad, so I
said all that...

fields.EN:
You've done nothing wrong, Rapu.
It didn't dawn on me that your
hair was so important to you.
fields.JP:
ラプは悪くありませんわ。わたしも、
ラプが大事にしている髪のことなのに、
むしんけいなことを言ってしまいましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've done nothing wrong, Rappy.
It didn't dawn on me that your
hair was so important to you.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Um, I only mad because it was
you, Cinderella. Someone else
no make me mad...
fields.JP:
あのね、どうでもいいひとにいわれたら、
あんなにおこらなかったとおもう。
でも、シンデレラのことはすきだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I only mad because it was
you, Cinderella. Someone else
no make me mad...

fields.EN:
Are you trying to imply that you
felt betrayed because you
believed in me?
fields.JP:
きっとラプは、わたしを信じていたのに、
裏切られたと思ったから、
怒ってしまったのですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you trying to imply that you
felt betrayed because you
believed in me?

fields.JP: そうなのかな……？　でも、そうかも

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
You mad of Rapunzel?
You hate Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ごめんなさい……。
ラプンツェルのこと、おこってる？
もう、きらいになった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
You mad of Rapunzel?
You hate Rapunzel?

fields.EN:
Of course not.
I like you no different from
before, Rapu.
fields.JP:
いいえ、まさか！
ラプのことは大好きですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not.
I like you no different from
before, Rappy.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
ほんとう……！？
これからも、ラプンツェルと
なかよくしてくれる？
わーーーーい！！　よかったぁ！

fields.EN:
I know! As a sign of friendship,
may I work on your hair?
fields.JP:
そうですわ！
仲直りの印に、ラプの髪を
かわいく結わせていただけません？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know! As a sign of friendship,
may I work on your hair?

fields.EN:
Why yes, I'm sure with your
long hair there's a lot of
different ways to bunch your hair.
fields.JP:
はい。ラプの髪は長いので、
アレンジのしがいがありますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I'm sure with your
long hair there's a lot of
different ways to bunch your hair.

fields.JP: わー、やってやって！　おもしろそー！！

fields.EN:
Well, do you mind coming to
my room then?
fields.JP: では、わたしの部屋へまいりましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, do you mind coming to
my room then?

fields.EN:
(It's good they're back together
again. Rapunzel's apology made
them bond stronger than before.)
fields.JP:
（二人とも仲直りできてよかったな。
　ラプンツェルも素直に謝れたし、
　雨降って地固まるってことか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's good they're back together
again. Rapunzel's apology made
them bond stronger than before.)

fields.EN:
Ouch... I shouldn't have hid
myself like that so suddenly.
I feel a kink in my back...
fields.JP:
……それにしても、
変な体勢でずっと隠れてたから、
体中が固まっちゃったな。いたた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch... I shouldn't have hid
myself like that so suddenly.
I feel a kink in my back...

fields.EN:
I can't let Princess see me
in pain like this...
fields.JP:
うう、こんなみっともないところ、
姫には見せられないや……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't let Princess see me
in pain like this...

fields.JP: ラプンツェル？　ため息をつくなんて珍しいな

fields.EN:
She doesn't look too well.
I wonder if there's a problem.
fields.JP:
ちょっと元気なさそうだね。
どうしたんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't look too well.
I wonder if there's a problem.

fields.JP: ため息なんかついて、なにかあったのか？

fields.EN:
If you'd like, we'd be more than
happy to listen.
fields.JP: 悩みごとなら相談にのるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you'd like, we'd be more than
happy to listen.

fields.EN:
Are you sick? We can take you
to the Rescue Center.
fields.JP:
あ、もしかして体調が悪いんじゃないか？
救護室に行くか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sick? We can take you
to the Rescue Center.

fields.EN:
Or maybe you're hungry?
That can bring people a notch
down, too.
fields.JP:
ひょっとして、お腹が空いてるとか。
お腹空くと、元気でなくなっちゃうもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or maybe you're hungry?
That can bring people a notch
down, too.

fields.JP: ふたりとも、ありがとう。でもだいじょうぶだよ

fields.EN:
You sound a lot more calmer
than usual...
fields.JP: こ、心なしか大人びた雰囲気だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sound a lot more calmer
than usual...

fields.EN:
You're definitely not the same
Rapu-chan that I know.
fields.JP: ますますいつものラプちゃんと違う……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're definitely not the same
Rappy that I know.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、いつもとおんなじだよ。
ちょっとかんがえごとしてただけ

fields.EN:
(Her thinking is already not
the usual Rapunzel...)
fields.JP:
（それもすでにいつものラプンツェルの
　イメージと違うんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her thinking is already not
the usual Rapunzel...)

fields.EN:
Um, I was thinking about
all sort of emotions.
fields.JP:
あのね、いろんな『きもち』のこと
かんがえてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I was thinking about
all sort of emotions.

fields.EN:
Emotions so strange. Mine keep
changing like clouds in sky.
fields.JP:
きもちって、ふしぎなんだよ。
じぶんのきもちでも、そらのくもみたいに、
かたちをかえてかわっていくの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Emotions so strange. Mine keep
changing like clouds in sky.

fields.EN:
Like clouds, everyone emotion
different. So normal that everyone
no understand each other.
fields.JP:
それでね、みんなべつべつのすなおな
きもちをもってるんだよ。だからちゃんと
わかりあえないときもあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like clouds, everyone emotion
different. So normal that everyone
no understand each other.

fields.EN:
But that no make them bad.
No need to have same emotion.
fields.JP:
でも、どれかひとつしかえらべない
なんてことはないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that no make them bad.
No need to have same emotion.

fields.EN:
If everyone think about others,
then okay. Everyone happy if
speak feelings with each other.
fields.JP:
みんながみんなのことをだいじにおもえば、
いいんだよね。しあわせになるには、
がんばってはなしあうのがだいじなんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If everyone think about others,
then okay. Everyone happy if
speak feelings with each other.

fields.EN:
You're right. If that was done,
then I'm sure there'd be no
fighting.
fields.JP:
そうだね。そうすれば、きっと誰も
ケンカしなくて済むよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. If that was done,
then I'm sure there'd be no
fighting.

fields.EN:
(I guess Rapunzel's been
thinking a lot since her argument
with Cinderella.)
fields.JP:
（……この間のシンデレラとの一件で、
　ラプンツェルなりにいろいろ考えたの
　かもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess Rapunzel's been
thinking a lot since her argument
with Cinderella.)

fields.EN:
(She can reason and understand
various things, even now.
She must be quite smart.)
fields.JP:
（まだ小さいのに、物事の本質を
　理解しているみたいだ。
　実はけっこう賢い子なのかもな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She can reason and understand
various things, even now.
She must be quite smart.)

fields.JP: 君は大人みたいだな、ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
I think you've matured a bit
after talking with various
people, and thinking about things.
fields.JP:
きっといろんな人と話して、
いろんなことを考えたから、
成長したんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you've matured a bit
after talking with various
people, and thinking about things.

fields.EN:
You say that people think Rapunzel
serious if I talk more?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、もっとたくさんおはなしすれば、
おとなになれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You say that people think Rapunzel
serious if I talk more?

fields.JP: そうしたら、こどもつくれるね！

fields.EN:
You can make babies when you're grown up, right?
Rapunzel will talk lots more and become a grown-up!
fields.JP:
こども、おとなになったらつくれるんだよね？
ラプンツェル、もっとおはなしして、
おとなになる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can be mother, right? I be mature
if I have baby! I can be mature if I
become mother!
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_24414.

fields.EN: All I need is make babies!
fields.JP: おとなになって、こどもつくるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: All I need is make babies!

fields.EN:
I'm not sure if she understands that
being a mother doesn't exactly
equate to being a mature individual.
fields.JP:
その場合の大人の意味は
精神的なものじゃないんだけどな。
ちょっとわかってなさそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure if she understands that
being a mother doesn't exactly
equate to being a mature individual.

fields.EN:
I guess there's a lot more ahead
of Rapu-chan before she's able to become
a normal and mature person...
fields.JP:
やっぱりラプちゃんが大人になるのは、
もうちょっと先かもね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess there's a lot more ahead
of Rappy before she's able to become
a normal and mature person...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: わああ！　どうしよ！　どーしよーー！！
って、なにをそんなに慌ててるんだ？

fields.EN:
It's dangerous running around
like that.
fields.JP: ラプちゃん、走り回ったら危ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous running around
like that.

fields.EN: Guree is coming! Guree is comingーー!
fields.JP: ぐれーがくる！　ぐれーがくるー！
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Guree...? You mean Gretel is coming?
Why does that mean we have to panic?
fields.JP:
ぐれー……グレーテルが来る？
なんでそれで慌てなきゃいけないんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretty...? You mean Gretel?
So what if she's coming?
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed
B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed
Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san
B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
You're making it sound like
you've met a monster.
fields.JP: あら、人を化け物みたいに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're making it sound like
you've met a monster.

fields.JP: うわー！　おつうたすけてーー！！

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Why are you hiding
behind my back?!
fields.JP: わっ、僕の背中に隠れちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Why are you hiding
behind my back?!

fields.EN: Rapu-chan, are you scared of Gretel-san?
fields.JP: ラプちゃん、グレーテルさんが怖いの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rappy, are you scared of Gretel?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: いったい、なにがあったんだ？

fields.EN:
Nothing really. We got some
cookies from Hikari earlier.
fields.JP:
大したことは、なにも。
さっき二人で、ヒカリから
クッキーをもらったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing really. We got some
cookies from Hikari earlier.

fields.EN:
Really? Do you have some
for us?
fields.JP: いいなぁ。ところで僕達の分は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Do you have some
for us?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel and I were offered the
cookies, so of course there are
none for you.
fields.JP:
私とラプンツェルがもらったのだから、
ないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel and I were offered the
cookies, so of course there are
none for you.

fields.EN:
I suppose sharing isn't part
of your choice...
fields.JP: 分けるという選択肢は毛頭ないんだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose sharing isn't part
of your choice...

fields.EN:
I consumed my cookies
immediately after obtaining them.
fields.JP: 私はクッキーをもらい、可及的速やかに食したわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I consumed my cookies
immediately after obtaining them.

fields.EN:
Most people talk about how good
they tasted, not how quickly they
ate them, you know...
fields.JP:
その言い方、食べ物を食べるときに
使う表現じゃない気がするけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Most people talk about how good
they tasted, not how quickly they
ate them, you know...

fields.EN:
Well, all you did was eat your
cookies, right? So why would
Rapu-chan be...
fields.JP:
でもただ食べただけだったら、
どうしてラプちゃんは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all you did was eat your
cookies, right? So why would
Rappy be...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: うー……、また見てくるよぅ……

fields.EN:
Maybe she was scared of how
you looked at her, Gretel.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは、もしかしてその視線が
怖くて逃げてきたんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she was scared of how
you looked at her, Gretel.

fields.EN:
I simply looked at her in envy
of her cookies. I didn't even ask
to get some.
fields.JP:
私は「くれ」なんてひとことも言っていないわ。
ただ、羨ましいと思って見ていただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I simply looked at her in envy
of her cookies. I didn't even ask
to get some.

fields.EN:
Uu... Rapunzel had no choice,
so Rapunzel gave Guree one cookie...
fields.JP:
うう、ラプンツェル、しかたないから、
ぐれーにクッキー、いちまいあげた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Rapunzel can't help...
Rapunzel gave a cookie to
Gretty...
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Yes, and it was delicious.
Thank you.
fields.JP: おいしかったわ。ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it was delicious.
Thank you.

fields.EN:
Then she keep look at me...
So scary, so gave one more.
She keep looking at me, so...
fields.JP:
でも、もっとじーっとみてきた。
だからこわくて、もういちまいあげた。
それでもずっとみてきて、それで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then she keep look at me...
So scary, so gave one more.
She keep looking at me, so...

fields.EN: Oh, I see why you were scared...
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see why you were scared...

fields.EN:
Gretel, I can't believe you
pressured her to get her cookies.
fields.JP:
小さい子からお菓子を奪うなんて
大人げないぞ、グレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, I can't believe you
pressured her to get her cookies.

fields.EN:
I didn't pressure her.
She just gave hers to me.
fields.JP: 奪ってなんかいないわ。もらっただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't pressure her.
She just gave hers to me.

fields.EN:
The way you got them is
the problem...
fields.JP:
そのもらい方が大人げないって
言ってるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The way you got them is
the problem...

fields.JP: そ、そーだ、そーだ！　おとなげないー！

fields.EN:
Please don't stare at her like
that. Seriously, you're acting
like some child...
fields.JP:
僕越しにラプンツェルを
見つめようとするのはやめてくれ。
本当に大人げないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't stare at her like
that. Seriously, you're acting
like some child...

fields.EN:
That's quite a vague description
to use on me. Is it so important
to be acting like an adult?
fields.JP:
その大人げがある、ない、というのは、
とても曖昧で感覚的な表現ね。
大人げというのはそんなに大切なこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite a vague description
to use on me. Is it so important
to be acting like an adult?

fields.EN:
Will I be able to suppress my
Blood Libido if I act like an
adult?
fields.JP:
大人げがあれば血式リビドーは
抑えられるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will I be able to suppress my
Blood Libido if I act like an
adult?

fields.EN:
My Blood Libido is what makes
me seek sweets. I doubt acting
like an adult would help.
fields.JP:
甘い物やお菓子が好きなのは、
私の血式リビドーゆえの本能よ。
大人げなんかで抑えられるものじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My Blood Libido is what makes
me seek sweets. I doubt acting
like an adult would help.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, not prying her
sweets away is an act of an adult.
She's lucky I'm only staring.
fields.JP:
むしろ本当なら奪いたいところを
理性で抑えたのだから、
凝視するくらい許してほしいものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, not prying her
sweets away is an act of an adult.
She's lucky I'm only staring.

fields.EN:
(I know she's trying to make an
excuse, but I don't want to drag
this on any longer...)
fields.JP:
（へ理屈のような気もするけど、
　これ以上反論できない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's trying to make an
excuse, but I don't want to drag
this on any longer...)

fields.EN:
Didn't Hikari-chan share the cookies
to you both? If so, what Rapu-chan got
is rightfully hers.
fields.JP:
だけど、ヒカリちゃんは平等に配ってくれた
んでしょう？　それなら、ラプちゃんが
もらった分はラプちゃんのものですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't Hikari share the cookies
to you both? If so, what Rappy got
is rightfully hers.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan has the right to eat her cookies.
You can't take them away, Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
クッキーを食べる権利はラプちゃんに
あるんだから、グレーテルさんは
それを邪魔しちゃ駄目です
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Rappy has the right to eat
her cookies. You don't have the
right to take them away.

fields.JP: ……たしかに、その理屈は納得できるわ

fields.EN:
So, no more taking her
sweets, okay?
fields.JP: もうしちゃ駄目ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, no more taking her
sweets, okay?

fields.JP: よかったね、ラプンツェル

fields.EN:
Yup! Okay, I can eat my last
cookie now!
fields.JP:
うん！　じゃあ、さいごのいちまい、
いただきまーす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Okay, I can eat my last
cookie now!

fields.JP: もう、グレーテルさんったら……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Urrh... All right...
Here! Last one!
fields.JP:
ううー、しかたないなぁ。
そんなにほしいなら、さいごだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... All right...
Here! Last one!

fields.EN:
Broke in half!
We eat together!
fields.JP:
はい、クッキーはんぶんこ！
いっしょにたべよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Broke in half!
We eat together!

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan, you're such a good
girl!
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, you're such a good
girl!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: うん。本当、いい子だなぁ
ぼりぼりぼり……ごっくん
余韻に浸る間もなく一口で！？

fields.EN:
Hey! Stop staring at Rapunzel's
cookie!
fields.JP:
しかもラプンツェルの残ったクッキーを
また見つめてるし！　いい加減にしなよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Stop staring at Rapunzel's
cookie!

fields.EN:
Heh heh, I'm just joking.
Thank you, Rapunzel.
That was quite delicious.
fields.JP:
ふふ、冗談よ。
ありがとう、ラプンツェル。
……ごちそうさま
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, I'm just joking.
Thank you, Rapunzel.
That was quite delicious.

fields.EN:
Uu... Rapunzel thought it would get taken again...
Guree is scary... Uu~...
fields.JP:
うう、またとられるかとおもった……。
ぐれーこわい……ううー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Almost lost my cookie...
Gretty so scary... Urrh...
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Gretel traumatized Rapu-chan...
I'm not even sure if Gretel was
really joking there...
fields.JP:
ああ、ラプちゃんのトラウマに……。
最後の、本当に冗談だったのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel traumatized Rappy...
I'm not even sure if Gretel was
really joking there...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I'll assume she was joking
like she said...
fields.JP: わからないけど、冗談だったと思っておこう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll assume she was joking
like she said...

fields.EN:
Is that Rapunzel and Cinderella?
I hear their voices from the
cafeteria...
fields.JP:
わ、ラプンツェルとシンデレラの声だ。
食堂から聞こえてきたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that Rapunzel and Cinderella?
I hear their voices from the
cafeteria...

fields.EN:
Now, now, no need to get
so mad over it...
fields.JP: まあまあ、そう怒らないでよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, no need to get
so mad over it...

fields.EN:
We were only thinking about
you two...
fields.JP: 白雪たちは、お二人のことを想って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were only thinking about
you two...

fields.EN:
Rapunzel and Cinderella treated
like dummies! Meanie!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルとシンデレラを
こどもあつかいした！　ひどいー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel and Cinderella treated
like dummies! Meanie!

fields.EN:
We're well able to handle our
own!
fields.JP: わたしたち、ちゃんと一人前でしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're well able to handle our
own!

fields.EN:
Um, can I ask what's going on
here? I could hear your voices
from the hallway.
fields.JP:
なあ、なにをそんなに揉めてるんだ？
廊下まで声が聞こえてきたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, can I ask what's going on
here? I could hear your voices
from the hallway.

fields.EN:
Otsuu!
Aka-Aka and Shirayuki so mean!
fields.JP:
あっ、おつうー！
あかあかとしらゆきがひどいんだよー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu!
Reddy and Snow White so mean!

fields.EN:
They were leaving us out from
the expeditions, treating us like
we don't know what we're doing!
fields.JP:
わたしたちを子ども扱いして、
のけ者にしようとしましたのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They were leaving us out from
the expeditions, treating us like
we don't know what we're doing!

fields.EN: No, coming back after so long just made me think... do we really need to send little kids out on dangerous expeditions?
fields.JP:
いや、久しぶりに戻ってきて、ふと思ったんだ。
危険な探索にわざわざ小さい子どもを
行かせることもないんじゃないかって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just thinking that there's
no need to have them go
out on the expeditions.

fields.EN:
We've got a lot of Blood Maidens
now, so I was discussing with Shirayuki about keeping them here.
fields.JP:
血式少女の仲間もたくさんいるんだしさ。
別に二人は留守番でもいいんじゃないかって、
白雪に相談してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've got a lot of Blood Maidens
now, so I was discussing with Snow
White about keeping them here.

fields.EN:
Yes, I heard from Aka-neesama how
dangerous it is out there, so
what she said did make sense.
fields.JP:
はい。白雪も赤姉様からそのお話を聞いて、
なるほどって思いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I heard from sister Red how
dangerous it is out there, so
what she said did make sense.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
See?! They really are trying to leave Rapunzel and the others out!
They're treating us like kids!!
fields.JP:
ほらー！　やっぱりラプンツェルたちを
なかまはずれにしようとしてる！
こどもあつかいしてるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See?! They don't want us
with them! Treat us like useless!
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_24503.

fields.EN:
We're with everyone on our
mission out of here!
fields.JP: わたしたちだって、仲間ですのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're with everyone on our
mission out of here!

fields.EN:
Now, now, calm down for a moment.
They're just trying to think for
the better of you.
fields.JP:
まあまあ、落ち着いて。赤ずきんと白雪は
悪気があったわけじゃないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now, calm down for a moment.
They're just trying to think for
the better of you.

fields.EN:
They don't want you two to go
through danger out there.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルやシンデレラのことが心配だから、
危険なことをさせたくないだけなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They don't want you two to go
through danger out there.

fields.EN:
How rude! Are you implying that
we're that useless out there?!
fields.JP:
心配されるほど役立たずだということですの？
屈辱ですわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude! Are you implying that
we're that useless out there?!

fields.JP:
ううーーーー！
やっぱりこどもあつかいだーーーー！！

fields.EN:
You're both Blood Maidens we're
counting on. Without you two we
wouldn't be here.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもシンデレラも、頼りになる
血式少女仲間だよ。二人がいなければ
乗り越えられなかった場面もたくさんあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're both Blood Maidens we're
counting on. Without you two we
wouldn't be here.

fields.EN:
So, they're worried about you
because you're both precious friends.
fields.JP:
だけど赤ずきんたちがつい心配するのは、
二人が大切な仲間だからなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, they're worried about you
because you're both precious friends.

fields.EN:
That's right. You would be worried
if one of us got hurt too, right?
fields.JP:
そう。君達だって、僕達の誰かが
怪我をしたら心配するだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You would be worried
if one of us got hurt too, right?

fields.JP: するよ！　しんぱいする！

fields.EN:
Well, they feel the same way,
too. Do you understand?
fields.JP:
それと同じだよ、赤ずきんたちの気持ちも。
わかるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, they feel the same way,
too. Do you understand?

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry... I suppose not
seeing it in that light proves
that we're still immature...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさいですわ。
そんなこともわからずに駄々をこねて、
わたしたちはやっぱり子どもですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry... I suppose not
seeing it in that light proves
that we're still immature...

fields.EN:
Nah, let me apologize. Otsuu's
right. We were treating you two
like you don't know what you're doing.
fields.JP:
……いや、こっちこそごめん！
おつうの言う通りだ。たしかに二人のこと
子ども扱いしちゃってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nah, let me apologize. Otsuu's
right. We were treating you two
like you don't know what you're doing.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel-san, Cinderella-san, we see you both
as full-fledged friends we can rely on.
fields.JP:
そうですね。
ラプンツェルさんとシンデレラさんは、
頼りになる一人前の仲間です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but we do see you both
as precious friends who we
can rely on.

fields.EN:
So lemme take back what
I said earlier. You both wouldn't
mind coming with us, right?
fields.JP:
さっきの発言は撤回するよ。
これからも一緒に探索行ってくれるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
So lemme take back what
I said earlier. You both wouldn't
mind coming with us, right?

fields.EN: Of course! I'm counting on you!
fields.JP: もちろん！　頼りにしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course! I'm counting on you!

fields.EN:
Otsuu, you said there were lots of things you couldn't have gotten through
without Rapunzel and the others, right?
fields.JP:
おつうは、ラプンツェルたちがいなきゃ
のりこえられなかったこともたくさんあった、
っていってくれたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you said we here because
we were here, right?
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Exact shared counterpart of MS2_STORY_24529.

fields.JP: あのね、すごーくうれしかったよ！

fields.EN:
Same here! I'm very happy that
you took note of our
contributions!
fields.JP:
わたしもですわ！
わたしたちの活躍、ちゃんと
見ていてくれたんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here! I'm very happy that
you took note of our
contributions!

fields.EN:
We help even more, so keep
eyes on us, okay?
fields.JP:
つぎのたんさくもがんばるから、
ちゃんとみててね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We help even more, so keep
eyes on us, okay?

fields.EN:
No problem, but make sure you both
don't go too far, or else you're
both staying behind, got it?
fields.JP:
わかってるよ。
でもあんまり調子に乗るようなら、
留守番させちゃうからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem, but make sure you both
don't go too far, or else you're
both staying behind, got it?

fields.EN:
Huh? Is that... Rapunzel and
Cinderella?
fields.JP: ……え？　ラプンツェルと、シンデレラが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Is that... Rapunzel and
Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Sure is! They were so cute coming
here wanting to sleep with me!
fields.JP:
うん、そう！
昨日の夜、わたしの部屋に一緒に寝に来たの。
可愛かったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure is! They were so cute coming
here wanting to sleep with me!

fields.EN:
D-Did they sleep together with you
in your bed?
fields.JP: い、一緒に寝たって、姫と同じベッドで？
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Did they sleep together with you
in your bed?

fields.EN:
(What the...?! They slept together
with Princess?! I feel both angry
and jealous at the same time...)
fields.JP:
（姫と同じベッド！　同じ布団！
　無邪気にそんなことができる二人が、
　憎らしいような羨ましいような……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the...?! They slept together
with Princess?! I feel both angry
and jealous at the same time...)

fields.JP: おつうちゃん？　なんか、顔怖い……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh... Hahaha...
I'm not angry in the slightest,
Princess!
fields.JP:
え？　ははは、怖い顔なんて
するわけないじゃありませんか、姫！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh... Hahaha...
I'm not angry in the slightest,
Princess!

fields.JP: やっぱりちょっと怖いよ……

fields.EN:
(There's no way I can tell her
I'm jealous of those two...)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルとシンデレラに嫉妬したなんて、
　言えるわけないよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way I can tell her
I'm jealous of those two...)

fields.EN:
Now that Princess is back in
her room, I should get to sleep,
too.
fields.JP:
さて、姫は部屋まで送ったし、
僕もそろそろ寝るとするか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that Princess is back in
her room, I should get to sleep,
too.

fields.JP: んーー、おつう、うるさい

fields.EN:
Rapunzel? Cinderella?
What are you two doing in my
bed?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルに、シンデレラ……。
寝ぼけて僕の布団に入り込んじゃったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel? Cinderella?
What are you two doing in my
bed?

fields.EN:
(So this is how they got into
Princess's room... I can't believe
they sleepwalked here...)
fields.JP:
（姫が言っていたのはこういうことか。
　それにしても、なんて寝ぼけ方なんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So this is how they got into
Princess's room... I can't believe
they sleepwalked here...)

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...
Fine, but just for tonight.
fields.JP: ……まったく、仕方ないな。今晩だけだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...
Fine, but just for tonight.

fields.EN:
(Hm? That's right... Rapunzel
and Cinderella are sleeping
with me...)
fields.JP:
（……ん？　ああ、そういえば、
　ラプンツェルとシンデレラが
　一緒に寝てるんだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? That's right... Rapunzel
and Cinderella are sleeping
with me...)

fields.EN:
(Wh-What the...?! Oh well...
I'm sure they're fine...
So sleepy...)
fields.JP:
（そ、そんなところまで……！
　でもまぁ、寝ぼけているんだろうし、
　僕も眠いし、放っておくか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-What the...?! Oh well...
I'm sure they're fine...
So sleepy...)

fields.JP: おはよう、おつうちゃん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Oh, good morning, Princess...
As beautiful as ever.
fields.JP:
あ……おはよう、姫。
今日も相変わらず麗しい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, good morning, Princess...
As beautiful as ever.

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、なんかすごいことに
なってるけど……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
You know, Rapu-chan and Cinderella-san are
sleeping with you like that, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんとシンデレラさんが、
あられもない恰好で
おつうちゃんと寝てること
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, how Rappy and
Cinderella are sleeping with you
like that...
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): シンデレラ => Cinderella-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.JP: あ、おはよー。いっぱいねれたー

fields.EN:
*yawn*
I wouldn't have minded sleeping
in a bit longer...
fields.JP:
ふあぁ……。
もっと寝ていたかったですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*yawn*
I wouldn't have minded sleeping
in a bit longer...

fields.EN:
You were both sleeping with me
too, right? Why are you both
sleeping all over the place?
fields.JP:
二人とも、この間はわたしのところで
一緒に寝たよね？　どうして
いろんな人のところに寝に行くの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were both sleeping with me
too, right? Why are you both
sleeping all over the place?

fields.EN:
Look for someone feel good
to sleep with!
fields.JP: ねごこちいいひと、さがしてるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look for someone feel good
to sleep with!

fields.JP: へぇ、面白いことしてるね

fields.EN:
Otsuu's chest felt better when
trying to go to sleep than you,
Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
おつうの胸は、人魚姫のよりも
寝心地がよかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu's chest felt better when
trying to go to sleep than you,
Little Mermaid.

fields.EN:
Um, Princess!
I don't think you...!
fields.JP: 姫！　あまり深く考えないほうが……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Princess!
I don't think you...!

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan's breasts are larger
than mine...
fields.JP:
やっぱり、おつうちゃんの胸のほうが
大きいもんね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu's breasts are larger
than mine...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Size doesn't matter! Your cute
non-assertive breasts are the
pinnacle of...
fields.JP:
大きさなんて無意味です！
姫の慎ましく愛らしい胸こそが
僕にとっては最高の……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Size doesn't matter! Your cute
non-assertive breasts are the
pinnacle of...

fields.EN:
Non-assertive...
You do know you're not praising
me, right?
fields.JP:
慎ましく、か……。
それ、あんまりフォローになってないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Non-assertive...
You do know you're not praising
me, right?

fields.EN:
P-Princess...
Your eyes are scaring me...
fields.JP: ひ、姫。目が笑ってません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Princess...
Your eyes are scaring me...

fields.JP: にんぎょ、なんかおこってる……？

fields.EN:
They're just arguing over petty
things. It's best we not get
involved.
fields.JP:
ちわげんか、というやつですわ。
首をつっこまないほうがいいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're just arguing over petty
things. It's best we not get
involved.

fields.JP: えーと、なんというか、その……
あの……すみませんでした
よしよし、いいこですねー

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel's talking to a doll?
I suppose she's just playing
house.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルだ。人形を抱っこして
　遊んでるのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel's talking to a doll?
I suppose she's just playing
house.)

fields.JP:
あ、おつう……じゃなくて、
おとーさんがかえってきましたよー
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Daddy took our dog, Jack,
out for a walk!
fields.JP:
おとーさんは、わんちゃんのジャックの
おさんぽにいってくれてたんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Daddy took our dog, Jack,
out for a walk!

fields.JP: ああ、おままごとの話か……

fields.EN:
(I'm the father, and Jack's the
dog? Which means Rapunzel is the
mother, and the doll the baby?)
fields.JP:
（僕が父親で、ジャックが飼い犬って設定か？
　それでラプンツェルはお母さん役、と。
　あの人形は赤ちゃんかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm the father, and Jack's the
dog? Which means Rapunzel is the
mother, and the doll the baby?)

fields.EN:
(She's playing with the play set
I gave her the last time. Well,
I guess I can play for a moment.)
fields.JP:
（そういえばこれ、この間あげた
　おままごとセットだ。せっかく遊んで
　くれてるんだし、ちょっと付き合うか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's playing with the play set
I gave her the last time. Well,
I guess I can play for a moment.)

fields.EN:
Thanks for taking the dog out
for walk after work!
fields.JP:
おかえりなさい！　おしごとから
かえってきたあとにおさんぽいってくれて、
おつかれさま！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for taking the dog out
for walk after work!

fields.EN:
For playing make-believe, this is
a lot more detailed than
I thought...
fields.JP:
ああ、僕は仕事から帰ってきたあとに
犬の散歩に行っていたことになってるんだ。
意外と凝った設定……
fields.LOCALIZED:
For playing make-believe, this is
a lot more detailed than
I thought...

fields.JP: いま、ゆうごはんのじゅんびするからね！

fields.EN:
Looks like she's having fun.
I guess it was worth giving
her the play set.
fields.JP:
楽しそうに遊んでるなぁ。
おままごとセットをあげてよかったね、
ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's having fun.
I guess it was worth giving
her the play set.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Seeing her happy makes me
happy, too.
fields.JP:
うん。ラプンツェルが楽しそうだと、
僕達も嬉しいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing her happy makes me
happy, too.

fields.EN:
Oh, but are you okay being the
family dog? It's not the best of
roles, you know?
fields.JP:
……ところで犬役だけど、大丈夫？
キャスティングに不満はない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but are you okay being the
family dog? It's not the best of
roles, you know?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Heh, that's good to hear.
You really are kind, Jack.
fields.JP: はは、よかった。ジャックは優しいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, that's good to hear.
You really are kind, Jack.

fields.EN:
Daddy! Baby crying!
Take care baby!
fields.JP:
おとーさん、あかちゃんぐずってる！
あかちゃんのおせわしてー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Daddy! Baby crying!
Take care baby!

fields.EN:
(Hm, I've never done this before.
I guess I can make-believe I'm
trying to cheer the baby up...)
fields.JP:
（そんなのしたことないな。
　どうすればいいんだろう。とりあえず
　人形をあやすふりでもするか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm, I've never done this before.
I guess I can make-believe I'm
trying to cheer the baby up...)

fields.EN:
Uh... You're a good baby...
Peek-a-boo! Upsey-daisy!
fields.JP:
よ、よーしよしよし、べろべろばー。
えーと、高い高ーい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... You're a good baby...
Peek-a-boo! Upsey-daisy!

fields.EN:
No do upsey-daisy!
Too dangerous! Need to keep
baby neck straight!
fields.JP:
たかいたかい、しちゃだめなんだよ！
あかちゃんのくび、あぶないんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No do upsey-daisy!
Too dangerous! Need to keep
baby neck straight!

fields.EN:
Ah, I think I heard that before...
You shouldn't shake babies.
Sorry, I won't do that any more.
fields.JP:
あー、たしかにそんな話も聞いたこと
あるような……。揺さぶられっ子なんとか、
だっけ。ごめん、もうしないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I think I heard that before...
You shouldn't shake babies.
Sorry, I won't do that any more.

fields.EN:
Daddy! Baby is crying!
Need change diaper!
fields.JP:
あ、おとーさん、あかちゃんがないてるよ！
おむつみたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Daddy! Baby is crying!
Need change diaper!

fields.EN:
You don't know how change diaper?
Okay, let mommy do it!
fields.JP:
もー、おむつもかえられないのー？
しかたないなぁ、おかーさんにかして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know how change diaper?
Okay, let mommy do it!

fields.JP: はーい、おむつかえましょうねー

fields.EN:
(She's changing the doll's diaper
pretty quickly. I guess she knows
a thing or two about babies.)
fields.JP:
（あれ、なんだかおむつ替えの手際が
　いいな。高い高いを注意したことといい、
　赤ちゃんのことちゃんと知ってるみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's changing the doll's diaper
pretty quickly. I guess she knows
a thing or two about babies.)

fields.EN:
(I underestimated her...
She's a lot more serious about
this make-believe play.)
fields.JP:
（ただのごっこ遊びだと思ったけど、
　けっこう本格的なんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I underestimated her...
She's a lot more serious about
this make-believe play.)

fields.EN:
You're pretty amazing, Rapunzel.
No, uh... mommy.
fields.JP:
しっかりしてるなぁ、ラプンツェル……
いや、お母さんは
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're pretty amazing, Rapunzel.
No, uh... mommy.

fields.EN:
You must have studied on taking
care of babies. You're acting just
like any other mom.
fields.JP:
赤ちゃんのことちゃんと勉強してるんだね。
ご飯作りながら赤ちゃんの世話するなんて、
本当のお母さんみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must have studied on taking
care of babies. You're acting just
like any other mom.

fields.JP: えへへー、ほめられちゃった！

fields.EN:
You're very serious about having
make-believe play, aren't you?
fields.JP: おままごとなのに本格的だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're very serious about having
make-believe play, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Yup! I want to have babies, so
I study plenty! I hope I can
make babies soon.
fields.JP:
うん！　こどもほしいから、
いっぱいべんきょーしたんだよ！
はやくこどもほしいなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! I want to have babies, so
I study plenty! I hope I can
make babies soon.

fields.JP: あはは、それはいつかそのうちね……

fields.EN:
Say, you think Rapunzel be a
good mommy? A really good
mommy?
fields.JP:
ねーねー、ラプンツェル、
いいおかーさんになれるかな？
なれるかなっ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, you think Rapunzel be a
good mommy? A really good
mommy?

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sure you will be a good
mommy.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sure you will be a good
mommy.

fields.EN:
Yaay! Okay, I practice more with
play set!
fields.JP:
わーーい！！
じゃあ、このおままごとセットで
もっともっとれんしゅうする！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yaay! Okay, I practice more with
play set!

fields.JP:
おとーさんも、いっしょに
れんしゅうしようね！

fields.EN:
Sounds good. After all, Princess
wouldn't be happy if she knew I
can't even change a baby's diaper.
fields.JP:
わかったよ、お母さん。
僕もおむつ替えくらいできないと、
姫にかっこつかないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds good. After all, Princess
wouldn't be happy if she knew I
can't even change a baby's diaper.

fields.EN:
Princess? What's with the trash
there?
fields.JP: 姫？　そのゴミ袋はいったい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess? What's with the trash
there?

fields.EN:
Ah, Otsuu-chan. I was planning to stop by
your room later too.
fields.JP:
あ、おつうちゃん。
あとでおつうちゃんの部屋にも
寄ろうと思ってたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu? Oh, I was planning on
going to your room later.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
I was going to throw out my trash,
so I figured I'd go around to pick
up everyone else's trash, too.
fields.JP:
わたしの部屋のゴミを捨てに行くから、
ついでにみんなの部屋のゴミも集めて
回っていたところなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was going to throw out my trash,
so I figured I'd go around to pick
up everyone else's trash, too.

fields.EN:
Are you serious?! I'm impressed!
You sure are kind.
fields.JP:
みんなの部屋の分まで！
ああ、なんて姫は心優しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you serious?! I'm impressed!
You sure are kind.

fields.EN:
You're praising me too much, Otsuu-chan.
I was just picking up trash along the way.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんってば褒めすぎ。
ただのついでだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on. I was just picking
up trash along the way.

fields.EN:
But gathering the trash is a
big burden for such a frail body.
Let me help.
fields.JP:
姫の細腕ではゴミ収集は大変でしょう。
よろしければ、僕にも手伝わせてくれませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But gathering the trash is a
big burden for such a frail body.
Let me help.

fields.EN:
Thank you.
I'd appreciate it if you'd help.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、お言葉に甘えて
手伝ってもらおうかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you.
I'd appreciate it if you'd help.

fields.EN:
The only rooms left are Kaguya-chan's and
yours, Otsuu-chan. Let's see... Kaguya-chan's
room is...
fields.JP:
残ってるのは、かぐやちゃんの部屋と
おつうちゃんの部屋だけなんだ。
えーと、かぐやちゃんの部屋は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only rooms left are yours and
Kaguya's. Let's see... Kaguya's
room is...?

fields.EN:
Right here.
Let's check if she's in.
fields.JP:
ああ、ちょうどここみたいだね。
ノックしてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right here.
Let's check if she's in.

fields.JP: 僕と人魚姫だけど。ちょっといいか？

fields.EN:
Do you have any trash to throw
out? I was going around gathering
everyone's trash.
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃん、捨てたいゴミはない？
今、みんなの部屋のゴミを集めて
捨てに行くところなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you have any trash to throw
out? I was going around gathering
everyone's trash.

fields.EN: I can take your trash for you.
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんの部屋のゴミも
一緒に持って行ってあげるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I can take your trash for you.

fields.EN:
Oh, um, nothing at all...
I'm fine right now.
fields.JP:
い、いえ、なんでもありません～。
今は、ゴミはけっこうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um, nothing at all...
I'm fine right now.

fields.EN:
Right now?
Oh, so you already threw your
trash away?
fields.JP:
今は……？
あ、もうゴミ捨てしちゃったあととか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right now?
Oh, so you already threw your
trash away?

fields.EN:
Well, if you have any, I can take
them for you.
fields.JP: 少しでもあるなら持って行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you have any, I can take
them for you.

fields.JP: ……少しであれば、どれほどよかったか

fields.EN:
Huh? What did you just say?
You have a bit more to throw
away?
fields.JP:
え？　今なんて言ったんだ？
少しゴミが溜まってるから
持って行ってほしいって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What did you just say?
You have a bit more to throw
away?

fields.EN: Not at all. You heard me wrong...
fields.JP:
いえ、全然違いますから～。
どんな聞こえ方してるんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Not at all. You heard me wrong...

fields.EN:
It's just that I have way too much
trash to throw out so simply...
fields.JP:
むしろ多すぎて、とても気楽に
ゴミ捨てを頼める量では……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I have way too much
trash to throw out so simply...

fields.EN:
Hahaha. How much can you have?
It's not like your room is filled
with trash or anything.
fields.JP:
ははっ、ゴミが多すぎるって大げさな。
別にゴミ部屋ってほどじゃないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. How much can you have?
It's not like your room is filled
with trash or anything.

fields.JP: ま、まさか～。冗談がきついですよ～

fields.EN:
Uh, why the pause?
You're starting to scare me...
fields.JP: いや、その間はなに？　怖いんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, why the pause?
You're starting to scare me...

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you seriously have
a load of trash to toss out...
fields.JP:
……まさか、本当にゴミ部屋なんて
ことはないよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you seriously have
a load of trash to toss out...

fields.EN:
Of course not. None of the trash
I have is rotting, so I can still
handle the smell.
fields.JP:
いえいえ、まさか。
まだ生ゴミ系までは進んでないので、
ニオイとかは大丈夫です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. None of the trash
I have is rotting, so I can still
handle the smell.

fields.EN:
Smell? You're making excuses here,
aren't you? I'm starting to think
you're like some pack rat...
fields.JP:
な、生ゴミじゃないから
大丈夫っていう発想が、
すでにゴミ部屋の住人じみている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Smell? You're making excuses here,
aren't you? I'm starting to think
you're like some pack rat...

fields.EN:
I'm not a pack rat!
It's just that I haven't cleaned
my place in a bit!
fields.JP:
ゴミ部屋じゃありません～！
ただちょっと片づいてないだけです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a pack rat!
It's just that I haven't cleaned
my place in a bit!

fields.EN:
Now you're really making me want
to see what your room is like...
fields.JP:
……なんかここまで聞くと、
わたしも興味出てきちゃったな。
かぐやちゃんの部屋、見てみたいかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now you're really making me want
to see what your room is like...

fields.EN: Do you mind if we come in?
fields.JP: ちょっと見せてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if we come in?

fields.EN:
Come on, how about we just
take a peek instead?
fields.JP: 僕も見たいな。ひと目くらいいいだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, how about we just
take a peek instead?

fields.EN:
She tripped!
Let's take a look inside!
fields.JP:
かぐやがこけた！
今のうちにちょっと覗かせてもらおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
She tripped!
Let's take a look inside!

fields.JP: ごめんね、かぐやちゃん

fields.EN:
No use hiding it now...
The place is filthy, isn't it?
fields.JP:
……ふん、見られてしまったからには
仕方ないです～。
どうせ汚い部屋と言いたいんでしょ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No use hiding it now...
The place is filthy, isn't it?

fields.EN:
Mmm... The place does need
some cleaning to be done...
fields.JP:
うーん。たしかにちょっと、
片づけないといけないかもね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... The place does need
some cleaning to be done...

fields.EN:
I figured as much. After all,
you were trying to stop us from
looking inside your room.
fields.JP:
やっぱり僕が予想した通りだったな。
部屋をあんなに隠そうとするなんて、
怪しいと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured as much. After all,
you were trying to stop us from
looking inside your room.

fields.EN:
It may look dirty, but I actually
have what I want placed tactically
within reach.
fields.JP:
こ、これはただ散らかってるんじゃなく、
必要な物がすぐに取れるように
計算し尽くされた配置になってるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It may look dirty, but I actually
have what I want placed tactically
within reach.

fields.EN:
You mentioned yourself that the
place is filthy...
fields.JP:
さっき、どうせ汚い部屋とか
自分で認めてなかったか？
矛盾してるだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mentioned yourself that the
place is filthy...

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you need help cleaning
your place, right?
fields.JP:
もう、かぐやちゃんったら。
本当は一人で片づけるのが大変で
困ってたんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you need help cleaning
your place, right?

fields.EN:
If you need help, just ask.
We're here for you.
fields.JP:
困ってるなら言ってくれれば手伝うのに。
遠慮しなくていいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you need help, just ask.
We're here for you.

fields.EN:
Of course.
We're friends, you know?
fields.JP: もちろんだよ。仲間でしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course.
We're friends, you know?

fields.EN:
Well, if you can help,
then please do.
fields.JP: それならお願いします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you can help,
then please do.

fields.JP: うわ、素早い手のひら返し……

fields.EN:
I have no reason not to rely on a
helping hand. Well, I'll be the
advisor then.
fields.JP:
せっかく手伝ってくれるというのを、
断る理由なんてありませんから～。
わらわは司令塔に徹しますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no reason not to rely on a
helping hand. Well, I'll be the
advisor then.

fields.JP: なに、さり気なく楽な役割を取ってるんだよ

fields.EN:
How rude. I'm simply assigning
myself a proper role befitting of
my abilities.
fields.JP:
あら、人聞きの悪い～。
合理的に掃除を進めるための
妥当な役割分担です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude. I'm simply assigning
myself a proper role befitting of
my abilities.

fields.EN:
Princess, are you going to let
that fly?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, are you going to let
that fly?

fields.EN:
Why not? I don't mind cleaning.
Now that I've seen the place,
I have to get this place cleaned.
fields.JP:
うん。お片づけって嫌いじゃないし、
このまま放置したら気になっちゃうから
いいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not? I don't mind cleaning.
Now that I've seen the place,
I have to get this place cleaned.

fields.EN:
Fine... If you say so.
Let me help.
fields.JP:
はぁ……、わかった。
姫がそう言うなら、僕も手伝うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... If you say so.
Let me help.

fields.EN: You don't need to force yourself.
fields.JP: 無理しなくていいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't need to force yourself.

fields.EN:
I'm not, Princess. I'm actually
quite honored to be of assistance
to you.
fields.JP:
無理ではありませんよ、姫。
あなたの手伝いをできるのならば、
この上なく光栄なことです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not, Princess. I'm actually
quite honored to be of assistance
to you.

fields.EN:
(There's no way I can leave her
alone to handle all this...)
fields.JP:
（そもそも、姫だけに重労働なんて
　させられるわけないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way I can leave her
alone to handle all this...)

fields.EN:
You're going to help too, Otsuu-san?
Thank you very much.
fields.JP:
おつうさんも手伝ってくれるんですか～？
ありがとうございます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to help, too?
Thank you very much.

fields.EN: You owe me one, got it?
fields.LOCALIZED: You owe me one, got it?

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
You're both borderline gullible,
aren't you?
fields.JP: ふふ、二人ともお人好しですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
You're both borderline gullible,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
(Huh? Kaguya?
What's she doing over there?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、かぐや。みんなから離れて
　どうしたんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Kaguya?
What's she doing over there?)

fields.EN:
(What's she doing in the shadows
there? Is she sick?
I better go and check...)
fields.JP:
（急に物陰に隠れた……。
　気分でも悪いのかな。ちょっと見に行こう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's she doing in the shadows
there? Is she sick?
I better go and check...)

fields.EN: I guess this should be fine...
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess this should be fine...

fields.EN:
(There she is... What's she...?
Huh? She took out...
a water sprayer?)
fields.JP:
（いたいた。なにか取り出そうと
　しているぞ。あれは……霧吹き？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she is... What's she...?
Huh? She took out...
a water sprayer?)

fields.EN:
Heh heh... Time to use one of
my special goof-off items...
the "Worker's Sparkle."
fields.JP:
ふふ、『仕事してる風七つ道具』の一つ、
『努力家のきらめき』を使います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... Time to use one of
my special goof-off items...
the "Worker's Sparkle."

fields.JP:
（『仕事してる風七つ道具』！？
　……すごく馬鹿馬鹿しい響きのアイテムだな）

fields.EN:
(She's spraying her face with
it... What is she doing?)
fields.JP:
（霧吹きを顔に吹きかけた……。
　なにやってるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's spraying her face with
it... What is she doing?)

fields.EN: I better not forget my neck...
fields.LOCALIZED: I better not forget my neck...

fields.EN:
(She's spraying on her neck...
Wait... Is she faking sweat?
No, she wouldn't...)
fields.JP:
（で、うなじにも吹きかける、と。
　……まさか、あれで汗を演出してるのか？
　いやいや、さすがにそんな馬鹿な）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's spraying on her neck...
Wait... Is she faking sweat?
No, she wouldn't...)

fields.EN:
(But, she did say "goof-off,"
so... Is she seriously...?)
fields.JP:
（……でもさっき、『仕事してる風』って
　言ってたよな。それじゃあやっぱり、
　ひょっとして本当に……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, she did say "goof-off,"
so... Is she seriously...?)

fields.EN:
Good... That should do it.
I bet no one would ever think
of using a spray bottle like this.
fields.JP:
……よし、これくらいでいいでしょう～。
こんなすごい道具、他の人は
思いつかないでしょうね～。ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good... That should do it.
I bet no one would ever think
of using a spray bottle like this.

fields.EN:
(Okay, it really is stupid...
At least she's right that no one
would use the bottle like that.)
fields.JP:
（……思った以上の馬鹿馬鹿しさだった。
　たしかにそんな道具、
　他の人は思いつかないだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Okay, it really is stupid...
At least she's right that no one
would use the bottle like that.)

fields.EN:
I better head on back...
I need to keep this all as
inconspicuous as possible...
fields.JP:
さてと、そろそろみんなのところに
戻らないと～。不審に思われては
元も子もありませんから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better head on back...
I need to keep this all as
inconspicuous as possible...

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、すごい汗！

fields.EN:
Very good! I don't know what you
did exactly, but your sweat proves
you must have done something!
fields.JP:
そんなにも汗をかくほどがんばったんだな！
いつがんばったのかは知らんが、すごいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very good! I don't know what you
did exactly, but your sweat proves
you must have done something!

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you okay?
You wanna rest?
fields.JP: かぐやー、だいじょうぶ？　ちょっとやすむ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you okay?
You wanna rest?

fields.EN:
No, I'm fine...
This is nothing for my fine
friends here.
fields.JP:
いいえ、これくらい平気です……。
みなさんの役に立てるなら、軽い物ですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine...
This is nothing for my fine
friends here.

fields.EN:
Well said!
A true friend indeed!
fields.JP: よくぞ言った！　さすがワレの仲間だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said!
A true friend indeed!

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan! Look at how much Kaguya
is doing! She's all sweating and
everything! Isn't she something?
fields.JP:
あ、おつうちゃん！
かぐやちゃんがこんなに汗をかきながら
がんばってるの！　すごく偉いと思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Look at how much Kaguya
is doing! She's all sweating and
everything! Isn't she something?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Uh, yes...
She sure is something...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, yes...
She sure is something...

fields.EN:
(I don't want to dampen the mood
here, but... aren't they a bit too
gullible?)
fields.JP:
（せっかく姫が感動してるのに、
　水を差すことはできない。だけどみんな、
　簡単に騙されすぎじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want to dampen the mood
here, but... aren't they a bit too
gullible?)

fields.EN:
Now, let's get going.
As hard-working as I am,
I shall still lead the way.
fields.JP:
さあ、先を急ぎましょう。
働き者のわらわも、引き続きがんばりますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, let's get going.
As hard-working as I am,
I shall still lead the way.

fields.EN:
Heh heh... You can praise me
more. After all, I am doing quite
a lot. Heh heh...
fields.JP:
ふふ、それほどでも。
ただ、少し努力してるだけですから。
ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... You can praise me
more. After all, I am doing quite
a lot. Heh heh...

fields.EN:
She should put her efforts into
something more productive...
fields.JP: いや、その努力はもっと他に活かそうよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She should put her efforts into
something more productive...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、なにか言った？

fields.EN:
No...
I'm just mumbling to myself...
fields.JP: いいえ、姫。ただの独り言です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No...
I'm just mumbling to myself...

fields.EN:
*sigh*
I want to hurry and cozy up in
my room...
fields.JP:
はぁ……早く帰って部屋に
こもりたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*
I want to hurry and cozy up in
my room...

fields.EN:
Urrh... Rapunzel so tired...
No wanna walk...
fields.JP:
はうぅ……ラプンツェルもつかれたー。
もうあるきたくないよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh... Rapunzel so tired...
No wanna walk...

fields.EN:
Come now, you shouldn't be
sitting down here like this.
fields.JP:
ああ、こんなところにしゃがみこんだら
駄目だって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, you shouldn't be
sitting down here like this.

fields.JP: でもつかれたんだもん……

fields.EN:
We did walk for quite some time
now, so I'm not surprised if
everyone is exhausted.
fields.JP:
たしかにだいぶ歩いたから、
疲労が溜まっていてもおかしくないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did walk for quite some time
now, so I'm not surprised if
everyone is exhausted.

fields.EN:
It should make walking a little easier.
Here, Rapunzel-san, use it.
fields.JP:
この杖で歩くのが少しは楽になるはずです。
ラプンツェルさんにお貸ししましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It should help make walking
a bit easier. Go ahead and use it.

fields.EN:
Cane? How you use?
Like this?
fields.JP:
つえ？　どうやってつかうの？
こう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cane? How you use?
Like this?

fields.EN:
Whoa! Watch it!
Don't swing it around like that!
fields.JP:
うわっ、危ない！
振り回す物じゃないぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Watch it!
Don't swing it around like that!

fields.EN:
You're supposed to put the tip
to the ground, so that you can
lean on it while walking.
fields.JP:
それは縦に持って、先端を地面につけて、
体を支えるようにしながら歩く物よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're supposed to put the tip
to the ground, so that you can
lean on it while walking.

fields.EN:
Oh, okay!
Got it! Lemme do it!
fields.JP:
そうなんだ！
やるやるー！　やってみる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, okay!
Got it! Lemme do it!

fields.EN: How does it feel using it?
fields.LOCALIZED: How does it feel using it?

fields.EN:
Um, a little easy to walk?
Thanks, Kaguya!
fields.JP:
あのね、なんかちょっとあるきやすい！
ありがとー！　かぐやー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, a little easy to walk?
Thanks, Kaguya!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you had a
cane on you.
fields.JP: かぐや、杖なんてよく持ってたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you had a
cane on you.

fields.EN:
It's just a showing of my
resolve.
fields.JP: これは、わらわの覚悟の表れなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a showing of my
resolve.

fields.EN:
It shows my resolve of moving
forward no matter what!
All for the sake of my friends!
fields.JP:
わらわはどんなに疲れても、
この杖をついてでも先へ進もうと覚悟して
いるんです！　すべてはみんなのために！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It shows my resolve of moving
forward no matter what!
All for the sake of my friends!

fields.JP: おおー！　なんという心意気だ！

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
I'm more than willing to
bathe in your praises.
fields.JP: ふふ、称賛は随時受付中です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
I'm more than willing to
bathe in your praises.

fields.EN:
Hm? But, you're always riding
on your thing there, so you don't
need a cane, do you?
fields.JP:
……あれ？
でもかぐやは乗り物に乗ってるから、
疲れても杖なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? But, you're always riding
on your thing there, so you don't
need a cane, do you?

fields.JP: さあ！　先に進みましょう！
つえであるくのらくになったーー！
よかったな、ラプンツェル！
……なんか、誤魔化された気がする

fields.EN:
Wait a minute... If she's riding
on that vehicle of hers, why don't
she let Rapunzel ride on it?
fields.JP:
ん？　っていうかそもそも、杖を貸すより、
ラプンツェルをあの乗り物に
乗せてあげればよかったんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute... If she's riding
on that vehicle of hers, why don't
she let Rapunzel ride on it?

fields.EN:
Maybe that cane is one of her
goof-off items... At the very
least, I doubt she even uses it.
fields.JP:
あの杖も『仕事してる風七つ道具』の
一つだったのかも。少なくとも、
絶対に自分で使う用じゃないよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that cane is one of her
goof-off items... At the very
least, I doubt she even uses it.

fields.EN:
She has seven of those items,
eh? She could put her efforts
towards something more fruitful.
fields.JP:
そんな下らない道具を七つも
持ち歩いてるのか……。相変わらず、
努力の方向が激しく間違ってる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She has seven of those items,
eh? She could put her efforts
towards something more fruitful.

fields.EN:
Otsuu!
Hurry it up, will you?!
fields.JP: おつう！　早く来ないと置いて行くぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu!
Hurry it up, will you?!

fields.EN:
Ah, Otsuu-san! Ningyohime-san!
What perfect timing.
fields.JP:
あ、おつうさん～、人魚姫さん～。
ちょうどいいところへ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Otsuu! Little Mermaid!
What perfect timing.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ちょうどいいところへって、どうかしたの？

fields.EN:
Do you mind getting me that
cup of water over there?
fields.JP:
あそこに水の入ったコップがあるので、
ちょっと取ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you mind getting me that
cup of water over there?

fields.JP: って、君からの距離のほうが近いじゃないか

fields.EN:
I don't want to move.
I was going to fill my spray
with it.
fields.JP:
動くのが面倒くさいんです～。
霧吹きに入れる用の水を用意したのに、
あそこに置き忘れてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to move.
I was going to fill my spray
with it.

fields.EN: Oh, uh... You didn't hear that!
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, uh... You didn't hear that!

fields.EN:
(Oh, she's talking about that
water bottle she used before...)
fields.JP: （ああ、あの『仕事してる風七つ道具』か……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, she's talking about that
water bottle she used before...)

fields.EN: Can you get it for me, please?
fields.JP: とにかく、取ってくれませんか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Can you get it for me, please?

fields.JP: ありがとうございます～

fields.EN:
You were within reach...
You sure are lazy, aren't you?
fields.JP:
こんなに近くにあるんだから
自分で取ればいいのに、本当に無精だな。
まったく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were within reach...
You sure are lazy, aren't you?

fields.EN:
But she always does her best,
so I don't mind seeing her
being lazy.
fields.JP:
でもいつもがんばってるんだし、
わたしたちの前でくらい、
だらだらさせてあげようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she always does her best,
so I don't mind seeing her
being lazy.

fields.EN:
How kind of you.
A true princess indeed!
fields.JP: なんてお優しい。さすがは僕の姫だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How kind of you.
A true princess indeed!

fields.EN:
But, she tries to be as lazy as
possible at all times. It's almost
as if that's her life's work...
fields.JP:
……だけど、かぐやは隙さえあれば
だらけているな。むしろだらけることに
全力を出しているというか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, she tries to be as lazy as
possible at all times. It's almost
as if that's her life's work...

fields.EN:
Maybe being lazy is her
Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
もしかして、だらけることが
血式リビドーなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe being lazy is her
Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, we're
not sure what her Blood
Libido is...
fields.JP:
そういえば、かぐやちゃんの
血式リビドーってよくわからないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, we're
not sure what her Blood
Libido is...

fields.EN:
I do have a Blood Libido. It's in
relation to a few items that were
lost.
fields.JP:
……血式リビドーはありますけど、
すでに失われた『物』に関することなんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do have a Blood Libido. It's in
relation to a few items that were
lost.

fields.EN:
Why yes. Nothing can be done
already, so you can forget
about it.
fields.JP:
そうです～。どうしようもないことなので、
もう放っておいてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. Nothing can be done
already, so you can forget
about it.

fields.EN:
(She sure looks sad...
Maybe she's trying to force
herself to forget...)
fields.JP:
（放っておいてなんて言ってるけど、
　なんだか寂しそうだな。無理やり
　諦めようとしてるだけかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sure looks sad...
Maybe she's trying to force
herself to forget...)

fields.EN:
It must have been something
very precious to you. Don't you
have any regrets?
fields.JP:
……かぐやちゃん、その『物』が
すごく大切だったんだね。
本当は今も心残りがあるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must have been something
very precious to you. Don't you
have any regrets?

fields.EN:
Not really... It's not like
I'll ever see any of them again.
fields.JP: 別に……どうせ二度と戻ってこないんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not really... It's not like
I'll ever see any of them again.

fields.EN:
But Blood Libido is something that
can bring intense pain and
suffering.
fields.JP:
だけど、血式リビドーって辛いでしょ。
わたしにもわかるもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Blood Libido is something that
can bring intense pain and
suffering.

fields.EN:
Maybe we can help.
We can look for them on our
expedition and things!
fields.JP:
少しでも力になれないかな？
探索中に見つかる物だったら、
わたしたちも探すの手伝うから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can help.
We can look for them on our
expedition and things!

fields.EN:
No need for that, really.
I'm fine.
fields.JP:
そんなのはしなくて大丈夫です～。
本当に、もういいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need for that, really.
I'm fine.

fields.EN:
But look at you... You look really
depressed. There's no way I can
leave you like that.
fields.JP:
でもかぐやちゃんがそんな悲しそうな顔
してるのに、放ってなんておけないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But look at you... You look really
depressed. There's no way I can
leave you like that.

fields.JP: そんなこと言わずに、ね？

fields.EN:
If you can at least tell us what
you lost then we can help.
fields.JP:
せめてなにを探せばいいのかだけ
教えてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can at least tell us what
you lost then we can help.

fields.JP: だから……いいって言ってるじゃないですか！

fields.EN:
I'm trying my best to forget about
it! Just leave me alone!
fields.JP:
人ががんばって諦めようとしているんだから、
放っておいてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm trying my best to forget about
it! Just leave me alone!

fields.EN:
You don't know anything!
Mind your own business!
fields.JP:
なにも知らないくせに、首突っ込んで……！
おせっかいなんです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know anything!
Mind your own business!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't know you
didn't want us to get involved.
I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさい。
そんなに嫌だったなんて……。
わたし、たしかにおせっかいだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't know you
didn't want us to get involved.
I'm sorry...

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Princess this
depressed before...)
fields.JP: （姫がこんなに悲しそうな顔を……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Princess this
depressed before...)

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you didn't need to yell
at her like that. She was trying
to help.
fields.JP:
かぐや。そんな言い方はないだろう。
姫は君のためを想って申し出てくれたんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you didn't need to yell
at her like that. She was trying
to help.

fields.EN: Well, keep your help to yourself.
fields.JP: 親切の押し売りは迷惑です～
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, keep your help to yourself.

fields.EN:
It's fine, Otsuu-chan. I didn't think
of how Kaguya felt and kept
pestering her.
fields.JP:
いいの、おつうちゃん。
わたしがかぐやちゃんの気持ちも考えず、
無神経なこと言っちゃっただけなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, Otsuu. I didn't think
of how Kaguya felt and kept
pestering her.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san, I know you meant well,
but really, you should mind your own business.
fields.JP:
……人魚姫さんに悪気がないのは
わかっています～。
でも、余計なお世話は迷惑なんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you meant well,
but really, you should mind your
own business.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... I guess I made you worry too,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
……ごめんね。
おつうちゃんにも気を遣わせちゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I guess I made you feel bad,
too...

fields.EN:
You don't need to apologize.
If anything, Kaguya should be the
one to apologize here.
fields.JP:
姫が謝ることなどなにもありません。
せっかくの姫の厚意を無碍にした、
かぐやのほうが悪いんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to apologize.
If anything, Kaguya should be the
one to apologize here.

fields.EN:
But she's right...
If she doesn't want help, then
I should mind my own business...
fields.JP:
でも、かぐやちゃんの言う通りだよ。
親切の押し売りは迷惑って
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she's right...
If she doesn't want help, then
I should mind my own business...

fields.EN:
I guess it was something she
didn't want to have people
getting into.
fields.JP:
……かぐやちゃんにとっては
踏み込まれたくない問題だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it was something she
didn't want to have people
getting into.

fields.JP: （たしかにそうなのかもしれない。だけど……）

fields.EN:
That still doesn't mean Kaguya
can talk like that. You really did
nothing wrong.
fields.JP:
……それでも、あんな言われ方をしていい
理由にはなりません。姫はなにも悪くない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That still doesn't mean Kaguya
can talk like that. You really did
nothing wrong.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(This is awkward...
This is the first time we're face-to face
since Kaguya went on her tirade.)
fields.JP:
（き、気まずい……。この間の一件以来、
　ちゃんと顔を合わせるのは初めてだからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is awkward...
This is the first time we're face-to face
since Kaguya went on her tirade.)

fields.EN:
(We don't need to apologize,
and I doubt Kaguya would
apologize. What to do...)
fields.JP:
（でもこちらから謝ることでもないし、
　かといってあっちが謝るとも思えないし……。
　どうしたらいいんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We don't need to apologize,
and I doubt Kaguya would
apologize. What to do...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about the last time.
I think I went too far.
fields.JP:
……この間は、わらわも言いすぎました～……。
すみませんでした～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about the last time.
I think I went too far.

fields.JP: かぐやちゃん、こっちこそごめんね！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(I guess what happened back then
bothered Kaguya, too...)
fields.JP: （この間のこと、かぐやなりに気にしてたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess what happened back then
bothered Kaguya, too...)

fields.EN:
Thank you for being worried
about me and my Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
お二人とも、先日は血式リビドーのことで
心配してくれて、その……
ありがとうございました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for being worried
about me and my Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
It's just that I rarely ever have
anyone worried over me, so
I just went out of control.
fields.JP:
そういう気遣いに慣れていなかったもので、
つい、きつい態度を取ってしまったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that I rarely ever have
anyone worried over me, so
I just went out of control.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. It doesn't bother me
anymore. If there's something
you want to discuss, let us know.
fields.JP:
もう気にしてないよ。
でもなにかあれば相談してね。
わたしたちも力になれるかもしれないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. It doesn't bother me
anymore. If there's something
you want to discuss, let us know.

fields.EN:
We both understand how tough it
is to have a Blood Libido, so come
see us if you want to talk.
fields.JP:
うん。僕達も血式リビドーの
苦しさみたいなものは知っているから、
話したくなったらいつでも聞くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We both understand how tough it
is to have a Blood Libido, so come
see us if you want to talk.

fields.JP: おつうさん、人魚姫さん……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
W-Well, if that's the case, do you
mind if we talk right now?
fields.JP:
そ、それなら……今、聞いてもらっても
いいですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, if that's the case, do you
mind if we talk right now?

fields.EN:
(Maybe Kaguya wanted to talk
about her Blood Libido
all along...)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたらかぐやは、
　ずっと誰かに話を聞いてもらい
　たかったのかもしれないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Kaguya wanted to talk
about her Blood Libido
all along...)

fields.EN:
Do you remember what I said
about my Blood Libido? Well,
it's that I seek "five treasures."
fields.JP:
前にも少しお話しましたが、
わらわの血式リビドーは、ある物……
『五つの宝物を欲する』というものなんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you remember what I said
about my Blood Libido? Well,
it's that I seek "five treasures."

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, those treasures
have been taken away from me, and
I don't know where they are now.
fields.JP:
でもその宝物は取り上げられてしまって、
今はどこにあるのかわからないんです～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, those treasures
have been taken away from me, and
I don't know where they are now.

fields.JP: 取り上げられたって、誰に？

fields.EN:
Hm?
What are you girls doing there?
fields.JP: ん？　お前ら、そんなとこでなにしてるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm?
What are you girls doing there?

fields.EN:
Oh, well, we were just talking
a bit, and...
fields.JP: ああ、うん。ちょっとした立ち話を
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, well, we were just talking
a bit, and...

fields.EN:
Wha-?! What the...?!
What is it?!
fields.JP: うお、びっくりした。なんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?! What the...?!
What is it?!

fields.EN:
M-M-M-Mamoru-san!
Th-That thing you have there...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!
fields.JP:
マ、ママママモルさんっ！
そ、その手に持っているものは……っ、
燕の子安貝～！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-M-M-Mamoru!
Th-That thing you have there...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: マモルさん => Mamoru-san

fields.EN:
Pretty cool, huh? I found it when
I was salvaging for parts at
the old Liberated District.
fields.JP:
ああ、これか。元開放地区を漁ってるときに、
偶然見つけたんだ。へへっ、いいだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pretty cool, huh? I found it when
I was salvaging for parts at
the old Liberated District.

fields.JP:
あ、あの、そそそれは実はその、
わ、わらわは、えーと、その……！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan... Maybe that's one of
the treasures Kaguya is looking
for...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、もしかして、
あれが『五つの宝物』の一つなんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Maybe that's one of
the treasures Kaguya is looking
for...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I see... That would explain why
Kaguya is all flustered seeing it.
fields.JP:
そうか。それがいきなり目の前に現れたから、
かぐやはこんなにテンパっているのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... That would explain why
Kaguya is all flustered seeing it.

fields.EN:
Mamoru, what you have there is
probably something precious
that Kaguyahime lost.
fields.JP:
……マモル。君が見つけたっていうそれは、
もしかしたらかぐや姫が前になくした
大切な物かもしれないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, what you have there is
probably something precious
that Kaguya lost.

fields.EN: Do you mind if we take a look?
fields.JP: 悪いけど、ちょっと見せてもらってもいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you mind if we take a look?

fields.EN:
Thank you...
Kaguya? Is this one of them?
fields.JP:
ありがとう。……かぐや、
これは君の大切な宝物で間違いないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you...
Kaguya? Is this one of them?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... That's it...
It's one of my five treasures...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!
fields.JP:
は、はい。そうです……。
これはたしかに、わらわの『五つの宝物』の
一つ、『燕の子安貝』です～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... That's it...
It's one of my five treasures...
The Swallow's Cowry Shell!

fields.EN:
It's amazing we came across
one of your treasures like this.
fields.JP:
話しているちょうどそのときに
見つかるなんて、すごい偶然だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's amazing we came across
one of your treasures like this.

fields.EN:
Uh, um... Mamoru-san?
Do you mind giving it to me?
fields.JP:
あ、あの、マモルさん。
これを譲っていただけますか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, um... Mamoru?
Do you mind giving it to me?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: マモルさん => Mamoru-san

fields.EN:
Mind? It's yours, right?
Take it.
fields.JP:
譲るもなにも、今の話聞いてたら、
もともとお前の物なんだろ？
お前が持っておけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind? It's yours, right?
Take it.

fields.JP: あ……ありがとうございます～！

fields.EN:
Well, I gotta go now.
Not sure what happened, but you
be careful not to lose it again.
fields.JP:
じゃーな。よくわかんないけど、
大事な物ならもうなくすなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I gotta go now.
Not sure what happened, but you
be careful not to lose it again.

fields.JP: よかったね、かぐやちゃん！

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san... Ningyohime-san...
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
おつうさん、人魚姫さん、
ありがとうございました～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Little Mermaid...
Thank you so very much!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
Heh heh heh heh...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
Heh heh heh heh...

fields.JP: かぐやちゃんったら、すごく嬉しそう

fields.EN:
She did get one of her treasures
back after all.
fields.JP:
大事な宝物が一つでも手元に戻ったんだから、
当然だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did get one of her treasures
back after all.

fields.EN:
Oh, but that's not the only
reason I'm happy.
fields.JP:
はい～！
……でもそれだけじゃなくて、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but that's not the only
reason I'm happy.

fields.EN:
I'm even happier knowing that
you both were worried about me
to this extent.
fields.JP:
お二人がわらわのことを
自分のことのように心配してくれたのが、
とても嬉しかったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm even happier knowing that
you both were worried about me
to this extent.

fields.JP: だって、かぐやちゃんは大事な仲間だもん

fields.EN:
As long as you're happy,
all is good.
fields.JP: かぐやが元気になってくれてよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're happy,
all is good.

fields.EN:
Thank you.
And, it's all because of you two.
fields.JP: はい～。みんなのおかげです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you.
And, it's all because of you two.

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Kaguya smile like
that before. It looks like she's a
bit more friendly now.)
fields.JP:
（かぐやのこんな晴れやかな笑顔は
　初めて見たかも。
　前より心を開いてくれたみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Kaguya smile like
that before. It looks like she's a
bit more friendly now.)

fields.EN:
(I'm just as happy as her now.
I can only hope we can strengthen
our friendship even further.)
fields.JP:
（こっちこそすごく嬉しいよ、かぐや。
　これからも仲良くできるといいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm just as happy as her now.
I can only hope we can strengthen
our friendship even further.)

fields.JP: いいもの持って来たよ！

fields.EN:
Huh, your room is cluttered just
borderline of calling the place
dirty...
fields.JP:
おお、相変わらず微妙な散らかり具合の
部屋だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, your room is cluttered just
borderline of calling the place
dirty...

fields.EN:
Did you come here to pick a
fight? I thought you came here
saying you brought something.
fields.JP:
喧嘩を売りに来たんですか～？
いいものを持って来たと聞いたんですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you come here to pick a
fight? I thought you came here
saying you brought something.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. We came because
we wanted to give you this...
fields.JP:
ごめんごめん。
実は、これを君に渡したくてさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. We came because
we wanted to give you this...

fields.EN:
These are the four remaining
treasures, right? Here, they're
for you!
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんの『五つの宝物』の残り四つ、
これでいいんだよね？
これで五つ全部揃ったね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
These are the four remaining
treasures, right? Here, they're
for you!

fields.JP: きゃあっ、かぐやちゃんが倒れた！

fields.EN:
Uh... Ah... Urh...
I-I was just surprised, and...
I didn't expect...
fields.JP:
あ……あう、あうぅ～。
あまりにも驚いてしまって……
だって、まさか本当に～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Ah... Urh...
I-I was just surprised, and...
I didn't expect...

fields.EN:
Th-These are... These...!
Are...! Uh... Ah...!
fields.JP:
こ、これはたしかにわらわの……
ああう、あうあう～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-These are... These...!
Are...! Uh... Ah...!

fields.EN:
Looks like she's at a loss for
words.
fields.JP: 言葉にならないみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's at a loss for
words.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect her to be that
surprised...
fields.JP: これほど驚かれるのは予想外だったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect her to be that
surprised...

fields.EN:
Aah...!
I-I can't hold myself back!
Th-Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ、ああ、
つい興奮してしまいました～。
本当にありがとうございます～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah...!
I-I can't hold myself back!
