Th-Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
It's nothing.
We're friends after all.
fields.JP: まぁ、これくらい仲間なんだから当然だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing.
We're friends after all.

fields.EN:
Then again, it did take a while to
get them together, but we wanted
to see you happy, so... yeah...
fields.JP:
たしかにこれをすべて揃えるのは
けっこう大変だったけど、
君に喜んでほしくてね。ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, it did take a while to
get them together, but we wanted
to see you happy, so... yeah...

fields.EN:
Oh, but you owe us one.
Got it?
fields.JP: あ、でも貸しってことだからね、うん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but you owe us one.
Got it?

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: I don't think she hears you...
fields.JP:
たぶんかぐやちゃん、
もう聞いてないと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think she hears you...

fields.EN:
Aah... My precious treasures
are back in my hands...
Heh heh heh heh...
fields.JP:
ああ～、大事な大事な『五つの宝物』～。
やっとわらわのもとに戻ってきた～。
ふふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... My precious treasures
are back in my hands...
Heh heh heh heh...

fields.EN: As long as she's happy, I suppose.
fields.JP: ……まぁ、喜んでくれたならいいけど
fields.LOCALIZED: As long as she's happy, I suppose.

fields.EN:
I didn't know she could smile
like that... Who would've known?
fields.JP:
かぐやちゃんってこんなに
無邪気な顔で笑うんだね。
こんな表情、初めて見た
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know she could smile
like that... Who would've known?

fields.EN:
Indeed. I'm really glad we
brought them to her.
fields.JP:
そうですね。
……本当、喜んでくれてよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I'm really glad we
brought them to her.

fields.EN:
Aah...
Thank you so very much...
fields.JP: はぁ……ありがとうございます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah...
Thank you so very much...

fields.EN:
You're welcome. I'm glad those
are back in your hands.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして。
宝物が手元に戻ってよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're welcome. I'm glad those
are back in your hands.

fields.EN:
Why yes...
And, you know what?
fields.JP:
はい～。
でも、それだけじゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes...
And, you know what?

fields.EN:
I'm just happy to know you both
went through the trouble of
finding them all.
fields.JP:
二人がこの宝物をがんばって集めて
くれたことが、同じくらい嬉しいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy to know you both
went through the trouble of
finding them all.

fields.EN: It's not just because I got my treasures back. Somehow, I feel strangely fulfilled inside~
fields.JP:
宝物が戻ったからだけではなく、なんだか
不思議と心が満たされた感じがします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting the treasures back is one
thing, but seeing what you've done
has filled me with great joy.

fields.EN:
We're happy to hear that. I guess
it was all worth the trouble.
Isn't that right, Princess?
fields.JP:
そう言ってもらえると、
僕達の苦労も報われるよ。
……よかったですね、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're happy to hear that. I guess
it was all worth the trouble.
Isn't that right, Princess?

fields.EN:
All done...
It looks better already...
fields.JP: ……よし。これできれいになりました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
All done...
It looks better already...

fields.JP:
あら……？
あなた今、メガネを拭いていたわよね
え？　そ、そうですけど……

fields.EN:
(Kaguya and Gretel?
What could those two be talking
about...?)
fields.JP:
（かぐやとグレーテル……？
　珍しい組み合わせでなに話してるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya and Gretel?
What could those two be talking
about...?)

fields.EN:
I noticed that the lenses lack
the proper corrective features
normally found in other glasses.
fields.JP:
外したメガネをちらりと見たけど、
それ、度が入っていないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I noticed that the lenses lack
the proper corrective features
normally found in other glasses.

fields.EN:
Are you hiding something in
regards to those glasses?
fields.JP:
……ひょっとして、そのメガネには
なにか秘密があるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you hiding something in
regards to those glasses?

fields.EN:
I'm inquiring purely from
curiosity. I have no intention of
telling others.
fields.JP:
別に口外するつもりはないわ。
ただ、伊達メガネをかける理由に
興味が湧いただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm inquiring purely from
curiosity. I have no intention of
telling others.

fields.EN:
So, you really want to know
the secret of these glasses?
fields.JP: ……わらわの秘密を知りたいと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you really want to know
the secret of these glasses?

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
I must say, you have fine taste in
taking interest in these.
fields.JP:
……ふふふ、これに興味を持つなんて、
目の付け所が違いますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
I must say, you have fine taste in
taking interest in these.

fields.EN:
This is one of my special goof-off
items... The "Smart Mistress!"
fields.JP:
これはずばり、『仕事してる風七つ道具』
の一つ、通称『働く女の知性』です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is one of my special goof-off
items... The "Smart Mistress!"

fields.EN:
(Oh, she's going to tell her what
it is? I guess she wanted to
brag about it...)
fields.JP:
（あ、教えちゃうのか。
　……まさか、誰かに自慢しくて
　うずうずしてたんじゃないだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, she's going to tell her what
it is? I guess she wanted to
brag about it...)

fields.JP:
『仕事してる風七つ道具』？
なにやら面白そうね

fields.EN:
As its name states, the goof-off
items are made to make it look
like you're working.
fields.JP:
『仕事してる風七つ道具』とは、
その名の通り、仕事をしている風を
装うためのアイテムです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
As its name states, the goof-off
items are made to make it look
like you're working.

fields.EN:
With these, you can make others
feel like you're working hard.
fields.JP:
これがあれば、働いていないのに
なんとなく働き者と思わせることが
できるんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
With these, you can make others
feel like you're working hard.

fields.EN:
So you're deceiving others with
them? Your ingenuity is quite
impressive.
fields.JP:
働いていないのに、働き者と思わせる……？
すごいわ。凡人の発想ではないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're deceiving others with
them? Your ingenuity is quite
impressive.

fields.EN:
I'm quite surprised you kept
such items hidden with you.
Do you have more of them?
fields.JP:
七つ道具ということは他にもあるのかしら。
あなたがまさかそんな秘密道具を
持っていたなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite surprised you kept
such items hidden with you.
Do you have more of them?

fields.EN:
I see you're a lady who
appreciates true value.
Let me show you a bit more.
fields.JP:
物の価値がわかる人ですね～。
あなたには特別に、七つ道具の一部を
紹介してあげます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see you're a lady who
appreciates true value.
Let me show you a bit more.

fields.EN:
These glasses were specially
crafted so that an excessive
amount of light reflects off them.
fields.JP:
まずこの伊達メガネ、通称『働く女の知性』は、
レンズに細工がしてあって
光を無駄に反射しやすくなってます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
These glasses were specially
crafted so that an excessive
amount of light reflects off them.

fields.EN:
It hides the wearer's eyes,
thus making it seem like the
wearer is working studiously.
fields.JP:
目元が隠れることで、
なにもしてなくても仕事してる
雰囲気が出るんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It hides the wearer's eyes,
thus making it seem like the
wearer is working studiously.

fields.JP: なるほど。斬新なアイディアだわ

fields.EN:
The glasses also help persuade
others as it makes the wearer look
smarter and more convincing.
fields.JP:
しかもメガネをかけているだけで
頭が良さそうに見えて発言に説得力が出るので、
話し合いのときにはもってこいなんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The glasses also help persuade
others as it makes the wearer look
smarter and more convincing.

fields.EN:
It's true that people judge others
by their looks. So this uses that
to the wearer's advantage.
fields.JP:
たしかに人は外見でその人間を判断しがちだわ。
それを逆手に取った作戦ということね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true that people judge others
by their looks. So this uses that
to the wearer's advantage.

fields.EN:
(Is she serious...?
Their conversation sounds pretty
stupid, but...)
fields.JP:
（いや、それで納得していいのか？
　話してる内容は果てしなく
　馬鹿馬鹿しく聞こえるんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she serious...?
Their conversation sounds pretty
stupid, but...)

fields.EN:
Next, the "Weathered Notebook."
It's been crafted so that each
page inside is crumpled.
fields.JP:
次に『へろへろの手帳と赤ペン』です～。
メモ帳を一ページずつくしゃくしゃにした
逸品なんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next, the "Weathered Notebook."
It's been crafted so that each
page inside is crumpled.

fields.JP: これはどうやって使うものなの？

fields.EN:
Simply holding onto it will make
it seem like you're taking notes.
fields.JP:
これを持っているだけで、
真面目にメモを取っている雰囲気を
醸し出せるんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Simply holding onto it will make
it seem like you're taking notes.

fields.EN:
The pages gives it a well-used
touch, and the red pen that comes
with it adds a bit of flair to it.
fields.JP:
ページがヘロヘロだとたくさん
メモしてある感じに見えますし、
ペンも赤色だと印象に残りやすいんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The pages gives it a well-used
touch, and the red pen that comes
with it adds a bit of flair to it.

fields.EN:
People who are studious are
often favorably looked upon
regardless of their achievements.
fields.JP:
たしかに勤勉な人間は、
成果を出していなくても好感を
持たれやすいものだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
People who are studious are
often favorably looked upon
regardless of their achievements.

fields.EN:
I'm quite impressed that you
placed emphasis on image
than results...
fields.JP:
実際に勤勉であることより、
勤勉に見えることに重点を置くなんて……。
その発想は画期的だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite impressed that you
placed emphasis on image
than results...

fields.JP: （いや、単に怠け者なだけだろ……）

fields.EN:
Oh, and I have this bottle here
that can be used to make it
look like you're sweating, and...
fields.JP: 他にも、この霧吹きで汗を演出したりとか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and I have this bottle here
that can be used to make it
look like you're sweating, and...

fields.JP: 独創的なアイディアね。ふふふ……

fields.EN:
(They're really going at it...
I thought Kaguya's items were
supposed to be secret...)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ、なんか変な盛り上がり方してるけど、
　あんなにバラしちゃ駄目じゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're really going at it...
I thought Kaguya's items were
supposed to be secret...)

fields.EN:
Heh heh. Gretel-san, you really have a good
eye for these things.
fields.JP:
ふふ、グレーテルさんは
目の付け所がいいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh. I have to say again,
you have great tastes.

fields.EN:
I'm more impressed that you
have such an interesting mindset.
fields.JP: あなたこそ、興味深い発想の持ち主だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm more impressed that you
have such an interesting mindset.

fields.EN:
(Well, looks like they're having
fun, so I guess I can leave them
be...)
fields.JP:
（……でもまぁ、本人たちは
　楽しそうだからいいか。
　僕は邪魔しないでおこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, looks like they're having
fun, so I guess I can leave them
be...)

fields.EN:
(Huh? I hear someone...
Is it coming from those two?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、ひそひそ声が聞こえる……。
　あの二人、内緒話か？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? I hear someone...
Is it coming from those two?)

fields.JP: ……では、確実に殺せるんですね？

fields.EN:
Yes, this poison should do the
trick...
fields.JP: はい、この毒は効きますから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, this poison should do the
trick...

fields.EN:
(K-Kill?! Poison?!
Am I hearing them right?!)
fields.JP:
（こ、殺す！？　毒！？
　すごい物騒なワードが聞こえてきたけど！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(K-Kill?! Poison?!
Am I hearing them right?!)

fields.EN:
I still can't believe such filth
appeared in my room...
fields.JP:
はぁ……。まさかわらわの部屋に、
あのような汚らわしいものが出るなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still can't believe such filth
appeared in my room...

fields.EN:
Yes, I know how you feel.
It's quite disgusting to find
roaches running around...
fields.JP:
やっぱり嫌ですよね。
部屋にゴキ……害虫が出るのって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I know how you feel.
It's quite disgusting to find
roaches running around...

fields.EN:
In any case, I'm very happy
you had the poison feed to
use against them.
fields.JP:
このたびは害虫退治用の毒団子を
用意してくださって、本当に助かりました
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I'm very happy
you had the poison feed to
use against them.

fields.EN: I'm glad to be of help.
fields.JP: いえ、お役に立ててよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad to be of help.

fields.EN:
But, I don't think the poison will
resolve the situation. Um... You
do keep your room clean, right?
fields.JP:
でも毒団子じゃ根本的な解決には
ならないと思うんです。あの……失礼ですが、
ちゃんと掃除してますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I don't think the poison will
resolve the situation. Um... You
do keep your room clean, right?

fields.EN:
I can say that I have everything
positioned, so all that I need
is within reach...
fields.JP:
……必要な物はすべて、
その場から動かなくてもすぐに
手の届くところに配置しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can say that I have everything
positioned, so all that I need
is within reach...

fields.EN:
Um... So, that means your place
isn't clean then?
fields.JP:
えっと、それって散らかってるって
ことじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... So, that means your place
isn't clean then?

fields.EN:
I'm simply decorating my room
so that it fits my lifestyle.
fields.JP:
わらわの生活スタイルに合った
インテリアコーディネートにしてるだけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm simply decorating my room
so that it fits my lifestyle.

fields.EN:
(I guess that's one way of
wording it? Still, that's a
tough excuse to swallow.)
fields.JP: （物は言いよう！　強引に押し通した！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's one way of
wording it? Still, that's a
tough excuse to swallow.)

fields.EN:
I-I see...
You must have... a very lively
room...
fields.JP:
そ、そうですか……。
つまり賑やかなお部屋ということですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see...
You must have... a very lively
room...

fields.EN:
(I guess that's just Shirayuki's
way of trying to keep things
mellow...)
fields.JP:
（そして白雪もマイルドな言い回しに！
　気を遣ってあげたんだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's just Snow White's
way of trying to keep things
mellow...)

fields.EN:
Still, I suggest you reduce the
general clutter in your room. That
would help keep the bugs in check.
fields.JP:
だけどできれば、部屋にある物は
少なくしたほうがいいですよ。
害虫が隠れられる場所をなくすんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I suggest you reduce the
general clutter in your room. That
would help keep the bugs in check.

fields.EN:
You need to do something other
than using poison if you really
want to get rid of them for good.
fields.JP:
そうじゃないと、毒団子を置くだけじゃ
根本的な解決にならないというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to do something other
than using poison if you really
want to get rid of them for good.

fields.JP: 部屋の片づけなんて無理です

fields.EN: It's never too late to start.
fields.JP: 諦めるのは早いですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's never too late to start.

fields.EN:
But, can you imagine what
would happen if one of those
roaches appeared during cleaning?
fields.JP:
無理です。だって片づけの最中に、
物陰からあの害虫が飛び出してきたら
どうするんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, can you imagine what
would happen if one of those
roaches appeared during cleaning?

fields.JP: そ、それは……たしかに怖いです

fields.EN:
Right? The reason I don't clean
my room is because I'm scared
of them.
fields.JP:
そうでしょう？
わらわが部屋を片付けられないのは、
害虫が怖いからなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? The reason I don't clean
my room is because I'm scared
of them.

fields.EN:
(She's lying...
That's not the reason why
she can't clean her room.)
fields.JP:
（絶対嘘だ。かぐやが部屋を片付けられない
　理由は、それじゃないと思う……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's lying...
That's not the reason why
she can't clean her room.)

fields.EN:
Poor Kaguya!
To think that you can't clean your
room because of those vermin!
fields.JP:
害虫が怖くて部屋を片付けられないなんて、
かぐやさん、かわいそうです……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Poor Kaguya!
To think that you can't clean your
room because of those vermin!

fields.EN:
Understood...
Let me show you how to make
"Super Roach Poison" then!
fields.JP:
……わかりました。
この毒団子よりもさらに強力な、
『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』の作り方をお教えします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood...
Let me show you how to make
"Super Roach Poison" then!

fields.EN:
(That sounds horrible!
Did Shirayuki really come up
with that name?)
fields.JP:
（なんか物騒なネーミング来た！
　っていうか、白雪がその名称考えたのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That sounds horrible!
Did Snow White really come up
with that name?)

fields.EN:
"Super Roach Poison?!"
That sounds quite potent.
fields.JP:
『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』……！？
なんだかすごく効きそうな感じです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Super Roach Poison?!"
That sounds quite potent.

fields.EN:
Let me explain how you make it.
First you...
fields.JP:
ではかぐやさん、『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』の
作り方を説明しますね。まず最初に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me explain how you make it.
First you...

fields.EN:
(Kaguya's taking notes? She's not
faking that? She must really hate
those roaches...)
fields.JP:
（おお、あのかぐやが真剣にメモを取っている。
　メモを取っているふりじゃなくて……。
　よっぽど切実なんだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya's taking notes? She's not
faking that? She must really hate
those roaches...)

fields.EN:
There you have it...
That's how you make it.
fields.JP: ……と、このような方法で作ることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you have it...
That's how you make it.

fields.EN:
I see. I'm very surprised you
use "that" ingredient to make it.
fields.JP:
そうなんですね。
まさかそんな意外な材料を使うなんて、
目からウロコです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. I'm very surprised you
use "that" ingredient to make it.

fields.JP: （意外な材料？　……なにを使うんだ？）

fields.EN:
If possible, can you make one
now so that I can see what it
will end up like?
fields.JP:
でも実物を見ないとよくわからないので、
一度作ってもらっていいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If possible, can you make one
now so that I can see what it
will end up like?

fields.EN:
(I take that back. Kaguya is lazy.
She's going to make Shirayuki
make it...)
fields.JP:
（あ、白雪に作ってもらって楽するつもりだ、
　これ。そんなに切実じゃなかった。
　しかもよく見ればメモも書いてなさげ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I take that back. Kaguya is lazy.
She's going to make Snow White
make it...)

fields.EN:
You want to see one in the making?
I suppose you should see one made
to truly understand.
fields.JP:
実物ですか……、わかりました。
たしかに説明を聞いただけじゃ
作れないかもしれませんよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want to see one in the making?
I suppose you should see one made
to truly understand.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much.
Heh heh... That should get rid of
every one of them...
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
ふふふ、これで一匹残らず殲滅です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much.
Heh heh... That should get rid of
every one of them...

fields.EN:
I can guarantee it'll work!
Let's do our best killing them!
fields.JP:
『Ｇ滅殺毒団子・改』なら絶対効きますよ。
がんばって殺しましょうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can guarantee it'll work!
Let's do our best killing them!

fields.EN:
Yes, we will eradicate them
into oblivion... Heh heh...
fields.JP:
はい。必ず息の根を止めてやりましょう～
ふふふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we will eradicate them
into oblivion... Heh heh...

fields.EN:
(I can't believe how casually they
talk about killing and things.
They're starting to scare me...)
fields.JP:
（話し方はほのぼのしてるのに、
　話してる内容は怖い！　むしろ二人の
　害虫への殺意が地味に怖い！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe how casually they
talk about killing and things.
They're starting to scare me...)

fields.EN:
(I'm interested in the ingredient
Kaguya mentioned, but I better
not get too involved...)
fields.JP:
（意外な材料っていうのは気になるけど、
　知らないでいたほうが身のためかもな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm interested in the ingredient
Kaguya mentioned, but I better
not get too involved...)

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime's still not here...
I thought I told her it's
something important...)
fields.JP:
（大事な話し合いがあるっていうのに、
　時間になってもかぐや姫が来ない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya's still not here...
I thought I told her it's
something important...)

fields.EN:
(Everyone is so bored waiting that
they're starting to do their own
things. What a waste of time...)
fields.JP:
（待ちくたびれたみんなは怒るやら
　心配するやら、しまいにはヒマつぶしに
　ゲームまで始める始末。もうぐだぐだだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone is so bored waiting that
they're starting to do their own
things. What a waste of time...)

fields.EN:
(I better go and check on Kaguyahime.
Let's see what she has to say...)
fields.JP:
（仕方がないので、僕がかぐや姫の部屋
　まで様子を見に行くことになった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better go and check on Kaguya.
Let's see what she has to say...)

fields.EN: Thanks for coming with me, Jack.
fields.JP: 付き合ってくれてありがとう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks for coming with me, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
おづう、だぎぎ……べん……ぎぎぎ

fields.EN:
Thanks for caring.
You're a great guy, you know that?
fields.JP:
ああ、僕の苦労をわかってくれるんだね。
なんて優しい奴なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for caring.
You're a great guy, you know that?

fields.EN:
Kaguya.
What's taking you so long?
fields.JP: かぐやー。もう話し合いの時間すぎてるぞー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya.
What's taking you so long?

fields.EN:
(No reply...
Maybe she's so sick that
she can't leave her room...)
fields.JP:
（返事がない……。
　まさか具合が悪くなって部屋の中で
　倒れてるんじゃないだろうな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No reply...
Maybe she's so sick that
she can't leave her room...)

fields.EN:
Kaguya? Are you in there?
I'm coming in.
fields.JP: かぐやー、いるんだろー？　開けるぞー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya? Are you in there?
I'm coming in.

fields.EN:
Wha-?!
She's down on her bed!
fields.JP:
はっ！
かぐやがベッドの上に倒れてる……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha-?!
She's down on her bed!

fields.JP: って、違う！　ただ寝てるだけだ！

fields.EN:
Kaguya, wake up.
Come on now.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, wake up.
Come on now.

fields.EN:
You can't be serious!
Most people ask for five minutes,
not five hours!
fields.JP:
ずいぶん大胆な時間を要求してくるね！？
普通そこは五分とかだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't be serious!
Most people ask for five minutes,
not five hours!

fields.EN:
But... So sleepy...
The pillow is so soft and comfy...
fields.JP:
だって、眠くて……。
この低反発枕が気持ちよすぎるんです～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... So sleepy...
The pillow is so soft and comfy...

fields.EN:
Oh, you're using it?
I didn't notice it since it's so
clean.
fields.JP:
あ、その枕使ってくれてたんだ。
きれいになってたから気づかなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're using it?
I didn't notice it since it's so
clean.

fields.EN:
I washed, dried, then wrapped a
clean towel around it. It feels so
good that I can sleep forever.
fields.JP:
洗って乾かして、きれいな布を巻きつけ
ましたからね～。もう寝心地がよすぎて、
毎晩永眠しちゃいそうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I washed, dried, then wrapped a
clean towel around it. It feels so
good that I can sleep forever.

fields.EN:
I hope you don't...
Well, I'm just happy you like
it so much.
fields.JP:
はは、永眠は困るな。
でもそこまで気に入ってもらえると
思わなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope you don't...
Well, I'm just happy you like
it so much.

fields.EN:
It won't let me go...
So please, let me sleep for
another six hours...
fields.JP:
もうこの枕と離れられないんです～。
そういうわけなので、あと六時間
寝かせてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It won't let me go...
So please, let me sleep for
another six hours...

fields.EN:
No!
And, no adding to the time!
fields.JP:
だから駄目だって！
何気にさっきより一時間増えてるし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No!
And, no adding to the time!

fields.EN:
I know I should wake up...
But, this is my very best
trying to get myself up...
fields.JP:
わらわだって、これじゃいけないと
思ってるんです～。これでも懸命に
起きようとしてるんですけど～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I should wake up...
But, this is my very best
trying to get myself up...

fields.EN:
That's your best?
Come on, wake up already.
fields.JP:
全然起きれてないじゃん……。
ほら、いい加減起きて
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's your best?
Come on, wake up already.

fields.EN:
Aah... The pillow conforms to my
head beautifully...
I don't want to get up...
fields.JP:
ああ、この甘美な頭のフィット感が
堪りません～。まだ起きたくないです～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... The pillow conforms to my
head beautifully...
I don't want to get up...

fields.EN:
Otsuu... Please...
Can you have the discussion
without me...?
fields.JP:
おつう、お願いです～。
わらわの代理として、話し合いに
参加してきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... Please...
Can you have the discussion
without me...?

fields.EN:
I'm also a bit thirsty,
so bring me a glass of water...
fields.JP:
あと喉が渇いてきたので、
お水を持ってきてください～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm also a bit thirsty,
so bring me a glass of water...

fields.EN:
Please don't use me as your
gofer...
fields.JP: 僕をパシらせないでほしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't use me as your
gofer...

fields.EN: Jack-san, can you get me water?
fields.JP: じゃあ、ジャックさんでもいいですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, can you get me water?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
かぐや、ジャックを無駄に困らせないで

fields.EN:
(She's even lazier than before...
There's no way she'll join in
this state...)
fields.JP:
（普段のグータラに拍車がかかってる……。
　こんな状態じゃ話し合いに参加させるのは
　無理そうだな。はぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's even lazier than before...
There's no way she'll join in
this state...)

fields.EN: You must really like that pillow.
fields.JP: その枕、よっぽど気に入ったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: You must really like that pillow.

fields.EN:
Why yes...
I can't let it go...
fields.JP: はい～。もう離れられません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes...
I can't let it go...

fields.EN:
I guess I can let you go...
I know you'll carry your load,
so enjoy your sleep for today.
fields.JP:
まぁ、そこまで言うなら今日のところは
いいや。かぐやはやるときはやってくれるから、
今は寝ていなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I can let you go...
I know you'll carry your load,
so enjoy your sleep for today.

fields.EN:
I knew you'd understand, Otsuu...
Thank you...
fields.JP: おつうは理解がありますね～。助かります～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew you'd understand, Otsuu...
Thank you...

fields.EN:
Oh, before you go, do you mind
taking me to the bathroom?
I think I'm going to leak...
fields.JP:
助かるついでに、わらわの代わりに
お手洗いに行ってきてくれませんか～？
もう漏れちゃいそうで～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, before you go, do you mind
taking me to the bathroom?
I think I'm going to leak...

fields.JP: いや、それは自分で行って

fields.EN:
Oyayubi, it's me.
Do you mind if I come in?
fields.JP: 親指……僕だけど、入っていい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, it's me.
Do you mind if I come in?

fields.JP:
おつう？
……いいわよ。入って

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
Is there something you need?
fields.JP: どうしたの？　何か用？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
Is there something you need?

fields.EN:
Nothing in particular.
I just stopped by since I happened
to be around.
fields.JP:
いや、用があるわけじゃないんだけど
近くまで来たから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing in particular.
I just stopped by since I happened
to be around.

fields.JP: そう……まぁ、ちょうどいいわ

fields.EN:
For something I wanted to say
to you.
fields.JP:
あんたが用はなくても、
こっちにはあるってことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For something I wanted to say
to you.

fields.EN:
Now that's unusual,
you wanting to speak with me.
fields.JP:
君が僕と話をしたいだなんて、
珍しいこともあるものだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that's unusual,
you wanting to speak with me.

fields.EN: Is that supposed to be sarcastic?
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that supposed to be sarcastic?

fields.EN:
Not at all.
I'm actually quite honored.
fields.JP:
ふざけてなんかいないさ。
光栄だと言ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all.
I'm actually quite honored.

fields.EN:
So, what is it that you wanted
to say?
fields.JP: それで、いったいどんな話なのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what is it that you wanted
to say?

fields.EN: I-I'm sorry about the last time!
fields.JP: こ、この間は悪かったわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I'm sorry about the last time!

fields.EN:
(Is it about what happened at
the Art Alley area?)
fields.JP: （ああ、旧芸術通りエリアでのことか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is it about what happened at
the Art Alley area?)

fields.EN:
I know I wasn't in the best
condition, but still, I spoke
too harsh to you then...
fields.JP:
こっちも余裕がなかったとはいえ、
ちょっと強く言い過ぎたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I wasn't in the best
condition, but still, I spoke
too harsh to you then...

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry. I was just taken
aback that you would apologize
to me like this.
fields.JP:
ああ、ごめん。
そんな風に素直に謝罪されるとは、
思ってもみなかったから、ついね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry. I was just taken
aback that you would apologize
to me like this.

fields.EN:
But, now I know that you're
finally the Oyayubi that
I used to know.
fields.JP:
でも、やっと僕の知っている親指に
戻ったように感じるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, now I know that you're
finally the Thumbelina that
I used to know.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: あなたの知ってるわたし……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
You were always the brash type,
but you were never suspicious
of things like that.
fields.JP:
昔の君は少しキツイところはあったけど、
あそこまで疑心暗鬼じゃなかった気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were always the brash type,
but you were never suspicious
of things like that.

fields.EN:
Sorry, but I can't talk to you
much about what happened yet...
fields.JP:
……ごめん。
今は……まだ言えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, but I can't talk to you
much about what happened yet...

fields.EN: I want to trust you, but...
fields.JP:
おつうのことは、信じたいと思ってる
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to trust you, but...

fields.EN:
Even though it's gone, I am
still a member of Dawn, right?
fields.JP: 滅びたとはいえ、黎明だったから……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even though it's gone, I am
still a member of Dawn, right?

fields.EN:
So many things happened in
the Order after Chiaki's passing.
fields.JP:
初代陽司の千昭が死んでから、
タイヨウ教団にも色々あったのよ
そう、いろいろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So many things happened in
the Order after Chiaki's passing.

fields.EN:
I'll talk a bit more on it once
I can get my mind settled.
fields.JP:
いつか、心の整理がついたら
ちゃんと話すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll talk a bit more on it once
I can get my mind settled.

fields.EN:
(Which means that she doesn't
want me to ask her any further...)
fields.JP: （つまり、今は聞かないでってことか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which means that she doesn't
want me to ask her any further...)

fields.JP: ああ、いくらでも待つさ

fields.EN:
(I'm not used to seeing her
apologize so often...
She's taking me off guard.)
fields.JP:
（そんな風に急に素直になられると、
　こっちも調子が狂ってしまうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not used to seeing her
apologize so often...
She's taking me off guard.)

fields.EN:
By the way, how do you like
everyone here? Pretty interesting
crew, isn't it?
fields.JP:
そうだ。新しい仲間たちとはどう？
みんな個性的で面白いだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, how do you like
everyone here? Pretty interesting
crew, isn't it?

fields.JP:
個性的ね。
ずいぶん遠慮した言い方じゃない

fields.EN:
I can at least say that they're
a reliable bunch.
fields.JP:
でも、そうね。
頼りになるとは思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can at least say that they're
a reliable bunch.

fields.EN:
I don't have the smarts as
Gretel does.
fields.JP:
悔しいけど、グレーテルには
頭で敵いそうもないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have the smarts as
Gretel does.

fields.EN:
When it comes to sheer strength
Hameln is top-notch. Too bad
she's a bit loose on the top.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンも強さだけなら申し分ない
……バカだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
When it comes to sheer strength
Hameln is top-notch. Too bad
she's a bit loose on the top.

fields.EN:
She also reminds me a bit of
Aka-nee.
fields.JP: それに、なんだか赤姉を思い出すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She also reminds me a bit of
sister Red.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Hameln is straightforward and open.
She's always trying to protect her friends...
That's probably what makes them alike.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは、裏表がなくて真っ直ぐだ。
いつだって仲間を守ろうとしてくれる……
たぶん、そういうところが似てるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln is straightforward, and
always helps her friends. Those
qualities remind me of sister Red.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
I know I just said I can't
fully trust you, but...
fields.JP:
その、信じきれないとか
言っておいてなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I just said I can't
fully trust you, but...

fields.EN:
I'm just happy that nothing has
changed with you and Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
おつうや人魚姫は変わってない。
……嬉しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy that nothing has
changed with you and Little
Mermaid.

fields.EN:
I promise you that I won't change,
ever. I also promise you that
I will win your trust.
fields.JP:
なら、約束しよう。
何があっても僕は僕のままでいる。
そしていつか君の信頼を取り戻すと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promise you that I won't change,
ever. I also promise you that
I will win your trust.

fields.EN:
Y-You better keep that promise!
Make me trust you, you hear?
fields.JP: そ、そうよ！　せいぜいがんばんなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You better keep that promise!
Make me trust you, you hear?

fields.EN:
(Is that... Oyayubi?
Who is she with? Is it someone
we saved the last time?)
fields.JP:
（あれは……親指？　
　一緒にいる女性は誰だろう？　
　この間救出した人かな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that... Thumbelina?
Who is she with? Is it someone
we saved the last time?)

fields.EN:
Don't worry.
The sun always looks over us.
fields.JP:
何も心配することなどありません。
タイヨウはいつでもわたし達を
見守ってくれています
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry.
The sun always looks over us.

fields.EN:
As with its warm light, you too
seek solace and peace as you wait
for the coming.
fields.JP:
あの暖かな光のように
あなたも穏やかにその時を
待っていてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
As with its warm light, you too
seek solace and peace as you wait
for the coming.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much.
I will do my best to see the
sun once again.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
タイヨウをもう一度見るまで
頑張ってみます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much.
I will do my best to see the
sun once again.

fields.JP:
わぁっ！？
あ、あんた見てたの！？

fields.EN:
She wanted to join the Order,
so after giving her our teachings,
I was going to show her around.
fields.JP:
……今の人は入団希望者よ。
教団の教えを説いていたの。
今度、連れていって案内するつもりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wanted to join the Order,
so after giving her our teachings,
I was going to show her around.

fields.EN:
I see.
Sorry to surprise you like this.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ
驚かせてごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see.
Sorry to surprise you like this.

fields.EN:
I don't mind, but next time let me
know you're here.
fields.JP:
別にいいけど……。
あんたこそ、見てないで声かけなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind, but next time let me
know you're here.

fields.EN:
Well, I wasn't sure if I could
bother you. After all, you weren't
acting like yourself there.
fields.JP:
いやぁ、親指がなんだか普段と違うから
つい見とれてしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I wasn't sure if I could
bother you. After all, you weren't
acting like yourself there.

fields.EN:
Hmph... I bet you thought
I was out of place there.
fields.JP:
ふん、どうせ似合ってないとか
思ってたんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph... I bet you thought
I was out of place there.

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないって

fields.EN:
It can't be helped. I have roles
here, and I can't be acting like
how I usually do.
fields.JP:
仕方ないでしょ。
こっちにも立場があるんだから。
普段通りってわけにはいかないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can't be helped. I have roles
here, and I can't be acting like
how I usually do.

fields.EN: I see. It must be quite tiring.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. It must be quite tiring.

fields.EN:
Honestly, I'm still not used to
this. In a way, it's easier
fighting Marchens.
fields.JP:
正直、未だに教団の活動には慣れないわ。
ある意味メルヒェンと戦ってる方がラクね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, I'm still not used to
this. In a way, it's easier
fighting Marchens.

fields.EN:
Then again, it's not that I don't
like doing this as long as it
helps everyone here.
fields.JP:
でも、この活動も悪くないと思ってるのよ
実際、みんなの助けになってるわけだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, it's not that I don't
like doing this as long as it
helps everyone here.

fields.EN: Fighting isn't only about defeating Marchens. Doing this made me realize there are other ways to protect people's hearts.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンを倒すだけが戦いじゃない。
人の心を守る方法は他にもあるんだって、
この活動をしていて気づかされたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting Marchens isn't
everything. The Order made me see
that there are other ways to help.

fields.JP: メルヒェンを倒す以外の戦いか……

fields.EN:
Oh and Lady Oohime...
I guess I can call her "Michiru"
in front of you.
fields.JP:
まぁ、あと大陽女……
って、あんたの前ならミチルでいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh and Lady Oohime...
I guess I can call her "Michiru"
in front of you.

fields.EN:
It also helps to know that
Michiru's words almost
always come true...
fields.JP:
ミチルの訳分かんない予言が、
よく当たるのも事実だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It also helps to know that
Michiru's words almost
always come true...

fields.EN:
I haven't thought about it before,
but are her omens that accurate?
fields.JP:
正直、僕にはぴんとこないんだけど、
そんなに当たるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't thought about it before,
but are her omens that accurate?

fields.JP: あんたの気持ちもわかるわ

fields.EN:
We were able to get away from
that Nightmare because of
Michiru.
fields.JP:
でも、あのナイトメアから逃げられたのも
ミチルの予言のおかげなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were able to get away from
that Nightmare because of
Michiru.

fields.EN:
Michiru was acting really weird
a short while before the
Nightmare struck.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが襲ってくる直前、
ミチルの様子がおかしくなったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru was acting really weird
a short while before the
Nightmare struck.

fields.EN:
She was pale, shaking, and scared
out of her wits. It was then she
asked that we all leave the area.
fields.JP:
顔面蒼白で何かに怯えるように震えて……
ともかく、すぐにここから離れようって
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was pale, shaking, and scared
out of her wits. It was then she
asked that we all leave the area.

fields.EN:
But it was too late...
We simply didn't have time to help
everyone in the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
でも、間に合わなかった。
解放地区の住民までは手が回らなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it was too late...
We simply didn't have time to help
everyone in the Liberated District.

fields.JP: 親指たちの責任じゃないよ

fields.EN:
I guess so...
But, we could have helped...
fields.JP:
そうね……そうかもしれない。
でも、もしかしたら助けられたかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess so...
But, we could have helped...

fields.EN:
You may be thinking that you
weren't able to save them, but
if so, you got it all wrong.
fields.JP:
解放地区の人たちを救えなかった。
君はそう思ってるかもしれないけど、
それは間違いだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be thinking that you
weren't able to save them, but
if so, you got it all wrong.

fields.EN:
You were able to save the Order.
Everyone there is alive now.
That's a fact.
fields.JP:
君たちのおかげでタイヨウ教団の人たちは、
こうして無事に生きている。
それだけが間違いない事実だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were able to save the Order.
Everyone there is alive now.
That's a fact.

fields.EN: Thinking "what if..." will only drive you into a corner.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら……なんて考えるのは、
自分を追い詰めるだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanting to save everyone and
wishing you could've done more
will hurt you more than anything.

fields.EN:
We sisters made it out alive, so
we're going to have to become the
beacon of hope for the survivors.
fields.JP:
わたしたち姉妹は生き残った。
せめて今生きてる人たちの希望となるように、
隙を見せずしっかりしないといけないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We sisters made it out alive, so
we're going to have to become the
beacon of hope for the survivors.

fields.EN:
I'm sure all will go well the
next time. We'll make sure we
save everyone.
fields.JP: ああ、次はしくじらない。……必ず救う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure all will go well the
next time. We'll make sure we
save everyone.

fields.EN:
I guess we'll just have to each
do our best.
fields.JP: お互いやれるだけのことはやりましょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we'll just have to each
do our best.

fields.EN:
Of course.
I'm counting on you, Oyayubi.
fields.JP:
ああ、もちろん。
頼りにしてるよ、親指
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course.
I'm counting on you, Thumbelina.

fields.EN: Ugh... H-Hmph! If you're going to say that much, I guess I have no choice!
fields.JP:
うっ……ふ、ふん！
そこまで言われたら仕方ないわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... H-Hmph!
I guess I can do my best,
just for you!

fields.EN:
(A beacon of hope... I guess being
in the Order changed her in
a number of ways...)
fields.JP:
（人々の希望として隙は見せられない、か。
　親指が以前と少し変わったのは、
　教団という環境のせいかもしれないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A beacon of hope... I guess being
in the Order changed her in
a number of ways...)

fields.EN:
(I wonder what Oyayubi
and the girls went through.)
fields.JP: （親指たちになにがあったのか気になる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what Thumbelina
and the girls went through.)

fields.EN:
(I think I'll talk with her again.
If that won't work, then I'll just
have to wait until she's ready.)
fields.JP:
（もう一度、聞いてみよう。
　それで、ダメだったら今度こそ、
　親指が話してくれるまで待つことにする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think I'll talk with her again.
If that won't work, then I'll just
have to wait until she's ready.)

fields.EN: Oyayubi, it's me. I want to talk to you for a bit. Is that okay?
fields.JP:
親指、僕だよ。
ちょっと話があるんだけど、いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's me.
Do you mind if I come in?

fields.EN:
Hi there, Oyayubi.
Sorry to barge in all of a
sudden.
fields.JP:
やあ、親指。
いきなり押しかけてすまない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi there, Thumbelina.
Sorry to barge in all of a
sudden.

fields.EN:
No problem.
So, what is it?
fields.JP:
別に構わないわよ。
それで、話って何かしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem.
So, what is it?

fields.EN:
I recall we didn't talk much
about what happened after
you joined the Order.
fields.JP:
この間、きみから聞けなかった、
タイヨウ教団へ行った後のこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall we didn't talk much
about what happened after
you joined the Order.

fields.EN:
You said you'd talk about it
once your mind was settled,
right?
fields.JP:
心の整理がついたら話してくれるって、
そう言っていたよね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said you'd talk about it
once your mind was settled,
right?

fields.EN:
I know it's a bit brash that
I ask about it like this.
fields.JP:
こうやって僕の方から尋ねるのは、
スマートじゃないとは思ったんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's a bit brash that
I ask about it like this.

fields.EN:
But, I wanted to hear what you
had to say.
fields.JP: でも、聞かせてほしいんだ。君のこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I wanted to hear what you
had to say.

fields.EN:
Fine...
I guess I can talk.
fields.JP:
……しょうがないわね。
話してあげるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine...
I guess I can talk.

fields.EN:
Just for the record, it isn't
because I trust you, got it?!
fields.JP:
別に、あんたのこと信用してるからとか、
そういう理由じゃないんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just for the record, it isn't
because I trust you, got it?!

fields.EN:
Sure, you may still be under
Dawn, but... you're a comrade
in battle and... Um...
fields.JP:
黎明のことはともかく、
今は一緒に戦う仲間なわけで……
だから、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, you may still be under
Dawn, but... you're a comrade
in battle and... Um...

fields.EN:
Oh, right!
It's just my way of showing you
respect!
fields.JP:
えっと……そう！
わたしなりの誠意ってやつよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, right!
It's just my way of showing you
respect!

fields.EN:
Sure, whatever you say.
You're free to take your time
finding trust in me.
fields.JP:
今は、それでもいいよ。
ゆっくり見極めてくれればいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, whatever you say.
You're free to take your time
finding trust in me.

fields.JP: とはいえ、どこから話せばいいかしらね……

fields.EN:
Let's see...
So, everything started with
Chiaki's death...
fields.JP:
そう、きっかけは陽司のちー……
千昭が殺されたことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see...
So, everything started with
Chiaki's death...

fields.EN:
With his passing, the Order went
into chaos. Some even sought to
kill Michiru amid the confusion.
fields.JP:
陽司を失った教団は大混乱に陥ったわ。
中にはミチルの存在を否定して、
命を狙おうとする者たちも現われた
fields.LOCALIZED:
With his passing, the Order went
into chaos. Some even sought to
kill Michiru amid the confusion.

fields.EN:
But, you know Michiru...
The situation didn't even phase
her...
fields.JP:
それでも、ミチルはあんなんだから、
ちっとも気にしてなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you know Michiru...
The situation didn't even phase
her...

fields.EN:
I was worried as heck. Michiru
is like family to me. There's no
way I would leave her alone.
fields.JP:
わたし、心配で。
だって放っておけるわけないじゃない。
ミチルは、家族同然なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was worried as heck. Michiru
is like family to me. There's no
way I would leave her alone.

fields.EN:
Why didn't you discuss it with
the Professor or the others in
Dawn?
fields.JP: だったら博士や黎明の皆に相談すれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why didn't you discuss it with
the Professor or the others in
Dawn?

fields.EN:
I talked with the Professor.
You want to know what he said?
fields.JP:
わたし、博士に相談したの。
そしたらなんて言われたと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I talked with the Professor.
You want to know what he said?

fields.EN:
He said that we shouldn't get
involved with the Order of the Sun
anymore.
fields.JP:
もう、教団に関わらない方がいいって、
そう言われたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that we shouldn't get
involved with the Order of the Sun
anymore.

fields.EN:
Like I'd listen to that!
The Order raised me there!
fields.JP:
そんなこと、できるわけないじゃない。
あそこは、わたし達が育った場所なのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I'd listen to that!
The Order raised me there!

fields.EN:
He knows that and he still told
me to turn a blind eye... He told
me to let go of my home...
fields.JP:
なのに、関わるなって……
育った場所を捨てろってことじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
He knows that and he still told
me to turn a blind eye... He told
me to let go of my home...

fields.JP: それで、黎明を離れたのか

fields.EN:
The biggest reason why I left
was because I thought
Cinderella killed him.
fields.JP:
一番の理由はね、ちーを殺した犯人が
シンデレラだって思ったからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The biggest reason why I left
was because I thought
Cinderella killed him.

fields.EN:
I thought she spat on my trust,
and destroyed the Order...
fields.JP:
あんなに信頼していたシンデレラに
教団がめちゃくちゃにされた……。
と思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought she spat on my trust,
and destroyed the Order...

fields.EN:
It felt like everyone I trusted
went against me.
fields.JP:
信じてたもの全部に
裏切られた気分だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt like everyone I trusted
went against me.

fields.EN:
I thought that Dawn wasn't the
place for me, which is why us
sisters returned to the Order.
fields.JP:
もう黎明にはいられないと思った。
だから、妹たちを連れて教団に戻ったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought that Dawn wasn't the
place for me, which is why us
sisters returned to the Order.

fields.EN:
It was tough. Michiru suddenly
appointed each one of us to be
the next Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
……教団に戻ってからも大変だったわ。
ミチルったら、いきなりわたし達を
次の陽司に指名するんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was tough. Michiru suddenly
appointed each one of us to be
the next Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
I know I'm not the type to lead
people, but then again, we needed
to bring peace back to the Order.
fields.JP:
がらじゃないのはわかってたけどね。
教団の混乱をおさめるためにも、
わたしたちがやるしかなかったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm not the type to lead
people, but then again, we needed
to bring peace back to the Order.

fields.EN:
It was tiring trying to hold
a front worthy of a Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
本当に大変だったわ。
人前では常に陽司らしく振る舞わなくちゃ
いけないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was tiring trying to hold
a front worthy of a Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
We also had to help Michiru,
especially with how nonchalant
she was with what was happening.
fields.JP:
危機感が足りないミチル達の世話も
しなくちゃいけないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also had to help Michiru,
especially with how nonchalant
she was with what was happening.

fields.EN:
Then we had a bunch of guys who
tried to dethrone Michiru as the
leader of the Order.
fields.JP:
ここぞとばかりに、ミチルから教祖の座を
奪おうとするやつらとか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we had a bunch of guys who
tried to dethrone Michiru as the
leader of the Order.

fields.EN:
Some started to pester us sisters
because they didn't like us.
fields.JP:
わたし達姉妹が気に入らないからって、
嫌がらせしてくるやつもいたりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some started to pester us sisters
because they didn't like us.

fields.EN:
You can't imagine what I had to do
to get rid of them. I used dirty
tactics that I'm not proud of.
fields.JP:
まあ、そういう不埒な連中には
教団の中にある黎明への反感を、
こう上手いこと誘導して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't imagine what I had to do
to get rid of them. I used dirty
tactics that I'm not proud of.

fields.EN: I guess you went through a lot.
fields.JP: な、なかなか苦労してきたみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess you went through a lot.

fields.EN:
Well, I know my means weren't the
best, but I really didn't have
much of an option...
fields.JP:
褒められたやり方じゃないってことは、
わたしもよく分かってる。
でも、そうするしかなかったのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I know my means weren't the
best, but I really didn't have
much of an option...

fields.EN:
Oh, stop it. There's no need to be
so down on yourself. You did what
you could for everyone.
fields.JP:
そんな顔をしないで。
親指は、必死にみんなを守ろうとしたんだ
恥じ入ることはないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, stop it. There's no need to be
so down on yourself. You did what
you could for everyone.

fields.EN:
Dawn is no more. There's no one
you need to apologize to. We're
all working off a clean slate now.
fields.JP:
それに、黎明はもうないんだ。
今さら詫びる相手もいない。
つまりは、リセットってことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dawn is no more. There's no one
you need to apologize to. We're
all working off a clean slate now.

fields.EN: (...Even though I said that... the Professor and everyone in Dawn are dead, and the Order is still in turmoil.)
fields.JP:
（……なんて言ってはみたものの。
　博士や黎明のみんなは死んでしまった
　そして教団もいまだ混乱の中にある）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite her words, I'm sure
there's a lot of confusion still
among those in the Order.)

fields.EN:
(With many dead, anger, hatred,
and sorrow still runs through
their group.)
fields.JP:
（憎しみや怒り、そして悲しみは、
　ずっとこの場所で渦巻いたままだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With many dead, anger, hatred,
and sorrow still runs through
their group.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe things wouldn't be how it
is if Hitsuka-san was still alive...)
fields.JP:
（陽司さんが生きてたら、
　こんなことにはならなかったのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe things wouldn't be how it
is if Hitsuka was still alive...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
Like I always say, be careful
and always be on the lookout
for potential trouble!
fields.JP:
だからいつも言っているでしょ！
白雪はもう少し相手を
疑うことを覚えなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I always say, be careful
and always be on the lookout
for potential trouble!

fields.JP: 親指ちゃんと白雪ちゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it Thumby and Snow White?

fields.EN:
It sure doesn't look like they're
having a casual talk there...
fields.JP:
姉妹で仲良くおしゃべりしてる……
って雰囲気じゃなさそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure doesn't look like they're
having a casual talk there...

fields.EN:
That was dangerous!
You never know what can happen,
so always keep your guard up!
fields.JP:
今回は本当に危ないところだったのよ！？
誰がいつ狙ってくるか分からないんだから、
常日頃から気をつけなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was dangerous!
You never know what can happen,
so always keep your guard up!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama...
Shirayuki is... sorry...
Please... Enough...
fields.JP:
親指姉さま……
白雪姉さまも…………反省してる……
だから……もう、そのくらいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina...
Snow White is... sorry...
Please... Enough...

fields.EN: Looks like Nemu-chan was here, too.
fields.JP: ねむちゃんも一緒だったのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like Sleepy was here, too.

fields.JP: いったい何があったんだ？

fields.EN:
Shirayuki was about to be
framed by an advocate of
the first Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
どうもこうもないわ。
白雪が旧陽司派の信者に絡まれて、
ハメられそうになったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White was about to be
framed by an advocate of
the first Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
There's a number of followers
who say that we're not fit to be
a Hitsuka...
fields.JP:
白雪達は陽司に相応しくないって、
言っている人たちです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a number of followers
who say that we're not fit to be
a Hitsuka...

fields.EN:
To word it bluntly, they don't
like the idea we were assigned
as a Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
要するに、わたし達が陽司なのが
気に入らない連中のことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To word it bluntly, they don't
like the idea we were assigned
as a Hitsuka.

fields.EN: So, what did this follower do?
fields.JP: それで、その信者は何をしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what did this follower do?

fields.EN:
He asked Shirayuki about
Michiru, while faking that he
didn't know about her.
fields.JP:
ミチルのことを知らないふりした信者が、
白雪にミチルのことを聞いたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He asked Snow White about
Michiru, while faking that he
didn't know about her.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki answered saying that
Michiru was a very mysterious
person.
fields.JP:
それで、白雪はついミチルのことを
「天然で不思議な人」って言ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White answered saying that
Michiru was a very mysterious
person.

fields.JP: それが……なにか問題なの？

fields.EN:
It isn't wrong... but...
can't... say that...
fields.JP:
……間違って……ない……けど、
その……言い方は……ダメ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It isn't wrong... but...
can't... say that...

fields.EN: Some people say that because we serve Michiru, it's disrespectful to treat her like a friend or family.
fields.JP:
わたし達はミチルに仕えてる身だから、
友達や家族のように接するのは不敬だ。
って言う奴がいるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some of the followers say that we
should treat Michiru as an icon,
not like someone close to us.

fields.EN:
What's fresh is that the same guy
came and used Shirayuki's words
to cause a bit of a ruckus.
fields.JP:
今回も同じ。
白雪の言葉尻をつかまえて、
大げさに騒いだやつがいたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's fresh is that the same guy
came and used Snow White's words
to cause a bit of a ruckus.

fields.EN:
That's where Oyayubi-neesama
came in to help calm the
situation.
fields.JP:
そこを親指姉様が収めて、
助けてもらったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's where sister Thumbelina
came in to help calm the
situation.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: なんて幼稚な嫌がらせだ

fields.EN:
Right?! But even if they try to
cause a stir, we need to act our
roles as Hitsuka...
fields.JP:
そうよ！　でも、嫌がらせだとしても、
わたし達は陽司として振る舞わなくちゃ
いけないのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right?! But even if they try to
cause a stir, we need to act our
roles as Hitsuka...

fields.EN:
That's why I was telling them
to be careful of what they do and
say.
fields.JP:
だから、常日頃から気をつけなさいって
妹たちには言ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I was telling them
to be careful of what they do and
say.

fields.EN:
Don't trust anyone coming near
you, and never show any weakness
that they can use, got it?!
fields.JP:
近づいてくる人は先ず疑いなさい！
そして絶対に隙を見せないこと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't trust anyone coming near
you, and never show any weakness
that they can use, got it?!

fields.EN:
And you, Nemu! You too!
If you noticed what was happening
go in to help Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
それからネム！　あんたもよ！
気づいてたんだったら、
しっかり白雪をフォローしなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you, Sleepy! You too!
If you noticed what was happening
go in to help Snow White!

fields.EN:
You need to speak up in order
to make others listen to you.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと話さないと、
相手には伝わらないのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to speak up in order
to make others listen to you.

fields.EN:
P-Please don't go so hard on
Nemu-chan...!
fields.JP:
ね、ネムちゃんをあんまり
責めないでください……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please don't go so hard on
Sleepy...!

fields.EN:
She did what she could to help!
Shirayuki is the one to blame!
fields.JP:
ネムちゃんは、ちゃんと
フォローしてくれました！
全部、白雪がどんくさいのが悪いんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did what she could to help!
Snow White is the one to blame!

fields.EN:
I'm not talking about who was
at fault!
fields.JP:
ちょっと、今は誰が悪いとか
そういう話はしていないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not talking about who was
at fault!

fields.EN:
A-And, not all the followers are
like that!
fields.JP:
そ、それに！　
ああいう信者さんばかりじゃありません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-And, not all the followers are
like that!

fields.EN:
There are plenty who say they were
saved after talking with us!
fields.JP:
白雪やネムちゃんのお話で希望が持てたって、
言ってくれる人だってたくさんいます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are plenty who say they were
saved after talking with us!

fields.EN:
That's Michiru's job. You're only
going to get in her way if you
can't properly control yourself.
fields.JP:
そういうのはミチルの仕事なの。
余計なことをして、それで足下を
すくわれてたら意味ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Michiru's job. You're only
going to get in her way if you
can't properly control yourself.

fields.EN:
Anyone saying that they were
saved has got to be lying, and...
fields.JP:
だいたい、わたし達と話して希望を持てた
なんて、そんなの嘘に決まって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyone saying that they were
saved has got to be lying, and...

fields.EN:
Oh, uh...
That's not what I...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, uh...
That's not what I...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama... is right...
But... so sad...
fields.JP:
……親指姉さまの……
言う通りかもしれない……
……でも……それは……悲しい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina... is right...
But... so sad...

fields.EN:
That was a bit too harsh there,
Oyayubi-chan.
fields.JP: 親指ちゃん、今のは言いすぎだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a bit too harsh there,
Thumby.

fields.JP:
……分かってる。
わたし、ひどいこと言っちゃった

fields.EN:
Heh...
I guess that might have put the
nail in the coffin for us sisters.
fields.JP:
あはは……
もう、わたし達三姉妹もお終いかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
I guess that might have put the
nail in the coffin for us sisters.

fields.EN:
That's not true!
I'm sure everything will be back
to normal if you apologize.
fields.JP:
……そんなことない！
ちゃんと謝ればきっと仲直りできるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
I'm sure everything will be back
to normal if you apologize.

fields.EN:
It's no use... We've been hurting
each other like this all along.
It's all over this time...
fields.JP:
無理よ……今まで何回もこうやって、
傷つけてきたんだもの……
今回ばかりはもう無理よ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use... We've been hurting
each other like this all along.
It's all over this time...

fields.EN: Actually, maybe this is for the best. If we leaned on each other just because we're sisters, it would get in the way of our work as Hitsuka.
fields.JP:
むしろ、これでよかったのかも。
姉妹だからって甘えてたら、
陽司の仕事に差し支えるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess this may have been for the
best. We were each getting in our
way of being a Hitsuka.

fields.EN:
We should go our own separate
ways...
fields.JP: だから、お互い距離を取った方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should go our own separate
ways...

fields.JP: しらゆきとねむねむ、ないてた
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White and Sleepy was crying.

fields.EN:
Um, well, they had a bit of an
argument, that's all.
fields.JP: あのね、いま、ちょっとだけ行き違いが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well, they had a bit of an
argument, that's all.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi said to Rapunzel that
you need say feelings.
fields.JP:
おやゆびは、ラプンツェルにいったよ。
きもちは、すなおにいわなきゃだめだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby said to Rapunzel that
you need say feelings.

fields.EN:
Say sorry if you did bad, and
make friends again after sorry.
fields.JP:
わるいことしたら、ごめんなさいって。
ちゃんとあやまってなかなおりしなさいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say sorry if you did bad, and
make friends again after sorry.

fields.EN:
How come Oyayubi no say sorry?
Was that lie, Oyayubi?
fields.JP:
どうしておやゆびはあやまらないの！　
おやゆびがいったことはうそだったの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How come Thumby no say sorry?
Was that lie, Thumby?

fields.JP: ラプンツェルの言うとおりだ

fields.EN:
Wanting to fill the role of a
Hitsuka, and wanting to apologize
are your honest feelings, right?
fields.JP:
陽司の仕事が大事だという気持ちと、
二人に謝りたい気持ち。
親指にとってどっちも素直な気持ちだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanting to fill the role of a
Hitsuka, and wanting to apologize
are your honest feelings, right?

fields.EN:
Well then, why don't you talk with
them how you really feel?
fields.JP:
だったらもう一度、
今度は素直な気持ちで
あの二人と話してみたら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, why don't you talk with
them how you really feel?

fields.EN:
Thank you, Rapu.
Thanks, Otsuu, Ningyohime...
Let me go and talk to them.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。ラプ。
それから、おつうと人魚姫も……
わたし、二人とちゃんと話してみる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Rappy.
Thanks, Otsuu, Little Mermaid...
Let me go and talk to them.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Yes, and it's all because of
Rapunzel.
fields.JP: ああ。これもラプンツェルのおかげかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and it's all because of
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
It just means you did good.
fields.JP: ふふ……それが大事なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
It just means you did good.

fields.EN:
I can't seem to find the right
time to talk with them... What
am I supposed to say anyway?
fields.JP:
声をかけるタイミングが見つからないわ。
そもそもなんて声かければいいの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't seem to find the right
time to talk with them... What
am I supposed to say anyway?

fields.EN:
N-Never mind what I said!
Y-You should really stop
talking from behind like that!
fields.JP:
じゃなくて！
い、いきなり話しかけないでよ！？
びっくりするじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Never mind what I said!
Y-You should really stop
talking from behind like that!

fields.EN:
Well, just for the record,
I was here the whole time...
fields.JP:
そう言われてもね……
僕はずっとそこにいたんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, just for the record,
I was here the whole time...

fields.EN:
Then you should tell me that
you're here!
fields.JP: だったら声かけなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then you should tell me that
you're here!

fields.EN:
You're confusing me...
Do you want me to tell you
or not tell you I'm here?
fields.JP: 声をかけろとかかけるなとか……はぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're confusing me...
Do you want me to tell you
or not tell you I'm here?

fields.EN: The more time you spend putting it off, the more excuses you make for yourself, and the harder it becomes to take the plunge.
fields.JP:
そうやって時間をかければかけるだけ、
自分の中に言い訳がたくさんできて、
余計に踏ん切りがつかなくなっていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyhow, you have to stop making
excuses. You need to take the
first step approaching them.

fields.EN:
I think it's okay to act based on
your emotions, especially if it
is for your loved ones.
fields.JP:
たまには感情的に行動してもいいと思うよ
それが、大切な人のためならなおさらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's okay to act based on
your emotions, especially if it
is for your loved ones.

fields.EN:
You're right...
Thanks! Here I go!
fields.JP:
……おつうの言う通りね。
ありがとう、わたし行ってくる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
Thanks! Here I go!

fields.EN:
(Guess it takes a good old nudge
to get her going...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess it takes a good old nudge
to get her going...)

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: I'm sorry about the last time!
fields.JP: この間はごめんなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry about the last time!

fields.EN:
Wh-What the...?
Why are you two...?
fields.JP:
ど、どういうことよ？
なんであんた達が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What the...?
Why are you two...?

fields.EN:
I knew you were only trying to
help us, but we spoke out against
you.
fields.JP:
あの時は白雪の言い方が悪かったんです
親指姉様は白雪たちのことを心配して
言ってくれているのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew you were only trying to
help us, but we spoke out against
you.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
I don't speak up... so...
I always cause... problems...
fields.JP:
ボクも……ごめんなさい……
いつも、ちゃんと話さなくて……
いっぱい……迷惑かけてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I don't speak up... so...
I always cause... problems...

fields.EN: No... neither of you did anything wrong! Shirayuki is kind and doesn't discriminate against people, and Nemu is desperately trying to communicate what she wants!
fields.JP:
違う……二人は悪くない……！
白雪は人を差別しない優しい子だし！
ネムは必死に意志を伝えようとしてるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not the ones to apologize.
I know you're both kind and always
try to do your best.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: I'm the one at fault here...
fields.JP: 違うの。悪いのはわたしなの……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm the one at fault here...

fields.EN:
I pushed my own insecurity of
the future onto you two...
fields.JP:
わたしはわたしの抱えてる不安を、
あなた達に押しつけてただけなんだわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I pushed my own insecurity of
the future onto you two...

fields.EN:
I can't believe I said I'd protect
you two, when I'm the one
who hurt you both...
fields.JP:
あなた達を守りたいなんて言っておいて、
逆に傷つけてたら意味ないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe I said I'd protect
you two, when I'm the one
who hurt you both...

fields.EN:
That's not true!
We're here only because you were
with us!
fields.JP:
そんなことないです！
親指姉様がいたから、白雪たちは今日まで
生きてこられたんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
We're here only because you were
with us!

fields.EN:
So please, don't try to burden
everything by yourself.
fields.JP:
だから、もう親指姉様ひとりで
背負い込まないでくださいっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't try to burden
everything by yourself.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry...
I think I was pushing everyone
and even myself too hard...
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。
わたし、焦ってたんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry...
I think I was pushing everyone
and even myself too hard...

fields.EN:
It felt as if I was surrounded
by enemies, ever since I heard
Cinderella killed Chii...
fields.JP:
シンデレラがちーを殺したって聞いて、
それで、すごく怖くなって、
周りがみんな敵に見えてた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt as if I was surrounded
by enemies, ever since I heard
Cinderella killed Chii...

fields.EN:
I was simply using his followers
as an excuse. I was just scared
of trusting anyone...
fields.JP:
旧陽司派のことはきっと言い訳。
本当は誰かを信用するのが怖かったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was simply using his followers
as an excuse. I was just scared
of trusting anyone...

fields.EN:
The only ones I could trust were
you girls and Michiru.
fields.JP:
信じられるのはミチルと、
あなたたち二人だけだって、
そんな風に疑心暗鬼になってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only ones I could trust were
you girls and Michiru.

fields.EN:
So what you heard back then
was just me lashing out.
fields.JP: この間のことは、ぜんぶ八つ当たりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So what you heard back then
was just me lashing out.

fields.EN:
I was just irritated that you two
were so open and believing
of others...
fields.JP:
わたしはこんなに不安でいっぱいなのに、
どうして、あなた達はそんなにも無警戒で
いられるのかって。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just irritated that you two
were so open and believing
of others...

fields.EN:
What a loser...
I wouldn't be surprised if
you both hated me by now.
fields.JP:
本当に情けなくて、嫌なやつだわ……
あなた達に嫌われても仕方ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a loser...
I wouldn't be surprised if
you both hated me by now.

fields.EN:
That's not true!
We love you no different from
before!
fields.JP:
そんなことありません！
白雪達は親指姉さまが大好きです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true!
We love you no different from
before!

fields.EN:
But...
I said so many horrible things
to you...
fields.JP:
でも……わたしは……
あんなにひどいことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...
I said so many horrible things
to you...

fields.EN:
It's only common that people
say a bit too much at times.
fields.JP:
誰だって、言い過ぎてしまう
ことくらいあります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only common that people
say a bit too much at times.

fields.EN: Even if you were taking it out on us... you always said those things because you cared about us... so... we'd never hate you...!
fields.JP:
八つ当たりでも……いつも……
ボク達のことを、思って言ってた……
だから……嫌いになんてならない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always... say things...
because you... cared...
We love you... just the same...

fields.EN:
We made a lot of mistakes and
have done our worth of horrible
deeds.
fields.JP: 白雪達も悪いところいっぱいありました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We made a lot of mistakes and
have done our worth of horrible
deeds.

fields.EN:
In fact, we always were reliant
on you, not doing anything
ourselves...
fields.JP:
親指姉様ばかりに頼って、
自分ではなんにもできなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, we always were reliant
on you, not doing anything
ourselves...

fields.EN:
We were... concerned...
that we weren't...
helping you... at all...
fields.JP:
ボク達も……焦ってた……
親指姉様の、こと……ぜんぜん助けて……
あげられないって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were... concerned...
that we weren't...
helping you... at all...

fields.EN:
I think we all were thinking the
same, and it just happened that
we didn't communicate well enough.
fields.JP:
きっとみんな同じことを考えてたんです。
ただ、それが上手くいかなくて、
言葉にしないまま、すれ違っていただけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think we all were thinking the
same, and it just happened that
we didn't communicate well enough.

fields.EN:
(Looks like I don't need to
intervene here...)
fields.JP:
（どうやら僕の出番はないみたいだ。
　それに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like I don't need to
intervene here...)

fields.EN:
(I better leave them be.
They're sisters, so they know
what to do...)
fields.JP:
（それに、ここから先は姉妹の時間だ。
　これ以上覗いてるのは野暮ってものだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better leave them be.
They're sisters, so they know
what to do...)

fields.JP: どうしたんだい？　姫
見て、あそこにいるのって……

fields.EN:
Hm? Looks like it's the Oyayubi
sisters and... Rapunzel?
fields.JP: ん……親指達とラプンツェルだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Looks like it's the Thumbelina
sisters and... Rapunzel?

fields.EN:
Rapu... So warm...
Feel so good...
fields.JP: らぷ……温かくて……気持ちいい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy... So warm...
Feel so good...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: んふー……ねむねむ柔らかくて好きー……

fields.EN: Come on... How long are you two going to keep clinging to each other?
fields.JP:
もう……
二人とも、いつまでくっついてるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon girls...
How much longer do I have
to wait here?

fields.EN:
Well, it does feel good to
hug Nemu-chan.
fields.JP:
ネムちゃん、ぎゅってすると
気持ちいいもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it does feel good to
hug Sleepy.

fields.EN:
It's like they're appraising each
other how comfy they are...
Look who's here...
fields.JP:
ていうか、お互いお布団を評価してる
みたいに聞こえるんだけど……あっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's like they're appraising each
other how comfy they are...
Look who's here...

fields.JP: そんなところで見てないで声かけなさいよ

fields.EN:
Well, we didn't want to bother
you folks.
fields.JP: 邪魔したら悪いかなと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we didn't want to bother
you folks.

fields.JP: 邪魔だなんてそんなこと……

fields.EN:
Thank goodness...
It looks like you sisters are
back together again.
fields.JP:
よかった……
ちゃんと、仲直りできたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness...
It looks like you sisters are
back together again.

fields.EN:
And, it's because Otsuu gave
me the courage to go and
speak with them.
fields.JP:
あのとき……おつうが背中を
押してくれたおかげよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, it's because Otsuu gave
me the courage to go and
speak with them.

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you're talking
about. All I did back then was
eavesdrop on you.
fields.JP:
なんのことかな？
僕はただ覗き見していただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you're talking
about. All I did back then was
eavesdrop on you.

fields.EN:
I-I'm trying to praise you here,
so just take it! Sheez!
fields.JP:
か、感謝してるんだから
素直に受け取りなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm trying to praise you here,
so just take it! Sheez!

fields.EN:
Okay, let me rephrase it...
I owe you one, got that?!
fields.JP:
いいわ。絶対にこの借りは返すんだから
覚えてなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let me rephrase it...
I owe you one, got that?!

fields.EN:
Looks like you had a load lifted
off your back. You're a lot like
how you were before.
fields.JP:
親指ちゃん、肩の荷が下りたみたい。
前よりも自然体な気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you had a load lifted
off your back. You're a lot like
how you were before.

fields.EN:
You think?
Not that I can tell myself,
really.
fields.JP:
そうかしら？
……自分ではよく分からないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think?
Not that I can tell myself,
really.

fields.EN:
Oh, but don't try to burden
yourself again, you hear?
fields.JP: でも、また無理しちゃダメだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but don't try to burden
yourself again, you hear?

fields.EN:
Hmph, you don't need to tell me
that. If anything happens, I'm
gonna be relying on my sisters.
fields.JP:
ふん。分かってるわよ。
それに、もし何かあったとしても、
わたしには頼れる妹たちがいるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph, you don't need to tell me
that. If anything happens, I'm
gonna be relying on my sisters.

fields.EN: You can rely on us too, you know?
fields.JP: なんなら僕たちを頼ってくれていいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You can rely on us too, you know?

fields.EN:
J-Just because you helped this
once doesn't mean I'm gonna
trust you, you hear?!
fields.JP:
っ！？　い、一回手助けしたからって、
調子に乗るんじゃないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Just because you helped this
once doesn't mean I'm gonna
trust you, you hear?!

fields.EN:
But... if you have anything you
need from us, be sure you come
and ask, got it?!
fields.JP:
あんたの方こそ、
何かあったら言ってきなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... if you have anything you
need from us, be sure you come
and ask, got it?!

fields.EN:
Understood. After all, you did
say you owe me one, right?
fields.JP:
ああ、そうさせてもらうよ
借りは返すそうだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. After all, you did
say you owe me one, right?

fields.EN:
Heh heh, you're just like how
you were before. No doubt
about that.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、こうして話していると、
なんだか昔に戻ったみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, you're just like how
you were before. No doubt
about that.

fields.JP: 何言ってんのよ、全然違うわよ

fields.EN:
We're more of a friend than
ever before.
fields.JP: だって、昔より今の方が仲いいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're more of a friend than
ever before.

fields.EN:
Yes, I like how we are now
more than how we were before,
that's for sure.
fields.JP:
そうだね……。
昔より今のほうがずっといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I like how we are now
more than how we were before,
that's for sure.

fields.EN:
So, you were going to the
cafeteria to get some snacks,
was it?
fields.JP:
それで、おやつを取りに食堂に
行くところなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you were going to the
cafeteria to get some snacks,
was it?

fields.EN:
I know I'm a sucker, but it's hard
to push back against Rapu and
Nemu...
fields.JP:
自分でも甘いと思うけど、
ラプとネムのコンビには敵わないのよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm a sucker, but it's hard
to push back against Rappy and
Sleepy...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I can't blame you. Those two are
so adorable that I wouldn't mind
doing things for them.
fields.JP:
あー、ちょっと分かる気がする。
最近のあの二人見てると、
ついつい甘やかしちゃうよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't blame you. Those two are
so adorable that I wouldn't mind
doing things for them.

fields.JP: あんたは誰にでも基本甘いでしょ

fields.EN:
That aside...
Why the silence, Otsuu?
fields.JP:
そんなことより……
おつうはさっきから何黙ってるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside...
Why the silence, Otsuu?

fields.EN: No, I've been wondering about this for a while... Oyayubi, aren't you unusually honest only with Princess?
fields.JP:
いや、前から気になってたんだけど、
親指って姫に対してだけは、
やけに素直じゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I noticed that you're very
friendly and honest when speaking
with Princess.

fields.EN:
You know, as much as I'd like
to disagree... you're right.
fields.JP:
そんなことない……って言いたいけど、
まぁ……そうかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, as much as I'd like
to disagree... you're right.

fields.EN:
It's strange. It's like I can talk
to her without worrying about the
things happening around me.
fields.JP:
人魚姫と話してると余計なこと考えなくて
すむっていうか、不思議と気が楽なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's strange. It's like I can talk
to her without worrying about the
things happening around me.

fields.EN:
Maybe it's because she's kind
and honest, unlike a certain
someone I know...
fields.JP:
ほら、人魚姫って優しいし、
誰かさんと違って裏がない感じがするから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's because she's kind
and honest, unlike a certain
someone I know...

fields.EN:
I guess she just brings out
the honesty in me.
fields.JP:
だからきっと、釣られてこっちも
素直になっちゃうのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess she just brings out
the honesty in me.

fields.EN:
I agree with you. Princess is kind
and has a very pure and honest
heart.
fields.JP:
その意見には僕も同意するよ。
確かに姫は優しくて裏表のない、
とても綺麗な心の持ち主だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree with you. Princess is kind
and has a very pure and honest
heart.

fields.EN:
Oh, um... Would you two mind?
You're embarrassing me...
fields.JP:
あ、あの、二人ともそのくらいに……
恥ずかしいよぉ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... Would you two mind?
You're embarrassing me...

fields.EN:
Wait... Did you just say that
I'm not kind or honest?
fields.JP:
というかその言い方だとまるで、
僕に裏があるように聞こえるけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait... Did you just say that
I'm not kind or honest?

fields.EN:
Well, it's not like you're
honest all the time, you know?
fields.JP: ふん、いつも肝心なことははぐらかすくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's not like you're
honest all the time, you know?

fields.EN:
Well, you're in the same boat.
You keep saying things contrary
to what you feel.
fields.JP:
そういう親指こそ僕に対して、
本心と言葉が裏がえってるじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you're in the same boat.
You keep saying things contrary
to what you feel.

fields.EN:
I believe there's an old word
that describes someone like
you. "Tsundere," was it?
fields.JP: そういうの、ツンデレって言うんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe there's an old word
that describes someone like
you. "Tsundere," was it?

fields.EN:
I-It's because I still don't
trust you, you hear?!
fields.JP: だ、誰があんたなんかに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-It's because I still don't
trust you, you hear?!

fields.EN:
Hahaha!
See? Exactly what I said.
fields.JP: はははっ。素直じゃないなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha!
See? Exactly what I said.

fields.EN:
You can read them like a book.
In that sense, I guess they're
being honest about themselves.
fields.JP:
二人とも、とっても分かりやすいし、
ある意味素直だと思うんだけどなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can read them like a book.
In that sense, I guess they're
being honest about themselves.

fields.EN:
(Hm...?
Oyayubi and Alice together?
Well, that's unusual.)
fields.JP:
（あれは……
　親指がアリスに話しかけてる
　珍しいこともあるもんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm...?
Thumbelina and Alice together?
Well, that's unusual.)

fields.EN:
Are you getting used
to being here?
fields.JP: ここでの生活には慣れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you getting used
to being here?

fields.EN:
Yes, sort of...
I can't say I'm all that
comfortable yet.
fields.JP:
ええ、そうね……
まだ、少し戸惑う部分もあるけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, sort of...
I can't say I'm all that
comfortable yet.

fields.EN:
Really? What's on your mind?
It looks like something is
bothering you.
fields.JP:
そう？　そのわりには、
浮かない顔をしているようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? What's on your mind?
It looks like something is
bothering you.

fields.EN: Good! It looks like I'm first!
fields.JP: よし！　一番乗りはワレの物だ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Good! It looks like I'm first!

fields.EN:
Urrh!
I was gonna beat you here!
fields.JP: うー！　あとちょっとで追い抜けたのにー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh!
I was gonna beat you here!

fields.JP: ふははははっ、ワレは最強だからな！
あら、ちょうどいいところに……

fields.EN:
Hameln! Rapu!
Can you come here for a moment?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、ラプ！
ちょっとこっち来なさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln! Rappy!
Can you come here for a moment?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: ん？　ワレに何の用だ？
おやゆびー！　アリス―！　げんきー？

fields.EN:
Yes, we're okay.
You know, Alice said she wants to
join you girls.
fields.JP:
はいはい、元気よ。
それより、アリスが一緒に遊びたいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, we're okay.
You know, Alice said she wants to
join you girls.

fields.EN:
Stop with the stern look on your
face, and just jump in.
fields.JP:
いつまでも難しい顔して考えてないで、
思い切って飛び込んでみればいいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop with the stern look on your
face, and just jump in.

fields.EN:
I don't know what's going on
here, but if you want to play with
us you're free to join!
fields.JP:
なんだかよく分からんが、
ワレと遊びたいというなら歓迎してやろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what's going on
here, but if you want to play with
us you're free to join!

fields.EN:
Yaaay!
Oyayubi and Alice no play often.
Can't wait!
fields.JP:
やったー！　
おやゆびとありすとは、
あんまり遊んだことないから楽しみ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yaaay!
Thumby and Alice no play often.
Can't wait!

fields.EN:
Look at the smiles on their faces.
Are you telling me you're going
to refuse?
fields.JP:
さて、あんたはこの眩しい笑顔を、
曇らせる事ができるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at the smiles on their faces.
Are you telling me you're going
to refuse?

fields.EN:
Unbelievable... I can't believe
you set me up like this.
fields.JP: はぁ……その言い方は卑怯よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable... I can't believe
you set me up like this.

fields.EN: Hm, let's play a game of tag!
fields.JP: ふむ、ならば鬼ごっこをするぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm, let's play a game of tag!

fields.EN:
Oooh! Let's play!
Alice and Oyayubi are it!
fields.JP:
やろうやろう！
ありすとおやゆびが鬼ねー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oooh! Let's play!
Alice and Thumby are it!

fields.EN:
I can't believe you dragged me
into this...
fields.JP: まさか、こんなことになるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you dragged me
into this...

fields.EN:
C'mon, let's go and get them!
If we're gonna play, we're gonna
play to win!
fields.JP:
ほら、さっさと追いかけるわよ！
やるからには絶対勝つんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, let's go and get them!
If we're gonna play, we're gonna
play to win!

fields.EN:
(Oyayubi really looks out for
others. I guess I can leave them
alone.)
fields.JP:
（親指もあれで面倒見いいよな。
　あの様子なら、任せて大丈夫だろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina really looks out for
others. I guess I can leave them
alone.)

fields.EN:
Hey there, Oyayubi.
Having a friendly bath?
fields.JP:
やあ、親指。
姉妹仲良くお風呂かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey there, Thumbelina.
Having a friendly bath?

fields.EN:
Nothing. We were just taking a
bath together as sisters to
strengthen our bond.
fields.JP:
べつに。どうもしないわよ。
仲直りの意味も込めて久しぶりに姉妹で、
お風呂に入ってるだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing. We were just taking a
bath together as sisters to
strengthen our bond.

fields.EN:
I'm enjoying my time with them,
washing their backs and things...
fields.JP:
そう、お互いに背中を流してあげたり、
とっても幸せな時間を過ごしているわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm enjoying my time with them,
washing their backs and things...

fields.EN:
Uh, you don't seem like you're
enjoying yourself.
fields.JP:
いや、幸せそうって顔には、
とても見えないんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you don't seem like you're
enjoying yourself.

fields.EN:
Mind your own business.
It's just something I need to
get over...
fields.JP:
気にしないで。これはわたし個人の……
そう、とても個人的な問題なのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind your own business.
It's just something I need to
get over...

fields.EN:
(Mmm... I have no idea what
she's trying to say.)
fields.JP:
（うーん、困ったな
　まったく意味が判らないぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mmm... I have no idea what
she's trying to say.)

fields.EN:
I should enjoy seeing them
mature... Maturing is a good
thing...
fields.JP:
そうよね……いいことなのよね。
二人がちゃんと色々成長してるんだもの。
これは喜ぶべきことなのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should enjoy seeing them
mature... Maturing is a good
thing...

fields.EN:
Hey, you're comparing my chest
with Nemu's, aren't you?
fields.JP:
ちょっとあんた、今わたしとネムの
どこを見比べたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you're comparing my chest
with Sleepy's, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Don't apologize...
You're making me feel worse...
fields.JP:
そこで謝んないでよ。
余計辛くなるでしょうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't apologize...
You're making me feel worse...

fields.EN:
Um, but you don't need to worry.
Each person has their own traits,
isn't that right, Shirayuki?
fields.JP:
え、えっと、気にすることはないと思うよ。
ほら、それぞれに個性ってことで。
白雪もそう思うだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, but you don't need to worry.
Each person has their own traits,
isn't that right, Snow White?

fields.JP: あ、あんまりこっちを見ないでください！

fields.EN:
I don't want you to look at
Shirayuki's stocky body!
fields.JP: 白雪のだらしない身体を見ないで下さい～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want you to look at
Snow White's stocky body!

fields.EN: Uh, I don't think you're stocky.
fields.JP: べ、別にだらしなくなんてないと思うよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, I don't think you're stocky.

fields.JP: そんなことありません！

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama is slender, and
Nemu-chan has an hourglass figure.
Me...? I'm just a lump of meat!
fields.JP:
親指姉様みたいにスレンダーでもないし、
ネムちゃんみたいにスタイル抜群でもない
こんなダメダメなおにくの塊！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina is slender, and
Sleepy has an hourglass figure.
Me...? I'm just a lump of meat!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I-I need to lose weight...
I need to get slim...
I'll do it from tomorrow...
fields.JP:
ダイエット……ダイエットしなきゃ……
痩せなきゃ……明日からちゃんと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I need to lose weight...
I need to get slim...
I'll do it from tomorrow...

fields.EN:
(They can't even take a bath
without a commotion, can they?)
fields.JP:
（この姉妹はお風呂も無事に
　入れないのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They can't even take a bath
without a commotion, can they?)

fields.EN:
You don't need to lose weight.
Your body is proof that you're
healthy.
fields.JP:
白雪、ダイエットなんてしなくてもいいの。
むしろ健康な証でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to lose weight.
Your body is proof that you're
healthy.

fields.EN:
Yes... I'm very happy to see
you two mature so well...
fields.JP:
ええ……そうよ。
わたしは、あんた達がちゃんと
成長しててくれて、嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I'm very happy to see
you two mature so well...

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I should've noticed how you two
grew both in body and soul.
I've been too protective of you...
fields.JP:
心も体も成長して大人になっていたのに、
わたしったら、過保護すぎたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I should've noticed how you two
grew both in body and soul.
I've been too protective of you...

fields.EN:
Heh... If anyone needs protection,
it's me. I haven't grown a bit...
fields.JP:
むしろ、身体はわたしが一番成長してない
みたいだしね……あはは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... If anyone needs protection,
it's me. I haven't grown a bit...

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Please get a hold of yourself!
You're our Oyayubi-neesama!
We're very proud of you!
fields.JP:
しっかりしてください！
親指姉様は、白雪たちの姉様なのです！
誰よりも尊敬する白雪たちの姉様なのです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please get a hold of yourself!
You're our dear sister!
We're very proud of you!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama
Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I love you two, too.
If not, I wouldn't be so
protective of you!
fields.JP:
わたしも、あなた達のことが大好きよ。
好きじゃなかったら、あんなに
過保護にならないもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you two, too.
If not, I wouldn't be so
protective of you!

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: うぐぐ……ちょ、く、苦しってば……！？

fields.EN: No! We won't let you go!
fields.JP: いやです！　もう絶対に離しません！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! We won't let you go!

fields.EN:
We'll always... be with you...
Won't ever... let you go...!
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll always... be with you...
Won't ever... let you go...!

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指お姉様 -> Oyayubi-onee-sama

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Stop it!
You're suffocating Oyayubi!
fields.JP:
ちょっと、二人とも！
親指が窒息しそうになってるからーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Stop it!
You're suffocating Thumbelina!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm? Ah, the Oyayubi sisters...
I wonder what they're doing.
fields.JP:
