ん？　……ああ、親指たちか。
三姉妹で顔つき合わせて、
なにしてるんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Ah, the Thumbelina sisters...
I wonder what they're doing.

fields.EN:
Everyone's here...
It's time we get our summit
meeting started.
fields.JP:
みんな揃ったわね。
これから三姉妹重要会議を始めるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's here...
It's time we get our summit
meeting started.

fields.EN:
We're here to discuss this...
The three-pronged earphones...
fields.JP:
議題はもちろんこれ。
この間ゲットした三又イヤホンについてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're here to discuss this...
The three-pronged earphones...

fields.EN:
The issue is what we'll use it
for, right?
fields.JP: 使い道をどうするか、ですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The issue is what we'll use it
for, right?

fields.EN:
Yes, it's used to listen to music,
but we don't have any device to
play music.
fields.JP:
そうね。本来の使い道は音楽を聞くことよ。
でも残念なことに、わたし達の周りには
音楽を聞ける機械がないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, it's used to listen to music,
but we don't have any device to
play music.

fields.EN:
But stowing away for safekeeping
doesn't do us good, so we need to
think of a way to use it.
fields.JP:
かといって大事に
しまい込むだけじゃ芸がない。
なにか他に使い道がないか考えるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But stowing away for safekeeping
doesn't do us good, so we need to
think of a way to use it.

fields.EN:
Yup...
Us Big Three... can come up...
with a good idea...
fields.JP: ん……。三人寄れば、文殊の知恵……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup...
Us Big Three... can come up...
with a good idea...

fields.EN:
Color me impressed.
I didn't know you knew
such a word.
fields.JP:
あら、よくそんな言葉知ってたわね。
偉いわ、ネム
fields.LOCALIZED:
Color me impressed.
I didn't know you knew
such a word.

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan is right.
Us Big Three can come up
with something for sure!
fields.JP:
ネムちゃんの言う通り、
三人で知恵を絞ればなにかいい案も
出ますよね。がんばりましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy is right.
Us Big Three can come up
with something for sure!

fields.EN:
That said, Shirayuki actually
has an idea...
fields.JP:
実は、白雪も一つアイディアを
考えてきたんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, Snow White actually
has an idea...

fields.JP: どんなアイディアなの？　教えて

fields.EN:
The earphones have six speakers
and cords, right? We first weave
them together, like so...
fields.JP:
このイヤホンはスピーカーが六個あるので、
六本のコードがありますよね？
まず、これを丁寧に編み込んでいきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The earphones have six speakers
and cords, right? We first weave
them together, like so...

fields.EN: Weave all six of them? That's already pretty difficult right from the start...
fields.JP:
六本を編み込むの？
まず、の時点でちょっと難易度高いわね……

fields.EN:
And... voila!
The cords form a basket-like part
that you cover your eyes with.
fields.JP:
そうして出来上がりましたのが、こちら。
籐のカゴみたいに編んだ部分を目に当てて
fields.LOCALIZED:
And... voila!
The cords form a basket-like part
that you cover your eyes with.

fields.EN:
The plug is used to secure
the earphones to the head...
and done! A sleep mask!
fields.JP:
残ったプラグ部分のコードで頭に固定すれば、
アイマスクの完成です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The plug is used to secure
the earphones to the head...
and done! A sleep mask!

fields.EN:
I-I see... It's going to take a bit
of getting used to, but it isn't
bad at all.
fields.JP:
な、なるほどね。
たしかに手先の器用さが求められるけど、
仕上がりは悪くないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I see... It's going to take a bit
of getting used to, but it isn't
bad at all.

fields.EN:
But, does that have to be
something made from the
earphones?
fields.JP:
だけどそれ、イヤホンで作る意味
あるのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, does that have to be
something made from the
earphones?

fields.EN:
The cord is tough, so I guess it
won't work well with sleeping.
How about using it awake?
fields.JP:
硬くて使い心地がいまいちなので、
ちょっと寝るときには向きませんよね。
だから起きてるときに使います
fields.LOCALIZED:
The cord is tough, so I guess it
won't work well with sleeping.
How about using it awake?

fields.EN:
Like, when you're scared of
mirrors! You can wave mirrors
goodbye with it!
fields.JP:
鏡が怖いときに使うんです！
通路に鏡があっても、これさえあれば大丈夫。
鏡を見ずに通過することができるんですよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, when you're scared of
mirrors! You can wave mirrors
goodbye with it!

fields.EN:
N-Now hold on there. It's
dangerous covering your eyes
with it while walking.
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待って。
アイマスクで目をふさいでたら、
前が見えなくて歩けないんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-Now hold on there. It's
dangerous covering your eyes
with it while walking.

fields.EN:
You're right... I'm so sorry.
I thought it would work.
fields.JP:
うぅ、たしかにそうですね。すみません。
いいアイディアだと思ったんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... I'm so sorry.
I thought it would work.

fields.EN:
You did get the brainstorm going
so good job with that.
fields.JP:
でも、真っ先にアイディア出してくれたのは
助かったわ。ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You did get the brainstorm going
so good job with that.

fields.EN:
I can't be picking on ideas like
this. I have to come up with
something, too.
fields.JP:
わたしもツッコミ入れてるばかりじゃ駄目ね。
ちゃんとアイディア出さないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't be picking on ideas like
this. I have to come up with
something, too.

fields.EN:
You know, Shirayuki had the
right idea, but how about using
the earphones as an ornament?
fields.JP:
ねぇ、今の白雪の案を聞いて
思いついたんだけど、あえてイヤホンを
身に着けるっていうのもアリじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, Snow White had the
right idea, but how about using
the earphones as an ornament?

fields.EN:
Like, you tie this, like... so.
Then you do... this...
fields.JP:
これをこうして結んで、
こうして、こうすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, you tie this, like... so.
Then you do... this...

fields.EN:
Ta-da! How's this?
A specially crafted choker!
fields.JP:
ほら、変わったデザインの
チョーカーになったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ta-da! How's this?
A specially crafted choker!

fields.JP: どことなく前衛的でおしゃれですね！

fields.EN:
Heh heh, not bad, is it?
Now, all you need to do is
tie it behind your neck like...
fields.JP:
ふふ、悪くないでしょ？
これを首に巻けば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, not bad, is it?
Now, all you need to do is
tie it behind your neck like...

fields.EN:
Hm...? It's a bit tight...
Get on me...! There...!
fields.JP:
ん？　なんか首に絡まって……
ちょっとキツイわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...? It's a bit tight...
Get on me...! There...!

fields.EN:
Urgh...! Th-This isn't good...!
Neck... strangled...! A-Air...!
fields.JP:
うぐっ、ま、まずいわこれ、
首が絞まっ……く、苦しぃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urgh...! Th-This isn't good...!
Neck... strangled...! A-Air...!

fields.JP: た、大変！　親指姉様ー！！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Huff... Huff... That was close...
Guess you shouldn't wrap cords
around your neck. Too dangerous.
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ……あー危なかった。
コードは首に巻いちゃ駄目ね。
小さい子が真似してもいけないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huff... Huff... That was close...
Guess you shouldn't wrap cords
around your neck. Too dangerous.

fields.EN:
Well, what else can we use
these for then?
fields.JP:
このイヤホン、どうしましょう。
他になにか使い道は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, what else can we use
these for then?

fields.EN:
Ears? You mean, put them on
our ears?
fields.JP: 耳？　イヤホンを耳につけるっていうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ears? You mean, put them on
our ears?

fields.EN:
Um, we can't use it to listen to
music, so you mean use it
as an accessory?
fields.JP:
音楽は聴けませんから、
アクセサリーとして……ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, we can't use it to listen to
music, so you mean use it
as an accessory?

fields.EN:
Um, you're not going to be able to
hear anything with it on. It'd be
no different than any earplug.
fields.JP:
でもそれだとなにも
聞こえなくなっちゃうわよ。
それじゃあまるで耳栓……あ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you're not going to be able to
hear anything with it on. It'd be
no different than any earplug.

fields.EN:
Oh, I see. We can wear it to
shut out the sounds around us
when we sleep.
fields.JP:
なるほど。寝るときに使えば、
うるさい音が聞こえなくていいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. We can wear it to
shut out the sounds around us
when we sleep.

fields.EN:
Good idea, Nemu! We'll just use
it as an earplug instead, so that
we can sleep better!
fields.JP:
ナイスだわ、ネム！　そうよ、
耳につけて音が聞こえなくなるんなら、
そう使えばいいんじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good idea, Sleepy! We'll just use
it as an earplug instead, so that
we can sleep better!

fields.EN:
So, not being able to listen with
it was a feature in itself! Great
find, Nemu-chan!
fields.JP: 逆転の発想ですね。ネムちゃん、すごい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, not being able to listen with
it was a feature in itself! Great
find, Sleepy!

fields.EN:
Well then, let's see how this
works!
fields.JP:
よし、さっそく三人で耳栓として
使ってみるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, let's see how this
works!

fields.EN:
Uh... You know, this thing doesn't
really work too well as an
earplug...
fields.JP:
……ねぇ。今気づいたんだけど、
これ、思ったほど音をシャットアウト
するわけじゃないのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... You know, this thing doesn't
really work too well as an
earplug...

fields.EN:
Y-You're right...
I can hear some noise even
with it on...
fields.JP:
そ、そうですね。
わりと雑音が聞こえますね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're right...
I can hear some noise even
with it on...

fields.EN:
The other problem is that we'd
have to sleep together and
share this thing...
fields.JP:
あと寝るときに使うにしても、
三人一緒に寝てないと使えないという……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other problem is that we'd
have to sleep together and
share this thing...

fields.EN:
We'd have to stay completely
still to be able to use it
properly, too...
fields.JP:
下手に寝がえりが打てなくて、
ちょっと眠りづらいですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'd have to stay completely
still to be able to use it
properly, too...

fields.JP: ネムはもう寝ちゃってるけど

fields.EN:
Well, a valiant attempt to use
it, but I guess we'll have to
find some other use.
fields.JP:
はぁ……。すごくいいアイディアだと
思ったんだけど、耳栓にするには
ちょっと無理があったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, a valiant attempt to use
it, but I guess we'll have to
find some other use.

fields.EN:
I guess earphones were meant
to be used for music and
nothing else...
fields.JP:
やっぱり音楽を聞く以外の方法では、
イヤホンを役立てることは
難しいんでしょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess earphones were meant
to be used for music and
nothing else...

fields.EN:
I guess we'll have to think a
bit more on how to use these
earphones.
fields.JP:
ええ。今のところ、イヤホンの使い道は
保留って感じかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess we'll have to think a
bit more on how to use these
earphones.

fields.EN:
If only we had a music player. It
would've been nice, especially
since we could listen together.
fields.JP:
音楽を聞けたらよかったんですけどね。
せっかくの三又イヤホンなのに、残念です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we had a music player. It
would've been nice, especially
since we could listen together.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sure the day will come
when we can enjoy some
good music.
fields.JP:
……そうね。きっとそのうち、
このイヤホンで音楽を聞けるような日が来るわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sure the day will come
when we can enjoy some
good music.

fields.EN:
And when that day comes, we're
going to use this together, and
that's a promise.
fields.JP:
そのときが来たら、
三人でこのイヤホンを使うのよ。
約束ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And when that day comes, we're
going to use this together, and
that's a promise.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
It's a good thing they're enjoying
their time with it. I guess it was
meant for them to have.
fields.JP:
親指達が喜んでくれてよかった。
やっぱりあのイヤホンは、あの三人が
持つべきものだったのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a good thing they're enjoying
their time with it. I guess it was
meant for them to have.

fields.EN:
Is that you, Shirayuki?
Come on in.
fields.JP: その声は白雪か？　どうぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that you, Snow White?
Come on in.

fields.EN:
Um, well... I just wanted to
say hello as a new member here.
fields.JP:
はい、その……これから一緒に
がんばっていくので、
改めてご挨拶をと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... I just wanted to
say hello as a new member here.

fields.EN: D-Did I come at the wrong time?
fields.JP: も、もしかしてご迷惑でしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED: D-Did I come at the wrong time?

fields.EN:
Not at all. I was just surprised
how formal you were. Well,
hello to you, too.
fields.JP:
いや、まさか。あんまり律儀だから、
ちょと驚いただけだよ。
僕のほうこそ、改めてよろしく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I was just surprised
how formal you were. Well,
hello to you, too.

fields.EN:
Thank you, and here's to looking
forward to being with you again...
fields.JP: よかった……。よろしくお願いします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, and here's to looking
forward to being with you again...

fields.EN: Oh, and... I have to apologize.
fields.JP: それから、あの……一つ謝りたいことが
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, and... I have to apologize.

fields.EN:
It's about Oyayubi-neesama. I'm sorry she's
been so harsh toward you and the others,
Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
親指姉様のことです。
おつうちゃん達にキツイ態度を取ったりして、
すみませんでした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina...
I'm sorry about her antics
towards you...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
(She's been bothered by that?
She doesn't have to apologize...)
fields.JP:
（それをわざわざ謝るなんて。
　もしかして、ずっと気にしてたのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's been bothered by that?
She doesn't have to apologize...)

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama can be misunderstood,
but she is actually a very kind
person.
fields.JP:
親指姉様はちょっと誤解されやすい
ところがあるんですけど、
本当は優しい人なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear sister can be misunderstood,
but she is actually a very kind
person.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
So, I'm just hoping she didn't
leave a bad impression with you.
Please, forgive her.
fields.JP:
だから、その……
気を悪くしないでほしいんです。
ごめんなさい。許してあげてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I'm just hoping she didn't
leave a bad impression with you.
Please, forgive her.

fields.EN:
Is that it? Sure, she can get a bit
under my skin, but I know she's
a caring and loving person.
fields.JP:
なんだ、そんなことか。
たしかに前よりキツくはなったけど、
親指が優しい子なのはわかってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that it? Sure, she can get a bit
under my skin, but I know she's
a caring and loving person.

fields.EN: So there's nothing to worry here.
fields.JP: 僕は別に気にしてないから、大丈夫！
fields.LOCALIZED: So there's nothing to worry here.

fields.JP: ごめんなさい。ごめんなさい……！

fields.EN: No, really, no need to apologize.
fields.JP:
いや、本当に気にしてないから。
君がそんなに謝ることじゃないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED: No, really, no need to apologize.

fields.EN:
A-Are you sure? After all that
she said to you?
fields.JP:
ほ、本当にいいんですか？
親指姉様ったら、あんなにキツイ態度で
ひどい言い方をしたのに？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Are you sure? After all that
she said to you?

fields.EN:
Like I said, I'm fine.
It's not like I'd get mad over
what she said to me.
fields.JP:
だから、いいって。
今さら態度がキツイからって怒ったりしないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said, I'm fine.
It's not like I'd get mad over
what she said to me.

fields.EN:
Or, would you rather like to hear
me say that I won't forgive her?
fields.JP:
……それとも、許さないって
言ったほうがよかったかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or, would you rather like to hear
me say that I won't forgive her?

fields.EN:
No... It's just that...
I'm just a bit surprised you don't
seem very phased by her.
fields.JP:
いえ、そんなことは……。
ただ、あんまりあっさり許してもらえたので、
拍子抜けしちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... It's just that...
I'm just a bit surprised you don't
seem very phased by her.

fields.EN:
I'm also relieved you're not angry,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: おつうちゃんが怒ってなくてホッとしました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm also relieved that you're
not angry at her.

fields.EN:
You changed a bit, too... I don't
recall you being so worried
like this before.
fields.JP:
……なんか、ちょっと変わったな。
親指もそうだけど、白雪も昔より他人の目を
気にするようになったような気が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You changed a bit, too... I don't
recall you being so worried
like this before.

fields.EN:
Is that so?
I can't really tell myself.
fields.JP:
そうでしょうか？
自分ではよくわかりませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that so?
I can't really tell myself.

fields.EN:
I can tell that I'm not like
Oyayubi-neesama. She keeps
scolding me for my naivete...
fields.JP:
でも、考え方が親指姉様と似てるわけでは
ないと思います。白雪はお人好しすぎるって、
親指姉様にはよく叱られちゃいますし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can tell that I'm not like
sister Thumbelina. She keeps
scolding me for my naivete...

fields.EN:
She also tends to come out strong,
so we get into arguments quite
a lot recently.
fields.JP:
親指姉様は親指姉様で、あの通り
人に厳しく当たりすぎるところがあるから、
つい口論になったりするんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
She also tends to come out strong,
so we get into arguments quite
a lot recently.

fields.EN:
I know she's only saying what she
says for me and Nemu-chan, but...
fields.JP:
白雪やネムちゃんのことを想って
くれてるのはわかるんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know she's only saying what she
says for me and Sleepy, but...

fields.EN:
But, I don't think that gives her
the right to be yelling at others.
fields.JP:
でも、だからって人に厳しくするのは
おかしいと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I don't think that gives her
the right to be yelling at others.

fields.EN:
(It must have been stressful to
have worried like this the whole
time...)
fields.JP:
（白雪、ずっと一人で悩んでたのかな。
　そうだとしたら辛かっただろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must have been stressful to
have worried like this the whole
time...)

fields.EN: (Still... didn't Oyayubi, Shirayuki, and Nemuri start thinking a little more extremely after they joined the Order of the Sun?)
fields.JP:
（しかしなぁ。親指も白雪も眠りも、
　タイヨウ教団に行ってから考え方が
　ちょっと極端になったんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to say, they sure changed
a lot since they joined the Order
of the Sun.)

fields.EN:
(Or, maybe it's just that time
took its toll on them...)
fields.JP:
（月日が経てば考え方も変わる、と言われれば
　それまでかもしれないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Or, maybe it's just that time
took its toll on them...)

fields.EN:
We argue a lot because we think differently,
and it causes trouble for you and the others too,
Otsuu-chan... sigh.
fields.JP:
……考え方の違いのせいで喧嘩しちゃう
こともよくあって、おつうちゃん達にも
ご迷惑かけちゃってますけど……はぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry that us arguing is
causing everyone so many
problems...

fields.EN:
No need to worry.
I think everything is just fine.
fields.JP:
迷惑だなんて思ってないよ。
……それに、大丈夫だと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to worry.
I think everything is just fine.

fields.EN:
You sisters each care for each
other in their own way, so I'm
sure things will fall in place.
fields.JP:
互いに大切に想い合ってる姉妹なんだから、
少しくらい考え方が違ったって、きっと大丈夫
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sisters each care for each
other in their own way, so I'm
sure things will fall in place.

fields.EN:
If you have anything on your mind
that you'd like to let out, feel
free to come and talk to me.
fields.JP:
白雪は真面目に考えすぎて
抱え込んじゃうみたいだけど、
そんなときはいつでも話を聞くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have anything on your mind
that you'd like to let out, feel
free to come and talk to me.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan... I feel a lot better now.
Thank you very much.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……。なんだか、
おかげで心が楽になった気がします。
ありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu... I feel a lot better now.
Thank you very much.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Oh, but you'll owe me one,
got it?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but you'll owe me one,
got it?

fields.EN:
Hm? Say, Otsuu-chan?
Isn't that Shirayuki-chan?
fields.JP:
……ん？　ねぇ、おつうちゃん。
あそこにいるのって白雪ちゃんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Say, Otsuu?
Isn't that Snow White?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
You're right. What's she doing in
the middle of the hallway?
Is she... shaking?
fields.JP:
本当だ。廊下で立ち止まって……
いや、震えてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. What's she doing in
the middle of the hallway?
Is she... shaking?

fields.EN:
What are you doing there,
Shirayuki?
fields.JP: 白雪、そんなところでなにしてるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing there,
Snow White?

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan, Ningyo-chan...
Th-There's a mirror over there...
fields.JP:
あ、おつうちゃん、人魚ちゃん……。
そ、そこに、鏡があって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu, Little Mermaid...
Th-There's a mirror over there...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Mirror? Oh, you mean that large
one over there?
fields.JP: 鏡……？　ああ、うん。あの大きい姿見の鏡か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mirror? Oh, you mean that large
one over there?

fields.EN:
We put that there so that everyone
could use it, but is there a
problem?
fields.JP:
みんなが日常的に使うから、使いやすい
ようにって廊下に置いてあるんだよね。
あれがどうかした？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We put that there so that everyone
could use it, but is there a
problem?

fields.EN:
Why would you be scared?
Are you scared that you'd see a
ghost behind you?
fields.JP:
どうして怖いの？
あ、自分の後ろにオバケが映るんじゃ
ないかと思っちゃうとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why would you be scared?
Are you scared that you'd see a
ghost behind you?

fields.EN:
It's not that. I can't explain it,
but I'm just scared of seeing
myself in the mirror...
fields.JP:
そういうのじゃないんですけど、
どうしても怖くて。
鏡自体も、鏡に自分が映ることも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that. I can't explain it,
but I'm just scared of seeing
myself in the mirror...

fields.EN:
It's Shirayuki's Blood Libido.
I can't get myself to budge
the moment I see a mirror...
fields.JP:
これが白雪の血式リビドーなんです。
鏡を前にすると怖くて、
足がすくんじゃって……うぅ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's Snow White's Blood Libido.
I can't get myself to budge
the moment I see a mirror...

fields.EN:
(She really is scared...
What a Blood Libido to have...)
fields.JP:
（本気で怖がってるみたいだ。
　厄介な血式リビドーだな。……いや、
　厄介じゃない血式リビドーなんてないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She really is scared...
What a Blood Libido to have...)

fields.EN:
Are you always like this when
you go through here?
fields.JP:
この廊下を通るとき、毎回そんなに
びくびくしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you always like this when
you go through here?

fields.EN:
Yes... I can get through somehow
when Oyayubi-neesama and Nemu-chan
are with me, but...
fields.JP:
はい……。親指姉様やネムちゃんが一緒なら
一気に通っちゃえるんですけど、
今日は一人だったもので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I can get through somehow
when sister Thumbelina and Sleepy
are with me, but...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Poor thing.
I wonder if there's anything we
can do to help.
fields.JP: かわいそう。どうにかできないかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Poor thing.
I wonder if there's anything we
can do to help.

fields.EN:
I know, why don't we stand in
front of the mirror so we can
obstruct its view from you?
fields.JP:
そうだ。僕たちが鏡の前に立って、
鏡が見えないように隠してあげれば
いいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, why don't we stand in
front of the mirror so we can
obstruct its view from you?

fields.EN:
Good idea, Otsuu-chan!
We can hide it from you,
Shirayuki-chan.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、ナイスアイディア！
わたしたちで白雪ちゃんを
守ってあげればいいんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good idea, Otsuu!
We can hide it from you,
Snow White.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Okay, so we'll stand in front of
it like... this...
fields.JP: じゃあ、二人並んで鏡の前に立って、と……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, so we'll stand in front of
it like... this...

fields.EN:
There you go, Shirayuki.
You can't see the mirror now,
right?
fields.JP: 白雪、どうぞ。これで鏡は見えないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go, Snow White.
You can't see the mirror now,
right?

fields.JP: すみません。じゃあ、遠慮なく……！
……はぁ、無事に通り抜けられました！

fields.EN:
Thank you so very much,
Otsuu-chan, Ningyo-chan!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、人魚ちゃん、
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so very much,
Otsuu, Little Mermaid!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: まぁ、貸しだからね。うん

fields.EN:
You're so kind not to tease me
because of my fear of mirrors. You
even went out of the way to help.
fields.JP:
二人とも優しいんですね。鏡が怖いって
言っても、ちっとも馬鹿にしないで、
親身になって助けてくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so kind not to tease me
because of my fear of mirrors. You
even went out of the way to help.

fields.EN: The pain of Blood Libido is something only those who know it can understand. We're in the same boat.
fields.JP:
血式リビドーの辛さは、
わかる人にしかわからないからね。
お互い様ってやつだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We all know how tough it is to
live with our Blood Libido.
We're all in this together.

fields.EN:
But isn't it hard to live without
mirrors? I mean, how do you
check yourself out?
fields.JP:
だけど、鏡を見られないと
毎日の身支度が大変じゃない？
いつもどうしてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But isn't it hard to live without
mirrors? I mean, how do you
check yourself out?

fields.EN:
Um, Oyayubi-neesama helps me
get dressed and things...
fields.JP:
えっと、それは親指姉様に
手伝ってもらってるので……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, sister Thumbelina helps me
get dressed and things...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I know it's weird. I'm no
different from some small child
getting help to get dressed.
fields.JP:
あ……。ち、小さい子どもみたいで、
おかしいと思うかもしれませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's weird. I'm no
different from some small child
getting help to get dressed.

fields.EN:
That's not true. If anything,
I'm a bit jealous how well you
sisters get along.
fields.JP: そんなことないよ。仲良し姉妹でいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. If anything,
I'm a bit jealous how well you
sisters get along.

fields.EN:
Yup, I wish things were like that
for me, too.
fields.JP: うん。ちょっと憧れちゃう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, I wish things were like that
for me, too.

fields.JP: そ、そうですか？　えへへ……

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama can get a bit
too clingy at times, but she's
very kind at heart.
fields.JP:
親指姉様はちょっと過保護なところも
あるんですけど、すごく優しいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina can get a bit
too clingy at times, but she's
very kind at heart.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
She makes sure I don't have to
rely on mirrors by taking care of
me in all sorts of ways.
fields.JP:
白雪が鏡を見ないで済むように、
普段から気を遣ってくれたりするんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She makes sure I don't have to
rely on mirrors by taking care of
me in all sorts of ways.

fields.EN:
(I never noticed before. She must do it
so casually that nobody notices.)
fields.JP:
（今まで気づかなかった。
　きっとすごくさり気なく
　やってあげてるんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know that...
I guess Thumbelina does it in a
way so that we don't take notice.)

fields.EN:
You girls are so different from each
other, but you get along well. You're such
wonderful sisters. I'm a little jealous.
fields.JP:
性格が全然違っても、
本当に仲の良い姉妹なんだね。
素敵な姉妹で、うらやましいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls are so different from each
other, but you get along well. You're such
wonderful sisters. I'm a little jealous.

fields.EN:
I think so too, but for me, I'm
happy I didn't have any siblings.
fields.JP:
……白雪たち姉妹はすごくいいと思うけど、
僕は姉妹とか兄弟がいなくてよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think so too, but for me, I'm
happy I didn't have any siblings.

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? I would hate
to have competition in having
your grace, my dear princess.
fields.JP:
決まっています。
僕と同じ相手を慕われたら
困るからですよ、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? I would hate
to have competition in having
your grace, my dear princess.

fields.EN: It's obvious we'd end up fighting over Princess. That's why I'm glad I don't have any siblings.
fields.JP:
姫の取り合いになることは目に見えています。
だから僕に兄弟姉妹はいなくてよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I had siblings, I can see us
fighting over you.

fields.EN:
I-I guess I should be glad I don't have
siblings too. That way I get you all to myself,
Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
わ、わたしも、姉妹がいなくてよかったかも。
おつうちゃんを独り占めできるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I guess I should be happy
I don't have siblings, too.
That way I have you all to myself.

fields.EN:
Heh heh...
I can see you two get along
wonderfully, too.
fields.JP: ふふっ。二人の関係も、とっても素敵ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...
I can see you two get along
wonderfully, too.

fields.EN:
What's with the sigh?
Is there a problem?
fields.JP:
ため息ついてたみたいだけど、
どうかしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with the sigh?
Is there a problem?

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan, Ningyo-chan...
I was just getting a bit down on
myself...
fields.JP:
ああ、おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃん……。
ちょっと、自分の嫌なところを考えて
憂鬱な気分になってたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu, Little Mermaid...
I was just getting a bit down on
myself...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm just surprised at how
narrow-minded I am, or like how
I get scared so easily...
fields.JP:
白雪の心の狭さとか、
どうしても怖がっちゃうところとか、
考え出したらきりがなくて……はぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just surprised at how
narrow-minded I am, or like how
I get scared so easily...

fields.EN:
Huh? I've never seen you as a
narrow-minded person before.
fields.JP:
えー？　白雪ちゃんの心が狭いなんて
思ったことはないけどなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I've never seen you as a
narrow-minded person before.

fields.EN:
On the contrary, you always come
to help Oyayubi and things.
fields.JP:
うん、むしろ親指をフォローしてあげたりして、
優しい子だと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, you always come
to help Thumbelina and things.

fields.EN:
As for being scared, I'm guessing
it's about the mirrors, but that's
just your Blood Libido at work.
fields.JP:
それに、鏡を怖がっちゃうのは仕方ないよ。
血式リビドーなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
As for being scared, I'm guessing
it's about the mirrors, but that's
just your Blood Libido at work.

fields.EN:
That's not it. Sure, I'm scared of
mirrors, but there's something
else that's scaring me...
fields.JP:
違うんです。鏡も怖いですけど、
どうしても怖がっちゃうっていうのは別のことで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it. Sure, I'm scared of
mirrors, but there's something
else that's scaring me...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
こんにちは、ジャックさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(What's the matter? She looks
so distraught...)
fields.JP:
（どうしたんだろう。
　なんだか顔が引きつっているような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the matter? She looks
so distraught...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
しらゆぎひべ……、だいじょう、ぶ？

fields.EN:
Whoa! What the...?!
Why are you hiding behind me?
fields.JP:
わっ、白雪？
なんで僕の後ろに隠れるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! What the...?!
Why are you hiding behind me?

fields.EN:
I-I-I'm so sorry!
It's just that Jack-san is...
fields.JP:
すすす、すみません！
……その、ジャックさんのことが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I-I'm so sorry!
It's just that Jack is...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
ひょっとして
どうしても怖がっちゃうって、
ジャックさんのこと？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Yes... I know he isn't bad,
but the moment I see him,
I just can't...
fields.JP:
……はい。悪い人じゃないことは
わかっているんです。わかっているのに、
いざ目の前にすると、どうしても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I know he isn't bad,
but the moment I see him,
I just can't...

fields.EN:
I know I'm just judging him by
his looks. I'm so narrow-minded.
I'm such a horrible girl...
fields.JP:
きっと外見で判断しちゃってるんですね。
白雪は心が狭くて駄目な子なんです、
本当に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm just judging him by
his looks. I'm so narrow-minded.
I'm such a horrible girl...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Well, I understand how you feel.
I mean, just by looks alone,
Jack can be quite intimidating.
fields.JP:
まぁ、白雪の言ってることも理解できなくは
ないよ。ジャックは外見だけなら、
けっこう迫力あるのも事実だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I understand how you feel.
I mean, just by looks alone,
Jack can be quite intimidating.

fields.EN:
I know he's our ally, and that
I shouldn't be scared, but...
fields.JP:
だけど仲間なんだから、
怖がっちゃいけないんですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know he's our ally, and that
I shouldn't be scared, but...

fields.EN:
It's okay, Shirayuki-chan.
Say, you have an apple with you,
right? You mind if I have one?
fields.JP:
白雪ちゃん、大丈夫だよ。
ねぇ、リンゴを持ってるでしょ？
貸してみて
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay, Snow White.
Say, you have an apple with you,
right? You mind if I have one?

fields.JP: じゃあ、よく見ててね。……それっ！

fields.EN:
Wow! Jack caught the apple
with his mouth!
fields.JP: すごい！　ジャックが口でキャッチした！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow! Jack caught the apple
with his mouth!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
むしゃ、むしゃ……。お……いぢい

fields.EN:
Um, "see" what?
I mean, that was amazing, but...
fields.JP:
えっと、なにがですか？
たしかにすごいと思いますけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, "see" what?
I mean, that was amazing, but...

fields.EN:
You'll know if you toss one.
Here, give it a try.
fields.JP:
白雪ちゃんも自分の手で
リンゴを投げてみればわかるよ。
ほら、やってみて
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll know if you toss one.
Here, give it a try.

fields.JP: は、はい。わかりました。……えいっ！
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
More? Okay, how about two in
a row? Here...!
fields.JP:
もっとですか？　それじゃあ、
今度は二つ連続で……えいっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
More? Okay, how about two in
a row? Here...!

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
むしゃ、むしゃ……ごっくん。げふっ

fields.EN:
So, how is it? Jack-san's looking
a lot cuter now, right?
fields.JP:
白雪ちゃん、どう？
ジャックさんもこうして見ると、
愛嬌があってちょっと可愛いでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how is it? Jack's looking
a lot cuter now, right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Not anymore! Now that I've had
a chance to interact with him,
he's not as scary as before.
fields.JP:
はい！　たしかにこうして接すると、
怖さもだいぶなくなりました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not anymore! Now that I've had
a chance to interact with him,
he's not as scary as before.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(That's good she overcame her
fear of Jack. But, she's looking
at him more as a pet now...)
fields.JP:
（怖くなくなったみたいでよかった。
　……でも、仲間というよりペットみたいな
　扱いなのが気になるけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's good she overcame her
fear of Jack. But, she's looking
at him more as a pet now...)

fields.EN:
Huh? Wait a second...
Weren't Shirayuki's apples
poisonous?
fields.JP:
あれ？　そういえば白雪のリンゴって
毒リンゴじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Wait a second...
Weren't Snow White's apples
poisonous?

fields.EN:
(Well, it doesn't look like it's
affecting Jack, so I guess it's
okay...)
fields.JP:
（まぁ、ジャック本人は大丈夫そうだから、
　気にしなくていいか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, it doesn't look like it's
affecting Jack, so I guess it's
okay...)

fields.EN:
What's with Shirayuki?
I feel like we've been through
this before...
fields.JP:
あれ、白雪がまたため息ついてる。
前にもこんなことがあったような……。
デジャヴ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with Snow White?
I feel like we've been through
this before...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki-chan does have a tendency
of feeling bad for herself...
fields.JP:
白雪ちゃんって、ちょっと落ち込み
やすいところがあるのかもね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White does have a tendency
of feeling bad for herself...

fields.JP: えーと、なにかあったのか？
どうして、そんなことを聞くんですか……？

fields.EN:
Well, you look troubled, and most
of the time that means you're
worried about something.
fields.JP:
だって白雪ちゃんがこんな感じのときって、
だいたいなにか悩みがあったりするでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you look troubled, and most
of the time that means you're
worried about something.

fields.EN:
I suppose...
I guess Shirayuki is readable
like a book...
fields.JP:
たしかに……。
ふふ、白雪はわかりやすいですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose...
I guess Snow White is readable
like a book...

fields.EN:
(This isn't good.
She sounds worse than usual...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんか病んでる。
　こういうのはちょっと新しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good.
She sounds worse than usual...)

fields.EN:
If you'd like, we're open to
discussion here.
fields.JP: なにかあったなら相談に乗るよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you'd like, we're open to
discussion here.

fields.EN:
Thank you very much.
I... got into another fight with
Oyayubi-neesama.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
……実は、また親指姉様と
喧嘩しちゃったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you very much.
I... got into another fight with
sister Thumbelina.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
(I guess you get your fair share
of fights, even among sisters.)
fields.JP:
（仲良し姉妹だけど、
　相変わらず喧嘩も多いんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess you get your fair share
of fights, even among sisters.)

fields.JP: なにが原因で喧嘩になったの？

fields.EN:
I'm not sure...
It just sort of... started.
fields.JP:
……きっかけは、よく覚えていなくて。
それくらい些細な言い争いだったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure...
It just sort of... started.

fields.EN:
All I can recall is that Oyayubi-neesama was angry at how
naive I am...
fields.JP:
でも親指姉様が怒っていたのは、
白雪の甘さについてでした。
そんな甘い考えじゃ駄目だ、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I can recall is that sister
Thumbelina was angry at how
naive I am...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I'm sure she was angry only
because she was worried for you,
Shirayuki-chan.
fields.JP:
親指ちゃんは、きっと白雪ちゃんを
心配してそう言ったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure she was angry only
because she was worried for you,
Snow White.

fields.EN:
Yes, I know she's always thinking
of us sisters as a whole...
fields.JP:
はい……。親指姉様は、
いつも白雪やネムちゃんのことを
想ってくれてますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I know she's always thinking
of us sisters as a whole...

fields.EN:
I don't want to fight, but I'm not
sure why it happens so often...
fields.JP:
本当は喧嘩なんてしたくないのに……。
どうしていつも、こうなっちゃうんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to fight, but I'm not
sure why it happens so often...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama does have a
tendency to go off a bit, but what
she says makes sense.
fields.JP:
そして……親指姉様はちょっと気性が
激しいところもありますけど、
言っていることは正論なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Thumbelina does have a
tendency to go off a bit, but what
she says makes sense.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I'm sure it's the same this time,
too. She's right in that Shirayuki is a naive, foolish girl...
fields.JP:
きっと今回も、親指姉様のほうが
正しいんですよ。どうせ白雪なんて、
甘ちゃんで夢見がちでダメダメで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure it's the same this time,
too. She's right in that Snow
White is a naive, foolish girl...

fields.EN:
You don't have to be so down on
yourself like that, Shirayuki-chan.
fields.JP:
白雪ちゃん、そこまで自分を
卑下することないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to be so down on
yourself like that, Snow White.

fields.EN:
She's right. Being naive is a sign
that you're kind, and I think
that's a defining part of you.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。甘ちゃんって、
要するに優しいってことなんだから。
君の優しさは長所だと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Being naive is a sign
that you're kind, and I think
that's a defining part of you.

fields.EN:
Do you think? For all you know,
my "kindness" could just be me
being indecisive...
fields.JP:
そうでしょうか……？
白雪のは優しさじゃなく、ただの
優柔不断さかもしれないですよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think? For all you know,
my "kindness" could just be me
being indecisive...

fields.EN:
I'm probably just acting like I'm
kind only to avoid confrontation.
fields.JP:
誰とも衝突したくないから、
誰にでもいい顔をしちゃうだけ
かもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm probably just acting like I'm
kind only to avoid confrontation.

fields.EN:
If so, then what Oyayubi-neesama
said is right. I am naive...
fields.JP:
だとすれば、それは親指姉様の言う通り、
白雪が甘ちゃんだからだと思うんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If so, then what sister Thumbelina
said is right. I am naive...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないと思うけど……

fields.EN:
Thank you for your kind words,
but I'm sure you're saying that
only because it's true...
fields.JP:
お気遣い、ありがとうございます……。
でも本当のことだからこそ、無理に
慰めようとしてくれてるんですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for your kind words,
but I'm sure you're saying that
only because it's true...

fields.JP: いや、そういうわけじゃ……

fields.EN:
(This isn't good. She feels so bad
that she's starting to doubt us.
Our words aren't reaching her...)
fields.JP:
（まずいな。落ち込みすぎて
　疑心暗鬼になってる。僕達がなにを言っても、
　白雪の心に届いていない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good. She feels so bad
that she's starting to doubt us.
Our words aren't reaching her...)

fields.EN:
(Looks like Princess is trying to
figure this out, too...)
fields.JP: （ああ、姫も途方に暮れているみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Princess is trying to
figure this out, too...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for making you both
worried. Please, you can leave
me alone.
fields.JP:
すみません、
困らせるようなこと言っちゃって。
白雪のことは気にしないでください
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for making you both
worried. Please, you can leave
me alone.

fields.EN:
I understand very well what Oyayubi-neesama is saying. We are
sisters after all...
fields.JP:
本当は、親指姉様の言うこと
もわかるんです。考え方は違っても、
やっぱり姉妹だから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand very well what sister
Thumbelina is saying. We are
sisters after all...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I'm sure I'm in the wrong, so I'll
just follow whatever my dear
sister says.
fields.JP:
きっと白雪のほうが間違ってるんだから、
もう割り切って姉様の言う通りに
していようと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure I'm in the wrong, so I'll
just follow whatever my dear
sister says.

fields.EN:
Stop it. Oyayubi would never
want you to just blindly follow
what she says.
fields.JP:
白雪、それは違う。親指だって、
君が自分の考え方を放棄するようなことは
望んでいないと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it. Thumbelina would never
want you to just blindly follow
what she says.

fields.JP:
いいんです、おつうちゃん。
もう、本当に……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I'm sorry that I brought this up
in the first place, and...
thank you for listening to me.
fields.JP:
変なこと言っちゃって、すみませんでした。
……話を聞いてくれて、ありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry that I brought this up
in the first place, and...
thank you for listening to me.

fields.EN:
That was the most frail smile I've
seen in my life. She has to be
lying to herself.
fields.JP:
……あんなに辛そうに微笑んでおいて、
もういいなんて……割り切れたなんて、
嘘に決まっている
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was the most frail smile I've
seen in my life. She has to be
lying to herself.

fields.EN:
Yup...
I sure hope she's going to be
okay...
fields.JP:
うん……。
ちょっと心配だね、白雪ちゃんのこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup...
I sure hope she's going to be
okay...

fields.EN:
(Shirayuki isn't looking so
good... Isn't there anything
I can do for her?)
fields.JP:
（……白雪、この間から元気がない。
　なんとかしてあげられないのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White isn't looking so
good... Isn't there anything
I can do for her?)

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、白雪ちゃんが心配？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 姫……。僕の気持ちはお見通しなんですね

fields.EN:
I'm worried for Shirayuki-chan, too.
But, I think I can handle this
this time.
fields.JP:
わたしもね、この間は白雪ちゃんの
ことが心配だったの。
でも、今は大丈夫かなって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm worried for Snow White, too.
But, I think I can handle this
this time.

fields.EN:
I have a plan.
Can you help me out?
fields.JP:
わたしにいい考えがあるの。
ちょっと付き合って
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a plan.
Can you help me out?

fields.JP:
人魚ちゃん……？
それに、おつうちゃんも……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Say, do you mind following me?
There's something I want to show
you.
fields.JP:
ねぇ、一緒に来てくれない？
見せたいものがあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, do you mind following me?
There's something I want to show
you.

fields.JP: いいから、ほら。早く早く
（姫はいったいどうするつもりなんだ……？）

fields.EN:
The cafeteria...?
Why did you bring me here?
fields.JP: 食堂……？　どうしてここに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The cafeteria...?
Why did you bring me here?

fields.EN:
Wh-What?!
What did you just say?!
fields.JP:
な、なんだとおぉ！？
貴様、今なんと言った！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?!
What did you just say?!

fields.EN:
I said that thing you have there
is garbage. It's quite dirty, so
you should discard it quickly.
fields.JP:
だから、ゴミだと言ったのよ。あなたが
どこかから拾ってきた、その汚いガラクタは。
今すぐ捨てたほうがいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said that thing you have there
is garbage. It's quite dirty, so
you should discard it quickly.

fields.EN:
This is not garbage!
It's art décor!
fields.JP:
これはガラクタではない！
アートなオブジェだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is not garbage!
It's art décor!

fields.JP: まぁまぁ、落ち着いてください

fields.EN:
Yikes, Hameln and Gretel fighting?
They're really going at it this
time...
fields.JP:
うわ、ハーメルンとグレーテルが喧嘩を……。
また派手にやってるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes, Hameln and Gretel fighting?
They're really going at it this
time...

fields.EN: Oh no! We need to stop them!
fields.JP: た、大変！　早く止めないと！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no! We need to stop them!

fields.EN:
It's okay.
Just watch what happens.
fields.JP: 大丈夫だよ。いつもの光景だから、見ていて
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay.
Just watch what happens.

fields.EN:
How dare you not see my kindness
of showing you all my special
art piece!
fields.JP:
せっかくのオブジェを皆に見せて
やろうという、ワレの思いやりが
なぜわからんのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you not see my kindness
of showing you all my special
art piece!

fields.EN:
The location couldn't have been
worse. Having that here will only
get in everyone's way.
fields.JP:
飾った場所が問題なのよ。
こんなものを食事をする場所に
置かれると迷惑だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The location couldn't have been
worse. Having that here will only
get in everyone's way.

fields.EN:
It is true that it is dirty and is
a bit of an obstruction...
fields.JP:
たしかに皆、「邪魔」とか「汚い」とか
思ってたみたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is true that it is dirty and is
a bit of an obstruction...

fields.EN:
No one could say it outright because you
seemed to like it, Hameln-san...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさんが気に入ってるから、
誰もはっきり言えなかったわけですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one really said that to you
because you seemed to have a
strange attraction to it...

fields.EN:
(Gretel must have said what was
on everyone's mind straight to
Hameln...)
fields.JP:
（つまりグレーテルだけは気を遣わないで、
　真実をズバッと言ったということか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel must have said what was
on everyone's mind straight to
Hameln...)

fields.EN:
Everyone can add spice to their
meals with my art piece! Why do
I have to get rid of it?!
fields.JP:
食事をしながら芸じゅちゅ鑑賞ができれば、
皆が喜ぶに決まっていよう！
なぜ捨てなければならぬのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone can add spice to their
meals with my art piece! Why do
I have to get rid of it?!

fields.EN:
Putting something you found from
someplace no one knows is very
unsanitary to the locale.
fields.JP:
衛生面から考えて、外から拾って
来たものなんて食堂に置くべきでは
ないと言っているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Putting something you found from
someplace no one knows is very
unsanitary to the locale.

fields.EN: Hygiene...? W-What are you talking about?
fields.JP: えいせいめん……？　な、なんの話だ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Loca... what?
Wait, what are you talking about?

fields.EN:
Hm, I guess I need to dumb
down my words...
fields.JP:
そうね……あなたならこう言えば
わかるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I guess I need to dumb
down my words...

fields.EN:
You remember saying you had a
stomachache from eating dirt?
That's because dirt has germs.
fields.JP:
前にあなたは土を食べてお腹を痛くしたと
言っていたでしょ。それは大雑把に表現すれば、
雑菌……ばい菌のせいなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You remember saying you had a
stomachache from eating dirt?
That's because dirt has germs.

fields.EN:
That thing you have there came
from outside where there's dirt.
Therefore it has similar germs.
fields.JP:
このオブジェとやらも同じで、
外にあったということは、どんな
ばい菌がついているかわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That thing you have there came
from outside where there's dirt.
Therefore it has similar germs.

fields.EN:
If you leave that here, there's no
telling when those germs will
get onto our meal.
fields.JP:
それを食事する場所に置いたら、
なにかの拍子にばい菌が口の中に入って
病気になるかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you leave that here, there's no
telling when those germs will
get onto our meal.

fields.EN:
So, does that make more sense as
to why I said for you to
discard it?
fields.JP:
私がこれを捨ててこいと言った
理由がわかったかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, does that make more sense as
to why I said for you to
discard it?

fields.EN:
Hm... I see...
I can't be the cause of making my
friends sick...
fields.JP:
むむ、そういうことか……。
ワレのせいで仲間を病気にさせるわけには
いかないんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I see...
I can't be the cause of making my
friends sick...

fields.EN: I'm glad I got through to you.
fields.JP: わかってもらえたなら、それでいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad I got through to you.

fields.EN:
How about we place it somewhere
other than the cafeteria?
fields.JP:
では、このオブジェはどこか別の場所に
移すということでいいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about we place it somewhere
other than the cafeteria?

fields.JP: うーむ、どこに移せばいいのだ？

fields.EN:
I think it's best you leave it
where you found it.
fields.JP:
できれば、拾って来た元の場所が
いいと思いますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's best you leave it
where you found it.

fields.EN:
(That's no different from throwing
it away... Not that Hameln sees it
that way though.)
fields.JP:
（それって捨てに行くのと同じことだよな。
　ハーメルンは気づいていなさそうだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's no different from throwing
it away... Not that Hameln sees it
that way though.)

fields.EN:
See? They took care of the
situation themselves. Do you
understand what I want to say?
fields.JP:
そういうわけで、一件落着。
ね？　大丈夫だったでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? They took care of the
situation themselves. Do you
understand what I want to say?

fields.EN:
I see... I think I know what
you're getting at.
fields.JP:
そっか……。今のやり取りを見ていて、
なんだかわかった気がします
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... I think I know what
you're getting at.

fields.EN:
Gretel-san chose her words to get
through to Hameln-san, which brought
closure to the situation.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんが、ハーメルンさんに
伝わりやすいように言い方を変えたから、
今の言い合いが解決したんですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel chose her words to get
through to Hameln, which brought
closure to the situation.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
All I need to do is to talk to
people in ways that best matches
their personality...
fields.JP:
誰にでも同じように対応するんじゃなく、
相手の性格や考え方に合わせて
話せばいいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I need to do is to talk to
people in ways that best matches
their personality...

fields.EN:
Personality changes from person to
person, so I need to make sure
I choose the right words...
fields.JP:
性格なんて人それぞれなんだから、
そのほうが理解し合えるに決まってますよね。
やっと気づきました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Personality changes from person to
person, so I need to make sure
I choose the right words...

fields.EN:
I see, so Princess brought Shirayuki here to show her what she
wanted to relay...
fields.JP:
姫、もしかして今の喧嘩を見せて、
そのことを白雪に伝えようと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see, so Princess brought Snow
White here to show her what she
wanted to relay...

fields.EN:
You're always straightforward, so
I figured seeing their fight would
make you see things differently.
fields.JP:
うん。白雪ちゃんは真面目すぎて、
誰にでも同じように接しちゃうから、
いろいろ悩んじゃうのかもって思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're always straightforward, so
I figured seeing their fight would
make you see things differently.

fields.EN:
I feel a lot better now!
Thank you very much,
Ningyo-chan, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
目からウロコです！
人魚ちゃん、おつうちゃん、
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel a lot better now!
Thank you very much,
Little Mermaid, Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It looks like Shirayuki-chan finally
snapped out of her rut.
fields.JP: 白雪ちゃん、吹っ切れたみたいでよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like Snow White finally
snapped out of her rut.

fields.EN:
(It also looks like Princess and
Shirayuki are back on good
terms with each other again.)
fields.JP:
（やっと白雪との気まずさも消えた。
　これも姫の機転のおかげだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It also looks like Princess and
Snow White are back on good
terms with each other again.)

fields.EN:
You really are a true princess
to me...
fields.JP: ……やっぱり、僕の姫は世界一です
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are a true princess
to me...

fields.EN:
I was just reconfirming my
admiration of you, that's all.
fields.JP:
いえ、姫のすごさを改めて
実感していただけですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just reconfirming my
admiration of you, that's all.

fields.EN:
I'm happy you came to my room,
Otsuu-chan, Ningyo-chan!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、人魚ちゃん！
白雪の部屋にようこそ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy you came to my room,
Otsuu, Little Mermaid!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Thank you for inviting us here.
fields.JP: やあ。今日はお招きいただき、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you for inviting us here.

fields.EN:
I was looking forward to coming
here today.
fields.JP:
部屋にお呼ばれするなんて、
ちょっとドキドキしちゃうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was looking forward to coming
here today.

fields.EN:
Well, I'm happy you're both here.
I invited you both because
I wanted to give my thanks.
fields.JP:
来てくれて、ありがとうございます。
今日は二人に普段のお礼を言いたくて
お招きしたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm happy you're both here.
I invited you both because
I wanted to give my thanks.

fields.EN:
What for? It's not like we did
anything special...
fields.JP:
普段のお礼？
別に大したことはしてないはずだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What for? It's not like we did
anything special...

fields.EN:
That's not true. You took us
sisters in, and made us realize
what was important to us.
fields.JP:
してくれてますよ。白雪たちを
受け入れてくれて、大事なことを
教えてくれたじゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. You took us
sisters in, and made us realize
what was important to us.

fields.EN: Since then, I've been able to properly talk things through with Oyayubi-neesama without it turning into a huge fight.
fields.JP:
あれ以来親指姉様とも
激しい喧嘩にならずに、きちんと
話し合えるようになってきました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We sisters haven't had any fights
since, and we've been able to talk
things out like never before.

fields.EN:
You saved us all, Otsuu-chan, Ningyo-chan, and I think that deserves
all the thanks in the world!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃんのおかげで、
白雪は救われた気持ちなんです。
だから、改めてありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You saved us all, Otsuu, Little
Mermaid, and I think that deserves
all the thanks in the world!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Oh, and Oyayubi-neesama doesn't
say it, but she appreciates you
two, too.
fields.JP:
口には出さないかもしれませんけど、
親指姉様もきっと二人に感謝してると
思いますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and sister Thumbelina doesn't
say it, but she appreciates you
two, too.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Now you're making me blush,
but... thank you.
fields.JP:
なんか照れちゃうな。
こっちこそ、いつもありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now you're making me blush,
but... thank you.

fields.EN: Well, you girls owe me one.
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, you girls owe me one.

fields.EN:
Heh heh... It's so interesting to
see how you two are so different,
yet are so close to each other.
fields.JP:
ふふ、二人は面白いですね。
とっても仲良しでいつも一緒なのに、
性格はあんまり一緒じゃなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh... It's so interesting to
see how you two are so different,
yet are so close to each other.

fields.EN:
I bet you're each a mirror that
reflects the other's image.
fields.JP: 二人はきっと、互いを映し合う鏡なんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you're each a mirror that
reflects the other's image.

fields.EN:
Why yes. That's why you both
get along so well ever so
naturally.
fields.JP:
はい。だから互いに尊重し合って、
自然と一緒にいられるのかなって。
そう思ったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes. That's why you both
get along so well ever so
naturally.

fields.EN:
As a mirror reflects one's image,
so too we need someone to act as
a mirror to tell you who you are.
fields.JP:
自分という姿を客観的に捉えるためにも、
自分自身の心を映す鏡は
白雪にも必要なのかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
As a mirror reflects one's image,
so too we need someone to act as
a mirror to tell you who you are.

fields.JP:
（へぇ、ずいぶんと哲学的なことを
　考えてるんだな……）

fields.EN:
I'm scared of mirrors, but
thinking about it instigates me
to want to do better.
fields.JP:
本物の鏡は相変わらず怖いですけどね。
……でも、いろいろがんばってみようかなって
思えるきっかけになったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm scared of mirrors, but
thinking about it instigates me
to want to do better.

fields.EN:
I'm happy to know you're thinking
like that!
fields.JP: 白雪ちゃん、すごい！　なんか前向きだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy to know you're thinking
like that!

fields.EN:
Heh heh...  And it's because of
you two. I mean, I would've never
thought like that before.
fields.JP:
えへへ……。だとしたら二人のおかげです。
前はこんなこと、考えもしなかったので
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh...  And it's because of
you two. I mean, I would've never
thought like that before.

fields.EN:
I learned there are all kinds of ways of seeing
things because you and Ningyo-chan taught me,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんと人魚ちゃんが
教えてくれたから、いろんな価値観が
あるってわかったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found out that there are many
different ways of seeing things
after talking with you two.

fields.EN:
Well, I'm happy to know we were
of some inspiration to you.
fields.JP:
そっか……。
僕達で役に立てたなら、よかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm happy to know we were
of some inspiration to you.

fields.EN:
Oh, where're my manners?
Let me brew a nice cup of tea
for you!
fields.JP:
あ、長々とおしゃべりしちゃって、すみません。
普段のお礼に、今日は紅茶をご馳走しようと
思ってたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, where're my manners?
Let me brew a nice cup of tea
for you!

fields.EN:
Let me get it ready.
Please do wait a moment.
fields.JP: 今淹れてくるので、くつろいでいてくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me get it ready.
Please do wait a moment.

fields.EN:
It looks like she's changing for
the better.
fields.JP:
……白雪ちゃん、いい方向に
変わっているみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like she's changing for
the better.

fields.EN:
Yes, you can even notice how
her expression has softened a bit.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
心なしか表情も明るくなったというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you can even notice how
her expression has softened a bit.

fields.EN:
Are you all right, Shirayuki?
Do you need help?
fields.JP:
白雪、大丈夫か？
今、すごい音がしたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you all right, Snow White?
Do you need help?

fields.JP: だ、大丈夫です！　気にしないでください！

fields.EN: Eek! I have to wipe this later!
fields.LOCALIZED: Eek! I have to wipe this later!

fields.JP: ああもう、またやっちゃった……！

fields.EN:
It looks like she really is back
to her normal self all right...
I forgot how clumsy she could be.
fields.JP:
心のつかえが取れて気が緩んだら、
昔みたいにおっちょこちょいが
ぶり返してきちゃったかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like she really is back
to her normal self all right...
I forgot how clumsy she could be.

fields.EN:
Heh...
Well, at least that's something
we can take care of for her.
fields.JP:
まぁ、みんなでフォローすればいいですよ。
ははは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
Well, at least that's something
we can take care of for her.

fields.EN:
What happened?
Is there something wrong, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
急に立ち止まってどうしたの？
おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
What happened?
Is there something wrong, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
It's Shirayuki and Kaguya.
It looks like something's up.
We should hide for a bit...
fields.JP:
いや、あそこに白雪とかぐやが……。
なにか深刻な話をしている雰囲気なもので。
ちょっと隠れて見てみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's Snow White and Kaguya.
It looks like something's up.
We should hide for a bit...

fields.EN:
(I wonder what they're talking
about... Maybe we can eavesdrop
on them if we get closer...)
fields.JP:
（なにを話してるんだ？
　もう少し近寄れば聞こえるかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what they're talking
about... Maybe we can eavesdrop
on them if we get closer...)

fields.EN:
There's something I wanted to ask
you, Kaguya...
fields.JP:
今日は折り入って、かぐやさんに
聞きたいことがあるんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's something I wanted to ask
you, Kaguya...

fields.JP: 聞きたいこと？　なんでしょう？

fields.EN:
How do you stay so slim, even
while you ride your Bamboo One?
fields.JP:
かぐやさんはいつもバンブー１号に
乗っているのに、どうしてそんなに
痩せているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How do you stay so slim, even
while you ride your Bamboo One?

fields.EN:
Um, well... You know, uh...
Shirayuki is a bit... chubby...
fields.JP:
白雪は、その、ぽ……ぽっちゃり系
じゃないですか。でもかぐやさんは
とってもスリムですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... You know, uh...
Snow White is a bit... chubby...

fields.EN:
I wanted to know how you can
keep your weight like that without
moving so much!
fields.JP:
あまり動いていないのに
どうやってその体型を維持しているのか、
教えてほしいんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to know how you can
keep your weight like that without
moving so much!

fields.EN:
It's not like I'm completely
immobile... Contrary to what you
think, I actually am quite active.
fields.JP:
う、動いてないなんてことはありませんよ？
いつもちゃんと働いてますからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I'm completely
immobile... Contrary to what you
think, I actually am quite active.

fields.EN:
Please don't lie!
You need to tell me the truth!
fields.JP: 本当のことを教えてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't lie!
You need to tell me the truth!

fields.JP:
（働いてるってことを何気に否定してないか？
　サラッとひどいな、白雪……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow, Snow White just dissed
Kaguya innocuously...)

fields.EN:
But, I really am not watching my
weight... I'm not sure what to
tell you...
fields.JP:
……でも、困りましたね。
特にダイエットのようなことはしてませんし、
本当のことと言われても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I really am not watching my
weight... I'm not sure what to
tell you...

fields.EN:
Y-You're not watching your weight?
You don't watch what you eat
or exercise?
fields.JP:
ダ、ダイエットはしていない……？
食事制限は？　運動は？
なにもしていないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're not watching your weight?
You don't watch what you eat
or exercise?

fields.EN:
It's such a pain in the...
Oh, um... I never saw the need to
do such a thing.
fields.JP:
だって面倒……いえ、その必要を
感じたことはないので。してませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's such a pain in the...
Oh, um... I never saw the need to
do such a thing.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 白雪姫さん => Snow White-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Genetics... Is it genetics?!
If so, there's nothing I can do!
fields.JP:
体質？　体質ということなんですか？
じゃあ、白雪は絶望的じゃないですか……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Genetics... Is it genetics?!
If so, there's nothing I can do!

fields.EN:
P-Please calm down, Shirayukihime-san.
I really don't think you're fat or anything...
fields.JP:
お、落ち着いてください～
白雪姫さんは、別に太ってないと
思いますけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please, calm down...
I really don't think you're fat
or anything...

fields.EN:
*sob* Please!
You don't have to console me!
fields.JP:
気休めはよしてくださいー！
うっ、ううぅ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sob* Please!
You don't have to console me!

fields.EN:
Uh... This isn't good...
Please don't cry!
fields.JP:
あああ、どうしましょう～！
泣かないでください～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... This isn't good...
Please don't cry!

fields.JP: えっ、ラプンツェルさん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.EN:
Kaguya make Shirayuki cry!
Rapunzel gonna tell!
fields.JP:
かぐやー、しらゆきなかせた！
ラプンツェル、みちゃったーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya make Snow White cry!
Rapunzel gonna tell!

fields.EN:
(Egad, this is only going to
get worse...)
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Egad, this is only going to
get worse...)

fields.EN:
N-No...
You have this all wrong...
fields.JP: ち、違うんです～、これにはわけが～
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No...
You have this all wrong...

fields.EN:
Kaguya such a meanie!
Shirayuki crying!
fields.JP:
かぐやー、わるいんだー！
しらゆきないてるーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya such a meanie!
Snow White crying!

fields.EN:
P-Please, you have to stop
crying... What to do...?
Um... Uh...
fields.JP:
な、泣かないでください～。
わらわはどうすれば……。
えーと、えーと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
P-Please, you have to stop
crying... What to do...?
Um... Uh...

fields.EN:
I-I know! I think Ningyohime-san
is in the know of how to get trim.
fields.JP:
そ、そうです。たぶん人魚姫さんが
スリムの秘訣を知ってると思いますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I know! I think Little Mermaid
is in the know of how to get trim.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ひ、姫、静かにしてないと見つかる……！
あっ、おつうとにんぎょだー！
ああ、ちょうどいいところに……

fields.EN:
Ningyo-chan, please tell me the
secrets in staying slim!
fields.JP:
人魚ちゃん、スリムの秘訣を
教えてください……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid, please tell me the
secrets in staying slim!

fields.JP: わたし、そんなの知らないよー！

fields.EN:
Let's make a run for it before
they drag us into the mess.
fields.JP: 姫、面倒に巻き込まれる前に逃げましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's make a run for it before
they drag us into the mess.

fields.JP: う、うん！　ごめんね、白雪ちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yup!
I'm so sorry, Snow White!

fields.EN:
Hm...?
They're not coming after us...
fields.JP: ……ん？　追って来ないみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...?
They're not coming after us...

fields.EN:
Ah, Hikari-san! You're pretty slim,
aren't you? What do you do to
stay so slim?
fields.JP:
あっ、ヒカリさーん！
ヒカリさんもスリムですよね。
どうやったらその体型を維持できるんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Hikari! You're pretty slim,
aren't you? What do you do to
stay so slim?
fields.notes: Line-level source-gated honorific restoration; automatic occurrence matching was ambiguous.

fields.EN:
Huh?! What's this about?!
Stay away from me!
fields.JP:
えええ、いきなりなに！？
怖いんだけどー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! What's this about?!
Stay away from me!

fields.EN:
Ooh... It looks like she found
another target.
fields.JP: あー、別のターゲットを見つけたみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh... It looks like she found
another target.

fields.EN:
Sorry, Hikari...
We'd better leave while we
still can.
fields.JP: ヒカリには悪いけど、今のうちに逃げよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Hikari...
We'd better leave while we
still can.

fields.JP: （ん？　あそこで言い争ってるのは……）

fields.EN:
No, please, let me!
Shirayuki will fix it good!
fields.JP:
遠慮しないでください。
白雪が縫ってあげますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, please, let me!
Snow White will fix it good!

fields.EN:
Seriously, it's nothing major.
Don't worry about it.
fields.JP:
いや、本当にいいから。
どうせちょっとなんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously, it's nothing major.
Don't worry about it.

fields.EN:
Which is why a few stitches will
do the trick. So please, let me
fix it for you!
fields.JP:
ちょっとだからこそ、
ちょっと縫えば直るんですから、
今のうちに直しちゃいましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why a few stitches will
do the trick. So please, let me
fix it for you!

fields.EN:
What are you arguing over?
Something about sewing?
fields.JP:
二人してなんの話だ？
縫うとかどうとか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you arguing over?
Something about sewing?

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan! I was going to sew
the fray in Aka-neesama's clothes.
fields.JP:
あ、おつうちゃん。赤姉様の服の裾が
ちょっとほつれちゃってるので、
縫ってあげようとしてたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu! I was going to sew
the fray in sister Red's clothes.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan | Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I'm fine, really. I mean,
I appreciate you wanting to help,
but it's really not worth it...
fields.JP:
別にいいって。申し出はありがたいけど、
なんか……めんどいし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, really. I mean,
I appreciate you wanting to help,
but it's really not worth it...

fields.EN:
There's no way I can let a fray
go by me! Now please, let me!
fields.JP:
いいえ、ほつれを見つけて
しまったからには放っておけません！
やらせてください！　さあ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way I can let a fray
go by me! Now please, let me!

fields.EN:
(I know she's just trying to be
helpful, but...)
fields.JP:
（おせっかい……じゃなくて、
　ただただ純粋な親切心なんだろうなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's just trying to be
helpful, but...)

fields.EN:
Why don't you go ahead and let
her fix it up for you?
fields.JP:
ここまでやってくれるって言ってるんだし、
お言葉に甘えれば？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you go ahead and let
her fix it up for you?

fields.JP: そうですよ。どうぞ甘えてください！

……わかったよ。
んじゃ、やってもらおうかな
では、さっそく縫いますね

fields.EN:
I-I'm fine. I'm sorry.
I just pricked my finger a bit.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫です。すみません。
ほんの少し針で刺しちゃっただけなんで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm fine. I'm sorry.
I just pricked my finger a bit.

fields.EN:
I'll be done in a jiffy.
Just a little while longer...
fields.JP:
すぐに縫い終わりますから、
待っててくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll be done in a jiffy.
Just a little while longer...

fields.EN:
(She's been pricking herself quite
a lot... It's like she's doing it
at every stitch she makes...)
fields.JP:
（さ、さっきからすごいぶすぶす
　刺してるけど。縫うより指に刺した
　ほうが多いんじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's been pricking herself quite
a lot... It's like she's doing it
at every stitch she makes...)

fields.JP: ちくちくちく、……と。よし、できました！

fields.EN:
Um, you just stitched my clothing
to your skirt...
fields.JP:
なんか、あたしの服と白雪のスカートが
縫い合わされちゃってるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, you just stitched my clothing
to your skirt...

fields.EN:
Whoops! I must've stitched them
together when I had it on my lap.
L-Let me get this fixed!
fields.JP:
あああっ、膝の上に置いてたから
一緒に縫っちゃったみたいです！
す、すみません、すぐ取ります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoops! I must've stitched them
together when I had it on my lap.
L-Let me get this fixed!

fields.EN:
Th-There... I'm so sorry...
Looks like I can't sew something
without getting something wrong.
fields.JP:
と、取りました。すみません。
縫ってあげるなんて張り切ったのに、
こんな結果で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-There... I'm so sorry...
Looks like I can't sew something
without getting something wrong.

fields.EN:
Shirayuki is such a dummy...
I want to help, but all I did was
cause trouble to Aka-neesama...
fields.JP:
白雪は、本当に不器用で駄目な子ですね……。
赤姉様の役に立ちたかったのに、
逆に迷惑かけちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White is such a dummy...
I want to help, but all I did was
cause trouble to sister Red...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
No need to get so down on
yourself, Shirayuki. Come on,
say something, Akazukin.
fields.JP:
白雪、そこまで落ち込むことないよ。
赤ずきんも、そう思うだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to get so down on
yourself, Snow White. Come on,
say something, Red Riding Hood.

fields.JP: くくくっ、……あははははっ！

fields.EN:
Huh? Wh-Why are you laughing?
Did I say something funny?
fields.JP:
え？　え？　どうして笑うんですか？
なにかおかしなことでも言いましたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Wh-Why are you laughing?
Did I say something funny?

fields.EN:
So sorry! I was laughing because
of how much of a klutz you are.
Whew, that was funny...
fields.JP:
ははっ、ごめんごめん！
白雪の不器用っぷりがあんまりおかしくてさ。
いやー、笑った笑った
fields.LOCALIZED:
So sorry! I was laughing because
of how much of a klutz you are.
Whew, that was funny...

fields.JP: お、おかしいって……。怒ってないんですか？

fields.EN:
Why would I be angry? I know you're
trying to be helpful here. I'm
happy you're doing this for me.
fields.JP:
怒るわけないじゃん。白雪が親切心で
やってくれようとしたことなんだからさ。
むしろ嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why would I be angry? I know you're
trying to be helpful here. I'm
happy you're doing this for me.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
You're not making it obvious
if you're refusing her help.
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、最初は断ってたくせに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not making it obvious
if you're refusing her help.

fields.EN:
I figured it wasn't much, but
I changed my mind after seeing
how earnest she was about it.
fields.JP:
これくらい別に縫わなくたっていいと
思ってたけど、白雪ががんばる姿見てたら、
なんか気が変わった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured it wasn't much, but
I changed my mind after seeing
how earnest she was about it.

fields.EN:
Will you please let me try again?
I'll do it right this time!
fields.JP:
赤姉様、もう一度やらせてくれませんか？
今度はうまくやりますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will you please let me try again?
I'll do it right this time!

fields.JP: いいよ。もー気の済むまでやっちゃって

fields.EN: Thank you! I'll do my best!
fields.JP: はい！　がんばります！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you! I'll do my best!

fields.EN:
(Looks like Shirayuki's
clumsiness helped to bring a smile
back on Akazukin's face.)
fields.JP:
（よかった。白雪のおっちょこちょいが
　赤ずきんの沈みがちな気持ちを
　少し元気づけてくれたみたいだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Snow White's
clumsiness helped to bring a smile
back on Red Riding Hood's face.)

fields.EN: Hey, Nemuri? Are you in there?
fields.JP: おーい、眠りー。いるかー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Sleepy? Are you in there?

fields.JP: あ、よかった。いたんだな
……おつう……おはよう、ございます……

fields.EN:
Good morning, Nemuri.
Not that it's the time of day
to be saying this though...
fields.JP:
おはよう、眠り。
まぁ、おはようっていう時間でもないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good morning, Sleepy.
Not that it's the time of day
to be saying this though...

fields.EN:
I just happened by, so I wanted
to see if you're doing fine.
fields.JP:
部屋の前を通りかかったから、
様子を見て行こうかと思ったんだ。
ちょっと心配だったしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened by, so I wanted
to see if you're doing fine.

fields.EN:
Well... It seemed like there's
something on your mind,
especially after joining us.
fields.JP:
うん。なんとなく放っておけない
というか……探索するようになってから
不安そうに見えたものだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... It seemed like there's
something on your mind,
especially after joining us.

fields.JP:
心配……してくれた……？
お気遣い、どうも……
え？　あ、こちらこそ、どうも

fields.EN:
So sorry...
to make you worried...
fields.JP:
……その、ご心配おかけして、
……しました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So sorry...
to make you worried...

fields.JP:
……えっと……、……えっと……
ありがとう……

fields.EN:
(It almost feels like she's
forcing herself to speak...)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう、無理になにかしゃべろうと
　しているような……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It almost feels like she's
forcing herself to speak...)

fields.EN:
Um... You're trying to tell me
that you're happy that we're
going on the expeditions together?
fields.JP:
……えーと、探索にいつも一緒に
行けてうれしい、ってことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... You're trying to tell me
that you're happy that we're
going on the expeditions together?

fields.EN:
Hey, I understood you.
I think...?
fields.JP:
おお、当たった。
っていうか、僕もよくわかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I understood you.
I think...?

fields.EN:
Pillows here... so good...
Feels good... so...
fields.JP:
ここの、枕……好き……。
だから……気持ちよくて……、あの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pillows here... so good...
Feels good... so...

fields.EN:
You like the pillows here?
Can I assume that you're okay
with living here then?
fields.JP:
ここの枕が気持ちよくて好きなんだ？
ってことは、この拠点での生活も
悪くないって思ってくれてるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You like the pillows here?
Can I assume that you're okay
with living here then?

fields.EN: I think I'm getting good at this!
fields.LOCALIZED: I think I'm getting good at this!

fields.EN:
(I guess I do understand her.
But, it still seems like she's
trying to force a conversation.)
fields.JP:
（地味にすごいな、僕の通訳力。
　……だけど、なんとなく眠りが
　無理してる気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess I do understand her.
But, it still seems like she's
trying to force a conversation.)

fields.EN:
Nemuri, you don't like talking
much, do you?
fields.JP:
眠り、もしかして話すのが
辛かったりする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, you don't like talking
much, do you?

fields.EN:
You don't need to force a
conversation, you know?
fields.JP:
もしもそうなら、無理に話さなくたって
大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need to force a
conversation, you know?

fields.JP: 親指が？　なにか言われてるのか？

fields.EN:
She said... I need to talk...
to be... the Order's...
Hitsuka...
fields.JP:
……ん……。タイヨウ教団の陽司として、
しっかり……話せるように、
ならないといけない……って
fields.LOCALIZED:
She said... I need to talk...
to be... the Order's...
Hitsuka...

fields.EN:
I think... I need to speak...
more often, too...
fields.JP: ボクも……そうしなきゃいけないと思うし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think... I need to speak...
more often, too...

fields.EN:
That's what you call forcing
yourself.
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what you call forcing
yourself.

fields.EN:
Mmm... I'm okay...
Not forcing... myself...
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... I'm okay...
Not forcing... myself...

fields.EN:
I'll do... my best... so that...
I can talk... better...
fields.JP: ちゃんと、話せるように……がんばる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll do... my best... so that...
I can talk... better...

fields.EN:
(She doesn't look too happy,
but there's no reason for me to
stop her from trying to speak...)
fields.JP:
（無理してるように見えるんだけどな。
　でも本人ががんばるっていうのに、
　水を差すのもどうかと思うし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't look too happy,
but there's no reason for me to
stop her from trying to speak...)

fields.EN:
Well, it's good you're trying, but
make sure you don't force yourself
too hard, okay?
fields.JP:
眠り、がんばるのもいいけど、
無理はしなくていいんだからな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's good you're trying, but
make sure you don't force yourself
too hard, okay?

fields.EN:
(I hope she isn't going to do
beyond what's needed...
I better keep a good eye on her.)
fields.JP:
（本当、がんばりすぎなきゃいいんだけど。
　……様子を見に来て、
　ますます心配になっちゃったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope she isn't going to do
beyond what's needed...
I better keep a good eye on her.)

fields.EN:
You're pale and you've been
wobbling the whole time.
Are you sick?
fields.JP:
すごく辛そうな顔してるし、
足元もふらふらじゃないか。
具合でも悪いのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're pale and you've been
wobbling the whole time.
Are you sick?

fields.EN:
A-Are you sleepy? I see...
I guess that is just like you...
fields.JP:
ね、眠いのか。そっか……。
君らしいといえば、らしいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy... Oh, uh...
Well, that is your name, so...

fields.EN:
No more...
Need to sleep...
Can't move...
fields.JP:
もう……駄目。
眠くて、仕方なくて……
これ以上、動けない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No more...
Need to sleep...
Can't move...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Don't be sleeping here?!
You need to sleep in your room!
fields.JP:
わわっ、こんなところで寝ようとしちゃ
駄目だよ！　せめて部屋に戻ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Don't be sleeping here?!
You need to sleep in your room!

fields.EN:
Fine... I'll carry you back to
your room then.
fields.JP:
ああもう、仕方ないな。
おんぶして部屋まで連れて行って
あげるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... I'll carry you back to
your room then.

fields.EN: Sure, but you owe me one.
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but you owe me one.

fields.JP: おつう、優しい……。ありがとう……

fields.EN: Like I said, you owe me one!
fields.JP: だ、だから貸しだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Like I said, you owe me one!

fields.EN: Now then, get on my back.
fields.LOCALIZED: Now then, get on my back.

fields.EN:
I can't... hold back...
from sleeping...
I'm so... bad...
fields.JP:
……どうしても……眠いって……
気持ちだけは、抑えられなくて……。
ボク、駄目な子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't... hold back...
from sleeping...
I'm so... bad...

fields.JP: 眠り？　なんでそんなこと……
……迷惑だなんて、思ってないからな

fields.EN:
Now that I got a chance to look,
you have a pretty neat room.
Look at all the plants...
fields.JP:
こうして改めて見ると、すごい部屋だな。
いろんなところに植物が生えてる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I got a chance to look,
you have a pretty neat room.
Look at all the plants...

fields.EN:
That's right. No time for me to be
lounging in your room. There...
Nice and comfy in your bed.
fields.JP:
おっと、部屋を観察してる場合じゃなかった。
眠りをベッドに寝かせてあげて、っと
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. No time for me to be
lounging in your room. There...
Nice and comfy in your bed.

fields.EN:
Whew... Guess that's that.
Now, I just need to leave
without waking her up...
fields.JP:
ふぅ、これでよし。
あとは起こさないように立ち去れば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... Guess that's that.
Now, I just need to leave
without waking her up...

fields.JP: （というか、やけに顔が近い気が……！）

fields.EN:
She's mighty clingy...
Is she dreaming or something?
fields.JP:
なんか甘えられてるような……。
ね、寝ぼけてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's mighty clingy...
Is she dreaming or something?

fields.EN:
I can't sleep with you, but I can
stay with you, so have a good
sleep, you hear?
fields.JP:
一緒には寝れないけど、
寝るまでは一緒にいてあげるから。
今はゆっくり寝なきゃ駄目だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't sleep with you, but I can
stay with you, so have a good
sleep, you hear?

fields.EN:
Is she asleep...? I guess she
must've been fighting hard to stay
awake the whole time.
fields.JP:
……寝たのか？
こんなにすぐ寝ちゃうなんて、
よっぽど眠いのを我慢してたんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she asleep...? I guess she
must've been fighting hard to stay
awake the whole time.

fields.EN:
Good night, and sleep tight.
May you be blessed with
a good dream tonight...
fields.JP:
眠り、安心して寝ていいからね。
……おやすみ、良い夢を
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good night, and sleep tight.
May you be blessed with
a good dream tonight...

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan, you're wobbling.
Are you all right?
fields.JP: ねむちゃん、ふらふらだよ。大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, you're wobbling.
Are you all right?

fields.JP: 辛そうな顔してるけど……

fields.EN: This has happened before. I think she's suffering because she's sleepy. Last time, I took her back to her room.
fields.JP:
前にもこんなことがあったんだけど、
たぶん眠くて辛いんだと思う。
そのときは僕が部屋に連れて帰ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is like deja vu...
She was sleepy the last time,
and probably this time, too.

fields.JP: また眠くなったんだろう？　眠り

fields.EN:
I knew it... She's going to end
up sleeping here, so we should
take her to her room.
fields.JP:
やっぱり。このままだと
ここで寝ちゃいかねないから、
また部屋まで連れて帰ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... She's going to end
up sleeping here, so we should
take her to her room.

fields.JP: そうだね。ねむちゃん、行こ？

fields.EN:
Come now, if you're going to
sleep, sleep in your bed.
fields.JP: ほら、寝るんならちゃんとベッドで寝て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, if you're going to
sleep, sleep in your bed.

fields.EN:
No, those are plants!
Your bed is over here!
fields.JP:
いや、そこはなんか変な植物の葉っぱの上！
ベッドはこっち！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, those are plants!
Your bed is over here!

fields.EN:
Heh, it's almost like she's
sleepwalking.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ねむちゃんってば
すごく寝ぼけてるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, it's almost like she's
sleepwalking.

fields.JP: え？　今なんて言ったんだ？

fields.EN:
I want to... sleep with you...
again... Otsuu...
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to... sleep with you...
again... Otsuu...

fields.EN:
(Shoot... This isn't going to
go well...)
fields.JP:
（まずい。なんか今の言い方だと、
　すごく誤解を招くような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot... This isn't going to
go well...)

fields.EN: It's not what you think, Princess.
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not what you think, Princess.

fields.EN:
Please sleep with me...
like the last time... Otsuu...
fields.JP:
あのときみたいに……ボクと寝て？
おつう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please sleep with me...
like the last time... Otsuu...

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、それって……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Y-You've got this all wrong!
I didn't lay a single finger on
her, ever! I promise!
fields.JP:
ちち違うんです姫！
僕と眠りはやましいことなど、なにも！
天地神明に誓って！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You've got this all wrong!
I didn't lay a single finger on
her, ever! I promise!

fields.EN:
Um... Otsuu...
Did I... do something wrong...?
fields.JP:
あ……えっと……、
おつう、困ってる……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Otsuu...
Did I... do something wrong...?

fields.EN:
Nemuri, can you vouch what
I said for me?! Tell her that
we've done nothing wrong!
fields.JP:
眠り、今のはそういう意味じゃ
ないんだって君からも言ってくれ！
姫の誤解を解いてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, can you vouch what
I said for me?! Tell her that
we've done nothing wrong!

fields.EN:
Of all the sentences she has to
prematurely say! Please, wake
up, Nemuri!
fields.JP:
あああ寝ちゃった！
しかもよくわからないボケを言い残して！
起きてくれ眠りー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of all the sentences she has to
prematurely say! Please, wake
up, Sleepy!

fields.EN:
Wh-What should I do...?
How can I prove I haven't
done anything wrong...?
fields.JP:
どど、どうしよう。
どうやって身の潔白を証明すれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What should I do...?
How can I prove I haven't
done anything wrong...?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, you're blowing this way
out of proportion. I'm fine.
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、慌てすぎ。大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you're blowing this way
out of proportion. I'm fine.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 姫……僕の潔白を信じてくれるのですか？

fields.EN:
I wasn't doubting you at all, Otsuu-chan.
If anything, I was happy seeing how kind you
were to Nemu-chan.
fields.JP:
最初から疑ってなんていないよ。
むしろ、おつうちゃんがみんなに
優しくて嬉しいくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just happy how kind you
were to Sleepy. I wasn't doubting
you in the slightest.

fields.EN:
I just think Nemu-chan is just
fawning.
fields.JP:
あのね、ねむちゃんはたぶん、
甘えたいだけなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just think Sleepy is just
fawning.

fields.EN:
You helped Nemu-chan when she was staggering
in the hallway, right, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは、廊下でふらふらだった
ねむちゃんを助けてあげたんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You helped her out before,
right?

fields.EN: She was so happy you were kind to her that she couldn't help leaning on you. Maybe she's actually the type who likes being spoiled.
fields.JP:
優しくしてもらったのが嬉しくて、
つい甘えたくなっちゃったんだよ。
もしかして、本当は甘えんぼなのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think she's just happy you
were so kind to her. It could be
she's still a child inside.

fields.EN:
(So she wanted to be spoiled...
Come to think of it, she was like that before too.)
fields.JP:
（甘えたかったのか……。
　たしかにこの間も、そんな感じだったかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A child inside...
That does sort of describe
Sleepy's actions back then.)

fields.EN:
(I'm pretty amazed she could read
Nemuri like this.)
fields.JP:
（眠りのそういう気持ちに気づけるなんて、
　やっぱり姫はすごいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm pretty amazed she could read
Sleepy like this.)

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Why don't we all
have a nap together? I'm getting
sleepy anyway.
fields.JP:
ねぇおつうちゃん、
今日はこのまま三人でお昼寝しよっか。
わたしもなんだか眠くなってきちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Why don't we all
have a nap together? I'm getting
sleepy anyway.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
As you wish.
I shall escort you to the world
of dreams.
fields.JP:
よろこんで。
夢の世界へエスコートいたしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you wish.
I shall escort you to the world
of dreams.

fields.JP: ふふ、おつうちゃんったら
