fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
We should keep quiet so that
we don't wake up Nemu-chan.
fields.JP:
ねむちゃんが起きちゃわないように、
静かにしようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should keep quiet so that
we don't wake up Sleepy.

fields.EN:
(The room smells quite good...
It must be because of the plants,
Nemuri, and Princess...)
fields.JP:
（……いい匂い。部屋中の植物と……
　眠りと、姫の匂いだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The room smells quite good...
It must be because of the plants,
Sleepy, and Princess...)

fields.EN:
(Wait... I'm sleeping with
Princess? And I'm supposed
to sleep?!)
fields.JP:
（……考えてみれば、今、
　姫と一緒に寝ているんだよな。
　うわ、意識したら一気に緊張してきた！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... I'm sleeping with
Princess? And I'm supposed
to sleep?!)

fields.EN:
(I can't wake up now, or else the
two will wake up. I can't even
move a muscle...)
fields.JP:
（でも起きたら二人を起こしちゃうし……。
　この状況で身動きできないって、
　けっこう辛い……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't wake up now, or else the
two will wake up. I can't even
move a muscle...)

fields.EN:
(Well, so long as Nemuri is
happy, I guess this is fine...)
fields.JP: （……まぁ、眠りが幸せそうだから、いっか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, so long as Sleepy is
happy, I guess this is fine...)

fields.EN:
C'mon, speak up.
You know... I have to get going.
fields.JP:
……なんだ、はっきりしないな。
用がないなら、もう行くからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, speak up.
You know... I have to get going.

fields.JP: ねむちゃん、こんにちは

fields.EN:
Did you need something from that person?
It looked like you were talking to them.
fields.JP:
なぁ、今の人になにか用だったのか？
話しかけてたみたいだけど
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: ゆっくりでいいよ、ねむちゃん

fields.EN:
Ripped part was... embarrassing...
So wanted to... warn...
fields.JP:
あんなとこ、破れてたら……
はずかしい、と……思って……それで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ripped part was... embarrassing...
So wanted to... warn...

fields.JP:
（あんなとこって、どんなとこが
　破れてたんだろう……）

fields.EN:
I see. So, you wanted to let the
person know then?
fields.JP:
そっか。それでねむちゃんは
教えてあげようとしてたんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So, you wanted to let the
person know then?

fields.EN:
If only... I could speak up...
Then maybe...
fields.JP:
もっと、ちゃんと……
うまくしゃべれたら……伝えられたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only... I could speak up...
Then maybe...

fields.JP: やっぱり、ボク……ダメな子……

fields.EN:
That's not true. You shouldn't get
so down on yourself like that.
fields.JP:
そんなことない。
眠りが落ち込む必要なんかないって
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. You shouldn't get
so down on yourself like that.

fields.EN:
She's right. Not everyone can
speak up, you know?
fields.JP:
そうだよ。言いたいことを
うまく伝えられないことなんて、
誰にでもあることだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Not everyone can
speak up, you know?

fields.EN:
It's not like you tore that
person's clothes or anything.
fields.JP:
そもそも、服の一部が破けていたのは
眠りのせいじゃないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like you tore that
person's clothes or anything.

fields.EN:
If anything, it's that person's
fault for not willing to listen to
what you wanted to say.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと教えてあげようとしたのに、
それを聞かなかったほうが悪いんだよ。
仕方ないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything, it's that person's
fault for not willing to listen to
what you wanted to say.

fields.EN:
Each person has their strengths
and weaknesses, so you don't need
to force what you're not good at.
fields.JP:
それに人には向き不向きがあるんだから。
苦手なことを、無理にできるように
ならなくても大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each person has their strengths
and weaknesses, so you don't need
to force what you're not good at.

fields.EN:
But... I still want... to talk...
I want to... help...
fields.JP:
それでも……教えて、あげたかった……。
誰かの、役に……立ちたかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... I still want... to talk...
I want to... help...

fields.EN:
If it's... my weakness... then...
No use... to do my best...
fields.JP:
でも……向き、不向きがあるなら……
がんばっても、意味、ない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's... my weakness... then...
No use... to do my best...

fields.EN:
Ah... No, that's not what
I meant.
fields.JP:
あ……。違うの、そういう意味で
言ったわけじゃなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... No, that's not what
I meant.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. We didn't mean to
denounce what you're doing.
We just wanted to cheer you up.
fields.JP:
ごめん、僕達に悪気はなかったんだ。
ただ、苦手なことがあっても落ち込む
必要はないって言いたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. We didn't mean to
denounce what you're doing.
We just wanted to cheer you up.

fields.JP: ……ボク、ちょっと……楽になったかも……

fields.EN:
I thought I needed... to do my
best, but... some things...
I don't need... to worry about...
fields.JP:
ずっと、がんばらなきゃいけないって、
思ってた……。でも、がんばっても、
できないことがあるって、わかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I needed... to do my
best, but... some things...
I don't need... to worry about...

fields.EN:
I can't... talk well...
and I don't... need to...
fields.JP:
……やっぱり、ボク、
うまくしゃべるの……無理……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't... talk well...
and I don't... need to...

fields.EN:
(We tried to cheer her up, but
it only made things worse. She's
giving up on trying her best...)
fields.JP:
（励まそうとしたのに逆効果だった。
　眠りは楽になったんじゃなくて、
　諦めちゃったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We tried to cheer her up, but
it only made things worse. She's
giving up on trying her best...)

fields.EN:
(I didn't think she'd take our
words so badly...)
fields.JP:
（こんな風に落ち込ませることになるなんて、
　思わなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't think she'd take our
words so badly...)

fields.JP:
……なんだか……眠くなって、きた……。
部屋、戻る……

fields.EN:
What should we do, Otsuu-chan? We made
Nemu-chan misunderstand us. I only wanted to
cheer her up...
fields.JP:
どうしよう、おつうちゃん。
ねむちゃんに誤解させちゃった。
励ましたかっただけなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should we do? It looks like
we just made things worse for
her...

fields.EN:
I don't think anything we say now
will get through to her.
fields.JP:
……でも、たぶん今はなにを言っても、
眠りの心には届かないだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think anything we say now
will get through to her.

fields.EN:
I hope we can make things
better for her...
fields.JP: この誤解、ちゃんと解けるかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope we can make things
better for her...

fields.EN:
As long as we speak with her
I'm sure things will be all right.
fields.JP:
……うん、大丈夫。
ちゃんと話せば、きっと解けるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as we speak with her
I'm sure things will be all right.

fields.EN:
(It's Nemuri... What's she doing
there? She looks... sad...)
fields.JP:
（あ……眠りだ。あんなところで
　一人でぼんやりして……。
　心なしか寂しそうだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Sleepy... What's she doing
there? She looks... sad...)

fields.EN:
Hi there, Nemuri.
Would you mind if I sat here?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hi there, Sleepy.
Would you mind if I sat here?

fields.EN:
Whew... It feels good to have
a break like this, right?
fields.JP: ふぅ。外の空気を吸うと、気持ちいいよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... It feels good to have
a break like this, right?

fields.JP: 眠りは気分転換しに、ここへ？

fields.EN:
(She's not responding to me well.
I guess what I said back then
is affecting her badly...)
fields.JP:
（反応が鈍いな。前にも増して言葉少な
　だし……。この間のことで、ますます
　話すのが苦手になっちゃったのかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not responding to me well.
I guess what I said back then
is affecting her badly...)

fields.EN:
(What should I say? I feel like
anything I say will only make
matters worse.)
fields.JP:
（なんて言葉をかければいいんだろう。
　なにを言っても落ち込ませてしまう
　気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What should I say? I feel like
anything I say will only make
matters worse.)

fields.JP: わーい！　ねむねむだー！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, as happy as usual,
aren't you?
fields.JP: ラプンツェル、元気そうだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, as happy as usual,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
Heh heh! I like Nemu-Nemu!
Her boobies so soft!
fields.JP:
えへへー、ねむねむのむね、
ふわふわできもちいーなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! I like Sleepy!
Her boobies so soft!

fields.JP:
……ねむねむ？
なんか、いつもとちがう？

fields.EN:
(Looks like Rapunzel noticed
something is wrong with her.)
fields.JP:
（さすがにラプンツェルでも
　眠りの異変に気がついたか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like Rapunzel noticed
something is wrong with her.)

fields.EN:
Nemu-Nemu? You don't like Rapunzel
anymore?
fields.JP:
ねむねむ、もしかして、もしかして……
ラプンツェルのこと、きらいになった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy? You don't like Rapunzel
anymore?

fields.JP: じゃあ、きらいじゃない？
ほんと？　よかったーー！！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
No wanna talk?
fields.JP:
どうしたの？
あんまりはなしたくないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
No wanna talk?

fields.JP:
でも、ラプンツェルのことは
きらいじゃないんだよね？

fields.EN:
Heh heh! Rapunzel like
Nemu-Nemu, too!
fields.JP:
えへへー。ラプンツェルも、
ねむねむのことだいすきだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! Rapunzel like
Sleepy, too!

fields.JP:
（心なしか、眠りの表情が
　柔らかくなった……？）
ねむねむ、きょう、あさごはんたべたー？

fields.EN:
Rapunzel eat plenty!
Nemu-Nemu eat plenty, too?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはねー、いっぱいたべたよ！
ねむねむは？　いっぱいたべた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel eat plenty!
Sleepy eat plenty, too?

fields.EN:
No eat much? Ooh!
We eat plenty sweets then!
fields.JP:
そっか、あんまりたべなかったんだね。
じゃあそのぶん、おやつはいっぱいたべようね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No eat much? Ooh!
We eat plenty sweets then!

fields.JP: （あ、眠りが部屋の方向を指さした……）
もしかして、たべるよりねたいの？

fields.EN:
I see~. Then when you take a nap,
can Rapunzel sleep with you too?
fields.JP:
そっかー。それじゃあ、おひるねするとき、
ラプンツェルもいっしょにねていい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Then Rapunzel can take nap
with Sleepy, too?

fields.JP: わーい！　ねむねむとおひるねだー！

fields.EN: (Amazing. They're actually having a conversation. It doesn't have much substance, but it really is a conversation...!)
fields.JP:
（すごい。会話が成り立ってる。
　あんまり中身のない会話だけど、
　ちゃんと成り立ってる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised they can
communicate so well with each
other...)

fields.EN:
They're pretty much talking with
yes and no questions. That can
makes things easier for Nemuri.
fields.JP:
……そうか。全部イエス、ノーで答えられる
質問と、指さしだけでやり取りしてたんだ。
そのほうが眠りの負担にならないのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're pretty much talking with
yes and no questions. That can
makes things easier for Sleepy.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's casual conversation
must have made things easy, too...
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルとの気負わなくていい会話で、
自然と指をさせたのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's casual conversation
must have made things easy, too...

fields.JP: おつう、なにぶつぶついってるのー？

fields.EN:
Oh, I was just impressed,
Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
ああ、いや、ラプンツェルは
すごいなって思っただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I was just impressed,
Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
Heh heh! Thanks!
Nemu-Nemu, you think Rapunzel
is super, too?
fields.JP:
？　えへへ、ほめられちゃったー！
ねむねむも、ラプンツェルすごいっておもう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh! Thanks!
Sleepy, you think Rapunzel
is super, too?

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Yaay! Rapunzel happy speaking
with Nemu-Nemu!
fields.JP:
やったー！　ねむねむとおはなしできて、
ラプンツェルたのしかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yaay! Rapunzel happy speaking
with Sleepy!

fields.EN:
Guess you don't need that many
words to express your feelings.
fields.JP:
うまく言葉にできなくても、
気持ちは伝わるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess you don't need that many
words to express your feelings.

fields.EN:
(Nemuri looks a lot better now.
Maybe she sees how you don't need
to say much to express yourself.)
fields.JP:
（眠りの表情、なにかから解放されたような
　感じだな。無理に話さなくていいんだって
　思えるようになったのかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleepy looks a lot better now.
Maybe she sees how you don't need
to say much to express yourself.)

fields.JP: （今回はラプンツェルに感謝しないとな）

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Hm? What about my pants?
Is there something...
fields.JP:
ん？　俺のズボンを指さして……
なにかついてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What about my pants?
Is there something...

fields.EN:
What the...?! I didn't know there
was a hole here!
fields.JP:
げげっ！　こんなところに穴が！
いつの間に破れてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...?! I didn't know there
was a hole here!

fields.EN:
I get it. You wanted to tell me
that, didn't you? Well, sorry
I gave you the cold shoulder then.
fields.JP:
……そうか、君はこれを教えて
くれようとしたのか。
この間は邪険にして悪かったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get it. You wanted to tell me
that, didn't you? Well, sorry
I gave you the cold shoulder then.

fields.EN:
Thanks for telling me!
I better hurry and get this
patched up. Thanks again!
fields.JP:
このままじゃまずいから、
ちょっと繕ってくるか。
教えてくれてありがとな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for telling me!
I better hurry and get this
patched up. Thanks again!

fields.JP: 眠り！　今の見てたよ

fields.EN:
Looks like you got through
to him!
fields.JP: ちゃんと伝わったみたいだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you got through
to him!

fields.JP:
……指、さした。
わかって、もらえた……

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, she did
point to her room before when
she was with Rapunzel...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、ラプンツェルとの会話で
　自然と指さしをしてたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, she did
point to her room before when
she was with Rapunzel...)

fields.EN:
I guess you can communicate well
without the talk.
fields.JP:
言葉じゃなくても、言いたいことを
相手に伝えることはできるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess you can communicate well
without the talk.

fields.EN:
(She doesn't speak much, but
I think I understand her better
now. She even looks happier now.)
fields.JP:
（相変わらず口数は少ないけど、
　前より意思表示がわかりやすくなったかも。
　表情も明るくなったし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't speak much, but
I think I understand her better
now. She even looks happier now.)

fields.JP: ねむちゃん、なんだか少し様子が変わったね

fields.EN:
I don't know how to word it, but
you look a lot more relaxed and
calm now.
fields.JP:
前よりも雰囲気が柔らかくなったっていうか
……肩の力が抜けたっていうのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know how to word it, but
you look a lot more relaxed and
calm now.

fields.JP: なにかいいことでもあったの？

fields.EN:
Otsuu and Rapu taught me...
Thanks...
fields.JP:
おつうと、らぷ……教えてくれた……。
ありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Rappy taught me...
Thanks...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan and Rapu-chan?
What did you girls teach her?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんとラプちゃんが？
へー、いいこと教えてあげたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Rappy?
What did you girls teach her?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Nothing at all. If anything, we
just sort of gave her the nudge.
fields.JP:
教えたというほどのことじゃないんだけど、
きっかけになることができたというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing at all. If anything, we
just sort of gave her the nudge.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel went as far as showing
us that there's a way Nemuri
can communicate all on her own.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルが大事なことに
気づかせてくれたんだ。
眠りなりの会話方法があるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel went as far as showing
us that there's a way Sleepy
can communicate all on her own.

fields.EN:
Just take it step-by-step, Nemuri.
You may not talk much, but we
know you're a kind-hearted soul.
fields.JP:
話すときも、ゆっくり話せばいいからね。
言葉が少なくたって、僕たちは眠りが
優しい子なのはわかってるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just take it step-by-step, Sleepy.
You may not talk much, but we
know you're a kind-hearted soul.

fields.EN: Huh? Not like I did anything.
fields.JP: え？　いや、別に普通だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Not like I did anything.

fields.EN:
You're sleepy? You want us to
take you back to your room?
fields.JP: 眠くなってきたの？　部屋まで送ろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're sleepy? You want us to
take you back to your room?

fields.EN:
You taught me... not to...
force myself...
fields.JP:
無理、しなくていいって……
おつうたち、教えてくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You taught me... not to...
force myself...

fields.EN:
I see. Well, I guess you're
good then.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Well, I guess you're
good then.

fields.EN:
She's looking pretty good.
I guess she'll be able to get
back to her room okay.
fields.JP:
……足取り、しっかりしてるね。
これなら部屋までちゃんと戻れそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's looking pretty good.
I guess she'll be able to get
back to her room okay.

fields.EN:
I'm just glad that she's not
pressuring herself like before.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
無理しないようになってくれて、
ホッとしたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just glad that she's not
pressuring herself like before.

fields.EN:
Yes, seeing her down on herself
after we spoke to her was
bothering me all along...
fields.JP:
前にねむちゃんを落ち込ませちゃってから、
ずっと気になってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, seeing her down on herself
after we spoke to her was
bothering me all along...

fields.EN:
I'm glad you and Rapu-chan managed to sort it
out before I knew it, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
でも、いつの間にかおつうちゃんと
ラプちゃんが解決してたんだね。よかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you and Rappy were able
to take care of it.

fields.EN:
I didn't do anything in
particular, really.
fields.JP: 解決したってほどのことはしていないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't do anything in
particular, really.

fields.EN: You know, I'm a bit jealous...
fields.JP:
……だけど、さっきのは
ちょっと妬けちゃったな
fields.LOCALIZED: You know, I'm a bit jealous...

fields.EN:
It felt like you and Nemu-chan were in your
own little world, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんとねむちゃんで、二人の世界ー、
みたいな雰囲気だったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, the way you and Sleepy
were connected, and how I was left
out of it.

fields.EN:
O-Oh, not at all!
I belong to you, body and soul!
fields.JP: そ、そんな！　僕の心は姫一筋です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Oh, not at all!
I belong to you, body and soul!

fields.EN:
Nemuri is a very precious friend,
but you are my fated soulmate!
fields.JP:
眠りは仲間として大事というわけで、
姫は僕の運命の人だから全然違って……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy is a very precious friend,
but you are my fated soulmate!

fields.EN:
Sorry, I'm joking. It was just too funny
watching you panic, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、冗談だよ。
おつうちゃんが慌てるのが
あんまりおかしかったから、つい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just pulling your leg.
Looking at you panic is just
too fun to watch.

fields.EN:
Oh, okay... So, it's a joke then?
You had me scared for a moment...
fields.JP:
な、なんだ、からかわれてたのか。
焦った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, okay... So, it's a joke then?
You had me scared for a moment...

fields.JP: あ、姫！　それに眠りもこんなところで……
fields.notes: B14 malformed English + source short-form Nemuri restoration

fields.EN:
Yup. If you can keep it down
a little that'd be great.
fields.JP:
うん。気持ちよさそうだから、
起こさないようにしてあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. If you can keep it down
a little that'd be great.

fields.EN:
Understood.
But, why are you two here?
fields.JP:
わかった。
……姫と眠りは、どうしてここへ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood.
But, why are you two here?

fields.EN:
Oh, just to pass the time. We
decided to step outside to get
some air.
fields.JP:
気晴らしだよ。たまたまねむちゃんと
会ったから、ちょっと外の空気を吸いに
行こうかって話になったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, just to pass the time. We
decided to step outside to get
some air.

fields.EN:
Nemu-chan nodded to me when
I asked her out. She looked
happy, I think?
fields.JP:
わたしが誘ったら、ねむちゃん、
「ん……」って頷いたの。
なんだか嬉しそうな顔だったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy nodded to me when
I asked her out. She looked
happy, I think?

fields.EN:
I would think so, too. Even if it
was a nod, I'm sure she was able
to relay her feelings to you well.
fields.JP:
きっと嬉しかったんだよ。
誘ってもらったことも、言葉が少なくても
ちゃんと気持ちが伝わることも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would think so, too. Even if it
was a nod, I'm sure she was able
to relay her feelings to you well.

fields.JP: （わ、まずい。起こしちゃったか？）

fields.EN:
She's not waking up at all.
She must be deep in sleep.
fields.JP:
……ぜんぜん起きない。
だいぶ深く眠っているんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's not waking up at all.
She must be deep in sleep.

fields.EN:
It didn't take very long for her
to fall asleep. She sort of just
drooped on me.
fields.JP:
ホームに来てしばらくしたら、
眠いって言って、
わたしにもたれかかって寝ちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't take very long for her
to fall asleep. She sort of just
drooped on me.

fields.EN:
I know it's not cold, but she can
catch a cold like this. Shall I
carry her back to her room?
fields.JP:
寒くはないけど、こんなところで
寝たら風邪引かないかな。
僕が部屋までおぶっていこうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it's not cold, but she can
catch a cold like this. Shall I
carry her back to her room?

fields.EN:
Thanks, but I think we can stay
out for a little longer. After
all, she does like this place.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。でも、もう少しここにいよう。
ねむちゃんはここが気に入ってるみたいだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, but I think we can stay
out for a little longer. After
all, she does like this place.

fields.EN:
I see... This place is quiet, and
it does feel quite good out here.
fields.JP:
そっか……。たしかにここは静かだし、
開放感があって気持ちいいからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... This place is quiet, and
it does feel quite good out here.

fields.EN:
Oh, I forgot to ask.
What were you talking about with
Nemuri?
fields.JP:
それはそうと、姫、
ここで眠りとなにを話していたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I forgot to ask.
What were you talking about with
Sleepy?

fields.EN: Do you really want to know?
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you really want to know?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? I'm interested
in anything related to you,
my dear princess.
fields.JP:
言うまでもないだろう？
姫のことならなんだって気になるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? I'm interested
in anything related to you,
my dear princess.

fields.EN:
Heh... Well, I guess I can let
you in on what we talked about.
fields.JP: ふふ、だったら教えてあげようかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Well, I guess I can let
you in on what we talked about.

fields.EN:
But, it wasn't anything special.
We just small talked about how it
felt good out here and things.
fields.JP:
あのね、特に珍しいことなんて
話してないの。風が気持ちいいねとか、
監獄塔が伸びたねとか、そんな話だけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it wasn't anything special.
We just small talked about how it
felt good out here and things.

fields.EN:
Even so, it was so relaxing
chatting with her out here like
this.
fields.JP:
でも、そういう何気ない会話だけなのに、
心地いい時間だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, it was so relaxing
chatting with her out here like
this.

fields.EN:
She doesn't talk much, but maybe
that's why it's so soothing to be
with her, passing the time by.
fields.JP:
ねむちゃんといると、心が落ち着くの。
たくさん話さない分、ゆったりした時間が
流れるのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She doesn't talk much, but maybe
that's why it's so soothing to be
with her, passing the time by.

fields.EN:
It must be tiring having her on
your shoulder like that. Let me
sit next to you...
fields.JP:
姫、ずっと肩を貸していたら疲れるだろ？
僕が姫の隣に座るから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must be tiring having her on
your shoulder like that. Let me
sit next to you...

fields.EN:
Okay, you can lean on me now.
It should lighten the load a bit.
fields.JP:
ほら、姫は僕に寄りかかって。
そうすれば少しは楽になるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, you can lean on me now.
It should lighten the load a bit.

fields.EN:
Thank you. Hehe, with you and Nemu-chan
sandwiching me, Otsuu-chan, I feel popular.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。
ふふ、おつうちゃんとねむちゃんに挟まれて、
モテモテになった気分だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I feel like a winner
with you and Sleepy sandwiching
me like this.

fields.EN:
Oh? You want someone else to
love you, even when you know
I am here for you?
fields.JP:
おや。僕というものがありながら、
姫は他の人にもモテたいのですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? You want someone else to
love you, even when you know
I am here for you?

fields.JP: あれ、おつうちゃんってば妬いてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Do I sense someone getting
jealous?

fields.EN:
Of course. I was jealous the
minute I knew you were out on
a date with Nemuri.
fields.JP:
ええ、もちろん。
眠りとデートしていたことにも、
実は妬いているんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I was jealous the
minute I knew you were out on
a date with Sleepy.

fields.JP: 眠り？　起きてたのか？

fields.EN:
She must be having a good
dream...
fields.LOCALIZED:
She must be having a good
dream...

fields.EN:
It's almost like she's talking
with us, even while sleeping.
fields.JP:
寝てるのに、なんだかねむちゃんも
一緒に話してるみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's almost like she's talking
with us, even while sleeping.

fields.EN:
Why hello there, Nemu.
Good to see you.
fields.JP: まあ、ネム。ごきげんよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why hello there, Sleepy.
Good to see you.

fields.EN:
You seem happy.
Did something good happen?
fields.JP:
心なしか、表情が明るいですわね。
なにかいいことでもありましたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem happy.
Did something good happen?

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's because the three sisters made up.
I'm glad she looks happy.)
fields.JP:
（三姉妹で仲直りできたからかな。
　嬉しそうでよかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's no wonder since Sleepy and
her sisters are getting along
well again.)

fields.JP: 親指姫や白雪も元気ですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are Thumbelina and
Snow White?

fields.EN:
That's good to hear. Oh my,
how have I not noticed that
wonderful hairpin of yours.
fields.JP:
それはなによりですわ。
あら、改めて見ますと、
その髪飾り、かわいいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear. Oh my,
how have I not noticed that
wonderful hairpin of yours.

fields.EN:
The flower matches your hair well.
Come to think of it, you decorated
your room with flowers, right?
fields.JP:
花の色が、髪にとても似合っていますわ。
そういえばあなたの部屋には、
たくさん花があるんでしたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The flower matches your hair well.
Come to think of it, you decorated
your room with flowers, right?

fields.EN:
Taking care of them must be
quite taxing.
fields.JP: やっぱり、植物の世話は大変なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Taking care of them must be
quite taxing.

fields.EN:
How wonderful would it be to live
a life surrounded by flowers. What
is needed to take care of them?
fields.JP:
ああでも、お花に囲まれた生活も素敵ですわ。
どのように育てればいいのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
How wonderful would it be to live
a life surrounded by flowers. What
is needed to take care of them?

fields.EN:
(I see... She's having a hard time
replying since she can't answer
with a simple yes or no.)
fields.JP:
（そうか。イエス、ノーで答えられる
　質問じゃなかったから、
　眠りは戸惑っちゃったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... She's having a hard time
replying since she can't answer
with a simple yes or no.)

fields.EN:
Um, Cinderella? Do you mind asking
questions that are a bit more...
simpler to reply to?
fields.JP:
えーと、シンデレラ。
もう少し簡潔に答えやすい言い方に
してくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Cinderella? Do you mind asking
questions that are a bit more...
simpler to reply to?

fields.EN:
I think Nemuri is far more adept
at raising plants than trying to
actually explain how to do it.
fields.JP:
ほら、眠りは人に説明することよりも、
植物を育てることのほうが得意だと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think Sleepy is far more adept
at raising plants than trying to
actually explain how to do it.

fields.EN:
You've been bombarding her with
questions, so I think it's best to
give her some space to reply.
fields.JP:
あんまり一度にいろいろ聞かれると、
ちょっと戸惑っちゃうかもしれないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've been bombarding her with
questions, so I think it's best to
give her some space to reply.

fields.EN:
Mmm... But there are so many
things I would like to ask...
fields.JP:
むう。では、なんて聞けばいいんですの？
植物について、いろいろ聞きたいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... But there are so many
things I would like to ask...

fields.EN:
What? You want to raise plants,
Cinderella?
fields.JP: シンデレラ、あんた植物育てたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You want to raise plants,
Cinderella?

fields.JP:
親指？　どこから湧いて……じゃない、
どうしてここに？

fields.EN:
I just happened to come by,
that's all.
fields.JP:
たまたま通りかかったら、
話し声が聞こえてきたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just happened to come by,
that's all.

fields.EN:
She's saying that it requires a
bit of effort to raise plants.
fields.JP:
ネムの代わりにわたしが答えてあげる。
植物の世話だけど、やっぱりそれなりに大変、
ですって
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's saying that it requires a
bit of effort to raise plants.

fields.EN:
But, it's like a pastime to her,
so taking care of them doesn't
bother her much.
fields.JP:
でも趣味みたいなものだし、
もう慣れちゃったから、
世話するのも苦にはならないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, it's like a pastime to her,
so taking care of them doesn't
bother her much.

fields.EN:
The plants really help your room feel
more comfortable. If you'd like to try and
raise them, she can share some.
fields.JP:
なにより部屋の寝心地がよくなるから、
植物は欠かせないの。もしも植物を育てて
みたくなったら、株を分けてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
The plants really help your room feel
more comfortable. If you'd like to try and
raise them, she can share some.

fields.EN:
I can't believe you were able to
get that all right!
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe you were able to
get that all right!

fields.EN:
I'm quite amazed! You really do
know Nemu well!
fields.JP:
すごいですわ！
親指姫はネムの言いたいことが、
ちゃんとわかっていますのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite amazed! You really do
know Sleepy well!

fields.EN:
Same here. I wouldn't have
imagined so much content from
so little words.
fields.JP:
本当、驚いたよ。
眠りのあの短い言葉だけで、
よく今の長文になったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. I wouldn't have
imagined so much content from
so little words.

fields.EN: Well, I am her sister after all.
fields.JP: まぁね。姉なんだから当然よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I am her sister after all.

fields.EN:
Nemu may not say much, but she
has a lot going on in her head.
She's no dummy, that's for sure!
fields.JP:
それにね、ネムは口数が多くないだけで、
頭の中ではしっかり考えてるんだから。
ネムはすごい子なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy may not say much, but she
has a lot going on in her head.
She's no dummy, that's for sure!

fields.EN:
With how Nemuri is... well, so
sleepy all the time, I couldn't
have imagined her to be like that.
fields.JP:
少し意外だったな。眠りはふわっとしていて、
こんなにはっきりしたことを考えてるような
イメージじゃなかったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
With how Sleepy is... well, so
sleepy all the time, I couldn't
have imagined her to be like that.

fields.JP: わたしもですわ。意外な一面ですわね

fields.EN:
Yeah, everyone seems to
misunderstand her like that,
which is a bit vexing to me.
fields.JP:
ボーっとしてるように誤解されやすいのよ、
この子。それがわたしは悔しくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, everyone seems to
misunderstand her like that,
which is a bit vexing to me.

fields.EN: So that's why you wanted Nemuri to be able to speak for herself—so your little sister, whom you're so proud of, wouldn't be misunderstood.
fields.JP:
だから親指は、眠りが自分で話せるように
なってほしかったんだな。
自慢の妹が誤解されないように
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that's why you wanted her to
speak up, so that she wouldn't
be misunderstood?

fields.EN:
(So she isn't denying it after all.
But with Oyayubi's way of doing things,
it's hard for that to come across...)
fields.JP:
（あ、やっぱり否定はしないんだ。
　でも親指のやり方じゃ、
　なかなか伝わらないよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. But, I don't think
Thumbelina's plans for Sleepy
are that easy to notice.)
fields.notes: B12 source-form character identity restoration; B12 remove localized name insertion/fanfiction

fields.EN:
For being so caring of your
sisters, you always seem to end up
with the short end of the stick.
fields.JP: せっかく妹想いなのに、不器用だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For being so caring of your
sisters, you always seem to end up
with the short end of the stick.

fields.EN:
Oh, shut up!
Like, I've been trying to change
how I approach things.
fields.JP:
放っておいて！
……ただ、最近考えを変えるように
なっただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, shut up!
Like, I've been trying to change
how I approach things.

fields.EN:
Since they're helping me, I figure
it's only natural that I help
Nemu with her talking.
fields.JP:
わたしも妹たちに助けてもらうことが
あるんだから、ネムがうまく話せないなら、
わたしが伝えてあげればいいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since they're helping me, I figure
it's only natural that I help
Sleepy with her talking.

fields.EN:
So each of you sisters will cover
each one's back? Sounds like
a plan.
fields.JP:
苦手なことをフォローし合うってことか。
いいね。そういうのって
fields.LOCALIZED:
So each of you sisters will cover
each one's back? Sounds like
a plan.

fields.JP: あの……うれしかった。……ありがとう……

fields.EN:
Y-You don't have to thank me!
I only did what needed to be done!
fields.JP: な、なに言ってるのよ。当たり前でしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You don't have to thank me!
I only did what needed to be done!

fields.EN:
(There she goes again... I guess
they really are sisters with how
easily they get misunderstood.)
fields.JP:
（また素直じゃないんだから。
　誤解されやすいのは姉妹で似てるなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes again... I guess
they really are sisters with how
easily they get misunderstood.)

fields.EN:
I'm so envious of how well they
support each other as sisters...
fields.JP:
いいですわねぇ……。
姉妹で支え合えて、うらやましいですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so envious of how well they
support each other as sisters...

fields.EN:
You don't need sisters when you
have us, right?
fields.JP:
姉妹がいなくたって、シンデレラには
僕やみんながいるから寂しくないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't need sisters when you
have us, right?

fields.EN:
Heh heh, I suppose you're
right, Otsuu.
fields.JP: ふふっ。そうでしたわね、おつう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, I suppose you're
right, Otsuu.

fields.EN:
Um, this is Cinderella's room,
wasn't it?
fields.JP: えーと、ここだよな。シンデレラの部屋って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, this is Cinderella's room,
wasn't it?

fields.EN:
(It's great to see her back, but
I am a bit worried...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが戻って来てくれてよかった。
　でも、ちょっと心配なんだよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's great to see her back, but
I am a bit worried...)

fields.EN:
(It must feel weird, especially
when time has passed around
you like this.)
fields.JP:
（なんせシンデレラにしてみれば、
　知らないうちに時間が経って、
　未来に来たような感覚だろうし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must feel weird, especially
when time has passed around
you like this.)

fields.EN:
(She could be thoroughly
confused, so I better support her
as a friend.)
fields.JP:
（いろいろと混乱したり、
　心細かったりするかもしれない。
　仲間としてしっかり支えてやらないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She could be thoroughly
confused, so I better support her
as a friend.)

fields.JP: なんでですのおおおぉ！？

fields.EN:
Wh-What the...?!
I'm coming in, Cinderella!
fields.JP:
ど、どうしたんだ！？
シンデレラ、入るぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What the...?!
I'm coming in, Cinderella!

fields.EN:
What was that about, Cinderella?
Huh...? Princess? You're here?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、今すごい声が聞こえたけど
……って、姫？　姫も来ていたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was that about, Cinderella?
Huh...? Princess? You're here?

fields.EN:
Yup. I was a little worried about
Cinderella-san, so I came by.
fields.JP:
うん、ちょっとシンデレラさんのことが
気になっちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, I was a bit worried,
so I swung on by.

fields.EN:
(I see, so she came for the
same reason I did. She truly is
a kind soul...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、そうか。姫も僕と同じ理由で
　来ていたんだ。さすがお優しい……
　じゃなくて！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see, so she came for the
same reason I did. She truly is
a kind soul...)

fields.EN:
Cinderella, didn't you scream
just now?
fields.JP:
ところでシンデレラ、
さっきなにか叫んでなかったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, didn't you scream
just now?

fields.JP: べ、別になにも言ってませんわ
なんでですのー、って聞こえたけど

fields.EN: Then why'd you ask me earlier?
fields.JP: ちゃんと聞こえてたんじゃありませんの……
fields.LOCALIZED: Then why'd you ask me earlier?

fields.EN:
Fine... It's just that things are
so different. Ningyohime is
like an older sister now.
fields.JP:
はぁ……。少しくやしかっただけですわ。
人魚姫があまりにも優しくて……
まるでお姉さんみたいで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... It's just that things are
so different. Little Mermaid is
like an older sister now.

fields.EN:
Everyone around me has aged quite
a bit, but now I'm the younger one
here. It just feels... weird.
fields.JP:
いつの間にかみんな大きくなってるんですもの。
昔はわたしのほうが年上だったのにって
思ったら、ふくざつで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone around me has aged quite
a bit, but now I'm the younger one
here. It just feels... weird.

fields.JP: まぁ、それはそうだろうなぁ

fields.EN:
What makes matters worse is
how well-timed Ningyohime
came to visit.
fields.JP:
だいたい、人魚姫がぜつみょうなタイミングで
来るのがいけないんですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What makes matters worse is
how well-timed Little Mermaid
came to visit.

fields.EN:
You came just when I was trying
to get over the changes, acting
all kind and everything to me.
fields.JP:
ちょうどわたしがとまどって不安に
なっているときに会いに来て、
優しくしてくれるんですもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You came just when I was trying
to get over the changes, acting
all kind and everything to me.

fields.EN:
I felt like you were treating me
like I was dumb. You just made
matters worse!
fields.JP:
なんだか子ども扱いされたようで……
ますますふくざつな気分ですわっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt like you were treating me
like I was dumb. You just made
matters worse!

fields.JP: それで嘆いていたわけか……

fields.EN:
I really don't feel like an older sister
now after that. All that yelling made
me feel so immature...
fields.JP:
こんなことでわめいていては、ますます
子どもみたいなのはわかっていますわ。
ぜんぜんお姉さんらしくないですわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really don't feel like an older sister
now after that. All that yelling made
me feel so immature...

fields.EN:
Uh, you weren't much of an
older sister from before.
fields.JP:
だけどさ、そもそもシンデレラって、
元からそんなにお姉さんっぽくなかったよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you weren't much of an
older sister from before.

fields.EN:
Akazukin was like an older
sister, but yeah... you were immature.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんはお姉さんって感じだったけど、
シンデレラはあんまり年上って感じじゃ
なかったっていうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood was like an older
sister, but yeah... you were immature.

fields.JP: ちょ、ちょっとおつうちゃん……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
But don't worry! You're the same
Cinderella I know, and that's all
that matters!
fields.JP:
でもまぁ、シンデレラはシンデレラだよ。
気にすることないんじゃないかな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't worry! You're the same
Cinderella I know, and that's all
that matters!

fields.EN:
Oh, I see what you're getting at.
I know I'm not very reliable...
fields.JP:
ふん。安っぽいなぐさめなんていりませんわ。
どうせわたしは出来そこないですもの。
頼りがいがなかったということですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see what you're getting at.
I know I'm not very reliable...

fields.EN: Huh? No, that's not what I...
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? No, that's not what I...

fields.EN:
I was never good at training, and
I had a lot of trouble using
different kinds of weapons...
fields.JP:
たしかにわたしは昔から訓練も
上手にできなかったし、
武器の扱いも下手でしたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was never good at training, and
I had a lot of trouble using
different kinds of weapons...

fields.EN:
But you were very athletic, and the best
melee fighter among us. I think you're amazing,
Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
でも、運動神経は良かったよね。
素手での接近戦だって誰より強かったし、
シンデレラさんはすごいと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you were very athletic, and
the best melee fighter among us.
That alone makes you amazing.

fields.EN:
I was just in my groove back then.
In fact, I would often miss my
targets from losing focus.
fields.JP:
たまたま調子がいいときがあった
というだけですわ。むしろすぐあせって
ミスしてしまうことのほうが多くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was just in my groove back then.
In fact, I would often miss my
targets from losing focus.

fields.EN:
Everyone misses time-to-time.
I think it's more important we
focus on the good.
fields.JP:
失敗くらい誰にでもあるでしょ？
そんなのより、出来たことを
数えるほうが楽しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone misses time-to-time.
I think it's more important we
focus on the good.

fields.EN:
You do have a tendency of
underestimating yourself, and
overstating your mistakes.
fields.JP:
シンデレラは自分を過小評価する
ところがあるよな。欠点を大げさに
受け止めちゃうというか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do have a tendency of
underestimating yourself, and
overstating your mistakes.

fields.EN:
I couldn't tell back then, but now
that I'm older I know... You
shouldn't underestimate yourself.
fields.JP:
うん。昔はわからなかったけど、
大人になった今ならわかる。
シンデレラはもっと自分を評価すべきだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't tell back then, but now
that I'm older I know... You
shouldn't underestimate yourself.

fields.EN:
She's right. Looking only at the
bad side of things will make
matters worse.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。欠点ばっかり数え上げてたら、
わたしだって落ち込んじゃうもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Looking only at the
bad side of things will make
matters worse.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right, but I'm
supposed to be the older sister
here...
fields.JP:
それは、たしかに……。
だけど、わたしはお姉さんのはずなのに……。
こんなわたしじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right, but I'm
supposed to be the older sister
here...

fields.EN: You're still saying that? Being the older sister, being older or younger—none of that matters, does it?
fields.JP:
まだそんなこと言ってるのか？
お姉さんとか年上とか年下とか、
そんなの関係ないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're still dwelling on that?
I don't think age is important.

fields.EN:
What's important is that we're
a family that came under Dawn.
fields.JP: 僕達は黎明の大事な家族じゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's important is that we're
a family that came under Dawn.

fields.EN:
Yup! We're all family here!
I'm just happy we can all be
together again.
fields.JP:
うん！　大事な家族だよ。
また一緒にいられるようになって、
すごく嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We're all family here!
I'm just happy we can all be
together again.

fields.EN: Ohohoho! If you insist, I suppose I have no choice. I'll set the whole older-sister issue aside for now!
fields.JP:
おーっほっほっほ！　そこまで言うのなら
しかたありませんわね。お姉さん問題は
ひとまず気にしないであげますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... Ohohoho! Fine!
I suppose I can turn the blind
eye to our age difference for now!

fields.EN:
How unlike me to forget...
Family... Yes, we are a family!
fields.JP:
ふふ、家族か……。そうでしたわね。
わたしたちは家族でしたわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How unlike me to forget...
Family... Yes, we are a family!

fields.EN:
(Looks like she's a bit better
now. She's so simple...
No... So pure...)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが機嫌を直してくれた
　みたいでよかった。それにしても、
　単純……いや、純粋だなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like she's a bit better
now. She's so simple...
No... So pure...)

fields.EN:
(I guess that's how young she was.
Considering she used to be older
than us, this does feel awkward.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりまだ幼いってことか？
　もともとは年上だったのに、
　なんだか不思議な感じだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's how young she was.
Considering she used to be older
than us, this does feel awkward.)

fields.EN:
Waaah! What shall I do?
My pendant... Pendant!
fields.JP:
ふえぇ、どうしましょう……！
ペンダントが、ペンダントがー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waaah! What shall I do?
My pendant... Pendant!

fields.EN:
D-Don't cry! It'll be fine!
You're not helping me one
bit by crying!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だから泣くな！
貴様に泣かれると、すごーく困るんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't cry! It'll be fine!
You're not helping me one
bit by crying!

fields.EN:
Um... Here! Look! Fast, right?
See how quickly I can move
side-to-side!
fields.JP:
えーと、ほら、これを見よ！
ちょうこうしょ……じゃない、
ちょうこうそく反復横跳びだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Here! Look! Fast, right?
See how quickly I can move
side-to-side!

fields.JP:
見たか！？　このスピード感！
すごいだろう！！

fields.EN:
(Hameln is trying to stop
Cinderella from crying?)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラが泣いていて、
　ハーメルンはそれを慰めようとしてる、
　ってとこか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln is trying to stop
Cinderella from crying?)

fields.EN:
(Uh, but I've never seen such a
weird way of trying to stop
someone from crying before...)
fields.JP:
（でも、泣いてる相手に対して
　あんなヘンテコな慰め方は初めて見た……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, but I've never seen such a
weird way of trying to stop
someone from crying before...)

fields.EN:
Augh! Stop crying already!
What am I supposed to do?!
fields.JP:
ああー、もう泣くなというに！
ワレはどうしたらいいのだー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Augh! Stop crying already!
What am I supposed to do?!

fields.EN:
I'm not sure, but I know that
what you were doing there
isn't going to do the trick...
fields.JP:
どうしたらって、少なくとも
反復横跳びを披露することじゃ
ないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure, but I know that
what you were doing there
isn't going to do the trick...

fields.EN:
Otsuu! Perfect timing!
Help me stop Cinderella from
crying!
fields.JP:
おつう！　よいところに来てくれた！
シンデレラが泣いてしまって
困っていたんでゃじょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Perfect timing!
Help me stop Cinderella from
crying!

fields.JP: ハーメルン、シンデレラをいじめたのか？
なななっ、そんなわけあるみゃい！！

fields.EN:
She wasn't teasing me, Otsuu.
She was just helping me with
my training...
fields.JP:
……ちがうんですの、おつう。
ハーメルンはわたしの訓練に
付き合ってくれていただけですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wasn't teasing me, Otsuu.
She was just helping me with
my training...

fields.EN:
I haven't trained in a long while,
and I didn't want to get in
anyone's way, so...
fields.JP:
もう長いこと訓練なんてしていなかったので、
みんなの足手まといにならないように
しなくてはと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't trained in a long while,
and I didn't want to get in
anyone's way, so...

fields.EN: I see... Well, good for you.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... Well, good for you.

fields.EN:
But sometime during the training
my pendant must have come loose,
and...
fields.JP:
でも訓練がひとくぎりついて、
気がついたら、わたしの……
大切なペンダントがなくなっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But sometime during the training
my pendant must have come loose,
and...

fields.EN:
And that's when she started
crying. You can't imagine how
confused I was.
fields.JP:
それで急に泣き出してしまったのだ。
ワレはものすごく焦ったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that's when she started
crying. You can't imagine how
confused I was.

fields.EN:
Pendant? Are you referring to the
one with the glass slipper
trinket on it?
fields.JP:
ペンダントって、
あの小さいガラスの靴のペンダントのことだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pendant? Are you referring to the
one with the glass slipper
trinket on it?

fields.EN:
Yes... I think it flew off during
training.
fields.JP:
はい……。たぶんはげしく動いたときに
落ちてしまったのですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I think it flew off during
training.

fields.EN:
Then it has to be around here
somewhere. It's a good thing it
didn't come off during battle.
fields.JP:
それなら、きっと近くに落ちてるはずだ。
戦闘中とかじゃなくてまだよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then it has to be around here
somewhere. It's a good thing it
didn't come off during battle.

fields.EN:
I-I need that pendant, or else...
I... I...
fields.JP:
でも……あのペンダントがないと、
わたし、わたし……っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I need that pendant, or else...
I... I...

fields.EN:
I can't help but think that I look
utterly unsightly without it!
fields.JP:
自分がどうしようもなくみにくく思えて、
不安で仕方ないんですの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't help but think that I look
utterly unsightly without it!

fields.EN:
Y-You're fine! Cheer up!
I'll help look too, so stop with
the crying thing!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫だ！　元気を出せ！
ワレらも探してやるから、
そんなにめそめそするな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You're fine! Cheer up!
I'll help look too, so stop with
the crying thing!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Cinderella.
I'm sure we'll find it.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、落ち着いて。
きっとすぐに見つかるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Cinderella.
I'm sure we'll find it.

fields.EN:
Indeed!
You're in good hands here!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ！
大船に乗ったちゅもりでいるがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed!
You're in good hands here!

fields.EN: And Hameln, be careful while you search. Whatever you do, don't step on the pendant and break it.
fields.JP:
それとハーメルン。くれぐれも気をつけて
探すんだぞ。間違ってもペンダントを
踏んで壊したりしないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, just a fair warning to
you, but be very careful where
you're stepping, got it?

fields.EN:
H-How rude! Y-You don't need
to say that to me!
fields.JP:
な、なぜワレを名指しで念を押す！？
なんとなく失礼な気がするぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-How rude! Y-You don't need
to say that to me!

fields.JP: さあ、さっそく探そうか！

fields.EN:
Hey! Here it is!
This is it, right?
fields.JP: ……あっ、あった！　これだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Here it is!
This is it, right?

fields.JP: こ、これです！　これですわ！！

fields.EN:
So there it is! Good thing we
found it, isn't that right,
Cinderella?
fields.JP:
なんだ、そんなところにあったのだな。
見つかってよかったな、シンデレラ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there it is! Good thing we
found it, isn't that right,
Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Why yes! Aah, thank goodness...
Thank you so very much!
fields.JP:
はいっ！　ああ、よかった……。
お二人とも、本当にありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes! Aah, thank goodness...
Thank you so very much!

fields.EN:
Aah... I feel better already.
I can't imagine how life would be
without it.
fields.JP:
はぁ……これで落ち着きましたわ。
これがないと、もう不安で仕方なくって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah... I feel better already.
I can't imagine how life would be
without it.

fields.EN:
You said something about feeling
like you're unsightly?
fields.JP: 醜くく思えて不安、って言ってたっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said something about feeling
like you're unsightly?

fields.EN:
Why yes, without it I lack any
form of physical beauty...
fields.JP:
はい……。
これをつけていないと、わたしは、
その……ぜんぜん美しくありませんもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, without it I lack any
form of physical beauty...

fields.EN:
Not at all. Why do you think you
need it to be beautiful?
fields.JP:
別にそんなことはないだろう。
なぜそれがないと美しくないなんて
言うのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. Why do you think you
need it to be beautiful?

fields.EN:
I'm not beautiful... I only look
beautiful because I wear beautiful
things on me.
fields.JP:
だって……わたしはきれいじゃない
からですわ。きれいなもので着飾って、
ようやく少しまともに見えるんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not beautiful... I only look
beautiful because I wear beautiful
things on me.

fields.EN:
I don't think you would look any
different without it.
fields.JP: 君は普通にしていても十分きれいだと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think you would look any
different without it.

fields.EN:
That's not true... My pendant and
all that I wear makes me who
I am...
fields.JP:
そんな……もしそうだとしたら、
きっとこのペンダントや、他のかざりの
おかげでそう見えているだけですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true... My pendant and
all that I wear makes me who
I am...

fields.EN:
My true form is utterly unsightly
and miserable...
fields.JP:
本当のわたしなんて……みにくくて……
みすぼらしくて、ぜんぜん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My true form is utterly unsightly
and miserable...

fields.EN:
Huh, I wouldn't think that in the
slightest. I guess that must be
your Blood Libido...
fields.JP:
うーむ、そんなことないと思うんだがなぁ。
これがけっしきリビドーというやつなのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, I wouldn't think that in the
slightest. I guess that must be
your Blood Libido...

fields.EN:
I recall someone long ago telling
me how beautiful I was...
I think it was my mother.
fields.JP:
それに……昔、「キレイ、キレイ」って、
誰かに言ってもらった記憶がありますの。
たぶん、お母さまに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall someone long ago telling
me how beautiful I was...
I think it was my mother.

fields.JP: へぇ、お母さんのことを覚えてるのか？

fields.EN:
I don't recall much, but I do
starkly remember how she said
those words to me...
fields.JP:
ほとんど記憶にはないんですけど、
あの優しい言葉だけは覚えていますわ。
きっとあれはお母さまなんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't recall much, but I do
starkly remember how she said
those words to me...

fields.EN:
I fondly remember my mother's
words bringing great joy to me.
fields.JP:
お母さまにキレイキレイって言って
もらえて、すごくうれしかったことだけは
覚えていますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I fondly remember my mother's
words bringing great joy to me.

fields.EN:
That is why I need to stay
beautiful at all times.
fields.JP:
……だからわたしは、
きれいでなければいけませんの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is why I need to stay
beautiful at all times.

fields.EN:
But wasn't your mother referring
to you being beautiful, and not
what was on you?
fields.JP:
でも君のお母さんは、そのままの
シンデレラをきれいって言ったんだろう？
だったらそのままでも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But wasn't your mother referring
to you being beautiful, and not
what was on you?

fields.EN:
No... I need to dress properly...
I'm not beautiful... I need to
keep myself well-dressed...
fields.JP:
だめですの、ちゃんときかざらないと……
わたしはぜんぜんきれいじゃありませんわ。
どうしても不安になってしまうんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No... I need to dress properly...
I'm not beautiful... I need to
keep myself well-dressed...

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, I guess it can't be helped
if that's your Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
……そっか。
血式リビドーじゃ、仕方ないよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, I guess it can't be helped
if that's your Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
(Still, I think she can hold a
bit more confidence in herself...)
fields.JP:
（とは言っても、シンデレラには
　もっと自信を持ってもらえると
　いいんだけどな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, I think she can hold a
bit more confidence in herself...)

fields.EN:
(Not that there's anything I can
do for her now...)
fields.JP:
（こればかりは僕がいくら言っても、
　どうにもならないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that there's anything I can
do for her now...)

fields.EN:
Hm, I see...
Quite the discovery...
fields.JP:
ふむ、なるほど。
これは素晴らしい発見かもしれん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, I see...
Quite the discovery...

fields.EN:
Isn't it? If this theory is
correct, this will greatly advance
our research.
fields.JP:
ええ。この仮説が正しければ、
研究が飛躍的に進むことになるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it? If this theory is
correct, this will greatly advance
our research.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: What are you folks talking about?
fields.JP: やあ。なんの話をしてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you folks talking about?

fields.JP: え？　あ……なんの話というか、その……

fields.EN:
Otsuu, what timing... I want
you to be in the know with us.
fields.JP:
おつう、ちょうどよかった。
君にも聞いてほしいと思っていたところだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, what timing... I want
you to be in the know with us.

fields.EN:
We found out that the blood sample
we recovered at the old Liberated
District was Cinderella's.
fields.JP:
破壊された元開放地区で回収した
血式少女の血液サンプルが、
シンデレラのものだったと判明したのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We found out that the blood sample
we recovered at the old Liberated
District was Cinderella's.

fields.EN: There are only two or three, but we're lucky such valuable samples were left behind.
fields.JP:
ほんの２、３個だけだけど、
こんなに貴重な資料が遺されていたなんて
運が良かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have only a couple on hand,
but we're lucky that such a prime
sample was found.

fields.EN:
What wonders await as we
research these samples...
Heh heh...
fields.JP:
ああ、ここからどんな新しい発見が
あるのかしら。ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What wonders await as we
research these samples...
Heh heh...

fields.EN:
You look quite happy, Gretel.
Is it that much of a discovery?
fields.JP:
グレーテル、嬉しそうだな。
それってそこまで喜ぶようなことなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You look quite happy, Gretel.
Is it that much of a discovery?

fields.EN:
Cinderella's blood samples match
closely to her current blood
samples despite the time lapse.
fields.JP:
簡潔に言えば、この五年前の血液サンプルと
今のシンデレラの血液状態に、
ほとんど変化が見られなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella's blood samples match
closely to her current blood
samples despite the time lapse.

fields.JP: その反応は、よくわかっていないようね

fields.EN:
Under normal circumstances, blood
found five years ago wouldn't keep
its state.
fields.JP:
いいかい？　五年前の血液と今の血液が
同じなんて、普通はあり得ないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Under normal circumstances, blood
found five years ago wouldn't keep
its state.

fields.EN: Cinderella's body hasn't changed... or deteriorated at all in five years. In other words, she hasn't aged!
fields.JP:
シンデレラの体は、五年前から変化……
劣化してない。つまり歳をとっていない
ということなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But her blood hasn't changed much,
which means that the blood hasn't
aged.

fields.EN:
We were discussing why Cinderella
hasn't aged.
fields.JP:
「なぜシンデレラは年を取らなかったのか」。
この問題について僕とグレーテルは議論を重ねた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were discussing why Cinderella
hasn't aged.

fields.EN:
That led us to the theory that
Blood Skelter affects the aging
process of Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
そしてついに、「ブラッドスケルター化
していた影響ではないか」という
新しい仮説を導き出したんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That led us to the theory that
Blood Skelter affects the aging
process of Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
That's quite a discovery. Come to
think of it, Cinderella was under
Blood Skelter the whole time.
fields.JP:
おお、それは大発見だな。
たしかにシンデレラはずっと
ブラッドスケルター化していたしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's quite a discovery. Come to
think of it, Cinderella was under
Blood Skelter the whole time.

fields.EN:
She hasn't changed much in
appearance too, so you folks
may be right.
fields.JP:
外見も変わっていないから、
その仮説は本当に正しいのかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She hasn't changed much in
appearance too, so you folks
may be right.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Jack.
This discussion is a bit too
hard for you.
fields.JP:
ジャックにはわからないか。
まぁ、無理もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Jack.
This discussion is a bit too
hard for you.

fields.EN:
You were just staring there...
Are you feeling okay?
fields.JP:
いや、なんかぼーっとしてるみたいだったから。
気分でも悪いのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were just staring there...
Are you feeling okay?

fields.EN:
I-I'm absolutely fine...
Look! I've never felt better!
Ohohohoho!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことありませんわ。
わたしはいつでもシャキッとしていましてよ！
おーっほっほっほー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm absolutely fine...
Look! I've never felt better!
Ohohohoho!

fields.EN:
So, not aging also means that
my beauty is eternal!
fields.JP:
歳をとらないということは、
つまりわたしの美しさをずっと
保てるということですのね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, not aging also means that
my beauty is eternal!

fields.EN:
How delightful!
After all, getting old means that
I would only become decrepit...
fields.JP:
そう、歳をとらないのなら、みにくく
ヨボヨボになっちゃうこともないん
ですもの……。素晴らしいことですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How delightful!
After all, getting old means that
I would only become decrepit...

fields.EN:
(She knows that getting old is
how one can mature.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラはきっとわかっている。
　老いがないということは、
　成長もしないということだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She knows that getting old is
how one can mature.)

fields.EN:
(She must feel lonely not being
able to age with everyone...)
fields.JP:
（みんなと一緒に歳を重ねることができず、
　一人だけ置いて行かれてしまう孤独……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must feel lonely not being
able to age with everyone...)

fields.EN:
(It must feel very weird to her...
I should've noticed before I said
all those things...)
fields.JP:
（強がって見せているけど、
　複雑な心境だろうな。……僕は馬鹿だ。
　無神経なことを言ってしまったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must feel very weird to her...
I should've noticed before I said
all those things...)

fields.JP:
（ん？　なんだかあっちのほうが
　騒がしいみたいだけど……）

fields.EN: Why are you on her side?!
fields.JP: なぜこんな奴を庇うのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why are you on her side?!

fields.EN:
How many times do I have to
say this? Are you stupid?!
fields.JP:
だーかーら、違うんだって
何度言えばわかるのよ！
このアンポンタン！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many times do I have to
say this? Are you stupid?!

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Cinderella-san. You're not at
fault, so hold your head high.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよ。
シンデレラさんは悪くないんですから、
堂々としていればいいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. We know you're fine.
Just stay strong.

fields.EN:
Stop it right there.
Do you have a problem with my
friends here?
fields.JP: はい、そこまで。僕の仲間になにか用か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop it right there.
Do you have a problem with my
friends here?

fields.EN:
That girl there killed one of us!
She won't get away from her sins
killing Hitsuka-sama!
fields.JP:
その女はタイヨウ教団の陽司様を
殺害した大罪人だ！
それを庇うなど、言語道断！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That girl there killed one of us!
She won't get away from her sins
killing Hitsuka!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司様 => Hitsuka-sama

fields.EN:
Like I said, she didn't kill him!
What are those ears on you for?!
fields.JP:
だからシンデレラは千昭を殺してなんか
いないって言ってるでしょ！？
人の話を聞きなさいっての！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like I said, she didn't kill him!
What are those ears on you for?!

fields.EN:
It's all a misunderstanding.
We explained this already,
and Michiru agreed, too!
fields.JP:
全部誤解なのよ。このことは
前にもきちんと教団で説明したし、
ミチルだってわかってくれたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all a misunderstanding.
We explained this already,
and Michiru agreed, too!

fields.EN:
If you're supposed to be one of
the hot-shots here, then you
should listen to her!
fields.JP:
あんたも教団の幹部なら、
その判断に従うべきでしょう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're supposed to be one of
the hot-shots here, then you
should listen to her!

fields.EN:
Hmph! I bet you tricked Lady
Oohime, tainting her purity!
fields.JP:
ふん！　どうせ姑息な手を使って、
純粋な大陽女様を欺いたのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! I bet you tricked Lady
Oohime, tainting her purity!

fields.EN: W-We wouldn't do such a thing!
fields.LOCALIZED: W-We wouldn't do such a thing!

fields.EN:
Uh, what the hell is
going on here?
fields.JP: おいこら、なに揉め事起こしてんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, what the hell is
going on here?

fields.EN:
Mamoru, what perfect timing. The
person here is apparently a key
member of the Order, and...
fields.JP:
マモル、ちょうどよかった。
この人はタイヨウ教団の幹部らしいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, what perfect timing. The
person here is apparently a key
member of the Order, and...

fields.JP: ……ああ、なんとなく事情はわかった

fields.EN:
We got rules around here, and if
you're gonna cause trouble I'm
gonna have to ask you to leave.
fields.JP:
おい、あんた。
こんなところでもルールはあるんだ。
問題を起こすようなら出てってもらうぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We got rules around here, and if
you're gonna cause trouble I'm
gonna have to ask you to leave.

fields.EN: Sure, but only after you leave.
fields.JP: はいはい、一名様お帰りでーす、っと
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but only after you leave.

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...
Do you girls have to go through
this every time?
fields.JP:
まったく……。さっきみたいな奴は
珍しくないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...
Do you girls have to go through
this every time?

fields.EN:
Those in the Order who don't like
seeing us sisters often cause
trouble like that...
fields.JP:
……白雪たちをタイヨウ教団の陽司として
気に食わない人達は、ああしてわざと
問題を起こしてくるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the Order who don't like
seeing us sisters often cause
trouble like that...

fields.EN:
(I can see why Oyayubi was
suspecting anyone who came
near her...)
fields.JP:
（ああいう連中に隙を見せるわけには
　いかない。親指が疑い深くなったのは、
　そのせいもあったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can see why Thumbelina was
suspecting anyone who came
near her...)

fields.JP:
い……今の人が言っていたことは、
本当なんでしょうか……？

fields.EN:
That was complete bull.
Just forget about it.
fields.JP:
全部でたらめよ。
あんな言葉に耳を貸す必要ないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was complete bull.
Just forget about it.

fields.EN:
She's right, Cinderella.
You've done nothing wrong.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、シンデレラ。
君は悪くないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Cinderella.
You've done nothing wrong.

fields.EN:
But you don't have proof that
I wasn't the perpetrator, right?
fields.JP:
でも……わたしが犯人じゃないという
証拠もありませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you don't have proof that
I wasn't the perpetrator, right?

fields.EN:
M-Maybe I did lay hands on him
when I went into Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
も、もしかしたら本当に、
ブラッドスケルター化したときに、
わたしがやったんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Maybe I did lay hands on him
when I went into Blood Skelter...

fields.JP: そうじゃないんです、シンデレラさん……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
How can you be so sure?
I may be the culprit...
fields.JP:
どうして言い切れますの？
そういう可能性だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can you be so sure?
I may be the culprit...

fields.EN:
I think it's best we let her in
on all the details...
fields.JP:
……もう、すべてを話したほうが
いいかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's best we let her in
on all the details...

fields.EN:
B-But if what you said is true,
then I was the one who led to
Hitsuka-san's death...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな……。
では、やっぱりわたしのせいで、
陽司さんが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But if what you said is true,
then I was the one who led to
Hitsuka's death...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.JP: あんたのせいじゃないわ

fields.EN:
I am at fault... If I didn't go
to the prison area alone, then
none of that would've happened.
fields.JP:
でも、わたしが原因のようなものですわ。
わたしが一人で独房エリアへ行ったり
しなければ、そんなことには……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am at fault... If I didn't go
to the prison area alone, then
none of that would've happened.

fields.EN:
Don't get down on yourself.
Finding faults isn't going to do
anyone good.
fields.JP:
自分を責めないで。
なにが原因かなんて言い出したら
きりがないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't get down on yourself.
Finding faults isn't going to do
anyone good.

fields.EN:
Like, I could even say that it
wouldn't have happened if I didn't
say all those things to you...
fields.JP:
元はと言えば、わたしが酷いこと
言ったりしなければ、あんたが一人で
独房エリアに行くこともなかったんだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, I could even say that it
wouldn't have happened if I didn't
say all those things to you...

fields.EN:
Please, stop! You don't need to
try and cover for me like this!
Nothing will change the fact!
fields.JP:
なぐさめなんてやめてください！
なにを言っても、起きてしまったことは
変わりませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, stop! You don't need to
try and cover for me like this!
Nothing will change the fact!

fields.JP:
もう、わたしのことなんて
放っておいてください……！

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry for yelling...
I... got out of hand there.
fields.JP:
……大きな声を出したりして、
すみませんでした。
取り乱してしまいましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry for yelling...
I... got out of hand there.

fields.EN:
Please, leave me alone for a
moment. I need to think for
a while alone...
fields.JP:
少し、一人にしてください。
気持ちを落ち着かせたいんですの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, leave me alone for a
moment. I need to think for
a while alone...

fields.EN:
(This isn't good... She hasn't
matured like us mentally...)
fields.JP:
（……心配だな。シンデレラの精神年齢は、
　外見の年齢と同じくらいのはずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This isn't good... She hasn't
matured like us mentally...)

fields.EN:
(I doubt she can process all
that we told her...)
fields.JP:
（それなのにいきなりあんな真実を
　知らされたら、自分の中でうまく
　処理できないかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I doubt she can process all
that we told her...)

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what else we can
say to her...
fields.JP:
なんて声をかければいいのか、
わかりませんでした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what else we can
say to her...

fields.JP: 僕もだよ。……もどかしいけど

fields.EN:
All we can do now is to grant her
wish by leaving her alone for
a moment...
fields.JP:
ええ。きっと今は、そっとしておくしか
ないんでしょうね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we can do now is to grant her
wish by leaving her alone for
a moment...

fields.EN:
I better check up on her every so
often so that she doesn't go
astray...
fields.JP:
シンデレラが思いつめて変なことを
考えないように、ちょくちょく顔を出したほうが
いいかもしれないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better check up on her every so
often so that she doesn't go
astray...

fields.JP:
（シンデレラ……。
　まだ元気なさそうだな……）

あ、シンデレラだー！
ねーねーねー、なにしてんのー？

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Ooh! How 'bout we play?!
Play with Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
じゃあさ、じゃあさ、
ラプンツェルとあそぼーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! How 'bout we play?!
Play with Rapunzel!

fields.JP: ？　げんきない？　おなかすいたの？

fields.EN: Augh! What a pain in the...!
fields.JP: あーもー、見てらんないわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Augh! What a pain in the...!

fields.EN:
(Oyayubi?! She was
eavesdropping on her, too?)
fields.JP:
（って、親指！？
　近くに隠れて見てたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina?! She was
eavesdropping on her, too?)

fields.EN:
How many times do I need to
tell you that it's okay?!
Get a grip already!
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、あんたは悪くないって
何度も言ってるでしょ？
いい加減、元気出しなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many times do I need to
tell you that it's okay?!
Get a grip already!

fields.EN:
(I know she's trying to cheer
Cinderella up, but it's hard to
tell with all her yelling...)
fields.JP:
（励ましたいんだろうなぁ。
　あんな逆ギレみたいな言い方じゃ、
　わかりづらいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know she's trying to cheer
Cinderella up, but it's hard to
tell with all her yelling...)

fields.EN:
If you're in the wrong, then the
same goes for me, too! Why do you
keep blaming yourself?!
fields.JP:
あんたが悪いんなら、わたしだって
悪いんだから！　自分ばっかり
責めるのはおかしいでしょ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're in the wrong, then the
same goes for me, too! Why do you
keep blaming yourself?!

fields.EN:
You're fine, Oyayubihime... I was
the one who went off to the
prison area, not you...
fields.JP:
……親指姫は悪くありませんわ。
独房エリアなんかに一人で行ったのは、
結局はわたしなんですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're fine, Thumbelina... I was
the one who went off to the
prison area, not you...

fields.EN:
If it was someone else, they
wouldn't have ran off like how
I did...
fields.JP:
もしわたしと同じ状況になったとしても、
他の人ならあんなところに
行かなかったかもしれないんですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it was someone else, they
wouldn't have ran off like how
I did...

fields.EN:
Sure, maybe, but that's a moot
point!
fields.JP:
かも、でしょ？　仮定の話をいくら
したってしょうがないじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, maybe, but that's a moot
point!

fields.EN:
Hitsuka-san wouldn't have died if
I didn't run off like that...
fields.JP:
わたしがあの時ぼうそうして、
独房エリアなんて行ったから……
陽司さんが死ぬことになったんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hitsuka wouldn't have died if
I didn't run off like that...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.JP:
そんなわたしには、もう生きてる資格
なんてないんですわ……！
……そんなこと、本気で言ってるの……？

おやゆび、ないてる……？
どっかいたいの？

fields.EN:
No, it's just that hearing
Cinderella say she doesn't deserve
to live cut me deep...
fields.JP:
ううん、そうじゃなくて……。
生きてる資格がないなんて、そんなこと
言わせちゃったのがわたしだと思ったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's just that hearing
Cinderella say she doesn't deserve
to live cut me deep...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry to make you think that.
I should've apologized from
before...
fields.JP:
ごめん、シンデレラ……。
本当はずっと謝りたかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry to make you think that.
I should've apologized from
before...

fields.EN:
I regretted not hearing you out.
I just couldn't get myself
to listen...
fields.JP:
ちゃんと話を聞いてあげれば
よかったって、ずっと後悔してた。
あのときは意固地になっちゃってたの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I regretted not hearing you out.
I just couldn't get myself
to listen...

fields.EN:
If only I listened and helped you
in your time of need... Maybe then
no one would've gotten hurt...
fields.JP:
謝らなきゃいけないのはわたしのほうだわ。
あんたの話を聞いて、力になっていれば、
誰も傷つかずに済んだのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I listened and helped you
in your time of need... Maybe then
no one would've gotten hurt...

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, Cinderella...
I really should've apologized
earlier...
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、ごめんなさい。
……もっと早くに謝っていればよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, Cinderella...
I really should've apologized
earlier...

fields.EN:
It didn't dawn on me that you were
in so much pain over me...
fields.JP:
……あなたも同じように苦しんでいたなんて、
わたし、思いもしませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It didn't dawn on me that you were
in so much pain over me...

fields.EN:
I kept thinking I was the only one
causing all the trouble and
suffering from it...
fields.JP:
悪いのも、苦しんでいるのも、
ぜんぶ自分一人だと思い込んで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept thinking I was the only one
causing all the trouble and
suffering from it...

fields.EN: (To think they were both blaming themselves in the same way. At this rate, neither of them can be saved...)
fields.JP:
（二人とも同じように自分を責めていたなんて。
　これじゃどっちも救われない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess they were both suffering
over the same thing...)

fields.JP: えっとねー、ふたりともだいじょうぶだよ！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Rapunzel get into fight with
Cinderella before. Cried a lot.
fields.JP:
あのね、ラプンツェルもこのあいだ、
シンデレラとけんかして、ないちゃったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel get into fight with
Cinderella before. Cried a lot.

fields.EN:
But Oyayubi said that was okay.
Kids make mistakes and grow!
fields.JP:
でもね、おやゆびがそれでもいいって
いったんだよ。ちいさいころは、
しっぱいしておおきくなるんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Thumby said that was okay.
Kids make mistakes and grow!

fields.EN: I guess I did say that before...
fields.JP: そういえば、そんな話もしたわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess I did say that before...

fields.EN:
So no worry! Cinderella and Oyayubi
made mistake when little!
Learn from mistake!
fields.JP:
だからだいじょうぶ！　シンデレラとおやゆびが
ちいさいころしっぱいしたことなら、
これからはやらなきゃいいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So no worry! Cinderella and Thumby
made mistake when little!
Learn from mistake!

fields.EN:
Oyayubi said that make mistake
can make everyone happy, too!
Right?
fields.JP:
しっぱいされたひとも、
そのほうがよろこぶんだって。
ね、そうでしょ？　おやゆび！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby said that make mistake
can make everyone happy, too!
Right?

fields.EN:
You're right, Rapu... I just have
to avoid making the same
mistake again.
fields.JP:
……ラプ、あんたの言う通りだわ。
もう同じ失敗を繰り返さなければ
いいだけの話なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right, Rappy... I just have
to avoid making the same
mistake again.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Thanks, I feel a lot better now...
fields.JP: ありがとう。なんだか、すごく気が楽に……
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks, I feel a lot better now...

fields.EN:
Oyayubi? You crying?
Rapunzel make you cry?
fields.JP:
おやゆび？　あれ？　なんでなくの？
ラプンツェル、へんなこといった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby? You crying?
Rapunzel make you cry?

fields.EN:
No, I'm just relieved, that's all.
I appreciate you reminding me
what I said.
fields.JP:
違うの。ホッとしちゃっただけ。
大事なことを思い出させてくれて、
あんたには感謝してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm just relieved, that's all.
I appreciate you reminding me
what I said.

fields.EN:
Your words of honesty has lifted
the load that was on me, Rapu.
fields.JP:
ラプの素直な言葉のおかげで、
ずっと胸の奥につかえていたものが
取れたような気がしますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your words of honesty has lifted
the load that was on me, Rappy.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I guess I was getting a bit too
stubborn there...
fields.JP:
わたしはかたくなだったのかも
しれませんわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I was getting a bit too
stubborn there...

fields.EN:
We just need to be a bit more
honest like her.
fields.JP:
これからはもっと素直になればいいじゃない。
わたしたち
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just need to be a bit more
honest like her.

fields.EN:
Huh? Not sure what happening,
but no crying, right?
fields.JP:
？　よくわかんないけど、
ふたりとも、もうなかない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Not sure what happening,
but no crying, right?

fields.EN:
Why yes, I feel like we're all
great friends again because of
you, Rapu.
fields.JP: ええ、ラプのおかげで仲直りできましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why yes, I feel like we're all
great friends again because of
you, Rappy.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: ほんと！？　えへへー、よかった！

fields.EN:
(Whew... I guess that takes care
of that. Kudos to Rapunzel's
sheer honesty.)
fields.JP:
（……ふぅ、一件落着か。
　ラプンツェルはすごいな。
　野生の勘、ってやつか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whew... I guess that takes care
of that. Kudos to Rapunzel's
sheer honesty.)

fields.EN: (Things will still be hard from here on, but those two have friends who'll support them. Me included, of course. So I'm sure they'll be fine.)
fields.JP:
（これからも大変なことがあるだろうけど、
　二人には支えてくれる仲間がいる。
　もちろん、僕も。だからきっと大丈夫だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There will be more to face, but
we're all here to help each other,
so it'll all be fine.)

fields.EN:
(Now then, I better take leave.
There's nothing else for me to
see here.)
fields.JP:
（……さてと、そろそろ行くとするか。
　これ以上盗み見するのは野暮だもんな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now then, I better take leave.
There's nothing else for me to
see here.)

fields.EN:
What's the matter with the
sighing?
fields.JP:
どうしたんだ？
ため息なんかついちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter with the
sighing?

fields.EN:
Nothing in particular.
I just happened to sigh,
that's all.
fields.JP:
別に、なんでもありませんわ。
わたしだって、一人でたそがれたい
ときくらいありますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing in particular.
I just happened to sigh,
that's all.

fields.EN:
Oh now, what's with that look?
I feel like you're taunting me
here.
fields.JP:
む。なんですの？　その反応は。
なんだかばかにされてるみたいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh now, what's with that look?
I feel like you're taunting me
here.

fields.EN:
Of course not.
Why would I do that?
fields.JP: まさか。馬鹿になんてするわけないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not.
Why would I do that?

fields.EN:
Well, your attitude isn't helping!
Hmph!
fields.JP:
その余裕な感じがばかにしてるみたい
だって言ってますのよ！　もうっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, your attitude isn't helping!
Hmph!

fields.EN: Now, now, no need to get angry.
fields.JP: まあまあ、そう怒るなって
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, now, no need to get angry.

fields.EN:
I still can't believe you're all
older than me now! If only...!
fields.JP:
やっぱりおつう達ばっかり先に
大人になるなんて許せませんわ！
わたしだって、わたしだって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I still can't believe you're all
older than me now! If only...!

fields.JP:
あれ？　怒ったかと思えば
急に落ち込んで……忙しいな

fields.EN:
Hmph...
Sure, it's not surprising I'm
emotionally unstable, right?
fields.JP: ふん。どうせ、じょうちょふあんていですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph...
Sure, it's not surprising I'm
emotionally unstable, right?

fields.EN:
I thought I was lacking only in
age in comparison to you folks.
fields.JP:
……前は、わたしがふがいないのは、
大人のおつう達と違って
子どもだからだと思ってましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I was lacking only in
age in comparison to you folks.

fields.EN:
But that wasn't true.
Even Rapu had a strong center,
unlike me.
fields.JP:
でも違うってわかりましたわ。
ラプは小さい子なのに、わたしよりしっかりした
『自分』というものを持っていますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that wasn't true.
Even Rappy had a strong center,
unlike me.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime is doing her best to
get over her own weakness, too.
fields.JP:
親指姫だって、自分に至らない
ところがあれば、それをカバーしようと
努力していますし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina is doing her best to
get over her own weakness, too.

fields.EN:
It all boils down to how each one
approaches themselves. Being old
made no difference.
fields.JP:
要は、どう生きるかなんですのよね。
大人かどうかなんて、関係なかったんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It all boils down to how each one
approaches themselves. Being old
made no difference.

fields.EN:
In that sense, me being worried about
everyone being older than me is
proof of my immaturity...
fields.JP:
大人か子どもかなんて気にしている時点で、
わたしはいつまでも子どもで……
不甲斐ないってことですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that sense, me being worried about
everyone being older than me is
proof of my immaturity...

fields.EN:
Have you been listening to what
I said? What made you say that?
fields.JP:
ちょっ、今の話を聞いてまして？
なんでそうなるんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Have you been listening to what
I said? What made you say that?

fields.EN:
I'm amazed that you're so deep
in thought.
fields.JP:
いや、シンデレラがそうやって悩んでるのは、
自分でいろいろ考えてるからだろ？
すごいことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm amazed that you're so deep
in thought.

fields.EN: Someone who's truly inadequate wouldn't worry about it, and probably wouldn't even realize they were inadequate in the first place.
fields.JP:
本当に不甲斐ない奴は
悩んだりしないし、そもそも自分が
不甲斐ないことに気づかないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Immature people don't think like
that, and don't notice that they
are immature in the first place.

fields.EN:
Fortunately, there are no real
immature people around me.
fields.JP:
まぁ、僕の周りにはそういう人は
いないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fortunately, there are no real
immature people around me.

fields.EN:
You really did mature, didn't you?
I'm talking about your mental
maturity here.
fields.JP:
……やっぱり、おつうは大人ですわ。
体だけじゃなく心も、という意味ですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really did mature, didn't you?
I'm talking about your mental
maturity here.

fields.EN:
Come now, I have my own faults.
I keep thinking how I can make
myself better.
fields.JP:
僕だって駄目なところだらけだよ。
もっとしっかりしなきゃって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, I have my own faults.
I keep thinking how I can make
myself better.

fields.EN:
Heh, whatever you say. Well, I guess
I still have quite a bit to learn.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ひかえめですわね。でもいいですわ。
今のわたしが子どもなら、まだまだ
成長できるということですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, whatever you say. Well, I guess
I still have quite a bit to learn.

fields.EN:
Just you wait! I'm going to do
my very best to catch up to
you folks!
fields.JP:
たくさんがんばって、今におつう達に
追いついてみせますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just you wait! I'm going to do
my very best to catch up to
you folks!

fields.EN:
Well, that means I need to do
even more so that I can keep
our gap.
fields.JP:
言うね。僕も負けないように
がんばらないとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that means I need to do
even more so that I can keep
our gap.

fields.EN:
There you go again. Mind you,
I don't like it with that attitude
of yours, acting older than me.
fields.JP:
むぅー。やっぱりその態度、
なんだか余裕な感じで気に入らないですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again. Mind you,
I don't like it with that attitude
of yours, acting older than me.

fields.EN:
Well, all you need to do is to
mature inside and act like
you're older than me then.
fields.JP: だったら早く追いついて、追い越せばいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all you need to do is to
mature inside and act like
you're older than me then.

fields.EN:
You don't have to tell me that!
Like I said, just you wait!
fields.JP:
言われなくてもやってやりますわ。
覚悟しておくことですわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to tell me that!
Like I said, just you wait!

fields.EN:
(I'm glad we can talk freely like
this again. I'm looking forward to
spending our time together again.)
fields.JP:
（また昔みたいに話せるようになって
　よかった……。離れていた時間の分、
　これからはたくさん一緒にいられるといいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad we can talk freely like
this again. I'm looking forward to
spending our time together again.)

fields.EN:
Mmm... Where should I sit?
The place is too open for comfort.
fields.JP:
うーん、どこの席に座ろうかな。
こんなに空いてると、逆に迷うな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Where should I sit?
The place is too open for comfort.

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan, look there.
It's Cinderella-san.
fields.JP:
あ。ねぇ、おつうちゃん。
あっちの席でシンデレラさんが食事してるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu, look there.
It's Cinderella.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san; おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
*munch* *munch*
It's good to have some time off
like this every so often...
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……。にぎやかな食事も
楽しいですけど、たまには一人で
ゆっくり食事するのもいいものですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* *munch*
It's good to have some time off
like this every so often...

fields.EN:
Oh dear, I forgot my water...
I'll finish off my main dish
later...
fields.JP:
……あ、お水がなくなってしまいましたわ。
ちょっともらってきましょう。
おかずは後にとっておいて、と……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh dear, I forgot my water...
I'll finish off my main dish
later...

fields.EN:
Huh? Tasty food here?
No one wants? So waste...
fields.JP:
あれ？　だれもいないのにおかずが
のこってる……。おいしそうなのに、
もったいないなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Tasty food here?
No one wants? So waste...

fields.EN:
Left over, so no one wants.
Rapunzel eat then!
fields.JP:
のこしてあるんだから、
きっともういらないんだよね。
ラプンツェルがたべてあげよっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Left over, so no one wants.
Rapunzel eat then!

fields.JP: あら、ラプも来ていたんですの？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I came look for everyone!
Oooh! How about we play?!
fields.JP:
うん！　だれかいないかなーっておもったの！
ねーねー、あそぼー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came look for everyone!
Oooh! How about we play?!

fields.EN:
Why I'd be delighted.
Oh, but let me first finish my...
Hm?
fields.JP:
いいですわよ。
でも、これを食べ終わってから……あら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why I'd be delighted.
Oh, but let me first finish my...
Hm?

fields.EN:
That's strange... My meal is gone.
I was going to finish off the main
course...
fields.JP:
おかしいですわね。残しておいた
おかずがなくなっていますわ。
最後に食べようと思ってましたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's strange... My meal is gone.
I was going to finish off the main
course...

fields.EN:
Rapu, do you know what happened
to the food that was here?
fields.JP: ラプ、なにか心当たりはありません？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, do you know what happened
to the food that was here?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Uh... Don't know...
Rapunzel eat left over, so...
fields.JP:
えっと、しらない……。
ラプンツェルがたべたのは、
もういらないおかずだったから……その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Don't know...
Rapunzel eat left over, so...

fields.EN:
That would mean my food
disappeared into thin air.
How unusual.
fields.JP:
ということは、わたしのおかずは
消えてしまったということになりますわね。
ふしぎですわねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean my food
disappeared into thin air.
How unusual.

fields.EN:
Are you sure you don't know
anything? You do know that
lying isn't good for you, right?
fields.JP:
ほんとーに、知りませんの？
もしもうそをついたら、
針千本飲ませちゃいますわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure you don't know
anything? You do know that
lying isn't good for you, right?

fields.JP: ふえっ！？　はり、せんぼん……！？

fields.EN:
Cinderella, you can stop teasing
her now.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、脅かすのは
それくらいにしてあげなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, you can stop teasing
her now.

fields.EN:
We saw the whole thing, and we
can tell Rapu-chan didn't mean to do
anything wrong.
fields.JP:
わたしたち一部始終見てたけど、
ラプちゃんに悪気はなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We saw the whole thing, and we
can tell Rappy didn't mean to do
anything wrong.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, you already know that
what you ate was Cinderella's
meal, right?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、自分が食べたおかずは
シンデレラが残しておいたものだって、
もう気づいてるんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, you already know that
what you ate was Cinderella's
meal, right?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry... Rapunzel eat it...
Rapunzel thought that food
no one want...
fields.JP:
……うう、ごめんなさい……。
ラプンツェル、たべちゃった……。
もういらないやつだとおもって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry... Rapunzel eat it...
Rapunzel thought that food
no one want...

fields.EN:
Fine... It was bad of me that
I left my food behind like that.
fields.JP:
はぁ、仕方ありませんわね。
ここに残していったわたしも悪かったですし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine... It was bad of me that
I left my food behind like that.

fields.JP:
まぁ、ちゃんと認めて謝ってくれたん
ですから、それでいいですわ

fields.EN: U-Um... do I have to swallow a thousand needles...?
fields.JP:
あ、あの……。はりせんぼん、
のまなきゃいけない……？

fields.EN: The 'thousand needles' was only a figure of speech. You don't actually have to swallow them.
fields.JP:
針千本というのはただの例えですわ。
飲まなくていいですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only said that to scare you.
There's nothing to worry about.

fields.EN:
R-Really...?
Whew... So good to hear...
fields.JP: ほ、ほんと……？　はー……よかったぁー
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Really...?
Whew... So good to hear...

fields.EN:
Looks like I scared you a bit more
than necessary. I'm sorry, Rapu.
fields.JP:
思ったよりも怖がらせてしまった
みたいですわね。ごめんなさい、ラプ
fields.LOCALIZED:
