fields.EN:
Hello there, Alice-san.
It looks like Jack-san is here, too.
fields.JP:
こんにちは、アリスさん。
ジャックさんもいたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello there, Alice.
It looks like Jack is here, too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Why, hello to you too, Jack.
Oh, and it looks like you've got
the place cleaned up, Alice.
fields.JP:
ああこんにちは、ジャック。
それにしてもアリス、だいぶ荷物も
整理がついたみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why, hello to you too, Jack.
Oh, and it looks like you've got
the place cleaned up, Alice.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm finally starting to
settle into place here.
fields.JP: ええ、ようやく落ちついてきたところ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm finally starting to
settle into place here.

fields.EN: So, is there anything you need?
fields.JP:
それで、ここで暮らすに当たって
何か不自由はないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, is there anything you need?

fields.EN:
If you have any particular needs
or requests, feel free to let us
know.
fields.JP:
足りないものとか設備の要望、
それ以外でも問題抱えてるなら
何でも言ってほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have any particular needs
or requests, feel free to let us
know.

fields.EN:
I'm fine... The facilities here
are actually quite robust.
fields.JP:
足りないものは……ないわ。
設備だって、充分すぎるくらいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine... The facilities here
are actually quite robust.

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, she was in a
cell for a very long time...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……今まで独房エリアに
　ずっといたんだもんな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, she was in a
cell for a very long time...)

fields.EN:
So, no troubles or issues then?
Don't worry. You're free to say
what you want here.
fields.JP:
じゃあ何か問題とかトラブルもないか？
もしも来たばかりでワガママ言えない、
とか遠慮してるなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, no troubles or issues then?
Don't worry. You're free to say
what you want here.

fields.EN:
No, I'm fine, really.
Jack is with me now, and that's
all that matters...
fields.JP:
ううん、本当にないの。
わたしとジャックが生きてる……
それだけで充分なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm fine, really.
Jack is with me now, and that's
all that matters...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack calls me by my name.
Just hearing that is more than
enough for me...
fields.JP:
こうしてジャックがわたしの名前を
呼んでくれる……それだけで満足なの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack calls me by my name.
Just hearing that is more than
enough for me...

fields.EN:
Jack-san may not have ended up like
this if things were different...
fields.JP:
もしかしたらジャックさんはこんな姿に
ならなくて済んだかもしれないんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack may not have ended up like
this if things were different...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Jack-san got himself critically
injured when he tried to save me
during a fall...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは、崖から落ちたわたしを
守るために瀕死になって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack got himself critically
injured when he tried to save me
during a fall...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
That led to his transformation
into a Nightmare...
fields.JP:
それでナイトメアに
なってしまったんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That led to his transformation
into a Nightmare...

fields.EN: I'm sorry we couldn't save him...
fields.JP: 助けられなくて……ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry we couldn't save him...

fields.EN:
Jack-san wouldn't have to be like
this if only I didn't fall!
It's... It's all my fault!
fields.JP:
だってっ……わたしを助けたばっかりに
ジャックさんはこんな姿になって……！
わたしが下になっていればっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack wouldn't have to be like
this if only I didn't fall!
It's... It's all my fault!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Here... You don't need to cry.
fields.JP: ……頭を上げて。もう泣かないで
fields.LOCALIZED: Here... You don't need to cry.

fields.EN:
I don't have any bad feelings
towards you two, Ningyohime-san,
Otsuu-san.
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんのこともおつうさんのことも、
わたし本当に恨んでなんかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have any bad feelings
towards you two, Little Mermaid,
Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
On the contrary, I appreciate
how you brought me back so
that I can be with Jack again.
fields.JP:
むしろ、こうしてまたジャックと
再会させてくれてありがとうって思ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
On the contrary, I appreciate
how you brought me back so
that I can be with Jack again.

fields.EN:
And knowing Jack, he definitely would have
protected you, Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
それにジャックなら
確かに人魚姫さんを守ったと思うから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, thinking how Jack is, he
would have done anything to try
to have saved you.

fields.EN:
So I'm actually proud of
what he did.
fields.JP: むしろ誇らしいくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I'm actually proud of
what he did.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
So please, don't blame yourself.
Jack is here next to me now,
and that's all that matters.
fields.JP:
だからね、そんなに気負わないでほしいの。
ジャックは今こうしてわたしの隣にいる。
それで充分なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please, don't blame yourself.
Jack is here next to me now,
and that's all that matters.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
You're... patting me on my head?
Thank you...
fields.JP: 頭撫でてくれるの……嬉しい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're... patting me on my head?
Thank you...

fields.EN:
Jack, stop making me jealous.
You're acting more like a prince
than me.
fields.JP:
ジャック、おまえ僕に負けないくらい
王子様してるじゃないか
ちょっと妬けるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, stop making me jealous.
You're acting more like a prince
than me.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
J-Jack... Um, I appreciate it, but
you can stop now. I'm getting a
little embarrassed now...
fields.JP:
じゃ、ジャック……
嬉しいけど、そのくらいにして。
少し恥ずかしくなってきたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Jack... Um, I appreciate it, but
you can stop now. I'm getting a
little embarrassed now...

fields.EN:
I have no intention of blaming
anyone, so please, you can stop
apologizing.
fields.JP:
わたしはもう誰かを責めるつもりはないから
だから、これ以上は謝ったりしないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no intention of blaming
anyone, so please, you can stop
apologizing.

fields.EN: Oh, uh... I didn't say that.
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, uh... I didn't say that.

fields.EN: I didn't even hear what you said.
fields.JP: ええ、何も聞こえてないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't even hear what you said.

fields.EN: (But Alice gets so girlish when it comes to Jack...)
fields.JP:
（しかしアリスはジャックのことになると
　すごく乙女だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice is very reliable and puts up a
strong front towards everyone, but...)

fields.EN:
(She is quite the lady in front
of Jack...)
fields.JP:
（普段は凛としていて、
　ホント頼りがいがあるなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She is quite the lady in front
of Jack...)

fields.EN: Alice, do you have a moment?
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice, do you have a moment?

fields.EN:
That's strange...
I'm sure I heard something...
fields.JP: 変だな……中から声はするのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's strange...
I'm sure I heard something...

fields.JP: アリス、聞こえてないのかい？

fields.EN:
Oh well...
Sorry, but I'm coming in.
fields.JP:
……仕方ない、か。
悪いけど、入るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well...
Sorry, but I'm coming in.

fields.EN:
Alice? I brought you your new
lingerie that Kaede got for you.
fields.JP:
アリス、カエデから君の分の
新しい下着もらったから届けに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice? I brought you your new
lingerie that Kaede got for you.

fields.EN:
This cup... No...
How about this one? No...
fields.JP:
このカップも……駄目。
こっちも……駄目だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This cup... No...
How about this one? No...

fields.JP: なにをやってるんだい？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
How are you doing, Jack?
No one answered so I welcomed
myself in...
fields.JP:
やあジャック、元気かい。
声をかけても返事がないから
悪いけど勝手に入らせてもらったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are you doing, Jack?
No one answered so I welcomed
myself in...

fields.JP: それで、アリスは何をしてるんだ……？
ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぎ……がっ……ぶ……
みで…………る……

fields.EN:
She's looking at cups?
That's an accurate description...
fields.JP:
カップを見てる？
うん……見たまんまだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's looking at cups?
That's an accurate description...

fields.EN:
The last two... No...
None of them work...
fields.JP:
残りの２つは……やっぱり駄目ね。
ああもう、どれも使えないじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The last two... No...
None of them work...

fields.EN:
Um, Alice? What's with all
those cups?
fields.JP:
ねえアリス、そのたくさんの
カップはいったいどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Alice? What's with all
those cups?

fields.JP: あっ、やだっ、おつうさん！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
You should at least knock on
the door if you're coming in.
fields.JP:
もう……入ってくるなら
ノックくらいしてくれないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should at least knock on
the door if you're coming in.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but I did, though it
seemed like you couldn't hear
me knocking.
fields.JP:
すまない。何度もしたんだけど、
聞こえてないみたいだったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but I did, though it
seemed like you couldn't hear
me knocking.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't notice.
How embarrassing...
fields.JP:
そ、そうだったの……
ごめんなさい、気づかなくて……
ああもう、恥ずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry... I didn't notice.
How embarrassing...

fields.EN:
So, what are you doing with
those cups?
fields.JP:
それで、カップ
ばかり集めてどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what are you doing with
those cups?

fields.EN:
I think this is because of my
Blood Libido...
fields.JP:
これは血式リビドーのせいなの。
……たぶん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this is because of my
Blood Libido...

fields.EN:
That's good. You must have learned
about it from Itsuki.
fields.JP:
ああ、血式少女の基礎知識、
イツキにちゃんと習ったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good. You must have learned
about it from Itsuki.

fields.EN:
Yes. I'd wondered about it for a long time,
but after hearing Itsuki-san's story, it finally
made sense.
fields.JP:
ええ。前から不思議に思ってはいたけれど、
イツキさんの話を聞いてようやく納得したの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I was curious as to why
I behaved this way, but talking
with him made me understand why.

fields.EN: That this strange urge unique to me comes from being a Blood Maiden, and that it's perfectly natural.
fields.JP:
この自分にしかない不思議な衝動は、
わたしが血式少女だからで、そしてそれは
当たり前のことなんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that Blood Maidens have
unusual urges which is common
among us.

fields.EN:
Right. Behaviors coming from our
Blood Libido is normal to us.
fields.JP:
そうだね。血式リビドーは僕たち
血式少女にとって決して変なことではないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Behaviors coming from our
Blood Libido is normal to us.

fields.JP:
それでね、わたしの
血式リビドーなのだけど……

fields.EN:
It seems like mine is about me
wanting to hold tea parties...
fields.JP:
どうやら『お茶会を開きたい』っていう
衝動らしくて、その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like mine is about me
wanting to hold tea parties...

fields.EN:
And, that's why you have
these cups out?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that's why you have
these cups out?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes... I found a tea set, so
I brought it back with me...
fields.JP:
そ……そうなの……
カップのセットを見つけたから、
つい拾ってきてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes... I found a tea set, so
I brought it back with me...

fields.EN:
At this rate, everyone is going
to assume I'm some kind of
pack rat...
fields.JP:
ああもう、変なモノ拾い集める人だって
思われちゃう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this rate, everyone is going
to assume I'm some kind of
pack rat...

fields.EN:
It'll be fine, Alice. We all have
our own Blood Libido. No one
will make fun of you for it.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよアリス。
僕たちはみんな血式リビドーを持っている。
誰も笑いやしないさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be fine, Alice. We all have
our own Blood Libido. No one
will make fun of you for it.

fields.JP: そ……そうかもしれないけど……

fields.EN:
Don't worry, not a single one of
us will laugh at you about it!
fields.JP:
大丈夫！　笑う奴なんて
僕たちの中には誰もいないさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, not a single one of
us will laugh at you about it!

fields.EN:
(Like, Hameln and Rapunzel bring
things back too, and that isn't
because of their Blood Libido...)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンやラプンツェル辺りは
　リビドーなんて関係なく変なモノを
　拾ってくるからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Like, Hameln and Rapunzel bring
things back too, and that isn't
because of their Blood Libido...)

fields.EN:
(Compared to some of the
others', Alice's Blood Libido
is quite cute.)
fields.JP:
（アリスのリビドーなんて、
　かわいいものさ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Compared to some of the
others', Alice's Blood Libido
is quite cute.)

fields.EN:
I'm rather interested in your tea
party. Do you mind if I join?
fields.JP:
それに僕もお茶会には興味ある。
よかったらいつか同席させてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm rather interested in your tea
party. Do you mind if I join?

fields.EN:
I'm glad to hear that, but the
cups I have here are all broken.
fields.JP:
それは嬉しいのだけど……
でもこのカップのセット、
全部壊れてて使い物にならないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad to hear that, but the
cups I have here are all broken.

fields.EN:
So it seems... This one has a
crack, and this one... the handle
is missing.
fields.JP:
あ、ホントだ。こっちはヒビが入ってるし、
こっちは持ち手が取れちゃってるな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it seems... This one has a
crack, and this one... the handle
is missing.

fields.EN:
Too bad they weren't in great
shape when you found them.
fields.JP: せっかく見つけたのに残念だね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too bad they weren't in great
shape when you found them.

fields.JP: でもね、わたし諦めないわ

fields.EN:
I'm going to find me a set of
teacups if it's the last thing
I'll do...
fields.JP:
いつかまたどこかで
カップのセットを見つけて、
ちゃんと揃えるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to find me a set of
teacups if it's the last thing
I'll do...

fields.EN:
(I can tell Alice is dead
serious...)
fields.JP:
（おお、アリスから
　とてつもないやる気を感じる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can tell Alice is dead
serious...)

fields.EN:
One day, I'll hold the tea party
with Jack beside me...
fields.JP:
だって、いつかジャックと一緒に
お茶会したいもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
One day, I'll hold the tea party
with Jack beside me...

fields.EN: I'll help you where I can.
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll help you where I can.

fields.EN:
I think it's beautiful seeing
someone doing their best
for their love.
fields.JP:
だって好きな人のために頑張るって、
とっても素敵なことだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's beautiful seeing
someone doing their best
for their love.

fields.EN: D-Did you hear what I just said, Otsuu-san?!
fields.JP:
もっ、もしかしておつうさん
今のわたしの独り言聞こえてたの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Did you hear what I just
said?!

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, Jack always
faces up to eat because the
food dribbles from his mouth.)
fields.JP:
（でもジャックって普通に食べると
　こぼしちゃうから、いつも上向いて
　食べてるよなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, Jack always
faces up to eat because the
food dribbles from his mouth.)

fields.EN:
(Which means that he'd have to
look up to drink, too...)
fields.JP:
（ということはお茶を飲んでる間は
　ずっと上を向いて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which means that he'd have to
look up to drink, too...)

fields.EN:
(That's going to be one sight to
see when the day comes where
he enjoys a cup of tea...)
fields.JP:
（駄目だ、シュールな絵面しか
　想像できない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's going to be one sight to
see when the day comes where
he enjoys a cup of tea...)

fields.JP: ちょっとお邪魔するね、アリスさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Nice to see you, Alice.
Must've been a rough day.
fields.JP:
お疲れ様アリス。
今日も色々大変だったろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice to see you, Alice.
Must've been a rough day.

fields.EN:
Not at all. Having a physical and
training are all part of survival
down here.
fields.JP:
いいえ、定期検査も訓練も、
生き抜くために必要なことだもの。
全然大変なんかじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. Having a physical and
training are all part of survival
down here.

fields.EN:
Well, if that was me, then I'd be
completely burned out by now.
fields.JP:
アリスはすごいね。
僕だったらもうヘトヘトだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if that was me, then I'd be
completely burned out by now.

fields.EN:
I am the newest member here, so if
anything, I need to do my best so
that I can catch up to everyone.
fields.JP:
今いる血式少女の中で、
わたしが一番新参者だから。
遅れてる分、頑張らないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am the newest member here, so if
anything, I need to do my best so
that I can catch up to everyone.

fields.EN:
Well then, Alice-san, I have a present for
you for working so hard!
fields.JP:
じゃあ頑張ってるアリスさんに、
わたしからプレゼント！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well then, I have a surprise for a
certain someone doing their
very best!

fields.EN:
We spoke together to see how
we could be of help to you.
fields.JP:
僕が姫に話したんだ。
そしたら姫が何か力になりたいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
We spoke together to see how
we could be of help to you.

fields.EN:
It just so happened we found it in
our previous expedition. There's a
small crack, but it'll work fine!
fields.JP:
この前独房エリアに調査に行った時にね、
ちょうど見つけたの。少し壊れてるけど、
まだ使えるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just so happened we found it in
our previous expedition. There's a
small crack, but it'll work fine!

fields.EN:
Oh, but... we did find it, and it
is cracked, so if it doesn't work
then...
fields.JP:
でもその……拾ってきたものだし、
少し壊れてるから逆に迷惑だったら
申し訳ないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but... we did find it, and it
is cracked, so if it doesn't work
then...

fields.EN:
Oh no! Not at all!
I couldn't be happier!
fields.JP:
ううん！　そんなことないわ！
とっても嬉しいっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! Not at all!
I couldn't be happier!

fields.JP: ありがとう、人魚姫さん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
You're welcome.
Heh, I'm glad you like it.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして。
ふふ、喜んでくれてよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're welcome.
Heh, I'm glad you like it.

fields.EN:
(Look at her carefully holding the
cup... She must be happy.)
fields.JP:
（掲げてみたりして、
　アリス本当に嬉しそうだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at her carefully holding the
cup... She must be happy.)

fields.EN:
I haven't had such a wonderful
present like this in ages.
fields.JP:
こんなに嬉しいプレゼントは
久しぶりだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't had such a wonderful
present like this in ages.

fields.EN:
What was the last present you
got that you really liked?
fields.JP: 前は何をもらって嬉しかったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was the last present you
got that you really liked?

fields.EN:
You mean your hairpin?
Oh, it must be something very
special to you.
fields.JP:
いつもつけてる髪飾り……
そうか、とても大事な贈り物だったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean your hairpin?
Oh, it must be something very
special to you.

fields.JP:
それをプレゼントしたのって、
もしかして……

fields.EN:
Yes... I got it from Jack quite
a while back.
fields.JP:
ええ……ずっと昔に、
ジャックにもらったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I got it from Jack quite
a while back.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
It's your most precious treasure, isn't it,
Alice-san?
fields.JP: アリスさんの、一番大事な宝物だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must be the most precious thing
in the world to you.

fields.EN:
Yes... I never want to take it
off me.
fields.JP:
ええ。これだけは絶対になくしたくないし、
いつもつけていたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I never want to take it
off me.

fields.EN:
I can tell... the way your hand touches the
hair ornament is so gentle, Alice-san...
fields.JP:
分かるよ……髪飾りに触るアリスさんの手、
とても優しいもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can tell it's precious from
looking at the way you carefully
handle it.

fields.EN:
I used to live in a village long
ago, where I was feared...
fields.JP:
……昔、わたし人間の集落にいたんだけど、
ある時から迫害されるようになっちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I used to live in a village long
ago, where I was feared...

fields.EN:
They said that the color of
my eyes were strange...
fields.JP: 瞳の色がおかしい、って言われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said that the color of
my eyes were strange...

fields.EN:
(She must be referring to how
the Blood Maiden's eyes can
change color...)
fields.JP: （血式少女特有の、瞳の色の変化……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must be referring to how
the Blood Maiden's eyes can
change color...)

fields.EN: I know now that it was because I'm a Blood Maiden. But back then I knew nothing. And none of the adults protected me...
fields.JP:
今ならそれが血式少女だからって分かる。
でもその時の自分は何も知らなかった。
そして大人は誰も守ってくれなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know now that this is unique to
Blood Maidens, but back then no
one knew or cared...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
I was harassed and shunned...
It didn't take long for me to
distance myself from others.
fields.JP:
いじめられたり、避けられたり……
わたしは段々と心を閉ざしていったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was harassed and shunned...
It didn't take long for me to
distance myself from others.

fields.EN: Of course, some people did treat me decently. But only as far as they could without becoming targets themselves.
fields.JP:
もちろんまともに接してくれる人も
中にはいたわ。でもそれはあくまで
自分に飛び火しない程度の接し方だったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, some treated me like any
other, but that was only because
they didn't want to look bad...

fields.EN:
I made sure I stayed away from
everyone, and lost any interest in
associating with others...
fields.JP:
だからわたしは心を閉ざしたの。
もう誰にも開くつもりはなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I made sure I stayed away from
everyone, and lost any interest in
associating with others...

fields.EN:
(I can't imagine how horrible of a
life she went through as a child.)
fields.JP:
（子供ながらにそこまで
　決意させるほどに劣悪な環境って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't imagine how horrible of a
life she went through as a child.)

fields.EN:
Through all that, only one person
genuinely cared about me.
fields.JP:
そんな中、たった１人だけが
わたしに構ってくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Through all that, only one person
genuinely cared about me.

fields.EN:
I would keep shooing him off,
but he would never give up.
fields.JP:
何度も何度も『あっち行って』って
言ってるのに、その男の子は全然、
これっぽっちも諦めてくれなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would keep shooing him off,
but he would never give up.

fields.EN: Even if I ran away, he'd always chase me; even if I hid, he'd always find me. If I got angry, he'd get dejected, but then he'd start following me again...
fields.JP:
逃げても絶対に追いかけてきて、
隠れても絶対に探し出してきて、
怒ったらしょげるけど、またついてきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I moved away, he'd follow. If I
hid, he would find me. I would get
mad, but he would still follow.

fields.EN:
That certain person must have
been pretty persistent.
fields.JP:
意外と押しが強いんですね、
その男の子って
fields.LOCALIZED:
That certain person must have
been pretty persistent.

fields.EN:
Yes, very...
I finally gave up trying to lose
him.
fields.JP:
ええ、とっても強かった。
先に根負けしたのはわたしの方だったもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, very...
I finally gave up trying to lose
him.

fields.EN:
I asked him why he kept
following me, and he said it was
because I looked lonely...
fields.JP:
どうしてわたしについてくるの？
って聞いたら『寂しそうに見えた』って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked him why he kept
following me, and he said it was
because I looked lonely...

fields.EN:
That's when it struck me that
I wasn't feeling lonely like
before...
fields.JP:
わたしその時ようやく思い出したの。
『そういえばわたし、寂しかったんだ』って
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's when it struck me that
I wasn't feeling lonely like
before...

fields.EN: With him constantly following me, I kept running, hiding, and getting angry... until I'd forgotten my loneliness and frustration.
fields.JP:
ずっとつきまとわれて、
逃げて隠れて怒ってるうちに、
寂しさや悔しさなんて忘れてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I forgot that I was supposed to
be lonely and sad because of all
his bugging and following me.

fields.EN:
Then I started to laugh... It was
funny thinking how he reminded me
that I was supposed to be lonely.
fields.JP:
それで、わたし久しぶりに笑ったの。
寂しさを忘れてたわたしを『寂しそう』って
追いかけてきたことが面白くて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I started to laugh... It was
funny thinking how he reminded me
that I was supposed to be lonely.

fields.EN:
I also laughed because I was
happy that someone actually
cared about me...
fields.JP:
……その優しさが嬉しくて。
だからわたし、笑ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also laughed because I was
happy that someone actually
cared about me...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ううん、ないんでもないわジャック

fields.EN:
So you see, it's a special
present from Jack.
fields.JP:
この髪飾りは、そんなジャックが
初めてくれたプレゼントなの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you see, it's a special
present from Jack.

fields.EN: Yup, and I can see why.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, and I can see why.

fields.EN:
You were so cute when you talked about
Jack-san, Alice-san...
fields.JP:
ジャックさんのことを話してるアリスさん、
本当にかわいらしいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were so cute while
talking about it, too.

fields.JP: 見てて微笑ましいよね

fields.EN:
Alice-san in love...
That's so dreamy...
fields.JP:
恋する乙女のアリスさん、
本当に素敵……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice in love...
That's so dreamy...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Wh-Wh-What are you saying?!
I-I'm not cute...
fields.JP:
そそっ、そんなこと……！
かわいくなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Wh-What are you saying?!
I-I'm not cute...

fields.EN: You're very cute when you blush too, Alice-san.
fields.JP:
照れてるアリスさんも
とってもかわいらしいんだよ？
も、もうそれ以上言わないでっ

fields.EN:
B-Back on subject! The cup you gave me,
Ningyohime-san, was the first present in a
long time that made me that happy!
fields.JP:
と、とにかくっ！
人魚姫さんのくれたカップは、
それ以来の嬉しいプレゼントってことなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-Back on subject! So that's the
last present I got that I was
really happy for!

fields.EN:
Thank you, Alice-san.
I'm glad you liked it.
fields.JP:
ありがとうアリスさん。
プレゼントしてよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Alice.
I'm glad you liked it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.JP: うん、僕もとっても嬉しいよ

fields.EN:
(It's good I discussed with
Princess beforehand. Alice is
more pleased than I thought.)
fields.JP:
（想像以上に喜んでくれたなアリス。
　姫に相談してよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's good I discussed with
Princess beforehand. Alice is
more pleased than I thought.)

fields.EN:
Princess, do you mind coming
with me to see Kaede?
fields.JP:
姫、後でカエデの
ところに一緒に行かないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, do you mind coming
with me to see Kaede?

fields.EN:
Sure. Are you going to get
something from her?
fields.JP: いいけど……何か支給品でももらうの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. Are you going to get
something from her?

fields.EN:
I heard Kaede got some sweets,
and she said she could share
some with us.
fields.JP:
実はカエデが密かに
甘いモノを手に入れたらしくって……
少し分けてくれるって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard Kaede got some sweets,
and she said she could share
some with us.

fields.JP:
本当に？
よかったね、おつうちゃん！

fields.EN:
(What...?
Jack's mind is... going out
of control?)
fields.JP:
（これは……
　ジャックの心が乱れてる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What...?
Jack's mind is... going out
of control?)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I'm fine...
We need to go to Alice's room,
now...!
fields.JP:
うん、大丈夫だ……
それより、アリスの部屋に
行かなくちゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine...
We need to go to Alice's room,
now...!

fields.JP: いったい何があったの、アリスさん！

おつうさん、人魚姫さん……
いえ、その……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぎぢぢ……あ゛り゛……ず……
まも…………ぎぎぎるるる……！
ジャック、いったいどうしたんだ！？

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. It's my fault.
I cut my finger from the chipped
cup there...
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、わたしがいけないんです。
わたしが欠けたカップの縁で
指を切ってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. It's my fault.
I cut my finger from the chipped
cup there...

fields.EN:
Jack then started to go on a
rampage...
fields.JP:
そうしたらジャックが突然
暴れ出してしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack then started to go on a
rampage...

fields.JP: アリスさんが傷を負ったから……？

fields.EN:
I would imagine so. Jack seems to
think that the cup attacked Alice.
fields.JP:
……どうやらそうみたいだね。
アリスがカップに傷つけられたと、
ジャックはそう認識してるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would imagine so. Jack seems to
think that the cup attacked Alice.

fields.EN:
So he attacked the cup as an
enemy to protect Alice.
fields.JP:
それで『敵』であるカップを
破壊して、アリスを守ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So he attacked the cup as an
enemy to protect Alice.

fields.EN:
I guess Jack-san is really protective
of Alice...
fields.JP:
ちゃんと見守っているんだね、
ジャックさん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess Jack is really protective
of Alice...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(But Jack hasn't calmed down
a bit...)
fields.JP:
（でもまだジャックの奴、
　興奮したままだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But Jack hasn't calmed down
a bit...)

fields.EN:
(I better tell him everything is
okay now...)
fields.JP:
（早いところ大丈夫だって、
　落ち着けてやらないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better tell him everything is
okay now...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack, it's fine.
No one's going to hurt Alice.
fields.JP:
ジャック、もう大丈夫だ。
アリスを傷つける奴はもういない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, it's fine.
No one's going to hurt Alice.

fields.EN:
See? We're fine...
So just calm down...
fields.JP:
ほら、大丈夫だから……
そうだ、心を落ち着けて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? We're fine...
So just calm down...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

あり……す……ぎぎぎ……
……だい……じょ……ぶぶぶ……？

fields.EN:
Yes, she is. Look.
Alice is safe.
fields.JP: ああ、見てごらん、アリスは無事だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, she is. Look.
Alice is safe.

fields.EN:
I'm safe because of you, Jack.
See?
fields.JP:
ほら、あなたのおかげで
わたしは無事よ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm safe because of you, Jack.
See?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

よがっ……だ……
ぐぎぎぎぎ……

（……よかった。
　ようやく落ちついてくれた……）

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu-san...
If you weren't here, things may
not have settled down...
fields.JP:
ありがとう……おつうさん。
あなたが来てくれなかったら、
もしかしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu...
If you weren't here, things may
not have settled down...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
We just happened to pass by.
Are you hurt elsewhere?
fields.JP:
近くを通りかかった
タイミングでよかったよ。
指先以外に怪我はないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We just happened to pass by.
Are you hurt elsewhere?

fields.JP: ごめんなさい、アリスさん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Because I gave you that chipped cup, you got hurt,
Alice-san...!
fields.JP:
わたしが欠けたカップなんて
プレゼントしたせいで、アリスさんに
怪我をさせちゃって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The teacup I gave you hurt you!
If only I didn't give it to you!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
I even ruined your tea party
you had planned for Jack-san...
fields.JP:
その上ジャックさんのために
用意していた大事なお茶会を、
台無しにしてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I even ruined your tea party
you had planned for Jack...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san
Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
What's the matter?
You don't look well...
fields.JP:
どうしたの……？
結構苦しそうだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?
You don't look well...

fields.JP: いや、ちょっと頭が痛くなって……

fields.EN:
(It must be from the emotional
rush Jack had earlier that's
only now surging through me...)
fields.JP:
（興奮してたジャックの感情が
　波のように一気に押し寄せたからだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must be from the emotional
rush Jack had earlier that's
only now surging through me...)

fields.EN:
That must be painful.
Let me take you to Hikari.
fields.JP:
それは大変ね。
ヒカリのところまで連れて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must be painful.
Let me take you to Hikari.

fields.EN:
Don't worry, Alice-san. I'll take responsibility
for getting Otsuu-chan back to her room so she
can rest.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、アリスさん。
おつうちゃんはわたしが責任もって
部屋に連れてって休ませるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry, Alice. I'll take her
back to her room to rest.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): アリス => Alice-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
I think it's safer to have Jack-san
stay with Otsuu-chan for a while in case
he gets needlessly excited again.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんもまた興奮した時のために、
おつうちゃんのそばにいた方がいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it's safer to have Jack
stay with Otsuu for a while in case
he gets needlessly excited again.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

ぐ……ぎぎ……
わあ゛が……だだだ……

fields.EN:
Then, Alice-san, I'm going now.
I'm really sorry I ruined your tea party...
fields.JP:
じゃあアリスさん、わたし行くね。
お茶会、台無しにしちゃって本当に
ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we'll be going now.
And... I'm really sorry I ruined
your tea party...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, grab onto my shoulders.
Jack-san? Can you follow me?
fields.JP:
ほらおつうちゃん、
わたしの肩に寄りかかって。
ジャックさんもついてきてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, grab onto my shoulders.
Jack? Can you follow me?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
That's unusual to hear Alice
wanting to see us.
fields.JP:
珍しいな、アリスの方から
呼び出してくるのって
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's unusual to hear Alice
wanting to see us.

fields.EN:
I think this may actually be the
first time she's asked us to come.
fields.JP:
確かに……もしかしたら
初めてかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this may actually be the
first time she's asked us to come.

fields.EN:
She did mention to bring Jack
along, too. Maybe she has
something to discuss.
fields.JP:
ジャックを連れてきてとも
言ってたから……何かの相談かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She did mention to bring Jack
along, too. Maybe she has
something to discuss.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

あ゛り゛ず……あ゛り゛ず……
ぐぎぎ……あ゛り゛ずの゛……べや゛……

fields.EN:
Jack-san seems happy about us
going to see Alice-san.
fields.JP:
アリスさんに会えるからだよね、
ジャックさん嬉しそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack seems happy about us
going to see Alice.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
His happy feelings are flowing
through me as I speak.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックの奴、
すごい喜びの感情で溢れてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
His happy feelings are flowing
through me as I speak.

fields.EN:
Heh, no need to fret.
Alice is beyond the door here.
fields.JP:
はは、慌てなくてもアリスは
このドアの向こうにいるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, no need to fret.
Alice is beyond the door here.

fields.EN:
It's me, Tsuu.
I'm coming in, Alice.
fields.JP:
僕だ、つうだ。
アリス、入るぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's me, Otsuu.
I'm coming in, Alice.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: いらっしゃいおつうさん、人魚姫さん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I don't have enough teacups,
so I had to improvise a bit.
fields.JP:
まあカップは足りないし、
色々強引に仕上げたものだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have enough teacups,
so I had to improvise a bit.

fields.EN:
Well, I think this is a beautiful
set-up you have here!
fields.JP:
ううん、そんなことない！
とっても素敵なセッティングだと思う！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I think this is a beautiful
set-up you have here!

fields.EN:
(Sure she's using bowls and other
items to cover the lack of cups,
but...)
fields.JP:
（確かにカップ足りなくて
　茶碗とかで代用しちゃってるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sure she's using bowls and other
items to cover the lack of cups,
but...)

fields.EN:
(That's not what's important.
What's important is that she's
finally holding a tea party.)
fields.JP:
（でも問題はそこじゃない。
　お茶会を開く、それが大事なんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's not what's important.
What's important is that she's
finally holding a tea party.)

fields.EN:
Looks like your dream came true.
Kudos to getting it all set up.
fields.JP:
自分から叶えたね、アリス。
さすがの行動力だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like your dream came true.
Kudos to getting it all set up.

fields.JP: ジャックさんも嬉しそう
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Jack, don't you go off like that
before. You don't want to waste
what Alice set up, do you?
fields.JP:
ジャック、今度は取り乱したりするなよ？
せっかくアリスが準備してくれたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, don't you go off like that
before. You don't want to waste
what Alice set up, do you?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Okay, I guess we'll take our
leave now.
fields.JP: じゃあ僕たちはこれで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, I guess we'll take our
leave now.

fields.EN:
Let us know how it went,
okay, Alice-san?
fields.JP: 後で感想聞かせてね、アリスさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let us know how it went,
okay, Alice?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
We brought Jack here like you
wanted. If there's anything else
we can help with, let us know.
fields.JP:
ちゃんとジャックは連れてきたし……
まだ何か手伝うことあるなら、するけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We brought Jack here like you
wanted. If there's anything else
we can help with, let us know.

fields.EN:
But if we stay, you won't be able to start your tea
party with Jack-san, Alice-san...
fields.JP:
でもわたしたちがいたら、アリスさんは
ジャックさんとお茶会が始められないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, us staying here is only
going to get in the way of your
and Jack's tea party.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Look at the table. There are places for Otsuu-san
and Ningyohime-san too.
fields.JP:
ちゃんとテーブルを見て。
おつうさんと人魚姫さんの分もあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at the set-up.
I have it set ready for you and
Otsuu.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Huh? But wasn't the tea party
supposed to be for you and
Jack?
fields.JP:
えっ、だってお茶会は
アリスとジャックだけの時間じゃあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But wasn't the tea party
supposed to be for you and
Jack?

fields.EN:
I mean, we're more than happy
to join, but are you sure we
won't get in your way?
fields.JP:
誘いは素直に嬉しいけど……
でもいいの？　邪魔にならないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, we're more than happy
to join, but are you sure we
won't get in your way?

fields.EN:
Don't worry.
You're more than welcome to join.
fields.JP:
もう……２人とも気を遣いすぎよ……
邪魔なわけないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry.
You're more than welcome to join.

fields.EN: I wanted to prepare everything with Jack and then invite you two... I wanted the four of us to have a tea party together.
fields.JP:
それにわたしはジャックと一緒に準備して、
そしてあなたたちを呼びたかったのよ？
……４人でお茶会を開きたかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to invite you two after
getting the place set up with
Jack.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about that, Alice.
It didn't dawn on me that
you were doing this for us.
fields.JP:
ごめん、アリス。
君の思いに気づけなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about that, Alice.
It didn't dawn on me that
you were doing this for us.

fields.EN:
I've wanted to thank you both for a long time,
Otsuu-san and Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
……わたしはね、
おつうさんと人魚姫さんに
ずっとお礼がしたかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to show my thanks
to you two...

fields.EN:
You still don't get it, do you?
That applies to you too,
Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
もう……やっぱり分かってないわね。
人魚姫さんも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You still don't get it, do you?
That applies to you too,
Little Mermaid...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Huh? But I haven't done anything for you to
thank me for, Alice-san...
fields.JP:
えっ、だってわたし、
アリスさんにお礼言われるようなこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But, I didn't do anything
deserving of thanks from you...

fields.EN:
Otsuu-san, Ningyohime-san, you both saved
Jack and me.
fields.JP:
おつうさんと人魚姫さんは、
わたしとジャックを救ってくれたじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: You both saved me and Jack.

fields.EN:
Sure, Jack may have saved
Ningyohime-san when you fell...
fields.JP:
崖から落ちる時、ジャックは
人魚姫さんを救ったかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, Jack may have saved
Little Mermaid when you fell...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
But, you brought him back without
turning your back on him. Without
you, he wouldn't be here now.
fields.JP:
でもその後ジャックを見捨てずに、
ちゃんとここまで連れてきてくれた。
ジャックだけでは辿り着けなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, you brought him back without
turning your back on him. Without
you, he wouldn't be here now.

fields.EN:
Well, it was just the right thing
to do...
fields.JP: それは……当然のことをしただけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it was just the right thing
to do...

fields.EN: You also reunited me with Jack.
fields.JP:
そしてわたしをまた
ジャックに引き合わせてくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED: You also reunited me with Jack.

fields.EN:
You can't imagine how much
in debt I am to you...
fields.JP:
わたしがそのことを
どれだけ感謝しているか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't imagine how much
in debt I am to you...

fields.EN:
I didn't know that...
I'm so sorry I didn't notice...
fields.JP:
そう……思ってくれていたんだね……
なのに、わたしったら気づけなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know that...
I'm so sorry I didn't notice...

fields.EN:
(I also thought that all Alice
needed was Jack.)
fields.JP:
（僕も、心のどこかでアリスは
　ジャックさえいればいいのだと思ってた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I also thought that all Alice
needed was Jack.)

fields.EN:
(But this just shows that Alice
cares about everyone else
as her friend, too.)
fields.JP:
（でも僕たちのことも、
　アリスはしっかり仲間だと
　思ってくれてるんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But this just shows that Alice
cares about everyone else
as her friend, too.)

fields.EN:
Sorry we didn't take notice
earlier.
fields.JP:
アリスの感謝の気持ちに
気づけなくてごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry we didn't take notice
earlier.

fields.EN:
Yes, and that's why you didn't
need to apologize to me when
I got hurt, Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
この間カップで怪我した時のことだって、
人魚姫さんが謝る必要はなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and that's why you didn't
need to apologize to me when
I got hurt, Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
But you keep worrying about me,
and put me ahead of yourself...
fields.JP:
なのにずっと……
いつもわたしに気を遣ってくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you keep worrying about me,
and put me ahead of yourself...

fields.EN:
Of course, Jack is precious to me,
but everyone here is precious
to me, too.
fields.JP:
わたしはジャックのことを大切に思ってる。
でもみんなのことも同じように大切なの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, Jack is precious to me,
but everyone here is precious
to me, too.

fields.EN:
Now do you see why I want
to have a tea party with you?
fields.JP: だから、一緒にお茶会しましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now do you see why I want
to have a tea party with you?

fields.JP:
（そうだ、僕たちが勝手に
　アリスという子を誤解してたんだ）

fields.EN:
(She's way more caring than we
thought she was.)
fields.JP:
（こんなにも
　優しい子だっていうのに……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's way more caring than we
thought she was.)

fields.EN:
We would be honored to join
your tea party, Alice.
fields.JP: ぜひ同席させてくれ、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
We would be honored to join
your tea party, Alice.

fields.EN:
No need to be reserved anymore,
you hear?
fields.JP: ……もう遠慮なんてしては駄目よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to be reserved anymore,
you hear?

fields.EN:
Yes, understood.
Now then, let's enjoy your tea
party to its fullest, shall we?
fields.JP:
ああ。もう変な遠慮とかはしない。
だから時間の許す限り、お茶会を楽しもう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, understood.
Now then, let's enjoy your tea
party to its fullest, shall we?

fields.EN:
(The mock battle today was
intense... Hameln needs to learn
to control herself...)
fields.JP:
（今日の模擬戦闘はきつかった……
　まったく、ハーメルンの奴ってば
　容赦ないもんな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The mock battle today was
intense... Hameln needs to learn
to control herself...)

fields.EN:
(Ouch... I better get myself
patched up with Hikari. No telling
what would happen next...)
fields.JP:
（いたたた……ヒカリに湿布
　もらわないと明日が怖いな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ouch... I better get myself
patched up with Hikari. No telling
what would happen next...)

fields.JP:
（……ん？
　あれはアリスと……ジャック？）

fields.EN:
Say, Jack? You understand what
I'm saying, right?
fields.JP:
ねえジャックは……わたしの言葉、
分かってくれてるのよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Jack? You understand what
I'm saying, right?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I thought so. You wouldn't be
here with me if you didn't
understand me.
fields.JP:
ええ、分かってる。何も通じてなかったら、
こんなに一緒にいるなんてできないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought so. You wouldn't be
here with me if you didn't
understand me.

fields.EN:
I'm just happy we can communicate.
It's really nothing short of a
miracle...
fields.JP:
そう、それだけでも奇跡……
本当に嬉しいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just happy we can communicate.
It's really nothing short of a
miracle...

fields.EN:
But, I was hesitant at first...
I wasn't sure you'd understand me
now that you're like that...
fields.JP:
……でもね、実は初めは不安だったの。
ジャックがこのような姿になって……
わたしを分かってくれるかな、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I was hesitant at first...
I wasn't sure you'd understand me
now that you're like that...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I also didn't know Otsuu-san and
Ningyohime-san well...
fields.JP:
それにおつうさんや人魚姫さんも、
どんな人か分からなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also didn't know Otsuu and
Little Mermaid well...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
So, I was anxious the whole
time here...
fields.JP: だからずっと不安だったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I was anxious the whole
time here...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I just happened by
when I overheard you.
fields.JP:
ごめん、たまたま通りかかったら
アリスの言葉が聞こえてしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I just happened by
when I overheard you.

fields.EN:
I want you to be candid...
Are you still anxious?
fields.JP:
……正直に話してほしい。
アリスは今も……不安かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to be candid...
Are you still anxious?

fields.EN:
At first, yes... I was even scared
of possibly being treated badly.
fields.JP:
……最初は、言ったとおり不安だったわ。
もしかしてまた酷い扱いを受けるかもって、
勝手に怯えたりもした
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first, yes... I was even scared
of possibly being treated badly.

fields.EN:
After spending all this time with Otsuu-san,
Ningyohime-san, and everyone else, I know
how kind you all are.
fields.JP:
でも、今日までずっと過ごしてきて、
おつうさんや人魚姫さん、他のみなさん……
みんな優しいんだって分かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after all the time we spent
together, I know for a fact that
everyone here is very kind.

fields.EN:
So if anything, I appreciate
you all being here with me.
fields.JP: だから、今はむしろ感謝しているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if anything, I appreciate
you all being here with me.

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, that's good to hear.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, that's good to hear.

fields.JP: 昔も今もそうなのだけど……

fields.EN:
I sometimes lose track of myself
with how I keep thinking of Jack.
fields.JP:
わたしの中でジャックという存在は
とても大きくて、それだからこそ周りが
見えなくなる時がたまにあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sometimes lose track of myself
with how I keep thinking of Jack.

fields.JP: うん……それは充分理解しているよ

fields.EN:
I would often get out of control
when matters concerning Jack
arose.
fields.JP:
以前はジャックのことになると
すぐに自分を見失っていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would often get out of control
when matters concerning Jack
arose.

fields.EN:
But now you're here, Otsuu-san, along with
Ningyohime-san, who protected Jack...
fields.JP:
でも今は、ジャックを守ってくれた
おつうさんや人魚姫さんがいる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you and Little Mermaid
protected Jack and are here with
us now...
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 人魚姫 => Little Mermaid-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I think that's why I can control
myself better since I know Jack
is in safe hands...
fields.JP:
だから、ジャックのことで何かあっても、
以前より少し冷静で客観的に見られるように
なったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that's why I can control
myself better since I know Jack
is in safe hands...

fields.EN:
Jack is still the most important
person to me, but that also goes
to everyone here.
fields.JP:
もちろん、今もジャックが一番大切。
でも、みんなのこともとても大切なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is still the most important
person to me, but that also goes
to everyone here.

fields.EN:
Well, thanks for placing trust in
us, Alice.
fields.JP:
そうか……
信頼してくれてありがとう、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, thanks for placing trust in
us, Alice.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I-I know you don't have any bad intentions,
Otsuu-san, but...
fields.JP:
お、おつうさんはそんなことないって
分かってはいるのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I know you don't have any bad
intentions, but...

fields.EN:
Um, I sometimes... get jealous of
you, seeing how you can
communicate with Jack.
fields.JP:
その、ジャックと意思疎通ができることに、
たまに、嫉妬しちゃうの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I sometimes... get jealous of
you, seeing how you can
communicate with Jack.

fields.EN:
Jack is a gentleman well deserving
of you. I have another person of
destiny, so don't you worry.
fields.JP:
ジャックはとても頼りになるし
格好いい男の子だけど、僕の想い人は
別にいるから安心して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is a gentleman well deserving
of you. I have another person of
destiny, so don't you worry.

fields.EN:
Oh, I see...
That's good to hear...
fields.JP: そ、そうなのね……よかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see...
That's good to hear...

fields.EN:
You do know that the only person
Jack has his sights on now is
you, right?
fields.JP:
それに、ジャックはアリスのことしか
見えてないよ。それくらいは分かるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You do know that the only person
Jack has his sights on now is
you, right?

fields.JP:
やっぱりそうかしら……？
そう思って……いいのかしら……？

fields.EN:
(She's so cute when it comes to
talking about Jack...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりジャックのことを思ってる時の
　アリスは、とてもかわいらしいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so cute when it comes to
talking about Jack...)

fields.EN:
Yes, you're the only one in
Jack's eyes.
fields.JP: ああ。ジャックはずっとアリスだけを見てる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you're the only one in
Jack's eyes.

fields.EN:
The day will come when you will
understand Jack. Your affection
towards him will make that happen.
fields.JP:
きっといつかアリスにもジャックと
はっきりと意思疎通ができる日が来るよ。
これだけ想いあってるんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The day will come when you will
understand Jack. Your affection
towards him will make that happen.

fields.EN:
I suppose you're right...
I won't give up...!
fields.JP:
そうよね……
……ええ、わたし諦めないわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose you're right...
I won't give up...!

Well, that table looks very
fancy with the tablecloth
draped on it.
fields.JP:
へぇ、テーブルクロスをかけるだけで
だいぶ雰囲気が変わるんだね。ただの
テーブルがいつもよりオシャレに見えるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that table looks very
fancy with the tablecloth
draped on it.

fields.EN:
I like how the fold along the
edges are detailed...
fields.JP: この端っこの布の折り方とか凝ってるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I like how the fold along the
edges are detailed...

fields.EN:
I'm trying to place it perfectly
on the table, so I'd appreciate it
if you don't touch it yet.
fields.JP:
そのテーブルクロスはミリ単位で
計算しつくして整えている最中なの。
まだ完成していないから、今は触らないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm trying to place it perfectly
on the table, so I'd appreciate it
if you don't touch it yet.

fields.EN:
(Perfectly, eh? No wonder she
looked busy.)
fields.JP:
（ミリ単位……。
　さっき真剣な顔してたのは、
　そういうわけだったのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Perfectly, eh? No wonder she
looked busy.)

fields.EN:
It's fun thinking about how you want
to decorate the table. A tablecloth
can make a big difference.
fields.JP:
テーブルクロスはかけ方を変えるだけでも
違う雰囲気になるから、どういう風に
かけようか考えるのも楽しいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fun thinking about how you want
to decorate the table. A tablecloth
can make a big difference.

fields.EN:
One day I'll hold a wonderful tea
party, with everyone sitting
around a large table.
fields.JP:
わたしね、大勢でテーブルを囲むような、
素敵なお茶会パーティを開くのが夢なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
One day I'll hold a wonderful tea
party, with everyone sitting
around a large table.

fields.EN:
I can't wait to get a chance to
set up the table, tea set, and the
decorations to match...
fields.JP:
大きなテーブルに、素敵なティーセット……。
ああ、楽しみだわ。テーブルのセッティングも
どんな風にしようか今から迷っちゃうわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't wait to get a chance to
set up the table, tea set, and the
decorations to match...

fields.EN:
(She looks really happy. It's
almost like seeing a girl getting
dressed for her first date.)
fields.JP:
（本当に楽しみにしてるんだなぁ。
　なんだか初デートの服を選ぶ女の子みたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks really happy. It's
almost like seeing a girl getting
dressed for her first date.)

fields.EN:
I'm sure your tea party will be
wonderful, since you're spending
the time now to plan ahead.
fields.JP:
今のうちにたくさん迷っておけば、
本番もきっと上手にできるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure your tea party will be
wonderful, since you're spending
the time now to plan ahead.

fields.EN:
Thank you. When I finally hold a tea party, I'll
invite you too, Otsuu-san—along with Jack and
everyone else, of course.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。いつかお茶会パーティを
開くときは、おつうさんとジャックも、
他のみんなも、もちろん招待するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. And, when I do hold
the tea party, you, Jack, and
everyone will be my guest.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Sounds like a plan.
I bet it'd be fun with the whole
crew around.
fields.JP:
すごく賑やかになりそうだね。
みんなでわいわいやれたら楽しいだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like a plan.
I bet it'd be fun with the whole
crew around.

fields.EN:
Oh, I would also have to prepare
some sweets to match the tea.
fields.JP:
お茶会パーティにはおいしいお菓子も
用意したいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I would also have to prepare
some sweets to match the tea.

fields.EN:
A fair warning... If you do
prepare sweets, be careful of
Gretel... She'd eat them all up.
fields.JP:
そのときはグレーテルにお菓子を
全部食べられちゃわないように、
気をつけないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
A fair warning... If you do
prepare sweets, be careful of
Gretel... She'd eat them all up.

fields.EN:
Heh, you're right. Of course,
all I would need to do is make
more than everyone's fair share.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そうね。できればお茶もお菓子も、
みんなが満足できるくらい用意できれば
一番いいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh, you're right. Of course,
all I would need to do is make
more than everyone's fair share.

fields.EN:
When the day comes for the tea
party, I'm sure gathering things
will be much easier than now.
fields.JP:
でもお茶会パーティを開けるころには、
今と違って、きっとなんでも
揃えられるでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the day comes for the tea
party, I'm sure gathering things
will be much easier than now.

fields.EN:
(I never thought that old fabric
would be a tablecloth that
would make Alice this happy.)
fields.JP:
（アリスが嬉しそうでよかった。
　ただの古い布だと思ってたけど、
　テーブルクロスの力は侮れないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I never thought that old fabric
would be a tablecloth that
would make Alice this happy.)

fields.EN:
This tablecloth put me one step
closer to attaining my dream.
Thank you...
fields.JP:
このテーブルクロスをもらったおかげで
夢が広がったわ。二人とも、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This tablecloth put me one step
closer to attaining my dream.
Thank you...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Glad you like it. I'll be looking
forward to the day I receive
your invitation to your tea party.
fields.JP:
喜んでもらえてよかった。
いつかみんなとのお茶会パーティに
招待してくれるの、楽しみにしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad you like it. I'll be looking
forward to the day I receive
your invitation to your tea party.

fields.JP: （そういえば、この辺りで前に……）

fields.EN:
This is where I entered Blood
Skelter, right?
fields.JP:
……わたし、前にこの辺りで
ブラッドスケルター化しちゃったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is where I entered Blood
Skelter, right?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry about the trouble
I caused you then...
fields.JP:
あのときはごめんね。
いっぱい迷惑かけて、
いっぱい心配かけちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry about the trouble
I caused you then...

fields.EN:
As long as you're okay, Princess.
Sure I was worried, but you
didn't cause me any trouble.
fields.JP:
姫が無事ならいいんだ。
それに心配はしたけど、
迷惑だなんて少しも思ってないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're okay, Princess.
Sure I was worried, but you
didn't cause me any trouble.

fields.EN:
So you don't have to force
yourself to remember what
happened here...
fields.JP: ……だから、無理に思い出さなくていい
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you don't have to force
yourself to remember what
happened here...

fields.EN:
Okay... But, it is something that
happened, so I need to accept
what happened...
fields.JP:
うん……。でも自分のことなんだから、
ちゃんと向き合わないといけないかなって
思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... But, it is something that
happened, so I need to accept
what happened...

fields.EN:
To be honest, I was about to
enter Blood Skelter long ago
before then...
fields.JP:
実はね、もっと前にも
ブラッドスケルター化しそうに
なったことがあったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
To be honest, I was about to
enter Blood Skelter long ago
before then...

fields.JP: え……っ？　そ、そんなの初耳だけど

fields.EN:
It happened so long ago that
I only remembered it when my
Blood Skelter triggered my memory.
fields.JP:
初めてブラッドスケルター化しちゃって、
その感覚でふと思い出したの。
それに、もうだいぶ前のことだったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It happened so long ago that
I only remembered it when my
Blood Skelter triggered my memory.

fields.EN:
Not that I remember the exact
details, but I think it was before
I met you, Otsuu-chan...
fields.JP:
わたしもはっきりと覚えてる
わけじゃないんだけど、
おつうちゃんと出会う前……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that I remember the exact
details, but I think it was before
I met you, Otsuu...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Back then I was scared and unsure
of the future. It felt similar to
when I enter Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
あのころは心が不安定で、怖くて、
不安でいっぱいだった。ブラッドスケルター化
したときの心の感覚にすごく近かったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back then I was scared and unsure
of the future. It felt similar to
when I enter Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Maybe that's because I was
about to enter Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
あのころは気づかなかったけど、
今思えばブラッドスケルター化
しそうになっていたのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that's because I was
about to enter Blood Skelter...

fields.EN: But you've been fine all this time, right...?
fields.JP:
でも、これまではずっと
大丈夫だったんだよね……？

fields.EN:
Yup. I've never felt that way
since I've met you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
うん。おつうちゃんと出会ってからは、
あんな風になることはなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I've never felt that way
since I've met you, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
It's probably because you're supporting my
heart, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
きっとおつうちゃんがわたしの心を
支えてくれてるからだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's probably because your
existence helps to keep my
mind at ease.

fields.EN:
Not only that, but you always
protect me too, just like how
you did this time.
fields.JP:
心だけじゃないよ。
いつもわたしのこと守ってくれて、ありがとう。
今回も守ってくれたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only that, but you always
protect me too, just like how
you did this time.

fields.EN:
It's only natural that I protect
you, Princess.
fields.JP: 僕が姫をお守りするのは当然のことですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only natural that I protect
you, Princess.

fields.EN:
(Hearing her words is triggering
my memory, too. Maybe...)
fields.JP:
（……だけど、今の姫の話を聞いて
　思い出した。もしかしたら僕も……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hearing her words is triggering
my memory, too. Maybe...)

fields.EN:
Hm? Otsuu-chan?
What's with that face?
fields.JP:
？　おつうちゃん、
なにか難しいこと考えてる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Otsuu?
What's with that face?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I was just thinking that
maybe I was about to enter
Blood Skelter long ago, too.
fields.JP:
ああ、いや……。ひょっとしたら僕も、
すごく、昔……ブラッドスケルター化しそう
だった危機はあったのかもって思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I was just thinking that
maybe I was about to enter
Blood Skelter long ago, too.

fields.EN:
There was a time back then that
reminds me of what it's like
to enter Blood Skelter...
fields.JP:
なんとなく、思い当たるような
心境だったときがあった気がして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There was a time back then that
reminds me of what it's like
to enter Blood Skelter...

fields.JP: そ、そうだったの？　今は？　今は大丈夫？

fields.EN:
I'm fine. I do have you beside me,
after all.
fields.JP: 大丈夫だよ。僕には姫がいたからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. I do have you beside me,
after all.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you will help me in
some way if I ever enter Blood
Skelter.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルター化しそうになっても、
きっとそのときは姫に助けられたんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you will help me in
some way if I ever enter Blood
Skelter.

fields.EN:
(Princess made me who I am
now... Because of her, I'm...)
fields.JP:
（そう。姫が僕の心を
　繋ぎとめてくれていたんだ。
　姫がいてくれたから、僕は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Princess made me who I am
now... Because of her, I'm...)

fields.EN:
Thanks for being with me
back then...
fields.JP: あのとき、一緒にいてくれてありがとう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for being with me
back then...

fields.EN:
(Wait... Back when?
I don't recall anything from back
then...)
fields.JP:
（あのときって、いつだ？
　自然と言葉が出てきたけど、
　思い出そうとしても思い出せない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... Back when?
I don't recall anything from back
then...)

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. Let me rephrase myself.
Thanks for being with me all
the time, Princess.
fields.JP:
ごめん、間違えた。
あのときじゃなく、いつもだったね。
姫がいてくれるのは
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. Let me rephrase myself.
Thanks for being with me all
the time, Princess.

fields.EN:
I'll always stay with you, Otsuu-chan.
I promise.
fields.JP:
わたしはずっとおつうちゃんと
一緒にいるよ。約束するね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know that I will always be
with you. It's a promise.

fields.JP: むぅ。なーんか陰気臭い場所だな
うん、ちょっと不気味だね……

fields.EN:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just stay by my side and all
will be fine.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ、姫。
でも僕から離れないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you worry, Princess.
Just stay by my side and all
will be fine.

fields.EN:
Oho! It's been a while since
I saw someone pass by!
fields.JP: おっ、人が通るなんて久しぶりっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oho! It's been a while since
I saw someone pass by!

fields.EN: C'mon, you can put your arms down.
fields.JP: やだなー、そんな警戒しないでほしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: C'mon, you can put your arms down.

fields.EN:
And, she's got a heck of a load
on her back...
fields.JP:
やたらとでかい荷物を持ってるな。
変な奴だぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, she's got a heck of a load
on her back...

fields.EN:
Are you, by any chance,
a survivor? We need to take you
to safety then.
fields.JP:
こんなところに一人でいるなんて、
まさか生き残りか？
すぐに保護しないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you, by any chance,
a survivor? We need to take you
to safety then.

fields.EN:
Now hold on a second there!
No need to worry. I'm not a
survivor or lost or anything.
fields.JP:
ちょーっと待つっす！
自分は生き残りでも迷子でもないっすから、
保護する必要はないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now hold on a second there!
No need to worry. I'm not a
survivor or lost or anything.

fields.EN:
The name's Clara!
I'm just a traveling merchant
roving about the prison area!
fields.JP:
自分はくらら！
独房エリアを転々とする、
さすらいの放浪商人っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The name's Clara!
I'm just a traveling merchant
roving about the prison area!

fields.EN:
We're going to have to take
you with us by force, then.
fields.JP: よし、保護しよう。無理やりにでも
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to have to take
you with us by force, then.

fields.JP: 捕まえるなら任せておけ！

fields.EN:
Hey! Didn't ya hear me?!
Nobody's forcing me anywhere!
That's what we call an abduction!
fields.JP:
ちょっと人の話聞いてたっすかー！？
無理やり保護って、それただの誘拐っすよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Didn't ya hear me?!
Nobody's forcing me anywhere!
That's what we call an abduction!

fields.EN:
But there's no way you could
travel the prison area at your
age...
fields.JP:
だって信じられないよ。
こんな小さい子なのに、独房エリアを
転々とする放浪商人とか言われても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's no way you could
travel the prison area at your
age...

fields.EN:
Maybe she bonked her head
and is confused now.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら頭でも打って、
精神が錯乱しちゃってるのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she bonked her head
and is confused now.

fields.EN:
Stop looking at me like that.
I'm a full-fledged traveling
merchant, living life on the road.
fields.JP:
そんな憐れみの目で見ないでほしいっす。
こう見えても、自分は放浪商人として
しっかり自立した生活してるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop looking at me like that.
I'm a full-fledged traveling
merchant, living life on the road.

fields.EN:
So, what's this about you being
a traveling merchant?
fields.JP: なぁ、その、ほーろー商人とはなんなのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what's this about you being
a traveling merchant?

fields.EN:
Heh heh, glad you asked!
I make a living selling loot that
I find in the prison area.
fields.JP:
ふふ、よくぞ聞いてくれたっす！
自分は独房エリアで拾った素敵アイテムや
ガラクタを売って生業にしてるんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh heh, glad you asked!
I make a living selling loot that
I find in the prison area.

fields.EN:
You'd be surprised with the kind of
goodies you can find! Not a bad
business, really.
fields.JP:
探せばけっこうなお宝も落ちてるんで、
案外、悪い商売じゃないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'd be surprised with the kind of
goodies you can find! Not a bad
business, really.

fields.EN:
Well duh... But, it's not like
I got a choice.
fields.JP:
危ないっちゃ危ないっすね。
でも他に生きる術もないし、仕方ないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well duh... But, it's not like
I got a choice.

fields.EN:
Then again, I can run fast,
and I got great mojo,
so I'm doing just fine.
fields.JP:
まぁ、逃げ足の速さと運の強さには
自信あるんで、大丈夫っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, I can run fast,
and I got great mojo,
so I'm doing just fine.

fields.EN:
But it's still tough living on
your own. You should really
come with us...
fields.JP:
だけどやっぱり、一人で生活する
なんて大変じゃない？
わたしたちと一緒に来たほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's still tough living on
your own. You should really
come with us...

fields.EN:
Nah, this is just how I live.
I'm not the type to get myself
corralled with the others.
fields.JP:
いやー、自分は一人で好きに
やってるほうが性に合ってるっすよ。
集団生活には向かないんっすよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nah, this is just how I live.
I'm not the type to get myself
corralled with the others.

fields.EN:
But, I appreciate the thought.
It's good to know there are caring
people out in this dank world.
fields.JP:
でも、心配してくれてありがとうっす。
殺伐とした暮らしをしてるんで、
人情が身に染みるっすねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I appreciate the thought.
It's good to know there are caring
people out in this dank world.

fields.EN: So, what are you selling now?
fields.JP: それで、どんなものを売っているのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what are you selling now?

fields.EN:
Yikes, um... I'm all out today.
Maybe next time. I usually got a
ton of stuff to choose from.
fields.JP:
あー、今日はもう売り物がないんっすよ。
でもなにかご入り用のときは言って
くださいっす。たいていの物は揃えるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yikes, um... I'm all out today.
Maybe next time. I usually got a
ton of stuff to choose from.

fields.EN:
Great to have met you folks,
and good luck to ya!
fields.JP: ではでは、今後ともご贔屓くださいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great to have met you folks,
and good luck to ya!

fields.EN:
She sure is bold despite her
young age! A true professional!
fields.JP:
幼いのになかなか肝が据わった奴だったな！
あれぞプロの商売人だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She sure is bold despite her
young age! A true professional!

fields.EN:
It's still dangerous for her to
wander around the prison area
by herself...
fields.JP:
だけど、独房エリアを一人で
うろつくなんて危険だなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's still dangerous for her to
wander around the prison area
by herself...

fields.EN:
Then again, she seems to be
doing fine, so maybe we will
see her again.
fields.JP:
そんなことをして生き残れてるなんて、
すごい子だね。また会えるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, she seems to be
doing fine, so maybe we will
see her again.

fields.EN:
I have a feeling we'll see her
more often than not...
fields.JP:
なんとなく、これからちょいちょい
会うことになる気がするな。
……なんとなくだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a feeling we'll see her
more often than not...

fields.EN:
Mamoru! There you go again!
What were you going to do if
something happened?!
fields.JP:
もう！　マモルはいつも勝手なことして！
何かあったらどうするの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru! There you go again!
What were you going to do if
something happened?!

fields.EN:
My job is to find out what's
happening, you know?
fields.JP:
その何かあるかどうかを
確かめるのが俺の仕事だろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My job is to find out what's
happening, you know?

fields.EN:
C'mon, cut me some slack, will
you? All is well that ends well.
fields.JP:
何もなかったんだからいいじゃねぇか。
本日も異常なしってわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, cut me some slack, will
you? All is well that ends well.

fields.EN:
Oh no you don't!
You shouldn't be stepping outside
by yourself! It's dangerous!
fields.JP:
そういうことを言ってるんじゃないの！
一人で外に出るなんて危ないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no you don't!
You shouldn't be stepping outside
by yourself! It's dangerous!

fields.EN:
Isn't that... Mamoru and Hikari?
They look like they're arguing...
fields.JP:
あれって……マモルとヒカリか。
なにを言い争ってるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't that... Mamoru and Hikari?
They look like they're arguing...

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what they're arguing
about, but we should stop them!
fields.JP:
分からないけど、
ケンカしてるなら止めないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what they're arguing
about, but we should stop them!

fields.EN:
I don't know what's going on,
but please stop with the fighting!
fields.JP:
何があったのかは知らないけど、
喧嘩はやめてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what's going on,
but please stop with the fighting!

fields.JP: ああん？　ケンカだと？
二人はケンカしてたんじゃないのか？

fields.EN: Huh? What made you think that?!
fields.JP: ええっ！？　し、してないよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What made you think that?!

fields.JP: でも、さっきまで言い争いを……
あれは別にケンカしてたわけじゃねぇよ

fields.EN: Um, did I jump the gun?
fields.JP: じゃあ、わたしの勘違い……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, did I jump the gun?

fields.EN:
Sorry. It looks like we scared
you there. But don't worry. We're
always like this.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、心配させちゃったみたい。
でも、私たちいつもこんな感じだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. It looks like we scared
you there. But don't worry. We're
always like this.

fields.EN:
I guess it just means you two know
each other too well... So, how
long have you known each other?
fields.JP:
なるほど。気の置けない間柄というわけだ。
ずいぶん長い付き合いみたいだけど、
どれくらいなんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess it just means you two know
each other too well... So, how
long have you known each other?

fields.EN:
How long? I dunno... It's been
ever since we were little.
fields.JP:
どれくらいって言われてもな……
もうずっと小さいころからの付き合いだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
How long? I dunno... It's been
ever since we were little.

fields.EN:
Yeah...
By the time we knew it, we were
hanging around each other.
fields.JP:
そうだねー。
物心ついたころにはもう一緒にいたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah...
By the time we knew it, we were
hanging around each other.

fields.EN: We used to live close by, too.
fields.LOCALIZED: We used to live close by, too.

fields.EN:
We lived our lives together ever
since our parents were abducted
by the Marchens.
fields.JP:
それで、両親がメルヒェンに攫われた後も、
ずっと二人で力を合わせて
生きてきたんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We lived our lives together ever
since our parents were abducted
by the Marchens.

fields.EN:
Uh, but I didn't have much trouble
living since Mamoru was in
charge of the food.
fields.JP:
あ、でも、マモルがいたから食べ物で
苦労したことはあまりなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, but I didn't have much trouble
living since Mamoru was in
charge of the food.

fields.EN:
He's got a knack for finding food,
for better and for worse...
fields.JP:
マモルって食べ物のこととなると、
ものすごい力を発揮するから
良い意味でも悪い意味でも
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's got a knack for finding food,
for better and for worse...

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: 良い意味でも悪い意味でも？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Uh... Sometimes he'd steal veggies
from someone's crop...
fields.JP: えっと、畑から野菜盗んできたり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... Sometimes he'd steal veggies
from someone's crop...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Only sometimes!
I paid back my dues then with
hard labor!
fields.JP:
た、たまにだよ！
その分、ちゃんと力仕事で返したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Only sometimes!
I paid back my dues then with
hard labor!

fields.EN:
Unbelievable...
I guess you haven't changed much
since you were a kid.
fields.JP:
やれやれ……
君は子供の頃からあまり変わらないようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unbelievable...
I guess you haven't changed much
since you were a kid.

fields.EN:
That said, I was only able to
survive because Mamoru made
sure there was food on the table.
fields.JP:
でも、そうやってマモルが食べ物を持って
きてくれたから、私は生きてこられたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I was only able to
survive because Mamoru made
sure there was food on the table.

fields.EN:
To add, I ate the food he took,
so that makes me his cohort
in crime.
fields.JP: それに私も食べてるから同罪だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
To add, I ate the food he took,
so that makes me his cohort
in crime.

fields.EN:
Hikari's a weird one...
She's gullible and cries a lot.
fields.JP:
ヒカリはガキの頃からどっか抜けてんだよ
お人好しだし、すぐ泣くし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari's a weird one...
She's gullible and cries a lot.

fields.EN:
That's why I have to stay next
to her, so that I can protect her
from her own actions.
fields.JP:
ほっとくのも危なっかしいからよ、
俺がいつでも側にいて守ってやるって
そう決めてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I have to stay next
to her, so that I can protect her
from her own actions.

fields.EN:
I see why you two get along so
well now.
fields.JP: そっか……素敵な幼馴染みなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see why you two get along so
well now.

fields.EN:
That would mean Hikari is
Mamoru's princess.
fields.JP:
なるほど、ヒカリはマモルにとっての
お姫様というわけか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would mean Hikari is
Mamoru's princess.

fields.JP: べ、別にそんなんじゃねぇよ！

fields.EN:
She's no princess, that's for
sure. Back when we were kids, we
took a bath together and she...
fields.JP:
それに、こいつは姫っていうガラじゃねぇし。
小さい頃も風呂に一緒に入ってる時に、
こいつがドジったことがあってな――
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's no princess, that's for
sure. Back when we were kids, we
took a bath together and she...

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Don't try to tell Otsuu-kun and the
others something like that! You idiot!
fields.JP:
ちょっ！？　そんなこと、
おつうくん達に話そうとするなー！
このバカー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! What in the world are
you saying! Stop it, dummy!

fields.EN: Ouch! What the hell is that for?!
fields.JP: 痛ぇ！？　なにしやがる！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ouch! What the hell is that for?!

fields.EN:
You should really listen to what
you're saying! You dummy!
fields.JP:
マモルが変な事言おうとするからでしょ！？
バカバカバカーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should really listen to what
you're saying! You dummy!

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Stop! Ouch!
Now put that down...!
I'm gonna die!
fields.JP:
こら、やめろ！　いだっ！？
つーか、それはマズいだろ！？
本気で死ぬ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Stop! Ouch!
Now put that down...!
I'm gonna die!

fields.EN:
I thought you appreciated me being
around?!
fields.JP: おまえ俺に感謝してたんじゃないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you appreciated me being
around?!

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean you can
blab about our past like that!
fields.JP: それとこれとは話が別ですー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean you can
blab about our past like that!

fields.EN: They really do go well together.
fields.JP: 二人はとっても仲良しなんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: They really do go well together.

fields.EN:
They may fight a lot, but I guess
that proves they're that close to
each other.
fields.JP:
ケンカするほど……って言うけど、
なるほど、こういう間柄のことを言うんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
They may fight a lot, but I guess
that proves they're that close to
each other.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm? What's that in your hand,
Jack?
fields.JP: あれ。ジャック、なにを持ってるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's that in your hand,
Jack?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
A square wooden case with
tools inside? What's this for?
fields.JP:
……ふーむ。四角い木製ケースの中に、
細かい道具がたくさん入ってるな。
なにに使うんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A square wooden case with
tools inside? What's this for?

fields.EN:
It's pretty old, too...
If it was clean then we could've
given just the case to Princess.
fields.JP:
しかもすごいボロボロだし。
もう少しきれいなら、ケースだけでも
姫へのお土産にできたんだけどなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's pretty old, too...
If it was clean then we could've
given just the case to Princess.

fields.EN:
Well, not that we can use it.
Jack, do you mind putting it back
where you found it?
fields.JP:
まぁ、なんにせよ僕達には必要ないものか。
ジャック、落ちてた場所に戻しておいてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, not that we can use it.
Jack, do you mind putting it back
where you found it?

fields.EN:
Oh, Hameln, what's with that
look on your face?
fields.JP:
あ、ハーメルン。
そんな顔して、どうかしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Hameln, what's with that
look on your face?

fields.EN:
W-Wait... Is that... a set of
manga drawing pens...?
fields.JP:
そ、それは……っ、
マンガ描きセットではないか……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait... Is that... a set of
manga drawing pens...?

fields.JP: え、これ？　このボロボロのやつ？

fields.EN:
I'm sure that's the holy grail of
manga drawing... A set of special
pens. Where did you...?!
fields.JP:
そうだ。それは聖なる書物・マンガを
描くための道具一式のセットだ。
いったいそれをどうしたのだ……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure that's the holy grail of
manga drawing... A set of special
pens. Where did you...?!

fields.EN:
Oh, I found it near here.
Um, you want this?
fields.JP:
この近くに落ちてたんだ。
……えーと、欲しいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I found it near here.
Um, you want this?

fields.EN:
O-Okay...
Jack, do you mind handing it
to Hameln?
fields.JP:
わ、わかったよ。
ジャック、それをハーメルンに渡してあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay...
Jack, do you mind handing it
to Hameln?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
おおっ、ありがとう！　ありがとう！！

fields.EN:
Of course I am! I can finally draw
manga with this! What kind of
masterpiece will be born?!
fields.JP:
当たり前だ！　これさえあれば、
ワレにもマンガが描けるのだ！
ああっ、どんな名作が生まれるのだろう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I am! I can finally draw
manga with this! What kind of
masterpiece will be born?!

fields.EN:
Otsuu! Jack! Thank you fyor
giving theym to me! I will show
you my manga as soon as I'm donye!
fields.JP:
おつう、ジャック、これをゆじゅってくれて
ありがとう！　礼に、ワレがマンガを描いたら
真っ先に見しぇてやるからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Jack! Thank you fyor
giving theym to me! I will show
you my manga as soon as I'm donye!

fields.EN:
Urrh...! I can already feel my
creativity bubbling from inside
me!
fields.JP:
ぬおおおおっ、さっそく
そーさく意欲が燃えてきたぞおおぉ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...! I can already feel my
creativity bubbling from inside
me!

fields.JP: ひゃっほおおおおおぉっ！！

fields.EN:
I didn't expect her to be that
happy...
fields.JP:
……あんなに喜んでもらえるとは
思わなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect her to be that
happy...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
I didn't know she had that side
to her. I can't wait to see what
she'll create.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンにあんな一面があるなんて
意外だったなぁ。どんなマンガを見せて
くれるのか楽しみにしていようっと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know she had that side
to her. I can't wait to see what
she'll create.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: タクミさん => Takumi-san

fields.EN:
Please... Please...
Is anyone there? H-Help...
fields.JP:
誰かー……誰かいーなーいーのー……
ああ……助け……て……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please... Please...
Is anyone there? H-Help...

fields.JP:
タクミ大丈夫か……
って、なんだこれは……！？
機械の部品がいっぱい……

fields.EN: Is that you, Otsuu-chan? Ningyo-chan? P-Please... help...
fields.JP:
その声はおつうちゃんに人魚ちゃん……？
お願い、助けてぇ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that you, Otsuu? Little
Mermaid? P-Please... help...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Wait a minute... Don't tell me
you're buried under these parts?!
fields.JP:
助けてって……まさか、
この部品の山の下敷きになってるのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute... Don't tell me
you're buried under these parts?!

fields.EN:
Y-Yes...
I can't get them off...
fields.JP:
そうなのよー
重くて仕方ないのよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes...
I can't get them off...

fields.EN:
Oh no! We need to hurry
and get him out of there!
fields.JP: 大変！　急いで助けないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! We need to hurry
and get him out of there!

fields.EN: Whew, I thought I was going to die. Thanks, both of you.
fields.JP:
いやー、死ぬかと思った
ありがとねー二人とも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whew... I thought I was a goner.
Thanks!

fields.EN:
You're very welcome.
I'm just glad you weren't hurt.
fields.JP:
どういたしまして。
怪我がなくてよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're very welcome.
I'm just glad you weren't hurt.

fields.EN: Yes... and you owe us one.
fields.JP: まったく……貸し一つだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes... and you owe us one.

fields.EN:
So, how'd you get under there
anyway?
fields.JP: で、なんであんなところに埋まってたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, how'd you get under there
anyway?

fields.EN:
Ya see, I was dismantling a train,
and the pile of parts I took apart
sort of fell on top of me.
fields.JP:
いやさいやさ、電車一機を分解してて
部品をそのまま周りに積んでたら、
そのうち崩れてきちゃってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya see, I was dismantling a train,
and the pile of parts I took apart
sort of fell on top of me.

fields.EN:
And, that's why you were stuck
under all those parts?
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, that's why you were stuck
under all those parts?

fields.EN:
Yup. I really have to pay more
attention to my surroundings,
especially when I'm focused.
fields.JP:
そういうこと。
いやー、夢中になるとどうも周りが
見えなくなっちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I really have to pay more
attention to my surroundings,
especially when I'm focused.

fields.EN:
Yes, you better be careful
next time.
fields.JP: もう、気をつけないとダメですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you better be careful
next time.

fields.JP: 次からは気をつけるぜ

fields.EN:
Um, so why were you dismantling
a train in the first place?
fields.JP: それにしても、何で電車を分解してたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, so why were you dismantling
a train in the first place?

fields.EN:
Huh? Cuz I like to, that's why.
Of course, it's also because we
can reuse some of them parts.
fields.JP:
んー？　そりゃ好きだからだよ
一応部品の再利用って理由もあるけど、
やっぱり一番の理由は好きだからだねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Cuz I like to, that's why.
Of course, it's also because we
can reuse some of them parts.

fields.JP: 好きって……分解するのが？

fields.EN:
You got it! I liked taking things
apart from long ago. Used to
dismantle all sorts of stuff.
fields.JP:
そうそう。
昔っから物を分解するのが好きでねー
片っ端から色んなものを分解してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got it! I liked taking things
apart from long ago. Used to
dismantle all sorts of stuff.

fields.EN:
That's something I'll probably
never understand...
fields.JP: 正直、僕にはよく分からない趣味だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's something I'll probably
never understand...

fields.EN:
I don't blame ya, and I don't
expect anyone to understand, too.
fields.JP:
そりゃそうでしょうね
私も分かってもらおうとは特に思ってないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't blame ya, and I don't
expect anyone to understand, too.

fields.EN:
Oh yeah, and you know how
I talk all weird and stuff, right?
Comes from dismantling, too.
fields.JP:
ちなみに、オイラのこの喋り方も
いろいろ分解してたらこうなったんやで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh yeah, and you know how
I talk all weird and stuff, right?
Comes from dismantling, too.

fields.EN:
Uh, you mean you took
different speech styles and
put them together to use?
fields.JP:
それって、バラバラになって
元に戻らなくなったってことか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you mean you took
different speech styles and
put them together to use?

fields.EN:
Bingo! Ya know, by the time
I knew it, I couldn't remember
how I used to speak before.
fields.JP:
そのとーり！
いろいろ試してたら、元のしゃべり方が
分からなくなっちゃってねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bingo! Ya know, by the time
I knew it, I couldn't remember
how I used to speak before.

fields.EN:
That's... interesting.
I guess that may happen...
fields.JP:
すごいです……
そういうことってあるんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's... interesting.
I guess that may happen...

fields.EN:
Don't be serious, Princess.
All it is, is that he's a weirdo.
fields.JP:
姫、真面目に聞いちゃダメだ。
要するに、変人なんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be serious, Princess.
All it is, is that he's a weirdo.

fields.EN:
Weirdo? Oh my, you're gonna
make me tear here! Boo-hoo!
fields.JP:
変人って……ひどいわー
私泣いちゃう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Weirdo? Oh my, you're gonna
make me tear here! Boo-hoo!

fields.EN:
See? He's just enjoying playing
out different styles of speeches.
fields.JP:
ほらね、自分でも楽しんでるんだよ
このキャラクターを
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? He's just enjoying playing
out different styles of speeches.

fields.EN:
Nah, I've still got a long way to go.
I'm no match for you, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
いやいやー俺なんてまだまだ、
おつうちゃんには負けますぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon now, I'm not as good
as how ya speak to Princess.

fields.EN:
Like, you speak and act like
some kinda prince in front of
her.
fields.JP:
なにせ、好きな相手のために、
王子様になりきってるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, you speak and act like
some kinda prince in front of
her.

fields.EN:
Please don't make it sound like
we're the same...
fields.JP: 君の性癖と一緒にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't make it sound like
we're the same...

fields.EN:
My motivation is love. My love
towards my dear princess brings
out the prince in me.
fields.JP:
姫が姫であるがゆえに、
僕もまた王子様であらねばならない
それはすなわち愛なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My motivation is love. My love
towards my dear princess brings
out the prince in me.

fields.JP:
あの、おつうちゃん……
ちょっと恥ずかしいよ……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Yup, yup! I definitely feel a kinship with you,
Otsuu-chan. As fellow weirdos, that is.
fields.JP:
うんうん、やっぱりおつうちゃんには、
シンパシーを感じるな。変人仲間として
