You use it to cover a table with.
It's an essential piece to
have a tea party.

fields.EN:
The way it's draped can make a
huge difference with how the tea
party will fare.
fields.JP:
テーブルクロスのかけ方にもいろいろあって、
お茶会を盛り上げる影の立役者と言っても
過言ではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The way it's draped can make a
huge difference with how the tea
party will fare.

fields.JP: （アリス、だんだん熱が入ってきてる……）

fields.EN:
This is no ordinary cloth, that's
for sure! It's very precious!
fields.JP:
そういうわけで、この布は
ただの古い布じゃないわ。
とても価値のある物なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is no ordinary cloth, that's
for sure! It's very precious!

fields.EN:
If you don't have any use for
it, do you mind if I have it instead?
fields.JP:
いらないなら、これはわたしが
もらってもいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't have any use for
it, do you mind if I have it instead?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Sure, not like we'd use it.
I think it's best in your caring
hands, Alice.
fields.JP:
うん。特に使うわけでもないし、
この布はアリスが持っていたほうが
いいみたいだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, not like we'd use it.
I think it's best in your caring
hands, Alice.

fields.EN:
Thank you! I'm going to wash it
clean the moment we return.
fields.JP:
ありがとう……！
帰ったらこのテーブルクロスを
きれいに洗濯してみるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you! I'm going to wash it
clean the moment we return.

fields.EN:
Look forward to the tea party
I'll prepare using this.
fields.JP:
そのうち、これを使ってジャックと
素敵なお茶会ができたらいいな。ふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look forward to the tea party
I'll prepare using this.

fields.EN:
A piece of paper?
There's something written on it.
fields.JP: 紙きれ……？　なにか書いてあるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
A piece of paper?
There's something written on it.

fields.JP: おつうちゃん、どうしたの？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: なにかいい物でも見つけたとか？

fields.EN:
Oh, I just happened to step on
this piece of paper. Looks like
some kind of memo...
fields.JP:
姫、赤ずきん。
今、この紙きれを拾ったんだ。
なにかのメモみたいなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I just happened to step on
this piece of paper. Looks like
some kind of memo...

fields.JP: なんて書いてあったの？

fields.EN:
It's a bit smudged and hard to
read, but... it looks like some
adventurer wrote it.
fields.JP:
ちょっと文字が薄れて読みにくいけど、
えーと……。昔ここを冒険した人の備忘録が
書かれてるみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a bit smudged and hard to
read, but... it looks like some
adventurer wrote it.

fields.EN:
That may prove useful.
But, why would someone leave a
memo here?
fields.JP:
へぇ、ありがたいね。
でも誰がそんなメモを残して
くれたんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That may prove useful.
But, why would someone leave a
memo here?

fields.JP: うーん……。たしかに謎だね

fields.EN:
Say, you mind if I take a look
at it?
fields.JP: ……ねぇ、それ、もうちょっとよく見せて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, you mind if I take a look
at it?

fields.JP:
（赤ずきん、真剣な顔でメモを
　観察してるな……）

fields.EN:
I knew it... I recall seeing
something like this before.
fields.JP:
……やっぱりだ。
あたし、前にこれと似たようなメモを
見たことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew it... I recall seeing
something like this before.

fields.EN:
Yup. I found a similar memo back
when I was exploring a prison
area. I gave that one to Dad.
fields.JP:
うん。前に独房エリアを探索している時に
見つけて、お父さんに渡したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I found a similar memo back
when I was exploring a prison
area. I gave that one to Dad.

fields.EN:
He said that the memo was
probably something left behind
for others to follow.
fields.JP:
そしたら、昔の黎明の人が
後の冒険者のために残したメモ
じゃないかって言ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
He said that the memo was
probably something left behind
for others to follow.

fields.EN:
At least that's what Dad said.
He had no proof, but I believe
what he said.
fields.JP:
証拠はないけどね。
でもお父さんはそういう風に考えてたよ。
あたしもそうだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least that's what Dad said.
He had no proof, but I believe
what he said.

fields.EN:
I guess many have tried to escape
from here before. This memo must
be a historic relic of sorts...
fields.JP:
今までもたくさんの人達がジェイル脱獄を
目指してきたんだな。そのメモは歴史的な
遺物みたいなものなのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess many have tried to escape
from here before. This memo must
be a historic relic of sorts...

fields.EN:
I wonder what kind of person
left this memo...
fields.JP:
そのメモを残してくれた人は
どうなったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what kind of person
left this memo...

fields.EN:
Who knows? That person may have
survived, or maybe died along the
way.
fields.JP:
わからない。
無事に帰ってきたかもしれないし、
行ったきり戻れなかったかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows? That person may have
survived, or maybe died along the
way.

fields.EN: Even though they were in danger themselves, they desperately left this memo behind. I wonder what they must have been feeling...
fields.JP:
自分も危険にさらされているのに、
その中でも必死にこのメモを残してくれたんだ。
いったいどんな想いだったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoever it is, the person left the
memo amid their own perils.
A lot must have happened...

fields.EN:
Maybe that person knew they
wouldn't make it, so they left
it behind for the future.
fields.JP:
後の冒険者に少しでも知識を遺そうとして……。
自分が果たせなかったことを
あたし達に託したかったのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that person knew they
wouldn't make it, so they left
it behind for the future.

fields.EN:
You may be right...
And if so, we need to do our best
to fulfill that person's will.
fields.JP:
そうかもしれない……。
僕達はその想いに報いるためにも、
がんばらないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may be right...
And if so, we need to do our best
to fulfill that person's will.

fields.EN:
I'm sure we'll make it out
of here with everyone.
fields.JP:
わたし達が力を合わせれば、
きっと大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure we'll make it out
of here with everyone.

fields.EN:
Yeah, and this person who wrote
the memo may have survived, too.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。それにこのメモを書いた人が
死んじゃったと決まったわけじゃないんだしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and this person who wrote
the memo may have survived, too.

fields.EN:
We may just happen to meet
the person, you know?
fields.JP: 案外、しぶとく生き残ったかもしれないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may just happen to meet
the person, you know?

fields.EN: Heh, I can only hope for the best.
fields.JP: ふふっ、そうかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh, I can only hope for the best.

fields.EN:
Well, here's to hoping we make
the best use of the memo.
Now, let's get going.
fields.JP:
さあ、あたし達は先を急ごう。
このメモの情報をありがたく受け取ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, here's to hoping we make
the best use of the memo.
Now, let's get going.

fields.JP: ？　おつうちゃん、これなんだろう？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Look at the wall.
There's a door-like thing there.
fields.JP: ほら、この壁際。扉みたいなのがあるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at the wall.
There's a door-like thing there.

fields.EN:
You're right...
I didn't notice it there.
fields.JP: 本当だ。薄汚れてて気づかなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right...
I didn't notice it there.

fields.EN:
I wonder if this will lead us
to another area.
fields.JP:
開くのかな？
この向こうはなにがあるんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if this will lead us
to another area.

fields.EN:
Don't go near it, Princess.
It could be dangerous so we need
to be careful.
fields.JP:
姫、むやみに近づくのは危険だ。
ここはもっと慎重に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't go near it, Princess.
It could be dangerous so we need
to be careful.

fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、
セッテイシテクダサイ

fields.EN:
Who's that?!
Where is the voice coming from?!
fields.JP: え、今の誰だ！？　どこから声が……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who's that?!
Where is the voice coming from?!

fields.EN:
SET THE CORRECT ITEM
TO OPEN THE PORTAL.
fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、セッテイスレバ、
トビラガヒラキマス
fields.LOCALIZED:
SET THE CORRECT ITEM
TO OPEN THE PORTAL.

fields.JP:
……ひょっとして、
この扉がしゃべったのか？

fields.EN:
It sounded really weird...
Like, it was a human, but it
didn't feel very human...
fields.JP:
変な声だったね。人間の言葉なのに、
人間の声じゃないみたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sounded really weird...
Like, it was a human, but it
didn't feel very human...

fields.EN:
It said something about setting an
item, right? What item? Is this
supposed to be a trap?
fields.JP:
正しいアイテムを設定すれば扉が開く、って
言ってたよな。正しいアイテムってなんだ？
なにかの罠なのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It said something about setting an
item, right? What item? Is this
supposed to be a trap?

fields.EN: You mean the door is lying?
fields.JP: この扉が嘘をついてるってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean the door is lying?

fields.EN:
Whoa! It is talking!
Wait... It understands what we're
saying?
fields.JP:
うわっ、びっくりした。こいつ、
僕達の言ってることがわかるのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! It is talking!
Wait... It understands what we're
saying?

fields.EN:
I WAS CREATED TO ONLY
TELL THE TRUTH.
fields.JP:
ワタシハ、ウソヲツケナイヨウニ、
ツクラレテイマス
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WAS CREATED TO ONLY
TELL THE TRUTH.

fields.EN:
Created? Ah, so maybe this is
that "AI" thing people made
in the past.
fields.JP:
作られて……？
そうか、きっとこれは昔の人間が作った
『ＡＩ』ってやつなんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Created? Ah, so maybe this is
that "AI" thing people made
in the past.

fields.EN:
I don't know the details, but
it's supposed to be some computer
that can think for itself.
fields.JP:
細かくは知らないけど、
学習するコンピュータらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know the details, but
it's supposed to be some computer
that can think for itself.

fields.EN:
I heard it used to help people
back in the old days to make
everyone's life easier.
fields.JP:
昔はそういうのがたくさんあって、人間の
生活を支えていたんだって聞いたことがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard it used to help people
back in the old days to make
everyone's life easier.

fields.EN:
Huh, so it must have been working
like this the whole time.
That's so amazing.
fields.JP:
へぇ、じゃあこの子はずっとここで
働いていたんだ。偉いねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh, so it must have been working
like this the whole time.
That's so amazing.

fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、
セッテイシテクダサイ

fields.EN: It's saying the same thing again.
fields.JP: あ、また同じこと言ってる……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's saying the same thing again.

fields.EN:
Maybe it can only speak whatever
that was programmed, and doesn't
understand everything we say.
fields.JP:
人間の言葉が全部わかるわけじゃなくて、
決められたやりとりしかできないのかも
しれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it can only speak whatever
that was programmed, and doesn't
understand everything we say.

fields.EN:
SET THE CORRECT ITEM
TO OPEN THE PORTAL.
fields.JP:
タダシイアイテムヲ、セッテイスレバ、
トビラガヒラキマス
fields.LOCALIZED:
SET THE CORRECT ITEM
TO OPEN THE PORTAL.

fields.EN:
Yes, yes, we heard.
We'll come back once we have
this "correct item" you need.
fields.JP:
はいはい、それはわかったよ。
今は正しいアイテムってのを持って
いないから、またそのうちな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, yes, we heard.
We'll come back once we have
this "correct item" you need.

fields.EN:
We better make sure we don't
forget about this. We may need
to go beyond the door.
fields.JP:
正しいものがあれば扉が開くんだね。
なにかのときのためにも、
ちゃんと覚えておこうっと
fields.LOCALIZED:
We better make sure we don't
forget about this. We may need
to go beyond the door.

fields.EN:
Indeed. We'll try the door once
we can find whatever it needs.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
正しいアイテムが手に入ったら、
この扉を開けてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. We'll try the door once
we can find whatever it needs.

fields.JP:
【西】元墓所エリア
【東】地下洞窟エリア

【西】元街道沿いエリア
【北】水族館エリア
【東】旧学生街エリア

fields.EN:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.
fields.JP: 物資販売所では、アイテムを売買できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.

fields.EN:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.
fields.JP:
アイテムは物語の進行に応じて変更されるため、
時折り確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.

fields.EN:
You can accept work orders and
cultivate Blood Flowers at the
new Liberated District.
fields.JP:
依頼所では、ハーメルン解放地区の住人からの
依頼を受けたり、ハーメルンの下僕を使用して
血花の植付や、収穫が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can accept work orders and
cultivate Blood Flowers at the
new Liberated District.

fields.EN:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.
fields.JP:
依頼を達成すると報酬が得られるため、
積極的に受けてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.

fields.EN:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.
fields.JP:
依頼は物語の進行に応じて追加されるため、
時折確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.
fields.JP:
研究室では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の能力を強化できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.

fields.EN:
You can also expand skill slots
and change jobs.
fields.JP:
『スキル枠拡張』では所持スキル数の増加、
『職業変更』では現在の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also expand skill slots
and change jobs.

fields.EN:
Raise and lower Blood Maidens'
levels with "Blood Devolution."
fields.JP:
『血式退化』では、血式少女のレベルを下げて
再び育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Raise and lower Blood Maidens'
levels with "Blood Devolution."

fields.EN:
You can also appraise Blood Packs
and transfuse appraised Blood
Packs to the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
また、所持しているユ血液の鑑定を行い、
鑑定したユ血液の注入も行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also appraise Blood Packs
and transfuse appraised Blood
Packs to the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Use Blood Crystals to increase
the number of skill slots in
"Expand Skill Slots."
fields.JP:
スキル枠拡張では『血晶』を使用して
所持するスキル数を増やすことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Blood Crystals to increase
the number of skill slots in
"Expand Skill Slots."

fields.EN:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.
fields.JP:
スキル枠を拡張したら、
メニューの『スキルセット』で忘れずに
スキルをセットしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.

fields.EN:
Use Blood Crystals to change
between unlocked jobs.
fields.JP:
『血晶』を使用することで、
解放されている職業に
変更することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Blood Crystals to change
between unlocked jobs.

fields.EN:
Use Job Unlock Rights and Blood
Crystals to change a Blood
Maiden's job.
fields.JP:
職業変更では、『職業解放権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Job Unlock Rights and Blood
Crystals to change a Blood
Maiden's job.

fields.EN:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the job chosen.
fields.JP:
職業を変更すると、レベルを保持したまま
職業に応じたステータスに変化します
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the job chosen.

fields.EN:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".
fields.JP:
また、その職業で習得可能なスキルが
新たに追加されるため、『スキルメイク』を
確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".

fields.EN:
You gain Job Unlock Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.
fields.JP:
職業解放権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Job Unlock Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.

fields.EN:
Once a job is unlocked, you can
freely change jobs at any time.
fields.JP:
一度職業解放した職業には、
いつでも自由に変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once a job is unlocked, you can
freely change jobs at any time.

fields.EN:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.
fields.JP:
血式退化では、『退化権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女のレベルを下げられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.

fields.EN:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.
fields.JP:
血式退化を行うと、
項目に書かれた数値分、レベルが下がります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.

fields.EN:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.
fields.JP:
また、下げたレベルに応じて、
ＣＰやステータス上昇ボーナスが得られます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.

fields.EN:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.
fields.JP:
血式退化することで、強さを底上げした状態で
血式少女を育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.

fields.EN:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.
fields.JP:
退化権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.

fields.EN:
Blood Packs are used to learn
Blood Pack Skills.
fields.JP:
ユ血液は、血式少女に注入すると
『ユ血液スキル』を習得させることができる
特殊なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Packs are used to learn
Blood Pack Skills.

fields.EN:
Blood Pack Appraisal is used to
appraise and determine the
content of Blood Packs.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液鑑定』を行うと、
選択したユ血液のスキルの内容を
鑑定することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Pack Appraisal is used to
appraise and determine the
content of Blood Packs.

fields.EN:
Use Blood Pack Transfusion to
learn skills. Used Blood Packs
are lost during the process.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液注入』を行うと、
鑑定済みのユ血液を消費し、
血式少女にスキルを習得させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Blood Pack Transfusion to
learn skills. Used Blood Packs
are lost during the process.

fields.EN:
Up to 99 Blood Packs can be
transfused. The more used,
the stronger the skill effect.
fields.JP:
同じユ血液は最大９９個まで注入でき、
注入した分、スキルの効果が強化されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Up to 99 Blood Packs can be
transfused. The more used,
the stronger the skill effect.

fields.EN:
You can gain Blood Packs through
Blood Farming and Blood Flowers.
fields.JP:
ユ血液は、
『ブラッドファーム』や『血花代行』で
入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain Blood Packs through
Blood Farming and Blood Flowers.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen gear at the
"Blood Weapon Factory" by using
Blood Crystals gained in battle.
fields.JP:
血式武器製造所では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、装備品を強化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen gear at the
"Blood Weapon Factory" by using
Blood Crystals gained in battle.

fields.EN:
Your gear can be strengthened
20 times.
fields.JP: 装備品の強化は、最大２０回まで行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your gear can be strengthened
20 times.

fields.EN:
You can purge a Blood Maiden's
Corruption using Nightmare Jack's
blood through "Purge."
fields.JP:
浄化では、ナイトメア・ジャックの血液を
使用して、血式少女に溜まった
『穢れ』を浄化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can purge a Blood Maiden's
Corruption using Nightmare Jack's
blood through "Purge."

fields.EN:
Purging will deteriorate Nightmare
Jack's mind, so the number of
purges possible is limited.
fields.JP:
浄化を行うと、ナイトメア・ジャックの精神が
不安定になり、限界に達すると
浄化は行えなくなります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Purging will deteriorate Nightmare
Jack's mind, so the number of
purges possible is limited.

fields.EN:
By purging, you gain resistance
to Corruption and bonuses to the
Blood Maiden's maximum HP or SP.
fields.JP:
浄化すると、『穢れ耐性』がアップするほか、
ＨＰかＳＰの上限値にボーナスが付与されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By purging, you gain resistance
to Corruption and bonuses to the
Blood Maiden's maximum HP or SP.

fields.EN:
The effects of purging stay until
either the Blood Maiden is KO'd,
or you leave the dungeon.
fields.JP:
浄化の効果は、血式少女が戦闘不能になる、
もしくは次にダンジョンから帰還するまでの間
持続します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The effects of purging stay until
either the Blood Maiden is KO'd,
or you leave the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Use the Left Stick to move the screen,
and use the touch screen/Right Stick to
rub the blood on the Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
浄化は、左スティックで画面を動かし、
血式少女に振りかけたジャックの血液を
タッチパッドを通じて塗り込むことで行います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the Left Stick to move the screen,
and use the touch screen/Right Stick to
rub the blood on the Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
The purge is successful if you
can rub all of the blood spots into
her body within a set amount of time.
fields.JP:
制限時間内に全て塗り込むことができれば、
浄化成功です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The purge is successful if you
can rub all of the blood spots into
her body within a set amount of time.

fields.EN:
Once successful, you can skip the
rubbing portion for that Blood
Maiden when conducting a purge.
fields.JP:
一度成功した血式少女は、次回から
行為を省略して浄化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once successful, you can skip the
rubbing portion for that Blood
Maiden when conducting a purge.

fields.EN:
You can use the skip feature for
the purging process on multiple
Blood Maidens to save time.
fields.JP:
省略浄化は、複数の血式少女にまとめて
行うこともできるので、活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can use the skip feature for
the purging process on multiple
Blood Maidens to save time.

fields.EN:
Free Purge is a mode where you
can conduct a purge without a
time limit.
fields.JP:
フリー浄化は、時間制限なしで
じっくり浄化できるフリーモードです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Free Purge is a mode where you
can conduct a purge without a
time limit.

fields.EN:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.
fields.JP:
ただし、成功しても
『穢れ耐性』アップなどの恩恵は得られません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.

fields.EN:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.
fields.JP:
ただし、成功しても
『穢れ耐性』アップなどの
恩恵は得られません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that, even if successful, no
resistance or benefits will be
gained.

fields.EN:
You can select "Check Affection",
"Manage Storage" or "Library"
from Tsuu's Room.
fields.JP:
つうの部屋では、
『友情度チェック』、『格納庫整理』、
『ライブラリ』を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can select "Check Affection",
"Manage Storage" or "Library"
from Otsuu's Room.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Access "Check Affection" to see
the affection level between Tsuu
and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
『友情度チェック』では、つうに対する
血式少女の友情度を確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Check Affection" to see
the affection level between Otsuu
and the Blood Maidens.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Access "Manage Storage" to store
and remove items from storage,
and to sell items.
fields.JP:
『格納庫整理』では、
格納庫にアイテムを預けたり、取り出したり、
アイテムの売却ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Access "Manage Storage" to store
and remove items from storage,
and to sell items.

fields.EN:
Use "Library" to view work orders,
character profiles, the Jail
Creature Manual, and tutorials.
fields.JP:
『ライブラリ』では、依頼、ジェイル内生物図鑑、
キャラクターのプロフィール、チュートリアルを
確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use "Library" to view work orders,
character profiles, the Jail
Creature Manual, and tutorials.

fields.EN:
You can also view work orders, the
Jail Creature Manual, Profile, and tutorials
from the "Library" option in your main menu.
fields.JP:
依頼、ジェイル内生物図鑑、プロフィール、
チュートリアルは、メニューにある
『ライブラリ』でも確認することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also view work orders, the
Jail Creature Manual, Profile, and tutorials
from the "Library" option in your main menu.

fields.EN:
You can give "Surprise Items" to
any of the Blood Maidens in their
rooms.
fields.JP:
血式少女の部屋では、
『サプライズアイテム』を渡すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can give "Surprise Items" to
any of the Blood Maidens in their
rooms.

fields.EN:
There are two types of surprise
items - gifts and interior items.
fields.JP:
サプライズアイテムには、
『プレセント』と『インテリア』の２種類あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are two types of surprise
items - gifts and interior items.

fields.EN:
Raise a Blood Maiden's affection
by giving them items. You may get
items in return, too.
fields.JP:
プレゼントを渡すことで、友情度がアップし、
プレゼントのお礼として、アイテムが貰えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Raise a Blood Maiden's affection
by giving them items. You may get
items in return, too.

fields.EN:
The level of affection can trigger
various events, open new skills,
and can affect the story, too.
fields.JP:
友情度を上げるとさまざまなイベントが発生し、
スキルを習得したり、シナリオに影響を与えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The level of affection can trigger
various events, open new skills,
and can affect the story, too.

fields.EN:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.
fields.JP:
また、インテリアは、
血式少女の部屋が実際に模様替えされます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.

fields.EN: Once you've given an interior item, you can freely use it to redecorate.
fields.JP:
一度渡したインテリアであれば、
自由に模様替えを楽しむことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interior items can be freely
changed at any time.

fields.EN:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンには、宝箱や採取ポイントなど
アイテムを入手できる場所が存在するほか、
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.

fields.EN: There are also various Gimmicks, such as doors opened by levers and traps that deal damage.
fields.JP:
レバーで開く扉やダメージを受けるトラップなど、
さまざまなギミックが存在します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are also various gimmicks,
such as levers to open portals,
and perilous traps.

fields.EN:
Areas traversed are shown in the mini
map towards the left. Press the Left
Stick to swap the map size.
fields.JP:
歩いた場所の情報は、画面左の『ミニマップ』に表示
され、タッチパッドボタンを右クリックすることで、
ミニマップの表示切替ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Areas traversed are shown in the mini
map towards the left. Press the Left
Stick to swap the map size.

fields.EN:
Press the Y Button then Down Button
to access the map details.
fields.JP:
また、□ボタン＋方向キー下で
『詳細マップ』の確認もできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button then Down Button
to access the map details.

fields.EN:
You can access Auto-Pilot in the
map details by selecting the
location you wish to move to.
fields.JP:
詳細マップで開示済みの場所を指定すると、
その場所まで自動で移動ができる
オートパイロットを実行できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can access Auto-Pilot in the
map details by selecting the
location you wish to move to.

fields.EN:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.
fields.JP:
オートパイロットは階層をまたいで
使用可能なため、うまく活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.

fields.EN:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、イベントが起こるポイントや
アイテムが採取できるポイント、ヒントとなる
看板など、さまざまなアイコンがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.

fields.EN:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるアイコンを見極め、
スムーズに探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.

fields.EN:
All areas are connected to other
areas.
fields.JP: 全てのエリアは、地続きにつながっています
fields.LOCALIZED:
All areas are connected to other
areas.

fields.EN:
For example, the Underground
Cavern is connected to the City
Streets, Aquarium Ruins, and Dorm.
fields.JP:
例えば地下洞窟エリアは、『元街道沿いエリア』
『水族館跡エリア』『旧学生街エリア』へつながり、
ダンジョン内のどこかから行くことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, the Underground
Cavern is connected to the City
Streets, Aquarium Ruins, and Dorm.

fields.EN:
Check for "sign" icons within the
dungeon to see how you can get
from one area to another.
fields.JP:
どこから新たなエリアへ行けるのかは、
ダンジョン内の『看板』アイコンで確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Check for "sign" icons within the
dungeon to see how you can get
from one area to another.

fields.EN: Once you've reached an area, you can travel directly to it from the overall map.
fields.JP:
また、一度たどり着いたエリアは、
全体マップから直接移動できるようになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Any areas you've already reached
can be directly accessed from the
map.

fields.EN:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.
fields.JP:
ジェイルには、『食欲』『性欲』『睡眠欲』の
三つの欲求があり、満たしてやることで
さまざまな恩恵を受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.

fields.EN:
The desires' gauges are displayed
at the top-right corner, and
change as they are fulfilled.
fields.JP:
三つの欲求は画面右上に表示されており、
欲求が満たされると徐々にゲージが溜まって
いきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The desires' gauges are displayed
at the top-right corner, and
change as they are fulfilled.

fields.EN:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.
fields.JP:
『食欲』は、戦闘中に敵の弱点を突くなどして
『血しぶき』を発生させることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.

fields.EN:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.
fields.JP:
『性欲』は、ダンジョン内にある
宝箱や採取ポイント、エモーションポイントを
調べることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.

fields.EN:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.
fields.JP:
『睡眠欲』は、まれに発生するジェイルの
睡眠タイム中に、ダメージを受けずに
行動することで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.

fields.EN:
When any of the 3 desires reach
their limits, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.
fields.JP:
いずれかの欲求のゲージがＭＡＸになると
『ジェイルボーナス』が発生し、
ボーナス内容のルーレットが開始されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
When any of the 3 desires reach
their limits, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.

fields.EN:
You gain special benefits,
depending on the roulette's
results.
fields.JP:
ルーレットが止まった項目の内容によって、
さまざまな恩恵が受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain special benefits,
depending on the roulette's
results.

fields.EN:
The moon icon on the left of the
desires' gauges shows which will
be filled faster during that time.
fields.JP:
また、三大欲求の左にある月のアイコンは、
ジェイルが最も求めている欲求を表しており、
満たすことで多めにゲージが上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moon icon on the left of the
desires' gauges shows which will
be filled faster during that time.

fields.EN:
The Jail has mood shifts, which
is represented on the top right
during dungeon crawling.
fields.JP:
ジェイルには機嫌があり、
ジェイルの機嫌は、メーターとして、
探索画面の右上に表示されています
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail has mood shifts, which
is represented on the top right
during dungeon crawling.

fields.EN:
Fighting increases the mood gauge,
and filling the Hunger, Libido,
and Sleep gauges lowers the gauge.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌は戦うたびに上昇していき、
『食欲』『性欲』『睡眠欲』を満たすと減少します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting increases the mood gauge,
and filling the Hunger, Libido,
and Sleep gauges lowers the gauge.

fields.EN:
As the Jail's mood gauge
increases, so does the difficulty
of the enemies that appear.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなっていくと、
出現する敵が強くなっていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the Jail's mood gauge
increases, so does the difficulty
of the enemies that appear.

fields.EN:
Filling the mood gauge may
summon a Nightmare without
any notice.
fields.JP:
さらに、ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなりすぎると
ナイトメアが突然現れることもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Filling the mood gauge may
summon a Nightmare without
any notice.

fields.EN:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、
床の先に鎖が伸びている場所があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.

fields.EN:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to get across
to the other side.
fields.JP:
その鎖に乗ると、不安定な足場を進んでいく
『綱渡りギミック』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to get across
to the other side.

fields.EN:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.
fields.JP:
綱渡り中は自動で前進していきますが、
常に『右スティック』でバランスを取る必要が
あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.

fields.EN:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるバーの中心に
ポイントが来るように右スティックを傾けながら
進んでいきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.

fields.EN:
Blood Farm lets you plant "+" type
Blood Crystals in dungeons with the
ZL Button to grow Blood Flowers.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内では、Ｌ２ボタンで
『＋系』の血晶を地面に埋めて血花を育てる
『ブラッドファーム』を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Farm lets you plant "+" type
Blood Crystals in dungeons with the
ZL Button to grow Blood Flowers.

fields.EN:
An area of 3 x 5 squares can be
planted, and battles will make the
Blood Flowers grow.
fields.JP:
正面３列、距離５マスの範囲に埋めることができ、
埋めた状態で戦闘をこなすことで、
『苗』→『蕾』→『花』と血花が成長します
fields.LOCALIZED:
An area of 3 x 5 squares can be
planted, and battles will make the
Blood Flowers grow.

fields.EN:
Covering these squares with Blood
Toss will change the Blood Flower
color and increase its rank.
fields.JP:
血花に、『血投げ』などで
血を付着させると、色が変化し、
血花がランクアップします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Covering these squares with Blood
Toss will change the Blood Flower
color and increase its rank.

fields.EN:
Once bloomed, you can harvest them
by searching them or by using
Hameln's "Magnetic Piccolo."
fields.JP:
『花』に成長した血花は、直接調べるか
血式能力『磁力ピッコロ』を使用して
収穫することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once bloomed, you can harvest them
by searching them or by using
Hameln's "Magnetic Piccolo."

fields.EN:
You will gain various items and
equipment based on the rank and
the Blood Crystal planted.
fields.JP:
収穫すると、埋めた血晶の種類に応じた、
アイテムや装備品が手に入ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will gain various items and
equipment based on the rank and
the Blood Crystal planted.

fields.EN:
Use Magnetic Piccolo to harvest
them at once to gain a chance to
get better equipment.
fields.JP:
『磁力ピッコロ』で２つ以上まとめて収穫すると、
装備品がよくなる可能性がある
『アップデートチャンス』が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Magnetic Piccolo to harvest
them at once to gain a chance to
get better equipment.

fields.EN: You can grow only up to 15 Blood Flowers per floor, so be careful where you plant them.
fields.JP:
１フロアにつき、１５個までしか
血花を育てることはできませんので、
埋める際には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you can only plant up
to 15 squares each dungeon floor.

fields.EN:
Some areas have sparkling squares.
These are called Blood Farm Zones.
fields.JP:
また、独房エリアには
フロア毎に『ブラッドファームゾーン』という
キラキラと光る特殊なマスがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some areas have sparkling squares.
These are called Blood Farm Zones.

fields.EN: Blood Flowers grown in Blood Farm Zones yield different items when harvested.
fields.JP:
『ブラッドファームゾーン』で成長した血花は、
収穫できるアイテムも変わります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The items and equipment gained
using these squares are different
than usual.

fields.EN:
Look for these special squares on
the map. They are colored purple,
so check them out.
fields.JP:
マップ上でも、紫色のマスで表示されるので、
見つけたら血花を育ててみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look for these special squares on
the map. They are colored purple,
so check them out.

fields.EN:
You may come across portals
that can only be accessed by
using items.
fields.JP:
独房エリア内には、
鍵などで閉じられた扉があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may come across portals
that can only be accessed by
using items.

fields.EN:
These can be opened by using
Action Items.
fields.JP:
そういった扉は、
『アクションアイテム』を使用して突破します
fields.LOCALIZED:
These can be opened by using
Action Items.

fields.EN:
Using the wrong item incur various
penalties, such as taking damage
and encountering enemies.
fields.JP:
間違ったアイテムを使用すると、
ダメージを受けたり、敵に遭遇する
ペナルティが発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using the wrong item incur various
penalties, such as taking damage
and encountering enemies.

fields.EN:
If you don't have the right item,
search the area well as it is
likely somewhere in the area.
fields.JP:
開錠に必要な『アクションアイテム』を
持っていない時は、
独房エリア内から探し出しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't have the right item,
search the area well as it is
likely somewhere in the area.

fields.EN:
Jail Manage lets you, to an
extent, control the results
of the Jail Bonus roulette.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』とは、
『ジェイルボーナス』のルーレットの効果を
ある程度制御できる機能です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Control lets you, to an
extent, control the results
of the Jail Bonus roulette.

fields.EN:
The Jail Bonus results can be
fixed by using J-Pieces in
Jail Manage.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』では、
ルーレットの効果が設定された『Ｊピース』
という特殊なアイテムを使用します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail Bonus results can be
fixed by using J-Pieces in
Jail Control.

fields.EN:
Setting the J-Pieces grants you
the chance of the roulette
landing on your J-Piece.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』で、
『Ｊピース』を設定することで、その効果が
ルーレットの項目に選ばれる可能性があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Setting the J-Pieces grants you
the chance of the roulette
landing on your J-Piece.

fields.EN:
J-Pieces can be found in
dungeons, and can only be used
in Jail Manage.
fields.JP:
『Ｊピース』は、独房エリア内で入手でき、
入手した独房エリアの『ジェイルマネージ』でのみ
使用できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Pieces can be found in
dungeons, and can only be used
in Jail Control.

fields.EN:
TriJail can increase your
risks, but returns a greater
reward in battle.
fields.JP:
『トライジェイル』とは、
敵を強くするなど探索に縛りを設けることで、
代わりに多大な恩恵を受けられるシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trial can increase your
risks, but returns a greater
reward in battle.

fields.EN: TriJail restrictions and benefits apply only while exploring the area you set out for.
fields.JP:
『トライジェイル』の縛りと恩恵は、
出発先のエリア探索中にのみ適応されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The limits placed through Jail
Trial applies only to the dungeon
area you are currently in.

fields.EN:
Beware as you can add limits
during your expedition, but can't
remove them until you leave.
fields.JP:
探索中はメニューから追加の設定ができますが、
縛りの追加のみで、縛りの解除はできませんので
注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beware as you can add limits
during your expedition, but can't
remove them until you leave.

fields.EN: While exploring, you can add restrictions from the menu, but you can't remove them. In return, you'll receive substantial benefits.
fields.JP:
探索中に、メニューから追加の設定ができますが、
縛りの追加のみで、縛りの解除はできません
代わりに多大な恩恵を受けられるシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trial lets you to add limits
during your expedition so that
you can gain greater rewards.

fields.EN:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities the Blood Maidens can
use inside the dungeon.
fields.JP:
『血式能力』は、血式少女がダンジョン内で
発動できる特殊能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities the Blood Maidens can
use inside the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Toggle through abilities with the
Right Stick, and activate them
with the B Button.
fields.JP:
使用できる能力は画面左下に表示されており、
右スティックの左右で切り替え、
×ボタンで発動できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toggle through abilities with the
Right Stick, and activate them
with the B Button.

fields.EN:
Note that you will use SP when
activating each Blood Ability.
fields.JP: また、能力の発動にはＳＰを消費します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you will use SP when
activating each Blood Ability.

fields.EN:
Some dungeons require certain
Blood Abilities in order to clear
the area.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンを進むために『必須な能力』も
ありますので、探索に行き詰まったら
能力を見直してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some dungeons require certain
Blood Abilities in order to clear
the area.

fields.EN:
Tsuu can create an orb with her
power, "Bamboo Weaver."
fields.JP:
つうの血式能力【バンブーウィーバー】は
目の前に球体を出現させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu can create an orb with her
power, "Bamboo Weaver."
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
The orb can be used to fill holes
to create a path, or to activate
floor gimmicks.
fields.JP:
丸い穴が開いた床に、球体を落して
道を作ったり、床のスイッチに
球体を置いて作動させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The orb can be used to fill holes
to create a path, or to activate
floor gimmicks.

fields.EN:
It can also be used to block
Nightmares, so use it to your
advantage as much as possible.
fields.JP:
また、ナイトメアに対して障害物としても
利用できるので、活用してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can also be used to block
Nightmares, so use it to your
advantage as much as possible.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime can unleash a blast
of cold with "Frozen Tear."
fields.JP:
人魚姫の血式能力【フローズンティアー】は、
目の前に冷気を放つ能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid can unleash a blast
of cold with "Frozen Tear."

fields.EN:
It can be used to douse flames,
and to freeze liquids.
fields.JP:
燃え盛る炎に使うことで、炎を消したり、
液体に使うことで、凍らせることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can be used to douse flames,
and to freeze liquids.

fields.EN:
If you get stuck while exploring,
look around for places where you can use it.
fields.JP:
探索に行き詰まった場合は、
使用できる場所がないか探してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can't find a way through a
dungeon, see if Little Mermaid's
power can help get you through.

fields.EN:
Alice can use her power, "Rabbit
Jump" to jump across 5 squares.
fields.JP:
アリスの血式能力【ラビットジャンプ】は、
前方５マス分ジャンプできる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice can use her power, "Rabbit
Jump" to jump across 5 squares.

fields.EN:
It is best used when trying to
jump over gaps and chasms.
fields.JP:
行く手にある大きな溝を超える時に
使用することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is best used when trying to
jump over gaps and chasms.

fields.EN:
If you come across an area you
need to get across, try using
her power to get through.
fields.JP:
探索中、他の能力でも乗り越えられない
溝があった時に活用してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you come across an area you
need to get across, try using
her power to get through.

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack's "Wonder Hole" creates a point
where you can save and escape from the dungeon.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックの能力【ワンダーホール】は、
『セーブ』『ダンジョンからの脱出』ができる
ポイントを設置する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack uses "Rabbit Hole."
This creates a save point and an
escape route out of the dungeon.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ワンダーホール → Wonder Hole; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Save points in dungeons can only be placed in
certain locations, so use Wonder Hole saves
to help you progress through your exploration.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内のセーブポイントは配置場所が
限られているため、ワンダーホールでのセーブを
活用して探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can only set save points in
certain areas, so create save
points as you find them.

fields.EN:
Placing a new Wonder Hole automatically removes
the one you placed previously.
fields.JP:
新たなワンダーホールを設置すると、
以前に設置したものは自動的に消滅します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that setting a new Rabbit
Hole will erase any previous
Rabbit Hole that was set.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ワンダーホール → Wonder Hole; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Akazukin can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの血式能力【ボディニッパー】は
さまざまなものを切ることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.
fields.JP:
切れそうな対象の前でボディニッパーを使うと、
新しい道を開くことができたり、
アイテムを入手できたりします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.

fields.EN:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.
fields.JP:
探索に行き詰まった場合には、
ボディニッパーで切れる場所を探してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.
fields.JP:
白雪姫の血式能力【ポイズンボム】は、
時限式の毒爆弾を設置することで、
爆発を発生させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.

fields.EN:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to inflict direct damage
onto Nightmares.
fields.JP:
壊せそうな壁を吹き飛ばしたり、
ナイトメアに直接ダメージを与えることもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to inflict direct damage
onto Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.
fields.JP:
ただし、爆発時に近くにいると、
自分たちもダメージや毒を受けてしまうため
十分に注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.
fields.JP:
眠り姫の血式能力【ローズアロー】は、
前方７マス先に向かって、
イバラの矢を放つことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.
fields.JP:
行けない場所にあるスイッチを押したり、
遠くから何かを狙わなければならない場合
などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.
fields.JP:
親指姫の血式能力【プチプリンセス】は
所持している特定のアイテムを小さくする
ことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.

fields.EN:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.
fields.JP:
何かを小さくする必要があったり、
小さくすることで便利になりそうなアイテムが
ある場合に発動してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.

fields.EN:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.
fields.JP:
また、小さくしたアイテムは、
元の大きさに戻すことも可能です
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.

fields.EN:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.
fields.JP:
シンデレラの血式能力【１２ダッシュ】は、
１２秒間、自分たちの速度を上げることが
できる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.

fields.EN:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.
fields.JP:
急ぐ必要がある場合や、普段のスピードでは
通れない場所がある場合に試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.

fields.EN:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただし、壁や物にぶつかってしまうと、
少しの間、動けなくなるため注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫の血式能力【タケプロテクター】は、
１０秒間だけ、あらゆるトラップのダメージを
無効化する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.

fields.EN:
You also have a chance of
nullifying attacks from a
Nightmare during "Chase."
fields.JP:
また、『虐殺鬼ごっこ』中に、ナイトメアからの
攻撃をたまに無効化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also have a chance of
nullifying attacks from a
Nightmare during "Chase."

fields.EN:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ダメージを受けずに進みたい場合や
ナイトメアから逃げ切りたい場合などに
能力を活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's Blood Ability, "Hair!," extends her hair
4 squares ahead and lets her grab objects.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの血式能力【ヘアー！】は、
前方４マス先に向かって髪を伸ばし、
物をつかむことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel uses "Hair Flair." This
lets you reach items 5 squares in
the direction you're facing.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ヘアー/ヘアー！ → Hair!; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, activate things, or
when you need to grab onto things.
fields.JP:
手が届かない場所にある宝箱を開けたり、
何かを作動させたり、つかまったりしなければ
ならない場合などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, activate things, or
when you need to grab onto things.

fields.EN:
Gretel's Blood Ability, "Bread Portal," lets her throw
breadcrumbs 3 squares ahead and use them to warp.
fields.JP:
グレーテルの血式能力【ブレッドポータル】は
前方３マス先に向かってパンくずを投げ、
それを利用してワープする能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel uses "Bread Portal." This
creates a warp point 3 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.
fields.JP:
能力を発動してパンくずを投げた後、
もう一度能力を発動することで
パンくずの場所にワープできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.

fields.EN:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.
fields.JP:
歩きでは行けない場所に
渡りたい場合などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.

fields.EN:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの血式能力【磁力ピッコロ】は、
笛の音色で磁力を発生させ、
物を引き寄せることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.

fields.EN:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 5 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.
fields.JP:
正面の３列、距離５マスに効果があります。
引き寄せられそうな物を見つけた場合に
試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 5 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.

fields.EN:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン探索中に
メモの形をしたアイコンに触れると
戦闘が始まります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.

fields.EN:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.
fields.JP:
戦闘に勝利することで、
ダンジョンを進む際のヒントが書かれた
『メモ』を手に入れることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.

fields.EN:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."
fields.JP:
手に入れたメモは、アイテムの
『その他』のタブでいつでも確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."

fields.EN:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.
fields.JP:
放浪商人は、ダンジョン探索中に
まれに出会う商人です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.

fields.EN:
The merchant sells rare items that
can't normally be purchased at the
store.
fields.JP:
購入できる品々は、物資販売所では買えない
装備品や珍しいアイテムばかりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The merchant sells rare items that
can't normally be purchased at the
store.

fields.EN: Defeat all enemies to win a battle. If every party member is KO'd, it's game over.
fields.JP:
戦闘では、全ての敵を倒すと勝利、
パーティメンバー全員が戦闘不能になると
ゲームオーバーになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win battles by defeating all
enemies. The battle ends if
everyone in your party is KO'd.

fields.EN:
The turn order is determined by
the character's agility, from
highest to lowest.
fields.JP:
戦闘が始まると、全キャラクターで
ＡＧＩの高い順に行動がまわってきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The turn order is determined by
the character's agility, from
highest to lowest.

fields.EN:
Tsuu has 5 different commands:
Attack, Skill, Defend, Item,
and Escape.
fields.JP:
主人公のつうには、
『攻撃』『スキル』『アイテム』『防御』『逃げる』の
コマンドがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu has 5 different commands:
Attack, Skill, Defend, Item,
and Escape.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.
fields.JP:
他の血式少女には、
『攻撃』『スキル』『防御』『逃げる』の
コマンドがあります。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.

fields.EN:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.
fields.JP:
『攻撃』は通常攻撃、
『スキル』はＳＰを使用した特殊攻撃
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.

fields.EN:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" may
let you escape from battle.
fields.JP:
『防御』は敵からのダメージ軽減、
『逃げる』は逃走を試みるコマンドです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" may
let you escape from battle.

fields.EN:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.
fields.JP:
敵をすべて倒して勝利すると、
『経験値』や『血晶』が手に入るほか、
アイテムや武器が手に入ることもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.

fields.EN: A basic battle technique is to hit enemy weaknesses with elemental attacks.
fields.JP:
戦闘の基本要素に
『属性攻撃で敵の弱点を突く』という
テクニックがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
One of the most basic things to
remember during battle is to
attack enemy weak points.

fields.EN:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Wind > Earth > Water > Fire
fields.JP:
属性は火、風、土、水の４種類あり、
『火は風に強い』『風は土に強い』
『土は水に強い』『水は火に強い』関係です
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Wind > Earth > Water > Fire

fields.EN:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."
fields.JP:
敵を弱点属性で攻撃すると、
大きなダメージを与えられるだけでなく、
『血しぶき』を発生させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."

fields.EN:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生すると、
血式少女の『返り血アイコン』が少しずつ
満たされていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.

fields.EN:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Genocide" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンがＭＡＸになると、次の行動順に
強力な『ジェノサイドモード』に変身します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Massacre" mode.

fields.EN:
During Genocide mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードでは、ステータスが上昇し、
強力な専用スキルも使用できるため、
積極的に狙っていきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
During Massacre mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.

fields.EN:
They will exit Genocide mode after
a set amount of turns.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードは、
数回行動すると解除されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
They will exit Massacre mode after
a set amount of turns.

fields.EN:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."
fields.JP:
血しぶきは、
大ダメージを与えて倒す『オーバーキル』や
『クリティカル』などでも発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."

fields.EN: When Blood Splatter has built up in a Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter icon, you can "Lick" the blood.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生し、血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』が溜まっている場合に、
それを『舐める』ことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can "Lick" a Blood Maiden when
their Blood Splatter icon has
accumulated a certain amount.

fields.EN:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."
fields.JP:
『誰の血を舐めるのか』を選択することで、
その血式少女の『魂血スキル』が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."

fields.EN:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.
fields.JP:
『魂血スキル』は、
基本的に補助回復系の癒しの技です
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.
fields.JP:
血を舐められた血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』は、０に戻ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.

fields.EN:
Use Genocide mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.
fields.JP:
『ジェノサイドモード』で強くなるか、
『魂血スキル』で態勢を立て直すか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Massacre mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.

fields.EN:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.
fields.JP:
血しぶきを戦況によってどう使い分けるかが
戦闘のカギを握っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.

fields.EN:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.
fields.JP:
血式少女は、パーティメンバーの戦闘不能、
大ダメージを受けるなど、心が乱れることで
『穢れ』が溜まっていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.

fields.EN:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.
fields.JP:
『穢れ』が溜まると、
返り血アイコンが次第に『濁った色』へと
変化していきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.

fields.EN:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンが濁った状態でＭＡＸになると、
暴走状態である『ブラッドスケルターモード』に
変身してしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードの血式少女は、
敵・味方の見境なく攻撃を行います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter can be ended using
Life Purge, when the battle ends,
or when you are KO'd.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードは、
『いのちがけじょうか』『戦闘終了』『戦闘不能』
でしか解けることはありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter can be ended using
Life Purge, when the battle ends,
or when you are KO'd.

fields.EN:
The murkier the Blood Splatter
icon, the greater your chances of
entering Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンの濁りが濃いほど
ブラッドスケルターモードになる可能性が
高いため、アイコンの状態には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The murkier the Blood Splatter
icon, the greater your chances of
entering Blood Skelter mode.

fields.EN:
Tsuu and Jack move as a pair,
so actions are shared between
the two.
fields.JP:
つうとジャックは一心同体のため
常に一緒に行動する必要があります
そのため、２人はセットで行動を選択できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and Jack move as a pair,
so actions are shared between
the two.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
You can toggle who will take
action by pressing the Left
or Right Buttons.
fields.JP:
つうとジャックのどちらで行動するかは、
方向キーの左右で切り替えができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can toggle who will take
action by pressing the Left
or Right Buttons.

fields.EN:
You can either have Tsuu or
Jack act twice, or you can have
each of them take a single action.
fields.JP:
つうとジャックでそれぞれ行動したり、
つうが二回行動、ジャックが二回行動といった
パターンの組み合わせができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can either have Otsuu or
Jack act twice, or you can have
each of them take a single action.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack has 4 commands:
"Deep Breath," "Nightmare Zone,"
"Item," and "Escape."
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックには、
『しんこきゅう』『ナイトメアくうかん』
『アイテム』『逃げる』のコマンドがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack has 4 commands:
"Deep Breath," "Nightmare Zone,"
"Item," and "Escape."

fields.EN:
The command chosen may affect
his mind meter located above
Nightmare Jack's icon.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックは選択したコマンドによって
画面上に表示されている
意識メーターに影響を与える効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The command chosen may affect
his mind meter located above
Nightmare Jack's icon.

fields.EN:
"Deep Breath" has the ability to
calm his mind meter.
fields.JP:
『しんこきゅう』は、
意識メーターを落ち着かせる効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Deep Breath" has the ability to
calm his mind meter.

fields.EN:
"Nightmare Zone" can null enemy
actions the next turn, but it will
agitate his mind meter.
fields.JP:
『ナイトメアくうかん』は、敵単体か敵全体を
次のターン行動不能にさせる効果がありますが
その代わりに意識メーターが乱れてしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Nightmare Zone" can null enemy
actions the next turn, but it will
agitate his mind meter.

fields.EN:
"Item" and "Escape" has no
effect on his mind meter.
fields.JP:
『アイテム』や『逃げる』は、
意識メーターに影響を与えず使用できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Item" and "Escape" has no
effect on his mind meter.

fields.EN: If Nightmare Jack's Mind Meter becomes too unstable, he will transform into the berserk 'Ripper Jack' after the turn ends.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックの意識メーターが
乱れすぎてしまうと、ターン終了後に
暴走状態の『ジャックリッパー』に変身します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If his mind meter peaks past a certain
point, at the end of his turn, there is a 
chance he will transform into Ripper Jack.

fields.EN:
Ripper Jack cannot be controlled,
and will attack both enemies and
allies.
fields.JP:
『ジャックリッパー』時は、
ナイトメア・ジャックの行動選択は不可能で、
敵味方関係なく攻撃を振るってしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ripper Jack cannot be controlled,
and will attack both enemies and
allies.

fields.EN:
Tsuu can calm Nightmare Jack
by using her command,
"Counseling."
fields.JP:
暴走したナイトメア・ジャックは、
つうの『カウンセリング』を使用することで
意識を正常に落ち着かせることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu can calm Nightmare Jack
by using her command,
"Counseling."
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: If Ripper Jack activates three times in a single battle, Jack's consciousness will be swallowed by darkness and it's Game Over, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただ１度の戦闘で『ジャックリッパー』が３回発動
してしまうと、ジャックの意識が闇に呑まれ、
ゲームオーバーになるので注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Ripper Jack occurs 3 times
during a single battle, the game
will end, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Nightmare Jack can Purge or Life
Purge, but those will agitate
his mind meter.
fields.JP:
ナイトメア・ジャックのコマンド『じょうか』では、
意識メーターが乱れる代わりに、
『じょうか』と『いのちがけじょうか』ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmare Jack can Purge or Life
Purge, but those will agitate
his mind meter.

fields.EN:
Purge can clear one Blood Maiden's
Corruption, or lower the
Corruption of all Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
『じょうか』には、単体か全体の２種類あり、
単体では、一人の濁りを全て消し、
全体では、全員の濁りを少し消す効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Purge can clear one Blood Maiden's
Corruption, or lower the
Corruption of all Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Using Life Purge will allow you
to take a Blood Maiden out of
Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
『いのちがけじょうか』では、
『ブラッドスケルターモード』になってしまった
血式少女の状態を元に戻す効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using Life Purge will allow you
to take a Blood Maiden out of
Blood Skelter mode.

fields.EN:
Press the Y Button when selecting
your command to use Auto-Battle.
fields.JP:
コマンド選択時に□ボタンを押すと、
オート戦闘を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button when selecting
your command to use Auto-Battle.

fields.EN:
Press the Left Stick to toggle
between the Auto-Battle
types available.
fields.JP:
タッチパッドボタンの右クリックで、
オート戦闘のタイプを切替えられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Left Stick to toggle
between the Auto-Battle
types available.

fields.EN:
Holding the R Button during
battle effects lets you skip the
effect to make the battles faster.
fields.JP:
また、戦闘演出中にＲ１ボタンを押すと、
戦闘演出をスキップして高速戦闘ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Holding the R Button during
battle effects lets you skip the
effect to make the battles faster.

fields.EN:
These help to expedite battles,
but be careful using them when
facing powerful enemies.
fields.JP:
とても便利な機能ですが、
強敵との戦闘で使用する際には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These help to expedite battles,
but be careful using them when
facing powerful enemies.

fields.EN: There are various effects in battle, such as Poison, Paralysis, stat boosts, and more.
fields.JP:
戦闘では、毒、麻痺やステータスＵＰなど、
さまざまな状態効果が存在します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are various effects that can
be used in battle, such as Poison,
Stun, stat boosts, and more.

fields.EN:
Each effect is displayed in the
Blood Maiden's stat window, so
keep an eye on what's in effect.
fields.JP:
効果は各血式少女のステータスウィンドウに
表示されるため、状態効果アイコンを
意識しながら戦闘を行いましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each effect is displayed in the
Blood Maiden's stat window, so
keep an eye on what's in effect.

fields.EN:
If you need to confirm what
effects are on you, press the
− Button to verify.
fields.JP:
また、タッチパッドボタンの左クリックで
状態異常の詳細が確認できます
困ったときは確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you need to confirm what
effects are on you, press the
− Button to verify.

fields.EN:
Using a weapon or skill with the
"Bloodshot" effect has a chance of
triggering "Kagome-Kagome."
fields.JP:
武器やスキルに『血走り効果』がついていると、
一定確率でかごめかごめ効果が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using a weapon or skill with the
"Bloodshot" effect has a chance of
triggering "Kagome-Kagome."

fields.EN:
Kagome-Kagome forces the enemy
to turn around making them weaker
against attacks.
fields.JP:
かごめかごめ効果は、
敵を後ろに振り向かせる効果で、
発動中は敵はとても弱くなります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kagome-Kagome forces the enemy
to turn around making them weaker
against attacks.

fields.EN:
Battles occurring near gimmicks
may cause them to attack even
during battle.
fields.JP:
独房エリア内のギミックの付近で戦闘が始まると、
戦闘中にかかわらず、ギミックが攻撃してきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Battles occurring near gimmicks
may cause them to attack even
during battle.

fields.EN: Gimmicks aren't valid attack targets and can't be disabled, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ギミックは、攻撃対象ではなく、
無力化することができないので注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beware as gimmicks in battle
can't be destroyed.

fields.EN:
Blood Maiden's can use "Embrace"
against those in Blood Skelter and
Ripper Jack.
fields.JP:
血式少女のコマンド『抱きとめる』は、
『ブラッドスケルター』『ジャックリッパー』化した
仲間を対象に使用するコマンドです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maiden's can use "Embrace"
against those in Blood Skelter and
Ripper Jack.

fields.EN: When you use Embrace, if the target goes berserk and attacks, the character embracing them will take the attack.
fields.JP:
『抱きとめる』を使用すると、
対象が暴走して、攻撃した際、
抱きとめたキャラクターが攻撃を受け止めます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using Embrace will force those
targeted to attack the user of
Embrace.

fields.EN:
Use Embrace to tactically control
who is attacked, or let luck take
its toll. The choice is yours.
fields.JP:
抱きとめて、仲間への攻撃を完全に阻止するか
抱き留めずに、運に任せて放置するか、
プレイヤーの判断に委ねられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Embrace to tactically control
who is attacked, or let luck take
its toll. The choice is yours.

fields.EN: Aside from status ailments such as Poison, Sleep, and Paralysis, there's also an ailment called "Infection."
fields.JP:
戦闘では、毒、睡眠、麻痺といった状態異常
の他に、『感染』という状態異常があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aside from ailments, such as
Poison, Sleep, and Stun, one may
get inflicted with "Infection."

fields.EN: Infection comes in three types: Poison, Sleep, and Paralysis. Infection can spread between adjacent characters.
fields.JP:
『感染』には、毒、睡眠、麻痺の３種類あり、
感染の状態異常は、隣同士のキャラクターに
移されたり、移したりする効果があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Infection carries Poison, Sleep,
or Stun, and can infect adjacent
allies in battle.

fields.EN: Cure the ailment before the Infection spreads.
fields.JP: 感染が広がる前に、状態異常を治しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leaving it alone may lead to a
party's demise, so be sure to heal
those with the "Infection" effect.

fields.EN:
Critical Notice is a system where
you are notified beforehand that
your attack will be a critical.
fields.JP:
クリティカル攻撃予告は、
ターン開始時に、そのターンの攻撃が
クリティカルになることが確定するシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Critical Notice is a system where
you are notified beforehand that
your attack will be a critical.

fields.EN:
There are 3 levels to the notice.
The flashier the effect, the
stronger the critical attack.
fields.JP:
クリティカル攻撃予告には３段階あり、
演出が豪華になるほど、
高いクリティカル攻撃が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 3 levels to the notice.
The flashier the effect, the
stronger the critical attack.

fields.EN:
The effect has a greater chance of
occurring when using combos, or
using weapons with "Strike."
fields.JP:
戦闘中に、コンボをつなげていったり
装備品に『殴打属性』などを付けることで、
発生しやすくなります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The effect has a greater chance of
occurring when using combos, or
using weapons with "Strike."

fields.EN:
There are invincible creatures
called "Nightmares" in each
dungeon protecting the area.
fields.JP:
各ダンジョンには、『ナイトメア』と呼ばれる
無敵の看守が徘徊しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are invincible creatures
called "Nightmares" in each
dungeon protecting the area.

fields.EN:
Nightmares bring a white mist with
them, so if the dungeon becomes
white, be careful!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは真っ白い闇をまとっているため、
ダンジョン探索中に周囲が真っ白い闇に
包まれたら警戒が必要です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmares bring a white mist with
them, so if the dungeon becomes
white, be careful!

fields.EN:
If you encounter a Nightmare,
"Chase" will begin.
fields.JP:
もし闇の中でナイトメアに遭遇してしまうと、
恐怖の『虐殺鬼ごっこ』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter a Nightmare,
"Chase" will begin.

fields.EN:
Once Chase begins, the Nightmare
will chase the party until
everyone dies.
fields.JP:
虐殺鬼ごっこが発生すると、
ナイトメアは『プレイヤーが全滅』するまで
どこまでも追いかけてきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once Chase begins, the Nightmare
will chase the party until
everyone dies.

fields.EN:
If you can run far away from the
Nightmare, the chase will end,
and things will go back to normal.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアを引き離すことができれば
『逃亡成功』となり、通常の探索に戻ることが
できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can run far away from the
Nightmare, the chase will end,
and things will go back to normal.

fields.EN: If you encounter Marchens during a Chase, a "Booking Battle" occurs.
fields.JP:
また、虐殺鬼ごっこ中にメルヒェンに出会うと、
『ブッキングバトル』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter Marchens during
a Chase, a special battle will
occur.

fields.EN: During a Booking Battle, you can't move until the Marchens are defeated, and the Nightmare will attack you as well, so defeat the Marchens quickly.
fields.JP:
ブッキングバトルはメルヒェンを倒すまで移動できず、
ナイトメアからも攻撃を受けてしまうため、
速やかにメルヒェンを倒しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Nightmare will attack while
you're fighting the Marchens, so
defeat them as fast as you can.

fields.EN:
Note that the Blood Splatter that
occurs in battle may splatter the
blood onto the dungeon, too.
fields.JP:
戦闘中に発生する『血しぶき』は、
血式少女だけでなくダンジョンにも付着します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that the Blood Splatter that
occurs in battle may splatter the
blood onto the dungeon, too.

fields.EN:
The blood splatter will clear the
area, so it helps to cause blood
splatters whenever possible.
fields.JP:
血しぶきは真っ白い闇を照らす
道しるべとなるため、
普段から発生を狙っていくのも効果的です
fields.LOCALIZED:
The blood splatter will clear the
area, so it helps to cause blood
splatters whenever possible.

fields.EN:
If the Nightmare catches up to you
during a Chase, you may need to
face it in battle.
fields.JP:
鬼ごっこ中にナイトメアに追い詰められると、
戦って切り抜けるしかなくなる場合があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Nightmare catches up to you
during a Chase, you may need to
face it in battle.

fields.EN:
Press the A Button while standing
next to the Nightmare to enter
battle.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアに隣接して○ボタンを押すと、
戦闘に突入します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the A Button while standing
next to the Nightmare to enter
battle.

fields.EN:
You can knock down a Nightmare by
inflicting enough damage to it,
or by destroying its parts.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアは、部位を破壊する
もしくは、ダメージを蓄積させることで
『ノックダウン』状態になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can knock down a Nightmare by
inflicting enough damage to it,
or by destroying its parts.

fields.EN:
When the Nightmare is knocked down
the battle ends, and you can get
past the Nightmare to escape.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアがノックダウンすると戦闘が終了し、
ナイトメアを乗り越えて逃げることができます
いざという時に活用していきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the Nightmare is knocked down
the battle ends, and you can get
past the Nightmare to escape.

fields.EN:
Note that sometimes the "Move"
command may fail, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただし、『移動する』コマンドが
失敗する可能性もあるので注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that sometimes the "Move"
command may fail, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Destroying "cores" in the dungeon
allows you to defeat Nightmares
in that dungeon.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内にある『核』を破壊すると、
ナイトメアの討伐が可能になります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Destroying "cores" in the dungeon
allows you to defeat Nightmares
in that dungeon.

fields.EN:
If you encounter a Nightmare after
you destroy a core, you will enter
battle to defeat the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
核の破壊後にナイトメアと遭遇すると
ナイトメアを倒すための『討伐戦』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you encounter a Nightmare after
you destroy a core, you will enter
battle to defeat the Nightmare.

fields.EN: You cannot escape from the Nightmare during this battle, so use every means at your disposal to seize victory.
fields.JP:
討伐戦では、ナイトメアから逃げることは
できないため、あらゆる手段を駆使して
勝利をつかみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You won't be able to escape from
this battle, so be sure you're
well-prepared.

fields.EN:
You can view important information
and adjust settings through the
menu.
fields.JP:
メニューでは、さまざまな情報を確認したり、
設定したりすることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view important information
and adjust settings through the
menu.

fields.EN:
"Item," "Skill," and "Equipment"
allow you to view details of each
and use them as needed.
fields.JP:
『アイテム』では各種アイテムの使用、
『スキル』ではスキルの使用や確認、
『装備』では装備の変更が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Item," "Skill," and "Equipment"
allow you to view details of each
and use them as needed.

fields.EN: "Skill Custom" lets you learn and set new skills, as well as configure Blood Abilities.
fields.JP:
『スキルカスタム』では、
新たなスキルの習得やセットができるほか、
血式能力の設定もできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Customize Skills" lets you set
new Skills and Blood Abilities.

fields.EN:
Customizing skills is important
in strengthening a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
血式少女の強化を行うための
最重要項目のため、忘れずに利用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customizing skills is important
in strengthening a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
"Formation" lets you set party
members and partners.
fields.JP:
『編成』では、パーティメンバーの設定や
戦闘のサポートメンバーの設定が行えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Formation" lets you set party
members and partners.

fields.EN:
"Status" lets you view stats, and
"Area Info" lets you confirm Jail
Control and TriJail.
fields.JP:
『ステータス』では血式少女の能力の確認、
『エリア詳細』では、ジェイルマネージや
トライジェイルの確認ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Status" lets you view stats, and
"Area Info" lets you confirm Jail
Control and Jail Trial.

fields.EN:
"Library" lets you view work
orders, enemy details, and the
tutorial.
fields.JP:
『ライブラリ』では、受注した依頼や敵の情報、
チュートリアルなどを確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Library" lets you view work
orders, enemy details, and the
tutorial.

fields.EN:
"System" lets you save and load
data, change settings, and return
to the title screen.
fields.JP:
『システム』では、
データのセーブやロード、環境設定ができるほか、
タイトル画面に戻ることもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"System" lets you save and load
data, change settings, and return
to the title screen.

fields.EN:
There are 6 item categories: Items,
Equipment, Blood Crystals, Blood
Packs, Surprise Items, and Others.
fields.JP:
アイテムには、『道具』『装備』『血晶』
『ユ血液』『サプライズアイテム』『その他』の
６つのカテゴリーがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 6 item categories: Items,
Equipment, Blood Crystals, Blood
Packs, Surprise Items, and Others.

fields.EN:
"Items" lets you use items,
"Equipment" lets you access a
Blood Maiden's gear.
fields.JP:
『道具』は探索に役立つアイテム、
『装備』は血式少女の装備品です
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Items" lets you use items,
"Equipment" lets you access a
Blood Maiden's gear.

fields.EN:
"Surprise Items" lets you give
items to the Blood Maidens to
increase their affection.
fields.JP:
『サプライズアイテム』は、
血式少女に渡すことで友情度をアップできる
アイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Surprise Items" lets you give
items to the Blood Maidens to
increase their affection.

fields.EN:
"Blood Crystals" are needed to
change a Blood Maiden's job,
strengthen gear, and more.
fields.JP:
『血晶』は、血式少女の職業変更や
装備品の強化などに必要なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Crystals" are needed to
change a Blood Maiden's job,
strengthen gear, and more.

fields.EN:
"Blood Packs" are used to learn
special Blood Pack Skills.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液』は、血式少女に『ユ血液スキル』を
習得させる特殊なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Packs" are used to learn
special Blood Pack Skills.

fields.EN:
"Others" contains items that are
necessary in order to progress
through the game.
fields.JP:
『その他』は、物語を進めていく上で
重要なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Others" contains items that are
necessary in order to progress
through the game.

fields.EN:
If you have any unwanted items,
you can manage them in Tsuu's
room.
fields.JP:
不必要なアイテムは、
つうの部屋の格納庫で整理することもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have any unwanted items,
you can manage them in Otsuu's
room.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Under the Equipment menu there
are 4 types of gear: Weapons, Head
Gear, Body Armor, and Accessories.
fields.JP:
メニューの装備では、
『武器』『頭の防具』『体の防具』『装飾品』の
４種類を血式少女に装備させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Under the Equipment menu there
are 4 types of gear: Weapons, Head
Gear, Body Armor, and Accessories.

fields.EN:
Some equipment can only be used
by certain jobs.
fields.JP:
装備品には、血式少女の職業によって、
装備できるものとできないものがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some equipment can only be used
by certain jobs.

fields.EN: Equipment that the current job cannot equip cannot be selected.
fields.JP:
その職業では装備できない装備品は、
選択することができません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jobs that can't use any particular
equipment can't be selected.

fields.EN:
Obtain equipment from battles, as
treasures, at the Blood Farm, or
from Wandering Merchants.
fields.JP:
装備品は、宝箱や戦闘の報酬で手に入るほか、
ブラッドファームで収穫したり、
放浪商人から購入することもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Obtain equipment from battles, as
treasures, at the Blood Farm, or
from Wandering Merchants.

fields.EN:
You can set the skills to be used
by the Blood Maidens through
"Skill Set."
fields.JP:
スキルセットでは、血式少女が使用する
スキルをセットすることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can set the skills to be used
by the Blood Maidens through
"Skill Set."

fields.EN:
Be sure you set the skills you
learn through "Skill Creation."
fields.JP:
『スキルメイク』で新たなスキルを習得したら
必ずセットするようにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure you set the skills you
learn through "Skill Creation."

fields.EN:
Toggle the job you want to set a
skill to by selecting a skill slot
and pressing the R or L Button.
fields.JP:
セットしたい『スキル枠』を選択した状態で
Ｒ１ボタンやＬ１ボタンを押すと、
職業を切り替えることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toggle the job you want to set a
skill to by selecting a skill slot
and pressing the R or L Button.

fields.EN:
Customize your very own set of
skills by combining the skills you
learn from the jobs available.
fields.JP:
さまざまな職業で習得したスキルを
自由に組み合わせてカスタマイズしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customize your very own set of
skills by combining the skills you
learn from the jobs available.

fields.EN:
You can learn new skills for the
Blood Maidens to use through the
"Skill Creation" menu.
fields.JP:
スキルメイクでは、血式少女に
『新たなスキル』を習得させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can learn new skills for the
Blood Maidens to use through the
"Skill Creation" menu.

fields.EN:
To learn skills, you will need a
set amount of "CP," which can be
gained through leveling up.
fields.JP:
スキルの習得には、
レベルアップで得られる『ＣＰ』を使用します
fields.LOCALIZED:
To learn skills, you will need a
set amount of "CP," which can be
gained through leveling up.

fields.EN:
You can only use skills that are
preset, so be sure to set them
prior to use.
fields.JP:
習得したスキルは『スキルセット』で
セットしないと使用できないため、
必ずセットするようにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can only use skills that are
preset, so be sure to set them
prior to use.

fields.EN:
You can change the order of Blood
Abilities when checking Blood
Ability slots.
fields.JP:
血式能力スロットでは、
『血式能力』の並び替えができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can change the order of Blood
Abilities when checking Blood
Ability slots.

fields.EN:
Customize the order to your
liking, such as ordering them by
frequency of use.
fields.JP:
使う頻度の高い能力を並べるなど、
自分好みにカスタマイズしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customize the order to your
liking, such as ordering them by
frequency of use.

fields.EN:
You can select "Party Formation"
or "Partner" through the
"Formation" menu.
fields.JP:
編成では、『パーティ編成』と
『コンビネーション』の設定ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can select "Party Formation"
or "Partner" through the
"Formation" menu.

fields.EN: "Party Formation" lets you add or remove party members and swap their positions.
fields.JP:
『パーティ編成』では、
パーティメンバーの追加や除外を行えるほか、
メンバー同士の配置入れ替えもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Party Formation" lets you change
and shift members within your
party.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens in the middle are
often targeted, so place the
weaker ones on the outside.
fields.JP:
中心にいる血式少女ほど、
敵からやや狙われやすい傾向にあるため、
弱い血式少女は外側に配置してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens in the middle are
often targeted, so place the
weaker ones on the outside.

fields.EN:
You can also press the Y Button
to toggle allies on the front and 
rear lines.
fields.JP:
また、□ボタンで
前衛、後衛を切り替えることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also press the Y Button
to toggle allies on the front and 
rear lines.

fields.EN:
Those in the front deal and
receive full physical damage to
and from enemies.
fields.JP:
前衛は物理攻撃が１００％の威力を発揮しますが、
敵からの物理ダメージも１００％受けます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the front deal and
receive full physical damage to
and from enemies.

fields.EN:
Those in the rear deal and receive
half the physical damage to and
from enemies.
fields.JP:
後衛は物理攻撃の威力が半減する反面、
敵からの物理ダメージを半分に抑えられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those in the rear deal and receive
half the physical damage to and
from enemies.

fields.EN:
"Partner" lets you assign Blood
Maidens to support members in
the party.
fields.JP:
『コンビネーション』では、
それぞれのパーティメンバーに
サポートの血式少女を設定できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Partner" lets you assign Blood
Maidens to support members in
the party.

fields.EN:
Assigned Blood Maidens offer
support through attacking enemies
or healing their partners.
fields.JP:
サポートメンバーに設定した血式少女は、
戦闘中に攻撃や回復の補助をしてくれます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Assigned Blood Maidens offer
support through attacking enemies
or healing their partners.

fields.EN:
Be sure to assign partners once
you have enough Blood Maidens in
your party.
fields.JP:
血式少女が増えてきたら、
コンビを組ませて戦闘を有利に進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to assign partners once
you have enough Blood Maidens in
your party.

fields.EN: Under "BONUS," you can view "NOVEL," "GALLERY," "MUSIC," "CHARACTER," and "HEROINE'S MEMORIES."
fields.JP:
BONUSでは、『NOVEL』『GALLERY』『MUSIC』
『CHARACTER』『HEROINE'S MEMORIES』の
鑑賞ができます

fields.EN:
You can read the prologue to the
novel version of "Mary Skelter:
Nightmares" under "Novel."
fields.JP:
『NOVEL』では、前作の前日譚
【神獄塔 メアリスケルター～獄中童話前日譚～】
を全話読むことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can read the prologue to the
novel version of "Mary Skelter:
Nightmares" under "Novel."

fields.EN:
You can watch movies and view CGs
in the "Gallery," and listen to
BGM through "Music."
fields.JP:
『GALLERY』では、ムービーやＣＧなどの閲覧、
『MUSIC』では、ＢＧＭの試聴ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can watch movies and view CGs
in the "Gallery," and listen to
BGM through "Music."

fields.EN:
You can view character
illustrations under "Characters."
fields.JP:
『CHARACTER』では、キャラクターのイラストを
鑑賞することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view character
illustrations under "Characters."

fields.EN:
You can view various heroine
events under "Memories."
fields.JP:
『HEROINE'S MEMORIES』では、
ヒロインの個別イベントを回想できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view various heroine
events under "Memories."

fields.JP:
装備には『血走』、『鋭利』、『殴打』の
三つの付加効果があります

fields.EN:
"Bloodshot - Kagome-Kagome effect will go into effect.
"Slice" - Amount of bleeding will increase
"Strike" - Chance of critical will increase
fields.JP:
『血走』はかごめかごめ効果を発生させます
『鋭利』は出血量が上がります
『殴打』はクリティカルの発生率が上がります
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Bloodshot - Kagome-Kagome effect will go into effect.
"Slice" - Amount of bleeding will increase
"Strike" - Chance of critical will increase

fields.EN: There will be 3 grades for the +ailments. "Silver", "Gold", "Platinum". When the grade is higher the higher the chance of the effects.
fields.JP:
付加効果には『ノーマル』『ゴールド』『プラチナ』の
三つのグレードがあり、グレードが上がると
発生率や効果が高くなります。
fields.LOCALIZED: There will be 3 grades for the +ailments. "Silver", "Gold", "Platinum". When the grade is higher the higher the chance of the effects.

fields.EN: If you equip yourself with the same effects, then the effects and the rate for it happening will increase. Try a combination that matches your style!
fields.JP:
同じ付加効果は複数装備することで
効果や確率が上がります
自分の戦術にあった組み合わせを見つけてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: If you equip yourself with the same effects, then the effects and the rate for it happening will increase. Try a combination that matches your style!

fields.EN: So, what is it that you need?
fields.JP: それで、頼みたいことって何だい？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, what is it that you need?

fields.EN:
Well, the shelves I had at
the store broke.
fields.JP: 実はさ、販売所の棚が壊れちゃったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the shelves I had at
the store broke.

fields.JP: え？　それ大丈夫なのかい？

fields.EN:
Yeah, I'm fine, but it makes life
a pain without them.
fields.JP:
まぁ、大丈夫って言ったら大丈夫なんだけど、
やっぱりちょっと不便なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I'm fine, but it makes life
a pain without them.

fields.EN:
So, you want us to find you some
shelves?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、依頼っていうのは僕たちに、
棚を探してきてくれってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you want us to find you some
shelves?

fields.EN:
That would be ideal, but I doubt
you'd find any good ones out
there.
fields.JP:
それでもいいけど、
壊れてない棚を見つけるのは大変でしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
