That would be ideal, but I doubt
you'd find any good ones out
there.

fields.EN:
I'll make the shelves themselves, so I'd like
you and the others to bring me any usable wood
you find, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
棚自体はあたしが作るから、
おつうちゃん達には使えそうな木材を
持ってきてほしいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead, do you mind keeping an
eye out for wood that I can use
to make the shelves with?

fields.EN:
I see... Wood...
I wonder where I can find them.
fields.JP:
なるほど……木材か……
何処かにあったかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Wood...
I wonder where I can find them.

fields.EN:
Oh, and like I said, it only makes
life a bit of a pain, so keep it
low on your priority list.
fields.JP:
ああ、さっきも言ったけど、
ちょっと不便ってだけだから、
木材は見つかったらでいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, and like I said, it only makes
life a bit of a pain, so keep it
low on your priority list.

fields.EN:
Got it.
If we stumble on some, we'll
be sure to bring them back.
fields.JP:
わかった
見つけたら持っていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it.
If we stumble on some, we'll
be sure to bring them back.

fields.EN:
These look perfect to make
shelves with. I better bring them
back to Kaede.
fields.JP:
これなら棚を作るのにちょうど良さそうだな
戻ったら依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These look perfect to make
shelves with. I better bring them
back to Kaede.

fields.EN: I found some wood for you.
fields.JP: 良さそうな木材を持ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I found some wood for you.

fields.EN:
Thanks! Now I can make the shelves!
I should get started right away. I can't wait!
fields.JP:
ありがとう！　これで棚が作れるわ！
早速作らなくっちゃね。腕が鳴るわよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks! I can make new shelves
with these! I'm gonna get started
pronto!
fields.notes: B14 remove localization-only pronto verbal tic

fields.EN:
You're going to make them now?
Do you mind if I watch?
fields.JP:
今から作るのかい？
だったら見学していいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're going to make them now?
Do you mind if I watch?

fields.EN:
Huh...
So that's how you make a shelf?
fields.JP: へぇ……棚ってこういう風に作るんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...
So that's how you make a shelf?

fields.EN:
All I did was hammer some nails
here and there, so it's a bit
rickety, but heck, it'll work...
fields.JP:
ただ釘で組み立ててるだけだから、
ガッタガタだけどね
まぁ、それでも無いよりかマシ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I did was hammer some nails
here and there, so it's a bit
rickety, but heck, it'll work...

fields.EN:
No problem! All I have to do is
put it back together again! We
have more wood too, so...
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫大丈夫
また組み立てなおせばいいだけだし、
木材はまだあるから――あ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem! All I have to do is
put it back together again! We
have more wood too, so...

fields.EN:
(Maybe the shelves broke because
of her...)
fields.JP:
（もしかして……棚が壊れたのって……
　カエデの力が強すぎたから？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe the shelves broke because
of her...)

fields.EN:
So, you wanted to see me?
What is it?
fields.JP:
それで？
僕たちに頼みたいことって何だい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you wanted to see me?
What is it?

fields.JP: おー、よくぞ聞いてくれました！

fields.EN:
See, I wanted to dismantle a rare
part I found, but I don't have the
proper tools to do it.
fields.JP:
いやさー、結構珍しい部品見つけたから
解体したいんだけど、
工具が足りないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
See, I wanted to dismantle a rare
part I found, but I don't have the
proper tools to do it.

fields.EN:
Tools? You mean like a
screwdriver?
fields.JP: 工具っていうとドライバーとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tools? You mean like a
screwdriver?

fields.EN:
Bingo! That's exactly what I'm
missing. Oh, but I need one of
them tiny screwdrivers, you dig?
fields.JP:
そうそう、正にドライバーが足りないんだよ
つっても普通のじゃなくて、
極小ドライバーなんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bingo! That's exactly what I'm
missing. Oh, but I need one of
them tiny screwdrivers, you dig?

fields.EN:
So, my mission to you! Is!
Can you please bring me back
a mini-screwdriver?
fields.JP:
んで、君たちにお願いしたいのは
この極小ドライバーを探して持ってくること
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, my mission to you! Is!
Can you please bring me back
a mini-screwdriver?

fields.EN:
Sure thing, but I can't assure you
that we will find it...
fields.JP:
分かった
と言っても、見つかるかどうかは
分からないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing, but I can't assure you
that we will find it...

fields.EN:
Eh, if you can is fine. Not like
I need it right away anyway. Just
drop it off to me if you find one.
fields.JP:
まぁ、出来たらでいいよ
どうしても必要ってわけじゃないしねー
一応見つけたら、持ってきてほしいってだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eh, if you can is fine. Not like
I need it right away anyway. Just
drop it off to me if you find one.

fields.EN:
Will do. If I find one
I'll bring it to you.
fields.JP:
わかった
もし見つけたら持っていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do. If I find one
I'll bring it to you.

fields.EN:
Is this the mini-screwdriver
Takumi wanted? I better bring
it back to him.
fields.JP:
極小ドライバーってこれかな？
依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this the mini-screwdriver
Takumi wanted? I better bring
it back to him.

fields.EN:
Is this the mini-screwdriver you
were asking for?
fields.JP:
この前言ってた極小ドライバーって、
これのことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this the mini-screwdriver you
were asking for?

fields.EN:
Ooh! That's the one!
I didn't expect ya to find one!
fields.JP:
お、お～！　これこれ！
マジで見つけて来たのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! That's the one!
I didn't expect ya to find one!

fields.EN:
Didn't expect...?
Wait... You didn't think we'd
bring you back one?
fields.JP:
マジでって……
見つかると思ってなかったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't expect...?
Wait... You didn't think we'd
bring you back one?

fields.EN: To be honest, I didn't think you'd find one.
fields.JP: 正直に言うと見つかると思ってなかった

fields.EN:
C'mon, man, this stuff is
pretty darn rare. Also means
I super appreciate you found one.
fields.JP:
いやだってこれ結構レアなんだぜ？
だから、本当に感謝してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
C'mon, man, this stuff is
pretty darn rare. Also means
I super appreciate you found one.

fields.EN:
It feels weird to hear you
thanking me...
fields.JP:
……なんか、
タクミに素直にお礼言われると調子が狂うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It feels weird to hear you
thanking me...

fields.EN:
Ouch... Well, I don't blame you
for saying that. Anyway, many
thanks for bringing one back.
fields.JP:
酷いなー。ま、自覚してるけどね
それだけ嬉しかったってことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch... Well, I don't blame you
for saying that. Anyway, many
thanks for bringing one back.

fields.EN:
Now then, I better get back to
business!
fields.JP: これでいろいろ作業が捗るからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I better get back to
business!

fields.EN:
Okay, well, good to hear...
As long as you're happy.
fields.JP:
そうか……なら、
こっちも素直にお礼を受け取っておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, well, good to hear...
As long as you're happy.

fields.EN:
(I guess Takumi can be honest as
long as it has something to do
with what he likes.)
fields.JP:
（タクミも好きな物の前では、
　素直な反応になるんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess Takumi can be honest as
long as it has something to do
with what he likes.)

fields.EN:
A bag of beans... I assume it's
not very large, so I better keep
my eyes open for it.
fields.JP:
豆袋かぁ。小さい物だろうから、
見落とさないように気をつけておかないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
A bag of beans... I assume it's
not very large, so I better keep
my eyes open for it.

fields.EN:
I'm not surprised it got lost
after being chased by a Marchen.
I hope I can find it...
fields.JP:
大事な物でも、メルヒェンに追われたら
たしかにそれどころじゃなくて落とし
ちゃうよな。見つかるといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not surprised it got lost
after being chased by a Marchen.
I hope I can find it...

fields.EN:
This must be it...
Glad I found the bag of beans.
fields.JP:
ああ、これが例の豆袋かな。
見つかってよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
This must be it...
Glad I found the bag of beans.

fields.EN:
The beans must be pretty special
since they were kept in a special
bag...
fields.JP:
中身は豆、だよな？
袋に入れて大事に持っていたくらいだから、
なにか特別な豆だったのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The beans must be pretty special
since they were kept in a special
bag...

fields.EN:
It's nice they shared some beans,
but what should I do with them?
fields.JP:
豆袋を見つけたお礼にって、
少し豆を分けてもらったけど……。
うーん、どうしよう、これ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nice they shared some beans,
but what should I do with them?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh, this?
It's some beans I got after
returning the bag of beans.
fields.JP:
ああ、これ？
依頼のお礼にもらった豆だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh, this?
It's some beans I got after
returning the bag of beans.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Huh? You want them, Jack?
What are you going to do
with them?
fields.JP:
へ？　ジャック、この豆欲しいの？
どうするつもりだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You want them, Jack?
What are you going to do
with them?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Oh, you're going to eat them?
I never thought you'd want them,
but...
fields.JP:
ふぅん？　食べるんだ。
珍しいこと言うね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're going to eat them?
I never thought you'd want them,
but...

fields.EN:
Not like I need them anyway...
Let me toss them into your
mouth. Open wide...
fields.JP:
まぁ、いいや。
僕が持っていても仕方ないし、
欲しいならあげるよ。はい、あーん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not like I need them anyway...
Let me toss them into your
mouth. Open wide...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック
はぐっ、ぽりぽりぽり……ごっくん
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: (Maybe he used to like beans? Jack and beans... It kind of suits him, and kind of doesn't. I can't really tell...)
fields.JP:
（もしかして昔は豆が好きだったのかな？
　ジャックと豆……。イメージが合うような
　合わないような。よくわからないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Jack liked beans from
before. Weird, Jack and beans
feel so natural together...)

fields.EN:
I know I'm going to ask
something unreasonable, but do
you mind listening to me?
fields.JP:
ダメ元で申し訳ないのだが……
君たちに頼みたいことがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm going to ask
something unreasonable, but do
you mind listening to me?

fields.EN:
Sure.
What is it you want to ask?
fields.JP:
それは構わないけど……
頼みたいことっていうのはなんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure.
What is it you want to ask?

fields.EN:
Can you find me a blood sample?
There may be one left behind at
the old Liberated District.
fields.JP:
「血液サンプル」を探してきてほしい
元解放区になら残っているかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you find me a blood sample?
There may be one left behind at
the old Liberated District.

fields.EN:
I highly doubt there's any left,
but if you happen across one,
please bring it back to me.
fields.JP:
だが、さっきも言った通りこれはダメ元だ
正直、今も残っている可能性は低いだろう
だから、できればで構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I highly doubt there's any left,
but if you happen across one,
please bring it back to me.

fields.EN:
Understood. We'll keep an eye
out for one when we're at the
old Liberated District.
fields.JP:
わかった
余裕があるときに、
元解放区で探してみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. We'll keep an eye
out for one when we're at the
old Liberated District.

fields.EN:
I don't see any Marchens around
now, so I should check and see
if there's any blood samples left.
fields.JP:
今ならメルヒェンはいないみたいだし、
「血液サンプル」を探してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see any Marchens around
now, so I should check and see
if there's any blood samples left.

fields.JP: 奥の方なら見つかるかな？

fields.EN:
I don't see any...
I guess they all went missing.
fields.JP:
なかなか見つからないな……
やっぱり残ってないのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see any...
I guess they all went missing.

fields.EN:
Hm...? Is this it? I think this
is what Itsuki was referring to.
I better bring it back to him.
fields.JP:
…………ん？　これじゃないか？
うん。たぶんそうだ
よし、持っていこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...? Is this it? I think this
is what Itsuki was referring to.
I better bring it back to him.

fields.EN: Itsuki, I found a blood sample.
fields.JP: イツキ、「血液サンプル」見つけて来たよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Itsuki, I found a blood sample.

fields.EN:
This is it! Thank you!
This should help accelerate my
research!
fields.JP:
ああ、これだ！
ありがとう感謝する！
これで、研究が進むだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is it! Thank you!
This should help accelerate my
research!

fields.EN:
I'm surprised you were able to
find one remaining among
the ruins.
fields.JP:
しかし、あれだけの事があったのに
残っていたのは奇跡だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised you were able to
find one remaining among
the ruins.

fields.EN:
I didn't expect to find one too,
but I guess luck was on our side.
fields.JP:
正直僕も残ってないと思ってたよ
日ごろの行いがよかったのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect to find one too,
but I guess luck was on our side.

fields.EN:
Sorry, Otsuu. You mind if I ask
you something?
fields.JP:
すまん、おつう
ちょっと相談があるんだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Otsuu. You mind if I ask
you something?

fields.JP: 相談？　別にいいけど……なんだい？

fields.EN:
Well, you know how Hameln's
familiars are helping with the
rounds, right?
fields.JP:
ああ、この解放区の見回りなんかを
ハーメルンの下僕のメルヒェン達に、
手伝ってもらってるんだけどさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you know how Hameln's
familiars are helping with the
rounds, right?

fields.EN:
But it's a bit of a pain to gather
them together, since they're
all over the place.
fields.JP:
いちいち声かけて回らないと
集まって来ないから、
頼み事するのめんどうなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's a bit of a pain to gather
them together, since they're
all over the place.

fields.EN:
So, I was thinking maybe there's
something I can use to gather
them. You got any clues?
fields.JP:
それで、あいつらを集めるための
道具かなんかあればいいと思うんだが、
なんか心当たりはないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I was thinking maybe there's
something I can use to gather
them. You got any clues?

fields.EN:
Mmm... Not really.
Any ideas, Hameln?
fields.JP:
うーん……僕はちょっと思いつかないな
ハーメルンはどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Not really.
Any ideas, Hameln?

fields.EN:
Heh! They are my minions!
Of course they'd only listen
to me!
fields.JP:
ふふん！　あ奴らはこのワレの下僕だぞ？
ワレ以外に統率できるわけがなかろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh! They are my minions!
Of course they'd only listen
to me!

fields.EN:
Which means Hameln has no
clue, too.
fields.JP: ハーメルンにも心当たりはないみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means Hameln has no
clue, too.

fields.EN:
I see...
Well, it was worth the try.
fields.JP:
そうか……わかった
じゃあしょうがねぇな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Well, it was worth the try.

fields.EN:
Not that I can't communicate
with them... Well, thanks for
listening.
fields.JP:
めんどうだけど、
どうにもならないわけじゃないしな
この話は気にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that I can't communicate
with them... Well, thanks for
listening.

fields.EN:
Come now, we'll see if there's
anything that can help. We may
find something out there.
fields.JP:
そういうわけにもいかないだろ
外で何か探してくるから待っててくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come now, we'll see if there's
anything that can help. We may
find something out there.

fields.EN:
You girls are busy though.
You sure about that?
fields.JP: でも忙しいだろ？　いいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You girls are busy though.
You sure about that?

fields.EN:
I can't guarantee we'll find
something, but we can at least
try.
fields.JP:
片手間で探すくらいならできるよ
見つかるかどうかは分からないけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't guarantee we'll find
something, but we can at least
try.

fields.JP: 探してくれるだけでも大助かりだ

fields.EN:
Maybe Mamoru can use this to
get Hameln's familiars together.
fields.JP:
これならマモルがハーメルンの
下僕を集めるのに使えるかもな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Mamoru can use this to
get Hameln's familiars together.

fields.EN:
Mamoru, about that thing about
gathering the familiars...
Maybe this will help.
fields.JP:
マモル。この間のことだけど、
これなら集められるんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, about that thing about
gathering the familiars...
Maybe this will help.

fields.EN:
A whistle? I guess this may work.
Let me try...
fields.JP:
これは……笛か。
確かに、これなら良さそうだな
ちょっと試してみるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A whistle? I guess this may work.
Let me try...

fields.EN:
Whoa! They're all coming!
I won't need to go around trying
to corral them!
fields.JP:
おお！　集まってきた！
これでいちいち呼び回らなくてすむぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! They're all coming!
I won't need to go around trying
to corral them!

fields.JP: 上手くいったみたいでよかったよ

fields.EN:
Yeah, and it's all thanks to you!
You're the best!
fields.JP:
ああ、おまえらのおかげだ！
ありがとうな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, and it's all thanks to you!
You're the best!

fields.EN:
I didn't expect my minions to
gather with just a whistle...
fields.JP:
ワレの下僕は笛で集まる様な、
単純な奴らだったのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect my minions to
gather with just a whistle...

fields.EN:
Glad to see ya!
I'm soooo in need of help!
fields.JP:
よく来てくれたわ～
もうホント私、今困ってるのよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad to see ya!
I'm soooo in need of help!

fields.EN:
Uh, you sound worse than usual...
What's the matter?
fields.JP:
なんかいつも以上に様子がおかしいけど、
どうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, you sound worse than usual...
What's the matter?

fields.EN:
Um...
I found cockroaches in my room.
fields.JP: それが……私の部屋にゴキブリが出たのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um...
I found cockroaches in my room.

fields.JP:
そうよ！　
もうマジムリ！

fields.EN:
I'm never gonna be able to
sleep again with them around!
fields.JP:
あんなのがいる部屋じゃ、
私眠れないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm never gonna be able to
sleep again with them around!

fields.EN:
You're blowing this all out
of proportion...
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're blowing this all out
of proportion...

fields.EN:
No, I'm not! Pretty please!
Bring me something that can
get rid of 'em roaches!
fields.JP:
大げさじゃないんだよ～！
お願いだから、なんかゴキブリを
退治できる物を持ってきてちょうだい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm not! Pretty please!
Bring me something that can
get rid of 'em roaches!

fields.EN:
Huh... But, aren't Marchens
scarier than roaches?
fields.JP:
えぇ……
だいたいゴキブリより、
メルヒェンの方が怖いじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh... But, aren't Marchens
scarier than roaches?

fields.EN:
The type of scare they each induce
is different! So, please!
Pretty please with sugar on it!
fields.JP:
それとこれとは恐怖の種類が違うのよ～
ね？　お願い！　ほ～んとに、お願い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The type of scare they each induce
is different! So, please!
Pretty please with sugar on it!

fields.EN:
*sigh* Fine...
You're going to owe me one.
fields.JP:
はぁ……わかったよ
これは貸しだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Fine...
You're going to owe me one.

fields.EN:
A poison dumpling?
I guess this can get rid of the
roaches bothering Takumi...
fields.JP:
これは……ほうさん団子？
ゴキブリ殺せるみたいだし、これでいいか
fields.LOCALIZED:
A poison dumpling?
I guess this can get rid of the
roaches bothering Takumi...

fields.EN:
Ooh! I can use it to get rid of
the roaches! Thanks, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
おお！　これで奴らを退治できるわー！
ありがとう！　おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! I can use it to get rid of
the roaches! Thanks, Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
No problem. Glad to hear...
Hm? Isn't that a cockroach?
fields.JP:
はいはい。それは良かったね……って、
そこにいるのゴキブリじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem. Glad to hear...
Hm? Isn't that a cockroach?

fields.EN:
Aha! We meet again!
Time for you to perish!
fields.JP:
此処であったが百年目！
成敗でござるー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aha! We meet again!
Time for you to perish!

fields.EN:
Heh...
The evil has been dispatched.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh...
The evil has been dispatched.

fields.EN:
You're not scared of
them at all...
fields.JP: タクミ、ゴキブリ平気じゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not scared of
them at all...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Hey, Jack.
What are you doing here?
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャック。こんなところにいたのか。
ボーっとしてどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Jack.
What are you doing here?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
That? Oh, you were looking at
the Jail Tower?
fields.JP:
あれって……監獄塔を見てたのか？
ふーん
fields.LOCALIZED:
That? Oh, you were looking at
the Jail Tower?

fields.EN:
(Jack sometimes does strange
things. I shouldn't be surprised
though since he is a Nightmare.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックってときどき不思議な行動
　するよなぁ。まぁ、ナイトメアなんだから
　人間の基準で考えても仕方ないけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack sometimes does strange
things. I shouldn't be surprised
though since he is a Nightmare.)

fields.EN:
That aside, we have a mission.
Let's get going, Jack.
fields.JP:
それより依頼を受けたんだ。
行こう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, we have a mission.
Let's get going, Jack.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Say, Otsuu-chan? Jack-san's been staring at
the tower the whole day.
Do you know why?
fields.JP:
ねぇ、おつうちゃん。
ジャックさん、今日はずっと監獄塔を見てるの。
どうしたんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, Otsuu? Jack's been staring at
the tower the whole day.
Do you know why?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(He was like that the last time,
too. I wonder why he's staring
at it...)
fields.JP:
（たしか、依頼を受ける前もあんな感じ
　だったっけ。本当にどうしたんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He was like that the last time,
too. I wonder why he's staring
at it...)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Jack, you're looking at the tower
again, are you?
fields.JP: ジャック、また監獄塔を見てたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you're looking at the tower
again, are you?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Are you that interested in it?
Like, you want to have it?
fields.JP:
そんなに監獄塔が気になるのか？
あれが欲しいとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you that interested in it?
Like, you want to have it?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Up? You want to climb the tower?
fields.JP: 上？　あの上に登りたいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Up? You want to climb the tower?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Well, that's going to be a
tough climb.
fields.JP: はは、それは大変そうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's going to be a
tough climb.

fields.EN: (He wants to climb the Jail Tower... Is that a Nightmare instinct, or Jack's own wish...? Either way, it's a strange urge.)
fields.JP:
（監獄塔に登りたい、か。ナイトメアとしての
　本能か、ジャック自身の望みか……。
　どちらにしても不思議な欲求だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if wanting to climb the
tower is Jack's desire? A pretty
odd desire if you ask me.)

fields.EN: What is it you want, Hikari?
fields.JP: それで、ヒカリが頼みたいことって何だい？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it you want, Hikari?

fields.EN: Um, it's not absolutely necessary, so only if you can, but I'd like you to find some helmets for me.
fields.JP:
えーと、絶対に必要ってわけじゃないから、
できればでいいんだけど、
ヘルメットをいくつか探してきてほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, not that I really need it
right away, but do you mind
finding some helmets for me?

fields.EN:
Yup!
Oh, and large ones at that.
fields.JP:
うん！　
それも、ちょっと大きめの物が欲しくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup!
Oh, and large ones at that.

fields.EN:
Large helmets...
Okay, I'll keep my eye out for
them.
fields.JP:
大きめのヘルメットか……
分かった。探してみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Large helmets...
Okay, I'll keep my eye out for
them.

fields.EN:
Thanks!
Oh, but really, no need to go
out of your way for them.
fields.JP:
ありがとう！
でも、無理しなくていいからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks!
Oh, but really, no need to go
out of your way for them.

fields.EN:
Will do.
Well, I'll be going now.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ
じゃあ、行ってくる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will do.
Well, I'll be going now.

fields.EN:
I wonder if these helmets would
work for Hikari? I better take
them back with me.
fields.JP:
大きめのヘルメットってこれでいいのかな
ヒカリのところに持って行ってみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if these helmets would
work for Hikari? I better take
them back with me.

fields.EN:
I brought the helmets, but will
these do?
fields.JP:
ヘルメット持ってきたけど、
これでいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I brought the helmets, but will
these do?

fields.EN:
Let me see...
Yup, they should work just fine!
fields.JP:
えーっと……うん
これならたぶん大丈夫！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see...
Yup, they should work just fine!

fields.EN:
That's good to hear.
So, what were you planning on
doing with them?
fields.JP:
そうか、それはよかった
それで？　このヘルメットは
なんに使うんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear.
So, what were you planning on
doing with them?

fields.EN:
I was gonna hand them out to
Hameln-chan's familiars.
fields.JP:
このヘルメットはね
ハーメルンちゃんのしもべさん達に
渡そうと思ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was gonna hand them out to
Hameln's familiars.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンちゃん => Hameln-chan

fields.EN:
They go out to dangerous places
too, right?
fields.JP:
しもべさん達は危険なところにも
行ってもらってるでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They go out to dangerous places
too, right?

fields.EN:
So, I wanted to give them these
so that they can avoid getting
hurt from above.
fields.JP:
だから、少しでも怪我しないように、
せめてヘルメットを着けてあげたいって、
思ったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, I wanted to give them these
so that they can avoid getting
hurt from above.

fields.EN:
I see. I'm sure they'd all be
happy you got them the helmets.
fields.JP:
なるほど
きっとしもべ達も喜んでくれるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. I'm sure they'd all be
happy you got them the helmets.

fields.EN:
(She's so kind...
She even extended her
kindness to the Marchens...)
fields.JP:
（メルヒェンまで心配するなんて、
　この子は本当に優しい子だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so kind...
She even extended her
kindness to the Marchens...)

fields.EN:
I was planning on making something
cool, but I don't have the
propellers I need, so...
fields.JP:
今ちょっと作ろうと思ってる物があるだけど、
プロペラが足りないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was planning on making something
cool, but I don't have the
propellers I need, so...

fields.EN:
So you want us to find some
for you, right?
fields.JP: それを僕たちが持ってくればいいんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you want us to find some
for you, right?

fields.EN:
Bingo!
You know me like a book!
fields.JP:
そうそうそのとーり！
いやぁ、話が早いねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bingo!
You know me like a book!

fields.EN:
Oh, but it's only cool and not
super important, so whenever
you come across some is fine.
fields.JP:
まぁでも、今作ってるのは
必需品ってわけじゃないから、
もし、見つかったらでいいよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but it's only cool and not
super important, so whenever
you come across some is fine.

fields.EN:
Okay, we'll keep an eye out
for some.
fields.JP: とりあえず、探すだけ探してみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, we'll keep an eye out
for some.

fields.EN:
I guess these propellers will do.
I wonder what Takumi is planning
to make with them.
fields.JP:
プロペラってこれだよな
タクミは一体何を作ろうとしてるんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess these propellers will do.
I wonder what Takumi is planning
to make with them.

fields.EN:
I'll just take them to him and
ask him then.
fields.JP:
とりあえず持って行って、
そのときに聞いてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll just take them to him and
ask him then.

fields.EN:
Here are some propellers.
Will these work?
fields.JP:
プロペラを持ってきたよ
これでいいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here are some propellers.
Will these work?

fields.EN:
Ooh! Nice! Thanks!
Man, these are gonna spin
like crazy!
fields.JP:
おおー！　これこれ！　ありがとう！
いやぁ、実によく回りそうな、
いいプロペラだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh! Nice! Thanks!
Man, these are gonna spin
like crazy!

fields.EN:
So, what in the world are you
planning on making?
fields.JP:
それで、いったい何を
作ろうとしてるんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what in the world are you
planning on making?

fields.EN:
Glad ya asked! I'm a-making us
some electric fans!
fields.JP:
よくぞ聞いてくれたわね！
私は今、扇風機を作っているのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad ya asked! I'm a-making us
some electric fans!

fields.EN:
Oh, I see. That's what you meant
by "cool." It can get hot and
muggy around here.
fields.JP:
あ、なるほど
ここは確かに蒸し暑いし、
ちょうどいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I see. That's what you meant
by "cool." It can get hot and
muggy around here.

fields.EN:
Right? I should have a number of
them ready soon enough, so I'll
bring ya one later.
fields.JP:
でしょでしょ
幾つか作れるから、
できたら持って行ってあげるね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? I should have a number of
them ready soon enough, so I'll
bring ya one later.

fields.EN:
They did help keep the temperature
in check back at Dawn, so I'd
love to get one. Thanks.
fields.JP:
黎明時代のときも部屋にあると、
大分過ごしやすかったからね
是非お願いするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They did help keep the temperature
in check back at Dawn, so I'd
love to get one. Thanks.

fields.EN:
Say, we have a lot of girls
with us now, right?
fields.JP: 最近さ、人がずいぶん増えたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, we have a lot of girls
with us now, right?

fields.EN:
Yes, and some of them are
Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
うん。
僕たちの仲間も増えたからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, and some of them are
Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
So yeah, I'm getting a lot of
orders for hairpins now.
Lost all my inventory already.
fields.JP:
それで、髪留めを注文する
人が増えたんだけど、
在庫が無くなっちゃったのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So yeah, I'm getting a lot of
orders for hairpins now.
Lost all my inventory already.

fields.EN:
If you come across hairpins during
your expeditions, can you bring
them to me?
fields.JP:
だから、出来たらでいいんだけど、
髪留めになりそうなものがあったら、
拾ってきてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you come across hairpins during
your expeditions, can you bring
them to me?

fields.EN:
Got it. I wouldn't mind getting
one too myself anyway.
fields.JP:
わかった、いいよ
僕もちょっと欲しいしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. I wouldn't mind getting
one too myself anyway.

fields.JP:
よかった～
じゃあ、よろしくね

fields.EN:
That should be enough hairpins
for Kaede. I better head back.
fields.JP:
髪留めはこれだけあればいいかな
依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That should be enough hairpins
for Kaede. I better head back.

fields.EN:
Kaede, I brought some hairpins
back.
fields.JP: カエデ、髪留め持ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede, I brought some hairpins
back.

fields.EN:
Really?! Thanks!
I think what you have
there will do.
fields.JP:
本当に！？　ありがとう！
これだけあれば、当分は大丈夫だと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! Thanks!
I think what you have
there will do.

fields.EN:
These are all so cute! But, I'm
sure the guys are gonna be a
bit hesitant to use them.
fields.JP:
でも、見事に可愛いヘアピンばかりね
これを男の人がつけるのは、躊躇しそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
These are all so cute! But, I'm
sure the guys are gonna be a
bit hesitant to use them.

fields.EN:
Well, they're going to have to
get over it.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、その辺は
我慢してもらうしかないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, they're going to have to
get over it.

fields.EN:
Yeah, we're just lucky you were
able to come across them.
fields.JP:
ま、それもそうね
見つかっただけよしと思わなくちゃね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, we're just lucky you were
able to come across them.

fields.EN:
Speaking of, your hair is pretty
long, so why don't you use
one of these hairpins?
fields.JP:
ところで、カエデも結構髪長いけど
こういう可愛いヘアピンは使わないのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of, your hair is pretty
long, so why don't you use
one of these hairpins?

fields.EN:
Oh, hell no! I don't look good
with them on!
fields.JP:
ないない！　
ガサツなあたしがこんなの着けても
似合わないって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, hell no! I don't look good
with them on!

fields.EN:
I don't think so.
I think they'd look cute on you.
fields.JP:
そうかな？
けっこう似合うと思うけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think so.
I think they'd look cute on you.

fields.EN:
Yes. Like, this red hairpin would
look great on you.
fields.JP:
うん
ほら、この赤っぽいのとか似合いそうだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Like, this red hairpin would
look great on you.

fields.EN:
Well, I guess I can try some of
them on... They are cute, too.
fields.JP:
そう言うなら、気が向いたらあたしも
たまには可愛いヘアピンを着けてみようかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess I can try some of
them on... They are cute, too.

fields.EN:
(Kaede may not show it,
but she really has a nice,
feminine side to her.)
fields.JP:
（なんだかんだ言っても、
　興味がある辺りカエデも女の子だよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaede may not show it,
but she really has a nice,
feminine side to her.)

fields.EN:
I have a personal request that
I was hoping wouldn't be
much of a bother for you.
fields.JP:
すまない。私的な事なので、
本来なら頼むべきじゃないのかもしれないが、
ちょっと困っていてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a personal request that
I was hoping wouldn't be
much of a bother for you.

fields.EN:
No problem, but what is it
that you want?
fields.JP:
それはいいけど、
困ってるっていったいどうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No problem, but what is it
that you want?

fields.EN:
It seems as if my vision has taken
a nosedive recently, and my
glasses aren't helping much now.
fields.JP:
いや、実はどうにも視力が落ちたようでな
眼鏡の度が合わないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems as if my vision has taken
a nosedive recently, and my
glasses aren't helping much now.

fields.EN:
You're losing your vision...?
Are you all right?
fields.JP: 視力が落ちたって……大丈夫なのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're losing your vision...?
Are you all right?

fields.EN:
It's not as bad as it sounds, but
it is hampering my research
progress.
fields.JP:
日常生活を送る上では問題ない
ただ、研究の時に少し不便でな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not as bad as it sounds, but
it is hampering my research
progress.

fields.EN:
So, what I was hoping was for
you to find me a pair of lenses
that I can use for my glasses.
fields.JP:
それで、君たちにお願いしたいのは
眼鏡か眼鏡のレンズを探してきて欲しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what I was hoping was for
you to find me a pair of lenses
that I can use for my glasses.

fields.EN:
Sure I can do that, but there's no
assurance that what I find
will correct your vision.
fields.JP:
それはいいけど……
持ってきたものが度が合うとは限らないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure I can do that, but there's no
assurance that what I find
will correct your vision.

fields.EN:
That shouldn't be a problem.
I can adjust them a bit to conform
better to my vision.
fields.JP:
そのあたりは大丈夫だ
ある程度ならこちらで調整できる
fields.LOCALIZED:
That shouldn't be a problem.
I can adjust them a bit to conform
better to my vision.

fields.EN: Besides, it's not like I can't do research as things are. Just look for one if you have some spare time.
fields.JP:
それに、今のままでも
研究ができないわけじゃないからな
探すのも暇があったらで構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mind you, my vision is merely an
inconvenience, so whenever you
come across any is fine.

fields.EN:
Understood. I can't guarantee I'd
find the perfect fit, but I'll try
my best.
fields.JP:
わかった
丁度いいのが見つかるかどうかは
分からないけど、探してくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I can't guarantee I'd
find the perfect fit, but I'll try
my best.

fields.EN:
I wonder if these lens will help
correct Itsuki's vision?
fields.JP:
眼鏡のレンズってこれかな？
ちゃんと度が合うといいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if these lens will help
correct Itsuki's vision?

fields.EN:
I better take it back to him
and see.
fields.JP: とりあえず、依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I better take it back to him
and see.

fields.JP: 頼まれていたもの持ってきたよ

fields.EN:
Yes, they just need some minor
adjustments, but they should work
fine.
fields.JP:
ああ、これなら少し調整するだけで、
十分使えそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, they just need some minor
adjustments, but they should work
fine.

fields.EN:
That's good to hear. I was
wondering what to do if they
didn't help correct your vision.
fields.JP:
よかった
度が合わなかったらどうしようかと思った
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good to hear. I was
wondering what to do if they
didn't help correct your vision.

fields.EN:
I can assure you that I will be
able to make great progress with
my research now. Thank you!
fields.JP:
これで、良く見えるようになり研究が捗る！
ありがとう、君たちのおかげだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can assure you that I will be
able to make great progress with
my research now. Thank you!

fields.EN:
Oh, but please don't research to
the extent that you drop your
vision.
fields.JP:
けど、せっかく僕たちが持ってきたんだ、
研究のし過ぎでさらに視力を落とすのは
やめてくれよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but please don't research to
the extent that you drop your
vision.

fields.EN:
Hm... I will try my best not to
do that. Now, if you will excuse
me...
fields.JP:
うっ……ぜ、善処しよう
では、僕はこれで失礼するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... I will try my best not to
do that. Now, if you will excuse
me...

fields.EN:
I almost feel like he puts more
time into research than Gretel.
fields.JP:
やれやれ、あれは下手したら
グレーテル以上の研究好きだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I almost feel like he puts more
time into research than Gretel.

fields.EN:
He did say he'd try his best not
to, but I have a feeling he's just
going to worsen his vision again.
fields.JP:
善処するって言ってたけど、
また目を悪くしそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He did say he'd try his best not
to, but I have a feeling he's just
going to worsen his vision again.

fields.JP: 花を持ってきてほしい？

fields.EN:
Yeah, like this one. The problem
is, I don't think you'd find them
around here anymore.
fields.JP:
ああ。こういう感じの花だ
ただ、もうどこにも咲いてないかも
知れないから、探索のついででいいぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, like this one. The problem
is, I don't think you'd find them
around here anymore.

fields.EN:
I don't mind looking for them
while on our expeditions, but
I'm surprised you want flowers.
fields.JP:
探索のついででいいなら構わないけど
でも、花なんて意外だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind looking for them
while on our expeditions, but
I'm surprised you want flowers.

fields.EN:
I know it ain't like me to want
flowers...
fields.JP: ガラじゃないのは分かってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know it ain't like me to want
flowers...

fields.EN:
Hm... Not sure what you want
them for, but I'll be sure to
bring some back if I find some.
fields.JP:
ふーん。まぁ、何に使うかは分からないけど
見つけたら取ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Not sure what you want
them for, but I'll be sure to
bring some back if I find some.

fields.EN:
These look just like the flower
Mamoru wanted.
fields.JP:
聞いてた特徴と一致する
たぶんこれがマモルが言っていた花だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
These look just like the flower
Mamoru wanted.

fields.EN:
Okay, I'll take some back
to him.
fields.JP: よし。いくつか摘んで行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, I'll take some back
to him.

fields.EN:
I found the flower you wanted,
so here you go...
fields.JP:
頼まれていた花を見つけたから、
いくつか摘んできたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found the flower you wanted,
so here you go...

fields.EN:
I'm surprised they're still
around... Good! Just hold on
a second!
fields.JP:
まだ残ってたんだな……
よし！　ちょっと待ってろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm surprised they're still
around... Good! Just hold on
a second!

fields.EN:
Okay... I do this... and this...
Done!
fields.JP:
えっと……これをこうして……
よし、できた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay... I do this... and this...
Done!

fields.EN:
That's fine, but what were you
doing back there?
fields.JP: それはいいけど……なにしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine, but what were you
doing back there?

fields.JP: これを作ってたんだよ

fields.EN:
I made this fragrance pouch
using the flowers you got.
fields.JP:
おまえ達にとって来てもらった花で、
香り袋を作ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I made this fragrance pouch
using the flowers you got.

fields.EN:
Right? Hikari taught me how
to make it.
fields.JP: だろ？　昔ヒカリに教えてもらったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? Hikari taught me how
to make it.

fields.EN: Huh... But, why make it now?
fields.JP:
へぇー……
でも、なんでこれを今作ったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh... But, why make it now?

fields.EN:
You know how this place is musty
and things? I figured it can help
make the place a little better.
fields.JP:
ほら、ここってかび臭いだろ？
だから、こういう物があると
少しはマシになると思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how this place is musty
and things? I figured it can help
make the place a little better.

fields.EN:
I see...
It does smell good and makes
you feel a little better.
fields.JP:
なるほど、確かに
これがあると気が休まるかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
It does smell good and makes
you feel a little better.

fields.EN:
It does, right? So, I made enough
for all you girls, so you mind
handing them out for me?
fields.JP:
だろ？
おまえらの分もあるから、
みんなに配ってくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It does, right? So, I made enough
for all you girls, so you mind
handing them out for me?

fields.EN:
You made it for all of us?
Um... Thanks...
fields.JP: 僕たちの分もあるのか……その、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You made it for all of us?
Um... Thanks...

fields.EN:
No need to thank me. You're the
one who went and picked the
flowers.
fields.JP:
お礼なんて要らねぇよ
だいたい、これはおまえらが持ってきた
花があったから作れたんだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to thank me. You're the
one who went and picked the
flowers.

fields.EN:
If anything, I owe you girls
all the thanks in the world.
fields.JP:
お礼を言うならこっちの方だ
ありがとうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything, I owe you girls
all the thanks in the world.

fields.EN:
You really know how to sweet
talk at the strangest of times...
fields.JP: まったく……調子が狂うな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really know how to sweet
talk at the strangest of times...

fields.EN:
Yup! If you find any, do you mind
bringing them to me?
fields.JP:
うん
見つかったらでいいんだけどね、
取ってきてほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! If you find any, do you mind
bringing them to me?

fields.EN:
Sure thing. I'll be sure to keep
an eye out for them.
fields.JP:
分かった
見つかったら持ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing. I'll be sure to keep
an eye out for them.

fields.EN:
These are... sugar beets!
Good! I'll take some back to
Hikari.
fields.JP:
これは……砂糖大根だ！
よし、持っていこう!
fields.LOCALIZED:
These are... sugar beets!
Good! I'll take some back to
Hikari.

fields.EN:
Hikari, I got those sugar beets
that you wanted.
fields.JP: ヒカリ、砂糖大根取ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari, I got those sugar beets
that you wanted.

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうくん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun

fields.EN:
So, what are you planning on
cooking?
fields.JP:
ところでそれ、どうするんだい？
何かそれで料理を作るのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, what are you planning on
cooking?

fields.EN:
Well, before I cook them,
I want to cultivate them.
fields.JP:
最終的にはそうするけど、
まずは育てて数を増やすつもりだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, before I cook them,
I want to cultivate them.

fields.EN:
Yup! Mamoru likes sugar beets,
and I wanted to have a crop for
us to enjoy, too!
fields.JP:
うん！　
この砂糖大根はマモルの好きな物だからね！
いつでも食べれるようにしたいし、
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! Mamoru likes sugar beets,
and I wanted to have a crop for
us to enjoy, too!

fields.EN:
Then everyone can enjoy some
tasty sugar beets!
fields.JP: みんなにもご馳走してあげたいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then everyone can enjoy some
tasty sugar beets!

fields.EN:
I see. So, you're doing this
for Mamoru, eh?
fields.JP:
なるほどね
マモルの好物だからか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So, you're doing this
for Mamoru, eh?

fields.EN:
Oh, um... I thought I said
this is for us to enjoy...
fields.JP:
あ、いや……その、みんなにも
食べてもらいたいんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um... I thought I said
this is for us to enjoy...

fields.EN: I see you're telling the truth.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see you're telling the truth.

fields.EN:
You want all of us to enjoy the
sugar beets, but you want
Mamoru to have first dibs, right?
fields.JP:
みんなに食べてもらいたいのは
本当なんだけど、一番食べて欲しいのは
マモルなんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want all of us to enjoy the
sugar beets, but you want
Mamoru to have first dibs, right?

fields.EN:
(I guess this just shows how
she feels about Mamoru...)
fields.JP:
（やれやれ、ヒカリとマモルは
　本当に仲がいいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess this just shows how
she feels about Mamoru...)

fields.EN:
You lost a frog plushie, was it?
It must have been special to you.
fields.JP:
君がなくしたっていうカエルのぬいぐるみ、
よっぽど大切なものだったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You lost a frog plushie, was it?
It must have been special to you.

fields.EN:
Yup... My mom gave it to me,
but I dropped it while coming here.
fields.JP:
うん……。
ここに来る途中で落としてきちゃったんだ。
お母さんがくれたものだったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup... My mom gave it to me,
but I dropped it while coming here.

fields.EN: First my mom's gone... And now...
fields.JP: お母さん……もういないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: First my mom's gone... And now...

fields.EN:
(I see... So it was a keepsake
left behind by his mother.)
fields.JP: （そうか。母親の形見だったんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see... So it was a keepsake
left behind by his mother.)

fields.JP:
わかった。
落ちていないか、気をつけてみるよ。
見つかったらちゃんと届けてあげるね

fields.EN:
Isn't this the frog plushie the
kid was looking for? It's great
I found it, but...
fields.JP:
……これ、あの子が探していた
カエルのぬいぐるみだよな？
見つかったのはいいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't this the frog plushie the
kid was looking for? It's great
I found it, but...

fields.EN:
(It's torn with only the head
remaining... What is he going to
say seeing it like this...?)
fields.JP:
（もうボロボロで首だけになっちゃってる。
　この状態で返すのも残酷な気がするな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's torn with only the head
remaining... What is he going to
say seeing it like this...?)

fields.EN:
(It can't be helped. I better take
it back to him. It is his precious
keepsake from his mother...)
fields.JP:
（でも仕方ない。とにかく報告するだけ
　報告しよう。どんな状態でも、
　あの子にとっては母親の形見だもんね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It can't be helped. I better take
it back to him. It is his precious
keepsake from his mother...)

fields.EN:
Here's your lost frog plushie.
Unfortunately, it was like this
when I found it...
fields.JP:
はい、カエルのぬいぐるみ。
見つけたときにはもうこの状態に
なっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here's your lost frog plushie.
Unfortunately, it was like this
when I found it...

fields.EN:
Only the head...?
My mom's... My special plushie...
fields.JP:
あ……首だけになっちゃってる……。
お母さんがくれたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only the head...?
My mom's... My special plushie...

fields.EN:
(It must be shocking... I'm not
sure it was the right move to
bring just its head back...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりショックだろうな。
　一部だけでも戻ってよかったとはいえ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must be shocking... I'm not
sure it was the right move to
bring just its head back...)

fields.EN:
Oh, don't be scared. Jack may look
scary, but he's nice and gentle.
fields.JP:
ああ、怖がらないで。
このジャックは見た目は怖いけど、
本当は大人しくていい奴だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, don't be scared. Jack may look
scary, but he's nice and gentle.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(Hm? Why is Jack plucking
the leaf on his head?)
fields.JP: （ん？　ジャックが自分の葉っぱを取った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Why is Jack plucking
the leaf on his head?)

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Huh...? You're giving it to me?
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh...? You're giving it to me?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN: Um... Is he trying to cheer me up?
fields.JP: えっと……慰めてくれてるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Is he trying to cheer me up?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Thanks...
I'm sorry I was scared...
fields.JP:
……ありがとう。
さっきは驚いちゃって、ごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks...
I'm sorry I was scared...

fields.EN:
Onii-san, I'm sorry too. Even though you
found my plushie for me, I got all
depressed...
fields.JP:
お兄さんも、ごめんなさい。
せっかくぬいぐるみを見つけてくれたのに、
落ち込んじゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
And, I'm sorry I was like that...
You went and found my
plushie like I asked...
fields.notes: Restored source onee/onii/aneue form from exact shared source/localized record.

fields.EN:
That's fine. It's not much, but
be sure you take good care of it.
fields.JP:
いいんだよ。大事なものは、
もうなくさないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine. It's not much, but
be sure you take good care of it.

fields.EN:
It looks like he's fine now,
and it's all because of you, Jack.
fields.JP:
元気になってくれたみたいでよかった。
ジャックのおかげだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It looks like he's fine now,
and it's all because of you, Jack.

fields.EN:
You really are kind.
You're always the same Jack
no matter what.
fields.JP:
やっぱりジャックは優しいな。
どんな姿になっても、君は君ってことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are kind.
You're always the same Jack
no matter what.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(Hm, but I didn't know his leaves
come off... Wait a second...
It's grown back already... Wow...)
fields.JP:
（それはそうと、あの頭の葉っぱって
　普通に取れるんだな……
　っていうか、もう生えてるし。戻るの早っ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm, but I didn't know his leaves
come off... Wait a second...
It's grown back already... Wow...)

fields.EN: All the shovels I was using broke, so if you find any, could you bring them to me...?
fields.JP:
私の使ってたシャベルが
全部壊れちゃったから、
見つけたら持ってきて欲しいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The shovel I was using broke,
so I was hoping you could find
one for me.

fields.EN:
I thought I told you a thousand
times... I'll take care of the
digging, so don't bother her.
fields.JP:
だから、何度も言ってるだろ？
わざわざおつう達に頼む必要はねぇよ
俺がでかいので掘るから、それでいいだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I told you a thousand
times... I'll take care of the
digging, so don't bother her.

fields.EN:
Um... So you want me to
do what again?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... So you want me to
do what again?

fields.EN:
Hey, Mamoru, can you be quiet for
a moment?! I wanna help you dig!
fields.JP:
もう！　マモルはちょっと静かにしてて！
私も一緒に掘りたいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Mamoru, can you be quiet for
a moment?! I wanna help you dig!

fields.JP:
……分かったよ
しょうがねぇな

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry, Otsuu-kun. So, I was
hoping you could find a shovel for
me.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんねおつうくん
ほんと、探索のついででいいから、
出来ればシャベルを見つけてきて欲しいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry, Otsuu. So, I was
hoping you could find a shovel for
me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what exactly is going
on here, but... find a shovel?
Got it.
fields.JP:
なんだかよく分からないけど……
シャベルを見つけたら持ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what exactly is going
on here, but... find a shovel?
Got it.

fields.JP: ありがとう、おつうくん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun

fields.EN:
This shovel would be perfect
for Hikari.
fields.JP:
このシャベルはヒカリに
ちょうどいいかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
This shovel would be perfect
for Hikari.

fields.EN: I better take it back to her.
fields.JP: 依頼所に持っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED: I better take it back to her.

fields.EN:
I found a right-sized shovel,
so... here.
fields.JP:
良さそうなシャベルがあったから
持ってきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found a right-sized shovel,
so... here.

fields.EN:
Thanks, Otsuu-kun!
I can get back to digging again!
fields.JP:
ありがとうおつうくん！
これで私も一緒に掘る事ができるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, Otsuu!
I can get back to digging again!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうくん => Otsuu-kun

fields.EN:
You're very welcome. So, what
exactly are you digging for?
fields.JP:
どういたしまして
それで、そのシャベルで何をしてるんだい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're very welcome. So, what
exactly are you digging for?

fields.EN:
We were digging graves for
Hameln's familiars.
fields.JP:
俺達は、ハーメルンのしもべ達の
墓を掘ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were digging graves for
Hameln's familiars.

fields.EN:
I just wanted to help by digging
the graves for them...
fields.JP:
うん
それで、その時に私も一緒に
お墓を作ってあげたかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just wanted to help by digging
the graves for them...

fields.EN:
I didn't know you two were
doing that for my minions...
fields.JP:
まさか……ワレのしもべの為に、
裏でそんなことをしてくれていたとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you two were
doing that for my minions...

fields.EN:
As their master, I give you my
thanks. Thank you for caring
for them till the end.
fields.JP:
主として礼を言う
しもべ達を弔ってくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
As their master, I give you my
thanks. Thank you for caring
for them till the end.

fields.EN:
We're just doing what's expected.
To add, they are our friends
now, you know?
fields.JP:
べつに、当たり前のことをしてるだけだ
何だかんだあいつらもすっかり仲間だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're just doing what's expected.
To add, they are our friends
now, you know?

fields.EN:
Yup! We're doing it because
we want to, that's all!
fields.JP:
うん！　私たちがやりたいから
やってるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! We're doing it because
we want to, that's all!

fields.EN:
I see...
Thank you for your kindness,
Hikari, Mamoru.
fields.JP:
そうか……
ヒカリたちは、本当に優しいのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see...
Thank you for your kindness,
Hikari, Mamoru.

fields.EN:
Um, if you happen to come across
small-sized weights, do you
mind bringing one to me?
fields.JP:
本当にたまたま見つけたらでいいんだけど、
小さくて軽いダンベルがあったら、
持ってきてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, if you happen to come across
small-sized weights, do you
mind bringing one to me?

fields.EN:
Sure, but... you said you want
small-sized weights?
fields.JP:
別にいいけど……
小さくて軽いのでいいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but... you said you want
small-sized weights?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm not gonna use them
myself.
fields.JP: あたしが使うわけじゃないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm not gonna use them
myself.

fields.EN:
Oh? Well, okay.
If I come across one, I'll be sure
to bring one back.
fields.JP:
そうなのか？
とりあえず分かった
もし見つかったら持ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Well, okay.
If I come across one, I'll be sure
to bring one back.

fields.JP: 悪いね、こんな事頼んじゃって

fields.EN:
Not a problem at all.
Well, I'll be going.
fields.JP:
別に構わないよ
じゃあ、行ってくる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not a problem at all.
Well, I'll be going.

fields.EN:
Wow... This weight is surprisingly
light-weight! I guess this should
work for Kaede.
fields.JP:
うわ、このダンベル凄く軽い！
カエデの依頼はこのダンベルを
持っていけばいいかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow... This weight is surprisingly
light-weight! I guess this should
work for Kaede.

fields.EN:
Hm, but if Kaede isn't going to
use it, who is it for?
fields.JP:
しかし、カエデじゃないなら
誰が使うんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm, but if Kaede isn't going to
use it, who is it for?

fields.EN:
I found a small weight, but are
you sure this is what you want?
It's pretty darn light, you know?
fields.JP:
とりあえず見つけたから持ってきたけど、
これでいいの？　かなり軽いよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found a small weight, but are
you sure this is what you want?
It's pretty darn light, you know?

fields.EN:
Ooh, you found one?! Thanks!
Actually, the weight is perfect.
fields.JP:
お、持ってきてくれたの？　ありがとう！
むしろ、これくらい軽いほうが
ちょうどいいと思うし、大丈夫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, you found one?! Thanks!
Actually, the weight is perfect.

fields.EN:
As long as you're fine with it...
So, who is it for? It's not for
you, right?
fields.JP:
ならいいけど……
それで、結局これは誰が使うんだ？
カエデじゃないんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
As long as you're fine with it...
So, who is it for? It's not for
you, right?

fields.EN:
Well... How about you come with
me and see?
fields.JP:
そうだね……なんならついてくる？
今から渡しに行こうと思ってるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well... How about you come with
me and see?

fields.JP: じゃあ、お言葉に甘えて

fields.EN:
All righty!
To the Laboratory we go!
fields.JP: じゃ、行きましょう――研究室に
fields.LOCALIZED:
All righty!
To the Laboratory we go!

fields.EN:
See? It's so light-weight that
even you can use it. You need to
get some training in, Itsuki.
fields.JP:
ほら、これだけ軽ければ持てるでしょ！
イツキも身体鍛えないとダメよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? It's so light-weight that
even you can use it. You need to
get some training in, Itsuki.

fields.EN:
(Ah, so that's why she was
looking for weights that weren't
that heavy and big...)
fields.JP:
（なるほど。イツキが使うから
　あんなに軽いのを探してきてくれって、
　言っていたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah, so that's why she was
looking for weights that weren't
that heavy and big...)

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan and the girls went through
the trouble of finding it, so just
give it a try.
fields.JP:
わざわざおつうちゃん達が
持ってきてくれたんだから、
とりあえず持ち上げてみなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu and the girls went through
the trouble of finding it, so just
give it a try.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
はぁ……分かったよ
しょうがない

fields.EN: You've got to be kidding me?!
fields.LOCALIZED: You've got to be kidding me?!

fields.EN:
I'm not... like you!
I'm... a thinker...
I don't do... manual labor...
fields.JP:
僕は……頭脳労働専門なんだ……！
君といっしょにしないでくれ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not... like you!
I'm... a thinker...
I don't do... manual labor...

fields.JP:
えぇ……
あんたが弱すぎるだけでしょこれは……

fields.EN:
An order that needs me to go into
the tower... I better get myself
ready for this...
fields.JP:
監獄塔の中での依頼か……。
なにがあるかわからないから、
気を引き締めてかからないとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
An order that needs me to go into
the tower... I better get myself
ready for this...

fields.JP: あぁあ……あぅ、ううううぅ……っ

fields.EN:
I can hear a Nightmare moaning
from afar. We better get out of
here while we still can.
fields.JP:
うわ……っ、遠くでナイトメアが鳴いてる。
ここは早めに引いた方がいいかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can hear a Nightmare moaning
from afar. We better get out of
here while we still can.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(He's looking in the direction the
moaning is coming from? I wonder
what's bothering him.)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアの鳴き声が聞こえてきた
　方角を見てる……？
　なにか気になることでもあるのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's looking in the direction the
moaning is coming from? I wonder
what's bothering him.)

fields.EN: Hey, Jack? We better get moving.
fields.JP: おーい、ジャック。早く行くぞー
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Jack? We better get moving.

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
(He's strangely fixed on that
Nightmare... I wonder...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり気になってるみたいだ。
　なんなんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's strangely fixed on that
Nightmare... I wonder...)

fields.EN:
Okay, that should do it with the
order... Whew...
fields.JP:
よし、依頼の報告も終了、っと。
あー疲れた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, that should do it with the
order... Whew...

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, Jack's
reaction back there is a bit
concerning.)
fields.JP:
（……そういえば、あのときの
　ジャックの反応が引っかかるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, Jack's
reaction back there is a bit
concerning.)

fields.EN:
(It seemed like he was interested
in that Nightmare's wail...)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアの鳴き声に興味を
　持っているように見えた。
　まるで真剣に耳を傾けているみたいに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seemed like he was interested
in that Nightmare's wail...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe Jack could understand
what the Nightmare was wailing
about...)
fields.JP:
（僕にわからなかっただけで、
　あの鳴き声の意味がジャックには
　ちゃんとわかっていたのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Jack could understand
what the Nightmare was wailing
about...)

fields.EN:
(If so, I wonder what that
wailing was trying to say?)
fields.JP: （あの鳴き声はなんて言っていたんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If so, I wonder what that
wailing was trying to say?)

fields.EN:
We need to go to the tower,
so we better be very careful.
fields.JP:
監獄塔での依頼だし、
普段以上に気をつけないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to go to the tower,
so we better be very careful.

fields.EN:
I have a bad feeling about this
order... I can only hope I'm
going to be proven wrong.
fields.JP:
……それに、なにか胸騒ぎが
するような気がする。
なにも起きないといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a bad feeling about this
order... I can only hope I'm
going to be proven wrong.

fields.JP: こんなのどーってことないんだぞ！
ナイトメア・ジャック
よかった。それじゃあ、行こうか

（！！　あのメルヒェン二匹、
　まだ生きて……！）
アリス、ハーメルン！　危ない！！
ナイトメア・ジャック

う……っ！
ジャックの意識が……！

fields.EN:
(Jack went in-between the Marchen
and Alice?!)
fields.JP: （ジャックがアリスを庇った……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jack went in-between the Marchen
and Alice?!)

fields.EN:
Hmph! What insolence!
This is price you pay for
scaring me like that!
fields.JP:
ふん、死にぞこないめ！
ワレをちょっとびっくりさせた罪は重いぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! What insolence!
This is price you pay for
scaring me like that!

fields.EN:
Urrh...
Hameln... Are you all right?
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ……。
ハーメルン、そっちは大丈夫だった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urrh...
Hameln... Are you all right?

fields.EN:
Not to worry! I personally made
sure they won't get up again!
fields.JP:
うむ、今度こそトドメを刺して
やったから安心するがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to worry! I personally made
sure they won't get up again!

fields.EN:
That was a close call.
Thanks...
fields.JP: ありがとう。助かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was a close call.
Thanks...

fields.JP: ジャック、わたしを庇ってくれたの……？
ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Yes... Thank you for protecting
me, Jack.
fields.JP:
ええ、あなたのおかげよ。
ありがとう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... Thank you for protecting
me, Jack.

fields.JP:
（でも今のジャックの位置からだと、
　手前にいたハーメルンのほうが
　近かったはずだ）

fields.EN:
(I guess that's how precious
Alice is to him...)
fields.JP:
（それなのに奥にいたアリスを
　助けるなんて、本当にアリスのことが
　大事なんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess that's how precious
Alice is to him...)

fields.EN:
That was quite something back
there, Jack. That was great seeing
you cover for Alice.
fields.JP:
ジャック、さっきは活躍したね。
アリスを守ってかっこよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was quite something back
there, Jack. That was great seeing
you cover for Alice.

fields.EN:
Curious, but you went in to
protect Alice instead of Hameln,
right?
fields.JP:
……ねぇ、聞いていいか？
あのとき手前にいたハーメルンより、
奥の方にいたアリスを助けたよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Curious, but you went in to
protect Alice instead of Hameln,
right?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Does that mean Alice is someone
special to you? And, that's why
you went in to protect her?
fields.JP:
やっぱり、君にとってアリスは
特別な存在ということ？
だから守ろうとしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean Alice is someone
special to you? And, that's why
you went in to protect her?

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジャック

fields.EN:
Well, there he goes...
I was hoping he'd answer my
questions...
fields.JP:
……行っちゃった。
もっといろいろ聞きたかったんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, there he goes...
I was hoping he'd answer my
questions...

fields.EN:
(In any case, Alice must really be
special to Jack...)
fields.JP:
（なんにせよ、ジャックにとってアリスが
　特別ってことは確かなんだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In any case, Alice must really be
special to Jack...)

fields.EN:
(We'll be caught if we
head back now.)
fields.JP: （戻ると追いつかれてしまう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We'll be caught if we
head back now.)

fields.EN:
(The Nightmare is catching up
on us! We need to run!)
fields.JP:
（ナイトメアが迫ってきている！
　逃げなくては！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Nightmare is catching up
on us! We need to run!)

fields.JP: （おつうちゃんを追わなきゃ！）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime's Poison Bomb
destroyed the obstruction!
fields.JP:
白雪姫のポイズンボムで
行く手を遮る壁を破壊した！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White's Poison Bomb
destroyed the obstruction!

fields.JP: パーティーが合流した！

fields.EN:
Blood Academy High School.
The private institution more commonly
known as "Blood High."
fields.JP: 私立血式学園高等学校――通称『血高』。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Academy High School.
The private institution more commonly
known as "Blood High."

fields.EN:
Hallways fill with chatter as students enjoy
campus life between classes at this morbidly-
named school.
fields.JP:
なにやら血なまぐさい略称のこの学園で、
今日も多くの生徒たちが勉学に励み、
青春を謳歌している。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hallways fill with chatter as students enjoy
campus life between classes at this morbidly-
named school.

fields.EN:
Some students are said to have very special
abilities...
fields.JP:
――そう、少しばかり不思議な能力を
持っているだけの、ごくごく普通の生徒たちが。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some students are said to have very special
abilities...

fields.EN:
The Jail Tower is an eerie building not too
far from campus. It is a haunted landmark.
fields.JP:
学園の敷地内でひときわ目を引くのが、
血高のシンボルでもある不気味な塔『監獄塔』。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail Tower is an eerie building not too
far from campus. It is a haunted landmark.

fields.EN:
Countless rumors surround the Jail Tower.
If you propose beneath it, your relationship
will never end. The rumors go on and on.
fields.JP:
この下で告白すれば永遠に結ばれるとか、
監獄塔のてっぺんはどこか別の世界に
繋がっているとか、様々な噂が絶えない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Countless rumors surround the Jail Tower.
If you propose beneath it, your relationship
will never end. The rumors go on and on.

fields.EN:
But the veracity of these rumors do little to
quell how menacing the tower looks from
below.
fields.JP:
その真偽はさておき、天高くそびえる監獄塔は、
今日も生徒たちを見守っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the veracity of these rumors do little to
quell how menacing the tower looks from
below.

fields.EN: Here is one of Blood Academy's students...
fields.JP: そしてここに、血高に通う生徒が一人――。
fields.LOCALIZED: Here is one of Blood Academy's students...

fields.EN: But today's important. Gotta be sharp.
fields.JP:
でも、今日は大事な日だ。
気合い入れないとな。うん
fields.LOCALIZED: But today's important. Gotta be sharp.

fields.EN:
(Today is my birthday, and I've made an
oath to confess my love to my crush.)
fields.JP:
（今日は僕の誕生日。
　そして、あの子に想いを伝えようと
　心に決めていた決戦日なんだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Today is my birthday, and I've made an
oath to confess my love to my crush.)

fields.EN: Good morning, Jack! You awake in there?
fields.JP: ジャックー、朝よー！　ちゃんと起きてるー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Good morning, Jack! You awake in there?

fields.EN: Oh, Mom... I'm up! Hold on. Getting changed!
fields.JP:
あ、母さん……。
起きてるよ！　待って、今着替えるから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Mom... I'm up! Hold on. Getting changed!

fields.EN: Okay, ready! No funny business, right?
fields.JP:
……よし、着替え完了！
どこも変なとこないよな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, ready! No funny business, right?

fields.JP: 父さん、母さん、おはよう
そして誕生日おめでとう！
ありがとう。覚えててくれたんだ

fields.EN:
Of course. Can't forget my favorite son's
birthday.
fields.JP:
当たり前だろう？
愛する息子の誕生日なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. Can't forget my favorite son's
birthday.

fields.JP: あれ、ところでラプンツェルは？

fields.EN:
She went to her club's morning practice.
Even if they're not related by blood,
it's still her onii-chan's birthday...
fields.JP:
部活の朝練に行っちゃったわ。
血が繋がってないとはいえ、せっかく
お兄ちゃんの誕生日だっていうのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Off to her club's morning practice.
I know you're not actually related, but
it's still her brother's birthday.

fields.EN: Ha. That's okay. I'll see her at school later.
fields.JP:
あはは、別にいいよ。
どうせあとで学校で会うんだしね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ha. That's okay. I'll see her at school later.

fields.EN:
Oh, Alice came over. I'm gonna leave now,
so could you two butt out of my room?
fields.JP:
あ……アリスが迎えに来たんだ。
もう行くから、二人とも部屋を出て
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Alice came over. I'm gonna leave now,
so could you two butt out of my room?

fields.EN: Planning to lock the door again?
fields.JP: あら、また部屋に鍵をかけちゃうの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Planning to lock the door again?

fields.JP:
ふふ、思春期の男にはいろいろあるんだよ、
母さん

fields.EN: Yeah, yeah. Okay, you can leave now.
fields.JP:
そうそう、いろいろあるの。
だから早く出てってよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, yeah. Okay, you can leave now.

fields.EN:
Jack is so secretive. I guess that's how boys
are...
fields.JP:
……ジャックが隠し事をするように
なるなんて。こうして男の子は大人に
なっていくのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is so secretive. I guess that's how boys
are...

fields.EN: Independence is a good thing. By the way, Mother... Jack's old enough now, so maybe it's time to give him another little brother or sister...
fields.JP:
自立心があっていいことじゃないか。
ところで、母さん。あいつもいい歳だし、
そろそろ弟か妹をもう一人……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Independence is a good thing. By the way,
now that Jack's grown up, how about we
talk about having another...?

fields.EN:
Oh, gosh! I guess I wouldn't mind having
more company around here...
fields.JP:
あらやだ、あなたったら！
……でも、そうね。家の中がもう少し
賑やかでもいいかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, gosh! I guess I wouldn't mind having
more company around here...

fields.EN:
(Forever star-crossed lovers, those two.
Just ignore the heart shape and walk
away...)
fields.JP:
（万年新婚夫婦め。
　背後からハートな気配が飛んでくるけど、
　無視しよう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Forever star-crossed lovers, those two.
Just ignore the heart shape and walk
away...)

fields.EN: Oh... I missed out on breakfast.
fields.JP: ……あ。流れで朝ごはん食べそこねた
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... I missed out on breakfast.

fields.EN: Morning, Alice! Sorry for keeping you.
fields.JP: おはよう、アリス！　遅くなってごめん
fields.LOCALIZED: Morning, Alice! Sorry for keeping you.

fields.EN: Oh, no worries. Let's get going.
fields.JP: ううん、いいの。さ、行きましょ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, no worries. Let's get going.

fields.EN:
(Alice is my oldest, sweetest friend.
We've been going to school together
every morning since we were kids.)
fields.JP:
（アリスは真面目でしっかり者な幼馴染。
　毎朝家まで迎えに来てくれて、
　一緒に登校しているんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice is my oldest, sweetest friend.
We've been going to school together
every morning since we were kids.)

fields.EN:
(My tummy's growling! Of all the moments!
Just my luck...)
fields.JP:
（は、腹の虫が！　このタイミングで
　鳴るなんて、間が悪い……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My tummy's growling! Of all the moments!
Just my luck...)

fields.EN:
Are you hungry? Did you miss out on breakfast
for me?
fields.JP:
お腹空いてるの？　もしかして、
わたしを待たせないために
朝ごはん食べてこなかったんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you hungry? Did you miss out on breakfast
for me?

fields.JP: いや、別にそんなことは！

fields.EN:
Your stomach is growling. It's not that big of
a deal. You've known me for longer than that.
fields.JP:
ほら、やっぱりお腹鳴ってるじゃない。
幼馴染なんだから、変に気を遣わなくても
いいのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your stomach is growling. It's not that big of
a deal. You've known me for longer than that.

fields.EN:
Y-yeah. There was so much commotion this
morning that I forgot to eat.
fields.JP:
う、うん。ちょっといろいろあって、
今朝は朝ごはんを食べるタイミングを
逃しちゃったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-yeah. There was so much commotion this
morning that I forgot to eat.

fields.EN:
I saw my parents acting all lovey-dovey
and I hightailed outta there.
fields.JP:
なんていうか、朝っぱらから
両親の熱々ぶりを見せつけられた
というか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw my parents acting all lovey-dovey
and I hightailed outta there.

fields.EN:
Ah, yeah. They're inseparable. I'm almost
jealous of couples like that.
fields.JP:
ああ、おじさんとおばさんは
昔から仲いいもんね。
ああいう夫婦、羨ましいなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yeah. They're inseparable. I'm almost
jealous of couples like that.

fields.JP: 見せつけられるほうは大変だけどね……
ふふ、諦めるしかなさそうね

fields.EN:
You know what? I have some cookies.
Want one?
fields.JP:
そうだわ。
ビスケットを持ってるんだけど、
朝ごはんの代わりに食べる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know what? I have some cookies.
Want one?

fields.EN:
Of course. I'm sure. Leave it to me to pack
more snacks than I need.
fields.JP:
ええ。ただのおやつだし、
ちょっと多く持ってきすぎちゃったから。
……はい、どうぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I'm sure. Leave it to me to pack
more snacks than I need.

fields.EN: Wow, thanks! Sure, I'd love one!
fields.JP:
わぁ、ありがとう！
それじゃあ、いただきます！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow, thanks! Sure, I'd love one!

fields.EN:
*munch* Mmm. That's delicious!
That hit the spot.
fields.JP:
ぱくっ。ん～、おいしい！
空きっ腹に染み渡るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch* Mmm. That's delicious!
That hit the spot.

fields.EN:
(Hey. Alice hasn't mentioned my birthday.
Did she forget?)
fields.JP:
（……あれ。そういえばアリス、
　僕の誕生日についてなにも触れないな。
　忘れちゃったとか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hey. Alice hasn't mentioned my birthday.
Did she forget?)

fields.EN:
(She always thinks of the best surprises.
Not that I was expecting one or anything...)
fields.JP:
（毎年欠かさず祝ってくれたんだけどなぁ……。
　いや、別にお祝いを期待してたわけじゃ
　ないんだけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She always thinks of the best surprises.
Not that I was expecting one or anything...)

fields.EN:
(But cookies for your birthday isn't all
that bad.)
fields.JP:
（まぁ、このビスケットが誕生日プレゼントって
　いうのもありだよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But cookies for your birthday isn't all
that bad.)

fields.JP: はーっはっはっはっはっは！！

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! I have arrived! What a positively
stupendous morning!
fields.JP:
ふははははっ！！　ワレ、参上！！
よい朝だな、貴様ら！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! I have arrived! What a positively
stupendous morning!

fields.EN: Where'd you come from? The sky?!
fields.JP:
っていうか、なんて登場の仕方してるんだ！？
なんか空から下りてきたぞ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Where'd you come from? The sky?!

fields.EN:
It's all thanks to the Magnetic Piccolo!
Would you like me to reveal all of the
marvelous secrets behind its design?!
fields.JP:
ふふ、『磁力ピッコロ』の力だ！
どういう仕組みかは秘密なんだが、
特別に教えてやってもよいぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's all thanks to the Magnetic Piccolo!
Would you like me to reveal all of the
marvelous secrets behind its design?!

fields.EN:
Humble of you to reject my offer.
Anyway I've got some urgent news, so keep
those eyelids open and listen up, Jack!
fields.JP:
ふむ、けんきょな奴だな。
それはそうと、今から大事なことを言うから、
目を見開いてよーく聞くのだ！　ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humble of you to reject my offer.
Anyway I've got some urgent news, so keep
those eyelids open and listen up, Jack!

fields.EN: Who does he need his eyelids to listen?
fields.JP: 聞くのに目は関係ないわよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Who does he need his eyelids to listen?

fields.EN: Come to my castle at lunch break today!
fields.JP: 今日の昼休み、我が城まで来るがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Come to my castle at lunch break today!

fields.EN:
Lunch, you hear me?! Better come!
You'll never live it down if you don't!
fields.JP:
いいか、昼休みだぞ！　絶対だぞ！
忘れたら許さないんだからなー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lunch, you hear me?! Better come!
You'll never live it down if you don't!

fields.EN:
Is Hameln's castle Room 1-A? I hear it's empty
so she loiters around there.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの城っていえば、
１－Ａの空き教室のことかしら。
勝手に入り浸っているってうわさだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is Hameln's castle Room 1-A? I hear it's empty
so she loiters around there.

fields.EN: Hm. Not sure. Guess I'll have to find out.
fields.JP:
うーん。なんかよくわからないけど、
行くしかないんだろうなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Not sure. Guess I'll have to find out.

fields.EN:
Finally, lunch. It's kind of a pain, but I should
go see Hameln.
fields.JP:
やっと昼休みかー。
面倒だけど、やっぱりハーメルンのところに
行かないとなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally, lunch. It's kind of a pain, but I should
go see Hameln.

fields.JP: おーい、ハーメルン？　来たけど

fields.EN:
(A huge sign that says "Happy BirtXXXX Jack!"
Also the classroom's been sparsely decorated.)
fields.JP:
（『ジャック　たんじょ〇〇おめでとう！』の
　横断幕がでかでかと……。
　しかも教室中に飾り付けが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A huge sign that says "Happy BirtXXXX Jack!"
Also the classroom's been sparsely decorated.)

fields.EN:
(The "XXXX" is covered up with cloth, but
this looks like a birthday party for me!)
fields.JP:
（『〇〇』のところが辛うじて
　布で隠されてるけど、これは明らかに
　僕の誕生日パーティ会場……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The "XXXX" is covered up with cloth, but
this looks like a birthday party for me!)

fields.EN: Don't be so nervous. Lighten up!
fields.JP:
ふふ、そう緊張しなくていいんだぞ。
もっと気を楽にするがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be so nervous. Lighten up!

fields.EN:
(Must be a surprise party. Hameln thinks
I haven't noticed yet.)
fields.JP:
（僕のサプライズパーティ……かな。
　ハーメルンは僕に気づかれてないと
　思ってるんだろうな、きっと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Must be a surprise party. Hameln thinks
I haven't noticed yet.)

fields.EN:
Everyone else is busy so they couldn't come,
but this'll do for now. Some come back again
this afternoon!
fields.JP:
今日の放課後はみんな忙しいから会えぬが、
ワレはジャックに用がある。
だから放課後、またここに来るように！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone else is busy so they couldn't come,
but this'll do for now. Some come back again
this afternoon!

fields.EN:
So Jack, want anything in particular for your
birthday?
fields.JP:
さて、ジャック。ときに貴様、
なにか欲しい物はないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Jack, want anything in particular for your
birthday?

fields.EN:
Something I want? Uh, maybe refills for my
mechanical pencil?
fields.JP:
欲しい物？
あー……そういえばシャープペンの芯が
なくなりそうだったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something I want? Uh, maybe refills for my
mechanical pencil?

fields.EN: Nooo! Not like that! Something special!
fields.JP:
ちがーーう！！
そーゆーのじゃなくて、もっとこう、
特別な感じの物じゃないとダメなんだぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Nooo! Not like that! Something special!

fields.EN: So sudden... How about a deck of cards?
fields.JP:
そんな急に言われてもな。
えーと、じゃあ……ト、トランプとか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So sudden... How about a deck of cards?

fields.EN: Yeah. I think it'd be fun for everyone to play.
fields.JP:
うん。みんなで遊べたら
楽しいだろうなーって思って
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I think it'd be fun for everyone to play.

fields.EN:
I see. Understood! A deck of cards, you say?
Scrub your neck and stay put!
fields.JP:
なるほど！　よしわかった、トランプだな？
首を洗ってまっているがよい！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Understood! A deck of cards, you say?
Scrub your neck and stay put!

fields.JP:
（首を洗ってって、使い方が
　おかしいけど……）

fields.EN:
While you're at it, do me a favor.
Go and give these invites to everyone.
fields.JP:
では、ついでに用事を頼むぞ。
この手紙をみんなに渡してきてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
While you're at it, do me a favor.
Go and give these invites to everyone.

fields.EN:
("Hameln's Top-Secret Change the Time Plan".
Top-Secret, my butt. Why is she making me
give this out?)
fields.JP:
（『ひみつのハーメルン時間へんこう作戦』。
　……どうリアクションすればいいんだ。
　これ、僕に見せちゃ駄目なやつじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
("Hameln's Top-Secret Change the Time Plan".
Top-Secret, my butt. Why is she making me
give this out?)

fields.EN: Hand those letters out to everyone after school today, by 5 PM!
fields.JP:
その手紙を今日の放課後、
そうだな……１７時までに
みんなに配るのだぞ！

fields.EN: And you be here by 6 PM! Understood?
fields.JP:
そしてジャックは１８時に
またここに来るのだ！　わかったな？
fields.LOCALIZED: And you be here by 6 PM! Understood?

fields.EN:
Now go! Hmhmhm! You best anticipate what's
to come!
fields.JP:
では行くがよい！
むふふ、楽しみにしているんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now go! Hmhmhm! You best anticipate what's
to come!

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Everyone's been working hard to
keep my surprise under wraps.
fields.JP:
……はぁ。みんな裏でがんばって、
サプライズ誕生日パーティの準備をして
くれてたってことなんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... Everyone's been working hard to
keep my surprise under wraps.

fields.EN:
But if I bring them these invites, they'll
know the secret's out...
fields.JP:
でも僕がこの手紙を持って行ったら、
バレたってことがわかって、
きっとがっかりするだろうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if I bring them these invites, they'll
know the secret's out...

fields.EN:
Okay. I'll hand them over casually. Like I
didn't even notice. What if I give myself
away?!
fields.JP:
よし。うまいこと気づいてないふりをして、
さりげなく手紙を渡そう。
できるかどうかはともかく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. I'll hand them over casually. Like I
didn't even notice. What if I give myself
away?!

fields.EN: I've got some time, so I'll just hand 'em out.
fields.JP:
昼休みの時間もまだあるし、
ひとまず先に何人かに渡しておこうかな
fields.LOCALIZED: I've got some time, so I'll just hand 'em out.

fields.EN: (Oh, shoot. I didn't account for time to eat lunch. I guess I'll have to buy some bread at the school store and eat it quickly.)
fields.JP:
（あ、しまった。昼ごはん食べる時間を
　考えてなかった。……購買でパンでも買って
　サッと食べるしかないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no. I forgot to eat lunch. I'll buy
some pastries and wolf 'em down.)

fields.JP: （とりあえず教室に戻ってみたけど……）
あ、ジャック。戻ってきたのね

お昼休みが始まってから、
ずっとどこかに行ってましたよね？

fields.EN:
That would be a pretty long restroom trip.
Just had to run some errands.
fields.JP:
いくらなんでも、こんなに長いわけ
ないだろ……。ちょっとした用事を
済ませてきたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would be a pretty long restroom trip.
Just had to run some errands.

fields.EN:
(Otsuu is one of my few close guy friends.
He's actually going out with Ningyohime.
I'm so jealous...)
fields.JP:
（おつうは僕の数少ない男友達だ。
　しかも人魚姫とは公認カップルという
　リア充っぷり。実に羨ましい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Otsuu is one of my few close guy friends.
He's actually going out with Little Mermaid.
I'm so jealous...)

fields.JP: な、なんだよ、ニヤニヤして

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, he might be shy. Don't be so pushy.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、言いづらいことかも
しれないんだから、しつこく追求しちゃ
駄目だよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, he might be shy. Don't be so pushy.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: I know, Princess. His secret's safe with me.
fields.JP:
わかってますよ、姫。
友の秘密を暴こうなどという
野暮はしませんとも
fields.LOCALIZED: I know, Princess. His secret's safe with me.

fields.EN:
(Otsuu acts all princely in front of Ningyohime. Always does the cool routine
in front of his girlfriend.)
fields.JP:
（おつうって人魚姫に対しては
　王子様っぽく振る舞うんだよなぁ。
　やっぱり恋人にはいいところ見せたいのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Otsuu acts all princely in front of Little
Mermaid. Always does the cool routine
in front of his girlfriend.)

fields.EN: By the way Jack, what did you have for lunch?
fields.JP: ところでジャック、お昼ごはんはどうするの？
fields.LOCALIZED: By the way Jack, what did you have for lunch?

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah. I bought some pastries on my way
back from Room 1-A.
fields.JP:
ああ、うん。
空き教室から帰ってくるとき、
購買でパンを買って来たから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah. I bought some pastries on my way
back from Room 1-A.

fields.EN: Room 1-A? No one goes there. Why were you...
fields.JP:
空き教室？
誰も行かないようなところなのに、
そんなところになんの用が……
fields.LOCALIZED: Room 1-A? No one goes there. Why were you...

fields.JP:
はっ。
まさか誰かと逢引きしていたとか……っ？

fields.EN: Oh no! It's not like that, Alice!
fields.JP:
いや、違うから！
アリスまで本気にしないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no! It's not like that, Alice!

fields.EN:
No! Asking him won't do you any good!
He might be having a secret love affair!
fields.JP:
だ、駄目よ、どんなに気になっても
聞いちゃ駄目！　秘められた恋かも
しれないんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Asking him won't do you any good!
He might be having a secret love affair!

fields.EN: Princess, you sound a little too invested.
fields.JP: 姫……けっこう興味津々そうだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Princess, you sound a little too invested.

fields.EN:
No, it's nothing like that. I visited 1-A for a
different reason...
fields.JP:
だから違うんだってば。
１－Ａの空き教室に行ったのは
そういう理由じゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's nothing like that. I visited 1-A for a
different reason...

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah. Didn't Hameln ask you to meet her
there? What was that about?
fields.JP:
ああ、そういえば今朝、
ハーメルンに呼び出されていたわね。
それで、どんな用事だったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah. Didn't Hameln ask you to meet her
there? What was that about?

fields.JP:
あー、うん。用事というほどの用事じゃ
なかったんだけど、なんていうかな……

fields.EN:
(What do I do? They'll suspect something's up
with the surprise party no matter what!)
fields.JP:
（ど、どうしよう。なんて答えても、
　サプライズパーティの話題に直撃する
　予感しかしない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do I do? They'll suspect something's up
with the surprise party no matter what!)

fields.EN:
(It's impossible for me to hand over the invite
without drawing suspicion!)
fields.JP:
（気づいてないふりをして
　さりげなく手紙を渡すなんて、
　僕にはハードルが高すぎる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's impossible for me to hand over the invite
without drawing suspicion!)

fields.EN:
Umm. Didn't notice anything weird there.
She and I just chatted is all.
fields.JP:
えーと……欲しい物を聞かれたけど、
ただの世間話みたいな感じだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Umm. Didn't notice anything weird there.
She and I just chatted is all.

fields.EN: (Shoot... Hope I didn't dig my own grave.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (Shoot... Hope I didn't dig my own grave.)

fields.EN:
I-I didn't notice any of the decorations around
the classroom. It all looked normal!
fields.JP:
べ、別に教室が飾り付けてあるとか
気づかなかったし。ほんと普通だったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I didn't notice any of the decorations around
the classroom. It all looked normal!

fields.EN:
(Nooo! I've dug myself into an even deeper
hole! Is this what they mean by self-sabotage?!)
fields.JP:
（あああ、特大の墓穴をどんどん
　掘りまくっている！　これって自分から
　追い詰められていくスタイル！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nooo! I've dug myself into an even deeper
hole! Is this what they mean by self-sabotage?!)

fields.EN: Oh, by the way! Hameln gave me these!
fields.JP:
あ、そ、そうだ！　ハーメルンから
預かってたものがあるんだった！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, by the way! Hameln gave me these!

fields.EN:
Here you go! She told me to hand these out
to everyone.
fields.JP:
はい、これ！
みんなに渡すように言われたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here you go! She told me to hand these out
to everyone.

fields.EN:
I wonder what it is! No idea what it's about!
I haven't taken one look!
fields.JP:
な、なんなんだろうね！
僕にはさっぱり意味のわからない手紙だし、
そもそも読んでいないけどね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it is! No idea what it's about!
I haven't taken one look!

fields.EN:
Sure... I suppose Jack being a terrible liar can
only be a good thing.
fields.JP:
そ、そうね。……嘘がつけないのは、
ジャックのいいところよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure... I suppose Jack being a terrible liar can
only be a good thing.

fields.JP:
（それって遠回しに、けっこうひどいこと
　言ってないか……？）

fields.EN:
D-Don't worry, Jack-san. You didn't do
anything wrong.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫ですよ。
ジャックさんは悪くありません
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry. It's not your fault.

fields.JP:
そうそう、これは全面的に
ハーメルンの落ち度だから！

fields.EN:
(I should hit the nurse's office. I can relax
and munch there. Plus Kaguya's there too.)
fields.JP:
（誰もが気づいているのに、
　気づいていないふりをしている不自然さ！
　こ、この空気はいたたまれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should hit the nurse's office. I can relax
and munch there. Plus Kaguya's there too.)

fields.EN:
(Don't know if I've got it in me to finish
lunch here...)
fields.JP:
（ここで昼ごはんを食べる勇気は、
　僕にはない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't know if I've got it in me to finish
lunch here...)

fields.EN:
Oh, yeah! Gotta finish a few more errands,
so I'll be on my way.
fields.JP:
そ、そうだ！　まだ他にも用事があるのを
思い出したから、僕はこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, yeah! Gotta finish a few more errands,
so I'll be on my way.

fields.JP: あ、ああ、うん。がんばってね……

fields.EN:
(Woof. Still got seven of these to give out.
I'm so hungry, but there's no time to eat.)
fields.JP:
（はぁ、渡さなきゃいけない手紙が
　まだ七通も……。昼ごはんのパンも
　食べちゃいたいけど、時間がないなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Woof. Still got seven of these to give out.
I'm so hungry, but there's no time to eat.)

fields.EN:
(I should hit the nurse's offices. I can relax
and munch there. Plus Kaguyahime's there too.)
fields.JP:
（……あ、そうだ。保健室に行こう。
　あそこならゆっくり昼ごはんを食べられ
　そうだし、かぐや姫がいるはずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should hit the nurse's offices. I can relax
and munch there. Plus Kaguya's there too.)

fields.EN:
(If I hand this over to her, it's killing two birds
with one stone.)
fields.JP:
（どうせかぐや姫にも手紙を渡さなきゃ
　いけないんだし、一石二鳥だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I hand this over to her, it's killing two birds
with one stone.)

fields.EN:
Hey Kaguyahime, you here? You are, aren't you?
Heeey!
fields.JP:
かぐや姫、いるか？　っていうか、いるよね？
おーい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Kaguya, you here? You are, aren't you?
Heeey!

fields.EN:
Agh. What's the deal? I can't pass through this
bamboo wall...
fields.JP:
って、うわ。なんだこれ？
竹の塀？　みたいなものがあって
先に進めない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agh. What's the deal? I can't pass through this
bamboo wall...

fields.EN:
(Why is this in the nurse's office? I bet Kaguyahime
had something to do with it...)
fields.JP:
（普通、保健室にこんなものないよね。
　よくわからないけど、十中八九、
　かぐや姫の仕業だろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is this in the nurse's office? I bet Kaguya
had something to do with it...)

fields.EN: Kaguyahime! Heeey! Are you on the other side?!
fields.JP:
かぐや姫ー！　おーい！
この向こうにいるんだよねー！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Kaguya! Heeey! Are you on the other side?!

fields.EN:
Ouch. I thought it was just bamboo, but
it's pretty sturdy.
fields.JP:
いたた。ただの竹でできてると思ったのに、
やたらと頑丈だな、これ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ouch. I thought it was just bamboo, but
it's pretty sturdy.

fields.JP:
かぐや姫ー！　かーぐーやーひーめー！！
出て来てくれないかー？
かぐや姫。やっぱりいたんだ……

fields.EN:
(That's Kaguyahime. As passionate as she is lazy,
she sure loves to delegate.)
fields.JP:
（彼女は下級生のかぐや姫。
　だらけることに関してはやたらと熱心で、
　なにかと僕に用事を頼んだりする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's Kaguya. As passionate as she is lazy,
she sure loves to delegate.)
