fields.EN:
(I can usually find her napping at the nurse's
office. I wonder what she does during class
hours... Maybe I should ask one of these days.)
fields.JP:
（だいたいいつも保健室で寝ているけど、
　授業はどうしているんだろう……という
　常識的なことは気にしてはいけない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can usually find her napping at the nurse's
office. I wonder what she does during class
hours... Maybe I should ask one of these days.)

fields.EN:
I was wondering who disturbed my slumber.
Of course it was you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
あら、誰がわらわの眠りを妨げたのかと思えば、
ジャックさんじゃありませんか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was wondering who disturbed my slumber.
Of course it was you, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I'm impressed you managed to surpass my
iron bamboo protector...
fields.JP:
鉄壁のタケプロテクターにめげず
わらわを呼び起こすなんて、さすがですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm impressed you managed to surpass my
iron bamboo protector...

fields.EN: Bamboo protector's sure selling it short...
fields.JP:
あの竹の塀、タケプロテクターって
いうんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Bamboo protector's sure selling it short...

fields.EN:
That is no ordinary wall. Anyone who dares
intrude shall face...
fields.JP:
あれはただの塀じゃありませんよ～。
わらわの眠りを邪魔する侵入者は、
容赦なくアレしてくれるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is no ordinary wall. Anyone who dares
intrude shall face...

fields.JP: うふふ、アレといったらアレです～

fields.EN:
(Leave it to Kaguya to be a bigger wall in
conversation than her bamboo protector.)
fields.JP: （なんか深く知らないほうがいい気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Leave it to Kaguya to be a bigger wall in
conversation than her bamboo protector.)

fields.EN:
So, for what reason have you disturbed my
slumber? Another one of your trivial matters?
fields.JP:
それで、わらわの眠りを妨げてまで
なにしに来たんですか～？
つまらない用事じゃないですよね～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, for what reason have you disturbed my
slumber? Another one of your trivial matters?

fields.EN: Here, just wanted to hand this over!
fields.JP:
て、手紙を渡したかったんだ！
はい、これ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Here, just wanted to hand this over!

fields.JP: え……。この手紙を、わらわに……？

fields.EN: Yup. Just wanted to you to read it.
fields.JP: うん。君に読んでほしくて
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. Just wanted to you to read it.

fields.EN:
A letter from Jack-san. Oh my, I'm blushing.
I may not feel comfortable reading it in
front of you.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんから文をもらうなんて、
ちょっと照れちゃいます～。
まだ心の準備が～
fields.LOCALIZED:
A letter from Jack. Oh my, I'm blushing.
I may not feel comfortable reading it in
front of you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: But if you insist, I shall—
fields.JP:
でもそこまで言うなら、
読んであげてもいいですけど～？
fields.LOCALIZED: But if you insist, I shall—

fields.EN:
Great! The letter's from Hameln, so don't
mind me.
fields.JP:
ああ、よかった。
ハーメルンから預かってきた手紙だから、
絶対に渡さないとって思ってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great! The letter's from Hameln, so don't
mind me.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP:
え？　今、なんか君らしくない呟きが
聞こえたような……

fields.EN:
Anyway, I shall see about Hameln-san's letter.
...If I ever overcome this pain.
fields.JP:
っていうか、ハーメルンさんからの
手紙って……ああ、この要件ですか～。
めんどくさいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, I shall see about Hameln's letter.
...If I ever overcome this pain.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Allow me to skip the formalities and give this
to you now...
fields.JP:
こんな回りくどいことするくらいなら、
もうここでプレゼント渡しちゃったほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Allow me to skip the formalities and give this
to you now...

fields.EN:
(She's not even pretending! If she blows it
now, the others will flip!)
fields.JP:
（えぇ、隠す気がない……！
　今バラされちゃったら、
　他のみんなががっかりするのに！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not even pretending! If she blows it
now, the others will flip!)

fields.EN: Hey, Jack-san. Um... Here is your bir—
fields.JP: ジャックさん、あの～。これ、誕生日プ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Jack. Um... Here is your bir—
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Okay! You got the letter, so I've gotta split.
fields.JP: じゃあ、手紙を渡したから、僕はこれで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! You got the letter, so I've gotta split.

fields.JP: え、もう行っちゃうんですか～？

fields.EN: (I'm grateful for how you feel, but for everyone else's sake, I can't accept a present right now...!)
fields.JP:
（君の気持ちは嬉しいけど、
　他のみんなのためにも、今プレゼントを
　もらうわけにはいかないんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I appreciate your kindness, but we need to
save it for later. Or else!)

fields.EN:
(I made it back to the main campus, but lunch
is practically over.)
fields.JP:
（いつの間にか校庭に……。
　それはそうと、昼休みも残り時間がだいぶ
　少なくなってきたな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I made it back to the main campus, but lunch
is practically over.)

fields.EN:
(I should eat first and hand these out later.
Where's the quickest bite...?)
fields.JP:
（もう残りの手紙を渡すのは放課後に回して、
　いい加減、昼ごはんを食べないと。
　どこかいい場所はないかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should eat first and hand these out later.
Where's the quickest bite...?)

fields.JP: 眠り姫だ。あんなところでなにしてるんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED: Sleeping Beauty? What's she doing there?

fields.EN:
(Nemurihime's in the same year as me.
She's quiet, almost perpetually drowsy.
We don't share any classes, but we stay close.)
fields.JP:
（同じ学年の眠り姫は、ちょっと無口で
　いつも眠そうにしている。クラスは違うけど、
　よく挨拶したりする間柄だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleeping Beauty's in the same year as me.
She's quiet, almost perpetually drowsy.
We don't share any classes, but we stay close.)

fields.EN:
I think she's in the Gardening Club. Must be
why she's off dozing by the flowers.
fields.JP:
たしか園芸部に入ってるんだよな、彼女。
あの辺りの花壇の世話をしてるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think she's in the Gardening Club. Must be
why she's off dozing by the flowers.

fields.EN:
Oh. She is sleeping. She can nap just about
anywhere.
fields.JP:
……あれ。近づいてみたら寝てた。
こんなところでも眠れるなんて、
ある意味すごいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. She is sleeping. She can nap just about
anywhere.

fields.EN: I shouldn't disturb her. I need to be quiet.
fields.JP:
おっと、起こしちゃいけないな。
静かにしないと
fields.LOCALIZED: I shouldn't disturb her. I need to be quiet.

fields.EN:
(This meadow is huge. Watering it all sounds
like a chore.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、けっこう広い花壇だな。
　他にも花壇があるみたいだし、
　水やりだけでも大変だろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This meadow is huge. Watering it all sounds
like a chore.)

fields.EN:
(Nemurihime's not exactly the speediest
worker, so I wonder how she finds time to
care for them all.)
fields.JP:
（眠り姫ってきびきび働くイメージじゃ
　ないけど、どうやってこんなにたくさんの
　花を世話しているんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleeping Beauty's not exactly the speediest
worker, so I wonder how she finds time to
care for them all.)

fields.EN:
(Huh? She's moving in her sleep. Now she's
grabbing her bow and arrows. Hey, why is
she aiming at me?)
fields.JP:
（？　寝たまま身じろぎしたね、うん。
　それで、いつもの弓矢をつがえて……
　あれ、こっちを狙ってない？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? She's moving in her sleep. Now she's
grabbing her bow and arrows. Hey, why is
she aiming at me?)

fields.EN:
Mercy! Mercy! I'm sorry for watching you sleep!
I didn't mean any harm! ...huh?
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさいごめんなさいっ！
寝顔をじろじろ見てごめんなさいっ！
別にやましい気持ちはなくて……って、ん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mercy! Mercy! I'm sorry for watching you sleep!
I didn't mean any harm! ...huh?

fields.EN:
The arrow struck the faucet and switched on
the sprinkler.
fields.JP:
矢がちょうど水栓に当たって、
水撒き用のホースから勝手に水が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The arrow struck the faucet and switched on
the sprinkler.

fields.EN:
What? Did she do that in her sleep?
Does she always do that?
fields.JP:
……え。まさか今の、寝たままやったの？
ひょっとしていつもこうやって水撒きしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Did she do that in her sleep?
Does she always do that?

fields.EN:
(What a feat. But is it really a shortcut?
Wouldn't it be easier just to wake up
and turn the sprinkler on yourself?)
fields.JP:
（た、達人技すぎる……！
　ある意味才能の有効活用？　でもこれなら
　普通に起きて水栓捻ったほうが簡単だよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a feat. But is it really a shortcut?
Wouldn't it be easier just to wake up
and turn the sprinkler on yourself?)

fields.EN: (Maybe she wanted to get back to napping.)
fields.JP:
（それとも、少しでもたくさん
　寝ていたいのかな。うーん……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe she wanted to get back to napping.)

fields.EN:
Ha. She's a heavy sleeper. She never fails to
amaze me.
fields.JP:
はは……よく寝てる。君って本当にすごいな。
色んな意味で
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha. She's a heavy sleeper. She never fails to
amaze me.

fields.EN: When I'm beside you, it feels like time passes slowly. It's hard to believe I was pressed for time just a moment ago.
fields.JP:
君の側では、時間がゆっくり
流れている気がする。さっきまで
時間に追われていたのが嘘みたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Suddenly I don't feel the need to rush.
Maybe you're rubbing off on me.

fields.EN: Thanks Nemurihime. I owe you one.
fields.JP: ありがとう、眠り姫。君のおかげで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks Sleeping Beauty. I owe you one.

fields.EN:
Oh no! I still haven't eaten! I'm running out
of time!
fields.JP:
あ、やばい！　まだ昼ごはん
食べてなかったのに！！　うわぁ、
普通の時間の流れが一気に戻ってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! I still haven't eaten! I'm running out
of time!

fields.EN: *munch, munch* At least I have to finish this bread, *munch, munch*, or I'll miss lunch! *gulp*!
fields.JP:
むぐむぐ、とにかくパンだけでも
食べちゃわないと、んぐんぐ、
昼ごはん抜きになる！　ごっくん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*munch, munch* This pastry should hold me
for now! *gulp*!

fields.EN:
Morning Nemurihime! The bell rang, so
you should head to class!
fields.JP:
ああ、眠り姫おはよう！
予鈴が鳴ったから、君も早く
教室に戻ったほうがいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Morning Sleeping Beauty! The bell rang, so
you should head to class!

fields.EN:
What do you mean? Like I said to Kaguyahime,
it's not that big of a deal.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ってなにが？　いや、まぁいいや。
かぐや姫の例もあるし、授業がどうとか
言うのは野暮な気がしてきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean? Like I said to Kaguya,
it's not that big of a deal.

fields.EN: Oh, I almost forgot. A letter from Hameln!
fields.JP:
そうそう、忘れるところだった。
はい、手紙！　ハーメルンからだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I almost forgot. A letter from Hameln!

fields.EN:
I gotta go! I have Kaede's class up next!
She'll have my butt if I'm late again!
fields.JP:
僕はもう行くから！　次はカエデ先生の
授業だから、遅れたら怖いんだ！
それじゃ、またね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gotta go! I have Kaede's class up next!
She'll have my butt if I'm late again!

fields.EN: Phew. Done with class for the day.
fields.JP: ふぅ。今日の授業もこれで終わり、っと
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew. Done with class for the day.

fields.EN:
(5 more letters. Need to find a better way to
hand these out or I won't make it by 5 PM.)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンから預かった手紙は、あと五通。
　効率よく渡していかないと、
　１７時までに配り終わらないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(5 more letters. Need to find a better way to
hand these out or I won't make it by 5 PM.)

fields.JP:
（もう渡した子たちは除外して、
　あとはどういう順番で渡せば……）
あら、心ここに非ずといった様子ね

fields.EN: G-Gretel... Um, what are you wearing?
fields.JP:
グ、グレーテル……えーと、
その恰好はいったい……？
fields.LOCALIZED: G-Gretel... Um, what are you wearing?

fields.EN:
(Gretel's in the same year as me.
She's a real bookworm, and she doesn't
have the best social awareness.)
fields.JP:
（同級生のグレーテル。
　強すぎる知的好奇心ゆえに変わり者で、
　こんな風にいろいろと常識がズレている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel's in the same year as me.
She's a real bookworm, and she doesn't
have the best social awareness.)

fields.EN:
I know that's a swimsuit, but this is a
classroom.
fields.JP: 水着なのはわかってるけど、ここ、教室だよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that's a swimsuit, but this is a
classroom.

fields.EN:
I'm on the diving team, so naturally
I sport competition-ready attire.
fields.JP: 私は水泳部だから水着を着るのは当然よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm on the diving team, so naturally
I sport competition-ready attire.

fields.EN:
I don't care what team you're on.
Wearing a swimsuit in class is weird.
fields.JP:
いや、いくら水泳部でも、
教室で水着なんておかしいと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't care what team you're on.
Wearing a swimsuit in class is weird.

fields.EN:
I could always dip my toe in the pool using
the Bread Portal, so don't mind me.
fields.JP:
『ブレッドポータル』でいつでも
プールサイドに戻れるから、問題ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could always dip my toe in the pool using
the Bread Portal, so don't mind me.

fields.EN:
I'll save time by going straight there
without changing. Marvelous idea, isn't it?
fields.JP:
時間を有効活用するために、
着替える時間を短縮しているの。
画期的でしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll save time by going straight there
without changing. Marvelous idea, isn't it?

fields.EN: Sure. If you say so, whatever.
fields.JP:
……うん。
君がいいなら、それでいいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure. If you say so, whatever.

fields.EN:
(Gretel could counter anything I say in a
heartbeat, I don't stand a chance.)
fields.JP:
（価値観が揺るがないグレーテルと話してると、
　だんだん自分のほうが変なこと
　言ってるような気がしてくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel could counter anything I say in a
heartbeat, I don't stand a chance.)

fields.EN:
Use your time wisely, Jack. Your poor legs
may give up before lunch ends if you keep
this up.
fields.JP:
ジャックも時間は大切にしたほうがいいわよ。
あなた今日、昼休みにあちこちを
駆け回っていたらしいけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use your time wisely, Jack. Your poor legs
may give up before lunch ends if you keep
this up.

fields.EN:
I hear things. Mainly that you've wasted
a lot of time.
fields.JP:
目撃情報を耳にしただけよ。
ずいぶん無駄な時間を過ごしたみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hear things. Mainly that you've wasted
a lot of time.

fields.EN:
It hasn't been that bad. Sure I'm not gonna win
any courier awards anytime soon, but it hasn't
been a waste.
fields.JP:
そんなことはないよ。
たしかに効率よく時間を使えたわけじゃ
ないけど、無駄ではなかったと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
It hasn't been that bad. Sure I'm not gonna win
any courier awards anytime soon, but it hasn't
been a waste.

fields.EN: Sometimes conversation is a gift in itself.
fields.JP:
僕は僕で、みんなと話せて
楽しいところもあったしね
fields.LOCALIZED: Sometimes conversation is a gift in itself.

fields.EN: Hm. Right... That might go for one of us.
fields.JP:
ふぅん、そう……。
あなたと私では価値観が異なるようね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Right... That might go for one of us.

fields.EN: Well, I for one am enjoying our conversation.
fields.JP:
今こうして君と話している時間も、
僕は楽しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I for one am enjoying our conversation.

fields.EN:
But I hear you think conversation's just
a waste of time.
fields.JP:
まぁ、君に言わせれば時間の無駄遣い
なのかもしれないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I hear you think conversation's just
a waste of time.

fields.EN:
Yes, but... You know I'm not opposed to
spending time with you.
fields.JP:
……そうね。だけど私も別に、
あなたと話すこの時間は嫌いじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, but... You know I'm not opposed to
spending time with you.

fields.EN:
For once we're not discussing urgent matters,
so let me wing it.
fields.JP:
建設的な話し合いをしているわけじゃ
ないのだから、無駄な時間のはずなのに、
おかしなものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
For once we're not discussing urgent matters,
so let me wing it.

fields.EN:
I suppose there are feelings I have yet
to sort through. I find myself drawn to
the unknown.
fields.JP:
どうやら私自身も把握しきれていない
感情があるようだわ。
……未知のものというのは興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose there are feelings I have yet
to sort through. I find myself drawn to
the unknown.

fields.EN:
O-okay. The most important thing is to
have fun.
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……。
君も楽しいって思ってくれてるなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-okay. The most important thing is to
have fun.

fields.JP: 楽しいとは言っていないわ

fields.EN:
Oh no. This took 90 seconds longer than I
allotted for. I must take my leave.
fields.JP:
ああ、いけない。
予定していた時間を一分半もオーバーして
しまったわ。もう行かないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no. This took 90 seconds longer than I
allotted for. I must take my leave.

fields.EN: Ah, wait! I need to give this to you!
fields.JP:
あっ、待って！
君にもこれを渡したいと思っていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, wait! I need to give this to you!

fields.EN:
Here, from Hameln. Um, I don't know what
it's in it!
fields.JP:
はい、ハーメルンからの手紙。
えーと、僕は中身読んでないから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, from Hameln. Um, I don't know what
it's in it!

fields.EN: Oh it's still sealed. But sure, thank you.
fields.JP: あら、聞いてもいないのに、どうも
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh it's still sealed. But sure, thank you.

fields.EN: ...Hm, hm... I see. I understand the situation. Though I suppose this has nothing to do with you, since you didn't read what was inside.
fields.JP:
……ふむふむ……なるほど。
事情はわかったわ。中身を読んでいない
あなたには関係ない話でしょうけれど
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmhm... I see. I understand the situation.

fields.EN: (Feels like I'm slowly being attacked. She's sadistic...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんかじわじわ責められてる気がする。
　ドＳ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Feels like I'm slowly being attacked. She's sadistic...)

fields.EN: It's going to be interesting. Hehe...
fields.JP: この後が楽しみね。……ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's going to be interesting. Hehe...

fields.EN:
Phew. Got away safely, but at least I handed
her the letter.
fields.JP:
……ふぅ。
あんまり誤魔化せた気がしないけど、
とりあえず手紙は渡したぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. Got away safely, but at least I handed
her the letter.

fields.EN: Gotta take care of the rest of these now.
fields.JP:
さてと、早いところ他の子達にも
渡しちゃわないとな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Gotta take care of the rest of these now.

fields.EN:
(Hm. Where could she be? Must be at
the gym for practice.)
fields.JP:
（えーと、彼女はどこかな。
　この時間なら体育館で
　部活中のはずだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. Where could she be? Must be at
the gym for practice.)

fields.EN: Hey, mind picking up the ball for me?
fields.JP: そこのあんた、ちょっとそのボール取って！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, mind picking up the ball for me?

fields.EN: Oh, it's Jack. What are you doing here?
fields.JP:
って、ジャックじゃない。
あんたこんなところでなにしてんのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's Jack. What are you doing here?

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime's in the same grade as me, but
she looks so much younger. Can't believe
she's Nemurihime's older sister.)
fields.JP:
（同じ学年の親指姫は、同年代よりちょっと
　……いや、けっこう幼く見える。
　これで眠り姫の姉なんだから、びっくりだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina's in the same grade as me, but
she looks so much younger. Can't believe
she's Sleeping Beauty's older sister.)

fields.EN:
(As usual, she's hard at work practicing
her volleyball game.)
fields.JP:
（今日も小さい体をめいっぱい使って、
　バレーボール部の活動にいそしんで
　いるらしい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As usual, she's hard at work practicing
her volleyball game.)

fields.EN: Hey, is this ball smaller than usual?
fields.JP:
あれ？　でもこのバレーボール、
よく見たら普通のより小さくないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, is this ball smaller than usual?

fields.JP: こ、これは……わたし専用だから……

fields.EN:
Exclusive to me! Regulation-size is too big.
This way I can hone my moves.
fields.JP:
だから、わたし専用のボールだって言ってるの！
普通サイズのボールだと、
大きすぎてうまく使えないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exclusive to me! Regulation-size is too big.
This way I can hone my moves.

fields.EN: Doesn't that make real games harder?
fields.JP: そ、それって競技をするのに致命的なんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Doesn't that make real games harder?

fields.EN:
I don't wanna give up! I'll practice with my mini
ball, then one day I'll move up to the real thing!
fields.JP:
それでも諦めたくないの！
小さいボールで練習して、いつか普通のボール
でもバレーできるようになってやるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna give up! I'll practice with my mini
ball, then one day I'll move up to the real thing!

fields.JP: そっか……親指姫は偉いね

fields.EN: Whaaaa?! Where's all this praise coming from!
fields.JP: な、なななっ、なによ、急に褒めたりして！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whaaaa?! Where's all this praise coming from!

fields.EN:
It's because you never give up! You're playing
volleyball to grow taller, aren't you?
fields.JP:
だって希望を捨てずにがんばり続ける
なんて偉いよ。少しでも身長を伸ばしたくて
バレーボールをしてるんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because you never give up! You're playing
volleyball to grow taller, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Playing volleyball or basketball won't make
you taller, but your effort more than makes
up for it.
fields.JP:
バレーをしようがバスケをしようが、
もうそれ以上背は伸びないだろうけど、
希望を捨てないなんてすごいな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Playing volleyball or basketball won't make
you taller, but your effort more than makes
up for it.

fields.JP: 君のそういう前向きさは尊敬するよ！

fields.EN:
It's not like I'm giving up on volleyball!
Why are you so obsessed with my height?!
fields.JP:
わ、わたしは普通のボールでバレー
するのを諦めないって言ったのよ！？
なんで身長の話になってるのよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like I'm giving up on volleyball!
Why are you so obsessed with my height?!

fields.EN:
Oh sorry! I thought you were playing to get
taller.
fields.JP:
え、ごめん！
てっきり、身長を伸ばしたくて
バレーをしてるんだとばっかり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh sorry! I thought you were playing to get
taller.

fields.EN:
How rude of you to assume! I'm an athlete,
you dingus!
fields.JP:
その発想がそもそも失礼なのよ！！
わたしはあくまでも純粋にスポーツとして
がんばってるの！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How rude of you to assume! I'm an athlete,
you dingus!

fields.EN: Growing taller is just a bonus!
fields.JP: 身長を伸ばすのはただのついでよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Growing taller is just a bonus!

fields.EN: So, you do want to be taller?
fields.JP: あ、やっぱり身長は伸ばしたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: So, you do want to be taller?

fields.EN:
Besides, it's no fair! Why are courts and balls
so big!
fields.JP:
だいたい、世の中おかしいわ！
なんでスポーツのコートとかボールって
こんなにおっきいのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, it's no fair! Why are courts and balls
so big!

fields.EN:
You don't think everyone else is too big,
and that I'm perfectly-sized?
fields.JP:
前から思ってたんだけど、
わたしが小さいんじゃなくて、
他が大きすぎるだけなんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't think everyone else is too big,
and that I'm perfectly-sized?

fields.EN:
If the court and ball were smaller, I'd be
the world's number one!
fields.JP:
ボールもコートももっと小さくすれば、
きっとわたしが一番うまくできるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the court and ball were smaller, I'd be
the world's number one!

fields.JP: そんなむちゃくちゃな……

fields.EN:
Rude! Why should everyone else get to look
down on me?!
fields.JP:
ああもう悔しいっ！
なんで他の部員たちにさんざん
見下ろされなきゃなんないのよーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rude! Why should everyone else get to look
down on me?!

fields.EN:
(Can't say it's unexpected when you joined the
volleyball team...)
fields.JP:
（それはバレーボール部に入っちゃった
　宿命だと思う……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Can't say it's unexpected when you joined the
volleyball team...)

fields.EN: Hey, by the way, I was looking for you.
fields.JP:
そ、そうだ。
そういえば君を探しに来たんだった
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, by the way, I was looking for you.

fields.EN: Hameln asked me to give this to you. Here ya go!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンから手紙を預かってきたんだ。
はい、たしかに渡したから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hameln asked me to give this to you. Here ya go!

fields.EN: Uh, okay... What are you, Hameln's gopher?
fields.JP:
あ、うん……。なによあんた、
ハーメルンの使いっぱしりでもしてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, okay... What are you, Hameln's gopher?

fields.EN:
Um, not exactly... Just handing these out as
a favor for her.
fields.JP:
いや、そういうわけじゃ……。
でもなぜか現状、そうなってるかも。
他のみんなにも配って回ってるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, not exactly... Just handing these out as
a favor for her.

fields.EN:
Okay, I gotta run. I got more of these to
give out!
fields.JP:
そ、それじゃあ、もう行くね。
まだ他にも手紙を渡さなきゃ
いけない子がいるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, I gotta run. I got more of these to
give out!

fields.EN: Why is he handing these out...? I don't get it.
fields.JP:
……なんでこんなもんをあいつが配ってるのよ。
意味わかんないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Why is he handing these out...? I don't get it.

fields.EN:
Hmm. Just got four more of these.
At least I'm making progress.
fields.JP:
うーんと、渡さなきゃいけない手紙は
あと四通か。うん、順調順調
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. Just got four more of these.
At least I'm making progress.

fields.EN: Aaaah! Who cut down the wall?!
fields.JP: ひええっ！！　か、壁が切れた……！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aaaah! Who cut down the wall?!

fields.JP:
ふはははは！　そんなことでワレを
捕らえられるとでも思ったかー！！

あ、赤ずきんさん……？
ハーメルンを追いかけてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood..? Is she after Hameln?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: (Doesn't she know not to run with scissors?)
fields.JP:
（あのハサミを振り回しながら追いかけるとか、
　めちゃくちゃ危険なんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Doesn't she know not to run with scissors?)

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san's a grade above me, and
is one of Blood High's top hall monitors. She's
a big part of the student body around here.)
fields.JP:
（風紀委員の赤ずきんさんは、僕の先輩だ。
　いつも元気で活発で行動力がみなぎっていて
　……あれ？　全部同じか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood's a grade above me, and
is one of Blood High's top hall monitors. She's
a big part of the student body around here.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: あ、あのー、赤ずきん……さん？
ああ、ジャック！　奇遇だね！

fields.EN:
A coincidence? I guess so. Seems like you
got tangled up in some risky business.
fields.JP:
奇遇というか、なんというか……。
なんか今、すごく危ないことしてなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A coincidence? I guess so. Seems like you
got tangled up in some risky business.

fields.EN:
Haha. I might have gotten ahead of myself.
There I go again, getting carried away!
fields.JP:
あはは、たしかにちょっと興奮しすぎ
ちゃったかも。いやー、反省反省！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. I might have gotten ahead of myself.
There I go again, getting carried away!

fields.EN: (She's not guilty at all, is she?)
fields.JP: （絶対反省してないよね、これ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's not guilty at all, is she?)

fields.EN:
As part of the student government, I urged
Hameln to abide by school rules, but she got
away.
fields.JP:
風紀委員として今日こそハーメルンに
校則を守らせようとしてたんだけど、
また逃げられちゃったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As part of the student government, I urged
Hameln to abide by school rules, but she got
away.

fields.EN:
She's a total delinquent. I hardly think she
knows the rules at all.
fields.JP:
番長だかなんだか知らないけど、
あいつ、校則守る気ゼロだもんね。
むしろ守ってる校則のほうが少ないくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's a total delinquent. I hardly think she
knows the rules at all.

fields.EN: Each time I try, she always gets away.
fields.JP:
捕まえようとしてもいつも逃げられちゃって、
苦労させられるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Each time I try, she always gets away.

fields.EN:
So you think running after her with scissors
is gonna help?
fields.JP:
で、いつもハサミを振り回して、
壁を切り刻みながら、
ああして追い回していると……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you think running after her with scissors
is gonna help?

fields.EN: Yup. I've had enough of Hameln.
fields.JP: うん。ハーメルンにも困ったもんだね、ほんと
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. I've had enough of Hameln.

fields.EN:
Considering the damaged wall, I'm not sure
who's more in the wrong here.
fields.JP:
被害状況だけで見れば、
どっちが困ったものかは
わからないと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering the damaged wall, I'm not sure
who's more in the wrong here.

fields.EN:
It's in the name of law and order!
Justice comes with a price!
fields.JP:
すべては風紀を守るため！
正義に尊い犠牲はつきものだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's in the name of law and order!
Justice comes with a price!

fields.EN:
(Oh man, she's heating up. She has no idea
that her actions are doing more harm than
good.)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ、言い切った。
　迷惑を自覚してるのに改める気はないとか、
　余計にタチが悪い……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh man, she's heating up. She has no idea
that her actions are doing more harm than
good.)

fields.EN:
Well, I'm not really into school politics,
but here's a letter from Hameln for you.
fields.JP:
まぁ、風紀委員の活動には
口出ししないでおくよ。ところで、
そのハーメルンから手紙を預かってきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm not really into school politics,
but here's a letter from Hameln for you.

fields.EN:
Thank you... Um, "Hameln's Top-Secret
Change the Time Plan"?
fields.JP:
ん、ありがと。えーと……
『ひみつのハーメルン時間へんこう作戦』？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you... Um, "Hameln's Top-Secret
Change the Time Plan"?

fields.EN: (Agh. Did she have to read it aloud...?)
fields.JP: （えっ。それを口に出して読んじゃうの？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Agh. Did she have to read it aloud...?)

fields.EN:
What on earth is Hameln thinking making
you deliver these? What an idiot.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンってば、こんなのを本人に
配達させるなんてなに考えてるんだか。
ほんっと、馬鹿番長ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What on earth is Hameln thinking making
you deliver these? What an idiot.

fields.EN:
Hey Akazukin! What are you doing
there?!
fields.JP:
やーい、赤ずきん！
そんなところでなにをしている！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Red Riding Hood! What are you doing
there?!

fields.JP:
あっ、ハーメルン！
あいつ、あんなところに……！

fields.EN:
Looks like you've given up on catching me!
Should've known you're too much of a slowpoke.
fields.JP:
もうワレを捕まえるのは諦めたようだな！
ワレの素早さには敵わないと思い知ったかー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you've given up on catching me!
Should've known you're too much of a slowpoke.

fields.EN: Am not! Stay put, I'm coming after you!
fields.JP:
んなわけないでしょ！
今すぐ捕まえてやるから、
首洗って待ってなさい！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Am not! Stay put, I'm coming after you!

fields.EN:
That was close. All this trouble just for some
stupid invites...
fields.JP:
あ、危なかった。手紙渡すだけなのに、
なんでこんな危険な目にあわなきゃ
ならないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was close. All this trouble just for some
stupid invites...

fields.EN:
Makes me wonder what kind of nutso rules
Akazukin-san's enforcing...
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんを見てると、風紀とはなにかと
考えさせられるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Makes me wonder what kind of nutso rules
Red Riding Hood's enforcing...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Oh, haven't seen Rapunzel yet. She must be
at basketball practice.
fields.JP:
そういえば、今日はまだラプンツェルに
会ってなかったっけ。放課後はバスケ部の
練習をしてるはずだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, haven't seen Rapunzel yet. She must be
at basketball practice.

fields.JP: えーっ！　これはズルじゃないよー！

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's hair is just like her hands!
So this isn't cheating!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのかみは、
てとおんなじなんだよ！
だからこれはズルじゃないんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: My hair's a part of me, so it's not cheating!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Um. That's not how basketball works...
fields.JP:
いや、バスケのルールに
そんな理屈は通用しないから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. That's not how basketball works...

fields.EN: I don't care how it works!
fields.JP: りくつとか、むずかしいことわかんない！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't care how it works!

fields.EN:
(That's my adopted sister, Rapunzel. She can
be a real brat sometimes, but I'll admit she's
clever when she wants to be.)
fields.JP:
（あの子は僕の義理の妹のラプンツェル。
　いつも無邪気で幼い言動が多いけど、
　たまに鋭いことを言ったりする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's my adopted sister, Rapunzel. She can
be a real brat sometimes, but I'll admit she's
clever when she wants to be.)

fields.EN: Um. Is my sister causing trouble?
fields.JP:
あのー、うちの義妹が
なにか迷惑かけましたか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. Is my sister causing trouble?

fields.JP: あっ、ジャックだー！　おはよー！！

fields.EN: Yeah, morning. It's already after school, though. I guess you said good morning because this is the first time we've seen each other today...
fields.JP:
うん、おはよう。もう放課後だけどね。
今日初めて会ったからおはようなんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, morning. It is noon, you know?

fields.EN:
Are you Rapunzel's onii-san? Could you tell
her that using her hair is against the rules?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのお兄さん？
ちょっと言い聞かせてやってよ、
バスケでは髪を使っちゃいけないんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you Rapunzel's brother? Could you tell
her that using her hair is against the rules?

fields.JP: へ？　髪を使うというと？

fields.EN:
She's stealing the ball with her hair. Along
with dribbling, shooting, and even defense.
She's breaking almost every rule.
fields.JP:
髪でボールを取ったり、ドリブルしたり、
シュートしたり、ディフェンスしたり、
その他もろもろのルール違反
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's stealing the ball with her hair. Along
with dribbling, shooting, and even defense.
She's breaking almost every rule.

fields.EN: You there! That wasn't a compliment!
fields.JP: そこ、褒めない！　誇らない！
fields.LOCALIZED: You there! That wasn't a compliment!

fields.JP:
す、すみません。
たしかに駄目ですよね、それは……

fields.EN:
Basketball's a team sport, so if she can't
follow the rules, she can't play. Tell her
to be more careful next time.
fields.JP:
チーム競技なんだから、ルールを
守らないとコートに立たせられないわ。
わかったら、今後は気をつけるように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Basketball's a team sport, so if she can't
follow the rules, she can't play. Tell her
to be more careful next time.

fields.EN: Rapunzel, stop using your hair on the court.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、バスケではもう
髪を使っちゃ駄目だよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel, stop using your hair on the court.

fields.EN: But Rapunzel's hair is really useful...
fields.JP:
でも、ラプンツェルのかみ、
すごくべんりなのに……
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
No one else has hair like yours. If you can't
play fair, then what's the fun?
fields.JP:
他のみんなは髪をそんな風に便利に
使えないんだ。ラプンツェルもみんなと
同じ条件でプレイしなきゃ不公平だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one else has hair like yours. If you can't
play fair, then what's the fun?

fields.EN:
Yes. Playing by the rules is a show of good
sportsmanship.
fields.JP:
そう。みんなと同じルールの中でプレイしたら、
きっと今よりもっと、みんなと仲良くなれるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Playing by the rules is a show of good
sportsmanship.

fields.EN: Don't you want to play with everyone?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、みんなと楽しく
バスケがしたいだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you want to play with everyone?

fields.JP: うん！　たのしくしたい！

fields.EN: Then promise me you won't use your hair!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、これからはバスケで
髪を使わないって約束できるか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Then promise me you won't use your hair!

fields.EN: Promise! Just my hands from now on!
fields.JP:
やくそくする！　みんなといっしょに、
てでボールにさわる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Promise! Just my hands from now on!

fields.EN: Good. Glad you got it, Rapunzel.
fields.JP: よかった。ラプンツェルはいい子だな
fields.LOCALIZED: Good. Glad you got it, Rapunzel.

fields.EN:
By the way, Jack, why did you come here?
Did you come to watch Rapunzel's club activity?
fields.JP:
そういえばジャック、なんでここにきたの？
ラプンツェルのぶかつ、みにきたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, why are you here? To watch
me play?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Oh no. I came here to give you a letter from
Hameln. Here you go.
fields.JP:
そうじゃなくて、今日はハーメルンからの
手紙を届けに来たんだ。はい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no. I came here to give you a letter from
Hameln. Here you go.

fields.EN: A letter for Rapunzel? Lemme see, lemme see!
fields.JP: ラプンツェルにてがみ？　みるみるー！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Hmph, hmph... Oh, I know! This is about
Jack's surprise party!
fields.JP:
ふむふむ、えーとー……わかった！
このてがみ、ジャックのサプライズ
たんじょうびパーティのやつだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph, hmph... Oh, I know! This is about
Jack's surprise party!

fields.JP: ……あ。いっちゃだめだったんだ

fields.EN:
(Woof. Even Rapunzel's spilling the beans.
Not that I'm much better.)
fields.JP:
（ああ……。ほんっとうに、
　隠し事ができない性格なんだなぁ、
　ラプンツェルって。あれ、僕もか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Woof. Even Rapunzel's spilling the beans.
Not that I'm much better.)

fields.EN:
Um... Did you hear me? Were you listening?
About the surprise party.
fields.JP:
あの……、きいた？　きいちゃった？
サプライズたんじょうびパーティって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Did you hear me? Were you listening?
About the surprise party.

fields.EN:
Huh? A "sunrise par tea"? No idea what you
mean.
fields.JP:
え？　い、今の、サンライズ耽美調パリティが
どうとかいう話？
僕にはなんのことやらさっぱり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? A "sunrise par tea"? No idea what you
mean.

fields.EN:
Yay! Then don't worry about anything in this
letter!
fields.JP:
よかったー！
ジャックはこのてがみのことは、
ぜんぜんきにしなくていいんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yay! Then don't worry about anything in this
letter!

fields.EN:
(She's so sweet... Almost too sweet.
Why does that worry me...?)
fields.JP:
（我が義妹ながら、なんて純粋なんだ。
　ただ……うん。純粋すぎてちょっと
　不安になってくるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so sweet... Almost too sweet.
Why does that worry me...?)

fields.EN:
Okay. Next up, Shirayukihime. I think she's with
the chemistry club.
fields.JP:
さてと、次は白雪姫だな。
えーと、彼女は科学部の部活動を
してるはずだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Next up, Snow White. I think she's with
the chemistry club.

fields.EN:
Whoa. Almost had a heart attack. Where'd
that explosion come from? I heard it from
this direction...
fields.JP:
び、びっくりした。
どこかで爆発でもあったのか？
あっちのほうから聞こえてきたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Almost had a heart attack. Where'd
that explosion come from? I heard it from
this direction...

fields.EN: Oh no! Some people have fallen over.
fields.JP: 大変だ、倒れてる人が何人も……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no! Some people have fallen over.

fields.EN: (Looks like no one's too hurt. What happened?)
fields.JP:
（とりあえずひどい怪我をした人は
　いないみたいだけど、それにしたって、
　いったい……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Looks like no one's too hurt. What happened?)

fields.JP: ああ、また失敗しちゃいました……
白雪姫！　よかった、無事だったんだね

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime's in my grade, but she's
Oyayubihime's little sister. She's pretty
mellow, so I enjoy her company.)
fields.JP:
（同学年の白雪姫は、親指姫の妹で
　眠り姫の姉の女の子。おっとりした子で、
　側にいるとなんだか癒されるんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White's in my grade, but she's
Thumbelina's little sister. She's pretty
mellow, so I enjoy her company.)

fields.EN: I thought I heard a big explosion. You okay?
fields.JP: すごい爆発音がしたけど、大丈夫だった？
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought I heard a big explosion. You okay?

fields.EN:
Yes...but I failed. I thought I could make it
work. *sigh*.
fields.JP:
はい……。でも、失敗しちゃいました。
うまくいくと思ったんですけど……はぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes...but I failed. I thought I could make it
work. *sigh*.

fields.JP:
……ということは、この惨状の原因は
君にあるってこと？

fields.EN: Err I'm sorry. I didn't mean any harm...
fields.JP:
うぅ、ごめんなさい……。
ご迷惑おかけして、本当に……
fields.LOCALIZED: Err I'm sorry. I didn't mean any harm...

fields.EN:
Hey, I'm not here to blame you. Just happy
you're safe.
fields.JP:
いや、別に君を責めてるわけじゃないんだ。
無事でよかったよ。うん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I'm not here to blame you. Just happy
you're safe.

fields.EN:
(Relatively safe, of course. At least no one
suffered serious harm.)
fields.JP:
（この惨状を『無事』と表現するのは
　無理がある気もするけど。でも怪我人が
　いないんだったらセーフだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Relatively safe, of course. At least no one
suffered serious harm.)

fields.EN: So how'd the whole ka-boom happen?
fields.JP: それで、どうして爆発なんて起きちゃったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So how'd the whole ka-boom happen?

fields.EN:
I was experimenting on a "Poison Bomb"
for the chemistry club, but...
fields.JP:
科学部の活動で、『ポイズン・ボム』の
実験をしていたんですけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was experimenting on a "Poison Bomb"
for the chemistry club, but...

fields.JP:
ポイズンで、ボム……。
それはまた、リアルにやばそうなものを
実験していたんだね……

fields.EN:
Normally we conduct our experiments in
controlled conditions.
fields.JP:
本来なら他に被害が及ばないように、
実験用の強化ケースの中で
爆発させるはずだったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normally we conduct our experiments in
controlled conditions.

fields.EN:
But one careless error on my part was
enough to send it up in smoke.
fields.JP:
でもうっかりしていて、
いろいろあって、間違って誘爆させて
しまって……こんなことに
fields.LOCALIZED:
But one careless error on my part was
enough to send it up in smoke.

fields.EN:
Um. I feel like there's more to the story
here. Wanna fill in the details for me?
fields.JP:
うん。大事なところがほぼぼやかされてるよね。
こうなった原因を、もうちょっと詳しく
説明できないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. I feel like there's more to the story
here. Wanna fill in the details for me?

fields.EN: I really was careless. Shirayuki is such a bad girl...
fields.JP:
ほんっとうに、うっかりしていたんです。
本当に駄目な子ですね、白雪なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: I was just careless. I'm a failure...

fields.EN: Don't be so hard on yourself. Mistakes happen.
fields.JP:
ああ、そんなに落ち込まないで。
君が反省してるのはわかったから
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be so hard on yourself. Mistakes happen.

fields.EN: (I say, having no idea what her mistake was.)
fields.JP: （肝心の原因は結局はぐらかされたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I say, having no idea what her mistake was.)

fields.EN: Do you guys do lab tests often?
fields.JP: いつもこんな物騒な実験をしてるのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you guys do lab tests often?

fields.JP:
いつもではないんですけど、
けっこうよく実験していますよ

fields.EN:
I always screw up experiments, so don't
worry!
fields.JP:
実験に失敗しちゃうのもいつものことなので、
心配しなくて大丈夫です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always screw up experiments, so don't
worry!

fields.EN: There isn't a single thing about that that makes me worry less...
fields.JP: 心配しなくていい要素が一つもないんだけど……

fields.EN:
Shoot. I'm realizing that this area may be
contaminated with poison.
fields.JP:
あ、忘れてました。
そういえば、まだこの辺りには毒の成分が
充満しているはずなんですけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot. I'm realizing that this area may be
contaminated with poison.

fields.EN:
Club members have been given an antibody
just in case, but you might be in danger, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
白雪や部員の人達は抗体ができてるから
大丈夫なんですけど、ジャックさんは
ちょっと危ないかもしれませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Club members have been given an antibody
just in case, but you might be in danger, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
It won't kill you, but the fumes may cause
nausea, loss of breath, heart palpitations,
and a negative outlook on life.
fields.JP:
命に関わる成分じゃないんですけど、
吸ってしまうと、目眩、動悸、息切れ、幻覚、
将来への漠然とした不安感などの症状が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It won't kill you, but the fumes may cause
nausea, loss of breath, heart palpitations,
and a negative outlook on life.

fields.EN: Are you serious?! That's almost worse!
fields.JP:
そ、それ、すごくやばい成分なんじゃない？
とくに後半の症状が怖い！
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you serious?! That's almost worse!

fields.EN:
Hehehe. But I can assure you that the
components are legal substances.
fields.JP: うふふ、どれも違法性のない成分ばかりですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. But I can assure you that the
components are legal substances.

fields.EN: (Ugh. I'm not feeling well... I'd better run.)
fields.JP:
（う、なんだか心なしか気分が悪くなって
　きたような……？　長居するとまずいかも）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ugh. I'm not feeling well... I'd better run.)

fields.EN:
Hameln asked me to give this to you.
Here you go.
fields.JP:
白雪姫、ハーメルンから手紙を渡すように
言われていたんだ。はい、これ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln asked me to give this to you.
Here you go.

fields.JP: 手紙ですか。これはご丁寧に、どうも

fields.EN: Okay. I appreciate all of your concern.
fields.JP:
はい！　いろいろ心配してくださって、
ありがとうございました
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. I appreciate all of your concern.

fields.EN:
That took forever. Just one more letter.
Last one's for Cinderella.
fields.JP:
長かった……。届けなきゃいけない手紙は、
残りあと一通だ。最後はシンデレラだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That took forever. Just one more letter.
Last one's for Cinderella.

fields.EN: If she's anywhere, it should be the detached storage room that's normally unused... I wonder if she's here today too.
fields.JP:
彼女がいるとしたら、普段使われていない
離れの倉庫のはずだけど……今日も来てるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She might be at the unused storage room.
I wonder whereabouts...

fields.EN: (This place feels chilly. Sure hope she's here)
fields.JP:
（……倉庫内の空気、ひんやりしてるな。
　シンデレラがいるといいけど）
fields.LOCALIZED: (This place feels chilly. Sure hope she's here)

fields.EN: No one is here! Kindly go away!
fields.JP:
ここには誰もいませんわ！
どうか見逃してくださいまし……！
fields.LOCALIZED: No one is here! Kindly go away!

fields.EN: Cinderella? It's me, Jack. Don't worry.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ？　僕だよ、ジャック。
安心していいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Cinderella? It's me, Jack. Don't worry.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: よかった、やっぱりここにいたんだね

fields.EN:
It is you, Jack-san. I started to panic thinking it
could be someone else.
fields.JP:
あなたでしたのね、ジャックさん。
他の人だったらどうしようかと思いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is you, Jack. I started to panic thinking it
could be someone else.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Then why lead with "No one is here"?
fields.JP:
だからって、「いません」って言うのは
どうかと思うけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: Then why lead with "No one is here"?

fields.EN: Oh, darn... You've caught me there.
fields.JP:
いやですわ、わたくしったら……。
気が動転してしまったのですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, darn... You've caught me there.

fields.EN:
(Cinderella's technically a grade or two above
me, but due to personal circumstances, she's
not an official Blood High student.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラは僕の先輩……のはずなんだけど、
　家庭の事情で入学できなかったので、
　実は学園の正式な生徒ではない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella's technically a grade or two above
me, but due to personal circumstances, she's
not an official Blood High student.)

fields.EN:
(We meet here during afternoons so that
she can enjoy a taste of the school life.)
fields.JP:
（そんな彼女に少しでも学園生活を
　味わってもらおうと、学校には内緒で
　放課後みんなとここに集まっているんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We meet here during afternoons so that
she can enjoy a taste of the school life.)

fields.JP: （まぁ、平たく言えば彼女は不法侵入者だ）

fields.EN:
What should I do if a member of the faculty
comes around? I am an outsider after all.
fields.JP:
他の学校関係者が来たらどうしましょう。
わたくしはいわば、不法侵入者ですから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should I do if a member of the faculty
comes around? I am an outsider after all.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. This place doesn't get a lot of
foot traffic after mornings.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。この倉庫に来るのは
ごく一部の人達だけだし、
来るとしても朝がほとんどだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. This place doesn't get a lot of
foot traffic after mornings.

fields.EN:
But if you are caught, tell them you were
waiting for me.
fields.JP:
それでも万が一見つかったら、
僕に呼ばれて待ち合わせしていた
とでも言えばいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if you are caught, tell them you were
waiting for me.

fields.EN: But then you will be punished.
fields.JP:
でも、それではあなたが叱られて
しまうのでは……
fields.LOCALIZED: But then you will be punished.

fields.EN: Don't worry about me. That's nothing.
fields.JP:
それくらい、どうってことないよ。
僕のことは気にしなくていいから
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry about me. That's nothing.

fields.EN:
Thank you so much... I am indebted to your
kindness.
fields.JP:
……ありがとうございます。
あなたは優しいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so much... I am indebted to your
kindness.

fields.EN:
Better than you getting in trouble. Did you
manage to sneak in without issue?
fields.JP:
そんな……。君が見つかっちゃうより
ずっとましだからね。それより、
今日もうまく学園内に入れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Better than you getting in trouble. Did you
manage to sneak in without issue?

fields.EN:
Yes. I zoomed by with unbelievable speed
thanks to the 12 Dash. Not a problem.
fields.JP:
はい。１２ダッシュで、それはもう
信じられないほどの速さで駆け抜けたので
大丈夫でしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I zoomed by with unbelievable speed
thanks to the 12 Dash. Not a problem.

fields.JP: 信じられないほどの速さ……

fields.EN:
Also, I accessed a secret passage so no one
saw me enter.
fields.JP:
あと、みなさんが確保してくれた
秘密の抜け道を通りましたので。
誰にも見とがめられずに入れましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, I accessed a secret passage so no one
saw me enter.

fields.EN:
G-Good to hear, but I'm not so sure that
the secret passage is the right move.
fields.JP:
そ、それはよかった。
君の足の速さなら、抜け道なんて
必要なかったかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
G-Good to hear, but I'm not so sure that
the secret passage is the right move.

fields.EN:
Hehe. I enjoy the school's ambiance.
It has a lively shine to it.
fields.JP:
ふふ、学校の雰囲気って好きですわ。
活気に満ちていて、きらきらして見えますの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. I enjoy the school's ambiance.
It has a lively shine to it.

fields.EN:
While I cannot join you in class, at least I can
soak up the atmosphere.
fields.JP:
さすがに授業は受けられませんけど、
おかげさまで学生気分を
満喫させてもらっていますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
While I cannot join you in class, at least I can
soak up the atmosphere.

fields.EN:
Glad to hear it. Let me know if there's
anything I can do for you.
fields.JP:
楽しんでくれてるみたいでよかった。
僕にできることがあれば、なんでも言ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad to hear it. Let me know if there's
anything I can do for you.

fields.EN:
Oh, I have something for you. A letter from
Hameln.
fields.JP:
それから、今日は渡す物があるんだ。
ハーメルンからの手紙なんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I have something for you. A letter from
Hameln.

fields.EN: A letter for me? Whatever could it say...?
fields.JP:
まぁ、わたくしに手紙？
なにが書いてあるのでしょう……
fields.LOCALIZED: A letter for me? Whatever could it say...?

fields.EN: Haven't read it, so beats me.
fields.JP:
さ、さあ～？
僕は読んでないからわからないなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Haven't read it, so beats me.

fields.JP:
（自然に渡せたかな？　自然に渡せたよな？
　うん）

fields.EN: Well, time for me to go. See you later.
fields.JP: じゃあ、僕はこれで……。また後で会おうね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, time for me to go. See you later.

fields.EN: ...? Why did he say he would see me later?
fields.JP:
？　そういえば、また後でって
なぜそんなことを……？
fields.LOCALIZED: ...? Why did he say he would see me later?

fields.EN:
Phew. Finally done. Got all of the invites to
where they need to be before 5 PM.
fields.JP:
はぁ……やっと終わった。
約束の１７時までにちゃんと手紙を
渡しきったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. Finally done. Got all of the invites to
where they need to be before 5 PM.

fields.EN:
Now all I need to do is visit the classroom
where Hameln is by 6 PM. I've got some
time to kill.
fields.JP:
さてと。あとは１８時にハーメルンが待つ
空き教室に行くだけだな。
まだ時間もあるし、適当に時間を潰すか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now all I need to do is visit the classroom
where Hameln is by 6 PM. I've got some
time to kill.

fields.EN:
(Wait... If I'm not surprised, then the others
might be disappointed.)
fields.JP:
（……いや、待てよ。サプライズ誕生日
　パーティで僕があんまり驚かなかったら、
　きっとみんながっかりするよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait... If I'm not surprised, then the others
might be disappointed.)

fields.EN:
(Guess I could practice being surprised until
it's time.)
fields.JP:
（約束の時間までに、自然に驚く練習を
　しておいたほうがいいかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess I could practice being surprised until
it's time.)

fields.EN:
Okay, it's almost 6. I think I got the whole
surprised face down. Easy peasy. Once
more for good look.
fields.JP:
……よし、もうすぐ１８時だ。
練習もしまくったから、驚く演技には
自信があるぞ。ちょっとやってみるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, it's almost 6. I think I got the whole
surprised face down. Easy peasy. Once
more for good look.

fields.JP: ウワー！　ナンダコレハー！！

fields.EN: YOU GUYS SURE SURPRISED ME! OH BOY!
fields.JP:
スッゴクビックリシタヨ！！
イヤァ、ウレシイナー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: YOU GUYS SURE SURPRISED ME! OH BOY!

fields.EN: Haha. Nailed it. Maybe I should join drama.
fields.JP:
……ふふ、完璧なナチュラルさだ。
僕って意外と演技派だったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. Nailed it. Maybe I should join drama.

fields.JP: コホン！　失礼しまーす！

fields.EN:
(No one's here. Am I at the wrong classroom?
Should be the right place.)
fields.JP:
（誰もいないぞ。教室を間違えたか？
　でもやっぱりここで合ってるはずだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No one's here. Am I at the wrong classroom?
Should be the right place.)

fields.EN:
(Did I remember the time wrong? It did say
6 PM...)
fields.JP:
（まさか時間が違ったとか？
　……いや、ちゃんと１８時で合ってるよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did I remember the time wrong? It did say
6 PM...)

fields.EN:
(What's this all about? Was there no surprise
to begin with?)
fields.JP:
（これってどういうことだ？
　つまりサプライズ誕生日パーティなんて
　最初からなかったという……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's this all about? Was there no surprise
to begin with?)

fields.EN:
(You got to be kidding! Did I wrongly assume
they'd throw me a surprise?)
fields.JP:
（え、嘘！　本当に！？
　ま、まさか……僕が勝手に
　思い込んでいただけってこと？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(You got to be kidding! Did I wrongly assume
they'd throw me a surprise?)

fields.EN:
(Oh man. That's so embarrassing. Now I feel
like a real piece of work. Was I cocky for
expecting one?)
fields.JP:
（うわあぁ、だとしたらすごく恥ずかしい！
　僕ってどんだけ自意識過剰！？　傲慢！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh man. That's so embarrassing. Now I feel
like a real piece of work. Was I cocky for
expecting one?)

fields.EN:
(Regardless, Hameln should be here, since
she's the one who invited me...)
fields.JP:
（だけどそれにしたって、
　せめて呼んだ張本人のハーメルンは
　待ってるべきだと思う……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Regardless, Hameln should be here, since
she's the one who invited me...)

fields.EN:
I feel pooped all of a sudden. Must be from
all that running I did.
fields.JP:
あぁ、気が抜けたらどっと疲れが……。
考えてみれば今日って、手紙を配るのに
奔走しただけの一日だったなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel pooped all of a sudden. Must be from
all that running I did.

fields.EN: ...Hey. Dad? Mom? Seriously. Is no one home?
fields.JP:
……あれ？　父さん？　母さん？
……嘘だろ、誰も家にいないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Hey. Dad? Mom? Seriously. Is no one home?

fields.EN: (Come to think of it, they were lovey-dovey this morning. Maybe they went out on a date like that and still haven't come back...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば今朝、ラブラブしてたっけ。
　あの勢いでデートにでも出かけて、
　そのまま帰ってきてないのかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe they went on a date without telling
me...)

fields.JP:
はぁ、虚しい……。
もうふて寝でもするしかないな……

fields.EN:
(So this is how my birthday ends...
Guess there's always next year.)
fields.JP:
（でも、僕の誕生日はこれで終わりか。
　……正直、ちょっと寂しいかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So this is how my birthday ends...
Guess there's always next year.)

fields.JP: 誕生日おめでとうございます！！
誕生日おめでとうございます～！
誕生日おめでとうございます！！
たんじょうびおめでとー！！
誕生日おめでとうございます！！
ジャック、驚いてくれたみたいね

（僕の誕生日は、もしかしたらまだ
　終わってなかったのかもしれない……）
ジャックのサプライズ誕生日パーティよ

fields.EN: Haha. You're speechless! I call that a success!
fields.JP:
ふふん、驚いて言葉もないようだな！
サプライズ大成功だぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. You're speechless! I call that a success!

fields.JP: やったー！　だいせいこうーー！！

fields.EN:
No. You almost ruined the whole thing,
Hameln.
fields.JP:
いや、ハーメルンのおかげで
普通に失敗するところだったけどね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You almost ruined the whole thing,
Hameln.

fields.EN: Yes. I think you owe the rest of us an apology.
fields.JP:
そうですよ～。
ちゃんと反省してくださいね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I think you owe the rest of us an apology.

fields.EN: Hmph? An apology for what, exactly?
fields.JP: む？　ワレに反省するところなどあったか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph? An apology for what, exactly?

fields.EN: Think long and hard about what you've done!
fields.JP: あんたねぇ、ちょっとは自覚しなさいっての！
fields.LOCALIZED: Think long and hard about what you've done!

fields.EN:
W-Well, we did surprise him, so everything
worked out?
fields.JP:
まあまあ、結果的には成功したんですから、
よかったですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, we did surprise him, so everything
worked out?

fields.EN: Mm... All that matters is the result.
fields.JP: ん……。終わりよければ、すべてよし……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... All that matters is the result.

fields.EN:
We planned to use the empty classroom first,
but we made a last-minute change.
fields.JP:
最初はハーメルンの空き教室を
会場にする予定だったけど、
急遽変更したのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We planned to use the empty classroom first,
but we made a last-minute change.

fields.EN:
We noticed you acting strangely, and knew it
was only a matter of time till you found out.
fields.JP:
どう考えても今日のジャックは様子が
おかしかったから、これはバレてるって
直感したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We noticed you acting strangely, and knew it
was only a matter of time till you found out.

fields.EN: Oh. So you all knew the whole time?
fields.JP:
あ、やっぱりおかしいと思われてたんだ。
僕の様子……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. So you all knew the whole time?

fields.EN:
You're not very good at keeping secrets,
Jack-san.
fields.JP: ジャックさんは隠し事が苦手なんですよね
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not very good at keeping secrets.

fields.EN:
Not to mention you were the one handing
out the invites.
fields.JP:
そもそも、あの手紙を持って来たのが
ジャック本人だったしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention you were the one handing
out the invites.

fields.EN:
So we confronted Hameln, and decided as
a group to adjust.
fields.JP:
そこでハーメルンを問い詰めた結果、
明らかにこの計画は露見しているだろうと
判断したの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we confronted Hameln, and decided as
a group to adjust.

fields.EN:
Booking a new venue would be a headache,
so we figured your bedroom would be the
next best place.
fields.JP:
今から別の会場を探すわけにも
いかなかったから、ジャックの部屋を
使わせてもらうことにしたってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Booking a new venue would be a headache,
so we figured your bedroom would be the
next best place.

fields.EN: I even got permission from your Mom and Dad.
fields.JP:
おじさんとおばさんには、
わたしから許可を取っておいたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I even got permission from your Mom and Dad.

fields.EN:
I was the last to receive my invitation, so I was
surprised by the sudden change.
fields.JP:
わたくしは手紙を受け取ったのが
最後でしたから、そのあとに場所の変更を
知らされて驚きましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was the last to receive my invitation, so I was
surprised by the sudden change.

fields.EN: If we'd gone to talk to her before Hameln's letter was delivered, we might've run into Jack.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの手紙を渡される前に
話しに行ったら、ジャックと鉢合わせ
しちゃうかもしれないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. There was a risk of you spotting us
if we told her too soon.

fields.EN:
Jack-san, when you said "see you later," I knew
something was off. The party was supposed to
be a secret.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんが「また後で」なんて
おっしゃるから、おかしいと思いましたの。
パーティのことは秘密のはずですのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said see you later, so I knew something
was off. It was supposed to be a surprise.

fields.JP:
とっくにバレてたってこと。
あー馬鹿らしい

fields.EN:
We didn't want all of our hard work to go
to waste at the last second.
fields.JP:
せっかく内緒で計画を進めてたのに、
直前でバレたら台無しですからね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't want all of our hard work to go
to waste at the last second.

fields.EN:
We couldn't have carried all of the decorations
without your help.
fields.JP:
会場変更でいろいろと荷物を運ぶとき、
かぐやさん大活躍でしたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We couldn't have carried all of the decorations
without your help.

fields.EN:
I'll say. My precious Bamboo One treated
like a mere packmule. Goodness...
fields.JP:
バンブー１号を台車代わりに
酷使されてしまいました～。
まったくも～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll say. My precious Bamboo One treated
like a mere packmule. Goodness...

fields.EN: Guys... I can't thank you all enough...
fields.JP: みんな……そこまでして、僕のために……
fields.LOCALIZED: Guys... I can't thank you all enough...

fields.JP: ふふん、感謝するんだぞ！
おめでとうございます！

fields.EN:
This party is a delight. Happy birthday again,
Jack.
fields.JP:
賑やかな誕生日パーティだな、ジャック。
改めて、誕生日おめでとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This party is a delight. Happy birthday again,
Jack.

fields.EN:
Thanks everyone. Wow, even Otsuu's got
birthday wishes for me. Talk about a real
bro.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、みんな……。
いやぁ、男友達のおつうにまで
祝ってもらえるなんて、ありがたいなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks everyone. Wow, even Otsuu's got
birthday wishes for me. Talk about a real
bro.

fields.JP:
あら、ジャックさんは
まだ気づいてませんの……？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Nope. He still thinks Otsuu's his bro...
fields.JP:
そうなのよ。あいつ、未だにおつうのこと
男だと思ってるの
fields.LOCALIZED: Nope. He still thinks Otsuu's his bro...

fields.EN:
One could easily tell, even if she wears boy
clothes.
fields.JP:
いくら男装してるからって、
わかりそうなものなんですけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
One could easily tell, even if she wears boy
clothes.

fields.EN:
Maybe it's a sign that Otsuu-chan's just too cool.
Hehe.
fields.JP:
それくらいおつうちゃんが
かっこいいってことかな？　えへへ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's a sign that Otsuu's just too cool.
Hehe.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: You sound a little biased there.
fields.JP: はい、のろけいただきましたー
fields.LOCALIZED: You sound a little biased there.

fields.JP: 胸のことはどう思ってるのかしら……

fields.EN: Hm? Looks perfectly fine to me.
fields.JP: うん、鳩胸で誤魔化せてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Looks perfectly fine to me.

fields.EN:
You're just saying that because you're
going steady!
fields.JP:
鳩胸で全部解決できると
思うんじゃないわよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're just saying that because you're
going steady!

fields.EN: Let's tone it down a bit.
fields.JP: それは限界がありますわねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's tone it down a bit.

fields.EN:
Seems like Jack-san's clueless about everything,
isn't he?
fields.JP:
単にジャックさんの目が節穴なだけじゃ
ないですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like Jack's clueless about everything,
isn't he?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: 案外、それが真実かもしれないわね……

fields.EN: What are you all talking about?
fields.JP: みんな、なにこそこそ話してるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you all talking about?

fields.JP:
あのねー、ジャックがはとむねで、
ふしあなってはなしだよ！

わわ、ラプンツェルさん、
ちょっと黙ってましょうね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.JP: ジャックは気にしなくていいから

fields.EN: Anyways Jack, we all chipped in on your gift!
fields.JP:
それよりジャック、貴様が希望した通りの
プレゼントを用意してやったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyways Jack, we all chipped in on your gift!

fields.EN:
You said you wanted a deck of cards!
Don't tell me you forgot!
fields.JP:
トランプが欲しいと言ったではないか！
忘れたとは言わせぬぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said you wanted a deck of cards!
Don't tell me you forgot!

fields.JP: ありがとう、ハーメルン

fields.EN: Here you go! A birthday cake from us!
fields.JP:
じゃーん！　わたしたちからは
特製バースデーケーキでーす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Here you go! A birthday cake from us!

fields.EN:
Wow, incredible! Topped with strawberries
and whipped cream. Is it homemade?
fields.JP:
うわぁ、すごい本格的！
生クリームたっぷりだし、イチゴも
たくさん……。これ、手作りなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow, incredible! Topped with strawberries
and whipped cream. Is it homemade?

fields.EN:
Yes. Ningyo-chan, Gretel-san, and my sisters
baked it.
fields.JP:
はい。人魚ちゃんとグレーテルさんと
白雪たち三姉妹で、がんばって作ったんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Little Mermaid, Gretel, and my sisters
baked it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Yes. It was quite the team effort.
fields.JP: ええ、なかなか興味深い体験だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. It was quite the team effort.

fields.EN:
Almost had to stop Gretel-san from scarfing
down the finished product.
fields.JP:
完成品をグレーテルさんが食べちゃいそうに
なったのには、焦りましたけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Almost had to stop Gretel from scarfing
down the finished product.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: 味見っていう量じゃなかったでしょ！

fields.EN: Haha. It looks delicious. I can't blame you.
fields.JP:
ははっ。すごく美味しそうだから、
食べたくなるのも無理ないよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. It looks delicious. I can't blame you.

fields.EN:
A present from me too. A handmade
handkerchief.
fields.JP:
僕からもプレゼント。
はい、手織りのハンカチ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A present from me too. A handmade
handkerchief.

fields.EN:
From me, hand-crafted floral wreaths...
I think they turned out quite nice.
fields.JP:
あの、わたくしからはお花で作った
リースを……。きれいに作れましたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From me, hand-crafted floral wreaths...
I think they turned out quite nice.

fields.EN:
Super special alloy scissors from me!
Cut through anything in one snip!
fields.JP:
あたしからのプレゼントは、
特別製の超合金ハサミ！　これでなんでも
ジャキジャキ切りまくっちゃって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Super special alloy scissors from me!
Cut through anything in one snip!

fields.EN:
Hey, Rapunzel will give you an 'I'll play with you anytime ticket'!
Use it whenever you want!
fields.JP:
あのね、ラプンツェルは
『いつでもあそんであげるよチケット』を
あげるよ！　いつでもつかってね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll give you one free "One on One" ticket,
redeemable any time!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
I got you a bamboo backscratcher.
Perfect for the hard-to-reach spots.
fields.JP:
わらわからは、竹製のまごの手を
プレゼントします～。遠くのものを
引き寄せるのに便利なんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got you a bamboo backscratcher.
Perfect for the hard-to-reach spots.

fields.EN:
Here you go. A copy of my favorite novel
as of late, "Psychology, Physics, and Skin
Rashes."
fields.JP:
私のプレゼントはこれ。
最近一番面白いと思った書籍の
『超心理学における物理と肌荒れ』よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here you go. A copy of my favorite novel
as of late, "Psychology, Physics, and Skin
Rashes."

fields.EN: Is that title supposed to be funny on purpose?
fields.JP:
難しいのか笑えるのか、
よくわからないタイトルね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that title supposed to be funny on purpose?

fields.JP: そういうあなたは、なにを用意したの？

fields.EN:
I brought him some tea leaves. In fact,
they're my favorite, so I wanted Jack to
sample them.
fields.JP:
わたしは、ギフト用の紅茶を……。
とってもおいしい紅茶だから、
ジャックにもぜひ味わってほしくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I brought him some tea leaves. In fact,
they're my favorite, so I wanted Jack to
sample them.

fields.EN: Thank you everyone... I'm so happy!
fields.JP:
みんな、ありがとう……！
本当に嬉しいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you everyone... I'm so happy!

fields.EN: Thrilled to hear you like your gifts.
fields.JP: 喜んでもらえてよかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thrilled to hear you like your gifts.

fields.EN:
After all we've done, if you weren't happy,
I'd have some choice words for you...
fields.JP:
これだけしたんだから、
喜ばなかったら許さなかったところよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all we've done, if you weren't happy,
I'd have some choice words for you...

fields.EN:
Hey... I just realized. Why are you wearing
your clothes from your electives?
fields.JP:
……あれ？　今気づいたけど、どうして
みんな部活のときの恰好のままなんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey... I just realized. Why are you wearing
your clothes from your electives?

fields.EN: Also, my door was locked. How'd you get in?
fields.JP:
それに僕の部屋には鍵をかけてあった
はずなのに、どうやって中に……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Also, my door was locked. How'd you get in?

fields.EN:
We're all in the same outfits because we came
right after practice ended.
fields.JP:
この恰好は、部活終わりに直行したからに
決まってるでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're all in the same outfits because we came
right after practice ended.

fields.JP:
予定より少し早めようって、
ハーメルンさんが提案したんですよね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Yes. Starting earlier means a longer party!
It was a good idea!
fields.JP:
うむ。早くから始めたほうが、
長い間パーティができるからな！
ワレながらよいあいでぃあだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Starting earlier means a longer party!
It was a good idea!

fields.EN: Of course, that also meant less time for set-up.
fields.JP:
その分、準備できる時間が減ることまでは
考えが及んでいなかったようだけど
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course, that also meant less time for set-up.

fields.EN:
But it's all worth it if we can celebrate
more!
fields.JP:
でもまぁ、できるだけ長い時間楽しく
やろうってのは、あたしも賛成！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's all worth it if we can celebrate
more!

fields.EN:
Hence why everyone agreed to change
the plan.
fields.JP: だからみなさんもその計画に乗ったんですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hence why everyone agreed to change
the plan.

fields.JP: なるほどね。ハーメルンらしい提案だな

fields.EN: Also getting into your room was a cinch.
fields.JP:
それと、鍵がかかったあなたの部屋に
入れた理由は簡単よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Also getting into your room was a cinch.

fields.EN: Don't tell me you guys picked the lock.
fields.JP: まさか、この中に鍵開けの名人が
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't tell me you guys picked the lock.

fields.EN:
I placed my Wonder Hole and used it
to enter this room directly.
fields.JP:
わたしのワンダーホールを設置して、
直接この部屋に入らせてもらったの
fields.LOCALIZED: I used Rabbit Hole to open the door.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ワンダーホール → Wonder Hole; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN: Really? Huh... Never thought of that.
fields.JP: え？　あ、そっか。その手があったか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? Huh... Never thought of that.

fields.EN: This is where I return. Right?
fields.JP: ここがわたしの帰るところだから。……ね？
fields.LOCALIZED: This is where I return. Right?

fields.EN:
(I didn't think everyone would do all this
just for me. To think I almost gave up hope.)
fields.JP:
（みんなに誕生日をこんな風に祝って
　もらえるなんて思わなかった。
　いったん諦めたぶん、余計に嬉しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't think everyone would do all this
just for me. To think I almost gave up hope.)

fields.EN:
I can't thank you guys enough for
everything.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't thank you guys enough for
everything.

fields.JP: ラプちゃん、眠くなっちゃった？
とか言ってるけど、今にも寝落ちしそうだな
こっちはとっくに寝ちゃってるし

fields.EN: It's pretty late, so I don't blame her.
fields.JP:
けっこう遅い時間だし、この子が
眠くなっちゃっても仕方ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's pretty late, so I don't blame her.

fields.EN: Yeah. It's getting to be about that time.
fields.JP: 本当だ。もうこんな時間か……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. It's getting to be about that time.

fields.EN: Time flies when you're having a blast.
fields.JP:
とっても楽しくて、時間が経つのが
あっという間でしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Time flies when you're having a blast.

fields.EN:
Staying up talking and playing games
was such a treat.
fields.JP:
たくさん遊んで、おしゃべりして、
楽しかったですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Staying up talking and playing games
was such a treat.

fields.JP: ワレはまだまだ遊び足りんぞ！

fields.EN:
I grew bored of playing the umpteenth game
of Old Maid.
fields.JP:
とは言っても、ずっとババ抜きばかりで
飽きてしまいました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I grew bored of playing the umpteenth game
of Old Maid.

fields.EN:
Well, we had to play a game that Rapunzel
and Hameln could understand.
fields.JP:
仕方ないわ。ラプンツェルやハーメルンでも
ルールがわかるゲームだと、
他にあまり選択肢がなかったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we had to play a game that Rapunzel
and Hameln could understand.

fields.EN: Mm? Are you making fun of me..?
fields.JP:
ん？
そこはかとなく馬鹿にされてるような……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm? Are you making fun of me..?

fields.EN: Shall we call it a night?
fields.JP: そろそろお開きにする？
fields.LOCALIZED: Shall we call it a night?

fields.JP:
そうだね。
みんな、今日は本当にありがとう

fields.EN: Time for us to head home then!
fields.JP: じゃあ、あたしたちは帰ろうか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Time for us to head home then!

fields.EN: Hey Nemu, wake up. We're going home.
fields.JP: ほら、ネム。帰るわよ。起きて
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Sleepy, wake up. We're going home.

fields.EN: We may have to carry her.
fields.JP:
白雪と親指姉様で支えて帰るしか
なさそうですね
fields.LOCALIZED: We may have to carry her.

fields.EN:
I wouldn't want all you girls to have to walk
home at this hour by yourselves. I'll come too.
fields.JP:
あ、こんな時間に女の子ばっかりじゃ
危ないかな。送っていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't want all you girls to have to walk
home at this hour by yourselves. I'll come too.

fields.EN: Don't worry. It's us, you know?
fields.JP:
いや、大丈夫でしょ。
このメンツだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry. It's us, you know?

fields.EN:
Oh, right. Otsuu's with you, so you're all
good!
fields.JP:
ああ、男のおつうがいるんだった。
それなら安心だね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, right. Otsuu's with you, so you're all
good!

fields.EN: I didn't mean it that way...but sure.
fields.JP:
そういう意味じゃなかったんだけど……。
まぁいいや
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't mean it that way...but sure.

fields.EN: Rapunzel, you should head to bed too.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、寝るなら自分の部屋に
戻らないと
fields.LOCALIZED: Rapunzel, you should head to bed too.

fields.JP:
むぅー……ここで、ねる……。
ジャックといっしょ……

fields.EN:
No, you can't! Just because you're his
sister doesn't mean...! You can't! I'll take
you to your room.
fields.JP:
だ、駄目よ！　いくら義妹だからって！
むしろ義妹だからこそ！
わたしが部屋まで連れて行くわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you can't! Just because you're his
sister doesn't mean...! You can't! I'll take
you to your room.

fields.EN: Well Jack-san, I think we better get going.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、わたしたちも
おいとましますね、ジャックさん
fields.LOCALIZED: Well Jack, I think we better get going.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
こちらこそ、ありがとう。
みんな、気をつけて帰ってね

fields.EN: Hoo. That was fun. Exhausting, but fun.
fields.JP:
はぁ。すごく楽しかった。
疲れたけど、いい誕生日だったなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hoo. That was fun. Exhausting, but fun.

fields.EN:
(I was occupied all day, so I couldn't confess
my feelings. But tomorrow's a new day!)
fields.JP:
（……でも、今日はドタバタしていて
　あの子に告白できなかったな。
　明日こそはちゃんと想いを伝えないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was occupied all day, so I couldn't confess
my feelings. But tomorrow's a new day!)

fields.JP: アリス。来てくれたんだね

fields.EN: Of course. You're the one who invited me.
fields.JP:
当然でしょ？
せっかくジャックが呼んでくれたんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. You're the one who invited me.

fields.EN:
Your letter said you had something very
important to discuss, so I was worried.
Is something the matter?
fields.JP:
でも「大切な話がある」なんて手紙が
突然きたから、びっくりしちゃった。
急にどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your letter said you had something very
important to discuss, so I was worried.
Is something the matter?

fields.JP: ……けじめをつけようと思ったんだ

fields.EN: We've been friends since we were kids.
fields.JP:
僕達は幼なじみで、昔から
ずっと一緒に過ごしてきたよね
fields.LOCALIZED: We've been friends since we were kids.

fields.EN:
Right. We've been classmates for so long
that you're closer than family to me.
fields.JP:
そうね。学校でも一緒だったし、
家族よりも長い時間を過ごしたかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We've been classmates for so long
that you're closer than family to me.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Out of everyone, I've always felt
especially close to you. I've come to
realize how much I depend on you.
fields.JP:
うん。君は僕にとって一番身近な存在で、
一番の理解者だよ。でも、僕はそれに
甘えていたのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Out of everyone, I've always felt
especially close to you. I've come to
realize how much I depend on you.

fields.EN: Being with you was so comfortable, and I was afraid this relationship would fall apart, so I've kept suppressing my feelings all this time.
fields.JP:
君との時間が心地よくて、
この関係が壊れてしまうのが怖くて、
ずっと自分の想いを押し殺してきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
For that reason, I've been holding back on
saying how I truly feel for a long time.

fields.EN:
But that's not right. Being as close as we are
without being totally honest.
fields.JP:
でも、それって不自然なことだと思うんだ。
自分の気持ちを偽ったまま、
君の隣にい続けるなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's not right. Being as close as we are
without being totally honest.

fields.EN:
So I've made up my mind. I need you to
know.
fields.JP:
だから、覚悟を決めた。
君に本当の気持ちを伝えようって
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I've made up my mind. I need you to
know.

fields.JP: 僕は君が好きだ、アリス

fields.EN:
Not just as a friend, but more than that...
I think I've always loved you.
fields.JP:
幼なじみとしてはもちろん、
一人の女の子として……。
たぶん、だいぶ前から好きだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not just as a friend, but more than that...
I think I've always loved you.

fields.EN: But what about you, Alice? Do you...love me?
fields.JP:
アリス、君はどう？
その……僕のことを、お、男として……
見れるかな
fields.LOCALIZED: But what about you, Alice? Do you...love me?

fields.EN:
You...really feel that way? When you could
date so many nicer girls than me?
fields.JP:
わ……わたしで……いい、の？
もっと他にも、素敵な女の子は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You...really feel that way? When you could
date so many nicer girls than me?

fields.EN:
Of course I do, Alice. There's no one else
for me.
fields.JP:
君がいいんだよ、アリス。
他の子じゃ駄目なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I do, Alice. There's no one else
for me.

fields.EN:
Huh? Are you crying? Sorry, did I say
something bad?
fields.JP:
えっ、な、泣いてるの？
ごめん、もしかして嫌だった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Are you crying? Sorry, did I say
something bad?

fields.EN:
No, no... I'm just so flattered. I never thought
this day would come.
fields.JP:
違うの。違うの……。嬉しくて、つい……。
ジャックに告白してもらえるなんて、
思いもしなかったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, no... I'm just so flattered. I never thought
this day would come.

fields.EN:
You know, I haven't been honest with my
true feelings either.
fields.JP:
あのね、自分を偽ってたのは
わたしも同じだったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I haven't been honest with my
true feelings either.

fields.EN:
I've always loved you too, but I haven't
found the courage to tell you.
fields.JP:
わたしも、ずっとあなたのことが好きだった。
でも、告白する勇気なんてなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've always loved you too, but I haven't
found the courage to tell you.

fields.EN:
Even if you eventually found a soulmate, I'd
be just as happy being your number one
as your childhood friend too.
fields.JP:
もしもジャックに恋人ができたとしても、
幼なじみとしてなら、わたしはあなたの
一番でいられるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you eventually found a soulmate, I'd
be just as happy being your number one
as your childhood friend too.

fields.EN:
But I was so afraid of losing our closeness
that I kept it to myself. I was a coward.
fields.JP:
あなたの一番でいられる立場を捨ててまで、
あなたに想いを伝える勇気なんてなかった。
わたしは弱虫だったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I was so afraid of losing our closeness
that I kept it to myself. I was a coward.

fields.EN: (I had no idea she felt this way...)
fields.JP: （アリスがそんなことを思っていたなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I had no idea she felt this way...)

fields.EN:
I figured I was better off not taking the leap,
as long as you were happy.
fields.JP:
ジャックが幸せなら、
別にわたしの気持ちなんて伝えなくても
いいと思っていたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured I was better off not taking the leap,
as long as you were happy.

fields.EN:
I kept it secret when there was nothing I
wanted more than to be there next to you,
laughing and smiling.
fields.JP:
本当は一番近くで笑っていたかったのに、
その願いは押し殺していたのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept it secret when there was nothing I
wanted more than to be there next to you,
laughing and smiling.

fields.JP: じゃあ、僕達は似た者同士だったんだ……
ふふっ、そうだったみたい

fields.EN:
Had you never confessed, then neither of us
would have known.
fields.JP:
ジャックが勇気を出してくれなかったら、
わたしたちは想い合っているのに、
ずっとなにも変わらないところだったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Had you never confessed, then neither of us
would have known.

fields.EN: So Jack, if you'll let me say it too...
fields.JP: ねぇ、ジャック。わたしからも言わせて
fields.LOCALIZED: So Jack, if you'll let me say it too...

fields.JP: あなたのことが大好きよ！

（今日はアリスが手料理を振る舞って
　くれるということで、家に招待してくれた）

fields.EN: (We used to play together at her house all the time, but I haven't been here much lately, so I'm a little nervous...)
fields.JP:
（昔はよく家で一緒に遊んだけど、
　最近はあんまり来てなかったから
　ちょっと緊張するな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I used to come over here for playdates,
but now it's the real thing...)

fields.JP: いらっしゃい、ジャック

fields.EN:
Thanks for having me. I'm surprised you
offered to make dinner for me.
fields.JP:
今日は呼んでくれてありがとう。
でも、手料理を作ってくれるなんて
急に言うから驚いたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for having me. I'm surprised you
offered to make dinner for me.

fields.EN: It's because...we're together now, aren't we?
fields.JP:
だって、ほら……。
わたしたち、こ、恋人同士に
なったわけでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: It's because...we're together now, aren't we?

fields.EN:
I always wanted a partner whom I could
impress with my cooking.
fields.JP:
昔から憧れていたの。
好きな人に手料理を食べてもらって、
おいしいって言ってもらうのが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always wanted a partner whom I could
impress with my cooking.

fields.EN:
So Jack, sit back and relax. I'll whip us up
something spectacular!
fields.JP:
だからほら、ジャックは
くつろいで待っていて。
腕によりをかけて料理を作るから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Jack, sit back and relax. I'll whip us up
something spectacular!

fields.EN: Cool. Can't wait to try it.
fields.JP: わかった。楽しみにしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Cool. Can't wait to try it.

fields.EN:
(I didn't know Alice could cook. Something
to remember for the future.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、アリスって料理
　できたんだな。幼なじみでも
　知らない一面ってあるものだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't know Alice could cook. Something
to remember for the future.)

fields.EN:
Okay, everything's coming together. Just need
to add these eggs.
fields.JP:
よし、ここまでは完璧よ。
あとはこの卵をふわふわに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, everything's coming together. Just need
to add these eggs.

fields.EN: I'm fine! Just dropped a bowl. Just a minute.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫よ。ちょっとボウルを
落としちゃっただけ。気にしないで
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm fine! Just dropped a bowl. Just a minute.

fields.JP: ……ん？　なんか焦げ臭くないか？

fields.EN: Aah. A rare moment of weakness for Alice.
fields.JP:
あー……。しっかり者のアリスにしては
珍しい失敗だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah. A rare moment of weakness for Alice.

fields.EN: Don't be sorry! Besides, what are you making?
fields.JP:
い、いや、落ち込まないで！
……ところで、なに作ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be sorry! Besides, what are you making?

fields.EN: Omurice... The chicken rice is already done. All I had left was to wrap it in fluffy egg, but...
fields.JP:
オムライス……。チキンライスは
もうできてるから、あとはふわふわ卵で
包めば完成だったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Omelette with rice. I managed to prep the
rice with the demi-glace sauce, so all I had
to do was top it with egg, but...

fields.EN:
No. You please just relax. I've got this recipe
memorized, so I can handle it.
fields.JP:
ううん、ジャックは待っていて。
レシピはちゃんと暗記してるし、
わたし一人で平気！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You please just relax. I've got this recipe
memorized, so I can handle it.

fields.EN:
I've been practicing cooking for you, so I'm
determined to get it perfect. Oh...
fields.JP:
ジャックに食べてもらいたくて
たくさん練習したんだから、今日こそは
絶対においしいオムライスを……あ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been practicing cooking for you, so I'm
determined to get it perfect. Oh...

fields.JP:
（そっか、練習してくれたんだ。
　僕のために……）

fields.EN:
If you say so, then I'll wait. But if you need
anything at all, just say the word.
fields.JP:
アリスがそう言うなら、待ってるよ。
でも手伝えることがあったらなんでも言ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you say so, then I'll wait. But if you need
anything at all, just say the word.

fields.EN: Okay it's done! It's all ready Jack.
fields.JP:
はい、できたわ！
お待ちどおさま、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay it's done! It's all ready Jack.

fields.EN: Wow. This smells delicious! Looks good too.
fields.JP:
わぁ、おいしそう！
形もすごくきれいだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. This smells delicious! Looks good too.

fields.EN: Right? All that hard work paid off.
fields.JP:
だから言ったでしょ？
たくさん練習したって
fields.LOCALIZED: Right? All that hard work paid off.

fields.EN:
I did worry about what we would do if the
dish hadn't turned out, but thanks to you, 
it's perfect.
fields.JP:
正直、上手にできなかったら
どうしようって思ってたの。
でもジャックのおかげでうまくいったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did worry about what we would do if the
dish hadn't turned out, but thanks to you, 
it's perfect.

fields.EN: Me? But I didn't do anything.
fields.JP: 僕？　なにもしてないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Me? But I didn't do anything.

fields.EN: You said you would wait for me.
fields.JP: 待ってる、って言ってくれたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: You said you would wait for me.

fields.EN:
You believed in me, and that was enough
to encourage me.
fields.JP:
ジャックがわたしを信じて、
わたしに任せてくれたんだと思ったら、
なんだか自信が出てきちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You believed in me, and that was enough
to encourage me.

fields.EN:
Just pour a little more of the demi-glace
and it'll be ready. Which design would
you like?
fields.JP:
さあ、あとはケチャップをかけたら完成よ。
ジャックはどんな柄がいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just pour a little more of the demi-glace
and it'll be ready. Which design would
you like?

fields.EN:
Like a heart, or cute animals. Maybe I could
write LOVE. Any requests?
fields.JP:
ハートとか、かわいい動物とか……
ＬＯＶＥって書くのもいいわね。
なにかリクエストはある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like a heart, or cute animals. Maybe I could
write LOVE. Any requests?

fields.JP: そんなサービスまであるんだ……

fields.EN:
(What should I ask for? I don't want to make
it harder for her, but LOVE would be kind of
embarrassing.)
fields.JP:
（でも、なにを頼もう？
　あんまり難しい柄だと困るだろうし、
　ＬＯＶＥはちょっと気恥ずかしいし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What should I ask for? I don't want to make
it harder for her, but LOVE would be kind of
embarrassing.)

fields.JP: そうだな、じゃあ……ハートで……

（って、ハートもけっこう
　恥ずかしかったかな……）

fields.EN:
Need to be careful with the demi-glace.
A little goes a long way...
fields.JP:
ケチャップで、慎重に、手の力は均一に、
そーっと、そーっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Need to be careful with the demi-glace.
A little goes a long way...

fields.EN:
It's splattered everywhere. Bottle must've
had some air in it.
fields.JP:
ちょっと飛び散っちゃったね。
容器に空気が入ってたのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's splattered everywhere. Bottle must've
had some air in it.

fields.JP: あ、アリス。ちょっとじっとしてて
頬、ケチャップがついちゃってる
はい、これできれいになった

fields.EN:
Hm? Oh sorry! Force of habit, I guess.
We used to do that as kids, so I...
fields.JP:
ん？　……あっ、ご、ごめん！
子供の頃と同じ感覚で、つい……！
この歳でやることじゃなかったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Oh sorry! Force of habit, I guess.
We used to do that as kids, so I...

fields.EN:
Oh, it's okay. You just caught me off-guard.
But since it was you...
fields.JP:
う、ううん。
ちょっとびっくりしちゃっただけ。
嫌じゃなかったわ。ジャックだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, it's okay. You just caught me off-guard.
But since it was you...

fields.EN: (Damn it, man! Is that all you've got to say?)
fields.JP:
（そう、って！
　もっと気の利いた言葉はなかったのか！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Damn it, man! Is that all you've got to say?)

fields.EN:
(She said she doesn't mind me licking her
because it's me!)
fields.JP:
（っていうか僕だから嫌じゃなかったなんて、
　そんなこと言われたら……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She said she doesn't mind me licking her
because it's me!)

fields.EN:
(Man, my heart's pounding like crazy.
Easy boy, steady!)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ、なんだかすごくドキドキしてきた。
　まずい、やばい、鎮まれ僕の心臓！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, my heart's pounding like crazy.
Easy boy, steady!)

fields.EN:
The heart didn't turn out too well.
I should have practiced more...
fields.JP:
ハートの形、汚くなっちゃった。
練習したときはうまくできたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The heart didn't turn out too well.
I should have practiced more...

fields.EN: It' okay, Alice. Hand me the sauce.
fields.JP: 大丈夫だよ。アリス、ケチャップを貸して
fields.LOCALIZED: It' okay, Alice. Hand me the sauce.

fields.EN:
If we pour on the splattered bits... There.
Looks like a heart to me.
fields.JP:
飛び出しちゃったところを隠すように
ケチャップをかけたら、ほら、
赤いハートになった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we pour on the splattered bits... There.
Looks like a heart to me.

fields.EN:
Wow Jack. I had no idea you were so
talented.
fields.JP:
ジャック、すごいわ。
こんなに器用だったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow Jack. I had no idea you were so
talented.

fields.EN:
It's nothing. You drew most of it, so I finished
it off.
fields.JP:
そんな、大したことじゃないよ。
アリスが途中までうまく描いてくれたから、
やりやすかったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nothing. You drew most of it, so I finished
it off.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Thank you. Seems even childhood
friends have a lot to learn from one another.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ありがとう。
幼なじみでも知らない一面って、
まだまだあるものなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Thank you. Seems even childhood
friends have a lot to learn from one another.

fields.EN:
I had the same thought. I didn't know
you could cook.
fields.JP:
それ、僕もさっき同じこと考えてた。
アリスって料理できるんだ、
知らなかったなーって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had the same thought. I didn't know
you could cook.

fields.EN:
I'm looking forward to learning even more
about you.
fields.JP:
これからも、いろんな君を
知っていけるといいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm looking forward to learning even more
about you.

fields.EN:
That makes two of us. Until then, why don't
