we savor the rest of our dinner?
fields.JP:
きっとできるわ。
ひとまず、今はわたしの手料理の味を
知ってもらっていいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That makes two of us. Until then, why don't
we savor the rest of our dinner?

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack. You're my guest, and you
even cleaned up for me.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジャック。
お客様なのに後片づけさせちゃって、ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack. You're my guest, and you
even cleaned up for me.

fields.EN:
Consider it my thanks for your wonderful
dinner.
fields.JP:
おいしい食事をご馳走してもらった
お礼だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Consider it my thanks for your wonderful
dinner.

fields.JP: お、おいしかった？　本当の、本当に？

fields.EN: Really! It was the best omurice I've ever had!
fields.JP:
うん、本当だよ。
今まで食べたオムライスで
一番おいしかった！
fields.LOCALIZED: Really! It was the best omurice I've ever had!

fields.EN: Thank goodness... You made my night.
fields.JP:
よかった……。
おいしいって言ってもらえて、すごく嬉しい
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank goodness... You made my night.

fields.EN:
I did screw up with the sauce design, but
nothing more practice won't fix.
fields.JP:
でもケチャップはちょっと失敗しちゃったし、
やっぱりまだまだね。もっと上達しないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did screw up with the sauce design, but
nothing more practice won't fix.

fields.EN:
It was flavorful from the start. With more
practice, you could turn pro.
fields.JP:
初心者でもこんなにおいしかったのに、
もっと上達したらプロみたいに
なっちゃうんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was flavorful from the start. With more
practice, you could turn pro.

fields.EN: I just know you'll make a great wife someday.
fields.JP:
きっと料理上手ないい奥さんに
なるんだろうな、アリスは
fields.LOCALIZED: I just know you'll make a great wife someday.

fields.EN: (Did I go too far?! Come on, man...)
fields.JP:
（なんか大胆なこと言っちゃったな。
　ちょっと照れてきた……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Did I go too far?! Come on, man...)

fields.EN:
I-I should get going. Don't want to overstay
my welcome...
fields.JP:
そ、それじゃあ、僕はそろそろ帰ろうかな。
あんまり長居してもあれだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I should get going. Don't want to overstay
my welcome...

fields.JP: （ん？　服の裾を引っ張られて……）

fields.EN: Um. My parents aren't home tonight.
fields.JP: あのね、今夜……うちの両親が留守なの
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. My parents aren't home tonight.

fields.EN: I get uneasy when I'm alone at night, so... would you stay with me until morning?
fields.JP:
夜に一人だと心細いから、
朝まで一緒に過ごしてくれない……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel lonely when they're gone, so would
you mind staying over?

fields.EN:
(Stay over as in just the two of us?
I'm sure she doesn't mean anything by it,
but...!)
fields.JP:
（つまり、二人きりでひと晩を共にすると！？
　変な意味じゃないのはわかってるけど！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Stay over as in just the two of us?
I'm sure she doesn't mean anything by it,
but...!)

fields.EN: ...No? I had a movie I thought we could watch.
fields.JP:
……駄目？　できればジャックと
一緒に観たかった映画もあるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: ...No? I had a movie I thought we could watch.

fields.EN:
(Aaaah! She's waiting for you! Don't be
a weirdo!)
fields.JP:
（ああもう、いい加減覚悟を決めろ！
　だから変な意味じゃなく！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Aaaah! She's waiting for you! Don't be
a weirdo!)

fields.EN: Sure. I'd be happy to spend the night.
fields.JP:
……わかった。
アリスがいいなら、泊まっていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure. I'd be happy to spend the night.

fields.JP:
（そう、大丈夫。泊まるだけ、泊まるだけ。
　なにも変なことはないんだから）

fields.EN:
(Still, as a guy, I have mixed feelings if she's
not wary of me at all...)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、あんまり警戒されなさすぎても、
　男としてはちょっと微妙な心境にも
　なるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But she sure left it late to ask me...)
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
(Guess that just means she trusts me.
That counts for something.)
fields.JP:
（まぁ、信頼されてると思えば悪くないよね。
　うん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess that just means she trusts me.
That counts for something.)

fields.EN: Let's watch over on the sofa.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、こっちのソファで
一緒に座って観ましょ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's watch over on the sofa.

fields.EN:
She's so close. I can't concentrate on this
movie...
fields.JP:
わ、距離近いな……。緊張で映画の内容
頭に入ってこなかったりして
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's so close. I can't concentrate on this
movie...

fields.EN:
Oh, nothing. Hope this movie's as good as
they say.
fields.JP: いや、なんでもない。映画楽しみだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, nothing. Hope this movie's as good as
they say.

fields.EN:
(What's got me so worked up? We're
perfectly fine taking things one step
at a time.)
fields.JP:
（僕達のこれからは、まだ長いんだ。
　時間はいくらでもある。
　ゆっくり歩いていけばいいよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's got me so worked up? We're
perfectly fine taking things one step
at a time.)

fields.EN:
(I'm amazed at how fresh but familiar
it all still feels to me.)
fields.JP:
（もうずいぶん昔のことのような気もするし、
　まだほんの少し前のことのような気もする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm amazed at how fresh but familiar
it all still feels to me.)

fields.EN:
(This is the story of me confessing my
love to my soulmate.)
fields.JP:
（これは、僕が運命の人に
　告白したときの話――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the story of me confessing my
love to my soulmate.)

fields.JP: 姫、こんなところに呼び出してごめん

fields.EN:
Of course. I've never seen the Jail Tower
up close, so I'm excited.
fields.JP:
ううん、いいよ。監獄塔って
こんなに近くで見たことなかったから、
ちょっと新鮮な気分で楽しいし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I've never seen the Jail Tower
up close, so I'm excited.

fields.EN:
What was it you wanted to discuss?
Was it not classroom-appropriate?
fields.JP:
それで、お話ってなに？
教室じゃ話せないこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What was it you wanted to discuss?
Was it not classroom-appropriate?

fields.EN:
Yes. I have something to tell you...
Please remain calm.
fields.JP:
……はい。姫に伝えなければ
ならないことがあります。
どうか落ち着いて聞いてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I have something to tell you...
Please remain calm.

fields.EN:
I have been pretending to be a boy, but
I'm not!
fields.JP:
僕はゆえあって男として
暮らしていましたが、
実は、男ではないのです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have been pretending to be a boy, but
I'm not!

fields.EN:
I understand your shock. But this is the
reality.
fields.JP:
驚くのも無理はないでしょう。
しかしこれは現実なんです受け止めてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand your shock. But this is the
reality.

fields.EN:
I've got a girl's body! A lady, a woman!
Two X chromosomes!
fields.JP:
僕のこの肉体はれっきとした女。
婦女子！　ウーマン！
染色体ＸＸなのです！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've got a girl's body! A lady, a woman!
Two X chromosomes!

fields.EN: I think everyone knows. Except Jack-san.
fields.JP:
むしろみんな気づいてるんじゃないかな。
ああ、ジャックさんは気づいてないと思うけど
fields.LOCALIZED: I think everyone knows. Except Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(That's news to me! I thought I kept it
under wraps pretty well... There goes
my grand confession.)
fields.JP:
（衝撃の事実！　上手く隠せてると
　思ってたのに……。すごく思い切って
　カミングアウトしたのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's news to me! I thought I kept it
under wraps pretty well... There goes
my grand confession.)

fields.JP:
はは、あはははは……。
そっか、みんな気づいてたのかぁ……

fields.EN: Was that a surprise to you? I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
なんかショック与えちゃったかな？
ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Was that a surprise to you? I'm sorry.

fields.EN:
No, that's fine. My acting skills could use
some work I guess.
fields.JP:
いや、いいんだ。
僕の男としての演技が
下手なだけだったんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's fine. My acting skills could use
some work I guess.

fields.EN:
But... Otsuu-chan, I always thought you were
gallant and cool.
fields.JP:
あ、でもね。
わたしはおつうちゃんのこと、
凛々しくてかっこいいと思ってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: But...I still think you're super noble and cool.

fields.EN:
You're my prince, aren't you? No one
else makes me feel like a princess like
you do.
fields.JP:
いつもわたしに王子様みたいに
接してくれるでしょ？　本当のお姫様に
なったみたいで嬉しかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're my prince, aren't you? No one
else makes me feel like a princess like
you do.

fields.EN:
But maybe that was stressful for you,
Otsuu-chan...?
fields.JP:
でも、もしかしておつうちゃんにとっては
ストレスだったのかな……？
えっ？　どうしてそんな……

fields.EN:
Because you felt the need to pose as a boy
when you're a girl. That seems tricky.
fields.JP:
だって女の子なのに男の子として
暮らすなんて大変でしょ？　もうやめたいと
思ったから打ち明けたのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because you felt the need to pose as a boy
when you're a girl. That seems tricky.

fields.EN:
N-No! I just got to thinking that I couldn't
confess my feelings unless you knew the
real me.
fields.JP:
ち、違う！　僕のこの想いを伝えるなら、
男と偽ったままじゃいけないと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No! I just got to thinking that I couldn't
confess my feelings unless you knew the
real me.

fields.EN: Hime. I have always loved you.
fields.JP: 姫。……ずっとあなたのことが好きでした
fields.LOCALIZED: Little Mermaid. I have always loved you.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Since the first time I laid eyes on you.
My heart calls to you like the sea to a
sailor.
fields.JP:
初めて会ったときからひとめぼれでした。
まるで離れ離れだった恋人と
再会したかのように胸が高鳴って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since the first time I laid eyes on you.
My heart calls to you like the sea to a
sailor.

fields.EN:
But my feelings only intensified as time
went on. I've been in love with you for ages.
fields.JP:
友人として共に過ごすうちに、
この想いはもっと強くなっていきました。
僕はずっと、あなたに恋をしています
fields.LOCALIZED:
But my feelings only intensified as time
went on. I've been in love with you for ages.

fields.EN:
Things might different now that you know
we're both girls, but would you go out with
me?
fields.JP:
女同士なんておかしいかもしれないけど、
僕と付き合ってくれませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Things might different now that you know
we're both girls, but would you go out with
me?

fields.EN: Are you sure? Even though I'm a girl?
fields.JP:
……いいの？
僕は男じゃないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you sure? Even though I'm a girl?

fields.EN: It's fine. I like you too, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
いいの。だってわたしも
おつうちゃんのこと好きなんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED: Duh. I like you just as much too, silly.

fields.EN:
I used to wish you really were a boy,
Otsuu-chan... but if we love each other, it's
fine even if we're both girls, right?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが本当に男の子だったら
よかったのにって思ってたけど、
好きなら女の子同士でもよかったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't matter what we are. All that
matters is that we share feelings for one
another.

fields.EN:
I could never ask anyone but you to be
my prince, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP: わたしだけの王子様になって。おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I could never ask anyone but you to be
my prince, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: ...And it would be my pleasure, Princess.
fields.JP: ……よろこんで。僕だけのお姫様
fields.LOCALIZED: ...And it would be my pleasure, Princess.

fields.EN:
Hime, allow me to escort you
to the aquarium.
fields.JP:
姫、本日の水族館デートの
エスコートはお任せを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid, allow me to escort you
to the aquarium.

fields.EN: Thank you. I look forward to it.
fields.JP: ありがとう。期待してるね
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you. I look forward to it.

fields.EN:
Wow. Look at all the colorful fishes!
I could stare at them all day.
fields.JP:
わぁ、きれいな魚がいっぱい！
ずっと見ていたくなっちゃうねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. Look at all the colorful fishes!
I could stare at them all day.

fields.EN:
I know the feeling. Especially when you
smile like that.
fields.JP:
そうですね。
僕も姫の笑顔が見られてよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know the feeling. Especially when you
smile like that.

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, I was talking about the fishes...
fields.JP:
……って、おつうちゃん。
さっきから魚よりもわたしのこと
ばっかり見てるでしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, I was talking about the fishes...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
We came to the aquarium to see the
aquarium. Like that! That fish is gigantic!
fields.JP:
せっかく水族館に来たんだから、
ちゃんと魚も見なきゃもったいないよ。
ほら見て、あの魚。すごくおっきいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We came to the aquarium to see the
aquarium. Like that! That fish is gigantic!

fields.EN:
You're right. I bet this thing could eat
half the sea.
fields.JP:
本当だ。あれだけ大きいと
食べごたえがありそうですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. I bet this thing could eat
half the sea.

fields.EN:
You could feed a village with that much
sashimi.
fields.JP: お刺身が何十人前も作れそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could feed a village with that much
sashimi.

fields.EN:
If you insist Princess, then I will catch every
one of its kind just for you.
fields.JP:
姫のご所望とあらば、あの魚の
十匹ニ十匹釣ってみせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you insist Princess, then I will catch every
one of its kind just for you.

fields.EN:
You're so dependable, Otsuu-chan. Even if we
were stranded on a deserted island, I wouldn't
worry as long as I was with you.
fields.JP:
頼もしいね。無人島に行ったとしても、
おつうちゃんと一緒なら心配なさそうだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
My hero. Glad to know I could count on you
even if we were stranded on an island.

fields.EN:
(Wow... Between Hime's dazzling
smile and this lovely date, everything is
going smoothly. Hmhmhm...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、姫の笑顔が眩しい。
　デートのつかみは上々。
　ここまでは完璧だな。ふふふ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow... Between Little Mermaid's dazzling
smile and this lovely date, everything is
going smoothly. Hmhmhm...)

fields.EN:
Look, Hime. That fish looks
yummy too. I bet it would be perfect
grilled or sauteed.
fields.JP:
姫、見てください。
あそこを泳いでる魚もおいしそうですね。
あれは焼くかムニエルにでもしましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look, Little Mermaid. That fish looks
yummy too. I bet it would be perfect
grilled or sauteed.

fields.EN:
Haha. Always thinking with your stomach,
Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
ふふ、おつうちゃんってば
食べることばっかりなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Always thinking with your stomach,
Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Oh, but this fish is poisonous.
fields.JP: ……あ。でもあの魚、毒があるんだって
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, but this fish is poisonous.

fields.EN:
That's what the placard next to the tank
says. Poisonous if ingested without proper
precaution.
fields.JP:
水槽の前にあの魚の説明書きがあるよ。
毒のある魚じゃ食べられないねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what the placard next to the tank
says. Poisonous if ingested without proper
precaution.

fields.EN:
You're right... Haha. Can't believe I missed
that.
fields.JP:
そ、そうですね。いやー、ははは、
僕としたことが説明を読み損ねるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right... Haha. Can't believe I missed
that.

fields.EN:
(Okay, everyone misses once. It's cool.
Just need to bounce back.)
fields.JP:
（うーん、ちょっとかっこ悪かったな。
　でも大丈夫。これから挽回していけば
　いいだけの話だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Okay, everyone misses once. It's cool.
Just need to bounce back.)

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, take a look at this tank too!
There's a shark in here!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、こっちの水槽もすごいよ。
大きいサメが泳いでる！　迫力満点だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, take a look at this tank too!
There's a shark in here!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
If I ever came across one in the ocean,
I would die from fright.
fields.JP:
だけど、もしも海であんなサメに
出くわしちゃったらって思うと怖いなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I ever came across one in the ocean,
I would die from fright.

fields.EN:
Worry not. I wouldn't let a single fing—
I mean, a single fin touch you.
fields.JP:
心配には及びません。
姫には指一本、いえ、ヒレ一枚たりとも
触れさせはしませんとも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worry not. I wouldn't let a single fing—
I mean, a single fin touch you.

fields.EN:
I'll protect you from any shark who dares
attack my princess!
fields.JP:
凶暴なサメからであろうと、
姫のことはこの僕がお守りしましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll protect you from any shark who dares
attack my princess!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(That's more like it. Now Hime's
sure to like me even more!)
fields.JP:
（ふっ、決まった。これで姫も僕に
　惚れ直すこと間違いなし！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's more like it. Now Little Mermaid's
sure to like me even more!)

fields.EN: Actually, it seems this shark is friendly.
fields.JP: でも、このサメは大人しいサメなんだって
fields.LOCALIZED: Actually, it seems this shark is friendly.

fields.EN:
Seeing it in its natural habitat might
frighten people, but it's not a predator.
fields.JP:
海で会っちゃったら怖いけど、
人が襲われることはないみたいだから
大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing it in its natural habitat might
frighten people, but it's not a predator.

fields.EN:
But I was happy when you said you'd protect me,
Otsuu-chan. Thank you!
fields.JP:
あ、でもおつうちゃんが守ってくれるって
言ったのは嬉しかったよ。ありがとう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm grateful you would do all that for
me.

fields.EN: (Ugh, I thought I sounded cool, but I blew it—and made Hime worry about me instead. I need to try harder...)
fields.JP:
（うぅ、決まったと思ったのに滑って、
　しかも逆に姫に気を遣わせてしまうなんて。
　もっとがんばらないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought I nailed that response, but she
countered me with her trivia.)

fields.EN: Um, Otsuu-chan... I'm having a great time with you.
fields.JP:
……あのね、おつうちゃん。
わたし今、すごく楽しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, Otsuu... I'm having a great time with you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Going on a date with you like this has had my
heart fluttering the whole time, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
こうしておつうちゃんと一緒に
デートに来られて、心がずっと
うきうきしちゃってるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been looking forward to going on a
date with you for some time now.

fields.EN:
Which means, you don't have to try so
hard to impress me.
fields.JP:
だからね、がんばってかっこいいところを
見せようとしてくれなくてもいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means, you don't have to try so
hard to impress me.

fields.JP: ……最初からバレてたってこと？

fields.EN:
I know you, Otsuu-chan. You're trying to keep
me entertained, right?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんのことなら、なんとなく
わかっちゃうの。がんばってわたしを
楽しませようとしてくれてたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you, Otsuu. You're trying to keep
me entertained, right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
But just being with you is fun and makes me
happy, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
でもわたしはおつうちゃんと一緒にいるだけで
楽しいし、幸せなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Spending time with you is all I need.

fields.EN: Besides, I've got the coolest prince around.
fields.JP:
それにね、わたしの王子様は
普段通りで十分かっこいいんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides, I've got the coolest prince around.

fields.EN:
*sigh* So you knew it all from the start...
All my work, wasted.
fields.JP:
……はぁ。それにしても、姫には
すべてお見通しだったというわけか。
僕も無駄なことをしたなぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* So you knew it all from the start...
All my work, wasted.

fields.EN:
Oh no, that's not true. I was happy seeing how
hard you were trying for me, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
えー、そんなことないよ。わたしのために
一生懸命なおつうちゃんが見れて、
わたしは嬉しかったけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no, it's not wasted. I'm flattered you
want to impress me.

fields.EN:
That's a relief. This is all new to me.
I wanted to escort you with class.
fields.JP:
姫が喜んでくれるのはなによりだけど、
ちょっと複雑だな。せっかくかっこよく
エスコートしたかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a relief. This is all new to me.
I wanted to escort you with class.

fields.EN:
You're cool even when you're just being yourself,
Otsuu-chan. So today, relax and enjoy it with me,
okay?
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは普通にしてても
かっこいいんだから、今日は自然体で
一緒に楽しめばいいよ。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're cool just the way you are, so
be yourself, okay?

fields.EN:
(How does she expect me not to blush
after hearing that...?)
fields.JP:
（姫にかっこいいと言われただけで、
　顔がにやけそうになる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How does she expect me not to blush
after hearing that...?)

fields.EN:
Now that's settled, let's keep this date
going. Plenty of time to woo you later.
fields.JP:
……わかった。
今日は一緒にめいっぱい楽しもう。
エスコートは、また次の機会にね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that's settled, let's keep this date
going. Plenty of time to woo you later.

fields.EN: Ahh. That was a date to remember.
fields.JP:
はー、いっぱい遊んだなぁ。
今日は楽しかったねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Ahh. That was a date to remember.

fields.EN:
Totally. We got to do so much. Like watch
the dolphin show and munch on aquarium
snacks.
fields.JP:
うん、満喫したね。
イルカショーも見たし、
水族館限定スイーツも食べたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Totally. We got to do so much. Like watch
the dolphin show and munch on aquarium
snacks.

fields.EN:
The illuminated jellyfish tank was
marvelous as well. How romantic.
fields.JP:
あと、きれいなイルミネーションの
クラゲ水槽もよかったなぁ。
すごくロマンチックな雰囲気だったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The illuminated jellyfish tank was
marvelous as well. How romantic.

fields.EN:
That explains why they say the aquarium
is the perfect date spot.
fields.JP:
あの水族館が人気のデートスポットに
なるわけだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That explains why they say the aquarium
is the perfect date spot.

fields.JP: また一緒に行こうね、おつうちゃん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan
Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Hime... Do you really think that
it's okay we're together?
fields.JP: ……姫は……本当に僕でよかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid... Do you really think that
it's okay we're together?

fields.EN:
There were plenty of couples out there,
but we were the only girl-girl pair.
fields.JP:
今日はたくさんの人達がデートに
来てたけど、みんな男女のカップルで、
女同士なんて僕達だけだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were plenty of couples out there,
but we were the only girl-girl pair.

fields.EN:
Onlookers might have thought we're
just friends, which makes me sad...
fields.JP:
僕達は、きっと傍から見れば女友達同士に
見えていたよね。なんか、急に情けなく
思えてきちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Onlookers might have thought we're
just friends, which makes me sad...

fields.EN:
No matter how badly I want to be your
prince, I can't. Are you okay with that?
fields.JP:
僕はどんなに王子様になりたいと思っても、
本物にはなれない。姫はそんな僕でも
いいのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how badly I want to be your
prince, I can't. Are you okay with that?

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, you are my one true prince.
It has to be you.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんはわたしにとって
本物の王子様だし、
わたしはおつうちゃんがいいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you are my one true prince.
It has to be you.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
I know that, but who cares? Life is for
living, know what I mean?
fields.JP:
そんなの知ってる。
でも女の子同士じゃいけないなんて、
そんな決まりはないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that, but who cares? Life is for
living, know what I mean?

fields.EN:
If you keep putting my sweet Otsuu-chan
down, I'll never forgive you, got it?
fields.JP:
わたしが選んだおつうちゃんを悪く言ったら、
いくらおつうちゃんでも許さないんだからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you keep putting my sweet Otsuu
down, I'll never forgive you, got it?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
You see, nothing can stop me from loving
you. Your charm is incomparable, and that's
the Otsuu-chan I fell in love with.
fields.JP:
あのね、わたしはどんなおつうちゃんも
好きなの。王子様みたいにかっこいい
おつうちゃんも、可愛いおつうちゃんも
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see, nothing can stop me from loving
you. Your charm is incomparable, and that's
the Otsuu I fell in love with.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=3

fields.EN:
Even when you were talking with Jack-san and
Alice-san at school, you kept checking on me,
Otsuu-chan, didn't you?
fields.JP:
学校でジャックさんやアリスさんと
しゃべってるときも、おつうちゃんってば、
しょっちゅうわたしを気にしてたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think I haven't caught you staring
at me when I'm chatting with Alice or Jack
at school.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1; アリス => Alice-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1

fields.EN:
You really put yourself out there from
the beginning, didn't you? It was adorable.
fields.JP:
ちょっと不器用だけど、
がんばってアピールしようとしてたよね。
なんか可愛いなーって思ってたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really put yourself out there from
the beginning, didn't you? It was adorable.

fields.JP:
うわぁ、そこまでバレちゃってたのか。
恥ずかしい……

fields.EN:
You don't have to be embarrassed, Otsuu-chan.
I'm telling you I like that side of you too.
fields.JP:
恥ずかしがらなくてもいいでしょ。
わたしはそういうおつうちゃんも
好きだよって話なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing to be embarrassed about.
I'm trying to say I like you just the way you
are.

fields.EN:
I think to myself sometimes that it's a
miracle that we get to enjoy each other's
company like we do.
fields.JP:
わたしね、ふと思うの。この幸せな世界で、
わたし達がこうして一緒にいられるのって、
奇跡なんじゃないかって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think to myself sometimes that it's a
miracle that we get to enjoy each other's
company like we do.

fields.EN:
Think about it. There's a chance we never
would have met, and there's the possibility
of us separating further down the line.
fields.JP:
運命によっては、もしかしたら
出会えなかったかもしれない。離れ離れに
なってしまっていたかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think about it. There's a chance we never
would have met, and there's the possibility
of us separating further down the line.

fields.EN:
It's a worrying though. But maybe I'm only
clutching so hard because I know this is too
good to lose.
fields.JP:
そう思うと、ちょっと不安になるの。
きっと今が幸せすぎるからだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a worrying though. But maybe I'm only
clutching so hard because I know this is too
good to lose.

fields.EN:
(When she puts it that way, it worries me
too. Even though it's just a possibility...)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう……。姫の話を聞いていたら、
　僕まで妙に心がざわついてきた。
　単に可能性の話なのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When she puts it that way, it worries me
too. Even though it's just a possibility...)

fields.EN:
(If fate somehow conspired to tear us apart,
I would...)
fields.JP:
（もしも姫と引き裂かれるような
　運命があったとしたら、僕は……っ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If fate somehow conspired to tear us apart,
I would...)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 僕はこの手を離さない！

fields.EN:
These hands are mine to hold for eternity,
no matter what cruel tricks fate plays!
You never have to worry, Hime.
fields.JP:
どんな運命が襲って来たとしても、
僕は姫の手を決して離さないと誓います。
だから安心してください、姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
These hands are mine to hold for eternity,
no matter what cruel tricks fate plays!
You never have to worry, Little Mermaid.

fields.JP: えへへ、嬉しすぎてキスしちゃった

fields.EN:
When you said you wouldn't let go of my hand,
Otsuu-chan, all the worry in my chest somehow
disappeared.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが手を離さないって
言ってくれたら、なんとなく
胸の中にあった不安が全部消えちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
All of the worry left me as soon as you
said my hands are yours to hold forever.

fields.EN: Thank you, Otsuu-chan. My dashing prince.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、おつうちゃん。
やっぱりおつうちゃんは、
わたしの素敵な王子様だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you, Otsuu. My dashing prince.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.JP: ……あれ？　固まっちゃって、どうしたの？

fields.LOCALIZED: A kiss... Little Mermaid kissed me.

fields.EN: Eeek! Did you Otsuu-chan just faint?!
fields.JP: きゃー！　おつうちゃんが倒れたー！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Eeek! Did you Otsuu just faint?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(The rush from the touch of Hime's lips was enough to make
me faint.)
fields.JP:
（姫からのほっぺチューで脳の許容量が
　越えた僕は、無様にもその場に倒れて
　しまったのだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The rush from the touch of Little
Mermaid's lips was enough to make
me faint.)

fields.EN:
(Looks like there's a long way to go before
this frog becomes the perfect prince.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり完璧な王子様への道のりは、
　まだ遠そうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like there's a long way to go before
this frog becomes the perfect prince.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if she even read the letter.
I've been here for thirty minutes with
no sign of her...)
fields.JP:
（手紙、読んでくれたのかな。
　かれこれ三十分は待ってるけど、本当に
　来てくれるのか不安になってきた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if she even read the letter.
I've been here for thirty minutes with
no sign of her...)

fields.EN: (Shoot. Maybe she's not going to show...)
fields.JP: （……まさか、このまま来なかったりして）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Shoot. Maybe she's not going to show...)

fields.EN: What is it? You seem surprised.
fields.JP:
なんですか～？
そんな大げさに感動したりして～
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it? You seem surprised.

fields.EN: I started to think maybe you stood me up.
fields.JP:
いや、もう来てくれないんじゃないかと
不安になってたところだったから……
fields.LOCALIZED: I started to think maybe you stood me up.

fields.EN: Forgive me. I ran a bit behind.
fields.JP:
すみません～。
ちょっとだけ時間に遅れてしまいました～
fields.LOCALIZED: Forgive me. I ran a bit behind.

fields.EN:
That's okay. I'm used to it by now. I had
something important to tell you.
fields.JP:
う、うん。遅れたのは別にいいんだ。
それより、今日は大事な話を聞いてくれるかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's okay. I'm used to it by now. I had
something important to tell you.

fields.EN:
Something important? Whatever it is,
be a dear and give me the concise version.
fields.JP:
大事な話ですか～？
よくわかりませんけど、手短にお願いしますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something important? Whatever it is,
be a dear and give me the concise version.

fields.EN:
(She has no clue what I'm going to tell
her. Best to be straight-forward...)
fields.JP:
（なんの話か、本当にわかってなさそうだな。
　ここは単刀直入に行くしかない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has no clue what I'm going to tell
her. Best to be straight-forward...)

fields.EN: I love you, Kaguyahime! Princess Kaguyahime...!
fields.JP: 君のことが好きなんだ！　かぐや姫……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I love you, Kaguya! Princess Kaguya...!

fields.EN: I-I love you. Wanna go out with me?
fields.JP:
だ、だから好きなんだ。
できれば僕と付き合ってくれないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I love you. Wanna go out with me?

fields.EN:
...Do my ears deceive me, or did you just
profess your love for me?
fields.JP:
……わらわの耳が確かなら、今、
好きとか言いませんでした～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Do my ears deceive me, or did you just
profess your love for me?

fields.EN:
Is this some sort of prank? You know how
I feel about those.
fields.JP:
からかってるんですか～？
そういう冗談は好きじゃありません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this some sort of prank? You know how
I feel about those.

fields.EN:
You must have a demented sense of humor
if you get a rise out of this sort of thing.
fields.JP:
そんな冗談を言うなんて、
悪趣味なんですね～。意外でした～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must have a demented sense of humor
if you get a rise out of this sort of thing.

fields.EN: It's not a prank! I really do love you!
fields.JP:
じょ、冗談じゃないよ？
僕は本気で君のことが……！
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not a prank! I really do love you!

fields.EN:
So it wasn't a prank. You must have awful
taste.
fields.JP:
だとすれば、悪趣味じゃなくて
趣味が悪いんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it wasn't a prank. You must have awful
taste.

fields.EN:
Who in their right mind could love
someone who demands as much as
I would...?
fields.JP:
なにかと用事を言いつけてくる
面倒くさい後輩なんて、
誰が好きになるって言うんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who in their right mind could love
someone who demands as much as
I would...?

fields.EN:
Oh. So you're admitting you ask a lot of
favors.
fields.JP:
あ、なにかと用事を言いつけてる
自覚はあったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. So you're admitting you ask a lot of
favors.

fields.EN:
Jack-san always takes on anything I ask without
so much as a frown, so I can't help relying on
him~
fields.JP:
ジャックさんはどんな頼みごとも
嫌な顔一つせず引き受けてくれるので、
ついつい頼んじゃうんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would require my love to heed my call
at a moment's notice.

fields.EN:
Besides, I'm as lazy as they come, so
there's not much to love.
fields.JP:
そもそも、わらわはだらけてばかり
じゃないですか～。好きになる要素が
どこにあるのか教えてほしいくらいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I'm as lazy as they come, so
there's not much to love.

fields.EN:
Sure. I caught onto your lazy act at first,
but then I realized there's so much more
to you.
fields.JP:
たしかに最初はグータラな後輩かと
思ってたけど、それだけじゃないって
だんだんわかってきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. I caught onto your lazy act at first,
but then I realized there's so much more
to you.

fields.EN: You seem lazy, but not irresponsible.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫は普段だらだらしてるけど、
不真面目ってわけじゃないよね
fields.LOCALIZED: You seem lazy, but not irresponsible.

fields.EN:
Like with the surprise party. I saw how
much effort you put in.
fields.JP:
この間のサプライズ誕生日パーティの
ときだって、準備のためにいろいろと
がんばってくれたじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like with the surprise party. I saw how
much effort you put in.

fields.EN: You do what matters even when it's a pain, and I think you usually conserve your stamina and mental energy.
fields.JP:
君は大事なことは面倒でもちゃんと
やってくれるし、普段は体力や気力を
温存してる感じなのかなって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you save your enthusiasm for things
that really move you. I respect that.

fields.EN:
Um... Don't you think you're being a tad
generous?
fields.JP:
……それは……好意的に解釈しすぎ
なんじゃないですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Don't you think you're being a tad
generous?

fields.EN: Maybe, but that's love. Love is generosity.
fields.JP:
そうかもね。
でも好きな子のことなんだから、
好意的に解釈しちゃうのも仕方ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe, but that's love. Love is generosity.

fields.EN:
Knock on my taste all you want, I still
love you. Even when we're doing nothing
at all.
fields.JP:
いくら趣味が悪いって言われても、
やっぱり僕はかぐや姫が好きなんだ。
君と一緒にいるときのだらけた空気も
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knock on my taste all you want, I still
love you. Even when we're doing nothing
at all.

fields.EN:
...Or is the problem that you don't see me
as more than a servant?
fields.JP:
……それとも、かぐや姫は僕のこと、
ただのパシリとしか見られないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Or is the problem that you don't see me
as more than a servant?

fields.EN:
I-I have never once thought of you as an errand
boy, Jack-san~
fields.JP:
……わ、わらわはジャックさんのことを、
一度でもパシリだなんて思ったことは
ありません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have never thought of you as a mere
servant.

fields.EN:
Of course not! I rely so much upon your
kindness.
fields.JP:
当たり前です～！
その……いつもあなたの親切に
甘えてしまっていただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not! I rely so much upon your
kindness.

fields.JP:
……本当に、わらわのこと……
好きなんですか～？

fields.EN: Duh. Should I have saved it for another time?
fields.JP:
本当だよ。かぐや姫は、
僕に告白されて嫌だった？
fields.LOCALIZED: Duh. Should I have saved it for another time?

fields.JP: い、いいえ……。嬉しかったです～……

fields.EN:
B-But are you prepared to accept that I'll
still be my lazy self? Is that what you want?
fields.JP:
で、でも、仮に付き合ったとしても、
わらわは今まで通りだらけますよ～？
それでもいいんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But are you prepared to accept that I'll
still be my lazy self? Is that what you want?

fields.EN: You bet it is. I like you for who you are.
fields.JP:
むしろそれでいいんだよ。
そういう君を、僕は好きになったんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: You bet it is. I like you for who you are.

fields.JP: つ、つくづく物好きな人ですね～

fields.EN: But maybe strange is exactly what I need.
fields.JP:
……でもまぁ、そういう変わり者なら、
わらわにも合うかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED: But maybe strange is exactly what I need.

fields.JP:
せっかくの告白ですし、
受けてあげることにします～

fields.EN: Hehe. Maybe lazing around together from now on wouldn't be so bad~
fields.JP:
ふふ。これからは二人でグータラするのも
悪くないかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Perhaps "World's Laziest Couple"
has a certain ring to it.

fields.EN: (And that's how Kaguyahime and I got together.)
fields.JP: （僕とかぐや姫は晴れて恋人同士になった）
fields.LOCALIZED: (And that's how Kaguya and I got together.)

fields.EN:
(But as a couple, we have a rather...
unique situation.)
fields.JP:
（そう。なったはず、なのに……。
　この状況はなんなんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But as a couple, we have a rather...
unique situation.)

fields.EN:
(My girlfriend's here in my room, but it's
not as sweet or heart-racing as I imagined.)
fields.JP:
（恋人が自分の部屋に来ているというのに、
　甘い雰囲気にもドキドキの展開にも
　ならないってどういうことだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My girlfriend's here in my room, but it's
not as sweet or heart-racing as I imagined.)

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime's spent the whole day grinding
in her RPG, and I'm just picking up after
her.)
fields.JP:
（さっきからかぐや姫はＲＰＧのレベル上げ
　しかしてないし、僕は彼女をかいがいしく
　世話するばかり）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya's spent the whole day grinding
in her RPG, and I'm just picking up after
her.)

fields.EN:
(Expectation is one thing, but reality is
another.)
fields.JP: （予想していたとはいえ、少し寂しい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Expectation is one thing, but reality is
another.)

fields.EN:
Your house is so conveniently close to school,
Jack-san~ Mine is so far away~
fields.JP:
ジャックさんの家は学校に近くて
便利ですね～。わらわの家は遠いので～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness your house is so much
closer to school. My place is soooo far.

fields.EN:
Here I am, being served tea simply for
being a guest. Paradise for a homebody
like me.
fields.JP:
黙っていてもお茶を出してもらえるし、
ここはだらだらするには最高の環境ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here I am, being served tea simply for
being a guest. Paradise for a homebody
like me.

fields.EN: Haha. Well, thanks. Have more tea.
fields.JP:
はは、それはどうも……。
はい、新しいお茶入れてきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. Well, thanks. Have more tea.

fields.EN:
You're on top of it. I just noticed the
bottom of my teacup.
fields.JP:
気が利きますね～。ちょうどお茶が
なくなったところだったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're on top of it. I just noticed the
bottom of my teacup.

fields.EN:
(Not that I'm opposed necessarily to our
arrangement, but I'm practically a butler.)
fields.JP:
（不満があるわけではないけど、
　これじゃあパシリと待遇が大差ない
　ような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that I'm opposed necessarily to our
arrangement, but I'm practically a butler.)

fields.EN: Jack-san, you sure are the sweetest.
fields.JP:
ふふ、やっぱりジャックさんは
優しいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, you sure are the sweetest.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(But it's all worth it just to see her smile.
Maybe I'm the simple one.)
fields.JP:
（だけど彼女が笑ってくれてるだけで
　顔がにやけそうになっちゃう辺り、
　僕も単純だよなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But it's all worth it just to see her smile.
Maybe I'm the simple one.)

fields.EN:
Would you be so kind as to level up my
party?
fields.JP:
優しいついでに、このＲＰＧのレベル上げを
頼んでいいですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would you be so kind as to level up my
party?

fields.EN: Only while I rest and sip more tea.
fields.JP:
わらわがお茶を飲んで休憩している
間だけでいいんで、お願いします～
fields.LOCALIZED: Only while I rest and sip more tea.

fields.JP: まぁ、いっか。やっておくよ

fields.EN:
(I feel like making the relationship official
should open us up to doing more together.)
fields.JP:
（付き合い始める前よりも、頼まれる雑用が
　増えた気がしなくもない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like making the relationship official
should open us up to doing more together.)

fields.EN: (But knowing I'm the only person Kaguyahime asks to do things like this doesn't feel bad. Maybe this is the weakness that comes with being in love...)
fields.JP:
（でもかぐや姫がこんなことを頼む相手が
　僕だけだと思うと、悪い気はしない。
　これも惚れた弱みってやつかもな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But caring for her makes me happy.
The things we do for love.)

fields.EN: Urrr... My back's a bit sore.
fields.JP: う～。ちょっと腰が痛いです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Urrr... My back's a bit sore.

fields.EN:
You okay? You've been sitting in the same
position for hours. Might need to stretch.
fields.JP:
大丈夫？　ずっと同じ体勢でいたから、
体が固まっちゃったのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You okay? You've been sitting in the same
position for hours. Might need to stretch.

fields.EN:
I put so much hard work into growing my
party that I've fatigued myself.
fields.JP:
さっきまでせっせとレベル上げに
精を出してましたからね～。
真面目に働きすぎたかもしれません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I put so much hard work into growing my
party that I've fatigued myself.

fields.JP:
（これを働いたことにカウントして
　いいのかな……）

fields.EN:
Jack-san, instead of playing that game, could
you be a dear and massage my back?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん～、レベル上げはもういいので、
ちょっと腰を揉んでくれますか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, instead of playing that game, could
you be a dear and massage my back?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Massage?! Um. I'm not so sure...
fields.JP:
えっ、腰！？
いや、それはさすがに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Massage?! Um. I'm not so sure...

fields.EN:
Oh my, are you blushing? You're my
boyfriend. You needn't worry.
fields.JP:
あらら～？　照れてるんですか～？
それくらい、彼氏なんですから
いいじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, are you blushing? You're my
boyfriend. You needn't worry.

fields.JP: （うぅ、完全にからかわれてる……）

fields.EN:
O-Okay. I'll massage you, but keep the
commentary to a minimum.
fields.JP:
わ、わかった。マッサージするけど、
下手だとかなんだとか、
文句は受け付けないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Okay. I'll massage you, but keep the
commentary to a minimum.

fields.JP: あいたっ！　力が強すぎです～！
わ、ごめん。……これならどうかな？
あっ、あっ、それ、いい感じです～

fields.EN:
Hmhmhm. That's the spot. You're not
half bad.
fields.JP:
んふふ～、らくちんらくちん～。
やればできるじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmhmhm. That's the spot. You're not
half bad.

fields.EN:
(Do I have a future as a massage therapist?
Seems like she's enjoying herself.)
fields.JP:
（もしかして僕にはマッサージ師の
　才能があったのか？　褒められると
　俄然やる気が出てくるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do I have a future as a massage therapist?
Seems like she's enjoying herself.)

fields.JP: よーし、気合い入れていくぞ！
どどど、どこ触ってるんですか～！？

fields.EN:
Why are you answering like that's normal?!
That's not what I'm asking! I never said you
could touch my butt, you know?!
fields.JP:
なにを普通に答えてるんですか～！
そういうことを聞いてるんじゃないです～。
おしりを触っていいなんて言ってませんよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing?! Above the belt,
mister.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
A warning would be nice if you're not
going to slide down there delicately!
fields.JP:
いきなりそんなところを触るなんて、
破廉恥です～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A warning would be nice if you're not
going to slide down there delicately!

fields.EN: Sorry, it was an accident. My hand slipped.
fields.JP:
ごめん、わざとじゃなかったんだ。
うっかり手が滑って……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, it was an accident. My hand slipped.

fields.EN:
No time for excuses. If Jack-san doesn't wish
to be delicate, then he must be punished.
fields.JP:
聞く耳持ちません～。
破廉恥なジャックさんには、
無慈悲な制裁を与えます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No time for excuses. If Jack doesn't wish
to be delicate, then he must be punished.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: I order you to massage my thighs and calves.
fields.JP:
太ももとふくらはぎのマッサージも
追加でやってもらいますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: I order you to massage my thighs and calves.

fields.EN:
(Wait, so thighs and calves are okay?
Where's the line...)
fields.JP:
（あ、おしりは駄目でもそこはいいんだ。
　線引きがよくわからない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, so thighs and calves are okay?
Where's the line...)

fields.EN:
While you do that, I plan to continue
grinding. I'm such a multi-tasker.
fields.JP:
その間に、わらわはまたレベル上げに
いそしみますので～。
わらわってば働き者ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
While you do that, I plan to continue
grinding. I'm such a multi-tasker.

fields.EN:
And Jack-san, the boyfriend's foremost duty
is to meet his partner's work ethic. So get
to it.
fields.JP:
さあ、ジャックさんもきりきり
働いてくださいね～。
彼氏として当然の義務ですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
And Jack, the boyfriend's foremost duty
is to meet his partner's work ethic. So get
to it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
I wouldn't call it a duty so much as an ordeal,
but here goes nothing...
fields.JP:
義務というか試練な気もするけど……。
とりあえず、がんばってみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't call it a duty so much as an ordeal,
but here goes nothing...

fields.EN:
Night time already? It's late. I should take
you home now, Kaguyahime.
fields.JP:
もう夜か……。いつの間にか
けっこう時間が経ってたね。
かぐや姫、家まで送っていくよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Night time already? It's late. I should take
you home now, Kaguya.

fields.EN:
What...? But I haven't even begun to relax.
Going home is a burden.
fields.JP:
え～、まだだらだらし足りません～。
帰るの面倒くさいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...? But I haven't even begun to relax.
Going home is a burden.

fields.EN:
No, I can't exactly do that. My whole family has
plans tonight, so they shouldn't be coming home...
fields.JP:
いや、そういうわけにもいかないでしょ。
うちの家族、今夜はみんな用事があって
帰らないはずだし……
fields.LOCALIZED: You have to. My family's not home tonight.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: Is that so? Even more reason for me to stay.
fields.JP:
そうなんですか～？　だったらなおさら、
もっとだらだらできるじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that so? Even more reason for me to stay.

fields.EN:
No, no, no. Think about it. That means
we'd be home together tonight, right?
fields.JP:
いやいやいや、よく考えて。
家に二人きりで夜を迎えるのは、
さすがに……ねぇ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, no, no. Think about it. That means
we'd be home together tonight, right?

fields.EN:
I mean, surely you know the possible
risks for a boy and a girl to...
fields.JP:
だ、だからですね、
男女二人でなにか間違いが起きては
いけないという意味です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, surely you know the possible
risks for a boy and a girl to...

fields.JP:
（って、なんで僕は敬語になってるんだ！？
　緊張しすぎだよ！）

fields.EN: A boy and a girl to, what...? Oh.
fields.LOCALIZED: A boy and a girl to, what...? Oh.

fields.EN:
Is that really where your head went?!
Jack-san, you animal!
fields.JP:
なな、なにをいやらしいこと
考えてるんですか～！？
ジャックさんのケダモノ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that really where your head went?!
Jack, you animal!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
No, you misunderstand! I'm trying to
prevent becoming an animal!
fields.JP:
ご、誤解だよ！
むしろケダモノにならないように
手を打とうとしたんだってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you misunderstand! I'm trying to
prevent becoming an animal!

fields.EN:
You're already an animal for imagining
such things. Ugh, typical men...
fields.JP:
いやらしいことを考えた時点で
ケダモノなんです～！
まったく、これだから殿方は～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're already an animal for imagining
such things. Ugh, typical men...

fields.EN:
Although, perhaps it's in your nature.
They say men can't go without seven
seconds without those thoughts.
fields.JP:
……まぁ、仕方ないですけど～。
殿方の八割は性欲で出来ていると
聞きますし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Although, perhaps it's in your nature.
They say men can't go without seven
seconds without those thoughts.

fields.EN: Wait, that seems extreme. Even for me.
fields.JP:
待って。
その情報はかなり偏ってると思うんだけど。
せめて五割くらいにしてほしい
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait, that seems extreme. Even for me.

fields.EN:
Hehe, no need to be embarrassed, Jack-san. Even
if you're a beast, my generous heart will accept
you~
fields.JP:
ふふ、照れなくていいんですよ～。
ジャックさんがケダモノでも、わらわの
広い心で受け入れてあげますから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. No need to be embarrassed.
I accept you for who you, animal or not.

fields.EN:
I wouldn't mind taking the next step with
you. What do you say?
fields.JP:
あなたとなら、つ、次の段階に進んでも
構わないと思っていなくもないんですよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't mind taking the next step with
you. What do you say?

fields.JP:
えっ？　あ、あの、それはつまり、
でもやっぱり……！

fields.EN:
In any case, I do not plan on returning home
tonight. It's much simpler to stay here.
fields.JP:
とにかく、わらわは帰るつもりは
ありません～。帰るよりここにいるほうが
楽ですからね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
In any case, I do not plan on returning home
tonight. It's much simpler to stay here.

fields.EN:
I'm not leaving this bed, and there's nothing
you can do about it.
fields.JP:
今日はこのベッドから出る
つもりはありませんから、
覚悟しておいてくださいね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not leaving this bed, and there's nothing
you can do about it.

fields.EN:
(Nearing the meeting time. I wonder if
she read the letter...)
fields.JP:
（もうすぐ約束の時間だけど、手紙、
　ちゃんと読んでもらえたかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nearing the meeting time. I wonder if
she read the letter...)

fields.JP: 来たわよ。約束の時間ちょうどね
す、すごい。本当にジャストで来た……

fields.EN:
Think nothing of it. I'm merely honoring
the time you noted.
fields.JP:
手紙でこの時間に呼び出されたのだから、
ちょうどの時間に来るのは当然のことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think nothing of it. I'm merely honoring
the time you noted.

fields.EN:
(She's in her swimsuit, per usual. Bet
she came straight from the pool thinking
our chat would be brief.)
fields.JP:
（しかもいつも通り水着姿だし……。
　きっとすぐに終わると思って、プールから
　この恰好で直行してきたんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's in her swimsuit, per usual. Bet
she came straight from the pool thinking
our chat would be brief.)

fields.EN: So what is it? Make it quick.
fields.JP:
それで、用というのは？
手短に済ましてくれるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: So what is it? Make it quick.

fields.EN:
(I'm nervous enough already! Calm down!
Keep it brief.)
fields.JP:
（ただでさえ緊張してたのに、急かされると
　すごい焦る！　落ち着け、僕。
　落ち着いて、かつ手短に……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm nervous enough already! Calm down!
Keep it brief.)

fields.EN:
You mean to say you've developed feelings
for me, correct? If I'm understanding you.
fields.JP:
あなたが私に好意を抱いている、
ということでしょう？　言われた内容は
正確に理解したと思うけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean to say you've developed feelings
for me, correct? If I'm understanding you.

fields.JP: じゃあ……うん。その返事は……

fields.EN: Do you want to go out with me?
fields.JP: つ、付き合ってくれるでしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you want to go out with me?

fields.EN: Go out? As in become steady?
fields.JP:
付き合う？
それは男女交際という意味かしら
fields.LOCALIZED: Go out? As in become steady?

fields.EN:
A couple. I didn't expect this. I see.
You and me...
fields.JP:
男女交際……。いささか予想外な話ね。
そう、あなたと私が男女の仲に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A couple. I didn't expect this. I see.
You and me...

fields.EN:
You don't have to put it that way!
We can take it slow, you know?
fields.JP:
その言い方だとちょっと語弊が
ある気がするんだけど！　ぼ、僕はちゃんと
段階を踏むつもりだからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to put it that way!
We can take it slow, you know?

fields.EN:
You want to take things slow, do you?
Are you lusting after me, Jack?
fields.JP:
つまり段階を踏んで男女の仲に
なりたいということね。
ジャック、あなたは私に欲情しているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want to take things slow, do you?
Are you lusting after me, Jack?

fields.JP:
よ、よくじょう……っ！？
ちちっ、違うから！！

fields.EN:
(A quirky response was expected, but
this is something else.)
fields.JP:
（相手がグレーテルだから斜め上の反応は
　ある程度予想してたけど、こう来たか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A quirky response was expected, but
this is something else.)

fields.EN:
I see. A resolute no. So why do you want
to date me?
fields.JP:
そう、欲情はしていないのね。
それならどうして付き合いたいなどと
言ったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. A resolute no. So why do you want
to date me?

fields.JP: それは、グレーテルが好きだからで……

fields.EN: (I can't hide my feelings. That'd be lying.)
fields.JP:
（……でも、ここで変に取り繕うのは
　よくないかもしれない。グレーテルに
　嘘をつくことになっちゃうよな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I can't hide my feelings. That'd be lying.)

fields.EN:
Sorry. That didn't come to mind right away,
but I do think you're very pretty.
fields.JP:
……ごめん。あまり自覚して
なかったんだけど、たしかに君の言う通り、
欲情してるのも事実だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. That didn't come to mind right away,
but I do think you're very pretty.

fields.EN:
I'd like for us to get to know each other
better because I like you. Maybe lust
comes hand in hand with that.
fields.JP:
好きだから一緒にいたいし、もっと君のことを
知りたいと思うし、そういう気持ちの中に
欲情も入ってるんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd like for us to get to know each other
better because I like you. Maybe lust
comes hand in hand with that.

fields.EN:
That said, I think I'm in love with you,
Gretel.
fields.JP:
だから、なんていうか……恋をしてるんだ。
グレーテルに
fields.LOCALIZED:
That said, I think I'm in love with you,
Gretel.

fields.EN:
Love... Right. Took you long enough, but
now I understand.
fields.JP:
恋……なるほど。さっきからあなたの言い方が
煮え切らないのは、そのせいだったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Love... Right. Took you long enough, but
now I understand.

fields.EN:
They say emotions are incompatible with
logic, especially when it comes to love.
fields.JP:
人間の感情は理屈で説明できないことが
多いけれど、特に恋心というのは複雑怪奇だと
聞いたことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They say emotions are incompatible with
logic, especially when it comes to love.

fields.EN:
So there is a chance I may be in love with
you too.
fields.JP:
それなら私も、あなたに恋をしている
のかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So there is a chance I may be in love with
you too.

fields.EN: (After all the back and forth, she drops this...)
fields.JP: （び、びっくりしすぎて変な声出た……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (After all the back and forth, she drops this...)

fields.EN:
I am equally intrigued by you and would
like to pursue this curiosity.
fields.JP:
私もあなたの人間性は好ましいと
思っているし、あなたのことを
もっと知りたいという気持ちもあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am equally intrigued by you and would
like to pursue this curiosity.

fields.JP:
他のどの人間よりも、あなたに
興味を抱いているのは事実よ

fields.EN: I have no reason to lie.
fields.JP: 私が嘘をつく理由なんてないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I have no reason to lie.

fields.EN:
If what you describe is love, then I must
feel the same.
fields.JP:
あなたの言う感情が恋だとすれば、
私もあなたに対して恋に似た感情を
抱いているということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If what you describe is love, then I must
feel the same.

fields.EN:
Which means that our love is mutual,
thus I see no issue with us going steady.
fields.JP:
ということは、私達は両想いということに
なるわ。特に問題もないことだし、
付き合っても構わないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means that our love is mutual,
thus I see no issue with us going steady.

fields.JP: い、いいの？　そんなあっさり……

fields.EN:
It was a quick deliberation. No sense wasting
time, right?
fields.JP:
私なりに熟考した結果よ。
無意味にもったいぶっても
時間がもったいないだけでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a quick deliberation. No sense wasting
time, right?

fields.JP: あ……、ありがとう！　嬉しいよ！

fields.EN:
(That wasn't the smoothest confession,
but mission accomplished? Yeah!)
fields.JP:
（なんかヘンテコな流れだけど、
　告白はうまくいったってことだよね？
　よかったー！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That wasn't the smoothest confession,
but mission accomplished? Yeah!)

fields.EN:
There is one matter I would like to discuss
before we solidify our arrangement.
fields.JP:
では、交際するにあたって
確認しておきたいことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is one matter I would like to discuss
before we solidify our arrangement.

fields.EN: What is it? I'm all ears!
fields.JP: なに？　なんでも聞いて！
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it? I'm all ears!

fields.EN: What is it you see in me?
fields.JP: あなたはなぜ私に好意を抱いたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it you see in me?

fields.EN:
You sure don't mince words. That could
be part of it.
fields.JP:
いきなりズバッと核心を突いてくるなぁ。
でも、そういうところも好きになった理由かも
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure don't mince words. That could
be part of it.

fields.EN:
You always seem to know how to ask the
right questions because you love to learn.
I appreciate that kind of sincerity.
fields.JP:
グレーテルは疑問に思ったことはなんでも
口に出すよね。それって、自分にも他人にも
まっすぐ向き合おうとしている証拠だと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always seem to know how to ask the
right questions because you love to learn.
I appreciate that kind of sincerity.

fields.EN:
Some people might think you're cold or
impersonal, but not me.
fields.JP:
君のそういうところを、空気が読めないとか、
冷たい性格だとか思う人もいるみたいだけど、
僕はそうは思わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some people might think you're cold or
impersonal, but not me.

fields.EN: I think it's because you're truly kind that you always try to face things seriously. That's what drew me to you.
fields.JP:
本当は優しいからこそ、君はいつでも真剣に
向き合おうとしているだけなんだと思う。
僕は君のそういうところに惹かれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've seen how kind you are first-hand.
That's what I mean by sincerity. That's
what I see in you.

fields.EN:
Kind...? I believe you are the first person
to tell me so. Perhaps you have a loose
screw somewhere.
fields.JP:
優しい……？
そんなことを言われるのは初めてだわ。
あなたは変わった考え方をするのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kind...? I believe you are the first person
to tell me so. Perhaps you have a loose
screw somewhere.

fields.EN:
Let's not compare who's got the looser
screws...
fields.JP:
まぁ、グレーテルほどは変わってないかも
しれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's not compare who's got the looser
screws...

fields.EN:
The sincerity of my supposed kindness
aside, I find your train of thought interesting,
And I don't mind being called kind.
fields.JP:
本当に私が優しいかはともかく、
あなたの考え方は非常に興味深いわ。
それに、優しいと言われて悪い気はしない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sincerity of my supposed kindness
aside, I find your train of thought interesting,
And I don't mind being called kind.

fields.EN:
Thank you, Jack. I have a feeling that I have
much to learn about myself if we pursue this.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジャック。
あなたと交際したら、私も新たな発見が
できるかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Jack. I have a feeling that I have
much to learn about myself if we pursue this.

fields.JP: う、うん！　そうなるといいね！

fields.EN:
(Her smile...is gorgeous! I think my heart
skipped a beat.)
fields.JP:
（今の笑顔、やばい……！
　普段あんまり笑わないのに、急にこんな
　笑顔見せられるとすごいドキドキする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her smile...is gorgeous! I think my heart
skipped a beat.)

fields.EN: (Maybe she had me pegged all along...)
fields.JP:
（ハートを撃ち抜かれるって、
　こういうことなのかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe she had me pegged all along...)

fields.EN:
(I used to think a poolside date with
Gretel would be a ton of fun...)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルとプールデートしたら
　楽しいに違いない！　……と）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I used to think a poolside date with
Gretel would be a ton of fun...)

fields.EN:
(But it's not exactly panning out like I
thought it would.)
fields.JP:
（そんな夢を抱いていたときが、
　僕にもありました……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But it's not exactly panning out like I
thought it would.)

fields.EN:
Phew. The water is the perfect temperature.
You should join.
fields.JP:
ふぅ。
やはりプールで泳ぐのは気分がいいわ。
あなたも遠慮せずにもっと泳いだら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. The water is the perfect temperature.
You should join.

fields.EN:
Hahah. I'm fine. I'm enjoying watching you
go at it.
fields.JP:
あはは、僕は大丈夫。
君が泳ぐのを見てるだけで、
もうお腹いっぱいだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahah. I'm fine. I'm enjoying watching you
go at it.

fields.EN:
(Swimming together sounded fun at first,
but I can't keep up with her speed and
athleticism.)
fields.JP:
（最初は一緒に楽しく泳いでたけど、
　すぐにグレーテルの泳ぐ速さにも持久力にも
　ついていけなくなって）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Swimming together sounded fun at first,
but I can't keep up with her speed and
athleticism.)

fields.EN:
(I'm out of shape. I became winded and was
back resting by the poolside in no time.)
fields.JP:
（僕だけ早々にプールサイドで
　へばっているなんて、
　悔しいやら情けないやら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm out of shape. I became winded and was
back resting by the poolside in no time.)

fields.EN: Don't mind me. Swim as much as you want.
fields.JP:
僕のことは気にせず、グレーテルは
思う存分泳いできたらいいよ。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't mind me. Swim as much as you want.

fields.EN: You sure? If you insist, I will.
fields.JP: そう……？　なら、そうするわ
fields.LOCALIZED: You sure? If you insist, I will.

fields.EN: You sure love to swim, huh? Kinda surprising.
fields.JP:
それにしても、本当に泳ぐのが
好きなんだね。ちょっと意外だったな
fields.LOCALIZED: You sure love to swim, huh? Kinda surprising.

fields.JP: 意外？　それはどういうこと？

fields.EN:
You like science, so I figured you'd join
a like-minded club.
fields.JP:
グレーテルは理系のことが好きみたいだから、
科学部とかに入りそうなものなのになー
って思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You like science, so I figured you'd join
a like-minded club.

fields.EN:
They offer all sorts of extracurriculars
here. What made you join the swim team?
fields.JP:
部活は他にもたくさんあるのに、
どうしてその中で水泳部を選んだの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They offer all sorts of extracurriculars
here. What made you join the swim team?

fields.EN:
That they do. That's a valid question, since
the sciences are my main fields of expertise.
fields.JP:
なるほど。あなたの疑問はもっともね。
たしかに私は理系の分野に多くの興味を
抱いているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That they do. That's a valid question, since
the sciences are my main fields of expertise.

fields.EN:
But I have, in fact, been a member of the
science club before.
fields.JP:
実際、以前は科学部にも所属していた
ことがあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I have, in fact, been a member of the
science club before.

fields.EN:
But I found the club's needless rules and
regulations to be stifling to my research,
so I quit.
fields.JP:
だけど部活では様々な縛りがあって
思うような活動ができなかったから、
辞めたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I found the club's needless rules and
regulations to be stifling to my research,
so I quit.

fields.EN:
I considered other clubs centered on my
interests, like the literature and exercise
clubs.
fields.JP:
他にも文化部系、運動部系問わず、
興味がある部活にはひと通り所属してきたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I considered other clubs centered on my
interests, like the literature and exercise
clubs.

fields.EN:
However, it never took long before I mastered
their disciplines before losing interest.
fields.JP:
ただ、なにをしてもすぐに上達してしまうから、
興味がなくなってじきに辞めてしまうんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, it never took long before I mastered
their disciplines before losing interest.

fields.EN:
You're practically a savant. Why are you
sticking with swimming?
fields.JP:
道場破りみたい……じゃなくて、
まさに文武両道って感じだね。
それなら水泳部はどうして続いてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're practically a savant. Why are you
sticking with swimming?

fields.EN:
I realized that what I need was a place
where I could find solitude.
fields.JP:
私に必要なのは、
「一人で静かに考えられる場所」
だと気づいたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I realized that what I need was a place
where I could find solitude.

fields.JP:
水の中は考え事をするのにちょうどいい
環境だったわ。物理に文学に芸術、
それにお菓子のこと。考える内容は尽きないわ

fields.EN:
Ultimately I realized I wanted something
more than what those clubs offered me.
fields.JP:
大切なのは、どの部に属するかでは
なかったということね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ultimately I realized I wanted something
more than what those clubs offered me.

fields.EN:
You don't say... If I'm being frank, it sounds
like you're a genius.
fields.JP:
考えられる場所か……。
よくわからないけど、きっと君みたいな人を
天才っていうんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't say... If I'm being frank, it sounds
like you're a genius.

fields.EN:
Who's to say? If not a genius, then most
definitely a girl in love.
fields.JP:
どうかしらね。今は天才ではなく、
ただの恋する乙女かもしれないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who's to say? If not a genius, then most
definitely a girl in love.

fields.EN:
Recently I've been visited by thoughts of
you during my morning swim. Before then,
all I did were mental calculations.
fields.JP:
近頃は、泳ぎながらあなたのことばかり
考えてしまうわ。前はもっと実のある
計算に集中できたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Recently I've been visited by thoughts of
you during my morning swim. Before then,
all I did were mental calculations.

fields.EN:
But thinking of you while I swim gives me
serenity. Though I cannot explain why.
fields.JP:
だけどあなたのことを考えながら泳ぐのは、
なかなか気持ちのいい時間だわ。
なぜなのかはわからないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But thinking of you while I swim gives me
serenity. Though I cannot explain why.

fields.EN: I-I want to think that means Gretel likes me... What do you think?
fields.JP:
た、たぶんそれは、グレーテルが
僕のことを好きでいてくれてるってこと
だと思いたいんだけど……どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope that means you actually like me...

fields.EN:
(Might be embarrasing for me to say,
but she may not realize it if I don't ask.)
fields.JP:
（自分で言うのは恥ずかしいけど……。
　でも言わないと、グレーテルのことだから
　自覚してくれないかもしれないしなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Might be embarrasing for me to say,
but she may not realize it if I don't ask.)

fields.EN:
...Indeed. That could be the case.
I love you, Jack.
fields.JP:
……そうね。
たしかにその通りかもしれない。
私はあなたが好きだわ、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Indeed. That could be the case.
I love you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Ah. Is that blush I detect? All that from the
person who pointed it out. Hmhmhm.
fields.JP:
あら、自分で指摘しておいて
照れるなんて、変な人ね。ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Is that blush I detect? All that from the
person who pointed it out. Hmhmhm.

fields.EN: Okay. Time for us to go.
fields.JP: さて、そろそろ帰りましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. Time for us to go.

fields.EN:
G-Gretel?! You're still in a swimsuit!
You can't walk around in that!
fields.JP:
グ、グレーテル！？
スクール水着のままだけど！？
外でそれはさすがにまずいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
G-Gretel?! You're still in a swimsuit!
You can't walk around in that!

fields.EN: I fail to see the issue.
fields.JP: こうすれば問題ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I fail to see the issue.

fields.JP: うわっ！　……って、ここは僕の部屋？

ワープしたの。
こうすれば帰るのも楽でしょう

fields.EN:
But you're still in your swimsuit. I don't
mind, but aren't you uncomfortable?
fields.JP:
で、でも水着のままなのは
変わらないじゃないか。
僕は構わないけど、君が困るだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you're still in your swimsuit. I don't
mind, but aren't you uncomfortable?

fields.EN:
No, it does not. Because I intend for us to
take things to the next level.
fields.JP:
困らないわよ？
私達はこれから、性行為をするのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it does not. Because I intend for us to
take things to the next level.

fields.EN:
Why so surprised? I've read countless books
on the topic. The one consistency is that all
romantic love must be consummated.
fields.JP:
あら、そんなに驚くこと？
文献で調べたけど、恋人同士は性行為を
通して絆や人間関係を深めるそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why so surprised? I've read countless books
on the topic. The one consistency is that all
romantic love must be consummated.

fields.EN:
We are a couple, so this shouldn't be too
shocking, no?
fields.JP:
私達は恋人同士なのだから、
性行為をすることになんの問題も
ないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We are a couple, so this shouldn't be too
shocking, no?

fields.EN:
But that's not all we can do to deepen
our bond! You're skipping a bunch of steps!
fields.JP:
だっ、だけど、絆を深める方法は
それだけじゃないよ！
グレーテルは順序を飛ばしすぎ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's not all we can do to deepen
our bond! You're skipping a bunch of steps!

fields.EN: Steps? What are these steps you speak of?
fields.JP:
順序？　具体的にどのような順序が
必要だというの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Steps? What are these steps you speak of?

fields.JP: それはまぁ、手を繋ぐとか……

fields.EN: Skin on skin contact, you mean?
fields.JP: 皮膚による接触ということね
fields.LOCALIZED: Skin on skin contact, you mean?

fields.EN:
Ah, you mean connecting our mucous
membranes. Splendid suggestion.
fields.JP:
粘膜同士の接触ということね。
では、さっそく実践してみましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, you mean connecting our mucous
membranes. Splendid suggestion.

fields.JP:
ぷはっ！
ちょ、ちょっと待って！　今……っ

fields.EN:
Yes. I held your hands and went in for
the kiss.
fields.JP: ええ。手を握って、キスをしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I held your hands and went in for
the kiss.

fields.EN:
I feel our bond deepening like you said
it would. So this is how a relationship feels.
fields.JP:
たしかに今の接触で、あなたをより近くに
感じることができた気がするわ。
これが絆が深まるということかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel our bond deepening like you said
it would. So this is how a relationship feels.

fields.EN:
My heart is racing at a higher speed than
normal, I can feel it against my chest.
fields.JP:
……いつもより鼓動が早くて、
心が満たされている感じね
fields.LOCALIZED:
My heart is racing at a higher speed than
normal, I can feel it against my chest.

fields.JP: こんなあっさりキスしちゃった……

fields.EN:
Does this mean we've concluded all our
steps?
fields.JP:
さあ、性行為をするためには、
次はなにをすればいいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does this mean we've concluded all our
steps?

fields.JP: そ、そんなの知らないよっ！！

fields.EN: Right. Then perhaps we require more research.
fields.JP: そう。それなら調べてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Then perhaps we require more research.

fields.EN:
That's not what I mean! What I mean is
the mood's not right!
fields.JP:
いや、そういう意味じゃなくて！
こ、こんなのじゃムードもへったくれも
ないじゃないか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not what I mean! What I mean is
the mood's not right!

fields.EN:
It might better for us to wait until the
right moment.
fields.JP:
やっぱりこういうのは、
そういう雰囲気になって、その……
するべきだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It might better for us to wait until the
right moment.

fields.EN:
(What am I saying? Isn't it usually the girl
who says stuff like that?)
fields.JP:
（なんで僕がこんなこと言ってるんだろう。
　普通、ムードとかを気にするのは
　女の子のほうじゃないのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What am I saying? Isn't it usually the girl
who says stuff like that?)

fields.EN:
That was quite the non-answer, but I suppose
love works in mysterious ways.
fields.JP:
そういう雰囲気、という表現は曖昧ね。
でも仕方ないわ。恋というものに
曖昧さは付き物のようだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was quite the non-answer, but I suppose
love works in mysterious ways.

fields.JP: ホッ。わかってくれたんだね

fields.EN:
Well, then why don't we test the waters
tonight to see if the mood strikes us?
fields.JP:
そういうわけだから。
ひと晩一緒に過ごして、「そういう雰囲気」
とやらになるかどうか実験してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, then why don't we test the waters
tonight to see if the mood strikes us?

fields.JP: なにがそういうわけだからなの！？

fields.EN:
Think of it as an experiment which can only
be conducted by you and me. Hehehe.
What a tantalizing thought.
fields.JP:
あなたと私にしかできない実験よ。
ふふふ、考えただけでも興奮してくるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think of it as an experiment which can only
be conducted by you and me. Hehehe.
What a tantalizing thought.

fields.EN: I'm looking forward to tonight, Jack.
fields.JP: 今夜はよろしくね。……ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm looking forward to tonight, Jack.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
シンデレラ？
……姿が見えないんだけど

fields.EN: I am afraid of someone seeing me.
fields.JP:
誰かに見つかるかもしれないと
思うと、恐ろしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED: I am afraid of someone seeing me.

fields.EN:
No one else is here but us. Don't worry.
Please come out.
fields.JP:
ここには僕達の他に誰もいないよ。
大丈夫だから、隠れてないで出て来て
fields.LOCALIZED:
No one else is here but us. Don't worry.
Please come out.

fields.EN:
Um. I read your letter. You mentioned
having something important to say.
fields.JP:
あの……、大切な話があるという
お手紙をいただいたのですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. I read your letter. You mentioned
having something important to say.

fields.EN: Right. Thanks for coming to meet me.
fields.JP: うん、来てくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Thanks for coming to meet me.

fields.EN: What is it you wish to discuss?
fields.JP: それで、お話というのは……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it you wish to discuss?

fields.EN:
...I've made up my mind. No more holding
back.
fields.JP:
……僕は覚悟を決めたんだ。
もうこれ以上、曖昧な態度をとるのは
やめようと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I've made up my mind. No more holding
back.

fields.JP: シンデレラ、僕は君が好きだ！

fields.EN:
Oh, that makes me so happy! I like you too,
Jack-san.
fields.JP:
まぁ、嬉しいですわ！
わたくしもジャックさんが好きですわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow! This brings me so much joy!
I feel the same way.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness. This went a lot smoother
than I thought it would.)
fields.JP:
（よかったー！　緊張してたけど、
　告白がこんなにすんなりいくなんて
　思わなかったなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness. This went a lot smoother
than I thought it would.)

fields.EN: Will you go out with me then?
fields.JP: じゃあ、付き合ってもらえるかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Will you go out with me then?

fields.EN: No, no, no! This cannot be happening!
fields.JP:
って、いえいえいえ！
こんなうまい話があるわけありませんわー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No, no, no! This cannot be happening!

fields.EN:
That such fortune would befall me.
It's like the sun rising from the west.
This must be a trap!
fields.JP:
わたくしにこんな幸運が転がり込むなんて、
太陽が西から昇ってもありえませんわ！
なにかの罠に決まってますわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That such fortune would befall me.
It's like the sun rising from the west.
This must be a trap!

fields.EN:
Oh, I know. Are you trying to deceive me
into signing a contract?!
fields.JP:
はっ、わかりましたわ。
わたくしを油断させたところで契約書に
サインさせるという作戦ですわね……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I know. Are you trying to deceive me
into signing a contract?!

fields.EN:
You're just trying to sell me an expensive
duvet! Or is it a pot! Maybe a painting?!
fields.JP:
きっとわたくしは高級羽毛布団を
買わされてしまうのですわ！
もしくは開運の壺！？　掛け軸！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're just trying to sell me an expensive
duvet! Or is it a pot! Maybe a painting?!

fields.EN: Let's bring it down, shall we?
fields.JP: ちょ、ちょっと落ち着こう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's bring it down, shall we?

fields.EN:
And I'm in no position to make payments,
which means I may become destitute...
Aaaaah!
fields.JP:
そして法外な代金を支払えなかった
わたくしは、いけないお店に連れて行かれて、
ついには……あああっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I'm in no position to make payments,
which means I may become destitute...
Aaaaah!

fields.EN:
(Cinderella has one heck of an imagination,
but she always seems to think of the worst.
I know it can't be helped, but still...)
fields.JP:
（ネガティブな方向にすごい想像力だな。
　彼女の性格を考えれば仕方ないけど、
　さすがに悲しくなってくる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella has one heck of an imagination,
but she always seems to think of the worst.
I know it can't be helped, but still...)

fields.EN:
You're heading straight for the worst case-
scenario. Do you think I'd really do that to
you?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、君が心配するようなことは
ないから。僕がそんなことする人間に見える？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're heading straight for the worst case-
scenario. Do you think I'd really do that to
you?

fields.EN: N-No, I don't think you would...
fields.LOCALIZED: N-No, I don't think you would...

fields.EN:
...I'm sorry. I just couldn't believe it, and I
said something rude to you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
……すみませんでした。
あまりにも信じられなくて、ジャックさんに
失礼なことを言ってしまいましたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I'm sorry. I just couldn't believe it.
My response was awful.

fields.EN:
You are far too kind to someone who
doesn't attend this school. I'm returning
your favor in the worst way possible.
fields.JP:
こんなみすぼらしい不法侵入者のわたくしにも、
いつも優しく接してくださったのに……。
恩を仇で返してしまいましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are far too kind to someone who
doesn't attend this school. I'm returning
your favor in the worst way possible.

fields.EN: That's fine. As long as you heard me.
fields.JP:
ううん。
誤解が解けたなら、それでいいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's fine. As long as you heard me.

fields.EN:
But I still can't understand it... that you,
Jack-san, would confess your feelings to someone
like me...
fields.JP:
ですが、やはり納得できませんわ……。
ジャックさんがわたくしなんかに
告白してくださるなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I still don't understand...why you
would confess your love for me.

fields.EN: I am so pitiful, so negative. I'm not worthy.
fields.JP:
みずぼらしくてネガティブなこんな人間が、
誰かに好いてもらえるわけがありませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I am so pitiful, so negative. I'm not worthy.

fields.EN:
None of that stuff is true at all. Besides,
I don't mind your negativity.
fields.JP:
シンデレラはみすぼらしくなんかないし、
ネガティブなところだって嫌いじゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of that stuff is true at all. Besides,
I don't mind your negativity.

fields.EN:
Just to make things clear, I didn't ask you
to meet me out of the kindness of my heart.
fields.JP:
言っておくけど、僕は同情なんかで
君に会いに行っていたわけじゃないからね。
好きだから会いに行っていただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just to make things clear, I didn't ask you
to meet me out of the kindness of my heart.

fields.EN:
You always try your best even when the
going gets tough. That's something I admire.
fields.JP:
シンデレラは大変な境遇にいても
いつも健気にがんばっていて、
見ているだけで勇気づけられるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always try your best even when the
going gets tough. That's something I admire.

fields.EN: You're like a flower blooming in the desert.
fields.JP:
ベタかもしれないけど、
野に咲く可憐な花みたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED: You're like a flower blooming in the desert.

fields.EN:
That's the first time anyone's ever called
me a flower.
fields.JP:
……花に例えてもらうなんて、
初めてですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the first time anyone's ever called
me a flower.

fields.EN: Me too. It's making me blush.
fields.JP:
僕も、女の子を花に例えるなんて初めてだよ。
けっこう照れるな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Me too. It's making me blush.

fields.EN:
Because I'm positively elated. I never thought
something this good would ever happen.
fields.JP:
だって、嬉しすぎて……。こんな幸せが
わたくしに訪れるわけなんてないのに、
……うぅっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because I'm positively elated. I never thought
something this good would ever happen.

fields.EN:
I must be dreaming. I bet I'm sleeping atop
a mountain of ashes as we speak!
fields.JP:
きっと夢なんですわ。
本当のわたくしは、灰の山の中で
眠っているに決まってますわあぁ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must be dreaming. I bet I'm sleeping atop
a mountain of ashes as we speak!

fields.EN:
Hey, stop pinching yourself! Stop!
You'll hurt yourself!
fields.JP:
ちょっ、そんなに強くほっぺを
つねるなんて！　やめなよ！
顔の輪郭変わっちゃってるよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, stop pinching yourself! Stop!
You'll hurt yourself!

fields.EN: It hurrrts! Thiiiiis isn't a dream?!
fields.JP:
ひ、ひたひでふは～！
ほれはゆへへははいんへふはへ～！？
fields.LOCALIZED: It hurrrts! Thiiiiis isn't a dream?!

fields.EN:
Phew.  That was dreadful. So it's not a dream.
So why me...?
fields.JP:
はー、痛かったですわ。
やっぱり夢ではないんですのね……。
でも、どうしてわたくしなんかが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew.  That was dreadful. So it's not a dream.
So why me...?

fields.EN:
(I can tell she's not used to being treated
well. Then it's my job to change that.)
fields.JP:
（本当に幸せに慣れてないんだな。
　彼女にはもっと幸せになってほしい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can tell she's not used to being treated
well. Then it's my job to change that.)

fields.EN:
Cinderella, I'll say it as many times as you
need to hear it. I'd love nothing more than
to take you on a date.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、もう一度言うよ。
僕と付き合ってほしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, I'll say it as many times as you
need to hear it. I'd love nothing more than
to take you on a date.

fields.EN:
And if things go great, then maybe you and
I could become a couple. What do you say?
fields.JP:
これから僕と一緒に、幸せな時を過ごして
くれると嬉しい。……駄目かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if things go great, then maybe you and
I could become a couple. What do you say?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Hehe. The only man who is kind as he is
strange.
fields.JP:
……ふふっ。
本当に物好きで、それ以上に、
本当に優しい方ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. The only man who is kind as he is
strange.

fields.EN: If that's what you're into, then count me in!
fields.JP: わたくしでよければ、よろこんで……！
fields.LOCALIZED: If that's what you're into, then count me in!

fields.EN:
(Cinderella and I are finally on our first
date.)
fields.JP:
（今日はシンデレラとデートに
　行くことになった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella and I are finally on our first
date.)

fields.EN:
(But right now all we're doing is walking
around campus. I'd rather find somewhere
both of us would enjoy.
fields.JP:
（とは言っても、学校の近くを二人で
　散歩するだけ。もっと楽しいところに
　連れて行ってあげたいんだけどなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But right now all we're doing is walking
around campus. I'd rather find somewhere
both of us would enjoy.

fields.EN:
You seem chipper. Are you having a good
time?
fields.JP:
シンデレラが楽しそうでよかった。
でもせっかくのデートなのに、
散歩するだけで本当によかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem chipper. Are you having a good
time?

fields.EN: Of course. It's what I asked for.
fields.JP:
ええ。だってわたくしが
リクエストしたことですもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. It's what I asked for.

fields.EN:
You were trying to be considerate of me,
Jack-san, offering presents and treating me to
a meal, weren't you?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんはわたくしに気を遣って、
プレゼントや、食事をご馳走して
くれようとしましたわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a twinkle in your eye that tells me
you wanted to spoil me and take me to a fancy
restaurant.

fields.JP: だけど、それでは対等ではありませんもの

fields.EN:
Well, I'm your boyfriend, so I don't think
that would've been an issue.
fields.JP:
か、彼氏なんだから、それくらい
甘えてくれてもいいと思うけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm your boyfriend, so I don't think
that would've been an issue.

fields.EN:
I appreciate it, but this really is what I want.
I'm glad you could oblige me.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
でも、これはわたくしのけじめですから。
もう少し見守っていてくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate it, but this really is what I want.
I'm glad you could oblige me.

fields.EN:
Besides, you've done plenty without even
spending money.
fields.JP:
それにお金のかからないところでは、
十分に甘えさせてもらってますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, you've done plenty without even
spending money.

fields.EN:
Don't you realize? You've been a wonderful
escort.
fields.JP:
あら、無自覚ですのね。
さっきからさり気なく、車道側を歩いて
くださってるじゃありませんか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you realize? You've been a wonderful
escort.

fields.EN:
You even walk at the perfect pace.
The ideal gentleman taking care of his lady.
fields.JP:
歩調も合わせてくださってますし。
レディとして扱っていただけて、
とっても嬉しいですわ。紳士ですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You even walk at the perfect pace.
The ideal gentleman taking care of his lady.

fields.EN: I-I'm no gentleman, but happy you approve.
fields.JP:
し、紳士だなんて。
でも、シンデレラが喜んでくれたなら……
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I'm no gentleman, but happy you approve.

fields.EN:
I've realized something lately. Just being with
you makes the whole world look brighter,
Jack-san.
fields.JP:
わたくし、最近気がつきましたの。
ジャックさんと一緒にいるだけで、
世界が輝いて見えますのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's only been a short amount of time, but
the world seems so much brighter with you
at my side.

fields.EN:
All thanks to you, the haze has given way to
a bright light.
fields.JP:
あなたのおかげで、これまでは
灰色だった景色が、キラキラした
素晴らしいものに変わりましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All thanks to you, the haze has given way to
a bright light.

fields.JP:
まるでジャックさんは、
わたくしの魔法使いですわね

fields.EN:
(My cheeks are burning up. Guess I really
am special to her.)
fields.JP:
（ちょっと照れるな。
　でも、それくらい僕がシンデレラの
　特別な存在になれたってことだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My cheeks are burning up. Guess I really
am special to her.)

fields.JP: あ……いえ、なんでもありませんわ

fields.EN:
(She says it's nothing, but I see her looking
in that direction over and over. Oh, there's
a couple holding hands.)
fields.JP:
（なんでもないと言いつつ、ちらちら
　遠くを見てるけど。……ああ、仲良さそうな
　カップルがいるな。手を繋いでる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She says it's nothing, but I see her looking
in that direction over and over. Oh, there's
a couple holding hands.)

fields.EN: (Maybe we could give that a try.)
fields.JP:
（僕達もあれくらい大胆に手を繋げる
　ようになれれば……ん？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe we could give that a try.)

fields.EN: Cinderella, would you like to hold hands?
fields.JP: シンデレラ、ひょっとして手を繋ぎたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Cinderella, would you like to hold hands?

fields.EN:
Of course I do. It may seem childish, but
I would love nothing more than to walk
hand-in-hand.
fields.JP:
……おっしゃる通りですわ。
はしたないと思われるかもしれませんけど、
手を繋いで歩けたら、と……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I do. It may seem childish, but
I would love nothing more than to walk
hand-in-hand.

fields.EN: What a coincidence. I was thinking the same.
fields.JP:
奇遇だね。僕も、ちょっと
うらやましいなって思ってたから
fields.LOCALIZED: What a coincidence. I was thinking the same.

fields.EN:
(Whoa, crossing arms instead of holding
hands! ...but man, I'm so happy.)
fields.JP:
（わっ、大胆！　手を繋ぐを飛び越して
　腕組んじゃった！　……でも、嬉しい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa, crossing arms instead of holding
hands! ...but man, I'm so happy.)

fields.EN:
It's amazing. Being this close, I can feel your
warmth, Jack-san... and it makes my heart race.
fields.JP:
すごいですわ。こうしていると、
ジャックさんの体温を近くに感じて……
ドキドキしますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's amazing. The warmth trickling from
your hand makes my heart pound.

fields.JP: ぼ、僕も、けっこうドキドキしてる

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Cinderella smile so much.
That's a successful first date in my book.
Everything went according to plan.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラ、すごく嬉しそうだな。
　初めてのデートで緊張したけど、
　うまくいったみたいでよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Cinderella smile so much.
That's a successful first date in my book.
Everything went according to plan.)

fields.EN:
Thanks for today, Cinderella. I had a great
time.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、今日はありがとう。
すごく楽しかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for today, Cinderella. I had a great
time.

fields.EN: As did I. You made for the perfect escort.
fields.JP:
わたくしもですわ。
エスコートしていただけて、
とても嬉しかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: As did I. You made for the perfect escort.

fields.EN:
I didn't do much, but if you felt safe,
that's all that matters.
fields.JP:
エスコートなんて立派なものじゃ
なかったけどね。でも君に満足して
もらえたなら、なによりだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't do much, but if you felt safe,
that's all that matters.

fields.EN: Why don't we head home? I'll walk you.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、今日はもう帰ろうか。
家まで送っていくよ、シンデレラ
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we head home? I'll walk you.

fields.EN:
Yeah. It's dark out. I can't let you walk
by yourself.
fields.JP:
うん。もう暗くなっちゃったし、
女の子を一人で帰すわけにはいかないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. It's dark out. I can't let you walk
by yourself.

fields.EN:
I-It's okay! With my speed, I can outrun
any danger.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫ですわ！
わたくしの俊足をもってすれば、
どんな危険も振り切れますから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-It's okay! With my speed, I can outrun
any danger.

fields.EN:
Besides, no one would try to attack a pitiful
girl like me!
fields.JP:
そもそもわたくしのような
みすぼらしい娘なんか、不審者だって
見向きもしないに決まってますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, no one would try to attack a pitiful
girl like me!

fields.EN:
Cinderella, it makes me sad when you put
yourself down like that.
fields.JP:
みすぼらしいなんて……。
シンデレラが自分のことをそこまで
卑下すると、僕まで悲しくなっちゃうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, it makes me sad when you put
yourself down like that.

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry. The doom and gloom is something
of a bad habit of mine.
fields.JP:
あ……申し訳ありません。
つい、いつものくせでネガティブに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry. The doom and gloom is something
of a bad habit of mine.

fields.EN:
I don't really mind. You're more cautious
than anything, but you don't have to beat 
yourself up all the time.
fields.JP:
君のネガティブなところは嫌いじゃないよ。
きっとすごく慎重な証拠だよね。だけど
あんまり自分を悪く言う必要はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really mind. You're more cautious
than anything, but you don't have to beat 
yourself up all the time.

fields.EN: Sure, but walking me home is a hassle...
fields.JP:
はい……。ですがやはり、
送っていただくのは……困りますわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but walking me home is a hassle...

fields.EN:
(Since when is walking a hassle? I wonder
if she's worried or something.)
fields.JP:
（困る？　……こんなに頑なに拒むなんて、
　なにか言いづらいことでもあるのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Since when is walking a hassle? I wonder
if she's worried or something.)

fields.EN:
Cinderella, is there something you're not
telling me?
fields.JP:
……ねぇ、シンデレラ。
君、隠しごとしてない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, is there something you're not
telling me?

fields.EN:
You don't have to tell me if you don't
want to, but I think it's best if we start
our relationship with honesty.
fields.JP:
どうしても言いたくないことなら
