言わなくていいけど、できれば僕は
シンデレラのことをもっと知りたいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to tell me if you don't
want to, but I think it's best if we start
our relationship with honesty.

fields.EN:
If there's anything I can help with, then
tell me. Or is that I can't help you?
fields.JP:
もしもなにか困っているなら、
もっと僕を頼ってほしい。
それとも、僕じゃ君の力にはなれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there's anything I can help with, then
tell me. Or is that I can't help you?

fields.EN:
....Forgive me. I was unsure how to bring it
up. But you're right. Honesty is best.
fields.JP:
……いいえ。すみません、
どうしても言い出しづらくて……。
でも、たしかに隠し事はよくありませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
....Forgive me. I was unsure how to bring it
up. But you're right. Honesty is best.

fields.JP:
実は、わたくしの家はなくなって
しまいましたの……

fields.EN: What?! Where do you live then?
fields.JP: えっ！？　じゃあ、今はどこに住んでるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! Where do you live then?

fields.EN:
In the unused storage building at the school.
It shelters me from the elements.
fields.JP:
学校の倉庫に……。雨風をしのげるので、
なんとかなっていますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the unused storage building at the school.
It shelters me from the elements.

fields.EN:
Oh no, that must be so awful. Why didn't
you tell me sooner?
fields.JP:
そんな……それでもすごく大変なはず
じゃないか。どうして言ってくれなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no, that must be so awful. Why didn't
you tell me sooner?

fields.JP: だって、恥ずかしいんですもの……

fields.EN:
Not only am I poor, but now I'm homeless too.
I was afraid you might leave me, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
貧乏なだけでなく、今やわたくしは
家なき子ですわ。さすがにジャックさんに
振られてしまうかもと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only am I poor, but now I'm homeless.
I was afraid you wouldn't like me anymore.

fields.EN: I could never stop liking you for that..!
fields.JP:
僕がそんなことでシンデレラを
嫌うわけないじゃないか……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I could never stop liking you for that..!

fields.EN:
(This is serious. I had no idea Cinderella had
been driven that far...)
fields.JP:
（だけどこれは一大事だ。シンデレラが
　そこまで追い詰められた状況だったなんて、
　全然知らなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (This is a big deal. I had no idea...)
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
(If I left her now, then I wouldn't deserve
to be her boyfriend!)
fields.JP:
（これを放っておいたら、彼女の恋人を
　名乗る資格なんかない！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I left her now, then I wouldn't deserve
to be her boyfriend!)

fields.JP: ……シンデレラ。ひとつ提案があるんだ

fields.EN: Why don't you come over to mine?
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you come over to mine?

fields.EN:
Not in a weird way. I just can't let you stay
here.
fields.JP:
えっと、別に変な意味じゃないんだ。
でもシンデレラが困っているのを
放っておくことなんてできない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not in a weird way. I just can't let you stay
here.

fields.EN:
They have extra rooms, and my family
won't mind. They're welcoming, so make
yourself comfortable.
fields.JP:
家には余ってる部屋もあるし、家族も細かい
ことを気にしない性質……というか寛容だから、
君一人くらい住人が増えても問題ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They have extra rooms, and my family
won't mind. They're welcoming, so make
yourself comfortable.

fields.EN: As long as you don't mind, Cinderella...
fields.JP: だからその、シンデレラさえよければ……
fields.LOCALIZED: As long as you don't mind, Cinderella...

fields.EN:
I appreciate your offer. However, I couldn't
bear to impose like that.
fields.JP:
お気持ちは嬉しいですわ。
ですが、そこまでご迷惑をかける
わけにはいきませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate your offer. However, I couldn't
bear to impose like that.

fields.EN: Then I'll join you in the storage room.
fields.JP: じゃあ、僕も学校の倉庫に住むよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then I'll join you in the storage room.

fields.EN:
No, you can't! I won't let you subject yourself
to that kind of life!
fields.JP:
い、いけませんわ！
あなたまでそんな不便な生活をする
必要なんてありませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you can't! I won't let you subject yourself
to that kind of life!

fields.EN:
I can't let you suffer in there by yourself,
so I'll move in there too.
fields.JP:
シンデレラだけが不便な生活をしている
ことのほうが、僕には耐えられない。
だからせめて一緒に暮らす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't let you suffer in there by yourself,
so I'll move in there too.

fields.EN:
(Living in the storage room... That was
kind of an impulsive claim, but it's not
a bad idea.)
fields.JP:
（学校の倉庫で暮らす、か。
　勢いで言っちゃったけど、
　わりと名案かも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Living in the storage room... That was
kind of an impulsive claim, but it's not
a bad idea.)

fields.EN:
It's either I go to the storage room, or
you come over. Which do you choose?
fields.JP:
僕が倉庫に押し掛けるか、君が家に来るか、
その二択だよ。さあ、どうする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's either I go to the storage room, or
you come over. Which do you choose?

fields.EN:
Err... I have no choice. I suppose I'll come
over to your family home.
fields.JP:
う……仕方ありませんわ。
そこまでおっしゃるなら、
ひと晩だけお世話になりますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Err... I have no choice. I suppose I'll come
over to your family home.

fields.EN:
(She said just one night, but I could convince
her to stay longer.)
fields.JP:
（ひと晩なんて言ってるけど、そのあとは
　どうにか引き留めて、なし崩し的に
　家に住んでもらっちゃおう。うん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She said just one night, but I could convince
her to stay longer.)

fields.JP: けっこう強引ですのね……

fields.EN: Only when it comes to you.
fields.JP: 君のためなら、強引にだってなるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Only when it comes to you.

fields.EN: Cinderella. Once I'm socially independent and can stand on my own, let's live together. I promise.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ。僕がもっと社会的に自立して、
一人前になったら、一緒に住もう。約束だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, when we're old enough, let's
live together. Let's make a vow.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Tough times come and go, but we'll overcome
them together.
fields.JP:
大変なこともあるかもしれないけど、
二人で支えていけばきっとなんとかなるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tough times come and go, but we'll overcome
them together.

fields.EN:
This sounds like a proposal. This is the
happiest day of my life.
fields.JP:
プ、プロポーズのようですわね。
……嬉しいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This sounds like a proposal. This is the
happiest day of my life.

fields.EN:
I accept your vow. From henceforth, we
will be together forever.
fields.JP:
わたくしも約束しますわ。
あなたとずっと一緒にいると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I accept your vow. From henceforth, we
will be together forever.

fields.EN:
Sorry for keeping you. You got here before
I did.
fields.JP:
先に来てくれてたんだね。
待たせちゃってごめん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for keeping you. You got here before
I did.

fields.EN: You feeling okay? Something seems different.
fields.JP:
……あの、もしかして元気ない？
いつもと様子が違うみたいだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: You feeling okay? Something seems different.

fields.EN: Of course not. All because of that letter.
fields.JP:
元気なわけがなかろう。
あのような手紙を受け取ったのだからな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course not. All because of that letter.

fields.EN: So you were serious about it. Thanks for that.
fields.JP:
そこまで真剣に考えてくれたってことだね。
ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: So you were serious about it. Thanks for that.

fields.EN:
It surprised me. I didn't think you had the
courage to do such a thing.
fields.JP:
しかし驚いたんだぞ。よもや貴様に、
あんなものを送ってくるほどの
勇ましさがあるとは思わなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It surprised me. I didn't think you had the
courage to do such a thing.

fields.JP: 勇ましさか……。そう言われると照れるな

fields.EN:
(I had to use every drop of courage to confess
my love. Hameln knew all along.)
fields.JP:
（たしかに告白するのにずいぶん勇気を
　振り絞ったもんな。ハーメルンには
　全部お見通しだったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I had to use every drop of courage to confess
my love. Hameln knew all along.)

fields.EN:
It's a bit embarrassing since you already
know, but I'll go ahead and say it.
fields.JP:
改めて言うのも照れるけど、
もうバレちゃってるみたいだから
思い切って言うね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a bit embarrassing since you already
know, but I'll go ahead and say it.

fields.EN: Right. There's no point hiding it at this point.
fields.JP:
そうだな。ここまできて、
回りくどい話は意味がない
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. There's no point hiding it at this point.

fields.JP: けっとーだ！　ジャック！！

fields.EN:
Save the tricks for someone else! You won't
make a mockery of me!
fields.JP:
この期に及んでしらばっくれる気か！
ワレを馬鹿にしてるのかーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Save the tricks for someone else! You won't
make a mockery of me!

fields.JP: いや、話が見えてこないんだけど！？

fields.EN:
You're the one who sent the letter challenging
me to a duel here!
fields.JP:
しらじらしいぞ。「会いたい」と
けっとーじょうを送りつけてきたのは
そっちではにゃいか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the one who sent the letter challenging
me to a duel here!

fields.EN:
(Huh? Did someone change the letter?
No, that couldn't be...)
fields.JP:
（なんで？　まさか僕が送った手紙が
　他の人が書いた決闘状とすり替わったとか？
　いやいや、それはないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Did someone change the letter?
No, that couldn't be...)

fields.EN:
Sorry for knocking you around a bit, but
you're the one who sent me that challenge!
fields.JP:
ワレも貴様をぶちのめすのは心が痛いが、
けっとーを申し込まれたからには
断れないんだぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for knocking you around a bit, but
you're the one who sent me that challenge!

fields.EN:
Am I just a punch magnet or something?
Um. I think you've got it mixed up.
fields.JP:
しかも僕がぶちのめされるのは確定なの？
あのー、たぶんすごい誤解があると
思うんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Am I just a punch magnet or something?
Um. I think you've got it mixed up.

fields.JP:
もんどーむよー！！
ジャック、覚悟ー！！
好きなんだ。ハーメルンのことが

fields.EN:
This might confuse you, but I called you here
because I wanted to confess my love to you.
Not battle.
fields.JP:
君は勘違いしてるけど、
僕は決闘をしたいわけじゃなくて、
告白したくて君を呼び出したんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This might confuse you, but I called you here
because I wanted to confess my love to you.
Not battle.

fields.EN:
Yes. My love. Sorry for the mix-up.
I didn't expect you to think I was trying to
duel you.
fields.JP:
そう、告白。紛らわしいことして
悪かったけど、まさか決闘状と
間違われるとは思わなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. My love. Sorry for the mix-up.
I didn't expect you to think I was trying to
duel you.

fields.EN:
You really are one-of-a-kind, Hameln.
But that's what I like about you.
fields.JP:
本当にハーメルンは変わってるよね。
まぁ、そういうところにも惹かれたんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
You really are one-of-a-kind, Hameln.
But that's what I like about you.

fields.EN:
You're strange, but irresistable. Stubborn,
yet kind. I fall harder for you every day.
fields.JP:
変わった子だけど、どこか憎めなくて、
強気だけど優しいとこもあって……。
いつの間にか好きになっちゃってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're strange, but irresistable. Stubborn,
yet kind. I fall harder for you every day.

fields.EN:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What! Why didn't you just
say so from the get-go! I just made a fool
of myself!
fields.JP:
なっ、なななっ！　それならそうと
最初から言えばよかろう！
い、いらぬ恥をかいたんだじょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Wh-Wh-What! Why didn't you just
say so from the get-go! I just made a fool
of myself!

fields.EN:
I really thought you wanted to duel!
I fell into a depression over it!
fields.JP:
てっきりけっとーじょうだと思って、
本気でへこんでたんだからな！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really thought you wanted to duel!
I fell into a depression over it!

fields.EN:
Of course! I don't want to fight! I thought my
heart would exlpode.
fields.JP:
当たり前であろう！？
……貴様と戦うなんて、嫌に決まってる。
胸がぎゅーって痛かったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! I don't want to fight! I thought my
heart would exlpode.

fields.EN:
So I realized...that you're different from the
others for me.
fields.JP:
……でも、それで気づいたのだ。
貴様はワレにとって、
他の誰とも違う存在なんだと
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I realized...that you're different from the
others for me.

fields.EN:
It became a startling realization of everything
I stand to lose.
fields.JP:
貴様と戦うのがどうして
こんなに嫌なのかと考えたら、
なんとなくわかった気がした
fields.LOCALIZED:
It became a startling realization of everything
I stand to lose.

fields.EN:
I'm starting to think that maybe I'm falling
for you too.
fields.JP: どうやらワレも貴様を好いていたようだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm starting to think that maybe I'm falling
for you too.

fields.JP: じゃ、じゃあ、僕の告白は……

fields.EN: Yes. I won't make you regret choosing me!
fields.JP:
うむ。ワレに告白した目の高さに免じて、
受けてやらんこともない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I won't make you regret choosing me!

fields.EN:
Hmph. I hope you've got what it takes to
keep up.
fields.JP:
ふふん、ワレの伴侶にふさわしい男と
なれるように、しょーじんするんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. I hope you've got what it takes to
keep up.

fields.EN:
(Hameln told me she wanted to apologize
for mistaking the love letter for a duel
invitation.)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンが、告白の手紙を
　決闘状と勘違いしてしまった
　お詫びをしたいと言い出した）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln told me she wanted to apologize
for mistaking the love letter for a duel
invitation.)

fields.EN:
(I told her I didn't mind, but she insisted,
so I called upon one favor.)
fields.JP:
（僕は別にいいと言ったんだけど、
　どうしてもと言って聞かなかったので、
　一つお願いをすることにした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I told her I didn't mind, but she insisted,
so I called upon one favor.)

fields.EN: Jack, I didn't know you were into this...
fields.JP:
……ジャック、まさか貴様にこのような
趣味があるとは知らなかったんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, I didn't know you were into this...

fields.JP:
こ、こんな……。
ワレをはじゅかしめるよーな
真似をしゅるなんて……！

fields.EN:
I'm not trying to embarrass you. I just wanted
to see a different side of you.
fields.JP:
は、辱めるつもりなんてないんだけどな……。
僕はただ、ハーメルンの違う一面も
見てみたかっただけなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not trying to embarrass you. I just wanted
to see a different side of you.

fields.EN: But what does this outfit have to do with it!
fields.JP:
だからといって、なぜこんな
ひらひらした恰好を……！
fields.LOCALIZED: But what does this outfit have to do with it!

fields.EN:
I just wanted to see it for myself. This isn't
really your style, so I was super curious.
fields.JP:
着てみてほしかったから。
ハーメルンって普段はこういう恰好しないから、
どんな感じか気になったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just wanted to see it for myself. This isn't
really your style, so I was super curious.

fields.EN: Isn't this enough then? I'm gonna change!
fields.JP:
だ、だったらこれで十分見たであろう！？
ワレはもう着替えるからな！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Isn't this enough then? I'm gonna change!

fields.JP: あれ、そんなに嫌だった？

fields.EN:
Of course not! I might go mad from shame!
I only wore it because you asked.
fields.JP:
当たり前だっ！
恥ずかしくてどうにかなりそうだ。
貴様の頼みだから着てやったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not! I might go mad from shame!
I only wore it because you asked.

fields.EN: I know for a fact I don't look good in these.
fields.JP:
こ、こんな服が似合わないことは、
ワレが一番よくわかってるんだぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I know for a fact I don't look good in these.

fields.EN: What do you mean? You look adorable.
fields.JP: えー、もったいない。そんなに可愛いのに
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean? You look adorable.

fields.EN:
Hameln, you're the one wearing the clothes.
That makes you cute by default.
fields.JP:
その服を着てるハーメルンが、だよ。
そういう服も似合ってるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, you're the one wearing the clothes.
That makes you cute by default.

fields.EN:
Darn you, Jack. Using your quick wit to charm
girls. This is all in your playbook.
fields.JP:
……ジャックめ。
息をするよーに女を褒めるとは……。
一見無害そーな顔をして、なかなかやるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Darn you, Jack. Using your quick wit to charm
girls. This is all in your playbook.

fields.EN: (Was that praise? Or am I missing something?)
fields.JP:
（？　褒められたのかな？
　よくわからない……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Was that praise? Or am I missing something?)

fields.EN:
I do appreicate your honesty however.
Maybe I don't look too bad in these.
I could get used to them.
fields.JP:
だが、貴様のその正直さは悪くないんだぞ。
そうか、この服はワレに似合ってるのか……。
そう言われればそんな気がしてきたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do appreicate your honesty however.
Maybe I don't look too bad in these.
I could get used to them.

fields.EN: Well, maybe you're onto something! Hehehe.
fields.JP:
うん。貴様がそう言うのなら、
たぶんそうなのだろう！
むふふっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, maybe you're onto something! Hehehe.

fields.EN: With my figure, any outfit works!
fields.JP:
やはりワレほどのレベルになると、
どんな服でも着こなしてしまうと
いうことだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: With my figure, any outfit works!

fields.EN: Bring on the clothes! I love a good challenge!
fields.JP:
もうこうなったらどんな服でももってこーい！
受けて立ってやるぞ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Bring on the clothes! I love a good challenge!

fields.EN: That's the spirit, Hameln? How about this?
fields.JP:
その気になってくれたんだね、ハーメルン！
じゃあこっちの服も着てみてほしいな！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's the spirit, Hameln? How about this?

fields.EN:
Ugh... What that outer top? You think it'll
look good?
fields.JP:
うわ……それはまた、だいぶすごいな……。
ワレに似合うだろうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh... What that outer top? You think it'll
look good?

fields.EN: It will! All of the frilly lace is really cute.
fields.JP:
きっと似合うよ！
この服もレースがふんだんに使われてて、
すっごく乙女チックでいいよねー
fields.LOCALIZED: It will! All of the frilly lace is really cute.

fields.EN:
Wow. This outfit looks just as good as the
last one. You look like a princess with the
big pink ribbon.
fields.JP:
わぁ、あっちの服もいいね！
大きいピンクのリボンがお姫様みたいだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. This outfit looks just as good as the
last one. You look like a princess with the
big pink ribbon.

fields.JP:
ハーメルン、こっちの服も
着てみてくれるよね？

fields.EN:
Rgh... If you insist then I have no choice but to
accept! Curse my bold promises!
fields.JP:
く……っ、そんな期待に満ちた顔を
されたら仕方ない。
番長に二言はにゃいんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh... If you insist then I have no choice but to
accept! Curse my bold promises!

fields.JP: やったぁ！　さすがハーメルン！

fields.EN:
I only wear these clothes because of you!
You'd better be thankful!
fields.JP:
こ、こんな服を着てやるのなんて、
貴様のためだけなんだからな。
せーぜー感謝するがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only wear these clothes because of you!
You'd better be thankful!

fields.EN: That was one heck of a shopping spree!
fields.JP:
いやー、今日はついたくさん
買い物しちゃったね！
fields.LOCALIZED: That was one heck of a shopping spree!

fields.EN: I had a blast! We gotta do that again soon.
fields.JP:
でもすごく楽しかったな！
またデートしたいね
fields.LOCALIZED: I had a blast! We gotta do that again soon.

fields.EN:
Um. Did you not enjoy yourself, Hameln?
You don't sound too excited.
fields.JP:
……あのー、ハーメルン。
ひょっとして楽しくなかった？
テンション低いけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. Did you not enjoy yourself, Hameln?
You don't sound too excited.

fields.EN: No, I had fun going out with you, Jack. That's true.
fields.JP:
いや、貴様と二人で出かけるのは
楽しかったぞ、ジャック。それは本当だ
fields.LOCALIZED: I enjoyed our date, Jack. That much is true.

fields.EN:
But after trying on practically the whole
store, I'm wiped.
fields.JP:
だがな、あのあともひらひらした服を
とっかえひっかえ試着させられたんだぞ。
もーくたくただ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after trying on practically the whole
store, I'm wiped.

fields.EN:
Also, I appreciate a little praise now and 
then, but that was embarrassing.
fields.JP:
それに褒められるのは悪い気はしないが、
めちゃくちゃ恥ずかしかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, I appreciate a little praise now and 
then, but that was embarrassing.

fields.EN: Aaaah. Sorry. I went a little overboard.
fields.JP:
あー、ごめん。楽しくて
ちょっと調子に乗りすぎたかも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Aaaah. Sorry. I went a little overboard.

fields.EN:
Can't blame you. We're both figuring
out the ropes at this whole dating thing.
fields.JP:
まぁ、仕方あるまいな。
ワレも貴様も、まだ恋人としては
ちょちんちゃだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't blame you. We're both figuring
out the ropes at this whole dating thing.

fields.EN:
These are just growing pains. Stuff you
gotta get over on this lifelong journey we
call the lover's path.
fields.JP:
最初はこーゆーこともあるだろう。
ワレらは長く険しい「恋人道」を
歩み始めたばかりなのだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
These are just growing pains. Stuff you
gotta get over on this lifelong journey we
call the lover's path.

fields.JP: 恋人道……。なんか勇ましいね……

fields.EN:
We try hard to make the other smile,
learn something new about each other.
The lover's path is the most fulfilling of all.
fields.JP:
恋人の喜ぶ顔が見たくてがんばったり、
恋人のおかげで新たな自分を見つけたり……。
恋人道とは奥が深いのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We try hard to make the other smile,
learn something new about each other.
The lover's path is the most fulfilling of all.

fields.EN: We need to be serious here.
fields.JP: これはもっと真剣に学ばないといけないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: We need to be serious here.

fields.EN: Yeah lets take it step by step and learn slowly...
fields.JP:
そうだね。ゆっくりと少しずつ
学んでいければ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah lets take it step by step and learn slowly...

fields.EN: No! We must master the lover's path at once!
fields.JP:
駄目だ！
そんなゆーちょーなことを言っていては、
恋人道の覇者にはなれんぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! We must master the lover's path at once!

fields.EN:
Come on! We can study all about the lover's path
at my house! All night long!
fields.JP:
善は急げだ。さっそくワレの家で、
恋人道をべんきょーするぞ！　徹夜で！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on! We can study all about the lover's path
at my house! All night long!

fields.EN:
Yes. We shall study hard together, and we'll
have until the morning all by ourselves.
fields.JP:
そうだ。二人きりで朝までみっちりがっちり、
時にもっちりしっぽり、恋人とはなんなのかを
べんきょーしまくるのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. We shall study hard together, and we'll
have until the morning all by ourselves.

fields.EN:
(What do I do? I'm sure Hameln's not
planning anything out of line, but that's
kind of a big step.)
fields.JP:
（ど、どうしよう。
　ハーメルンに他意がないのは
　わかってるけど、緊張してきた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do I do? I'm sure Hameln's not
planning anything out of line, but that's
kind of a big step.)

fields.EN: Hm? What's wrong? Don't wanna study?
fields.JP:
む？　どうした、浮かない顔をしてるな。
嫌なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? What's wrong? Don't wanna study?

fields.EN:
I'm just wondering to myself if it's actually
okay to stay over.
fields.JP:
そ、そうじゃないけど、
本当にいいのかなって。
僕が泊まっても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just wondering to myself if it's actually
okay to stay over.

fields.JP: いいに決まっておろう！
えんりょすることはない！

fields.EN: (She really, truly has no ulterior motive...)
fields.JP: （ほんっとーに、他意はないんだなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What exactly is she going for here...?)

fields.EN:
Besides, I wouldn't mind wearing those dresses
you got earlier today.
fields.JP:
それに今日買った服を、貴様になら
また着て見せてやってもいいと
思ってるんだぞ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I wouldn't mind wearing those dresses
you got earlier today.

fields.EN: Really? I wouldn't want to miss that.
fields.JP: 本当？　それは見たいな
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? I wouldn't want to miss that.

fields.EN:
Right. I still need the courage to wear it outside.
I'll only wear it for you.
fields.JP:
う、うむ。外に着ていくにはまだ
勇気がいるが……、見せてやるのなんて
貴様にだけなんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I still need the courage to wear it outside.
I'll only wear it for you.

fields.JP: ジャック、貴様はワレの特別だからな……

fields.EN:
Then we're one in the same.
You're my sweetheart too.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、僕と同じだね。
僕にとっても、君は特別だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we're one in the same.
You're my sweetheart too.

fields.JP:
……っ！　そ、そうだなっ。
きぐうだな、うん

fields.EN:
*cough*! Jack, I haven't said this formally yet,
so here it is. Listen up.
fields.JP:
コホン！　……ジャック。そういえば
ちゃんと言ってなかった気がするから、
今言っておく。よーく聞け
fields.LOCALIZED:
*cough*! Jack, I haven't said this formally yet,
so here it is. Listen up.

fields.JP: あ、いたいたー！　ジャックー！
ラプンツェル！　走って来てくれたの？

fields.EN:
This is my first letter from you! I couldn't wait
so I shot over!
fields.JP:
ジャックからてがみもらうの、
はじめてだった！
うれしかったから、はしってきたの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my first letter from you! I couldn't wait
so I shot over!

fields.EN:
So what's this important thing you wanted to
talk about? Couldn't we talk about it at home?
fields.JP:
ねーねー、だいじなはなしってなに？
うちではなすんじゃだめなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So what's this important thing you wanted to
talk about? Couldn't we talk about it at home?

fields.EN: Yeah, but Mom and Dad are home, so...
fields.JP:
う、うん。
家だと、父さんや母さんがいるし……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, but Mom and Dad are home, so...

fields.EN:
We're keeping it secret from them? Wow.
This must be a big deal!
fields.JP:
おとーさんとおかーさんにはないしょ？
わー、なんかどきどきしちゃうね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're keeping it secret from them? Wow.
This must be a big deal!

fields.EN:
(Man. The nervousness on top of the whole taboo
of it all makes me feel even worse. Wish I could
be as cheerful as her about it. I'm terrified.)
fields.JP:
（僕のドキドキ感は背徳感と相まって
　ガチというか、ラプンツェルと違って
　ひやひやものなんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man. The nervousness on top of the whole taboo
of it all makes me feel even worse. Wish I could
be as cheerful as her about it. I'm terrified.)

fields.EN: (But I agonized over this for ages before finally making up my mind. If I stop now, everything really will have been for nothing.)
fields.JP:
（だけどずっと迷ったあげく、
　ようやく覚悟を決めたんじゃないか。
　ここでやめたら、それこそ全部台無しだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But my mind was already made up.
I can't waste both of our time.)

fields.EN: This might sound weird coming from me, but...
fields.JP:
あ、あのさ、こんなこと言ったら
気持ち悪いと思うかもしれないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: This might sound weird coming from me, but...

fields.EN:
I really like you, Rapunzel. Not as a step-sister.
Like as in the other way.
fields.JP:
僕はラプンツェルのことが好きなんだ。
……義妹としてではなく、女の子として
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really like you, Rapunzel. Not as a step-sister.
Like as in the other way.

fields.EN: Huh? Why would that be weird?
fields.JP:
えー？
なんでそれがきもちわるいことなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Why would that be weird?

fields.EN: Even if we're not related by blood, we're brother and sister, you know? Normally, siblings aren't supposed to feel that way about each other...
fields.JP:
だって血の繋がりはないとはいえ、
僕達は兄妹なんだよ？　普通、兄妹で
そういう風に思っちゃいけないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because even though we're not related by blood,
we're family. This kind of thing isn't exactly
typical.

fields.EN: So I can't tell Mom or Dad?
fields.JP: おとーさんとおかーさんにもいっちゃだめ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So I can't tell Mom or Dad?

fields.EN:
If you could. I've told you my feelings.
I'd like to know yours.
fields.JP:
頼むね、本当に。……それで、
僕はラプンツェルが好きなわけだけど、
その、君の気持ちはどうかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you could. I've told you my feelings.
I'd like to know yours.

fields.EN: Would it gross you out if I saw you as a girl? What do you think, Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
僕が君を女の子として意識してたら、
気持ち悪いかな？
ラプンツェルはどう思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Am I weird for even bringing this up?
What do you think?

fields.EN: If you don't like it, tell me! We can go back to treating each other normally as brother and sister, just like before...
fields.JP:
あ、もしも嫌だったらそう言って！
今まで通り、普通の兄妹として普通に接して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you think it's weird, then just tell me!
I don't want to lose our relationship.

fields.JP: いやじゃないよ！　うん！

うん。ラプンツェルもジャックのこと、
すきだもん！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Not like as a step-brother, but maybe like we
could go out?
fields.JP:
義兄としてだけでなく、そのー、
お付き合いしてもいいなーって
思えるってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not like as a step-brother, but maybe like we
could go out?

fields.EN:
I'm not sure I'm following what you mean,
but as long as we're together!
fields.JP:
おつきあいとかよくわかんないけど、
たぶん、ジャックとならいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure I'm following what you mean,
but as long as we're together!

fields.EN: I know it's cowardly to say this after the fact, but the truth is, it's not really okay for us to date.
fields.JP:
後からこんなこと言うのは卑怯だと
思うんだけど、僕達が付き合うのは、
本当はよくないことなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I just said everything I said, but I'm
not sure it's a good idea for us to be seen on
a date in public.

fields.EN:
We need to keep it secret from everyone,
including Mom and Dad. Can you promise?
fields.JP:
父さんと母さんにも、他の人にも、
秘密にしなきゃいけないんだ。
それでもいいって約束できる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need to keep it secret from everyone,
including Mom and Dad. Can you promise?

fields.EN:
Hmm... Sounds hard, but Rapunzel will try!
'Cause Rapunzel wants to go out with Jack too!
fields.JP:
んー……、たいへんそうだけど、がんばる！
だってラプンツェルも、ジャックと
おつきあいしたいもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sounds hard, but I will try!
Because I want to go out with you!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Going out means having babies, right?!
fields.JP:
おつきあいって、こどもつくること
なんだよね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Going out means having babies, right?!

fields.JP: なっ！？　いや、それは……っ

fields.EN: Not exactly, but that's like 20 steps ahead.
fields.JP:
ち……違うわけでもないけど、
それはかなり極端な解釈だね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Not exactly, but that's like 20 steps ahead.

fields.EN:
(Sound like Rapunzel has no idea how dating
works. Did I pull the trigger too early?)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルの認識では、付き合うのと
　子供を作るのはほぼ同じことなんだ……。
　告白は早まったか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sound like Rapunzel has no idea how dating
works. Did I pull the trigger too early?)

fields.EN:
(No, but Rapunzel is cute. If I don't hurry,
someone else might confess to her first!)
fields.JP:
（いや、でもラプンツェルはかわいいから、
　早くしないと他の誰かに告白されちゃう
　かもしれない！）
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
(I can't even imagine what that would be like.
...Does this mean I have a sister complex?)
fields.JP:
（そんなの想像しただけでも許せない！！
　……あれ、僕って実はかなりシスコン？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't even imagine what that would be like.
...Does this mean I have a sister complex?)

fields.EN: (...But it's true that I see Rapunzel as a girl, not as my stepsister. This goes beyond even a sister complex...)
fields.JP:
（……だけど、ラプンツェルを義妹でなく、
　女の子として見てしまっているのは本当だ。
　こんなの、シスコンですらないよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I do care for Rapunzel beyond our step-
sibling relationship. This is something more.)

fields.EN: Jack, what is wrong? Does your tummy hurt?
fields.JP:
？　ジャック、だまってどうしたの？
おなかいたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, what is wrong? Does your tummy hurt?

fields.EN: You know, Rapunzel's heart is pounding even faster than before.
fields.JP:
あのね、なんかラプンツェル、
さっきよりどきどきしてきちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED: My heart is pounding faster than earlier.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
When Rapunzel thought, 'Jack sees Rapunzel as a girl?'
her heart suddenly started pounding faster.
fields.JP:
ジャックがラプンツェルをおんなのこ
としてみてる？　っておもったら、
きゅうにどきどきがはやくなったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowing you have a crush on me makes my
heart beat wicked fast.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's never felt her heart pound like this before.
What's happening to Rapunzel...?
fields.JP:
こんなどきどき、はじめて。
ラプンツェル、どうしちゃったんだろう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never known this feeling before.
What's happened to me?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: I just hope you feel the same way I do.
fields.JP:
……だったら、たぶんラプンツェルも
僕と同じ気持ちなのかなって思いたい
fields.LOCALIZED: I just hope you feel the same way I do.

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、へんじゃない？
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Not at all. I'm the weird one. Ya know, for
confessing his love for his step-sister.
fields.JP:
変じゃないよ。……変なのは僕のほうなんだ。
義妹に告白するなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all. I'm the weird one. Ya know, for
confessing his love for his step-sister.

fields.EN:
Then Rapunzel is weird too!
Because Rapunzel loves weird Jack!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、やっぱりラプンツェルもへん！
だって、へんなジャックのことが
だいすきなんだもん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then count me in too! Because I love you back!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: I can't wait to start a family!
fields.JP: いっしょにこども、つくろうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't wait to start a family!

fields.EN: W-Well we've got plenty of time until then.
fields.JP: そ、それはまた別の話だからねっ？
fields.LOCALIZED: W-Well we've got plenty of time until then.

fields.EN: (Maybe first we can have a normal date.)
fields.JP:
（まずは清く正しく健全な男女交際
　というものを教えないと。
　まずはそこからだな、うん……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe first we can have a normal date.)

fields.EN: Let me scrub your back for you. *rub, rub, rub*.
fields.JP:
おせなか、ながしますねー。
ごしごし、ごしごし……
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me scrub your back for you. *rub, rub, rub*.

fields.EN: How is it Jack? Does it feel good?
fields.JP: ジャック、どう？　きもちいい？
fields.LOCALIZED: How is it Jack? Does it feel good?

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel was reading a book on something,
then all of a sudden we were taking a bath.
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルなりに恋人というものを
　勉強してたみたいだけど、背中を流すと喜ぶ、
　なんて知識を仕入れてきたらしい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel was reading a book on something,
then all of a sudden we were taking a bath.

fields.EN:
(The back-scrubbing aside, I'm not too keen
on people interrupting my bath like that.
fields.JP:
（どこでどう知ったのかは置いておくとして、
　僕が風呂に入ってるときに突撃してこられると
　めちゃくちゃ困る……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The back-scrubbing aside, I'm not too keen
on people interrupting my bath like that.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's happy Jack liked it!
Rapunzel studied a whole lot!
fields.JP:
ジャックによろこんでもらえてうれしいな！
ラプンツェル、たくさんべんきょうしたんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Happy you like it, Jack! I've been studying!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: The best lovey-dovey couples bathe together.
fields.JP:
らぶらぶなこいびとどうしは、
いっしょにおふろにはいって、
せなかをあらってあげるんだって！
fields.LOCALIZED: The best lovey-dovey couples bathe together.

fields.JP: ……ちなみにそれ、どこで知ったの？
おとーさんとおかーさんがいってた！

fields.EN: Hey Rapunzel-san, you didn't mention us did you...?
fields.JP:
ちょっ、ラプンツェルさん！？
まさか僕達のことは……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Rapunzel, you didn't mention us did you...?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.EN:
Not a peep. I asked them what someone should
do to get closer to their partner.
fields.JP:
いってないよ？　でもね、こいびとどうしは
どうやったらなかよくなれるの？　って
きいたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not a peep. I asked them what someone should
do to get closer to their partner.

fields.EN:
They said bathing together often. That explains
why they're always in the bath together!
fields.JP:
そしたら、おふろがいいんだって。
うちのおとーさんとおかーさんも、
よくいっしょにおふろはいってるもんね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They said bathing together often. That explains
why they're always in the bath together!

fields.JP: あー、そういえば入ってるね……

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel was asking some lofty stuff.
Maybe I should tell her to pipe down 
a bit.)
fields.JP:
（というかラプンツェルってば、
　かなり際どいことを親に聞いてたんだな。
　あとで改めて口止めしておかないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel was asking some lofty stuff.
Maybe I should tell her to pipe down 
a bit.)

fields.EN: Hehehe, now Jack and Rapunzel are close lovers!
fields.JP:
えへへー、これでジャックとラプンツェルは、
なかよしのこいびとだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. Now we are close as ever!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
(I just hope she's happy. Especially she learned
all that scrubbing for me.)
fields.JP:
（……まぁ、ラプンツェルが楽しそうなのが
　一番だよな。せっかく僕のために勉強して
　くれたんだし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I just hope she's happy. Especially she learned
all that scrubbing for me.)

fields.EN:
Hm. That feels different on my back.
Did you change sponges?
fields.JP:
……ん？　背中をこする感じがさっきまでと
違うような……。スポンジ変えた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. That feels different on my back.
Did you change sponges?

fields.EN: Yup! Rapunzel's rubbing you with her hair!
fields.JP:
うん！　ラプンツェルの髪で
こすってあげてるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! I am rubbing with my hair!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
What?! Are you really using your hair?
Why in the world!
fields.JP:
えっ？　ああっ、よく見たら本当に髪だ！
な、なんで髪でこすってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Are you really using your hair?
Why in the world!

fields.EN:
Jack is precious, so Rapunzel's rubbing you
with Rapunzel's precious hair!
fields.JP:
ジャックはだいじだから、
ラプンツェルのだいじなかみで
こすってあげるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're precious to me, so figured I'd use
my precious hair to clean you!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
(Surprising. Is this her way of showing affection?
Sure is like her...)
fields.JP:
（驚いたけど、これも一つの愛の形って
　ことかな……？　ラプンツェルらしいや）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Surprising. Is this her way of showing affection?
Sure is like her...)

fields.EN:
Is rubbing your back enough, or should I do
your tummy too?
fields.JP:
ねー、ごしごしするの、せなかだけでいい？
まえもやる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is rubbing your back enough, or should I do
your tummy too?

fields.JP: 前は自分でやる！　自分でやるからっ！

fields.EN: B-Because... Just my back is fine.
fields.JP:
い、いろいろあるの。
背中だけで十分だから
fields.LOCALIZED: B-Because... Just my back is fine.

fields.EN:
(Something about this makes me feel strange.
It's not every day your step-sister scrubs you
down with her hair in the bath.)
fields.JP:
（考えてみれば、けっこう背徳的な状況
　だよな。血の繋がらない妹兼恋人に、
　髪で体をこすってもらうとか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Something about this makes me feel strange.
It's not every day your step-sister scrubs you
down with her hair in the bath.)

fields.EN: (Ugh, I shouldn't think about it too much.)
fields.JP:
（…………うわ、やばい。
　今は深く考えないようにしよう）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ugh, I shouldn't think about it too much.)

fields.EN:
Jack, you sure just the back is fine? I don't
mind?
fields.JP:
ジャック、ほんとにせなかだけでいいの？
まえもやるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, you sure just the back is fine? I don't
mind?

fields.JP: 前は勘弁してください……
ふへー、つーかーれーたー

fields.EN: I bet. You sure put some work in on my back.
fields.JP:
そりゃ、あれだけがんばって
こすってくれたらね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I bet. You sure put some work in on my back.

fields.EN:
(I appreciate her help, but my skin's practically
raw.)
fields.JP:
（がんばってくれたことはありがたいけど、
　正直、背中の皮膚がひりひりする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I appreciate her help, but my skin's practically
raw.)

fields.JP: な、なに？　じっと見て……

fields.EN: You seem mad... Was my scrubbing no good?
fields.JP:
ジャック、なんかげんきなさそう……。
きもちよくなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED: You seem mad... Was my scrubbing no good?

fields.EN:
Rub-rub in the bath...
It was Rapunzel's first time, so was she bad at it?
fields.JP:
おふろで、ごしごし……。
はじめてだったから、ラプンツェル、
うまくできなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rub-rub in bath... Was I not good?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Is that what you're worried about?
I mean, my back does hurt a little.
fields.JP:
なんだ、そんなことを気にしてたのか。
まぁ、たしかにちょっと背中が
ひりひりするけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that what you're worried about?
I mean, my back does hurt a little.

fields.EN:
But you gave it your all, which is more than
enough for me.
fields.JP:
だけどラプンツェルががんばってくれた
ことはわかってるから、僕は嬉しかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you gave it your all, which is more than
enough for me.

fields.EN: Yeah. I can tell how much you care, you know?
fields.JP:
本当だよ。ラプンツェルは僕のために
してくれたんだよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I can tell how much you care, you know?

fields.EN:
Thank you Rapunzel. I'm happy knowing you
care about making me happy. I'm not worried
about how good or bad it is.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ラプンツェル。
うまくできるかどうかじゃなく、
やってくれようとした気持ちが嬉しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you Rapunzel. I'm happy knowing you
care about making me happy. I'm not worried
about how good or bad it is.

fields.JP:
ジャック……うぅ～！
だいすきいいぃーー！！

fields.EN:
You make me so happy! I love you! I love you!
I'll do better next time!
fields.JP:
うー、うれしいー！！
ジャック、すきすきしゅきー！！
次はもっとがんばるね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You make me so happy! I love you! I love you!
I'll do better next time!

fields.EN: Yeah. A little gentleness would go a long way.
fields.JP:
うん、がんばりすぎないように、
適度にがんばってくれると嬉しいかな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. A little gentleness would go a long way.

fields.EN:
(Hm? I made a promise that we'd take
another bath again sometime soon.
fields.JP:
（ん？　自然な流れでまた一緒に
　入る約束をしてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? I made a promise that we'd take
another bath again sometime soon.

fields.EN: Hey, you sleepy? You worked hard today.
fields.JP:
あれ、急に眠くなっちゃったのかな。
今日はたくさんがんばったからね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you sleepy? You worked hard today.

fields.EN: Go back to your room and sleep.
fields.JP: 今日はもう寝るといいよ。部屋に戻りな
fields.LOCALIZED: Go back to your room and sleep.

fields.EN:
Sleep...but no go to room...sleep here like
before.
fields.JP:
……ねる。でも、もどらない……。
むかしみたいに、ここでねる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleep...but no go to room...sleep here like
before.

fields.EN:
You're not a kid anymore, so we can't.
We have to sleep separately.
fields.JP:
駄目だよ。もう子供じゃないんだから、
別々に寝ないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not a kid anymore, so we can't.
We have to sleep separately.

fields.EN: No. I wanna sleep next to you.
fields.JP:
やだ。……ほんとはずっと、
いっしょにねたかった
fields.LOCALIZED: No. I wanna sleep next to you.

fields.JP: え、一緒に寝たかったって……

fields.EN: (I know she means it innocently, but still...)
fields.JP:
（別に他意はないんだろうけど、
　またずいぶん大胆なことを
　言ってくれるなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I know she means it innocently, but still...)

fields.EN:
Rapunzel knows.
Lovers sleep together, right...?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、しってるよ。
こいびとどうしは、
いっしょにねるんでしょ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
People who love each other are supposed to
sleep in the same bed.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
And you know what they say: happy wife,
happy life!
fields.JP:
それにおんなのこは、
こいびとにちょっとくらいわがまま
いってもいいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you know what they say: happy wife,
happy life!

fields.JP: だから、おねがい。いいでしょ……？

fields.EN: *sigh*... Okay. But just tonight, got it?
fields.JP:
……はぁ。
仕方ないな、とりあえず今日だけだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh*... Okay. But just tonight, got it?

fields.EN: Hehehe. Yes. We haven't done this in forever.
fields.JP:
えへへ、やったー。
ジャックといっしょのおふとん、
ひさしぶり！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. Yes. We haven't done this in forever.

fields.EN:
Jack, hurry, hurry!
Come over by Rapunzel's arm!
fields.JP:
ジャック、はやくはやく！
ラプンツェルのうでのとこ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hurry Jack! Next to my arm!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Lovers sleep next to each other, arm to arm,
right?
fields.JP: こいびとは、うでまくらするんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lovers sleep next to each other, arm to arm,
right?

fields.EN: I've never heard that before in my life...
fields.JP:
……えーと、普通は女の子がするものじゃ
ないんだけどね？
fields.LOCALIZED: I've never heard that before in my life...

fields.EN:
(Not that I would know any better. But maybe
we can let common sense dictate.)
fields.JP:
（僕も詳しいわけじゃないけど、
　やっぱり常識的なことは、一つずつ
　教えていかないといけないなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that I would know any better. But maybe
we can let common sense dictate.)

fields.EN:
(But sleeping next to one another like this
isn't so bad at all. It's like when we were
little...)
fields.JP:
（まぁ、だけど今だけは、
　子供の頃みたいに一緒にだらだら
　寝るのもいいか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But sleeping next to one another like this
isn't so bad at all. It's like when we were
little...)

fields.JP: （親指姫、手紙読んでくれたかな……）
ジャック、待たせたわね

親指姫！
よかった、手紙読んでくれたんだね

fields.EN: Yeah. So about this "imporant talk" nonsense...
fields.JP:
ま、まぁね。「大事な話がある」って
改まって呼び出すなんて、その……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. So about this "imporant talk" nonsense...

fields.EN:
Yeah... Just thought I'd clear the air on how
I feel.
fields.JP:
うん……。もういい加減、
自分の気持ちをはっきりさせなきゃ
いけないと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Just thought I'd clear the air on how
I feel.

fields.EN: Let me just say it. I wanna c-confess, but...
fields.JP: 単刀直入に言うと、こ、告白……というか
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me just say it. I wanna c-confess, but...

fields.EN: But what? Out with it, boy!
fields.JP:
というかってなによ、というかって！
は、はっきりしなさいよっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: But what? Out with it, boy!

fields.EN: Sorry... I just wanted to say I love you.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん。つまり、君のことが
好きだって伝えたかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry... I just wanted to say I love you.

fields.EN:
I've always wanted to tell you, but never
had the chance. Especially with how chaotic
my birthday was.
fields.JP:
前から言おうと思ってたのに、
タイミングがつかめなくて……。
僕の誕生日のときも結局ぐだぐだだったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've always wanted to tell you, but never
had the chance. Especially with how chaotic
my birthday was.

fields.EN:
But...it's all true. Oyayubihime, will you go
out with me?
fields.JP:
でも、今日はちゃんと言うよ。
親指姫、僕と付き合ってくれないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...it's all true. Thumbelina, will you go
out with me?

fields.JP: な……なに考えてるのよあんた！！

fields.EN:
I treat you like dirt and you still like me?
Are you a masochist?! Or just insane?!
fields.JP:
今までわたし、さんざんキッツイこと言って
きたじゃない！　それなのに好きって……
あんたＭなの！？　ドＭなの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I treat you like dirt and you still like me?
Are you a masochist?! Or just insane?!

fields.EN:
You think? You invite me for a confession
that you "think" is true?
fields.JP:
たぶんですって！？
そんな生半可な気持ちで……っ、
気持ち、で……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think? You invite me for a confession
that you "think" is true?

fields.EN:
Sorry! I didn't mean it that way!
Just calm down!
fields.JP: ごめん！　たぶんじゃないから落ち着いて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry! I didn't mean it that way!
Just calm down!

fields.EN:
If being in love with you makes me a masochist,
then so be it. But the first part is undeniable.
fields.JP:
Ｍかどうかは別として、
僕はそのままの親指姫を好きになったんだ。
それだけは誤解しないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
If being in love with you makes me a masochist,
then so be it. But the first part is undeniable.

fields.EN:
You might tell it like it is, but I know deep
down you've got a heart of gold.
fields.JP:
たしかに言い方がキツイところはあるけど、
君の言ってることはだいたい正しいし、
根っこには優しさがあるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You might tell it like it is, but I know deep
down you've got a heart of gold.

fields.EN:
You're also a hard worker, and everyone
looks up to you. You have many attractive
qualities, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
それにがんばり屋で、面倒見がよくて、
思いやりがあって……。親指姫の
いいところはたくさんあると思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're also a hard worker, and everyone
looks up to you. You have many attractive
qualities, Thumbelina.

fields.EN:
Sure we're not in the same year, but that
never stopped me dreaming.
fields.JP:
クラスは違うけど、いつの間にか
君のことばかり目で追うようになってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure we're not in the same year, but that
never stopped me dreaming.

fields.EN: (Oh no. Something's off. Did I upset her?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、なんだろう。様子がおかしいな……。
　もしかして困らせちゃったのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh no. Something's off. Did I upset her?)

fields.EN:
(Thinking back, I might have just spilled
too much. I should've though this through.)
fields.JP:
（考えてみれば、いきなり好きだとか
　言われても困るだけかもしれない。相手の
　気持ちも考えず先走っちゃったかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thinking back, I might have just spilled
too much. I should've though this through.)

fields.EN: Um. I'm sorry... I upset you, didn't I?
fields.JP:
……あの、ごめん。
困らせちゃったよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. I'm sorry... I upset you, didn't I?

fields.EN:
I see. Then I apologize. That's not what I
wanted. Let's just forget what I said, okay?
fields.JP:
やっぱり……。本当にごめん。
困らせたいわけじゃなかったんだ。
今のはなかったことにしてもいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Then I apologize. That's not what I
wanted. Let's just forget what I said, okay?

fields.EN: Huh? Wait a second! What do you mean?
fields.JP:
えっ？　ちょ、ちょっと待ちなさいよ！
なに自己完結して勝手なこと言ってんのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Wait a second! What do you mean?

fields.EN:
I'm shocked, of course. But I never said I
didn't like it!
fields.JP:
たしかにびっくりして、
ちょっとだけ困ったけど、
別に嫌だなんて言ってないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm shocked, of course. But I never said I
didn't like it!

fields.JP: わたしだってあんたのこと好きなんだから！！

fields.EN: Yup. Got a problem with it, buster?
fields.JP: そうよ！　なによ、悪い？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. Got a problem with it, buster?

fields.EN:
I know I can be harsh on you, but at least
I've never lied to you.
fields.JP:
いつもあんたにキツく当たっちゃうし、
こんなときでもツンツンしちゃうけど、
わたしは嘘はつかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I can be harsh on you, but at least
I've never lied to you.

fields.EN: I've actually had my eye on you for a while.
fields.JP:
……あんたのこと、前からちょっと
気になってたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: I've actually had my eye on you for a while.

fields.EN:
Seriously? That's so nice... So does that
mean the feeling's mutual?
fields.JP:
そ、そうだったんだ……ありがとう。
じゃあ、僕達両想いってこと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously? That's so nice... So does that
mean the feeling's mutual?

fields.EN:
You need a hearing aid because I already
said yes!
fields.JP: そんな改めて確認しないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need a hearing aid because I already
said yes!

fields.JP: もう、すぐ謝るのも禁止！

fields.EN:
If you wanna be my boyfriend, you can't get
flustered so easily.
fields.JP:
わたしの、か、彼氏になるんだったら、
もっと堂々としてなさいよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you wanna be my boyfriend, you can't get
flustered so easily.

fields.EN: Yeah, good point. I'll do better next time.
fields.JP:
そうだね。君の彼氏にふさわしく
なれるように、がんばるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, good point. I'll do better next time.

fields.JP:
そ、そうよ！
それでこそわたしの彼氏よ！

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime requested that all of us come
to cheer on the volleyball team for their
game.)
fields.JP:
（親指姫の誘いで、今日はバレーボール部の
　試合を応援しに来た）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina requested that all of us come
to cheer on the volleyball team for their
game.)

fields.EN:
(She isn't in the starting line-up, so instead
she's with me on the bench.)
fields.JP:
（もっとも、彼女はレギュラーじゃないので、
　一緒に応援席で応援しているんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She isn't in the starting line-up, so instead
she's with me on the bench.)

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime sure knows how to work the
crowd.)
fields.JP:
（親指姫、さっきから応援に
　すごい熱が入ってるなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina sure knows how to work the
crowd.)

fields.EN:
Hm? Hey Jack, don't just sit there!
Cheer them on!
fields.JP:
……ん？　ちょっとジャック、
なにボーっとしてるのよ。
あんたもちゃんと応援して！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Hey Jack, don't just sit there!
Cheer them on!

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry. Guess I was distracted by all
your cheering.
fields.JP:
ああ、うん。ごめん。
親指姫があんまり一生懸命だから、
つい見ちゃってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry. Guess I was distracted by all
your cheering.

fields.EN:
Huh? What gives? It's not like I invented
the pep rally.
fields.JP:
へっ？　な、なによ、わたしなんか
見たって面白くもなんともないでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What gives? It's not like I invented
the pep rally.

fields.EN:
Mm... I don't care if it's unoriginal.
I just can't stop watching you.
fields.JP:
うーん、面白いとか面白くない
とかじゃなくて、気がついたら
君に目が行っちゃうっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm... I don't care if it's unoriginal.
I just can't stop watching you.

fields.EN:
(Did that corny line just come out of my
mind?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、今、何気にクサいこと
　言っちゃったかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did that corny line just come out of my
mind?)

fields.EN: What is with you today? Cheeseball!
fields.JP:
なな、なにクサいこと言ってるのよ！
まったく……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What is with you today? Cheeseball!

fields.JP: う、やっぱりクサかったか……

fields.EN:
Anyway, get off your butt and cheer! Gooo!
Go, go, go, go, goooo!
fields.JP:
そ、それより応援よ、応援！
いっけーいけいけいけいけけつこー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, get off your butt and cheer! Gooo!
Go, go, go, go, goooo!

fields.EN: Oh, we get the next serve! Quiet!
fields.JP: あっ、次、うちのサーブよ！　静かに！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, we get the next serve! Quiet!

fields.EN:
(Seems like she's more into the game than
hanging out with me.)
fields.JP:
（バレーの応援ばっかりで、
　ほとんど構ってもらえない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like she's more into the game than
hanging out with me.)

fields.EN:
(I thought this would be more of a date,
but I was wrong.)
fields.JP:
（ちょっとはデートみたいな感じに
　なるかなぁ、なんて期待してたけど、
　考えが甘かった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought this would be more of a date,
but I was wrong.)

fields.EN: ...Well, I fell for Oyayubihime precisely because she gives her club activities everything she's got.
fields.JP:
……まぁ、部活にも一生懸命な親指姫
だからこそ、好きになったんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pure passion for her hometeam...
Now that's what I like about her.

fields.EN:
Are you talking again? You're being a
little weirdo again, aren't you?
fields.JP:
なにか言った？
……っていうか、またわたしのこと
見てたでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you talking again? You're being a
little weirdo again, aren't you?

fields.EN:
Sorry. It's hard not to stare every time
you lead the cheer.
fields.JP:
ごめん。なんていうか、
本当に全力で応援してるのが伝わってきて、
いいなーって思ってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. It's hard not to stare every time
you lead the cheer.

fields.EN:
And...that means? We need to work on your
game etiquette.
fields.JP:
な、なによそれ。
まぁ、褒め言葉として受け取っておくけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And...that means? We need to work on your
game etiquette.

fields.EN:
I thought you joined the volleyball to grow
taller, so this is a surprise.
fields.JP:
背を伸ばすことがバレーボール部に
入った一番の目的だと思ってたから、
ちょっと意外だったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you joined the volleyball to grow
taller, so this is a surprise.

fields.EN:
I told you before, dummy! It's not about
getting taller, I just like the sport!
fields.JP:
前にも言ったでしょ！
今は純粋にスポーツとして
バレーボールが好きなの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you before, dummy! It's not about
getting taller, I just like the sport!

fields.EN:
Sure it might have started out that way,
but not anymore.
fields.JP:
たしかに始めたきっかけは、
背が伸びればいいなって気持ちだったわ。
でも、今はそんなの二の次よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure it might have started out that way,
but not anymore.

fields.EN:
Once I started, I couldn't stop! I might not
be a starter, but I love it all the same.
fields.JP:
いざやり始めたら、バレーに夢中に
なっちゃった。レギュラーにはなれなくても、
応援するだけでも楽しいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I started, I couldn't stop! I might not
be a starter, but I love it all the same.

fields.EN: Besides, I have you with me today.
fields.JP:
そ、それに、今日はあんたも
来てくれてるし……
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides, I have you with me today.

fields.EN:
Even though I'm not playing, being able to
enjoy the game from these stands with you
is just as exciting.
fields.JP:
試合には出れなくても、あんたが
隣にいるんだって思うと、
いつもよりテンション上がっちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even though I'm not playing, being able to
enjoy the game from these stands with you
is just as exciting.

fields.EN:
(Is that confirmation that she's happy I'm
here? Be still my beating heart...)
fields.JP:
（つまり、僕が来たから嬉しいってこと？
　そんなこと言われると、なんだか、
　けっこう、すごく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that confirmation that she's happy I'm
here? Be still my beating heart...)

fields.JP:
は？　ちょ、え、いきなり
なに言ってるのよ！

（って、今日謝ってばかりじゃないか？
　僕……）

fields.EN:
I get distracted when you call me cute.
It affects my cheers.
fields.JP:
か、かわいいとか言われたら変に
意識しちゃうでしょ。緊張して応援に
集中できなくなったらどうするのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get distracted when you call me cute.
It affects my cheers.

fields.JP:
あーもうっ、とにかく変なこと言ってる暇が
あったら、あんたもしっかり応援するのよ！
いいわね？

わ、わかった。
がんばれー、血高ー！

fields.EN: Phew, we did it! We crushed our opponents!
fields.JP:
あーよかったー！
今日の試合、血高の圧勝だったわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew, we did it! We crushed our opponents!

fields.EN: Yeah. All thanks to your rousing support.
fields.JP: うん。きっと君の応援のおかげだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. All thanks to your rousing support.

fields.EN: No. it's 100% down to our tacts.
fields.JP: いや、１００パーうちの学校の実力でしょ
fields.LOCALIZED: No. it's 100% down to our tacts.

fields.EN: Do you find my pragmatism off-putting?
fields.JP:
……こういうこと言うなんて、
かわいくない奴だって思った？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you find my pragmatism off-putting?

fields.EN: Not at all. If anything, I'm used to it by now.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。
それに、親指姫がそういう言い方をするのは
今に始まったことじゃないしね
fields.LOCALIZED: Not at all. If anything, I'm used to it by now.

fields.EN:
Sorry for being so blunt. I appreciate you
trying to cheer, so I'll let it slide.
fields.JP:
悪かったわね、ツンツンしてて。
まぁ後半はあんたもしっかり応援してくれたし、
それに免じて許してあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for being so blunt. I appreciate you
trying to cheer, so I'll let it slide.

fields.EN:
Oh, this is your house. My place is in the
other direction, so see ya.
fields.JP:
……あ、もうあんたの家に着いちゃったわね。
わたしの家あっちだから、ここまででいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, this is your house. My place is in the
other direction, so see ya.

fields.EN:
No, I'll walk you. I can't let you go off by
yourself.
fields.JP:
ううん、このまま送っていくよ。
夜道を女の子一人なんて危ないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'll walk you. I can't let you go off by
yourself.

fields.EN: Huh? You don't have to. Don't be paranoid.
fields.JP:
へ？　そ、そんなことしなくていいわよ。
心配性なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? You don't have to. Don't be paranoid.

fields.EN: Hey, I insist. You can never be too careful.
fields.JP:
駄目だよ。送ってく。
君は女の子なんだから、
もっと警戒心を持たないと
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, I insist. You can never be too careful.

fields.EN:
Careful, huh? Thanks for the offer, but
I don't need a bodyguard.
fields.JP:
警戒心って言われてもねぇ……。
気持ちはありがたいけど、
わたしは本当に一人でも大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Careful, huh? Thanks for the offer, but
I don't need a bodyguard.

fields.EN:
Please. I can't let you go alone. Who knows
if someone's out there. Better to be safe
than sorry.
fields.JP:
いや、そういうわけにはいかないよ。
物騒なことも多いんだし、
用心に越したことはない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please. I can't let you go alone. Who knows
if someone's out there. Better to be safe
than sorry.

fields.EN: I said it's fine! Lay off!
fields.JP:
だから、いいって、言ってるでしょ！！
しつこいわよ、もう！
fields.LOCALIZED: I said it's fine! Lay off!

fields.EN:
Besides, anything that happens to me isn't
your fault. So you don't have to go out of
your way.
fields.JP:
仮にわたしになにかあったって
あんたのせいじゃないのに、なんで送って
いくなんて面倒なことしたがるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, anything that happens to me isn't
your fault. So you don't have to go out of
your way.

fields.JP: そんなの、親指姫が好きだからに決まってる！

fields.EN:
I worry because I love you and I want to
be with you. Isn't that normal?
fields.JP:
好きだから心配もするし、
少しでも一緒にいたいって思う。
当たり前だろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I worry because I love you and I want to
be with you. Isn't that normal?

fields.EN: Then I'll say it too! I love you!
fields.JP:
な、なら言わせてもらうけどね！
わたしだってあんたのことが好きなのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then I'll say it too! I love you!

fields.EN:
I love you, but the last thing I want in my
relationship is to be treated with kid gloves,
got it?!
fields.JP:
好きだからこそ、いちいち家まで送らないと
いけない面倒な奴とか思われたくないの！！
わかった！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you, but the last thing I want in my
relationship is to be treated with kid gloves,
got it?!

fields.EN:
...Man, we're a couple of cheeseballs
aren't we?
fields.JP:
……僕達、だいぶ恥ずかしいこと
言い合ってなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Man, we're a couple of cheeseballs
aren't we?

fields.JP: う……冷静になってみると、そうかも

fields.EN: You hear that? Was that an argument?
fields.JP: なんだなんだ？　喧嘩か？
fields.LOCALIZED: You hear that? Was that an argument?

fields.JP: わ、どうしよう、誰か来る！
ひとまず僕の家に入ろう。さあ、早く！

fields.EN: You've got some nosy neighbors, don't you?
fields.JP:
あんたの近所の人、野次馬根性
丸だしみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED: You've got some nosy neighbors, don't you?

fields.EN:
(Mom and Dad are on vacation, and Rapunzel's
off at camp.)
fields.JP:
（そういえば今日、父さんと母さんは
　旅行で留守だったな。ラプンツェルも
　合宿に行くとか言ってたっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mom and Dad are on vacation, and Rapunzel's
off at camp.)

fields.EN:
(Hey... Does that mean I'm alone with
Oyayubihime tonight...?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　まさか今、この家に
　親指姫と僕の二人きり……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hey... Does that mean I'm alone with
Thumbelina tonight...?)

fields.EN:
We only hid inside in case of emergency,
but I'll take you home later!
fields.JP:
あ、あの、緊急避難で僕の家に入っちゃった
けど、あとでちゃんと送ってくから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We only hid inside in case of emergency,
but I'll take you home later!

fields.EN: The person we saw earlier will probably head home as soon as they realize no one's here!
fields.JP:
たぶんさっきの人も、誰もいないって
わかったらすぐ家に戻るだろうし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My neighbors should head back to their
houses any time now!

fields.EN:
If you're so adamant about taking me home,
I would rather stay here...
fields.JP:
送られるくらいなら、ここで、
もっとあんたと一緒に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're so adamant about taking me home,
I would rather stay here...

fields.EN:
What am I saying?! I can't seem to get my
thoughts straight when I'm with you.
fields.JP:
って、わたしってばなに言ってんのかしら！
なんかあんたといると調子狂っちゃうみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
What am I saying?! I can't seem to get my
thoughts straight when I'm with you.

fields.JP: ごめん、少ししたらすぐ帰るから

fields.EN: I-I want you to be here with me too.
fields.JP: ぼ、僕も、まだ君と一緒にいたいな
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I want you to be here with me too.

fields.EN: If you...wouldn't mind, wanna see my room?
fields.JP:
その……君さえよければ、
部屋に上がっていかない？
fields.LOCALIZED: If you...wouldn't mind, wanna see my room?

fields.EN: Only if you promise no funny business.
fields.JP: ……変なことしないでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED: Only if you promise no funny business.

fields.JP:
ぷっ、ふふふっ、そんな慌てないでよ。
ちょっとからかっただけ
で、でも、別にあんたとなら……

fields.EN:
Anyways, sure! I'll see your room. I've
never seen a boy's room before.
fields.JP:
と、とにかく！　お言葉に甘えて、
部屋にお邪魔しようかしらね。
男の子の部屋って初めてだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyways, sure! I'll see your room. I've
never seen a boy's room before.

fields.EN:
But if your room's filthy, then I'm gonna
punch you.
fields.JP: あ。でも部屋が汚かったらぶっ飛ばすわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if your room's filthy, then I'm gonna
punch you.

fields.EN: It should be fine... I think.
fields.JP: たぶん大丈夫だよ。……たぶん
fields.LOCALIZED: It should be fine... I think.

fields.EN:
Hehe. You have to pass my inspection.
Prepare yourself!
fields.JP:
ふふっ、それならわたしが判定してあげる。
覚悟しておくことね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. You have to pass my inspection.
Prepare yourself!

fields.EN:
This might be my first time seeing Jail Tower
up close.
fields.JP:
へー、監獄塔ってこんなに
まじまじと見たの初めてかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
This might be my first time seeing Jail Tower
up close.

fields.EN:
Thanks for coming, Akazukin-san.
Are you done with your disciplinary committee
work?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん、来てくれてありがとう。
風紀委員の仕事はもういいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my first time. You done with student
body stuff?

fields.JP:
うん、今日の分はチャチャっと
終わらせてきちゃったから

fields.EN: So what is this place? It sounds creepy.
fields.JP:
それで、用ってなに？
こんなところに呼び出されると、
なんか緊張するんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED: So what is this place? It sounds creepy.

fields.EN: Oh, right. I wanted to tell you how I feel.
fields.JP:
ああ、うん。……僕の気持ちについて、
聞いてほしいと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, right. I wanted to tell you how I feel.

fields.EN:
How you feel? Need to get something off
your chest? Don't worry, I'll never tell!
fields.JP:
気持ち？　あ、もしかして悩み事の
相談とか？　だったら任せて。
こう見えて口硬いから、あたし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How you feel? Need to get something off
your chest? Don't worry, I'll never tell!

fields.EN:
Yeah. You're easygoing, Akazukin-san, but you're
serious about things like that.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
赤ずきんさんはおおらかだけど、
そういうところは真面目だもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I like you earnest and laidback you
are about everything.

fields.EN: Oh yeah, keep up the praise!
fields.JP: うんうん、もっと褒めて！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh yeah, keep up the praise!

fields.EN:
You're always straightforward, hardworking,
and kind... It's because you're that kind of
person, Akazukin-san, that I...
fields.JP:
いつもまっすぐで、一生懸命で、
優しくて……。そういう赤ずきんさんだから、
僕は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're one of the nicest, hardest-working
people I know, and that's why...

fields.EN:
I was drawn to you as a friend, but I got
to thinking that maybe you're more special
to me than that.
fields.JP:
最初は先輩とか友だちとして、
憧れてたんだと思う。でもいつの間にか、
もっと特別な存在になっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was drawn to you as a friend, but I got
to thinking that maybe you're more special
to me than that.

fields.EN:
Hold on! Wait, what?! What's this about?
What do you mean?
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待って！　え？　なに？
それってどういうこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on! Wait, what?! What's this about?
What do you mean?

fields.EN:
S-So... what I'm saying is that I love you,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
だ、だから、僕は赤ずきんさんのことが
好きってこと……です
え……、それってもしかして……

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
（うぅ、改めて確認されると
　余計に恥ずかしい……）

fields.EN: Um. I beg you to reconsider.
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. I beg you to reconsider.

fields.EN:
I'm older than you, and I'm not too girly.
I might not be your type.
fields.JP:
だってあたし、年上だよ？
それにあんまり女の子っぽくないし……。
ジャックならもっと他にいい子がいるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm older than you, and I'm not too girly.
I might not be your type.

fields.EN: (Did she reject me? Is this how that feels?)
fields.JP:
（これってつまり、遠回しに断られた？
　フラれたってこと……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Did she reject me? Is this how that feels?)

fields.EN:
Right... Sorry. Guess I should've read the
room a little more, huh?
fields.JP:
そっか……ごめん。僕に告白されたって、
迷惑なだけだったかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right... Sorry. Guess I should've read the
room a little more, huh?

fields.EN: What? No, I didn't say that.
fields.JP: え？　いや、なんでそうなるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What? No, I didn't say that.

fields.EN:
Maybe to you, Akazukin-san, I'm just an
unreliable junior...
fields.JP:
たしかに赤ずきんさんからすれば、
僕はただの頼りない後輩なのかも
しれないね……

fields.EN:
No! That's not what I mean! I actually think
highly of you too.
fields.JP:
ち、違うよ！　そんなことない！
あたしだってジャックのこと、
意識したことないわけじゃないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! That's not what I mean! I actually think
highly of you too.

fields.EN: But when Jack confessed to me, I could only think he'd lost his mind.
fields.JP:
でもジャックがあたしに告白するなんて、
血迷ったとしか思えなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED: But I thought you were mad for liking me.

fields.EN:
No boy has ever said he loves me before.
So I began to worry...if I was unlovable.
fields.JP:
男の子から好きだなんて言われたのも
初めてだし、本当にあたしでいいのかな
って……不安で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No boy has ever said he loves me before.
So I began to worry...if I was unlovable.

fields.EN: Akazukin-san, is that really what you thought?
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、そんなこと思ってたの？

fields.EN: This is very important to me.
fields.JP:
む。そんなことじゃないよ。
すごく重要なことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: This is very important to me.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. My feelings for you are real,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
心配しなくても、赤ずきんさんを
好きなこの気持ちは本物だよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry. My feelings are real.

fields.EN: Oh, I'm sorry. But am I really worthy of you..?
fields.JP:
あ……、ごめん。
でも、本当にあたしでいいのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I'm sorry. But am I really worthy of you..?

fields.EN: Because if we date, I'm a handful.
fields.JP:
だってあたし、ジャックと付き合ったりしたら、
たぶんすごく甘えちゃうと思うよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Because if we date, I'm a handful.

fields.EN:
I'm not gonna be the same cool
upperclassman, am I?
fields.JP:
お姉さんっぽくなくなっちゃっても、
いいの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not gonna be the same cool
upperclassman, am I?

fields.EN:
Whether that's okay or not, Akazukin-san, I'm not
asking you to act like an older sister.
fields.JP:
いいもなにも、赤ずきんさんには
お姉さんっぽさなんて求めてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That has nothing to do with how I feel
about you.

fields.EN: Oof, then tell me how you really feel.
fields.JP: それはそれで失礼じゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oof, then tell me how you really feel.

fields.EN:
S-Sorry. That's not what I meant. I wanted to say
I didn't fall for you because you seemed like an
older sister, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめん。そうじゃなくて、
赤ずきんさんがお姉さんっぽいから好きに
なったわけじゃないって言いたかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I didn't mean it like that. I just
mean I didn't fall for you because you
were cool or older.

fields.EN:
I-If you want to lean on me, Akazukin-san, you
can. I'd actually be happy if you did...
fields.JP:
あ、赤ずきんさんが僕に
甘えたいなら、甘えていいよ。
むしろ甘えてもらえたら嬉しいかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you ever need me, I'm here. In fact,
I'd be more than happy to.

fields.EN:
I promise I'll become someone you can rely on
without worry, Akazukin-san. So... will you go
out with me?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんが安心して甘えられるような、
そんな男になるって約束する。
だから僕と付き合ってくれないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll try my best to become someone you can
rely on. So how about a date?

fields.JP:
わ……わかった。
そこまで言ってくれるなら……
いいの？　ありがとう……！

あたしを選んでくれて、
ありがとね！

fields.EN:
(Today's my first date with Akazukin-san.
We found a cute dress while browsing.
fields.JP:
（今日は赤ずきんさんとの初デート。
　ウィンドウショッピングしていたら、
　服屋さんでかわいい服を見つけた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Today's my first date with Red Riding Hood.
We found a cute dress while browsing.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san wanted to try it on,
so I'm waiting for her in the dressing room.)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんがその服を着てみたいと
　言ったので、試着室から出てくるのを
　待っているわけだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood wanted to try it on,
so I'm waiting for her in the dressing room.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yeah... But I'm starting to have second
thoughts.
fields.JP:
う、うん……。
でも、やっぱり見せるのやめようかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... But I'm starting to have second
thoughts.

fields.JP: どうして？　見てみたいな

fields.EN: Yeah right. Okay then, here goes...
fields.JP:
そうだね。ジャックが笑うわけないもんね。
……わかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah right. Okay then, here goes...

fields.JP:
（か、かわいい……！
　なんか普通にすごくかわいい！）

fields.EN:
You got quiet. Girly clothes don't suit me, 
do they?
fields.JP:
だって、黙り込んじゃったから……。
こんな女の子っぽい恰好、
あたしには似合わないよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You got quiet. Girly clothes don't suit me, 
do they?

fields.EN:
No, of course not! Sorry. I was so surprised
that I couldn't help staring.
fields.JP:
そんな、まさか！
ごめん。あんまり驚いて、
つい見とれちゃったんだ
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
You're lying... You didn't say anything
cause it looked bad.
fields.JP:
うそ……。ノリでこんな格好したから、
引いちゃったんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're lying... You didn't say anything
cause it looked bad.

fields.EN:
I swear! If anything I'm just speechless
from how pretty you look. You could
wear anything you like.
fields.JP:
そんなわけないよ。
普段と全然雰囲気が違ってびっくりした。
そういう恰好も似合うんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I swear! If anything I'm just speechless
from how pretty you look. You could
wear anything you like.

fields.JP: すごくかわいいよ、赤ずきんさん
fields.LOCALIZED: You're a cutie pie, Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san?! Pretty daring to hug
me in this outfit.
fields.JP:
あ、赤ずきんさん！？
抱き付くなんて、だ、大胆……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood?! Pretty daring to hug
me in this outfit.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Well, pardon me for being happy!
fields.JP: だって、すっごく嬉しかったんだもん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, pardon me for being happy!

fields.EN:
I've been told I look cool before, but
never cute, so...
fields.JP:
あたし、かっこいいって言われることは
よくあるけど、かわいいなんて言われたこと
なかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been told I look cool before, but
never cute, so...

fields.EN:
You're the cutest, Akazukin-san.
Dresses might just be your new thing.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんはかわいいよ。
女の子らしい恰好もよく似合ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the cutest, Red Riding Hood.
Dresses might just be your new thing.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I-I'm happy too. Someone as c-cute as you,
Akazukin-san, became my girlfriend...
fields.JP:
その……僕も嬉しいな。
赤ずきんさんみたいな、か、かわいい人が、
恋人になってくれたなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy too. How lucky am I to have such
a pretty girlfriend like you?

fields.JP: わっ、な、なに？　いきなり大声出して

fields.EN: You know, you're smoother than you think.
fields.JP:
ジャックって、たまにちょっと
天然タラシなとこあるよね
fields.LOCALIZED: You know, you're smoother than you think.

fields.EN:
But save those sweet nothings for me.
Not for other women...
fields.JP:
あたしには言っていいけど、
あんまり他の女の子にそういう発言
したら駄目なんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But save those sweet nothings for me.
Not for other women...

fields.EN: Don't give them the wrong impression.
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't give them the wrong impression.

fields.JP: も、もしかして……やきもち？

fields.EN:
Yes, I am. I'm your girlfriend, so let it slide.
Okay?
fields.JP:
そ、そうだよ。
だってジャックはあたしの恋人なんだから、
ちょっとくらいいいでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I am. I'm your girlfriend, so let it slide.
Okay?

fields.EN:
Your eyes should be on ME, or else I'll get
jealous. Understand?
fields.JP:
あたしのことちゃんと見ててくれないと、
今みたいにまたやきもち焼いちゃうからね。
わかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your eyes should be on ME, or else I'll get
jealous. Understand?

fields.EN:
(Still, having Akazukin-san get jealous over me
is kind of nice. Hehe...)
fields.JP:
（でも、赤ずきんさんに
　やきもち焼いてもらえるって
　いいものだなぁ。ふふ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(For some reason, I don't mind dating
a jealous-type. Heh...)

fields.EN:
You called me cute, but you also seem
way cooler than before.
fields.JP:
あたしのことかわいいって言ってくれたけど、
ジャックも、なんか……
前よりかっこよく見えるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You called me cute, but you also seem
way cooler than before.

fields.JP: えっと、じゃあ服着替えて来るね！

fields.EN: (I think my heart just skipped a beat.)
fields.JP:
（ふ、不意打ちであんなこと言われると、
　心臓に悪い……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I think my heart just skipped a beat.)

fields.EN: Haaa, it was so fun today!
fields.JP: はー、今日は楽しかったー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Haaa, it was so fun today!

fields.EN:
Yeah it was. We did a lot of walking.
How are you feeling?
fields.JP:
本当だね。
けっこうあちこち歩いて回ったけど、
疲れなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah it was. We did a lot of walking.
How are you feeling?

fields.JP:
あれ、大丈夫？　元気なさそうだけど、
やっぱり疲れちゃった？

fields.EN:
Thanks for your concern. Just surprised I
let my true colors show today.
fields.JP:
心配してくれて、ありがと。
でもそうじゃないよ。今日は素の自分が
出ちゃって、自分でも驚いたっていうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for your concern. Just surprised I
let my true colors show today.

fields.EN:
Bet you've noticed by now that I like to be
pampered. Is that different from what you're
used to?
fields.JP:
今日一日でわかったと思うけど、
あたしってけっこう甘えたがりで、
かわいい物好きで……イメージと違ったでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bet you've noticed by now that I like to be
pampered. Is that different from what you're
used to?

fields.EN:
You probably never noticed this side to me
before, so I'm afraid you'll be disappointed.
fields.JP:
ジャックはこういうあたしを知っていて
告白してくれたわけじゃないから、
幻滅されてないかな、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You probably never noticed this side to me
before, so I'm afraid you'll be disappointed.

fields.EN:
(That's nothing to worry about. I guess
everyone has their insecurities.)
fields.JP:
（そんなことを心配していたんだ。
　自信がないところもあるんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's nothing to worry about. I guess
everyone has their insecurities.)

fields.EN:
It was a little surprising. I thought, "So this is
what Akazukin-san is really like. I never knew."
fields.JP:
たしかにちょっと意外だったな。
赤ずきんさんってこういう人だったんだ、
知らなかったなー、って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Somewhat surprising, but I chalked it up
to getting to know you better.

fields.EN: And it only made me like you more.
fields.JP: そ、そうしたら、もっと好きになったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: And it only made me like you more.

fields.EN:
I like the usual you too, Akazukin-san, but I
also think you're cute when you lean on me or
get embarrassed.
fields.JP:
普段の赤ずきんさんもいいけど、
甘えたり照れたりする赤ずきんさんも
かわいくて、僕は好きだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't get me wrong. I like everything about
you. But I sorta like your coy, girly side.
It's cute.

fields.EN:
And if that's something for my eyes only,
then I count myself lucky.
fields.JP:
僕だけにそういう顔を見せてくれるん
だとしたら、すごく嬉しい
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if that's something for my eyes only,
then I count myself lucky.

fields.EN:
(So cute... She's grabbing my arm! Keep it,
together man!)
fields.JP:
（かわいい……。
　っていうか、腕に柔らかい感触が！
　いちいち動揺するな！　落ち着け、僕！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So cute... She's grabbing my arm! Keep it,
together man!)

fields.EN:
You've worked hard all this time as everyone's
older sister, Akazukin-san. I think it's okay for
you to lean on someone more.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんはみんなのお姉さんとして
今までがんばってきたんだから、
もっと甘えてもいいと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You work so hard to be a great role model
at school, but with me, you can relax.

fields.EN:
At least with me, I'd be happy if you showed me
the real you, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、僕には本当の赤ずきんさんを
見せてくれたら嬉しいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can at least show me the real you
when we're together, I'd be thrilled.

fields.EN:
(M-Maybe I said something pretty bold. But
Akazukin-san showed me her true self, so I have
to respond in kind.)
fields.JP:
（け、けっこう大胆なこと言っちゃったかも。
　でも赤ずきんさんは本当の自分を見せて
　くれたんだから、僕もそれに応えないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did I say too much? ...But if she's being
her true self, then I should too.)

fields.EN:
I'm happy we're together Jack. I can't
believe this is happening.
fields.JP:
ジャックと付き合えてよかった。
こうして二人で一緒にいられるなんて、
まだ信じられないくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy we're together Jack. I can't
believe this is happening.

fields.EN:
I don't wanna go home tonight. I want to
stay with you.
fields.JP:
なんか……今夜は帰りたくないな。
もっとジャックと一緒にいたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna go home tonight. I want to
stay with you.

fields.EN: Ah... What am I saying? Saying that would only put you in a difficult position, Jack.
fields.JP:
あ……やだ、あたしってばなに言ってるんだろ。
そんなこと言ったらジャックを困らせちゃう
だけなのに
fields.LOCALIZED: What am I saying? I know that's a lot.

fields.EN: Hahaha, sorry. That was a joke.
fields.JP: あはは、ごめんね。今の冗談だから
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha, sorry. That was a joke.

fields.EN: Um, I...I want to be with you too.
fields.JP: え、えっと、僕もまだいたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, I...I want to be with you too.

fields.EN:
To be honest... I want to spend more time with
you too, Akazukin-san. Is that okay?
fields.JP:
その……正直に言えば、
僕ももっと赤ずきんさんと一緒にいたい。
駄目かな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, I never want you to leave.
Is that okay?

fields.JP: じゃあ、このままどこか行っちゃおうか

fields.EN: (I was so restless that I came way earlier than the time we agreed on. Still, I guess it's better to arrive first and wait...)
fields.JP:
（なんだか落ち着かなくて、
　約束の時間よりだいぶ早めに来ちゃったな。
　でも先に来て待っているほうが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm a little early, but it's always good to
be prompt.)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
You're here already? It's much earlier
than the time I wrote.
fields.JP:
もう来てたの？
手紙に書いた約束の時間より
だいぶ早いけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're here already? It's much earlier
than the time I wrote.

fields.EN:
Well, I was terrified of being late.
Had to play it safe.
fields.JP:
だって、絶対に遅れたくなかったので。
なにかトラブルがあって遅刻しちゃったら
大変じゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was terrified of being late.
Had to play it safe.

fields.EN:
Just imagining that I might keep you waiting,
Jack-san, makes me feel terribly guilty...
fields.JP:
もしも万が一ジャックさんを待たせて
しまったらと思うと、考えただけでも
申し訳なくて、申し訳なくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The thought of keeping you waiting made
my heart ache.

fields.JP: （心配性だなぁ。でも白雪姫らしいや）

fields.EN:
Thanks for meeting me. Did the letter
catch you off-guard.
fields.JP:
えっと、改めて、今日は来てくれて
ありがとう。突然手紙で呼び出したりして、
驚かせちゃった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for meeting me. Did the letter
catch you off-guard.

fields.EN: Y-Yes, slightly, but not to worry...
fields.JP:
は、はい。ちょっと驚きましたけど、
でも……大丈夫です
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-Yes, slightly, but not to worry...

fields.EN: Okay, good. I wanted to tell you something.
fields.JP:
そっか、よかった……。
今日は白雪姫に話したいことがあったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, good. I wanted to tell you something.

fields.EN:
(Okay, just play it cool. Remember what
you rehearsed. Remember...)
fields.JP:
（よし、ここまでは大丈夫だ。
　落ち着いて言えばいい。
　落ち着いて、落ち着いて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Okay, just play it cool. Remember what
you rehearsed. Remember...)

fields.EN: I-If you wouldn't be opposed, wanna date?
fields.JP:
あ、あのさ。もしよければ、
僕と付き合ってくれないかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I-If you wouldn't be opposed, wanna date?

fields.JP: 実は僕、前から君のことが……
わわっ、白雪姫が倒れたー！？

fields.EN: You okay? You fainted all of a sudden.
fields.JP:
あ、気がついた？
急に倒れちゃったから心配したよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You okay? You fainted all of a sudden.

fields.EN: I'm sorry. I had the most wondrous dream.
fields.JP:
す、すみません……。
なにか衝撃的なことがあったようで、
ありえない夢を見ていました……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry. I had the most wondrous dream.

fields.EN:
A convenient dream where you confessed your love
to me, Jack-san... It felt so real, almost like
reality.
fields.JP:
白雪がジャックさんに告白される
なんていう、都合のいい夢です……。
まるで現実のようにリアルな夢で
fields.LOCALIZED:
A dream where you confessed your love
for me. It all seemed so real.

fields.JP: いや、そ、その、夢じゃないから

fields.EN: Not a dream? What was it, a hallucination?
fields.JP:
夢じゃない……？
ということは、白雪の妄想？
それとも幻覚でしょうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Not a dream? What was it, a hallucination?

fields.EN: No, it was all real. I confessed my feelings.
fields.JP:
そうじゃなくて、現実。
さっき僕は白雪姫に告白したんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it was all real. I confessed my feelings.

fields.EN: Wha... Huh? That was all real?
fields.JP:
え……っ、え？
じゃあ、さっきのは本当に……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha... Huh? That was all real?

fields.EN: Yes, I will say it again. I love you.
fields.JP: うん。改めて言うけど、僕は君が好きなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I will say it again. I love you.

fields.JP:
……っ！？
そ、そんなのおかしいです……！

fields.EN:
I'm not thin, and I'm a klutz. How could
someone possibly love me!
fields.JP:
白雪はぽっちゃり系だし、いつも
ドジばっかりだし……。それなのに
告白されるなんて、おかしいです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not thin, and I'm a klutz. How could
someone possibly love me!

fields.EN: You're lying! This is a mix-up!
fields.JP:
嘘です！　絶対になにかの間違いに
決まってます……！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're lying! This is a mix-up!

fields.EN:
(I can't believe she has such low self-
esteem...)
fields.JP: （こんなに自己評価が低いなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't believe she has such low self-
esteem...)

fields.JP:
白雪姫は、その、こ、告白されて
嫌だった……？

そんな、まさか！　むしろ……っ、
白雪は……

fields.EN:
So it wasn't a dream. Perhaps someone
else would suit you more.
fields.JP:
……本当に、夢じゃなかったんですね。
でも、白雪なんかじゃ……もったいないです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it wasn't a dream. Perhaps someone
else would suit you more.

fields.EN:
There are so many slim, wonderful girls out there.
Someone like Shirayuki isn't good enough for
you, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
他にスリムで素敵な女の子は
たくさんいるのに、白雪なんかじゃ、
ジャックさんに釣り合いません……
fields.LOCALIZED: Slimmer, prettier girls. I'm not worthy...

fields.JP:
それこそ間違いだよ。
君は十分素敵な女の子だと思う

fields.EN:
At first it was your kindness that caught
my eye, and also your conviction.
fields.JP:
白雪姫のおっとりした雰囲気も、
優しいところも、意外と意志が強いところも、
少しずつ惹かれていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first it was your kindness that caught
my eye, and also your conviction.

fields.EN:
I guess I realized I wanted to know
you better.
fields.JP:
それで、できればもっと一緒にいたいと
思うようになっていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I realized I wanted to know
you better.

fields.EN:
...The truth is, Shirayuki has been thinking
about you too, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
……本当は、白雪もジャックさんのことが
気になってたんです

fields.EN:
Might be weird to put it this way, but
I always felt you were out of my league.
fields.JP:
それなのに、高嶺の花だからって
最初から諦めていて……。男性に
高嶺の花なんて言い方、おかしいですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might be weird to put it this way, but
I always felt you were out of my league.

fields.JP:
でも白雪にとっては、
まさにそんな感じだったんです

fields.EN:
So Jack-san, you just made me the happiest girl
alive.
fields.JP:
あの……、ジャックさん。
告白してもらえて、とっても嬉しかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Jack, you just made me the happiest girl
alive.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: If you wouldn't mind, how about a date?
fields.JP:
白雪でいいなら、お付き合いして
いただけますか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: If you wouldn't mind, how about a date?

fields.JP:
ありがとう……！
これからよろしく、白雪姫

fields.EN: Thank you for liking me back too!
fields.JP:
は、はい。ふつつか者ですが、
よろしくお願いします……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you for liking me back too!

fields.EN:
(Today I'm assisting Shirayukihime with
her science project. I wonder what it'll
be.)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫に頼まれて、科学部の実験に
　助手として付き合うことになった。
　でもどんな実験をするんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Today I'm assisting Snow White with
her science project. I wonder what it'll
be.)

fields.EN: Thanks for all your help, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
今日は助手役を快く引き受けてくださって、
ありがとうございます。ジャックさん
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks for all your help, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: No problem. I'd never say no to you.
fields.JP: いいんだよ。白雪姫の頼みだからね
fields.LOCALIZED: No problem. I'd never say no to you.

fields.EN:
(Besides, when she relies on me even for little
things, it makes me happy because I feel like
her boyfriend...)
fields.JP:
（それに些細なことでも頼ってもらえると、
　彼氏って感じがして嬉しいし……）
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: So what are we going to do today?
fields.JP: それで、今日はなにをするの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So what are we going to do today?

fields.EN: Making a slime out of detergent gel.
fields.JP:
はい、洗濯のりでスライムを
作ろうと思います
fields.LOCALIZED: Making a slime out of detergent gel.

fields.EN:
Slime? Well, hopefully it's safer than
that...poison thing.
fields.JP:
スライム？　またずいぶんと安全……いや、
平和的な物を作るんだね。
いつかのポイズンなんとかと比べると
fields.LOCALIZED:
Slime? Well, hopefully it's safer than
that...poison thing.

fields.EN:
