You mean Poison Bomb. I opted for something
better, but the club rejected it.
fields.JP:
ポイズン・ボムですね。白雪も本当は
もっと面白い実験をしたいんですけど、
科学部の方針で却下されちゃいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean Poison Bomb. I opted for something
better, but the club rejected it.

fields.EN:
Today's experiment is practice for next
year's recruitment demo.
fields.JP:
今日の実験は、来年の新入部員勧誘のときに
実演するための実験、その予行演習なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Today's experiment is practice for next
year's recruitment demo.

fields.EN: Ahh, I see. Then it has to be safe.
fields.JP:
ああ、なるほど。
それなら安全なやつじゃないとね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ahh, I see. Then it has to be safe.

fields.EN:
But don't you think an experiment with
higher impact attracts more people?
fields.JP:
でもやっぱりインパクトのある実験のほうが、
新入部員が集まると思いませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't you think an experiment with
higher impact attracts more people?

fields.EN:
I think we should make Poison Bomb
instead of slime...
fields.JP:
スライム作りはやめて、
今からでもポイズン・ボム・ハイパーの
実験及び実演に変更したほうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think we should make Poison Bomb
instead of slime...

fields.JP: 僕はスライム作りのほうがいいと思うなぁ！

fields.EN: Yup! Easier AND safer for beginners!
fields.JP:
うん。スライムなら安全だし、
面白いし、素人にも簡単だし、
なにより安全だからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Easier AND safer for beginners!

fields.EN:
If you say so, Jack-san... all right. I'll stick
with the original plan and make slime after all.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがそう言うなら……。
わかりました。やっぱり最初の方針通り、
スライム作りをしますね
fields.LOCALIZED: If you say so. Then slime it is.

fields.JP: うんうん、それがいいよ

fields.EN:
(Making something dangerous for a demo
is a recipe for disaster.)
fields.JP:
（部員勧誘で危険物を作らせたら
　大変なことになるもんな。
　阻止できてよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Making something dangerous for a demo
is a recipe for disaster.)

fields.EN: Let us begin. Could you hand me that bottle?
fields.JP:
では、さっそく実験を始めますね。
まずはそっちのビーカーを取ってくれますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Let us begin. Could you hand me that bottle?

fields.JP: あわわっ、す、すみませんっ！
ふぅ、危うくビーカーを落とすところだったね

fields.EN:
(Oh, I grabbed her hand along with the
bottle.)
fields.JP:
（あ、しまった。勢いでビーカーごと
　白雪姫の手を握っちゃってた！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I grabbed her hand along with the
bottle.)

fields.EN:
Oh no, it's okay. Thanks to you, it didn't
break.
fields.JP:
い、いえ、お、おかげさまで、
落とさずに、す、済みましたっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no, it's okay. Thanks to you, it didn't
break.

fields.JP: 白雪姫、緊張しすぎだよ。大丈夫？

fields.EN: Totally... I was just unprepared for that.
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫です……。
ちょっと心の準備ができていなくて、
動揺してしまって
fields.LOCALIZED: Totally... I was just unprepared for that.

fields.EN:
I think anyone would be startled by
a sudden touch.
fields.JP:
だって好きな人の手がいきなり
触れたりしたら、誰だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think anyone would be startled by
a sudden touch.

fields.EN:
(I don't think she realizes that she's thinking
aloud.)
fields.JP:
（わりと恥ずかしい本音が口から
　出ちゃってるけど。無自覚かな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't think she realizes that she's thinking
aloud.)

fields.EN: (I think I am getting nervous too...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだかつられて僕まで緊張してきた。
　手が汗ばんで……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I think I am getting nervous too...)

fields.JP: あれ……？　いったい……　あっ！
気がついた？　白雪姫

fields.EN:
Ah...! Jack-san, did you shield Shirayuki...?
A-Are you hurt?
fields.JP:
あ……！　ジャックさん、白雪を庇って……？
け、怪我はされてませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh...! Was it you who saved me? Are you hurt?

fields.EN:
I'm okay. The blast was huge, but doesn't
seem to be much impact. How are you?
fields.JP:
平気だよ。爆発音はすごかったけど、
衝撃自体はそれほどじゃなかったから。
君こそ怪我はない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm okay. The blast was huge, but doesn't
seem to be much impact. How are you?

fields.EN: I-I'm okay. I was just a little surprised by the position we're in...
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫です。
ちょっとこの体勢に驚いちゃっただけで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I'm okay. Just frightened by the explosion.

fields.EN: Good... But how would slime explode?
fields.JP:
よかった。それにしても、
スライム作りでどうして爆発なんか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Good... But how would slime explode?

fields.EN:
It wasn't supposed to, but I think I accidentally
made a Poison Bomb...
fields.JP:
本当はあそこで爆発するはずじゃ
なかったんですけど……失敗しちゃいました。
スライム・ボム作り……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't supposed to, but I think I accidentally
made a Poison Bomb...

fields.EN: You just can't let it go, huh...
fields.LOCALIZED: You just can't let it go, huh...

fields.EN:
Forgive me, Jack-san. I wanted to prove to
you I could do it, but I failed...
fields.JP:
すみません……。ジャックさんに
いいところを見せたいと思ったんですけど、
完全に裏目に出ちゃいました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forgive me, Jack. I wanted to prove to
you I could do it, but I failed...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: I always do this. A good-for-nothing klutz.
fields.JP:
白雪はいつもこうなんです。
ドジで抜けてて駄目な子で……
fields.LOCALIZED: I always do this. A good-for-nothing klutz.

fields.EN:
Don't be so hard on yourself. I probably
just made you nervous.
fields.JP:
そんなに自分を責めないで。
僕がいたせいで緊張させちゃった
せいもあると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be so hard on yourself. I probably
just made you nervous.

fields.EN:
Can you stand? Watch out, there's broken
glass.
fields.JP:
それより、立てる？
あ、そこビーカーの破片が散ってるから、
気をつけて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you stand? Watch out, there's broken
glass.

fields.JP: は、はい。ありがとうございます……

fields.EN: Something smells funny. Is it toxic?
fields.JP:
ところでなんか変な臭いが漂ってるけど、
これって有害物質じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Something smells funny. Is it toxic?

fields.EN:
Better to circulate the air regardless.
Let's turn on the fan.
fields.JP:
でも換気したほうがよさそうですね。
換気扇をつけないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Better to circulate the air regardless.
Let's turn on the fan.

fields.JP: じゃあ、僕は扉を開けてくるよ

fields.EN:
It's no use. Think it got jammed from the
explosion.
fields.JP:
……駄目だ、開かない。
さっきの爆発の衝撃で
扉が歪んじゃったみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use. Think it got jammed from the
explosion.

fields.EN:
I'd call for help, but no one's near the
third-floor classrooms at this time.
fields.JP:
助けを呼びたいけど、放課後の今の時間だと、
三階のこの教室には誰も近づかないだろうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd call for help, but no one's near the
third-floor classrooms at this time.

fields.EN: So we're trapped? What do we do?
fields.JP:
と、閉じ込められたってことですか？
どうしましょう……
fields.LOCALIZED: So we're trapped? What do we do?

fields.EN: Hmm. Security should make rounds at night, but if we're unlucky, there's a chance they won't notice us.
fields.JP:
うーん。夜になれば守衛さんが
見回りに来ると思うけど、運が悪ければ
気づいてもらえない可能性もあるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm. Security patrols come at night, but
more than likely no one's gonna notice.

fields.EN: We may have to spend the night here.
fields.JP:
最悪の場合、このままここでひと晩
過ごさなきゃいけないかもね
fields.LOCALIZED: We may have to spend the night here.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. Someone will come.
Your club convenes tomorrow, right?
fields.JP:
大丈夫、きっと誰かに見つけてもらえるよ。
少なくとも明日になれば、
科学部の部員が来るはずだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. Someone will come.
Your club convenes tomorrow, right?

fields.EN: Besides. It was a good thing I was trapped.
fields.JP:
それに、一緒に閉じ込められたのが
僕でよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides. It was a good thing I was trapped.

fields.EN: But I caused you trouble, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
でも、ジャックさんにご迷惑
かけちゃいました……
fields.LOCALIZED: But I caused trouble for you...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
It's okay. Rather you're stuck with me
than anyone else.
fields.JP:
いいって。それより白雪姫が他の誰かと
ひと晩過ごすことになったりしたら、
そっちのほうがずっと嫌だったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay. Rather you're stuck with me
than anyone else.

fields.EN:
Jack-san... I consider it a great honor to be
trapped with you.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん……。
白雪も、一緒に閉じ込められたのが
ジャックさんでよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack... I consider it a great honor to be
trapped with you.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
Even after all this, I'm not afraid when I'm with
you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
その……こんなことになっちゃったのに、
ジャックさんが一緒だと怖くないんです
fields.LOCALIZED: With you, I feel no fear at all.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
頼もしい、こ……こい、びと、が
側にいてくれるんだって、思うと……

fields.EN:
(I'm not used to being called a boyfriend.
I like it.)
fields.JP:
（恋人って改めて言われると、
　なんかこそばゆい……。でも嬉しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not used to being called a boyfriend.
I like it.)

fields.JP: 手……繋いでもいいですか？

fields.EN: Your hands are bigger than mine, Jack-san...
fields.JP: ジャックさんの手、白雪のより大きいですね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Your hands are bigger than mine...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: 白雪姫の手は小さいね

fields.EN: ...Jack-san, please take care of me tonight.
fields.JP:
……ジャックさん、今日はひと晩、
よろしくお願いします
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: こちらこそ、よろしくね

（もうすぐ約束の時間だ。
　彼女は来てくれるかな……）
眠り姫……！　来てくれたんだね

fields.EN:
I asked you here because I've got something
to tell you.
fields.JP:
今日呼んだのは、ずっと君に
言いたかったことを伝えようと
思ったからなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked you here because I've got something
to tell you.

fields.EN:
I admire how much you care for this garden.
The fruits of your labor are here for all to
see.
fields.JP:
その、眠り姫はいつも花の世話を
がんばっていたよね。風の強い日も
花壇の様子を見に行ったりして。尊敬するよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I admire how much you care for this garden.
The fruits of your labor are here for all to
see.

fields.EN: Yeah. I've been watching from upstairs.
fields.JP: うん。ずっと見てたから
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I've been watching from upstairs.

fields.EN: Ah, don't get the wrong idea. I wasn't spying on you or stalking you, okay? It's not for any weird reason, it's just...
fields.JP:
あっ、誤解しないでほしいんだけど、
別に監視とか付きまといとかじゃないよ？
変な理由じゃなくて、ただ、その……
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean, I wasn't spying. I just...

fields.JP: き、君のことが気になっちゃって……
好きなんだ。眠り姫のことが……

fields.EN: Of course, but also as a potential partner.
fields.JP:
友達としても好きだけど、
この場合はそうじゃなくて、
一人の女の子として……
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course, but also as a potential partner.

fields.EN:
I can relax around you. Another reason
I'm attracted to you.
fields.JP:
眠り姫の側では時間がゆっくり流れるような
感じがして、すごく落ち着くんだ。
そういうところにも惹かれていて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can relax around you. Another reason
I'm attracted to you.

fields.EN: If you don't mind, wanna go on a date?
fields.JP:
も、もしも迷惑じゃなければ、
僕と付き合ってもらえないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: If you don't mind, wanna go on a date?

fields.EN: (I said it! I finally said it!)
fields.JP: （言った！　僕はついに言ったぞ！！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I said it! I finally said it!)

fields.EN:
(What's the silence? Is she too upset to
respond?)
fields.JP:
（あ、あれ、なにこの沈黙。フリーズ？
　返事もできないほど困らせちゃったのか？
　それとも嫌だったとか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's the silence? Is she too upset to
respond?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe it was bad to spring it on her
because she's so mellow.)
fields.JP:
（考えてみれば、おっとりしたタイプの
　眠り姫に対して、いきなり付き合って
　ほしいなんてまずかったかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it was bad to spring it on her
because she's so mellow.)

fields.EN:
Sorry. I didn't mean to impose. I might've
forced these feelings onto you.
fields.JP:
あー、ごめん。困らせるつもりは
なかったんだ。自分の気持ちばっかり
押し付けちゃったよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I didn't mean to impose. I might've
forced these feelings onto you.

fields.JP: 好き……、ボクも……。驚いただけ……

ん……。ジャック、いつも優しい……。
それで……

fields.EN: Um, uh...sorry...I don't know what to say...
fields.JP:
あ……えと……ごめんなさい……。
いい言葉、なくて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, uh...sorry...I don't know what to say...

fields.EN: Don't worry. What you said means so much.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。
眠り姫ががんばって伝えてくれた言葉が、
僕にとっては一番の言葉なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry. What you said means so much.

fields.JP:
ん……ありがと……。
やっぱり、優しい……

fields.EN:
Nemurihime, I finished that section
of the garden.
fields.JP:
眠り姫、あっちの花壇の花殻は
全部摘み終わったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty, I finished that section
of the garden.

fields.EN:
(I'm helping her tend the flower bed
today. I kinda dig this.)
fields.JP:
（今日は眠り姫の手伝いで花壇を
　手入れしている。土いじりなんて
　久しぶりだけど、けっこう楽しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm helping her tend the flower bed
today. I kinda dig this.)

fields.JP: 次はなにをすればいい？

fields.EN: Okay, gotta water them. Be right back.
fields.JP:
わかった。ジョウロで水をやれば
いいんだね。ちょっと行ってくる
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, gotta water them. Be right back.

fields.JP: （？　眠り姫、一人でなにか言ってる……）

きれいに咲いたね。
がんばったね……いい子……

fields.EN: You are still a bud... Take your time.
fields.JP:
……君は、まだつぼみ……。
でも、大丈夫。ゆっくりでいい……
fields.LOCALIZED: You are still a bud... Take your time.

fields.EN: (She's talking to the flowers. How sweet.)
fields.JP:
（花に話しかけてるのか。
　やっぱり優しい子だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's talking to the flowers. How sweet.)

fields.EN:
(She looks like a fair with all these flowers
around her. Ugh, my fantasy mind!)
fields.JP:
（こうして花に囲まれてる姿を見ると、
　なんだか花の妖精のような……って、
　なにその恥ずかしいファンシー思考！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks like a fair with all these flowers
around her. Ugh, my fantasy mind!)

fields.EN:
(Flowers really do suit her. Yeah.
She still looks sleepy as ever, but her expression
seems a little softer too...)
fields.JP:
（でも花が似合うのは本当だよね。うん。
　それに相変わらず眠そうだけど、
　心なしか表情も柔らかいし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But there's something whimsical to her.
Sleepy as usual, but with a soft face.)

fields.EN:
Nemurihime, I finished watering.
I'll go here.
fields.JP:
眠り姫、こっちの水やりは終わったよ。
そっちに戻るね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty, I finished watering.
I'll go here.

fields.EN: You're right! I almost stepped on it.
fields.JP:
わっ、本当だ！
危うく踏むところだった……
fields.LOCALIZED: You're right! I almost stepped on it.

fields.JP:
ん……。そこ、危ない。
こっちに移動……

（あ、わざわざミミズを移動させて
　あげるんだ……）

fields.EN: Sorry. I was staring, wasn't I?
fields.JP:
ああ、ごめん。
つい、じっと見ちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry. I was staring, wasn't I?

fields.EN:
You're even kind to worms, not just flowers.
I thought girls didn't like bugs.
fields.JP:
花だけじゃなく、ミミズにまで
優しいんだなぁって感心してた。
普通、女の子は怖がりそうなものなのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're even kind to worms, not just flowers.
I thought girls didn't like bugs.

fields.EN:
Worms fertilize soil... Good soil means
happy flowers...
fields.JP:
ミミズ、土、耕してくれる……。
いい土、花も喜ぶ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worms fertilize soil... Good soil means
happy flowers...

fields.JP: でも、そうじゃなくても、小さい命……大事

fields.EN:
(She doesn't normally say this much.
Guess she's a big floral fan.)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、眠り姫がこんなに
　話すって珍しいな。やっぱり好きな花に
　関することだと饒舌になるのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't normally say this much.
Guess she's a big floral fan.)

fields.EN:
Of course not. You're a gardener, so I imagine
you're used to them by now.
fields.JP:
全然変じゃないよ。眠り姫は花壇の
世話をしてるんだから、こういう虫にも
慣れていて当然だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. You're a gardener, so I imagine
you're used to them by now.

fields.EN: You're the kindest girl on the planet.
fields.JP:
虫だからって嫌ったりしない、
そんな優しい君が僕は好きだな
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the kindest girl on the planet.

fields.EN: Mm... Thank you... Jack is kind...
fields.JP:
ん……、ありがと……。
ジャックも、優しい……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... Thank you... Jack is kind...

fields.EN:
(Wow. The passion! We're already going
out, but she keeps stealing my heart!)
fields.JP:
（わわ、情熱的！
　一応付き合ってはいるけど、こうして
　改めて言われるとドキドキする……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow. The passion! We're already going
out, but she keeps stealing my heart!)

fields.JP: ど、どうしたの？　急に

fields.EN: I like Jack and flowers. Important...
fields.JP: ジャックと花、好き……。大事……
fields.LOCALIZED: I like Jack and flowers. Important...

fields.EN:
Oh, ah... So you like me as much as you
like flowers, is that it?
fields.JP:
え、えーと……、僕と花が同じように好きで、
大事だから、ずっと一緒にいたい、ってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, ah... So you like me as much as you
like flowers, is that it?

fields.EN: So you said it out loud.
fields.JP: だから、つい言っちゃったわけか
fields.LOCALIZED: So you said it out loud.

fields.JP: でも、ジャックのほう、もっと……好き

fields.EN: (I think my voice cracked. Nice one, Jack.)
fields.JP: （声が裏返ってしまった。かっこ悪い……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I think my voice cracked. Nice one, Jack.)

fields.JP: （……でも、ま、笑ってくれたからいいか）

fields.EN:
Wow. She fell asleep walking. Wake up,
Nemurihime, almost home.
fields.JP:
うわ、歩きながら寝ちゃった。
眠り姫、起きて。家までがんばって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. She fell asleep walking. Wake up,
Sleeping Beauty, almost home.

fields.EN:
It's no use. She's out. Guess she can nap at
mine.
fields.JP:
駄目だ、起きない……。仕方ないな。
僕の家が近いから、少し休ませるか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no use. She's out. Guess she can nap at
mine.

fields.EN:
(I carried her all the way here, but...
she really does sleep soundly...)
fields.JP:
（……と、おぶって来たわけだけど。
　本当によく寝てるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I carried her all the way back. They don't
call her Sleeping Beauty for nothing...)

fields.EN:
(Having a girl napping in my room makes
nervous. Don't try anything, okay?)
fields.JP:
（自分の部屋で女の子が寝息立ててると、
　なんだかそわそわしちゃうな。
　いや、下心なんてないけどね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Having a girl napping in my room makes
nervous. Don't try anything, okay?)

fields.JP: （って、誰に言い訳してるんだ……？）

fields.EN: Don't worry. This is my room.
fields.JP: ああ、心配しないで。ここは僕の部屋だから
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry. This is my room.

fields.EN: You fell asleep, so I wanted to let you rest.
fields.JP:
眠り姫が帰り道で寝ちゃったから、
ひとまずここで休ませてから
送ろうと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED: You fell asleep, so I wanted to let you rest.

fields.JP:
い、言っておくけど、
別に変なことはしてないからねっ
（なんか墓穴掘りに行った感が……）

fields.EN: Really? It's just an ordinary bed...
fields.JP: そ、そう？　ごく普通のベッドだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? It's just an ordinary bed...

fields.EN: It smells like Jack... It calms me...
fields.JP:
ジャックのにおい、いっぱい……。
安心……
fields.LOCALIZED: It smells like Jack... It calms me...

fields.JP:
（不意打ちでそういうこと言うの、
　反則だって……）

植物、たくさん……。
よく、寝れる……

fields.EN:
You mean you sleep best when you're
near lots of plants?
fields.JP: 植物がたくさんあると、よく眠れるってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean you sleep best when you're
near lots of plants?

fields.EN: (I wonder if there's science behind that.)
fields.JP:
（果たしてそれは寝心地がいいもの
　なんだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wonder if there's science behind that.)

fields.EN: This is good... Jack and plants...
fields.JP:
ここも……いい……。
ジャックと植物、一緒……
fields.LOCALIZED: This is good... Jack and plants...

fields.EN: So like plants, I help you sleep?
fields.JP:
僕も植物と一緒で、安眠効果があるって
ことか……？　なんか変なの
fields.LOCALIZED: So like plants, I help you sleep?

fields.EN: Haha. I guess I'm like a plant?
fields.JP:
はは、それじゃ僕が植物の括りに
入っちゃってるみたいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. I guess I'm like a plant?

fields.JP:
……次、起きたとき、最初に……
ジャックの顔……見たい……

fields.EN: (She fell asleep again. And she's got my hand in a tight grip, so I can't exactly move carelessly...)
fields.JP:
（また寝ちゃった。
　しかも手でがっちり捕まって、
　下手に動けないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She knocked out again. She's
holding my hand for dear life.)

fields.EN:
(B-Being close enough to feel her breath is
dangerous in all sorts of ways...! But even if I
tried to wake her, she probably wouldn't wake up...)
fields.JP:
（こ、この息がかかりそうな距離感は
　いろいろまずい……！　でも起こそうと
　したって起きないだろうし……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (We're so close... I can't wake her up.)
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
(I have no choice but to distract myself
so I don't have lewd thoughts. Clear my
mind, go to bed.)
fields.JP:
（うぅ、仕方ない。煩悩を消すんだ。
　心を無にして、僕も寝てしまおう。
　それしかない！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have no choice but to distract myself
so I don't have lewd thoughts. Clear my
mind, go to bed.)

fields.JP: それが、僕が最初に抱いた感想だった。

fields.EN: In reality, the sky wasn't coming down—we were the ones getting closer to it.
fields.JP:
実際のところ空は降りて来ているのではなく
僕らの方が空に近づいているんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I was quickly proven wrong; we had
finally reached the tip of the sky itself.

fields.EN:
With Hikari's power, our bodies ascended,
lifting up towards our destination.
fields.JP:
ヒカリの力でふわりと浮かび上がった僕らの身体は
ゆっくり、ゆっくりと上昇していく
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Hikari's power, our bodies ascended,
lifting up towards our destination.

fields.EN: Below us, I saw it shrinking in the distance.
fields.JP:
それにつれて、僕たちが過ごした場所が
足下で小さくなっていくのが見える
fields.LOCALIZED: Below us, I saw it shrinking in the distance.

fields.JP: そこは監獄──ジェイルと呼ばれていた。

fields.EN: The Jail was Hell in every sense.
fields.JP: ジェイルは本当に地獄だった
fields.LOCALIZED: The Jail was Hell in every sense.

fields.EN:
A cesspool where our dignity wouldn't
last. Each day brought turmoil and grief
for the fallen.
fields.JP:
人の尊厳が犯され、踏みにじられ、足蹴にされ
毎日たくさんの命が無為に散っていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
A cesspool where our dignity wouldn't
last. Each day brought turmoil and grief
for the fallen.

fields.EN: I've lost count of how many people we lost.
fields.JP:
あそこでいったい何人が犠牲になったのか、
想像もつかない
fields.LOCALIZED: I've lost count of how many people we lost.

fields.EN:
Even so, those trapped within Jail's
horrific walls never lost hope.
fields.JP:
それでもジェイルに囚われた僕たちは必死に足掻き、
何度も挫けそうになりながら、それでも諦めず
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, those trapped within Jail's
horrific walls never lost hope.

fields.EN:
At last, we reached it... The core tower.
Where gruesome Nightmares were born.
fields.JP:
ついにはジェイルの中心──
悪夢の生まれるあの塔の頂上に辿り着いた
fields.LOCALIZED:
At last, we reached it... The core tower.
Where gruesome Nightmares were born.

fields.EN: Awaiting our arrival was a cruel truth.
fields.JP:
そこで待っていたのは僕たちにとっては
過酷な真実だった
fields.LOCALIZED: Awaiting our arrival was a cruel truth.

fields.EN:
Our nemesis, Snark, who was responsible
for years of suffering, was none other than
the Professor, a man we greatly admired.
fields.JP:
長きに渡って苦しめられた最悪の敵──
『スナーク』の正体は、僕らが信頼する博士だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our nemesis, Snark, who was responsible
for years of suffering, was none other than
the Professor, a man we greatly admired.

fields.EN:
The Order of the Sun, along with the Dawn,
were nothing more than chess pieces for the
Professor's convoluted game.
fields.JP:
ジェイルに暮らす人々の希望だったタイヨウ教団も
黎明解放戦線もすべては博士の計画だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Order of the Sun, along with the Dawn,
were nothing more than chess pieces for the
Professor's convoluted game.

fields.EN:
It was all for the white core―a vessel for
Witchcraft. It grants its bearer unlimited
power, where one can even create "God."
fields.JP:
すべては白い核──ウィッチクラフトを手に入れるため。
願いを現実にする力で『神』を作り出すこと──
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was all for the white core―a vessel for
Witchcraft. It grants its bearer unlimited
power, where one can even create "God."

fields.JP: ウィッチクラフト、とてつもない力だった

fields.EN:
It could alter the world, even rewind time.
Something only a god could do.
fields.JP:
時を巻き戻すように世界を塗りかえる。
まさに神様にしかできないようなことができてしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could alter the world, even rewind time.
Something only a god could do.

fields.EN:
That's why I have two sets of memories.
Same time, same place.
fields.JP: だから僕には同じ時間、同じ場所で２つの記憶がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I have two sets of memories.
Same time, same place.

fields.EN:
My first memories are from when I was human.
And the other set comes from...when I was
a monster, a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
１つめは人間としての記憶。
もう１つは、ナイトメア──化け物としての記憶
fields.LOCALIZED:
My first memories are from when I was human.
And the other set comes from...when I was
a monster, a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
I became a Nightmare and plotted my
escape from Jail alongside Tsuu and
Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
かつてナイトメアだった僕はつうと人魚姫さんの
２人とともにジェイルからの脱獄を目指していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I became a Nightmare and plotted my
escape from Jail alongside Otsuu and
Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It was a timeline where Tsuu rejected
Ningyohime-san's death and pleaded with
the white core to rewrite the world...
fields.JP:
そこは人魚姫さんの死を拒絶したつうが、
白い核──ウィッチクラフトに願い、
書き換えた世界だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a timeline where Otsuu rejected
Little Mermaid's death and pleaded with
the white core to rewrite the world...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
However, the world which awaited us
at the end of her wish proved to be
anything but a happy ending for them.
fields.JP:
だけど、そんな願いの果てに辿り着いた世界は
２人にとって幸せな場所じゃなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, the world which awaited us
at the end of her wish proved to be
anything but a happy ending for them.

fields.EN: Tsuu had no choice but to undo her wish.
fields.JP: 結局、つうは自ら願った世界を否定するしかなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu had no choice but to undo her wish.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Fate is cruel, relentless. This was especially
true for the Jail.
fields.JP:
運命はいつだって過酷で容赦がない。
このジェイルではとくにそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fate is cruel, relentless. This was especially
true for the Jail.

fields.EN:
But something must be done, or nothing
will change. The finale must come at the
end of the rising action.
fields.JP:
でも、何もしなければ変わらない。
前に進まなければ見えないものがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
But something must be done, or nothing
will change. The finale must come at the
end of the rising action.

fields.EN:
For Tsuu, at least, their wish to preserve
Ningyohime-san lives on inside me.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、つうが願った世界は、
人魚姫さんの想いは、確かに僕の中に残っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
For Otsuu, at least, their wish to preserve
Little Mermaid lives on inside me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: We can change the world. Fate isn't inescapable.
fields.JP:
世界は変えられる。
運命は決して逃れられないものじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can change the world.
But fate is inescapable.

fields.EN:
We weren't just trying to break out of the
Jail. We attempted to elude an unjust fate.
fields.JP:
僕らが脱獄するのはジェイルからじゃない。
このどうしようもなく理不尽な運命からだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We weren't just trying to break out of the
Jail. We attempted to elude an unjust fate.

fields.EN:
When at last it dawned upon me, I reunited
with Tsuu.
fields.JP:
それに気づいた時、
僕とつうは、ふたたび出会えたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When at last it dawned upon me, I reunited
with Otsuu.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
The Jail is full of mystery. It brings our
most unimagined fears to life, yet so too is
it capable of fulfilling our deepest wishes.
fields.JP:
ジェイルは本当に不思議な存在だ。
僕らを苦しめもするけど、願いを叶えもする
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail is full of mystery. It brings our
most unimagined fears to life, yet so too is
it capable of fulfilling our deepest wishes.

fields.EN:
Both Tsuu and Ningyohime-san, along
with all the others, had evaded certain
death and made it safely to the surface.
fields.JP:
つうも人魚姫さんも……そして死んだはずの
みんながこうして生きて地上に向かっている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both Otsuu and Little Mermaid, along
with all the others, had evaded certain
death and made it safely to the surface.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It was another power that the Witchcraft
had granted Hikari.
fields.JP:
それもまたウィッチクラフトが
ヒカリに与えた力でもある
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was another power that the Witchcraft
had granted Hikari.

fields.EN:
By overcoming several rings of despair,
we maintained our hope in freedom.
fields.JP:
繰り返される絶望を乗り越えて、
僕らは今、希望へと脱出しようとしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
By overcoming several rings of despair,
we maintained our hope in freedom.

fields.EN:
Of course, freedom doesn't guarantee
paradise. Jail won't go quietly.
fields.JP:
もちろん、地上が楽園とは限らない。
ジェイルはあるだろうって話も聞いている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, freedom doesn't guarantee
paradise. Jail won't go quietly.

fields.EN:
But that won't stop us in our mission.
I have no intentions of turning around.
fields.JP:
でも僕たちの上昇は止まらない。
引き返すつもりもなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that won't stop us in our mission.
I have no intentions of turning around.

fields.EN:
I'm sure my friends, the members of the
Dawn, feel the same.
fields.JP:
周りにいる仲間たち――
『黎明』のみんなも同じ気持ちだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure my friends, the members of the
Dawn, feel the same.

fields.EN: Then, a gust of wind hit my cheeks.
fields.LOCALIZED: Then, a gust of wind hit my cheeks.

fields.JP: 誰かが「地上だ！」と声をあげた

fields.EN:
Who was there? A group comprised of my
friends from the Dawn and one hundred
survivors from the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
誰だろう。ここにいるのは黎明の仲間たちと
解放区に暮らしていた１００人ほどの一般人だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who was there? A group comprised of my
friends from the Dawn and one hundred
survivors from the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Before I was born, prior to the emergence
of the Jail, I heard cities were flourished
with people.
fields.JP:
僕が生まれる前──ジェイルが出現する前には
街に人が溢れていたそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before I was born, prior to the emergence
of the Jail, I heard cities were flourished
with people.

fields.EN:
Will there come a day when we see that
again? Could we ever know peace again?
fields.JP:
また、そんな光景が見られるだろうか。
平和で安全な日々を取り戻せるだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will there come a day when we see that
again? Could we ever know peace again?

fields.EN: At the end of a tunnel, light awaits.
fields.JP: 悪いことの後には幸せが待ってる──
fields.LOCALIZED: At the end of a tunnel, light awaits.

fields.EN:
There will be challenges, but there's a
whole world out there for us. A world
worth smiling at.
fields.JP:
大変かもしれないけど、きっとみんなが
笑顔でいられる世界が待ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There will be challenges, but there's a
whole world out there for us. A world
worth smiling at.

fields.JP: 誰もが期待に胸を高鳴らせていた

fields.EN:
Seeing the sky was no longer just an
ambition. It would become our new
way of life...
fields.JP:
そこはもう見上げるだけの『空』じゃない。
僕らが生きる新しい世界だ──
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing the sky was no longer just an
ambition. It would become our new
way of life...

fields.EN:
I heard the sky was supposed to be blue,
but this one is...
fields.JP: “青空”だと聞いていたのに、この空はとても──
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard the sky was supposed to be blue,
but this one is...

fields.JP: それが、僕が最初に抱いた感想だった。

fields.EN: In reality, the sky wasn't coming down—we were the ones getting closer to it.
fields.JP:
実際のところ空は降りて来ているのではなく
僕らの方が空に近づいているんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I was quickly proven wrong; we had
finally reached the tip of the sky itself.

fields.EN:
With Hikari's power, our bodies ascended,
lifting up towards our destination.
fields.JP:
ヒカリの力でふわりと浮かび上がった僕らの身体は
ゆっくり、ゆっくりと上昇していく
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Hikari's power, our bodies ascended,
lifting up towards our destination.

fields.EN: Below us, I saw it shrinking in the distance.
fields.JP:
それにつれて、僕たちが過ごした場所が
足下で小さくなっていくのが見える
fields.LOCALIZED: Below us, I saw it shrinking in the distance.

fields.JP: そこは監獄──ジェイルと呼ばれていた。

fields.EN: The Jail was Hell in every sense.
fields.JP: ジェイルは本当に地獄だった
fields.LOCALIZED: The Jail was Hell in every sense.

fields.EN:
A cesspool where our dignity wouldn't
last. Each day brought turmoil and grief
for the fallen.
fields.JP:
人の尊厳が犯され、踏みにじられ、足蹴にされ
毎日たくさんの命が無為に散っていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
A cesspool where our dignity wouldn't
last. Each day brought turmoil and grief
for the fallen.

fields.EN: I've lost count of how many people we lost.
fields.JP:
あそこでいったい何人が犠牲になったのか、
想像もつかない
fields.LOCALIZED: I've lost count of how many people we lost.

fields.EN:
Even so, those trapped within Jail's
horrific walls never lost hope.
fields.JP:
それでもジェイルに囚われた僕たちは必死に足掻き、
何度も挫けそうになりながら、それでも諦めず
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, those trapped within Jail's
horrific walls never lost hope.

fields.EN:
At last, we reached it... The core tower.
Where gruesome Nightmares were born.
fields.JP:
ついにはジェイルの中心──
悪夢の生まれるあの塔の頂上に辿り着いた
fields.LOCALIZED:
At last, we reached it... The core tower.
Where gruesome Nightmares were born.

fields.EN: Awaiting our arrival was a cruel truth.
fields.JP:
そこで待っていたのは僕たちにとっては
過酷な真実だった
fields.LOCALIZED: Awaiting our arrival was a cruel truth.

fields.EN:
Our nemesis, Snark, who was responsible
for years of suffering, was none other than
the Professor, a man we greatly admired.
fields.JP:
長きに渡って苦しめられた最悪の敵──
『スナーク』の正体は、僕らが信頼する博士だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our nemesis, Snark, who was responsible
for years of suffering, was none other than
the Professor, a man we greatly admired.

fields.EN:
The Order of the Sun, along with the Dawn,
were nothing more than chess pieces for the
Professor's convoluted game.
fields.JP:
ジェイルに暮らす人々の希望だったタイヨウ教団も
黎明解放戦線もすべては博士の計画だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Order of the Sun, along with the Dawn,
were nothing more than chess pieces for the
Professor's convoluted game.

fields.EN:
It was all for the white core―a vessel for
witchcraft. It grants its bearer unlimited
power, where one can even create "God."
fields.JP:
すべては白い核──ウィッチクラフトを手に入れるため。
願いを現実にする力で『神』を作り出すこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was all for the white core―a vessel for
witchcraft. It grants its bearer unlimited
power, where one can even create "God."

fields.JP: それは、とてつもない力だった

fields.EN:
It could alter the world, even rewind time.
Something only a god could do.
fields.JP:
時を巻き戻し、世界を塗りかえる。
まさに神様にしかできないようなことができてしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could alter the world, even rewind time.
Something only a god could do.

fields.EN:
That's why I have two sets of memories.
Same time, same place.
fields.JP: だから僕には同じ時間、同じ場所で２つの記憶がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why I have two sets of memories.
Same time, same place.

fields.EN:
My first memories are from when I was human.
And the other set comes from...when I was
a monster, a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
１つめは人間としての記憶。
もう１つは、ナイトメア──化け物としての記憶
fields.LOCALIZED:
My first memories are from when I was human.
And the other set comes from...when I was
a monster, a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
I became a Nightmare and plotted my
escape from Jail alongside Tsuu and
Ningyohime.
fields.JP:
かつてナイトメアだった僕はつうと人魚姫の２人と
ともにジェイルからの脱獄を目指していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I became a Nightmare and plotted my
escape from Jail alongside Otsuu and
Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
It was a timeline where Tsuu rejected
Ningyohime's death and pleaded with
the white core to rewrite the world...
fields.JP:
そこは人魚姫の死を拒絶したつうが
白い核に願い、書き換えた世界だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was a timeline where Otsuu rejected
Little Mermaid's death and pleaded with
the white core to rewrite the world...
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
However, the world which awaited us
at the end of her wish proved to be
anything but a happy ending for them.
fields.JP:
だけど、そんな願いの果てに辿り着いた世界は
２人にとって幸せな場所じゃなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, the world which awaited us
at the end of her wish proved to be
anything but a happy ending for them.

fields.EN: Tsuu had no choice but to undo her wish.
fields.JP: 結局、つうは自ら願った世界を否定するしかなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu had no choice but to undo her wish.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Fate is cruel, relentless. This was especially
true for the Jail.
fields.JP:
運命はいつだって過酷で容赦がない。
このジェイルではとくにそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fate is cruel, relentless. This was especially
true for the Jail.

fields.EN:
But something must be done, or nothing
will change. The finale must come at the
end of the rising action.
fields.JP:
でも、何もしなければ変わらない。
前に進まなければ見えないものがある
fields.LOCALIZED:
But something must be done, or nothing
will change. The finale must come at the
end of the rising action.

fields.EN:
For Tsuu, at least, their wish to preserve
Ningyohime lives on inside me.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、つうが願った世界は、
人魚姫の想いは、確かに僕の中に残っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
For Otsuu, at least, their wish to preserve
Little Mermaid lives on inside me.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: We can change the world. Fate isn't inescapable.
fields.JP:
世界は変えられる。
運命は決して逃れられないものじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can change the world.
But fate is inescapable.

fields.EN:
We weren't just trying to break out of the
Jail. We attempted to elude an unjust fate.
fields.JP:
僕らは脱獄するのはジェイルからじゃない。
このどうしようもなく理不尽な運命からだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We weren't just trying to break out of the
Jail. We attempted to elude an unjust fate.

fields.EN:
When at last it dawned upon me, I reunited
with Tsuu.
fields.JP:
それに気づいた時、
僕とつうは、ふたたび出会えたんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
When at last it dawned upon me, I reunited
with Otsuu.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
The Jail is full of mystery. It brings our
most unimagined fears to life, yet so too is
it capable of fulfilling our deepest wishes.
fields.JP:
ジェイルは本当に不思議な存在だ。
僕らを苦しめもするけど、願いを叶えもする
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail is full of mystery. It brings our
most unimagined fears to life, yet so too is
it capable of fulfilling our deepest wishes.

fields.EN:
Both Tsuu and Ningyohime, along
with all the others, had evaded certain
death and made it safely to the surface.
fields.JP:
つうも人魚姫も……そして死んだはずのみんなが
こうして生きて地上に向かっている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both Otsuu and Little Mermaid, along
with all the others, had evaded certain
death and made it safely to the surface.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: That, too, is a power the Jail's white core granted Hikari.
fields.JP:
それもまたジェイルの、
白い核がヒカリに与えた力でもある
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was another power that the Witchcraft
had granted Hikari.

fields.EN:
By overcoming several rings of despair,
we maintained our hope in freedom.
fields.JP:
繰り返される絶望を乗り越えて、
僕らは今、希望へと脱出しようとしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
By overcoming several rings of despair,
we maintained our hope in freedom.

fields.EN:
Of course, freedom doesn't guarantee
paradise. Jail won't go quietly.
fields.JP:
もちろん、地上が楽園とは限らない。
ジェイルはあるだろうって話も聞いている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, freedom doesn't guarantee
paradise. Jail won't go quietly.

fields.EN:
But that won't stop us in our mission.
I have no intentions of turning around.
fields.JP:
でも僕たちの上昇は止まらない。
引き返すつもりもなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that won't stop us in our mission.
I have no intentions of turning around.

fields.EN:
I'm sure my friends, the members of the
Dawn, feel the same.
fields.JP:
周りにいる仲間たち――
『黎明』のみんなも同じ気持ちだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure my friends, the members of the
Dawn, feel the same.

fields.EN: Then, a gust of wind hit my cheeks.
fields.LOCALIZED: Then, a gust of wind hit my cheeks.

fields.JP: 誰かが「地上だ！」と声をあげた

fields.EN:
Who was there? A group comprised of my
friends from the Dawn and one hundred
survivors from the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
誰だろう。ここにいるのは黎明の仲間たちと
解放区に暮らしていた１００人ほどの一般人だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who was there? A group comprised of my
friends from the Dawn and one hundred
survivors from the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Before I was born, prior to the emergence
of the Jail, I heard cities were flourished
with people.
fields.JP:
僕が生まれる前──ジェイルが出現する前には
街に人が溢れていたそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before I was born, prior to the emergence
of the Jail, I heard cities were flourished
with people.

fields.EN:
Will there come a day when we see that
again? Could we ever know peace again?
fields.JP:
また、そんな光景が見られるだろうか。
平和で安全な日々を取り戻せるだろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Will there come a day when we see that
again? Could we ever know peace again?

fields.EN: At the end of a tunnel, light awaits.
fields.JP: 悪いことの後には幸せが待ってる──
fields.LOCALIZED: At the end of a tunnel, light awaits.

fields.EN:
There will be challenges, but there's a
whole world out there for us. A world
worth smiling at.
fields.JP:
大変かもしれないけど、きっとみんなが
笑顔でいられる世界が待ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There will be challenges, but there's a
whole world out there for us. A world
worth smiling at.

fields.JP: 誰もが期待に胸を高鳴らせていた

fields.EN:
Seeing the sky was no longer just an
ambition. It would become our new
way of life...
fields.JP:
そこはもう見上げるだけの『空』じゃない。
僕らが生きる新しい世界だ──
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing the sky was no longer just an
ambition. It would become our new
way of life...

fields.EN: What the...? What is going on?
fields.LOCALIZED: What the...? What is going on?

fields.EN:
My princess, look away! This is...
This is so...!
fields.JP:
見ちゃダメだ、姫！
こんな……こんな……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess, look away! This is...
This is so...!

fields.EN:
Everywhere we looked, there were
dead bodies. We couldn't have seen
it from underground.
fields.JP:
どこを見ても死体の山か。
地下でもこれほどの数は見たことがないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everywhere we looked, there were
dead bodies. We couldn't have seen
it from underground.

fields.EN:
What the hell? No one warned us about
this!
fields.JP:
冗談じゃねぇ。
こんなの聞いてねえぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the hell? No one warned us about
this!

fields.EN:
Are you okay, Nemurihime? It's okay.
Close your eyes. Get some rest.
fields.JP:
大丈夫、眠り姫？　ほら、目をつぶって。
少し休んでた方がいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you okay, Sleeping Beauty? It's okay.
Close your eyes. Get some rest.

fields.EN:
I thought by now I'd be used to seeing
corpses, but this stench is gonna make
me sick.
fields.JP:
死体には慣れたつもりだったけどよ
さすがにこの匂い、吐きそうだぜ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought by now I'd be used to seeing
corpses, but this stench is gonna make
me sick.

fields.EN:
The sky is red and hazy.
What does it mean, Jack-san?
fields.JP:
真っ赤に曇った空……
それがどうしたの？　ジャックさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sky is red and hazy.
What does it mean, Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
違う……！
曇っているんじゃない！　これは……！

fields.EN:
It's so tall, but its shadow is taller.
How big can it be...?
fields.JP:
あんなに遠くにあるのにここまで影が落ちてる。
なんて大きさだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's so tall, but its shadow is taller.
How big can it be...?

fields.EN:
The underground Jail's almost cute in
comparison.
fields.JP: 地下の監獄塔がかわいく、見えるぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The underground Jail's almost cute in
comparison.

fields.EN:
Wait, is that Jail floating? How does that
even work? Do those ivies have something
to do with it?
fields.JP:
しかもあの監獄塔は浮いているのか……？
どういう原理だ。あのツタが関係しているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, is that Jail floating? How does that
even work? Do those ivies have something
to do with it?

fields.EN:
What are we to do? Maybe we should
investigate.
fields.JP:
みんな、これからどうする？
少し辺りを調べてみるべきかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are we to do? Maybe we should
investigate.

fields.EN:
Itsuki, stand back. Unless you'd like to join
that pile of corpses.
fields.JP:
下がっておれ、イツキ。
あの山の一部になりたくないのならな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki, stand back. Unless you'd like to join
that pile of corpses.

fields.JP: そ、それはどういう意味だい……？

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious? These bodies didn't fall
here naturally.
fields.JP:
考えてみれば当然だ。
死体が自然に積み上がるわけがない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious? These bodies didn't fall
here naturally.

fields.EN:
Take a look. It looks like an offering to
the Jail tower.
fields.JP: 見なよ、まるで監獄塔への捧げ物みたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take a look. It looks like an offering to
the Jail tower.

fields.EN:
An offering, huh. Makes sense.
Perhaps that girl had something to do with it.
fields.JP:
捧げ物か。なるほど確かに。
では、それをやったのはあそこの連中であろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
An offering, huh. Makes sense.
Perhaps that girl had something to do with it.

fields.EN:
Doesn't look like she's just passing by.
She's wearing machine armor with blue
flames.
fields.JP:
でも、普通の女の子のわけがないよね。
機械の鎧に青い炎か……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't look like she's just passing by.
She's wearing machine armor with blue
flames.

fields.EN: Oh, that's peculiar. She looks like us...
fields.JP: でも、どうしてかな。わたしたちに似てる……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, that's peculiar. She looks like us...

fields.JP: おい！　１人こっちに来るぞ……！

fields.EN:
Apologies for the sudden intrusion.
I am Guillotine of the Genocide Pink.
fields.JP:
突然のところ失礼致します。
私、処刑台少女のギロチンと申します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Apologies for my sudden intrusion.
My name is Guillotine, the scaffold
of Massacre Pink.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology; B12 P0 Guillotine introduction restored from JP

fields.EN:
Genocide Pink...?
That is quite an ominous name.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女……？
随分と物騒な名前だな
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink introduction follow-up restored from JP

fields.EN:
I believe there to be a girl named Alice
among your ranks. Would you mind
identifying her for me?
fields.JP:
この中にアリスという方が
いらっしゃると思うのですが、
いったいどなたでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe there to be a girl named Alice
among your ranks. Would you mind
identifying her for me?

fields.EN: How does she know Alice's name?
fields.JP: どうして初対面の君がアリスの名前を……？
fields.LOCALIZED: How does she know Alice's name?

fields.JP: アリス、何だか怪しい。下がってて
なるほど。あなたがそうですか

fields.EN: What the—?! She moved in a blink!
fields.JP:
なっ……！？
一瞬で移動した……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What the—?! She moved in a blink!

fields.JP: あなたがアリスですね？
だ……だったら何だって言うのよ

fields.EN:
Well, a case of mistaken identity would
spell trouble for us both.
fields.JP:
よかった、間違っていたら
どうしようかと思いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, a case of mistaken identity would
spell trouble for us both.

fields.EN:
What a relief to have found you. Well then,
the rest of you, I bid adieu.
fields.JP:
確認できて本当によかったです。
それでは、それ以外はさようなら
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a relief to have found you. Well then,
the rest of you, I bid adieu.

fields.EN:
I just finished tidying up.
There's always light work for idle hands.
fields.JP:
まったく掃除を終えたばかりだというのに、
ゴミというのはすぐに沸いてきますね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just finished tidying up.
There's always light work for idle hands.

fields.EN: Stop it! Why are you doing this to us?!
fields.JP:
やめなさい！
何でいきなりこんなことをするの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop it! Why are you doing this to us?!

fields.JP: と、とにかく止めないと！

fields.EN:
Hold on, Jack! She's too dangerous for
just you!
fields.JP:
待つんだジャック！
君１人では危険すぎる！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on, Jack! She's too dangerous for
just you!

fields.EN:
L-Look at her speed! N-Not faster than
me of course! But wow, she's quick!
fields.JP:
な、なんて速さだ！
もちろん我ほどではないがな！
でもやっぱり速すぎる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
L-Look at her speed! N-Not faster than
me of course! But wow, she's quick!

fields.JP: だ、誰か助け──ぎゃあああああっ

fields.EN: Goodness, garbage is noisy even when it dies!
fields.JP: 本当に、ゴミは死ぬ時も五月蠅いですね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Goodness. Time to take out the garbage!

fields.EN:
Shoot! She's going berserk! My princess,
stay back! Your life depends on it!
fields.JP:
くそっ、手当たり次第か！
姫、下がって！　巻き込まれる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! She's going berserk! My princess,
stay back! Your life depends on it!

fields.JP:
でも、おつうちゃん！
みんなが、みんなが……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 次のゴミはあなたですねえええええっ！
邪魔しないでくれます？
おつうちゃん、わたしも戦うよ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Princess, watch out! This bastard is no
ordinary foe!
fields.JP:
姫、気をつけて！
こいつ、並の相手じゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, watch out! This bastard is no
ordinary foe!

fields.EN:
Ugh... I hate when prey resists.
Would you just shut up and take it?
fields.JP:
ちっ……ゴミはゴミらしくさっさと
朽ち果てればいいものを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh... I hate when prey resists.
Would you just shut up and take it?

fields.EN:
How dare you treat our lives like junk...
I'll never forgive the likes of you!
fields.JP:
人の命をゴミ扱いする……
君のような人を、僕は許さない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you treat our lives like junk...
I'll never forgive the likes of you!

fields.EN: Forgive? Why would I need your forgiveness?
fields.JP:
許さない？
なら、力づくで止めてみますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Forgive? Why would I need your forgiveness?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: What are you doing to Otsuu-chan?!
fields.JP: おつうちゃんに何するの！
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you doing to Otsuu?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
She should have minded her business.
I'll save her for later.
fields.JP:
出しゃばらなければいいものを。
まあ、いずれにせよ殺しますが
fields.LOCALIZED:
She should have minded her business.
I'll save her for later.

fields.JP: なんなんだ……こいつらのこの力は……

fields.EN: The Marchens never prepared us for this...
fields.JP: メルヒェンなんか比べものにならない……
fields.LOCALIZED: The Marchens never prepared us for this...

fields.JP: ひいいいっ！　に、逃げろっ！

fields.EN:
My. While I was distracted from taking
out the trash, the others ran off.
fields.JP:
……ふぅ、ゴミに関わってる間に他のゴミどもが
逃げ出してしまったじゃありませんか
fields.LOCALIZED:
My. While I was distracted from taking
out the trash, the others ran off.

fields.EN: It seems my method of disposal is inefficient.
fields.JP: あっちもお掃除してまいりましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED: It seems my method of disposal is inefficient.

fields.EN: No... You can't! She'll kill everyone!
fields.JP:
ダメよ……そんな……
どんどん殺されていっちゃう……！
fields.LOCALIZED: No... You can't! She'll kill everyone!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Those girls are targeting everyone
who's fleeing!
fields.JP: あの子たち、逃げる人から率先して殺してる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those girls are targeting everyone
who's fleeing!

fields.EN: They're trying to clean out the place!
fields.JP: 本当に“掃除”のつもりなんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: They're trying to clean out the place!

fields.JP: （しかも、なんてひどい殺し方なんだ……）

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: ジャック、覚悟を決めよう

fields.EN:
We may not win, but we can't let them
get away with murder.
fields.JP:
勝てないかもしれない。
それでも、みんなが殺されるのを見過ごせない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We may not win, but we can't let them
get away with murder.

fields.EN:
Hoped you'd say that! I was getting tired
of watching.
fields.JP:
よくぞ言った！
いいかげん我も我慢の限界だったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hoped you'd say that! I was getting tired
of watching.

fields.EN:
Escape might be possible if we divert
one's attention.
fields.JP: １人を集中して攻撃すればいけるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Escape might be possible if we divert
one's attention.

fields.EN:
Stopping them now might be tough, but
at least we can buy the others time. Let's go.
fields.JP:
たとえ勝てなくても、みんなを逃がす時間は
稼げるかもしれないよね……がんばる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stopping them now might be tough, but
at least we can buy the others time. Let's go.

fields.EN: Oh, where are you off to?
fields.JP: あら、どちらに行かれるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, where are you off to?

fields.EN:
Honestly, do you think any of you stand
a chance against me?
fields.JP: もしかして、全員でかかれば私を倒せると？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, do you think any of you stand
a chance against me?

fields.EN:
My, my. Saving you for later must have given
you false hope. Forgive me.
fields.JP:
これはこれは、後回しにしたせいで希望を持たせて
しまったようですみませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, my. Saving you for later must have given
you false hope. Forgive me.

fields.EN: Leave the waste disposal to me.
fields.JP:
ちゃんとあなたたちゴミの処分は
引き受けさせて頂きますので
fields.LOCALIZED: Leave the waste disposal to me.

fields.EN:
(I'm getting the chills! She wasn't at full
power this whole time?!)
fields.JP:
（なんだ、この寒気……！
　今まで本気ですらなかった……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm getting the chills! She wasn't at full
power this whole time?!)

fields.EN:
I...couldn't get one measly hit in.
What do I do?!
fields.JP:
この我がまともに一撃も
入れられなかったなど、どうすれば……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I...couldn't get one measly hit in.
What do I do?!

fields.EN: We all risked our lives...to come this far.
fields.JP:
みんなで死ぬ思いをして、
やっとここまで来たっていうのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: We all risked our lives...to come this far.

fields.EN:
Tch. Surely you should be dead by now.
Perhaps you aren't trash. More like roaches.
fields.JP:
ちっ……殺したと思ったのにまだ生きてるなんて
ゴミじゃなくてゴキブリの集まりかよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch. Surely you should be dead by now.
Perhaps you aren't trash. More like roaches.

fields.EN:
Oh, dear me. Pardon my manners,
I needn't fret over this.
fields.JP:
おっといけません。
私としたことが、この程度で取り乱すなど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, dear me. Pardon my manners,
I needn't fret over this.

fields.EN:
(What...? She's...insane. We came all this
way...)
fields.JP:
（そんな、勝てない……のか……
　せっかくここまで来たのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What...? She's...insane. We came all this
way...)

fields.EN:
(Everyone's counting on us to make it
to the surface.)
fields.JP:
（みんな、みんな地上を楽しみに
　希望を抱いてきたっていうのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone's counting on us to make it
to the surface.)

fields.EN:
Just a second ago, everyone was alive...
Smiling...
fields.JP:
ほんの少し前まで
みんな生きて笑ってたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just a second ago, everyone was alive...
Smiling...

fields.EN:
Seems I've disposed of nearly everyone.
The time for mercy is over.
fields.JP:
だいぶ片付いたようですね。
あなたたちも、そろそろ死んでくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems I've disposed of nearly everyone.
The time for mercy is over.

fields.EN: (Is this is it...? All that effort, just to die...)
fields.JP:
（もうダメなのか
　僕らはここで死ぬ運命なのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Is this is it...? All that effort, just to die...)

fields.JP: くらら！　しっかりしろくらら！

fields.EN: (No, that's... The one drenched in blood is...)
fields.JP:
（そんな……あれは……あそこで
　血まみれで倒れているのは……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (No, that's... The one drenched in blood is...)

fields.JP: くららーーーー！　しらゆきーーーー！

fields.EN:
No, you can't...!! Don't die!
Don't die, Clara!
CLARAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!
fields.JP:
そんな、ダメだ……！　死ぬな！　死ぬなくらら！
くららぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you can't...!! Don't die!
Don't die, Clara!
CLARAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!

fields.EN:
Ugh. What a nuisance. Would you mind
cutting down the racket?
fields.JP:
まったくうるさいったらありませんね。
いいかげんにしてもらえませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. What a nuisance. Would you mind
cutting down the racket?

fields.JP: そっちこそいいかげんにしろよ……！

fields.EN:
I SAID, CUT IT OUT, YOU BASTARD!
WHAT'S GOING TO COME OF ALL THIS
MURDER?!
fields.JP:
いいかげんにしろって言ったんだ！
こんなに殺してなんになるっていうんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I SAID, CUT IT OUT, YOU BASTARD!
WHAT'S GOING TO COME OF ALL THIS
MURDER?!

fields.EN: You're talking, aren't you? Moving, aren't you? Alive, aren't you? That's more than enough to deserve death!
fields.JP:
話してんだろ？　動いてんだろ？　生きてんだろ？
それでじゅーぶん、死刑に値すんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You done? Feeling brave? Flapping that
mouth of yours. I've just about had enough
of you.

fields.EN:
You should be begging us to kill you.
Accept your death with some dignity!
fields.JP:
だからさっさと殺されればいいものを、
意地汚く生き延びて泣き叫んでんじゃねえよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should be begging us to kill you.
Accept your death with some dignity!

fields.EN:
ARGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGH!
YOU WILL PAY FOR YOUR DEFIANCE!
fields.JP:
ああああああああああああああああああああ！
イラつくイラつくイラつくイラつくイラつく！
fields.LOCALIZED:
ARGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGGH!
YOU WILL PAY FOR YOUR DEFIANCE!

fields.JP: ジャックは……ジャックは傷つけさせない！

fields.EN:
Get back, Alice! If you fight with your
injury, they'll kill you!
fields.JP:
下がるんだ、アリス！
そんな傷で戦ったら死んでしまう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Get back, Alice! If you fight with your
injury, they'll kill you!

fields.EN:
No. I refuse to step back. She's trying to
kill Jack, and I'm going to make her pay.
fields.JP:
いいえ、下がれないわ……。
こいつはジャックを殺そうとした。
報いは受けさせる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I refuse to step back. She's trying to
kill Jack, and I'm going to make her pay.

fields.EN:
(But that won't change anything. I have
to change the tide even if it kills me.)
fields.JP:
（だけど、それだけじゃ何も変わらない。
　無理や無茶をしてでも状況を変えないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But that won't change anything. I have
to change the tide even if it kills me.)

fields.EN:
(In the end, our lives are in that Guillotine
girl's hands.)
fields.JP:
（結局、僕らの命はあのギロチンと
　いう名の少女の気分次第なんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the end, our lives are in that Guillotine
girl's hands.)

fields.EN:
Tch... What a brat. You want me to chop
off that pretty head?
fields.JP:
ちっ……めんどくさ。
今すぐその首刎ねてやろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... What a brat. You want me to chop
off that pretty head?

fields.EN:
As much as it pains me, Master specifically
ordered me not to kill you. What to do...
fields.JP:
と言いたいところだが、
マスターからは殺すなという命令だ……
さて、どうしたものか
fields.LOCALIZED:
As much as it pains me, Master specifically
ordered me not to kill you. What to do...

fields.EN: (Is that who's looking for Alice? What for?)
fields.JP:
（その人がアリスを探しているのか？
　いったいなんの目的が……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Is that who's looking for Alice? What for?)

fields.JP: みんな！　目をつぶって！
くっ、なんだこの押しつぶされるような力は……

何だ！？
いったい何が起きたのだ？

fields.EN:
Rgh. No longer will I stand and watch!
Everyone, I've got her pinned.
fields.JP:
くっ……もう好きにはさせない……！
みんな、わたしが抑えているうちに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh. No longer will I stand and watch!
Everyone, I've got her pinned.

fields.EN:
Okay, let's take down Guillotine and
help the rest of the survivors!
fields.JP:
ああ、今のうちにギロチンを倒して、
生き残ってる人たちを助けに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's take down Guillotine and
help the rest of the survivors!

fields.EN:
Damn you. Insolent trash should know its
place!
fields.JP: クソッ、ゴミどもの分際でぇぇっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn you. Insolent trash should know its
place!

fields.EN:
Heh. Sounds like you're getting desperate!
Stand guard, everyone!
fields.JP:
ふっ、そんな不様な格好で言っても
惨めなだけよ。覚悟するがいい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh. Sounds like you're getting desperate!
Stand guard, everyone!

fields.EN: Man, that was so cool of me! What now?!
fields.JP:
せっかく我がカッコよく決めたというのに！
今度は何なのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Man, that was so cool of me! What now?!

fields.EN: I don't like the sound of that roar...
fields.JP: まるで獣の咆哮のような……
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't like the sound of that roar...

fields.EN: Hikari! You fool, don't push it!
fields.JP: ヒカリ！　ばかやろう無茶すんじゃねえ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hikari! You fool, don't push it!

fields.EN: I-I'm fine. This is nothing... Urgh!
fields.JP:
へ、へーきだよ。
このぐらい……くぅっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I'm fine. This is nothing... Urgh!

fields.EN:
You're lying! There's a spear impaled
through your shoulder!
fields.JP:
んなわけねーだろ！
お前、肩に槍がぶっ刺さってんだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're lying! There's a spear impaled
through your shoulder!

fields.EN: What the...? Where'd this spear...come from?
fields.JP:
なんだ、この禍々しい槍は……
いったいどこから飛んできたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: What the...? Where'd this spear...come from?

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Ugh. I'm finally free. So, who's still kicking?
fields.JP:
あーもう、やーっと自由になったー。
さ、動いてる子はどこかな～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. I'm finally free. So, who's still kicking?

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.JP: お願いです……どうか命だけは……！
輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Mercy...? How about you give me your
necklace first?
fields.JP:
本当に……？
それじゃその大事に手に持ってるネックレス頂戴？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mercy...? How about you give me your
necklace first?

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Aw, that so? Can't help if it's an heirloom.
fields.JP:
そっかー、ダメかー。
形見じゃあ仕方ないよねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, that so? Can't help if it's an heirloom.

fields.EN: O-Oh, n-no, it's just a rock! H-Here you go!
fields.JP:
い、いえ！　こ、こんなものただの石ころです！
ど、どうぞお譲りします！
fields.LOCALIZED: O-Oh, n-no, it's just a rock! H-Here you go!

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Kyahahaah! Man, that was too easy.
Actually, never miiiiind. Don't want it!
fields.JP:
キャハハ！　あっさりあげすぎ～。
ていうか、そんなのやっぱりいーらないっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kyahahaah! Man, that was too easy.
Actually, never miiiiind. Don't want it!

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Ohh, look at that presentation! Like your
new necklace? Thank me later~
fields.JP:
綺麗に首が吊れたー！
新しいネックレス気に入った？
はーい救済完了～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohh, look at that presentation! Like your
new necklace? Thank me later~

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
*pant, pant* UGH! I'm about to lose it!
Where can a girl get some fresh-squeezed
blood around here ★
fields.JP:
はぁはぁ……んもー！　いらいらする！
おいしい血でも飲んできぶんてんかんだぞ★
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant* UGH! I'm about to lose it!
Where can a girl get some fresh-squeezed
blood around here ★

fields.JP:
ひいぃぃっ、挟まないで……やめっ……
ぐぎゃあああああっ！！
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Ah, refreshing. Human blood has a certain
je ne sais quoi★
fields.JP:
ああ、美味しい～。
やっぱり人間の血って大人の味だね★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, refreshing. Human blood has a certain
je ne sais quoi★

fields.EN:
We're in trouble, Jack. They're going on a
spree again.
fields.JP:
まずいぞ、ジャック
あいつらまた殺しはじめた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're in trouble, Jack. They're going on a
spree again.

fields.JP: ようやく動けるようになりました

fields.EN:
I can't believe she got me. If Master finds
out, he won't be happy.
fields.JP:
あんな女にやられるなんて、
マスターが知ったらきっとお怒りになる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe she got me. If Master finds
out, he won't be happy.

fields.EN: YOU WON'T YOU WON'T YOU WON'T!
fields.JP: 許さない許さない許さない許さない許さないいいッ！
fields.LOCALIZED: YOU WON'T YOU WON'T YOU WON'T!

fields.EN: Damn it! I won't let you snatch Hikari!
fields.JP: くそっ！　ヒカリはやらせねえ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn it! I won't let you snatch Hikari!

fields.JP: 邪魔をするなあああああっ！
くっ、なんて速さなのっ……！

fields.EN:
GOGOGOGO! DIE! DIE!
DIEEEE, YOU BASTARDS!
fields.JP:
ほらほらほらぁ！
死ねよ死ね死ねよ死ねよおおおお！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
GOGOGOGO! DIE! DIE!
DIEEEE, YOU BASTARDS!

fields.EN: Alice! How dare you attack Alice―
fields.JP:
アリスーッ！！
よくも、よくもアリスを――
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice! How dare you attack Alice―

fields.EN:
WHAT PART OF OUTTA MY WAY DON'T
YOU BASTARDS UNDERSTAAAAAND?!
fields.JP:
だから邪魔すんじゃねえって言って
んだろうがああああああああああ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
WHAT PART OF OUTTA MY WAY DON'T
YOU BASTARDS UNDERSTAAAAAND?!

fields.EN:
Darn, this is nuts! Nemurihime,
look alive!
fields.JP:
いかん、このままでは……！
眠り姫、二人同時に行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Darn, this is nuts! Sleeping Beauty,
look alive!

fields.EN: Th-That bitch... She won't sit still...
fields.JP:
お、おのれ……。
我の攻撃が、こんなに簡単に……
fields.LOCALIZED: Th-That bitch... She won't sit still...

fields.EN:
J-Jack, please... Run away. Even if it's
just you...
fields.JP:
う……ジャック……
今のうちに、あなただけでも……逃げて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Jack, please... Run away. Even if it's
just you...

fields.JP:
アリス！
そんなことできないよ……！

fields.EN:
What can I do right now? How can I get
us out of this...?
fields.JP:
どうしたらいいんだ……
どうすればここを突破できるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What can I do right now? How can I get
us out of this...?

fields.EN:
(Shoot, I'm useless... I can't save anyone.
I'm at my wit's end.)
fields.JP:
（くっ、やっぱり僕は無力だ……
　誰一人救えない、何一つ打開できない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot, I'm useless... I can't save anyone.
I'm at my wit's end.)

fields.JP: もしかしてヒカリ、君なのかい……？

fields.EN:
I don't want anyone to die. Hang in there
for me.
fields.JP:
誰も死なせたくない……
頑張れ私……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want anyone to die. Hang in there
for me.

fields.EN:
You idiot! If you keep using your powers
in your condition...!
fields.JP:
おい馬鹿！
そんな傷でこんな力使ったら……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You idiot! If you keep using your powers
in your condition...!

fields.EN: I'll be fine. I have to do something!
fields.JP:
だい、じょうぶだよ……
これくらい、みんなの痛みに、比べたら
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be fine. I have to do something!

fields.EN:
The pain makes it a little harder to control,
so I have to apologize in advance...
fields.JP:
でもね、痛みで、ちょっと制御が難しいかも。
だから先に、みんなに、謝っとくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The pain makes it a little harder to control,
so I have to apologize in advance...

fields.JP:
謝るって何をだよ！？
おい、ヒカリ！　やめろって！

fields.EN:
Mamoru, I simply cannot. Even coming
from you...
fields.JP: マモルの頼みでも、それは聞けない……かな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, I simply cannot. Even coming
from you...

fields.EN:
That winged pest! It's her!
I'll kill her first!
fields.JP:
あの羽女……！
あいつだ、あいつを先に殺す！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That winged pest! It's her!
I'll kill her first!

fields.EN: Let's all meet again, no matter what—
fields.JP: 絶対、またみんなで、会おうね──
fields.LOCALIZED: Promise me we'll meet again someday...

fields.EN: We all risked our lives...to come this far.
fields.JP:
みんなで死ぬ思いをして、
やっとここまで来たっていうのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: We all risked our lives...to come this far.

Tch. Surely you should be dead by now.

ちっ……殺したと思ったのにまだ生きてるなんて

fields.LOCALIZED:

そんな傷で戦ったら死んでしまう！
fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.JP: そうだよ、一旦退いて手当てしなきゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED: She's right, Alice. Stay back and heal!

As much as it pains me, Master specifically
ordered me not to kill you. What to do...

fields.EN: (Is that who's looking for Alice? What for?)
fields.JP:
（その人がアリスを探しているのか？
　いったいなんの目的が……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Is that who's looking for Alice? What for?)

fields.JP: みなさん！　めをつぶって！

fields.EN:
Agh. What was that?! Something's
crushing me.
fields.JP: くっ、なんだこの押しつぶされるような力は……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agh. What was that?! Something's
crushing me.

fields.EN:
I'll hold her back a bit...
In the meantime, please...
fields.JP:
少しだけおさえこみます……
その間に……お願い……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll hold her back a bit...
In the meantime, please...

fields.EN:
Okay, let's take down Guillotine and
help the rest of the survivors!
fields.JP:
ああ、今のうちにギロチンを倒して、
生き残ってる人たちを助けに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's take down Guillotine and
help the rest of the survivors!

fields.EN:
Damn you. Insolent trash should know its
place!
fields.JP: クソッ、ゴミどもの分際でぇぇっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn you. Insolent trash should know its
place!

fields.EN: I don't like the sound of that roar...
fields.JP: まるで獣の咆哮のような……
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't like the sound of that roar...

fields.EN: What the...? Where'd that spear come from?
fields.JP:
なんだ、この禍々しい槍は……
いったいどこから飛んできたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: What the...? Where'd that spear come from?

fields.JP: ようやく動けるようになりました

や……やめっ……
ぐぎゃあああああっ！！

fields.EN:
We're in trouble, Jack. They're going on a
spree again.
fields.JP:
まずいぞ、ジャック
あいつまた殺しはじめた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're in trouble, Jack. They're going on a
spree again.

fields.EN:
I can't believe she got me. If Master finds
out, he won't be happy.
fields.JP:
あんな女にやられるなんて、
マスターが知ったらきっとお怒りになる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe she got me. If Master finds
out, he won't be happy.

fields.EN: YOU WON'T YOU WON'T YOU WON'T!
fields.JP: 許さない許さない許さない許さない許さないいいッ！
fields.LOCALIZED: YOU WON'T YOU WON'T YOU WON'T!

fields.JP: ええい、ヒカリを守るぞ！
邪魔をするなあああああっ！

fields.EN:
GOGOGOGO! DIE! DIE!
DIEEEE, YOU BASTARDS!
fields.JP:
ほらほらほらぁ！
死ねよ死ね死ねよ死ねよおおおお！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
GOGOGOGO! DIE! DIE!
DIEEEE, YOU BASTARDS!

fields.EN:
What can I do right now? How can I get
us out of this...?
fields.JP:
どうしたらいいんだ……
どうすればここを突破できるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What can I do right now? How can I get
us out of this...?

fields.EN:
(Shoot, I'm useless... I can't save anyone.
I'm at my wit's end.)
fields.JP:
（くっ、やっぱり僕は無力だ……
　誰一人救えない、何一つ打開できない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot, I'm useless... I can't save anyone.
I'm at my wit's end.)

fields.JP: もしかしてヒカリ、あなたなの……？

fields.EN:
I don't want anyone to die. Hang in there
for me.
fields.JP:
誰も死なせたくない……
頑張れ私……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want anyone to die. Hang in there
for me.

fields.EN:
That winged pest! It's her!
I'll kill her first!
fields.JP:
あの羽女……！
あいつだ、あいつを先に殺す！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That winged pest! It's her!
I'll kill her first!

fields.EN: Let's all meet again, no matter what—
fields.JP: 絶対、またみんなで、会おうね──
fields.LOCALIZED: Promise me we'll meet again someday...

fields.JP: （くっ…みんな手も足もでない）

fields.EN: Where are we...? Weren't we just outside...?
fields.JP:
ここは……どこだろう……？
僕たち外にいたはずじゃ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Where are we...? Weren't we just outside...?

fields.EN: Oh, right. Hikari used her powers to save us.
fields.JP:
そうだ、あの時ヒカリが
僕たちを助けようと力を使って……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, right. Hikari used her powers to save us.

fields.JP: おいヒカリ！　しっかりしろ！

fields.EN: Darn, she really did it this time!
fields.LOCALIZED: Darn, she really did it this time!

fields.JP: （そうだ、ヒカリは怪我をしていて……！）

fields.EN: No, you're not! Look at you!
fields.JP: なにが平気だ！　無茶しやがって！
fields.LOCALIZED: No, you're not! Look at you!

fields.JP: マモルは心配症なんだ……から……
嘘だろおい、しっかりしろヒカリ！
落ち着いて、気を失っただけだ

fields.EN:
Her wounds have closed, and she's breathing.
She's just exhausted.
fields.JP:
傷も塞がっているし、呼吸もちゃんとしてる。
おそらく体力を使い果たしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her wounds have closed, and she's breathing.
She's just exhausted.

fields.EN:
This place...is definitely not where we just
were. I think Hikari took us somewhere safe.
fields.JP:
ここは……さっきまでいた場所とは明らかに違う。
きっとヒカリが僕たちを別の場所まで
飛ばしてくれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place...is definitely not where we just
were. I think Hikari took us somewhere safe.

fields.EN:
I see. Does that mean I've been separated
from my princess?
fields.JP:
そうか……
姫とは離れ離れになったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Does that mean I've been separated
from my princess?

fields.EN: Sorry... She's always jumping the gun.
fields.JP: すまねえ……こいつ、昔っからそそっかしくてよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry... She's always jumping the gun.

fields.EN:
Oh, no need to apologize. In fact, I should
be thanking her.
fields.JP:
いや、責めてるわけじゃないんだ。
むしろ、ヒカリは命の恩人だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, no need to apologize. In fact, I should
be thanking her.

fields.EN:
Right. Considering the circumstances,
getting out of there was a task in itself.
fields.JP:
そうだね。あんな状態だったから、
飛ばすだけで精一杯だったんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Considering the circumstances,
getting out of there was a task in itself.

fields.EN: We must thank her when she awakes.
fields.JP: 起きたらちゃんとお礼を言わないとね
fields.LOCALIZED: We must thank her when she awakes.

fields.EN: Man, those girls... Who were they?
fields.JP:
それにしても、あの女の子たち、
いったい何者だったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED: Man, those girls... Who were they?

fields.EN:
They called themselves...Genocide Pink,
correct? Such terrifying power.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女……だっけ。
とてつもない強さだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They called themselves...Massacre Pink,
correct? Such terrifying power.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
They didn't hesitate to kill people.
They did it as casually as sweeping the road.
fields.JP:
それに人を殺すことに躊躇いがなかった。
簡単に、道を掃除するみたいに殺していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
They sure lived up to the massacre part.
She murdered people like it was her job.

fields.EN:
So that's what we came to the surface for?
When does it end? Sheesh.
fields.JP:
地上にはあんなのがうろついてんのかよ。
勘弁してほしいぜまったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's what we came to the surface for?
When does it end? Sheesh.

fields.EN:
That mountain of corpses haunts me. If those
four were responsible, then we have reason
to be afraid.
fields.JP:
あのおびただしい数の死体の山を
たった４人の女の子だけで
作ったとしたら恐ろしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That mountain of corpses haunts me. If those
four were responsible, then we have reason
to be afraid.

fields.EN:
It doesn't matter how strong they are!
Look what they did to Hikari. They won't
get away with this.
fields.JP:
どんだけ強かろうと関係ねえ！
ヒカリをこんなにしやがったやつらだ
絶対に許さねえ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't matter how strong they are!
Look what they did to Hikari. They won't
get away with this.

fields.EN: I don't think that was them...
fields.JP: いや、あれは彼女たちがやったんじゃないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think that was them...

fields.JP: おい、どういうことだよ！

fields.EN:
I didn't exactly see it happen, but I think
that spear came from beyond the mountain
of bodies.
fields.JP:
しっかり見ていたわけじゃないけど、
あの槍は死体の山のずっと向こうから
飛んできたように見えた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't exactly see it happen, but I think
that spear came from beyond the mountain
of bodies.

fields.EN: You're telling me there's more of 'em?
fields.JP: じゃあ、他にもやつらの仲間がいたってことか
fields.LOCALIZED: You're telling me there's more of 'em?

fields.EN:
Maybe. That's not including that loud
roar we heard right before.
fields.JP:
かもしれない。
それに、直前に聞こえた獣のような咆吼も気になる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe. That's not including that loud
roar we heard right before.

fields.EN:
In other words, we're totally in the dark.
Damn it. They'd better show themselves.
fields.JP:
要するになんにもわからないってことか。
クソッ、こそこそ隠れてねえで出てこいってんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, we're totally in the dark.
Damn it. They'd better show themselves.

fields.EN:
Regardless, we don't have enough info, so
it's pointless to speculate.
Let's find everyone else first.
fields.JP:
とにかく、敵については今の時点じゃ情報が
少なすぎて、考えるだけ時間の無駄だ。
まずは、はぐれてしまったみんなを探そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, we don't have enough info, so
it's pointless to speculate.
Let's find everyone else first.

fields.EN:
Think we should scan the area first?
There might be Marchens wandering.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、この辺りを探索してみるかい？
メルヒェンがいるかもしれないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think we should scan the area first?
There might be Marchens wandering.

fields.EN:
Could be dangerous, no telling how long
we'll stay undetected in this spot.
fields.JP:
危険は承知の上だ。
それに、ここが安全だって保障もないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could be dangerous, no telling how long
we'll stay undetected in this spot.

fields.JP: 確かに、ジャックの言う通りだけど……

fields.EN:
I'll carry Hikari. Sorry, I'll have to leave the
battling to you all.
fields.JP:
ヒカリは俺が運ぶ。
悪いが、敵はお前らに任せるぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll carry Hikari. Sorry, I'll have to leave the
battling to you all.

fields.EN: I hope my princess is nearby...
fields.JP: 姫、近くにいるといいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope my princess is nearby...

fields.EN: She'll be okay. We'll see her in no ti―
fields.JP:
大丈夫だよ。
きっとすぐ再会でき――
fields.LOCALIZED: She'll be okay. We'll see her in no ti―

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: ほらしっかりして、くらら……！

fields.EN:
There's so much you wanted to do on the
surface, remember?!
fields.JP:
あなた地上でやりたいこと
いっぱいあるって言ってたでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's so much you wanted to do on the
surface, remember?!

fields.EN: Snap out of it! You have to pull through!
fields.JP:
だから気をしっかり持ちなさい！
こんなところで倒れちゃ駄目よ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Snap out of it! You have to pull through!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: Oh, it's you guys... You're safe.
fields.JP: あなたたち……無事だったのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's you guys... You're safe.

fields.EN: What happened to her? She's drenched...
fields.JP:
おい、こいつどうしたんだよ。
こんなに血が……
fields.LOCALIZED: What happened to her? She's drenched...

fields.EN:
(That's right. I saw it happen.
Genocide Pink cut Clara up pretty bad.)
fields.JP:
（そうだった、あの時、僕は見たんだ。
　くららが処刑台少女に斬られるのを……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. I saw it happen.
Massacre Pink cut Clara up pretty bad.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: くららは、大丈夫なのか！？

fields.EN:
I did some first aid, but she's lost a lot of
blood.
fields.JP: 応急処置はしたけれど……血が流れすぎた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did some first aid, but she's lost a lot of
blood.

fields.EN: At this rate, she'll die from blood loss.
fields.JP: このままではこの子、出血多量で死ぬわ
fields.LOCALIZED: At this rate, we might lose her.

fields.JP: 自分、今めっちゃ感動してるっす

fields.EN:
I wondered to myself how we'd manage
to make it to the surface.
fields.JP:
正直、地上への脱出って言っても
どうやってやるのかって、思ってたんすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wondered to myself how we'd manage
to make it to the surface.

fields.EN:
I thought we'd have to fling down a rope
from the top of Jail, but I knew that would
never work.
fields.JP:
監獄塔のてっぺんからロープでも
伸ばすのかとか思ってたんすけどね、
でもそれもムリがあるっていうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought we'd have to fling down a rope
from the top of Jail, but I knew that would
never work.

fields.EN:
Then, BAM! We were floating!
It was like something out of a fairy tale!
fields.JP:
なーんて思ってたらまさかの浮遊っすよ！
これはさすがの自分もまったく、
ぜ－んぜん想像してなかったっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then, BAM! We were floating!
It was like something out of a fairy tale!

fields.JP: ねえ師匠もそう思うっすよね？

fields.EN: Can't you stay quiet for just a second...?
fields.JP: 少しは静かにできねえのか、お前……
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't you stay quiet for just a second...?

fields.EN:
How in the world are you so calm about
this?! Come on, Boss! Smile!
fields.JP:
こんな時にテンション上がらない方が
どうかしてると思うっすよ！
ほら師匠もニッコリするっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How in the world are you so calm about
this?! Come on, Boss! Smile!

fields.JP:
あーもううるせえ、
ちょっと黙ってろっての

fields.EN: Aw, fine. Guess I'll keep my mouth shut.
fields.JP:
えー。分かったっすよ。
静かにするっすよ、もう
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, fine. Guess I'll keep my mouth shut.

fields.JP:
ふーんだ、師匠のいけず。
とーへんぼく。ぼくねんじん！

fields.EN:
Instead of complaining, why don't you
think of insults that are less juvenile?
fields.JP:
お前、朴念仁って言葉の意味
分かってねえだろ……。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead of complaining, why don't you
think of insults that are less juvenile?

fields.EN: As long as it irks you, I'm good.
fields.JP:
何となく師匠がモヤッとしてくれたら
それでいいんすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: As long as it irks you, I'm good.

fields.EN:
I will rip that smart mouth off...
Keep quiet, will ya?
fields.JP:
口の減らねえ……。
とにかくおとなしくしてろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will rip that smart mouth off...
Keep quiet, will ya?

fields.EN:
Okaaaay. I'll follow your lead, Boss.
One grumpy stump, comin' up!
fields.JP:
はーい。師匠見習って
ちゃんとムッツリしとくっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okaaaay. I'll follow your lead, Boss.
One grumpy stump, comin' up!

fields.EN:
I-I'm kidding! Lighten up a bit!
Okay, now I'll shut up!
fields.JP:
う、嘘っすよ！
そんなに怒らないで下さいってば！
今度こそ黙るっすから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm kidding! Lighten up a bit!
Okay, now I'll shut up!

fields.EN: But I'm no good at sitting still...
fields.JP: じっとしてるのは苦手なんすけどね……
fields.LOCALIZED: But I'm no good at sitting still...

fields.EN:
(I just never imagined a day when
we'd be able to come back up.)
fields.JP:
（でもまさか、自分が地上に行ける日が
　来るなんて思ってもみなかったっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I just never imagined a day when
we'd be able to come back up.)

fields.EN:
(The Marchens nabbed almost all of us.
Me too, if it weren't for my grandma.)
fields.JP:
（まわりの子たちはみーんなメルヒェンに
　捕まって、自分はなんとかおばあちゃんの
　おかげで助かったっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Marchens nabbed almost all of us.
Me too, if it weren't for my grandma.)

fields.EN:
(But then, I was alone. Been chugging
along desperately ever since.)
fields.JP:
（でも、すぐに１人になっちゃって、
　そこからはもう必死だったっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But then, I was alone. Been chugging
along desperately ever since.)

fields.EN:
(Somehow, I stumbled upon the Liberated
District. I had to pick pockets to survive.)
fields.JP:
（なんとか解放地区に辿り着いて、
　人様の財布をスリ盗って生きていたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Somehow, I stumbled upon the Liberated
District. I had to pick pockets to survive.)

fields.EN: Man, my life's been no picnic!
fields.JP:
って、自分の人生、
不運にもほどがあるっす！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Man, my life's been no picnic!

fields.EN: Another outburst. Geez, what in the...
fields.JP:
いきなり叫ぶな。
どうしたんだいったい……
fields.LOCALIZED: Another outburst. Geez, what in the...

fields.JP:
あ、いや何でもないっす。
すいません師匠

fields.EN:
(That's right. Even with my bad luck,
I got to meet the Boss―Haru-san!)
fields.JP:
（そうっす。自分の人生、最悪なこと
　ばっかだったっすけど、おかげでハルさんに――
　師匠に出会えたっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. Even with my bad luck,
I got to meet the Boss―Haru!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: Hey Boss, remember when we first met?
fields.JP:
師匠、自分と出会った時のことって
覚えてるっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Boss, remember when we first met?

fields.EN:
Huh? Obviously. You tried nicking my
wallet.
fields.JP:
あ？　そりゃあ覚えてるさ。
なんせこの俺からスリ取ろうと
しやがったんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Obviously. You tried nicking my
wallet.

fields.EN:
Oh, man. I'd never been so scared in my
life. That was the lecture of a lifetime.
fields.JP:
いやあ……あの時の説教は
人生でいちばんビビったっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, man. I'd never been so scared in my
life. That was the lecture of a lifetime.

fields.EN:
Scared, my ass. You tried to pick my
pocket another ten times afterwards.
fields.JP:
って言う割にはお前、
あの後も１０回くらい俺から
スリ取ろうとしたじゃねえか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Scared, my ass. You tried to pick my
pocket another ten times afterwards.

fields.EN:
Well, that's 'cuz you seemed like a nice
but easy target.
fields.JP:
それは師匠がいい人そうで、
チョロそうだったからっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's 'cuz you seemed like a nice
but easy target.

fields.EN:
Kidding. No, I know you were looking
out for me the whole time.
fields.JP:
冗談言い過ぎたっす。師匠だけが、
ちゃんと自分を見てくれたんすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kidding. No, I know you were looking
out for me the whole time.

fields.EN:
(When he caught me stealing, he scolded
me. Others opted for foot-fist diplomacy.)
fields.JP:
（スリがバレた時、師匠は説教してくれたっす。
　他の人はみんな殴ったり蹴ったりだったのに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When he caught me stealing, he scolded
me. Others opted for foot-fist diplomacy.)

fields.EN:
That's why yer forever the Boss, Boss.
I'll follow you to the ends of the earth.
fields.JP:
だから師匠は、いつだって自分の師匠っす。
どこまででもついていくっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why yer forever the Boss, Boss.
I'll follow you to the ends of the earth.

fields.EN:
Right, then start with a simple order from
the Boss. Keep your mouth shut.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあ師匠の言いつけはきちんと
守れ。とりあえず静かにするところから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, then start with a simple order from
the Boss. Keep your mouth shut.

fields.EN:
(Boss, you're so gruff. When you aren't
scolding me, you're smoking, but that
won't stop me from following you.)
fields.JP:
（師匠……ぶっきらぼうだし、説教多いし、
　いつもタバコ吸っててけむいけど、
　それでもこれからも一緒に付いていきたいっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Boss, you're so gruff. When you aren't
scolding me, you're smoking, but that
won't stop me from following you.)

fields.EN:
(That's why I'm gonna do whatever it
takes to hone my skills.)
fields.JP: （そのためにも、師匠の技術をちゃんと学ぶっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's why I'm gonna do whatever it
takes to hone my skills.)

fields.EN:
(Haru... The only Blood craftsman
in the Liberated District.)
fields.JP:
（解放地区で随一の血式武器の生成や強化の腕を持つ
　武器製造士……ハル）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haru... The only Blood craftsman
in the Liberated District.)

fields.JP:
（自分も、いつか師匠みたいに、
　立派な武器製造士になるっすよ！）

fields.EN:
(Life sure is funny. I thought I'd be
underground forever, never mind
witnessing this miraculous sight.)
fields.JP:
（でもほんと人生何があるか分からないっす。
　一生地下監獄かと思ってたっす。
　まさかこんな奇跡の瞬間に立ち会えるなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Life sure is funny. I thought I'd be
underground forever, never mind
witnessing this miraculous sight.)

fields.EN:
OH?! I wonder if fortune's finally
in my favor!
fields.JP:
はっ！？　自分の人生、
ようやく運が向いてきたっすか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
OH?! I wonder if fortune's finally
in my favor!

fields.JP:
す、すんません、
つい声に出てしまったっす！

fields.EN: You loudmouth. It's only been a few seconds...
fields.JP: お前、口閉じてからまだ数秒しか――
fields.LOCALIZED: You loudmouth. It's only been a few seconds...

fields.JP:
あ、ほら師匠！
地上が見えてきたっすよ！！

fields.EN:
(Beyond this great abyss is the surface...
I'm as lucky as they get.)
fields.JP:
