（あの淵の先が地上……。
　本当に今の自分はラッキーだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Beyond this great abyss is the surface...
I'm as lucky as they get.)

fields.EN:
God... It's a mountain of bodies.
There's easily thousands here...
fields.JP:
ひでえ死体の山だ……
軽く見積もっても数千はあるぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
God... It's a mountain of bodies.
There's easily thousands here...

fields.EN:
The stench of blood is suffocating...
Hardly any of them are decomposing.
These bodies are fresh.
fields.JP:
このむせかえるような血の匂い……
白骨化どころかほとんど腐ってもいねえ。
ってことは、それほど時間は経ってないってことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The stench of blood is suffocating...
Hardly any of them are decomposing.
These bodies are fresh.

fields.JP: なんだ！　どうしたってんだ！

fields.EN: How can you keep calm right now?!
fields.JP: こんなの見て、どうしてそんなに冷静なんすか！
fields.LOCALIZED: How can you keep calm right now?!

fields.EN:
Shut up! I need time to think, or
I'll go mad!
fields.JP:
うるせえ！　分析でもしてなきゃ、
今にも頭がおかしくなりそうなんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up! I need time to think, or
I'll go mad!

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Oh, look over heeeeeere. I see some
folks moving over yonder!
fields.JP:
あ、こんなところにも動いてる子が
いーっぱい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, look over heeeeeere. I see some
folks moving over yonder!

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Aw. Shame I have to kill them too.
fields.JP: これはちゃーんと殺してあげないとねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. Shame I have to kill them too.

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Oh, but I don't know which one is Alice.
Killing them might be a waste of time, huh?
But I still wanna....
fields.JP:
あ、でも“アリス”って子がどれか分かんないや。
殺しちゃったらマズいかなー、マズいよねー。
ああ、でも殺したいなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, but I don't know which one is Alice.
Killing them might be a waste of time, huh?
But I still wanna....

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.JP: あららー？　ギロチン姉さんが殺り始めちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? Sister Guillotine is going off...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: So that means I can too, right?!
fields.JP: じゃあ、わたしも殺っちゃっていいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED: So that means I can too, right?!

fields.EN: Shit... This isn't good! Guys, RUN FOR―
fields.JP:
やべぇ……やべぇぞ……！
おい、みんな逃げ──
fields.LOCALIZED: Shit... This isn't good! Guys, RUN FOR―

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: You'd better run, or you'll dieeeee.
fields.JP: ほら、逃げないと死んじゃうわよお？
fields.LOCALIZED: You'd better run, or you'll dieeeee.

fields.JP: 輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.JP:
足、おそーい。もうちょっと
みんな必死になればいいのにぃ
輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Aww, I don't like when the prey's too easy.
fields.JP:
あーあ、こんなに簡単に
殺したくないんだけどなあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Aww, I don't like when the prey's too easy.

fields.EN: A-Ahh, Boss. We should get outta here!
fields.JP:
あ、ああ、師匠、
自分たちも逃げなきゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: A-Ahh, Boss. We should get outta here!

fields.JP: な、何すかこの女の子っ

fields.EN:
Clara, step back! She's not from the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
くらら、離れろ！
そいつ解放地区の人間じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, step back! She's not from the
Liberated District!

fields.EN: So she's one of those demons?!
fields.JP: ってことはあの殺人鬼の仲間っすか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: So she's one of those demons?!

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah! Hiaburibashira is Kubitsuridai...
Kubitsuri-neesan's little sister!
fields.JP:
そ、そうよ！　火あぶり柱は首吊り台……
首吊り姉さんの妹なんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yeah, I'm Pyre... Sister Gallows'
little sister!
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Hiaburibashira | Source-gated Kubitsuridai/Kubitsuri-neesan identity restoration.

fields.EN:
H-Hiaburibashira can kill people easily too...!
Just you watch...!
fields.JP:
ひ、火あぶり柱だって
人なんて簡単に殺せるわよ……！
見てなさい見てなさい……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I can wipe you out just like they can!
Just you wait...!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(S-So her name is Hiaburibashira, huh? And the scary
one over there is Kubitsuridai...)
fields.JP:
（この子、『火あぶり柱』っていうっすか。
　あっちのもっと危ないのは『首つり台』……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(S-So her name is Pyre, huh? And the scary
one over there is Gallows...)
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Hiaburibashira | Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.

fields.JP: （どっちも名前からしてまともじゃないっす！）

fields.EN: B-Boss...this doesn't look good at all.
fields.JP:
し、師匠……これ、
かなりマズイ気がするっす……
fields.LOCALIZED: B-Boss...this doesn't look good at all.

fields.EN:
Clara, don't show them your back.
Back up slowly.
fields.JP:
くらら、背中を見せずに
ゆっくりこっちに来い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, don't show them your back.
Back up slowly.

fields.EN: Hiaburibashira can do it too...! Just watch...!
fields.JP:
やってやるんだから……！
火あぶり柱もできるんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm gonna do it! I'll show you all!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: I won't let you hurt anyone anymore!
fields.JP: これ以上みんなに危害を加えさせませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I won't let you hurt anyone anymore!

fields.JP: あれ、逃げない子なんて珍しい～

fields.EN:
Oh, you want to play? How delightful!
Hope your bite matches your bark!
fields.JP:
遊んでくれるの？
わあ、嬉しい！　簡単に死なないでよね！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you want to play? How delightful!
Hope your bite matches your bark!

fields.EN:
Cinderella-san! She's not a Blood Maiden
for nothin'! We're definitely safe now!
fields.JP:
シンデレラさん……！
さすが血式少女っす！！
これならきっと助かるっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella! She's not a Blood Maiden
for nothin'! We're definitely safe now!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
If they're responsible for the mountain
of corpses, then the Blood Maidens will
have their hands full.
fields.JP:
この死体の山を作ったのがこいつらなら、
血式少女でも油断できる相手じゃないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If they're responsible for the mountain
of corpses, then the Blood Maidens will
have their hands full.

fields.EN:
As I said, these bodies are fresh, and
they made quick work of them.
fields.JP:
言っただろ、死体の山ができてそれほど時間は
経っちゃいねえ。つまり、こいつらはこの数の
死体をほんのわずかな時間で作ったってことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As I said, these bodies are fresh, and
they made quick work of them.

fields.JP: やめてっ、痛いっ……がああっ！
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.JP: 新鮮な血……あはっ、美味しい♪

fields.EN: They're going at it over there too...
fields.LOCALIZED: They're going at it over there too...

fields.EN:
Wh-Who the hell are you people?!
Where the hell do you get off?!
fields.JP:
なあ、お前らいったい何者なんだ。
なぜこんな惨いことをする！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Who the hell are you people?!
Where the hell do you get off?!

fields.JP: い、今のは火あぶり柱に言ったの……？
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Who else would I be talking to?
fields.LOCALIZED: Who else would I be talking to?

fields.EN:
Sh-Shut up! Shut UP! Papa commanded me
to kill you guys!
fields.JP:
う、うるさいうるさい！
お前らはパパの命令で死ぬんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sh-Shut up! Shut UP! Papa commanded me
to kill you guys!

fields.EN:
What the...? Her attacks are slower and
weaker than the others.
fields.JP:
なんだ……？　こいつの攻撃、
さっきの奴に比べたら遅いし
大したことないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...? Her attacks are slower and
weaker than the others.

fields.EN: Seriously. Even I managed to dodge it.
fields.JP:
そっすね、自分でも
簡単に避けられたくらいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously. Even I managed to dodge it.

fields.EN:
Then again, doesn't seem like we can
reason with her. Let's run for it.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、話が通じる相手じゃなさそうだ。
とりあえず逃げるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, doesn't seem like we can
reason with her. Let's run for it.

fields.EN: Goodness, Hiaburibashira. What's the hold up?
fields.JP:
やぁだ、火あぶり柱ったら
こんなのに手間取ってるのぉ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Goodness, Pyre. What's the hold up?

fields.JP: また別のが来やがった……！

fields.EN: Sh-She was just over there a second ago!
fields.JP: む、向こうで戦っていたはずじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sh-She was just over there a second ago!

fields.EN:
Come on, Hiaburibashira! I got your back!
Here I come, grandpa!
fields.JP:
ほら火あぶり柱、手助けしてあげる！
いくわよおじさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, Pyre! I got your back!
Here I come, grandpa!

fields.EN:
Aww, look at you. Rushing into the circle
all on your own.
fields.JP:
あーあ、わたしの輪っかに
自分から捕まりに来るなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aww, look at you. Rushing into the circle
all on your own.

fields.EN:
Of course. I'll let you go, right after I'm
through with you!
fields.JP: うん、殺してから解放してあげるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I'll let you go, right after I'm
through with you!

fields.EN:
Oh. You're sturdier than you look. Thought
I sliced you clean in half.
fields.JP:
あらぁ、意外と頑丈。
真っ二つにしたつもりだったのにー。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. You're sturdier than you look. Thought
I sliced you clean in half.

fields.EN:
Clara-chan! Ugh! You're not getting away
with this!
fields.JP: くららちゃん！　このぉ……許せません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara! Ugh! You're not getting away
with this!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.EN:
Hey! Never interrupt an artist while
they work. Out of my way!
fields.JP: ちょっと、トドメ刺すんだから邪魔しないでよっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! Never interrupt an artist while
they work. Out of my way!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: くららーーーー！　しらゆきーーーー！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
No, you can't...!! Don't die!
Don't die, Clara!
CLARAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!
fields.JP:
そんな、ダメだ……！　死ぬな！　死ぬなくらら！
くららぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you can't...!! Don't die!
Don't die, Clara!
CLARAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!

fields.EN:
Ugh, one after the other. Would you
get out of my way? I'm not done.
fields.JP:
あーもう、次から次へと。
ちょっとそこどいてよ、殺せないでしょー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, one after the other. Would you
get out of my way? I'm not done.

fields.JP: そんなことさせませんわ！

fields.EN:
Another one out of the woodwork...
Oh, I know! Hiaburibashira, handle the half-dead
one over there!
fields.JP:
また新しいのが……あ、そうだ！
火あぶり柱、そっちの死にかけは
あんたが殺しなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another one out of the woodwork...
Oh, I know! Pyre, handle the half-dead
one over there!

fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: That's right~ Even you can kill someone who's half-dead and a little kid, can't you~? Ahh, what a caring sister I am! Hehe!
fields.JP:
そうよー、死にかけとチビッコくらいなら、
あんたでも殺れるでしょー。
あぁ、わたしってばすごい妹想い！　フフ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. She's almost gone, but she's
tiny enough even for you to handle.
Aren't I a generous sister? Hehe!

fields.EN: I'll check properly afterward, so make sure you do it right!
fields.JP:
ちゃんと後でチェックするから、
しっかりやりなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be right back, so don't let me down!

fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.
B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ねえ、なんでこんなひどいことするの！？

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: That's not true! Hiaburibashira didn't do it!!
fields.JP: 違うもん！　火あぶり柱じゃないもん！！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not true! It wasn't me!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: おいくらら、しっかりしろ！

fields.EN:
She's banged up pretty bad.
Damn it. I was supposed to protect her.
fields.JP:
脇腹と手首の傷が深いな……。
クソッ、俺が守ってやるべきだったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's banged up pretty bad.
Damn it. I was supposed to protect her.

fields.JP: （師匠、無事みたいだ。よかった……）

fields.EN:
(But what did they do to me...?
I can barely move...)
fields.JP:
（でもいったい何されたんだろ……。
　力がどんどん、抜けていく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But what did they do to me...?
I can barely move...)

fields.EN:
(My body's in agony. Keeping my eyes
open is almost impossible...)
fields.JP:
（あちこち痛すぎて、もうこれが
　痛みなのかも分からなくなってきた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My body's in agony. Keeping my eyes
open is almost impossible...)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I bit off more than I could chew.
Should've known I couldn't dodge that.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱ似合わないことを
　するもんじゃないなぁ……。
　上手くかわす、なんてできなかったよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I bit off more than I could chew.
Should've known I couldn't dodge that.)

fields.JP: おいくらら！　返事しやがれ！

fields.EN:
(I don't want to die...
I must...keep pushing...)
fields.JP:
（まだ死にたくない……。
　どうにか助かる方法は……ないかなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want to die...
I must...keep pushing...)

fields.EN:
Ooh. I get so stuffy if I stare at the sky for
too long. Why is that...?
fields.JP:
あー、空見過ぎるとクシャミでるよね。
なんでだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh. I get so stuffy if I stare at the sky for
too long. Why is that...?

fields.EN: As usual, no one's going to respond.
fields.JP: ──ま、いつも通り誰も答えちゃくれねーんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED: As usual, no one's going to respond.

fields.EN:
Truthfully, I can't believe we've made
it this far. I never thought the day of
freedom from Jail would ever come.
fields.JP:
にしても、マジでここまで来ちまった。
まさか地下ジェイルを脱出するなんて話に
なるとはね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Truthfully, I can't believe we've made
it this far. I never thought the day of
freedom from Jail would ever come.

fields.EN:
I bet anything they've not only forgotten
my name, but my face too, despite us living
in the same Liberated District!
fields.JP:
しかもこいつら、俺の名前どころか、
顔すら覚えてねーんだろうなー
同じ解放地区の住人だっていうのにな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet anything they've not only forgotten
my name, but my face too, despite us living
in the same Liberated District!

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I'm never noticed.
Unless people bump into me, I'm just
a fly on the wall. The life of a loner.)
fields.JP:
（なんで俺には、存在感というものが
　ないんだろう。ぶつかりでもしない限り
　認識されないって、お一人様極めすぎだろ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I'm never noticed.
Unless people bump into me, I'm just
a fly on the wall. The life of a loner.)

fields.EN:
(Well, I guess I've been sighted here
or there, but never as anything
more than a strange creature.)
fields.JP:
（あ、でも何回かは俺の人生でも
　ちゃんと認識されたことあったな。
　変な生き物扱いだったけどな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, I guess I've been sighted here
or there, but never as anything
more than a strange creature.)

fields.EN:
(Strange creature... Kinda rude.
Well, I never had a name, so can't
be helped I suppose.)
fields.JP:
（変な生き物……ひどい話だ。まあ、
　そもそも前は俺に名前なんてなかったから、
　仕方なかったのかもしんないけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Strange creature... Kinda rude.
Well, I never had a name, so can't
be helped I suppose.)

fields.EN:
(Hmph. Not that it bothers me. If I strike a match,
I can see happy visions.)
fields.JP:
（ふん、気にはしてない。だってマッチを
　擦れば幸せな幻覚が見られるからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hmph. Not that it bothers me. All I have to
do is light a match, and I see phantoms.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN:
(Still, that harem vision where I was wildly popular
with both guys and girls was the best...)
fields.JP:
（それにしてもあの、
　男女問わずモテまくりの
　ハーレム幻覚は最高だった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, that one time when I got the
attention of all those girls and boys
as a phantom rocked...)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN:
(I was all they could see.
I was such a little devil...)
fields.JP:
（みんなの目に俺しか映ってないとか、
　俺って罪な女だぜ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was all they could see.
I was such a little devil...)

fields.EN: (That's right. All I need are matches.)
fields.JP:
（そう、マッチがあれば、
　俺はそれでいいんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That's right. All I need are matches.)

fields.EN:
(Most of the commotion at the Liberated
District came from Marchen raids and food
shortages, but that wasn't my problem.)
fields.JP:
（メルヒェンからの防衛とか食糧問題とか、
　解放地区は色々と騒がしかったけど、
　それらも気にしないでよかったからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Most of the commotion at the Liberated
District came from Marchen raids and food
shortages, but that wasn't my problem.)

fields.EN:
(Aaaah, being alone sure is the life. Those
other losers must be so jealous of me!)
fields.JP:
（あーやっぱ孤独って最高。
　ひとりで過ごせない半端モノどもが、
　俺がうらやましいだろ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Aaaah, being alone sure is the life. Those
other losers must be so jealous of me!)

fields.EN:
(What kind of vision should I see next...?
Maybe rescuing a princess who's been captured
in a really sexy way... No, I should be the princess...)
fields.JP:
（次はどんな幻覚を見てやろうか……。
　めっちゃエロい感じで囚われてる
　姫を助けに……いや、俺が姫で……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what phantom I'd see next.
Maybe I could be a charming prince to
a damsel in distress... No, I'm the damsel.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN:
O-Oh, it's you, Charlotte.
What's the matter?
fields.JP:
な、なんだ、シャーロットか。
どうかしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Oh, it's you, Charlotte.
What's the matter?

fields.EN:
I overheard you and thought you were
sick. Were you able to visit the
restroom before we left?
fields.JP:
ずっと黙ってるから、
具合でも悪いのかと思って。
ちゃんと出発前におトイレ行った？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I overheard you and thought you were
sick. Were you able to visit the
restroom before we left?

fields.EN: I-I went, and I'm not sick.
fields.JP: い、行ったし、具合も悪くない
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I went, and I'm not sick.

fields.EN:
You sure? If you say so. Don't be shy
if you need something, okay?
fields.JP:
そう？　ならいいんだけど。
何かあったら遠慮せず言うのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure? If you say so. Don't be shy
if you need something, okay?

fields.JP:
（相変わらずシャーロットは
　俺にすごく優しいぜ）

fields.EN:
(Unlike the others, she does notice me,
even if there's not much to look at.)
fields.JP:
（そもそも他の奴らと違って、
　この存在感がない俺に
　ちゃんと気づいてくれてるしな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Unlike the others, she does notice me,
even if there's not much to look at.)

fields.JP:
（で、なんか知らんが世話を焼いてくれる。
　お節介とも思うけど、これはこれで
　なんだかんだ嬉しいもんだ）

fields.EN:
(Plus, she's super soft and smells like
heaven, so no complaints from me.)
fields.JP:
（そうそう、身体がめっちゃ柔らかくて、
　すごくいい匂いがするのもポイントが高い）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Plus, she's super soft and smells like
heaven, so no complaints from me.)

fields.EN:
(Even the name Mary...came from her.
Maybe Charlotte likes me after all.)
fields.JP:
（しかもこの『メアリー』って名前まで
　つけてくれた。やっぱシャーロットは
　俺のことが好きなんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even the name Mary...came from her.
Maybe Charlotte likes me after all.)

fields.EN:
(Oh! Wait, could this mean that if I start
becoming recognized, I'd be popular?!)
fields.JP:
（……はっ！？
　もしかしてちゃんと認識されれば、
　俺って人気者なんじゃね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh! Wait, could this mean that if I start
becoming recognized, I'd be popular?!)

fields.EN:
(Of course, my rampant popularity could
mean chaos for mankind, so perhaps my
current situation works for now...)
fields.JP:
（そうだよ、モテすぎて人類のバランスを
　崩しかねないから、こうして存在感を
　マイナス調整されてるに違いない……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Of course, my rampant popularity could
mean chaos for mankind, so perhaps my
current situation works for now...)

fields.EN:
(Well, it's not like I need to be noticed.
I've got plenty of free time as-is.)
fields.JP:
（まあ、存在感なんてなくて
　一向に構わないんだけどな。
　俺は静かに過ごせればそれでいい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, it's not like I need to be noticed.
I've got plenty of free time as-is.)

fields.EN: (Still, why do I have to go to the surface?)
fields.JP:
（っつーのに、なんで地上になんか
　行かなきゃならんのだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Still, why do I have to go to the surface?)

fields.EN:
(Since everyone else is going, Charlotte
claimed we wouldn't get food delivered,
which is why I joined her...)
fields.JP:
（みんな地上に行くから今までの場所に
　いても食料の配給はされない、って
　シャーロットが言うから渋々来たけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Since everyone else is going, Charlotte
claimed we wouldn't get food delivered,
which is why I joined her...)

fields.EN:
(But I see no need to leave the Liberated
District, but maybe that's out of habit...
What a bore.)
fields.JP:
（正直、住み慣れた解放地区から
　動くなんて気が進まないんだよなぁ……。
　めんどくさ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I see no need to leave the Liberated
District, but maybe that's out of habit...
What a bore.)

fields.EN:
Hey Otsuu-chan, do you think lots of people
really live on the surface?
fields.JP:
ねえ、おつうちゃん、
地上にはいっぱい人がいるかなぁ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Otsuu, do you think lots of people
really live on the surface?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Sure, seems reasonable to think there are
plenty who truly know how to live up there.
fields.JP:
そうだね、きっとたくさんの人が
頑張って生きてると思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, seems reasonable to think there are
plenty who truly know how to live up there.

fields.EN:
Anyways, my princess, if you keep moving,
your head will be upside down.
fields.JP:
それよりも姫、そんなに動いたら
頭逆さまになってしまうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyways, my princess, if you keep moving,
your head will be upside down.

fields.EN:
Then, to keep that from happening, how about you
carry me, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
じゃあそうならないように、
おつうちゃんがわたしを抱っこする、
っていうのはどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case, how about you carry me as
a precautionary measure?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
While it is true that part of my duty
includes carrying you, Princess, everyone
is watching...
fields.JP:
姫を抱っこするのは
確かに僕の役目だけども、
みんな見てるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
While it is true that part of my duty
includes carrying you, Princess, everyone
is watching...

fields.EN:
My, Otsuu-chan. You have no problem with
chivalry, but the moment I put you to
the hilt, you blush.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、自分では
平気でそういうこと言うのに、
言われると照れるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, Otsuu. You have no problem with
chivalry, but the moment I put you to
the hilt, you blush.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(I mean, that's how Charlotte and I could
look, easily! ...Not that I'd want that.)
fields.JP:
（つーか、俺とシャーロットも
　あんな風に見えてるかもしれないし！）
　……いや、見られても困るな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I mean, that's how Charlotte and I could
look, easily! ...Not that I'd want that.)

fields.EN:
Why not, Tsuu? Everyone already knows you and
Ningyohime-san are together.
fields.JP:
いいんじゃない、つう。
君と人魚姫さんの仲はもう
みんな公認なんだしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not, Otsuu? Everyone knows you
two are thick as thieves.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10). | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I know, Jack, but nonetheless I can't control
my own face.
fields.JP:
ジャック、そうは言っても、
やっぱり照れるじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, Jack, but nonetheless I can't control
my own face.

fields.EN:
Seeing the two of you together
always brings a smile to our faces.
fields.JP:
２人が仲良くしてるのを見てると、
僕もみんなも、嬉しい気持ちになるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing the two of you together
always brings a smile to our faces.

fields.EN:
Good thing we worked our butts off
to escape from Jail.
fields.JP:
頑張って地下ジェイルを脱獄して
よかったなって思えるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good thing we worked our butts off
to escape from Jail.

fields.EN: (Whoa! Just where does he get off?!)
fields.JP: （うっわ、サラッと言ってのけやがった！？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Whoa! Just where does he get off?!)

fields.EN:
(What a goodie two-shoes! All that joy's
gonna make me sick! Give it a rest.)
fields.JP:
（良い子ちゃんかよ！　
　しかも、どんだけ前向きなんだよ！
　引くわー、マジで引くわー）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a goodie two-shoes! All that joy's
gonna make me sick! Give it a rest.)

fields.EN:
(No chance in Hell would I be their friend.
Seriously. No way.)
fields.JP:
（ぜーったい仲良くなれねえ。
　間違いないから。ほんと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No chance in Hell would I be their friend.
Seriously. No way.)

fields.EN:
(Gotta admit, people seem magnetically
drawn to guys him. Unlike me.)
fields.JP:
（だけど、こういうやつの周りには、
　自然と人が集まってくるんだよなー。
　俺とは大違いだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gotta admit, people seem magnetically
drawn to guys him. Unlike me.)

fields.JP: （いや、ぜんぜん、まったく羨ましくないけど）

fields.EN:
(Responsibilities and all that crap,
looking out for other people. Yaaaawn,
couldn't pay me to do that. Seriously.)
fields.JP:
（責任だのなんだの、みんなに気を遣って
　めちゃくちゃ大変そうだわ。
　無理。マジで無理）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Responsibilities and all that crap,
looking out for other people. Yaaaawn,
couldn't pay me to do that. Seriously.)

fields.EN:
(Hmph. Being alone is primetime.
Only babies need other people.)
fields.JP:
（ふん、やっぱひとりが最高だな。
　ひとりになれない奴は半端モノだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hmph. Being alone is primetime.
Only babies need other people.)

fields.EN:
(I mean, I guess I could talk to them
or whatever.)
fields.JP:
（ま、話しかけてくるなら、
　相手してやらないこともないけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I mean, I guess I could talk to them
or whatever.)

fields.EN:
(If I really set my mind to it, I could easily
attract others and make friends.)
fields.JP:
（あの程度のコミュニケーション、
　俺だって少し頑張れば余裕だし？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I really set my mind to it, I could easily
attract others and make friends.)

fields.EN:
Mary, looks like we're about to reach the
surface.
fields.JP: メアリー、もう少しで地上だそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, looks like we're about to reach the
surface.

fields.EN: Hehe... No, I actually couldn't. Yup.
fields.JP:
くふ、くふふ……
いややっぱり無理です、はい
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe... No, I actually couldn't. Yup.

fields.EN:
Oh, um, the grub on the surface. I was...
thinking to myself that food might be
a little scarce, so I need to stay sharp.
fields.JP:
あ、いや、地上での食料配給も
その……段々無理が出てくるだろうから、
頑張んなきゃ……って思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, um, the grub on the surface. I was...
thinking to myself that food might be
a little scarce, so I need to stay sharp.

fields.EN:
Look at you thinking about the surface,
on top of being so considerate...
fields.JP:
もう地上に着いてからのことを考えてるのね。
しかも他の人たちのことまで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at you thinking about the surface,
on top of being so considerate...

fields.EN:
Onee-chan is touched! Let's do our best
together!
fields.JP:
お姉ちゃん、感動しちゃった。
一緒に頑張りましょうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: How touching! We're in this together!

fields.EN:
(Oh, crap. Spare me the sentimental
mumbo-jumbo.)
fields.JP:
（やっべー、なんかすっげー面倒なこと
　やる流れになっちまったー）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, crap. Spare me the sentimental
mumbo-jumbo.)

fields.EN: (I'm a fool. Maybe this needs more thought.)
fields.JP: （俺のバカー、もうちょっと考えろー）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'm a fool. Maybe this needs more thought.)

fields.EN:
(But if Charlotte's happy, that's good
enough for me.)
fields.JP:
（まあ、でも、シャーロットが
　喜んでるからいいか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if Charlotte's happy, that's good
enough for me.)

fields.EN:
Hey, that must be light from the surface.
Almost there, Mary.
fields.JP:
あ、地上の淵が見えてきたわ。
楽しみね、メアリー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, that must be light from the surface.
Almost there, Mary.

fields.EN:
(There's no telling what's waiting for us
up there, but hopefully, it's quiet...)
fields.JP:
（地上がどんな場所か想像もつかないけど、
　静かに過ごしたいなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no telling what's waiting for us
up there, but hopefully, it's quiet...)

fields.JP: あ、あれもしかして、全部、し、死体……
見ては駄目よ、メアリー

fields.EN:
(How in the world can she expect me
to ignore all those bodies?!)
fields.JP:
（つってもあんな山みたいな量の
　死体なんて、嫌でも目に入るって！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How in the world can she expect me
to ignore all those bodies?!)

fields.EN:
(Like, really? Looks like we made the
wrong choice to come up...)
fields.JP:
（いや、どう考えてもこれ、
　地上に来たの確実に失敗だろ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Like, really? Looks like we made the
wrong choice to come up...)

fields.EN:
(I was 100% right. The Liberated District
is waaaaay safer. Maybe we can still turn
around... Huh? What's that?)
fields.JP:
（１００％断言できる。
　地下の解放地区にいた方が絶対いいって。
　今から戻れないか……ん？　なんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was 100% right. The Liberated District
is waaaaay safer. Maybe we can still turn
around... Huh? What's that?)

fields.EN: What's the matter? I hear a commotion.
fields.JP:
どうしたのかしら？
なんだか騒がしいわね
fields.LOCALIZED: What's the matter? I hear a commotion.

fields.JP: （騒がしいっつーか、なんか揉めてる？）
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Found a huuuman.
All right, everyone. Give your blood to me ★
fields.JP:
人間はっけーんっ。
ほらほら、みんな血をちょうだい★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Found a huuuman.
All right, everyone. Give your blood to me ★

fields.JP: やめてっ、痛いっ……がああっ！
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.JP: 新鮮な血……あはっ、美味しい♪

fields.EN:
(Who's that madwoman, and what is
she holding...? Is that a weapon?)
fields.JP:
（なんだよあの頭オカシイ女は……。
　しかもえらくゴツイ武器……武器だよな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Who's that madwoman, and what is
she holding...? Is that a weapon?)

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Now, who's next? I think I fancy myself
a girl...
fields.JP:
さーて次は誰にしよっかなー。
今、女の子を殺したい気分なんだよね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, who's next? I think I fancy myself
a girl...

fields.JP: ああ、あの、や、やめてくださ……
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Oh, lookie here. Your blood looks divine.
fields.JP:
あっ、あそこにいるじゃーん。
美味しそうな血をしてそう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, lookie here. Your blood looks divine.

fields.EN: (Ah, duh. That nutter couldn't see me!)
fields.JP:
（そ、そうか、たぶんあのゴツイ武器の奴、
　俺のことが見えてないんだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ah, duh. That nutter couldn't see me!)

fields.EN:
(She mentioned wanting a girl, but she
missed the one right in front of her!)
fields.JP:
（女の子を殺したいとか言っちゃって、
　目の前にいる美少女の俺をスルーしてやんの！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She mentioned wanting a girl, but she
missed the one right in front of her!)

fields.EN:
(Haha! Don't underestimate my lack
of presence! Idiot! Idiot!)
fields.JP:
（ははっ！　この俺の存在感のなさ
　舐めんなよ！　バーカバーカ！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haha! Don't underestimate my lack
of presence! Idiot! Idiot!)

fields.JP: グレーテル！　し、しっかりして下さい～
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
I just want to sample your blood★
Ah... MMM...MM?!
fields.JP:
さーて、あなたの血はどんな味かなー★
チュパ……ん～……んんっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just want to sample your blood★
Ah... MMM...MM?!

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Agh, gross! What is that? Disgusting!
fields.JP:
まずっ！？　なにこれっ！？
ちょーまずいんですけど！
fields.LOCALIZED: Agh, gross! What is that? Disgusting!

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: I had such high hopes, but I've been duped!
fields.JP: めっちゃ期待してたのに、ダマされたじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: I had such high hopes, but I've been duped!

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Argh! You've pissed me off. How dare
they trick Iron Maiden. You're gonna
beg for death when I'm done with you!
fields.JP:
あー、もうムカつく！
このアイアン・メイデンをダマして、
ふつーに殺してもらえると思うなよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh! You've pissed me off. How dare
they trick Iron Maiden. You're gonna
beg for death when I'm done with you!

fields.EN:
(So her name is Iron Maiden.
Man, I hope to never see her again.)
fields.JP:
（あいつの名前はアイアン・メイデンって
　いうのか……。マジで二度と関わりたくねえ奴だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So her name is Iron Maiden.
Man, I hope to never see her again.)

fields.EN:
(Looks like she's fighting members of
the escape team, though. Bet they'll
buy me plenty of time.)
fields.JP:
（でもちょうど地上脱出の
　中心メンバーが戦うみたいだ。
　じゃあ一般人よりは時間稼いでくれんだろ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like she's fighting members of
the escape team, though. Bet they'll
buy me plenty of time.)

fields.EN:
How can you be so cruel? What are you
even trying to accomplish...?
fields.JP:
いきなり現れてこんなことして、
あんたいったい何がしたいのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can you be so cruel? What are you
even trying to accomplish...?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious?! I want to...
Kill★You★All!
fields.JP:
そんなの決まってるじゃん！
み・な・ご・ろ・し★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious?! I want to...
Kill★You★All!

fields.EN:
(Don't mind me passing through!
Time to make a run for it! It'd be
pointless to die now.)
fields.JP:
（そのままこっちに気づくなよ……！
　よし今のうちに逃げよう！
　命あっての物種だからな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't mind me passing through!
Time to make a run for it! It'd be
pointless to die now.)

fields.JP: あなた、よくもやってくれましたわね！！
輪っかのような武器の少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Argh! One after the other! You vermin!
fields.JP: あーもう、次から次へとめんどくさいなあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Argh! One after the other! You vermin!

fields.JP: くららーーーー！　しらゆきーーーー！

fields.EN:
(Shoot, it's chaos everywhere I turn.
Give me a break... I gotta jet.)
fields.JP:
（やばっ、あちこちで同じような
　ことが起きてるみたいだ。
　マジかよ、すぐに逃げないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot, it's chaos everywhere I turn.
Give me a break... I gotta jet.)

fields.EN:
(Huh? Where'd Charlotte go?
She was just here a second ago.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　シャーロットはどこだ？
　そのへんにいたはずだけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Where'd Charlotte go?
She was just here a second ago.)

fields.JP:
大丈夫ですか？　しっかりして下さい。
ほら、立てますか？

fields.EN:
Wh-What the hell is she doing?!
We gotta go...or we're done for!
fields.JP:
ななっ、何してんだ……！
逃げないとっ……やられる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What the hell is she doing?!
We gotta go...or we're done for!

fields.EN:
No, I can't let this one go. Forget about
me, Mary. Go ahead and get to safety!
fields.JP:
駄目よ、さすがに見過ごせないわ。
私のことはいいからメアリー、
あなただけでも逃げなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I can't let this one go. Forget about
me, Mary. Go ahead and get to safety!

fields.EN: Hurry up, go! I'll be right behind you.
fields.JP:
いいから行って！
私もこの人たちと一緒に後から追い掛けるから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hurry up, go! I'll be right behind you.

fields.EN:
(No, I'm not abandoning her. We're
doing what we have to.)
fields.JP:
（違う、これは見捨てたんじゃない。
　それぞれがするべきことをしただけなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No, I'm not abandoning her. We're
doing what we have to.)

fields.EN:
(I couldn't have done anything if I
stayed. Actually, I would've gotten
in the way.)
fields.JP:
（俺が残っても何もできることはないし、
　むしろ足手まといになったかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I couldn't have done anything if I
stayed. Actually, I would've gotten
in the way.)

fields.EN: (Plus, Charlotte told me so! I'm going!)
fields.JP:
（何より、これはシャーロットの指示なんだ。
　これが正しい選択なんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Plus, Charlotte told me so! I'm going!)

fields.EN: Stop it! Don't kill anyone else!
fields.JP:
やめて！　もうこれ以上
みんなを殺さないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop it! Don't kill anyone else!

fields.EN:
Oop, sorry. I don't take requests★
Plus, when you make your eyes get
all big like that, I only want to play more.
fields.JP:
残念だけどぉ……それって逆効果っ★
そーんな顔で言われたらぁ……むしろ
いたぶり殺したくなっちゃう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oop, sorry. I don't take requests★
Plus, when you make your eyes get
all big like that, I only want to play more.

fields.EN:
(What? How did she murder the escape
team so quickly?)
fields.JP:
（なっ、もしかしてあの中心メンバーども、
　秒で負けたっつーのか！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What? How did she murder the escape
team so quickly?)

fields.JP:
（シャーロット！　他のやつなんてどうでもいい！
　シャーロットだけは……！）
ねえ、あなたひとりなの？

fields.EN: Wha? Y-Yes... You can see me...?
fields.JP:
ふぇっ？　そ、そうですけど……
わわ、わたしのこと、
み、見えるんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha? Y-Yes... You can see me...?

fields.EN:
Of course. You're not a ghost! Anyway,
I made too much food, so you want to
share some with me?
fields.JP:
幽霊じゃあるまいし、当たり前じゃない。
それでね、ご飯作り過ぎちゃったんだけど、
よかったら一緒に食べてくれない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. You're not a ghost! Anyway,
I made too much food, so you want to
share some with me?

fields.JP:
えっ……い、いい……
いいんです……か……？

fields.EN:
I'm the one who offered. Won't you join me?
Thank you! You're doing me a huge favor.
fields.JP:
お願いしてるのは私の方よ。
じゃあ食べてくれるのね？
ありがとう、助かったわ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm the one who offered. Won't you join me?
Thank you! You're doing me a huge favor.

fields.EN:
(Oh, I know! I've played out this scenario
in my head tons of times!)
fields.JP:
（そ、そうだ！
　こんなシチュエーション、
　さんざん妄想してきたじゃないか！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I know! I've played out this scenario
in my head tons of times!)

fields.EN:
(One time, a militia occupied the Liberated
District, capturing Charlotte and other
civilians. I was the only one who could move.)
fields.JP:
（武装集団によって占拠された解放地区……
　囚われのシャーロットたち住民……
　動けるのは俺１人だけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(One time, a militia occupied the Liberated
District, capturing Charlotte and other
civilians. I was the only one who could move.)

fields.EN:
(With the cards stacked against me, I had
a special power! Alas, their bullets couldn't
hit me!)
fields.JP:
（圧倒的不利な状況の中、
　しかし俺には異能力があった……！
　そう、銃弾なんてかすりもしない！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With the cards stacked against me, I had
a special power! Alas, their bullets couldn't
hit me!)

fields.EN:
(With this ability and my quick thinking,
I can rescue Charlotte and be the district's
coolest hero!)
fields.JP:
（この能力と冷静な判断力で、俺は
　クールにシャーロットたちを助け出して、
　一躍解放地区のヒーローに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With this ability and my quick thinking,
I can rescue Charlotte and be the district's
coolest hero!)

fields.EN:
(That's right! Time to do it again!
Well, I might not have an "ability,"
but I AM a quick thinker!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、これと同じことをすれば……！
　いや、そんな便利な異能力はないけど、
　冷静な判断力、これだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right! Time to do it again!
Well, I might not have an "ability,"
but I AM a quick thinker!)

fields.EN: What the...? What happened to my powers?
fields.JP:
なんなの……？
急に力が入らなくなっ……
fields.LOCALIZED: What the...? What happened to my powers?

fields.EN: (Huh? Funny, looks like she's in pain.)
fields.JP:
（ん、何だ？　あいつ
　急に苦しみだしたぞ？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Huh? Funny, looks like she's in pain.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe this is my chance...? It is!
It's now or never!)
fields.JP:
（もしかしこれはチャンスなんじゃ……？
　そうだよな、チャンスだよな！
　よし、今だ――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe this is my chance...? It is!
It's now or never!)

fields.EN:
(What now?! Something's coming from
that mountain of bodies!)
fields.JP:
（こ、今度は何なんだよ！
　あの死体の山から……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What now?! Something's coming from
that mountain of bodies!)

fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……。
ようやく力が、戻った……

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... Ugh! I'm pissed!
Gotta sip some yummy blood to quench
my thirst★
fields.JP:
はぁはぁ……んもー！　いらいらする！
おいしい血でも飲んできぶんてんかんだぞ★
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... Ugh! I'm pissed!
Gotta sip some yummy blood to quench
my thirst★

fields.JP:
ひいぃぃっ、挟まないで……やめっ……
ぐぎゃあああああっ！！

fields.EN:
Ah, refreshing. Human blood has a certain
je ne sais quoi★
fields.JP:
ああ、美味しい～。
やっぱり人間の血って大人の味だね★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, refreshing. Human blood has a certain
je ne sais quoi★

fields.EN:
(Oh, crap crap crap! Charlotte's gonna
be killed any second now!)
fields.JP:
（ヤバイヤバイヤバイヤバイ……！
　シャーロットがやられるのも
　時間の問題だ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, crap crap crap! Charlotte's gonna
be killed any second now!)

fields.EN: (Damn it! I can't just abandon her!)
fields.JP:
（くそっ！　シャーロットを見捨てる
　なんて、できるわけねえだろ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Damn it! I can't just abandon her!)

fields.EN:
(I'm the only one who can rescue her.
Time to go!)
fields.JP:
（この状況を救えるのは俺だけだ、
　とにかく行くしかない！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm the only one who can rescue her.
Time to go!)

fields.JP: いやあああああああああああああああああっ！

fields.EN:
Don't die! You CAN'T DIE!
Alice! ALIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIICE!
fields.JP:
死んじゃダメ、あなたは死んじゃダメなのよ！
アリス！　アリスううううううっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't die! You CAN'T DIE!
Alice! ALIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIICE!

fields.EN:
Ew, gross. Did she finally lose her mind?
Super gross★
fields.JP:
うっわ、なんなのこいつー。
ついに狂っちゃったの？　ふつーにキモーい★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ew, gross. Did she finally lose her mind?
Super gross★

fields.EN:
(Gross doesn't cut it! I've never seen
Charlotte like this!)
fields.JP:
（キモいとかそんなレベルじゃねぇ！
　あんなシャーロット初めて見た！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gross doesn't cut it! I've never seen
Charlotte like this!)

fields.EN:
(I-I have to do whatever it takes to save
her!)
fields.JP: （と、とにかくシャーロットだけでも……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I-I have to do whatever it takes to save
her!)

fields.JP:
しゃ、シャーロット、
一緒に……に、逃げ……

そんな……ダメよ……ダメ……
ダメダメダメだめだめだめだめえええええっ！

fields.EN:
(Damn, she can't hear me! What do I do?
What CAN I do?!)
fields.JP:
（くそっ、聞こえてねぇ！
　どうすりゃいい！　どうすりゃいいんだよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn, she can't hear me! What do I do?
What CAN I do?!)

fields.EN:
She's yucky, annoying, and her blood stinks.
Where's a girl to get a drink around here?★
fields.JP:
キモいし、ウザいし、血は美味しくないし。
なーんかもーやる気でねー★
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's yucky, annoying, and her blood stinks.
Where's a girl to get a drink around here?★

fields.EN:
(A-Are we about to die for absolutely
nothing?! I-I don't wanna!)
fields.JP:
（こ、こんな訳わからねぇ状態で死ぬのか……！？
　い、いやだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A-Are we about to die for absolutely
nothing?! I-I don't wanna!)

fields.JP: なっ！？　空をとびはじめた！

fields.EN:
(Not just me, Charlotte is too, along with
the other survivors! All of us!)
fields.JP:
（つーか、俺だけじゃない、
　シャーロットや他の生きてる奴らも
　みんなだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not just me, Charlotte is too, along with
the other survivors! All of us!)

fields.EN:
(Won't someone explain what's going
on?! Seriously!)
fields.JP:
（なんだこれなんだこれ！
　マジでなんだこれー！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Won't someone explain what's going
on?! Seriously!)

fields.EN:
SHEEEESH! NO FAIR! You can't just
fly off! Get down here!
fields.JP:
もおおおお！　突然飛ぶなんてずるいじゃん！
降りてこいってのー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
SHEEEESH! NO FAIR! You can't just
fly off! Get down here!

fields.EN:
(I don't know how to get down!
ARGH! What the HELL is happening?!)
fields.JP:
（降り方なんて知らねえよ！
　あーもう、いったい何だってんだよ！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know how to get down!
ARGH! What the HELL is happening?!)

fields.EN:
DAMN IT! I NEVER should've come up
to the surface!
fields.JP:
くっそぉぉぉぉっ！　地上なんて
来るんじゃなかったーーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
DAMN IT! I NEVER should've come up
to the surface!

fields.EN:
H-Hey sisters, was there something
you wished to tell me?
fields.JP: ね、姉さんたち……お話ってなあに？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey sisters, was there something
you wished to tell me?

fields.EN:
Don't even get me started. Iron Maiden,
Kubitsuridai, what do you ladies think?
fields.JP:
まさか、そんなことも分かってないとは。
アイアン・メイデン、首吊り台、
どう思いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't even get me started. Iron Maiden,
Gallows, what do you ladies think?

fields.EN:
Yeaaaah. Geez Hiaburibashira, you sure took your
sweet time killing, didn't you? ★
fields.JP:
はーい、火あぶり柱ったら
さっきの集落での殺し、サボってたよねー★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeaaaah. Geez Pyre, you sure took your
sweet time killing, didn't you? ★

fields.EN: But you failed to kill a single target.
fields.JP: だけど、ただの１人も殺してなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: But you failed to kill a single target.

fields.EN:
Exactly. You better not make a habit of that,
got it?
fields.JP:
そういうことです。
まさか、それでいいなどと思っている
わけではないでしょうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. You better not make a habit of that,
got it?

fields.EN:
O-Of course not! That's...
Well, I'm just finding my rhythm!
fields.JP:
あ、当たり前じゃん！　あれは……
そう、ちょっと気分がのらなかっただけなんだからっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course not! That's...
Well, I'm just finding my rhythm!

fields.EN:
Your rhythm? Do you think that excuses
your inability to follow Master's orders?
fields.JP:
気分がのらない？
そんな理由で、マスターからのご命令を
無視したというの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your rhythm? Do you think that excuses
your inability to follow Master's orders?

fields.EN:
WHEN I ASK YOU A QUESTION,
I EXPECT AN IMMEDIATE RESPONSE!
fields.JP:
私の質問には素早く丁寧に、
はっきりと答えなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
WHEN I ASK YOU A QUESTION,
I EXPECT AN IMMEDIATE RESPONSE!

fields.EN:
I-I'm sorry, Guillotine-neesan!
I'll do better next time!
fields.JP:
ごごっ、ごめんなさいギロチン姉さん！
次はちゃんとやるからっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm sorry, Sister Guillotine!
I'll do better next time!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.EN:
Yeah, right. Second chances mean squat
when we can't count on you to do it
right the first time.
fields.JP:
どうだかね。次こそは～とか、
やればできる～なんて言ってる奴は、
いつまでも出来るわけないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, right. Second chances mean squat
when we can't count on you to do it
right the first time.

fields.EN:
Sheesh. The mere sight of you irks me,
useless junk.
fields.JP:
ほんっと、マジ見ててムカつくわよね、
このクソ雑魚ってば
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sheesh. The mere sight of you irks me,
useless junk.

fields.EN:
Hehe★ Nothing like the taste of fresh blood★
Mweheheh...
fields.JP:
あはっ★　人を殺すのってこーんな
気持ちいいコトなのにね～★　うへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe★ Nothing like the taste of fresh blood★
Mweheheh...

fields.EN:
Hey Mei-neesan, I don't mind you lapping up blood,
but could you watch the splatter?
You're ruining my outfit.
fields.JP:
ちょっとメイ姉さん、血を舐めるのは
いいけど、こっちに飛ばさないでよ。
服が汚れちゃうじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Mei, I don't mind you lapping up blood,
but could you watch the splatter?
You're ruining my outfit.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
Don't sweat the small stuff. Hey,
Kubitsuri-chan, why don't you lick it too?
It's tasty~!
fields.JP:
細かいことは気にしない気にしないっ。
ってか首吊りチャンも舐めれば？
美味しいよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to be so prissy. Don't you want
a taste, Gallows? A yummy sample?

fields.EN:
I'll pass. Human blood is common swill.
Wringing their corpses is good enough.
fields.JP:
いらないわよ。
血なんて人間が垂れ流すただの汁じゃない
いっぱい搾れればそれでいいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll pass. Human blood is common swill.
Wringing their corpses is good enough.

fields.EN:
Hiaburibashira, you need to mind your place.
Our objective is to see Master's plans
through to completion.
fields.JP:
火あぶり柱、あなたはもっと自覚を持ちなさい
私たちはマスターの理想を実現させるための
ただの道具なのです。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre, you need to mind your place.
Our objective is to see Master's plans
through to completion.

fields.EN:
Master's happiness is our happiness.
So too is his anger on our hands.
fields.JP:
マスターの喜びが私たちの喜び。
マスターの怒りは私たちの罪。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Master's happiness is our happiness.
So too is his anger on our hands.

fields.EN:
Tools must be useful, lest they become
obsolete. Never forget that.
fields.JP:
道具は優秀でなければただの塵。
決して忘れてはなりませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tools must be useful, lest they become
obsolete. Never forget that.

fields.JP: わ、分かったわ……ギロチン姉さん
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.EN:
(That's right... Hiaburibashira has to learn to
kill people properly.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ……火あぶり柱も
　ちゃんと人を殺さなきゃ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That's right... I have to kill people.)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(All of my memories are gone. When I
awoke, all I knew was I am Hiaburibashira of
the group Genocide Pink.)
fields.JP:
（自分には昔の記憶なんかなくて、
　目覚めた時はもう処刑台少女の
　『火あぶり柱』で……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All of my memories are gone. When I
awoke, all I knew was I am Pyre of
the group Massacre Pink.)
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Hiaburibashira; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(If Hiaburibashira lets down Papa and her
sisters, who look after her like this, maybe
they'll abandon Hiaburibashira someday...)
fields.JP:
（そんな自分の面倒を見てくれる
　パパや姉さんたちの期待を裏切ったら、
　いつか火あぶり柱は捨てられちゃうかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I mean, I'm under the custody of Papa
and my sisters. If I let them down, they
may abandon me...)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: （だめだめ、そんなこと考えちゃ）

fields.EN:
(Hiaburibashira has trained and studied every
day to kill people. Of course Hiaburibashira
can do it too.)
fields.JP:
（毎日人を殺すための
　訓練と教育を受けてきたんだ。
　火あぶり柱にだってできるに決まってる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have been training under their tutelage
every day to become a killing machine.
I know what I'm capable of.)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Listen up, you three. There's no room for
error in our next mission. Burn those words
into your brain.
fields.JP:
いいですか３人とも。
次の命令も決して失敗は許されません。
心してかかるようになさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen up, you three. There's no room for
error in our next mission. Burn those words
into your brain.

fields.EN:
Mei-neesan, don't get carried away again,
okay?
fields.JP:
メイ姉さん、殺す相手
間違っちゃ駄目だからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Mei, don't get carried away again,
okay?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
I know, I know★
I just don't want to upset Sister Guilla!
fields.JP:
分かってるってば★
ギロ姉チャンに叱られたくないし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, I know★
I just don't want to upset Sister Guilla!

fields.JP:
（そうだ、パパの話だと、
　これから目の前の大穴から
　大勢の人間が出てくるんだ……）

fields.EN:
(Among them is a girl named Alice, whom
I must capture. The rest...we kill.)
fields.JP:
（その中に『アリス』って女の人がいるから、
　その人だけ捕まえて後は、全員……殺す）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Among them is a girl named Alice, whom
I must capture. The rest...we kill.)

fields.EN:
(But can we say for sure that it's the
people we're looking for? How does
he know?)
fields.JP:
（でも、本当にこんな大穴から
　人が出てきたりするのかな？
　どうしてそんなこと分かるんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But can we say for sure that it's the
people we're looking for? How does
he know?)

fields.EN:
You listening, Hiaburibashira? That goes double for
you.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと聞いてますか、火あぶり柱。
特にあなたに言っているんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You listening, Pyre? That goes double for
you.

fields.EN:
I-I'll do better this time!
Watch me, guys! I'll blow your minds!
fields.JP:
つ、次はちゃんとやるわ！
見てて、姉さんたちもきっと驚くから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'll do better this time!
Watch me, guys! I'll blow your minds!

fields.EN:
Sure, you say this time, but you should've
been ready from the jump. Man, you really
are useless.
fields.JP:
次とか言ってないで最初っからやれってのよ。
ほんと、使えないったらないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, you say this time, but you should've
been ready from the jump. Man, you really
are useless.

fields.JP: 首吊りちゃん、きっびしー。

fields.EN: My, those humans were quite noisy earlier.
fields.JP: だって、さっきは人間がいっぱい騒ぐから……
fields.LOCALIZED: My, those humans were quite noisy earlier.

fields.EN:
Humans are pathetic and loud, especially
when they beg for mercy. One hit and they
squeal, but choking them is...pure poetry.
fields.JP:
人間たちの命乞いなど、ただの雑音です。
殴れば音がする。首を刎ねれば汁が出る。
その程度のことでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Humans are pathetic and loud, especially
when they beg for mercy. One hit and they
squeal, but choking them is...pure poetry.

fields.EN:
(Guillotine-neesan terrifies me.
She murdered someone crying out for
their life without blinking.)
fields.JP:
（ギロチン姉さんは本当に怖い……。
　さっきの集落でも、命乞いする人間を
　平然と殺してまわっていた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sister Guillotine terrifies me.
She murdered someone crying out for
their life without blinking.)
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.EN:
(She has no regard for life, it's all junk
to her. I shudder to think how she acts
when she's actually mad.)
fields.JP:
（それこそ、塵をどかすみたいに。
　でも、本当に怖いのは姉さんが怒った時だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has no regard for life, it's all junk
to her. I shudder to think how she acts
when she's actually mad.)

fields.EN:
(If anyone spoke ill of Papa even a little,
 killing them all wouldn't have been the end of it.)
fields.JP:
（ほんの少しでもパパを悪く言われたなら、
　皆殺しどころじゃすまかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Were anyone to speak ill of Papa,
they would invoke a fate worse than
a massacre.)

fields.EN:
(There would be nothing left of them.
Slashed beyond recognition.)
fields.JP:
（それこそ、死体も残らないくらいに
　細切れにされていただろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There would be nothing left of them.
Slashed beyond recognition.)

fields.EN:
Exterminate the insects before they make
noise. The most efficient method of disposal.
fields.JP:
虫ケラは五月蠅く騒ぐ前に駆除。
それが最もスマートで効率的な殺し方です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exterminate the insects before they make
noise. The most efficient method of disposal.

fields.EN:
Aw. Mei's a real human whisperer.
You seem to have good luck catching
'em, don't you?
fields.JP:
えー、メイは人間と喋るの好きだけどな～。
たまに面白い奴とかいるじゃん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. Mei's a real human whisperer.
You seem to have good luck catching
'em, don't you?

fields.EN:
"I don't care what happens to me, but
please, spare my wife and children!"
I love those!
fields.JP:
自分はどうなってもいいから、妻と子供だけは～。
っていうヤツ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
"I don't care what happens to me, but
please, spare my wife and children!"
I love those!

fields.EN:
Little do they know that wives and the
children have the sweetest, mildest flavor.
Delicious★
fields.JP:
そういう妻と子供の血はたいてい、
甘くてまろやかで美味しいんだよねー★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little do they know that wives and the
children have the sweetest, mildest flavor.
Delicious★

fields.EN:
Of course, slaying a father in front of his
wife and children is the most indelible
treat of all!
fields.JP:
でもでも、いっちばんのご馳走は妻と子供を
目の前で殺された旦那だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, slaying a father in front of his
wife and children is the most indelible
treat of all!

fields.EN:
OHHHH! Such a bold and savory delight,
with only a hint of bitterness. Hehehe...
*slurp*...
fields.JP:
それはもうとろりと濃厚で、
微かに苦みがあって～
うへへ……じゅるり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
OHHHH! Such a bold and savory delight,
with only a hint of bitterness. Hehehe...
*slurp*...

fields.EN:
(Mei-neesan is another beast compared
to Guillotine-neesan...)
fields.JP:
（メイ姉さんはギロチン姉さんとは
　別の意味で恐ろしい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sister Mei is another beast compared
to Sister Guillotine...)
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san; メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN: (Her attitude is that anything's fine as long as it's fun, and she enjoys killing people more than anyone. She also loves drinking the blood of the people she's killed.)
fields.JP:
（楽しければ何でもいいって性格で、
　人を殺すのを誰よりも楽しんでいる。
　それに、殺した人間の血を飲むのが大好き）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She attacks indiscriminately, so long as
it tickles her fancy. She's a sadist who
enjoys drinking the blood of her enemies.)

fields.EN:
(Once when I asked her why she enjoyed
drinking blood, she remarked that it was
part of her skincare routine.)
fields.JP:
（前に、どうして血を飲むのか聞いたことがある。
　そしたら美しさを保つためだって言ってた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once when I asked her why she enjoyed
drinking blood, she remarked that it was
part of her skincare routine.)

fields.EN:
(It never made sense to me. Sounds more
like a convenient excuse.)
fields.JP:
（理由はなくて、ただなんとなく
　そんな気がするから、らしい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It never made sense to me. Sounds more
like a convenient excuse.)

fields.EN:
(I often spot her checking her bangs and
make-up in her hand-mirror, but it seems
her blood-stained mouth never bothers her.)
fields.JP:
（よく手鏡で前髪やメイクを気にしているけど、
　それ以前に口の周りが血まみれなのは
　気にならないんだろうかといつも思う）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I often spot her checking her bangs and
make-up in her hand-mirror, but it seems
her blood-stained mouth never bothers her.)

fields.EN:
Ugh, gross. Human blood is nasty.
Keep it away from me.
fields.JP: 最悪、人間の血なんて汚らしくて触りたくもない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, gross. Human blood is nasty.
Keep it away from me.

fields.EN: Aw, but why? It's so yummy.
fields.JP: ええー、なんでー。おいしーのにー
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, but why? It's so yummy.

fields.EN:
Guillotine-neesan is right. You're better off
killing the humans quickly.
fields.JP:
ギロチン姉さんの言う通り、
人間は騒ぐ前に殺しちゃえばいいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Guillotine is right. You're better off
killing the humans quickly.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.EN:
(She says that, but I've seen Kubitsuri-neesan
speaking to humans just before killing them.)
fields.JP:
（あんなこと言ってるけど、首吊り姉さんは
　よく殺す前に人間とおしゃべりをしている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She says that, but I've seen Sister Gallows
speaking to humans just before killing them.)
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
(Kubitsuri-neesan has a tendency to covet
things other people hold dearest.)
fields.JP:
（首吊り姉さんは人が大事にしているものが
　どうしても欲しくなる癖があるからだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sister Gallows has a tendency to covet
things other people hold dearest.)
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
(Not just things. Accessories, clothes,
beautiful hair, a lover, a child, a mother...
Her desire has no limit.)
fields.JP:
（それは、物だけじゃない。
　アクセサリーや服、綺麗な髪の毛、
　恋人や子供、母親……なんでも欲しくなる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not just things. Accessories, clothes,
beautiful hair, a lover, a child, a mother...
Her desire has no limit.)

fields.EN:
(Once she desires something, she rests
at nothing until she acquires it.)
fields.JP:
（欲しくなったら最後、手に入れるまで
　絶対に諦めないしどんな手段を使ってでも
　手に入れようとする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once she desires something, she rests
at nothing until she acquires it.)

fields.EN: She'd say, 'Give me that and I won't kill you,' take it from them... then once she had it, she'd suddenly lose interest and kill them.
fields.JP:
（「それをくれたら殺さないであげる」
　そう言って、取りあげて……でも手に入れたら
　急に興味がなくなって殺してしまう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
("I'll spare you," she promises them, just
before taking their treasure, but they are
unaware that their lives are already forfeit.)

fields.EN:
(Earlier, in the village, she encountered a
man with stunning eyes, and marked them
as her next target.)
fields.JP:
（さっきの集落でも、瞳の色が綺麗な男の人を
　見つけて欲しくなってた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Earlier, in the village, she encountered a
man with stunning eyes, and marked them
as her next target.)

fields.EN:
("If you want to live," she said, "then choose
me over your wife." So the man yelled at her,
hit her repeatedly, then stomped on her.)
fields.JP:
（死にたくなければ一緒にいた奥さんより
　自分の方を選ぶようにって、何度も何度も
　奥さんを罵倒させて殴らせて踏みつけさせてた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
("If you want to live," she said, "then choose
me over your wife." So the man yelled at her,
hit her repeatedly, then stomped on her.)

fields.EN:
(In the end, however, she strung them
up and killed them off.)
fields.JP: （結局、どっちも吊るして殺しちゃったけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the end, however, she strung them
up and killed them off.)

fields.EN:
Aye, I'm bored. Won't the humans come
out to play?
fields.JP:
あー退屈だわぁ。
早く人間たち出てこないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aye, I'm bored. Won't the humans come
out to play?

fields.EN:
Ugh, I'm losing patience. Not to mention,
staaaarving.
fields.JP:
もー、メイちゃん飽きちゃったー。
お腹も空いたー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, I'm losing patience. Not to mention,
staaaarving.

fields.EN:
That's enough. We must await according
to Master's orders.
fields.JP:
騒がしいですよ。
マスターのために大人しく待っていなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's enough. We must await according
to Master's orders.

fields.EN:
(Guillotine-neesan, Mei-neesan, and Kubitsuri-neesan. How could they take so much
pleasure from hurting others?)
fields.JP:
（ギロチン姉さんもメイ姉さんも
　首吊り姉さんも、３人ともどうしてそんなに
　楽しそうに人を殺せるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sister Guillotine, Sister Mei, and Sister
Gallows. How could they take so much
pleasure from hurting others?)
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san; ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san; メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
(If Hiaburibashira learns to kill properly,
will she start to think it's fun too...?)
fields.JP:
（ちゃんと殺せるようになれば、
　火あぶり柱も楽しいって
　思うようになるのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if I'm any good at killing.
If I'll find enjoyment from it too...)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
（自分はまだ１人も殺せたことがない。
　予行演習っていうさっきの集落だって、
　何もできなかった）

fields.EN:
(That's why, "next time" will be my first
real kill... I wonder if I have what it takes.)
fields.JP:
（だから『人を殺す』のは次が初めてだ。
　……ちゃんとできるかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's why, "next time" will be my first
real kill... I wonder if I have what it takes.)

fields.EN:
(...No, no! I can't think like this.
I HAVE to do it.)
fields.JP:
（……だめだめ！　弱気になんてなっちゃ。
　やらなきゃいけないんだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...No, no! I can't think like this.
I HAVE to do it.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder if I'll end up like my sisters,
with an insatiable appetite for death.)
fields.JP:
（でも、自分も姉さんたちのように、
　人殺しを楽しむようになっちゃうのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if I'll end up like my sisters,
with an insatiable appetite for death.)

fields.EN:
Hiaburibashira, you look like you're getting cold
feet again.
fields.JP:
火あぶり柱。あなた、
まだ怖じ気づいているみたいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre, you look like you're getting cold
feet again.

fields.JP: 違っ、そんなことないわ！

fields.EN: Then keep your head up. That's why you—
fields.JP:
では、うつむくのを止めなさい。
そんなだからあなたは――
fields.LOCALIZED: Then keep your head up. That's why you—

fields.EN:
Hey, LOOK! There's light coming out
of that hole!
fields.JP:
あっ、みんな！
穴からぶわーって光が出てきたよっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, LOOK! There's light coming out
of that hole!

fields.EN: Wow, would you look at that?
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow, would you look at that?

fields.EN:
Stand at the ready, everyone. Be sure not
to execute the wrong target.
fields.JP:
全員、気を引きしめなさい。
絶対に殺し間違いだけはしないように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stand at the ready, everyone. Be sure not
to execute the wrong target.

fields.EN: (It's time... I have to do this.)
fields.JP: （いよいよだ……絶対にやり遂げないと）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It's time... I have to do this.)

fields.JP:
えっ……ギロチン姉さんが
もうアリスって人を見つけた……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...? Sister Guillotine already found
Alice?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.JP: あっ、待ってメイ姉さん、首吊り姉さんっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, wait! Sister Mei! Sister Gallows!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san; メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
(They're gone... Look at them.
Lost in the revelry of heartless murder.)
fields.JP:
（行っちゃった……。姉さんたち、
　あんなに楽しそうに人間を殺して……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're gone... Look at them.
Lost in the revelry of heartless murder.)

fields.EN:
(Now that we've found Alice, the rest must
die. It's up to me this time...)
fields.JP:
（アリスって人を見つけた以上、
　他の人間はもう皆殺し。
　今度こそ自分もやらなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that we've found Alice, the rest must
die. It's up to me this time...)

fields.EN:
(Some of them are running towards me.
All right, I gotta step forward. Can't let
them get away.)
fields.JP:
（何人かこっちに逃げてくる……。
　よし、前に出るんだ。逃がしちゃだめだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Some of them are running towards me.
All right, I gotta step forward. Can't let
them get away.)

fields.EN:
(Aw, I can't do it... I have to hurry,
or they'll escape.)
fields.JP:
（うぅっ、できない……。早くしないと、
　どんどん逃げられちゃうっていうのに！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Aw, I can't do it... I have to hurry,
or they'll escape.)

fields.EN:
(I have to kill these next two,
I must kill...!)
fields.JP:
（せめて次の２人組は
　ちゃんと殺さないと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have to kill these next two,
I must kill...!)

fields.JP: キャスケットの女の子
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: な、何すかこの女の子っ

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
Clara, step back! She's not from the
Liberated District!
fields.JP:
くらら、離れろ！
そいつ解放地区の人間じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, step back! She's not from the
Liberated District!

fields.EN: So she's one of those demons?!
fields.JP: ってことはあの殺人鬼の仲間っすか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: So she's one of those demons?!

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah! Hiaburibashira is Kubitsuridai...
Kubitsuri-neesan's little sister!
fields.JP:
そ、そうよ！　火あぶり柱は首吊り台……
首吊り姉さんの妹なんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yeah, I'm Pyre... Sister Gallows'
little sister!
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Hiaburibashira | Source-gated Kubitsuridai/Kubitsuri-neesan identity restoration.

fields.EN:
H-Hiaburibashira can kill people easily too...!
Just you watch...!
fields.JP:
ひ、火あぶり柱だって
人なんて簡単に殺せるわよ……！
見てなさい見てなさい……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I can wipe you out just like they can!
Just you wait...!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: B-Boss...this doesn't look good at all.
fields.JP:
し、師匠……これ、
かなりマズイ気がするっす……
fields.LOCALIZED: B-Boss...this doesn't look good at all.

fields.EN:
Clara, don't show them your back.
Back up slowly.
fields.JP:
くらら、背中見せずにゆっくり
こっちに来い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, don't show them your back.
Back up slowly.

fields.EN: Hiaburibashira can do it too...! Just watch...!
fields.JP:
やってやるんだから……！
火あぶり柱もできるんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm gonna do it! I'll show you all!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(It's okay. Just need to remember my
training...)
fields.JP: （大丈夫、訓練通りにやるだけよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's okay. Just need to remember my
training...)

fields.EN:
(I need to use this Gore Suit and the weapon.
With them, I'll kill everyone with ease.)
fields.JP:
（このゴアスーツと武器があれば、どんな
　相手だろうと簡単に殺せるんだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to use this Gore Suit and the weapon.
With them, I'll kill everyone with ease.)

fields.EN:
(Look at Guillotine-neesan. She's on a spree.
Just copy whatever she does.)
fields.JP:
（ギロチン姉さんなんて、
　あっちでもっとたくさんの相手をしてる。
　自分も早くそうならないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Look at Sister Guillotine. She's on a spree.
Just copy whatever she does.)
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.EN:
(All right, I got this. Just swing the weapon,
and there'll be a sea of dead bodie—)
fields.JP:
（よし、やるぞ。
　ちょっと振り下ろすだけで
　こいつらなんてすぐ死体に――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All right, I got this. Just swing the weapon,
and there'll be a sea of dead bodie—)

fields.JP: （なんで……どうしてできないの……！）

fields.EN:
Wh-Who the hell are you people?!
Where the hell do you get off?!
fields.JP:
なあ、お前らいったい何者なんだ。
なぜこんな惨いことをする！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Who the hell are you people?!
Where the hell do you get off?!

fields.JP: い、今のは火あぶり柱に言ったの……？
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Who else would I be talking to?
fields.LOCALIZED: Who else would I be talking to?

fields.EN:
Sh-Shut up! Shut UP! Papa commanded me
to kill you guys!
fields.JP:
う、うるさいうるさい！
お前らはパパの命令で死ぬんだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sh-Shut up! Shut UP! Papa commanded me
to kill you guys!

fields.EN:
What the...? Her attacks are slower and
weaker than the others.
fields.JP:
なんだ……？　こいつの攻撃、
さっきの奴に比べたら遅いし
大したことないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the...? Her attacks are slower and
weaker than the others.

fields.EN: Seriously. Even I managed to dodge it.
fields.JP:
そっすね、自分でも
簡単に避けられたくらいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously. Even I managed to dodge it.

fields.EN:
Then again, doesn't seem like we can
reason with her. Let's run for it.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、話が通じる相手じゃなさそうだ。
とりあえず逃げるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, doesn't seem like we can
reason with her. Let's run for it.

fields.EN: Goodness, Hiaburibashira. What's the hold up?
fields.JP:
やぁだ、火あぶり柱ったら
こんなのに手間取ってるのぉ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Goodness, Pyre. What's the hold up?

fields.JP: また別のが来やがった……！

fields.EN: Sh-She was just over there a second ago!
fields.JP: む、向こうで戦っていたはずじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sh-She was just over there a second ago!

fields.EN:
Come on, Hiaburibashira! I got your back!
Here I come, grandpa!
fields.JP:
ほら火あぶり柱、手助けしてあげる！
いくわよおじさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, Pyre! I got your back!
Here I come, grandpa!

fields.EN:
Aww, look at you. Rushing into the circle
all on your own.
fields.JP:
あーあ、わたしの輪っかに
自分から捕まりに来るなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aww, look at you. Rushing into the circle
all on your own.

fields.EN:
Of course. I'll let you go, right after I'm
through with you!
fields.JP: うん、殺してから解放してあげるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I'll let you go, right after I'm
through with you!

fields.EN:
Oh. You're sturdier than you look. Thought
I sliced you clean in half.
fields.JP:
あらぁ、意外と頑丈。
真っ二つにしたつもりだったのにー。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. You're sturdier than you look. Thought
I sliced you clean in half.

fields.EN:
(Aw, she's dead. She was so small and
harmless. Did she really have to die?)
fields.JP:
（ああ……死んでしまった……。
　あんな小さくて無害そうな女の子、
　何も殺さなくてもよかったんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Aw, she's dead. She was so small and
harmless. Did she really have to die?)

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: くららっ！　ねえくららってばっ！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
(She's still so tiny. Do I really have to kill
these girls...?)
fields.JP:
（また小さな女の子……。
　本当にこんな子たちを
　殺さないといけないの……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's still so tiny. Do I really have to kill
these girls...?)

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ねえ、なんでこんなひどいことするの！？

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: That's not true! Hiaburibashira didn't do it!!
fields.JP: 違うもん！　火あぶり柱じゃないもん！！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not true! It wasn't me!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: うぅっ……ぐっ……ああああっ！

fields.EN:
(My head...is going to explode...
I can't...breathe...)
fields.JP:
（頭が割れそう……胸も苦しい……
　上手く、息が……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My head...is going to explode...
I can't...breathe...)

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: えっ……ど、どうしたのきゅうに……

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: だいじょうぶ？　けびょうじゃない？

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
（もしかして……
　心配、してくれてるの……？）

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
What do I do? Do I take her down?
She attacked me...
fields.JP:
どうしよう……
ねかせてあげたほうがいいかな？
でも、くららをこうげきしてきたやつだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do I do? Do I take her down?
She attacked me...

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁっ……
苦しく……なくなった……？

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: なおった？　もういたくない？

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
(What's with her...? She's supposed to be
my enemy. She knows it!)
fields.JP:
（なんなのよこいつは……。
　敵だってことくらい分かるでしょ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's with her...? She's supposed to be
my enemy. She knows it!)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she's trying to lower my guard...
Or is she?)
fields.JP:
（油断させようとしてる……
　じゃないよね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she's trying to lower my guard...
Or is she?)

fields.EN:
(What hurt me earlier...? Was I attacked?
I wasn't taught about this...)
fields.JP:
（それよりさっきの苦しみは
　何だったの……？　敵の攻撃？
　こんなの聞いてない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What hurt me earlier...? Was I attacked?
I wasn't taught about this...)

fields.EN:
(Argh! None of this makes sense...! Sisters,
Papa, don't leave Hiaburibashira alone...!)
fields.JP:
（ああもう、色々ワケが分からない……！
　姉さん、パパ、火あぶり柱を
　ひとりにしないで……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(ARGH! I don't get what's going on!
Sisters, Papa... Don't abandon me!)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.
B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
わわっ！
ラプンツェルも！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
（みんな、光に包まれて浮かんでる。
　どんどん上に昇っていく）

助けてギロチン姉さん！
メイ姉さんっ！　首吊り姉さ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Help me, Sister Guillotine! Sister Mei!
Sister Gallo—
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san; メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san | Source-gated Kubitsuridai/Kubitsuri-neesan identity restoration.

fields.EN:
(Why are my sisters on the surface? Why are
they looking up at Hiaburibashira?)
fields.JP:
（どうして姉さんたちは地上にいるの？
　どうして火あぶり柱を見上げているの？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why are they on the surface? Why are
they looking up at me?)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: (Why do they look so upset with me?)
fields.JP: （どうして、そんな顔をしているの？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why do they look so upset with me?)

fields.EN:
(Don't glare at me. I'll do a good job. I'll
kill them all. I'll be useful for Papa...)
fields.JP:
（やめて、そんな目で見ないで。
　ちゃんとするから。人間もたくさん殺す。
　パパの役に立つから。だから──）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't glare at me. I'll do a good job. I'll
kill them all. I'll be useful for Papa...)

fields.JP:
うぅっ……パパ……
姉さんっ……姉さん……！
火あぶり柱を、見捨てないで……
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: (There's no huge hole, no mountain of corpses. And it's not like I'm half-asleep.)
fields.JP:
（大穴もないし、死体の山もない。
　自分が寝ぼけているわけでもない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The chasm's gone. So is the mountain
of corpses. The haze is starting to clear.)

fields.EN:
(This is a different place.
But there's something familiar about it.)
fields.JP:
（さっきまでいたのとは、全然違う場所だ。
　でも、どこかで見たことがある気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is a different place.
But there's something familiar about it.)

fields.JP:
ギロチン姉さん！　メイ姉さん！
首吊り姉さん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sister Guillotine! Sister Mei! Sister Gallows!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san; ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san; メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
(They're not here. I can't even hear
anyone talking. No one screaming either.)
fields.JP:
（近くにはいないみたい……。
　それどころか人間たちの話し声も、
　悲鳴も何も聞こえない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're not here. I can't even hear
anyone talking. No one screaming either.)

fields.EN:
(Could it be... Hiaburibashira really was
abandoned...?)
fields.JP:
（もしかして、火あぶり柱は
　本当に捨てられた……？）
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
N-No... I don't believe it! That can't be
true!
fields.JP:
う……嘘だ嘘だっ！
そんなはずないっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No... I don't believe it! That can't be
true!

fields.EN:
There's no way Papa and my sisters would
abandon Hiaburibashira!
fields.JP:
パパや姉さんたちが、
火あぶり柱を捨てるなんて
あるわけないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Papa and my sisters would never
abandon me! That's impossible!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Papaaaa! Sistersss! Hiaburibashira is right
here!!
fields.JP:
ねえパパーーっ！　姉さんーーっ！
火あぶり柱はここよーーーっ！！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
やだよ……火あぶり柱を
ひとりにしないでよ……
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
（どうしてこんなことに
　なっちゃったの……？）

fields.EN:
(What is it...? An animal? Or is it
a Marchen?)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう……動物……？
　それともメルヒェン……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What is it...? An animal? Or is it
a Marchen?)

fields.EN:
(I-I'll be okay. I'm wearing the Gore Suit.
I can just shoo it away.)
fields.JP:
（だ、大丈夫。
　自分はゴアスーツを着てるんだし、
　その程度なら簡単に追い払える……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I-I'll be okay. I'm wearing the Gore Suit.
I can just shoo it away.)

fields.EN:
(B-But I'm scared... Even if I wait, I don't
think anyone's coming...)
fields.JP:
（うぅ、なんか怖いな……。それにここで
　待っていても誰も来てくれなさそう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(B-But I'm scared... Even if I wait, I don't
think anyone's coming...)

fields.JP:
（早いうちにどこか安全な場所を
　探した方がいいかな……）

fields.EN: O-Okay, I have to get going.
fields.LOCALIZED: O-Okay, I have to get going.

fields.EN: I wonder where my sisters are...
fields.JP: 姉さんたち、どこにいるんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder where my sisters are...

fields.JP:
疲れたよぉ……
お腹減ったよぉ……

fields.EN:
(She's blonde... It's that girl from earlier.
I think she's...Rapunzel.)
fields.JP:
（金髪の女の子……
　こいつはさっきの……確かラプンツェル）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's blonde... It's that girl from earlier.
I think she's...Rapunzel.)

fields.EN: (Oh, what a relief. I found someone.)
fields.JP: （よかった、ようやく人に会えた……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh, what a relief. I found someone.)

fields.JP:
（ちょっと待って。
　これってもしかしてチャンスなんじゃ……？）

fields.EN: (Perfect. I'll kill her. Just like Papa asked.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ。殺すんだ。
　パパに言われた通りに）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Perfect. I'll kill her. Just like Papa asked.)

fields.EN:
(She's not moving. This'll be like crushing
an insect.)
fields.JP:
（こいつは今、動けない。
　そこらの虫より簡単に殺せるわ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's not moving. This'll be like crushing
an insect.)

fields.JP:
でも……それはあまりにも
ひどいんじゃ……

fields.EN:
(NO! I must rid my head of these thoughts.
Or I'll never fulfill my duty!)
fields.JP:
（だめっ！　余計なこと考えたら
　また何もできなくなる！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(NO! I must rid my head of these thoughts.
Or I'll never fulfill my duty!)

fields.JP:
（人間は殺す！
　それが火あぶり柱の役目！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Humans must be exterminated.
That is my duty!)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(Oh, yeah. She was rude as hell to me
earlier! That's good enough reason!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、こいつはさっき
　生意気なこと言ってきたし！
　殺してもいいんだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, yeah. She was rude as hell to me
earlier! That's good enough reason!)

fields.EN:
(Something beyond Genocide Pink is
calling out to me from within...telling
me to kill.)
fields.JP:
（何より、自分の中の処刑台少女としての心が
　『殺せ』って言ってるもの……たぶん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Something beyond Massacre Pink is
calling out to me from within...telling
me to kill.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP:
みんな……
しんじゃ……だめ……

fields.EN:
Hmph. Looks like no one's coming to
save you. I, Hiaburibashira, will kill you in one
fell swoop.
fields.JP:
ふん、今から死ぬのはあんたよ。
火あぶり柱が一撃で殺してあげるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. Looks like no one's coming to
save you. I, Pyre, will kill you in one
fell swoop.

fields.EN: Pity, but misfortune befalls us all.
fields.JP: ま、運が悪かったと思いなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Pity, but misfortune befalls us all.

fields.EN: The least I can do is make it painless.
fields.JP: せめて、苦しまないように殺してあげる
fields.LOCALIZED: The least I can do is make it painless.

fields.EN: I mean it. I'm going to kill you here and now.
fields.JP:
本気だからね。
ぜったい、ぜったい本気で殺すんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean it. I'm going to kill you here and now.

fields.JP:
（振り下ろすだけ、
　あとは振り下ろすだけ……！）

fields.EN: H-Hiaburibashira can do it if she tries...!
fields.JP:
ひ、火あぶり柱だって
やればできるんだから……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I...I can do it if I believe it!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: できるんだからーーーーっ！！

fields.EN: (All that we've fought for is here at last.)
fields.JP: （ようやくみんなの願いが叶う……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (All that we've fought for is here at last.)

fields.EN:
(The Dawn, the Liberated District becoming
a faint memory...)
fields.JP:
（黎明が……解放地区が、
　もうあんなに小さくなって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Dawn, the Liberated District becoming
a faint memory...)

fields.EN:
(I never thought the day would come.
I'm proud of us for making it this far.)
fields.JP:
（こんな光景が見られるなんて、
　あたしたち、本当に頑張ったよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I never thought the day would come.
I'm proud of us for making it this far.)

fields.EN: (At first we could only put up a small resistance, but we gained more allies and slowly took things back... and finally made it this far.)
fields.JP:
（最初は小さな抵抗しかできなかったけど、
　仲間を増やして、少しずつ取り戻していって……
　ついにここまで来られた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At first, our resistance was gradual. Soon,
we added more to our ranks and fought
our hearts out. All for this moment...)

fields.EN:
(Our efforts couldn't have been realized
were it not for Jack and Alice.)
fields.JP:
（たぶん、その反撃のきっかけは、
　ジャックとアリスに出会ったことだと思う）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Our efforts couldn't have been realized
were it not for Jack and Alice.)

fields.EN:
(Without Jack, we would have killed Otsuu
as a Nightmare.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックがいなかったら、あたしたちはきっと
　ナイトメアのおつうを殺してしまっていただろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Without Jack, we would have killed Otsuu
as a Nightmare.)

fields.EN:
(And Ningyohime wouldn't be here
now... That's right. I made sure to save
Ningyohime.)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫も生き返ることはなかった。
　そう、あたしが死なせた人魚姫は今、
　こうして生きているんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And Little Mermaid wouldn't be here
now... That's right. I made sure to save
Little Mermaid.)

fields.EN: (It gives me peace knowing she's okay.)
fields.JP:
（そのことに、あたしがどれだけ
　救われているかわからない）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It gives me peace knowing she's okay.)

fields.EN:
(When we met them, things moved forward.
I felt like things were progressing.)
fields.JP:
（２人に出会って何かが動き出した。
　何かが変わる、前に進んでるって実感できた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When we met them, things moved forward.
I felt like things were progressing.)

fields.JP: （それはたぶん希望ってやつだったんだと思う）

fields.EN:
(In times of distress, Jack was always there
to cheer me up: "You are who you are,
no matter what...")
fields.JP:
（悩んでいた時、
　『どんなあたしでも、あたしはあたしだ』
　って言ってくれたのもジャックだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In times of distress, Jack was always there
to cheer me up: "You are who you are,
no matter what...")

fields.EN: (...What's going on? I keep thinking of Jack.)
fields.JP:
（……なにこれ。
　あたしってばジャックのことばかり考えてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (...What's going on? I keep thinking of Jack.)

fields.JP:
（本当に、ジャックには
　感謝してもしきれないな……）

fields.EN:
(I, on the other hand, feel useless.
How am I supposed to be the big sister?)
fields.JP:
（それに比べてあたしはダメダメだ。
　お姉さんなんてとても言えたもんじゃない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I, on the other hand, feel useless.
How am I supposed to be the big sister?)

fields.EN:
(I let Dad take advantage of me until
the bitter end.)
fields.JP:
（あたしは最後までお父さんに騙されて、
　いいように操られてた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I let Dad take advantage of me until
the bitter end.)

fields.EN: (No matter what he did, I fully trusted him.)
fields.JP:
（何をされようが信じ切っていて、
　疑うなんてことこれっぽっちもしなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED: (No matter what he did, I fully trusted him.)

fields.EN: (But... Dad was really nice to me though.)
fields.JP:
（でも……だけど……
　本当に、お父さんはあたしに優しかったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But... Dad was really nice to me though.)

fields.JP: １０歳のお誕生日おめでとう、赤ずきん
