ありがとうみんな！　ふーっ

fields.EN: Akazukin. I have another gift for you.
fields.JP: 赤ずきん、今日は他にもプレゼントがあるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood. I have another gift for you.

fields.EN:
Akazukin. That is a weapon made just for you
by Haru-kun.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、それはハルくんが
作ってくれたお前のための武器だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood. That is a weapon made just for you
by Haru.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルくん => Haru-kun; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
With that, you can defeat more Marchens
easily.
fields.JP:
それがあれば、今までよりももっと簡単に、
多くのメルヒェンを倒すことができる
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that, you can defeat more Marchens
easily.

fields.EN: Professor! I want to hurry and use this!
fields.JP: 博士！　これ、早く使いたい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Professor! I want to hurry and use this!

fields.JP: （だめだだめだ！　泣くなあたし！）

fields.EN:
(I'm sure the surface isn't in great shape
either, but there's no time to waste.)
fields.JP:
（地上だって色々と大変なはずなんだ、
　落ち込んでいる場合じゃない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure the surface isn't in great shape
either, but there's no time to waste.)

fields.EN:
(The future's in our hands, so we must
band together!)
fields.JP:
（せっかく掴み取った未来だ。
　これからはみんなと一緒に頑張らなきゃ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The future's in our hands, so we must
band together!)

fields.EN:
All right, everyone! I see the surface!
Ready yourselves!
fields.JP:
みんな！　地上が見えてきたよ！
気合い入れていこうっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, everyone! I see the surface!
Ready yourselves!

fields.EN: Hey guys, this is the surface, right...?
fields.JP:
ねえみんな……
ここ、地上なんだよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey guys, this is the surface, right...?

fields.EN: Why are there so many corpses...?
fields.JP:
なんだって、
こんな死体の山ばかりなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why are there so many corpses...?

fields.EN:
I braced myself for the possibility that
there could be another Jail up here, but...
fields.JP:
ジェイルはあるかもって聞いてたから、
少しは覚悟していたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I braced myself for the possibility that
there could be another Jail up here, but...

fields.JP:
さすがにここまでとは
思っていませんでしたよね……

fields.EN:
Wow. Even the Liberated District looked
better than this...
fields.JP:
これなら解放地区の方がよっぽど
素敵な場所に見えるわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. Even the Liberated District looked
better than this...

fields.EN:
I thought the whole idea behind reaching
the surface was because the underground
was so awful...
fields.JP:
あたしたちのいた地下は最低最悪の場所で、
だから地上を目指したはずなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought the whole idea behind reaching
the surface was because the underground
was so awful...

fields.JP: こんなのあんまりです……

fields.EN:
But those bodies can't have been here
long. The blood's still wet.
fields.JP:
死体が比較的新しいわ。
まだ、血が固まっていないものまである。
fields.LOCALIZED:
But those bodies can't have been here
long. The blood's still wet.

fields.EN: Gretel! Don't get too close to them!
fields.JP:
グレーテル！
あんまり近づかない方がいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel! Don't get too close to them!

fields.EN:
Does anyone know how this could've
happened? This is dystopian.
fields.JP:
でもこれができた理由は知っておくべきでしょう？
これから先、この地上で生きていくのなら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does anyone know how this could've
happened? This is dystopian.

fields.EN:
That's a good question, but it can wait.
First, we need to make a settlement.
fields.JP:
ごもっともではあるけど、ちょっと待って。
まずは落ち着ける場所を探した方がいいと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a good question, but it can wait.
First, we need to make a settlement.

fields.EN:
I wouldn't want Shirayuki and Nemu
to witness this.
fields.JP:
白雪とネムにいつまでも
こんな光景を見せていたくないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wouldn't want Snow White and Sleepy
to witness this.

fields.EN:
True, it makes my stomach churn.
Let's find somewhere safe and gather—
fields.JP:
そうだね。ここはあまりに酷すぎる。
どこか別の場所に移動した方がいい。
いったん、みんなで集まって──
fields.LOCALIZED:
True, it makes my stomach churn.
Let's find somewhere safe and gather—

fields.JP: あなたたち、武器を構えなさい！！
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.JP: ん～★　気づかれちゃった～
鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: You noticed Mei? Maybe you've got good instincts. I wanted to kill this girl nice and slowly, but now that I've been spotted, I guess I have no choice but to kill her★
fields.JP:
メイに気づくなんて、カンがいいのかな？
この子すっごくゆっくり殺したかったけどぉ、
気づかれちゃったなら殺しちゃうしかないよねぇ★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Someone's got a sharp eye, huh?
Wish I could take my time with this kill,
but as you can see, duty calls★

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
I just want to sample your blood★
Ah... MMM...MM?!
fields.JP:
さーて、あなたの血はどんな味かなー★
チュパ……ん～……んんっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just want to sample your blood★
Ah... MMM...MM?!

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: Agh, gross! What is that?! Disgusting!
fields.JP:
まずっ！？　なにこれっ！？
ちょーまずいんですけど！
fields.LOCALIZED: Agh, gross! What is that?! Disgusting!

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN: I had such high hopes, but I've been duped!
fields.JP: めっちゃ期待してたのに、ダマされたじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: I had such high hopes, but I've been duped!

fields.JP: 鋼鉄製の棺を武器にする少女
fields.notes: B19 restored anonymous source speaker label; removed localization-only Massacre Pink A/B

fields.EN:
Argh! You've pissed me off. How dare
they trick Iron Maiden. You're gonna
beg for death when I'm done with you!
fields.JP:
あー、もうムカつく！
このアイアン・メイデンをダマして、
ふつーに殺してもらえると思うなよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh! You've pissed me off. How dare
they trick Iron Maiden. You're gonna
beg for death when I'm done with you!

fields.EN: Don't move, Gretel. Let me treat you!
fields.JP:
グレーテル、動いちゃ駄目っ。
す、すぐに手当てするから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't move, Gretel. Let me treat you!

fields.EN: Save it... We have to deal with her first.
fields.JP: 後で、いい……それより、あいつを……
fields.LOCALIZED: Save it... We have to deal with her first.

fields.EN:
Heyyy! Why the cold shoulder?
How rude!
fields.JP:
ちょっとぉ！　無視とかヒドくなーい？
ちょー傷つくんですけど！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heyyy! Why the cold shoulder?
How rude!

fields.JP:
口直し～～っと、
チュパ……

fields.EN:
Wooo! Delicious★
Now THAT'S how blood should taste!
fields.JP:
くぅ～～おいしい～～★
血はこうでなくっちゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wooo! Delicious★
Now THAT'S how blood should taste!

fields.EN: All right, now to sample the others~
fields.JP:
さーて、他の子は
どんな味がするのかなー
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, now to sample the others~

fields.EN:
How can you be so cruel? What are you
even trying to accomplish...?
fields.JP:
いきなり現れてこんなことして、
あんたいったい何がしたいのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can you be so cruel? What are you
even trying to accomplish...?

fields.EN:
Isn't it obvious?! I want to...
Kill★You★All!
fields.JP:
そんなの決まってるじゃん！
み・な・ご・ろ・し★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it obvious?! I want to...
Kill★You★All!

fields.EN:
Well I kinda killed Gretel quite easily
so for the rest of you guys, I'd
like it if we could play longer★
fields.JP:
グレーテルチャンはサクッと
やっちゃったから、みんなとはもう少し
長く遊べたらメイ嬉しいかも★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well I kinda killed Gretel quite easily
so for the rest of you guys, I'd
like it if we could play longer★

fields.JP: くららーーーー！　しらゆきーーーー！

fields.EN:
No, you can't...!! Don't die!
Don't die, Clara!
CLARAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!
fields.JP:
そんな、ダメだ……！　死ぬな！　死ぬなくらら！
くららぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you can't...!! Don't die!
Don't die, Clara!
CLARAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA!

fields.EN:
What the... Everyone's dropping like flies.
Aka-nee, at this rate—
fields.JP:
そんな……みんな次々に殺されてく……。
赤姉っ、このままじゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the... Everyone's dropping like flies.
Sister Red, at this rate—
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored
B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Why? Why is this happening...?
Wasn't the surface supposed to be safe?
fields.JP:
何で……何でこんな目に……。
地上は希望しかなかったんじゃないの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Why is this happening...?
Wasn't the surface supposed to be safe?

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Jack and Cinderella are both in the heat
of battle, and neither one seems to be
faring well...
fields.JP:
ジャックたちの方でも、
シンデレラたちの方でも戦闘が発生してる。
どっちも状況はかなり悪そう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack and Cinderella are both in the heat
of battle, and neither one seems to be
faring well...

fields.EN:
We have to hurry and defeat this woman
so we can help them.
fields.JP:
だから、わたしたちが
さっさとこいつを倒して加勢するの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have to hurry and defeat this woman
so we can help them.

fields.EN:
You think you stand a chance against ME?!
Kyaha★ Now that's hilarious!
fields.JP:
メイをさっさと倒すってー！？
キャハ★　ちょー受けるんですけど！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think you stand a chance against ME?!
Kyaha★ Now that's hilarious!

fields.EN:
You wanna see hilarious? How about
a punch in the mouth?
fields.JP:
あいつムカつくでしょ？
ぶん殴りたいでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wanna see hilarious? How about
a punch in the mouth?

fields.EN: Hey Aka-nee, snap out of it!
fields.JP: ねえ、赤姉しっかりして！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Sister Red, snap out of it!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: (She's right. I have to keep it together!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、
　あたしがしっかりしないと……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's right. I have to keep it together!)

fields.EN:
(I heard Shirayuki screaming earlier too,
so Oyayubi wants us to head over.)
fields.JP:
（さっき、白雪の悲鳴も聞こえた。
　親指は本当はすぐにでも駆けつけたい
　はずなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I heard Snow White screaming earlier too,
so Thumby wants us to head over.)

fields.EN:
(But she's so worried for Gretel and the
rest of us that she's staying behind...)
fields.JP:
（でもグレーテルやあたしたちを
　心配して、留まってくれている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But she's so worried for Gretel and the
rest of us that she's staying behind...)

fields.EN:
(Oyayubi's right. We must handle Iron
Maiden swiftly and rescue the others.)
fields.JP:
（親指の言うとおりだ。
　さっさとアイアン・メイデンを倒して、
　みんなを助けに行かないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumby's right. We must handle Iron
Maiden swiftly and rescue the others.)

fields.EN:
Right, one step at a time. First we gotta
deal with her!
fields.JP:
そうだ。考えるのは後回し。
まずはこいつをぶん殴る……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, one step at a time. First we gotta
deal with her!

fields.EN: Oh, good! Aka-nee, you're a lifesaver!
fields.JP:
よかった。
いつもの頼りがいのある赤姉だわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, good! Sister Red, you're a lifesaver!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP:
ごめん親指！
もうあたし大丈夫だからっ！

fields.EN:
Princess Lazy! Aka-nee and I have this
covered, so go on and heal Gretel!
fields.JP:
グータラ姫！
ここはわたしと赤姉が引き受けるから、
あんたはグレーテルの治療をして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess Lazy! Sister Red and I have this
covered, so go on and heal Gretel!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: Okay, leave it all to me~
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, leave it all to me~

fields.EN:
Aw. The thought of dealing with three
of you at once tantalized me.
fields.JP:
えー、３人まとめての方が、
もっと長く楽しめるのに～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. The thought of dealing with three
of you at once tantalized me.

fields.EN: Well, the number of people I get to kill doesn't change, so I guess it's fine★
fields.JP: ま、殺す人数は変わんないからいっか★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I suppose I'll have to settle for the
thrill of the chase ★

fields.JP: よし、じゃあ親指、行くよっ！

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Wooow★ I expected you to die off quick,
but you're pretty tough!
fields.JP:
すっごーい★
死ぬかなって思ったのに意外と頑丈～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wooow★ I expected you to die off quick,
but you're pretty tough!

fields.EN: Aka-nee, I don't think I can...
fields.LOCALIZED: Sister Red, I don't think I can...
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: しっかりしろ！　弱気になるなっ

fields.EN:
Yeah, she's right★
Come on! Get up, get up★
I'm not done with you yet!
fields.JP:
その子の言う通りだよー★
ほら立って立って★
まだ試したいことがあるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, she's right★
Come on! Get up, get up★
I'm not done with you yet!

fields.EN:
I wanna see how many pulls it takes to
rip your foot from your leg. Or if you'd
survive me wringing you like a wet rag.
fields.JP:
どれだけ引っ張ったら足が千切れるかとかー。
雑巾みたいに絞っても生きてられるかとかー。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanna see how many pulls it takes to
rip your foot from your leg. Or if you'd
survive me wringing you like a wet rag.

fields.EN:
Since you hardly make for a good dinner,
hopefully you're better as entertainment ★
fields.JP:
おいしくないんだから、
そのくらいしてメイを楽しませてよねー★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since you hardly make for a good dinner,
hopefully you're better as entertainment ★

fields.EN:
(Both Blood Maidens went at her full
throttle, but they were no match.)
fields.JP:
（血式少女２人がかりで、
　まったく歯が立たないなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Both Blood Maidens went at her full
throttle, but they were no match.)

fields.EN: Hm. Hm...? Hey, you losers giving up?
fields.JP:
んー？　んんー？
その顔、もしかして、諦めちゃった系？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Hm...? Hey, you losers giving up?

fields.EN:
Oof, boring. Can't expect me to have fun
with yucky blood on the line. You bore
me. Time to die.
fields.JP:
なーんだつまんない。
血はおいしくないし、やる気もないし。
あんた、つまんない。もう殺しちゃおー。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oof, boring. Can't expect me to have fun
with yucky blood on the line. You bore
me. Time to die.

fields.EN: Stop it! Don't kill anyone else!
fields.JP: やめて！　もうこれ以上みんなを殺さないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop it! Don't kill anyone else!

fields.EN:
Oh, is that another challenger I hear?
Very well... I'll play with you ★
fields.JP:
あっれー、もしかしてやる気あるある系？
んー……決ーめたっ。そっちと遊んであげる★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that another challenger I hear?
Very well... I'll play with you ★

fields.EN:
Besides, I wouldn't get a thrill out of killing
you. Why don't you just kill yourself?
fields.JP:
つーか、あんた殺しても楽しくなさそうだし。
ま、勝手にひとりで死ねば？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I wouldn't get a thrill out of killing
you. Why don't you just kill yourself?

fields.EN:
(She left... She's gone. She walked away,
ignored me.)
fields.JP:
（行った……いなくなった。
　あたしを置いて、無視して……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She left... She's gone. She walked away,
ignored me.)

fields.EN:
(Truthfully, thank goodness. Happy I'm not
dead.)
fields.JP:
（ホッとしてる。安堵してる。
　死ななくてよかったと思ってる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Truthfully, thank goodness. Happy I'm not
dead.)

fields.EN:
(This is awful. How have I weakened so
much? Was I always this pathetic...?)
fields.JP:
（最悪だ。いつからあたしはこんなに弱くなった。
　いつからこんなに惨めなやつになったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is awful. How have I weakened so
much? Was I always this pathetic...?)

fields.EN: (This is more hellish than the underground...)
fields.JP: （こんなの、地下よりも地獄じゃない……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (This is more hellish than the underground...)

fields.EN: Rgh... I won't let you go...
fields.JP: うっ……い、行かせないわよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh... I won't let you go...

fields.EN:
If we let her go...innocent people will be
murdered.
fields.JP:
あいつを、行かせたら……
また、たくさんの人が殺される……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we let her go...innocent people will be
murdered.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi! Just stop already!
You can't fight like that! You'll die!
fields.JP:
親指！　もうやめて！
その身体じゃ無理だ！　殺されるだけだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumby! Just stop already!
You can't fight like that! You'll die!

fields.JP: 負けて……たまるもんですか……

fields.EN:
If I die...who'll protect Shirayuki and
Nemu...?
fields.JP:
わたしが死んだら……
誰が白雪とネムを守るっていうの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I die...who'll protect Snow White and
Sleepy...?

fields.EN:
(Snap out of it! I'm the only one being
a wimp!)
fields.JP:
（なにをやってるんだあたしは！
　ひとりだけ怖じ気づいて！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snap out of it! I'm the only one being
a wimp!)

fields.EN: Oyayubi, stay here. I...will stop her.
fields.JP:
親指、あんたはここにいなさい。
あたしが……あいつを止める。
fields.LOCALIZED: Thumby, stay here. I...will stop her.

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP:
（やらなきゃ。あたしが。
　あたしがやるんだ……！）

fields.EN: (But I'm scared... I don't wanna die.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (But I'm scared... I don't wanna die.)

fields.JP: う……ううう……うわああああああっ！

fields.EN:
Aka-nee...! At this rate, she'll enter
Blood Skelter!
fields.JP:
赤姉……！
こ、このままじゃブラッドスケルター化
しちゃうわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Red...! At this rate, she'll enter
Blood Skelter!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: うわあああああああああっ！

（あれ、急に穢れた気持ちが
　薄らいで――）

fields.EN:
...Don't continue down this path.
You may lose yourself.
fields.JP:
……それ以上はいけない。
自分を見失ってしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Don't continue down this path.
You may lose yourself.

fields.JP:
その手に持ってるのは……
メアリガン……？

fields.EN:
That's not important. Can you stand?
Get up, even if it hurts. Now's our chance
to run for it.
fields.JP:
そんなことはどうでもいい。
立てるか？　いや、無理にでも立て。
今のうちに逃げるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not important. Can you stand?
Get up, even if it hurts. Now's our chance
to run for it.

fields.EN:
But Shirayuki, Nemu...
Everyone's counting on me.
fields.JP:
でも、白雪、ネム……
他の住民だってまだいるのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Snow White, Sleepy...
Everyone's counting on me.

fields.EN:
If we stay, we'll all die for nothing.
The only way we'll survive is if we
regroup. Okay, I'm making a break for it.
fields.JP:
今の状態じゃ犬死にだ。
仮に戦うとしても仕切り直せ
それでは僕は逃げるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we stay, we'll all die for nothing.
The only way we'll survive is if we
regroup. Okay, I'm making a break for it.

fields.EN:
Seems like...the only option. Kaguya,
how's Gretel doing?
fields.JP:
そうするしか……ないようね。
かぐや、グレーテルの容体は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like...the only option. Kaguya,
how's Gretel doing?

fields.EN:
She won't stop bleeding. Her condition
is critical. I'll have to carry her.
fields.JP:
……血が止まらない危険な状態ですね。
グレーテルはわらわが運びます
fields.LOCALIZED:
She won't stop bleeding. Her condition
is critical. I'll have to carry her.

fields.EN:
Thanks. Aka-nee, let's go. Come on,
take my hand.
fields.JP:
頼んだわ。
赤姉、わたしたちも一旦退きましょう。
ほら肩貸して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks. Sister Red, let's go. Come on,
take my hand.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: That groan, that light... What is going on?!
fields.JP:
あのうなり声、それに光……
いったい、なんなんですか…！
fields.LOCALIZED: That groan, that light... What is going on?!

fields.JP: もう何なの……わけわかんないよ……！
赤姉、ちょっとしっかりしてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sister Red, snap out of it!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: うう……ジャック……お父さん……

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: ほら、赤姉行きましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Come on, Sister Red. Let's go.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
*pant*...*pant*...
I think this place is safe for now.
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
何とか隠れられたかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant*...*pant*...
I think this place is safe for now.

fields.EN:
We have that white-haired fellow to thank.
Just who was he...?
fields.JP:
さっきの白い髪の人に感謝ですね。
それにしても誰だったんでしょう……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have that white-haired fellow to thank.
Just who was he...?

fields.EN:
No idea. I assume he came along with the
rest of us from the underground. Do you
know him, Aka-nee?
fields.JP:
分からないわ。
一緒に地上に来た人だろうけど……。
赤姉、知ってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No idea. I assume he came along with the
rest of us from the underground. Do you
know him, Sister Red?
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
If our paths ever cross again, we'll have to
thank him.
fields.JP: どこかで会えたらお礼を言わないと──
fields.LOCALIZED:
If our paths ever cross again, we'll have to
thank him.

fields.EN: Huh? Gretel is floating?! Wait, so am I~!
fields.JP:
え、グレーテルが浮いてる……！？
わらわの身体まで～……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Gretel is floating?! Wait, so am I~!

fields.EN:
Ugh, now what?! Everyone, hold hands so
we're not separated! Grab here, Aka-nee.
fields.JP:
今度はいったい何だっていうのよ……！
みんな、離れないように手を繋いだ方が良いわね。
ほら、赤姉
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, now what?! Everyone, hold hands so
we're not separated! Grab here, Sister Red.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: Aka-nee, reach for my hand! Aka-nee!
fields.JP: って赤姉、手を伸ばして！　赤姉！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sister Red, reach for my hand! Sister Red!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
(If I kept going, I would've entered Blood
Skelter...)
fields.JP:
（あのままいったら、あたしはきっと
　ブラッドスケルター化していた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I kept going, I would've entered Blood
Skelter...)

fields.EN:
(Man, I'm just a burden... I'm no good to
anyone here...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱあたしは、どこまでも
　みんなの足を引っ張るダメな子だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, I'm just a burden... I'm no good to
anyone here...)

fields.EN:
(Think we're out of salt. I should pick
some up at the shop.)
fields.JP:
（確か塩が切れてたよね。
　物資販売所で買って帰ろうかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Think we're out of salt. I should pick
some up at the shop.)

fields.EN: Hehe. Would you like an angel's egg?
fields.JP: ふふ、天使の卵も買ってく？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Would you like an angel's egg?

fields.EN:
That's not real. Even if it were, we don't
know what's in there...
fields.JP:
いや、そんなのないだろう？
あっても温めて何が生まれてくるか
わかったもんじゃないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not real. Even if it were, we don't
know what's in there...

fields.EN: Hehe. Mamoru has one too, don't you?
fields.JP: ふふ、でもマモルはもう天使の卵持ってるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Mamoru has one too, don't you?

fields.EN: Haha! You didn't hear it from me!
fields.JP: ははっ！　相変わらずつかみどころがない人だぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha! You didn't hear it from me!

fields.EN: So, know what you wanna buy?
fields.JP: なにか買うものは決まったか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, know what you wanna buy?

fields.JP: なんか今日は大盛況ね

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: With this much piled up, just finding what we're looking for is a chore.
fields.JP: これだけ山積みにされてると探すのだけで一苦労だ

fields.EN:
(Miko-san, Michiru-san, Chiaki-san, Gatou-san, and Mamoru
are all here.)
fields.JP:
（視子さん、ミチルさん、千昭さん、
　賀東さん、マモルとみんなそろってる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Miko, Michiru, Chiaki, Gato, and Mamoru
are all here.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 千昭さん => Chiaki-san; 視子さん => Miko-san | Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN: Hey Jack, what a welcome surprise.
fields.JP:
あら、ジャック、こんな風に鉢合う
なんて珍しいわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Jack, what a welcome surprise.

fields.EN:
(Luckily everyone's here...
Maybe this is a good time to ask.)
fields.JP:
（幸い、今はみんないるし……今なら
　聞いてみてもいいかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Luckily everyone's here...
Maybe this is a good time to ask.)

fields.EN: What's the matter? What's with the face?
fields.JP: どうしたの？　急に大きな声出して
fields.LOCALIZED: What's the matter? What's with the face?

fields.EN:
Sorry, I just had to ask. Did anyone know
Alice was badly hurt?
fields.JP:
すみません……聞きたいことがあって。
みなさんはアリスが重傷を
負ったのを知ってますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, I just had to ask. Did anyone know
Alice was badly hurt?

fields.JP: ああ、それは目の前で見てたしな
ええ、ジャックから聞いたわね
ジャックの目に焼き付いた話を聞いたよ

fields.EN:
I believe Gatou-san and I might've overheard
when we first met.
fields.JP:
ああ、出会った時に私と賀東さんは、
軽く聞いたと記憶するが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe Gato and I might've overheard
when we first met.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Something about the story doesn't sit right
with me. It sounds like someone else healed
her.
fields.JP:
ただそのことで気になることがあって……
どうやら自然に治ったのではなく、
誰かが治療してくれたみたいなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something about the story doesn't sit right
with me. It sounds like someone else healed
her.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I didn't know that. That was nice of them.
fields.JP: それは知らなかったが、良かったじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't know that. That was nice of them.

fields.JP: そいつはどこのどいつなんだ？

fields.EN: Apparently no one knows who it was. They only said, 'Alice... you mustn't die...' and then left...
fields.JP:
それが誰かわからないらしくて、
「アリス…お前は死んではだめなんだ…」
とだけ言って去ってしまったらしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know. Supposedly they mentioned
that Alice can't die before they left.

fields.EN:
Wait. If someone treated her, does that mean
they're one of us?
fields.JP:
おいおい、治して立ち去るって……
味方ってことか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. If someone treated her, does that mean
they're one of us?

fields.EN:
Right. They can't be an enemy, but there's
no way to know for sure right now.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ。……僕も助けてくれたから
敵ではないのかとも思うけど、確証はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. They can't be an enemy, but there's
no way to know for sure right now.

fields.EN:
Hm... Someone that nice up here is too good
to be true.
fields.JP:
うーん……。
わりぃやつじゃねーんだろうけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Someone that nice up here is too good
to be true.

fields.EN:
Why do you think they went off? If it were
me, I'd stick around to get full credit.
fields.JP:
たぶん、名前を名乗れない理由があるんだろうな？
俺ならぜってー名乗ってるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why do you think they went off? If it were
me, I'd stick around to get full credit.

fields.EN: Hehe. Perhaps it was a fairy.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、妖精さんがあらわれたような、
不思議なお話ね。
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Perhaps it was a fairy.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: でも、そもそもがおかしいのではないか？

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
If she was gravely injured, it seems fortuitous
that someone appeared out of nowhere to save
her.
fields.JP:
そんな重傷を負っていたなら、他に見てた人も
近づけばよかっただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she was gravely injured, it seems fortuitous
that someone appeared out of nowhere to save
her.

fields.JP: それはそうなんですけど……

fields.EN:
Seems like Mary was watching from afar. 
But she was too scared to get up close.
fields.JP:
どうやらメアリーが遠くから
見ていたようなんですが……
怖くて近づけなかったらしく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like Mary was watching from afar. 
But she was too scared to get up close.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーさん => Mary-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Many mysteries hide in this Jail. We don't
even know if this person is human.
fields.JP:
監獄塔にはまだまだ謎があるからね。
そもそも人間かどうかも
わからない場合さえもあるというし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Many mysteries hide in this Jail. We don't
even know if this person is human.

fields.JP: いくらでも可能性はありますからね

fields.EN:
(Oh. I didn't even consider that.
Professor and Haru-san were aliens...)
fields.JP:
（そうか……それは考えてなかった。
　……確かに博士やハルさんも
　地球外知的生命体のようだし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. I didn't even consider that.
Professor and Haru were aliens...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP:
（つうみたいな人間側の
　ナイトメアもいるようだし……）
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: (I want to look into it, but...)
fields.JP:
（そこは突っ込んで
　調べてみたいところだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I want to look into it, but...)

fields.JP:
（今はまだ……
　わからないことだらけだ）

fields.EN:
Still, whoever it was saved Alice. If only
we could thank them in person.
fields.JP:
なんにしてもアリスの命の恩人であることには
変わりはねーからな、そこは感謝だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, whoever it was saved Alice. If only
we could thank them in person.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: さあ、私はよくわからないから……

fields.EN:
...Sorry. I just remembered something.
Please excuse me.
fields.JP:
……ごめんなさい。用を思い出したから
私はこれで失礼するわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Sorry. I just remembered something.
Please excuse me.

fields.EN:
I wonder what's up with Miko-san. She left
her whole basket.
fields.JP:
……視子さん、どうしたんだろうな？
買い物もしないで帰ってたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what's up with Miko. She left
her whole basket.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: (That was weird. Does Miko-san know something?)
fields.JP:
（……なんだか様子がおかしいな。
　視子さんはなにか心当たりがあるのだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That was weird. Does Miko know something?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: （随分そっけないような気がする）

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: ジャックくん、ちょっといいかな
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP:
あれ、賀東さん。
どうしたんですか？
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I have a question for you.
fields.JP:
いや、君たちの
今までの話を聞きたくてね
fields.LOCALIZED: I have a question for you.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I know you've got a lot on your plate,
so I understand if this is a bad time.
fields.JP:
君たちが仲間とはぐれて、
今はそれどころじゃないっていうのは
分かるんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you've got a lot on your plate,
so I understand if this is a bad time.

fields.EN: Oh, not at all. What's on your mind?
fields.JP:
いや、大丈夫ですよ。
今までの話っていうと？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, not at all. What's on your mind?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Well, you said you came from underground, didn't you? That there was a Jail Tower underground too, and that you survived there...
fields.JP:
その、君たちは地下から来たって話じゃないか。
地下にも監獄塔があって、生き延びていたって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you mentioned escaping from the
underground Jail.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I've done some research, so I'm familiar
with Jail and the Blood Maidens. Please
share your experience with me.
fields.JP:
それで、自分も研究していたから
ジェイルや血式少女というのは知っているが、
地下はいったいどんな様子だったのかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've done some research, so I'm familiar
with Jail and the Blood Maidens. Please
share your experience with me.

fields.EN:
I understand the curiosity, what with you
being a researcher after all. I'll answer
anything you wanna know.
fields.JP:
確かに研究者としては、違う環境のことは
気になりますよね。　僕でいいならお話しますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I understand the curiosity, what with you
being a researcher after all. I'll answer
anything you wanna know.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Really? How kind of you. Tell me about life
underground...
fields.JP:
そうかい？　そう言ってくれると嬉しいよ。
じゃあ早速だけど、まずは地下の生活について――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? How kind of you. Tell me about life
underground...

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
...Right. Sounds like quite the harrowing
experience.
fields.JP:
なるほど、大変な環境で
君たちは生き抜いてきたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Right. Sounds like quite the harrowing
experience.

fields.EN:
Yeah. But to tell you the truth, the surface
might be even worse.
fields.JP:
そうですね……でも、今となっては、
地上の方が何倍も大変な気がします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. But to tell you the truth, the surface
might be even worse.

fields.EN: Haha. That's almost embarrassing to admit.
fields.JP: はは、こんな弱気恥ずかしいですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. That's almost embarrassing to admit.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Hey, I commend your dedication. In fact,
I'm impressed by this Dawn organization.
fields.JP:
そんなことないさ、その諦めのなさもすごいが、
なにより黎明は組織としての統率力がすばらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I commend your dedication. In fact,
I'm impressed by this Dawn organization.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You and the Blood Maidens, and your great
escape, are proof that you've been molded
by strong leadership.
fields.JP:
血式少女をまとめあげ、結果ジェイルを脱獄する。
しっかりとした血式少女を導く者がいたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You and the Blood Maidens, and your great
escape, are proof that you've been molded
by strong leadership.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: As an outsider, I can only admire.
fields.JP: 地上にいる、組織から見れば相当まともだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: As an outsider, I can only admire.

fields.EN:
(Gatou-san's right. We only made it this far
because of the Dawn.)
fields.JP:
（賀東さんの言うとおり、
　黎明があったから僕たちは脱獄できた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gato's right. We only made it this far
because of the Dawn.)
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
(But then again, that was all Professor's
doing, so I don't want to credit them too
much.)
fields.JP:
（ただその研究者――博士の件があるから、
　全部黎明のおかげだと言うには抵抗がある……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But then again, that was all Professor's
doing, so I don't want to credit them too
much.)

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Thank you Jack-kun. This paints a much clearer
picture.
fields.JP:
ありがとうジャックくん。
地下の血式少女たちについては
だいたい分かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you Jack. This paints a much clearer
picture.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
How about Charlotte-san and Mary-san? What do
you know of them?
fields.JP:
それで、地上で出会った
シャーロットさんやメアリーさんについては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about Charlotte and Mary? What do
you know of them?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san; メアリーさん => Mary-san

fields.EN:
Wait a second. How did you say you knew
about Blood Maidens, Gatou-san?
fields.JP:
あれ、そういえば賀東さんは
どうして血式少女を知っているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a second. How did you say you knew
about Blood Maidens, Gato?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Yeah. Blood Maidens have existed for a long time. So they don't exist only underground.
fields.JP:
ああ。血式少女は昔からいたからね。
だから、何も地下だけに存在している
わけじゃないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. They are more common than you think.
They don't all live underground.

fields.JP: 確かに処刑台少女なんかも似てますもんね
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
(Makes sense. We've seen Marchens up here
too.)
fields.JP:
（確かに『妊婦のメルヒェン』という意味では、
　いつどこにいたって、おかしくはないしね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Makes sense. We've seen Marchens up here
too.)

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I've met my fair share of Blood Maidens
up here, but not all of them are kind.
fields.JP:
地上にいた血式少女は自分も見たことがあるけど、
すべてがすべて、善良な血式少女ではなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've met my fair share of Blood Maidens
up here, but not all of them are kind.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: The Devouring Armada Tower and Jail Towers infest this world now, but they aren't the only reason it fell into ruin.
fields.JP:
今のこの世界は、悪食の監隊塔や
監獄塔がはびこってはいるけれど、
荒廃したのは決してそれらだけのせいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since the Devouring Armada Tower
came into this world, everything fell to ruin.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Cruelty which was exacerbated by selfish
Blood Maidens and ignorant humans.
fields.JP:
この惨状は、エゴにまみれた人間たちや、
悪い血式少女のせいというところもあるんだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cruelty which was exacerbated by selfish
Blood Maidens and ignorant humans.

fields.EN:
Witchcraft did nothing but expose humans
for what they really are.
fields.JP:
確かにウィッチクラフトなんてモノがあれば、
人間の欲望は剥き出しになってしまうし、
めちゃくちゃになりますよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Witchcraft did nothing but expose humans
for what they really are.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Right. Such a power is too dangerous in
the wrong hands. Mankind's too prone
to evil to be trusted.
fields.JP:
ああ、どんな願いをも叶えるシロモノなんて、
人の手には余るものだよ。そんなものがあるから、
欲して、奪い合って、争いが起こるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Such a power is too dangerous in
the wrong hands. Mankind's too prone
to evil to be trusted.

fields.EN:
We don't need Witchcraft. Mankind can
develop civilization on its own!
fields.JP:
ウィッチクラフトなんてなくても、
人類はこれまで自らの力で
文明を発展させ続けてきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't need Witchcraft. Mankind can
develop civilization on its own!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Precisely! We don't need magic to survive!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　あんなものに頼らずとも、
人々は生きていけるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Precisely! We don't need magic to survive!

fields.JP: はい、僕もそう思います

fields.EN: (Gatou-san's got a good head on his shoulders.)
fields.JP:
（賀東さんもここまで来るのに
　色々とあったんだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Gato's got a good head on his shoulders.)
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP:
それで、シャーロットさんたちの
話なんだが……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP: アリスどうしたんだい？
視子さんが呼んでいるわよ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Don't worry about it. We'll discuss Charlotte-san 
another time.
fields.JP:
いや仕方ない、シャーロットさんたちの話は
また今度聞かせてもらうとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry about it. We'll discuss Charlotte 
another time.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: You sure? I can tell her to wait.
fields.JP:
いや、そのくらいでしたらちょっと
待っててもらうんで、僕は構いませんよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: You sure? I can tell her to wait.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
No, don't mind me. I've some things to attend
to. Thank you Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
いや、申し訳ないし失礼するよ。
ありがとうジャックくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, don't mind me. I've some things to attend
to. Thank you Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: (He's gone. He didn't have to rush.)
fields.JP:
（行っちゃった。
　そんなに急がなくてもいいのに）
fields.LOCALIZED: (He's gone. He didn't have to rush.)

fields.EN: Okay, arms up. Take a deep breath.
fields.JP:
はい、シャツ上げて。
大きく息を吐いて
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, arms up. Take a deep breath.

fields.EN:
Vitals are normal. Numbers are higher
than last time, but for a Blood Youth,
they check out.
fields.JP:
バイタルデータに異常はなし。
血液検査のこの数値だけ前回より上がってるけど、
血式少年特有のブレの範囲内ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Vitals are normal. Numbers are higher
than last time, but for a Blood Youth,
they check out.

fields.EN: Yup. No doubt about it. You're fit as a fiddle.
fields.JP:
うん、問題ないわね。
すこぶる健康な身体をしているわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. No doubt about it. You're fit as a fiddle.

fields.EN:
I'm really glad you learned what you did at the lab,
Miko-san. I never expected we could get examined
even somewhere like this.
fields.JP:
こんな場所でも検査してもらえるなんて、
視子さんが研究所の知識を身につけてくれてて
本当によかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy you know your stuff. Getting
a physical seems like a luxury up here.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Well, being self-taught has its advantages.
fields.JP: まあ、ほぼ独学みたいなものだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, being self-taught has its advantages.

fields.EN:
Self-taught? I thought you worked under
Professor.
fields.JP:
そうなんですか？
てっきり博士に教わっていたのかと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Self-taught? I thought you worked under
Professor.

fields.EN:
Right, in the beginning. He showed me the
medical ropes when I started out.
fields.JP:
そうね、最初はそうだった。
医者を目指していた私に、専門の医療知識を
叩き込んでくれたのは確かに博士だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, in the beginning. He showed me the
medical ropes when I started out.

fields.EN: He probably only taught me because that was the minimum he required of an assistant... Unfortunately, it was also the maximum.
fields.JP:
博士にとっては、助手に求める最低限のラインが
そこだったから教えてくれただけだろうけど……
残念なことに、最大限のラインもそこだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
That man expected a lot from his assistants,
but gave a lot in return. Equal parts blessing
and curse.

fields.EN: Was he strict when it came to medical stuff?
fields.JP: 医療知識だけあればいいってことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Was he strict when it came to medical stuff?

fields.EN:
Strict is one word for it. But I think he
spent a lot of time preparing us to treat
Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
そんな感じね。思えば博士は、
血式少女たちの医療的なケアを
するだけの人材が欲しかったんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strict is one word for it. But I think he
spent a lot of time preparing us to treat
Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
But he never gave more than instructions,
leaving us to devise our own methods.
fields.JP:
だからその先は、
積極的には教えてくれなくなった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But he never gave more than instructions,
leaving us to devise our own methods.

fields.EN: So I started telling him I needed to know and asking questions, drawing the knowledge out of the Professor and making it my own. He never looked very pleased about it.
fields.JP:
それで私から『必要だ』と言って質問していって、
博士から知識を引き出し、身につけたの。
あまりいい顔はされなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I pleaded with him for some guidance,
but he didn't take too kindly to those
requests.

fields.EN:
Yes. Professor, or Snark, wasn't too keen
on sharing his innate knowledge. Maybe
he feared me learning the truth.
fields.JP:
そうね、多分博士……スナークは、私が知識を
持つことを望んでいなかったんだと思うわ。
手の内を明かすリスクを恐れたんでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Professor, or Snark, wasn't too keen
on sharing his innate knowledge. Maybe
he feared me learning the truth.

fields.EN:
Honestly though, I had a feeling something
was off.
fields.JP:
正直に言うと私もね、
薄々どこかおかしいと思ってたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly though, I had a feeling something
was off.

fields.EN:
Did you realize the Professor was doing something
behind the scenes, Miko-san?
fields.JP:
視子さんは博士が裏で何かしているって
気づいてたんですか？
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Well, the more I learned about the Blood
Maidens and Marchens, the less stuff added
up.
fields.JP:
まあね。
血式少女やメルヒェンについて知れば知るほど、
違和感を感じてしまう内容もあったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, the more I learned about the Blood
Maidens and Marchens, the less stuff added
up.

fields.EN:
Put simply, it seemed strange to make them
the focus of our research.
fields.JP:
簡単に言えば『そんな研究必要？』ってことも、
あの人は行っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Put simply, it seemed strange to make them
the focus of our research.

fields.EN:
But I never had the courage to ask.
I knew he'd just play it off, but now I
know he was hiding a lot from us.
fields.JP:
でもね、それをはっきりと聞く勇気はなかった。

へえ、賀東さんのためだけに作られたんですか。
それはすごいなあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow, it's custom? That's cool, Gato.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Ha. Thanks. Truthfully, there's one other
slightly like it. But it belonged to my long-
lost brother.
fields.JP:
はは、ありがとう。まあ実はもう１つ、
近いデザインのものがあるんだけど、
そっちは行方不明の兄さんが持っててね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha. Thanks. Truthfully, there's one other
slightly like it. But it belonged to my long-
lost brother.

fields.EN: I see. Happy you found it.
fields.JP:
そうなんですか……
でもそれならなおさら、見つかってよかったですね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Happy you found it.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Right. I have you to thank, Mary-san.
fields.JP: ああ。メアリーさんには本当に感謝しかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I have you to thank, Mary.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーさん => Mary-san

fields.EN:
O-oh, no problem. Um... Hehe. Just glad
to help.
fields.JP:
いい、いえ、お役に立ったのなら、
しょの、えへ、よかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-oh, no problem. Um... Hehe. Just glad
to help.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Thank you. Well, I'll see you around.
fields.JP: ありがとう。それじゃあ失礼するよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you. Well, I'll see you around.

fields.EN:
I'm happy for him. Gatou-san's got a spring in
his step. What's the matter Mary?
fields.JP:
よかったなあ、賀東さん。
何か後ろ姿も嬉しそう……
ん？　なんだいメアリー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy for him. Gato's got a spring in
his step. What's the matter Mary?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN: Ah. So you gave Gatou-san a copy, huh...?
fields.JP:
やっぱり賀東さんに渡したあれ、
メアリーの能力で作った奴だったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah. So you gave Gato a copy, huh...?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
*sigh* I mean, broken watches aren't worth
much. But I don't wanna hold onto it.
fields.JP:
はー、もう壊れたやつなんて価値ねーし、
かといって持ってて後でバレてもこえーし、
もう俺には無用のもんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I mean, broken watches aren't worth
much. But I don't wanna hold onto it.

fields.EN:
Yeah, you have it. Kekeke. I want nothing to
do with it.
fields.JP:
つーことでジャック、それあげたからな。
ククク、もう俺と懐中時計に一切の
関係はございませんってな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you have it. Kekeke. I want nothing to
do with it.

fields.EN:
(Is Mamoru talking to someone?
I wonder who he's talking to? Tsuu?)
fields.JP:
（マモル、誰かとしゃべってるのかな？
　相手は誰だろう？　つう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is Mamoru talking to someone?
I wonder who he's talking to? Otsuu?)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: (Oh no... He's talking to Hikari in her sleep.)
fields.JP:
（あ、いや違う……
　眠ってるヒカリに話し掛けてるんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh no... He's talking to Hikari in her sleep.)

fields.EN:
How much more sleep do you need?!
I'm gonna pinch you!
fields.JP:
ったく、いつまで寝てるんだこのお姫様は！
ほっぺ、むにってやるぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How much more sleep do you need?!
I'm gonna pinch you!

fields.EN: (Sheesh. If he pulls too hard, she'll wake up.)
fields.JP:
（あ～あ～そんなに引っ張っちゃ……
　起きてしまうよ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Sheesh. If he pulls too hard, she'll wake up.)

fields.JP: （ああ、この場合は起きていいのか？）

fields.EN: (I hear her sleeping... Guess she's out.)
fields.JP:
（……寝息……やっぱり
　そう簡単には起きないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I hear her sleeping... Guess she's out.)

fields.EN:
Do you get it? If it wasn't for you, everyone 
would have died.
fields.JP:
わかってるか？
ヒカリがいなかったら
みんな今頃死んでたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you get it? If it wasn't for you, everyone 
would have died.

fields.EN:
You're amazing! But...I guess we asked too
much of you.
fields.JP:
お前、さすがだよ！
でも……ちょっと頼りすぎだったよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're amazing! But...I guess we asked too
much of you.

fields.EN: Well, you did good. So good, kid.
fields.JP:
……まあ、だから、お前、大儀だったよ。
すげえ、頑張ったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, you did good. So good, kid.

fields.EN: Was I too hard on you...? Sorry.
fields.JP:
いいや、俺が頑張らせすぎたのかな？
ごめんな
fields.LOCALIZED: Was I too hard on you...? Sorry.

fields.EN:
Seriously! You've been asleep forever!
Woof. I'm worried.
fields.JP:
ただお前、寝すぎだっつーの！
まったく……俺は心配だよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously! You've been asleep forever!
Woof. I'm worried.

fields.EN:
Jack and the girls are doing everything
they can, so don't worry. Just wake up.
Come on.
fields.JP:
今ならジャック達が
踏ん張ってくれてっから
安心して目を覚ませって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack and the girls are doing everything
they can, so don't worry. Just wake up.
Come on.

fields.JP:
あいつ、謙遜してるけど、
すげーからな

fields.EN:
We're safe now. When you wake up,
we're gonna eat a bunch... Okay?
fields.JP:
俺達は安心だ。だから……
目が覚めたらまた
なにかうまいもんでも食べようぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're safe now. When you wake up,
we're gonna eat a bunch... Okay?

fields.EN: Hahaha. I'll take that as a yes. Keep it up.
fields.JP:
ははははっ。食い意地張ってんな。
その意気だぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. I'll take that as a yes. Keep it up.

fields.EN: Wake up, or I'll start eating next to you.
fields.JP: 早く起きないと、枕元で大根食い始めるからな
fields.LOCALIZED: Wake up, or I'll start eating next to you.

fields.EN:
I'm glad everyone's here... If I was alone,
I would've gone mad.
fields.JP:
みんながいてくれて良かった……
こんな状態……ひとりじゃ
どうにかなってたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad everyone's here... If I was alone,
I would've gone mad.

fields.EN: Ugh. I'm so pathetic! Keep it together!
fields.JP:
あー、情けねぇなっ！
しっかりしろお、俺！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. I'm so pathetic! Keep it together!

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry. Too loud, huh? Wait, does that
mean you hear me?
fields.JP:
あ、ごめん。うるさかったよな。
いや、うるさいなら起きるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry. Too loud, huh? Wait, does that
mean you hear me?

fields.EN:
Damn it! Don't give in! Gotta keep giving
it my all!
fields.JP:
くそっ！　しょげてても仕方ねえ！
俺は俺のできることを最大出力でやるだけだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! Don't give in! Gotta keep giving
it my all!

fields.EN:
Hikari! When you wake up, you're in
for a real treat!
fields.JP:
ヒカリ！　お前が目を覚ました時には
全部終わってて腰抜かせてやるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari! When you wake up, you're in
for a real treat!

fields.JP:
でさ……
またくだらねー話しよーぜ

fields.EN:
(I'm worried that Hikari won't wake up,
but Mamoru must be hurting even more.)
fields.JP:
（ヒカリが目覚めないのは僕も心配だけど……
　いつも一緒にしたマモルは
　もっともっと……辛いよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm worried that Hikari won't wake up,
but Mamoru must be hurting even more.)

fields.JP:
（それでも頑張ろうとするマモルは、
　やっぱり僕の希望の1つだよ……）

fields.EN:
Alice...! ALIIIIIICCCCEEEEE!
YOU CAN'T DIE! NO, DON'T DIE.
YOU CAN'T NO NO NO ALICEEEE!
fields.JP:
アリス………ッッ！　アリスウウウーー！
死んじゃダメ死んじゃ
ダメダメダメダメアリスーーッッ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice...! ALIIIIIICCCCEEEEE!
YOU CAN'T DIE! NO, DON'T DIE.
YOU CAN'T NO NO NO ALICEEEE!

fields.JP: 今の声、シャーロットさんだ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Charlotte, it's a dream! Just a dream!
Alice isn't dead!
fields.JP:
シャーロット夢だ！　それは夢！
だから、アリスは死んでねーよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, it's a dream! Just a dream!
Alice isn't dead!

fields.JP: アリス、アリスがぁ……アリスウウウッ！

fields.EN:
Calm down! Look at me!
Charlotte, look at me! It's me!
It's Mary!
fields.JP:
落ち着けったら！　俺を見ろよ！
シャーロット、俺を見ろ！　俺だ！
メアリーだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down! Look at me!
Charlotte, look at me! It's me!
It's Mary!

fields.EN:
*pant* *pant* *pant* Mary?
Huh? Alice... Alice... Alice...?
Alice isn't here? She's not here, right?
fields.JP:
はあ、はあ、はあ、メアリー？
えっ、アリス…？　アリス…アリス…？
アリスはここにいないの？　いないのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant* *pant* *pant* Mary?
Huh? Alice... Alice... Alice...?
Alice isn't here? She's not here, right?

fields.JP: そうだ。ここにはアリスはいねえ

fields.EN: Right... That's right... Alice isn't here.
fields.JP: うん……そうだった……アリスはいない
fields.LOCALIZED: Right... That's right... Alice isn't here.

fields.EN:
That's right. What you saw was a dream.
A dream. You hear?
fields.JP: そうだよ、今見たことは夢、夢だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. What you saw was a dream.
A dream. You hear?

fields.EN:
(What's going on? Both Charlotte and Mary
seem out of it.)
fields.JP:
（どういうことだ？　シャーロットも
　メアリーもこんなに取り乱して……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's going on? Both Charlotte and Mary
seem out of it.)

fields.JP: な、なにがあったんだい！？

fields.EN: Oh, Jack? You saw that, right?
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックか？
今の見ただろ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Jack? You saw that, right?

fields.EN:
That's what I'm talking about! When we got
to the surface, Charlotte started going nuts!
fields.JP:
これだよ、これ！　地上に出た時に
シャーロットが突然発狂したってやつだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I'm talking about! When we got
to the surface, Charlotte started going nuts!

fields.JP:
（ああ、そういうことか……
　確かに、これは……！）

fields.EN: Yeah, seems like she's having a hard time.
fields.JP:
うん。本当に取り乱してる
って感じだね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, seems like she's having a hard time.

fields.JP:
はあ、はあ、はあ、はー。
ああ……夢……なのね

fields.EN: Yeah. Just a dream. Go on back to sleep.
fields.JP: そうだ。夢だ。安心して寝ろ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Just a dream. Go on back to sleep.

fields.JP:
はぁぁ…………。
ようやく収まってくれた……
なにをしたらこんなことになったんだい？

fields.EN:
Nothing I can think of. I just went to nap
with her, then it started.
fields.JP:
別に特別なことはしてねえよ。
たまには気持ちよく寝るためにシャーロットと
昼寝をしてただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing I can think of. I just went to nap
with her, then it started.

fields.EN:
Charlotte began screaming that Alice was
dead, then you showed up.
fields.JP:
そうしたら、突然シャーロットが発狂してアリスが
死んだみたいなことを言い始めたんだ……
で、後はさっきの通りだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte began screaming that Alice was
dead, then you showed up.

fields.EN:
Her dreams are telling her something.
If Alice really is dead, then we're in trouble.
fields.JP:
アリスが死んだ夢でも見たんだろ。
アリスに本当になにかあったらこんなもんじゃ
済まないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her dreams are telling her something.
If Alice really is dead, then we're in trouble.

fields.JP: （本当に発狂してしまうんじゃないか？）

fields.EN: Yeah. I'll probably have bad dreams next.
fields.JP:
ああ……
今度はこっちが悪夢を見そうだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I'll probably have bad dreams next.

fields.EN: I just pray Charlotte won't suffer.
fields.JP:
とにかく、もうこれ以上シャーロットが
悪夢で叫び出さないことを祈るわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I just pray Charlotte won't suffer.

fields.EN: Yeah. That must be tough on you, Mary.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
メアリーも大変だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. That must be tough on you, Mary.

fields.EN: Hah. Well, I guess I just got unlucky.
fields.JP: はっ、まぁ運が悪かったと思うわ

fields.EN: Charlotte... Just hang in there, okay?
fields.JP:
シャーロット……
もうこんなんなったら嫌だかんな
fields.LOCALIZED: Charlotte... Just hang in there, okay?

fields.EN: She seems better now. Thank goodness.
fields.JP: 何にしても治まってよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED: She seems better now. Thank goodness.

fields.EN:
I'm heading off to bed. Charlotte probably
won't remember, so don't mention it.
fields.JP:
まぁ俺はこのまま寝るから、どうせシャーロットは
覚えてねーだろうから、余計なことすんなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm heading off to bed. Charlotte probably
won't remember, so don't mention it.

fields.JP:
……覚えてない、前の時と一緒だとしたら
そうかもね。　わかったよ

fields.EN:
(Charlotte-san is always so level-headed.
I've never seen her like this.)
fields.JP:
（いつも落ち着いてるシャーロットさんが
　あんなに取り乱すなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Charlotte is always so level-headed.
I've never seen her like this.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(Could this have something to do with
Charlotte-san's Blood Libido...?)
fields.JP:
（もしかしてシャーロットさんの
　血式リビドーと何か関係あるのだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe it has to do with her Blood Libido.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: (Dang. I forgot to fill up my water bottle.)
fields.JP:
（水筒に水を入れ忘れちゃうとは、
　我ながらドジだなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Dang. I forgot to fill up my water bottle.)

fields.EN:
(I'm tired of being stuck in here. I can't
wait to see the outside.)
fields.JP:
（しかしいつも監獄塔の中だから、
　たまには空がみたいな……
　今上を見てもあるのは不気味な天井のみ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm tired of being stuck in here. I can't
wait to see the outside.)

fields.JP: おいっ、邪魔だジャック

fields.EN: Whoa! Mary, I didn't see you there!
fields.JP: わわっ！　メアリーいたんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! Mary, I didn't see you there!

fields.EN:
I was behind you this whole time.
I need to use the bathroom. Move!
fields.JP:
ずっと後ろにいたわ
早く便所行きたいんだからどけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was behind you this whole time.
I need to use the bathroom. Move!

fields.JP:
（相変わらずなんというか……。
　あれ？）
メアリー寝る時はそんな格好なんだね

fields.EN:
Only for sleeping. The thing hanging around my 
feet turns into a hanger for my clothes when
I sleep so it's convenient.
fields.JP:
もう横になりたい時はこの格好だよ。
いつも足元に居るあいつがハンガー代わりに
なるから、変にめんどくさくないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only for sleeping. The thing hanging around my 
feet turns into a hanger for my clothes when
I sleep so it's convenient.

fields.EN: Why don't you take better care of it?
fields.JP: もう少しあの子かわいがってあげなよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you take better care of it?

fields.JP: はっ！　俺の勝手だろ

fields.EN: Hey. Getting a good look, perv?
fields.JP:
あれ、もしかしてこれって
ラッキースケベってやつじゃね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. Getting a good look, perv?

fields.EN:
Aren't you lucky? You get to see a new side
of me. Is your heart racing?
fields.JP:
おいおい、ジャックよかったな
俺の新しい一面にドキドキってやつだろ、これ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aren't you lucky? You get to see a new side
of me. Is your heart racing?

fields.EN: (What do I do...? She's not doing it for me.)
fields.JP: （どうしようまったく何も感じない……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What do I do...? She's not doing it for me.)

fields.EN: Anyway, aaaah! I gotta use the bathroom.
fields.JP:
って、やばいやばい！
ともかく俺は便所いくから、じゃあな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, aaaah! I gotta use the bathroom.

fields.EN:
(Hikari's still sleeping, but I'm still worried
about her... Maybe I'll pay her a visit.)
fields.JP:
（ヒカリはまだ元気に寝ているらしいけど、
　やっぱりちょっと心配だな……
　たまには顔を見にいこうかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hikari's still sleeping, but I'm still worried
about her... Maybe I'll pay her a visit.)

fields.JP: （あれ？　あれはマモルと視子さん）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: くぅっ……！　やっぱしみるわ！

fields.EN:
Ugh. You hurt yourself again. Take care
of yourself, or it'll get infected.
fields.JP:
もう、またこんな怪我して、怪我も重ねれば
大病になるんだから気を付けなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. You hurt yourself again. Take care
of yourself, or it'll get infected.

fields.EN: Sorry Miko-san. I can't stay out of trouble.
fields.JP:
ごめんってば視子さん
なんでだろうな生傷が絶えねえんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry Miko. I can't stay out of trouble.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
That's because you love to overdo it.
You're worse than Jack sometimes.
fields.JP:
それはマモルが無理してるからよ。
あなたはジャックとは別の意味で心配ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's because you love to overdo it.
You're worse than Jack sometimes.

fields.EN:
(Miko-san was worried about me... I guess I do push
myself too hard sometimes.)
fields.JP:
（視子さん心配してくれてたんだ……
　確かに僕も無理しちゃう時はしちゃうからね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, she worries about me. Guess I have
that problem too.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Okay, all done now. Listen to your body.
Give it a break.
fields.JP:
はい、これでおしまい
外傷も含めて体調管理も仕事のうちなんだから、
しっかりなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, all done now. Listen to your body.
Give it a break.

fields.EN: I know Miko-san. Sorry for all the trouble.
fields.JP:
わかってるよ視子さん
面倒かけてわりぃな
fields.LOCALIZED: I know Miko. Sorry for all the trouble.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Tell me about it. Please watch out, we'll
need you in the future.
fields.JP: 本当よ、いざという時のために無理しないで頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tell me about it. Please watch out, we'll
need you in the future.

fields.EN:
I was just thinking I can't believe you really
looked up to Professor Ueshima, Miko-san.
fields.JP:
いや、視子さんは本当に'上島先生'を
目指してたとは思えねえなと思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man, I can't believe you looked up to
Professor once upon a time.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
What do you mean, Mamoru?!
What's he got to do with anything?!
fields.JP:
な、な、な、な、何言ってるのマモル！！
今先生は関係ないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean, Mamoru?!
What's he got to do with anything?!

fields.EN:
No, seriously. When you were young, Miko-san, you
used to say, "I want to be someone who's always
smiling like Sensei."
fields.JP:
いやいや若い頃の視子さんは'先生'に
「先生みたいにいつもニコニコした人になりたい」
って、キラキラ元気に言ってたからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on. You always said how you wanted
to be just like him.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: 今の態度と大分違うなと思ってさ

こ、こらっ！　マモル！
'隊長'の記憶を使うのはよしなさい！
使うっていうか、もう一体化しちゃってるしよ……

fields.EN: I'd rather discuss anything else, got it?!
fields.JP:
と、ともかく！
私の前でその話は禁止よ禁止！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'd rather discuss anything else, got it?!

fields.EN: Ugh. Now you even sound like him.
fields.JP:
もう、デリカシーがないところまで
似なくていいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Now you even sound like him.

fields.EN:
Hahahaha! Those days were so fun.
No need to be ashamed.
fields.JP:
はははっ！　あんなに楽しかった日々なのに
黒歴史扱いしないでくれよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha! Those days were so fun.
No need to be ashamed.

fields.EN:
Memories are precious, but we don't need
to coast on them to be happy.
fields.JP:
あの時の記憶は凄く大事な大切な記憶よ。
だけど、マモルに言われるのは恥ずかしいし、
何か違うのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Memories are precious, but we don't need
to coast on them to be happy.

fields.EN:
Anyway, we're done here. Go on back to
your tent.
fields.JP:
ともかくもう終わったから、自分のテントに
戻りなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, we're done here. Go on back to
your tent.

fields.JP: へいへい、ありがと視子さん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(Oh, right. Mamoru's inherited the Dawn's
memories.)
fields.JP:
（そうか、マモルは前黎明の過去を
　引き継いでるんだったっけ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, right. Mamoru's inherited the Dawn's
memories.)

fields.EN:
(But he sure got Miko-san flustered.
How cute.)
fields.JP:
（ただ、あんな視子さんを見るのは、
　新鮮でちょっとおもしろかわいく見えるね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But he sure got Miko flustered.
How cute.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(Whoa?! That startled voice from the infirmary
didn't sound like Miko-san at all... What happened?)
fields.JP:
（わっ！？　救護室の方から
　視子さんらしからぬ驚きの声が……。
　なんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa. I heard that all the way from here.
What happened?)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: なにを言ってるのあなたは？

fields.EN: Sister, you can't just say that.
fields.JP:
ね、姉さん。
そんな突然……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sister, you can't just say that.

fields.EN:
(It's Miko-san, Michiru-san, and Chiaki-san. Bad things
happen when they're all together.)
fields.JP:
（視子さんとミチルさんと千昭さんだ。
　あんまりいい関係ではない３人……心配だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's Miko, Michiru, and Chiaki. Bad things
happen when they're all together.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 千昭さん => Chiaki-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: So~ Michiru was wondering if she and Miko could become best friends~
fields.JP:
だからね～視子とミチルは親友に
なれるかな～って
fields.LOCALIZED: Like I said, I hoped we could be friends.
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP explicitly frames 視子とミチル as the pair.

fields.EN: Friends... Do you know what that means?
fields.JP: 親友って……、あなた意味を分かって言ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Friends... Do you know what that means?

fields.EN: Mm? I don't think there's meaning to friendship?
fields.JP: ん～親友に意味はないと思うけど？
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm? I don't think there's meaning to friendship?

fields.EN: (Looks like Miko-san's in a bad mood...)
fields.JP: （……視子さんちょっと不機嫌そう）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Looks like Miko's in a bad mood...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Miss Ueshima, my sister means no harm.
She is merely trying to make peace.
fields.JP:
上島さん姉さんに悪意はないんだ。
恐らく思ったことを素直に言っただけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miss Ueshima, my sister means no harm.
She is merely trying to make peace.

fields.JP: それが問題だと思うんだけど

fields.EN:
Don't you get why there's bad blood?
I thought you guys worked for Snark.
fields.JP:
わかってるの？　特にわだかまりはないけれど、
地下監獄の時は私は貴方たちを怪しい集団だと
思っていたし、スナークの手先と思ってたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you get why there's bad blood?
I thought you guys worked for Snark.

fields.EN:
But the Order of the Sun no longer concerns
us. Look at the state of things now.
fields.JP:
ミチルと視子との間にタイヨウ教団は関係ないよ。
それにお空が見える煙のように消えたこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Order of the Sun no longer concerns
us. Look at the state of things now.

fields.EN: *sigh*... This is what I'm talking about...
fields.JP: はぁ……そういうところがね……
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh*... This is what I'm talking about...

fields.EN:
Miss Ueshima, forgive my sister for her
confusing words. But she is no liar.
fields.JP:
上島さん姉さんは言い回しが理解しづらいかも
しれないが、好意に対して嘘をつく人じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miss Ueshima, forgive my sister for her
confusing words. But she is no liar.

fields.EN: So I hope there's no hard feelings.
fields.JP: だから、あまり気を悪くしないでほしい
fields.LOCALIZED: So I hope there's no hard feelings.

fields.EN: And you, with your sister complex.
fields.JP: 貴方も大概シスコンね……
fields.LOCALIZED: And you, with your sister complex.

fields.EN:
Michiru admires Miko.
Miko has a world Michiru doesn't, and Michiru wants to see a little of it.
fields.JP:
ミチルは視子に憧れてるよ
ミチルにはない世界を持ってるから
その世界を少し見たいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to be more like you, Miko.
I want to see the world through your eyes.
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP repeats ミチル as self-reference and describes Miko having a world Michiru lacks.

fields.JP: 視子はミチルのことが尊敬できない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you not respect me, Miko?
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP is 視子はミチルのことが尊敬できない？ with both names explicit.

fields.EN:
Talking to you always throws me off. There are
things I respect about you, you know. I could
never lead people the way you do.
fields.JP:
もう貴方と話すといつも調子が狂うわ
尊敬すべきところはあるわよ、人を導くなんて
私には到底できないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a mystery. Respect is earned, not
given.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: And friendship is something else entirely.
fields.JP: だけど、親友どうこうは話が別
fields.LOCALIZED: And friendship is something else entirely.

fields.EN: I see. That's unfortunate for me.
fields.JP: そっか私としては残念だな
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. That's unfortunate for me.

fields.EN: ...Fine. I'll think about it once we get out of here. Until then, please stop saying such weird things.
fields.JP:
……もう、ここからでられたら考えるわ
それまではそんな変なこと言わないで頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. I'll give it a second thought. Just leave
me be.

fields.EN:
(Maybe there's hope for them yet.
Miko-san seems quietly pleased.)
fields.JP:
（なんか昔の関係性から新しい絆が生まれそうで
　よかった。　視子さんもなんか嬉しそう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe there's hope for them yet.
Miko seems quietly pleased.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
This battle means more than our fate.
It's for the fate of mankind.
fields.JP:
どうやら自分たちの命運というよりも、
人類の命運を決めた戦いになったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
This battle means more than our fate.
It's for the fate of mankind.

fields.EN: Haha. So it seems. Doesn't feel like it.
fields.JP:
はは、そのはずなんですけど……
なんか実感ないんですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. So it seems. Doesn't feel like it.

fields.EN: It will be fine. You were all born from hope.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。　ジャック達は希望から
生まれた子達。　安心して
fields.LOCALIZED: It will be fine. You were all born from hope.

fields.EN:
Hehe. If Lady Oohime says so, it must be
true.
fields.JP: ふふ、大陽女さんが言うと何か縁起がいいわね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. If Lady Oohime says so, it must be
true.

fields.EN:
My sister has faith in Jack and the girls.
They've overcome so much. That must
bode well for the future.
fields.JP:
姉さんは今まで色々な困難を乗り越えた
ジャック君達なら最後までやり遂げるって
信じてるんだと思う。
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sister has faith in Jack and the girls.
They've overcome so much. That must
bode well for the future.

fields.JP:
千昭さんありがとうございます。
なんとなくわかります……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN: Man. Look at us now, Jack.
fields.JP:
しかしよ。
来るところまで来たなジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Man. Look at us now, Jack.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Who knew what awaited us outside
of Jail?
fields.JP:
ああ、狭苦しく辛い監獄からは、
こんな未来は全然想像できなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Who knew what awaited us outside
of Jail?

fields.EN: Seriously. We've come so far. All four of us.
fields.JP:
本当にそうね……
４人で励ましあった日々が遠く昔に感じるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously. We've come so far. All four of us.

fields.EN:
Crazy to think about how the four of us
started in that tiny cell.
fields.JP:
あの監獄に閉じ込められ、声を掛けたあの日から、
ここまでマモルとヒカリと来れたことを……
僕は凄く誇りに思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Crazy to think about how the four of us
started in that tiny cell.

fields.EN: Right back at you. If only Hikari was here.
fields.JP:
それはこっちのセリフだぜ。
……今の言葉、ヒカリにも聞かせてやりてぇな
fields.LOCALIZED: Right back at you. If only Hikari was here.

fields.EN:
She's looking a lot better. Hopefully it means
she'll wake soon.
fields.JP:
ただ、大分顔色も良くなって
いつか目覚めるかもしれないって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's looking a lot better. Hopefully it means
she'll wake soon.

fields.EN: With that said, let's do this thing!
fields.JP:
そんないい流れを感じるからよ……。
最後までぶちかましてやろうぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED: With that said, let's do this thing!

fields.EN:
Miko-san, Michiru-san, Chiaki-san, we couldn't have done
it without you guys too!
fields.JP:
それに視子さん、ミチルさん、千昭さん……
本当に皆さんの支えがなきゃ、僕たちは
ここまで来れませんでした。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, Michiru, Chiaki, we couldn't have done
it without you guys too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; 千昭さん => Chiaki-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: ありがとうございます！

fields.EN: (I wonder how Gatou feels about everything.)
fields.JP:
（賀東はどんな気持ちでここで
　協力してくれていたのだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wonder how Gato feels about everything.)
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
Wow. Way to leave it till the end. You make
it seem like we're marching to our deaths.
fields.JP:
もう、そういうのは全てが終わってから言うのよ。
今言ったら死にに行くみたいになってしまうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. Way to leave it till the end. You make
it seem like we're marching to our deaths.

fields.EN:
But it's touching. So you'd better thank us
again when it's all over.
fields.JP:
だけど、そう言われると嬉しいのも事実よ。
だから、また全てが終わったら聞かせて頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's touching. So you'd better thank us
again when it's all over.

fields.EN:
Feels like we've known each other for
ages, Jack. Seems like just yesterday that
we chatted about the sun.
fields.JP:
なんだかんだジャック君とは長くいる気がするよ
一緒に太陽の話をしていたころが昔のようだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Feels like we've known each other for
ages, Jack. Seems like just yesterday that
we chatted about the sun.

fields.EN:
Yes. Even though it was only recently, Chiaki-san,
it feels like we've been chasing mysteries together
for ages... It's a strange feeling.
fields.JP:
はい、つい最近のはずなのに千昭さんとは
ずっと前から一緒に謎を求めていたような……
不思議な感覚があります
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Your friendship is the reason we made
it this far.
fields.JP:
君が私や姉さんに歩み寄ってくれたおかげで
今があると思っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your friendship is the reason we made
it this far.

fields.EN: But you had a hand in it too, Chiaki-san.
fields.JP:
僕もあの時千昭さんが色々話をしてくれた
おかげで今があると思ってます
fields.LOCALIZED: But you had a hand in it too, Chiaki.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN: Let us pray for more good fortune.
fields.JP: お互いの今が続くといいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Let us pray for more good fortune.

fields.JP:
ミチルさん……！
そうですね！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.JP: それじゃ僕たちは賀東を止めに行ってきます
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
I know there's not much time, but don't
rush. We're ready to set out when you are.
fields.JP:
確かに時間はないけど焦らないようにね
私達はジャックがいつでも再出発できるように
準備しておくわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know there's not much time, but don't
rush. We're ready to set out when you are.

fields.EN: (I don't know if you can call this fate, but we're here because everyone else was there for us.)
fields.JP:
（これを運命といっていいのかわからないけど、
　みんながいたから僕たちがいる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Call it fate, call it whatever, but somehow,
we made it.)

fields.EN:
(In the end, I'm just a Blood Youth.
I can only do so much.)
fields.JP:
（結局僕は血式少年としてしか動けない。
　圧倒的な力はない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the end, I'm just a Blood Youth.
I can only do so much.)

fields.EN: (But I have no choice but to fulfill my role, even if it costs me my life...!)
fields.JP:
（だけど、僕は僕の役割を命がけで
　やるしかないんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But I need to make the most of this chance!)

fields.JP:
（それを教えてくれたのは、
　何よりもみんなだった）

fields.EN: I'll do the best I can within my limits!
fields.JP: はい、無理せずやれる限りやりたいと思います！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll do the best I can within my limits!

fields.EN: Yes, definitely. We're here with you, Jack-kun.
fields.JP: ああ、ジャックくん待ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, definitely. We're here with you, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: Hey Shira? You've been here, right?
fields.JP: ねーシラはここにきたことあるんだよねー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Pyre? You've been here, right?

fields.EN: Yeah. Papa brought me here before.
fields.JP: そうね、パパに連れられて来たことあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Papa brought me here before.

fields.JP: みちはおぼえてないのー？

こんなだだっ広い道なんて、
いちいち覚えてられないわよ！

イッヒッヒッ……
お買い求めになるものはありますか？

キャーーーッ！！！
な、な、突然なによ！？

fields.EN:
Oh my. Well excuse me. I am a humble
merchant peddling my wares.
fields.JP:
これはこれは突然失礼しました。
私はここらへんで商売をしている
ケチな商人でございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my. Well excuse me. I am a humble
merchant peddling my wares.

fields.EN:
Please take a look. Surely something may
come in handy.
fields.JP:
もし興味あらば、さあさ、見てって下さい。
きっとお役に立つものがあると思いますよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please take a look. Surely something may
come in handy.

fields.JP: シ、シラさん大丈夫っすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(I never thought a Genocide Pink would
be scared like this.)
fields.JP:
（処刑台少女でもこんな風に
　おどろくんっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I never thought a Massacre Pink would
be scared like this.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: ん……？　貴様何か見たことあるな

fields.EN:
You're the wandering merchant we saw in the 
underground Jail. You're here too?
fields.JP:
以前地下監獄内を彷徨ってた商人ね
こんなところまで来るなんてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're the wandering merchant we saw in the 
underground Jail. You're here too?

fields.EN: Hey, don't stare! Make him leave!
fields.JP: ちょ、ちょっと見てないで追い出しなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, don't stare! Make him leave!

fields.JP: シラ……落ち着く……よしよし……

fields.EN: Um. It's dangerous up here. Are you okay?
fields.JP:
え、えっと、ここは危ないっすよ？
大丈夫っすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. It's dangerous up here. Are you okay?

fields.JP:
イッヒッ…………
ほうほうほうほう

な、なんすか？
自分の顔じっと見て……

fields.EN:
Ihihihi. I have various items. 
Does anything catch your eye?
fields.JP:
イッヒッヒ、いろんな商品が
揃ってます買いますかえ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ihihihi. I have various items. 
Does anything catch your eye?

fields.JP: い、いや今は間に合ってるっす……

fields.EN:
I see. How unfortunate. See you around.
Ihihi.
fields.JP:
そうですか、それは残念。
ではまたご贔屓に……イッヒッヒッヒ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. How unfortunate. See you around.
Ihihi.

fields.EN:
Hihihi. Worry not. I do not fear this cursed
world. Pay me no mind.
fields.JP:
イッヒッヒッヒ、私のことならご心配なく
今は世を捨てた、ただの商人でございますから、
何の心配もございません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hihihi. Worry not. I do not fear this cursed
world. Pay me no mind.

fields.EN: ...To think he's doing the same thing even after reaching the surface... Is he that much of a madman, or truly a recluse?
fields.JP:
……地上に出てまで同じようなことをしてるなんて……
よっぽどの狂人か本当に世捨て人なのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never expected to encounter him up
here as well. He's either resourceful
or insane.

fields.JP: （いや、ジッと見て来て少し怖かったす）

ふふ～んっす♪
みなさんの家具を作るのは楽しいっすね～

fields.EN: Hm? Is that Shira-san and Kaede-san?
fields.JP: ん？　あれはシラさんとカエデさんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Is that Pyre and Kaede?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san; シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: シラちょっと面貸してもらっていいかい？

fields.EN: Head to that tent, won't you?
fields.JP:
ちょっとあそこのテント
まで来てもらっていいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Head to that tent, won't you?

fields.EN:
W-What?! Are you humans trying to do something
to Shira?!
fields.JP:
な、な、なによ！
人間がシラになにかしようっていうの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you people want?! Is this a prank?
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(What's Kaede-san doing?! That's a Genocide
Pink girl they're messing with!)
fields.JP:
（カ、カエデさん達何してるんっすか！？
　仮にも相手は処刑台少女っすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's Kaede doing?! That's a Massacre
Pink girl they're messing with!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Oh, come on. It'll only take a second.
Come here!
fields.JP:
いいから手短に終わるからさ。
ちょっと来てくれないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on. It'll only take a second.
Come here!

fields.EN:
B-Bring it on! If you're going to try something
on Shira, she'll kill you!
fields.JP:
じ、上等じゃない！　シラになにかしようって
いうなら殺してやるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Bring it on! If you mess with me, you die!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(Oh no, I need to do something before
it gets out of hand!)
fields.JP:
（ひぃぃ何かあってからじゃマズイっす！
　後を付けるっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no, I need to do something before
it gets out of hand!)

fields.JP: この中に入って行ったっす……

fields.EN: Shira, seriously. I can't thank you enough.
fields.JP:
シラ本当にありがとうね。
本当に……感謝しきれないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Pyre, seriously. I can't thank you enough.

fields.EN: Yeah. We owe you big time!
fields.JP: ああ、君のおかげで僕が生きていられるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. We owe you big time!

fields.JP: ほんっとよ！！　命の恩人！

fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Please accept my sincerest apology for
calling you scary.
fields.JP:
君の事を怖いと言ってしまった
今までの非礼を詫びさせてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please accept my sincerest apology for
calling you scary.

fields.EN:
Yeah. You're a sweetheart. I don't know
what got into us.
fields.JP: 本当だよ！　こんないい子を見る目がないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. You're a sweetheart. I don't know
what got into us.

fields.EN: (What's going on? Why are they thanking Shira-san?)
fields.JP:
（どういうことっすか……。
　この短時間にシラさんが締めたんっすか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What's going on? Why are they thanking Pyre?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: （入っても大丈夫そうな空気っすね）
皆さんこんにちはっす。　何を話してるっすか？

fields.EN:
Oh, hello Clara. Just thanking Shira for
saving us.
fields.JP:
ああ、くらら。　シラがあたし達の命を
救ってくれたからさお礼を言ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, hello Clara. Just thanking Pyre for
saving us.

fields.EN: Yeah! She did us a really big favor!
fields.JP: もう一番の悩みが解消されてほんと感謝なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! She did us a really big favor!

fields.EN:
Looks like it was a good thing Shira left the
core on Leichhardt Island...
fields.JP:
シラがね、ライカード島の核を残したのが
良かったみたいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Turns out leaving that core on Licard
Island was a good idea.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.; B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.JP: あたし達さメルヒェンなんだよ

fields.EN: What?! How'd you find that out?!
fields.JP:
ええっ！！
なにいきなり衝撃発言してるんっすか！！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! How'd you find that out?!

fields.EN: Why'd you lead with that? You see...
fields.JP:
もう少し順序良く話せないのか……
僕たちは実は……
fields.LOCALIZED: Why'd you lead with that? You see...

fields.EN: ...So you were all killed once in the underground Jail, then mimicked together with the nearby weapons that belonged to the old Dawn members, and that's how you exist now?
fields.JP:
地下監獄で一度殺された皆さんは近くにあった
昔の黎明の方々の武器と一緒に擬態化されて
今いるってことっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So you guys died in the underground Jail,
but you were revived with the power of
mimicry?

fields.EN:
That's the gist of it. Think of us as a special
kind of Marchen.
fields.JP:
大枠としてはそういうことだ
特殊なメルヒェン程度に思ってくれればいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the gist of it. Think of us as a special
kind of Marchen.

fields.EN:
Which explains where all these scars came
from.
fields.JP: このみんなの傷もその時ついたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which explains where all these scars came
from.

fields.JP: 今ではおしゃれとして楽しんでるぜい！
そんな大変な目にあってたんだ……

fields.EN: Then why are you thanking Shira-san?
fields.JP: それがなんでシラさんに感謝なんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So why are you thanking her?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
We survive only because of that core's
energy. Without it, we would be dead.
fields.JP:
僕たちはジェイルの核からエネルギーを
配給しているんだ。　核がない地下監獄では
元々死にゆく運命だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We survive only because of that core's
energy. Without it, we would be dead.

fields.EN: I thought that even on the surface, we'd never be free of that worry—that every day would still be spent living side by side with death.
fields.JP:
地上にでてもその心配は尽きないし、
常に死と隣り合わせの毎日を送ると思っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were worried that coming to the
surface would result in our demise.

fields.EN:
Thanks to Shira guarding that core, we're
still kicking.
fields.JP:
そう、シラが管理権？だかなんだか
分からないけどさ、あたし達に常にエネルギーを
配給してくれる核を残してくれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to Pyre guarding that core, we're
still kicking.

fields.EN: That's great! You saved three people, Shira-san!
fields.JP:
それは良かったっすね！
シラさん３人の命を救って凄いじゃないっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's great! You saved three people, Pyre!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira
Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
本当にその通りだ
ありがとうシラ

fields.EN:
All I have to repay you with is food, but
please, allow me...
fields.JP: 料理くらいしかできないけど、沢山恩返しさせてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I have to repay you with is food, but
please, allow me...

fields.EN:
I-It was just a coincidence! As long as you
understand how amazing Shira's power is,
that's fine!
fields.JP:
べ、別にたまたまだけどね！
シラの力がすごいってわかったならいいわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it was just a coincidence! As long
as you respect my powers, we're even!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
You should worship Shira even more from now
on! S-Shira has things to do, so she's leaving!
fields.JP:
もっとこれからあがめるといいわ！
シ、シラはもう用事があるからいくわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just keep praising me! Anyway, I gotta go!
Later!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: 走って行っちゃったっすね

fields.EN:
Knowing her now, it's funny to think that
she used to terrify me.
fields.JP:
あたしも地上で処刑台少女に恐怖したけどさ。
あの子は悪い子じゃないと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowing her now, it's funny to think that
she used to terrify me.
