fields.JP: それは自分も思うっす！

fields.EN: We still owe her our lives.
fields.JP: 僕たちからも歩み寄らなきゃな
fields.LOCALIZED: We still owe her our lives.

fields.EN: Maybe we can throw her a little party?
fields.JP: カフェパーティでも開くみたいな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe we can throw her a little party?

fields.EN: (I know Shira-san's got a good heart.)
fields.JP:
（シラさんはやっぱり根っからの
　悪人じゃないっす）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I know Pyre's got a good heart.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: I'm not in pain anymore, I'm totally fine! Please!
fields.JP:
わたし、もうどこも痛くないし、
ぜんぜん大丈夫ですからっ！
お願いします！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm not in pain anymore, I'm totally fine! Please!

fields.JP: カエデさん、どうかしたんすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
She wants to help, but she won't listen. 
I told her she needs rest.
fields.JP:
彼女、どうしてもお手伝いが
したいって聞かないのよ。
まだ休んでなさいって言ったんだけどねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She wants to help, but she won't listen. 
I told her she needs rest.

fields.EN:
You've been through so much.
Please rest up.
fields.JP:
大変な目に遭われたわけですし、
ゆっくりしてくださいと伝えたのですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've been through so much.
Please rest up.

fields.EN: B-But I can't do that! I really want to repay everyone who saved me!
fields.JP:
でもでも、そんな訳にはいかないですっ。
わたしを救ってくれたみなさんに、
どうしても恩返しがしたいんです～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But... But... I'm okay now.
You saved me, so let me repay you!

fields.EN:
Hehe. You're so kind. We're lucky to have
you, Rachel.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、ほんとにしっかりしてるね。
レイチェルみたいないい子が来てくれて、
あたしも嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. You're so kind. We're lucky to have
you, Rachel.

fields.EN:
Yes. Seeing an innocent girl like you, Rachel-san,
reminds me of the Order.
fields.JP:
ええ、レイチェルさんのような
無垢な子を見ていると、教団を思い出します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing you here reminds me of my time
in the Order.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Aw, you're so nice! I'm not that good!
fields.JP:
そ、そんな、恥ずかしいです。
わたし、そんなにいい子じゃないですから～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, you're so nice! I'm not that good!

fields.EN:
No, no. I'm happy a good girl like you came along
too, Rachel-san.
fields.JP:
いやいや、自分もレイチェルさんみたいな
いい子が来てくれて、嬉しいっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, no. You should give yourself more
credit.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: えへへ、みなさん、ありがとうございます

fields.EN:
Even though I lost my parents, it feels
like I've gained a whole family of sisters.
fields.JP:
パパもママも、もういないけど……
ここにいると、お姉さんたちが
たくさんいるみたいで、寂しくないです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even though I lost my parents, it feels
like I've gained a whole family of sisters.

fields.EN:
AWWW! That's the sweetest thing I've
ever heard! You can count on us any time,
okay?
fields.JP:
あーもう！　ほんとにいじらしいんだからっ！
寂しくなったら、あたしたちに
いくらでも甘えていいからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
AWWW! That's the sweetest thing I've
ever heard! You can count on us any time,
okay?

fields.EN: Yeah! Think of me as your cool older sister♪
fields.JP:
そうよー、あたいのことも、
実のお姉さんだと思ってくれて
構わないんだから♪
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Think of me as your cool older sister♪

fields.EN:
Um, Takumi, I'm not sure that's what I'd
call you.
fields.JP:
いや、タクミの場合
お姉さんとは違うだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Takumi, I'm not sure that's what I'd
call you.

fields.EN: Me neither. I can think of a few more...
fields.JP: 同感。ツッコミを入れて欲しいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Me neither. I can think of a few more...

fields.EN:
Ugh. Let me have this! Don't be mean,
Icchan!
fields.JP:
もぅっ、今はそういう気分なの！
イッちゃんも姉御も、ひどーい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Let me have this! Don't be mean,
Icchan!

fields.EN: Aha♪ Ahaha... This is so much fun!
fields.JP:
あはっ♪　あははっ……
みなさんと一緒だとすごく楽しいです！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aha♪ Ahaha... This is so much fun!

fields.EN: But if it's okay, just for today... may I call you all 'older sisters' and 'older brothers'...?
fields.JP:
でも、もしよかったら今日だけでも
皆さんのこと「姉さん」「兄さん」って
呼んでいいですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can I pretend you guys are my sisters?
Just for today?

fields.EN:
Sure. I quite like the sound of that.
It tickles.
fields.JP:
も、もちろんいいわよ。
姉御ってのは良く言われるけど、姉さんか。
照れるね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. I quite like the sound of that.
It tickles.

fields.EN:
It's touching to know you think of us
that way.
fields.JP:
はい、むず痒いですけれど、
そう思われると嬉しいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's touching to know you think of us
that way.

fields.EN: Thank you. Of course I don't mind.
fields.JP: ありがとう、もちろん構わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you. Of course I don't mind.

fields.JP:
姉さんだなんて！
もー、レイチェルちゃんてば、いいこいいこ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルちゃん => Rachel-chan

fields.EN:
Kaede-neesan♪
Is there anything I can help you with?
fields.JP:
カエデ姉さん♪
何か手伝うことはないですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Big Sister Kaede♪
Is there anything I can help you with?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: カエデ姉さん -> Kaede-nee-san

fields.EN:
Haha. Look at you go. Want to help me
organize the pantry?
fields.JP:
はは、もう調子乗っちゃって……
じゃあ、あっちで道具の整理を
手伝ってもらおうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Look at you go. Want to help me
organize the pantry?

fields.EN:
Oh. Good idea. It's always nice to have
another pair of hands.
fields.JP:
あ、それはいいですね。
人手があると助かりますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Good idea. It's always nice to have
another pair of hands.

fields.JP:
はーい！　わかりました、
カエデ姉さん！　スクイ姉さん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, got it! Sister Kaede! Sister Sukui!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: カエデ姉さん -> Kaede-nee-san; スクイ姉さん -> Sukui-nee-san

fields.EN:
Hehe. Feels like I've gained a new little
sister.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、なんだか
新しい妹が出来たみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Feels like I've gained a new little
sister.

fields.JP:
（す、すごいっす……レイチェルさんて、
　誰にでも馴染めちゃう子なんすね）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
By the way, Shira.
Why are you called a "Genocide Pink"?
fields.JP:
ところでシラ。
なぜ『処刑台少女』なのかしら？
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Huh? Where did this come from?
That's random.
fields.JP:
は？　な、なによいきなり。
わけがわからないんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Where did this come from?
That's random.

fields.EN:
That came out of nowhere, Gretel-san.
Was there something you were curious about?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、唐突っすね～。
何か気になることでもあったんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: You're so funny, Gretel. Feeling curious?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
It isn't something I just thought of.
I've been wondering about it for quite a while.
fields.JP:
別に、いきなり思い付きで言った
わけではないわ。
前々から疑問には思っていたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hope I'm not intruding. I've wondered
for a while.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
I've finally had time to sort through my questions
one by one, so I thought I'd ask Shira.
fields.JP:
一つずつ疑問を整理していって、
やっとその事を考える時間が出来たから、
シラに確認しようと思ったわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this point, I don't think it's much of a
stretch to ask.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
First of all, has the term "Genocide Pink"
existed for a long time?
fields.JP:
そもそも、『処刑台少女』というのは、
昔からあったものなのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: How long have they been around for?
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Shira doesn't know. But... Papa said
'Genocide Pink' was apparently already
an existing term.
fields.JP:
シラはわからない。けど……
パパの話だと、『処刑台少女』っていうのは、
元々あった言葉みたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, right... Papa says they've been
around for eternity.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
(Shira-san used to sound like she was talking
to herself, but at some point she started answering
us normally...)
fields.JP:
（シラさん、前は独り言っぽく喋ってたのが、
　いつの間にか普通に受け答えしてくれる
　ようになったすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pyre used to give vague answers, or act
like she was talking to herself, but now
she's opening up.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.JP:
へぇ……。
もっと詳しく聞いてみたいわ

fields.EN:
What did the old term "Genocide Pink"
originally mean?
fields.JP:
昔からある『処刑台少女』とは、
元々はどういう意味のものだったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean for eternity?
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
...Probably beings like Shira and the others?
Papa said something like that.
Shira doesn't know the details.
fields.JP:
……多分、シラたちみたいな存在？
パパはそんな感じのこと言ってた。
詳しくは知らないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess the group's been around in some
form forever? Ask Papa. I don't know.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Yes, that's what I think too. It's clear that Shira
and the rest of us are the same kind of beings—
'Blood Maidens' and 'Genocide Pinks'.
fields.JP:
そうね、私もそう思うわ。
シラと私たちは同じ『血式少女』であり、
『処刑台少女』であることは明白だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, I see. Seems like Massacre Pink and
the Blood Maidens have a lot in common.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
It wouldn't be strange at all if there had been
others like us.
fields.JP:
他にそういう存在がいたとしても、
全く不自然ではないものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it makes sense that there were others
like us.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
(That's true. Going Genocide or Blood Skelter...
we're alike in those ways too.)
fields.JP:
（そりゃ確かに、ジェノサイド化したり、
　ブラッドスケルター化したりと、
　そういうとこも同じだったっすからね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good point. Massacre Mode and Blood
Skelter aren't too different.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
(The only real difference is whether we're based
on fairy tales or execution devices. Makes sense.)
fields.JP:
（後はモチーフが童話か、処刑器具かの
　違いくらいしかないっすから、納得っす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(One's based on fairy tales, the other
torture devices.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Shira doesn't understand the complicated stuff,
but... Shira is the same as Rapu and the others...?
fields.JP:
難しいことわかんないけど、
シラも、ラプたちと同じ……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mean I'm not too different from
you and Rappy, huh?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
...So can we assume that the surface term
'Genocide Pink' is like what we call a
'Blood Maiden' underground?
fields.JP:
……つまり、地上で呼ばれる『処刑台少女』
という名称は、地下で言う『血式少女』
のようなものだと判断していいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, we are all two halves of
the same coin. Is that it?
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
...Not necessarily. Shira thinks she heard
there are all sorts of other names too...
fields.JP:
……そうとは限らない。
なんか、他にも色々な呼ばれ方が
あるらしいって聞いたような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not necessarily. There's a lot more to all
of us than meets the eye.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Papa said, 'It's a name that must not be forgotten,
so that's what I call you.'
fields.JP:
ただ、パパが『これは忘れてはいけない名前
だから、お前達をそう呼んでいる』
って言ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Papa just kinda gave us the name, and
it stuck.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
I see. Your 'Papa' seems to be very attached
to the term 'Genocide Pink'.
fields.JP:
ふぅん、貴女の“パパ”というのは、
余程『ジェノサイド・ピンク』という言葉に
思い入れがあるようね
fields.LOCALIZED: Sounds like this Papa's attached to it.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
And despite the name, none of your colors really
suggest pink. I wonder if that's connected somehow...
fields.JP:
貴女達の色合いも、名前と違って
ピンクというイメージはないけれど、
その辺りも何か関係しているのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But none of you are pink. I wonder what
the color means.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.JP: シラは、そこまでは知らな……
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
...W-Wait, crap! Shira said too much!
Forget it! Forget everything Shira just said!
fields.JP:
……ってっ、やばっ！
つ、つい喋り過ぎちゃった！
なし、いまのは、全部なしっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, crap! I said too much! Forget what
I said, got it?!
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
(No, I think it's already too late. Gretel-san kept
asking, and Shira-san honestly told her everything...)
fields.JP:
（いや、既に手遅れな気がするっす。
　グレーテルさんから聞かれるまま、
　素直に全部喋ってたっすからね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Um. It's too late. You answered all of
Gretel's questions.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Aah! Papa will scold Shira if he finds out!
Don't ever tell Papa what Shira just said!
If you do, Shira'll kill you!
fields.JP:
ああーっ、バレたらしかられちゃう！
い、今の話、パパには絶対内緒だからね！
しゃべったら、ころすから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! If they hear I told you that,
they'll kill me! Don't tell Papa! Or I'll
kill you!
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Oh, what a shame.
I wanted to get a little more out of you.
fields.JP:
あら、残念。
もう少し聞き出したかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED: How terrible. I still have so many questions.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Shira-san is so innocent, like a small child.
She's adorable.
fields.JP:
シラさんの反応って、何だか小さい子
みたいで素直で可愛いっすよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre is so innocent, like a small child.
She's adorable.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(I never knew the name "Genocide Pink"
had that kind of history behind it.)
fields.JP:
（でも、自分も知らなかったっす。
　『処刑台少女』って名前には、
　そんな歴史があったんすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I didn't know that "Massacre Pink" 
had that history.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.JP:
これは……とても面白い本ね。
ふふっ、うふふ

fields.EN:
(Gretel-san always looks like she enjoys reading,
but it's rare for her to actually say it out loud.
Is the book really that interesting?)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんて、いつも楽しそうに
　本を読んでるっすけど、言葉にするのは
　珍しいっすね。そんなに面白かったんすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel always looks like she enjoys reading,
but it's weird. Is it really interesting?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN: Gretel-san, what kind of book are you reading?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、今読んでるのって、
どういう本なんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel, what kind of book are you reading?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Oh, this book contains the author's personal
observations and the history of the 'Genocide Pink'
that has been passed down since long ago.
fields.JP:
ああ、この本にはね、昔から伝わる
『処刑台少女』について、著者の個人的な
考察や、その歴史が書かれているのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, a book on Massacre Pink, detailing
their history and the author's opinion.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology; B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Though it's limited to what this book's author
personally witnessed.
fields.JP:
あくまでも、この本の著者が見て来たレベルで、
の話だけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is at the minimum just a perspective
from the author.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
'Genocide Pink'... It seems they, much like us
'Blood Maidens,' have quite a history behind them.
fields.JP:
『ジェノサイド・ピンク』…私達でいう
『血式少女』にも、様々な事があったようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Massacre Pink, and Blood Maidens for
that matter, have quite the history.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN: Oh? What kind of things does it say?
fields.JP:
へー、ちなみに、どんな感じのことが
書かれてたんすか？
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
For example, it says here that they were
'sometimes champions of justice' and 'sometimes
saviors who rescued people.'
fields.JP:
例えばここにはこう書かれているわ。
彼女達は『時には正義の味方』であり、
『時には人々を救う救世主』であったと
fields.LOCALIZED:
It discusses their powers, their capacity for
justice, and their potential as saviors of
humanity.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Genocide Pink/Blood Maiden explanatory scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
Their primary duty once was to rid the
world of Marchens and Nightmares.
fields.JP:
その独自の力を用いて、メルヒェンや
ナイトメアなどの退治を生業にしていたそうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Their primary duty once was to rid the
world of Marchens and Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Oh, just like the Blood Maidens!
They must be a pretty big deal!
fields.JP:
おおーっ、本当に『血式少女』と同じっすね！
『ジェノサイド・ピンク』にも、
みなさんのように立派な人もいたんすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, just like the Blood Maidens!
They must be a pretty big deal!

fields.EN:
What intrigues me is that, once upon a
time, Genocide Pink fought FOR the people.
fields.JP:
でもね、本当に面白いのはこの先よ。
どうやら初めは、人々のために戦っていた
『ジェノサイド・ピンク』達だったけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What intrigues me is that, once upon a
time, Massacre Pink fought FOR the people.

fields.EN:
But the power got to their heads, and they
began to dominate humanity once they
ascertained enough influence.
fields.JP:
崇め称えられることで、やがて権力者や
統治者として、人々の上に立つようになり、
横暴な行動が目立つようになった、とあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the power got to their heads, and they
began to dominate humanity once they
ascertained enough influence.

fields.EN:
Power really does corrupt, huh?
That makes me sad.
fields.JP:
えっ、そんなすごい人達だったのに、
いつの間にか権力に溺れていっちゃったんすか…
何だか切ないっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Power really does corrupt, huh?
That makes me sad.

fields.EN:
The very same thing could happen to
us.
fields.JP:
でもね、これは、私達にとっても
他人事じゃないの。
大いにあり得る話だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The very same thing could happen to
us.

fields.JP:
いやいや、みなさんに限って
それは絶対ないっすよー

fields.EN:
Never say never. Unchecked power is
the most potent temptation there is.
fields.JP:
いいえ、絶対ということはないのよ。
人が権力を得た時の怖さを知らない人間は、
簡単に権力に溺れるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never say never. Unchecked power is
the most potent temptation there is.

fields.EN:
No doubt they once had good intentions,
but no one is infallible from corruption.
fields.JP:
最初は純粋に人々の為、崇高な使命を以て
力を振るっていたとしても、権力に取り憑かれた
者達は、やがてその慧眼を濁らせる
fields.LOCALIZED:
No doubt they once had good intentions,
but no one is infallible from corruption.

fields.EN:
If we wish to avoid the same fate, we
must work hard to keep such ambitions
in check.
fields.JP:
そうやって堕ちてゆきたくないのなら、
私達にもそれなりの努力と、
自制心が求められるでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we wish to avoid the same fate, we
must work hard to keep such ambitions
in check.

fields.EN: I see. How tragic. Scary to think about.
fields.JP:
なるほど、嫌な時代があったんすね……
いやー、力があるってのは、
ある意味怖いものなんすね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. How tragic. Scary to think about.

fields.EN:
I love you guys. I don't ever want that
to happen.
fields.JP:
自分は、今のみなさんが好きだから、
そんな風にはなって欲しくないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love you guys. I don't ever want that
to happen.

fields.EN:
Right. I personally do not want to be
a fool, drunk with power.
fields.JP:
そうね、私個人としても、
欲に溺れた滑稽な人間にだけは
なりたくないものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I personally do not want to be
a fool, drunk with power.

fields.EN: Oh, hey Shira-san. Why are you staring at Sukui-san?
fields.JP:
あれ、シラさん、さっきから
スクイさんのことを気にしてるんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, hey Pyre. Why are you staring at Sukui?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: スクイさん => Sukui-san; シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
I-I'm not. I mean... I just felt like Sukui is
the only one who's dressed differently.
I wanted a closer look.
fields.JP:
べ、別に。気になるっていうか……
スクイだけが他と違う格好をしてるから。
それで、ちょっと見てただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not. I mean... I just felt like Sukui is
the only one who's dressed differently.
I wanted a closer look.

fields.EN:
Oh, this outfit? It's what we in the Order
of the Sun wear.
fields.JP:
ああ、この服装のことでしょうか？
これは、『タイヨウ教団』と呼ばれる、
教団の関係者が身に着ける衣装なんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, this outfit? It's what we in the Order
of the Sun wear.

fields.JP:
タイヨウ・キョウダン？
それって、何かの組織とか？

fields.EN:
I'm not too familiar either.
Michiru-san is their head.
fields.JP:
自分はあんま詳しくないんすけど……
ミチルさんっていう人が
教祖をやってる組織なんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not too familiar either.
Michiru is their head.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
I think they believe in some kind of sun
god to lead them out of Jail. Something
like that.
fields.JP:
その教えの中に、太陽の神様？を
信じていれば、人々を監獄の外に出して
くれる？的な、予言があるらしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think they believe in some kind of sun
god to lead them out of Jail. Something
like that.

fields.EN:
...That is Lady Oohime's prophecy.
One day the sun will guide us all to
salvation.
fields.JP:
……それは、大陽女様のお告げですね。
『いつかタイヨウが天幕を焼き、監獄の
外へ人々を連れ出してくれるでしょう』と
fields.LOCALIZED:
...That is Lady Oohime's prophecy.
One day the sun will guide us all to
salvation.

fields.EN:
We in the order believed that and carried
about our lives hoping it would come true.
fields.JP:
わたくしたちタイヨウの教団の者は、
地下でそれを信じて日々を過ごしていました
fields.LOCALIZED:
We in the order believed that and carried
about our lives hoping it would come true.

fields.JP: まあ、平たく言うとそうっすね

fields.EN:
...Shira doesn't understand at all. Papa said
religion is something weak humans without
power do...
fields.JP:
……シラはぜんぜん、理解できない。
宗教なんてものは、力の無い弱い人間が
やるもんだって、パパが言ってたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't get it. Papa said religions are for
the weak.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: No, no, that's not true! It was one of the things people could truly lean on emotionally in life underground.
fields.JP:
いやいや、そんなこともないっすよ！
地下生活での、立派な心の拠り所の一つっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, that's a little harsh. It gave a lot of
people in the underground hope.

fields.EN:
No, Shira-san's right. I believed because of
weakness.
fields.JP:
……いいえ、シラさんが仰る通りです。
わたくしは、とても弱い人間でした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, Pyre's right. I believed because of
weakness.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
I thought I'd be stuck underground forever.
I saw the faith as a way to distract myself
from the sickening reality.
fields.JP:
地下ジェイルに閉じ込められたまま、
外にも出ることも叶わず、
現状を打破する力も無い、ちっぽけな人間……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I'd be stuck underground forever.
I saw the faith as a way to distract myself
from the sickening reality.

fields.EN:
But then I saw Michiru-sama, and it struck me. I
wanted to become someone calm yet strong at heart,
just like her.
fields.JP:
ですが、そんな時に大陽女様…ミチル様を見て、
わたくしは衝撃を受け、こう思いました。
彼女のように穏やかで、芯の強い人になりたいと
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Lady Oohime. After meeting her,
I was inspired to follow in her stead.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(I see. Sukui-san must have aspired to be like
Michiru-san.)
fields.JP:
（なるほど、スクイさんは、
　教団のミチルさんって人を
　心の目標にしてたんっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. Sukui must have aspired to be like
Michiru.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san; スクイさん => Sukui-san

fields.EN: The sun gave me hope, and I followed.
fields.JP:
タイヨウはわたくしに、生きる希望と、
進むべき道を教えて下さったのです
fields.LOCALIZED: The sun gave me hope, and I followed.

fields.EN:
The desperate cling to whatever hope they
can find.
fields.JP:
無力感に苛まれ、何かに願わざるを
得ない人間もいるのですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The desperate cling to whatever hope they
can find.

fields.EN:
You're still young, Shira-san, so it may be
difficult to understand. But...
fields.JP:
シラさんはまだ小さいですし、
難しいかもしれませんね。
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This might be difficult to comprehend at
your age, but...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
The world can be unkind, and sometimes
it's better to work for a paycheck than
wait to win the lottery.
fields.JP:
世の中にはそういった者も少なからずいますし、
それに誇りを持って生きる人間もいるのだと、
頭の片隅で覚えておいてもらえると嬉しいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
The world can be unkind, and sometimes
it's better to work for a paycheck than
wait to win the lottery.

fields.JP:
何かを願わざるを得ない……か。
うん、そっか……

fields.EN:
...Sukui. Shira understands that feeling too.
Sorry for saying it in such a strange way...
fields.JP:
……スクイ。
シラも、その気持ち……分かる。
変な風に言って、その、ごめん……なさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sukui, I think I know what you mean.
Sorry for saying those things.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: いえいえ、とんでもないです！

fields.EN:
I was happy to learn that you understood how those
of us in the Order feel, Shira-san.
fields.JP:
シラさんが教団に身を置く者たちの
気持ちを理解して下さったと知って、
わたくしも嬉しかったですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just glad you can see where we're
coming from.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
（お、おお……驚きっすね。
　あのシラさんが、めちゃくちゃ素直に
　謝ってたっす……！）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(Maybe Sukui-san's story helped Shira-san discover
something important.)
fields.JP:
（スクイさんの話は、シラさんにとって、
　何かいい発見になったんすかね）
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): スクイ => Sukui-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: へぇ……ここはそういう名前なのね

fields.EN:
...Salvation Tower.
Does Genocide Pink control it?
fields.JP:
……救済の監獄塔。
ここも、誰か処刑台少女が管理してるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Salvation Tower.
Does Massacre Pink control it?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: …………ここは首吊り姉さんが管理してるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: This is in Sister Gallows' dominion.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
(Kubitsuridai...almost killed me. My hair's
standing thinking of it.)
fields.JP:
（首吊り台……って、自分を半殺しにした人っす
　正直いまだに思い出すと震えるっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gallows...almost killed me. My hair's
standing thinking of it.)

fields.EN: Oh, it's Rachel-san. What's the matter?
fields.JP:
あ、レイチェルさん
どうしたっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's Rachel. What's the matter?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
*pant*...*pant*... I'm so glad we made it.
Um, please eat this!
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……良かった間に合った。
これあの皆さんが食べてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant*...*pant*... I'm so glad we made it.
Um, please eat this!

fields.EN:
Yeah! Well, more like baked flour.
But I hope you like it!
fields.JP:
はい！クッキーというか、
ただの焼いた小麦粉みたいな物なんですけど、
少しでも探索の役に立てばいいなって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! Well, more like baked flour.
But I hope you like it!

fields.JP: ほんとっ！　やったーーー！
あら、最高の差し入れね

fields.EN: Oh, it does look good. Did you bake this?
fields.JP:
ほんとだ、おいしそう……
これレイチェルが焼いたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it does look good. Did you bake this?

fields.EN: I'm so glad you guys like it!
fields.JP: みなさん喜んでくれて嬉しいです！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so glad you guys like it!

fields.EN: Thank you so much Rachel-san! I appreciate it!
fields.JP:
レイチェルさん感謝っす！
ありがたく頂くっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you so much Rachel! I appreciate it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
(Thanks to Rachel-san, my anxiety subsided.
What a relief.)
fields.JP:
（レイチェルさんのおかげで恐怖が薄れたっす。
　よかったっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thanks to Rachel, my anxiety subsided.
What a relief.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
I was afraid we'd run into Kubitsuridai, so this
calms my nerves!
fields.JP:
正直、首吊り台がいるって聞いて怖かったっす。
今こういうのはほんと勇気でるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was afraid we'd run into Gallows, so this
calms my nerves!

fields.JP: 名前の時点でこわいっすよね

fields.EN:
What is that? Never heard of it, but
it spooks me out!
fields.JP:
なにそれなにそれ、見たことないけど
聞くだけでも怖いです
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is that? Never heard of it, but
it spooks me out!

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Fear not, Rachel! I'll finish this
before you ever have to face it!
fields.JP:
はっはっはっ！　安心するが良いレイチェルよ！
我が会うこともなく終わらせてやにょうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Fear not Rachel! I won't lyet you
come into hyarm's way!

fields.EN: That was just my foreign accent!
fields.JP: こ、これは欧米風に言っただけだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That was just my foreign accent!

fields.JP: みなさん……本当に無理しないでくださいね

fields.EN: Thanks Rachel-san. See you back at camp.
fields.JP:
ありがとうっす。レイチェルさんは大人しく
キャンプ地で待っててほしいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks Rachel. See you back at camp.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
(All right. That was sweet of her!
Gotta do my best for Rachel!)
fields.JP:
（よし、元気をもらったっす！
　探索がんばるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All right. That was sweet of her!
Gotta do my best for Rachel!)

fields.EN: We have just a little bit of our journey left!
fields.JP: 自分たちの旅もあと少しって感じっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: We have just a little bit of our journey left!

fields.EN:
Right. If we beat that Gatou guy, that
takes care of our biggest problem.
fields.JP:
そうだな、あの賀東という男を叩けば、
少なくとも大きな不安は取り除かれるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. If we beat that Gato guy, that
takes care of our biggest problem.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN: The battle we're about to face will decide our fate. We need to steel ourselves too!
fields.JP:
これから挑むのは、まさに命運を分ける
戦いになるってわけね。
あたし達も気合いを入れなきゃね！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is the big one, huh? I'm ready!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.JP:
（ううっ…い、いざ、そう思うと
　急に緊張してくるっすね）

fields.EN:
I'm sure you guys will be fine. You have the 
sun's divine protection too.
fields.JP:
……皆さんでしたら、きっと大丈夫ですよ。
タイヨウのご加護もついてるはずですから。
皆さんに、暖かい陽が共にありますように
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you guys will be fine. You have the 
sun's divine protection too.

fields.EN: Thank you! That makes me feel better!
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとうっす！
そう言われると、ホッとするっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you! That makes me feel better!

fields.EN: Ugh. Darn. They stole all my lines!
fields.JP:
……って、もう！　
ウチが言いたかったこと、
全部姉御達に言われちゃったわー
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Darn. They stole all my lines!

fields.EN: All that matters is that you mean it.
fields.JP:
あら、気持ちがこもってるなら、
別に同じような言葉でもいいじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: All that matters is that you mean it.

fields.EN: Sis! It's like totally not okay!
fields.JP:
姉御～！
ぜんっぜんよくないわよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sis! It's like totally not okay!

fields.EN: Now now, you two. Leave it there.
fields.JP: まぁまぁ、お２人ともそのくらいで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Now now, you two. Leave it there.

fields.EN:
Keep acting like that, and you'll jinx
the girls.
fields.JP: 肝心な時にそれじゃあ、くらら達が呆れるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep acting like that, and you'll jinx
the girls.

fields.EN:
N-No! Seeing everyone acting just like usual
helped me relax.
fields.JP:
い、いえっ、皆さんがいつも通りだな―と
思ったら、良い具合にリラックスできたっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, don't mind us. I appreciate it.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
いつも通りが、一番……

fields.EN:
Kaede-san and the others have supported us with
everything around camp, even risking your lives.
I can't thank you enough.
fields.JP:
カエデさん達には、自分達の身の回りの
こととか、命掛けでサポートしてもらって、
感謝してもしきれないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't thank you all enough for everything
you've done. We owe you our lives.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Don't mention it. We can't fight like you
can. Just happy to do our part.
fields.JP:
ううん、大したことはしてないわよ。
あたし達はあんた達みたいに戦えないし、
いつも危険なことばかりさせちゃってるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't mention it. We can't fight like you
can. Just happy to do our part.

fields.EN:
All we want is to give you a fighting
shot.
fields.JP:
だから、せめて生活面くらいは…って
やってただけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we want is to give you a fighting
shot.

fields.EN:
No, really, we were grateful! You took the lead with
cooking, laundry, and all sorts of things, Kaede-san.
fields.JP:
いやいや、それが本当にありがたかったっす！
カエデさんは、炊事洗濯から色んなことを
率先してやってくれたっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I mean! All that cooking and
laundry is much appreciated!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Yeah! You're a good cook, Kaede!
fields.JP:
うんっ！　カエデのつくったごはん、
すっごくおいしかったよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! You're a good cook, Kaede!

fields.EN:
You're like our mother hen. You kept us
afloat and helped us stay positive!
fields.JP:
まるでみんなの、お母さんみたいだったっす。
何よりすごく前向きで諦めない姿勢から、
自分も元気を貰えたっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're like our mother hen. You kept us
afloat and helped us stay positive!

fields.EN:
Haha. I'm not old enough to be a parent.
But it warms my heart to hear you say
that. Thanks!
fields.JP:
ははっ、流石にこんな大きな子がいる
ような歳じゃないけどね。でも……
そう言われると素直に嬉しいよ。ありがと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. I'm not old enough to be a parent.
But it warms my heart to hear you say
that. Thanks!

fields.EN: Hehe. No better time to say it than now.
fields.JP:
へへ……こんな時っすからね、
改めて言っちゃったっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. No better time to say it than now.

fields.EN:
(Yeah. This is as good of a chance as we're
gonna get. It needed to be said.)
fields.JP:
（そうっす……本当にこれはいい機会っす。
　自分の気持ちを伝えておきたいっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yeah. This is as good of a chance as we're
gonna get. It needed to be said.)

fields.EN: And Itsuki-san, I appreciate you too!
fields.JP:
それに、イツキさんにも
感謝してるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: And Itsuki, I appreciate you too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: イツキさん => Itsuki-san

fields.EN: Hm? I don't remember doing anything.
fields.JP:
ん？　僕は特に感謝されるようなこと
をした覚えはないんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? I don't remember doing anything.

fields.EN: No way! You even listened when I asked you about the Blood Youth abilities I still don't understand!
fields.JP:
とんでもないっす！　自分にはまだまだ
分からない、血式少年としての能力の
相談にも乗ってくれたじゃないっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about? You're
the best listener I know!

fields.EN:
I thought you were standoffish at first,
but you're as kind as they come.
fields.JP:
最初は、少しぶっきらぼうな人かとも
思ったっすけど、本当はとっても
優しい人だって分かったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you were standoffish at first,
but you're as kind as they come.

fields.EN:
Man. You're gonna make me cry.
I don't know what to say.
fields.JP:
……参ったな。
面と向かって感謝されると、
どう返していいか分からない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man. You're gonna make me cry.
I don't know what to say.

fields.EN:
Itsuki, your eye for observation is a blessing.
I enjoy our discussions.
fields.JP:
イツキの持っている観察眼や知識は、
私とも違う切り口で、有意義な会話を楽しめてるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki, your eye for observation is a blessing.
I enjoy our discussions.

fields.EN: Haha. Means a lot coming from you, Gretel.
fields.JP:
はは……まさかグレーテルに
褒められるとは、思ってもみなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. Means a lot coming from you, Gretel.

fields.EN: And Sukui-san... You saved my skin!
fields.JP:
そして……スクイさんにも
自分はたくさん助けられたっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: And Sukui... You saved my skin!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: スクイさん => Sukui-san

fields.EN:
Duh! No matter how tough things got,
you always had a smile for me.
fields.JP:
うっす！　どんなにつらい時でも
ニコニコと優しい言葉を
掛けてくれたじゃないっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Duh! No matter how tough things got,
you always had a smile for me.

fields.EN:
You never shooed me away, it means so
much. I can always count on you!
fields.JP:
つい甘えたくなっちゃう時にも話に
乗ってくれたりして、とっても嬉しかったっす！
すごく……すごく頼りになったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You never shooed me away, it means so
much. I can always count on you!

fields.EN: Aw. I'm nothing compared to Michiru-sama.
fields.JP:
そんな……ミチル様にくらべたら、
わたくしなど、まだまだです
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. I'm nothing compared to Lady Michiru.
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ミチル様 => Michiru-sama (remove localized English title)

fields.EN:
But...I don't want to do a disservice to the
sun, so I appreciate your kind words.
fields.JP:
でも……少しはタイヨウに恥じない
ように振る舞えたのであれば、
わたくしにとって、それは喜ばしいことです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...I don't want to do a disservice to the
sun, so I appreciate your kind words.

fields.JP: ……シラも、スクイのことは好きだよ
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
So am I next? Aw, don't make me blush!
Come on! I'm all ears, baby!
fields.JP:
……ってことは、次はあたいの番ってやつ？
いやー、照れるわね―。
ほらほら、何でも言っちゃってー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So am I next? Aw, don't make me blush!
Come on! I'm all ears, baby!

fields.JP:
そうっすね。
えっと、タクミさんは……変人っすね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: タクミさん => Takumi-san

fields.EN: Kidding of course! It was a joke!
fields.JP: あっ、もちろん嘘っす、嘘っす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Kidding of course! It was a joke!

fields.EN:
I can't believe that, as a fellow Blood Weapon
craftsman, you could do as much as Master...!
fields.JP:
まさか同じ血式武器職人として、
師匠と同じくらい色々できたなんて、
驚いたっす……！
fields.LOCALIZED: But the Boss taught you well!
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: I could say the same to you, Clara-chan.
fields.JP:
まぁ、オレっちも師匠は
くららちゃんと同じだしな
fields.LOCALIZED: I could say the same to you, Clara.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.EN:
We're practically family, so there's more
I could say.
fields.JP:
……確かに、自分の兄弟弟子的な
立ち位置になると思うと、複雑っす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're practically family, so there's more
I could say.

fields.EN: Oh, please. I'd do it all again in a heartbeat.
fields.JP:
イケズねぇ、ま、この力をあんた達の為に
存分に使って役立てられて、
良かったなーって思ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, please. I'd do it all again in a heartbeat.

fields.JP: はいっす！　すごく頼りになるっす！

fields.EN:
Anyway, thanks for all your support!
Thank you all!
fields.JP:
とにかく、ここに来るまで、
ずっと自分達を支えてくれて……
皆さん、本当にありがとうっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, thanks for all your support!
Thank you all!

fields.EN: We're working together to escape this place!
fields.JP:
みんなで力を合わせて、
見事この場所から脱獄するっすよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED: We're working together to escape this place!

fields.EN:
Mwahahaha! Of course! Of course!
Everyone, follow the great Demon Kyng!
fields.JP:
ぬははは～っ！　当然当然！
皆の者、この大魔王についてくりゅのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mwahahaha! Of course! Of course! 
All you people. Hyeed the Demon Kyng!

fields.EN: There she goes again. It's a bit now.
fields.JP:
また肝心なところで噛んでいるわね……
本当に頼りになるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: There she goes again. It's a bit now.

fields.JP: か、噛んでなどおらにゅ！

なんだか、一気に締まらない
雰囲気になったわね

でも、めるんらしいー！
あはははっ！

fields.EN: Haha. You're right. Best team ever!
fields.JP:
ははっ、そうっすね。
これもまた、このグループらしさってことっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. You're right. Best team ever!

fields.EN: Totally. It all worked out perfectly.
fields.JP:
まったくだわ。あんた達の場合、
それが良い具合に噛み合ってるんでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED: Totally. It all worked out perfectly.

fields.EN:
Well, better than hating each other.
I have faith in you.
fields.JP:
ああ、下手に肩に力を入れて挑むよりも、
良い結果が残せるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, better than hating each other.
I have faith in you.

fields.JP:
そーそ、色んな意味で
準備もバッチリってことねー

fields.EN:
Everyone, may the sun's divine protection
bless you.
fields.JP:
改めて……皆さんに、
タイヨウのご加護のあらんことを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone, may the sun's divine protection
bless you.

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness for our friends.
We can accomplish anything!)
fields.JP:
（こんなに頼もしい人たちが仲間だと、
　一切負ける気がしないっす……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness for our friends.
We can accomplish anything!)

fields.EN:
(Dad, Mom, Grandma... My heart's so
full. All we can do is push forward!)
fields.JP:
（父ちゃん、母ちゃん……婆ちゃん……
　自分お腹も胸もいっぱいっす……。
　あとは動くだけっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Dad, Mom, Grandma... My heart's so
full. All we can do is push forward!)

fields.JP: （そして師匠……待っててほしいっす！）

fields.EN:
Hey Jabberwock, could I borrow you for
a minute?
fields.JP:
ちょっと聞きたいことがあるんだが、
いいか、ジャバウォック
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Jabberwock, could I borrow you for
a minute?

fields.JP: どうしたんだい、ジュウくん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウくん => Toh-kun | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
How did you get here? Specifically in this
tower.
fields.JP:
お前はどういう経緯でここにいる？
何故こんな監獄塔に１人でいるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you get here? Specifically in this
tower.

fields.JP: はは、君は随分とまっすぐに聞いてくるのだね

fields.EN:
Of course. If we're going to move about
together, I need to know what kind of
person you are.
fields.JP:
当たり前だ。行動を共にするのであれば、
お前が何者かより知っておく必要があるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. If we're going to move about
together, I need to know what kind of
person you are.

fields.EN:
You're right. Actually, I'd be more worried
if you didn't ask. Here's this...
fields.JP:
確かにそうだね。むしろこの状況で
聞かれない方が心配になる。……これを
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Actually, I'd be more worried
if you didn't ask. Here's this...

fields.EN: There's a lot of you. Researchers?
fields.JP: 随分大勢いるな。これは皆、研究者たちか？
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a lot of you. Researchers?

fields.EN:
Yup. Everyone on the Jail and Marchen
research team.
fields.JP:
そうだ。皆、ジェイルや
メルヒェンの研究者たちだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Everyone on the Jail and Marchen
research team.

fields.EN: Actually, I was with several of them until just a few days ago. Originally, though, we were a group of several dozen...
fields.JP:
実は本当に、ほんの数日前まで
彼ら数人と一緒にいたんだ。まあ、元々は
数十名からなる団体だったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I saw some of them just a few days
ago. We started with about a dozen.

fields.EN: But no longer. Did you quit?
fields.JP:
どんどん減って、
最終的にお前も団体を抜けたということか？
fields.LOCALIZED: But no longer. Did you quit?

fields.JP: いや。簡単に言うと、殺されたんだ……

fields.EN:
Surviving up here isn't easy, know what
I mean?
fields.JP:
今の地上において、外の世界で生きるのは
非常に困難なのは分かるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surviving up here isn't easy, know what
I mean?

fields.EN:
Hard to move around with a gigantic Jail
hovering around.
fields.JP:
ああ、あまりにも荒廃しきっている上に、
天を突くほどの巨大な監獄塔があるしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hard to move around with a gigantic Jail
hovering around.

fields.EN:
They call it the Devouring Armada Tower
up here.
fields.JP:
あの監獄塔は、地上の人間の間では
『悪食の監隊塔』と呼ばれている
fields.LOCALIZED:
They call it the Devouring Armada Tower
up here.

fields.EN: That's a talk for another day.
fields.JP:
まあそれについては今度また、
分かる範囲で詳しく説明しよう
fields.LOCALIZED: That's a talk for another day.

fields.EN: Anyway, that thing killed most of our team.
fields.JP:
ともあれ、何十人もいた研究者は
悪食の監隊塔に巻き込まれ命を落とした……
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, that thing killed most of our team.

fields.EN:
Some of us thought it'd be safer to live
inside of it.
fields.JP:
そこで生き残った私たち数名は、
外よりは安全と考え、あえて監獄塔に入った
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some of us thought it'd be safer to live
inside of it.

fields.EN: Marchens and Nightmares were frightening, but compared with senseless death outside, our chances of survival were definitely higher.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンやナイトメアの
恐怖はあるものの、外での理不尽な死に比べれば、
まだ生きる可能性が高いのは確かだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, no one likes Marchens or Nightmares,
but sometimes the devil you know is better
than the devil you don't.

fields.EN: But the Jail still wasn't a place ordinary humans could live. In the end, those few were killed by Marchens too...
fields.JP:
だがやはり、監獄塔は普通の人間が住める
場所ではなかったのだ。その数名も、
結局はメルヒェンに殺されてしまった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not that the Jail's a resort. Some of them
died upon entering too.

fields.EN:
(Jabberwock's making a lot of sense.
If he's telling the truth, that is.)
fields.JP:
（ジャバウォックの話におかしな所はなく、
　納得もできる内容だ。　
　もちろん嘘がなければ、だがな。）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jabberwock's making a lot of sense.
If he's telling the truth, that is.)

fields.EN:
Honestly, the past few days have been
rough. I've accepted my time's around
the corner.
fields.JP:
正直、この数日は
結構絶望的な気持ちになっていてね。
ただ死を待つばかりだと思っていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, the past few days have been
rough. I've accepted my time's around
the corner.

fields.EN: So when I heard a voice coming from that transfer orb, I was so happy I forgot my age. Clinging to a sliver of hope, I headed toward it without even considering whether it was dangerous.
fields.JP:
だからあの転送球体から声が聞こえてきた時は、
年甲斐もなく喜び、一縷の望みと共に、
危険かどうかも考えず、向かってしまったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when I heard a voice through the orb,
I grabbed that sliver of hope and hopped in.

fields.JP: なるほど、そういうことだったのか

fields.EN:
(Doesn't seem like he's much of a team
player.)
fields.JP:
（でも、それにしてはこいつは
　『一緒にいてくれ』とは言わないのだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Doesn't seem like he's much of a team
player.)

fields.EN: (But he made it this far. He's got courage.)
fields.JP:
（さすがここまで生き残っただけあって、
　肝が据わっている……ということか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But he made it this far. He's got courage.)

fields.EN: That's why I'm truly grateful I got to meet you all like this.
fields.JP:
だから私は、こうして君たちに出会えて、
本当に感謝しているんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
On my end, I'm lucky to have found you
guys.

fields.EN: There's no need to thank us. We're only together because our interests happen to align.
fields.JP:
別に感謝などしなくていい。
一緒にいるというのは、互いに
利害が一致しているってだけの話だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't mention it. We need all the help we
can get.

fields.EN:
Haha. Even so, I'm grateful. Anything
else you want to know?
fields.JP:
はは、そうだとしても感謝するよ。
それで、他に聞きたいことはあるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Even so, I'm grateful. Anything
else you want to know?

fields.EN:
Are you the last Jail researcher on the
surface?
fields.JP:
そういえば、地上のジェイル研究者は
もうお前しかいないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you the last Jail researcher on the
surface?

fields.EN:
There was another one, a long time ago.
One I used to call my friend.
fields.JP:
……私は最初の頃、戦友と呼べるほど
認め合った若い研究者と一緒にいたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There was another one, a long time ago.
One I used to call my friend.

fields.EN: But we lost each other a long time ago.
fields.JP:
だが彼とは、皆で逃げ出した時、
最初にはぐれてしまってね
fields.LOCALIZED: But we lost each other a long time ago.

fields.EN: If anyone's alive, it's him. At least I hope.
fields.JP:
仮に生きている研究者がいるとすれば、
彼くらいかもしれない。どこかで
生きているといいのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED: If anyone's alive, it's him. At least I hope.

fields.EN: Right. Sorry for digging up the past.
fields.JP:
そうか。辛いことを
思い出させてしまい、すまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Sorry for digging up the past.

fields.EN: No worries. Hope it helps somehow.
fields.JP:
いいさ。これで君の私への疑念が、
多少なりとも晴れたのなら安いもんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: No worries. Hope it helps somehow.

fields.EN:
Well, I'm gonna call it a night. If you
need anything else, you know where
to find me.
fields.JP:
じゃあ今日はこの辺りで終わろうか。
また聞きたいことがあれば、何でも聞いてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm gonna call it a night. If you
need anything else, you know where
to find me.

fields.EN:
(Huh? That's Haru and Jabberwock.
What are they whispering about?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　ハルとジャバウォックじゃないか。
　あいつら２人で何をコソコソと話してるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? That's Haru and Jabberwock.
What are they whispering about?)

fields.EN: (I didn't see what they were talking about before, but they're from the same planet... Maybe I can get some useful information.)
fields.JP:
（ここまでのやり取りを見てはいないが、
　あいつらは同じ星の住人……もしかしたら
　何か情報を掴めるかもしれないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're both from the same planet.
Maybe I can dig in deeper.)

fields.EN:
(Still, if I go into the laboratory, they may stop
talking. Better listen from outside.)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、研究室に入っていったら
　話をやめてしまうかもしれない。
　ここは外から探った方がいいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then again, they may stop if they
see me.)
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: I never thought I'd see you again, Jabberwock.
fields.JP:
まさかお前に会えるとは思わなかったぜ、
ジャバウォック
fields.LOCALIZED: I never thought I'd see you again, Jabberwock.

fields.EN: Same here. I hardly believed my eyes.
fields.JP:
私もだよ。皆の中に君を見つけた時は、
我が目を疑ったくらいだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Same here. I hardly believed my eyes.

fields.EN: I thought you had died a long time ago.
fields.JP: お互い、生きていたとは思わなかったな……
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought you had died a long time ago.

fields.EN:
We were separated soon after arriving on
this planet. Seeing you now...must be fate.
fields.JP:
星をなくし、この地に降り立ち、
いつの間にか散り散りになって……
それでもまた会えるとは、これも腐れ縁かな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were separated soon after arriving on
this planet. Seeing you now...must be fate.

fields.EN:
Right, I concur. Small world.
Or should I say, small universe.
fields.JP:
ああ、まったくだ。
これほど世界……いや宇宙が
狭いと思ったことはないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, I concur. Small world.
Or should I say, small universe.

fields.EN: Hahaha. Glad to see you too, Haru.
fields.JP: ははは、再会できて嬉しいよ、ハル君。
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. Glad to see you too, Haru.

fields.EN:
...So I wanted to ask you. Haru, you couldn't
stop my brother?
fields.JP:
……それで、１つ聞きたいのだが。
ハル君、君じゃ兄さんを止められなかったのかい
fields.LOCALIZED:
...So I wanted to ask you. Haru, you couldn't
stop my brother?

fields.EN:
No, it's fine. I know you tried.
And I know my brother.
fields.JP:
いや、いいんだ。
君が止めようとしたことは容易に想像がつくし、
何より相手はあの兄さんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's fine. I know you tried.
And I know my brother.

fields.EN: Once my brother decides to do something, he's always ruthlessly removed everything in his way and carried it through to the end without ever giving up...
fields.JP:
兄さんは昔から、やると決めたら冷酷なまでに
邪魔するものをすべて排除し、絶対に最後まで
諦めず遂行する男だった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once he makes up his mind, he can be
a real bastard. Right till the end.

fields.EN:
Nothing I did would have stopped him.
I have no right to speak.
fields.JP:
だから、私でも止められなかっただろう。
責めることなどできるものか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing I did would have stopped him.
I have no right to speak.

fields.EN:
Rather, without you around, I'm sure he could 
have done worse. Thank you Haru.
fields.JP:
むしろ君が兄さんのそばにいなかったら、
きっともっと酷いことになっていただろうね。
ありがとう、ハル君
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rather, without you around, I'm sure he could 
have done worse. Thank you Haru.

fields.JP:
そうだジャバウォック、
あのジュウってやつなんだが……

fields.EN:
Yeah. Some things about him have caught
my eye.
fields.JP:
ああ、私も彼については
気になるところがあったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Some things about him have caught
my eye.

fields.EN: Huh? What are you doing here, Juu-san?
fields.JP:
あれ？　そんなところで
何してるんですか、ジュウさん？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What are you doing here, Toh?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Hm? Juu, is that you? Did you need anything?
fields.JP: ん？　ジュウか。研究室に用事か？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Toh, is that you? Did you need anything?

fields.EN: You could come in, you know?
fields.JP:
用があるなら、
遠慮せず入ってきて構わないのだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You could come in, you know?

fields.EN:
(It looked like they were about to start talking
about me, but it seems they missed their chance.)
fields.JP:
（僕の話を始めようとしていたみたいだが、
　どうやらタイミングを逃してしまったようだな）
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: どうしたんですか、入らないんですか？

fields.EN: Oh. I was just passing by. So long.
fields.JP:
いや、たまたま通りかかっただけだ。
失礼するよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. I was just passing by. So long.

fields.EN:
(Our greater numbers have made survival
a bit easier.)
fields.JP:
（人が増えてキャンプもだいぶ
　生活しやすくなってきたが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Our greater numbers have made survival
a bit easier.)

fields.EN: (This makeshift barricade still worries me a little. We can't afford to be picky, and we do have a guard posted, so I think we'll be all right...)
fields.JP:
（この簡易的なバリケードはやはり多少不安が
　残るな。まあ、贅沢は言っていられないし、
　門番も置いているから大丈夫だとは思うが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, the makeshift barricade worries
me. Mustn't complain though.)

fields.EN: Hey Kadowaki. Here's something for you.
fields.JP: 門脇さんごくろうさまです、差し入れです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Kadowaki. Here's something for you.

fields.JP: お、悪いな。ありがとうどじっ子
その呼び方は止めて下さい……

fields.EN:
Sorry, but I can't help it. That's your
nickname now.
fields.JP:
悪い、いつもおっちょこちょいな
姿を見てる感じがして、つい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, but I can't help it. That's your
nickname now.

fields.JP: わたくし、そんなにドジ踏んでますかね

fields.EN:
Not a day goes by where you don't trip.
You're practically headfirst out of the tent.
fields.JP:
ここで門番してると、君が転ばない日を
見たことがないんだけど。テントから出てくる時は
だいたいヘッドスライディングだしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not a day goes by where you don't trip.
You're practically headfirst out of the tent.

fields.JP: あ、あれ見てたんですか……！

fields.EN: I'm the gatekeeper. Nothing gets past me.
fields.JP:
門番してると横目で見えちゃうんだって。
何より結構な音がするし
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm the gatekeeper. Nothing gets past me.

fields.EN: Oh... I didn't know. How embarrassing...
fields.JP:
そうだったんですか……
恥ずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... I didn't know. How embarrassing...

fields.EN:
Don't worry about it. You're a hard worker.
I appreciate you.
fields.JP:
まあ気にしないでよ。
君はよくやってくれてると思うし。
オレ、いつも感謝してるんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry about it. You're a hard worker.
I appreciate you.

fields.JP:
（あんな風にも接することができるのか。
　門脇もなかなか素直なやつのようだな）

fields.EN: Thanks for the snack. Much obliged.
fields.JP:
差し入れも美味いしね。
ほんと、いつもありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks for the snack. Much obliged.

fields.EN:
Right back at you, Kadowaki. I bet
standing guard is hard work.
fields.JP:
そんな、門脇さんこそ長時間の見張り、
いつも大変じゃないですか。
ほんと、ありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right back at you, Kadowaki. I bet
standing guard is hard work.

fields.JP: オレは君がいるから頑張れるんだ

fields.EN: K-Kadowaki... In a place like this...
fields.JP: か、門脇さん、こんな場所でいきなり……
fields.LOCALIZED: K-Kadowaki... In a place like this...

fields.EN:
Without a fellow human, I wouldn't feel
nearly as comfortable here.
fields.JP:
本当、人間の君がいなきゃ
こんなところ耐えらんないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Without a fellow human, I wouldn't feel
nearly as comfortable here.

fields.EN: O-oh, I see what you mean.
fields.JP: ああ、そ、そういうことですか
fields.LOCALIZED: O-oh, I see what you mean.

fields.EN:
But Akazukin-san, Haru-san, and all the others are
very good people. I don't think they're any
different from humans at all...
fields.JP:
でもでも、赤ずきんさんやハルさん、
他のみなさんも、とてもいい人たちです。
人間と何一つ変わらないと思いますよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But they're all good people. Human or not,
that's what matters.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Besides, humans, Blood Maidens, Blood Youths... you're all the same. I can't think of any of you as something different.
fields.JP:
それにそもそも人間だとか血式少女・少年……。
皆さん同じで別の何かだなんて思えません
fields.LOCALIZED:
The truth is, not much separates us.
We're all fighting for the same cause.

fields.EN:
I thought that at first. The Dawn really
gave us hope down there.
fields.JP:
最初はそう思っていたんだけどね。
黎明は地下に残された人間たちの希望……
オレだってその一員だったことを誇りに思ってた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought that at first. The Dawn really
gave us hope down there.

fields.EN:
But the Dawn turned out to be a group of
aliens hoping to observe mankind. Since
then, I've got trust issues.
fields.JP:
でも実際は、黎明そのものが宇宙人による
侵略計画だった。それを知ったら、オレはもう
人間以外を信じるなんてできないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Dawn turned out to be a group of
aliens hoping to observe mankind. Since
then, I've got trust issues.

fields.EN:
But none of the Blood Maidens knew about
that plan. Isn't that why you stopped them?
fields.JP:
でも、血式少女のみなさんは
その計画を知らなかったそうじゃないですか。
だからそれを阻止してくれたんですよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But none of the Blood Maidens knew about
that plan. Isn't that why you stopped them?

fields.EN:
The Blood Maidens have been behind us
the whole time on the surface.
fields.JP:
それに、あの子たちは地上に来ても
わたくしたちを見捨てずにいてくれてる
じゃないですか。優しい証拠ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maidens have been behind us
the whole time on the surface.

fields.EN: The aliens may not have given up on their invasion yet. Maybe the only reason they helped us was because they needed people for the camp.
fields.JP:
宇宙人はまだ侵略を諦めていないかもしれない。
オレたちを助けたのも、キャンプ要員が
必要だった、ってだけの理由かもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pft. They're still aliens at the end of the
day. They only spared us because they
need the manpower.

fields.EN:
Maybe this whole surface trip was part of
some big plan.
fields.JP:
あるいはもしかしたら、
地上に出てからのこの状況すべてが、
壮大な計画なのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe this whole surface trip was part of
some big plan.

fields.EN: The Blood Maidens might simply be caught up in all this too... and there's no evidence to say otherwise.
fields.JP:
血式少女のみんなもまた
巻き込まれてるだけかもしれないけど、
そうじゃない証拠だってない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're playing nice now, but who knows
how long it'll last.

fields.EN:
I've been around the Blood Maidens long
enough to know they're not on our side.
fields.JP:
もちろん、あの子たちとはつきあい長いから、
情がないとは言わない。でも、
それでもあっち側の人間なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been around the Blood Maidens long
enough to know they're not on our side.

fields.EN: Don't let your guard down either.
fields.JP: だから君も、油断しない方がいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't let your guard down either.

fields.EN:
(I see. I guess Kadowaki is still bitter about
the betrayal.)
fields.JP:
（なるほど、門脇は黎明に裏切られたことが
　結構響いているようだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. I guess Kadowaki is still bitter about
the betrayal.)

fields.EN:
(Haru and Jabberwock are talking again.
I'll join this time.)
fields.JP:
（ハルとジャバウォックがまた話をしているな
　今回は僕も……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haru and Jabberwock are talking again.
I'll join this time.)

fields.EN:
Hey Haru, Jabberwock. What are you
talking about?
fields.JP: ハルとジャバウォック、何を話している？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Haru, Jabberwock. What are you
talking about?

fields.EN:
Oh Juu. Just discussing tales from the
motherland.
fields.JP:
ジュウじゃないか。　俺とジャバウォックが会えば
そりゃ母星の話しかでねえさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh Toh. Just discussing tales from the
motherland.

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Us old guys only know how to talk
about the good ol' days.
fields.JP:
ははは、
お互い年を取ると昔の話ばかりになるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Us old guys only know how to talk
about the good ol' days.

fields.EN:
Could you tell me more about your planet?
Or more about you two?
fields.JP:
関係ないかもしれないが、お前らの関係性を
知るために母星について聞かせてくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could you tell me more about your planet?
Or more about you two?

fields.EN: It's a long story. Where do we start...?
fields.JP:
と言われてもな……。
話が大きすぎて何を話せばいいかわからねえな
fields.LOCALIZED: It's a long story. Where do we start...?

fields.EN:
Oh, fair. Hm. How about how you ended
up here?
fields.JP:
確かにその通りだ、失礼した。
そうだな、「なぜこの星にたどり着いたか」
なんてどうだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, fair. Hm. How about how you ended
up here?

fields.EN: Simply put... in pursuing convenience, the harmony of the atmosphere was disrupted and the planet died...
fields.JP:
そうだね……簡単にいえば便利さを求めた結果、
大気の調和が乱れ星が死んでしまった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. We came in search of a new home,
as our planet's atmosphere could no longer
sustain life.

fields.EN: Something like science running out of control?
fields.JP: 科学の暴走のようなものか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Was it some kind of chemical accident?

fields.JP: そう受け取って貰っていいさ

fields.EN:
Even on the dying planet, Snark fought
until the very end.
fields.JP:
死に行く星の中で、あいつは……スナークは
最後まで全力で抵抗してたな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even on the dying planet, Snark fought
until the very end.

fields.EN: Right. But that was just like my older brother. Once he decided to call it, he switched to the evacuation plan in an instant.
fields.JP:
そうだね、ただそこは流石兄さんだったよ。
打ち切る時は一瞬で、すぐ脱出計画に移行した
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. He was many things, including
a protector. If you can believe that.

fields.JP:
（スナークという男は母星愛が
　強い奴だったんだな）

fields.EN:
He devised an escape plan, but it hinged
upon us landing on a hospitable planet.
fields.JP:
そして、脱出計画はうまく行った。
あとは住める星に到着するだけだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
He devised an escape plan, but it hinged
upon us landing on a hospitable planet.

fields.EN: Haha. That was the hardest part.
fields.JP: ハハッ、それが一番難解だったがね
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. That was the hardest part.

fields.JP: それがこの地球だったという訳か？

fields.EN:
...But it didn't go so well. We bumped into
an asteroid, so we had no choice but to land.
fields.JP:
……そう上手くはいかなかった。　その後
運悪く隕石に激突し、不時着を余儀なくされた
fields.LOCALIZED:
...But it didn't go so well. We bumped into
an asteroid, so we had no choice but to land.

fields.EN: And then we ended up here.
fields.JP: そして着いたのがここって訳さ
fields.LOCALIZED: And then we ended up here.

fields.JP: 生きてるだけでも良かったな

fields.EN:
Sort of. We didn't exactly leave this planet
in a great place.
fields.JP:
そうでもないさ。　私達のせいでこの星を
こんな風にしてしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sort of. We didn't exactly leave this planet
in a great place.

fields.EN:
Honestly, seeing it now, it might have been
better if we died on our planet.
fields.JP:
正直今の状況をみると、私達はあの星と
共に朽ちるが正しかったとさえ思うよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, seeing it now, it might have been
better if we died on our planet.

fields.EN:
I've been searching for a way to make
amends, but it seems hopeless.
fields.JP:
そのため共生できる道を探してきたのだが、
うまくはいかないものだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been searching for a way to make
amends, but it seems hopeless.

fields.EN:
No point dwelling on the past. Survival
has its costs.
fields.JP:
終わったことを嘆いても仕方ないだろ
生きると願った結果がこれなら受け入れる以外ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
No point dwelling on the past. Survival
has its costs.

fields.EN:
If you aren't as selfish as Snark, then
there's still time to atone.
fields.JP:
少なくともスナークのように支配してやろうという、
悪意がないならば、諦めずに歩むしかあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you aren't as selfish as Snark, then
there's still time to atone.

fields.JP: 俺もそう思うよ、ジャバウォック

fields.EN:
You're full of surprises, Juu-kun. Maybe there's
hope for us yet.
fields.JP:
ジュウくんにそう言われるとは思わなかったが、
少し救われた気持ちになったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're full of surprises, Toh. Maybe there's
hope for us yet.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウくん => Toh-kun | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
(I don't know what came over me when
I said that.)
fields.JP:
（こんな事を言うつもりはなかったのだが、
　自然と言葉がでてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't know what came over me when
I said that.)

fields.JP: 確かにジュウに言われるとなぜか心が軽くなるな

ふん、別の星の者でも赤ずきんみたいなことを
言うんだな

fields.EN:
Ha. Maybe you're rubbing off on me.
I'm glad you have.
fields.JP:
はっ、感化されたのかもな……
俺は……感化されてよかったよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha. Maybe you're rubbing off on me.
I'm glad you have.

fields.EN: In any case, thank you for sharing.
fields.JP:
なんにしても、お前たちの経緯が
ある程度見えたよ。　礼を言う
fields.LOCALIZED: In any case, thank you for sharing.

fields.EN: Their words didn't seem like lies. I understood that they really had suffered. Maybe I can lower my guard a little.
fields.JP:
（あいつらの言葉に嘘はなく感じた。
　実際に不幸な境遇であることも理解した。
　警戒はもう少し緩めていいのかもしれないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's more to them than I initially
thought. Perhaps they can be trusted.)

fields.EN:
(There's Kadowaki and Kunai.
Are they taking a break?)
fields.JP:
（あれは……門脇とクナイ、
　休憩をしているのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's Kadowaki and Kunai.
Are they taking a break?)

fields.JP: 門脇さんごくろうさまです、お昼のご飯です

fields.EN: Hey klutz, thanks for bringing it.
fields.JP:
どじっ子、ちゃんと持ってこれたんだな
ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey klutz, thanks for bringing it.

fields.EN: Ugh. When will you stop calling me that?
fields.JP:
もう、その呼び方は控えて下さいって
言いましたよね？　わたくしそんなに
ドジ踏んでますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. When will you stop calling me that?

fields.EN: Haha. I do say it too much, huh?
fields.JP: あっははは、確かに言うほどではないかもね
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. I do say it too much, huh?

fields.EN: Agh! If you think that, then stop!
fields.JP: っもう！　そう思ってるならやめてください！
fields.LOCALIZED: Agh! If you think that, then stop!

fields.EN: But seriously klutz, thanks for the meal.
fields.JP: しかしどじっ子はいつも飯を運んでくれて助かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: But seriously klutz, thanks for the meal.

fields.EN:
It's because no one else will eat with
you. I have no choice.
fields.JP:
門脇さんがみんなとご飯を食べたくないとか
わがまま言いますからね。　仕方なくです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because no one else will eat with
you. I have no choice.

fields.EN:
Well I didn't say that. But it's true.
I like my space.
fields.JP:
流石に食べたくないとまでは思わないが……
距離は置きたいかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well I didn't say that. But it's true.
I like my space.

fields.JP:
門脇さん……もう気が付き
始めてるんじゃないですか？

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san and the others aren't
your enemies.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん達は決して門脇さんの敵じゃないって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood and the others aren't
your enemies.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Well, Akazukin and I do get on
well together when we train...
fields.JP:
……赤ずきんなんかはあだ名「お気に入り」ってくらい
だからね、お互いトレーニング好きとして波長は合うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Red Riding Hood and I do get on
well together when we train...

fields.EN:
But she's the Professor's daughter. Who
knows what she really thinks?
fields.JP:
ただあれは裏切者の博士の実質娘みたいなもんだ
裏で何か考えてるんじゃないか……とも考えるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she's the Professor's daughter. Who
knows what she really thinks?

fields.EN:
But...she's not a traitor. In fact, she does
more for us than anyone.
fields.JP:
……でも、そんな素振りどころかいつも命がけで
なんとかしてくれようと奮闘しているではないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...she's not a traitor. In fact, she does
more for us than anyone.

fields.EN: Yeah, but that doesn't change the past.
fields.JP: そうなんだが、それでもオレは裏切られたからね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, but that doesn't change the past.

fields.EN: What? That's bold. Even for you, klutz.
fields.JP:
……っ！！
今のはどじっ子でも聞き捨てならないな
fields.LOCALIZED: What? That's bold. Even for you, klutz.

fields.EN:
I might not be as strong as the Blood Maidens,
but I held my own against their best.
That makes me plenty strong.
fields.JP:
確かに血式少女には勝てないかもしれないが、
それでも俺はお気に入りとトレーニングをした、
黎明の中ではかなりの力自慢だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I might not be as strong as the Blood Maidens,
but I held my own against their best.
That makes me plenty strong.

fields.EN:
Maybe if I train hard enough, I might
win one of these days.
fields.JP:
戦い方やまだまだトレーニングをすれば
勝てる見込みがあるとさえ思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe if I train hard enough, I might
win one of these days.

fields.EN:
Then where's your confidence?!
I've heard all about your battle prowess
with the Dawn.
fields.JP:
それならもっと堂々とされていたらいいんですよ！
わたくしは門脇さんが誰よりもトレーニング
していたのを黎明で見ていました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then where's your confidence?!
I've heard all about your battle prowess
with the Dawn.

fields.EN:
You should put your money where your
mouth is instead of bringing other people
down!
fields.JP:
それをこそこそ精神攻撃みたいにやるのは、
鍛えてきた身体に失礼なんじゃないですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should put your money where your
mouth is instead of bringing other people
down!

fields.EN:
What?! I did no such thing!
Take that back!
fields.JP:
な、なんだと……！
誰も精神攻撃なんてつもりはない！
取り消してくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! I did no such thing!
Take that back!

fields.EN: Then prove it. Prove you're better than that.
fields.JP:
それじゃもっと昔の門番で踏ん反り返っていた
門脇さんみたいに堂々となさってください
fields.LOCALIZED: Then prove it. Prove you're better than that.

fields.EN:
Show me that the Blood Maidens and the
aliens aren't as strong as you!
fields.JP:
血式少女、地球外生命体なんて関係ないって
ところを見せつけてください！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Show me that the Blood Maidens and the
aliens aren't as strong as you!

fields.EN: *sigh* I didn't expect sass from the klutz.
fields.JP:
……ふう……。
まさかどじっ子にそんなこと言われるとはね
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh* I didn't expect sass from the klutz.

fields.EN:
My parents were killed mercilessly by
Marchens.
fields.JP: オレはさ両親がメルヒェンに凄惨に殺されたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My parents were killed mercilessly by
Marchens.

fields.EN:
I trained every day so they wouldn't kill
me. That's how I got strong. I can actually
defeat a weak Marchen.
fields.JP:
もうあんなやつらに負けるかという憎悪の中で
日々トレーニングをして強くなっていった……
実際弱いメルヒェン程度なら勝てるしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I trained every day so they wouldn't kill
me. That's how I got strong. I can actually
defeat a weak Marchen.

fields.EN:
But at the same time, I saw the Blood
Maidens get stronger by the day, and 
I realized I can't beat them.
fields.JP:
ただ同時にさ、日々強くなる血式少女を
目の当たりにして'勝てない'と思ったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But at the same time, I saw the Blood
Maidens get stronger by the day, and 
I realized I can't beat them.

fields.EN:
And at the same time, Professor's betrayal... Maybe 
this is the only way I could defend myself.
fields.JP:
それと同時に博士の裏切り……
オレはもうこういう方法でしか防衛
できなかったのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
And at the same time, Professor's betrayal... Maybe 
this is the only way I could defend myself.

fields.EN: Become strong again so you can protect me.
fields.JP:
それじゃ、わたくしを守るために
また強くなってください
fields.LOCALIZED: Become strong again so you can protect me.

fields.EN:
I heard the Blood Maidens were originally
half-human. In my eyes, they don't look too
different...
fields.JP:
血式少女も元々半分は人間だって聞きました。
わたくしの中では何も変わりないですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard the Blood Maidens were originally
half-human. In my eyes, they don't look too
different...

fields.EN: That means you still have a chance, Kadowaki.
fields.JP:
ただそれならば門脇さんだって、まだまだ
チャンスがあるってことだと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED: That means you still have a chance, Kadowaki.

fields.EN:
Do you really think your training and effort
were a waste?
fields.JP:
それにそんな今までの努力が嘘になるような
トレーニングだったんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you really think your training and effort
were a waste?

fields.EN:
HAHAHA! It's true. My training's never
betrayed me.
fields.JP:
……ははっははは！
確かにトレーニングだけは今まで裏切って
来なかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
HAHAHA! It's true. My training's never
betrayed me.

fields.EN: And I definitely shouldn't do anything that would betray all the training I've put in so far.
fields.JP:
逆に今までのトレーニングをオレが
裏切るようなマネしちゃいけないのは確かだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I shouldn't break from my routine.

fields.EN:
I just want everyone to get along.
They're more than Blood Maidens,
you know?
fields.JP:
その、わたくしはみんな仲良くしてほしいです。
血式少女とか以前に「赤ずきん」さん達だと
思っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just want everyone to get along.
They're more than Blood Maidens,
you know?

fields.EN: Hearing your side does make me nervous.
fields.JP:
だけど、門脇さんの話を聞いてると、ふと
わたくしも怖くなるときがあります……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hearing your side does make me nervous.

fields.EN:
But if the worst comes to light, then
I know I can count on you, Kadowaki.
fields.JP:
だからその時は門脇さんが、自分が
鍛えているから大丈夫くらいの気持ちで、
守ってもらえると、とても嬉しいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if the worst comes to light, then
I know I can count on you, Kadowaki.

fields.EN: You're right. Time to start training again.
fields.JP:
……そうだな。
そうと決まればまた１から筋肉トレーニング
をやっていこうと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You're right. Time to start training again.

fields.EN:
Okay! I'll help! If you gain confidence,
maybe we can start eating with the
others again.
fields.JP:
はい！　わたくしもお手伝いします！
そして……不安がなくなるほど強くなったら、
また皆さんと対等に食事をしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! I'll help! If you gain confidence,
maybe we can start eating with the
others again.

fields.JP:
はっはは！
どじっ子にしてやられている気もするが……

（クナイは赤ずきん達の士気も
　あげてくれている）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Kunai really cares about Red Riding Hood.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she's the group's pillar.
Everyone plays their part.)
fields.JP:
（実はこのグループの精神的支柱の
　役割を担ってくれているのかもしれないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she's the group's pillar.
Everyone plays their part.)

fields.EN:
(Regardless, it would be great for Kadowaki
to rebuild his relationship with them.)
fields.JP:
（なんにしてもこれで門脇との関係性が
　改善されれば悪いことはない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Regardless, it would be great for Kadowaki
to rebuild his relationship with them.)

fields.EN:
(That walk was strenuous. Mustn't overdo
it.)
fields.JP: （大分歩いたな……過度に動いても仕方あるまい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That walk was strenuous. Mustn't overdo
it.)

fields.EN: Let's take a break. I don't see any Marchens.
fields.JP:
みんなここで一度休息を取ろう。
丁度メルヒェンの気配もない、用心しつつも
身体を休めるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's take a break. I don't see any Marchens.

fields.JP: ジュウはちょいちょい休憩挟むよね

fields.EN:
We risk losing concentration and swiftness
otherwise. The choice is obvious.
fields.JP:
動きっぱなしは集中力や瞬発力の低下を招く。
当然のことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We risk losing concentration and swiftness
otherwise. The choice is obvious.

fields.EN: Yeah, yeah. I'll stand watch so you can rest.
fields.JP:
へいへい、それじゃあたしが代表して、
周りに気を配りつつみんなを休ませますよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, yeah. I'll stand watch so you can rest.

fields.JP: わたくしが休んだら交代しましょう
（ジェイルの機械扉……少し気になるな）

fields.EN:
I have a question. Are there doors like
this in every Jail?
fields.JP:
お前に質問だ。　全ての機械扉の意思は
監獄塔を超え繋がってるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a question. Are there doors like
this in every Jail?

fields.EN:
And another question.
When was this mechanical door made?
fields.JP: 更に質問だ。　この機械扉ができたのはいつだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And another question.
When was this mechanical door made?

fields.JP: ふっ……この間は機械のバグでも起きたのか？
（下らないことをしてしまったな）
ミライガカコヲカエルコトガアリマス

fields.EN: You can speak? What was that?
fields.JP:
会話ができるのか……？
今のはなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: You can speak? What was that?

fields.JP: ミライガカコヲカエルコトガアリマス

fields.EN:
I'm going to ask again.
What is the meaning of that?
fields.JP: 再度聞く、それはどういうことだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to ask again.
What is the meaning of that?

fields.JP: ミライガカコヲカエルコトガアリマス

fields.EN:
Sounds like programmed gibberish.
I bet it responds automatically.
fields.JP:
やはり所詮はただのプログラムされた機械か
声に反応して適当なことを言っているだけか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like programmed gibberish.
I bet it responds automatically.

fields.JP:
セイテハコトヲシソンジマスヨ
ヘンカモケッカモスグニハワカリマセン

fields.EN: But perhaps there is some meaning.
fields.JP: ……意味があるような適当なような
fields.LOCALIZED: But perhaps there is some meaning.

fields.JP:
セイテハコトヲシソンジマスヨ
ヘンカモケッカモスグニハワカリマセン

fields.EN:
There's something about this machine.
But I can't put my finger on it.
fields.JP:
なぜかこいつがただの機械には思えないが、
特に決定的な根拠がある訳ではない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's something about this machine.
But I can't put my finger on it.

fields.EN:
Hey Juu! You're getting too far away!
Come back!
fields.JP: ちょっとジュウ！　離れすぎ！　戻ってきな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Toh! You're getting too far away!
Come back!

fields.EN:
Akazukin? Have you ever felt like
parts of the Jail feel human?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんこのジェイルの扉を見て、
何か人間味を感じたことはあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood? Have you ever felt like
parts of the Jail feel human?

fields.EN:
Huh? What are you talking about?
Of course not. Anyways, come back.
fields.JP:
は？　突然何言ってんの？　ある訳ないじゃん。
それよりも少し離れすぎだから戻ってきなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What are you talking about?
Of course not. Anyways, come back.

fields.EN: (Maybe I'm the only one... How weird.)
fields.JP:
（そんなこと思うのは僕だけか……
　変な気持ちになることもあるもんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe I'm the only one... How weird.)

fields.EN: Oh perfect. You're here too Haru.
fields.JP: 丁度ハルもいるのか良かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh perfect. You're here too Haru.

fields.EN: Need to talk to me too?
fields.LOCALIZED: Need to talk to me too?

fields.EN: What do you want to talk about?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you want to talk about?

fields.EN:
This whole me being the Professor and Snark 
situation. Thanks for enlightening me.
fields.JP:
今回の僕が「博士」、「スナーク」だった件、
色々と不安な中で言ってくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This whole me being the Professor and Snark 
situation. Thanks for enlightening me.

fields.JP: ははっ……、予想外の言葉だな

fields.EN:
Right. You've nailed my brother's weird
respect thing, though.
fields.JP:
あ、ああ、確かに。
ただ変なところで律儀なのも兄さんっぽいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. You've nailed my brother's weird
respect thing, though.

fields.EN: Come to think of it, you're right.
fields.JP: そう言われるとそうかもな
fields.LOCALIZED: Come to think of it, you're right.

fields.EN:
I can't believe I hadn't realized it sooner.
Do I resemble him?
fields.JP:
恐らく僕に似ているところがあるから、
今回の発見に繋がったと思うが、
そんなに似ているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe I hadn't realized it sooner.
Do I resemble him?

fields.EN:
Right. He was never emotional, except
when it came to his wife.
fields.JP:
ああ、普段感情の起伏が少ないが、
嫁のことになるとすぐ顔に出るところなんて、
若い頃のあいつに似てるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. He was never emotional, except
when it came to his wife.

fields.JP: ふっ……それは確かに似てるかもな

fields.EN: But you haven't lost your way... Even I was taken aback by how drastically he changed once he'd made up his mind back then.
fields.JP:
ただ、お前は道を踏み外してない……。
あの時のあいつの豹変した覚悟の仕方は
俺も戸惑ったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you've turned as he did. Sometimes
it scares me to think about how much he
changed. And how much he lost.

fields.EN: And I got swept up in that atmosphere and couldn't stop him...
fields.JP:
そしてその雰囲気に飲まれ、
俺は止めることができなかった……

fields.EN:
Juu, this may sound weird coming from
me, but you two are very different.
fields.JP:
ジュウ君、こんなこと言うのも変なのだが……
君を別の人間だと私は思っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, this may sound weird coming from
me, but you two are very different.

fields.EN: Circumstances aside, I agree. So I think you should do whatever you want.
fields.JP:
経緯はさておきとして、俺もそう思う。
だから、お前が好きなように
行動したら良いと思っているよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I concur. You are your own man.

fields.EN:
I think so as well. It pleases me to hear
you agree.
fields.JP:
無論そう思っている
……そして、そう思ってくれるなら良かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think so as well. It pleases me to hear
you agree.

fields.EN: He died in front of me.
fields.JP: あいつは俺の前で死んだんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: He died in front of me.

fields.JP: そう……私の兄さんは死んだ……

だからこそ、お前さんがもし道を
踏み外すようなことがあったら……

fields.EN: I'll beat the hell out of you.
fields.JP: 遠慮なくぶん殴って止めさせてもらうさ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll beat the hell out of you.

fields.EN: Haha. Wouldn't expect any less, Haru.
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. Wouldn't expect any less, Haru.

fields.JP: ふっ……そうだなそうしてくれ

fields.EN:
(I don't remember them from my past life,
but there's a bond between us nonetheless.)
fields.JP:
（この二人の思い出はまったくないが……
　絆というものは感じたよ。　　ありがとう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't remember them from my past life,
but there's a bond between us nonetheless.)

fields.EN: (We made it. This is our final battle.)
fields.JP:
（ようやくここまで来た。
　……いよいよ最終決戦だな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (We made it. This is our final battle.)

fields.EN:
(We shouldn't die here...
But it doesn't change the fact it's dangerous.)
fields.JP:
（僕らはここで死ぬ運命ではないはずだ……
　それでも限りなく危険なことには変わりない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We shouldn't die here...
But it doesn't change the fact it's dangerous.)

fields.EN:
Jabberwock, Haru, Kunai, Kadowaki.
Thank you.
fields.JP:
ジャバウォック、ハル、クナイ、門脇、
色々あったが……ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jabberwock, Haru, Kunai, Kadowaki.
Thank you.

fields.JP:
突然どうした随分らしくないことを
言うんだな

fields.EN: Yeah. That doesn't sound like Juu, who usually thinks, 'Our goals are the same, so it's a win-win relationship.'
fields.JP:
確かに普段『目的は一緒だからお互い
ウィンウィンの関係だ』と思ってるジュウ
の言葉とは思えないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. You're usually so calculated.
I'm shocked.

fields.EN:
Don't ruin the moment. I'm only speaking
my mind.
fields.JP:
からかうんじゃない。
本当の気持ちを言ったまでだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't ruin the moment. I'm only speaking
my mind.

fields.EN:
Haha. We're not making fun of you.
We're just surprised.
fields.JP:
はは、みなからかってるわけじゃない。
意外だと思っているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. We're not making fun of you.
We're just surprised.

fields.EN: But it's touching to hear you say it.
fields.JP:
意外だが君の口からそう言われると
嬉しいものだね
fields.LOCALIZED: But it's touching to hear you say it.

fields.JP: わたくしもとっても嬉しいです……！

fields.EN:
I'm no Akazukin, so I'll make this
brief.
fields.JP:
僕は赤ずきんのように流暢に言葉を重ねて
礼をいえるような話術はない。
だからこそ手短になってしまうが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm no Red Riding Hood, so I'll make this
brief.

fields.EN:
We couldn't have made it here without
you. I sincerely appreciate all your efforts.
fields.JP:
君たちがいたからここまでこれた。
これは紛れもない事実だ
感謝するありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We couldn't have made it here without
you. I sincerely appreciate all your efforts.

fields.EN: I feel the same, Juu-san. I'm indebted to you.
fields.JP:
わたくしもジュウさんと同じ気持ちです。
本当に皆さんがいなかったら、
わたくしはここにいなかったと思います
fields.LOCALIZED: I feel the same, Toh. I'm indebted to you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Akazukin and the others would
say the same about you, Kunai.
fields.JP:
ただ逆にクナイがいなければ、赤ずきん達は
ここにいないと僕は思っている。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood and the others would
say the same about you, Kunai.

fields.JP: そ、そんなことないですよ

fields.EN:
You're a lot stronger than you think.
Give yourself some credit.
fields.JP:
「君がいた」ということが彼女たちの
大きな力になったのは間違いない
だから、そんなに卑下しなくても良い
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a lot stronger than you think.
Give yourself some credit.

fields.JP: ……ふふ、本当にありがとうございます

fields.EN:
Oh and Jabberwock, I'm sorry for what
happened between us.
fields.JP:
ああ、あとジャバウォック、
お前には色々と申し訳ないことをした
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh and Jabberwock, I'm sorry for what
happened between us.

fields.EN:
Sorry for accusing you. Even though I don't
quite remember being brothers, I do feel a
kinship with you.
fields.JP:
疑っていたことに対してもだが、
弟……兄弟としての記憶がまったくないこと……
仕方ないこととはいえ、申し訳なく思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for accusing you. Even though I don't
quite remember being brothers, I do feel a
kinship with you.

fields.EN:
Brother, you don't have to say that.
You're coming back, right?
fields.JP:
兄さん……そんなことは今言わなくていいんだ。
無事に帰ってくるんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Brother, you don't have to say that.
You're coming back, right?

fields.EN:
Of course. But I don't want to make a
promise I can't keep.
fields.JP:
もちろんそのつもりだ。
ただ、僕はそんな無責任に「生きて帰る」
なんて言えない……だから……すまない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. But I don't want to make a
promise I can't keep.

fields.EN: Man, you sure know how to stage an exit.
fields.JP: ったく、どこまでいってもお前は不器用だな
fields.LOCALIZED: Man, you sure know how to stage an exit.

fields.EN:
You're quite the awkward eccentric yourself,
following a clumsy man like that.
fields.JP:
その不器用な男について来てくれた
お前も十分不器用な変わり者だがな
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose the same goes for you.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: ……同じことは二度言わんのは知ってるだろ
ああ、だけど聞いちまったよ……

fields.EN: I know you may not trust us, but...
fields.JP:
まだ僕たちのことを心から
信頼していないかもしれないが……
fields.LOCALIZED: I know you may not trust us, but...

fields.JP: いや、今は信頼はしてるよ

fields.EN: I've realized the days I spent with Akazukin, Oyayubihime, and the others weren't a lie.
fields.JP:
なんだかんだ赤ずきんや親指姫、あいつらと
過ごした日々には嘘がないことに気が付いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
