I've realized the days I spent with Red Riding
Hood, Thumbelina, and the others weren't a lie.

fields.EN: All thanks to Miss Klutz here.
fields.LOCALIZED: All thanks to Miss Klutz here.

fields.EN: Now I have nothing left to say. Of course, I have no intention of losing or dying, but I suppose this is simply my nature...
fields.JP:
これでもう言い残すことはない。
もちろん負ける気も死ぬ気もないが、
これはもう僕の性分なのだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have nothing else to say. I'm not planning
on dying out there, but nothing's certain.

fields.EN: Well, I've already given up on that.
fields.JP: ま、そこはもう諦めてるよ

fields.EN:
All we can do is await your return.
Do what you have to do.
fields.JP:
俺たちはもうお前の帰りを待つだけさ
好きにやってくるといいさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All we can do is await your return.
Do what you have to do.

fields.EN:
(Hopefully all of us can live in peace
once this is over.)
fields.JP:
（願わくば、ここにいる者たちと妻とで
　穏やかな日々を過ごしたいものだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hopefully all of us can live in peace
once this is over.)

fields.EN: Hey! Rachel, you can't go that way!
fields.JP: こら、レイチェル勝手に行っちゃダメ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! Rachel, you can't go that way!

fields.JP:
あはっ、あはは！
ねーちゃ、はやいはやい
なんか高そうな時計ね
ちょこえーとじゃない？

fields.EN:
No, this tells time. It's called a watch,
Rachel.
fields.JP:
そうだよ、これは時間を見るための
「時計」だよ、レイチェル
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, this tells time. It's called a watch,
Rachel.

fields.EN:
Hm. I don't think the contaminated use
watches. Let's see.
fields.JP:
そうだね、汚染動物が使うとは思えないし……
ひろっておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. I don't think the contaminated use
watches. Let's see.

fields.EN: They might come back, let's go.
fields.JP: じっとしてたら汚染動物くるかもだから行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED: They might come back, let's go.

fields.JP: おねえ、もうつかれたよ……

fields.EN: We're almost there. We'll rest soon, okay?
fields.JP:
あと少しで出口だからね
これが終わったらいっぱい休もうね
fields.LOCALIZED: We're almost there. We'll rest soon, okay?

fields.EN:
(She's about to cry. They're working so
hard.)
fields.JP:
（……泣くなっていうほうが無理だよね……
　二人ともがんばってくれてる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's about to cry. They're working so
hard.)

fields.JP:
ヒッヒッ……
珍しいお客様でございますね

fields.EN: My my, sorry to scare you. How rude.
fields.JP:
おやおや、驚かせてしまいました。
これは失礼しやした
fields.LOCALIZED: My my, sorry to scare you. How rude.

fields.EN:
But small children like yourselves likely
have no interest in my goods.
fields.JP:
こんな小さいお子さんじゃあ、
商品は買えないですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But small children like yourselves likely
have no interest in my goods.

fields.JP: わ、わるいけど、今はそれどころじゃないから！

fields.EN:
Sorry to bother you, but have you seen
a pocket watch around here?
fields.JP:
お急ぎのところ申し訳ございませんが、
ここらへんで懐中時計を見ませんでしたかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to bother you, but have you seen
a pocket watch around here?

fields.EN:
I have no need for it, but I am a little
attached to it.
fields.JP:
もう不要なものですが、
少し思い入れがありあしてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no need for it, but I am a little
attached to it.

fields.EN: A watch? I found one earlier... This?
fields.JP: 時計？　さっき拾ったけど……これ？
fields.LOCALIZED: A watch? I found one earlier... This?

fields.JP: おお！　それは確かに私の懐中時計！

fields.EN:
Would you kindly return it to me?
It's my most prized possession.
fields.JP:
お嬢さん、返してくださいませんかねえ？
私以外にゃ大して価値のないもんでさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would you kindly return it to me?
It's my most prized possession.

fields.EN:
Rachel, it belongs to him. Should we give it
back?
fields.JP:
レイチェル、この時計この人のなんだって
返してあげよう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rachel, it belongs to him. Should we give it
back?

fields.JP: はい。もう落とさないでよ

fields.EN:
Thank you. I shall repay this debt to you
another time.
fields.JP: ありがとうございました、このご恩は何か商品で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I shall repay this debt to you
another time.

fields.EN:
Argh. Not now! Later!
Ellie, Rachel, come on!
fields.JP:
あーもう、今はそれどころじゃないの！
お礼とかいいからじゃあね！！
エリー、レイチェル行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh. Not now! Later!
Ellie, Rachel, come on!

fields.JP: ありゃ……？　行ってしまわれた

fields.EN: Aw, I owe them now. Hihihhi...
fields.JP:
こりゃ貸しになってしまいましたねえ。
ヒヒッヒッ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, I owe them now. Hihihhi...

fields.EN:
Something ominous approaches.
I shall take my leave.
fields.JP:
何か不穏な空気も致しますから、
私もこれで失礼致しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something ominous approaches.
I shall take my leave.

fields.EN: What, is there no way to save Clara?
fields.JP: そんな、何とかくららを助けられないんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What, is there no way to save Clara?

fields.EN:
I've closed up her wound, but she's lost too
much blood. There's no way I can perform a
blood transfusion...
fields.JP:
傷は塞いだけれど、血を失いすぎているの。
輸血可能な者もいないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've closed up her wound, but she's lost too
much blood. There's no way I can perform a
blood transfusion...

fields.EN: Use my blood! Take as much as you need!
fields.JP:
僕の血を使ってくれ！
いくらでもとってくれて構わないから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Use my blood! Take as much as you need!

fields.EN:
Generous of you, but your blood type is
incompatible with hers.
fields.JP:
気持ちは嬉しいけど、
つうじゃ血液型が合わないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Generous of you, but your blood type is
incompatible with hers.

fields.EN: Oh. Maybe Hikari can do something!
fields.JP: そうだ、ヒカリなら何とかできるかもしれねえ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Maybe Hikari can do something!

fields.EN:
Mamoru, Hikari's in pretty bad shape right
now. If we push her any harder, she won't
make it.
fields.JP:
マモル、ヒカリもだいぶ衰弱している。
下手に力を使わせたら、彼女の身も危ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru, Hikari's in pretty bad shape right
now. If we push her any harder, she won't
make it.

fields.EN: You're right. Hikari put up a good fight...
fields.JP:
そうだな……ヒカリの奴、
すげえ頑張ってくれたもんな……
fields.LOCALIZED: You're right. Hikari put up a good fight...

fields.EN: Damn it! Is there nothing we can do?!
fields.JP: くそっ！　どうすることもできないのか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn it! Is there nothing we can do?!

fields.EN:
Jack, I believe you and Clara are the same
blood type!
fields.JP: ジャック、あなた確かくららと同じ血液型だわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, I believe you and Clara are the same
blood type!

fields.EN:
I was so focused on your special attributes
that I simply overlooked your blood type.
It's just...
fields.JP:
その血の特殊性ばかりに注目していて、
単純な血液型のことをすっかり忘れていたわ
ただ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was so focused on your special attributes
that I simply overlooked your blood type.
It's just...

fields.EN:
Your blood... I'm not sure what side-effects
it may imbibe upon another.
fields.JP:
あなたの……血式少年の血液が他の人の身体に
どんな影響を及ぼすかわからない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your blood... I'm not sure what side-effects
it may imbibe upon another.

fields.EN:
But if we don't give Clara blood, she won't
make it, right? We have no other choice.
fields.JP:
けどよ、いま輸血しねえと
くららは死んじまうんだろ？
だったら賭けてみるしかねえよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we don't give Clara blood, she won't
make it, right? We have no other choice.

fields.EN:
Mamoru's right.
No time to think.
fields.JP:
マモルの言う通りだ。
悩んでいる時間はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru's right.
No time to think.

fields.EN:
...Got it. Let's do it. If we're doing this, I'm
gonna give it my all to save Clara. Jack, give
me some of your blood.
fields.JP:
……そうね。私も覚悟を決めるわ。
やるからには、全力でくららを救う。
ジャック、悪いけど血を分けてくれるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Got it. Let's do it. If we're doing this, I'm
gonna give it my all to save Clara. Jack, give
me some of your blood.

fields.EN: Of course! Whatever you need to save her!
fields.JP:
もちろんです！
僕の血でよければいくらでも！
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course! Whatever you need to save her!

fields.EN:
Can everyone lend me a hand? We need to
keep her stable during the transfusion.
fields.JP:
それじゃみんな手伝ってくれる？
輸血をしながら治療の方も進めていく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can everyone lend me a hand? We need to
keep her stable during the transfusion.

fields.EN:
Tsu, ward away any Marchens. Mamoru,
you hold Clara's body.
fields.JP:
つうはメルヒェンが来ないように見張っていて。
マモルは、くららの身体を押さえてくれるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tsu, ward away any Marchens. Mamoru,
you hold Clara's body.

fields.EN: Consider the deed done under penalty of death.
fields.JP: 絶対にここは死守するよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Consider the deed done under penalty of death.

fields.EN:
I'll hold her steady for you. Please Miko-san,
save her.
fields.JP:
手元が狂わねえようにガッチリ押さえとくぜ。
だから頼んだぜ、視子さん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll hold her steady for you. Please Miko,
save her.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
I'll do my best. All right Jack, lie down beside
her.
fields.JP:
最善を尽くすわ。
じゃあジャックは横に寝そべって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll do my best. All right Jack, lie down beside
her.

fields.JP: お願いします、視子さん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
We've used most of our medical supplies
up to this point, but thankfully not the last
transfusion kit. Here we go...
fields.JP:
ここに来たとき、医療器具が大分なくなってたけど
輸血キットが残ってたのは不幸中の幸いだったわ。
……それじゃいくわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've used most of our medical supplies
up to this point, but thankfully not the last
transfusion kit. Here we go...

fields.EN:
Phew... Okay, I think the operation was
successful.
fields.JP: ふう……ひとまず処置は終了よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew... Okay, I think the operation was
successful.

fields.EN:
Glad no Marchens dared to interrupt us.
How's Clara doing, Miko-san?
fields.JP:
メルヒェンも来なくてよかったよ。
それで視子さん、くららの容態は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad no Marchens dared to interrupt us.
How's Clara doing, Miko?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Her breathing has stabilized. The worst of it
is over.
fields.JP:
脈も呼吸も安定しているし、
恐らく峠は越えたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her breathing has stabilized. The worst of it
is over.

fields.EN:
Yes, truly. I'm grateful you two were here,
Miko-san, Jack.
fields.JP:
ああ、ホントにな。
視子さんとジャックがいて良かったぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, truly. I'm grateful you two were here,
Miko, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Hey, no need to thank me. All the praise
belongs to Miko-san.
fields.JP:
そんな、僕は何もしてないよ。
視子さんが頑張ってくれたから助かったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, no need to thank me. All the praise
belongs to Miko.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: There you go again, Jack. So humble.
fields.JP: 出たな、ジャックの謙遜グセ
fields.LOCALIZED: There you go again, Jack. So humble.

fields.EN:
You're being too nice, Jack. We are in your
debt here.
fields.JP:
そこがジャックのいいところでもあるけど、
もっと誇ってもいいと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're being too nice, Jack. We are in your
debt here.

fields.EN:
She's right. I couldn't have saved her alone.
Be proud.
fields.JP:
その通り。私だけじゃ救えなかったんだから。
胸を張りなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. I couldn't have saved her alone.
Be proud.

fields.EN:
There's something I'm curious about, though.
During the procedure, Clara's heart rate
normalized almost immediately.
fields.JP:
それにしても何かしらね、
途中からくららの容体が急激に安定したわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's something I'm curious about, though.
During the procedure, Clara's heart rate
normalized almost immediately.

fields.EN:
It was as though the amount of blood she
needed was restored by force of will.
fields.JP:
まるで自らの意思で
生成する造血量を増やしていったみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was as though the amount of blood she
needed was restored by force of will.

fields.EN:
Maybe Jack's blood has something to do with
it.
fields.JP: やっぱりこれは、ジャックの血の影響かしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Jack's blood has something to do with
it.

fields.EN:
Perhaps it is a perk of inheriting the Blood
Youth's blood.
fields.JP: 血式少年の血には、そういった効果もあるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps it is a perk of inheriting the Blood
Youth's blood.

fields.EN:
It's possible. Truthfully, I'd like to do more
research on it, but that's a luxury in our 
circumstances.
fields.JP:
可能性はあるわね。
正直、もう少し詳しい検査をしたいところだけど
こんな状況では贅沢というものよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's possible. Truthfully, I'd like to do more
research on it, but that's a luxury in our 
circumstances.

fields.EN:
Regardless, I'm thankful her body hadn't
rejected the blood.
fields.JP: 何にせよ、拒絶反応がなくて何よりだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, I'm thankful her body hadn't
rejected the blood.

fields.EN:
Miko-san, you deserve a break. You've been
watching after Clara since before we got
here.
fields.JP:
視子さんは休んでくれ。
俺たちが来る前から、ずっとくららを
診ててくれたんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko, you deserve a break. You've been
watching after Clara since before we got
here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Thank you. But I'm sure all of you are just
as tired.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。でも疲れているのは
あなたたちも同じでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. But I'm sure all of you are just
as tired.

fields.EN:
We don't have much, little more than blankets
on cold ground, but everyone should sleep.
fields.JP:
物資もないから、地べたに布きれを
敷くくらいしかできないけれど、みんなで休みましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't have much, little more than blankets
on cold ground, but everyone should sleep.

fields.EN:
Yes, sleep sounds great. We haven't been on
the surface in a while.
fields.JP:
そうだね、そうしようよみんな。
地上に出てから随分経つしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, sleep sounds great. We haven't been on
the surface in a while.

fields.EN:
Apologies, Jack. But my heart still yearns for
my princess.
fields.JP:
ごめんジャック。
僕は正直、姫を探したい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Apologies, Jack. But my heart still yearns for
my princess.

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
We have safety in our numbers, but my
princess may be lost, all alone.
fields.JP:
僕たちはこうして集まることができたけど、
姫はもしかしたら、ひとりぼっちかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have safety in our numbers, but my
princess may be lost, all alone.

fields.EN:
I can't help but think fearful thoughts of
what could happen were she to bump into
some horrible Marchen.
fields.JP:
そんな状況で、もしもメルヒェンたちに
遭遇してしまったらと思うと、気が気じゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't help but think fearful thoughts of
what could happen were she to bump into
some horrible Marchen.

fields.EN:
Tsuu, I know what you mean. Even so,
we won't do her any good if we're tired.
fields.JP:
つうの気持ちはとてもよく分かるよ。
でも今は休むべきだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, I know what you mean. Even so,
we won't do her any good if we're tired.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Tsuu, when you were ambushed on the
surface, you fought to protect us, right?
fields.JP:
だってつうは地上で襲われた時、
僕たちを守るために戦ってくれたでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, when you were ambushed on the
surface, you fought to protect us, right?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
And during the operation, you stood watch.
How you're standing is beyond me.
fields.JP:
しかもくららの手術中も、ずっと見張りを
続けてくれていた。誰よりも疲れてるはずだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
And during the operation, you stood watch.
How you're standing is beyond me.

fields.EN: You flatter me. I'm still fine...
fields.JP:
そんなことないさ。
僕はまだまだ元気だから……
fields.LOCALIZED: You flatter me. I'm still fine...

fields.JP: なっ、何するんだマモル！

fields.EN:
Look at you. One shove and you're toppling
over. You're barely hanging on here.
fields.JP:
俺に背中押されてよろけるなんて、
普段のおまえじゃありえねえだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at you. One shove and you're toppling
over. You're barely hanging on here.

fields.JP: こ、これはたまたまだって

fields.EN:
Look. In your condition, you'll die before
we ever find Ningyohime. Geez, get it
together.
fields.JP:
あのな、そんな状態じゃ人魚姫を見つける前に
お前が死ぬぞ。ったく、無理すんなっての
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look. In your condition, you'll die before
we ever find Little Mermaid. Geez, get it
together.

fields.EN:
In that case, I'll stand watch tonight. You all
get some sleep.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、まずは俺が見張りをする。
だからみんなは休んでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case, I'll stand watch tonight. You all
get some sleep.

fields.JP: マモル、僕も一緒に見張りするよ

fields.EN: You just had your blood drawn. Rest up.
fields.JP:
おまえは血を抜かれたばっかだろ。
休んどけ休んどけ
fields.LOCALIZED: You just had your blood drawn. Rest up.

fields.EN:
Yeah, but all I did was lay down. Let me stand
watch with you at least.
fields.JP:
そうだけど、寝ていただけだからさ。
見張りくらいやらせてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but all I did was lay down. Let me stand
watch with you at least.

fields.EN:
You sure? Wouldn't mind the help. Otsuu,
sorry, but if anything happens, I'll wake you.
fields.JP:
そうか？　じゃあ一緒にやっか。
おつう、何かあったら悪いが起こすぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure? Wouldn't mind the help. Otsuu,
sorry, but if anything happens, I'll wake you.

fields.EN:
I don't mind. I've got more than enough fight
left in me. Thanks, you two.
fields.JP:
構わない。すぐに飛び出せるようにしておくよ。
じゃあ２人とも、頼んだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind. I've got more than enough fight
left in me. Thanks, you two.

fields.EN:
(I wonder where everyone else is...
Hope they're safe.)
fields.JP:
（他のみんなは今どこにいるんだろう……。
　無事だといいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder where everyone else is...
Hope they're safe.)

fields.EN:
(Besides, where are we anyways? Is this
a Jail?)
fields.JP:
（それに、そもそもここはいったい
　どこなんだろう？　やっぱりジェイルなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Besides, where are we anyways? Is this
a Jail?)

fields.JP: ジャック、どうかしたかい？

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry! Nothing.
Leave the watch to us.
fields.JP:
あ、ごめん！　何でもないよ。
見張り、任せて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry! Nothing.
Leave the watch to us.

fields.EN:
Hey Jack, we may want to rethink this spot.
Some blindspots around here.
fields.JP:
なあジャック。良いか悪いかはさておき、
ここは袋小路だ。見通しも悪い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Jack, we may want to rethink this spot.
Some blindspots around here.

fields.EN: I propose we move over there for our watch.
fields.JP:
だからよ、向こうの道まで
出て見張ってようぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: I propose we move over there for our watch.

fields.EN:
We're gonna head a little further out, okay?
Otsuu, Miko-san, sleep tight!
fields.JP:
つーわけで、ちょっと先んとこで見張るわ。
おつうも視子さんもしっかり寝といてくれよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're gonna head a little further out, okay?
Otsuu, Miko, sleep tight!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
(The fewer Marchens we see, the better.
But it's a little too quiet for me around
here...)
fields.JP:
（メルヒェンが来ないに越したことはないけど、
　静かすぎるのも、それはそれで薄気味悪いな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The fewer Marchens we see, the better.
But it's a little too quiet for me around
here...)

fields.EN:
Well, this has already been quite the
adventure.
fields.JP: にしてもよ、またとんでもないことになっちまったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, this has already been quite the
adventure.

fields.EN:
We were greeted on the surface by a mountain
of corpses. So much for the splendor of nature
that I read about.
fields.JP:
地上に出たと思ったら死体の山だしよ、
本で読んだ綺麗な景色はどこにあるんだか
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were greeted on the surface by a mountain
of corpses. So much for the splendor of nature
that I read about.

fields.EN: I like to think it's out there somewhere.
fields.JP: どこかにはあるって思いたいよね
fields.LOCALIZED: I like to think it's out there somewhere.

fields.EN:
Not to be cynical, but I highly doubt that
judging by what we've seen so far.
fields.JP:
希望を捨てるつもりはねえけど、絶対あるって
言い切れねえくらいにはひでえ状況だよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to be cynical, but I highly doubt that
judging by what we've seen so far.

fields.EN:
Not to mention the enormous Jail tower
that made the underground Jail look like
a jungle gym.
fields.JP:
あの地下監獄のジェイルが豆粒に
見えるほどの、でっけえ監獄塔もあったしよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention the enormous Jail tower
that made the underground Jail look like
a jungle gym.

fields.EN:
We struggled enough with the Jail below
ground. I shudder to think of what's next.
fields.JP:
地下のジェイルですらあんなに苦労したから、
この先を考えるだけで恐ろしいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We struggled enough with the Jail below
ground. I shudder to think of what's next.

fields.EN:
It's not just Marchens this time, either.
Those crazy girls...who were they?
fields.JP:
しかも今度はメルヒェンだけじゃねえしな。
あのヤバそうな女たち、なんつったっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not just Marchens this time, either.
Those crazy girls...who were they?

fields.JP: 処刑台少女……って言ってたね
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
I mean, the Blood Maidens could barely
keep up. Who would've thought?
fields.JP:
血式少女が手も足も出ないなんて、
まさか想像もしなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, the Blood Maidens could barely
keep up. Who would've thought?

fields.EN:
If it weren't for Hikari, we would've been
done for.
fields.JP: ヒカリがいなかったら、マジでやばかったよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it weren't for Hikari, we would've been
done for.

fields.EN:
I know... She saved us. But now we're all
separated.
fields.JP:
そうだね……おかげで助かったよ。
でも、今度はバラバラになっちゃったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know... She saved us. But now we're all
separated.

fields.EN: Yeah. Hard to tell what's up or down.
fields.JP: ああ。　そのうえここがどこかも分からねえしな
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Hard to tell what's up or down.

fields.EN:
Surviving up here means eventually having
to deal with Genocide Pink.
fields.JP:
しかも地上で生きてくなら、処刑台少女とは
きっとこの先、どこかでまた出会う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surviving up here means eventually having
to deal with Massacre Pink.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
If only we could broker some kind of peace,
then we could work together to survive...
fields.JP:
だから生き残るためにも、
みんなでまた集まって力を合わせないと――
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we could broker some kind of peace,
then we could work together to survive...

fields.EN:
Bet you're thinking the same thing, right
Jack?
fields.JP:
なーんてことをジャック、
おまえはまた、ごちゃごちゃ考えてるんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bet you're thinking the same thing, right
Jack?

fields.EN: Honestly, my head's all over the place. Haha.
fields.JP:
いや……正直、頭が追いつかないよ。
……はは
fields.LOCALIZED: Honestly, my head's all over the place. Haha.

fields.EN:
Normally I'm not the one who's got to think
of all this stuff. I don't know much.
fields.JP:
俺はそんなに頭回んねえから、
色々分からねえことだらけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normally I'm not the one who's got to think
of all this stuff. I don't know much.

fields.EN:
But I think there's a lot of mysteries here,
waiting in the shadows.
fields.JP:
きっとこの先、色々な『謎』を
解決していかなきゃいけねえんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I think there's a lot of mysteries here,
waiting in the shadows.

fields.EN:
For now I'll appreciate that I'm still here,
and maybe plot my next move.
fields.JP:
でも、今はこうして生きてることに感謝して、
次に何をするべきかを考えなきゃって思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
For now I'll appreciate that I'm still here,
and maybe plot my next move.

fields.EN: (He's right. I do tend to get ahead of myself.)
fields.JP:
（確かに僕は、先のことを
　考えすぎていたかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED: (He's right. I do tend to get ahead of myself.)

fields.EN:
(One wrong decision, and we might not walk
out of here with our lives.)
fields.JP:
（それで行動を見誤ったら、
　今度こそ生き延びられないかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(One wrong decision, and we might not walk
out of here with our lives.)

fields.EN:
(Right. I can't lose sight of what I've got
to do.)
fields.JP:
（そうだよ、今やらなきゃ
　いけないことを見失っちゃ駄目だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Right. I can't lose sight of what I've got
to do.)

fields.EN:
First, we'll have to establish shelter here.
Then we'll look for our friends.
fields.JP:
……まずはここで生活の基盤を
作りながら、仲間を探そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, we'll have to establish shelter here.
Then we'll look for our friends.

fields.JP: そうそう、それがいいと思うぜ

fields.EN:
Once that's secured, then let's scour for food.
We've got a lot to do.
fields.JP:
安全を確保して、それからメシや寝床と、
やることはいっぱいある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once that's secured, then let's scour for food.
We've got a lot to do.

fields.JP: うん。まずはそこからだね

fields.EN:
Thanks Mamoru. If I were alone, I think the
pressure of the situation would've gotten to
me.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、マモル。
僕ひとりだったら、きっとこの状況に飲まれて
もっと焦ってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks Mamoru. If I were alone, I think the
pressure of the situation would've gotten to
me.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. Can't blame anyone for freaking
out right now.
fields.JP: こんなの混乱しねえ奴なんていねえから安心しろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. Can't blame anyone for freaking
out right now.

fields.EN:
But Mamoru, you knew what to do right
away. You're so courageous. I'm happy
you're here with us.
fields.JP:
でも、今やるべきことをマモルは分かってた。
しかも度胸もあるし……
一緒にいてくれてよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Mamoru, you knew what to do right
away. You're so courageous. I'm happy
you're here with us.

fields.JP:
それにしても……
はは、何だかおかしいよね

fields.EN:
Just the other day, we were locked up in the
Jail together.
fields.JP:
だってさ、マモルと一緒にジェイルに
捕まっていたのって、ついこの間のことだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just the other day, we were locked up in the
Jail together.

fields.EN: Now here we are. Free and on the surface.
fields.JP: それなのに、脱獄して地上に出て……
fields.LOCALIZED: Now here we are. Free and on the surface.

fields.EN:
Before we knew it, we're stuck in a place
with seemingly no way out. The two of us,
again.
fields.JP:
気づけばこんな右も左も分からない場所に、
こうして２人でいるんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before we knew it, we're stuck in a place
with seemingly no way out. The two of us,
again.

fields.EN:
I see your point. Seems fate has a sense of
humor.
fields.JP: 確かに運命サマも気まぐれすぎだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see your point. Seems fate has a sense of
humor.

fields.EN:
It pulls strings, ensuring we're never bored.
Me? I wish it would mind its own business.
Sheesh.
fields.JP:
もし退屈させないように計らってくれてんなら、
ありがた迷惑な話だぜ、ったく
fields.LOCALIZED:
It pulls strings, ensuring we're never bored.
Me? I wish it would mind its own business.
Sheesh.

fields.EN:
(Mamoru always points his nose forward,
no matter what, laughing in the face of his
fears.)
fields.JP:
（マモルはどんな状況でも前を向いている。
　そして、いつだって不安を笑い飛ばしてくれる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mamoru always points his nose forward,
no matter what, laughing in the face of his
fears.)

fields.EN:
(Even in the timeline imagined by Tsuu,
he had a knack for leadership.)
fields.JP:
（つうが作りだした世界の時だって、そうやって
　みんなを引っ張っていってくれたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even in the timeline imagined by Otsuu,
he had a knack for leadership.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(If Mamoru wasn't here, I probably would've
given up by now. What would I do without
him?)
fields.JP:
（マモルがいなければ、僕たちは途中で
　諦めていたと思う。本当に頼りになるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If Mamoru wasn't here, I probably would've
given up by now. What would I do without
him?)

fields.JP: とにかく、まずは食料探しだ

fields.EN:
Right. We should also scout some nearby
areas to see if anyone else―
fields.JP:
うん。それと一緒に近場から
他のみんなも探していこう――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We should also scout some nearby
areas to see if anyone else―

fields.JP: おいジャック、今の……見たよな？

fields.EN:
Yeah. Something in that back hallway.
It was big, dark, and moving...
fields.JP:
うん……あっちの道の奥、
大きくて真っ黒な空間が動いてたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Something in that back hallway.
It was big, dark, and moving...

fields.EN: Almost certainly has to be a Nightmare.
fields.JP: どう見てもナイトメアが現れた時の空間、だよな
fields.LOCALIZED: Almost certainly has to be a Nightmare.

fields.EN: I can't believe we found one up here!
fields.JP: ここにもナイトメアがいるなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't believe we found one up here!

fields.EN:
Crap. If it finds us, we're good as dead.
Doesn't look good for us.
fields.JP:
まずいぞ、今鉢合わせたら間違いなく全滅だぜ。
こっちは袋小路だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Crap. If it finds us, we're good as dead.
Doesn't look good for us.

fields.EN:
What do we do? Wake everyone up and
flee from here?
fields.JP: どうする？　今のうちにみんなを起こして逃げる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do we do? Wake everyone up and
flee from here?

fields.EN:
If the Nightmare approaches, it's best for
us to wake everyone and escape.
fields.JP:
もしもナイトメアがこっちに向かってくるようなら、
全員起こしてイチかバチか突破だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Nightmare approaches, it's best for
us to wake everyone and escape.

fields.EN:
(Good. It turned the other way...
Wait, why's it stopping?!)
fields.JP: （いいぞ、そのまま向こうに――動きが止まった！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Good. It turned the other way...
Wait, why's it stopping?!)

fields.JP: （お願いだ、こっちには来ないでくれ……！）
ああ……気づかれずに済んだみたいだな

fields.EN: Man, keeping watch is no joke.
fields.JP: やばいな、この門番は命懸けだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Man, keeping watch is no joke.

fields.EN:
Let's report back to everyone and update
them. For now, keep your guard up.
fields.JP:
後でみんなに報告して話し合おう。
とにかく今は、気合い入れて見張るぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's report back to everyone and update
them. For now, keep your guard up.

fields.EN:
Right. Can't let anything slip past us on
our watch.
fields.JP: うん。少しの変化も見逃さないようにしなきゃね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Can't let anything slip past us on
our watch.

fields.EN:
(While I'm still worried about Alice and the
others, I gotta stay focused.)
fields.JP:
（アリスや他のみんなも心配だけど、
　今は目の前に集中しないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(While I'm still worried about Alice and the
others, I gotta stay focused.)

fields.EN:
(Can't find our friends if we're already
dead.)
fields.JP: （じゃないと、次に死体になるのは僕たちだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Can't find our friends if we're already
dead.)

fields.EN:
Thank you for keeping watch, Jack and
Mamoru.
fields.JP: お疲れジャック、マモル
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for keeping watch, Jack and
Mamoru.

fields.JP: あ、起きたんだね２人とも

fields.EN:
You've been out here a while. Why didn't
you wake us?
fields.JP:
随分と長い時間見張りをしてくれてたのね。
起こしてくれてよかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've been out here a while. Why didn't
you wake us?

fields.EN:
Standing watch is all there is to do right
now. Don't worry about it.
fields.JP:
見張りは今、俺にできる唯一の仕事だからな。
気にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Standing watch is all there is to do right
now. Don't worry about it.

fields.JP: 視子さん、くららはどうなんですか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Still recovering, but she's stable. She
should be fine.
fields.JP:
傷は、完全には塞がっていないわ。
でも容態は安定したから、もう大丈夫ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still recovering, but she's stable. She
should be fine.

fields.EN:
Finally, some good news! Sounds like we'll
be able to handle the Marchens now.
fields.JP:
いいニュースが聞けて、元気出てきたぜ！
今ならメルヒェンだろうがぶっ飛ばせそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally, some good news! Sounds like we'll
be able to handle the Marchens now.

fields.EN:
Really? Maybe we'll have to schedule you
on watch more often then, Mamoru.
fields.JP:
本当かい？　じゃあマモルには、
引き続き見張りをお願いしようかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Maybe we'll have to schedule you
on watch more often then, Mamoru.

fields.EN: Wha?! W-well no, I need a break.
fields.JP:
げっ！？　
あ、いや、それは勘弁してくれ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha?! W-well no, I need a break.

fields.EN: Hahaha. Only joking. Let me take over.
fields.JP:
はははっ。冗談だって。
次は僕が変わるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. Only joking. Let me take over.

fields.EN:
Wait, Tsuu. Before we swap out, let's
discuss our next move.
fields.JP:
待って、つう。見張りを交代する前に、
これからのことを話したいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, Otsuu. Before we swap out, let's
discuss our next move.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: 分かった。聞かせてくれ

fields.EN:
For starters, there wasn't much trouble
with Marchens on watch.
fields.JP:
ひとまず一晩見張ってみて、
メルヒェンが来ることはほとんどなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For starters, there wasn't much trouble
with Marchens on watch.

fields.EN:
Some would timidly approach us, but it
seemed like they thought it was a dead
end and walked on past.
fields.JP:
たまに近づいてくる奴もいたけど、そいつらも
行き止まりだって分かってるのか通りすぎていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some would timidly approach us, but it
seemed like they thought it was a dead
end and walked on past.

fields.EN: I see. What if they were to realize?
fields.JP: なるほど。でもいつかは入ってくるんじゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. What if they were to realize?

fields.EN:
Well, I made a little make-shift gate
just in case. Should help with that.
fields.JP:
だから念のため、俺が即席の柵を作っておいた。
これでさらに気づかれにくくなったはずだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I made a little make-shift gate
just in case. Should help with that.

fields.EN:
We can't afford to let our defenses
down, but it'll do.
fields.JP: 心許ないけど、今はこれが精一杯ってところね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't afford to let our defenses
down, but it'll do.

fields.EN:
For now, we can use this as a base while
we gather food and water.
fields.JP:
まずはここを拠点に、食料や飲み水の
確保をしたいと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
For now, we can use this as a base while
we gather food and water.

fields.EN:
While we stock up, we should continue
searching for the others.
fields.JP:
それで、ライフラインに必要なものを
揃えていきながら、他のみんなを探すべきかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
While we stock up, we should continue
searching for the others.

fields.EN:
No objections here. Preparation is the key
to our survival.
fields.JP:
異論はないわ。
まず生きることを考えるべきよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No objections here. Preparation is the key
to our survival.

fields.EN:
One problem, though. There are Nightmares
about.
fields.JP:
だけど、１つ問題がある。
ここにもナイトメアがいやがる
fields.LOCALIZED:
One problem, though. There are Nightmares
about.

fields.EN: ...I see. I knew it. I had an inkling.
fields.JP:
……そうか。やはりね。
なんとなく予想はしてたけど
fields.LOCALIZED: ...I see. I knew it. I had an inkling.

fields.EN: That won't stop us from exploring though.
fields.JP:
まあ、だからといって
探索しないって選択肢はねえんだが
fields.LOCALIZED: That won't stop us from exploring though.

fields.EN:
I think it might be best if Tsuu and
I handle the search.
fields.JP:
探索は僕とつうの２人だけで
行くのがベターだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think it might be best if Otsuu and
I handle the search.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
We wouldn't want to burden you two.
That's a sound decision.
fields.JP: 私たちは足手まといだもの、そうするしかないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We wouldn't want to burden you two.
That's a sound decision.

fields.EN:
Tsuu's our only Blood Maiden. We haven't
fortified this area enough yet, and I can't
help much in battle.
fields.JP:
血式少女はつう１人。ここを守れる者がいなくなるのは
不安だけど、探索しなければやがては行き詰まるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu's our only Blood Maiden. We haven't
fortified this area enough yet, and I can't
help much in battle.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Y-yeah... I'm fine. But I'll only feel more
assured once I'm actually doing something.
fields.JP:
あ、ああ……大丈夫だ。
心配するよりまずは行動しないとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-yeah... I'm fine. But I'll only feel more
assured once I'm actually doing something.

fields.EN:
Yes. For the sake of Princess, you need
rest too, Jack. As soon as you're up, we'll
begin our search!
fields.JP:
姫のためにも、まずジャックは休もう。
ジャックが休み終わったら、
早速探索に向かいたいと思う！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. For the sake of Princess, you need
rest too, Jack. As soon as you're up, we'll
begin our search!

fields.EN: (I bet she's worried sick for Ningyohime... Thanks Tsuu.)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫のことが心配で堪らないはずなのに……
　ありがとう。　つう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I bet she's worried sick for Little
Mermaid... Thanks Otsuu.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: We'll look after Clara and Hikari for now.
fields.JP:
それじゃ、私はしばらく
くららとヒカリを診ているわ
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll look after Clara and Hikari for now.

fields.EN:
I don't have to tell you this, but be careful,
okay? Don't get ahead of yourself out there.
fields.JP:
分かってると思うけど、あまり無理はしないようにね。
一度で探索しようなんて考えては駄目よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't have to tell you this, but be careful,
okay? Don't get ahead of yourself out there.

fields.EN: I'll keep watch here, so don't worry about us.
fields.JP:
俺はしっかりと見張りしてるからよ。
拠点のことは任せとけ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll keep watch here, so don't worry about us.

fields.EN: Just...come back here in one piece.
fields.JP: ま、どうあれ無事に帰って来いよな
fields.LOCALIZED: Just...come back here in one piece.

fields.JP:
ん、ん……
うーーーーーん

fields.EN:
All right... I'm up! Hey Tsuu, let's go
exploring!
fields.JP:
よし……起きた！
さぁ、つう早速探索に出かけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right... I'm up! Hey Otsuu, let's go
exploring!
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
But you only just woke up, and you slept
for only a few hours. You sure, Jack?
fields.JP:
そんな起きてすぐだし、数時間しか寝てないけど
大丈夫かいジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you only just woke up, and you slept
for only a few hours. You sure, Jack?

fields.EN:
Yeah. That's plenty for now. I'm more
worried about Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
うん、今はこれで十分だよ。
僕も人魚姫さんが心配だしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. That's plenty for now. I'm more
worried about Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
……っ！
ありがとう、ジャック…！

fields.EN:
Actually, you're the one who let me sleep,
even though you were eager to set out.
Thanks for that, Tsuu.
fields.JP:
むしろ今にも飛び出したかったはずなのに、
僕の身体を気遣ってくれてありがとう、つう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually, you're the one who let me sleep,
even though you were eager to set out.
Thanks for that, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Very astute. Your concern doesn't
go unnoticed.
fields.JP:
ははっ、流石相棒。
全てお見通しだったみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Very astute. Your concern doesn't
go unnoticed.

fields.EN: We do go way back. Let's get to it!
fields.JP:
なんだかんだ長い付き合いだしね。
そうとなれば早速行こうか…！
fields.LOCALIZED: We do go way back. Let's get to it!

fields.EN:
Right. Here we come, Princess. We'll find
you all!
fields.JP: ああ、一刻も早く姫や他の人たちをみつけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Here we come, Princess. We'll find
you all!

fields.EN: Jack, someone's on the ground there!
fields.JP: ジャック、あそこに誰か倒れてる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, someone's on the ground there!

fields.EN: I see them! Let's go, Tsuu!
fields.JP: 本当だ……！　行こう、つう！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see them! Let's go, Otsuu!
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP:
大丈夫ですか！
しっかりして下さい！

fields.EN:
I wonder if a Marchen got to them. If only
we made it in time.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンにやられちゃったのかな。
僕たちと合流できていれば良かったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if a Marchen got to them. If only
we made it in time.

fields.EN: I recognize them from the Liberated District.
fields.JP: この人解放地区で見たことあるな
fields.LOCALIZED: I recognize them from the Liberated District.

fields.EN: I see. Maybe everyone was warped here, including the people who had died.
fields.JP:
そうか、もしかしたら死んだ人も含めて、
みんなワープしたのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Maybe some of the bodies in that big
pile were warped here.

fields.EN:
Look at the wounds. Inflicted by a sharp
weapon. Has to be some of Genocide Pink's
victims.
fields.JP:
ほら見てこの傷、鋭利な武器でつけられたものだよ。
きっとあの処刑台少女にやられたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at the wounds. Inflicted by a sharp
weapon. Has to be some of Massacre Pink's
victims.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Yes, you're right. Those wounds are too
clean to have come from a Marchen.
fields.JP:
確かにメルヒェンの仕業にしては、
手際が良すぎるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, you're right. Those wounds are too
clean to have come from a Marchen.

fields.EN: I see. Killed by Genocide Pink...
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Killed by Massacre Pink...
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Forgive me. I was no match against them.
I'm sorry...for not saving you.
fields.JP:
ごめん……僕、奴らに手も足も出なくて……
あなたを守れなくて……本当にごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forgive me. I was no match against them.
I'm sorry...for not saving you.

fields.EN:
You can't blame yourself, Tsuu. You were
wounded, but you still managed to keep
everyone else safe.
fields.JP:
つう、あまり自分を責めないで。
君はあんなにボロボロになりながら、
みんなを守り続けてくれたじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't blame yourself, Otsuu. You were
wounded, but you still managed to keep
everyone else safe.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: But none of that is your fault.
fields.JP: だから、君のせいなんかじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: But none of that is your fault.

fields.EN:
Thank you Jack, but perhaps our fates would
be different had I not faltered.
fields.JP:
ありがとうジャック。
でも、僕が負けたのは事実だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you Jack, but perhaps our fates would
be different had I not faltered.

fields.EN: If I were stronger, they wouldn't have died.
fields.JP:
僕がもっと強ければ、
こんな目に遭う人をもっと減らせたんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: If I were stronger, they wouldn't have died.

fields.EN:
(Tsuu seems hung up on her defeat
against Genocide Pink.)
fields.JP:
（つう、処刑台少女に敗北したこと、
　ずっと引きずっているみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Otsuu seems hung up on her defeat
against Massacre Pink.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(I hope she doesn't think she has to
shoulder that burden alone.)
fields.JP: （あまり背負いこみすぎないといいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope she doesn't think she has to
shoulder that burden alone.)

fields.EN:
Jack, let's move on. My concern lies more
with the princess.
fields.JP:
ジャック、先へ進もう。
姫のことがさらに心配になってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, let's move on. My concern lies more
with the princess.

fields.JP: ってジャック、かがみこんで何してるんだい？

fields.EN: Sorry... Just need to search the body.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい……
あなたの身体、ちょっと調べさせてもらいます
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry... Just need to search the body.

fields.EN: Are you stealing from the dead?!
fields.JP: まさか物資をもらっていくつもりなのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you stealing from the dead?!

fields.EN:
Yeah. It looks bad, but we're also trying
to survive out here. Times are tough.
fields.JP:
うん。この人には悪いけど、ここに残していく
ぐらいなら、使わせてもらおうと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. It looks bad, but we're also trying
to survive out here. Times are tough.

fields.EN: Taking from the dead is inexcusable.
fields.JP:
亡くなった人のを持っていくのは、
少し気が引けるね
fields.LOCALIZED: Taking from the dead is inexcusable.

fields.EN:
Sure, but what's the alternative? We need
to live so we can reunite with Alice, Ningyohime-san, and the others.
fields.JP:
だけど、僕たちは生きなきゃいけない。
生きて、アリスや人魚姫さん、みんなと再会するんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but what's the alternative? We need
to live so we can reunite with Alice, Little
Mermaid, and the others.
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
You're absolutely right, Jack. Forgive my
naivety.
fields.JP:
うん。そうだね。ジャックの言う通りだ。
甘いことを言っちゃって、すまない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're absolutely right, Jack. Forgive my
naivety.

fields.EN:
It's okay. The old me wouldn't have gone
along with this too.
fields.JP:
いいんだ。昔の僕なら、つうと同じように
迷ってたと思うから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay. The old me wouldn't have gone
along with this too.

fields.EN:
They had some food and a bit of water in
their bag. This cloth might also help our
camp.
fields.JP:
鞄には少しだけど水と食料があった。
この大きな布も、寝床にいいかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
They had some food and a bit of water in
their bag. This cloth might also help our
camp.

fields.EN:
Thank you. If only we knew your name,
and could grant you a proper burial.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。名前も知らない誰か。
できることならちゃんと弔ってあげたいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. If only we knew your name,
and could grant you a proper burial.

fields.EN: At the very least, here's a prayer.
fields.JP: せめて、亡骸に手を合わせていこう
fields.LOCALIZED: At the very least, here's a prayer.

fields.EN:
Thank you so much. Your death won't be
in vain, we will honor you with what you've
left behind.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございました。
あなたの残したもの、使わせて頂きます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you so much. Your death won't be
in vain, we will honor you with what you've
left behind.

fields.EN:
We promise it shan't be used in vain, so
thank you...
fields.JP:
物資、決して無駄にはしないから。
だから頂いていくね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We promise it shan't be used in vain, so
thank you...

fields.EN:
(We can't even bury the dead here. No
flowers. Not even a eulogy.)
fields.JP:
（ちゃんと埋葬してやることもできない。手向ける
　花のひとつもない。まともに弔うことも許されない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We can't even bury the dead here. No
flowers. Not even a eulogy.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder how much more of this kind of
stuff we have ahead of us...)
fields.JP: （これからも、こんなことが続くのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder how much more of this kind of
stuff we have ahead of us...)

fields.EN:
(I hope there are more survivors than we
think.)
fields.JP: （どうか、多くの人が生きてますように）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope there are more survivors than we
think.)

fields.EN:
Okay, looks like the coast is clear
from Marchens.
fields.JP: よし、メルヒェンはいないみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, looks like the coast is clear
from Marchens.

fields.EN:
Surprised to see no one else is here. Other
than that body, it's been pretty empty.
fields.JP:
それにしても、誰にも会えないね。
この辺りは、さっきの亡骸の他に誰もいないのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surprised to see no one else is here. Other
than that body, it's been pretty empty.

fields.EN:
It'll be okay, Tsuu. We found each other,
didn't we? We'll find Ningyohime-san too.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だって、つう。僕たちが再会できたように、
人魚姫さんとも再会できるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be okay, Otsuu. We found each other,
didn't we? We'll find Little Mermaid too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Y-you're right. I almost gave up hope. Sorry.
fields.JP:
そ、そうだね。弱気になるところだった。
すまない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-you're right. I almost gave up hope. Sorry.

fields.JP: って、どうしたんだいジャック？

fields.EN: I thought I heard someone's voice.
fields.JP: いや、誰かの声が聞こえた気がして
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought I heard someone's voice.

fields.JP:
本当だ……！
それに、あの声は……！

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Michiru-san...! The Marchens are going to find
us if you keep being noisy!
fields.JP:
ミチルさん……！　そんなに大きい声を出したら
メルヒェンが出ちゃうよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru...! The Marchens are going to find
us if you keep being noisy!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN: No, I think we'll be okay.
fields.JP: ううん、きっと大丈夫だと思う
fields.LOCALIZED: No, I think we'll be okay.

fields.EN:
I don't sense anyone around us,
but I DO sense something else!
fields.JP: 今は気配がない、けど違う気配がしたのー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't sense anyone around us,
but I DO sense something else!

fields.JP: それってどういうこと……？

fields.EN: Uh, THAT is what I mean.
fields.JP: えっとー、あーゆーこと
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh, THAT is what I mean.

fields.JP: おつうちゃん！　ジャックさんも！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san, Michiru-san! We finally found
you!
fields.JP:
人魚姫さん、ミチルさん……！
やっと見つけられたよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid, Michiru! We finally found
you!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; ミチルさん => Michiru-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Ahhh, my princess! Princess! My heart can
rest now that we've found you.
fields.JP:
ああ、姫っ、姫っ……！
無事でよかった……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahhh, my princess! Princess! My heart can
rest now that we've found you.

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, ouch. Not so tight. It hurts.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん……そんなに強く
抱きしめられたら、苦しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, ouch. Not so tight. It hurts.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
*sniffle* I was oh-so-worried about you.
Nearly went mad thinking about your safety.
fields.JP:
ぐすっ、だって姫が心配で心配で、
気が気じゃなくて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sniffle* I was oh-so-worried about you.
Nearly went mad thinking about your safety.

fields.EN:
If you were to die again on my watch, I...
OOGH!
fields.JP:
また姫を死なせてしまったら、
僕はもう……うぅっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were to die again on my watch, I...
OOGH!

fields.EN:
Right... I've made you sad so many times already,
haven't I, Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP:
そっか……わたし、おつうちゃんを
もう何度も悲しませちゃってるんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I bet this isn't the first or only time
I've sent you into panic.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: In this world, and in the last world.
fields.JP: この世界でも、その前の世界でも
fields.LOCALIZED: In this world, and in the last world.

fields.EN:
I have made many mistakes on my path.
I was too late. Failed too many times.
fields.JP:
これまで進むべき道を間違えたり、
手遅れだったり、何度も失敗したんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have made many mistakes on my path.
I was too late. Failed too many times.

fields.EN:
But now I'm taking fate by my own hands,
and I will never let you go!
fields.JP:
でも今は、それを乗り越えて掴んだ道なんだ。
だからもう、姫を離したくないんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now I'm taking fate by my own hands,
and I will never let you go!

fields.EN: Okay, I'll never leave you either.
fields.JP: うん……もう絶対に離れないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, I'll never leave you either.

fields.JP:
泣かないでおつうちゃん。
ほら、よしよし
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I'm happy we found each other too.
Thanks for never giving up, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
わたしも再会できて、とっても嬉しい。
探してくれてありがとう、おつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy we found each other too.
Thanks for never giving up, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Tsuu's been worried sick about you,
Ningyohime-san. No matter how far or
how long we searched, she kept going.
fields.JP:
つう、ずっと人魚姫さんのこと心配してて、
疲れてるのに無理をして捜索してたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu's been worried sick about you,
Little Mermaid. No matter how far or
how long we searched, she kept going.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I'm so relieved you two could reunite.
fields.JP:
だから、２人が再会できて
本当によかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so relieved you two could reunite.

fields.JP: ふふ、ジャックさんもありがと
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ん？　どうしたのミチルさん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.JP: あのね、人魚、今は冷静に見えるでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Doesn't Little Mermaid seem strangely calm?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
When I first ran into her, she was freaking
out. She kept calling out for Otsuu-chan and
everyone!
fields.JP:
でもここで再会した時は、とっても取り乱していたの。
『おつうちゃん、みんなー』って
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I first ran into her, she was freaking
out. She kept calling out for Otsuu and
everyone!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: ちち、違う、取り乱してなんか……

fields.EN: Hey. It's rude to stare, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
うぅ、わたしの顔そんなに見つめないで、
おつうちゃん……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. It's rude to stare, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: You and Ningyohime-san are kind of alike, Tsuu.
fields.JP: つうも人魚姫さんも、なんだか似てるね
fields.LOCALIZED: You two are perfect for each other.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10). | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: もう、ジャックさんまでからかって～～～！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ごめん、からかったわけじゃ……！

fields.EN:
My princess, I for one consider our
similarities to be a blessing.
fields.JP: 姫、僕は似てるって言われて嬉しいよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess, I for one consider our
similarities to be a blessing.

fields.EN: I mean, sure. So do I, but...
fields.JP: それはわたしだって嬉しいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean, sure. So do I, but...

fields.JP: とにかく、もうこの話は終わり！

fields.EN:
R-right. Uh, Ningyohime-san, when exactly
did you and Michiru-san meet up?
fields.JP:
そ、そうだね。えーっと、人魚姫さんと
ミチルさんは最初から一緒にいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-right. Uh, Little Mermaid, when exactly
did you and Michiru meet up?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; ミチルさん => Michiru-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Say. I think I warped right by you, didn't I?
fields.JP: そうよ。すぐそばにいたの。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Say. I think I warped right by you, didn't I?

fields.EN:
Oh boy. Don't believe her. Despite the
circumstances, Michiru-san seemed totally calm.
I couldn't believe it.
fields.JP:
うん、ミチルさんってばこんな状況でも
いつもと変わらないから、初めは驚いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh boy. Don't believe her. Despite the
circumstances, Michiru seemed totally calm.
I couldn't believe it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN: Michiru is Michiru. She can't change what she is.
fields.JP: ミチルはミチル。変わりようがないもの
fields.LOCALIZED: What you see is what you get. Can't be helped.
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP is explicitly ミチルはミチル.

fields.EN:
Michiru-san seemed to think the area was safe,
so we stayed there.
fields.JP:
それでミチルさんが『ここなら安心かも？』って
言った場所にしばらくいたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru seemed to think the area was safe,
so we stayed there.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
Michiru-san's presence helped my stress a bit,
but still, I wanted to find the others.
fields.JP:
ミチルさんといたら、少しだけ落ち着けた。
でもみんなを探さないとって思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Michiru's presence helped my stress a bit,
but still, I wanted to find the others.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
Then I felt a presence, so I called out to
you guys.
fields.JP:
そうしたら、ちょうど気配がしたから、
だから呼んだの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I felt a presence, so I called out to
you guys.

fields.EN:
You startled me when you shouted, but I'm glad I did
what you said, Michiru-san.
fields.JP:
大声で呼ぶからビックリしちゃった。
でも、ミチルさんの言うとおりにしてよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! I only freaked out because you started
screaming out of nowhere. But thankfully it
was for a good reason.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Right. It's what led us to you.
fields.JP: そうだね。こうして再会できたからね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. It's what led us to you.

fields.EN:
Let's all head back now. We set up a little
camp as a base.
fields.JP:
それじゃあみんな、ひとまず戻ろっか。
拠点――キャンプ地にしてる場所があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's all head back now. We set up a little
camp as a base.

fields.EN:
Indeed. I bet the others will be happy to
see you.
fields.JP: そうだね、みんなも喜ぶしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. I bet the others will be happy to
see you.

fields.EN:
Listen up. We have successfully located and
escorted Princess and Michiru!
fields.JP: 聞いてくれ、姫とミチルに再会できたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen up. We have successfully located and
escorted Princess and Michiru!

fields.JP: ただいま、マモルさんに視子さん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: マモルさん => Mamoru-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: ふふ、また賑やかになったね

fields.EN:
Ohhh, you're safe! Thank goodness you
found Ningyohime, Otsuu!
fields.JP:
おーおまえら無事だったか！
おつう、人魚姫と再会できて本当によかったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohhh, you're safe! Thank goodness you
found Little Mermaid, Otsuu!

fields.EN: Yeah...! I'm never letting her go again!
fields.JP: ああ……！　もう絶対離さないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah...! I'm never letting her go again!

fields.EN:
Not to ruin the reunion celebrations, but
we should all go over what we've learned
so far.
fields.JP:
感動の再開のところ申し訳ないけど、
仲間が増えたことだし
今の状況を一度共有しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to ruin the reunion celebrations, but
we should all go over what we've learned
so far.

fields.JP: それでヒカリちゃんとくららちゃんは大丈夫なの？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリちゃん => Hikari-chan; くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.EN:
Thanks to Miko-san's help, they have recovered
from their critical injuries. They seem fine.
fields.JP:
一時は危なかったけど、
視子さんが診てくれたんだ、もう大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to Miko's help, they have recovered
from their critical injuries. They seem fine.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Ningyohime, Lady Oohime, both of you
look well. You must be exhausted.
We don't have much, but please rest.
fields.JP:
人魚姫も大陽女さんも、怪我はないようね。
疲れたでしょう、何もないけど休んで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid, Lady Oohime, both of you
look well. You must be exhausted.
We don't have much, but please rest.

fields.EN:
Michiru's fine. Miko's the doctor, so isn't Miko
the one having a harder time?
fields.JP:
ミチルはへいき。お医者さんをしている
視子の方が大変でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. Miko, you're the doctor. You must
be more tired than everyone here.
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP uses ミチル as self-reference and compares Miko's burden as doctor.

fields.EN: Oh please, don't worry about me.
fields.JP: 私はさっき休んだから大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh please, don't worry about me.

fields.EN: Miko, Michiru can tell you're tired, you know?
fields.JP: 視子、疲れてるのミチル分かるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Miko, I can tell just looking at you.
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP explicitly says ミチル分かる.

fields.EN:
Thank you for your concern. In any case,
get some rest.
fields.JP:
お気遣いありがとう。
ま、まあとにかく、今はくつろいでて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you for your concern. In any case,
get some rest.

fields.EN:
Thank goodness you guys went on that
search!
fields.JP: しっかし探索に出て正解だったな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness you guys went on that
search!

fields.EN:
Right! Hopefully the others won't be too
far behind.
fields.JP:
うん！　この調子で他のみんなとも
無事合流できるといいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! Hopefully the others won't be too
far behind.

fields.EN: Of course they are. They're all a tough bunch.
fields.JP:
無事に決まってるさ。
みんなしぶとい連中ばかりだからね
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course they are. They're all a tough bunch.

fields.EN:
Hey everyone, we found some stuff while we
were out. I think they'll come in handy.
fields.JP:
そうだみんな、僕たち物資も見つけたんだ。
これでだいぶマシになるんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey everyone, we found some stuff while we
were out. I think they'll come in handy.

fields.EN: Oh, a big cloth and a clasp.
fields.JP: おお、でけえ布に留め具も……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, a big cloth and a clasp.

fields.EN: This should work nicely for a tent.
fields.JP: これなら即席のテントくらいは作れるかもな
fields.LOCALIZED: This should work nicely for a tent.

fields.EN:
Really Mamoru?! So everyone will get a good
night's rest―
fields.JP:
本当かい、マモル！
これでみんなまともな休息が取れる――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really Mamoru?! So everyone will get a good
night's rest―

fields.EN: Do you think it's a Marchen?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you think it's a Marchen?!

fields.EN:
No, it could be a Nightmare!
Everyone stand back!
fields.JP:
いや、ナイトメアの可能性もある！
みんな、下がるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it could be a Nightmare!
Everyone stand back!

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan. We have to do something!
fields.JP: おつうちゃん、わたしたちで何とかしなきゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu. We have to do something!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Wait a minute. There's no Marchens or
Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ってあれっ？
メルヒェンもナイトメアもいないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute. There's no Marchens or
Nightmares.

fields.EN: Did that light come from Clara and Hikari?
fields.JP: 光の出所はくららとヒカリ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did that light come from Clara and Hikari?

fields.JP: いったい何だっていうんだ！？

fields.EN: Oh, I'm so glad. Everyone seems safe.
fields.JP: よかった、無事みたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I'm so glad. Everyone seems safe.

fields.EN: Wait. Where's Clara? I don't see her.
fields.JP:
待って、くららは？
あの子がどこにもいないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. Where's Clara? I don't see her.

fields.EN:
But she was just there. Sleeping the whole
time. She can't have moved on her own.
fields.JP:
さっきまで確かにそこにいたのよ。
ずっと眠っていたし、自分で動くなんてあり得ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she was just there. Sleeping the whole
time. She can't have moved on her own.

fields.EN:
Now that you mention it, Hikari's lying in
a different spot as well.
fields.JP:
それによく見れば、ヒカリも
寝かせてた場所から随分離れた位置にいるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you mention it, Hikari's lying in
a different spot as well.

fields.EN:
Maybe Hikari had something to do with it.
Hey Hikari, hey!
fields.JP:
もしかして、ヒカリが何かしたのか……？
なあヒカリー、なあってば
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Hikari had something to do with it.
Hey Hikari, hey!

fields.EN:
Hey Hikari, fess up or I'll pinch your cheeks
some more!
fields.JP:
ほーらヒカリ、教えねえと
もっとほっぺたつねんぞ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Hikari, fess up or I'll pinch your cheeks
some more!

fields.JP: マモル、寝てるんだから止めなよ……
ねえ、何が起こったと思う？

fields.EN:
There's no way out of here, so we would've
seen if anyone came in.
fields.JP:
ここは袋小路だし、何者かが入ってきたら
すぐに分かるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way out of here, so we would've
seen if anyone came in.

fields.EN:
Miko-san just saw the two of them sleeping
here too.
fields.JP:
視子さんたちが、さっきまでそこで
寝ていたのを見ている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Miko just saw the two of them sleeping
here too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: Can't imagine someone went off with them.
fields.JP: 誰かに連れ去られたとは考えにくいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't imagine someone went off with them.

fields.JP: やっぱ、ヒカリの力じゃねえか？

fields.EN:
She warped us here, so maybe she accidentally
warped Clara somewhere too.
fields.JP:
私たちをここにワープさせたように、
無意識にくららをまた別の場所へ飛ばした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She warped us here, so maybe she accidentally
warped Clara somewhere too.

fields.EN: That would make the most sense.
fields.JP: 確かにそれがいちばん、しっくり来るわね
fields.LOCALIZED: That would make the most sense.

fields.EN: We'll have to ask Hikari-chan when she wakes up.
fields.JP:
とりあえず、ヒカリちゃんが起きたら
聞いてみるしかないね
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll have to ask Hikari when she wakes up.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリちゃん => Hikari-chan

fields.EN:
(We looked everywhere for Clara, but in the
end, we couldn't find her.)
fields.JP:
（あれからみんなでくららを探したけれど、
　結局見つけることはできなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We looked everywhere for Clara, but in the
end, we couldn't find her.)

fields.EN:
(Without any trace of her, our terror grew.
But we kept our hopes up since there was
no sign of struggle or blood.)
fields.JP:
（何の痕跡もないことに落胆もしたけれど、
　血痕や服の切れ端がない分、希望は持てる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Without any trace of her, our terror grew.
But we kept our hopes up since there was
no sign of struggle or blood.)

fields.EN:
(This wasn't an attack from an unknown
enemy. Hikari must've done something.
Contemplating the alternative was worse.)
fields.JP:
（やはりこれは正体不明の敵の攻撃なんかじゃなくて、
　ヒカリが無意識に何かしたんだと、
　ひとまずはそう結論づけることにした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This wasn't an attack from an unknown
enemy. Hikari must've done something.
Contemplating the alternative was worse.)

fields.EN:
(We knew in our hearts though that this
was a temporary peace of mind.)
fields.JP: （ある意味、気休めとも言えるけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We knew in our hearts though that this
was a temporary peace of mind.)

fields.EN:
Jack, keep looking for Clara. We can't give up.
We found Ningyohime. I'm sure we'll find
her too.
fields.JP:
ジャック、くららのことは諦めずに探していこうぜ。
人魚姫たちが見つかったんだ、いつかきっと見つかる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, keep looking for Clara. We can't give up.
We found Little Mermaid. I'm sure we'll find
her too.

fields.EN: Right, yeah. We're not giving up.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
うん、諦めたりなんてしてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right, yeah. We're not giving up.

fields.EN:
That being said, we should expand our camp
with all this stuff we've found.
fields.JP:
っつーことで、ひとまず物資もある程度見つかったし、
こっからはここをキャンプ地として発展させてえんだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
That being said, we should expand our camp
with all this stuff we've found.

fields.EN:
I agree. Having everyone together means
we can accomplish much more.
fields.JP:
賛成だ。人数も増えて、
できることの幅も広がったしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree. Having everyone together means
we can accomplish much more.

fields.EN:
Then we Blood Maidens will explore to locate
more supplies.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、わたしたち血式少女は、
物資の調達と他のみんなの捜索係だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we Blood Maidens will explore to locate
more supplies.

fields.EN: Jack. You're coming with us, right?
fields.JP: ジャックもついてきてくれるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack. You're coming with us, right?

fields.EN: Of course. We'll all meet back here.
fields.JP: もちろんだよ。ここにまたみんなを集めよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. We'll all meet back here.

fields.EN:
Our survival is contingent on whatever
you guys find out there.
fields.JP:
ここにいるみんなが生き残るのも、他の仲間たちを
集めるのも、あなたたちにかかっているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our survival is contingent on whatever
you guys find out there.

fields.EN:
But even so, be careful. Your safety comes
first.
fields.JP:
でも決して無茶はしないで。まずは
あなたたちが無事にここに戻ることを優先して
fields.LOCALIZED:
But even so, be careful. Your safety comes
first.

fields.EN: Got it. We promise to be careful.
fields.JP: はい。無茶は絶対にしません
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. We promise to be careful.

fields.EN:
The remaining members will ensure life
here is as comfortable as possible.
fields.JP:
じゃあ残りのメンバーは、このキャンプ地を
快適に生活できるよう整えていく係っつーことで
fields.LOCALIZED:
The remaining members will ensure life
here is as comfortable as possible.

fields.EN:
Lady Oohime, forgive me, but that means we
will have to call upon your help as well.
fields.JP:
大陽女さん、悪いけどこんな状況だから、
教祖様のあなたにも働いてもらうわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lady Oohime, forgive me, but that means we
will have to call upon your help as well.

fields.EN:
The only way we're getting through this is
together.
fields.JP: みんなで協力する、はとてもいいことだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only way we're getting through this is
together.

fields.JP: 何だか調子が狂うわね……

fields.EN: All right, then everyone's roles are set.
fields.JP: おし、じゃあそれぞれの役割は決まったな
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, then everyone's roles are set.

fields.EN:
Hehe. We'll make this place look like a
chateau by the time you get back.
fields.JP:
へへ、探索組のおまえたちが帰ってきたら
驚くようなキャンプにしてやるぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. We'll make this place look like a
chateau by the time you get back.

fields.EN:
Thank goodness you're here with us,
Mamoru. We are greatly indebted to your
survival skills.
fields.JP:
こんな時、サバイバルに強い
マモルがいてくれて本当によかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness you're here with us,
Mamoru. We are greatly indebted to your
survival skills.

fields.EN: Hm? What do you know about my skills?
fields.JP:
ん？　俺がこういうの得意だって、
おまえ知ってたっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? What do you know about my skills?

fields.EN:
You came to my aid with Hameln's Liberated
District. Ah, but that is a story from a
different life, isn't it?
fields.JP:
ハーメルン解放地区ではかなり世話になった……
って、そうかあれは別の世界か
fields.LOCALIZED:
You came to my aid with Hameln's Liberated
District. Ah, but that is a story from a
different life, isn't it?

fields.EN: Yeah. Mamoru saved us back then too.
fields.JP:
あの時はほんと、
マモルたちがいてくれてよかったよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Mamoru saved us back then too.

fields.EN:
Hameln's Liberated District? What an odd
name.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン解放地区？
なんだその面白そうな名前は
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln's Liberated District? What an odd
name.

fields.EN: Aye, a story for another time...
fields.JP: ああ、いやそれは別の記憶というか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Aye, a story for another time...

fields.EN:
It's a long one to boot. We'll have to tell it
to you sometime.
fields.JP:
話すと長くなりそうだし、
それはまた今度じっくりと話すよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a long one to boot. We'll have to tell it
to you sometime.

fields.EN:
Okay everyone, gather round. We need to
take care of Genocide Pink, and obviously
that big Jail thing.
fields.JP:
じゃあみんな、力を合わせて頑張ろう。
もちろん処刑台少女のことや、あの巨大な監獄塔……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay everyone, gather round. We need to
take care of Massacre Pink, and obviously
that big Jail thing.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
There's so much we don't know about the
surface, but that can wait until our survival's
ensured.
fields.JP:
この世界のことにしたって、色々と分からないこと
だらけだけど、まずは今を生き抜こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's so much we don't know about the
surface, but that can wait until our survival's
ensured.

fields.EN:
Yeah. We can't solve any mysteries on an
empty stomach.
fields.JP:
ああ、謎よりも目下のところは、
メシの方がずっと大事だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We can't solve any mysteries on an
empty stomach.

fields.JP: まずは僕たちが態勢を整える

fields.EN:
Then we'll find all our friends and make our
own little Liberated District.
fields.JP:
そしてみんなを探して、
また解放地区みたいにしようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we'll find all our friends and make our
own little Liberated District.

fields.JP:
あれ、視子さん、
神妙な顔してどうしたんですか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Well, I was worried about the other Blood
Maidens. Jack's not with them.
fields.JP:
いえ、他の血式少女たちには今、
ジャックがそばにいない。それが心配で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I was worried about the other Blood
Maidens. Jack's not with them.

fields.EN:
Ah. Without Jack's blood, they may enter
Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
そっか、ジャックの血がないと、
ブラッドスケルター化した時に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Without Jack's blood, they may enter
Blood Skelter mode.

fields.EN: Then we have to be quick about it.
fields.JP: それじゃあ、色々と急がなきゃいけないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Then we have to be quick about it.

fields.EN: All right, let's get right to exploring!
fields.JP: よし、じゃあ探索組はすぐに出かけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right, let's get right to exploring!

fields.EN:
(We need to find everyone as soon as we
can.)
fields.JP: （一刻も早くみんなを見つけないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need to find everyone as soon as we
can.)

fields.EN: Hey. Did you hear footsteps over there?
fields.JP: ねえ、今あっちの方で足音聞こえなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. Did you hear footsteps over there?

fields.JP: 本当だ、うっすらと聞こえた！

fields.EN: Maybe they're survivors! Come on, you two!
fields.JP:
きっと生き残った人だよ！
２人とも、行ってみよう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe they're survivors! Come on, you two!

fields.EN:
Hey, wasn't that the merchant back in
the underground Jail?
fields.JP:
あれ、あの人って確か、
地下のジェイルで会った商人のひと……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wasn't that the merchant back in
the underground Jail?

fields.EN:
Wait. I don't remember seeing him escape
with us. Was he hiding in the back?
fields.JP:
え、地上に上がる時見なかったけど、
あの商人、まさか僕たちと一緒に来てたのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. I don't remember seeing him escape
with us. Was he hiding in the back?

fields.EN: If he's up here, that might be the case.
fields.JP: ここにいるってことは、それしかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: If he's up here, that might be the case.

fields.EN: Hm...? Oh, a customer. Heehee. Well, hello.
fields.JP:
ん……？　おや、お客さんですね。
イッヒッヒッヒ、これはこれはいらっしゃいませ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm...? Oh, a customer. Heehee. Well, hello.

fields.EN:
Please take a look at my wares. I'm sure
something can be of use to you.
fields.JP:
さあさ、見てって下さい。
きっとお役に立つものがあると思いますよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please take a look at my wares. I'm sure
something can be of use to you.

fields.EN:
I'm glad you're safe, but now's not really
a good time!
fields.JP:
無事みたいでよかったですけど、
今はそれどころじゃないですって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you're safe, but now's not really
a good time!

fields.EN:
It's dangerous here! We need to get to
safety now!
fields.JP: ここは危険です、すぐに離れないと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's dangerous here! We need to get to
safety now!

fields.EN:
Our camp is just beyond this point.
I'm sure there aren't any Marchens.
fields.JP:
向こうに僕たちのキャンプがあるんだ。
そこならメルヒェンもほとんど来ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our camp is just beyond this point.
I'm sure there aren't any Marchens.

fields.EN: Heehee. Worry not for my sake.
fields.JP: イッヒッヒッヒ、私のことならご心配なく
fields.LOCALIZED: Heehee. Worry not for my sake.

fields.EN:
I am but a humble merchant, casting my
fate to the winds of this world. I make due
day by day.
fields.JP:
なんせ私は世を捨てた、ただの商人でございますから、
その日暮らしの放浪生活で充分
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am but a humble merchant, casting my
fate to the winds of this world. I make due
day by day.

fields.EN:
If my safety is a concern for you, then by
all means, browse my wares. Hehehe.
fields.JP:
お気遣い頂けるのであれば、
是非商品を買っていってくだせい。イッヒッヒ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If my safety is a concern for you, then by
all means, browse my wares. Hehehe.

fields.EN: Sorry, but now is not the time.
fields.JP: すまないが、今はそれどころじゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, but now is not the time.

fields.EN: We're kind of in a rush. Sorry.
fields.JP: 先を急いでるんで……ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: We're kind of in a rush. Sorry.

fields.EN:
I see. How unfortunate. Until next time
then. Hehehe.
fields.JP:
そうですか、それは残念。
ではまたご贔屓に……イッヒッヒッヒ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. How unfortunate. Until next time
then. Hehehe.

fields.EN:
Hey, where are you going?! Our camp is
that way!
fields.JP:
ちょっと、どこに行くんだ！？
僕たちのキャンプは安全なんだぞ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, where are you going?! Our camp is
that way!

fields.EN:
Does he really insist on going it alone?
I don't understand.
fields.JP:
そんなに独りでいたいのか……？
よく分からない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does he really insist on going it alone?
I don't understand.

fields.EN:
I'm worried about him. Let's try convincing
him.
fields.JP:
やっぱり心配だよ。
もう一度説得してみようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm worried about him. Let's try convincing
him.

fields.JP: そうだね。よし、追いかけよう

fields.EN: Wait. He was just here, now he's gone.
fields.JP: あれ？　こっちに行ったはずなのに、いない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. He was just here, now he's gone.

fields.JP: 完全に見失ってしまったみたいだね

fields.EN: I don't hear his footsteps either.
fields.JP: 足音も全然聞こえなくなっちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't hear his footsteps either.

fields.EN:
Well, he was always wandering the Jail.
He'll be fine...I think.
fields.JP:
まあ、前もジェイルの中を放浪してた人だから、
きっと大丈夫……だと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, he was always wandering the Jail.
He'll be fine...I think.

fields.EN:
(He was already creepy enough, but now
he's happily exploring this labyrinth...)
fields.JP:
（前もちょっと不気味な感じだったけど、
　こんな場所に来ても変わらずにいるなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He was already creepy enough, but now
he's happily exploring this labyrinth...)

fields.EN: (He might be even creepier than I thought.)
fields.JP: （あの商人さんの方がよっぽど怖いかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (He might be even creepier than I thought.)

fields.EN:
Fine. Next time we see him, we will try our
best to persuade him.
fields.JP:
しょうがない、次に会ったら、
もう一度説得してみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine. Next time we see him, we will try our
best to persuade him.

fields.JP: そうだね。じゃあ、先に進もうか

fields.EN:
Princess, surely you feel some fatigue from
how long we've explored?
fields.JP:
だいぶ探索したけど、
姫、疲れてないかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, surely you feel some fatigue from
how long we've explored?

fields.JP: わたしはまだまだ平気だよ、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Please inform me if anything changes.
I would gladly carry you around.
fields.JP:
疲れたらいつでも仰って下さい。
僕が抱きかかえてお連れいたしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please inform me if anything changes.
I would gladly carry you around.

fields.EN:
If push comes to shove, sure, but then you
wouldn't be able to do anything.
fields.JP:
そんなことしたら
いざって時に身動きが取れないでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If push comes to shove, sure, but then you
wouldn't be able to do anything.

fields.EN:
Worry not. Protecting you is my utmost
priority.
fields.JP: 大丈夫さ。何があっても姫は守るから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worry not. Protecting you is my utmost
priority.

fields.JP: もう、おつうちゃんてば
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: This place. It truly is...a Jail.
fields.JP: やっぱり……ここはジェイルなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: This place. It truly is...a Jail.

fields.JP: どうしたんだい、ジャック？

fields.EN:
After walking all over this place, I got to
thinking about how there are Nightmares
and Marchens here.
fields.JP:
歩き回ってみて思うんだけどさ、
ここにはナイトメアやメルヒェンがいるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
After walking all over this place, I got to
thinking about how there are Nightmares
and Marchens here.

fields.EN:
The whole place. How it looks, how it
functions. Don't you think it's a lot like
the Jail?
fields.JP:
そして見たことのあるような、この場所の構造や挙動。
とてもジェイルに似てると思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The whole place. How it looks, how it
functions. Don't you think it's a lot like
the Jail?

fields.JP: 確かにそっくりだよね

fields.EN:
Though it pains me to admit it, it seems
we've entered the Jail's captivity once more.
fields.JP:
あまり認めたくはないけど、
つまり僕達はジェイルに逆戻りしたってわけか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though it pains me to admit it, it seems
we've entered the Jail's captivity once more.

fields.EN:
Makes sense as to why our expedition
hasn't been smooth.
fields.JP: それじゃ、探索がはかどらなくて当然だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Makes sense as to why our expedition
hasn't been smooth.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Those Nightmares are a hassle. Even
when we want to progress, we're forced to
change paths.
fields.JP:
ああ。ナイトメアが厄介すぎる。
先に進みたくても、進路変更を余儀なくされるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Those Nightmares are a hassle. Even
when we want to progress, we're forced to
change paths.

fields.EN:
But there's hope. If this is a Jail, there has
to be a core.
fields.JP:
でも、希望はある。
ここがジェイルだっていうのなら核もあるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's hope. If this is a Jail, there has
to be a core.

fields.EN: If we can destroy the core, it'll be safer and much easier to explore!
fields.JP:
もしも核を破壊できたら、安全にもなるし、
探索もずっとしやすくなるよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we destroy the core, then it will make
exploring much easier!

fields.EN:
Danger may find us, but we will find the
core first!
fields.JP: それじゃあ危険だけど、核も探していこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Danger may find us, but we will find the
core first!

fields.EN: Someone's over there! Must be a survivor!
fields.JP:
２人とも、あそこに誰かいる！
きっと生き残った人だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Someone's over there! Must be a survivor!

fields.JP: ジャック、行っちゃダメだ！

fields.EN:
(Tsuu? Why are you covering my mouth?
We just found someone―)
fields.JP:
（つう？　どうして僕の口を塞ぐの？
　せっかく人を見つけたのに――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Otsuu? Why are you covering my mouth?
We just found someone―)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(Wait, is that Guillotine from Genocide Pink?!
What is she doing here?!)
fields.JP:
（って、あれは処刑台少女のギロチン……！？
　どうしてここに……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, is that Guillotine from Massacre Pink?!
What is she doing here?!)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Hmph. Not around here either.
Ugh. This is proving to be a headache.
fields.JP:
ふん、この辺にもいませんか。
まったく、面倒な話です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. Not around here either.
Ugh. This is proving to be a headache.

fields.EN:
Don't move, you two. Let's hide. Don't make
any noise.
fields.JP:
２人とも、動かずにじっと隠れてやり過ごそう。
物音を立てないようにするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't move, you two. Let's hide. Don't make
any noise.

fields.EN: Looks like she's looking for something.
fields.JP: 何かを探してるみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like she's looking for something.

fields.EN:
Princess! Don't poke your head out!
Hide behind me.
fields.JP:
姫、顔を出しちゃダメだ！
僕の後ろに隠れてて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess! Don't poke your head out!
Hide behind me.

fields.EN:
This mission should've been a cake walk,
if my sisters weren't so useless...
fields.JP:
簡単な任務のはずだったのに、
妹たちが無能なせいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This mission should've been a cake walk,
if my sisters weren't so useless...

fields.EN: Let us pray she doesn't cross our path.
fields.JP:
とにかく今は、
こっちに来ないことを願うしかない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Let us pray she doesn't cross our path.

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Hmph. I'm sure I'll find them soon.
fields.JP: まあ、すぐに見つけられるでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph. I'm sure I'll find them soon.

fields.EN: I'm so relieved she passed us.
fields.JP: こっちに来なくてよかったね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so relieved she passed us.

fields.JP: うん。生きた心地がしなかったよ

fields.EN:
S-sorry Jack! I didn't realize I was still
covering your mouth!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんジャック！
君の口、塞いだままだった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-sorry Jack! I didn't realize I was still
covering your mouth!

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... Don't worry. I'm glad you
stopped me.
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁっ……いや大丈夫、気にしないで。
むしろ止めてくれて助かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... Don't worry. I'm glad you
stopped me.

fields.EN:
But why is Guillotine here? She's worse
than a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
それにしても、どうしてこんなところに
ナイトメアより厄介なあのギロチンがいるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But why is Guillotine here? She's worse
than a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Do you think she's lost and looking for
her sisters too?
fields.JP:
もしかして、ギロチンも迷ってて、
他の処刑台少女と合流しようとしてるのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think she's lost and looking for
her sisters too?

fields.EN:
Are you suggesting that Hikari managed
to warp Guillotine here too?
fields.JP:
ギロチンたちもヒカリの力で
一緒にワープさせられたってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you suggesting that Hikari managed
to warp Guillotine here too?

fields.EN:
I don't think so. We were the only ones
who were wrapped in that light.
fields.JP:
それは違うと思う。あの時、光に包まれて
浮かんでいたのは僕たちだけだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think so. We were the only ones
who were wrapped in that light.

fields.EN: That light was the only way out of there.
fields.JP: あれがワープをする人の選別だったと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: That light was the only way out of there.

fields.EN:
Which means Guillotine came here on her
own accord.
fields.JP:
ってことは、ギロチンたちは自力で
ここまでやって来たってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means Guillotine came here on her
own accord.

fields.JP: そういうことになる……のかな
じゃあ目的はわたしたち？

fields.EN:
Maybe. Regardless, it would be better for
us to steer clear.
fields.JP:
かもしれないね。どっちにしろ、
遭遇するのはマズイってことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe. Regardless, it would be better for
us to steer clear.

fields.EN:
We should flee this area at the soonest
opportunity.
fields.JP: ともかく、早くここから離れるべきだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should flee this area at the soonest
opportunity.

fields.EN:
Right. If anyone else from Genocide Pink
shows up, we're done for.
fields.JP:
そうだね……他の処刑台少女もいたら、
それこそ終わりだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. If anyone else from Massacre Pink
shows up, we're done for.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(Tsuu's started to clutch her hands from
shaking.)
fields.JP:
（つう、手を押さえて
　震えを見せないようにしてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Otsuu's started to clutch her hands from
shaking.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: （人魚姫さんも、どこか怯えた瞳の色だ）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Guillotine nearly killed the both of them.
I can only imagine how terrified they must
be.)
fields.JP:
（２人ともギロチンに殺されかけたことで、
　処刑台少女たちを恐れているみたいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guillotine nearly killed the both of them.
I can only imagine how terrified they must
be.)

fields.EN: (We need to go on the search even more.)
fields.JP: （これはますます、早く探索しないとな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (We need to go on the search even more.)

fields.EN: Yes. Now we can defeat the Nightmare!
fields.JP: やった、これでナイトメアを倒すことができる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. Now we can defeat the Nightmare!

fields.JP:
待って、おつうちゃん！
何かいる！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: やっぱり番人がいたか……！

fields.EN: Looks like we have no choice but to fight.
fields.JP: 戦うしかないみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like we have no choice but to fight.

fields.EN:
My princess, let us strike them down with
one blow. Jack, stand back.
fields.JP:
姫、一気に勝負を決めよう。
ジャックは下がっててくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My princess, let us strike them down with
one blow. Jack, stand back.

fields.JP: ふぅ、終わったみたいだね

fields.EN:
As if the similarities weren't enough, this
Jail has a guardian too.
fields.JP:
番人がいるところまで
地下のジェイルに似なくていいのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As if the similarities weren't enough, this
Jail has a guardian too.

fields.EN:
Seriously. Thankfully our experience with
that dingy prison has benefitted us.
fields.JP:
まったくだよ。でもおかげで、
地下ジェイルの経験を生かせるけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. Thankfully our experience with
that dingy prison has benefitted us.

fields.EN: Nice work, you two. Are you hurt at all?
fields.JP:
２人とも、お疲れさま。
怪我はない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice work, you two. Are you hurt at all?

fields.JP: わたしたちは大丈夫だよ、ジャックさん
