fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
That's good. Now let's destroy the core
quickly.
fields.JP: よかった。それじゃあ早速、核を破壊しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's good. Now let's destroy the core
quickly.

fields.EN: I'll do it. Stand back, you two.
fields.JP:
僕がやろう。
念のため２人とも離れていてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll do it. Stand back, you two.

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN: We destroyed the core, then it started yelping.
fields.JP:
やっぱり核を破壊してこういう声が
出るってことは……
fields.LOCALIZED: We destroyed the core, then it started yelping.

fields.EN: Yup. We're definitely in a Jail.
fields.JP: うん、確実にここはジェイルだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. We're definitely in a Jail.

fields.EN:
All that time spent trying to escape and here
we are. On the surface, trying to escape.
fields.JP:
ようやく地上に出たのに、
また脱獄を目指すなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that time spent trying to escape and here
we are. On the surface, trying to escape.

fields.EN: I never wanted to go through this again.
fields.JP:
もう二度とごめんだって
思ってたんだけどなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I never wanted to go through this again.

fields.EN:
Still, we're making progress. The only way
through is forward.
fields.JP:
でも少しずつだけど、僕たちは先に進めているよ。
一歩ずつでも頑張っていこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, we're making progress. The only way
through is forward.

fields.EN:
Too right. If we keep at it, fate will be kind
to us. Let's take it into our own hands!
fields.JP:
そうだね。頑張ればいつかは終わる。
今度こそ掴み取ろう…！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too right. If we keep at it, fate will be kind
to us. Let's take it into our own hands!

fields.EN:
(Even though there's that huge Jail thing,
so maybe we've got a long way to go.)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、あの大きな監獄塔もあるから、
　これで最後じゃないかもしれないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even though there's that huge Jail thing,
so maybe we've got a long way to go.)

fields.JP: 辺りが暗くなってきた……！

fields.EN:
Tsuu, Ningyohime-san, you two are the only
ones who can fight. You sure you're good?
fields.JP:
戦えるのはつうと人魚姫さんだけだけど、
本当に挑むんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, Little Mermaid, you two are the only
ones who can fight. You sure you're good?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yes. Our hope of finding our scattered
comrades means defeating it here and now.
fields.JP:
ああ。一刻も早くみんなを探すためには、
今ここで倒すしかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Our hope of finding our scattered
comrades means defeating it here and now.

fields.EN:
The longer we take, the harder finding our
friends becomes.
fields.JP:
バラバラになっているわたしたちは、
時間をかけるだけ不利になっていくしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The longer we take, the harder finding our
friends becomes.

fields.EN:
(She's right. Not only do we have the
Nightmare, but Guillotine too. Let's not
make things harder for ourselves.)
fields.JP:
（確かにナイトメアもギロチンもいる状況だ、
　今のうちに叩いておくべきかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right. Not only do we have the
Nightmare, but Guillotine too. Let's not
make things harder for ourselves.)

fields.EN: Got it! Just don't overdo it!
fields.JP: 分かった！　でも絶対に無理はしないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it! Just don't overdo it!

fields.EN:
(Who's responsible for making these
Nightmares so damn creepy?)
fields.JP:
（それにどうしてどこのナイトメアも、
　こうも異形で不気味な存在なんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Who's responsible for making these
Nightmares so damn creepy?)

fields.EN:
(Even when I was a Nightmare, I was an
abomination.)
fields.JP:
（僕がナイトメアだった時も、
　形は違えど最悪の見た目だったし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even when I was a Nightmare, I was an
abomination.)

fields.JP: ゴァァ……アアアアアアア……ッ！

fields.EN:
You...can understand us? We don't want
to fight you―
fields.JP:
君……僕たちの言葉わかるよね？
不要な戦いを僕たちは望んでないん――
fields.LOCALIZED:
You...can understand us? We don't want
to fight you―

fields.EN:
Aah! Maybe trying to chat with it was a
little optimistic. Guess we can't.
fields.JP:
……っ！
ほんの少しだけ、意思疎通できるのを
期待してたけど……無理みたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah! Maybe trying to chat with it was a
little optimistic. Guess we can't.

fields.EN: Yes. It seems bent on killing us.
fields.JP: ああ、僕たちを殺す気まんまんって感じだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. It seems bent on killing us.

fields.EN:
Princess, it's just us two. We cannot waste
a single precious minute.
fields.JP:
姫。僕たちは２人だけだから、
長引かせたら一気に不利になる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, it's just us two. We cannot waste
a single precious minute.

fields.EN: Let's put an end to this here and now.
fields.JP: だからなるべく短期決戦でいこう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's put an end to this here and now.

fields.JP:
分かった、おつうちゃん。
絶対に勝とうね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Of course. On my lead, Princess.
Brace yourself!
fields.JP:
もちろんさ。さあ奴が来るよ、姫。
気を引きしめていこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. On my lead, Princess.
Brace yourself!

fields.EN: All right. We destroyed part of it!
fields.JP: よし、部位を破壊できた！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right. We destroyed part of it!

fields.EN: Now that the core's gone, it's vulnerable!
fields.JP:
やっぱり核を破壊したから、
不死性も消えてるみたいだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now that the core's gone, it's vulnerable!

fields.EN: Yes! Now we can defeat it!
fields.JP: ああ、これなら倒せるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes! Now we can defeat it!

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, the Nightmare's weakened.
Now's our chance!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、ナイトメアが弱っている
今のうちに一気に決めちゃおうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, the Nightmare's weakened.
Now's our chance!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Yes Princess! We shall strike at this moment!
fields.JP:
了解だ、姫！
このチャンス確実にものにする！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes Princess! We shall strike at this moment!

fields.JP: だからジャック、援護は頼んだよ！

fields.EN: Leave it to me! Let's defeat it!
fields.JP: 任せて！　必ず仕留めよう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Leave it to me! Let's defeat it!

fields.JP: 見て、闇が晴れていくよ

fields.EN:
This feeling... Seems like we were doing
this just yesterday.
fields.JP:
この光景……そんな前じゃないのに、
何だか少し懐かしい感じがするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This feeling... Seems like we were doing
this just yesterday.

fields.EN:
Okay everyone, now we can locate the others
in peace.
fields.JP: さあ、これで他のみんなを安心して探せるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay everyone, now we can locate the others
in peace.

fields.EN: Oh, did someone turn on a light in here...?
fields.JP: おや、ナイトメアの闇が晴れた……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, did someone turn on a light in here...?

fields.EN:
Do we have guests? What a surprise.
A wonderful one at that.
fields.JP:
もしかして誰か、いるんでしょうか。
気になりますね。ええ、気になりますとも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do we have guests? What a surprise.
A wonderful one at that.

fields.JP: まずい、ギロチンの奴に気づかれた……！

fields.EN:
I didn't know she was so close!
What do we do?
fields.JP:
こんな近くにいたなんて……！
ど、どうしよう……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know she was so close!
What do we do?

fields.EN: This way, you two. Let's go around her.
fields.JP:
２人とも、道はまだ奥に続いてるから、
そっちに逃げよう
fields.LOCALIZED: This way, you two. Let's go around her.

fields.JP:
わ、分かった。
さあ姫、行こう
足音が聞こえた！　走って！

fields.EN:
*pant, pant* All right. Seems we've eluded
Guillotine.
fields.JP:
はぁっ……はぁっ……
よし、ギロチンは追ってきてないみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant* All right. Seems we've eluded
Guillotine.

fields.EN:
Really? Thank goodness. I couldn't run
anymore.
fields.JP:
本当……？
よかった、もう走るの、限界だった、から
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Thank goodness. I couldn't run
anymore.

fields.EN: She was distracted inspecting that Nightmare.
fields.JP:
どうやら、ナイトメアのいた辺りを
確認して引き返したみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED: She was distracted inspecting that Nightmare.

fields.JP: やっぱり誰かを探してるみたいだな

fields.EN:
Maybe she's looking to finish the job on
some victims she missed out on...
fields.JP:
もしかして殺し損ねた人たちを
探して回っているのかも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she's looking to finish the job on
some victims she missed out on...

fields.EN:
Maybe, maybe not. For now her motives
are unknown to us.
fields.JP:
そうかもしれないし、そうじゃないかもしれない。
目的ははっきりとは分からないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe, maybe not. For now her motives
are unknown to us.

fields.EN: In any case, we should avoid her.
fields.JP: とにかく、絶対に遭遇しないようにしよう
fields.LOCALIZED: In any case, we should avoid her.

fields.EN: She doesn't realize it's us, does she?
fields.JP: わたしたちだって、感づかれてないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: She doesn't realize it's us, does she?

fields.EN:
Perhaps not, Princess. If she did, then
surely she would have pursued us.
fields.JP:
それは大丈夫だと思うよ、姫。
もしバレていたら、目の色変えて追ってくるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps not, Princess. If she did, then
surely she would have pursued us.

fields.EN:
Let's do our best to evade her detection.
Were it up to me, I'd never see her again―
fields.JP:
とにかく見つからずにやり過ごそう。
はっきり言って二度と会いたくない――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's do our best to evade her detection.
Were it up to me, I'd never see her again―

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: What's wrong, Jack? Wait, what's that?
fields.JP:
どうしたんだいジャック、いきなり……
……って、何だこれ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's wrong, Jack? Wait, what's that?

fields.JP: 光る……球体？　宙に浮いてるね

fields.EN: It's enormous. We could fit right in.
fields.JP:
しかも大きいな。
中に僕らが丸ごと納まりそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's enormous. We could fit right in.

fields.EN:
What is it? I've never come across one of
these in the other Jail.
fields.JP:
何だろう……。
こんなの今までのジェイルで見たことない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is it? I've never come across one of
these in the other Jail.

fields.EN:
I wonder if it's unique to this surface Jail.
We can't just ignore it.
fields.JP:
地上のジェイル、オリジナルのものか。
さすがに、調べないわけにはいかないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if it's unique to this surface Jail.
We can't just ignore it.

fields.EN:
It's no ordinary orb though. Interacting
with it could be costly.
fields.JP:
けど、ただの光じゃなさそうだし、
迂闊に触るのも危険だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no ordinary orb though. Interacting
with it could be costly.

fields.EN: Why don't we toss a rock inside?
fields.JP: じゃあこの石を投げて様子を見て見ようか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we toss a rock inside?

fields.JP: ジャック、気をつけてくれ

fields.EN: I'll be careful. Here I go... Yah!
fields.JP:
油断しないようにするよ。
じゃ、いくよ……せーの！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be careful. Here I go... Yah!

fields.EN:
It engulfed the rock. Did you hear it fall
on the other side?
fields.JP:
石を吸い込んでいったけど……
何か落ちる音とか鳴ったかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It engulfed the rock. Did you hear it fall
on the other side?

fields.EN:
Then we have no choice but to enter it
ourselves.
fields.JP:
こうなると、直に触れるわけには
いかなくなっちゃったね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we have no choice but to enter it
ourselves.

fields.EN:
Another mystery. A brilliant orb.
Use caution, my lady.
fields.JP:
また分からないことが増えたな。
光の球体……不気味すぎる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another mystery. A brilliant orb.
Use caution, my lady.

fields.EN:
Keep a mental note that it's here, but we
should move on for now.
fields.JP:
ねえ、この場所を覚えた上で、
ひとまず迂回して進むっていうのはどうかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep a mental note that it's here, but we
should move on for now.

fields.EN:
Right. Good idea. We don't have the time to
investigate this right now.
fields.JP:
そうだね……それがいいかも。
今は調査している余裕もないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Good idea. We don't have the time to
investigate this right now.

fields.EN: We'll be sure to return. Let's go.
fields.JP:
じゃあ改めてここに来るってことで、
今は先に進もうか
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll be sure to return. Let's go.

fields.EN:
You guys, time for dinner. Wash your
hands. Let's dig in!
fields.JP:
みんな、ごはんですよー。
はい、てをあらって、いただきまーす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You guys, time for dinner. Wash your
hands. Let's dig in!

fields.EN: Darling Clara, what are you playing with?
fields.JP:
くららや。
さっきから何で遊んでるんだい
fields.LOCALIZED: Darling Clara, what are you playing with?

fields.EN: I'm playing house! I'm the mother!
fields.JP:
おままごと！
くららがおかーさんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm playing house! I'm the mother!

fields.EN:
Is that so? Playing house won't put food
on the table.
fields.JP:
そうかい。でも、おままごとなんてもんは、
飯を食うのに何の役にも立ちゃあしないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that so? Playing house won't put food
on the table.

fields.EN:
If you want to play, why don't you play
something that will be of use to you?
fields.JP:
どうせ遊ぶんだったら、もっと自分の
身になる事をして遊ぶんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to play, why don't you play
something that will be of use to you?

fields.JP: ばーちゃん、“みになること”って？

fields.EN:
I'm telling you to learn practical skills.
If you become useful for others, it will
empower you.
fields.JP:
手に職をつけろってことだよ。
役に立つ技術を身に着ければ、
それは自分にとっての力になる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm telling you to learn practical skills.
If you become useful for others, it will
empower you.

fields.EN:
When you grow up, Clara, you'll never
struggle for food.
fields.JP:
くららが大人になった時に、
食うのには困らなくなるってわけさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you grow up, Clara, you'll never
struggle for food.

fields.EN:
Here, take this screwdriver. I'll teach
you to assemble this junk. First, we find
a screw to fit this hole.
fields.JP:
ほら、おまえに、このドライバーをやろう。
ガラクタの直し方を教えてやるよ。
まずは、この穴に合うネジを選んで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, take this screwdriver. I'll teach
you to assemble this junk. First, we find
a screw to fit this hole.

fields.EN:
Okay. I'll give it a shot!
Is this a screw? Twisty twisty~ ♪
Ahaha. This is fun!
fields.JP:
うん、やってみる！
ねじって、これかな？　くるくる～♪
あははっ、こっちもたのしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. I'll give it a shot!
Is this a screw? Twisty twisty~ ♪
Ahaha. This is fun!

fields.EN:
Thattagirl. This is your playtime now.
Make yourself useful, and you'll never
be alone.
fields.JP:
そうそう、そうやって遊びながら学びな。
手に職をつけときゃ安心さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thattagirl. This is your playtime now.
Make yourself useful, and you'll never
be alone.

fields.EN:
Listen to me, Clara. Even when things get
tough, you have to make sure you eat.
fields.JP:
いいかい、くらら。
もしも困ったり、どうしようもなくなった時は、
なんでもいいからまずは食べるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen to me, Clara. Even when things get
tough, you have to make sure you eat.

fields.EN:
When your stomach's full, you can think,
which means acting quickly. In the end,
that'll keep you alive. Do you understand?
fields.JP:
腹を満たし、考えて、自分の力を理解し動くんだ。
それが結果的におまえを助けてくれる。
わかったかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
When your stomach's full, you can think,
which means acting quickly. In the end,
that'll keep you alive. Do you understand?

fields.JP:
ひっく……ひぐ……
父ちゃん、母ちゃん……婆ちゃん……

fields.EN:
Why did the Marchens take you...?
I'm so lonely... *sniff*...
fields.JP:
なんでメルヒェンに連れてかれちゃったの……
１人じゃ寂しいよぉ……ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did the Marchens take you...?
I'm so lonely... *sniff*...

fields.EN:
*hiccup* Aww, Grandma... Teach me.
I don't know what to do.
fields.JP:
うぐっ、ううっ……婆ちゃん、教えてよぉ。
どうしたらいいか、全然わかんない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*hiccup* Aww, Grandma... Teach me.
I don't know what to do.

fields.EN: *sniff* I'm hungry... It's been two days.
fields.JP:
ぐすっ……お腹すいたなぁ。
あれから２日も経ってたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: *sniff* I'm hungry... It's been two days.

fields.EN:
I need to eat something or I'll pass out...
There's no one here.
fields.JP:
このまま食べなかったら、死んじゃうのかな。
誰にも会えないままで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I need to eat something or I'll pass out...
There's no one here.

fields.EN:
Listen to me, Clara. Even when things get
tough, you have to make sure you eat.
fields.JP:
いいかい、くらら。
もしも困ったり、どうしようもなくなった時は、
なんでもいいからまずは食べるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen to me, Clara. Even when things get
tough, you have to make sure you eat.

fields.EN:
When your stomach's full, you can think,
which means acting quickly. In the end,
that'll keep you alive. Do you understand?
fields.JP:
腹を満たし、考えて、そして動くんだ。
それが結果的におまえを助けてくれる。
わかったかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
When your stomach's full, you can think,
which means acting quickly. In the end,
that'll keep you alive. Do you understand?

fields.EN:
...Right. You're absolutely right.
I'll do what you said!
fields.JP:
……うん、そうだね。
婆ちゃんの言う通りにする！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Right. You're absolutely right.
I'll do what you said!

fields.EN:
I gotta wake up. Then, no matter what,
I have to find something to eat!
fields.JP:
起きなきゃ……そんで、何が何でも
ご飯、見つけて食べなくちゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gotta wake up. Then, no matter what,
I have to find something to eat!

fields.EN:
I have to eat, and thank...*sniff*...
Grandma, mm...
fields.JP:
食べて、考えなきゃ、う…うう……
婆ちゃ…ん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have to eat, and thank...*sniff*...
Grandma, mm...

fields.EN:
Oh? Huh...?
When did I fall asleep?
fields.JP:
あ？　あ、れ……？
自分、いつの間に寝て…？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Huh...?
When did I fall asleep?

fields.EN:
Thank goodness! You're awake!
I was so scared.
fields.JP:
あっ、良かった！　気がついたんだね！
ほんとに、ハラハラしたんだよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness! You're awake!
I was so scared.

fields.EN:
Whoa! I-Is that a goddess before my own
eyes?!
fields.JP: ふわぁっ！　め、女神様が目の前に！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! I-Is that a goddess before my own
eyes?!

fields.EN:
Huh?! I'm not in pain. H-How?!
I think Genocide Pink got me back there.
fields.JP:
あれっ？　痛くない。な、なんで？
自分、確か処刑台少女とかいう連中に、
派手にやられたはずじゃ…
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh?! I'm not in pain. H-How?!
I think Massacre Pink got me back there.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Looks like someone treated you, but I was
able to heal you. I'm so relieved.
fields.JP:
元々誰かが治療してくれてたみたいだけど、
私の力で全快させたの。　治ってよかったよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like someone treated you, but I was
able to heal you. I'm so relieved.

fields.EN:
Ohhh, you're right. My wounds are all
healed. You're a goddess!
fields.JP:
お、おおっ、マジであの怪我が治ってるっす！
さっすが女神様っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohhh, you're right. My wounds are all
healed. You're a goddess!

fields.EN: Hehe. You make me blush. Just call me Hikari.
fields.JP:
へへ、女神様だなんて照れるよ
ヒカリでいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You make me blush. Just call me Hikari.

fields.EN:
(She looks just like a goddess. But more
approachable. Almost like a friend.)
fields.JP:
（今まで神々しいイメージだったすけど、
　友達みたいに接しやすい人っすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks just like a goddess. But more
approachable. Almost like a friend.)

fields.EN: Hey, wait. Where'd my cloth go?
fields.JP:
って、あれ？
この腕に巻いてあるのって、ひょっとして
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, wait. Where'd my cloth go?

fields.EN:
Oh, this cloth? You were holding it so carefully,
Clara-chan, so I wrapped it around the scar.
fields.JP:
あ、この布ね。
くららちゃんが大事そうに持ってたから、
傷跡を隠すのに巻いてみたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, this? You gripped it so tight, so I
wrapped it around your wound.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
This is my boss's―Err, I mean Haru-san's―tie.
Have you seen him?!
fields.JP:
これ、師匠のネクタイっす。
あ、あの、師匠……
血式武器製造士のハルさんを見なかったっすか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my boss's―Err, I mean Haru's―tie.
Have you seen him?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Sorry, I don't know who that is. At least not
in this eastern area. I scattered everyone
randomly.
fields.JP:
ごめん、その人のことは分からない。
少なくともここらへんにはいなそう……。
咄嗟のテレポートでみんなを飛ばしちゃったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, I don't know who that is. At least not
in this eastern area. I scattered everyone
randomly.

fields.EN: Besides, I actually only woke up about twenty minutes ago, so I still don't have the full picture. I've been treating you ever since...
fields.JP:
それに私も、じつは２０分くらい前に
起きたばかりで、全部把握しきれてないんだ。
そのあと、ずっと治療をしてたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I only awoke about twenty minutes
ago, so I've yet to scan the area. I've spent
this time healing you.

fields.EN:
HEEEEY!
We don't have the time for this!
fields.JP:
あーーーーーっ！
って、それどころじゃないんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HEEEEY!
We don't have the time for this!

fields.JP: ぬぉっ！？　な、なんなんっすか！？

fields.EN:
Oh no! Oh no, oh no! This is no good!
You need to find the Blood Maidens and
purify them!
fields.JP:
たたた、大変っ！　たいへんなのっ！
今すぐ血式少女のいる場所に行って、
浄化しないとっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no! Oh no, oh no! This is no good!
You need to find the Blood Maidens and
purify them!

fields.EN:
While I treated you, I used my clairvoyance
to check on everyone, and I saw some people
in a bind!
fields.JP:
さっき治療しながら、
『千里眼』でみんなの様子を見てたら、
大変な事になってる人たちがいて、そのっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
While I treated you, I used my clairvoyance
to check on everyone, and I saw some people
in a bind!

fields.EN:
Oh, shoot, what do we do?! This isn't good!
Clara-chan, please save them!
fields.JP:
あっ、あっ、どうしよう！
このままじゃ、まずいっ！
おねがい、くららちゃん、助けて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, shoot, what do we do?! This isn't good!
Clara, please save them!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.EN:
What? Purify? Oh, no no no, I can't!
I'm just a craftsman's assistant!
fields.JP:
えっ、じょ、浄化？
いやいやいや、無理っすよ！
自分、ただの製造士の助手兼、元店番なんで！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Purify? Oh, no no no, I can't!
I'm just a craftsman's assistant!

fields.EN:
Then don't worry! I noticed while I treated
you earlier.
fields.JP:
あ、それなら大丈夫！
さっき、手当てをしてて気付いたんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then don't worry! I noticed while I treated
you earlier.

fields.EN:
Clara-chan, your body somehow contains Jack's
purification power! I don't know why!
fields.JP:
くららちゃんの身体には、なんと！
なんでかは知らないけど、
ジャックの浄化の力が宿ってたんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't explain it exactly! But you have the
same power as Jack to heal.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
So please! Save them!
Everyone's in trouble!
fields.JP:
だから、お願い！　助けて！
みんな、ピンチ、困ってるから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So please! Save them!
Everyone's in trouble!

fields.EN:
What? I have the same powers as Jack-san?
No no, you've gotta be kidding me!
That doesn't make sense!
fields.JP:
ふへっ！？　自分に、ジャックさんと同じ力が？
いやいや、何の冗談っすか！
さ、さっぱり分からないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? I have the same powers as Jack?
No no, you've gotta be kidding me!
That doesn't make sense!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Oh, sorry. That was confusing, wasn't it?
fields.JP:
あっ！　ご、ごめんね。
今のだとぜんぜんわかんないよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, sorry. That was confusing, wasn't it?

fields.EN: Aww. I need to calm down!
fields.JP: う～、落ち着け落ち着け、私！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aww. I need to calm down!

fields.EN:
(Huh? She's a little less regal than I took
her for.)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　なんか地上に行く時よりも、
　威厳が減ってないっすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? She's a little less regal than I took
her for.)

fields.JP:
すーっ、はーっ、すーっ、はーっ。
うん、落ち着いた

fields.EN:
Sorry for almost losing it. Let me start
from the beginning.
fields.JP:
と、取り乱しちゃってごめんね。
今、ちゃんと説明するから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for almost losing it. Let me start
from the beginning.

fields.JP: は、はい、よろしくお願いするっす！

fields.EN:
Currently, everyone was teleported to
different places following our skirmish
with Genocide Pink.
fields.JP:
今みんなは、処刑台少女達との戦いで、
散り散りバラバラになってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Currently, everyone was teleported to
different places following our skirmish
with Massacre Pink.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
So I used my clairvoyance to identify where
they are.
fields.JP:
私の能力の『千里眼』で、
みんなの居場所を探し始めたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I used my clairvoyance to identify where
they are.

fields.EN:
One girl especially looked to be in trouble.
You need to hurry, or she won't make it.
fields.JP:
すごいピンチ状態になってる子がいたの。
早く助けないと、大惨事になっちゃう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
One girl especially looked to be in trouble.
You need to hurry, or she won't make it.

fields.EN:
Clara-chan, I'm going to send you there so that
you can save her.
fields.JP:
だから、くららちゃんをそこへテレポートするから
助けてあげてほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, I'm going to send you there so that
you can save her.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.EN:
But how do you expect me to do that?
What can I do?
fields.JP:
で、でも、助けるって、
自分が行って、どうするんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But how do you expect me to do that?
What can I do?

fields.EN: I build things with my hands. I'm no fighter.
fields.JP:
自分は、物作りは出来ても、
戦う力なんて何ひとつ持って無いっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I build things with my hands. I'm no fighter.

fields.EN:
As I said earlier Clara-chan, somehow you've
gained the same healing powers as Jack.
You can purify like the Blood Youths.
fields.JP:
さっきも言ったけど、今のくららちゃんには、
なぜか分からないけどジャックと同じ
『血式少年』の浄化の力が宿ってるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As I said earlier Clara, somehow you've
gained the same healing powers as Jack.
You can purify like the Blood Youths.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.EN: Wait, you weren't joking? I can purify now...?
fields.JP:
えっ、それ、マ、マジだったんですか。
自分に、浄化の力が……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait, you weren't joking? I can purify now...?

fields.JP: えええ……と言われてもっす

fields.EN:
I know this is a lot of information, try to
keep up.
fields.JP: いきなりすぎて理解が追いつかないかもだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know this is a lot of information, try to
keep up.

fields.EN:
At this point, you're the only one who can
save them, Clara-chan.
fields.JP:
今この場で助けに行けるのは、
くららちゃん……あなたしかいないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this point, you're the only one who can
save them, Clara.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.JP: みんなを助けられるのが、自分だけ……

fields.EN:
One girl has become berserk from corruption.
She may soon harm her friends.
fields.JP:
穢れて暴走してる子がいるの
このままだと、仲間同士で傷つけ合っちゃう
fields.LOCALIZED:
One girl has become berserk from corruption.
She may soon harm her friends.

fields.EN:
I want you to purify her before things
worsen.
fields.JP:
その子を浄化さえしてしまえば、
もう大丈夫だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want you to purify her before things
worsen.

fields.EN:
We could wait for Jack's return, but there's
no telling when that'll be.
fields.JP:
探索に出てるジャックが戻るのを待って
行ってもらってもいいんだけど、
いつ戻ってくるか分からないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We could wait for Jack's return, but there's
no telling when that'll be.

fields.EN:
(If we wait for Jack-san, then someone could
get hurt. I couldn't live that down...)
fields.JP:
（でも、ジャックさんが戻るまでに、
　誰かがやられたら、絶対後悔しそうっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we wait for Jack, then someone could
get hurt. I couldn't live that down...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(Boss isn't around. Maybe he's where I
teleported? Besides...)
fields.JP:
（師匠はここにいないみたいだし、
　そのテレポート先にいるかも…？
　それに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Boss isn't around. Maybe he's where I
teleported? Besides...)

fields.EN:
(I honestly don't feel any more powerful.
If my grandma were here, what would she
say...?)
fields.JP:
（正直、新しい力とか、全然実感湧かないけど、
　もしこの場に婆ちゃんがいたら、
　自分にきっとこう言うっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I honestly don't feel any more powerful.
If my grandma were here, what would she
say...?)

fields.EN: (Embrace the power from within, then act.)
fields.JP:
（自分が身に着けた力を使って、
　考えて動けって）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Embrace the power from within, then act.)

fields.EN:
U-Um, I don't really get the purification
thing, but I'll give it a shot! Oh! I don't have
a Mary Gun!
fields.JP:
あ、あの、浄化とかピンと来てないっすけど、
とにかく自分がみんなのところに行ってみるっす！
あ、でも自分、メアリガン持ってないっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
U-Um, I don't really get the purification
thing, but I'll give it a shot! Oh! I don't have
a Mary Gun!

fields.EN:
Oh, that's right. Sorry! Let me prepare one
for you... Mm!
fields.JP:
あっ、そうだったよね。ごめん！
すぐに用意するから。
……んっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's right. Sorry! Let me prepare one
for you... Mm!

fields.EN:
Whoa! That's a Mary Gun all right!
You were so quick, you'd put my boss
to shame.
fields.JP:
うわ、一瞬でメアリガンがっ！
目の前でサクッと作られると、
師匠の助手として、なんかショックっすねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! That's a Mary Gun all right!
You were so quick, you'd put my boss
to shame.

fields.EN:
If you're so powerful, why don't you go,
Hikari-san?
fields.JP:
そんな凄い力があるなら、
ヒカリさんが行けばいいんじゃないすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're so powerful, why don't you go,
Hikari?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN: Whoa, your nose is bleeding! Are you okay?!
fields.JP:
って、鼻血が！
だ、大丈夫っすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa, your nose is bleeding! Are you okay?!

fields.EN:
Haha. I used up all my strength against
Genocide Pink and extracting everyone.
I barely have any energy...
fields.JP:
はは……処刑台少女と戦ったのと、
みんなを逃がすためのテレポートで、
もう、ほんと、限界ギリギリで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. I used up all my strength against
Massacre Pink and extracting everyone.
I barely have any energy...
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: It's good that I woke up, but almost none of my strength has returned...
fields.JP:
目が覚めたは良かったんだけど、
力はほとんど戻ってなくてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm doing okay since I woke up, but I'm
still regaining strength.

fields.EN:
I used every last bit of strength I had just to send
you to everyone else, Clara-chan... Haha.
fields.JP:
ほんと～に、最後の最後の力を振り絞って、
くららちゃんをみんなのとこへ飛ばすのが
精一杯で……ハハっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll sit here and recharge while you go and
save the others. That's all I can do. Haha.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Oh man! That's a lot to handle!
fields.JP: ちょ、無理し過ぎじゃないっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh man! That's a lot to handle!

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah, it may be dangerous. But... I have to send
you away one last time, Clara-chan.
fields.JP:
う、うん、さすがに危ないかな。
でも……最後にくららちゃんを飛ばさないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, our situation is rather dire, but...
I must teleport you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: う、うっす！　腹をくくったっす！

fields.EN: Okay, be careful out there. Here we go!
fields.JP:
うん。気をつけて、行ってきて。
よーし、じゃあいくよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, be careful out there. Here we go!

fields.EN:
Th-There we go... *sigh*... I've got nothing
left.
fields.JP:
……で、できたぁ。
はう……も、もう、力が空っぽだよおぉ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-There we go... *sigh*... I've got nothing
left.

fields.EN: Clara-chan, I'm leaving the rest... Zzz... Zzz...
fields.JP: くららちゃん…後はおねが…すぅ、すぅ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Clara, I'm leaving the rest... Zzz... Zzz...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan

fields.EN:
Whoa, is this where our friends are?
Hey, I'm floating!
fields.JP:
おおっ、ここに他の仲間がいるっすか。
……って、足が着いてないっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa, is this where our friends are?
Hey, I'm floating!

fields.JP: ふわぁぁっ、お、落ちるうっ！

fields.EN:
Huh? That didn't hurt too bad. Did something
break my fall?
fields.JP:
あれれっ、思ったより痛くないっす。
柔らかい物が下にあったお陰っすかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? That didn't hurt too bad. Did something
break my fall?

fields.EN:
You bastard, how dare ye strike from
above! You must be pretty brave to
step on me!
fields.JP:
おにょれ、上から奇襲するとは何ヤツ！
この我を尻に敷くとは良い度胸だなっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You bastard, how dare ye strike from
above! You must be pretty brave to
step on me!

fields.JP: うわっ、クッションが喋ったっす！

fields.EN: Who you callin' a cushion! Get off-a me!
fields.JP:
だれがクッションだーーー！！
はやく我の上から退かんかー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Who you callin' a cushion! Get off-a me!

fields.JP: わわわっ！　し、失礼したっす！

fields.EN:
Only a fool of gigantine proportions
would step on Hameln, the Demon King!
Name yourself!
fields.JP:
この大魔王であるハーメルンを
尻の下に敷くとは、いい度胸だ。
貴様、名を名乗れ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only a fool of gigantine proportions
would step on Hameln, the Demon King!
Name yourself!

fields.EN:
I-I'm Clara! Sorry, that was an accident.
I swear!
fields.JP:
く、くららっす！
すんません、今のは不慮の事故で
ワザとやったんじゃないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm Clara! Sorry, that was an accident.
I swear!

fields.EN:
Hm? Clara? You seem familiar. Oh, that's
right. You're the kid from the Dawn.
fields.JP:
うん？　くららだと？
なんだか見覚えがある顔だな。
そうか、貴様は黎明にいた小娘だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Clara? You seem familiar. Oh, that's
right. You're the kid from the Dawn.

fields.EN:
Exactly. The goddess—I mean, Hikari-san—
sent me here to help someone, so here
I am.
fields.JP:
その通りっす！　ついさっき女神様……
ヒカリさんから、血式少女の誰かが
ピンチだって聞かされて来たっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. The goddess—I mean, Hikari—
sent me here to help someone, so here
I am.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN: To speed things up, I arrived via teleport!
fields.JP:
それで、急いで駆けつけるために、
ここにテレポートで送られたんっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: To speed things up, I arrived via teleport!

fields.EN: I see, point made! Excellent timing.
fields.JP:
にゃるほど、確かに！
絶妙なタイミングではあるな
fields.LOCALIZED: I see, point made! Excellent timing.

fields.EN: Oh, are you guys in a bind?
fields.JP: あ、やっぱりピンチだったんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, are you guys in a bind?

fields.EN: Indeed. The bind of all binds. Look there.
fields.JP:
ああ、ピンチもピンチだ。
ほれ、あのようにな
fields.LOCALIZED: Indeed. The bind of all binds. Look there.

fields.JP: あは、あは、あははははっ！！
あはははあああああああっ！！

うわっ、グレーテルさんが
手当たり次第襲いまくってるっす！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Yes. When I came to, Gretel was already in
that state. Argh. If I were at full strength,
I could handle it, but I'm hurt.
fields.JP:
気がついたらグレーテルがああなってたのだ。
くっ、我が万全の状態なら余裕なのだが、
残念ながら今は手負いの身だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. When I came to, Gretel was already in
that state. Argh. If I were at full strength,
I could handle it, but I'm hurt.

fields.EN:
I can't do it all on my own, so I pretended
to be a rock until you came crashing on me.
fields.JP:
我１人ではどうする事も出来ず、
岩のふりをして丸まっていたら、
そこに貴様が落ちて来たというわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't do it all on my own, so I pretended
to be a rock until you came crashing on me.

fields.EN: Hahaha. What do ya say? A bind, right?
fields.JP:
はっはっは！
どうだ、まごう事なきピンチであろう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. What do ya say? A bind, right?

fields.EN:
This is no laughing matter! We must do
something!
fields.JP:
それ、笑ってるどころじゃないっすよ！
早く何とかしないとヤバイじゃないっすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is no laughing matter! We must do
something!

fields.EN:
Sure, but Jack and the others are nowhere
to be found. We can't purify her.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、皆もジャックの姿もないから
あやつを浄化できる者がおらんのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but Jack and the others are nowhere
to be found. We can't purify her.

fields.EN:
Purify... Oh, that's right. Hikari-san gave me the
Mary Gun! She said I could purify her!
fields.JP:
浄化…あっ、そう言えば、自分、ヒカリさんに
メアリガンを持たされたのを思い出したっす！
自分なら、浄化出来るから、って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Purify... Oh, that's right. Hikari gave me the
Mary Gun! She said I could purify her!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN:
What?! You can do that? Gretel saw us.
Hurry up and purify her.
fields.JP:
なに！？　やるではないか小娘！
ヤツがこちらに気付いたようだ。
さっそく浄化を頼むぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! You can do that? Gretel saw us.
Hurry up and purify her.

fields.JP: うひゃひゃひゃひゃーっ！！

fields.EN:
Ah, she's coming this way! U-Uh, lemme
grab the Mary Gun. Wait, I haven't equipped
myself yet!
fields.JP:
ひぇっ、こっちに来たっ！？
え、えっと、早速メアリガンを……
って、あれっ、まだ装備してなかったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, she's coming this way! U-Uh, lemme
grab the Mary Gun. Wait, I haven't equipped
myself yet!

fields.JP:
この、愚か者ーーーーっ！
貴様、結局役に立ってないではないか！

fields.EN: I'm so sorry! Let's run for it!
fields.JP:
申し訳ないっす！
と、とりあえずこの場は離脱するっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so sorry! Let's run for it!

fields.JP: うおっ！　いきなり手ぇ引っ張るなっ！
いいから、早く逃げるっすーー！

fields.EN:
F-Fine, you may grab my hand just this
once.
fields.JP:
し、仕方ないな。
我の手を取ることを特別に許してやろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Fine, you may grab my hand just this
once.

fields.JP: わかったっすから、今は走って下さいっす！
うぬっ！　ふぉぉっ！　危なっ！

fields.EN: She's starting to gain on us, hurry!
fields.JP:
ああっ、このままだと
すぐに追いつかれそうっすっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: She's starting to gain on us, hurry!

fields.EN:
S-Someone, if you're out there! Save us!
I'll permit it!
fields.JP:
だ、誰かーーー、今すぐ我を助けよ！
特別に許可してやるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Someone, if you're out there! Save us!
I'll permit it!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ふふっ、ふははははははっ！！

fields.EN:
Oh, that's a Marchen! Now I can use my
trick!
fields.JP:
おおっ、運良くメルヒェンが現れたぞ！
我の人望の成せる技だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's a Marchen! Now I can use my
trick!

fields.EN: That was a close one. Let's get out of here.
fields.JP:
ほんと、ラッキーだったっすね。
今のうちに全力で逃げ切るっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: That was a close one. Let's get out of here.

fields.EN:
Ah... *pant, pant*... We managed to escape
somehow.
fields.JP:
ひぃ、はぁ……はぁっ……っ
な、なんとか逃げ切れたっすかねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... *pant, pant*... We managed to escape
somehow.

fields.EN:
*wheeze, wheeze, wheeze*... Right.
Seems like it.
fields.JP:
ぜーっ、はーっ、ぜーっ、はーっ。
う、うむ、そのようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
*wheeze, wheeze, wheeze*... Right.
Seems like it.

fields.JP: つ、疲れたっす……はううっ

fields.EN:
Not only are my legs terribly sore, but I
don't think I could take another step.
fields.JP:
もう、我は走るどころか、
一歩も歩けぬぞ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not only are my legs terribly sore, but I
don't think I could take another step.

fields.EN: Me too. Let's take a seat here.
fields.JP: 同感っす。この辺りで休憩するっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Me too. Let's take a seat here.

fields.EN: Phew. So Hameln-san, how'd that happen?
fields.JP:
ふぅ……ところで、ハーメルンさん。
なんであんな事になったんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew. So Hameln, how'd that happen?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Huh? Oh, you mean Gretel. Beats me.
Before I knew it, I was passed out.
fields.JP:
……ん？　ああ、グレーテルの事か。
なんだかよく分からないうちに、
我も気を失ってしまってな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Oh, you mean Gretel. Beats me.
Before I knew it, I was passed out.

fields.EN:
She was like that once I regained my
senses.
fields.JP:
目を覚ましたらあそこにいて、目の前に
あの状態になったグレーテルがいたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was like that once I regained my
senses.

fields.EN:
It was insane. I half-thought I would
wet my pants.
fields.JP:
いやもう、ビックリなんてもんじゃなかったぞ。
正直、ちょっともよおしそうになった
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was insane. I half-thought I would
wet my pants.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Can't say I wouldn't do the same
in your shoes.
fields.JP: 自分も、そうなってたらちびる自信があるっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Can't say I wouldn't do the same
in your shoes.

fields.EN:
Hmm. I'm discovering that it's far worse
to be on the receiving end of a chase.
fields.JP:
うーむ。今回よく分かったが、
追うよりも追われる方がしんどいのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. I'm discovering that it's far worse
to be on the receiving end of a chase.

fields.EN:
(For someone who was just freaking out
a second ago, she seems happy-go-lucky.)
fields.JP:
（余裕がなさそうだった割には、
　ずいぶん呑気なことを言ってるっすね～）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(For someone who was just freaking out
a second ago, she seems happy-go-lucky.)

fields.EN:
Yeah. Being chased really gets the blood
going.
fields.JP:
そうっすね、追われるってのは
心理的にもつらいっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Being chased really gets the blood
going.

fields.EN:
How odd. It seems like all of us were
together on the surface for the briefest
moment.
fields.JP:
しかし、妙だな。
地上に出た時点では、他の者たちと
一緒だったはずなのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
How odd. It seems like all of us were
together on the surface for the briefest
moment.

fields.EN:
Then all of a sudden, I was floating, then
everything went blank.
fields.JP:
ふわ～っと浮き上がった後、
どうなったのかさっぱりなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then all of a sudden, I was floating, then
everything went blank.

fields.EN:
Ah... That must've been Hikari-san's doing.
She teleported us away from Genocide Pink.
fields.JP:
あー……それはきっと、ヒカリさんの力っすね。
処刑台少女達から、みんなをテレポートで
逃がしてくれたんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... That must've been Hikari's doing.
She teleported us away from Massacre Pink.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Oh, I see. So I have Hikari to thank?
fields.JP:
おお、なるほど！
あれはヒカリの力だったのか
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see. So I have Hikari to thank?

fields.EN:
We can ignore Gretel's brutish outbursts
then. I was saved!
fields.JP:
危うくグレーテルに襲われそうになったことは
置いといて、お陰で助かった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can ignore Gretel's brutish outbursts
then. I was saved!

fields.EN:
She actually healed me from a pretty
serious injury! She's my savior!
fields.JP:
自分も、酷い怪我をしたのを、
治癒で助けてもらったっす。
彼女は命の恩人っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She actually healed me from a pretty
serious injury! She's my savior!

fields.EN:
Like, we finally made our way above
ground just to meet those wicked enemies.
Talk about a warm welcome.
fields.JP:
しっかし、やっとみんなで地上に来たってのに、
あんな恐ろしい敵がいるなんて、
本当に予想外だったっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like, we finally made our way above
ground just to meet those wicked enemies.
Talk about a warm welcome.

fields.EN:
Right, Genocide Pink. They pose a far
bigger threat than Gretel in her current
state. They would best even me right now.
fields.JP:
うむ。あの処刑台少女とやらからは……
先程のグレーテル以上の危機感を覚えたのだ。
今の我では、あやつらには到底敵わぬ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, Massacre Pink. They pose a far
bigger threat than Gretel in her current
state. They would best even me right now.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(Wow. Even the prideful Hameln-san is admitting
her limits. Those girls must be something.)
fields.JP:
（あのハーメルンさんがこんな素直に
　認めるってことは、彼女達は相当怖い
　相手ってことっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow. Even the prideful Hameln is admitting
her limits. Those girls must be something.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san
Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
But just you wait and see! I won't lose
to them next time!
fields.JP:
だがっ、みておりぇっ！
我は、次こそはまけぬぞおおおお！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But just you wait and see! I won't lose
to them next time!

fields.EN:
Hey, keep it down! Gretel-san's gonna notice
us!
fields.JP:
ちょっ！　今大きな声を出さないで欲しいっす！
グレーテルさんに気付かれるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, keep it down! Gretel's gonna notice
us!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Oh, shoot. Did she see us?
fields.JP:
はっ！　しまったっ！
あやつには見つかっておらんだろうな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, shoot. Did she see us?

fields.EN: If she does, we're in trouble!
fields.JP: 今見つかったら、マジでヤバイっすからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: If she does, we're in trouble!

fields.JP: 今の声は、ハーメルンかい？

fields.EN: Oh, thank goodness. We've found the others!
fields.JP:
ああ、よかったです。
やっと他の方が見つかりましたね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, thank goodness. We've found the others!

fields.JP: ぬ？　あの声は……もしや……
カエデさん、ここってなんっすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
This is our campground. Well, a makeshift
one at that.
fields.JP:
あたしたちのキャンプ地よ。
とはいえ、急ごしらえだけどねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is our campground. Well, a makeshift
one at that.

fields.EN: Sukui and I looked for a relatively safe place and made this makeshift camp here.
fields.JP:
スクイと２人で比較的安全な場所を探して、
ここに簡易キャンプを作ったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sukui found a secluded area and set up
a simple camp.

fields.EN: Yes. It's vital to our survival.
fields.JP: はい、拠点になる場所は必要不可欠ですから
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. It's vital to our survival.

fields.EN: I see. Makeshift indeed, but not terrible.
fields.JP:
ほうほう、質素な造りではあるが、
悪くはないではないか
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Makeshift indeed, but not terrible.

fields.EN:
Hey, if you don't like it, you can sleep
outside.
fields.JP:
こらこら、質素とか言うやつには
使わせないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, if you don't like it, you can sleep
outside.

fields.JP: ぬうっ！　そ、それは横暴だぞ！

fields.EN:
You watch yours, and be thankful.
Anyway, afterwards, we began searching
if anyone else came down this way.
fields.JP:
だったら大人しく感謝すること。
で、その後、誰か近くにいないかって、
仲間を探していたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You watch yours, and be thankful.
Anyway, afterwards, we began searching
if anyone else came down this way.

fields.EN: Ah, I see. Did you find anyone?
fields.JP:
そうだったんすか。
何か発見はあったんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, I see. Did you find anyone?

fields.EN: Nope. Not apart from you guys.
fields.JP:
ううん、見つけられたのは
貴女たちが最初
fields.LOCALIZED: Nope. Not apart from you guys.

fields.EN:
Honestly, with just the two of us, we can't
cover much ground.
fields.JP:
正直あたしたちだけじゃ
そんな遠くにも行けないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, with just the two of us, we can't
cover much ground.

fields.EN: I guess Hameln will have to do for now.
fields.JP:
この際、見つかったのが
ハーメルンでも良かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess Hameln will have to do for now.

fields.EN:
Excuse me, what do you mean "have to do"!
You should be so grateful!
fields.JP:
おい、ハーメルン“でも”とはなんなのだ！！
むしろ我を見つけたのは僥倖なのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Excuse me, what do you mean "have to do"!
You should be so grateful!

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Just kidding. It's nice to see you,
Hameln.
fields.JP:
ははは、うそうそ
ハーメルンが見つかって心強いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Just kidding. It's nice to see you,
Hameln.

fields.EN:
Enough bickering, you two. It's good that
we were able to find each other.
fields.JP:
お２人とも、そのくらいにしましょう。
本当に合流出来て良かったですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough bickering, you two. It's good that
we were able to find each other.

fields.EN:
That's right. Plus, you guys secured a
safe hideaway. I'm grateful.
fields.JP:
そうっすよ、こうして安全な場所と
テントまであって、ありがたいことっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Plus, you guys secured a
safe hideaway. I'm grateful.

fields.EN:
Well, I called it safe, but that's only
relative to where we are.
fields.JP:
あのね、確かにここは安全だとは言ったけど、
あくまでも“比較的”という意味でよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I called it safe, but that's only
relative to where we are.

fields.EN:
I doubt anywhere in this place is truly
safe. That frightens me.
fields.JP:
本当の意味で安全な場所なんて、
ここのどこにも無さそうで恐ろしかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt anywhere in this place is truly
safe. That frightens me.

fields.EN:
I'm simply happy I'm with Kaede-san.
She's so reliable. Must be the divine
protection of the sun.
fields.JP:
わたくしは、頼りになるカエデさんと一緒で
心強かったですよ。
これもタイヨウのご加護ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm simply happy I'm with Kaede.
She's so reliable. Must be the divine
protection of the sun.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
(Divine protection of the sun...
Oh, that's right. That's what the Order of
the Sun wears.)
fields.JP:
（タイヨウのご加護……
　あ、そうか、この格好は、
　タイヨウ教団でみたことある人っす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Divine protection of the sun...
Oh, that's right. That's what the Order of
the Sun wears.)

fields.EN:
Anyway, let's compare notes on what
happened after we split.
fields.JP:
ともかく、あの後何があったのか、
お互いに一度、今の状況を
じっくり話し合ってみましょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, let's compare notes on what
happened after we split.

fields.EN: Yes, let's. Allow me to begin.
fields.JP:
うむ、くるしゅうない。
我も状況を話してやろう
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, let's. Allow me to begin.

fields.EN:
Ah. So the reason we escaped was because
of Hikari...
fields.JP:
なるほど、あの時みんなが離脱出来たのは、
彼女のテレポートのお陰だったんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. So the reason we escaped was because
of Hikari...

fields.EN:
Yes, that's right. Hikari-san has an incredible
power.
fields.JP:
はい、そうだったんす。
ヒカリさんはすごい力を持ってるっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, that's right. Her teleportation powers
are amazing.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Seriously. We barely made it out.
Without her, we wouldn't be here.
fields.JP:
確かに、本当に間一髪だったわ。
あの時、逃がしてもらえなかったら、
こうしてキャンプを作るどころじゃなかったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. We barely made it out.
Without her, we wouldn't be here.

fields.EN: I owe my life to Hikari-san.
fields.JP:
今、自分が生きていられるのも、
ヒカリさんのお陰っす
fields.LOCALIZED: I owe my life to Hikari.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN:
She used the last of her power to send me
here before falling asleep.
fields.JP:
自分をここに送るのに、最後の力を使い果たして
寝ちゃったっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She used the last of her power to send me
here before falling asleep.

fields.EN:
Well, it's nice to know where Gretel is,
but I didn't expect her to go full Blood
Skelter.
fields.JP:
でも、グレーテルを発見したのはいいけれど、
ブラッドスケルター化してたってのは、
予想外だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's nice to know where Gretel is,
but I didn't expect her to go full Blood
Skelter.

fields.EN:
Gretel-san suffered a serious injury against
Genocide Pink. That explains her current
condition.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんは、その前に処刑台少女との
戦闘で重症を負っていたから、
それでそうなったのかも知れないですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel suffered a serious injury against
Massacre Pink. That explains her current
condition.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Oh, really? That totally explains
how she went Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
なにっ、そうだったのか？
ならばあやつがブラッドスケルター化したのも
納得がいくというものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really? That totally explains
how she went Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Ya know, Genocide Pink, and that enormous
Jail Armyda thing, are mysteries to us.
fields.JP:
それにしても、処刑台少女といい、
あの巨大すぎる監獄塔みたいな物といい、
どれも解せぬことばかりだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ya know, Massacre Pink, and that enormous
Jail Armyda thing, are mysteries to us.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
I wonder what the deal is with the big Jail.
All those corpses...make me sick.
fields.JP:
あの不気味な監獄塔は、なんなんっすかね。
死体まで積み上げられて……気分が悪いっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what the deal is with the big Jail.
All those corpses...make me sick.

fields.EN:
Otsuu mentioned something back then.
Like it was an offering to the Jail tower.
I'm inclined to agree.
fields.JP:
あの時、おつうが言っておった。
まるで、監獄塔への捧げ物のようであると。
我も同じように感じた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu mentioned something back then.
Like it was an offering to the Jail tower.
I'm inclined to agree.

fields.EN:
But simply talking about it here won't
bring us any closer to the answers.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、こうしてただ話してるだけじゃ、
あの監獄塔らしき物の正体は
判明しないだろうけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
But simply talking about it here won't
bring us any closer to the answers.

fields.EN:
First, I think it would be wise to look for the rest
of our companions, including Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
まずはともかく、グレーテルさんを含めた
残りの仲間を探すのが賢明かと思います
fields.LOCALIZED: To start, we should find our remaining friends.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
True. We can't just leave Gretel in that
state. If something were to happen to
her, I'd feel terrible.
fields.JP:
うむ。グレーテルをあのまま放置する
訳にもいかぬしな。
あやつに何かあったら寝覚めが悪い
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. We can't just leave Gretel in that
state. If something were to happen to
her, I'd feel terrible.

fields.EN:
Likewise. I want to help Gretel-san as soon as
we can.
fields.JP:
自分も同感っす。
グレーテルさんを、一刻も早く
元に戻してあげたいっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Likewise. I want to help Gretel as soon as
we can.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Hm? Come to think of it, didn't you mention
that you can purify now?
fields.JP:
ぬ？　そう言えば小娘は、
ジャックのように浄化ができるとか
ぬかしておったが……実際はどうなのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Come to think of it, didn't you mention
that you can purify now?

fields.EN:
Hmm. I've never done it myself, so I can't
say for certain.
fields.JP:
うーん、まだ実際にやったことはないし、
本当に出来るかどうかは、
自分にも分からないっすけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. I've never done it myself, so I can't
say for certain.

fields.EN:
But now that I've equipped the Mary Gun,
maybe we can give it a shot?
fields.JP:
今度こそメアリガンも装着したし、
早速試してみるっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now that I've equipped the Mary Gun,
maybe we can give it a shot?

fields.EN:
Oh, looks like it. Try to see if you can purify
my corruption with your blood.
fields.JP:
おお、格好だけはそれっぽいな。
その血で我の穢れを浄化できるか、
試してみるがよい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, looks like it. Try to see if you can purify
my corruption with your blood.

fields.EN: Gave it a good go, so how do you feel?
fields.JP:
えっと、やってみたっすけど。
ど、どんな感じっすかね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Gave it a good go, so how do you feel?

fields.EN:
OHHHH! Th-This is... I feel positively
fantastic!
fields.JP:
お、おおおっ、これはっ。
本当に穢れが取れた感じがするぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
OHHHH! Th-This is... I feel positively
fantastic!

fields.EN: Really? Thank goodness. Hikari-san was right.
fields.JP:
本当っすか！　よ、よかったぁ、
ヒカリさんが言ってた通りっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? Thank goodness. Hikari was right.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN:
Hahaha. How incredible! With this power,
we no longer have to fear corruption!
fields.JP:
ふはははっ、よい、実によいぞ！
この力さえあれば、穢れを恐れる必要も無い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. How incredible! With this power,
we no longer have to fear corruption!

fields.JP:
ふはははははははっ！
我々は無敵だな！

fields.EN:
That's what I like to hear! We'll use this
to purify Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
自分も、自信が出てきたっす！
これを使ってグレーテルさんを浄化するっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I like to hear! We'll use this
to purify Gretel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Hehe. Look at you, Hameln. Back to your
normal self.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、ハーメルンも、
すっかりいつもの調子を取り戻したじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Look at you, Hameln. Back to your
normal self.

fields.EN:
Aye. Looks like luck's on our side with
these two.
fields.JP:
はい、この子たちを見ていると、
なんとかなりそうな気がします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aye. Looks like luck's on our side with
these two.

fields.JP:
んんっ…？　むにゃ、むにゃ……
お、もう朝か
我は大魔王であるぞーーー！
ぬおぉっ！？　な、なにごとっすか！

fields.EN: Rgh, goodness... Hameln again! Be quiet!
fields.JP:
あー、もう……またハーメルンね！
うるさいわよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh, goodness... Hameln again! Be quiet!

fields.EN: Oh, that woke you, did it? Good morning.
fields.JP:
おっ、貴様らも起きたのか。
よい朝であるな
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, that woke you, did it? Good morning.

fields.EN:
No, it was your screaming that woke
me up. Why are you being so loud?
fields.JP:
そりゃ、ビックリして起きるっすよ。
さっきの叫びは、なんなんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it was your screaming that woke
me up. Why are you being so loud?

fields.EN: Hm? I do this every day.
fields.JP: うん？　我の毎朝の日課だが？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? I do this every day.

fields.EN:
That's right. I begin each dawn with a
hearty declaration, or my day's ruined.
A habit I picked up in Jail.
fields.JP:
そうだ。起き抜けにこれをやらないと、
一日スッキリしないのでな。
ジェイルにいた時からの習慣だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. I begin each dawn with a
hearty declaration, or my day's ruined.
A habit I picked up in Jail.

fields.EN:
(Now I know what Jack-san had to put up
with.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックさんも、自分が知らない部分で
　色々苦労してたんすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now I know what Jack had to put up
with.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Now that we've eaten breakfast, let's
plan our next course of action.
fields.JP:
簡単な食事も済ませたことだし、
これから改めてどうするか決めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we've eaten breakfast, let's
plan our next course of action.

fields.EN:
Right. Now that our tummies are full,
I'm solid!
fields.JP:
そうっすね。
お腹が膨れたら、もうバッチリっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Now that our tummies are full,
I'm solid!

fields.EN: But Kaede-san and I won't be able to fight.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、わたくしやカエデさんは、
戦うことはできませんから……
fields.LOCALIZED: But Kaede and I won't be able to fight.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
So I assume we should try to locate others
to fortify our campground.
fields.JP:
いずれ他のみなさんと合流するために、
ここでのインフラを整えようかと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I assume we should try to locate others
to fortify our campground.

fields.EN:
Can't argue with that. We're better off
if our base is set up.
fields.JP:
賛成っす。拠点が充実するのは
ありがたいことっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't argue with that. We're better off
if our base is set up.

fields.EN:
Right. You minions figure it out while I
lay back in comfort.
fields.JP:
うむ、今後も我が快適に過ごせるよう、
よきにはからうのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. You minions figure it out while I
lay back in comfort.

fields.EN:
Yeah, yeah. This isn't for you. This is
for everyone.
fields.JP:
はいはい、ハーメルンのためじゃなく、
みんなのために頑張るわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, yeah. This isn't for you. This is
for everyone.

fields.JP: ぬうっ、我をもっとあがめるにょだ！

fields.EN:
Haha. Our praise for you is directly linked
to how hard you work, Hameln. Clara, can
we entrust you to explore?
fields.JP:
はは、崇めるかどうかはこれから次第。
ハーメルンとくららは、周囲の探索を
お願いできるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Our praise for you is directly linked
to how hard you work, Hameln. Clara, can
we entrust you to explore?

fields.EN:
Sure thing. We can't do much with just
the two of us though, so we won't venture
too far.
fields.JP:
自分はもちろんいいっすよ。
でも２人だけじゃ危ないんで、
あんまり遠くには行かないようにするっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing. We can't do much with just
the two of us though, so we won't venture
too far.

fields.EN:
Please be careful. May the divine protection
of the sun protect you, Clara-san.
fields.JP:
くれぐれも、気をつけて下さいね。
くららさんたちに、タイヨウのご加護が
ありますように
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please be careful. May the divine protection
of the sun protect you, Clara.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららさん => Clara-san

fields.EN: Oh, don't worry. You have me after all!
fields.JP:
なぁに、心配などいらぬぞ、
何しろこの我がついているからな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, don't worry. You have me after all!

fields.EN:
Just pretend you're aboard a large vessel.
Or better yet, a pirate ship.
fields.JP:
大船、いや、海賊船に乗ったくらいの
つもりでいるがよい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just pretend you're aboard a large vessel.
Or better yet, a pirate ship.

fields.EN:
...That doesn't inspire much faith. Just don't
go overboard or run the thing aground.
fields.JP:
……それが一番心配なんだけど。
調子に乗りすぎて、
泥舟にならないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...That doesn't inspire much faith. Just don't
go overboard or run the thing aground.

fields.EN:
With Hameln-san with me, I feel reassured. More
importantly, will you and the others be all right
while we're gone, Kaede-san?
fields.JP:
でも、ハーメルンさんと一緒なら心強いっす。
それより、自分たちが留守の間、
カエデさんたちの方は大丈夫っすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
With Hameln with me, we'll be fine.
I'm more worried about you two.
Will you be okay without us?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ハーメルン => Hameln-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
More than okay. You built a front gate for
us, remember?
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ。ゆうべくららが、
突貫で作ってくれた柵があるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
More than okay. You built a front gate for
us, remember?

fields.EN:
With that, we can keep out most of the
Marchens unless they charge in.
fields.JP:
あれがあるお陰で、故意的に狙って来る
メルヒェン以外は今は大丈夫そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that, we can keep out most of the
Marchens unless they charge in.

fields.EN: Besides, honestly, anything we choose right now comes with danger. We'll just have to accept that.
fields.JP:
それに正直今は何を選択しても危険が伴うからね。
割り切るしかないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, risk is the name of the game
right now. Everyone do their part.

fields.EN: Right. Don't worry for our sake, go ahead.
fields.JP:
はい、わたくしたちの事は
心配しないでお出かけ下さい
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Don't worry for our sake, go ahead.

fields.EN: You sure? Glad to hear the gate works.
fields.JP:
そうっすか。
あの柵が役に立ったのなら嬉しいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: You sure? Glad to hear the gate works.

fields.EN: Okay, little one. Let's get going. Follow me.
fields.JP:
では、小娘よ、探索に向かうぞ！
さあ、我についてくるがいい
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, little one. Let's get going. Follow me.

fields.JP:
あっ、ハーメルンさん、
待って下さいっす！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Ah, I feel loose! Thanks to your purification
yesterday, I'm good as new!
fields.JP:
うむ、身体が軽い！
昨日小娘に浄化されてから、
すこぶる調子がよいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I feel loose! Thanks to your purification
yesterday, I'm good as new!

fields.EN: Glad to hear it. Even so, I'm still surprised I was actually able to purify you with my own blood.
fields.JP:
それはよかったっす。
それにしても、本当に自分の血で
浄化ができたのは未だに驚きっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Happy to hear it. I'm still shocked I could
use my blood to help you.

fields.EN:
Here I thought you were just an ordinary girl,
but you're proving useful. Worthy of praise.
fields.JP:
ただの小娘だと思っていたが、
なかなかやるではないか。
我が褒めてつかわすのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here I thought you were just an ordinary girl,
but you're proving useful. Worthy of praise.

fields.EN:
But where'd that power come from?
Hikari-san didn't seem to know either.
fields.JP:
でも、なんでいきなり浄化出来るように
なったんすかね？
ヒカリさんもわからないって言ってたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But where'd that power come from?
Hikari didn't seem to know either.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN:
Does a bird ponder how it can fly? All that
matters is that you can. It's a cause for
celebration.
fields.JP:
ま、細かいことなどどうでもいいではないか。
自分に出来る事が増えたのは、
素直に喜ぶべき事だと我は思うのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does a bird ponder how it can fly? All that
matters is that you can. It's a cause for
celebration.

fields.EN:
You have a point. I guess I should learn to
embrace it.
fields.JP:
そうっすね、これもある意味、
手に職ってヤツっすよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have a point. I guess I should learn to
embrace it.

fields.EN: Precisely! Thanks to your work, look!
fields.JP:
うむ、その通り！
その甲斐もあって、ほれ見よ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Precisely! Thanks to your work, look!

fields.EN:
My body is in tip-top shape. Beware,
Marchens! Have at thee!
fields.JP:
今の我は、体調万全であるぞ！
メルヒェンだろうと何だろうと、
何でもかかって来～い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My body is in tip-top shape. Beware,
Marchens! Have at thee!

fields.EN:
There you go again. Keep boasting and
they'll show up in no time.
fields.JP:
またまた～、
そんな事を言ってると、藪蛇になるっすよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again. Keep boasting and
they'll show up in no time.

fields.EN:
Fuahahaha. Bring it on. I'll handle them
all myself!
fields.JP:
ふははははっ、蛇だろうと何だろうと、
今の我には余裕余裕！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fuahahaha. Bring it on. I'll handle them
all myself!

fields.JP: ふふふふふっ、あはははっ！

fields.EN: Nyooowaa! That was a sucker punch!
fields.JP:
にょわぁぁっ！？
ふ、不意打ちとはひきょうにゃりっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Nyooowaa! That was a sucker punch!

fields.JP: ふふっ、ふははははははっ！！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
(She snuck up from behind me. I let my
guard down!)
fields.JP:
（いつの間に自分らの後ろにいたんすかっ、
　気付かなかったのは不覚っす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She snuck up from behind me. I let my
guard down!)

fields.EN:
D-Darned you, Gretel! You will fait me,
I'm in my best condition!
fields.JP:
お、おにょれグレーテル！
万全の我が相手になってやりゅう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Darned you, Gretel! You will fait me,
I'm in my best condition!

fields.JP: うふふふっ、あは、あははっ……

fields.EN: No! That's dangerous! Hm. Y-You do good.
fields.JP:
……ぬおう！　危なっ！
うむむっ、や、やりおるなっ
fields.LOCALIZED: No! That's dangerous! Hm. Y-You do good.

fields.EN:
So this is what Blood Skelter looks like,
huh? This is my first time seeing it up
close.
fields.JP:
こ、これがブラッドスケルター化した
血式少女っすか。
まともに見たのは初めてっす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is what Blood Skelter looks like,
huh? This is my first time seeing it up
close.

fields.EN:
Wow. Those moves are unreal. 
Can hardly see her.
fields.JP:
なんて人間離れした動きなんすか。
自分は、目で追うのがやっとっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. Those moves are unreal. 
Can hardly see her.

fields.EN:
Hrngh! Nimbly dodged! If it hits, it will
hoit!
fields.JP:
ふぬっ！　避けるに決まってるのだ！
当たったら痛いじゃすまないりょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hrngh! Nimbly dodged! If it hits, it will
hoit!

fields.EN:
Tch. Damn you, Gretel! Fool! Snap out of
your daze!
fields.JP:
ちっ、グレーテルめ、このバカものが！
早く、目をさますのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch. Damn you, Gretel! Fool! Snap out of
your daze!

fields.EN:
Oogh... I don't think I can intervene.
What do I do...?
fields.JP:
うう、２人の戦いに割って入れそうにないっす。
自分、いったいどうすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh... I don't think I can intervene.
What do I do...?

fields.EN:
What are you doing there, little girl?!
Don't forget your role!
fields.JP:
小娘よ、何をボーッとしてる！
自らに与えられた役目を忘れるでない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing there, little girl?!
Don't forget your role!

fields.EN:
Don't make me throttle her! You're the only
one who can save Gretel!
fields.JP:
悔しいが、我はこやつに全力をぶつけるのは
本望ではない！
だからグレーテルを救えるのは、貴様だけだろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't make me throttle her! You're the only
one who can save Gretel!

fields.JP: ふふふ……うふふふ……あはっ！

はっ……！
そ、そうだったっす！

fields.EN:
I'm Jack-san's backup. Only my blood can save 
Gretel-san!
fields.JP:
今の自分は、ジャックさんの代わり。
グレーテルさんを救えるのは、
この血だけだったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm Jack's backup. Only my blood can save 
Gretel!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: I'll pin down Gretel, purify her!
fields.JP:
我がグレーテルを押さえつけてる間に、
こやつの浄化を！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll pin down Gretel, purify her!

fields.JP: え、えーいっ、行くっすよ！！

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... She passed out.
L-Looks like we've done it.
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁ……っ、こやつ気を失いおった。
ど、どうやら成功したようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... She passed out.
L-Looks like we've done it.

fields.EN: Yup. Looks like Gretel-san's all purified now.
fields.JP:
はい、グレーテルさんの穢れ、
ちゃんと浄化されたみたいっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. Looks like Gretel's all purified now.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Damn you, Gretel. Fight me anytime you
want, but not like this.
fields.JP:
まったく、グレーテルのやつめ。
我につっかかってくるにしても、
こんな方法では困るのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn you, Gretel. Fight me anytime you
want, but not like this.

fields.EN:
If you want a piece of me, do it when
you're sane.
fields.JP: 来るなら、正気の時に来い
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want a piece of me, do it when
you're sane.

fields.EN: But seriously, glad Gretel-san's back to normal.
fields.JP:
でも、本当に、グレーテルさんが元に戻って
よかったっす
fields.LOCALIZED: But seriously, glad Gretel's back to normal.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Yeah. Of course it's all thanks to my
incredible skills, with small part thanks
to the little girl sticking with my plan!
fields.JP:
うむ。我の素晴らしい活躍もさることながら、
小娘が己の役目を思い出して、
それをまっとうした結果だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Of course it's all thanks to my
incredible skills, with small part thanks
to the little girl sticking with my plan!

fields.EN: Yes. An important role only I can fulfill... It's finally starting to feel real.
fields.JP:
はい、自分にしか出来ない重要な役目……
ようやく実感できたっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, that's all I'm good for. It's starting
to sink in.

fields.EN:
Anyway, that was taxing. We can't go on.
Let's drag her back.
fields.JP:
ともかく、このままでは探索にならぬ。
こやつを連れて、一旦戻るか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, that was taxing. We can't go on.
Let's drag her back.

fields.EN:
Right. I can already see the smile on
Kaede-san's face.
fields.JP:
そうっすね。
きっと、カエデさんたちも喜ぶっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I can already see the smile on
Kaede's face.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.JP:
カエデさん、スクイさん。
ただいまっすー！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san; スクイさん => Sukui-san

fields.EN: Oh! Am I glad to see you! Welcome back!
fields.JP:
あっ！　２人とも良かった！
無事に戻って来たのね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! Am I glad to see you! Welcome back!

fields.EN:
*pant* *pant*...
I-I'm glad to see you all safe.
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁ……
み、みなさんがご無事でなによりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant* *pant*...
I-I'm glad to see you all safe.

fields.EN:
(Huh? They look winded. What's going
on?)
fields.JP:
（あれ？　慌ててたみたいだけど、
　何かあったんすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? They look winded. What's going
on?)

fields.EN:
Oh, didn't expect such a warm welcome.
I think you've got the right attitude.
fields.JP:
おお、わざわざ我らを出迎えに来るとは、
殊勝な心がけではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, didn't expect such a warm welcome.
I think you've got the right attitude.

fields.EN:
Here, I found Gretel and brought her back.
Whatever I do, I get it right the first time.
fields.JP:
ほれ、グレーテルを見つけて回収したぞ。
我に掛ればこやつごとき、イチコロなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, I found Gretel and brought her back.
Whatever I do, I get it right the first time.

fields.JP:
あっ、グレーテルじゃない！
彼女も見つけたのね

fields.EN:
I see... Looks like the purification went
smoothly.
fields.JP:
そうでしたか、この方が……
無事に浄化されているようですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... Looks like the purification went
smoothly.

fields.EN:
Fuhahaha. What's there to hide?
I held her back!
fields.JP:
ふはははっ、何を隠そう
我がこやつを取り押さえたのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fuhahaha. What's there to hide?
I held her back!

fields.EN:
Gretel tried to faint me, but with a keen
eye I leapt from her attack, floating like
a butterfly and stinging like a bee.
fields.JP:
不意打ちで襲いかかるグレーテルの
攻撃をひらりとかわし、
蝶のように飛び、蜂のように刺す！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel tried to faint me, but with a keen
eye I leapt from her attack, floating like
a butterfly and stinging like a bee.

fields.EN:
Thanks to my beating, we apprehended
her with ease.
fields.JP:
我がこやつを弱らせたお陰で、
こうして回収する事ができたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to my beating, we apprehended
her with ease.

fields.EN:
Well, I can't deny that she's here in front
of me, but I can't help but feel you're
stretching the truth.
fields.JP:
彼女を回収出来たのは事実として、
なんだか話を盛りまくってる気がするんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I can't deny that she's here in front
of me, but I can't help but feel you're
stretching the truth.

fields.EN:
I-I most certainly stretched no truth!
In fact—
fields.JP:
も、盛りまくってなどいないぞ！
実際に──
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I most certainly stretched no truth!
In fact—

fields.EN: ...Indeed. In fact, it's thanks to Clara, right?
fields.JP: ……実際には、くららのお陰じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Indeed. In fact, it's thanks to Clara, right?

fields.JP: えっ、グレーテルさん、起きてたっすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Nuo! Damn you. Don't tell me you were just
pretending to sleep on my back.
fields.JP:
ぬおっ！　貴様、いつの間にっ
おのれ、我の背中で狸寝入りをしておったのかっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nuo! Damn you. Don't tell me you were just
pretending to sleep on my back.

fields.EN:
I woke up just a moment ago. Not that it
changes that I merely let you carry me
because I was tired.
fields.JP:
少し前から意識はあったわ。
ただ、疲労が酷いのは事実だから、
運んでもらった方が効率が良いと判断したのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I woke up just a moment ago. Not that it
changes that I merely let you carry me
because I was tired.

fields.EN: Thanks to you, I feel just splendid.
fields.JP: お陰で、ここまで楽だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks to you, I feel just splendid.

fields.EN:
(Gretel-san is totally sticking it to Hameln-san
right now.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさん、完全にハーメルンさんを
　あしらってるっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel is totally sticking it to Hameln
right now.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
How dare you make a servant of the Great
King of Evil! You're going to pay! Get off
of me!
fields.JP:
ぬっ、魔王である我を足代わりにするとはっ、
罰当たりなやつめ！
早く背中から降りるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you make a servant of the Great
King of Evil! You're going to pay! Get off
of me!

fields.JP: ええ、もちろんそのつもりよ……んっ

fields.EN:
I wonder why you are somehow able
to wield the Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
なぜあなたがメアリガンを使えるのかという
疑問はあるけれども
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder why you are somehow able
to wield the Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
Regardless, forgive me for the trouble
I have caused. Thank you for saving me.
fields.JP:
何にしても、迷惑を掛けたわね。
助けてくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, forgive me for the trouble
I have caused. Thank you for saving me.

fields.JP: あ、いや、礼には及ばないっすよ

fields.EN:
(I didn't expect her to thank me like that.
Weird.)
fields.JP:
（まさか素直にお礼を言われるなんて。
　意外で驚いたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't expect her to thank me like that.
Weird.)

fields.EN: That's right, Gretel! Pile on your thanks!
fields.JP:
そうだぞ、グレーテル。
もっと我にも感謝するのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's right, Gretel! Pile on your thanks!

fields.EN:
If I hadn't pinned you down, we never
would have purified you!
fields.JP:
我が貴様を取り押さえなければ、
浄化すらできなかったのだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I hadn't pinned you down, we never
would have purified you!

fields.EN: ...Right, point taken. Thank you, Demon King.
fields.JP:
……ええ、そうね。
流石大魔王、助かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Right, point taken. Thank you, Demon King.

fields.EN:
Fuhahaha! That was nothing!
Piece of cake for the Demon King.
fields.JP:
ふはははっ、あれくらい余裕余裕！
大魔王たる我にとっては朝飯前よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fuhahaha! That was nothing!
Piece of cake for the Demon King.

fields.EN:
How impressive, my liege. Since it's such
a piece of cake, I want you to fetch water
and chairs.
fields.JP:
本当にすごいわね大魔王。
余裕ついでに、水と椅子を用意してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
How impressive, my liege. Since it's such
a piece of cake, I want you to fetch water
and chairs.

fields.EN: Nuhahahaha! You make it too easy for me.
fields.JP:
ぬははははっ！
それくらい我にとっては容易いことよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Nuhahahaha! You make it too easy for me.

fields.EN: I see no chairs, would a cushion do?
fields.JP:
ここには椅子は無いが、
座布団のような物でよいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see no chairs, would a cushion do?

fields.JP: わかった、そこで待っているがよい

fields.EN:
Gretel's got Hameln on puppet strings.
She doesn't even realize she's putting
in work.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの使い方が上手いわね。
パシリにされてる事に気付いてなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's got Hameln on puppet strings.
She doesn't even realize she's putting
in work.

fields.EN:
Hameln-san is completely wrapped around
Gretel-san's finger...
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさん、グレーテルさんの手の上で、
完全に転がされてるっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Talk about wrapped around your finger.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
But seriously, I owe you my life. I can
recall nothing prior to purification.
fields.JP:
でも、本当に助かったわ。
浄化されるまでの事は、よく覚えていないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But seriously, I owe you my life. I can
recall nothing prior to purification.

fields.EN:
The last thing I remember is when Iron
Maiden of that group Genocide Pink
nearly killed me.
fields.JP:
自分が、アイアン・メイデンと呼ばれる
処刑台少女に殺されかけたことまでは、
覚えているのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The last thing I remember is when Iron
Maiden of that group Massacre Pink
nearly killed me.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: ...Seems like we're nowhere near that place.
fields.JP:
……どうやらここは、
あの時戦っていた場所とは全く違うようね
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Seems like we're nowhere near that place.

fields.EN:
Nor does it look like any of the others are
with us. It's unsettling. I have no idea what
transpired until I came to.
fields.JP:
見たところ、他の人もいないようだけれど？
目覚めるまでの間に自分に何が起きたのか、
理解が及ばなくて気持ちが悪いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nor does it look like any of the others are
with us. It's unsettling. I have no idea what
transpired until I came to.

fields.EN:
Oh, I'll get you up to speed. What
happened afterwards is...
fields.JP:
あ、それについては自分が教えるっす。
あの後、どうしたかって言うと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'll get you up to speed. What
happened afterwards is...

fields.JP: なるほど……そういうことだったのね

fields.EN:
The reason we escaped Genocide Pink is
thanks to Hikari-san's teleportation!
fields.JP:
はい、処刑台少女たちから逃げられたのは、
ヒカリさんのテレポートのお陰っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The reason we escaped Massacre Pink is
thanks to Hikari's teleportation!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Hey, I brought you your water and cushions.
fields.JP: おーい、水と座布団を持って来てやったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, I brought you your water and cushions.

fields.EN: Hey, why is the Demon King the one...
fields.JP:
というか、なぜ魔王の我が、
こんなことをしているのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, why is the Demon King the one...

fields.EN:
Enough. I'd like to share my hypothesis
as to why Clara can purify like Jack can.
fields.JP:
それよりも、なぜくららが
ジャックのように浄化できるようになったのか、
私なりに仮説を立ててみたのだけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough. I'd like to share my hypothesis
as to why Clara can purify like Jack can.

fields.EN: Oh! What'd you think of, Gretel-san?
fields.JP:
あ、はい！　グレーテルさんには
何かわかったんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! What'd you think of, Gretel?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: うおい！　我を無視するにゃ！

fields.EN:
I think I understand why Hikari told
Clara that she has Jack's purification
ability.
fields.JP:
恐らくヒカリが、くららに
『ジャックの浄化の力が宿っている』と
言ったということは
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think I understand why Hikari told
Clara that she has Jack's purification
ability.

fields.EN:
It may be due to her receiving Jack's blood
via transfusion after she was gravely injured.
fields.JP:
酷い怪我をしていたという点と合わせて、
ジャックの血を輸血されたから
ではないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It may be due to her receiving Jack's blood
via transfusion after she was gravely injured.

fields.EN:
Oh, the transfusion? I think I remember
hearing they gave me emergency treatment.
fields.JP:
えっ、輸血っすか？
そういえば治癒を受ける前に、
応急処置をしてたような事を聞いたっすが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, the transfusion? I think I remember
hearing they gave me emergency treatment.

fields.EN:
I suspect they determined that waiting
for Hikari to awake would spell doom for
you.
fields.JP:
ヒカリが目覚めるのを待っていたら、
大量出血でくららが手遅れになると、
判断したのでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suspect they determined that waiting
for Hikari to awake would spell doom for
you.

fields.EN:
Therefore, there's a high chance they used
Jack's blood in Clara's operation.
fields.JP:
応急処置として、くららに
ジャックの血を輸血した可能性が高いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Therefore, there's a high chance they used
Jack's blood in Clara's operation.

fields.EN: Hmm. But just because they're the same blood type, can a mere transfusion really change someone's abilities?
fields.JP:
ふぅん、でも同じ血液型だからって、
輸血しただけで能力が変わるものなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. So she inherited his abilities through
the transfusion?

fields.EN:
I once read a book related to how blood
transfusions can alter traits.
fields.JP:
輸血を行うことで、元の性質から変化する
ことがあると、本で読んだことがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I once read a book related to how blood
transfusions can alter traits.

fields.EN:
Sometimes, subjects note changes in
their food preferences, personalities,
and some even discover new talents.
fields.JP:
好物が急に変わったり性格に影響が出たり、
それこそ、今まで出来なかった事が、
出来るようなったり、ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sometimes, subjects note changes in
their food preferences, personalities,
and some even discover new talents.

fields.JP: （流石グレーテルさんは、物知りっす）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
So Clara's newfound purification ability
might be thanks to Jack's blood.
That seems the likeliest conclusion.
fields.JP:
くららが新しく得た浄化の力は、
ジャックの血を輸血された影響であると
考察するのが、一番納得性が高いでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Clara's newfound purification ability
might be thanks to Jack's blood.
That seems the likeliest conclusion.

fields.EN:
I see. I never even considered Jack-san giving
me his blood.
fields.JP:
そうっすか。ジャックさんが
自分に輸血をしてた可能性のことは
考えてなかったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. I never even considered Jack giving
me his blood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
If you were critical enough to need a blood
transfusion, I could see Jack doing it.
fields.JP:
小娘が一刻も早く輸血しなければならぬ
状況であったのなら、
ジャックならばやりかねぬ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you were critical enough to need a blood
transfusion, I could see Jack doing it.

fields.EN:
So it's not just Hikari-san who's saved me.
Jack-san has too.
fields.JP:
……自分は、ヒカリさんだけじゃなく、
ジャックさんにも命を救われてたんすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it's not just Hikari who's saved me.
Jack has too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: To think we'd go through something this terrifying on the surface I'd always dreamed of... I shudder to think what would've happened without those two.
fields.JP:
憧れの地上でこんな恐ろしい目に遭うなんて。
あの２人がいなかったらと思うと、
ぞっとするっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who could have guessed the surface
would be a pain in the ass for us? I'd hate
to know where we'd be without those two.

fields.EN:
Right, but it's not as though we're still
on the surface. With Marchens crawling
around, we're more likely in a Jail.
fields.JP:
そうね。でもここが地上とは限らないわ。
メルヒェンが出て来るということは、
ジェイルである可能性が高いもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, but it's not as though we're still
on the surface. With Marchens crawling
around, we're more likely in a Jail.

fields.EN:
Wh-Wha, yo ruh?! That whole grand escape,
and we're stuck in another Jail?!
fields.JP:
なにっ、そんな馬鹿にゃ！
離脱したはずなのに、
こ、ここもジェイルの中だったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Wha, yo ruh?! That whole grand escape,
and we're stuck in another Jail?!

fields.EN:
Yes. Though I do not think we're in the same
Jail as before.
fields.JP:
ええ、今まで私たちがいたジェイルと
同一とは限らないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Though I do not think we're in the same
Jail as before.

fields.EN: ...Oh, that reminds me. We saw it.
fields.JP:
……っ、それで思い出しました。
わたくしたち、見てしまったのです
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Oh, that reminds me. We saw it.

fields.EN:
R-Right. When we foraged the area for food,
we saw a black shadow. We suspect it was
a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
え、ええ……近場で食料を捜している時に、
黒い影を見たの。
あれはナイトメアのものだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-Right. When we foraged the area for food,
we saw a black shadow. We suspect it was
a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
When we saw the shadow, we panicked
and ran all the way here.
fields.JP:
影を見たわたくしたちは、
恐ろしくてここまで逃げて来たのです
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we saw the shadow, we panicked
and ran all the way here.

fields.EN:
(Ah, that explains why they seemed out
of breath earlier.)
fields.JP:
（それで、出迎えたにしては、
　妙に慌ててたんすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah, that explains why they seemed out
of breath earlier.)

fields.EN:
Ugh. Nightmares are here too?! Are you
absolutely certain?!
fields.JP:
ぬぅ、ナイトメアまでいたのか！？
何かと見間違えたのではないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Nightmares are here too?! Are you
absolutely certain?!

fields.EN: No, it was definitely a Nightmare. I've been killed by one before... That terror is something I couldn't forget even if I wanted to.
fields.JP:
いいえ、あれはきっと、ナイトメアよ。
あたし、一度殺されてるから……
あの恐怖は、忘れたくても忘れられないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Positive, it was a Nightmare. After what I've
gone through, I could never forget.

fields.EN:
I see. The appearance of Nightmares seems
to support my theory.
fields.JP:
そう。ナイトメアまで出たのならば、
私の予測は正しかったみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. The appearance of Nightmares seems
to support my theory.

fields.EN:
By that, I mean we can conclude we are
definitely inside a Jail.
fields.JP:
今居るここは、確実にジェイルの中であると
断言してもいいでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
By that, I mean we can conclude we are
definitely inside a Jail.

fields.EN:
So we should have broken out, but we're
back. How?
fields.JP:
自分たちは、ジェイルから
脱獄したはずなのに……なんで
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we should have broken out, but we're
back. How?

fields.EN:
There's even Nightmares crawling around.
Who's to say how much longer we can stay
here safely?
fields.JP:
……近くにナイトメアまで出るなんて。
この拠点が安全と言っていいのか、
ますますわからなくなったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's even Nightmares crawling around.
Who's to say how much longer we can stay
here safely?

fields.EN:
Genocide Pink, Jail, and the emergence of
this new mysterious, massive Jail tower.
My curiosity is more than piqued... Hehe.
fields.JP:
『処刑台少女』、『謎のジェイル』。
そしてそびえ立っていた『謎の巨大監獄塔』。
どれも知識欲が刺激される物ばかり……ふふっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Massacre Pink, Jail, and the emergence of
this new mysterious, massive Jail tower.
My curiosity is more than piqued... Hehe.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: まったく、貴様は相変わらずだな

fields.EN:
Hey, give me a second to think. We must
formulate a safe exit strategy.
fields.JP:
あら、これでも私なりに考えているのよ。
ここからより安全に脱出するためには、
何が必要かって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, give me a second to think. We must
formulate a safe exit strategy.

fields.EN:
Yes. Consider all the options as the sun
guides us to safety.
fields.JP:
はい、タイヨウのお導きのまま、
わたくしたちが出来る事を
探さなくてはいけませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Consider all the options as the sun
guides us to safety.

fields.EN:
