According to Hikari-san, the rest of our crew
were teleported somewhere nearby.
fields.JP:
ヒカリさんの話だと、あちこちに
テレポートで飛んだ仲間がいるはずっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
According to Hikari, the rest of our crew
were teleported somewhere nearby.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN: Why don't we band together to find them?!
fields.JP:
まずは、探索を続けながら、
仲間を捜して合流したいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we band together to find them?!

fields.EN:
Seems the most reasonable course of action
for now. No objections from me.
fields.JP:
それが一番現実的な対策でしょうね。
私としても、異論はないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems the most reasonable course of action
for now. No objections from me.

fields.EN:
Ugh. So now you've got your sanity back,
you think you can boss us around? Figures.
fields.JP:
まったく、正気になったらなったで
偉そうと言うか、鬱陶しいやつだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. So now you've got your sanity back,
you think you can boss us around? Figures.

fields.JP: ハーメルンほどじゃないわ

fields.EN:
Oh, come to think of it... When you were in
Blood Skelter, your outfit looked different.
fields.JP:
むっ……そういえば貴様、
ブラッドスケルター化していた時に、
前と模様が少し変わっておったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come to think of it... When you were in
Blood Skelter, your outfit looked different.

fields.JP:
あら、そうだったの？
それは興味深いわね

fields.EN:
Even so, I couldn't tell you why. It certainly
wasn't intentional. We can look into it later.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、今はその理由は分からないし、
現象として何か変化がある訳ではないし、
詳しく調べるのは保留にしておきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I couldn't tell you why. It certainly
wasn't intentional. We can look into it later.

fields.EN:
Hameln-san, you sure are observant. I don't know
how you noticed that in the heat of battle.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさん、あの激闘の中で、
よくそんな細かい事に気付くっすね。
やっぱり場数を踏んだ人は違うっすねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, you sure are observant. I don't know
how you noticed that in the heat of battle.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
HAHAHA! Right? Nothing escapes my keen
eye!
fields.JP:
わはははっ、そうであろう？
我の観察眼は、優れておるからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HAHAHA! Right? Nothing escapes my keen
eye!

fields.EN:
There you go again. You never miss an
opportunity to big yourself up. Everyone
must be exhausted. Let's get some sleep.
fields.JP:
もう、すぐ調子に乗るんだから。
みんなも今日は疲れたでしょう？
明日のためにも、よく休みなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again. You never miss an
opportunity to big yourself up. Everyone
must be exhausted. Let's get some sleep.

fields.EN:
Yup. Everyone, rest up so we can kickstart
our trip tomorrow!
fields.JP:
はい、しっかり休んで、
明日からまた探索を再開するっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Everyone, rest up so we can kickstart
our trip tomorrow!

fields.EN:
Hey, that little area seems peculiar.
What is it...?
fields.JP:
あれ、あっちに妙な空間があるっすね。
ちょっと気になるっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, that little area seems peculiar.
What is it...?

fields.EN: Yes, I notice it too. Let's investigate.
fields.JP:
ええ、私も興味がそそられるわ。
探索してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I notice it too. Let's investigate.

fields.EN:
Hey, no giving out commands! I'm leading
the team around here.
fields.JP:
こらっ、貴様が仕切るでない！
探索チームのリーダーは、この我であるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, no giving out commands! I'm leading
the team around here.

fields.EN:
Since when? I wasn't informed. Very well.
I'll leave the Marchen to you, leader.
fields.JP:
いつそう決まったのかは疑問だけれど。
じゃあ、メルヒェンが出たら、
露払いは任せたわよ。リーダー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since when? I wasn't informed. Very well.
I'll leave the Marchen to you, leader.

fields.JP: うむ、我に任せるがよい！

fields.EN:
(There she goes again. Being bossed around
without even knowing it.)
fields.JP: （やっぱり手の上で転がされてるっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes again. Being bossed around
without even knowing it.)

fields.EN: Oh? This room is... Wait, is that a core?
fields.JP:
む？　この部屋は……
もしかすると、あそこにあるのは
核ではないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? This room is... Wait, is that a core?

fields.EN: Ah, correct. That is the Jail's core.
fields.JP:
あら、本当だわ。
あれは間違い無くジェイルの核ね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, correct. That is the Jail's core.

fields.EN:
Which further proves that we're inside of
a Jail, no?
fields.JP:
やはりこれがあるということは、
この場所がジェイルである証ということか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which further proves that we're inside of
a Jail, no?

fields.EN: If I remember right, destroying the core makes a Nightmare lose its immortality, right?
fields.JP:
確か、核を破壊すると、
ナイトメアの不死性が失われるんすよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. If we destroy it, then the Nightmares
become vulnerable, right?

fields.EN:
That's right. Unless we destroy it ourselves,
we have no hope of stopping the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
そう。核を破壊しない限り、
ナイトメアを倒すことはできない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Unless we destroy it ourselves,
we have no hope of stopping the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Might not be what we set out to do at
first, but seeing how worried Kaede-san and
Sukui were, we should destroy it, right?
fields.JP:
当初の目的とは違うっすけど……
カエデさんたちもナイトメアを気にしてたし、
破壊した方がいいっすよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might not be what we set out to do at
first, but seeing how worried Kaede and
Sukui were, we should destroy it, right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
Nuhahahaha! Leave it to me.
I'll smash that core into a million pieces!
fields.JP:
ぬはははっ！　我に任せるがよい、
すぐに核を破壊してやるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nuhahahaha! Leave it to me.
I'll smash that core into a million pieces!

fields.JP: あっ！　行っちゃったっす！

ハーメルン、待ちなさい！
何かいるわ

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
Grr! Must you be the guardian of the core?!
You're blocking my way!
fields.JP:
ぬっ！　我の行く手を阻むとは、
もしや貴様は、核の番人か！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr! Must you be the guardian of the core?!
You're blocking my way!

fields.EN:
Ugh, so predictable. Very well, let's deal
with him.
fields.JP:
はぁ、だから言ったのに……
仕方ないわね、先にこいつから片付けるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, so predictable. Very well, let's deal
with him.

fields.EN:
Wooow. We defeated the guardian.
Good job!
fields.JP:
はぁぁ、番人を倒せたみたいっすね。
お疲れ様っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wooow. We defeated the guardian.
Good job!

fields.EN: I see. Having a guardian at the core is something this has in common with the underground Jail, too.
fields.JP:
なるほど、核に番人がいるのも、
地下のジェイルと共通しているのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Looks like we've only seen the
beginning of just how many guardians
there are across all of these Jails.

fields.EN:
I wonder how similar they are in relation
to the original Jail.
fields.JP:
どこまでが今までのジェイルと
共通しているのかしら、調べてみたいわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how similar they are in relation
to the original Jail.

fields.EN:
There you go, Gretel. On one of your
rambles again. Let's destroy the core
before a Nightmare shows up.
fields.JP:
こらっ、グレーテルの悪い癖が出ておるぞ
ナイトメアが出没する前に、
まずは核の破壊を優先せねばなるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go, Gretel. On one of your
rambles again. Let's destroy the core
before a Nightmare shows up.

fields.EN:
Right. I'll leave the dirty work to you,
Hameln.
fields.JP:
そうね、そういう面倒くさい荒事は
ハーメルンに任せるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I'll leave the dirty work to you,
Hameln.

fields.EN:
Damn you. Maybe a show of gratitude
would be nice, but leave it to me!
URYAAAAAAH!
fields.JP:
……貴様の言い方は微妙に引っかかるが、
ここは我に任せるがよい！
うおりゃぁぁっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn you. Maybe a show of gratitude
would be nice, but leave it to me!
URYAAAAAAH!

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
Wahahaha! I'll show you pipsqueaks
how it's done!
fields.JP:
わはははっ、我の手にかかれば
ざっとこんなものよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wahahaha! I'll show you pipsqueaks
how it's done!

fields.EN: Hey! I just heard something really creepy.
fields.JP:
お疲れ様っす！
今、すごく不気味な声が聞こえたっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! I just heard something really creepy.

fields.EN: That's the Jail's scream. Proof that the core has been destroyed. The Nightmare is no longer immortal.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの悲鳴よ。核が破壊出来た証ね。
これでナイトメアが不死者ではなくなったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That would be the Jail's scream. Proof that
the core has been broken. Now to confront
that Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Nightmawe or not, I'll snuff it out!
Fuhahaha! *cough*!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが出ても我が倒してくれりゅわ！
ふははははっ！　ぶべっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmawe or not, I'll snuff it out!
Fuhahaha! *cough*!

fields.EN: Oh! Hameln-san, are you okay? Are you hurt?
fields.JP:
あっ！　ハーメルンさん、大丈夫っすか？
怪我してないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! Hameln, are you okay? Are you hurt?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Grr! Blame this accursed stone! No fair.
How dare it stand in my way!
fields.JP:
ぬぅ、この石が悪いのだ！
我が足を運んだ先にあるとは、卑怯なり！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr! Blame this accursed stone! No fair.
How dare it stand in my way!

fields.EN:
It's because you prance about without
bothering to watch where you're going.
fields.JP:
有頂天状態のまま、
足元を見ないで進もうとするからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because you prance about without
bothering to watch where you're going.

fields.EN:
If you keep your guard down, it'll only be
more troublesome. Jot this down while you
can. Stay alert while we search, everyone.
fields.JP:
油断していると足を掬われるという、
お手本のような行動ね。
私たちは油断せずに探索を続けましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you keep your guard down, it'll only be
more troublesome. Jot this down while you
can. Stay alert while we search, everyone.

fields.JP: わ、わかったっす！　気を引き締めるっす！

fields.EN:
Wamn you, Gretel! Don't make an example
out of me!
fields.JP:
おにょれ～、グレーテルめ。
我を教訓扱いするでないっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wamn you, Gwetel. Don't make an example
out of me!

fields.EN:
Noted. Perhaps if you didn't make one out
of yourself, I wouldn't have to.
fields.JP:
そうね。模範にすべきいいお手本を
見せてくれたら、その時は考えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Noted. Perhaps if you didn't make one out
of yourself, I wouldn't have to.

fields.JP: ぬ？　そこにいるのはナイトメアではないか？

fields.EN: Ah... At long last, we've found one.
fields.JP: うっ……ついに出たっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah... At long last, we've found one.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Great timing. Let's get this thing over
with.
fields.JP:
くくく、いいタイミングだったな。
早速片付けてやろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Great timing. Let's get this thing over
with.

fields.EN:
Hahahaha. Aren't you glad we destroyed that
core earlier?! Now let's get on with it!
fields.JP:
ぬははっ、さっき核を破壊しておいて
正解だったな！
では、貴様ら、ゆくぞーーーーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha. Aren't you glad we destroyed that
core earlier?! Now let's get on with it!

fields.JP: 待ちなさい、ハーメルン

fields.EN:
*huff, puff* Just what is your deal, Gretel?!
Y-You made me choke.
fields.JP:
ぜーっ、はーっ、何をするグレーテルっ！
い、息が詰まったではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
*huff, puff* Just what is your deal, Gretel?!
Y-You made me choke.

fields.JP: 考え無しに突撃しようとするからよ

fields.EN:
What's wrong with me charging in?!
The core's already long-gone! Let go!
Let go of me!
fields.JP:
核を破壊したのに、倒しに行って何が悪いっ！
離せっ、離さぬかーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's wrong with me charging in?!
The core's already long-gone! Let go!
Let go of me!

fields.EN:
Ignore Hameln for now. Bear in mind that
this Jail is different from the others we've
seen.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは置いといて。
ここは、今までのジェイルとは
違うということを念頭に置かないといけないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ignore Hameln for now. Bear in mind that
this Jail is different from the others we've
seen.

fields.EN:
Past logic would dictate that removing the
core renders the Nightmare vulnerable.
fields.JP:
いままでの法則通りなら、ナイトメアの
不死性は既に失われているはずだけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Past logic would dictate that removing the
core renders the Nightmare vulnerable.

fields.EN:
But it seems this tower plays by slightly
different rules from the underground Jail.
What if we're wrong about the Nightmares?
fields.JP:
けれど、ここは地下とは、似て非なる場所よ。
ナイトメアの性質も未知数なのに、ろくに
確かめもせずに特攻したらどうなると思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it seems this tower plays by slightly
different rules from the underground Jail.
What if we're wrong about the Nightmares?

fields.EN:
Seems risky to assume things are exactly
the same in here.
fields.JP:
もしも今までと法則が違っていたら、
かなりヤバイっすよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems risky to assume things are exactly
the same in here.

fields.EN:
Hm. R-Really...? How do you suppose we test
your hypothesis?
fields.JP:
むっ……そ、そうなのか。
だが、どうやって強さを確かめるのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. R-Really...? How do you suppose we test
your hypothesis?

fields.EN:
Well of course, the best course of action
would be to fight it and record the data.
fields.JP:
それはもちろん、実際に戦って
データを得るしかないでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well of course, the best course of action
would be to fight it and record the data.

fields.EN:
If our challenge determines that it is still
invincible, we'll flee immediately. Got it?
fields.JP:
その上で、不死性だと判明したら、
すぐさまこの場を離脱すること。いいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If our challenge determines that it is still
invincible, we'll flee immediately. Got it?

fields.EN: Keep that in mind as we proceed.
fields.JP:
以上のことを念頭において、
さあ、行くわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Keep that in mind as we proceed.

fields.EN:
Oh, so now we're proceeding...
Why did you bother stopping me?
fields.JP:
いや、『さあ、行くわよ』って……
ならば、何で我は止められたのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so now we're proceeding...
Why did you bother stopping me?

fields.EN:
Oh, will you not be joining us, Hameln?
Don't let me keep you.
fields.JP:
あら、ハーメルンは行かないの？
私は行かせてもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, will you not be joining us, Hameln?
Don't let me keep you.

fields.EN:
I-I'm going too! This is all the Nightmare's
fault! That thing doesn't know what's coming!
fields.JP:
わっ、我も行くぞ！
それもこれも、全部ナイトメアが悪いのだ！
理不尽な想いは、全てヤツにぶつけてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm going too! This is all the Nightmare's
fault! That thing doesn't know what's coming!

fields.JP: 改めて、突撃するぞーーー！
はい、気をつけて下さいっす！
待って。様子がおかしいわ

fields.EN: HEY GRETEL! Quit interrupting our charge!
fields.JP:
くおらぁっ、グレーテルっ！
いい加減、寸止めするのはやめるのだーっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: HEY GRETEL! Quit interrupting our charge!

fields.EN: Are you blind? The Nightmare isn't moving.
fields.JP:
貴女、気付いていないの？
あのナイトメア、さっきから
停止しているみたいだけれど
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you blind? The Nightmare isn't moving.

fields.JP: な、なに？　そんな馬鹿な！？

fields.EN:
See. It's still. As if it doesn't know we're
here.
fields.JP:
ほら、こうして近づいてみても、
全く反応を見せない
fields.LOCALIZED:
See. It's still. As if it doesn't know we're
here.

fields.EN:
Seriously. I don't believe this. I'll wave at it.
Helloooo. Over here!
fields.JP:
いやいや、そんなまさか。
ほれほれ～、手を振ってやろう。
我はここにいるぞ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. I don't believe this. I'll wave at it.
Helloooo. Over here!

fields.EN:
I-It's really oblivious. Didn't even glance
at Hameln-san.
fields.JP:
ほ、本当に無反応っすね。
ハーメルンさんの方を、
チラリとも見てないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-It's really oblivious. Didn't even glance
at Hameln.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP:
自分、ちょっと、
つついてみてもいいっすか？

fields.EN:
No, that's dangerous. Stay back. We know
at least that it's unresponsive when called.
fields.JP:
いや危険だわ、やめておきましょう。
ただ声を掛けても反応はないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's dangerous. Stay back. We know
at least that it's unresponsive when called.

fields.EN:
What's going on? I've never seen such a
lazy Nightmare.
fields.JP:
まったく、こやつはどうしたというのだ。
こんなやる気の無いナイトメアは、
初めて見たぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's going on? I've never seen such a
lazy Nightmare.

fields.EN:
What should we do about it? Should we
destroy it?
fields.JP:
このナイトメア、どうするっす？
倒すべきなんすかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should we do about it? Should we
destroy it?

fields.EN:
Well, if it's not engaging with us, then
there's no need to waste time in battle.
Let's go.
fields.JP:
いえ、動かないのなら、
ここで無意味に戦う必要はないわ。
このままにして去りましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if it's not engaging with us, then
there's no need to waste time in battle.
Let's go.

fields.EN:
Besides, I wouldn't want to risk injury
if it were to get the jump on us.
fields.JP:
それに、下手に攻撃をしたことで、
急に予測不能な動きをされた方が困るもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I wouldn't want to risk injury
if it were to get the jump on us.

fields.EN:
Right. Besides, there's no challenge in
crushing a foe that doesn't move. You
live to see another day, cretin.
fields.JP:
うむ。我としても無抵抗のヤツと
やり合ってもつまらぬしな。
この場は見逃してやるとしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Besides, there's no challenge in
crushing a foe that doesn't move. You
live to see another day, cretin.

fields.EN:
What could it all mean? I have never seen
anything like it, nor do I recall Tsuu
mentioning anything similar.
fields.JP:
それにしても、これはいったい……
こんな現象今まで見たことも、
つうに聞いたこともないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What could it all mean? I have never seen
anything like it, nor do I recall Otsuu
mentioning anything similar.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I'm still curious what was up with that
Nightmare.
fields.JP:
本当に、さっきのナイトメアって、
なんだったんすかね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still curious what was up with that
Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Sure beats me! Maybe even Nightmares
have off days. Maybe it was snoozing.
fields.JP:
さっぱりわからん！
だが、案外ナイトメアにも、不調な時や
絶好調な時があるのやも知れぬな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure beats me! Maybe even Nightmares
have off days. Maybe it was snoozing.

fields.EN: Normally, that shouldn't be possible. But maybe that Nightmare is one of the things that makes this Jail different from the usual ones.
fields.JP:
本来、そんな事はあり得ないはずだけれど。
いつものジェイルと違う部分の一つが、
あのナイトメアとも考えられるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normally I would object, but there's no
doubt this Nightmare seems disparate
from the rest of the Jail.

fields.EN: Everything looks the same, but slightly off.
fields.JP:
いつもと似ているようでいて違うと、
変な感じがするっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Everything looks the same, but slightly off.

fields.EN:
Ugh. Just as I was getting in the mood
to fight. What a letdown.
fields.JP:
せっかく我がやる気満々だったというのに、
拍子抜けもいいところなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Just as I was getting in the mood
to fight. What a letdown.

fields.EN: Hm? What's that? Something's back there.
fields.JP:
うん？　なんなのだアレは。
奥の方に妙なものが見えたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? What's that? Something's back there.

fields.EN: I saw it too. Wanna go towards it?
fields.JP:
自分にも見えたっす。
ちょっと行ってみるっすか
fields.LOCALIZED: I saw it too. Wanna go towards it?

fields.EN: Whoa. It's huge! And it's floating!
fields.JP:
うわ、大きいっすね！
しかも宙に浮いてるっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa. It's huge! And it's floating!

fields.EN:
Huh? Something's swirling inside of it.
How bizarre.
fields.JP:
むむっ？　渦のようにぐるぐると
蠢いておるな。
奇妙な物もあったものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Something's swirling inside of it.
How bizarre.

fields.EN:
Interesting. I've never seen anything like it.
We must do a closer examination.
fields.JP:
……興味深いわね。
こんな物は今まで見たことがないわ。
詳しく調査してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting. I've never seen anything like it.
We must do a closer examination.

fields.EN:
Look at Gretel. She's so excited. She loves a
good mystery.
fields.JP:
グレーテルのやつ、顔を輝かせているのだ。
あやつは、この手の謎には目がないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at Gretel. She's so excited. She loves a
good mystery.

fields.EN:
What is this thing? Is it a threat? A trap?
I'm curious too.
fields.JP:
これって、何なんすかね？
敵っすか？　それともトラップっすか？
自分も、気になるっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is this thing? Is it a threat? A trap?
I'm curious too.

fields.EN:
It doesn't seem sentient, but I do detect
energy radiating from within it.
fields.JP:
どうも、生命体ではなさそうだわ。
何らかのエネルギーのような物が、
渦状になって動いているようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It doesn't seem sentient, but I do detect
energy radiating from within it.

fields.EN: The orb is approximately 180 cm in diameter.
fields.JP:
球体の大きさは、おおよそ
直径１８０ｃｍといったところかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: The orb is approximately 180 cm in diameter.

fields.EN: Right. Big enough for us to go inside.
fields.JP:
そうっすね。自分たちの全身が、
すっぽり入りそうなくらい大きいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Big enough for us to go inside.

fields.EN:
Maybe the swirling...is some connection
to the outside. That would be something.
fields.JP:
もしかすると、この渦の動きは……
どこか別の場所と繋がっている可能性も
考えられるわね、ますます興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe the swirling...is some connection
to the outside. That would be something.

fields.EN:
Oh, you think it's a warp device! Wow,
that's mindblowing!
fields.JP:
えっ、じゃあワープ装置かもってことっすか？
うわぁ、自分も気になるっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you think it's a warp device! Wow,
that's mindblowing!

fields.EN:
There's no telling where that orb leads.
Mindlessly entering it carries the chance
of dismemberment.
fields.JP:
ただ、渦状ということを考えると、
うかつに中に入ってしまったら、身体が
バラバラにされる可能性も十分あるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling where that orb leads.
Mindlessly entering it carries the chance
of dismemberment.

fields.EN:
What?! Like ripping our bodies to shreds?!
N-No, I don't want that!
fields.JP:
なぬ？　身体がバラバラに！？
そ、それは嫌すぎるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Like ripping our bodies to shreds?!
N-No, I don't want that!

fields.EN:
Why don't we toss a rock in to see what
becomes of it?
fields.JP:
渦に入った場合、どうなるか。
まずは、石を投げて試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we toss a rock in to see what
becomes of it?

fields.EN:
Hopefully there's a rock of adequate size
placed conveniently nearby.
fields.JP:
ちょうどいいサイズの石が、
どこかに落ちていないかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hopefully there's a rock of adequate size
placed conveniently nearby.

fields.EN:
Hmm. The more I look at it, the more
mysterious it is. How annoying. Circle,
circle, ciiiircle circle....circle circle.
fields.JP:
うーむ。見れば見るほど面妖な物体なのだ。
グルグルして、何だか生意気なやつだなー。
ぐるぐる……ぐーるぐる……ぐるぐる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. The more I look at it, the more
mysterious it is. How annoying. Circle,
circle, ciiiircle circle....circle circle.

fields.EN: Wh-What's the matter, Hameln-san? Are you sick?
fields.JP:
ど、どうしたっすか、ハーメルンさん
具合でも悪いっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wh-What's the matter, Hameln? Are you sick?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Urp. I was staring at the swirl, saw it going
round and round and got dizzy... I think I'm
gonna be sick.
fields.JP:
ううっ、渦をじっと見つめていたら、
グルグルし過ぎて目が回ったのだ……
ぎ、ぎぼちわるい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Urp. I was staring at the swirl, saw it going
round and round and got dizzy... I think I'm
gonna be sick.

fields.EN:
No! Hameln-san! Oh no, Gretel-san! Hameln-san got
sucked in!
fields.JP:
ああっ！　ハーメルンさんがっ！？
グレーテルさん大変っす、
ハーメルンさんが渦に吸い込まれたっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Hameln! Oh no, Gretel! Hameln got
sucked in!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san; グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
What? Ugh, what ever will we do with her?
We haven't even finished our investigation,
and there she goes, acting recklessly.
fields.JP:
なんですって？
まったく、まだ調査が終わっていないのに、
いつも考えなしな行動ばかりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Ugh, what ever will we do with her?
We haven't even finished our investigation,
and there she goes, acting recklessly.

fields.EN: HEY! Who you calling reckless! I can hear you!
fields.JP:
こらーっ、誰が考えなしにゃ！
しっかり聞こえておりゅぞ～～！
fields.LOCALIZED: HEY! Who you calling reckless! I can hear you!

fields.EN: Oh, thank goodness you're safe, Hameln-san!
fields.JP: ほっ、ハーメルンさん、無事だったっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, thank goodness you're safe, Hameln!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP: うむ、全くもって何一つ問題無いぞ！

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Well, if that really is her, then
going in shouldn't pose a problem.
fields.JP:
……はぁ。
まぁ、あれだけ呑気な声が出せるのなら、
本当に入っても問題はないようね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... Well, if that really is her, then
going in shouldn't pose a problem.

fields.EN:
You too, Gretel-san?! I guess she did end up
safe in there. Maybe it's not scary after
all.
fields.JP:
あっ、グレーテルさんまで！
うーん、躊躇いなく入ってたし、
そんなに怖くない物なんすかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Gretel?! I guess she did end up
safe in there. Maybe it's not scary after
all.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP:
よし、自分も行くっす。
……ええい、ままよ！

fields.EN: I'm looking for my beloved wife.
fields.JP: 最愛の妻を探している
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm looking for my beloved wife.

fields.EN:
The woman with an eternal smile, forever
at my side...
fields.JP:
どんな時でも笑顔を崩さず、
僕をずっと支え続けてくれただろう、女性だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The woman with an eternal smile, forever
at my side...

fields.EN:
How long is forever, really? The strange
thought grips me.
fields.JP:
おかしな言い方だな、
と自分でも思わずにはいられない
fields.LOCALIZED:
How long is forever, really? The strange
thought grips me.

fields.EN:
Though I can't help but think it. The reason
being that I barely remember anything.
fields.JP:
だがそう表現するより他はない。
何故なら、僕にはほとんどの記憶がないからだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though I can't help but think it. The reason
being that I barely remember anything.

fields.EN:
Only one photo of her survives, and with it,
her smile lives in my memory. It's all I have
of her, along with some of her last words.
fields.JP:
たった１枚残された写真のように、
脳裏に浮かび上がる、とびきり美しい妻の笑顔。
彼女の記憶は、それと少しの言葉くらいしかない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only one photo of her survives, and with it,
her smile lives in my memory. It's all I have
of her, along with some of her last words.

fields.JP: そして、他に覚えていたことと言えば――

fields.EN: The only other things I remembered were that I'm a 'Blood Youth' and that I am a 'Jail Tower'.
fields.JP:
自分が『血式少年』であることと、
『監獄塔』である、ということだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...of myself as a Blood Youth, and of the
Jail.

fields.EN: But that alone does not make a man.
fields.JP:
正直、それだけでは、
自分が何者であるかなど分かりやしない
fields.LOCALIZED: But that alone does not make a man.

fields.EN:
Ever since I awoke in the Liberated District,
I searched for my identity. But no clues arose.
fields.JP:
だから、解放地区で気がついてから、
しばらく自分のことを探ってみた。
だが手がかりはまったく得られなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since I awoke in the Liberated District,
I searched for my identity. But no clues arose.

fields.EN:
It would be a lie to say it hadn't bothered
me. But out of self-preservation, I came to
realize how little it mattered.
fields.JP:
それに対して、焦りがなかったと言えば嘘になる。
だが、冷静になればなるほど、そんなことは
どうでもいいのだと気づいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would be a lie to say it hadn't bothered
me. But out of self-preservation, I came to
realize how little it mattered.

fields.EN:
All that matters is reuniting with my wife's
tender smile.
fields.JP:
あの柔らかく笑う妻と再会すること、
それだけが僕の望みだったのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that matters is reuniting with my wife's
tender smile.

fields.EN:
Until...I was granted the chance to ascend
to the surface.
fields.JP:
――そんな時だった。
ちょうど地上へ行く方法が見つかったと、
知らせが舞い込んだのは
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until...I was granted the chance to ascend
to the surface.

fields.EN:
No longer was I captive to the Jail. My wife
could be alive on the surface, so without
thinking twice I took my chance.
fields.JP:
きっとこんな狭い地下監獄よりも、
地上の方が遥かに妻のいる可能性は高いだろう。
そう思い、僕は迷うことなく地上へと向かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
No longer was I captive to the Jail. My wife
could be alive on the surface, so without
thinking twice I took my chance.

fields.EN:
But awaiting us on the surface was a fate
worse than death, Genocide Pink...
fields.JP:
しかし待ち受けていたのは『処刑台少女』という、
人の形をした化け物たちだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But awaiting us on the surface was a fate
worse than death, Massacre Pink...
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
And they lived up to their namesake.
Brutality. Victims stabbed, wrung, mutilated.
Murdered without thought.
fields.JP:
すぐに殺戮の宴が始まり、
人々は千切られ、括られ、切り刻まれ、
いとも簡単に殺されていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And they lived up to their namesake.
Brutality. Victims stabbed, wrung, mutilated.
Murdered without thought.

fields.EN:
A storm of oppressive, inescapable violence.
Their victims were helpless.
fields.JP:
圧倒的な暴力の嵐――
そんな感想が簡単に出てくるくらいだ、
人々に為す術などなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
A storm of oppressive, inescapable violence.
Their victims were helpless.

fields.EN:
We could only run or hide. No other choice.
A sobering truth.
fields.JP:
後はできることと言ったら、逃げるか隠れるか。
それ以外に行動の選択肢はないんだと、
僕自身、痛いほどよく知っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
We could only run or hide. No other choice.
A sobering truth.

fields.EN: Huh...? But how do I remember that?
fields.JP:
……ん？　どうして僕はそんなことを
痛いほど知っているんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh...? But how do I remember that?

fields.EN:
The lost memories take longer to recall,
but their lucidity survives.
fields.JP:
まあ、失った記憶の中にそんな知識が
あったんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The lost memories take longer to recall,
but their lucidity survives.

fields.EN: That doesn't matter for now. Only survival.
fields.JP:
そんなことは今はどうでもいい。
とにかく、何とかやり過ごさねばならなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: That doesn't matter for now. Only survival.

fields.EN:
I began to observe. Genocide Pink slaughtered
victims who fled. Which meant my only choice
was to hide.
fields.JP:
冷静に周りを観察すると、処刑台少女は
逃げる人間から殺していることが分かった。
となれば、選択肢は『隠れる』しかなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I began to observe. Massacre Pink slaughtered
victims who fled. Which meant my only choice
was to hide.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
I made an effort to stay hidden among the
mountain of corpses. I feigned my own death.
fields.JP:
なるべく目立たないように、
積み上がった死体の山に身を潜めようと動く。
死体のふりをしてやり過ごすのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I made an effort to stay hidden among the
mountain of corpses. I feigned my own death.

fields.EN:
It may sound pathetic, but I couldn't care
less. I needed to survive to find my wife.
fields.JP:
端から見たら情けない姿かもしれない。
だがそれこそどうでもいいことだ。
僕は生きて妻に会わなければいけないのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It may sound pathetic, but I couldn't care
less. I needed to survive to find my wife.

fields.EN:
...Don't continue down this path.
You may lose yourself.
fields.JP:
……それ以上はいけない。
自分を見失ってしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Don't continue down this path.
You may lose yourself.

fields.JP:
その手に持ってるのは……
メアリガン……？

fields.EN:
That's not important. Can you stand?
Get up, even if it hurts. Now's our chance
to run for it.
fields.JP:
そんなことはどうでもいい。
立てるか？　いや、無理にでも立て。
今のうちに逃げるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not important. Can you stand?
Get up, even if it hurts. Now's our chance
to run for it.

fields.EN:
Seeing that Blood Maiden suffer tightened
my heart in my chest.
fields.JP:
思わずあの、血式少女といったか――
彼女達の悲痛な顔を見たら、胸がチクチクとしたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing that Blood Maiden suffer tightened
my heart in my chest.

fields.EN:
Being a Blood Youth, I knew what I could do.
It gave me the resolve to fire off the Mary
Gun.
fields.JP:
『血式少年』である自分は、
その役割についてもちゃんと理解していた。
だからとっさに、メアリガンを撃つことができた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being a Blood Youth, I knew what I could do.
It gave me the resolve to fire off the Mary
Gun.

fields.EN: I already had this Mary Gun when I woke up with no memory. I only kept it because I had no reason to let it go.
fields.JP:
このメアリガンは、記憶を失って目が覚めた時に
すでに所持していたものだ。手放すだけの理由が
なかったから持っていたに過ぎないが
fields.LOCALIZED:
The weapon was in my possession when
I had awoke. Despite my amnesia, I knew
enough to keep it with me.

fields.EN: Anyway, thanks to that, it seems the girl called Akazukin was safely restored to normal.
fields.JP:
ともあれ、そのおかげで赤ずきんという少女は
無事に正常な状態に戻ることができたようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to that, the Red Riding Hood girl
lived.

fields.EN: But these girls called Blood Maidens seemed to be the only ones trying to fight them. Wouldn't staying with them put me in danger too?
fields.JP:
しかし、この血式少女と呼ばれる少女たちは、
唯一奴らと戦おうとしていたみたいだが、
一緒にいると僕の身も危険ではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the other Blood Maidens attempted to
retaliate on her behalf. Logic dictated that
the situation was untenable for my safety.

fields.EN:
My priority had to be finding my wife, hence
why I fled the scene.
fields.JP:
それは困る。僕は妻に会わなければいけないのだ。
だから早々にその場を去った
fields.LOCALIZED:
My priority had to be finding my wife, hence
why I fled the scene.

fields.EN:
Come to think of it, why had I saved her?
Was it worth risking my life? I am still a
mystery, even to myself.
fields.JP:
今にして思えば、何故そんな行動を取ったのか。
自らの命を秤にかけてまでやることだったのか？
まったくもって自分が理解できない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come to think of it, why had I saved her?
Was it worth risking my life? I am still a
mystery, even to myself.

fields.EN:
The more things unfold, the more they confuse
me. As I attempted to flee the Blood Maidens,
I suddenly began to float.
fields.JP:
そして事態はますます意味が分からなくなる。
血式少女たちのもとから去ろうとした時、
突然、僕の身体が宙に浮いたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more things unfold, the more they confuse
me. As I attempted to flee the Blood Maidens,
I suddenly began to float.

fields.EN:
When I came to, I found myself having been
teleported to this cold place.
fields.JP:
で、気づけばこんな寒い空間に
飛ばされてしまったというわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I came to, I found myself having been
teleported to this cold place.

fields.EN:
I care nothing for what becomes of this world
and its inhabitants. I have other priorities.
fields.JP:
――正直な話、この世界がどうなろうが、
周りにいた人間がどうなろうが知ったことではない。
僕には、何よりも優先すべきことがあるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I care nothing for what becomes of this world
and its inhabitants. I have other priorities.

fields.EN:
I must find my wife. I must hear her voice,
hear everything I've missed.
fields.JP:
妻に会って、話がしたい。
まだまだ話したいことがたくさんあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must find my wife. I must hear her voice,
hear everything I've missed.

fields.EN:
Her flower-like smile and her love drive
me forward. Though I must remind myself
that slow and steady wins the race.
fields.JP:
ほんの僅かな愛の思い出と、花のような笑顔。
そして記憶の果ての彼女が呟く、
『急がば回れ』という言葉……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her flower-like smile and her love drive
me forward. Though I must remind myself
that slow and steady wins the race.

fields.EN:
I must remember. I must see out my task.
I must do whatever it takes to reunite with
her.
fields.JP:
これらを胸に、これから何をすべきか、
どうすれば彼女に再会できるのか、
しっかりと考えていかねば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must remember. I must see out my task.
I must do whatever it takes to reunite with
her.

fields.EN: (Where am I? Why am I here?)
fields.JP:
（どこだ、ここは。
　どうしていきなりこんな場所に……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Where am I? Why am I here?)

fields.EN: (Ugh, it's cold. Ice everywhere. If I'd woken up a little later, I might have gotten frostbite.)
fields.JP:
（くっ、寒いな。一面氷だらけとは。
　もう少し目覚めるのが遅かったら、
　凍傷になってたかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. It's cold. As ice. I could've frozen to
death in here.)

fields.EN:
(First the surface is littered with corpses.
Now I'm here... This makes no sense.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、死体だらけの大地かと思えば、
　全然知らない空間――まったくもって意味不明だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(First the surface is littered with corpses.
Now I'm here... This makes no sense.)

fields.JP: （僕はまた記憶喪失になったのか？）

fields.EN:
(No. I remember. I tried to flee once
Genocide Pink started attacking.)
fields.JP:
（いや、違う。ちゃんと覚えている。
　処刑台少女に襲われて、身を隠そうとしてたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No. I remember. I tried to flee once
Massacre Pink started attacking.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(The last thing I remember is floating...
Ah. Yes. That girl who carried us to the
surface. It must be her doing.)
fields.JP:
（確か覚えている最後は、身体が宙に浮いて……
　そうか、地上に出る時に全員を運んだ、
　あの人外の女の仕業に違いない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The last thing I remember is floating...
Ah. Yes. That girl who carried us to the
surface. It must be her doing.)

fields.EN:
(If she could make us float, then surely she
is how I ended up here.)
fields.JP:
（宙に浮かせたのがその女だというなら、
　ここに飛ばしたのも、その女の力なんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If she could make us float, then surely she
is how I ended up here.)

fields.EN:
(But just where did she place me?
I suppose I should thank her for saving
me from Genocide Pink.)
fields.JP:
（まったく、酷い場所に飛ばしてくれたもんだ。
　まあ処刑台少女から遠ざけてくれたことには、
　感謝をするべきなのだろうが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But just where did she place me?
I suppose I should thank her for saving
me from Massacre Pink.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: メルヒェンがいるだと……？

fields.EN:
(I can sense a core nearby. Must mean
I'm in a Jail tower.)
fields.JP:
（……最上部に核の意識を感じるな。
　となると、ここはどこかの監獄塔ということか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can sense a core nearby. Must mean
I'm in a Jail tower.)

fields.EN:
(Just my luck. I have no means to fend off
a Marchen. Hiding will only get me so far.)
fields.JP:
（面倒なことになったな。
　僕自身にはメルヒェンと対抗する術がない。
　隠れてやり過ごすのも限界があるだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just my luck. I have no means to fend off
a Marchen. Hiding will only get me so far.)

fields.EN:
(Need to find something of use around
here. I can't die down here. What to do...?)
fields.JP:
（どうにかして利用できるものを探さないと。
　こんなところで終わるわけにはいかないんだ。
　何かないか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Need to find something of use around
here. I can't die down here. What to do...?)

fields.EN: Are you okay?! Please wake up, Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
しっかりして！
目を覚まして下さい白雪！
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you okay?! Please wake up, Snow White!

fields.EN:
Oh, her wounds are terrible. Genocide Pink
are savages.
fields.JP:
ああ、ひどい傷……
あなたまで処刑台少女に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, her wounds are terrible. Massacre Pink
are savages.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(That girl. She's a Blood Maiden. She was
with Akazukin.)
fields.JP:
（あの女……血式少女か。
　そういえば赤ずきんとやらと一緒にいたな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That girl. She's a Blood Maiden. She was
with Red Riding Hood.)

fields.EN:
(Perhaps the Blood Maiden is my ticket
out of this Jail.)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたら、あの血式少女を利用すれば、
　この監獄塔を抜け出せるかもしれないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Perhaps the Blood Maiden is my ticket
out of this Jail.)

fields.EN:
(Blood Maidens are born of a Marchen,
inheriting Marchen and human traits.)
fields.JP:
（確か血式少女は、
　メルヒェンに擬態化した妊婦が産み落とす、
　人間とメルヒェンのハーフのような存在……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Blood Maidens are born of a Marchen,
inheriting Marchen and human traits.)

fields.EN:
(As a result, they alone have the power to
fight against the Marchens.)
fields.JP:
（それ故、彼女たちは
　メルヒェンに対抗する力を持つらしい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As a result, they alone have the power to
fight against the Marchens.)

fields.EN:
(I saw it for myself on the surface. Even
despite being overwhelmed by Genocide
Pink, they demonstrated inhuman power.)
fields.JP:
（実際、地上での戦いを見ていた限り、
　処刑台少女に押されていたとはいえ、
　血式少女たちも、充分に人間離れしていた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I saw it for myself on the surface. Even
despite being overwhelmed by Massacre
Pink, they demonstrated inhuman power.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(In fact, it was all thanks to the Dawn,
a group centered around those girls,
that we were freed from the Jail.)
fields.JP:
（そもそも地上にやって来られたのだって、
　彼女たちの集う組織『黎明』が、
　地下のジェイルを完全に解放したからと聞く）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In fact, it was all thanks to the Dawn,
a group centered around those girls,
that we were freed from the Jail.)

fields.EN:
(Then using the Blood Maidens to escape
would be my best course of action. Okay...)
fields.JP:
（それなら、監獄塔の脱出に
　血式少女を使わない手はないな……よし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then using the Blood Maidens to escape
would be my best course of action. Okay...)

fields.EN:
If only I could halt her bleeding! Shirayuki!
Don't you die on me.
fields.JP:
どうして出血が止まらないんですか……！
白雪、お願いだから死なないで下さい……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I could halt her bleeding! Snow White!
Don't you die on me.

fields.JP: なあ、そこの君。ちょっといいか

fields.EN:
I came up from the underground, just like
you. Here, let me.
fields.JP:
君たちと同じように、地上に来た者だ。
それよりも、ちょっとどいてみろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I came up from the underground, just like
you. Here, let me.

fields.EN:
(I see. This dying girl is also a Blood Maiden.
Her injuries are severe.)
fields.JP:
（なるほど、横たわっている女も血式少女か。
　随分と深手を負ったようだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. This dying girl is also a Blood Maiden.
Her injuries are severe.)

fields.EN:
(Her eyes are beginning to change color.
Potent sign of corruption.)
fields.JP:
（しかも２人とも瞳の色が濁っている。
　相当穢れが溜まってしまっているな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Her eyes are beginning to change color.
Potent sign of corruption.)

fields.EN: How is she? Will she be okay?
fields.JP: ど、どうですか、助かるんですか
fields.LOCALIZED: How is she? Will she be okay?

fields.EN:
I'm not a doctor, so I can't say. I will do
my best.
fields.JP:
あいにくと医者じゃないから断言はできない。
だがまあ、できる限りのことはやってみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not a doctor, so I can't say. I will do
my best.

fields.EN:
Let's try to stop her bleeding. Turn her
upright, and place her leg on her bag.
Put pressure on the wound with this cloth.
fields.JP:
まずは止血だ。その女を仰向けにして、
足を荷物の上に軽く乗せるんだ。
それからハンカチで傷口をしっかり押さえててくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's try to stop her bleeding. Turn her
upright, and place her leg on her bag.
Put pressure on the wound with this cloth.

fields.JP:
分かりました。
ほら白雪、もうちょっとの辛抱ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. Hang in there, Snow White.

fields.EN: (Okay, I'm going to reduce her corruption too.)
fields.JP: （よし、じゃあ今のうちに穢れを消しておくか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Okay, I'm going to reduce her corruption too.)

fields.JP: 慌てるな。危害を加えたわけじゃない

fields.EN: Ooookay. I feel rosy all of a sudden.
fields.JP:
え――まさか、穢れが
ゆっくり消えていくこの感覚は……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooookay. I feel rosy all of a sudden.

fields.EN: I rid you of all of your corruption.
fields.JP: 君たちの穢れを消しておいた
fields.LOCALIZED: I rid you of all of your corruption.

fields.EN:
You also purified Akazukin.
Just who are you, sir?
fields.JP:
そういえばあなたは、
確か赤ずきんの穢れも消していましたね。
いったい何者なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also purified Red Riding Hood.
Just who are you, sir?

fields.EN:
If you came from underground, it means you
must have lived in the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
一緒に地上に来たってことは、
解放地区にいらっしゃったと――
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you came from underground, it means you
must have lived in the Liberated District.

fields.EN:
Wait. We can exchange introductions later.
We must tend to her wounds first.
fields.JP:
待て。今はそんな話を
している場合ではないだろう。
まずはこの女の治療が先だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. We can exchange introductions later.
We must tend to her wounds first.

fields.EN:
(This is bad. The bleeding won't stop.
I thought restricting flow would help,
but nothing's working.)
fields.JP:
（駄目だな、傷口を押さえ続ければ、
　あるいは止血できるかとも思ったが、
　どうやら無理のようだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is bad. The bleeding won't stop.
I thought restricting flow would help,
but nothing's working.)

fields.EN:
(Very well. I was saving this for an
emergency, and this well counts.)
fields.JP:
（仕方ない、もしもの時のために
　取っておいた救急用の薬を使うか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Very well. I was saving this for an
emergency, and this well counts.)

fields.EN:
I gave her some medicine. Keep her still.
Eventually her bleeding will slow.
fields.JP:
傷薬を使っておいた。
あとはなるべく動かさずにしておけば、
じきに出血はおさまるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I gave her some medicine. Keep her still.
Eventually her bleeding will slow.

fields.EN: Okay. It's a miracle. Thank you so much.
fields.JP:
そ、そうですか。
よかった……本当にありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. It's a miracle. Thank you so much.

fields.EN:
It's too early to call it a miracle. The winds
blow strong here. Far too cold for her in
this state.
fields.JP:
安心するのはまだ早い。
この場所は吹き抜けで風が強い。ここにいたら、
傷は塞がっても寒さで体力が落ちていくぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's too early to call it a miracle. The winds
blow strong here. Far too cold for her in
this state.

fields.EN:
Find a place where the wind doesn't blow
and no Marchen will find us.
fields.JP:
だから風の入ってこない、
メルヒェンたちにも見つかりにくい場所を探すんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Find a place where the wind doesn't blow
and no Marchen will find us.

fields.EN: Right. I must find shelter for us.
fields.JP:
そうですね。休ませてあげられる場所を
探してあげないといけませんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I must find shelter for us.

fields.JP:
ならすぐに移動するぞ。
ついてくるんだ

fields.EN:
This place is perfect. Out of sight and out
of the wind.
fields.JP:
休ませるにはちょうどいい場所ですね。
奥まっていて風も入ってこないですし
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is perfect. Out of sight and out
of the wind.

fields.EN:
But I worry that sleeping on the frozen
ground may not be good for Shirayuki.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、凍っている床に白雪を寝かせるのは、
体温の低下を招きますね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I worry that sleeping on the frozen
ground may not be good for Snow White.

fields.EN: Wow. A blanket and clothes. Thank you.
fields.JP: まあ、敷物に服まで……助かります
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. A blanket and clothes. Thank you.

fields.EN:
Clothe her and tuck her into the blanket.
If you huddle close with her, it should
help you both.
fields.JP:
服は身体に掛けて、その上で
君は止血しつつ身体を寄り添わせて、
少しでも温めてやれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clothe her and tuck her into the blanket.
If you huddle close with her, it should
help you both.

fields.EN: (This is taking more work than I expected. But I suppose it can't be helped if I want to borrow the Blood Maidens' power...)
fields.JP:
（思ったよりも手間がかかっているな。
　血式少女の力を借りるためには仕方ないが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is some task, but it can't be helped.
Consider it a favor to be redeemed later.)

fields.EN:
(We must treat her quickly. She has gashes
all along her legs, from her thighs to her
feet.)
fields.JP:
（とにかく、早くこの女を治療しないとな。
　残るは足の傷だが……太腿をやられてるのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We must treat her quickly. She has gashes
all along her legs, from her thighs to her
feet.)

fields.EN: Hey, what are you doing to Shirayuki?!
fields.JP: ちょ、ちょっとあなた白雪に何してるんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, what are you doing to Snow White?!

fields.EN: What do you mean? Stopping her bleeding.
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean? Stopping her bleeding.

fields.EN:
I know that! But you're being a little
handsy, don't you think?
fields.JP:
それは分かります！
ですがそんなにスカートをめくって、
ふとももまで触って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know that! But you're being a little
handsy, don't you think?

fields.EN:
This technique is called tourniquet. I must
put pressure on the artery before wrapping
the wound with gauze. It's part of it.
fields.JP:
これは止血帯法という手段だ。
傷口を圧迫して包帯をするから、
触らねばやりようもない
fields.LOCALIZED:
This technique is called tourniquet. I must
put pressure on the artery before wrapping
the wound with gauze. It's part of it.

fields.EN:
(Ugh. Is she suspecting me of foul play?
Foolish girl. Take a look around you.)
fields.JP:
（……ああ、欲情したとでも思ったのか。
　こんな時に、なんてくだらない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. Is she suspecting me of foul play?
Foolish girl. Take a look around you.)

fields.EN:
Let me be frank with you, I am looking for
my lost wife.
fields.JP:
言っておくが、僕は離ればなれに
なってしまった妻を探しているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me be frank with you, I am looking for
my lost wife.

fields.EN:
In this or in any circumstance, never would
I lay my hands on another woman. Let alone
this girl. Let that be clear.
fields.JP:
そんな僕が他の女性に――
しかもこんな子どもの身体に興味など抱くものか
fields.LOCALIZED:
In this or in any circumstance, never would
I lay my hands on another woman. Let alone
this girl. Let that be clear.

fields.EN:
Consider our situation for a moment. Only
a fool would think me so shortsighted.
fields.JP:
ましてや今は緊急事態だ。
こんな状況でそのようなことを考える奴は、
ただの馬鹿だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Consider our situation for a moment. Only
a fool would think me so shortsighted.

fields.EN:
Wait. You look to be about my age.
You're married?!
fields.JP:
え、あなた同い年くらいに見えるんですけど、
結婚してるんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. You look to be about my age.
You're married?!

fields.EN:
Okay, the bleeding's stopped. The rest is up
to her.
fields.JP:
……よし、どうやら出血も止まったようだ。
あとはこいつの運次第だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, the bleeding's stopped. The rest is up
to her.

fields.EN: That's her name, and I am Kaguyahime.
fields.JP:
その子の名前です。
あとわらわは、かぐや姫と申します
fields.LOCALIZED: That's her name, and I am Kaguya.

fields.EN:
From now on, I would rather you address us
by name.
fields.JP:
これからは、こいつとかではなく、
名前で呼んで頂けるとありがたいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
From now on, I would rather you address us
by name.

fields.EN:
But once more, we are greatly indebted to
you for saving Shirayuki. Without you,
she wouldn't have made it.
fields.JP:
そして改めて白雪のこと、ありがとうございます。
あなたがいてくれなかったら、
この子は助からなかったかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
But once more, we are greatly indebted to
you for saving Snow White. Without you,
she wouldn't have made it.

fields.EN:
Well, we can't say for sure she's made it
yet. Like I said, it's up to her―I mean, Shirayukihime's luck and fortitude.
fields.JP:
まだ助かったわけじゃない。
こいつ、いや白雪姫の体力と運次第だと言ったろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we can't say for sure she's made it
yet. Like I said, it's up to her―I mean, Snow
White's luck and fortitude.

fields.EN:
Even so, I appreciate you. Thank you so
much. I have some questions for you if
you do not mind.
fields.JP:
それでも感謝します。
本当に助かりました……それで、改めて
あなたのことをお聞きしたいのですが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I appreciate you. Thank you so
much. I have some questions for you if
you do not mind.

fields.EN:
Sure, but it may not help you much. I have
amnesia. There's not much I remember.
fields.JP:
聞きたいと言われてもな。
僕自身、記憶を失っているから
話せることはほとんどないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but it may not help you much. I have
amnesia. There's not much I remember.

fields.EN:
Really?! Then how do you explain the
Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
そうだったんですか！？
ではどうしてメアリガンを持っているか、
というのもご存じないのですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! Then how do you explain the
Mary Gun?

fields.JP: 僕が覚えているのは３つだけだ

fields.EN:
One, I am looking for my wife. Two, I am
a Blood Youth. And three, I am a Jail tower.
fields.JP:
妻を探していること。
自分が血式少年であること。
そして自分が監獄塔であるということだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
One, I am looking for my wife. Two, I am
a Blood Youth. And three, I am a Jail tower.

fields.EN:
My possession of the Mary Gun supports
the second point.
fields.JP:
メアリガンを持っているのは、
僕が血式少年だから、なのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
My possession of the Mary Gun supports
the second point.

fields.EN:
A bizarre excuse, but one I cannot refute.
You don't recall how you gained ownership,
and I don't know how you know the Dawn.
fields.JP:
理由になっているような、なっていないような……
どこで手に入れたのかも分かりませんし、
黎明が感知していなかった理由も分かりませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
A bizarre excuse, but one I cannot refute.
You don't recall how you gained ownership,
and I don't know how you know the Dawn.

fields.EN:
And that last point. You claim to be a Jail
tower? I wonder what it means.
fields.JP:
それに監獄塔？　あなた自身が監獄塔とは、
いったいどういう意味なんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And that last point. You claim to be a Jail
tower? I wonder what it means.

fields.JP: 僕に聞かれても困る話だ

fields.EN: Oh, right. The amnesia. How about a name?
fields.JP:
う……確かに、記憶喪失ですもんね。
ではあなたのお名前は？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, right. The amnesia. How about a name?

fields.EN:
Now that you mention it, I don't remember
it. Go ahead and call me "You" or even "Hey,"
it doesn't matter.
fields.JP:
そういえば、名前も覚えていないな。
まあ、『あなた』でも『お前』でも、
好きなように呼ぶといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you mention it, I don't remember
it. Go ahead and call me "You" or even "Hey,"
it doesn't matter.

fields.EN: Anyway, I've told you all I know.
fields.JP: とにかく、今話した以上のことは知らない
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, I've told you all I know.

fields.EN:
Truthfully, I don't care what becomes of
me. So don't make it your concern as well.
fields.JP:
僕自身、自分のことなどどうでもいいんだ。
だから君も気にするな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Truthfully, I don't care what becomes of
me. So don't make it your concern as well.

fields.EN:
You say that, but how could I not? I wonder
how you lost your memories.
fields.JP:
気にするなと言われても、
気になって仕方ないんですけど……
あなたはどこで記憶を失ったんでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You say that, but how could I not? I wonder
how you lost your memories.

fields.EN:
Did you lose your memories after our run-in
with Genocide Pink?
fields.JP:
もしかして、処刑台少女に襲われたショックで、
記憶を失ってしまった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you lose your memories after our run-in
with Massacre Pink?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: You resemble Jack somehow. Could you two be siblings?
fields.JP:
それにどことなくジャックに面影が似ていますが、
もしかして兄弟だったりするんでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED: You sort of resemble Jack. Are you brothers?

fields.EN:
Jack is the blue-haired boy, is he not?
I've seen him from afar. I don't know him.
fields.JP:
ジャックとは水色の髪の男だろう？
あいつは遠目から見たことがあるが、
あんな奴は知らないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack is the blue-haired boy, is he not?
I've seen him from afar. I don't know him.

fields.EN:
Jack never mentioned you either. Guess we
can eliminate the family angle.
fields.JP:
ジャックもそんな話はしてませんでしたし、
やはり関係はありませんか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack never mentioned you either. Guess we
can eliminate the family angle.

fields.EN:
Oh. What's your wife's name? Maybe one
of us knows her. We can track―
fields.JP:
そうだ、あなたの妻の名前は何ですか？
もしかしたら、知ってる方かもしれません。
力になれるかも――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. What's your wife's name? Maybe one
of us knows her. We can track―

fields.EN:
All I have is my desire to find her. I know
not her name, only her face.
fields.JP:
こんなにも妻を求めているのに、
顔も思い出せるのに、名前が思い出せないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I have is my desire to find her. I know
not her name, only her face.

fields.EN:
But that is no excuse to give up. I must
survive at all costs to find her. Hence why
I came to your aid.
fields.JP:
だが、それが妻を探し出せない理由にはならない。
何があろうと絶対に生き抜き、見つけてみせる。
そのために君たちを助けたんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that is no excuse to give up. I must
survive at all costs to find her. Hence why
I came to your aid.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: それってどういう意味です？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
You think I helped you out of the goodness
of my heart with Marchens around? That
was precious time and resources.
fields.JP:
こんなメルヒェンが徘徊している場所で、
貴重な時間と資材を費やしてまで
一般人を助けるとでも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think I helped you out of the goodness
of my heart with Marchens around? That
was precious time and resources.

fields.EN: I don't have the power to fight Marchens myself. I was looking for people who could stand up to them, and that's when I found you Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
僕はメルヒェンと戦う力はないからな。
奴らと渡り合える者を探していた。それで
見つけたのが血式少女の君たち、というわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lack the means to combat the Marchens.
I've been looking for someone to change
that. That's where you come in.

fields.EN:
Wow. I had no idea you were so calculated.
Now I'm certain there's no way you and Jack
are related!
fields.JP:
うわ……打算まみれだったなんて……
確かにジャックと兄弟とは思えないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. I had no idea you were so calculated.
Now I'm certain there's no way you and Jack
are related!

fields.EN: That's why there's no way we're brothers—
fields.JP: だから兄弟なんかであるわけ――
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you we couldn't be―

fields.JP: ちょっと待て、辺りが暗くなってきてないか？

本当ですね～
って、この闇は……！

fields.EN:
That's right. A Nightmare. Marchens are one
thing, but this is another kettle of fish.
fields.JP:
ああそうか、ナイトメアか……
メルヒェンならまだしも、厄介な奴が出てきたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. A Nightmare. Marchens are one
thing, but this is another kettle of fish.

fields.EN:
Very well. We've done all we can for her.
This might be it.
fields.JP:
仕方ない、手間をかけて応急処置をしたが、
ここまでのようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. We've done all we can for her.
This might be it.

fields.EN: Huh? What are you talking about?
fields.JP: は？　あなた何を言って……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What are you talking about?

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you're thinking about leaving
Shirayuki behind. I could never!
fields.JP:
まさか、白雪を置いていくつもりですか！？
そんなことできるわけがないでしょう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you're thinking about leaving
Snow White behind. I could never!

fields.EN:
You say that, but your chances of living
dwindle if you even think about carrying
her while fleeing the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
そうは言っても、白雪姫を背負って
ナイトメアから逃げるというのは、
死ぬ確率を相当上げる行為なんだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You say that, but your chances of living
dwindle if you even think about carrying
her while fleeing the Nightmare.

fields.EN: And if we leave her behind, the Nightmare should turn its attention to her. That lowers our chances of dying, right?
fields.JP:
それに彼女を置いていけば、
ナイトメアもそっちに気がいくはずだ。
その方が死ぬ確率は下がる、そうだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leaving her behind might buy us even
more time with that beast, thus giving
us a chance to escape.

fields.EN:
Do you even know who Shirayuki is?!
I refuse to sacrifice her as bait!
fields.JP:
あ、あなたは白雪を何だと思ってるんですか！
囮にも生贄にもさせはしません！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you even know who Snow White is?!
I refuse to sacrifice her as bait!

fields.EN:
Should we all join hands here and await
our demise? Forget that.
fields.JP:
では、ここで全員仲良く死ぬか？
僕はごめんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Should we all join hands here and await
our demise? Forget that.

fields.EN: You know how selfish you sound right now?
fields.JP: あなたは自分のことしか考えていないのですね
fields.LOCALIZED: You know how selfish you sound right now?

fields.EN:
If you don't help Shirayuki, I'll leave
you behind. And I couldn't care less if the
Nightmare gets ahold of you.
fields.JP:
白雪を助けなければ、
わらわもあなたを見捨てますよ。
ナイトメアに捕まろうがなにであろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't help Snow White, I'll leave
you behind. And I couldn't care less if the
Nightmare gets ahold of you.

fields.EN:
I see. In that case, I would most certainly
die. Though I shudder to think of what may
become of you when you enter Blood Skelter.
fields.JP:
なるほど、それだと僕は死ぬな。
だがそうすれば、君は遠くないうちに
ブラッドスケルター化するだけだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. In that case, I would most certainly
die. Though I shudder to think of what may
become of you when you enter Blood Skelter.

fields.EN:
Argh. Even so, I won't leave Shirayuki
behind!
fields.JP:
ぐっ……それでも、白雪を見捨てるという
選択肢はあり得ません……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh. Even so, I won't leave Snow White
behind!

fields.EN:
(I'm only trying to guarantee our survival.
Why is she so stubborn?)
fields.JP:
（僕は生き延びるための最善の方法を
　提示しているというのに、どうしてこの女は
　それを受け入れようとしないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm only trying to guarantee our survival.
Why is she so stubborn?)

fields.EN:
(Logic would dictate that leaving the girl
behind gives us the best chance.)
fields.JP:
（合理的に考えれば、見捨てるという
　選択肢しかあり得ないはずなのに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Logic would dictate that leaving the girl
behind gives us the best chance.)

fields.EN:
(Hasn't she seen action as a Blood Maiden
already? How can she be so naïve?)
fields.JP:
（血式少女は多くの戦いを
　生き抜いてきた者たちだろう？
　こんなに甘い考えをしていたとは意外だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hasn't she seen action as a Blood Maiden
already? How can she be so naïve?)

fields.EN:
(Huh? Why does my heart feel so heavy
all of a sudden? Something...isn't sitting
right.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　どうして胸がチクチクするんだ？
　このざわつくような感情はいったい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Why does my heart feel so heavy
all of a sudden? Something...isn't sitting
right.)

fields.JP:
ハ……デ……
あなたって、本当に不器用ね
（今のはいったい何だったんだ？）
ごぎぎぎぎぎぃぃぃっ！

fields.EN:
It'll be here any second. Should I stand my
ground? No. Not only would it kill me, but
I'd be putting Shirayuki at risk.
fields.JP:
だいぶ近づいてきていますね……
ここで戦う？　いえ、倒せない上に
白雪を巻き込んでしまう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be here any second. Should I stand my
ground? No. Not only would it kill me, but
I'd be putting Snow White at risk.

fields.EN:
Do I carry her and run? I would be totally
vulnerable.
fields.JP:
背負って逃げる？
完全に無防備になりますが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do I carry her and run? I would be totally
vulnerable.

fields.EN:
If I carry Shirayukihime, you'll fight in my
stead, right? Very well. I'll grab her.
fields.JP:
……白雪姫を連れて行けば、
君は僕の代わりに戦ってくれるんだな？
いいだろう、僕が負ぶっていってやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I carry Snow White, you'll fight in my
stead, right? Very well. I'll grab her.

fields.EN:
But if my life is in danger, I will drop her
immediately.
fields.JP:
だが僕の命が危なくなれば、
即座にその場に置いていくからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if my life is in danger, I will drop her
immediately.

fields.EN:
Whatever. If you're going to let me down,
then I'll handle it myself!
fields.JP:
まあいいです、そうしてくれるのであれば、
わらわが本気で何とかしてやります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever. If you're going to let me down,
then I'll handle it myself!

fields.EN:
Shirayuki. When you recover, you're
going to owe me a long vacation!
fields.JP:
白雪、回復したら向こう１年間は、
わらわのサボりにつきあってもらいますからね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White. When you recover, you're
going to owe me a long vacation!

fields.EN:
Hold onto me. This might get a little bumpy.
Once we escape the Nightmare, I'll find you
somewhere safe to rest.
fields.JP:
慌ただしいけど、少し我慢して下さいね。
ナイトメアから逃げて、今度こそ安全な場所に
連れて行きますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold onto me. This might get a little bumpy.
Once we escape the Nightmare, I'll find you
somewhere safe to rest.

fields.EN: You ready? Let's ditch that Nightmare.
fields.JP:
よし、準備はいいな？
ではナイトメアを振り切るぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You ready? Let's ditch that Nightmare.

fields.EN: *pant, pant*... There, I think we lost it.
fields.JP:
ぜぇ、ぜぇ……
どうやら、逃げ切ったようだな
fields.LOCALIZED: *pant, pant*... There, I think we lost it.

fields.EN: True. The darkness is fading away.
fields.JP: ええ、もうナイトメアの暗闇はありませんね
fields.LOCALIZED: True. The darkness is fading away.

fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと息をっ、
整えさせて、くれ…………

fields.EN: Oh. You're even weaker than I thought.
fields.JP: あら、思った以上にひ弱なんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. You're even weaker than I thought.

fields.EN:
You try carrying dead weight while running
for your life...
fields.JP:
こ、こんな重いものを背負って走ったのは、
生まれて初めてだ、からな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You try carrying dead weight while running
for your life...

fields.EN:
How did you ever make it out of the
Liberated District?
fields.JP: それでよく解放地区で暮らせていましたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you ever make it out of the
Liberated District?

fields.EN: (Ugh. Normally I would never take this risk...)
fields.JP:
（くっ、普段なら
　こんなリスクは冒さないというのに）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ugh. Normally I would never take this risk...)

fields.EN:
(The pain from earlier. That echoing voice.
Without that headache, I wouldn't have made
the wrong choice!)
fields.JP:
（あの胸のチクチクとした痛み、
　それに頭の中に響いた声のせいだ。
　あれらがなければ判断は誤らなかった……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The pain from earlier. That echoing voice.
Without that headache, I wouldn't have made
the wrong choice!)

fields.EN:
Regardless, thank you for not abandoning
Shirayuki.
fields.JP:
何にせよ、白雪を見捨てないでくれて
ありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, thank you for not abandoning
Snow White.

fields.EN:
All part of the deal. You fought for me,
and I carried her. No need to thank me.
fields.JP:
その代わり君に戦ってもらうという
約束に従ったまでだ。礼などいらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
All part of the deal. You fought for me,
and I carried her. No need to thank me.

fields.EN: (Still, since two Blood Maidens capable of fighting survived, there's no denying the outcome itself was good...)
fields.JP:
（戦力となる血式少女が２人生き残ったから、
　結果で見れば良かったのは確かだが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Both Blood Maidens survived and can
fight. This may well yet end in my favor.)

fields.EN: (But it's a risk I'm hesitant to take again.)
fields.JP:
（二度とこんなリスクの高い
　選択はしたくないな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But it's a risk I'm hesitant to take again.)

fields.EN:
Well, all that matters is finding a safe place
for Shirayukihime to rest.
fields.JP:
さて、今度こそしっかりと白雪姫を
寝かせておける場所を探したいところだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, all that matters is finding a safe place
for Snow White to rest.

fields.EN:
But the Jail is unlikely to provide any such
refuge for us.
fields.JP:
監獄塔の中で安全な場所を探すというのは、
なかなかに難しそうですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the Jail is unlikely to provide any such
refuge for us.

fields.JP: ん？　そこにいるのは、かぐやか？

その声――
ハル！　それに門脇も！
よかった、無事だったか

fields.EN:
There's three of you? Kaguya, the guy with
white hair, and Snow.
fields.JP:
そっちは３人か？
かぐやと白い髪の君と……
背負われているのは、白いのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's three of you? Kaguya, the guy with
white hair, and Snow.

fields.EN: (Are they the members of the Dawn?)
fields.JP:
（こいつら、確か血式少女たちのいた
　黎明ってところの……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Are they the members of the Dawn?)

fields.EN:
Thank goodness you're both safe. At last,
friendly faces in this forsaken place.
fields.JP:
おふたりも無事で何よりです。
ああ、ようやく仲間と再会できた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness you're both safe. At last,
friendly faces in this forsaken place.

fields.EN:
Hey, wasn't Clara with you? Have you seen
her around?
fields.JP:
お前ら、くららは一緒じゃないのか？
どこかで見なかったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wasn't Clara with you? Have you seen
her around?

fields.JP: え、いえ、見ていませんけど……

fields.EN: I see. Well, at least we've found you two.
fields.JP:
そうか……いや、お前たちだけでも
会えてよかった
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Well, at least we've found you two.

fields.EN:
Right, but there's no time to celebrate.
Shirayuki's in critical condition.
Do you know somewhere we can treat her?
fields.JP:
そうだ、喜んでいる場合ではありません。
白雪が重傷なんです。どこか治療に専念できる、
安全な場所をご存じありませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, but there's no time to celebrate.
Snow White's in critical condition.
Do you know somewhere we can treat her?

fields.EN:
We set up a camp. There's some medical
supplies, so we can take a look at her.
fields.JP:
それなら俺たちが設営したキャンプがある。
そこなら一通りの物資もあるから、
ちゃんとした治療もできるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We set up a camp. There's some medical
supplies, so we can take a look at her.

fields.JP: 白いのはだいぶ危険なのか……？

fields.EN:
This man performed some first aid on her
before we got here, but it was a mere
stop-gap.
fields.JP:
この人が応急手当をしてくれたので、
最悪な状況はひとまず回避しましたが、
予断は許しません
fields.LOCALIZED:
This man performed some first aid on her
before we got here, but it was a mere
stop-gap.

fields.EN: Got it. You saved her, then? Thank you.
fields.JP:
そうか、あんたが。
……ありがとうと言っておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. You saved her, then? Thank you.

fields.EN:
Shall we be on our way? Standing here
won't do her any favors.
fields.JP:
それよりどうするんだ？
何をするにせよ、ここに突っ立っていても
仕方がないと思うが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shall we be on our way? Standing here
won't do her any favors.

fields.EN: Right you are. Let's head over.
fields.JP: それもそうだな。じゃあ行くか
fields.LOCALIZED: Right you are. Let's head over.

fields.EN: At last, a glimmer of hope.
fields.JP: ようやく希望の目が出てきました……
fields.LOCALIZED: At last, a glimmer of hope.

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime is one thing, but can I trust these
newcomers?)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫はともかく、
　この男たちを信用していいものか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya is one thing, but can I trust these
newcomers?)

fields.EN:
(What use are they to me? They're not
even Blood Maidens.)
fields.JP:
（それに血式少女でもない一般人と一緒にいて、
　僕に利するところがあるとも思えない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What use are they to me? They're not
even Blood Maidens.)

fields.EN:
(But this is our situation. Pressing them
for answers right away might sooner put
me in a grave.)
fields.JP:
（だがこの状況だ。
　答えを急いで変に勘ぐりすぎるのも、
　自らの首をしめる結果になりかねないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But this is our situation. Pressing them
for answers right away might sooner put
me in a grave.)

fields.EN:
What are you doing? Hurry up and carry
Shirayuki.
fields.JP:
何してるんですか？
早く白雪を運びますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing? Hurry up and carry
Snow White.

fields.JP: よし、すぐ近くだ。ついてこい

fields.EN: This way. Shirayuki'll be fine in this tent.
fields.JP:
こっちだ。テントの中に
白雪を寝かせるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: This way. Snow White'll be fine in this tent.

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime. Prop up her head with something, and
be sure to lift her leg above her heart.
Let's make sure she's comfortable.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫。枕代わりになるものと、
足のつま先を心臓より高い位置にできる
荷物か何かを用意してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya. Prop up her head with something, and
be sure to lift her leg above her heart.
Let's make sure she's comfortable.

fields.EN:
Well, I could bunch up this towel as a pillow.
We can use her shoes to lift her leg.
fields.JP:
では枕は丸めたタオルで、
足の方は白雪の鞄を使いましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I could bunch up this towel as a pillow.
We can use her shoes to lift her leg.

fields.EN: Okay, we can finally let her sleep.
fields.JP: よし、これでようやく寝かせられる
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, we can finally let her sleep.

fields.EN:
We did our best to stop the bleeding. Looks
like her wounds are clotting, her breathing's
stabilized. I think she'll pull through.
fields.JP:
止血した傷口も安定したし、
呼吸も落ちついてきたようだ。
ひとまず大丈夫だろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did our best to stop the bleeding. Looks
like her wounds are clotting, her breathing's
stabilized. I think she'll pull through.

fields.JP: そうか、そいつは良かった

fields.EN: Man, this has already been quite the ordeal.
fields.JP: それにしても、お互いによく生き延びたもんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Man, this has already been quite the ordeal.

fields.EN: We were attacked the moment we reached the surface, then sent to a Jail Tower before we even knew what was happening, and on top of that chased by a Nightmare...
fields.JP:
地上に出ていきなり襲われて、
わけの分からないうちに監獄塔に飛ばされて、
あげくナイトメアに追われて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were attacked the moment we set foot
on the surface. Then we were transported to
the Jail before we gathered our bearings.

fields.EN:
I confronted death in the face more times
than I could count.
fields.JP: わらわは何度死ぬと思ったことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I confronted death in the face more times
than I could count.

fields.EN:
Indeed. We should all swap notes on what
happened to one another before meeting up.
fields.JP:
そうだ、お互い地上に出てからここまで、
何があったか情報交換をしようじゃねえか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. We should all swap notes on what
happened to one another before meeting up.

fields.EN: (Swapping notes, eh? I have nothing to share.)
fields.JP: （情報交換ね。まあ僕には関係のないことだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Swapping notes, eh? I have nothing to share.)

fields.EN:
(In fact, I'm exhausted from all that running.
I could use a break.)
fields.JP:
（それより、僕もだいぶ体力を消耗したし、
　休憩を取っておかないとな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In fact, I'm exhausted from all that running.
I could use a break.)

fields.EN:
(Their makeshift camp is impressive though.
Especially for a Jail.)
fields.JP:
（しかし、よくこんなキャンプを監獄塔の中に
　設営したな。たいしたものだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Their makeshift camp is impressive though.
Especially for a Jail.)

fields.EN:
Moreover...I want to know who that gentleman
is.
fields.JP: 特に、そこの少年が何者なのか、とかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Moreover...I want to know who that gentleman
is.

fields.EN: A Blood Youth who isn't Jack.
fields.JP: ジャック以外の血式少年か……
fields.LOCALIZED: A Blood Youth who isn't Jack.

fields.EN:
Well, that's not the surprising part. I'm more
curious as to how we've never seen you before.
fields.JP:
いや、そりゃいてもおかしくはなかったんだがよ、
何で今まで発見されなかったんだか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's not the surprising part. I'm more
curious as to how we've never seen you before.

fields.EN: Of course, no one could know you existed if you never told anyone. But you have a Mary Gun, don't you?
fields.JP:
存在だけなら、本人が口外しなければ
もちろん分かりようがないけどよ、
でもメアリガン持ってるんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you have your reasons for laying
low, but here you are. You even have a
Mary Gun, do you not?

fields.EN:
How could such a person live in the
Liberated District without the Dawn
knowing? Very strange indeed.
fields.JP:
そんな奴が解放地区に住んでて、
黎明が知らなかったってのも、変な話なんだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
How could such a person live in the
Liberated District without the Dawn
knowing? Very strange indeed.

fields.EN:
Beats me. It's true though. What do you
want from me?
fields.JP:
変だと言われてもな。
事実だから仕方ないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beats me. It's true though. What do you
want from me?

fields.EN:
Ah, yes. Truth. Even if I asked you, you'd fall
back on the amnesia excuse.
fields.JP:
事実か……もうちょっと突っ込んで聞きたくても、
記憶喪失じゃ聞きようがねえしなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, yes. Truth. Even if I asked you, you'd fall
back on the amnesia excuse.

fields.EN:
Is it possible that people outside of the Dawn
have managed to develop a Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
黎明以外でメアリガンを作っている人がいる、
という可能性はどうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is it possible that people outside of the Dawn
have managed to develop a Mary Gun?

fields.EN:
To my knowledge, there is no outside facility
capable of manufacturing one. At least not in
the underground Jail. That skill lies with me.
fields.JP:
地下ジェイルでは、少なくとも
黎明以外に作れる施設は見たこともないし、
もっと言えば俺以外に作れる奴なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To my knowledge, there is no outside facility
capable of manufacturing one. At least not in
the underground Jail. That skill lies with me.

fields.EN:
Wait, could it be Clara? If that were the case,
she undoubtedly would have rubbed it in my
face.
fields.JP:
もしかして、くららか……？
でもあいつなら、作ったらドヤ顔で
見せに来そうなもんだしなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, could it be Clara? If that were the case,
she undoubtedly would have rubbed it in my
face.

fields.EN: I suppose there's no point speculating.
fields.JP: ……今はこれ以上考えてもしょうがねえか
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose there's no point speculating.

fields.EN:
I can't answer your questions without my
memories. Besides, I don't put much stake
in myself.
fields.JP:
僕が分からないのに、
君たちに分かるわけがないだろう。
それに僕は、自分のことなどどうでもいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't answer your questions without my
memories. Besides, I don't put much stake
in myself.

fields.EN:
(I'd rather get down to finding out where
my wife is. If they don't know who I am,
how would they know who she is?)
fields.JP:
（それよりも妻の情報がほしいが……
　僕の事を知らないやつが妻の事を知ってる訳がないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'd rather get down to finding out where
my wife is. If they don't know who I am,
how would they know who she is?)

fields.EN: So anyone here got a plan?
fields.JP: ……これからどうするつもりかプランはあるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So anyone here got a plan?

fields.EN:
Right. There is so much to discuss. Including
that gigantic Jail we saw above the surface.
Curious...
fields.JP:
そうですね、処刑台少女のこととか、
地上に出た瞬間に見た巨大な監獄塔とか、
色々と考えなければならないことはありますが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. There is so much to discuss. Including
that gigantic Jail we saw above the surface.
Curious...

fields.EN:
Our top priority is getting more provisions
for our camp. The next is finding the rest
of our group.
fields.JP:
まずはこのキャンプで生活していくために
やるべきことと、他の仲間を探すことに
専念するのが最優先かと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our top priority is getting more provisions
for our camp. The next is finding the rest
of our group.

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Kadowaki? That was a
heavy sigh.
fields.JP:
どうしたんです、門脇。
大きくため息なんてついて
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Kadowaki? That was a
heavy sigh.

fields.EN:
Nothing. Just thinking to myself, even with
the white-haired boy around, I'm the only
human.
fields.JP:
いや、聞いてるとそこの白髪君も含めて、
あくまでも君たち人間じゃないのか……って思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing. Just thinking to myself, even with
the white-haired boy around, I'm the only
human.

fields.EN:
I can't really trust any of you, but I have
to. Guess we're in it for the long haul.
fields.JP:
いまいち信用できないけど、
今は協力して生き延びないといけないからね。
まあ、よろしく頼むよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't really trust any of you, but I have
to. Guess we're in it for the long haul.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that, Kadowaki?
fields.JP: 門脇、それってどういう……
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that, Kadowaki?

fields.EN: Oh, don't mind me. Just thinking aloud.
fields.JP:
ああ、気にしないでくれ。
ただそう思ったってだけのことだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, don't mind me. Just thinking aloud.

fields.EN:
(Can't trust any of us, including me? Or
is it a human thing? I get it though. I don't
trust any of them either.)
fields.JP:
（信用できない、というのは僕に対してか？
　それとも「人間」と思っていないこのメンバーか？
　まあ、信用していないのはお互い様だが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Can't trust any of us, including me? Or
is it a human thing? I get it though. I don't
trust any of them either.)

fields.EN:
(Can I infer from what Kadowaki said that
Haru isn't human either?)
fields.JP:
（しかしこの門脇の言い方だと、
　ハルという奴も人間じゃないというのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Can I infer from what Kadowaki said that
Haru isn't human either?)

fields.EN:
Well, I'm sure everyone's tired. Why don't
we get some rest?
fields.JP:
あー、今日はみんな疲れてるし、
もう休むとするか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm sure everyone's tired. Why don't
we get some rest?

fields.EN:
Agreed. Our plan is settled. Some beauty
sleep would do me wonders.
fields.JP:
そうですね。当面の方針も決まりましたし、
わらわもそろそろ寝転がりたいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agreed. Our plan is settled. Some beauty
sleep would do me wonders.

fields.EN: Let's call it a day. I'll be on my way.
fields.JP:
じゃあ今日は解散ということだな。
それでは失礼する
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's call it a day. I'll be on my way.

fields.EN:
(Finally. A place to lay my head. Not that I
plan to stick around much longer.)
fields.JP:
（さて、寝床は確保したが、
　いつまでもここで生活する気もない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Finally. A place to lay my head. Not that I
plan to stick around much longer.)

fields.EN:
(I'm sure they're in the same boat. But if
they keep dallying, I'll have to come up with
my own exit strategy.)
fields.JP:
（それはこいつらも同じだとは思うが……
　いつまでも足止めを食らうなら、
　他にも方法を考えなくてはな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure they're in the same boat. But if
they keep dallying, I'll have to come up with
my own exit strategy.)

fields.EN: (A long day has finally drawn to a close.)
fields.JP: （長い１日が、ようやく終わろうとしていた）
fields.LOCALIZED: (A long day has finally drawn to a close.)

fields.EN:
(Since arriving on the surface, I've narrowly
avoided death. I'm at my limits now.)
fields.JP:
（地上に出てからここまで、
　何度死線をくぐり抜けてきたことか。
　さすがに疲労も限界だった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Since arriving on the surface, I've narrowly
avoided death. I'm at my limits now.)

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime tended to Shirayukihime in one tent,
and the men decided to stay in another.)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫のことはかぐや姫に任せ、
　男連中はもう１つのテントで寝ることにした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya tended to Snow White in one tent,
and the men decided to stay in another.)

fields.EN: (Maybe Kadowaki didn't want to stay with us; the moment he said he'd stand watch, he left without waiting for a reply. He wasn't hostile, but he wasn't friendly either.)
fields.JP:
（だが門脇は僕たちと一緒にいたくないのか、
　見張りをすると言うと返事も待たずに出ていった。
　敵意こそないが、好意的でもない態度だった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kadowaki decided to stand watch and left
without a word. He hasn't been outwardly
hostile, but he's not exactly a team player.)

fields.EN: Don't worry about Towa. He's a good guy.
fields.JP:
永遠のことは気にすんな。
悪い奴じゃねえ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't worry about Towa. He's a good guy.

fields.EN:
I'm not bothered. To tell you the truth,
I don't care much for what others think.
fields.JP:
別に気にしていない。
どう思われようが、僕にはどうでもいい話だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not bothered. To tell you the truth,
I don't care much for what others think.

fields.JP: ……で、お前本当に何も覚えてないのか？

fields.EN:
You're persistent. All I remember is my wife,
that I'm a Blood Youth, and that I'm a Jail
tower. I told you.
fields.JP:
しつこいな。僕が覚えてるのは妻のこと、
血式少年であること、監獄塔だということ
だけだと言ったはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're persistent. All I remember is my wife,
that I'm a Blood Youth, and that I'm a Jail
tower. I told you.

fields.EN:
Sorry. I don't mean to pry. I thought perhaps
that sharing some stories would jog your
memory.
fields.JP:
悪い、疑ってるわけじゃないんだ。
ただもう少し記憶の断片を細かく教えてくれれば、
力になれるかもと思っただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I don't mean to pry. I thought perhaps
that sharing some stories would jog your
memory.

fields.EN: For example, if you remember your wife's face or what she wore, tell us what she looked like and we can search too. More efficient than searching alone, right?
fields.JP:
たとえば妻の顔や格好を覚えているなら、
その特徴を言ってくれれば、俺たちも探せる。
１人で探すよりは効率的だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, can you recall what she looks
like? What she wore? Those details might be
helpful in identifying her, don't you think?

fields.JP:
覚えている。
妻の顔も、その表情も

fields.EN:
You sure you want to know? She has nothing
to do with your mission.
fields.JP:
だがいいのか？
君たちには関係のないことだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure you want to know? She has nothing
to do with your mission.

fields.EN:
Our survival hinges on our cooperation.
Personally I feel safer knowing the people
I'm working with.
fields.JP:
今は力を合わせて生き延びるって状況だ。
一緒にいる奴とは、なるべくなら
いい関係を築くべきだと俺は思っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our survival hinges on our cooperation.
Personally I feel safer knowing the people
I'm working with.

fields.EN:
My wife wears a golden barrette on her pure
white hair.
fields.JP:
妻は艶のあるきれいな純白の長い髪に
金色のバレッタをしていて、
fields.LOCALIZED:
My wife wears a golden barrette on her pure
white hair.

fields.EN:
Her skin is fine, almost ethereal. If you told
me she was plucked from a fine painting, I
would believe you.
fields.JP:
肌は透き通るくらいにきめ細かく、
顔立ちも精巧な美術品のように美しいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her skin is fine, almost ethereal. If you told
me she was plucked from a fine painting, I
would believe you.

fields.EN:
At first glance, she might seem aloof, like a
fleeting beauty, but her smile glows with life.
That's the kind of woman she is.
fields.JP:
そして一見、儚いと思える風貌とは裏腹に、
常にニコニコ笑い、活力に満ち溢れている――
そんな女性だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first glance, she might seem aloof, like a
fleeting beauty, but her smile glows with life.
That's the kind of woman she is.

fields.EN:
Sounds like love. Didn't know we had a poet
on our hands.
fields.JP:
べた惚れだな。
ま、それだけの風貌と性格だもんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like love. Didn't know we had a poet
on our hands.

fields.JP: にしても、白い髪か……かなり珍しいな

fields.EN:
It's true. She's like no other from the
underground.
fields.JP: 確かに、地下ではほとんど見なかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. She's like no other from the
underground.

fields.EN:
Hopefully that means finding her won't be
too troublesome. If you see her, I'd like for
you to let me know.
fields.JP:
だが珍しいなら、見つけたらすぐに分かるだろう。
その時は教えてくれると助かる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hopefully that means finding her won't be
too troublesome. If you see her, I'd like for
you to let me know.

fields.EN:
Searching for a loved one can wear down
your heart. I can only imagine how you feel.
fields.JP:
まったく、探し人を持つと大変だよな。
心配で神経がすり減っちまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Searching for a loved one can wear down
your heart. I can only imagine how you feel.

fields.EN:
Right. I just pray she's safe. It's all I think
about.
fields.JP:
ああ、妻が無事でいてくれるかと、
そんなことを常に考えてしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I just pray she's safe. It's all I think
about.

fields.EN:
I'm looking for my dumb apprentice, myself.
I bet she's out there worried sick.
fields.JP:
……俺にも、早く見つけてやんねえと不安な
馬鹿弟子がいるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm looking for my dumb apprentice, myself.
I bet she's out there worried sick.

fields.EN:
That idiot...protected me. Hope she's okay
out there.
fields.JP:
あの馬鹿……俺なんかをかばいやがって……
無事でいてくれるといいが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That idiot...protected me. Hope she's okay
out there.

fields.EN: I hope you find her as well.
fields.JP: ……そいつも早く見つかるといいな
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope you find her as well.

fields.EN:
Oh. Lost track of time. Tomorrow's an early
one. Let's hit the hay.
fields.JP:
っと、話し込んじまったな。
明日も早い。そろそろ寝るか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Lost track of time. Tomorrow's an early
one. Let's hit the hay.

fields.EN:
(Okay. Finally got a full night's sleep, so I'm
ready to head out.)
fields.JP:
（よし、一晩休めたおかげで、
　だいぶ疲れも取れたな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Okay. Finally got a full night's sleep, so I'm
ready to head out.)

fields.EN:
(Today we begin our escape from the Jail.
My dearest, hang in there...)
fields.JP:
（今日からようやく監獄塔脱出に向けて
　動くことができる。妻よ、待っててくれ――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Today we begin our escape from the Jail.
My dearest, hang in there...)

fields.JP: あ、おはようございます！

fields.EN:
You saved me, right? You not only carried me.
You treated me.
fields.JP:
あなたが助けてくれた方ですよね？
ここまで運んでくれて、その上、
治療までしてくれたという
fields.LOCALIZED:
You saved me, right? You not only carried me.
You treated me.

fields.EN:
If it weren't for you, I would've died.
I can't thank you enough!
fields.JP:
あなたがいなかったら、
白雪はきっと死んじゃってました。
本当にありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it weren't for you, I would've died.
I can't thank you enough!

fields.EN:
Don't thank me. Call it self-preservation.
Be thankful you're a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
そのことなら、僕が生き残るために
仕方なくやったことだ。血式少女でよかったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't thank me. Call it self-preservation.
Be thankful you're a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN: Haha. They weren't kidding about you.
fields.JP: はは……お話通りの方ですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. They weren't kidding about you.

fields.EN:
I'll find a way to convince you that you made
the right decision saving me. I'm still healing,
but I'm a Blood Maiden after all.
fields.JP:
では助けて良かったと思って頂けるように、
病み上がりではありますが、血式少女としての
役割をしっかりと果たそうと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll find a way to convince you that you made
the right decision saving me. I'm still healing,
but I'm a Blood Maiden after all.
