fields.EN: Isn't it too soon for you to be moving? You should rest so the wound doesn't reopen. It's a life we managed to save, so don't waste it.
fields.JP:
まだ動くには早いんじゃないか？
傷を開かせないためにも、安静にしているべきだ。
せっかくすくい取った命だ、無駄にはするな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you think you should rest still?
Wouldn't want your wounds to open up.
Don't put my efforts to waste.

fields.EN: Is that a hint of concern I detect?
fields.JP: 心配してくれるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that a hint of concern I detect?

fields.JP: いや、そういうわけでは……

fields.EN:
Thank you. I'll make you grateful you saved
me!
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます。
救ってもらった命、大切にしながら頑張ります！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I'll make you grateful you saved
me!

fields.JP:
……まあいい。
それより、かぐや姫はどうした？

fields.EN:
She says she's too lazy to get up, so she
wants to reschedule the expedition for noon.
fields.JP:
ああ、かぐやさんなら、
起きるのが面倒くさいから、
探索は午後からにしよう、と言ってました
fields.LOCALIZED:
She says she's too lazy to get up, so she
wants to reschedule the expedition for noon.

fields.EN:
Are you serious? Why? She was so involved
yesterday.
fields.JP:
本当か？　何故だ……
昨日はあんなにやる気だったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you serious? Why? She was so involved
yesterday.

fields.EN:
What?! Kaguya? Involved?! I know things
were dire, but that's a stretch.
fields.JP:
ええっ！？　かぐやさんがやる気を出すだなんて！
いくら大変な状況とはいえ、驚きです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Kaguya? Involved?! I know things
were dire, but that's a stretch.

fields.EN:
That seems unfair. Your life was on the line.
She had no choice.
fields.JP:
意外と辛辣だな……
命が懸かってたんだ、
やる気を出さざるを得ないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
That seems unfair. Your life was on the line.
She had no choice.

fields.EN:
Well, Kaguya's not exactly known for her
work ethic. On account of her Blood Libido.
I'm surprised she overcame it.
fields.JP:
いえ、かぐやさんは元々とてつもない
面倒くさがりやで、それが血式リビドーなんです。
ですから、それに抗うのは大変だったはずです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Kaguya's not exactly known for her
work ethic. On account of her Blood Libido.
I'm surprised she overcame it.

fields.EN:
(Blood Libido... Isn't that one of the Blood
Maidens' inherent traits?)
fields.JP:
（血式リビドー……
　確か、この血式少女たちが持つ
　性格的特性だったはず……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Blood Libido... Isn't that one of the Blood
Maidens' inherent traits?)

fields.EN: (How do I know that? I'm right, I think.)
fields.JP:
（どうして僕がこんなことを知っているのか
　よく分からないが、それで正しいはずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (How do I know that? I'm right, I think.)

fields.EN:
I see. Sounds like she really stuck her
neck out for me.
fields.JP:
そっか、そんなに
頑張ってくれたんだあ、かぐやさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Sounds like she really stuck her
neck out for me.

fields.EN:
Where does that leave me? I want to get
a move on. Guess I have to get her.
fields.JP:
しかし困ったな、もう出発したいのだが……
しょうがない、呼びに行くか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where does that leave me? I want to get
a move on. Guess I have to get her.

fields.EN:
Since Kaguya worked so hard yesterday,
why don't we give her some time to rest?
fields.JP:
かぐやさん、昨日はとても
頑張ってくれたみたいだから、
少し休ませてあげてくれませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since Kaguya worked so hard yesterday,
why don't we give her some time to rest?

fields.EN: But we don't have time for that...
fields.JP: だがあまりゆっくりしている時間も……
fields.LOCALIZED: But we don't have time for that...

fields.EN:
(Then again, chaperoning a pair of girls
that are either exhausted or recovering
sounds like a headache.)
fields.JP:
（とはいえ、疲労を抱えた奴と
　病み上がりを連れて行っても、
　問題が起きる可能性が増えるだけか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then again, chaperoning a pair of girls
that are either exhausted or recovering
sounds like a headache.)

fields.EN: Got it. We'll take off at noon.
fields.JP: 分かった。午後からでいい
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. We'll take off at noon.

fields.JP: 本当ですか？　ありがとうございます！

fields.EN:
Oh. I thought I heard an excitable squall
in this direction.
fields.JP: おー、元気のいい声が響いてると思えば
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I thought I heard an excitable squall
in this direction.

fields.JP: ハルさん！	ご心配おかけしました！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP:
ちゃんと回復したみたいだな。
助かって本当によかったよ
はい、この方のおかげです

fields.EN:
No. It wasn't my treatment that saved
you. It was actually thanks to your fat
storage, Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
いや違う。助かったのは僕の応急処置よりも、
ひとえに白雪姫自身の、皮下脂肪の高さのおかげだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. It wasn't my treatment that saved
you. It was actually thanks to your fat
storage, Snow White.

fields.EN:
In this cold climate, your subcutaneous fat
prevented a loss of body heat. That's how
you survived.
fields.JP:
この極寒の中で、皮下脂肪が高いおかげで
体温の低下を防いでくれたことが、
白雪姫が助かった要因だろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
In this cold climate, your subcutaneous fat
prevented a loss of body heat. That's how
you survived.

fields.JP: そそ、そんなことあるはず……

fields.EN:
You should be proud. Not everyone has such
high subcutaneous fat―
fields.JP: 誇っていい。君の皮下脂肪が――
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should be proud. Not everyone has such
high subcutaneous fat―

fields.JP:
わ～～～～～っ！！
そんなこと聞きたくありません～～～～～！！
ははっ……かわいそうになあ

fields.EN:
We're going to work on your tact.
There's something about you that
reminds me of someone.
fields.JP:
ったく、言葉選びが絶望的だな。
お前みたいなカタブツ、昔どこかで見たことあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're going to work on your tact.
There's something about you that
reminds me of someone.

fields.EN: I think it's important to be direct.
fields.JP: 事実を伝えるのは大事なことだと思うが
fields.LOCALIZED: I think it's important to be direct.

fields.EN:
Hence why I think we should go over your
tact.
fields.JP: そういうところだ、カタブツ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hence why I think we should go over your
tact.

fields.EN:
(Is he serious? Sheesh. Women are an
enigma...)
fields.JP:
（そういうものなのか？　まったく、
　女心というものは分からないものだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is he serious? Sheesh. Women are an
enigma...)

fields.EN:
(I suppose I can occupy my time for a few
hours.)
fields.JP: （何にしてもあと数時間、僕も休もう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose I can occupy my time for a few
hours.)

fields.EN: Why is the Jail so big? I'm tiiiiired.
fields.JP:
監獄塔はどうしてこうも広いんでしょう。
わらわ、もう疲れました～
fields.LOCALIZED: Why is the Jail so big? I'm tiiiiired.

fields.JP:
かぐやさん、まだ出発して
そんなに経ってませんよ……

fields.EN:
But we haven't found anyone. I crave
discovery.
fields.JP:
だって誰も見つからないですし。
せめて新しい発見がほしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we haven't found anyone. I crave
discovery.

fields.JP: 何か見つけたんですか？

fields.EN: There's a core here. Let's go.
fields.JP: ああ、すぐそこに核がある。行くぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a core here. Let's go.

fields.JP: 本当に核がありましたね……

fields.EN: How'd you know this was here?
fields.JP: ど、どうして核があるって分かったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: How'd you know this was here?

fields.JP: 何となく感覚で核の位置を捉えただけだ

fields.EN:
Maybe you being a Blood Youth has
something to do with it?
fields.JP:
やっぱりそれも、
血式少年だからなんでしょうか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe you being a Blood Youth has
something to do with it?

fields.JP:
でもジャックさんには
そのような力はありませんでしたけど……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Even if we asked him, he'll claim he has
amnesia anyway.
fields.JP:
まあ、どうしてと尋ねても、記憶喪失さんは
答えを持ち合わせてはいないのでしょう～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if we asked him, he'll claim he has
amnesia anyway.

fields.EN:
You know me too well. Does that mean we
can skip the pointless questions?
fields.JP:
分かってるじゃないか。
これからもそんな感じで無駄な質問は
しないでくれると助かる
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know me too well. Does that mean we
can skip the pointless questions?

fields.EN:
Yeah yeah yeah. I don't care. Let's smash
that core to pieces.
fields.JP:
はいはい、わらわもどうでもいいですので～。
それよりも、核を破壊しておきましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah yeah yeah. I don't care. Let's smash
that core to pieces.

fields.EN: Right. Destroying it would be best.
fields.JP:
そうですね。壊しておくに
越したことはありません
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Destroying it would be best.

fields.JP:
待て、２人とも。
番人が出てきたぞ

fields.EN: Ah. I knew it looked too easy.
fields.JP:
ああ、やっぱり簡単には
やらせてくれないですか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah. I knew it looked too easy.

fields.JP: 仕方ない。あいつを倒すぞ

fields.EN: We beat it! Kaguya, destroy that core already!
fields.JP:
たっ、倒しました！
かぐやさん、核を破壊して下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED: We beat it! Kaguya, destroy that core already!

fields.EN: Yes. We won't miss this chance.
fields.JP: ええ。このチャンス、逃しません
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. We won't miss this chance.

fields.JP: 極寒の監獄塔のジェイル
ひぎぃっ、いやだああああ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛！！
いきなり倒れて、何があったんです！？
大丈夫だ、何でもないっ……

fields.EN:
Don't tell me that. It's clearly something!
You're about to faint! Are you sick?
fields.JP:
そんな、いきなり倒れそうになって、
何でもないわけないじゃないですか！
具合でも悪くなったんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me that. It's clearly something!
You're about to faint! Are you sick?

fields.EN:
No, that's not it... Did neither of you hear
that?
fields.JP:
いや、そうじゃない……
君たちは今何か聞こえなかったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not it... Did neither of you hear
that?

fields.JP: ジェイルの鳴き声なら聞こえましたけど～

fields.EN:
That loud screech, right? Yeah, I heard it.
Creepy...
fields.JP:
『ぎいいい～』って奴ですよね？
確かにあれ、気持ち悪いですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That loud screech, right? Yeah, I heard it.
Creepy...

fields.EN: Yeah, same here. It was horrible.
fields.JP: 聞くに堪えない声なのは確かですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, same here. It was horrible.

fields.EN:
(No. It didn't sound creepy. It was
someone's agonizing cry.)
fields.JP:
（違う。そんな人外の鳴き声なんかじゃなく、
　もっと人間の断末魔のような絶叫だったぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No. It didn't sound creepy. It was
someone's agonizing cry.)

fields.EN:
(I heard it the moment the core broke.
Echoing in my head. I thought my skull
would burst.)
fields.JP:
（そんな絶叫が、さっき核が破壊された瞬間、
　突然頭の中に響き渡った。
　頭が割れるかと思った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I heard it the moment the core broke.
Echoing in my head. I thought my skull
would burst.)

fields.EN:
(But it seems like neither of them caught
wind of it. Whose scream could it be?)
fields.JP:
（しかも２人にはまったく聞こえていないらしい。
　いったい誰の絶叫だっていうんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But it seems like neither of them caught
wind of it. Whose scream could it be?)

fields.EN:
You sure you're okay? Don't push yourself
too hard.
fields.JP:
本当に大丈夫ですか？
無理はしないで下さいね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure you're okay? Don't push yourself
too hard.

fields.EN:
Talk about our luck. We broke that core in
one go.
fields.JP:
それにしても、今回はラッキーでしたね～。
いきなり核を破壊できるなんて～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Talk about our luck. We broke that core in
one go.

fields.EN:
Yes. Now that the Nightmare is vulnerable,
we have hope!
fields.JP:
はい、これでナイトメアの不死性も
なくなりましたから、希望が見えてきました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Now that the Nightmare is vulnerable,
we have hope!

fields.EN:
No, not so fast. Seems like there's another
core.
fields.JP:
いや、喜ぶのはまだ早い。
どうやらもう１つ核があるようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not so fast. Seems like there's another
core.

fields.EN:
Whoa, really? Aw. Guess we'll delay the
celebration.
fields.JP:
うわ、本当ですか？
はぁ……わらわの喜びを返してほしいです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa, really? Aw. Guess we'll delay the
celebration.

fields.EN:
A Jail with two cores? Possible, but
unlikely.
fields.JP:
２つ核がある監獄塔……
確かにありますけど、珍しいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
A Jail with two cores? Possible, but
unlikely.

fields.EN:
But where? It could be anywhere. Should
we look for it now?
fields.JP:
どうする？　ここからだと結構遠そうだが、
破壊しに向かうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But where? It could be anywhere. Should
we look for it now?

fields.EN: No, let's stop for now~. Our first priority is to survive. To do that, we should look for our companions and supplies~.
fields.JP:
いえ、ひとまず止めておきましょう～。
今のわらわたちの目的は、まず生き残ること。
そのために仲間や物資を探すべきです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Let's table it for later. Our time now
is better served finding our friends or
provisions.

fields.EN:
I agree with Kaguya. Staying out here is
dangerous. We need to tread lightly.
fields.JP:
白雪もかぐやさんに賛成です。
無茶して死んでしまっては意味がありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree with Kaguya. Staying out here is
dangerous. We need to tread lightly.

fields.EN:
Then we'll proceed with our original plan
to find food and water.
fields.JP:
では当初の予定通り、
物資などの探索ということだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we'll proceed with our original plan
to find food and water.

fields.EN:
(Must keep focused while we wait out our
survival. This is a marathon, not a sprint.)
fields.JP:
（先に進みたいが、
　生き残るための基盤を固めなくては、
　この先が厳しいのも確かだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Must keep focused while we wait out our
survival. This is a marathon, not a sprint.)

fields.JP: よし、それじゃ探索の続きといこうか
２人とも、ちょっと待ってくれ

今度はどうしたんですか～？
また具合悪くなりましたか～？

fields.EN: Seems like...the other core's been destroyed.
fields.JP:
……どうやら、
もう１つの核も破壊されたようだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Seems like...the other core's been destroyed.

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sure of it. I sense it fading away.
Both of you might be skeptical.
fields.JP:
ああ、間違いない。反応が消えたのが分かる。
君たちには信じられないかもしれないが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sure of it. I sense it fading away.
Both of you might be skeptical.

fields.EN:
You located the core earlier. I trust your
intuition.
fields.JP:
あなたは先程、実際に核を探知しました。
その力については信じられます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You located the core earlier. I trust your
intuition.

fields.EN:
Which means the Nightmare is no longer
invincible!
fields.JP:
じゃあ今度こそナイトメアの不死性も
消えたってことですよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means the Nightmare is no longer
invincible!

fields.EN: Yes. They're no longer opponents we have absolutely no chance against~
fields.JP:
ええ。絶対に勝てない相手、
というわけではなくなりましたね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. Now they're as good as dead.

fields.EN: But who destroyed the other core...?
fields.JP: でも誰がもう１つの核を破壊したんでしょう……
fields.LOCALIZED: But who destroyed the other core...?

fields.EN:
Maybe Jack-san and the others were out there
and destroyed one too!
fields.JP:
ひょっとしたらジャックさんたちや、
他のみんなが壊してくれたのかも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Jack and the others were out there
and destroyed one too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
That's an idea! Only our friends could fend
off the Marchens.
fields.JP:
そうかもしれませんね～。
メルヒェンと戦える人なんて、
わらわたちの仲間くらいのものですし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's an idea! Only our friends could fend
off the Marchens.

fields.EN:
(I wonder why...the mere mention of his
name annoys me.)
fields.JP:
（何故だろう、その名前を聞くと、
　少し不愉快な気持ちになるのは）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why...the mere mention of his
name annoys me.)

fields.EN: (Maybe something happened between Jack and me before...)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたら以前、僕とジャックとの間に
　何かがあったのかもしれない……）
ん？　どうかされましたか？

いや、何でもない。
探索を続けよう
また暗闇が出てきたな……

fields.EN:
What should we do? Since the core's gone,
we shouldn't have to worry.
fields.JP:
どうしましょう？　核は破壊してあるから、
挑めないこともありませんが～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should we do? Since the core's gone,
we shouldn't have to worry.

fields.EN:
No. It's better for us to stay out of trouble
if we can help it.
fields.JP: いや、回避できる危険に挑む必要なんてない
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. It's better for us to stay out of trouble
if we can help it.

fields.EN: You're right. I'd rather kick back. Too lazy...
fields.JP:
そうですね、わらわも戦わなくていいなら、
こんな面倒なのは相手にしたくありません～
fields.LOCALIZED: You're right. I'd rather kick back. Too lazy...

fields.EN:
Just because the Nightmare is vulnerable
to attack doesn't make it less dangerous.
Safety should be our priority.
fields.JP:
確かに不死性は無くなったとはいえ、
ナイトメアは危険な存在です。
迂闊に挑むべきではないでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just because the Nightmare is vulnerable
to attack doesn't make it less dangerous.
Safety should be our priority.

fields.EN:
But if we want to find our friends, we may
not have a choice.
fields.JP:
ですが、この先にいるだろう
仲間かもしれない人たちに会うには、
戦うしかないと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we want to find our friends, we may
not have a choice.

fields.EN: So it comes to that after all... We've pretty much explored everything up to here~. That leaves what's beyond the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
やはりそうなりますか……
ここまではだいたい探索しましたしね～。
残るはナイトメアの向こう、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had a feeling you'd say that, but we've
been out for a while. The Nightmare's
all that's waiting for us.

fields.EN:
Then don't you think it would be wiser
for us to let it pass?
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが動くのを待って、
隙を見て通過するのはどうだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then don't you think it would be wiser
for us to let it pass?

fields.EN:
This area is dangerous enough as it is.
I doubt it would let us pass undetected.
fields.JP:
この辺りは逃げるだけでも大変です。
ましてや横をすり抜けるなんて、無理があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
This area is dangerous enough as it is.
I doubt it would let us pass undetected.

fields.EN:
(Rgh... What do we do?
Do we fight the Nightmare?)
fields.JP:
（くっ、どうする……？
　ナイトメアに戦いを挑むか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rgh... What do we do?
Do we fight the Nightmare?)

fields.EN:
(No, that's too dangerous. An unmeasured
risk.)
fields.JP:
（駄目だ、危険すぎる。
　それこそ命の無駄遣いだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No, that's too dangerous. An unmeasured
risk.)

fields.EN:
(Although Kaguyahime is right. We've scanned
this whole area. We need to move on, or
we're stuck.)
fields.JP:
（だが、かぐや姫の言うように、
　ここまではほとんど探索してしまった。
　この先に進まなければ立ち往生するだけだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Although Kaguya is right. We've scanned
this whole area. We need to move on, or
we're stuck.)

fields.EN:
(If I want to find my wife, we must press
forward.)
fields.JP:
（妻を探すためには、
　この先に進む必要がある）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I want to find my wife, we must press
forward.)

fields.JP: （だとするなら――これは戦う運命なんだろう）
分かった。ナイトメアを倒そう

fields.EN:
Right, I don't want to wallow in this Jail
forever. Fighting is our best choice.
fields.JP:
まあ、ずっとこの監獄塔で暮らすのも嫌ですしね～。
仕方ありません、やりますか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, I don't want to wallow in this Jail
forever. Fighting is our best choice.

fields.EN:
Listen up. Things are about to get hectic,
but I don't need to tell you that. I'll help
however I can.
fields.JP:
いいか、分かってると思うが無闇に突っ込むなよ。
僕もできる限りのサポートはする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen up. Things are about to get hectic,
but I don't need to tell you that. I'll help
however I can.

fields.EN:
If we get overwhelmed, we'll run for it.
Understand?
fields.JP:
そして危険と判断したらすぐ逃げる
わかったか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we get overwhelmed, we'll run for it.
Understand?

fields.EN: All right! It's starting to waver!
fields.JP: やったあ、攻撃がちゃんと通ります！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! It's starting to waver!

fields.EN:
Yeah. No time to get lazy, we're almost
at the end!
fields.JP:
ええ。油断しなければ、
何とか倒すことができそうですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. No time to get lazy, we're almost
at the end!

fields.JP: これがナイトメアの本体……

fields.EN:
(That Nightmare is so fearsome. What a
treacherous creature.)
fields.JP:
（本当にこのナイトメアというのは、
　不気味な姿をしているな。
　まるでこの世のものとは思えない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That Nightmare is so fearsome. What a
treacherous creature.)

fields.EN:
(Wait, strange. I've never seen one before.
Why do I revere it so...?)
fields.JP:
（いや、おかしいな。どうして僕は、
　このナイトメア以外見たこともないのに、
　そんな風に思ったんだ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, strange. I've never seen one before.
Why do I revere it so...?)

fields.EN:
You two, the Nightmare is moving.
Watch out!
fields.JP:
おふたりとも、ナイトメアが動きます。
気をつけて下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You two, the Nightmare is moving.
Watch out!

fields.EN: We made it this far. Here we go!
fields.JP: ここまできたら、絶対に倒しましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: We made it this far. Here we go!

fields.JP: ごぎぎぎぎぎぃぃぃっ！

fields.EN: *pant, pant* I thought I was a goner for sure.
fields.JP: はぁっ、はぁっ、し、死ぬかと思いました～
fields.LOCALIZED: *pant, pant* I thought I was a goner for sure.

fields.EN: But we took it down, just the three of us!
fields.JP:
でも白雪たちだけでも
しっかりと勝てましたね！
fields.LOCALIZED: But we took it down, just the three of us!

fields.EN:
Now that you mention it, going into battle
with only two Blood Maidens is pretty
reckless.
fields.JP:
そう言われてみれば、
血式少女２人だけで戦うなんて、
なかなかに無理がありましたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you mention it, going into battle
with only two Blood Maidens is pretty
reckless.

fields.EN: Thank you both. Now we can progress.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、２人とも。
これで先に進める
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you both. Now we can progress.

fields.EN: I didn't do it for you.
fields.JP:
別にあなたのためだけに
やったわけじゃありません～
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't do it for you.

fields.EN: True, but you have my thanks regardless.
fields.JP: そうだな。でも、感謝する
fields.LOCALIZED: True, but you have my thanks regardless.

fields.EN:
Let's move on! With the Nightmare gone,
we can search for the others in peace.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ先に進みましょう！
ナイトメアもいなくなったことですし、
安心してみなさんを探せますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's move on! With the Nightmare gone,
we can search for the others in peace.

fields.EN:
(Which brings me one step closer to
finding my wife...)
fields.JP:
（よし、これで妻探しを
　ようやく進めることができる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which brings me one step closer to
finding my wife...)

fields.EN:
Seems we've entered the Jail's innermost
chamber.
fields.JP:
どうやらこの部屋が、
監獄塔のいちばん奥に当たるようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems we've entered the Jail's innermost
chamber.

fields.EN: (If there's nothing here, we'll be in serious trouble... Please, let there at least be some clue that can help us move forward—)
fields.JP:
（ここに何もないと非常に困る……
　頼む、何か先に進む手がかりだけでも
　見つかってくれ――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we find nothing here, then hope is lost.
Any hint will do. Please―)

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Oh, my. Must've been you who destroyed
the other core.
fields.JP:
まあ、もう１つの核を破壊したのは
赤ずきんだったんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, my. Must've been you who destroyed
the other core.

fields.EN:
(Ah, we've encountered others. She looks
like a Blood Maiden. How convenient.)
fields.JP:
（やはり別の人間がいたか……
　どうやら血式少女のようだし、
　それなら僕にとっては好都合だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah, we've encountered others. She looks
like a Blood Maiden. How convenient.)

fields.EN: Akazukin. Don't tell me you're alone.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、あなたまさか
１人ってことはありませんよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood. Don't tell me you're alone.

fields.JP: どうしたんですか、赤姉様？
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: そちらに何があるって言うんです？
（ん？　誰か部屋にいたのか）
どうしてあなたが、ここにいるんですか……

fields.EN: Do you two know this man?
fields.JP: ２人とも、こいつを知っているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you two know this man?

fields.EN: Huh. When did I fall asleep?
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh. When did I fall asleep?

fields.EN:
(I'm so confused. How did I get here?
Blegh. It smells old and musty here. Ugh...)
fields.JP:
（意味分かんねえ。
　何がどうしてこうなった？
　くそっ、埃っぽいしカビ臭いし、最悪……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm so confused. How did I get here?
Blegh. It smells old and musty here. Ugh...)

fields.EN:
(Hey, wait. There's a core. Wait, am I inside
a Jail...?)
fields.JP:
（って、核があるじゃねえか。
　まさかジェイルなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hey, wait. There's a core. Wait, am I inside
a Jail...?)

fields.EN: I don't see any Marchens nearby.
fields.JP: 周りにメルヒェンはいねえみてーだな
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't see any Marchens nearby.

fields.EN:
Passing out then waking up to one of those
big meanies would suck. Close call.
fields.JP:
目覚めた瞬間目の前にいた、
なんつったら確実にアウトだったからな。
あぶねーあぶねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Passing out then waking up to one of those
big meanies would suck. Close call.

fields.EN:
The core is...unresponsive. Guess this thing
doesn't recognize me.
fields.JP:
核は……反応しないか。やっぱりこいつも
俺のこと、認識してねーようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core is...unresponsive. Guess this thing
doesn't recognize me.

fields.EN:
Wait, she's not around. Tch. I was trying
to save my matches.
fields.JP:
そういえばあいつがいねーじゃねーか。
ちっ、マッチ節約中だってのに、仕方ねーな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, she's not around. Tch. I was trying
to save my matches.

fields.EN:
Ahh. Nothing better than the sharp strike
of a match.
fields.JP: はぁ～マッチの火は落ちつくぜ～～～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ahh. Nothing better than the sharp strike
of a match.

fields.EN:
Oops. There I go, daydreaming before the
match goes out.
fields.JP:
っていけね、燃え尽きちまう前に
妄想して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oops. There I go, daydreaming before the
match goes out.

fields.EN: Now, I have to throw it into the core.
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, I have to throw it into the core.

fields.EN:
Man, if only I had some grunts to do the
work for me.
fields.JP:
うっし、俺の代わりに
面倒なことやってくれるやつがいねーとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man, if only I had some grunts to do the
work for me.

fields.EN:
But that would mean more mouths to feed.
Let's see how many I've got... Tch.
I'm practically out.
fields.JP:
でも大事に使っていかねえと。
残りは……ちっ、もうこんな減ってんのかよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that would mean more mouths to feed.
Let's see how many I've got... Tch.
I'm practically out.

fields.EN:
(Used to have more than I could count.
Was sure I'd never run out, I was invincible.)
fields.JP:
（昔は山ほどあって、
　いくら使っても減らねえ気がして、
　無敵感が半端なかったんだけどな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Used to have more than I could count.
Was sure I'd never run out, I was invincible.)

fields.EN:
(I kept creating this thing to make life easier,
and kept seeing visions now and then. Before I knew it,
I was down to this few...)
fields.JP:
（ついつい楽するためにコイツを生み出したり、
　ちょくちょく幻覚見てたせいで、気づけば
　いつの間にかこんなに少なく……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Spent too much time on my ass, watching
phantoms as the hours passed. Now they're
all gone...)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN:
(Might as well throw the rest of 'em
in the core to entertain myself.)
fields.JP:
（いっそのこと残りのマッチ全部核に投げ込んで、
　俺専用の特大理想郷でも作ったろか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Might as well throw the rest of 'em
in the core to entertain myself.)

fields.EN:
(It'd be a hell of a lot of fun if I wrapped
this whole area in a vision.)
fields.JP:
（ここら一帯を全部幻覚に包んだら、
　すげー楽しいんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Bet I could make this place a real
ghost town in seconds.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN:
(But Charlotte says I have to conserve.
Gotta be frugal.)
fields.JP:
（でもシャーロットにあんまり使うな、
　節約しろって言われてるしな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But Charlotte says I have to conserve.
Gotta be frugal.)

fields.EN:
(If I ran out of matches, Charlotte
wouldn't be too happy with me...)
fields.JP:
（マッチなくなったら
　シャーロットも悲しむよな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I ran out of matches, Charlotte
wouldn't be too happy with me...)

fields.EN:
(She loves to use me as a shoulder to cry on.
The thought alone makes me teary...)
fields.JP:
（俺を膝枕するシャーロット。
　そんな俺の頬を、あいつの涙が打つ――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She loves to use me as a shoulder to cry on.
The thought alone makes me teary...)

fields.EN:
(Not that it's a bad thing. I wouldn't wanna
make her cry. Shoot, guess I'll pass.)
fields.JP:
（っつー展開も悪くはねえんだけど、
　リアルに泣き顔見たいってわけじゃねえし。
　仕方ない、我慢するか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that it's a bad thing. I wouldn't wanna
make her cry. Shoot, guess I'll pass.)

fields.JP: （っつーか誰もいねーのかよ）
あのー、誰か、いい、いませんか……？

fields.EN:
I told 'em all along that we should've
stayed beneath the surface. They're
all nuts...
fields.JP:
だから地上なんて出なきゃよかったんだよ、
何だよあのイカれた連中はよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told 'em all along that we should've
stayed beneath the surface. They're
all nuts...

fields.JP: 俺は地下にいるべきだって思ってたのによ……

fields.EN:
But I was told that staying meant possibly
starving, which didn't leave me much choice.
fields.JP:
地下に残ったら食糧供給なくなるかもとか、
言われたら地上に行くしか選択肢ないだろうが
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I was told that staying meant possibly
starving, which didn't leave me much choice.

fields.EN:
This place is a dump. So much for paradise.
Who do I complain to here?
fields.JP:
マジ鬼畜の所行だわ。
で、このザマだ。責任者出てこいっての
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place is a dump. So much for paradise.
Who do I complain to here?

fields.EN:
(Ugh, I feel awful.
Maybe I should strike a match and see a vision...?)
fields.JP:
（あーもう最悪の気分だ。
　やっぱりマッチ擦って幻覚見るか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh, I'm getting worked up. Maybe I should
light up a match and find a phantom.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.JP: （シャーロット、探しに行くか……）

fields.EN:
(After walking aimlessly through the
field, I encounter a big path.)
fields.JP: （適当に道を進んでたら広い道にでたな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After walking aimlessly through the
field, I encounter a big path.)

fields.EN:
(Great. I'm lost! I need to find Charlotte
before I'm stuck here forever.)
fields.JP:
（って、どこ歩いて来たか分からなくなっちまった！
　本格的に迷子になる前にシャーロット
　見つけねえと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Great. I'm lost! I need to find Charlotte
before I'm stuck here forever.)

fields.JP: （げっ、メルヒェンじゃねえか）

fields.EN:
(Ugh. Can't believe those pests are here
too.)
fields.JP:
（何だよ、あの気持ち悪いの、
　ここにもいんのかよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. Can't believe those pests are here
too.)

fields.JP: （やっぱここはジェイルで決まりか……？）

fields.EN:
(I need to shoo already or I can't move on.
Ugh, get out of here.)
fields.JP:
（しかし、どっか行ってくんねえと
　先に進めないな……ああもう、
　ウロチョロしてんじゃねえよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I need to shoo already or I can't move on.
Ugh, get out of here.)

fields.JP: 俺に秘められた力とかあればなあ……

fields.EN:
(Evil power sealed in my right arm...
The moment this logo is displayed
the enemy's death was unavoidable.)
fields.JP:
（右腕に封印されし邪神の力……
　この紋様が浮かび上がった今、
　奴の死は確定した）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Evil power sealed in my right arm...
The moment this logo is displayed
the enemy's death was unavoidable.)

fields.EN:
(Silly Marchens. They'll rue the day
they disturbed Mary.)
fields.JP:
（迫り来るメルヒェン。
　だが覚醒したメアリーの敵ではなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Silly Marchens. They'll rue the day
they disturbed Mary.)

fields.EN:
(Mary slips into the enemy's guard in an instant.
The foolish foe can't even follow her movements.
Then she swings her shining fist!)
fields.JP:
（一瞬で懐に潜り込むメアリー。
　愚かな敵は、その動きを捉えることもできない。
　そして彼女は輝く拳を振り抜く！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She dives into the fracas, nimbly evading
enemy strikes, only to return the favor
with a haymaker!)

fields.EN:
(In one hit, the Marchen is vanquished.
Mary wipes off the blood in one swift
motion, and Charlotte hugs her tearfully.)
fields.JP:
（その一撃で消滅するメルヒェン。
　メアリーはクールな表情で血を払う。
　シャーロットは潤んだ瞳で飛び込んでくる――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In one hit, the Marchen is vanquished.
Mary wipes off the blood in one swift
motion, and Charlotte hugs her tearfully.)

fields.EN:
(Damn, I'm awesome. Charlotte, of course,
would fawn over me.)
fields.JP:
（やっべ、かっけえな俺。
　そりゃシャーロットも完全にメスの顔するわ――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn, I'm awesome. Charlotte, of course,
would fawn over me.)

fields.EN: (H-How'd that thing sneak up on me?!)
fields.JP:
（メメ、メルヒェン、
　いつの間にこんな近くに！？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (H-How'd that thing sneak up on me?!)

fields.EN:
S-S-Sorry. I'm so sorry. That haymaker
was just a joke! P-please don't kill me!
fields.JP:
ごっ、ごご、ごめんなさいごめんなさいっ、
ワンパンで倒すなんてウソですっ！
だだ、だから許して……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-S-Sorry. I'm so sorry. That haymaker
was just a joke! P-please don't kill me!

fields.EN:
(Oh, so that thing can't see me either.
I got all wimpy for nothing.)
fields.JP:
（ああ、あいつも俺のこと見えてないのか。
　謝って損したじゃねーか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, so that thing can't see me either.
I got all wimpy for nothing.)

fields.EN:
Heh. Idiot. You're nothing.
Next time I see you, you're dead!
fields.JP:
へっ、ばーか余裕だっつーの。
次に会ったらマジでぶっ飛ばすからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh. Idiot. You're nothing.
Next time I see you, you're dead!

fields.JP: やや、やっぱウソですゴメンナサイ……！

fields.EN:
(Wait, did I imagine that?
That Marchen is... Okay, it's gone.)
fields.JP:
（って、気のせいか……。
　メルヒェンは……うん、いねえな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, did I imagine that?
That Marchen is... Okay, it's gone.)

fields.JP: （あーもう、シャーロットどこにいるんだよ）
早いとこ、探さないとな

fields.EN:
(I've walked all over, and she was just
with me near the surface opening. She
has to be nearby.)
fields.JP:
（俺がどうやってここに運ばれてきたのか
　分かんないけど、地上では近くにいたんだ。
　だから今もきっとそばにいるはず……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've walked all over, and she was just
with me near the surface opening. She
has to be nearby.)

fields.EN:
(So why can't I find her? Great, leave it
to the professional loner. I'm teetering
on the edge here.)
fields.JP:
（なのにどうして見つからないんだ。
　お一人様を極めた俺じゃなかったら、
　絶望してるところだぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So why can't I find her? Great, leave it
to the professional loner. I'm teetering
on the edge here.)

fields.JP: （ん？　向こうに誰か倒れてる……）

fields.EN: (Say, that's Miss Know-It-All from the Dawn.)
fields.JP: （あれは確か、黎明にいたリア充メンバー）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Say, that's Miss Know-It-All from the Dawn.)

fields.EN:
(Hm. Should I call out to her? I mean,
it's not like we're friends.)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう、声かけた方がいいのか？
　でもお互いに知り合いでもねーし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. Should I call out to her? I mean,
it's not like we're friends.)

fields.EN:
(Sh-She's bleeding all over...!
Wait, is she already dead?!)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだあの血の量……！
　もしかして死んでるのか……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sh-She's bleeding all over...!
Wait, is she already dead?!)

fields.EN:
(Wh-wh-wh-what do I do...?
Even if she's still alive, I can't do
anything for her wound.)
fields.JP:
（ど、どど、どうしよう……？
　生きてるとしても、あの怪我じゃ
　俺には助けられねーぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-wh-wh-what do I do...?
Even if she's still alive, I can't do
anything for her wound.)

fields.EN:
(And if I were to treat her and she
kicks it, I'd never live with myself.)
fields.JP:
（それに手当てして死なれたら
　すげー後味悪いし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And if I were to treat her and she
kicks it, I'd never live with myself.)

fields.EN:
(If Charlotte were here, she'd tell
me to save her.)
fields.JP:
（ああでも、シャーロットならきっと
　助けろって言うだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If Charlotte were here, she'd tell
me to save her.)

fields.EN:
(Do I leave her hanging, or do I help?
Oh, I'll pretend I didn't see her!)
fields.JP:
（見捨てるか、助けるか。
　そうだ、見なかったことにするってのは――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Do I leave her hanging, or do I help?
Oh, I'll pretend I didn't see her!)

fields.JP: （やべえ、何か来る！　隠れねーと……！）

fields.EN:
(That thing's kneeling near Miss Know-It-All.
What's it doing? Is it eating her...?)
fields.JP:
（あ、あいつリア充のそばにしゃがみ込んで、
　いったい何してやがるんだ。
　まさか食ってんのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That thing's kneeling near Miss Know-It-All.
What's it doing? Is it eating her...?)

fields.JP: （そしてこの機械みたいな音は何だ？）
―アリス、お前は死んでは駄目なんだ……―

fields.EN:
(What's it saying...? Crap, it's heading
this way!)
fields.JP:
（あいつ何をしゃべってるんだ……？
　って、今度はこっちに来る！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's it saying...? Crap, it's heading
this way!)

fields.EN:
(K-K-K-K-Keep calm! Look down, avoid eye 
contact. I-If I don't move, then maybe―!)
fields.JP:
（お、おおおお、落ち着け俺！
　目を合わせないように下向くんだ、
　そんで動かなければ、もしかしたら……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(K-K-K-K-Keep calm! Look down, avoid eye 
contact. I-If I don't move, then maybe―!)

fields.EN:
(Wait, this hallway's got nowhere to
hide. Crap. They'll find me!)
fields.JP:
（って、ただ通路の陰に隠れてるだけじゃ、
　やっぱり無理がある！　駄目だ、見つかる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, this hallway's got nowhere to
hide. Crap. They'll find me!)

fields.JP: （気づかれずにやり過ごせた……？）

（よかった……あいつにも
　俺のこと見えてねーみたいだな）

fields.EN:
(Oh? That Dawn girl's fine now. 
Does that mean it was friendly?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　あの黎明のリア充、治療されてる。
　なんだ今の奴ってば、いいやつじゃねーか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh? That Dawn girl's fine now. 
Does that mean it was friendly?)

fields.EN:
(Not to forget, do I have to make small
talk with Miss Know-It-All?)
fields.JP:
（つーかどうしよう。
　リア充に話しかけた方がいいのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not to forget, do I have to make small
talk with Miss Know-It-All?)

fields.EN:
(Well, she's up and at 'em. She's alive,
right?)
fields.JP:
（まあ治療はされたんだし、
　生きてるなら……生きてるよな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, she's up and at 'em. She's alive,
right?)

fields.EN:
(Not that I'd want to say hi. Besides,
I'm better off alone.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱ声かけるの嫌だな。
　うーん、１人でいいかなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that I'd want to say hi. Besides,
I'm better off alone.)

fields.EN:
(But walking around here alone gives
me the heebie-jeebies too...)
fields.JP:
（でもこんな怖いとこに
　１人で居続けるのもしんどいし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But walking around here alone gives
me the heebie-jeebies too...)

fields.EN:
(Chances are that waking her means
subjecting myself to unnecessary
conversation, which I don't want either.)
fields.JP:
（でも起こしたら怒濤のトークに
　巻き込まれたりすんのかな。
　それはちょっと面倒かも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Chances are that waking her means
subjecting myself to unnecessary
conversation, which I don't want either.)

fields.EN: (No... if it's just to tide me over until I find Charlotte, maybe that's fine...? I can handle one or two bits of standard couple sex talk, easy... right?)
fields.JP:
（いや、シャーロットが見つかるまでの
　繋ぎならまあいいか……？　俺もリア充定番の
　エロトークの１つや２つ、余裕だし？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, maybe it could kill time while I
find Charlotte? I can totally handle an
adult conversation for at least a bit.)

fields.JP:
あああ、あのぅ……
だ、大丈夫です、かぁ……？

fields.EN:
How'd I get here? Ugh, I can't remember
anything.
fields.JP:
わたし、どうしてこんなところに？
……駄目、思い出せない
fields.LOCALIZED:
How'd I get here? Ugh, I can't remember
anything.

fields.EN: Someone healed me... Who was it?
fields.JP:
それに傷が、治療されてるわ……
いったい誰が……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Someone healed me... Who was it?

fields.EN:
(Oh, she can't see me. Not that way.
This way.)
fields.JP:
（あ、こいつ俺に気がついてねえ。
　ったく、そっちにゃいねえよ。こっちだこっち）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, she can't see me. Not that way.
This way.)

fields.EN:
(Argh. Should I tap her shoulder?
You better not be scared.)
fields.JP:
（ああもう、肩叩くからな？
　驚いたりすんなよ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Argh. Should I tap her shoulder?
You better not be scared.)

fields.EN:
Y...You are...? Wait, have you been here
the whole time?
fields.JP:
あ……あなたは……？
もしかして、ずっとそこにいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y...You are...? Wait, have you been here
the whole time?

fields.EN:
Y-Yes.... Um, I-I've been standing right
in front of you!
fields.JP:
は、はいぃ、そのですね、
ずっとしょしょ、しょばにいました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes.... Um, I-I've been standing right
in front of you!

fields.EN:
S-Sorry I didn't notice you! I didn't expect
to see anyone, so I was frightened.
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさい気づかなくて！
誰もいないと思ってたから、驚いちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sorry I didn't notice you! I didn't expect
to see anyone, so I was frightened.

fields.JP: いい、いえぇ、だ、大丈夫、です……

fields.EN: (I knew this would happen. I'm used to it.)
fields.JP:
（こうなると思ったわ。
　もう慣れたけどよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I knew this would happen. I'm used to it.)

fields.EN:
Hey, I think I was hurt pretty bad.
Did you treat me?
fields.JP:
ねえ、わたし酷い怪我だったと思うのだけど、
もしかしてあなたが手当てしてくれたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I think I was hurt pretty bad.
Did you treat me?

fields.EN:
(Crap, what do I tell her? It wasn't me.
I was too busy hiding in the corner.)
fields.JP:
（やべ、どうしよう。手当てなんてしてねーし、
　怖いから話しかけただけだなんて言えねえ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Crap, what do I tell her? It wasn't me.
I was too busy hiding in the corner.)

fields.JP:
そっ、そそ、そうですね……えっと、
あたしが……はい、見てました……

fields.EN:
So, it was you! If you weren't there,
I would've died for sure.
fields.JP:
やっぱりそうだったのね……！
ありがとう、あなたが看てくれなかったら、
わたし、きっとここで死んでいたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it was you! If you weren't there,
I would've died for sure.

fields.JP:
い、いえ……当然のこっ、こと……
したまでで、です

fields.EN:
(I have a feeling she misunderstood me.
Oh well. I didn't lie.)
fields.JP:
（なんかご誤解された気もするけど
　ま、いいか。ウソはついてないし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have a feeling she misunderstood me.
Oh well. I didn't lie.)

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I didn't introduce myself.
fields.JP:
あ、ごめんなさい。
自己紹介しないと話しづらいわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I didn't introduce myself.

fields.EN:
I'm Alice. I'm a Blood Maiden of the Dawn.
Do you know what that is...?
fields.JP:
わたしはアリスという名前よ。
黎明の血式少女なんだけど……分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm Alice. I'm a Blood Maiden of the Dawn.
Do you know what that is...?

fields.EN:
Y-yyyyes. I know. I too came from the
underground.
fields.JP:
は、はいい、分かります。
あた、あたしもっ、地下から来た、ので
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-yyyyes. I know. I too came from the
underground.

fields.EN: Oh, wonderful. Can you tell me your name?
fields.JP:
そう、よかった。
じゃああなたのお名前も教えてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, wonderful. Can you tell me your name?

fields.JP:
えっと、ああたしは…………
メアリー…………です……

fields.EN: What a lovely name. It's a pleasure, Mary.
fields.JP:
いい名前じゃない。
よろしくね、メアリー
fields.LOCALIZED: What a lovely name. It's a pleasure, Mary.

fields.EN:
So Mary, do you know where we are,
and how we got here?
fields.JP:
それでメアリー、あなたここがどこなのか、
どうしてこんな場所にいるのか、分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Mary, do you know where we are,
and how we got here?

fields.EN:
I-I don't know...what's going on either.
Yup.
fields.JP:
あ、あたしには、何がなんだか、
ぜんぜん……です、はい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I don't know...what's going on either.
Yup.

fields.EN:
I see. We're stranded together, are we?
Where are we...?
fields.JP:
そう……あなたも分からないのね。
いったいどういうことなのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. We're stranded together, are we?
Where are we...?

fields.EN:
Oh, have you seen anyone else? I'm looking
for a boy with light blue hair. Does that ring
a bell?
fields.JP:
そうだ、他の人たち見なかった？
特に水色の髪の男の子を目撃していたら、
教えてほしいのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, have you seen anyone else? I'm looking
for a boy with light blue hair. Does that ring
a bell?

fields.JP: いい、いえ、みみ見て、いません……

fields.EN:
(Is she really worried about a guy at a time
like this? Hmph!)
fields.JP: （こんな状況でも男の心配かよ、けっ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she really worried about a guy at a time
like this? Hmph!)

fields.EN:
I see... How about a hooded girl with
short hair?
fields.JP:
そう……。
他にもフード被った
ショートカットの女の子や……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see... How about a hooded girl with
short hair?

fields.EN:
(What gives? I just said I didn't see anyone
else. Just look down.)
fields.JP:
（んだよ、誰にも会ってねーっつの
　とりあえず下見てやり過ごそう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What gives? I just said I didn't see anyone
else. Just look down.)

fields.EN:
(There's something by Alice's foot.
Looks expensive...!)
fields.JP:
（アリスの足元に何か落ちてるな
　高級っぽそう……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's something by Alice's foot.
Looks expensive...!)

fields.EN:
Aah! What's the matter? Is something
on my leg?
fields.JP:
きゃっ！ ど、どうしたの？
わたしの足に何かついてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah! What's the matter? Is something
on my leg?

fields.EN:
(There's string wrapped around her foot.
Got it off, but I won't bother explaining...)
fields.JP:
（足に紐が少しからんでんな……よし、取れた。
　しかし、言うのもめんどうだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's string wrapped around her foot.
Got it off, but I won't bother explaining...)

fields.EN:
Well, hehe... I haven't seen anyone either.
Uh, yup...
fields.JP:
い、いや……へへ
おれ……あたしも、だ誰ともあってない
……です、はい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, hehe... I haven't seen anyone either.
Uh, yup...

fields.EN:
Oh, really? So I'm the only other person
you've met down here?
fields.JP:
え、あ、そうなの
じゃあ、あなたにとっても、
わたしがここに来て初めて会った人なのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really? So I'm the only other person
you've met down here?

fields.EN:
Sounds like neither of us knows what
we're in for.
fields.JP:
どうやらわたしたち、まだ全然
状況を把握できていないみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like neither of us knows what
we're in for.

fields.EN:
But I'm glad we met. Thanks for saving me.
Two's always better than one out here.
fields.JP:
でもこうして出会えてよかったわ。
助けてくれたことももちろんだけど、
１人より２人の方が生存率が上がるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm glad we met. Thanks for saving me.
Two's always better than one out here.

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
I had a feeling this place resembled a
Jail...!
fields.JP:
雰囲気が何となくジェイルのようだとは
思ったけれど、やっぱりここは……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had a feeling this place resembled a
Jail...!

fields.EN: Mary, I'll take front. Stay behind me, okay?
fields.JP:
メアリー、わたしが前に出るから、
あなたはなるべく下がってて
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, I'll take front. Stay behind me, okay?

fields.EN:
(So she plans to take it on. How in the
world did that Marchen recognize me?)
fields.JP:
（戦う気か、こいつ。
　でも何でいきなりメルヒェンは
　俺のことを認識――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So she plans to take it on. How in the
world did that Marchen recognize me?)

fields.EN:
(Oh, I see! Since she's here, the Marchen
can see me too!)
fields.JP:
（そうか！　こいつがいるせいで
　俺までメルヒェンに見えちまってるんだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I see! Since she's here, the Marchen
can see me too!)

fields.EN:
(Damn it. I messed up. I should've just
ignored her!)
fields.JP:
（クソッ、大失敗だ。
　こんなことなら話しかけるんじゃなかった！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn it. I messed up. I should've just
ignored her!)

fields.EN: (I have no choice but to fight!)
fields.LOCALIZED: (I have no choice but to fight!)

fields.EN:
I think that was the last of them. Mary,
you were amazing back there.
fields.JP:
これで終わりのようね。
メアリー、あなたもなかなかやるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think that was the last of them. Mary,
you were amazing back there.

fields.EN:
(That was terrifying... I didn't know
battling was so strenuous...)
fields.JP:
（ああ怖かった……
　戦いなんて妄想でしかしたことないっての……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was terrifying... I didn't know
battling was so strenuous...)

fields.JP:
ちょっとメアリー！
あなた、その瞳の色……

fields.EN: Huh? Wh-What? I... Did I do something bad?
fields.JP:
えっ？　なな、あた、あたし
何かいけないことでも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Wh-What? I... Did I do something bad?

fields.EN:
Let me see!
...Oh my goodness, I don't believe it.
fields.JP:
ちょっとよく見せて！
……やっぱりそうね、間違いない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let me see!
...Oh my goodness, I don't believe it.

fields.JP: メアリー、あなた血式少女だったのね！

fields.EN:
Uh... I-I-I think Charlotte mentioned
that, yes...
fields.JP:
えええと、そそ、そんなことを
確かシャーロットが言ってたような……はい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh... I-I-I think Charlotte mentioned
that, yes...

fields.EN:
I didn't know there were still Blood
Maidens. Where've you been all this
time? What fairytale are you from?
fields.JP:
まだ血式少女がいたなんて……
ねえ、あなた今までどこにいたの！？
いったい何のおとぎ話なの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know there were still Blood
Maidens. Where've you been all this
time? What fairytale are you from?

fields.JP:
あの、しょの……かかか解ほ……
えっと……その……

fields.EN:
(Why is she so interested?! What does
that have to do with anything?!)
fields.JP:
（何でいきなり食いついてくんだよ！
　それが今何の関係があるっつーんだ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is she so interested?! What does
that have to do with anything?!)

fields.EN: (You're scaring me! That face! Lemme go!)
fields.JP: （怖えよ、顔近えよ！　もう勘弁してくれ！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (You're scaring me! That face! Lemme go!)

fields.JP: ねえ、誰かいるのーーー？

fields.EN:
(That voice... It's Charlotte!
Oh thank goodness!)
fields.JP:
（あの声は……シャーロット！！
　やった、助かったぜ……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That voice... It's Charlotte!
Oh thank goodness!)

fields.JP:
おーーーーーいシャーロットーーーー！
俺はここだぁ～～～～～～～～！！

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... *pant, pant*...
I'm sure she heard me.
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ、はぁっ……
これで声、届いただろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... *pant, pant*...
I'm sure she heard me.

fields.EN: I didn't know you could scream so loud...
fields.JP: あなた、こんな大きな声出せたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't know you could scream so loud...

fields.JP:
メアリー、無事だったのね～。
よかったわ～

fields.EN:
Who you thanking! I told you, Charlotte!
The surface is shit!
fields.JP:
よくねえよ！
シャーロット、やっぱ地上は
クソだったじゃねーか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who you thanking! I told you, Charlotte!
The surface is shit!

fields.EN: Well, you were right. This place is a mess.
fields.JP:
そうね、本当に
たいへんなことになっちゃったわね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, you were right. This place is a mess.

fields.EN:
A mess, my ass! Give me peace and quiet
underground any day!
fields.JP:
なっちゃったわね～、じゃねえよ！
俺の平穏な日々を返せ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A mess, my ass! Give me peace and quiet
underground any day!

fields.JP: え～それは流石に無理よ～

fields.EN:
Damn it. There's no food, no place to
sleep. What exactly is the plan here?!
fields.JP:
クソッ、ご飯もないわ寝床もないわ、
どう落とし前つけてくれる……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it. There's no food, no place to
sleep. What exactly is the plan here?!

fields.JP: っておいシャーロット、聞いてんのか

まあアリスじゃない！
あなた無事だったのね……！

fields.EN:
Forgive me. I don't mean to be rude, but
I don't recognize you. Have we met before?
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい……えっと、気を悪くしないで
ほしいのだけど、あなたに覚えがなくて……
わたしたち、どこかで会ったことあるかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forgive me. I don't mean to be rude, but
I don't recognize you. Have we met before?

fields.EN:
Oh? Your wounds are healed, Alice.
Someone must have treated you.
fields.JP:
あら、アリスの傷が塞がってるわ。
なるほど、誰かが治療してくれたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Your wounds are healed, Alice.
Someone must have treated you.

fields.EN:
Y-Yes. Mary found me and took care of me,
didn't you?
fields.JP:
え、ええ、そうなの。
メアリーがわたしを見つけて、
手当てしてくれたのよ。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-Yes. Mary found me and took care of me,
didn't you?

fields.EN: (Don't ask me! I just make weird noises!)
fields.JP:
（いきなり話しかけんなよ！
　思わず変な声出ちまっただろーが！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Don't ask me! I just make weird noises!)

fields.JP: まあ！　すごいお手柄じゃない、メアリー！！

fields.EN:
(Whoa, a congratulatory hug! What the
hell? Guess saving Miss Know-It-All was
a blessing in disguise.)
fields.JP:
（うおっ、ご褒美ハグ！？
　なんだよなんだよ、やっぱリア充に
　声かけて正解だったじゃねーか～）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa, a congratulatory hug! What the
hell? Guess saving Miss Know-It-All was
a blessing in disguise.)

fields.EN:
(Man, she's softer than I thought.
I could be here all day.)
fields.JP:
（あーやべえ胸の感触たまんねえ。
　ずっと埋まってたいわー）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, she's softer than I thought.
I could be here all day.)

fields.JP:
（相変わらずのたわわチャンだぜ……
　このまま、もぎたてを丸かじり……）

fields.EN: She sure has a funny look on her face.
fields.JP:
何かやらしいこと
考えてそうな顔してるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: She sure has a funny look on her face.

fields.EN: Anyway, Charlotte-san, was it? Who are you?
fields.JP:
それで、シャーロットさんだっけ。
あなたは何者なの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, Charlotte, was it? Who are you?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Me? I'm a fellow Blood Maiden.
fields.JP: 私？　私はあなたと同じ血式少女よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Me? I'm a fellow Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
So I'm aware of Jack-kun, Akazukin-chan,
Oyayubi-chan, Kaguya, the whole lot.
fields.JP:
それにジャックくんや赤ずきんちゃん、
親指ちゃんやかぐやちゃん、
だいたいみんなのこと、知ってるわよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I'm aware of Jack, Red Riding Hood,
Thumbelina, Kaguya, the whole lot.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんちゃん => Red Riding Hood-chan; ジャックくん => Jack-kun; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Well, because I've been watching you guys?
fields.JP: えーっと、知ってるのは……見てたから？
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, because I've been watching you guys?

fields.JP: ますます分からないわ……

fields.EN:
Hey Charlotte, how much longer are we
gonna be down here? It's dangerously
creepy. Let's leave already.
fields.JP:
なあシャーロット、
いつまでこんなところにいんだよ。
危ねーし気味悪いからさっさと出ようぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Charlotte, how much longer are we
gonna be down here? It's dangerously
creepy. Let's leave already.

fields.EN:
Hey, wait. We're in the middle of a
conversation. Could you give us a
minute? I'm gathering my thoughts.
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って、今はわたしが話してる最中よ。
整理がつかなくなるから黙っててくれないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, wait. We're in the middle of a
conversation. Could you give us a
minute? I'm gathering my thoughts.

fields.JP: ひっ！　ごごご、ごめんなさい……！

fields.EN:
(I-I've overstepped my boundaries!
A supporting character should know
better!)
fields.JP:
（でで、出しゃばりすぎたー！
　俺みたいな陰キャ劣等種が失礼しましたー！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I-I've overstepped my boundaries!
A supporting character should know
better!)

fields.EN:
Alice, please think before you speak.
That hurt Mary's feelings.
fields.JP:
アリス、そんな風な言い方をしてはダメよ。
メアリーが可哀想でしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, please think before you speak.
That hurt Mary's feelings.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry, but a lot of this isn't adding
up for me.
fields.JP:
わ、悪かったわよ。
けど、分からないことだらけなんだもの。
気になって仕方ないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry, but a lot of this isn't adding
up for me.

fields.EN:
No, Mary is right. Our first priority needs
to be leaving this place. We need to think
quickly.
fields.JP:
いいえ、今はメアリーの言うとおり、
この危険な場所を抜けるのが先でしょう？
せっかちはいけません
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, Mary is right. Our first priority needs
to be leaving this place. We need to think
quickly.

fields.JP: ほら、メアリーにごめんなさいは？
ごめんなさい……メアリー

fields.EN: Oh nononono. I'm totally fine. Yes...!
fields.JP: い、いえいえあたしは全然平気です、はい……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh nononono. I'm totally fine. Yes...!

fields.EN:
Then we're all friends.
Good job, Alice♪
fields.JP:
それじゃあ仲直りね。
よくできました、アリス♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we're all friends.
Good job, Alice♪

fields.JP: ちょっと、子ども扱いしないでよシャーロット！

fields.EN:
(Whoa, they already seem close. This
is why people scare me...)
fields.JP:
（うわ、何だよもうタメ口かよ。
　これだから群れてるやつは怖えー）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa, they already seem close. This
is why people scare me...)

fields.EN:
(Hm? But this Alice girl doesn't seem too
afraid of Charlotte.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　でもこのアリスってやつ、
　シャーロットには頭が上がんなそうだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? But this Alice girl doesn't seem too
afraid of Charlotte.)

fields.EN:
Alice, I'll answer all your questions later.
Let's find somewhere safe first, okay?
fields.JP:
アリス、後でちゃんとあなたの質問には答えるわ。
だから今は安全な場所を探しましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, I'll answer all your questions later.
Let's find somewhere safe first, okay?

fields.JP:
分かったわ。
約束よ、シャーロット

fields.EN: L-Let's just move on. Charlotte, Alice.
fields.JP:
と、と、ともかく先に進もうぜ、
シャーロット、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED: L-Let's just move on. Charlotte, Alice.

fields.EN:
Mary, why are you acting like this
all of a sudden?
fields.JP:
メアリー、何かいきなり
態度が変わったような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, why are you acting like this
all of a sudden?

fields.EN: (Okay, I gotta be tough for Charlotte!)
fields.JP:
（おし、やっぱシャーロットの前なら
　強気でいけるな！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Okay, I gotta be tough for Charlotte!)

fields.EN:
Hey, you two. Time to plan our exit
strategy or find some shelter.
fields.JP:
ほら２人とも、
さっさと出口とか休める場所とか探すぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, you two. Time to plan our exit
strategy or find some shelter.

fields.EN:
Aw, look. Shy Mary's got her backbone.
Sounds like Alice is rubbing off on you.
fields.JP:
あら、人見知りのメアリーが
こんな風に接することができるなんて、
短い間に随分とアリスに懐いたのね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, look. Shy Mary's got her backbone.
Sounds like Alice is rubbing off on you.

fields.EN:
I see. So you two also came from the
Liberated District.
fields.JP:
なるほど、やっぱりあなたたちも
解放地区にいたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. So you two also came from the
Liberated District.

fields.EN:
That explains how you know so much
about the Dawn.
fields.JP:
それなら黎明にいたわたしたちのことを
知っていてもおかしくないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That explains how you know so much
about the Dawn.

fields.EN:
Huh? But if you're not part of the Dawn,
how did you know we're Blood Maidens?
fields.JP:
あれ？　でも黎明に関わっていないのに、
どうして自分たちが血式少女だって分かったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But if you're not part of the Dawn,
how did you know we're Blood Maidens?

fields.EN:
Well, Blood Maidens change eye color
when exposed to Marchen blood, right?
That makes two of us, so I assumed.
fields.JP:
アリスたち血式少女はみんなメルヒェンの血で、
瞳の色がピンク色に変わるでしょう？
私たちも同じだったから、そう思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Blood Maidens change eye color
when exposed to Marchen blood, right?
That makes two of us, so I assumed.

fields.JP: そういうことだったのね

fields.EN:
Anyway Alice, don't you want to find Jack-kun?
He is your childhood friend ♪
fields.JP:
それより、アリスも早くジャックくんに
会いたいんじゃない？　幼馴染だものね♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway Alice, don't you want to find Jack?
He is your childhood friend ♪
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: H-How do you know that, Charlotte...?
fields.JP: く、詳しすぎない？　シャーロット……
fields.LOCALIZED: H-How do you know that, Charlotte...?

fields.EN:
(Hehe. Charlotte knows everything.
No idea how she does it though.
I owe everything I know to her.)
fields.JP:
（ふふん、シャーロットは何でも知ってるからな。
　なんでそんな知ってるかは分かんねーけど。
　ちなみに俺の知識もほとんどシャーロットのおかげだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hehe. Charlotte knows everything.
No idea how she does it though.
I owe everything I know to her.)

fields.EN:
(Well, apart from the survival tips,
I tuned out most of it.)
fields.JP:
（まあ、生きてくのに必要な知識以外は
　興味もねーし、半分聞き流してたけどな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, apart from the survival tips,
I tuned out most of it.)

fields.EN:
(About the Liberated District. About the
surface. Charlotte yapped on and on about
it, so eventually I paid attention.)
fields.JP:
（解放地区についてとか、この世界についてとか、
　そういうのはシャーロットが真面目に話すから、
　こっちもちゃんと聞いたっけ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(About the Liberated District. About the
surface. Charlotte yapped on and on about
it, so eventually I paid attention.)

fields.EN:
(Even then, I was still bored.
I was always thinking about striking a match
and seeing a vision.)
fields.JP:
（それでもやっぱり退屈だったんだよな。
　マッチを擦って幻覚見たいって、
　いつも思ってたわ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Couldn't help my boredom though.
I always wanted to light a match and
see a phantom instead.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN:
(To be honest, I don't care much for
the world outside of myself.)
fields.JP:
（だって自分以外の世界の話なんて、
　俺には何の関係もねーんだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(To be honest, I don't care much for
the world outside of myself.)

fields.EN:
(Hence why I couldn't stand Charlotte at
first. She really got on my nerves.)
fields.JP:
（だから初めの頃は、シャーロットのことを、
　正直めんどくせえって思ってたこともあった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hence why I couldn't stand Charlotte at
first. She really got on my nerves.)

fields.JP:
（でも、シャーロットに世話を焼いてもらって、
　よかったこともある）

fields.EN: (More than anything, I was damn happy that she gave me the name 'Mary.' I don't know why, though...)
fields.JP:
（特にこの『メアリー』っていう名前を
　つけてもらえたことは、すげえ嬉しかった。
　何故かは分からないけどな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Especially because she named me Mary.
It made me so happy...)

fields.EN: (I wonder if my name means anything.)
fields.JP: （つーか、この名前に何か意味ってあるのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wonder if my name means anything.)

fields.EN: Hey, Charlotte. It still doesn't sit right with me that you know so much...
fields.JP:
ねえシャーロット、あなたが色々知ってること、
やっぱり腑に落ちないんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed Charlotte, I find it amazing that
you know so much.

fields.EN:
Sure, but give me a little credit for my
explanation at least.
fields.JP: そうねえ、でも説明した通りだもの～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but give me a little credit for my
explanation at least.

fields.EN:
(Well, whatever. Man, Charlotte sure has
a figure.)
fields.JP:
（まあ、どうでもいいか。
　にしてもやっぱシャーロットの乳はたまんねえぜ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, whatever. Man, Charlotte sure has
a figure.)

fields.EN:
(Haa. What I'd give to rest in her sweet
embrace. I hope she hugs me again.)
fields.JP:
（はぁ……疲れたからあの乳に顔埋めてえな……
　また抱きついてきてくんねえかなー）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haa. What I'd give to rest in her sweet
embrace. I hope she hugs me again.)

fields.EN:
(Hm? Why's it dark all of a sudden?
Wait, is it coming from behind us...?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　なんでいきなり暗くなるんだ？
　いや、奥からどんどん闇が迫ってきてる……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Why's it dark all of a sudden?
Wait, is it coming from behind us...?)

fields.EN:
Right. Looks like there's Nightmares
here too.
fields.JP:
ええ、どうやらこの場所にも
ナイトメアがいるみたいね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Looks like there's Nightmares
here too.

fields.EN: Ha, what's that? Alice, you scared?
fields.JP:
は、何だそりゃ。
アリス、もしかしてビビってんのか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ha, what's that? Alice, you scared?

fields.EN: No time for talking. Let's run for it!
fields.JP:
おしゃべりしてる場合じゃないわ、
逃げるわよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No time for talking. Let's run for it!

fields.JP: え？　これってそんなにやばいの？

fields.EN:
Let's just say none of us are prepared
for the hell it can give us! Mary, HURRY!
fields.JP:
今のわたしたちが
いちばん出会っちゃいけない存在よ！
早く、メアリー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just say none of us are prepared
for the hell it can give us! Mary, HURRY!

fields.EN: (Damn, what the HELL is going on?)
fields.JP: （クソッ、何だよ、何だってんだよっ！！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Damn, what the HELL is going on?)

fields.JP: どうやら振り切ったみたいね……

fields.EN: I'm so happy you both made it out safely.
fields.JP: みんな無事に切り抜けられてよかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm so happy you both made it out safely.

fields.EN:
What the HELL was that stupid, creepy
monster?! I almost peed my pants!
fields.JP:
なんだあのクソきめえ化け物は！
おしっこ漏らすとこだったじゃねーか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the HELL was that stupid, creepy
monster?! I almost peed my pants!

fields.EN:
Ah, perhaps we should find a restroom
nearby.
fields.JP: そうねえ、おトイレできるところも探さなきゃね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, perhaps we should find a restroom
nearby.

fields.EN:
That's not the point! What the HELL was
that?! Explain!
fields.JP:
違う、俺の言いたいのはそこじゃねえ！
何なんだよアレは！　説明しろ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the point! What the HELL was
that?! Explain!

fields.EN:
That's a Nightmare. One of Jail's terrible
guardians. It lurks around looking for an
intruder, until it chases and kills it.
fields.JP:
あれはナイトメアよ。
ジェイルの番人ね。ああやって徘徊して、
侵入者を見つけたらどこまでも追い掛けて殺す
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a Nightmare. One of Jail's terrible
guardians. It lurks around looking for an
intruder, until it chases and kills it.

fields.EN:
Nightmares are extremely powerful.
Marchens hardly compare.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアはとてつもなく強いわ。
メルヒェンなんかとは比べものにもならない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nightmares are extremely powerful.
Marchens hardly compare.

fields.EN:
If that doesn't convince you, they're
invincible.
fields.JP: でも、何より恐ろしいのは、不死身ってこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that doesn't convince you, they're
invincible.

fields.EN:
Yes. They cannot be defeated in battle.
There is a way to make them vulnerable,
but we can't right now. We have to run.
fields.JP:
ええ。普通に立ち向かっても、殺せない。
方法がないわけじゃないけれど、今は無理。
だから逃げるしかなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. They cannot be defeated in battle.
There is a way to make them vulnerable,
but we can't right now. We have to run.

fields.EN:
(I don't get it. Even if we COULD kick
its butt, I'd rather run. I don't want to
risk my neck.)
fields.JP:
（よく分かんねえけど、
　倒せるとしても俺は逃げたいけどな。
　立ち向かうとかできるわけねーだろ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't get it. Even if we COULD kick
its butt, I'd rather run. I don't want to
risk my neck.)

fields.EN:
If we're running into Nightmares, then
it all but confirms we're in Jail.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアがいたってことは、
ここはジェイルで間違いないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're running into Nightmares, then
it all but confirms we're in Jail.

fields.EN:
I heard rumors about there being a Jail
on the surface, but I never thought I'd
live to see it.
fields.JP:
地上にもジェイルがあるとは
聞いていたけど……まさか来ることに
なるとは思わなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard rumors about there being a Jail
on the surface, but I never thought I'd
live to see it.

fields.EN: (Ah, I guess I should take that as a warning.)
fields.JP: （なるほど、やっぱりここはヤバイ場所なんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ah, I guess I should take that as a warning.)

fields.EN:
Hey Alice, it looks like you've got a lot of
corruption built up. I'm worried...
fields.JP:
それはそうとアリス、あなた随分と
穢れが溜まってきているみたいね。
心配だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Alice, it looks like you've got a lot of
corruption built up. I'm worried...

fields.EN:
I know, but I can't do anything about it
without Jack.
fields.JP:
分かってはいるのだけど、
ジャックがいないとどうしようもなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, but I can't do anything about it
without Jack.

fields.EN:
Corruption... I think Charlotte mentioned
it before. "Bloodski," right?
fields.JP:
『穢れ』って前にシャーロットが言ってた、
ブラスケナントカになるやつか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corruption... I think Charlotte mentioned
it before. "Bloodski," right?

fields.EN: You mean, Blood Skelter. Look at you go.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターね。
よく知ってるじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: You mean, Blood Skelter. Look at you go.

fields.EN:
(Are you serious? If we're stuck with
a wanted person, then we're in danger
too. Maybe we should ditch her...)
fields.JP:
（マジかよ、そんな危ねえ奴と一緒にいたら、
　俺まで酷い目に遭うんじゃねーのか？
　こ、ここは別々に行動した方がいいんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Are you serious? If we're stuck with
a wanted person, then we're in danger
too. Maybe we should ditch her...)

fields.EN:
We must do something. This affects all
of us.
fields.JP:
早く何とかしないとまずいわね。
とはいえ、私たちも他人事じゃないのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
We must do something. This affects all
of us.

fields.EN:
(Oh, but we're just like Alice.
Blood Maidens...)
fields.JP:
（そっか、俺たちも
　アリスと同じ血式少女ってやつだった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, but we're just like Alice.
Blood Maidens...)

fields.EN:
(Which means that even if we ditch Alice,
we're still at risk as Blood Maidens.)
fields.JP:
（ってことはアリスと別行動したって、
　ブラッドスケルターの危険はなくならねえな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which means that even if we ditch Alice,
we're still at risk as Blood Maidens.)

fields.EN: (Ugh... Talk about a rock and a hard place.)
fields.JP: （はぁ……やっぱり地上、クソすぎんだろ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ugh... Talk about a rock and a hard place.)

fields.EN:
What should we do...? I mean, we're at risk
of Blood Skelter as our stress piles on...
fields.JP:
どうするべきかしらね……
そもそもブラッドスケルターはストレスが
積もり積もって発生するものだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What should we do...? I mean, we're at risk
of Blood Skelter as our stress piles on...

fields.EN:
So we need to find a way to calm our
hearts to rid ourselves of the corruption
so we can control it. But this place...
fields.JP:
休息や心を落ち着ける何かがあれば、穢れを消せる。
あるいは抑制できるはず。でもこんな場所じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we need to find a way to calm our
hearts to rid ourselves of the corruption
so we can control it. But this place...

fields.EN:
(So as long as we have an outlet for our
stress, then we're fine? Okay...)
fields.JP:
（それって、要はストレス発散が
　できりゃいいってことか？　なら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So as long as we have an outlet for our
stress, then we're fine? Okay...)

fields.JP: おいアリス、これやるよ

fields.EN: Huh? Is this...a match? I don't need it.
fields.JP:
何、これは……マッチ？
今は別に必要ないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Is this...a match? I don't need it.

fields.EN:
No. Take that, and light it with my
matchbox then see what happens.
fields.JP:
いいから、そいつを俺の持ってる
このマッチ箱に擦りつけて火を起こしてみろって
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Take that, and light it with my
matchbox then see what happens.

fields.EN:
When you do, make sure to think of
a fond memory, got it?
fields.JP:
で、その時に楽しいこととか
幸せなこととか考えるんだ。いいな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you do, make sure to think of
a fond memory, got it?

fields.EN:
I don't see how this is supposed to help.
It makes no sense.
fields.JP:
いきなりそんなことを言われても、
意味がまったく分からないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't see how this is supposed to help.
It makes no sense.

fields.EN:
Lighting this match and thinking of a fond
memory don't exactly correlate...
fields.JP:
それにマッチに火をつけることと、
楽しいことを考えることが
まったく繋がらないのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lighting this match and thinking of a fond
memory don't exactly correlate...

fields.EN:
Don't sweat the small stuff. Just do it.
Hehehe. You'll see soon enough.
fields.JP:
細かいことはいいから、とにかく擦ってみろって。
うへへ、最高にキまるぞ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't sweat the small stuff. Just do it.
Hehehe. You'll see soon enough.

fields.EN: As if that's supposed to convince me.
fields.JP:
なんだか、そんな言い方されると、
余計にやりたくないんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED: As if that's supposed to convince me.

fields.EN: ARGH! Just shut up and do it!
fields.JP: ああ、もう！　いいからやれっつーの！
fields.LOCALIZED: ARGH! Just shut up and do it!

fields.EN: O-Okay, sheesh... So just light it?
fields.JP:
わ、分かったわよ。仕方ない……
ただ、擦ればいいのね？
fields.LOCALIZED: O-Okay, sheesh... So just light it?

fields.EN: Yup. Rub it on the box.
fields.JP: そうだ。シュシュッとやっちまえ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. Rub it on the box.

fields.EN:
I suggest we find somewhere safe to
rest...
fields.JP: やっぱり休息場所を探すのが先決ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suggest we find somewhere safe to
rest...

fields.EN: What? What are you doing, Mary?!
fields.JP: え、何をやってるのメアリー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: What? What are you doing, Mary?!

fields.EN:
Wh-What...? I just gave Alice my matches.
See, look.
fields.JP:
な、何だよいきなり……
マッチをアリスにくれてやっただけだっての。
ほら、見てみろよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What...? I just gave Alice my matches.
See, look.

fields.EN:
Wh-What?! Jack?! No, I'm there too...
What's going on? What am I seeing?
fields.JP:
な、ジャック……！？　いや、わたしもいる……
これはいったいどういうこと？
何をわたしは見ているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What?! Jack?! No, I'm there too...
What's going on? What am I seeing?

fields.EN:
This scene... It's the tea party I promised
Jack.
fields.JP:
この光景は――
ジャックと約束していたお茶会だわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This scene... It's the tea party I promised
Jack.

fields.EN: Ugh. Why's this world so saccharine?
fields.JP: うげ、何だこの優しく甘ったるい世界は……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Why's this world so saccharine?

fields.EN:
Ah, I smell the tea leaves. The breeze
feels so good on my cheek.
fields.JP:
ああ、華やかなお茶の匂い……
吹き抜ける風の、なんて気持ちいいこと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I smell the tea leaves. The breeze
feels so good on my cheek.

fields.EN:
I can see Jack, and he has such a warm
smile on his face as we take a sip.
fields.JP:
わたしの瞳にはジャックだけが映って……
そんなジャックは優しく微笑みかけてくれて、
そして互いにカップを傾けて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can see Jack, and he has such a warm
smile on his face as we take a sip.

fields.EN:
A vision from one match lasts about this long.
Hey, Alice, it's over.
fields.JP:
マッチ１本で見られる幻覚の時間は、
まあこんなもんだな。おい、終わりだぞアリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, a phantom lasts about one match,
so about that long. Hey Alice, it's over.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN: Wait. Look, Alice's corruption is gone!
fields.JP: 待って、アリスの穢れが消えているわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. Look, Alice's corruption is gone!

fields.EN:
All right! I knew it. All it takes to get rid
of stress is a little delusion. I figured it'd
work.
fields.JP:
よっしゃ、予想通りだな！
ストレスが原因なら、それを打ち消せるくらい
最高にキまるもん見りゃあ、いけると思ったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! I knew it. All it takes to get rid
of stress is a little delusion. I figured it'd
work.

fields.EN:
Thanks to this, I'm practically always
relaxed.
fields.JP: これのおかげで俺もストレスすぐ解消できてたしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to this, I'm practically always
relaxed.

fields.EN:
It's one of my special visions. You got to go on
a date with your guy, and your corruption's gone too.
Pretty great, right?
fields.JP:
俺特製の幻覚だよ。男とデートできた上に、
穢れも消えて最高だったろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a special phantom. Not only could
you go on a date with your guy, but your
corruption's gone too. Amazing, right?
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN: I see. Those matches are no joke...
fields.JP:
なるほど、あなたのマッチ、
そういうことだったのね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Those matches are no joke...

fields.EN:
My corruption's gone, but you saw me
during the vision, right...?
fields.JP:
でも確かに穢れは消えたけれど、
わたしの幻覚も見られちゃったのよね……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My corruption's gone, but you saw me
during the vision, right...?

fields.EN: Yeah. It was so sweet I wanted to hurl.
fields.JP: ああ、甘くて吐き気がしそうだったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. It was so sweet I wanted to hurl.

fields.JP: ああもう、恥ずかしいわ

fields.EN:
Who cares? Cheap price to pay for getting
rid of the corruption.
fields.JP:
いいじゃねえか、
穢れが消えるんなら安いモンだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who cares? Cheap price to pay for getting
rid of the corruption.

fields.EN:
Mary! Do you have any idea what you've
done?!
fields.JP:
メアリー！
あなた何をしたか分かってるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary! Do you have any idea what you've
done?!

fields.EN:
Wh-What? Why are you so upset?
What other, um, choices did we have?
fields.JP:
そ、そんなに怒ることないだろ？
だってその、他に方法もなかったわけだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What? Why are you so upset?
What other, um, choices did we have?

fields.EN:
What's your deal? I didn't do anything
wrong...
fields.JP: 何だよ……俺、別に悪いことしてねえだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your deal? I didn't do anything
wrong...

fields.EN:
Ch-Charlotte, I'm grateful for Mary's
suggestion. Please, don't be mad at her,
okay?
fields.JP:
シャ、シャーロット、
わたしはメアリーに感謝してるわ。
だからそこまで怒らないであげて……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ch-Charlotte, I'm grateful for Mary's
suggestion. Please, don't be mad at her,
okay?

fields.EN: Mary, how many matches do you have?
fields.JP:
メアリー、マッチは
あとどれくらい残っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, how many matches do you have?

fields.EN:
Hey Mary, we'll excuse using the match
just this once as an emergency.
fields.JP:
ねえメアリー。今は緊急時だから、
そのマッチを使わせてもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Mary, we'll excuse using the match
just this once as an emergency.

fields.EN:
But when you're down to the last box,
make sure to tell me, got it?
fields.JP:
けれど、残り１箱になったら、
絶対に私に教えること。いいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when you're down to the last box,
make sure to tell me, got it?

fields.EN: No way. Everything makes you grumpy.
fields.JP:
嫌だね。
だってシャーロット怒ってばっかだし
fields.LOCALIZED: No way. Everything makes you grumpy.

fields.EN:
I did a good deed, and now you're upset
with me? That makes no se―HNRGH?!
fields.JP:
せっかくいいことしたっていうのに、
怒られるとか意味分かんね――むぎゅっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did a good deed, and now you're upset
with me? That makes no se―HNRGH?!

fields.EN:
(Charlotte's hugging me again―
Is she using her charm?!)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットの奴、また抱きしめて――
　何だ、お色気作戦か！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Charlotte's hugging me again―
Is she using her charm?!)

fields.EN:
Mary, I'm not upset at you for using
matches seemingly for no reason.
fields.JP:
メアリー。私が怒っているのは、
あなたがマッチを考えもなしに使ったことよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, I'm not upset at you for using
matches seemingly for no reason.

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, Alice's corruption is gone.
But you did so on a total hunch, right?
You struck a match without thinking.
fields.JP:
あなたのおかげで、確かにアリスの穢れは取れた。
でもその確証はなかったわけでしょう？
それなのに、簡単にマッチを使ったりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, Alice's corruption is gone.
But you did so on a total hunch, right?
You struck a match without thinking.

fields.EN:
That side of you worries me. I feel like you
don't think enough about consequences.
fields.JP:
私、そんなあなたが心配なの。
どこか自分の命をどうでもいいと思っているようで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That side of you worries me. I feel like you
don't think enough about consequences.

fields.EN:
Charlotte, you make it sound like using
Mary's matches is dangerous. What's
the worst that could happen?
fields.JP:
シャーロット、話を聞いてる限り、
メアリーのマッチがなくなると
危ないみたいだけど、何が起こるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, you make it sound like using
Mary's matches is dangerous. What's
the worst that could happen?

fields.EN:
What?! Wait Mary, you really gave me
something so precious?
fields.JP:
なっ……！？
そんな大事なものを、メアリーはわたしに？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Wait Mary, you really gave me
something so precious?

fields.EN:
Yes. She's kind, but she doesn't see the
threat her matches pose.
fields.JP:
ええ、優しい子なの。
でもマッチのことに危機感を持ってくれなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. She's kind, but she doesn't see the
threat her matches pose.

fields.JP:
うへへ……やわらけえ……
もっとだ、もっと挟んでくれよ……へへへ……

fields.EN:
(I don't care about running out of
matches. If it's my time, it's my time.)
fields.JP:
（マッチなんて無くなったっていいのさ。
　それで終わりっつーなら、それで構わない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't care about running out of
matches. If it's my time, it's my time.)

fields.EN:
(But it would be tragic not to see
Charlotte's chest ever again.)
fields.JP:
（でも、シャーロットのこの胸の感触が
　味わえなくなるのは、ちょっと寂しいなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But it would be tragic not to see
Charlotte's chest ever again.)

fields.EN: (Oh well, gotta enjoy it while I've got it!)
fields.JP:
（よし、ならなおさら、
　堪能できる時に堪能しておかねーとな！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh well, gotta enjoy it while I've got it!)

fields.JP: そこに誰かいるのかい？
あら、ようやく別の人たちに会えたわね

fields.EN:
There's two. I don't recognize one...
But the other is...Hitsuka-san!
fields.JP:
２人いるわね。１人は分からない……
もう１人は……陽司さん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's two. I don't recognize one...
But the other is...Hitsuka!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.JP:
（んだよ……
　誰だ邪魔した奴は）

fields.EN:
Yes. The Marchens won't find us.
A perfect place to rest.
fields.JP:
ええ、メルヒェンにも見つかりにくそうだし、
休むにはいい場所じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. The Marchens won't find us.
A perfect place to rest.

fields.EN: Right? Let's set up a campground here.
fields.JP:
そうだろう？
私たちはここをキャンプ地にしているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right? Let's set up a campground here.

fields.EN: (A campground... As long as I can rest.)
fields.JP:
（キャンプ地ねえ……
　まあ休めるんならどこでもいいけど）
fields.LOCALIZED: (A campground... As long as I can rest.)

fields.EN:
Anyway, I'm glad to have found you.
What luck, you're even Blood Maidens.
Thank goodness.
fields.JP:
それにしても、無事な人間に出会えてよかったよ。
しかも血式少女がいる。一安心だ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, I'm glad to have found you.
What luck, you're even Blood Maidens.
Thank goodness.

fields.EN:
We're also glad we found you, Hitsuka-san.
There's strength in numbers.
fields.JP:
わたしたちも陽司さんたちに出会えて
ホッとしてるわ。少人数じゃこの先大変だもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're also glad we found you, Hitsuka.
There's strength in numbers.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.JP: それで、そこの人は誰なの？

fields.EN:
Oh, this man here is Gatou-san.
He saved my life.
fields.JP:
ああ、こちらの方は賀東さん。
私の命の恩人だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, this man here is Mister Gato.
He saved my life.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Hello, I'm Gatou. Nice to meet you.
It's been a while since I've seen so many
faces at once. I'm elated to see it.
fields.JP:
初めまして、賀東と申します。
こんなに多くの人に出会えるのは
随分久しぶりだから、本当に嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello, I'm Gato. Nice to meet you.
It's been a while since I've seen so many
faces at once. I'm elated to see it.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
So, you're not from the Liberated District,
you're from the surface. How'd you guys
meet?
fields.JP:
ということは……解放地区の住民じゃなく、
地上で暮らしてきた人なのね。
それで、どうやって出会ったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, you're not from the Liberated District,
you're from the surface. How'd you guys
meet?

fields.EN:
Remember when those mysterious
girls arrived? Hikari-san teleported us,
right?
fields.JP:
ほら、謎の少女たちに襲われた時、
ヒカリさんがテレポートしてくれただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember when those mysterious
girls arrived? Hikari teleported us,
right?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN: Ah, so this is Hikari's doing?
fields.JP:
わたしたちがここにいるのは、
やっぱりヒカリの力だったのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, so this is Hikari's doing?

fields.EN: I think so. Before I knew it, I was here.
fields.JP:
おそらく、だけどね。
それで私は、気づいたらここにいたわけだが……
fields.LOCALIZED: I think so. Before I knew it, I was here.

fields.EN:
Thankfully, Gatou-san found us near the
campground, and he carried me to
this place.
fields.JP:
実はたまたま、このキャンプ地の近くにいた
賀東さんが見つけてくれて、この場所に
運んでくれたみたいなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thankfully, Gato found us near the
campground, and he carried me to
this place.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
Then Gatou-san, does that mean you willingly
entered the Jail?
fields.JP:
えっと、じゃあ賀東さんは自ら、
このジェイルの中にいたということかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then Gato, does that mean you willingly
entered the Jail?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
Why would you come to such a dangerous
place...?
fields.JP: そうね、こんな危険な場所にどうして……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why would you come to such a dangerous
place...?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
To answer your question, I'll have to give
some background to this foul place.
fields.JP:
それを説明するには、今のこの世界のことを
少し話さなければいけないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
To answer your question, I'll have to give
some background to this foul place.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I performed research on Marchens, Nightmares, 
the Jail, and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
自分は元々メルヒェンやナイトメア、
それにジェイルや血式少女の研究者だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I performed research on Marchens, Nightmares, 
the Jail, and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
There are people like the Dawn on the
surface too, huh?
fields.JP: 地上にも黎明のような人たちがいたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are people like the Dawn on the
surface too, huh?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: There are probably other researchers out there too. If there are still places in this world where humans are living, there have to be.
fields.JP:
おそらく、他にも研究者はいると思うよ。
今のこの世界で人間が生きている場所が
あるとするなら、必ずね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure there were other researchers.
So long as humanity survives, so too shall
its will to learn.

fields.EN:
We must find a way to fight back, or we
face extinction. That is our unfortunate
reality.
fields.JP:
対抗する手段を見つけ出せなければ、
生き残れない……そういう場所みたいだものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We must find a way to fight back, or we
face extinction. That is our unfortunate
reality.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Yes. Sadly, my colleagues were wiped out.
fields.JP:
だが残念なことに、
自分のコミュニティは壊滅してしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. Sadly, my colleagues were wiped out.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Ever since the Devouring Armada Tower
arrived, we have been helpless. It killed
nearly all of us, and scattered the rest.
fields.JP:
あの『悪食の監隊塔』が出現して以降、
為す術がなくてね。多くが殺され、
残った者もみんな散り散りに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since the Devouring Armada Tower
arrived, we have been helpless. It killed
nearly all of us, and scattered the rest.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I had no act of recourse but to run and
hide. Which leads me here today.
fields.JP:
そして自分もどうにもできず、
逃げ隠れて生きることを余儀なくされ……
今ここにいる、というわけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had no act of recourse but to run and
hide. Which leads me here today.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Indeed. Forgive me. I didn't mean to dampen
your spirits.
fields.JP:
ああ、すまない。
暗い気持ちにさせるつもりはなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. Forgive me. I didn't mean to dampen
your spirits.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Times are treacherous, but I can rejoice
in our meeting. So please, my friends,
don't look so grim.
fields.JP:
確かにつらい。でも今はこうして
みなさんに出会えたことを喜びたいんだ。
だからそんな顔をしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Times are treacherous, but I can rejoice
in our meeting. So please, my friends,
don't look so grim.

fields.JP: 分かりました。あなたがそうおっしゃるのなら
賀東さんは優しいなあ……
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
Well Gatou-san, I'm gonna dive right into the
question. What is the Devouring Armada Tower?
fields.JP:
じゃあ賀東さん、
遠慮なく聞かせてもらうのだけど、
悪食の監隊塔というのは何？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well Gato, I'm gonna dive right into the
question. What is the Devouring Armada Tower?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: You said you came from underground, right? Then did you see the enormous Jail Tower outside that looks almost like a living creature?
fields.JP:
君たちは、地下からやって来たと言っていたね？
それならば外にある、まるで生き物のような
巨大な監獄塔は見たかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said you came from underground,
correct? Which means you've seen the
giant, human-like Jail outside here, right?

fields.EN:
Yes. It makes the old Jail look cute in
comparison. Its ivy is so long too.
fields.JP:
ええ、普通の監獄塔が
可愛く見えるくらいの大きさで、
ツタが遥か遠くまで伸びていた塔、よね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It makes the old Jail look cute in
comparison. Its ivy is so long too.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: That's right. It's the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP: そうだ。あれが『悪食の監隊塔』だ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's right. It's the Devouring Armada Tower.

fields.EN: So it's not just a tower, it's a whole army.
fields.JP: 監獄塔ではなく、監隊塔……
fields.LOCALIZED: So it's not just a tower, it's a whole army.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I don't know who named the thing, but
it doesn't take a scientist to see why.
About that thing―
fields.JP:
誰が呼び始めたかは分からないが、
いつからかそう呼ばれているね。
それであの監隊塔だが――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know who named the thing, but
it doesn't take a scientist to see why.
About that thing―

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: アリス・シャーロット・千昭
（何騒いでんだ？　みんなして）

fields.EN:
(Oh well. It's not my problem. Geez,
how's a girl to get good sleep on hard
ground?)
fields.JP:
（まあいいや、俺には関係ねーし。
　つーか床が硬くて寝られねえ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh well. It's not my problem. Geez,
