how's a girl to get good sleep on hard
ground?)

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
At first, the Devouring Armada Tower
was the size of your ordinary Jail tower.
fields.JP:
初めはあの悪食の監隊塔も、
普通の監獄塔程度の大きさだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first, the Devouring Armada Tower
was the size of your ordinary Jail tower.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
But once the tower got moving, it began
to devour living things, buildings, anything
it found.
fields.JP:
だがあいつは自ら動いては、生き物や建物、
ありとあらゆるものを『喰い』続けた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But once the tower got moving, it began
to devour living things, buildings, anything
it found.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
The more it ate, the bigger it grew.
It's expanded so large that it's eaten
a whole country.
fields.JP:
そして食べた量に比例するように
どんどんと巨大化していき、
ついには『国』までも食い潰してしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more it ate, the bigger it grew.
It's expanded so large that it's eaten
a whole country.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Maybe it's called the Devouring Armada Tower because it keeps advancing with enough force to destroy an entire country.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら監隊塔という名前は、
国を潰すほどの進撃を続けるからこそ
ついた名前かもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps the Devouring Armada Tower's
name came from its unstoppable nature.
It'll consume the whole world.

fields.EN: It makes sense when you put it that way.
fields.JP:
あなたの話を聞くと、
その名前も納得してしまうわね
fields.LOCALIZED: It makes sense when you put it that way.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: There's still much we don't know...
fields.JP: 本当のところは分からないがね……
fields.LOCALIZED: There's still much we don't know...

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Anyway, after we kept fleeing from those constantly moving Jail Towers, we realized being inside a Jail Tower was safer than staying on the surface.
fields.JP:
まあとにかく、そうやって移動し続ける
監隊塔から逃げ続けた結果、地上にいるよりも
監獄塔の方が安全だと気づいたのさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, it's on the move. Knowing how
it operates, I figured we'd be safer up here
as opposed to out there.

fields.EN:
Safer in a Jail tower. Wow, just when I
thought I'd seen it all.
fields.JP:
監獄塔にいた方がマシだなんて、
まさかそんなこと思う日が来るなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Safer in a Jail tower. Wow, just when I
thought I'd seen it all.

fields.EN:
The surface is worse than anyone could
have imagined.
fields.JP:
地上がこんなに大変な場所だったなんて
想像すらしてなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The surface is worse than anyone could
have imagined.

fields.EN:
There's still hope. Not only did we find each
other, but we met a Blood Maiden. Good thing
I searched for this in hiding.
fields.JP:
でもまだ希望はある。こうして合流できて、
血式少女を見つけられたんだから。
隠れながらの探索が実を結んでよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's still hope. Not only did we find each
other, but we met a Blood Maiden. Good thing
I searched for this in hiding.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
But still, we're in a Jail tower. With all of
the usual horrific amenities.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、ここが監獄塔――
ジェイルであることに変わりはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But still, we're in a Jail tower. With all of
the usual horrific amenities.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
If you want to reunite with your other
friends, then you'll have to escape from
here.
fields.JP:
みんなの他の仲間たちと合流するのであれば、
まずはここを脱出しなければいけない
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to reunite with your other
friends, then you'll have to escape from
here.

fields.EN: That's right. For that, we'll need to divide our roles: have the Blood Maidens go out exploring while we lay the groundwork for daily life here.
fields.JP:
そうですね。そのためには血式少女に
探索に出てもらい、私たちが生活の基盤を整える
という役割分担をしていかないといけません
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. We need the Blood Maidens
to locate a safe place for us to create a
base. We're better off splitting up.

fields.EN:
No objections here. We'll go search
the Jail.
fields.JP:
異論はないわ。じゃあわたしたちが
ジェイルの内部を探ってくるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No objections here. We'll go search
the Jail.

fields.EN: Hehe. Alice, you sound good to go.
fields.JP: ふふ、アリスってばやる気ね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Alice, you sound good to go.

fields.EN:
(Wait, huh? Since when does being a Blood
Maiden mean doing dirty work? Count me out.
...but I don't want to be left here either.)
fields.JP:
（え、何？　血式少女ってだけで
　そんなに危険なことしなきゃいけねーの？
　面倒くせえ……でも置いていかれても困るし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait, huh? Since when does being a Blood
Maiden mean doing dirty work? Count me out.
...but I don't want to be left here either.)

fields.EN: Seriously. You're making me go too?
fields.JP: マジかよ、俺も行かなきゃいけないのか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously. You're making me go too?

fields.EN: Mary, you don't want to go with us...?
fields.JP: メアリー、一緒に行くの嫌なの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, you don't want to go with us...?

fields.EN:
N-No. Um, well, uh... I figured err-everyone
is t-tired, so how about a nap?
fields.JP:
ちち、違っ、あの、ですねその……
今日は、そ、そのみんな疲れてるだろうからですね、
えっと休んでもらって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-No. Um, well, uh... I figured err-everyone
is t-tired, so how about a nap?

fields.EN:
A-And while you do that, I thought I'd
stand watch! Or something like that, um...
fields.JP:
で、しょの間に、ああ、あたしが
見張りに行かなきゃいけないなー！
なんてですね、その、思ったわけでして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-And while you do that, I thought I'd
stand watch! Or something like that, um...

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP:
（やべえ、オッサンにめっちゃ見られてる……！
　ななな何で……！？　すごく空気読んだじゃん！
　つーか、なんだその目……！）

fields.EN: Oh, I see. Thanks for your concern.
fields.JP:
なんだ、そうだったのね。
わたしたちのこと心配してくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see. Thanks for your concern.

fields.EN: How did...we ever find...a girl like her?
fields.JP: いつの間に……こんな子がいたなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED: How did...we ever find...a girl like her?

fields.EN: Ha hahaha, l-leave it to me...
fields.JP: あは、はは……ま、任せてください……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ha hahaha, l-leave it to me...

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
(Crap. He's still staring at me. Wait,
does he...have a crush on me?)
fields.JP:
（やべ……まだ見つめてくるよ……
　もしかしてあれなのか……惚れたのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Crap. He's still staring at me. Wait,
does he...have a crush on me?)

fields.EN:
Oh, Gatou-san. You look stern. Is something
the matter?
fields.JP:
あら、賀東さん険しい顔を
してどうかしましたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Gato. You look stern. Is something
the matter?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Haha. Earlier I dropped my pocket watch
somewhere around here. Just remembered.
fields.JP:
はは、実はさっきの移動中に
懐中時計を無くしてしまったんだ。
そのことを考えてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Earlier I dropped my pocket watch
somewhere around here. Just remembered.

fields.EN:
Oh, that's unfortunate. I'll let you know if
I find anything.
fields.JP:
それは気の毒ですね。
私もそれらしいものが見つかったら連絡します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's unfortunate. I'll let you know if
I find anything.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
(What? Pocket watch...? What is that?
Oh, well.)
fields.JP:
（んだよ、かいちゅうどけい……？
　なんだそりゃ、まぁいいか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What? Pocket watch...? What is that?
Oh, well.)

fields.EN:
Okay, things are going to get a little crazy.
Genocide Pink's still out there. I'm worried
for the others. Base needs to be fortified too.
fields.JP:
さて、これから忙しくなるわね。
処刑台少女の件もあるし、他のみんなも心配だし、
それにこのキャンプ地も改良していかないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, things are going to get a little crazy.
Massacre Pink's still out there. I'm worried
for the others. Base needs to be fortified too.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
You make perfect sense. All the more reason
for us to rest right now. Don't put too much
on your shoulders, Alice.
fields.JP:
気持ちは分かるけれど、
こういう時こそ一度ゆっくりと休みましょう。
気負いすぎてはいけないわ、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
You make perfect sense. All the more reason
for us to rest right now. Don't put too much
on your shoulders, Alice.

fields.EN:
You're right. If we want to make it out
of here, we need sleep. Okay, everyone.
Get some shut-eye.
fields.JP:
そうね。生き抜くためには、
休める時に休まないとね。
じゃあみんな、少し休みましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. If we want to make it out
of here, we need sleep. Okay, everyone.
Get some shut-eye.

fields.EN:
(So I'm stuck with them for a while, huh?
I don't know how long I'll stand it for.)
fields.JP:
（これからこのメンツで過ごすのか。
　団体行動とかほんと、マジ無理なんすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So I'm stuck with them for a while, huh?
I don't know how long I'll stand it for.)

fields.EN:
(Argh. Hope it's over soon. All a girl wants
is some peace and quiet.)
fields.JP:
（ああもう、これ以上仲間とか増えないでくれよ？
　俺は静かに暮らしたいんだからさ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Argh. Hope it's over soon. All a girl wants
is some peace and quiet.)

fields.EN:
Ugh. Sleeping on the ground is terrible.
Can't we do anything about it?
fields.JP:
やっぱ地べたで寝るのきついって。
どうにかなんねーのかよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Sleeping on the ground is terrible.
Can't we do anything about it?

fields.EN:
Especially since we're packed here?
I can't listen to another one of you
snoring.
fields.JP:
しかもみんなで雑魚寝だろ？
誰かのいびきで眠れないとかは、
マジ勘弁だからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially since we're packed here?
I can't listen to another one of you
snoring.

fields.JP: まあまあ、そう文句言わないの

fields.EN: That's right. We should be happy just to have reunited with our companions and found a safe place to sleep.
fields.JP:
そうよ、こうして仲間と合流できて、
無事に眠れる場所があるだけで幸せなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. We're lucky to have a place at all
where we can sleep in a group.

fields.JP: へいへい、ありがたいことですよ

fields.EN:
(Ugh. Looks like those two are the best
of friends.)
fields.JP: （クソ、２人とも変に息が合ってやがる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. Looks like those two are the best
of friends.)

fields.EN:
(Sheesh. Alice is just like me. Not too big
around the chest like Charlotte. Doesn't
look like she's got much to offer.)
fields.JP:
（ったく、アリスは俺と同じで
　シャーロットほどのおっぱいもねーし、
　癒しもほとんどねえくせになぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sheesh. Alice is just like me. Not too big
around the chest like Charlotte. Doesn't
look like she's got much to offer.)

fields.EN:
I'm relieved as well. I got to find Mary, and
more than anything, I reunited with you,
Alice.
fields.JP:
私も今、本当に幸せよ。
なんたってメアリーと合流できたし、
何よりアリスに無事出会えたんだもの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm relieved as well. I got to find Mary, and
more than anything, I reunited with you,
Alice.

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, I've never once heard
Charlotte mention Alice in conversation,
despite her yapping all the time.)
fields.JP:
（そういえばシャーロットの奴、
　今まで色んな話を聞かせてくれたけど、
　アリスの話はしてくれたことなかったよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, I've never once heard
Charlotte mention Alice in conversation,
despite her yapping all the time.)

fields.EN:
(But look at how happy she looks.
Just who is this Alice person?!)
fields.JP:
（でもそこまで喜ぶなんて、
　まさか、そんなにアリスのファンだったのか！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But look at how happy she looks.
Just who is this Alice person?!)

fields.JP: ありがとう、シャーロット

fields.EN:
That's very kind, but I don't understand.
How do you know me, and why do you care?
fields.JP:
でもね、その気持ちは嬉しいのだけど……
わたし分からないわ。シャーロットはどうして
そんなに私のこと、気にかけてくれるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's very kind, but I don't understand.
How do you know me, and why do you care?

fields.JP: そういえば何故かしらね……？
じ、自分のことでしょう……

fields.EN:
Yeah, but I guess I haven't put a lot of
thought into it.
fields.JP:
そうなのだけど、
ほんとに考えたことなかったのよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but I guess I haven't put a lot of
thought into it.

fields.EN: I sense our fates are connected somehow.
fields.JP: きっとアリスに運命を感じてるのね
fields.LOCALIZED: I sense our fates are connected somehow.

fields.EN: You make it sound so simple.
fields.JP: やっぱり他人事のような言い方ね……
fields.LOCALIZED: You make it sound so simple.

fields.EN: Either way, I'm grateful to have met you ♪
fields.JP: アリスに出会えて嬉しいのは本当よ♪
fields.LOCALIZED: Either way, I'm grateful to have met you ♪

fields.EN:
Besides, Mary doesn't usually open up
to people, but she did to you, Alice.
It brings a smile to my face.
fields.JP:
それに人見知りのメアリーが
アリスと仲良くなってくれて、
本当によかったわー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, Mary doesn't usually open up
to people, but she did to you, Alice.
It brings a smile to my face.

fields.EN:
(I don't feel like even we're that close,
but...as long as I've got Charlotte, I won't
fear Alice.)
fields.JP:
（いやそこまで仲良くなれた気はしないんだが……
　まあシャーロットがいればアリスも怖くねえしな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't feel like even we're that close,
but...as long as I've got Charlotte, I won't
fear Alice.)

fields.EN:
W-Well, I'm the one who saved her.
Maybe it's destiny? Or a spirit bond?
Something like that.
fields.JP:
ま、まぁ俺が助けてやったくらいだしな。
縁っつーの？　絆っつーの？　そういう感じよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, I'm the one who saved her.
Maybe it's destiny? Or a spirit bond?
Something like that.

fields.EN:
(Hehe. Looks like I just boosted my
approval rating with her...)
fields.JP:
（ぐふふ、また俺の好感度が
　上がっちまったようだぜ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hehe. Looks like I just boosted my
approval rating with her...)

fields.EN:
If you hadn't saved me, then I would've
certainly died. It's all thanks to you, Mary.
fields.JP:
あの時あなたが助けてくれなかったら、
わたしはきっと死んでいたわ。
本当にありがとう、メアリー
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you hadn't saved me, then I would've
certainly died. It's all thanks to you, Mary.

fields.EN:
Haha. Not even I would be so cruel as to
abandon someone in need.
fields.JP:
はは、困ってる奴を放っておけるほど
俺も薄情じゃないしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Not even I would be so cruel as to
abandon someone in need.

fields.EN:
But like Charlotte said, you were so shy
at first. I was worried we wouldn't get
close.
fields.JP:
でもシャーロットの言うとおり、
メアリーって初めはすごく内気な感じだったから、
正直、打ち解けられるか不安だったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But like Charlotte said, you were so shy
at first. I was worried we wouldn't get
close.

fields.EN:
But then all of a sudden, she approached
me. It was a surprise.
fields.JP:
それがいつの間にか豹変したみたいに
気さくに話してくれるようになって、
本当によかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But then all of a sudden, she approached
me. It was a surprise.

fields.EN:
What?! That goes for you too, Alice.
You're the one who only got chummy
with Charlotte at first.
fields.JP:
んなっ……！　それならアリスもじゃねーか。
シャーロットのことをいきなり
呼び捨てでタメ口だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! That goes for you too, Alice.
You're the one who only got chummy
with Charlotte at first.

fields.EN: Oh, you got a point there. I wonder why.
fields.JP:
はっ……そ、そういえばそうだったわ。
どうしてかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, you got a point there. I wonder why.

fields.EN:
I was being rude to Charlotte-san, wasn't
I? My apologies.
fields.JP:
シャーロットさん、不躾でした。
本当にすみません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was being rude to Miss Charlotte, wasn't
I? My apologies.
fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san (remove localized English title)

fields.EN:
H-hey, don't be like that. No need to get all
formal on me. It makes me uncomfortable.
fields.JP:
や、やめてそんな接し方。
今から『さん』付けで敬語なんて、
何だかむずがゆいわ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-hey, don't be like that. No need to get all
formal on me. It makes me uncomfortable.

fields.EN:
Oh, really? Then, uh, Charlotte, officially,
it's a pleasure to meet you.
fields.JP:
そう……？　じゃあえっと、
シャーロット……その、改めてよろしくね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really? Then, uh, Charlotte, officially,
it's a pleasure to meet you.

fields.JP: ええ、よろしくねアリス♪
なあ、もうそろそろ寝ようぜ？
そうね、休みましょうか

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry for keeping you guys up.
Before you go to bed, I want to tell
you something.
fields.JP:
あ……ごめんなさい２人とも。
寝る前にちょっとだけ話したいことがあるのだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry for keeping you guys up.
Before you go to bed, I want to tell
you something.

fields.JP: 何だよ、そんな真剣な口調になって

fields.EN:
What do you think the Devouring Armada
Armada wants?
fields.JP:
２人はあの悪食の監隊塔って、
何を求めてるのだと思う？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you think the Devouring Armada
Armada wants?

fields.EN:
Huh? It's a tower, right? Why would it
want anything?
fields.JP:
え？　塔だろ？
生き物みたいに欲求があるみたいな
言い方をされても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? It's a tower, right? Why would it
want anything?

fields.JP: その通りよ。塔は生きているわ

fields.EN:
Based on everything Gatou-san explained,
at the end of the day, it's still a Jail tower
right?
fields.JP:
えっと、まずあの悪食の監隊塔だけど、
賀東さんの話を聞く限り、
結局あれは監獄塔じゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Based on everything Gato explained,
at the end of the day, it's still a Jail tower
right?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
The Jail tower is still comprised of cores
and Nightmares.
fields.JP:
それで、元々監獄塔というものには、
１対の雄しべと雌しべがあるものなのだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail tower is still comprised of cores
and Nightmares.

fields.EN:
But at the top of the armada tower, the
"White Moon" core wasn't present.
I wonder what it means...
fields.JP:
悪食の監隊塔の上には、
雌しべとなる『白い月』がなかったのよ。
これってどういうことかなと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
But at the top of the armada tower, the
"White Moon" core wasn't present.
I wonder what it means...

fields.JP: んなもん分かるわけねえだろ……むにゃ

fields.EN:
Maybe the armada tower is different
from anything else we've encountered.
fields.JP:
もしかしたらあの監隊塔とやらは、
今までとまったく違うものなのかもしれないわ。
まだまだ謎だらけね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe the armada tower is different
from anything else we've encountered.

fields.EN:
Alice, it's good to plan ahead, but let's
not strain ourselves.
fields.JP:
アリス、色々考えるのは
あなたのいいところだけれど、
考えすぎもよくないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, it's good to plan ahead, but let's
not strain ourselves.

fields.EN:
You must be fatigued. You need a breather.
Here, I'll rub your back.
fields.JP:
ほら、疲れているでしょう？
今はゆっくり休まないと。
ね、背中撫でてあげるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must be fatigued. You need a breather.
Here, I'll rub your back.

fields.EN:
(Those two are locked in conversation again.
I'm too sleepy. I'm off to bed.)
fields.JP:
（２人とも何だか難しい話してるなぁ。
　俺は眠いからもう寝るぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Those two are locked in conversation again.
I'm too sleepy. I'm off to bed.)

fields.EN:
(Damn it, Alice. Now she's got Charlotte
comforting her now.)
fields.JP:
（つーかアリスの奴、
　シャーロットに癒してもらってねーか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn it, Alice. Now she's got Charlotte
comforting her now.)

fields.JP:
（ちょっと待て……
　その癒しは……俺のもん……だ……）

fields.EN:
What? Charlotte and Alice are both up
already?
fields.JP:
なんだ、シャーロットもアリスも、
もう起きてんのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Charlotte and Alice are both up
already?

fields.EN:
I slept terribly. The ground's too damn
hard, I can't take it anymore. Damn. My back.
fields.JP:
まだ寝足りねえ……
でも床が硬くてもう限界だ……
クソッ、背中痛え
fields.LOCALIZED:
I slept terribly. The ground's too damn
hard, I can't take it anymore. Damn. My back.

fields.EN:
You're finally up, Mary. Come on.
Get ready to leave.
fields.JP:
やっと起きたわね、メアリー。
ほら、出発の準備して
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're finally up, Mary. Come on.
Get ready to leave.

fields.EN: Are you serious? I just got up.
fields.JP: マジかよ……もうちょっと時間くれよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you serious? I just got up.

fields.EN: Everyone's ready. You're the only one left.
fields.JP:
わたしたちはもう準備終わってるわ。
あとはメアリーだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Everyone's ready. You're the only one left.

fields.EN:
(Ugh. They'e so prompt. Uptight in all
the wrong ways.)
fields.JP:
（うえ……２人ともきっちりしてるぜ……
　変なところで似たもの同士でいやがる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. They'e so prompt. Uptight in all
the wrong ways.)

fields.EN: Okay, fine. Need help changing up?
fields.JP:
しょうがないわね。
着替え、手伝ってあげましょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, fine. Need help changing up?

fields.EN: I can do it myself! I'm not a child!
fields.JP:
自分でできるわ！
子供あつかいすんな！
fields.LOCALIZED: I can do it myself! I'm not a child!

fields.EN:
Yeah, but you're also the one who tossed
and turned, talking in her sleep. If that's
not bad enough, you snored all night.
fields.JP:
そんなこと言ったって、
いつも寝相は悪いし寝言は言うし、
そうそう。夕べなんていびきもひどかったわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but you're also the one who tossed
and turned, talking in her sleep. If that's
not bad enough, you snored all night.

fields.JP: なっ！？　い、いびきなんてかいてねーよ！

fields.EN: Oh, but you did. It woke up me and Alice.
fields.JP:
あらぁ、ほんとよ？
私もアリスも思わず起きちゃったんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, but you did. It woke up me and Alice.

fields.EN:
But Mary, you're the only one who slept
soundly.
fields.JP:
なのにメアリーったら、１人だけ
気持ちよさそうに眠ってるんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Mary, you're the only one who slept
soundly.

fields.EN:
(Whoa, seriously? I kicked up a fuss, and I
was the one who snored. Super lame!)
fields.JP:
（うああああマジかよ、
　ここまで言っていびきを掻いたの俺だとか、
　クッソだせえじゃねえか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa, seriously? I kicked up a fuss, and I
was the one who snored. Super lame!)

fields.EN:
Mary, save it for later. Hurry up and get
dressed. *yawn*...
fields.JP:
メアリー、落ち込むのは後にして
早く準備を……ふぁぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, save it for later. Hurry up and get
dressed. *yawn*...

fields.EN:
You must be sleepy, Alice. If Mary's at fault,
I'll apologize in her stead. She's tired too.
fields.JP:
アリス、寝不足のようね。
もしメアリーのせいだったらごめんなさいね。
あの子も疲れてたから、ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must be sleepy, Alice. If Mary's at fault,
I'll apologize in her stead. She's tired too.

fields.EN:
No, that's not it. I just, um, have a lot on
my mind.
fields.JP:
ううん、そうじゃないの。
その、色々と心配で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not it. I just, um, have a lot on
my mind.

fields.EN: I'm sure Jack-kun will be okay.
fields.JP: ジャックくんなら、きっと大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sure Jack will be okay.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: シャーロット、あなた心が読めるの……！？

fields.EN:
Oh. I mean, of course I'm worried about the
others too. But yes, I was worried for Jack.
fields.JP:
あ、いえ他の人の心配もしていたのよ？
今は確かにその、ジャックのことを
考えていたけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I mean, of course I'm worried about the
others too. But yes, I was worried for Jack.

fields.EN:
It's okay to worry about Jack-kun. There's nothing
wrong with caring about the person most important
to you.
fields.JP:
別にジャックくんの心配をしていいのよ。
いちばん大事なひとを想うことが、
悪いことなわけないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay to be concerned for him. It's never
a bad thing to look out for the people most
important to you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Alice sure is sensitive. Losing sleep over
a guy...)
fields.JP:
（男を心配して眠れなくなるとか、
　アリスって見た目に反して、意外と繊細だよな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice sure is sensitive. Losing sleep over
a guy...)

fields.EN:
(But if Charlotte was missing, I'd feel
lonely too. Guess I see where she's at.)
fields.JP:
（でも俺だって、今もシャーロットと
　離ればなれだったら寂しいしな。
　その気持ち、少しは分かるぜ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if Charlotte was missing, I'd feel
lonely too. Guess I see where she's at.)

fields.EN:
I feel better now. Lack of sleep won't
bother me one bit.
fields.JP:
おかげで元気出たわ。
寝不足なんて全然平気よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel better now. Lack of sleep won't
bother me one bit.

fields.EN:
Okay, you two. Let's follow the plan and
scope the area. Nothing too dangerous.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ２人とも、今日は打ち合わせ通りに、
無理しない程度の探索に行きましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, you two. Let's follow the plan and
scope the area. Nothing too dangerous.

fields.EN: Hopefully we'll find more food or friends.
fields.JP: 他の人や食料が見つかるといいわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hopefully we'll find more food or friends.

fields.JP: （もう出発か……面倒くせえなぁ……）

fields.EN:
(Hanging with strangers all day is bad
enough. Guess I have no choice but to
go.)
fields.JP:
（でもここに知らねえ奴といたって、
　息が詰まるだけだしな。しょうがない、行くか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hanging with strangers all day is bad
enough. Guess I have no choice but to
go.)

fields.EN:
Mary, I don't need to remind you, but
conserve your matches.
fields.JP:
メアリー、分かってると思うけど、
マッチは使いすぎてはダメよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, I don't need to remind you, but
conserve your matches.

fields.JP: 真面目に言ってるのよ。ちゃんと聞きなさい

fields.EN: O-Okay fine. Don't get so worked up...
fields.JP:
わ、分かったよ。
そんなに怒るなって……
fields.LOCALIZED: O-Okay fine. Don't get so worked up...

fields.EN: Hey, you two. Over there. There's a core.
fields.JP: ねえ２人とも、あそこ――核があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you two. Over there. There's a core.

fields.EN:
(Hm? This is where I woke up. Ah, so
this is where they keep the core.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　ここって俺が目覚めた場所じゃねーか。
　そういえば核のある場所だったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? This is where I woke up. Ah, so
this is where they keep the core.)

fields.EN:
Nice work. We're lucky to have found one
so quickly.
fields.JP:
やったじゃない。
こんなに早く見つけられるなんて、運がいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice work. We're lucky to have found one
so quickly.

fields.EN:
Yep. It wasn't on our to-do list, but
destroying the core will make exploring
a little easier.
fields.JP:
ええ、探索の目的とは違うけれど、
核を破壊すれば探索自体がしやすくなるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yep. It wasn't on our to-do list, but
destroying the core will make exploring
a little easier.

fields.EN:
Be careful though. The cores perform
something known as mimicry.
fields.JP:
でも気をつけて。
核は擬態化行動をしてきたりするから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be careful though. The cores perform
something known as mimicry.

fields.EN:
Mary, I just warned you. Don't get too
close to it!
fields.JP:
メアリー、話したそばから
不用意に近づいてはダメよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, I just warned you. Don't get too
close to it!

fields.JP: いや俺には反応しないのよ、こいつ

fields.EN:
This thing doesn't seem to mimic much of
anything.
fields.JP: しかもこいつ、何か擬態化能力弱いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This thing doesn't seem to mimic much of
anything.

fields.JP: なっ、そんなこと分かるの……！？

fields.EN: Yeah. Get on my level. Piece of cake.
fields.JP:
まあな。俺くらいになると
そのくらい余裕っつーか
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Get on my level. Piece of cake.

fields.EN:
Mary, you used one of your matches on
this core, didn't you?
fields.JP:
メアリー……あなた、
この核にマッチ使ったのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, you used one of your matches on
this core, didn't you?

fields.JP: （やべ、思わず口が滑っちまった……）

fields.EN:
L-Look! It's this!
I need this or I can't function.
fields.JP:
ほ、ほら！　こいつだよこいつ！
俺にはこいつがいないと困るんだってば！
fields.LOCALIZED:
L-Look! It's this!
I need this or I can't function.

fields.EN: I mean it! Without it, I'll die!
fields.JP:
マジだって、コイツがいないと
俺は生きていけねーんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean it! Without it, I'll die!

fields.EN:
Fine. I don't like it when you waste your
matches, but I'll let self-defense slide.
fields.JP:
仕方ないわね……
マッチの無駄遣いはいけないけれど、
身を守るためだもの。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine. I don't like it when you waste your
matches, but I'll let self-defense slide.

fields.EN:
Yup, exactly! Glad you understand,
Charlotte!
fields.JP:
そうそう、そういうこと！
分かってくれてありがたいぜシャーロット！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, exactly! Glad you understand,
Charlotte!

fields.EN: I held off asking until now, but that little one at your feet really is one of your companions, Mary.
fields.JP:
今まで聞かないでおいたけど、
やっぱり足下のその子は、
メアリーのお仲間さんだったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been meaning to ask you, Mary, but
what's that thing around your leg?

fields.EN: I still don't quite understand, though. What do the match and the core have to do with that little one...?
fields.JP:
それで、よく分からないのだけど、
マッチと核がその子にどういう関係があるの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really get it. How does the match
affect the core?

fields.EN:
If Mary throws the flame of a match into the core,
she can make the vision she's seeing take form.
fields.JP:
メアリーはね、マッチの炎を核に投げ込むことで、
その時見ている幻覚を擬態化させることができるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Mary throws a match into the core, she
can mimic the phantom she sees.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.JP: そっ、そんなことが可能なの！？

fields.EN: Yup. This is the servant my match brought me.
fields.JP: ああ、こいつは俺がマッチで作り上げたしもべ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. This is the servant my match brought me.

fields.EN:
I mean, my friend. It helps me out in and
out of the battlefield.
fields.JP:
じゃなかった、お友達。
いろいろとお手伝いしてくれたり、
一緒に戦ってくれたりするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, my friend. It helps me out in and
out of the battlefield.

fields.JP: お話しすることはできるの？

fields.EN:
If I want it to, sure. I summoned it at first
so I could have someone to talk to.
fields.JP:
そういう風に作ればできるな。
俺も初めはお喋り相手も兼ねて
作ろうと思ったんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I want it to, sure. I summoned it at first
so I could have someone to talk to.

fields.EN:
But it didn't work out that way at first.
I was afraid it'd annoy me, so I made it
silent.
fields.JP:
思った通りにならなくて、
変に口うるさい奴だったら嫌だって思って、
それでこんな感じの無口キャラにしたってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it didn't work out that way at first.
I was afraid it'd annoy me, so I made it
silent.

fields.EN: Cool, right? Pretty useful if you ask me.
fields.JP: いいだろ～こいつは超便利だぜー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Cool, right? Pretty useful if you ask me.

fields.JP: でもそれって、かなり恐ろしい力なんじゃ……

fields.EN:
Hehehe. I like how scared you are.
Let me show you.
fields.JP:
ふっふっふ、いい驚きっぷりだぜ。
よし、じゃあ今から特別に実演してやろうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. I like how scared you are.
Let me show you.

fields.EN: Hey! I just told you not to waste them!
fields.JP: こーら、無駄遣いはダメって言ったでしょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! I just told you not to waste them!

fields.EN:
J-Just kidding! Geez, don't get so worked
up, Charlotte.
fields.JP: じょ、冗談だってば、怒んなってシャーロット
fields.LOCALIZED:
J-Just kidding! Geez, don't get so worked
up, Charlotte.

fields.EN:
Shh. Quiet, you two. Mary, step away from
the core.
fields.JP:
――２人とも、静かに。
あとメアリーは核からゆっくり離れて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shh. Quiet, you two. Mary, step away from
the core.

fields.JP: なんだ、いきなり。俺は大丈夫だって
違うわメアリー、メルヒェンよ……！

メルヒェン？
そんなのどこに――ひぃぃぃぃっ！？

fields.EN:
Sounds like it emerged while we were
chatting.
fields.JP:
どうやらわたしたちが話してる間に
出てきてしまったようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like it emerged while we were
chatting.

fields.EN: Alice, maybe this is guarding the core.
fields.JP: アリス、これが核の番人なのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice, maybe this is guarding the core.

fields.EN:
Yes. It's trying to protect it. I'm sure it's
the guardian.
fields.JP:
ええ。核を守るような動きをしている。
番人で間違いないと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It's trying to protect it. I'm sure it's
the guardian.

fields.JP: どっ、どど、どうにかしてくれ！

fields.EN:
What do you mean, Mary?! You're fighting
with us!
fields.JP:
何言ってるのメアリー、
あなたも戦うのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean, Mary?! You're fighting
with us!

fields.JP: そ、そんなこと言ったってよ～～～

fields.EN: Let's go! It's coming. Weapons out!
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's go! It's coming. Weapons out!

fields.EN: Damn. Do I have no choice?!
fields.JP: クソッ、やるしかねえのかよ～！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn. Do I have no choice?!

fields.JP: もっ、もももう終わりだよな！？
ええ。番人はもういないわ

fields.EN: You did great, Mary. There, there ♪
fields.JP: よく頑張ったわメアリー。偉い偉い♪
fields.LOCALIZED: You did great, Mary. There, there ♪

fields.EN:
Aaaaah, thank goodness. Sheesh,
don't make me break a sweat.
fields.JP:
あ～～～よかったぁ……
ったく、俺にこんな働かせるなよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aaaaah, thank goodness. Sheesh,
don't make me break a sweat.

fields.JP: それじゃあ核を破壊するわね

fields.EN:
(What a waste. Even if the mimicry stuff
was weak, we could do so much more with
the match and core.)
fields.JP:
（もったいないなぁ……
　擬態化能力が弱いとはいえ、
　核があればマッチで色々できるのに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What a waste. Even if the mimicry stuff
was weak, we could do so much more with
the match and core.)

fields.JP: アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
That was the Jail screaming. Now we can
defeat the Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの悲鳴のようなものよ。
これで、ナイトメアも倒せるようになったはず
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was the Jail screaming. Now we can
defeat the Nightmares.

fields.JP: シャーロット、どうかしたの？

fields.EN:
Seems like there's another core. We still
can't defeat the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
どうやら核はもう１つあるみたい。
だから、ナイトメアはまだ倒せないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like there's another core. We still
can't defeat the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
How do you know for sure? Do you know
something?
fields.JP:
どうしてそう言い切れるの？
もしかして、何か知っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How do you know for sure? Do you know
something?

fields.EN: I guess it's just a sense...
fields.JP: なーんかね、見えちゃうらしいのよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess it's just a sense...

fields.EN:
There you go again, letting your senses
do the talking.
fields.JP: またそんな他人事みたいな言い方して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again, letting your senses
do the talking.

fields.EN:
Charlotte thinks she can see and feel
everything before it happens.
fields.JP:
あー、またシャーロットの
『見えちゃう』が発動したかぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte thinks she can see and feel
everything before it happens.

fields.EN:
What kind of power is that? Are they
premonitions?
fields.JP:
それはどんな力なの？
透視能力とかそういう力？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What kind of power is that? Are they
premonitions?

fields.EN:
Couldn't tell you. But from time to time,
she brings up her "senses."
fields.JP:
俺もよくは分からないけど、
前からたまーに『見えちゃう』って言うんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Couldn't tell you. But from time to time,
she brings up her "senses."

fields.EN:
Then she immediately finds whatever she's
looking for, which helps every time I'm lost.
Guess she can see stuff we can't.
fields.JP:
そうすると、探し物をすぐ見つけてくれたり、
道に迷ったのに最短ルートで帰れたりするんだわ
俺らには見えない何かが見えてんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then she immediately finds whatever she's
looking for, which helps every time I'm lost.
Guess she can see stuff we can't.

fields.EN:
But her sense is usually spot-on. I mean,
she saw me after all.
fields.JP:
でもこの『見えちゃう』の信憑性は高いぜ？
なんせ俺の存在に完璧に気づくんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But her sense is usually spot-on. I mean,
she saw me after all.

fields.EN:
Anyone can see you. It's not like you're
invisible, Mary.
fields.JP:
そんなの、誰でも気づくでしょう。
メアリーが透明になれるわけでもあるまいし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyone can see you. It's not like you're
invisible, Mary.

fields.EN:
Oh come on, Alice. Have you already
forgotten how we met?
fields.JP:
おいおいアリス、お前は
最初に俺に出会った時のことを忘れたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh come on, Alice. Have you already
forgotten how we met?

fields.EN:
I've never said it out loud, but I have no
presence. If I don't initiate, no one sees
me.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと言ってなかったけどな、
俺は存在感がマジで希薄なんだ。こっちがアピール
しない限り、ほとんど気づかれないんだぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never said it out loud, but I have no
presence. If I don't initiate, no one sees
me.

fields.EN:
But Charlotte always noticed me.
No matter what. See? It's amazing.
fields.JP:
それなのにシャーロットだけは、
いつだって俺に気づいてくれるんだ。
な？　これって凄いことなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Charlotte always noticed me.
No matter what. See? It's amazing.

fields.JP: なるほどね……納得したわ

fields.EN:
Charlotte has the sixth sense and Mary
can't be "seen."
fields.JP:
『見えちゃう』シャーロットと、
『見えない』メアリーか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte has the sixth sense and Mary
can't be "seen."

fields.EN: You make quite the interesting pair.
fields.JP: ほんと、あなたたちは不思議な人たちね
fields.LOCALIZED: You make quite the interesting pair.

fields.EN:
(From my point of view, Alice is the
interesting one. I mean, how does she
handle those Marchens?)
fields.JP:
（俺からすれば、アリスの方が不思議な人
　だけどな。よく自分からメルヒェンに
　立ち向かっていくもんだぜ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(From my point of view, Alice is the
interesting one. I mean, how does she
handle those Marchens?)

fields.EN:
Charlotte, I'm gonna double-check, but
you sure we can't stop the Nightmares?
fields.JP:
シャーロット、確認するけど、
今はまだナイトメアは倒せないのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, I'm gonna double-check, but
you sure we can't stop the Nightmares?

fields.EN: Seems like it. Let's be careful moving around.
fields.JP:
そうらしいわ。だから出くわさないように、
気をつけて進んだ方がいいかも
fields.LOCALIZED: Seems like it. Let's be careful moving around.

fields.EN:
Got it. Avoid the darkness, and continue
our search.
fields.JP:
分かったわ。じゃあ暗闇を避けるように、
慎重に探索を続けましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. Avoid the darkness, and continue
our search.

fields.EN: Ugh, it's too dark. Could it be...?
fields.JP: げっ、この暗闇ってもしかして……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh, it's too dark. Could it be...?

fields.EN:
Yep, it's a Nightmare. We just had to go
this way...
fields.JP:
ええ、ナイトメアね。
こんなところで出会うなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yep, it's a Nightmare. We just had to go
this way...

fields.EN:
We can't hide from it. Okay you two,
let's make a run for it.
fields.JP:
隠れてやり過ごすのはもう無理だわ。
２人とも、全速力で走って逃げるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't hide from it. Okay you two,
let's make a run for it.

fields.EN:
Wait. Alice, about the other core...
I think it's gone.
fields.JP:
待って、アリス。もう１つの核だけど、
どうやらなくなったらしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. Alice, about the other core...
I think it's gone.

fields.EN: Are your senses telling you that?
fields.JP: それって『見えちゃった』のかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are your senses telling you that?

fields.JP: ええ。見えちゃったみたい

fields.EN:
Which means...the Jail's screams indicate
when the other core is destroyed.
fields.JP:
ということは……
さっき新しく聞こえたジェイルの悲鳴は、
もう１つの核が破壊されたってことのようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means...the Jail's screams indicate
when the other core is destroyed.

fields.EN:
H-Hey, what are you doing? Let's run
for it!
fields.JP:
お、おい何してんだよ、
早く逃げようぜ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, what are you doing? Let's run
for it!

fields.EN:
Wait Mary, we could run for it, but we can
also defeat the Nightmare now.
fields.JP:
待ってメアリー。
確かに逃げるって選択肢もある。
でも、今のナイトメアは倒せる状態なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait Mary, we could run for it, but we can
also defeat the Nightmare now.

fields.EN:
So if we want to explore without a hitch,
we should take down the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
だから、この先の探索のことを考えれば、
ここでナイトメアを叩いておいた方がいいと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if we want to explore without a hitch,
we should take down the Nightmare.

fields.EN: Right. Defeating it means walking in peace.
fields.JP: そうねえ、倒しちゃえば安全に歩けるものね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Defeating it means walking in peace.

fields.EN:
Are you guys serious?! If we can get away
scot-free, why not?!
fields.JP:
お前ら、マジで言ってんのか！？
避けて通れるんだから避ければいいじゃねーか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you guys serious?! If we can get away
scot-free, why not?!

fields.EN:
But if it ambushes us later, wouldn't that
be worse?
fields.JP:
でも放置して、どこから襲ってくるか
分からないのって怖いでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if it ambushes us later, wouldn't that
be worse?

fields.EN:
Please Mary, we don't need that fear on
our backs. Be brave, okay?
fields.JP:
ね、メアリー。
その恐怖を無くすためにも、戦いましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please Mary, we don't need that fear on
our backs. Be brave, okay?

fields.JP: ナイトメアが来たわよ

fields.EN:
(Holy crap, that roar is even scarier up
close! Ugh, it's so creepy-looking. 
Do they really expect to win here?)
fields.JP:
（近くだと鳴き声も一層おぞましい……！
　しかも見た目もやっぱ、気持ち悪ぃし不気味だし、
　本当にこんな奴相手に勝てるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Holy crap, that roar is even scarier up
close! Ugh, it's so creepy-looking. 
Do they really expect to win here?)

fields.EN: No time to run. Okay, fine. I'll do it.
fields.JP:
でももう逃げてる時間もないな……
分かったよ、やってやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: No time to run. Okay, fine. I'll do it.

fields.EN:
Ugh, whatever. Let's just do it.
You bastarrrrrd!
fields.JP:
あーもう、どうにでもなれってんだ、
このクソッタレがーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, whatever. Let's just do it.
You bastarrrrrd!

fields.EN: All right. Looks like we hurt it bad!
fields.JP:
よし、ちゃんと
傷を負わせることができているわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right. Looks like we hurt it bad!

fields.EN:
Just like Charlotte said, the other core
must have been destroyed!
fields.JP:
シャーロットの言うとおり、
もう１つの核はしっかりと破壊されていたようね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just like Charlotte said, the other core
must have been destroyed!

fields.JP: ふふ、だから言ったじゃない

fields.EN:
How are you two so chipper?! We haven't
even beat it yet!
fields.JP:
お前ら、まだあいつ倒してないのに
よくそんな笑顔でいられるな！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are you two so chipper?! We haven't
even beat it yet!

fields.EN:
You're right. We shouldn't let our guards
down.
fields.JP: そうね油断してはいけないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. We shouldn't let our guards
down.

fields.EN:
(After all we've thrown at it, it's still alive!
Talk about tough as nails.)
fields.JP:
（こいつ、こんな傷つけても
　まだ生きてんだぜ？　何だよこの生命力……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After all we've thrown at it, it's still alive!
Talk about tough as nails.)

fields.JP: ゴァァ……ゴアアアアアアアッ！
さあ、一気に終わらせるわよ！
（ちくしょう、さっさと倒れろ……！！）

fields.EN: I think we finally subdued it.
fields.JP: 今度こそ終わりのようね
fields.LOCALIZED: I think we finally subdued it.

fields.EN: Yes. Now we can keep exploring safely.
fields.JP:
ええ、これで安全に
探索を進めることができるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. Now we can keep exploring safely.

fields.JP: そっか、終わったんだな

fields.EN:
AAAAAH! ARGHHHH! I can't anymore!
I'm pooped! I can't move!
fields.JP:
あ～～～～～～しんど～～～～～～～！
もー無理！　もー動けねえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
AAAAAH! ARGHHHH! I can't anymore!
I'm pooped! I can't move!

fields.EN: Hehe. You gave it your all back there, Mary.
fields.JP: ふふ、メアリーとっても頑張ったものね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You gave it your all back there, Mary.

fields.EN:
Right? I worked my butt off, right?!
So as a treat, gimme a big hug.
fields.JP:
そうだろ？　俺頑張っただろ！？
だからご褒美にその……ぎゅっとだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? I worked my butt off, right?!
So as a treat, gimme a big hug.

fields.EN: Come on. We need to keep moving.
fields.JP: ほら、早く探索の続き行きましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Come on. We need to keep moving.

fields.EN: You're right. We can head in deeper now.
fields.JP:
そうね、これでもっと先まで行っても、
すぐ帰ってこれそうだものね～
fields.LOCALIZED: You're right. We can head in deeper now.

fields.EN: Oh. What were you saying, Mary?
fields.JP: そうだメアリー、今何て言おうとしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. What were you saying, Mary?

fields.EN:
(Damn it. So close, but so far. May as well
kill me where I stand.)
fields.JP:
（ちくしょう、
　俺の人生の中でいちばん頑張ったのに！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Damn it. So close, but so far. May as well
kill me where I stand.)

fields.EN: (Can't get rest, can't get a hug.)
fields.JP:
（休ませてもくれなきゃ、
　抱きしめてもくれないなんて……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Can't get rest, can't get a hug.)

fields.JP: メアリー、ほら行くわよ～

fields.EN: Hey, are we not done yet? I'm tired already.
fields.JP:
なぁ、まだ探索終わんねえのか？
いいかげん疲れたぜ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, are we not done yet? I'm tired already.

fields.JP: そうねえ、だいぶ奥まで来たと思うけれど……

fields.EN:
Seems like we've turned over almost
every stone. This is the last place to look.
fields.JP:
めぼしいところはだいたい探したわ。
だからこの辺りが、探索してない
最後の場所なんじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like we've turned over almost
every stone. This is the last place to look.

fields.EN:
Why? Why isn't he here...? There has to
be somewhere we haven't looked.
fields.JP:
なんで、なんでいないの……
まだ見つけてない道があるべきよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Why isn't he here...? There has to
be somewhere we haven't looked.

fields.EN: It's not here. I can't find the path.
fields.JP: ない……道が見つからないわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not here. I can't find the path.

fields.EN: No one else is here anymore. Jack's not here.
fields.JP:
ここにはもう誰も……
ジャックもいないんだわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: No one else is here anymore. Jack's not here.

fields.EN:
We'll search every corner, Alice. If we still
can't find him, we'll look outside.
Don't give up.
fields.JP:
隅々まで探しましょう、アリス。
それでも見つからなければ、今度は外を探すの。
諦めてはダメよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll search every corner, Alice. If we still
can't find him, we'll look outside.
Don't give up.

fields.EN:
(Sheesh, just how lonely is this Alice girl?
Is she this whiny without everyone?)
fields.JP:
（アリスの奴、どんだけ寂しがり屋なんだよ……
　そんなにみんながいないとダメなのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sheesh, just how lonely is this Alice girl?
Is she this whiny without everyone?)

fields.EN:
(Well, if I couldn't find Charlotte, I'd
probably be crying too.)
fields.JP:
（まあでも……俺もこんだけ探して
　シャーロットが見つからなかったら、
　もしかしたら泣いてたかもしれねーな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, if I couldn't find Charlotte, I'd
probably be crying too.)

fields.EN:
(Guess I should count my lucky matches
that I found Charlotte so quickly.)
fields.JP:
（すぐにシャーロットが見つかった俺は、
　きっと幸せな方なんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess I should count my lucky matches
that I found Charlotte so quickly.)

fields.EN:
(I thought I was the perfect loner, but here
I am, always thinking of Charlotte. I put up
a front, but there it is.)
fields.JP:
（って、お一人様を極めたはずなのに、
　シャーロットのことばっか考えてんな、俺。
　格好つけといて、ダセェったらないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought I was the perfect loner, but here
I am, always thinking of Charlotte. I put up
a front, but there it is.)

fields.EN:
(In a life or death situation, it makes sense
to want your people close to you. It's simple
math.)
fields.JP:
（でも今は生きるか死ぬかっていう緊急時だ。
　誰かを求めるのは、生存本能的に正しいというか、
　合理的な判断に基づいた行動っていうか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In a life or death situation, it makes sense
to want your people close to you. It's simple
math.)

fields.EN:
(Charlotte probably feels the same.
She needs me and Alice just as much.)
fields.JP:
（それに、シャーロットだって、
　俺やアリスがいないとダメなんだろ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Charlotte probably feels the same.
She needs me and Alice just as much.)

fields.EN:
(That's right. Charlotte isn't perfect.
When those crazies attacked us on the surface,
she started feeling pain out of nowhere.)
fields.JP:
（そうだよ、シャーロットも万能じゃない。
　地上であのぶっ飛んだ奴らに襲われた時、
　急に苦しんだりもしたし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. Charlotte isn't perfect.
When those crazies attacked us on the surface,
she started feeling pain out of nowhere.)

fields.EN:
(If I wasn't with her then, she would've
been done for. Who's to say for sure?)
fields.JP:
（あの時、俺がついててやらなかったら、
　きっとヤバかったに違いないんだ。
　まあ根拠はねえけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I wasn't with her then, she would've
been done for. Who's to say for sure?)

fields.EN:
(But where did that pain come from?
Maybe she's sick or something?)
fields.JP:
（でも何でいきなり苦しそうになったんだ？
　もしかして病気でも抱えてる？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But where did that pain come from?
Maybe she's sick or something?)

fields.EN:
(That was my first time seeing Charlotte
in so much pain. She's normally so strong.
She can't be sick, I think...)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットが苦しんでいるのは、
　あの時が初めてだ。そしてそれ以降はない……
　病気の線は薄いんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was my first time seeing Charlotte
in so much pain. She's normally so strong.
She can't be sick, I think...)

fields.JP: ほらアリス、元気出して

fields.EN:
(Please Charlotte, stay healthy forever...
I can't bear to see her in pain.)
fields.JP:

Well, we've gone this way. Why don't we
go in further?

メアリー、シャーロット、
奥に進みましょう！！

いきなり駆け出して、
アリスの奴どうしたんだ……？

Hehe. Her feelings were answered.
Let's go after her.

ふふ、想いが通じたのよ。

Hehe. Her feelings were answered.
Let's go after her.

Killing a sleeping girl should be as easy

Killing a sleeping girl should be as easy

At this rate, my sisters will never let me

At this rate, my sisters will never let me
hear the end of it... Can't have that.

Yeaaaah. Geez Hiaburibashira, you sure took your
sweet time killing, didn't you? ★

はーい、火あぶり柱ったら

sweet time killing, didn't you? ★

そういうことです。

Exactly. You better not make a habit of that,
got it?

O-Of course not! That's...
Well, I'm just finding my rhythm!

もっ、もちろん！
あれはそう、たまたまなのっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Of course not! That's...
Well, I'm just finding my rhythm!

fields.EN: Then why did you just stand there instead of chasing anyone? Did you think we'd kill them for you if you left them alone?

ではどうして誰も追いかけず、突っ立って

私たちが殺してくれるとでも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your rhythm? Do you think that excuses

(Papa doesn't need useless children. At this

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

Yeah, right. Second chances mean squat

fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, right. Second chances mean squat
when we can't count on you to do it
right the first time.

Sheesh. The mere sight of you irks me,
useless junk.
fields.JP:
ほんっと、マジ見ててムカつくわよね、
このクソ雑魚ってば
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sheesh. The mere sight of you irks me,
useless junk.

fields.EN:
Failure won't be forgiven next time.
I can't let that happen... I must kill her.
fields.JP:
次に失敗したら、きっと許してもらえない。
それだけはダメ……殺さなくちゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Failure won't be forgiven next time.
I can't let that happen... I must kill her.

This time, I'll do it. I have to!
I'll show my sisters!

今度こそ、絶対に……成功させなくちゃ！
それで、姉さんたちを見返すんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This time, I'll do it. I have to!
I'll show my sisters!

fields.JP:
う……ううっ……あぁっ！
こ、殺……

んっ……みんな……
ぶじで……いて……

fields.EN:
She's thinking about her friends again? Even
though Hiaburibashira might kill her this time...

また仲間のこと、考えてるの？
今度こそ、火あぶり柱に
殺されちゃうかもしれないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is she really concerned for her friends?
I'm literally about to murder her...
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Geez, what a sympathetic fool. An even

enemy. That was weird at first...
fields.JP:
なんて、バカなおひとよし。
敵だと分かってて人を心配するなんて大バカ！
あの時だって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Geez, what a sympathetic fool. An even
bigger fool for worrying for your own
enemy. That was weird at first...

fields.JP:
へんなの～。
わるいやつなのに、どうして？
ラプンツェルをたすけてくれたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's weird. You're an enemy. Why'd you
do that? Did you save me?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Well...I thought you would take to being
my apprentice. It's the only reason I saved
you.
fields.JP:
う……そ、それは、
下僕にできそうだと思って、
そ、それで打算的に助けただけよっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...I thought you would take to being
my apprentice. It's the only reason I saved
you.

fields.EN: I don't get it. So you're not a bad guy?
fields.JP:
むずかしーこと、わかんないけど。
わるいやつじゃないってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't get it. So you're not a bad guy?

fields.EN: ARGH! LIKE I SAID, I had ulterior motives!
fields.JP:
～～～っ、だ、だからっ、
こっちの思惑でやったことだって
言ってるでしょっ
fields.LOCALIZED: ARGH! LIKE I SAID, I had ulterior motives!

fields.JP:
……あなた、これから……
どうするの？
……やっぱり、すぐに、帰っちゃう……？

fields.EN: (What am I supposed to do...? This place looks vaguely familiar, but I don't even know where I am...)
fields.JP:
（本当に、どうしたらいいんだろ？
　見た覚えがあるような場所だけど、
　ここがどこかもわからないし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What should I do? I might be able to
make my way out alone, but this place
doesn't look too familiar.)

fields.EN:
(Shoot, this is bad. I need to reunite with
Papa and my sisters soon, but getting home
might be tough.)
fields.JP:
（まずい、まずいわ。
　一刻も早くパパや姉さんたちと合流しなきゃ
　いけないのに、帰り方もわからないなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Shoot, this is bad. I need to reunite with
Papa and my sisters soon, but getting home
might be tough.)

fields.JP:
うぐっ！　ち、違っ……ううっ！
あううっ～～～！

fields.EN: So what if I am? Does that concern you?
fields.JP:
……か、仮に、そうだとしたら何？
おまえに関係ある？
fields.LOCALIZED: So what if I am? Does that concern you?

fields.EN: Until...you can go home...stay with us.
fields.JP:
……帰り道、わかるまで……
一緒に……行く？
fields.LOCALIZED: Until...you can go home...stay with us.

fields.EN:
(Is that an invitation?! What's her angle
here?!)
fields.JP:
（さ、誘ってくれたの？
　こいつ、どこまでおひとよしなんだろ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is that an invitation?! What's her angle
here?!)

fields.EN: (What do I do...? My sisters will definitely scold me if they find out. But I'm scared to go back all by myself...)
fields.JP:
（ど、どうしよう……姉さんたちに
　バレたら絶対叱られるよね？
　でも、１人ぼっちで戻るのは怖いし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If my sisters find out I've been fraternizing
with the enemy, they'll be mad. But finding
my way alone sounds scarier.)

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Hmm~... If Nemu-Nemu's okay with it, Rapunzel is too!
fields.JP:
ん～～っ、ねむねむがいいなら、
ラプンツェルはいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. If you're okay with it Sleepy, then
so am I!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Oogh. Fine. But stay in line, and only until
we're out of this area.
fields.JP:
う、うう……と、途中までなら、
一緒でもいいわ。
た、ただし、帰り道が分かるまでだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh. Fine. But stay in line, and only until
we're out of this area.

fields.EN: Ohh, so you're joining Rapunzel and the others!
fields.JP:
そっかー、ラプンツェルたちの
なかまになるんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. That makes us friends now!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
うんっ、なかま！
さっきはありがと！

fields.EN:
(Hiaburibashira isn't their friend... Ugh, then
why does hearing that make her grin?!)
fields.JP:
（火あぶり柱は仲間なんかじゃ……
　ううっ、でも、そう言われると
　顔がにやけるのはなんで～！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not their friend...but if I was...
You wouldn't catch me smiling about it!)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Now that we're friends, let me introduce
myself. I'm Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
なかまになったから、じこしょーかいしよ。
ラプンツェルは、ラプンツェル！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we're friends, let me introduce
myself. I'm Rapunzel!

fields.EN:
Um. So what was your name again...?
I forgot.
fields.JP:
えっと、なまえ……なんだっけ？
ながいから、わすれちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. So what was your name again...?
I forgot.

fields.JP:
ひあぶ……ら？
あれれ、ちあぶり？

fields.EN:
No, I told you, that's wrong.
Not 'basha' — 'ba-shi-ra'!
fields.JP:
だから、違うってば。
ばしゃじゃなくて、『ば　し　ら』！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. For the last time, my name is Pyre.
P-Y-R-E.
fields.notes: B19 removed residual localization-only Pyre/Pi/Byre; source wording/distortion restored

fields.EN: Ohhh, Shira! I'm calling you Shira from now on!
fields.JP:
あっ、シラかー！
じゃあ、いまからシラってよぶね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohhh, Pi! I'm calling you Pi from now on!

fields.EN:
Wait, that's even shorter than your other
guesses. My name is Hiaburibashira.
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと、なんで変なとこで略すのよ。
本当は火あぶり柱なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, that's even shorter than your other
guesses. My name is Pyre.

fields.EN:
Well I can't say hard words! Shira! Shira!
I like that better!
fields.JP:
だって、むずかしーと、なまえよべないから！
シラ！　シラがいいっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well I can't say hard words! Pi! Pi!
I like that better!

fields.EN: Oh, brother. This is going to be a long walk.
fields.JP: う、うう……っ、納得いかない
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, brother. This is going to be a long walk.

fields.EN:
(Shira, huh...? It sounds better than being
called Hiaburibashira... maybe.)
fields.JP:
（けど、シラ、か……
　火あぶり柱って呼ばれるより、
　悪くない響き……かも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi, huh...? I kinda like that more than Pyre.
I think.)
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
...Fine. Better than you butchering my name
all the time. I accept. Albeit begrudgingly.
fields.JP:
……し、仕方ないわね。
何度も間違えて呼ばれるよりはマシだし、
そ、それでもいいわ。納得いかないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Fine. Better than you butchering my name
all the time. I accept. Albeit begrudgingly.

fields.JP:
うんっ！　ラプンツェルのことは、
ラプってよんでいいよー
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! You can call me Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
(Kinda tickles me to think that someone
gave me a nickname. I wonder what this
feeling means...)
fields.JP:
（誰かから親しげに呼ばれるのって、
　妙にくすぐったい。
　な、何だろう、この感情……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kinda tickles me to think that someone
gave me a nickname. I wonder what this
feeling means...)

fields.EN:
(I feel it in my chest, but it doesn't bother
me. Why is that?)
fields.JP:
（すごく胸がムズムズするのに、
　嫌じゃないのは……なんでだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel it in my chest, but it doesn't bother
me. Why is that?)

fields.JP:
と、ともかく、行くわよ！
ラプ、眠り！
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: うんっ！　しゅっぱつだね！

fields.EN:
Shira♪ I'm with Shira and Nemu-Nemu.
Having a blast. Yaaaaay.
fields.JP:
シーラ♪　シラとねむねむと
いっしょ、たのしーなっ、わーい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pi♪ I'm with Pi and Sleepy.
Having a blast. Yaaaaay.
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
...Hey Rapu, what's got you so chipper
all of a sudden?
fields.JP:
……ちょっと、ラプ。
あんた、はしゃぎすぎじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Hey Rappy, what's got you so chipper
all of a sudden?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Hehehe. Hard not to smile when you're
making new friends.
fields.JP:
えへへー、だってなかまがふえて、
うれしいんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. Hard not to smile when you're
making new friends.

fields.JP: ねむねむも、うれしいっていってる！

fields.EN: Wow. Glad you're both enjoying yourselves.
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. Glad you're both enjoying yourselves.

fields.EN:
(This is the first time having a stroll with
people other than my sisters.)
fields.JP:
（でも、姉さんたち以外の人と、
　こうして一緒に歩くのって、初めてかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the first time having a stroll with
people other than my sisters.)

fields.EN:
(I'm so uptight around my sisters. I worry
about every little thing I do. For some
reason, these two put me more at ease.)
fields.JP:
（姉さんたちの前だと、失敗しないように
　いつもガチガチに緊張してたけど……
　こいつらとなら、不思議と緊張しないし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm so uptight around my sisters. I worry
about every little thing I do. For some
reason, these two put me more at ease.)

fields.EN:
(Sure they're weird, but only a little.
Maybe I'm having...fun.)
fields.JP:
（変な連中だけど、ほんのちょっと、
　ちょぴっとだけ、楽しい…かも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sure they're weird, but only a little.
Maybe I'm having...fun.)

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: えっ、どーかした、ねむねむ？

fields.EN:
...Rapu, you corrupt. Must treat...or bad
things happen.
fields.JP:
……らぷ、少し、穢れてる。
このまま放置したら、大変……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Rappy, you corrupt. Must treat...or bad
things happen.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
What? But Jack's not with us? What do
we do?
fields.JP: えっ！　じゃっくがいないのに、どーしよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? But Jack's not with us? What do
we do?

fields.JP: なんでそんなに焦ってるわけ？

fields.EN:
...Purify Blood Maidens from corruption...
Or they start lose control.
fields.JP:
……血式少女は、穢れを浄化しないと、
衝動、押さえきれなく……なる
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Purify Blood Maidens from corruption...
Or they start lose control.

fields.EN:
Oh. Then we should purify her, right?
That's easy.
fields.JP:
ふぅん？　まぁとにかく、
穢れを浄化すればいいんでしょ？
簡単なことじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Then we should purify her, right?
That's easy.

fields.JP: ……でも、浄化できる人、ここにいない……

fields.EN: If only we had Jack with us.
fields.JP: じゃっくがいたら、できたのにねー
fields.LOCALIZED: If only we had Jack with us.

fields.EN: We don't need him. See, look.
fields.JP:
別にそんなやつ、いなくてもできるってば。
ほら、こうやって
fields.LOCALIZED: We don't need him. See, look.

fields.EN:
Yaaay, all better~!
Rapunzel's corruption is gone!
fields.JP:
わぁい、すっきり～！
ラプンツェルのけがれ、きえちゃった！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yaaaay! I feel great! Corruption's all gone.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Nemu-Nemu, look! No more corruption!
You're amazing, Shira!
fields.JP:
ねむねむ、みて～、ほら！
かんぜんに、けがれがきえちゃった
シラって、すごいんだねー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy, look! No more corruption!
You're amazing, Pi!
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Keep it down! It's no big deal. If that's all
it takes, then you have nothing to worry
about.
fields.JP:
お、大げさ過ぎ！　こんなの簡単じゃない。
穢れなんて、さっきみたいにやれば、
すぐに浄化できるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Keep it down! It's no big deal. If that's all
it takes, then you have nothing to worry
about.

fields.JP: ……もしかして、シラも、血式少女？

血式少女？
なによそれ、知らないわ

fields.EN:
Oh, is that no? How do you know what
corruption is then?
fields.JP:
え、ちがうんだ。
じゃあ、なんでけがれをしってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that no? How do you know what
corruption is then?

fields.EN:
Because Genocide Pink also has to manage
their corruption.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女も、穢れを浄化する
必要があるからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because Massacre Pink also has to manage
their corruption.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: But with this 'Gore Suit,' I'm fine. I can exert many times my normal strength, and I can purify things easily like I did before.
fields.JP:
でも、この『ゴアスーツ』があれば大丈夫。
普段の何倍の力も出せるし、
さっきみたいに簡単に浄化もできるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
But with this Gore Suit, I'm good. I'm twice
as powerful and I have the power to purify.

fields.EN: Oh. Amazing! Shira, you sure can do it all!
fields.JP:
へーっ、すごい、すごいっ！
シラはすごいのうりょくがあるんだね～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Amazing! Pi, you sure can do it all!

fields.EN:
Well, yeah! The Hiaburibashira you know isn't one
to depend on others for purification.
fields.JP:
ま、まあね！　火あぶり柱は
浄化が他人頼りなあんたたちとは違うのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yeah! The Pyre you know isn't one
to depend on others for purification.

fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Hehe. All by design, of course.
fields.JP: ふふん。簡単にわかってたまるもんですか
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. All by design, of course.

fields.EN:
(Oh no. I'm smiling again. It feels so nice
to be praised.)
fields.JP:
（あ、ダメ、また顔がにやけちゃう。
　褒められるのって、気分がいいなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no. I'm smiling again. It feels so nice
to be praised.)

fields.EN: Oh, Nemu-Nemu...? Someone's coming over here.
fields.JP:
……あれ？　ねむねむ～、
あっちから、だれかきたよー
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Sleepy...? Someone's coming over here.

fields.JP: あれは、眠り姫じゃないか！

fields.EN:
You're right! Heeeey Nemu-chan!
You guys safe?
fields.JP:
本当だ！　おーい、ネムちゃん！
無事だったのかーい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right! Heeeey Sleepy!
You guys safe?

fields.JP: ……ん。あの人たち、見た覚え、ある……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's never seen them before.
Someone Nemu-Nemu knows?
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは、みたことないよ。
ねむねむの、しってるひと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen them before.
Do you know them Sleepy?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Yup yup... Jack's friends! It's...Itsuki...
and Takumi...
fields.JP:
……うん、うんっ。
ジャックの、仲間……！
……たしか、イツキと、タクミ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup yup... Jack's friends! It's...Itsuki...
and Takumi...

fields.EN: Oh, really! Then they're friends of Rapunzel and the others! Yay!
fields.JP:
そうなんだ！　じゃあ、ラプンツェルたちの
なかまなんだね！　わーい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really?! Friends of yours are friends of
mine! Yay!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
It really is you, Nemu-chan. Thank goodness
we found you.
fields.JP:
やっぱり、ネムちゃんだ。
合流出来てよかったー
fields.LOCALIZED:
It really is you, Sleepy. Thank goodness
we found you.

fields.EN:
The other Blood Maidens are safe and
sound too.
fields.JP:
そっちの血式少女たちも、
無事で何よりだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other Blood Maidens are safe and
sound too.

fields.JP: うんっ、ラプンツェルもげんきだよー
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
……火あぶり柱は、
血式少女なんかじゃないけど

fields.EN:
Hm? Don't I know you from somewhere?
Wait, isn't that―!
fields.JP:
んんっ？　君、どこかで見たような……
げぇっ、ま、まさか……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Don't I know you from somewhere?
Wait, isn't that―!

fields.EN:
She's from Genocide Pink! Both of you,
get away from her!
fields.JP:
処刑台少女の仲間か！
みんな、すぐに離れるんだっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's from Massacre Pink! Both of you,
get away from her!
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(Oogh... There they go again! Not that I
blame them. I am their enemy after all.)
fields.JP:
（ううっ……またそうやってっ！
　でも、そうだよね、火あぶり柱は敵だから、
　当然の反応だよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oogh... There they go again! Not that I
blame them. I am their enemy after all.)

fields.EN: Mm... Mmmm. No. She's no enemy!
fields.JP:
……んーっ、んーっ。
ちがう、この子、敵じゃない……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... Mmmm. No. She's no enemy!

fields.EN:
That's right! Shira isn't bad.
She's friends with Rapunzel and Nemu-Nemu~!
fields.JP:
そーだよ！　シラはわるいやつじゃないよ、
ラプンツェルとねむねむのなかまだよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Pi's not a bad guy! She's our friend!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
You say this girl is your friend? Wait.
What's going on? I don't understand.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女が仲間？
えー、どういう状況なのー？
さっぱりわからないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You say this girl is your friend? Wait.
What's going on? I don't understand.

fields.EN: Is it true you've befriended them?
fields.JP:
君が彼女たちの仲間になったというのは、
事実なのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it true you've befriended them?

fields.EN:
Friends of circumstance. I could turn on
them at any time. Don't get it twisted.
fields.JP:
たまたま、成り行きでそうなっただけ。
いつでも、気が向いたら敵に戻るわ。
だから、勘違いしないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Friends of circumstance. I could turn on
them at any time. Don't get it twisted.

fields.EN: But Shira...saved us. She has...good heart.
fields.JP:
……でも、シラは……ボクたちを、
何度も助けてくれた……
本当は、とても、いいこ
fields.LOCALIZED: But Pi...saved us. She has...good heart.

fields.EN:
Okay. If Nemu-chan approves, then I guess we
can trust her?
fields.JP:
う、うーん、ネムちゃんがそう言うなら、
大丈夫なのか……な？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. If Sleepy approves, then I guess we
can trust her?

fields.EN:
I'm skeptical, but I'll take their word for
it.
fields.JP:
俄に信じられないけれど、
本当ならば心強いかも知れないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm skeptical, but I'll take their word for
it.

fields.EN:
Her name is Shira~!
She's friends with Rapunzel and the others!
fields.JP:
シラ、っていうんだよ～！
ラプンツェルたちのなかま！
fields.LOCALIZED: Her name is Pi! She's our friend.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
...It's actually Hiaburibashira.
But Shira is fine.
fields.JP:
……本当は、火あぶり柱だけど。
でもまぁ、シラでいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Pyre, actually. But whatever. Pi works too.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Oh. We've set up a base nearby. You three
should rest up at camp.
fields.JP:
そういえば、僕たちはこの近くに
拠点になるキャンプ地を作ったんだ。
３人ともそこで休んだらいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. We've set up a base nearby. You three
should rest up at camp.

fields.JP:
ネムちゃんも、
早く眠りたいでしょ？

……うんっ、うんっ……！
シラも、行こう……

fields.EN:
(I can't shelter with an enemy. But...it's
too scary to sleep out there alone.
Lonely too.)
fields.JP:
（敵の世話になんてなれないわよ。
　……でも、火あぶり柱だけ野宿するのは、
　怖いし、寂しいし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't shelter with an enemy. But...it's
too scary to sleep out there alone.
Lonely too.)

fields.EN:
No holding back~! Rapunzel wants Shira with her too!
Let's sleep together with Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
えんりょは、だめだよ～！
シラもいっしょがいい！
ラプンツェルといっしょにねよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No holding back! I want Pi with me!
Come on, this way!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
(Oh, I-I know! I'm observing the enemy.
If I infiltrate the enemy base, I can spy
on them for Papa and my sisters.)
fields.JP:
（そ、そうよ！　これは敵情視察っ！
　敵の拠点に潜入したら、
　パパや姉さんたちのためにもなるしね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I-I know! I'm observing the enemy.
If I infiltrate the enemy base, I can spy
on them for Papa and my sisters.)

fields.EN: Very well. If you insist, then I'll go.
fields.JP:
……し、仕方ないわね。
そこまで言うなら、同行してあげる
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well. If you insist, then I'll go.

fields.EN:
Ta-daaaa! This is our camp. It's crude,
but we made do with what we had.
Should work well for now.
fields.JP:
じゃーん、ここがうちらの作ったキャンプー！
あり合わせの材料で作ったものだから、
多少不便でも勘弁してちょーだいっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ta-daaaa! This is our camp. It's crude,
but we made do with what we had.
Should work well for now.

fields.EN: Hmm... Good enough to sleep... Zzz...
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmm... Good enough to sleep... Zzz...

fields.JP: ねむねむ、ねるのはやいー

fields.EN:
Let's celebrate our arrival first! I'm relieved
we found each other.
fields.JP:
まずは改めて、
お互いの無事を祝おうじゃないか。
こうして合流できて何よりだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's celebrate our arrival first! I'm relieved
we found each other.

fields.EN:
With those Genocide Pink maniacs around,
it's a miracle we made it this far.
fields.JP:
あの処刑台少女ってヤバイ連中から
生き延びられたのは、ラッキーだったよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
With those Massacre Pink maniacs around,
it's a miracle we made it this far.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
You have Hikari to thank for that, since
she's the one who teleported us here.
fields.JP:
恐らく、あの場から僕たちが離脱できたのは、
ヒカリの力のお陰だろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have Hikari to thank for that, since
she's the one who teleported us here.

fields.EN:
If she hadn't, who knows where we'd
be right now...
fields.JP:
あの時離脱できなかったら、
僕たちは今頃……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she hadn't, who knows where we'd
be right now...

fields.EN:
The thought of it makes my hair
stand.
fields.JP:
ううっ、考えただけで
おいらも震えが止んねぇぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The thought of it makes my hair
stand.

fields.EN:
(It's true. No doubt my sisters would have
slaughtered everyone but Alice, who they
needed. Such is the life of Genocide Pink.)
fields.JP:
（あのままだったら、姉さんたちが、
　きっと目的のアリス以外を殺してた。
　でも、それが処刑台少女の役目だから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true. No doubt my sisters would have
slaughtered everyone but Alice, who they
needed. Such is the life of Massacre Pink.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(At least, that's what they told me.
That was the only outcome.)
fields.JP:
（ずっと、そうするのが当たり前だって、
　姉さんたちからも言われてたのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At least, that's what they told me.
That was the only outcome.)

fields.EN: (But now, I'm restless. I feel kinda awkward.)
fields.JP:
（今は妙に、落ち着かないっていうか、
　すごく気まずい……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But now, I'm restless. I feel kinda awkward.)

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan and Nemu-chan, we believe you.
But what we saw makes it a bit harder
to take at face value.
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんやネムちゃんの言うことを
信じちゃいるんだけどさー、
アレを目の当たりにしたら、さすがにねー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy and Sleepy, we believe you.
But what we saw makes it a bit harder
to take at face value.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Maybe if you gave us your word that you
wouldn't turn, it would help.
fields.JP:
君が、僕たちに危害を加えないという
保証をしてくれるとありがたいのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe if you gave us your word that you
wouldn't turn, it would help.

fields.JP:
……んーっ、んーっ。
シラは……ボクが、保証する……

fields.EN:
Rapunzel vouches for her too!
Shira's our friend!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもほしょーするよ！
シラは、なかまだもんねっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Me too! I vouch too! Pi's a good one!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Hey, no need to get so touchy.
fields.JP: ちょ、き、気安くくっつかないでよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, no need to get so touchy.

fields.EN:
Huh, you don't like it?
Rapunzel likes hugging Shira tight~!
fields.JP:
え、いやなの？
ラプンツェルは、シラにぎゅーっとするの
すきだよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, does that bother you? But I wuv hugs!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: I don't hate it... It's just embarrassing.
fields.JP:
い、嫌っていうか……そういうの、
慣れてないから、恥ずかしいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't hate it... It's just embarrassing.

fields.EN: Then you won't mind hugs, right? *huuuug*!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、してもいいってことだよね？
ぎゅ～～っ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then you won't mind hugs, right? *huuuug*!

fields.EN: (Ah, my chest is tingling again. No one has ever trusted Hiaburibashira and protected her like this before.)
fields.JP:
（ああ、また胸がむずむずするっ。
　こんな風に火あぶり柱のことを信用して、
　守ってくれる人は初めてだよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. There goes my heart again. It tickles.
Nobody's ever shown me trust and kindness
like this before.)

fields.EN: Well, if these two are this friendly with you, I guess there's really no problem.
fields.JP:
……まぁ、この２人がこんだけ懐いてんなら、
ほんとになんも問題ないかー
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I'll take their word for it. For now.

fields.EN:
Agreed. Let's fill each other in on what
we've missed then get some rest.
fields.JP:
僕も同感だよ。
それじゃあ、ひとまず休憩しつつ、
お互いに今の状況を話し合おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agreed. Let's fill each other in on what
we've missed then get some rest.

fields.EN: Ah. I see, I see. That makes sense.
fields.JP:
へー、なるほどなるほど。
それですっかり打ち解けたんだー
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah. I see, I see. That makes sense.

fields.EN: Yeah. Nemu-Nemu told me Shira's a good girl!
fields.JP:
うんっ、ねむねむが、シラは
いいこだよっておしえてくれたの！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Sleepy told me Pi's a good girl!
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Hmm. A good girl? You don't even know me.
fields.JP:
……む～、いい子とか、
勝手に決めつけないでよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmm. A good girl? You don't even know me.

fields.EN:
(Not that I mind. I quite like having that
reputation over being a murderer.)
fields.JP:
（でも、怖いとか言われるより、
　ずっと嬉しい……かも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that I mind. I quite like having that
reputation over being a murderer.)

fields.EN:
There's still a lot we don't know about
Genocide Pink or that big Jail.
fields.JP:
僕たちは、処刑台少女やあの巨大すぎる
監獄塔について、あまりにも
知らないことが多い
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's still a lot we don't know about
Massacre Pink or that big Jail.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Mind filling in the blanks for us?
fields.JP:
君の知っている情報を、
教えてはくれないだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Mind filling in the blanks for us?

fields.EN:
What?! You expect me to divulge info to
an enemy?
fields.JP:
は、はぁ？　そんなこと、
敵にペラペラ話すわけないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! You expect me to divulge info to
an enemy?

fields.EN: Hahaha. Well, that's to be expected.
fields.JP: はははっ、まぁ、そりゃそうかー
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. Well, that's to be expected.

fields.EN: Wait. But Shira's not our enemy.
fields.JP: えーっ、シラはてきなんかじゃないよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. But Pi's not our enemy.

fields.EN: Ugh. We're going in circles here.
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. We're going in circles here.

fields.EN:
Genocide Pink was founded by my Papa.
I don't know much else about it.
fields.JP:
……処刑台少女は、『パパ』が作った
組織だけど、詳しいことは知らない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Massacre Pink was founded by my Papa.
I don't know much else about it.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
What I do know is Genocide Pink was
born for one purpose. To kill.
fields.JP:
わかってるのは、処刑台少女たちは、
ただ『人を殺す』ためだけに
生まれた存在ってことだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I do know is Massacre Pink was
born for one purpose. To kill.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
How many of you are there? What can
you tell us about them?
fields.JP:
処刑台少女は、全部で何人いるんだい？
それぞれの、特徴は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many of you are there? What can
you tell us about them?

fields.EN:
I said I can't divulge that information.
Pretend I'm talking to myself here.
fields.JP:
敵には話さないって言ったでしょ。
これはただの独り言よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said I can't divulge that information.
Pretend I'm talking to myself here.

fields.EN:
Guillotine-neesan, Iron Maiden... Mei-neesan,
and Kubitsuridai... Kubitsuri-neesan...
fields.JP:
『ギロチン姉さん』、
『アイアン・メイデン…メイ姉さん』、
『首吊り台…首吊り姉さん』……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Guillotine, Iron Maiden or Sister Mei,
and Gallows... Sister Gallows.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san | Source-gated Kubitsuridai/Kubitsuri-neesan identity restoration.

fields.EN:
That leaves me, the youngest, Hiaburibashira.
We all work under Papa's command.
fields.JP:
そして末娘の『火あぶり柱』。
『パパ』のために、火あぶり柱たちは働いてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
That leaves me, the youngest, Pyre.
We all work under Papa's command.

fields.EN:
My sisters are elites, so they don't flinch
before killing someone. I'm the only
useless one.
fields.JP:
姉さんたちは優秀だから、
人間を殺すのを少しも躊躇わない……
火あぶり柱だけが役立たずだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
My sisters are elites, so they don't flinch
before killing someone. I'm the only
useless one.

fields.JP: シラは、うまれてから、ずっとそうだったの？

fields.EN:
Don't ask me, I'm just talking to myself!
Well, whatever...
fields.JP:
だから、独り言だってば…！
って、ま、まぁ、いいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't ask me, I'm just talking to myself!
Well, whatever...

fields.EN:
I don't know much about my childhood.
Only some memories from a few years ago.
fields.JP:
小さい頃のことは何も知らない。
火あぶり柱には、
数年前からの記憶しかないから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know much about my childhood.
Only some memories from a few years ago.

fields.EN: Really? No memory at all, Shira?
fields.JP:
そーなんだ。
シラって、きおくそーしつなの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? No memory at all, Pi?

fields.EN:
Who cares? I have everything I need up
here.
fields.JP:
ど、どうでもいいわよ、そんなこと。
今必要な事は、ちゃんと覚えてるもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who cares? I have everything I need up
here.

fields.EN:
Hm. Then, what can you tell us about the
big Jail tower, Shira?
fields.JP:
……ん。シラは、
あの巨大な監獄塔が何か、知ってる…？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Then, what can you tell us about the
big Jail tower, Pi?

fields.EN:
That is the Devouring Armada Tower.
All I know is that it's mobile.
fields.JP:
あのでっかいやつは、『悪食の監隊塔』よ。
知っているのは、アレが
『動く監獄塔』だってことだけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is the Devouring Armada Tower.
All I know is that it's mobile.

fields.EN:
I don't know anything else! Again, just
talking to myself here!
fields.JP:
あ、後は本当に知らない！
…って、これも独り言だけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know anything else! Again, just
talking to myself here!

fields.EN:
(Aw. I can't help but answer Rapu and
Nemuri when they make eyes at me. This
isn't good.)
fields.JP:
（ううー、ラプと眠りから聞かれると、
　つい話し過ぎちゃう……いけないなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Aw. I can't help but answer Rappy and
Sleepy when they make eyes at me. This
isn't good.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: I see. Thanks for giving us the scoop.
fields.JP: なるほど、貴重な情報提供、感謝するよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Thanks for giving us the scoop.

fields.EN: Seriously, Shira-chan, you're such an open book.
fields.JP:
いやあほんと、シラちゃんって
わかりやすい子なのねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously Pi. You're an open book.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Regardless, we need to devise a plan to
find the rest of the crew and get out
of here.
fields.JP:
ともかく、今僕たちが優先すべきことは、
仲間を集めてここから脱出することだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, we need to devise a plan to
find the rest of the crew and get out
of here.

fields.EN:
I agree, that would be best. I'm itching to
reunite with Jack and the others!
fields.JP:
そーね、それはあたちも賛成。
ジャッくんたちと早く合流したーい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree, that would be best. I'm itching to
reunite with Jack and the others!

fields.EN: What should Rapunzel and the others do?
fields.JP: ラプンツェルたちは、どーしたらいいの？
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Let's check out the rest of this area.
That way we can find nearby landmarks,
or even run into one of our friends.
fields.JP:
まずは周囲の探索かな。
仲間を探しつつ、このあたりが
どうなっているか、調べようと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's check out the rest of this area.
That way we can find nearby landmarks,
or even run into one of our friends.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime, Rapunzel, and Shira.
Would you three be willing to lead
this brief expedition?
fields.JP:
眠り姫やラプンツェル、
そしてシラにも、探索の協力を
お願いしてもいいだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty, Rapunzel, and Pi.
Would you three be willing to lead
this brief expedition?
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Okay~! Rapunzel will explore too,
with Nemu-Nemu and Shira!
fields.JP:
いいよー！　ねむねむとシラといっしょに、
ラプンツェルもたんさくするー！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: ……っ、なんで火あぶり柱までっ

……探索で、シラも家族と再会……
出来たらいいね……

fields.EN:
Do you even know what that entails?
It's all sunshine and rainbows with you
people.
fields.JP:
それ、どういう意味か分かって言ってる？
まったく、なんてお花畑な考えなんだか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you even know what that entails?
It's all sunshine and rainbows with you
people.

fields.EN:
But you're right. If you insist, I can tag
along.
fields.JP:
でも、そうね……どうしてもって言うなら、
協力してやらないことも無いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you're right. If you insist, I can tag
along.

fields.EN: Yay. Can't wait to adventure with you, Shira!
fields.JP:
やった、じゃあ、たんさくで
シラもいっしょだねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Yay. Can't wait to adventure with you, Pi!

fields.EN:
I-I'm only doing it 'cuz you asked.
Don't get it twisted.
fields.JP:
な、成り行きでやるだけだから、
かんちがいしないでよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm only doing it 'cuz you asked.
Don't get it twisted.

fields.EN:
...They had no trouble handling the
contaminated beings, one after another.
fields.JP: ……あいつら、汚染動物を次々倒してたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...They had no trouble handling the
contaminated beings, one after another.

fields.EN: Yeah... They might prove useful yet!
fields.JP:
うん……もしかしたら、
あいつら、使えるかも！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah... They might prove useful yet!

fields.EN: Hey Shira, what's your favorite food?
fields.JP:
ねー、シラは、
すきなたべものとか、あるー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Pi, what's your favorite food?

fields.EN: ...I don't know. Never thought about it.
fields.JP:
……特にないわ。
そんなこと、今まで考えもしなかったし
fields.LOCALIZED: ...I don't know. Never thought about it.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel wants yummy food!
Marchens and stuff! They're super yummy!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはねー、おいしいごはん！
メルヒェンとか！　すごくおいしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But food's so yummy! Marchens too!
They're the yummiest.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Wait, Rapu. You're telling me you eat
those things?
fields.JP:
ラ、ラプって、
あんなのを好んで食べてたの…？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, Rappy. You're telling me you eat
those things?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
And then, walls!
Guree said they were tasty too!
fields.JP:
あとはねー、かべ！
ぐれーもおいしいっていってた！
fields.LOCALIZED: And the wall! Gretty said it was yummy too!
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Wall?! How come you're not suffering
a tummy ache from eating all that junk?
fields.JP:
か、壁！？
そんな変なのばかり食べて、
よくお腹壊さないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wall?! How come you're not suffering
a tummy ache from eating all that junk?

fields.EN:
Mm... She means Jail wall... Rapu never
gets tummy ache.
fields.JP:
……ん。それは、ジェイルの壁。
らぷは、お腹壊したこと、ない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm... She means Jail wall... Rappy never
gets tummy ache.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: うんっ！　ぜんぜんへーき！

fields.EN:
(Rapu's a wild card, but I guess that's
just her charm.)
fields.JP:
（ラプって、なんだか野生児っぽい
　感じがしたけど、実際にそうなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rappy's a wild card, but I guess that's
just her charm.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
They told us not to let our guards down,
so try not to make yourself sick.
Don't say I never warned you.
fields.JP:
でもね、油断大敵って言うし、
あんまり変なのを食べ過ぎて、
お腹壊しても知らないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They told us not to let our guards down,
so try not to make yourself sick.
Don't say I never warned you.

fields.EN: Huh, Shira, are you worried about Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
えっ、シラ、ラプンツェルを、
しんぱいしてくれてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh Pi, are you worried about me?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
……うん、うん……
伝わってくる……

fields.EN:
I'm not worried! Pipe down, Nemuri.
This isn't up for debate.
fields.JP:
べ、別に心配なんてしてないわ！
眠りまで、都合よく解釈しないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not worried! Pipe down, Sleepy.
This isn't up for debate.

fields.EN:
Hehehe, Shira, you're so nice~!
Rapunzel wants to make babies with Shira!
fields.JP:
えへへ、シラ、やさしいねー！
