ラプンツェル、シラとこどもつくりたい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Teehee. Pi, you're so nice! I wanna make
babies with Pi!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: What?! Babies?! Are you out of your mind?
fields.JP:
はっ！？　こ、こどもって！？
あんた、何かかんちがいしてない？
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! Babies?! Are you out of your mind?

fields.EN: Nope, I'm not. Even if I wanted to, I can't!
fields.JP:
してないよー、でも、
ほしくても、なかなかできないのー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Nope, I'm not. Even if I wanted to, I can't!

fields.EN: (What in the world is she talking about?)
fields.JP: （ど、どういう意味で言ってんの！？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What in the world is she talking about?)

fields.EN:
...Rapu's Blood Libido. Makes her want
babies.
fields.JP:
……これは、らぷの血式リビドー。
気に入った人と、子供、欲しくなる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Rappy's Blood Libido. Makes her want
babies.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: How about you, Shira? You want any kids?
fields.JP:
ねー、シラは？
こどもほしくならないの？
fields.LOCALIZED: How about you, Pi? You want any kids?

fields.EN: No! And stop touching me all the time!
fields.JP:
な、ないわよ、そんなの！
あと、あんまり火あぶり柱にベタベタしないで
fields.LOCALIZED: No! And stop touching me all the time!

fields.EN:
Huh... Shira didn't like it?
Is it bad if Rapunzel clings to you?
fields.JP:
え……シラはいやだった？
ラプンツェルがくっついたら、だめ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You don't like it, Pi? Do you not
want me to hold onto you?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: No, I don't! It bothers me!
fields.JP:
こ、困るのよ、そういうの！
迷惑！
fields.LOCALIZED: No, I don't! It bothers me!

fields.EN: Uu~... Shira, do you hate Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
う～、……シラは、ラプンツェルのこと、
きらい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. You don't like me, Pi?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
(Oh no. I've said too much, but I can't
tell her the truth either.)
fields.JP:
（あっ、どうしよう、言い過ぎちゃった！
　でも、本当の気持ちなんて言えないし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no. I've said too much, but I can't
tell her the truth either.)

fields.EN:
(I don't hate Rapu. But I don't know how
to process all the attention she gives me.)
fields.JP:
（ラプたちは嫌じゃない…けど、あまり
　構われても、どう反応していいか
　わからないんだもん……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't hate Rappy. But I don't know how
to process all the attention she gives me.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
……らぷ。シラはきっと、
こういうのに慣れてないだけ……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
...If she hated you, she wouldn't be here...
So...let it go.
fields.JP:
……らぷを嫌ってたら、
こうやって一緒にいたりしない……
だから、きっと…だいじょうぶ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...If she hated you, she wouldn't be here...
So...let it go.

fields.EN:
(Ugh. Nemuri's normally zonked out.
All of a sudden she's sharp.)
fields.JP:
（うっ、眠りってぼーっとしてるくせに、
　こういう時はするどいわね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. Sleepy's normally zonked out.
All of a sudden she's sharp.)

fields.JP:
ち、違うわ。
これは、そういうのじゃないから！

fields.EN:
Rapu, you're my apprentice.
That means obey me!
fields.JP:
ラプは火あぶり柱の下僕なんだから…
火あぶり柱のいうことを聞いてればいいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, you're my apprentice.
That means obey me!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Whaaat? Rapunzel likes Shira,
but she doesn't wanna be your servant~!
fields.JP:
えーっ、でもラプンツェルは
シラのことすきだけど、
げぼくとか、いやだよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaaaat? I sure like you Pi, but I don't
wanna be your apprentice!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: But I can be your friend!
fields.JP: でもね、ともだちならいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: But I can be your friend!

fields.EN:
(Argh. Why does it make me so happy
to hear her say that?!)
fields.JP:
（あーもうっ、友達なんて言われて、
　なんで嬉しくなっちゃうのよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Argh. Why does it make me so happy
to hear her say that?!)

fields.EN: (No... No! I absolutely can't be friends with the enemy! My sisters will scold me!)
fields.JP:
（ダメ…ダメだってば！
　敵と友達とか、そんなの絶対ダメっ！
　姉さんたちに叱られる！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No. No no no! I can't befriend the enemy!
My sisters are gonna kill me!)

fields.JP: （…ううっ、でも、勝手に顔が緩んじゃうぅ）
シラ……ともだちだと、だめなの？

fields.EN:
Ugh, fine. If that's what it takes, then
sure. But you're a friend first, and my
apprentice second!
fields.JP:
し、仕方ないわね。
そこまでなって欲しいならいいわ。
ただし、友達のあとは、下僕だからねっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, fine. If that's what it takes, then
sure. But you're a friend first, and my
apprentice second!

fields.JP: わーい、ともだち、ともだちっ！

fields.EN: Yup yup...! You two are like sisters.
fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ……！
２人とも、姉妹…みたい……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup yup...! You two are like sisters.

fields.EN:
Huh, sisters?
Then Rapunzel's the big sister!
fields.JP:
えっ、しまい？
じゃあ、ラプンツェルがおねえさんだねっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What? Sister? I wanna be the older one!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Ha! What gives you the right? Shouldn't
I obviously be the older sister?
fields.JP:
はぁ？　なんでそうなるわけ？
どう考えても火あぶり柱の方が姉でしょっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha! What gives you the right? Shouldn't
I obviously be the older sister?

fields.EN:
Nooo! It's Rapunzel!
Shira said she's the little sister!
fields.JP:
ちがうよー！　ラプンツェルだよっ
シラはいもうとだっていってたし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
NO! I'm the older sister. You said you're
the youngest!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Well sure, but only to my actual sisters.
To you, I'm older.
fields.JP:
そりゃ、姉さんたちの妹だけど、
ラプが相手なら火あぶり柱が姉だもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well sure, but only to my actual sisters.
To you, I'm older.

fields.JP:
ぶーぶー！
なっとくいかなーい
それはこっちのセリフよ

……うん、うん……っ！
２人とも、とっても、仲良し……

fields.EN: Okay Nemuri, let's not get ahead of ourselves.
fields.JP:
もう、眠りってばまた……
そ、そんなんじゃないってば
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay Sleepy, let's not get ahead of ourselves.

fields.EN:
We can settle who's older and who's
younger while we walk. Keep up, Rapu.
fields.JP:
まぁ、どっちが姉らしいかは、
いずれ決着付けましょ。
それじゃ、探索を続けるわよ、ラプ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can settle who's older and who's
younger while we walk. Keep up, Rappy.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Hey Nemu-Nemu, Shira! There's a room over here.
fields.JP:
ねー、ねむねむ、シラー！
こっち、へやみたいなのがあるよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Sleepy, Pi! There's a room over here.
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Over there. I think I've seen it before.
What was it again?
fields.JP:
あそこにあるやつ、
まえにみたことあるような
きがするけど、なんだっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Over there. I think I've seen it before.
What was it again?

fields.EN:
Mm... Is that...a core?
So...this is Jail...
fields.JP:
……ん。これは……核？
やっぱり、ここは……ジェイル……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm... Is that...a core?
So...this is Jail...

fields.EN: Oh, I see. This is the Jail's core!
fields.JP: あ、そっか、これ、ジェイルのコアなんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see. This is the Jail's core!

fields.EN:
Yup yup... Destroy this...to beat the
Nightmare...
fields.JP:
……うん、うんっ……
これを壊せば、あの時の
ナイトメアも、倒せる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup yup... Destroy this...to beat the
Nightmare...

fields.EN: What? That's―! Oh, so it's true.
fields.JP:
え、ここって……っ！
あっ、やっぱりそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED: What? That's―! Oh, so it's true.

fields.EN: I just remembered. I've been here before.
fields.JP:
今、思い出した。
火あぶり柱は、前に一度だけ
ここに来たことある……
fields.LOCALIZED: I just remembered. I've been here before.

fields.EN: (Papa said he'd give Hiaburibashira an area of the Jail once Hiaburibashira became full-fledged. This is the place we came with Papa and the others back then!)
fields.JP:
（パパが……火あぶり柱が一人前になったら、
　ジェイルのエリアをくれるって。
　ここは、あの時パパたちと来た場所だ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Long ago... Papa told me he'd give my own
corner of the Jail when I was ready. He took
me and my sisters here.)

fields.EN: I...came here once. With my papa and sisters.
fields.JP:
前に……一度だけ、パパたちと一緒に
用があってこの場所に来たことがあったの
fields.LOCALIZED: I...came here once. With my papa and sisters.

fields.EN: Oh really? What brought you here?
fields.JP:
え、そうなんだー
ここでなにをしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh really? What brought you here?

fields.EN:
(I believe Papa named me "warden" of
this place.)
fields.JP:
（……確かあの時、パパは火あぶり柱を、
　『管理者』にしたとか言ってたよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I believe Papa named me "warden" of
this place.)

fields.EN:
(But I don't know what that means.
Would I find out if I touch the core?)
fields.JP:
（『管理者』っていうのが何なのか、
　火あぶり柱にはよくわからないけど…
　核に触れたら分かるのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I don't know what that means.
Would I find out if I touch the core?)

fields.EN: Shira! Don't touch core...! It has guardian...
fields.JP:
……シラ！　核に触ったら、ダメ……！
核を守ってる、番人が……
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi! Don't touch core...! It has guardian...

fields.EN: I'll be fine. I'm not afraid of any guardian.
fields.JP: 大丈夫よ、番人くらい大したことないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be fine. I'm not afraid of any guardian.

fields.JP:
（それに、火あぶり柱は
　パパに登録してもらったんだもの）

fields.EN: Oh! There's the guardian! Should we beat it?
fields.JP:
あっ、ばんにん、でた！
やっつける？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! There's the guardian! Should we beat it?

fields.EN:
Hey! You think you're tough enough to
keep me out?
fields.JP:
ちょっと！　番人のくせに
火あぶり柱とやり合うつもり？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! You think you're tough enough to
keep me out?

fields.EN:
Come on, brat. If it's a scrap you want,
then you're in the right place!
fields.JP:
生意気なやつ……
そっちがその気なら、相手をしてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, brat. If it's a scrap you want,
then you're in the right place!

fields.JP: やったー！　ばんにんたおしたー！

fields.EN:
Hmph. It's just a guardian. Now it knows
to stay out of my way.
fields.JP:
ふん……たかが番人のくせに、
火あぶり柱たちのじゃまをするのが悪いのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. It's just a guardian. Now it knows
to stay out of my way.

fields.EN: Yup yup...! Time for the core...
fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ……！
あとは、核を破壊すれば……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup yup...! Time for the core...

fields.EN:
We can take down a Nightmare! Hurrah!
Let's destroy the core!
fields.JP:
ナイトメアもたおせるね！
よーし、コアもこわしちゃおー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can take down a Nightmare! Hurrah!
Let's destroy the core!

fields.EN:
Oh Rapu, wait! You don't have to destroy
it!
fields.JP:
あっ、ラプ、ちょっと待って！
壊さなくてもいいからっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh Rappy, wait! You don't have to destroy
it!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Mmm...mmm... We need to break it...
Or Nightmare will come back.
fields.JP:
……んー、んーっ……
またナイトメアが出た時のために、
核、壊さないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...mmm... We need to break it...
Or Nightmare will come back.

fields.EN:
Well, I can stop the Nightmare even without
breaking the core.
fields.JP:
核を壊さなくたって、火あぶり柱なら
ナイトメアを止められるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I can stop the Nightmare even without
breaking the core.

fields.JP:
ええっ、そーなの？
なんでなんでー？

fields.EN: Papa told me that once Hiaburibashira became fully fledged, he'd officially give me this Jail area.
fields.JP:
火あぶり柱が一人前になったら、
その時はパパから、このジェイルエリアを
正式にもらえるって言われてたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Papa put me in charge of this area of
the Jail once I'm ready.

fields.EN: Remember? Hiaburibashira said earlier that she'd been here before on some business.
fields.JP:
さっき、火あぶり柱は、前に用があって
ここに来たって言ったでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Remember what I told you earlier?

fields.EN:
That's when Papa registered me as Warden
of this area and gave me management rights.
fields.JP:
その時に火あぶり柱は、
ここで『管理者』の登録をすませて、
『管理けん』だけをパパからもらったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's when Papa registered me as Warden
of this area and gave me management rights.

fields.EN:
(Part of me feels like I came here once
before that too...but maybe I'm imagining
that.)
fields.JP:
（それよりも昔に、ここに来たような
　感じがあるんだけど……
　そっちはたぶん気のせいだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Part of me feels like I came here once
before that too...but maybe I'm imagining
that.)

fields.EN:
Shira, what are management rights? Is that
a good thing?
fields.JP:
シラ、『かんりけん』って、なーに？
それをもってると、いいことあるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pi, what are management rights? Is that
a good thing?

fields.EN: Having management rights is useful in all sorts of ways. You know the core and Nightmare are one and the same, and their lives are directly linked, right?
fields.JP:
『管理けん』を持ってると、色々とべんりなの。
そもそも、核とナイトメアは一心同体。
直接命がつながってるのは知ってるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you asked about management rights.
Nightmares and cores are two halves of the
same coin, right?

fields.EN: Mm... With the core, Nightmares no die...
fields.JP:
……ん。ジェイルの核を壊さない限り、
ナイトメアは、絶対に死なない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... With the core, Nightmares no die...

fields.EN:
It means that if I command this core, then
I can also command the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
だから、火あぶり柱が核に命令すれば、
このジェイルの核とつながっている、
ナイトメアの行動をせいぎょできるってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It means that if I command this core, then
I can also command the Nightmare.

fields.EN: Oh! Do the Marchens obey you too, Shira?
fields.JP:
へー、じゃあ、メルヒェンも
シラのめいれいをきくのかなー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! Do the Marchens obey you too, Pi?

fields.EN:
If only. Life would be so much easier.
But Marchens are wild animals. They
act on instinct. Can't do much about that.
fields.JP:
それができたらもっと楽なんだけど、
メルヒェンはしょせん動物みたいなものだからね。
おそってくるやつはおそってくるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only. Life would be so much easier.
But Marchens are wild animals. They
act on instinct. Can't do much about that.

fields.EN:
Anyway, it means Nightmares won't give
us any trouble in this area. Impressive, huh?
fields.JP:
とにかく、ここでナイトメアを止めてしまえば、
わざわざ戦わなくてもいいってわけよ
どう？　すごいでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, it means Nightmares won't give
us any trouble in this area. Impressive, huh?

fields.EN: Wow Shira! Hurry, hurry! Show us!
fields.JP:
シラ、すごーい！
やって、はやくやってみせてー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow Pi! Hurry, hurry! Show us!

fields.JP: いいわよ、特別にみせてあげるから
アアアアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
Hmm... Jail...screaming. Just like...when we
broke the core.
fields.JP:
……ん。ジェイルが…叫んでる。
これは、核を壊したときと同じ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm... Jail...screaming. Just like...when we
broke the core.

fields.EN:
Whoa! Incredible! Did that work on the
Nightmare?
fields.JP:
わーっ、すごいすごい！
これでナイトメアがうごかなくなったのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa! Incredible! Did that work on the
Nightmare?

fields.EN:
That was my first attempt, but I have a
hunch it went through. I hope.
fields.JP:
じっさいに試したのは初めてだけど、
命令は通った感じだし、多分ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was my first attempt, but I have a
hunch it went through. I hope.

fields.JP:
……シラ。管理者って…シラ自身が、
管理者ナイトメアになること…？

fields.EN:
No. From what Papa and my sisters say,
the warden doesn't equal the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
違うわよ、パパや姉さんたちが言うには、
そもそも『管理者＝ナイトメア』じゃないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. From what Papa and my sisters say,
the warden doesn't equal the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
That being said, one must use the core in
order to register the warden. That's how
it worked for Genocide Pink.
fields.JP:
核が決めた生物が『管理者』になるから、
そこをバグらせる…？　ことで、
処刑台少女が『管理者』になれるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That being said, one must use the core in
order to register the warden. That's how
it worked for Massacre Pink.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(But I never understood Papa's explanation.
I hope I'm saying it right.)
fields.JP:
（パパたちの話はむずかしくて、聞いても
　意味がよくわかんなかったけどね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I never understood Papa's explanation.
I hope I'm saying it right.)

fields.EN:
Wow. Being a warden sounds so cool!
Does that mean you're invincible, Shira?
You won't die like the Nightmares?
fields.JP:
かんりしゃってすごいんだねー！
じゃあ、シラたちって、むてきなの？
ナイトメアみたいに、しなない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. Being a warden sounds so cool!
Does that mean you're invincible, Pyre?
You won't die like the Nightmares?

fields.EN:
No. Unlike the Nightmares, we are not
given nutrients from the Jail, so we're
still vulnerable.
fields.JP:
火あぶり柱たちは、ナイトメアと違って
ジェイルから直接栄養補給はしてないから、
さすがに無敵ってわけじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Unlike the Nightmares, we are not
given nutrients from the Jail, so we're
still vulnerable.

fields.EN:
Whaa~... It's too hard for Rapunzel to understand,
but Shira's amazing!
fields.JP:
ふえぇ～～、むずかしくて
ラプンツェルにはよくわかんないけど、
シラってすごいんだー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaaa. That doesn't make sense. Still
cool though!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
……うん、うんっ……
予想外のことだらけ……

fields.EN:
Hehe. Sounds like you two are easily
impressed. Time to get a move-on.
fields.JP:
ふふん、これくらいでおどろくなんて、
２人とも大したことないわね。
さあ、先に進むわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Sounds like you two are easily
impressed. Time to get a move-on.

fields.EN:
Hey! There's a shiny ball over there!
Can we eat it?
fields.JP:
ねー、あっちにぴかぴかしたたまがあるよ！
これって、たべられるやつかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! There's a shiny ball over there!
Can we eat it?

fields.JP:
……おおきい。
それに、渦がぐるぐると……

fields.EN: Staring at it makes me dizzy!
fields.JP:
ずーっとみてると、
めがまわっちゃいそうだね～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Staring at it makes me dizzy!

fields.JP:
たま……？
あっ、これっ、この球体はっ！

fields.EN: Yay! With this, I can return to my sisters!
fields.JP:
やった！　これさえあれば、
姉さんたちのところにかえれる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yay! With this, I can return to my sisters!

fields.JP:
……ん。もしかして……
ここから、移動…できるの……？

fields.EN:
Exactly. This orb allows us to warp between
towers.
fields.JP:
そのもしかして、よ。
これはね、別の監獄塔に飛ぶそうちなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. This orb allows us to warp between
towers.

fields.EN:
Yup yup. I remember now. It's all coming
back to me!
fields.JP:
うんうん、思い出した。
やっぱり、あの時と同じやつだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup yup. I remember now. It's all coming
back to me!

fields.EN: We used this to teleport around the Jail.
fields.JP:
火あぶり柱たちも、前にこの場所へ来た時に
これをつかって移動したのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: We used this to teleport around the Jail.

fields.EN: Warp device? Kinda like Hikari's powers?
fields.JP:
いどーそーち？
ひかりんのてれぽーとみたいに
どこかにとべるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Warp device? Kinda like Hikari's powers?

fields.EN:
Yeah! Hahaha. Now we can finally escape
this place!
fields.JP:
そうよ！　あははっ、やっとこの場所から
脱出する方法が分かったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! Hahaha. Now we can finally escape
this place!

fields.EN:
(I'm outta here! With this orb, I'll get back
to my sisters and Papa!)
fields.JP:
（もう、火あぶり柱は迷子なんかじゃない！
　このそうちさえあれば、
　パパや姉さんたちにも会えるんだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm outta here! With this orb, I'll get back
to my sisters and Papa!)

fields.EN:
(But...I really messed up. Would they even
welcome me back?)
fields.JP:
（…でも、こんなヘマをした火あぶり柱を、
　パパたちはやさしく受け入れて
　くれるのかな…）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But...I really messed up. Would they even
welcome me back?)

fields.EN:
(Oogh. They'll probably scold me first...
If my sisters are on the other side of this
orb, they'll tell me to kill these girls.)
fields.JP:
（ううっ、今までで一番叱られそう…
　そもそも、姉さんたちに再会したら、
　こいつらを殺せって言われるよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oogh. They'll probably scold me first...
If my sisters are on the other side of this
orb, they'll tell me to kill these girls.)

fields.EN:
(But I don't wanna. I do want to see my
family, but it could come at a great cost.)
fields.JP:
（やだな…パパや姉さんたちには
　会いたいけど、そのことを考えたら
　すごく憂鬱になる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I don't wanna. I do want to see my
family, but it could come at a great cost.)

fields.EN:
Yeah. You were all smiles a second ago.
Does your tummy hurt?
fields.JP:
さっきまで、にこにこしてたのにねー？
きゅーにおなか、いたくなった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. You were all smiles a second ago.
Does your tummy hurt?

fields.JP: べ、別になんでもな……あ……っ

fields.EN:
Huh? What the―?!
Shira's suit's making weird noises!
fields.JP:
えっ、えっ、なになにー？
シラのすーつからへんなおとがしたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What the―?!
Pi's suit's making weird noises!

fields.JP:
……あっ……きゃあっ！？
これって、まさか……！

fields.EN:
Aw, I knew it... What do I do?!
What do I DO?!
fields.JP:
あぅ……やっぱりそうだ……
ど、どうしよう、どうしよう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, I knew it... What do I do?!
What do I DO?!

fields.EN:
Look at Shira! Her outfit's different!
What's going on?!
fields.JP:
えーっ、シラのみためがかわっちゃった！
なになに、どうしちゃったのー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at Pi! Her outfit's different!
What's going on?!

fields.EN:
My Gore Suit is starting to wear off.
Which means I can't fight or purify
like I did earlier... *sniff*
fields.JP:
『ゴアスーツ』の効果が切れちゃったの…
もう、今までみたいに戦えないし、
穢れだって浄化できないよぉ……ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My Gore Suit is starting to wear off.
Which means I can't fight or purify
like I did earlier... *sniff*

fields.EN:
I really am as useless as they say...
Wah... *sniff*
fields.JP:
これじゃ、火あぶり柱は、
ほんとの役立たずになっちゃったよぉ……
ううっ、ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I really am as useless as they say...
Wah... *sniff*

fields.EN:
Wait. All this time...you were...
Genocide Mode?
fields.JP:
これって…もしかして……
いままでが……ジェノサイドモードだった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. All this time...you were...
Massacre Mode?

fields.JP: じゃあ、こっちがほんとのシラってこと？

fields.EN:
I don't know. All I know is I'm stuck like
this unless I can replenish "something."
fields.JP:
し、知らない……わかってるのは、
一度こうなったら『何か』をほきゅうするまで
ずっとこのままってことだけだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know. All I know is I'm stuck like
this unless I can replenish "something."

fields.EN:
Papa's the only one who can replenish
the Gore Suit. I don't know what else to
do.
fields.JP:
『ゴアスーツ』のほきゅう作業は、
パパにしかできないことだから……
どうしたらいいか、わかんないっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Papa's the only one who can replenish
the Gore Suit. I don't know what else to
do.

fields.EN: So should we look for your papa?
fields.JP: じゃあ、シラのパパにあいにいく？
fields.LOCALIZED: So should we look for your papa?

fields.EN: (I'm still scared to see them. But now that it's come to this, I have to steel myself and reunite with my older sisters...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり、会うのは怖い。
　でも、こうなった以上は覚悟を決めて、
　姉さんたちと合流しなくちゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm scared to see him. But in this state,
I might not have a choice.)

fields.EN:
(Rapu and Nemuri are my friends―I mean,
apprentices. Maybe I can convince my sisters
to grant me a special pardon...or not.)
fields.JP:
（ラプも眠りも大切な友達──火あぶり柱の
　下僕だから。姉さんたちに言ったら、
　特別に見逃してくれない……かな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rappy and Sleepy are my friends―I mean,
apprentices. Maybe I can convince my sisters
to grant me a special pardon...or not.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(I know they'd never do that, not in a
million years. Just like last time―)
fields.JP:
（でも、あのパパやギロチン姉さんたちが、
　そんなの許してくれる訳ないよね……
　きっと、あの時みたいに──）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know they'd never do that, not in a
million years. Just like last time―)

fields.JP:
……っ、じゃ、じゃあ、
球の中に……入る……から

fields.EN:
Okay! You know Shira, you seem pretty sad
for someone who's gonna see their family.
fields.JP:
うん！　でも、かぞくにあえるのに、
シラはぜんぜんげんき、ないね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! You know Pi, you seem pretty sad
for someone who's gonna see their family.

fields.EN:
(I don't want either of them to die, but I
don't know what else to do.)
fields.JP:
（２人を死なせたくない。
　でも、他にどうしたらいいか……
　火あぶり柱にはわかんないよぉ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want either of them to die, but I
don't know what else to do.)

fields.EN:
(If only the heavens could open me up to
take me out of this situation... Please!)
fields.JP:
（ここから出るまでに、素敵な神様が現れて、
　火あぶり柱の苦しみを取り除いてください。
　……お願いだから！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If only the heavens could open me up to
take me out of this situation... Please!)

fields.EN:
...Those girls moved somewhere through
the orb.
fields.JP:
……あいつら、あの光る球で、
どこかに移動するみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Those girls moved somewhere through
the orb.

fields.EN:
That girl with the big weapon didn't want
to enter though.
fields.JP:
あのゴツイ武器のヤツ、
あまり乗り気じゃない感じだったけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
That girl with the big weapon didn't want
to enter though.

fields.EN: So we have an airhead, a ditz, and a crybaby.
fields.JP:
あほっぽいヤツに、ぼーっとしたヤツ、
それと、泣きべそかき
fields.LOCALIZED: So we have an airhead, a ditz, and a crybaby.

fields.EN:
They seem strong enough to fend off the
monsters, but nothing compared to us.
Like shooting fish in a barrel.
fields.JP:
化け物を倒せる恐ろしい力は
持ってるみたいだけど、ちょろそう。
あんなガキ達なら騙せるかも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They seem strong enough to fend off the
monsters, but nothing compared to us.
Like shooting fish in a barrel.

fields.EN: I agree. Just a bunch of goodie-two-shoes.
fields.JP:
同感。
みんなおひとよしって感じね
fields.LOCALIZED: I agree. Just a bunch of goodie-two-shoes.

fields.EN:
Doesn't look like they're coming back
though. Should we follow them?
fields.JP:
あいつら、戻って来る気配がないね。
私たちもついていく？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't look like they're coming back
though. Should we follow them?

fields.EN: What choice do we have? In the end, we probably can't survive without making use of them too.
fields.JP:
そうするしかないでしょ。
結局あたし達も、あいつらを利用しないと
生きていけないだろうし
fields.LOCALIZED: We have no choice. Our lives depend on it.

fields.EN:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...
fields.JP:
やれやれ……獅子身中の虫とは、
まさにこのことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...

fields.JP: お父さん……否定、してくれないんだ……
……最後にもう一度だけ言わせてもらう

fields.EN:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.
fields.JP:
考え直せ。全ては変化していくんだ。
何もかもがお前の掌中にあるわけじゃない。
この星と共に生きることを考えろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just stop. Everything changes.
You're not in control. Think about
coexisting with this planet.

fields.EN:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.
fields.JP: さて。用済みの玩具には退場願おうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now then, I'll need to ask all of
you scattered toys to go back into
your box.

fields.EN:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!
fields.JP:
使える銃がまだ残っていたなんて……！
みんな、気をつけて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
He has a working gun?! Everyone,
be careful...!

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.
fields.JP:
なに、このままじっとしていてくれれば何も
しないよ。面倒だからね。
何なら塔を降りてくれても構わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I won't do anything
if you all stay put. Or, if you
prefer, you may leave the tower.

fields.EN:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.
fields.JP: 私は私で、目的を叶えることにしよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will continue down this path to
attain my goal.

fields.EN:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...
fields.JP:
お父さんが昔のお父さんじゃなくても、
あたしにとっては……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you aren't the same Dad
I knew before, you're still my
Dad...

fields.EN:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Akazukin. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.
fields.JP:
君には大いに感謝しているよ、赤ずきん。
私の計画は、君のおかげで大きく前進
することになったのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Red Riding Hood. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.

fields.EN:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...

fields.EN:
I can't get the image of my father's betrayal
out of my head.
fields.JP:
お父さんに裏切られたあの時のことが、
頭に焼き付いて離れてくれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't get the image of my father's betrayal
out of my head.

fields.EN: Never once had I doubted him before.
fields.JP:
あたしはお父さんのことを、
生まれてから一度も疑ったことなんてなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Never once had I doubted him before.

fields.EN:
Whenever I was hurt or sick, he was there
for me. Always making time for me even if
he was busy.
fields.JP:
だって、怪我や病気の時は
すごく心配してくれたし、どんなに忙しくても
時間を作って会いに来てくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whenever I was hurt or sick, he was there
for me. Always making time for me even if
he was busy.

fields.EN:
He loved me all those years. I was always
his daughter. I had no need to doubt him.
fields.JP:
何年も何年も、変わらずに愛をくれた。
あたしはずっとずっとお父さんの娘だった。
そこに疑問なんて持つわけなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
He loved me all those years. I was always
his daughter. I had no need to doubt him.

fields.EN: So...his final words shattered my heart.
fields.JP:
だから――
最後のお父さんの言葉は、
あたしの心を突き刺し、軽々と打ち砕いた
fields.LOCALIZED: So...his final words shattered my heart.

fields.EN:
Can't be helped, I guess. I truly believed
him.
fields.JP:
仕方ないよね。
あたし、お父さんのこと本気で信じてたもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't be helped, I guess. I truly believed
him.

fields.EN:
It felt like everything I had been working
towards crumbled.
fields.JP:
そう。あの時、あたしはそれまでの
自分の人生を否定された気がした
fields.LOCALIZED:
It felt like everything I had been working
towards crumbled.

fields.JP:
ううん、違う。
間違いなく否定されたんだと思う……

fields.EN:
Because all of the family time I cherished
with my dad was fake. He said so himself.
fields.JP:
だってそれまでのお父さんとの家族の時間は、
ぜんぶ偽物だったんだって突きつけられたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because all of the family time I cherished
with my dad was fake. He said so himself.

fields.EN:
Still, I wanted to believe. I wanted all of
this to be one big misunderstanding.
fields.JP:
でも、それでもあたしは信じようとした。
何かの誤解やすれ違いなんだって思いたかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, I wanted to believe. I wanted all of
this to be one big misunderstanding.

fields.EN:
But it was what it was. In the end, I was
just afraid to admit it.
fields.JP:
いや、信じたかっただけなんだろう。
それまでただ、怖くて目を向けられなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it was what it was. In the end, I was
just afraid to admit it.

fields.EN:
Ultimately, everything backfired on me,
and I endangered everyone.
fields.JP:
結果、あたしの行動はぜんぶ裏目に
出ちゃって、みんなを危険に晒した……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ultimately, everything backfired on me,
and I endangered everyone.

fields.EN:
I wanted to be a leader, but I couldn't
lead anyone.
fields.JP:
あたしはリーダー気取りでいたけれど、
みんなを導くことはできなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to be a leader, but I couldn't
lead anyone.

fields.EN:
And did I act like a big sister? No.
Who was I able to protect?
fields.JP:
そしてお姉さんかと言われれば、
そんなこともなかった。あたしが誰を守れた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And did I act like a big sister? No.
Who was I able to protect?

fields.EN:
Even earlier. As soon as we reached the
surface, I stood dumbfounded as we
were ambushed.
fields.JP:
さっきだってそうだ。
地上に出ていきなりの出来事に、
あたしはただ呆然とするだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even earlier. As soon as we reached the
surface, I stood dumbfounded as we
were ambushed.

fields.EN:
I couldn't protect my friends or the civilians.
Instead, I just got in the way.
fields.JP:
仲間も住民の人たちも守れず、
それどころか、むしろ足手まといだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't protect my friends or the civilians.
Instead, I just got in the way.

fields.JP: ほんと、あたしってばダメだ……

fields.EN:
I bet Jack would shake his head if he saw
me like this. I don't want to disappoint him.
fields.JP:
きっとジャックも、
こんなあたしを見たら呆れるだろうな。
そんな顔、させたくはないけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet Jack would shake his head if he saw
me like this. I don't want to disappoint him.

fields.EN:
But I don't know what to do.
Dad abandoned me. I put everyone in
danger. Do I even deserve to live?
fields.JP:
でも、どうしていいか分かんないんだよ。
お父さんに捨てられ、みんなを危険に晒して、
そんなあたしはどう生きればいいのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I don't know what to do.
Dad abandoned me. I put everyone in
danger. Do I even deserve to live?

fields.JP: もうみんなに会わせる顔がない……

fields.EN:
If Witchcraft truly is real, I wish I could
just make it all go away.
fields.JP:
もしもウィッチクラフトが今目の前にあったら、
あたしは『消えて無くなりたい』って、
そう願うだろうな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Witchcraft truly is real, I wish I could
just make it all go away.

fields.EN: Aah... I wish I could disappear.
fields.JP: ああ、ほんと消えてしまいたい
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah... I wish I could disappear.

fields.JP: （あたしを呼ぶ声……？　いったい誰……？）

（あたしのことは
　放っておいてくれていいのに……）

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ああ良かった、目を覚ましてくださって

fields.EN:
(I don't remember her name, but she was
at the Dawn.)
fields.JP:
（名前は知らないけど、
　確か黎明にいた人だよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't remember her name, but she was
at the Dawn.)

fields.EN: (Man, it's cold. Was I asleep the whole time?)
fields.JP:
（それにしても寒い……
　そんな変な場所で寝てたっけ、あたし……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Man, it's cold. Was I asleep the whole time?)

fields.EN: How are you holding up, Akazukin-san?
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、具合の方は大丈夫ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: How are you holding up, Red Riding Hood?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I'm fine. Who are you again...?
fields.JP:
だいじょぶ……
ところであなた、誰だっけ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm fine. Who are you again...?

fields.EN:
Oh, forgive me. I sold goods at the Dawn.
My name is Kunai.
fields.JP:
あ、これは失礼しましたっ。
わたくし、黎明で物資の販売なんかを
担当していました、クナイと申します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, forgive me. I sold goods at the Dawn.
My name is Kunai.

fields.EN:
We've spoken a few times before. I guess
you don't remember.
fields.JP:
直接お話したこともあるんですけど……
覚えてないですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've spoken a few times before. I guess
you don't remember.

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I was just an employee at the
store. I don't blame you.
fields.JP:
いえ、気にしないで下さい。
たまに行くお店のスタッフってだけですから、
覚えてなくても仕方ありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I was just an employee at the
store. I don't blame you.

fields.EN: But I know you pretty well, Akazukin-san♪
fields.JP:
ただ、わたくしは赤ずきんさんを
よく知っていますけどね♪
fields.LOCALIZED: But I know you pretty well♪
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
When you and the others visit, Akazukin-san, the
shop gets livelier, and I have fun too.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんたちがいらっしゃると、
販売所が賑やかになって、
こっちも楽しかったんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your visits to the store made it a much
livelier place to work. For me, at least.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: あ、ああー……それで有名なのね

fields.EN:
(This place is abnormally cold. The walls
and floors are all frozen.)
fields.JP:
（異常なまでに寒いと思ったけど、
　床も壁も凍ってるところばっかりじゃん……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This place is abnormally cold. The walls
and floors are all frozen.)

fields.JP: （っていうか、あたし外にいなかったっけ？）

fields.EN:
(...That's right. I was attacked by Genocide
Pink.)
fields.JP:
（――そうだ、あたしたちは地上に出て、
　いきなり処刑台少女って奴らに襲われたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...That's right. I was attacked by Massacre
Pink.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(I remember chaos, then we suddenly
began to float. I can't recall what followed
though.)
fields.JP:
（それで、すごいピンチってところで
　突然身体が浮いて……それ以上思い出せないや）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember chaos, then we suddenly
began to float. I can't recall what followed
though.)

fields.EN:
(I'm sure that's when we were saved from
Genocide Pink though. Maybe that angel
Hikari had something to do with it?)
fields.JP:
（きっとその時に、何かの方法で
　処刑台少女を振り切って、逃げてきたんだろう。
　ひょっとしたら天使のヒカリって子の力……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure that's when we were saved from
Massacre Pink though. Maybe that angel
Hikari had something to do with it?)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(Ugh. It's all fuzzy. I need to gather my
bearings a bit.)
fields.JP:
（ダメだ、寝起きだし、
　これ以上は考えてもよく分かんなそうだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. It's all fuzzy. I need to gather my
bearings a bit.)

fields.EN:
Sorry. I know you just came to, but we
need to get moving.
fields.JP:
あの、起きたばかりで申し訳ないんですが、
すぐに移動した方がいいと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I know you just came to, but we
need to get moving.

fields.EN:
Right. The sooner, the better. This place
is a walk-in freezer.
fields.JP:
そうだねえ、なんだか知らないけど、
ここ寒いもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. The sooner, the better. This place
is a walk-in freezer.

fields.EN:
While yes, that's part of the problem,
the reason we should hurry is because
there's Marchens and a Nightmare nearby.
fields.JP:
いえ、それも問題ではあるんですが、
ここに留まらない方がいいと言うのは、
メルヒェンやナイトメアがいるみたいだからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
While yes, that's part of the problem,
the reason we should hurry is because
there's Marchens and a Nightmare nearby.

fields.EN:
Well, I assume we're in a Jail tower.
That's the likeliest reason there are
Marchens everywhere.
fields.JP:
おそらくですが、ここは監獄塔じゃないかと。
メルヒェンたちを説明するには、
それしかありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I assume we're in a Jail tower.
That's the likeliest reason there are
Marchens everywhere.

fields.EN:
(We thought we were done with it once
and for all. Not this again...)
fields.JP:
（せっかく逃げ出せたって思ったら、
　すぐにこれか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We thought we were done with it once
and for all. Not this again...)

fields.EN:
Forgive me. I would've let you sleep longer,
but between the Marchens and the weather,
it's too dangerous here.
fields.JP:
すみません、本当はもう少し寝かせて差し上げ
たかったんですが、メルヒェンといい寒さといい、
ここはあまりにも危険です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forgive me. I would've let you sleep longer,
but between the Marchens and the weather,
it's too dangerous here.

fields.EN:
But I can't explore it out there alone.
I feel bad saying this, but that's why I
woke you.
fields.JP:
わたくしだけではこの場所を探索できませんし、
それで申し訳ありませんが、起こさせて頂きました
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I can't explore it out there alone.
I feel bad saying this, but that's why I
woke you.

fields.EN:
No need to apologize. I should thank you
for waking me.
fields.JP:
謝んないでいいってば。
むしろ起こしてくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to apologize. I should thank you
for waking me.

fields.EN: So, let me ask you...is anyone else around?
fields.JP:
で、聞きたいんだけど……
他に誰かいないの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, let me ask you...is anyone else around?

fields.EN:
Well I only walked around for a bit, but
I didn't see anyone.
fields.JP:
はい……ほんの少ししか見て回ってないですが、
この辺りに人影はありませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well I only walked around for a bit, but
I didn't see anyone.

fields.JP: そっか……それはだいぶ困ったね

fields.EN: (What...? Jack and the others aren't here.)
fields.JP:
（そんな……ジャックも、
　他のみんなもいないなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What...? Jack and the others aren't here.)

fields.EN:
(I'm the only Blood Maiden. If any Marchens
showed up, I'd have to protect Kunai.)
fields.JP:
（血式少女はあたしだけ。
　メルヒェンに遭遇したら、
　あたしがクナイを守らないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm the only Blood Maiden. If any Marchens
showed up, I'd have to protect Kunai.)

fields.EN:
(Haha. Me. The one who failed to protect
everyone else. We might not even make it.)
fields.JP:
（はは、誰も守ってこられなかったあたしだよ？
　やられるのなんて、時間の問題じゃないの……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haha. Me. The one who failed to protect
everyone else. We might not even make it.)

fields.JP: （みんな、どこにいるの？　無事だよね……？）

fields.EN:
I mean, I don't have much to offer on the
combat front, but luckily I've got supplies!
fields.JP:
わたくし、戦いにおいて力にはなれませんけど、
実は運良く色んな道具を持ってるんですっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, I don't have much to offer on the
combat front, but luckily I've got supplies!

fields.EN:
See, look. Food, medicine. There's a pot
and a water bottle. I even have a tarp we
can use as a sleeping bag! For camping!
fields.JP:
ほら見て下さい、携帯食に薬、
鍋に水筒に、寝床代わりのビニールシートまで！
キャンプをするには困りませんよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
See, look. Food, medicine. There's a pot
and a water bottle. I even have a tarp we
can use as a sleeping bag! For camping!

fields.EN:
Don't you think that's pretty lucky? Hehe.
Lucky that I just happened to be the pack mule.
fields.JP:
これって結構ラッキーだと思いません？
ふふ、物資担当だったのが幸いしました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you think that's pretty lucky? Hehe.
Lucky that I just happened to be the pack mule.

fields.EN: Oh. Guess we're all set on survival goods.
fields.JP: へえ、当分の間は生活面は安心だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Guess we're all set on survival goods.

fields.EN:
Yup! So let's take advantage of this chance
to look for the others!
fields.JP:
はい！　ですからこのチャンスを生かして、
他のみなさんを探しましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup! So let's take advantage of this chance
to look for the others!

fields.EN:
Right. You're right. We're lucky that way.
Let's find the others.
fields.JP:
そっか、そうだよね。
あたしたちはきっと恵まれた状況にいる。
うん、みんなを探そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. You're right. We're lucky that way.
Let's find the others.

fields.EN: Then on we go, dare I say, for an adventure!
fields.JP:
じゃあそうと決まれば、
今すぐ出発しましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then on we go, dare I say, for an adventure!

fields.EN:
(That's right. I'm the only who can protect
her.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、今この子を守れるのは、
　あたししかいないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. I'm the only who can protect
her.)

fields.EN: (Failure isn't an option. I must protect her.)
fields.JP:
（守れるか、なんて考えちゃダメだ。
　絶対に守らないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Failure isn't an option. I must protect her.)

fields.EN:
We've looked all over this place, but
there's no one around.
fields.JP:
けっこう探し回ったけど、
誰も見つからないね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've looked all over this place, but
there's no one around.

fields.EN:
If they're all safe, they must also be looking
for shelter. I'm sure we're all just missing
one another.
fields.JP:
みなさんも無事なら、
安全な場所を探して動いてるはずです。
きっとすれ違っているだけですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If they're all safe, they must also be looking
for shelter. I'm sure we're all just missing
one another.

fields.EN:
(Why's everyone split up? We were all
together just a second ago.)
fields.JP:
（何でみんないないの……
　あんなに大勢で一緒にいたじゃない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why's everyone split up? We were all
together just a second ago.)

fields.EN: (I miss everyone so much. I miss warmth.)
fields.JP:
（ああ、みんなに会いたい。
　それで早く温まりたい……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I miss everyone so much. I miss warmth.)

fields.EN:
(I can hardly remember the last time we
drank tea together. I wonder if we'll ever
get to do that again.)
fields.JP:
（最後に紅茶を飲んだの、
　随分と前のことに思えるよ。
　もう飲めないのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can hardly remember the last time we
drank tea together. I wonder if we'll ever
get to do that again.)

fields.EN:
(Geez. There I go again. Being a big downer.
I gotta snap out of it.)
fields.JP:
（ダメだ、またあたしってば
　後ろ向きなことばっかり考えて。
　ちゃんとしなきゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Geez. There I go again. Being a big downer.
I gotta snap out of it.)

fields.EN: Kunai, need a break? Don't overdo it, okay?
fields.JP:
クナイ、疲れてない？
無理しちゃ駄目だからね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Kunai, need a break? Don't overdo it, okay?

fields.EN:
Thank you, I'm fine. You've been protecting me all
this time, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます、わたくしは平気です。
ずっと赤ずきんさんに守ってもらっていますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. I'm fine. Especially with you
as my bodyguard.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
If anything, I'm sorry for relying on you so much,
Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
むしろ赤ずきんさんにばかり頼ってしまって、
本当にすみません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I feel bad for relying on you so
much.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Don't worry about it! It's my job!
Kunai, you just stick close to me.
fields.JP:
いいっていいって！
前に立つのがあたしの役割なんだから。
クナイはちゃんとついてきてくれればいいの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry about it! It's my job!
Kunai, you just stick close to me.

fields.EN:
If it weren't for you Kunai, I think I would've
felt lonely and scared. I would have panicked.
I'm grateful for you. Thank you.
fields.JP:
それに、クナイがいなかったら、
あたし寂しくて怖くてパニックになってた。
本当に心強いよ……ありがと
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it weren't for you Kunai, I think I would've
felt lonely and scared. I would have panicked.
I'm grateful for you. Thank you.

fields.EN:
Nothing. Just surprised you'd say that is all,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
いえ、赤ずきんさんも
そんな風に思うんだなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing. Just surprised you'd say that is all,
Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I mean, who wouldn't panic waking up in
a Jail like this with no one around?
fields.JP:
そりゃいきなりこんな監獄塔で目覚めて、
他に誰もいないなんて状況になったら、
誰だってパニックになるって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, who wouldn't panic waking up in
a Jail like this with no one around?

fields.EN: Sure. That's a normal reaction, but―
fields.JP: もちろん、それが普通の反応なんですが……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure. That's a normal reaction, but―

fields.EN:
This may sound rude, but I thought you were someone
who wasn't afraid of anything, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
失礼な話ですがわたくし、
赤ずきんさんは怖いモノなどない、
というお人かと思っていたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry if this sounds rude, but I never took
you for someone who's easily phased.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
From the outside looking in, you always
seemed so confident. A natural leader.
I never saw you waver once.
fields.JP:
だって遠くから見ていた限りでは、
いつも堂々としてて、みんなを引っ張っていて、
弱さなんて微塵も見せませんでしたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
From the outside looking in, you always
seemed so confident. A natural leader.
I never saw you waver once.

fields.EN:
That's why I was somehow happy to learn that you
feel fear and loneliness just like I do,
Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
だから赤ずきんさんが
わたくしと同じように怖いとか寂しいって
思うって分かって、何だか嬉しいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why it's so surprising to hear you say
you felt fear and loneliness. Like me.
It almost brings a tear to my eye.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Ah. So to everyone else, I come off as real
tough, do I?
fields.JP:
遠目から見るあたしって、
やっぱ強そうって印象だったんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. So to everyone else, I come off as real
tough, do I?

fields.JP: ご、ごめんなさいっ、つい……

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I'm not upset.
Actually, I'm happy you said it.
fields.JP:
謝らなくていいってば。
怒ってない――っていうか、
むしろちょっと嬉しいし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'm not upset.
Actually, I'm happy you said it.

fields.EN:
(The fact I can show her my soft side,
and she doesn't hate me...)
fields.JP:
（こんな弱いあたしを見せても、
　嫌いにならないでくれるなんてね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The fact I can show her my soft side,
and she doesn't hate me...)

fields.EN:
This is weird. We hardly spoke to each
other back at the Dawn.
fields.JP:
な、なんか不思議だね。
黎明ではほとんど喋ったことなかったのにさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is weird. We hardly spoke to each
other back at the Dawn.

fields.EN:
You're right. I never imagined I'd get to talk with
you alone like this, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
確かに。赤ずきんさんとふたりっきりで
お話しできるなんて、想像もしてませんでしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have a point. I never thought I'd get
to speak to you one on one like this.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Maybe that in itself is a blessing.
fields.JP:
そういった点では、
この状況に感謝かもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe that in itself is a blessing.

fields.JP: 前向きだねえ、クナイは――

fields.EN: I-It got dark all of a sudden.
fields.JP: い、いきなり辺りが暗くなりましたね
fields.LOCALIZED: I-It got dark all of a sudden.

fields.EN:
This is a Nightmare! Kunai, let's run
for it!
fields.JP:
こっ、これはナイトメア……！
クナイ、逃げるよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a Nightmare! Kunai, let's run
for it!

fields.EN: (Shoot. It's one thing after the next here!)
fields.JP: （もう、こんな時に遭遇するなんて！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Shoot. It's one thing after the next here!)

fields.EN: (I have to protect Kunai. I'm all she's got.)
fields.JP:
（とにかく、クナイを守らないと。
　今それができるのは、あたしだけなんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I have to protect Kunai. I'm all she's got.)

fields.EN:
(I must protect her! She's not leaving my
sight!)
fields.JP:
（だから絶対に、
　この子の手を離してたまるか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I must protect her! She's not leaving my
sight!)

fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁっ……
やっと振り切った、みたいだね……

fields.EN: Thank goodness. I couldn't go much longer...
fields.JP:
よ、よかったです……
わたくし、もう体力の限界、でしたから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank goodness. I couldn't go much longer...

fields.JP: ちょっと、休憩しよっか……

fields.EN:
Yes, let's. I'm so sweaty, this frozen ground
feels heavenly.
fields.JP:
そうしましょう……
ああ、凍った床がちょうどいいって思えるくらい、
今わたくし、身体が熱いです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, let's. I'm so sweaty, this frozen ground
feels heavenly.

fields.EN:
Ah. I should exercise more often.
My hands and knees feel like jelly.
fields.JP:
ああ、日頃からちゃんと運動しておくべきでした。
膝も手もガクガクいってます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. I should exercise more often.
My hands and knees feel like jelly.

fields.EN:
Oh, come on. You weren't half bad
back there Kunai―
fields.JP:
そんなこと言って、
クナイも結構、足速かったじゃん――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on. You weren't half bad
back there Kunai―

fields.EN:
(There's no way her hands would be
shaking that much just from being out
of shape. Nor is it the cold.)
fields.JP:
（だって、走りすぎて手が震えるって、
　ちょっとピンとこないし……もちろん、
　寒さで震えてるわけでもない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way her hands would be
shaking that much just from being out
of shape. Nor is it the cold.)

fields.EN: (Man, she shouldn't have to hide it.)
fields.JP: （もう、無理に誤魔化さなくていいのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Man, she shouldn't have to hide it.)

fields.EN:
Kunai, you okay? Pretty scary back there,
wasn't it?
fields.JP: クナイ、大丈夫？　怖かったよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kunai, you okay? Pretty scary back there,
wasn't it?

fields.JP: ……やっぱり、分かっちゃいます？
ええ、とっても怖かったです……

fields.EN:
I've worked in the Dawn for so long. It was
my first time coming face to face with 
a Nightmare. I couldn't do that alone.
fields.JP:
わたくし、長いこと安全な黎明にいましたから、
ナイトメアなんて初めてで……ひとりだったら、
足がすくんで動けなかったでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've worked in the Dawn for so long. It was
my first time coming face to face with 
a Nightmare. I couldn't do that alone.

fields.EN:
You must have been scared too, Akazukin-san, yet you
stayed strong for me. Thank you so much.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんも怖かったはずなのに、
わたくしのために気丈に振る舞ってくれて、
本当にありがとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should've been scared too. But you
were our anchor. I appreciate you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Yeah. I mean, look at that thing.
Who wouldn't be?
fields.JP:
はい。あんな化け物、
怖くて当たり前じゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I mean, look at that thing.
Who wouldn't be?

fields.EN:
Yes, who wouldn't be. Everyone says
they're brave until they greet death
on the battlefield.
fields.JP:
そうです。どんなに勇敢な人だって、
立ち向かうかどうかは別にして、
怖いものは怖いはずです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, who wouldn't be. Everyone says
they're brave until they greet death
on the battlefield.

fields.JP: うん……あたしも、すっごく怖かった……

fields.EN:
I mean, I couldn't take down that
Nightmare on my own either.
fields.JP:
だって今のナイトメアはきっと、
どう頑張っても倒せない状態だろうし、
何よりあたしひとりだったし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, I couldn't take down that
Nightmare on my own either.

fields.EN: Even for a Blood Maiden, if you face a Nightmare all alone, you'll probably be killed easily.
fields.JP:
いくら血式少女だって、
たったひとりでナイトメア相手にしたら、
きっと簡単に殺されちゃうんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I might be a Blood Maiden, but there's only
so much one can do against a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
Which is why I figured we were dead meat.
Sorry for being so useless.
fields.JP:
だから、もうダメかもって思っちゃった……
ごめんね、こんなに頼りなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which is why I figured we were dead meat.
Sorry for being so useless.

fields.EN:
Hey, come on. Akazukin-san, you had
my back the whole time.
fields.JP:
そんなことありませんよ。
赤ずきんさんは、わたくしの手を
離さずにいてくれたじゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, come on. Red Riding Hood, you had
my back the whole time.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Well, I tried to be brave so that you wouldn't
worry, but I couldn't...
fields.JP:
本当ならクナイが怖がらないように、
どんと構えていなきゃいけなかったの。
でもそんな余裕もなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I tried to be brave so that you wouldn't
worry, but I couldn't...

fields.JP:
それでもわたくしを助けてくれたという
事実は変わりません

fields.EN: Besides, you're fine just the way you are.
fields.JP: それに……いいんですよ、それで
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides, you're fine just the way you are.

fields.EN:
If I were the only scared one, it would've
been embarrassing. Like I'm in your way.
Like I'm a burden.
fields.JP:
わたくしだけ怖かったら、きっと
情けない気持ちでいっぱいになってました。
足を引っ張って、最悪だなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I were the only scared one, it would've
been embarrassing. Like I'm in your way.
Like I'm a burden.

fields.EN:
But because you were scared too, Akazukin-san, I
didn't fall quite so deeply into self-loathing. I'm
really glad we're the same...
fields.JP:
でも赤ずきんさんも怖いって思ってくれたから、
そこまで自己嫌悪に陥らずに済んだんです。
本当に、同じでよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if you're scared too, then hey, that
makes two of us. I'm glad we're in it
together.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: (She accepts me just the way I am...?)
fields.JP:
（こんなあたしでよかったって、
　あなたはそう言ってくれるの……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She accepts me just the way I am...?)

fields.JP:
（頼りなくて情けない、
　間違いだらけのあたしなのに）
ううっ……ありがとう、クナイ……

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: I knew it! It is her!
fields.LOCALIZED: I knew it! It is her!

fields.JP: やっと会えましたわね！

fields.EN:
Ah. This place is great. Gonna be hard
for Marchens to find us. The perfect location.
fields.JP:
へえ、ここなら
メルヒェンたちにも見つかりにくそうだし、
キャンプ地にちょうどいいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. This place is great. Gonna be hard
for Marchens to find us. The perfect location.

fields.EN:
Right? Thanks to our camp, we've been
able to hide out.
fields.JP:
そうでしょ？　この場所のおかげで、
わたしたちしばらく隠れていられたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? Thanks to our camp, we've been
able to hide out.

fields.EN:
OH-ho-HO! I'm the one who found this
campsite! Amazing, don't you think?
fields.JP:
おーっほっほっほ！
このキャンプ地はわたくしが見つけたんですのよ！
すごくなくって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
OH-ho-HO! I'm the one who found this
campsite! Amazing, don't you think?

fields.EN: Uh. All you did was faint here...
fields.JP:
いや、あんたが
最初に倒れてたってだけでしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh. All you did was faint here...

fields.EN: Y-you weren't supposed to say that!
fields.JP: そ、それは言わない約束ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-you weren't supposed to say that!

fields.EN:
Regardless, I'm relieved to see you both.
I was beginning to worry.
fields.JP:
何にせよ、親指とシンデレラが無事でよかったよ。
ここまで誰にも会えなかったからさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, I'm relieved to see you both.
I was beginning to worry.

fields.EN:
We tried exploring a bit, but we haven't
found anyone either. The two of us were
just about to embark on a long search.
fields.JP:
わたしたちも近場を回ってみたけど、
誰にも会えなかったの。だからいよいよ
遠出してみようかって話をしてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We tried exploring a bit, but we haven't
found anyone either. The two of us were
just about to embark on a long search.

fields.EN:
Then suddenly, I caught wind of your
voice.
fields.JP:
そうしたら、いきなり赤姉たちの声が
聞こえた気がしてね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then suddenly, I caught wind of your
voice.

fields.EN:
To our surprise, it really was you.
You have no idea how happy I am to see you.
fields.JP:
もしかしてって思って
見に行ったら、本当にいたから驚いたわ
ほんと、赤姉たちも無事でよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To our surprise, it really was you.
You have no idea how happy I am to see you.

fields.EN:
It's thanks to your loud voice, Akazukin-san. I
don't know if I'd have heard anyone else.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんの大きな声のおかげですわね。
他の人の声だったら、聞こえたかどうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
All thanks to your loud voice. If it were
anyone else, I doubt I would've heard.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: そんなにあたしの声ってうるさいの……？
割と真面目に褒めてるんですのよ？

fields.EN:
You guys, I was rummaging through my
things and found something awesome!
fields.JP:
みなさん、荷物整理してたら
いいもの見つけました～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You guys, I was rummaging through my
things and found something awesome!

fields.JP: わあ、クッキーじゃありませんの！

fields.EN:
This is my secret stash, not included in my
rations of course. Let's share it♪
fields.JP:
携帯食とは別にこっそり忍ばせておいた、
わたくしのとっておきです。
さあ、食べましょう♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my secret stash, not included in my
rations of course. Let's share it♪

fields.EN: Thank you. I've been craving sweets.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。
甘いもの食べたかったから、助かるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you. I've been craving sweets.

fields.JP:
そういえばあなた、
ちょくちょく見たことあるような……？

fields.EN:
It's Kunai-san. She worked at the shop back
at the Dawn. Wonderful to see you.
fields.JP:
黎明の販売所にいたクナイさんですわよ。
無事で本当によかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's Kunai. She worked at the shop back
at the Dawn. Wonderful to see you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: クナイさん => Kunai-san

fields.JP: シンデレラ、クナイのこと知ってるんだ？

fields.EN:
Of course. She and I were paired together
on cleaning duty. Which all of you know
thanks to our spotless work.
fields.JP:
ええ。掃除仲間だったんですのよ。
黎明がキレイに保たれていたのは、
わたくしたちのおかげなんですからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. She and I were paired together
on cleaning duty. Which all of you know
thanks to our spotless work.

fields.EN:
That's right. Cinderella-san made cleaning time
feel like a break.
fields.JP:
シンデレラさんのおかげで、
いつも掃除の時間が楽しかったんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Cinderella made cleaning time
feel like a break.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
I didn't know you guys had that kind of
relationship.
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't know you guys had that kind of
relationship.

fields.EN:
Just glad the four of us are here together.
This is gonna make finding the others way
easier.
fields.JP:
何にしても、こうして４人だけでも
合流できてよかったわ。これで他のみんなを
探しに行くのも楽になるわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just glad the four of us are here together.
This is gonna make finding the others way
easier.

fields.EN:
I'm curious where the others could be.
Goodness. Of all the rotten things that
could have happened to us on the surface.
fields.JP:
でも他のみんなはどこにいるのかしら。
ああ、地上に出てどうして
いきなりこんなことに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious where the others could be.
Goodness. Of all the rotten things that
could have happened to us on the surface.

fields.EN:
Yeah, I don't get it. Genocide Pink. The big
Jail tower. So much, so fast.
fields.JP:
確かに何が何だかよく分からないわよね。
処刑台少女とかあの巨大な監獄塔とか、
短い間に色々と起こりすぎだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I don't get it. Massacre Pink. The big
Jail tower. So much, so fast.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
But we can't let that stop us, right Sister
Aka-nee?
fields.JP:
でも、色々考えなくちゃいけないことはあるけど、
今は立ち止まってはいられない。
そうでしょ、赤姉？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we can't let that stop us, right Sister
Red?
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: それはそうなんだけど……

fields.EN:
Jack's not here. We have no way to lower
our corruption.
fields.JP:
あたしたちには今、ジャックがいない。
『穢れ』を取る方法がないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's not here. We have no way to lower
our corruption.

fields.JP:
だから今は、むやみやたらに
戦うわけにはいかないよ

fields.EN:
We might have one method of removing
corruption, right Cinderella?
fields.JP:
『穢れ』を取る方法なら、
あるっちゃあるけど……ねえ、シンデレラ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We might have one method of removing
corruption, right Cinderella?

fields.EN:
Gretel-san offered me a rather strong sleeping
pill for aiding her with her research.
fields.JP:
前にグレーテルさんから研究の対価として
もらった、とても強力な睡眠薬ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel offered me a rather strong sleeping
pill for aiding her with her research.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Drinking this temporarily lowers your
corruption.
fields.JP:
これを飲めば、一時的にではあるけれど
『穢れ』を減らすことができるんですのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Drinking this temporarily lowers your
corruption.

fields.EN:
Gretel, when'd she get around to making
that?
fields.JP:
そんな便利なものを、
グレーテルったらいつの間に……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, when'd she get around to making
that?

fields.EN:
Ah, but there's a catch. It's not a simple
sleep aid.
fields.JP:
ところがどっこい、
そんな都合のいいものでもないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, but there's a catch. It's not a simple
sleep aid.

fields.EN:
While it does lower corruption, it works
precisely as intended. One pill, and you
are out like a light.
fields.JP:
この薬、確かに『穢れ』を減らせるのだけど、
睡眠薬の効果も強力で、飲んだら最後、
強制的に眠ることになってしまうんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
While it does lower corruption, it works
precisely as intended. One pill, and you
are out like a light.

fields.EN:
Which means we should think again
about taking it in the middle of battle.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ戦ってる最中に飲んだら、
無防備なままボコボコにされちゃうじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means we should think again
about taking it in the middle of battle.

fields.EN:
That's the catch, but better than nothing,
I guess?
fields.JP:
だからあるっちゃあるけど、って濁したのよ。
でも、ないよりはマシでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the catch, but better than nothing,
I guess?

fields.JP: そうだね……本当に最終手段だけど

fields.EN: Agreed. We shouldn't rely on it.
fields.JP:
ええ。グレーテルの薬には、
なるべく頼らずに行きましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Agreed. We shouldn't rely on it.

fields.EN:
Speaking of Gretel, Shirayuki was injured
too... Hope she's okay.
fields.JP:
そういえばグレーテル……
それに白雪もケガを負わされていたけど、
大丈夫かなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speaking of Gretel, Snow White was injured
too... Hope she's okay.

fields.EN:
If I were on top of things, this all could
have been avoided.
fields.JP:
あたしがもっとしっかりしていれば、
被害はもっと少なくできたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I were on top of things, this all could
have been avoided.

fields.EN:
The same could be said for me. I gravely
underestimated Genocide Pink. I was no
match for them.
fields.JP:
それを言うならわたくしも、ですわ。
処刑台少女を甘く見すぎていましたもの。
いざ戦ったら、手も足も出なかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The same could be said for me. I gravely
underestimated Massacre Pink. I was no
match for them.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: They sure handed it to us...
fields.JP: あいつら、強かったよね……
fields.LOCALIZED: They sure handed it to us...

fields.EN:
Don't be so hard on yourselves. We'll
get another shot soon enough.
fields.JP:
お、落ち込んでちゃダメでしょ。
次は勝つ、くらい言わなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be so hard on yourselves. We'll
get another shot soon enough.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime-san, you were there too.
We hardly escaped with our lives.
fields.JP:
親指姫さんも戦ったんですから、
それが簡単じゃないことは分かりますでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina, you were there too.
We hardly escaped with our lives.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
白雪、無事よね……？
それにネムも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White's safe, right? And Sleepy?

fields.JP: いきなりどうしたの、クナイ

fields.EN:
I Just remembered something I had in
my pocket... A-ha!
fields.JP:
わたくし、いいものを持ってきてたんでした。
えっと確かこのポケットに……ありました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I Just remembered something I had in
my pocket... A-ha!

fields.EN: Here, a lighter. This'll warm us up.
fields.JP:
ほら、ライターです。
これで暖かくなれますよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Here, a lighter. This'll warm us up.

fields.EN:
Hold on. Huh? It's not turning on―
OUCH!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って下さいね。
あ、あれ？　点かな――あつっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on. Huh? It's not turning on―
OUCH!

fields.EN: Kunai, you're holding it upside down.
fields.JP: クナイ、持ち方が上下逆だって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Kunai, you're holding it upside down.

fields.JP: あら、何かおかしいと思ったんですよねー

fields.EN: Kunai-san, I didn't know how clumsy you are.
fields.JP:
クナイさん、もしかして
意外とそそっかしい……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Kunai, I didn't know how clumsy you are.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: クナイさん => Kunai-san

fields.EN: Hehe. I get that a lot.
fields.JP: ふふ、よく言われるんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I get that a lot.

fields.JP: いや、褒めてないからね！？

fields.EN:
Sure, but now we can start a fire. I've just
about had it. I'm freezing.
fields.JP:
でもこれで火がおこせますわね。
わたくし、正直寒くて限界だったんですのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but now we can start a fire. I've just
about had it. I'm freezing.

fields.EN:
Same here. Let's get a fire going. Come on,
Aka-nee. Block the wind.
fields.JP:
実はわたしもよ。
じゃあたき火作って、暖を取りましょ。
ほら赤姉、風よけになって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. Let's get a fire going. Come on,
Sister Red. Block the wind.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: （何だか火を見てると落ちつくなあ）

fields.EN:
(...The guilt was starting to get to me.
Nothing can drag me down.)
fields.JP:
（……正直、あたしは色々と後悔だらけだ。
　でも今は、それを引きずっちゃいけない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...The guilt was starting to get to me.
Nothing can drag me down.)

fields.EN:
(I don't want to be the reason Kunai, 
Oyayubi, or anyone gets hurt.)
fields.JP:
（そんなことをして、
　クナイや親指たちに危険が及ぶような真似は、
　もう絶対にしたくないから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't want to be the reason Kunai, 
Thumby, or anyone gets hurt.)

fields.EN: (This time, I won't let anyone down.)
fields.JP: （今度こそ、しっかりと守るんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (This time, I won't let anyone down.)

fields.EN: I haven't rested that well in ages.
fields.JP:
何だかずいぶんと久しぶりに、
ぐっすり寝た気分ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I haven't rested that well in ages.

fields.EN:
I don't expect a princess to know much
about all-nighters.
fields.JP: 別に１日たりとも徹夜なんてしてないのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't expect a princess to know much
about all-nighters.

fields.EN:
You think I had it easy? Yesterday was
traumatic for us all.
fields.JP:
昨日があまりにも色々とありすぎたからね。
あたしも体力、限界だったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think I had it easy? Yesterday was
traumatic for us all.

fields.EN:
Well thanks to the good night's sleep,
we can explore all day today.
fields.JP:
でも一晩しっかりと休んだから、
今日はしっかりと探索に出られるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well thanks to the good night's sleep,
we can explore all day today.

fields.EN:
You're setting off, everyone? Please
return safely.
fields.JP:
みなさん、出発ですか？
絶対に無事に帰ってきて下さいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're setting off, everyone? Please
return safely.

fields.EN:
What do you mean, Kunai? You're coming
with us.
fields.JP:
何言ってるの。
クナイも一緒に来るんだってば
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean, Kunai? You're coming
with us.

fields.EN:
Really? I thought I was in charge of watching
the camp.
fields.JP:
そうなんですか？　わたくしはてっきり、
ここに残ってキャンプを守るのかと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I thought I was in charge of watching
the camp.

fields.EN:
As much as I'd like for someone to stand
watch, we can't afford to split up right now.
fields.JP:
探索組とキャンプ組に分けたいところなんだけど、
あたしたち人数少ないからさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As much as I'd like for someone to stand
watch, we can't afford to split up right now.

fields.EN: If we split into pairs, the exploration team would be in trouble. But there's no way I can leave Kunai alone at camp, either.
fields.JP:
２人ずつに分けたら、探索組が厳しい。
だからって、キャンプにクナイ１人を
残すなんて絶対にできない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Groups of two would just make both
jobs tougher, but I wouldn't want you
to stay back at camp alone.

fields.EN: No matter how we split up, one side would be short-handed. So I figured we'd just leave the campsite unmanned and all go together.
fields.JP:
どう分けてもどっちかが手薄になるなら、
いっそキャンプ地は無人で放置して、
みんなで行こうって、そう考えたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how we split it, we're short on
people. So we might as well stick together.

fields.EN:
If a Marchen wanders in, they might thrash
the place around, but better the camp than
us.
fields.JP:
キャンプは迷い込んだメルヒェンとかに
荒らされちゃうかもしれないけど、
それはもうしょうがないって割り切ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If a Marchen wanders in, they might thrash
the place around, but better the camp than
us.

fields.EN:
She's right. Our lives are more important.
Fear not, Kunai-san! I shall protect you!
fields.JP:
命の方が大事ですものね。
大丈夫、クナイさんはわたくしが
ちゃんとお守りいたしますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Our lives are more important.
Fear not, Kunai! I shall protect you!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: クナイさん => Kunai-san

fields.JP:
ありがとうございます、シンデレラさん。
とても心強いです
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
I'm so glad you're here, Aka-nee. We can
immediately plot our course and get going.
fields.JP:
やっぱ赤姉がいてくれて良かったわ。
方針がズバッと決まるし、まとまりが出るもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so glad you're here, Sister Red. We can
immediately plot our course and get going.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: We can do no better with you at the helm.
fields.JP:
やっぱりわたくしたちは、
こうでなくっちゃ、ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: We can do no better with you at the helm.

fields.EN: But I haven't even done anything yet.
fields.JP: いや、あたしなんて大したことしてないってば
fields.LOCALIZED: But I haven't even done anything yet.

fields.EN:
That's not true. Because of you Aka-nee,
none of us has to walk through the fire alone.
fields.JP:
そんなことないわ。赤姉がいてくれるから、
みんな下向かずに頑張ることができてるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. Because of you Sister Red,
none of us has to walk through the fire alone.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
You guys would be just as capable without
me to mess things up...
fields.JP:
あたしがいなかったら、
他のみんながもっとしっかりやってくれるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You guys would be just as capable without
me to mess things up...

fields.EN: Couldn't be further from the truth, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP: そうじゃありませんわ、赤ずきんさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Couldn't be further from the truth, Red
Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I've been together with you since childhood,
Akazukin-san. Training, playing—everything...
fields.JP:
わたくしは、子どもの頃からずっとずっと、
赤ずきんさんと一緒でしたわ。
それこそ、修行も遊びもぜんぶ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have been companions since childhood.
Countless hours spent on the training grounds
or playing together. All of it.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Each waking moment, spent side by side.
I wouldn't feel safer with anyone else.
fields.JP:
そう、それが当たり前の日常だったんです。
だから、あなたがそばにいてくれるだけで
安心するんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each waking moment, spent side by side.
I wouldn't feel safer with anyone else.

fields.EN: Sorry, Cinderella. I call myself the leader and an older sister, but all I can do is stay by your side...
fields.JP:
ごめんね、シンデレラ。
あたしリーダーだとかお姉さんだとか言いながら、
そばにいるしかできなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Cinderella. I always make myself
out to be a leader and role model, but I'm
just a waste of space here.

fields.JP:
（ほんと、何であたし、
　こんなに情けないんだろう……）

fields.EN: But none of that is true...
fields.JP: そうじゃありませんのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: But none of that is true...

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
(Ugh. I'm being all mopey again. I told
myself I needed to stay strong for them.)
fields.JP:
（ダメだ、またあたしってばウジウジして……
　みんなを守るって決めたのに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. I'm being all mopey again. I told
myself I needed to stay strong for them.)

fields.EN:
I know I mentioned this yesterday, but
we need to be extra careful exploring
since we can't remove corruption.
fields.JP:
そうだ、昨日も話したけど、わたしたち
『穢れ』をちゃんと取ることができないから、
無茶なことはしないようにしましょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I mentioned this yesterday, but
we need to be extra careful exploring
since we can't remove corruption.

fields.EN:
Yeah. Stay sharp so we can avoid using
Gretel's sleeping pills.
fields.JP:
うん。グレーテルの睡眠薬に
頼らなくて済むように行動しなきゃだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Stay sharp so we can avoid using
Gretel's sleeping pills.

fields.JP: それじゃあ行こうか、みんな

fields.EN:
Argh... We've looked everywhere. Doesn't
seem like anyone's near us.
fields.JP:
はぁぁ……。
結構探したってのに、
誰にも会わないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh... We've looked everywhere. Doesn't
seem like anyone's near us.

fields.EN: Signs seem scant for any recent lifeforms.
fields.JP:
誰かがいたっていう
痕跡すら見当たりませんでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Signs seem scant for any recent lifeforms.

fields.EN:
But we found Aka-nee and Kunai.
Surely the others aren't far behind.
fields.JP:
赤姉とクナイが見つかったんだもん、
他のみんなもきっといると思うんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we found Sister Red and Kunai.
Surely the others aren't far behind.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Maybe everyone else already found an
exit route and managed to escape?
fields.JP:
もしかして、みなさん出口を見つけて
外に出ていってしまったんじゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe everyone else already found an
exit route and managed to escape?

fields.EN: Possibly, but do you see any exits anywhere?
fields.JP:
その可能性も確かにあるけど、出口らしき
ものなんて、ここまで見なかったわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Possibly, but do you see any exits anywhere?

fields.EN:
Perhaps this Jail is much larger than we
think it is.
fields.JP:
わたくしたちが思っている以上に、
この監獄塔は広大なのかもしれませんわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps this Jail is much larger than we
think it is.

fields.EN:
Take solace in the fact everyone's likely in
the same boat as us, but if the Jail's this big
all around, we're in for a long trek.
fields.JP:
みんなのいる可能性が
消えないのはいいことだけど、
広すぎるってのもウンザリする話ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take solace in the fact everyone's likely in
the same boat as us, but if the Jail's this big
all around, we're in for a long trek.

fields.EN:
In the end, we must exercise patience.
Isn't that right, Akazukin-san?
fields.JP:
結局、まだまだ地道に
探していくしかありませんわね。
ね、赤ずきんさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the end, we must exercise patience.
Isn't that right, Red Riding Hood?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: みんな、どこにいるんだよ……

fields.EN: (Why has no one else shown up yet?)
fields.JP:
（何でこんなに探してるのに
　見つからないんだよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why has no one else shown up yet?)

fields.EN:
(We can't survive in this cold forever.
Even worse, one of us could go Blood
Skelter at any moment.)
fields.JP:
（いつまでもこんな寒いところで生活できないし、
　何よりもう、いつブラッドスケルター化しても
　おかしくない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We can't survive in this cold forever.
Even worse, one of us could go Blood
Skelter at any moment.)

fields.EN: We gotta hurry before it's too late.
fields.JP: 早くしないと、手遅れに……
fields.LOCALIZED: We gotta hurry before it's too late.

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Oh. Say, doesn't this remind you guys of
what life was like before Jack?
fields.JP:
あー……そ、そういえば、
昔のジャックがまだいない時を思い出すわねっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Say, doesn't this remind you guys of
what life was like before Jack?

fields.EN:
Right! Just like the good old days, all of
us present and accounted for.
fields.JP:
そ、そうですわね！
あの頃もこんなメンバーでしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! Just like the good old days, all of
us present and accounted for.

fields.EN:
Whenever we lost track of you, Aka-nee,
you'd just march on through the Jail.
fields.JP:
赤姉ってば目を離すとズンズンと
進んでいっちゃうし、元気よくジェイルの中を
駆け回るから大変だったわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whenever we lost track of you, Sister Red,
you'd just march on through the Jail.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP:
あら、想像するだけで
可愛らしいエピソードですね

fields.EN:
We'd chase after her then scurry away from
the Marchens. Talk about living on the edge.
fields.JP:
わたしたちは赤姉を追いかけながら、
メルヒェンから逃げたりと、けっこう
ハードな展開だったりしたのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'd chase after her then scurry away from
the Marchens. Talk about living on the edge.

fields.EN: My, my... But you're all veterans now.
fields.JP:
あらあら……でもそれが、
今に繋がってるんですよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: My, my... But you're all veterans now.

fields.EN:
Quite. That time hardened us, taught us
valuable lessons about the Jail.
fields.JP:
ええ。そのおかげで、
どんどんジェイルについて新しいことが
分かったりしましたもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quite. That time hardened us, taught us
valuable lessons about the Jail.

fields.EN:
You were a ball of curiosity, Aka-nee.
Sure you got us into trouble sometimes,
but you always managed to pull us out.
fields.JP:
好奇心の塊だったからねえ、赤姉。
おかげでピンチになることも多かったけど、
でも不思議と何とかなる、って思えたのよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were a ball of curiosity, Sister Red.
Sure you got us into trouble sometimes,
but you always managed to pull us out.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Thinking back on it now, those really were
the days.
fields.JP:
今になって思い返すと、
あの頃ってとても楽しかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thinking back on it now, those really were
the days.

fields.EN:
Yeah. We knew nothing back then.
We were just kids.
fields.JP:
あの頃のあたしはほんとに
何も知らない子どもだったんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We knew nothing back then.
We were just kids.

fields.EN: I had so much confidence in those days.
fields.JP:
だから根拠もないのに何でもできるって、
そう思ってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I had so much confidence in those days.

fields.EN:
We didn't know just how good we had it.
That's why we were reckless. Dad was hard
on us, but encouraging.
fields.JP:
実際、色々と上手くいっちゃったりしてさ。
それだからお父さんも、無茶したことを叱りつつも
褒めてくれたっけなあ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We didn't know just how good we had it.
That's why we were reckless. Dad was hard
on us, but encouraging.

fields.JP: その行動力が赤姉のいいところなのよね
fields.LOCALIZED: You always took initiative, Sister Red.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: でも今はもう、子どもじゃないから……

fields.EN:
We are not, but your true nature has shined
through even after we met Jack-san and Alice.
It's saved us numerous times, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
確かにそうですけど、ジャックさんたちが
入ってきてからも、何度も赤ずきんさんの
行動力には救われてきましたのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We are not, but your true nature has shined
through even after we met Jack and Alice.
It's saved us numerous times, Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: You think? It's not all me.
fields.JP: そう？　あたしに行動力なんてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You think? It's not all me.

fields.EN:
I don't really feel like myself right now.
I'm sure all of you can tell.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、今のあたしは見ての通り、
こんな感じだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't really feel like myself right now.
I'm sure all of you can tell.

fields.EN:
That may be true, but don't all of us have
days like that?
fields.JP:
そうかもしれませんけど、
調子が悪い時なんて誰にでもありますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That may be true, but don't all of us have
days like that?

fields.EN:
Seriously. You have more to give than
you think, Aka-nee.
fields.JP:
そうよ。赤姉が頼りないなんてこと、
ないんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. You have more to give than
you think, Sister Red.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
(Sheesh, I'm horrible. Look at how Oyayubi
and Cinderella pity me...)
fields.JP:
（親指やシンデレラに
　気を遣わせるようになるなんて、
　あたしってば本当に最悪だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sheesh, I'm horrible. Look at how Thumby
and Cinderella pity me...)

fields.EN: Hey! Isn't this a Jail core?
fields.JP: あっ！　あれ、この監獄塔の核じゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! Isn't this a Jail core?

fields.EN:
Good catch! If we destroy it, then we should
be able to topple that Nightmare.
fields.JP:
本当ですわ！　ではこれを壊せば、
ナイトメアを倒せるように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good catch! If we destroy it, then we should
be able to topple that Nightmare.

fields.JP:
でもやっぱり、番人もいるわね。
まあ、予想はしてたけど

fields.EN: Hey, let's not rush into anything though.
fields.JP:
ねえ、今無理して
壊そうとしなくてもいいんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, let's not rush into anything though.

fields.EN:
Why not? If we don't break the core,
then we can't stop the Nightmare.
This is our shot!
fields.JP:
どうしてよ？
核を壊せばナイトメアの不死性を無くせるわ。
倒すチャンスじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why not? If we don't break the core,
then we can't stop the Nightmare.
This is our shot!

fields.EN: I know, but there's only three of us.
fields.JP:
確かにそうだけど、
でも血式少女はあたしたち３人だけだし……
fields.LOCALIZED: I know, but there's only three of us.

fields.EN:
Come on, you know we can handle it.
Gotta strike the iron while it's hot.
fields.JP:
昔はこんな人数でも挑んでいたじゃない。
やれる時にやらなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, you know we can handle it.
Gotta strike the iron while it's hot.

fields.EN:
But it'll be safer if we recruit some of the
others first.
fields.JP:
でも、他のみんなと合流してからの方が、
安全にいけるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it'll be safer if we recruit some of the
others first.

fields.EN: No, Aka-nee. We defeat the Nightmare, make sure it's safe, and then look for everyone. We can do it as we are now.
fields.JP:
逆よ赤姉、ナイトメアを倒して、
安全を確保してからみんなを探すのよ。
今のわたしたちならやれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not so sure. If we don't take that thing
down before searching for the others, it'll
snatch us before we get another chance.

fields.EN:
Look. The old me would have gone in
all gung-ho...
fields.JP:
昔の自分なら、
やれるって言い切っていたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look. The old me would have gone in
all gung-ho...

fields.EN: (That's right. I used to be such an idiot.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ。前のバカなあたしなら、
　間違いなく突撃していた）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That's right. I used to be such an idiot.)

fields.EN:
(But I never considered the danger that I
put the others in...)
fields.JP:
（その結果、判断を誤ってみんなを危険に
　晒すことになるなんて知らずに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I never considered the danger that I
put the others in...)

fields.EN:
(Now I need to act rationally.
Should we attack, or fall back?)
fields.JP:
（だから、ちゃんと考えなきゃ。
　今、本当に突撃していいのかを）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now I need to act rationally.
Should we attack, or fall back?)

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
How do we know that destroying the core
won't sick a bunch of Marchens on us?
fields.JP:
今、核を破壊することで、
周りのメルヒェンが一斉に向かってくるとか、
何か大変なことが起きたりしない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How do we know that destroying the core
won't sick a bunch of Marchens on us?

fields.EN:
If we attack the core, the Jail might enter
a frenzy. Might be best for us to ignore it
and move on.
fields.JP:
核に手を出せば、当然ジェイルはざわつく。
ここはやっぱり無視して進んだ方が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we attack the core, the Jail might enter
a frenzy. Might be best for us to ignore it
and move on.

fields.EN:
Though in the off-chance that we DO run
into a Nightmare, we have a better shot at
taking it down.
fields.JP:
でも確かにナイトメアに遭遇した時、
不死性を奪っていれば対処のしようもあるし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though in the off-chance that we DO run
into a Nightmare, we have a better shot at
taking it down.

fields.EN:
Hey Aka-nee, I don't think we have
much time left to decide.
fields.JP:
ちょっと赤姉、
今はゆっくり考えている場合じゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Sister Red, I don't think we have
much time left to decide.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
No. We have to explore every option.
No room for error.
fields.JP:
ダメだよ、ちゃんと考えて動かないと。
危ない橋は渡っちゃいけないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. We have to explore every option.
No room for error.

fields.EN:
What would Gretel do? Would she break the
core? She'd probably want a sample of the
Jail.
fields.JP:
グレーテルなら何て言う？
あの子は核を破壊したがるかな。
ジェイルの変化のサンプルが、とか言いそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What would Gretel do? Would she break the
core? She'd probably want a sample of the
Jail.

fields.EN:
But Jack would probably warn against
putting everyone in danger.
fields.JP:
でもジャックだったら、
みんなを危険な目に遭わせるくらいなら
やめようって言ってくれそう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Jack would probably warn against
putting everyone in danger.

fields.EN: Argh. What do I do? Decisions, decisions...
fields.JP:
ああもう、正解はどっちなの。
考えないと、考えないと――
