fields.LOCALIZED: Argh. What do I do? Decisions, decisions...

fields.EN: Enough. This is so unlike you, Akazukin-san!
fields.JP:
もう、そんなの
赤ずきんさんらしくありませんわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough. This is so unlike you, Red Riding
Hood!
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
But what if whatever's "like me" dooms all
of us?!
fields.JP:
その『らしさ』で突撃して、
危険な目に遭ったらどうするの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But what if whatever's "like me" dooms all
of us?!

fields.EN:
Akazukin-san, are you regretting what you've done up
to now...?
fields.JP:
もしかして赤ずきんさん、
自分のこれまでの行動を悔やんでるんですの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does the burden of regret paralyze you
with fear...?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Yes. I guess I'm realizing that I've been
making the wrong call more often than
not. I can't make that same mistake.
fields.JP:
そうだよ。あたし、
色々と判断間違えてきたって気づいちゃったの
だから慎重にならないといけないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I guess I'm realizing that I've been
making the wrong call more often than
not. I can't make that same mistake.

fields.EN:
You haven't made a mistake. We're only alive today
because of you, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
間違えてなんていませんわ。だって
わたくしたちがここまで生きてこられたのは、
赤ずきんさんのおかげなんですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you haven't made any mistakes.
You're the only reason we're still alive.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
That's not true. Everyone depended on me
when Genocide Pink attacked, and I let all
of you down.
fields.JP:
違うよ。ほら、処刑台少女に襲われた時、
あたしちゃんと判断できずに、
みんなを危険にさらしたじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. Everyone depended on me
when Massacre Pink attacked, and I let all
of you down.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
It all happened so quick. If you hadn't
been there, it's more likely none of us
would have made it.
fields.JP:
あれは突然の出来事だし、しょうがないわ。
むしろ赤姉がいなかったら、みんな死んでいたかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
It all happened so quick. If you hadn't
been there, it's more likely none of us
would have made it.

fields.EN:
She's right, Akazukin-san.
Cast your doubts aside.
fields.JP: そうです、赤ずきんさんは頑張っていますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Red Riding Hood.
Cast your doubts aside.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
While it's true that Jack-san's addition to our
team has been invaluable on its own...
fields.JP:
確かにジャックさんが入ってくれて、
わたくしたちはあの人の判断に
助けられることが増えました
fields.LOCALIZED:
While it's true that Jack's addition to our
team has been invaluable on its own...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Jack-san has only been with us for a few months.
You, Akazukin-san, have been making the right calls
for far longer than he has...
fields.JP:
でも、まだ入って数ヶ月ですわ。
赤ずきんさんは、そんなジャックさんよりも
ずっと長い間、的確な判断をし続けてきた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's only had a few months to prove
himself. You, on the other hand, have
turned up time and time again.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Can't you see how astounding that is?
If you ever need a reminder, I'd be more
than willing to provide it.
fields.JP:
それがどれだけすごいことか。
もしご自分で分かっていないんでしたら、
わたくしいくらでも語って差し上げますわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't you see how astounding that is?
If you ever need a reminder, I'd be more
than willing to provide it.

fields.EN:
That's right. You've stuck your neck out
for us more times than I can count.
fields.JP:
そうよ。赤姉はこれまでちゃんと、
わたしたちを良い判断で引っ張ってきてくれたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You've stuck your neck out
for us more times than I can count.

fields.EN:
You need to believe in yourself too.
Don't think for one second that we
don't have your back.
fields.JP:
だから今、赤姉が自信を持って判断を
してくれるなら、わたしたちは
何も言わずにそれを信じるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You need to believe in yourself too.
Don't think for one second that we
don't have your back.

fields.JP: 分かったよ。それじゃあ……

fields.EN:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Akazukin. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.
fields.JP:
君には大いに感謝しているよ、赤ずきん。
私の計画は、君のおかげで大きく前進
することになったのだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I appreciate what you've done for
me, Red Riding Hood. Your efforts
accelerated my plans.

fields.EN:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, I have no need for you
anymore...

fields.JP: （やっぱりあたしには決められない……！）

fields.EN:
It's okay to let go, Akazukin-san.
We owe our lives to you, believe it.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさん、自信を持って下さい。
今、わたくしが生きているのは、
間違いなく赤ずきんさんのおかげです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay to let go, Red Riding Hood.
We owe our lives to you, believe it.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 赤ずきん => Red Riding Hood-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Got it? I'm not scared anymore.
We have death to confront sooner or later.
fields.JP:
ね？　それは真新しくて忘れようのない、
絶対の事実ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it? I'm not scared anymore.
We have death to confront sooner or later.

fields.EN:
(Oh, that's right. That night I saved Kunai's
life...)
fields.JP:
（そうか、あたしクナイを
　助けることができてたんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, that's right. That night I saved Kunai's
life...)

fields.JP: よしっ、それじゃあみんな――
ぎいいいいいいいいいいいいいっ！！

fields.EN: Oh no! Aka-nee, the guardian's spotted us!
fields.JP: しまった！　赤姉、番人に見つかったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no! Sister Red, the guardian's spotted us!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: Then it seems dueling is our only option.
fields.JP: こうなったらもう、戦うしかありませんわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Then it seems dueling is our only option.

fields.JP: ごご、ごめんなさいみなさん……！

fields.EN: It's fine, Kunai. All right, everyone—don't let your guard down!
fields.JP:
いいって、クナイ。
それじゃあみんな、絶対に油断しちゃダメだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Back here, Kunai. You two, fan out!

fields.EN:
Now's our chance, Aka-nee!
Destroy the core!
fields.JP: 今よ、赤姉！　核を破壊して！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now's our chance, Sister Red!
Destroy the core!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: ぎいいいいいいいいいいいいいっ！！

fields.EN: Yes! Now we've stripped that Nightmare of its immortality!
fields.JP:
やった、これでナイトメアの
不死性を無くせましたわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
YES! Now we can stick that Nightmare
right where it hurts!

fields.EN:
That voice we heard earlier. Do you think
there could be two cores?
fields.JP:
これって、さっきも聞こえた声ね。
もしかして核は２つあったとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That voice we heard earlier. Do you think
there could be two cores?

fields.EN: Maybe that's just how this Jail works.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、そういう
ジェイルなのかもしれませんわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pray tell what other tricks this Jail
has up its sleeve.

fields.EN:
Do you think our friends destroyed the
other ones...? It's too early to say.
fields.JP:
だとするなら、仲間の誰かがやった……？
いや、まだ決めつけるのは早いかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think our friends destroyed the
other ones...? It's too early to say.

fields.EN: In any case, a hard-fought victory.
fields.JP: 何にせよ、破壊できてよかったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: In any case, a hard-fought victory.

fields.EN:
So does this mean we can fight the
Nightmare? Well done, everyone!
fields.JP:
これでナイトメアにも対抗できるんですよね？
すごいです、みなさん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So does this mean we can fight the
Nightmare? Well done, everyone!

fields.EN: (Well, I guess we did the right thing.)
fields.JP: （まあ、結果的にこれでよかったかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Well, I guess we did the right thing.)

fields.EN:
Now, let's get some rest and pick back up
tomorrow.
fields.JP:
さて、と。それじゃあ少し休憩して、
また探索しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, let's get some rest and pick back up
tomorrow.

fields.EN: (I sure hope we did the right thing.)
fields.JP: （うん、この流れでよかったんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I sure hope we did the right thing.)

fields.JP: 辺りが暗くなってきた……！

こ、これは……！
ナイトメアが出たんですか？

fields.EN:
Yes, pretty darn close I bet.
Kunai, don't make any noise.
fields.JP:
ええ、かなり近くにいるみたいね。
クナイ、今はまだ絶対に音立てちゃダメよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, pretty darn close I bet.
Kunai, don't make any noise.

fields.EN: Got it. I'll hide until you give me the O-K!
fields.JP:
はいっ、みなさんがいいって言うまで
じっとしてます……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. I'll hide until you give me the O-K!

fields.EN:
So, whose got a plan? Shall we run away,
or do we fight?
fields.JP:
それで、どうするんですの？
やりすごすか、それとも戦うか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, whose got a plan? Shall we run away,
or do we fight?

fields.EN:
I feel like we should avoid confrontation
if at all possible.
fields.JP:
あたしは、無理に戦わなくても
いいと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel like we should avoid confrontation
if at all possible.

fields.EN:
Am I hearing this right? You want us
to run? I hope this is the confident you
speaking.
fields.JP:
それが赤姉の自信を持った判断って言うなら、
ちゃんと聞くけど……違うんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Am I hearing this right? You want us
to run? I hope this is the confident you
speaking.

fields.EN:
We've searched all over this place and
haven't seen anyone. That way's the only
way forward.
fields.JP:
ここまで探索しても、
誰も見つけられなかったのよ？
それならもう、先に進むしかないと思うの
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've searched all over this place and
haven't seen anyone. That way's the only
way forward.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime-san's not wrong. Let's slay that
beast and be on with it.
fields.JP:
親指姫さんに賛成ですわ。
ナイトメアを倒して、道を開きましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina's not wrong. Let's slay that
beast and be on with it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Even without the core's protection, that's
one Nightmare against us three.
fields.JP:
いくら不死性が無くなったとは言っても、
あたしたち３人だけだからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even without the core's protection, that's
one Nightmare against us three.

fields.EN: But there's nothing else between us and it now. All right, you two—let's fight.
fields.JP:
でも手前にはもう何もないんだもんね。
分かったよ２人とも、戦おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
But sometimes you gotta get your hands
a little dirty. Right on, you two. Show time.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
If you've got your heart in it, then I'm
right behind you.
fields.JP:
赤姉がそうやって決めてくれると、
わたしたちも気が引き締まるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you've got your heart in it, then I'm
right behind you.

fields.JP: そ、そんな持ち上げなくていいってば
本当のことなのになあ

まあいいわ。じゃあ赤姉、
ビシッと号令よろしく
fields.LOCALIZED: Whatever. Sister Red, on your command.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Hey, both of you promise me you won't
push yourselves. In case of emergency,
fall back, um―
fields.JP:
みんな、絶対に無理しないでね。
あと危ないと思ったら後ろに下がって、
それで、ええと――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, both of you promise me you won't
push yourselves. In case of emergency,
fall back, um―

fields.JP: とにかく、ゴーって言ってくれればいいのよ

もうっ、分かったよ！
みんな行くよー！

fields.EN: We're actually managing to wound it!
fields.JP: ちゃんと傷、つけることができてますわ！

fields.EN:
Yes. Good thing we got rid of that core!
It's starting to work, keep going.
fields.JP:
ええ、核を破壊した甲斐があったわね。
不死性がなければこっちのものよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Good thing we got rid of that core!
It's starting to work, keep going.

fields.EN: This isn't over yet. Don't get complacent.
fields.JP: でもみんな、油断しちゃだめだからね
fields.LOCALIZED: This isn't over yet. Don't get complacent.

fields.EN:
Right. We're about to find out what a
Nightmare looks like when it's desperate.
fields.JP:
そうね、きっと追いつめられてるから、
あっちも死にものぐるいで来るしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We're about to find out what a
Nightmare looks like when it's desperate.

fields.EN:
(Ew. Could Nightmares look any less creepy?
Wish I could turn away...)
fields.JP:
（ほんと、このナイトメアっていうのは
　不気味な姿をしているよね。
　直視したくないっていうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ew. Could Nightmares look any less creepy?
Wish I could turn away...)

fields.EN: Hey! You girls got this! Stick together!
fields.JP:
みなさん、わたくしはここから応援してます！
勝って下さいね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! You girls got this! Stick together!

fields.EN:
(I gotta focus. Any mistakes could put Kunai
at risk.)
fields.JP:
（おっと集中集中。あたしがやられたら、
　クナイもきっと無事じゃ済まない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I gotta focus. Any mistakes could put Kunai
at risk.)

fields.JP: ごぎぎぎぎぎぃぃぃっ！
来るよ！　みんな、気をつけて！

はぁっ、はぁっ……
やっと倒した……

化け物がついに……
みなさん、おめでとうございます！

fields.EN:
Do I live up to my reputation or what,
Kunai-san?
fields.JP: クナイさん、わたくしの活躍ご覧になりまして？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do I live up to my reputation or what,
Kunai?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: クナイさん => Kunai-san

fields.JP:
もちろんです！
カッコよかったですよ～
そうでしょうそうでしょう！

シンデレラってば、
あんなにはしゃいじゃって

fields.EN:
...How you feeling, Aka-nee? We took
down the Nightmare no problem.
fields.JP:
……よかったね、赤姉。
無事にナイトメア倒せて
fields.LOCALIZED:
...How you feeling, Sister Red? We took
down the Nightmare no problem.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Yeah. The jitters got to me at first, but we
did it. Now we go in further.
fields.JP:
うん……久しぶりで緊張したけど、
何とかなったね。これでさらに奥に行けるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. The jitters got to me at first, but we
did it. Now we go in further.

fields.EN:
Okay, everyone. Just a little more, then
a well-deserved break.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあみんな、
少し休憩したら出発しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, everyone. Just a little more, then
a well-deserved break.

fields.EN: One step closer to finding our friends!
fields.JP: これで安心してみんなを探せますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: One step closer to finding our friends!

fields.JP: （よかった、誰にも被害がなくて……）

fields.EN:
You know I gotta say. Feels a lot better to
walk in the Jail knowing the Nightmare's
gone.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアがいないって分かってると、
監獄塔の中とはいえ、気持ちが
軽くなるものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know I gotta say. Feels a lot better to
walk in the Jail knowing the Nightmare's
gone.

fields.EN:
Indeed. It puts the mind at ease while
exploring. Especially with how far in
we've gone.
fields.JP:
確かに、探索もこれまで以上に
はかどるって気がしますね。
もう奥まで来ちゃいましたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. It puts the mind at ease while
exploring. Especially with how far in
we've gone.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Proof we can hold our own without
Jack and the others.
fields.JP:
ふふん、意外とジャックたちがいなくても
何とかなるものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Proof we can hold our own without
Jack and the others.

fields.EN:
A fact most evident in how efficiently
we work in combat together.
fields.JP:
やっぱり一緒にやってきた時間が
戦いにでてますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
A fact most evident in how efficiently
we work in combat together.

fields.EN:
We're practically veterans of the Dawn.
There's history between us three.
fields.JP:
これが黎明初期メンバーの強さってやつね。
年期が違うのよ、年期が
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're practically veterans of the Dawn.
There's history between us three.

fields.EN:
I guess all those years wandering the
Jail with Akazukin-san are finally
paying off.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんに連れられて、
ジェイルに潜ってただけはありますわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess all those years wandering the
Jail with Red Riding Hood are finally
paying off.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Glad you've found a silver lining in
all this.
fields.JP:
まあ、あの日々が役に立っているのは
あたしも実感してるけどさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad you've found a silver lining in
all this.

fields.EN:
(Those early exploring days we spent
in our childhood... They actually liked
them?)
fields.JP:
（子どもの頃のあの探索の日々を、
　２人も役に立ってるって思ってくれてるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Those early exploring days we spent
in our childhood... They actually liked
them?)

fields.EN:
(Guess we are veterans. Strong ones, at
that. Almost brings a tear to my eye.)
fields.JP:
（初期メンバーは強い、か。
　なんか嬉しいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess we are veterans. Strong ones, at
that. Almost brings a tear to my eye.)

fields.EN: No fair, you guys. I wasn't there back then!
fields.JP:
なーんかみなさんだけ
楽しそうでずるいです～
fields.LOCALIZED: No fair, you guys. I wasn't there back then!

fields.EN:
I'm so jealous you guys grew up together.
I wasn't an original Dawn member, so I'm
totally left out here.
fields.JP:
いいなあ、子どもの頃から一緒で。
わたくしは黎明の初期メンバーじゃないから、
みなさんとの思い出もないですし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so jealous you guys grew up together.
I wasn't an original Dawn member, so I'm
totally left out here.

fields.EN:
Not even a Blood Maiden either, so I don't
get to participate in any of the cool stuff.
fields.JP:
何より血式少女じゃないから、
ジェイルに潜ったりもできません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not even a Blood Maiden either, so I don't
get to participate in any of the cool stuff.

fields.EN:
Oh, Kunai. Guess this is your first tour
of a Jail. What do you think?
fields.JP:
ほほう、じゃあクナイはようやく今、
念願のジェイルに来られたってわけね。
それで、感想は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Kunai. Guess this is your first tour
of a Jail. What do you think?

fields.EN:
This is a cold, horrible place.
How you did it, I'll never know...
fields.JP:
寒いし怖いしで最悪です。
二度と来たくありません……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a cold, horrible place.
How you did it, I'll never know...

fields.EN:
Hehe. In ideal circumstances,
we wouldn't have needed to.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ジェイルなんて行かなくていいなら、
絶対に行きたくなんてありませんわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. In ideal circumstances,
we wouldn't have needed to.

fields.EN:
I just never knew I could miss anything
more than I miss my bed.
fields.JP:
こんなにベッドが恋しくなるとは、
思ってもみませんでしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just never knew I could miss anything
more than I miss my bed.

fields.EN:
Yup, hear you there. Feels like ages since
I slept on a nice bed.
fields.JP:
あ、それすごい分かる。
ふかふかのベッドで眠ったのが、
遠い昔のように感じるわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, hear you there. Feels like ages since
I slept on a nice bed.

fields.EN:
You know what this means though?
You're a Jail expert, Kunai-san!
fields.JP:
それが分かったってことは、
クナイさんはもうジェイルマスターですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know what this means though?
You're a Jail expert, Kunai!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: クナイさん => Kunai-san

fields.JP: ええ……そんな称号いりません……
（みんな思った以上に元気そうで、よかった）

fields.EN:
(Until now, I tried convincing myself that
I had to be the leader, the big sister.)
fields.JP:
（これまであたし、
　リーダーだからとか、お姉さんだからとか、
　そんな風に言い聞かせて頑張ってきたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Until now, I tried convincing myself that
I had to be the leader, the big sister.)

fields.EN:
(But strength isn't about what's on the
outside. It's what's on the inside.)
fields.JP:
（そんな風に振る舞わなくても、
　みんなこんなにも気持ちを強く持って
　頑張っていけるものなんだね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But strength isn't about what's on the
outside. It's what's on the inside.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I don't need to impose myself in
any role to lead other people.)
fields.JP:
（別にあたし、無理にリーダーや
　お姉さんぶらなくてもいいのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I don't need to impose myself in
any role to lead other people.)

fields.EN:
(Yeah. That's a lot of pressure to bear.
I mean, I've got my awesome friends by
my side.)
fields.JP:
（うん、これからは無理に
　気を張ったりしないでいこうかな。
　だってこんなに素敵な仲間たちがいるんだもん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yeah. That's a lot of pressure to bear.
I mean, I've got my awesome friends by
my side.)

fields.EN: Oh. Is that the last room?
fields.JP: お、あの部屋で最後かしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Is that the last room?

fields.EN:
So it would seem. I don't see any other
routes.
fields.JP:
そうですわね、この辺りが
監獄塔のいちばん奥のはずですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it would seem. I don't see any other
routes.

fields.EN: Then let's get this over with.
fields.JP: じゃあパパッと調べちゃおうか
fields.LOCALIZED: Then let's get this over with.

fields.EN: Oh, Aka-nee. Don't just go in there!
fields.JP:
あっ、赤姉ってば
いきなりひとりで飛び出さないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Sister Red. Don't just go in there!
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: 大丈夫だって、もうナイトメアもいないし

fields.EN:
You're not quite back to your usual self yet,
Akazukin-san, but you seem a little more like
yourself.
fields.JP:
いつもの赤ずきんさんとまではいきませんけど、
少し雰囲気戻りましたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't quite place my finger on it,
but there's something different
about you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Okay, slowpokes. I'm going in, okay?
fields.JP:
ほら、みんな遅いよ。
あたし開けちゃうからね
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, slowpokes. I'm going in, okay?

fields.EN: Heeeeey. Anyone in here? I'm here to―
fields.JP: おーい、誰かいるー？　助けに来――
fields.LOCALIZED: Heeeeey. Anyone in here? I'm here to―

fields.EN: Alice! Boy is it good to see you!
fields.JP:
アリス……！
よかった、無事だったんだね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice! Boy is it good to see you!

fields.EN: Right back at ya! Oh Jack, it's you.
fields.JP:
それはわたしの台詞よ！
ああっ、ジャック……本当によかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Right back at ya! Oh Jack, it's you.

fields.EN: Are you hurt? Or sick at all?
fields.JP:
どこも怪我してない？
具合も悪くなったりしてない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you hurt? Or sick at all?

fields.EN:
I'm fine. With a little help I managed
to get here mostly in one piece.
fields.JP:
うん、大丈夫だよ。
みんなのおかげでここまで問題なく
来ることができたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine. With a little help I managed
to get here mostly in one piece.

fields.JP: ん……？　アリス、そっちの２人は……

fields.EN: Oh, some new friends. They're Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
ああ、ここに来る途中で出会ったの。
２人とも血式少女なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, some new friends. They're Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
Interesting. Didn't know there were more
of you outside the Dawn.
fields.JP: 驚いたな、黎明以外に血式少女がいたなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting. Didn't know there were more
of you outside the Dawn.

fields.EN:
This is Charlotte, and the red-headed girl
is Mary.
fields.JP:
こっちのお姉さんがシャーロットで、
そっちの赤い髪の子がメアリーよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is Charlotte, and the red-headed girl
is Mary.

fields.EN:
Pleased to meet you. I'm Charlotte.
You must be Jack-kun. Alice has told me all
about you.
fields.JP:
初めまして、シャーロットよ。
あなたがジャックくんね？
アリスから話はたーっくさん聞いてるわよ～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pleased to meet you. I'm Charlotte.
You must be Jack. Alice has told me all
about you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: Oh, um... Hello! Nothing too bad, I hope...?
fields.JP:
え、あ……は、初めまして！
そんなに僕のこと話していたんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, um... Hello! Nothing too bad, I hope...?

fields.EN: Charlotte! Don't give him any ideas!
fields.JP:
シャーロット！　わたしそんなに
ペラペラ喋ってなんかないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Charlotte! Don't give him any ideas!

fields.EN:
I will say. She never once stopped worrying
about you.
fields.JP: でもずーっと心配していたのは本当なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will say. She never once stopped worrying
about you.

fields.JP: そうなんだ……アリス、心配かけてごめんね

fields.EN: It's okay, Jack. Just happy you're safe.
fields.JP:
ううん、いいの。
ジャックが無事だって分かれば、それで……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's okay, Jack. Just happy you're safe.

fields.EN:
Hey Alice. Don't ever lose him again, okay?
Anyway, nice to meet you. Put her there♪
fields.JP:
もうアリスを離しちゃダメよ？
それじゃあこれからよろしくね。
はい、握手♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Alice. Don't ever lose him again, okay?
Anyway, nice to meet you. Put her there♪

fields.JP: はい、よろしくお願いしますっ

fields.EN:
(She seems nice. Nice enough for Alice
to have spilled her guts out to her after
they just met.)
fields.JP:
（優しいお姉さんって感じの人だな。
　短い間にアリスがこんなに気を許すなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She seems nice. Nice enough for Alice
to have spilled her guts out to her after
they just met.)

fields.EN: Um, Mary was it? I'm Jack. Nice to meet you.
fields.JP:
えっと、メアリー……だよね？
僕はジャック。よろしく
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, Mary was it? I'm Jack. Nice to meet you.

fields.JP: えーっと、握手はどうかなって思ったんだけど

あ、ああっ、あくしゅしゅっ……！？
えと、えとですね、あのぉ……
（下がってしまった……何か変な子だなあ）

fields.EN: It got quite lively all of a sudden.
fields.JP: 何だか一気に賑やかになったね
fields.LOCALIZED: It got quite lively all of a sudden.

fields.EN:
Yes. I don't remember the last time I smiled
so much.
fields.JP:
うん、久しぶりに
楽しい気分になれた気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I don't remember the last time I smiled
so much.

fields.EN:
Thank goodness everyone's safe. I'm Tsuu.
This here is Her Highness, Ningyohime.
Pleasure, Charlotte-san and Mary.
fields.JP:
ともあれみんな無事でよかった。
僕はつう。隣にいるのが人魚姫だ。
よろしくね、シャーロットさん、メアリー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness everyone's safe. I'm Otsuu.
This here is Her Highness, Little Mermaid.
Pleasure, Charlotte and Mary.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: どいつもこいつも俺にタメ口か……

fields.EN:
Oh, nothing at all! I just... Yup!
Nothing to see here!
fields.JP:
な、なっなんでもないです
た、タメになるなぁってて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, nothing at all! I just... Yup!
Nothing to see here!

fields.EN: (Guess she's no fan of the spotlight.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (Guess she's no fan of the spotlight.)

fields.EN: I hope we become good friends!
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope we become good friends!

fields.EN:
We have other companions, Miko-san and Mamoru.
Are any others with you, Alice?
fields.JP:
それでアリス、僕たちの方には他に
視子さんやマモルたちがいるんだけど、
君たちの方にも誰かいるかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have other companions, Miko and Mamoru.
Are any others with you, Alice?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN: Yes. We have Hitsuka-san, and a few others.
fields.JP:
わたしたちの方には、
陽司さんたちがいるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. We have Hitsuka, and a few others.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN: Why don't we all gather here?
fields.JP:
それじゃあ改めてみんなを連れて、
ここで合流しようか
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we all gather here?

fields.JP: そうね。じゃあ一旦別れましょう

fields.EN:
Now, we can expand our search further
than ever!
fields.JP:
これで僕たちも、ようやく本格的に
探索を始められそうかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, we can expand our search further
than ever!

fields.EN:
Yes. It looks like Alice's party is about as
big as ours. We can cover more ground.
fields.JP:
うん。アリスたちの方にも
僕たちと同じぐらいの人数がいるみたいだし、
だいぶ動きやすくなりそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It looks like Alice's party is about as
big as ours. We can cover more ground.

fields.JP: あ、アリスさんたち来たよ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN: Hitsuka-san, let me grab some of that.
fields.JP: 陽司さん、やっぱりわたしも荷物持ちます
fields.LOCALIZED: Hitsuka, let me grab some of that.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san

fields.EN:
No. You need to be alert at the first sign
of danger. Let me carry the supplies.
fields.JP:
いや、君たちには戦ってもらってるんだ、
このくらい、役に立たないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You need to be alert at the first sign
of danger. Let me carry the supplies.

fields.EN:
*pant, pant* Who knew camping supplies
were so heavy?
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ……キャンプ道具が、
こんなに重いとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant* Who knew camping supplies
were so heavy?

fields.EN:
Thank the heavens, you're alive!
I was worried sick, I couldn't sleep!
fields.JP:
よかった、無事で……！
ずっとずっと心配していたんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank the heavens, you're alive!
I was worried sick, I couldn't sleep!

fields.EN:
Same here. Hehe. But here you are.
You have no idea how good that feels to say.
fields.JP:
心配かけてごめんね。
ふふ、でもいつものちーちゃんだ。ちょっと安心。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. Hehe. But here you are.
You have no idea how good that feels to say.

fields.EN: (That's sweet. Bet they missed each other.)
fields.JP: （よかった……あの２人も無事に再会できて）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That's sweet. Bet they missed each other.)

fields.EN:
Now that our two parties are merging,
let's all discuss what we know.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ２つのグループが
合流したところで、まずは今まで何があったか、
情報の共有をしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that our two parties are merging,
let's all discuss what we know.

fields.EN:
I count three among us whom I do not
recognize...
fields.JP: 見たことがない人たちが、３人もいるしね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I count three among us whom I do not
recognize...

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Yes. As long as it stands, no one is safe.
fields.JP:
そう。あれがある限り、
人はまともに外を歩くことなどできないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. As long as it stands, no one is safe.

fields.EN: What's stopping us from going there?
fields.JP:
その監隊塔のそばに
近づかなければいい話じゃないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's stopping us from going there?

fields.EN:
It's not that easy. If I recall correctly, it
moves on its own and eats anything it
sees. Right Gatou-san?
fields.JP:
いいえ。あの悪食の監隊塔は確か、
『自ら動いてあらゆるものを喰い続ける』って……
そうでしたよね、賀東さん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that easy. If I recall correctly, it
moves on its own and eats anything it
sees. Right Gato?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: What the...? A tower that moves and eats?
fields.JP: 何だそりゃ……塔が自ら動いて食べるって……
fields.LOCALIZED: What the...? A tower that moves and eats?

fields.JP: にわかには信じがたいな

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
But it's all true. But I have a hunch staying
in here is our safest option.
fields.JP:
しかしこれは本当のことなんだ。
だから恐らく、今は監獄塔の中が
いちばん安全ってことだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's all true. But I have a hunch staying
in here is our safest option.

fields.EN:
Hold on a second. Didn't you say it eats
whatever it sees? How would a Jail of all
places be safer?
fields.JP:
外が危険なのは分かりましたけど、
だからって何故監獄塔の中が安全なんですか？
あらゆるものを食べるんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on a second. Didn't you say it eats
whatever it sees? How would a Jail of all
places be safer?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Surrounding the Devouring Armada Tower
at all times are countless tubes.
fields.JP:
君たちには見えてなかったかもしれないが、
悪食の監隊塔からはいくつもの
大きな『クダ』が伸びているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surrounding the Devouring Armada Tower
at all times are countless tubes.

fields.EN:
(Didn't I see some of those? They resembled
ivy on a wall.)
fields.JP:
（確かに無数の蔦？　
　のようなものが見えた気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Didn't I see some of those? They resembled
ivy on a wall.)

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
They connect to all of the other Jail towers.
Including the one where we are currently
situated.
fields.JP:
そしてそれらは、別の監獄塔に繋がっている。
ここもクダが伸ばされた監獄塔の１つだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They connect to all of the other Jail towers.
Including the one where we are currently
situated.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Which leads me to believe that any of the
towers under our control will keep us safe
from the big one.
fields.JP:
それで、私はそういった監獄塔については、
襲われないと考えている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which leads me to believe that any of the
towers under our control will keep us safe
from the big one.

fields.EN: What, like some kind of tower hierarchy?
fields.JP:
それって、悪食の監隊塔の
従属だからということですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What, like some kind of tower hierarchy?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I think that's probably it. These subordinate Jail Towers gather nutrients and send them to the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP:
きっと、そういうことだと思う。
これら従属の監獄塔は、養分を集めて
悪食の監隊塔へと送っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe so. The secondary towers produce
energy that is fed to the central tower.

fields.EN:
I see. That saves them from becoming
another course.
fields.JP:
そっか、養分を運ばせているから、
潰さないでくれるんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. That saves them from becoming
another course.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: That's right. Incidentally, the Marchens and Nightmares in these subordinate Jail Towers act to send nutrients to the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP:
それで合ってるはずだよ。ちなみに、
従属の監獄塔のメルヒェンやナイトメアは、
悪食の監隊塔に養分を送るために動いているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Self-preservation. Therefore, all of the
Marchens and Nightmares work together
to keep that Devouring Armada Tower alive.

fields.EN:
Guess the Marchens here are mindless
beasts too.
fields.JP:
その辺りの基本的なメルヒェンの
生態ってのは、変わってないんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess the Marchens here are mindless
beasts too.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I suspect the Marchens supply their energy
through whichever tower they come from.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンは自らの監獄塔に向けて
養分を送っているつもりかもしれないけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suspect the Marchens supply their energy
through whichever tower they come from.

fields.EN:
By the way, anyone know what became
of Genocide Pink?
fields.JP:
そういえば、処刑台少女って何なのか、
賀東さんは分かりますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, anyone know what became
of Massacre Pink?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: いや、よく分からないんだ

fields.EN:
Really? First time Mister Surface doesn't
know what's going on, huh?
fields.JP:
そうですか……地上に詳しい賀東さんでも、
彼女たちについては分からないんですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? First time Mister Surface doesn't
know what's going on, huh?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Sorry. All I know is we haven't much time
left. The Devouring Armada Tower is growing.
fields.JP:
すまない……ただ分かるのは、
あの悪食の監隊塔の動きが活発になり始めてから
現れた気がする、ということくらいなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. All I know is we haven't much time
left. The Devouring Armada Tower is growing.

fields.EN:
(There's a big chance Genocide Pink are
behind the tower's rapid growth...)
fields.JP:
（ということは、悪食の監隊塔と処刑台少女は
　何か関係があるってことなのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's a big chance Massacre Pink are
behind the tower's rapid growth...)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(Guillotine mentioned having a "master"
or something. So much we don't know...)
fields.JP:
（それにギロチンが言っていた
　『マスター』という存在も気になるし……
　まだまだ謎だらけだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guillotine mentioned having a "master"
or something. So much we don't know...)

fields.EN:
What say you, gang? Shall we continue
investigating this tower? We may have
explored every nook and cranny.
fields.JP:
みんな、どうする？
この監獄塔をまだ探索するかい？
僕たちの方は探し尽くしたつもりだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
What say you, gang? Shall we continue
investigating this tower? We may have
explored every nook and cranny.

fields.EN: Did you skip anywhere on your travels, Alice?
fields.JP:
アリスたちの方は
まだ探してないところはある？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you skip anywhere on your travels, Alice?

fields.EN:
No. Our search was pretty thorough.
We found no one else.
fields.JP:
いいえ、くまなく探したわ。
でも他には誰もいなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Our search was pretty thorough.
We found no one else.

fields.EN:
If we want to find the rest of our friends,
we might have to risk venturing outside.
fields.JP:
他の仲間を探すなら、後はもう、
危険を承知で外に出るしかないってことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we want to find the rest of our friends,
we might have to risk venturing outside.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
No. If we're going to travel, it's best for
us to use the orb.
fields.JP:
いや、先に進むのであれば、
そこにある光る球体の中に入るといい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. If we're going to travel, it's best for
us to use the orb.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I stumbled upon a great, big orb of light
while searching for a place to hide.
It links passages between towers.
fields.JP:
逃げ続けていて偶然発見したんだが、
あれは別の監獄塔に繋がっている
fields.LOCALIZED:
I stumbled upon a great, big orb of light
while searching for a place to hide.
It links passages between towers.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Seriously. This tower comprises one of the
many nerves feeding into the great armada.
fields.JP:
ああ、これが恐らく悪食の監隊塔へ養分を送る
クダのような役割を果たしているのだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. This tower comprises one of the
many nerves feeding into the great armada.

fields.EN: I had no idea it worked like that...
fields.JP: そんな風になっていたなんて……

fields.EN:
Which means it might be wise for us to
explore each tower.
fields.JP:
それなら、別の監獄塔を探してみるっていうのも
いいかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means it might be wise for us to
explore each tower.

fields.EN: Yeah. If it's safer inside a Jail Tower than outside, the others might be in some other Jail Tower too.
fields.JP:
だな。外より監獄塔の中の方が
安全だって言うなら、他のみんなも
どこか別の監獄塔にいるかもしんねーしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct. If it's safe for us in here, then any
of the others must be safe too!

fields.JP: は！？　またこんな場所うろつくのかよ！

fields.EN:
Now, now. I'm sure if we stick together,
you'll make it out safely, Mary.
fields.JP: まあまあ、みんなでいれば大丈夫よメアリー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now. I'm sure if we stick together,
you'll make it out safely, Mary.

fields.EN:
That's not the issue. I'm more concerned
with my achy feet.
fields.JP:
そういう問題じゃねーんだ。
俺は静かに暮らしたいって言っただろーが
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not the issue. I'm more concerned
with my achy feet.

fields.JP: ん？　メアリー、どうしたの？

いいいや、なな、何でもないです……よ……
へへ、へへへへへ

fields.EN: (There she goes again. What's her deal?)
fields.JP:
（下がっちゃった……
　やっぱ不思議な子だなあ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (There she goes again. What's her deal?)

fields.EN: Then it's settled. Off to the next tower!
fields.JP: じゃあみんな、早速次の監獄塔に進もうか
fields.LOCALIZED: Then it's settled. Off to the next tower!

fields.EN: I'm...not so sure. Who knows what's in there?
fields.JP:
うん……でもこれ、ちょっと
入るのためらっちゃうね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm...not so sure. Who knows what's in there?

fields.EN:
What do you mean? We have no time to
waste.
fields.JP:
何言ってんだ、立ち止まってらんないんだろ？
なら、先に進むしかないってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean? We have no time to
waste.

fields.EN:
(Mamoru's real courageous. Can't believe
I never noticed before.)
fields.JP:
（初めて見る装置なのに、
　マモルは相変わらずすごい度胸だなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mamoru's real courageous. Can't believe
I never noticed before.)

fields.EN:
(That's right. I won't let anything stand in
our way.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、僕たちはみんなと再会して、
　平穏な日々を手に入れるまで立ち止まれないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. I won't let anything stand in
our way.)

fields.JP: 待ってよマモル、僕も行くよ！！

fields.EN:
(We went through the orb, and it warped
us to a new tower.)
fields.JP:
（あれから、光る球体を使ってみた。
　確かに新しい監獄塔に移動することができた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We went through the orb, and it warped
us to a new tower.)

fields.EN:
(Gatou-san told us this new tower was known
as the Eiserne Jail Tower. The air here feels
stale, precipitating a new kind of terror.)
fields.JP:
（ここは賀東さんいわく、
　アイゼルネの監獄塔と呼ばれているらしい。
　前とまた違った不気味さがある監獄塔だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gato told us this new tower was known
as the Eiserne Jail Tower. The air here feels
stale, precipitating a new kind of terror.)
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
(But we can't stop now. First, we'll set
up camp.)
fields.JP:
（けど怖いと足を止めてもいられない。
　僕たちは早速キャンプ地の設営をした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But we can't stop now. First, we'll set
up camp.)

fields.EN:
(Everyone worked efficiently, expediting
the setup process with our larger crew.)
fields.JP:
（みんなきびきびと動き回っていた。
　前よりも人が増えたこともあって、
　これなら色々なことができそうだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone worked efficiently, expediting
the setup process with our larger crew.)

fields.EN:
I'm putting the shipment you requested
right here, okay Mamoru?
fields.JP:
マモル、頼まれてたやつ、
テントの外に置いておくからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm putting the shipment you requested
right here, okay Mamoru?

fields.EN:
Phew. Looks like we can finally breathe
for a bit.
fields.JP:
ふう、こうやって見ると、
結構物資も増えてきたなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. Looks like we can finally breathe
for a bit.

fields.EN: Nice work, Jack. Have some tea.
fields.JP:
お疲れさま、ジャック。
はい、お茶
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice work, Jack. Have some tea.

fields.EN:
Thanks Alice. I'm just about done here.
How about you?
fields.JP:
ありがとう、アリス。
僕の方は終わったけど、そっちはどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks Alice. I'm just about done here.
How about you?

fields.EN:
Same here. I've been on my feet all day.
I'm tired with a capital "T."
fields.JP:
わたしも終わったわ。
ずっと立ちっぱなしだったから、
さすがに疲れちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. I've been on my feet all day.
I'm tired with a capital "T."

fields.JP: キャンプ、ようやく完成だね

fields.EN: Yup. The culmination of days of hard labor.
fields.JP: ええ。ここ数日の苦労がようやく報われる気分ね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. The culmination of days of hard labor.

fields.EN:
No kidding. My hands are throbbing.
Felt like we'd never run out of things to do.
fields.JP:
ほんと大変だったもんね。
できることが増えると、あれもしたい、
これもしたいってなっちゃったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
No kidding. My hands are throbbing.
Felt like we'd never run out of things to do.

fields.EN: I wish we could live in this feeling forever.
fields.JP: なるべく便利に生活したいものね
fields.LOCALIZED: I wish we could live in this feeling forever.

fields.EN:
But I forget how close we are to stuff
like Marchens or Nightmares lurking at
night.
fields.JP:
でも、こんな光景見てると
忘れそうになるのだけど、ここにもやっぱり
メルヒェンやナイトメアはいるのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I forget how close we are to stuff
like Marchens or Nightmares lurking at
night.

fields.EN:
Right. Even now, they might be just around
the entrance.
fields.JP:
そうだね。今こうしている時にも、
あの出入り口からメルヒェンが現れても
おかしくないんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Even now, they might be just around
the entrance.

fields.EN:
Maybe I let my guard slip... Tomorrow,
we'll pick our search back up with some
renewed perspective.
fields.JP:
わたし、ちょっと気が緩んでたかもしれない。
明日から再開する探索、もっと気を引きしめて
臨まないといけないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I let my guard slip... Tomorrow,
we'll pick our search back up with some
renewed perspective.

fields.EN:
Same here. We have to be sharp, at our
absolute best, to get us and everyone out.
fields.JP:
僕もだ。この光景を壊さないためにも、
もっと人を増やすためにも、頑張らないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. We have to be sharp, at our
absolute best, to get us and everyone out.

fields.EN:
I mean, if anything my guard would have
slipped because I found you.
fields.JP:
でも、こんな風に気が緩むのも、
ジャックたちと再会できたからなのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, if anything my guard would have
slipped because I found you.

fields.EN: If I weren't here with you, Jack, and everyone else, I think I'd still be restless, spending sleepless nights worrying.
fields.JP:
きっとわたし、ジャックやみんなと
一緒じゃなかったら今も気が気じゃなくて、
不安で眠れない日々が続いてたと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
If our paths hadn't crossed, I would have
tossed and turned at night thinking about
you.

fields.EN:
So now I can relax. Enjoy a little reset.
It's assuring, more than anything.
fields.JP:
だから、気を緩めることができて、
また引きしめ直すことができるのが、嬉しい。
それに何より、心強いもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So now I can relax. Enjoy a little reset.
It's assuring, more than anything.

fields.EN:
Being with you ignites this huge flame in me.
Like I'm taken by this rush of courage.
fields.JP:
僕もアリスがそばにいてくれると、
それだけで背中を押してもらえる気がして、
もっと頑張れるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Being with you ignites this huge flame in me.
Like I'm taken by this rush of courage.

fields.JP: 嬉しい……ありがとう、ジャック

fields.EN:
Sorry, I'm talking your ear off. We should rest.
Tomorrow's gonna be a long one.
fields.JP:
いけない、長話しすぎちゃったわね。
明日のためにも、ゆっくり休まないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, I'm talking your ear off. We should rest.
Tomorrow's gonna be a long one.

fields.EN:
True. We can't be nodding off while
we explore.
fields.JP:
そうだね。せっかくの探索なのに、
疲れを残してたらみんなに申し訳ないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. We can't be nodding off while
we explore.

fields.JP: それじゃあまたね、ジャック

fields.EN:
(But the night's still young. Camp's starting
to settle. Maybe I can check in with everyone.)
fields.JP:
（いや、でもまだ時間はある。
　キャンプ設営もようやく落ちついたことだし、
　もう少しだけ何かしようかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But the night's still young. Camp's starting
to settle. Maybe I can check in with everyone.)

fields.EN:
(My head's been so all over the place
so I haven't gotten all caught up!)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、ここのところ忙しくて
　みんなともロクに話せてなかったし、
　ちょっと誰かのところに顔を出してみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My head's been so all over the place
so I haven't gotten all caught up!)

fields.EN:
(At last we kick off our expedition in the
Eiserne tower.)
fields.JP:
（ようやくアイゼルネの監獄塔の
　探索が本格的に開始された）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At last we kick off our expedition in the
Eiserne tower.)

fields.EN:
(Alice, Tsuu, and Ningyohime-san seem
hellbent on finding the others.)
fields.JP:
（アリスやつう、人魚姫さんは
　みんなを探してやるんだって感じで
　とても引き締まった表情だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice, Otsuu, and Little Mermaid seem
hellbent on finding the others.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(It's weird though, Charlotte-san looks stuck
in her own world, smiling from the back.)
fields.JP:
（その後ろをシャーロットさんが
　ニコニコしながらついていくのは、
　少し不思議な光景でもあるけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's weird though, Charlotte looks stuck
in her own world, smiling from the back.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(Mary, on the other hand, looks like she'd
rather be anywhere else. Anytime we lock
eyes she darts away. What a weirdo.)
fields.JP:
（対して、メアリーは面倒そうに見える。
　でも目が合うと途端に慌てたような感じで、
　キリッとしたりもする。本当に不思議な子だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mary, on the other hand, looks like she'd
rather be anywhere else. Anytime we lock
eyes she darts away. What a weirdo.)

fields.EN:
(But more Blood Maidens means more heads
to purify. Whatever. They're giving their all
on the frontline. I gotta do my part too.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても血式少女の人数が増えてきて、
　穢れの浄化が大変だ。でもみんなが前で
　戦ってくれているんだ、僕も頑張らないとね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But more Blood Maidens means more heads
to purify. Whatever. They're giving their all
on the frontline. I gotta do my part too.)

fields.EN:
(Wait a sec. How were they handling
corruption without me...?)
fields.JP:
（ん……？　そういえば僕と合流する前って、
　どうやって穢れを消していたんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait a sec. How were they handling
corruption without me...?)

fields.EN:
Hey Alice, how'd you manage to purify
yourselves without me?
fields.JP:
ねえ、アリスたちは今までどうやって
穢れを浄化していたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Alice, how'd you manage to purify
yourselves without me?

fields.EN: What...? Why are you looking at me?
fields.JP: な、なんだよ、いきなりこっち見んなよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: What...? Why are you looking at me?

fields.EN: Up to now, we've been purifying the Corruption using Mary's matches... but she hardly has any matches left.
fields.JP:
ここまでメアリーのマッチ棒を使うことで、
穢れを浄化していたんだけど……
もうマッチ棒、ほとんどないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first I was saved with the help of Mary's
matches...but she's only got a few left.

fields.EN:
It'll put more of a burden on Jack-kun, but please
stop relying on Mary's matches from now on.
fields.JP:
だから、ジャックくんには負担をかけるけど、
もうメアリーのマッチ棒は当てにしないであげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, for her sake, don't let her use them
all up.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: I don't get it, but sure. Whatever.
fields.JP:
えっと、よく分からないですけど、
当てにしないようにします
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't get it, but sure. Whatever.

fields.EN: I still have a box of 'em.
fields.JP: マッチ棒ならまだ１箱もあんぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I still have a box of 'em.

fields.EN:
No! You still have your whole life ahead of you!
You need to take better care of yourself!
fields.JP:
ダメよ、あなたの一生はまだまだ続くのよ！
もっと自分を大事にしなきゃダメでしょ！
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: Not that crap again. Okay, I'll save 'em.
fields.JP:
な、何だよ、またその話かよ～。
なるべく節約はするっての
fields.LOCALIZED: Not that crap again. Okay, I'll save 'em.

fields.EN:
You have to save them like your life
depends on it, or else!
fields.JP:
二度と使わないくらいの気持ちじゃないと、
あなたが困ることになるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You have to save them like your life
depends on it, or else!

fields.EN:
If I say it's fine, it's fine. Bleh.
Why are you so worked up...?
fields.JP:
俺がいいって言うならいいじゃねーかよ。
んだよ、また怒られるのかよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I say it's fine, it's fine. Bleh.
Why are you so worked up...?

fields.EN:
Whoa. Enough with the hug routine!
You aren't fooling me!
fields.JP:
わっ、また急に抱きしめ作戦か！？
俺は惑わされねえぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Enough with the hug routine!
You aren't fooling me!

fields.EN:
Rgh. But I can't fight it. I can't...
More. Sandwich me more, Charlotte...
Hehehe.
fields.JP:
くっ、でも抗えねえ、いや抗いたくねえ……
もっと……もっと挟んでくれシャーロット……
うへへへへへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh. But I can't fight it. I can't...
More. Sandwich me more, Charlotte...
Hehehe.

fields.JP: （な、なんてだらしない顔なんだ……）
分かってくれた、メアリー？

fields.EN: Yes, I get it. Shut up and keep hugging me.
fields.JP:
おう、分かった、分かったから
もうちょっとぎゅ～っとしてくれ
ぐへへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I get it. Shut up and keep hugging me.

fields.EN:
(Anyway, should keep track of Mary and
her matchsticks.)
fields.JP:
（と、とにかく、
　メアリーのマッチ棒っていうのには、
　何かあるみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Anyway, should keep track of Mary and
her matchsticks.)

fields.EN:
(Sounds like there are some serious
consequences if I don't.)
fields.JP:
（でも聞いてる限り、
　期待はしないでおいた方が良さそうだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sounds like there are some serious
consequences if I don't.)

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san, Mary? The mystery only seems
to thicken with you two.
fields.JP:
そういえばシャーロットさんやメアリーって
経緯を聞けば聞くほど不思議だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, Mary? The mystery only seems
to thicken with you two.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Indeed. How is it possible there are two
Blood Maidens the Dawn didn't know...?
fields.JP:
そうだね、血式少女で解放地区にいたのに、
黎明もわたしたちも知らなかったり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. How is it possible there are two
Blood Maidens the Dawn didn't know...?

fields.EN:
Oh. I know both of you well, Tsuu-kun and
Ningyo-chan.
fields.JP:
あら、私はつうくんも人魚ちゃんも
ちゃーんと知ってるわよー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I know both of you well, Otsuu and
Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうくん => Otsuu-kun | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Tsuu-kun, for example, carries a pocketbook
of Prince Charming quotes to use on you,
Ningyo-chan.
fields.JP:
例えばそうね、つうくんが
人魚ちゃんのために日々、
王子様語録を書きためてることとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, for example, carries a pocketbook
of Prince Charming quotes to use on you,
Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうくん => Otsuu-kun | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
H-how do you know that?!
Not even Jack knows that!
fields.JP:
な、何故それを……！
ジャックも知らないことなのに……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-how do you know that?!
Not even Jack knows that!

fields.EN: 'Hands aren't meant to grip, they're meant to connect,' and 'A single pebble by the roadside can be a reason to hug someone'... Aren't those wonderful?
fields.JP:
『手は握るものじゃない、繋ぐものだ』とか、
『道端の小石ひとつが、抱きしめる理由になる』
なんて素敵だと思うわ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stuff about hands clenched together and
having more love than grains of sand.
Real romantic stuff.

fields.EN: HEEEEEEEEY! How do you know its contents?!
fields.JP:
わーーーーーっ！
何で中身まで知ってるんだーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: HEEEEEEEEY! How do you know its contents?!

fields.EN: I used to have a—how do you call it—vision.
fields.JP:
いや、なーんか昔から
みんなのことが『見えてた』のよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: I used to have a—how do you call it—vision.

fields.JP: まあそういう力が昔あったって思って

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, I never knew how thoughtful you were...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、いつもそうやって
考えてくれてたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, I never knew how thoughtful you were...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
ひひ、姫、できれば
今のことは忘れてくれ……

fields.EN:
Oh, don't think Ningyo-chan's innocent
either. She's written tons of songs about
Tsuu-kun—
fields.JP:
あ、もちろん人魚ちゃんのことも見えてたわよ？
つうくんのことを書いた歌詞が――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, don't think Little Mermaid's innocent
either. She's written tons of songs about
Otsuu—
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうくん => Otsuu-kun | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
ストーーーップ！
それ以上は絶対に言わないで下さい～！
あらそう？　なら止めておくけど

fields.EN:
How exactly does she know so much
about us?
fields.JP:
この人はいったいどこまで
僕たちのことを知っているんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How exactly does she know so much
about us?

fields.EN: I've never even sung in public...
fields.JP: あれは人前で歌ったことなんてないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: I've never even sung in public...

fields.EN:
Damn it, Charlotte! We get you're clairvoyant,
but you can't go around revealing everyone's
secrets!
fields.JP:
もう、シャーロット！
あなたが色々と見えちゃうのは分かるけど、
人の秘密を言うのはよくないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it, Charlotte! We get you're clairvoyant,
but you can't go around revealing everyone's
secrets!

fields.JP: あら、アリスに怒られちゃったわ

fields.EN: Sorry, you two. I just got a tiny mischievous urge.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい２人とも。ほんのちょっとだけ、
いたずら心が芽生えちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, you two. Think I went a little
overboard.

fields.EN:
(I have a special feeling about Charlotte-san's
vision...)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさんの能力、
　何だかとてつもないものな気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have a special feeling about Charlotte's
vision...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(It seems beyond what I've seen other
Blood Maidens do.)
fields.JP:
（これは今までの血式少女の力を
　超えているんじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It seems beyond what I've seen other
Blood Maidens do.)

fields.EN:
(But she said "used to." Wonder if she can't
do it anymore.)
fields.JP:
（でも『昔あった』ってことは、
　今はもう持ってないってことなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But she said "used to." Wonder if she can't
do it anymore.)

fields.EN:
From now on, Charlotte, let's mind our own
business. Especially our friends. Not even as
a joke.
fields.JP:
シャーロット、これからは絶対に
いたずらでも他の人の秘密を
簡単に喋っちゃダメよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
From now on, Charlotte, let's mind our own
business. Especially our friends. Not even as
a joke.

fields.JP: はいはい、分かりました♪

fields.EN: I can never tell with her...
fields.JP: 分かってなさそうなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: I can never tell with her...

fields.EN: (Look at that. Alice is taking charge for once.)
fields.JP:
（意外だな、アリスが年上の人に
　こんな風に言うなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Look at that. Alice is taking charge for once.)

fields.EN:
(They must've gotten close on their travels
together.)
fields.JP:
（僕たちと合流する前に、
　随分仲良くなったんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They must've gotten close on their travels
together.)

fields.EN: Hey Jack. Let's shake a leg.
fields.JP: なー、ジャック、早く行こうぜー
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Jack. Let's shake a leg.

fields.EN:
(Why's she acting chummy all of a sudden?
Progress, I guess.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり何故か一気に馴れ馴れしい感じに……
　いや、そっちの方が嬉しいんだけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why's she acting chummy all of a sudden?
Progress, I guess.)

fields.EN:
You know, Alice, all that talk about you getting
hurt, and there's hardly a scratch on you.
fields.JP:
そういえばアリスが普通に元気だから、
今まで忘れてたんだけどさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, Alice, all that talk about you getting
hurt, and there's hardly a scratch on you.

fields.EN:
Didn't Genocide Pink hurt you badly?
How you holding up?
fields.JP:
アリス、処刑台少女の攻撃で深手を負わされてた
気がするんだけど大丈夫だったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't Massacre Pink hurt you badly?
How you holding up?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Yeah. My wounds were pretty severe.
But Mary found me collapsed on the
ground, and gave me treatment.
fields.JP:
ええ、確かにわたし重傷だったわ。
でも倒れてたところを、ちょうど
メアリーが通りかかってくれたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. My wounds were pretty severe.
But Mary found me collapsed on the
ground, and gave me treatment.

fields.EN: Ah. You took care of her, Mary?
fields.JP: そうか、メアリーが手当してくれたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah. You took care of her, Mary?

fields.EN:
No. Some stranger came up and fixed
her on the spot.
fields.JP:
いや、なんかよくわからねー奴が来て、
パパっと治してったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Some stranger came up and fixed
her on the spot.

fields.EN:
Hey. I thought you're the one who treated
me, Mary. Is that...a lie?
fields.JP:
あら、わたしメアリーが手当てをしてくれたって
聞いた気がするんだけど……違うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey. I thought you're the one who treated
me, Mary. Is that...a lie?

fields.JP: メ　　ア　　リ　　ー？

fields.EN: Well...to tell you the truth, I was hiding.
fields.JP: じ、実は俺、隠れてただけなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well...to tell you the truth, I was hiding.

fields.EN:
Then in walked some random person who said,
"You mustn't die," to Alice and then treated her.
fields.JP:
そしたら、その知らないやつが
『アリス、お前は死んでは駄目なんだ』とか言って
手当していったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then in walked some random person who said,
"You mustn't die," to Alice and then treated her.

fields.EN:
I kept poking my head out to see what they'd
do next, but they left.
Then it was just me and Alice. Sorta...
fields.JP:
どうするのかなーって見てたら
そのままどっか行っちまって
俺とアリスだけが残った……みたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept poking my head out to see what they'd
do next, but they left.
Then it was just me and Alice. Sorta...

fields.EN: Mary, why would you lie about treating Alice?
fields.JP:
メアリー、どうして自分が治したなんて
ウソをついたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, why would you lie about treating Alice?

fields.EN:
Weeeeell, um... I thought if I saved her that
I'd be...cool...
fields.JP:
え、いや、しょしょ、しょのですね、
思わずそこでえっとその、助けたって
ことにしたらカッコいいなーって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Weeeeell, um... I thought if I saved her that
I'd be...cool...

fields.EN:
N-N-N-No! I meant that I cooouldn't
see anything! Because I was so far from
her. Um... Yeah.
fields.JP:
いいいや！　かっこ……
格好が見えなかった、わわわけでして！
そっ、それも遠目だから何にもです、はい
fields.LOCALIZED:
N-N-N-No! I meant that I cooouldn't
see anything! Because I was so far from
her. Um... Yeah.

fields.EN:
I figured it ended up just being us girls
anyway. No harm, no foul.
fields.JP:
で、その時はですね、あた、あたしと
アリスしかいなかったもんで、えーと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured it ended up just being us girls
anyway. No harm, no foul.

fields.EN:
If I told you there was a weird stranger
involved, you would've asked a bunch of
questions.
fields.JP:
よく分からない人がうろついてる、
なんて言ったら、き、きっと
心配しちゃうかなーって思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I told you there was a weird stranger
involved, you would've asked a bunch of
questions.

fields.EN:
Mary, I didn't know you looked out for
the both of us all along.
fields.JP:
メアリー、あなたそんなに
気を遣ってくれていたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, I didn't know you looked out for
the both of us all along.

fields.EN: Yeah, yeah. When there are only one or two of you, it feels pretty lonely. I get it~
fields.JP:
うんうん、まだ１人２人の時って
心細いもんね。分かるよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Being a protector can be quite the
lonely task.

fields.EN:
To think you kept it to yourself just so you
wouldn't worry Alice. I'm proud of you, Mary.
fields.JP:
それなのにアリスに心配かけないように
自分の胸のうちにしまっておくなんて……
えらいわ、メアリー
fields.LOCALIZED:
To think you kept it to yourself just so you
wouldn't worry Alice. I'm proud of you, Mary.

fields.EN:
Ch-Charlotte. Enough with the patronizing
head pats.
fields.JP:
あ、頭撫でるとか、
子ども扱いはやめろよシャーロット……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ch-Charlotte. Enough with the patronizing
head pats.

fields.EN:
Sorry for putting you through that.
Be open with us next time though.
You don't have to suffer alone.
fields.JP:
あなただけに気遣いをさせて、ごめんね。
でもそういうことは、これからはちゃんと言って。
メアリーにだけつらい思いはさせたくないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for putting you through that.
Be open with us next time though.
You don't have to suffer alone.

fields.EN:
Right... Sorry. Maybe we can talk about
it sometime.
fields.JP:
う、うん……すまねえ。
これからはちゃんと言うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right... Sorry. Maybe we can talk about
it sometime.

fields.EN:
(I feel like she dodged the original question.
Then dove headfirst into Charlotte-san.)
fields.JP:
（何か無理矢理に帳尻を合わせたような……
　あ、さりげなくシャーロットさんの
　胸に飛び込んでいった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel like she dodged the original question.
Then dove headfirst into Charlotte.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP: （今確かにセーフって言ったよね！？）

fields.EN:
Hm? What's wrong, Jack? Charlotte's mine.
I'm not sharing.
fields.JP:
ん？　なんだよジャック。
シャーロットは俺のもんだ、やんねーぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's wrong, Jack? Charlotte's mine.
I'm not sharing.

fields.EN: That didn't even cross my mind!
fields.JP: そそ、そういうつもりじゃないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That didn't even cross my mind!

fields.EN: Heh. You can just stand there and watch helplessly while I do whatever I want with this body.
fields.JP:
ふ、お前はそこで指を咥えて見ているがいい。
俺がこの身体を好き放題にするところをな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh. Dream all you want. I'm the only one
she listens to.

fields.EN: Don't be mean. Now Mary, that's enough.
fields.JP:
好き放題になんてさせません。
ほらメアリー、そろそろ離れて
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be mean. Now Mary, that's enough.

fields.EN:
But now we know someone out there saved
me. I'd like to thank them personally.
fields.JP:
でも、私を助けてくれた人が別にいたなんて。
次にもし会えたなら、ぜひお礼がしたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now we know someone out there saved
me. I'd like to thank them personally.

fields.EN:
We hadn't met them in the last tower. 
Whoever they are must be progressing
like us.
fields.JP:
前の監獄塔にはいない様子だったね。
もしかしたら、僕たちみたいに
先に進んでいるのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
We hadn't met them in the last tower. 
Whoever they are must be progressing
like us.

fields.EN: Maybe Alice will get her wish then.
fields.JP: じゃあいつか行く先で会えるかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe Alice will get her wish then.

fields.EN:
(If we do find them, I'll need to thank them
too.)
fields.JP:
（僕もその人に会えたら、
　大事なアリスを助けてくれたお礼を言わなきゃ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we do find them, I'll need to thank them
too.)

fields.EN:
(Still, the question remains as to why
they healed her then left her behind.)
fields.JP:
（でもその人は、どうして治療だけして
　アリスのそばを離れていってしまったんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still, the question remains as to why
they healed her then left her behind.)

fields.EN:
(Guess we can ask when we find them.
Right now the priority is exploring.)
fields.JP:
（まあ、いつか会ったら聞けばいいか。
　今はそれよりも探索の続きだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess we can ask when we find them.
Right now the priority is exploring.)

fields.JP: よしみんな、探索の続きをしよう

fields.EN: Yeah. That means the Nightmare's next!
fields.JP: うん、これでナイトメアを倒すことができるね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. That means the Nightmare's next!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: Aw. Cute little thing's got a death wish.
fields.JP: やっぱり、ただでは破壊させてはくれないようね
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. Cute little thing's got a death wish.

fields.JP: アリスしっかり周りが見えてたわね
あなたに褒められると何か照れるわね

fields.EN: Yeah, yeah. Don't blow smoke up my butt.
fields.JP:
わかったわかった
いちいち労うな陽キャめ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, yeah. Don't blow smoke up my butt.

fields.JP: （しかし、ほんと態度が一変したなぁ）

fields.EN: Huh? Did something break in my pocket?
fields.JP: あれ、ポケットの中の何かが壊れてる……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Did something break in my pocket?

fields.EN: Oh. My watch broke during that last battle...
fields.JP: ん、今の戦いで時計が壊れた……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. My watch broke during that last battle...

fields.EN: You had a watch? And it broke?
fields.JP: 時計なんて持ってたんだ、壊れちゃったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: You had a watch? And it broke?

fields.EN:
Oh. I found this when I found Alice...
What?!
fields.JP:
いや前にアリスが倒れていた所にあって
頂戴したんだけど……んだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I found this when I found Alice...
What?!

fields.JP: それ高級そうな懐中時計だね

fields.EN:
A pocket watch... I thought I'd seen
one before. Expensive, you say?!
fields.JP:
懐中時計……どこかで聞いた気がすんな。
って、これ高級なのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
A pocket watch... I thought I'd seen
one before. Expensive, you say?!

fields.JP: シャーロットは何してる？
よし、これでナイトメア討伐にいけるね
つうくんちょっと待って頂戴
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうくん => Otsuu-kun | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: I don't sense any more cores. We're good!
fields.JP: 核の気配はないからもう大丈夫そうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't sense any more cores. We're good!

fields.EN:
I can still sense the core. Watch out for any 
Nightmares...
fields.JP:
まだ核の気配を感じるわね……。
まだまだナイトメアには油断できないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can still sense the core. Watch out for any 
Nightmares...

fields.EN: You can tell all this, Charlotte-san?!
fields.JP: そんなことわかるんですかシャーロットさん！
fields.LOCALIZED: You can tell all this, Charlotte?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Charlotte supposedly has some kind of vision...
fields.JP:
どうやらなぜかはわからないけど、
シャーロットにはそういう'気配'が見えるらしいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Charlotte supposedly has some kind of vision...

fields.EN: Hehehe. Gonna take out one of my matches...
fields.JP: へっへっへ、いまのうちにマッチを出してと……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. Gonna take out one of my matches...

fields.JP:
しっ！
お前は黙ってろ

fields.EN:
(A watch just came out of the smoke!
Is this what Mary's capable of?)
fields.JP:
（マッチの煙から時計が浮かび上がってきた！
　これがメアリ―の力！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A watch just came out of the smoke!
Is this what Mary's capable of?)

fields.EN: (Wait. I thought she has to save her matches.)
fields.JP: （あれ？ マッチは使っちゃいけなかったんじゃ？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Wait. I thought she has to save her matches.)

fields.EN: All right. And throw it into the core.
fields.JP: うっし、この核へほいっと
fields.LOCALIZED: All right. And throw it into the core.

fields.EN:
What?! You can bring your imagination to
life?!
fields.JP:
えっ！！
想像したものが擬態化されて出てきた！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! You can bring your imagination to
life?!

fields.JP:
バカッ！
静かにしろ！

fields.EN:
Wow. Incredible. You can mimic anything
you imagine!
fields.JP:
こんな想像したものを
そのまんま擬態化できるなんて凄いよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. Incredible. You can mimic anything
you imagine!

fields.JP: ん？　どうかしたの、ジャックくん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Hahaha. You sure did it, Jack!
Let's destroy the core!
fields.JP:
はははっジャックやったな、おい！
よし、核のヤローをぶっ壊してやろうぜ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. You sure did it, Jack!
Let's destroy the core!

fields.EN: Oh Mary. You're opening up to Jack.
fields.JP:
あら、メアリ―ったらすっかり
ジャック君と仲良しね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh Mary. You're opening up to Jack.

fields.JP: （なにか凄いごまかすのに使われたような……）

fields.EN: Let's take care of that core!
fields.JP: そうね、それじゃ核を破壊しましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's take care of that core!

fields.JP: アイゼルネ監獄塔ジェイル
ギィイイエエエエェェェェ！

fields.EN:
Another terrifying scream...
But now we can proceed!
fields.JP:
相変わらずすごい悲鳴……
ともかく、これで先に進めるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another terrifying scream...
But now we can proceed!

fields.EN: That we can, Princess. Come, Jack.
fields.JP:
そうだね姫
それじゃジャック行こうか
fields.LOCALIZED: That we can, Princess. Come, Jack.

fields.EN:
(I wonder what story Charlotte-san's power
comes from. That vision of hers is impressive.)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさんの何かの気配を感じる
　血式能力ってなんの童話が元なのか
　想像もつかないし、凄いけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what story Charlotte's power
comes from. That vision of hers is impressive.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(We should watch out for Mary's matches.
It would be trouble for us if they fell into
the wrong hands.)
fields.JP:
（メアリーのマッチ棒の能力は使い方によっては
　とんでもないことになるんじゃ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We should watch out for Mary's matches.
It would be trouble for us if they fell into
the wrong hands.)

fields.JP: 核の気配は感じないわね

うげぇ……。
と思ったら、辺りが暗くなってきやがった
ナイトメアが近くにいるわね

fields.EN: Jack, cover that flank! Let's strike now!
fields.JP: ジャックこれをチャンスとみて一気に叩こう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, cover that flank! Let's strike now!

fields.JP: うん、わたしもそう思う

fields.EN: Nice call. Just don't overdo it!
fields.JP:
そうだね。
みんな絶対無理はしないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice call. Just don't overdo it!

fields.JP: 相変わらずキモい見た目だぜ

fields.EN:
We destroyed one of its limbs!
Well done, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
部位を破壊できた！
やったねおつうちゃん
fields.LOCALIZED:
We destroyed one of its limbs!
Well done, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Thank you, Princess. Just a little bit more!
fields.JP:
はい姫！
このまま一気に決めましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you, Princess. Just a little bit more!

fields.EN:
Woo. Looks like you guys got it all under
control.
fields.JP: そうね、倒さなきゃいけなさそうね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Woo. Looks like you guys got it all under
control.

fields.EN:
(Why does Charlotte-san always look spaced
out in the back?)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさん？
　どこか他人事のような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why does Charlotte always look spaced
out in the back?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Oh! That's right! I should help too!
fields.JP:
あっ！
そうだわ私も当事者だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! That's right! I should help too!

fields.EN:
Leave the second wave to me!
Give it your all!
fields.JP:
ともかくみんな援護は僕に任せて！
一気に叩こう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave the second wave to me!
Give it your all!

fields.JP: 無事闇が晴れていくわね
へへ、やっぱり実は俺つえぇのかな

fields.EN: Yes, Mary-chan. You were smashing out there.
fields.JP: うん、メアリーちゃんも強かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, Mary. You were smashing out there.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーちゃん => Mary-chan

fields.EN:
What? You heard me... Oh, um, yes.
Thank you, uh...
fields.JP:
え、聞こえてた……はい……。
ありがとう……です。　はい
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You heard me... Oh, um, yes.
Thank you, uh...

fields.EN:
Guess that means we're safe to explore
the area a bit more.
fields.JP: これで安心して先に進めるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess that means we're safe to explore
the area a bit more.

fields.EN:
But we still haven't run into anyone from
the Dawn or the Liberated District.
fields.JP:
今のところ黎明のみんなや解放地区の人、
誰も見つからなかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we still haven't run into anyone from
the Dawn or the Liberated District.

fields.EN: I just hope they're all safe.
fields.JP: みんな無事だといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: I just hope they're all safe.

fields.EN:
They might not be with us, but they are
in spirit!
Keep the faith everyone. For their sake!
fields.JP:
いるかいないかどちらも証明できないなら、
いると思って行動したほうがいいと思うんだ。
希望を捨てずに先に進もうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
They might not be with us, but they are
in spirit!
Keep the faith everyone. For their sake!

fields.JP:
ふふ、確かにそうね
ジャック

fields.EN: Ha. Jack-kun, you're not half bad at speeches.
fields.JP: ふふ、ジャックくん頼もしいわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ha. Jack, you're not half bad at speeches.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: それじゃ先に進みましょう

fields.EN: Oh! Do I spy one of those orbs?
fields.JP:
あっ……！
あれ光る球体じゃないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! Do I spy one of those orbs?

fields.EN: That means we can venture out further.
fields.JP: ということは、また別の場所に行けるのね
fields.LOCALIZED: That means we can venture out further.

fields.EN:
Good. I was beginning to worry we'd
encounter a dead end soon.
fields.JP:
よかった、行き止まりだったら
どうしようかと思ったー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good. I was beginning to worry we'd
encounter a dead end soon.

fields.EN:
We haven't found everyone, but there's
still a chance we will.
fields.JP:
みんなは見つからなかったけど、
可能性は閉ざされずに済んだわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We haven't found everyone, but there's
still a chance we will.

fields.EN: Yeah. Don't give up. Keep searching.
fields.JP: うん。諦めずに探し続けよう
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Don't give up. Keep searching.

fields.EN: Hey, I can see the outside from here.
fields.JP: おい、こっから外が見えるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, I can see the outside from here.

fields.EN:
You're right. The wall's cracked.
How's it on the outside, Mary?
fields.JP:
本当だ、壁がちょっと崩れてるね。
メアリー、外はどんな感じ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. The wall's cracked.
How's it on the outside, Mary?

fields.EN:
Hm. Pretty dystopian, if you ask me.
Nothing but ruins and waste.
Not a soul in sight. Except for some raiders.
fields.JP:
そうだな……まさに世紀末って感じだな。
見渡す限り荒野と廃墟で、人なんか見当たらねえ。
いてもならず者くらいだろうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Pretty dystopian, if you ask me.
Nothing but ruins and waste.
Not a soul in sight. Except for some raiders.

fields.EN:
Though if it were up to me, I'd lead a dashing
charge against the raiders to save a damsel in
distress.
fields.JP:
そんな中、俺は連れ去られたヒロインを
取り戻すために、たったひとりで
ならず者たちを蹴散らしていくんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though if it were up to me, I'd lead a dashing
charge against the raiders to save a damsel in
distress.

fields.EN:
There, I'd find the rat bastard of a raider chief
who kidnapped my damsel.
fields.JP:
ついに敵の首領を追いつめた俺。
しかし奴は卑劣にもヒロインを
人質に取りやがるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There, I'd find the rat bastard of a raider chief
who kidnapped my damsel.

fields.EN:
But thanks to my cunning skill, I succeed in
my rescue mission, and the damsel is mine
forever.
fields.JP:
だが俺は機転を利かせてヒロインを奪い返し、
首領に正義の鉄槌を下すことに成功する。
そしてヒロインといつまでも幸せに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But thanks to my cunning skill, I succeed in
my rescue mission, and the damsel is mine
forever.

fields.EN:
(I don't get it. She's daydreaming again.
Whatever. I'll peek through the hole.)
fields.JP:
（よく分からないけど、
　ひとりの世界に入っちゃったみたいだ……
　まあいいや、僕も見てみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't get it. She's daydreaming again.
Whatever. I'll peek through the hole.)

fields.EN:
(Wow. Mary wasn't kidding. It's all rubble
and ruins. How could anyone live out there?)
fields.JP:
（すごいな、確かにメアリーが
　言ってたように、荒野と廃墟ばかりだ。
　人なんかもう誰もいないんじゃないか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow. Mary wasn't kidding. It's all rubble
and ruins. How could anyone live out there?)

fields.JP: （ん？　今何か動いたような……）
（あっ、あそこに人影が見える！）

はぁっ、はぁっ……
おい、もっと早く走るんだ！

fields.EN: I'm going as fast as I can!
fields.JP: そんなこと言っても、これが全力だっての……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm going as fast as I can!

fields.EN:
Damn it! I didn't know the damn thing would
up and move!
fields.JP:
くそっ、まさか悪食の監隊塔が
急に動き始めるなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it! I didn't know the damn thing would
up and move!

fields.EN: It's no use! There's nowhere to go!
fields.JP: 駄目だ、もうどこにも逃げ場なんてねえよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: It's no use! There's nowhere to go!

fields.EN: Like Hell there isn't... Shoo! SHOO!
fields.JP:
せっかくここまで逃げてきたっていうのに……！
来るな、来るなっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Like Hell there isn't... Shoo! SHOO!

fields.JP:
ひぃっ……！
いやだ、いやだ……！

fields.EN:
Ah. Ahaha... How could I forget?
My new special friend!
fields.JP:
あは、あはは……そうだ、
この前、落とし物を拾ったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Ahaha... How could I forget?
My new special friend!

fields.EN:
It's a cat. A cat! It's not the best teacher,
but the sucker sure can dance!
Are you eating trash again?
fields.JP:
ネコだよネコ、先生が優秀で一気飲みして、
待ち合わせには毎回遅刻して踊りまくって、
生ゴミ食べちゃったんですかあ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a cat. A cat! It's not the best teacher,
but the sucker sure can dance!
Are you eating trash again?

fields.EN:
What are you saying? Are you hallucinating?
Snap out of it!
fields.JP:
なんだよ、お前幻覚でも見てんのか！？
しっかりしろよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you saying? Are you hallucinating?
Snap out of it!

fields.EN: Ahahahaha! This is delicious. So deli—GAH!
fields.JP:
あひゃひゃひゃ、
おいしい、おいし――ぐぺっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ahahahaha! This is delicious. So deli—GAH!

fields.EN:
Oh my God. It swallowed him. All in one gulp.
That damn thing better not still be hungry.
fields.JP:
ああ……飲み込まれちまった……
俺もあんな風にすり潰されるように
吸い取られて終わるのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my God. It swallowed him. All in one gulp.
That damn thing better not still be hungry.

fields.EN: Damn it. Is this it...? Huh? Mom?
fields.JP:
くそっ……ここまでか……
え、母さん……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn it. Is this it...? Huh? Mom?

fields.EN:
Where've you been? I've been looking all
over for you! What? Outer space? What
are you talking about? We're on Earth! EARTH!
fields.JP:
どこ行ってたんだよ、探したんだぞ！
え、宇宙？　何言ってんだ、
ここは地球だよ地球地球地球！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where've you been? I've been looking all
over for you! What? Outer space? What
are you talking about? We're on Earth! EARTH!

fields.EN:
I told you to pick up the trash on Earth!
Dinner will be ready for you when you're
done leaping from the rooftop!
fields.JP:
地球の草むしりしとけって言っただろうが！
終わったらご飯は屋上から飛び降りたところに
用意してあるからさあああああああ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you to pick up the trash on Earth!
Dinner will be ready for you when you're
done leaping from the rooftop!

fields.EN: Okay! Time for dinner! Wait, where's my—AAH!
fields.JP:
ほら、ご飯が迫ってくるよ！
あれ……ご飯にされるの俺じゃん――ぎゃぼっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! Time for dinner! Wait, where's my—AAH!

fields.EN:
(Both of them were totally engulfed by
those tentacles.)
fields.JP: （２人とも触手に飲み込まれてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Both of them were totally engulfed by
those tentacles.)

fields.EN:
Oh, wow. It really did teleport us outta
there. How cool! Man, this place is creepy
though.
fields.JP:
へー、本当に違う場所に出たんすね。
すごい仕組みっす！
しかし、また不気味な所っすね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, wow. It really did teleport us outta
there. How cool! Man, this place is creepy
though.

fields.EN:
Hahaha. All of you can thank me for my
show of bravery to that orb!
fields.JP:
ぬはははっ、これも我が身体を張って
あの球体の安全を確認したおかげだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. All of you can thank me for my
show of bravery to that orb!

fields.EN:
No. You simply charged in before our close
examination.
fields.JP:
私が調べる前に、ハーメルンが勝手に
頭から突っ込んだだけでしょうに
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. You simply charged in before our close
examination.

fields.JP: そ、そんにゃことはないぞ！

fields.EN:
Ah. So you use baby talk when you're
flustered, huh?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. So you use baby talk when you're
flustered, huh?

fields.EN: Oh? Wait, I think I see something in the orb...
fields.JP: あら？　今、球体になにか映ったような……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? Wait, I think I see something in the orb...

fields.EN:
Huh? What do you see?
Let me see...
fields.JP:
え？　なにか見えたんすか？
どれどれ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What do you see?
Let me see...

fields.JP:
たたた……って、あれっ、人の声…？
今、誰か出てきたっすか？

fields.EN:
Wh-What's your problem?! I try summoning
God and I get stuck with a small fry!
fields.JP:
な、なによ、あんた！
素敵な神様が現れるどころか、
ただの雑魚人間じゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What's your problem?! I try summoning
God and I get stuck with a small fry!

fields.JP: あっ、す、すみませんっす！

fields.EN:
Why in the world are you just standing
there like a buffoon?!
fields.JP:
そんなところに誰かがボーッと
突っ立ってるとか、
普通、思わないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why in the world are you just standing
there like a buffoon?!

fields.EN: Oh, um... Wait, hey! You look familiar.
fields.JP:
……あ、はい。えっ、あれ？
どこかで見たことある人っすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, um... Wait, hey! You look familiar.

fields.JP:
ま、まさか……ジ、ジェノサ……！！！
ひぃぃっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Wait... Isn't she in M-Massacre...!
AAAAAH!
fields.notes: B19 removed residual Massacre terminology and restored source meaning

fields.EN:
That weapon... It belongs to Hiaburibashira!
Aah!
fields.JP:
その武器…た、たしか、
火あぶり柱って言う物騒な名前の人っす！
ひぃぃっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That weapon... It belongs to Pyre!
Aah!

fields.EN:
What?! Y-You're with Genocide Pink?!
Why are you here?!
fields.JP:
なんとっ！？
き、貴様は処刑台少女か！
なぜこんなところにいるのだ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! D-Damn you. You're in Massacre Pink?!
What are you doing here?!
fields.notes: B19 removed residual Massacre terminology and restored source meaning

fields.EN:
I, the Demon King Hameln, forbid you from
harming her!
fields.JP:
小娘を傷つけることは、
この大魔王ハーメルンが許さぬぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I, the Demon King Hameln, forbid you from
harming her!

fields.EN:
What's your deal? You sure like to bark.
If you're up for it, then...!
fields.JP:
な、何よいきなりやり合うつもり？
そっちがその気なら、こっちも……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your deal? You sure like to bark.
If you're up for it, then...!

fields.EN:
Our last performance against Genocide Pink
doesn't inspire much confidence, but I guess
we have no choice...
fields.JP:
私達が戦った処刑台少女と同じくらいの強さなら
正直勝てるか未知数ではあるけど……。
やるしかないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our last performance against Massacre Pink
doesn't inspire much confidence, but I guess
we have no choice...
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Aww... Hameln-san, Gretel-san. Please be careful.
fields.JP:
う、うう……
ハーメルンさん、グレーテルさん、
どうか、気をつけて下さいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Aww... Hameln, Gretel. Please be careful.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san; グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
How the heck did you three get here...?
What do I do, what do I do? I can't use my
Gore Suit yet.
fields.JP:
なんでこのタイミングで出るのよ…
どうしよう、どうしよう。
ゴアスーツが使えない時だってのにっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How the heck did you three get here...?
What do I do, what do I do? I can't use my
Gore Suit yet.

fields.EN:
B-But that won't stop me from wiping the
floor with you! Brace yourselves.
fields.JP:
あ、あんたらなんて、簡単に殺せるんだから！
覚悟はできてるんでしょうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But that won't stop me from wiping the
floor with you! Brace yourselves.

fields.EN:
Come at me! The Demon King will show you
the meaning of pain!
fields.JP:
来るがよい！
この大魔王が相手になるぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come at me! The Demon King will show you
the meaning of pain!

fields.EN:
Wh-What the—?! Reinforcements?!
Damn you, that's no fair!
fields.JP:
き、奇襲か！？　援軍か！？
おのれ、貴様、ひきょうだぞっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-What the—?! Reinforcements?!
Damn you, that's no fair!

fields.EN:
Wait! Is that you, Nemu?! Wait, so that
must mean that's...
fields.JP:
えっ、ネムさんっすか？
あれ？　じゃあ、さっき出てきたのって…
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! Is that you, Sleepy?! Wait, so that
must mean that's...

fields.JP:
あいたた……
じゃーん、ラプンツェルだよー！

fields.EN:
What?! Wh-What's going on?!
Explain yourselves!
fields.JP:
なに！？　わ、わけがわからんぞ！
我にちゃんと説明しろー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Wh-What's going on?!
Explain yourselves!

fields.JP:
……うん、うん！
ボクが……説明する……

fields.EN:
Heh. Sounds like there's an interesting
backstory here.
fields.JP:
……ふっ。　よく分からない面白いことが
起きているみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh. Sounds like there's an interesting
backstory here.

fields.EN:
Y-You mean to say, Hiaburibashira-san's not an enemy,
she's one of us?
fields.JP:
……って、つ、つまり今はその、
火あぶり柱さんは敵じゃなくて、
仲間ってことなんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-You mean to say, Pyre's not an enemy,
she's one of us?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 火あぶり柱さん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Hiaburibashira

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
シラは、ボクたちの仲間……

fields.EN:
Huh? I-I'm not your friend! Th-This is just
a temporary truce!
fields.JP:
は？　な、仲間じゃないしっ！
一時的な協定みたいなもんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I-I'm not your friend! Th-This is just
a temporary truce!

fields.JP:
……むぅ、だがそやつは、
人間を殺してたやつではないのか？
ち、違っ、シラは殺してないもん！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(Wait. Come to think of it, I noticed she
was the only one not participating in the
fight.)
fields.JP:
（あれ…？　でもそう言えば、
　あの時はこの子だけが、
　まったく動いてなかったような？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait. Come to think of it, I noticed she
was the only one not participating in the
fight.)

fields.EN: UGH. ANYWAYS! Shira's a good one.
fields.JP:
もー、とにかくっ！
シラはわるいこなんかじゃないよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: UGH. ANYWAYS! Pi's a good one.

fields.EN:
But if she defaults back to Genocide Pink,
then that would make her our enemy still,
right?
fields.JP:
でも、他の処刑台少女の所へ戻ったら、
いずれ敵になる可能性が高いのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if she defaults back to Massacre Pink,
then that would make her our enemy still,
right?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
