fields.EN:
Wouldn't it be in our best interest to snuff
out this threat while we can?
fields.JP:
今のうちに始末しておいた方が、
後々都合がいいんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wouldn't it be in our best interest to snuff
out this threat while we can?

fields.EN:
Uu... No, you can'tーーー!!
Rapunzel will definitely protect Shira!
fields.JP:
うう……そんなの、だめーーー！！
ラプンツェルは、ぜったいシラをまもる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, NO! You can't! I'll protect Pi!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Yup, yup...! Don't understand yet... but NO!
fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
まだ、わからない……ダメ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, yup...! Don't understand yet... but NO!

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Grr. Stop complaining! No mercy for
Genocide Pink! If you won't deal with her,
then I wheeeel!
fields.JP:
ぬぅぅ、ワガママを言うでないっ！
処刑台少女に情けは無用だ！
やらぬのなら、我が殺ってやにゅのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr. Stop compwaining! No mercy for
Massacre Pink! If you won't deal with her,
then I wheeeel!
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology; B17 Hameln speaker fidelity pair 052

fields.EN:
(Wh-Why does she always flub her lines
at the last second?!)
fields.JP: （な、なんで大事なところで噛むんすか……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wh-Why does she always flub her lines
at the last second?!)

fields.JP: 待ちなさい、ハーメルン
うるさい、では突撃ーー―へぷしっ！

fields.EN: W-WAMN YOU! What are you doing, Gretel?!
fields.JP:
お、おにょれっ！
なにをするのだ、グレーテル！！
fields.LOCALIZED: W-WAMN YOU! What are you doing, Gretel?!

fields.EN:
Take it easy. It's unwise for us to engage
our friends. They just got here.
fields.JP:
少しは冷静になりなさい。
ここで折角会えた眠り姫たちと
仲違いするのは、得策ではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take it easy. It's unwise for us to engage
our friends. They just got here.

fields.JP:
ぐれー！
わかってくれたの？
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Back to our conversation, are there any
others around?
fields.JP:
ところで、まだ話の途中だったけれど、
もしかして貴女たち以外にも、
仲間がいるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back to our conversation, are there any
others around?

fields.EN: Yeah, there are! We're with Itsuki and Takumi!
fields.JP:
うんっ、いるよー！
イツキと、タクミ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, there are! We're with Itsuki and Takumi!

fields.EN: On our side, we've got Kaede-san and Sukui-san.
fields.JP:
こっちは、自分たちの他には、
カエデさんとスクイさんがいるっす
fields.LOCALIZED: On our side, we've got Kaede and Sukui.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san; スクイさん => Sukui-san

fields.EN:
And as you may have gathered, we seem to
be inside a new kind of Jail. We should set
this area as a rendezvous point.
fields.JP:
この場所は恐らく、見ての通りの
新しいジェイル…監獄塔。
合流するならこの場所が最適でしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
And as you may have gathered, we seem to
be inside a new kind of Jail. We should set
this area as a rendezvous point.

fields.EN:
We should head back and gather our
bearings then meet back here.
fields.JP:
お互いに仲間と荷物を集めてから、
再度ここへ集まりましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should head back and gather our
bearings then meet back here.

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: んー？　シラ、なんかいった？
な、何でもないわ、独り言よ

fields.EN: Gretel-san, that was pretty merciful of you.
fields.JP:
なんだか、グレーテルさんらしからぬ
優しさっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel, that was pretty merciful of you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Hehehe. You think? Wouldn't you hope for
the same in her position?
fields.JP:
ふふふっ、そう？
でも、実際に仲違いしては困るでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. You think? Wouldn't you hope for
the same in her position?

fields.JP: まぁ、その通りっすけど

fields.EN:
More importantly, she will serve us extremely
well...as collateral.
fields.JP:
それになによりも、彼女は……
人質として有効に使えるかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
More importantly, she will serve us extremely
well...as collateral.

fields.EN:
(A-Ah, I knew that was outta character for
Gretel-san. She's still got it!)
fields.JP:
（ひ、ひええ……やっぱりグレーテルさんは、
　グレーテルさんだったっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A-Ah, I knew that was outta character for
Gretel. She's still got it!)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
(All of us returned to camp to report to
Kaede-san on what we saw.)
fields.JP:
（あれから、一旦キャンプに戻った自分たちは、
　カエデさん達にさっきのことを話したっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All of us returned to camp to report to
Kaede on what we saw.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
(It felt like Kaede-san and Sukui-san's worries
had gone away, and they were thrilled
we found the others! Success!)
fields.JP:
（不安げだったカエデさんやスクイさんも、
　皆さんと再会できると聞いてほっとしてたっす！
　本当によかったっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It felt like Kaede and Sukui's worries
had gone away, and they were thrilled
we found the others! Success!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san; スクイさん => Sukui-san

fields.EN:
(We banded together and got to reunite
with Rapu-san!)
fields.JP:
（そして自分たちはすぐ引っ越しの準備をして
　ラプさん達と合流したっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We banded together and got to reunite
with Rappy!)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(With our old friends in tow, we immediately
got to work setting up camp, where we could
share what we'd learned.)
fields.JP:
（新しい仲間たちと、早速キャンプ地の
　設営をしたし、お互いが知っている
　情報を共有したりして……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With our old friends in tow, we immediately
got to work setting up camp, where we could
share what we'd learned.)

fields.EN:
(With so many people on our side, there's
so much for us to do together!)
fields.JP:
（前よりも人が増えたし、これなら色々
　出来なかったこともやれそうっすね！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With so many people on our side, there's
so much for us to do together!)

fields.EN:
This is my chance to stake my claim as
a blood weaponsmith!
fields.JP:
よーし、自分も血式武器制作者として、
名乗りを上げるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my chance to stake my claim as
a blood weaponsmith!

fields.EN: Oh. You can't do that, Clara.
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. You can't do that, Clara.

fields.EN:
What?! Why not?! I want to forge weapons
to help you!
fields.JP:
えーっ！　なんでっすか！
みなさんの役に立つ武器を
バンバン作りたいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Why not?! I want to forge weapons
to help you!

fields.EN:
Indeed. But if you want to aid us, then I
want you to think more carefully about
your role.
fields.JP:
……そう。でも役に立ちたいというのなら、
まずは自分が、人から何を求められているか、
考えた方がいいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. But if you want to aid us, then I
want you to think more carefully about
your role.

fields.EN:
The only person that can purify corruption
other than Jack is you. That is invaluable.
fields.JP:
今の貴女は、ジャックと同じ立場。
人数が増えても、穢れを浄化できるのは
現状はくらら１人だけだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only person that can purify corruption
other than Jack is you. That is invaluable.

fields.EN: Like Jack, you'll need to lead the expedition.
fields.JP:
ジャックと同じように、
探索に出てもらわなくては、
困ってしまうわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Like Jack, you'll need to lead the expedition.

fields.EN:
Oh. You're right. I'm the only one in our
big group who can purify.
fields.JP:
あ……そ、そっすよね。
仲間は一気に増えたけど、
浄化は自分しかできないんすよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. You're right. I'm the only one in our
big group who can purify.

fields.EN:
(Now I know how important Jack-san is for us.
Gotta make everyone proud!)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりジャックさんの存在は
　大きかったんすね……
　自分も頑張らないとっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now I know how important Jack is for us.
Gotta make everyone proud!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Hmph. If I had my Gore Suit, then I wouldn't
have to worry about corruption. Oh well.
fields.JP:
ふん、火あぶり柱のゴアスーツさえ
動けば浄化なんて楽勝なんだけど。
ほんと、仕方ないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. If I had my Gore Suit, then I wouldn't
have to worry about corruption. Oh well.

fields.EN: Hey, bastard! Watch your bratty mouth!
fields.JP:
なにっ、こやつめ！
なんと生意気なやつなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, bastard! Watch your bratty mouth!

fields.EN:
Besides, why would we ask a cold snob
for her help? You good-for-nothing!
fields.JP:
そもそも、貴様はツンケンして
ふんぞり返ってるだけで、
ロクに役に立っていないではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, why would we ask a cold snob
for her help? You good-for-nothing!

fields.JP:
こーらー！　めるんも、シラも！
けんかはだめー！！

fields.EN:
I'd rather you avoid unnecessary quarrels.
Hameln, you're no better than Shira in that
regard.
fields.JP:
無駄な争いはやめて欲しいわね。
それを言うなら、ハーメルン、
貴女もシラと対して変わらないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd rather you avoid unnecessary quarrels.
Hameln, you're no better than Pyre in that
regard.

fields.EN:
Grr! Damn you, Gretel! How dare you insult
the Demon King! Just whose side are you on?!
fields.JP:
うぬぅっ！　グレーテルめっ！
大魔王である我を役立たずだとぉっ！
貴様、どっちの味方なのだっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr! Damn you, Gretel! How dare you insult
the Demon King! Just whose side are you on?!

fields.EN: Sides have nothing to do with it.
fields.JP: そもそもどちらの味方という話ではないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sides have nothing to do with it.

fields.EN:
Damn you! You're supposed to be on MY
side! We're Blood Maidens!
fields.JP:
おにょれぇぇっ！
そこは血式少女である
我の味方をすべきであろうが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn you! You're supposed to be on MY
side! We're Blood Maidens!

fields.EN: Boo. Mel, you're always so mad!
fields.JP: ぶー、めるんは、おこってばっかり！
fields.LOCALIZED: Boo. Mel, you're always so mad!

fields.EN:
Anyway, Clara, take the lead with the
explorations. Got it?
fields.JP:
とにかく、くららは探索に必要な
メンバーだから、頼んだわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, Clara, take the lead with the
explorations. Got it?

fields.EN:
If you say so, then I will. I'll pick up where
Jack-san left off.
fields.JP:
そういうことなら了解っす。
ジャックさんのかわりに、
自分が探索に同行するっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you say so, then I will. I'll pick up where
Jack left off.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Oh, and Shira, one more thing...
fields.JP:
あぁ、それで、シラ。
改めて貴女に確認したいのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, and Pi, one more thing...

fields.EN:
This "Eiserne Jail Tower" is managed by
one of Genocide Pink. Iron Maiden, right?
fields.JP:
この『アイゼルネ監獄塔』というのは、
『アイアン・メイデン』という
処刑台少女が管理していると言ってたわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This "Eiserne Jail Tower" is managed by
one of Massacre Pink. Iron Maiden, right?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
W-Well, yeah...
If no one were around, I'd say...
fields.JP:
ま、まあね……
って、これも、あくまで独り言だけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
W-Well, yeah...
If no one were around, I'd say...

fields.EN:
Iron Maiden... Papa gave Sister Mei
control of this Jail tower.
fields.JP:
『アイアン・メイデン』……
メイ姉さんが、この監獄塔を
パパから任されて管理してるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Iron Maiden... Papa gave Sister Mei
control of this Jail tower.

fields.EN:
(Is she even trying to act discreet?
She's an open book.)
fields.JP:
（独り言だって言うわりには、
　こうやって聞いたら
　結構喋ってくれるんすよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she even trying to act discreet?
She's an open book.)

fields.EN:
Oh, impressive performance. Bodes well
for you that I don't have to torture you to
get information I need.
fields.JP:
……ふぅん、独り言、ね。
尋問をしなくても素直に情報を
吐いてくれるのはとても助かるけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, impressive performance. Bodes well
for you that I don't have to torture you to
get information I need.

fields.EN:
If someone were around, that might count
as treason, wouldn't it?
fields.JP:
貴女のそれは、既にコミュニケーションの
一種ではないのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If someone were around, that might count
as treason, wouldn't it?

fields.JP:
ち、違っ！
何バカなこといってんだかっ！

fields.EN:
(At this rate, with Gretel-san constantly calling
Shira-san out, we'll never get anywhere.)
fields.JP:
（こんな調子でグレーテルさんが
　シラさんにツッコミ入れるから、
　なかなか話が進まないんすよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There Gretel goes, poking Pi's buttons
again.)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
So about the warden. If Iron Maiden is
this Jail's warden...
fields.JP:
ところで、『管理者』についてなのだけれど。
その『アイアン・メイデン』が、
この監獄塔の『管理者』であると言うなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So about the warden. If Iron Maiden is
this Jail's warden...

fields.EN:
...wouldn't she know that we're here
already?
fields.JP:
私たちや貴女の居場所も、
既に把握できているんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...wouldn't she know that we're here
already?

fields.JP:
だとしたら、おかしいわ。
どういうつもり……？

fields.EN:
Shira thought Mei-neesan would come get her
right away...
fields.JP:
メイ姉さん、すぐにシラを
迎えに来てくれると思ったんだけど…
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought Sister Mei would come for me
immediately...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san | Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(They know where she is and still aren't coming for
Shira-san... Don't tell me they abandoned her.)
fields.JP:
（居場所が分かるのに迎えに来ないって……
　まさかシラさんは、捨てられたとか
　じゃないっすよね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If they haven't come for Pi yet...
Don't tell me they've abandoned her.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(They're terrifying people who don't care about
human lives, but even so... I feel sorry for
Shira-san if her family abandoned her.)
fields.JP:
（人の命をなんとも思わない、
　恐ろしい人たちっすけど、家族に捨てられる
　とか、さすがにシラさんが可愛そうっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're monsters who care nothing for
others. But abandoning your family is just...
Poor Pi.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(After nearly dying to Genocide Pink's attack, I
have to admit Shira-san still scares me a little...)
fields.JP:
（正直、処刑台少女の攻撃で
　瀕死になった身としては、
　シラさんが怖いところはあるっすが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I should be terrified of her because of our
run-in with Massacre Pink, but...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Seeing how Rapu-san and Nemu are so fond
of her makes me think I shouldn't be...
Tough to say.)
fields.JP:
（でも、ラプさんやネムさんがあんなに懐いて
　推してるし、自分も何とか怖く無いように
　思いたいっすけど……やっぱり怖いっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seeing how Rappy and Sleepy are so fond
of her makes me think I shouldn't be...
Tough to say.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Grr... Aren't you all done yet? I'm getting
sleepy!
fields.JP:
むぅぅ……話し合いはまだ終わらぬのか？
我はいい加減眠くなってきたぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr... Aren't you all done yet? I'm getting
sleepy!

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ……
もう……起きていられな……くぅ

fields.EN:
Ah, Nemu-Nemu's about to fall asleep!
Rapunzel's tired too! She wants to sleep already!
fields.JP:
あっ、ねむねむがねそーになってる！
ラプンツェルも、つかれたー！
はやくねたいー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HEY! Sleepy's knocking out! I'm tired too!
I wanna go to bed now!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Fine then. Let's rest up so we can set out
first thing tomorrow.
fields.JP:
……はぁ、仕方ないわね
明日の探索に備えて休むとしましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine then. Let's rest up so we can set out
first thing tomorrow.

fields.EN:
Right on. Get some food and sleep in so we're
all in tip-top shape!
fields.JP:
そうっすね。しっかり食べて寝て、
体力を回復させたいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right on. Get some food and sleep in so we're
all in tip-top shape!

fields.EN:
Clara, Hameln, Rapunzel, Nemurihime,
and Shira of Genocide Pink. It'll be the first time
we set out as a group together.
fields.JP:
くらら、ハーメルン、ラプンツェル、
眠り姫に、処刑台少女のシラ……
初めてこのメンバーで探索を行うけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, Hameln, Rapunzel, Sleeping Beauty,
and Pi of Massacre Pink. It'll be the first time
we set out as a group together.
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Who knows what dark adventures await us.
Hehe.
fields.JP:
なかなかもって、先がどうなるか
想像も付かないわね……ふふふっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows what dark adventures await us.
Hehe.

fields.EN:
(Seems like Gretel-san's licking her lips at
what's to come.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさん、予想が付かないことに
　対してワクワクしてるんすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like Gretel's licking her lips at
what's to come.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
*yawn* I slept great. Got some food in me.
Ready to move.
fields.JP:
ふぁぁ……よく寝たっす。
食べる物も食べたし、これで動けるっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*yawn* I slept great. Got some food in me.
Ready to move.

fields.EN:
(It's not a resort, but everyone's really
gotten this camp off the ground!)
fields.JP:
（まだまだ安心とまではいかないけど、
　大分人が住む場所らしくなってきた
　気がするっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's not a resort, but everyone's really
gotten this camp off the ground!)

fields.EN:
(Today, we begin our exploration. I hope
we can make Rapu-san, Nemu, and even Shira-san
feel welcome.)
fields.JP:
（今日から改めて探索開始かぁ……
　合流したラプさんやネムさん、
　シラさんとうまいことやっていきたいっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Today, we begin our exploration. I hope
we can make Rappy, Sleepy, and even Pyre
feel welcome.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Oh, Boss's tie... It was loosening. Glad I
noticed before we set out.
fields.JP:
あっ、師匠のネクタイが……
いつの間にか緩んでたんすね。
探索に出る前に気付いてよかったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Boss's tie... It was loosening. Glad I
noticed before we set out.

fields.EN:
I'll tie it tight so it doesn't get undone.
...There! Perfect.
fields.JP:
解けないように、しっかり巻いて
結んで……と。
よし、これでバッチリっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll tie it tight so it doesn't get undone.
...There! Perfect.

fields.EN:
A big part of me hoped we'd run into Boss
when we were on the move, but I haven't
seen him.
fields.JP:
移動した時、師匠と会えるかもって、
ほんの少しだけ期待したっすけど、
いなかったっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A big part of me hoped we'd run into Boss
when we were on the move, but I haven't
seen him.

fields.EN:
Wonder where he is...
What could he be doing?
fields.JP:
……あの師匠は今、
どこでなにしてるんすかね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wonder where he is...
What could he be doing?

fields.EN:
(But if Genocide Pink managed to get ahold
of him first, then...)
fields.JP:
（あの後、師匠たちが別の処刑台少女と
　バッタリ出くわしたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if Massacre Pink managed to get ahold
of him first, then...)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
No! I can't think like that! Boss wouldn't
die. Won't even think about it.
fields.JP:
…って、縁起でもないことは
考えちゃダメっす！
師匠が死ぬなんて……思わないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! I can't think like that! Boss wouldn't
die. Won't even think about it.

fields.EN:
(Boss would never go down easily.
Trust in him.)
fields.JP:
（あの師匠は、簡単に死ぬタマじゃないっす。
　自分はその直感を信じるだけっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Boss would never go down easily.
Trust in him.)

fields.EN:
Right. Stressing out won't bring him back.
It'll just make me hungry and thirsty.
fields.JP:
……うん、悩んでたって師匠は来ないし、
お腹も空くし、喉だって渇くっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Stressing out won't bring him back.
It'll just make me hungry and thirsty.

fields.EN:
I'll put my best foot forward! I'll lead this
exploration, then we'll find Boss!
fields.JP:
今、自分にできることを精一杯やる！
サクサク探索をして、
とっとと師匠を捜しに行くっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll put my best foot forward! I'll lead this
exploration, then we'll find Boss!

fields.JP: あ、辺りが真っ暗になってきたっす！

fields.EN:
We have no choice.
Let's run for it.
fields.JP:
仕方ない。
逃げるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have no choice.
Let's run for it.

fields.EN:
Wait! This Nightmare should know Shira, so
just wait!
fields.JP:
ま、待って！
ここのナイトメアはシラを知ってるはず、
だからちょっと待って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait! This Nightmare should know me.
Just hold on!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Isn't that unsafe, Shira? You sure?
fields.JP:
シラあぶなくない？
だいじょうぶ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Isn't that unsafe, Pi? You sure?

fields.JP: アイゼルネ監獄塔ナイトメア

そ、そうこうしてたら
来たっすよ……！

fields.EN: Ready to attack at any time.
fields.JP: 我はいつでも動けるようにしておくぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ready to attack at any time.

fields.EN:
I'm Hiaburibashira! Shira of the Genocide Pink,
Hiaburibashira!
fields.JP:
火あぶり柱よ！
処刑台少女のシラ、火あぶり柱よ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I am Pyre! Pyre of Massacre Pink!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
You know me and I know you! Don't attack!
Back off!
fields.JP:
あなたは火あぶり柱を見たことがあるはずよ！
攻撃しないように言われてるでしょ！
ここは退きなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know me and I know you! Don't attack!
Back off!

fields.JP: アイゼルネ監獄塔ナイトメア
も、もしかして……行けそうっすか
アイゼルネ監獄塔ナイトメア
ギギギギィィィィィィィィィ！！！！

fields.EN: Why...? Last time, nothing happened! Why?!
fields.JP:
な、なんで……。
前あった時は何もしてこなかったのに！
なんでなんで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why...? Last time, nothing happened! Why?!

fields.JP: と、ともかく今は退避っすよーー！

はぁはぁ……。
無事逃げられたっす……

fields.EN: Why?! WHY?! It never attacked me before!
fields.JP:
な、なんで！なんで！
前は攻撃なんてしてこなかったのに！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why?! WHY?! It never attacked me before!

fields.EN: (Shira-san... I don't want to think this, but...)
fields.JP:
（シラさん、
　考えたくないっすけど……）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
そうね。
今の状況から推測するに、むぐっ

fields.EN:
You better not say it was because she
was abandoned, Gretel-san!
fields.JP:
'見捨てられた'なんて口が裂けても
言っちゃダメっすよ！
グレーテルさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You better not say it was because she
was abandoned, Gretel!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP:
ナイトメア……
シラを……忘れてる……？

fields.EN: Right! It's just too dumb, is all!
fields.JP:
そ、そうよね！
あいつらお馬鹿だし！
fields.LOCALIZED: Right! It's just too dumb, is all!

fields.EN: Anyway, glad we're all safe! Come on!
fields.JP:
ともかく無事に逃げられて良かったっすね！
先を急ごうっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, glad we're all safe! Come on!

fields.EN: (And I don't know any other way to dodge the subject myself...)
fields.JP:
（と、自分もこんな風に
　ごまかすしか方法を知らないっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Looks like we dodged a bullet back there.)

fields.EN: Hm. Nothing sticks out to me here...
fields.JP:
ふーん、この辺りは
特に変わったものはないっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Nothing sticks out to me here...

fields.EN:
(Ah, there's Shira-san. She doesn't look well.
I wonder if she's depressed.)
fields.JP:
（あ、シラさんっす。
　なんだか、元気がないっすね。
　落ち込んでるんすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, there's Pi. She looks down.
I wonder if something's bothering her.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(I'm still scared of her, but maybe this is
a chance for me to build a bridge. Aw...
Guess I could talk to her.)
fields.JP:
（まだちょっと怖いけど、あんな顔を
　見ちゃったらさすがに気になるっす。
　うう……こ、声、かけてみようかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm still scared of her, but maybe this is
a chance for me to build a bridge. Aw...
Guess I could talk to her.)

fields.EN: U-Um, Shira-san. You don't look well. Are you okay?
fields.JP:
あ、あの～、シラさん。
元気ないみたいっすけど、大丈夫っすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: U-Um, Pi? Why the long face? You okay?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
...I was just thinking about how Mei-neesan
isn't here.
fields.JP: ……メイ姉さん、現れないなと思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I was just thinking about how Sister Mei
isn't here.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
(Oh. She must be sad that her family isn't
coming for her...)
fields.JP:
（あ…家族が迎えに来てくれないから、
　落ち込んでたんすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. She must be sad that her family isn't
coming for her...)

fields.EN:
M-Maybe something else is holding her up.
That has to be it. Cheer up!
fields.JP:
あっ、あの、きっと、別の事で忙しくて
それで来られないだけかもっすよ。
だからその、元気出して下さいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Maybe something else is holding her up.
That has to be it. Cheer up!

fields.EN:
...! I-It's got nothing to do with Shira!
And it's none of your business either!
fields.JP:
……っ！　べ、別にシラには
関係ないことだし！
あんたにも関係ないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh...! Hmph. Doesn't matter to me!
And it's none of your business.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: あはは…ご、ごめんなさいっす

fields.EN:
(Maybe she's not mean, not too scary
neither. In fact, she's kinda cute!)
fields.JP:
（気のせいか、怒ってる割には、
　あんまり怖くないっすね……
　むしろちょっと子供っぽくてかわいいっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she's not mean, not too scary
neither. In fact, she's kinda cute!)

fields.JP: ぬ？　眠り姫、どうかしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? What's the matter, Sleeping Beauty?

fields.EN:
Hey, look! Someone's on the floor.
Looks like a girl!
fields.JP:
あれー？　だれかたおれてる！
おんなのこかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, look! Someone's on the floor.
Looks like a girl!

fields.EN: Th-that's not good! I wonder if she's okay.
fields.JP:
そ、それは大変っす！
そこの人、大丈夫っすかー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Th-that's not good! I wonder if she's okay.

fields.JP:
……ん、ううっ……パパ……ママ……
い…や……

fields.EN:
Oh, she's groaning. She seems pretty
traumatized.
fields.JP:
ああ、酷くうなされてるっす。
よっぽど怖い思いをしたんすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, she's groaning. She seems pretty
traumatized.

fields.EN:
She's cut up pretty bad. Something must've
happened.
fields.JP:
あちこちすりきずだらけだし、
なにかあったのかなー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's cut up pretty bad. Something must've
happened.

fields.EN:
H-Hey, why don't we end our exploration
here and take her back to camp? I'm worried.
fields.JP:
あ、あの、今日は探索を終わりにして、
この子をキャンプで保護してもいいっすか？
自分、気になっちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey, why don't we end our exploration
here and take her back to camp? I'm worried.

fields.EN:
Right. Even a demon can see reason in that.
I shall grant her a special pardon.
fields.JP:
うむ。我も鬼ではないからな。
特別に許可をしてやろうではないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Even a demon can see reason in that.
I shall grant her a special pardon.

fields.EN:
She's a civilian, right? I wonder how she
got here alone.
fields.JP:
この子、一般人よね？
何故こんなところに１人でいたのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's a civilian, right? I wonder how she
got here alone.

fields.EN:
Maybe she got lost after separating from
her parents. I'd like to help her.
fields.JP:
親御さんと離れて、迷子になったんすかね？
できれば、なんとかしてあげたいっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she got lost after separating from
her parents. I'd like to help her.

fields.EN: Let's take her back to camp.
fields.JP:
とにかく、この子をキャンプ地まで
運びましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's take her back to camp.

fields.EN:
Okay. We'll all take turns carrying her.
Guards up, everyone.
fields.JP:
うむ、みんなで交代しながら
そ～っと運ぶのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. We'll all take turns carrying her.
Guards up, everyone.

fields.EN:
When she wakes up, I hope we can help
her out.
fields.JP:
この子の目が覚めたら、
何か力になれるといいっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
When she wakes up, I hope we can help
her out.

fields.EN:
We're almost back at camp. Should be fine
here.
fields.JP:
もうすぐキャンプ地に着くっす。
ここまで来たらもう大丈夫っすよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're almost back at camp. Should be fine
here.

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
……よし、よし。
へいき……だから……

fields.EN:
Oh, we're already back. Let's hurry up so
we can rest up at camp.
fields.JP:
おお、やっとここまで来たのだな。
我は早くテントでごろごろしたいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, we're already back. Let's hurry up so
we can rest up at camp.

fields.EN:
My feet are positively aching. I thought the
plan was to take turns, so why did I end up
doing most of the lifting...?
fields.JP:
ここまで来るのに妙に疲れたのだ。
みんなで交代で運んでたはずなのに、
気のせいか我だけ多かったような……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
My feet are positively aching. I thought the
plan was to take turns, so why did I end up
doing most of the lifting...?

fields.EN:
You're imagining things, Hameln. You're only
tired because you carried her with more
verve than anyone else.
fields.JP:
気のせいよ、ハーメルン。
疲れたのは恐らく、誰よりも気合いを入れて、
その子を運んでいたからでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're imagining things, Hameln. You're only
tired because you carried her with more
verve than anyone else.

fields.EN:
(She didn't imagine anything. Gretel-san's just
messing with her again.)
fields.JP:
（いーや、気のせいじゃないす。
　すごくナチュラルに、グレーテルさんに
　押しつけられてたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She didn't imagine anything. Gretel's just
messing with her again.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Hey! You guys! Stop right there!
fields.JP:
こら～！　あんたたちっ！
止まりなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! You guys! Stop right there!

fields.EN: Huh? Was that Kaede-san? What's happening?
fields.JP:
あれ？　今の声ってカエデさんっすか？
何かあったんすかね
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Was that Kaede? What's happening?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.JP: カエデ、だれかにおこってる？

あれっ…？
だれかがこっちに走って来るっすね？

fields.EN: Oww... We need helmets at this rate.
fields.JP:
いててて……
最近、こんなんばっかりっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oww... We need helmets at this rate.

fields.JP:
つぅぅぅ……
おのれっ！　今度はなんなのだ！

fields.EN: Ouch. I totally bumped my head.
fields.JP:
いたた……
思い切り頭をぶつけちまった
fields.LOCALIZED: Ouch. I totally bumped my head.

fields.JP: ちっ、どこ見て歩いてんだ！

fields.EN: Riley, don't mind them. Let's go.
fields.JP:
ライリー構わない
行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Riley, don't mind them. Let's go.

fields.EN: I know! We got no time to deal with them!
fields.JP:
わかってるって！　汚染動物を倒せる
やつらなんかと関わってられっか
fields.LOCALIZED: I know! We got no time to deal with them!

fields.EN:
Damn them. They bump into us without
even apologizing?! What is with them?!
fields.JP:
ぬぅぅ、ぶつかっておきながら、
謝りもしないだと？
なんなのだあやつらはっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn them. They rudely bump into us
without even apologizing?! Whyat is up
with thyem?!

fields.EN:
Mel, Clara, you guys okay? 
Banged your heads again, huh?
fields.JP:
めるん、くらら、いたくない？
また、あたまごっちーんしてたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mel, Clara, you guys okay? 
Banged your heads again, huh?

fields.JP: あの石頭……すごく痛いのよね

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... OH! Grab them, guys!
They're thieves!
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁっ……
あっ！　君たち、その２人を捕まえてくれ！
泥棒なんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... OH! Grab them, guys!
They're thieves!

fields.JP: んもう、待ちなさいってばー！

はぁっ、はぁっ……
あの子たち、逃げ足が早いわねっ
ばーか！　もう遅いよっ！

fields.EN: What? They're thieves?! A-After them at once!
fields.JP:
なに？　今の２人がぬすっとだと！？
す、すぐに追いかけるぞ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What? They're thieves?! A-After them at once!

fields.EN:
They've already escaped. Like they said,
we were too late.
fields.JP:
そんなことを言ってる間に、
もう消えてしまったわ。
あの２人が言うように遅かったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
They've already escaped. Like they said,
we were too late.

fields.EN: Gretel! Whose side are you on?
fields.JP:
グレーテル～っ！
だから貴様は、どっちの味方なのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel! Whose side are you on?

fields.JP: 私は事実を述べているまでよ

fields.EN:
How weird. Never thought we'd run into
thieves here.
fields.JP:
で、でも、驚いたっす。
まさかこんなところにまで泥棒が出るんすねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How weird. Never thought we'd run into
thieves here.

fields.JP: そうね。確かにこれは予想外だったわ
あーん、もう逃げられちゃったー！

fields.EN:
Luckily Sukui-chan caught them in time, so they
only nicked a couple random pieces of junk.
fields.JP:
不幸中の幸いで、スクイちゃんが
気がついたから、盗られたのは
ガラクタとか適当な物だけっぽかったけどー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Luckily Sukui caught them in time, so they
only nicked a couple random pieces of junk.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: スクイちゃん => Sukui-chan

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... Geez. Thankfully they didn't
trash the place. Just missing some rations.
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁ……んもう、
被害は少なかったとはいえ、
食料も少し盗られちゃったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... Geez. Thankfully they didn't
trash the place. Just missing some rations.

fields.EN:
I let my guard down. Since there were no
other civilians, I didn't prepare for any theft.
fields.JP:
僕も油断していたよ。
住民も見当たらないようなこの場所で、
盗人が出るとは俄には信じられなかったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I let my guard down. Since there were no
other civilians, I didn't prepare for any theft.

fields.EN: Oh! That's right. This is more important.
fields.JP:
あっ！　そうだったっす。
今はこっちの方が重要だったっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! That's right. This is more important.

fields.EN: About her. We found her passed out.
fields.JP:
あの、この子なんすけど、
さっき道ばたで倒れてるのを見つけて……
fields.LOCALIZED: About her. We found her passed out.

fields.EN: What? That's awful. Kaede, you got this?
fields.JP:
なんだって？　それは大変だ。
カエデ、頼んでもいいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: What? That's awful. Kaede, you got this?

fields.EN:
Sure. Sukui and I will keep an eye on her.
Leave it to us.
fields.JP:
ええ、スクイと一緒に看るわ。
こちらに渡してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. Sukui and I will keep an eye on her.
Leave it to us.

fields.EN:
This campground is safe. Get some sleep,
and feel better soon.
fields.JP:
このキャンプ地なら比較的安全っす。
よく休んで、元気出すっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This campground is safe. Get some sleep,
and feel better soon.

fields.EN:
Nice work out there. Rest up, everyone.
Leave the rest to us.
fields.JP:
探索ご苦労様。みんなは休んでて。
後はあたしたちに任せてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice work out there. Rest up, everyone.
Leave the rest to us.

fields.JP: はいっ、この子をお願いするっす！

fields.EN:
Phew. She's in good hands now. She didn't
seem too injured. Hope she gets well soon.
fields.JP:
ふー、これであの子も、一安心っすかね。
大きな外傷もなかったみたいっすけど、
早く元気になるといいっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. She's in good hands now. She didn't
seem too injured. Hope she gets well soon.

fields.EN: Yeah! With food and rest, she'll be good!
fields.JP:
うんっ！　よくねてごはんたべたら、
きっと、すぐげんきになっちゃうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! With food and rest, she'll be good!

fields.EN:
...I-I'm fine. Nothing for any of you to worry
about.
fields.JP:
……べ、別に普通よ。
ラプに心配されるようなことなんてないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I-I'm fine. Nothing for any of you to worry
about.

fields.EN:
(Shira-san still looks down. Maybe it's because no
one's come to get her.)
fields.JP:
（シラさん、迎えが来ないからか、
　やっぱり元気ないっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi seems glum because her family's not
coming for her.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: The core. It looks so menacing.
fields.JP:
お、核っすね
あいかわらず不気味な形っすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: The core. It looks so menacing.

fields.EN: Don't just stand there! The guardian's nearby!
fields.JP:
ボーっとしてるんじゃないわよ！
ここにも番人はいるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't just stand there! The guardian's nearby!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
来るわよ。
構えなさい

fields.EN: I'll get rid of it in a flash!
fields.JP: 我が一瞬で屠ってみせようぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll get rid of it in a flash!

fields.JP:
無事倒せたみたいっすね。
お疲れ様っす！

それでは破壊するぞ！
行くぞー！
ハメルンちゃん待って……

っとと……！
どうしたのだ眠り姫？

ん……シラ……
前みたいの……できる？

fields.EN:
Ohh! You mean when Shira does the WOOO
and lights thingy?!
fields.JP:
あーー！
あの、シラがこあに
ひゅってやってパーってなるやつ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohh! You mean when Pi does the WOOO
and lights thingy?!

fields.EN: I have no idea what you're talking about.
fields.JP: 何のことだからさっぱりわからないっす
fields.LOCALIZED: I have no idea what you're talking about.

fields.EN: Shira can't... This isn't Shira's Jail Tower.
fields.JP:
できない……
ここはシラの監獄塔じゃないから
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't. This isn't my tower.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
んー……んー……
気にしない……ありがとう……
シラ……

……ん？
もちろん……シラお返事していい子……

fields.EN:
I'm not following, but it sounds intriguing.
Fill me in next time.
fields.JP:
何かわからないけど、面白そうな話ね。
今度聞かせてもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not following, but it sounds intriguing.
Fill me in next time.

fields.JP:
それでは破壊するぞーー！
うおりゃぁぁっ！
アイゼルネ監獄塔ジェイル
バギギギアアアァァァァァ……！！

fields.EN:
Wait. There should be multiple cores in
this tower. Don't drop your guard.
fields.JP:
待って、この監獄塔には核が複数あったはず！
まだ油断はできないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. There should be multiple cores in
this tower. Don't drop your guard.

fields.JP:
ええぇ！
そうなんっすか？

fields.EN: That's how it was when Shira came here before.
fields.JP: 前にシラが来たときはそうだったの
fields.LOCALIZED: It was the case last time I was here.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
すごーい！
シラはなんでもしってるね！

fields.EN:
...! A-Anyway, stay alert and keep going!
Don't slow Shira down!
fields.JP:
……ぅ！
と、ともかく油断しないで先にいくわよ！
シラの足を引っ張らないでね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...! Anyway, stay alert and keep going!
Better not slow me down!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(Shira-san really isn't as scary or bad as I
thought.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりシラさんは思ったより
　怖い人でも悪い人でもないっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi's not nearly as bad as I thought she
could be.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: なんにしてもまだまだ油断できないってことっすね

fields.EN:
The Jail's screamed a few times. Maybe it's
vulnerable now.
fields.JP:
何度かジェイルの叫び声があったけど、
不死性は失われたのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail's screamed a few times. Maybe it's
vulnerable now.

fields.EN:
I'm tired of running! Let the Demon King
turn it to dust!
fields.JP:
もう逃げてばかりは疲れたのだーー！
我の魔王の力で塵にしようぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm tired of running! Let the Demon King
turn it to dust!

fields.JP: めるん、ラプンツェルもー！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: What?! Rapunzel's not the Demon King!
fields.JP:
なぬっ！
ラプンツェルは魔王ではないだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! Rapunzel's not the Demon King!

fields.EN:
As far as Shira knows, there shouldn't be any
cores left...
fields.JP:
シラがわかる限りでは
もう核はないとおもうけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: As far as I know, the core should be gone.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Right. In that case, let's proceed and initiate
the fight at once.
fields.JP:
そう、それならそれを信じて
一度戦ってみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. In that case, let's proceed and initiate
the fight at once.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: シラを信じてくれるの？
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Hehe. You're fighting with us. No sense
lying to you.
fields.JP:
ふふ、あなたも戦うんだもの
嘘を言う理由はないでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. You're fighting with us. No sense
lying to you.

fields.EN: Don't look too excited! Let's go!
fields.JP:
な、何か引っかかる気はするけど、
それじゃ行くっすか……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't look too excited! Let's go!

fields.JP: （この瞬間はいつも怖いっす！）
うむ、それでは行くぞーー！
相変わらず気持ち悪い見た目っす……

fields.EN: Shira will make you pay for forgetting her!
fields.JP:
シラを忘れた罰、
受けさせるんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll make you regret forgetting me!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
やったっす！
ふぅぅ……怖かったっす……

fields.EN:
Hahahaha. That fool had one reason for
losing: they made me angry!
fields.JP:
はっはっはっ、あやつの敗因は一つだ。
あやつは我を怒らせたにょだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha. That fool got what was coming
to them! That'll teash you!

fields.EN:
Right. We haven't seen anyone from the
Dawn or the underground yet.
fields.JP:
そうね、ここまで黎明や地下監獄にいた人間は
見なかったわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We haven't seen anyone from the
Dawn or the underground yet.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime, I know they're safe.
Take it from me, the Demon King!
fields.JP:
眠り姫よあやつらは早々に死ぬやつらではない、
我が認めたやつらだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty, I know they're safe.
Take it from me, the Demon King!

fields.JP: ねむねむ、だいじょうぶだよ！

fields.EN:
Yeah! We still have a lot of ground to cover.
Stick close and scan the area.
fields.JP:
そうっすよ！
まだまだ先はありそうですし、
注意深く探していくっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! We still have a lot of ground to cover.
Stick close and scan the area.

fields.JP:
ん…ん…！
みんな……ありがとう……

fields.EN:
The orb in question is back here.
Think it's connected to another tower?
fields.JP:
奥で例の球体を見つけたわ。
ねぇ、これもまた別の監獄塔へと
繋がっているのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The orb in question is back here.
Think it's connected to another tower?

fields.EN:
...Yes. This is a teleportation device designed
to warp you to another location.
fields.JP: ……そう。別の場所への移動装置よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Yes. This is a teleportation device designed
to warp you to another location.

fields.EN:
Oh, so you're joining the conversation for
once instead of talking to yourself?
fields.JP:
あら、今回は独り言じゃなく、
素直に返事をしてくれるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so you're joining the conversation for
once instead of talking to yourself?

fields.EN:
I see. You're not giving up. Your allegiances
are conflicted.
fields.JP:
なるほどね。素直になったというよりも、
心ここにあらずといったところかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. You're not giving up. Your allegiances
are conflicted.

fields.EN:
Watching the bratty one doubt herself
is a curious sight.
fields.JP:
こ生意気なヤツが急に素直になると、
こっちまで調子が狂うのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Watching the bratty one doubt herself
is a curious sight.

fields.EN:
(So Shira-san is down because her older sister named
Iron Maiden never came...)
fields.JP:
（結局、『アイアン・メイデン』って言う
　お姉さんが来なかったから、
　シラさんは落ち込んでるんすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems more like Pi's upset that her older
sister didn't come to save her...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Hey, where's Shira's sister? Isn't she near?
fields.JP:
ねーねー、シラのわるいおねえさんって、
けっきょく、どこにもいなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, where's Pi's sister? Isn't she near?

fields.JP:
……っ！
い、いなかったけど、それがなによ

fields.EN:
Mei-neesan is smart and pretty. I'm sure
she's just carrying out Papa's orders.
fields.JP:
メイ姉さんは有能だし多忙だから、
今頃はパパの命令で、
あちこち飛び回ってるんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Mei is smart and pretty. I'm sure
she's just carrying out Papa's orders.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
I just gotta wait around you weaklings until
she's done with her business.
fields.JP:
忙しくて、迎えだとか
ここにいる雑魚たちを
構いにくる暇なんかないだけよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just gotta wait around you weaklings until
she's done with her business.

fields.EN:
Ohh, then Shira can stay with Rapunzel
and the others for a long time yet!
fields.JP:
そっかー、それじゃあシラは
まだまだラプンツェルたちといっしょに
いられるんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. Means you'll stay, right?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: シラと……一緒だと、ボクも……嬉しい

fields.EN:
...R-Right. If you guys like me so much,
then I guess you can have me.
fields.JP:
……そ、そう。
じゃあ、そんなに一緒がいいのなら、
もう少しくらいはいてやってもいいわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...R-Right. If you guys like me so much,
then I guess you can have me.

fields.JP: わぁい！　シラといっしょ！
まったくもう、大げさに喜ぶんだから

fields.EN:
(Shira-san looks really happy. Rapu-san and Nemu-san
seem to be her salvation.)
fields.JP:
（シラさん、すごく嬉しそうっす。
　ラプさんやネムさんの存在が
　彼女の救いになってるっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi seems happier than she lets on.
Got Rappy and Sleepy to thank for that.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Well, this leads to the next tower.
Let's head back to camp.
fields.JP:
新しい監獄塔への入り口も見つけたし、
一度キャンプへ戻った方が良さそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, this leads to the next tower.
Let's head back to camp.

fields.EN:
Right. We should tell Kaede-san and the others
what's happened.
fields.JP:
そうっすね、カエデさんたちにも
他に移動するかも、って伝えないとっすねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We should tell Kaede and the others
what's happened.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.JP:
……あっ！　お姉さんたち、
お帰りなさいっ！

あっ、この子は……
よかった、元気になったんっすね！

fields.EN:
Hahaha. We appreciate the warm welcome.
You look fit as a fiddle.
fields.JP:
わははっ、出迎えご苦労である。
走れるようになるまで回復したのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. We appreciate the warm welcome.
You look fit as a fiddle.

fields.EN:
Yes. Kaede-san told me everything. You saved me.
Thank you!
fields.JP:
はいっ、カエデさんから聞きました。
みなさんがわたしを助けてくれたんですね。
ありがとうございました！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Kaede told me everything. You saved me.
Thank you!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN: Oh, welcome back. She's just come to.
fields.JP:
あら、みんな、おかえり。
この子、さっき目が覚めたところでね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, welcome back. She's just come to.

fields.EN: We were just talking about who had saved her when all of you happened to come back.
fields.JP:
誰が自分を助けてくれたって話になった時に、
ちょうどみんなが帰って来たってわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Speak of the devil. As soon as I mention you
guys, here you are.

fields.JP:
そーだったんだ。
ちょうどいー、たいみんぐだったねっ！

fields.EN:
Um, I'm Clara.
What's your name?
fields.JP:
あの、自分はくららって言うんすけど、
あなたのお名前は？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, I'm Clara.
What's your name?

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry for not introducing myself.
Hello everyone. My name is Rachel♪
fields.JP:
あっ、先に名乗らなくてごめんなさい。
みなさん初めまして、
わたしは“レイチェル”って言います♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry for not introducing myself.
Hello everyone. My name is Rachel♪

fields.JP: どうぞ、よろしくお願いします

fields.EN: You seem precocious. My name is Gretel.
fields.JP:
ふぅん、随分としっかりした子ね。
私はグレーテル
fields.LOCALIZED: You seem precocious. My name is Gretel.

fields.EN:
This antsy one is the self-proclaimed Demon
King, Hameln.
fields.JP:
こっちの落ち着きのなさそうなのが、
自称魔王のハーメルンよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This antsy one is the self-proclaimed Demon
King, Hameln.

fields.EN:
Hey! It's not self-proclaimed! I am the
great Demon King, Hamelyn!
fields.JP:
じ、自称ではないのだ！
我こそは、大魔王ハーメリュンであるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! It's not self-proclaimed! I am the
Demon Kyng, Hamelyn!

fields.EN: Pleased to meet you, Gretel-san, Hamelyn.
fields.JP:
よろしくお願いします、
グレーテルさん、ハーメリュンさん
fields.LOCALIZED: Pleased to meet you, Gretel, Hamelyn.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Pardon me... My name is Hameln!
fields.JP:
い、今のはちょぴっと噛んだだけでっ、
我はハーメルンなのだっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Pardon me... My name is Hameln!

fields.JP:
ラプンツェルだよーっ！
こっちのこは、シラってゆーの！

fields.EN: I'm Rachel. Nice to meet you, Shira-san.
fields.JP:
レイチェルです。
よろしくお願いしますね、シラさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm Rachel.
Nice to meet you, Pi.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: S-Sorry. Shira-san seems a little tired today.
fields.JP:
す、すまないっす、
今日のシラさん、ちょっと疲れてるみたいっす
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: い、いえいえ、大丈夫ですから

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime just said Professor.
Why does that ring a bell?)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫たちの言う『博士』
　どこかで聞いたことがあるような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya just said Professor.
Why does that ring a bell?)

fields.EN: (I just don't get it. I need to observe.)
fields.JP:
（だが状況が把握しきれない。
　ひとまずは、ことの成り行きを見守るか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I just don't get it. I need to observe.)

fields.EN:
Here I thought the Jail was making all that
noise, but now I realize it was all of you.
fields.JP:
まったく、何やらこっちの監獄塔が
騒がしいと思って来てみれば、
こんなに大勢でいったい何だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here I thought the Jail was making all that
noise, but now I realize it was all of you.

fields.EN:
Hm? Those eyes...
Are those Genocide Pink girls still out there?
fields.JP:
ん……？　君たちのその瞳……
まさかまだジェノサイド・ピンクの
生き残りがいるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Those eyes...
Are those Massacre Pink girls still out there?

fields.EN: There's so many of you... What's going on?
fields.JP:
しかもこんなに多くの人数が……
いったいどういうことなのだ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: There's so many of you... What's going on?

fields.EN: Professor, what are you plotting now?
fields.JP:
博士、今度はいったい
何を企んでいるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Professor, what are you plotting now?

fields.EN: Don't play dumb. Shirayuki, behind me.
fields.JP:
しらばっくれないで。
……白雪、わたしの後ろに来なさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't play dumb. Snow White, behind me.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Glad you're safe, but we can catch up later.
Get away from him.
fields.JP:
無事で何よりだわ。
けど再会を喜び合うのは後で。
博士に気を許しちゃダメよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad you're safe, but we can catch up later.
Get away from him.

fields.EN:
I'm not your dad, I'm not Professor,
I have no idea what you're talking about.
You have me mistaken for someone else.
fields.JP:
『お父さん』も『博士』も、
私には何が何だかさっぱり分からないのだが……
人違いではないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not your dad, I'm not Professor,
I have no idea what you're talking about.
You have me mistaken for someone else.

fields.EN:
Quit the act, you're not fooling anyone.
You didn't even bother to disguise yourself.
fields.JP:
顔を一切変装せずに人違いじゃないかとは、
しらばっくれるのが下手にも程がありますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quit the act, you're not fooling anyone.
You didn't even bother to disguise yourself.

fields.EN: Even if you say that, I truly don't remember. Are you saying every one of you definitely knows me?
fields.JP:
そう言われても、私には本当に覚えがないのだ。
君たちは全員が間違いなく私のことを
知っていると、そう言うのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously, I don't know who you are.
Have we met before?

fields.EN:
What do you mean, "Have we met before?"
All those terrible years under your custody,
and you have the audacity to ask?!
fields.JP:
知っているもなにも、
あんなに長いこと一緒にいて、
何をおっしゃってるんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean, "Have we met before?"
All those terrible years under your custody,
and you have the audacity to ask?!

fields.EN: (I see. It seems this old man they call Professor was close to the Blood Maidens.)
fields.JP:
（なるほど、この博士と呼ばれている老人は、
　血式少女たちと親しい間柄のようだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. Sounds like everyone here's got a
complicated relationship with that
fellow they call the Professor.)

fields.EN:
(But everyone seems shaken, even during
what should be a joyful reunion.)
fields.JP:
（だが地上で散り散りになって、
　ようやく合流できた、という雰囲気でもないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But everyone seems shaken, even during
what should be a joyful reunion.)

fields.EN:
(Leads me to believe they came up together
from underground, but were split apart.)
fields.JP:
（ということは、地下にいる時に
　別れた知り合いということか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Leads me to believe they came up together
from underground, but were split apart.)

fields.EN:
(If that's the case, how in the world did he
get here too?)
fields.JP:
（でもそれなら、この老人は
　どうやって地上に来たんだ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If that's the case, how in the world did he
get here too?)

fields.EN:
Don't think any of us could've predicted
seeing the Professor up here. If anyone's
gotta do it, guess it's us.
fields.JP:
まさかこんなところで博士に
再会するとは思ってなかったけど、
止めるなら今すぐに動くべきよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think any of us could've predicted
seeing the Professor up here. If anyone's
gotta do it, guess it's us.

fields.EN:
S-Sure, but just hold on.
Let me speak with him first.
fields.JP:
そ、そうだよね……でもちょっと待って、
少し話をさせてほしいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-Sure, but just hold on.
Let me speak with him first.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, I don't want to be the one
to say it, but talking to him won't undo the
hurt he caused you.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、あまり言いたくないけれど、
話せば話すほどつらい思いをすると思いますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, I don't want to be the one
to say it, but talking to him won't undo the
hurt he caused you.

fields.EN:
But even so...there's still stuff I wanted to
say back then.
fields.JP:
そ、それでも……
あの時では話せなかったこととか、
あるかもしれないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But even so...there's still stuff I wanted to
say back then.

fields.EN: Wait, don't tell me. Are you Blood Maidens?
fields.JP:
待ってくれ、まさかとは思うが……
君たちは血式少女かい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait, don't tell me. Are you Blood Maidens?

fields.EN:
Still playing coy? You're the one who
gathered and raised us.
fields.JP:
まだしらばっくれるつもりなのですか？
血式少女はそもそも、あなたが集めて
育てた集団じゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still playing coy? You're the one who
gathered and raised us.

fields.EN:
Play dumb all you want, but you can't avoid
your morbid obsession with Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
知らないふりをしても、
わたしたちと血式少女を結びつける時点で、
誤魔化せてなんていないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Play dumb all you want, but you can't avoid
your morbid obsession with Blood Maidens.

fields.EN:
You guys really are Blood Maidens.
Which means you'll be very interested
in what I have to say.
fields.JP:
やはり血式少女なのだな。
それでは、私はこの状況を
収めるためにも告げねばなるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You guys really are Blood Maidens.
Which means you'll be very interested
in what I have to say.

fields.JP: 私の名はジャバウォック……

fields.EN:
The man you know as Professor Tohjima
is my older brother...
fields.JP: 君たちが言う『十島博士』の弟だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The man you know as Professor Tohjima
is my older brother...

fields.EN:
(We're currently in the Eiserne Jail Tower
with Jabberwock.)
fields.JP:
（今僕たちはジャバウォックと共に、
　ここアイゼルネ監獄塔へとやって来ている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're currently in the Eiserne Jail Tower
with Jabberwock.)

fields.EN:
(He diffused the situation, and invited us
to his camp as a gesture of good will.)
fields.JP:
（混乱した状況を収め、整理するためにも、
　彼が自分のキャンプ地へ行こうと提案し、
　それに乗った形だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He diffused the situation, and invited us
to his camp as a gesture of good will.)

fields.EN:
(We managed to move the shiny orb we
found in the back of the Frozen Jail
Tower.)
fields.JP:
（さて、どうやって移動したかと言えば、
　極寒の監獄塔のいちばん奥にあった光る球体、
　その力によってだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We managed to move the shiny orb we
found in the back of the Frozen Jail
Tower.)

fields.EN:
(The orb seems to harness space-time
technology to warp between locations.
With Jabberwork, we traveled through.)
fields.JP:
（どうやら光る球体は空間を繋いでいるらしく、
　ジャバウォックに続いて飛び込んだ僕たちは、
　一瞬で移動したことに驚かざるを得なかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The orb seems to harness space-time
technology to warp between locations.
With Jabberwork, we traveled through.)

fields.EN:
(Nothing can possibly prepare you for
transporting through time and space.)
fields.JP:
（景色が瞬時に切り替わるというのは、
　なかなかに異質な体験だった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nothing can possibly prepare you for
transporting through time and space.)

fields.EN:
(Nevertheless, it was my safe passage out
of that frozen tower.)
fields.JP:
（ともあれ、極寒の監獄塔を抜け出せて、
　本当によかったと思う）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nevertheless, it was my safe passage out
of that frozen tower.)

fields.EN:
(There's something...special about it.
Almost like something calls me to it.)
fields.JP:
（ただ、また監獄塔か……という
　落胆の思いも、同時について回ったわけだが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's something...special about it.
Almost like something calls me to it.)

fields.EN:
Okay, back up. Did you say you're the
Professor's little brother?
fields.JP:
それで、あなたが
博士の弟さんってお話は本当なんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, back up. Did you say you're the
Professor's little brother?

fields.EN:
Technically speaking, we're identical.
Separated by mere minutes, but not
much else. Can't blame you for not knowing.
fields.JP:
私と兄は元々、見た目が瓜二つだったからね。
この地球の姿でも似てしまうのは、仕方ないんだ。
勘違いしてしまうのも無理はない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Technically speaking, we're identical.
Separated by mere minutes, but not
much else. Can't blame you for not knowing.

fields.EN: Sounds fishy. I don't believe it.
fields.JP:
本当かしら。
まだにわかには信じられないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sounds fishy. I don't believe it.

fields.EN:
Knowing Professor, I could see this being
one of his elaborate Jail plots.
fields.JP:
博士なら、生き延びて
こうして別の監獄塔で何かをしていても
おかしくない気がしてしまいます……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowing Professor, I could see this being
one of his elaborate Jail plots.

fields.EN:
It's certainly possible, but highly
unlikely.
fields.JP:
さっきよりはまだマシな言い訳に
聞こえますが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's certainly possible, but highly
unlikely.

fields.EN: I-I still refuse to believe you!
fields.JP: わ、わたくしは信じられませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I still refuse to believe you!

fields.EN:
My eyes haven't left him this whole time.
It's not Dad.
fields.JP:
あれからじっと見てるけど、
確かにこの人はお父さんとは違うよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My eyes haven't left him this whole time.
It's not Dad.

fields.EN:
His face is longer, and his chin's a little
more wrinkled than Dad's.
fields.JP:
だって、お父さんより顔がシュッとしてるし、
口元のしわも、少しだけお父さんより深いもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
His face is longer, and his chin's a little
more wrinkled than Dad's.

fields.EN: I don't see it at ALL! Shirayuki, do you?
fields.JP:
まっっったく違いが分からないわ。
白雪、あなた分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't see it at ALL! Snow White, do you?

fields.EN: No. Looks like the Professor to me.
fields.JP: いえ、博士の顔にしか見えません……
fields.LOCALIZED: No. Looks like the Professor to me.

fields.JP:
本当だってば。
みんな、よく見れば分かるって

fields.EN: I get the feeling maybe only Akazukin can see it that way~
fields.JP:
たぶんそれ、赤ずきんにしか
分からない気がします～
fields.LOCALIZED: I think you've lost your mind.

fields.EN:
This whole situation seems pretty
complicated, I'm not following.
fields.JP:
そこのジャバウォックと君たちは
複雑な関係のようだが、僕にも彼にも、
この状況が掴めない
fields.LOCALIZED:
This whole situation seems pretty
complicated, I'm not following.

fields.EN: Could someone start me from the beginning?
fields.JP: だから順を追って説明してくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Could someone start me from the beginning?

fields.EN:
Wait, I've got an idea. We can figure out if
Jabberwock's lying or not by asking him
questions about the Professor's past.
fields.JP:
確かに、お互いの情報をすり合わせてみれば
ジャバウォックが博士の弟かどうか、
分かるかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, I've got an idea. We can figure out if
Jabberwock's lying or not by asking him
questions about the Professor's past.

fields.EN: Got it. Let me do the talking.
fields.JP: 分かった。じゃああたしが話すよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. Let me do the talking.

fields.EN:
...I see. So the "Professor" raised you guys,
but turned out to be this evil guy named
Snark, who controlled Jail the whole time.
fields.JP:
……なるほど。つまり君たちの育ての親である、
『博士』と呼ばれる人物は、実はあの地下監獄で
暗躍していた黒幕『スナーク』だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I see. So the "Professor" raised you guys,
but turned out to be this evil guy named
Snark, who controlled Jail the whole time.

fields.EN:
He used you to power the Jail for his
own motives, but eventually you found
out.
fields.JP:
そんな博士は君たちを利用し、
自分の野望のために監獄塔を成長させたが、
最後には君たちによって暴かれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
He used you to power the Jail for his
own motives, but eventually you found
out.

fields.EN:
And in the end, you guys escaped
the Jail, but not before killing him...
Did I get all that?
fields.JP:
そして監獄塔と融合した末に
君たちによって殺された……そういうことだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
And in the end, you guys escaped
the Jail, but not before killing him...
Did I get all that?

fields.EN: That's putting it briefly, but yes.
fields.JP: 短く説明してしまえば、その通りですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's putting it briefly, but yes.

fields.JP: なんだ？　何か間違っていたか？

fields.EN:
You're not wrong. Just sounds bad
when you put it that way.
fields.JP:
間違ってないよ。
でもそんな言い方はしないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not wrong. Just sounds bad
when you put it that way.

fields.EN:
We did what we had to survive.
We didn't want to kill him.
fields.JP:
あの時はああしなきゃ、
みんな無事では済まなかった。
殺したくて殺したわけじゃないんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We did what we had to survive.
We didn't want to kill him.

fields.EN:
While that's true, I'm just stating the facts.
Your personal feelings don't change the
outcome.
fields.JP:
でもそれが事実で、僕はそれを述べただけだ。
そこに君たちの感情を考慮する必要はないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
While that's true, I'm just stating the facts.
Your personal feelings don't change the
outcome.

fields.EN:
You weren't there, don't act like you were!
Besides, who are you anyway? We don't
even know your name.
fields.JP:
部外者のくせに軽々しく言わないで！
そもそもあんた誰なのよ！
名前も名乗らないで……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You weren't there, don't act like you were!
Besides, who are you anyway? We don't
even know your name.

fields.EN: If I had a name to give, you'd have it.
fields.JP:
名乗るべき名前があれば、
この場に至るまでに名乗っていたさ
fields.LOCALIZED: If I had a name to give, you'd have it.

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
Oh, dear. Sounds like my brother did some
unspeakable things.
fields.JP: そうか、兄はそんな愚かなことをしたのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, dear. Sounds like my brother did some
unspeakable things.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN:
Please, let me apologize on his behalf.
I am so, so sorry.
fields.JP:
兄の許されざる行いについて、
身内として謝らせてくれ。
本当にすまなかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please, let me apologize on his behalf.
I am so, so sorry.

fields.EN:
If you're not him, then you don't need
to apologize.
fields.JP:
博士じゃないなら、
あなたが謝る必要なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're not him, then you don't need
to apologize.

fields.EN:
She's right. It has nothing to do with
you. You're his little brother.
fields.JP:
そうですよ、弟さんである
あなたには関係がありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. It has nothing to do with
you. You're his little brother.

fields.EN:
Please Jabberwock-san, don't blame yourself.
I'm sure it's hard for you too.
fields.JP:
ジャバウォックさん、頭を上げて。
あなたも事実を知ってつらいでしょ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please Jabberwock, don't blame yourself.
I'm sure it's hard for you too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN:
Jabberwock, how do we know you're not
Snark?
fields.JP:
もしかしてジャバウォック、
お前がスナークじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jabberwock, how do we know you're not
Snark?

fields.EN:
Kind of suspicious for an old man to be
wandering a Jail by himself. Especially
one who looks exactly like its master.
fields.JP:
そもそもこんな老齢の人間が、
監獄塔に１人でいることがおかしいのに、
さらに黒幕と瓜二つの姿で現れる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kind of suspicious for an old man to be
wandering a Jail by himself. Especially
one who looks exactly like its master.

fields.JP: これこそ、不自然極まりないとは思わないか？

fields.EN: That's all it is. Cool it with the accusations.
fields.JP:
そんなのたまたまだって。
それに、そんな風な言い方しなくても……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's all it is. Cool it with the accusations.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, was it?
The one who used faulty proof to draw
her weak conclusion.
fields.JP:
そもそも、赤ずきんと言ったか、
君のジャバウォックはスナークじゃないという
発言も、根拠に乏しいものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, was it?
The one who used faulty proof to draw
her weak conclusion.

fields.EN:
You stated his facial shape alters slightly
from his brother's. Subjective observation.
fields.JP:
輪郭のほんの僅かな違いが、
いったいどれほどの証拠になるというんだ。
あまりにもいい加減すぎるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You stated his facial shape alters slightly
from his brother's. Subjective observation.

fields.EN: If you look closely, you'd see―
fields.JP: だからそれはよく見れば分かるって――
fields.LOCALIZED: If you look closely, you'd see―

fields.EN:
If Jabberwock is indeed Snark, it puts all
of us at risk.
fields.JP:
もしもジャバウォックの正体が
スナークだった場合、ここにいる全員、
全滅だってあり得るんだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Jabberwock is indeed Snark, it puts all
of us at risk.

fields.EN:
What is your problem?! You don't know
anything, but think you know everything!
fields.JP:
さっきから何なのよあんた！
何も知らないくせに当然のように
仕切ってずけずけと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is your problem?! You don't know
anything, but think you know everything!

fields.EN: I saw Dad die right before my eyes!
fields.JP:
あたしたちはお父さんが死んだのを
確かにこの目で見たの！
fields.LOCALIZED: I saw Dad die right before my eyes!

fields.EN:
I lived with him for more than ten years!
I'm the first to tell you if it's him or not!
fields.JP:
それにあたしは十何年とお父さんと暮らしてきた！
だから本物かどうかは分かるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I lived with him for more than ten years!
I'm the first to tell you if it's him or not!

fields.EN:
You lived with him for a decade and
never noticed he was pulling the strings
the whole time.
fields.JP:
その十何年という月日がありながら、
博士が黒幕だと分からなかったのは、
他でもない君だろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You lived with him for a decade and
never noticed he was pulling the strings
the whole time.

fields.EN:
It's true. I didn't realize Dad's true identity
was Snark, but I was in denial.
fields.JP:
確かにあたし、お父さんが
スナークだって見抜けなかった。
だって信じたくなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. I didn't realize Dad's true identity
was Snark, but I was in denial.

fields.EN:
But I can tell you...Jabberwock-san isn't my dad.
I know it!
fields.JP:
でも分かるもん……
ジャバウォックさんはお父さんと違うって、
あたしには分かるもん……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I can tell you...Jabberwock isn't my dad.
I know it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN: Whatever. I'm not arguing with crazy.
fields.JP:
いいや、君の言葉に、
信じるに足る根拠はない
fields.LOCALIZED: Whatever. I'm not arguing with crazy.

fields.EN:
Hey, what is your problem? Quit it already!
You've gone too far!
fields.JP:
ちょっとあなた、
いくら何でも言い過ぎです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, what is your problem? Quit it already!
You've gone too far!

fields.EN:
Yeah! Aka-neesama had no choice but to
kill her father! Grow your heart!
fields.JP:
そうですよ、赤姉様は大好きなお父様を
その手にかけなければならなかったんですよ！？
もう少し言葉に配慮をすべきです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! Sister Red had no choice but to
kill her father! Grow your heart!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
So I'm supposed to go off blind faith?
And put my fate in her hands, knowing
we'd all suffer if she was wrong?
fields.JP:
じゃあ盲目的に赤ずきんの言葉を信じろと？
そんなことをして万が一間違っていたら、
酷い目に遭うのは周りの僕たちなんだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I'm supposed to go off blind faith?
And put my fate in her hands, knowing
we'd all suffer if she was wrong?

fields.JP: いや、赤ずきん君の言葉は正しいなと思ってね
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood, you were right.

fields.EN: You still haven't proved you're not Snark.
fields.JP:
お前がスナークじゃないことは
証明されていないが？
fields.LOCALIZED: You still haven't proved you're not Snark.

fields.EN:
No, no. That's not what I mean.
Akazukin had it right all along.
Just who are you?
fields.JP:
違う違う。そこじゃない。
赤ずきん君は散々言っていただろう？
『あんたは何なんだ』と
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, no. That's not what I mean.
Red Riding Hood had it right all along.
Just who are you?

fields.EN: Why don't you tell us who you are?
fields.JP: まず、君こそいったい何者なんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you tell us who you are?

fields.EN:
Akazukin lived underground and
doesn't recognize you. Not even your name.
You want proof, but you have none yourself.
fields.JP:
長い間地下にいた赤ずきん君が見たこともない、
かつ名前すらない、自分を証明できない君が、
どうしてそこまで人を疑えるというのかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood lived underground and
doesn't recognize you. Not even your name.
You want proof, but you have none yourself.

fields.JP: それは確かにそうだな……
もしかして、君がスナークなんじゃないかね？

fields.EN:
(I suppose I can't defend myself here
either.)
fields.JP:
（いや、僕自身も
　スナークではないと証明できない、か……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I suppose I can't defend myself here
either.)

fields.EN:
Hehe... Sorry. Maybe I was going a little
hard there. Some payback for earlier.
Don't take it personally.
fields.JP:
ふっ……すまない、少し意地悪だったね。
君をスナークと言ったのは、ただの意趣返しだ。
気にしないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe... Sorry. Maybe I was going a little
hard there. Some payback for earlier.
Don't take it personally.

fields.EN:
Well, I'm neither Professor nor Snark.
Believe that if you want.
fields.JP:
さて、私は博士でもスナークでもないが、
それを信じるかどうかは君たち次第だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm neither Professor nor Snark.
Believe that if you want.

fields.EN:
If you do, then I'll be here if you need me.
Visit me anytime.
fields.JP:
もしも信じてくれるのであれば、
私はしばらくここで待つから、
また尋ねてきてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you do, then I'll be here if you need me.
Visit me anytime.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN:
(What do we do? Should I trust this old
man? Much to consider...)
fields.JP:
（どうする……
　この弁が立つ老人を信じるべきか否か、
　しっかりと考えなければ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do we do? Should I trust this old
man? Much to consider...)

fields.EN:
What are you gonna do? You believe
Jabberwock-san?
fields.JP:
それでどうするの？
ジャバウォックさんの話、信じる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you gonna do? You believe
Jabberwock?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN:
Is he really Professor's brother?
Or is it all a ruse?
fields.JP:
あの人が本当に博士の弟なのか、
それとも博士が成りすましているのか、ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is he really Professor's brother?
Or is it all a ruse?

fields.EN: Hm. Something tells me he's being truthful.
fields.JP:
白雪は、あの人が嘘を
言っているようには見えませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Something tells me he's being truthful.

fields.EN:
I think so too. I want to believe.
But the real Professor was convincing too.
fields.JP:
わらわもそう思うし、信じたいです。
でも本物の博士も同じだったことも、また事実……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think so too. I want to believe.
But the real Professor was convincing too.

fields.EN: How about you? Still not convinced?
fields.JP:
あなたはどうなんですか～？
やっぱりまだ信用できないですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: How about you? Still not convinced?

fields.EN:
Me? Oh. I suppose I have no reason to
doubt him.
fields.JP:
僕か？
ああ、それなら信じざるを得ないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me? Oh. I suppose I have no reason to
doubt him.

fields.EN:
After that whole show earlier!
You doubted me the whole time!
fields.JP:
あんたさっき、あんなに疑ってたじゃん！
あたしの言葉なんて信じられない、とか言って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
After that whole show earlier!
You doubted me the whole time!

fields.EN:
Yeah, but that was earlier. When I came
back from my walk, something hit me.
fields.JP:
さっきの時点ではそうだった。
だが一旦ここに戻ってきて、気づいたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but that was earlier. When I came
back from my walk, something hit me.

fields.EN:
Jabberwock didn't seem relieved at all
to have found us. I bet the Professor would
have mentioned your powers by now.
fields.JP:
ジャバウォックは、自分といることのメリットを
一切口にしなかった。騙そうとするなら、
普通は甘い言葉で誘惑するものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jabberwock didn't seem relieved at all
to have found us. I bet the Professor would
have mentioned your powers by now.

fields.JP: それはそうかもしれないけど……

fields.EN:
Which means he doesn't seem at all
bothered by whether or not we believe
him.
fields.JP:
つまりあの男にとって、
君たちに信じてもらおうがもらうまいが、
本当にどちらでもいいということだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means he doesn't seem at all
bothered by whether or not we believe
him.

fields.EN:
He might be bluffing, but I don't see what
he stands to gain from that.
fields.JP:
その態度すらもブラフと考えられなくもないが、
まあ、そこまでしてこちらの信用を得ることに
メリットがあるとは思えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
He might be bluffing, but I don't see what
he stands to gain from that.

fields.EN:
Given he and his brother's identical
appearance, I assume he knows what's
at stake if he crosses you.
fields.JP:
そもそも、瓜二つの姿で現れることが、
最大限のデメリットだと普通ならばわかるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Given he and his brother's identical
appearance, I assume he knows what's
at stake if he crosses you.

fields.EN:
I don't trust him. Not fully.
But I can get information from him.
fields.JP:
完全に信じるわけにもいかないが、
色々と情報を引き出せそうなのは確かだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't trust him. Not fully.
But I can get information from him.

fields.EN: So for now, I'll play along.
fields.JP: だから僕は、ひとまず信じたフリをする
fields.LOCALIZED: So for now, I'll play along.

fields.EN:
In other words, you're hoping he knows
where your wife is.
fields.JP:
ようするに、少しでも
妻に繋がる手がかりがほしいってことですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, you're hoping he knows
where your wife is.

fields.EN: Obviously. It's the only reason I'm here.
fields.JP:
当たり前じゃないか。
そのために僕は進もうとしているんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED: Obviously. It's the only reason I'm here.

fields.EN: I see... Well, thanks for your input.
fields.JP: なるほど……まあ、あんたの意見は分かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... Well, thanks for your input.

fields.EN:
Aren't you happy he agrees with you
now, Aka-neesama?
fields.JP:
意見が対立しなくて
よかったじゃないですか、赤姉様
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aren't you happy he agrees with you
now, Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
I guess. I can't explain it.
He flipped so quick I can't tell if he's
sincere.
fields.JP:
そうなんだけどさあ、何て言うか、
そんな簡単に手のひら返されると、
納得がいかないっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess. I can't explain it.
He flipped so quick I can't tell if he's
sincere.

fields.EN:
Oh, right. So much happened I forgot
to mention.
fields.JP:
ああそうだった。
色々あって忘れていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, right. So much happened I forgot
to mention.

fields.EN: Wait. Is that a Mary Gun?
fields.JP: え……これ、もしかしてメアリガン……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. Is that a Mary Gun?

fields.JP: 確かに……穢れがすっと消えていくような……

fields.EN:
I recall you saying you were worried
about the corruption. I'm sure that was
nervewracking.
fields.JP:
ここまで穢れを取る手段がなかったようだな。
不安だったろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I recall you saying you were worried
about the corruption. I'm sure that was
nervewracking.

fields.JP: 何であんたがメアリガンを……

fields.EN:
Oh...! Wait. You're the one who purified
me on the surface?
fields.JP:
……っ！　そうだ、あんた確か、
地上であたしの穢れを消してくれた――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh...! Wait. You're the one who purified
me on the surface?

fields.EN: I was in shock. It all happened so fast.
fields.JP:
だってあの時は色々とパニック状態だったし、
それに一瞬の出来事みたいなもんだったから……
fields.LOCALIZED: I was in shock. It all happened so fast.

fields.EN:
I see. That was you. Well, um...thanks
for saving me.
fields.JP:
そっか、あれ、あんただったんだ。
あの時はメアリガンを使ってくれて、
その……あり、ありが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. That was you. Well, um...thanks
for saving me.

fields.EN: AAAAAHH! I don't want to thank him!
fields.JP: あああああ今は素直に言いたくないっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: AAAAAHH! I don't want to thank him!

fields.EN:
Okay. Why don't we start with your name?
We've come this far. Can't you tell us?
fields.JP:
……ねえ、あんた結局何者なのよ。
ここまで関わったんだから、
教えてくれてもいいでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. Why don't we start with your name?
We've come this far. Can't you tell us?

fields.EN:
You don't know...?
Well, maybe you're serious.
fields.JP:
分からない？
冗談ってわけじゃなさそうだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't know...?
Well, maybe you're serious.

fields.EN: So you weren't mocking me earlier?
fields.JP:
じゃあもしかして、名前がないって
言ってたのも意地悪とかじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So you weren't mocking me earlier?

fields.EN:
It's true he doesn't know his name,
Akazukin.
fields.JP: その人に名前がないのは本当ですよ、赤ずきん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true he doesn't know his name,
Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
I have amnesia. I only know that I'm
looking for my wife, and that I'm a Blood
Youth. And a Jail tower.
fields.JP:
僕には記憶がないんだ。覚えているのは、
最愛の妻を探していること、血式少年であること、
そして僕は監獄塔だということだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have amnesia. I only know that I'm
looking for my wife, and that I'm a Blood
Youth. And a Jail tower.

fields.JP: まるで意味が分からないわね

fields.EN:
Forget it. I don't understand it either.
Well I don't have to yet.
fields.JP:
気にするな。僕も分かってないし、
別に分からなくてもいいと思ってるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forget it. I don't understand it either.
Well I don't have to yet.

fields.JP: はー、そうだったんだー

fields.EN:
Here I thought you were just aloof.
Guess everybody's got their battle.
fields.JP:
あんた人生なんて簡単ですって感じで
飄々とした雰囲気見せてたけど、
実は意外と苦労してたんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here I thought you were just aloof.
Guess everybody's got their battle.

fields.EN: ...So that's what you think of me.
fields.JP: ……そんな風に思われていたのか
fields.LOCALIZED: ...So that's what you think of me.

fields.EN:
(Even she pities me. I doubt the two of
us will ever see eye to eye.)
fields.JP:
（しかも同情まで見せるとは。
　この赤ずきんって女とは、
　馬が合う気がしないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even she pities me. I doubt the two of
us will ever see eye to eye.)

fields.EN:
You know, if you were a team player,
maybe things wouldn't be so tough
for you.
fields.JP:
まあでも、もっと協調性を持てば、
いらない苦労を背負い込むこともないかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, if you were a team player,
maybe things wouldn't be so tough
for you.

fields.EN: Just food for thought... See, not so bad.
fields.JP:
せっかくアドバイスしてあげてるのに……
そういうところよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Just food for thought... See, not so bad.

fields.EN:
(Now she's starting to lecture me.
I must put an end to this―)
fields.JP:
（しかも説教まで始めるとは。
　さすがにそろそろ止めてもらうとするか――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now she's starting to lecture me.
I must put an end to this―)

fields.EN: I know. Let's give him a name!
fields.JP: そうだ、名前を決めましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: I know. Let's give him a name!

fields.EN: Name? I said I don't need one.
fields.JP: 名前？　必要ないと言ったはずだが
fields.LOCALIZED: Name? I said I don't need one.

fields.EN:
Sure. But how are we supposed to introduce
you to our friends without a name?
fields.JP:
でもこれからさらに人が増えたら、
名前がないと色々と面倒なことが増えますよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. But how are we supposed to introduce
you to our friends without a name?

fields.EN:
How do you expect us to address you
in case of an emergency?
fields.JP:
いざという時も、名前が呼べないと
あなたのことだって伝わらないですからね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How do you expect us to address you
in case of an emergency?

fields.EN:
(They raise a very good point.
A major oversight that could prove fatal.)
fields.JP:
（言われてみれば、確かにそうだな。
　呼ばれたと分からずに反応が遅れて、
　致命的なことになったりするかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They raise a very good point.
A major oversight that could prove fatal.)

fields.EN:
Got it. Well nothing comes to mind,
so go ahead and think of one for me.
fields.JP:
分かった。だが僕には思いつかないから、
君たちで勝手に決めてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. Well nothing comes to mind,
so go ahead and think of one for me.

fields.EN:
Names are very important. Are you sure
you want us to pick it for you?
fields.JP:
名前はとても大事なものですよ。
あなた抜きで決めてもいいんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Names are very important. Are you sure
you want us to pick it for you?

fields.EN:
I told you. It doesn't matter.
This is simply a matter of utility.
fields.JP:
言っただろう。名前なんて何でもいいと。
僕だと判別できればそれでいいんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you. It doesn't matter.
This is simply a matter of utility.

fields.EN:
Well, he said so. Let's take him up on
his offer. Any suggestions?
fields.JP:
ま、本人がそう言ってるなら、
お言葉に甘えてこっちで勝手に
決めちゃいましょうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, he said so. Let's take him up on
his offer. Any suggestions?

fields.EN:
Then again, we could sit here all day
deciding on a name.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、いざ命名するとなると、
なかなかに出てこないものですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then again, we could sit here all day
deciding on a name.

fields.EN:
Might something in his appearance tip
us off, like his white hair?
fields.JP:
まず特徴的なところからいくと、
髪の毛が白いことですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Might something in his appearance tip
us off, like his white hair?

fields.EN: Like Shiro? Aw, like a cute puppy.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、シロ？
やだ、そんな可愛らしい名前似合わないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Like Shiro? Aw, like a cute puppy.

fields.EN:
(That is pretty cute. Almost as cute as
my wife's name.)
fields.JP:
（随分とかわいい名前だな
　妻の名前よりもかわいいかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That is pretty cute. Almost as cute as
my wife's name.)

fields.EN:
(Why is it that I can't remember her
name, but I know its character?)
fields.JP:
（……名前は思い出せないのに、
　'かわいい名前'という概念は
　残っているのだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is it that I can't remember her
name, but I know its character?)

fields.EN: When I first saw him, he reminded me of Jack.
fields.JP:
わらわは初めてあった時は
少しジャックに似ていると思いました～
fields.LOCALIZED: When I first saw him, he reminded me of Jack.

fields.EN:
But it only took a few minutes for him to
prove me wrong.
fields.JP: ただ、数分しゃべって全然違うと思いました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it only took a few minutes for him to
prove me wrong.

fields.EN: Oh, I could see that as well.
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I could see that as well.

fields.EN:
He's just a little tactless. That's all.
He's no jerk.
fields.JP:
こ、言葉のチョイスが悪いだけで、
決して悪い人ではないですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's just a little tactless. That's all.
He's no jerk.

fields.JP: ジャックの面影……というよりは。

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: (I hate when everyone's staring at me.)
fields.JP:
（全員に長時間じろじろ見られるのは
　決していい気分ではないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I hate when everyone's staring at me.)

fields.EN: Hey. Shiro didn't sound too ba―
fields.JP: おい、もうシロでもなんでも、
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. Shiro didn't sound too ba―

fields.JP: ジュウっていうのはどうかな……？

どういう理由でその名前に
行き着いたのか、よければ聞かせてくれるか？

fields.EN:
Huh? Not sure. Just a feeling, I guess?
You seem like a Juu to me. Hahaha.
fields.JP:
え？　あーそのっ、雰囲気で？
何だか『ジュウ』って感じが
したっていうか……あは、あはは
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Not sure. Just a feeling, I guess?
You seem like a Toh to me. Hahaha.

fields.JP: 確かに、どこかしっくりくるかも

fields.EN:
If we keep repeating his name, it's
bound to stick.
fields.JP:
何度か口にしていると、
違和感も感じなくなりますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we keep repeating his name, it's
bound to stick.

fields.EN: Nothing better's been suggested, so why not?
fields.JP: 他に案もないし、いいんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Nothing better's been suggested, so why not?

fields.EN:
Hm. Juu... Maybe you're onto something.
It does fit.
fields.JP:
ふむ、ジュウか……
確かに君たちの言うように、
何故かしっくりくるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Toh... Maybe you're onto something.
It does fit.

fields.EN: Then, Juu it is! Yay, it's set!
fields.JP:
じゃあ『ジュウ』にしましょう！
わーい、決定です！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then, Toh it is! Yay, it's set!

fields.EN: Um. Pleased to meet you, Juu.
fields.JP:
えっと……それじゃ、
これからもよろしくね、ジュウ
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. Pleased to meet you, Toh.

fields.EN:
(We returned to the Eiserne Jail tower
to speak once more with Jabberwock.)
fields.JP:
（僕たちは再びアイゼルネの監獄塔にやって来た。
　ジャバウォックと合流することを選んだからだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We returned to the Eiserne Jail tower
to speak once more with Jabberwock.)

fields.EN:
(Now that Akazukin and I settled
our debate on Jabberwock's innocence,
we could move forward at last.)
fields.JP:
（ジャバウォックを信じるかどうかについては、
　僕と赤ずきんの間で意見が分かれてなかったので、
　みんなのまとまりは早かった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that Red Riding Hood and I settled
our debate on Jabberwock's innocence,
we could move forward at last.)

fields.EN:
(We made camp and prepared to embark.
Seeing all of us together made me realize our
numbers swelled.)
fields.JP:
（一旦キャンプに戻り、
　人員や物資をまとめてまた集まった時には、
　中々の大所帯になったと思ったものだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We made camp and prepared to embark.
Seeing all of us together made me realize our
numbers swelled.)

fields.EN:
(We extended our lodgings from
Jabberwock's campsite.)
fields.JP:
（そしてジャバウォックのキャンプ地を
　間借りした僕たちは、早速設営を開始した）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We extended our lodgings from
Jabberwock's campsite.)

fields.EN:
(There was Haru, Kadowaki, Akazukin, and the girls. Among them, Kunai,
who set up a storefront. Not a bad camp.)
fields.JP:
（ハルと門脇、それと赤ずきんたちと
　共にいたクナイという女が中心となって、
　なかなか立派なキャンプを作ることができた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There was Haru, Kadowaki, Red Riding
Hood, and the girls. Among them, Kunai,
who set up a storefront. Not a bad camp.)

fields.EN:
(Then we debriefed one another, exchanging
stories before taking a long rest.)
fields.JP:
（それから休憩も兼ねて、お互いのグループが
　知り得た情報を共有したりした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then we debriefed one another, exchanging
stories before taking a long rest.)

fields.EN:
(Having larger numbers allowed us to
expand our scope of operation.)
fields.JP:
（さらに人員が増えたことで、
　これまで出来なかった作業にも、
　手が出せるようになるだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Having larger numbers allowed us to
expand our scope of operation.)

fields.EN:
(At first, I cared little for the humans.
Now here I am, in their debt.)
fields.JP:
（僕自身、初めは他の人間なんて
　どうでもいいと思っていたが、今はこうして
　人がいることの恩恵にあずかっている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At first, I cared little for the humans.
Now here I am, in their debt.)

fields.EN:
(Of course, it might be self-preservation.
Although, something tells me the old me
would not have chosen this path.)
fields.JP:
（もちろん生き抜く上での
　必要性を感じたからではあるのだが、
　前の僕なら選ばなかった道のようにも思う）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Of course, it might be self-preservation.
Although, something tells me the old me
would not have chosen this path.)

fields.EN:
(So many unexpected happenings since
arriving on the surface.)
fields.JP:
（地上に来てから、本当に
