　想像もしてないことばかり起きるものだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So many unexpected happenings since
arriving on the surface.)

fields.EN:
(I decided not to pry Jabberwock about the 
giant, floating Jail or Genocide Pink yet.)
fields.JP:
（そう、地上と言えば、
　『巨大な監獄塔』や『処刑台少女』に関して、
　ジャバウォックに尋ねることは保留にした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I decided not to pry Jabberwock about the 
giant, floating Jail or Massacre Pink yet.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(Still I have my doubts. But I knew they
could only be assuaged by familiarity.)
fields.JP:
（単純にあの男をまだ怪しいと思っているし、
　あちらも僕たちも、もう少し互いのことを
　知った方がいいと思ったからだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Still I have my doubts. But I knew they
could only be assuaged by familiarity.)

fields.EN: (Slow and steady wins the race, as they say.)
fields.JP:
（これもまた『急がば回れ』
　ということかもしれないが――）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Slow and steady wins the race, as they say.)

fields.EN: (Dear, I wonder where my wife could be.)
fields.JP: （ああ、妻はいったいどこにいるんだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Dear, I wonder where my wife could be.)

fields.JP: ほら、ジュウ出発するよ

そうそう、これ言っておかないと、
って思ってたんだ

fields.EN:
No more picking small fights. I want you to
be more considerate before you speak.
fields.JP:
あのね、これからいちいち喧嘩なんて
していられないんだから、もう少し
デリカシーを持って話してよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No more picking small fights. I want you to
be more considerate before you speak.

fields.JP: よし、それじゃあ行くよ！

fields.EN: (I never intended to pick any fights.)
fields.JP:
（僕には喧嘩をする気なんて、
　これっぽっちもないのだが……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I never intended to pick any fights.)

fields.EN:
(How surprising that the supposed oldest
of the group is the most aggravating?)
fields.JP:
（まさか白雪姫やかぐや姫よりも年上の女に、
　面倒くさいなんて感情を抱くことになるとは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How surprising that the supposed oldest
of the group is the most aggravating?)

fields.JP: 赤ずきん、そっちはさっき見たじゃないか
くっ、分かってるってば

fields.EN:
We're lagging. Quit wasting time. Everyone's
far up.
fields.JP:
まったく、みんな先に行ってしまったぞ。
モタモタしてないで早く行かないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're lagging. Quit wasting time. Everyone's
far up.

fields.JP: そうだけど、でももしかしたらここに……

fields.EN:
Akazukin. Keep your focus.
You're making me anxious.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、君は本当によそ見が多いな。
見ているこっちが不安になる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood. Keep your focus.
You're making me anxious.

fields.EN:
I know, but I can't help it. My friends could
have come this way!
fields.JP:
そんなこと言ったって、他の仲間がいないか
細かく見てるんだからしょうがないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, but I can't help it. My friends could
have come this way!

fields.EN:
Expecting something to change when the
steps are the same is the definition of insanity!
fields.JP:
何度も同じところを確認するのは、
時間の無駄というものだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Expecting something to change when the
steps are the same is the definition of insanity!

fields.EN:
Ugh. Didn't we discuss this already?
About thinking before we speak?
fields.JP:
む～っ、出発前に言ったばかりだっていうのに、
どうしてあんたはそういう、
デリカシーのない言い方ばっかり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Didn't we discuss this already?
About thinking before we speak?

fields.EN:
How did you ever find someone willing
to marry you?
fields.JP:
ほんと、あんたによく
結婚してくれる人がいたもんよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you ever find someone willing
to marry you?

fields.EN: Yeah. I ask myself the same thing.
fields.JP: ああ、自分でもそう思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I ask myself the same thing.

fields.EN:
Oh, wait... Sorry. That was a joke.
Didn't mean it seriously.
fields.JP:
あ……違っ、あたし、ちょっとからかうつもりで
言っただけで、そんな馬鹿にする気じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, wait... Sorry. That was a joke.
Didn't mean it seriously.

fields.JP:
いや、いいんだ。
赤ずきんの言うとおりだからな

fields.EN:
I said I have amnesia. But truthfully I have
slivers of memories.
fields.JP:
僕は記憶を失っていると言ったが、
実は頭の中には、欠片とも呼べない、
砂粒くらいの記憶はあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said I have amnesia. But truthfully I have
slivers of memories.

fields.EN:
Each sliver is faint, barely registerable
as memory. But if I focus hard enough,
I can make out brief images.
fields.JP:
それらは一粒一粒では何の情報も読み取れない
矮小なものなんだが、すくいあげてみることで、
ぼんやりだが、ある記憶を形成したりするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each sliver is faint, barely registerable
as memory. But if I focus hard enough,
I can make out brief images.

fields.EN:
What I do know is, I was often the odd one
out. Mere conjecture though, of course.
fields.JP:
それによると、どうやら僕は
変わり者の扱いをされていたらしい。
もちろんそんな気がした、程度の記憶だが
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I do know is, I was often the odd one
out. Mere conjecture though, of course.

fields.EN:
It seems I was notorious for being difficult.
But one person always stuck by me.
fields.JP:
周りの多くの者は僕を扱い辛そうだった。
だが、そんな僕を優しいと言って、
そばに居続けてくれた人がいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I was notorious for being difficult.
But one person always stuck by me.

fields.EN: That would be my wife. She saved my life...
fields.JP:
それが妻だったんだ。
僕が彼女にどれだけ救われたことか……
fields.LOCALIZED: That would be my wife. She saved my life...

fields.EN:
And I want us to live out the rest of our
lives in peace together. I'll stop at nothing
to make that happen.
fields.JP:
僕はそんな妻と、
もう一度安らかな日々を送りたい。
それが叶う日まで、立ち止まるつもりはない
fields.LOCALIZED:
And I want us to live out the rest of our
lives in peace together. I'll stop at nothing
to make that happen.

fields.EN:
Well, makes sense. You must really love
your wife.
fields.JP:
あんたが奥さんを大事にしてるって
いうことだけは分かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, makes sense. You must really love
your wife.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, do your friends mean
everything to you?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, do your friends mean
everything to you?

fields.EN:
I mean, duh.
I won't leave a single one behind.
fields.JP:
何言ってんの、大事に決まってるじゃない。
誰ひとりいなくなっちゃ嫌だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, duh.
I won't leave a single one behind.

fields.EN:
We might be scattered right now, but I want
nothing more than for all of us to be together.
Like before we got to the surface.
fields.JP:
今はみんなバラバラになっちゃったけど、
また集まって、しょーもないことで笑い合いたい。
あの地上に出発する前の日みたいにさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We might be scattered right now, but I want
nothing more than for all of us to be together.
Like before we got to the surface.

fields.EN:
They're the best. Wish I could hear what
kind of talking-to they'd give you for your
attitude.
fields.JP:
みんないい奴なんだ。
きっと揃ったら、デリカシーのない
あんたは怒られてばっかりかもね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're the best. Wish I could hear what
kind of talking-to they'd give you for your
attitude.

fields.EN:
Alice and Otsuu would throw fits.
Gretel would give you a taste of your own
medicine. Even Rapunzel would chime in.
fields.JP:
おつうやアリスなんかは特に怒りそう。
グレーテルは別方向から叩き伏せそうだし、
案外ラプンツェルもいい怒り方しそうだなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and Otsuu would throw fits.
Gretel would give you a taste of your own
medicine. Even Rapunzel would chime in.

fields.EN:
It sure would be. As lively as you could
possibly imagine.
fields.JP:
そりゃ楽しいね。
どう想像したって賑やかなんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
It sure would be. As lively as you could
possibly imagine.

fields.EN:
We could even make a contest out of who's
the most annoyed by Juu.
fields.JP:
いっそのこと、誰がジュウをいちばん
へこませられるか大会でも開いちゃおうかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We could even make a contest out of who's
the most annoyed by Toh.

fields.JP: そんなものは絶対に御免だが……

fields.EN:
Both of us have so much to lose.
I can see how much you've sacrificed.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、僕が妻を想うのと同じように、
君が仲間を大事に想っていることは分かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both of us have so much to lose.
I can see how much you've sacrificed.

fields.EN:
Focus on surviving. Let no obstacle oppose
you. That is the least you will need.
fields.JP:
それなら、君自身がなんとしても生き延び、
効率的な探し方をした方がいい。
それが再び巡り会うために必要なことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Focus on surviving. Let no obstacle oppose
you. That is the least you will need.

fields.EN: The way you put it is roundabout and not exactly kind, but... are you giving me advice?
fields.JP:
言い方は回りくどいし、優しくもないけど、
もしかしてアドバイスをしてくれてる……？
fields.LOCALIZED: This is a first. Are you giving me advice?

fields.EN: Hey Juu, um... I'll keep that in mind.
fields.JP:
あのさ、ジュウ。
その……さ、参考にさせてもらうよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Toh, um... I'll keep that in mind.

fields.EN: ...That's fine. Look, everyone came back because they were worried.
fields.JP:
……それでいい。
ほら、みんなが心配して戻ってきたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Good. The others must be worried.

fields.EN: Oh, whoa. I'll tell them you were rambling.
fields.JP:
うわ、ほんとだ。
怒られたらジュウが道草食ってたって言おう
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, whoa. I'll tell them you were rambling.

fields.EN:
I doubt they'd believe you over me in this
instance.
fields.JP:
そこについては、さすがに僕の方が
信用されると思うけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I doubt they'd believe you over me in this
instance.

fields.JP: じゃあやってみよっか？

fields.EN:
Hey everyone! Juu was wast―
WHOA! Sorry! Okay! I'm sorry!
fields.JP:
ねーみんな、ジュウが道草し――
わわ、ごめんごめん！　あたしが悪かったって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey everyone! Toh was wast―
WHOA! Sorry! Okay! I'm sorry!

fields.EN: Look. They saw through you the whole time.
fields.JP: 速攻でバレて怒られてるじゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Look. They saw through you the whole time.

fields.EN:
(There's something to be said about their
bond.)
fields.JP: （まあ確かに、いい仲間のようだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's something to be said about their
bond.)

fields.EN: Hey. There's a core over there.
fields.JP: おいこっちに核があるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. There's a core over there.

fields.JP: ほ、本当にありましたわね！

fields.EN:
Would you look at that? Maybe he's not
a liar.
fields.JP:
眉唾ものだと思ってたけど、
本当にわかるのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would you look at that? Maybe he's not
a liar.

fields.EN: I have no reason to be. Let's destroy it already.
fields.JP:
僕が嘘をつく理由がないからな
さっさと破壊しよう
fields.LOCALIZED: I have no reason to be. Let's destroy it already.

fields.EN: But is that really a good idea?
fields.JP: いや、本当に破壊していいのかな、これ……
fields.LOCALIZED: But is that really a good idea?

fields.EN:
Well, I just wouldn't want us to make any
rash, irreversible decisions.
fields.JP:
いや、そんな簡単に決めて取り返しの
つかないことが起きないかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I just wouldn't want us to make any
rash, irreversible decisions.

fields.EN:
Is that what this is about? We're in a Jail.
What more reason could we need? Do we
really need justification to destroy a core?
fields.JP:
そんな漠然とした理由で反論してきたのか？
ここが監獄塔とわかっている時点で破壊する
デメリットがメリットを上回るとは思えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that what this is about? We're in a Jail.
What more reason could we need? Do we
really need justification to destroy a core?

fields.EN: Ugh. Fine, sorry. I'll shut up.
fields.JP:
くっ、悪かったよ。
もうあたしは喋んないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Fine, sorry. I'll shut up.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: (Rgh... There it goes again! My heart.)
fields.JP:
（くっ……まただ……！
　胸がチクチクする）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Rgh... There it goes again! My heart.)

fields.EN:
F-Forgive me. You were right to consider
our options. Just trust me next time.
fields.JP:
い、いや喋るなとまでは言わない。
反論は時に重要な意味を持つこともある。
ただもう少しだけ根拠を出してくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
F-Forgive me. You were right to consider
our options. Just trust me next time.

fields.JP:
そうですよね！　全員が大丈夫って時が
一番油断しているときですし

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Maybe she was pointing out the guardian
standing in front of the core?
fields.JP: ただやっぱり核の前には番人がいますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she was pointing out the guardian
standing in front of the core?

fields.EN:
If we want to smash that thing to pieces,
we have no choice but to fight!
fields.JP: 核を破壊するなら戦うしかありませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we want to smash that thing to pieces,
we have no choice but to fight!

fields.EN:
Right. Look alive, everyone. Shoot to kill.
Ready, Akazukin?
fields.JP:
ああ、油断せずに着実に進めて行こう
準備はいいか赤ずきん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Look alive, everyone. Shoot to kill.
Ready, Red Riding Hood?

fields.EN: Now for the grand finale! YAH!
fields.JP:
このまま核も破壊しますわ！
とりゃーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now for the grand finale! YAH!

fields.JP: アイゼルネ監獄塔ジェイル
バギギギアアアァァァァァ……！！

いぎぃぃ、いだあ゛あ゛
やだああああ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛
ちょ、ちょっといきなりどうしたの！

ああ、大丈夫だ
心配は無用だ

fields.EN: Seriously? Looked like you were dying.
fields.JP:
無用だって……
今まで見たことない苦しい顔してたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously? Looked like you were dying.

fields.EN: Yes, that's what I suspect too... For some reason, maybe I'm the only one who can hear the core's voice...
fields.JP:
ああ、僕もそう予測している……
核の声がなぜか僕だけに
聞こえているかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I suspect so. Somehow, I thought I heard
the core screaming.

fields.EN:
Makes sense. You collapsed as the core
shattered. I wonder what it means.
fields.JP:
確かに以前も核を破壊したときに
苦しんでました。
どういうことなのでしょう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Makes sense. You collapsed as the core
shattered. I wonder what it means.

fields.EN: I don't know about that, but we'll just have to keep thinking about it.
fields.JP:
そればっかりはわからないが、
考えていくしかあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED: As do I, but it's something.

fields.JP: 立てますかジュウさん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: I said I'm fine. Continue our exploration.
fields.JP:
無用だと言っている。
このまま探索の続きへと行こう
fields.LOCALIZED: I said I'm fine. Continue our exploration.

fields.JP: もう仕方ない方ですわね
ああ、ナイトメアのようだな

fields.EN: Juu-san, are there any more cores?
fields.JP: ジュウさん核はもうなさそうですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, are there any more cores?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
(Careful. We have the personnel, but
Nightmares are still an ordeal.)
fields.JP:
（どうしたものか。
　確かに血式少女は増えたが、ナイトメアが
　脅威の存在であることに変わりはない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Careful. We have the personnel, but
Nightmares are still an ordeal.)

fields.JP: 悩ましいところですね～
かぐや姫、お前はどう思う？

fields.EN: I'm overdue for a long nap. In short, I'm lazy.
fields.JP:
結局リスクのある行為ですからね～
簡単にいえばめんどくさいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm overdue for a long nap. In short, I'm lazy.

fields.JP: ふっ、かぐや姫らしい答えだ
少しだけ待ってみますか？

fields.EN: There's something peculiar about this one...
fields.JP: 一向に動く気配がありませんわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: There's something peculiar about this one...

fields.EN:
Peculiar, indeed. Nightmares usually slither
about. Seems like someone's controlling this
one.
fields.JP:
常に動いている印象のあるナイトメアだが、
誰かがまるで操作しているような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Peculiar, indeed. Nightmares usually slither
about. Seems like someone's controlling this
one.

fields.EN:
Shouldn't we take care of it? I'm getting
antsy.
fields.JP:
このままじゃ埒あかないし、
戦った方がいいんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shouldn't we take care of it? I'm getting
antsy.

fields.EN: *sigh* Hate to say it, but you're right.
fields.JP:
はぁ……
気は進まないがその通りだ
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh* Hate to say it, but you're right.

fields.JP:
よしっ！
気合入れて行くわよ！

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Just remember not to go in over your head.
Fall back if you're overwhelmed. Don't be
a hero.
fields.JP:
言わなくともわかっていると思うが、
僕が危険だと思ったら即座に退避だ。
無理をする理由はないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just remember not to go in over your head.
Fall back if you're overwhelmed. Don't be
a hero.

fields.JP: はいはい、わかってますよ
君が一番不安なのだがね……

fields.EN: Save the chat. We have a Nightmare to fight!
fields.JP: なんにしても全力でがんばりますわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Save the chat. We have a Nightmare to fight!

fields.JP:
うん！
じゃあ行くよ！
相変わらず気持ちの悪い見た目ですね～

fields.EN: Don't let your guard down, Princess Lazy!
fields.JP: ぐーたら姫油断しないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't let your guard down, Princess Lazy!

fields.JP: やはり怒ってますわね……！
こっちに近づいて来ます！
全力で行かせてもらうよ！

fields.EN: We did it! We have emerged victorious!
fields.JP:
やりましたわ！
無事倒しましたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it! We have emerged victorious!

fields.JP: 白雪もがんばったわね

fields.EN:
That's the last time anyone underestimates
me!
fields.JP: もう地味なだけ、なんて言わせません！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the last time anyone underestimates
me!

fields.EN: No one even said that. Sheesh.
fields.JP: 誰もそんなこといってないわよ、もう
fields.LOCALIZED: No one even said that. Sheesh.

fields.EN:
Now we've rid ourselves of the Jail's biggest
threat. This should guarantee our safe passage.
fields.JP:
これでこの監獄塔の一番の脅威は去った
これで効率よく奥へ行けるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now we've rid ourselves of the Jail's biggest
threat. This should guarantee our safe passage.

fields.JP: もう少し労ってもいいんじゃないのー？

fields.EN: There's no point expecting that from Juu-san~
fields.JP: ジュウさんにそんなことを期待しても仕方ないです～
fields.LOCALIZED: You should know better by now...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(I meant that as a token of appreciation.
Should be more careful with phrasing.)
fields.JP:
（労ったつもりなのだがな……
　うまく伝わっていないようだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I meant that as a token of appreciation.
Should be more careful with phrasing.)

fields.EN: Seriously... You're no good at this.
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously... You're no good at this.

fields.EN:
(I can sense my wife's footsteps, but
no trace of her. Where are you...?)
fields.JP:
（ここにも妻の足取りがわかる
　痕跡がなかった……君はどこにいるんだい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can sense my wife's footsteps, but
no trace of her. Where are you...?)

fields.JP: ここまでで誰にも会わなかったね……
ネムちゃん……どこにいるんだろう

fields.EN:
Right. All the more reason for us to keep
going.
fields.JP:
そうね。　だからこそ足取りを
止めるわけにはいかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. All the more reason for us to keep
going.

fields.JP: 親指姉様……そうですよね……！

fields.EN:
We have no other choice. But seriously...
I'm tired.
fields.JP:
今は先に進むしかないですね～
……正直わらわはもうヘトヘトですが～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have no other choice. But seriously...
I'm tired.

fields.JP:
そうだな、その通りだ。
引き続き探索を続けよう

fields.EN: Oh! Isn't that a teleportation orb?
fields.JP: あっ！　あれ、転送の球体じゃないですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! Isn't that a teleportation orb?

fields.EN:
Wonderful. Might not be one of our friends,
but it's progress.
fields.JP:
よかったですわ。誰も見つかりませんでしたけど、
これで先へ進むことはできそうですもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wonderful. Might not be one of our friends,
but it's progress.

fields.EN: Wait, you two! Look! She's here!
fields.JP:
待った、２人とも！
あいつがいる……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait, you two! Look! She's here!

fields.EN:
I had a feeling you'd show up.
I am such a genius★
fields.JP:
ここで待ってれば来ると思ったしー。
メイってばちょー天才★
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had a feeling you'd show up.
I am such a genius★

fields.EN: (Isn't she the girl who battled Akazukin? She's in Genocide Pink...)
fields.JP:
（こいつは確か、赤ずきんたちと
　戦っていた処刑台少女……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Isn't she the girl who battled Red Riding
Hood? She's in Massacre Pink...)
fields.notes: B12 source-form character identity restoration; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: 何であんたがこんなところにいるのよ……！

fields.EN:
What, so you've just been waiting for us
the whole time?
fields.JP:
わらわたちを待ち構えてたって、
どういうことですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What, so you've just been waiting for us
the whole time?

fields.EN:
Duh, why wouldn't I? ★
Welcome to my dominion. Nothing happens
here without me knowing about it.
fields.JP:
そんなの簡単なことだよー★
なんたってここはメイの場所だし？
何かあればすーぐ分かっちゃうんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Duh, why wouldn't I? ★
Welcome to my dominion. Nothing happens
here without me knowing about it.

fields.EN:
Aw. Just when we thought Hikari-san saved us
from the worst of it...
fields.JP:
せっかくヒカリさんが
白雪たちを逃がしてくれたというのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. Just when we thought Hikari saved us
from the worst of it...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ヒカリさん => Hikari-san

fields.EN: Shirayuki, check yourself. No time to mope.
fields.JP:
白雪、気持ちを切り替えなさい。
気を抜いたらやられるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White, check yourself. No time to mope.

fields.EN:
Oh. So many of you.
Means more fun for me★
fields.JP:
ふーん、前よりちょっとは
楽しめそうな雰囲気してんじゃーん★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. So many of you.
Means more fun for me★

fields.EN: But alas, I didn't come here to play with you.
fields.JP:
でもね、残念だけど今はメイ、
あなたたちと遊びに来たワケじゃないんだよね～
fields.LOCALIZED: But alas, I didn't come here to play with you.

fields.JP: じゃあ何の目的で来たのよ……

fields.EN: Because I am very, very angry★
fields.JP: メイはね、今とーっても怒ってるの★
fields.LOCALIZED: Because I am very, very angry★

fields.EN:
How dare you set foot in MY dominion with
your disgusting blood!
fields.JP:
ゲロマズの血をしてるくせに、
このメイだけの場所で好き勝手やるなんてさ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare you set foot in MY dominion with
your disgusting blood!

fields.EN:
Papa told me not to play around, but you
can't expect me to sit quietly while you cause
havoc★ Time to set you all straight!
fields.JP:
パパに勝手に遊ぶなって言われてるけど、
さすがにここまでされたら黙ってらんないよ★
絶対に許さないかんね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Papa told me not to play around, but you
can't expect me to sit quietly while you cause
havoc★ Time to set you all straight!

fields.EN:
Rgh... Not this time. You won't lay a single
dirty finger on my friends!
fields.JP:
くっ、負けてたまるか……
今度こそみんなを守らないといけないんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh... Not this time. You won't lay a single
dirty finger on my friends!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Akazukin. She's a threat,
but don't get carried away.
fields.JP:
落ち着け、赤ずきん。
とてつもなく危険な相手なのは分かるが、
緊張しすぎだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Red Riding Hood. She's a threat,
but don't get carried away.

fields.EN:
Watch your opponent, but keep your head.
Luckily this space isn't as open, and there
are no civilians to protect.
fields.JP:
相手の動きに注意しつつも、手の力を抜くんだ。
幸い、今回は空間も限定されているし、
周りに守るべき一般人もいない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Watch your opponent, but keep your head.
Luckily this space isn't as open, and there
are no civilians to protect.

fields.EN:
This time, you have me. Don't worry about
Blood Skelter. Just take her down.
fields.JP:
それに今回は僕もいる。
ブラッドスケルター化を恐れずに
立ち向かっていいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This time, you have me. Don't worry about
Blood Skelter. Just take her down.

fields.JP: でも、あいつの強さは異常で……

fields.EN: (I have no choice. Gotta buy us some time.)
fields.JP: （仕方ない。少し時間を稼いでみるとするか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I have no choice. Gotta buy us some time.)

fields.EN:
Hey. Iron Maiden, was it? You've been after
us a while. What's your end goal?
fields.JP:
なあ、アイアン・メイデンと言ったか。
お前たちは執拗に僕たちを狙うが、
最終目標はいったい何なんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey. Iron Maiden, was it? You've been after
us a while. What's your end goal?

fields.EN: What? End goal? Uh, get serious.
fields.JP:
えー最終目標ー？
何それ意味分かんなーい
fields.LOCALIZED: What? End goal? Uh, get serious.

fields.EN:
All I want is blood. Everyone's.
Dump it all in a big tank and bathe in it.
I feel prettiest after a good, long soak★
fields.JP:
メイはただ、たくさんの人から血をもらってー、
それを集めてお風呂にして－、
ゆっくり浸かってキレイになるの★
fields.LOCALIZED:
All I want is blood. Everyone's.
Dump it all in a big tank and bathe in it.
I feel prettiest after a good, long soak★

fields.EN:
You should try it. My skin's never felt so
soft.
fields.JP:
血のお風呂に入ると、
お肌のツヤが違うんだよね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should try it. My skin's never felt so
soft.

fields.EN:
Oh! But you have to get the blend just right.
I prefer a mix of all ages★
fields.JP:
そうそう！　色んな配合があってねー
今色んな性別とか年とかブレンド作ってるんだよ★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! But you have to get the blend just right.
I prefer a mix of all ages★

fields.EN:
Believe me! This group has some of the worst
tasting blood I've ever had! A cesspool.
But maybe you're better suited for my tub★
fields.JP:
そうだ！　あなたたちの血は
罰ゲーム以下の肥溜めみたいな味だけどー、
お風呂には使えるかもしんないね★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Believe me! This group has some of the worst
tasting blood I've ever had! A cesspool.
But maybe you're better suited for my tub★

fields.EN:
I've made up my mind★
I'll drain all of your blood★
fields.JP:
決ーめたっ★
みんなの血、ぜんぶもらってあげるよ★
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've made up my mind★
I'll drain all of your blood★

fields.EN:
I didn't expect diplomacy, but man
is she crazy.
fields.JP:
話すとは思ってなかったが、
まさかここまでとはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't expect diplomacy, but man
is she crazy.

fields.EN: Yup. We learned that the hard way last time.
fields.JP:
うん。前もそうだったけど、
まったく話し相手にならないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. We learned that the hard way last time.

fields.JP: 赤ずきん、もう大丈夫みたいだな

fields.EN: Huh? Oh... Yup. Got the last of my nerves out.
fields.JP: え？　ああ……緊張、ほぐれたみたい
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Oh... Yup. Got the last of my nerves out.

fields.JP: みんな！　絶対にこいつを倒すよ！！

fields.EN:
Woohoo! Feeling spry?★
Not all at once, everyone. 
I'll feast on you all in good time.
fields.JP:
キャハッ、元気いーね★
じゃあみんな、きれーに挟んであげるね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Woohoo! Feeling spry?★
Not all at once, everyone. 
I'll feast on you all in good time.

fields.EN:
Ooh, I underestimated you★
I love a good challenge.
fields.JP:
へえ～、メイの予想より全然やるじゃん★
ちょっと楽しくなってきたかもー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, I underestimated you★
I love a good challenge.

fields.EN: We were just getting warmed up last time!
fields.JP:
いけるわ、あの時より
わたしたちも強くなっている！
fields.LOCALIZED: We were just getting warmed up last time!

fields.EN:
Yes. Last time felt hopeless, but the tide is
turning!
fields.JP:
ええ、絶望的だった前回に比べれば、
しっかりと渡り合えていますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Last time felt hopeless, but the tide is
turning!

fields.EN: We can't stay down forever. It's our turn now.
fields.JP:
いつまでも負けっ放しじゃいられません。
今度はこちらの番です
fields.LOCALIZED: We can't stay down forever. It's our turn now.

fields.EN:
You're getting a taste of our true power.
We won't make this easy for you.
fields.JP:
あの時は不覚を取りましたが、
今度はそうはいきませんでしてよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're getting a taste of our true power.
We won't make this easy for you.

fields.EN:
Ugh. My bangs are ruined!
All that effort for nothing!
fields.JP:
あ、メイの前髪がハネちゃってるー！
も～、せっかくキレイにセットしたのにー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. My bangs are ruined!
All that effort for nothing!

fields.EN:
We've barely made a dent. She's not even
looking at us―
fields.JP: あいつ、余裕ぶってよそ見してる――
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've barely made a dent. She's not even
looking at us―

fields.JP:
チャンスだっ！
食らえぇっ！

fields.EN:
Oh, was that supposed to hurt me?
I'm insulted.
fields.JP:
は、メイに勝てるとか思っちゃったのぉ？
なーんかムカつくなー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, was that supposed to hurt me?
I'm insulted.

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
I was being merciful, and it's gotten to
your head. Now I'm going to kill you.
fields.JP:
ちょっと遊んであげたら、
すぐ調子に乗っちゃってー。
もうあなたはぶっ殺し決定っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was being merciful, and it's gotten to
your head. Now I'm going to kill you.

fields.JP: 赤ずきん、早く体勢を立て直しなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood, get in formation!

fields.EN:
My mouth is watering! And I like my food
best when it's crying★
fields.JP:
ほら、本気で挟んであげる！
いい声で鳴いてね★
fields.LOCALIZED:
My mouth is watering! And I like my food
best when it's crying★

fields.JP: じゃあね、ばいばーいっ★

fields.EN: That was close. Are you hurt?
fields.JP: 危なかったな。怪我はないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: That was close. Are you hurt?

fields.EN:
(I felt compelled to jump out. Why in the
world did I do that?)
fields.JP:
（思わず飛び出してしまった……
　僕としたことが、こんな危険なことをするなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I felt compelled to jump out. Why in the
world did I do that?)

fields.EN: Thanks Juu. If you hadn't pulled me, I...
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジュウ……
あんたが引っ張ってくれなかったら、あたし……
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks Toh. If you hadn't pulled me, I...

fields.EN:
Hey, what's the big idea! ARGH!
YOU'RE PISSING ME OFF!
fields.JP:
ちょっと、なに邪魔してくれてんのよー！
ムカつくムカつくムカつくーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, what's the big idea! ARGH!
YOU'RE PISSING ME OFF!

fields.EN:
This is infuriating. I'm going to rip the
flesh from your bones with my teeth,
and swallow you in all one gulp★
fields.JP:
あーもうメイ、完っ全にキレちゃった。
みんな挟んで、１つのきれーな
肉のカタマリにしてあげるから★
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is infuriating. I'm going to rip the
flesh from your bones with my teeth,
and swallow you in all one gulp★

fields.JP:
な、なんですの……
いきなり雰囲気が変わりましたわ……

fields.EN:
She's storing energy. Guess she really was
going easy on us.
fields.JP:
力を溜めてるわ。さっきまでのが
本気じゃなかったっていうのは、本当みたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's storing energy. Guess she really was
going easy on us.

fields.EN: Does that mean we're doomed again...?
fields.JP: またわらわたちは勝てないというんですか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Does that mean we're doomed again...?

fields.JP: せっかくここまで頑張ったっていうのに……！

fields.EN: Okay★ All ready! Enough playing around.
fields.JP:
おっけー★　準備完了っ。
それじゃあ殺してあげるねっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay★ All ready! Enough playing around.

fields.EN: Mm..? Oh, wait. Papa just paged me.
fields.JP:
……ん？　あーちょっと待ってね、
今パパからポケベルに連絡入ったからー
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm..? Oh, wait. Papa just paged me.

fields.JP: （ポケベル……？　ああ、通信機械のことか）

fields.EN:
Whoa. Alice is there, blah blah blah?
Ugh. Fine.
fields.JP:
うっわ、またアリスがいるから
どうのこうのって話ー？　えーもーヤだぁ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Alice is there, blah blah blah?
Ugh. Fine.

fields.EN:
Aw. Guess Papa was watching me.
Oh? A message. Hmm... What is it?
fields.JP:
はぁ……メイの行動、
パパにバレちゃってたかぁ。
えっと、伝言？　なになに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. Guess Papa was watching me.
Oh? A message. Hmm... What is it?

fields.EN:
Welp. I'm in big trouble, I gotta dash. Later.
Till next time. But next time, you're all dead★
fields.JP:
じゃ、怒られたからメイ帰るねー。
そーゆーわけで今日はここまでだけど、
次は必ず殺すからね★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Welp. I'm in big trouble, I gotta dash. Later.
Till next time. But next time, you're all dead★

fields.EN:
(Not sure what's going on, but her leaving
would do everyone a favor.)
fields.JP:
（よく分からないが、
　退いてくれるというなら願ったりだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not sure what's going on, but her leaving
would do everyone a favor.)

fields.EN:
Oh, by the way. Snark's always watching★
Later.
fields.JP:
あ、そうそう。スナークは見てるからね★
それじゃ、ばいばーい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, by the way. Snark's always watching★
Later.

fields.JP: やっぱり関わっていたってことですの！？
だってお父さんは、あの時確かに……
（赤ずきん、手が震えているのか……？）

fields.EN: Let's regroup at camp. We can talk there.
fields.JP:
……とにかく、戻って態勢を立て直そう。
話はそれからだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's regroup at camp. We can talk there.

fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁ……。
こっちよ！　急いで！

はぁ、はぁっ……。
やっと……着いたぁ……

fields.EN: Father and mother came this way, didn't they?
fields.JP:
……お義父さんとお義母さんは、
この中に入っていったよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Father and mother came this way, didn't they?

fields.EN: You smell that? It's blood. It's getting dark.
fields.JP:
真っ暗な道の先から、風に乗って、
血生臭いにおいが漂ってくる
fields.LOCALIZED: You smell that? It's blood. It's getting dark.

fields.EN: Explains the stench I've been gagging from.
fields.JP:
異臭の原因を想像して、
あたしたちはゴクリと唾を飲み込んだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Explains the stench I've been gagging from.

fields.EN:
My name is Riley. This is my little sister,
Ellie.
fields.JP:
あたしの名は、ライリー。
隣にいるのは、妹のエリー
fields.LOCALIZED:
My name is Riley. This is my little sister,
Ellie.

fields.EN: We were born in the slums on Leichhardt Island.
fields.JP: あたしたちは、ライカード島のスラム街で生まれた
fields.LOCALIZED: We were born in the slums on Licard Island.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN:
My real dad died a long time ago.
And my mom... She decided we were in
her way, and ran off with another man.
fields.JP:
本当の父親はとっくの昔に死んでる。母親も
自分たちを足でまといと言って、若い男と逃げた
fields.LOCALIZED:
My real dad died a long time ago.
And my mom... She decided we were in
her way, and ran off with another man.

fields.EN:
Our current father and mother are the ones
who saved us.
fields.JP:
そんな絶望的な状況を助けてくれたのが、
今のお義父さんとお義母さんだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our current father and mother are the ones
who saved us.

fields.EN:
They took us in as their children despite
not knowing us.
fields.JP:
あの２人は、赤の他人であるあたしたちを
自分たちの子どもとして温かく迎え入れてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
They took us in as their children despite
not knowing us.

fields.EN:
I always wondered why they took us in.
One time, I asked them...
fields.JP:
あの頃は、なんで優しくしてくれるのか不思議で、
『どうして？』って、繰り返し聞いたっけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I always wondered why they took us in.
One time, I asked them...

fields.EN: But they just laughed and replied...
fields.JP:
そんなあたしに、お義父さんとお義母さんは、
笑いながらいつもこう言った
fields.LOCALIZED: But they just laughed and replied...

fields.EN:
"We have a little girl of our own.
We couldn't leave you out there knowing you
were abandoned."
fields.JP:
ちょうど自分たちに小さい娘が生まれたし、
困っているあたしたちを放っておけなかった、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
"We have a little girl of our own.
We couldn't leave you out there knowing you
were abandoned."

fields.EN:
I thought it was a lie.
There had to be a catch.
fields.JP:
絶対に嘘だ。
何か裏があるはずだと、あたしは思った
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it was a lie.
There had to be a catch.

fields.EN:
But living with them made me realize there really
are good people in this world. People like them
who made our slums livable. I understood.
fields.JP:
だけど義両親と暮らすうちに、２人は本物のお人好しで
こういう人たちのおかげでスラムが成り立っていると、
世の中の仕組みについて分かるようになっていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But living with them made me realize there really
are good people in this world. People like them
who made our slums livable. I understood.

fields.EN: But larger forces were playing around us.
fields.JP: そして、この世界で起こってることも――
fields.LOCALIZED: But larger forces were playing around us.

fields.EN: Around the world, areas called 'Contaminated Zones' are spreading, and large numbers of 'Contaminated Animals' born from them, along with supposedly immortal 'Dangerous Contaminated Animals,' have appeared.
fields.JP:
世界では『汚染地帯』と呼ばれる場所が広がってて
そこから生まれる『汚染動物』や、不死身と言われてる
『危険汚染動物』が大量に発生しているらしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
The world was becoming contaminated.
A sickness that spread across places, and
soon to groups of people and creatures.

fields.EN:
Everything fell into a state of panic.
Leichhardt Island, of course, was no exception.
fields.JP:
そのせいで世界は大パニックに陥っている
もちろん、ライカード島も例外じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everything fell into a state of panic.
Licard, of course, was no exception.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN:
A few months ago, the contamination reached
the island.
fields.JP:
数か月前。突然現れた『汚染地帯』は、
島中をみるみるうちに浸食した
fields.LOCALIZED:
A few months ago, the contamination reached
the island.

fields.EN:
Eventually it infected people and monsters.
Horrific things began to happen.
Death, beheadings...
fields.JP:
それによって汚染動物がのさばり、
おまけに、首を切られるなんていう
恐ろしい殺人まで増えた。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eventually it infected people and monsters.
Horrific things began to happen.
Death, beheadings...

fields.EN: Soon, the slums tore themselves apart.
fields.JP: 結果、このスラム街はおかしくなった。
fields.LOCALIZED: Soon, the slums tore themselves apart.

fields.EN: There used to be a community. Law and order.
fields.JP:
以前は、いくつかの派閥があって、
それなりにルールもあった。
fields.LOCALIZED: There used to be a community. Law and order.

fields.EN:
Now it's different. Theft, murder, rape.
It's no man's land. Everyone for themselves.
fields.JP:
でも今は違う。
窃盗、殺し、強姦など、やりたい放題。
完全な無法地帯になってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now it's different. Theft, murder, rape.
It's no man's land. Everyone for themselves.

fields.EN: My adoptive parents hid us in an empty house away from people, said, 'We'll look for somewhere safe. We'll be right back,' and entered the Contaminated Zone.
fields.JP:
義両親は、あたしたちを人気のない空き家に隠し、
『安全な場所がないか探してくる。すぐ戻る』と、
汚染地帯へと入っていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
My new parents hid us in a remote house,
telling us they'd be right back before
re-entering the contaminated zone.

fields.EN: A whole day passed, and neither came home.
fields.JP: それから丸１日経っても、２人は帰ってこなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: A whole day passed, and neither came home.

fields.EN:
We grew anxious. Then some arsonist began
lighting homes ablaze, and killing anyone who
ran screaming from them.
fields.JP:
不安になるあたしたち。追い打ちをかけるように
暴徒が周囲の家に火を放ち、飛び出してきた住民を
片っぱしから殺し始めた
fields.LOCALIZED:
We grew anxious. Then some arsonist began
lighting homes ablaze, and killing anyone who
ran screaming from them.

fields.EN:
"They're going mad! Women, children, they
don't care! We'll die if we stay here!"
fields.JP:
あいつらは女子供にも容赦しない！
ここにいたら死ぬ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
"They're going mad! Women, children, they
don't care! We'll die if we stay here!"

fields.EN:
I took my sister as we escaped from the house.
We ran and ran and ran, then ended up here.
fields.JP:
そう思ったあたしは、妹を連れて家を飛び出した。
走って走って、たどり着いたのは、ここ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I took my sister as we escaped from the house.
We ran and ran and ran, then ended up here.

fields.EN:
This is the contaminated region that Father and
Mother traveled to.
fields.JP: お義父さんとお義母さんが入っていった、汚染地帯だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is the contaminated region that Father and
Mother traveled to.

fields.EN: Hey, Sissy? Are Papa and Mama here?
fields.JP:
ねーねー、ねーちゃ。
パパとママ、このなかにいるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Sissy? Are Papa and Mama here?

fields.EN: I watched where the two of them went from the hideout window the whole time. This is definitely the place.
fields.JP:
隠れ屋の窓から、２人がどこに行くのか
ずっと見てたからね。間違いないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, look inside this window. I just know
they're here.

fields.EN: Oh really? Hope we find them soon.
fields.JP:
そーなのー。
はやくパパとママにあいたいなー
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh really? Hope we find them soon.

fields.EN:
This is my other little sister, Rachel.
My foster parents' only real daughter.
fields.JP:
この子は、あたしのもうひとりの妹、レイチェル。
大好きなお義父さんとお義母さんの実の娘だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my other little sister, Rachel.
My foster parents' only real daughter.

fields.EN:
She was so young. She didn't understand
anything going on. A carefree child.
fields.JP:
まだ小さいこの子は、全く状況を理解していないようで
きゃっきゃと楽しそうに笑っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was so young. She didn't understand
anything going on. A carefree child.

fields.EN:
Sis, are they really inside? Shouldn't we head
back? It smells funny...
fields.JP:
おねえ、本当に中に入るの？
もどった方がいいんじゃない……？
さっきから、変なにおいがするし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sis, are they really inside? Shouldn't we head
back? It smells funny...

fields.EN:
No. If we leave now, we're risking our lives
and Rachel's.
fields.JP:
ダメよ。今引き返したら、あたしたちどころか、
レイチェルだって酷い目に遭うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. If we leave now, we're risking our lives
and Rachel's.

fields.EN:
(I'm scared too, but I don't wanna go.
But if we don't move now, the rioters will
find us and kill us all.)
fields.JP:
（あたしだって、怖いし、行きたくない。
　でも、前に進まずジッとしていたら、そのうち
　暴徒に見つかってエリーもレイチェルも殺される）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm scared too, but I don't wanna go.
But if we don't move now, the rioters will
find us and kill us all.)

fields.EN:
Let's sneak around back to avoid anyone who's
contaminated, okay?
fields.JP:
とりあえず、汚染動物に見つからないように、
こっそり奥に向かうわよ。いいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's sneak around back to avoid anyone who's
contaminated, okay?

fields.JP: レイチェル、声が大きい。しー

fields.EN:
Huh...? Rachel doesn't get it!
Neecha, I'm tired! Carry me!
fields.JP:
うぅ……？　れいちぇる、わかんない！
ねーちゃ、つかれた！　おんぶ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh...? I don't get it! Sissy, I'm tired!
Carry me!
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.EN:
Hehe. Okay. I know you're tuckered out
from earlier.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、いいわよ。
さっき頑張って走ったもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Okay. I know you're tuckered out
from earlier.

fields.JP:
よいしょっと……。
ちゃんと掴まってなさいよ？

うん！
ねーちゃの背中、あったかくて気もちいいー

fields.EN:
There you go again. Spoiling her.
You go too easy on Rachel.
fields.JP:
また甘やかす。
おねえは、レイチェルにかまいすぎ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again. Spoiling her.
You go too easy on Rachel.

fields.EN: Oh, come on. She's the baby.
fields.JP:
別にいいじゃない。
レイチェルは可愛い末っ子なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, come on. She's the baby.

fields.EN:
Besides, she doesn't know what's going on.
We need to look after her.
fields.JP:
それにこの子は、なにも分かってないんだ。
いざとなったら、あたしたちが守ってあげないと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, she doesn't know what's going on.
We need to look after her.

fields.EN: (The weapon Father gave me seems to work on the Contaminated Animals too. If something happens, we'll have no choice but to fight our way through...!)
fields.JP:
（お義父さんからもらった武器は、
　汚染動物たちにも効くみたいだし、もしもの時は、
　戦って切り抜けるしかないよね……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Father gave me something he said works
on contaminated beings. If we run into
trouble, we got this.)

fields.EN:
Looks like you're raring to go. Do me a favor
and be careful with that, okay?
fields.JP:
やる気まんまんだね。きばりすぎて、
おっちょこちょいぶりをはっきしないでよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like you're raring to go. Do me a favor
and be careful with that, okay?

fields.EN: Aaaah. Dun pull on mai cheeks!
fields.JP: うーー。ほっぺはひっぱらにゃいで
fields.LOCALIZED: Aaaah. Dun pull on mai cheeks!

fields.EN:
Rachel wants to do it too!
Squish, squish!
fields.JP:
れいちぇるもやるー！
むにむにー！
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.JP: もー、れいふぇるまでー

fields.EN: (Father and Mother must be farther in. Until I find them, I have to protect my precious little sisters.)
fields.JP:
（お義父さんとお義母さんは、きっとこの奥にいる。
　２人と会うまで、あたしが大事な妹たちを守らなきゃ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Father and Mother have to be close.
I'm getting them, and my sisters, out of here.)

fields.EN: Yay! Sissy you're amazing! So cool!
fields.JP: わー！　ねえちゃ、すごーい！　かっこいー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yay! Sissy you're amazing! So cool!

fields.JP: えへへっ、そお？　ありがと♪

fields.EN: Contaminated Animals are scary, but they're not unbeatable. With my father-in-law's weapon, I think we can make it through.
fields.JP:
汚染動物は怖いけど、敵わない相手じゃないわね。
お義父さんの武器があれば、上手く切り抜けられそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those contaminated beings might be scary,
but we can beat them. As long as we've got
this.

fields.EN:
Sure, but don't get too cocky, okay?
There's only one of those.
fields.JP:
うん。でも、あんまり調子にのってポカしないでよ？
おねえのフォローするの、けっこう大変
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but don't get too cocky, okay?
There's only one of those.

fields.JP: はいはい。分かってるって

fields.EN:
You could thank us for helping you, you know.
Geez. You're so reckless.
fields.JP:
『いつもフォローありがと♪』くらい
言ってくれてもいいのに。おねえのバカ。鈍感
fields.LOCALIZED:
You could thank us for helping you, you know.
Geez. You're so reckless.

fields.JP: エリー？　ため息なんかついてどうしたのよ
別に。ちょっと疲れただけ

fields.EN:
Wanna take a break? I'm sure we're safe,
 at least for a little bit.
fields.JP:
ねぇ、そろそろ休憩しない？
家を燃やした奴らも、ここまでは来ないだろうし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wanna take a break? I'm sure we're safe,
 at least for a little bit.

fields.EN:
Right. There might be some stragglers around.
Once the area is clear, we can take a breather.
fields.JP:
そうね。でも汚染動物はまだまだいるっぽいし、
落ち着ける場所が見つかるまで行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. There might be some stragglers around.
Once the area is clear, we can take a breather.

fields.EN: ...Okay. I'll hold on for a bit.
fields.JP:
……はーい。
もうひと頑張りしまーす
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Okay. I'll hold on for a bit.

fields.JP:
いいわよー、おいでー。
ぎゅ～～っ

fields.EN:
Hehehe♪
I love your piggy-back rides, Sissy!
fields.JP:
えへへへ～♪
ねーちゃのだっこ、だいすき！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe♪
I love your piggy-back rides, Sissy!

fields.JP: 嬉しいこと言ってくれるわね。よしよし♪

fields.EN: Hahaha! Rachel likes getting her head rubbed!
fields.JP:
きゃはは！
れいちぇる、あたまグリグリされるのすき！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahahaha! I love it when you do that!
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.JP: じゃあもっと撫でてあげる。うりゃ～
きゃはははっ！！　くすぐったいよ～っ

fields.EN: ...Quit it. Aren't we moving on? Hurry.
fields.JP:
……ふたりとも、なにイチャついてるの。
先に進むんでしょ。ほら、急いで
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Quit it. Aren't we moving on? Hurry.

fields.EN:
Man, it's always about Rachel. I'm your little
sister too, you know...
fields.JP:
ちぇっ、レイチェルの言うことばっかり聞いて。
わたしだって、おねえの妹なのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man, it's always about Rachel. I'm your little
sister too, you know...

fields.JP:
ふう……。
ずいぶん歩いたわね

fields.EN:
Yeah. My feet are swollen. I couldn't run
if you paid me to.
fields.JP:
うん……。もう足がパンパン。
今走れって言われたら、むり
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. My feet are swollen. I couldn't run
if you paid me to.

fields.JP: あっ、ハエさん！　まってー
こら、レイチェル。勝手に動かない
やー！　手、はなしてー！

fields.EN:
No. We're going back to Sis.
I'll drag you even if it kills me.
fields.JP:
だめ。おねえのところにもどる。
いやがっても引きずってく
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. We're going back to Sis.
I'll drag you even if it kills me.

fields.JP: おねえ、どうして笑ってる？

fields.EN:
Yeah, a little. I was thinking Ellie's
become quite the onee-chan.
fields.JP:
うん、ちょっとね。
エリーも立派なお姉ちゃんだなと思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like your sisterly instincts are kicking
in.

fields.EN:
You ran and brought back Rachel.
After declaring you could hardly walk.
fields.JP:
だって今、レイチェルを走って連れ戻したじゃない。
『走れって言われたら、むり』とか言ってたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You ran and brought back Rachel.
After declaring you could hardly walk.

fields.EN:
W-Well... it'd be a problem if she got lost
somewhere like this. It has nothing to do
with being her onee-chan.
fields.JP:
そ、それは……。
こんなところで迷子になったら迷惑だから。
お姉ちゃんだからとかは関係ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...her getting lost just means more work.
I didn't do it because I'm "sisterly."

fields.EN: ...Well, watching you work so hard as her big sister, I started thinking of myself as Rachel's older sister too.
fields.JP:
……まあ、がんばってるおねえを見てるうちに、
自分もレイチェルの姉って思うようになったけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, I saw you how you were around her.
Maybe I realized I could do that too.

fields.EN: That so? Maybe you underestimate yourself.
fields.JP:
ふーん？
ま、そういうことにしといてあげる
fields.LOCALIZED: That so? Maybe you underestimate yourself.

fields.EN: Maybe it's all in your head.
fields.JP: だから、変なかんちがい
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe it's all in your head.

fields.EN: No need to be shy! Hehehe.
fields.JP: 照れることないのに。うりうり
fields.LOCALIZED: No need to be shy! Hehehe.

fields.EN: Hey, staaaahp. Don't pull on me cheeks.
fields.JP: うう、ほへえ、ほっぺたひっぱらない
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, staaaahp. Don't pull on me cheeks.

fields.EN: Sissy, I wanna go over there! Let go of me!
fields.JP:
ねーちゃ、あっち行くー！
手、はなしてー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sissy, I wanna go over there! Let go of me!

fields.EN: Oh, now what? Is there a bug or something?
fields.JP:
も～、今度はなに。
ダンゴムシでも見つけた？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, now what? Is there a bug or something?

fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待って。
お義父さんの声が聞こえたの？

fields.EN:
Are you sure? Or is this another bid for
attention?
fields.JP:
空耳なんじゃない？
それか、おねえの気を引くための出まかせかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you sure? Or is this another bid for
attention?

fields.EN: Rachel wouldn't lie like that. Unlike us.
fields.JP:
レイチェルは、嘘なんかつかないわよ。
あたしたちと違ってね
fields.LOCALIZED: Rachel wouldn't lie like that. Unlike us.

fields.EN: Oof. Got me there. So Father's this way...?
fields.JP:
うっ。確かに……。
この先にお義父さんが……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oof. Got me there. So Father's this way...?

fields.EN:
Yes. I'm sure of it. If he's there, Mother
must be too! Ellie, Rachel, let's go!
fields.JP:
ええ、きっとそうよ。
お義父さんがいるなら、お義母さんもいるはず！
エリー、レイチェル、行くわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I'm sure of it. If he's there, Mother
must be too! Ellie, Rachel, let's go!

fields.EN:
Aw... Sissy, we've looked everywhere.
I don't see Mama or Papa.
fields.JP:
うー……？　ねーちゃ、もう道ないよ？
パパとママにあえないよお……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw... Sissy, we've looked everywhere.
I don't see Mama or Papa.

fields.EN:
It'll be okay. They might just past this door.
Come on, let's go!
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ。この扉を開けばきっと先に進めるわ。
さあっ、いくわよおぉ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be okay. They might just past this door.
Come on, let's go!

fields.JP: うっ、めちゃくちゃ重いわね
はぁっ、はぁ……やっと開いたぁ！

fields.EN:
Yeah. Phew... Almost there. Then Mother
and Father.
fields.JP:
うん……。ふぅ……もうすぐ、
お義父さんとお義母さんに会える……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Phew... Almost there. Then Mother
and Father.

fields.JP:
パパー！　ママー！
れいちぇるきたよーー！

ちょっ、レイチェル！
先に行っちゃだめ！

fields.EN: Aw, it's dark. Papa? Mama? Where are you?
fields.JP:
うーまっくらー
パパー？　ママー？
どこお……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, it's dark. Papa? Mama? Where are you?

fields.EN:
...They're finally in a better place.
Congratulations.
fields.JP:
――これで安全な場所へ行けましたね。
おめでとうございます
fields.LOCALIZED:
...They're finally in a better place.
Congratulations.

fields.JP: わぷっ！？　わわわわっ！？
レイチェル！　危ないっ
ねーちゃ！　ありがと……

fields.EN:
Oh. That was close. If I hadn't nabbed you,
you would've fallen to your death.
fields.JP:
は～っ、ききいっぱーつ……。
あと一秒、見つけるのが遅かったら、
石につまづいて派手に転んでた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. That was close. If I hadn't nabbed you,
you would've fallen to your death.

fields.JP: レイチェル、足元には気をつけるのよ？
おっちょこちょいの、おねえもね

fields.EN:
Shut up. Blame that stupid rock.
Almost lost my eye. Ellie, turn on the light!
fields.JP:
う、うっさいわね。　この石が悪いのよっ。
壁に蹴っ飛ばして粉々にしてやる！
エリー、ライト点けて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up. Blame that stupid rock.
Almost lost my eye. Ellie, turn on the light!

fields.JP:
ひぃっ……！？
お、お義父さん……？
（だ、だめ、こんなの見れないっ！）

っ……！　お義母さん……の……
も……そこに……！

……パパ？　ママ……？
どーして……ぐすっ、ううっ……。
ふぇぇぇえええええええええん！！

fields.EN:
Don't look, you guys! Come here! 
I got you. *sniffle*... *hiccup*...
fields.JP:
２人とも、見ちゃだめ！
抱っこしてあげるからおいで！　ほら、ぎゅーっ！
ぐすっ……ずずずっ、ううっ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't look, you guys! Come here! 
I got you. *sniffle*... *hiccup*...

fields.JP: おとうさん、おかあさん……

fields.EN:
...Oh, look. Witnesses. What do you think?
It's my masterpiece. I can see how it would
bring you to tears. It's beautiful.
fields.JP:
……あら、見物人がいたのですね。
どうです、そのすがた。素晴らしい作品でしょう？
感動のあまり涙する気持ちも分かります
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Oh, look. Witnesses. What do you think?
It's my masterpiece. I can see how it would
bring you to tears. It's beautiful.

fields.EN:
(Did they kill Father and Mother?
Their eyes are crazed. These are nutjobs...)
fields.JP:
（まさか、こいつがお義父さんたちを殺したの？
　分かんないけど、目がいっちゃってる。
　絶対やばいヤツだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did they kill Father and Mother?
Their eyes are crazed. These are nutjobs...)

fields.JP: ぐすっ、うぐっ、パパぁっ！　ママぁ！

fields.EN:
Oh? I like that little girl there. Let me get
a better look at her face.
fields.JP:
おや、あなたが抱えているその子いいですね。
もっとよく顔を見せてください
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? I like that little girl there. Let me get
a better look at her face.

fields.EN: Ah! Ellie! Run for it! Rachel, grab tight!
fields.JP:
ひっ！　エリー、逃げるよ！
レイチェルはこのまま掴まってな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah! Ellie! Run for it! Rachel, grab tight!

fields.EN:
*sigh*...It's the clean-up that takes the
longest. But it's worth the trouble.
fields.JP:
はぁ……。小さなホコリは取り辛くて困ります。
でもその分、掃除のし甲斐がありますね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*...It's the clean-up that takes the
longest. But it's worth the trouble.

fields.EN: *pant, pant*... Hey Sis? Are we safe...?
fields.JP:
はっ、はっ……ねぇ、おねえ。
あの女、追いかけてこない……？
fields.LOCALIZED: *pant, pant*... Hey Sis? Are we safe...?

fields.EN:
Yeah. I don't hear any footsteps.
Doesn't look like they followed us.
fields.JP:
ええ……。
足音も聞こえないし、気配もないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I don't hear any footsteps.
Doesn't look like they followed us.

fields.JP:
はぁっ、ふぅ……ううっ、ぐすっ……。
ぐすっ、おとうさん、おかあさん……

fields.EN:
Don't get too excited, you two. We're still
in no man's land. We need to get outta here.
fields.JP:
２人とも、気を緩めちゃだめよ。
まだ汚染地帯の中だし、早くここから出なきゃ。
泣くのはそれからよ。いいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't get too excited, you two. We're still
in no man's land. We need to get outta here.

fields.JP: うぅ……。れいちぇる、もうなかない……
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.EN:
Great. Thattagirl. I'm proud of you both.
I bet Father and Mother would be too.
fields.JP:
うん、いい返事。ふたりとも偉いわね。
お義父さんとお義母さんも、きっとそう思ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Great. Thattagirl. I'm proud of you both.
I bet Father and Mother would be too.

fields.JP: もー……おねえが泣いてどうすんの……

fields.EN:
A-am not! My eyes are just itchy!
Don't be stupid. Let's go.
fields.JP:
ち、違うわよ！　ちょっと目が痒いだけ！
変なこと言ってないで、さっさと行くわよっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-am not! My eyes are just itchy!
Don't be stupid. Let's go.

fields.EN:
(Father, Mother...
I'll take good care of them in your place.)
fields.JP:
（お義父さん、お義母さん……。
　これからは、２人の代わりに、あたしが妹たちを
　もっと強く引っぱっていくからね……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Father, Mother...
I'll take good care of them in your place.)

fields.EN:
*pant, pant* There's the exit!
We're almost out of this dump.
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁ……。出口だ……！
ここまでくれば大丈夫だよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant* There's the exit!
We're almost out of this dump.

fields.JP:
はぁっ、わたしたち……助かった……。
……っ、ぐすっ……ふえぇぇえん！

fields.EN:
Waaaah. *sniffle* *hiccup*! Papa, Mama...
I was scared!
fields.JP:
ううっ、ぐすっ、うぐっ……！
パパ、ママ……こわかったよお！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Waaaah. *sniffle* *hiccup*! Papa, Mama...
I was scared!

fields.EN:
You both held your own. There, there...
*sniffle* *hiccup*
fields.JP:
ふたりともよく頑張ったね。
よしよし……。ぐすっ……ずずっ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You both held your own. There, there...
*sniffle* *hiccup*

fields.EN:
Finally, you're here. Filthy insects.
I grew bored waiting.
fields.JP:
……やっと出てきましたね、ゴミ虫さん。
待ちくたびれました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Finally, you're here. Filthy insects.
I grew bored waiting.

fields.EN:
What are you doing here?!
Thought you gave up.
fields.JP:
な、なんでここに……！？
あきらめたんじゃなかったのっ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing here?!
Thought you gave up.

fields.EN:
Of course not. I'm a perfectionist.
Down to the last speck of dust.
fields.JP:
まさか。わたくしは、綺麗好きなんです。
塵屑ひとつ見逃しません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. I'm a perfectionist.
Down to the last speck of dust.

fields.EN: I told you. There's nowhere to go!
fields.JP:
ですから、逃がさないと言ってるでしょう。
はっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you. There's nowhere to go!

fields.JP:
い、いたいっ！
い、いたいよ……！
ねーちゃ！！　ちでてる！
うああっ！！　痛い、痛いよおっ！！

fields.EN:
Now you can't move anymore. Next, I'll finish
you off.
fields.JP:
これでもう動けなくなりましたね。
次は、息の根を止めて差し上げます
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
や……あ……やだ！
こ、こ、こ殺さないでっ……
お願い！　大事な妹に手を出さないで！

安心してください。
貴方にも手を出しますから

fields.EN:
Bring it on...! If you're gonna do it,
d-do it to me!
fields.JP:
っ……。望むところよ……！
やるなら……じ、自分にして……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Bring it on...! If you're gonna do it,
d-do it to me!

fields.EN: Oh. Wild card. Then, you choose.
fields.JP:
ほう。面白いことを言いますね。
では、あなた自身に選ばせてあげましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Wild card. Then, you choose.

fields.EN:
That girl you're holding,
or the one crawling on the floor.
fields.JP:
あなたが今抱えてる子と、
地べたを這いずり回っているそこの子、
どちらかをよこしなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
That girl you're holding,
or the one crawling on the floor.

fields.EN: Master and I will raise who you choose.
fields.JP: わたくしとマスターが育ててあげましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Master and I will raise who you choose.

fields.EN: And I will spare the rest.
fields.JP:
更に、あなたと残った子の命は
助けてあげます
fields.LOCALIZED: And I will spare the rest.

fields.EN:
(This murderer expects to raise my sister?!
As if she'd spare us!)
fields.JP:
（こ、こんな人殺しがまともに育てるわけがない！
　そもそも生かしてくれるかもあやしい！！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This murderer expects to raise my sister?!
As if she'd spare us!)

fields.EN:
Didn't you hear me? I picked myself!
I'd never give up one of my own!
fields.JP:
あたしは、やるなら自分にしてって頼んだの！
そんなふざけた取り引きするわけないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't you hear me? I picked myself!
I'd never give up one of my own!

fields.EN: Then all three of you will just die, you know?
fields.JP: それだと３人とも死ぬだけですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Then I'll kill all three of you.

fields.EN:
I'll count down from ten.
Think hard about your answer.
Here we go... TEN!
fields.JP:
制限時間は１０秒。
よぉーく考えて、答えを出してくださいね。
では、カウントダウンスタート！　じゅーーーう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll count down from ten.
Think hard about your answer.
Here we go... TEN!

fields.EN: How are you so cruel?! Karma will get you!
fields.JP:
こ……こんな酷いことしていいの！？
いつか必ず罰が当たるよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: How are you so cruel?! Karma will get you!

fields.EN:
Please have mercy! I'm begging you!
Don't kill us!
fields.JP:
な、生意気なこといってごめんなさいっ。
ほら、土下座して謝るから、許して！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please have mercy! I'm begging you!
Don't kill us!

fields.EN: If you save my younger sister's life, I'll become your underling! I'll steal, kill—anything! So please, save her!!
fields.JP:
妹の命を救ってくれたら、あなたの子分になるわ！
盗みだって殺しだってなんだってする！
だから、助けて……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you save my sisters, I'll be your servant!
I'll steal, kill, whatever! Just spare them!

fields.JP:
さああああああぁぁぁ
あああぁぁぁーーーん……
ねーちゃ……ぐすっ、ふえぇん！

fields.EN: (Ellie! Rachel! What the hell do I do!)
fields.JP:
（エリー……！　レイチェル！
　あたしは……どうすればいいの……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ellie! Rachel! What the hell do I do!)

fields.JP:
うん！
ねーちゃの背中、あったかくて気もちいいー

fields.EN: W-Well... it'd be a problem if she got lost somewhere like this. It has nothing to do with being her onee-chan.
fields.JP:
そ、それは……。
こんなところで迷子になったら迷惑だから。
お姉ちゃんだからとかは関係ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...her getting lost just means more work.
I didn't do it because I'm "sisterly."

fields.EN:
Hehehe♪
I love your piggy-back rides, Sissy!
fields.JP:
えへへへ～♪
ねーちゃのだっこ、だいすき！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe♪
I love your piggy-back rides, Sissy!

fields.JP: もー……おねえが泣いてどうすんの……

fields.EN: (Ellie, Rachel... I can't pick between them!)
fields.JP:
（エリー、レイチェル……。
　どっちかなんて選べるわけないよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ellie, Rachel... I can't pick between them!)

fields.EN: (But in a cruel world, survival means...)
fields.JP:
（でも、残酷なこの世界で、
　これからも生きていくとしたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But in a cruel world, survival means...)

fields.JP:
にーーーーぃぃぃぃぃーーぃぃぃぃーーーー
いいいいぃぃぃぃぃぃーーーーーーーーーー
ーーー～～～～～～いいいいいいーいいいい

fields.EN:
(That jerk...is laughing. She's pure evil.
I can't take her on by myself...)
fields.JP:
（こいつ……笑ってる。本物の悪魔だ……。
　あたしみたいな、ちっぽけなガキが逆らえる
　相手じゃないんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That jerk...is laughing. She's pure evil.
I can't take her on by myself...)

fields.JP:
いぃぃぃぃぃぃぃぃぃぃーーーーーーーー
ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー
ちぃぃぃぃぃぃぃいいいいいーーーーー

fields.EN: Take her... That's who I choose!
fields.JP: この子を……あなたにあげます！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Take her... That's who I choose!

fields.JP: ううっ、うわああああんっ！！

fields.EN:
Is that your final answer? How wonderful.
Then I'll take her from you.
fields.JP:
それがあなたの出した答えですか。
素晴らしい正解ですよ。
ではこの子をもらい受けるとしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that your final answer? How wonderful.
Then I'll take her from you.

fields.EN: No...! I wanna go with Sissy!
fields.JP: や……！！　ねーちゃといる！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No...! I wanna go with Sissy!

fields.EN:
Look at those terrible manners.
Quick, come before they ruin you.
You're pure trash!
fields.JP:
聞き分けのない子ですね。
いつまでもゴミにくっついてないで、
さっさとこっちへ来い、クズ虫が！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at those terrible manners.
Quick, come before they ruin you.
You're pure trash!

fields.JP: いやああっ、ねーちゃああっ！！

fields.EN: I accept this child. I bid you...farewell.
fields.JP:
この子、たしかに頂戴しましたわ。
それでは――ごきげんよう
fields.LOCALIZED: I accept this child. I bid you...farewell.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Birds of a filthy feather stick together.
You're a fool.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、ゴミと約束している生物なんて見たこと
ありますか？　とんでもない馬鹿ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Birds of a filthy feather stick together.
You're a fool.

fields.EN:
Regardless of your choice, I planned on
killing all of you but this one. HAHAHAHA!
fields.JP:
お前がどちらを選んでも、
この子以外は殺すと決めていたんですよ。
アハハハハハハ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless of your choice, I planned on
killing all of you but this one. HAHAHAHA!

fields.EN:
If you weren't too old, Master would have
had you take part in his experiment.
Only then would I spare you. Shame.
fields.JP:
お前たちの年齢がもう少し低ければ、
マスターが欲しがっている検体の条件に当てはまるので、
生かしておいたかもしれませんが……。ご愁傷様です
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you weren't too old, Master would have
had you take part in his experiment.
Only then would I spare you. Shame.

fields.JP: さあ、２人ともさようなら！！

fields.EN:
If that witch is gonna hurt Sis,
then I rather her take me! I'll do it!
fields.JP:
ううっ、こんなヤツに、
おねえをやられるくらい……なら……
あたしが……やる……！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that witch is gonna hurt Sis,
then I rather her take me! I'll do it!

fields.EN:
Oh my, what a surprise. She jumped in the
hole. Never took her for suicidal. Hehehe.
fields.JP:
おやまあ……。
落とし穴に身を投げるとは驚きですね。
まさか自殺するとは……ふふふっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh my, what a surprise. She jumped in the
hole. Never took her for suicidal. Hehehe.

fields.JP:
ねーちゃ！　ねーちゃぁぁ！！
……むぐぐぐぐぐっ！？

fields.EN: If you don't shut up, I'll cover your nose as well as your mouth and kill you.
fields.JP:
黙らないと口だけじゃなく、
鼻も塞いで殺しますよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Shut up, or I'll cover your nose too.

fields.EN: Finally. Quiet. That's better. Let's go.
fields.JP:
大人しくなりましたね。それでいいのです。
では、参りましょうか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Finally. Quiet. That's better. Let's go.

fields.JP:
うう……いたた……
……また転んじゃった

fields.EN:
Those cliffs are so loose. How many times
have I told you to watch your step? Ugh.
You klutz. Can you stand?
fields.JP:
この崖は足場が悪くて滑りやすいから、
気をつけて降りようって何度も言った。
本当におっちょこちょい。立てる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those cliffs are so loose. How many times
have I told you to watch your step? Ugh.
You klutz. Can you stand?

fields.EN: Of course! I don't need your help.
fields.JP:
あったり前よ！
あんたの手なんか借りなくても平気っ
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course! I don't need your help.

fields.EN:
(...Now my back's all sore. Haven't dropped
that hard in years.)
fields.JP:
（……とは言ったけど、お尻がジンジンする。
　こんなに痛いのは例の穴に落ちた時以来かも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...Now my back's all sore. Haven't dropped
that hard in years.)

fields.EN:
...Back then, Ellie and I fell down into
a sinkhole.
fields.JP:
――あの時。
あたしは、エリーと深い穴に落ちた
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Back then, Ellie and I fell down into
a sinkhole.

fields.EN:
I got the butterflies, bad. I shut my eyes,
anticipating to crash into the bottom.
fields.JP:
お腹の中身が浮くような感覚をおぼえながら、
間もなく訪れる死を覚悟して目を閉じた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got the butterflies, bad. I shut my eyes,
anticipating to crash into the bottom.

fields.JP: だけど、あたしたちは生き残ってしまった

fields.EN: I don't know if I'd call it lucky.
fields.JP: 運がよかったのか、悪かったのか、それは分からない
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know if I'd call it lucky.

fields.EN: Living with the guilt of being unable to save my adoptive parents and younger sister was literally a 'living hell.'
fields.JP:
義両親と妹を助けられなかったという罪悪感を抱き
ながら過ごすのは、文字通り『生き地獄』だったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Between guilt from my parents and the
fact I dragged Ellie into it, my life felt like
a living Hell.

fields.EN: Sometimes I wished I was dead.
fields.JP: 自分を責めるあまり、死のうと思った時もある
fields.LOCALIZED: Sometimes I wished I was dead.

fields.EN: Even so, I told myself that if I abandoned Ellie too, I wouldn't know what I'd been born for, and that was just enough to keep me from going over the edge.
fields.JP:
それでも、エリーのことまで見捨ててしまったら、
なんのために生まれてきたのか分からなくなると、
自分自身に言い聞かせ、ギリギリの所で踏み止まった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I couldn't abandon Ellie.
I couldn't do that to her.
That kept me alive.

fields.EN:
But this... This pain will live with me as
long as I live.
fields.JP: きっとこの痛みは、くたばるまで続く贖罪なんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this... This pain will live with me as
long as I live.

fields.EN: If that's so, then to atone to my adoptive parents and younger sisters, I have to live and suffer for even one second longer...
fields.JP:
だとしたら、あたしは義両親と妹たちに償うために、
１秒でも長く生きて、苦しまないといけないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In order to atone for my parents and my
sisters, I must live for twice as long and
endure.

fields.EN: Since then, I told Ellie never to call me Sis.
fields.JP: あれ以来、エリーには『おねえ』と呼ぶなと言っている
fields.LOCALIZED: Since then, I told Ellie never to call me Sis.

fields.EN: I failed her. I didn't deserve the title.
fields.JP:
自分は、姉失格だ。
そんなふうに呼ばれる資格なんてない
fields.LOCALIZED: I failed her. I didn't deserve the title.

fields.EN:
Oh, someone left a backpack!
Wonder if anything's in it...
fields.JP:
……あっ、リュックが落ちてる！
金目のものはあるかしらー……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, someone left a backpack!
Wonder if anything's in it...

fields.EN:
Tch. Nothing. It's covered in blood too,
so it's useless.
fields.JP:
チッ、収穫ゼロ。リュックも血だらけで
ボロボロで使えそうにないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch. Nothing. It's covered in blood too,
so it's useless.

fields.EN:
Damn. It's everywhere we go.
The world's finally ending.
fields.JP:
行く先々でこんなのばっか転がってるなんて、
世界もいよいよ終わりだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn. It's everywhere we go.
The world's finally ending.

fields.EN:
Never mind that. Let's hit the camp.
Bet they're short-staffed.
fields.JP:
そんなのに構ってないで、早く目当ての場所に行こ。
あいつらのキャンプ地、今なら手薄みたいだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never mind that. Let's hit the camp.
Bet they're short-staffed.

fields.EN:
Maybe we'll find something to make it
worth our while.
fields.JP:
こんなしけたものじゃない、
掘り出しものに巡り合えるといいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we'll find something to make it
worth our while.

fields.EN: (Contaminated Animals are no longer only as strong as small animals like before. They're getting more dangerous every year, and simple tools can't defeat them anymore—they're only good enough to help us escape.)
fields.JP:
（もう汚染動物も以前の小動物程度の力じゃない。
　年々危険性が増し、もう道具程度じゃ倒せない。
　逃げるために使える程度だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Every year, the contamination just gets
worse and worse. Normal weapons don't
hurt those monsters. They just buy time.)

fields.EN: (Every year, it gets harder to survive.)
fields.JP:
（年々生き辛く、困難さは増してきた……
　それでも……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Every year, it gets harder to survive.)

fields.EN:
I don't care what it takes.
We're getting out of here alive.
fields.JP:
どんな手を使っても、あたしたちが
生き延びるための物資を確保しないとね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't care what it takes.
We're getting out of here alive.

fields.EN:
(We used the orb to head for a new tower.
The Grave Jail Tower.)
fields.JP:
（あれから僕たちは球体を使い、
　新しい場所――グレーヴの監獄塔へとやってきた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We used the orb to head for a new tower.
The Grave Jail Tower.)

fields.EN:
(By the time we finished setting up our camp,
I gathered everyone to inform them of what
I saw when I looked beyond the cracked wall.)
fields.JP:
（そしてキャンプの設営を終えたところで
　みんなを集め、外を眺めた時に起こった出来事を
　話すことにした……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(By the time we finished setting up our camp,
I gathered everyone to inform them of what
I saw when I looked beyond the cracked wall.)

fields.EN:
The Devouring Armada swallowed someone
whole...?
fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔が、人を飲み込んだ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Devouring Armada swallowed someone
whole...?

fields.EN:
Yeah. A pair of survivors tried to flee,
but the tower shot out tentacles that
just absorbed them.
fields.JP:
はい。生き残った人たちが逃げてたんですけど、
悪食の監隊塔から伸びた触手に捕まって
吸い込まれるように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. A pair of survivors tried to flee,
but the tower shot out tentacles that
just absorbed them.

fields.EN: What the hell? What chance do we have?
fields.JP:
おいおい、あんな巨大なもんに追われたら、
逃げられるわけねえだろ
fields.LOCALIZED: What the hell? What chance do we have?

fields.EN:
That's not all. It engulfed everything in its
path. Streets, buildings, everything.
fields.JP:
しかも周りの道路や建物も全部、
問答無用で飲み込んでいったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not all. It engulfed everything in its
path. Streets, buildings, everything.

fields.EN: The thought makes my hair stand.
fields.JP: その場面を想像しただけで恐ろしい……
fields.LOCALIZED: The thought makes my hair stand.

fields.EN: I suppose that means we can't go outside.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ監獄塔の外には
確かに出られないわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I suppose that means we can't go outside.

fields.EN:
Seriously. The surface has brought us nothing
but trouble. Damn it.
fields.JP:
マジで地上にいいこと、
ひとっつもねえな……クソッ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. The surface has brought us nothing
but trouble. Damn it.

fields.EN:
It's just like Gatou-san said. Our safest option is
staying in the tower.
fields.JP:
あれを見た後なら、賀東さんが言ってたように
監獄塔の中の方が安全だって思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just like Gato said. Our safest option is
staying in the tower.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Indeed. If the Devouring Armada Tower eats
towers with which it has no connection, then
it's best for us to stay here.
fields.JP:
そうだね。悪食の監隊塔は、
従属関係にない監獄塔さえも飲み込むから、
ここにいた方が安全なのは間違いないと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. If the Devouring Armada Tower eats
towers with which it has no connection, then
it's best for us to stay here.

fields.EN:
Couldn't we just clear out the Marchens
and Nightmares?
fields.JP:
まだメルヒェンやナイトメアの方が
対処のしようがあるものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Couldn't we just clear out the Marchens
and Nightmares?

fields.EN:
That's only one layer to the threat.
Somewhere on the surface has to be safe,
right?
fields.JP:
それでも充分危険なことには変わりはないわ。
ねえ、地上にはどこか安全な場所はないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's only one layer to the threat.
Somewhere on the surface has to be safe,
right?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: There may be safe places, but I haven't heard of any.
fields.JP:
安全な場所もあるのかもしれないが、
自分は聞いたことがないな

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: The Devouring Armada Tower floats, so it can cross seas and mountains. Its range of movement is enormous.
fields.JP:
なんせ悪食の監隊塔は浮遊しているから、
海でも山でも越えてくるんだ。
行動範囲はとてつもなく広いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Devouring Armada Tower can float
above oceans and mountains. There is
no escaping its gaze.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: And because it can move without warning, we never know when we'll enter the area it can mimic.
fields.JP:
しかも急に移動するから、
いつ擬態化する範囲に入ってしまうかも分からない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It stalks quietly, shifting direction in seconds
before enclosing around its prey.

fields.EN: Makes life impossible for us up here.
fields.JP:
じゃあもう地上で生きていくことは
不可能なんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Makes life impossible for us up here.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
As far as I know, humanity has no way of
countering its appetite for destruction.
fields.JP:
少なくとも、今のところ
人類は為す術もなくやられっぱなしだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As far as I know, humanity has no way of
countering its appetite for destruction.

fields.EN:
(Geez. Sounds like we were better off
underground.)
fields.JP:
（こんなことなら地下にいた方が
　全然マシだったってことじゃないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Geez. Sounds like we were better off
underground.)

fields.JP:
（……あれ？　でも悪食の監隊塔は
　すべてを飲み込むんだよね？　なら別に、
　地下だから安全なんてことはないはず）

fields.EN:
(But it never attacked the underground Jail.
Why is that...?)
fields.JP:
（でも僕たちがいた地下監獄は襲われていない……
　なんで安全だったんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But it never attacked the underground Jail.
Why is that...?)

fields.EN:
If the surface is so dangerous, how do you
explain Genocide Pink running all over?
fields.JP:
地上に安全な場所はなさそうっていうのは
分かったけど、じゃあ処刑台少女たちは
どうしてそんな危険な外に出ていたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the surface is so dangerous, how do you
explain Massacre Pink running all over?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: That's right. They went outside like it was nothing, seemed unconcerned about the Devouring Armada Tower, and were killing people.
fields.JP:
そうだ、あいつらは普通に外に出て、
悪食の監隊塔なんて気にしてない感じで
人々を殺していたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. They operate outside without any
fear of being devoured.

fields.EN:
Good point. That's odd. It's like they knew
they weren't in any danger.
fields.JP:
確かにおかしな話ね。
まるで自分たちは襲われないと
分かっているかのよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good point. That's odd. It's like they knew
they weren't in any danger.

fields.EN: Come to think of it, when we came to the surface, I don't think the Armada Tower was moving either. Maybe they knew it was safe...
fields.JP:
そういえば僕たちが地上に来た時は、
監隊塔も動いていなかった気がする。
もしかして安全だって分かっていたのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that you mention it, that big tower
wasn't moving when we first ascended.
Maybe they know something we don't.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
To answer your question, I suspect that
the Devouring Armada Tower may be
Genocide Pink's stronghold.
fields.JP:
それについては、そもそも悪食の監隊塔が
処刑台少女の根城なのではないか、と
推測されているよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To answer your question, I suspect that
the Devouring Armada Tower may be
Massacre Pink's stronghold.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Perhaps they are spared its fate thanks to
their roles as wardens.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら、彼女たちは『管理者』として
特別扱いを受けているのかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps they are spared its fate thanks to
their roles as wardens.

fields.EN:
So are you saying Genocide Pink has the
power to control that thing?!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ処刑台少女が悪食の監隊塔を動かして
人を襲わせているってことですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So are you saying Massacre Pink has the
power to control that thing?!
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
It's just a theory.
But it's one my observations seem to support.
fields.JP:
あくまで推測でしかないがね。
ただ、そう思わせるふしはいくつも見受けられる
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a theory.
But it's one my observations seem to support.

fields.EN:
That's our worst case scenario. It's not
just the homicidal maniacs we have to
worry about. We've got their big tower too.
fields.JP:
それが本当だとしたら、最悪ね。
処刑台少女だけでも恐ろしい相手なのに
監隊塔まで相手にしないといけない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's our worst case scenario. It's not
just the homicidal maniacs we have to
worry about. We've got their big tower too.

fields.EN: That's nothing but despair. How are we supposed to fight against that...?
fields.JP:
そんなの、絶望しかないじゃないか。
どうやって立ち向かえばいいんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is something out of a bad dream.
What do they expect us to do?

fields.EN: Chii, pain is pain. Okay is okay.
fields.JP:
ちーちゃん、つらいはつらい。
大丈夫は大丈夫
fields.LOCALIZED: Chii, pain is pain. Okay is okay.

fields.EN: Michiru, was that an attempt to comfort me?
fields.JP:
大丈夫だって思えば、大丈夫だってこと？
姉さん
fields.LOCALIZED: Michiru, was that an attempt to comfort me?

fields.EN: But how'd it get so big to begin with?
fields.JP:
しかし、どうしてあの悪食の監隊塔は
あんなにも大きいのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: But how'd it get so big to begin with?

fields.EN:
It's enormous compared to the other towers
we've encountered.
fields.JP:
今までの監獄塔が普通のサイズだとするなら、
あれはまさしく異常よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's enormous compared to the other towers
we've encountered.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Possibly some kind of mutation, but I cannot
say for certain.
fields.JP:
突然変異と言われているが、
それ以上は自分もよく知らないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Possibly some kind of mutation, but I cannot
say for certain.

fields.EN:
I just realized. The big tower doesn't have the
white moon that the underground Jail had.
fields.JP:
そういえば……今思えば、
あの監隊塔には地下監獄のような
『白い月』がないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just realized. The big tower doesn't have the
white moon that the underground Jail had.

fields.EN: It's not all red either. What does that mean?
fields.JP:
それに、世界って本来こんなに
真っ赤なものじゃないでしょう？
その辺りが関係していたりするとかは……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not all red either. What does that mean?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Hate to say this, but we don't know how
they're correlated yet. But that part about
the white moon is correct.
fields.JP:
残念だが、その辺りの因果関係は不明だ。
だが少なくとも、他の監獄塔には
確かに白い月があるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hate to say this, but we don't know how
they're correlated yet. But that part about
the white moon is correct.

fields.EN:
(So the only difference between Jail towers
is the moon...)
fields.JP:
（他の監獄塔との違いは、
　白い月があるかどうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So the only difference between Jail towers
is the moon...)

fields.EN: There's no way we would've missed the moon.
fields.JP:
まさか監隊塔の白い月を見落としていた、
なんてことはないはず……
fields.LOCALIZED: There's no way we would've missed the moon.

fields.EN: Yeah. Back then, there was definitely only the real moon in the sky.
fields.JP:
うん、あの時間違いなく
空には本物の月しか浮かんでいなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. There's only one moon in the sky.

fields.EN: Do you think it's trying to reach the moon?
fields.JP: もしかして、本物の月を目指しているとか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you think it's trying to reach the moon?

fields.EN: No way. Are you saying the Jail Tower is mistaking it for one?
fields.JP:
まさか、そんな馬鹿な。
監隊塔が勘違いしているとでも言うの？
fields.LOCALIZED: No, that's impossible. How could it?

fields.EN: Could something like that really happen?
fields.JP: そんなこと、あり得るんですか？

fields.EN: I've only heard about it myself, but apparently some plants do move that way.
fields.JP:
私も聞いたことしかないのだけど、
植物の一部には、そういう動きを
するものもあるらしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe it feeds off of light from the moon.

fields.EN:
Sunflowers, for example, shift their stems
to face towards the sun.
fields.JP:
例えばひまわりは、太陽の方を向くために
自らの茎を動かしていくわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sunflowers, for example, shift their stems
to face towards the sun.

fields.EN: And in the same way, the Jail Tower moves toward what will fertilize it—the white moon.
fields.JP:
そしてそれと同じように、
監獄塔も自らが受精するもの――
白い月に向かって動いていく
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail might be similarly inclined to face
the moon—meaning it intends to plant itself 
there.

fields.EN: Living things evolve so they can take the actions they need to obtain what they need.
fields.JP:
このように生物というものは、必要なもののために
必要な行動を取れるように進化するものなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a survival instinct. The tower moves
according to its energy source.

fields.EN: With that in mind, for some reason the Devouring Armada Tower had no white moon. But when it looked up, the real moon was there instead...
fields.JP:
それを踏まえて、悪食の監隊塔には
何らかの理由で白い月がなかった。
でも、見上げれば代わりに本物の月はある……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you consider that the Devouring Armada
Tower doesn't have its own moon, it has
to improvise. Look at the moon.

fields.EN: The Devouring Armada Tower mistook the real moon for its white moon and started heading toward it.
fields.JP:
あれ、白い月があるじゃないか。
悪食の監隊塔は、そう錯覚し月を目指し始めた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look, there it is. The big tower's aimed right
at it.

fields.EN:
That explains why it's increasing in size,
and why it floats around...?
fields.JP:
だからどんどん巨大になって、
ついには浮くようにもなった……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That explains why it's increasing in size,
and why it floats around...?

fields.EN:
All conjecture, of course. But if we think of
the Jail as a plant, it makes sense.
fields.JP:
もちろん推測よ。ただ、
植物の必要行動と照らし合わせると、
あり得る話ではないかって思っただけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All conjecture, of course. But if we think of
the Jail as a plant, it makes sense.

fields.JP: あなたなら、本当は知ってるんじゃないの？

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I must admit, I inferred the same.
But without a way to test it, it remains
a theory.
fields.JP:
まあ、その予想は確かにあったが、
結局のところ調べきれるものではないからね。
分からないままだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I must admit, I inferred the same.
But without a way to test it, it remains
a theory.

fields.EN: Wait. You said 'for some reason,' but where did the pistil... the female plant go?
fields.JP:
待って。何らかの理由って言ったけど、
その雌しべ……雌株はどこにいったのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. If the tower's planning to spread its
seed, does that mean there's a female plant?

fields.EN: Maybe some problem in nature beyond human understanding caused it to disappear?
fields.JP:
それは……人間には計り知れない、
何か自然界のトラブルでなくなったとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps. It could be right under our noses.
Something hidden among nature.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: (If the Jail Tower really is climbing toward the real moon, then where did its original white moon go...?)
fields.JP:
（確かに、仮に監隊塔が本物の月に
　上っていってるとしたら、本来の白い月は
　どこに行ったんだろう……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's right. What's on the moon that the
Jail wants so badly? What's it all mean?)

fields.JP: ……推測ではこの辺りが限界かしらね

fields.EN:
That's a start at least. Even if there's a lot
still to figure out.
fields.JP:
色々と話し合ったけど、
まだまだ分からないことだらけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a start at least. Even if there's a lot
still to figure out.

fields.EN:
What's certain is leaving this tower spells
doom.
fields.JP:
ひとつ確実なのは、
外には出ないほうがいいってことかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's certain is leaving this tower spells
doom.

fields.EN: Yes. It's best for us to stay indoors.
fields.JP: うん、今は監獄塔の中にいた方がいいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. It's best for us to stay indoors.

fields.EN:
Hey. Didn't Genocide Pink mention some kind
of a superior? They kept referring to Master...
fields.JP:
そうだ、処刑台少女には命令を出している存在が
いるんだよね？　確かマスターとかいう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey. Didn't Massacre Pink mention some kind
of a superior? They kept referring to Master...
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Some of them called him Papa.
fields.JP: パパ、って呼んでる子もいたよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Some of them called him Papa.

fields.EN: Maybe he's in charge of the big guy.
fields.JP:
もしかしたらそいつが、
悪食の監隊塔を牛耳っているのかも……
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe he's in charge of the big guy.

fields.EN:
That could be, but we don't know enough
to say. No point making assumptions.
fields.JP:
その可能性はあるけど、まだ情報が足りない。
決めつけても仕方ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That could be, but we don't know enough
to say. No point making assumptions.

fields.EN: We done for now then? Why don't we turn in?
fields.JP:
なあ、話は一区切りついたか？
もうそろそろ休まねえか？
fields.LOCALIZED: We done for now then? Why don't we turn in?

fields.EN:
Right. I bet everyone's spent from today.
Let's call it a night.
fields.JP:
そうね。みんなも疲れてることだろうし、
今日はこの辺りで解散にしましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I bet everyone's spent from today.
Let's call it a night.

fields.EN:
Tomorrow, we explore the new tower.
Sleep tight, everyone.
fields.JP:
明日からはこの新しい監獄塔の探索だし、
みんな、しっかりと休んでおいてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tomorrow, we explore the new tower.
Sleep tight, everyone.

fields.EN:
(There's a lot to think about, but first,
a well-deserved break.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、色々考えることはあるけど、
　今はちゃんと疲れを残さないようにしないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's a lot to think about, but first,
a well-deserved break.)

fields.EN:
Please be safe out there on your search.
Nothing's getting in this camp while I'm here.
fields.JP:
大変だろうけど、探索、頼んだぜ。
キャンプの方は死んでも守るからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please be safe out there on your search.
Nothing's getting in this camp while I'm here.

fields.EN: Leave it to us, Mamoru. We won't fall behind against Marchens or Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ああ、任せてくれマモル。
メルヒェンやナイトメアにおくれは取らないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave it to us, Mamoru. Expect us to recant
tales of victory upon our return.

fields.EN: Along with our friends, of course.
fields.JP: みんなを見つけられるように頑張るね
fields.LOCALIZED: Along with our friends, of course.

fields.JP: あのさ、ちょっといいかな、みんな

fields.EN:
You know how we've looked everywhere
for our friends and keep coming up short?
fields.JP:
僕たち、今までは漠然と
はぐれたみんなを探していただけだったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know how we've looked everywhere
for our friends and keep coming up short?

fields.EN:
While that's one of our priorities,
why don't we head for the big one?
fields.JP:
もちろんそれもとっても大事なんだけど……
どうかな、同時に悪食の監隊塔を目指すというのは
fields.LOCALIZED:
While that's one of our priorities,
why don't we head for the big one?

fields.EN: The hell? Have you actually lost your mind?
fields.JP: は？　お前いきなりなんてこと言ってくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED: The hell? Have you actually lost your mind?

fields.EN: Actually, you stole the words from my mouth.
fields.JP: 実は僕も、それを提案しようと思ってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Actually, you stole the words from my mouth.

fields.EN:
R-r-r-r-right. I, uh, had the same thought.
Sorta. Hehehehe...
fields.JP:
そっ、そそ、そうですよね～
あ……あたしもそれいいかなー、
なんて思ってて……ひひ、ひひひ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-r-r-r-right. I, uh, had the same thought.
Sorta. Hehehehe...

fields.JP: 意見変えるの早いわね……

fields.EN: Tell me about it. Mary's so open-minded.
fields.JP: そうなのよ、メアリーは柔軟なのよねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Tell me about it. Mary's so open-minded.

fields.EN:
Ultimately, no matter how many of us we
find, we can't live up here with that thing
flying around.
fields.JP:
結局、この先どれだけ仲間を見つけても、
悪食の監隊塔をどうにかしない限り、
外に出て平和に暮らすなんて、できやしないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ultimately, no matter how many of us we
find, we can't live up here with that thing
flying around.

fields.EN:
While we continue searching for our friends,
