we have to make our way to the main tower.
fields.JP:
だったら仲間を探しつつ悪食の監隊塔に向かって、
どうにか止める手段を探すべきなんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
While we continue searching for our friends,
we have to make our way to the main tower.

fields.EN: I concur. We'll have to face it sooner or later.
fields.JP:
その通りだ。いつかあの監隊塔を
止めなければいけないのは間違いないんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED: I concur. We'll have to face it sooner or later.

fields.EN:
Besides, these towers we're running through
are leading us right to it. We're bound to hit
an orb that takes us there.
fields.JP:
それに、今までの監獄塔が悪食の監隊塔の従属で、
光る球体で繋がれているというのなら、
辿っていけばきっといつか到達できると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, these towers we're running through
are leading us right to it. We're bound to hit
an orb that takes us there.

fields.EN:
It makes a lot of sense. We're following its
feeding pipeline, essentially.
fields.JP:
養分の送り先である
悪食の監隊塔に繋がっている可能性は、
充分に高いと私も思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It makes a lot of sense. We're following its
feeding pipeline, essentially.

fields.JP: 賀東さん、あなたもそう思うでしょう？
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Hm? Oh, sorry. I was lost in thought.
fields.JP:
ん？　ああ、すまない。
少し考えごとをしていた
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Oh, sorry. I was lost in thought.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Well said. That seems logical to me.
fields.JP:
そうだね、確かめたことはないが、
繋がっているかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well said. That seems logical to me.

fields.EN: And this may be something only we can do.
fields.JP:
それにこれは、僕たちにしか
できないことかもしれないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: To me, it's our best shot at moving ahead.

fields.EN: Yes. A ground siege is out of the question.
fields.JP: 外からじゃ乗り込むのは難しそうだもんな
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. A ground siege is out of the question.

fields.EN:
Right, and since we're already in one of its
feeding towers, we can infiltrate it.
fields.JP:
うん。ちょうど従属の監獄塔にいるからこそ、
僕たちは悪食の監隊塔を目指せるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, and since we're already in one of its
feeding towers, we can infiltrate it.

fields.EN:
That's not to say that breaking in won't
still be incredibly dangerous.
fields.JP:
とはいえ、悪食の監隊塔は処刑台少女たちの
根城かもしれないのよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not to say that breaking in won't
still be incredibly dangerous.

fields.EN:
That's true. But if we plan to escape this
place, we must fight true, no matter what
foul creatures await us.
fields.JP:
そうだね……だからもし目指すんであれば、
悪食の監隊塔に着くまでに、あいつらに負けない
力を、なんとしてもつけないといけない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true. But if we plan to escape this
place, we must fight true, no matter what
foul creatures await us.

fields.EN:
At this point, it's inevitable. Might as well
deal with it.
fields.JP:
このまま行けば、いつかぶつかる可能性は
高いと考えておいた方がいいものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this point, it's inevitable. Might as well
deal with it.

fields.EN:
This doesn't end here. I never want to feel
the pain of separation again.
fields.JP:
僕は絶対に負けたくない。
大事なものを失うなんて二度とごめんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This doesn't end here. I never want to feel
the pain of separation again.

fields.JP: 一緒に強くなろう、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Deal. I'll never abandon you, my lady.
My life belongs to you.
fields.JP:
ああ。姫とともに強くなって、
僕はさらに、そんな姫を守れるくらい
もっと強くなるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Deal. I'll never abandon you, my lady.
My life belongs to you.

fields.EN: Hehe. That makes two of us.
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. That makes two of us.

fields.EN:
All right, everyone. It's settled.
Ready to hit the main tower?
fields.JP:
じゃあみんな、
僕たちで悪食の監隊塔を止めにいく、でいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right, everyone. It's settled.
Ready to hit the main tower?

fields.EN:
Of course. We're practically there, aren't we?
It has to be us.
fields.JP:
わたし、賛成。
きっと悪食の監隊塔にいちばん近いの、
わたしたちだと思うし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. We're practically there, aren't we?
It has to be us.

fields.EN:
I agree with Princess. It is a worthy threat
to our collective strength. Let's end this now.
fields.JP:
姫の言うとおりだよ。何とかできる可能性が
いちばんあるのが僕たちだ。だからやらなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I agree with Princess. It is a worthy threat
to our collective strength. Let's end this now.

fields.EN:
Count me in. I've always dreamt of a peaceful
life. That's why we're here.
fields.JP:
わたしも賛成。平和な世界で
暮らすことを夢見て、地上にやって来たんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Count me in. I've always dreamt of a peaceful
life. That's why we're here.

fields.JP: 私もアリスと同じ意見よ
じゃ、じゃあ俺もシャーロットと、同じで……

fields.EN:
I knew you had it in you, Mary-chan!
We're in it together! As comrades♪
fields.JP:
さすがメアリーちゃん！
一緒に頑張ろうね！
握手握手♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew you had it in you, Mary!
We're in it together! As comrades♪
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーちゃん => Mary-chan

fields.EN:
Oh...uhhhhhh... erm...
I'll... do my best...
fields.JP:
あ……あわわわわわ……ぇっと、
がんばり……まっす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh...uhhhhhh... erm...
I'll... do my best...

fields.EN:
Whoa. The power of positivity...
She's soft. So smooth. I didn't realize
how close we got just then.
fields.JP:
ぅぉぉぉぉぉ陽キャパワーこええ……
近えしスキンシップすげえし……
あ、でも手、めっちゃスベスベだったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. The power of positivity...
She's soft. So smooth. I didn't realize
how close we got just then.

fields.EN:
If it guarantees the lot of you a nice lifetime
of peace, then I won't stand in the way.
fields.JP:
私は、みんなが幸せに暮らすための
選択なら異論はないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it guarantees the lot of you a nice lifetime
of peace, then I won't stand in the way.

fields.JP: はーい、みちるもちーちゃんと一緒だよ

fields.EN: Of course I'm in. This place is a shithole.
fields.JP:
賛成に決まってんだろ。
こんなクソみてえな世界のままで
納得なんてできるかってんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course I'm in. This place is a shithole.

fields.EN: So whether it's the Devouring Armada Tower or a Jail Tower, if they threaten us, we've got to stop them all.
fields.JP:
だから監隊塔だろうが監獄塔だろうが、
俺たちを脅かすなら全部止めてやんなきゃな
fields.LOCALIZED: Either the Devouring Tower, or the Jail.

fields.EN: Oh. Don't worry about leaving us behind.
fields.JP:
あ、監獄塔をなくした後の
俺たちの心配ならいらねえからな
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Don't worry about leaving us behind.

fields.EN:
(That's right. Mamoru and Hikari were
both revived by the core's technology.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、マモルたちは核に擬態化されて
　蘇っているから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. Mamoru and Hikari were
both revived by the core's technology.)

fields.EN:
It's fine. I'm sure we'll figure it out.
Or die trying.
fields.JP:
いいんだ。きっと何とかなるし、
そうなるように足掻くからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. I'm sure we'll figure it out.
Or die trying.

fields.EN:
Where there's a will, there's a way.
Isn't that right, Jack?
fields.JP:
『生きていればチャンスはある』……
そうだろ、ジャック？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Where there's a will, there's a way.
Isn't that right, Jack?

fields.JP: （それ、地上に出る前に僕が言った――）

fields.EN:
(But which core is linked to Mamoru and
Hikari?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、でもマモル達は今なんの核から
　エネルギーを貰ってるのかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But which core is linked to Mamoru and
Hikari?)

fields.EN:
(Is it linked to the Devouring Armada, or is
it a core we haven't found yet?)
fields.JP:
（常に新しい監獄塔の核から……？
　それとも破壊されてない核があるとか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is it linked to the Devouring Armada, or is
it a core we haven't found yet?)

fields.EN:
(I sure as hell hope we don't suffer any
sudden power outages in there...)
fields.JP:
（分かりようがなさそうだけど、
　急にエネルギー配給が
　なくならなければいいけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sure as hell hope we don't suffer any
sudden power outages in there...)

fields.EN:
Knowing Hikari, she'd want us to topple the
new Jail for causing so much suffering.
fields.JP:
それでいい。ヒカリの奴だって、
絶対に人々に害をなす監獄塔ならなくそうって
言うに決まってるしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowing Hikari, she'd want us to topple the
new Jail for causing so much suffering.

fields.EN: But until she wakes up, can't know for sure.
fields.JP:
それにしても、ヒカリは
相変わらず目を覚まさねえなあ
fields.LOCALIZED: But until she wakes up, can't know for sure.

fields.EN:
Yeah, but at least she's stable.
She's sleeping soundly, she's fine.
fields.JP:
そうだね……でも、傷も治ってるし、
今も気持ちよさそうに寝息を立ててるから、
きっと大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but at least she's stable.
She's sleeping soundly, she's fine.

fields.EN: Right. She's out like a light.
fields.JP: だな。まったく、幸せそうな寝顔しやがって
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. She's out like a light.

fields.EN:
Okay, then we'll stick to this tower for
now before Hikari wakes up.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあヒカリが目覚める前に
この監獄塔の探索を終わらせちゃおうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, then we'll stick to this tower for
now before Hikari wakes up.

fields.EN:
Then we're rounding up and heading straight
for the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP:
それで、悪食の監隊塔まで一気に
突き進もう、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we're rounding up and heading straight
for the Devouring Armada Tower.

fields.EN: Um, Charlotte-san? I had a quick question.
fields.JP:
あの、シャーロットさん、
ちょっと聞きたいことがあるんですけど
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, Charlotte? I had a quick question.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
What's up? I don't want to hear about you
and Alice crossing over in dreamland.
fields.JP:
あら何かしら？
昨日のジャック君が出ていたアリスの夢の内容は
分からないわよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's up? I don't want to hear about you
and Alice crossing over in dreamland.

fields.EN: What the—?! It's not like that!
fields.JP:
な、なんですかそれ！
そういうのじゃないです！
fields.LOCALIZED: What the—?! It's not like that!

fields.EN:
H-how did you know Jack was in my dream
last night?! ...Charlotte, did you—?!
fields.JP:
な、なんで昨日わたしが見た夢に
ジャックが出てきたことを知ってるの……！
……まさかシャーロット！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-how did you know Jack was in my dream
last night?! ...Charlotte, did you—?!

fields.EN:
That was just a joke, but hilarious that
it happened.
fields.JP:
流石にそれは冗談で言ったんだけど、
本当に見てたのね、ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That was just a joke, but hilarious that
it happened.

fields.JP: それでジャックくん、何を聞きたいの？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Anyone ever notice how all that time we
spent underground, not one of us even
knew the Devouring Armada Tower existed?
fields.JP:
僕たちは地下に長いこといたっていうのに、
悪食の監隊塔に襲われたりしませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyone ever notice how all that time we
spent underground, not one of us even
knew the Devouring Armada Tower existed?

fields.EN:
Considering how quickly it moves and
how much it eats, I find it odd that it wasn't
a problem sooner.
fields.JP:
あの監隊塔が、移動しながら
あらゆるものを喰らい尽くすというなら、
それはおかしいなって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering how quickly it moves and
how much it eats, I find it odd that it wasn't
a problem sooner.

fields.EN: Charlotte-san, I have a feeling you know why.
fields.JP:
それで、シャーロットさんなら、
どうして地下監獄が悪食の監隊塔に
襲われなかったのか分かるかなって思って
fields.LOCALIZED: Charlotte, I have a feeling you know why.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Sorry, I'm only knowledgeable about the
underground. I'm clueless about the surface.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、地下監獄の中のことは分かるんだけど、
外のことまでは分からないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, I'm only knowledgeable about the
underground. I'm clueless about the surface.

fields.JP:
そうですか……
さすがにそんなに都合よくはいかないか

fields.EN:
Tell us more about your "vision," Charlotte.
How do you know so much?
fields.JP:
そもそもシャーロットのその
『見えちゃう』っていうのは何なの？
どうしてそんなに知ることができるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tell us more about your "vision," Charlotte.
How do you know so much?

fields.EN:
Oh, I heard about that before. Apparently
Charlotte-san can get a bird's-eye view of the world
when she closes her eyes.
fields.JP:
ああ、それならこの前聞いたんだけど、
シャーロットさんって目をつぶると
俯瞰的に世界を視ることができるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. She explained it to me before.
Says she's got a bird's-eye view of
the world when she shuts her eyes.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: それってものすごいことだよね……

fields.EN:
Ah. Explains how she knew about the
pocketbook...
fields.JP: そうか、だから僕の王子様語録が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Explains how she knew about the
pocketbook...

fields.EN:
For some reason though, she's losing
touch with her powers.
fields.JP:
でも今は何故か、
その力も弱まってるらしいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For some reason though, she's losing
touch with her powers.

fields.EN: Yes, he's right. Real pathetic, isn't it?
fields.JP: そうそう、そうらしいのよ。大変よねえ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, he's right. Real pathetic, isn't it?

fields.EN:
I get the impression this doesn't bother 
you...
fields.JP: そんな他人事みたいに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get the impression this doesn't bother 
you...

fields.EN:
It must have something to do with her
Blood Ability.
fields.JP: きっと血式能力の１つみたいなものよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It must have something to do with her
Blood Ability.

fields.EN: If everyone has powers like that of their own, then I guess mine is probably the same kind of thing.
fields.JP:
みんなにもそれぞれそういった力があるんなら、
私のこれも、たぶんそうなんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Powers come and go.
This is just one of those times.

fields.JP: でも、どうして弱まってしまったのかしら……

fields.EN: Ugh. I'm gonna pull my hair out...
fields.JP: ああもう、調子が狂うわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. I'm gonna pull my hair out...

fields.EN:
Oh. I know. Charlotte, why weren't you a part
of the Dawn?
fields.JP:
はっ、そうだわシャーロット、
前に聞いた時は深く考えなかったけど、
どうして黎明に入らなかったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I know. Charlotte, why weren't you a part
of the Dawn?

fields.EN:
You knew us, you saw us, and you yourself
are a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
わたしたちのことも見えていて、
自分が血式少女だってことも
分かっていたっていうのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
You knew us, you saw us, and you yourself
are a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
Your life would've been easier if you had
joined, don't you think? Must've been so
dangerous.
fields.JP:
血式少女なら黎明に入った方が
生活は楽だったんじゃないか？
もちろん危険も多いけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your life would've been easier if you had
joined, don't you think? Must've been so
dangerous.

fields.EN:
Um, well... Honestly, I had to look out
for Mary.
fields.JP:
その、ね……正直メアリーを
ほっとけなかったっていうのも
あるんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, well... Honestly, I had to look out
for Mary.

fields.EN:
Ah. Is that an indirect way of saying
you'd miss me? Hehe... I have that
effect on people.
fields.JP:
シャーロットも
俺から目が離せなかったってことだな。
ぷくく……罪だな、俺も
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Is that an indirect way of saying
you'd miss me? Hehe... I have that
effect on people.

fields.EN: That's one way of looking at it...
fields.JP: すごい前向きな捉え方だね……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's one way of looking at it...

fields.EN:
To tell you the truth, I couldn't see myself
getting along with any of you. I'd be the odd
one out.
fields.JP:
実はね、正直言えばあなたたちの中に
混ざりたくない気持ちがあったの。
なんだか当事者になってしまいそうで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To tell you the truth, I couldn't see myself
getting along with any of you. I'd be the odd
one out.

fields.EN:
(Odd one out...? What does she mean by
that? I wonder what Charlotte-san being a
Blood Maiden means too.)
fields.JP:
（当事者……？　どういうことなんだろう。
　それもシャーロットさんの血式少女としての
　何かなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Odd one out...? What does she mean by
that? I wonder what Charlotte being a
Blood Maiden means too.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
It wasn't because I hated you guys or anything!
In fact, I love all of you!
fields.JP:
あ、もちろんあなたたちのことが
嫌いなわけじゃないのよ！？
むしろ全員大好きなくらい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't because I hated you guys or anything!
In fact, I love all of you!

fields.EN:
We get it, we can see. Interesting choice of
words though.
fields.JP:
それは見ていれば分かるから
気にしていないけど……不思議な言い回しね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We get it, we can see. Interesting choice of
words though.

fields.EN: Charlotte, what fairy tale are you from?
fields.JP:
そもそもシャーロットって、
何の童話なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Charlotte, what fairy tale are you from?

fields.EN:
Huh? I never thought about it. Couldn't
tell you.
fields.JP:
あれ？　あまり気にしてなかったけど、
確かに童話が想像つかないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I never thought about it. Couldn't
tell you.

fields.EN:
Everyone else is fairly easy to identify,
yet Charlotte-san remains an enigma.
fields.JP:
他のみんなが分かりやすいだけかもしれないけど、
シャーロットさんはパッと出てこないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone else is fairly easy to identify,
yet Charlotte remains an enigma.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Seriously. What could it be?
Hope someone finds out.
fields.JP:
ね、私の童話って何かしらね？
分かるといいわよね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. What could it be?
Hope someone finds out.

fields.EN:
(She's so nonchalant about everything.
I can't tell if it's an act or not.)
fields.JP:
（本人がこれじゃあ、
　僕たちには分かりそうもないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so nonchalant about everything.
I can't tell if it's an act or not.)

fields.EN: Well, let's bring it up to Michiru-san.
fields.JP: じゃあ今度ミチルさんに聞いてみようよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, let's bring it up to Michiru.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ミチルさん => Michiru-san

fields.EN:
You're right. Lady Oohime has got to know
something.
fields.JP:
そうね、大陽女さんなら
知ってるかもしれないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Lady Oohime has got to know
something.

fields.EN: Is it really that big of a deal?
fields.JP: そんなに人の童話知りたいもんかね
fields.LOCALIZED: Is it really that big of a deal?

fields.EN:
Of course. If we know her story, we'll get
insight into her abilities, her Blood Libido.
All kinds of handy stuff.
fields.JP:
もちろんよ。シャーロットの童話が分かれば、
見えちゃう能力が何かとか、血式リビドーとか、
これからに役立つことが分かるかもしれないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. If we know her story, we'll get
insight into her abilities, her Blood Libido.
All kinds of handy stuff.

fields.EN:
Really? As long as Charlotte doesn't have
another outburst, then it's fine with me.
fields.JP:
そうなのか？　まあ俺はシャーロットが
この間みてーにならなきゃ、何でもいいけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? As long as Charlotte doesn't have
another outburst, then it's fine with me.

fields.JP: この間？　何かあったのかいメアリー

fields.EN:
Well, it happened right when Genocide
Pink staged their little ambush.
fields.JP:
いや、俺たち地上に出てすぐに
処刑台少女に襲われただろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it happened right when Massacre
Pink staged their little ambush.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Charlotte started screaming out!
"Alice! Don't die!" It was nuts.
fields.JP:
そん時いきなりシャーロットが、
見たことない勢いで『アリス、死んじゃダメ』って
絶叫しまくってたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte started screaming out!
"Alice! Don't die!" It was nuts.

fields.EN: Aw, Mary. I don't remember that...
fields.JP: やだメアリー、私そんなことした覚えないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, Mary. I don't remember that...

fields.EN:
Hmm... Couldn't it have been one of Mary's
usual visions?
fields.JP:
うーん……それって
メアリーお得意の幻覚とかじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. Any chance it was just one of Mary's
phantoms?
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN: What?! I'm not lying! I saw it! It's real!
fields.JP:
は！？　俺は嘘ついてねえよ！
しっかり見たんだよ、現実だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! I'm not lying! I saw it! It's real!

fields.EN:
The name thing, I get. But the hysteria?
We never even met.
fields.JP:
名前は知っていたとして、
接触がないわたしになんでそんな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The name thing, I get. But the hysteria?
We never even met.

fields.EN:
True. That's weird. Maybe Charlotte-san had heard
your name from someone before.
fields.JP:
そうだね、確かに変だ。だってシャーロットさん、
アリスは知っていても、
アリスとは出会ってないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. That's weird. Maybe Charlotte had heard
your name from someone before.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: But she screamed it at the top of her lungs.
fields.JP: でもマジで連呼してたぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED: But she screamed it at the top of her lungs.

fields.EN:
Sorry, everyone. I can't recall any of what
Mary described.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、みんな。
メアリーが言ったことは本当に何も覚えてないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, everyone. I can't recall any of what
Mary described.

fields.EN: I see. Well, there's no point pressing it.
fields.JP:
そう……それなら、
これ以上は追求しようがないわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Well, there's no point pressing it.

fields.EN: As long as Charlotte feels fine, I don't care.
fields.JP:
ま、別に俺もいつものシャーロットで
いてくれれば、そんなことはどうでもいいしな
fields.LOCALIZED: As long as Charlotte feels fine, I don't care.

fields.EN:
Okay, let's move on. Thanks for opening up
to us about it, Charlotte-san.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ先に進もうか。
シャーロットさん、色々話してくれて
ありがとうございました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, let's move on. Thanks for opening up
to us about it, Charlotte.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Sorry I couldn't be more useful.
fields.JP: お役に立てずにごめんなさいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry I couldn't be more useful.

fields.JP:
（シャーロットさんとアリス、
　どういう繋がりがあるんだろう）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: It's the core. Nice call, Jack!
fields.JP:
核だわ
やったわねジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED: It's the core. Nice call, Jack!

fields.JP: 番人がいるね、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: これは戦うしかないようね

fields.EN:
What's the point in guarding it anyway?
Ugh. I hate breaking a sweat.
fields.JP:
こんなん守ってどうするんだよ。
めんどくせえ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the point in guarding it anyway?
Ugh. I hate breaking a sweat.

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: Mary, get in position. Look alive!
fields.JP:
ほら、メアリー構えなさい
怪我しちゃうわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, get in position. Look alive!

fields.EN:
This is way beyond just getting hurt!
Ah, damn it!
fields.JP:
怪我しちゃうとかそういうレベルじゃないだろ！
あーくそっ！
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
つかれた……
だりぃ……

fields.EN: Nicely done, Mary. Here. Rest on me.
fields.JP:
メアリーお疲れさま、えらかったわね。
ほら、私により掛かりなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Nicely done, Mary. Here. Rest on me.

fields.EN:
(You know, for all her faults, at least
Mary's easy to cooperate with.)
fields.JP:
（こう見るとメアリーが
　物凄く扱いやすい気がしてきた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(You know, for all her faults, at least
Mary's easy to cooperate with.)

fields.EN:
Sorry to interrupt Charlotte-san, but do you
still sense a core nearby?
fields.JP:
労っているところ申し訳ないが、
シャーロットさんまだ核の気配は感じる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to interrupt Charlotte, but do you
still sense a core nearby?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Hm. Hard to say. Don't we need to go higher?
fields.JP:
うーん……
ちょっともう少し上に行かないと
わからないかも？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Hard to say. Don't we need to go higher?

fields.EN:
Looks like we'll have to.
Stick close, everyone.
fields.JP:
それじゃ変わらず用心して
進むしかないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we'll have to.
Stick close, everyone.

fields.EN: Right. Don't let your guards down.
fields.JP: うん、油断は禁物だもんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Don't let your guards down.

fields.EN:
As soon as we break the core, let's hit the
depths.
fields.JP:
それじゃ核を破壊したら
改めて奥を目指そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
As soon as we break the core, let's hit the
depths.

fields.JP: わかった、ジャックさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: I don't sense it at all anymore.
fields.JP: 今は完全に核の気配を感じないわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't sense it at all anymore.

fields.EN:
(No telling how many are left now.
I wonder who destroyed it.)
fields.JP:
（いくつの核があるのかわからないけど、
　いったい誰が破壊してるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No telling how many are left now.
I wonder who destroyed it.)

fields.EN: (A Blood Maiden or a Dawn member, I hope.)
fields.JP: （これが他の血式少女や黎明の人ならいいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (A Blood Maiden or a Dawn member, I hope.)

fields.JP:
辺りが真っ暗になってきたよ……
おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: A Nightmare! Behind me, my lady.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアだ！
姫、気を付けて！
fields.LOCALIZED: A Nightmare! Behind me, my lady.

fields.JP: 気を引き締めなきゃいけないみたいね

fields.EN: OH-KAY! L-L-L-Let's do it! Let's goooo!
fields.JP:
お、おっし！　やややってやろうぜ！
いくぞおおおお！
fields.LOCALIZED: OH-KAY! L-L-L-Let's do it! Let's goooo!

fields.EN: Aw. Mary's got a cute battle charge.
fields.JP: メアリーも士気を高めててえらいわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. Mary's got a cute battle charge.

fields.EN:
There I go again, making a fool out of myself
by stepping out of character. Kill me...
fields.JP:
って……陽キャのマネをしてみたけど、
ものすごく恥ずかしいなコレ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There I go again, making a fool out of myself
by stepping out of character. Kill me...

fields.JP: グレーヴの監獄塔ナイトメア

うわっ……！
本当に来やがった！

fields.EN:
All together now! If one of us falls back,
we all follow!
fields.JP:
みんな気を付けて！
危ないと思ったらすぐ逃げよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All together now! If one of us falls back,
we all follow!

fields.EN: Got it, Jack! It's barreling towards us!
fields.JP:
ええ、わかってるわジャック
来るわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it, Jack! It's barreling towards us!

fields.EN: Hey, it's faltering! Kill it where it stands!
fields.JP:
よし、やったぞ！
このまま畳みかけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, it's faltering! Kill it where it stands!

fields.JP:
おつうちゃん
わたしもがんばる！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: We did it, Otsuu-chan! Is everyone okay?
fields.JP:
やったよ、おつうちゃん！
みんな怪我ない？
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it, Otsuu! Is everyone okay?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I'm fine, my lady. Especially now after
witnessing your heroic splendor.
fields.JP:
ああ、僕は平気だよ姫。
姫の活躍この目でしかと見届けました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine, my lady. Especially now after
witnessing your heroic splendor.

fields.EN:
Oh, Otsuu-chan! You flatter me. You were quite
the prince back there. So gallant.
fields.JP:
もう、おつうちゃんってば！
おつうちゃんも王子様みたいで
かっこよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Otsuu! You flatter me. You were quite
the prince back there. So gallant.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2

fields.EN:
Does anyone have a paper bag I could
borrow...?
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does anyone have a paper bag I could
borrow...?

fields.EN: We came all this way, and no one's here.
fields.JP:
ここまできてやっぱりまだ仲間に
会わなかったね……
fields.LOCALIZED: We came all this way, and no one's here.

fields.EN:
I hear you, Jack. Maybe our reunion was
pure dumb luck.
fields.JP:
そうね、ジャック……
わたし達が出会えたことも
奇跡だったのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hear you, Jack. Maybe our reunion was
pure dumb luck.

fields.EN:
This might sound crazy, but I get a feeling
someone is just beyond this area.
fields.JP:
でも、気のせいかもしれないけど、
この先に人の気配を感じるのよね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This might sound crazy, but I get a feeling
someone is just beyond this area.

fields.JP: 本当ですか、シャーロットさん！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: It's just a hunch. Don't hate me if I'm wrong.
fields.JP:
なんとなくよ？
間違っていたらごめんなさいね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's just a hunch. Don't hate me if I'm wrong.

fields.EN: I trust her instinct. Let's run with it.
fields.JP: シャーロットの勘は鋭いから期待できるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I trust her instinct. Let's run with it.

fields.EN: Hehe. I'm relieved to hear you say that, Charlotte.
fields.JP:
ふふ、アリスにそんな風に言ってもらえると
嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I'm relieved to hear you say that, Charlotte.

fields.EN:
(Somehow, when Charlotte-san says it, I start to
think it really exists...)
fields.JP:
（なんでかシャーロットさんが言うと
　本当にいる気がしちゃう……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I have a feeling she's onto something.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: それじゃ油断せず、先に進もう！

fields.EN:
Say! That's another orb, isn't it?
It'll lead us to the next tower.
fields.JP:
あっ！　あれ球体じゃない？
これで次の監獄塔に行けるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say! That's another orb, isn't it?
It'll lead us to the next tower.

fields.JP: 姫、待つんだ！　……あいつがいる
どうしてあいつがこんなところに……！
まさかこんなに早く遭遇するなんて……

fields.EN: Mary, stay close. Play it cool.
fields.JP: メアリー、危ないから離れてはダメよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, stay close. Play it cool.

fields.EN: L-L-Let's run for it! She's a maniac!
fields.JP:
ににに、逃げようぜ……！
あいつには関わんねえ方がいいって……！
fields.LOCALIZED: L-L-Let's run for it! She's a maniac!

fields.EN:
We can't. She's seen us already.
In fact, I think she's been waiting for us.
fields.JP:
駄目ね。もう向こうも気づいてる。
いや、初めから待ち構えていた……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't. She's seen us already.
In fact, I think she's been waiting for us.

fields.EN:
Ah. In come the filthy little insects.
'Bout time you showed up.
fields.JP:
おや、ようやく来ましたか、動くゴミども。
よくもまああんな最下層からここまで来たものです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. In come the filthy little insects.
'Bout time you showed up.

fields.EN:
(She was waiting for us. How did she know?
Does she know where our camp is too?)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり僕たちのことを待ってたみたいだ。
　もしかしてどこにいるか、把握されている？
　だとしたら、キャンプ地も知っているのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She was waiting for us. How did she know?
Does she know where our camp is too?)

fields.EN: You should've just died up on the surface. Instead, you shamelessly kept running around and made me go to all this trouble... It's been a long time since trash irritated me this much.
fields.JP:
あのまま地上で死んでいればよかったものを、
意地汚くも逃げ回って、手間かけさせて……
久しぶりですよ、ゴミにここまで苛立ったのは
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of you should have survived the minute
you set foot on the surface. 
Then you made such a mess. How infuriating.

fields.EN:
Master told me not to harm you, but with
all the damage you've done to my jurisdiction,
I'm afraid I can no longer watch.
fields.JP:
マスターには手を出すなと言われていますが、
ここまで私の管轄区域を荒らされたとあっては、
さすがに許すことはできませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Master told me not to harm you, but with
all the damage you've done to my jurisdiction,
I'm afraid I can no longer watch.

fields.EN:
Jurisdiction...? Guillotine, do you control
this tower?
fields.JP:
管轄区域……？
この監獄塔はギロチンが管理しているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jurisdiction...? Guillotine, do you control
this tower?

fields.EN: Don't think that needed to be asked.
fields.JP: 話ぶりからすると、そうみたいだね。
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't think that needed to be asked.

fields.EN: Something tells me this isn't a friendly visit.
fields.JP: 逃がしてくれる気は、ないみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Something tells me this isn't a friendly visit.

fields.EN:
Damn it. I should have faked sick and stayed
back at the tent!
fields.JP:
くそぉ、こんなことなら
仮病使ってテントで寝てりゃあよかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it. I should have faked sick and stayed
back at the tent!

fields.EN:
Filth like you are undeserving of my time.
Time to gut you.
fields.JP:
さて、ゴミ相手にこれ以上話すこともありません。
今度は綺麗に内臓ぶちまけて下さいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Filth like you are undeserving of my time.
Time to gut you.

fields.EN:
Wait. Why did your master tell you not to
harm us?
fields.JP:
ちょっと待って、どうしてそのマスターって人は
僕たちに手を出すなって言ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. Why did your master tell you not to
harm us?

fields.EN:
Hey. Who do you think you are, casually
referring to Master? I'll grind you against
the ground for invoking his name.
fields.JP:
おい、お前今、気安くマスターって言ったな？
地面の底を這い回っていたゴミが、
軽々しく口にしていい存在じゃないぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey. Who do you think you are, casually
referring to Master? I'll grind you against
the ground for invoking his name.

fields.EN:
What do I call him then? Come on,
we're just chatting here.
fields.JP:
じゃあ何て呼べばいいかな。
対話をするくらい、いいじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do I call him then? Come on,
we're just chatting here.

fields.EN: Don't you understand what 'shut up' means? Just keep your mouth closed until you're on the verge of death. The only thing your mouth is good for is coughing up blood.
fields.JP:
黙れって意味も分からないか？
いいから死ぬ寸前まで口を閉じてろよ。
お前の口は血ヘド吐く以外価値なんてねえんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you a fool or a dimwit? Shut that mouth
before I make you. My stomach turns every
time you squeak.

fields.EN:
Besides, nothing can save you now.
You're better off silent.
fields.JP:
それに今から死ぬお前たちには、
何の関係もないことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, nothing can save you now.
You're better off silent.

fields.EN:
There's no use reasoning with her, Jack.
She's a tyrant.
fields.JP:
不快になるだけだから、
無理に会話しようとしなくていいわ、ジャック。
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no use reasoning with her, Jack.
She's a tyrant.

fields.EN:
Some people respond better to...physical
forms of diplomacy.
fields.JP:
少なくとも叩き伏せた後じゃないと、
何も聞き出せないと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some people respond better to...physical
forms of diplomacy.

fields.EN:
By all means, are you volunteering yourself
first? How dare you speak to me that way,
scum!
fields.JP:
勝てる気でいやがんのか？
ゴミで虫ケラのお前らごときが！　この私に！
fields.LOCALIZED:
By all means, are you volunteering yourself
first? How dare you speak to me that way,
scum!

fields.EN:
Fat chance. I took a vow with my princess that
I would become stronger. Starting with you!
fields.JP:
どうかな……ただ僕は姫に強くなるって
誓ったんだ。前のようにはやられない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fat chance. I took a vow with my princess that
I would become stronger. Starting with you!

fields.JP:
うん、わたしたちは
こんなところで死ねないもん！

fields.EN:
Shut up! Enough of your idiotic rambling!
Scum like you should never mix,
but you all make me sick! You're trash!
fields.JP:
うるせえぇぇぇ！　ゴミ同士の絆とか馬鹿か！？
汚物と吐瀉物が混ざり合ったところで、
ただの肥溜めが完成するだけだろうが！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up! Enough of your idiotic rambling!
Scum like you should never mix,
but you all make me sick! You're trash!

fields.EN:
Argh. I'm losing it with you people.
I'll kill you all!
fields.JP:
クソッ、苛つく苛つくっ……！
絶対にぶっ殺してやる！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh. I'm losing it with you people.
I'll kill you all!

fields.EN: You want some, come get it!
fields.LOCALIZED: You want some, come get it!

fields.EN: Everyone, let's make sure we survive this!
fields.JP: みんな、絶対に生き延びよう！

fields.EN:
It appears you're adapting to the surface.
Impressive.
fields.JP:
地上で揉まれて、
多少は環境に適応したゴミになったか
fields.LOCALIZED:
It appears you're adapting to the surface.
Impressive.

fields.EN:
We're fine! We've got the upper hand this
time.
fields.JP:
大丈夫よ。前に比べたら、
わたしたち戦えてるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're fine! We've got the upper hand this
time.

fields.EN:
Aye. Those towers have conditioned us
to our peaks. She's no match for our might.
fields.JP:
ああ、あれから僕たちだって、
いくつも監獄塔を生き抜いてきて、強くなってる。
決して勝てない相手じゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aye. Those towers have conditioned us
to our peaks. She's no match for our might.

fields.EN:
Yup. Five fully-powered Blood Maidens.
We got this.
fields.JP:
強くなった血式少女が
５人もいるんだもん、何とかなるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Five fully-powered Blood Maidens.
We got this.

fields.EN:
Wipe those smirks from your faces.
How pathetic of you to celebrate your
victory prematurely.
fields.JP:
少しばかり戦いで生き長らえただけで、
その喜びよう……いかに低レベルな世界で
生きてきたか、知れるというもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wipe those smirks from your faces.
How pathetic of you to celebrate your
victory prematurely.

fields.EN:
Your arrogance sickens me. My blood is
boiling.
fields.JP:
それなのに調子に乗りやがって……
本当に、はらわたが煮えくりかえる思いだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your arrogance sickens me. My blood is
boiling.

fields.EN:
Master told me to spare Alice, but I'm no
longer letting you make a fool of me.
fields.JP:
マスターからは、アリスだけは
絶対に殺すなと言われているが……
ここまで舐められたら、我慢ならないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Master told me to spare Alice, but I'm no
longer letting you make a fool of me.

fields.JP: ギロチンの気配が変わった……！
まだ力を隠し持っていたの……！？

fields.EN: AAAAH! She had us all fooled! We're doomed!
fields.JP:
ひぃぃぃっ……！
さ、さっきので全力じゃなかったのかよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: AAAAH! She had us all fooled! We're doomed!

fields.EN:
Ha. Did you seriously think I was trying?
Too late now. I'll slice you to pieces.
fields.JP:
ハッ、あれで全力だと思ったか？
もう後悔しても遅いぞ、綺麗に
スライスして並べてやる――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha. Did you seriously think I was trying?
Too late now. I'll slice you to pieces.

fields.JP: ん？　マスターから連絡ですか

fields.EN:
(That must be a pager. I've heard of those.
Apparently they allow people to communicate
over long distances.)
fields.JP:
（あれは確か、ポケベルっていう
　通信用の機械じゃなかったっけ。
　ずっと昔にあったものと聞くけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That must be a pager. I've heard of those.
Apparently they allow people to communicate
over long distances.)

fields.EN: What do we have here...? Huh? What the...!
fields.JP:
なになに……
え、どういうことですか……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What do we have here...? Huh? What the...!

fields.JP:
もしかしてマスター、
どこかで見ているんですか……？
いったい、どうしたっていうのかしら

fields.EN: One look at that device, and she...
fields.JP: 変な機械を見たと思ったら急に……
fields.LOCALIZED: One look at that device, and she...

fields.EN: Hey, you giving up? Have at thee?
fields.JP:
おい、かかってこないのか！
僕たちの覚悟はとっくにできている！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, you giving up? Have at thee?

fields.EN:
I'm a little busy, so pipe down!
...Maybe I'll have to kill you after all.
fields.JP:
人が手が離せない時に、
好き勝手言いやがって……！
やっぱり殺してやろうか――
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm a little busy, so pipe down!
...Maybe I'll have to kill you after all.

fields.EN:
Rgh. I can't. I need to focus right now.
Can't disobey Master's orders.
fields.JP:
くっ、駄目だ。いかに愚かなゴミどもの
掃除といえど、一時の激情に身を任せて
マスターの命令を無視するなど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh. I can't. I need to focus right now.
Can't disobey Master's orders.

fields.EN: Damn. I was so close to slaughtering them all.
fields.JP: クソッ、もう少しで皆殺しにできたのに
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn. I was so close to slaughtering them all.

fields.EN:
Her demeanor totally changed.
What was that about?
fields.JP:
突然表情を変えて、
いったい何があったんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her demeanor totally changed.
What was that about?

fields.EN:
(Something about what Guillotine said
just doesn't sit well with me.)
fields.JP:
（それに、さっき言ったギロチンの台詞、
　あれもすごく気になる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Something about what Guillotine said
just doesn't sit well with me.)

fields.EN: Ah, you're Rachel-san. What an adorable name.
fields.JP:
レイチェルさんって言うんすかー。
可愛い名前っすねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, you're Rachel. What an adorable name.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN: Hehe. Thank you♪ I like your name too, Clara-san.
fields.JP:
えへへ、ありがとうございます♪
くららさんも、素敵なお名前ですよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Thank you♪ I like your name too, Clara.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららさん => Clara-san

fields.JP:
あはは、そ、そうっすか？
なんだかくすぐったいっす

（レイチェルさんって、
　明るくて人懐っこそうな感じの人っすね～）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN: Um. I know you just saved us, but, um...
fields.JP:
あ、あの～、助けてもらったのに
ずうずうしいかなって思うんですけど、
その……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. I know you just saved us, but, um...

fields.EN: What is it? Anything you want, go ahead.
fields.JP:
なぁに？　気になることがあったら、
遠慮なく言ってよ
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it? Anything you want, go ahead.

fields.EN: Um. Well, um... Could I...stay with you?
fields.JP:
あ、あの……えっと、その……
わたしも、ここにいて…いいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. Well, um... Could I...stay with you?

fields.EN:
I'm alone. I have nowhere else to go.
But if I'm bothering you, I'll shoo!
fields.JP:
１人ぼっちになって、行くあてがなくて。
あっ、ダメだったら諦めますからっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm alone. I have nowhere else to go.
But if I'm bothering you, I'll shoo!

fields.EN:
What do you mean?! Of course you can stay
with me! Can't she, everyone?
fields.JP:
な、何を言ってるんすか！
もちろんいいに決まってるっすよ！
ですよねっ、みなさん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean?! Of course you can stay
with me! Can't she, everyone?

fields.EN:
Of course. We'd never let you fend for
yourself out there. Make yourself at home here.
fields.JP:
そうよ、助けておいて、このまま放り出す
なんて酷い真似はしないから安心してよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. We'd never let you fend for
yourself out there. Make yourself at home here.

fields.EN:
Yeah! Even I'm merciful enough to approve your
addition to our squad. Stay as long as you
want.
fields.JP:
うむ！　我も心は広いからな！
レイチェルの気が済むまで、
同行することを許してやるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! Even I'm merciful enough to approve your
addition to our squad. Stay as long as you
want.

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
みんなで……一緒に……！
なかよくしよーね、ちぇるー！
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.EN: Okay. Thank you all. It's so nice to meet you♪
fields.JP:
は、はいっ、これからも
よろしくおねがいします♪
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. Thank you all. It's so nice to meet you♪

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: I have a question for you, Rachel. May I?
fields.JP:
ところで、レイチェルに
質問をしたいのだけれど、いいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: I have a question for you, Rachel. May I?

fields.JP:
は、はい。
なんでしょう、グレーテルさん？
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Why are you here all by yourself?
fields.JP: 貴女はなぜ、あんな場所に１人でいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why are you here all by yourself?

fields.EN:
Uh, that's easy. I, uh...can explain.
My Mama...and Papa... *sniffle*
fields.JP:
……っ、そうですよね。
みなさんに、事情…説明しないと。
実はあの日、パパとママが……っ、ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, that's easy. I, uh...can explain.
My Mama...and Papa... *sniffle*

fields.EN:
We had to hide for so long, and we almost
made it. But... *sniffle*
fields.JP:
わ、わたし、今まで、パパやママたちと、
ずっと支え合って、家族でひっそりと
ここで生きていたんです……ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We had to hide for so long, and we almost
made it. But... *sniffle*

fields.EN:
That day, the Nightmare came. My Papa told
us to go ahead, and ran towards it.
fields.JP:
でも、あの日……ナイトメアが出て、
わたしたちを逃がすために、
咄嗟にパパが立ち向かって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That day, the Nightmare came. My Papa told
us to go ahead, and ran towards it.

fields.JP:
（……っ、レイチェルさんの話、
　なんだか他人事とは思えないっす）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
*sniffle* I ran with Mama, then we saw a big
Marchen. Then Mama... Waaaah!
fields.JP:
ぐすっ、ママと一緒に必死に逃げていたら、
今度はわたしたちの前に、大きなメルヒェンが
現れたんです…それで……ママが、ううっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sniffle* I ran with Mama, then we saw a big
Marchen. Then Mama... Waaaah!

fields.EN:
Mama...told me to run. And never to turn back.
I just ran and ran. *hiccup*
fields.JP:
マ、ママは…わたしに逃げなさいって。
絶対、振り返っちゃダメって。
わたし、夢中で走って……ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mama...told me to run. And never to turn back.
I just ran and ran. *hiccup*

fields.EN:
I tripped and fell. Then I was here.
Mama and Papa must be... Wah.
fields.JP:
転んで気を失ったみたいで、
気がついたらここにいました。
パパとママは、きっともう……ううっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tripped and fell. Then I was here.
Mama and Papa must be... Wah.

fields.JP:
……なるほど、そういうことね。
事情は分かったわ

fields.EN:
Grr. Gretel, YOU'RE terrible. How can you be
so cold?
fields.JP:
ぬぅぅ、グレーテル、貴様は冷たすぎだ！
こやつの話を聞いて、気の毒だと思わんのかっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr. Gretel, YOU'RE terrible. How can you be
so cold?

fields.EN: Rather than pity her in some strange way, wouldn't it ultimately help her more if we listened to her and then thought about what to do from here?
fields.JP:
変に同情をするよりも、
話を聞いた上で、今後のことを考えた方が、
結果的に彼女を救えるのではないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why should we pity her? Shouldn't we educate
her on what she could do better for next time?

fields.EN: GRRR! Pull that stick out of your butt!
fields.JP: ぬううっ！　正論っぽく聞こえるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: GRRR! Pull that stick out of your butt!

fields.EN:
That must have been awful. Sorry you had to
deal with that all by yourself.
fields.JP:
……そんな辛いことがあったんだ。
思い出させちゃって、ごめんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That must have been awful. Sorry you had to
deal with that all by yourself.

fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.JP:
レイチェルさん。
これからは自分たちがついてるっすよ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
*sniffle* You're all so kind... Like my Mama.
*sniffle*
fields.JP:
ぐすん……みなさん、優しい……
ママみたい……ぐすっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sniffle* You're all so kind... Like my Mama.
*sniffle*

fields.EN:
I miss Mama and Papa... Don't...
Don't leave me... *hiccup*
fields.JP:
……ぐすん、パパとママに会いたいよ。
パパ、ママ……わたしを１人にしないで、
ひっ、ぐっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I miss Mama and Papa... Don't...
Don't leave me... *hiccup*

fields.JP:
……ん。なで、なで……
泣かないで……

fields.EN:
Hmph. Consider yourself lucky that you
survived at all in Mei-neesan's tower.
fields.JP:
ふ、ふん……メイ姉さんの監獄塔で
生き残れただけでも、運がいいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. Consider yourself lucky that you
survived at all in Sister Mei's tower.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN: Boo Shira! No meanies allowed here!
fields.JP:
ぶーっ、シラってば！
そんなつめたいこといっちゃ、だめなんだよー
fields.LOCALIZED: Boo Pyre! No meanies allowed here!

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
……ふ、ふんっ。
シラは知らない！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(Maybe Shira-san didn't like that Rapu-san and the
others were fussing over Rachel-san...?)
fields.JP:
（シラさんは、仲良しのラプさんたちが
　レイチェルさんばかり構うのが
　気に入らなかったんすかね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Pi doesn't like the fact we're all
paying attention to Rachel.)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): レイチェル => Rachel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Could she be jealous? Shira-san seems a little
younger than me. That's kind of cute.)
fields.JP:
（ひょっとして、嫉妬したとか？
　シラさんって、自分より少し
　年下みたいっすけど、かわいいなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She must be jealous. She's probably a little
younger than I am. I totally get it.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: あの子……怖いですぅ……ぐすっ

fields.EN:
Maybe at first, but she's also looking for her
family. She's nice once you get to know her.
fields.JP:
ちょっと怖そうに見えるけど、あの人も
少し寂しがりやなだけっす。
家族となかなか会えなくて、落ち込んでて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe at first, but she's also looking for her
family. She's nice once you get to know her.

fields.EN:
Hey, I remember! Kaede-san, we have to move
camp again! I figured out how to get to the
next tower.
fields.JP:
……って、思い出したっす！
カエデさん、新しい監獄塔に繋がる
道が開けたんで、また移動が必要かもっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I remember! Kaede, we have to move
camp again! I figured out how to get to the
next tower.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN: What? You want us to move again?
fields.JP: えっ、また拠点を移動するの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What? You want us to move again?

fields.EN:
I see. Thanks for the heads up. We'll divvy
up responsibilities and prepare for the trek.
fields.JP:
そうか、報告ありがとう。
後で手分けをして、
キャンプの移動の準備を始めようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Thanks for the heads up. We'll divvy
up responsibilities and prepare for the trek.

fields.EN: This is gonna take forever. I can taste it.
fields.JP:
移動自体も大変だけどー
これって、いつまで続くんでしょーね？
fields.LOCALIZED: This is gonna take forever. I can taste it.

fields.EN: ...I'm anxious too. But for now, I think all we can do is follow the sun's guidance and keep moving forward.
fields.JP:
……私も不安ではあります。
ですが、今はただ、タイヨウの
お導きのままに前に進むしかないかと
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still anxious. But so long as the sun's
guiding us, we'll be okay.

fields.EN:
(She's right. We gotta find Boss and the
others, fast!)
fields.JP:
（そうなんすよね…まずはあの時から、
　離れ離れになったままの仲間や師匠たちを
　探さないといけないっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right. We gotta find Boss and the
others, fast!)

fields.EN:
(Who knows how much longer we'll be
in here? All we can do is keep working,
one day at a time!)
fields.JP:
（未だに終わりは見えないっすけど、
　こうやって新しいところへいけば、
　少しずつでも先に進めてるはずっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Who knows how much longer we'll be
in here? All we can do is keep working,
one day at a time!)

fields.EN:
We're gonna find our friends sooner or later.
We just have to...right?
fields.JP:
頑張れば、いつか終わりが……
みんなとまた再会出来るはずっすよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're gonna find our friends sooner or later.
We just have to...right?

fields.EN:
There's no telling what awaits us through
that portal.
fields.JP:
いったい、いつになったらこれが
終わるのか、それは私にも分からないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling what awaits us through
that portal.

fields.EN:
Slowly but surely though, the pieces are
beginning to form.
fields.JP:
でも、少しずつだけれど、色々なピースが
手元に集まって来ているのは確かだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Slowly but surely though, the pieces are
beginning to form.

fields.EN: If we sort through those pieces, eventually the truth of this world will come into view. Our final destination should reveal itself eventually, too.
fields.JP:
そのピースの整理をしてゆけば、
やがてこの世界の真実が見えてくる。
私たちの最終地点も、いずれ現れるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eventually, we'll uncover whatever grim truth
awaits us.

fields.EN:
Never mind Gretel's ominous soliloquies!
Just leave it all to us! Hahahaha!
fields.JP:
グレーテルの小難しい話はよくわからぬが、
とにかく、大船に乗ったつもりで我に任せい！
ぬははははっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never mind Gretel's ominous soliloquies!
Just leave it all to us! Hahahaha!

fields.EN:
The truth of this world...? With Shira-san's help,
I feel like we're uncovering it piece by piece.
fields.JP:
この世界の真実っすか……
シラさんの協力のおかげもあって、
ひとつひとつ見えて来た気がするっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ominous soliloquies, huh...? Thanks to Pi,
they're all coming together.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Yup. No choice but to keep going.
fields.JP:
……ま、悩んだところで結局は、
みんなで先に進むしかないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. No choice but to keep going.

fields.EN: Totally! Off we go to the next tower!
fields.JP:
うんうん、そうっすよね！
次の監獄塔でも頑張るっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Totally! Off we go to the next tower!

fields.EN: I'm setting a pair of tents on this side.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、僕はこっち側に
テントを２つほど設置しておくよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm setting a pair of tents on this side.

fields.EN: Got it. We got this side.
fields.JP:
ええ、わかったわ。
あたしたちもこっちに設置するわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. We got this side.

fields.EN:
We've done this so many times, I'm an expert
now. We've even got all our stuff organized.
fields.JP:
何度もやって慣れたおかげか、
最初に設営した時よりもスムーズに
できるようになった気がしますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've done this so many times, I'm an expert
now. We've even got all our stuff organized.

fields.JP:
あ、あの……カエデさん。
わたしも一緒に
お手伝いしてもいいですか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
How kind of you, Rachel. Don't worry.
We've got it all under control.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、レイチェルは優しいね。
でも、気を遣わなくて大丈夫。
あたしたちだけでできるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
How kind of you, Rachel. Don't worry.
We've got it all under control.

fields.JP: でも……そんなの、わるいです……

fields.EN:
Of course it is. You've had a rough time.
Go ahead and rest. Let us handle everything.
fields.JP:
いいのいいの。
移動したばかりなんだし、休んでて。
無理は禁物よ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course it is. You've had a rough time.
Go ahead and rest. Let us handle everything.

fields.JP: は、はい、ありがとうございます

くんくん……ふん、ふん、ふん……
あれれっ？

fields.EN: Rapu-san, what's with the sniffing? Do I smell?
fields.JP:
ラプさん、匂いなんて嗅いでどうしたんすか？
変な臭いでもするっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Rappy, what's with the sniffing? Do I smell?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Um, maybe Rapunzel's imagining it,
but she smells Jack and Aka-Aka...? *sniff, sniff*
fields.JP:
んとねー、きのせいかもだけど、
じゃっくやあかあかのにおいがする？
……くんくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. I could be imagining things, but I think
I smell Jack and Red...? *sniff, sniff*...
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: What? You smell Jack-san? What are you, a dog?
fields.JP:
えっ、ジャックさんたちの匂いっすか？
いやいやそんな、犬じゃないんすから
fields.LOCALIZED: What? You smell Jack? What are you, a dog?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Oh! I smell them again! *sniff, sniff*...
It's coming from this way. Beyond the wall!
fields.JP:
あ！　またにおいがした。
くんくん……あ、こっちからする。
このかべのおくがあやしー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! I smell them again! *sniff, sniff*...
It's coming from this way. Beyond the wall!

fields.EN: This wall's in the way! I'm goin' for it.
fields.JP:
このかべ、すっごくじゃまー！
よーしっ、やっちゃおっと
fields.LOCALIZED: This wall's in the way! I'm goin' for it.

fields.EN:
Going for what? What are you doing?
Where are you going with that hammer?!
fields.JP:
ちょっ、やるって？
ハンマーなんか出して、なにをする気っすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going for what? What are you doing?
Where are you going with that hammer?!

fields.JP:
うひゃあっ！？
きゅ、急になにをするんすか～っ！

fields.EN: Yay! Made a tiny hole! Now we can go through.
fields.JP:
わーい、ちょっとだけど、あながあいた！
これで、むこうがしらべられるね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yay! Made a tiny hole! Now we can go through.

fields.JP:
ええーーっ！
もうふさがっちゃった……

fields.EN: What's going on?! Are we being ambushed?!
fields.JP:
な、なにごとなのだ！
敵襲かっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: What's going on?! Are we being ambushed?!

fields.JP: ……っ、らぷ、くらら、だいじょうぶ？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Totally fine! Just tried chipping through this
wall.
fields.JP:
うんっ、ぜんぜんへーき！
えっとね、さっきこのかべにあなを
あけようとしたんだけどねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Totally fine! Just tried chipping through this
wall.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel hit it with all her might,
but it only opened a little and closed right away!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルがおもいっきりやったのに、
ちょっとしかあかなくて、
すぐにとじちゃったの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Smacked it with all my might, but it didn't
break! Then it closed by itself!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Oh, brother... How about we don't do that?
Clara, what gives? Why'd you let her do that?
fields.JP:
な、なによそれ……
変なことして驚かせないでくれる？
くららもいたのなら、ラプを止めなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, brother... How about we don't do that?
Clara, what gives? Why'd you let her do that?

fields.EN:
Oh, come on. She did it out of nowhere.
Caught me off-guard.
fields.JP:
いやいや、自分もいきなりのことで
めっちゃビックリしたっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on. She did it out of nowhere.
Caught me off-guard.

fields.EN: Phew. That scared me. What was the point?
fields.JP:
まったく、人騒がせね……
いったいどんな目的があって、
そんな真似をしたのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew. That scared me. What was the point?

fields.EN:
Rapunzel could smell Jack and the others
from the other side of the wall.
fields.JP:
あのね、かべのむこーから、
じゃっくたちのにおいがしたの
fields.LOCALIZED: I could smell Jack and Red beyond the wall.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP:
なにぃっ！？
向こうにジャックたちがいたのか？

fields.EN:
Rapunzel doesn't know if someone was really there.
The hole closed before Rapunzel could check.
fields.JP:
ほんとにいたかどーかは、わかんない。
ラプンツェルがたしかめるまえに
あな、ふさがっちゃったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know for sure though. Before I could
look, the wall closed.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
I tried watching too, but it's just like Rapu-san
said. The tiny hole closed up in seconds.
fields.JP:
自分も見てたっすけど、ラプさんの攻撃で
３０センチくらいの穴が開いたのに、
あっという間に塞がったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried watching too, but it's just like Rappy
said. The tiny hole closed up in seconds.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Right. Even if we break an ordinary wall by attacking it, mimicry quickly takes over and repairs it.
fields.JP:
そうね、普通の壁を攻撃で壊しても、
すぐに擬態化が進んで修復されてしまうものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. So we can't alter the pathways.
The building regenerates itself.

fields.EN: Aw. I thought I'd find Jack on the other side.
fields.JP:
う～～、かべをこわしたら
じゃっくたちとあえるかもって
おもったのにー
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. I thought I'd find Jack on the other side.

fields.EN:
Even so, we couldn't all fit through that
tiny hole. If anyone could slither about
that easily, it'd be the Nightmares.
fields.JP:
破壊で壁を通ろうとするのは難しいわね。
この壁をすり抜けられる者がいるとすれば、
恐らくナイトメア……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, we couldn't all fit through that
tiny hole. If anyone could slither about
that easily, it'd be the Nightmares.

fields.EN: Or perhaps one of the wardens.
fields.JP: この監獄塔の『管理者』だけだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Or perhaps one of the wardens.

fields.EN: Oh Gretel-san! All hail Gretel the wise!
fields.JP:
おおっ、さすがグレーテルさんは、
博識っすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh Gretel! All hail Gretel the wise!
fields.notes: Line-level source-gated honorific restoration; automatic occurrence matching was ambiguous.

fields.EN:
How'd you find out Nightmares can travel
through the walls?
fields.JP:
ナイトメアが壁をすり抜けられるって、
どこで知ったんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How'd you find out Nightmares can travel
through the walls?

fields.EN:
Because my brother Hansel-niisan once did the
very same.
fields.JP:
……ヘンゼル兄さんが、実際にそれで
監獄塔を移動していたからよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because my brother Hansel once did the
very same.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
Really?! I didn't know Nightmares could do
that! That's why they sneak up on ya!
Spooky.
fields.JP:
そ、そうだったんっすか！
ナイトメアにそんな力があったなんて。
だからいつも神出鬼没なんすね……怖いっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really?! I didn't know Nightmares could do
that! That's why they sneak up on ya!
Spooky.

fields.JP:
……ん。今グレーテルは
『管理者』ならできるって言った……

……シラも、自分の管理場所なら……
すり抜けられる？

fields.EN:
No. Shira was only just registered. Papa
didn't give Shira, who's not fully fledged yet,
that much authority.
fields.JP:
無理よ。登録してもらっただけだし。
一人前じゃないシラには、パパが
そこまでの権限をくれなかったんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't. I was only just registered to my
domain. I'm not off probation yet though,
so Papa hasn't granted me full access.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Wardens, full access... I wonder what kind of
man your papa is if he can grant that power.
fields.JP:
管理者の権限譲渡……
監獄塔を制御出来るなんて、
シラの父親はいったい何者なのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wardens, full access... I wonder what kind of
man your papa is if he can grant that power.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Papa's amazing. He has a mystical
"seed" that gives orders—
fields.JP:
ふふん、パパはなんでもできるのよ。
いつもなにか不思議な『種』みたいなものを
持って、命令して──
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Papa's amazing. He has a mystical
"seed" that gives orders—

fields.EN: Oh crap! I said too much! You didn't hear that!
fields.JP:
……あっ！　やば、喋り過ぎちゃった！
なし！　今のは、なしだからねっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh crap! I said too much! You didn't hear that!

fields.EN:
Ohh. There you all are. I've been looking
all over for you.
fields.JP:
あれぇ、みんなそっちにいたのー？
あたし、探しちゃったー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohh. There you all are. I've been looking
all over for you.

fields.JP: あれ、タクミさん、どうしたっす？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: タクミさん => Takumi-san

fields.EN: I came to deliver something for you.
fields.JP:
ちょっと、便利アイテムのお届けにね。
はい、これどうぞー
fields.LOCALIZED: I came to deliver something for you.

fields.JP: あら、トランシーバーなんてあったのね

fields.EN:
Yup. I nabbed a couple before we left Dawn.
Got around to fixing it finally.
fields.JP:
うんうん、これは前に黎明で
見つけたやつなんだけどね？
直して使えるようにしてみたんだー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. I nabbed a couple before we left Dawn.
Got around to fixing it finally.

fields.EN:
With this, we can stay in contact. Assuming
the signal isn't too bad. Thought it could help.
fields.JP:
これがあったら、変なところにさえ
いなければ、お互いに連絡が取れるから
便利かもって思ったわけ
fields.LOCALIZED:
With this, we can stay in contact. Assuming
the signal isn't too bad. Thought it could help.

fields.EN:
Perfect. Now we can check in with camp
while we're out exploring.
fields.JP:
あ、そっか。
これがあればキャンプ地にいる人たちと
気軽に連絡が取れるんっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect. Now we can check in with camp
while we're out exploring.

fields.EN:
You're awesome! This is a godsend!
Right, everyone?
fields.JP:
確かに、これがあると一気に便利っす！
いやー、すごいっすねえ、いいっすねえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're awesome! This is a godsend!
Right, everyone?

fields.EN:
Glad to hear it! Make sure to get some good
use out of it.
fields.JP:
でしょでしょー？
探索に出る時に、活用しちゃってー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad to hear it! Make sure to get some good
use out of it.

fields.EN: Got it. As soon as camp is set up, we'll set out!
fields.JP:
はいっ、キャンプ地の設営が終わったら
早速探索で使ってみるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. As soon as camp is set up, we'll set out!

fields.JP:
……くんくん。
あれ、このにおいって？

fields.EN: What's up, Rapu-san? Is it Jack-san again?
fields.JP:
ラプさん、どうしたっすか？
またジャックさんたちの匂いがしたとか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's up, Rappy? Is it Jack again?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
No, it's not Jack's.
But Rapunzel knows this smell!
fields.JP:
ううん、じゃっくのじゃないよ。
でも、ラプンツェル、このにおいしってる！
fields.LOCALIZED: No, not Jack... But I know this smell!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: いったい誰の匂いがするというのだ？

fields.EN:
Hm... Who is it? I wonder whose scent it is!
*sniff, sniff*... *sniff, sniff*...
fields.JP:
んー、だれだったかなぁ……
ついさいきん、かいだことある～
くんくん……くんくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... Who is it? I wonder whose scent it is!
*sniff, sniff*... *sniff, sniff*...

fields.EN: Oh, now I remember! It's those thieves!
fields.JP:
あっ、おもいだした！
このまえの、どろぼーふたりぐみ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, now I remember! It's those thieves!

fields.JP: あ、あの時の盗人さんたちっすか

fields.EN: Yup. I smell 'em from over there.
fields.JP:
うん。あっちのしげみのほうから、
においがしてるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. I smell 'em from over there.

fields.EN: There they are. Now's our chance.
fields.JP:
あいつら、あっちで何かしてる
今がチャンスだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: There they are. Now's our chance.

fields.EN:
Right. Some old hag got in the way last time,
so we came up short.
fields.JP:
うん、この前はオバサンに邪魔されて、
いいのが盗れなかったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Some old hag got in the way last time,
so we came up short.

fields.JP:
ああ、今日こそはいいカネに
なりそうなのを探そう

fields.EN: Looks like they're heading towards camp.
fields.JP:
あの人たち、キャンプ地の方へ
向かって行ったみたいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like they're heading towards camp.

fields.EN:
Are they trying to steal our food again?
Grr. We gotta stop them!
fields.JP:
またみんなのごはんをぬすむのかな？
むーっ、そんなのだめー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are they trying to steal our food again?
Grr. We gotta stop them!

fields.EN: We're still in the middle of exploring, but I'm worried about them. Should we head back to camp for now?
fields.JP:
まだ探索の途中っすけど、
彼女たちのことが気になるし、
一度キャンプ地に戻るっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't go on exploring knowing they're
about to cause trouble. Let's beat them there.

fields.EN: Some adults are still there, but so's Rachel-san.
fields.JP:
あっちには大人だけじゃなく、
レイチェルさんもいるわけで
fields.LOCALIZED: Some adults are still there, but so's Rachel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
I don't mind. They'll wish they never stole
from us. I'll make them pay.
fields.JP:
私も、それで構わないわ。
まったく、盗人のカモにされるだなんて
困ったものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't mind. They'll wish they never stole
from us. I'll make them pay.

fields.EN: Right, then let's intercept those bandits!
fields.JP:
うむ。そうと決まれば、
すぐにキャンプ地へもどるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Right, then let's intercept those bandits!

fields.JP:
……はぁ、仕方ないわね。
戻ればいいんでしょ
あの２人、やっぱりここに来たんすかね？

fields.EN:
How dare they sneak into our camp,
take our precious goods we toiled to find.
I will never, ever forgive them!
fields.JP:
こそこそと何度も忍び込んで、
我らが集めた物を楽して盗もうだなんて、
その小ずるい根性は許せんのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How dare they sneak into our camp,
take our precious goods we toiled to find.
I will never, ever forgive them!

fields.EN: I, the Demon King, shall have my vengeance!
fields.JP: この大魔王が、直々に成敗してくれようぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I, the Demon King, shall have my vengeance!

fields.EN:
Argh! They got us again. This and that!
I can't believe it. Ugh!
fields.JP:
あーーっ！　また盗られてるーっ！
あれも、これもっ！
やだ、ちょっと、信じられな～い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh! They got us again. This and that!
I can't believe it. Ugh!

fields.EN:
Seems we just missed them. And left them
enough time to nick all our things.
fields.JP:
一足遅かったかしら。
どうやら既に犯行が行われた後のようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems we just missed them. And left them
enough time to nick all our things.

fields.EN:
But they couldn't have gone too far!
I'm sure they're around somewhere.
fields.JP:
で、でもまだそんなに時間は
経ってないはずっす！
きっとまだ、キャンプ地にいるはずっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
But they couldn't have gone too far!
I'm sure they're around somewhere.

fields.EN:
There aren't many routes out of here.
If we work quick, we'll find them.
fields.JP:
そう広くない場所だから、
探せばすぐに見つかりそうっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There aren't many routes out of here.
If we work quick, we'll find them.

fields.EN:
Hunger is the best motivator. Split up
and find them!
fields.JP:
たべもののうらみは、こわいよー！
みんなでてわけして、さがそー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hunger is the best motivator. Split up
and find them!

fields.EN:
Right. They'll rue the day they messed with
me!
fields.JP:
うむ。もう我をどんくさいなどとは、
言わせぬぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. They'll rue the day they messed with
me!

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Fine. Shira will make a special
exception and help.
fields.JP:
……はぁ、仕方ないわね
シラも特別に手伝ってあげる
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: そっちはどうだったー？

fields.EN:
No, I don't see anyone. Odd. No tracks
either. I thought for sure we'd find them.
fields.JP:
いないっす。うーん、おかしいっすね。
簡単に見つかると思ってたのに、
なかなか姿が見えないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I don't see anyone. Odd. No tracks
either. I thought for sure we'd find them.

fields.JP:
……ん。見当……つかない。
もしかして……もういない？

fields.EN:
(No. What would I do if I stole a bunch
of stuff and people were after me...?)
fields.JP:
（いや、自分の過去の経験上、
　人が多くて逃げにくい時は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No. What would I do if I stole a bunch
of stuff and people were after me...?)

fields.EN: I bet they're hiding, waiting for us.
fields.JP:
もしかすると、ほとぼりが冷めるまで
隠れているつもりかもっす
fields.LOCALIZED: I bet they're hiding, waiting for us.

fields.EN:
In fact, I bet they're back at camp.
They're big sneaks, no doubt.
fields.JP:
キャンプ地のどこかしらにいると思うっす。
ずいぶんと隠れるのが上手いっすけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I bet they're back at camp.
They're big sneaks, no doubt.

fields.EN:
Maybe if we open our noses, one of us
will catch their scent?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、みんなでにおいかいだら、
すぐにわかるかも？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe if we open our noses, one of us
will catch their scent?

fields.EN:
No. That's more your forte, Rapu-san.
Be quiet while scanning the area.
fields.JP:
いやいや、それで見つけられるのは、
ラプさんくらいっすよ。
もっと細かいところまで探し……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. That's more your forte, Rappy.
Be quiet while scanning the area.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
だ、だれか～！
こっちにいましたっ！

……あっ！
今の声、レイチェルさんっすね！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.JP: うん、あっちからきこえたよー！

fields.EN: Hey, have you been here the whole time?
fields.JP: ふぅん、こんな場所に潜んでいたのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, have you been here the whole time?

fields.EN:
Shoot, Riley. They're all together now.
This is your fault. You wanted to get closer.
fields.JP:
ま、まずいよ、ライリー
みんな集まって来ちゃったよ。
あんたがあの子に声掛けようっていうから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot, Riley. They're all together now.
This is your fault. You wanted to get closer.

fields.EN: So did you, Ellie! Whatever. Run for it!
fields.JP:
エリーだって、めちゃくちゃ
気にしてたじゃん。
どっちにしろ、もう逃げるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: So did you, Ellie! Whatever. Run for it!

fields.EN:
I bet you were terrified. Thanks for calling
us over.
fields.JP:
怖かったでしょう？　もう大丈夫よ。
すぐにみんなを呼んでくれて助かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you were terrified. Thanks for calling
us over.

fields.EN: It's okay... I was so scared.
fields.JP: は、はい……すごく怖かったです
fields.LOCALIZED: It's okay... I was so scared.

fields.EN:
Hehe. We've got you surrounded, thieves!
Gib it up!
fields.JP:
ぬふふっ、囲んだからもう逃げられんぞ！
盗人どもめ、観念するのにゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. We've got you surrounded, thieves!
Gib it up!

fields.EN: Hmph. Fat chance. Come on, Ellie!
fields.JP:
ふん、そんなのするわけないっての。
エリー、やるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph. Fat chance. Come on, Ellie!

fields.JP: りょーかい！　せぇーのっ！
あっ！　シラさんのテントが！
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Nyooowaaah! Right under my nose!
You bastards! HRNGH!
fields.JP:
にょわぁっ！？
テ、テントが我の顔にっ、おにょれ～っ！
むぐむぐむぐ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nyooowaaah! Right under my nose!
You bastards! HRNGH!

fields.JP: 簡単にはつかまらない！

fields.EN:
...Hngh. Aah! Grrrr. They got away!
They're slippery.
fields.JP:
……むぐむぐ、ぷはっ！
ぐぬぬぬっ、またしても～！
なんと逃げ足の速いやつらなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Hngh. Aah! Grrrr. They got away!
They're slippery.

fields.EN:
If only you didn't have the reflexes of a
sloth. Thanks for letting them get away.
fields.JP:
あれくらいの攻撃は避けて欲しいものね。
ハーメルンがそこで藻掻いているうちに、
まんまと逃げられてしまったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only you didn't have the reflexes of a
sloth. Thanks for letting them get away.

fields.EN: I don't want to hear that from you when all you did was stand back and watch!
fields.JP:
離れて見てただけの貴様には
言われたくないのだー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's rich coming from you, bookworm!
If you did more than stand and watch, we'd
have them!

fields.EN:
Now now, everyone. Let's calm down.
Rachel-san, are you hurt?
fields.JP:
まーまー、２人とも落ち着いて下さいっす。
レイチェルさん、怪我とかしてないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now now, everyone. Let's calm down.
Rachel, are you hurt?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN: I'm fine. Um... Actually, I saw...
fields.JP:
は、はい……あ、あの……
わたし……実は見ちゃったんです
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm fine. Um... Actually, I saw...

fields.EN:
Shira-san and those two were... whispering
together.
fields.JP:
そこの、シラさんと、あの２人が……
こそこそと話していたんです
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi, and those two...talking with one another.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: I saw Shira-san's eyes, and I screamed.
fields.JP:
シラさんと目があって
怖くなってしまって、
それで声を……
fields.LOCALIZED: I saw Pyre's eyes, and I screamed.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: なっ……なにぃ、シラが盗人たちと！？

fields.EN: Is that true? What did you talk about with those two?
fields.JP:
それは本当なの？　あの２人と
どんなことを話していたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that true, Pyre? Did you speak with them?
What's going on?
fields.notes: B19 removed residual localization-only Pyre/Pi/Byre; source wording/distortion restored

fields.EN:
Shira doesn't really know either! All they said
was, 'You... no, never mind.'
fields.JP:
シラだって、よくわかんないわよ！
『あんた……いや、なんでもない』
って言われただけなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know either! For a second, it looked
like they recognized me, but then they left.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
They definitely seemed to know each other. Those two
were very familiar with Shira-san.
fields.JP:
……どうみても顔見知りって感じでした。
あの２人、シラさんに対して
すごく親しげな雰囲気だったから
fields.LOCALIZED: They knew you though. Pretty well, it seems.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
N-No... Shira doesn't know! Really, nothing!
Like Shira said, they just said something
incomprehensible, and...!
fields.JP:
ちっ、違っ……シラは知らないっ！
本当に何もっ！　さっきも言ったように、
意味不明なこと言われただけで、そのっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? No! I don't! I promise you!
It's like I said, they stopped in their tracks
for a sec then ran off!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Yeah. No way would Shira help the thieves!
fields.JP:
そーだよ！
シラがどろぼーのともだちのわけないよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. No way would Pyre help the thieves!

fields.EN:
I want to believe her, but it's suspicious
that they knew her enough to make an
approach. It could mean...
fields.JP:
そうなんだろうけれど、
でも、実際に相手は、顔見知りのように
話しかけて来たんだろう？　つまり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to believe her, but it's suspicious
that they knew her enough to make an
approach. It could mean...

fields.EN:
Itsuki, it's too early to assume. All we have
for now is her word. I caution against hasty
judgments with only one side of the story.
fields.JP:
イツキ、結論を急ぐのはまだ早いわ。
今のところの情報は、彼女の証言のみ。
一方的な情報しか無い状態での推測は危険よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki, it's too early to assume. All we have
for now is her word. I caution against hasty
judgments with only one side of the story.

fields.JP: 確かに、そのとおりだが……

fields.EN:
Hey! It's gone! That transmitter I fixed!
They stole one of 'em!
fields.JP:
あーーーっ、ないっ、ない！
せっかく直したトランシーバーの片割れ、
あの子たちに盗られちゃった～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! It's gone! That transmitter I fixed!
They stole one of 'em!

fields.EN: Shoot. One won't work without the other!
fields.JP: もーっ、一個だけあったって意味ないのに！
fields.LOCALIZED: Shoot. One won't work without the other!

fields.EN:
Just one? Looks like they took stuff without
even looking. They must be pretty desperate.
fields.JP:
価値も分からず持って行ったってことっすか？
相変わらず目の前にあったものを、
反射的に盗んでいるような感じっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just one? Looks like they took stuff without
even looking. They must be pretty desperate.

fields.EN:
Ugh. First we had Marchens to deal with,
now we've got thieves running around.
fields.JP:
はぁ……まさかメルヒェンじゃなくて、
人間の子にこんなに手を焼かされるなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. First we had Marchens to deal with,
now we've got thieves running around.

fields.EN: They stole our food. Our camp is a disaster.
fields.JP:
食料も漁られたし、せっかく建てたテントまで
ぐちゃぐちゃにされちゃったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: They stole our food. Our camp is a disaster.

fields.EN:
Grr. Damn those bastards. They'll pay soon
enough. Next time, I'll string them up myself!
fields.JP:
ぬぅぅ、あやつらめ……
覚えておれよ～！
次こそは我の手で捕まえてやるのだっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr. Damn those bastards. They'll pay soon
enough. Next time, I'll string them up myself!

fields.EN:
I took a brief look at our inventory, but they
didn't take anything too important.
fields.JP:
ざっと確認したけれど、幸いにして
致命的な物は盗まれてはいないようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I took a brief look at our inventory, but they
didn't take anything too important.

fields.EN:
I vote we let it go. Gotta focus on our
exploration.
fields.JP:
下手にあの子たちに構うよりも、
ひとまずは探索に集中すべきだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I vote we let it go. Gotta focus on our
exploration.

fields.EN:
True. Let's clean up this mess, then prepare
to set out tomorrow.
fields.JP:
そうっすね、気にはなるっすけど、
今は探索の方が重要っすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. Let's clean up this mess, then prepare
to set out tomorrow.

fields.JP:
…シラさんとあの人たちって、
どういう関係なんだろ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: It's the core! Phew. We found it.
fields.JP:
核っす！
ふぅ、やっとたどり着いたっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's the core! Phew. We found it.

fields.JP:
気をつける……
メルヒェン……気配……

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: Small fry like this are no match for Shira!
fields.JP: こんな雑魚、シラの相手じゃないわ！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Don't get cocky over there. Here it comes.
fields.JP:
油断しないで頂戴。
来るわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't get cocky over there. Here it comes.

fields.JP: えへへ、ラプンツェルころした！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
んー？
ねむねむなにがだめなの？

メルヒェンも……自分たち守るために……
戦ってる……

fields.EN:
Are you saying we should spare them
since they're living creatures?
fields.JP:
だから生き物としての敬意は
持つべきってことっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you saying we should spare them
since they're living creatures?

fields.JP:
お互い……事情はあるけど……
一生懸命……

fields.EN: Hm. You mean I should go easy on 'em?
fields.JP:
うーん……
ざつにしたらダメってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. You mean I should go easy on 'em?

fields.EN:
Mm. Enough...for now. Good girl...
There there...
fields.JP:
ん……ん……
今はそれで……いい……
いい子……いい子……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm. Enough...for now. Good girl...
There there...

fields.JP: 眠りは甘すぎじゃない……？
でも、それがネムさんのいいところっすよ！

fields.EN: Well, let's get on with it. YAAAAAAH!
fields.JP:
それでは破壊するぞ！
うおりゃぁぁっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, let's get on with it. YAAAAAAH!

fields.JP: グレーヴ監獄塔ジェイル
ヴギギギイイイイィィィィィィ！！

fields.EN: This tower should have another core.
fields.JP:
以前と同じでここの監獄塔も
たしか核は他にもあったはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED: This tower should have another core.

fields.JP: どちらにしても油断は禁物よ
引き続きみんなで協力して先に進むっす！

fields.EN: I even heard Jail screeching a bit.
fields.JP: もう何度かジェイルのひめいもあったわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I even heard Jail screeching a bit.

fields.EN:
We should think fast, or we'll lose where it
came from.
fields.JP:
何にしてもそろそろ戦わねば
どちらかわからぬからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We should think fast, or we'll lose where it
came from.

fields.EN: I know it's scary, but let's give it all we got.
fields.JP: やっぱり怖いっすけど、やるだけやるっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: I know it's scary, but let's give it all we got.

fields.JP:
はっはっはっ！
我にまかせるがにょい！

fields.EN:
(Who knew Hameln-san was so reliable?
...In battle, I mean. Her battlecry could
use some work.)
fields.JP:
（根拠はないっすけど、こういう時の
　ハーメルンさんはほんと頼りになるっす
　……噛んでるっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Who knew Hameln was so reliable?
...In battle, I mean. Her battlecry could
use some work.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
That takes care of the core, which means
just around the corner—
fields.JP:
それにしても別の核が
破壊されているということは他にも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That takes care of the core, which means
just around the corner—

fields.JP: グレーヴの監獄塔ナイトメア
うん、ラプンツェルまけないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hope it's light on its feet!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: That thing put up a fight.
fields.JP: 無事破壊はできたっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: That thing put up a fight.

fields.EN: That was only the beginning. Brace yourselves.
fields.JP:
ただここからが本番よ。
気を引き締めていきなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: That was only the beginning. Brace yourselves.

fields.JP:
わかっておる！
行くぞ！

はっはっはっ！
我最強なり！
ラプンツェルもがんばったよ！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
ん……ん……
ラプもシラも……えらい……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I-It's not like Shira did anything special...
She just did what anyone would...
fields.JP: べ、別にシラは当然のことやっただけだし……
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: No sign of anyone from Dawn again...
fields.JP: ここにも他の黎明の人たちいなかったっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: No sign of anyone from Dawn again...

fields.EN:
So it seems. But we know someone else
is here for sure.
fields.JP:
そうね。　だけど何者かが
この監獄塔にいるのは間違いないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it seems. But we know someone else
is here for sure.

fields.EN:
There were other cores in the tower, yet
the Nightmare became vulnerable.
Someone else must have destroyed it.
fields.JP:
核が複数ある中でナイトメアが不死性を失う。
それは誰かが核を破壊したということ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There were other cores in the tower, yet
the Nightmare became vulnerable.
Someone else must have destroyed it.

fields.EN:
Whether they're allies, enemies, or one
of the other monstrosities, there's no way
of telling right now.
fields.JP:
それが味方なのか敵なのか、
それとも自然現象なのかは
まだまだ考える余地があるけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whether they're allies, enemies, or one
of the other monstrosities, there's no way
of telling right now.

fields.JP: 今はそれがわかっただけでも十分っす！

fields.EN: Besides, you haff me! Weave it all to meee!
fields.JP:
それに我もいるしな！
大船に乗ったつもりでいるがにょい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides, you haff me! Weave it all to meee!

fields.EN:
You're not making sense! You sound like
you have food in your mouth!
fields.JP:
よくわからないし、噛んでるっすけど、
引き続き頑張っていくっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not making sense! You sound like
you have food in your mouth!

fields.JP: か、噛んでなどおらぬぞ！

fields.EN:
Oh, there it is! One of those travel ball
thingies.
fields.JP:
あっ、見つけったす！
これが他の監獄塔に繋がる装置っすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, there it is! One of those travel ball
thingies.

fields.EN:
Sure. If you call warping between towers
traveling.
fields.JP:
うむ、これでまた別の監獄塔への
移動が可能になったのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. If you call warping between towers
traveling.

fields.JP: シラ、またげんきないね？

fields.EN:
No, I'm not... It's just my Guillotine-neesan
is this tower's warden. But I don't see her.
It's just weird is all.
fields.JP:
べ、別に……ただ、ここの監獄塔は
ギロチン姉さんの管理だったはずなのに、
現れなかったなって。そう思っただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm not... It's just my sister Guillotine
is this tower's warden. But I don't see her.
It's just weird is all.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san

fields.JP:
……ん。シラは、またお姉さんに
会えなくて、残念……
ね、眠り！　ちょっと、暑苦しいってば！

……大丈夫。
そのうち、きっと会えるから……

fields.EN:
I-I'm not upset! What is it, relief—
forget I said anything!
fields.JP:
お、落ち込んでないってば！
むしろホッとし……な、なんでもないっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not upset! What is it, relief—
forget I said anything!

fields.JP: ん？　今の音、なんすかね？

fields.EN:
CHUGCHUG... SNARK...
GGG... PPPPP... ZZZ... PPPP.
fields.JP:
ハウテハロデ……スナーグ……
ガガガ……ピピピ……
ガガガ……ピピピ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
CHUGCHUG... SNARK...
GGG... PPPPP... ZZZ... PPPP.

fields.EN:
Sounds like a machine!
I think it came from that way!
fields.JP:
こっちの方角から音が聞こえたっす！
機械みたいな感じだったっすけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like a machine!
I think it came from that way!

fields.EN:
Yup, Rapunzel heard it too!
Let's all go!
fields.JP:
うんっ、ラプンツェルにもきこえた！
みんなでいこー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! I heard it too! Come on!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: What's with this thing? I can't... Damn it!
fields.JP: な、なんだこの通信機、勝手に……くそっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What's with this thing? I can't... Damn it!

fields.EN:
It's just a noise box. Way to go for me
finding junk.
fields.JP:
やかましいだけ。
役に立たないガラクタ拾っちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a noise box. Way to go for me
finding junk.

fields.EN: Hey, thieves! What are you doing?
fields.JP:
あーっ、どろぼーのこたちだ！
こんなとこで、なにしてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, thieves! What are you doing?

fields.JP: げっ！　お、おまえらは……

fields.EN:
Wh-Whatever. It's none of your business.
You're not my parent.
fields.JP:
べ、別に……何でも……
答える義理なんてないし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Whatever. It's none of your business.
You're not my parent.

fields.EN:
Grrr. You pesky brats! You were about to
burgle again, weren't you!
fields.JP:
うぬぅ、貴様ら！
また性懲りもなく我らの隙を見て、
盗みをしようとしていたのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grrr. You pesky brats! You were about to
burgle again, weren't you!

fields.EN:
Hand over everything you stole from us!
Your treachery ends here.
fields.JP:
というか、キャンプで盗んだものを返すのだ！
あれは我らの所有物なのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hand over everything you stole from us!
Your treachery ends here.

fields.EN: Hmph. I sold all your crap to that creepy guy.
fields.JP:
ふん、あんなガラクタなんて、
不気味なおっさんの商人にほとんど売っちまった
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph. I sold all your crap to that creepy guy.

fields.EN:
I got nothing for you. Ate all the grub too.
What you gonna do about it?
fields.JP:
返すもなにも、食料も全部食べた。
手元にはなんにも残ってない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got nothing for you. Ate all the grub too.
What you gonna do about it?

fields.EN:
Enough! I want none of it! Give us back
our goods at once!
fields.JP:
うるさい！　言い訳は無用！
