なんにしても、盗んだ物を返すのだーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough! I want none of it! Give us back
our goods at once!

fields.JP: 待ちなさい、ハーメルン

fields.EN: Damn you, Gretel! Once more you interrupt me!
fields.JP:
おにょれ、グレーテルっ！！
貴様またしても我の邪魔を～～～！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn you, Gretel! Once more you interrupt me!

fields.EN:
I have a question for you two. Did either
of you work with Shira here to break into
our campsite?
fields.JP:
あなた達に質問があるの。
この“シラ”という子と組んで、
キャンプ地で盗みを行ったのは事実なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a question for you two. Did either
of you work with Pyre here to break into
our campsite?

fields.JP:
なっ、グレーテルさん！？
それはっ……！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP:
ち、違う……！
ほんとに、シラは……っ！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Neither of you has to confess, but things
don't have to be difficult, do they?
fields.JP:
喋らないでいれば、それで済むと
思っているようだけれど……
犯罪者に黙秘権があると思っているのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Neither of you has to confess, but things
don't have to be difficult, do they?

fields.EN:
It would serve both of you more to tell us
the truth. Your choice. If not, then I'm sure
we can make you talk somehow.
fields.JP:
自主的に喋った方が、お互い楽だったのに。
人に口を割らせる方法なんて、
いくらでもあるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It would serve both of you more to tell us
the truth. Your choice. If not, then I'm sure
we can make you talk somehow.

fields.EN:
You're welcome to start too, Shira.
Someone better answer before I start swinging.
fields.JP:
シラ、聞いているのは貴女にもよ。
私がコレを振り下ろす前に、正直に答えなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're welcome to start too, Pi.
Someone better answer before I start swinging.

fields.EN:
Shira doesn't know! Shira really doesn't know
people like these!
fields.JP:
知らない……っ！
シラは、本当にこんなやつら
なんて、知らないもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen these people in my life.
Honest!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Guree... Shira means it, you know?
Rapunzel believes Shira!
fields.JP:
ぐれー。シラは、ほんきでいってるよ？
ラプンツェルは、シラをしんじる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretty... Pi means it. I believe her!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
そもそも……シラは嘘が苦手。
ボクも、シラを信じる……！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Huh? But if Shira is telling the truth,
was Cheruu mistaken?
fields.JP:
あれれ？　でもシラがほんとのこと
いってるなら、ちぇるーはかんちがいしてた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hang on. Maybe Chelly's wrong?
Could've seen someone else.
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.EN: Do you think we misunderstood Rachel-san?
fields.JP:
レイチェルさんの方が、
何かを勘違いしてたってことっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you think we misunderstood Rachel?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.JP: なっ、“レイチェル”だって！？
うわっ！？　い、いきなりなんなんっすか！

fields.EN:
No sudden movements, either of you.
If you know what's good for you.
fields.JP:
この状況下で下手な真似をしないほうが、
選択としては賢いんじゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No sudden movements, either of you.
If you know what's good for you.

fields.EN:
I don't care about this right now!
Is someone named Rachel with you?!
fields.JP:
そんなこと、今はどうでもいい！
ねぇっ、レイチェルって子が
本当にあそこにいるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't care about this right now!
Is someone named Rachel with you?!

fields.JP:
そ、そうっすけど……
レイチェルさんが、どうかしたんすか？
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
レイチェルは……
私たちの妹かもしれない

fields.EN:
(We arrived at our destination.
The Grave Jail Tower. It menaces above
us as we set up our camp.)
fields.JP:
（今僕たちは、次の場所である
　『グレーヴの監獄塔』へ到着し、
　ひとまずキャンプの設営を進めている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We arrived at our destination.
The Grave Jail Tower. It menaces above
us as we set up our camp.)

fields.EN:
(Spirits around the camp are low. The mood
is hushed, somber. The Blood Maidens seem
unusually quiet, especially Akazukin.)
fields.JP:
（みんな、どこか口数が少ない。
　中でも血式少女たち――特に赤ずきんは、
　他の誰より元気がないようだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Spirits around the camp are low. The mood
is hushed, somber. The Blood Maidens seem
unusually quiet, especially Red Riding Hood.)

fields.EN: (Though I could not blame them for it...)
fields.JP:
（それも先程終えた話合いの後では、
　仕方のないことかもしれないが……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Though I could not blame them for it...)

fields.EN:
(In the past, an alien had posed as a professor
of an organization known as the Dawn within
the underground Jail. It was all his plot.)
fields.JP:
（以前、地下監獄の黎明という組織で博士をし、
　それをカムフラージュに地球を侵略しようと
　していた宇宙人がいた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the past, an alien had posed as a professor
of an organization known as the Dawn within
the underground Jail. It was all his plot.)

fields.EN: (His name was Snark. Apparently his objective was to use 'Witchcraft' in the underground Jail Tower to restore his homeland.)
fields.JP:
（そいつはスナークといい、
　地下の監獄塔にある『ウィッチクラフト』で、
　自らの故郷を取り戻すのが目的だったらしい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(His name was Snark. Using the power of
Witchcraft, he controlled Jail in order to
regain his home world once more.)

fields.EN:
(But Akazukin thwarted his plot,
taking his life in the process.)
fields.JP:
（だが結局、赤ずきんたちによって殺され、
　野望は阻止されたという話だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But Red Riding Hood thwarted his plot,
taking his life in the process.)

fields.EN:
(Why is his name coming up again now?
Out of Iron Maiden's mouth, no less.)
fields.JP:
（だが、何故か今になってその名前が出てきた。
　それもアイアン・メイデンの口からだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is his name coming up again now?
Out of Iron Maiden's mouth, no less.)

fields.EN:
(Does Snark have something to do with
Genocide Pink too?)
fields.JP:
（僕たちが今まで処刑台少女に襲われてきたのは、
　スナークが生きていたからなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does Snark have something to do with
Massacre Pink too?)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(I jogged through the camp to find Jabberwock
and Haru to reveal to them the great dark cloud
looming above us.)
fields.JP:
（とにかくこれは重大な話だと
　考えた僕たちは、キャンプ地を移動すると、
　すぐにジャバウォックやハルに伝えに行った）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I jogged through the camp to find Jabberwock
and Haru to reveal to them the great dark cloud
looming above us.)

fields.JP:
（その時の彼らの反応は、
　やはり僕たちと同じようなものだった――）
確かにスナークと口にしたんだな？

fields.EN:
Yes. It was Iron Maiden, from Genocide Pink.
"Snark is watching."
fields.JP:
ああ、確かに処刑台少女のアイアン・メイデンが、
『スナークは見ている』と言っていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It was Iron Maiden, from Massacre Pink.
"Snark is watching."
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: わらわたちも、確かに耳にしました

fields.EN:
You're kidding me. I saw him die back in Jail.
With my own eyes...!
fields.JP:
おいおいマジかよ。
俺はあいつが監獄塔になって破滅していく様を、
この目でしっかり見ていたんだぜ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're kidding me. I saw him die back in Jail.
With my own eyes...!

fields.EN: Yes. All of us did. But perhaps we're mistaken.
fields.JP:
そうなんです、みんな見ていましたわ。
でも違ったのかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. All of us did. But perhaps we're mistaken.

fields.EN: My brother's alive...? That can't be.
fields.JP: 兄さんが生きている？　馬鹿な……
fields.LOCALIZED: My brother's alive...? That can't be.

fields.EN:
Imagine how we feel. We had to tell you
right away.
fields.JP:
だからわたしたちも混乱しちゃって、
それで相談に来たのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Imagine how we feel. We had to tell you
right away.

fields.EN:
Wait. Genocide Pink keeps bringing up
someone they call Papa. Could it be Snark?
fields.JP:
ねえ、処刑台少女たちが言ってた『パパ』ってさ、
もしかしてスナークのことなのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. Massacre Pink keeps bringing up
someone they call Papa. Could it be Snark?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
He—I mean, Snark—raised me.
Maybe he's up to his old tricks...
fields.JP:
ほら、あたしもお父さん……
いやスナークの娘ってことで育ったし、
また同じことをしてたりするのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
He—I mean, Snark—raised me.
Maybe he's up to his old tricks...

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: いや、そう結論づけるのは早いな

fields.EN:
The fact Iron Maiden showed up at all
is a mystery as well.
fields.JP:
正直、アイアン・メイデンがどうして、
あの場面であんなことを言ったのかが不明だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The fact Iron Maiden showed up at all
is a mystery as well.

fields.EN:
Even if he were here, you'd treat him as
an enemy, wouldn't you?
fields.JP:
仮に今の君たちがスナークと再会したら、
敵同士の関係性なんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if he were here, you'd treat him as
an enemy, wouldn't you?

fields.EN:
Why's he bothering to reveal he's alive?
He knows he's putting you on the defensive.
fields.JP:
ならばスナークにとって、わざわざ自分が
生きていると明かす意味がどこにある？
こちらに警戒させるだけじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why's he bothering to reveal he's alive?
He knows he's putting you on the defensive.

fields.EN:
I don't know where to start.
Does he want revenge...?
fields.JP: 考えたくもないけど……復讐、とか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know where to start.
Does he want revenge...?

fields.EN: For having his ambition thwarted? From what I've heard, Snark spent a long time carrying out his plan for the sake of his long-cherished wish, didn't he?
fields.JP:
野望を阻止されたことへのか？
聞いた話だと、スナークは自らの悲願のために、
長い時間をかけて計画を遂行していたのだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Revenge? I think Snark's above that.
Didn't you tell me it took years
to execute his plan?

fields.EN: Would someone that patient really get involved with you now, when he might have a chance to revive here on the surface the ambition that was once thwarted?
fields.JP:
そんな忍耐強い奴なら、今この地上で
一度は潰えた野望を再び叶えられるかもしれない、
という時に君たちに関わろうとするだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything, he's patient, determined to
execute his plan. He could still be at it.
Do you think he could be using you again?

fields.EN:
He's more calculated than that.
The question is how are you involved?
fields.JP:
復讐よりも、悲願の達成を
優先するんじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
He's more calculated than that.
The question is how are you involved?

fields.EN:
What if he's got worse on his mind,
and wants to get rid of us?
fields.JP:
わたしたちを脅威と考えて、
先に潰そうとしてる、とかは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if he's got worse on his mind,
and wants to get rid of us?

fields.EN:
All the more reason it would be strange
for him to reveal himself. There has to be
something more to it.
fields.JP:
それこそ、スナークと明かすメリットが皆無だ。
正体を明かして有利になることなど何もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the more reason it would be strange
for him to reveal himself. There has to be
something more to it.

fields.JP: じゃあいったい何なの……？

fields.EN:
We'll have to sit on it. For now, we have
no throughline from Genocide Pink's Papa
to Snark himself.
fields.JP:
それはこれから考察していく事柄だな。
とにかく、現状では処刑台少女のパパと
スナークを結びつけるのは、まだ早い
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll have to sit on it. For now, we have
no throughline from Massacre Pink's Papa
to Snark himself.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: He's right. No need to jump to conclusions.
fields.JP:
そうですよ赤姉様。
まだ決めつける必要なんてありません
fields.LOCALIZED: He's right. No need to jump to conclusions.

fields.EN:
We don't know her motives, so until we do,
let's take it with a grain of salt.
fields.JP:
あの場面で言う意味や目的が
分からない限りは、半信半疑のままなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know her motives, so until we do,
let's take it with a grain of salt.

fields.EN:
But we've got other stuff to worry about
for now, so let's keep going.
fields.JP:
だから答えは出せないし、
出さなくていいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we've got other stuff to worry about
for now, so let's keep going.

fields.EN:
Besides, Iron Maiden could've been talking
out of her you-know-what.
fields.JP:
そもそも、わらわたちはまだ、
アイアン・メイデンの言うスナークを
見ていないですしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, Iron Maiden could've been talking
out of her you-know-what.

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Jabberwock?
Does any of this hit home?
fields.JP:
どうしたジャバウォック。
何か思い当たることでもあるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Jabberwock?
Does any of this hit home?

fields.JP: いや、思い当たるということでは、ない
（……何か引っかかる言い方だな）

fields.EN:
Ugh. In the end, we still know nothing.
What a tangled web.
fields.JP:
はぁ……結局のところ、
まだ何も分からないってことね。
まったく、色々とゴチャゴチャしてきたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. In the end, we still know nothing.
What a tangled web.

fields.EN:
You said it. There's Genocide Pink, the
enormous Jail, and now Snark.
fields.JP:
確かに、処刑台少女のことや
巨大な監獄塔の謎もあるというのに、
スナークの謎まで出てきちゃいましたね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You said it. There's Massacre Pink, the
enormous Jail, and now Snark.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Also the whereabouts of our comrades,
I might add. There can't be many more
towers where they could be, right?
fields.JP:
それよりも他のみんなはどこにいるのかしら。
わたくしたちのように監獄塔に飛ばされた、
ってわけじゃないんですの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also the whereabouts of our comrades,
I might add. There can't be many more
towers where they could be, right?

fields.EN:
Plus I haven't once seen any bonfires
or camps other than ours.
fields.JP:
今のところ、わたしたち以外のキャンプの痕跡って
見つかってないわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plus I haven't once seen any bonfires
or camps other than ours.

fields.EN:
It's okay. We all found each other.
They're bound to turn up soon.
fields.JP:
大丈夫です、わたくしたちが再会できたように、
みなさんともきっとどこかで会えますよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay. We all found each other.
They're bound to turn up soon.

fields.EN: I hope that "soon" means this Jail tower.
fields.JP:
その『どこか』が、
この監獄塔だといいんだけどな
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope that "soon" means this Jail tower.

fields.EN:
The mystery deepens. Still looking for
the others.
fields.JP:
謎は深まるばかり、
他のみんなも見つからない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The mystery deepens. Still looking for
the others.

fields.EN: Feels like we're all just going in circles.
fields.JP:
あたしたち、進展してるようで
実はほとんどしてないのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED: Feels like we're all just going in circles.

fields.EN:
If only we knew who this Juu-san character is.
Maybe if we knock his head around, he'll
start remembering.
fields.JP:
せめてジュウさんが何者か、
くらい判明してほしいところですよね。
頭叩いたら思い出したりしないんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we knew who this Toh character is.
Maybe if we knock his head around, he'll
start remembering.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Stop. My head isn't so conveniently made that something like that would make me remember.
fields.JP:
やめてくれ。そんなことで思い出せるほど、
僕の頭は都合よくできていない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thankfully for me your barbaric methods
won't bring my memories back.

fields.EN: *sigh* Still as cold as ever. Couldn't you take a little more interest in your own memories~?
fields.JP:
はぁ、相変わらずつれない対応ですね。
もう少し自分の記憶に興味持っても
いいんじゃないですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Always with the loser attitude.
Why aren't you more interested in getting
them back?

fields.EN:
Whatever's in my brain apart from clues
to my wife's whereabouts can remain a
mystery for all I care.
fields.JP:
妻の居場所に繋がらないことなんて、
僕の記憶だろうが、他の謎だろうがどうでもいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever's in my brain apart from clues
to my wife's whereabouts can remain a
mystery for all I care.

fields.EN: What matters is finding my wife. That's all.
fields.JP:
大事なのは、
妻がどこにいるか……それだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED: What matters is finding my wife. That's all.

fields.EN: For better or worse, you're consistent.
fields.JP:
相変わらず、いい意味でも悪い意味でも
一貫してるわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: For better or worse, you're consistent.

fields.EN: Somehow I find that kind of consistency enviable.
fields.JP:
そのブレなさ、
たまにとても羨ましくなりますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Somehow I find that kind of consistency enviable.

fields.EN: Yeah. Mind if I call it a night?
fields.JP:
あのさ、あたしちょっとこの話合い、
抜けていいかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Mind if I call it a night?

fields.EN:
My head's spinning from the whole day.
Sorry guys, I'm gonna get some sleep.
fields.JP:
なんか色々ありすぎて疲れちゃった。
ごめん、ちょっと休むね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
My head's spinning from the whole day.
Sorry guys, I'm gonna get some sleep.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
She's right. We could all get some sleep
after our run-in with Genocide Pink.
Let's call it a night.
fields.JP:
確かにわたしたちも、
処刑台少女と戦ってからほとんど休んでないしね。
ここは一旦解散しましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. We could all get some sleep
after our run-in with Massacre Pink.
Let's call it a night.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Agreed. I'm snoozing just thinking about it.
fields.JP:
賛成です～。わらわもそろそろ、
働くの嫌になってきましたし～
fields.LOCALIZED: Agreed. I'm snoozing just thinking about it.

fields.JP: そうだな。じゃあみんな休むとするか

fields.EN: (And so everyone set off for the evening.)
fields.JP:
（――そんな感じで今に至り、
　みんな黙々と、それぞれの時間を過ごしている）
fields.LOCALIZED: (And so everyone set off for the evening.)

fields.EN:
(The camprunners tended to the camp
in the cool night. The Blood Maidens had
gone to bed.)
fields.JP:
（キャンプ組の者たちは設営を、
　血式少女たちは休息を、といった具合だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The camprunners tended to the camp
in the cool night. The Blood Maidens had
gone to bed.)

fields.EN:
(Jabberwock was one of the few who
neither rested nor worked. He sat there
in stoic thought.)
fields.JP:
（そんな中、ただ一人ジャバウォックだけが、
　設営をするでも休息をするでもなく、
　ずっと考えごとを続けていた……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jabberwock was one of the few who
neither rested nor worked. He sat there
in stoic thought.)

fields.EN:
(I have a feeling he's hiding something.
Is it worth a closer look? I don't know if
it'll lead to my wife.)
fields.JP:
（恐らくジャバウォックは、何かを隠している。
　はたして僕は、それを探るべきだろうか？
　それが妻に繋がる行為だとはとても思えないが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have a feeling he's hiding something.
Is it worth a closer look? I don't know if
it'll lead to my wife.)

fields.EN:
(However since I am no closer to finding her,
I am even more tempted to solve this other
mystery in the meantime.)
fields.JP:
（だが妻の行方が一向に分からない今、
　こんな関係のなさそうな謎にでも、
　手がかりを求めようとしてしまいそうになる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(However since I am no closer to finding her,
I am even more tempted to solve this other
mystery in the meantime.)

fields.EN:
(Can't there be a simpler, more effective
way to locate her?)
fields.JP:
（もっと、何か他にシンプルで
　効率のいい探し方はないのだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Can't there be a simpler, more effective
way to locate her?)

fields.EN: Slow and steady wins the race.
fields.LOCALIZED: Slow and steady wins the race.

fields.JP: （いや、もちろん気のせいだろう）

fields.EN:
(All that slow and steady crap is nonsense.
Try pulling that card in a life-or-death
emergency.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても『急がば回れ』というのは、
　緊急事態でも、会いたくて仕方のない時でも
　回らなければいけないものなのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All that slow and steady crap is nonsense.
Try pulling that card in a life-or-death
emergency.)

fields.EN: (I want nothing more than to find you.)
fields.JP: （僕は君に早く会いたいのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I want nothing more than to find you.)

fields.EN:
(This is no time to wait. I must take action
on finding a lead at once.)
fields.JP:
（いや、立ち止まってる場合じゃない。
　今はとにかく、動いて探し続けるんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is no time to wait. I must take action
on finding a lead at once.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I'll talk with Jabberwock.
The chances of him leading me somehow
to my wife can't be zero.)
fields.JP:
（よし、ジャバウォックに色々と聞きに行こう。
　妻に繋がる可能性は、ゼロではないのだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I'll talk with Jabberwock.
The chances of him leading me somehow
to my wife can't be zero.)

fields.EN: A minute of your time, everyone.
fields.JP: みんな、ちょっといいか
fields.LOCALIZED: A minute of your time, everyone.

fields.EN: Why did you call this meeting?
fields.JP: わらわたちを集めて、いったい何なんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why did you call this meeting?

fields.EN: I've thought of a quest for us.
fields.LOCALIZED: I've thought of a quest for us.

fields.EN: It's to find your wife, right? This guy...
fields.JP:
それって、ジュウの奥さんを
探すってことでしょ？　何を今さら……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's to find your wife, right? This guy...

fields.EN:
A quest is something to be achieved.
Purpose is something you desire.
fields.JP:
目標は、目的達成のために定める通過点、
あるいは達成すべきことだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
A quest is something to be achieved.
Purpose is something you desire.

fields.JP: それで、具体的には何なのよ

fields.EN:
Our quest should be reaching the Devouring
Armada Tower.
fields.JP:
僕たちの目指す目標、
それはあの『悪食の監隊塔』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our quest should be reaching the Devouring
Armada Tower.

fields.EN:
Devouring...Armada...Tower?
Not the Jail? What do you mean?
fields.JP:
悪食の……監隊塔？
監獄塔じゃなくって？
それ、何なんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Devouring...Armada...Tower?
Not the Jail? What do you mean?

fields.EN: Is that the huge Jail we saw on the surface?
fields.JP:
もしかして、地上に出てきた時に見た、
あの巨大な監獄塔のことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that the huge Jail we saw on the surface?

fields.EN:
That's right. Jabberwock told us that's what
the surface dwellers call it. We should make
a plan to get there.
fields.JP:
そうだ。ジャバウォックに聞いたんだが、
地上の人々の間でそう呼ばれているらしい。
僕たちはあの塔を攻略すべきだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. Jabberwock told us that's what
the surface dwellers call it. We should make
a plan to get there.

fields.EN:
Uh. That's unexpected.
What inspired this?
fields.JP:
何か急に話が飛躍したんだけど、
どうしてそうなるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh. That's unexpected.
What inspired this?

fields.JP:
それについては、
まず私から少し説明しよう

fields.EN: First, all of you have been using the glowing orbs to travel from one Jail Tower to another, right?
fields.JP:
まず皆はこれまで、光る球体を用いて
監獄塔から監獄塔へと移動してきただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
To start with, you know how we've been
traveling between towers with the orbs?

fields.EN:
That orb is one of the nerves feeding the
Devouring Armada Tower with energy.
fields.JP:
実はあの球体は、悪食の監隊塔に
栄養を送るパイプのようなものなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That orb is one of the nerves feeding the
Devouring Armada Tower with energy.

fields.EN:
Whoa. Does that mean we've been side
by side with tower food?
fields.JP:
うわ、わたしたち監隊塔ってやつの
栄養扱いされちゃってたってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Does that mean we've been side
by side with tower food?

fields.JP: そう考えると、何だか不気味ですね

fields.EN:
Is there a chance those orbs feed off of us
as well?
fields.JP:
移動する時に何か
吸い取られちゃってたりするんですの……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is there a chance those orbs feed off of us
as well?

fields.EN: Yeah, that's possible. Whenever I pass through one of those spheres, I lose all motivation. The Devouring Armada Tower must have been sucking it out of me~
fields.JP:
ああ、あり得ます。だってあの球体を通ると、
いつもわらわのやる気がなくなるんです。
きっと監隊塔に吸われていたんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's possible. I feel my eyelids getting
heavier every time we use one. Must be that
Devouring Armada.

fields.JP: いや、あんたは元からでしょ

fields.EN:
Sounds to me like someone's too lazy
to explore today...
fields.JP:
単に新しい場所の探索が
面倒くさいってことね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds to me like someone's too lazy
to explore today...

fields.EN:
Well, don't worry. Humans aren't affected by
the orb.
fields.JP:
まあ心配しなくても、
人間が通過する分には問題ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, don't worry. Humans aren't affected by
the orb.

fields.EN:
Logic would dictate that following its
feeding pipeline would lead us right
into the belly of the beast.
fields.JP:
それで、あの光る球体が
悪食の監隊塔の栄養パイプということは、
辿っていけばいつかそこに着く、ということだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Logic would dictate that following its
feeding pipeline would lead us right
into the belly of the beast.

fields.EN:
Way I see it, there's two main threats.
Genocide Pink, and the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP:
今僕たちにとって脅威は２つある。
処刑台少女とあの悪食の監隊塔だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Way I see it, there's two main threats.
Massacre Pink, and the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
The longer they're both here, the closer we
are to death. Gotta deal with them eventually.
fields.JP:
どちらも僕たちの命を脅かす存在だから、
おそらく、どこかで解決しなくてはならない
fields.LOCALIZED:
The longer they're both here, the closer we
are to death. Gotta deal with them eventually.

fields.EN:
However, there's no way for us to track
Genocide Pink. Attacking them doesn't do
much good for us either.
fields.JP:
だが処刑台少女はどこにいるかも分からない。
こちらからでは何も仕掛けることが出来ないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, there's no way for us to track
Massacre Pink. Attacking them doesn't do
much good for us either.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
You're right. We're better off waiting for them
to come for us.
fields.JP:
確かに今は、その問題を解決したくても、
向こうが来るのを待つしか出来ませんよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. We're better off waiting for them
to come for us.

fields.EN: Then wouldn't it be less wasteful to deal with the threat of the Devouring Armada Tower first? We know where it is, after all.
fields.JP:
それなら先に悪食の監隊塔の脅威を
消すように動いた方が無駄がないだろう？
そっちの位置は分かっているんだからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Isn't it better for us to address the threat
looming right in front of us? At least we
know where this one is.

fields.EN:
You make a lot of sense, but do you really
want to put heading to the main Jail ahead
of finding your wife?
fields.JP:
悪食の監隊塔を目指す理由は分かりましたけど、
奥さんを探すのは二の次でいいんですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You make a lot of sense, but do you really
want to put heading to the main Jail ahead
of finding your wife?

fields.EN:
It is still my sole purpose. That hasn't
changed.
fields.JP:
もちろん僕は妻を探すことが
何よりも大事で、最優先事項だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is still my sole purpose. That hasn't
changed.

fields.EN:
But as my wife used to say,
"Slow and steady wins the race."
fields.JP:
でも『急がば回れ』と、
いつも妻がうるさく言っていたのを、
改めて思い出した
fields.LOCALIZED:
But as my wife used to say,
"Slow and steady wins the race."

fields.EN:
So long as the Devouring Armada Tower is
still around, there's no point in finding her.
fields.JP:
考えてみれば、あの悪食の監隊塔がある限り、
妻を安全に探すことは出来ないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So long as the Devouring Armada Tower is
still around, there's no point in finding her.

fields.EN:
Because the Jail would still terrorize the
world, even if you two were reunited.
fields.JP:
奥さんを見つけられたとしても、
あの塔を止めなければ平穏な日々には
なりそうもないですしね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because the Jail would still terrorize the
world, even if you two were reunited.

fields.EN:
Correct. That's why I believe this mission
is more important.
fields.JP:
そうだ。だから僕は、
あの悪食の監隊塔をどうにかしたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct. That's why I believe this mission
is more important.

fields.EN:
We can't make a life for ourselves up here
with that thing around. It's inevitable.
fields.JP:
あたしたちにとっても、地上で暮らしていくなら
いつかはどうにかしなきゃいけない問題だしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't make a life for ourselves up here
with that thing around. It's inevitable.

fields.EN: And if the others are in some other Jail Tower, if we keep moving through the orbs, we might eventually run into them.
fields.JP:
それに、仮に他のみんなもどこかの監獄塔に
いるとするなら、球体で移動を繰り返していけば
いつか会えるかもしれないもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, we've been making our way
through those orbs like lightning!
We'll run into our friends in no time.

fields.EN: That's right. If we keep at it, we might be able to meet everyone!
fields.JP: そうだよ、頑張ればみんなに会えるかもしれない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Nothing's getting past our search
brigade!

fields.JP:
わかったよ、ジュウ。
あたしたちもその案に乗るよ

fields.EN: I see. Happy to have you.
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Happy to have you.

fields.EN:
Hehe, Juu-san always says 'more haste, less speed,'
doesn't he?
fields.JP:
ふふ、急がば回れって、
ジュウさんよく言ってますもんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Slow and steady wins the race, was it?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: 妻の座右の銘だからな

fields.EN:
You know, I think this our first time seeing
eye to eye, Juu.
fields.JP:
そういえば、ジュウと
同じ目標見据えるのって初めてじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I think this our first time seeing
eye to eye, Toh.

fields.EN: Maybe. Until now, our relationship was simply that I accompanied your search in exchange for being able to move forward.
fields.JP:
そうかもしれないな。これまでは君たちの探索に
つきあう代わりに、先に進むという
見返りを受けているだけの関係だったからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Until now our acquaintance
meant little apart from escaping this prison
together.

fields.EN:
Now, now. We're all working toward the
same goal. We're a team, right Aka-neesama?
fields.JP:
まあまあ、ここで同じ方向を向くように
なったんですからいいじゃないですか、赤姉様
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, now. We're all working toward the
same goal. We're a team, right Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Now that's settled, I have a favor to ask you,
Juu.
fields.JP:
そうだ、話がまとまったところで、
ジュウ君にひとつ頼みがあるんだが――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that's settled, I have a favor to ask you,
Toh.

fields.EN:
If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to take your
blood sample to run some tests.
fields.JP:
もしよければ、君の血液を
少し採取させてくれないかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you wouldn't mind, I'd like to take your
blood sample to run some tests.

fields.EN:
I hoped to record some of your attributes
as a Blood Youth.
fields.JP:
改めて血式少年の特性について、
少し調べたいことができてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hoped to record some of your attributes
as a Blood Youth.

fields.EN:
Attributes? If they're worth noting, then
keep me in the loop too.
fields.JP:
血式少年の特性？
それは僕にとって朗報となり得ることか？
であれば詳しく聞かせてほしいが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Attributes? If they're worth noting, then
keep me in the loop too.

fields.EN: We won't know until we investigate, but if your blood turns out to hold something new, it might prove useful to us going forward.
fields.JP:
調べてみないと分からないことだが、
君の血が新たな何かを秘めていると分かれば、
もしかしたらこの先に役立てるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no telling until I examine them.
But if there's a chance to discover something,
it's worth a look.

fields.EN:
Perhaps your blood could be harnessed
somehow to improve the weapons.
fields.JP:
あー俺も血式武器の強化に
使えねえかって思ってたんだ。
ちょうどいいからお前の血、採取させろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps your blood could be harnessed
somehow to improve the weapons.

fields.EN: Fine... We'll get it over with later.
fields.JP: 仕方ないな……分かった、後でな
fields.LOCALIZED: Fine... We'll get it over with later.

fields.EN: Okay. Night's still young, how about a break?
fields.JP:
ねえみんな、話もまとまったんだし、
そろそろ休憩にしない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. Night's still young, how about a break?

fields.JP:
そうですわね。
わたくし、お腹空いてきちゃいましたわ

fields.EN: Just in time for dinner. I made some soup♪
fields.JP:
でしたら、そろそろご飯にしましょうか。
実はもうスープ作ってあるんです♪
fields.LOCALIZED: Just in time for dinner. I made some soup♪

fields.EN:
Lovely! I wondered what that delicious
aroma could be.
fields.JP:
嬉しい！　実はさっきから
いい匂いがすると思ってたんですの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lovely! I wondered what that delicious
aroma could be.

fields.EN:
Ooh. I could smell it all the way from the
back gate while I stood watch.
fields.JP:
オレも見張りしてる間、ずっと
美味そうな匂いが後ろから漂ってくるからさ、
最後はキャンプの方を向いて見張りしてたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh. I could smell it all the way from the
back gate while I stood watch.

fields.EN: Um. Maybe you should focus more on watching...
fields.JP:
いや、そこはちゃんと
前向いて見張りなさいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. Maybe you should focus more on watching...

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Aw, come on!
Don't be so uptight, shorty.
fields.JP:
ははは、冗談冗談！
ちっこいのは手厳しいなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Aw, come on!
Don't be so uptight, shorty.

fields.EN: Okay. Next stop, the Devouring Armada Tower!
fields.JP:
よし、それじゃこれからの
あたしたちの目標は、悪食の監隊塔だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. Next stop, the Devouring Armada Tower!

fields.EN:
Whatever comes next will test us.
Get some sleep to be sharp for tomorrow.
fields.JP:
きっと今まで以上に大変だと思う。
だからしっかり食べて寝て、明日から頑張ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever comes next will test us.
Get some sleep to be sharp for tomorrow.

fields.EN:
I second that. Need to make sure we're
all fit for the journey.
fields.JP: そうだな。疲れていては話にならないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I second that. Need to make sure we're
all fit for the journey.

fields.EN:
(Morale seems high amongst the Blood Maidens.
The wonders of a common goal.)
fields.JP:
（みんなの士気が上がった気がするな。
　もしかしたら、目標を決めたことが
　功を奏したのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Morale seems high amongst the Blood Maidens.
The wonders of a common goal.)

fields.EN:
(Regardless this is a good omen.
Bodes well for the trials ahead.)
fields.JP:
（何にせよいいことだ。
　これでこの先の探索もよりはかどるだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Regardless this is a good omen.
Bodes well for the trials ahead.)

fields.EN:
Surprise, surprise. Another creepy Jail
tower...
fields.JP:
この監獄塔も、他のところに
負けず劣らず不気味ですね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Surprise, surprise. Another creepy Jail
tower...

fields.EN: I'll never get used to it.
fields.JP: どこまで行っても慣れないものよね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll never get used to it.

fields.JP:
わたくしたちは１人じゃないだけ
まだマシですけれど……
わあああっ！　来るな、来るなぁ！

fields.EN: Look! Someone's being attacked by a Marchen!
fields.JP: 見て、誰かメルヒェンに襲われてる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Look! Someone's being attacked by a Marchen!

fields.JP: （こんなところに、まだ一般人がいるとはな）

fields.EN: Hang on! We're here to help!
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですか！
しっかりして下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hang on! We're here to help!

fields.EN:
Rgh... The contaminated being...tortured me.
Ngh. *cough*!
fields.JP:
ぐ……あの汚染動物に……
拷問されて……うぅ……ぐはっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh... The contaminated being...tortured me.
Ngh. *cough*!

fields.EN: Hey! Sit tight. Let me treat you.
fields.JP:
ちょっとあなた！　今手当てしますから、
気をしっかり持つんですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! Sit tight. Let me treat you.

fields.JP: シンデレラ……その方はもう……
せっかくここまで生き延びていたのに……！

fields.EN:
If only we made it sooner, we could've
saved him.
fields.JP:
わたしたちがもう少し来るのが早ければ、
助けられたかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we made it sooner, we could've
saved him.

fields.JP: 助けられなくてごめんなさい……

fields.EN:
(Perhaps they have a different name for
them up here...)
fields.JP: （確かにメルヒェンとは共通言語ではないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Perhaps they have a different name for
them up here...)

fields.EN:
Guess the surface had to suffer with these
pests too.
fields.JP:
やっぱり、まだこうして
苦しんでいる人がいるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guess the surface had to suffer with these
pests too.

fields.EN:
How many more couldn't we save?
I don't know how much more my heart
can take if there are other survivors.
fields.JP:
あたしたちの手が届かない人たち、
どれくらいいるのかな。これからも
こんな光景を見るのかと思うとつらいよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How many more couldn't we save?
I don't know how much more my heart
can take if there are other survivors.

fields.EN:
If they hadn't fled, perhaps they would have
made it.
fields.JP:
逃げたりしなければ、
死ぬこともなかったのにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
If they hadn't fled, perhaps they would have
made it.

fields.EN: Why are you such a downer, Juu?!
fields.JP: ジュウ、そんな言い方はないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why are you such a downer, Toh?!

fields.EN: If he was being tortured, then as long as he endured it, at least he probably wouldn't have been killed yet.
fields.JP:
拷問を受けていたってことは、
そのままでいれば、少なくともまだ
殺されなかっただろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We all know that if a Marchen's torturing
you, the best thing to do would be to stay
still.

fields.EN: So for that man, holding out until we arrived was the right choice.
fields.JP:
だから、僕たちが来るまで耐えていた方が、
あの男の選択肢としては正しかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that man were braver, he could
have pushed through.

fields.EN: Easy for you to say right now!
fields.JP: そんな結果論言ってもしょうがないじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Easy for you to say right now!

fields.EN:
Just stating the truth. By the time we arrived,
it was already too late.
fields.JP:
事実を述べたまでだ。僕らが見つけた時点で、
男に生きる道はもうなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just stating the truth. By the time we arrived,
it was already too late.

fields.EN: The truth, without knowledge, is pointless.
fields.JP:
ジジツヲイッテモ、
リカイシテモラエナケレバ
イミハアリマセンヨ
fields.LOCALIZED: The truth, without knowledge, is pointless.

fields.EN: I was so startled, I nearly threw my back out!
fields.JP:
い、いきなりすぎて
腰を抜かすかと思いましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I was so startled, I nearly threw my back out!

fields.EN:
You will come up short if you rush your quest.
Slow and steady wins the race.
fields.JP:
アナタ、コタエヲイソギスギタリ、
イッポウテキダッタリシテハイケマセン。
セイテハコトヲシソンジマスヨ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will come up short if you rush your quest.
Slow and steady wins the race.

fields.EN:
What the hell? It's coming from that Jail
door.
fields.JP:
何だこいつは。たかだかジェイルの扉のくせに、
なかなか納得できる言葉を並べるじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the hell? It's coming from that Jail
door.

fields.JP: 不思議とこの扉、知性を感じますね
ジュウさんをたしなめているくらいですしね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Just because something is true doesn't mean you
can say whatever you want.
fields.JP:
ジジツデアレバナニヲイッテモイイ、
トイウコトデハアリマセン。
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
What, you can reason with a door but
as soon as I say something, you have a
rebuttal.
fields.JP:
ちょっと、何であんた、
あたしにはめっちゃ反論してくるのに、
この扉には素直なのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What, you can reason with a door but
as soon as I say something, you have a
rebuttal.

fields.EN:
Maybe I prefer being admonished by a
computer over you.
fields.JP:
いや、この間の抜けたような声で
言われたら、何故だか納得してしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I prefer being admonished by a
computer over you.

fields.EN: Well, I happen to think it's cute.
fields.JP:
まああたしも、ちょっと可愛らしいって
思っちゃったけど
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I happen to think it's cute.

fields.EN: I wonder what prompted the door to speak.
fields.JP: 突然どうしたんですかね、この扉
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder what prompted the door to speak.

fields.EN:
Normally it only recognizes people who pass
through it.
fields.JP:
いつもは鍵を開けるときのみ喋るのに、
摩訶不思議ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normally it only recognizes people who pass
through it.

fields.EN:
Hey, got any more insults for us, door?
Wanna scold him again?
fields.JP:
ねえ、扉さん！
もっとこの分からず屋を叱ってくれるー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, got any more insults for us, door?
Wanna scold him again?

fields.JP:
急に機能が停止した？
何だったのかしらね、いったい

fields.EN: At least it gave us the chance to rip into Juu.
fields.JP: ジュウを真人間に戻すチャンスだったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: At least it gave us the chance to rip into Toh.

fields.EN:
As if you don't deserve a good ripping, what
with your clumsy hands. The door should get
you next.
fields.JP:
僕はじゅうぶんまともな人間だ。
むしろ赤ずきんこそ、そそっかしいところを
あの扉に叱ってもらうべきだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
As if you don't deserve a good ripping, what
with your clumsy hands. The door should get
you next.

fields.EN: Don't you talk about my hands!
fields.JP: あたしはそそっかしくなんかないってば！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you talk about my hands!

fields.EN: You're fooling yourself if you deny it.
fields.JP: 自覚がないのがいちばんタチが悪いんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: You're fooling yourself if you deny it.

fields.JP: その言葉そっくり返すっての！
ほらジュウ、赤姉も先に進むわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, Sister Red, let's move on.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Fair enough. The door's stopped responding.
I have better things to do than argue with you.
fields.JP:
そうだな。もう扉も反応しないみたいだし、
何より赤ずきんと口論してる時間がもったいない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fair enough. The door's stopped responding.
I have better things to do than argue with you.

fields.EN: Yeah, right. As if you're not following US.
fields.JP:
そうだね、ここにいても分からず屋が
分かるようなこともなさそうだし
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, right. As if you're not following US.

fields.JP: 互いに口が減らないですね～
しかし便利な機能ですわね

fields.EN: It's almost like he's familiar with this place.
fields.JP: まるで監獄塔の心がわかるみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's almost like he's familiar with this place.

fields.EN:
Jack-san could find them too. Maybe it's just
an intuition?
fields.JP:
でも、ジャックさんにも近い力は
ありましたし、その力に長けているという
ことなんですかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack could find them too. Maybe it's just
an intuition?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Looks like we won't learn who Juu-san really is
until we find his wife.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんの正体は結局奥さんが
見つからない限りわからなさそうですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't seem like we'll know more about
him until his wife turns up.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Hey. The core's nearby, so watch out!
fields.JP: みんな核の近くだから油断しちゃダメだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. The core's nearby, so watch out!

fields.EN:
(Took the words out of my mouth.
Maybe Akazukin's a leader after all.)
fields.JP:
（僕も同じことを言おうとした。
　ここに来て赤ずきんに落ち着きが
　見えてきたな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Took the words out of my mouth.
Maybe Red Riding Hood's a leader after all.)

fields.EN:
Agreed. Enough about me. Let's destroy
that core.
fields.JP:
まったくだ。
僕の事など後回しにして核を破壊するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agreed. Enough about me. Let's destroy
that core.

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: Ah, I knew it. The guardian!
fields.JP: やっぱり番人がいたね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, I knew it. The guardian!

fields.EN: This won't be easy! Stand your ground!
fields.JP:
相手にとって不足はありませんわ！
行きますわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: This won't be easy! Stand your ground!

fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
はぁ～……。
めんどくさかったですね～

fields.EN: Yeah! Great job! I'll kill it off!
fields.JP:
うん！　よかったよ！
それじゃ破壊するね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Great job! I'll kill it off!

fields.JP: ちょっと待ってほしい

っとと！
なにどうしたのジュウ？

fields.EN: W-What are you doing?! It's dangerous to try touching the core!
fields.JP:
な、なにしてんのよ！
核に触れようとするなんて危ないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing?! It's dangerous if you
go too close!

fields.EN:
(Hm. For some reason, I feel no fear.
Like it's all an experiment. I'm touching it.)
fields.JP:
（うむ……不思議と怖くない。
　何事も実験だ……触れてみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. For some reason, I feel no fear.
Like it's all an experiment. I'm touching it.)

fields.EN:
No guardian detected. No guardian detected.
I'm scared. I'm scared.
fields.JP:
バンニン　イナイ　イナイ
コワイコワイ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No guardian detected. No guardian detected.
I'm scared. I'm scared.

fields.EN:
No guardian detected. No guardian detected.
I'm scared. I'm scared.
fields.JP:
バンニン　イナイ　イナイ
コワイコワイ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No guardian detected. No guardian detected.
I'm scared. I'm scared.

fields.JP:
（…………。
　更に奥に行けそうだぞ……）

アヴァア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛！！！！！！
ナバババババズズズズズズルゥゥゥ
あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛あ゛！！！！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP:
ジュウ！！！
だ、だ、大丈夫！？

はぁはぁはぁはぁ……
はぁ……はぁ……
気持ち悪い……

fields.EN:
(I was close to passing out. Terrifying.
Now that was fear.)
fields.JP:
（意識ごと持ってかれるような……
　怖い……これは恐怖だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was close to passing out. Terrifying.
Now that was fear.)

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... S-Sorry, I'm fine.
I just need a minute.
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
いや、す、すまない大丈夫だが……
今はそっとしておいてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... S-Sorry, I'm fine.
I just need a minute.

fields.EN:
Were you trying to hear the core's voice directly?
Anyway, Juu-san, step away and get some rest!
fields.JP:
核の声を直接聞こうとした……？
なんにしても、ジュウさん離れて休みましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Were you speaking with the core? Tch.
Get back here and rest this instant!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Shirayukihime's perceptive. That was dangerous.
Never again.)
fields.JP:
（流石白雪姫察しがいいが……
　これは危険だもう二度とやらない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White's perceptive. That was dangerous.
Never again.)

fields.EN:
(The girls ended up destroying the core.
I wasn't close enough to hear its scream...)
fields.JP:
（その後赤ずきん達が核を破壊してくれたようだ。
　僕はかなり離れていたこともありいつもの悲鳴も
　大きくは聞こえなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The girls ended up destroying the core.
I wasn't close enough to hear its scream...)

fields.EN:
(I believe some thanks are in order to those
girls.)
fields.JP: （今回ばかりは彼女達に感謝せねばならない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I believe some thanks are in order to those
girls.)

fields.EN: I've never seen Juu-san shudder like that.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんが震えているなんて
初めてみましたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I've never seen Toh shudder like that.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Pretty shocking, if you ask me.
fields.JP: よっぽど衝撃的な何かがあったんですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Pretty shocking, if you ask me.

fields.EN: Sorry. I'm all better. Let's go.
fields.JP:
すまない……もう大丈夫だ
行こう
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry. I'm all better. Let's go.

fields.EN:
You sure? Maybe you should wait a while
to regain your strength.
fields.JP:
ほんと？　流石にあんな取り乱した
姿みたことないから、心配だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You sure? Maybe you should wait a while
to regain your strength.

fields.EN:
I said I'm fine. If I need to stop, I'll tell
you.
fields.JP:
ああ、大丈夫だ。
もし辛かったら正直に言おう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I said I'm fine. If I need to stop, I'll tell
you.

fields.EN: Well, just in case, let's take our time.
fields.JP:
ま、やせ我慢する奴でもないし、
ゆっくり進みましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, just in case, let's take our time.

fields.EN:
Fine. All we're doing is wasting time.
On with it.
fields.JP:
ああ、こうしている時間ももったいない
行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine. All we're doing is wasting time.
On with it.

fields.JP: この暗闇！　来たわね！

fields.EN:
Mhm. The Nightmare's close. Don't think
there's any cores left either.
fields.JP:
ああ、ナイトメアだな。
もう核もなさそうだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mhm. The Nightmare's close. Don't think
there's any cores left either.

fields.EN:
(Need to plan it out. Can't risk everyone's
lives without a strategy.)
fields.JP:
（どうする今回も戦いを避けた方が
　いいとは思うが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Need to plan it out. Can't risk everyone's
lives without a strategy.)

fields.EN:
This might be strange coming from me, Juu-san,
but why don't we fight it?
fields.JP:
白雪が進言するのもなんですが……
ジュウさん戦いませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This might be strange coming from me, Toh,
but why don't we fight it?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Our goal is to reach the Devouring Armada.
Who knows how many more Jails we have
to pass through? We need the experience.
fields.JP:
今の目標は、悪食の監隊塔へ行くことです。
白雪達は今後いくつの監獄塔を跨ぐかわかりません
力を付けられる時は力を付けるべきだと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is to reach the Devouring Armada.
Who knows how many more Jails we have
to pass through? We need the experience.

fields.EN:
I say, if the end is nigh, why not go out with
a bang? What do you say, Juu-san?
fields.JP:
いつか来る、逃げれない時のために……
ジュウさんどうですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I say, if the end is nigh, why not go out with
a bang? What do you say, Toh?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Shirayuki! You know, I'm inclined to agree.
fields.JP:
白雪……！
そうね、白雪の言う通りだと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White! You know, I'm inclined to agree.

fields.EN:
Well said! If we wish to put Genocide Pink
in their place, we must get stronger!
fields.JP:
そうですわ！　まだ処刑台少女もいますし、
わたくし達は強くならなければなりませんもの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well said! If we wish to put Massacre Pink
in their place, we must get stronger!
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: I knew I could count on you! Count me in!
fields.JP:
みんな頼もしいね！
あたしもそう思うよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I knew I could count on you! Count me in!

fields.JP: はぁ……かぐや姫はどう思う？

fields.EN:
Do you even need to ask? For starters,
the deeper in we go, the tougher the
Marchens are getting.
fields.JP:
めんどくさいこと聞きますね～
それはわらわ達がいた初めの監獄塔よりも、
メルヒェン達はどんどん強くなってます～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you even need to ask? For starters,
the deeper in we go, the tougher the
Marchens are getting.

fields.EN:
I do agree steps need to be taken to stop
the Marchens and Nightmares, but...
fields.JP:
そう考えると今後のメルヒェン・ナイトメア対策は
必要だとは思いますが～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do agree steps need to be taken to stop
the Marchens and Nightmares, but...

fields.JP: もう、このぐーたら姫は！
ふふ、かぐやさんらしいですわ
リスクを負ってでもやらなければならないか……

fields.EN:
This is no different. But if I give the word
to fall back, you must get to safety!
Don't be reckless.
fields.JP:
それじゃいつも通りだ。
僕が危険だと判断し声を掛けたら一斉に退却だ。
無理だけはするなよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is no different. But if I give the word
to fall back, you must get to safety!
Don't be reckless.

fields.JP:
ありがとうございます！
ジュウさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: それじゃ早速いきますか！

fields.EN: Right. In the name of glory!
fields.JP: ええ、わたくし達まだまだ強くなりましてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. In the name of glory!

fields.JP: グレーヴの監獄塔ナイトメア

fields.EN: This thing is the real deal!
fields.JP: ここからが本番ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED: This thing is the real deal!

fields.EN: Keep your guard up. Let's finish this!
fields.JP: 気を緩めず一気に叩きますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Keep your guard up. Let's finish this!

fields.EN: It looks mad, so we should hurry.
fields.JP:
あいつも大分キレてるみたいだし、
注意しなきゃね
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks mad, so we should hurry.

fields.JP:
よーし！
それじゃ行くよ！

やったね！
どんなもんだい！

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: Nice. We should be safe for a while.
fields.JP: よし、これで大きな脅威は消えたな
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice. We should be safe for a while.

fields.EN: Looks like there's a back area here.
fields.JP: まだ奥はあるようですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like there's a back area here.

fields.EN: But I'm tiiiired. My feet are killing me.
fields.JP:
わらわはもう疲れました～
もう歩けません～
fields.LOCALIZED: But I'm tiiiired. My feet are killing me.

fields.JP: あんたは元々歩いてないでしょ

fields.EN:
I know you're concerned for your friends,
but we should explore the whole area.
fields.JP:
仲間の事もあるかもしれないが、
ひとまず奥を最後まで調べてみよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you're concerned for your friends,
but we should explore the whole area.

fields.EN:
You're right. Wow. You're finally thinking 
of people other than your wife.
fields.JP:
そうだね
ふふっ奥さんのことじゃないんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Wow. You're finally thinking 
of people other than your wife.

fields.EN:
Hmph. I know what must be done.
I was just being courteous. Let's go.
fields.JP:
ふん、僕はもうやるべきことが決まっている。
君たちが気にしそうだと思って言ったまでだ。
いくぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. I know what must be done.
I was just being courteous. Let's go.

fields.EN: Maybe Juu's not so bad after all.
fields.JP: 段々ジュウって人間が見えてきたわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe Toh's not so bad after all.

fields.EN: Do you finally believe me now, Oyayubi-neesama?
fields.JP:
親指姉様、白雪の言う通り悪い人ではないって
わかって貰えましたか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you finally believe me now, Thumbelina?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: Me? I've never thought bad of him in my life.
fields.JP: あら、元から悪い奴とは言ってないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Me? I've never thought bad of him in my life.

fields.JP: あ、親指姉様ずるいですー！

ははは
さ、わたし達もいくわよ！
やっと球体が見つかったな

fields.EN: This'll take us straight to the next tower.
fields.JP: これで次の監獄塔に行けるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: This'll take us straight to the next tower.

fields.EN: Do you think the big one's next?
fields.JP: つ、次はあの悪食の監隊塔でしょうか
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you think the big one's next?

fields.EN:
Beats me. It's so large it could need several
more towers to power itself.
fields.JP:
どうだろうな。
栄養を運ぶための監獄塔が、
まだ他にあってもおかしくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beats me. It's so large it could need several
more towers to power itself.

fields.EN:
While it's possible there are more feeding
towers, it's just as likely this orb could send
us right where we want to be.
fields.JP:
まあパイプは何本もあるだろうから、
僕たちの使っているこれは、
次で終わりという可能性もあるけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
While it's possible there are more feeding
towers, it's just as likely this orb could send
us right where we want to be.

fields.JP: 結局分からないってことですね～

fields.EN:
If I knew the ins and outs of this structure,
then we wouldn't have to guess, would we?
fields.JP: 球体の繋がる先を、僕が知るわけないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I knew the ins and outs of this structure,
then we wouldn't have to guess, would we?

fields.EN: Yes, yes. Enjoy your crude games.
fields.JP: はいはい、そう言うと思いました～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, yes. Enjoy your crude games.

fields.JP: ん？　赤ずきんさん、どうしたんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. What's the matter, Red Riding Hood?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry. It's doing my head in thinking
about where everyone could be.
fields.JP:
ほんと、みんなは
どこにいるんだろうなって思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry. It's doing my head in thinking
about where everyone could be.

fields.JP: ああ……ずっとそれを考えていたんですのね

fields.EN:
Yeah. I just thought we'd find someone
by now. I hope they're safe, wherever
they are.
fields.JP:

Nah. We hadn't met and I was way somewhere
else.

fields.JP: メアリー、がんばって思い出してっ。

fields.EN:
It's on the tip of my tongue. Ugh.
This sucks.
fields.JP:
もうちょっとで出てきそうな、
出てこなさそうな……あーくそっ、もどかしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's on the tip of my tongue. Ugh.
This sucks.

fields.EN:
Charlotte, maybe a big hug would jog my
memory?
fields.JP:
シャーロットがぎゅってしてくれたら
思い出せるかもしんねえんだけどなあー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, maybe a big hug would jog my
memory?

fields.EN: Oh, like this? Does this help?
fields.JP: こう？　これで思い出せそう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, like this? Does this help?

fields.EN:
Oh. I'm getting there. Just keep holding me
tight till I can't breathe. Uehehehe.
fields.JP:
あーまだ足んねえなあ。
もっと弾力による武力行使で
俺を挟み殺してくれ……うひ、うひひ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I'm getting there. Just keep holding me
tight till I can't breathe. Uehehehe.

fields.EN: This is a new low. How is this supposed to...
fields.JP: 思い出す気なさそうなんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: This is a new low. How is this supposed to...

fields.EN:
Seeing it from this angle vexes me.
Has it always looked this gross?
fields.JP:
初めて正面から見たけど、
こんな度し難い顔をしてたのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing it from this angle vexes me.
Has it always looked this gross?

fields.EN:
Hear me out, gang. It's not something we
need to deal with right now.
fields.JP:
みんな、聞いてほしい。
僕としては、これは放っておいて
いい問題じゃないと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hear me out, gang. It's not something we
need to deal with right now.

fields.EN:
Alice's safety is one thing, but my concern
is whatever Genocide Pink and their master
want with her.
fields.JP:
アリスの身の安全というのももちろんだけど
その理由が、マスターや処刑台少女の
目的に繋がっている気がするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice's safety is one thing, but my concern
is whatever Massacre Pink and their master
want with her.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Sooner we figure that out, the sooner we
can devise a plan to take them down.
fields.JP:
相手の目的が分かれば、作戦の立てようもある。
そういうことだね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sooner we figure that out, the sooner we
can devise a plan to take them down.

fields.EN:
I'm just confused as to what they want with me.
That creeps me out.
fields.JP:
わたしに執着する理由が、
自分で考えても何一つ出てこないの。
だからちょっと不気味ね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just confused as to what they want with me.
That creeps me out.

fields.EN:
Let's consult with the others.
They might point us in the right direction.
fields.JP:
よし、他のみんなにも相談してみよう。
もしかしたら、何か手がかりが掴めるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's consult with the others.
They might point us in the right direction.

fields.EN:
So the question is, for what reason could
this Master want Alice?
fields.JP:
アリスだけが、そのマスターって
奴には特別ってことか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So the question is, for what reason could
this Master want Alice?

fields.EN:
Yeah, he specifically ordered them not to
kill her. There has to be an explanation.
fields.JP:
『アリスだけは絶対に殺すな』だもの。
当然、理由があるに決まっているわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, he specifically ordered them not to
kill her. There has to be an explanation.

fields.EN: And you've never had this problem before?
fields.JP: 本当に心当たりはないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: And you've never had this problem before?

fields.EN:
Nope. I mean, we've been underground this
whole time. These freaks are all new to me.
fields.JP:
ないわ。だって、ずっと地下にいたんだもの。
地上の人になんて会ったこともないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope. I mean, we've been underground this
whole time. These freaks are all new to me.

fields.EN: Figures. We have no background on them.
fields.JP: だよなあ。接点なんかあるわけないよな
fields.LOCALIZED: Figures. We have no background on them.

fields.EN:
Wait, how would this person know her
from the underground?
fields.JP:
そもそも、何でそいつは地下監獄にいた
アリスを知っているんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, how would this person know her
from the underground?

fields.EN: It's possible they had a way down all along.
fields.JP: 地上と地下を行き来できる方法でもあるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED: It's possible they had a way down all along.

fields.EN: At the very least, there isn't any secret passage. If there were, there'd be no reason to stay in the Underground Jail.
fields.JP:
少なくとも抜け道なんてものはないわ。
そんなものがあったら、地下監獄に
留まる理由はないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That can't be. If it was, we wouldn't have
been held captive in the underground Jail
for ages.

fields.EN:
Maybe there's a way to warp back and forth.
Well, I guess you'd have to be Hikari to do
that.
fields.JP:
じゃあ空を飛んで行き来できる？
それこそヒカリでもなきゃ無理だよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there's a way to warp back and forth.
Well, I guess you'd have to be Hikari to do
that.

fields.EN:
Wait. Forget all that for a sec.
Do you think the big tower didn't attack
because we had Alice with us?
fields.JP:
でも、地下にいたアリスを知る方法は別として、
悪食の監隊塔が地下を襲わなかったのって、
アリスがいたからだったりするのかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait. Forget all that for a sec.
Do you think the big tower didn't attack
because we had Alice with us?

fields.EN:
That seems likely. Especially if their master
is the one controlling the Armada Tower, right?
fields.JP:
あり得そうな話に思えるわね。
マスターという人は監隊塔の
管理者かもしれないんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That seems likely. Especially if their master
is the one controlling the Armada Tower, right?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Right. We also know that Genocide Pink
claim dominion over it too.
fields.JP:
そうだね。監隊塔は処刑台少女たちが
管理していると言われている……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We also know that Massacre Pink
claim dominion over it too.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
If this person really is master of that band
of witches, then they must also be master
of the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP:
そんな彼女たちがマスターと呼ぶ存在なら、
その者こそが監隊塔の真の管理者
なのかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
If this person really is master of that band
of witches, then they must also be master
of the Devouring Armada Tower.

fields.EN: So it's thanks to Alice...that we're alive?
fields.JP:
じゃあ僕たちは、アリスのおかげで
生かされているのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So it's thanks to Alice...that we're alive?

fields.EN:
But that doesn't make sense.
They put me within inches of my life.
fields.JP:
でもおかしいわ。わたしは
地上に出た時に深手を負わされたのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that doesn't make sense.
They put me within inches of my life.

fields.EN: Those wounds were severe enough that I could have died. If I'm supposed to be special to Master, don't you think that's contradictory?
fields.JP:
あれは死んでもおかしくないほどの傷だったわ。
もしもわたしがマスターの特別だって言うなら、
矛盾していると思わない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was in pretty rough shape. If I'm so special
to their master, why would they attack me?

fields.JP: どうしたの、もしかして何か分かったの！？

fields.EN:
Erm. Um. It may not be a big deal.
So, um. Never mind.
fields.JP:
あぁ、いや……しょの、たいしたことないかも
しれませんので、ななな何でもないです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Erm. Um. It may not be a big deal.
So, um. Never mind.

fields.JP:
気になったことがあるなら言って。
どんな些細なことでもいいから！

fields.EN: AAAAAH! I'm sorry, I'll talk! I'LL TALK!
fields.JP:
ひぃぃぃっ！
ごめんなさい、言います言いますぅ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: AAAAAH! I'm sorry, I'll talk! I'LL TALK!

fields.EN:
Um... that thing you were all talking about
earlier, about not killing Alice... I think I heard
that too...
fields.JP:
ええっとですね、さっきみなさんが言ってた、
アリスは殺すな～みたいな話をですね、あの、
あたしも聞いたなーって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh. The whole Alice deal...
I remember now.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: Um, um... I think it was back at the first Jail Tower, when I found Alice almost dead...
fields.JP:
えと、えと、確か最初の監獄塔で
死にそうなアリスを、ああの、
見つけた時のことでして
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... I think it was when I first found Alice.

fields.EN:
It was when Alice was passed out,
and someone came and healed her. 
I swear I'm telling the truth.
fields.JP:
倒れてるアリスにですね、近づいて
傷を治してった謎の奴がいたんですけど……
ほほ、本当ですよ、これは本当ですぅ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was when Alice was passed out,
and someone came and healed her. 
I swear I'm telling the truth.

fields.EN: Okay, I understand. Just take it slow.
fields.JP:
分かったから。
大丈夫、ゆっくり話して
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, I understand. Just take it slow.

fields.EN:
I-I thought I heard that person mention
something similar when they healed Alice.
Yes, um... Yeah.
fields.JP:
そそその謎の奴が、アリスの傷を治してる時にも
似たようなこと言ってたような気がしたな～
って、はい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I thought I heard that person mention
something similar when they healed Alice.
Yes, um... Yeah.

fields.EN: Oh, I think I recall you saying that, Mary.
fields.JP: そういえばそんな話していたわね、メアリー
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I think I recall you saying that, Mary.

fields.EN:
Maybe he ordered someone to clean up
Guillotine's mess.
fields.JP:
もしかしてギロチンのミスを
フォローするために仲間がやって来たってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe he ordered someone to clean up
Guillotine's mess.

fields.EN: So I was healed by an enemy?
fields.JP: じゃあわたし、敵に手当てをされた……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So I was healed by an enemy?

fields.JP: 話を聞いてると、そんな感じがするね

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Um. Mary-san, was it? You didn't happen to see
their face, did you?
fields.JP:
えーっと……メアリーさんと言ったかな。
そいつの顔は見ていないのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. Mary, was it? You didn't happen to see
their face, did you?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーさん => Mary-san

fields.EN: Oh, um... I dunno. My eyes were covered.
fields.JP:
え、あ、あのっ……ですね、
怖かったから、見ないようにしてました……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, um... I dunno. My eyes were covered.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Then how do you know you saw someone?
For all we know, it was one of your
hallucinations.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、そもそもいたのかどうかも……
もしかしたら恐怖のあまり幻覚を
見てしまったのかもしれないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then how do you know you saw someone?
For all we know, it was one of your
hallucinations.

fields.EN:
Huh? No way! I don't get reality mixed up.
Not even from far away. Never.
fields.JP:
は？　それは絶対にねーよ！
この俺が現実と幻覚を見間違えるわけがねー。
遠目だろうが絶対にだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? No way! I don't get reality mixed up.
Not even from far away. Never.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Sorry, I meant no offense. But if we have
no concrete witnesses...
fields.JP:
すまない、侮辱するつもりはないんだ。
でも他に目撃者もいないとなると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, I meant no offense. But if we have
no concrete witnesses...

fields.EN: No! This thing saw it too!
fields.JP: いやいや、こいつも見てっから！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! This thing saw it too!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: That what? Uh... What is that?
fields.JP: 足下？　えっと……この生き物は？
fields.LOCALIZED: That what? Uh... What is that?

fields.EN: Didn't you summon it from the core, Mary?
fields.JP:
確かメアリーが
核から生み出したお手伝いさんよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Didn't you summon it from the core, Mary?

fields.EN: Yes, it's my serva—I mean, my friend.
fields.JP: そうそう便利な従者、いやお友達だ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, it's my serva—I mean, my friend.

fields.EN:
He listens to my every word.
Sure it doesn't talk, or have a will of its own,
really, but it's alive.
fields.JP:
こいつは俺の命令を忠実に聞くんだけど、
喋らないし、ほぼ意思も持っちゃいない。
でも、それでも生きてはいるんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He listens to my every word.
Sure it doesn't talk, or have a will of its own,
really, but it's alive.

fields.EN: Right? You saw that person heal Alice, right?
fields.JP:
な、アリスを治した謎の奴、
お前も見たよな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Right? You saw that person heal Alice, right?

fields.JP: おお、無言で首を縦に振った……
ほらな、幻覚じゃねえだろ！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
What is this...? I have never seen someone
summon a creature using parts of the core.
fields.JP:
何だこれは……核からこんなものを
生み出すなんて、聞いたこともない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is this...? I have never seen someone
summon a creature using parts of the core.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: How does it work? Will you tell me?
fields.JP:
いったいどういう仕組みなのか、
聞かせてもらってもいいかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: How does it work? Will you tell me?

fields.EN: Oh, well let's try it out.
fields.JP: ああ、それなら今試しに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, well let's try it out.

fields.EN: Mary, no need to demonstrate. I'll explain.
fields.JP:
メアリー、無闇に使っちゃダメ。
私が説明するから
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, no need to demonstrate. I'll explain.

fields.EN:
With Mary's matches, you can see a vision
of whatever you imagine.
fields.JP:
メアリーのマッチ棒を使うと、
想像したものの幻覚を見ることができるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
With one of her matches, Mary can create a
phantom out of anything she imagines.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN:
By throwing a match into the core, she was
able to materialize her friend here.
A triumph of the mind, if you will.
fields.JP:
それを核に投げ込めば、
想像を擬態化させることもできる。
お手伝いさんはこれで生み出したのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
By throwing a match into the core, she was
able to materialize her friend here.
A triumph of the mind, if you will.

fields.EN:
I knew those matches were powerful,
but that's something else.
fields.JP:
マッチがどんな力なのか
ある程度は聞いてはいたけれど、
そんなすごいことにまで使えるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew those matches were powerful,
but that's something else.

fields.EN: Well, it's no big deal... Hehe. Hehehe...
fields.JP:
い、いやそんな大したことじゃ……
へへ……えへへへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, it's no big deal... Hehe. Hehehe...

fields.EN:
(But if they're used for evil, they could drum
up all kinds of trouble. How insane.)
fields.JP:
（なんか悪用しようと思えば、
　いくらでもできそうな凄まじい力だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if they're used for evil, they could drum
up all kinds of trouble. How insane.)

fields.EN:
(All we can do is trust Mary and hope she
doesn't flip a switch on us.)
fields.JP:
（力の持ち主がメアリーだから、
　この程度のもので済んでいるのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All we can do is trust Mary and hope she
doesn't flip a switch on us.)

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I had no idea such a thing was possible.
fields.JP: 世の中にはこんな力があるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED: I had no idea such a thing was possible.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
For now, we know whoever saved me is
affiliated with Guillotine. That doesn't bring
us any closer to knowing who their master is.
fields.JP:
結局、わたしを手当てしたのが
ギロチンの仲間だって線は濃厚になったけれど、
マスターについては分からないままね
fields.LOCALIZED:
For now, we know whoever saved me is
affiliated with Guillotine. That doesn't bring
us any closer to knowing who their master is.

fields.EN:
We must get to the bottom of what they
want with Alice.
fields.JP:
アリスがマスターにとって
どう特別なのかも、判然としないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We must get to the bottom of what they
want with Alice.

fields.EN:
Sounds like our best bet is to ask Guillotine
or one of her sisters.
fields.JP:
これはもう、ギロチンたち処刑台少女に
聞くしかないかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like our best bet is to ask Guillotine
or one of her sisters.

fields.EN:
She waited for us last time. No doubt
she's lurking just around the corner.
fields.JP:
僕たちを待ち構えていたくらいだ。
きっとギロチンはすぐに現れると思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She waited for us last time. No doubt
she's lurking just around the corner.

fields.JP: じゃあしっかりと態勢を整えておかないとね

fields.EN: Yes. Next time, I won't lose.
fields.JP: ああ。次こそは絶対に負けないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. Next time, I won't lose.

fields.EN:
Okay, enough chit-chat. We don't have enough
to go on, and speculating is asking for trouble.
fields.JP:
よし、話はこのくらいにしとこうぜ。
色々と分からないことはまだたくさんあるけどよ、
考えすぎても深みにはまるだけだと思うぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, enough chit-chat. We don't have enough
to go on, and speculating is asking for trouble.

fields.EN: Right. We can't neglect either searching for everyone or finding the glowing orb.
fields.JP:
そうだね。みんなを探すのも、光る球体を
見つけるのも、おろそかにはできないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Let's keep searching and find
that orb.

fields.JP: それじゃあ準備して探索に出かけようか

fields.EN: There's a core over there, guys!
fields.JP: みんな向こうに核があるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a core over there, guys!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: どこに救済感あんだよ……

fields.EN: That thing is ready to fight.
fields.JP: 向こうはやる気まんまんみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED: That thing is ready to fight.

fields.JP: みんな気をつけて来るよ！

ジャック！
一緒に頑張りましょう！

やったわね
メアリーもがんばって、えらいわ

fields.EN:
But I'm tired. If only I had somebody
to lean on.
fields.JP:
でも、ちょっと疲れたな……
寄り掛かれるところがあれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm tired. If only I had somebody
to lean on.

fields.JP: もう、甘えん坊なんだから仕方ないわね
（なんであんな欲望に忠実に動けるんだ……）
ともかく、さっさと核を破壊しよう！
救済の監獄塔ジェイル
ボア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛ーーーーァァ

fields.EN: The Jail's voice is just as creepy no matter which Jail Tower we're in...
fields.JP:
どこの監獄塔もジェイルの声が
不気味なのは変わらないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how many times I hear it,
it gives me the absolute creeps.

fields.EN: Yeah. It's still ringing in my ears.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. It's still ringing in my ears.

fields.EN:
I have a feeling the core's reacting,
maybe not. We might have to go higher.
fields.JP:
核の反応はあるような……ないような……。
もう少し上にいけばわかるかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a feeling the core's reacting,
maybe not. We might have to go higher.

fields.EN:
Regardless, the enemy ahead is strong.
Destroying the core is but the first of
many tasks before us.
fields.JP:
どっちにしてももう核を破壊したくらいじゃ
全然油断できない程敵が強いからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, the enemy ahead is strong.
Destroying the core is but the first of
many tasks before us.

fields.EN:
(The Devouring Armada Tower is gaining
power, just waiting for us.)
fields.JP:
（悪食の監隊塔に近づくほど
　強くなっているのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The Devouring Armada Tower is gaining
power, just waiting for us.)

fields.EN: Steady, everyone, we're aiming for the depths.
fields.JP:
ひとまず焦らず
ゆっくり奥を目指そう
fields.LOCALIZED: Steady, everyone, we're aiming for the depths.

fields.JP: 救済の監獄塔ナイトメア
ヴヴヴヴヴェェーーーーー！！

fields.EN:
The darkness...! Charlotte-san, can you feel the
core nearby?
fields.JP:
暗闇が……！
シャーロットさん核の気配は！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The darkness...! Charlotte, can you feel the
core nearby?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: ...Right. Can't get a sense of it anywhere.
fields.JP:
…………。
そうね、もう核の気配はしないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Right. Can't get a sense of it anywhere.

fields.EN: Which means we can take down the Nightmare.
fields.JP: それじゃこのナイトメアとは戦う価値があるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Which means we can take down the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
But Alice, if everyone's wiped, we don't
have to fight.
fields.JP:
でもアリス、それにみんなも無理そうなら
戦わないのも手だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Alice, if everyone's wiped, we don't
have to fight.

fields.JP:
ジャック……ありがとう。
わたしは大丈夫よ

fields.EN: I don't wanna fight. There, I said it.
fields.JP: んなもん、戦いたくねーに決まってるだろ
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't wanna fight. There, I said it.

fields.JP: そうなのかい、メアリー？

fields.EN:
U-U-Uuum. I'm hoping that one day,
you know, we don't have to fight anymore.
But am I able...? I guess.
fields.JP:
え、えええ、えっと、
た、た戦わない世界がいつか来たら
い、いいなって……、今は、はいやる気です……
fields.LOCALIZED:
U-U-Uuum. I'm hoping that one day,
you know, we don't have to fight anymore.
But am I able...? I guess.

fields.EN:
Mary-chan's right. Sometimes I'm hanging onto
my last breath. But we can't turn back.
fields.JP:
メアリーちゃんの言う通りだよ。
わたしも怖くて戦いたくないけど……
だから今逃げちゃいけないって思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary's right. Sometimes I'm hanging onto
my last breath. But we can't turn back.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーちゃん => Mary-chan

fields.JP: 救済の監獄塔ナイトメア
やったね、おつうちゃん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP:
うん！
このまま畳みかけよう！

fields.EN: Don't sound so eager, Tsuu-kun. Almost there.
fields.JP:
つうくん、はしゃぎすぎないようにね
それじゃやりましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't sound so eager, Otsuu. Almost there.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうくん => Otsuu-kun | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: That does it. Jack, you hurt at all?
fields.JP:
やったわね……
ジャック怪我はない？
fields.LOCALIZED: That does it. Jack, you hurt at all?

fields.JP: うん、僕は平気だよアリス

fields.EN:
Classic Alice. Always putting Jack-kun first.
The rest of us fought pretty hard too!
fields.JP:
だめでしょアリス。
こういう時はみんなを心配しなきゃ
ジャックくん以外もがんばったんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Classic Alice. Always putting Jack first.
The rest of us fought pretty hard too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I-I know! I can think of whoever I want first,
including Jack!
fields.JP:
わ、わかってるわよ！
ただ最初に気になったのがジャックだったの……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I know! I can think of whoever I want first,
including Jack!

fields.EN:
(Alice is getting defensive when Charlotte-san
pokes fun at her. It's kinda cute.)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさんに何か言われているアリスは
　どこか幼げがあってかわいいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice is getting defensive when Charlotte
pokes fun at her. It's kinda cute.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Hehehe. You're head over heels, Alice-san.
fields.JP: ふふふ、アリスさんは一途だもんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. You're head over heels, Alice.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN: Aren't I head over heels for you, Princess?
fields.LOCALIZED: Aren't I head over heels for you, Princess?

fields.JP: わかってるよ、おつうちゃん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I feel good all of a sudden. This isn't a snack
house. Why's it smell so sweet?
fields.JP:
なんだこの緊張感のなさは……
ここはお菓子の家じゃねーんだ、
甘い空気だしてんじゃねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel good all of a sudden. This isn't a snack
house. Why's it smell so sweet?

fields.EN: People tend to let their guard down at times like this, so everyone, let's proceed carefully once more.
fields.JP:
こういう安心してる時こそ油断しがちだから、
みんな今一度慎重に進んでいこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a gimmick. It's trying to trick you, so
you have to stay even more on guard.

fields.JP: てめー聞こえてやがったな

fields.EN: Let's just say you're not exactly quiet.
fields.JP: メアリーは思ったこと口に出しすぎだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just say you're not exactly quiet.

fields.JP: あら、どうかしたの二人とも？

fields.EN: Let's just go, okay? I want out of this dump.
fields.JP:
と、ともかくもう行こうぜ！
こんな不気味なところ早くでたいしさ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's just go, okay? I want out of this dump.

fields.EN: With you there. Just a bit deeper in.
fields.JP:
まぁ確かにそれもそうね。
それじゃ奥に進みましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: With you there. Just a bit deeper in.

fields.EN: Which means we can travel to a new Jail.
fields.JP: これで次の監獄塔に行けるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Which means we can travel to a new Jail.

fields.EN:
We're making pretty good time, don't you
think?
fields.JP:
思った以上にわたしたち、
順調に先に進んでるよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're making pretty good time, don't you
think?

fields.EN:
Right. I expected Guillotine to show,
but it seems she's off to other matters.
fields.JP:
そうだね。結局、ここでは
ギロチンが現れなかったのもあるけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I expected Guillotine to show,
but it seems she's off to other matters.

fields.EN:
Normally we're better for it, but without
her we won't figure out who their master is.
fields.JP:
出ないでくれた方が気が楽でいいけど、
出てくれないとマスターのことを
聞けないのよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normally we're better for it, but without
her we won't figure out who their master is.

fields.EN:
She'll find us if anything, which means stay
on guard and push forward.
fields.JP:
こちらから会うことはできなそうだし、
用心しつつ先に進むのみよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She'll find us if anything, which means stay
on guard and push forward.

fields.EN:
A new tower means finding the right place
to set up camp.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ先に次の監獄塔に行って、
キャンプ地にできるところがあるか調べよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
A new tower means finding the right place
to set up camp.

fields.JP:
あーまた新しい監獄塔か……
嫌だなあ……

fields.EN: What is this place...? It's different.
fields.JP:
何よここ……
今までと雰囲気がまったく違うわね
fields.LOCALIZED: What is this place...? It's different.

fields.EN:
Don't tell me I have to go in there.
It's the yuckiest yet.
fields.JP:
不気味さてんこ盛りじゃねえか……
こんなところ進むのかよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me I have to go in there.
It's the yuckiest yet.

fields.EN: I'm with her. That's not very inviting.
fields.JP: 確かにここは、長居したくない場所ね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm with her. That's not very inviting.

fields.EN:
Hey, everyone! We can look at it from the
outside here.
fields.JP:
あ、ねえみんな！
あそこから外が見えるみたいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, everyone! We can look at it from the
outside here.

fields.JP: 本当だ、ちょっと外を確認しておこうか

fields.EN:
(I'm sure it'll be the same as last time.
More ruins...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり前みたいな荒廃とした
　風景しか広がってないんだとは思うけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm sure it'll be the same as last time.
More ruins...)

fields.JP: えっ？　ものすごく高い……

fields.EN:
H-Hey! Does it look like we're in the air to
you?
fields.JP:
おっ、おい！
この監獄塔、浮いてねーか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey! Does it look like we're in the air to
you?

fields.EN: Y-You're right... We're in the sky.
fields.JP: 本当だわ……わたしたち、空にいる……
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-You're right... We're in the sky.

fields.EN: How tiny the surface looks from here.
fields.JP: 地上があんなに遠くに……
fields.LOCALIZED: How tiny the surface looks from here.

fields.EN: I'm sure that's the least of our troubles here.
fields.JP: とんでもないところに来ちゃったわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sure that's the least of our troubles here.

fields.EN: Right. We're in the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP: そっか、ここが悪食の監隊塔なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. We're in the Devouring Armada Tower.

fields.EN: None of the Jail Towers we've seen before were ever this tall. If there's one that could be, it has to be that Jail Tower we saw from the surface...
fields.JP:
これまでの監獄塔は、絶対にこんな高さは
なかったよ。あるとすれば、地上で見た
あの監獄塔以外に考えられない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of the previous Jails even compare.
This has to be the battleship we saw from
the surface.

fields.EN: Then at last, we've finally come.
fields.JP: じゃあ僕たちはついに辿り着いたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Then at last, we've finally come.

fields.EN:
Yes. Our survival's in our hands.
We might know peace once and for all.
fields.JP:
うん。ここを止めれば、
僕たちは外に出て生きていくことができるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Our survival's in our hands.
We might know peace once and for all.

fields.EN:
But Genocide Pink's here somewhere.
We have to find out what they want with me.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女もこのどこかにいるのね。
今度はわたしのことを聞き出さなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Massacre Pink's here somewhere.
We have to find out what they want with me.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Wait Alice. I see why you'd feel that way,
but we need to gather our bearings first.
fields.JP:
待ってアリス。気持ちは分かるけど、
しっかりと準備をして出直すべきだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait Alice. I see why you'd feel that way,
but we need to gather our bearings first.

fields.EN: But...yeah. We'll fail if we're unprepared.
fields.JP:
でも……いえ、そうね。
焦っては失敗するだけよね
fields.LOCALIZED: But...yeah. We'll fail if we're unprepared.

fields.EN:
We don't know what's awaiting us.
Let's return to camp and plan our next move.
fields.JP:
この先何があるか分からない。
みんな、一旦キャンプに戻って、
これからのことを話し合おうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We don't know what's awaiting us.
Let's return to camp and plan our next move.

fields.EN: You found the Devouring Armada Tower?!
fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔を見つけた！？
fields.LOCALIZED: You found the Devouring Armada Tower?!

fields.EN: Yeah! This is our final stop.
fields.JP:
うん。僕たちはついに
最後の場所まで辿り着いたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! This is our final stop.

fields.JP: マジかよ！　やったじゃねえかお前ら！

fields.EN:
I thought it'd take us twice as long.
This is encouraging.
fields.JP:
正直まだまだかかると思っていた。
何だか希望が湧いてきたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it'd take us twice as long.
This is encouraging.

fields.EN:
Everything looks so much smaller from
up here.
fields.JP: みーんなお空に行けるようになったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everything looks so much smaller from
up here.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I never thought we'd make it this far.
fields.JP: まさか自分もここまで来られるとは……
fields.LOCALIZED: I never thought we'd make it this far.

fields.EN: This is also the result of everyone combining their strength. Neither the exploration team nor the camp team could have survived this far on their own.
fields.JP:
これもみんなで力を合わせた結果だね。
探索組だけでも、キャンプ組だけでも
ここまで生き残れはしなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is the culmination of all we've worked
towards. The explorers and the camp crew
made this possible.

fields.EN:
So all that's left is for us to clear out the
big tower.
fields.JP:
じゃあ後は乗り込んでいって
監隊塔を止めるだけだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
So all that's left is for us to clear out the
big tower.

fields.EN:
But we still haven't encountered Genocide Pink
or their master yet.
fields.JP:
でも、まだ処刑台少女たちにも、
彼女たちのマスターって奴にも
出会っていないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we still haven't encountered Massacre Pink
or their master yet.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Guillotine was just waiting for us last time.
We should assume we're being monitored.
fields.JP:
前回ギロチンが待ち構えていたことを考えると、
わたしたちの動きはある程度は把握されていると
考えた方がいいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guillotine was just waiting for us last time.
We should assume we're being monitored.

fields.EN:
Right. No doubt they're plotting something.
It's wise for us to be cautious.
fields.JP:
ああ。奴らは絶対に僕たちの前に現れる
用心するに越したことはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. No doubt they're plotting something.
It's wise for us to be cautious.

fields.EN:
I just realized we never ended up finding
the others...
fields.JP:
結局、ここまで他に誰も
見つけられなかったなあって思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just realized we never ended up finding
the others...

fields.EN:
The lack of clues has been discouraging.
I know it's hard to take.
fields.JP:
僕たちが合流してからは、
痕跡すら見つかってないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The lack of clues has been discouraging.
I know it's hard to take.

fields.EN:
What if they were teleported somewhere
else on the surface?
fields.JP:
今さらだけど、仮に外のどこかに
飛ばされていたのだとしたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if they were teleported somewhere
else on the surface?

fields.EN:
Hey, I'm sure they're just fine. They survived
the underground Jail, after all.
fields.JP:
大丈夫、きっと他の奴らだって生きてるって。
なんせあの地下監獄を生き抜いたんだぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I'm sure they're just fine. They survived
the underground Jail, after all.

fields.EN:
I bet Hikari sent everyone indoors knowing
the Jails were safe.
fields.JP:
それにヒカリがみんなを監獄塔の中に
ワープさせたのは、外より安全だって
感じたからに違いねえ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet Hikari sent everyone indoors knowing
the Jails were safe.

fields.EN:
In that case we can assume they're making
their way through the towers, as we were.
fields.JP:
だから他の奴らも、
俺たちと同じようにどこかの監獄塔にいて、
生き延びているに違いねえと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that case we can assume they're making
their way through the towers, as we were.

fields.EN: Yeah. Our friends are tough. Keep the faith!
fields.JP:
うん、きっとみんな生きてるよ。
僕たちがそれを信じなきゃ！
