fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Our friends are tough. Keep the faith!

fields.EN: And maybe everyone else is heading for the Devouring Armada Tower too.
fields.JP:
もしかしたら悪食の監隊塔に
みんなも向かっているかもしれないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have a feeling they also know to head for
the Devouring Armada Tower.

fields.EN: Yes. We'll all be reunited in no time.
fields.JP: そうそう。他のみんなにもきっと再会できるわよー
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. We'll all be reunited in no time.

fields.EN: Does your vision tell you so, Charlotte?
fields.JP: シャーロット、それって『見えた』の？
fields.LOCALIZED: Does your vision tell you so, Charlotte?

fields.EN: No, but I've got a good feeling about it.
fields.JP:
いいえ、そういうわけじゃないけど、
何だかそんな気がしたみたい
fields.LOCALIZED: No, but I've got a good feeling about it.

fields.JP: あなたも相変わらずね

fields.EN:
But we do know other cores are being
destroyed. So that's a good sign.
fields.JP:
でも、誰かが核を破壊していることも
確かだから、生存者がいるってことは
間違いないと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we do know other cores are being
destroyed. So that's a good sign.

fields.EN:
Precisely. We might not have proof, but
we have enough to believe in our friends.
fields.JP:
その通りだね
いない可能性もあるけど、いる可能性も十分ある
わからないなら信じた方が力が出るしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Precisely. We might not have proof, but
we have enough to believe in our friends.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You're a positive bunch. I on the other hand
would've lost hope by now.
fields.JP:
君たちは本当に強いね。
自分なら、もう挫けていたと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a positive bunch. I on the other hand
would've lost hope by now.

fields.JP: へっ、俺たちのしぶとさナメんなよ？

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: ああ。まったく、本当にたいしたしぶとさだよ

fields.EN:
Then tomorrow we shall push onward
and set up camp.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあ早速明日にでも、
みんなでキャンプ地を移そうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then tomorrow we shall push onward
and set up camp.

fields.EN:
Good idea. This might be the last base
we'll need, so let's get it well-fortified.
fields.JP:
そうだね。これが僕たちにとっての
最後の前線基地になるから、なるべく
早いとこ設営しなきゃね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good idea. This might be the last base
we'll need, so let's get it well-fortified.

fields.EN:
Right. We've got so much to carry.
We'll need all hands on deck.
Brace yourselves.
fields.JP:
だいぶ荷物も増えてっからな。
運ぶの大変だぞ、覚悟しとけよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We've got so much to carry.
We'll need all hands on deck.
Brace yourselves.

fields.EN: Then Michiru will work reaaaallly hard!
fields.JP: じゃあミチルがいーっぱいがんばるよー
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP explicitly uses ミチル as subject.

fields.EN:
M-Michiru, you shouldn't have to lift a
finger.
fields.JP:
ね、姉さんは
そんなことしなくてもいいんだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
M-Michiru, you shouldn't have to lift a
finger.

fields.EN:
We've been over this. We need all the
help we can get.
fields.JP: こんな状況でそれは駄目だって言ったでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've been over this. We need all the
help we can get.

fields.EN:
Th-Then allow me to carry her share!
How's that?!
fields.JP:
じゃ、じゃあ私が姉さんの分まで運ぶ！
これでどうだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Th-Then allow me to carry her share!
How's that?!

fields.EN:
You'll burn yourself out like that. Aside from
the wounded and sick, everyone puts in their
share. Trust her.
fields.JP:
それであなたが動けなくなったらどうするの。
とにかく、怪我人と病人以外はみんな平等よ。
あの人にも納得してもらってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll burn yourself out like that. Aside from
the wounded and sick, everyone puts in their
share. Trust her.

fields.EN: Not even Hitsuka-san could take down Miko-san.
fields.JP: 陽司さんも視子さんには勝てないのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Not even Hitsuka could take down Miko.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 陽司さん => Hitsuka-san; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP: 何だか新鮮な光景だよね

fields.EN:
Tomorrow's gonna be an early start, so
everyone get some sleep.
fields.JP:
それじゃあみんな、
明日も早いから、今日はもう休みましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tomorrow's gonna be an early start, so
everyone get some sleep.

fields.EN:
(Maybe some fresh air could do me good...
Nope, I still feel the same.)
fields.JP:
（少しテントの外を歩いたら
　気持ちが落ちつくかとも思ったけど、
　そんな気もしないなあ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe some fresh air could do me good...
Nope, I still feel the same.)

fields.EN:
(There's no moon floating in the sky.
The first Jail was controlled by a moon.
I wonder what controls the big one.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、白い月がなくて、
　巨大で、浮遊していて、他の監獄塔を従えて――
　悪食の監隊塔には何があるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no moon floating in the sky.
The first Jail was controlled by a moon.
I wonder what controls the big one.)

fields.JP:
（あまりにも僕たちの知ってる
　監獄塔とは違いすぎる……）

fields.EN:
(Plus there's Genocide Pink, their master,
and their obsession with Alice.)
fields.JP:
（それに処刑台少女と、そのマスター。
　そしてアリスへの執着）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Plus there's Massacre Pink, their master,
and their obsession with Alice.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: (Of course, I can't stop worrying about where everyone else is either.)
fields.JP:
（他のみんなの行方だって、
　もちろん気になって仕方ない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wanna find everyone too, but we've already
got so much on our plate.)

fields.EN:
(Just have to trust they're heading for the
Devouring Armada Tower too. If only we
had some sign of them...)
fields.JP:
（きっとみんな、悪食の監隊塔に向かっている。
　そう自分に言い聞かせているけど、やっぱり
　みんなの手がかりが少しは欲しい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just have to trust they're heading for the
Devouring Armada Tower too. If only we
had some sign of them...)

fields.EN:
(If Akazukin-san were here, I bet she'd
be leading the charge with a rallying cry.)
fields.JP:
（こんな時赤ずきんさんなら、
　『何があろうとあたしは信じてる！』
　って迷いなく言うんだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If Red Riding Hood were here, I bet she'd
be leading the charge with a rallying cry.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Ugh. I can't get all negative now. Okay.
I'll keep walking to refresh my mind.)
fields.JP:
（って弱気になっちゃ駄目だ。
　よし、もうちょっと散歩して気分を変えよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. I can't get all negative now. Okay.
I'll keep walking to refresh my mind.)

fields.JP: （何だかやけに静かに感じるな……）

（ん？　僕の他にも誰か起きてる。
　あれはメアリーのテント……）

fields.EN: (What in the world is Guillotine doing here?)
fields.JP:
（こんな時間に忍び込んで、
　ギロチンはいったい何をしていた？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What in the world is Guillotine doing here?)

fields.EN: (Hm? Is that Mary's clothing she's holding? No... it's not just her clothes. She's holding her body too. But why is there only half of her...?)
fields.JP:
（ん？　あいつが手に持ってるの、メアリーの服？
　いや違う。服だけじゃなく身体も抱えてる。
　でも何でだろう、半分しかない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Why's she holding Mary's clothes?
Wait. Are those body parts there...?)

fields.EN:
(It looks like someone took a circular saw
to her...)
fields.JP:
（まるで大きくて鋭利な刃物によって
　真っ二つにされたような――）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like someone took a circular saw
to her...)

fields.JP: （そんな、まさかメアリーが……殺された？）

fields.EN: I see. So you claim to be Rachel's sisters?
fields.JP:
……なるほど、貴女達はあのレイチェルの
姉妹であると主張するわけね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. So you claim to be Rachel's sisters?

fields.EN:
Yes. When we snuck into your camp, I thought
I heard her voice. Felt her presence.
fields.JP:
うん、あんたらのところに忍び込んでる時に
ずっとレイチェルの声や影を感じてたんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. When we snuck into your camp, I thought
I heard her voice. Felt her presence.

fields.EN: But it seems I was only partially mistaken.
fields.JP: ただ一人目は当てが外れたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: But it seems I was only partially mistaken.

fields.EN:
Anyway, I don't think it's just a coincidence.
She has to be our little sister.
fields.JP:
ともかく、そのレイチェルが
同姓同名の別人じゃなくて、あたしたちの妹だって
可能性は高いと思ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, I don't think it's just a coincidence.
She has to be our little sister.

fields.JP:
レイチェルが、ライリーとエリーの姉妹……
姉妹を気にかける気持ち、ボクにも分かる。
……白雪姉さま……親指姉さま……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little sister...  Same...
Snow White... Thumbelina...

fields.EN: It's okay, Nemu-Nemu. We'll find them soon!
fields.JP:
ねむねむ、だいじょーぶだよ。
おやゆびたちにも、きっとすぐあえるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: It's okay, Sleepy. We'll find them soon!

fields.EN:
That's weird though. Rachel-san mentioned her
parents, but never any sisters.
fields.JP:
でも、妙っすね……
レイチェルさんはご両親の話はしてたけど、
姉妹がいるって話は一度もしてなかったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's weird though. Rachel mentioned her
parents, but never any sisters.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN: Right... We were separated some time ago.
fields.JP:
うん……あの子とは、かなり昔に
離れ離れになったってのもあるし……
fields.LOCALIZED: Right... We were separated some time ago.

fields.EN:
Both Father and Mother were killed...
That's probably all she remembers.
fields.JP:
父さんも母さんも、
とっくの昔に殺されてて……
多分、それもあると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Both Father and Mother were killed...
That's probably all she remembers.

fields.EN: Yeah. Rachel's always been a crybaby.
fields.JP:
うん……レイチェルは、
誰よりも泣き虫だったからね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Rachel's always been a crybaby.

fields.EN: (Maybe she'd been separated from those two for so long that she thought they were already dead... and it was too painful to say anything.)
fields.JP:
（ずっと前に２人と生き別れになったから、
　もう死んでいると思って辛すぎて、
　言えなかったんすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like they were separated a while ago
and suspected their sister was dead...)

fields.EN:
(This place is awful. I can only imagine
how many other kids are in their spot.)
fields.JP:
（世界はこんな状況だし、
　自分みたいな辛い境遇の子たちが、
　他にもいっぱいいるんだろうなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This place is awful. I can only imagine
how many other kids are in their spot.)

fields.EN:
(Man...that stuff is so sad to think about.
I can relate to them...)
fields.JP:
（うう……この２人の身の上話は、
　とても他人事に聞こえないっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man...that stuff is so sad to think about.
I can relate to them...)

fields.EN:
H-Hey. Now that introductions are done,
why don't we let them speak with Rachel?
fields.JP:
な、なぁ、せっかく巡り会えたのだし、
こやつらとレイチェルを、
会わせてやった方がいいのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-Hey. Now that introductions are done,
why don't we let them speak with Rachel?

fields.JP:
あっ、そ、それは……！
ダメなんだ、あたしらはあの子には会えない

fields.EN:
Hm? But why? You're certain she's your
sister, right?
fields.JP:
む？　なぜだ？
姉妹だと確信しているのだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? But why? You're certain she's your
sister, right?

fields.EN:
Even if she was, we might not mean anything
to her anymore.
fields.JP:
……たとえ姉妹でも、あたし達は
あの子と顔を合わせられるような
人間じゃないんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if she was, we might not mean anything
to her anymore.

fields.JP: レイチェルさんとの間に、何かあったんすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.JP:
……あたし達は、元々はライカード島の
人間だったんだけどね
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN:
But after things got scary up here, we needed
people strong enough to fight the contaminated
and to find shelter.
fields.JP:
でも、世界がこんな状態だったからさ、
汚染動物に勝てる強い奴と、
安全な場所が欲しかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after things got scary up here, we needed
people strong enough to fight the contaminated
and to find shelter.

fields.EN:
At first we thought you guys could help us
get by, but we've decided to return home.
fields.JP:
それで、あんたらを利用しようと思って、
近くにいたんだけど……
もう島に帰ることにしたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first we thought you guys could help us
get by, but we've decided to return home.

fields.EN:
I know you think of us as nothing more than
thieves, but please protect Rachel. Please.
fields.JP:
盗人の身で言えた義理じゃないんだけどさ、
これからも、どうかレイチェルのことを
守ってやって欲しい。頼むよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you think of us as nothing more than
thieves, but please protect Rachel. Please.

fields.EN:
You're all so strong, so I'm not worried about
her if she's with you.
fields.JP:
みんな強いから、レイチェルのことも
安心して任せられる
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're all so strong, so I'm not worried about
her if she's with you.

fields.JP:
もうあの子にとって、
私達は必要ない存在……

fields.EN:
A tender but well-rehearsed sob story.
You expect us to listen to thieves?
fields.JP:
一方的に結論を出さないで欲しいわね。
盗人の言い分を聞けと言うの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A tender but well-rehearsed sob story.
You expect us to listen to thieves?

fields.EN: Gretel! You're horrible! Where's your heart?
fields.JP:
グレーテルっ！　貴様というやつは！
相変わらず、血も涙もないやつだの！
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel! You're horrible! Where's your heart?

fields.EN: It might just be an excuse to escape, and until we face Rachel, we can't know whether they're really sisters, can we?
fields.JP:
あら、逃げるための方便かも知れないし、
レイチェルと対面してみなくては、
実際に姉妹かどうか分からないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
For all we know, they're trying to garner
sympathy. It's hard for us to refute a sibling
story.

fields.EN:
Not to mention Riley's vague reasoning for
why they can't see their sister.
fields.JP:
それに今のところライリーの言っていることは
感覚の話だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention Riley's vague reasoning for
why they can't see their sister.

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, I'm sure Riley-san and the others have
some serious reason they can't see Rachel-san even
though they want to!
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、ライリーさん達はきっと、
レイチェルさんに会いたくても会えない
深い事情があるんすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Riley and Ellie have their reasons,
Gretel. We don't know their story!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1; ライリー => Riley-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
These two don't feel like they're lying. I'm sure
they really want to meet Cheruu but just can't!
fields.JP:
このふたり、うそついてるかんじしないよ？
きっと、ほんとにあいたくても
ちぇるーにあえないんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Crazy, huh? Sisters are so precious!
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
In other words, you'd rather us blindly take
the word of thieves? Is that what you want?
fields.JP:
つまり貴女たちは、バカ正直に盗人の
言い分を信じて、このまま解放しろと。
そう主張したいのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, you'd rather us blindly take
the word of thieves? Is that what you want?

fields.EN:
S-Sorry... but I want to do that for them.
Riley-san and the others have it so rough.
fields.JP:
す、すみません……
でも、そうしてあげたいっす。
あまりにもライリーさん達がかわいそうっす
fields.LOCALIZED: S-Sorry...but yes. I feel for them.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Looks like I'm in the minority here.
Then do as you please.
fields.JP:
……はぁ。この場の多数決で決めるとなると、
私が不利ということになるわね。
……だったら、好きになさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... Looks like I'm in the minority here.
Then do as you please.

fields.EN: Oh! Maybe you have a heart after all!
fields.JP:
おおっ！　貴様も随分と
物わかりがよくなったな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! Maybe you have a heart after all!

fields.EN:
If I'm the only one arguing against it, then
it's a waste of time. I know that much.
fields.JP:
１人で反対して、貴女たちと
言い争いをするのは、本当の意味で
時間の無駄だと悟っただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I'm the only one arguing against it, then
it's a waste of time. I know that much.

fields.EN: And so far, there hasn't actually been any harm that directly leads to death.
fields.JP: 実際に今のところ死に連結する実害もないし
fields.LOCALIZED: We've managed just fine this far too.

fields.EN: But if this turns out to be a lie and they break in to steal again, I'll never forgive them.
fields.JP:
でも、これが嘘だったとして、
次盗みに入ったとしたら私は絶対に許さないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Liars or not, they're thieves, and I cannot
forgive that.

fields.EN:
(Oh. This is a different kind of anger from
Gretel-san...)
fields.JP:
（ひえっ……っす
　でも、今までのグレーテルさんの怒りとは
　違う怒りを感じるっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. This is a different kind of anger from
Gretel...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
I-Isn't that nice? We can let the theft stuff
go. You guys can safely return home.
fields.JP:
よ、よかったっすね、これでおとがめなしっす！
２人とも故郷に帰れるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-Isn't that nice? We can let the theft stuff
go. You guys can safely return home.

fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう……
でも、本当にいいの？

fields.EN:
Guree said it was okay too,
so it's fine, it's fine!
fields.JP:
ぐれーもいいっていったから、
いーの、いーの！
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretty said it's okay, so it's okay!
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Then we'll take you up on your offer and
get outta here.
fields.JP:
うん、じゃあお言葉に甘えて、
このまま２人で帰らせてもらう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we'll take you up on your offer and
get outta here.

fields.EN:
Don't feel obligated, but would you two like
to return with us to camp?
fields.JP:
あ、でも、無理強いはしないっすけど、
やっぱり自分たちと一緒に、
キャンプ地に来ないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't feel obligated, but would you two like
to return with us to camp?

fields.JP: うん、ごはんもたべられるよー

fields.EN:
No thanks. We couldn't bear to face Rachel.
It's better for us if we part here.
fields.JP:
いや、それは遠慮しとくよ。
やっぱりあの子には会わせる顔が無いし、
会わずに去った方がお互いのためだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No thanks. We couldn't bear to face Rachel.
It's better for us if we part here.

fields.EN: Yeah. We've got some thinking to do.
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. We've got some thinking to do.

fields.EN:
Um, sorry for all the trouble we caused you.
We kinda mistook you for someone else.
fields.JP:
あっ、あなたにも迷惑かけてごめんね。
この間声をかけたのは、ほんとに
ちょっとした人違いだったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, sorry for all the trouble we caused you.
We kinda mistook you for someone else.

fields.EN: Please travel safely back to Leichhardt Island.
fields.JP:
ライカード島へ帰ったら、
くれぐれも気をつけて下さいっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Please travel safely back to Licard.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN: Oh, we'll be fine. The two of us have already managed to scrape by while you were away.
fields.JP:
ああ、それなら大丈夫。
あんた達がいない間も、２人でギリギリ
生きてきた実績はあるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks, appreciate it. Us two will be just
fine.

fields.EN:
Our hearts can rest knowing Rachel's alive
and safe, even if we're apart.
fields.JP:
レイチェルが無事だってわかったんだ。
離れていても、しぶとく生き延びてやるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our hearts can rest knowing Rachel's alive
and safe, even if we're apart.

fields.EN:
That sure is something! Argh. Whatever!
Consider this a send-off! Take it as you will!
fields.JP:
な、なんという見上げた根性なのだ！
えーい、これは我からの餞別なのだ！
もってけどろぼうっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That sure is something! Argh. Whatever!
Consider this a send-off! Take it as you will!

fields.EN: What? All this? Don't you need this more?
fields.JP:
えっ、こ、こんなにいいの？
あんたらにとっても、必要な物なんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What? All this? Don't you need this more?

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Don't insult the Demon King's kindness!
Stick together and look out for one another.
fields.JP:
ふはははっ、大魔王に二言はないのだ！
これからも２人仲良く
逞しく生き延びるのだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Don't insult the Demon King's kindness!
Stick together and look out for one another.

fields.JP:
う、うん……ありがとう……
お言葉に甘えさせてもらうよ

fields.EN: Well, this is farewell. Thanks for everything.
fields.JP:
……じゃあ、そろそろあたし達は行くね。
最後まで、本当に世話になったね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, this is farewell. Thanks for everything.

fields.EN:
Thank you. We'll never forget you.
Hope we cross paths again someday.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、みんなの親切は忘れないから。
また、いつかどこかで会えるといいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. We'll never forget you.
Hope we cross paths again someday.

fields.EN: Yes! Be careful! See you next time!
fields.JP:
はい！　お気を付けてっす！
どこかでまた会えるといいっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes! Be careful! See you next time!

fields.EN:
(After making our way to the new tower
with our new friend Rachel-san in tow, Kaede-san
led the task of setting up camp.)
fields.JP:
（その後、自分達は新たな監獄塔を見つけて、
　カエデさんやレイチェルさん達と移動して、
　キャンプ地を設営したっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After making our way to the new tower
with our new friend Rachel in tow, Kaede
led the task of setting up camp.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san; カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
(Riley-san and Ellie-san, as requested, left without
seeing Rachel-san...)
fields.JP:
（ライリーさんとエリーさんは、
　２人が希望していた通り、レイチェルさんに
　会わないまま帰って行ったっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Riley and Ellie, as requested, left without
seeing Rachel...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san; ライリーさん => Riley-san; エリーさん => Ellie-san

fields.EN:
(There was a sadness in their eyes as they
left us, but it seemed they were comforted
by the knowledge that Rachel-san's safe.)
fields.JP:
（せめて家族の安否くらいはと思って、
　レイチェルさんにも２人のことを
　伝えたけど、悲しそうだったっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There was a sadness in their eyes as they
left us, but it seemed they were comforted
by the knowledge that Rachel's safe.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.JP:
あっ、おかえりなさい！
みなさん、ご無事でしたか？

fields.EN:
Yeah, totally. We even found the escape to
a new tower.
fields.JP:
うんうん、全員無事っすよ。
新しい監獄塔への道も見つけたっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, totally. We even found the escape to
a new tower.

fields.JP: そうでしたか～、お疲れ様ですっ

fields.EN:
(Hm. Rachel-san has a right to know we found
her sisters, doesn't she...?)
fields.JP:
（うーん、会えなくても、レイチェルさんに、
　姉妹が無事だったってことを
　すぐに伝えた方がいいっすよね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. Rachel has a right to know we found
her sisters, doesn't she...?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
Hey Rachel-san, I have something to share with
you. It's very important.
fields.JP:
あの、それで、レイチェルさんに、
どうしても伝えておかないと
いけない大事なお話があるんすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Rachel, I have something to share with
you. It's very important.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN: Who, me? What could it be?
fields.JP:
えっ、私に…ですか？
なんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Who, me? What could it be?

fields.EN: I actually met your older and younger sisters, Rachel-san.
fields.JP:
実は、レイチェルさんのお姉さんと
妹さんを見つけたっす
fields.LOCALIZED: I actually met your older and younger sisters, Rachel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.JP:
（あれ？　驚きすぎて
　言葉も出ないんすかね？）

えっと、レイチェルさん？
大丈夫っすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.JP:
……っ、す、すみません、
あ、あの、本当にお姉ちゃんが……？

fields.EN:
Yes—your older sister, Riley-san, and your younger
sister, Ellie-san. They're the two thieves who came
to rob our camp the other day!
fields.JP:
そうっす、お姉さんのライリーさんと、
妹のエリーさん。実はこの間ここへ
泥棒に来てた２人組がそうだったんす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Riley and Ellie. They were the thieves
who raided our camp!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ライリーさん => Riley-san; エリーさん => Ellie-san | Restored source onee/onii kinship form. Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
N-No way... Riley-oneechan and Ellie...
are alive?
fields.JP:
う、うそ……ライリーお姉ちゃんと、
エリーが……生きてたの？

fields.EN:
I... I didn't think I'd ever see them again.
I can't believe it.
fields.JP:
ああっ、もう二度と会えないんじゃないかって
思ってたから……信じられないです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I didn't think I'd ever see them again.
I can't believe it.

fields.EN:
Well... I urged them to see you, but they said they
couldn't face you, Rachel-san.
fields.JP:
それが……会って行くように勧めたっすけど、
どうしてもレイチェルさんに
会わせる顔がないって言って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I invited them to see you, but they
said they have no right to do so.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Then they set off for Leichhardt Island.
fields.JP:
そのまま２人で、故郷のライカード島へ
帰ってしまったっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Then they set off for Licard Island.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN:
It's sad I couldn't see them, but just knowing
onee-chan-tachi are alive makes me happy...
fields.JP:
会えないのは残念ですけど、
お姉ちゃんたちが生きてるって
知れただけでも、よかったです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's sad I couldn't see them, but I'm happy
they're okay.

fields.EN:
Yeah! Don't you worry about a thing.
I'm sure you'll be together again some day.
fields.JP:
そうっす！　落ち込まなくても、
生きてたらきっとまたいつか会えるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! Don't you worry about a thing.
I'm sure you'll be together again some day.

fields.EN:
Right. Seems like you meant a lot to them,
Rachel!
fields.JP:
うんうん、やつらもレイチェルのことを
案じていたからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Seems like you meant a lot to them,
Rachel!

fields.EN: You might run into Cheruu sometime!
fields.JP: そのうち、ちぇるーとばったりあうかも！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hopefully you find them again, Chelly!
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
姉妹の絆は、途切れない……

そ、そうですよね。
みなさん、ありがとうございます……

fields.EN:
(After we shared the news with Rachel-san,
she holed up in her tent for a while.)
fields.JP:
（あの後レイチェルさんは、
　少しの間１人でテントに閉じ籠もって
　いたっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After we shared the news with Rachel,
she holed up in her tent for a while.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN:
(Thankfully, she came back out later to
assist Kaede-san.)
fields.JP:
（今ではすっかり元気になって、
　カエデさん達を手伝ってるっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thankfully, she came back out later to
assist Kaede.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN: Okay! I'll set up the outer fences!
fields.JP:
うしっ！　自分も張りきって、
キャンプ地周りの柵を作るっすよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay! I'll set up the outer fences!

fields.EN: Clara, sorry to bother you. Got a minute?
fields.JP:
くらら、作業中に悪いのだけれど、
少しだけ時間を取らせてもらえないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Clara, sorry to bother you. Got a minute?

fields.EN: Hey Gretel-san. Sure thing. What's up?
fields.JP:
あ、グレーテルさん。
自分は別に構わないっすよ
どんな御用っす？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Gretel. Sure thing. What's up?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Remember that transmitter Riley and Ellie
stole from us? Know what happened to it?
fields.JP:
ライリーとエリーが前に盗んで行った
トランシーバーなのだけれど、
アレがどうなったか、貴女は知ってる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember that transmitter Riley and Ellie
stole from us? Know what happened to it?

fields.EN: Oh, the one Takumi-san mentioned? It's, um...
fields.JP:
あー、タクミさんが盗まれたって
言ってたヤツっすね。
うーん、あれは……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, the one Takumi mentioned? It's, um...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: タクミさん => Takumi-san

fields.EN:
Actually I don't remember taking it back from
them. They might still have it.
fields.JP:
返してもらった覚えが無いんで、
彼女達が持って行ったままかもっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually I don't remember taking it back from
them. They might still have it.

fields.JP: そう。それは困ったわね……

fields.EN: Why? Is it important for our journey?
fields.JP:
どうしてっすか？
あ、もしかして、今後の探索に
必要不可欠だったっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why? Is it important for our journey?

fields.EN:
No, not for our journey. But it could aid me
with something else.
fields.JP:
いいえ、探索に使うというより、
個人的に引っかかっていることがあるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not for our journey. But it could aid me
with something else.

fields.EN:
Remember when we heard someone's voice
on the transmitter?
fields.JP:
あの時、彼女達のトランシーバーから、
人の声が聞こえたのを覚えているかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember when we heard someone's voice
on the transmitter?

fields.JP:
ハウテハロデ……スナーグ……
ガガガ……ピピピ……
ガガガ……ピピピ……

fields.EN:
Oh! I remember! Not what the voice said,
but I remember it cracking and talking!
fields.JP:
あ！　思い出したっす！
何て言ってるか、わからなかったっすが、
確かに声が聞こえましたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! I remember! Not what the voice said,
but I remember it cracking and talking!

fields.EN:
After we got the transmission, I tried to use
the transmitter again.
fields.JP:
あの後、こちらの手元に残っていた
トランシーバーでも試してみたのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we got the transmission, I tried to use
the transmitter again.

fields.EN:
But I couldn't find any signal, no matter
which channel I selected.
fields.JP:
そもそも、周波数が一つも登録されて
いなかったから、いくら試しても
どこにも繋がらなかったのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I couldn't find any signal, no matter
which channel I selected.

fields.JP:
そうだったんすか……
それは残念っす

fields.EN:
It was practically all static, but it confirmed
one thing.
fields.JP:
正直、音質も悪いし、内容もいまいち何を
言ってたか聞き取れなかったけど、
一つだけ言えることがあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was practically all static, but it confirmed
one thing.

fields.EN:
There are other humans settled up here.
We just haven't found them yet.
fields.JP:
この世界に、私たち以外の人間が
存在するのは間違い無いわ。
それが誰なのかまでは分からないけれどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are other humans settled up here.
We just haven't found them yet.

fields.EN:
Whoever was on the other side of that
transmitter was trying to make contact.
fields.JP:
その人物が、トランシーバーを使って、
何者かと連絡を取ろうとしていたんでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoever was on the other side of that
transmitter was trying to make contact.

fields.EN:
So...do you think it could've been Jack-san or
Boss on the line?
fields.JP:
じゃあ……ひょっとすると、
あの声は、ジャックさんや
師匠のものだったりするっすか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So...do you think it could've been Jack or
Boss on the line?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Yes, that's very possible. If we could just figure out the frequency they were using, we might be able to contact them from our side...
fields.JP:
ええ、その可能性は大いにあるわね。
使用されていた周波数さえ分かれば、
こちらから連絡を取れそうなのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. That's highly likely. If we could figure
out which channel they're using...

fields.EN:
To figure that out, we need the transmitter
back from Riley-san.
fields.JP:
そのためには、ライリーさん達から
トランシーバーを返してもらうしか
ないってことっすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
To figure that out, we need the transmitter
back from Riley.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ライリーさん => Riley-san

fields.EN:
Exactly. But getting to Leichhardt Island is a 
mission in itself, never mind finding them.
fields.JP:
まさにその通りよ。
何にしてもライカード島へ
行ってあの２人を探すのは大変でしょうし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Exactly. But getting to Licard Island is a 
mission in itself, never mind finding them.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN:
We also have no idea of knowing when they'll
arrive safely. What do we do?
fields.JP:
そこそも彼女たちが無事に
着いたのかも分からないわね。
困ったものだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We also have no idea of knowing when they'll
arrive safely. What do we do?

fields.EN:
B-But it had to mean that someone was within
range of the transmitter, right?
fields.JP:
で、でも、トランシーバーの電波が届く
範囲に、自分たち以外の誰かが
いたってのは確かなんすよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
B-But it had to mean that someone was within
range of the transmitter, right?

fields.EN: Yes, good point. That's a safe assumption.
fields.JP:
ええ、そうね。
そう判断してもいいと思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, good point. That's a safe assumption.

fields.EN:
Wow, amazing! At least it's a start!
That brightens up my mood.
fields.JP:
いやー、嬉しいっす！
それが分かっただけでも、
気持ち的に明るくなったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow, amazing! At least it's a start!
That brightens up my mood.

fields.EN:
Wait for us, Boss! I promise we're coming!
Let's set out as soon as camp's all done.
fields.JP:
師匠、待ってろっす！
自分が必ず見つけに行くっす！
設営が終わったら、早速探索するっすよ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait for us, Boss! I promise we're coming!
Let's set out as soon as camp's all done.

fields.JP:
あれ……？
シラさん、どこに行ったっすか？
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: You're right. She's gone. Maybe she's lost?
fields.JP:
ほんとだ、シラいないねー、
まいごかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: You're right. She's gone. Maybe she's lost?

fields.EN:
Ugh. How dare she wander off.
That one's trouble.
fields.JP:
まったく、勝手にはぐれるとは
困ったやつなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. How dare she wander off.
That one's trouble.

fields.EN: Yeah. Shira-san hasn't seemed well lately.
fields.JP:
そうっすね、シラさん
最近元気なかったっすから
fields.LOCALIZED: Good idea. She's looked real glum lately.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Rare for Gretel to show concern for someone
else. Next you'll tell me cats and dogs will
rain from the sky.
fields.JP:
グレーテルが人の心配をするなんて、
珍しいのだ。
明日はきっと槍が降るぞ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rare for Gretel to show concern for someone
else. Next you'll tell me cats and dogs will
rain from the sky.

fields.EN:
I'm not worried about her. She's in Genocide
Pink, after all. I just want to know where she
is.
fields.JP:
別に、心配しているわけじゃないわ。
彼女は、あくまでも処刑台少女だもの。
行動を把握しておきたいだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not worried about her. She's in Massacre
Pink, after all. I just want to know where she
is.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Guree worries too much!
Shira is not that bad!
fields.JP:
ぐれーはきにしすぎ！
シラはそんなわるいこじゃないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretty, you worry too much! Pi's not evil.
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN: Anyway, let's split up and look for Shira-san.
fields.JP:
まぁ、とにかく手分けしてシラさんを
探してみるっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, let's split up and find her.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
（こっちの道には、
　シラさんはいないみたいっすねぇ……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(Ah, there you are, Shira-san. Wait, who's with
you...?! )
fields.JP:
（あ、シラさん、そっちにいたっすか。
　って、一緒にいるのは……！！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh, there she is. Wait, is that—?!)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).
Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
There you are, Hiaburibashira. Looks like you've been
having fun slacking off, huh?
fields.JP:
火あぶり柱、久しぶり―。
大事な仕事をほったらかして、何だか楽しく
過ごしてるみたいじゃなーい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you are, Pyre. Looks like you've been
having fun slacking off, huh?

fields.EN:
(Oh no! It's Kubitsuridai, one of Genocide Pink!
She tried to kill me!)
fields.JP:
（ひっ、あ、あの人はっ……！
　自分を半殺しにした、
　首吊り台って名前の処刑台少女っす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no! It's Gallows, one of Massacre Pink!
She tried to kill me!)
fields.notes: Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(S-Scary... seriously scary. Is she here to take
Shira-san back?)
fields.JP:
（こ、怖い……マジで怖いっす。
　もしかして、彼女がシラさんを
　迎えに来たんすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'm scared... So scared. Is she here for Pi?)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: あ、あの、首吊り姉さん、シラ……、
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: い、いや、火あぶり柱は……、そのっ

fields.EN:
Oh, that's fine. So long as you accomplish
your mission, I won't tell Papa about your
little detours.
fields.JP:
別にいいのよー、やることをちゃんと
やるってのなら、多少の寄り道は、
パパ達には黙っててあげるー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that's fine. So long as you accomplish
your mission, I won't tell Papa about your
little detours.

fields.EN:
Yup. Cleaning up. Isn't that why you're
spending time with the trash?
fields.JP:
そ、お掃除。そのためにあんたも
わざわざゴミの中に入り込んだんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Cleaning up. Isn't that why you're
spending time with the trash?

fields.EN:
With that said, kill them all in their sleep
tonight. Do I make myself clear?
fields.JP:
ってことでぇ、今夜にでもあいつらを
裏切って、全員殺っちゃいなさい。
これ、決定事項ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that said, kill them all in their sleep
tonight. Do I make myself clear?

fields.EN: (They're going to make Shira-san kill us?!)
fields.JP: （シラさんに、自分達を殺させるっすか！？）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
...! W-Wait, Sister Gallows.
You're not here to rescue me?
fields.JP:
……っ！！
そ、そもそも姉さんは、火あぶり柱を
迎えに来てくれたんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...! W-Wait, Sister Gallows.
You're not here to rescue me?

fields.EN:
WHAT?! Ugh. You're joking, right?
So many towers have been ruined by
you and the filth you travel with.
fields.JP:
はぁ！？　あんた何言ってんの？
姉たちの監獄塔を虫ケラ共と
ことごとく侵略して行ったくせに？
fields.LOCALIZED:
WHAT?! Ugh. You're joking, right?
So many towers have been ruined by
you and the filth you travel with.

fields.EN: When you say something that self-serving, it makes me want to kill you, you know? Do you want me to hang you that badly?
fields.JP:
あんまり虫の良いこと言われると、
思わず殺したくなっちゃうんだけどー？
そんなにわたしに吊られたいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if you want to live, then how about you
stop interfering with our plans. Want me to
hang you?

fields.EN: S-Sorry, sister! Please don't kill me!
fields.JP:
ご、ごめんなさい！　首吊り姉さんっ！
殺さないでっ
fields.LOCALIZED: S-Sorry, sister! Please don't kill me!

fields.JP:
でーもー。わたしは優しいお姉ちゃんだから、
ちゃんとやることやったら、
火あぶり柱を許してあげる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Buuut...since I'm the kindest of us all,
as long as you see out your task, I will
forgive you, Pyre.

fields.EN:
Besides, I bet Papa would be real impressed
if you managed to kill them all♪
You wanna prove yourself, don't you?
fields.JP:
それに、あいつら全員をあんたが殺せば、
パパはきっと見直してくれるでしょーね♪
晴れて一人前になれるし、イイ話じゃなーい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I bet Papa would be real impressed
if you managed to kill them all♪
You wanna prove yourself, don't you?

fields.EN: N...No... I don't wanna kill them.
fields.JP:
い……いやだ……
殺したく……ない
fields.LOCALIZED: N...No... I don't wanna kill them.

fields.EN:
That so? So you want Papa and us to kill you?
That's what you want? You absolutely sure?
fields.JP:
あ、そう？　それならわたしもパパも
あんたを殺すわよ？　それでもいーのね？
ぜーったい、後悔しないのね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That so? So you want Papa and us to kill you?
That's what you want? You absolutely sure?

fields.EN:
Huh? You look pale, child. Why are you all
hunched up here?
fields.JP:
うん？　小娘、顔が真っ青だぞ。
そんなとこにしゃがんでどうしたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You look pale, child. Why are you all
hunched up here?

fields.EN: Oh, Hameln-san! Now's not a good time!
fields.JP:
あっ、ハーメルンさん！
い、今はマズイっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Hameln! Now's not a good time!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: What do you mean by that?
fields.JP: マズイって何がなのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean by that?

fields.EN:
...Hey! Isn't she in Genocide Pink?
What's the meaning of this, Shira?
fields.JP:
……むむっ！
そこにいるのは、処刑台少女ではないか！
シラ、そやつといったい何をしている！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Hey! Isn't she in Massacre Pink?
What's the meaning of this, Pi?
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Aw, that's our time. You better not let us
down. I'll be watching you.
fields.JP:
あら、見つかっちゃったー。
じゃあ、さっきのやつ、必ずやってね。
や・く・そ・く。だから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, that's our time. You better not let us
down. I'll be watching you.

fields.EN:
Grr. She sank into the wall! Dyamn her!
She's a quick one.
fields.JP:
ぬぅっ、か、壁の中に消えたのだ……！
おにょれっ！　逃げ足の速いやつめっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr. She sank into the wall! Dyamn her!
She's a quick one.

fields.EN:
(So those are the warden powers Gretel-san had
mentioned.)
fields.JP:
（あれが……グレーテルさんが言ってた
　監獄塔の管理者権限を持った者が
　できることっすか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So those are the warden powers Gretel had
mentioned.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: シラさん！　だ、大丈夫っすか？
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Hey Shira, what'd she tell you to do?
fields.JP:
おい、シラよ。
あやつにいったい何を言われたのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Pi, what'd she tell you to do?

fields.EN:
Out with it. Something's on your mind.
Or do you think you can't tell us?
fields.JP:
黙っていては、わからぬぞ
我には言えないようなことなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Out with it. Something's on your mind.
Or do you think you can't tell us?

fields.EN: I-I don't know. Before she could tell me, you all showed up, so my sister just ran away.
fields.JP:
……し、知らない。
言われる前に、あんたたちが来たから
姉さんは逃げていっただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I don't know. She left before she could
tell me. I think she was in a hurry.

fields.EN:
(Huh? W-Why would you tell a lie like that,
Shira-san...?)
fields.JP:
（えっ？　な、なんでそんな嘘を
　つくんすか……シラさん）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Oh Shira, there you are! Found you.
fields.JP:
あー、シラ、みつけたー！
そっちにいたんだねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh Pi, there you are! Found you.

fields.EN:
Hey, what's wrong? Something happen?
You look upset.
fields.JP:
あれ？　げんきない？
シラ、なにかあったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, what's wrong? Something happen?
You look upset.

fields.EN:
Someone from Genocide Pink was just here.
She approached Shira and scurried off when I
arrived.
fields.JP:
ついさっきまで、処刑台少女がいたのだ。
シラに近づいてきたところを、
我が近寄ったら恐れを成して逃げて行ったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Someone from Massacre Pink was just here.
She approached Pi and scurried off when I
arrived.
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Someone from Genocide Pink came for Shira?
fields.JP: 処刑台少女が、シラに接触して来たの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Someone from Massacre Pink came for Pi?
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
...Kubitsuridai. Kubitsuri-neesan...
she tried to talk to me.
fields.JP:
……首吊り台。首吊り姉さんが……
は、話しかけようとして来たの
fields.LOCALIZED: Gallows... My sister. She came here.

fields.EN:
What...?! Your scary sister was here?
You okay, Shira?
fields.JP:
……えーっ！　こわいおねえさんが
はなしかけてきたの？
シラ、だいじょーぶだった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...?! Your scary sister was here?
You okay, Pi?

fields.JP:
……シラの、顔色……ひどい……
すごく心配……

き、気にしないで！
大丈夫、何も話してないから！

fields.EN:
(I'm really bothered that Shira-san lied to
everyone...)
fields.JP:
（シラさんが、みんなに嘘をついたのが
　すごく気になるっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It worries me that Pi lied to everyone...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(But she said 'no' back then... I'll trust
Shira-san.)
fields.JP:
（でもあの時『いやだ』と言った、
　シラさんを信じてみるっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But she also seemed hesitant to carry out
their orders. I believe in you, Pi...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).
B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: って、早速番人があらわれたっすよ！

fields.EN: I'm always ready! Come and get it!
fields.JP:
我はいつでも戦闘態勢だ！
来るがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm always ready! Come and get it!

fields.EN: What's the matter, Shira? You hungry?
fields.JP:
どーしたの、シラ？
おなかすいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's the matter, Pi? You hungry?

fields.EN: Sh-Shut up! Shira is totally ready too!
fields.JP:
う、うるさいわね！
シラも準備ばんたんよ！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Don't sound so excited... Look sharp!
fields.JP:
興奮しすぎないで頂戴ね
……行くわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't sound so excited... Look sharp!

fields.JP:
ふぅぅ……っす。
みなさん怪我はないっすか？

だ、大丈夫よ！
心配しないで！

fields.EN:
Looks like we're getting the hang of this
combat thing.
fields.JP:
それにしても、みなさんどんどん連携が
うまくなっていくっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like we're getting the hang of this
combat thing.

fields.EN:
I-It just means you guys finally caught up to
Shira's level.
fields.JP:
あ、あんた達がやっとシラのレベルに
おいついたってことね
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice of you guys to finally get on my level.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: You wish, brat. I'm as strong as they come!
fields.JP:
相変わらず生意気なやつめ
我のほうが断然強いぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You wish, brat. I'm as strong as they come!

fields.EN:
(Shira-san gets down sometimes, but it feels like
everyone cheers her up.)
fields.JP:
（シラさんちょいちょい元気ないっすけど、
　みんなに元気をもらってる感じっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm happy Pi still finds a way to smile with
everyone even when things are tough.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: No fighting! Or I'll tell Jack!
fields.JP:
けんかはだめーっ！
ジャックもいってたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: No fighting! Or I'll tell Jack!

fields.JP: シラそいつ知らないし！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Save your bickering for later. Let's hurry and
destroy that core!
fields.JP:
根拠のない論争ほど無駄な時間はないわ
さっさと核を破壊して行くわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Save your bickering for later. Let's hurry and
destroy that core!

fields.EN:
(At this point I fear Gretel-san more than a
guardian...)
fields.JP: （グレーテルさんが保護者みたいに見えるっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At this point I fear Gretel more than a
guardian...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: あ、あそこ見てほしいっす！

fields.EN:
That beast will pay for the trouble it's caused!
HNGRGH!
fields.JP:
我に苦労をかけたその報い、
覚悟するのだ！
ふべしっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That beast will pay for the trouble it's caused!
HNGRGH!

fields.EN:
What in the world are you...?! Grete—
Wait, Nemurihime?!
fields.JP:
にゃ、なにをするのだ！
グレーテ……って眠り姫！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What in the world are you...?! Grete—
Wait, Sleeping Beauty?!

fields.JP:
ごめん……でも……
ハメルンちゃん……まだ待つ……
（とうとうネムさんに止められるようになったっす）
じぇいるたくさんないたよ？

fields.EN: It's true. I heard it three times now.
fields.JP: たしかにもう三回はないた気がするわね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's true. I heard it three times now.

fields.EN: It's worth trying... Once we determine that part has regenerated, let's get out of here immediately.
fields.JP:
試してみる価値はありそうね……。
部位が回復したと判断したらすぐ逃げましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could be worth investigating. Once we break
the core, let's dash.

fields.JP: ハメルンちゃん……行っていいみたい？

fields.EN:
I don't get it. Whatever.
Unleash upon the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
なにか解せぬが、まぁ良い
この怒りナイトメアにぶつけるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't get it. Whatever.
Unleash upon the Nightmare!

fields.JP:
はっはっはっ！
破壊はできたぞ！

……っ！
でも、すごいおこってる！
シラさん、大丈夫っすか？
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: I-it's nothing! Get on with it!
fields.JP:
な、なんでもないわ！
それじゃいくわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I-it's nothing! Get on with it!

fields.EN:
They're no match for Shira, but... Shira will
burn them to ashes with everything she's got!
fields.JP:
シラの敵じゃないけど……
全力で燃やし尽くしてあげる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't my enemy, but that won't stop me
from charring it to a crisp!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
あはっ！
シラの敵じゃなかったわね！

fields.EN:
Sweet moves back there, Shira!
Happy I'm on your team!
fields.JP:
シラつよかったよ！
シラとのれんけいたのしい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sweet moves back there, Pi!
Happy I'm on your team!

fields.EN:
O-Obviously! Shira is the one matching you
properly!
fields.JP:
シ、シラがうまく合わせてるんだから
当然でしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-Obviously it's because I'm adapting
with your squad!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(Shira-san seems to have gotten back in form through
fighting... I knew Shira-san wouldn't betray us!)
fields.JP:
（シラさん戦いを通じて、調子が戻ってきたっすね……
　やっぱりシラさんは裏切ったりしないっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi's back to her usual self.
I knew she wouldn't turn on us!)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Seems like someone else destroyed the
core again. How do we keep missing each
other...?
fields.JP:
また誰かが核を破壊したのは間違いないわね
ただなぜこうまで鉢合わせないのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like someone else destroyed the
core again. How do we keep missing each
other...?

fields.EN:
I have the power of a thousand demons inside
me! There is no soul alive who can take me!
fields.JP:
しかし我の力がどんどん強くなっていくのが
わかるぞ！　もはや敵なしなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have the power of a thousand demons inside
me! There is no soul alive who can take me!

fields.EN: Don't jinx it. We still need to be careful!
fields.JP: 調子に乗りすぎないで慎重に行くっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't jinx it. We still need to be careful!

fields.JP: むむぅ、小娘も言うようになったの

fields.EN:
It just means I'm that worried about you,
Hameln-san!
fields.JP:
それだけハーメルンさんを
心配してるってことっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well excuse me for worrying about you!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: It sounds nice when you put it like that...
fields.JP: そう言われると悪い気はせぬが……
fields.LOCALIZED: It sounds nice when you put it like that...

fields.EN:
(Gretel-san's got a point there. I don't know why.
I don't know how, but I know Boss is nearby!)
fields.JP:
（今のグレーテルさんの言葉を聞くとなんでか
　わからないっすけど……わからないっすけど、
　師匠たちが近くにいる気がするっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel's got a point there. I don't know why.
I don't know how, but I know Boss is nearby!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: There, I see the orb! All according to plan.
fields.JP:
あ、また新しい移動装置を見つけたっす！
別の監獄塔へまた移動できるっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: There, I see the orb! All according to plan.

fields.EN: I'll see where it leads... YAH!
fields.JP:
どこに繋がってるか、
早速我が試してみるのだ。
とぅっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll see where it leads... YAH!

fields.JP: あっ、ハーメルンさん、待って下さいっす！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: This Jail feels way creepier than the others...
fields.JP:
なんだか、いつも以上に薄気味悪い
感じがする監獄塔っすね
fields.LOCALIZED: This Jail feels way creepier than the others...

fields.JP: あっ、ここからそとがみられるよー！

fields.EN:
None of the other towers had windows!
Let's see.
fields.JP:
あら、他の監獄塔に窓はなかったのにね。
とりあえず、外を確認してみましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of the other towers had windows!
Let's see.

fields.EN:
Wait...! There's something different about this
tower.
fields.JP:
……これは！
他の監獄塔とは明らかに違う造りのようね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait...! There's something different about this
tower.

fields.EN: Huh? Hold on. Are we floating?
fields.JP:
えっ、な、なんすかこれ？
もしかして、監獄塔が浮いてるんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Hold on. Are we floating?

fields.EN: Wow. We're in the air. Do my eyes deceive me?
fields.JP:
ぬぅっ、宙に浮くとは
なんとも奇妙な監獄塔なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. We're in the air. Do my eyes deceive me?

fields.EN: I see. You know where you are now, don't you?
fields.JP:
そう。ここにはあなたの
“パパ”がいるのね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. You know where you are now, don't you?

fields.EN:
(Shira-san just said 'Papa.' So the leader of
Genocide Pink is in this Jail Tower.)
fields.JP:
（今、シラさんが“パパ”って。
　つまりこの監獄塔には処刑台少女の
　親玉がいるってことっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi just mentioned her Papa.
That means Massacre Pink's leader is here.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Do you think this is the big one...?
The Devouring Armada Tower?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ひょっとしてここが、
前に聞いた『悪食の監隊塔』……
と呼ばれるところっすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you think this is the big one...?
The Devouring Armada Tower?

fields.JP: そういうことになるでしょうね

fields.EN:
(Then we're in the enemy fortress.
This is what it's all come to.)
fields.JP:
（ついに敵の本拠地まで来たっす。
　ここが自分たちの一つの終着点に
　なる気がするっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then we're in the enemy fortress.
This is what it's all come to.)

fields.EN:
It's about time we made our entrance!
Grrr. I grow tired of waiting!
fields.JP:
ついに辿り着いたというやつだな！
うぬぬっ、なんだか気が逸るのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's about time we made our entrance!
Grrr. I grow tired of waiting!

fields.EN: Yup! Rapunzel's heart is pounding really hard too!
fields.JP:
うんっ、ラプンツェルも
すっごくどきどきしてる！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
……ん。でも、一度戻らないと。
カエデ達が、待ってる……

fields.EN:
Right. We shouldn't get ahead of ourselves.
Let's head to camp for a debrief.
fields.JP:
そうね、このまま進むのは得策ではないわ。
準備を整えるためにも、
一度キャンプ地へ戻りましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We shouldn't get ahead of ourselves.
Let's head to camp for a debrief.

fields.EN: Ugh... I just can't get comfy.
fields.JP: うー……今日は何だか眠れないすねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh... I just can't get comfy.

fields.EN:
(Back at camp, we got Kaede-san and the others
up to speed.)
fields.JP:
（あの後、カエデさん達に
　今日の探索結果を話したっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Back at camp, we got Kaede and the others
up to speed.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
(Including the news about the transmitter
possibly indicating that our friends were
still safe somewhere out there.)
fields.JP:
（トランシーバーがどこかの誰かと繋がった
　話もしたら、仲間がいる可能性が高いって
　みんなも喜んでいたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Including the news about the transmitter
possibly indicating that our friends were
still safe somewhere out there.)

fields.EN:
(Thankfully that raised their spirits, since
we also told them about the scary tower
where Genocide Pink's leader was.)
fields.JP:
（処刑台少女の親玉がいる『悪食の監隊塔』に
　移動するのを躊躇うかもって思ったっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thankfully that raised their spirits, since
we also told them about the scary tower
where Massacre Pink's leader was.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(In the end, they comforted me with laughter,
insisting they had no choice but to follow us.)
fields.JP:
（最後は結局、ここまでずっと一緒に来たし、
　自分達について行くしかないって、
　笑いながら言ってくれたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the end, they comforted me with laughter,
insisting they had no choice but to follow us.)

fields.EN: (How lucky are we to have Kaede-san and Itsuki-san.)
fields.JP:
（カエデさんやイツキさん達の
　懐の広さにはいつも救わるっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (How lucky are we to have Kaede and Itsuki.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: イツキさん => Itsuki-san; カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
I feel wired, but I should try to sleep.
Tomorrow we set out for the Devouring
Armada Tower!
fields.JP:
なかなか寝付けないけど、しっかり寝て
明日は『悪食の監隊塔』に
拠点を移す作業をするっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel wired, but I should try to sleep.
Tomorrow we set out for the Devouring
Armada Tower!

fields.EN: I know why I can't get to sleep... In the end, I couldn't tell anyone about what happened this afternoon.
fields.JP:
寝付けない原因は分かってるっす。
……結局、昼間のあのことは、
誰にも言えなかったっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know why I'm having trouble...
I can't shake what I heard this afternoon.

fields.EN:
With that said, kill them all in their sleep
tonight. Do I make myself clear?
fields.JP:
ってことでぇ、今夜にでもあいつらを
裏切って、全員殺っちゃいなさい。
これ、決定事項ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that said, kill them all in their sleep
tonight. Do I make myself clear?

fields.EN:
Besides, I bet Papa would be real impressed
if you managed to kill them all♪
You wanna prove yourself, don't you?
fields.JP:
それに、あいつら全員をあんたが殺せば、
パパはきっと見直してくれるでしょーね♪
晴れて一人前になれるし、イイ話じゃなーい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I bet Papa would be real impressed
if you managed to kill them all♪
You wanna prove yourself, don't you?

fields.EN: N...No... I don't wanna kill them.
fields.JP:
い……いやだ……
殺したく……ない
fields.LOCALIZED: N...No... I don't wanna kill them.

fields.EN:
Even if her older sister ordered her to, Shira-san
wouldn't do something like that.
fields.JP:
いくらお姉さんの命令でも、
シラさんは……そんなことしないはずっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if her sister gave the order,
Pi wouldn't do that.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: (Oh. Sounds like someone else is awake.)
fields.JP:
（あれ、こんな時間に、
　他にも誰か起きてたっすか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh. Sounds like someone else is awake.)

fields.JP:
（また、首吊り台が出たっすっ！！
　マズイっす、隠れないとっ！）

fields.EN: (What is she doing here? Who let her in?!)
fields.JP:
（な、な、なんであの人がここに……！
　キャンプ地にまで来たんすかっ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What is she doing here? Who let her in?!)

fields.EN:
(Oh no. This is awful. Please tell me I'm
making this up. Gotta take one more look.)
fields.JP:
（ああっ、こ、怖いっす。
　どうか自分の見間違いであって欲しいっす。
　ゆ、勇気を出して、もう一度確認を……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no. This is awful. Please tell me I'm
making this up. Gotta take one more look.)

fields.EN:
(Huh, Shira-san? Does that mean I mistook whoever I
saw earlier for Shira-san? No, but I know what I
saw...)
fields.JP:
（あれっ、シラさん？　さっきのは、
　シラさんと見間違えたってことっすか？
　いや、でも、この目で確かに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi...? Is that who I actually saw...?
I saw them with my own eyes.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(There's no way I'd mistake that terrifying Kubitsuridai
for our companion Shira-san.)
fields.JP:
（あの自分を恐ろしい目に遭わせた
　首吊り台と、仲間のシラさんを
　見間違えるはずがないっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's no way I wouldn't recognize
someone who tried to kill me.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10). | Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.

fields.EN:
(Does that mean Kubitsuridai is hiding around
somewhere here? What do I do? Should I
tell everyone?)
fields.JP:
（も、もしかして、どこかに
　首吊り台が隠れてるっすか？
　どうしよう、みんなを呼ぶべきっすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does that mean Gallows is hiding around
somewhere here? What do I do? Should I
tell everyone?)

fields.EN:
Hmm-mmm-mmm♪
Dinner tonight is canned stew♪
fields.JP:
ふんふんふーん♪
今日のご飯は缶詰ドバドバごった煮シチュ～♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm-mmm-mmm♪
Dinner tonight is canned stew♪

fields.JP:
あ、みなさんお帰りなさい――
ってそんな怖い顔してどうしたんですか？

fields.EN:
Sorry to do this to you, but it's about to get
real rowdy right now. Some serious business.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、ちょっと
騒がしくなるかもしれないけど、
見過ごせないことだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to do this to you, but it's about to get
real rowdy right now. Some serious business.

fields.JP:
みみ、見てはいけないものだったんですね。
失礼しました……！

fields.EN: I'll explain... Please, just let me go!
fields.JP: 説明はする……だから離してくれっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll explain... Please, just let me go!

fields.JP: 別に拘束するつもりはないさ

fields.EN:
You had contact with the outside this whole
time. What's up with that?!
fields.JP:
おいお前、外に連絡する手段を
持っていたのに、何故黙っていた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You had contact with the outside this whole
time. What's up with that?!

fields.EN:
I heard what you said.
You maintain contact with Snark, correct?
fields.JP:
お前は確かに『スナーク生きてるか』と言った。
つまりスナークと連絡することができた、
ということだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard what you said.
You maintain contact with Snark, correct?

fields.EN:
Sorry, but this won't slide.
As of now, you're our prisoner.
Just to start.
fields.JP:
悪いがこれは見過ごすことはできない。
事と次第によっては、お前を拘束――
いや、もっと踏み込んだ手段に訴えるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, but this won't slide.
As of now, you're our prisoner.
Just to start.

fields.EN: Sorry! Hear me out. I had to give it a shot!
fields.JP:
すまなかった……！　ダメだとは分かっていても、
私はどうしても試したかったのだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry! Hear me out. I had to give it a shot!

fields.EN:
When Genocide Pink raised the possibility
of my brother living, I couldn't let it go.
fields.JP:
以前、スナーク……兄が生きていると
処刑台少女が口にしたと、
君たちから聞いただろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Massacre Pink raised the possibility
of my brother living, I couldn't let it go.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
I had to know for certain if it was true.
It can't be, given the circumstances.
But I needed certainty.
fields.JP:
正直、真偽のほども定かではない。
むしろ状況から鑑みても疑わしい。
だが、どうしても無視できなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had to know for certain if it was true.
It can't be, given the circumstances.
But I needed certainty.

fields.EN: My brother—Snark—is the only family I have.
fields.JP:
兄さん……スナークは、私にとって
たったひとりの肉親なのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: My brother—Snark—is the only family I have.

fields.EN:
Regardless, you had the means to contact
him all along.
fields.JP:
それはつまり、ずっとスナークとの
連絡手段があったということになるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, you had the means to contact
him all along.

fields.EN:
You see, my brother and I corresponded
regularly while he was in the underground
Jail.
fields.JP:
実は以前から、地下監獄にいる兄とは
密かに連絡を取り合っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see, my brother and I corresponded
regularly while he was in the underground
Jail.

fields.EN:
So you and Snark were affiliated this whole
time?
fields.JP:
じゃあ以前からあなたは、
スナークと繋がっていた……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you and Snark were affiliated this whole
time?

fields.EN:
Y-yes, but please listen! Not once did I think
my brother would commit those atrocities.
fields.JP:
そ、そうだが、でも信じてほしい！
兄があんなことをするなんて知らなかったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Y-yes, but please listen! Not once did I think
my brother would commit those atrocities.

fields.EN:
We exchanged information regarding the
statuses of the surface and underground.
fields.JP:
連絡の内容は主に、地上と地下の状況について、
ジェイル研究の共有……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We exchanged information regarding the
statuses of the surface and underground.

fields.EN:
We collaborated our research for the purpose
of restoring Earth's balance. I never intended
any harm!
fields.JP:
そして私たちが地球と
共存していく方法についてだ。
誓って地球に破滅をもたらす類いのものではない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We collaborated our research for the purpose
of restoring Earth's balance. I never intended
any harm!

fields.EN: You expect us to believe that?
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこと言われても
信じられませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You expect us to believe that?

fields.EN: It's true. Over the comms, we only shared information with each other that could help this world!
fields.JP:
本当なんだ。
通信ではこの世界のためになる情報を
互いに共有しただけだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I swear. Our aim was always to help.
That was the extent of our conversations.

fields.EN: I see. Explains that feeling I had.
fields.JP: そうか……お前に抱いていた違和感の正体はこれか
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Explains that feeling I had.

fields.EN:
I knew something was off. People on the
surface call Marchens "contaminated."
But you knew underground nomenclature.
fields.JP:
おかしいと思っていたんだ。
地上の人間はメルヒェンを汚染動物と呼ぶのに、
お前は何故か地下監獄の共用語で話していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew something was off. People on the
surface call Marchens "contaminated."
But you knew underground nomenclature.

fields.EN:
You even knew Snark's underground name.
Professor Tohjima.
fields.JP:
それに地下に来てからスナークが名乗っていた、
「十島博士」という名前も知っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You even knew Snark's underground name.
Professor Tohjima.

fields.EN:
It was all in the open. Information made
known only to his associates.
fields.JP:
どれも、地下のスナークと
繋がっていればこそ、知り得た話ですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was all in the open. Information made
known only to his associates.

fields.EN:
I beg you to forgive my omission.
We were beginning to trust each other.
I was waiting for the right time to tell you.
fields.JP:
黙っていたことは、本当に申し訳なかった……
君たちとの信頼を築き上げてから、
話そうと思っていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I beg you to forgive my omission.
We were beginning to trust each other.
I was waiting for the right time to tell you.

fields.EN:
Had I fully disclosed my past relationship
with him, I knew you would have been less
willing to build that bridge.
fields.JP:
君たちが黒幕と思っていた人物と、
私が連絡を取り合う方法を持っていたと分かれば、
関係性を築くなどできないと思ったからだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Had I fully disclosed my past relationship
with him, I knew you would have been less
willing to build that bridge.

fields.EN:
Nevertheless, you attempted contact while
trying to gain our confidence. Did it work?
fields.JP:
……それで、僕たちの信頼を得る前に
隠れて行ったさっきの通信、繋がったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nevertheless, you attempted contact while
trying to gain our confidence. Did it work?

fields.EN:
No. No response. Chances seem low Snark's
still alive.
fields.JP:
いや……返答はなかった。
やはりスナークが生きている可能性は低いだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. No response. Chances seem low Snark's
still alive.

fields.EN:
And you think we're gonna believe
that, do you?
fields.JP:
それを僕たちがすんなり信じるとは、
思ってないよな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you think we're gonna believe
that, do you?

fields.EN:
So what's your endgame? What are you
and Snark conspiring about now?
Total planetary control?
fields.JP:
お前たちの目的は、結局何なんだ。
スナークと組んでいったい何をしたかったんだ？
まさかこの星の支配か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So what's your endgame? What are you
and Snark conspiring about now?
Total planetary control?

fields.EN:
Don't be preposterous. As I told you, our
work was focused on making the planet
more livable in the long term.
fields.JP:
そんなことは本当に考えていない……
さっきも言ったが、地上にいた私たちは、
本当にこの星の人間との共存を目指していたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be preposterous. As I told you, our
work was focused on making the planet
more livable in the long term.

fields.EN:
You hide your connection to Snark and then
think we'll take your word for everything
else.
fields.JP:
スナークとの繋がりを隠していては、
それも疑わしいものだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You hide your connection to Snark and then
think we'll take your word for everything
else.

fields.EN:
Hang on. While it's true that Jabberwock
deceived us about making contact...
fields.JP:
待て、お前ら。俺もジャバウォックとスナークが
連絡を取り合っていることは知らなかったが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hang on. While it's true that Jabberwock
deceived us about making contact...

fields.EN:
I know for a fact he was not involved in the
original Jail plans. His name never came up.
fields.JP:
そいつは少なくとも、
地下監獄の計画を始めた時、確かにいなかった。
名前だって上がってもいない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know for a fact he was not involved in the
original Jail plans. His name never came up.

fields.EN:
I knew that project inside and out, and still
its true purpose was kept from me.
For that reason, I believe Jabberwock.
fields.JP:
元々計画を知っていた俺が知らなかった、
ということは、ジャバウォックが地下監獄の件を
知らなかったということは事実だと思うぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew that project inside and out, and still
its true purpose was kept from me.
For that reason, I believe Jabberwock.

fields.EN: Are you in on this too, Haru?
fields.JP: ハル。まさかお前もグルなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you in on this too, Haru?

fields.EN: Come on. You think it's a conspiracy?
fields.JP: おいおい、俺まで疑うのかよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Come on. You think it's a conspiracy?

fields.EN:
Haru-san sided with us when we cornered
Profess—I mean, Snark.
fields.JP:
ハルさんは白雪たちが博士……
スナークを追いつめる時に、
こちらの味方をしてくれました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru sided with us when we cornered
Profess—I mean, Snark.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP:
ハルさんはスナークを
止めようとしてくれたんです
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Plus it's hard to believe Snark planned
for us to kill him after fusing with Jail.
fields.JP:
それにスナークも、さすがに自ら監獄塔と
なった上でわらわたちに殺される――
そこまでが計画だったというのは無理があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plus it's hard to believe Snark planned
for us to kill him after fusing with Jail.

fields.EN:
That battle was a frenzy. End to end stuff.
No way that went to plan for him.
fields.JP:
実際にあれは死闘でしたし、
結果がどっちに転んでもおかしくなかった。
筋書きなんてあったとは考えられません
fields.LOCALIZED:
That battle was a frenzy. End to end stuff.
No way that went to plan for him.

fields.EN:
Neither of them had enough time to plot
something in the fray. Not Haru nor Snark.
I attest to that.
fields.JP:
あの時のハルもスナークも、
何かを欺けるような状況じゃなかったわね。
そこに関しては、わたしたちが保証するわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Neither of them had enough time to plot
something in the fray. Not Haru nor Snark.
I attest to that.

fields.EN: Right. I'll take your word for it then.
fields.JP:
なるほど。君たちがそう言うのであれば、
それは真実なんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I'll take your word for it then.

fields.EN:
*sigh*... Very well. I concede that you may
not be conspiring with Snark.
fields.JP:
はぁ……仕方ない。
スナークの計画を知らなかった、
という点については認めよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... Very well. I concede that you may
not be conspiring with Snark.

fields.EN:
But that doesn't mean we trust you.
Jabberwock, Kadowaki has been assigned
to watch over you at all times.
fields.JP:
だが、まだお前を信用したわけじゃない。
そうだな――ジャバウォック、お前は
これから門脇と常に一緒にいろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that doesn't mean we trust you.
Jabberwock, Kadowaki has been assigned
to watch over you at all times.

fields.EN: Who, me? Aw, give me a break.
fields.JP:
え、オレ？
冗談じゃない、勘弁してくれよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Who, me? Aw, give me a break.

fields.EN:
If you don't want to cooperate, then you're
welcome to join him. One less mouth to feed.
fields.JP:
お前はまだ僕たちも含めて、疑惑を抱いている。
ならそいつと一緒にいればその分、
疑う人数が減らせていいだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't want to cooperate, then you're
welcome to join him. One less mouth to feed.

fields.EN:
*sigh* Fine, I'll do it. As the only human
around here, I guess I'll do it since I go
way back with the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
はぁ……仕方ないなあ、分かったよ。
みんな人間じゃないけどさ、なんだかんだいって
ここの女の子たちとはつきあい長いしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Fine, I'll do it. As the only human
around here, I guess I'll do it since I go
way back with the Blood Maidens.

fields.JP: わわ、わたくしは血式少女ではないですよ～

fields.EN: Kunai, you didn't have to come with us.
fields.JP: クナイ、無理して出てこなくてもいいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Kunai, you didn't have to come with us.

fields.JP: ともあれこれで、ひとまず解決よね

fields.EN:
Thank you all for believing me.
I vow never to betray your trust again.
fields.JP:
皆、私の話を信じてくれてありがとう。
もう誤解させるようなことはしないと誓うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you all for believing me.
I vow never to betray your trust again.

fields.EN:
Hmph. Better not. Any more slip-ups,
and it becomes non-negotiable.
fields.JP:
ふん、当たり前だ。
次に疑わしい行動をしたら、許さないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. Better not. Any more slip-ups,
and it becomes non-negotiable.

fields.EN: Ah, yes. One more thing I wanted to ask.
fields.JP:
ああ、そうだ。
お前にまだ聞くべきことがあった
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, yes. One more thing I wanted to ask.

fields.EN:
Who is this "Hauteharolde" you called
with the transmitter?
fields.JP:
さっきの通信で言っていた
『ハウテハロデ』とはいったい何だ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who is this "Hauteharolde" you called
with the transmitter?

fields.EN: Snark's true name in our other tongue.
fields.JP: それは私たちの星での、スナークの本名だ
fields.LOCALIZED: Snark's true name in our other tongue.

fields.EN:
Professor. Snark. Hauteharolde...
How many names can one man have?
fields.JP:
博士、スナーク、ハウテハロデ……
いちいち呼び名の多い奴だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Professor. Snark. Hauteharolde...
How many names can one man have?

fields.JP: お父さん……ハウテハロデっていうんだ……

fields.EN:
He changed his name upon arriving here.
But to me, he is Hauteharolde.
fields.JP:
この星に来てからは名前を変えてしまったが、
私がいちばん慣れ親しんだ呼び方だったのでね
fields.LOCALIZED:
He changed his name upon arriving here.
But to me, he is Hauteharolde.

fields.EN:
Are there any more of you on this planet?
You referred to an "us" earlier.
fields.JP:
そういえばこの星に来た同胞は、
お前やハル以外にもいるのか？
さっき『地上にいた私たち』と言っていたが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are there any more of you on this planet?
You referred to an "us" earlier.

fields.EN:
There's one other on this little rock who
comes from our planet.
fields.JP:
いや、地上で共にいたのは、
私たちの星の人間ではないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's one other on this little rock who
comes from our planet.

fields.EN:
He was a curious, but kind lad.
In his early twenties, if I recall.
He assisted us with our research.
fields.JP:
非常に知性が高く、人柄もいい青年でね。
彼は二十代前半くらいだったろうか……
一緒に研究に協力してくれていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
He was a curious, but kind lad.
In his early twenties, if I recall.
He assisted us with our research.

fields.EN:
But when the Devouring Armada Tower
arrived, I lost contact.
fields.JP:
だが彼とは、あの悪食の監隊塔が
大きく動いた時にはぐれてしまってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when the Devouring Armada Tower
arrived, I lost contact.

fields.EN: (I guess he wanted nothing to do with this.)
fields.JP: （さすがにそいつは関係がなさそうだな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I guess he wanted nothing to do with this.)

fields.EN:
(For some reason, Hauteharolde sounds
so familiar...)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、ハウテハロデ……
　どこか聞き覚えがある名前だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(For some reason, Hauteharolde sounds
so familiar...)

fields.EN:
(Our heated discussion reduced to a simmer,
and we broke down our camp together.)
fields.JP:
（ジャバウォックの疑惑の件もひとまず落ちつき、
　僕たちはまたキャンプ地を移動させた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Our heated discussion reduced to a simmer,
and we broke down our camp together.)

fields.EN: (Allegedly, the next Jail is called Salvation.)
fields.JP:
（次は『救済の監獄塔』と言うらしい。
　なんだか大仰な名前だとも思う）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Allegedly, the next Jail is called Salvation.)

fields.EN:
(I'm disappointed we have yet to find the
big tower, though in due time we shall.)
fields.JP:
（残念なことに次は悪食の監隊塔、
　ということにはならなかったが、
　きっともうすぐ辿り着くに違いない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm disappointed we have yet to find the
big tower, though in due time we shall.)

fields.EN:
(Our crew must stay alert and focus on
the task ahead.)
fields.JP:
（僕たちはさらに気を引きしめて、
　目の前の監獄塔の探索へと
　臨むことを互いに誓い合った）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Our crew must stay alert and focus on
the task ahead.)

fields.JP:
ああ。かぐや姫の準備ができ次第、
といったところだ

fields.EN:
Oh... Once she's in the tent, good luck
getting her out.
fields.JP:
あー……あいつ、
一度テントに入るとアレだもんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... Once she's in the tent, good luck
getting her out.

fields.EN:
Right. How nice for her that her secluded nap 
times correspond with our departure times.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ。
特に今回のように新しい監獄塔に来ると、
引きこもりたがる傾向にあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. How nice for her that her secluded nap 
times correspond with our departure times.

fields.EN:
We're starting from square one in this tower.
Let her sleep, she's done plenty.
fields.JP:
また一から探索だからな。
でもまあ、あいつ頑張ってる方だと思うぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're starting from square one in this tower.
Let her sleep, she's done plenty.

fields.EN:
Yes. A team member like her is only useful
when she's rested.
fields.JP:
色々と助けられてることは認めよう。
とはいえ、それとこれとは別の問題だが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. A team member like her is only useful
when she's rested.

fields.EN:
By the way, I've been meaning to ask you
why you have the Mary Gun?
fields.JP:
そういえば今まで気になってたんだけどよ、
お前、何でメアリガン持ってんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, I've been meaning to ask you
why you have the Mary Gun?

fields.EN:
I think I mentioned this before... When I woke up
with no memories, I already had it.
fields.JP:
それは以前に話した気もするが……
記憶を失った僕が目覚めた時には、
すでに持っていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I wish I could tell you. Woke up with it.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
I might have told this to you before, but
there's only two people who could have
made that. Me and my apprentice.
fields.JP:
俺も前に言った気がするけどよ、
そのメアリガンを作れるヤツは恐らく俺だけ……
他にいるとしても、俺の弟子くらいのもんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I might have told this to you before, but
there's only two people who could have
made that. Me and my apprentice.

fields.EN:
I swear I have no idea. I have neither the
tools nor the craftsmanship to assemble one.
fields.JP:
僕は自分で作った覚えはない。
こういったものを作れるスキルもなければ、
設計図だって頭の中にないしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I swear I have no idea. I have neither the
tools nor the craftsmanship to assemble one.

fields.EN:
Maybe that apprentice of yours made it
behind your back.
fields.JP:
きっとその弟子とやらが、
内緒で作って僕に渡したんじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that apprentice of yours made it
behind your back.

fields.EN:
There's no way for me to know, but
believe me when I tell you otherwise.
fields.JP:
はっきりと違うとは言いきれないが、
あいつの性格上、それはないと思うんだよな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no way for me to know, but
believe me when I tell you otherwise.

fields.EN:
Look. If what you said is true, if it wasn't
you, then it has to be your apprentice.
fields.JP:
だが僕は、こうしてメアリガンを持っている。
ハルが作ったのではないのなら、
弟子しかいないじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look. If what you said is true, if it wasn't
you, then it has to be your apprentice.

fields.EN:
It's no simple process of elimination.
Something is amiss.
fields.JP:
消去法でいけばそうなるんだがよ、
断定するには釈然としないっつーか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's no simple process of elimination.
Something is amiss.

fields.EN:
How did she come to learn that you are
a Blood Youth? No way would she keep
that secret from me.
fields.JP:
何より、お前にメアリガンを渡したっていうなら、
お前が血式少年だって知ってたことになる。
それを報告しないなんて、まずあり得ないしな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did she come to learn that you are
a Blood Youth? No way would she keep
that secret from me.

fields.EN:
Besides, you would have no way of knowing
you're a Blood Youth without coming into
contact with a Blood Maiden.
fields.JP:
それに、黎明で血液検査をするか、
誰か血式少女に血でも浴びせないと、
血式少年だって分かりようがない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, you would have no way of knowing
you're a Blood Youth without coming into
contact with a Blood Maiden.

fields.EN:
If you knew Miko or the Blood Maidens all
along, why didn't you just say so?
fields.JP:
視子や血式少女の誰かが
お前と知り合いだったとして、
ひた隠す意味なんてないだろうしな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you knew Miko or the Blood Maidens all
along, why didn't you just say so?

fields.JP: ハル、お前は何が言いたいんだ

fields.EN: ...I'm just saying. It looks funny to me.
fields.JP: ……いや、ちょっと気になっただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED: ...I'm just saying. It looks funny to me.

fields.EN:
Without my memory, I can't convince you
of anything. It's pointless to debate.
fields.JP:
僕の過去については、
どう探ろうとしても記憶がない以上、
分かりようがないことは理解できるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Without my memory, I can't convince you
of anything. It's pointless to debate.

fields.EN: Sure, I hear you. But still... Never mind.
fields.JP:
まあそうなんだよな。
それは分かってるんだが……
いや、何でもない
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, I hear you. But still... Never mind.

fields.EN: Then let's set out. Kaguyahime looks rested.
fields.JP:
なら僕はもう探索に行くぞ。
かぐや姫も準備が終わったみたいだしな
fields.LOCALIZED: Then let's set out. Kaguya looks rested.

fields.EN:
Got it. We'll save it for later.
Good luck out there.
fields.JP: ああ、引き止めて悪かった。気をつけてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. We'll save it for later.
Good luck out there.

fields.EN:
This is the tallest tower yet. Salvation.
Yeah, right.
fields.JP:
どんどん進むのが大変になってくるなあ……
どこが救済だっての
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is the tallest tower yet. Salvation.
Yeah, right.

fields.EN:
I heard from Jabberwock that surface
dwellers named it. What were they thinking?
fields.JP:
ジャバウォックが、地上の人々が
つけた名前だって言ってましたけど、
何を思ってつけたんですかねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard from Jabberwock that surface
dwellers named it. What were they thinking?

fields.EN:
Perhaps they traded their lack of entry for
a symbol. A monument for those who could
not enter.
fields.JP:
中に入った人間は生きていないだろうから、
外から見た奴らが、何かを感じてつけたんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps they traded their lack of entry for
a symbol. A monument for those who could
not enter.

fields.EN: Ugh. He loves the sound of his own voice...
fields.JP: またあんたはそういうことを言う……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. He loves the sound of his own voice...

fields.JP: ん、こっちの方に核があるな

fields.EN:
I commend your instinct, Juu-san.
Your ability to navigate Jail towers is
second to none.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんのその監獄塔を
把握しちゃう感じは、改めて考えると
すごく特殊なスキルですよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I commend your instinct, Toh.
Your ability to navigate Jail towers is
second to none.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: I have to agree with you.
fields.JP: 言われてみればそうかも
fields.LOCALIZED: I have to agree with you.

fields.EN:
Jack's gotten pretty good at it too,
but nothing compared to Juu.
fields.JP:
確かジャックも
そういう感じのスキルがあったけど、
ジュウほどじゃないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's gotten pretty good at it too,
but nothing compared to Toh.

fields.JP: （僕はそんなに異質な存在なのか？）

fields.EN: (In the end, I still am a stranger to myself.)
fields.JP:
（結局、いまだに
　自分が何者なのか分かっていないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (In the end, I still am a stranger to myself.)

fields.EN:
Apart from being a Blood Youth, there's
little else we know about Juu-san.
fields.JP:
そういえばジュウさんって、
血式少年というわりには何の童話か
分からないですわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Apart from being a Blood Youth, there's
little else we know about Toh.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
You're right. Maybe we can connect the dots
somehow.
fields.JP:
ああ、確かに。
何か連想できるものってあったっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right. Maybe we can connect the dots
somehow.

fields.JP: パッとは出てこないわね

fields.EN:
(If I really am a Blood Youth from underground,
it must mean I'm connected to a fairy tale.)
fields.JP:
（そうか、地下監獄で生まれた血式少年であれば、
　何かの童話が元にあると考えるのが当然なんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If I really am a Blood Youth from underground,
it must mean I'm connected to a fairy tale.)

fields.JP:
（だが自分でもすぐに
　思い当たる童話は出てこない……）

fields.EN:
Juu's odd, that's for sure. He doesn't even
care about anything other than his wife.
fields.JP:
でもさ、そんな自分よりも奥さんの方が優先って、
やっぱりジュウって変わってるよねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh's odd, that's for sure. He doesn't even
care about anything other than his wife.

fields.EN:
To put your beloved before your own
memories. How romantic.
fields.JP:
自分の記憶よりも愛する人が大事……
素敵じゃありませんの
fields.LOCALIZED:
To put your beloved before your own
memories. How romantic.

fields.EN:
Don't give Juu-san too much credit.
He doesn't know what he doesn't know.
Guy's got amnesia.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんの場合は、
自分をなげうってでもというよりは、
記憶に価値を見出してないだけな気がします～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't give Toh too much credit.
He doesn't know what he doesn't know.
Guy's got amnesia.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
(She's got a point. I couldn't care less
about my memories if I can find my wife
without them.)
fields.JP:
（確かに僕は、
　妻さえいれば自分の記憶など
　どうでもいいと思っていた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's got a point. I couldn't care less
about my memories if I can find my wife
without them.)

fields.EN:
(But I possess the key to finding her within
me, and I mustn't hinder myself.)
fields.JP:
（だがそもそも僕の存在が
　周りに比べて異質だというのであれば、
　僕自身が、妻に至るヒントになるんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I possess the key to finding her within
me, and I mustn't hinder myself.)

fields.EN:
(Without anything to go off of, or anyone
who I can call a friend, I don't know where
to start.)
fields.JP:
（ただ僕はほとんどの記憶をなくしている。
　さらには僕を知っている人間もいない。
　手がかりは皆無と言っていい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Without anything to go off of, or anyone
who I can call a friend, I don't know where
to start.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I should dig deeper into whomever
I was below the surface.)
fields.JP:
（こんなことなら、地下で目覚めた時に
　もっと自分について探っておくべきだったな。
　まあ、今さら悔やんでも仕方ないことだが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I should dig deeper into whomever
I was below the surface.)

fields.EN: Hey, do any of you know anything about me?
fields.JP:
なあ、君たちの仲間で、
僕を知ってそうな奴はいるか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, do any of you know anything about me?

fields.EN:
I don't. If they knew there was another Blood
Youth, I'm certain they would have told us.
fields.JP:
どうでしょうか。
少なくとも血式少年の知り合いがいたら、
白雪たちにも知らされていたとは思いますが
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't. If they knew there was another Blood
Youth, I'm certain they would have told us.

fields.EN:
I suppose it's possible we met before,
but I don't recall ever meeting someone
with a Mary Gun.
fields.JP:
血式少年って知らずに
ジュウと知り合ってる可能性もなくはないけど、
メアリガン持ってたらすぐ分かりそうなものよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose it's possible we met before,
but I don't recall ever meeting someone
with a Mary Gun.

fields.EN:
Maybe Jack might know? They're both
Blood Youths. They can relate.
fields.JP:
いちばん可能性があるのはジャックじゃない？
同じ血式少年だし、雰囲気も何か似てるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe Jack might know? They're both
Blood Youths. They can relate.

fields.JP:
（その辺りも何か関係があるんだろうか。
　とはいえ、そのジャックに会えないんじゃ
　どうしようもないことだな）

fields.EN: (Come to think of it, I don't understand this memory that says I'm a Jail Tower either. Am I some part of a Jail Tower...?)
fields.JP:
（そういえば自分が監獄塔である、
　というこの記憶も、意味が分からない。
　僕は監獄塔の何かなんだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(On top of everything, I know I was once a Jail.
That's nonsense. How could I be a Jail?)

fields.EN: (For now, my questions will go unanswered.)
fields.JP: （何にせよ、今ここで答えが出ることもない）
fields.LOCALIZED: (For now, my questions will go unanswered.)

fields.JP:
まあいい。
みんな、先へ進もう
よし！　気合いれるよ！
