fields.EN: That's the Aka-nee we know and love.
fields.JP: 最近赤姉様の元気が戻って来て嬉しいですね
fields.LOCALIZED: That's the Red we know and love.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
You can say that again. Akazukin-san
is our beacon for us all.
fields.JP:
ほんとそうですわね。
わたくし達の赤ずきんさんは
あーでないといけませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can say that again. Red Riding Hood
is our beacon for us all.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Stay focused. The guardian's right there.
fields.JP:
よそ見をするな
もう核の前には番人がいてこちらを見てるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Stay focused. The guardian's right there.

fields.JP: これまた強そうですね～

fields.EN: Hmph. They're all the same to me.
fields.JP:
ふん、こんなところで
負けるわけにはいかないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph. They're all the same to me.

fields.JP:
みんな！
それじゃいくよ！

倒したわ！
誰も怪我はない？
それはいつものことだと思いますわ……

fields.EN: Sorry. Mind if I take a second?
fields.JP: すまないが、少し離れてしまってもいいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry. Mind if I take a second?

fields.JP: この間のことが気にかかりますもんね

fields.EN:
Honestly that scream hasn't left me.
I want to be as far as humanly possible
from that core.
fields.JP:
正直あの時の恐怖が染みついている。
なるべくなら核破壊時には近くにいたくない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly that scream hasn't left me.
I want to be as far as humanly possible
from that core.

fields.EN:
Wow. You're a coward!
...Actually, I remember how pale you looked
last time. Shirayuki, stay with Juu.
fields.JP:
もう情けないんだから！
……なんて、あれみたら言えないよ
白雪、ジュウに付いて行ってあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. You're a coward!
...Actually, I remember how pale you looked
last time. Snow White, stay with Toh.
fields.notes: source-gated Toh => Juu; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: (It's one of the mysteries about myself, but I still don't feel ready to solve it... I never knew nearly losing consciousness could be this frightening.)
fields.JP:
（自分自身の謎の１つではあるが、
　今はまだ解こうとは思えない……
　意識を失いかける事がここまで怖いとは）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yet another mystery pertaining to me.
And still I'm no closer to an answer.
Losing my consciousness was terrifying.)

fields.EN:
(Regardless, we need to destroy it and
move on.)
fields.JP: （なんにしても破壊したら先へ進もう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Regardless, we need to destroy it and
move on.)

fields.EN: The core's gone. You all ready?
fields.JP:
核はもうない。
準備はできているか？
fields.LOCALIZED: The core's gone. You all ready?

fields.EN: Oh, are we supposed to start charging in now?
fields.JP: あら、戦うかどうか決めないのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, are we supposed to start charging in now?

fields.EN:
Don't deviate from the strategy. So long as
you stick to the plan then I won't worry.
fields.JP:
基本方針を変える予定はない
変える時はその時に相談する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't deviate from the strategy. So long as
you stick to the plan then I won't worry.

fields.JP: 確かに、ジュウらしいわね
ナイトメアが見えてきました！

わたくしは準備万端ですわ！
行きますわよ！

fields.EN: As good as a nap sounds, I'm ready too~
fields.JP: 不本意ながらわらわも完了です～
fields.LOCALIZED: As good as a nap sounds, I'm ready too~

fields.EN: Follow Juu's directions! Stay in formation!
fields.JP:
ジュウの指示を見逃さないようにね！
それじゃ、気合入れて行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Follow Toh's directions! Stay in formation!

fields.JP: 救済の監獄塔ナイトメア
ここから一気に畳みかけていくよ！
はい、白雪も更に集中します！

fields.EN: Don't leave your back open while giving orders.
fields.JP:
集中するのはいいが周りにも
気を配るくらいが良いぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't leave your back open while giving orders.

fields.JP:
わかってるって。
一気に行くよ！

fields.EN: We did it! Victory in perfect harmony!
fields.JP:
やりましたー！
バッチリ連携が決まりましたね！
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it! Victory in perfect harmony!

fields.EN:
Leave it to the original Dawn girls to
show 'em how it's done.
fields.JP: 黎明初期メンバーの強みってやつだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave it to the original Dawn girls to
show 'em how it's done.

fields.JP: それわらわも入るんですか～？

fields.EN:
(I've decided not to rush our exploration in
the interest of morale.)
fields.JP:
（焦らないと決めてはいるが、
　こうまで誰もいないのは不可解だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've decided not to rush our exploration in
the interest of morale.)

fields.EN: (Without any sign of her allies, Akazukin grows more anxious.)
fields.JP:
（そろそろ赤ずきん達が
　不安がりそうな気がするな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Without any sign of her allies, Red Riding
Hood grows more anxious.)

fields.EN: Nemu... If only I could sense her somehow
fields.JP:
ネム……そろそろ痕跡だけでも
出てきてくれないかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED: Sleepy... If only I could sense her somehow

fields.EN: Jack-san, Alice-san... Where ever could they be?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、アリスさん……
皆さん本当にどこにいるんでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, Alice... Where ever could they be?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Juu would laugh if he heard this, but
I can feel their presence. They're not far.
fields.JP:
こんなこと言うとまたジュウに笑われるけどさ、
なんか最近気配を感じるんだ。　みんなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh would laugh if he heard this, but
I can feel their presence. They're not far.

fields.EN:
Juu said someone else is destroying cores.
On top of that, I dunno. Call it a sixth sense.
fields.JP:
前にジュウが何者かが核を破壊してる
って言ってたのもあるし、あとはなんだろう
近くにいる気がするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh said someone else is destroying cores.
On top of that, I dunno. Call it a sixth sense.

fields.JP: はは、ごめん適当すぎたわ

fields.EN: Hehe. You're a funny one, Akazukin.
fields.JP: ふふ、でも赤ずきんらしいとは思います～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You're a funny one, Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
I have no comment. You are free to express
yourself.
fields.JP:
僕はノーコメントだ。
それに言うのは自由だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no comment. You are free to express
yourself.

fields.JP:
相変わらずデリカシーのないコメント
ま、そういうと思ったけど

fields.EN:
(I actually had no quarrel with what she
said...but that's a first.)
fields.JP:
（今ここでの赤ずきんのコメントは
　悪くないと思った……。
　しかし、それを頻繁にいわれても困る）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I actually had no quarrel with what she
said...but that's a first.)

fields.EN:
Regardless, let's hurry up and hit the big
tower so we can see everyone from there!
fields.JP:
なんにしてもさっさと悪食の監隊塔に行って、
みんなを簡単に探せるようにしましょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, let's hurry up and hit the big
tower so we can see everyone from there!

fields.EN: Ah, a sight for sore eyes.
fields.JP: ああ、やっと光る球体に辿り着きました～
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, a sight for sore eyes.

fields.EN: Cool! That's our ticket outta this tower.
fields.JP: よし！　この監獄塔もようやく終わりだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Cool! That's our ticket outta this tower.

fields.JP: 早速入ってみませんこと？

fields.EN: Yeah. We should check out the next Jail Tower. All right, everyone, let's go.
fields.JP:
そうだな、次の監獄塔を確認しておくべきだな。
よし、行くぞみんな
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, no sense waiting to see what's next.

fields.EN:
What the hell? There's something menacing
about this tower.
fields.JP:
何だここは……
今まで以上に薄気味悪い監獄塔だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the hell? There's something menacing
about this tower.

fields.EN: The air has a stale taste...
fields.JP: 何だか空気が重々しい感じがします……
fields.LOCALIZED: The air has a stale taste...

fields.EN: Everyone, look! We can see outside!
fields.JP: ねえみんな、こっちから外が見えそうだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Everyone, look! We can see outside!

fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN:
Feels like ages since I've seen the outside.
All this effort and we're stuck in Jail again.
fields.JP:
何だか外を見るのも久しぶりですね。
頑張って地上に来たっていうのに、
ずっと監獄塔の中でしたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Feels like ages since I've seen the outside.
All this effort and we're stuck in Jail again.

fields.JP: いったいどんな景色が……

fields.EN: Huh?! Are we in the air?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! Are we in the air?!

fields.JP: 本当だわ……監獄塔自体が浮遊してる……
それに何ですか、この大きさは……
そうか、僕たちはついに辿り着いたんだな

fields.EN: Wait. Is this the Devouring Armada Tower?
fields.JP: まさかここが、悪食の監隊塔……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. Is this the Devouring Armada Tower?

fields.EN:
Must be. Its size and our location would
indicate so. I'm unaware of other floating
towers.
fields.JP:
間違いない。
浮遊している点も、あまりにも巨大な点も、
悪食の監隊塔以外にはあり得ない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Must be. Its size and our location would
indicate so. I'm unaware of other floating
towers.

fields.JP:
ここが、わたくしたちが
目指した場所なんですのね

fields.EN: Exploring this place looks like it'll be extremely difficult. Honestly, I wish I hadn't looked outside...
fields.JP:
探索がかなり大変そうですね。
正直言って、外を見なければよかったです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our journey has taken too long for my liking.
Honestly wish I never looked out the window.

fields.EN: Once you realize just how huge it is, it's overwhelming, isn't it?
fields.JP:
これだけ大きいと分かってしまうと、
圧倒されてしまいますよね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's massive. A fitting evil fortress.

fields.EN: At least here, we may find everyone.
fields.JP:
でも、今度こそ
みんなと会えるかもしれないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: At least here, we may find everyone.

fields.EN:
That's true! Oh Nemu-chan, everyone...
Hope you're all safe.
fields.JP:
そうですよね……！
ああ、ネムちゃんもみんなも、
どうか無事でいて下さい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true! Oh Sleepy, everyone...
Hope you're all safe.

fields.EN: I'm sure they're fine. We'll find them soon.
fields.JP: 大丈夫よ。きっと元気なネムに会えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sure they're fine. We'll find them soon.

fields.EN: (Alas, I found no hint of my wife's whereabouts.)
fields.JP:
（結局、ここまで妻の手がかりは
　見つけられなかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Alas, I found no hint of my wife's whereabouts.)

fields.EN:
(If we take down this tower, then I can go
about my search in peace.)
fields.JP:
（だがこの禍々しい監隊塔とやらを潰せば、
　その時は安全に探すことができるはずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we take down this tower, then I can go
about my search in peace.)

fields.EN:
(It's strange. The surface is completely
overrun. Objectively speaking, it's a
wasteland.)
fields.JP:
（……不思議なものだな。
　正直、地上はこんなにも蹂躙されていて、
　客観的に見れば絶望的な状況だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's strange. The surface is completely
overrun. Objectively speaking, it's a
wasteland.)

fields.EN:
(It's likely my wife is nowhere in this
godforsaken place. Yet something tells
me otherwise.)
fields.JP:
（妻だってもう
　いなくなっていてもおかしくない。なのに、
　何故だかどこかにいる気がしてならない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's likely my wife is nowhere in this
godforsaken place. Yet something tells
me otherwise.)

fields.EN:
(This is unlike me. Acting on feeling.
Akazukin must be rubbing off on me.)
fields.JP:
（僕らしくないな。
　こんな感覚だけでモノを言うなんて。
　もしかして赤ずきんに感化されたか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is unlike me. Acting on feeling.
Red Riding Hood must be rubbing off on me.)

fields.JP:
何いきなり笑って。
楽しいことでも思いだしたの？

fields.EN: Yeah, something like that. More importantly, everyone, let's head back to camp for now. I want to discuss our final strategy.
fields.JP:
まあ、そんなところだ。
それよりもみんな、一度キャンプに戻ろう。
最後の対策を話し合いたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, that's a word for it. Anyway, we should
gather the others at camp and update them.

fields.JP:
そうですね。
報告もしないといけませんしね
それじゃあみんな、帰ろっか

fields.EN:
Listen up, everyone. We discovered an orb
leading us to the Devouring Armada Tower.
fields.JP:
聞いてくれ。ここの光る球体の先で、
ついに悪食の監隊塔に辿り着いた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen up, everyone. We discovered an orb
leading us to the Devouring Armada Tower.

fields.EN:
Really! We saw the surface below us with
our own eyes.
fields.JP:
もちろん！　なんせ塔自体が
空中に浮いているのを、この目で見たからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really! We saw the surface below us with
our own eyes.

fields.EN: I see. It must be true.
fields.JP: なるほど。そりゃ間違いないな
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. It must be true.

fields.JP: とうとうそこまで到達したのだな……！

fields.EN:
I've gathered you here today to discuss
our main objective, which is infiltrating
and destroying the tower.
fields.JP:
後は乗り込んでいって、
あの監隊塔をどうにか潰すだけだ。
それについての話をしたいのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've gathered you here today to discuss
our main objective, which is infiltrating
and destroying the tower.

fields.EN:
Hm? What's the matter, you two?
I expected more enthusiasm.
fields.JP:
ん？　どうした２人とも。
喜んだと思ったら急に黙り込んで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? What's the matter, you two?
I expected more enthusiasm.

fields.EN: Um... I have something to report as well.
fields.JP:
その、だな……
こちらからも１つ報告があってな
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... I have something to report as well.

fields.JP: 報告？　そっちで何か新しい発見があったのか？

fields.EN: Yes, well... It would seem so.
fields.JP: ああ、まあ……そういうことになる
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, well... It would seem so.

fields.EN:
Remember how I drew your blood the
other day? I finished analyzing the test.
fields.JP:
この前、君の血液を採取させてもらっただろう？
その件についてなんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember how I drew your blood the
other day? I finished analyzing the test.

fields.EN: Oh, right. The blood sample. What about it?
fields.JP:
ああ、そういえば
血液を調べたいと言っていたな。
それがどうかしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, right. The blood sample. What about it?

fields.EN:
Firstly, let me apologize. While it's true
I drew your blood for research purposes,
I had another ulterior motive.
fields.JP:
まず先に謝らせてもらう。
あの血液検査は研究のためだと言ったが、
実は別の目的で採取させてもらったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Firstly, let me apologize. While it's true
I drew your blood for research purposes,
I had another ulterior motive.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I told you we were looking into making
weapon improvements, but that wasn't true.
fields.JP:
俺も血式武器のためって言ったが、
悪い、違うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I told you we were looking into making
weapon improvements, but that wasn't true.

fields.EN: Wait. You two lied to me?
fields.JP:
何だ２人とも、
もしかして嘘をついていたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. You two lied to me?

fields.EN:
We had our whole conversation about
transparency the other day, and you pull this?
I'm speechless!
fields.JP:
ついこの間、嘘を糾弾したばかりなのに、
舌の根も乾かぬうちにそんなことをされては、
呆れてものが言えないぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We had our whole conversation about
transparency the other day, and you pull this?
I'm speechless!

fields.EN:
Sorry, Juu. I worried you would be
taken aback had I asked you, but I promise
our intentions were good.
fields.JP:
そこについては、悪かったよジュウ。
だが、まともにお願いする方が失礼すぎてな。
どうしても別の理由を挙げざるを得なかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Toh. I worried you would be
taken aback had I asked you, but I promise
our intentions were good.

fields.JP: ……私たちには１つの疑念があったんだ

fields.EN:
The results of your blood test.
They determined your blood isn't human.
fields.JP:
血液を検査して分かったこと。
それは、ジュウ君の血は人間のものではない、
ということだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The results of your blood test.
They determined your blood isn't human.

fields.EN:
What do you mean? I'm a Blood Youth.
That makes me half-human, half-Marchen.
That's it, isn't it?
fields.JP:
どういうことだ？　僕は血式少年だから、
人間とメルヒェンのハーフということは分かる。
それを指しているのではないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean? I'm a Blood Youth.
That makes me half-human, half-Marchen.
That's it, isn't it?

fields.JP:
そうじゃねえ。
……そうじゃ、ねえんだ

fields.EN: Then what is it? Answer me!
fields.JP: では何だと言うんだ？　答えろ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then what is it? Answer me!

fields.JP: 私たちのものと、同じだったんだよ

fields.EN:
Oh, perfect timing. You were next on my list.
I've got a blade with your name on it.
fields.JP:
おや、丁度いい。
あなたもずっと気にくわなかったんです。
刻んであげましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, perfect timing. You were next on my list.
I've got a blade with your name on it.

fields.EN: Wha... What did you do to Mary?!
fields.JP: なんで……メアリーをどうして……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha... What did you do to Mary?!

fields.EN:
Are you a freak? Why are you worried
about someone else when you've got a
weapon pointed at you?
fields.JP:
刃を向けられながら、他人を気にするなんて、
いったいなんのつもりです？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you a freak? Why are you worried
about someone else when you've got a
weapon pointed at you?

fields.EN:
Please tell me you'll spare me all the crap
about feelings or goodness, right?
fields.JP:
まさか、思いやりだの気遣いだの
そんなことを考えていたりしませんよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please tell me you'll spare me all the crap
about feelings or goodness, right?

fields.EN:
Ooh, those eyes! So shiny!
I detect neither fear nor anger.
fields.JP:
ああっ、その目！
恐怖でも怒りでもない強い光！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ooh, those eyes! So shiny!
I detect neither fear nor anger.

fields.EN: Jack? What's the matter? What happ—
fields.JP: ジャック？　どうしたの？　何かあったの──
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? What's the matter? What happ—

fields.EN: Jack, are you okay? What happened?
fields.JP: ジャック、大丈夫？　何かあったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, are you okay? What happened?

fields.JP: メルヒェンでも出たのか！？

fields.EN: Alice! Guys! I...I couldn't save her!
fields.JP:
アリス！　みんな！
僕は、僕は……助けられなくてっ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice! Guys! I...I couldn't save her!

fields.EN:
Calm down, Jack-kun. Just breathe.
Tell us what happened.
fields.JP:
落ち着いてジャックくん。
何があったか、ゆっくりでいいから話して
fields.LOCALIZED:
Calm down, Jack. Just breathe.
Tell us what happened.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: ギロチンが今ここにいたんだ……！

fields.EN: For s-some reason, she had Mary's clothes...
fields.JP:
それで、ギロチンの手には何故か
メアリーの服が握られていて……
fields.LOCALIZED: For s-some reason, she had Mary's clothes...

fields.EN:
But it wasn't just her clothes.
It was half of her! And she ran off with 'em!
fields.JP:
でも、それは服じゃなくて、半分で！
それを持ったまま逃げていって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it wasn't just her clothes.
It was half of her! And she ran off with 'em!

fields.EN: Hold on, Jack! You're not making sense!
fields.JP:
ジャック落ち着け！
ちゃんと説明してくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hold on, Jack! You're not making sense!

fields.JP: メアリーが、どうしたの……？

だからっ！　メアリーがギロチンに
殺されちゃったんだよ！！
それは本当なのか、ジャック！
み、見間違いじゃないの……？

なんであの子がギロチンに
殺されなければならないの！？

fields.EN: Huh?! Wh-why is everyone staring at me?
fields.JP: な、何なんだよ、ジロジロ見んなよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! Wh-why is everyone staring at me?

fields.EN:
Why are all of you standing out here
like morons in the middle of the night?
fields.JP:
こんな夜中に揃いも揃ってアホ面下げて、
いったいどうしたんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are all of you standing out here
like morons in the middle of the night?

fields.EN:
Because just now, Mary, Guillotine killed you
and carried your corpse away...
fields.JP:
だって、さっきメアリー、
ギロチンに殺されて、死体ごと持ち去られて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because Mary... Guillotine just murdered
you and stole half of your body.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary corpse/clothes scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
I-It was wearing your clothes!
I know what I saw!
fields.JP:
き、君の服を着てたんだ！
見間違いじゃないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: S-She wore your clothes! I saw her!
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary corpse/clothes scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
What? But I'm here. In the flesh!
You're talking out of your—
fields.JP:
は？　俺はこのとおりピンピンしてるだろーが。
ったく、意味分かんねえこと言いやが――
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? But I'm here. In the flesh!
You're talking out of your—

fields.JP: テントの中に何かいるの！？
あれは――メアリーのお手伝いさん……！

fields.EN: It didn't make it... Poor thing.
fields.JP: 真っ二つにされてる……なんてひどい
fields.LOCALIZED: It didn't make it... Poor thing.

fields.JP: これはどういうことなんだ……？

fields.EN:
Jack. You said you saw her kill me, right?
And you swear you did?
fields.JP:
ジャック、俺がギロチンに
殺されたって言ってたよな……？
それ、マジで見たのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack. You said you saw her kill me, right?
And you swear you did?

fields.EN:
Yeah. Guillotine was carrying your clothes
and half of what I thought was your body.
fields.JP:
うん。ギロチンは真っ二つにされた
君の服と身体の半分を抱えていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. She carried half of you when she fled.
Clothes and all.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary corpse/clothes scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
I always sleep dressed like this.
I leave my jacket on this little guy
like it's a clothes hanger.
fields.JP:
俺はいつも、この通りの格好で寝るんだ。
それで、上着はハンガー代わりに
こいつに着せとくんだけどさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
See. I always sleep like this. I had my servant
wear my clothes like a hanger.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary corpse/clothes scene restored from JP

fields.EN: Looks like Guillotine fell for it.
fields.JP: たぶん、ギロチンはそれを間違えやがったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like Guillotine fell for it.

fields.EN:
I see... Guillotine mistook Mary's servant in her
jacket for Mary herself and cut it in half...
fields.JP:
なるほど、上着を着たメアリーのお手伝いさんを、
メアリー本人だと思って真っ二つにしたのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Guillotine must've seen its shadow
and cut it down without looking.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary corpse/clothes scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
(Mary's faint presence probably helped save her too.
That's why Guillotine made the mistake.)
fields.JP:
（きっとメアリーの存在感の薄さも、
　彼女が助かった要因の１つなんだろう。
　だからギロチンはミスをしたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess Mary's aloofness came in handy for
once. Thank goodness.)
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary corpse/clothes scene restored from JP

fields.EN:
So that corpse Jack saw...was half of
your servant?
fields.JP:
それじゃ、ジャックが見たメアリーの亡骸は、
お手伝いさんの身体のもう半分……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that corpse Jack saw...was half of
your servant?

fields.EN: Looks like it. Wonder why she came for me.
fields.JP:
そういうことだろうな。
つーか、どうして俺が狙われたんだ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like it. Wonder why she came for me.

fields.EN:
What could Guillotine possibly want
with Mary?
fields.JP:
ギロチンは本当に
メアリーを狙ったんだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What could Guillotine possibly want
with Mary?

fields.EN: Right... I can't think of a reason.
fields.JP:
確かに……メアリーが狙われる理由って、
どこにもないわよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right... I can't think of a reason.

fields.EN:
Maybe she came to abduct Alice-san, but
stumbled into Mary-chan's tent on accident
and retaliated to keep her quiet?
fields.JP:
アリスさんをさらおうとして、
間違ってメアリーちゃんのテントに入っちゃって、
それで口封じに……とか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she came to abduct Alice, but
stumbled into Mary's tent on accident
and retaliated to keep her quiet?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; メアリーちゃん => Mary-chan

fields.EN:
Maybe she was killing indiscriminately.
Mary could have been her first victim for
all we know.
fields.JP:
あるいは無差別にみんなを殺そうとした、
最初の標的がメアリーだった、とか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she was killing indiscriminately.
Mary could have been her first victim for
all we know.

fields.EN: No. I think it was a planned attack.
fields.JP:
いや、多分ギロチンは、
メアリーを狙ったんだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED: No. I think it was a planned attack.

fields.JP:
どうしてだ？　メアリーに
狙われる理由があるっていうのかい？

fields.EN:
Well, that I don't know. But Mary's tent
is the furthest back from the entrance.
fields.JP:
いや、理由は分からないよ。
でもこのメアリーのテントは、キャンプの
入口からは奥まったところに位置している
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that I don't know. But Mary's tent
is the furthest back from the entrance.

fields.EN:
If she were killing randomly, you would
think she'd hit someone closer up there.
fields.JP:
もし無差別に殺そうとしたなら、
手前のテントから襲っていくと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she were killing randomly, you would
think she'd hit someone closer up there.

fields.EN: Right. If she meant to kill everyone, it'd be strange to leave the people near the entrance for later and give them a chance to escape.
fields.JP:
そうねえ、全員殺すつもりなら、
入口近くの人間を後回しにして、
逃げる隙を与えるのもおかしいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She could have been trying to start from
the back to make it harder to flee.

fields.EN:
I don't think she'd mistake Mary for Alice.
Especially because she fled when Alice
approached me.
fields.JP:
そしてアリスと間違えたかというと、
それも違う。何故ならギロチンは、
アリスの声を聞いて逃げたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think she'd mistake Mary for Alice.
Especially because she fled when Alice
approached me.

fields.EN:
If Guillotine wanted to abduct her, then
why would she run? Doesn't add up.
fields.JP:
アリスが目的だったなら、
アリスに気づかれて逃げるのはおかしい。
だから今夜の目的はアリスじゃなく――
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Guillotine wanted to abduct her, then
why would she run? Doesn't add up.

fields.JP: メアリーってことになるのね

fields.EN:
But that's even more confusing.
We've never even met! Not one look!
fields.JP:
マジで意味分かんねえ……
俺はあいつと言葉はおろか、
目を合わせた覚えすらねえぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's even more confusing.
We've never even met! Not one look!

fields.EN:
I-I-I-It's all over...! You're my sleeping
buddy from now on, Charlotte!
fields.JP:
俺もうムムム、ムリだ……！
こ、これからは毎日シャーロットの
ところで寝るからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I-I-It's all over...! You're my sleeping
buddy from now on, Charlotte!

fields.EN:
Okay. I have room, Mary! Just watch your
personal space. I'm not going anywhere!
fields.JP:
分かったわ、一緒に寝ましょうメアリー。
ほら、そんなにしがみつかなくても、
私はどこにもいかないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. I have room, Mary! Just watch your
personal space. I'm not going anywhere!

fields.JP:
（でも本当に、どうして
　メアリーが狙われたんだ……？）

fields.EN:
(If Guillotine wants to assassinate her,
she could have done it at any time.
Why now...?)
fields.JP:
（こんな暗殺めいたやり方をするのなら
　機会はいくらでもあったのに、
　なぜ今になって……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If Guillotine wants to assassinate her,
she could have done it at any time.
Why now...?)

fields.EN:
(Is she panicking because we made it to
the Devouring Armada Tower?)
fields.JP:
（もしかして僕たちに悪食の監隊塔に
　到達されて、何か焦っているのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she panicking because we made it to
the Devouring Armada Tower?)

fields.EN:
Charlotte! Enough waiting outside!
Get in this tent with me immediately!
fields.JP:
シャーロット！
俺もう外にいたくねえ！
早くテント入ろうぜ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte! Enough waiting outside!
Get in this tent with me immediately!

fields.JP: 分かった、分かったから

fields.EN:
(A few days passed since the attempt on
Mary's life.)
fields.JP: （メアリー暗殺未遂事件から、数日が過ぎた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A few days passed since the attempt on
Mary's life.)

fields.EN:
(Mary's been extra cautious, and Charlotte-san
hasn't left her side once.)
fields.JP:
（あれ以降メアリーは警戒を強め、
　常にシャーロットさんと一緒にいた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mary's been extra cautious, and Charlotte
hasn't left her side once.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(Thankfully Guillotine hasn't showed up
since then either. That's good news for us
as we're moving camp to the new tower.)
fields.JP:
（そのおかげか、今日までギロチンが
　現れることはなく、僕たちはこうして、
　悪食の監隊塔にキャンプ地を移すことができた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thankfully Guillotine hasn't showed up
since then either. That's good news for us
as we're moving camp to the new tower.)

fields.EN:
(We've come a long way. Even so, there's
no time to rest on our laurels.)
fields.JP:
（しばらく何事もなく過ごすことができている。
　とはいえ、キャンプ内だからといって、
　油断することはもうできないだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We've come a long way. Even so, there's
no time to rest on our laurels.)

fields.EN:
This barricade is huge, Mamoru.
Did you build this all yourself?
fields.JP:
すごい大きなバリケードに改造したね、マモル。
これ全部１人でやったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This barricade is huge, Mamoru.
Did you build this all yourself?

fields.EN:
Of course not. Chiaki helped out too.
That's him over there, resting up.
fields.JP:
まさか。さっきまで千昭にも
手伝ってもらってたよ。
今は向こうでへばってるけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. Chiaki helped out too.
That's him over there, resting up.

fields.EN:
Chiaki-san's so serious all the time.
He looks beat.
fields.JP:
千昭さんすごく真面目だから、
きっと頑張りすぎちゃったんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chiaki's so serious all the time.
He looks beat.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN:
Yeah. I could tell him to take a break until
my voice gave out, but he just shrugs.
fields.JP:
そうそう。無理せず休めって言っても、
大丈夫だって聞かないんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I could tell him to take a break until
my voice gave out, but he just shrugs.

fields.EN:
By the way, did you happen to see if
Guillotine damaged the old barrier?
fields.JP:
……そうだ。ちょっと聞きたいんだけど、
この前のギロチンが襲ってきた後って、
バリケードどうなってた？
fields.LOCALIZED:
By the way, did you happen to see if
Guillotine damaged the old barrier?

fields.EN:
Oh. Hm, wait... Odd. Now that you mention
it, I didn't notice anything off.
fields.JP:
ああ、あの時は……あれ？
おかしいな、特に壊されてないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Hm, wait... Odd. Now that you mention
it, I didn't notice anything off.

fields.JP:
（何かおかしくないか？
　だってそれだと――）

fields.EN:
There you are, Jack. Everyone's ready.
We're about to set out.
fields.JP:
ああ、いたいた。
ジャック、わたしたちは準備できたわ。
そろそろ探索に出ましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you are, Jack. Everyone's ready.
We're about to set out.

fields.EN:
Oh? That time already? Sorry.
Let me get my things together!
fields.JP:
ん？　もうそんな時間か。
ごめん、すぐに荷物取ってくるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? That time already? Sorry.
Let me get my things together!

fields.EN:
(That's right. Today we embark on our first
exploration of the Devouring Armada Tower.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、今日からようやく
　悪食の監隊塔の探索に出るんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's right. Today we embark on our first
exploration of the Devouring Armada Tower.)

fields.EN:
(We'll learn why Guillotine tried to attack
Mary soon enough...)
fields.JP:
（メアリーの事件のことも気になるけど、
　探索の方もしっかりやらなければいけない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We'll learn why Guillotine tried to attack
Mary soon enough...)

fields.EN:
(This could very well be the site of the
last battle.)
fields.JP:
（だって、おそらくここが
　最後の戦いになる可能性が高いんだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This could very well be the site of the
last battle.)

fields.JP: （よし、気を引きしめていくぞ）

fields.EN: Took us long enough. If we destroy this—
fields.JP:
やっと見つけたわね。
これを破壊すれば……
fields.LOCALIZED: Took us long enough. If we destroy this—

fields.EN: Always keeping me waiting. I'm ancient now.
fields.JP:
随分と遅かったですね。
本当に待ちくたびれましたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Always keeping me waiting. I'm ancient now.

fields.EN:
Your tricks won't work on us anymore.
We'll handle you with ease...
fields.JP:
しばらく姿を見せなかったけど、
やっぱりわたしたちの行動、
把握してるみたいだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your tricks won't work on us anymore.
We'll handle you with ease...

fields.EN: I can sense her aura. Watch out.
fields.JP:
何だか鬼気迫るものを感じるわ。
みんな、気をつけて
fields.LOCALIZED: I can sense her aura. Watch out.

fields.EN: I-I told you, she's the one person I don't want to run into...!
fields.JP:
おお、俺、あいつにだけは
会いたくないんだって……！
ちっ……あなた、やっぱり生きていましたか

fields.EN:
Aah! I-I don't know you, Miss.
I didn't see anything that night. Nope.
fields.JP:
ひいっ！　あ、あたし、貴方様のことは
知りませんし、あの夜のことも何にも見て、
い、いませんです。はい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah! I-I don't know you, Miss.
I didn't see anything that night. Nope.

fields.EN: Hmph... You mean nothing to me.
fields.JP:
ふん……まあ、あなたなど
眼中にありませんでしたが……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph... You mean nothing to me.

fields.EN: Was it one of Master's orders?
fields.JP: マスターの命令なんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Was it one of Master's orders?

fields.EN:
Not you again! I thought I told you not to
invoke Master's name so lightly!
fields.JP:
またお前……！
いつもいつも気安くマスターの名を
口にするなと言っているだろうが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not you again! I thought I told you not to
invoke Master's name so lightly!

fields.EN:
Got it. I take your answer as an admission
of guilt!
fields.JP:
否定しないってことは、
そのマスターって人の命令だって
証明しているようなものだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. I take your answer as an admission
of guilt!

fields.EN:
Hah. So what if it was? What's the point in
knowing if I'm going to murder you anyway?
fields.JP:
はっ、だったら何だと言うんだ？
それが分かったところで、これから
死ぬお前に何の意味がある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hah. So what if it was? What's the point in
knowing if I'm going to murder you anyway?

fields.EN:
What's with the secrecy?
Did Master put you up to it?
fields.JP:
どうして君たちは対話をしようとしないんだ。
それもマスターの命令かい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's with the secrecy?
Did Master put you up to it?

fields.EN:
Strike three! You blasphemous piece of
filth. I should cut your tongue off!
fields.JP:
３度目だ……！
喋るゴミというだけでも万死に値するのに、
不敬の極みを働き続けるなど言語道断！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Strike three! You blasphemous piece of
filth. I should cut your tongue off!

fields.EN: I should have killed you that night!
fields.JP:
ああ、あの夜に
お前だけは殺しておくべきだったッ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I should have killed you that night!

fields.EN: Enough. I will slaughter you all now.
fields.JP: もういい、全員皆殺しにしてやる
fields.LOCALIZED: Enough. I will slaughter you all now.

fields.EN: I dare you. It won't be so easy this time.
fields.JP:
やってみろ。
だが、今までの僕たちだと思うなよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I dare you. It won't be so easy this time.

fields.EN: You don't know who you're messing with!
fields.JP:
わたしたちはこんなところで
負けていられない！
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't know who you're messing with!

fields.EN:
After we kick your butt, you're going to
tell us who Master is!
fields.JP:
あなたを倒して、
マスターのことを教えてもらうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
After we kick your butt, you're going to
tell us who Master is!

fields.EN: We're putting an end to your tyrannous reign.
fields.JP:
もうこれ以上みんなに
ひどいことするのは、許さないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: We're putting an end to your tyrannous reign.

fields.EN: If you're gonna kill us anyway, then I'll fight!
fields.JP:
やんなきゃやられるってんなら、
ちくしょう、やってやるよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: If you're gonna kill us anyway, then I'll fight!

fields.EN:
Ah, Master. You ordered me not to kill Alice,
but they are testing my patience greatly.
fields.JP:
ああ、マスター。
アリスは殺すなという話ですが、
私は今こいつらに激怒しています……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, Master. You ordered me not to kill Alice,
but they are testing my patience greatly.

fields.EN: So I've made up my mind! Alice is mine to kill!
fields.JP: だから決めましたっ！　アリスもぶっ殺すと！！
fields.LOCALIZED: So I've made up my mind! Alice is mine to kill!

fields.EN:
I was a fool. I should have done this a long,
long time ago!
fields.JP:
そうだ、最初っからややこしいこと言ってねーで
こうしていればよかったんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was a fool. I should have done this a long,
long time ago!

fields.EN:
You treacherous, annoying pests!
I will dearly savor your deaths!
fields.JP:
このうるせえうるせえうるせえうるせえ
蝿のたかるゴミどもなんて、
皆殺し以外にあり得ねえんだからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You treacherous, annoying pests!
I will dearly savor your deaths!

fields.EN: In your wildest dreams, you maniac!
fields.JP:
僕たちも、もうこれ以上
やられるわけにはいかないんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: In your wildest dreams, you maniac!

fields.EN: Here we go, everyone! All together!
fields.JP: みんな、ここで決着をつけよう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Here we go, everyone! All together!

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... I can't believe it.
Me? Defeated?
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ……
そんな馬鹿な、この私が負ける……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... I can't believe it.
Me? Defeated?

fields.JP: そうよ、あなたの負けよ

fields.EN: You can't fight with those injuries.
fields.JP: さすがにその傷じゃもう無理ね
fields.LOCALIZED: You can't fight with those injuries.

fields.EN: Give it up. Admit you've lost.
fields.JP:
もういいでしょ？
いいかげん、負けを認めるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Give it up. Admit you've lost.

fields.EN: No. Not yet... I can still fight.
fields.JP: いや、まだだ……まだ私は戦える……
fields.LOCALIZED: No. Not yet... I can still fight.

fields.EN: Not anymore. Told you not to mess with us.
fields.JP:
それ以上は無理だ。
君はもう僕たちには絶対に勝てないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Not anymore. Told you not to mess with us.

fields.JP: そんなこと、認めてたまるかあああっ！！

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I have shared the battlefield with
Jack many times. We're in sync.
fields.JP:
僕とジャックがどれだけ
一緒に戦ってきたと思ってるんだ。
お互いの考えていることくらい分かるさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have shared the battlefield with
Jack many times. We're in sync.

fields.EN: Besides, I vowed never to lose again.
fields.JP: それに、僕はもうお前に負けないって誓ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides, I vowed never to lose again.

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Of course. Someone had to come in to
save you at the last second. You cut it
pretty close this time.
fields.JP:
まったく、あえて怒らせた上に
自分に標的を向けさせるなんて、
君って奴は相変わらず無茶をするね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. Someone had to come in to
save you at the last second. You cut it
pretty close this time.

fields.JP: つうを信じてたからね
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Hehe. Thank you, Jack. I'm honored.
fields.JP: はは、ありがとうジャック。光栄だよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Thank you, Jack. I'm honored.

fields.EN:
Damn... What gives...?
These low-life moles came out of the
ground. They're nothing... How?!
fields.JP:
くそっ……何故勝てない……
こんな陽の光もまともに浴びたことのない
地底の生ゴミどもに、何故……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn... What gives...?
These low-life moles came out of the
ground. They're nothing... How?!

fields.EN:
This cannot be happening!
I'd never lose to this band of losers...
fields.JP:
あってはならない！
この私がゲロカスに負けるなんてことは、決して！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This cannot be happening!
I'd never lose to this band of losers...

fields.EN:
Aren't you the one with her back against
the wall? Give it up, Guillotine.
fields.JP:
でも壁に寄りかかってないと、
立ってもいられないんだろう？
もう諦めるんだ、ギロチン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aren't you the one with her back against
the wall? Give it up, Guillotine.

fields.EN:
Stop! I've had it with your crap. A puke-stain
like you doesn't deserve to say my name!
Only Master can say it!
fields.JP:
やめろ！　そのゲロ臭い、汚物を吐くしか
能のない口で私の名前を呼び捨てにするな！
それをしていいのはマスターだけだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stop! I've had it with your crap. A puke-stain
like you doesn't deserve to say my name!
Only Master can say it!

fields.EN:
Whatever. We're taking you prisoner,
and you're gonna start talking.
Don't worry. We won't kill you.
fields.JP:
何でもいいけど、とにかく君は拘束させてもらう。
そしてとことん話してもらうからね。
安心して、殺しはしないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever. We're taking you prisoner,
and you're gonna start talking.
Don't worry. We won't kill you.

fields.JP: ジャック……随分と大胆になったね

fields.EN:
Screw you! If you think I'll start talking then
you may as well kill me!
fields.JP:
ふざけるな……そんなことになるくらいなら、
私は今ここで死ぬ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Screw you! If you think I'll start talking then
you may as well kill me!

fields.EN: She was sucked into the wall!
fields.JP: なんだ、あいつ壁に吸い込まれて……！
fields.LOCALIZED: She was sucked into the wall!

fields.JP: いったい何だったんだろう、あれ……

fields.EN:
She cried out for her master. Maybe he
saved her?
fields.JP:
『マスター』って言ったってことは、
彼女を助けたのはマスターだったってこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She cried out for her master. Maybe he
saved her?

fields.EN: She couldn't have gone far, right?
fields.JP: そういうことになる、のかしら……？
fields.LOCALIZED: She couldn't have gone far, right?

fields.EN:
Damn it. We had her in custody, and
we let her go!
fields.JP:
くそっ、今度こそ追いつめたっていうのに、
取り逃がしてしまった……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it. We had her in custody, and
we let her go!

fields.EN:
It's not your fault, Otsuu-chan. This was out
of our control.
fields.JP:
仕方ないよおつうちゃん。
こればっかりは誰も予測できなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not your fault, Otsuu. This was out
of our control.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: It's a shame she got away, but she was badly wounded. Let's take it as a win that she probably won't attack us for a while.
fields.JP:
逃がしたのは残念だけど、だいぶ負傷はしていた。
当分襲ってこないってだけでも、良しとしようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
While it sucks we lost her, we roughed her
up pretty bad. Bet she'll think twice about
messing with us again. That's a win.

fields.EN:
Right. We still have a mountain to climb.
Let's find the core and move on.
fields.JP:
そうね。まだ悪食の監隊塔は続くわ。
だから切り替えて、まずはこの核を破壊しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. We still have a mountain to climb.
Let's find the core and move on.

fields.JP: あっ、ちょっと待ってちょっと待って！

fields.EN:
The core's here. Easy pickings.
Just like last time. It's silent... Made it!
fields.JP:
せっかく核があるんだ、使わない手はねーぜ。
よし、前と同じしゃべらない感じで……できたっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The core's here. Easy pickings.
Just like last time. It's silent... Made it!

fields.JP: あ、お手伝いさんが復活した

fields.EN:
It's pretty handy, isn't it?
Shoot. I'm running low on matches.
fields.JP:
やっぱこいつがいねーと不便だからな。
にしても、随分マッチ減っちまったな、へへ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's pretty handy, isn't it?
Shoot. I'm running low on matches.

fields.EN: Do you really still need that child? Depending on how things go, I really will take them away from you.
fields.JP:
もう、本当にその子必要なの？
場合によっては本当に取り上げちゃうんだからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you really need him? I should hold onto
them for you.

fields.EN: I know. I'm thinking it through properly, so don't worry.
fields.JP:
分かってるって。
しっかり考えてるから大丈夫だっての
じゃ、そろそろ破壊するわよ
グボォォォォォオオオ……！！

fields.EN:
Right. That Nightmare won't know what's
coming for it.
fields.JP:
やった、これで悪食の監隊塔のナイトメアも、
なんとかできそうだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. That Nightmare won't know what's
coming for it.

fields.EN: Yeah. If we run into it, we can fight it.
fields.JP: ああ。もし遭遇しても、戦うことができるね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Luck's in our favor this time.

fields.EN: Thinking about it, I'm glad it hasn't appeared since we came here.
fields.JP: そう思うと、ここに来てから現れてなくていいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Or we could, you know, just avoid it.

fields.EN: Yeah... We've never had that happen before, though. That's creepy in its own way.
fields.JP:
そうだね……
今までこんなことなかったはずなんだけど、
それはそれで不気味だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. It's all starting to hit me now.
Things are ramping up.

fields.EN: It's a problem whether it shows up or not.
fields.JP: いてもいなくても困った存在ねえ

fields.EN:
Right, and still more for us to figure out.
We gotta push on in the meantime.
Let's go, everyone.
fields.JP:
ひとまず、まだ気になることは
色々あるけど、今は先に進むしかない。
だから、立ち止まらずに進もう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, and still more for us to figure out.
We gotta push on in the meantime.
Let's go, everyone.

fields.EN:
Okay. What matters most is taking down the
armada tower.
fields.JP:
そうね。この監隊塔を止めるまで、
わたしたちは進み続けるのみね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. What matters most is taking down the
armada tower.

fields.JP: よし、それじゃあみんな、行こう

fields.EN:
(I thought I saw someone pull Guillotine
into the wall...but it was a human hand.)
fields.JP:
（さっき、一瞬ギロチンを壁の中に
　引きずり込んだモノが見えたけど、
　あれ『人の手』だったよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought I saw someone pull Guillotine
into the wall...but it was a human hand.)

fields.EN:
Oh. Where are we now? Something's different
about this place.
fields.JP:
お、何だこの部屋。
今までと随分と雰囲気が違うじゃねーか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Where are we now? Something's different
about this place.

fields.EN: It's all glass. Wonder what this room's for.
fields.JP:
一面ガラス張りね。
何のための部屋なのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: It's all glass. Wonder what this room's for.

fields.EN: There are two more doors like this on the other side. It looks like this glass divides the room into three sections...
fields.JP:
向こうにも同じような扉が２つあるわ。
どうやらこのガラスで部屋を
３等分しているみたいだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like there are two doors down there.
The room splits into three paths at that
intersection.

fields.EN:
Doesn't look like we can go in through this
side. What should we do?
fields.JP:
向こうには行けないみたいだけど、
どうしようか――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't look like we can go in through this
side. What should we do?

fields.JP:
ジャックさんたち……
それに姉貴たち……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ねえジュウ、これ夢じゃ……ないよね

fields.EN: No. It's real. These must be your friends you―
fields.JP:
現実だ。そうか、
こいつらが赤ずきんが言ってた――
fields.LOCALIZED: No. It's real. These must be your friends you―

fields.JP:
あーーーーーーーーーっ！！
みんながいるーーー！！

fields.EN: Oh! We have! Our search is over!
fields.JP:
おおーーーーー本当だっ！！
貴様らもここに来ておったのかーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! We have! Our search is over!

fields.EN: Jack-san! Everyone's safe in one piece!
fields.JP:
ジャックさん！
それにみなさん無事でしたのね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! Everyone's safe in one piece!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Oh, Nemu! Nemu! Shirayuki, it's Nemu!
fields.JP:
あっ、ネム！　ネムだ！
ねえ白雪、ネムがいるわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Sleepy! Sleepy! Snow White, it's Sleepy!

fields.JP: 本当だ！　ネムちゃんです！！

fields.EN: Wow. Otsuu-chan, it's all our friends!
fields.JP: すごい、みんないるよおつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. Otsuu, it's all our friends!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Somebody pinch me before I wake!
fields.LOCALIZED: Somebody pinch me before I wake!

fields.EN: Hey Nemuri, these the friends you mentioned?
fields.JP: ねえ眠り、これが言ってた仲間？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Sleepy, these the friends you mentioned?

fields.JP:
そうだよ……ボクの姉様たちも……
あそこにいるの……！

fields.EN: Jack. We finally got everyone back together!
fields.JP: ジャック、やっとみんなに再会できたわね……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack. We finally got everyone back together!

fields.EN: Yeah... The journey's been long, but worth it!
fields.JP: うん……長かったけど、ようやくだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah... The journey's been long, but worth it!

fields.EN:
(Wow. I never thought this day would come.
I'm glad we kept going...)
fields.JP:
（こんなことってあるんだな。
　信じて突き進んできて、本当によかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow. I never thought this day would come.
I'm glad we kept going...)

fields.EN:
(A buzz filled the air as we gathered
to celebrate our reunion.)
fields.JP:
（あれからしばらくの間、
　各々が好き勝手にしゃべって騒いで、
　再会を喜び合った）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A buzz filled the air as we gathered
to celebrate our reunion.)

fields.EN:
(We had so many updates for one another
that it took quite a while for things to settle.)
fields.JP:
（僕もそうだったから人のことは言えないけど、
　とにかくそれぞれに積もる話がありすぎて、
　収拾をつけるのにはだいぶ時間がかかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We had so many updates for one another
that it took quite a while for things to settle.)

fields.EN:
(But no one minded. We were all alive
and well. If anything, I was relieved to
see everyone return to their usual selves.)
fields.JP:
（でもそれは、逆にみんなが元気だった
　ということの証なわけで、変わらないみんなで
　いてくれたことが、僕は嬉しかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But no one minded. We were all alive
and well. If anything, I was relieved to
see everyone return to their usual selves.)

fields.EN:
(Once the festivities had died down a bit,
the conversation shifted to summaries of
what everyone had seen.)
fields.JP:
（その後、みんなが落ちついたところで、
　僕たちはこれまでのことを話し合うことにした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once the festivities had died down a bit,
the conversation shifted to summaries of
what everyone had seen.)

fields.JP:
（でも全員で行うとまた収拾がつかなく
　なりそうだったから、グレーテルの提案に従い、
　それぞれグループから２人ずつ出すことに決めた）

fields.EN:
(In the end, it was Alice and me, Clara and
Gretel, and Kaguyahime and the white-haired guy.)
fields.JP:
（結果、僕とアリス、くららとグレーテル、
　白い髪の男の人とかぐや姫、で行うことになった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the end, it was Alice and me, Clara and
Gretel, and Kaguya and the white-haired guy.)

fields.EN:
(The rest of the group sat encircled around
us, listening intently...)
fields.JP:
（それで残りのみんなは、
　話合いを見守る形でそばにいるんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The rest of the group sat encircled around
us, listening intently...)

fields.EN:
Please save any applause and audience
participation for after the presentations.
fields.JP:
あなたたち、後でいくらでも騒いでいいから、
とにかく今は黙りなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please save any applause and audience
participation for after the presentations.

fields.EN: (Why are they all sitting like schoolkids?)
fields.JP:
（な、何で２人とも
　正座までさせられてるんだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why are they all sitting like schoolkids?)

fields.EN: We'll be quick! Just get comfy!
fields.JP:
すぐに終わるっすから！
ちょっとの辛抱っす！
fields.LOCALIZED: We'll be quick! Just get comfy!

fields.JP:
さ、アレは放っておいていいから、
話合いをしましょう

fields.EN: Wait, I spy a guest among us. Just who are you?
fields.JP:
それで、１人だけ分からないのだけど
あなたは何者なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait, I spy a guest among us. Just who are you?

fields.EN:
I'm Juu. Like you, I'm an escaped prisoner
from Jail. I was warped to a tower where I
met Kaguyahime and her companions. That's all.
fields.JP:
ジュウだ。君たちと同じように
地下から来て、飛ばされた先の監獄塔で
かぐや姫たちと出会った。以上だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm Toh. Like you, I'm an escaped prisoner
from Jail. I was warped to a tower where I
met Kaguya and her companions. That's all.
fields.notes: source-gated Toh => Juu; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Though, you needn't introduce yourself to me.
fields.JP: ああ、君たちの自己紹介は必要はない
fields.LOCALIZED: Though, you needn't introduce yourself to me.

fields.JP: 僕たちのこと、みんな分かるの？

fields.EN:
As if this group ever stops talking about you.
Jack, I assume?
fields.JP:
仲間に聞いてるからな。
君はジャック、だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
As if this group ever stops talking about you.
Jack, I assume?

fields.EN:
Good guess. Yeah, I'm Jack. Nice to meet you,
Juu.
fields.JP:
本当だ。うん、ジャックだよ。
よろしくね、ジュウ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good guess. Yeah, I'm Jack. Nice to meet you,
Toh.

fields.EN: What a brat. Ugh. This bores me...
fields.JP:
大人げない人ですね～、
ああ、面倒くさい～
fields.LOCALIZED: What a brat. Ugh. This bores me...

fields.EN:
Haha... We're all still getting to know each
other. It's been a while, Kaguyahime.
Happy to see you're doing fine.
fields.JP:
はは……まだお互いをよく分かってないからね。
それよりかぐや姫も、久しぶり。
元気そうでよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha... We're all still getting to know each
other. It's been a while, Kaguya.
Happy to see you're doing fine.

fields.EN:
If you call being depleted and exhausted fine!
Akazukin and Shirayuki just won't
quit. Hence why I'm up here!
fields.JP:
こっち側は窮屈で面倒くさいです～。
今も赤ずきんや白雪が興奮しっぱなしだから、
何故かわらわが出席する羽目になりましたし～
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you call being depleted and exhausted fine!
Red Riding Hood and Snow White just won't
quit. Hence why I'm up here!

fields.EN:
Oh Jack, if only you knew how much I
wished you were with us.
fields.JP:
ああジャック、何度そなたに
早く合流してほしいと思ったか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh Jack, if only you knew how much I
wished you were with us.

fields.EN:
Right. That lineup's a doozy.
Guess you had no choice but to take charge.
fields.JP:
なるほど、その面子だとかぐや姫が
いちばんしっかりする羽目になって、
サボれなくなるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. That lineup's a doozy.
Guess you had no choice but to take charge.

fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん。
その節はどうもっす！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Uh, what did I do...? Wait Clara.
Is that a Mary Gun?!
fields.JP:
僕、何かしたっけ……って、くらら、
どうして君がメアリガンを持ってるの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, what did I do...? Wait Clara.
Is that a Mary Gun?!

fields.EN:
Oh, quit pretending you don't know! This is all
thanks to you, Jack-san!
fields.JP:
なーにとぼけたフリしてんすかー。
それもこれも全部、ジャックさんの
おかげじゃないっすか！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Don't play dumb. This is all thanks to you!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Each crew's representative took turns
recounting the previous events.)
fields.JP:
（その後、それぞれのグループが、
　自分たちにあったことを順番に話していった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Each crew's representative took turns
recounting the previous events.)

fields.EN:
(We corroborated details about the towers
that only confirmed some of the theories we
had, but also revealing startling new info.)
fields.JP:
（それらの中には、驚愕するような新しい
　情報もあったし、すでに知っていたものもあった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We corroborated details about the towers
that only confirmed some of the theories we
had, but also revealing startling new info.)

fields.EN:
(Turns out, starting with the Eiserne Jail,
all three groups were exploring the same
towers at the same time.)
fields.JP:
（そうそう、アイゼルネの監獄塔から先は、
　３つのグループが同じ時期に同じ監獄塔を
　探索していた、ということが判明した）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Turns out, starting with the Eiserne Jail,
all three groups were exploring the same
towers at the same time.)

fields.EN:
(After realizing how close we had been to
seeing each other throughout the whole
ordeal, we erupted into laughter.)
fields.JP:
（全員があまりにも近くにいたことが分かって、
　僕たちは思わず顔を見合わせて笑ってしまった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After realizing how close we had been to
seeing each other throughout the whole
ordeal, we erupted into laughter.)

fields.EN:
So that path suddenly opening back then was thanks
to Jack-san and the others, or Juu-san and his
group!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、あの時いきなり道が開けたのは、
ジャックさんたちかジュウさんたちの
おかげだったってことっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? The reason our paths started clearing
was all thanks to you, Jack!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
I had a suspicion that was the case, but
to think it was true all along.
fields.JP:
その可能性は考えていたけど、
まさか本当にそうだったとはね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had a suspicion that was the case, but
to think it was true all along.

fields.EN: In any case, an intriguing observation.
fields.JP:
それにしても、だいぶあなたたちも
面白いことになってるのね
fields.LOCALIZED: In any case, an intriguing observation.

fields.EN:
"Intriguing observation." What a Gretel thing
to say. My brain can hardly take anymore of
this hullabaloo. I'm too tired to think...
fields.JP:
これを面白いなんて、さすがグレーテルです～。
わらわは一気に情報が増えすぎて、
考えるのも面倒になってきました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Intriguing observation." What a Gretel thing
to say. My brain can hardly take anymore of
this hullabaloo. I'm too tired to think...

fields.JP: そうね、じゃあまずは目的を整理しましょうか

fields.EN:
We can assume the central Jail structure
is controlled by Genocide Pink's so-called
master. And it's heading for the moon.
fields.JP:
前提として、悪食の監隊塔は処刑台少女の
『マスター』とやらが管理している。
そして監隊塔は、月へ向かって伸びている説が濃厚
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can assume the central Jail structure
is controlled by Massacre Pink's so-called
master. And it's heading for the moon.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Our goal is to eliminate this "Master"
and bring down the Devouring Armada
Tower. Are we all in on this?
fields.JP:
私たちの目的は、その『マスター』と
いう奴を倒し、悪食の監隊塔を破壊すること。
これは共通しているってことでいいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goal is to eliminate this "Master"
and bring down the Devouring Armada
Tower. Are we all in on this?

fields.EN:
Yep. We must bring it down, or I can never
search for my wife in peace.
fields.JP:
ああ。この監隊塔を落とさなければ、
妻を安心して探せないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yep. We must bring it down, or I can never
search for my wife in peace.

fields.EN:
Another concerning fact is their order
not to harm Alice.
fields.JP:
次に共通している謎だけど、何故か全員
『アリスには手を出すな』と言われている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another concerning fact is their order
not to harm Alice.

fields.EN:
That comes all the way from their master.
But his motives are unknown. As is his
connection to Alice...
fields.JP:
恐らくそこには『マスター』の思惑がある。
でも、誰もそれについて心当たりはない。
当のアリスでさえも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That comes all the way from their master.
But his motives are unknown. As is his
connection to Alice...

fields.JP: ええ。まったく分からないわ

fields.EN:
So perplexing. A question that can only be
answered once Master is in our custody.
fields.JP:
これに関しては、いまだに謎のまま。
当人を捕まえて聞くしかないかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So perplexing. A question that can only be
answered once Master is in our custody.

fields.EN:
And finally, I don't know what this means,
but...
fields.JP:
そして最後に、私たちのこれからに
関係あるのかは不明だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And finally, I don't know what this means,
but...

fields.EN:
Juu... You're the other half of Professor's
mimic.
fields.JP:
ジュウ――あなたが、
博士の擬態化した片割れだということ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh... You're the other half of Professor's
mimic.

fields.EN:
Don't give me that look, Jack.
I've done nothing wrong. I'm offended.
fields.JP:
そういう顔をしないでくれないか、ジャック。
僕は君に困惑されるようなことは何もしてないんだ
正直不快だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't give me that look, Jack.
I've done nothing wrong. I'm offended.

fields.EN:
Ugh. Such a baby. Jack, you didn't even say
anything. Don't apologize to him.
fields.JP:
もう、本当にデリカシーがないです～。
ジャックもそういうつもりはないんでしょうし、
謝らなくていいですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Such a baby. Jack, you didn't even say
anything. Don't apologize to him.

fields.EN:
Then I'll apologize. I had hoped seeing you
in person would jog something, but it doesn't.
fields.JP:
とにかく、申し訳ないが君たちの
顔を見れば何か思い出すかと思ったが、
まったく思い出すことはなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I'll apologize. I had hoped seeing you
in person would jog something, but it doesn't.

fields.EN:
Looks to me like Juu-san is a trace of the
Professor revived as a mimic.
fields.JP:
恐らくジュウさんは、博士の『名残』を
擬態化したような存在なのでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks to me like Toh is a trace of the
Professor revived as a mimic.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Which explains why wants to find his wife
so bad...
fields.JP:
だから、わらわ達ではなく最愛の奥さんに
会いたいという一心を抱いているのでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which explains why wants to find his wife
so bad...

fields.EN:
So all that chatter about being the Jail is because
his memories were fused with that tower only
moments before. But how is he a Blood Youth?
fields.JP:
でも『自分が監獄塔』、というのは直前の
監獄塔と融合した時の記憶が共有されたとして
理解できるけれど、何故、血式少年なのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So all that chatter about being the Jail is because
his memories were fused with that tower only
moments before. But how is he a Blood Youth?

fields.EN:
Somehow his appearance also looks like Jack's.
Hehe. It's flattery disguised as imitation.
fields.JP:
しかも少しジャックの面影がある。
ふふ……まるで『憧れ』を
抱いていたとでも言わんばかりね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Somehow his appearance also looks like Jack's.
Hehe. It's flattery disguised as imitation.

fields.EN:
No, it can't be flattery. Because when I look
at Jack, I become irritated.
fields.JP:
……それは、間違っていると思う。
なぜなら今、僕はジャックを見て
苛立っているからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it can't be flattery. Because when I look
at Jack, I become irritated.

fields.EN: What the heck did I do...
fields.JP:
そんな風に言われちゃうと、
どう返したらいいか……
fields.LOCALIZED: What the heck did I do...

fields.EN:
Well, we'll file this loose thread with Alice's
under things we still don't know.
fields.JP:
まあこの謎も、アリスの謎と同様、
いまだに分からないことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we'll file this loose thread with Alice's
under things we still don't know.

fields.EN:
Yeah... We've got a lot to figure out, but
I'm just happy we're all back together.
Especially since Boss is safe too!
fields.JP:
そうっすね……でも、謎は残ったままっすけど、
こうして再会できたことが何より嬉しいっすよ。
みんなも師匠も無事で本当によかったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... We've got a lot to figure out, but
I'm just happy we're all back together.
Especially since Boss is safe too!

fields.EN:
I think we've got a long ways to go before the
top of the tower, so why don't we make camp?
fields.JP:
そうだ、悪食の監隊塔の最上階は
まだまだずっと上の方だろうし、
ここら辺にみんなもキャンプを設営しない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think we've got a long ways to go before the
top of the tower, so why don't we make camp?

fields.EN: Then we can reunite with Miko-san and Haru-san too!
fields.JP:
それで視子さんやハルさんたちを交えて、
もう一度話をしようよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then we can reunite with Miko and Haru too!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san; ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: やったー！　大賛成っすー！！

fields.EN: Yeah. The more information we have, the better, and someone may have seen my wife. I'm in on that proposal too.
fields.JP:
そうだな。情報は１つでも多くあった方がいいし、
妻を見たという人間もいるかもしれない。
その提案、こちらも乗ろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. Best for us to keep up to date with
everything going on. Ready when you are.

fields.EN:
Good. Then let's split up and get everyone
to regroup here.
fields.JP:
よかった、それじゃあ後で解散したら、
みんなを呼んでまたここに集まろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good. Then let's split up and get everyone
to regroup here.

fields.EN:
Before we jump right back into a discussion,
maybe give everyone a second to decompress.
fields.JP:
では解散の前に、自由時間にしましょうか。
アレもそろそろ限界みたいだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before we jump right back into a discussion,
maybe give everyone a second to decompress.

fields.EN:
ARRRRGH! Let us go already, Gretel!
My feet are getting numb!
fields.JP:
ぬおーーーっ！
そろそろ自由にしろグレーテルーー！
我の足が痺れ死ぬではないかーーーー！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
ARRRRGH! Let us go already, Gretel!
My feet are getting numb!

fields.EN: Rapunzel wants to talk with everyone too!!
fields.JP: ラプンツェルもみんなとおしゃべりしたーい！！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
(Once discussions had concluded, we rejoiced
in our collective reunion.)
fields.JP:
（というわけで、話もまとまったところで、
　改めて再会を喜び合う時間を取ることにした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once discussions had concluded, we rejoiced
in our collective reunion.)

fields.EN: (Everyone talked with their companions through the glass, and the room quickly grew lively again...)
fields.JP:
（みんながガラス越しに仲間と話し、
　部屋の中はまた一気に賑やかになった……）

ネムちゃん！
無事で本当によかったです～～～！

fields.EN:
I had a feeling you were out there.
Nicely done, Nemu!
fields.JP:
きっと生きてるって信じてたわ。
頑張ったわね、ネム……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had a feeling you were out there.
Nicely done, Sleepy!

fields.EN:
Yup, yup... Oyayubi-neesama... Shirayuki-neesama...
I... worked hard...
fields.JP:
うん、うんっ……親指姉さま……白雪姉さま……
ボク……がんばった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup yup... Thumby... Snow White...
Worked...hard.
fields.notes: B12 source-form character identity restoration; B12 remove localized name insertion/fanfiction

fields.JP: シンデレラ！　げんきしてた！？

fields.EN: Great! You're radiant as ever, Rapu-Rapu!
fields.JP:
もちろんですわ！
ラプラプも変わりありませんわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Great! You're radiant as ever, Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Duh! Come, meet Shira! Here! She's a good girl!
fields.JP:
もちろーーーん！
あ、シラもしょうかいしてあげる！
このこ！　とってもいいこなんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Duh! Come, meet Pi! Here! She's a good girl!

fields.EN:
Hey Rapu, don't introduce me like that!
That's embarrassing!
fields.JP:
ちょっとラプ、その紹介の仕方
やめてよ、恥ずかしいじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Rappy, don't introduce me like that!
That's embarrassing!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
So this is the Genocide Pink member you
mentioned, Clara-san...
fields.JP:
この方が、さっきくららさんが言ってた
処刑台少女の……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this is the Massacre Pink member you
mentioned, Clara...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららさん => Clara-san; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: う……そ、そうよ。シラはどうせ……
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Shira's a really nice girl!
That's why she and Rapunzel are really good friends now!
fields.JP:
シラはとってもやさしいこだよ！
だからね、いまはラプンツェルと
とってもなかよしのおともだちなの！
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi's so nice! We're best buddies now!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Hehe. A friend of Rapu-Rapu's is a friend of mine.
Nice to meet you, Shira-san.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ラプラプのお友達なら、
いい子に決まってますわね。
よろしくね、シラさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. A friend of Rappy's is a friend of mine.
Pleased to meet you, Pi.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: R-Right...! Um, nice to meet you.
fields.JP:
う、うんっ……！
その……よ、よろしくね……
fields.LOCALIZED: R-Right...! Um, nice to meet you.

fields.EN: Otsuu, Ningyo! I'm glad to see you're both doing well!
fields.JP:
おつう、人魚！
貴様らも元気そうで何よりだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu! Mermie! You both made it!

fields.JP: 久しぶりのハーちゃんだぁ～～～！

fields.EN:
We might not have known each other long,
but the distance has made my heart fonder
of you. I worried the whole time about you!
fields.JP:
貴様らとは短いつきあいだが、
何故かこの中でいちばん長い気がしてな。
だからずっと気がかりだったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We might not have known each other long,
but the distance has made my heart fonder
of you. I worried the whole time about you!

fields.EN: We feel the same, don't we Princess?
fields.JP:
はは、僕たちもそんな気がしてるよ。
ね、姫？
fields.LOCALIZED: We feel the same, don't we Princess?

fields.EN: Yup! Nothing can ever keep us apart!
fields.JP: うん！　ずっと前から友達だったんだよ、きっと！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Nothing can ever keep us apart!

fields.EN: More than anything, I'm glad you're safe.
fields.JP:
それにしても、
本当にお互い生きててよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED: More than anything, I'm glad you're safe.

fields.EN:
Hahaha. No need to fear. I'm invyincible
after all!
fields.JP:
ふはは、心配などいらぬ。
なんせ我は無敵だかりゃにゃっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. No need to fear. I'm invyincible
after all!

fields.EN:
I-I'm not slurring! Don't you dare question
the great Demon King!
fields.JP:
噛んでなどないわ！
我は大魔王まで登りつめた存在であるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not slurring! Don't you dare question
the great Demon King!

fields.EN: Hahaha. The tower hasn't changed you a bit.
fields.JP: ふふふ、ハーちゃんはいつも元気だね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. The tower hasn't changed you a bit.

fields.JP: みなさん、本当に元気ですね～

fields.EN:
All this talking tires me out. I'm gonna rest,
so we can save the chit-chat for later.
fields.JP:
わらわはもう喋り疲れました～。
休んでるので、後で声かけて下さいね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
All this talking tires me out. I'm gonna rest,
so we can save the chit-chat for later.

fields.JP:
ジャック！　アリス！
あー本物だ～！
赤ずきんさん！　やっと会えたね！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I missed you so much. We haven't seen you
since we split up on the surface.
fields.JP:
地上に出てすぐに
はぐれてしまったから心配したわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I missed you so much. We haven't seen you
since we split up on the surface.

fields.EN: It warms my heart to see you.
fields.JP: でも変わらず元気そうでよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It warms my heart to see you.

fields.EN:
Haha. You know, until we found you guys,
I was starting to get real down...
fields.JP:
はは……いや、実はさっきまで
ものすごーく落ち込んでたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. You know, until we found you guys,
I was starting to get real down...

fields.EN:
But now that we've all reunited, I feel much
better.
fields.JP:
みんなに再会したら、
なんか色々元気になっちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now that we've all reunited, I feel much
better.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Aw. Too bad about these glass walls.
Just another obstacle before we're all
truly back together.
fields.JP:
あーあ、こんなガラスも壁もなければいいのにね。
みんなに会えたのは嬉しいけど、
ちょっと残念っていうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. Too bad about these glass walls.
Just another obstacle before we're all
truly back together.

fields.EN:
If only we could shatter the glass.
Like BAM! You know?
fields.JP:
なんかこう、どっかーんって壊せれば
よかったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we could shatter the glass.
Like BAM! You know?

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、どうしたの！？

fields.EN: Aww, I only made a little hole in the wall... I thought we'd finally get to see everyone properly!
fields.JP:
やっぱちょっとしか、かべにあなあかないよー。
せっかくみんなとちゃんとあえるとおもったのに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, the hole's too small! Man, thought I'd
break it!

fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは相変わらず
元気いっぱいだなぁ……

fields.EN:
These walls are tough. They seem to regenerate
when we damage them too. Even Rapunzel-san can't
put a dent in.
fields.JP:
やっぱりこの壁、相当堅いし、
開けてもすぐ塞がっちゃうみたいですね。
ラプンツェルさんの力でも駄目でしたか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
These walls are tough. They seem to regenerate
when we damage them too. Even Rapunzel can't
put a dent in.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.JP: そうね傷ひとつつかないしね……

fields.EN:
Nemu must be lonely. Too bad you're not
here.
fields.JP:
ネムも寂しいでしょ。
こっちに来られればよかったのにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy must be lonely. Too bad you're not
here.

fields.JP: あら、メンバー交代は拒否させてもらうわよ？
え？　それってどういう……

ネムちゃんをこっちに来させるのは
駄目なんですか……？

fields.EN:
Correct. Our party is currently the ideal size.
On top of having the strongest and most
efficient members.
fields.JP:
ええ。だって今の私たちにとっては、
これが最適解のメンバーだもの。今の構成が
最も強く、最も効率がいい構成なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct. Our party is currently the ideal size.
On top of having the strongest and most
efficient members.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
You're absolutely right! This is the ultimate
team!
fields.JP:
確かにそうっすね！
自分ら、この面子が最強メンバーっす！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're absolutely right! This is the ultimate
team!

fields.EN:
Hahaha! Ultimate, got that right!
You jealous?
fields.JP:
ふはは！　そうだ、我らこそが最強なのだ！
どーだ、うらやましいであろう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha! Ultimate, got that right!
You jealous?

fields.EN: Nobody can beat Rapunzel and the othersーーーー!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルたちはだれにも
まけないんだからーーーー！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
I see. Nemu... She's grown since I last saw
her. When did she get so strong...?
fields.JP:
そっか……ネムったら、
すっかり姉離れしちゃってるのね。
いつのまにか強くなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Sleepy... She's grown since I last saw
her. When did she get so strong...?

fields.EN:
What?! Well, WE have Juu-san to make rational
decisions and Aka-neesama to lead us into battle!
WE'RE the best team!
fields.JP:
なんの！　白雪たちだって冷静なジュウさんと、
頼りになる赤姉様がいるんです！
負けませんよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Well, WE have Toh to make rational
decisions and Sister Red to lead us into battle!
WE'RE the best team!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
What are you doing, Shirayukihime...?
Don't fan the flames.
fields.JP:
何をやってるんだ、白雪姫……
くだらない争いをするんじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing, Snow White...?
Don't fan the flames.

fields.EN:
But they need to know we're good too!
That way, they won't worry...
fields.JP:
でも、白雪たちもすごいんだぞ、
心配いらないぞって伝えたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But they need to know we're good too!
That way, they won't worry...

fields.EN:
That's true! Don't count us out!
We're the original Dawn girls!
Exceptional and seasoned!
fields.JP:
確かにわたくしたちはすごいですわね！
なにせこっちは黎明初期メンバー、
熟練度ではいちばんですわ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true! Don't count us out!
We're the original Dawn girls!
Exceptional and seasoned!

fields.EN:
It's true. We all got each other's back.
Even when we're barely getting over the line.
fields.JP:
確かに、面倒はいちばん見てくれそうです～。
まぁたまにみなさん、ポンコツになることも
ありますけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. We all got each other's back.
Even when we're barely getting over the line.

fields.EN:
(The team spirit is stronger than ever.
I've never seen everyone so united.)
fields.JP:
（みんな前よりずっと強くなったみたいだ。
　それに全体の結束も深まった気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The team spirit is stronger than ever.
I've never seen everyone so united.)

fields.EN:
(It looks like our separation was a chance
for everyone to work harder and closer as
teams to survive.)
fields.JP:
（きっと離ればなれになったことで、
　僕たちと同じように、絶対に生き残ってまた
　再会するんだって一心で頑張ってきたんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It looks like our separation was a chance
for everyone to work harder and closer as
teams to survive.)

fields.JP: ジャック、僕たちも負けていられないな

fields.EN: We also have the best team, don't we?
fields.JP:
わたしたちだって
このメンバーが最強だもんね？
fields.LOCALIZED: We also have the best team, don't we?

fields.EN:
Yeah... You said it, gang. We're the best
of the bunch!
fields.JP:
うん……そうだね。
僕たちだって負けてないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... You said it, gang. We're the best
of the bunch!

fields.EN:
Okay everyone! All three groups split up
and make it to the summit of the tower!
fields.JP:
よし、この３グループで、
絶対に悪食の監隊塔を攻略しよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay everyone! All three groups split up
and make it to the summit of the tower!

fields.EN: Ugh. Typical hero act. So lame.
fields.JP:
こええよ、陽キャのノリ。
マジでついていけねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Typical hero act. So lame.

fields.EN: Mary, are you muttering insults again?
fields.JP:
メアリー、なーんか
ひねくれたこと言ってない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, are you muttering insults again?

fields.JP: い、いやいや言ってねえって

fields.EN:
But...all this preachy, bondy talk makes
me sick. Way too positive here for me.
fields.JP:
……まぁ、照れずに絆だの結束だの言えちゃう
陽キャのノリも含めて、あいつらはすごいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...all this preachy, bondy talk makes
me sick. Way too positive here for me.

fields.EN:
Tell me why do-gooders always have to
brag about themselves...
fields.JP:
それを言えるだけ必死にここまで
努力してきたってことだからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tell me why do-gooders always have to
brag about themselves...

fields.EN: Why don't you join in, Mary?
fields.JP: メアリーもあの中に入ってくれば？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you join in, Mary?

fields.EN: Oh. Never. I'm just fine here.
fields.JP:
それは絶ッッッ対にイヤだね。
俺の立つ場所はここでいい
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Never. I'm just fine here.

fields.EN:
But knowing them, they'd welcome me
with open arms...
fields.JP:
まぁ、あいつらなら、
受け入れてくれんだろけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But knowing them, they'd welcome me
with open arms...

fields.EN: Okay. See you all back here later!
fields.JP:
よし、それじゃあみんな、
後でまたここに集合しよう！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. See you all back here later!

fields.JP: そうか、みんな無事だったか！

fields.EN:
Yeah. Looks like everyone survived okay.
They're even cooperating better than usual.
fields.JP:
うん。みんな変わらず元気で、
前より頼もしくなってたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Looks like everyone survived okay.
They're even cooperating better than usual.

fields.EN:
And Itsuki, Kaede, Takumi. All of them are
there, right? Ahh! Incredible.
fields.JP:
それにイツキもカエデもタクミも、
全員いるんだろ？　くぅ～、最高じゃねえか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And Itsuki, Kaede, Takumi. All of them are
there, right? Ahh! Incredible.

fields.EN:
None of them is the type to go down
without a fight.
fields.JP:
あの人たちも
そう簡単に死ぬタマじゃないしな
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of them is the type to go down
without a fight.

fields.EN:
Yup. They broke out of the underground Jail
after all. So that means we can finally see
each other.
fields.JP:
ああ。だてに地下監獄を
生き延びてきてねえってな。
そうか、あいつらにもようやく会えるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. They broke out of the underground Jail
after all. So that means we can finally see
each other.

fields.EN: But our sleepy young lady still hasn't woken up, even though it's finally time for our reunion.
fields.JP:
でもウチの居眠りお嬢さんは、
まだ目が覚めないんだよなあ。
せっかく再会の時だってのによ
fields.LOCALIZED: But Sleepyhead still hasn't woken up.

fields.EN:
Hey Hikari. At this rate, when you wake up
there will be too many things for you to be
surprised for.
fields.JP:
おーいヒカリ、このままじゃお前が起きた時には
ビックリすることだらけだぞー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Hikari. At this rate, when you wake up
there will be too many things for you to be
surprised for.

fields.EN:
Mamoru-san. You sure like to pinch
Hikari-chan's cheeks...
fields.JP:
マモルさん、ヒカリちゃんの
ほっぺ引っ張るの好きだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mamoru. You sure like to pinch
Hikari's cheeks...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: マモルさん => Mamoru-san; ヒカリちゃん => Hikari-chan

fields.EN:
Her reaction is so entertaining I can't
help it. And I can check that she's safe.
fields.JP:
反応が面白くてつい、な。
無事の確認にもなるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her reaction is so entertaining I can't
help it. And I can check that she's safe.

fields.EN:
So the old man, Kadowaki, and Kunai all made
it, huh? Figures they were in good hands with
Akazukin.
fields.JP:
それにしても、あのオヤジや門脇くん、
クナイも生きててくれたとはね。
赤ずきんたちのグループなら、安心だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So the old man, Kadowaki, and Kunai all made
it, huh? Figures they were in good hands with
Red Riding Hood.

fields.JP: （あのオヤジ……ハルさんのことかな）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
What fortune for us to reunite after being
scattered for so long. Fate smiles upon us.
fields.JP:
バラバラだったみんなが、また集まった。
全てはいっこに導かれてるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
What fortune for us to reunite after being
scattered for so long. Fate smiles upon us.

fields.EN:
To think there are other survivors aside
from us here... Happy Sukui-san survived too.
fields.JP:
まさか私たちの信者にも無事な人がいるなんて……
そうか、スクイさん生きててくれたか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To think there are other survivors aside
from us here... Happy Sukui survived too.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: スクイさん => Sukui-san

fields.EN:
As we discussed earlier, we're planning to
join up with the rest of the group if possible
tomorrow. Which means moving camp.
fields.JP:
それで、さっきも話しましたけど、
明日にでもみんなに会いに行こうと思うんです。
可能であればキャンプ地も移したいですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
As we discussed earlier, we're planning to
join up with the rest of the group if possible
tomorrow. Which means moving camp.

fields.EN: Good plan. Let's waste no time.
fields.JP:
いいと思うぜ。
善は急げってやつだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Good plan. Let's waste no time.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: でも明日とは……随分と急だね

fields.EN:
We're running against the clock.
Sorry for rushing you guys.
fields.JP:
確かにそうなんですけど、
僕たちも一刻を争う状況ですから……
バタバタさせちゃってごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're running against the clock.
Sorry for rushing you guys.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
No need to apologize. You've been awaiting
this moment for some time.
fields.JP:
いや、仲間との再会だ、
気持ちが逸るのは仕方のないことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to apologize. You've been awaiting
this moment for some time.

fields.JP: じゃあ明日早速、みんなで行きましょう

fields.EN: I'd like to find a way for us to join up somehow, too.
fields.JP:
どうにかして合流できないか、
道も見つけたいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hopefully this time we can actually be
together with everyone.

fields.EN: Yeah. So close, yet so far.
fields.JP: 確かに、嬉しいけどもどかしいよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. So close, yet so far.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Lest we forget, the threat of Genocide Pink
still hides somewhere...
fields.JP:
それにしても、そうか
処刑台少女の子もいるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lest we forget, the threat of Massacre Pink
still hides somewhere...
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
Hey Jack, do we still have some time before
we meet up with everyone?
fields.JP:
なあジャック、その待ち合わせ場所ってのは
まだまだ先なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Jack, do we still have some time before
we meet up with everyone?

fields.EN: No, we're almost there. Just beyond this room.
fields.JP: いや、もう着くよ。この先の部屋なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: No, we're almost there. Just beyond this room.

fields.EN: Hehe. I wonder how they'll react.
fields.JP: ひひ、あいつらどんな顔すんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I wonder how they'll react.

fields.EN: Maybe something happened to the others!
fields.JP: もしかして、みんなに何かあったのかも！
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe something happened to the others!

fields.EN: Oh no! They're attacking Clara's party!
fields.JP: なんてこと……くららたちが襲われてるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no! They're attacking Clara's party!

fields.EN: Hey, what's that monster?! A Nightmare?!
fields.JP:
おいおい、何だよあの黒い物体は……！
まさかナイトメアか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, what's that monster?! A Nightmare?!

fields.EN:
(Huh? Its head looks like a monitor.
Looks like it's turning on.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　頭のモニターみたいなものに
　何かが映し出されてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Its head looks like a monitor.
Looks like it's turning on.)

fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Oh... Guillotine, and Iron Maiden, and Kubitsuridai.
Those wretched monsters from the surface!
fields.JP:
本当だ……ギロチン、
それと確かアイアン・メイデンと首吊り台……
あの時地上にいた奴らだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... Guillotine, and Iron Maiden, and Gallows.
Those wretched monsters from the surface!

fields.JP:
ニイザン！！
　　　　ババ！
　　　　　　　ヒアブリバジラゴロズッ！

fields.EN: No, Guillotine-neesan, Kubitsuri-neesan, Mei-neesan, go away... Please leave me alone.
fields.JP:
いや……ギロチン姉さん……
首吊り姉さん……メイ姉さん……来ないで……
お願いだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, Sister Guillotine, Sister Gallows, Sister
Mei, go away... Please leave me alone.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san; ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san; メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN: Hey, leave Shira alone! Stupid Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ええい、シラに手を出すでない！
このナイトメア風情が！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, leave Pi alone! Stupid Nightmare!

fields.JP: シラをいじめるなーーー！！

fields.EN:
You guys! Don't get too close! We haven't
destroyed the core yet!
fields.JP:
２人とも！　懐に入り過ぎちゃダメっす！
まだ核壊してないんすから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You guys! Don't get too close! We haven't
destroyed the core yet!

fields.JP:
ドボジデオマエダゲ……
ゴロス、ゴロスゴロス……ヴァァァァ！！

fields.EN: No! Go away! I said go!
fields.JP: やだっ、来ないで……来ないでってばぁ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! Go away! I said go!

fields.JP: ネムちゃん！　みなさん！

fields.EN: Can't we help her?! Hurry, or they'll...!
fields.JP:
どうにかできないの！？
早くしないとみんなが……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't we help her?! Hurry, or they'll...!

fields.EN:
We can't. Not even Rapu-Rapu could penetrate
these walls!
fields.JP:
駄目ですわ、ラプラプでも
壊せなかった壁ですのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't. Not even Rappy could penetrate
these walls!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプラプ -> Rapu-Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Come over here, Nightmare! We'll take you on!
fields.JP:
こっちに来いナイトメア！
あたしたちが相手をしてやる！
fields.LOCALIZED: Come on, Nightmare! I'll fight you!

fields.EN: It's totally ignoring us. What do we do...?
fields.JP: 全然見向きもしないですね……どうすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's totally ignoring us. What do we do...?

fields.JP: こっちに来いってばぁっ！！
しっかりするんだ、みんな！

fields.EN: Can't we lure it out somehow...?
fields.JP:
何とかしてわたしたちの方に
引きつけるには……
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't we lure it out somehow...?

fields.EN: Jack, just to make sure—there wasn't a core room anywhere nearby, right?
fields.JP:
ジャック、一応聞くけど、
近くに核の部屋なんてなかったわね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, quickly now. Are there any cores nearby?

fields.EN: Yeah, I don't sense any nearby.
fields.JP: うん、この辺りにはないみたいなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I don't sense any nearby.

fields.EN:
Oh no. This darkness is relentness. We move,
and it follows.
fields.JP:
困ったわね。暗闇の空間を抜けようが
何をしようが、執拗に追いかけてくるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no. This darkness is relentness. We move,
and it follows.

fields.EN:
I've been trying to distract it, but it's not
taking the bait. Running out of ideas!
fields.JP:
あたし達もさっきみたいに色々
気を引こうとしてるんだけど、
全然振り向いてもくれないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been trying to distract it, but it's not
taking the bait. Running out of ideas!

fields.EN: And we're still stuck in this glass cage!
fields.JP:
そっち側に行く方法も、
まだ考えつかないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED: And we're still stuck in this glass cage!

fields.JP: ジラァァァ……ジラァァァァァァァァッ！

あんなナイトメアが来たら
ひとたまりもない……

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: じじ、自分たちはどうしたらいいんだろうか

fields.EN:
(Even if there were only Blood Maidens here,
this situation is extremely dangerous.)
fields.JP:
（確かにこの場に血式少女以外の
　人間がいても、ただ危険が増すだけか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Even if there were only Blood Maidens here,
this situation is extremely dangerous.)

fields.EN: Got it. I'll guide everyone somewhere safe.
fields.JP: わかった、わたしがみんなを安全な場所に連れて行くよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. I'll guide everyone somewhere safe.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: The camp staff should probably join her.
fields.JP:
じゃあキャンプ組は
この場を離れましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: The camp staff should probably join her.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
We got Miko-san and the others behind cover,
but we've got more pressing issues.
fields.JP:
視子さんたちは避難させたけど、
問題はこっちよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We got Miko and the others behind cover,
but we've got more pressing issues.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Yeah. Our friends aren't gonna last much
longer. We gotta do something.
fields.JP:
こうしている間にも、
戦ってるみんながどんどん疲弊してってる。
何とかしないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Our friends aren't gonna last much
longer. We gotta do something.

fields.EN: Trying to think, but I'm running out of time.
fields.JP:
色々考えてるけど、
駄目だ、いい手が思いつかない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Trying to think, but I'm running out of time.

fields.EN: Everyone's in danger, and there's nothing we can do... Damn it!
fields.JP:
みんなが危険な目に遭ってるっていうのに、
僕たちは何もできないなんて……くそっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Curse this unbreakable glass.
We must rescue our friends! Damn it!

fields.EN:
(No matter how many times we hit the
wall, it reforms immediately.)
fields.JP:
（つうが壁を殴っても、
　わずかに小さい穴が開くだけ……
　しかも、それもすぐに閉じてしまう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No matter how many times we hit the
wall, it reforms immediately.)

fields.EN:
(Not even the mighty Rapunzel could break
through the enchanted wall. What do we do?)
fields.JP:
（そもそも力自慢のラプンツェルが
　殴っても壊れなかった壁だ。どうする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not even the mighty Rapunzel could break
through the enchanted wall. What do we do?)

fields.EN:
No, no, neesan, forgive Shira...!
Don't kill Shira...!
fields.JP:
いや、いや、姉さんもう許して……！
シラを殺さないで……！
fields.LOCALIZED: No, please. Sisters, forgive me! Have mercy!
