fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: くっ……待ってて。今何とかするから……！

fields.EN:
That Genocide Pink monstrosity is about
to kill Shira. It looks unstoppable...
fields.JP:
あの処刑台少女のナイトメアは、
シラって子を執拗に殺そうとしている……
きっと殺すまで止まらない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Massacre Pink monstrosity is about
to kill Pi. It looks unstoppable...
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Do we search for the core so we can combat
it? No, we don't have time...
fields.JP:
今のうちに核を探して破壊する？
いや、それは現実的じゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do we search for the core so we can combat
it? No, we don't have time...

fields.EN:
Create a diversion for the Nightmare?
Ugh, no. We tried that already.
fields.JP:
何とかしてナイトメアの気を引く……
駄目だ、そんなのもうとっくに試して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Create a diversion for the Nightmare?
Ugh, no. We tried that already.

fields.EN:
If only we could cloak or hide that Shira girl
somehow...
fields.JP:
何とかあのシラって子を
認識できないようにすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only we could cloak or hide that Pi girl
somehow...

fields.EN:
As you said, that Nightmare is indeed
pursuing that Shira girl.
fields.JP:
お前の言うとおり、あのナイトメアは
シラという処刑台少女を狙っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you said, that Nightmare is indeed
pursuing that Pi girl.

fields.EN:
Listen. Our only chance of saving her is to
fool it into thinking she's gone, or finding
a new target.
fields.JP:
いいか、シラを殺させずにあれを止めるには、
その代わりとなるもの、あるいは
『いなくなった』と思わせる方法が必要だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen. Our only chance of saving her is to
fool it into thinking she's gone, or finding
a new target.

fields.EN:
New target...? Whoever that thing targets
is in for a world of hurt.
fields.JP:
代わり……？
いや、結局代わりがいても、
その人が狙われるだけだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
New target...? Whoever that thing targets
is in for a world of hurt.

fields.EN:
But fooling it... How though?
Wait. I've thought of something...
fields.JP:
いなくなった……いなくなった？
待って、何か方法があるような気がする……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But fooling it... How though?
Wait. I've thought of something...

fields.JP: やめて、お願い来ないで――きゃっ！
シラさん、立ち上がるっす！！
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
ババ……ババババババ……
ニイザンニイザンニイザンニイザン……

fields.EN:
I WON'T...FORGIB YOUUUUU....
YOU TOO, COME HEEEERE....JIRAAAAAA!!
fields.JP:
ユルゼナイ……ユルゼナイィィィ……
オマエモコッヂニゴイ……ジラァァァァアア！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WON'T...FORGIB YOUUUUU....
YOU DID THIS TO ME....PYREEEE!

fields.EN: I see. Clara and Gretel's group got held up...
fields.JP:
そう……くららや
グレーテルのグループは不参加なのね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Clara and Gretel's group got held up...

fields.EN:
Yeah. The Nightmare attacked one of their
crew members out of nowhere.
fields.JP:
はい、向こうの仲間の子が
ナイトメアのせいで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. The Nightmare attacked one of their
crew members out of nowhere.

fields.EN:
Honestly, things went south quick.
So much for the tender reunion.
fields.JP:
それで、正直再会を喜べる状態では
ないということで、参加は見合わせるそうです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, things went south quick.
So much for the tender reunion.

fields.EN:
Hard to come back from such a traumatic scene. 
Cinderella and Akazukin won't be joining
us either.
fields.JP:
確かにあんな凄惨な光景を
見てしまっては立ち直れないだろう。
こちらもシンデレラと赤ずきんは不参加だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hard to come back from such a traumatic scene. 
Cinderella and Red Riding Hood won't be joining
us either.

fields.EN:
Gretel said not to worry and to go ahead.
She wanted the rest of us to gather and
debrief.
fields.JP:
グレーテルからは、気にせず進めてほしいと
言われています。再会とともに、情報の交換も
しておいてほしいから、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel said not to worry and to go ahead.
She wanted the rest of us to gather and
debrief.

fields.EN:
Taking down the Devouring Armada might
be our best chance to avenge them.
Let's proceed.
fields.JP:
悪食の監隊塔を止めることが
その子への弔いになるかもしれない。
お言葉に甘えて進めさせてもらいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Taking down the Devouring Armada might
be our best chance to avenge them.
Let's proceed.

fields.EN:
Jabberwock-san, was it? You really do look just
like him.
fields.JP:
それにしてもジャバウォックさん、でしたっけ。
本当に博士とそっくりなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jabberwock, was it? You really do look just
like him.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN: Haha. We are twins, after all.
fields.JP: はは、双子というわけではないのだがね
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. We are twins, after all.

fields.EN:
(They're so similar. Like a living copy.
I should keep my guard up around him.)
fields.JP:
（本当に、よく似ている。
　生き写しっていうのはこいうことを言うんだろう。
　だからこそ、つい身構えてしまうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're so similar. Like a living copy.
I should keep my guard up around him.)

fields.EN: Hm, are you...Gatou? Gatou, is that you?
fields.JP:
ん……もしかして君は
賀東君……賀東君なのか！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm, are you...Gato? Gato, is that you?
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Ah. It's been a while, Jabberwock.
Happy to see you're still alive.
fields.JP:
ああ……久しぶり、ジャバウォック。
君が生きててくれて嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. It's been a while, Jabberwock.
Happy to see you're still alive.

fields.JP:
面影があったからもしやと思ったが、
やはりそうだったか……！

fields.EN:
But how long has it been...? You've aged.
Looks like you've had some rough years.
fields.JP:
ずいぶんと雰囲気が変わったように見えるが……
それほどに老けて大変な日々を過ごしてきたのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But how long has it been...? You've aged.
Looks like you've had some rough years.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Yes. Lot's changed since then. I'm not as
spry as I used to be, but to tell you the truth,
I'm just happy to be here.
fields.JP:
ええ、まあ色々ありましたからね。
一気に老け込んでしまいましたが、
こうして生きているだけでもマシです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Lot's changed since then. I'm not as
spry as I used to be, but to tell you the truth,
I'm just happy to be here.

fields.JP:
（賀東さんって、
　実は見た目よりもだいぶ若いのか）
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
Yo Jack, how've you been? Looks like you've
grown a lot, kid.
fields.JP:
ようジャック、元気してたか？
なんかしばらく見ねえうちに
随分と頼もしい感じになりやがって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yo Jack, how've you been? Looks like you've
grown a lot, kid.

fields.EN:
Haru-san! Y-you think? Between you and me,
I wouldn't be here if it weren't for them.
fields.JP:
ハルさん……！
そ、そうですか？　僕なんてまだまだ
みんなに頼りっぱなしで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru! Y-you think? Between you and me,
I wouldn't be here if it weren't for them.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Ah, they're still savin' your skin?
You're lucky to have them, but they're
lucky to have you too.
fields.JP:
あーそういうところは変わってねえか。
でもまあ、その方がお前らしくて安心するけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, they're still savin' your skin?
You're lucky to have them, but they're
lucky to have you too.

fields.EN: Jack, good luck out there. You'll need it.
fields.JP:
なあジャック、この戦いも
きっとあと少しだ。だから絶対に……
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, good luck out there. You'll need it.

fields.JP:
やっぱガラじゃねえな。
ま、とにかくお互い生き残ろうぜ

fields.EN:
Nice to see you, Kadowaki. Glad you're
holding up well.
fields.JP:
門脇くん、久しぶり。
変わりないようでよかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nice to see you, Kadowaki. Glad you're
holding up well.

fields.EN:
Ueshima! Aaah! Feels like ages since I've
talked to another human.
fields.JP:
ウエシマさん！　あー久しぶりに
普通の人間に会えた気がするよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ueshima! Aaah! Feels like ages since I've
talked to another human.

fields.EN: Kadowaki-san, there you go saying that again! We just talked the other day about you trying to get closer to everyone!
fields.JP:
門脇さん、またそんなこと言って！
この間みんなに歩み寄るって
話をしたばっかりじゃないですか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, Kadowaki! Why do you say that?!
I'm right here, we just had this conversation!

fields.EN: Sorry, sorry. Totally forgot about Klutzy!
fields.JP:
ごめんごめん、どじっ子と話してたこと
普通に忘れてた！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, sorry. Totally forgot about Klutzy!

fields.EN:
Meanie! That's so rude! Hope you enjoy
your meatless stew at dinner!
fields.JP:
ひどいです！　もう門脇さんのごはんだけ
お肉抜きにしちゃいますよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Meanie! That's so rude! Hope you enjoy
your meatless stew at dinner!

fields.EN:
Crap. Now I've done it. Meals are the only
thing I'm living for these days...
fields.JP: それは困る……食事が唯一の楽しみなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Crap. Now I've done it. Meals are the only
thing I'm living for these days...

fields.EN:
Sounds pretty awkward over there, but
happy you all made it okay.
fields.JP:
なんかこじれてるみたいだけど、
２人とも元気そうで何よりだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds pretty awkward over there, but
happy you all made it okay.

fields.EN: Yeah. Shame about the glass dividers...
fields.JP:
ああ、みんなガラス越しじゃなくて
ちゃんと合流できればなあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Shame about the glass dividers...

fields.EN:
Oh, didn't someone say something about a
Nightmare around here? Is it okay now?
fields.JP:
あれ、そういえばここって
ちょっと前までナイトメアがいたんだろ？
今は大丈夫なのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, didn't someone say something about a
Nightmare around here? Is it okay now?

fields.EN: Hey, Kadowaki! Don't bring that up, remember?
fields.JP:
ちょっと、門脇さん！
ここでその話はいけませんって……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, Kadowaki! Don't bring that up, remember?

fields.JP: そうか？　だってちょっと怖いじゃないか

fields.EN: It's fine. The Nightmare's not coming back.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ですよ。
今はそのナイトメアは現れません
fields.LOCALIZED: It's fine. The Nightmare's not coming back.

fields.EN: Really?! Um, how do you know?
fields.JP: 本当かい！？　……ん、どうして分かるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really?! Um, how do you know?

fields.EN: Well, it was Genocide Pink's Nightmare...
fields.JP:
それは、少し前までいた
処刑台少女のナイトメア……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, it was Massacre Pink's Nightmare...
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
It's because their master, also known as
Papa, is here with us.
fields.JP:
その主人である『マスター』
もしくは『パパ』なる人物が、
今この場にいるからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because their master, also known as
Papa, is here with us.

fields.JP: うん。間違いないと思う

fields.EN: You must be Jack. Please, explain yourself.
fields.JP:
ジャック君といったね。
それはいったい、どういうことだい？
fields.LOCALIZED: You must be Jack. Please, explain yourself.

fields.EN:
Each tower is normally guarded by a Nightmare.
It'll aggressively pursue us if we're seen, but
if we lose it, then it goes back to its rounds.
fields.JP:
ナイトメアっていうのは監獄塔の番人で、
僕たちを見つけたら、全力で追いかけてくる。
でも見失えば、奴はまた巡回に戻ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each tower is normally guarded by a Nightmare.
It'll aggressively pursue us if we're seen, but
if we lose it, then it goes back to its rounds.

fields.EN:
But the one that attacked Shira just chased
and chased her. Even when she got out of
the darkness or left the room.
fields.JP:
なのに、シラという子を襲ったナイトメアは、
執拗にその子を追い続けた。暗闇から逃れても、
部屋を跨いでも、振り切れなかったみたいなんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the one that attacked Pyre just chased
and chased her. Even when she got out of
the darkness or left the room.

fields.EN:
I've never seen one act like that before,
chasing one target instead of everyone
in sight. Really unusual.
fields.JP:
番人が『人間たち』じゃなく『個人』に
執着するなんて、聞いたこともありません。
あまりにナイトメア“らしくない”。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen one act like that before,
chasing one target instead of everyone
in sight. Really unusual.

fields.EN:
That's a good point. That behavior is atypical
for Nightmares.
fields.JP:
確かにそうね。
やつらは人間をそういう風には見ていない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's a good point. That behavior is atypical
for Nightmares.

fields.EN:
It got me thinking. What if this "Master,"
the presumed warden of the Devouring Armada
Tower, is ordering the Nightmare?
fields.JP:
だから僕はこう考えたんです。
悪食の監隊塔の管理者と思われる『マスター』が、
ナイトメアに指示を送っていたんじゃないかって
fields.LOCALIZED:
It got me thinking. What if this "Master,"
the presumed warden of the Devouring Armada
Tower, is ordering the Nightmare?

fields.EN: I see. If this 'Master' is controlling it, then it can make the Nightmare relentlessly target one person or keep a Nightmare from appearing here right now.
fields.JP:
なるほど、確かにマスターとやらが操ってるなら、
１人を執拗に狙うことも、今ここにナイトメアを
出さないことも自由自在だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. That would explain how the Nightmare
acted with specific instructions.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: But what makes you suspect he's here?
fields.JP:
だが、何故君は、
マスターとやらがこの中にいると……？
fields.LOCALIZED: But what makes you suspect he's here?

fields.EN:
Because too many irregularities have been
occurring since the moment we set foot up
here.
fields.JP:
僕たちが地上に出てから、
おかしなことがいくつもあったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because too many irregularities have been
occurring since the moment we set foot up
here.

fields.EN:
For example, Genocide Pink's been on our
tails the whole time. Enough to wait for us
at every orb we've encountered.
fields.JP:
例えば、処刑台少女たちは
こちらの動向を事細かに把握していました。
光る球体の前で待ち伏せされたのがその証拠です
fields.LOCALIZED:
For example, Massacre Pink's been on our
tails the whole time. Enough to wait for us
at every orb we've encountered.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
But they had plenty of earlier chances to do
us harm. Like when we're at camp.
fields.JP:
にも関わらずあいつらは、僕らが一番無防備になる
キャンプ地を襲ってこなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But they had plenty of earlier chances to do
us harm. Like when we're at camp.

fields.EN:
My guess, that's because their master was
among our ranks.
fields.JP:
おそらくそれは、僕らの中に
『マスター』と呼ばれる人物がいたからです
fields.LOCALIZED:
My guess, that's because their master was
among our ranks.

fields.EN:
But didn't we engage with Genocide Pink
on several occasions?
fields.JP: だが、処刑台少女とは何度となく戦っただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But didn't we engage with Massacre Pink
on several occasions?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
Sure we did, but during every fight, each one
of them muttered about some objective she
had been given.
fields.JP:
そうですね、確かに戦いました。
ただそれは処刑台少女たちが独断で
行動したようでした。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure we did, but during every fight, each one
of them muttered about some objective she
had been given.

fields.EN:
Right. They did take umbrage because we
encroached upon their dominions.
fields.JP:
あれは自分の縄張りを荒らされて
怒っていたって感じだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. They did take umbrage because we
encroached upon their dominions.

fields.JP: 確かに、そんな風に見えたわね

fields.EN:
Besides, Genocide Pink always left before
we could question them.
fields.JP:
それに、処刑台少女はいつも
戦いの途中で引き上げていった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, Massacre Pink always left before
we could question them.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: Almost like Master rushed them out of there.
fields.JP: まるで、慌てたマスターが止めに入ったみたいに
fields.LOCALIZED: Almost like Master rushed them out of there.

fields.EN:
One more thing, the girls seemed especially
interested in Alice.
fields.JP:
もうひとつ、彼女たちはずっと
『アリス』のことを特別気にかけていたんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
One more thing, the girls seemed especially
interested in Alice.

fields.EN:
The first thing Guillotine asked us when we
got to the surface was which of us is Alice.
fields.JP:
地上に出てすぐ処刑台少女に襲われました。
その時、ギロチンは『アリスはどいつだ』って
僕たちに聞いてきたんです。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The first thing Guillotine asked us when we
got to the surface was which of us is Alice.

fields.JP: どういうことだ？　なぜアリスだけを……
理由はわたしにも分からないんです

fields.EN:
Judging by what Genocide Pink's told us,
they both fear and respect their master.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女の口ぶりからしてもマスターを
かなり恐れているし、敬ってもいる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Judging by what Massacre Pink's told us,
they both fear and respect their master.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
But if they get flustered, there's a shift.
Each girl rejects her protocol and acts
on her own.
fields.JP:
なのに、感情が高ぶれば命令を忘れて
独断専行してしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if they get flustered, there's a shift.
Each girl rejects her protocol and acts
on her own.

fields.EN:
That led me to think of how much of a
headache that must be for Master.
fields.JP:
マスターも部下として頭が痛い存在だった
んじゃないかと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That led me to think of how much of a
headache that must be for Master.

fields.EN:
If they happened to kill Alice on accident,
how could this master intervene?
fields.JP:
万が一にもアリスを殺してしまいかねない。
だったら、どうやってそれを止めるか──
fields.LOCALIZED:
If they happened to kill Alice on accident,
how could this master intervene?

fields.EN:
I figure his best bet would be to find a way
to keep watch over her directly.
fields.JP:
僕は、実際にアリスの近くにいて
監視をするんじゃないかと考えました。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figure his best bet would be to find a way
to keep watch over her directly.

fields.EN:
I see. The logic is valid. The next question,
who or what is their master, Papa, whatever?
fields.JP:
なるほど、理屈は通っている。
でも今私たちが知りたいのは、
黒幕であるマスターだかパパだかの正体だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. The logic is valid. The next question,
who or what is their master, Papa, whatever?

fields.EN: Jack-kun, do you have a prediction?
fields.JP: もしや、ジャックくんには目星がついているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, do you have a prediction?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
All along, there was one person who saved
Alice from the brink of death.
fields.JP:
実はこの中でひとり、
アリスの命を不自然に助けた人がいるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
All along, there was one person who saved
Alice from the brink of death.

fields.EN:
That's right. When we first arrived on the
surface, Alice nearly died trying to save me.
Hikari warped us away shortly after.
fields.JP:
そう、あれは地上に出た時に、
アリスが僕を守るために瀕死になり、
ヒカリによって散り散りに飛ばされた後のことです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. When we first arrived on the
surface, Alice nearly died trying to save me.
Hikari warped us away shortly after.

fields.EN:
But someone healed Alice when she was
unconscious on the floor of a Jail tower,
then they left her.
fields.JP:
監獄塔で倒れていたアリスを治療し、
しかしその場を去るという行動を
取った人物がいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
But someone healed Alice when she was
unconscious on the floor of a Jail tower,
then they left her.

fields.EN:
Why would someone treat her, but not
stick around to see if she's okay?
Seems strange, especially in Jail.
fields.JP:
治療しながらも介抱はしない……
それは確かに、監獄塔においてはかなり不自然だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why would someone treat her, but not
stick around to see if she's okay?
Seems strange, especially in Jail.

fields.EN:
Looks to me like whoever it was wanted
Alice to live, but didn't want their identity
to be known.
fields.JP:
アリスに生きててもらいたい。
でも一緒にいるところを見られて、
変に勘ぐられたくない――ってところだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks to me like whoever it was wanted
Alice to live, but didn't want their identity
to be known.

fields.EN:
Mary, however, saw the whole thing.
Didn't you, Mary?
fields.JP:
で、実はその人物をメアリーが見ているんです。
そうだよね、メアリー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, however, saw the whole thing.
Didn't you, Mary?

fields.EN:
You're gonna put me on the spot here?
Talk to Jack... Talk to Jack.
fields.JP:
そこで俺に振るのかよ。
ジャ、ジャックに話しかけるように……。
ジャックと話すように……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're gonna put me on the spot here?
Talk to Jack... Talk to Jack.

fields.EN:
...Yes, it's true. I saw whoever healed Alice
with my own eyes.
fields.JP:
ああ。確かに俺は、アリスを治療して
すぐどこかに行っちまった奴を
この目でしっかりと見たぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Yes, it's true. I saw whoever healed Alice
with my own eyes.

fields.JP: で、それはいったい誰なんだ？

fields.EN: The person who gave Alice treatment is...
fields.JP: アリスを不自然に治療した人。それは――
fields.LOCALIZED: The person who gave Alice treatment is...

fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Now, hold the phone. Where's this coming from?
fields.JP:
お、おいおい、本気で言ってるのかい？
さすがに、あまりにも突飛すぎるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, hold the phone. Where's this coming from?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I was with Chiaki-san at that time. I hadn't even
met Alice-san yet.
fields.JP:
じ、自分はあの時、千昭さんと一緒にいたし、
アリスさんとはまだ出会っていなかったんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was with Chiaki at that time. I hadn't even
met Alice yet.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 千昭さん => Chiaki-san; アリスさん => Alice-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Even if I had, I would have certainly taken
her somewhere safe. Isn't that obvious?
fields.JP:
それに仮に出会っていたとしたら、
ちゃんと安全な場所まで連れて行ったよ。
あ、当たり前だろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I had, I would have certainly taken
her somewhere safe. Isn't that obvious?

fields.EN:
Gatou, was it? Have you noticed nothing
you've said has refuted Jack's points?
fields.JP:
賀東といったか。お前、
今の弁解では何一つジャックの指摘に対して
反証を挙げられていないことは分かるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato, was it? Have you noticed nothing
you've said has refuted Jack's points?
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
There's no proof you weren't there before
you met Hitsuka. And we have a witness.
fields.JP:
お前がそこの陽司とやらに出会う前に、
アリスを治療してないという証拠はない。
そして何より、目撃者がいるんだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no proof you weren't there before
you met Hitsuka. And we have a witness.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Well, Mary-san must be mistaken! I swear I never
did such a thing!
fields.JP:
そ、それはメアリーさんが見間違えたんだろう。
誓って自分は、そんな場所にはいなかったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, Mary must be mistaken! I swear I never
did such a thing!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーさん => Mary-san

fields.EN: No, Gatou-san. You were there. I have proof.
fields.JP:
いや、あの時賀東さんは確かにいました。
それを証明するものも、ここにあります
fields.LOCALIZED: No, Gato. You were there. I have proof.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

behind evidence of his misdoings.)

(Damn it! How could I mess up so bad!

(Damn it! How could I mess up so bad!

違う、地震じゃないわ！

くっ、このままじゃ地面に激突して

僕たちの身体はことごとく吹き飛ばされ、

the walls.)

Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

other day.

どうしてだ、
この間返してもらったはずじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
How...? I thought you returned it to me the
other day.

Sorry. The one we gave back to you was, um,
a fake. This is the real one.
fields.JP:
すみません、この間お返ししたのは
その、偽物で……こっちが本物なんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. The one we gave back to you was, um,
a fake. This is the real one.

この懐中時計、実は前にメアリーが壊しちゃって、
それでメアリーがマッチ棒で擬態化させた

You see, the pocket watch I gave you is a decoy 
Mary created with one of her matches.

fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. Gonna take out one of my matches...

fields.JP: なにしてんのメアリー？

しっ！
お前は黙ってろ

(A watch just came out of the smoke!

それでメアリー、
この懐中時計はどこで拾ったんだい？

ああ、アリスが瀕死で倒れてただろ？

そりゃあ誰かがアリスに近づいた時に

the world.

That could only mean one thing, Gatou-san.

つまりこれは、賀東さんのもの。
だからアリスを治療したのは、

fields.LOCALIZED:

ただ誰かが瀕死になっていて、

賀東さん、その右ポケットに
入っているモノを見せて下さいますか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato, could you show me what's in your
right pocket?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
What's...in my pocket? Nothing special.
I only carry a memo pad for use during
exploration.
fields.JP:
こっ……このポケットに入ってるものかい？
残念だけどたいしたモノは入ってないよ。
探索の時に使うメモ帳とかで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's...in my pocket? Nothing special.
I only carry a memo pad for use during
exploration.

fields.EN:
If it's nothing special, then who cares?
Don't you want to prove your innocence?
fields.JP:
たいしたモノじゃないなら、いいじゃないですか。
それで疑いが晴れるなら安いものでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's nothing special, then who cares?
Don't you want to prove your innocence?

fields.EN:
Jack's right, man. Seems conspicuous if you
don't show us.
fields.JP:
ジャックの言うとおりだぜ？
そこで出さないのはますます自分がマスターだって
言ってるようなもんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack's right, man. Seems conspicuous if you
don't show us.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Well, it's more of a diary than a memo pad.
It has some personal thoughts, which I'd
rather not disclose.
fields.JP:
いや、メモ帳と言っても日記も兼ねているんだ。
それは気恥ずかしいし、さすがに見せたくないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's more of a diary than a memo pad.
It has some personal thoughts, which I'd
rather not disclose.

fields.EN:
But you have stuff in there, don't you?
Something in your pocket that wards off
the Marchens, am I right?
fields.JP:
本当はそんなもの、入っていないですよね？
その右ポケットにあるのは、メルヒェンたちを
避けるためのアイテム。そうでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you have stuff in there, don't you?
Something in your pocket that wards off
the Marchens, am I right?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Is that half of an orb? Does that keep the
Marchens away?
fields.JP:
何かの球根を半分にしたもの？
それがメルヒェンを避けるためのものなの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is that half of an orb? Does that keep the
Marchens away?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
No. This is more of a charm for me. I didn't
want to admit that I relied on something
like this.
fields.JP:
いや、これは別にただのお守りみたいなものでね。
こんなのにすがっていたと思われるのが嫌で、
出しづらかったというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. This is more of a charm for me. I didn't
want to admit that I relied on something
like this.

fields.EN:
If it's a charm, then it doesn't really work,
right?
fields.JP:
それはお守りだから、
実際に効果はないとそう言うんですね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's a charm, then it doesn't really work,
right?

fields.EN:
Well, why don't you prove it by walking into
the tower? I bet you'll be just fine in there.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、それを証明するために今から、
この悪食の監隊塔の中を歩いてみますか
恐らく誰もあなたを襲ってこないでしょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, why don't you prove it by walking into
the tower? I bet you'll be just fine in there.

fields.EN: You've been acting so bold lately, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、前に比べて
なんだか大胆になりましたね……
fields.LOCALIZED: You've been acting so bold lately, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Seems unthinkable compared to how he
used to be.
fields.JP: 出会った頃のジャックからは考えられませんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems unthinkable compared to how he
used to be.

fields.EN:
What do you say? Scared to check in on the
Marchens?
fields.JP:
どうですか？　メルヒェンに会いに
行けないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you say? Scared to check in on the
Marchens?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Besides, how did you know the terms for
Marchens, Nightmares, and Blood Maidens
from the get-go?
fields.JP:
賀東さん、あなたは何故か最初から、
『メルヒェン』や『ナイトメア』、
『血式少女』という言葉を知っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, how did you know the terms for
Marchens, Nightmares, and Blood Maidens
from the get-go?

fields.EN:
Those terms originated from the underground.
If you were from the surface, wouldn't you call
them contaminated?
fields.JP:
それらは地下の人間の間でしか使わない
言葉だというのにね。地上の人間なら、
メルヒェンは汚染動物と呼ぶはずでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those terms originated from the underground.
If you were from the surface, wouldn't you call
them contaminated?

fields.EN:
Also, you seemed to ask a lot of questions
that went beyond curiosity. It's time for you
to spill what you know.
fields.JP:
それに、私たちへの不自然な聞き込みなど、
色々と疑わしいことが正直多かった……
ちょうどいい機会だわ、すべてを晒しなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also, you seemed to ask a lot of questions
that went beyond curiosity. It's time for you
to spill what you know.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
*sigh*... You got me. This indeed does have
part of Theophile's female plant, which has
the ability to fend off Marchens.
fields.JP:
はぁ……観念したよ。
これは『テオフィルの雌株』の一部でね、
確かにメルヒェンを退ける効果がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... You got me. This indeed does have
part of Theophile's female plant, which has
the ability to fend off Marchens.

fields.EN:
Wait a minute! Is... Is that part of the Jail?
The root of the moon!
fields.JP:
ちょっと待ってくれ！
そんな……それはジェイルの雌しべ、
『白い月』の元ではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait a minute! Is... Is that part of the Jail?
The root of the moon!

fields.EN:
How did you get that...? Why were you hiding
it from us this whole time?!
fields.JP:
何故そんなものを持っていた……
いや、何故今の今まで持っていたことを
黙っていたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How did you get that...? Why were you hiding
it from us this whole time?!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
My acquisition of this item was happenstance,
but lo and behold, it's the perfect tool to survive
Jail.
fields.JP:
……たまたま手に入れたテオフィルの雌株は、
何年も監獄塔で生きていくのにちょうどよかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
My acquisition of this item was happenstance,
but lo and behold, it's the perfect tool to survive
Jail.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
With this, the denizens recognize me as part
of Jail itself. The Marchens steer clear.
fields.JP:
これを持っていると、おそらくジェイルの一部
それも大切な何かと認識されるんだろう。
メルヒェンは避けて通るからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
With this, the denizens recognize me as part
of Jail itself. The Marchens steer clear.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I can't just share valuable information like
that with someone I just met. It could be
stolen from me. That's why I kept it hush.
fields.JP:
そんなものを、出会ってすぐの人間に
教えたら奪われるかもしれない……
だから、すぐには打ち明けられなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't just share valuable information like
that with someone I just met. It could be
stolen from me. That's why I kept it hush.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
As time passed, I knew that you would only
accuse me of affiliating with Genocide Pink,
so I chose not to share it.
fields.JP:
だがそうやってタイミングを窺っているうちに、
今度は処刑台少女との繋がりを疑われるかも
しれない、という意味で打ち明けられなくなった
fields.LOCALIZED:
As time passed, I knew that you would only
accuse me of affiliating with Massacre Pink,
so I chose not to share it.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
See? It was just a matter of poor timing all
around.
fields.JP:
な、分かるだろう？
打ち明けるタイミングなんて、
どこにもなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? It was just a matter of poor timing all
around.

fields.EN:
Gatou-san, I'm sure that all makes sense to you,
but I'm not falling for it.
fields.JP:
賀東さん。もっともらしいことを
言っているように聞こえますが、
騙されませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato, I'm sure that all makes sense to you,
but I'm not falling for it.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN:
Yes. All of your concerns could have been
considered had you been open with them.
fields.JP:
ああ。どの疑惑についても、
疑われた時点で隠さずに告白していれば、
まだはぐらかせただろうがな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. All of your concerns could have been
considered had you been open with them.

fields.EN: Once your lies have been exposed, simply making excuses for them isn't any defense. A foundation built on lies made up on the spot is fragile, you know?
fields.JP:
嘘を暴かれて、そこに対して言い訳を
しているだけでは何の弁解にもならない。
その場しのぎの嘘で築いた足場は脆いぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now that your lies are being uncovered,
all you're doing is making excuses to preserve
your innocence. The truth will come to light.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Even if I had no way to prove my innocence,
you have to see that it was all timing!
fields.JP:
だが証明する術はなくとも、打ち明ける
タイミングがなかったことは本当なんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I had no way to prove my innocence,
you have to see that it was all timing!

fields.EN: You just don't get it, do you?
fields.JP: やれやれ、分かっていないようだな
fields.LOCALIZED: You just don't get it, do you?

fields.JP: お忘れのようですけど――

fields.EN: Now that we know Marchens don't attack you, Gatou-san, your claim that you 'left Alice because it was dangerous' was a lie, wasn't it?
fields.JP:
賀東さんがメルヒェンに襲われないことが
判明した今、『危険だからアリスの前から去った』
という発言は嘘になるんですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we know you have that little artifact,
the whole fleeing Alice because of the Marchen
angle looks suspect.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: しかしジャック大分大胆になったわね……

fields.EN:
Looks like Jack's grown a bunch since we
last saw him!
fields.JP:
ジャックはジャックなりに成長している
ということなのでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like Jack's grown a bunch since we
last saw him!

fields.EN:
Gatou-san. Why don't you cut the act and come
clean?
fields.JP:
賀東さん。
もう観念して、すべて話してくれませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato. Why don't you cut the act and come
clean?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
It's true I fled after healing Alice-san, and that I
possess Theophile's female plant.
fields.JP:
確かに自分はアリスさんを治療して去ったり、
テオフィルの雌株を持っていたりした……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true I fled after healing Alice, and that I
possess Theophile's female plant.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
HOWEVER! That is not proof I am Genocide
Pink's master or Papa either!
fields.JP:
しかしだ！　だからといって、
それが処刑台少女の『マスター』や『パパ』
だという理由にはならない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HOWEVER! That is not proof I am Massacre
Pink's master or Papa either!
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
None of your proof has corroborated such an
outlandish claim! If you have some, then now's
the time to show it!
fields.JP:
処刑台少女のマスターであるという証拠など、
君はこれまで提示などしてきてないのだからな！
あるというなら出してみたまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
None of your proof has corroborated such an
outlandish claim! If you have some, then now's
the time to show it!

fields.EN:
Right... I did have proof a while ago, but that
option's currently gone.
fields.JP:
そうですね……少し前まで
確かに証拠はあったんですが、
今それはなくなってしまいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right... I did have proof a while ago, but that
option's currently gone.

fields.EN:
It was Shira. The girl in Clara's group.
I bet she'd know Master's face and voice.
That would've helped.
fields.JP:
くららのグループにいた、処刑台少女のシラです。
あの子ならきっとマスターの顔も声も知ってるし、
それが決め手になったはずなんですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was Pyre. The girl in Clara's group.
I bet she'd know Master's face and voice.
That would've helped.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
True. One of Genocide Pink's own calling me
Papa or Master would be proof.
fields.JP:
確かに処刑台少女がこの場にいて、
マスターだのパパだの呼べば、それは
揺るぎない証拠になるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. One of Massacre Pink's own calling me
Papa or Master would be proof.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
But she's not here, is she? What's the point
in carrying on with this?
fields.JP:
だがそいつはもういないんだろう？
なら、そんな仮定の話をしても意味がない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she's not here, is she? What's the point
in carrying on with this?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, if you cannot prove it, then would you
recant your accusation? I deserve some due
diligence.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、今君が証明できないのであれば、
その疑惑は一度取り下げてくれないか？
疑わしいだけで罰するなど、あってはならないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, if you cannot prove it, then would you
recant your accusation? I deserve some due
diligence.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
See, no proof, right? Why don't we leave this
conversation for another time.
fields.JP:
ほら、出せないんだろう？
ここは仕切り直そうじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
See, no proof, right? Why don't we leave this
conversation for another time.

fields.JP: いいえ、取り下げません

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: 何故だ！　これ以上は何もないはず――

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
What's the meaning of this? That Nightmare
claimed to have killed her...
fields.JP:
どういうことだ、処刑台少女のナイトメアは
確かにこいつを殺したと言っていたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the meaning of this? That Nightmare
claimed to have killed her...

fields.EN: Oh, did I hear that right?
fields.JP:
あらあら、聞き捨てならないセリフが
聞こえてきたわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, did I hear that right?

fields.EN: Gretel-san, Clara-chan... Everyone! What's going on?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、くららちゃん……
それにみんな……！
これはどういうことなの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel, Clara... Everyone! What's going on?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; くららちゃん => Clara-chan
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Sorry you had to watch this, Shira. But please be
honest with us. Is Gatou-san your Papa?
fields.JP:
つらい思いをさせてごめんね、シラ。
でも正直に答えてほしいんだ。
賀東さんが、君のパパなんだね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry you had to watch this, Pi. But please be
honest with us. Is Gato your Papa?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: この人が、シラのパパです……
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: No! I don't know her! I most definitely am not!
fields.JP:
違う！　自分はこんな奴を知らない！
断じてパパなんかではない！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! I don't know her! I most definitely am not!

fields.EN:
Gatou-san, I wanted to resolve this issue in peace
without cornering you.
fields.JP:
賀東さん。僕はできれば
あなたをあまり追いつめず、
話し合いで平和的に解決したかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato, I wanted to resolve this issue in peace
without cornering you.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Why? But they told me they killed her!
fields.JP:
何故だ！　確かに
殺したという報告を受けたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why? But they told me they killed her!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
That can't be. Are you telling me the Nightmare
lied?! That's preposterous!
fields.JP:
あり得ない……まさかナイトメアが
嘘をついたとでも言うのか！？
そんなもの、聞いたことがない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That can't be. Are you telling me the Nightmare
lied?! That's preposterous!

fields.EN:
No. The Nightmare was fooled into thinking
Shira was dead.
fields.JP:
いや、あのナイトメアは
確かにシラが死んだと思っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. The Nightmare was fooled into thinking
Pi was dead.

fields.JP: やめて、お願い来ないで――きゃっ！
シラさん、立ち上がるっす！！
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
ババ……ババババババ……
ニイザンニイザンニイザンニイザン……

fields.EN:
I WONT...FORGIB YOUUUUU....
YOU TOO, COME HEEEERE....JIRAAAAAA!!
fields.JP:
ユルゼナイ……ユルゼナイィィィ……
オマエモコッヂニゴイ……ジラァァァァアア！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I WONT...FORGIB YOUUUUU....
YOU DID THIS TO ME....PYREEEE!

fields.JP: シラには手を出させない！！

fields.EN: (Thank goodness... But unless we come up with something quickly, we'll end up stuck either way.)
fields.JP:
（よかった……
　でも早く手立てを考えないと、
　このままじゃどのみち手詰まりだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness... We had to think fast, or
she would've been done for.)

fields.EN: Now... I think I've found the light.
fields.JP:
だけど……そう、何か光明のようなものが
見えた気がするんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED: Now... I think I've found the light.

fields.EN: Juu's the one who suggested that we hide her.
fields.JP:
さっきのジュウの言葉──
『いなくなったことにする』
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh's the one who suggested that we hide her.

fields.EN: That's when I got to thinking...
fields.JP: もしくは死んだことにする……？
fields.LOCALIZED: That's when I got to thinking...

fields.EN: ...of a way to make her disappear.
fields.JP:
何とかしてあの子を『死んだことにする』
そんな方法が──
fields.LOCALIZED: ...of a way to make her disappear.

fields.EN:
Honestly, I don't usually do this for people I
don't know, but after what I saw...
fields.JP:
正直言って、知らない奴のために使うのは
気が進まねーけど……流石にあんな光景見ちゃあな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, I don't usually do this for people I
don't know, but after what I saw...

fields.EN:
Here, Jack. Maybe you can put this to good
use.
fields.JP:
ジャック、ほれ。
こいつの出番だろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, Jack. Maybe you can put this to good
use.

fields.EN: Oh, I see what you mean!
fields.JP: そうか、そういうことか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see what you mean!

fields.EN:
Could I borrow a match if someone's life
depended on it?
fields.JP:
人の命が掛かってるんだ……。
1本貰って良いかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could I borrow a match if someone's life
depended on it?

fields.EN: Well, I was gonna give you one anyway.
fields.JP: ま、元々ジャックに一本やろうと思ってたしな
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I was gonna give you one anyway.

fields.EN: (Okay, the Nightmare's next to that wall!)
fields.JP:
（よし、ナイトメアは今ちょうど
　壁の近くにいる……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Okay, the Nightmare's next to that wall!)

fields.EN:
Tsuu! Punch the wall near the Nightmare
with everything you've got!
fields.JP:
つう！　今すぐ全力で
あのナイトメアのそばの壁を殴ってくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu! Punch the wall near the Nightmare
with everything you've got!
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I can't, Jack. Even if I were to use all my might,
it's going to patch itself back up!
fields.JP:
駄目だジャック、あの壁は
殴っても小さな穴が開くくらいで、
それもすぐに直ってしまうんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't, Jack. Even if I were to use all my might,
it's going to patch itself back up!

fields.EN: That's fine! Please! We don't have time!
fields.JP:
それでいいんだ！
とにかくお願い、時間がないんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's fine! Please! We don't have time!

fields.EN:
I'm not sure what you're planning,
but here I go! HAAAAA!
fields.JP:
何をする気か知らないが――
いくぞっ！　はぁぁぁぁっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure what you're planning,
but here I go! HAAAAA!

fields.JP: 穴が開いた！　今だメアリー！！

fields.EN:
Hehe. Looky looky, Nightmare. Got something
good for you.
fields.JP:
ひひ、こっち向いたなナイトメア。
それじゃあ俺がいいモンやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Looky looky, Nightmare. Got something
good for you.

fields.EN: Here. You'll get a kick out of this!
fields.JP: ほら、最高にキメられる１本だぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Here. You'll get a kick out of this!

fields.EN:
So the Nightmare saw a hallucination that Shira
had died and departed thinking it completed
its mission.
fields.JP:
そうやって、ナイトメアは
『シラが死んだ幻覚』を見て、
目的を果たしたと思い帰っていったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
So the Nightmare saw a hallucination that Pi
had died and departed thinking it completed
its mission.

fields.EN:
Sorry, Princess. Jack swore me to secrecy.
I promised.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、姫。
ジャックから誰にも言うなって
釘を刺されてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Princess. Jack swore me to secrecy.
I promised.

fields.EN:
We had to keep it secret from you
so we could confront Gatou-san, Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
ごめん、賀東さんを追いつめるのにどうしても
この話題をしたくなかったから、その場に
いなかった人魚姫さんには内緒にしたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We had to keep it secret from you
so we could confront Gato, Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: We absolutely had to keep it from being discovered until the very end. That's why I limited who took part. —Hey, you can come in now.
fields.JP:
最後まで絶対にバレずに行う必要があったしな。
だから人数を限定して行動させてもらった。
――おい、もう入っていいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Precautions were taken to ensure that no one
would jeopardize our plan.
The rest of you can come now.

fields.JP: ふぅ、やっと参加できるんだね

fields.EN:
I told you not to come out until I give the
signal.
fields.JP:
わたくし達は合図するまで入ってくるなって
話でしたけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you not to come out until I give the
signal.

fields.EN:
Sorry. Singling out their leader is a tricky
task, but now you can show your faces.
fields.JP:
悪いな。確実に黒幕をあぶり出したかったから、
リアクションでバレそうな君たちには
退席してもらってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. Singling out their leader is a tricky
task, but now you can show your faces.

fields.EN:
Hehe. This is quite the gathering.
Why don't you tell us the truth now?
fields.JP:
ふふ、みんな集まってきたわね。
ではそろそろ、真実を教えてもらいましょうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. This is quite the gathering.
Why don't you tell us the truth now?

fields.EN:
Gatou-san, you just admitted to ordering the
Nightmare to kill Shira. That's undeniable.
fields.JP:
賀東さん、あなたはさっきナイトメアに
シラを殺させようとしたことを自白しました。
もう言い逃れはできませんよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato, you just admitted to ordering the
Nightmare to kill Pi. That's undeniable.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: This means you're Genocide Pink's master.
fields.JP: 処刑台少女のマスターは、あなたです
fields.LOCALIZED: This means you're Massacre Pink's master.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Oh, dear. You've hit the nail on the head, my
boy. Well done. Great detective work.
fields.JP:
いや、参った。その通りだ。お見事。
実に素晴らしい推理だったよ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, dear. You've hit the nail on the head, my
boy. Well done. Great detective work.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
However, you should have brought Hiaburibashira
in from the start. You're cruel, Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
しかし、最初から火あぶり柱を出せばいいものを、
趣味が悪いな、ジャックくん
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, you should have brought Pyre
in from the start. You're cruel, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Hiaburibashira

fields.EN:
Couldn't do that. If you knew Shira was alive,
then you would've found a way to slip out.
fields.JP:
それはできません。シラがいると分かれば、
あなたは話し合いが始まる前にどんな理由を
つけてでも、この部屋から出ていったはずです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Couldn't do that. If you knew Pi was alive,
then you would've found a way to slip out.

fields.EN:
All to order a hit on Shira again. You wouldn't
have talked if she were dead. I wasn't gonna
take that chance.
fields.JP:
そして再びシラを狙い、
命を奪ってから話し合いに臨んだことでしょう。
そんなことはさせません
fields.LOCALIZED:
All to order a hit on Pi again. You wouldn't
have talked if she were dead. I wasn't gonna
take that chance.

fields.EN:
We had to line everything up, or else we
wouldn't have gotten a confession out of
you.
fields.JP:
何より、この手順じゃなければ、
あなたの自白は引き出せなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
We had to line everything up, or else we
wouldn't have gotten a confession out of
you.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Gatou-san, it's time to start talking. You're gonna
tell us all about the Devouring Armada Tower,
and Genocide Pink's Nightmare―
fields.JP:
賀東さん。あなたには色々と聞きたいことがある。
この悪食の監隊塔についてや、ナイトメアと
なった処刑台少女について――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato, it's time to start talking. You're gonna
tell us all about the Devouring Armada Tower,
and Massacre Pink's Nightmare―
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I was deceived by insolent mortals...
I failed in taking that monster's word for it.
fields.JP:
まさかゴミ虫に騙されるとは……
あんな化け物を信じた俺の失敗だったようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was deceived by insolent mortals...
I failed in taking that monster's word for it.

fields.EN: Gatou-san, is this your true nature...?
fields.JP: 賀東さん……それがあなたの本性ですか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Gato, is this your true nature...?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Shut up! All those days in your unbearable
company gone to waste! When at last I have
reached the truth!
fields.JP:
黙れ！　貴様らのような化け物と過ごし我慢した
日々が、ほとんど無意味なものになったんだぞ！
俺はほぼ真実まで到達していたというのにだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up! All those days in your unbearable
company gone to waste! When at last I have
reached the truth!

fields.EN:
Do you have anything to do with Guillotine's
attempt on Mary's life?
fields.JP:
それはもしかして、この間ギロチンが
メアリーを殺そうとしたことが
関係しているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you have anything to do with Guillotine's
attempt on Mary's life?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Kuhaha. You caught onto that, did you?
Guess I underestimated you.
fields.JP:
クハハ……まさかそこまで察しがいいとはな。
正直、貴様を見くびっていたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kuhaha. You caught onto that, did you?
Guess I underestimated you.

fields.EN:
I couldn't figure out your motive, but I had
a feeling you had a hand in it.
fields.JP:
理由までは分かりませんでした。
でもマスターとやらが何かを
掴んでの行動だとは思いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't figure out your motive, but I had
a feeling you had a hand in it.

fields.EN:
The tell was her coming while we were
sleeping. Guillotine's too haughty to do
that herself. She'd never.
fields.JP:
だって寝込みを襲うなんて、
僕たちを格下だと思っているギロチンの
性格を考えたらおかしいですからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The tell was her coming while we were
sleeping. Guillotine's too haughty to do
that herself. She'd never.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I should have killed Mary myself...
fields.JP: 俺が直接手を下すべきだったか……
fields.LOCALIZED: I should have killed Mary myself...

fields.EN: Gatou-san, what are you trying to do?
fields.JP:
賀東さん、あなたはいったい
何をしようとしているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Gato, what are you trying to do?
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I wanted vengeance against this cursed
planet using Theophile's female plant.
Over and over and over again!
fields.JP:
俺はこの『テオフィルの雌株』を使って、
この世界への復讐を果たそうとした。
何度も何度も何度も何度もだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted vengeance against this cursed
planet using Theophile's female plant.
Over and over and over again!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
HOWEVER! EVERY TIME! Someone uses their
Witchcraft and resets this world!
fields.JP:
だがいつもだ！　いつも誰かがどこかで
ウィッチクラフトを使って、この世界を
リセットしてしまう！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HOWEVER! EVERY TIME! Someone uses their
Witchcraft and resets this world!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Even so, I didn't give up. For decades, through dozens of resets, I wandered this world and kept searching for the cause!
fields.JP:
それでも俺は諦めなかった。
何十年も何十回もリセットされた世界を
彷徨い、その原因を探り続けた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I couldn't give up. So I've wandered upon
these lands dozens and dozens of times to
discover the cause!

fields.JP: リセット……時間の巻き戻しか！

fields.EN:
That is only possible with Witchcraft.
But Gatou, you've contributed to it too.
fields.JP:
確かにウィッチクラフトであればそれも可能だ。
だが、それならば賀東君も巻き込まれるはず……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is only possible with Witchcraft.
But Gato, you've contributed to it too.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
Ah. Theophile's female plant. Since he was
part of the Pistil, Witchcraft doesn't affect
him.
fields.JP:
そうか、テオフィルの雌株だ。
雌しべの一部として認識されウィッチクラフトの
影響下から外れたのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Theophile's female plant. Since he was
part of the Pistil, Witchcraft doesn't affect
him.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Correct. I am uninhibited by the planet's
confinement. I exist alone in a flow of time
which cannot be shared.
fields.JP:
そうだ。おかげで俺だけが世界の枠の外にいる。
たったひとり、誰とも共有できない時の流れに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Correct. I am uninhibited by the planet's
confinement. I exist alone in a flow of time
which cannot be shared.

fields.EN:
(He's done this over and over for decades.
Gatou-san is the only one who aged...)
fields.JP:
（何十年も、同じ時間を繰り返す……
　賀東さんだけが１人
　年を取り続けてきたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(He's done this over and over for decades.
Gato is the only one who aged...)
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: No matter how many times the cycle repeated, I couldn't find who was causing the resets or any way to avoid them.
fields.JP:
何度繰り返しても一向にリセットを行う者も、
回避する手立ても見つけられなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter how many times I repeated myself,
I couldn't avoid it.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
But I've finally found it! The key to disabling
the repetition.
fields.JP:
だが、ようやく見つけたのだ！
繰り返すリセットの共通点を！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I've finally found it! The key to disabling
the repetition.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: It ends with the death of a woman named Alice.
fields.JP: それは『アリス』という女の死だ
fields.LOCALIZED: It ends with the death of a woman named Alice.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Well, you are just the trigger. Next in the
sequence is the unraveling of
Charlotte's mind.
fields.JP:
まあ、それは言わば引き金にすぎん。
そこから始まる一連の流れ
次はそう、そこのシャーロットが発狂する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you are just the trigger. Next in the
sequence is the unraveling of
Charlotte's mind.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Then shortly afterwards, the power of
Witchcraft reignites.
fields.JP:
そしてしばらく後に、
ウィッチクラフトの力が発動する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then shortly afterwards, the power of
Witchcraft reignites.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
It resets the world's mimicry a hundred
times stronger than usual.
fields.JP:
およそ通常の数百倍以上の擬態の力によって、
世界をリセットしてしまうのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It resets the world's mimicry a hundred
times stronger than usual.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Why does that happen?! Who's causing it?!
fields.JP:
なぜそんなことが起こる！
いったい誰の仕業だ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why does that happen?! Who's causing it?!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: It's as if some invisible force is at work.
fields.JP: まるで姿が見えない幽霊の仕業のようだったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's as if some invisible force is at work.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I deduced that the cause of the reset was
located in the underground Jail where Alice
and Charlotte were, so I left you be.
fields.JP:
しかし少なくとも世界がリセットされる原因は
アリスとシャーロットがいる地下監獄にある
そう睨んだ俺は、貴様らを泳がせることにした
fields.LOCALIZED:
I deduced that the cause of the reset was
located in the underground Jail where Alice
and Charlotte were, so I left you be.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
As you made your way to the surface,
I joined so that I could observe.
fields.JP:
そして地上に出てきた貴様らのグループに入り、
じっくりと観察した……
fields.LOCALIZED:
As you made your way to the surface,
I joined so that I could observe.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP:
そして、見つけたのだ！　おまえを！
『メアリー』！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
There's a connection between Alice, Charlotte,
and Mary. Along with Mary's Blood Ability.
The match somehow maxes the core's powers.
fields.JP:
『アリス』『シャーロット』『メアリー』という
３人の関係性……そしてメアリーの血式能力
マッチ棒、核の力を最大限に使用できる力……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a connection between Alice, Charlotte,
and Mary. Along with Mary's Blood Ability.
The match somehow maxes the core's powers.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
And here they are, proving my hypothesis.
It's all their doing!
fields.JP:
これですべてが繋がった。
俺の推測は正しかった……
やはりこいつらのせいだった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
And here they are, proving my hypothesis.
It's all their doing!

fields.EN: So Mary using Witchcraft resets the world...?
fields.JP:
じゃあメアリーが、
ウィッチクラフトで世界をリセットしている……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So Mary using Witchcraft resets the world...?

fields.JP: お、俺リセットなんてしてねえよ！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Mary, you alone possess the power to reset
the world. And indeed you have, over and
over again.
fields.JP:
メアリー、おまえの能力だけが世界を
リセットできる可能性を持っている
そして実際に世界はリセットをし続けている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, you alone possess the power to reset
the world. And indeed you have, over and
over again.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
If I let you live, the cycle will continue.
Hence why I ordered your death.
fields.JP:
おまえを放っておけば、
世界は永遠に同じ時間を巡り続ける。
だから俺はおまえを襲わせたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I let you live, the cycle will continue.
Hence why I ordered your death.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: And not just Mary. Once I knew the truth, I didn't care if everyone else died. It was supposed to end with all of you slaughtered.
fields.JP:
そしてメアリーだけじゃない、
真実さえ分かれば、あとは全員死んでよかった。
皆殺しで終わるはずだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I won't stop at Mary. Now that I know
the truth, I don't care if any of you live.
The rest of you could die, for all I care.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
But Guillotine, Iron Maiden, and Kubitsuridai
all ignored orders and failed me!
fields.JP:
それなのに、ギロチンもアイアン・メイデンも
首吊り台も皆、ことごとく単独行動に走り、
そして失敗を繰り返した！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Guillotine, Iron Maiden, and Gallows
all ignored orders and failed me!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
So I molded them into a Nightmare to do
my bidding, but even that failed! Useless!
fields.JP:
頭にきたから無理矢理ナイトメアにしてやったが、
それでも毛ほどの役にも立たなかったがな。
本当にとんだゴミを生み出してしまったものだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I molded them into a Nightmare to do
my bidding, but even that failed! Useless!

fields.EN: (What a selfish monster. This man is lost...)
fields.JP:
（なんて身勝手な考えなんだ……
　この人はもう壊れてしまっている……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What a selfish monster. This man is lost...)

fields.EN:
Gatou, why?! You worked so hard to make the
world a better place. Was it all an act?!
fields.JP:
賀東君、何故だ！
私と一緒にこの世界を良くしようと
頑張ってきた、あれも演技だったというのか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gato, why?! You worked so hard to make the
world a better place. Was it all an act?!
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Make the world a better place...?
fields.LOCALIZED: Make the world a better place...?

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP:
クク……クハハハハ！
アーハハハハ！　ヒャハハハハハ！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Oh. Sorry for laughing Jabberwock, but you
sound so foolish. Kekeke...
fields.JP:
あー……いや、笑ってすまない、ジャバウォック。
だが、そう、あまりにも滑稽で……ククク
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Sorry for laughing Jabberwock, but you
sound so foolish. Kekeke...

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Jabberwock, this world...is done.
Humanity is lost.
fields.JP:
ジャバウォック、この世界は……
人間はもうダメだ。救いようがない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jabberwock, this world...is done.
Humanity is lost.

fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I had faith in this world, I gave myself to it.
But I was betrayed. No, maybe I never had
faith in the first place.
fields.JP:
世界を信じて、尽くしたら裏切られた。
いや、最初から信じてはいけなかったんだ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had faith in this world, I gave myself to it.
But I was betrayed. No, maybe I never had
faith in the first place.

fields.JP: まさか……ジェノサイド・ピンクか？

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
That's right! Hearing their names fills me
with enough rage to destroy this world!
fields.JP:
そうだ！　その名前を聞くだけで、
俺は何度でもこの世界を破壊したくなる！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right! Hearing their names fills me
with enough rage to destroy this world!

fields.EN:
...Sorry, but I'm stopping you here.
Gatou-san, you're coming with us.
fields.JP:
――悪いけど、話はそこまでにして。
賀東さん、一緒に来てもらうわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Sorry, but I'm stopping you here.
Gato, you're coming with us.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You're trash. This isn't the end of this!
You're useless to me, Alice.
fields.JP:
ゴミ虫が、もしかして勝った気でいるのか！？
今となっては、貴様ももう用無しなんだぞアリス！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're trash. This isn't the end of this!
You're useless to me, Alice.

fields.EN: I've never been happier to be useless.
fields.JP: あなたにとって用無しなら、願ったりだわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I've never been happier to be useless.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: You think you can make a fool of me?!
fields.JP: これ以上俺を愚弄するか！
fields.LOCALIZED: You think you can make a fool of me?!

fields.EN: Did he vanish into the wall?!
fields.LOCALIZED: Did he vanish into the wall?!

fields.EN: He must be using the plant!
fields.JP: これもテオフィルの雌株の効果……！
fields.LOCALIZED: He must be using the plant!

fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP:
クッハハハハハ！
じゃあなゴミ虫ども！！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I no longer need to hide behind my act.
I must enact my plan to destroy this planet!
fields.JP:
もうなりふりなど構いはしない、
この世界が崩壊するまで突き進むのみだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I no longer need to hide behind my act.
I must enact my plan to destroy this planet!

fields.EN:
Guys! Gatou's trying to destroy the world!
Let's find him!
fields.JP:
みんな！　賀東の目的はこの世界の崩壊だ！
とにかく探し出して止めよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guys! Gato's trying to destroy the world!
Let's find him!
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou
Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
He vanished. We have no idea where Gatou
escaped.
fields.JP:
……行ってしまったか
賀東がどこに逃げたかも分からないというのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
He vanished. We have no idea where Gato
escaped.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
But we should return to camp. We'll plan
accordingly.
fields.JP:
……とにかく、戻って態勢を立て直そう。
話はそれからだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we should return to camp. We'll plan
accordingly.

fields.JP: 待って、少しだけ待ってくださいっす！
くらら！　無事でよかった！

fields.EN: Boss! I missed you so much!
fields.JP:
師匠！
会いたかった、会いたかったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Boss! I missed you so much!

fields.EN:
Me too. Sorry. Having my apprentice save
me...
fields.JP:
俺もだ。すまない、弟子のお前に
助けられるとは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too. Sorry. Having my apprentice save
me...

fields.EN:
The only thing that matters is you're alive,
Boss!
fields.JP: 師匠が生きててくれれば、それでいいっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The only thing that matters is you're alive,
Boss!

fields.EN: You idiot. What's the point if you get hurt?
fields.JP: 馬鹿野郎。お前が怪我したら意味あるか
fields.LOCALIZED: You idiot. What's the point if you get hurt?

fields.EN:
I worked so hard to get here! So, so hard!
I want you to praise me! A lot!
fields.JP:
自分、ここまで頑張ったっす
たくさんたくさん、頑張ったんっす！
だから、たくさん褒めてほしいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I worked so hard to get here! So, so hard!
I want you to praise me! A lot!

fields.EN:
Yes. When all of this is over, I will give you
every praise under the sun.
fields.JP:
ああ。全てを終わらせたら、
太陽の下でいくらでも褒めてやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. When all of this is over, I will give you
every praise under the sun.

fields.EN: Wait, everyone. The darkness is growing!
fields.JP:
待ってみんな、
あそこ、暗闇が急に――！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait, everyone. The darkness is growing!

fields.JP: ええっ！？　またナイトメアっすか！？

fields.EN:
Clara! Take this as an order from Boss to his
dumb apprentice. Listen up good.
fields.JP:
くらら！　師匠から馬鹿弟子へ命令だ
いいかよく聞け――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara! Take this as an order from Boss to his
dumb apprentice. Listen up good.

fields.EN:
(We searched for Gatou all over, but he slipped
from our grasp.)
fields.JP:
（その後僕たちは、賀東を見つけられず、
　みんながいた場所に戻ったが既に誰もいなかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We searched for Gato all over, but he slipped
from our grasp.)
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.JP:
（その後の悪食の監隊塔では処刑台少女の
　ナイトメアが頻繁に現れ、不用意に
　歩き回ることができなくなってしまった）
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(For safety, we asked Miko-san and the others who
can't fight not to leave camp.)
fields.JP:
（僕たちは安全を優先し、戦えない視子さん達には
　キャンプから出ないようお願いをした）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(To keep everyone from danger, we returned to
the tip of Salvation Tower and set up camp.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(I assume everyone else is doing the same.
It stinks to retreat, but there's not much we
can do.)
fields.JP:
（おそらく他のグループもそうしていると思う。
　後退するのは歯がゆいけど、仕方ない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I assume everyone else is doing the same.
It stinks to retreat, but there's not much we
can do.)

fields.EN:
(We're running out of time. Now that
Gatou's told us the truth, I'm sure he'll
kick into destroy-the-world mode.)
fields.JP:
（時間はきっとあまり残されていないだろう。
　賀東が真実を色々と知った以上、まっすぐに
　この世界の崩壊を目指すだろうから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're running out of time. Now that
Gato's told us the truth, I'm sure he'll
kick into destroy-the-world mode.)
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
(But exactly how he plans to carry out
his plan is still a mystery...)
fields.JP:
（ただ、賀東はどんな風に
　この世界を崩壊させるつもりなのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But exactly how he plans to carry out
his plan is still a mystery...)

fields.EN:
(Witchcraft allows you to create worlds out
of mimicry, but does that make the opposite
possible too...?)
fields.JP:
（ウィッチクラフトでは
　擬態化された世界は作れるけど、それが
　世界崩壊に繋がるとでもいうのだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Witchcraft allows you to create worlds out
of mimicry, but does that make the opposite
possible too...?)

fields.EN:
Not to mention that ugly thing sitting
next to it...
fields.JP:
あたりまえのように横になんか
やべぇのいるしよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not to mention that ugly thing sitting
next to it...

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ヴォオオオオォォォォ！！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
Its looks befit its appearance as guardian
of the Devouring Armada Tower.
I sense this one is the strongest yet.
fields.JP:
流石悪食の監隊塔の番人だね。
今までとは比べ物にならない強さを感じるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Its looks befit its appearance as guardian
of the Devouring Armada Tower.
I sense this one is the strongest yet.

fields.EN: We've come this far. All we can do now is hit it with everything we've got.
fields.JP:
ここまで来たら持っている力
全てをぶつけるしかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look how far we've made it.
There's no chance we'll back down from this.

fields.JP: その通りだと思う、アリスさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Okay. We got this, team. Just like before.
Let's go!
fields.JP:
うん、いつも通りの僕たちなら絶対に勝てるよ！
それじゃ、行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. We got this, team. Just like before.
Let's go!

fields.EN: Yes, we did it! Anyone hurt?
fields.JP:
うん、やったわね！
みんな怪我はないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, we did it! Anyone hurt?

fields.JP: シャーロットさんは大丈夫？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Oh, I'm doing just fine. Thanks for asking.
fields.JP:
あら、気を使ってもらっちゃったわね
私は大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I'm doing just fine. Thanks for asking.

fields.EN: So is this the last core?
fields.JP: これが最後の核なのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: So is this the last core?

fields.EN: Not sure, but it's business as usual from here.
fields.JP:
いやわからない……
ただそんなのは関係なく同じくらいの
緊張感を持って進もう
fields.LOCALIZED: Not sure, but it's business as usual from here.

fields.EN:
I've messed up too many times not to
expect the worst by now.
fields.JP:
以前それで壊滅的に痛い目に
あったことがあるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've messed up too many times not to
expect the worst by now.

fields.EN: Jack... Duly noted. Everyone, stay on guard!
fields.JP:
ジャック……
そうだね油断せずに行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack... Duly noted. Everyone, stay on guard!

fields.EN:
(Right, so Gatou has experienced this timeloop
several times now...)
fields.JP:
（そうか賀東はこんな何度も
　やり直す経験をしてきたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Right, so Gato has experienced this timeloop
several times now...)
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.JP: （並大抵じゃない執念……情念を持っていたんだな）
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

ググギギグ……！！
ニ”イザバニ”イザバアアアア
処刑台少女達のナイトメアだ……
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(Whenever I look at it, I don't feel fear...
I feel pity.)
fields.JP:
（何度見ても、怖いというよりも……
　哀れに見ちゃうよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whenever I look at it, I don't feel fear...
I feel pity.)

fields.EN: Ew. Smells like baby in here.
fields.JP: ったく、陽キャ特有の甘ちゃんの空気が流れてるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ew. Smells like baby in here.

fields.JP: そんな風にいってはダメよメアリー

fields.EN:
Jack and I are used to Nightmares. We get it.
Nightmares speak in primitive tongue.
No embellishments. Which must mean...
fields.JP:
僕やジャックはナイトメアだったからわかるんだ。
ナイトメアの言葉は表裏ない真っすぐなものだって、
だから、彼女たちの言葉はきっと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack and I are used to Nightmares. We get it.
Nightmares speak in primitive tongue.
No embellishments. Which must mean...

fields.notes: Line-level source-gated honorific restoration; automatic occurrence matching was ambiguous.

fields.EN:
Those Genocide Pink girls killed so many
innocent people. Call it karma if you want.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女達はたくさんの人を殺し続けた……
報いを受けたといえばそれまでなのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Those Massacre Pink girls killed so many
innocent people. Call it karma if you want.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
But they were also manipulated by someone
they trusted. It's too cruel...
fields.JP:
ただそれが信じ続けた親から
されたことだって思うと、
無残すぎる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But they were also manipulated by someone
they trusted. It's too cruel...

fields.EN:
But...we also have people we need to protect.
So this ends right here, right now.
fields.JP:
だけど……だけど、僕たちにも守るものがある。
ここで彼女たちと全ての決着を付けたいと思う！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...we also have people we need to protect.
So this ends right here, right now.

fields.JP:
……うん！
僕たちの全てをぶつけよう！
ジャック……行きましょう！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

グググッ！！！
ビビイザンアアアア”ア”ア”
こんな無残な姿なんて……

fields.EN:
Defeating them might not absolve them,
but we're the only ones who can stop them!
fields.JP:
彼女たちを倒すことが救いなんて言わないよ
ただ、終わらせられるのは僕たちだけだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Defeating them might not absolve them,
but we're the only ones who can stop them!

fields.JP:
そうね……
その通りだわジャック
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

ググギィィィ！
ヒバブリバジラアアア……
ニグイニグイイイイィィ！！！！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア
ババダズゲデ、ダズゲデエエエ！！！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア
ニジザバニジザバアアアアア
それじゃ……止めを刺そう……
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

グギィ！
ゴノババゴボババジャア゛ア゛ア゛
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア
ア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛ア゛！

fields.EN: It fell down the hole. From this height...
fields.JP:
穴に落ちていったわね。
この高さじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: It fell down the hole. From this height...

fields.EN:
They killed over a thousand people.
Call it karma...
fields.JP:
数千以上の人間を殺してきたんだろ
報いだ報い
fields.LOCALIZED:
They killed over a thousand people.
Call it karma...

fields.EN: Too right. I shouldn't pity them, but...
fields.JP:
その通りなんだけどね……
同情しちゃいけないんだろうけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Too right. I shouldn't pity them, but...

fields.EN: Come on, guys. We don't have much time.
fields.JP:
みんな、もう行こう。
僕たちに残された時間はあまりない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Come on, guys. We don't have much time.

fields.JP:
ジャック……
ううん、行きましょう！

fields.EN: I'll bite my tongue for now.
fields.JP:
わたしもあなたのように
その気持ちをしまっておくわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll bite my tongue for now.

fields.EN: Now let's do this thing, once and for all!
fields.JP: さあ、最後の戦いへ行こう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now let's do this thing, once and for all!

fields.EN: The tower's rooftop is just beyond this point.
fields.JP: みんな、この先が悪食の監隊塔の屋上みたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED: The tower's rooftop is just beyond this point.

fields.EN:
I assume Gatou's there... Guess this is the last
stand.
fields.JP:
おそらく賀東もいる……
だからこれが、きっと最後の戦いになると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I assume Gato's there... Guess this is the last
stand.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.JP: ようやくここまで来たのね

fields.EN: Looking back though, it feels like time flew.
fields.JP:
でも振り返ると、
なんかあっという間だった気もするね
fields.LOCALIZED: Looking back though, it feels like time flew.

fields.EN: Yeah. We barely had time to catch our breath. We came to the surface thinking there was hope, only for all this to happen—we were suddenly attacked, then ended up inside another Jail Tower...
fields.JP:
色々と息つく暇もないくらいだったからね。
希望があると地上に出たらこんなことになってて、
いきなり襲われるわ、また監獄塔に入るわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We've barely had a moment to rest.
Our hope was nearly extinguished upon arrival.
Now we're stuck in another Jail...

fields.EN:
I know. Sometimes I don't know how we made
it this far without breaking down.
fields.JP:
ほんと、わたしたち
よく心折れずに頑張ったよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. Sometimes I don't know how we made
it this far without breaking down.

fields.JP: 俺は初めっからバッキバキに折れてるけどな
もう、そういうこと言わないの

fields.EN: I've almost broken down a few times honestly.
fields.JP: わたしは何度も折れそうになったかな……
fields.LOCALIZED: I've almost broken down a few times honestly.

fields.EN:
But Jack never gave up. Because of his support,
I held myself together.
fields.JP:
でもここまでジャックがまったく折れずに
声をかけ続けてくれたから、頑張れたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Jack never gave up. Because of his support,
I held myself together.

fields.EN:
That's not true. It was all thanks to our group.
That's how we made it this far.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。
僕の方こそ、みんながいてくれたから
ここまで頑張れたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. It was all thanks to our group.
That's how we made it this far.

fields.EN: None of us could have made it here alone.
fields.JP: みんな１人じゃ無理だったってことだね
fields.LOCALIZED: None of us could have made it here alone.

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san, how have you been faring?
Were there any times you felt like giving up?
fields.JP:
シャーロットさんは
ここまでどうだったの？
やっぱり心折れそうになった時もある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, how have you been faring?
Were there any times you felt like giving up?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Hm. I was never really bothered, nor did I feel
like giving up. I guess everything just felt...
unexpected.
fields.JP:
そうね、大変だとか折れそうだとかは
思ってないんだけど……ただただ意外な道のり
だったなって思ってるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. I was never really bothered, nor did I feel
like giving up. I guess everything just felt...
unexpected.

fields.EN:
I mean, I never saw myself as related to
anything going on here, you know? But lo
and behold, I'm the cause. How surprising.
fields.JP:
だって私、自分が当事者になるなんて
絶対にないと思ってたのに、当事者どころか
実は原因そのものだったんだもの。驚いたわ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, I never saw myself as related to
anything going on here, you know? But lo
and behold, I'm the cause. How surprising.

fields.EN:
So if I die, Charlotte loses her mind, then Mary
resets the world's cycle?
fields.JP:
わたしが死ぬとシャーロットが発狂して、
メアリーが世界を戻すっていう、あのこと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if I die, Charlotte loses her mind, then Mary
resets the world's cycle?

fields.EN:
Right. I don't get it either. Did he mean that the
world runs on a loop?
fields.JP:
そうそう。いまだに信じられないんだけど、
この世界は何度もやり直してるって話じゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I don't get it either. Did he mean that the
world runs on a loop?

fields.EN: I don't remember it, but Mary did that because she wanted to save Alice and me, right?
fields.JP:
覚えてないけど、それってメアリーが
私やアリスを助けたいって思ってやったのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't make it out. It's because Mary wants to
protect us, right?

fields.EN: I see. Seems to be the case.
fields.JP: そうか……そういうことになるのね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Seems to be the case.

fields.EN:
So Mary, thank you for resetting the world
over and over again.
fields.JP:
だからね、メアリー。
何度も世界を作り直してくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Mary, thank you for resetting the world
over and over again.

fields.JP: い、いや俺も記憶ねえから……

fields.EN:
Making a whole new world just for Charlotte...
If it came to it, I'd do it every time. I would.
Even now...
fields.JP:
でもシャーロットのために世界を作り直す……か。
まぁ、いざとなったらそうするかもな
いや、するんだろうな。今回も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Making a whole new world just for Charlotte...
If it came to it, I'd do it every time. I would.
Even now...

fields.EN:
I won't let you. This time, we're all making
it through.
fields.JP:
絶対にそんなことにはさせない。
今度こそ、みんなで生き残るんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I won't let you. This time, we're all making
it through.

fields.EN:
There you go again with the hero routine...
Would you quit interrupting me while I talk
to myself?
fields.JP:
お前はまた、さわやか陽キャ発言しやがって……
ってか俺の独り言に反応すんのやめてくんね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There you go again with the hero routine...
Would you quit interrupting me while I talk
to myself?

fields.EN: Sorry, didn't mean to. Just overheard you.
fields.JP: ごめん、聞こえちゃったから、つい
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, didn't mean to. Just overheard you.

fields.EN:
You keep overstepping my line.
Watch me dive into your daydreams next time.
fields.JP:
いつも遠慮なく距離詰めてきやがって、
今度お前の妄想マッチで見てやっからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You keep overstepping my line.
Watch me dive into your daydreams next time.

fields.JP: なんてこと考えてるんだメアリーは……

fields.EN: Mary, I told you to stop wasting matches!
fields.JP: メアリー、無駄遣いはダメって言ったでしょう！
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, I told you to stop wasting matches!

fields.JP: じょ、冗談に決まってるだろ、うん

fields.EN:
Haha. I for one admire your venerable spirit.
Keep it up, Jack!
fields.JP:
はは、僕はどんな妄想だったとしても
ジャックを軽蔑したりはしないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. I for one admire your venerable spirit.
Keep it up, Jack!

fields.JP:
わ、わたしは
おつうちゃんのが見たいかも……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 何だか一気に緊張感が……

fields.EN: But I'm grateful to all of you for making things so much fun. It makes me feel like a wonderful future is waiting for us...
fields.JP:
でも僕、こんな楽しいみんなに感謝してるんだ。
きっと素敵な未来が待ってるって思えるから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I appreciate the support, everyone.
I think I'm finally starting to see the
light at the end of the tunnel.

fields.EN:
Which means, we're within touching distance
of the bright future we've dreamt of.
fields.JP:
じゃあ今から、そんな素敵な未来を
きっちり掴みに行かないといけないわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means, we're within touching distance
of the bright future we've dreamt of.

fields.EN:
Come on, Jack. Let's break outta this thing,
once and for all!
fields.JP:
行きましょうジャック。
そして今度こそ、こんな世界からの
脱獄を果たしましょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on, Jack. Let's break outta this thing,
once and for all!

fields.EN:
(In the morning, our camp set out to scale
the tower.)
fields.JP:
（朝になってからみんなで移動して、
　今度は『悪食の監隊塔』にキャンプ地を
　設営したっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the morning, our camp set out to scale
the tower.)

fields.EN:
(I still can't get the sight of last night out of
my head...)
fields.JP:
（昨夜、自分が見た光景が
　頭から離れないっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I still can't get the sight of last night out of
my head...)

fields.JP:
（えっ……？
　な、なんで自分をスルーして、
　歩き回ってるんすか？）

fields.EN:
(O-oh...? She left.
How didn't she see me?)
fields.JP:
（……あ、あれ？　行っちゃったっすか？
　もしかして、こっちが見えて
　なかったんすかね……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(O-oh...? She left.
How didn't she see me?)

fields.EN:
(Shira-san still hasn't told anyone anything about
what happened then...)
fields.JP:
（シラさんもあの時のことを、
　未だに誰にも何ひとつ言ってない
　みたいっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Pi still hasn't told us about that one time...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(It felt like our eyes met. Maybe I imagined
it?)
fields.JP:
（あの時、ものすごく目が
　あった気がするんすけど……
　自分の気のせいだったっすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It felt like our eyes met. Maybe I imagined
it?)

fields.EN:
With that said, kill them all in their sleep
tonight. Do I make myself clear?
fields.JP:
ってことでぇ、今夜にでもあいつらを
裏切って、全員殺っちゃいなさい。
これ、決定事項ね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
With that said, kill them all in their sleep
tonight. Do I make myself clear?

fields.EN:
Besides, I bet Papa would be real impressed
if you managed to kill them all♪
You wanna prove yourself, don't you?
fields.JP:
それに、あいつら全員をあんたが殺せば、
パパはきっと見直してくれるでしょーね♪
晴れて一人前になれるし、イイ話じゃなーい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, I bet Papa would be real impressed
if you managed to kill them all♪
You wanna prove yourself, don't you?

fields.EN:
(Shira-san definitely said she didn't want to do it
back then... Has she been worrying about it this
whole time?)
fields.JP:
（シラさんは……あの時確かに
　嫌だって言ったっすけど、
　もしかしてずっと悩んでたんすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi...said she didn't want to go through
with it. I can tell it's weighed heavily on
her mind.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(But... the fact that Shira-san is even troubled by
it makes me sad.)
fields.JP:
（でも……シラさんに悩まれること
　自体が悲しいっす）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Nuahahaha! My new fort is finally
assembled!
fields.JP:
ぬはははっ！
我らの新たな拠点が完成したようだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nuahahaha! My new fort is finally
assembled!

fields.EN:
So this Jail's ringleader is around here!
I won't lyet him do as he pleases while the
great Demon King is here!
fields.JP:
この監獄塔に、悪の親玉とやらがいるのだな！
大魔王である我を差し置いて、
そんな奴に、好き勝手にはさせにゅぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So this Jail's ringleader must be around here
somewhere! How dare he vyiolate admist
knowing I'm hyere!

fields.JP: あははっ、めるんがまたかんだー

fields.EN: Hameln, you're always like that when it matters most.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンは、肝心なところで
いつもそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe when this is over, Hameln can get
speech lessons.

fields.EN: Shut up! I was just tongue-tied is all!
fields.JP:
う、うるさいっ！
気合いが入りすぎて、ちょっぴり舌が
回らなくなっただけなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Shut up! I was just tongue-tied is all!

fields.JP:
そう……じゃあ、そういうことに
しておきましょう

fields.EN: Rapunzel and Nemu-Nemu are just as fired up as Merun!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルもねむねむも、
めるんとおなじくらい
きあいはいってるよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sleepy and I are pumped too!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
ボクも……頑張る……！

fields.EN:
(Shira-san... what are you thinking right now?
Are you still torn?)
fields.JP:
（シラさんは…今、何を考えてるんすか？
　やっぱり、迷ってるんすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi, what's on your mind? Are you still
thinking?)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Even so... I believe in Shira-san, who said she
didn't want to kill anyone.)
fields.JP:
（それでも自分は……殺すのは嫌だと
　言った、シラさんを信じてるっす）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Still... I believe she wouldn't do it.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(If we keep exploring this Jail Tower, maybe we'll
understand Shira-san better.)
fields.JP:
（この『悪食の監隊塔』の探索が進めば、
　シラさんのことが、もっと理解
　できるかもしれないっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe exploring this tower with her
will let me get to know her better...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(More than anything...we'll find Boss and
the others too!)
fields.JP:
（それに何より……この親玉の本拠地でこそ、
　師匠たちと再会できるかもしれないっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(More than anything...we'll find Boss and
the others too!)

fields.JP: よーし、自分も頑張るっすよ！

fields.EN: But there aren't any Nightmares here.
