fields.JP:
そういえばこの悪食の監隊塔、
ナイトメアがいないっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: But there aren't any Nightmares here.

fields.JP: そう私もそれが気になっていたわ

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN:
There it is! I think this one's meaner than
the Nightmares we've seen before!
fields.JP:
でおったな！
確かに今までの番人とは風格がちがう……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There it is! I think this one's meaner than
the Nightmares we've seen before!

fields.JP: うん！　きけんなかおりがする！

fields.EN:
But little does it know, how much trouble
it's in for!
fields.JP:
しかし我に掛かれば……
我に掛かればな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But little does it know, how much trouble
it's in for!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: イギギギギエエエエェェ！！！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
だーーーー！
なぜ決め台詞を言う前にくるのだ！
不毛なことをしてないで来るっすよ！

fields.EN: Hmph! Dyat's what you get for getting in my way!
fields.JP: ふん！　我の邪魔をするからにゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph! Dyat's what you get, you fat pesht!

fields.EN: Uh... Whatever that means. Glad we're safe!
fields.JP:
ここは噛むところではないと思うんっすけど、
なんにしても無事倒せて良かったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh... Whatever that means. Glad we're safe!

fields.JP: シラ、あなたさっき何か言いかけたわね
べ、別に敵に言うことじゃないし……！

fields.EN: Still hung up on it, are you?
fields.JP: まだそれを引きずってるのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Still hung up on it, are you?

fields.EN:
Shira, Rapunzel wants to know too!
What is it, what is it?
fields.JP:
シラ、ラプンツェルもきになる！
なになになーに？
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi! I wanna know too! What's up?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Rgh... I won't tell! Not even to you, Rapu!
fields.JP: うっ！　ラプのお願いでも聞かないもん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh... I won't tell! Not even to you, Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: うーん……わかった、シラごめんなさい

fields.EN:
Oogh... I just remembered why there aren't
Nightmares here!
fields.JP:
ううぅ……。
ここのナイトメアがいない理由を思い出したのっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh... I just remembered why there aren't
Nightmares here!

fields.EN:
(She's never honest with herself.
All part of her charm, I guess.)
fields.JP:
（素直じゃないっすねえ。
　でも、そんなところもかわいいっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's never honest with herself.
All part of her charm, I guess.)

fields.EN:
I remember Papa talking about this tower.
He said he didn't want that monster near
him.
fields.JP:
この悪食の監隊塔は前にパパが
「あんな化け物は近くにおきたくない」って、
言ってて置いてないらしくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember Papa talking about this tower.
He said he didn't want that monster near
him.

fields.JP:
マジっすか！？
それならかなり精神的負担が軽くなるっすよ～

……うん……うん……
僕も……うれしい……

fields.EN: Yeah. I do feel like something's missing, but if everyone's safe, I'm happy too!
fields.JP:
うむ、物足りない気はするが、
皆が安全なら我もうれしいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I feel like something's missing, but
less trouble for us!

fields.JP: シラっ、おしえてくれてありがとう！

fields.EN: She isn't here, is she? Kubitsuri-neesan...
fields.JP: いないよね……首吊り姉さん……
fields.LOCALIZED: She isn't here, is she? Gallows...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
(Normally Shira-san would get carried away here...
Is she worried about her surroundings?)
fields.JP:
（いつものシラさんならここで
　調子にのるんっすけど……
　何か周りを気にしてるんっすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Knowing Pi, she's probably freaking out.
At least she's looking out for us.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Wait. Is this the signal Kubitsuridai mentioned?
No, there's no way! I can't doubt her!)
fields.JP:
（まさか、この間見た首吊り台に合図を……！
　いや、そんなことするわけないっす！！
　少しでも疑った自分は馬鹿っす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait. Is this the signal Gallows mentioned?
No, there's no way! I can't doubt her!)

fields.EN: Clara, what's the problem? Come on.
fields.JP:
くらら、何をぼーっとしてるのかしら？
もう行くわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Clara, what's the problem? Come on.

fields.EN: Whoa! Oh. I'm fine! Let's go!
fields.JP:
わっ！　いや、大丈夫っす！
さ、さ、出発っしゅ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! Oh. I'm fine! Let's go!

fields.EN: Hahaha! Now you're the oyne who's slurring!
fields.JP:
ハハッハッ！
今日はくららが噛みおったにょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha! Now you're the oyne who's slurring!

fields.JP: あはは、めるんもだよー！

（不確定なことで動揺しても仕方ないっす……
　ひとまず一度キャンプ地に戻って
　整理したいっす……）

fields.EN:
That takes care of the core! Now we have
good news to give Kaede-san!
fields.JP:
核も無事破壊したし、カエデさんたちに
いい報告が出来そうっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That takes care of the core! Now we have
good news to give Kaede!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
U-Um... Another successful trip.
Glad you're back safe.
fields.JP:
あ、あの……探索お疲れ様でした。
ご無事でなによりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
U-Um... Another successful trip.
Glad you're back safe.

fields.EN:
Huh? What's the matter, everyone?
You're acting weird.
fields.JP:
あれ？　みなさんどうしたんすか？
何だか様子が変っすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's the matter, everyone?
You're acting weird.

fields.EN:
Well, while you were out, we were hit
with some unfavorable news.
fields.JP:
いや、君達が不在の間に、
俄には信じ難い話を聞かされて、
少々混乱していてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, while you were out, we were hit
with some unfavorable news.

fields.EN: Perhaps we'll let Rachel-chan tell you herself.
fields.JP:
詳しくは、レイチェルちゃんから
お話を聞いてちょーだいな
fields.LOCALIZED: Perhaps we'll let Rachel tell you herself.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルちゃん => Rachel-chan

fields.JP: ん？　レイチェルの話だと？

fields.EN: Oh! You're back! I've been waiting for you.
fields.JP:
あっ！　みなさん、帰って来たんですね！
待っていたんですよっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! You're back! I've been waiting for you.

fields.EN: Cheruu, you're really excited. What's wrong?
fields.JP:
ちぇるー、すごくこうふんしてる
どーしたの？
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.EN:
Okay everyone, listen up! The other night...
I saw...!
fields.JP:
あのっ、みなさん、聞いて下さいっ、
わたし……この間の夜、見てしまったんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay everyone, listen up! The other night...
I saw...!

fields.EN:
I saw Shira-san over there... secretly talking with
that scary Kubitsuridai woman from Genocide Pink!
fields.JP:
そこの、シラさんが…処刑台少女の
首吊り台っていう怖い女の人と、
こそこそ話してるのをっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pi was there...and she was talking with
that Gallows lady from Massacre Pink!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10). | Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.

fields.JP: なにいっ、処刑台少女の首吊り台だと！？
fields.notes: Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP:
……それで、いったいシラは
その首吊り台と何を話していたというの？

fields.EN: The two of them were talking about killing us... *sob* I got so scared I couldn't keep quiet...
fields.JP:
２人で、わたしたちを殺すみたいなことを
話してたんです……ううっ。
わたし、怖くてだまっていられなくなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
They talked about killing us at night...
Ooh. I was so scared, I had to tell.

fields.EN: R-Rachel-san, you were watching that night?
fields.JP: れ、レイチェルさんもあの夜、見てたんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: R-Rachel, you were watching that night?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: レイチェルさん => Rachel-san

fields.EN: Clara, you saw too?! So Rachel's not lying?!
fields.JP:
くららも現場を見ていたの！？
じゃあ、彼女の見間違いとかじゃないのね……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Clara, you saw too?! So Rachel's not lying?!

fields.EN: What do you have to say for yourself, Shira?!
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you have to say for yourself, Pi?!

fields.EN: It's true I saw Kubitsuri-neesan, but...
fields.JP:
……っ、確かに、首吊り姉さんとは
会ってたけど……でも……っ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's true I saw my sister, but...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
See! She admitted it! She talked to the
thieves too! She's up to no good!
fields.JP:
やっぱり！　認めましたよっ！
この人は、この間も泥棒と一緒だったし、
きっと、いつも悪い事を考えてるんです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See! She admitted it! She talked to the
thieves too! She's up to no good!

fields.JP:
ち、ちがう！
シラはっ……！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Answer, did you or did you not talk about
killing us?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、わたしたちを殺すって話は、
絶対してなかったって言うんですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Answer, did you or did you not talk about
killing us?

fields.EN: Well... She wanted me to, but...but...
fields.JP:
……そ、それは……
首吊り姉さんは、そう言ってたけど、
でも、でも……っ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well... She wanted me to, but...but...

fields.JP: ほら！　やっぱり、言ってたじゃないですか！

fields.EN: Shira, is she telling the truth?
fields.JP:
シラ、彼女が言うように、
それは事実なのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi, is she telling the truth?

fields.EN:
Aw, I'm scared! We should kick her out
before she kills us all!
fields.JP:
やだやだっ、怖いよぉ……！
この人を追い出さないと、
わたしたち、きっとみんな殺されちゃう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, I'm scared! We should kick her out
before she kills us all!

fields.JP: シラは、そんなことしないよ！！！

fields.EN:
But Rapunzel-san, Shira-san keeps doing suspicious
things, doesn't she?
fields.JP:
でも、ラプンツェルさん、
シラさんは、いつも疑わしいこと
ばかりしてるんですよ？
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ラプンツェル => Rapunzel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: She used to be with the bad people, right? And now she's come here to kill everyone... That must have been her goal from the start!
fields.JP:
元々悪い人たちの仲間だったんでしょう？
しかも、ここにきてみんなを殺すとか……
元々それが目的だったに違いないです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She worked with the bad guys, right?
You saw them, didn't you? I bet this
has been her plan the whole time!

fields.EN:
But...! Even so, Shira would never do that!
Rapunzel believes Shira!
fields.JP:
でも……っ、それでもシラは
ぜったいそんなことしない！
ラプンツェルは、シラをしんじる！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
(Rapu-san trusts Shira-san completely even now.
I'll follow the path I believe in too!)
fields.JP:
（ラプさんは、この状況でも真っ直ぐに
　シラさんを信じているんっすね。
　自分も、己が信じた道を行くっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rappy believes in Pi despite everything.
I'm gonna do the same!)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Like Rapu-san... I believe Shira-san is innocent
too!
fields.JP:
自分も……ラプさんと同じく、
シラさんの潔白を信じるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm with Rappy... Pi's gotta be innocent!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Shira-san has risked her life fighting beside us.
She's an important companion. She wouldn't do
something like that!
fields.JP:
今まで自分たちと一緒に命掛けで
戦っていたシラさんが……大事な仲間が、
そんなことするはずないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pi has been risking her life beside us.
She wouldn't betray her friends like that!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うん！
シラは……大事な仲間……！

fields.EN:
Hmph. I had that thought first.
The girl just said it first...
fields.JP:
ふ、ふん、我も実はそう思っていたぞ！
小娘たちに先に言われてしまったがな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. I had that thought first.
The girl just said it first...

fields.EN:
Happy you can all agree on something for
once. But innocence isn't proven by hearsay.
fields.JP:
意見がまとまっているところ、悪いけれど。
『思う』だけでは疑いは晴れないわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Happy you can all agree on something for
once. But innocence isn't proven by hearsay.

fields.EN: Damn you, Gretel! Why are you such a jerk?!
fields.JP:
くぉらっ、グレーテル！
そこでいきなり水を差すでないっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn you, Gretel! Why are you such a jerk?!

fields.EN: As usual, I'm merely stating the truth.
fields.JP: 私はいつものように、事実を述べたまでよ
fields.LOCALIZED: As usual, I'm merely stating the truth.

fields.EN: Hey, I side with Gretel-san on this!
fields.JP: そうですっ、グレーテルさんの言う通りです！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, I side with Gretel on this!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
It seems the accusation is that Shira met with
Kubitsuridai and was ordered to kill us.
fields.JP:
このシラが首吊り台と会って、
私たちを殺すように言われていたのは
事実のようね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems the accusation is that Pi met with
Gallows and was ordered to kill us.
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira | Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.

fields.EN:
But she has yet to do so. The question is,
does she intend to?
fields.JP:
ただ、実行はしていない。
そもそも、本人にその意思はあるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she has yet to do so. The question is,
does she intend to?

fields.EN:
No! No way! Shira... Shira doesn't want to
kill anyone!
fields.JP:
ないっ！　そんなわけないっ！
シラは……誰も殺したくなんか、ないっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No! Of course not! I... I don't want to kill
anyone!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
But that's your word for it. We have no way
of telling if you've killed anyone else by now.
fields.JP:
……とシラ本人は主張しているし、
この時点で実行していないのなら、
後はわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's your word for it. We have no way
of telling if you've killed anyone else by now.

fields.EN:
So if possible, our best solution would be to
have a section of us monitoring Shira at all times.
fields.JP:
可能性があるとしたら、
『今後シラは複数の人間と常に行動を取る』
といった対策くらいしか出来ないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So if possible, our best solution would be to
have a section of us monitoring Pi at all times.

fields.EN: Got it? This discussion is over.
fields.JP: はい、これでこの話はお終いよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it? This discussion is over.

fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんにしては、
　ずいぶんとあっさりした言い分っすね）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
So you're asking us to stay with someone
who could kill us?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、これからも、
わたし達を殺すかもしれない人と
一緒にいろってことですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you're asking us to stay with someone
who could kill us?

fields.EN: Hehehe. Spices things up, doesn't it?
fields.JP:
ふふふっ、今はそんな些細なことよりも、
もっと興味深いことがあるのよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. Spices things up, doesn't it?

fields.EN: Uh. Why does Gretel-san have that look?
fields.JP:
えっ、グレーテルさん、
妙に嬉しそうっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh. Why does Gretel have that look?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Right, Rachel. Or should I say, someone who
claims to be Rachel. Who are you really?
fields.JP:
ねぇ、レイチェル……いいえ。
レイチェルのフリをしている誰かさん。
あなたは、いったい何者なのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, Rachel. Or should I say, someone who
claims to be Rachel. Who are you really?

fields.EN:
...Gretel-san, what are you even saying?
Don't mock me. That's mean.
fields.JP:
……っ、グレーテルさん、
こんな時に何を言ってるんですか？
わたしをからかわないで下さい。ひどいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Gretel, what are you even saying?
Don't mock me. That's mean.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
I am not mocking you. I only doubt that you
are the Rachel you pretend to be.
fields.JP:
からかってなんかいないわ。
私は貴女が『レイチェル』という人物
ではないと思っているから、聞いたまでよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I am not mocking you. I only doubt that you
are the Rachel you pretend to be.

fields.EN:
But everyone told me they met my older
and younger sisters!
fields.JP:
で、でも、みなさんはわたしの
姉と妹に会ったと仰ってました……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But everyone told me they met my older
and younger sisters!

fields.EN:
Aye, but there's the rub. That can't be true.
We hadn't met Rachel's older and younger
sisters. Just her two older sisters.
fields.JP:
そもそも、そこからして違うのよ。
私たちが会ったのはレイチェルの『姉と妹』
ではなく、『２人の姉』だったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aye, but there's the rub. That can't be true.
We hadn't met Rachel's older and younger
sisters. Just her two older sisters.

fields.EN: What?! B-But that's what Clara-san said...
fields.JP:
っ！？
で、でも、くららさんも、
わたしの姉さんと妹だって……
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! B-But that's what Clara said...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららさん => Clara-san

fields.EN: Yes, I did say that. Wait. Was I wrong?
fields.JP:
確かに自分はそう言ったっすけど、
あれれ？　違ったんすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I did say that. Wait. Was I wrong?

fields.EN:
You are mistaken, little girl. I thought both
of your sisters are older.
fields.JP:
小娘、それは間違いであるぞ。
我は２人とも姉であると聞いたのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are mistaken, little girl. I thought both
of your sisters are older.

fields.JP:
……うん、うん。
２人とも、レイチェルのお姉さん……

fields.EN:
Oh, really?! Maybe I had it wrong all along.
I need to apologize to those girls.
fields.JP:
そ、そうだったんすか！
自分、勘違いしてたかもしれないっす。
２人には失礼なことしちゃったっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, really?! Maybe I had it wrong all along.
I need to apologize to those girls.

fields.EN:
How would you mistake your sisters like that?
Wouldn't you remember?
fields.JP:
ねぇ、自分の姉妹の序列を間違えるなんて、
そんなこと、あるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How would you mistake your sisters like that?
Wouldn't you remember?

fields.EN: Well...I haven't seen them in a while.
fields.JP:
そ、それは……
暫く……会ってなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Well...I haven't seen them in a while.

fields.EN:
One more thing. You said your parents
sacrificed their lives to let you escape.
That's how they were murdered.
fields.JP:
もう一つ。貴女は最初、両親があの時に
自分を逃がすために犠牲になって
殺されたと言っていたけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
One more thing. You said your parents
sacrificed their lives to let you escape.
That's how they were murdered.

fields.EN:
But Riley and Ellie mentioned that their
parents had passed a long time ago.
Your story is full of holes.
fields.JP:
ライリーとエリーは、両親は大分前に
死んだと言っていたわ……
まず、その時点で穴だらけなのよ、貴女は
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Riley and Ellie mentioned that their
parents had passed a long time ago.
Your story is full of holes.

fields.EN:
Besides, how would you know if Shira was speaking
with Kubitsuridai if you had never met the latter?
fields.JP:
そもそもシラと会っていた人物が、
貴女が会ったこともないはずの、
『首吊り台』だと、どうして分かったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, how would you know if Pi was speaking
with Gallows if you had never met the latter?
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira | Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.

fields.JP:
そ、それは昔、首吊り台って人を
見たことがあって……

fields.EN:
Hehe. Is that so? It doesn't add up.
Remember what you said before?
fields.JP:
ふふっ、あら、そうだったの？
でも、おかしいわね。
貴女は以前みんなの前でこう言ってたわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Is that so? It doesn't add up.
Remember what you said before?

fields.EN: You said, 'What's that? What's that? I've never seen her, but just hearing about her is scary.'
fields.JP:
『なにそれなにそれ、見たことないけど
聞くだけでも怖いです』ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You asked who she was, and said her name
was scary. Remember?

fields.EN:
B-But Gretel-san, you saw Shira-san meeting Kubitsuridai
that day too, didn't you?!
fields.JP:
で、でもっ！　グレーテルさんだって、
シラさんと首吊り台が会ってた日に、
現場を見てたはずでしょうっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Gretel! Didn't you see Pi talk to Gallows
too?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10). | Source-gated Gallows => Kubitsuridai.

fields.JP:
（えっ！？　そうだったんすか？
　気付かなかったっす）

fields.EN:
Yes, exactly. I was in fact watching.
But how would YOU know that...?
fields.JP:
ええ、その通りよ。
確かに見ていたけれど……
なぜそれを貴女が知っているのかしらね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, exactly. I was in fact watching.
But how would YOU know that...?

fields.EN:
Hm. How strange. Rachel's story seems more
and more implausible.
fields.JP:
むぅ……聞いててどうにもおかしいのだ。
レイチェルの話には矛盾が多すぎるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. How strange. Rachel's story seems more
and more implausible.

fields.JP: ちぇるーは、ほんとはちぇるーじゃないの？
fields.notes: B15 Rachel third-person self-reference / Cheruu source nickname restoration

fields.EN:
I mean, I've had my suspicions from the
beginning. I noticed your penchant for flattery.
fields.JP:
そもそも貴女が見せている、
人に媚びて訴えかけるような行動には、
最初から違和感があったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, I've had my suspicions from the
beginning. I noticed your penchant for flattery.

fields.EN:
The more I listened, the more contradictions
I found.
fields.JP:
そして貴女の話を聞けば聞くほど、
矛盾だらけだって気づいたの。
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more I listened, the more contradictions
I found.

fields.EN:
At first, I thought you might be a compulsive
liar. But now I know, you were trying to get
to Shira somehow.
fields.JP:
最初は、ただの虚言癖でもあるのかと思って
観察していたけれど、今回の発言で確信したわ。
貴女は『シラ』に何かをしようとしている
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first, I thought you might be a compulsive
liar. But now I know, you were trying to get
to Pi somehow.

fields.EN:
You could've told us this the day after you saw Kubitsuridai.
There was no need to make a point of saying it now,
right when everyone has reunited.
fields.JP:
そもそもこんな話は、首吊り台を見た
翌日にすればいいし、何も『全員が合流した』
このタイミングで、わざとらしく言わなくても
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, you could have told us all when we
originally accused Pi of talking with Gallows.
But you bring it up now, with everyone here.
fields.notes: B19 removed residual localization-only Pyre/Pi/Byre; source wording/distortion restored

fields.EN:
I found it odd that no one else noticed it was
odd. Hehe... Hehe.
fields.JP:
それで不自然に感じない方がおかしいわよね。
ふふっ、ふふふ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found it odd that no one else noticed it was
odd. Hehe... Hehe.

fields.EN:
(I thought at first that her story sounded fishy,
but I guess I didn't look too much into it.)
fields.JP:
（自分も、少し『あれっ』とは思ったけど、
　そこまでは全く思いつかなかったっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought at first that her story sounded fishy,
but I guess I didn't look too much into it.)

fields.EN:
Thanks to you, I now have an inkling as to
who you could be. So if I may...
fields.JP:
おかげで貴女が何者か、大体見当がついたわ。
だから、素直に感想を言わせて貰うと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, I now have an inkling as to
who you could be. So if I may...

fields.EN:
I bet you think you're real clever, don't you?
But your charade never fooled me. How amateur.
fields.JP:
貴女、もしかして自分のことを、
『知略に溢れた策略家』とでも思ってない？
穴だらけの行動でそれは、相当滑稽よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you think you're real clever, don't you?
But your charade never fooled me. How amateur.

fields.EN:
Tch... I let you blab all you want, and this is
what you came up with! Shut up! Stupid human!
fields.JP:
……ちっ、言わせておけば！
うるさいわね、低脳な人間のくせにっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... I let you blab all you want, and this is
what you came up with! Shut up! Stupid human!

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
Aww. I wanted to savor the surprise for a bit
longer, but you took forever! Sheesh!
fields.JP:
あーあ、あんたのもんを全部奪ってやろうと
思ってたのに、いっつまでもグズグズ
モタモタしてるからさぁ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aww. I wanted to savor the surprise for a bit
longer, but you took forever! Sheesh!

fields.EN:
You ruined everything! Ugh. You annoy me.
Time to slaughter all of you!
fields.JP:
台無しになっちゃったでしょー！
あーもう、ムカツクから、
おまえごとぜーんぶぶち殺してやるよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You ruined everything! Ugh. You annoy me.
Time to slaughter all of you!

fields.JP: ど、ど、どういうことなのだ！
（流石に頭が追いつかないっすよ……！！）

fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Don't think, just follow my orders!
Falter, and you'll perish! Am I clear?!
fields.JP:
今は何も考えず、私の指示に従いなさい！
迷ったらすぐ死ぬわよ！
返事は！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think, just follow my orders!
Falter, and you'll perish! Am I clear?!

fields.EN:
Let's start by showing Kubitsuridai here how we
do things. I repeat, defeat Kubitsuridai here and now!
That's all! Move out!
fields.JP:
まずは目の前の首吊り台を倒す！
もう一度言うわ、まずは目の前の首吊り台を倒す！
以上よ！　行くわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's start by showing Gallows here how we
do things. I repeat, defeat Gallows here and now!
That's all! Move out!

fields.JP:
わ、わかったっす！
いくっす！

fields.EN:
Tch... You're worthless bastards!
How dare you twerps challenge me!
fields.JP:
ちぃっ……このクソ以下のゴミクズ共がっ！
よくも……よくも優秀なこのわたしをっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch... You're worthless bastards!
How dare you twerps challenge me!

fields.EN:
Argh... I'm angry! Damn you!
Damn you all!
fields.JP:
あーもう、腹が立ってしかたないっての！
クソが……クソがぁぁっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Argh... I'm angry! Damn you!
Damn you all!

fields.JP: 首吊り姉さん……なんでこんなことをしたの
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
Hmph. This is nothing to me!
Besides, Papa ordered me to kill anyone
who crosses us!
fields.JP:
ふん、ちょっと遊んでやろうと思っただけよ！
そもそもあんたは、パパからすぐに裏切り者を
処分しろって言われてたんだけどねぇ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. This is nothing to me!
Besides, Papa ordered me to kill anyone
who crosses us!

fields.EN:
Haha. So I figured it would be more fun
to round up everyone you care about and
kill them with you! How's that sound?
fields.JP:
ははっ、どうせなら、あんたの大事なもんを、
全部奪ってから殺ろうと思ったんだー！
その方がただ殺るより、ずっと楽しいし？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. So I figured it would be more fun
to round up everyone you care about and
kill them with you! How's that sound?

fields.EN:
I wasted all that blood using the Gore Suit
to disguise myself. Ugh. So stupid!
fields.JP:
ゴアスーツの人間の血液量具合で
人間っぽくなれるのを利用したんだけどさ。
とんだ無駄だったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasted all that blood using the Gore Suit
to disguise myself. Ugh. So stupid!

fields.EN: (Wait, that's what fuels the Gore Suits...?)
fields.JP: （えっ！　ゴアスーツの「燃料」ってまさか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Wait, that's what fuels the Gore Suits...?)

fields.JP:
……っ！　首吊り姉さんは、
いつだって、そうだったよね
fields.LOCALIZED: ...! Sister Gallows, you're always like that.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
You find things people hold dear to them,
and you snatch it away! You're nothing but
a mean bully!
fields.JP:
いつも、人の大事なものばかり欲しがって、
無理矢理奪って……
手に入れたら、踏みにじって捨てる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You find things people hold dear to them,
and you snatch it away! You're nothing but
a mean bully!

fields.EN:
What's your deal? That's the fun in it.
Could you quit being a party pooper?
fields.JP:
なによぉ、それが楽しいんじゃない。
人の趣味にケチつけないでくれるぅ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your deal? That's the fun in it.
Could you quit being a party pooper?

fields.EN:
Wait, why did you pretend to be Rachel
in the first place?
fields.JP:
そもそも、なんで『レイチェル』って
人間になりすましてたんすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, why did you pretend to be Rachel
in the first place?

fields.EN:
If Riley-san and Ellie weren't here,
we may have never noticed...
fields.JP:
ライリーさんたちがいなかったら、
もしかしたら気付かれなかったかも
知れないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Riley and Ellie weren't here,
we may have never noticed...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ライリーさん => Riley-san

fields.EN:
Hahahaha. Honestly, they were a curve ball!
Who do you think Rachel is, anyways?
It's you, Hiaburibashira!
fields.JP:
あははっ、あれは正直計算外だったけどさぁ！
そもそもレイチェルって、誰だと思う？
あんたのことだよ、火あぶり柱！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha. Honestly, they were a curve ball!
Who do you think Rachel is, anyways?
It's you, Pyre!

fields.EN:
Guillotine-neesan took you. You were Papa's
first Genocide Pink experiment. A guinea pig!
fields.JP:
あんたはギロチン姉さんに連れられ、
パパに処刑台少女に改造された、被験体第１号。
ただの実験用のモルモットだったんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Guillotine took you. You were Papa's
first Massacre Pink experiment. A guinea pig!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
But who would've thought your sisters lived?
Those jerks...ruined my plans!
fields.JP:
それが、まさか姉妹が生きてるなんて、
クソがッ、予定が狂ったじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But who would've thought your sisters lived?
Those jerks...ruined my plans!

fields.EN:
S-Shira is... really Rachel?
An experimental subject for the Genocide Pink...?
fields.JP:
シ、シラが……本当はレイチェル？
処刑台少女の、被験体……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm... I'm Rachel? I'm an experiment?
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Tch. If it weren't for Alice, we could have
killed all three of you together on the spot!
fields.JP:
ちっ……そもそも、アリスなんて女に
縛られなければ、あの時こいつらを
まとめてすぐに殺れたってのにさぁ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch. If it weren't for Alice, we could have
killed all three of you together on the spot!

fields.EN: Ugh! This is horrible! You guys piss me off!
fields.JP:
あーあー、もう最悪！
胸くそ悪すぎだってのーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh! This is horrible! You guys piss me off!

fields.EN:
I-I can't forgive them! They took Shira-san from her
real family and even did something so horrible to
her...!
fields.JP:
ゆ、許せないっす！
シラさんを本当の家族から奪った上に、
そんな酷いことまでしてたなんて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll never forgive you! Not only did you take
Pi from her family, but you'll pay for your
crimes!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: I won't let you take anything else!
fields.JP: これ以上は、なにひとつ奪わせないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: I won't let you take anything else!

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ！
ボクも……ゆるせない……

fields.EN: What?! There's a hand coming out of the wall!
fields.JP: なっ！？　壁から手が……っ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! There's a hand coming out of the wall!

fields.EN: N-No... It's not what it looks like!
fields.LOCALIZED: N-No... It's not what it looks like!

fields.JP: あーーっ、にげるな！　まてーーーっ！

fields.EN: Huh? Where'd they go? Into the wall...
fields.JP:
あ、あれ？　どこにもいない？
かべにきえちゃった……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Where'd they go? Into the wall...

fields.EN: Grrr. They're so quick to escape!
fields.JP:
ぬぅぅ、おのれぇ、
なんて逃げ足が速いのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Grrr. They're so quick to escape!

fields.EN:
(After that, in front of a dejected Shira-san, we
told everyone about reuniting with our companions.)
fields.JP:
（その後、自分たちは落ち込んでるシラさんを
　前に、仲間達と会えた話をしたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Afterwards, I told the group that we
reunited with our friends, mostly to
cheer up Pi.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(Despite the good news, everyone seemed
glum, as there was more to be done...)
fields.JP:
（でも、折角会えたのにみんなどこか暗くて、
　素直に喜べない状況だったっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Despite the good news, everyone seemed
glum, as there was more to be done...)

fields.EN:
(I hope Shira-san is okay. For now, we have to meet
up with everyone tomorrow.)
fields.JP:
（シラさんは、大丈夫っすかね。
　ひとまず明日、みんなと合流しなきゃっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope Pi's okay. At least we can see our
friends tomorrow...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Oh, this way! We promised everyone we'd
come!
fields.JP:
あ、こっちっす！
この先で、みんなと合流する
約束をしてるんすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, this way! We promised everyone we'd
come!

fields.EN: I see. I'd love to see them all soon!
fields.JP:
そう、話は聞いたけど、
一刻も早くみんなの顔を見たいわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. I'd love to see them all soon!

fields.EN: Seriously... My heart is about to burst.
fields.JP: ええ、気持ちばかりが逸ります……
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously... My heart is about to burst.

fields.EN: We're almost there! Beyond this door.
fields.JP:
もうすぐっす！
ここの扉の先っす
fields.LOCALIZED: We're almost there! Beyond this door.

fields.EN: We're here! See, beyond that glass...
fields.JP:
到着っす！
ほら、あのガラスの向こうに……
fields.LOCALIZED: We're here! See, beyond that glass...

fields.JP: ……待って、部屋の中に何かいるわ

fields.EN: Wha! What the hell is that?!
fields.JP: ぬおっ！？　なんなのだこれは！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha! What the hell is that?!

fields.EN:
Aah! What is that thing?! It's getting dark
everywhere!
fields.JP:
ひっ！？　な、なんなんすか、
部屋の中に大きな闇があるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aah! What is that thing?! It's getting dark
everywhere!

fields.JP:
……グ、ギギ、ババ……
ギ、グ……ニイザン……

fields.EN:
Wait, is that a Nightmare?
Oh no, are those my sisters?!
fields.JP:
あの、ナイトメアって……
ま、まさか……姉さんたち！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wait, is that a Nightmare?
Oh no, are those my sisters?!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: ヴォオオオオォォォォ！！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: Whoa, that thing sure looks strong.
fields.JP: って、随分強そうなやつがいるっすね。
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa, that thing sure looks strong.

fields.EN:
That's the core! It must belong to that
Nightmare, right?
fields.JP:
って、あれは核っすね！
これがあのナイトメアの核ってことっすよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the core! It must belong to that
Nightmare, right?

fields.JP: シラは知っておるのか？

fields.EN:
(Shira-san still looks down after everything that
happened...)
fields.JP:
（シラさんやっぱりあんなことがあったから
　元気ないっすよね……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Pi still seems down, which is understandable.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
If that is the case, we must move to destroy
it. Ready?
fields.JP:
そうならば必ず破壊しなきゃいけないわね
準備はいい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that is the case, we must move to destroy
it. Ready?

fields.EN:
Of course! First things first, take down that
Nightmare! Come on!
fields.JP:
無論だ！
シラを襲ったナイトメア討伐の第一歩なのだ！
行くぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course! First things first, take down that
Nightmare! Come on!

fields.JP:
よしっ！
核もすぐさま壊すのだ！！

fields.EN:
Uooo! ...Whoa. Huh?
What's the matter, Shira?
fields.JP:
うおぉ……とと！
どうしたのだシラ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uooo! ...Whoa. Huh?
What's the matter, Pi?

fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: You don't want to destroy the core...?
fields.JP: 核壊したくないんっすか……？

fields.EN: What?! I have no reason to!
fields.JP:
……っ！
そ、そんな理由なんてないけど！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! I have no reason to!

fields.EN:
Shira-san, are you still hesitating because of your
older sisters...?
fields.JP:
もしかしてシラさん今だに
お姉さんのことで躊躇して……
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you conflicted because it's your sisters?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Wow, Clara. Even I wouldn't have come to
that conclusion. Is it true, Shira?
fields.JP:
凄いわねくらら。
私ならたどり着けない答えだわ
そうなの、シラ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow, Clara. Even I wouldn't have come to
that conclusion. Is it true, Pi?

fields.EN:
Oogh... *sob*...! Shira doesn't know either.
She doesn't know, but... when she thinks about
her sisters...
fields.JP:
ううぅ……うっうっ……！
シラもわかんない、わかんないけど……。
なんか姉さん達のことを思うと……。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh... Oogh...! I don't know either.
I don't know, but knowing my sisters...
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: （シラさんあんな目にあったのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (They were awful to her, but she's still upset.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Not sure why you're crying, Shira, but you
must know we plan to destroy the core
before we eliminate the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
シラ、私はあなたがなぜ涙しているのかは
わからない。　ただ私たちは核も破壊するし、
あのナイトメアも殺すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not sure why you're crying, Pi, but you
must know we plan to destroy the core
before we eliminate the Nightmare.

fields.EN:
I do not intend to forgive them for toying
with you. Even if you hate me for killing them,
I hope one day you understand...
fields.JP:
私はあなたを弄び殺そうとした、あのナイトメアを
許す気はないわ。　例えあなたに恨まれたとしても
私には撃つ理由があるの。　わかって頂戴。
fields.LOCALIZED:
I do not intend to forgive them for toying
with you. Even if you hate me for killing them,
I hope one day you understand...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
No... Shira knows she's in the wrong.
Sorry...
fields.JP:
ううぅ……う、ううん……
シラが間違ってるのはわかってるの
ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED: No... I know I'm in the wrong. I'm sorry.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: （グレーテルさんがシラさんの前に……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel's walking up to Pi...
What's she doing?)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: （シラさんのコメカミにキスしたっす！）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Have you snapped out of it?
fields.LOCALIZED: Have you snapped out of it?

fields.EN:
Now, time to destroy that core.
If you'd rather not watch, then stand back.
fields.JP:
さ、それじゃ核を破壊するわよ。
シラは見たくないなら離れなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, time to destroy that core.
If you'd rather not watch, then stand back.

fields.EN:
(Gretel-san is as unpredictable as ever. Still, I'm
glad Shira-san seems calmer.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんは相変わらず突拍子もないっす。
　ただシラさん落ち着いたみたいで良かったっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel, unpredictable as always.
At least Pi looks back to normal.)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): グレーテル => Gretel-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Shira, is there another core in this tower?
fields.JP: シラ、この監隊塔の核はまだあるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi, is there another core in this tower?

fields.EN: Then all we have to do is find the Nightmare!
fields.JP:
ってことは、後は例のナイトメアを
見つけるだけっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then all we have to do is find the Nightmare!

fields.EN:
(Regardless of the situation, she still must
be worried about her sisters...)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりあんな風になってもお姉さんのことを
　気にしてるんすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Regardless of the situation, she still must
be worried about her sisters...)

fields.JP:
シラ……。
ごめんね。
ほらギュ～～！

ちょっとなによ……
ラプ
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I can't fix your problems, but I'm here for
you. So here's an apology hug.
fields.JP:
シラのなやみかいけつできないから、
だけどちからになりたいっておもったの
だからごめんなさいのギューしてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't fix your problems, but I'm here for
you. So here's an apology hug.

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Sorry to rain on your parade, but there's
darkness ahead.
fields.JP:
どうやら水を差すようだけど
あそこに闇が見えるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry to rain on your parade, but there's
darkness ahead.

fields.EN:
Yup. No doubt that's the Nightmare.
Doesn't seem to have noticed us.
fields.JP:
うむ、あれぞまさしく例のナイトメアだ。
しかもまだこちらに気付いておらんな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. No doubt that's the Nightmare.
Doesn't seem to have noticed us.

fields.EN: They're looking away. Now's our chance.
fields.JP: ヤツが完全に後ろを向いている今は好機
fields.LOCALIZED: They're looking away. Now's our chance.

fields.EN:
Let's seize this opportunity and kill it now.
Stay here, Shira.
fields.JP:
この隙を乗じて、我らが一気に仕留めにいく、
シラはここにいるとよいぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's seize this opportunity and kill it now.
Stay here, Pi.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP: それでは行くぞおおお！

（すごいっす！
　一気に畳みかけたっす！）
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

fields.EN: See that?! I destroyed one of its limbs!
fields.JP: 見たか！　一発で部位を破壊したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: See that?! I destroyed one of its limbs!

fields.JP:
……っ！　ダメっ、ハーメルン、
今すぐ退きなさい！

か、回復したっす！
不死性がそのまま残ってるっす！

な、なにぃっ！
それは困るのだっ！

……ん、おかしい。
もう核、無いはずなのに……？

fields.EN:
It's true... From the Jail's cries, Shira thought
all the cores she knew about had been destroyed,
but...
fields.JP:
確かに、ジェイルの鳴き声でシラが
知っている限りの核は破壊されたと
思うのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I heard the Jail cry, and we took care
of the other cores...
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Oh, wait! Maybe it's the core on
Leichhardt Island?!
fields.JP:
あ、はっ……！
ラ、ライカード島の核……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, wait! Maybe it's the core on Licard
Island?!
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN:
What?! Does it use a core from a remote
tower?!
fields.JP:
え！？　でも、別の監獄塔の核から
エネルギーが配給なんてされるんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! Does it use a core from a remote
tower?!

fields.EN:
Interesting. If that were the case, then all
of the other Nightmares would have been
invincible too...
fields.JP:
確かにそうね。　それなら今までの
ナイトメアだって不死性を保っていたはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting. If that were the case, then all
of the other Nightmares would have been
invincible too...

fields.EN:
Papa mentioned that the Devouring Armada
Tower is supplied by every Jail tower...
fields.JP:
この悪食の監隊塔はすべての監獄塔の
エネルギーが配給される場所ってパパが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Papa mentioned that the Devouring Armada
Tower is supplied by every Jail tower...

fields.EN: ...which explains how this one got so big.
fields.JP:
……それならこの監隊塔の巨大さも
納得できるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: ...which explains how this one got so big.

fields.JP:
……じゃあ、
戦っても……勝てない……
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

……ジラ？ビバブリバジラ！？
ヴァァアアアアアアア！！！！！
fields.notes: B19 removed residual localization-only Pyre/Pi/Byre; source wording/distortion restored

fields.JP: ああっ、シラさん、危ないっす！！！
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP:
うあぁぁぁっ！？
ぐ……あぁっ、痛……いやぁ……っ！！

fields.EN: Shira! Are you hurt? You okay?!
fields.JP:
シラーーーーー！！
い、いたいの？
だいじょうぶ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi! Are you hurt? You okay?!

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

……ジラ……ゴロ……ス！！
グオォォォッ！
fields.notes: B19 removed residual localization-only Pyre/Pi/Byre; source wording/distortion restored

fields.EN: Why does that bastard keep going after Shira?!
fields.JP: こ、こやつ、シラを執拗に狙うつもりか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Why does that bastard keep going after Pi?!

fields.EN: Ngh... We must create a diversion.
fields.JP: くっ、これじゃあ陽動もできないわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ngh... We must create a diversion.

fields.EN:
What do we do?! We'll never make it at
this rate! Options, options...
fields.JP:
ど、どうしよう、これじゃ、
逃げるのも一苦労っす！
あああっ、どうしたらいいんすか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do we do?! We'll never make it at
this rate! Options, options...

fields.EN:
Huh? A transmitter?! Who would be calling
us now of all times?!
fields.JP:
えっ？　トランシーバー？
こんな時に呼び出すとか、誰なんっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? A transmitter?! Who would be calling
us now of all times?!

fields.EN:
(If it's Itsuki-san, worst case we could leave
Shira-san with him and stop it ourselves...!)
fields.JP:
（イツキさんとかなら、最悪シラさんを預けて、
　自分達だけで止めるって方法も……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If it's Itsuki, worst case scenario, they can
look after Pi and we'll find the core...)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): イツキ => Itsuki-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: (Chances are low, but here goes nothing!)
fields.JP:
（ええい、限りなく低い可能性っすけど、
　とにかく出てみるっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Chances are low, but here goes nothing!)

fields.EN: Hello...? Clara here! Hey, can you hear me?!
fields.JP:
……も、もしもし？
こちら、くららっす！
おーい、聞こえるっすかーー？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hello...? Clara here! Hey, can you hear me?!

fields.EN: Oh, it's a girl... Who is this?
fields.JP:
えっ、女の子の声……？
だ、誰っすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's a girl... Who is this?

fields.EN:
Oh, Clara! Is that you? It's me, Riley.
I gotta tell you something.
fields.JP:
あれ？　その喋り方は……くらら？
あ、あのさ、ライリーなんだけど、
ちょっと、話したいことがあってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Clara! Is that you? It's me, Riley.
I gotta tell you something.

fields.EN: Riley-san?! Sorry! Now's not the best time!
fields.JP:
ええっ、ライリーさんっすか！？
す、すみません、今それどころじゃなくって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Riley?! Sorry! Now's not the best time!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ライリーさん => Riley-san

fields.EN: ...Did you say Riley?! Clara, hand it over!
fields.JP:
……ライリーですって？
くらら。それ、貸してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Did you say Riley?! Clara, hand it over!

fields.EN:
I'm gonna cut to the chase. Your sister,
Rachel, is in trouble.
fields.JP:
端的にいうわ、
あなた達の妹『レイチェル』が重症なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna cut to the chase. Your sister,
Rachel, is in trouble.

fields.EN:
To save her, we need you to destroy the
core on Leichhardt Island. There's little time.
Hurry, or she'll be killed by the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
レイチェルを助けるためには『ライカード島』の
最奥にある『核』を破壊しないといけないわ。
もう時間がないの。急がないとナイトメアに殺される
fields.LOCALIZED:
To save her, we need you to destroy the
core on Licard Island. There's little time.
Hurry, or she'll be killed by the Nightmare.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN: Wait. What are you talking about?!
fields.JP: 待って。なに言ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. What are you talking about?!

fields.EN: You hear that? We're running out of time.
fields.JP:
……聞こえたかしら？
事態は一刻を争うのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You hear that? We're running out of time.

fields.EN: All we can do now is leave it to them... Heh... For them to arrive at a time like this, I really can't tell whether we're lucky or unlucky.
fields.JP:
後はあっちに任せるしかない……か。
ふっ……このタイミングで来るなんて、
本当に、運がいいのか悪いのか分からないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have no choice...but to leave it to them.
Heh. Life works in mysterious ways.
Hope they pull through.

fields.EN:
ARGH! What are they doing over there?!
I'm about to burst!
fields.JP:
あーーっ、もう、そっちは何をやってるのだ！
流石に我でも限界が近いぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
ARGH! What are they doing over there?!
I'm about to burst!

fields.EN: Uu~! Rapunzel can't hold it back either~!
fields.JP: うーっ、ラプンツェルもおさえきれないよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Can't hold on much longer!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
That Nightmare is hot on her trail.
We need to move like our lives depend
on it. Hear me, Clara?
fields.JP:
とにかく、あのナイトメアは、シラを
執拗に追って来るようだし、逃げて逃げて
逃げまくるわよ。いいわね、くらら
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Nightmare is hot on her trail.
We need to move like our lives depend
on it. Hear me, Clara?

fields.EN:
Roger. I see what you mean.
It's risky, but we have no choice!
fields.JP:
なるほど、つまりそういうことっすか……
中々ギャンブルな気もするっすけど、了解っす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Roger. I see what you mean.
It's risky, but we have no choice!

fields.EN:
(Just once I'd like for us to manage without
too much trouble! But that's asking a lot...)
fields.JP:
（なんかいつもギリギリの展開っす！
　そういう星の下に生まれたんっすかね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just once I'd like for us to manage without
too much trouble! But that's asking a lot...)

fields.EN: Well, here goes nothing... Full speed ahead!
fields.JP: やるしかないなら……やるしかないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, here goes nothing... Full speed ahead!

fields.EN: Aah... *pant, pant* This thing won't quit!
fields.JP:
ひぃ……はぁっ……はぁっ、
な、何でここまで執拗に追って来るんすかぁ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah... *pant, pant* This thing won't quit!

fields.EN:
GRR! I don't know how much longer I can
carry Shira!
fields.JP:
ぬぐぅぅっ、シラを背負ってる我も、
さすがに限界が近づいておるぞっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
GRR! I don't know how much longer I can
carry Pi!

fields.EN: Merun, hang in there! You too, Shira!
fields.JP:
めるん、がんばって！
シラ、しっかり！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hammy, hang in there! You too, Pi!

fields.JP: ……シラ……ボクたちが、助けるから……！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

fields.EN:
It stopped in its tracks. Looks like it's in
pain. Oh, do you think Leichhardt Island's
core was destroyed?!
fields.JP:
あれ？　急に止まって苦しそうに……
あっ、もしかして
ライカード島の核が破壊されたっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It stopped in its tracks. Looks like it's in
pain. Oh, do you think the core at Licard
Island's gone?
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

グガァァ……ヴヴヴ……
ジラ……ユルザ……ナっ！

はぁっ、はぁっ……
い、行ってしまったようね

fields.EN:
Phew. Did it run? Or did it leave in confusion?
Regardless, we're safe.
fields.JP:
……ふぅぅ、逃げたのか、それとも混乱して
どこかへ行ったのか……
まぁ、とにかく助かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. Did it run? Or did it leave in confusion?
Regardless, we're safe.

fields.JP: ふひぃぃ……や、やっと一息つけるのだ

fields.EN: Oh, perfect timing! Riley-san's contacting us!
fields.JP:
あっ！　このタイミング。
きっとライリーさんからの連絡っすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, perfect timing! Riley's contacting us!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ライリーさん => Riley-san

fields.EN: Hello? This is Clara. Riley-san, do you copy?
fields.JP:
もしもし、こちらくららっす。
ライリーさんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hello? This is Clara. Riley, do you copy?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ライリーさん => Riley-san

fields.EN:
...Yes, it's Riley. That core you told us about.
We destroyed it.
fields.JP:
……ライリーよ。
あんた達に頼まれた核だけど、
さっき無事に破壊できたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Yes, it's Riley. That core you told us about.
We destroyed it.

fields.EN: I knew it! You saved us! Thank you so much!
fields.JP:
やっぱりそうだったっすか！
助かったす～！　感謝するっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: I knew it! You saved us! Thank you so much!

fields.JP:
おお、やるではないか！
褒めてつかわすぞ！

fields.EN: We did it for you guys, but...also...
fields.JP:
別に、あんたらのためでもあるけど、
それよりはね……
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it for you guys, but...also...

fields.EN: Um, is...is Rachel safe? Is she there?
fields.JP:
それで、その……レイチェルは無事？
今、そこにいるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, is...is Rachel safe? Is she there?

fields.EN:
Well, it's complicated. The Rachel-san we mentioned
before is different, and the real Rachel-san is...
fields.JP:
あ、その結構複雑な事情があってっすね……
実は前話したレイチェルさんは違う
レイチェルさんで、本当のレイチェルさんは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's complicated. The Rachel we mentioned
before is different, and the real Rachel is...
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): レイチェル => Rachel-san on 2 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=3

fields.EN:
Right, we figured. I don't know what happened
on your end, but that bratty girl is Rachel,
right?
fields.JP:
ああ、うん大丈夫だよ。　なんでそうなったのかは
さっぱりわからないけど、あの生意気な子供が
そうなんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, we figured. I don't know what happened
on your end, but that bratty girl is Rachel,
right?

fields.JP:
……！
ライリーさん……凄いっすね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ライリーさん => Riley-san

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Well, it's a little traumatic for me.
So, is Rachel there?
fields.JP:
はは、ある意味トラウマみたいなもんさ
それでその……レイチェルはそこにいるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Well, it's a little traumatic for me.
So, is Rachel there?

fields.EN: U-Um... Shira-san. Can you talk to Riley-san?
fields.JP:
あ、あの……シラさん。
ライリーさんと、話せるっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... Pi. She wants to speak to you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Um... Sorry. You see, I don't have any of my
old memories. I couldn't tell you if I were
Rachel or not.
fields.JP:
あ、あの……ごめん。
実は……全然昔の記憶が無くて、
自分がレイチェルかどうかはわからない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um... Sorry. You see, I don't have any of my
old memories. I couldn't tell you if I were
Rachel or not.

fields.EN:
But Kubitsuri-neesan definitely said so.
She said 'Rachel' was Shira's old self...
fields.JP:
でも、首吊り姉さんが確かにそう言ってた。
『レイチェル』って言うのは、
昔のシラのことだって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that's what Gallows told me.
She said Rachel was the old me...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san | Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Got it. If you can't remember, then there's
nothing we can do.
fields.JP:
そっか……
記憶が無いんじゃ、仕方ないよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. If you can't remember, then there's
nothing we can do.

fields.EN:
But sis! That's her voice... That's Rachel!
That's our little sister!
fields.JP:
おねえ！　でも、この声は……
レイチェルだよ！
わたしたちの妹の声だよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But sis! That's her voice... That's Rachel!
That's our little sister!

fields.EN:
Hey, Ellie! Don't say that.
It'll confuse her more.
fields.JP:
こ、こら、エリー！
そんなこと言っても、
あの子を混乱させるだけだって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, Ellie! Don't say that.
It'll confuse her more.

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry... Regardless, happy you're there
safe. You guys take ca—
fields.JP:
え、えっと、ごめん。
何にしてもあんたが無事で良かったよ。
じゃあ、あんたらはあんたらで、頑張っ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry... Regardless, happy you're there
safe. You guys take ca—

fields.JP:
……っ、待って！
ライリー！　エリー！

fields.EN: Did you just call our names...?
fields.JP: えっ、今、あたしたちの名前を……
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you just call our names...?

fields.JP: どうしたの、レイチェル？

fields.EN:
Seriously. I can't remember.
I don't know what to believe, but...
BUT!
fields.JP:
正直、何ひとつ覚えてないし、
自分がレイチェルだって
自覚もないけど……でもっ、でもっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. I can't remember.
I don't know what to believe, but...
BUT!

fields.EN:
When this is over... Shira wants you two to
come see her again. She wants to talk with you
more... okay?
fields.JP:
今のことが終わったら……
またシラと会って欲しい。
２人と、もっと話がしたいの……いいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
When all of this ends, I want you guys to visit
me. I want to keep talking. Is that okay?
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Of course! We'll plan on it.
fields.JP:
も、もちろんだよ！
そんなの、いいに決まってるって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course! We'll plan on it.

fields.JP:
うんっ、うんっ！
絶対、約束だよ、レイチェル！

fields.EN:
Thank you both. Take care until then.
I'll do what it takes.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう、それまで２人とも元気でね。
こっちも、がんばるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you both. Take care until then.
I'll do what it takes.

fields.EN: Okay. We'll be waiting! See you soon!
fields.JP:
ああ、待ってる。
必ずまた、会おうね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. We'll be waiting! See you soon!

fields.EN:
(Shira-san, you finally got to talk with your
sisters... I'm so happy.)
fields.JP:
（シラさん、お姉さんたちとついに……
　ううっ、よかったっすね～）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Pi, you finally found your sisters. Oogh.
I'm so happy.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

グググググ……
ビバブリバジラ……バパァ……
ニ”いざン………

シラさん……
ナイトメアっす……
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Shira, you stand back.
We'll handle it.
fields.JP:
シラは下がってると良い。
我らだけで仕留める
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pi, you stand back.
We'll handle it.

fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Shira-san?! But you shouldn't push yourself...
fields.JP:
シラさん！？
でも、シラさん無理は……
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Shira understands now. Shira's life isn't
hers alone anymore!
fields.JP:
わかったの。
シラの命はもうシラだけのもの
じゃないってわかったの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. I now realize that my life is not just
my own!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Shira's life was saved by everyone, Riley, and
Ellie! Shira doesn't want to just stand here
and watch!
fields.JP:
シラの命はみんなやライリー、エリーの力で
すくい取ってもらったもの！
そんなシラがここで見てるだけなんて嫌！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My life is thanks to Riley and Ellie!
How can I just sit and watch? No way!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Shira... Shira is going to live!
fields.JP: シラは……、シラは生きるんだから！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
ハッハッハッ
らしくなって来たではないか

fields.EN: Let's finish this, once and for all.
fields.JP: そうと決まれば、決着をつけにいくわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's finish this, once and for all.

fields.JP: 自分も最大限サポートするっす！
ラプンツェルもぜんりょくぜんかいだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm going to go ALL OUT!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

グググッ！！！
ビバブリバジラア”ア”ア”ア”

fields.EN: Yeah...! Shira will show them her power!
fields.JP:
うん……！
シラの力、見せてやるんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup! Time to show them what I'm made of!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
それじゃ……、
終わらせにいくっす！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

fields.EN:
GGIIIIIIIIII!
HIBABURIBAJIRAAAA....
I HADE YOU, I HADE YOU!!!!!
fields.JP:
ググギィィィ！
ヒバブリバジラアアア……
ニグイニグイイイイィィ！！！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
GGIIIIIIIIII!
BYREEEEEEE....
I HADE YOU, I HADE YOU!!!!!

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア
ババダズゲデ、ダズゲデエエエ！！！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア
ニジザンニジザンバアアアアア

fields.EN: I don't think it can move anymore.
fields.JP: もう動けそうにないっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't think it can move anymore.

fields.JP:
しかし相手はナイトメア。
我が止めを刺しにいくぞ

fields.EN: Shira, you may want to look away.
fields.JP: ……シラは見ない方がよいかもしれん
fields.LOCALIZED: Pi, you may want to look away.

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

fields.EN: DON LOOG AT ME! SDOP! SDOPPP!
fields.JP:
ゾ、ゾンナ゛メデミルダ！！
ヤベロヤベロオオオオ！！！！
fields.LOCALIZED: DON LOOG AT ME! SDOP! SDOPPP!

fields.EN: It's still moving! Shira-san, watch out!
fields.JP:
まだ動けて！
あ、危ないっすシラさん！
fields.LOCALIZED: It's still alive! Watch out, Pi!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア
あなにおちていったよ……

fields.EN:
Falling from that height in their condition
should do it...
fields.JP: この深さであの傷なら恐らく助からないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Falling from that height in their condition
should do it...

fields.EN:
You know, Shira's sisters weren't kind to her.
They killed things Shira cared about and always
made fun of her...
fields.JP:
あのね、姉さん達はシラに優しくするどころか、
シラの大事なものを殺したり、いつもいつも
馬鹿にしてきたりしてて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, my sisters were cruel to me.
All they did was bully me, killing anything
I held dear out of spite.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
It's just...that...it didn't have to be like this.
*sniffle*...
fields.JP:
ただ……ただ……
こんな風にならなくても良かったんじゃないかって
……うっうっ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just...that...it didn't have to be like this.
*sniffle*...

fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Stand up, Shira. There's work to be done.
fields.JP:
シラ立ちなさい。
私達に残された時間はそう長くないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Stand up, Pi. There's work to be done.

fields.JP:
……うんっ！
わ、わかってるわよ
さ、行くわよ……！

fields.EN:
You're right, everyone. Totally! We're almost
at the top! Let's show that ringleader who's
boss!
fields.JP:
そうっすね……
そうっすよね！　最上階まであと少しっす！
黒幕に目にもの見せにいくっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're right, everyone. Totally! We're almost
at the top! Let's show that ringleader who's
boss!

fields.EN:
This way. Beyond this point is the peak of
the Devouring Armada Tower. Papa should
be there.
fields.JP:
……こっちよ。
この先にある、悪食の監隊塔の屋上に
パパがいるはず
fields.LOCALIZED:
This way. Beyond this point is the peak of
the Devouring Armada Tower. Papa should
be there.

fields.JP: 覚悟を決めてから、行きましょう

fields.EN: R-Right. By the way, Shira-san... are you okay?
fields.JP:
そ、そうっすね。
ところでシラさん、その……大丈夫すか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. So Pi, um, you okay?!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Of course! Shira isn't some small fry who'd
drag everyone down at a time like this!
fields.JP:
当たり前でしょ！
この局面でみんなの足引っ張るなんて
雑魚みたいなことをするシラじゃないもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course I am! I refuse to break in front of
the gang! I'll never be a small fry!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
(Everyone... huh. Shira-san thinks of us as her
companions too.)
fields.JP:
（みんな…っすか。
　シラさんの方も、自分達の仲間だと
　思ってくれるんすね）
fields.LOCALIZED: (The gang, huh? Pi sees herself as one of us.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(When we first met, I was terrified of Shira-san.
It's hard to believe now. So much has happened since
then...)
fields.JP:
（初めて会った時、シラさんが怖くて
　ビクビクしてたのが嘘みたいっす。
　あれから、色々あったっすからね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember when we first met. I was so
scared of her. But that feels like a lifetime
ago...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
The surface was more than we bargained
for. Talk about a rollercoaster.
fields.JP:
みんなで地上に出てからは……
まるでジェットコースター
みたいな日々だったっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The surface was more than we bargained
for. Talk about a rollercoaster.

fields.EN:
What's the matter, little one? Feeling
sentimental?
fields.JP:
なんだ、小娘。
今までのことを思い出しておるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, little one? Feeling
sentimental?

fields.EN:
Yeah. We nearly died right away, then somehow I
gained Jack-san's Blood Youth power and reunited
with everyone...
fields.JP:
うっす。いきなり死にそうになって、
いつの間にかジャックさんの血式少年の
力を得て、皆さんと合流して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. We almost died right away, then I
gained Blood Youth powers and managed
to find my friends.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
Fuahaha! Bet you're thankful you found me
first! I'm the ultimate! Count yourself lucky.
fields.JP:
ふはははっ、そこで初めに会ったのが、
最強の我でよかったな！
小娘は剛運の持ち主なのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fuahaha! Bet you're thankful you found me
first! I'm the ultimate! Count yourself lucky.

fields.EN:
Huh? But when we first met, you were a
scaredy cat.
fields.JP:
あれ？　でも、会って早々は
ピンチで逃げていたような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? But when we first met, you were a
scaredy cat.

fields.JP: そっ、そんなことはにゃいぞ！
（図星のあまり噛んでるっす）

fields.EN: I was lucky our paths crossed as well.
fields.JP:
くららとあの時会えたのは、
私にとっても幸運だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I was lucky our paths crossed as well.

fields.EN:
Had you not come, I would have been done
for. I appreciate you.
fields.JP:
貴女が来てくれなかったら、
私はあそこで終わりだっただろうし、
そこは本当に感謝ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Had you not come, I would have been done
for. I appreciate you.

fields.EN:
Boy. Sure feels nice hearing that from you,
Gretel-san. You're making me blush!
fields.JP:
い、いや～、グレーテルさんに
感謝されると、めちゃくちゃ照れるっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boy. Sure feels nice hearing that from you,
Gretel. You're making me blush!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: You know~... Rapunzel had fun meeting Shira!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはねー、
シラにあえてたのしかったよ！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
……うんっ、うんっ……！
シラに会えて……本当に良かった

fields.EN: Now's not the time for that! You fools!
fields.JP:
こ、こんな時に言うことじゃないでしょ！
ばっかじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now's not the time for that! You fools!

fields.JP: シラは、たのしくなかったの？

fields.EN:
...No, Shira had fun too. Meeting you two was
the best...
fields.JP:
……ううん、シラも、楽しかった。
２人と会えて最高に……だったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean, yeah... I'm glad I met you too.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: わーい、シラ！　すりすり～♪
……んっ、ボクも、ぎゅーっとする

fields.EN: Hey! Quit it already! You're distracting me!
fields.JP:
こ、こらっ、くっつくなっ！
緊張感がなくなるでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! Quit it already! You're distracting me!

fields.EN: Haha, Shira-san and the others really are close.
fields.JP: あはは、シラさん達は本当に仲良しっすね
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Are not... Argh. Rapu, Nemuri, it's hot!
fields.JP:
べ、別に仲良しなんかじゃ……
あーもう、ラプも眠りも暑苦しいってば！
fields.LOCALIZED: Are not... Argh. Rappy, Sleepy, it's hot!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Ugh. Have you ladies no shame?
fields.JP: まったく緊張感のないヤツラなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Have you ladies no shame?

fields.EN:
Look who's talking. You can hardly speak
without slurring.
fields.JP:
肝心なときに限って噛む、
ハーメルンほどじゃないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look who's talking. You can hardly speak
without slurring.

fields.EN: Dyamn you, Gretel! I never shlurr!
fields.JP:
おにょれっ、グレーテル！
我は噛んでなどおりゃぬっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Dyamn you, Gretel! I never shlurr!

fields.JP: 完全に証明しちゃったっすね……

fields.EN:
Haha. Rapu, Nemuri, Clara, Gretel, and Hameln.
Plus Kaede, and everyone else too...
fields.JP:
はは……。
ラプ、眠り、くらら、グレーテル、ハーメルン
そして、ここにはいないけどカエデ達も……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Rappy, Sleepy, Clara, Gretel, and Hameln.
Plus Kaede, and everyone else too...
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: To all of you...thanks for everything.
fields.LOCALIZED: To all of you...thanks for everything.

fields.EN:
If you two hadn't been there, Shira thinks she
would've been done for.
fields.JP:
多分あんたたちがいなかったら、
シラはダメだったと思う
fields.LOCALIZED: Without you guys, I wouldn't be here.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
I'm practically just a normal human! You're way more
amazing, Shira-san!
fields.JP:
自分はほぼただの人間っすから！
シラさんの方がすごいっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm just a girl! You're the cool one here, Pi!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: All these compliments...are throwin' me off!
fields.JP:
と、突然素直になりおって……
調子が狂うのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All these compliments...are throwin' me off!

fields.EN: (We're about to head somewhere our friends' lives will hang in the balance, yet strangely, I'm not nervous. I'm sure that's thanks to everyone.)
fields.JP:
（これから仲間達の生死を分けるような場へ
　行くはずなのに、不思議と緊張しないっす。
　きっと、皆さんのおかげっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're sitting at a crossroads. Who knows
what fate sits ahead of us. But we took this
moment to be grateful.)

fields.EN:
(After being separated from Boss, I met so
many friends, people I never would've known
otherwise. We went through Hell together.)
fields.JP:
（師匠から離れて、今まで地下で関わらなかった
　人達とも知り合って、色々な体験をして、
　なんともめまぐるしい日々だったっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After being separated from Boss, I met so
many friends, people I never would've known
otherwise. We went through Hell together.)

fields.EN:
(But hopefully I'll see Boss soon...
There's too much we have left to do.)
fields.JP:
（これが終わったら、自分も師匠と合流して……
　色々やりたいこととか、伝えたいことが
　たくさんあるっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But hopefully I'll see Boss soon...
There's too much we have left to do.)

fields.EN:
Well, that should settle it.
Let's head upstairs and do this thing!
fields.JP:
さ、準備も万端だし、
パパっと終わらせるために、
いよいよ最上階へ行くっすよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that should settle it.
Let's head upstairs and do this thing!

fields.EN:
What...? How do I have the same blood as
Jabberwock and Haru? How can that be?
fields.JP:
どういうことだ……？
僕にどうしてジャバウォックやハルと
同じ星の血が流れているんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...? How do I have the same blood as
Jabberwock and Haru? How can that be?

fields.EN:
Think about it. Devotion to your wife, your
dry personality, the whole slow and steady
thing. Juu, we knew someone just like you.
fields.JP:
『愛妻家』『ドライな考え方』『急がば回れ』……
これらはジュウ、お前の特徴なわけだが、
実はすべて、俺たちは心当たりがあったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think about it. Devotion to your wife, your
dry personality, the whole slow and steady
thing. Toh, we knew someone just like you.

fields.EN: After arriving on this planet and learning about the white core that could mimic anything, he said, 'For my wife's sake, I'll win people's trust and lie about who I am as much as I have to.'
fields.JP:
そいつはこの星に来て、何でも擬態化できる白い
核の存在を知った後に『妻のためなら人々に
信用され、いくらでも自分を偽ろう』と言った
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once he arrived on this planet and discovered
the white core, he told us that he would lie to
others to gain trust in honor of his wife.

fields.EN: Juu, everything about you is just like him...
fields.JP:
ジュウ、お前はそんな昔のあいつに、
性格や考えがそっくりだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, everything about you is just like him...

fields.JP: ちょっと待って、それってまさか……

fields.EN:
If they're Haru-san's companions who came to this
planet, then maybe...
fields.JP:
この星に来た、ハルさんの仲間
ってことはもしかして……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hang on. Does that mean he's...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
My older brother, Hauteharolde.
Known to you as Professor Tohjima, or Snark.
fields.JP:
私の兄、ハウテハロデ……
あるいは君たちが言う十島博士、
もしくはスナークのことだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My older brother, Hauteharolde.
Known to you as Professor Tohjima, or Snark.

fields.JP:
そ、それは！
わ、わらわも驚愕です

fields.EN: Huh?! But Professor was much more peaceful...
fields.JP:
そ、そんな！！
で、でも博士はもっと穏やかな人でしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! But Professor was much more peaceful...

fields.EN: That was all an act to gain our trust.
fields.JP:
それは周りに信用されるために
演じていたからよ
fields.LOCALIZED: That was all an act to gain our trust.

fields.EN:
Consider that maybe we never knew
who Professor really was.
fields.JP:
でも、そう考えるとわたしたち
本当の博士ってほとんど知らなかったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Consider that maybe we never knew
who Professor really was.

fields.JP: すまない赤ずきん。今少し考え中だ
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry Red Riding Hood, I'm thinking...

fields.EN:
(My memories start right before we ascended
to the surface. In other words, right after the
underground Jail was no more.)
fields.JP:
（僕の記憶があるのは、地上に出る少し前から……
　つまり、地下監獄の監獄塔が消えた後からだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My memories start right before we ascended
to the surface. In other words, right after the
underground Jail was no more.)

fields.EN: (And the three things I do remember are: "I want to find my wife," "I am a Jail Tower," and "I am a Blood Youth.")
fields.JP:
（そして記憶があるものとしては、
　『妻を探したい』『自分は監獄塔』、
　そして『自分は血式少年である』という３つ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And all I know about myself is my desire to
find my wife, that I am Jail, and I am a Blood
Youth. Those three things.)

fields.JP:
（スナークは自らの身体を
　監獄塔に擬態化させたという話だが……）

fields.EN:
Are you saying I'm another reincarnated being
born when Snark transformed through mimicry?
fields.JP:
僕はスナークが擬態化した時に生まれた
別の転生体……とでも言いたいのか？
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: スナークのもう１つの転生体……！？

fields.EN:
Don't take this the wrong way, but it's so
obvious when you think about it.
fields.JP:
君には酷な事実かもしれんが、
そう考えると色々と納得がいくのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't take this the wrong way, but it's so
obvious when you think about it.

fields.EN:
But that doesn't explain how I am a Blood
Youth though...
fields.JP:
そうなると『血式少年』になった
理由までは分からないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that doesn't explain how I am a Blood
Youth though...

fields.EN:
But this Mary Gun. If it is the result of
mimicry, then it makes sense.
fields.JP:
この最初から持っていたメアリガンも、
擬態化されたものとすれば確かに説明はつくな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this Mary Gun. If it is the result of
mimicry, then it makes sense.

fields.EN: Right. It explains why I didn't make it as well.
fields.JP:
ああ。それならば俺に作った覚えがないのも、
当然ということになる
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. It explains why I didn't make it as well.

fields.EN:
It seems my blood proves your point, and
explains the connections. But this seems to
be of little import to me.
fields.JP:
確かに僕の血液がお前たちの星のものというのは
大きな証拠になるし、色々と辻褄が合うが……
正直、僕には他人事にしか思えない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems my blood proves your point, and
explains the connections. But this seems to
be of little import to me.

fields.EN:
This is more significant for you, no?
Why keep it secret until now?
fields.JP:
だがお前たちにとっては大事なことだろう？
２人とも、何故今まで言わなかった？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is more significant for you, no?
Why keep it secret until now?

fields.EN:
I was terrified thinking that, if we told you,
you would regain your memories.
fields.JP:
……話したことで記憶を取り戻すのではないか、
そこが一番怖かった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was terrified thinking that, if we told you,
you would regain your memories.

fields.EN:
And if they hadn't returned, I was also
worried you couldn't handle the truth.
fields.JP:
それに戻らなかったとしても正直、
この事実に君が耐えられるのか不安だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if they hadn't returned, I was also
worried you couldn't handle the truth.

fields.EN:
More than anything, I didn't want to make
a false accusation. We had to make absolutely
certain.
fields.JP:
何より、安易に疑惑を投げかけ
この関係性を壊してしまうことも恐ろしかった。
だから確証を得るまでは、言えなかったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
More than anything, I didn't want to make
a false accusation. We had to make absolutely
certain.

fields.EN:
When Iron Maiden mentioned Snark was here,
that's why I tried to contact my brother.
I needed to be sure.
fields.JP:
アイアン・メイデンが『スナークがいる』と
言ったと聞き、すぐに兄に連絡したのも、
確証を得ようと焦ってしまったからなんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Iron Maiden mentioned Snark was here,
that's why I tried to contact my brother.
I needed to be sure.

fields.EN:
Juu, we want to get to the bottom of it,
but not at your expense.
fields.JP:
ジュウ。俺たちは確かに真実は知りたい。
だがお前を苦しめたいわけじゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, we want to get to the bottom of it,
but not at your expense.

fields.EN:
I'll trust you there, but this matters little
to me.
fields.JP:
……そこについては信用しよう。
まあ、どうでもいいけどな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll trust you there, but this matters little
to me.

fields.JP: ジュウはその、お父……なの……？

fields.EN:
Akazukin, let me be perfectly clear.
My wife and I never had children. So I don't
take kindly to that term.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん。はっきり言うが……
僕と妻の間には子どもなどいなかったし、
今さらそんなことを言われても困る
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, let me be perfectly clear.
My wife and I never had children. So I don't
take kindly to that term.

fields.EN:
I refuse to associate myself with the Snark
you all know. He and I are nothing alike.
fields.JP:
僕からすれば、君たちの言う『スナーク』と
自分がリンクするとはとても思えない。
完全に別個の存在だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I refuse to associate myself with the Snark
you all know. He and I are nothing alike.

fields.JP:
確かにジュウさんが博士の転生体だとしても、
白雪たちに会う直前のわずかな時間の記憶しか
ないのなら、それは博士とは言いづらいですね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
But still, knowing you are connected to the
Professor leaves me conflicted...
fields.JP:
それでも博士の転生体と言われると
複雑な気持ちですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But still, knowing you are connected to the
Professor leaves me conflicted...

fields.JP:
ジュウはジュウだって頭の中では
分かってはいるんだけどね

fields.EN:
Oh, Haru, Jabberwock. Does that mean you
know my wife?
fields.JP:
そうだ、ハル、ジャバウォック。
ならばお前たちは妻のことを知っているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Haru, Jabberwock. Does that mean you
know my wife?

fields.EN: Of course. She came to Earth with us.
fields.JP:
もちろん知っている。
ともに地球にやって来たからな
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. She came to Earth with us.

fields.EN: But we were separated shortly after arrival.
fields.JP: だが地球に降りてすぐに、彼女らとは離れ離れになった
fields.LOCALIZED: But we were separated shortly after arrival.

fields.EN:
Same. Snark and I arrived together, but he
was gone shortly after.
fields.JP:
俺もだ。スナークと俺は一緒にいたが、
あいつはいつの間にかいなくなっていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same. Snark and I arrived together, but he
was gone shortly after.

fields.EN: I see. That settles it then. Let's call it a day.
fields.JP:
そうか。それだけ分かればいい。
ではそろそろ解散するか
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. That settles it then. Let's call it a day.

fields.JP: ジュウさん、どこ行くんです？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
We have more of the Devouring Armada Tower
to explore, so we should rest. Good night.
fields.JP:
明日からは悪食の監隊塔の探索だから、
ゆっくり寝ておくべきだ。
なのでこれで失礼する
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have more of the Devouring Armada Tower
to explore, so we should rest. Good night.

fields.EN: Wait, Juu! Doesn't this shock you at all?!
fields.JP:
ちょっとジュウ！
あんたこんな事実を知って
なんとも思わないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait, Toh! Doesn't this shock you at all?!

fields.EN:
This is YOU we're talking about!
Take this seriously―
fields.JP:
あんたのことなんだよ！？
もっとしっかり考えて、それで――
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is YOU we're talking about!
Take this seriously―

fields.EN:
Leave him be. He needs time to process
everything. The man I know may still be
in there.
fields.JP:
そっとしておいてやれ。
ああ見えても、ショックは受けているはずだ。
俺がよく知る頃のあいつと同じなら……な
fields.LOCALIZED:
Leave him be. He needs time to process
everything. The man I know may still be
in there.

fields.EN:
If he's without his memories, he has much to
think about...
fields.JP:
それに記憶が存在しない以上、
俺たちに言えることは何もない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If he's without his memories, he has much to
think about...

fields.EN:
With or without his memories, they're too
different for us to call him Professor.
fields.JP:
でも転生体だとか、記憶があるかとか以前に、
とてもキャラが違うので博士とは思えないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
With or without his memories, they're too
different for us to call him Professor.

fields.EN:
Right. Professor wasn't as mature as that
lad.
fields.JP:
まあ博士もあいつほど
大人げなくはなかったしなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Professor wasn't as mature as that
lad.

fields.JP:
ちょっと門脇さん、
空気読んで下さいって……！

fields.EN: What did I say? He's a changed man.
fields.JP:
え、オレ変なこと言った？
だって本当にキャラ違うじゃん
fields.LOCALIZED: What did I say? He's a changed man.

fields.EN:
That's true. Towa's right.
He's totally different from Dad.
fields.JP:
そうだね、永遠の言うとおりだよ。
確かに性格はお父さんとぜんぜん違う
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true. Towa's right.
He's totally different from Dad.

fields.EN: But I think I could always sense Dad in him.
fields.JP:
でも、きっとあたしは最初から
どこか面影を感じてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: But I think I could always sense Dad in him.

fields.EN:
That's why, when I named him, I took Juu
from Professor Tohjima.
fields.JP:
だから、名前をつける時、思わず
『十島博士』から一文字取って、
ジュウって名前をつけたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why, when I named him, I took Toh
from Professor Tohjima.

fields.EN:
I see. So the origin of Juu-san's name really was
the Professor.
fields.JP:
なるほど、ジュウさんの名前の由来は、
しっかりと博士だったんですね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. A fitting nickname in the end.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
In the end, regardless of the resemblance,
he's not my Dad.
fields.JP:
でもやっぱりあの人は、
面影はあってもあたしの知ってる
『お父さん』じゃないんだと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the end, regardless of the resemblance,
he's not my Dad.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: Oyayubihime-san, have we come this way?
fields.JP:
親指姫さん、まだこっちは
探索してないですわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Thumbelina, have we come this way?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Don't think so. Juu, should we take a break
soon...?
fields.JP:
そのはずよ。
ねえジュウ、もう少し行ったら
軽く休憩でも――
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't think so. Toh, should we take a break
soon...?

fields.EN:
Hm? Good idea. When we have a chance,
let's rest.
fields.JP:
……ん？　ああ、安全そうな
場所を見つけたら、一息入れるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Good idea. When we have a chance,
let's rest.

fields.EN:
Juu-san. Normally you're quiet, but today you seem
especially so.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんは普段から無口な方ですけど、
今日は輪をかけて無口ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh. Normally you're quiet, but today you seem
especially so.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: かぐやさん、そういうことは……！

fields.EN:
Sorry. Honestly, I've had a lot on my mind.
Not sure if I should apologize or not.
fields.JP:
すまない、実は少し悩んでいる。
君たちに、謝罪すべきかどうかを
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. Honestly, I've had a lot on my mind.
Not sure if I should apologize or not.

fields.JP: 謝罪って……まさか記憶が戻ったの！？

fields.EN:
No, not at all. In fact, I don't think they ever
will. My memories never existed.
fields.JP:
いや、まったく戻っていない。
というより、戻るというのは正しくない。
元々、記憶は存在しないのだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, not at all. In fact, I don't think they ever
will. My memories never existed.

fields.EN: Then what are you apologizing for?
fields.JP: じゃあ何を謝るっていうの
fields.LOCALIZED: Then what are you apologizing for?

fields.EN: Well, for what Snark did to you.
fields.JP: それはもちろん、スナークが君たちにしたことだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, for what Snark did to you.

fields.EN:
But you don't remember any of that, Juu-san, and
you're a different existence in the first place,
right? You have nothing to apologize for.
fields.JP:
でもジュウさんには記憶がないし、
そもそも別の存在なんですよね？
謝る理由がないじゃないですか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you don't remember that, right?
You're a whole other person. You shouldn't
feel obligated to apologize.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: 確かに、そういう考え方もある

fields.EN:
Even if I have, hypothetically, become a new
person, part of me feels bound to sins which
were committed by Snark.
fields.JP:
だが仮に、別の存在となった僕ではあるが、
それでもスナークの一部だとするなら、
非道な行いを謝罪すべきなのではないか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if I have, hypothetically, become a new
person, part of me feels bound to sins which
were committed by Snark.

fields.JP: と、そんなことをずっと考えていてな

fields.EN:
That's what you're worried about?
Boy, you're so straight-laced.
fields.JP:
そんなこと悩んでたの？
ほんっとカタブツねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what you're worried about?
Boy, you're so straight-laced.

fields.EN: You know, your apologies could use some work.
fields.JP:
あんたねー、それは謝りたい相手の前で
言うことじゃないでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED: You know, your apologies could use some work.

fields.JP: む……そういうものなのか

fields.EN:
(I wasn't even going to apologize. I didn't
expect the critique. Should I even bother...?)
fields.JP:
（謝罪をしないと言ってるわけでもないのに、
　まさか咎められるとは……作法なのか知らないが、
　それは必要なことなのだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wasn't even going to apologize. I didn't
expect the critique. Should I even bother...?)

fields.EN:
Juu, don't you get it? Seriously.
You don't have to apologize.
fields.JP:
あ、理解してないでしょ、ジュウ。
とにかくあんたは謝らなくていいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, don't you get it? Seriously.
You don't have to apologize.

fields.EN:
At this point, I don't think Juu will ever
change.
fields.JP:
この感じだと、
ジュウはずっと変わらなさそうねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
At this point, I don't think Toh will ever
change.

fields.EN:
Oh well. That's our Juu. Let's table this talk
for after we take down the tower!
fields.JP:
まあいいや、ジュウはジュウだよ。
これ以上は悪食の監隊塔を潰してから考えよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh well. That's our Toh. Let's table this talk
for after we take down the tower!

fields.EN:
I would hate to leave this conversation open,
but perhaps you're right.
fields.JP:
そういう後回しにする考えは
好きではない……が、今回ばかりは同意する
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would hate to leave this conversation open,
but perhaps you're right.

fields.EN:
Whoa. Is this the first time both of you can
agree on something?
fields.JP:
あらあら、協調性を示すなんて、
珍しすぎてびっくりです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Is this the first time both of you can
agree on something?

fields.EN: Juu's growing up. What a happy sight.
fields.JP:
ジュウも成長したんだよ。
あたしは嬉しいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh's growing up. What a happy sight.

fields.EN: Don't confuse my irritation for maturation.
fields.JP: 今、ひどく苛立ちを覚えた僕がいるんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't confuse my irritation for maturation.

fields.JP: あはは、気にしない気にしない！

fields.EN:
Juu. No matter who you might be, you've risked
your life fighting alongside us. That's the truth.
fields.JP:
ジュウ。あんたが何者だろうが、
結局今まで命をかけて、一緒に力を
合わせてきたって事実は変わらないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh. No matter who you might be, you've risked
your life fighting alongside us. That's the truth.

fields.EN:
Let's leave the past behind and forge a new
future! That's all.
fields.JP:
だから、ここからも
