力を合わせて突き進む。それだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's leave the past behind and forge a new
future! That's all.

fields.JP: ふふ、そうですね親指姉様
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: さあっ、先に進みますわよーっ！！

fields.EN: Right. That must be the core.
fields.JP: よし、核に辿り着いたな
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. That must be the core.

fields.JP: ん？　あそこにいるのは……

fields.EN:
Hello, everyone! Long time no see.
Mei has come to play★
fields.JP:
久しぶり！　みんな元気してたぁ？
メイが遊びに来てあげたよ★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hello, everyone! Long time no see.
Mei has come to play★

fields.EN:
Oh, did I surprise you? Usually my beauty
routine takes precedence, but Papa gave
the O-K to kill you now!
fields.JP:
あ、いきなりで驚かせちゃったぁ？
メイもぉ、オシャレに美容に忙しいんだけどね、
パパがもう殺してもいいよって言ってくれたの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, did I surprise you? Usually my beauty
routine takes precedence, but Papa gave
the O-K to kill you now!

fields.EN: So here I am! Let's play★
fields.JP:
だから来ちゃった～！
さ、遊ぼ★
fields.LOCALIZED: So here I am! Let's play★

fields.EN:
What a brat. If you're so busy, then can't
you leave us be?
fields.JP:
相変わらず自分勝手な奴だな。
別に忙しいなら来なくて構わないんだぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a brat. If you're so busy, then can't
you leave us be?

fields.EN:
You're so cold, onii-san. Don't make such
a difficult face. Enjoy the moment!
fields.JP:
お兄さんつれないなぁ～。
そんなムズカシー顔してないで、
もっと今を楽しまなくっちゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Playing hard to get. Don't complicate
things. Let's make the most of our time.

fields.EN:
Papa gave me the go-ahead, so I'm going to
kick your asses! I know you're all weak, but
try to have fun with me★
fields.JP:
今回はパパのオッケーもらってるから、
メイ、最初から全力でやってあげる！
みんなも弱いなりに楽しんでね★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Papa gave me the go-ahead, so I'm going to
kick your asses! I know you're all weak, but
try to have fun with me★

fields.EN: Everyone, we're much stronger than when we fought her before! We'll definitely be okay!
fields.JP:
みんな、あたしたちは前に戦った時より
遥かに強くなってる！　だから絶対に大丈夫！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's show her everything we've learned
since last we met! We're in this together!

fields.EN: We made it this far. Can't quit now.
fields.JP:
ええ、わたしたちも伊達にここまで
生き延びてるわけじゃないものね
fields.LOCALIZED: We made it this far. Can't quit now.

fields.EN: Let's settle this affair in brilliant style!
fields.JP:
前と同じじゃないってこと、
分からせて差し上げますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's settle this affair in brilliant style!

fields.JP: 白雪たちはあなたなんかに負けません！

fields.EN:
I tire of her sick games. Combine forces
to stop her!
fields.JP:
これ以上つきまとわれるのも面倒です。
みなさん、ここで終わらせましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tire of her sick games. Combine forces
to stop her!

fields.JP: え、なーに調子乗ってんの？

fields.EN:
When will you insects learn?
Your hope is futile, but don't let me stop
you from dreaming★
fields.JP:
前もそうだったけどさぁ、
どこからそんな自信が湧いてくるのか、
メイさっぱりなんですけどー★
fields.LOCALIZED:
When will you insects learn?
Your hope is futile, but don't let me stop
you from dreaming★

fields.EN:
Oh, I know! I'll share a secret!★
I packed extra blood in my Gore Suit today!
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ！　イイコト教えてあげる★
今日のメイのゴアスーツにはね、
たっくさんの人間の血が入ってるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I know! I'll share a secret!★
I packed extra blood in my Gore Suit today!

fields.EN:
I even drank extra helpings of blood to make
sure I'm doubly ready to take you down!
fields.JP:
それにメイもたくさん人間の血を飲んできたから、
すご～～～～く強くなってるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I even drank extra helpings of blood to make
sure I'm doubly ready to take you down!

fields.EN:
So I'm feeling faaaaantastic.
Come and get me★
fields.JP:
そう考えると、ああすごいっ、
身体が火照ってきちゃう～★
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I'm feeling faaaaantastic.
Come and get me★

fields.JP: 相変わらず話を聞かないおかしな奴だな

fields.EN:
Who'd like to be squashed by Mei first?
Raise your hands★
fields.JP:
さあっ、メイに最初に
挟まれたい子は誰かな～？
いたら手ー挙げて★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who'd like to be squashed by Mei first?
Raise your hands★

fields.EN:
Anyone? Hahahaha!
Guess I'll just squash all of you at once★
fields.JP:
あれ、いないんだー？　あはははっ！
それじゃー今からみんな、もれなくまとめて
ミ　ナ　ゴ　ロ　シ★
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyone? Hahahaha!
Guess I'll just squash all of you at once★

fields.EN:
Stick together. Everyone's making it out of
this alive. Brace yourselves.
fields.JP:
僕たちは絶対に、
誰ひとり欠けずにここを突破する。
お前こそ覚悟するんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Stick together. Everyone's making it out of
this alive. Brace yourselves.

fields.JP:
うぅ……な、なんで……
こんなの、おかしいわ……！
言ったでしょ、あたしたちは強くなってるって

fields.EN: You couldn't even calmly assess our fighting strength, and you kept underestimating us. That's why you lost.
fields.JP:
あなたは冷静に戦力も分析できず、
ずっとわらわたちを侮ったままでした。
だから負けたんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're nothing but a hot-head.
You underestimate us, and that is why you lose.

fields.JP: もう抵抗は止めて下さい

fields.EN: Rgh... How could I lose to trash?!
fields.JP: くっ、なんでメイがこんなゴミどもに……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh... How could I lose to trash?!

fields.EN: You can't move with those wounds. Give up.
fields.JP:
その傷ではもう動けないでしょう。
観念するんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED: You can't move with those wounds. Give up.

fields.EN: Don't you doubt me! This is noth... AAAH!
fields.JP:
メイをナメるな……！
これくらいたいした傷じゃ……うああっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't you doubt me! This is noth... AAAH!

fields.EN:
You're stubborn. You'll only aggravate your
wounds.
fields.JP:
諦めが悪いわね。暴れても
あんたの傷が広がるだけなんだってば
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're stubborn. You'll only aggravate your
wounds.

fields.EN:
You bastards. You got lucky, and now you think
you're hot stuff...
fields.JP:
ちょっとラッキーで
勝てたくらいで偉そうにしやがって……
クソッ、クソッ、クソォォォッ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You bastards. You got lucky, and now you think
you're hot stuff...

fields.EN:
Before we end this, answer us at once.
You mentioned Snark once. Why?
fields.JP:
おい、終わらせる前に聞かせてもらうぞ。
前にお前が言った『スナーク』という言葉、
どういうつもりで口にした？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Before we end this, answer us at once.
You mentioned Snark once. Why?

fields.EN: Shut up, idiot! I don't know! Papa told me to!
fields.JP:
うるせーそんなの知るか！
パパが勝手にポケベルに送ってきたんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Shut up, idiot! I don't know! Papa told me to!

fields.EN:
(She doesn't know anything. I wonder why
Papa relayed that message.)
fields.JP:
（こいつは何も知らないのか。
　じゃあそのパパとやらは、いったい
　何を目的に送ってきたんだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't know anything. I wonder why
Papa relayed that message.)

fields.EN:
Damn. These ugly jerks think they can stop
me... AAAAH!
fields.JP:
ああクソッ、こんなゲロマズの血が流れてる
ブスどもに見下ろされるなんて――きゃっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn. These ugly jerks think they can stop
me... AAAAH!

fields.EN: What's going on? She's sinking into the wall!
fields.JP:
どういうこと！？
アイアン・メイデンが壁に
吸い込まれていくわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What's going on? She's sinking into the wall!

fields.JP: いったい何だったんですの？

fields.EN: No clue. Perhaps Papa came to the rescue?
fields.JP:
分からない。もしかしたら
パパとやらが助けたのかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED: No clue. Perhaps Papa came to the rescue?

fields.EN:
Yeah. I don't see her anywhere.
Ugh. Just when we had her.
fields.JP:
確かに、もうこの辺りにはいないみたいだね。
せっかく追いつめたのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I don't see her anywhere.
Ugh. Just when we had her.

fields.EN:
Nothing to be done. Time for us to remove
the core and move on.
fields.JP:
仕方ありませんよ。
こうなってしまった以上、核を壊して
先に進むしかないと思います～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing to be done. Time for us to remove
the core and move on.

fields.EN:
Hmph. Fine. Akazukin, want to do
the honors?
fields.JP:
ふん、そうだな。
じゃあ赤ずきん、頼めるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. Fine. Red Riding Hood, want to do
the honors?

fields.JP: グボォォォォォオオオ……！！

fields.EN: Yeah! Another core in the bag!
fields.JP: やった、これでまた一歩前進ですね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Another core in the bag!

fields.EN: Keep it up and get to the top!
fields.JP:
この調子で悪食の監隊塔を
ガンガン攻略していきましょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Keep it up and get to the top!

fields.EN: Right. Well done, everyone. Let's go.
fields.JP:
ああ、そのつもりだ。
よしみんな、行くぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Well done, everyone. Let's go.

fields.JP: みんな生きてた？　本当か！？

fields.EN:
Of course. We saw Jack, a girl named Clara,
and other Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
もちろんだ。ジャックにくららという少女、
他の血式少女も無事だった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. We saw Jack, a girl named Clara,
and other Blood Maidens.

fields.JP: そうか、くららも無事か……
そいつが、お前の言っていた弟子か？

fields.EN:
Yup. Real piece o' work that one.
What'll I do with her?
Thanks for the heads up, Juu.
fields.JP:
ああ。ほんといつだって
心配させやがるんだ、あいつは。
ジュウ、教えてくれてありがとな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup. Real piece o' work that one.
What'll I do with her?
Thanks for the heads up, Toh.

fields.EN: All part of the duty. No need to thank me.
fields.JP:
情報の共有は当たり前のことだ。
いちいち礼など言わなくていい
fields.LOCALIZED: All part of the duty. No need to thank me.

fields.EN: Ugh. Learn how to take thanks.
fields.JP: まーたこの人は大人げないですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Learn how to take thanks.

fields.EN:
So, did you happen to hear if any others
survived too?
fields.JP:
なあ、他の奴はどうなんだ？
オレたちみたいなキャンプ組もいるんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, did you happen to hear if any others
survived too?

fields.EN:
Sure. Miko, Michiru, and Mamoru made it too!
Looks like they've set up camps.
fields.JP:
ええ、視子やミチル、マモルたちも生きてるって！
やっぱ他のみんなもキャンプ作ってるみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. Miko, Michiru, and Mamoru made it too!
Looks like they've set up camps.

fields.EN:
Makes sense! I thought me and the klutz here
were the only humans left, so that's a relief.
fields.JP:
そっか、そうだよな！
いやー人間はオレとどじっ子だけだと思ったから、
他にも生きててくれて安心したよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Makes sense! I thought me and the klutz here
were the only humans left, so that's a relief.

fields.JP:
ちょっと門脇さん！
そういうのはよろしくないですよ！

fields.EN: Really? Aren't you happy there's more of us?
fields.JP: え、そう？　同族がいると嬉しくないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? Aren't you happy there's more of us?

fields.EN:
We're all part of the same family. No need
to worry about who fits into what. Ugh,
when will you learn? One of these days...
fields.JP:
わたくしたちはみんな同じ仲間なんですから、
そんな風に分けなくてもいいんです！
聞き分けがない人には～～～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're all part of the same family. No need
to worry about who fits into what. Ugh,
when will you learn? One of these days...

fields.EN:
Whoa, Kunai-san! Watch where you swing that
thing! Help me, little one!
fields.JP:
わっ、クナイさんフライパン振りかぶるの止めて！
ちっこいの、助けてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa, Kunai! Watch where you swing that
thing! Help me, little one!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: クナイさん => Kunai-san

fields.EN: Hm. Maybe she can knock some sense into you.
fields.JP:
あんたはいっぺん
殴られといた方がいいかもねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Maybe she can knock some sense into you.

fields.JP: まったく、何をやってるんだお前たちは……

fields.EN:
Whatever. Jabberwock, we must move camp
tomorrow. There's a rendezvous scheduled.
fields.JP:
まあいい。ジャバウォック、
明日にでもキャンプ地を移動させるぞ。
生存者全員の顔合わせをすることになったからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever. Jabberwock, we must move camp
tomorrow. There's a rendezvous scheduled.

fields.JP: それは随分と急な話だな

fields.EN:
Indeed, but adding more to our ranks
increases our chances of taking down
the tower.
fields.JP:
グループが増えたことで、この悪食の監隊塔の
攻略を一気に進めるチャンスかもしれないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed, but adding more to our ranks
increases our chances of taking down
the tower.

fields.EN:
Hehe. This may very well be the first ever
siege on the tower.
fields.JP:
ふふ、こんなに一気に攻め込まれるなんて、
悪食の監隊塔も初めてだと思いますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. This may very well be the first ever
siege on the tower.

fields.EN:
Right. I bet no one on the surface has dared
to scale it.
fields.JP:
そうだね。地上の人間で、今まで
この中まで進入することのできた者など、
おそらくいないだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I bet no one on the surface has dared
to scale it.

fields.EN: Right. To that end, we must prepare.
fields.JP:
そういうわけだ。
準備の方頼むぞ、みんな
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. To that end, we must prepare.

fields.EN: Very well. There's not much time.
fields.JP:
まあ確かに、我々に残されている
時間は少ないからね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well. There's not much time.

fields.EN: Right. I'll round up the troops.
fields.JP:
よし、じゃあすぐに
出発できるようにしとくぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I'll round up the troops.

fields.EN: Haru, you seem chuffed. Excited to see Clara?
fields.JP:
ハルおっさん、いつになく嬉しそうじゃん。
そんなにくららと会えるのが嬉しいの～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Haru, you seem chuffed. Excited to see Clara?

fields.EN:
No. Well, yes, but you know, I just wanna
see how much my lil' apprentice grew up.
fields.JP:
違っ……くはないが、ほらアレだ。
弟子がどんだけ成長したか見てやんねえと
って思ってな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Well, yes, but you know, I just wanna
see how much my lil' apprentice grew up.

fields.EN: Ah, that so? What's the truth?
fields.JP:
ふーん、そっかぁ。
で、本当のところは？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah, that so? What's the truth?

fields.EN:
Haru-san, don't act like you haven't been
worried about Clara-chan all this time!
fields.JP:
ハルさん、くららちゃんのこと
ずーっと心配してましたもんね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru, don't act like you haven't been
worried about Clara all this time!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: くららちゃん => Clara-chan; ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, you little... ARGH! Yes!
Of course I'm happy!
fields.JP:
白雪、お前そういうことをだな……
あーもう、嬉しいに決まってんだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, you little... ARGH! Yes!
Of course I'm happy!

fields.EN:
Last time I saw her, she was about to kick
the bucket. I'm happy she's alive.
Cross my heart, hope to die.
fields.JP:
俺が知ってる最後のあいつの姿は、
瀕死の状態だったからな。生きててくれて
心から嬉しい……それは確かだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Last time I saw her, she was about to kick
the bucket. I'm happy she's alive.
Cross my heart, hope to die.

fields.EN:
At least you're honest. That's all I wanted
to hear.
fields.JP:
ようやく素直になったじゃん。
あたしはそれが聞きたかったんだよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least you're honest. That's all I wanted
to hear.

fields.EN:
All that embarrassment for nothing.
Honesty is always the best policy!
fields.JP:
でもすごく恥ずかしそうですわね。
別に普通に言えばいいと思いますわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that embarrassment for nothing.
Honesty is always the best policy!

fields.EN:
Too right. Old men aren't cute when they
lie.
fields.JP:
そうそう。
おっさんのデレとか誰が得すんのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too right. Old men aren't cute when they
lie.

fields.EN:
Wh-Why does it look like I've walked in
at the wrong time?
fields.JP:
わ、わたくし、もしかして見てはいけないものを
見てしまいましたか……！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wh-Why does it look like I've walked in
at the wrong time?

fields.EN:
Ugh. Another man in this group just means
another headache...
fields.JP:
このグループは素直じゃない、
面倒くさい男の方が多いです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Another man in this group just means
another headache...

fields.EN:
(Once upon a time, I found their banter
annoying. But now I don't mind too much.
Hehe.)
fields.JP:
（なぜだろう、今まで不毛と思っていた
　こんなやりとりも嫌いではなくなっている。
　ふふ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once upon a time, I found their banter
annoying. But now I don't mind too much.
Hehe.)

fields.EN: I'm way more honest than Haru-san!
fields.JP: オレもハルさんに比べたらだいぶ素直だって！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm way more honest than Haru!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP: き、君たち、それ以上は止めてあげたまえ……

fields.EN: Ugh. You bastards. I'll get you for this.
fields.JP:
クソッ、お前らまとめて
いつか絶対シメるからな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. You bastards. I'll get you for this.

fields.EN:
Which means the guardian isn't far.
Look sharp!
fields.JP:
番人は確実にいるでしょうから、
準備します！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means the guardian isn't far.
Look sharp!

fields.JP: わらわも心の準備をします～

fields.EN: Is that code for nap time...?
fields.JP: あんたに心の準備なんて必要なの……
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that code for nap time...?

fields.EN: Got a strategy in mind, Juu?
fields.JP: 何か作戦はあるのジュウ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Got a strategy in mind, Toh?

fields.EN:
Well, at this point, it's more of the same.
Take out the core, defeat that Nightmare,
then we corner Gatou.
fields.JP:
もうここまできたら作戦はない。
核を破壊し、あの処刑台少女のナイトメアを
倒し、賀東を追いつめる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, at this point, it's more of the same.
Take out the core, defeat that Nightmare,
then we corner Gato.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN: Things have aligned since finding your allies.
fields.JP: 事実上仲間も揃ったとなればやることはシンプルだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Things have aligned since finding your allies.

fields.EN: As soon as we see the guardian, attack!
fields.JP: それじゃもう番人が見えたら突撃ですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: As soon as we see the guardian, attack!

fields.EN:
Well, no need to charge in blindly.
But the quicker we move, the less time
they have to prepare.
fields.JP:
そこまで猪突猛進でとは言ってないんだが……
ただ相手に準備をさせずに攻撃を始めるのは
ありかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, no need to charge in blindly.
But the quicker we move, the less time
they have to prepare.

fields.EN:
Then we'll get ready to attack immediately and
follow Juu-san's orders after that!
fields.JP:
それじゃすぐ攻撃できる準備はしつつ、
その後はジュウさんの指示に従っていきますね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then let's take advantage of this.
Ready at your command!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.JP: 一丁向こうが気が付く前に行きますか！

fields.EN: We did it! Now for the core...
fields.JP:
やりましたわ！
それじゃ早速核を……！
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it! Now for the core...

fields.JP: シンデレラ待ってくれ

ふぇ……！
あわわ、ですわ！

fields.EN: What's the matter? Is it unsafe?
fields.JP:
どうかしたんですか～？
また離れろってことですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: What's the matter? Is it unsafe?

fields.EN: No. Just want to check something.
fields.JP: いや……確かめたいことがある
fields.LOCALIZED: No. Just want to check something.

fields.EN: (Something is compelling me to do this...)
fields.JP: （ジェイルに触れていればいいと思うのだが……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Something is compelling me to do this...)

fields.EN: Why are you lying prostrate in front of it?
fields.JP: 両手を地面につけてなにするの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why are you lying prostrate in front of it?

fields.JP:
相変わらず君たちはせっかちだな。
暫く見ててほしい

fields.EN:
(I can feel the tower's pulse beating in my
hands. It seems at peace...)
fields.JP:
（両手から伝わる監隊塔の脈動……
　前よりは落ち着いて心穏やかに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can feel the tower's pulse beating in my
hands. It seems at peace...)

fields.EN:
(Match its breathing. Match it... Match it.
Follow.)
fields.JP:
（呼吸を合わせるように……合わせるように……
　合わせるように……合わせるように……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Match its breathing. Match it... Match it.
Follow.)

fields.JP:
バヴァヴァヴァヴァ！！！！
ダベエエベベベダアアアアアアアア！

ちょ、大丈夫！？
ジュウ

fields.EN:
(Don't let it take you. Stay strong.
Keep your heart calm. Keep...)
fields.JP:
（持ってかれるな……持ってかれるな……
　心を乱すな乱すな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't let it take you. Stay strong.
Keep your heart calm. Keep...)

fields.EN: What are 'Blood Maidens'? Let's call it an eternal mystery. Are they mutants bestowed upon us by God, or—
fields.JP:
『血式少女』とは何か。
それは永遠の謎とでも言っておこうか。
神が我々に与えた突然変異体なのか、それともーー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's just say it's something
we'll never really know. Maybe
it's the will of the gods, or...

fields.EN:
That aside, do you know where you
got your name, Jack-kun?
fields.JP:
……ところでジャックくん。
君は自分の名前の由来を知っているかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That aside, do you know where you
got your name, Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry, Akazukin. To
be honest, I completely forgot
about the memos I wrote.
fields.JP:
それは済まなかったね、赤ずきん。
実のところ……あのメモのことはほとんど
忘れかけていてね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry, Red Riding Hood. To
be honest, I completely forgot
about the memos I wrote.

fields.EN:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...
fields.JP:
やれやれ……獅子身中の虫とは、
まさにこのことか
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, it seems I did have a traitor
on this team...

fields.JP: ナイトメア・ジェイル
fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: 浅ハカナ考エデ私ヲ語ルナ……！

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: バウアアアアアアアア！！！！！

fields.EN: What? The core's rotting by itself!
fields.JP: うそっ！　何もしてないのに核が腐って……！
fields.LOCALIZED: What? The core's rotting by itself!

fields.EN: And the tower is crying out...
fields.JP: 監隊塔も鳴いてますわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: And the tower is crying out...

fields.JP:
どういうことなんでしょう。
ジュウさん、ジュウさん？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
ああ、大丈夫だ

fields.EN: (What was that memory? What did it mean?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだ今の記憶は……
　まさか今の記憶……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What was that memory? What did it mean?)

fields.JP: ジュウ、あんた何したの？

fields.EN:
When my connection to the Jail was made
clear to me, I thought long and hard about
what it could mean.
fields.JP:
自らの正体がわかった時に「自分が監獄塔」と
言っていた理由を考えたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When my connection to the Jail was made
clear to me, I thought long and hard about
what it could mean.

fields.EN: That made me wonder if this might be my true power, so I tried it.
fields.JP:
そしてその結果、もしかしたら僕の本当の力は
これなんじゃないかと思い、試した
fields.LOCALIZED:
Soon I realized that I possess an affinity
with the Jail, so I attempted to test this
hypothesis...

fields.EN: I see. What kind of power is it?
fields.JP:
なるほど。
それはどんな力だったんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. What kind of power is it?

fields.EN:
Until now, I thought it was merely being
able to hear the tower's voice.
fields.JP:
僕は今まで「核の声を聞ける」力を
持っていたと推測していた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until now, I thought it was merely being
able to hear the tower's voice.

fields.EN:
But that is only part of it. In truth, I can
merge my essence with the tower's.
fields.JP:
しかし、それは力の一部だったんだ。
本来の僕の力は「監獄塔」と一体化できる力
だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that is only part of it. In truth, I can
merge my essence with the tower's.

fields.JP: なんかすごそうな力ですわね……

fields.EN:
That's insane! Maybe Juu-san can control the
Jail somehow.
fields.JP:
すごいなんてもんじゃないと思います！
この監隊塔もジュウさんの手中に
収めることができてしまうかもしれません
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's insane! Maybe Toh can control the
Jail somehow.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
However, if I attempt to merge my mind
with the tower, I become overwhelmed.
fields.JP:
しかしだ。　以前も今もそうだったが、
監獄塔と一体化しようとした結果、
完全に意識を持ってかれそうになる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, if I attempt to merge my mind
with the tower, I become overwhelmed.

fields.EN:
I may not have enough strength to do this
again.
fields.JP:
こんなの何度もやってたら命が
いくつあっても足りないことがわかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may not have enough strength to do this
again.

fields.EN: Then it's best to play it safe.
fields.JP: それならやらないに越したことはないですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Then it's best to play it safe.

fields.EN:
I thought it could work against Gatou somehow,
but that is a stretch.
fields.JP:
賀東に対しての対策になれないかと思ったが、
実用化は厳しいかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought it could work against Gato somehow,
but that is a stretch.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN: (To use this power... you'd need to be well-prepared.)
fields.JP:
（これを使うときは……
　そうだな相当の覚悟が必要だ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (To use this power... you'd need to be well-prepared.)

fields.EN:
Sorry. We don't have time to waste.
Let's go.
fields.JP:
時間もない中ですまなかった。
行こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. We don't have time to waste.
Let's go.

fields.JP:
う、うん。
無理しないでよ

fields.EN:
Okay. I might've pushed it just now.
But I'll be careful.
fields.JP:
確かに無茶したところはあるな。
以後気を付ける
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay. I might've pushed it just now.
But I'll be careful.

fields.EN:
I never know what to say during your rare
flashes of humanity.
fields.JP: 素直な時は素直でやり辛いような
fields.LOCALIZED:
I never know what to say during your rare
flashes of humanity.

fields.JP: なんにしても最上階に向けて進みましょう！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

ババアァァァァァッ！！！
オディイザバアアアア゛ア゛ア゛

fields.EN: Ugh. I could never get used to looking at it.
fields.JP: 何度見ても悪趣味なナイトメアね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. I could never get used to looking at it.

fields.EN:
I wonder why they agreed to this.
Iron Maiden seemed so obsessed with
beauty. Seems out of character.
fields.JP:
あいつらさ、自分の意思でああなったのかな……
あんなに美にうるさかったアイアン・メイデンが
納得してあの姿になったのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder why they agreed to this.
Iron Maiden seemed so obsessed with
beauty. Seems out of character.

fields.EN: As if she would answer that for us.
fields.JP:
今その答えを持ち合わせている人物が
いないことくらいわかるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED: As if she would answer that for us.

fields.JP: いやそうなんだけどさ……

fields.EN: Considering everything they've done, maybe they brought it on themselves, but Shirayuki understands that unbearable feeling too...
fields.JP:
今までのことを考えると自業自得な人たち
なのかもしれませんが、やりきれない気持ちは
白雪にもわかります……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the end, they were selfish and evil.
But for some reason, I pity them.

fields.JP: だからといって見過ごせないですわ……

fields.EN: Do not give into your sentimentality.
fields.JP: そんな感傷に浸るようならば……
fields.LOCALIZED: Do not give into your sentimentality.

fields.EN:
Snap out of it! It's still a Nightmare, and it
still wants to kill us.
fields.JP:
みなさん喝ですよ！
わらわ達の仲間を襲い殺そうとする、
それはいつものナイトメアと変わりません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snap out of it! It's still a Nightmare, and it
still wants to kill us.

fields.EN:
There's only one thing for us to do.
I shall fight...to save the world.
fields.JP:
わらわ達のやることは決まっています。
仲間……世界を救うために全力で戦うことです
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's only one thing for us to do.
I shall fight...to save the world.

fields.EN: Jack and the other Blood Maidens are still fighting. With everyone doing their part, we can't afford to indulge in misplaced sympathy before our own fight.
fields.JP:
今もジャックや他の血式少女達は戦ってます。
そんな皆さんに対して、わらわ達が戦う前に
妙な情けを持ってもいいことはありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack and the others are fighting too.
We can't afford to show mercy to people
who want to see us dead.

fields.EN:
She's right. We could spare it, but that
would only put the others at risk.
fields.JP:
その通りだ。　このままあのナイトメアを
見過ごすことも出来るが、それは別の仲間に
危害が加わる可能性が高くなるということ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. We could spare it, but that
would only put the others at risk.

fields.EN:
Our good natures will betray us, but I won't
force you to make a decision. Just know that
emotion gets us nowhere.
fields.JP:
そういう意味で僕は今戦うべきだと思っている。
ただ無理強いはしない、情に流されている状態で
戦闘をしてもいいことはない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our good natures will betray us, but I won't
force you to make a decision. Just know that
emotion gets us nowhere.

fields.EN:
*sigh*... You're right.
The Nightmare is fighting to protect the Jail.
We fight to escape the Jail.
fields.JP:
はぁぁ……そうね。
ナイトメアはいつも通りジェイルを守るため、
わたし達は脱獄するため
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*... You're right.
The Nightmare is fighting to protect the Jail.
We fight to escape the Jail.

fields.EN: We will never see eye to eye.
fields.JP: 相いれない関係ですものね……
fields.LOCALIZED: We will never see eye to eye.

fields.EN:
Kaguya, Juu... We'll do it!
We have to...
fields.JP:
かぐや、ジュウ……。
あたしたちやるよ！　
今はやらないきゃいけないって思ってる……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, Toh... We'll do it!
We have to...

fields.JP:
白雪もネムちゃんに危害をくわえるような
マネはできません！

fields.EN:
Well as usual, if I deem it dangerous,
I'm going to give orders to retreat!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、いつも通り僕が危険だと感じたら
すぐ退散命令を伝える！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well as usual, if I deem it dangerous,
I'm going to give orders to retreat!

fields.EN:
Until then, everyone move into formation!
Stay alert!
fields.JP:
それまではいつも通り君たちの連携を
みせてやってほしい！
それじゃいくぞ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Until then, everyone move into formation!
Stay alert!

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

グググッ！！！
ビバブリバジラア”ア”ア”ア”

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... This is tougher than any
Nightmare we've fought!
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
今までのナイトメアの中で格段に強い！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... This is tougher than any
Nightmare we've fought!

fields.EN:
But all its limbs are destroyed! Now's our
chance!
fields.JP:
でも、全て部位は破壊しましたよ！
今こそチャンスですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But all its limbs are destroyed! Now's our
chance!

fields.JP:
よーっし……！
全力全開でいっくわよ！
白雪も親指姉さまに付いていきます！

よし、構えろ！
来るぞ！
悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

ググ……グ……グィ……
ババァァ……
もう動けそうにないな……

fields.EN: Time to deliver the finishing blow.
fields.JP: ……あとは止めを刺すだけですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Time to deliver the finishing blow.

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア

ググ……ババァァ……ダズゲデ……
……オデイザババァァ……ダズゲデ……

fields.EN: (It's in pain. Let's put it out of its misery.)
fields.JP:
（僕でさえ悲痛と思う声だ。　早めに止めを
　刺すのが彼女たちのタメだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It's in pain. Let's put it out of its misery.)

fields.EN: This is their karma for following Gatou.
fields.JP: 賀東などという人間を信じた末路ということか
fields.LOCALIZED: This is their karma for following Gato.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN: Juu, don't be cruel... Hey, are you crying?
fields.JP:
ジュウそれは流石に言いす……。
あ、あんたなんで泣いてるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, don't be cruel... Hey, are you crying?

fields.EN:
(She's right. Tears are falling down my
face. What is this...?)
fields.JP:
（確かに僕の目からは大粒の涙がでてる……
　これはなんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right. Tears are falling down my
face. What is this...?)

fields.JP: どこか怪我をなされたんですの？
ジュウさん大丈夫ですか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: (This is their karma for following Gatou...)
fields.JP:
（「賀東などという人間を信じた
　末路ということか」）
fields.LOCALIZED: (This is their karma for following Gato...)
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
Was it because of what happened earlier?
Say something.
fields.JP:
さっきの地面に手を付けたせいとか？
ちょっと何か言ってよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Was it because of what happened earlier?
Say something.

fields.EN:
(I see. I saw through Gatou's eyes...
These are tears of regret...)
fields.JP:
（ああ……そうか。結局僕は賀東と
　同じことをしていたのか……
　この涙は……『後悔』の涙だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. I saw through Gato's eyes...
These are tears of regret...)
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔ナイトメア
ガケに落ちていきましたね……

fields.EN:
Yeah. From this height...they couldn't have
survived.
fields.JP:
ああ、この高さだ……
恐らく無事ではすまないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. From this height...they couldn't have
survived.

fields.EN: Juu, you look ready to pass out. You okay?
fields.JP:
ジュウ、途中意識が飛んでたように見えたけど、
大丈夫だった？
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, you look ready to pass out. You okay?

fields.EN:
Yes. Thankfully I didn't, but I fear I've made
a mistake.
fields.JP:
ああ、意識はとんでないが……
僕は大きな過ちをしたことに気が付いたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Thankfully I didn't, but I fear I've made
a mistake.

fields.EN: Everyone, the end is near. We must hurry.
fields.JP:
みんな、もう終わりは近い。
早く行ったほうがいい……行こう。
fields.LOCALIZED: Everyone, the end is near. We must hurry.

fields.EN:
The top of the tower is beyond this point.
I assume Gatou is too.
fields.JP:
どうやらこの先が、
悪食の監隊塔の屋上のようだな。
おそらく賀東もそこにいるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The top of the tower is beyond this point.
I assume Gato is too.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.JP: ようやくここまで来たんですね

fields.EN:
So much has happened since we arrived
on the surface. I can scarcely remember
life underground.
fields.JP:
地上に出てから色々ありすぎて、
地下にいたのがずっと昔のようですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So much has happened since we arrived
on the surface. I can scarcely remember
life underground.

fields.EN: Hopefully this is the last of it.
fields.JP: その色々も、あと少しで終わる
fields.LOCALIZED: Hopefully this is the last of it.

fields.EN: Juu, I must thank you for everything.
fields.JP: ジュウ、なんだかんだありがとね
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, I must thank you for everything.

fields.EN:
Seriously. I thought you were a real bastard
at first. Almost unbearable.
fields.JP:
正直言うとさ、あんた初めはとんでもなく
人でなしなこと言ったり、デリカシーの欠片もなく
ズケズケ言うしで、全然好きになれなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. I thought you were a real bastard
at first. Almost unbearable.

fields.EN:
Ah. Yes, that's no surprise to me.
I've never met anyone so emotional or
illogical.
fields.JP:
そんなこと、論理的思考を放棄して
感情的にぶつかってくる時点で分かっていたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Yes, that's no surprise to me.
I've never met anyone so emotional or
illogical.

fields.EN: Yeah. You got on my nerves too.
fields.JP:
そうそう、そんな態度も
最初は何コイツ！　って感じだったね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. You got on my nerves too.

fields.EN:
Hehe. But maybe that's how Dad was as
a young man, too.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、そういうのが正直お父さんの若い頃の
性格だなんてとても思えないけどさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. But maybe that's how Dad was as
a young man, too.

fields.EN:
You claim you're just looking for your wife,
but you've stuck your neck out for us too.
fields.JP:
でも、奥さんのためだって言いながらも、
なんだかんだあたしたちのことも
考えてくれたでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You claim you're just looking for your wife,
but you've stuck your neck out for us too.

fields.EN: That's why we made it this far. If you were really as cold as your words, none of us would probably still be here.
fields.JP:
だからあたしたち、ここまで来られたんだよね。
もし本当に冷たい言葉のとおりの奴だったら、
たぶん、あたしたちみんな今頃いないもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's why we're here. Without you,
I doubt any of us would be here.

fields.EN: She's right. Even while saying it was for yourself, you ended up helping us after all.
fields.JP:
確かにそうね。自分のためって言いながらも、
結局助けてくれたりしてたもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. Credit to you for all your help
and leadership.

fields.EN:
You saved me first, Juu-san. Maybe it was calculated
back then, but it doesn't feel that way anymore!
fields.JP:
白雪は最初にジュウさんに助けられました。
あの時は打算だったかもしれませんが、
今はもうそんな感じ、しないです！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You saved me right at the start. It might
have been calculated, but at least I'm here!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
It's true that you saved me too while we were in the
Jail Tower, Juu-san!
fields.JP:
わたくしも、監獄塔が続く中でジュウさんに
救われた部分があったのは確かですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You played a big role in our survival.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
You know, if you peel back the pretentious
mumbles, you're quite the gentleman.
fields.JP:
思い返してみれば、面倒くさいところや
大人げないところを除けば、わりかし
紳士だったかもしれませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, if you peel back the pretentious
mumbles, you're quite the gentleman.

fields.JP: ありがとう。そしてすまない

fields.EN:
I'm sure you're all conflicted because we
don't know where I came from.
fields.JP:
君たちは今、
僕が何者なのかはっきりしないことに
複雑な気持ちを抱いていると思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you're all conflicted because we
don't know where I came from.

fields.EN:
Yet you shower me with kind praise.
Truthfully, I am moved.
fields.JP:
そんな中でこういった言葉を
かけてくれたのは、素直に嬉しい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet you shower me with kind praise.
Truthfully, I am moved.

fields.EN:
It's true. It's my wife I've been searching for,
but I never took my eyes off of you.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ、結局どんな時も妻のことを
考えていたのは間違いないが、いつの間にか
同時に君たちのことも考えるようになっていた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. It's my wife I've been searching for,
but I never took my eyes off of you.

fields.EN:
I know not why or how I feel this way.
My connection to you. It eludes me.
fields.JP:
ただ、いまだに、どうしてそう思うように
なったのか、君たちに抱くこの感情は何なのか、
論理的に説明できないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know not why or how I feel this way.
My connection to you. It eludes me.

fields.EN: Ugh. Leave it to you to overthink the situation.
fields.JP:
相っ変わらず
小難しいこと考えてんのねー、あんた
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Leave it to you to overthink the situation.

fields.JP: あのね、それは単に『好き』ってだけでしょ

fields.EN: Like...? I only know affection for my wife.
fields.JP:
好き……？
僕が好きだと感じたのは妻だけだが……
fields.LOCALIZED: Like...? I only know affection for my wife.

fields.EN:
Juu-san, you should know by now. Love exists
in many different forms.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんなら気がついてるはずですよ。
好きにも色々な種類があるってこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, you should know by now. Love exists
in many different forms.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: A smile? That's rare from you, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
あら、ジュウさんがこんな風に笑うなんて
とても珍しいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: A smile? That's rare from you, Toh.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Yeah. Never thought I'd see the day.
Huh, Aka-nee?
fields.JP:
あんたそんな顔もできたんだ、
意外だわー。ね、赤姉？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. Never thought I'd see the day.
Huh, Sister Red?
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored
B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.EN: Sorry. I know everyone's on edge...
fields.JP:
ごめんねみんな。
本当はここは気合いを入れるところだったのに
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry. I know everyone's on edge...

fields.EN:
But I wanted to say this just in case
I don't get another chance...
fields.JP:
でもこの先何があるか分からないから……
だから今、伝えたかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I wanted to say this just in case
I don't get another chance...

fields.EN: Ugh. So dramatic. What is it now?
fields.JP:
はぁ……まったく君って奴は。
謝る必要がどこにある？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. So dramatic. What is it now?

fields.EN: Oh. I was going to apologize for being sappy.
fields.JP: いや、なんかしんみりさせちゃったかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. I was going to apologize for being sappy.

fields.EN:
Who would dare criticize you for that?
Anyone here?
fields.JP:
それを悪いことだと思ってる奴が、
この中にいると思うのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who would dare criticize you for that?
Anyone here?

fields.EN:
Yeah, Aka-nee. There's no better time than
now.
fields.JP: そうよ赤姉、穏やかでいい時間だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, Sister Red. There's no better time than
now.
fields.notes: B19 source-form Akazukin nickname/kinship cleanup; localization-only Red naming removed or source form restored

fields.JP: 白雪も、とっても素敵なことだったと思いますよ

fields.EN:
Me too. Staring the end in the face really
brings something out of you.
fields.JP:
同じくですわ。最後を目前に控えてるからこそ、
素直になれたりもしますものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too. Staring the end in the face really
brings something out of you.

fields.EN: Right. Take, for example, Juu-san's smile.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんの微笑みなんていうのも、
たまにしか見ることができませんしね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Take, for example, Toh's smile.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Even so, it's right for all of us to acknowledge
our roles in getting our group here.
fields.JP:
とはいえ確かに、本来プロジェクトのお礼とは
すべてが終わってからするものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, it's right for all of us to acknowledge
our roles in getting our group here.

fields.EN:
But we can save the pleasantries for
after we complete our mission.
fields.JP:
だからすべてが終わったら、
その時改めてこの話を聞かせてもらおうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we can save the pleasantries for
after we complete our mission.

fields.EN: Typical man... Never talking about feelings.
fields.JP:
また回りくどい言い方を……
本当に不器用な人ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Typical man... Never talking about feelings.

fields.JP: ジュウさんらしいです
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
(I have been lying to these girls all along...
An unforgivable sin.)
fields.JP:
（僕はこんな少女達を騙していたのか……
　許されない罪だろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I have been lying to these girls all along...
An unforgivable sin.)

fields.EN: (Maybe this will be the first time I ever tell a lie.)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたら僕は、初めて
　嘘をつくことになるのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Hopefully one day, they'll know the truth.)

fields.EN: (But if that day comes, I mustn't hesitate.)
fields.JP:
（だがそれでも──
　今は立ち止まるべき時ではない）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But if that day comes, I mustn't hesitate.)

fields.EN: After our victory, we'll come back to it.
fields.JP:
みんな全てを終わらせ、
ここに戻って来よう
fields.LOCALIZED: After our victory, we'll come back to it.

fields.EN:
This place looks even more desolate than
normal.
fields.JP:
ついこの間までいたけど、
なんか前よりもなにもないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
This place looks even more desolate than
normal.

fields.JP: くららたちと別れ、辿り着いた生まれ故郷

fields.EN:
I came prepared to eat anything I could get my
hands on, but the place was even emptier than
before.
fields.JP:
なりふり構わずに食えるものを食うくらいの
覚悟で来たが、前よりもからっぽの状況だった
fields.LOCALIZED: Time hasn't been kind to this place.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
The island's contaminated zones are hardly
contained. It's at its limit.
fields.JP:
もうずっと前から、
この島も汚染地帯が広がってたけどさ、
もう行くところまでいっちゃったねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The island's contaminated zones are hardly
contained. It's at its limit.

fields.EN:
That's true. The island was paradise compared
to this.
fields.JP:
たしかに。
これと比べたら、昔の島は楽園
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true. The island was paradise compared
to this.

fields.EN:
Was there any point in coming back? Haha...
*sigh*
fields.JP:
あたしたち、ここに戻ってくる意味あったのかな。
はははは……。は～ぁ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Was there any point in coming back? Haha...
*sigh*

fields.EN:
(Now that we know Rachel's alive, we can't
stay here.)
fields.JP:
（まあ『レイチェルが生きてる』って聞いた以上、
　あそこに居続けるわけにはいかなかったものね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that we know Rachel's alive, we can't
stay here.)

fields.EN:
(I sacrificed my sister for my own safety.
Who am I to face her? I bet she hates us.)
fields.JP:
（我が身可愛さに見捨てた妹に、今更会えるわけない。
　きっとあの子は、あたしたちを恨んでいるはず）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I sacrificed my sister for my own safety.
Who am I to face her? I bet she hates us.)

fields.EN:
(There I go, running from my problems.
All because I couldn't handle Rachel being
upset at me.)
fields.JP:
（そっか。あたしはまた『逃げた』のか。
　レイチェルに軽蔑した眼差しを向けられたり、
　罵倒されることに耐えられないから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There I go, running from my problems.
All because I couldn't handle Rachel being
upset at me.)

fields.EN: (In the end, I'm just a selfish low-life.)
fields.JP:
（結局、いくつになってもあたしは、
　自分のことばかり考えてる下衆なんだわ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (In the end, I'm just a selfish low-life.)

fields.JP: ライリー、これからどうする？
うーん。まだ決めてない

だと思った……。
それなら、これ使ってみれば？

fields.EN:
This is their receiver. You had it?
We can't pawn this.
fields.JP:
あいつらのトランシーバーじゃない。
まだ持ってたの？　こんなもん金になんないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is their receiver. You had it?
We can't pawn this.

fields.EN:
Don't play dumb. You know what I mean,
right?
fields.JP:
話をそらさない。
わたしが言いたいこと、分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't play dumb. You know what I mean,
right?

fields.EN:
Try calling. It's this channel, I think.
Maybe you can talk to Rachel?
fields.JP:
ダメもとで、掛けてみよ。
多分この周波数。レイチェルと話せるかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try calling. It's this channel, I think.
Maybe you can talk to Rachel?

fields.JP: そんなことしても意味ないわ

fields.EN:
Come on! If you make up with Rachel,
then you'll stop feeling sorry for yourself,
Sis!
fields.JP:
あるよ！　レイチェルと仲直りできれば、
おねえがずっと抱えてきた苦しみから、
解放されるかもしれないんだよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Come on! If you make up with Rachel,
then you'll stop feeling sorry for yourself,
Sis!

fields.JP: あたしを『おねえ』って呼ぶな！！

fields.EN:
Then stop being so pathetic! Be yourself!
Where's the Riley I know and love?
fields.JP:
だったらそんな情けない顔するな！
いつも通り人間だろうが汚染動物だろうが、
奪えるもの奪っていこうって言いなよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then stop being so pathetic! Be yourself!
Where's the Riley I know and love?

fields.EN:
All this moping is driving me nuts.
We're sure to get eaten by one of those
contaminated beings at this rate.
fields.JP:
いつまでもウジウジされると、こっちも調子が狂う。
こんなんじゃそこら辺の汚染動物に見つかって、
簡単に殺される
fields.LOCALIZED:
All this moping is driving me nuts.
We're sure to get eaten by one of those
contaminated beings at this rate.

fields.EN:
The world might be cruel, but we need
to survive. Together, Sis.
fields.JP:
どんなに醜い世界でも、
わたしはまだまだ生きたいんだ。
おねえと一緒に
fields.LOCALIZED:
The world might be cruel, but we need
to survive. Together, Sis.

fields.EN: Ugh. I've let you ramble on for long enough.
fields.JP:
……黙って聞いてれば、
ずいぶん生意気なことを言うわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. I've let you ramble on for long enough.

fields.EN: Did you finally get your spine back?
fields.JP: 文句があるなら、言い返す？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you finally get your spine back?

fields.EN:
Almost. My heart aches. But as vexing as it
is, you're right.
fields.JP:
さっきまでそのつもりだったわ。
でも胸がじんじんして言葉がでてこないの
悔しいけど、あたしの負け
fields.LOCALIZED:
Almost. My heart aches. But as vexing as it
is, you're right.

fields.JP: おねえ……。分かってくれたんだね

fields.EN: I don't know whether it'll free her from her suffering. I just thought she should clear away the doubts in her heart. Here, lend me the transceiver.
fields.JP:
苦しみから解放されるかどうかは分かんないけど
心の迷いは吹っ切ったほうがいいと思っただけよ。
ほら、トランシーバーを貸して
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not sure I can forgive myself, but the
only way through is forward. Okay.
Hand me that thing.

fields.EN:
It's already switched on. Hopefully we'll
get through.
fields.JP:
はい。スイッチはもう入れてあるよ。
上手く繋がるといいんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's already switched on. Hopefully we'll
get through.

fields.EN:
(After a while, we heard a voice through
the static.)
fields.JP:
――しばらくすると、ノイズに混じって、
聞き覚えのある声が聞こえた
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After a while, we heard a voice through
the static.)

fields.EN:
(Seconds later, we got through to Gretel,
who revealed shocking information.)
fields.JP:
その数秒後、通信の相手が、
突然グレーテルに変わり、衝撃的なことを言われた
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seconds later, we got through to Gretel,
who revealed shocking information.)

fields.EN:
I'm gonna cut to the chase. Your sister,
Rachel, is in trouble.
fields.JP:
端的にいうわ、
あなた達の妹『レイチェル』が重症なの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna cut to the chase. Your sister,
Rachel, is in trouble.

fields.EN:
To save her, we need you to destroy the
core on Leichhardt Island. There's little time.
Hurry, or she'll be killed by the Nightmare.
fields.JP:
レイチェルを助けるためには『ライカード島』の
最奥にある『核』を破壊しないといけないわ。
もう時間がないの。急がないとナイトメアに殺される
fields.LOCALIZED:
To save her, we need you to destroy the
core on Licard Island. There's little time.
Hurry, or she'll be killed by the Nightmare.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ライカード → Leichhardt

fields.EN: Wait. What are you talking about?!
fields.JP: 待って。なに言ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. What are you talking about?!

fields.EN:
(I could hear a girl groaning faintly in the
distance.)
fields.JP:
耳をすましてグレーテルの話を聞いていると、
女の子のうめき声が聞こえた
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I could hear a girl groaning faintly in the
distance.)

fields.EN:
(I didn't even need to ask whom it was.
My heart answered for me.)
fields.JP:
『誰？』とは、あえて聞かなかった。
聞かなくても、直感で気づいたから
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't even need to ask whom it was.
My heart answered for me.)

fields.EN:
(As soon as I accepted the task, the signal
cut. It was quiet. I gripped the transmitter
tightly and took deep breaths.)
fields.JP:
グレーテルの声に頷いた直後、通信は途切れた。
あたしは、うんともすんとも言わなくなった
トランシーバーを強く握りしめ、大股で歩き始めた
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As soon as I accepted the task, the signal
cut. It was quiet. I gripped the transmitter
tightly and took deep breaths.)

fields.EN:
Huh? Sis, where are you going?!
Are we heading in?
fields.JP:
えっ。おねえ、まさか行く気！？
今更奥に行くとか、絶対やばいって！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Sis, where are you going?!
Are we heading in?

fields.EN:
Ellie, you can stay back. Don't worry.
I'll be quick.
fields.JP:
エリーはここら辺に隠れてて。
大丈夫、すぐに戻ってくるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ellie, you can stay back. Don't worry.
I'll be quick.

fields.EN:
That's what our parents said. You think
I'd let that happen again? It could be a trap.
fields.JP:
お義父さんたちと同じこと言うの止めて。
おねえ、なんであんな話をすぐに信じるの？
なにかの罠かもしれないじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what our parents said. You think
I'd let that happen again? It could be a trap.

fields.EN: I heard Rachel. She was crying...
fields.JP:
レイチェルの声が聞こえた。
痛い、痛いって、泣いてた……
fields.LOCALIZED: I heard Rachel. She was crying...

fields.EN:
I know, but we don't know if that was
really her.
fields.JP:
知ってる。
でも、あれが本物のレイチェルかどうかなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know, but we don't know if that was
really her.

fields.EN:
But I do. That voice...is the same one I've
heard in my dreams for years.
fields.JP:
分かるよ。だってあれは……
もう何年も何年も夢に出てきた声なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I do. That voice...is the same one I've
heard in my dreams for years.

fields.EN:
Remember? That bratty girl with Clara.
Her aura, her voice. That's Rachel.
fields.JP:
ねえ、覚えてる？
くららと一緒にいたワガママなガキ。
あの子の雰囲気と声、レイチェルにそっくりだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember? That bratty girl with Clara.
Her aura, her voice. That's Rachel.

fields.EN:
Yeah. The thought crossed my mind.
She looked just like Rachel.
fields.JP:
うん……。レイチェルが生きてたら、
こんな感じだったのかなってちょっと考えた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. The thought crossed my mind.
She looked just like Rachel.

fields.EN:
Me too. I almost believed her at first.
But it's gotta be.
fields.JP:
あたしも。違う子だって言われたから
勘違いだと思ってたけど、あれはやっぱり
レイチェルだったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too. I almost believed her at first.
But it's gotta be.

fields.EN:
If she's in danger, we must save her.
You won't change my mind.
fields.JP:
あの子が危ないなら、助けないと。
こればっかりは、止めても無駄よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she's in danger, we must save her.
You won't change my mind.

fields.EN: *sigh*... Guess not. Ugh. I'm coming with you.
fields.JP:
はぁ……。そんなことしない。
仕方ないから、一緒に行く
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh*... Guess not. Ugh. I'm coming with you.

fields.EN: Duh. Why do you think I still call you Sis?
fields.JP:
あのさ、自分が今、
どうして『おねえ』って呼んでるか分かる？
fields.LOCALIZED: Duh. Why do you think I still call you Sis?

fields.EN:
The world's about to end. I've been holding
this back for years. I need you as my sister
too. I can't do this without you either.
fields.JP:
もう世界は終わりそうだし、
今まで我慢してた分、とことん甘えたくなった
ここで別れたら欲求不満のまま
fields.LOCALIZED:
The world's about to end. I've been holding
this back for years. I need you as my sister
too. I can't do this without you either.

fields.EN: So I'm going wherever you go.
fields.JP: だから、どこまでもついてく
fields.LOCALIZED: So I'm going wherever you go.

fields.EN: Thank you, Ellie... You mean so much to me.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、エリー。
あたしの……大事な妹
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you, Ellie... You mean so much to me.

fields.EN: I think you could do better than that.
fields.LOCALIZED: I think you could do better than that.

fields.EN: Hahaha. Probably. Did you know I'd say that?
fields.JP:
あははっ、そうね。
……とでも言うと思った？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. Probably. Did you know I'd say that?

fields.EN: Don't get cocky, kiddo. COME HERE!
fields.JP:
あんた、さっきから調子に乗りすぎ。
少し黙りなさい。うりうりー
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't get cocky, kiddo. COME HERE!

fields.JP: うーー……おへえ、ほっぺたひっぱりふり

fields.EN: Shut up! Quit complainin' and follow me!
fields.JP:
うるさーーい。
文句たれてないで、さっさと出発するわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Shut up! Quit complainin' and follow me!

fields.EN:
(We're gonna save Rachel this time...
I swear!)
fields.JP:
（あたしたちが、レイチェルを助けるんだ。
　今度こそ……必ず……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We're gonna save Rachel this time...
I swear!)

fields.EN: It's a lot quieter here than I thought.
fields.JP:
想像はしてたけど、
汚染動物とあちこちで遭うわね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's a lot quieter here than I thought.

fields.EN: But stay alert. Bet they're all in hiding.
fields.JP:
今でさえこれなんだから、
奥にはうじゃうじゃいるんだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED: But stay alert. Bet they're all in hiding.

fields.EN:
Right. I've been hiding from these things
all my life. Never thought I'd set foot in
the nest.
fields.JP:
うん。今まで汚染動物を避けて生きてきたのに、
奴らの巣窟に行くことになるなんて
思ってもみなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I've been hiding from these things
all my life. Never thought I'd set foot in
the nest.

fields.EN:
Ellie, don't push it. If you want to hide,
then go ahead.
fields.JP:
エリー、今ならまだ引き返せるわよ？
気が変わったなら、遠慮しないで言って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ellie, don't push it. If you want to hide,
then go ahead.

fields.EN: Nice of you, but I'll pass.
fields.JP:
心配してくれてありがと。
でもそれ、余計なお世話
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice of you, but I'll pass.

fields.EN:
I want to protect Rachel just as much as
you do... This time, for sure.
If I turn back, I'll regret it forever.
fields.JP:
おねえがレイチェルを守りたいように、
わたしもあの子を守りたいんだ。……次は必ず
ここで引き返したら、それこそ後悔する
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to protect Rachel just as much as
you do... This time, for sure.
If I turn back, I'll regret it forever.

fields.EN:
(I'm not the only one hurting over Rachel.
Ellie is too. I was so wrapped up with myself
that I hadn't thought about her feelings.)
fields.JP:
（レイチェルのことで苦しんでるのは、
　あたしだけじゃない。エリーも同じなんだ。
　自分のことで精一杯でそんなことも忘れてた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not the only one hurting over Rachel.
Ellie is too. I was so wrapped up with myself
that I hadn't thought about her feelings.)

fields.EN: Heh, fine. I won't worry about you ever again. Come on, let's go! Just a little farther!
fields.JP:
ふっ、分かったよ。
もう二度と心配なんかしてやんない。
ほら、さっさと行くよ！　もう一息だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh. Got it. I'll never question you again.
Come on! Let's hurry. Just a bit further.

fields.JP: うん！　あと少し頑張ろう、おねえ！

fields.EN: Did we make it? Where's the core?
fields.JP:
奥って、ここ？
核はどこにある……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did we make it? Where's the core?

fields.JP: きっとこの更に奥の部屋よ

fields.EN:
No, but the treasure's always buried in
the deepest part, right?
fields.JP:
無いわ。でもこの世界のどこへ行っても、
お宝は一番奥に隠してあったでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, but the treasure's always buried in
the deepest part, right?

fields.EN:
Good point. Our experience as thieves
taught us as much.
fields.JP:
言われてみればたしかに……。
盗人の経験も、案外役に立つ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good point. Our experience as thieves
taught us as much.

fields.EN: Heh. Yeah. Enough chatter, let's move!
fields.JP:
ふっ、まあね。
お喋りはここまでにして、とっとと行くわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh. Yeah. Enough chatter, let's move!

fields.JP:
なっ……！？
危険汚染動物！？

fields.EN:
Hey, why's it chasing us?! The others weren't
like that!
fields.JP:
ちょっ、なんで急に追いかけてくるの！？　
ここの奴らは、今までじっとしてたのに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, why's it chasing us?! The others weren't
like that!

fields.EN:
(It's like someone's controlling it...
How's that possible?!)
fields.JP:
（まるで誰かが動かしてるみたい……。
　でもそんな芸当を、どこのどいつが
　できるっていうの？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's like someone's controlling it...
How's that possible?!)

fields.EN: No time to think! We need to get outta here!
fields.JP:
……って、余計なこと考えてる場合じゃないわね。
とにかく逃げるわよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: No time to think! We need to get outta here!

fields.EN:
(We need to dodge this thing and save
Rachel!)
fields.JP:
（こいつから逃げ切って、
　早くレイチェルを救わなきゃ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need to dodge this thing and save
Rachel!)

fields.EN: *pant, pant*... I think we got away.
fields.JP:
はぁっ、はぁ……。
なんとか……逃げ切った……
fields.LOCALIZED: *pant, pant*... I think we got away.

fields.EN:
Yeah, but this is a dead-end.
We need a way out...
fields.JP:
ええ、でもこの先は行き止まりよ。
急いでここを離れないと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, but this is a dead-end.
We need a way out...

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
あーもう！
やっぱり来やがった！！
おねえ、こっちにもいる！！

fields.EN: (What do we do? Climb the wall and escape? We have neither the tools nor the time! If we turn our backs, it's over! Beg for our lives? Negotiate? Contaminated Animals don't understand words!)
fields.JP:
（どうする？　壁を登って逃げる？
　道具も時間もない！　背を向けたら終わりだ！
　命乞いは？　交渉は？　汚染動物に言葉は通じない！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do we do? Do we climb?
There's no time! Do we beg for mercy?
They can't talk!)

fields.EN:
*sniff* Did we fail again...?
Man, how useless could I be...
fields.JP:
……ぐすっ。またダメなの……？
結局あたしは、いくつになっても無力なんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sniff* Did we fail again...?
Man, how useless could I be...

fields.JP: ばかおねえ！　ここまで来て諦めるな！！

fields.EN:
You always push me, Sis! You're not useless!
You're the greatest!
fields.JP:
おねえはいつだって、わたしに力をくれた。
無力なんかじゃない。最強のおねえだよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always push me, Sis! You're not useless!
You're the greatest!

fields.EN:
(She's right. We can't quit. Even if there's
no escape route, there has to be some
way to keep Ellie safe.)
fields.JP:
（そうよ。ここで降参してどうするの。
　逃げる手が見つからなくても、この子だけは、

ええ……。　この球根みたいな形、

fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh, fine. You don't have to be so pushy!

fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, I touched you. Like this?

このまま核に近づきますよ

うん……。しかも全然動かない。

fields.LOCALIZED:

fields.LOCALIZED:

くれぐれも私から手を離さないように……

fields.LOCALIZED:

the hands of a pair of brothers, torn asunder
by circumstance.

ただ運命を受け入れた私が、良くも悪くも、

accept that there is no right or wrong.

Mindless fool. You and I see the world with
different eyes.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
This monstrosity and me? How are we
similar? Tell me!
fields.JP:
この醜くて気持ち悪い化け物とこの俺！
どこが似ている！　言ってみろ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This monstrosity and me? How are we
similar? Tell me!

fields.EN:
Ah, you're blind to it... Her love.
Her sorrowful heart yearning for family.
fields.JP:
そう、あなたには見えないのね……
その子の愛情が……ただ家族を求める寂しい心が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, you're blind to it... Her love.
Her sorrowful heart yearning for family.

fields.EN: We do see the world from different eyes.
fields.JP: やっぱり、私たちとは見えている世界が違うわ
fields.LOCALIZED: We do see the world from different eyes.

fields.EN:
I love Alice and Mary. Even if they're 
different from me.
fields.JP:
私はアリスやメアリーを愛してる。
たとえ姿形が変わっても
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love Alice and Mary. Even if they're 
different from me.

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san's right. It's not their appearance
that makes them family. It's their hearts.
fields.JP:
シャーロットさんの言う通りだ。
人を醜くするのは見た目じゃない。心だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte's right. It's not their appearance
that makes them family. It's their hearts.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Hmph. You monsters would say that.
Sure, hold hands and sing songs all you want!
fields.JP:
貴様らみたいに化け物同士なら、
そりゃあ、おぞましく愛し合えるだろうな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. You monsters would say that.
Sure, hold hands and sing songs all you want!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Unfortunately, I am human, and I will do
what Man has always done to monsters.
fields.JP:
だが生憎、俺は人間でな、
化け物は退治するものだと決まってるんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately, I am human, and I will do
what Man has always done to monsters.

fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN: Guillotine did all this for you... She wanted to become your family, and even took this form to devote herself to you, didn't she?!
fields.JP:
ギロチンはお前のために……
お前と家族になりたくて、こんな姿になってまで
尽くそうとしたんじゃないのか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Guillotine is your family! That's why she's
doing this. It's all to help you!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Are you stupid?! Who would
ever become family with a roach?!
fields.JP:
馬鹿か貴様ッ！
貴様はゴキブリやゴミなんかと
家族になりたいと思うのか！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you stupid?! Who would
ever become family with a roach?!

fields.EN:
Jack, he's long gone. Nothing we say
will get through.
fields.JP:
ジャック。もうあの男は普通じゃない。
残念だけど、言葉はもう届かないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, he's long gone. Nothing we say
will get through.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
This ends now. I will dispose of you, and rid
the world of any monsters who oppose me.
fields.JP:
さあ、そろそろ終わりにしよう。
お前たちを殺し、月の落下を邪魔する
あの目障りな化け物も殺す
fields.LOCALIZED:
This ends now. I will dispose of you, and rid
the world of any monsters who oppose me.

fields.EN: You wish! I won't let you!
fields.JP:
そんなことさせるか！
僕たちがお前を止めてみせる！
fields.LOCALIZED: You wish! I won't let you!

fields.EN: I won't let you take our future from us!
fields.JP:
わたしたちの未来を
勝手に奪わせなんてしない！
fields.LOCALIZED: I won't let you take our future from us!

fields.JP:
あなたは間違ってる。
それを分からせてあげるわ

fields.EN:
Charlotte declared her love for me...
I'm curious what'll happen to the world.
So I'll give it my all too.
fields.JP:
シャーロットが愛してるって言ってくれたんだ、
世界の続きが気になるから、お、俺も頑張るぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte declared her love for me...
I'm curious what'll happen to the world.
So I'll give it my all too.

fields.EN: We're escaping this place once and for all.
fields.JP:
今度こそわたしたちは、
こんな運命から脱獄してみせるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: We're escaping this place once and for all.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Kuahaha. None of your howling can stop the
moon! Your brains can hardly comprehend!
fields.JP:
クハハ、あの月を目の前に、
よくそこまで吠えられるものだな！
クソ虫の極みだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kuahaha. None of your howling can stop the
moon! Your brains can hardly comprehend!

fields.EN: Gatou... I've never hated someone more.
fields.JP:
賀東……
こんなにも怒りをおぼえたのは生まれて初めてだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Gato... I've never hated someone more.
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.JP: お前だけは！　絶対に許さないっ！！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: それはこっちのセリフだ、ジャック

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I'll kill every last one of you and bring the moon crashing down to the surface. That's the only way I can be saved...
fields.JP:
貴様らを全員殺し、月を地上へ落とす。
それこそが唯一俺が救われる方法……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll make you and your friends pay for your
insolence by crashing the moon to this
planet's surface! Salvation is coming!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
After all you've done, we should kill you
where you stand.
fields.JP:
これまでのことを考えれば、
正直ここでお前を殺すべきなのかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
After all you've done, we should kill you
where you stand.

fields.EN:
But I'm sure you have your reasons for
your madness.
fields.JP:
ただ、あなたにもこんなことをする
理由があったんだろうと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm sure you have your reasons for
your madness.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
HA! I wondered what you were going to say.
Did you think I would confess and beg for
your forgiveness?
fields.JP:
ハッ、何を言うかと思えば……
俺が、過去を打ち明けて
許しを請うとでも思ったのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HA! I wondered what you were going to say.
Did you think I would confess and beg for
your forgiveness?

fields.JP: まだ立ち上がるなんて……！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: フハハハハハ、ハーッハッハッハ！！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I had no idea insects could feel pity.
I suppose this is the end for me.
fields.JP:
まさかゴミ虫に同情されるとは、
確かに俺ももう終わりだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had no idea insects could feel pity.
I suppose this is the end for me.

fields.JP:
あれは……ウィッチクラフト！？
どうして……！

fields.EN:
What? Does that mean the moon and the
tower...!
fields.JP:
まさか、ただの月なのに
受精したっていうのか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Does that mean the moon and the
tower...!

fields.EN: It can give birth even without consummation!
fields.JP:
無精卵でも生まれるということなのか……
はっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: It can give birth even without consummation!

fields.EN:
Shoot! Witchcraft has the potential to make
even the wildest dreams come true! Don't let
Gatou touch it!
fields.JP:
まずい！　ウィッチクラフトは
自分の思念を最大限擬態化させる！
賀東に触れさせては駄目だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot! Witchcraft has the potential to make
even the wildest dreams come true! Don't let
Gato touch it!
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.JP: そんな、せっかくここまで来たのに！

fields.EN: We...have to stop him, but we won't make—
fields.JP: 止めなきゃ……でも間に合わな――
fields.LOCALIZED: We...have to stop him, but we won't make—

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: You think I'd falter to you?! Don't insult me!
fields.JP:
この俺がこんな化け物の産物に頼り、
すがるとでも言うのか……！
馬鹿にするのもいいかげんにしろ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: You think I'd falter to you?! Don't insult me!

fields.JP:
なっ……！？
使わないというのか……？

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: None of you seem to get it.
fields.JP: 理解の足らぬゴミ虫どもが――
fields.LOCALIZED: None of you seem to get it.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I'm not like any of you! I am human!
I have used and destroyed this world with my
own hands. Hundreds of lives can attest to that.
fields.JP:
俺は貴様らとは違う！　人間だ！
人間としてこの世界を利用し、破壊し、
そして多くを殺してきた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not like any of you! I am human!
I have used and destroyed this world with my
own hands. Hundreds of lives can attest to that.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You think I need this to become a god?!
You're gravely mistaken!
fields.JP:
それなのに化け物の力を欲する！？
そんな安易で馬鹿げたものに頼るなど、
ゴミ虫がすることだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think I need this to become a god?!
You're gravely mistaken!

fields.EN: Gatou, where do you think you're going?
fields.JP: 賀東、どこに行くつもりだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Gato, where do you think you're going?
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou

fields.EN:
Is he heading for the tower's brink?
Does he plan to jump...?
fields.JP:
塔の淵へ……？
まさか、飛び降りて逃げるつもりじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is he heading for the tower's brink?
Does he plan to jump...?

fields.EN: There's no way he'd survive from that height.
fields.JP:
さすがにこの高さから飛び降りたら、
無事では済まないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: There's no way he'd survive from that height.

fields.EN:
I don't know what you're thinking, but don't
try it.
fields.JP:
何をする気か知らないけど、
もうやめるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what you're thinking, but don't
try it.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I don't need your pity. How does it feel?
Pretty good, I imagine.
fields.JP:
ゴミ虫が俺を哀れむか？　どうだ？　今の気分は。
実に心地よいだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't need your pity. How does it feel?
Pretty good, I imagine.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Genocide Pink was corrupted by your thirst
for "justice"! That justice ruined everything!
fields.JP:
ジェノサイド・ピンクまたお前らの『正義』に
全てが台無しにされたよ。
俺たちの普通を台無しにした『正義』がなぁ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Massacre Pink was corrupted by your thirst
for "justice"! That justice ruined everything!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Freedom, equality. Friendship. Reason.
Qualities preached only by the fearful.
Nothing more than defense from panic.
fields.JP:
自由と平等、友愛と理性をうたいながら
いざ目の前に異質なモノをみると不安に
焦燥にかられる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Freedom, equality. Friendship. Reason.
Qualities preached only by the fearful.
Nothing more than defense from panic.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: And it always ends at "justice"! There's no malice in it. It's like an instinct humans are born with.
fields.JP:
そしていつも行きつくのは『正義』！！
そこには悪意などない。
人が最初から持つ本能のようなものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone who pursues justice ends up the
same. It is the way and folly of man.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
But I aim to kill the petty hope of those who
search for it. Hehe... Hehehe... AHAHA!
fields.JP:
俺はその悪意のない正義を殺しに殺してきた！
……ふふ、ふふふ、あははははははははは！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I aim to kill the petty hope of those who
search for it. Hehe... Hehehe... AHAHA!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
However, it seems my failing was killing
too many people!
fields.JP:
ところが、どうやら俺の失敗は、
人を殺しすぎたことのようだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, it seems my failing was killing
too many people!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
If I had allowed one hundred to live, then
perhaps they would have seen through your
purity. Everything would be different.
fields.JP:
きっと１００人も生かしておけば、
貴様らの純粋さを人々は呪い、妬み、
こんな風にはならなかっただろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I had allowed one hundred to live, then
perhaps they would have seen through your
purity. Everything would be different.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
The precious people you hope to save would
have been the same people to drag you back
down into Hell.
fields.JP:
貴様らが救いたかった奴らが、
貴様らを引きずり下ろしたはずなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The precious people you hope to save would
have been the same people to drag you back
down into Hell.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
That's right. You worthless pests would have
been ostracized.
fields.JP: そう、疎まれたのは貴様らゴミ虫の方だったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You worthless pests would have
been ostracized.

fields.EN:
That's no reason to kill innocent people!
Everyone deserves happiness!
fields.JP:
だからと言って、殺して踏みにじっていい
理由にはならないだろ！
誰もが根底は幸せになりたいはずなんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's no reason to kill innocent people!
Everyone deserves happiness!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Do you suggest we gather in a circle and
sing campfire songs? Hehehe. HAHAHAHA!
fields.JP:
だからみんななかよしこよしで
お話しましょうということか？
ふふっふはははははははは！！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you suggest we gather in a circle and
sing campfire songs? Hehehe. HAHAHAHA!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You are nothing more than bugs festering in
humanity's rotten corpses. You're maggots!
fields.JP:
やはり貴様らはまさに人類という腐乱した
身体に潜むゴミ虫……いや、蛆虫だ！！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are nothing more than bugs festering in
humanity's rotten corpses. You're maggots!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Hmph. I see there's no reaching you.
Aha... AHAHAHAHA!
fields.JP:
ふん……まあ、貴様らには理解できないだろうな
あは、あははははははっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. I see there's no reaching you.
Aha... AHAHAHAHA!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Ah, how could I forget? Harmless little bugs are always killed by humans without the slightest malice.
fields.JP:
ああ、なぜ忘れてしまったのだ、
害のないゴミ虫を殺すのはいつだって、
悪意のない人間だということを忘れていたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder how I forgot. Humans have been
atop for so long, it's easy to forget.

fields.JP: 待って、それ以上踏み出したら危険――

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: ハハハハハハ、ただ俺に後悔はない！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Because right here and now, I can kill the last innocent human who made me suffer!!
fields.JP:
なぜなら俺を苦しめた、最後の悪意のない
人間を今ここで、殺せるのだから！！
fields.LOCALIZED: I am the last in a long legacy of death.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
In this warped world, I alone know suffering
and therefore that makes me human!
fields.JP:
この歪な世界・生物たちの中で俺は誰よりも
人間らしく醜悪で、人間のまま命を遂行できるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
In this warped world, I alone know suffering
and therefore that makes me human!

fields.JP: あいつ……飛び降りやがった……

fields.EN: Damn it. I couldn't grab him!
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn it. I couldn't grab him!

fields.EN:
Why? Why would you destroy the planet
then kill yourself?!
fields.JP:
何でだよ、何で勝手に世界を破滅させて、
何で勝手に死んじゃうんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why? Why would you destroy the planet
then kill yourself?!

fields.EN: What the...! The tremors are getting worse!
fields.JP:
なっ……！
揺れがさっきより激しくなったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What the...! The tremors are getting worse!

fields.EN:
I see! The Witchcraft has been reborn, and
the Devouring Armada Tower is falling!
fields.JP:
そ、そうか……！
ウィッチクラフトが生まれて、
悪食の監隊塔が崩壊しようとしてるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see! The Witchcraft has been reborn, and
the Devouring Armada Tower is falling!

fields.EN: The quake's too strong. I can't stand... Aah!
fields.JP: 揺れが酷すぎて立っていられね――うわあぁっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: The quake's too strong. I can't stand... Aah!

fields.EN: Oh, thank goodness. You'll be fine, Mary.
fields.JP:
よかったわ、メアリーは
遠くに吹き飛ばされただけみたい
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, thank goodness. You'll be fine, Mary.

fields.EN:
Soon, this whole place is gonna come down
and kill us all.
fields.JP:
でもどうするの、このままじゃ
ここも崩れて全員死んじゃう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Soon, this whole place is gonna come down
and kill us all.

fields.EN: What do we do? How can I save everyone?
fields.JP: どうする……どうすればみんな助かる……
fields.LOCALIZED: What do we do? How can I save everyone?

fields.EN: Jack, you're closest to it. Make a wish.
fields.JP:
ジャック。ウィッチクラフトに
いちばん近い君が、願い事をするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, you're closest to it. Make a wish.

fields.EN: Yes, it won't hold much longer! Please!
fields.JP:
ああ。もういくらも持たない。
だから頼むよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, it won't hold much longer! Please!

fields.EN:
What if it doesn't understand me?!
What should I say?!
fields.JP:
でも、ウィッチクラフトは願い事を
どう解釈するか分からないんだよ！？
そんな中でどう願えば……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What if it doesn't understand me?!
What should I say?!

fields.JP: ぐあああああああああああっ！！
な、何やってんの！　ねえジュウ！！
ぐあああああああああああっ！！
な、何やってんの！　ねえジュウ！！

fields.EN:
You're touching the floor with both hands.
What are you trying to do?!
fields.JP:
そんな苦しそうにしてまで
床に両手で触れて、いったい何がしたいのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're touching the floor with both hands.
What are you trying to do?!

fields.EN: Are you trying to enter the tower's mind?!
fields.JP:
もしかして、悪食の監隊塔の
意識に入ろうとしている……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you trying to enter the tower's mind?!

fields.EN: If you do that, Juu-san, your consciousness...!
fields.JP:
そんなことしたら、
ジュウさんの意識が……！
fields.LOCALIZED: If you do that, your mind—
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Entering the consciousness of something like this is obviously dangerous!
fields.JP:
こんなものの意識の中に入るなんて、
絶対に危険に決まってますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are toying with powers beyond your
imagination!

fields.EN:
Juu! Listen to me! Don't do it!
You'll overexpose yourself!
fields.JP:
ジュウ、ねえジュウ！　もういいよ！
あんたが苦しんでまでしなくていいってばぁ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh! Listen to me! Don't do it!
You'll overexpose yourself!

fields.EN: I've put you all through so much.
fields.JP: ……君たちにはだいぶ苦労をかけた
fields.LOCALIZED: I've put you all through so much.

fields.JP: よかった、戻ってきたんですねジュウさ――

fields.EN:
You were forced to join a fake organization
called Dawn, risking your lives to kill Marchens.
All while captive inside of Jail.
fields.JP:
君たちは黎明という仮初めの組織に
入れられ、命懸けでメルヒェンを殺し、
知らずジェイルを育てさせられた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were forced to join a fake organization
called Dawn, risking your lives to kill Marchens.
All while captive inside of Jail.

fields.EN:
You were flung into battle without realizing
you were part of a larger, sinister plot.
You did so with pure hearts, full of justice.
fields.JP:
『ウィッチクラフト』を育てるため
とも知らず、純真な君たちは使命を信じ、
ひたすらに死地に身を投じた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were flung into battle without realizing
you were part of a larger, sinister plot.
You did so with pure hearts, full of justice.

fields.EN:
How painful it must have been for the person
who raised you to have manipulated you like
that.
fields.JP:
そんな使命を与えた保護者が、
裏切り者であったと知った時の君たちは、
いったいどんな思いだったのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
How painful it must have been for the person
who raised you to have manipulated you like
that.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: いつの間に蘇ったんですか！？

fields.EN:
That man called Snark was a monster.
He took advantage of others for personal gain,
all in the interest of finding his wife.
fields.JP:
スナークという男はクズだった。
自分の星のため、そして妻のため、手段を選ばず、
笑顔の練習をし、人心掌握に全身全霊を傾けた
fields.LOCALIZED:
That man called Snark was a monster.
He took advantage of others for personal gain,
all in the interest of finding his wife.

fields.EN:
Haha. Akazukin. I, well, we never had
a child.
fields.JP:
はは、赤ずきん、
私に……僕たち夫婦の間に、子どもはいない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Red Riding Hood. I, well, we never had
a child.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, Oyayubihime, Shirayukihime,
Cinderella, and Kaguyahime...
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、親指姫、白雪姫、
シンデレラ、そしてかぐや姫……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, Thumbelina, Snow White,
Cinderella, and Kaguya...

fields.EN: The path you've walked was never wrong. There was simply a great villain named Snark along the way, pretending to be kind.
fields.JP:
君たちが歩んできた道は、決して間違っていない。
ただその道の途中にスナークという、
優しいフリをした大悪人がいただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are guilty of nothing. Your fates were sealed
by an evil man who pretended to be kind.

fields.EN: I get it. Why I became a Blood Youth...
fields.JP:
分かったんだ。
僕が血式少年になった理由……
fields.LOCALIZED: I get it. Why I became a Blood Youth...

fields.EN:
It's because I was jealous of the person who
ruined this plan. All because of one human boy.
I was jealous of Jack.
fields.JP:
きっと、僕の計画を崩した者……
人間としての魅力に溢れた少年『ジャック』に、
僕は嫉妬していたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's because I was jealous of the person who
ruined this plan. All because of one human boy.
I was jealous of Jack.

fields.EN:
I tried so hard to understand humanity that I
nearly failed you. But Jack came in and got it
right straight away.
fields.JP:
僕が必死に人心掌握に力を入れて
ようやく繋ぎ止めていた君たちの心を、
ジャックはいとも簡単に手に入れた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I tried so hard to understand humanity that I
nearly failed you. But Jack came in and got it
right straight away.

fields.EN:
He mastered the charisma I had spent years
to perfect. You have no idea how envious I
was of him.
fields.JP:
長い年月の果てにようやく手に入れた
偽りの魅力を、彼はすでに持っていたんだ。
僕にはそれが、たまらなく羨ましかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
He mastered the charisma I had spent years
to perfect. You have no idea how envious I
was of him.

fields.EN: Haha... I am the biggest fool of all. Forgive me.
fields.JP:
はは……本当に馬鹿でクズで、
どうしようもない男だな、僕は
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha... I am the biggest fool of all. Forgive me.

fields.EN: Okay, Devouring Armada Tower. Let me in!
fields.JP:
さあ悪食の監隊塔！
僕を中に入れてもらうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, Devouring Armada Tower. Let me in!

fields.JP: おおおおおおおおおおおッ！！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: 待って下さいジュウさん！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu
Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
I apologize to you all. I'm grateful for the time
we had together.
fields.JP:
すまなかった、みんな
君たちに会えて、よかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I apologize to you all. I'm grateful for the time
we had together.

fields.EN: So...I'm inside the mind of the tower.
fields.JP: これが悪食の監隊塔の……精神の中……
fields.LOCALIZED: So...I'm inside the mind of the tower.

fields.EN:
*gasp*! This is overwhelming. Waves of emotion.
The cascading sorrow, the anguish.
fields.JP:
くっ……すごいな、まるで感情の海だ。
それも悲しみや嘆きばかりの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*gasp*! This is overwhelming. Waves of emotion.
The cascading sorrow, the anguish.

fields.EN:
People screaming. Lives screaming.
Marchens screaming. Nightmares screaming.
fields.JP:
人の悲鳴、生き物の悲鳴、
メルヒェンの悲鳴、ナイトメアの悲鳴……
fields.LOCALIZED:
People screaming. Lives screaming.
Marchens screaming. Nightmares screaming.

fields.EN:
This tower was built brick by brick from
numerous regrets, pains, and grudges.
fields.JP:
すべての生きとし生けるものの後悔と
憎しみと怨念で、この監隊塔はできていたのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
This tower was built brick by brick from
numerous regrets, pains, and grudges.

fields.EN:
This is bad. I'm being engulfed by the pain.
If I lose my concentration, I'll drown.
fields.JP:
まずいな、剥き出しの感情が
波となって打ちつけてくる……
気を抜けば押し潰されてしまいそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is bad. I'm being engulfed by the pain.
If I lose my concentration, I'll drown.

fields.EN: But I sense her. My wife is here somewhere.
fields.JP:
でも、気配を感じる。
妻は間違いなく、ここにいる
fields.LOCALIZED: But I sense her. My wife is here somewhere.

fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔だったんだ

fields.EN: The AI in all the towers.
fields.JP: この全ての監獄塔のＡＩだったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: The AI in all the towers.

fields.EN: Why did you lie like that?
fields.JP: ナゼ、アンナウソヲツイタノデスカ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why did you lie like that?

fields.EN: Long white hair, and a golden barrette.
fields.JP: 白く長い髪の毛に、金色のバレッタ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Long white hair, and a golden barrette.

fields.EN:
Slow and steady wins the race, like you always
said. I did it so they could proceed.
fields.JP:
君の言う『急がば回れ』というやつだよ。
あの子たちが前に進むためさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Slow and steady wins the race, like you always
said. I did it so they could proceed.

fields.EN: Haste makes waste. Is that right?
fields.JP:
セイテハ　コト　ヲ　シソンジル
トイウコトデスネ
fields.LOCALIZED: Haste makes waste. Is that right?

fields.EN: Hehe. Is that how you say it down here?
fields.JP: ふふっ……こっちではそんな言い方をするのか
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Is that how you say it down here?

fields.EN: My, you haven't changed a bit.
fields.JP: ――もう、本当にあなたは不器用な人ね
fields.LOCALIZED: My, you haven't changed a bit.

fields.EN: Ha, you think? I beg to differ.
fields.JP:
そうかな。自分では
だいぶ器用になったと思ったのだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ha, you think? I beg to differ.

fields.EN:
You still have a long way to go.
Learn to embrace your feelings.
fields.JP:
まだまだですよ。
もっと素直に伝えていいんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
You still have a long way to go.
Learn to embrace your feelings.

fields.EN: Right... Hm. Even now, you teach me so much.
fields.JP:
そうか……
まったく、君には教えられてばっかりだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Right... Hm. Even now, you teach me so much.

fields.EN:
You can't fool me. I see right through you.
You're safe with me.
fields.JP:
でも、どんな不器用な言葉でも、
私だけはちゃんと分かっていますから。
だから、もう悩まないで下さいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't fool me. I see right through you.
You're safe with me.

fields.EN: There's so much I wanted to tell you.
fields.JP:
僕は、君に会ったら話そうと
思ってたことがたくさんあるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: There's so much I wanted to tell you.

fields.EN:
Then why don't you join me, and we can take our
time starting from the top?
fields.JP:
それじゃあその話は、
こっちへ来てゆっくり話しましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then why don't you join me, and we can take our
time starting from the top?

fields.EN:
I have searched all over for you. Yearning for
you. You are my everything.
fields.JP:
ずっと君を探していた。
かけがえのない君を、いつだって求め続けた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have searched all over for you. Yearning for
you. You are my everything.

fields.EN:
But to do so...I went rogue, and strayed from
my path.
fields.JP: だが、そのために道を踏み外してしまった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But to do so...I went rogue, and strayed from
my path.

fields.EN:
From now on, we'll be together forever.
All of your suffering is mine too. I shall help you
bear this great burden.
fields.JP:
これからはずっと一緒です。
その後悔も苦悩も、半分に分け合って
一緒に背負っていきましょう、あなた
fields.LOCALIZED:
From now on, we'll be together forever.
All of your suffering is mine too. I shall help you
bear this great burden.

fields.JP: ああ、本当にありがとう……
会いたかったよ――『チェシャラエミィ』

fields.EN: The tremors are beginning to stop...
fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔の揺れが、収まりました……
fields.LOCALIZED: The tremors are beginning to stop...

fields.JP: ジュウさんがやってくれたんですのね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: ありがとうジュウ。……ジュウ？

fields.EN: Hey, come on. Wake up. Hey!
fields.JP:
ちょっと、起きなさいよジュウ。
ねえってば
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, come on. Wake up. Hey!

fields.JP:
ジュウさん……
逝ってしまったんですか……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: いやジュウ、ありがとう……

fields.EN:
I'll never let anyone determine my fate again.
I'll live my own life, no matter what.
fields.JP:
もうあたしは誰の人生にも縛られない。
何があろうと、あたしはあたしの人生を生きるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll never let anyone determine my fate again.
I'll live my own life, no matter what.

fields.EN: The tower's beginning to calm down.
fields.JP: 悪食の監隊塔の揺れが収まった……
fields.LOCALIZED: The tower's beginning to calm down.

fields.JP: 本当だ。どうしてだろう？

fields.EN:
Jack! It was Juu! He stopped the earthquake!
Make your wish now!
fields.JP:
ジャック！　揺れはジュウが……ジュウが
抑えてくれたよ！　だから今のうちに早く
ウィッチクラフトに願いを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! It was Toh! He stopped the earthquake!
