Make your wish now!

fields.JP:
彼が？
いったいどうやって……

fields.EN:
That doesn't matter. The tower's finally holding
together, but that moon's still coming right for
us!
fields.JP:
それは今はいいわ。監隊塔の揺れは収まったけど、
いまだ月が落ちてくる未来に変わりはない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't matter. The tower's finally holding
together, but that moon's still coming right for
us!

fields.EN:
She's right! Come on, Jack! The world's
depending on you!
fields.JP:
そうだね。ジャック、頼む！
このままじゃすべてが無駄になる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right! Come on, Jack! The world's
depending on you!

fields.EN:
But...that's so much responsibility.
Are you sure...?
fields.JP:
でも……そんな大役、
僕なんかが引き受けてしまっていいのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...that's so much responsibility.
Are you sure...?

fields.EN: It has to be you, Jack.
fields.JP: わたしは、ジャックにお願いしたい
fields.LOCALIZED: It has to be you, Jack.

fields.EN:
You put everyone else first. You've been fighting
for us since day one.
fields.JP:
誰よりもみんなのことを考えて、
必死に抗ってきたのはジャックだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You put everyone else first. You've been fighting
for us since day one.

fields.EN: B-But isn't that true of everyone?
fields.JP: そ、それはみんなだってそうじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED: I just did what I was supposed to...

fields.EN:
No, Jack. You are a savior to the wounded
and to those with shaken faith.
fields.JP:
いいえ。ジャックは傷ついた人を、
挫けそうな人をいつだって助けてくれたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, Jack. You are a savior to the wounded
and to those with shaken faith.

fields.EN:
Myself included. If it wasn't for you, I never
would have made it this far.
fields.JP:
もちろん、わたしもそのひとり。
あなたがいなければ、きっとここまで
来ることはできなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Myself included. If it wasn't for you, I never
would have made it this far.

fields.EN:
I second that. You helped us realize our own
strength. Your bravery paved the way for us all.
fields.JP:
その通りだ。　僕達のような力がないのに、
いつも命がけで懸命に僕たちを助け、導いてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I second that. You helped us realize our own
strength. Your bravery paved the way for us all.

fields.EN:
Beyond that, in another timeline, I gained back
my memories and became a Nightmare, but you
offered me your hand. I'll never forget that.
fields.JP:
何より世界を超えて記憶を取り戻し、
ナイトメアになった僕に手を差し伸べて
くれたこと、僕は一生忘れない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beyond that, in another timeline, I gained back
my memories and became a Nightmare, but you
offered me your hand. I'll never forget that.

fields.EN:
You created a future where I could live with
everyone. You have that gift. I entrust you
with everything.
fields.JP:
僕にみんなと生きる未来をくれた
ジャックになら、僕はすべてを託せるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You created a future where I could live with
everyone. You have that gift. I entrust you
with everything.

fields.EN: Without you Jack-san, I wouldn't have made it.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがいなかったら、
わたしはこの世界では死んでいたんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Without you Jack, I wouldn't have made it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Even in the other world, Jack-san, you were a
Nightmare and still managed to protect
everyone.
fields.JP:
それにジャックさんは、
もう１つの世界では自分がナイトメアになっても
みんなを守ろうとしてくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even in the other world, Jack, you were a
Nightmare and still managed to protect
everyone.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: So I'm behind you all the way, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
だからわたしも、そんな
優しいジャックさんにお願いしたいな
fields.LOCALIZED: So I'm behind you all the way, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Me too. You've protected Alice ever since we were
trapped in the Underground Jail, Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
私も。ジャックくんは地下監獄に
囚われている時から、ずっとずっと
アリスを守ってくれていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Me too. You've protected Alice ever since we
were imprisoned in Jail.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
When we reached the surface, you conquered
every challenge in front of us. You never lost
hope.
fields.JP:
そして地上に来て、もっと酷いことが起きても、
決して諦めずにみんなを導いてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we reached the surface, you conquered
every challenge in front of us. You never lost
hope.

fields.EN:
You even welcomed me and Mary into your
group. Now I have a whole family to call my
own.
fields.JP:
その中に、メアリーと私も入れてくれて……
おかげで私は愛する妹たちの笑顔を
そばで見ていられたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You even welcomed me and Mary into your
group. Now I have a whole family to call my
own.

fields.EN:
If it's you, Jack-kun... I think you can grasp a
wonderful future, more than anyone.
fields.JP:
私はそんなジャックくんなら……って思う。
君ならきっと、他の誰より素敵な未来を掴めるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the leader you are. I'm sure whatever
future you envision will suit all of us.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN: Me too! I believe in you Jack!
fields.JP: 私も！　ジャックなら絶対できるって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Me too! I believe in you Jack!

fields.EN:
I mean, we broke out of the underground Jail
together!
fields.JP:
だってあの絶望的な
地下監獄を脱獄できたんだもん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, we broke out of the underground Jail
together!

fields.EN:
Also! If I'm being honest, it doesn't look like
we've gotten much better at avoiding danger!
fields.JP:
でね！　あっちとこっち、
ぶっちゃけたいして絶望感変わんないと思うの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Also! If I'm being honest, it doesn't look like
we've gotten much better at avoiding danger!

fields.JP: それはぶっちゃけすぎでは……

fields.EN:
HURRY UP ALREADY! THE MOON IS HEAVY!
PLEASE, JUST HURRY!
fields.JP:
ってか月がね、重いの～～～～！
お願い早く～～～～っ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
HURRY UP ALREADY! THE MOON IS HEAVY!
PLEASE, JUST HURRY!

fields.EN: Ouch. Damn it. I really slammed my behind.
fields.JP:
ったたたた……くそっ、
吹っ飛ばされてケツ打っちまったぜ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ouch. Damn it. I really slammed my behind.

fields.EN: Huh? That's a match. You're running out.
fields.JP:
え、これってマッチ棒じゃないか。
それもこんなに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? That's a match. You're running out.

fields.EN:
I don't wanna die, so I'll leave one for myself,
but you can have the rest.
fields.JP:
さすがに死にたくねえから
１本は残しておくけど、残りは全部くれてやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't wanna die, so I'll leave one for myself,
but you can have the rest.

fields.EN: You think I wanna die like this?
fields.JP:
ま、俺だってこんな風に
死にたいわけじゃねえしな
fields.LOCALIZED: You think I wanna die like this?

fields.EN:
Honestly, until recently, I didn't care much if
I died. Nothing ever happened in my life.
fields.JP:
……実はまあ、最近まで
いつ死んでも別にいいやって思ってたんだ。
特に人生、面白いこともなかったしさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, until recently, I didn't care much if
I died. Nothing ever happened in my life.

fields.EN:
I figured it'd all come to an end eventually.
My only regret was not hugging Charlotte
more. That's about it.
fields.JP:
自分から死なねえのは、面倒くせえから、
あとシャーロットのおっぱいに未練があった、
そんなもんだったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured it'd all come to an end eventually.
My only regret was not hugging Charlotte
more. That's about it.

fields.EN:
But when I was almost murdered the other day,
I realized that's not what I wanted at all.
fields.JP:
でもこの間殺されそうになってよ。
殺されるのは嫌だなって思ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when I was almost murdered the other day,
I realized that's not what I wanted at all.

fields.EN:
There's nothing wrong with dying,
but I know now I've got a whole lot
to live for.
fields.JP:
惰性で生きるのも惰性で死ぬのもありだが、
死ぬときは俺は俺の死を死にたいんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing wrong with dying,
but I know now I've got a whole lot
to live for.

fields.EN: Here, I'll hold the matchbox, so strike one. When you do, put everything you're imagining into it.
fields.JP:
ほら、俺がマッチ箱持っててやるから擦れ。
いいか、擦る時にお前が頭ん中で
想像したこと、全部ぶち込むんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here, I'll hold the matchbox. Light it.
Listen to me. When you do, think of what you
want most, and reach for it.

fields.EN:
That'd probably boost the Witchcraft's effect
through the roof too.
fields.JP:
きっとその方がウィッチクラフトの
効果も爆上がりすんだろ
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: よし、それじゃあみんな、見守ってて

fields.EN:
(It's my first time here. For some reason, I feel
so calm. It looks like a baby...)
fields.JP:
（初めて目の前に立つけど、
　とても大きくて不思議とどこか安心する。
　まるで胎児のような印象というか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's my first time here. For some reason, I feel
so calm. It looks like a baby...)

fields.EN:
(Gatou came so close, but didn't even see his
dream realized.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、願いが叶うかもしれないのに、
　賀東はよく見向きもしなかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gato came so close, but didn't even see his
dream realized.)
fields.notes: Source surname romanization: 賀東 => Gatou
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I'm not like any of you! I am human!
I have used and destroyed this world with my
own hands. Hundreds of lives can attest to that.
fields.JP:
俺は貴様らとは違う！　人間だ！
人間としてこの世界を利用し、破壊し、
そして多くを殺してきた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not like any of you! I am human!
I have used and destroyed this world with my
own hands. Hundreds of lives can attest to that.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You think I need this to become a god?!
You're gravely mistaken!
fields.JP:
それなのに化け物の力を欲する！？
そんな安易で馬鹿げたものに頼るなど、
ゴミ虫がすることだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think I need this to become a god?!
You're gravely mistaken!

fields.EN: I know what you wanted all along...
fields.JP:
きっとあなたも、最初からこんな結末を
望んでいたわけじゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I know what you wanted all along...

fields.EN: You never meant any ill will, you weren't evil.
fields.JP:
何かを欲しがっていたわけでも
誰かを憎んでいたわけでもない
fields.LOCALIZED: You never meant any ill will, you weren't evil.

fields.EN:
You were just in pain. So desperate, so hurt,
trying to beat on...
fields.JP:
ただ、苦しくて悲しくて、
必死で足掻いていただけ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were just in pain. So desperate, so hurt,
trying to beat on...

fields.JP: ウィッチクラフトよ！　僕の願いは――
マモル、そっち持ってー

fields.EN:
All right! Toss it on the count of two.
ONE, TWO, GO!
fields.JP:
おう！　じゃ、せーので
こっちに積み上げるぞ。せーの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All right! Toss it on the count of two.
ONE, TWO, GO!

fields.EN:
Hey, lookin' pretty good. We've gathered
a lot of wood.
fields.JP:
おっけー、いい感じ。
だいぶ木材溜まってきたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, lookin' pretty good. We've gathered
a lot of wood.

fields.EN: Even so, it's only enough for one cabin.
fields.JP:
って言っても、
まだまだ小屋１つ分にすらほど遠いけどな
fields.LOCALIZED: Even so, it's only enough for one cabin.

fields.EN:
*pant, pant*... This is taking forever.
I'm getting dizzy!
fields.JP:
ぜぇ……ぜぇ……
気が遠くなる作業だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant*... This is taking forever.
I'm getting dizzy!

fields.EN: Icchan, hang in there! We're almost done!
fields.JP:
イっちゃん、しっかり！
もうちょっとで休憩だから～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Icchan, hang in there! We're almost done!

fields.EN:
Hey, thanks for all your hard work!
I brought some tea.
fields.JP:
みんな、お疲れさま！
お茶持ってきたよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, thanks for all your hard work!
I brought some tea.

fields.EN:
Itsuki looks exhausted, typical.
How's it going, gang?
fields.JP:
予想通りイツキへばってんねー。
で、進み具合はどう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Itsuki looks exhausted, typical.
How's it going, gang?

fields.EN: I'd call it a massive step forward for mankind.
fields.JP:
人類は果てしない一歩を踏み出した、
ってところだな
fields.LOCALIZED: I'd call it a massive step forward for mankind.

fields.EN: I never knew how tough it was to build a house.
fields.JP:
家一軒建てるのが、
こんな大変だとは思わなかったね
fields.LOCALIZED: I never knew how tough it was to build a house.

fields.EN:
Cutting lumber and transporting it is one thing,
but we only have one usable saw.
fields.JP:
木の伐採や運搬の大変さもさることながら、
まずノコギリひとつまともにねえからな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cutting lumber and transporting it is one thing,
but we only have one usable saw.

fields.JP: 途方もない話に聞こえるわねー

fields.EN:
If only Hikari was still an angel. She could just
levitate this stuff for us. Mind giving us a hand,
Hikari?
fields.JP:
ヒカリがまだ天使だったら、
材木だってちょちょいと浮かせて……
なあ、お前もう１回天使になってくんね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only Hikari was still an angel. She could just
levitate this stuff for us. Mind giving us a hand,
Hikari?

fields.EN:
That'd be a piece of cake for you.
I heard you lifted the moon.
fields.JP:
確かにあの力があれば楽にはなるな。
聞けば月を止めたそうじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED:
That'd be a piece of cake for you.
I heard you lifted the moon.

fields.EN:
My, when did you get so strong?
I'm impressed!
fields.JP:
まったく、いつの間にそんなに力持ちに……
あちし感動だわ～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, when did you get so strong?
I'm impressed!

fields.EN:
Oh, so now it's all on me? Everyone else is
normal now too!
fields.JP:
あ、そーゆーこと言っちゃう？
みんなだって普通の人間に戻ったくせにー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, so now it's all on me? Everyone else is
normal now too!

fields.EN:
Seriously. How weird. All of the Jails have been
wiped off the planet too, but we're still here.
fields.JP:
ね、不思議よねー。
監獄塔が世界から完全になくなったのに、
まさか生きてるなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously. How weird. All of the Jails have been
wiped off the planet too, but we're still here.

fields.EN:
I can't tell you how it happened, but we should
just run with it.
fields.JP:
何でそうなったのか分かんねーけど、
ラッキーってことでいいじゃねーか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't tell you how it happened, but we should
just run with it.

fields.EN:
Good idea. We're just grateful for all the times
your powers saved our skins.
fields.JP:
ま、そうね。ただその分、
これまであたしたちがいかに特別な力に
助けられてきたかも実感しちゃうけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Good idea. We're just grateful for all the times
your powers saved our skins.

fields.EN:
Hikari's not the only one. Same thing happened
to the Blood Maidens too.
fields.JP:
ヒカリもそうだけど、
血式少女のみんなもだもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hikari's not the only one. Same thing happened
to the Blood Maidens too.

fields.EN:
Yep. The once-powerful Blood Maidens are now
ordinary girls.
fields.JP:
ああ。人並み外れた力を持ってた
血式少女のみんなも、今ではすっかり
普通の人間の女性になってしまったからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yep. The once-powerful Blood Maidens are now
ordinary girls.

fields.JP: 私は前となんにも変わらないわよ？

fields.EN: Hahaha. I'll say. You're the same as ever.
fields.JP:
あはは、タクミはほんと、
驚くほど変わってないよね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. I'll say. You're the same as ever.

fields.JP: 人に言われると何かショック！

fields.EN: Well, us men gotta step up now!
fields.JP: ま、俺たち男子チームが頑張らねーとな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, us men gotta step up now!

fields.EN:
Anyway, let's hurry and get this civilization thing
on the road. If not, I'll collapse...
fields.JP:
とにかく早く文明レベルを上げよう。
そうしないと僕が倒れてしまう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, let's hurry and get this civilization thing
on the road. If not, I'll collapse...

fields.EN:
Hehe. You've always had more brain than
brawns.
fields.JP: くくっ、あんたは頭脳労働専門だもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. You've always had more brain than
brawns.

fields.EN: Which is gonna fall first? Itsuki, or the tree?
fields.JP:
イツキが倒れるのが先か、
木が倒れるのが先か……だね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Which is gonna fall first? Itsuki, or the tree?

fields.JP: 上手いこと言えてねーからな？

fields.EN:
Oh. I forgot I was going to ask Haru-san for some
concrete materials. I'm gonna look into it!
fields.JP:
あっ！　僕この後ハルさんたちと
コンクリート素材を作るための
調査に行くんだった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I forgot I was going to ask Haru for some
concrete materials. I'm gonna look into it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
You've got your hands full, Jack.
We'll handle this. Go on ahead.
fields.JP:
お前も色々と大変だなあ、ジャック。
こっちは俺たちでやっとくから、
気にせず行ってこい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got your hands full, Jack.
We'll handle this. Go on ahead.

fields.EN:
Just gotta mix in the caustic limestone we
found at the bottom of the ocean.
...Hey Jack, you're recording this, right?
fields.JP:
ここで海底から取ってきた石灰を混ぜて、と……
おいジャック、記録取ってるな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just gotta mix in the caustic limestone we
found at the bottom of the ocean.
...Hey Jack, you're recording this, right?

fields.EN:
Yup, you know it. This is incredible.
That mixture's perfect.
fields.JP:
はい、バッチリです。
すごいですね、ちょっとずつ割合変えてて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yup, you know it. This is incredible.
That mixture's perfect.

fields.EN:
The key is in the timing. Add only a little bit at
a time. *sigh* What do you think, Miko?
fields.JP:
ベストなもん作るには地道な作業を
するしかねえからな。どうだ視子、今度の出来は
fields.LOCALIZED:
The key is in the timing. Add only a little bit at
a time. *sigh* What do you think, Miko?

fields.EN:
Hm. You've got the right materials, but the
quality is inconsistent.
fields.JP:
うーん、材料も分量も合ってはいるけど、
やっぱりさっきからムラがあるのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. You've got the right materials, but the
quality is inconsistent.

fields.EN:
Maybe it's how I mixed it. Back to the drawing
board, I guess...
fields.JP:
かき混ぜ方とかあんのかね……
やっぱなかなか上手くできねえもんだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe it's how I mixed it. Back to the drawing
board, I guess...

fields.EN:
Well, maybe we can use it for something else.
Shoot, we're almost out of materials.
fields.JP:
これはこれで何かに活用するとして……
もう材料がなくなってしまったな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, maybe we can use it for something else.
Shoot, we're almost out of materials.

fields.EN: Aw, man. Do I gotta do another supply run?
fields.JP:
うへぇ、また素材集めに
行かなきゃいけないんっすかあ
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, man. Do I gotta do another supply run?

fields.EN:
Quit complaining. Trial and error's all part of it.
I'll go with you, come on.
fields.JP:
仕方ねえだろ、こういうのは
トライアンドエラーの繰り返しだ。
ほら、俺も一緒に行ってやるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Quit complaining. Trial and error's all part of it.
I'll go with you, come on.

fields.EN:
Really Boss?! Heck yeah. Gotta make up for lost
time. I'll show you how much I've learned.
fields.JP:
マジっすか師匠！
よーし、離ればなれになってた分、
活躍してるところを見せるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really Boss?! Heck yeah. Gotta make up for lost
time. I'll show you how much I've learned.

fields.EN: Hey, not you! Seriously, read the room!
fields.JP:
いやアニキは来なくていいっす！
空気読むっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, not you! Seriously, read the room!

fields.EN:
Hehehe. Their banter makes me smile.
At last we can breathe.
fields.JP:
ふふ、こんなのどかなやり取りができるなんて、
ほんと平和になってよかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. Their banter makes me smile.
At last we can breathe.

fields.EN:
Yes. It's nice to not stress about defeating this
or protecting that.
fields.JP:
ええ、倒すとか守るとかで
悩まなくていいのは幸せなことよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. It's nice to not stress about defeating this
or protecting that.

fields.JP: ね、姉さん何やってるの！
ん？　どうしたんだろ

fields.EN: Don't subject yourself to manual labor like this!
fields.JP:
姉さんはそんな力仕事、
無理してしなくていいんだって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't subject yourself to manual labor like this!

fields.EN:
Chii, you're such a worrywart. I'm not subjecting
myself to anything. I'm doing my part.
fields.JP:
ちーちゃんは心配性だね。
わたしは無理なんてしてないよ？
だからいっぱい働けるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chii, you're such a worrywart. I'm not subjecting
myself to anything. I'm doing my part.

fields.notes: Source honorific replaces localized English title: ミチル様 => Michiru-sama (remove localized English title)

fields.EN:
Ugh. Enough with the lady routine. Oomph.
Oomph.
fields.JP:
もう『様』はいいのにー。
よいしょ、よいしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Enough with the lady routine. Oomph.
Oomph.

fields.JP: ああもう、僕がやるから！
千昭さんは相変わらずだなあ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 千昭さん => Chiaki-san

fields.EN:
Never thought I'd see Lady Oohime herself
working with her hands.
fields.JP:
でも大陽女さんがこんな頑張るなんて、
ちょっと意外だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never thought I'd see Lady Oohime herself
working with her hands.

fields.EN: Yeah. She's better than I thought.
fields.JP:
ええ。あんな活発な人だったなんて
思わなかったです
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. She's better than I thought.

fields.EN: Me too! That's a new discovery!
fields.JP: 自分もっす！　新しい発見っす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Me too! That's a new discovery!

fields.EN:
Okay, that should be good for today.
Jack, aren't you needed elsewhere?
fields.JP:
ま、何にせよ今日はそろそろ終わりましょうか。
ジャック、あなた何か呼ばれてるんでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay, that should be good for today.
Jack, aren't you needed elsewhere?

fields.EN:
Oh shoot! It's getting late, I gotta dash!
Sorry guys, see you later!
fields.JP:
そうだった！　もう夕方だし行かなきゃ！
すいません、お先に失礼します！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh shoot! It's getting late, I gotta dash!
Sorry guys, see you later!

fields.JP: あ、ジャック早くーーー！
やっときた！　じゃっくー！

fields.EN: I won't let you go, Rapu!
fields.LOCALIZED: I won't let you go, Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Hehe. I win. Hey Jack! You're it!
fields.JP:
ふふーん、あたしの勝ちっ。
ジャック―はいタッチ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I win. Hey Jack! You're it!

fields.JP:
わ、赤ずきんさん、
いきなり触ってきてどうしたんですか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa, Red Riding Hood! What gives?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Sorry, sorry. I was playing with Rapu.
You don't wanna?
fields.JP:
ごめんごめん、ラプとゲームをしててさ
嫌？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, sorry. I was playing with Rappy.
You don't wanna?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: 嫌じゃない、嫌じゃないけど！

fields.EN: Don't be naïve, Rapu. First come, first serve!
fields.JP: 甘いよラプ、早い者勝ちだかんね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be naïve, Rappy. First come, first serve!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(According to everyone, Akazukin-san seemed
freed at last from the burden of her past.
She's become her normal self.)
fields.JP:
（みんなが言うには、あれから赤ずきんさんは、
　何か気負っていたものがなくなったのか、
　自然体でいるようになったとのことらしい）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(According to everyone, Red Riding Hood seemed
freed at last from the burden of her past.
She's become her normal self.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Even so, everyone says they love Akazukin-san just
the way she is.)
fields.JP:
（それでもみんなそんな赤ずきんさんも
　好きだと言っている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But that never stopped anyone from loving
her all the same.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English direct/third-person grammar (B10).

fields.EN:
(The other day, Akazukin-san told me with a shy smile
that she'd started thinking about what suits her and
what doesn't.)
fields.JP:
（そう、この間、赤ずきんさんに、
　『少し自分の向き不向きを考えるように
　なったんだ』と、はにかみながら言われた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The other day, she told me with a smile that
she's started to think about what she's good
at, and what she struggles with.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(It was a refreshing sight. Maybe I'm crazy,
but I didn't notice too much of a difference
in her.)
fields.JP:
（どうやら色々と無理をしていた、
　ということのようだ。ただ僕は鈍感なのか
　実はあまり変化に気が付けてない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It was a refreshing sight. Maybe I'm crazy,
but I didn't notice too much of a difference
in her.)

fields.EN:
Jack, how long do you plan to keep us waiting?
We're taking a picture. Come here.
fields.JP:
ジャック、いつまでボサッとしてるの。
写真撮るんだから早くこっちに来なさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, how long do you plan to keep us waiting?
We're taking a picture. Come here.

fields.EN:
Who would have thought we'd ever get to
take a picture again...?
fields.JP:
それにしても、こんな崩壊した世界で
写真を撮ることができるなんて、
思ってもみなかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who would have thought we'd ever get to
take a picture again...?

fields.EN: Seriously! Thanks for finding this camera, Gretel!
fields.JP:
ほんとだよね！　グレーテル、
カメラを見つけてくれてありがと！
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously! Thanks for finding this camera, Gretel!

fields.EN:
I repaired it somewhat, but it's ancient.
We may only be able to take a few photos.
fields.JP:
なんとか直してはみたけど、まあボロボロね。
だから何回かしか撮れないかもしれないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I repaired it somewhat, but it's ancient.
We may only be able to take a few photos.

fields.EN: How interesting... I must be on camera.
fields.JP: それは貴重ね……ちゃんと写らなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED: How interesting... I must be on camera.

fields.JP: ドキドキしますね、親指姉様、ネムちゃん！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Can't wait to see how they turn out!
fields.JP: 出来上がりが楽しみですわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't wait to see how they turn out!

fields.JP: わらわは別に興味ないですけど～

fields.EN: Yeah, right. I saw you fixing your hair.
fields.JP:
何言ってんのよ、
しっかり身だしなみ整えてたじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, right. I saw you fixing your hair.

fields.EN: No fair. You mustn't reveal my secrets.
fields.JP: そ、それを言うのはズルいです～
fields.LOCALIZED: No fair. You mustn't reveal my secrets.

fields.EN:
Oh, how exciting. When the photograph develops,
I'm going to display it where everyone can see it♪
fields.JP:
あーわたしも楽しみだなあ。
ふふ、写真が出来上がったら、
いちばん目立つところに貼ろっと♪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, how exciting. When the photograph develops,
I'm going to display it where everyone can see it♪

fields.JP:
あれ、おつうちゃん、
なんか身体の動きが硬いけどどうしたの？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
This is my first time having a photo taken,
so I'm nervous.
fields.JP:
僕、写真撮るの初めてだから、
何か緊張しちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my first time having a photo taken,
so I'm nervous.

fields.EN:
Ha. It's your first time, Otsuu? Then look no
further than the expert poser.
fields.JP:
ふっ、おつうは初めてか。
ならば我が正しい写り方を教えてやろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha. It's your first time, Otsuu? Then look no
further than the expert poser.

fields.JP: ハーちゃん、写真撮ったことあるの？

fields.EN:
I haven't, but I've read several manga detailing
the practice! The general rule of thumb is to
jump in the middle! That's what we should do!
fields.JP:
それはないが、昔拾ったマンガで読んだのだ。
こういうのはど真ん中でジャンプ！
これで決まりよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I haven't, but I've read several manga detailing
the practice! The general rule of thumb is to
jump in the middle! That's what we should do!

fields.JP: ふはは、我に死角はないのだー！

ちょっとめるん、
じゃんぷしないでー！
ハーメルン、あたしたちにかぶってるってば

fields.EN: Oh, you don't get it Merun...
fields.JP:
なんだ、ハーメルンも
分かってないじゃないか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, you don't get it Hammy...

fields.EN: That's not true. I tyotally know!
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことはないのだ！
我はちゃんと知っているにょら！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's nyot true. I tyotally doooo!

fields.EN: Hameln, either sit still or stand in the back.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン、いいからあなたは
おとなしくするか後ろに行きなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Hameln, either sit still or stand in the back.

fields.EN: Okay, fine. Don't give me that look...
fields.JP:
わ、分かったのだ、
だからそんな顔をするでない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, fine. Don't give me that look...

fields.EN:
Say, does anyone know where Alice-san, Mary-san,
Charlotte-san, and Shira-san are...?
fields.JP:
そういえばアリスさんとメアリーさんと
シャーロットさん、それにシラさんも遅いですね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Say, does anyone know where Alice, Mary,
Charlotte, and Pyre are...?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san; アリスさん => Alice-san; メアリーさん => Mary-san; シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: I told them the time. Maybe they forgot?
fields.JP:
あれ、時間はちゃんと伝えてたんだけど、
忘れちゃってんのかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: I told them the time. Maybe they forgot?

fields.EN: I'll call them. Just hang on!
fields.JP:
それじゃ僕が呼んでくるよ。
みんな、ちょっと待ってて！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll call them. Just hang on!

fields.EN:
You think I'm amazing? Me, a hero?
Oh. Wanna know the details?
I mean, if you insist...
fields.JP:
いやー俺ってばマジですごくね？　英雄じゃね？
え、詳しく聞かせてほしい？　ったく、仕方ねえな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think I'm amazing? Me, a hero?
Oh. Wanna know the details?
I mean, if you insist...

fields.EN:
Between you and me, you see...I kinda saved
the world.
fields.JP:
実はここだけの話……俺、
ちょっと世界救っちゃったんすよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Between you and me, you see...I kinda saved
the world.

fields.EN:
Haha! No, seriously! Everyone survived all thanks
to me! Huh? Oh stop it. You flatter me...
fields.JP:
なんてな！　いやでも、
本当に俺のおかげで全員助かったしな！
え？　やめろよ、そんなに称えるなよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha! No, seriously! Everyone survived all thanks
to me! Huh? Oh stop it. You flatter me...

fields.JP: メアリー、ここにいるかい？
どわわわ！　ジャック！？

fields.EN:
Ah, I knew that was you. Come on, Mary.
We're taking pictures, remember? Let's go!
fields.JP:
あ、やっぱいた。ほらメアリー、
写真撮るって話聞いてただろう？　行くよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, I knew that was you. Come on, Mary.
We're taking pictures, remember? Let's go!

fields.EN: Oh, did you see me just now?
fields.JP: おっ、おお、お前、今の見てたりしたか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, did you see me just now?

fields.EN: Just now? Yeah, you seemed to be talking to yourself, but I wasn't watching.
fields.JP:
今の？　ああ、なんか１人で
喋ってたみたいだけど、見てはいないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just now? Only that you were muttering,
but I couldn't hear what.

fields.EN: Close call... Thought he heard me daydreaming.
fields.JP:
っぶねー……
妄想に耽ってんの見られたかと思ったぜ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Close call... Thought he heard me daydreaming.

fields.EN:
Hey Jack, didn't anyone ever teach you to knock?!
What if I was indisposed or something?
fields.JP:
つーかジャック、
お前勝手に入ってくんのやめろよな。
どうすんだ俺が１人でエロいことしてたら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Jack, didn't anyone ever teach you to knock?!
What if I was indisposed or something?

fields.JP: いや、そしたら謝るけど……

fields.EN: Anyway, you should focus on your studies.
fields.JP:
それより、君はもう少し
品性を知った方がいいと思うよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, you should focus on your studies.

fields.EN:
Hmph. But nothing I study compares to my
daydreams. Who needs it?!
fields.JP:
けっ、品性知ってたって
俺の妄想どおりの世界になるわけでもねーし、
そんなもんはいらん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. But nothing I study compares to my
daydreams. Who needs it?!

fields.EN:
What am I gonna do with you?
You always have a response...
fields.JP: もー、ああ言えばこう言う……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What am I gonna do with you?
You always have a response...

fields.EN: Anyway! Everyone's waiting, so hurry up!
fields.JP:
とにかく！
みんな待ってるから、急いで来てね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway! Everyone's waiting, so hurry up!

fields.EN:
Ugh. Always barging in.
He's worse than Charlotte.
fields.JP:
ったく、あいつは
勝手に世話焼きたがりやがって、
男版シャーロットかっての
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Always barging in.
He's worse than Charlotte.

fields.EN:
No. That's an insult to Charlotte's chest.
Jack's doesn't even compare...
fields.JP:
いや、それはシャーロットのおっぱいに失礼だな。
あの楽園はジャックには存在しない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. That's an insult to Charlotte's chest.
Jack's doesn't even compare...

fields.EN:
If I was going to reset, then I wish my life
would reset with me.
fields.JP:
結局リセットするなら、
この俺の性根も変わってくれれば
よかったのによ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I was going to reset, then I wish my life
would reset with me.

fields.EN: Oof. If only this were a dream...
fields.JP: ったく、これも幻覚ならよかったのにな
fields.LOCALIZED: Oof. If only this were a dream...

fields.JP:
ねえ、折角なら
もっとゆっくりしていったらいいじゃない

fields.EN:
Nope. We've been honing our survival skills,
so it's time for us to take them around the
world and travel.
fields.JP:
ううん、あたしたちは今までに覚えてきた
サバイバル知識があるし、それを使って
旅していくことにするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope. We've been honing our survival skills,
so it's time for us to take them around the
world and travel.

fields.EN:
But you could use them here. You could stay
with me a little longer...
fields.JP:
それなら、ここでだって使えるよ。
だからもう少し一緒にいてくれたって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you could use them here. You could stay
with me a little longer...

fields.JP: ごめんね、もう決めたんだ

fields.EN:
We have our own lives, and that goes for you too.
You're free to live however you want.
fields.JP:
あたしたちには、あたしたちの生き方がある。
それはあんたも同じ。あんたはあんたの道を行きな
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have our own lives, and that goes for you too.
You're free to live however you want.

fields.EN:
Rachel, this isn't good-bye forever.
We'll come home now and then.
fields.JP:
レイチェル、何も一生の別れじゃない。
たまには帰ってくるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rachel, this isn't good-bye forever.
We'll come home now and then.

fields.EN: Just shut up and let me hug you.
fields.JP: いいから黙って抱きしめさせる
fields.LOCALIZED: Just shut up and let me hug you.

fields.JP: ああ、あったかいなあレイチェルは

fields.EN:
...This is so nice. You have no idea how happy
I am knowing my little sister is alive and well.
fields.JP:
……よかった、
あたしの大事な妹たちがこんなに元気で
fields.LOCALIZED:
...This is so nice. You have no idea how happy
I am knowing my little sister is alive and well.

fields.EN:
Little sister...but I don't remember!
I still feel like Shira!
fields.JP: 妹って……ま、まだシラは思い出せないんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little sister...but I don't remember!
I still feel like Pyre!

fields.EN:
That's fine.
It's for the best you don't remember.
fields.JP:
いいよ、それで。
かえって思い出さない方があんたのため
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's fine.
It's for the best you don't remember.

fields.EN: Yup. You're perfect just the way you are.
fields.JP: うん、あんたはそのままでいい
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. You're perfect just the way you are.

fields.EN:
Besides, WE remember you.
You'll always be our baby sister, Rachel.
fields.JP:
それに、あたしたちが覚えてる。
レイチェルが大事な妹だってことをね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, WE remember you.
You'll always be our baby sister, Rachel.

fields.EN: Shira... Rachel too, kind of understands that.
fields.JP:
シラ……レイチェルも、
うっすらとはそのね、分かる
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, Rachel, um...will always be your baby sister.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: いじらしいったらないわねー

fields.EN: Hey, don't make fun of me!
fields.JP: もう、いじわるしないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, don't make fun of me!

fields.EN: Hahaha. Sorry, sorry. Can't help but dote on you.
fields.JP:
あはは、ごめんごめん。
あんたに姉心がキュンとしちゃって、つい
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. Sorry, sorry. Can't help but dote on you.

fields.EN: Ihihi. Let's get going, you two.
fields.JP:
イッヒッヒッ、
２人とも、もう行きますよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ihihi. Let's get going, you two.

fields.JP: はい。じゃあおねえ、行こ

fields.EN:
Right. Let's go before I change my mind.
Okay.
fields.JP: そうね、決意が揺らがないうちに……よしっ、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Let's go before I change my mind.
Okay.

fields.EN: See you, Rachel. You'll always be my cute younger sister. Even if you don't remember, that's one thing that will never change.
fields.JP:
じゃあね、レイチェル。
あなたはいつだって、あたしのかわいい妹。
覚えてなくても、それは絶対だからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
See ya, Rachel. We'll always be here for you.
Even if you don't remember. I promise.

fields.EN:
If you forget our faces when we return,
I'll never forgive you.
fields.JP:
帰ってきた時にわたしたちの顔忘れてたら、
承知しない
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you forget our faces when we return,
I'll never forgive you.

fields.EN: Okay... I promise to remember. I won't forget!
fields.JP:
うん……
ちゃんと思い出すし、絶対忘れない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay... I promise to remember. I won't forget!

fields.EN: Hehe. See you when we return!
fields.JP: ふふ、それじゃあまた帰って来た時にね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. See you when we return!

fields.EN:
Aww, they're gone. Even though Shira tried to
stop them. How rude.
fields.JP:
あーあ、行っちゃった。せっかく
シラが引き止めてあげたっていうのに、
まったく失礼しちゃうわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. They're gone already. I thought we'd have
more time. So rude...
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Oh, thank goodness I found you.
We're taking a group picture, remember?
Everyone's gathered, so can you head there?
fields.JP:
あ、よかった見つけた。
ほら、写真撮るって話聞いてるよね？
もう集まってるからシラも来て！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, thank goodness I found you.
We're taking a group picture, remember?
Everyone's gathered, so can you head there?

fields.EN: Got it. I'll be right there.
fields.JP: わかった、すぐに行くわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. I'll be right there.

fields.EN: Cool. I have one more stop, so I'll see you there!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ僕、
他に寄るところあるから先に行くね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Cool. I have one more stop, so I'll see you there!

fields.EN: Look at Jack go. My tears have stopped.
fields.JP:
ジャックのやつ、ばたばたしちゃって。
涙、止まっちゃったじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: Look at Jack go. My tears have stopped.

fields.EN: I guess it's better this way. No need to get mopey.
fields.JP:
でも、その方がいいのかもしれないわね。
しんみりする必要なんて、どこにもないんだもん
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess it's better this way. No need to get mopey.

fields.JP: アリス、目が覚めたのね

fields.EN:
Charlotte...?
Oh, I fell asleep on your lap...
fields.JP:
シャーロット……？
そっか、わたしあなたの膝で寝ちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte...?
Oh, I fell asleep on your lap...

fields.EN: You were dreaming. It was a long dream.
fields.JP: あなたは夢を見ていたのよ。長い夢を
fields.LOCALIZED: You were dreaming. It was a long dream.

fields.JP: そうね……うん、夢を見ていたわ

fields.EN:
It was so eerie, terrifying, but warm somehow.
It was so strange.
fields.JP:
なんかね、とても奇妙で怖いのだけど、
それでもどこか温かい……そんな夢だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was so eerie, terrifying, but warm somehow.
It was so strange.

fields.EN: Hehe. As long as it wasn't a nightmare.
fields.JP: ふふ、悪くない夢だったんならよかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. As long as it wasn't a nightmare.

fields.EN: It was so weird, it went on forever...
fields.JP: いや不思議でとても長い夢だったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: It was so weird, it went on forever...

fields.EN: But the days I spent in reality with Jack and the others left a much stronger impression on me.
fields.JP:
だけどわたし、ジャックたちと過ごした
あの現実の日々の方がよっぽど印象に残ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just realized how much Jack means
to me.

fields.EN:
Hey Charlotte, how long have you known that
I was your little sister?
fields.JP:
ねえ、シャーロットはいつから
わたしのことが妹だって分かったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Charlotte, how long have you known that
I was your little sister?

fields.EN:
When I think about it, I think my Blood Libido
was my strong affinity towards you, Alice.
fields.JP:
……今思えば、私の血式リビドーはアリス、
あなたに対する強い『友愛』だったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I think about it, I think my Blood Libido
was my strong affinity towards you, Alice.

fields.EN:
That emotion only grew stronger with time,
but...
fields.JP:
その感情、それ自体はどんどん強くなって、
私も気づいてきていたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That emotion only grew stronger with time,
but...

fields.EN:
The realization didn't hit me until we reached
the top of the tower.
fields.JP:
確信したのは、
悪食の監隊塔の屋上に着いた瞬間だったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The realization didn't hit me until we reached
the top of the tower.

fields.EN:
Yes. In that moment, I felt something come over
me. All sorts of things came to mind.
fields.JP:
ええ。あの瞬間、まるで憑き物が落ちたように、
私の中にすっとすべての情報が入り込んできたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. In that moment, I felt something come over
me. All sorts of things came to mind.

fields.EN: Jack-kun, Mary, Juu-kun, Clara-chan, Shira-chan, Akazukin-chan...
fields.JP:
『ジャックくん』『メアリー』
『ジュウくん』『くららちゃん』
『シラちゃん』『赤ずきんちゃん』……
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, Mary, Toh, Clara, Pyre, Red Riding Hood...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんちゃん => Red Riding Hood-chan; くららちゃん => Clara-chan; ジャックくん => Jack-kun; シラちゃん => Pyre-chan; ジュウくん => Toh-kun | source-gated Toh => Juu; source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: It was as if someone had restored my power.
fields.JP:
まるで誰かが私の力を返してくれたような、
そんな感じだったわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: It was as if someone had restored my power.

fields.EN:
That's when I realized you were my little sister.
Mary was there then too, and I gave her her name.
fields.JP:
その時にアリスが私の妹で、
メアリーは私の元となった人物の妹の名前で、
それを私はあの子につけたんだって分かったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's when I realized you were my little sister.
Mary was there then too, and I gave her her name.

fields.EN:
So all along I was your older sister, but before,
I was merely an observer of your story.
fields.JP:
そうそう、私はアリスの姉で、
ただ『物語を見るだけ』の人物だったはずなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So all along I was your older sister, but before,
I was merely an observer of your story.

fields.EN:
Yet, before I knew it, I became part of the story.
Life has a way of surprising you.
fields.JP:
それなのに、いつの間にか当事者になっちゃった。
ほんと、人生って何があるか分からないものねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet, before I knew it, I became part of the story.
Life has a way of surprising you.

fields.EN:
I wonder if that's why you always seemed so
aloof when everything went down.
fields.JP:
もしかして、シャーロットがいつも
どこか他人事みたいな言い方をしていたのって、
それのせいなのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if that's why you always seemed so
aloof when everything went down.

fields.JP: もしかしたら、そうかもしれないわね

fields.EN:
But becoming who I am today, as a mixture of
a storybook character and a real person, helped
me see you and Mary as my sisters.
fields.JP:
でも今の私になって、本だったり人物だったり、
色々と混ざってはいるけど、その上で『アリス』も
『メアリー』も私の大事な妹だって思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But becoming who I am today, as a mixture of
a storybook character and a real person, helped
me see you and Mary as my sisters.

fields.EN: Which makes Mary my little sister too...
fields.JP:
そうなると、メアリーは
わたしの妹ってことになるのね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Which makes Mary my little sister too...

fields.EN: What do we do? None of us look alike.
fields.JP: どうしよう、３人ともまったく似てないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: What do we do? None of us look alike.

fields.JP: それは認めざるを得ないわね

fields.EN: I wonder how your powers were restored.
fields.JP:
ねえ、どうしてシャーロットの力って
いきなり戻ったのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder how your powers were restored.

fields.EN: Actually, how were they lost in the first place?
fields.JP: いえ、そもそもどうして衰えていたのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: Actually, how were they lost in the first place?

fields.EN:
No idea. I mean, Gatou-san did say the world was on
a cycle.
fields.JP:
私にもさっぱり分からないわ。
ただ、賀東さんが言ってたじゃない？
『世界はリセットをし続けている』って
fields.LOCALIZED:
No idea. I mean, Gato did say the world was on
a cycle.
fields.notes: Source address form: 賀東さん => Gatou-san

fields.EN: I can't know that feeling as the me living now, but maybe, somewhere within this repeating world, I grew sick of it.
fields.JP:
今を生きる私には分からない感覚だけど、
もしかしたら繰り返す世界の中で、
私、嫌になっちゃったのかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a theory only because I exist now in the
present, but maybe in another timeline, I got
sick of the cycle.

fields.EN: To see my precious Alice die over and over...
fields.JP:
大好きなアリスの死を、
何度も見させられてしまうのが……ね
fields.LOCALIZED: To see my precious Alice die over and over...

fields.EN:
Maybe I told myself I was better off without
the power.
fields.JP:
そうしたら、こんな力いらないー
なんて思ったんじゃないかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I told myself I was better off without
the power.

fields.EN: Just imagining something terrible happening to you already makes me think I don't want that power at all.
fields.JP:
だって、今アリスが悲しいことになっちゃうって
想像しただけで、私すでにそんな力いらない、
って思っちゃってるくらいだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, the thought of anything hurting you
breaks my heart.

fields.EN:
In another life, perhaps I rejected my power
and someone else got it instead.
That's a romantic thought.
fields.JP:
でも、そんな風に力をいらないと思ったからこそ、
神様が代わりに何かしてくれたのかも……
なんてロマンチックすぎかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
In another life, perhaps I rejected my power
and someone else got it instead.
That's a romantic thought.

fields.EN: I like that way of thinking.
fields.JP: でもその考え、わたし嫌いじゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I like that way of thinking.

fields.JP: アリスー！　シャーロットさーん！

fields.EN: Oh no! We're late for the picture!
fields.JP:
あ、いけない！
今日は写真を撮るって話だったわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no! We're late for the picture!

fields.JP: そうだったわね、すっかり忘れちゃってたわ！
ジャック！　今すぐ行くわー！
ふう、これで全員に声かけられたかな

fields.EN:
Shoot. Sunset's in about an hour. I gotta hurry
before I miss it.
fields.JP:
やばっ、もう１時間程度で日が落ちそう。
完全に陽が落ちる前に行かなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shoot. Sunset's in about an hour. I gotta hurry
before I miss it.

fields.EN:
Maybe we're a long ways off knowing how
peace truly feels.
fields.JP:
結局、僕たちの落ちつける日常というものは
随分と先のことになりそうだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we're a long ways off knowing how
peace truly feels.

fields.EN:
That's how broken this world was.
Maybe that day will never come.
fields.JP:
それほどまでに世界は壊れてしまっていて、
もしかしたら夢に描いた穏やかな日々は、
一生来ないのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's how broken this world was.
Maybe that day will never come.

fields.EN:
But even so, the world as we knew it is long
gone.
fields.JP:
それでも、もう誰かが不用意に死ぬような、
不条理な不幸に見舞われるような世界は終わった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But even so, the world as we knew it is long
gone.

fields.EN:
We can hope for tomorrow, and live every day
to its fullest.
fields.JP:
僕たちはもう、明日に希望を持って、
今日を一生懸命に生きることができるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can hope for tomorrow, and live every day
to its fullest.

fields.EN: That alone is something to celebrate.
fields.JP: そう、それだけで充分幸せなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: That alone is something to celebrate.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I'm not like any of you! I am human!
I have used and destroyed this world with my
own hands. Hundreds of lives can attest to that.
fields.JP:
俺は貴様らとは違う！　人間だ！
人間としてこの世界を利用し、破壊し、
そして多くを殺してきた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not like any of you! I am human!
I have used and destroyed this world with my
own hands. Hundreds of lives can attest to that.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You think I need this to become a god?!
You're gravely mistaken!
fields.JP:
それなのに化け物の力を欲する！？
そんな安易で馬鹿げたものに頼るなど、
ゴミ虫がすることだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think I need this to become a god?!
You're gravely mistaken!

fields.EN: I know what you wanted all along...
fields.JP:
きっとあなたも、最初からこんな結末を
望んでいたわけじゃないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I know what you wanted all along...

fields.EN: You never meant any ill will, you weren't evil.
fields.JP:
何かを欲しがっていたわけでも
誰かを憎んでいたわけでもない
fields.LOCALIZED: You never meant any ill will, you weren't evil.

fields.EN:
You were just in pain. So desperate, so hurt,
trying to beat on...
fields.JP:
ただ、苦しくて悲しくて、
必死で足掻いていただけ――
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were just in pain. So desperate, so hurt,
trying to beat on...

fields.JP: ウィッチクラフトよ！　僕の願いは――

fields.EN:
This path...wasn't made possible by a simple
wish.
fields.JP:
僕たちの辿ってきた道は、
こんな願えば叶うような安っぽいものじゃないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
This path...wasn't made possible by a simple
wish.

fields.EN:
In that moment, I heard the Jail cry out.
A cry I'd never heard before.
And I knew...it was over.
fields.JP:
そう告げた瞬間、
ジェイルが今まで聞いたことのない、
どこか安堵したような声を上げた
fields.LOCALIZED:
In that moment, I heard the Jail cry out.
A cry I'd never heard before.
And I knew...it was over.

fields.EN: *gasp* Crap! I'm being swallowed by it!
fields.JP:
はっ……！　まずい、
剥き出しの負の感情たちが
一気に押し寄せて……！
fields.LOCALIZED: *gasp* Crap! I'm being swallowed by it!

fields.EN: Ngh... Guess I was destined to fail.
fields.JP:
くっ、僕はどうやら最後の最後で
失敗してしまったようだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ngh... Guess I was destined to fail.

fields.EN: Perhaps this is my penance for my betrayal.
fields.JP:
結局僕は、裏切り者として
裁かれる運命だったのかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED: Perhaps this is my penance for my betrayal.

fields.EN:
How fitting, to be taken by an everlasting pool
of darkness...
fields.JP:
無数の怨念に潰されて飲み込まれるなんて、
裏切り者には似合いの最期……か
fields.LOCALIZED:
How fitting, to be taken by an everlasting pool
of darkness...

fields.EN: Oh no. It's shaking even more!
fields.JP: だめ、揺れがどんどん酷くなっていくわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no. It's shaking even more!

fields.EN: What do we do? This place is going to crumble!
fields.JP: どうしよう、もうここも崩れちゃうよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What do we do? This place is going to crumble!

fields.JP:
ジャック！　お願いだ！
ウィッチクラフトに願ってくれ！！

fields.EN: But I don't know what to wish for!
fields.JP:
そうは言っても、
何をどう願えばいいのか分からないんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: But I don't know what to wish for!

fields.EN:
There's no time to think, goddammit!
Just wish for anything!
fields.JP:
悩んでるヒマはねーって言ってんだろー！
何でもいいからもう願っちまえ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's no time to think, goddammit!
Just wish for anything!

fields.EN: She's right. Don't think, just do it!
fields.JP:
確かにそうね、願いを
考えてる時間なんてもうなさそう……！
fields.LOCALIZED: She's right. Don't think, just do it!

fields.JP: でも、何でもって言ったって！

fields.EN:
When I say anything, I mean anything! It can be
your wildest fantasy, use your imagination!
Just pick the first thing you can think of!
fields.JP:
何でもは何でもだ！
お前の妄想でも想像でも、頭に浮かんだ
楽しそうな出来事を願えばそれでいいんだよ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I say anything, I mean anything! It can be
your wildest fantasy, use your imagination!
Just pick the first thing you can think of!

fields.EN: Jack, the ground is splitting open!
fields.JP: ジャック！　足場が一気に割れ始めたわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, the ground is splitting open!

fields.EN:
Witchcraft, I wish for a world where nothing
bad happens! A world without pain!
fields.JP:
ウィッチクラフト！
ともかく、もうこんな酷いことが起きない、
誰もが苦しいことを忘れられる世界に……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Witchcraft, I wish for a world where nothing
bad happens! A world without pain!

fields.EN: Oh. It was all a dream.
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. It was all a dream.

fields.EN:
I felt like I had the worst nightmare...
But I don't remember what it was about.
fields.JP:
今、ものすごい悪夢を見ていた気がする……
でも何だったか、思い出せないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt like I had the worst nightmare...
But I don't remember what it was about.

fields.EN:
(Hm? Mom and Dad are calling for me.
Oh, look at the time! I'm gonna be late!)
fields.JP:
（ん？　父さんと母さんが呼んでる。
　ってもうこんな時間か。早く朝ごはん食べないと）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Mom and Dad are calling for me.
Oh, look at the time! I'm gonna be late!)

fields.EN:
Well, it was just a dream! Gotta make it
to class!
fields.JP:
ま、夢は夢か！
そんなことより学校行かなくちゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it was just a dream! Gotta make it
to class!

fields.EN:
(An altogether different feeling than
running around a Jail...)
fields.JP: （監獄塔を回っていた時とはまた違う忙しさだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(An altogether different feeling than
running around a Jail...)

fields.EN:
(My life's finally sorted. I have my job,
and my life isn't falling apart.)
fields.JP: （やっと今日で仕事も身の回りの生活も落ち着いてきた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My life's finally sorted. I have my job,
and my life isn't falling apart.)

fields.EN:
(...Now I can talk to that person I fell out
with.)
fields.JP: （……ずっと話せなかった人と、やっと話せるくらいには）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...Now I can talk to that person I fell out
with.)

fields.JP: ……そろそろ行く準備、しなくちゃ

fields.EN: (I wanted to wait until the world was safe...)
fields.JP: （世界が平和になってからゆっくり話したいと思っていた）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wanted to wait until the world was safe...)

fields.JP: （今日やっとその子を誘えたんだけど……）

fields.EN: (What do I do? We usually talk so casually, but calling her out to talk one-on-one like this makes me a little nervous...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう。いつも何気なく話してるけど、
　いざ呼び出して二人っきりで話すとなると
　少しドキドキするな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What do I do? Whenever we're alone,
my heart beats like crazy.)

fields.EN: (What if she doesn't come? Oh boy.)
fields.JP:
（そもそも来てくれるのかな……
　どうしよう、不安になってきた）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What if she doesn't come? Oh boy.)

fields.JP: 会いたい相手選んでください
あ、アリス！　来てくれたんだね
もちろんよ、当たり前じゃない

それよりもごめんなさい。
少し待たせたかしら

fields.EN: Not at all. Just got here.
fields.JP:
ううん、大丈夫。
僕も今来たところだったから
fields.LOCALIZED: Not at all. Just got here.

fields.JP:
そう？
それならよかった

fields.EN: Sorry for calling you so suddenly.
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry for calling you so suddenly.

fields.EN:
Oh, don't worry. I've been looking forward
to this.
fields.JP:
いいのよ
ジャックとゆっくり話したいと思って来たんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, don't worry. I've been looking forward
to this.

fields.EN:
I bet you're busy too. Was there something
in particular you wanted to discuss?
fields.JP:
ジャックこそ忙しいはずなのに。
何か用でもあったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet you're busy too. Was there something
in particular you wanted to discuss?

fields.EN: ...Sorry. I just wanted to hang out.
fields.JP: ……ごめん。ただ会いたかっただけかも
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Sorry. I just wanted to hang out.

fields.EN:
Hehe. That makes two of us. I wanted to
hang out too.
fields.JP:
…………ふふっ。
わたしもただ会いたかったから一緒ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. That makes two of us. I wanted to
hang out too.

fields.EN: We've been together for ten years now.
fields.JP: …………もう１０年以上一緒にいるのね
fields.LOCALIZED: We've been together for ten years now.

fields.JP: 言われてみればそうだね

fields.EN:
You were so shy when we first met, Alice.
Shy and mean.
fields.JP:
出会った頃のアリスは凄い人見知りで
僕のことを邪険にしてたよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were so shy when we first met, Alice.
Shy and mean.

fields.EN:
Well, can you blame me after I was bullied
for having pink eyes? Hard to trust anyone.
fields.JP:
あ、あれはわたしがピンクの目をしてる
変なやつだって言われてて
怖くて誰も信用出来なかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, can you blame me after I was bullied
for having pink eyes? Hard to trust anyone.

fields.EN:
But you never gave up on me. You kept
going. Before I knew it, I got attached...
fields.JP:
それなのにあなたったら全然めげずに
声をかけ続けてくれるから……
その……いつの間にか嬉しくなっちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you never gave up on me. You kept
going. Before I knew it, I got attached...

fields.EN:
I wonder what kept me going.
You looked so lonely, and I couldn't turn
a blind eye to that.
fields.JP:
なんだろうね、あの頃はアリスが
寂しそうにしてるのがなんでか
ほっとけなかったんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what kept me going.
You looked so lonely, and I couldn't turn
a blind eye to that.

fields.EN:
I guess there was so much more than meets
the eye with you.
fields.JP:
いつの間にか寂しそうよりも
一緒にいたいって気持ちが大きくなっちゃったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess there was so much more than meets
the eye with you.

fields.JP: ……これからの１０年も一緒にいられたらいいわね

fields.EN: Oh, um... Would that bother you?
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, um... Would that bother you?

fields.EN: For the next ten, twenty years—and even further into the future—I want us to keep talking like this.
fields.JP:
これからの１０年、２０年、
それからもっと先の未来も
ずっとこんな風に話していきたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here's to the next ten, twenty, and the
happily ever after.

fields.EN:
...Yes. This is the peace we've always
wanted.
fields.JP:
……ええ。
やっと地上で平和な日常を手に入れたんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Yes. This is the peace we've always
wanted.

fields.EN:
I want to do everything we always talked
about. Together.
fields.JP:
やりたいこと、話したいこと、
いろんなことをしていきたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to do everything we always talked
about. Together.

fields.EN:
Since we don't have to worry about Blood
Libidos anymore, I want to have...tea parties.
fields.JP:
血式リビドーはなくなってしまったけれど、
お茶会だって……またやりたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Since we don't have to worry about Blood
Libidos anymore, I want to have...tea parties.

fields.EN:
Maybe we can make that happen.
Let's make a list of everything we wanna do.
fields.JP:
これから自由になってどうしていくか、
ジャックと話していきたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe we can make that happen.
Let's make a list of everything we wanna do.

fields.EN: Yeah! I'm all in. I'm looking forward to it.
fields.JP:
うん、これから全部やっていこう！
僕もそれを楽しみに頑張るから
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! I'm all in. I'm looking forward to it.

fields.JP: 頑張りすぎはダメだからね？
あの時、わたしを引っ張ってくれてありがとう
あなたと出会えて、本当に良かった

fields.EN:
Hey. I owe it all to you. Thanks for taking a
chance on me.
fields.JP:
僕なんかと……いや。
僕とここまで一緒にいてくれてありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey. I owe it all to you. Thanks for taking a
chance on me.

fields.JP: これからも、一緒にいてくれると嬉しいな

fields.EN: (Ouch. Oh. It doesn't hurt like it used to.)
fields.JP:
（いてて……
　あれ……でも前よりは痛くないな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ouch. Oh. It doesn't hurt like it used to.)

fields.EN:
You can't just charge at people.
That's dangerous.
fields.JP: いきなり突っ込んできたら危ないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't just charge at people.
That's dangerous.

fields.EN: Glad to see you're doing well.
fields.JP: でも、相変わらず元気そうでよかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Glad to see you're doing well.

fields.EN:
Oh. Wasn't Nemurihime coming too?
Don't you live together?
fields.JP:
……あれ？
そういえば同居してる眠り姫がついてくるって
言ってなかったっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Wasn't Sleeping Beauty coming too?
Don't you live together?

fields.EN: I don't see her. Did you come alone?
fields.JP: 姿が見当たらないけど１人で来たの？
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't see her. Did you come alone?

fields.EN:
Nemu-Nemu won't wake up from her nap.
So I snuck out.
fields.JP:
ねむねむはねー、おひるねしたままおきないから
ないしょできちゃったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy won't wake up from her nap.
So I snuck out.

fields.EN:
(Now that the world's peaceful, it's much
safer than before, but...)
fields.JP:
（まぁ確かに平和になった今の世界は
　以前に比べれば格段と安全だけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that the world's peaceful, it's much
safer than before, but...)

fields.EN:
Rapunzel, you're still little. You're not a
Blood Maiden anymore.
fields.JP:
でも、まだラプンツェルは子供だし、
血式少女の力はもうないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, you're still little. You're not a
Blood Maiden anymore.

fields.EN:
You're not as strong as you were, so don't
be so mischievous, okay?
fields.JP:
ちょっと前みたいに力持ちじゃないんだから、
あんまりわんぱくしすぎちゃダメだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not as strong as you were, so don't
be so mischievous, okay?

fields.EN: But, but, Rapunzel wanted to see Jack!
fields.JP:
でもでも、ラプンツェル、
じゃっくにあいたかったのー！
fields.LOCALIZED: But I wanted to see you, Jack!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: せっかくじゃっくがさそってくれたんだもん！
ラプンツェル、とってもうれしかったんだから！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: (Aw. She's so sweet. It makes me happy too.)
fields.JP:
（……ここまで喜ばれると僕も嬉しくなるな。
　誘ってよかった）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Aw. She's so sweet. It makes me happy too.)

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel's her usual pure self.
She puts my heart at ease.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルの純粋さも変わってないし
　心も癒やされる感じがする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel's her usual pure self.
She puts my heart at ease.)

fields.EN:
Just like you said Jack, it's hard without
my powers.
fields.JP:
でもじゃっくのいうとおり。
いま、ちからがなくてほんとふべんなのっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just like you said Jack, it's hard without
my powers.

fields.EN:
I used to YAH so easily, and I could carry
big rocks.
fields.JP:
あのいわなんて、むかしはどばーーー！！　って
もちあげたりできたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I used to YAH so easily, and I could carry
big rocks.

fields.EN:
Right now Rapunzel can only carry rocks about as big
as that Rapunzel face over there.
fields.JP:
いまはあそこにあるラプンツェルの
おかおくらいしかないいしももてないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Now I can only carry teeny rocks.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Well, you don't have to carry any rocks
anymore.
fields.JP: そんなに石を持ったりすることもないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you don't have to carry any rocks
anymore.

fields.EN:
Sucks, but I don't care. I get to run around
with Shira and study.
fields.JP:
うん、ふべんだけどね、それでもいいんだー。
このからだでシラとかけっこしたり
べんきょうしたりして
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sucks, but I don't care. I get to run around
with Pyre and study.

fields.EN: We compete every day. It's fun.
fields.JP: まいにちしょうぶしてるからたのしいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: We compete every day. It's fun.

fields.JP: それは偉いね。すごいよ
わーい！　ジャックにほめられたー！

fields.EN:
Just glad to see you're still happy-go-lucky,
Rapunzel. Even when the world's changed.
fields.JP:
この世界が変わっても、ラプンツェルの
天真爛漫さは変わらなくてよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just glad to see you're still happy-go-lucky,
Rapunzel. Even when the world's changed.

fields.JP:
うーん？　ラプンツェル、すごい？
えへへ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmm? Am I good girl? Teehee.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Yeah. The best. Your energy and positivity
made all the difference on our journey.
fields.JP:
うん、すごいと思うよ。きっと今回の冒険も、
その持ち前の明るさで色んな人のことを
明るい気持ちにしてきたんだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. The best. Your energy and positivity
made all the difference on our journey.

fields.EN:
I'm excited to see what the future holds for
you.
fields.JP: ラプンツェルの将来が楽しみだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm excited to see what the future holds for
you.

fields.EN: Hehe! Rapunzel's growing every single day!
fields.JP:
えっへん！
ラプンツェルはひび、せいちょうちゅうだからね！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: I'll be the best grown up ever!
fields.JP: あっというまにおとなのじょせいになるんだからー
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be the best grown up ever!

fields.JP: そんなことよりあそぼー！

fields.EN: We haven't played together, just the two of us, in so long! Let's do something we hardly ever get to do!
fields.JP:
せっかくひさしぶりにふたりであそぶんだから
めったにできないことしよーよー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We haven't played in ages! We got a lot
of catching up to do!

fields.EN:
Let's go to those rocks! I can't go by myself!
Come with me!
fields.JP:
あ、あそこのいわまでいってみたい！
ふだんひとりじゃいけないの。
じゃっくといきたいー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's go to those rocks! I can't go by myself!
Come with me!

fields.EN: (Looks like she suddenly got bored with the conversation... She's still a long way from being a grown woman, but I feel like she'll become a truly attractive woman someday.)
fields.JP:
（急に話に飽きたみたいだ……。
　大人の女性はまだ遠そうだけど
　いつか本当に魅力的な女性になる気がするよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like I've already bored her.
She's got a lot of growing up to do, but
I have a feeling she's got a bright future.)

fields.JP: ほらー、いくよー、手つなご！

fields.EN:
Oh, wow! I forgot how warm your hands
are.
fields.JP: わっ、ひさしぶりのじゃっくの手、あったかいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, wow! I forgot how warm your hands
are.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルも温かいよ

fields.EN: (She looks like she's having a blast.)
fields.JP: （本当に楽しそうに笑ってるなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She looks like she's having a blast.)

fields.EN:
(The wild child has finally been tamed.
She looks so happy.)
fields.JP:
（あの野生児だったラプンツェルが
　ここまで人間らしく育って……
　そして幸せそうで本当によかった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The wild child has finally been tamed.
She looks so happy.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she doesn't have to grow up just
yet. Maybe I can savor this for a bit.)
fields.JP:
（将来が楽しみなのは本心だけど……
　出来ればずっと、そのままの君でいてほしいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she doesn't have to grow up just
yet. Maybe I can savor this for a bit.)

fields.JP:
じゃっくー？
なんで黙ってるのー？
そう？　ならよかったっ！

fields.EN:
Jack~. From now on, stay with Rapunzel
forever and ever and ever!
fields.JP:
じゃっくー。これからもね、
ずーーーーっとラプンツェルといっしょにいてね！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Yeah, you got it. I'm here, Rapunzel.
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね。
さぁ、行こうか。ラプンツェル
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, you got it. I'm here, Rapunzel.

fields.JP:
うんっ。じゃっく！
それじゃあ、れっつごー！

fields.EN: Sorry for calling you over when you're busy.
fields.JP: ごめんね、忙しいのに呼びつけちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks for making it. I know you're busy.

fields.EN:
I suspect you had no particular reason to
summon me.
fields.JP: どうせ明確な用件はないんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suspect you had no particular reason to
summon me.

fields.EN:
Haha. I had a feeling you'd say that, so
I outlined a few things to discuss.
fields.JP:
はは、そう言われるかも、と思って
いくつかの議案を持ってきたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. I had a feeling you'd say that, so
I outlined a few things to discuss.

fields.EN:
Despite our separation, our rapport is
unchanged.
fields.JP:
お互い離れ離れの割には、
変に予測が付くものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite our separation, our rapport is
unchanged.

fields.EN:
(It's been a while since I've been alone with
Gretel. Looks like her smile's softened.)
fields.JP:
（……久しぶりにグレーテルと２人きりだけど
　グレーテルの笑顔が柔らかくなった気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been a while since I've been alone with
Gretel. Looks like her smile's softened.)

fields.EN: I thought you might never change, being Gretel and all, but your expression has softened just a little.
fields.JP:
グレーテルのことだから、変わらないのかな、と
思ってたけど、ちょっとだけ表情が
柔らかくなったね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowing you Gretel, you haven't changed
much. But something's different.

fields.EN:
Interesting observation. I do feel like I
have embraced forgiveness as of late.
fields.JP:
また曖昧な表現ね。
でも確かに以前よりも他人を許せるように
なったとは思うわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting observation. I do feel like I
have embraced forgiveness as of late.

fields.EN: Perhaps that is the softening you speak of.
fields.JP:
それを『柔らかい』と言うのであれば
そうなのでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED: Perhaps that is the softening you speak of.

fields.EN:
(Seems coming to the surface and interacting
with others has opened her eyes.)
fields.JP:
（地上の旅を経て……僕以外と触れ合ううちに
　グレーテルは少し変わったみたいだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems coming to the surface and interacting
with others has opened her eyes.)

fields.EN:
(She doesn't seem as cold or unsympathetic
before.)
fields.JP:
（もう昔みたいに、他人の気持ちがわからない
　子だとは思えないな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't seem as cold or unsympathetic
before.)

fields.EN: So what did you want to discuss?
fields.JP: それで、その議案はどんなものがあるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: So what did you want to discuss?

fields.EN:
Well, um... Maybe we can talk about what's
next for us?
fields.JP:
えーっと……例えば今後の発展のために
どうするべきか、とか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, um... Maybe we can talk about what's
next for us?

fields.JP:
ふむ……。
少し大枠だけど丁度いい議題ね

fields.EN:
Firstly, let's discuss population. An increase
is inevitable. We must create an infrastructure
to anticipate child rearing.
fields.JP:
まずは今の人口を考えるに人口の増加が不可欠で
'子作り'を推奨する必要があるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Firstly, let's discuss population. An increase
is inevitable. We must create an infrastructure
to anticipate child rearing.

fields.EN:
Well, there aren't many other humans, so
we may need to have more eventually...
fields.JP:
いや、まあ確かに今世界には僕たち以外の人間を
ほとんど見ないから人手は必要だけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, there aren't many other humans, so
we may need to have more eventually...

fields.JP:
……ん？
さっき言ってた'丁度いい'ってどういう……？

fields.EN: I want a child at once.
fields.JP: 私は今、子供が欲しいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I want a child at once.

fields.EN:
What's the matter?! Where'd this come
from? You sound like Rapunzel!
fields.JP:
ど、どうしたの！？　急にそんなこと……
昔のラプンツェルみたいなこと言い出して……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter?! Where'd this come
from? You sound like Rapunzel!

fields.EN: Perhaps she rubbed off on me.
fields.JP: そのラプンツェルに影響されたところはあるわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Perhaps she rubbed off on me.

fields.EN: My travels with Rapunzel, Shira and Nemurihime have been enlightening, to say the least.
fields.JP:
今回の冒険を通して、ラプンツェルやシラ、
眠り姫を見て、私の中で庇護欲のようなものが
湧いてきたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My travels with Rapunzel, Pyre and Sleeping
Beauty have been enlightening, to say the least.
fields.notes: source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Considering her party, I can't exactly
blame her.)
fields.JP:
（でもグレーテルがいたメンバーを考えると
　グレーテルの言ってることもわかるような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Considering her party, I can't exactly
blame her.)

fields.EN:
As the need for population growth increases,
so shall my desires. Not too far-fetched, no?
fields.JP:
人口も増えるし、自分の欲も満たせるし、
悪くない案だと思っているのだけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the need for population growth increases,
so shall my desires. Not too far-fetched, no?

fields.EN: Gretel, you never cease to amaze me....
fields.JP:
さすがグレーテルだね……。
想像の斜め上過ぎだよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Gretel, you never cease to amaze me....

fields.EN:
Oh? Considering our small-scale operation,
I thought it the most efficient way to expand.
fields.JP:
あら、小規模なこの状況での一番有力な
繁栄、発展方法だと思うけれど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Considering our small-scale operation,
I thought it the most efficient way to expand.

fields.EN: Besides, I already have a candidate in mind.
fields.JP: それに相手のアテもあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides, I already have a candidate in mind.

fields.JP:
（グレーテルがじーっと
　僕のことを見つめている……）

fields.EN:
Perhaps more time is needed. Parameters
must be set.
fields.JP:
まぁ確かに今はそれよりももっと必要な
インフラ整備があるものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps more time is needed. Parameters
must be set.

fields.EN:
But when the time comes, expect me.
However, you are free to approach me too.
fields.JP:
時期が来れば私からも声を掛けるし、
ジャックももう十分と思ったら声を掛けて頂戴
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when the time comes, expect me.
However, you are free to approach me too.

fields.EN: I-I might need more time to prepare...
fields.JP: そ、そ、そういうのはもっと段階が――
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I might need more time to prepare...

fields.EN:
For now, let us worry about the preliminary
steps.
fields.JP:
だからその１段階目を今後考えていきましょう。
ということよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
For now, let us worry about the preliminary
steps.

fields.EN:
(Wow... Never saw that coming.
Gretel never fails to surprise.)
fields.JP:
（はぁ……いきなりびっくりしたよ……。
　相変わらずグレーテルはぶっ飛んでるなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow... Never saw that coming.
Gretel never fails to surprise.)

fields.EN:
For now, let us enjoy the peace we have
earned.
fields.JP: なんにしても、今は今ある平和を享受しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
For now, let us enjoy the peace we have
earned.

fields.EN: Into the night we walk, free from fear.
fields.JP:
こうして夜、無警戒でも出かけられる世の中に
なったのだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Into the night we walk, free from fear.

fields.EN:
Right. This is definitely not what I thought
would happen, but it's a good start.
fields.JP:
う、うん。
なんか想像とは違う凄い展開になったけど
また今度こういう議案を話そう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. This is definitely not what I thought
would happen, but it's a good start.

fields.EN:
Indeed. A good start. I look forward to our
many more discussions together.
fields.JP:
そうね、もう急ぐ必要はあまりないものね。
これからもこんな時間が続くのを期待してるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Indeed. A good start. I look forward to our
many more discussions together.

fields.EN:
Same here. It might be the first of many
talks, but certainly not the last.
fields.JP:
それは僕も賛成だよ。
こんな風に君と話し続けていたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here. It might be the first of many
talks, but certainly not the last.

fields.EN: Hehe. Too right. Till next time, Jack.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そう。
それはこれからが楽しみね。ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Too right. Till next time, Jack.

fields.JP: うん、これからもよろしく、グレーテル
ハーメルン！　来てくれたんだね

fields.EN: Sorry for calling you over when you're busy.
fields.JP: ごめんね、忙しいのに呼びつけちゃって

fields.EN:
Ugh, you know it! You got some courage to
cyall me here!
fields.JP:
まったくであるぞ！
我を呼びつけるとは良い度胸にゃのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, you know it! You got some courage to
cyall me here!

fields.EN:
(There she goes again. At least Hameln hasn't
changed.)
fields.JP:
（そういう態度も噛み噛みなところも
　ハーメルンはいつも通り変わらないなあ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes again. At least Hameln hasn't
changed.)

fields.JP: 最近の調子はどうだい？

fields.EN:
Well...previously, I could throw rocks with
ease. But now? Nothing!
fields.JP:
それがな、以前ならあんな岩くらい
軽々とびゅーんって出来たというのに……
今はまったくもてないのだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well...previously, I could throw rocks with
ease. But now? Nothing!

fields.EN:
My reign can't come to an end! I demand
a recount!
fields.JP:
我は最強だというのに、
まるでリセットされたような気持ちだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
My reign can't come to an end! I demand
a recount!

fields.EN: (Well, she's not a Blood Maiden anymore, so it really is like she was reset.)
fields.JP:
（まぁ血式少女じゃなくなったわけだし
　リセットされたようなものなんだけどね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that's because we no longer have
powers...)

fields.JP: だが、それでも我はまだまだ諦めておらぬ……！

fields.EN:
I will become even more powerful and will
regain my role at the top!
fields.JP: これから力をつけて再び最強の座を目指すのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will become even more powerful and will
regain my role at the top!

fields.EN:
I noticed there's no manga here either!
This angers me! So I've decided to draw
my own!
fields.JP:
あと最近気づいたのだが、ここには漫画がない！
我はそのことに憤り、自ら描くことを決意したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I noticed there's no manga here either!
This angers me! So I've decided to draw
my own!

fields.JP: それは、本当に凄いバイタリティだね

fields.EN: It's amazing you've already found something you want to do.
fields.JP: やりたいことをもう見つけるなんて、凄いよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad you've picked up a hobby.

fields.EN:
Ha ha ha! The pen is stroynger than the
sword!
fields.JP:
ハッハッハッ！
ペンは剣よりつにょしなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha ha ha! The pyen is stroynger than the
syord!

fields.EN: (Wow! She's pumped! And slurring, as usual.)
fields.JP:
（すごい！　やる気満々だ！
　相変わらずここぞというところで噛んでるけど）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Wow! She's pumped! And slurring, as usual.)

fields.JP: いや、変わらないなあと思ってさ

fields.EN:
You've always been so jubilant. Sure, you
slur all the time, but it's charming.
fields.JP:
君は出会った時から元気いっぱいで、
カッコいい事を言うときは噛んで、
場を明るくしてくれたけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've always been so jubilant. Sure, you
slur all the time, but it's charming.

fields.EN: Even after everything, you're still you.
fields.JP: 今回の旅を経ても何も変わらないね
fields.LOCALIZED: Even after everything, you're still you.

fields.EN: Wyat did you say?! I've never slurred!
fields.JP:
にゃにを！？
我は一度も噛んだことなどないのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wyat did you say?! I've never shlurred!

fields.JP:
ははっ。ごめんよ。
ありがとう、ハーメルン

fields.EN: I feel like I can keep going too.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンがいるとこれからも
まだまだ頑張れそうな気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I feel like I can keep going too.

fields.EN: Hm. Is that praise I hear?
fields.JP: むー……これは褒められているのだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. Is that praise I hear?

fields.JP: うん、最高級に褒めてるよ

そうか！
なら良いのだ！
ハッハッハッ！

fields.EN:
(If this is a world of everlasting peace, then
I want Hameln's bright future to be part of
it...)
fields.JP:
（これからの平和な世界……
　そこで紡がれていくハーメルンの未来）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If this is a world of everlasting peace, then
I want Hameln's bright future to be part of
it...)

fields.EN: (And I wanna be beside her the whole time.)
fields.JP:
（出来れば近くでそれを
　ずっと見続けていきたいな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (And I wanna be beside her the whole time.)

fields.EN:
Jack, continue extolling my praises and you
will be rewarded handsomely!
fields.JP:
ジャックよ、今後もずっと我を称えて
たくさんの元気をもらうがよいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, continue extolling my praises and you
will be rewarded handsomely!

fields.EN: How funny. I had the same thought.
fields.JP: ……偶然かな、僕も同じようなことを考えてたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: How funny. I had the same thought.

fields.EN: Hameln. I'd be happy if you'd stay with me from now on.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン。
僕とこれからも一緒にいてくれると嬉しいよ

fields.EN: HAHAHA! Of course! Follow me, Jack!
fields.JP:
ハッハッハッ！　もちろんだ。
我についてくるがよい！　ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED: HAHAHA! Of course! Follow me, Jack!

fields.JP:
あ、眠り姫。
来てくれたんだね
眠いかもしれないのに、ごめんね

そ、そっか！
そういってもらえると嬉しいよ！

fields.EN:
I've been meaning to catch up with you
for a while now.
fields.JP: 僕も君と２人で話したかったから呼んだんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been meaning to catch up with you
for a while now.

fields.EN: How about we sit and chat?
fields.JP: それじゃあ、そこに座って話そっか
fields.LOCALIZED: How about we sit and chat?

fields.EN: Must've been so tough for you, Nemurihime.
fields.LOCALIZED:
Must've been so tough for you, Sleeping
Beauty.

fields.EN:
You were separated from Oyayubihime and
Shirayukihime.
fields.JP: 親指姫や白雪姫と離れ離れになっちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were separated from Thumbelina and
Snow White.

fields.EN: But I'm glad all of you found each other.
fields.JP: いまはまたいつでも会えるようになってよかったね
fields.LOCALIZED: But I'm glad all of you found each other.

fields.EN:
Oyayubi-neesama...said I've grown up.
She praised me.
fields.JP:
この前……親指姉さまが……
前よりお姉さんっぽくなったって……
褒めてくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina...said I've grown up.
She praised me.

fields.EN:
(I can see Nemurihime's coming out of
her shell.)
fields.JP:
（眠り姫も成長して
　自立しようとしてるんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can see Sleeping Beauty's coming out of
her shell.)

fields.JP:
確かに大変だった……けど……
楽しかった……
……らぷやシラ……ハメルンちゃんのおかげ……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
（…………ん？
　あれ、ハーメルンは眠り姫より
　年上だったような……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Hm? Isn't Hameln older than Sleeping Beauty?)

fields.EN: Thanks to them...I've learned a lot
fields.JP: みんなのおかげで……ボクも成長できたと思う……
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks to them...I've learned a lot

fields.EN: Can't say I've changed too much.
fields.JP: 特に成長したって実感はないな……
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't say I've changed too much.

fields.EN:
But with everything that happened,
I'm grateful we have each other.
fields.JP:
色々あったけどこうして以前と変わらず
眠り姫と話せていることが今は幸せかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But with everything that happened,
I'm grateful we have each other.

fields.EN:
Hearing you speak reminds me that you're
still the kind Nemurihime I know.
I can't help but smile when I think about you.
fields.JP:
話を聞いていると
眠り姫は相変わらず優しいままで、
より魅力が増したように感じるし、僕も嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hearing you speak reminds me that you're
still the kind Sleeping Beauty I know.
I can't help but smile when I think about you.

fields.JP: ボクも……いまとっても……楽しい……

ほんと？
それならよかったよ

血式リビドーは……ないから……
ここで寝ることはないけど……
……眠たがりなのは……変わらないから……

fields.EN: Should we call it a day then?
fields.JP: じゃあ今日はここまでにしようか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Should we call it a day then?

fields.JP:
（……わわわっ！！
　眠り姫の頭が肩に……！？）

fields.EN: Oh, okay! That's perfectly fine with me.
fields.JP:
あ……うん！
眠り姫が良いならいいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, okay! That's perfectly fine with me.

fields.EN: Mm... Your scent, Jack... So nice.
fields.JP:
……ん……ジャックのにおい……
安心する……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... Your scent, Jack... So nice.

fields.EN:
(It makes me happy that Nemurihime
feels comfy enough to sleep here peacefully.)
fields.JP:
（こんな風に眠り姫が外で安心して寝れる世界に
　なって、本当に良かったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It makes me happy that Sleeping Beauty
feels comfy enough to sleep here peacefully.)

fields.EN:
(I'll do whatever it takes to make sure her
slumber is restful forever.)
fields.JP: （……ずっとこの寝顔を大事にしていきたい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll do whatever it takes to make sure her
slumber is restful forever.)

fields.JP: ずっとこんな時が続けばいいね……

ん……ん……ジャックと……
これからも……ずっと……

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Sorry for calling you out when you're so busy.
fields.JP: 色々忙しい中、呼びつけちゃってごめん
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry for calling you out when you're so busy.

fields.EN:
Haha. Always looking out for everyone else,
Jack. Typical.
fields.JP:
ははっ。
ジャックは相変わらず気遣いが多いね―
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Always looking out for everyone else,
Jack. Typical.

fields.EN: So what's up? That call was random.
fields.JP:
で？　何かあったの？
急に呼び出して
fields.LOCALIZED: So what's up? That call was random.

fields.EN:
Well... things finally settled down, and I suddenly
wanted to talk with you, Akazukin-san...
fields.JP:
いや、その……
やっと僕が落ち着いてきて、
ふと赤ずきんさんと話したいと思って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, now that things are settling down,
I was hoping we could chat.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Aw, shucks! That's sweet of you!
fields.JP:
またまた！
嬉しいこと言ってくれるじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, shucks! That's sweet of you!

fields.EN: Right. A chat, huh? I'm all ears! You first!
fields.JP:
そうかー、あたしと話したかったかー
いいよ、話そっか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. A chat, huh? I'm all ears! You first!

fields.EN: I'm glad you haven't changed, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP: なんか、赤ずきんさんが変わりなくてよかったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Glad to see you haven't changed.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: I haven't? Haha. Tsk tsk, Jack.
fields.JP:
そう？
ははっ、まだまだだね、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: I haven't? Haha. Tsk tsk, Jack.

fields.JP: あたし実は大分変わったんだよ！

fields.EN: Yup. Before, I didn't really understand myself.
fields.JP:
うん。
なんだろう、今まではちょっと
自分のことがわからなかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup. Before, I didn't really understand myself.

fields.EN:
Nope. But I guess it's all thanks to D—
I mean, Juu.
fields.JP:
うん、そうなんだ。
こればっかりはお父……ジュウのおかげかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nope. But I guess it's all thanks to D—
I mean, Toh.

fields.JP: ジュウ……博士と何かあったの？

fields.EN:
Hm. Well, whether he's Dad or Juu,
there's something more to him...
fields.JP:
うーん、あれはお父さんっていうか、
ジュウだったから違うと思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Well, whether he's Dad or Toh,
there's something more to him...

fields.EN: Haha. But don't take my word for it.
fields.JP:
……ははっ、あたしバカだからさ
そういうのわからないや
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. But don't take my word for it.

fields.EN:
(There's something about Akazukin-san now... a kind
of allure I never felt before.)
fields.JP:
（なんだろう、赤ずきんさんに
　今までにはないような色気を感じる……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (There's a charm to her that lulls me.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: You sure have grown up, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんさんは、なんかお姉さんっぽさが増したね
fields.LOCALIZED: You sure have grown up, Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Haha. I'm through being the big sister!
fields.JP:
ははっ。
それもね、もう『お姉さん』はやめたんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. I'm through being the big sister!

fields.EN: Maybe I don't have what it takes to be one.
fields.JP:
うーん、どうやらあたしにはお姉さん適性は
なかったみたいなんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe I don't have what it takes to be one.

fields.EN: It occurred to me during our journey.
fields.JP: 今回の旅でそう思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: It occurred to me during our journey.

fields.EN: Besides, they don't need me as their sister.
fields.JP:
それに、お姉さんである必要も
実はなかったみたい
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides, they don't need me as their sister.

fields.EN:
(Akazukin-san...seems much more
confident with who she is.)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさん……
　きっと赤ずきんさんは、今回のことで
　色々と自分を見つめ直したんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood...seems much more
confident with who she is.)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 赤ずきん => Red Riding Hood-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
So! I spend all my days training!
And I love it!
fields.JP:
だーかーらー！
今は大好きなトレーニングをたっくさんしてんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
So! I spend all my days training!
And I love it!

fields.EN:
Enough being a role model. Time to become
a body-builder! Haha. Whaddya say?
fields.JP:
お姉さんという立場から筋肉女に
進化しようと思ってね！
ははっ、どうかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough being a role model. Time to become
a body-builder! Haha. Whaddya say?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Right... Akazukin-san must have finally found where
she truly belongs.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ、そうだよね。
　赤ずきんさんはきっと本来
　収まるべき自分を見つけたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's right. I see she's found her calling.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(I wasn't expecting her answer, but I'm
willing to cheer her on!)
fields.JP:
（ただ、それでも僕が困惑してると思って、
　僕のために元気づけようとしてくれてる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wasn't expecting her answer, but I'm
willing to cheer her on!)

fields.EN:
Calling yourself a 'muscle woman' is pretty extreme,
but I'm happy you're having fun, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
筋肉女って凄い言い方だけど、
赤ずきんさんが楽しそうで僕も嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Body-builder, huh? Glad to see you're
having fun.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(That's odd. Now she's acting like a big sister
again.)
fields.JP:
（……なんだろう、今のほうが
　むしろお姉さんっぽいような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's odd. Now she's acting like a big sister
again.)

fields.EN:
Jack! You could use some muscle definition
too. Maybe we can work out together.
fields.JP:
ジャックもさ！
今は肉体労働が多いだろうし体力つけようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack! You could use some muscle definition
too. Maybe we can work out together.

fields.JP: 今度、あたしと一緒にジョギングでもしない？
それはいいね、喜んで参加するよ
えへへ、いい考えでしょー？

fields.EN: A lot has happened, but just being able to make a promise like this with you now makes me happy, Jack!
fields.JP:
その、色々あったけどさ。
今こうしてジャックとこんな風に約束出来るだけ
あたしは幸せだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Despite everything, I'm glad that the two
of us can make a life for ourselves.

fields.EN:
Y-Yeah. I hope we can keep enjoying ourselves like
this forever, Akazukin-san.
fields.JP:
う、うん。これからもずっとこんな風に
赤ずきんさんと楽しめたらいいなって思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I've been waiting for this day for
a long time.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).
