fields.EN: That's sweet of you to say. I don't know why, but I feel like a promise with you, Jack, won't be broken.
fields.JP:
嬉しいこと言ってくれるね。
なんでかな、ジャックとの約束は
破られない気がするよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You make me so happy. I just know I can
always depend on you.

fields.EN:
The future with you looks bright.
I can't wait for what's to come, Jack.
fields.JP:
これからも、あたしをよろしくね？
ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED:
The future with you looks bright.
I can't wait for what's to come, Jack.

fields.JP: こちらこそ、よろしく、赤ずきんさん。
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Oh, Oyayubihime! Thanks for coming out today.
Sorry, I know you were busy.
fields.JP:
あ、親指姫！　来てくれてありがとう。
忙しいのにごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Thumbelina! Thanks for coming out today.
Sorry, I know you were busy.

fields.EN: You called me out of the blue...
fields.LOCALIZED: You called me out of the blue...

fields.EN: But, guess it worked out in my favor.
fields.JP: ま、わたしも丁度話したかったからいいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED: But, guess it worked out in my favor.

fields.EN: Huh? What do you mean by that...?
fields.JP: え？　それってどういう……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? What do you mean by that...?

fields.EN: N-nothing! Anyways, why did you call me?!
fields.JP:
べ、別にどうだっていいでしょ！
それより何のために呼び出したのよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: N-nothing! Anyways, why did you call me?!

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime...
I feel relieved. She hasn't changed a bit.)
fields.JP:
（親指姫……
　変わってなくて少し安心したかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thumbelina...
I feel relieved. She hasn't changed a bit.)

fields.EN:
(Oh, come to think of it, I didn't exactly
have something in mind to talk about...)
fields.JP:
（あれ……でもそう言われてみると
　話したいと思ったけど何を話そうか
　全く考えてなかったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, come to think of it, I didn't exactly
have something in mind to talk about...)

fields.EN:
Don't you dare tell me you brought me
out here for no reason.
fields.JP:
……もしかして、ノープランで
ここまで来たんじゃないでしょうね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you dare tell me you brought me
out here for no reason.

fields.EN: Ugh! You haven't changed a bit!
fields.JP: もう！　あんたは相変わらず全然変わらないわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh! You haven't changed a bit!

fields.EN: How dare you waste a lady's time! You fool!
fields.JP:
レディーを無意味に呼びつけるなんて……
ほんっとバカね！
fields.LOCALIZED: How dare you waste a lady's time! You fool!

fields.EN:
Sorry, sorry. Didn't you say you wanted to
talk to me, too? What happened?!
fields.JP:
ごめんごめん。
そういう親指姫こそ、丁度話したかったって
言ってたけど、何かあったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, sorry. Didn't you say you wanted to
talk to me, too? What happened?!

fields.JP: いや、伸びてないと思うけど……

fields.EN:
So you didn't have anything you wanted to
say, either?
fields.JP: ……親指姫も特にないんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you didn't have anything you wanted to
say, either?

fields.JP:
べ、別にいいでしょ！
あんたと同じじゃない！
ほんと、変わってなくて安心したよ
あんたこそ、何も変わってないくせに

fields.EN: Did Juu and the others get the same treatment?
fields.JP: ジュウや他の人にもこんな風に接してたのかい？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did Toh and the others get the same treatment?

fields.EN: I only act like this in front of YOU, idiot.
fields.JP: バカね、こんな態度取るのはあんただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I only act like this in front of YOU, idiot.

fields.EN:
Wha! There's no special reason, if that's
what you're asking!
fields.JP:
ふぇっ！？
い、いや別に特別な意味なんてないわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha! There's no special reason, if that's
what you're asking!

fields.JP: 今日こうやって話して思ったよ

fields.EN:
Maybe I just wanted...some alone time
with you.
fields.JP:
こんな風にまた……
親指姫と当たり前の会話がしたかったのかもって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe I just wanted...some alone time
with you.

fields.EN:
I don't know about you, but when the new
world arrived, you were the first person I
wanted to speak with.
fields.JP:
親指姫がどう思うかはわからないけど、
僕はこの新しい世界になって、
初めて会いたいと思ったのは親指姫だったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know about you, but when the new
world arrived, you were the first person I
wanted to speak with.

fields.EN: So this means a lot to me.
fields.JP: だから、こうして今話せてとても嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: So this means a lot to me.

fields.JP: あんた随分大胆なことを言うようになったわね……

fields.EN:
Really? Maybe I have. I'm better at speaking
my mind.
fields.JP:
そうかな？
確かに前よりは思ったことを言うようになったかも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Maybe I have. I'm better at speaking
my mind.

fields.EN: Every day is precious to me now.
fields.JP: 毎日毎日を大事にしてきたから、かな
fields.LOCALIZED: Every day is precious to me now.

fields.JP: ま、まああんたにしては殊勝な考えじゃない？

fields.EN:
Oh! I have to get up early tomorrow!
I have to get going soon!
fields.JP:
あ！　明日も早いんだから！
そろそろ行くわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! I have to get up early tomorrow!
I have to get going soon!

fields.EN:
We'll see each other again soon, okay...!
Okay, Jack?!
fields.JP:
また近いうちにこんな風に会うわよ……！
ジャック！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll see each other again soon, okay...!
Okay, Jack?!

fields.EN:
(At least I got a second with the adorable
Oyayubihime. And I think she agreed to
another meeting...)
fields.JP:
（でも、変わらずかわいい親指姫と話せたし
　次の約束も出来たし……嬉しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At least I got a second with the adorable
Thumbelina. And I think she agreed to
another meeting...)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: おまたせ、しましっ――キャッ！！

fields.EN: Hehe. It's the sand. All good.
fields.JP: えへへ、砂場なんで全然大丈夫です
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. It's the sand. All good.

fields.EN:
Ever since my abilities left me, I've felt
myself becoming dull.
fields.JP:
やっぱり血式少女の力を失ったから
運動神経が落ちてしまってますね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since my abilities left me, I've felt
myself becoming dull.

fields.EN:
(Uh, I feel like she's always been clumsy...
Well, I guess I won't mention that.)
fields.JP:
（少しドジなところは前からのような……
　いや、言わないでおこう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uh, I feel like she's always been clumsy...
Well, I guess I won't mention that.)

fields.EN:
Still, I'm glad I finally have time to talk with you
like this, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
いや、それにしてもジャックさんとこんな風に
お話出来る時間が出来たなんて、よかったです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, I'm glad the two of us could meet
today.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: （……前より少しだけ積極的になったのかな？）

fields.EN: I'm glad you made time for me too.
fields.JP: 僕も白雪姫と話したかったから嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm glad you made time for me too.

fields.JP: いざ、そう言われると照れますね。えへへ
（でも、相変わらず素直でいい子だなあ……）

fields.EN: Anyway, isn't this ocean simply grand?
fields.JP:
それにしても、この'海'って本当に
広大で綺麗ですよね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, isn't this ocean simply grand?

fields.EN:
Yeah. I couldn't have pictured this when
we were underground or scurrying through
those Jails.
fields.JP:
地下監獄や地上の監獄塔じゃ
見られない景色だもんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I couldn't have pictured this when
we were underground or scurrying through
those Jails.

fields.EN:
I hear swimming in it's good fun. There's
still so much for us to discover!
fields.JP:
泳いでも楽しいって聞きますし、
まだまだ白雪たちの知らない楽しみ方が
いっぱいありそうですよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hear swimming in it's good fun. There's
still so much for us to discover!

fields.EN:
That's true. Maybe we can plan a beach
trip sometime soon.
fields.JP:
うん、そうだね。
いつかみんなを誘って泳いでみたいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's true. Maybe we can plan a beach
trip sometime soon.

fields.EN:
Splendid. But I'm not sure I'd be too
comfortable in a swimsuit. I must lose weight!
fields.JP:
いいですね。
でも、正直水着になるのは恥ずかしいですね……。
それまでにダイエットしないと……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Splendid. But I'm not sure I'd be too
comfortable in a swimsuit. I must lose weight!

fields.EN:
(She doesn't have to do that. She's perfect
the way she is.)
fields.JP:
（そんなことしなくても
　十分痩せてると思うんだけどなあ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She doesn't have to do that. She's perfect
the way she is.)

fields.EN:
(But if I say that, she'll get even more
self-conscious.)
fields.JP:
（でも、それを言うと
　余計に気にしちゃいそうだし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But if I say that, she'll get even more
self-conscious.)

fields.EN:
Either way, whatever comes next, we'll
learn to enjoy together.
fields.JP:
何にしても、まだまだこれから
知らない楽しいことが出来るといいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Either way, whatever comes next, we'll
learn to enjoy together.

fields.EN:
Right! Someone suggested a game that
we can play on our beach trip. Perfect.
fields.JP:
はいっ！
そういえば誰かからか聞いたんですけど、
『すいかわり』という浜辺遊びがあるみたいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! Someone suggested a game that
we can play on our beach trip. Perfect.

fields.EN:
With this plant called a "watermelon", you
close your eyes and spin until you're dizzy,
then try to crack it open blindfolded!
fields.JP:
スイカという植物を使って、目隠しして
身体をぐるぐる回して、ふらふらな状態で
スイカを叩き割るそうです
fields.LOCALIZED:
With this plant called a "watermelon", you
close your eyes and spin until you're dizzy,
then try to crack it open blindfolded!

fields.JP: そ、それは……何が面白いのか不思議だね
ふふ、白雪もそう思います

fields.EN: A beach trip, huh? The sand sounds nice too.
fields.JP:
浜辺遊びかあ……。
普通に砂とか使った遊びも出来そうだね
fields.LOCALIZED: A beach trip, huh? The sand sounds nice too.

fields.EN: Oh. I wonder if that's juvenile.
fields.JP: あ、でも子供っぽいかな……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. I wonder if that's juvenile.

fields.EN: You think? I'd like to try.
fields.JP:
そうですか？
白雪はやってみたいです
fields.LOCALIZED: You think? I'd like to try.

fields.EN:
Why don't we build a sand castle?
That sounds lovely.
fields.JP:
大きなお城を立ててみたりするのはどうですか？
面白そうだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't we build a sand castle?
That sounds lovely.

fields.JP: ……確かに、そう言われてみると楽しそうだね

fields.EN: We could play "Capture the Flag" too!
fields.JP:
動き回るなら『びーちふらっぐ』とかいう
遊びもあるみたいですよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: We could play "Capture the Flag" too!

fields.EN:
The objective is to see who can fetch the
flag first! We can dive since it's on sand.
fields.JP:
旗をめがけてみんなで競争するんです。
砂の上なので、飛び込むことも出来るんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The objective is to see who can fetch the
flag first! We can dive since it's on sand.

fields.EN: I see. Sounds like a competitive game.
fields.JP: なるほど、競技性があって面白そうだね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Sounds like a competitive game.

fields.EN:
Yes. I see Aka-neesama and Rapunzel-san giving it
their all.
fields.JP:
はい、赤姉様やラプンツェルさんは
はしゃいでくれそうです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I see Sister Red and Rapunzel giving it
their all.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Rapunzel might be too distracted with the
sand castle to play.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはお城を作るか
動き回るかどっちだろうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel might be too distracted with the
sand castle to play.

fields.EN:
She may do as she please, but shouldn't
all of us be free to live how we please?
fields.JP:
したいようにすると思いますよ？
その時、したいことを自由に遊べたら
素敵だと思いませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She may do as she please, but shouldn't
all of us be free to live how we please?

fields.EN:
(Ah. It's such a treat to sit and talk with
Shirayukihime about nothing.)
fields.JP:
（……ああ、白雪姫とこんな風に
　他愛もない普通の会話が愛しいと思う）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah. It's such a treat to sit and talk with
Snow White about nothing.)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Can we schedule more days like this?
fields.JP:
これからも、白雪とこんな他愛もない
普通の話に、付き合ってくれませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Can we schedule more days like this?

fields.EN: Wow... I had the same thought.
fields.JP:
……びっくりしたよ。
今、全く同じことを考えてた
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow... I had the same thought.

fields.JP:
本当ですか？
それは……嬉しいです

fields.EN:
Let's make the most of our time together,
Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
そうだね、これからもずっと
白雪姫と日常を楽しんでいきたいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's make the most of our time together,
Snow White.

fields.EN:
Let's chop watermelons and play capture
the flag. As long as we're together.
fields.JP:
『すいかわり』も『砂遊び』も
『びーちふらっぐ』も……
それ以外のあらゆる日常を楽しみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's chop watermelons and play capture
the flag. As long as we're together.

fields.EN: Even small talk like this is nice.
fields.JP: もちろんこうやってお話することも
fields.LOCALIZED: Even small talk like this is nice.

fields.JP:
お願いできるかな？
白雪姫
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you say, Snow White?

fields.EN: I want to experience it all with you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
これからもたくさんお喋りしたり
いろんな経験をしていきましょうね、ジャックさん
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to experience it all with you, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
ジャック～……

fields.EN:
*pant*...*pant*...
Do I look okay to you?
fields.JP:
はぁ……はぁ……
この姿を見て大丈夫と思いますか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant*...*pant*...
Do I look okay to you?

fields.JP:
大丈夫なわけないです～
……はぁ……はぁ……

fields.EN:
Right, okay. What do you wanna do?
Wanna go home?
fields.JP:
そうだよね……。うん……。
どうする？　今日はもう家に戻る？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, okay. What do you wanna do?
Wanna go home?

fields.EN:
You idiot~ I only came here because of you,
Jack. Why on earth would I go home?!
fields.JP:
バカですね～……
ジャックに会いたいから来たのに
それじゃあ意味ありませんよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You idiot~ I only came here because of you,
Jack. Why on earth would I go home?!

fields.JP: （と、とりあえず落ち着くまで待とう……）

ふぅ～。
だいぶ落ち着きました～
まだ二足歩行は慣れない？

fields.EN: Hehe. You treat me like a child.
fields.JP: ふふっ、その言い方ではまるで赤子じゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You treat me like a child.

fields.EN:
But before you used Bamboo One to 
float around.
fields.JP:
でも、ずっとバンブー１号の力で
移動してたわけだしさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But before you used Bamboo One to 
float around.

fields.EN:
(Now that peace has been restored, Kaguyahime
lost her powers, which means she's practically
human.)
fields.JP:
（平和な世界に戻って、普通の女の子に戻り
　血式能力を失ったかぐや姫は、当然だけど
　『バンブー１号』を操る力も失った）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now that peace has been restored, Kaguya
lost her powers, which means she's practically
human.)

fields.EN:
(As a result, she's not too strong, but she
seems like she's working on it.)
fields.JP:
（その反動かやはり体力は極端にないわけで、
　少しずつ体力をつけているらしいのだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As a result, she's not too strong, but she
seems like she's working on it.)

fields.EN:
Walking is a hassle. I have been training my
stamina, but even getting up is a challenge.
fields.JP:
やはり歩くのも疲れますね～。
疲れないように運動をしたいんですが、
基本めんどくさいことばかりです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Walking is a hassle. I have been training my
stamina, but even getting up is a challenge.

fields.EN:
Looks like learning to walk hasn't changed
you much.
fields.JP:
自力で歩かないといけなくなってもその精神は
変わらないんだね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like learning to walk hasn't changed
you much.

fields.JP:
むむ、ジャックのくせに生意気なことを
言っていますね～

fields.EN: Hehe. It's all about taking one step at a time.
fields.JP:
ふふ。
まあめんどくさいですけど、
少しずつ動けるようにはしていきますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. It's all about taking one step at a time.

fields.EN:
So, why did you summon this weak, delicate
girl from her stead?
fields.JP:
で、こんな可憐で貧弱なわらわを
呼び出して何か用ですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, why did you summon this weak, delicate
girl from her stead?

fields.JP: それ、自分で言っちゃうんだ……

fields.EN: Knowing you Jack, it's nothing serious.
fields.JP:
ジャックのことですから、
大した用事はないんじゃないですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Knowing you Jack, it's nothing serious.

fields.EN: Well, you got me. I just wanted to catch up.
fields.JP:
いや、まあ……その通りなんだけど。
その、かぐや姫と久しぶりに
２人で話したいと思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, you got me. I just wanted to catch up.

fields.EN:
Very well. You summon me too casually,
too often. You ask too much of me.
fields.JP:
ふぅん……。
ここまで来るのに一苦労なわらわを
気軽に呼びすぎですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. You summon me too casually,
too often. You ask too much of me.

fields.EN:
Regardless, I count myself lucky for being
summoned.
fields.JP:
ま、わらわもそう思って来たので、
運が良かったですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, I count myself lucky for being
summoned.

fields.EN: So you think luck brought you here?
fields.JP: 来てくれたのは運だったの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So you think luck brought you here?

fields.EN: I kid, but the timing is good for us both.
fields.JP:
冗談です～。
まあタイミングがあったのは否定しないですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED: I kid, but the timing is good for us both.

fields.EN:
I know this may not be the best time to say
this, but I'm grateful I survived.
fields.JP:
このタイミングでいうのもなんですが～……
わらわ達は生き残ってしまいましたね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know this may not be the best time to say
this, but I'm grateful I survived.

fields.EN: Huh? Well, you did more than survive.
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Well, you did more than survive.

fields.JP: ……わらわの話を聞いてくれますか～？

fields.EN:
When the moon was pulled towards the
tower, I was met with a vision.
fields.JP:
悪食の監隊塔であの月が迫ってきた時……
わらわの覚えのない記憶が入ってきました
fields.LOCALIZED:
When the moon was pulled towards the
tower, I was met with a vision.

fields.EN: I thought the moon had come to take me.
fields.JP: このまま結局わらわは月に還るのかと思うほどに
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought the moon had come to take me.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Thinking back, it might have been my
cells reacting to the moon. I attribute it to my
Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
ふふ、今思えばわらわの血式リビドー、
童話としての細胞が月に反応したんでしょうね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Thinking back, it might have been my
cells reacting to the moon. I attribute it to my
Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
I thought to myself, "At last, I return to
the moon..."
fields.JP:
ああ……これで月に還るんだ……。
そう思いました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought to myself, "At last, I return to
the moon..."

fields.JP: でも、それを阻止してくれた人がいるんです

fields.EN:
Yeah. I didn't want to let you go, so I stopped
it from happening.
fields.JP:
……うん。かぐや姫を月に還したくなかったから。
そんなことさせるか、ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I didn't want to let you go, so I stopped
it from happening.

fields.EN: Hehe... Yes. And I'm blessed that you did.
fields.JP:
ふふ。
ええ、今回もわらわは還らずに済みましたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe... Yes. And I'm blessed that you did.

fields.EN:
This time, a man that WASN'T you put up 
a good fight. I suppose I owe him my thanks.
fields.JP:
……今回は、ジャック以外の不器用な男性も
奮闘してましたし、その方にも感謝ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This time, a man that WASN'T you put up 
a good fight. I suppose I owe him my thanks.

fields.EN: A man who truly loved his wife.
fields.JP: あの方は大変な愛妻家だったんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: A man who truly loved his wife.

fields.EN:
She's a lucky woman, to be loved so much.
I hope one day to find myself a man who
treats me with such dignity.
fields.JP:
あそこまで愛される相手はさぞ嬉しいだろうなと
考えるとわらわにもいつかあのように
思ってくれる殿方が現れるか期待しちゃいますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's a lucky woman, to be loved so much.
I hope one day to find myself a man who
treats me with such dignity.

fields.EN: I'm sure you will some day, Kaguyahime!
fields.JP:
かぐや姫ならきっと
そう遠くない未来に現れるよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sure you will some day, Kaguya!

fields.JP:
ふふっ……。
それは楽しみです～

fields.EN:
Regardless, a new dawn awaits us.
I find myself ready to take it on.
fields.JP:
何にしても僕たちの新しい毎日は日々進んでいく。
きっとまた大変なことが多い日々になる気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
Regardless, a new dawn awaits us.
I find myself ready to take it on.

fields.EN:
But, if possible, on days we're both off,
I would like to do this again.
fields.JP:
だけど、その……だからもし、よければまた
休みの日があえば、こうして話したいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, if possible, on days we're both off,
I would like to do this again.

fields.EN: This is what we dreamt of. Let's enjoy it, Jack.
fields.JP:
せっかく手に入れた平和ですからね～。
満喫していきましょう、ジャック
fields.LOCALIZED: This is what we dreamt of. Let's enjoy it, Jack.

fields.JP: うん！　もちろんだよ、かぐや姫！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: (Cinderella is so well-dressed. What a beauty.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても今日のシンデレラは
　すごいおしゃれに見える……きれいだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Cinderella is so well-dressed. What a beauty.)

fields.JP: すぐそちらに行きますわー！

ここ、砂場だから足を取られないように
気をつけて――

――ってシンデレラ！？
大丈夫！？

fields.EN:
(She got sand all over, even in her outfit!
Come on, man! Don't stare!)
fields.JP:
（髪の毛に砂がついちゃってる……
　服も乱れて……って見てる場合じゃない！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She got sand all over, even in her outfit!
Come on, man! Don't stare!)

fields.EN:
Are you okay? Are you hurt at all?
You're covered in sand!
fields.JP:
大丈夫？　怪我とかしてない？
ほら、砂がついちゃってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you okay? Are you hurt at all?
You're covered in sand!

fields.EN:
No...! I got all dressed up because I was so excited
to see you, Jack-san... and now it's all ruined!
fields.JP:
違いますの……！
せっかく！　ジャックさんに会えると思って
気合を入れてきましたのに……台無しですわーー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No...! I was so excited to see you that I got
dressed up! The day's ruined!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Oh...but that's so nice of you!
fields.JP: そ、そう……。それは嬉しいよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh...but that's so nice of you!

fields.EN:
I prepared myself thinking we would attend
a dance party! I spent all day getting ready
after receiving your invitation!
fields.JP:
舞踏会に行くくらい気合を入れましたのに！
誘われた日から色々試行錯誤してましたのに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I prepared myself thinking we would attend
a dance party! I spent all day getting ready
after receiving your invitation!

fields.JP:
あの……シンデレラ？
怪我とかは……

fields.EN:
I guess I'm no better dealing with sand
than I am with ash...
fields.JP:
結局わたくしは灰かぶり……いえ、砂かぶりが
お似合いということなのかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess I'm no better dealing with sand
than I am with ash...

fields.JP: （僕の話、全然聞いてくれてないな……）

fields.EN:
(I guess even after losing her powers, she's
still prone to pouty fits. It's cute though.)
fields.JP:
（ヤケになってる姿は普通の女の子に
　なっても変わらないなあ。
　逆に微笑ましくなってくるよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess even after losing her powers, she's
still prone to pouty fits. It's cute though.)

fields.EN:
I let you see me looking this ragged... I can hardly
face you, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
もうこんなボロボロの姿を見せてしまって……
ジャックさんに顔向け出来ませんわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I look horrendous now. I can hardly face you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
は、はいっ……。
え……あ、ジャックさん……？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: …………シンデレラは、すごく綺麗だよ

fields.EN:
What...? But I'm covered in sand, and my
hair is a bird's nest.
fields.JP:
そ、そんなっ……。
こんな身体中砂だらけで
髪の毛もみだれてますのよ……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What...? But I'm covered in sand, and my
hair is a bird's nest.

fields.EN: Even still, you're beautiful as ever.
fields.JP: うん、それでも凄く綺麗だと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Even still, you're beautiful as ever.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ふふ、やっぱりジャックさんは優しいんですのね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: You think? Just telling you the truth.
fields.JP:
そうかな？
思ったことを素直に言ってるだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You think? Just telling you the truth.

fields.EN:
And today, I wanted to take a walk with such a
beautiful Cinderella while we talked about
everything that's happened until now.
fields.JP:
そしてそんな綺麗なシンデレラと今日は
今までのことを話しながら散歩したかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I hoped we could take a walk.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: Hehe. Is that why you called me here?
fields.JP:
……ふふっ、そんな他愛もないことで
わたくしを呼んだんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Is that why you called me here?

fields.EN: Don't want to? I wouldn't mind a chat too.
fields.JP:
ダメかな？
シンデレラとどうしても話したくなっちゃったから
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't want to? I wouldn't mind a chat too.

fields.EN: No, that sounds amazing. Count me in.
fields.JP:
いいえ、ダメなわけありません。
とっても嬉しいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: No, that sounds amazing. Count me in.

fields.JP: あはは、それはよかった

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: It's been so long since I've laid eyes on you...
fields.JP:
久々に会って早々言うのもおかしいと
思うんですが……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's been so long since I've laid eyes on you...

fields.EN:
And within minutes I've made myself out
to be a bumbling fool.
fields.JP:
今日はお恥ずかしいところを
たくさんお見せしてしまいました……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And within minutes I've made myself out
to be a bumbling fool.

fields.EN: Don't be so hard on yourself.
fields.JP: そんな、気にしなくていいのに
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be so hard on yourself.

fields.EN:
Actually, embarrassing as it is, I got carried away
because I thought I'd get to meet with you alone,
Jack-san.
fields.JP:
……実は、お恥ずかしいことに
ジャックさんと２人きりで会えると思って
はしゃいでしまいましたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, I had been dreaming of this moment
with you for ages.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
That's why I tripped and ended up causing you
trouble too, Jack-san...
fields.JP:
そのせいで転んでしまい、
ジャックさんにもご迷惑をおかけしてしまい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hence why I tripped, and subsequently
troubled you...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Next time I see you, it'll be perfect!
fields.JP:
ですので、今度会う時は、
リベンジさせて頂きますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Next time I see you, it'll be perfect!

fields.EN:
Next time, I want my outfit to be perfect,
and cooler heads will prevail.
fields.JP:
ちゃんとした身なりで、きちんと落ち着いた状態で
次はお会いしたいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Next time, I want my outfit to be perfect,
and cooler heads will prevail.

fields.EN: So you were excited, huh? Makes sense.
fields.JP: 僕と会うためにはしゃいでくれたんだ……嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: So you were excited, huh? Makes sense.

fields.EN: We can do this as many times as you want.
fields.JP: シンデレラの気が済むまでリベンジしよう
fields.LOCALIZED: We can do this as many times as you want.

fields.EN:
Now that we're safe, we can hang out every
single day if you want.
fields.JP:
もう今は世界が平和になったことだし、
それこそ時間が合えば毎日会ってもいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we're safe, we can hang out every
single day if you want.

fields.EN: I enjoy our time together too, Cinderella.
fields.JP: 僕もシンデレラとこうして話すのも楽しいから
fields.LOCALIZED: I enjoy our time together too, Cinderella.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Hehe. Thank you. I can't wait for what the
holds for us.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ありがとうございます。
それじゃあこれからもお願いしますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Thank you. I can't wait for what the
holds for us.

fields.EN:
The next time you see me, I will dazzle you
with my outfit. Prepare yourself, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
今度会う時はもっと綺麗になっていましてよ？
覚悟してくださいね、ジャックさん
fields.LOCALIZED:
The next time you see me, I will dazzle you
with my outfit. Prepare yourself, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ははっ、楽しみにしてるよ。シンデレラ

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: 今度こそ僕たちの勝ちだ！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Over? You think this is over?
fields.JP: 終わり……？　終わりだと……
fields.LOCALIZED: Over? You think this is over?

fields.JP: そんな、まだ立ち上がって……！

fields.EN: Gato, enough! What's the point in all this?!
fields.JP:
ガトーさん、もうやめてくれ！
こんなことしてなんになるんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Gato, enough! What's the point in all this?!

fields.EN:
Taking and killing won't do anything!
We just want to LIVE!
fields.JP:
奪っても、殺しても、何も始まらない。
僕たちは生きるためにここにいるはずだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Taking and killing won't do anything!
We just want to LIVE!

fields.EN: That's why we don't want to kill you.
fields.JP: だから、あなたを殺したくはないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's why we don't want to kill you.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto
Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You don't want to kill me? Even now,
you cannot overcome your pathetic
nature.
fields.JP:
殺したくない……？　まだそんな
蛆虫みたいなことを言っているのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't want to kill me? Even now,
you cannot overcome your pathetic
nature.

fields.JP: まさか、飛び降りて逃げるつもりじゃ……

fields.EN:
From that height, there's no way he would
survive.
fields.JP:
さすがにこの高さから飛び降りたら、
無事では済まないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
From that height, there's no way he would
survive.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Do you pity me? Me? Save it.
It's quite nice up here actually.
fields.JP:
俺を哀れむか？　どうだ？　今の気分は。
実に心地よいだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you pity me? Me? Save it.
It's quite nice up here actually.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Yet another example of mankind's procilivity
of mistaking ignorance for superiority.
fields.JP:
そうだ、そうやって人は他人を見下し、蔑み、
「自分はあいつよりマシだ」と安堵する生き物だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yet another example of mankind's procilivity
of mistaking ignorance for superiority.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
People love to judge, and anyone outside
of their purview of judgment is deemed evil.
fields.JP:
そのくせ正義や悪にはことさら敏感で、
すぐ誰かに『悪』のレッテルを貼る
fields.LOCALIZED:
People love to judge, and anyone outside
of their purview of judgment is deemed evil.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: They preach freedom and equality, fraternity and reason, yet hate change and exclude anything simply for being different.
fields.JP:
自由と平等、友愛と理性をうたいながら
変化を嫌い、異質というだけで排除する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Freedom, equality. Friendship. Reason.
Qualities preached only by the fearful.
But the fearful can become dangerous.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
There is no evil in resisting collective
thinking. In fact, it is human to question.
fields.JP:
そこには悪意などない。
人が最初から持つ本能のようなものだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is no evil in resisting collective
thinking. In fact, it is human to question.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
However, it seems my failing was killing
too many people!
fields.JP: だから、俺の失敗は、人を殺しすぎたこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, it seems my failing was killing
too many people!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
If I had allowed one hundred to live, then
perhaps they would have seen through your
purity. Everything would be different.
fields.JP:
きっと１００人も生かしておけば、お前らの純粋さを
人々は呪い、妬み、こんな風にはならなかっただろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I had allowed one hundred to live, then
perhaps they would have seen through your
purity. Everything would be different.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
The precious people you hope to save would
have been the same people to drag you back
down into Hell.
fields.JP: そう、疎まれたのはお前ら蛆虫の方だったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The precious people you hope to save would
have been the same people to drag you back
down into Hell.

fields.EN: It's true, not everyone is strong. But everyone wants to be happy...!
fields.JP:
確かにみんながみんな、強いわけじゃないよ。
でも、みんな幸せになりたいはずなんだ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. You worthless pests would have
been ostracized.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
That's no reason to kill innocent people!
Everyone deserves happiness!
fields.JP:
だから自分たちが間違ってないと、
皆分かってくれたはずだと？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's no reason to kill innocent people!
Everyone deserves happiness!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Ha! You are delusional. You underestimate
the cruelty of man.
fields.JP:
はっ！　現実がまったく見えていない。
人という種の醜さを理解していない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ha! You are delusional. You underestimate
the cruelty of man.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
You are nothing more than bugs festering in
humanity's rotten corpses. You're maggots!
fields.JP: まさに人類という腐乱した身体から沸き出す蛆虫だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are nothing more than bugs festering in
humanity's rotten corpses. You're maggots!

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
I guarantee you! Whatever legacy you hope
to build will be tarnished by pure ignorance.
fields.JP:
必ずだ！　生き残った人間たちは、
いずれ必ずお前たちを疎むようになるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guarantee you! Whatever legacy you hope
to build will be tarnished by pure ignorance.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN:
Even if you "save" this world, the weak will
challenge you, if only to stake their own
survival.
fields.JP:
その行為が、腐った世界を救うためのものだとしても
ただ「見たくない」というだけで弱者はお前らを攻撃する！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even if you "save" this world, the weak will
challenge you, if only to stake their own
survival.

fields.EN: Even if that's true, it doesn't change the situation we're in now.
fields.JP:
仮にそうだとしても、
今のこの状況は変わらない。
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is neither here nor there. What matters
is what we do with you.

fields.EN:
She's right. You lost. And we're reclaiming
this world.
fields.JP:
そうよ、あなたは負けた。
私たちは、これから平和な世界を取り戻す。
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. You lost. And we're reclaiming
this world.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Hmph. You fools will never understand.
fields.JP: ふん……まあ、お前らには理解できないだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph. You fools will never understand.

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: Right... I'd forgotten that the ones who kill maggots are always humans without malice.
fields.JP:
ああ、蛆虫を殺すのはいつだって、
悪意のない人間だということを忘れていたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But far be it from me to educate the maggots
on their path to destruction.

fields.JP: 待って、それ以上踏み出したら危険――

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.JP: ハハハハハハ、ただ俺に後悔はない！

fields.notes: Japanese full-name order/waapuro: 賀東 優人 => Gatou Yuuto

fields.EN: I've killed and tormented innocent people, but I haven't done a single thing wrong!
fields.JP:
悪意のない人間を殺し、苦しめたこの俺に
何一つ非はないのだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have rightfully punished those who would
have rather me suffered!

fields.EN: What an unfitting end to a tyrant...
fields.JP: まさか、こんなかたちで自ら幕を下ろすなんてね
fields.LOCALIZED: What an unfitting end to a tyrant...

fields.EN:
Is this what he wanted? To make others
and himself unhappy?
fields.JP:
これがあの人のやりたかったことなの？
他人も自分も不幸にして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this what he wanted? To make others
and himself unhappy?

fields.EN: But... it also felt like he was desperately trying to appeal to us. Maybe he really wanted to change something too.
fields.JP:
でも……なんだか、僕らに必死に訴えてたようにも思う。
あの人も本当は何かを変えたかったんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...I feel like he's trying to tell us
something.

fields.EN: Guys, there's no time. The moon's approaching.
fields.JP:
みんな、時間がないわ。
月がもうそこまで迫っている
fields.LOCALIZED: Guys, there's no time. The moon's approaching.

fields.JP: そうだね。立ち止まってる場合じゃない

fields.EN:
We have to use Witchcraft to wish, or else
everything will go to waste.
fields.JP:
一刻も早く大きなウィッチクラフトに
願いを込めないと、すべてが無駄になる
fields.LOCALIZED:
We have to use Witchcraft to wish, or else
everything will go to waste.

fields.EN: What do we do? Who'll make the wish?
fields.JP: どうしよう、誰が願いを込める？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do we do? Who'll make the wish?

fields.EN: It has to be you, Jack.
fields.JP: わたしは、ジャックにお願いしたい
fields.LOCALIZED: It has to be you, Jack.

fields.EN:
You put everyone else first. You've been fighting
for us since day one.
fields.JP:
誰よりもみんなのことを考えて、
必死に抗ってきたのはジャックだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
You put everyone else first. You've been fighting
for us since day one.

fields.EN: B-But isn't that true of everyone?
fields.JP: そ、それはみんなだってそうじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED: I just did what I was supposed to...

fields.EN:
No, Jack. You are a savior to the wounded
and to those with shaken faith.
fields.JP:
いいえ。ジャックは傷ついた人を、
挫けそうな人をいつだって助けてくれたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, Jack. You are a savior to the wounded
and to those with shaken faith.

fields.EN:
Myself included. If it wasn't for you, I never
would have made it this far.
fields.JP:
もちろん、わたしもそのひとり。あなたがいなければ、
きっとここまで来ることはできなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Myself included. If it wasn't for you, I never
would have made it this far.

fields.EN:
Same here, Jack. You gave your life to me
even when I became a Nightmare.
fields.JP:
僕もだ。ジャックは
ナイトメアになった僕にも手を差し伸べてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Same here, Jack. You gave your life to me
even when I became a Nightmare.

fields.EN:
You helped realize a future that I could share
with everyone. You've done more than anyone.
fields.JP:
そうやって、みんなと生きる未来を
誰よりも築き上げてきてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You helped realize a future that I could share
with everyone. You've done more than anyone.

fields.EN: So, I entrust this task to you.
fields.JP: だから僕も、ジャックにお願いしたい
fields.LOCALIZED: So, I entrust this task to you.

fields.EN: Without you Jack-san, I wouldn't be here.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがいなかったら、
わたしはこの世界では死んでいたんだもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Without you Jack, I wouldn't be here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Even in the alternate world, Jack-san, you were
a Nightmare and gave your all.
fields.JP:
それにジャックさんは、自分がナイトメアになっても
みんなを守ろうとしてくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even in the alternate world, Jack, you were
a Nightmare and gave your all.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
That's why I'd like to ask a favor of someone as
kind as you, Jack-san.
fields.JP:
だからわたしも、
そんな優しいジャックさんにお願いしたいな
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't think of anyone better suited than you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Are you sure you trust me?
fields.JP: そんな大役、本当に僕でいいの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you sure you trust me?

fields.EN:
It wasn't a question of trust. It's a question
of total faith.
fields.JP:
君でいいんじゃない。
君がいいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't a question of trust. It's a question
of total faith.

fields.EN:
Jack, everything falls on you. We're right
behind you.
fields.JP:
ジャック、私たちのぜんぶ……
あなたに托すわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, everything falls on you. We're right
behind you.

fields.EN: I'll cast my wish to the Witchcraft.
fields.JP: 僕がウィッチクラフトに願いを込めるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll cast my wish to the Witchcraft.

fields.EN:
(After so many failures, after so many broken
hearts, we finally have our chance to fix things.)
fields.JP:
（今まで何度も挫けて、心を折られて、
　それでも立ち上がってきた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(After so many failures, after so many broken
hearts, we finally have our chance to fix things.)

fields.EN:
(I want a future where all of us can exist
together in peace.)
fields.JP: （すべてはみんなと生きる未来のため）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want a future where all of us can exist
together in peace.)

fields.EN: (That's right. We all feel the same way, and that will never waver.)
fields.JP:
（そう。みんなの想いは一つで、
　それは決して揺らがないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (All of us want the same thing.)

fields.JP: ウィッチクラフトよ！　僕の願いは――

（これまでの日々は、
　すべて幻だったんじゃないか――）

fields.EN:
(Can't help but think so when the sunlight
seeps in slowly on a lazy day.)
fields.JP:
（こんな柔らかい日差しの中でウトウトしてると、
　ついそんな風に思っちゃうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Can't help but think so when the sunlight
seeps in slowly on a lazy day.)

fields.EN:
(But, of course, it wasn't a dream or some
hallucination. It all happened.)
fields.JP:
（もちろん、夢でも幻でもなく、
　全部本当の出来事だったんだけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But, of course, it wasn't a dream or some
hallucination. It all happened.)

fields.EN: (When I woke up after that, everything was gone. The red moon, the ruined landscape strewn with corpses...)
fields.JP:
（あの後目が覚めると、すべてが無くなっていた。
　赤い月も、死体が転がる荒れ果てた光景も……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When I woke up, everything was gone. The
red sky. The desolate landscape littered with
corpses...)

fields.JP: （監獄塔すらも忽然と姿を消していたんだ）

fields.EN:
(Before me was a shimmering emerald world,
something out of a fantasy.)
fields.JP:
（そして目の前に広がっていたのは、
　ずっと夢に見ていた、緑溢れる景色）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Before me was a shimmering emerald world,
something out of a fantasy.)

fields.EN: (It was as if the suffering had never occurred.)
fields.JP:
（僕たちを苦しめていた世界なんて、
　最初からなかったかのような変化だった）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It was as if the suffering had never occurred.)

fields.EN:
(Witchcraft is truly mind-blowing. The sheer
power of desire.)
fields.JP:
（願いを具現化させるといウィッチクラフトの力に
　あの時は誰もが驚愕しただろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Witchcraft is truly mind-blowing. The sheer
power of desire.)

fields.EN:
(But this wasn't made possible because of
some wish...)
fields.JP: （でも、実はそうじゃないんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But this wasn't made possible because of
some wish...)

fields.EN:
(Because what I asked the Witchcraft for was...
Nothing.)
fields.JP:
（だってあの時、僕はウィッチクラフトに
　『何も願わなかった』んだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Because what I asked the Witchcraft for was...
Nothing.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe not making a wish made all the
difference, and the Jail believed its purpose
was fulfilled.)
fields.JP:
（もしかしたら僕が願わなかったことで、ジェイルは
　自らの役割を終えたと思ったのかもしれない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe not making a wish made all the
difference, and the Jail believed its purpose
was fulfilled.)

fields.EN: (Then it no longer needed to make flowers bloom ever again, so it stopped operating.)
fields.JP:
（それで、もう二度と花を咲かせる
　必要がなくなって、その活動を停止させた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With the desire for blood extinguished,
the Jail ceased to exist.)

fields.EN:
(Slowly but surely, the Jail relinquished its
energy stores, returning its nutrients to their
rightful and original places.)
fields.JP:
（結果、吸い上げられていた養分が大地に還り、
　あるべき元の姿に戻った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Slowly but surely, the Jail relinquished its
energy stores, returning its nutrients to their
rightful and original places.)

fields.JP: （なんて、これはただの僕の憶測だけどね）
ジャック！　準備できたかい？
もうほとんどみんな集まってるよー

fields.EN:
(I promised Haru-san I'd help him plant a new
kind of seed.)
fields.JP:
（今日はハルさんたちと、
　新しい作物を植える約束をしているんだった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I promised Haru I'd help him plant a new
kind of seed.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
(Apparently the ground is fertil enough to
grow fruits and veggies.)
fields.JP:
（これからは色々な野菜や
　果物を食べられるようになるんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Apparently the ground is fertil enough to
grow fruits and veggies.)

fields.EN: (But plowing the fields really was hard... I think the Blood Maidens felt that especially strongly.)
fields.JP:
（でも畑を耕すのは本当に大変だったな……。
　血式少女のみんなは、特にそう感じたと思う）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, plowing is hard work... I know the
Blood Maidens can back me up with that.)

fields.EN:
(Especailly since, after the Jail disappeared
they all lost their abilities and Libido.)
fields.JP:
（なんせ、ジェイルが消えるのと一緒に、
　今までのような能力やリビドーがなくなったからね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Especailly since, after the Jail disappeared
they all lost their abilities and Libido.)

fields.EN:
(So now, they can live as normal girls.
Sore muscles, weight training, the works.)
fields.JP:
（だからみんな普通の女の子として、
　筋肉痛と闘いながら鍬を振るっている毎日だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So now, they can live as normal girls.
Sore muscles, weight training, the works.)

fields.EN: (Well, I guess I'm normal now too...)
fields.JP: （まあそれは僕も同じなんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Well, I guess I'm normal now too...)

fields.EN:
(Actually, I still don't think I can beat any
of them in an arm wrestle...)
fields.JP:
（っていうか、今でも元血式少女のみんなに
　腕相撲で勝てる気はしないんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Actually, I still don't think I can beat any
of them in an arm wrestle...)

fields.EN:
(But from here on, the Blood Maidens and
Blood Youth are no more. We're all humans.)
fields.JP:
（とにかく『血式少女』も『血式少年』ももういない。
　みんなひとりの普通の人間に戻ったんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But from here on, the Blood Maidens and
Blood Youth are no more. We're all humans.)

fields.EN:
(Which is exactly the way we like it.
Now we can laugh and adventure together.)
fields.JP:
（でもそれでいいし、それがいい。みんなで
　同じように悩んで、同じように笑い合って――
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Which is exactly the way we like it.
Now we can laugh and adventure together.)

fields.EN:
(Once our village was settled, we began the
first day of the rest of our lives. Peace at last.)
fields.JP:
（そうやって村を作り、
　生活を再建していく今が愛おしいんだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Once our village was settled, we began the
first day of the rest of our lives. Peace at last.)

fields.EN:
Oh, where's Alice? I thought she'd be in your 
room.
fields.JP:
あれ、アリスはいないのか。
ジャックの部屋にいると思ったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, where's Alice? I thought she'd be in your 
room.

fields.EN:
Hmm. I wonder where she went.
Do you have any idea, Jack-san?
fields.JP:
うーん、どこ行っちゃったんだろうね？
ジャックさん、心当たりある？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. I wonder where she went.
Do you have any idea, Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Yeah, I have a hunch.
I'll go check over there.
fields.JP:
うん。何となくだけどね。
ちょっと行ってみようか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I have a hunch.
I'll go check over there.

fields.JP: （きっとまた、シャーロットさんと一緒だろうな）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP: あらアリス、目が覚めたのね

fields.EN: Hehe. Looks like you had quite the dream.
fields.JP: ふふ、随分と長いこと夢を見ていたようね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Looks like you had quite the dream.

fields.EN: Were you watching this whole time?
fields.JP: も、もしかしてずっと見ていたの……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Were you watching this whole time?

fields.JP: ええ。寝顔、とっても可愛かったわよ
シャーロットの意地悪……

fields.EN: Aw, don't pout. Come now, everyone's here.
fields.JP: 拗ねないの。ほら、みんなが来たわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, don't pout. Come now, everyone's here.

fields.EN: Hey Charlotte, this isn't a dream is it?
fields.JP:
ねえシャーロット。
わたし、今日は夢なんて見てないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Charlotte, this isn't a dream is it?

fields.EN: With everyone here...I can hardly tell.
fields.JP:
ただ、今目の前にみんながいる……
それが夢みたいなのだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED: With everyone here...I can hardly tell.

fields.EN:
(I wonder if everyone's adjusted to their new
lives yet.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても昔の生活に慣れてる人は
　今の生活大丈夫かな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if everyone's adjusted to their new
lives yet.)

fields.EN: (Ouch. Bumped into something. What was that?)
fields.JP:
（いたた……なにかにぶつかっちゃったな。
　前はしっかり見てたはずなんだけど）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ouch. Bumped into something. What was that?)

fields.JP:
（あれ、メアリー？
　……そっか、メアリーにぶつかっちゃったのか）
！？　お、おまえはジャック……さん……？

fields.EN:
(She's...weird. Especially her speech.
Maybe she's shy.)
fields.JP:
（……なんていうか、独特な間のある子だな。
　もしかして人見知りとか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's...weird. Especially her speech.
Maybe she's shy.)

fields.JP: ふん……なんだよ、謝りもしねーで……
え！　……あ、あのー、えっと、ごめん……？

fields.EN:
(Huh? Who was at fault there? Didn't I already
apologize? Maybe she didn't hear me.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　とっさに謝っちゃったけど、
　さっきも謝ったような……。
　メアリーには聞こえてなかったのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Who was at fault there? Didn't I already
apologize? Maybe she didn't hear me.)

fields.EN: Tch. He heard me... Man has crazy ears.
fields.JP: ちっ……。聞こえてたのかよ、地獄耳め……
fields.LOCALIZED: Tch. He heard me... Man has crazy ears.

fields.EN: Um... We haven't really talked much, have we?
fields.JP:
えーと……こうして二人で話す機会って
あんまりなかったよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Um... We haven't really talked much, have we?

fields.EN:
(Why does she seem closed off? What can
I say to get her to open up?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだか心を閉ざされているような？
　こんなときってなにを話せばいいんだ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why does she seem closed off? What can
I say to get her to open up?)

fields.EN:
Well, I'll watch where I'm going next time. 
Sorry about that!
fields.JP:
とにかくこれからは前に気をつけて歩くよ。
ぶつかっちゃってごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'll watch where I'm going next time. 
Sorry about that!

fields.EN:
Rgh... This is why I hate people who know
how to communicate.
fields.JP: ぐ……、これだからコミュ力高いやつは……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh... This is why I hate people who know
how to communicate.

fields.EN: Oh. Are you hurt? Any bumps?
fields.JP:
あれ、もしかしてどこか痛いの？
怪我してるとか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Are you hurt? Any bumps?

fields.EN:
Ugh. It's okay! It's OKAY! Sorry for just
standing here...
fields.JP:
もういい、もういい！
あ、あたしもこんなとこに突っ立ってて
悪かったよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. It's okay! It's OKAY! Sorry for just
standing here...

fields.EN: Nothing, um... I... I was at fault. Yes.
fields.JP:
いっ、いやいや、えっと……俺……
あ、あたしも悪かったですよ。はい
fields.LOCALIZED: Nothing, um... I... I was at fault. Yes.

fields.EN: Huh? Oh, no no. Forgive me.
fields.JP:
へ？　いえいえ、そんな。
こっちこそごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Oh, no no. Forgive me.

fields.JP: （……なんで互いに謝ってるんだろう）

fields.EN:
I thought... Is he mad at me, is he not?
Is he like Charlotte...? A good person?
fields.JP:
こいつ……怒ったと思ったけど違うのか……？
もしかしてシャーロットと同じで
いいやつ……なのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought... Is he mad at me, is he not?
Is he like Charlotte...? A good person?

fields.EN: (Should I respond to her mumbling to herself?)
fields.JP:
（一人でなにか言ってるけど、
　あんまり反応しないほうがいいのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Should I respond to her mumbling to herself?)

fields.EN:
Gotta figure out what to do with my last
matches... Later.
fields.JP:
俺はこれから、数少なくなってきたマッチ棒を
どう使うか考えなきゃならないんだ。
……じゃあな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotta figure out what to do with my last
matches... Later.

fields.EN: Wait! I thought you were saving them!
fields.JP:
え、マッチ棒ってもうあんまりないから
使わないって話じゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait! I thought you were saving them!

fields.EN:
You never know what's going on! I'm only
THINKING about what to do with 'em!
fields.JP:
な、なにがあるかわかんないだろ！
考えるだけだっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You never know what's going on! I'm only
THINKING about what to do with 'em!

fields.EN:
(That was my first real conversation with
Mary.)
fields.JP:
（メアリーとこんなに話したのは
　初めてだったな。なんていうか、こう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was my first real conversation with
Mary.)

fields.JP: （けっこう不思議な子みたいだな。うん）
メアリー、おーい。メアリー？

fields.EN: We're about to have a strategy meeting, but Mary isn't here... Guess I'll go to the tent and call her.
fields.JP:
これからみんなで作戦会議なのに、
メアリーがいない……。
仕方ない、テントまで呼びに行くか
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've got a meeting, but I can't find Mary
anywhere. Maybe she's at the tent.

fields.EN: Thanks Charlotte-san, but I can handle it.
fields.JP:
シャーロットさん、ありがとうございます。
でも僕一人で大丈夫ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks Charlotte, but I can handle it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
No. I'm a little worried about you going alone,
Jack-kun...
fields.JP:
ううん。
ジャックくん一人じゃ少し心配だから……
fields.LOCALIZED: No. I'm worried about you going alone...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(Worried? I'm just going to call her.
I wonder what she means...)
fields.JP:
（心配って、呼びに行くだけなのに？
　どういうことだろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Worried? I'm just going to call her.
I wonder what she means...)

fields.JP: ……ついたわ。ここがメアリーのテントよ

fields.EN: What the?! What's that creepy voice?!
fields.JP:
な、なんだ？
テントの中から不気味な笑い声が！
fields.LOCALIZED: What the?! What's that creepy voice?!

fields.EN:
I didn't want to think she'd do it, but
she did...!
fields.JP: 考えたくなかったけど、まさか……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to think she'd do it, but
she did...!

fields.EN:
Hehehe. Yup, then here I come sweeping
the enemies away. I'm so cool. I'm unstoppable.
fields.JP:
ふふふ……そう、ここで敵を一網打尽……
俺は……かっこいい……無敵だ～……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. Yup, then here I come sweeping
the enemies away. I'm so cool. I'm unstoppable.

fields.EN: Ugh. There she goes again, wasting matches!
fields.JP: あの子ったら、またマッチの無駄遣いを……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. There she goes again, wasting matches!

fields.EN: Aw, you scared me. I blew out my match.
fields.JP: ああ……びっくりして、つい消しちまった……
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw, you scared me. I blew out my match.

fields.EN:
Charlotte and Jack! I'm running out of matches!
Look what you made me do!
fields.JP:
シャーロットに、ジャック……！
マッチには数に限りがあるのに、
なんてことしてくれてんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte and Jack! I'm running out of matches!
Look what you made me do!

fields.EN:
Don't you blame us! I warned you to conserve
your matches!
fields.JP:
責任転嫁するんじゃないの。
マッチも残り少ないのに、
こんなことに使ったりして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you blame us! I warned you to conserve
your matches!

fields.EN:
(Did she light one just for a daydream...?
What a waste.)
fields.JP:
（ま、まさか自分の妄想を見て
　楽しむためだけにマッチを？
　だとしたらもったいなさすぎる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Did she light one just for a daydream...?
What a waste.)

fields.EN:
Mary, I've told you time and time again not to.
Next time, I'm confiscating them.
fields.JP:
メアリー、マッチの無駄遣いはダメよ。
次にやったら私がマッチを没収しちゃうんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, I've told you time and time again not to.
Next time, I'm confiscating them.

fields.JP:
な、なんだよシャーロット……。
本気で怒ったのか……？

fields.EN:
Don't be so uptight. I'm just decompressing.
Some escapism won't hurt. Hehe.
fields.JP:
そ、そんな怒んないでくれよ。
もう戦うのが精神的に疲れちゃって……その、
無性に逃避したくなったんだ……へ、へへ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be so uptight. I'm just decompressing.
Some escapism won't hurt. Hehe.

fields.EN: That's what this is about, Mary?
fields.JP: メアリー、そんなに追い詰められていたのね……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's what this is about, Mary?

fields.EN:
If you need to relax, come to me. I'll take
care of you.
fields.JP:
つらくなったら、まず私に言うのよ。
全力であなたの力になるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you need to relax, come to me. I'll take
care of you.

fields.EN:
But save those matches. Like your life
depends on it. If you run out...
fields.JP:
でもマッチ棒はもうあまりないんだから、
大事にしてちょうだい。
もしもマッチ棒がなくなったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But save those matches. Like your life
depends on it. If you run out...

fields.EN:
(Charlotte-san sure seems desperate. I wonder
what'll happen if Mary runs out of matches.)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさん、ずいぶん必死だな。
　マッチ棒がなくなったらなにか大変なことでも
　あるのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Charlotte sure seems desperate. I wonder
what'll happen if Mary runs out of matches.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP:
シャーロット……うへへ……。
くんかくんか

fields.EN:
(Whoa. Is she smelling Charlotte-san while she
hugs her?)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ。シャーロットさんの胸に抱き着いて、
　匂いをかいでいるのか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa. Is she smelling Charlotte while she
hugs her?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP:
（な、なんかいろいろと台無しな
　だらしない笑い方だな）

fields.EN: Well Mary, at least you're okay.
fields.JP:
メ、メアリーが思ったより
元気そうで安心したよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well Mary, at least you're okay.

fields.EN: *gasp*! Am not! I'm so stressed, can't you tell?
fields.JP:
はっ。そ……そんなことねーし？
悩みだってけっこうあるし？
fields.LOCALIZED: *gasp*! Am not! I'm so stressed, can't you tell?

fields.EN:
(There she goes again! She's nuts! I know
she likes Charlotte-san, but sheesh...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、また口元がだらしなく……。
　シャーロットさんが好きなのは
　わかるんだけどさ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There she goes again! She's nuts! I know
she likes Charlotte, but sheesh...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Mary, I know your Blood Libido is acting up,
but you need to be cautious.
fields.JP:
メアリー？　あなたの血式リビドーが
現実逃避なのはわかっているわ。
だけどマッチは使っちゃダメよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, I know your Blood Libido is acting up,
but you need to be cautious.

fields.EN:
Let's find a way to manage your libido without
using matches, okay?
fields.JP:
マッチを使わずにリビドーを満たせる
方法を一緒に考えていきましょう。いいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's find a way to manage your libido without
using matches, okay?

fields.EN:
(Does she get it, or is she just playing along?
Either way, maybe I should give her a second.)
fields.JP:
（本当にわかってるのかなぁ。
　なんにせよ、こんな状態じゃ
　作戦会議どころじゃなさそうだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Does she get it, or is she just playing along?
Either way, maybe I should give her a second.)

fields.EN: Mary, you go ahead and stay put.
fields.JP:
仕方ないから、メアリーはしばらく
こうしているといいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, you go ahead and stay put.

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san, I'll explain this to everyone.
Just take care of Mary.
fields.JP:
シャーロットさん、
みんなには僕から話しておくので、
メアリーのこと頼みます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, I'll explain this to everyone.
Just take care of Mary.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: I'm sorry about this. Thank you.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさいね。
よろしくお願いするわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry about this. Thank you.

fields.JP: 偽善者ジャック、ありがとう……ふひひ

fields.EN: (I heard that. I'm no hypocrite... I think.)
fields.JP:
（聞こえてるよー。
　偽善者じゃない……と思いたいんだけどなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I heard that. I'm no hypocrite... I think.)

fields.EN:
MMMM! 
Today's food is especially good!
fields.JP:
うんまいっ！
今日の飯はまた一段とうめえな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
MMMM! 
Today's food is especially good!

fields.EN: It's delicious. These dressings are lovely.
fields.JP:
本当、おいしいわ。
いつもと味付けがちょっと違う感じね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's delicious. These dressings are lovely.

fields.EN: Charlotte made it today. I was busy, so it really helped. Thank you.
fields.JP:
今日はシャーロットが作ってくれたのよ。
忙しかったから助かったわ、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte cooked today. I was so busy,
so thank her! Hahaha.

fields.EN: Hehe. You're welcome. Glad you enjoy it.
fields.JP:
うふふ、どういたしまして。
みんなが喜んでくれて嬉しいわ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You're welcome. Glad you enjoy it.

fields.EN:
Hey Mary! You took too long, so we started
eating!
fields.JP:
あ、メアリー！
なかなか来ないから先にご飯食べてたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Mary! You took too long, so we started
eating!

fields.EN:
Hurry. Come here. Let's eat together.
This way.
fields.JP:
早くメアリーも一緒に食べましょう。
こっちにいらっしゃい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hurry. Come here. Let's eat together.
This way.

fields.EN: Mary, say your thanks before you eat.
fields.JP: メアリー、まずは「いただきます」よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, say your thanks before you eat.

fields.EN: Oh? I've never seen this dish before.
fields.JP: あれ？　この食べ物って初めて見るな
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? I've never seen this dish before.

fields.EN: I hunted this the other day. Pretty good, huh?
fields.JP:
その食材、この間俺が見つけてきたんだぜ。
味もけっこういけるだろ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I hunted this the other day. Pretty good, huh?

fields.EN:
Some things only exist up here. Hope we
can find more tea leaves.
fields.JP:
この地上にしかないものもたくさんあるのよね。
茶葉ももっと見つかるといいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some things only exist up here. Hope we
can find more tea leaves.

fields.EN:
Be careful not to drink anything you don't
recognize. It could be toxic.
fields.JP:
でも初めて見るものには気をつけなきゃダメよ。
毒があるかもしれないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be careful not to drink anything you don't
recognize. It could be toxic.

fields.EN:
Especially you, Mamoru. Don't let your eyes
poison your stomach.
fields.JP:
特にマモル。見つけたそばから
なんでも口に入れないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Especially you, Mamoru. Don't let your eyes
poison your stomach.

fields.EN:
Oh, I wouldn't do that. What kind of man
do you think I am, Miko-san?
fields.JP:
いや、さすがにしねーって。
視子さんの中で俺って
そんな風に見えてるのかよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I wouldn't do that. What kind of man
do you think I am, Miko?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Any meal is something to be grateful for.
Let's keep searching for food.
fields.JP:
こうして食べられるものが
少しでも手に入るのはありがたいね。
これからもがんばって探そうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Any meal is something to be grateful for.
Let's keep searching for food.

fields.EN: One day we'll have one big feast.
fields.JP:
でももっとがっつりしたモンも
腹いっぱい食いたくなるよなー
fields.LOCALIZED: One day we'll have one big feast.

fields.JP: あはは。まあ、それはそのうちってことで

はぐっ！
はぐはぐはぐ、もぐもぐ、ごっくん！

fields.EN: Whoa! Where'd that appetite come from?
fields.JP: うおっ？　なんだ急にいい食いっぷりだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa! Where'd that appetite come from?

fields.JP: そんなにお腹が空いてたのかしら……？

むぐむぐむぐ、
むしゃむしゃむしゃ……んぐっ！？
ゲホゲホッ、ゴホッ、ゴヘッ！
大丈夫！？　のどに詰まらせちゃった？

fields.EN:
You wolfed that down too quick. Take a breath
between bites, okay?
fields.JP:
ほらほら、慌てて食べるからよ。
落ち着いて食べなさいね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wolfed that down too quick. Take a breath
between bites, okay?

fields.JP:
げほっ。
こ……この料理、う、うまいなあ！　な！？

fields.EN:
Don't you wanna stuff your face in it...?
So. Um...
fields.JP:
すごいいっぱい食べたくなるよな……？
だから……その
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't you wanna stuff your face in it...?
So. Um...

fields.JP:
あ……あれ……？
なんか、滑った……？　え……？

fields.EN:
..Oh I see.
Everyone can't laugh because I'm here...
fields.JP:
……ああ、そっか。
俺がいるからみんな盛り上がれないのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
..Oh I see.
Everyone can't laugh because I'm here...

fields.JP: う、うるせえ！　ぎ……偽善者が……！

fields.EN:
(What's gotten into her? Is she sick from
overeating?)
fields.JP:
（え、急にどうしたんだろう。
　たくさん食べすぎて気持ち悪く
　なっちゃったのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's gotten into her? Is she sick from
overeating?)

fields.JP: なにがしたかったんだ？　あいつ……

fields.EN:
Sorry, Mary just got overly excited.
She didn't mean to be rude.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさいね。
メアリーは張り切っちゃっただけで、
悪気はなかったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, Mary just got overly excited.
She didn't mean to be rude.

fields.JP: 別に気にしちゃいねえけどさ
相変わらず不思議な子ね
大丈夫かしら、メアリー……

fields.EN: (I wonder what her deal was. That was scary.)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだったんだろう、今の。
　びっくりした……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wonder what her deal was. That was scary.)

fields.EN:
(Haven't had a chance to chat with Mary
yet. I feel bad...)
fields.JP:
（あれからメアリーとちゃんと話せていなくて
　気になるな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Haven't had a chance to chat with Mary
yet. I feel bad...)

fields.EN:
(I'm at Mary's tent, but there's a weird sign
over the entrance.)
fields.JP:
（とか思ってメアリーのテントまで来てみたら、
　なんか変な張り紙が張ってあるし）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm at Mary's tent, but there's a weird sign
over the entrance.)

fields.EN: ("Do Not Enter"...? Is she locked up there alone?)
fields.JP:
（「中に入るべからず」……？
　なんだこれ。テントに引きこもるつもりかな）
fields.LOCALIZED: ("Do Not Enter"...? Is she locked up there alone?)

fields.JP:
メアリー、いるのかい？
メーアーリー！

……返事がない。
でもどう考えてもいるような……

fields.EN: (What should I do...? Normally I'd turn back, but today I feel like I can't let this moment pass...)
fields.JP:
（どうしよう……いつもなら引き返すけど、
　今日はこのタイミングを逃しちゃいけない
　気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What do I do? I can't just leave it be.)

fields.EN: Mary, you're there right? I'm coming in.
fields.JP:
メアリー、いるんだよね？
お邪魔するよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary, you're there right? I'm coming in.

fields.JP: 入るなって書いてあんだろーがあぁ！！
（やっぱりいるんじゃないか……）

fields.EN:
Mary, you can't stay in the tent all day.
Sorry, but I'm coming in.
fields.JP:
メアリー、このままずっとテントの中に
いるわけにもいかないだろ？
悪いけど、入らせてもらうよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, you can't stay in the tent all day.
Sorry, but I'm coming in.

fields.EN:
Ugh. You're a jerk. You knew I was
pretending to sleep.
fields.JP:
……おまえ、性格悪いな……。
俺が居留守使ってることわかってたんだろ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. You're a jerk. You knew I was
pretending to sleep.

fields.EN:
Hahaha. I don't care if you think I'm a jerk
or a hypocrite.
fields.JP: はは、もう性格悪くても偽善者でもいいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. I don't care if you think I'm a jerk
or a hypocrite.

fields.EN:
What's your problem...? You're mad,
aren't you?
fields.JP:
な、なんだよ……。
やっぱり怒ってんのかよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your problem...? You're mad,
aren't you?

fields.EN:
Sorry for calling you a hypocrite. I also
take back the jerk comment. Now get
out of here.
fields.JP:
偽善者って言ったことは謝るよ。
性格悪いも取り消す。これでいいだろ？
とっとと出てってくれよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for calling you a hypocrite. I also
take back the jerk comment. Now get
out of here.

fields.EN:
I'm not upset. Just thought you were acting
weird, so I came to check up on you.
fields.JP:
怒ってなんかいないよ。
この間の食事のときからメアリーの様子が
おかしかったから、気になって来てみたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not upset. Just thought you were acting
weird, so I came to check up on you.

fields.EN:
You rushed out of the room. Were you
feeling sick? How are you feeling?
fields.JP:
あのときは急にいなくなったけど、
たくさん食べすぎて調子が悪くなったの？
今はもう大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You rushed out of the room. Were you
feeling sick? How are you feeling?

fields.EN: I see. That's good. I was a little worried you might have been pushing yourself too hard.
fields.JP:
そっか、ならよかった。
もしかしたら無理してたんじゃないかって、
ちょっと心配してたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah. Good to hear. I was worried you fell
ill.

fields.EN:
...Worried? Even though I called you a
hypocrite? You're worried...
fields.JP:
……心配って。
一方的に偽善者とか言った俺に、
し……心配なんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Worried? Even though I called you a
hypocrite? You're worried...

fields.EN:
That's what I'm talking about...! You just
don't make sense!
fields.JP:
そ、そういうところが偽善者だって
言ってんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I'm talking about...! You just
don't make sense!

fields.JP:
えっ？　な、なんで？
僕はメアリーを心配しただけで……

fields.EN:
If you really were, why didn't you run after
me then? You didn't!
fields.JP:
そもそも本当に心配だってんなら、
あのあとすぐに追いかけりゃいいだろ！
そうしなかったじゃねーか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you really were, why didn't you run after
me then? You didn't!

fields.EN:
(Mary's right. I guess I didn't. I didn't put up
much of a defense.)
fields.JP:
（たしかにメアリーの言う通りだ。
　追いかけなかった時点で、
　僕の心配なんてたかが知れている……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Mary's right. I guess I didn't. I didn't put up
much of a defense.)

fields.EN:
My bad. You're right. I think I told myself
it wasn't that big of a deal.
fields.JP:
……ごめん。君の言う通り、
そんなに深刻なことじゃないだろうって
高をくくっていたのかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
My bad. You're right. I think I told myself
it wasn't that big of a deal.

fields.EN: It wasn't intentional. Honestly, it confused me.
fields.JP:
でもそれだけじゃなくて、その……
戸惑っていたところもあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: It wasn't intentional. Honestly, it confused me.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I didn't know why you reacted that
way, so I gave it some thought.
fields.JP:
うん。
どうして君があんな行動をとったのか
わからなくて、いろいろ考えて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I didn't know why you reacted that
way, so I gave it some thought.

fields.EN: Hmph. Dress it up with all the reasoning you like, but you don't really want to apologize to me. You just want me to forgive you so you can feel better.
fields.JP:
……ふん。なんだかんだ理屈をこねたって、
結局俺に謝りたいんじゃなくて、
許してもらって楽になりたいだけなんだろ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. All I hear are excuses. Anything
to be forgiven.

fields.EN: That's not it. That's not what I'm saying.
fields.JP: ち、違うよ。そういうわけじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not it. That's not what I'm saying.

fields.EN: No, it's not! You're just a big fake!
fields.JP:
違わねーだろ。
やっぱりおまえは偽善者なんだよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it's not! You're just a big fake!

fields.EN:
(Ugh. We're going in circles. I guess I see
where she's coming from. I just don't know
why she's so aggressive.)
fields.JP:
（……なんだろう。なんか納得いかないな。
　たしかに偽善者なところは認めるよ。
　でもここまで責められるなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. We're going in circles. I guess I see
where she's coming from. I just don't know
why she's so aggressive.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's the way I'm communicating.
But I don't appreciate her dismissing my
concern as fake.)
fields.JP:
（たぶん僕の伝え方も悪かったのかもしれない。
　だけどメアリーを心配した気持ちまで偽物
　みたいに言われるのは、違う気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's the way I'm communicating.
But I don't appreciate her dismissing my
concern as fake.)

fields.EN:
What's your deal...? You went quiet.
You mad now?
fields.JP:
な……なんだよ。急に黙りやがって……。
怒ったのかよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your deal...? You went quiet.
You mad now?

fields.EN:
...Yeah, I am. You can't read my mind.
I don't appreciate the assumptions.
fields.JP:
……そうだよ。
メアリーこそ僕の気持ちなんて知らないくせに、
勝手なことばっかり言わないでほしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Yeah, I am. You can't read my mind.
I don't appreciate the assumptions.

fields.EN:
I may not be perfect, but I'm doing the
best I can.
fields.JP:
僕は決してできた人間じゃない。
それでも自分にできる範囲でがんばってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I may not be perfect, but I'm doing the
best I can.

fields.EN:
I'm not level-headed like Charlotte-san, and
I'm not as decisive as Alice.
fields.JP:
シャーロットさんみたいに上手にフォローが
できるわけじゃないし、アリスみたいに冷静な
対処ができるわけでもない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not level-headed like Charlotte, and
I'm not as decisive as Alice.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
I'm not as logical as Gretel either, but I do
know how to try my best.
fields.JP:
グレーテルみたいに即座に論理的な答えが
出せるわけでもない。それでも僕なりに
どうしたらいいか考えているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not as logical as Gretel either, but I do
know how to try my best.

fields.EN:
Who's Gretel...? See? You have so many
friends.
fields.JP:
だ、誰だよグレーテルって……。
ってか、おまえやっぱり仲間多いんじゃねーか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who's Gretel...? See? You have so many
friends.

fields.EN:
You live a pampered life. Why are you
complaining when you're spoiled?!
fields.JP:
そんなリア充のくせに、
自分もがんばってるとかどーとか、
わがままな悩み持ってんじゃねーっての！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You live a pampered life. Why are you
complaining when you're spoiled?!

fields.JP: リア充ってなんなのさ！

fields.EN: You can talk to people, you have a life!
fields.JP:
おまえみたくコミュ力高くて
なんか楽しそうに生きてるやつだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You can talk to people, you have a life!

fields.JP: す、すごい言いがかりな気がする！

fields.EN:
Shut up! You'll never know what it's like
to be me!
fields.JP:
うるせー！
リア充に陰キャの闇がわかって
たまるかってんだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Shut up! You'll never know what it's like
to be me!

fields.EN: I have a lot on my plate too!
fields.JP: 僕だっていろいろ悩んで……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I have a lot on my plate too!

fields.EN:
Then let me ask you. Does it ever stress
you out to speak in front of others?!
fields.JP:
じゃあ聞くけどな？　みんなでしゃべるときに
なにを話せばいいのかとか、話し始める
タイミングとかで悩んだことあるか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then let me ask you. Does it ever stress
you out to speak in front of others?!

fields.EN:
It stresses me out! ALL THE TIME!
Just like at dinner the other day!
fields.JP:
俺はある！　むしろいつもだ！
この間の食事のときだってそうだった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It stresses me out! ALL THE TIME!
Just like at dinner the other day!

fields.EN:
I panicked because I just wanted to
impress you guys, I thought maybe you
would understand!
fields.JP:
そんでテンパったあげく、
大食いしたらなんかうまくしゃべれる
きっかけになるような気がして、大食いした！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I panicked because I just wanted to
impress you guys, I thought maybe you
would understand!

fields.EN: But then I fell flat on my face!
fields.JP: 結局だだ滑りしたけどなー！
fields.LOCALIZED: But then I fell flat on my face!

fields.EN:
(Man, Mary seems totally distraught.
But I don't get why...)
fields.JP:
（よくわからないけど、メアリーは僕とは
　違う方向でものすごく悩んでいるのかな。
　よくわからないけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, Mary seems totally distraught.
But I don't get why...)

fields.JP: （うぅ、罪悪感がじわじわ湧いてきた……）

fields.EN:
Um. I'm sorry for putting you on the spot.
Real sorry...
fields.JP:
なんか、その……メアリーの心の傷とか
気にしてることを暴露させちゃったみたいだ。
本当にごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. I'm sorry for putting you on the spot.
Real sorry...

fields.EN:
I didn't mean to be inconsiderate.
Sometimes I get stuck in my head
and miss the small stuff. I can be careless.
fields.JP:
僕はなんて無神経なやつなんだろう……。
その上、優柔不断だし気が利かないし
地味だしキャラ立ってないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't mean to be inconsiderate.
Sometimes I get stuck in my head
and miss the small stuff. I can be careless.

fields.EN: Hey, I didn't say all that...
fields.JP: お、おい……別にそこまでは……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, I didn't say all that...

fields.EN:
Public speaking can be hard.
Whatever I was worried about kinda pales
in comparison.
fields.JP:
メアリーの悩みを聞いて、
僕の悩みなんてちっぽけでくだらなくて
些細なことなんだって実感したよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Public speaking can be hard.
Whatever I was worried about kinda pales
in comparison.

fields.EN: Hey hey hey, wait now! Is that pity?
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょちょちょい待て！
なんか途中から俺をディスってないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey hey hey, wait now! Is that pity?

fields.EN: You could've just played dumb, ya know!
fields.LOCALIZED: You could've just played dumb, ya know!

fields.EN:
Ugh... Seriously, what is this...? Talking to you
is making it feel stupid to keep resisting you...
fields.JP:
はぁ……ったく、なんなんだよ……。
おまえと話してると、反発してるのが
バカバカしくなってきた……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. What the hell? Now I pity you.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: All that privilege, and you're a downer.
fields.JP: おまえ、リア充のくせにネガティブだな
fields.LOCALIZED: All that privilege, and you're a downer.

fields.JP: メアリーもなかなかのネガティブさだよね

fields.EN: Hey, at least I own it.
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, at least I own it.

fields.JP: ……僕たち、なんで言い争ってたんだっけ

fields.EN: I got over it a while ago.
fields.JP: そんなもん、とっくに失せたよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I got over it a while ago.

fields.EN: ...Maybe he's prone to mood swings like me.
fields.JP:
……こいつ、実はコンプだらけで
俺と一緒なんじゃねーか
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Maybe he's prone to mood swings like me.

fields.EN:
Ugh. Stop eavesdropping, nosy! Just leave!
Shoo, shoo!
fields.JP:
あーもう、地獄耳だな！
もういいから、さっさと帰れ帰れ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Stop eavesdropping, nosy! Just leave!
Shoo, shoo!

fields.EN:
(She might be irate, but at least she's not
upset.)
fields.JP:
（怒ってる……けど、さっきまでとは
　ちょっと違うような？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She might be irate, but at least she's not
upset.)

fields.JP: えっと、これからも仲良くできるかな
なんですでに仲がいい前提なんだよ！
まあ……どーだろーな。……ふんっ
よし。この辺りは異常なし、と……
うわっ！　び、びっくりした

fields.EN: You tried to walk past me.
fields.JP: 今、俺の前を素通りしようとしただろ
fields.LOCALIZED: You tried to walk past me.

fields.EN: I didn't see you. Where'd you come from?
fields.JP:
だって気づかなくて……。
いつからいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't see you. Where'd you come from?

fields.EN: I've been standing here the whole time.
fields.JP:
おまえが見回りしに来たときから
ずーっといたっての
fields.LOCALIZED: I've been standing here the whole time.

fields.EN:
Oh, sorry. I didn't expect anyone to join me.
Why are you out?
fields.JP:
う……ごめん。まさかこんなところに
誰かいるなんて思わなくて。
メアリーはここでなにを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, sorry. I didn't expect anyone to join me.
Why are you out?

fields.EN:
Oh! Don't tell me. Are you lighting one
of your matches again?
fields.JP:
あっ、まさか！
またマッチ棒で妄想を見ようとして
いたんじゃ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! Don't tell me. Are you lighting one
of your matches again?

fields.EN: OH! ...Uh, no idea what you mean.
fields.JP: ぎくっ。……なんのことやら
fields.LOCALIZED: OH! ...Uh, no idea what you mean.

fields.JP: ……ちっ。相変わらず勘がいいな

fields.EN:
You only have a few left. Don't be careless.
Remember what Charlotte-san said?
fields.JP:
もうマッチ棒だって残り少ないのに、
ダメじゃないか。シャーロットさんにも
止められてただろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You only have a few left. Don't be careless.
Remember what Charlotte said?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Hehehe. Who cares?
It's not like I'll run out.
fields.JP:
へ、へへっ。いいじゃねーか、
減るもんじゃなし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. Who cares?
It's not like I'll run out.

fields.EN:
Don't be such a stiff.
When you light a match... Hehe.
It hits the spot.
fields.JP:
堅いこと言うなって。
マッチを擦るとよぉ……へへ、
これがまた効くんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be such a stiff.
When you light a match... Hehe.
It hits the spot.

fields.EN: I feel fantastic. Here, have a taste.
fields.JP:
今の俺は気分がいいんだ。
特別におまえにも味わわせてやるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I feel fantastic. Here, have a taste.

fields.EN:
You can see any vision you want, you know?
That's amazing, isn't it? Come on, get over here.
fields.JP:
おまえが望めばどんな幻覚でも見れるんだぜ？
これってすごいことだろ。
いいからこっち来いよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whatever you think up, you can see.
Amazing, right? Come here.
fields.notes: B12 P0 Mary's match-induced 幻覚 restored as vision(s)

fields.EN: It's okay. I don't need to do that...
fields.JP: 僕はいいよ。そんなことしなくたって……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's okay. I don't need to do that...

fields.EN:
Don't be shy. You're a healthy boy.
I'm sure your imagination is wild.
fields.JP:
遠慮すんなって。
どうせおまえも健康な青少年なら、
えっちぃ妄想とかしてんだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be shy. You're a healthy boy.
I'm sure your imagination is wild.

fields.JP:
ピンク色のあんなことや、こんなこと。
正直にゲロっちまいな……！

fields.EN: I have no idea what you mean!
fields.JP: も、妄想なんてしないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I have no idea what you mean!

fields.EN: You closet freak. You're going to lie to me?
fields.JP: このムッツリめ。俺に嘘つく気かよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You closet freak. You're going to lie to me?

fields.EN:
Rgh. Well, I guess I'd be lying...if I didn't
say yes...
fields.JP:
う……そ、そりゃ、少しは……。
考えないこともない、けど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh. Well, I guess I'd be lying...if I didn't
say yes...

fields.EN: Then show me with a match.
fields.JP: だったらその妄想をマッチで見ればいいだろ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then show me with a match.

fields.EN:
That's embarrassing! Totally out of the question.
Not worth a match.
fields.JP:
そ、そんな恥ずかしいことできないって！
そもそもマッチ棒を無駄遣いするなんて
論外だし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's embarrassing! Totally out of the question.
Not worth a match.

fields.EN: Ugh. You're so lame, Jack. Unlike me.
fields.JP:
はぁ～。
やっぱりジャックはいい子ちゃんだな。
俺とは大違いだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. You're so lame, Jack. Unlike me.

fields.EN:
I'm used to being alone. Sometimes all I
had were my daydreams. My reality wasn't
too far off from a nightmare.
fields.JP:
俺はいつも孤独で、マッチを擦りながら
好きな世界を見るのだけが楽しみだった。
そうすると現実のほうが悪夢に見えてきてさ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm used to being alone. Sometimes all I
had were my daydreams. My reality wasn't
too far off from a nightmare.

fields.EN:
Hence why I love my solitude.
Nothing'll change that.
fields.JP:
だから俺は孤独を愛していたし、
それは間違いじゃないと思っていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hence why I love my solitude.
Nothing'll change that.

fields.EN:
It's just that...the more I spend time with
you guys, the more I second-guess if that
was the right move.
fields.JP:
ただ……最近おまえらと一緒にいると、
「孤独を愛している自分」は間違ってるんじゃ
ないかって気がしてきたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just that...the more I spend time with
you guys, the more I second-guess if that
was the right move.

fields.EN:
So I'm trying to meet you half-way.
Sometimes it feels like I can't get there.
fields.JP:
だからどうにかコミュニケーションをとろうと
いろいろがんばったけど、しばらくすると
なんか失敗だったのかなって思えてきてさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I'm trying to meet you half-way.
Sometimes it feels like I can't get there.

fields.EN:
(Ah. That explains why we had trouble
understanding each other. She's insecure.)
fields.JP:
（メアリーのちょっとズレたあれこれは、
　この子なりの不器用なコミュニケーション
　だったのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah. That explains why we had trouble
understanding each other. She's insecure.)

fields.EN:
But whatever, I can't be wrong. Solitude
still rocks.
fields.JP:
だからやっぱり、俺は間違っていなかった。
孤独が一番いいんだってわかったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But whatever, I can't be wrong. Solitude
still rocks.

fields.EN:
In the end, maintaining friendships is a skill
on its own.
fields.JP:
結局、人間関係を保つってのは
それだけで技術が必要だったんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the end, maintaining friendships is a skill
on its own.

fields.EN:
I got no knack for it. Nor do I care.
So yeah, take me or leave me.
fields.JP:
俺にはそのための技術も才能もなけりゃ、
努力もできなかった。まあ、あれだ。
とことん向いてなかったんだろうなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got no knack for it. Nor do I care.
So yeah, take me or leave me.

fields.EN:
But you. You seem to push through all
those doubts on your own. I could never.
fields.JP:
その点、コンプだらけでも
がんばってるジャックはすごいよ。
俺には逆立ちしたってできないことをしてる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you. You seem to push through all
those doubts on your own. I could never.

fields.EN:
(This is the first compliment Mary's given
me. Feels weird.)
fields.JP:
（メアリーが初めて僕を認めてくれた……？
　嬉しいけど、なんか変な感じだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This is the first compliment Mary's given
me. Feels weird.)

fields.EN:
So I thought I'd let you use one match as a
reward.
fields.JP:
そんなわけだから、
ご褒美にマッチを一本くらい使わせてやっても
いいかと思ったんだ
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
I see. Thanks. I appreciate the sentiment,
but your matches are precious.
fields.JP:
そうだったんだ……ありがとう。
でも気持ちだけで十分だよ。
マッチ棒は貴重なんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Thanks. I appreciate the sentiment,
but your matches are precious.

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san seemed pretty concerned.
What'll you do if you run out?
fields.JP:
前にシャーロットさんが
マッチ棒の残りをずいぶん心配してたけど、
マッチ棒がなくなったらどうなるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte seemed pretty concerned.
What'll you do if you run out?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Oh. If they're gone, I'll die.
fields.JP: うん。マッチ棒を使い切ると俺は死ぬんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. If they're gone, I'll die.

fields.JP: だからー、死ぬんだって

fields.EN: (Th-this is a bigger deal than I thought!)
fields.JP: （お、思っていた以上に大変なことじゃないか！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Th-this is a bigger deal than I thought!)

fields.EN: Mary! Stop using them then! Never ever!
fields.JP:
メアリー！
それじゃあもう一本も使っちゃダメだよ！
絶対に！
fields.LOCALIZED: Mary! Stop using them then! Never ever!

fields.EN:
Oh, come on. They help me calm myself.
I can't help it.
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこと言ったってよぉ、
辛いときはやっぱり妄想に逃げちゃうんだよ。
仕方ないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, come on. They help me calm myself.
I can't help it.

fields.EN:
(She uses matches, knowing that running
out spells her own demise.)
fields.JP:
（でも、そんな命の一部にも等しい
　大事なマッチ棒を僕に使わせて
　くれようとしたのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She uses matches, knowing that running
out spells her own demise.)

fields.EN:
(I appreciate her generosity, even if she
has a twisted way of showing it.)
fields.JP:
（方法はともかく、認めてもらえたんだと思うと
　少し嬉しいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I appreciate her generosity, even if she
has a twisted way of showing it.)

fields.EN:
No need to tell me. I won't use 'em.
I only got a few left. I can't die.
For Charlotte's sake.
fields.JP:
おまえに言われなくたって全部は使わないさ。
あと数本しかないけど、シャーロットのためにも
死ぬわけにはいかないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to tell me. I won't use 'em.
I only got a few left. I can't die.
For Charlotte's sake.

fields.EN: Can you imagine how sad she'd be? Hehehe.
fields.JP:
俺が死んだら、シャーロットが悲しむだろ？
くふふ
fields.LOCALIZED: Can you imagine how sad she'd be? Hehehe.

fields.EN: (She seems to care deeply for Charlotte-san.)
fields.JP:
（なんだかんだ言っても、シャーロットさんの
　ことは大事に思ってるってことか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She seems to care deeply for Charlotte.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Well, if you change your mind, you know
where to find me. It's the good stuff...
fields.JP:
まあ、気が変わったらいつでも言えよ。
いい夢、見させてやるぜ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you change your mind, you know
where to find me. It's the good stuff...

fields.JP: だから、それは遠慮するよ……

fields.EN:
(Hey. This is an unexpected trio.
Wonder what they're talking about.)
fields.JP:
（あれ、あの三人の組み合わせなんて珍しいな。
　なにを話してるんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hey. This is an unexpected trio.
Wonder what they're talking about.)

fields.EN:
(I don't wanna eavesdrop, but I bet Mary's
up to her mischief again...)
fields.JP:
（盗み聞きってわけじゃないけど、
　メアリーが変なこと言わないか心配だから
　ちょっと様子を見るか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't wanna eavesdrop, but I bet Mary's
up to her mischief again...)

fields.EN:
How about you, Alice-san? How are things
progressing with Jack-san?
fields.JP:
それでアリスさんはどうなの？
ジャックさんとの仲は進展してる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about you, Alice? How are things
progressing with Jack?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: Huh?! What do you mean progressing?!
fields.JP: ふえっ？　し、進展とかそんな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! What do you mean progressing?!

fields.EN:
It's not like that. Nothing worth gossiping
about to you, Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
ジャックとはそんな関係じゃないのよ。
人魚姫さんが期待するような話はなにも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not like that. Nothing worth gossiping
about to you, Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Hm. Now I feel bad. Alice and I are just
good friends. We don't wanna give anyone
the wrong impression.)
fields.JP:
（うーん、なんだか申し訳ないな。
　アリスも僕と幼馴染ってだけで
　変に誤解されたら困っちゃうよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. Now I feel bad. Alice and I are just
good friends. We don't wanna give anyone
the wrong impression.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe this has happened before and I just didn't
know about it. I need to be more careful too...)
fields.JP:
（僕が知らないだけで、これまでにも
　あんなふうに誤解されたことがあるの
　かもしれない。僕も気をつけないと……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe it's a me thing? I should be careful.)
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
