Whaaat? I think you and Jack-san make a perfect
couple, Alice-san.
fields.JP:
えー、ジャックさんとアリスさんは
お似合いの二人だと思うけどなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaaaat? But you and Jack are perfect
together.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジャック => Jack-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: ねえ、メアリーちゃんもそう思うでしょ？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーちゃん => Mary-chan

fields.EN: Come on, both of you, stop teasing me!
fields.JP: もう、二人ともからかわないで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop putting me on the spot!

fields.EN:
How are things with Otsuu-san, Ningyohime-san?
How's your love?
fields.JP:
に、人魚姫さんこそ、おつうさんとどうなの？
その、恋人としての関係は
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are things with Otsuu, Little Mermaid?
How's your love?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan and I are perfect as can be!
fields.JP: おつうちゃんとはラブラブだもん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu and I are perfect as can be!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(Ningyohime-san's strong. She doesn't mind
being asked about Tsuu.)
fields.JP:
（人魚姫さん、強い。
　つうとの関係を冷やかされても全然動じない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Little Mermaid's strong. She doesn't mind
being asked about Otsuu.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: メアリーちゃんもなにか質問？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: メアリーちゃん => Mary-chan

fields.EN: U-Um... I wanted to ask something...
fields.JP: え、え、……あの、一つ聞きたいことが……
fields.LOCALIZED: U-Um... I wanted to ask something...

fields.EN: (Ohh! Mary's speaking up! That's a first!)
fields.JP:
（おおっ、あのメアリーが進んで会話を！
　成長したなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ohh! Mary's speaking up! That's a first!)

fields.JP: や……ヤッてるん……ですかね？

fields.EN: (What on earth! What is she asking?!)
fields.JP: （うわああ、なに聞いてるんだ！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What on earth! What is she asking?!)

fields.EN: D-Do it? N-No! I-I-I've never done anything like that!?
fields.JP:
や、ヤるだなんて、そんな！
し、し、したことないよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you implying?! What do I know?!

fields.EN:
Do they what? What do you mean?
Ningyohime-san, what are you doing with Otsuu-san?
fields.JP:
ヤる……とはなにかしら？
人魚姫さん、おつうさんとなにかヤッているの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do they what? What do you mean?
Little Mermaid, what are you doing with Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; おつうさん => Otsuu-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: まさかのアリスさんからも！？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: アリスさん => Alice-san

fields.EN:
Really? Are you sure...? You sound kinda
defensive. Hehehe.
fields.JP:
ほ、ほんとにヤッてねーんですか？
今の言い方、怪しかったような……くふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? Are you sure...? You sound kinda
defensive. Hehehe.

fields.JP: ち、違うもん！　本当だってば！

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Mary-chan, get those thoughts out of your head!
My and Otsuu-chan's love is pure as snow.
fields.JP:
メアリーちゃん変なこと考えてるでしょ！
わ、わたしとおつうちゃんは清い関係で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mary, get those thoughts out of your head!
My and Otsuu's love is pure as snow.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; メアリーちゃん => Mary-chan

fields.EN: That's not what I was askin'... Fwehehe.
fields.JP: 別に二人を変な目で見てなんか……ふへへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not what I was askin'... Fwehehe.

fields.JP:
絶対変な目で見てる！
やーめーてー！

fields.EN:
AHEM! Mary, it's rude to pry. Ningyohime-san
doesn't appreciate it.
fields.JP:
コホン！
……メアリー、そういう話はさすがによくないわ。
人魚姫さんが嫌がっているでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
AHEM! Mary, it's rude to pry. Little Mermaid
doesn't appreciate it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: If you keep pushing, she'll push back.
fields.JP: あんまりしつこいと嫌われちゃうわよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: If you keep pushing, she'll push back.

fields.EN: Aah! I understand... Um, I-I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
……！　わ……わかったですよ。
その……す、すんませんです
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah! I understand... Um, I-I'm sorry.

fields.EN:
Um... how do I put this... I-I just wanted to know
what kind of relationship you and Otsuu-san have,
Ningyohime-san...
fields.JP:
いや、なんていうか、あれ……です。
俺……あたしはただ、人魚姫さんとおつうさんが
どんな恋愛をヤッてるのかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. How do I put this? I just meant...
Tell me about your and Otsuu's relationship.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Yes. I mean... Do you have pillow talk?
fields.JP: う……はい……。恋バナってやつ、ですかね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I mean... Do you have pillow talk?

fields.EN: Oh, pillow talk. Otsuu-chan and I... Oh dear.
fields.JP:
えっと、恋バナかぁ。
おつうちゃんとわたしの……照れちゃうなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, pillow talk. Otsuu and I... Oh dear.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Oh, you wanted to know if they tell
each other everything. Of course.
fields.JP:
なんだ、メアリーは恋バナが聞きたかったのね。
やっぱり女の子だものね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you wanted to know if they tell
each other everything. Of course.

fields.JP:
（ほっ。
　なんかいい方向に解釈してもらえた……）

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan always puts my well-being first.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんってね、
いつもわたしのこと大事にしてくれるの
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu always puts my well-being first.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I love her smile when our eyes meet.
It makes my heart flutter...
fields.JP:
ふとした瞬間に目が合ったら
微笑みかけてくれたりして、
そしたら胸がきゅんってなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I love her smile when our eyes meet.
It makes my heart flutter...

fields.EN:
I feel so safe with Otsuu-chan. So warm.
And ooooh-so-happy.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんが側にいるだけで
心の中がポカポカして、
すごく幸せな気持ちになれちゃうんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel so safe with Otsuu. So warm.
And ooooh-so-happy.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 人魚姫とつうが……へへ、うへへへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid and Otsuu. Hehe.
Hehehehe.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Glad that's over. Mary's in her own world.
Poor Ningyohime-san.)
fields.JP:
（あ、ダメだあれは。途中から話聞いてないな。
　せっかく人魚姫さんが話してくれてるのに……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Glad that's over. Mary's in her own world.
Poor Little Mermaid.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: (Well, at least they're getting along well.)
fields.JP:
（……まあなにはともあれ、
　みんなと仲良く話せてよかったね。メアリー）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Well, at least they're getting along well.)

fields.EN:
(Ah. Still feeling dizzy. Guess I used too
much blood back there.)
fields.JP:
（あ～……ダメだ。くらくらする。
　戦闘で血を使いすぎたかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah. Still feeling dizzy. Guess I used too
much blood back there.)

fields.EN:
(I think the lab tent is this way.
Maybe I can rest there.)
fields.JP:
（ここからだと研究所のテントが一番近いな……。
　ちょっと一休みさせてもらおう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think the lab tent is this way.
Maybe I can rest there.)

fields.EN: Are my clothes fine like this...?
fields.LOCALIZED: Are my clothes fine like this...?

fields.EN: Be sure to fold them. You too, Alice.
fields.JP: ちゃんと畳むのよ。アリスもね
fields.LOCALIZED: Be sure to fold them. You too, Alice.

fields.EN:
(Oh, I guess I fell asleep.
Who's out there...?)
fields.JP:
（あれ……。
　いつの間にか寝ちゃってたみたいだ。
　誰かいるのかな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I guess I fell asleep.
Who's out there...?)

fields.EN:
(What the?! Why's everyone in their
underwear? What's going on?!)
fields.JP:
（！？　な、なんでみんな下着姿なんだ！？
　どういう状況！？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What the?! Why's everyone in their
underwear? What's going on?!)

fields.JP: 姫、あまり人前に肌をさらしては……

fields.EN:
This is a check-up. You have to slip out
of your clothes. Come on, Otsuu-chan.
Don't be shy.
fields.JP:
健康診断なんだから、
服を脱がなきゃ始まらないでしょ？
ほら、おつうちゃんも恥ずかしがらずに
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a check-up. You have to slip out
of your clothes. Come on, Otsuu.
Don't be shy.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(Oh, I see. The Blood Maidens are doing
their physicals. Looks like they didn't see
me napping.)
fields.JP:
（そ、そうか。血式少女だけ集めて
　健康診断をしていたのか。テントのすみっこで
　僕が寝ていることに気づかなかったんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I see. The Blood Maidens are doing
their physicals. Looks like they didn't see
me napping.)

fields.EN:
(I can't slip out of here. They'll kill me.
I'll stay put...)
fields.JP:
（今出ていくのはまずい。
　僕の信用とかいろいろと終わる気がする。
　しばらくここでじっとしていよう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't slip out of here. They'll kill me.
I'll stay put...)

fields.EN:
Oh, what is that, Otsuu-san?
On your chest?
fields.JP:
あ……おつうさんのそれ、なん……です？
乳につけてるやつ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, what is that, Otsuu?
On your chest?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
It's a bra. You usually wear a sarashi, Otsuu-chan,
so it's unusual to see you in a bra.
fields.JP:
ブラジャーだよ。
いつもはさらしだから、おつうちゃんが
ブラジャーつけてるなんて珍しいよね
fields.LOCALIZED: It is called a bra. A type of undergarment.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
I only wore it knowing that our physicals
were scheduled for today. Don't you stare...
fields.JP:
健康診断はさらしだとなにかと不便だから、
今日は仕方なくブラジャーを……。
あ、あんまり見ないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only wore it knowing that our physicals
were scheduled for today. Don't you stare...

fields.EN:
...Ah, so that's what you look like without
clothes.
fields.JP:
……さらしで押さえていないと、
あんな感じなのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Ah, so that's what you look like without
clothes.

fields.EN: My my, Alice. You've got scary eyes.
fields.JP: あらあら、アリスったら目が怖いわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: My my, Alice. You've got scary eyes.

fields.EN: Otsuu-san, Charlotte... You two are next-level.
fields.JP:
おつうさんといい、シャーロットといい……
無情な格差を感じるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, Charlotte... You two are next-level.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.JP: うへへ……。たしかに、でかい……

fields.EN:
Don't gaze at me with those eyes.
They're a curse, not a blessing.
fields.JP:
へ、変な目で見るな。
こんなの、大きくても厄介なだけだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't gaze at me with those eyes.
They're a curse, not a blessing.

fields.EN:
Right? They weigh on the back, and they
get in the way during battle. There's nothing
good about them.
fields.JP:
そうよ～？
肩が凝るし戦闘の邪魔になるしで、
いいことなんてなにもないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right? They weigh on the back, and they
get in the way during battle. There's nothing
good about them.

fields.EN: Hahaha. A curse. If only I could say the same!
fields.JP:
あはは。邪魔になるだって。
そんな経験、一度でいいからしてみたいな～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. A curse. If only I could say the same!

fields.EN: Those who have can never understand how those who don't feel.
fields.JP:
持てる者には持たざる者の気持ちなんて
わからないんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know what they say. The grass is
always greener...

fields.EN:
I wonder if they're part of the reason
Charlotte smells so good...
fields.JP:
シャーロットがいい匂いがするのは
乳のせいなのか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if they're part of the reason
Charlotte smells so good...

fields.EN: Do Tsuu's smell good too...? Hehehe.
fields.JP:
ってことは、つうもいい匂いがするって
ことか……うへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Do Otsuu's smell good too...? Hehehe.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Oh, Mary only has a tank top on. You're getting to that age, so why not try wearing some cuter underwear?
fields.JP:
あら、メアリーはタンクトップだけなのね。
そろそろ年頃なんだし、もっとかわいい下着を
つけてみてもいいんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh Mary, is that a tank top? You're of age,
so don't you think you could wear something
more cute?

fields.EN:
Forget about me! I've got nothing on Charlotte!
What's your secret?
fields.JP:
お、俺のことはどーでもいいだろ！
シャーロットみたいに胸でかくねーし……。
どうやったらそんなにでかくなるんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Forget about me! I've got nothing on Charlotte!
What's your secret?

fields.EN:
I hear the more they're touched,
the bigger they get.
fields.JP:
そういえば、胸を人に触ってもらえば
大きくなるって聞いたことがあるけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hear the more they're touched,
the bigger they get.

fields.EN: Really? Is that what you did, Charlotte?
fields.JP: 本当？　シャーロットはそうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? Is that what you did, Charlotte?

fields.EN: No. I was born this way...
fields.JP: いいえ、普通にこうなったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: No. I was born this way...

fields.JP: 全然参考にならないじゃない……

fields.EN:
Hehe, Alice. I see it bothers you.
You're so cute.
fields.JP:
ふふ、アリスったらそんなこと気にしてるのね。
かわいいんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe, Alice. I see it bothers you.
You're so cute.

fields.EN: Aah! What are you doing, Charlotte?!
fields.JP:
ひあっ！？　ちょっ、シャーロット！
どこ触って……っ
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah! What are you doing, Charlotte?!

fields.EN:
If you desire, my princess...I too...can be
gentle... Yes.
fields.JP:
も、もし姫がお望みでしたら、
僕も丁寧に……はい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you desire, my princess...I too...can be
gentle... Yes.

fields.JP: ありがとう。でもしなくていいからね？

fields.EN:
Got it. If I get a bigger chest, I can sniff
myself, huh...? Hehe... Hehehehe.
fields.JP:
そうか……自分が乳がでかくなったら
自分の体の匂いかげばいいのか……。
うへへ、うへへへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Got it. If I get a bigger chest, I can sniff
myself, huh...? Hehe... Hehehehe.

fields.JP: （なんて発想なんだ、メアリー……）

fields.EN:
(Man, what a conversation. I wonder
how they'd react if they knew I was
listening...)
fields.JP:
（それにしてもすごい話が聞こえてしまった。
　ここに一人男子がいるって知られたら、
　どうなることか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, what a conversation. I wonder
how they'd react if they knew I was
listening...)

fields.EN:
(Any more of this, and my mind would
probably start wandering. I'm gonna get
some sleep. I'll deal with this later...)
fields.JP:
（これ以上話を聞いてたら変な想像
　しそうだから、もう本当に寝ちゃおう。
　見つかったらそのときはそのときだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Any more of this, and my mind would
probably start wandering. I'm gonna get
some sleep. I'll deal with this later...)

fields.EN:
What's your deal? You're lingering.
Settle down.
fields.JP:
……なんだよ。
さっきからきょろきょろして
落ち着きないやつだな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your deal? You're lingering.
Settle down.

fields.EN:
You always pace when you're worried, Jack.
What's going on?
fields.JP:
ジャックは移動するときなんかは
いつも周りを気にしてるよな。
どうかしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You always pace when you're worried, Jack.
What's going on?

fields.EN:
Yeah. I just can't stop thinking about
where the others could be.
We couldn't have missed them.
fields.JP:
……うん。
離れ離れになったメンバーがいないかどうか、
いつも気をつけるようにしているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I just can't stop thinking about
where the others could be.
We couldn't have missed them.

fields.JP: みんな元気でいるといいな……

ど、どんなやつがいるんだよ。
そのメンバーってのは……

fields.EN:
All sorts of people. Akazukin-san,
for instance, is sorta the mother hen
of the group.
fields.JP:
いろんな人がいるよ。
たとえば赤ずきんさんなんて、
すごく頼れるお姉さんって感じなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
All sorts of people. Red Riding Hood,
for instance, is sorta the mother hen
of the group.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
そ、それって、シャーロットみたいな
やつってことか……？

fields.EN: I don't know. She's on a different level.
fields.JP:
どうだろう、二人ともベクトルが違う
お姉さんって感じだからなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know. She's on a different level.

fields.JP:
お姉さんといえばシンデレラも
僕たちよりお姉さんだな

fields.EN:
She's real lady-like, but every now and
then she can be negative.
fields.JP:
お嬢様みたいな話し方なんだけど、
根は庶民的な人で、たまに……うん。
ちょっとネガティブになるときもあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's real lady-like, but every now and
then she can be negative.

fields.EN: She sounds like a lot of work...
fields.JP: なんかめんどくせーやつだな……
fields.LOCALIZED: She sounds like a lot of work...

fields.EN:
But Cinderella's got a good heart.
She's so reliable! Seriously!
fields.JP:
で、でもシンデレラは優しい人だし、
いてくれるとすごく助かる存在だよ！
本当に！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But Cinderella's got a good heart.
She's so reliable! Seriously!

fields.EN:
Plus Oyayubihime, Shirayukihime, and Nemurihime. They're all sisters. They don't look
alike, but they've got it where it counts.
fields.JP:
それから親指姫と白雪姫と眠り姫の三姉妹。
姉妹なのに全然似てなくて、でも仲がよくて、
いつも互いに支え合っているんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Plus Thumbelina, Snow White, and Sleeping
Beauty. They're all sisters. They don't look
alike, but they've got it where it counts.

fields.EN:
I hope they're all together... I fear the worst
if not.
fields.JP:
あの三人がバラバラになっていたら
かわいそうだな……。
せめて三人一緒にいるといいんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hope they're all together... I fear the worst
if not.

fields.EN:
I bet they're just fine. The three of them
know how to fend for themselves. I worry
most for Kaguya.
fields.JP:
彼女たちなら仮に一人でも大丈夫だろう。
なんだかんだ言って常識があるからな。
それより心配なのは、かぐやだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet they're just fine. The three of them
know how to fend for themselves. I worry
most for Kaguya.

fields.EN:
Yeah. She can be kinda lazy. I bet she'd
hate all this walking.
fields.JP:
ああ……だらけていそうだもんね。
もう動きたくないですーとか言って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. She can be kinda lazy. I bet she'd
hate all this walking.

fields.EN:
When it comes down to it, she's a reliable
friend. I bet she's okay. Yup.
fields.JP:
で、でもいざというときは頼りになるんだ。
だからたぶん大丈夫。うん
fields.LOCALIZED:
When it comes down to it, she's a reliable
friend. I bet she's okay. Yup.

fields.EN:
...Yeah, I bet they're all fine.
Gretel, Hameln, and Rapunzel too.
fields.JP:
……そう、きっとみんな大丈夫だよ。
グレーテルも、ハーメルンも、ラプンツェルも
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Yeah, I bet they're all fine.
Gretel, Hameln, and Rapunzel too.

fields.EN:
Gretel's a bookworm, but sometimes she
can be a little hard to handle. Quiet but
sharp as a tack.
fields.JP:
グレーテルは知的好奇心が強すぎて
性格に難ありだけど、冷静で頭が切れるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's a bookworm, but sometimes she
can be a little hard to handle. Quiet but
sharp as a tack.

fields.EN:
Hameln's got a superiority complex, but
she means well. Always the first to help.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンはすぐ人のこと下僕扱いするけど、
仲間想いで意外と面倒見がいいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln's got a superiority complex, but
she means well. Always the first to help.

fields.EN: Rapunzel even treated me and the others as emergency food at first, but lately she's learned a lot more common sense.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルなんか、最初は僕や仲間を
非常食扱いしてたけど、最近はずいぶん
いろんな常識を覚えてきたし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, on the other hand, took some
getting used to, but she's grown up a lot.

fields.EN:
If those are just the summaries, I bet they're
nuts.
fields.JP:
……さらっと紹介聞いただけでも、
やばそうなやつばっかなんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
If those are just the summaries, I bet they're
nuts.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I'm worried about Clara too.
I hope she's with Haru-san at least...
fields.JP:
ああ、でもくららは心配だな。
せめてハルさんと一緒なら安心なんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I'm worried about Clara too.
I hope she's with Haru at least...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN:
Kaede-san, Itsuki-san, Takumi-san.
I hope they're all doing well...
fields.JP:
カエデさんやイツキさん、タクミさん、
他のみんなもどうしているかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede, Itsuki, Takumi.
I hope they're all doing well...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: イツキさん => Itsuki-san; タクミさん => Takumi-san; カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN: Heh. Look at Mister Popular. You got it good.
fields.JP: けっ……そんだけ仲間いたら超リア充だろ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh. Look at Mister Popular. You got it good.

fields.JP:
ジャック、心配するな。
みんなは無事だよ

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
I can only imagine how concerned you feel.
Hard not to expect the worst.
fields.JP:
いろいろ考えてしまうのはわかるけど、
悪い想像ばっかりするのは君の悪いクセだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only imagine how concerned you feel.
Hard not to expect the worst.

fields.EN:
Ease up a bit. All things will pass.
Have faith in them.
fields.JP:
たまには楽観的になったほうが
物事がいい方向に転がるかもしれないだろ？
だからみんなの無事を信じようよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ease up a bit. All things will pass.
Have faith in them.

fields.EN:
Yeah. You're right, Tsuu.
Let's find 'em soon!
fields.JP:
……うん、つうの言う通りだ。
早く合流できるようにがんばろう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. You're right, Otsuu.
Let's find 'em soon!
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Ugh. If more people join up, I'll lose it.
fields.JP:
……ったく、これ以上いろんなやつが増えたら
たまったもんじゃねーな
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. If more people join up, I'll lose it.

fields.EN:
Who knows if I'll even fit in?
What a depressing thought. *sigh*...
fields.JP:
この先合流したとしても、
そいつらとうまくやっていけるか
今から憂鬱だぜ。……はー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who knows if I'll even fit in?
What a depressing thought. *sigh*...

fields.EN:
(We need more plant samples so we can
create more food supplies.)
fields.JP:
（やはりもっと植物のサンプルが欲しいな。
　それぞれの特性を調べていけば
　食糧配給の効率が上昇するかもしれない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need more plant samples so we can
create more food supplies.)

fields.JP: ……ん？　誰か走っているのか？

fields.EN:
Oh... Akazukin.
I mean, you've already entered.
fields.JP:
ふぅ……赤ずきんか。
入るもなにも、入ってから言われてもな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... Red Riding Hood.
I mean, you've already entered.

fields.EN:
Hahaha. I figured it'd be okay.
It's only your room.
fields.JP: あはは、別にジュウの部屋だからいいかなって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. I figured it'd be okay.
It's only your room.

fields.JP:
（この間デリカシーについて言っていた
　人間とは思えないな）

fields.EN: I need to talk to you...
fields.LOCALIZED: I need to talk to you...

fields.JP: それならその用件を手短に教えてくれ

fields.EN: (It doesn't seem to be a big deal.)
fields.JP: （大した要件ではなさそうだな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It doesn't seem to be a big deal.)

fields.JP: むっ、何そんなに忙しいの？

fields.EN: Yes. I have much to think about.
fields.JP: ああ、考えることが山ほどある
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I have much to think about.

fields.EN:
Looking for plant nutrients. Need to make
sure we don't run out of food.
fields.JP:
今は食べられる植物の法則性を調べていた。
この状況、食糧危機はいつやってくるか
わからないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looking for plant nutrients. Need to make
sure we don't run out of food.

fields.EN: Oh. Should we be concerned about that?
fields.JP:
へぇ～、どういうものなら
食べられそうとかあるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Should we be concerned about that?

fields.EN: Could you get on with it?
fields.JP: それで用件を言ってくれないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Could you get on with it?

fields.EN:
I asked you a question, and you ignore me.
Why are you so rude?
fields.JP:
せっかく質問したのに無視して、
そんな言い方はないんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I asked you a question, and you ignore me.
Why are you so rude?

fields.EN:
You come into my tent and think I want
to make chit-chat? Out with it!
fields.JP:
僕のところに来て、
用件以外の世間話が必要なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You come into my tent and think I want
to make chit-chat? Out with it!

fields.JP: そりゃ絶対って訳じゃないけどさ……

fields.EN:
What could you possibly want? A running
partner? Companionship?
fields.JP:
何だ夜中にマラソンでもする話か？
それでひとりじゃ寂しいから僕を誘いにきたか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What could you possibly want? A running
partner? Companionship?

fields.EN: Or did you want to discuss the weather?
fields.JP:
それとも、今日は暖かったね、
とでも言いに来たのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Or did you want to discuss the weather?

fields.EN: Enough of these games. Cut to the chase.
fields.JP:
僕はどの話にも乗る気はない。
つまり早く要件を言え
fields.LOCALIZED: Enough of these games. Cut to the chase.

fields.EN: Ugh. I didn't come here to invite you running!
fields.JP: 別に走りの誘いにきたわけじゃないし！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. I didn't come here to invite you running!

fields.EN:
I was being facetious. If you have nothing
to say, then save it.
fields.JP:
皮肉だよ。
大した用件じゃないならまた今度にしてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was being facetious. If you have nothing
to say, then save it.

fields.EN: Ugh. Why are you so difficult?!
fields.JP: 別に雑談くらいしてもいいでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Why are you so difficult?!

fields.EN: You don't have to be such a jerk.
fields.JP:
なにもそんな冷たく
あしらわなくてもいいじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't have to be such a jerk.

fields.EN: (*sigh*... We're not moving on from this.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (*sigh*... We're not moving on from this.)

fields.EN: I wasn't. I told you I'm busy.
fields.JP:
あしらったわけじゃない。
さっきから言ってるが忙しい
fields.LOCALIZED: I wasn't. I told you I'm busy.

fields.EN:
If you want to be nice, then turn around
and leave my tent.
fields.JP:
気を使ってくれるなら、今すぐまわれ右をして
テントから出ていってくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you want to be nice, then turn around
and leave my tent.

fields.JP: ちょっ！　なに出口を進めてるのよ！

fields.EN: For crying out loud, your attitude stinks!
fields.JP:
まったくなによ！　その態度！
むかつく――！！
fields.LOCALIZED: For crying out loud, your attitude stinks!

fields.EN: Will you spit it out already?! What do you want?
fields.JP:
本当にこんな話をしにきたのか？
それならハッキリと抗議させてもらうぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Will you spit it out already?! What do you want?

fields.JP: うっ……だから、用件はあるってば

fields.EN: Man! Can't we just be friends?
fields.JP: もーー！　本題の前に交流を深めてもいいでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Man! Can't we just be friends?

fields.EN: No need. I can hardly tolerate you as is.
fields.JP:
ああ、もう十分だ。　君が極めて面倒くさい
人間だということはわかった
fields.LOCALIZED: No need. I can hardly tolerate you as is.

fields.JP: 用件だけ手短に言うわよ！

fields.EN: If you need something, then ask.
fields.JP:
なんだ……やっぱり用事があるのか……
最初からそうしてくれ
fields.LOCALIZED: If you need something, then ask.

fields.EN:
I just wanted to thank you for shooting
me with the Mary Gun before we fought
Genocide Pink!
fields.JP:
あの時、地上に出た時。　処刑台少女と戦う前に
メアリガンで助けてくれてありがとっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just wanted to thank you for shooting
me with the Mary Gun before we fought
Massacre Pink!
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: って、お礼を言いに来たの！

fields.EN: That's not what it looks like.
fields.JP: とてもお礼を言っている態度には見えんが……
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not what it looks like.

fields.EN:
I'm just thankful that at the end of the day,
you helped us out...
fields.JP:
なんだかんだ言いながらでもあたしたちに
協力してくれたことも感謝してるよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just thankful that at the end of the day,
you helped us out...

fields.EN: (So I see. She's come to thank me about it...)
fields.JP:
（しかし、そうか助けてくれたお礼を
　言いにきたわけだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (So I see. She's come to thank me about it...)

fields.EN: That's all you came here for?
fields.LOCALIZED: That's all you came here for?

fields.EN:
Yeah! That's all! Excuse me for bothering
you! Hmph!
fields.JP:
そうよ！　おしまい！
お邪魔さまでした！
失礼したね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! That's all! Excuse me for bothering
you! Hmph!

fields.EN:
Geez. I was dumb to think you look
like him!
fields.JP:
まったく……
少しでも似てると思ったあたしが
馬鹿みたいだった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Geez. I was dumb to think you look
like him!

fields.JP:
はあ……ようやく終わったか……
徒労感が……

fields.EN: Who do I look like...? Jack?
fields.JP:
それにしても……似てるって話……
またジャックというやつのことか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Who do I look like...? Jack?

fields.EN:
She's persistent. We couldn't be more
different.
fields.JP:
……しつこい話だ。
似てるもなにもまったくの別人
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's persistent. We couldn't be more
different.

fields.EN:
She's so hung up on that guy, too.
Gag me.
fields.JP:
どこまでその男にこだわっているんだ？
さすがに、こうもだと、少々うんざりだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's so hung up on that guy, too.
Gag me.

fields.EN:
(I never expected her to have the book
I wanted from Haru.)
fields.JP:
（はあ……まさかハルから借りたい黎明の本を
　赤ずきんが持ってるとは……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I never expected her to have the book
I wanted from Haru.)

fields.JP: （面倒なことにならなければいいが）
（赤ずきんのテントはここか）

fields.EN:
Must hurry and fix it. Just a minute.
I'm pretty quick.
fields.JP:
じゃあ早めに直しますね！
待っていて下さい。
これでも手は早い方で自信があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Must hurry and fix it. Just a minute.
I'm pretty quick.

fields.JP:
えっ、あっ！　
ジュウさんでしたか失礼しました！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Sorry, I was standing at the entrance.
fields.JP: こちらこそ入り口に突っ立ていてすまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, I was standing at the entrance.

fields.EN: Juu?! Juu's here? Hey, stay out!
fields.JP:
ジュウ！？　ジュウが来てるの！？
ちょっ、入ってこないでよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh?! Toh's here? Hey, stay out!

fields.JP: （顔も見ずにいきなり拒絶か……理不尽だ）

fields.EN:
Akazukin. I need to talk to you. 
You busy?
fields.JP:
赤ずきんに用があってきたんだ。
今は都合が悪いのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood. I need to talk to you. 
You busy?

fields.EN: T-tttalk to me?! I'll hear you out later!
fields.JP: よ、よ、用事！？　なら、後で聞くから！
fields.LOCALIZED: T-tttalk to me?! I'll hear you out later!

fields.EN:
(What is her problem? She's emotionally
unstable. I saw her talking to Kunai.)
fields.JP:
（なんだあいつは？　情緒不安定だな。
　今クナイとはしゃべっていただろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What is her problem? She's emotionally
unstable. I saw her talking to Kunai.)

fields.EN:
I think Akazukin-san feels uneasy because she's not
wearing her hood right now.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんさんは今フードを被ってないので
不安になられてるんだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED: Without her hood, she can be moody.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: ん、フードを？　あの赤い？

fields.EN: (Oh, Kunai's holding her jacket. It's torn.)
fields.JP:
（そう言えば、クナイが持ってるのは
　赤ずきんのジャケットだな。
　しかも少しやぶれてるぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh, Kunai's holding her jacket. It's torn.)

fields.JP:
（そうか、確か赤ずきんの血式リビドーは……
　そうか……そういうことか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh I see, Red Riding Hood's Blood Libido.)

fields.EN:
(Well, that explains that. Just because
she's unstable, why can't she see me?)
fields.JP:
（いや、それはそれ、これはこれだろう？
　どうして不安になったから
　僕に会いたくないになるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, that explains that. Just because
she's unstable, why can't she see me?)

fields.EN:
Can you leave her be? I'm gonna sew her
jacket.
fields.JP:
だから、そっとしておいて下さいませんか？
わたくしはジャケットを直してきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can you leave her be? I'm gonna sew her
jacket.

fields.JP: （うむ……いまいち納得が得られないな）

fields.EN:
Why don't you want to speak? I don't get
it. What's the big deal?
fields.JP:
不安なのに会いたくないというのは
どういう意味だ？　よくわからないが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you want to speak? I don't get
it. What's the big deal?

fields.EN:
Hey, get out of here! I don't want you in
here!
fields.JP:
ちょっと何、入ってきてんのよ！
あんたには見られたくないっていってるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, get out of here! I don't want you in
here!

fields.EN: If you're anxious, I'll just wait.
fields.JP: まぁ不安ならばしばらく待つまでだ
fields.LOCALIZED: If you're anxious, I'll just wait.

fields.EN: (Phew. I guess I'll wait a little outside...)
fields.JP: （ふうっ、しばらく外で待つか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Phew. I guess I'll wait a little outside...)

fields.JP: よっし！　出ていってくれた……

fields.EN:
Ugh. I'm weak enough as is. I can't show
that side to Juu.
fields.JP:
まったく、こんなただでさえ弱ってるとき、
ジュウなんかに弱気なところ見せられないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. I'm weak enough as is. I can't show
that side to Toh.

fields.EN:
*sigh* Shirayuki, Oyayubi, Cinderella...
I wish you were all here.
fields.JP:
はあ、白雪や親指、シンデレラも
一緒に呼べばよかったかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Snow White, Thumbelina, Cinderella...
I wish you were all here.

fields.EN: But would they even come if I called?
fields.JP: でも、今のあたしなんかに来てくれるかな……
fields.LOCALIZED: But would they even come if I called?

fields.EN: No, no! Gotta stay strong! Get it together, Akazukin!
fields.JP:
だめだめ！　今は心を強く持たなきゃ！
しっかりするのよ！　赤ずきん！
fields.LOCALIZED: No! Gotta stay strong! Come on, Red!
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: Akazukin directly addresses herself by her source name; localization substitutes 'Red'.

fields.EN:
Even so, I refuse to be vulnerable in front
of Juu!
fields.JP:
それでもジュウに見せる弱気な顔なんて
ないんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Even so, I refuse to be vulnerable in front
of Toh!

fields.JP: （さっきからずっと独り言か？）

fields.EN: (I'll let her calm down. I can enjoy my book.)
fields.JP:
（まあ、落ち着くまで待とう。
　本を持ち歩いていて良かった）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'll let her calm down. I can enjoy my book.)

fields.EN:
(By the time I finish this chapter, she
should have calmed down.)
fields.JP:
（この項目を読み終わるうちに
　気持ちも落ち着くだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(By the time I finish this chapter, she
should have calmed down.)

fields.EN:
(Hm? She's taken a while. I got too into the
book.)
fields.JP:
（ん？　だいぶ時間が経ったな。
　夢中になって読み過ぎたぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? She's taken a while. I got too into the
book.)

fields.JP: 赤ずきんさん、直りました！
fields.LOCALIZED: Red Riding Hood, I fixed it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Oh, Juu-san, you were still here?
fields.JP: あら、ジュウさんまだいたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Toh, you were still here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: どうして、ここにいるのよ！

fields.EN: I told you I would be...?
fields.JP: いや、しばらくいると言ったはずだが……？
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you I would be...?

fields.JP:
それじゃあ、まさか……
さっきまでのひとり言も聞いてたの！？

fields.EN: That's rude. I just heard it. You were loud.
fields.JP:
人聞きが悪いな。
勝手に聞こえてきただけだ。
うるさかったぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's rude. I just heard it. You were loud.

fields.EN:
Now, now, calm down, you two. By the way, Juu-san,
why were you waiting?
fields.JP:
まあ、まあ、ふたりとも落ち着いて。
それにしてもジュウさんは
どうして待ってたんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now now. You two calm down.
Why were you waiting?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: I need to speak with Akazukin.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんに用事があったから
待っていただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I need to speak with Red Riding Hood.

fields.EN:
Perfect timing. Now that you're here,
I can say it.
fields.JP:
ちょうどいい。
顔を出してくれたことだし、
今言っておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect timing. Now that you're here,
I can say it.

fields.EN:
You know that book from the Dawn that
Haru gave you? Could you lend it to me?
Haru already said I could.
fields.JP:
ハルから借りた黎明の本があるだろ。
あれを貸してくれないか？
ハルには既に許可を取っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know that book from the Dawn that
Haru gave you? Could you lend it to me?
Haru already said I could.

fields.EN: That's it?! Ugh! Fine, take it!
fields.JP:
そ、そんだけのため！？
もう！　これでしょ、ほら！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's it?! Ugh! Fine, take it!

fields.EN: Don't throw it! It's an important artifact!
fields.JP:
本を投げるな。
大事な参考文献だぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't throw it! It's an important artifact!

fields.EN: Begone already! You got what you came for.
fields.JP:
もうこれで用ないでしょ。
さっさと帰りなさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Begone already! You got what you came for.

fields.EN:
Right. I also mean to thank you the other
day. I apologize for being rude.
fields.JP:
あぁ、あとこの間の礼を言いに来たが、
あの時は不躾だったかもしれない。
すまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I also mean to thank you the other
day. I apologize for being rude.

fields.EN:
My wife once told me I have a mean streak.
So I'm sorry.
fields.JP:
確かに妻にも出迎える礼儀がなってないと
言われたことがある。すまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
My wife once told me I have a mean streak.
So I'm sorry.

fields.JP: う、うん……まぁ、それはいいよ……

fields.EN:
I don't appreciate you eavesdropping!
I was testing you.
fields.JP:
でも、ひとりごと聞くなんてデリカシーなさすぎ！
だましうちだから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't appreciate you eavesdropping!
I was testing you.

fields.JP: しかし、それは不可抗力で……

fields.EN: Forget it! Go back to your room!
fields.JP:
もういい！　わかったから、
さっさと部屋にもどれーーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Forget it! Go back to your room!

fields.EN: I was planning on it. Later.
fields.JP:
元々そうするつもりだ。
それじゃあな
fields.LOCALIZED: I was planning on it. Later.

fields.JP: （相変わらず感情が騒がしいやつだな）

（まったく、赤ずきんのやつは
　何を考えてるんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Gosh, what is Red Riding Hood thinking?)

fields.JP: （こんなこと許すわけないだろ……）

（また、いろいろと文句を返すだろうが、
　今回だけは、ハッキリ抗議させてもらおう）

はあっ！？
ちょっと声もかけずになんで入ってくるかな！

fields.EN:
Akazukin. I heard you're trying
to get out of this tower.
fields.JP:
赤ずきん。
この監獄塔の外に出ようとしてるらしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood. I heard you're trying
to get out of this tower.

fields.EN: I mean, what are you talking about?
fields.JP: あ、いや、なんのことかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean, what are you talking about?

fields.EN:
I know you know how dangerous it is
outside.
fields.JP:
監獄塔の外が危険なのはわかってるが、
どこまで危険かわかるかと聞いてたらしいな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know you know how dangerous it is
outside.

fields.EN:
Don't try to play it off. Jabberwock told me
you asked him something odd.
fields.JP:
今さらごまかすな。
ジャバウォックが赤ずきんから
妙な質問をされたと聞いた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't try to play it off. Jabberwock told me
you asked him something odd.

fields.EN: Oh, so Jabberwock gave me away.
fields.JP: あー、ジャバウォックからもれたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, so Jabberwock gave me away.

fields.EN: Damn him. He has such a big mouth.
fields.JP:
ジャバウォックのやつ
口が軽いんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Damn him. He has such a big mouth.

fields.EN:
Don't pin it on Jabberwock. 
I know your plan.
fields.JP:
ジャバウォックを責めるのは筋違いだぞ
おかげで、この計画がわかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't pin it on Jabberwock. 
I know your plan.

fields.EN:
Thanks to that, you'll live. I can't let you
go through with your plan.
fields.JP:
そのおかげで赤ずきんは命拾いしたな。
いいか？　お前が計画してることは
絶対にさせる訳にはいかない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to that, you'll live. I can't let you
go through with your plan.

fields.EN:
What's your problem? You can't come in
here and boss me around. Who do you
think you are?!
fields.JP:
なによ！　いきなり上から目線で
絶対にさせないって……！
何様のつもり！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your problem? You can't come in
here and boss me around. Who do you
think you are?!

fields.EN: You have no idea what I'm planning.
fields.JP:
第一、別にその話だけで外に出るとは
断定できないでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You have no idea what I'm planning.

fields.EN:
Wrong. I cornered Shirayukihime and she
confessed.
fields.JP:
いや、計画のことを白雪姫に
問い詰めたら白状したぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wrong. I cornered Snow White and she
confessed.

fields.EN:
Damn it, Shirayuki! I told her not to
tell you.
fields.JP:
白雪のやつーー！
言うなって言ったのに！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn it, Snow White! I told her not to
tell you.

fields.JP:
白雪姫だって、お前のことを
心配していたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White was worried about you.

fields.JP: なぜこんなことをしようとした？

fields.EN: You know why I'm trying to stop you, right?
fields.JP:
どうして僕がこんなにも止めるか
わかっているよな
fields.LOCALIZED: You know why I'm trying to stop you, right?

fields.EN: I told you: outside the actual Jail Tower is the Devouring Armada Tower's feeding territory. We never know when it might attack.
fields.JP:
実際の監獄塔の外は
「悪食の監隊塔」の捕食領域で
いつ襲われるかわからないと言ったはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED: If you leave, you'll be devoured.

fields.EN: If you're eaten, we're all good as dead.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんが捕食されたら、
僕たちも危険にさらすことになるんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: If you're eaten, we're all good as dead.

fields.EN: I know! You don't have to tell me! But...
fields.JP:
それは知ってるよ！　知らないわけない！
でも……
fields.LOCALIZED: I know! You don't have to tell me! But...

fields.EN:
We still haven't found Jack, Nemu, or
anyone else. They could be outside...
fields.JP:
こんなに探してもいないから、ジャックや
ネムや仲間たちが外にいるんじゃないかって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We still haven't found Jack, Sleepy, or
anyone else. They could be outside...

fields.EN:
Yeah! It's about Jack! And Nemu! And the
others! This is serious to me!
fields.JP:
そう！　ジャックのことだよ！
それにネム！　みんなのことだよ！
そりゃあ、真剣になるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah! It's about Jack! And Sleepy! And the
others! This is serious to me!

fields.EN:
Dangerous or not, looking outside of the
tower might clue us in.
fields.JP:
いくら危険だって聞いても監獄塔の周りをみれば、
なにか情報が得られるかと思ったの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dangerous or not, looking outside of the
tower might clue us in.

fields.EN: We don't have many other options.
fields.JP:
だって、今はもうそれくらいしか
見つける方法ないんだからさ
fields.LOCALIZED: We don't have many other options.

fields.EN:
You're risking your life for an assumption.
There's no guarantee you'll find anything.
fields.JP:
そんな曖昧な推測で危険を冒そうとしてるのか？
外に出れば情報を得るという確証はないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're risking your life for an assumption.
There's no guarantee you'll find anything.

fields.EN: But there's no guarantee I'll die either!
fields.JP:
でも、逆に外に出れば必ず危険って言う
確証もないじゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: But there's no guarantee I'll die either!

fields.EN:
Listen. Calm down. Think about it.
You'd risk your life in the off-chance
you might find your friends?
fields.JP:
いいか、冷静に考えてみるんだ。
仲間がいるかいないかの確証を得るために
外に出て命の危険があるかないか確認する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen. Calm down. Think about it.
You'd risk your life in the off-chance
you might find your friends?

fields.JP: そんな必要性あるのか？

fields.EN: ARGH! Because I said so! There's a chance!
fields.JP:
ううぅ～！
でも、でもなんだよ！　可能性があるなら！
fields.LOCALIZED: ARGH! Because I said so! There's a chance!

fields.EN: What are you in a rush for, Akazukin?
fields.JP:
赤ずきん、いったい何を
焦っているんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you in a rush for, Red Riding Hood?

fields.JP: それじゃただ何も考えていない馬鹿だぞ

fields.EN:
If you put your friends in danger again, it
would be all your fault.
fields.JP:
お前のせいでまた仲間たちが危険に
なるかもしれないのがなぜわからない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you put your friends in danger again, it
would be all your fault.

fields.EN: Again. Did you say again?! I'm going alone!
fields.JP:
またって……またって！
こ、今回はあたし一人だし！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Again. Did you say again?! I'm going alone!

fields.EN: What about you? You claim to be worried.
fields.JP:
そういうあんたはどうなの？
まるであたしたちを心配してる風だけど
fields.LOCALIZED: What about you? You claim to be worried.

fields.EN: The real reason you don't want us to die is so you can find your precious wife, right?!
fields.JP:
実際のところ、あたしたちに
死んでほしくないのは
大事な奥さんを探すためでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: But you're just trying to find your own wife!

fields.EN: I can't be a selfish bastard like you!
fields.JP:
あんたみたいな自己中心的に
あたしはなれない！
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't be a selfish bastard like you!

fields.EN:
I'm not going to get in your way or
trouble my friends, so leave me alone!
Leave!
fields.JP:
あんたの邪魔や仲間に迷惑はかけないんだから
ほっといて！　出て行って！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not going to get in your way or
trouble my friends, so leave me alone!
Leave!

fields.JP: 早く、ほら、出ていってよ！

fields.EN: Ouch! Don't throw stuff at me. I'll leave.
fields.JP:
いたっ、物を投げるな。
出ていく
fields.LOCALIZED: Ouch! Don't throw stuff at me. I'll leave.

fields.EN:
(It's true I am taking action to find my wife.
But that was cruel.)
fields.JP:
（確かに僕は自分の妻を探すために
　行動している……。
　ただ、いざ言われると……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true I am taking action to find my wife.
But that was cruel.)

fields.EN: I didn't know this tower had an entrance.
fields.JP: この監獄塔には入り口があったんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't know this tower had an entrance.

fields.EN: Yeah. There it is. Looks like it.
fields.JP:
うむ………。　あれが監獄塔の入り口か
それらしい雰囲気だな
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. There it is. Looks like it.

fields.EN: This is a perfect time to try this out.
fields.JP: これを試すには持ってこいだ
fields.LOCALIZED: This is a perfect time to try this out.

fields.JP: ジュウッ！　かぐや待って！

ジュウさんっ！　かぐやさん！
　待ってくださいませ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
(Why are they here...?
And why are they panicking?)
fields.JP:
（ふたりとも、なぜここに……？
　それにしても何を慌てて来てる？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why are they here...?
And why are they panicking?)

fields.EN:
What are you doing, you idiot?
Where are you going?!
fields.JP:
何やってるの馬鹿！
どこに近寄ってんのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing, you idiot?
Where are you going?!

fields.EN: You're the one who said it's dangerous outside!
fields.JP:
あんたが監獄塔の外は危ないって
言ってたんじゃんっ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the one who said it's dangerous outside!

fields.EN:
Then what are you doing here?
You wouldn't come walking out here.
fields.JP:
いったい、何をしに来たんですの？
こんなところまで散歩ではないでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then what are you doing here?
You wouldn't come walking out here.

fields.EN:
Of course not. I was just trying to look
outside.
fields.JP:
もちろんだ。
ちょっと監獄塔の外を見ようと
思って来ただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course not. I was just trying to look
outside.

fields.JP:
そんな本当にっ！
はあ、くらくらと眩暈がしてきましたわ

fields.EN:
If we did the same thing, Juu-san would definitely
get furious and stop us.
fields.JP:
同じことをわたくしたちがしましたら、
きっとジュウさんは激怒して止めてますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we did the same thing, you would berate
us.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
そうだ！　そうだ！
シンデレラの言う通りだよ！！

fields.EN: Besides Kaguya! Why are you helping him?
fields.JP: それにかぐや！　あんたもなに協力してんのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Besides Kaguya! Why are you helping him?

fields.EN: It's too dangerous for Juu-san to go alone.
fields.JP: いや普通にジュウさん一人じゃ危ないですし～
fields.LOCALIZED: It's too dangerous for Toh to go alone.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: No, why aren't you stopping him?!
fields.JP: いや、なんで止めないんですの！？
fields.LOCALIZED: No, why aren't you stopping him?!

fields.EN: Juu! Don't be an idiot and don't go outside!
fields.JP:
ともかくジュウ！
外に出るなんてバカなことやめて！
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh! Don't be an idiot and don't go outside!

fields.EN:
You were the one that said I was the idiot
for going outside. So what are YOU doing?
fields.JP:
あんたが外に出るなんて馬鹿だって言ったのよ！
それなのに、何やってるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were the one that said I was the idiot
for going outside. So what are YOU doing?

fields.EN:
Yes, I said too much the other day.
I apologize for that.
fields.JP:
こ、この間はあたしも言い過ぎだったよ。
それは謝るよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I said too much the other day.
I apologize for that.

fields.EN: Don't be stubborn! Hear me out!
fields.JP: もう意地にならないでよ！　聞いて！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be stubborn! Hear me out!

fields.EN:
I know I said it was all for your wife, but
I can see you're risking your life for us.
fields.JP:
ジュウは奥さんのためだっていっても、
そもそも自分の血を使って命がけで
あたしたちをサポートしてくれる
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I said it was all for your wife, but
I can see you're risking your life for us.

fields.JP:
そうですわ。
いつも感謝してますわ

fields.EN:
You might be rude, but your efforts don't
go unnoticed. I appreciate you!
fields.JP:
口は悪いけどいつだって脱獄のために
色々と調べて実践してくれているのも
すごーく助かってる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You might be rude, but your efforts don't
go unnoticed. I appreciate you!

fields.EN:
So I take back what I said earlier!
I overstepped your boundaries. I was mean.
fields.JP:
だからこの間いったことは取り消す！
言い過ぎた。酷かった、ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I take back what I said earlier!
I overstepped your boundaries. I was mean.

fields.JP: ジュウさん、どうか考え直して下さいまし
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP:
ねえ、ジュウ！
本当にごめんってば……

fields.EN:
What are you talking about...? You got
it all wrong.
fields.JP:
……さっきからなにを言ってるんだ？
何を勘違いしている？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about...? You got
it all wrong.

fields.EN:
I'm just using this stick with a mirror attached
to look out of the tower.
fields.JP:
僕は、この長い棒の先に鏡をつけたものを使って
監獄塔の外を見ようとしていただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm just using this stick with a mirror attached
to look out of the tower.

fields.EN:
I have been thinking of a way to see the
outside without going outside.
fields.JP:
ずっと外に出ないで外を見る方法が
ないかと考えてたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have been thinking of a way to see the
outside without going outside.

fields.EN: And this is what I made: a stick with a mirror attached. It looks like a toy, but it's actually pretty useful.
fields.JP:
そしてできたのが、この鏡がついた棒だ。
おもちゃのようでいて、結構使える
fields.LOCALIZED: Now we have this. Primitive, but useful.

fields.JP: えっ、ええっと……それじゃ……

fields.EN: I wouldn't risk my life for nothing.
fields.JP:
僕が命をかけて何の勝算もなく
外に出るわけないだろ
fields.LOCALIZED: I wouldn't risk my life for nothing.

fields.EN:
I calculated, thought it out, so I'm putting the
plan to action. Unlike someone.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと計算して熟考しての結論を
行動に移したまでだ。　誰かさんとは違う
fields.LOCALIZED:
I calculated, thought it out, so I'm putting the
plan to action. Unlike someone.

fields.EN: Yep. He explained it all to me prior.
fields.JP:
わらわもそう聞いていたので、
一緒に来たんですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yep. He explained it all to me prior.

fields.JP:
それじゃあ、早速この長い棒を
監獄塔の入り口の先、外に伸ばしてみよう

fields.EN: How wonderful. Now we can look.
fields.JP:
まあ、素晴らしいですわ。
これで外が見れますのね。
わたくしも覗いてみますわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: How wonderful. Now we can look.

fields.JP: シンデレラ、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
I-I-I thought I locked eyes with the
Devouring Armada Tower through the mirror.
fields.JP:
い、い、今！
鏡の奥に見える悪食の監隊塔と
目があったような気がしましたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I-I thought I locked eyes with the
Devouring Armada Tower through the mirror.

fields.JP: とても恐ろしいですわ

まずい！　監獄塔の入り口から
肉触手が出てきたぞ！
この触手、あんたの鏡を飲み込んでく！
ジュウさん！　危ないですわ！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: くそっ！　くれてやる！

fields.EN: It took the stick with the mirror and went back inside the Jail Tower.
fields.JP:
鏡の棒を持って、
監獄塔の中に戻っていった

気持ち悪っ！
あんなのがいるの！？

fields.EN:
Phew. I didn't expect it to take my tool
so quickly, but oh well. Can't be helped.
fields.JP:
ふう……道具がすぐなくなったのは誤算だが。
まぁ仕方ない、収穫はあった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. I didn't expect it to take my tool
so quickly, but oh well. Can't be helped.

fields.JP:
まったくね。
シンデレラも危ないところだったよ

fields.EN:
Now you'll believe me when I say it's
dangerous outside.
fields.JP:
これでわかったな。
やはり外は危険なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now you'll believe me when I say it's
dangerous outside.

fields.EN:
Akazukin. I get your point.
But still you shouldn't.
fields.JP:
僕も赤ずきんの焦りはわかる。
だがこれはやめた方が良い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood. I get your point.
But still you shouldn't.

fields.JP: 今ので十分、それの理由を理解したはずだぞ
そ、そうだね。　ごめんなさい……

fields.EN:
I'm glad you guys understood before you
tried it.
fields.JP:
君たちが外に出る前に
分かって良かったよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad you guys understood before you
tried it.

fields.EN: If it snatched you, all would be for naught.
fields.JP:
こんなことになったら、
それこそ目も当てられない
fields.LOCALIZED: If it snatched you, all would be for naught.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP:
わらわはあんなの見て疲れました～
早く戻りましょう～

fields.EN: Yes. Our business is done here. Come now.
fields.JP: 確かにここにはもう用はない、戻るぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. Our business is done here. Come now.

fields.EN:
Hey it's me. Akazukin!!
Can I come in? Well I already did!
fields.JP:
おーい、あたしよ、赤ずきん！
入れてっつか、もう入るよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey it's me. Red Riding Hood!!
Can I come in? Well I already did!

fields.EN:
Haha. Classic response. "What do you want?
What do you want?" Got any better greetings?
fields.JP:
ははっ……相変わらずまずそれだね。
用件、用件って、もう少し歓迎してほしいなあ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Classic response. "What do you want?
What do you want?" Got any better greetings?

fields.EN:
Well, you always have something to say.
Don't say I don't welcome you.
fields.JP:
普通は用があるから来るものだ
それに歓迎してないとは言ってない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, you always have something to say.
Don't say I don't welcome you.

fields.EN: Of course I have something to say.
fields.JP: もちろん、用はありありだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course I have something to say.

fields.EN: What is it? Hurry up. I'm busy...
fields.JP:
なんだ？　じゃあ、さっさと言ってくれ。
僕はいそが
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it? Hurry up. I'm busy...

fields.EN: Yeah, yeah. I get it. Ready? Listen up.
fields.JP:
忙しいから直ぐ済ませてだよね。
わかってるって……
いい？　よおく聞いて
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, yeah. I get it. Ready? Listen up.

fields.EN:
...Let me apologize for the other day.
I got the wrong idea, I just blabbered around.
I feel bad.
fields.JP:
……この間はごめんなさい。
勝手に誤解して変なこと口走って……。
今は反省してる
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Let me apologize for the other day.
I got the wrong idea, I just blabbered around.
I feel bad.

fields.EN: I actually went too far. I wasn't thinking.
fields.JP:
あたし、猪突猛進過ぎた。
まったくもって考えなしだった
fields.LOCALIZED: I actually went too far. I wasn't thinking.

fields.EN: You don't have to say that. But I get it.
fields.JP:
いや、そこまで言うことないぞ。
確かに考えなしで猛進だが……
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't have to say that. But I get it.

fields.EN:
Firstly, I was the one who took action.
That was not your fault.
fields.JP:
第一、今回のことを勝手に
やったのは僕自身だ。
赤ずきんが気にすることはない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Firstly, I was the one who took action.
That was not your fault.

fields.EN: That's not it. Not about that.
fields.JP: 違うよ。そっちじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not it. Not about that.

fields.EN:
Then what are you talking about?
Was there anything else? I don't remember.
fields.JP:
そっちじゃないならどっちだ？
ほかに何かあったか？　覚えていないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then what are you talking about?
Was there anything else? I don't remember.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry for saying that you only wanted
to find your wife.
fields.JP:
ジュウがあたしたちに死んでほしくないのは
大事な奥さんを探すためだって方……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry for saying that you only wanted
to find your wife.

fields.EN:
I mean the time I said, "I can't be as
self-centered as you!"
fields.JP:
あんたみたいに自己中心的にあたしはなれない！
って、言っちゃったやつの方だよ
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
ああ、そっちか……
別に気にしてない

fields.EN:
You even made a tool to help us see the
outside clearly.
fields.JP:
ジュウはこの間もなんだかんだ
あたしたちのために、あんな道具を
作ってくれて監獄塔の外を調べてみてくれた
fields.LOCALIZED:
You even made a tool to help us see the
outside clearly.

fields.EN: Thanks to that, I realized again just how frightening it is outside a Jail Tower.
fields.JP:
おかげで、いかに監獄塔の外が怖いか、
改めて実感できた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks to you, I was able to see how right
you really are.

fields.EN:
The experiment may have looked like a
failure, but it was fruitful.
fields.JP:
あの実験は失敗だったが、
それなりの収穫はあったようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
The experiment may have looked like a
failure, but it was fruitful.

fields.EN:
Seriously though. Don't worry. It's not
like it costs us anything to learn.
fields.JP:
でも、あれは本当に気にしなくていい。
僕も興味があったし
実際に外に出て調べたわけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seriously though. Don't worry. It's not
like it costs us anything to learn.

fields.EN: I know! But you didn't deserve what I said.
fields.JP: 気にするよ！　あたし、ひどいこと言った
fields.LOCALIZED: I know! But you didn't deserve what I said.

fields.EN:
Juu, you're always looking out for us.
You even give us your blood.
fields.JP:
あんな風にいつだってリスクを回避する
ジュウが普段は自分の血を使って助けてくれたり、
ときには身体を張って戦ってもくれる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, you're always looking out for us.
You even give us your blood.

fields.EN: Well, I do what I can.
fields.JP: まあ、それもなりゆきだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I do what I can.

fields.EN: No. If you really didn't care, we'd know.
fields.JP:
ううん、きっとジュウが本当に嫌なら
あたし達を使わない方法を考えるはず……
fields.LOCALIZED: No. If you really didn't care, we'd know.

fields.EN: I took Juu's kindness for granted and kept focusing only on his dry words.
fields.JP:
あたしはそんなジュウの当たり前に甘えていて、
いつもドライな言葉にばかり気を取られてた
fields.LOCALIZED: So I took advantage of your kindness.

fields.EN: I thought you were just using us.
fields.JP:
勝手にあたしたちを利用するために
一緒にいるんだと思っていた……
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought you were just using us.

fields.EN:
But...I'm ashamed of how I acted. Please
accept my apology.
fields.JP: あたし……自分が恥ずかしいよ、ごめん……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...I'm ashamed of how I acted. Please
accept my apology.

fields.EN: Snark... You know about the Professor, right?
fields.JP: スナーク……黎明の博士の話は知ってるよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Snark... You know about the Professor, right?

fields.JP:
ああ、知っている。
裏切者だろう

fields.EN:
That traitor raised me. Tricked me into
thinking he loved me.
fields.JP:
あたしはその裏切者に育てられたんだ。
ずっと愛されていたと騙されて十数年間生きて来た
fields.LOCALIZED:
That traitor raised me. Tricked me into
thinking he loved me.

fields.EN:
Because of that... I'm doubting everything
about myself as a leader and as an older sister.
fields.JP:
そのせいで、今までの人生を……
血式少女隊のリーダーってことや
姉であったことを全否定された気がした
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because of that... I'm doubting everything
about myself as a leader and as an older sister.

fields.EN:
Now I feel flustered because the people
who supported me aren't here.
fields.JP:
何よりそれでも肯定してくれていた仲間達が
いなくなったことで大分焦ってたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I feel flustered because the people
who supported me aren't here.

fields.EN: Then, you appeared Juu. And I was...shocked.
fields.JP:
そうやって焦ってたところに、
ジュウが現れて……ひどく動揺した
fields.LOCALIZED: Then, you appeared Toh. And I was...shocked.

fields.EN: Why? Is there something about me that would unsettle you?
fields.JP:
どうしてだ？
なにか僕に動揺させる要素があるのか？

fields.EN:
You see, Juu, you really remind me so
much of Dad. The Professor. So being
around you is sorta complicated.
fields.JP:
実は……ジュウはあたしのお父さんに、
……博士に似てるんだよ。
だから、そばにいるとなんか落ち着かなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
You see, Toh, you really remind me so
much of Dad. The Professor. So being
around you is sorta complicated.

fields.EN:
Sorry. For that reason, I guess I see you as
a kind of father figure.
fields.JP:
ごめん……そんなんで初めなぜか無意識に
ジュウに父親と同じようなことを
期待してたのかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. For that reason, I guess I see you as
a kind of father figure.

fields.EN:
But you were dryer than I thought you'd
be. It felt unfair. So I took it out on you.
fields.JP:
でも、ジュウが想像以上にドライな人だから、
あたしはそれを理不尽に感じて、
勝手にガッカリしてたんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you were dryer than I thought you'd
be. It felt unfair. So I took it out on you.

fields.EN:
It's not your fault, Juu. I'm sorry for
being so difficult. It won't happen again.
fields.JP:
だから、全然ジュウは悪くない。
不快な思いを今までさせてきてごめん。
もう誤解しない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not your fault, Toh. I'm sorry for
being so difficult. It won't happen again.

fields.EN: You're not my father, Juu. You are Juu!
fields.JP:
ジュウはあたしの父親じゃない。
ジュウはジュウ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not my father, Toh. You are Toh!

fields.EN: (A rare show of honesty from her...)
fields.JP:
（そう言えば、少しでも似てると思った私が
　ばかみたいだったとか言っていたな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (A rare show of honesty from her...)

fields.EN: Heh. So you've got daddy issues.
fields.JP: ふっ、赤ずきんはとんだファザコンだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh. So you've got daddy issues.

fields.EN: Yeah I do! So be it!
fields.JP: そ、そうよ！　悪かったわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah I do! So be it!

fields.JP: 赤ずきんに１つアドバイスがある

ジュウがあたしにアドバイス？
珍しい……

fields.EN: I don't expect anything from you, Akazukin.
fields.JP: 僕は赤ずきんに何も期待していない
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't have much faith in you.

fields.EN:
But don't get me wrong. Listen.
It doesn't mean I've given up.
fields.JP:
誤解しないで聞いてくれ。
諦めてるといってるわけじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't get me wrong. Listen.
It doesn't mean I've given up.

fields.EN: I mean to say, you're fine the way you are.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんは今の君のままで
良いって言ってるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I mean to say, you're fine the way you are.

fields.EN:
You don't have to fulfill some older sister role,
and no one is forcing you to be a leader.
fields.JP:
姉である必要もなければ
リーダーである必要もない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't have to fulfill some older sister role,
and no one is forcing you to be a leader.

fields.EN:
You are free to pursue a life unburdened
by expectation. Live how you want to.
fields.JP:
そんな変な期待に縛られない、
今のままの赤ずきんで良いんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are free to pursue a life unburdened
by expectation. Live how you want to.

fields.EN:
I'm fine the way I am...? I am?
No, no. That's not true.
fields.JP:
今のままでいい……いいって、いいの？
いやいやいや、そんなこと駄目だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm fine the way I am...? I am?
No, no. That's not true.

fields.EN:
Akazukin, you put others first
constantly. I don't understand how.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんは論理よりも他人のために、
そんな先だった感情を優先して動く人間だ。
僕は理解できないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood, you put others first
constantly. I don't understand how.

fields.EN:
But that makes you the backbone of this
group. Everyone has their roles. You're my
polar opposite.
fields.JP:
が、そんな風に自分と真逆の人間がいないと
実はこういう団体は成り立たない。
人には「役割」があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that makes you the backbone of this
group. Everyone has their roles. You're my
polar opposite.

fields.JP: 真逆の人間……それってあたしだ

fields.EN: I think a lot of people have probably been saved by Akazukin without even realizing it.
fields.JP:
きっと多くの人が知らないうちに
赤ずきんに救われていると思うぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Before I knew it, you saved everyone.

fields.EN:
No. I've seen it myself. I know how hard you
work.
fields.JP:
いや、そう見えるし、実際そうだ。
だからお前が頑張ってるのもわかる
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I've seen it myself. I know how hard you
work.

fields.EN: But that is not your sworn duty.
fields.JP: だが、そうじゃない赤ずきんでもいい
fields.LOCALIZED: But that is not your sworn duty.

fields.EN:
Don't obligate yourself to fit into these
roles. Simply be, and you'll be happier
for it.
fields.JP:
姉やリーダーなんて概念はなくてもいいんだ。
そんなことはかまわずに
赤ずきんのままでいてくれればいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't obligate yourself to fit into these
roles. Simply be, and you'll be happier
for it.

fields.EN:
At least, for my sake. I need neither a big
sister nor a leader.
fields.JP:
少なくとも僕の前では、だ。
僕は姉もリーダーも必要としていない
fields.LOCALIZED:
At least, for my sake. I need neither a big
sister nor a leader.

fields.EN: I didn't know that's how you felt.
fields.JP: そんな風に思われてるとは思わなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't know that's how you felt.

fields.EN:
It's true. At first, you were a means to an
end to aid me in finding my wife.
fields.JP:
初めは君たちを妻を探すための
「道具」とさえ思ってた……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. At first, you were a means to an
end to aid me in finding my wife.

fields.EN: But soon I moved past that.
fields.JP:
でも、気が付いたらもうそういう目で
見なくなっているのがわかった……
fields.LOCALIZED: But soon I moved past that.

fields.EN:
My wife said it best. Slow and steady
wins the race.
fields.JP:
これが妻の言っていた「急がば回れ」の
１つなのかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
My wife said it best. Slow and steady
wins the race.

fields.EN: I see. Sounds like your wife loves Aesop.
fields.JP:
そっか……
あんたの奥さん、良い事いうね
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Sounds like your wife loves Aesop.

fields.EN: Well, what's another fable among friends?
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, what's another fable among friends?

fields.JP: ははっ、そんな風にのろけることあるんだね

fields.EN:
I'm sure you can't wait to get back to
being curt with me.
fields.JP:
きっとこれからもジュウはあたしに対して
ズバズバ嫌なことを言ってくるんだろうけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you can't wait to get back to
being curt with me.

fields.EN: But that's fine! You do you, and I'll do me.
fields.JP:
いいよ！　あたしはあたしが
正しいと思ったことを
やってみて考えるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: But that's fine! You do you, and I'll do me.

fields.JP:
ふっ、確かに君はそのくらいの方が
いいのかもしれないな

fields.EN: We can work on our dynamic, but no rush.
fields.JP:
違うアプローチ方法がある方が
正解には早く辿りつく気がする
fields.LOCALIZED: We can work on our dynamic, but no rush.

fields.EN:
Hehe. So does that mean I've got your stamp
of approval?
fields.JP:
ふふんっ、つまりジュウのお墨付きを
もらったわけね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. So does that mean I've got your stamp
of approval?

fields.EN: Then I'll do as I please.
fields.JP: じゃ、自由にやらせてもらうから
fields.LOCALIZED: Then I'll do as I please.

fields.EN: But don't expose your friends to danger.
fields.JP: ただし、仲間を危険にさらすな
fields.LOCALIZED: But don't expose your friends to danger.

fields.JP:
わかってるって！
じゃあね

fields.EN:
(She's a different person than when she
walked in. Back to normal.)
fields.JP:
（ここにやってきたときとは別人だな。
　すっかりふっきれて帰っていった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's a different person than when she
walked in. Back to normal.)

fields.EN: (Was that the right thing? I certainly hope so.)
fields.JP:
（これでいいんだよな……
　早く君にあって聞いてみたい）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Was that the right thing? I certainly hope so.)

fields.EN: (Huh? Akazukin, Kaguyahime, and Shirayukihime are all together.)
fields.JP:
（なんだ？　赤ずきん、かぐや姫、
　白雪姫と勢ぞろいしてるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? Red Riding Hood, Kaguya, and Snow
White are all together.)

fields.EN: (Why do they all have pieces of paper?)
fields.JP:
（みんなが手に持ってるのは紙か？
　ずいぶんボロボロになってるぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why do they all have pieces of paper?)

fields.EN: Oh, it's starting to look good!
fields.JP: おー、いい感じにできたね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's starting to look good!

fields.EN:
I managed to flip it over nicely~. My skills
haven't dulled yet~.
fields.JP:
うまくひっくり返せました～。
わらわの腕前、まだまだ衰えてませんね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Flip it over. I have mine.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
さすがかぐやさんですね！
とても綺麗に折れてます

fields.EN: The trick is in the crease.
fields.JP:
折り目をきっちりとつけることが
コツなんですね
fields.LOCALIZED: The trick is in the crease.

fields.EN: Are you making origami? You're wasting paper!
fields.JP:
なにをしてるかと思えば、折紙か
貴重な紙がもったいないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you making origami? You're wasting paper!

fields.EN:
You're stiff as usual. It's fine.
It's not wasting paper!
fields.JP:
ジュウは相変わらず固いなあ。
大丈夫だって、紙はもったいなくないよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're stiff as usual. It's fine.
It's not wasting paper!

fields.EN: You're consuming it, so it is a waste.
fields.JP: 実際消費してるのだからもったいないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED: You're consuming it, so it is a waste.

fields.EN:
Oh. We're using old paper from memos
and notes. It's recycling.
fields.JP:
あ、その紙ですが、もうメモ書きだらけだったり
書けないものを使ってるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. We're using old paper from memos
and notes. It's recycling.

fields.JP: ふむ。なるほど……それなら…

fields.EN:
Hehehe. That's right. We're using old paper
to make masterpieces.
fields.JP:
ふふふ～。そうですよ～。
いらない紙で、このような芸術作品が
作れるんですからね～安いものです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. That's right. We're using old paper
to make masterpieces.

fields.EN:
Kaguya, you really are good at origami.
This is a crane, right? It's wonderful.
fields.JP:
かぐやさんは本当に折り紙がお得意ですよね。
これは折り鶴ですよね、素晴らしい作品です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, you really are good at origami.
This is a crane, right? It's wonderful.

fields.EN:
Is this one a bear? Amazing! It's pretty cute.
A true artisan.
fields.JP:
で、こっちがクマさんかあ。
すごーい！　綺麗だし、かわいいし職人だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Is this one a bear? Amazing! It's pretty cute.
A true artisan.

fields.EN:
This bear is nice... I wanna fold one too!
Let me try.
fields.JP:
このクマさん……いいなあ。
あたしも折りたい！　やってみる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This bear is nice... I wanna fold one too!
Let me try.

fields.JP: ふふ、赤姉様、がんばってください
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: うまくいくといいですね～

fields.EN:
Oh no. I messed up my first fold. 
Why?! Hm? Huhhh? Whyyy?
fields.JP:
って、一発目でズレてしまった。
なんでだ！？　ん？　んんっ？　あれれれ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh no. I messed up my first fold. 
Why?! Hm? Huhhh? Whyyy?

fields.JP: はあ……いいか？　ちょっと見ていてくれ

fields.EN: Oh? You're going to teach me?
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh? You're going to teach me?

fields.EN:
First, hold the center where you're folding. 
Before you fold, keep it on this line.
fields.JP:
まず折る場所の中心を抑えて……
折る前に折り線の位置を確かめる
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, hold the center where you're folding. 
Before you fold, keep it on this line.

fields.EN: Then do this... And there's a bear.
fields.JP:
こうして、こうやって……
さあ、クマができたぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then do this... And there's a bear.

fields.JP: わぁ～ジュウさんお上手ですね！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
I see. Hmmm. Okay, got it.
I'll give it a shot!
fields.JP:
ふんふん、なるほどなるほど。
わかった。やってみる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. Hmmm. Okay, got it.
I'll give it a shot!

fields.EN:
Oh! I did it! I followed your instructions to
the tee. Wow, it's perfect!
fields.JP:
あっ！　できた！
凄い、言う通りにしたら折れたよ！
こんなにうまくいくもんなんだね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! I did it! I followed your instructions to
the tee. Wow, it's perfect!

fields.JP: こんなに早く会得するとは思わなかったです～
かわいいです！　赤姉様！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: Really? I think so too. Hehe.
fields.JP: そう？　あたしもそう思う、へへ
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? I think so too. Hehe.

fields.EN:
Once you get the trick, it's easy.
Origami is like a development map.
fields.JP:
コツがわかれば簡単だ。
折紙は理論の詰まった展開図だからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you get the trick, it's easy.
Origami is like a development map.

fields.EN:
A development...map?
I don't really get it...
fields.JP:
展開……図？
よくわかんないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
A development...map?
I don't really get it...

fields.EN:
Anyways, thanks Juu!
Thanks to you, I was able to fold it good!
fields.JP:
とにかくありがとう、ジュウ！
あんたのおかげでうまく折れた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyways, thanks Toh!
Thanks to you, I was able to fold it good!

fields.EN: Heh. If only you listened to me more.
fields.JP:
ふっ、普段からそのくらい
素直に言うことを聞けばいいのにな
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh. If only you listened to me more.

fields.JP:
そりゃあ、ジュウが今みたいに
優しい言い方するならね

fields.EN: Ugh. There you go, yapping again.
fields.JP:
まったく……減らず口が尽きない
面倒なやつだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. There you go, yapping again.

fields.EN:
Yeah that's right! I am annoying. 
So you handle me with caution.
fields.JP:
そうよ！　あたしは面倒なの！
だから大切に扱ってよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah that's right! I am annoying. 
So you handle me with caution.

fields.EN: All right! Let's try a crane next!
fields.JP: よしっ！　今度は折り鶴にチャレンジしてみるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All right! Let's try a crane next!

fields.JP: えっ、いきなり鶴ですか？

fields.EN: It could be too hard for you, Akazukin.
fields.JP: 赤ずきんには難しいと思いますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It could be too hard for you, Red Riding
Hood.

fields.EN: Well, we won't know till we try.
fields.JP: まーまー、やってみなきゃね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, we won't know till we try.

fields.EN:
Oh? Huh? Huh? I did so well earlier.
Why aren't my edges matching up?!
fields.JP:
あれ？　ありゃりゃ～。
さっきはうまくいったのに
どうして端っこが揃わないんだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh? Huh? Huh? I did so well earlier.
Why aren't my edges matching up?!

fields.EN: Maybe you're too rough with it.
fields.JP: す、少し力を入れすぎちゃいましたかね
fields.LOCALIZED: Maybe you're too rough with it.

fields.EN:
Why try an advanced technique when you're
still a beginner?
fields.JP:
なぜ基本ができてないのに
いきなり応用に走るんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why try an advanced technique when you're
still a beginner?

fields.EN: Well, I was wondering if I could do it.
fields.JP: いやー、できるかなって思っちゃうんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I was wondering if I could do it.

fields.EN:
If only I were as optimistic as you.
But I'm not.
fields.JP:
その楽観的なところは
学ぶべきかもしれないし、
そうでないかもしれない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If only I were as optimistic as you.
But I'm not.

fields.EN: Stop being difficult and teach me again!
fields.JP:
難しいこといってないで
また、教えてよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Stop being difficult and teach me again!

fields.EN:
You are pretty good at teaching, Juu.
It just comes into my head so naturally.
fields.JP:
ジュウの教え方上手で
すうっと頭にしみこんでくるんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are pretty good at teaching, Toh.
It just comes into my head so naturally.

fields.EN: Got it. How about a crease here?
fields.JP:
わかった。
じゃあ、まずは折紙に折り目をつけていこうか
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. How about a crease here?

fields.EN: Yes, now make a triangle. Then...
fields.JP: そう、三角に折って、それから……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, now make a triangle. Then...

fields.EN: You know. They work pretty well together.
fields.JP: なんだかんだ言って、実はうまくいってますね
fields.LOCALIZED: You know. They work pretty well together.

fields.JP: よいものを見させてもらいましたね～

fields.EN: Huh? Hey, why is this bent?
fields.JP: あれ？　ねえ、ここどうして曲がってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Hey, why is this bent?

fields.EN: It's not bent. You bent it.
fields.JP:
曲がってるんじゃない。
赤ずきんが曲げたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not bent. You bent it.

fields.EN: I saw it with my own eyes.
fields.LOCALIZED: I saw it with my own eyes.

fields.EN:
But from here, it kind of looks like a
gruff father and his daughter.
fields.JP:
……でもこうしてると
無骨な父親に教えられてる
娘みたいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But from here, it kind of looks like a
gruff father and his daughter.

fields.JP:
確かにそういわれたら
そんな気がしますね

fields.EN: Can't we bend it like this?
fields.JP: この折り目ついたまま行くのはだめ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't we bend it like this?

fields.EN:
Damn, Haru... He's crazy for asking me
to fix the bath near the outer wall.
fields.JP:
ハルのやつめ……
風呂の外壁修理を僕に任せるなんて
どうかしてるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Damn, Haru... He's crazy for asking me
to fix the bath near the outer wall.

fields.EN:
I've never used a hammer.
Why is he forcing me to do it?
It's important to know who's good at what.
fields.JP:
僕はトンカチなんて使ったことないと言って
いるのに、なぜ無理にやらせようとするのか？
得手不得手のすみ分けは重要だぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never used a hammer.
Why is he forcing me to do it?
It's important to know who's good at what.

fields.EN:
I hit my finger once again. At this rate,
my fingers are going to be flat.
fields.JP:
また、クギじゃなくて、指を打ち付けたぞ。
このままじゃ、指が平らになってしまう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hit my finger once again. At this rate,
my fingers are going to be flat.

fields.EN:
Doesn't Haru know how to assign the
right person for the right job?
fields.JP:
適材適所という言葉を
ハルのやつは知らないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't Haru know how to assign the
right person for the right job?

fields.EN:
Ugh. This is depressing. Not efficient or
logical at all. Let's get this over with.
fields.JP:
……駄目だな。考えると、気分が落ちる。
それは非効率で論理的なやり方じゃない。
さっさと済ませてしまおう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. This is depressing. Not efficient or
logical at all. Let's get this over with.

fields.EN:
Why do I have to hammer the nail in little by
little?
fields.JP:
そもそもどうしてクギは少しずつ
入れていかなければならないのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why do I have to hammer the nail in little by
little?

fields.EN: Can't I just get it in with one strong hit?
fields.JP:
普通に一度力強く打つだけでは
ダメなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't I just get it in with one strong hit?

fields.EN:
No, it'll work. All right. Let's give it a shot.
Theory and practice go hand in hand.
fields.JP:
いや、いけるだろう。
よし、試してみるか……
なにごとも理論と実践はセットだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it'll work. All right. Let's give it a shot.
Theory and practice go hand in hand.

fields.EN: I'm going to hit it in one punch. EIYAH!
fields.JP:
力いっぱい、一度に打ち込めるように
そーれっ！　えいやっ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm going to hit it in one punch. EIYAH!

fields.EN:
I made a hole in the wall. I see.
This is why I can't just hammer them in all at once.
fields.JP:
壊れて、壁に穴が開いてしまった。なるほど
こうなるから、1度に打ち付けてはいけないのだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I made a hole in the wall. I see.
This is why I can't just hammer them in all at once.

fields.EN: It sure is noisy out there.
fields.JP: なんですか、騒がしいですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: It sure is noisy out there.

fields.EN: Oh. So the bath is over this wall...
fields.JP: うむ。　この壁の先は風呂だったのか
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. So the bath is over this wall...

fields.JP: な、なにがどうしてこうなったのよ！？

fields.EN:
Haru asked me to fix the wall! But I accidentally
smashed the wall with the hammer.
fields.JP:
ハルに外壁修理を頼まれていたんだが、
クギを一度に埋め込もうとして
力いっぱい打ったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru asked me to fix the wall! But I accidentally
smashed the wall with the hammer.

fields.JP: 壁が崩れて穴が開いたってわけね

fields.EN: Yeah. Sorry for breaking the wall.
fields.JP:
そうだ。
壁を壊してしまいすまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Sorry for breaking the wall.

fields.EN: U-um, I know that it's an accident...
fields.JP: そ、その事故というのはわかったのですが……
fields.LOCALIZED: U-um, I know that it's an accident...

fields.JP: 冷たい風が入って来て気持ちいいですね～
あんたは少し慌てなさいよ……

fields.EN: Well, that wouldn't fix the wall...
fields.JP: 慌てたところで壁は直りませんから～
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, that wouldn't fix the wall...

fields.EN: Can you hurry up and fix that hole already?!
fields.JP:
と、ともかく！事故なのはわかったから
見てないでさっさとその壁をふさいで！
fields.LOCALIZED: Can you hurry up and fix that hole already?!

fields.EN: Yeah! We won't be able to bathe in peace!
fields.JP:
そうです！　そうしてください！
安心してお風呂に入れなくなります！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! We won't be able to bathe in peace!

fields.EN: And Juu-san, just look the other way!
fields.JP: ともかくジュウさんは向こうを見て下さいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED: And Toh, just look the other way!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Yeah! How long do you plan on standing there?!
fields.JP:
そうよ！
いつまで突っ立ってるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! How long do you plan on standing there?!

fields.EN:
It might be an accident, but you don't
have to STARE!
fields.JP:
穴が開くまでは事故でも
ずっと突っ立って見てるのは
ジュウの自由意思じゃないの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It might be an accident, but you don't
have to STARE!

fields.EN:
Oh. But I have to stand here if you want
me to fix it...
fields.JP:
いや、直すにはここで作業しなくては
いけないのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. But I have to stand here if you want
me to fix it...

fields.JP: それなら見ないで直して下さいまし！
流石にそれは無理難題だ
ともかく！　あたしたちは出るからあっち向け―！

fields.EN: Please don't look at my flabby body!
fields.JP: 白雪のだらしない身体を見ないでくださいーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Please don't look at my flabby body!

fields.EN: You're so much worse than Jack.
fields.JP: しかしジャックとは全然違う反応ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: You're so much worse than Jack.

fields.EN: Don't bring him up! That's even worse!
fields.JP:
こ、ここでジャックの名前をださないでよ！
なんか余計に恥ずかしくなってくるじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't bring him up! That's even worse!

fields.EN:
I have no interest in any woman's body
other than my wife's.
fields.JP:
僕は子供の身体に興味もないし、
そもそも妻の身体以外に興味はない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no interest in any woman's body
other than my wife's.

fields.EN:
There's nothing for me here. Get over
yourselves.
fields.JP:
君たちの入浴シーンになんて価値はない。
うぬぼれないでほしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's nothing for me here. Get over
yourselves.

fields.EN: Even now, you think of your wife...
fields.JP: こ、ここに来ても奥様命ですのね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Even now, you think of your wife...

fields.EN:
ANYWAYS! I get it was a mistake, but
please go away!
fields.JP:
とーもーかーくー！
あんたに悪意がないのはわかったから、
後ろ向いて立ち去りなさい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
ANYWAYS! I get it was a mistake, but
please go away!

fields.EN:
I don't need this headache. I'll consult with
Kunai.
fields.JP:
確かに不要な誤解は困る。
クナイにでも相談しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't need this headache. I'll consult with
Kunai.

fields.JP: 流石にもうちょっと常識を身に付けなさいよ！

fields.EN:
(Accident or not, my wife would kill me.
I have so much explaining to do...)
fields.JP:
（事故とはいえ確かにこれは妻でも怒るのはわかる。
　あとで改めて弁解と謝罪をしにいこう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Accident or not, my wife would kill me.
I have so much explaining to do...)

fields.JP: 今日もお腹いっぱいですわ！

fields.EN: I wish I still had servants...
fields.JP:
わらわはお付きの者が食べさせてくれる生活に
戻りたいです～
fields.LOCALIZED: I wish I still had servants...

fields.EN: You never did! Just be thankful we have food.
fields.JP:
そんなの昔からいないでしょ！
こうやって食べれるだけでも
ラッキーって思わなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED: You never did! Just be thankful we have food.

fields.JP: それはそうですけどね～
（相変わらずだな、かぐや姫は）

fields.EN:
I get we should be thankful, but we're
allowed to yearn, aren't we?
fields.JP:
今がありがたいという気持ちはわかるんですが、
確かにスイーツを食べたいって気持ちも
湧き出てきますわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get we should be thankful, but we're
allowed to yearn, aren't we?

fields.EN: Sure, but if we start, we'll never stop.
fields.JP: 欲を言ったらきりがないからねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but if we start, we'll never stop.

fields.EN:
We can't splurge right now. Let's be thankful
for what we've got!
fields.JP:
今は贅沢しすぎはダメよ。
いつかそんな生活に戻れるよう
今、がんばんなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't splurge right now. Let's be thankful
for what we've got!

fields.EN: It's pointless to want what doesn't exist.
fields.JP: ないものをねだっても仕方ないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED: It's pointless to want what doesn't exist.

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime has been staring at me.
Do I have something on my face?)
fields.JP:
（さっきから、かぐや姫が僕を見てるな。
　顔になにかついているのだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya has been staring at me.
Do I have something on my face?)

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime, why are you staring at me?
Do I have something on my face?
fields.JP:
かぐや姫、どうしてさっきから僕を見てるんだ？
顔に何かついてるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya, why are you staring at me?
Do I have something on my face?

fields.EN:
No, you don't have anything on your face.
It is YOUR face.
fields.JP:
そなたの顔になにかついてるわけではないです～
むしろ、顔そのものですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you don't have anything on your face.
It is YOUR face.

fields.EN:
Hm... What do you mean? I'm sure it's
not as ridiculous as you seem.
fields.JP:
うむ……どういうことだ？
今更下らないルックスの話ではあるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm... What do you mean? I'm sure it's
not as ridiculous as you seem.

fields.JP:
ふふふっ、違います～
思い出したんですよ～

fields.EN:
When I first saw you, Juu-san, I thought you looked
like Jack~
fields.JP:
初めてジュウさんを見た時は
ジャックに似てると思ったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
When we first met, you reminded me
of Jack.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(Not him again. I'm tired of this man.
Do we really look alike?)
fields.JP:
（また、ジャックの話か……。
　もうそろそろうんざりなんだが。
　そんなにやつに僕は似てるのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not him again. I'm tired of this man.
Do we really look alike?)

fields.EN:
But it's odd. Now I look at you, and 
you're completely different.
fields.JP:
でも不思議ですね～。
今改めて見ると、全く似ていないですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's odd. Now I look at you, and 
you're completely different.

fields.JP: そう言われると興味深いな

fields.EN: (All this talk, and now she's taking it back?)
fields.JP:
（似てると言われ続け、ここに来て
　似てないとはどういうことだ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (All this talk, and now she's taking it back?)

fields.EN: Oh! I get it! I had the same thought.
fields.JP:
あっ！　わかります！
白雪も同じことを思ってました
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! I get it! I had the same thought.

fields.EN:
Yes, strange. I thought you two were so
similar.
fields.JP:
そうなんです。不思議です。
最初は似てると思ったんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, strange. I thought you two were so
similar.

fields.EN:
But the more I get to know you, the less
similar you seem.
fields.JP:
やはり慣れてくると、
違いが見えてくるからでしょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But the more I get to know you, the less
similar you seem.

fields.JP:
そうですわね。　考えてみれば、
タイプがそもそも違いますものね
たしかに言われてみれば不思議ね～

fields.EN: Both great in their own ways.
fields.JP: どちらも違って、どちらもいいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Both great in their own ways.

fields.EN:
(Akazukin claims I resemble the
Professor. Can't I just be me?)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんは確か僕を博士に似ていると
　言っていたな……。　赤ずきんだけが
　始めからにていないと思っていたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Red Riding Hood claims I resemble the
Professor. Can't I just be me?)

fields.JP: 赤姉様はどう思いますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you think, Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: え、あたし！？　あたしは
はは、ちょっとわからないかな
ただジャックはいじりがいはあったかな
あははっ！　確かに懐かしいわね

fields.EN:
Now that he's gone, I don't have anyone to
pick on.
fields.JP:
今はジャックがいないから
いじりがいのあるやつがいなくて寂しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that he's gone, I don't have anyone to
pick on.

fields.EN: I understand! He was surprisingly fun.
fields.JP:
わかります～。
意外と楽しかったですからね～
fields.LOCALIZED: I understand! He was surprisingly fun.

fields.EN: He knew how to take a joke.
fields.JP: いるだけで楽しいことが起きてましたね
fields.LOCALIZED: He knew how to take a joke.

fields.EN: Hehe. He was clumsy at times too.
fields.JP: ふふ、実はドジなところもありましたわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. He was clumsy at times too.

fields.EN:
(I'm happy I don't resemble him, but
hearing them gossip about him is...)
fields.JP:
（似ていないは嬉しいが……
　話題に上がるとやはりもやもやするな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm happy I don't resemble him, but
hearing them gossip about him is...)

fields.EN: Are you still going on about this?
fields.JP:
まだそのジャックというやつの話は
続くのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Are you still going on about this?

fields.EN:
Oh, I'm sorry. It must be mean for us to be
talking about someone you don't know.
fields.JP:
あ、申し訳ありませんわ。
知らない人のことを話されるのは
居心地が悪いですわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I'm sorry. It must be mean for us to be
talking about someone you don't know.

fields.JP: いや、気にしなくていい

fields.EN: Thanks for the food. I'm going back to the tent.
fields.JP:
ごちそうさま
僕は自分のテントに戻ろうとおもう
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks for the food. I'm going back to the tent.

fields.EN:
Juu-san, you're different than Jack-san, but you
feel like family.
fields.JP:
