ジュウさんはジャックさんとは違いますが、
なんかこう謎の家族感がありますよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, you're different than Jack, but you
feel like family.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san; ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
I sense the same thing. Hm.
That must be Juu-san's trait.
fields.JP:
わたくしも感じ入るところがありますわ。
そうですね。それはジュウさんの
特徴だと思いますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I sense the same thing. Hm.
That must be Toh's trait.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: What is it? He's like a mean dad.
fields.JP:
なんだろうね。
こう、食卓にいる寡黙なお父さんみたいな
fields.LOCALIZED: What is it? He's like a mean dad.

fields.JP: ふふふっ、面白い例えですね～

fields.EN: (I can't hear what they're saying, but they're certainly lively. If I had a child around that age, maybe it'd be fun...)
fields.JP:
（何を言ってるか聞こえないが、賑やかなことだ。
　僕にもあれくらいの子供がいれば、
　楽しいのかもしれないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't hear what they're saying, but it's
loud. Maybe if I were their age, I'd enjoy
their company more.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder what it would be like if my wife
and I had children?)
fields.JP:
（妻との間に子どはいなかったと思うが……。
　今さら、どうしてそんなことを思ったんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what it would be like if my wife
and I had children?)

fields.EN:
(Something about this place looks different.
Much to consider.)
fields.JP:
（姿は違うが地質は本来のモノと変わらない？
　まだまだ調べることが多い……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Something about this place looks different.
Much to consider.)

fields.EN: (I want to get outside and investigate more... I wonder if someone would come with me.)
fields.JP:
（もっと外に出て調べ回りたいな……
　誰か一緒に同行してくれないだろうか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (If only I could do field research...)

fields.EN: Juu, are you there? It's me, Oyayubihime.
fields.JP:
ジュウ、いる？
わたしよ、親指姫よ
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, are you there? It's me, Thumbelina.
fields.notes: source-gated Toh => Juu; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Oh, there you are. You have a moment?
fields.JP:
なんだ、いるんじゃない。
今大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, there you are. You have a moment?

fields.JP: はは、やっぱあんたそっけないわね
世間話でもしにきたのか？
もちろんそういうんじゃないけど……

されても困るがな。
それでなんだ？

fields.EN: Just wanted to share my thanks.
fields.JP: 改めて、お礼がしたかったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Just wanted to share my thanks.

fields.JP: 白雪を助けてくれてありがとうって
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you for saving Snow White.

fields.EN: (A lot of people here are very dutiful. That's not a bad thing, but having my time tied up is a problem...)
fields.JP:
（ここにいる連中は律儀な奴が多いな。
　悪い事ではないが、僕の時間が制限されるのは
　困るな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They're all too polite. I can't handle another
token of appreciation.)

fields.EN: Honestly, don't mention it. It's fine.
fields.JP:
正直、礼を言われるようなことはしてないが……
受け取っておこう
fields.LOCALIZED: Honestly, don't mention it. It's fine.

fields.EN:
You're not too humble, so I'll get to the point,
but you really did save us.
fields.JP:
謙虚になるタイプじゃないだろうから
言うけど、本当にジュウのおかげで救われたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not too humble, so I'll get to the point,
but you really did save us.

fields.EN:
If you didn't save Shirayuki, I don't think
I would have been able to maintain my sanity.
fields.JP:
白雪が助かっていなかったら、正直
正気を保てるか自信がなかったから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you didn't save Snow White, I don't think
I would have been able to maintain my sanity.

fields.EN: You really have a strong sisterly bond.
fields.LOCALIZED: You must care deeply for her.

fields.EN: Yeah. She is my little sister.
fields.JP: まぁね、それだけ大事な妹だから
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. She is my little sister.

fields.EN: That's all. I'll pay you back some day.
fields.JP:
用件としてはそれだけ。
それじゃあ、この借りはいつか返すわ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's all. I'll pay you back some day.

fields.EN: Hm? Younger sister...? Ah, right. Come to think of it, you were the older sister.
fields.JP:
……ん？　妹……？　ああ、そうか。　
そういえば君はお姉さんだったな

fields.EN:
Hey! What's that mean?! Why wouldn't I
be the older sister?
fields.JP:
ちょっ……！　今のは聞き捨てならないわね！
なんで、一瞬でもわたしが
姉じゃないと思ったのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey! What's that mean?! Why wouldn't I
be the older sister?

fields.EN: (Oh boy. Is that what we're doing? Fighting?)
fields.JP:
（おぉ……！
　変なところで突っかかってきたな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh boy. Is that what we're doing? Fighting?)

fields.EN: (Why can't they ever make this easy for me?)
fields.JP:
（なぜ彼女はこんな簡単な答えも
　導き出せないんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why can't they ever make this easy for me?)

fields.EN: I initially thought Oyayubihime was around ten years old.
fields.JP:
そもそも親指姫のことは
最初、１０歳前後と思っていた
fields.LOCALIZED: I thought you were a child.

fields.EN: But now I know you're not.
fields.JP: 今は１０歳じゃないと分かってるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: But now I know you're not.

fields.JP:
と、当然でしょ！
わたしを１０歳扱いするなんて！

fields.EN: That's rude! You better apologize for that!
fields.JP:
流石に失礼よ！
あんた、謝りなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That's rude! You better apologize for that!

fields.EN:
Listen, okay? I'm Shirayuki's older sister.
Don't get that wrong!
fields.JP:
いい？
わたしは白・雪・の・姉だから
間違えないように！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen to me. I am Snow White's SISTER.
Don't get it wrong!

fields.JP:
（女性は確か実年齢より見た目が
　若い方が喜ぶと聞いたが……？）

fields.EN:
(Guess Oyayubihime proves that's not the
case.)
fields.JP:
（親指姫のように老けてた方が
　うれしいというケースもあるのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess Thumbelina proves that's not the
case.)

fields.EN:
(She's still glaring at me. I better change
the subject.)
fields.JP:
（なんかまだ睨んでいるぞ。
　どうにか年齢の話題から離れてもらおう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's still glaring at me. I better change
the subject.)

fields.EN: (She's heated. I don't want to deal with this.)
fields.JP:
（まだ怒っているな……。
　あまり出したくない話題だが、
　意識を違う方に向けた話題を……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's heated. I don't want to deal with this.)

fields.EN: So, you excited to find Jack or what?
fields.JP:
そう言えば、ジャックというやつに
早く会いたいのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: So, you excited to find Jack or what?

fields.EN: Jack?! What's he got to do with this?!
fields.JP:
じゃ、ジャック！？　どうしてそこで
いきなりジャックの話が出るのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack?! What's he got to do with this?!

fields.EN:
I'm totally NOT thinking about him, if that's
what you're asking!
fields.JP:
べ、別に早く会えればなあ……
なんて思ってないし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm totally NOT thinking about him, if that's
what you're asking!

fields.EN:
It just seemed like everyone always brings
him up. Sorry for the confusion.
fields.JP:
ジャックというやつの話をしている時に
会いたそうな発言をしていたなと思っていたが、
勘違いだったか失礼した
fields.LOCALIZED:
It just seemed like everyone always brings
him up. Sorry for the confusion.

fields.EN:
Hmph! Of course not! Why would you think
I would?!
fields.JP:
ふんっ！　そんなわけないでしょ！
だいたい、わたしが、な、なんであいつなんか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph! Of course not! Why would you think
I would?!

fields.JP:
も、もう、行くわね！
それじゃね！

fields.EN: (Calm, then mad. Give it a rest.)
fields.JP:
（冷静だったり、怒ったりと
　忙しない奴だったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Calm, then mad. Give it a rest.)

fields.EN:
(Hm. I hear her Blood Libido makes her
testy. I'll give her this.)
fields.JP:
（うむ、確かこういうのが好きな
　血式リビドーと聞いたからな。
　帰るついでに渡そう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. I hear her Blood Libido makes her
testy. I'll give her this.)

fields.EN: It's Juu. Can I come in?
fields.JP: 僕だ、ジュウだが入っていいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: It's Toh. Can I come in?

fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと！
今はその、えーっと、ダメよ！

fields.EN: Hey! Why are you already here?
fields.JP:
ちょっとー！
なんでもういるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! Why are you already here?

fields.EN: You said "yes" so I came in.
fields.JP: 「はい」と言ったから開けたのだが？
fields.LOCALIZED: You said "yes" so I came in.

fields.EN: At least pick up on the intonation! That was obviously a surprised "Yes?!"
fields.JP:
言葉のイントネーションくらい掴みなさいよ！
どう見ても驚いたときの「はい！」でしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't you read tone?! It was a hesitant yes!

fields.EN:
It's too late. What are you doing
in a child's sleeping bag?
fields.JP:
と言われても、既に見てしまった。
子供サイズのシュラフに入って
なにをしてるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's too late. What are you doing
in a child's sleeping bag?

fields.EN:
(Oyayubihime may be small, but even she couldn't
fit into a sleeping bag that child-sized... Besides,
there seems to be a larger sleeping bag.)
fields.JP:
（親指姫が小さいとはいえ、あんな幼児サイズの
　シュラフに入れはしないしな……
　そもそも、大きいシュラフはあるようだし）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's tiny. But even for her, that's small.)
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: あまり聞いたことがないが足用か？
ともかく、こんなのもう脱ぐから！

fields.EN: Phew. I finally was able to take it off.
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew. I finally was able to take it off.

fields.EN: What'd you do? You perplex me.
fields.JP:
で、結局なにをしたかったんだ？
不可思議な行動だから興味がある
fields.LOCALIZED: What'd you do? You perplex me.

fields.EN:
Can't you see? I'm trying to sleep!
That's what the sleeping bag's for!
fields.JP:
まったく、何って見ればわかるでしょ？
わたしは寝ようとしてたの！
シュラフは寝るための袋だし！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Can't you see? I'm trying to sleep!
That's what the sleeping bag's for!

fields.EN:
I don't believe that. You mean to tell me
you have TWO?
fields.JP:
いや、それはにわかには信じられないな。
そもそも寝られるサイズのものが隣にある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't believe that. You mean to tell me
you have TWO?

fields.EN:
Looks like she doesn't want me touching that
subject. Oyayubihime has her own circumstances,
so I'll stop bringing it up.
fields.JP:
どうやら触れてほしくないことのようだな。
親指姫にも色々あるのだろう、
もうこれ以上言及するのはやめよう
fields.LOCALIZED: You seem annoyed, so I'll drop it.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
That's not it! Would you keep your comments
to yourself?!
fields.JP:
ち、違うわよ！
変な想像を膨らませないでくれる！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it! Would you keep your comments
to yourself?!

fields.JP: （いや、まったくしてないのだが……）

fields.EN: *sigh*... Fine, I guess. I'll just admit it.
fields.JP:
はあ……もう、仕方がないわ。
白状するわ
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh*... Fine, I guess. I'll just admit it.

fields.EN: I tried tucking myself into this sleeping bag.
fields.JP:
この寝袋を見かけたときに、
これに包まれたいって思っちゃったの！
fields.LOCALIZED: I tried tucking myself into this sleeping bag.

fields.EN:
Before I knew it, the sleeping bag had swallowed
me halfway... So I couldn't help it!
fields.JP:
気がついたら、半分シュラフに飲まれてて……
だから仕方ないのよ！
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: I see. Is this a Blood Libido thing?
fields.JP:
なるほど、単に親指姫の血式リビドーが
発動したという話か
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Is this a Blood Libido thing?

fields.JP:
小さく狭い空間であれば
なんでも良いということか……
ま、まぁそういうことね

fields.EN: So why'd you pay me a visit?
fields.JP:
それで、わざわざわたしのテントを
訪ねてきて、何の用なの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So why'd you pay me a visit?

fields.JP:
ああ、そうだ。
ここに来た目的を忘れるところだった

fields.EN:
I found this near camp earlier. I thought
you might like it.
fields.JP:
先ほどキャンプ地周辺でたまたま見つけたんだ。
帰り際だしついでに良いと思い持ってきた
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found this near camp earlier. I thought
you might like it.

fields.EN: I hear you like small spaces.
fields.JP:
こういうのが好きと聞き、持ってきたが
正解だったようだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I hear you like small spaces.

fields.EN:
If you like that sleeping bag, you'll like
this even more.
fields.JP:
小さいシュラフが好きならば、小さい箱も
好きだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you like that sleeping bag, you'll like
this even more.

fields.EN: Okay, I got it! Leave it and go!
fields.JP: わかったから、さっさとそれ置いてでてけーー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, I got it! Leave it and go!

fields.EN:
She pushed me out. I thought she'd be
happy about it. Was I wrong?
fields.JP:
追い出されてしまった……
喜ばれると思ったが違ったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
She pushed me out. I thought she'd be
happy about it. Was I wrong?

fields.EN: Oh well. I'll go back to my tent.
fields.JP:
まぁいい。
さっさと帰ろう
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh well. I'll go back to my tent.

fields.EN: (Why do I hear voices this late in the night?)
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why do I hear voices this late in the night?)

fields.JP:
（なにかあったのか？
　……少し様子を見にいこう）
（こっちの方から聞こえてくるな）

fields.EN: So you don't know either, Kunai-san...
fields.JP: それじゃ、クナイさんでもわからないんですね……
fields.LOCALIZED: So you don't know either, Kunai...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: クナイさん => Kunai-san

fields.EN: You didn't even see a silhouette?
fields.JP: どこかで似た人影も見たことない？
fields.LOCALIZED: You didn't even see a silhouette?

fields.EN: No, sorry. I wish I could help...
fields.JP:
すいません。　それもないんです。
何かお力添えになれば良かったのですが……
fields.LOCALIZED: No, sorry. I wish I could help...

fields.EN:
Thank you. Don't worry. Sorry for making
you come with me in the middle of the night.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、気にしないで。
夜中に付き合わせて悪かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you. Don't worry. Sorry for making
you come with me in the middle of the night.

fields.EN: That's right. No need to feel bad.
fields.JP:
そうですよ。
そんなに申し訳なく思うことありません
fields.LOCALIZED: That's right. No need to feel bad.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: Right. I am just happy you let me talk.
fields.JP:
そう。
話を聞いてくれただけでも助かったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I am just happy you let me talk.

fields.EN: (What are they talking about at this hour?)
fields.JP: （こんな夜中に何を話してるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What are they talking about at this hour?)

fields.EN: If I hear anything, I'll let you know right away.
fields.JP:
何かそういうお話がきたら、
お二人にすぐにお知らせしますね
fields.LOCALIZED: If I hear anything, I'll let you know right away.

fields.EN: That would be nice. Thanks Kunai.
fields.JP:
それだと嬉しい。
ありがと、クナイ
fields.LOCALIZED: That would be nice. Thanks Kunai.

fields.EN: Thank you. Sorry for keeping you up.
fields.JP:
お願いします。
夜中にすみません
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you. Sorry for keeping you up.

fields.EN: It's totally fine. I'm sure you guys are worried.
fields.JP: いいんです。おふたりとも心配ですもんね
fields.LOCALIZED: It's totally fine. I'm sure you guys are worried.

fields.EN: Well, I'll be on my way. Good night.
fields.JP:
それでは、失礼しますね。
おやすみなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I'll be on my way. Good night.

fields.EN:
We haven't asked everyone, Shirayuki.
Have hope.
fields.JP:
白雪、まだ聞いてない人もいるし、
諦めちゃダメよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We haven't asked everyone, Snow White.
Have hope.

fields.EN: What are you two doing up so late?
fields.JP: ふたりとも、こんな夜中に何をしてるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you two doing up so late?

fields.JP: ちょっとびっくりしたじゃない！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Either of you want to answer?
fields.JP: それでこんな夜中に何をしているんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Either of you want to answer?

fields.JP: 白雪たちはネムちゃんのことが心配なんです
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White is worried about Sleepy.

fields.JP: ネムちゃん……？　ああ、君たちの妹か

fields.EN:
During the day, we look for everyone in
Dawn, but at night, we look solely for Nemu-chan.
fields.JP:
昼間は黎明のみなさんを探してますが、
深夜はネムちゃんを重点的に探しているんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
During the day, we look for everyone in
Dawn, but at night, we look solely for Sleepy.

fields.EN: So we do our night rounds.
fields.JP: こうやって夜に起きてる人に聞いてまわったり
fields.LOCALIZED: So we do our night rounds.

fields.EN:
We've been searching through knolls
and bushes.
fields.JP: ふたりで草むらや木陰を探したりします
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've been searching through knolls
and bushes.

fields.EN:
...That doesn't sound efficient. Especially
in the dark.
fields.JP:
……あまり効率的な活動とは思えないし、
この周辺はもう十分探したと思うが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...That doesn't sound efficient. Especially
in the dark.

fields.EN:
If anything, it's more dangerous for you
two alone at night. You'll just tire yourselves
out.
fields.JP:
何より、周辺とはいえ二人だと危険だ。
そして次の日の探索に影響がでる
fields.LOCALIZED:
If anything, it's more dangerous for you
two alone at night. You'll just tire yourselves
out.

fields.EN: This is pointless. Enough of this.
fields.JP:
それじゃ探す意味はないに等しいな。
今後やめた方がいい
fields.LOCALIZED: This is pointless. Enough of this.

fields.JP: そ、それでもやらないよりいいでしょ！？

fields.EN:
Well, if it affects your ability to explore,
then it's not.
fields.JP:
むしろそれで探索に集中できないほうが
問題だと思うが？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if it affects your ability to explore,
then it's not.

fields.EN:
Rgh... But when else are we supposed to?
Are you telling us NOT to look for her?
fields.JP:
くっ、でも今くらいしかやる時間がないわけ！
探すなとでも言いたいの！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rgh... But when else are we supposed to?
Are you telling us NOT to look for her?

fields.JP: 親指姉様、それ以上はっ！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: I don't think that during the day. But searching now is little more than self-satisfaction.
fields.JP:
日中はそう思わないが、
今探すのは自己満足に近いと思っている
fields.LOCALIZED: I think you're searching in vain.

fields.JP: ジュウさん、親指姉様を刺激しないでください
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: 親指姉様、ジュウさん落ち着きましょうね
fields.LOCALIZED: Sister Thumbelina, Toh, let's calm down.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: いや僕は落ち着いているが……
わたしだって落ち着いてるわ！

fields.EN: Talking to you is pointless, Juu.
fields.JP: どうやらジュウには何を言っても無駄なようね
fields.LOCALIZED: Talking to you is pointless, Toh.

fields.EN:
I don't get how you think it works. Even
this conversation is a waste.
fields.JP:
なぜ非効率だと理解できないのかわからないが、
確かにこの会話自体は無駄なようだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't get how you think it works. Even
this conversation is a waste.

fields.EN: You couldn't possibly understand how we feel, worrying about our little sister when we don't even know if she's alive or dead!
fields.JP:
あんたに、生死もわからない妹を心配する
わたし達の気持ちなんて、分かるわけないわよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You wouldn't know what it's like to be
afraid for your sister!

fields.EN: This discussion is over. I'm going to bed.
fields.JP:
お互いこれ以上喋っても無駄だ。
僕はもう寝るよ
fields.LOCALIZED: This discussion is over. I'm going to bed.

fields.EN:
Do as you please, but you better be ready
to set out tomorrow.
fields.JP:
もう好きにしたらいいが、
日中の探索に迷惑をかけるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do as you please, but you better be ready
to set out tomorrow.

fields.JP: お、親指姉様、ジュウさんは……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Right... Juu's looking for his wife too.
fields.JP: そっか……。ジュウは奥さんを……
fields.LOCALIZED: Right... Toh's looking for his wife too.

fields.JP: （何も間違ったことは言ってないはずだ）

fields.EN: (Acting on your own often ends up putting everyone in danger.)
fields.JP:
（勝手な行動をした結果、全員が危険に
　なることなどザラにある）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm not here to correct people on basic
decency.)

fields.JP: （だから、僕は間違っていないはずだ……）

fields.EN:
(But what is that pang shooting through
me...?)
fields.JP: （……それなのに……どうして胸が痛むんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But what is that pang shooting through
me...?)

fields.EN:
(That argument with Oyayubihime made my
heart feel so heavy...)
fields.JP:
（この間の親指姫とのやりとりを思い出すと
　相変わらず胸がちくちくする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That argument with Thumbelina made my
heart feel so heavy...)

fields.JP:
（正しいことを言って、
　謝る必要などないはずなんだが……）

fields.EN: Can I come in or what?
fields.LOCALIZED: Can I come in or what?

fields.EN:
(I hope this doesn't turn into anything. 
But I don't think I should send her away.)
fields.JP:
（なにか面倒な話じゃないといいが……
　ただ今は追い返すべきではないと……思う）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope this doesn't turn into anything. 
But I don't think I should send her away.)

fields.EN:
U-um, I'm sorry...for the other day.
I was out of line.
fields.JP:
そ、その……この前は……
言い過ぎたわ、ごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
U-um, I'm sorry...for the other day.
I was out of line.

fields.EN: Even though you're searching for your family too... I realized what I said was one-sided...
fields.JP:
ジュウも家族を探しているというのに……
わたしの言い分は一方的だと思った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're searching for your wife too, but
I made it seem like you didn't understand.

fields.EN: (So it's not about me searching at night, but what I said then.)
fields.JP: （夜探していたことではなくそっちの発言か）

fields.EN: That remark doesn't bother me. No matter what anyone says, I won't change my mind about finding my wife.
fields.JP:
別にその発言に関しては僕は気にしていない
何を言われようが、妻を探すと言う意思は
変わらないからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fret not. My feelings have no bearing
on my mission.

fields.EN: I'm searching because I'm weak. If I had a body that could keep moving forever, I'd want to keep searching.
fields.JP:
弱いから探してるんだよ
僕だってずっと動ける身体ならば探し続けたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. It's because I'm weak. I search for
her because I cannot live without her.

fields.EN:
However, all of us have our limits. And we
all need rest.
fields.JP:
だが体力は有限だ。
休めるときは休むべきだ、と思ってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, all of us have our limits. And we
all need rest.

fields.EN: I know. You have a point, Juu.
fields.JP:
分かってるわ。
ジュウの言ってることも確かにその通りよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I know. You have a point, Toh.

fields.EN:
But sometimes it feels better to try
rather than sit around.
fields.JP:
でもね……じっとしているより
動いている方が気が楽になることもあるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But sometimes it feels better to try
rather than sit around.

fields.EN:
Sitting still means contemplating the worst.
It's painful.
fields.JP:
じっとしていると悪い方向にばかり考えがいって、
辛くなる時があるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sitting still means contemplating the worst.
It's painful.

fields.JP: まして、今はこんな状況……

fields.EN: So I just wanted even 1% worth of information—anything at all.
fields.JP: だからともかく、１％でも何か情報がほしかったの

fields.EN: But it was still something that might have inconvenienced others. I'm sorry. That's all I wanted to say.
fields.JP:
でも他人に迷惑を掛けるかもしれない行動では
あったわ。　ごめんなさい。
それだけが言いたかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But nothing's guaranteed, and I acted
out of line. So please forgive me.

fields.EN: I also constantly rack my brain over how to find my wife. Sometimes, doing that lets me escape the pain.
fields.JP:
確かに僕も妻を探すために常に思考を巡らせている。
そうすることで辛さから逃れることもある
fields.LOCALIZED:
I spend every moment wondering where
my wife could be. It agonizes me.

fields.EN:
So Oyayubihime and the others were doing through
their actions what I do through thought—is that it?
fields.JP:
僕が思考でやってることを、
親指姫達は行動でしていた、
ということか
fields.LOCALIZED: So I understand what you mean.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP:
そうね……
理解はしてもらったみたいで嬉しいわ

fields.EN:
In the end, however, my opinion hasn't
changed. Do what you must, so long as
it doesn't interfere with our expeditions.
fields.JP:
結局、僕の意見は変わらない。
だが、日中の活動に差し支えがなければ
続ければいいさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the end, however, my opinion hasn't
changed. Do what you must, so long as
it doesn't interfere with our expeditions.

fields.EN:
I would do the same in your shoes.
That's why.
fields.JP:
僕も君たちの気持ちはわかるからな。
その上で言っているだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would do the same in your shoes.
That's why.

fields.EN: It took me a while to see...
fields.JP: 多少折れたところもあるがね
fields.LOCALIZED: It took me a while to see...

fields.EN:
Shirayuki said you're worried in your
own way. Guess she's right.
fields.JP:
白雪はジュウはジュウなりに心配しているって
言ってたけど……まぁなんかわかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White said you're worried in your
own way. Guess she's right.

fields.JP:
心配……？
そうともとれるのか？
なんにしても世話掛けたわね

fields.EN:
You needn't apologize for being concerned.
I'm sorry for scolding you.
fields.JP:
家族のために何かをするというのは
何も間違っていないさ。
僕もこの間は言いすぎたすまない
fields.LOCALIZED:
You needn't apologize for being concerned.
I'm sorry for scolding you.

fields.EN: Pfft—ahaha! Don't apologize so casually. Maybe you really are awkward.
fields.JP:
ぷっあははは！
そんなさりげなく謝らないでよ
確かにあんた不器用かもね
fields.LOCALIZED: AHAHAHA! Say it only if you mean it!

fields.JP: 君に言われたくはないな

fields.EN: Right. But I appreciate it. Thanks.
fields.JP:
確かにそうね。
なんにしても色々わかったわ。
ありがと
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. But I appreciate it. Thanks.

fields.EN: From now on, I'll keep doing the night patrols less often, without pushing myself too hard.
fields.JP:
これからは頻度を減らして無理しない程度に
夜の見回りは続けるわ

fields.EN:
I'll keep an eye out for your wife, or any
leads, too.
fields.JP:
ついでに、あんたの奥さんっぽい人を
見かけたり、そういう情報が入ったら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll keep an eye out for your wife, or any
leads, too.

fields.EN: You'll be the first person I call.
fields.LOCALIZED: You'll be the first person I call.

fields.EN:
(How could she look for my wife without
knowing her appearance?)
fields.JP:
（妻の顔写真もなくて、どうやって
　探すつもりなんだ？　ただ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(How could she look for my wife without
knowing her appearance?)

fields.JP: ふっそれはありがたい

（……ん？　いつの間にか胸の痛みが消えてる？
　不思議なこともあるな）

fields.EN:
Mmm...mmm... Ugh. Stop, don't go.
Not that way!
fields.JP:
ん……んん……くうっ、
やめろ、行くな。そっちは駄目だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm...mmm... Ugh. Stop, don't go.
Not that way!

fields.EN: I'll lose sight of you! Don't go! Come back!
fields.JP:
君を見失ってしまう！
行くな！　もどってこい！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll lose sight of you! Don't go! Come back!

fields.EN:
*pant* *pant* *pant*... A dream... 
What a horrific dream I saw...
fields.JP:
はあ、はあ、はあ……夢か……。
なにかとても恐ろしい夢を見ていたような……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant* *pant* *pant*... A dream... 
What a horrific dream I saw...

fields.EN: I'm thirsty. Is my canteen empty...?
fields.JP:
喉が渇いた。
……水筒は空か……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm thirsty. Is my canteen empty...?

fields.EN: Very well, I'll have to go get some.
fields.JP: 仕方ない取りに行こう
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well, I'll have to go get some.

fields.JP:
はーっ。
うむ、おいしい

fields.EN:
I wonder if those two are still patrolling at
this hour.
fields.JP:
こんな夜中でも、あのふたりは
また見回りをしているだろうか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder if those two are still patrolling at
this hour.

fields.JP: （いた。　今夜は親指姫だけか……）

わっ！　ジ、ジュウ！？
おどかさないでよ！

fields.EN: I didn't plan on it... Just you today?
fields.JP:
そんなつもりはないが……
今日は一人なのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't plan on it... Just you today?

fields.EN: No. Shirayuki went back to her room.
fields.JP:
ちがうわ
白雪は先に部屋に戻っただけ
fields.LOCALIZED: No. Snow White went back to her room.

fields.EN: I see. So what were you doing?
fields.JP:
そうか……。
それで、親指姫は何をしてたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. So what were you doing?

fields.EN:
Don't tell me you were trying to search
by yourself.
fields.JP:
まさか、ひとりで探索しようなんて
考えてないだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't tell me you were trying to search
by yourself.

fields.EN: No no. I wouldn't do that.
fields.JP:
ないない。
さすがにそれはないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: No no. I wouldn't do that.

fields.EN:
I just had some stuff on my mind.
Lost in a daze.
fields.JP:
わたしは少しだけ考えごとがあったの。
それで、外でぼーっとしてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just had some stuff on my mind.
Lost in a daze.

fields.EN:
But it's cold, so I was thinking of heading
back.
fields.JP:
でも、少し寒くなってきたから、
今帰ろうとしてたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's cold, so I was thinking of heading
back.

fields.EN:
I got thirsty, so I came to get water.
On the way back, I thought of you two,
so I took the scenic route.
fields.JP:
僕は喉が渇いて水を飲みに行ってた。
その帰りにちょっと君たちが気になって、
ふと遠回りしたらいたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got thirsty, so I came to get water.
On the way back, I thought of you two,
so I took the scenic route.

fields.EN: Doing something that impulsive is unlike you.
fields.JP:
そんな気まぐれなことするなんて、
あんたらしくないわね
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: Sure. So long as I can answer it.
fields.JP:
突然だな。
答えられるものなら答えるが？
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure. So long as I can answer it.

fields.EN:
How are you so calm, despite being separated
from your wife?
fields.JP:
どうして、ジュウは大事なお嫁さんと
離れ離れになってもそんなに冷静なの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are you so calm, despite being separated
from your wife?

fields.JP: 少なくともわたしの目にはそう映るわ
僕はまったく冷静ではいないぞ

fields.EN: What?! You're lying! You totally seem cool.
fields.JP:
ええっ！　うそっ！
どこからどう見ても冷静なんだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! You're lying! You totally seem cool.

fields.EN:
My wife never leaves my dreams.
I'm hardly calm.
fields.JP:
妻のことは夢に出てくるほど会いたくて、
落ち着いてなどいない
fields.LOCALIZED:
My wife never leaves my dreams.
I'm hardly calm.

fields.JP: そんな素振り、まったく見せてないじゃない！

fields.EN:
I knew my search would be long. I can only
focus on the present.
fields.JP:
長く確実に探し続けることを見据えて、
今できることを常に考え集中している
fields.LOCALIZED:
I knew my search would be long. I can only
focus on the present.

fields.JP: そう言われると、いつものジュウだけど……
でも、そういうことなのよね

fields.EN:
Our goals are similar, but our methods
differ.
fields.JP:
結局ジュウとわたしたちは似ているけど
やりかたが違うだけなんだってこと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Our goals are similar, but our methods
differ.

fields.JP:
そういうことだな
今更そんなことに気が付いたのか

fields.EN: Ugh. Take a compliment, would ya?
fields.JP: もぅ、本当に余計な一言が多いわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Take a compliment, would ya?

fields.JP: そうか……これも「急がば回れ」ということか

fields.EN:
Hehe. My wife used to say that slow and
steady wins the race.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、これは妻がよく自分に
言い聞かせてくれた言葉だ。　「急がば回れ」って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. My wife used to say that slow and
steady wins the race.

fields.EN: I guess pain can blind us from understanding.
fields.JP: 理解し合うというのはやはり難題なのだな
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess pain can blind us from understanding.

fields.EN: I've never heard you laugh before.
fields.JP: あんたもそんな風に思い出し笑いすんのね
fields.LOCALIZED: I've never heard you laugh before.

fields.EN: I almost feel a little closer to you.
fields.JP: ちょっと通じ合えた気がするわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I almost feel a little closer to you.

fields.EN:
I'm gonna get some sleep so SOMEONE
doesn't lecture me again.
fields.JP:
さっ、すっきりしたところで
誰かさんにまた説教されたくないからもう寝るわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm gonna get some sleep so SOMEONE
doesn't lecture me again.

fields.EN: Hm? Have I ever lectured you?
fields.JP: ん？　説教なんてしたことがあったか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Have I ever lectured you?

fields.EN: For a smart guy, you sure are dumb.
fields.JP: ほんと自分のことは見えないんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: For a smart guy, you sure are dumb.

fields.EN:
Hey Juu, in the end, both of us have
everything to gain, and even more to lose.
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジュウ。結局わたしたちも
あんたも家族のためなら、どんなに大変でも
なんでもするタイプなのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Toh, in the end, both of us have
everything to gain, and even more to lose.

fields.EN: But at least we're in that together.
fields.JP: まわりまわって同じってことね
fields.LOCALIZED: But at least we're in that together.

fields.EN: Yes. It's quite the bridge we've built.
fields.JP: 同じ痛みを抱えているのは分かるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. It's quite the bridge we've built.

fields.EN: Right. I hope we find them.
fields.JP:
そうね……。
お互いちゃんと見つかるといいわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I hope we find them.

fields.EN: Well, I'm going to bed. Sweet dreams.
fields.JP:
じゃあね、もう寝るわ
良い夢見なさいよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I'm going to bed. Sweet dreams.

fields.JP:
（この花は、花の中に花が咲いているのか、
　少し不気味だな）

fields.EN: (Why are they crouched around that puddle?)
fields.JP:
（どうして、大きな水たまりの傍に
　三人がしゃがんでるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why are they crouched around that puddle?)

fields.JP:
（ああ、たらいを置いて
　洗濯をしているんだな）

fields.EN:
(That's good that we have enough water
to do laundry.)
fields.JP:
（なんだかんだ洗濯するほど水に
　余裕があることは良いことだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's good that we have enough water
to do laundry.)

fields.EN: (But it doesn't look like the three of them are getting along.)
fields.JP:
（しかし、３人仲良く
　というわけでもなさそうだな）

fields.EN: Why was I assigned to this job?!
fields.JP:
なぜにわらわがこんなことをしないと
ならないんですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Why was I assigned to this job?!

fields.EN: Argh! It's because you messed it up!
fields.JP:
あーーもう！！
あんたが汚したからに決まってるでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Argh! It's because you messed it up!

fields.EN: The bubbles are scattering! Be quiet.
fields.JP:
泡が飛びます～
静かにしてください～
fields.LOCALIZED: The bubbles are scattering! Be quiet.

fields.JP: まあまあ、親指姉様、落ち着いてください
fields.LOCALIZED: Now now, Sister Thumbelina. Calm down.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: Juu-san. You came at a good time.
fields.JP:
おお～ジュウさん
ちょうど良いところに来ました～
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh. You came at a good time.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: わらわの代わりに洗濯してくれませぬか～？

fields.EN:
What?! No way! We're washing underwear
right now. We can't have him help.
That's impossible!
fields.JP:
はあっ！　ないないっ！
今は下着とか洗ってるんだから、
こいつに手伝わせるだなんてありえないわよ！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! No way! We're washing underwear
right now. We can't have him help.
That's impossible!

fields.EN:
What? Because it's underwear?
It's just cloth. No different from a
handkerchief.
fields.JP:
まあ、下着だから駄目なんて……
ただの布きれですよ～。
ハンカチと変わりありません～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Because it's underwear?
It's just cloth. No different from a
handkerchief.

fields.JP: あるわよ！　大ありよ！

fields.EN:
She's right, Kaguya! We have to draw a line! 
Juu-san is a man!
fields.JP:
そうですよ！　かぐやさん！
そこはきちんと区別していきましょう！
ジュウさんは男性ですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right, Kaguya! We have to draw a line! 
Toh is a man!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: 同じ布地なのにめんどうくさいです～
とにかく駄目なものは駄目よ！

fields.EN:
Very well. If both Oyayubi and Shirayuki
say no.
fields.JP:
仕方ありませんね～、
親指だけではなく、白雪まで反対するのでしたら～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. If both Thumbelina and Snow White
say no.

fields.JP: ほっ、納得してくれました

fields.EN: (Looking at this, couldn't the way we do laundry be improved a bit?)
fields.JP:
（こう見ると、もう少し洗濯方法の
　改善化ができるんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Even laundry's a debate with this gang.)

fields.EN:
We had people to do this for us back at
Dawn. How tragic.
fields.JP:
黎明にいたときはやってくれる人がいたのに、
不便な世の中です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
We had people to do this for us back at
Dawn. How tragic.

fields.EN:
We're not at Dawn anymore! Don't you
get it?!
fields.JP:
黎明は黎明！
ここはここよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not at Dawn anymore! Don't you
get it?!

fields.EN: Learn how to fend for yourself.
fields.JP:
ここにはそんな人いないんだから、
しっかりしなさい
fields.LOCALIZED: Learn how to fend for yourself.

fields.EN: Kunai already has enough to deal with on her own. We need to help each other.
fields.JP:
クナイ一人でも大変なんだから
助け合っていかなきゃ
fields.LOCALIZED: Look how Kunai's holding up. Do it for her!

fields.EN:
When you're like that, Oyayubi-neesama,
it's almost as if you're Kaguya-san's older sister.
fields.JP:
そうしていると、まるで親指姉様が
かぐやさんの姉様みたいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like Sister Thumbelina is bossing
Kaguya around.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama; B12 P0 Oyayubihime/Kaguyahime sister dynamic restored from JP

fields.EN: Oneesama~ Please wash them for me~.
fields.JP: おねえさま～、代わりに洗ってください～
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh dear, please wash my clothes!
fields.notes: B12 P0 Kaguyahime directly addresses Oyayubihime as oneesama

fields.EN:
Hey, don't cling to me!
I don't want a lazy little sister like you!
fields.JP:
ちょっとしがみつかないでよ！
こんなぐうたらな妹、こっちから願い下げよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Get off me! I don't want a lazy sister!
fields.notes: B12 P0 sister-dynamic response restored from JP

fields.EN: And another thing! You keep telling me to wash them for you, but everything I'm washing is yours, Kaguya!
fields.JP:
だいたいね！
代わりに洗ってって言ってるけど
そもそも洗ってるの全部かぐやのだからね！？

fields.EN: Yeah! Look, it even has your name on it!
fields.JP:
そうよ！
ほら、かぐやって名前も書いてある！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Look, it even has your name on it!

fields.JP: 書いたのはそなたです～

fields.EN:
Only because you'd use other people's
clothes otherwise!
fields.JP:
そうしないと、すぐ人のを
使っちゃうからでしょ！
こっちは親切心で書いてやってんのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only because you'd use other people's
clothes otherwise!

fields.JP: （なんだかんだ、面倒見がいいな……）

fields.EN: This is all too much work on my poor hands.
fields.JP:
だって、手洗いをするのって
面倒じゃありませんか～
fields.LOCALIZED: This is all too much work on my poor hands.

fields.EN:
That doesn't mean you can delegate your
laundry! Now scrub!
fields.JP:
だからって、人に押し付けない！
はい、ごしごしして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't mean you can delegate your
laundry! Now scrub!

fields.JP: さあ、かぐやさん、頑張りましょう！
（しかしやはり手洗いは時間効率が悪い）

fields.EN: (That's it! Couldn't I semi-automate the scrubbing on the washboard?)
fields.JP:
（そうだ！　洗濯板にこすりつけるのを
　半自動化することはできるんじゃないか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I know! If we use a washing board,
it would help.)

fields.EN:
(Yeah, the kind you can use to slide it... 
I think we can make it happen.)
fields.JP:
（うん。板同士を挟んで、片方の板が
　スライドするような……。
　これはいけそうな気がするぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yeah, the kind you can use to slide it... 
I think we can make it happen.)

fields.EN:
(If we can make it, it'll definitely be
more efficient.)
fields.JP: （できあがれば、効率化アップ間違いなしだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If we can make it, it'll definitely be
more efficient.)

fields.EN: How long do you plan to be here?
fields.JP: ねえ、あんたいつまでここにいるのよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: How long do you plan to be here?

fields.JP: 僕のことは気にしないでくれ
気にしないでくれって……
完全に思考の部屋に入ってますね

fields.EN:
(We should also make drying easier.
Maybe we fuse a hanger and a washing
board together...)
fields.JP:
（干すときも面倒な工程は省きたい。
　ハンガー型に木材をカットして
　そのまま洗えるのがいいだろうか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We should also make drying easier.
Maybe we fuse a hanger and a washing
board together...)

fields.EN:
Hey Juu! You say don't mind me,
but I mind you!
fields.JP:
ちょっと！　ジュウ！
あんたが気にしなくても
こっちが気になるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Toh! You say don't mind me,
but I mind you!

fields.EN:
There's underwear here.
How can I NOT be self-conscious?!
fields.JP:
下着があるって言ってるのに
気にしないなんて無理に
決まってんでしょーが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's underwear here.
How can I NOT be self-conscious?!

fields.EN:
It's fine. I'm not interested in your
undergarments. They're practically
socks.
fields.JP:
大丈夫だ、僕はそんな布切れに興味はない。
ハンカチと同じだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. I'm not interested in your
undergarments. They're practically
socks.

fields.EN: (Right. They need to be a different shape.)
fields.JP:
（そうだ。ハンカチを干す物干しは
　別の形がいいだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Right. They need to be a different shape.)

fields.EN:
(We need a kind of clip to keep the clothes
in place!)
fields.JP: （挟むものがついていれば効率的になるぞ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(We need a kind of clip to keep the clothes
in place!)

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.JP: さっさとどっかいきなさい！

あ～そんな強く背中を押しては
ダメですよ親指姉様！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: Okay... I'll go to my tent.
fields.JP:
……分かった。
とりあえずテントに戻って思索の続きをする
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay... I'll go to my tent.

fields.EN:
Whatever she says, she really does worry
about you. She's a good onee-chan.
fields.JP:
なんだかんだ言っても、
ちゃんと心配してくれる
いいお姉ちゃんですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's taking care of business!
Nice work, sister!

fields.EN: Yes. I'm proud you're my sister!
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I'm proud you're my sister!

fields.EN:
(Some clips would work perfectly here,
then...)
fields.JP:
（はさむやつだけを大量に下げたやつを
　作るのもありだな。それから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Some clips would work perfectly here,
then...)

fields.EN:
(I tried drawing my wife's face, but I'm
terrible at drawing.)
fields.JP:
（いざ、浮かんでも出てこない妻の顔を
　思い出すために、実際に絵に描いてみたが……
　僕の絵心のなさも酷いものだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I tried drawing my wife's face, but I'm
terrible at drawing.)

fields.JP: あの……入ってもいいでしょうか？

あ、すいません！
白雪姫です

fields.EN: Excuse me, Juu-san. Are you busy right now?
fields.JP:
ジュウさん失礼します
今お忙しかったですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Excuse me, Toh. Are you busy right now?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: No, but that doesn't mean I'm free either.
fields.JP:
忙しくはないが……
世間話をするほど暇ではないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: No, but that doesn't mean I'm free either.

fields.EN:
Right. I just had something I really wanted to ask
you, Juu-san...
fields.JP:
はい、ジュウさんにとってはわかりませんが、
白雪としてはどうしても聞きたいことがあって……
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I just had something to ask you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
（白雪姫は赤ずきんと違い、
　聞き分けが良く助かる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Snow White, unlike Red Riding Hood,
is understanding.)

fields.EN:
Remember how you saved my life before, Juu-san?
About that...
fields.JP:
以前ジュウさんが白雪の命を救ってくれた
じゃないですか　あの時のことなんですが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember how you saved my life?
About that...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Don't tell me you're going to thank me for that again. I hate wasting time having the same conversation twice.
fields.JP:
まさかもう一度あの時のお礼とかじゃないだろうな。
同じ話をするのは時間の無駄だから嫌いなのだが
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please don't thank me. I would rather you
poke my eyes out than give me more empty
thanks.

fields.EN: No, that's not what I'm here for.
fields.JP:
いえ、白雪もそうだろうなと思ってるので、
その話じゃないです。
fields.LOCALIZED: No, that's not what I'm here for.

fields.JP: あ、でも今も感謝の気持ちでいっぱいですよ！

fields.EN: Sorry. That was rude of me. Continue.
fields.JP: すまない、僕の方がぶり返してしまったな
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry. That was rude of me. Continue.

fields.EN: Y-yes. And the reason Shirayuki was saved was, um...
fields.JP:
は、はい。
それでその白雪が助かったのは、その……

fields.EN:
Did you happen to notice that I have
a lot of body fat?
fields.JP:
ひ、皮下脂肪が高いって言ってたんですけど、
そ、そんなに高く感じましたか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did you happen to notice that I have
a lot of body fat?

fields.EN:
Did I only survive the cold because of my
high body fat?
fields.JP:
そんなに白雪は寒さを守るお肉の鎧が
厚かったですか！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did I only survive the cold because of my
high body fat?

fields.EN:
(What in the... Did she really come here
to ask me that?)
fields.JP:
（……なんだこの下らない質問は、
　事実として白雪姫は皮下脂肪が高い）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What in the... Did she really come here
to ask me that?)

fields.EN:
(It's just that I'm sure Shirayukihime knows me.
But I can tell it bothers her...)
fields.JP:
（ただ、恐らく僕の事を少しは理解してるであろう
　白雪姫があえて聞くと言うことは、
　気になる案件という事だろう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's just that I'm sure Snow White knows me.
But I can tell it bothers her...)

fields.EN:
(This reminds me of when my wife
scolded me for hinting that she had
gained weight.)
fields.JP:
（うむ、妻にも似たことを言った時に
　'太ってるってこと！？'と叱責された。
　今回も似たケースのはずだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This reminds me of when my wife
scolded me for hinting that she had
gained weight.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe if I deny it, she'll believe me and
bugger off.)
fields.JP:
（ここで皮下脂肪は実は低かったと言えば
　収まるかもしれない……。
　ただ、正直嘘をつくほどの内容とは思えない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe if I deny it, she'll believe me and
bugger off.)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime, you don't have high fat
content. Even if you did, it's perfectly
healthy.
fields.JP:
白雪姫、皮下脂肪とは皮膚と筋肉の間に
生まれる脂肪のことなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, you don't have high fat
content. Even if you did, it's perfectly
healthy.

fields.EN:
The whole point is your body's creating
excess storage to provide you with energy
and insulation.
fields.JP:
その効果は寒さや外部からの刺激を軽減する
役割を持っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
The whole point is your body's creating
excess storage to provide you with energy
and insulation.

fields.EN:
Too much fat can be hazardous, of course,
but you're not anywhere close to fat.
fields.JP:
当然高すぎはよくないが、かといって
皮下脂肪がまったくないということも問題だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Too much fat can be hazardous, of course,
but you're not anywhere close to fat.

fields.EN: In other words, as long as you're healthy, subcutaneous fat itself isn't a bad thing.
fields.JP:
つまり健康を維持できているのであれば、
皮下脂肪そのものは悪というわけではない
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, you survived precisely
because you are healthy.

fields.EN:
Basically, it doesn't matter if I have fat
or not, so I shouldn't let it bother me?
fields.JP:
その、それって白雪が健康ならば皮下脂肪
は高くても気にするなってことですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Basically, it doesn't matter if I have fat
or not, so I shouldn't let it bother me?

fields.JP: ちょっとジュウさん答えてください！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: そういうことにはなる

わ～～～～～っ！！
やっぱりそうなんですね～～！！

fields.EN: (Hm. Did I say the wrong thing? Shirayukihime's clever, this could be bad.)
fields.JP:
（うむ……どう答えれるのが正解だったのか。
　しかし白雪姫は良くも悪くも察しが良いな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. Did I say the wrong thing? Snow
White's clever, this could be bad.)

fields.JP:
……はっ！
なぜ忘れていたのだ！

fields.EN: I remember a conversation...with my wife!
fields.JP:
さっきの妻との思い出……
今の会話で思い出したぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I remember a conversation...with my wife!

fields.EN:
It seems I've unlocked something hidden
deep inside of me.
fields.JP:
他人とのエピソードから閉まっていた
引き出しが開かれたのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems I've unlocked something hidden
deep inside of me.

fields.EN:
Only by speaking with Shirayukihime
and the others have I freed my mind.
fields.JP:
案外白雪姫や他の者たちと話すと、
またふと思い出すかもしれないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Only by speaking with Snow White
and the others have I freed my mind.

fields.EN:
(Was that Shirayukihime?! Is it a Marchen?
I must hurry.)
fields.JP:
（……！　今のは白雪姫の声？
　メルヒェンなどが現れたのだろうか。
　行かねば）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Was that Snow White?! Is it a Marchen?
I must hurry.)

fields.JP:
（周りを見る限り、
　メルヒェンなどではないようだな……）

fields.EN:
(There's a pile of trash. Is that why
she screamed?)
fields.JP:
（ここはゴミが積まれている場所。
　白雪姫はなぜ酷く怯えているんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's a pile of trash. Is that why
she screamed?)

fields.EN:
What's the matter, Shirayukihime?
Was there something in the trash?
fields.JP:
白雪姫、どうした？
このゴミになにかあったのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's the matter, Snow White?
Was there something in the trash?

fields.EN: I was in the middle of cleaning up...
fields.JP:
不用品とはいえ、とても散らばっていたので、
綺麗にしてたんです
fields.LOCALIZED: I was in the middle of cleaning up...

fields.JP: この鏡がどうかしたのか？

fields.EN: Aah! Don't point it at me!
fields.JP:
きゃっ！
そ、その向けないでください！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah! Don't point it at me!

fields.JP: ……この鏡に怯えていたということか

fields.EN: Yes! I didn't expect to find a mirror here!
fields.JP:
は、はいっ、そ、そうです！
こんなところに不用品に混ざって、
か、か、鏡があるなんてっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes! I didn't expect to find a mirror here!

fields.EN:
(I don't get it. It's just a mirror...
She is really scared.)
fields.JP:
（どういうことだ、たかが鏡で……
　とんでもない怯えようだぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't get it. It's just a mirror...
She is really scared.)

fields.EN: Oh... Is this a Blood Libido thing?
fields.JP:
あ……っ
血式リビドーか
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... Is this a Blood Libido thing?

fields.EN:
Yes, I'm sorry. I know it's odd, but I have
a phobia of them.
fields.JP:
はい、ごめんなさい。おかしいでしょうけど……
白雪は……昔からソレが怖いんです。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, I'm sorry. I know it's odd, but I have
a phobia of them.

fields.EN: No need to apologize. It's fine.
fields.JP: 何も謝ることはないし、おかしくもない
fields.LOCALIZED: No need to apologize. It's fine.

fields.EN:
Thanks Juu-san. Even hearing the word makes
me nervous.
fields.JP:
ジュウさん、ありがとうございます。
もう名前を聞くだけでも、どうしようもなく
不安に襲われちゃうんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks Toh. Even hearing the word makes
me nervous.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Especially to the point of panic.
fields.JP: それで悲鳴を上げるほど動揺したんだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Especially to the point of panic.

fields.EN:
(Now I've seen it all. These Blood Libidos
are getting out of hand.)
fields.JP:
（ここまで感情が揺さぶられるとは……
　血式リビドーとはやっかいな感情だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Now I've seen it all. These Blood Libidos
are getting out of hand.)

fields.EN:
(Thank goodness I don't have that problem.
Hell on earth.)
fields.JP:
（こんなものが自分に備わってなくてよかった。
　不便極まりない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Thank goodness I don't have that problem.
Hell on earth.)

fields.EN: Anyways, I should toss this, right?
fields.JP: とりあえず、この鏡を片付ければいいんだな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyways, I should toss this, right?

fields.JP:
そ、そんなごめんなさい。
でも、とっても助かります

fields.EN: I'll place it in this box, okay?
fields.JP: ひとまずダンボールの中に入れてしまうからな
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll place it in this box, okay?

fields.EN: Okay. As long as it's out of sight, I'll be fine.
fields.JP:
はい、視なければ大丈夫ですので。
段ボールの中に入れてしまえば、もう平気です
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. As long as it's out of sight, I'll be fine.

fields.EN:
I can hardly stand the thought of being
near it.
fields.JP: 昔は近くにあるだけでも怖かったんですけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can hardly stand the thought of being
near it.

fields.EN:
But depending on whom I'm with,
I can look into it.
fields.JP:
今は一緒にいる人によっては、
鏡を見ることもできるんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But depending on whom I'm with,
I can look into it.

fields.EN:
So your Libido changes based on your
companion. Strange.
fields.JP:
人によってリビドーの大小が変わるということか。
あまり聞かないケースだな興味深い
fields.LOCALIZED:
So your Libido changes based on your
companion. Strange.

fields.EN:
So who lowers your Libido? I assume
you've performed trial and error.
fields.JP:
そのリビドーの効力が下がる相手は誰なんだ？
そう言うからには実際にいるんだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So who lowers your Libido? I assume
you've performed trial and error.

fields.EN: I didn't expect you to ask. Um...
fields.JP:
そこを聞かれると思わなかったので、
心の準備が……
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't expect you to ask. Um...

fields.JP:
え、あの……その……
…………ジャック……さんです

fields.EN:
(The other Blood Youth. We've never
even spoken.)
fields.JP:
（別の血式少年、ジャック……
　喋ったことなどないが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The other Blood Youth. We've never
even spoken.)

fields.EN:
(But whenever I hear his name, it stirs
something inside me. What could these
strange feelings mean?)
fields.JP:
（なぜかその名前を聞くとモヤモヤする。
　僕は彼に何を思っているのだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But whenever I hear his name, it stirs
something inside me. What could these
strange feelings mean?)

fields.EN: Jack-san helped me overcome my fear.
fields.JP:
……以前ジャックさんが白雪の鏡恐怖症を
克服するために、色々協力してくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack helped me overcome my fear.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Right. I need to plot our exploration route.
Mind if I head back?
fields.JP:
そうか。
実は今探索ルートを考えている途中でな、
そろそろ戻って良いか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I need to plot our exploration route.
Mind if I head back?

fields.EN: Oh, sorry for bothering you! Thanks!
fields.JP:
あ、すみません。忙しいところ
駆けつけてくださったんですよね。
ありがとうございます！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, sorry for bothering you! Thanks!

fields.JP: ああ、解決して良かった
（どこか中途半端に終わらせてしまった……）

fields.EN: (Jack... could he have something to do with my lost memories...?)
fields.JP:
（ジャック……そいつは僕の失われた記憶に
　何か関係があるのだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Jack...has anything to do
with me...)

fields.EN: (Why does just hearing Jack's name leave me feeling unsettled...? There's still so much I don't understand about myself.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックの名前を聞いただけで
　なぜもやもやするのか……
　まだまだ自分自身わからないことだらけだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't put my finger on it. But there's
still so much I don't know about myself.)

fields.EN: Seems like today went off without a hitch.
fields.JP: 今日は平和に探索が終わりそうですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Seems like today went off without a hitch.

fields.EN: Yeah! Happy for an uneventful day.
fields.JP:
そうですね！
何事もなくてほんと良かったですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Happy for an uneventful day.

fields.EN: But this is no time to let our guards down.
fields.JP: そういう時ほど油断するんじゃないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: But this is no time to let our guards down.

fields.EN: It's annoying to hear this from Juu, but he's right.
fields.JP:
ジュウに言われると癪だけど、
ほんとその通りだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's annoying to hear this from Toh, but he's right.

fields.JP: はい。そうですね、ジュウさん、赤姉様
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. You're right. Toh, Sister Red.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Sure, but I want to savor this peaceful day
while I can.
fields.JP:
たまには穏やかな日があって
ほしいですわね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but I want to savor this peaceful day
while I can.

fields.EN: We haven't had one since reaching the surface.
fields.JP: 地上に来てからそんな日一日もないからねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED: We haven't had one since reaching the surface.

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
気を付けろっ！　
前方にメルヒェンだぞ！

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: T-Juu-san! There's a Marchen behind us!
fields.JP:
ジ、ジュウさんっ！
後ろにもメルヒェンがいます！
fields.LOCALIZED: T-Toh! There's a Marchen behind us!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Split into two groups, front and rear, and focus your attacks! I'll watch the situation from the middle and shift our forces if things get dangerous!
fields.JP:
前後二手に分かれて攻撃に集中しろ！
僕が真ん中で状況を見て、危険と判断したら
戦力を変える！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Split into groups of two, form a rear and
front guard! Focus your attacks. I'll stand
in the middle!

fields.EN:
Then Cinderella, Princess Lazy, and I will defeat
the Marchen in the back!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、わたしとシンデレラとぐーたら姫で
後ろのメルヒェンを倒す！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then Cinderella, Princess Lazy, and I will defeat
the Marchen in the back!

fields.EN:
Then I'm going to defeat the Marchen in
front with Shirayuki!
fields.JP:
それじゃあたしと白雪で前の
メルヒェンを倒すよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then I'm going to defeat the Marchen in
front with Snow White!

fields.JP:
そ、それじゃ白雪が先陣をきります！
やーーーっ！

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime, you're charging too much!
Come back!
fields.JP:
白雪姫、突っ込み過ぎだぞ！
戻れ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, you're charging too much!
Come back!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: Huh? Nooo! The Marchen got me!
fields.JP:
えっ、や、やああぁぁっ！！
いけないっ！　前のメルヒェンに挟まれて！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Nooo! The Marchen got me!

fields.JP: 白雪！　今、助けるからっ！

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama
B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP:
あ、ありがとうございます！
白雪も追撃します！！
白雪そいつもう死んでるから！
赤姉様に白雪の攻撃が！！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: No, you're not! Cinderella, cover Akazukin!
fields.JP:
そんなわけがないだろ！
シンデレラ、赤ずきん達をフォローしてくれ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, you're not! Cinderella, cover Red Riding
Hood!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.JP: 赤姉様っ！　メルヒェンがっ！
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: Rgh! I won't make it in time!
fields.JP: くっ！！　間に合いませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh! I won't make it in time!

fields.JP: （白雪姫は動揺して動けてない……！）

fields.EN: Don't underestimate me! I can handle this!
fields.JP:
舐めんなーーー！
これくらいあたしひとりで十分！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't underestimate me! I can handle this!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: 白雪、援護であんたの後ろに回るから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White, I'm right behind you.

fields.JP:
えっ、赤姉様、
白雪はどうすればいいんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do I do, Sister Red?
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.JP: （まずいぞ。白雪姫が混乱している）
ここに移動すればいいんでしょうか？

fields.EN:
No, that's not it! AAH! We're bumping into
one another!
fields.JP:
や、違うって、ああっ！　
ぶつかるっ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, that's not it! AAH! We're bumping into
one another!

fields.EN: Sorry, Aka-neesama. I'm in your way.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい、赤姉様、
ぶつかってしまいました
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, Sister Red. I'm in your way.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN: It's fine. I just see stars. It's fine.
fields.JP:
大丈夫。ちょっと頭に
星が飛んだだけだから平気
fields.LOCALIZED: It's fine. I just see stars. It's fine.

fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 赤姉様 -> Aka-nee-sama

fields.EN:
Shirayuki, are you okay?! Leave this
to me! Just calm down, okay?!
fields.JP:
白雪大丈夫？　こっちは任せて！
とにかく落ち着くのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, are you okay?! Leave this
to me! Just calm down, okay?!

fields.EN: I'm fine! Doing what I can!
fields.JP:
仕方ないです～
わらわも頑張ります～
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm fine! Doing what I can!

fields.EN:
S-sorry... Thank you. Oh so what should I do?
I don't even know anymore... *whimper*
fields.JP:
す、すみません……ありがとうございます。
ああ、白雪はどうしたらいいのでしょう？
それさえもわかりません……ううっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
S-sorry... Thank you. Oh so what should I do?
I don't even know anymore... *whimper*

fields.JP: 白雪姫、ひとまず僕の横に来い
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White. Stick close for now.

fields.EN: Juu-san. Thank you. I can still fight.
fields.JP:
ジュウさん、ありがとうございます。
白雪はまだ戦えます
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh. Thank you. I can still fight.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Don't be stupid. You've been overwhelmed.
fields.JP:
馬鹿言うな。
今、君は完全に平静を失っている
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be stupid. You've been overwhelmed.

fields.EN:
All those mistakes are disrupting your
rhythm. Bring it down!
fields.JP:
その上、その失敗で更に判断力を
失う負の流れになっている
fields.LOCALIZED:
All those mistakes are disrupting your
rhythm. Bring it down!

fields.JP:
で、でも、まだ親指姉様達がメルヒェンと
戦っているのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: But Sister Thumbelina's fighting by herself!
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 親指姉様 -> Oyayubi-nee-sama

fields.EN: That's exactly why. You're better off doing nothing right now, Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
だからこそだ。
今の白雪姫は何もしない方が良い
fields.LOCALIZED: Even more of a reason! Don't be reckless!

fields.JP: そ、そんな白雪は大丈夫です！

fields.EN:
How can you say that when you've made
error after error?
fields.JP:
さっきからこんなに連続して失敗しているのに
どこが大丈夫なんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can you say that when you've made
error after error?

fields.JP: ジュウ！　あんた言いすぎ！
事実を述べているのに言いすぎも何もない

fields.EN: Shirayuki has the tendency to get like this.
fields.JP:
白雪はそういう風に
なっちゃうときが、たまにあるの！
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White has the tendency to get like this.

fields.EN: We know what's going on, so it's okay!
fields.JP:
だから、こっちはわかって
やってるからいいの！
fields.LOCALIZED: We know what's going on, so it's okay!

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

notes: B46 mass exact-JP speaker source-label audit

fields.EN: You know yet you still make the same mistakes...?
fields.JP:
……わかっていて同じ失敗を
してるということか…？
fields.LOCALIZED: You know yet you still make the same mistakes...?

fields.EN:
Juu-san's right. I'll follow his orders.
I'll go behind Juu-san.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんの言う通りですね。
今日はもうジュウさんの指示に従います……
白雪はジュウさんの後ろにいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh's right. I'll follow his orders.
I'll go behind Toh.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジュウ => Toh-san on 2 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=3 | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: (That was unexpected. I didn't know Shirayukihime panics like that in tense situations.)
fields.JP:
（しかし、予想外だった。
　白雪姫は咄嗟の判断を間違えていくと
　階段を落ちるようにパニックになるのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That was unexpected. I didn't know Snow
White panics like that in tense situations.)

fields.JP:
（ちゃんと覚えて
　戦略に盛り込まねば……）

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime. It's Juu. Can I come in?
I need to speak with you.
fields.JP:
白雪姫、ジュウだ。入ってもいいか？
ちょっと折り入って話があるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White. It's Toh. Can I come in?
I need to speak with you.
fields.notes: source-gated Toh => Juu; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Huh?! Juu-san! Oh, sure! Come in!
fields.JP:
えっ！　ジュウさん！
あ、はい。どうぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! Toh! Oh, sure! Come in!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Actually give me 10 seconds.
I need to mentally prepare!
fields.JP:
あ、やっぱり１０秒待ってください。
心の準備をします！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Actually give me 10 seconds.
I need to mentally prepare!

fields.JP:
はい。もう大丈夫です。
どうぞお入りください

fields.EN:
It's rare for you to visit, Juu-san, so I'm a little
nervous!
fields.JP:
ジュウさんが訪ねてくるなんて珍しいので
ちょっと緊張しちゃいました！
fields.LOCALIZED: A rare visit! I'm almost nervous.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
It's about the other day, isn't it?
Scold me all you want. I know I'm useless.
fields.JP:
や、やっぱりこの間のことですよね……
お説教でもなんでも聞きます。
白雪がダメダメなのはわかってますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's about the other day, isn't it?
Scold me all you want. I know I'm useless.

fields.EN:
You had such high hopes for me, Juu-san, and I
disappointed you. I'm sorry...
fields.JP:
せっかくジュウさんに期待を
かけてもらってたのに失望しましたよね。
ごめんなさい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you must be disappointed. 
You had such high hopes for me. I'm sorry.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
（やっぱり、この前の襲撃のときのことを
　気にしてるのか……）

fields.EN:
I don't like to beat around the bush. But 
to the point, yes. It's about that day.
fields.JP:
僕はまわりくどい前置きは苦手だ。
だから、率直にいうが、この前の戦いの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't like to beat around the bush. But 
to the point, yes. It's about that day.

fields.EN:
Once I make a mistake or get confused, 
I have the tendency to spiral.
fields.JP:
白雪は一度失敗したり混乱すると
ドジが連鎖しちゃうことがあるんです……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once I make a mistake or get confused, 
I have the tendency to spiral.

fields.EN: That battle the other day was exactly like that. I'm truly sorry. I'm fine now, though.
fields.JP:
この前の戦闘のときがまさにそれで。
本当にすみませんでした。
今はもう大丈夫ですから
fields.LOCALIZED:
The other day being a perfect example.
But I'm fine now.

fields.JP: （はぁ……今もパニックになってどうする）

fields.EN: You're not okay. You're still not calm either.
fields.JP:
大丈夫ではないな。
まだまだ落ち着いてもいないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: You're not okay. You're still not calm either.

fields.EN:
What do you mean? I calmed down and
gave it some thought.
fields.JP:
ど、ど、どういう意味ですか？
白雪は落ち着いて考えましたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean? I calmed down and
gave it some thought.

fields.EN:
I didn't come here for an apology. 
You should know that, Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
僕が謝ってほしくてここに来た訳じゃないくらい、
白雪姫ならわかるだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't come here for an apology. 
You should know that, Snow White.

fields.EN: If that's what you think, it's rude.
fields.JP: 本気でそう思っているならば失礼だ。
fields.LOCALIZED: If that's what you think, it's rude.

fields.EN:
True... you're not the kind of person who'd come all
this way just to make someone apologize, Juu-san...
fields.JP:
……確かにジュウさんは
わざわざ人に謝ってもらおうとして
来るような人じゃないですよね……
fields.LOCALIZED: True. You're not one to seek apologies.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Then why are you here? For advice?
fields.JP:
では、どうして訪ねてきてくれたんですか？
もしかして、何かアドバイスがあるとか……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Then why are you here? For advice?

fields.EN:
I think you're one of the more intelligent
and rational members of the group.
fields.JP:
改めていうが、僕はこの集団の中では白雪姫は
知的で冷静な判断ができる方だと思っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think you're one of the more intelligent
and rational members of the group.

fields.JP: あ、ありがとうございます

fields.EN: But in spite of that, I know your weakness.
fields.JP: その上でそういう弱点があることが判明した
fields.LOCALIZED: But in spite of that, I know your weakness.

fields.EN:
I'm sorry. I've always wanted to fix it, but
when it comes down to it...
fields.JP:
すみません。ずっと直そうとは
思ってるんですけど……
やっぱりいざそうなると……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sorry. I've always wanted to fix it, but
when it comes down to it...

fields.EN: If you're aware, then there's nothing to fix.
fields.JP:
そこまでわかってるなら
直さなくていい
fields.LOCALIZED: If you're aware, then there's nothing to fix.

fields.JP:
ええっ！　直さなくていいんですか？
ど、どうして？

fields.EN:
I've put some thought into it. Have you
been like this since you were a child?
fields.JP:
あれからずっと考えたのだが、
そもそも話を聞くと幼少期のころから
その現象を分かっているんだよな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've put some thought into it. Have you
been like this since you were a child?

fields.EN:
If you haven't been able to fix this since,
then this cannot be fixed in normal means.
fields.JP:
それでいまだに治せないということは、
並大抵のことでは治せないと判断した
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you haven't been able to fix this since,
then this cannot be fixed in normal means.

fields.JP: そ、そういうことなんですよね……

fields.EN: Instead, let's settle on one answer for what to do when that happens.
fields.JP:
その代わりそうなった時に「どうするか」だけ
一つの答えを出しておこう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Instead of dwelling on the negatives, give
yourself the tools to work through it.

fields.EN: What do you mean? Is there something I can do?
fields.JP:
どういうことでしょうか？
え、そんなことできるんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you mean? Is there something I can do?

fields.EN: It's easy. Once you realize you're spiraling...
fields.JP:
簡単だ。
いいか、もしパニックになっていると
判断したら……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's easy. Once you realize you're spiraling...

fields.JP: 僕に任せるんだ、白雪姫

fields.EN:
Huh? So delegate everything to you when
I panic? That's your solution?
fields.JP:
ええっと、つまり、パニックになったら、
自分で判断をしないという対処方法ですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? So delegate everything to you when
I panic? That's your solution?

fields.EN: Heh. You pick up fast. Exactly.
fields.JP:
ふっ、白雪姫はやはり理解が早いな。
そういうことだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh. You pick up fast. Exactly.

fields.EN:
But that sounds pathetic... But also strangely
comforting.
fields.JP:
いざ言われると情けなく思いますが……
凄く安心提案です
fields.LOCALIZED:
But that sounds pathetic... But also strangely
comforting.

fields.EN: I'm worried about burdening you, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
ただ、それじゃジュウさんの
負担が重くなりそうで心配です
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm worried about burdening you, Toh.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Don't worry. I'd rather you rely on me than
freeze in the middle of battle.
fields.JP:
僕は心配ない。むしろパニックになって
事態がより混乱する方の負担が大きい。
この前の戦闘のようにな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't worry. I'd rather you rely on me than
freeze in the middle of battle.

fields.EN:
Falling is normal. What matters is getting
back up.
fields.JP:
大事なのは転んだ後なんだ。
生物は失敗するようにできている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Falling is normal. What matters is getting
back up.

fields.EN:
Accept mistakes as they come, and move
forward. Positive inertia.
fields.JP:
では、どうするかというとそれを想定して
失敗した後のことを考えることだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Accept mistakes as they come, and move
forward. Positive inertia.

fields.EN:
Soon it'll become a reflex, and you'll become
more adept at handling tricky situations.
fields.JP:
頭ではなく反射神経としてそれをすり込むことで
最悪の危機を回避する
fields.LOCALIZED:
Soon it'll become a reflex, and you'll become
more adept at handling tricky situations.

fields.EN:
Hehe. That sounds like the dry way you'd think about
it, Juu-san...
fields.JP:
ふふふっ。
ジュウさんらしいドライな考えに
聞こえますけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. How like you. So cut and dry.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Sounds like you've put a lot of thought into it.
fields.JP:
白雪のためにそんなことを
ずっと考えていてくれたんですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Sounds like you've put a lot of thought into it.

fields.EN: There's not much else to do around here.
fields.LOCALIZED: There's not much else to do around here.

fields.EN:
But I appreciate you for accepting me for
who I am. I can't let the others down.
fields.JP:
今の白雪を受け入れて
もらったようでうれしいです
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I appreciate you for accepting me for
who I am. I can't let the others down.

fields.EN:
It's not just for your sake. The other Blood
Maidens count on you too.
fields.JP:
白雪姫だけのことを考えてるわけじゃない。
他の血式少女のことを考えれば当然の判断だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not just for your sake. The other Blood
Maidens count on you too.

fields.EN:
Right, that's good to hear. Thank you.
I appreciate your understanding.
fields.JP:
はい。それでもうれしいです。
ありがとうございます。
姉様たち以外で、理解されたような気がします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, that's good to hear. Thank you.
I appreciate your understanding.

fields.EN:
I thought I understood, but we learn every
day. Glad we could chat. That's all for now.
I'm off.
fields.JP:
……常に理解しているはずなのだが。
ともかく対処法を伝え、すり合わせもできた。
僕の用件は以上だ。　失礼する
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought I understood, but we learn every
day. Glad we could chat. That's all for now.
I'm off.

fields.JP: また良かったらいつでも来てくださいね

fields.EN: Only if I have business with you.
fields.LOCALIZED: Only if I have business with you.

fields.JP: はい。それで結構ですよ、うふふ

fields.EN:
(I'm glad that Shirayuki was satisfied.
Seems she understood my philosophy.)
fields.JP:
（なんにしても白雪も色々と納得できたようだ。
　僕の理論を理解してくれたようでなによりだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad that Snow White was satisfied.
Seems she understood my philosophy.)

fields.EN:
Juu-san, it's Shirayuki.
May I speak with you?
fields.JP:
ジュウさん、白雪です。
少しだけお話いいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, it's Snow White.
May I speak with you?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: その……大した用ではないのですが……

fields.EN: (I was just taking a break anyways...)
fields.JP: （丁度休息を入れていたところだしな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I was just taking a break anyways...)

fields.JP: 忙しかったんじゃありませんか？

fields.EN: Okay, then I'll make it quick!
fields.JP:
では、少しだけお話しますね。
すぐ終わります！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, then I'll make it quick!

fields.EN:
Ever since I heard your plan the other day, Juu-san,
I feel like a weight I've carried for so long has
finally lifted.
fields.JP:
この間のジュウさんの対策を聞いてから、
ずっと抱えていた胸のつかえが取れた気がします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since our chat, I've felt a great weight
has been lifted.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
I think it's because you took on part of what I had
been carrying alone, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
これは白雪が一人で抱えていたものを、
ジュウさんが一部請け負ってくれたからだと
思います
fields.LOCALIZED: And I think it's because of you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: In light of that, it made me quite happy.
fields.JP: そう考えていくと、とても嬉しくなったんです
fields.LOCALIZED: In light of that, it made me quite happy.

fields.EN: *sigh* You always make such a big deal out of things. It wasn't anything so grand. We just divided up the roles.
fields.JP:
はぁ……。　君たちはいつも大げさだ。
そんな大層なもんじゃない。
単なる役割の分担をしただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* So dramatic. It's not that serious.
Consider it an act of duty.

fields.EN:
Glad my analysis wasn't far off, though.
Carry on.
fields.JP:
まぁ僕の分析に間違いはなく、
理解してもらえたようならなによりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad my analysis wasn't far off, though.
Carry on.

fields.EN:
The analysis too, but that's not it. There's another
reason I was happy because of you, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
分析もそうですが。　違うんです。
白雪がジュウさんに嬉しくなった理由は
別にあるんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's not just the analysis. Something
else made me happy too.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
I realized this must be about the 'trust' between
you and me, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
これはきっと白雪とジュウさんの
『信頼』の話なんだと思いました
fields.LOCALIZED: I think it's the trust between us.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
You use that word. Something unseeable
and unquantifiable. How naïve.
fields.JP:
「信頼」なんて見えないものの話をするとは
白雪姫もまだまだ甘いな
fields.LOCALIZED:
You use that word. Something unseeable
and unquantifiable. How naïve.

fields.EN:
Do you hear yourself, Juu-san? The old me
wouldn't be here talking like this.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんは気が付いていますか？
昔のジュウさんなら、この前みたいに
わざわざ白雪の部屋にきて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you hear yourself, Toh? The old me
wouldn't be here talking like this.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジュウ => Toh-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2 | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
And you wouldn't have helped me with my
panic attacks. You wouldn't have taken that
time.
fields.JP:
白雪のパニクりがちになる対応とか、
その過程の説明なんてしないと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
And you wouldn't have helped me with my
panic attacks. You wouldn't have taken that
time.

fields.EN:
I think the old Juu-san would have just barked
orders at me.
fields.JP:
多分……きっと前のジュウさんなら
ただ「命令」してくるだけだったと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think the old Toh would have just barked
orders at me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP:
……確かにそうだ。
そうだな……まったくだ

fields.EN:
I can trust what you say now, Juu-san. And you can
trust that I'll be all right as long as I don't
panic.
fields.JP:
白雪もジュウさんの言葉なら信じられる。
ジュウさんも白雪なら慌てなければ大丈夫
fields.LOCALIZED:
But now, I can trust whatever you say. 
But you also trust that I won't panic.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
That made me think that maybe we
have a mutual understanding.
fields.JP:
あの話はきっとお互い信頼しているから
でてきた案だと思うんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
That made me think that maybe we
have a mutual understanding.

fields.EN: With that said, I had something to say.
fields.JP:
そう思うと白雪はどうしても一言だけ
言いたくて来ちゃいました……
fields.LOCALIZED: With that said, I had something to say.

fields.EN: Juu-san, thank you for putting your faith in me.
fields.JP:
ジュウさん、
白雪を信じてくれてありがとうございます！
これからも白雪らしく頑張っていけそうです！
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, thank you for putting your faith in me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Heh. I see. I guess if that's what you call trust,
then so be it. But...
fields.JP:
ふっ、なるほどそれを信頼といえば、
信頼なのかもしれないな。
ただ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh. I see. I guess if that's what you call trust,
then so be it. But...

fields.EN: Is this what you came to tell me?
fields.JP: それだけのために来たのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Is this what you came to tell me?

fields.EN: I did warn you that it wasn't anything major.
fields.JP:
ふふ、だから言ったじゃないですか。
「大した用ではない」って
fields.LOCALIZED: I did warn you that it wasn't anything major.

fields.EN: Hahaha. True. I appreciate it anyway.
fields.JP:
はははっ、確かに。
ただ面白い話ではあった
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. True. I appreciate it anyway.

fields.EN:
You're not much of a talker, Juu-san, but that's
how I know you mean what you say.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんは言葉はドライですけど、
ジュウさんの考えは「認識」だけじゃなくなって
きてると白雪は思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're not much of a talker, Toh, but that's
how I know you mean what you say.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジュウ => Toh-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2 | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Sounds like all of us are getting the hang
of working as a unit.
fields.JP:
もう、とっくに「認め合う」ってところまで
いってる気がするんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sounds like all of us are getting the hang
of working as a unit.

fields.EN:
We're not exactly chums, but I see what
you mean.
fields.JP:
そこまでいくとオーバーだと思うが、
強く否定することはできないな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not exactly chums, but I see what
you mean.

fields.EN:
(True. I didn't just bark orders. Trust...
Maybe she's onto something.)
fields.JP:
（確かにあれは命令ではなかった
　信頼か……そんなものに共感できる日が
　来るとは不思議だ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(True. I didn't just bark orders. Trust...
Maybe she's onto something.)

fields.EN:
Another example of slow and steady
winning the race.
fields.JP:
今までの関係から導かれる答え……
これも「急がば回れ」ということか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Another example of slow and steady
winning the race.

fields.JP: そうです！　白雪もそう思います！

fields.EN:
That's all I needed for my little errand. Sorry to
bother you, Juu-san, but I feel much better now.
fields.JP:
これで白雪の大したことない用事は以上です。
ジュウさんには申し訳ないのですが、
白雪結構すっきりしちゃいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've said my piece. Sorry for bothering you.
I feel much lighter now.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Right. I've made a discovery of my own.
Thank you.
fields.JP:
ああ、僕も面白い一面を発見できたと思う。
ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. I've made a discovery of my own.
Thank you.

fields.EN: Thank me? Thank you! See you around, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
……ありがとう……
白雪こそいつもありがとうございます！
それじゃジュウさん失礼しますね
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank me? Thank you! See you around, Toh.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Sometimes, growth isn't just a data pattern...
fields.JP:
知識と方程式以外にも成長という概念が
あるとはわかっていたが……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sometimes, growth isn't just a data pattern...

fields.EN:
Sometimes, the best growth comes from
within.
fields.JP: 実際自分の身に起きると嬉しいものだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sometimes, the best growth comes from
within.

fields.EN:
(This book is pretty interesting. 
There are so many different kinds of plants.)
fields.JP:
（この本はかなり面白いな
　いろんな植物が載っている）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This book is pretty interesting. 
There are so many different kinds of plants.)

fields.EN:
(It must have every single plant listed in
here. I should look into this more.)
fields.JP:
（今のところ載っていないものがないぞ。
　もっといろいろと調べていこう、うん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It must have every single plant listed in
here. I should look into this more.)

fields.EN:
(There's Shirayukihime, Oyayubihime, and
Cinderella. What's going on?
They're eating something odd...)
fields.JP:
（白雪姫、親指姫、シンデレラもいるな。
　なんだ？　なにか不思議なものを
　食べているな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(There's Snow White, Thumbelina, and
Cinderella. What's going on?
They're eating something odd...)

fields.EN:
(It's a green circular...fruit? Hope it's
not poisonous.)
fields.JP:
（緑色の丸い……果物……？
　毒なんて入ってないと思うが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's a green circular...fruit? Hope it's
not poisonous.)

fields.EN:
*chomp* *chomp*... This is so delicious!
I've never eaten anything like it!
fields.JP:
パクパクパク……とっても美味しいですね！
初めての味です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*chomp* *chomp*... This is so delicious!
I've never eaten anything like it!

fields.EN: I think it's good for your skin.
fields.JP: お肌にも良さそうな食べ物ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I think it's good for your skin.

fields.EN:
It's not that sweet, but it's pretty addicting.
I could go for another, but we've got plenty.
fields.JP:
甘くはないけど、クセになる味だわ。
確かにもう一つくらいいけそうだけど……
結構な数が取れたのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not that sweet, but it's pretty addicting.
I could go for another, but we've got plenty.

fields.EN:
According to Jabberwock-san, there's a grove
with a bunch of them nearby.
fields.JP:
ジャバウォックさんが言うには、
大量に生えているところを見つけたそうです
fields.LOCALIZED:
According to Jabberwock, there's a grove
with a bunch of them nearby.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN: Explains how we've been eating so well.
fields.JP: それで、こんなに山のようにあるんですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Explains how we've been eating so well.

fields.EN: Yup, and they're ripe! Perfectly in season!
fields.JP:
はい。　しかも今白雪たちが食べているのは、
とてもいい感じに熟成したものらしく、
食べ頃みたいです！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yup, and they're ripe! Perfectly in season!

fields.JP: じゃあ、わたしももう一つ貰おうかしら
わたくしも、もう１個もらっちゃいますわ！

fields.EN:
Oh, Juu-san! Would you like to try some?
It's delicious. Come over here.
fields.JP:
あ、ジュウさん！　
ジュウさんもこちらにきて食べませんか？
美味しいですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Toh! Would you like to try some?
It's delicious. Come over here.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ジュウ => Toh-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2 | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Hm... I don't mind if I do.
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm... I don't mind if I do.

fields.EN:
Here you go. There is a big seed in the center,
so watch out okay?
fields.JP:
はい、どうぞ。
真ん中に大きな種がありますから
気をつけてくださいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here you go. There is a big seed in the center,
so watch out okay?

fields.EN: The flesh is very droopy and thick.
fields.JP: まわりがとろりと濃厚ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: The flesh is very droopy and thick.

fields.EN:
Oh. I've never tasted anything like this
but it's slimy. Wonderful flavor.
fields.JP:
ほー、確かにこれは初めての味わいだが、
なかなか美味しいな。
ねっとりしているところが面白い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. I've never tasted anything like this
but it's slimy. Wonderful flavor.

fields.EN: But it's so rich, one's enough for me.
fields.JP: しかし、濃厚過ぎて、ひとつで十分だな
fields.LOCALIZED: But it's so rich, one's enough for me.

fields.EN:
Interesting. You eat like a bird. Three is more
than enough for me.
fields.JP:
へー、見た目通り小食なのね。
ただ、わたしも３個食べれば十分かも
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interesting. You eat like a bird. Three is more
than enough for me.

fields.JP: わたくしも３個くらいが丁度いいですわね

fields.EN: Aah. Yummy. But we've got even more.
fields.JP:
はー、美味しかった。
でも、まだたくさんあるのよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Aah. Yummy. But we've got even more.

fields.JP:
パクパクパク……んふ……美味しいです。
パクパクパク……
あれ？　白雪さんは、まだ食べますの？

fields.EN: There's a bunch. Are you both done?
fields.JP:
まだたくさんありますよ。
みなさん、もう食べないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: There's a bunch. Are you both done?

fields.EN: How many have you eaten, Shirayuki?
fields.LOCALIZED: How many have you eaten, Snow White?

fields.EN: Not too many. That was my sixth.
fields.JP:
白雪なんて、まだまだです。
これでようやく６つ目ですから
fields.LOCALIZED: Not too many. That was my sixth.

fields.JP: パクパクパク……んん……幸せです～

む、む、むっつ！！
流石に、そんなは食べすぎよ……
そうですわねえ。ちょっとだけ食べすぎですわ

fields.EN: Yeah. If you eat too much, you'll get fat.
fields.JP: そうそう、食べ過ぎたら太っちゃうわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. If you eat too much, you'll get fat.

fields.EN:
Right. What was I thinking? I couldn't help
myself.
fields.JP:
そ、そうですね。白雪ったら、なんてことを……
思わず美味しすぎてついつい
食べすぎてしまいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. What was I thinking? I couldn't help
myself.

fields.EN: What have I done? I feel terrible.
fields.JP:
ああ、どうしてこんなに
食べてしまったのでしょう……反省します
fields.LOCALIZED: What have I done? I feel terrible.

fields.EN:
It's a fruit. They're generally low in calories
and high in nutrients, so don't sweat it.
fields.JP:
恐らくこれは果物だと思う。
果物は基本カロリーが低いはずだから大丈夫だろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a fruit. They're generally low in calories
and high in nutrients, so don't sweat it.

fields.EN: Yes. Jabberwock-san did say it was a fruit.
fields.JP:
はい。ジャバウォックさんも果物と
言ってました！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. Jabberwock did say it was a fruit.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN:
Then you should be good.
Aren't you happy, Shirayuki?
fields.JP:
それなら大丈夫じゃない？
良かったわね。　白雪
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then you should be good.
Aren't you happy, Snow White?

fields.EN: Then I guess I'll eat one more then.
fields.JP: それならわたくしも後でもう一つ食べますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then I guess I'll eat one more then.

fields.EN: I don't want them to rot. Maybe one more...
fields.JP:
まだまだありますし、腐ってももったいないので、
あと少し……あと少しだけ頂いちゃいますね
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't want them to rot. Maybe one more...

fields.JP:
パクパク……パクパクパク……
んふ……美味しいです……！

fields.EN: My, I just can't get enough.
fields.JP: はあ、食べても食べても飽きません
fields.LOCALIZED: My, I just can't get enough.

fields.EN:
I can't believe how many there are!
I'm in bliss.
fields.JP:
こんな美味しいものが山のようにあるなんて！
この世の春を謳歌しています
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't believe how many there are!
I'm in bliss.

fields.EN:
I wonder what fruit it is. Actually, I have
this plant encyclopedia.
fields.JP:
しかし、この果物は何だろうな？
ああ、そういえばちょうど
植物図鑑を持ってるんだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what fruit it is. Actually, I have
this plant encyclopedia.

fields.JP: 白雪姫、これは何という名前の果物だ？

はい。ジャバウォックさんは「アボカド」と
言ってました
