fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.JP: アボカドか……アボカド、アボカド……

fields.EN: What'd you find? Is it in there?
fields.JP: どうですか？　載ってますか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What'd you find? Is it in there?

fields.EN:
Oh, here it is. Avocado. Oh, it's a fruit.
It helps with skincare.
fields.JP:
……あった。アボカド……
ん？　あー、これは……やはり果物らしい。
美容にもいいと書いてある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, here it is. Avocado. Oh, it's a fruit.
It helps with skincare.

fields.EN: Delicious, and great for the skin. What a deal.
fields.JP:
美味しいのに美容にも
いいなんて素晴らしいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Delicious, and great for the skin. What a deal.

fields.JP: それならまた後で食べちゃおうかしら

fields.EN: (Calories... 300 kcal each... Isn't that high for a fruit? I think the recommended daily intake for an adult man is...)
fields.JP:
（カロリーが……1つ300kcal……
　果物にしてはカロリーが高くないか？
　確か成人男性の1日の摂取推奨カロリーが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa. 300 calories per avocado.
Maybe I was mistaken...)

fields.EN:
*nom nom* Thank goodness I can eat as
many as I want!
fields.JP:
パクパクパク……
こんな時にこんなにおいしいものが
食べられるなんて白雪は幸せ者です
fields.LOCALIZED:
*nom nom* Thank goodness I can eat as
many as I want!

fields.EN:
Look how happy she looks. It makes me
smile.
fields.JP:
ほんっと幸せそうに食べるわね。
わたしも見てて幸せな気分になるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look how happy she looks. It makes me
smile.

fields.EN: You're right. Jabberwock-san would be pleased.
fields.JP:
本当ですわね。
ジャバウォックさんも喜びますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: You're right. Jabberwock would be pleased.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャバウォックさん => Jabberwock-san

fields.EN:
(My wife used to fret over every calorie.
But I won't say anything...)
fields.JP:
（妻もカロリーの話題は嫌いだったからな。
　今は黙っておこう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(My wife used to fret over every calorie.
But I won't say anything...)

fields.EN: Well, I'll be on my way.
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I'll be on my way.

fields.EN:
*chomp* *chomp*... *nom nom nom*...
I just can't get enough. Ah. Yummy.
fields.JP:
パクパクパク……パクパクパク……
美味しいです、とても美味しいです。
はあ、しあわせです
fields.LOCALIZED:
*chomp* *chomp*... *nom nom nom*...
I just can't get enough. Ah. Yummy.

fields.JP:
誰ぞ～……誰ぞ～。
おりませぬか～？

fields.EN: (Is that Kaguyahime? I wonder what's wrong.)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫の声か？
　中で何かあったのだろうか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Is that Kaguya? I wonder what's wrong.)

fields.EN: I heard you outside. Did something happen?
fields.JP:
外まで声が聞こえていたが、
何か起きたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: I heard you outside. Did something happen?

fields.JP:
おおっ、ジュウさん。
ちょうどいいところに～
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: You're lying down. Are you ill?
fields.JP:
横たわっていたようだが、
具合でも悪いのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: You're lying down. Are you ill?

fields.JP: いいえ？　わらわは至って健康です～

fields.EN:
(She looks normal. Her room is tiny, but
cluttered.)
fields.JP:
（健康なのに、寝そべったままのかぐや姫。
　そして、所狭しとガラクタが散乱する部屋）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She looks normal. Her room is tiny, but
cluttered.)

fields.JP:
（そして、先程の“ちょうどいいところに”
　という言葉）

fields.EN:
(Oh goodness. What scheme did I just
walk into?)
fields.JP:
（そこから導き出される答えは……つまり、
　来た者を利用しようと考えていたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh goodness. What scheme did I just
walk into?)

fields.JP:
あっ！　ま、待って！
いきなり帰ろうとしないで下さい～！
せめて、わらわの話くらい聞いて下さい～！

fields.EN: Thank you. Actually, I had a favor to ask of you.
fields.JP:
ありがとうございます～
実は大切なお願いがあって声を掛けたんです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you. Actually, I had a favor to ask of you.

fields.JP: （十中八九、くだらない内容だと思うが）
よくぞ聞いてくれました～！

そこに置いてある飲み物を、
わらわのために取って下さい～

fields.EN: (Wow. It was even dumber than I anticipated.)
fields.JP:
（やれやれ、想像していた以上に、
　くだらない願いだったな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Wow. It was even dumber than I anticipated.)

fields.JP:
という訳で～
さっそく、お願いします～

fields.EN:
No. I told you that I would hear you out,
but I never said I would do it for you.
fields.JP:
いや、僕は話を聞くとは言ったが、
願いを聞くとは言っていない
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. I told you that I would hear you out,
but I never said I would do it for you.

fields.EN:
What?! That is so cruel. I wasted my breath
then.
fields.JP:
ええ～っ！　そんな殺生な、
聞かせ損じゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! That is so cruel. I wasted my breath
then.

fields.EN: It's right there, isn't it? This isn't something you should need to ask someone else to get.
fields.JP:
すぐそこにある物を取るだけだろう？
人に頼むような内容じゃないはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Fetching your beverage isn't worth my time.

fields.EN: But I have to get up for it.
fields.JP:
だって、そのためには起きあがらないと
いけないじゃないですか～
fields.LOCALIZED: But I have to get up for it.

fields.JP: そんな面倒なこと、わらわには出来ません

fields.EN:
In the time you spent asking me, you could
have done it by now.
fields.JP:
いちいち人を呼び止めて
頼む方が面倒だと思うんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In the time you spent asking me, you could
have done it by now.

fields.EN: I prefer not to move as much as possible.
fields.JP: わらわは、極力動きたくないのです～
fields.LOCALIZED: I prefer not to move as much as possible.

fields.EN: If I could do everything lying down, I would.
fields.JP:
全ての事が寝たまま出来たら、
控えめに言って、最の高です～
fields.LOCALIZED: If I could do everything lying down, I would.

fields.EN: So even getting a drink can be a task.
fields.JP:
そんなわらわにとって、立って飲み物を
取ってくるという行為が、いかに大変か……
fields.LOCALIZED: So even getting a drink can be a task.

fields.EN: You don't get it, Juu-san... Boohoo.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんはご存じないのです～
……よよよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't get it, Toh... Boohoo.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
(She's even prepared crocodile tears.
Is she THAT lazy?)
fields.JP:
（嘘泣き用の目薬まで用意しておきながら、
　自分から動くのは面倒くさいのだろうか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's even prepared crocodile tears.
Is she THAT lazy?)

fields.EN:
All that fake crying, and still no drink in
your hand.
fields.JP:
いや、そうやって嘘泣きをするよりも、
自分で取りに行った方がやはり早いのでは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All that fake crying, and still no drink in
your hand.

fields.EN: Agh. Even my angel tears won't work on him.
fields.JP:
くっ、わらわの十八番である、
通称『天使の涙』が効かないとは～
fields.LOCALIZED: Agh. Even my angel tears won't work on him.

fields.EN: You're a tough nut to crack, Juu-san.
fields.JP: ジュウさんは手強いです～
fields.LOCALIZED: You're a tough nut to crack, Toh.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: No one would fall for it.
fields.JP: 僕じゃなくても騙されないと思うが
fields.LOCALIZED: No one would fall for it.

fields.EN:
I wanted you to fall for it even if it was a lie~
So, Juu-san, please get me a drink~
fields.JP:
そこは嘘でも騙されて欲しかったです～。
だからジュウさん、飲み物取って下さい～
fields.LOCALIZED: Just do it for me. Pretty please.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: What part of no don't you understand?
fields.JP:
なぜそこで『だから』になるのか理解に
苦しむが、断る
fields.LOCALIZED: What part of no don't you understand?

fields.EN:
Oogh. You're so mean, Juu-san. All you have to
do is reach over there.
fields.JP:
ううっ、ジュウさんのいけず～
ちょーっと動いて取ってくれたらいいのに～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh. You're so mean, Toh. All you have to
do is reach over there.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: 自分でそうする事は考えないのか？

fields.EN: (She's dead set on being a deadbeat.)
fields.JP:
（何が何でも自分では動かないという、
　鋼のような信念すら感じるんだが）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's dead set on being a deadbeat.)

fields.EN: (To be honest, I'm getting a headache.)
fields.JP:
（正直なところ、この不毛なやりとりを
　続けるのは疲れる）
fields.LOCALIZED: (To be honest, I'm getting a headache.)

fields.JP: あら、ジュウさん、お疲れのようですね～
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: We could do this all day.
fields.JP:
でも、こうしていては、いつまで経っても
埒が明かないですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED: We could do this all day.

fields.EN: Isn't that supposed to be my line?
fields.JP: それは僕が言うべきセリフじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ever think you might be responsible for that?

fields.EN:
Besides, this would already be over if you'd brought
it to me while we were talking, Juu-san~
fields.JP:
そもそも、こうしている間にジュウさんが
持って来てくれれば終わる話ですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if you'd gotten it for me, we wouldn't
be here.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: (She's right. I want this to be over already.)
fields.JP:
（……確かにその通りだ。今の僕の目的は
　この面倒な局面を乗り切る事だ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's right. I want this to be over already.)

fields.EN: (It's best that I give her what she wants.)
fields.JP:
（それなら、さっさと用事を済ませる事が最善。
　だが……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It's best that I give her what she wants.)

fields.EN: Now now. Now that you understand, go get it.
fields.JP:
ささ、そうと決まれば
早くそれを取って下さい～
fields.LOCALIZED: Now now. Now that you understand, go get it.

fields.EN: No, I refuse. I have no obligation.
fields.JP:
いや、断る。
根本的に僕がこの話を聞く理由がない
fields.LOCALIZED: No, I refuse. I have no obligation.

fields.EN:
And if I do it once, I'll have to do it again in
the future.
fields.JP:
それに今回願いを聞くことで
今後も同じ要求をされても困るからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if I do it once, I'll have to do it again in
the future.

fields.JP: そんな！　なんて冷たい人でしょう～

fields.EN: (I should ignore her and walk off.)
fields.JP:
（このまま不毛な話をするくらいなら無視して
　立ち去ることが一番効率が良いだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I should ignore her and walk off.)

fields.EN:
(Not that my wife would approve of the
practice...)
fields.JP:
（……ただ、例えどんなに不毛な話でも、
　無視は良くないと、以前妻が言っていた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that my wife would approve of the
practice...)

fields.EN: (But no matter how much I think about it, I have no reason to hear her out on this...)
fields.JP:
（ただ、この件に関しては、いくら考えても
　僕に話を聞く理由がない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I have to stand my ground. This request
is asinine.)

fields.EN:
If you have time to think, then
please hurry and get it for me!
fields.JP:
だから～、考え事をする暇があったら、
早く取って下さい～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you have time to think, then
please hurry and get it for me!

fields.EN: I heard an argument, so I came over.
fields.JP:
なにか言い争いが聞こえたので
来てみたのですが
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: 何か凄く不毛な争いをしている気がします……

fields.EN: I have a feeling I don't belong here...
fields.JP:
わたくしが入ったら更に
ややこしくなりそうな気がしますね
fields.LOCALIZED: I have a feeling I don't belong here...

fields.JP:
…………。
お、お二人共頑張って下さい～！

fields.EN: This plant is interesting. Is this mimicry?
fields.JP:
この植物は興味深い。
擬態化されたものだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED: This plant is interesting. Is this mimicry?

fields.JP: こちらの花と一緒に調べてみるとしよう

あ、ジュウさんを発見～
……丁度いいですね～
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Oh, dear me. I suddenly feel fatigued.
fields.JP:
ああっ……どうしたものやら。
身体が急にだるくなって来たです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, dear me. I suddenly feel fatigued.

fields.EN:
(She went from chipper to winded in
seconds.)
fields.JP:
（さっきまで元気そうだったのに、
　急に座り込んだみたいだが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She went from chipper to winded in
seconds.)

fields.JP: ここから、もう一歩も動けそうにないです～

fields.EN:
How will I ever make it back to the tent?
What do I do?
fields.JP:
このままでは、テントに戻れないです～
とっても困りました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
How will I ever make it back to the tent?
What do I do?

fields.EN: (Oh, she's looking here. Just ignore her.)
fields.JP:
（うっ、あからさまに僕を見ているな。
　あまり関わりたくはないのだが）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh, she's looking here. Just ignore her.)

fields.JP:
はう～、すっごくだるいです～
ちらっ、ちらっ

fields.EN: (Must ignore her, must resist the urge...)
fields.JP:
（無視という選択肢もあるが……
　妻には良い顔をされないだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Must ignore her, must resist the urge...)

fields.EN: Aren't you tired of being tired all the time?
fields.JP:
だるいと言っているが、
君にとってはいつもの事じゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aren't you tired of being tired all the time?

fields.EN:
Not all the time. I just feel it today
especially.
fields.JP:
そんな事ないです～
いつも以上に動きたくないと言うか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not all the time. I just feel it today
especially.

fields.EN: If your body really feels that sluggish, shouldn't you hurry back to the tent and rest?
fields.JP:
本当に身体がだるいのなら、
早くテントに戻って休めばいいのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED: If you're tired, then go to sleep.

fields.EN: I can't. My Blood Libido's ZOOMING!
fields.JP:
無理です～
わらわの血式リビドーがＭＡＸです～
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't. My Blood Libido's ZOOMING!

fields.EN:
(If this is zooming, I wonder what her
extremes look like.)
fields.JP:
（ふむ、血式リビドーがＭＡＸと言われると
　強弱があるのか興味が湧いてしまうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If this is zooming, I wonder what her
extremes look like.)

fields.EN:
You seem perfectly fine. Are some days
harder than others?
fields.JP:
いつもとそう変わらないような気がするが、
強弱があるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You seem perfectly fine. Are some days
harder than others?

fields.EN: Of course. It happens every day.
fields.JP:
もちろんです～
わらわの血式リビドーはいつでもですけど
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. It happens every day.

fields.JP: もう、しんどい時は本当にすごいんですから～

fields.EN: You do seem more fatigued than usual.
fields.JP: 確かに、いつも以上に気だるそうに見えるが
fields.LOCALIZED: You do seem more fatigued than usual.

fields.JP:
（もしかすると、ホルモンバランスが
　関係しているのだろうか？）

ちなみに、具体的にはどういった時に
血式リビドーが強まるんだ？
ん～、運動をした後は特にだるいです～

fields.EN: Or when I've gone outside, but going back to the tent feels like too much effort.
fields.JP:
あと、外に出たのはいいけれど、テントに
戻るのがしんどいな～、っていう時とか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sometimes I can hardly drag myself out
of bed.

fields.EN:
I wish someone would carry me as I sleep.
That'd be heavenly.
fields.JP:
寝てたら誰かが勝手に運んでくれたらいいな～
って思うような時は、最高潮に高まりますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wish someone would carry me as I sleep.
That'd be heavenly.

fields.EN:
(I see. Her laziness is because of her
Libido.)
fields.JP:
（……なるほど、本当に面倒だと思う気持ちと、
　リビドーが相乗効果的になっているようだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. Her laziness is because of her
Libido.)

fields.EN:
In conclusion, your whims are merely the
fluctuations of your Libido.
fields.JP:
結論から言えば、単に君の『気分次第』で
リビドーの強弱が出ている可能性が高いな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In conclusion, your whims are merely the
fluctuations of your Libido.

fields.EN: I understand. Well, I'll be on my way.
fields.JP:
原因はよく分かった。
では、僕はこれで……
fields.LOCALIZED: I understand. Well, I'll be on my way.

fields.JP:
ええ～！　勝手に１人で納得して、
さっさと去ろうとしないでください～！

fields.EN:
You heard my story, so now you should
carry me back to my tent.
fields.JP:
わらわの話を聞いたんですから、
恩返しにテントまで連れて行って下さい～
fields.LOCALIZED:
You heard my story, so now you should
carry me back to my tent.

fields.EN: Why on earth would I do that?
fields.JP:
いや、ただ会話をしただけなのに
恩返しを求められても……
fields.LOCALIZED: Why on earth would I do that?

fields.EN:
I refuse to relent, and if you make me do
it, I'll never speak to you again.
fields.JP:
本当にそんな事になったら、
今後は君とは何も話せなくなるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I refuse to relent, and if you make me do
it, I'll never speak to you again.

fields.JP: はう、そ、それは困りました～

fields.EN:
Besides, it's always all about your feelings.
Learn how to fend for yourself.
fields.JP:
それに、気の持ちようだと言っただろう。
戻ろうと思えば、自力で戻れるはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Besides, it's always all about your feelings.
Learn how to fend for yourself.

fields.EN: You don't even have to walk to get around.
fields.JP:
第一、君にはいつも移動に使っている
それがあるだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't even have to walk to get around.

fields.EN:
Yes, this is 'Bamboo No. 1.' Want to try operating
it, Juu-san~?
fields.JP:
はい、この『バンブー１号』ですね。
ジュウさん、操作してみますか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh yes, Bamboo One. Want to try it?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Maybe if you give it a whirl, you'll understand
me better.
fields.JP:
これを外から操作すれば、わらわに対しての
理解が、更に深まるかもしれないですよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe if you give it a whirl, you'll understand
me better.

fields.JP:
なに？　それは外部から操作出来る物
だったのか？

fields.EN: (I thought she moved it with her mind.)
fields.JP:
（てっきり、彼女の意思で動く物だと
　思っていた）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I thought she moved it with her mind.)

fields.EN:
Use this controller, and it'll go wherever
you tell it to.
fields.JP:
ここにある、操作ボタンをちょいと動かせば、
誰でもこの『バンブー１号』を操れるのです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use this controller, and it'll go wherever
you tell it to.

fields.EN: (My curiosity is piqued. How does it work?)
fields.JP:
（うむ、これがどういう仕組みで
　動いているのか、僕の研究欲が刺激される）
fields.LOCALIZED: (My curiosity is piqued. How does it work?)

fields.EN:
(I want to test it out, but I feel like this is
one of Kaguyahime's schemes.)
fields.JP:
（操作して調べてみたい。
　だが、それがかぐや姫の
　策略だということもわかる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to test it out, but I feel like this is
one of Kaguya's schemes.)

fields.JP: どうです？　ちょっと弄ってみませんか～？

fields.EN:
Push this button to move forward, and turn
with this stick.
fields.JP:
ちなみに、このボタンを押すと前進で、
曲がりたい時は、こちらのボタンです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Push this button to move forward, and turn
with this stick.

fields.EN: (Very well. For research purposes, I shall.)
fields.JP:
（……やむを得ない、これも研究のため。
　真実を知るためには必要な行為）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Very well. For research purposes, I shall.)

fields.JP: わ、分かった、今回限りだからな

fields.EN: Very well. Let's head over to my tent!
fields.JP:
はいは～い、それでは、
わらわのテントに向けて全速前進～
fields.LOCALIZED: Very well. Let's head over to my tent!

fields.EN: You're a natural, Juu-san. Go go go!
fields.JP:
ジュウさん、操作がお上手ですね～
わらわも楽ちんです～
fields.LOCALIZED: You're a natural, Toh. Go go go!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: (It's a machine. How is she THIS lazy?)
fields.JP:
（ボタンを操作するだけなのに、
　それすら人に任せようとするとは）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It's a machine. How is she THIS lazy?)

fields.JP: どうにも腑に落ちない……

（音と共に、勝手に入り口が開いたぞ。
　この仕掛けはいったい……？）

あ、ジュウさんですか～、
ちょうどよかったです
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: かぐや姫か……やはり君の仕業か

fields.EN: What are you doing? I have a hunch though.
fields.JP:
なんでまたこんな事を……
いや、大体察してはいるが
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you doing? I have a hunch though.

fields.EN: If you do, this'll be quick.
fields.JP: 察しているのならば話は早いです～
fields.LOCALIZED: If you do, this'll be quick.

fields.EN:
Please come this way and pick up that
book for me. It's right near the entrance.
fields.JP:
こっちに来て、そこの本を拾って下さい～
入り口のすぐ近くにありますから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please come this way and pick up that
book for me. It's right near the entrance.

fields.EN: (Even if she beckons me over, I don't have any reason to pick up that book.)
fields.JP:
（いや、手招きされても困るし、
　僕が本を拾う理由もないのだが）
ところで、この仕掛けは一体なんなんだ？

fields.EN:
Oh, you're ignoring my request.
You are mean as usual.
fields.JP:
あ、わらわの頼みはスルーですか。
相変わらずいけずですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're ignoring my request.
You are mean as usual.

fields.EN: But I'll tell you what it's about.
fields.JP:
でも、そこまで知りたいのなら、
教えて差し上げましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED: But I'll tell you what it's about.

fields.EN:
It's one of my special seven tools. It's called
the "Bell of Invitation."
fields.JP:
これは、わらわの『サボり七つ道具』の１つ、
通称『招きの鈴』です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's one of my special seven tools. It's called
the "Bell of Invitation."

fields.JP: 『招きの鈴』……名前まで付けているのか

fields.EN: Yes, I made them through much trial and error.
fields.JP:
はい、試行錯誤を重ねて作った、
わらわの大切な『サボり七つ道具』ですから～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, I made them through much trial and error.

fields.EN:
(She puts so much effort into her schemes,
but can't bring herself to execute them.)
fields.JP:
（仕掛けを用意する労力は惜しまないのに、
　なぜそれをサボるために使うのだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She puts so much effort into her schemes,
but can't bring herself to execute them.)

fields.EN: What do you think? Impressive, huh?
fields.JP: どうです？　すごいでしょう～
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you think? Impressive, huh?

fields.EN:
If you pull this string, it rings, opening the
entrance so people can do me favors.
fields.JP:
この紐を引っ張ると、音と共に入り口が開いて、
人にお願いを聞いてもらえるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you pull this string, it rings, opening the
entrance so people can do me favors.

fields.EN: (She draws people in with her bell.)
fields.JP:
（音で引き寄せて同時に扉を開けば、
　人は何かあると思って覗きに来る）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She draws people in with her bell.)

fields.JP: （妙に心理的なものを考慮した装置だな）

fields.EN:
Now that I've explained it, please fetch my
book.
fields.JP:
では、解説も無事に済んだところで、
さっそく、本を拾って下さい～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that I've explained it, please fetch my
book.

fields.EN:
I refuse. I just happened to pass by.
I have no reason to comply.
fields.JP:
断る。たまたま通りがかっただけなのに、
僕がそうする理由がない
fields.LOCALIZED:
I refuse. I just happened to pass by.
I have no reason to comply.

fields.EN: Hmph. Juu-san, you always deny my requests.
fields.JP:
む～、ジュウさんは理由が無いからと言って、
いつもわらわのお願いを拒否しますね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Hmph. Toh, you always deny my requests.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Well, if I feel the urge to help, then I'll
let you know.
fields.JP:
それは、願いの内容にもよるだろう。
僕だって、必要だと感じれば手を貸すさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, if I feel the urge to help, then I'll
let you know.

fields.EN:
But your requests are nothing more than
gestures which cater to your laziness.
fields.JP:
だが、君のする願いというのは、大半が人に
手伝いを求める必要がないものばかりだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But your requests are nothing more than
gestures which cater to your laziness.

fields.EN: You can't blame me for my spoiled upbringing.
fields.JP:
え～、わらわが快適に過ごすためには、
どれも必要なことばかりですけど～？
fields.LOCALIZED: You can't blame me for my spoiled upbringing.

fields.EN: I don't understand... I can't find any reason to help you.
fields.JP:
僕には理解できないな……
手を貸す理由が全く見つからない
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't get it. I CAN blame you.

fields.EN: If Jack was here, he'd do it.
fields.JP:
ジャックなら、わらわがお願いしたら
いつでもやってくれたんですけどね～
fields.LOCALIZED: If Jack was here, he'd do it.

fields.JP: （むっ……今、その名前を出すのか）

fields.EN:
He never hesitates to do anything I ask
of him.
fields.JP:
困ったと言うと、ジャックはいつも
わらわを手伝ってくれたんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
He never hesitates to do anything I ask
of him.

fields.EN: I see. Jack sounds like a real pushover.
fields.JP:
なるほど。君が言うジャックという人物は、
よほどのお人良しなのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. Jack sounds like a real pushover.

fields.EN:
Unfortunately for you, I'm not Jack.
I am not your servant.
fields.JP:
残念だが、僕はジャックと言うやつじゃない。
君の家来とは違うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Unfortunately for you, I'm not Jack.
I am not your servant.

fields.EN:
That's right. He might have waited on you
hand and foot, but I'm different.
fields.JP:
そうだ。彼は僕とは違って、家来のように
何でも君の言うことを聞くのだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's right. He might have waited on you
hand and foot, but I'm different.

fields.EN: Ugh! So rude, Juu-san! Jack is no servant!
fields.JP:
むぅ、ジュウさん、失礼です～！
ジャックは家来なんかじゃないです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh! So rude, Toh! Jack is no servant!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: And I never asked him to be!
fields.JP:
わらわも、そんなつもりでジャックに
お願いしたことなんて、一度もないです！
fields.LOCALIZED: And I never asked him to be!

fields.EN:
It's also possible that the person making the
requests never realized they were doing it.
fields.JP:
頼んでいた本人にその自覚がなかった、
ということも考えられる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, maybe because he doesn't have the
spine to push back.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
If you insist upon asking others to do your
bidding, then expect rejection too.
fields.JP:
自分で動かず人にやらせたいというのなら、
その方法を変えるべきだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you insist upon asking others to do your
bidding, then expect rejection too.

fields.EN:
You spend all day creating these ploys
to goad people into taking care of you.
fields.JP:
他の誰かを顎で使うために、
こんな下らない装置を発明するくらいなら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You spend all day creating these ploys
to goad people into taking care of you.

fields.EN:
Perhaps your energy is better served
finding this Jack.
fields.JP:
そうやっている間にも、ジャックというやつを
見つけ出すために動くべきだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps your energy is better served
finding this Jack.

fields.EN: Wouldn't it be more useful for you to meet back up with him and work him hard like before?
fields.JP:
彼と合流して、今までのようにこき使った方が、
君にとっても有益ではないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The sooner you find him, the sooner you can
indulge your mindless whims.

fields.JP:
……っ、もういいですっ、
それ以上、聞きたくないです

fields.EN: Out of my tent this instant!
fields.JP: すぐにテントから出て行って下さい！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Out of my tent this instant!

fields.JP: ああ、そうさせて貰うとしよう
……かぐや姫は、珍しく本気で怒っていたな

fields.EN: (Sounds like Jack means a lot to her.)
fields.JP:
（それほどまでに、ジャックという人物は、
　彼女にとって大事な者なのだろうか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Sounds like Jack means a lot to her.)

fields.JP:
…………。
いや、僕には関係のないことだが

fields.EN:
(But maybe I took what she said about
Jack personally.)
fields.JP:
（僕も、ジャックというやつと比較されて、
　少しカッとしてしまったようだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But maybe I took what she said about
Jack personally.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe I was out of line. I wonder what
got into me.)
fields.JP:
（あんな言い争いをするなんて、非効率だ。
　僕らしくもない……なぜこうなった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I was out of line. I wonder what
got into me.)

fields.EN: (It was rude of me to call him a servant.)
fields.JP:
（知らない人物を家来呼ばわりしたのは、
　確かに言い過ぎたかも知れない）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It was rude of me to call him a servant.)

fields.EN: (But what she was doing to Jack wasn't much different from treating him like a servant, was it?)
fields.JP:
（だが、彼女がジャックに対してやっていたのは、
　家来扱いとそう変わらないんじゃないのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (But wasn't she out of line too...?)

fields.EN: (Does she have some firm conviction inside her that tells her that's absolutely not the case?)
fields.JP:
（絶対にそうではないという、
　確固たる何かが彼女の中にあるのだろうか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Or does she have some underlying reason
which I just disregarded?)

fields.EN: *sigh*... She'll always be a mystery to me.
fields.JP:
……はぁ。彼女の独特の理論を聞いていると、
どうにもペースを乱される
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh*... She'll always be a mystery to me.

fields.JP:
（それに、さっきから感じる
　この奇妙な感覚はなんだ……）

fields.EN: (That was out of character. Now I feel bad.)
fields.JP:
（らしくない事をしたせいか、
　やけに胸がチクチクするな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That was out of character. Now I feel bad.)

fields.EN:
(I wonder why I got so irritated with Kaguyahime
the other day.)
fields.JP:
（なぜ、僕はあの時……かぐや姫の発言に
　苛立ちを覚えたんだろう？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder why I got so irritated with Kaguya
the other day.)

fields.EN:
(When she compared me with Jack, 
I lost my cool.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックという者と自分を比べられた時、
　つい僕らしくもない態度を取ってしまった）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When she compared me with Jack, 
I lost my cool.)

fields.EN: (Maybe because she compared me to a stranger.)
fields.JP:
（やはり、自分がよく知らない人間と
　比較されたからだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Maybe because she compared me to a stranger.)

fields.EN:
(But after giving it some thought, I realized
it was for nothing.)
fields.JP:
（だが、あれから色々考えてみたが、
　これだという理由が思い当たらない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But after giving it some thought, I realized
it was for nothing.)

fields.EN:
(I want to understand why this is. 
Would speaking to Kaguyahime help?)
fields.JP:
（なぜそうなるのか、謎を解明したい。
　かぐや姫に聞いたら、答えが出るだろうか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I want to understand why this is. 
Would speaking to Kaguya help?)

fields.JP:
ではさっそく、
あ、いや、待てよ

fields.EN: She's the one who was angered with me.
fields.JP:
彼女は僕の発言に対して、
怒っていたのだった
fields.LOCALIZED: She's the one who was angered with me.

fields.EN: Calling him a servant was harsh, but...
fields.JP:
確かに、家来というのは言い過ぎたと思う。
しかし……
fields.LOCALIZED: Calling him a servant was harsh, but...

fields.EN: It's not fair to make others do your bidding.
fields.JP:
面倒な事を押しつける相手、という意味では、
あながち間違っていないと思うのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not fair to make others do your bidding.

fields.EN: But maybe she sees it differently. Hm.
fields.JP:
どうも彼女的には違うようだ。
……うーむ
fields.LOCALIZED: But maybe she sees it differently. Hm.

fields.EN:
This issue is hard. However, I don't like
being without an answer.
fields.JP:
この問題、やはり僕には難しいな。
しかし、答えが出ないままでは気持ちが悪い
fields.LOCALIZED:
This issue is hard. However, I don't like
being without an answer.

fields.EN:
So the fastest resolution is to ask Kaguyahime 
personally.
fields.JP:
やはり、最短の解決策として、
かぐや姫に直接聞いてみるしかないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
So the fastest resolution is to ask Kaguya 
personally.

fields.EN: Your tent's open. Kaguyahime, I am coming in.
fields.JP:
入り口が開いている……
かぐや姫、失礼するぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Your tent's open. Kaguya, I am coming in.

fields.EN: Juu-san... You have business with me?
fields.JP: ジュウさん……わらわに何の用です？
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh... You have business with me?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: (She's acting cold. I guess she's angry.)
fields.JP:
（このそっけない態度。やはり僕に対して、
　思うところがあるようだな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's acting cold. I guess she's angry.)

fields.EN: Well, I guess I've come to apologize.
fields.JP: ひとまず、前回の謝罪をするために来た
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I guess I've come to apologize.

fields.EN:
Yeah. I apologize for calling Jack a servant.
I went too far.
fields.JP:
ああ、僕がジャックを家来だと言った件は、
君にとって、言い過ぎに値するのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. I apologize for calling Jack a servant.
I went too far.

fields.EN:
But I don't understand why you snapped
at me.
fields.JP:
なぜあの時君がそう言われて怒ったのか、
正直なところ、僕には理解できなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I don't understand why you snapped
at me.

fields.EN: If I offended you, I apologize.
fields.JP:
だが、君を怒らせてしまった事は事実だ。
すまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED: If I offended you, I apologize.

fields.EN:
How can you apologize if you don't know
why I was upset?
fields.JP:
わらわが怒った理由も分からないのに、
“ひとまず”で謝罪に来たのですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How can you apologize if you don't know
why I was upset?

fields.EN: Right. There's no point in lying about that.
fields.JP: そうだ。そこで嘘をついても意味がない
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. There's no point playing coy.

fields.EN: Besides, I decided that apologizing with words I didn't mean wouldn't convey any real remorse.
fields.JP:
それに、嘘偽りの言葉で謝罪しても、
謝意が伝わらないと判断したんだ

fields.EN:
I figured it would be better to approach
you honestly.
fields.JP:
ならば、正直に本音で伝えようと思い、
こうして君と話しに来た
fields.LOCALIZED:
I figured it would be better to approach
you honestly.

fields.EN:
You're so serious, which is a blessing and
a curse sometimes. I've let it go.
fields.JP:
良くも悪くも、そなたは真面目なのですね～
はあ、なんだか毒気が抜けてしまいました
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're so serious, which is a blessing and
a curse sometimes. I've let it go.

fields.EN:
I see that not knowing what upset you
makes my apology feel hollow.
fields.JP:
……そうか、やはり何が悪いか理解しないと、
謝罪は受け入れられないということか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see that not knowing what upset you
makes my apology feel hollow.

fields.EN: Sorry for wasting your time. Farewell.
fields.JP:
無駄な時間を取らせてしまってすまなかった。
では失礼する……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry for wasting your time. Farewell.

fields.EN: Don't jump to conclusions and walk off.
fields.JP: もうっ、早合点して帰ろうとしないで下さい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't jump to conclusions and walk off.

fields.EN:
What I just said meant, 'I accept your apology,'
Juu-san~
fields.JP:
今のは、ジュウさんの謝罪を受け入れます、
という意味で言ったんです～
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Huh? I thought you were upset that I didn't
understand.
fields.JP:
えっ……だが、君は何が悪いか理解しない
僕に対して、怒っていたのでは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? I thought you were upset that I didn't
understand.

fields.EN: Well, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't mad.
fields.JP:
まぁ、これっぽっちも怒っていないと
言うと、嘘になりますけど～
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I'd be lying if I said I wasn't mad.

fields.EN: But back then, I too had overstepped my boundaries.
fields.JP:
あの時は……わらわもつい、
カッとなって言ってしまったので
fields.LOCALIZED: But back then, I too had overstepped my boundaries.

fields.EN:
So we both went too far.
Why don't we call it even?
fields.JP:
だから、言い過ぎたのはお互い様、
という事で手を打ちませんか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we both went too far.
Why don't we call it even?

fields.JP: （かぐや姫もそうだったのか……）

fields.EN: Can you help me understand what upset you?
fields.JP:
かぐや姫は、自身が怒った事に対して、
明確な理由は分かっているのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Can you help me understand what upset you?

fields.EN: I couldn't seem to figure it out.
fields.JP:
僕は……いくら考えても、
これだと思える答えが出なかった
fields.LOCALIZED: I couldn't seem to figure it out.

fields.EN:
Why were you mad at me? And why
did I respond that way?
fields.JP:
なぜ、君が僕に対して腹を立てたのか？
なぜ、僕は君に対して苛立ちを覚えたのか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why were you mad at me? And why
did I respond that way?

fields.EN: I wanted to hear it from you.
fields.JP:
だから、もし君に確固たる理由があるのなら、
それを聞いてみようと思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I wanted to hear it from you.

fields.JP: 確固たる理由なんてないです～

fields.EN: I wish I did, but I don't.
fields.JP:
わらわも、なぜあんなに腹が立ったのか、
自分でもよくわからなかったので～
fields.LOCALIZED: I wish I did, but I don't.

fields.JP:
（僕だけじゃなく、かぐや姫も
　分からない事象だったのか）

……真面目なお話をしていたら、
なんだか喉が渇いてしまいました～

ごくっ、ごく……んっ。
ふぅ、落ち着きました

……っ！
僕が取らなくて、よかったのか？

fields.EN: Oh... Guess I finally felt like it?
fields.JP:
ああ…まぁ、今はそんな気分じゃ
なかっただけです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... Guess I finally felt like it?

fields.EN:
So for you, when you ask someone to do
something for you, is that a sign of trust?
fields.JP:
もしかして、人を代わりに使う行為というのは、
君にとっては、信頼を示す代わりだったのでは？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So for you, when you ask someone to do
something for you, is that a sign of trust?

fields.EN:
Couldn't you have asked me to do it
if you were feeling lazy...?
fields.JP:
本当にただ動くのが面倒くさいだけなら、
今も僕に頼んでいたんじゃないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Couldn't you have asked me to do it
if you were feeling lazy...?

fields.EN: W...why are you asking me that?!
fields.JP:
な……ま、真面目な顔で、
なんてことを言うんですか～！
fields.LOCALIZED: W...why are you asking me that?!

fields.EN:
You really say that kind of analysis right to the
person's face, Juu-san... honestly...
fields.JP:
そんな分析、よく本人に向かって言えますね。
まったく、ジュウさんと来たら……
fields.LOCALIZED: How can you read my face like that?!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Seeing your reaction, I guess I wasn't
too far off.
fields.JP:
君の反応を見る限り、僕の推測は
あながち間違いではなかったようだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing your reaction, I guess I wasn't
too far off.

fields.EN:
If that's the case, then I understand why
you were upset I called him a servant.
fields.JP:
確かにそれならば、家来扱いした事について
怒った理由がわかる
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's the case, then I understand why
you were upset I called him a servant.

fields.EN:
Ah... I finally get it. Let me apologize once
again. I am sorry.
fields.JP:
……うん、ようやく納得した。
改めて心から謝罪しよう。すまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah... I finally get it. Let me apologize once
again. I am sorry.

fields.EN:
Ugh. You're so serious. You really get
on my nerves sometimes. Hehe.
fields.JP:
うう～、またそんなくそ真面目に。
まったく、そなたは面倒な人ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. You're so serious. You really get
on my nerves sometimes. Hehe.

fields.EN: Well, you're not a bad person. Hehe.
fields.JP:
まぁ、でも悪い人ではないんですよね～
ふふっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, you're not a bad person. Hehe.

fields.EN: I see... I don't get it.
fields.JP: そうか……自分では分からないのだが
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... I don't get it.

fields.EN:
Ugh, my mood changed.
I want to read a book now.
fields.JP:
気分が変わったので、
本を読みたくなってしまいました～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh, my mood changed.
I want to read a book now.

fields.EN:
There's a black-spined book over there.
Will you get it for me?
fields.JP:
あの端に積んである、黒い背表紙の本を
取ってもらえますか～？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a black-spined book over there.
Will you get it for me?

fields.EN: ...Fine. It's the one at the very top, right?
fields.JP:
……仕方ないな。
一番上にある、この本の事か？
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Fine. It's the one at the very top, right?

fields.EN: Yes yes, that one. Thank you.
fields.JP:
そうそう、この本です。
ありがとうございます～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes yes, that one. Thank you.

fields.EN:
(This must be her way of showing she
trusts me.)
fields.JP:
（つまりは、彼女なりに僕を信頼して、
　許してくれたという証なのだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(This must be her way of showing she
trusts me.)

fields.EN:
If something comes up again, may I ask you another
favor, Juu-san~?
fields.JP:
また、何かあった時に、
ジュウさんに頼み事をしてもいいですか～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would it be okay if I ask you more favors
later on?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Yeah, if it's something I agree with,
I will listen.
fields.JP:
ああ、僕が納得できる内容であれば、
君の頼みを聞こう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, if it's something I agree with,
I will listen.

fields.EN: Oh, so that part doesn't change, huh?
fields.JP: もう、そこはブレないのですね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, so that part doesn't change, huh?

fields.EN:
(I was able to fix my relationship with
Kaguyahime.)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫と元通りの関係になって、
　彼女の真意も理解したけれど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was able to fix my relationship with
Kaguya.)

fields.EN:
(But still I couldn't figure out why being
compared to Jack annoyed me.)
fields.JP:
（結局なぜ僕が、ジャックと比べられて
　苛立ったのか、それは分からなかったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But still I couldn't figure out why being
compared to Jack annoyed me.)

fields.EN: I hope we find another discovery today.
fields.JP: さて、また新たな発見があるといいのだが
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope we find another discovery today.

fields.EN:
Uh, next I'm going to take this part,
and do this. And that...
fields.JP:
えーと、次はこっちのパーツを
こうして、あーして……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, next I'm going to take this part,
and do this. And that...

fields.JP:
（おや？　あそこにいるのは
　かぐや姫じゃないか）

fields.EN:
Hmm. But then this isn't too different
from before. Hm.
fields.JP:
むー、でもこれだと、
前とそう変わらないですねぇ……うーん
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmm. But then this isn't too different
from before. Hm.

fields.EN:
This isn't what I want. Must be more
innovative.
fields.JP:
わらわが求めているのは、
もっと、こう、画期的な……
fields.LOCALIZED:
This isn't what I want. Must be more
innovative.

fields.EN: My... Juu-san, when did you get here?
fields.JP:
……まぁ、ジュウさん
いつからそこにいらしたんです～？
fields.LOCALIZED: My... Toh, when did you get here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Just earlier. I heard a sound so I came to see 
what it was, and there you were.
fields.JP:
ついさっきだ。
音が聞こえたので来てみたら君がいた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just earlier. I heard a sound so I came to see 
what it was, and there you were.

fields.EN: Oh sorry. Was I being noisy?
fields.JP: すみません、うるさかったですか～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh sorry. Was I being noisy?

fields.EN: No problem. I was just curious.
fields.JP:
問題無い。
気になって来てみただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED: No problem. I was just curious.

fields.EN:
Seems like you're building something. 
What contraption are you making this time?
fields.JP:
かぐや姫は、何かを作成していたようだが、
今度はどんな道具を作っていたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like you're building something. 
What contraption are you making this time?

fields.JP: ふっふっふ、よくぞ聞いてくれました～！

fields.EN: Another device to help me cut corners!
fields.JP:
わらわがより快適なサボり生活を送るために、
『新サボり七つ道具』を開発していたのです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Another device to help me cut corners!

fields.EN: You're a lazy visionary. Think it'll work?
fields.JP:
相変わらずサボる事に関しては全力だな。
それで、開発は上手く行きそうなのか？
fields.LOCALIZED: You're a lazy visionary. Think it'll work?

fields.EN:
Well, that's the thing. It is harder than
I anticipated.
fields.JP:
ん～、それがですねぇ、思っていた以上に
なかなか上手く行かないものですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's the thing. It is harder than
I anticipated.

fields.EN: If it doesn't surpass the old tools, I can't call it part of the 'New Seven Tools for Slacking Off'~
fields.JP:
前の道具を超えるような物じゃないと、
『新サボり七つ道具』とは言えないのです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It has to be bigger, bolder than anything
I've built before.

fields.EN: Hm. So it's an updated model.
fields.JP:
ふむ……従来の道具からの、
性能アップが今の課題なのか
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. So it's an updated model.

fields.EN:
Yes. But even with new patterns and
designs, there's not too much of a
difference.
fields.JP:
はい～、でもパターンを変えて試作してみても、
前と大差がなくて～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. But even with new patterns and
designs, there's not too much of a
difference.

fields.EN:
It's not new enough for me. It needs to
be more mindblowing.
fields.JP:
やはり『新』と呼べるだけの、
画期的な性能が欲しいですよね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not new enough for me. It needs to
be more mindblowing.

fields.EN: I see. What kind of device is it then?
fields.JP:
そうか。ちなみに、具体的にはどんな道具を
作ろうとしていたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. What kind of device is it then?

fields.EN:
Mhm. I call it "The Cat's Paw." It helps me grab
things from far away.
fields.JP:
んー……『サボり七つ道具』の一つに、
通称『猫の手』と呼んでいる、
遠くの物を掴む道具があるんですけど～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mhm. I call it "The Cat's Paw." It helps me grab
things from far away.

fields.EN:
Though I wish it was more dextrous and could
reach further than it currently can.
fields.JP:
更に遠くの場所まで届いて、かつ繊細に
物が取れるような道具があったらいいな～と
fields.LOCALIZED:
Though I wish it was more dextrous and could
reach further than it currently can.

fields.EN:
I see. You'd also want it to grab beverages
as well?
fields.JP:
なるほど、例えば壊れやすい物や、
液体のような不安定な物を運べるとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. You'd also want it to grab beverages
as well?

fields.EN:
Of course. Wouldn't want to spill.
It'd be great to grab drinks while
laying down.
fields.JP:
ですです～。飲み物をこぼさずに、
寝そべったまま運んで来られたら最高ですね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. Wouldn't want to spill.
It'd be great to grab drinks while
laying down.

fields.EN: That is the function that I am looking for.
fields.JP: それこそ、わらわが求めて止まない性能です～
fields.LOCALIZED: That is the function that I am looking for.

fields.EN:
I see. What you need is delicate movement
and flexible digits.
fields.JP:
そうか、求められるのは、
液体を運べるような繊細な動きか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I see. What you need is delicate movement
and flexible digits.

fields.EN:
It needs balance, as if you were holding
it with your own hand.
fields.JP:
液体のような物を安定して運ぶためには、
衝撃で波打つのを緩和させる必要があるな
fields.LOCALIZED:
It needs balance, as if you were holding
it with your own hand.

fields.EN:
So it needs to be a tight, but stable,
grip. Like this.
fields.JP:
しっかり握れて、それでいて安定感があって、
そのために必要なものは、例えば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So it needs to be a tight, but stable,
grip. Like this.

fields.EN: Juu-san? What are you doing with that branch?
fields.JP: ジュウさん？　木の枝で何をしてるんです～？
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh? What are you doing with that branch?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Hold on a minute. I'll be quick.
fields.JP:
ちょっと待っていてくれ。
すぐに終わる
fields.LOCALIZED: Hold on a minute. I'll be quick.

fields.EN:
You're drawing out a complicated pattern...? Wait, is 
this... Could it be?!
fields.JP:
何だか複雑な図形を描いて……？
いや、こ、これは……もしや！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're drawing out a complicated pattern...? Wait, is 
this... Could it be?!

fields.EN: Do you get it? What do you think?
fields.JP:
というわけだ、
これならどうだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Do you get it? What do you think?

fields.EN: I use this here, connect it there, and done.
fields.JP:
……で、この部分にはこれを使って、
更にこうして、完成だ
fields.LOCALIZED: I use this here, connect it there, and done.

fields.JP:
なっ……、なななっ！！
こ、これは……っ！

fields.EN:
This is a vast improvement over my design!
Ergonomic!
fields.JP:
装置に必要な素材に、パーツの組み合せ、
そして使い方まで的確に書かれている！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a vast improvement over my design!
Ergonomic!

fields.EN:
Amazing! What a discovery! I'm blown
away!
fields.JP:
す、すごいです～！
これは大発見です！！　目から鱗です！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Amazing! What a discovery! I'm blown
away!

fields.EN: You fashioned it with minimal effort!
fields.JP:
集められそうな素材だけで、
こんなすごい物が作れるだなんて～！
fields.LOCALIZED: You fashioned it with minimal effort!

fields.EN: Well, this is practically a toy. It's easy.
fields.JP:
いや、この程度の簡単な物なら、
玩具を作るのとそう変わらないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, this is practically a toy. It's easy.

fields.EN: I don't think it's anything you need to be that surprised by?
fields.JP:
君がそこまで驚く程の物では
ないと思うのだが？

fields.EN: Oh no no no. It's not that easy!
fields.JP: いえいえ、簡単なんかじゃないです～
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh no no no. It's not that easy!

fields.EN: This is truly amazing! I have to exclaim it!
fields.JP:
これは本当に素晴らしいものです！
と、声を大にして言わせていただきます～
fields.LOCALIZED: This is truly amazing! I have to exclaim it!

fields.JP: まったく、こんな簡単なのに大げさだな

fields.EN:
If it's that simple, then make more for me,
Juu-san!
fields.JP:
簡単だって言うなら、
ジュウさんが、もっと作って下さい～！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If it's that simple, then make more for me,
Toh!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Let's work together and develop the perfect "New Seven Tools for Slacking Off"!
fields.JP:
わらわと一緒に頑張って、これぞという
『新サボり七つ道具』を開発しましょう～

fields.EN:
Well, I just wrote down my inspiration.
I didn't intend to do all that...
fields.JP:
いや、ふと閃いた事をそこに書いただけで、
そんなつもりじゃなかったんだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I just wrote down my inspiration.
I didn't intend to do all that...

fields.EN:
(At this rate, she's going to make me
gather the materials.)
fields.JP:
（このままでは、僕が材料集めから
　作成までさせられてしまう気がする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(At this rate, she's going to make me
gather the materials.)

fields.EN:
Oh, just thinking about it is exciting.
Juu-san, I can't wait.
fields.JP:
ああ～、考えただけですごく楽しみです～
ジュウさん、よろしくお願いしますね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, just thinking about it is exciting.
Toh, I can't wait.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
(Kaguyahime asks people for favors as a sign of
trust.)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫が人に頼み事をするのは、
　相手に対する信頼の証……だったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Kaguya asks people for favors as a sign of
trust.)

fields.EN:
(With that in mind, I can't just blow her
off.)
fields.JP:
（彼女なりに僕を信頼していると考えると、
　あまり無碍には出来ない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(With that in mind, I can't just blow her
off.)

fields.EN:
...Fine. I guess I started something with you. 
Whenever I have time, I promise I will
help you think of new devices.
fields.JP:
……わかった、これも乗りかかった船だ。
時間がある時は君の道具の制作を
手伝うと約束しよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Fine. I guess I started something with you. 
Whenever I have time, I promise I will
help you think of new devices.

fields.JP:
……えっ！
ほ、本当に、い、いいんですか～？

fields.EN:
Why are you surprised? You are the one 
who asked.
fields.JP:
何を驚いているんだ。
先に頼んで来たのは、君の方だろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you surprised? You are the one 
who asked.

fields.EN: Sure, but I didn't expect you to say yes.
fields.JP:
あ、いえ、そうなんですけど……
ちょっとビックリしたというか～
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure, but I didn't expect you to say yes.

fields.EN:
Knowing you, Juu-san, I thought you'd definitely say
no...
fields.JP:
ジュウさんのことだから、
絶対ダメだと言われると思ったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I almost expected you to reject me
immediately.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: そう言って、断って欲しかったのか？

fields.EN: No, not at all! I'm so happy you accepted!
fields.JP:
いえいえ、とんでもないです！
引き受けてくれて嬉しいです～
fields.LOCALIZED: No, not at all! I'm so happy you accepted!

fields.EN:
If you're that motivated, Juu-san, I'll do my very
best too~
fields.JP:
ジュウさんがそこまでやる気なら、
わらわも、精一杯頑張りますよー
fields.LOCALIZED: If you give it your all, so will I!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
２人で、素晴らしいサボり道具を
作りましょう～！

fields.EN:
(I can't tell if she's hard-working or lazy...
But I expect nothing less.)
fields.JP:
（まったく、前向きなんだか怠惰なんだか、
　よくわからないが……そこが彼女らしいか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't tell if she's hard-working or lazy...
But I expect nothing less.)

fields.EN:
Hm...This book's interpretation is pretty 
interesting. It's not bad testing it out.
fields.JP:
ふむ……この本の解釈はなかなか興味深い。
検証してみるのも悪くないな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...This book's interpretation is pretty 
interesting. It's not bad testing it out.

fields.EN:
Oh, Kaguya. So what was it that you wanted
to show me?
fields.JP:
それで、かぐや。
あたしたちに見せたい物ってなに？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Kaguya. So what was it that you wanted
to show me?

fields.EN:
Hehehe. Now don't rush. 
You guys will be blown away.
fields.JP:
ふっふっふ、そう慌てずに～
見たらきっと、そなたたちも驚きますよ～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. Now don't rush. 
You guys will be blown away.

fields.EN: Oh, so you've created something great, huh?
fields.JP:
へぇ、それだけかぐやさんは
いい物を作られたということですのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, so you've created something great, huh?

fields.EN: Well truly. I am most proud of this one.
fields.JP: それはもう。わらわの自信作ですから～
fields.LOCALIZED: Well truly. I am most proud of this one.

fields.JP: それはまたずいぶんと大きく出たわね

fields.EN:
(Oh this voice... I hear voices gathered in
Kaguyahime's tent.)
fields.JP:
（おや、この声は……？
　かぐや姫たちがテントに集まって、
　話をしているようだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh this voice... I hear voices gathered in
Kaguya's tent.)

fields.EN:
(But I don't really plan to join, so I guess I'll
keep reading this book.)
fields.JP:
（でも、特に混ざるつもりもないし、
　この辺で本の続きでも読んでいよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I don't really plan to join, so I guess I'll
keep reading this book.)

fields.EN: So let me show you guys.
fields.JP: では、早速お披露目したいと思います～
fields.LOCALIZED: So let me show you guys.

fields.EN: Behold, my new invention. I call it "Juu's Hand"!
fields.JP:
これが、わらわの『新サボり七つ道具』の一つ、
通称『ジュウの手』です～
fields.LOCALIZED: Behold, my new invention. I call it "Toh's Hand"!

fields.EN:
(I see. She wanted to show everyone her
new invention.)
fields.JP:
（なるほど、みんなに完成したばかりの
　例の道具を披露していたのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see. She wanted to show everyone her
new invention.)

fields.EN: (I ended up helping her out a lot...)
fields.JP:
（結局、僕がかなりの部分を
　担当してしまったがな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I ended up helping her out a lot...)

fields.EN:
Why are you calling it "Juu's Hand"?
Wouldn't it be "Cat's Paw 2.0" or
something?
fields.JP:
なぜ、『ジュウの手』と言うんですの？
『猫の手２号』とかではありませんの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you calling it "Toh's Hand"?
Wouldn't it be "Cat's Paw 2.0" or
something?

fields.EN:
Well the base may be "Cat's Paw," but it is 
completely different.
fields.JP:
これは、基本は『猫の手』であっても、
それとは異なるものだからです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well the base may be "Cat's Paw," but it is 
completely different.

fields.EN:
This contraption is a special device that Juu-san 
invented for me.
fields.JP:
この道具は、ジュウさんがわらわのために、
特別に考案してくれたものですから～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This contraption is a special device that Toh 
invented for me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Oh, I see. That explains the name.
fields.JP:
あー、なるほどね
それで『ジュウの手』って名前なんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I see. That explains the name.

fields.JP:
そうなんです～
ジュウさんは、本当にすごいんです～
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
If I use "Juu's Hand," it will reach further,
and it can now make intricate moves.
fields.JP:
この『ジュウの手』を使えば、すごく離れた場所まで
届きますし、おまけに、より繊細な動きが
可能になったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I use "Toh's Hand," it will reach further,
and it can now make intricate moves.

fields.EN: Oh wow, it can grab something that far?
fields.JP:
まぁっ、そんなに遠くの物が
取れるんですの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh wow, it can grab something that far?

fields.EN:
The previous "Cat's Paw" could only grab things
in your vicinity, right?
fields.JP:
前に使っていた『猫の手』では、
届くのはせいぜいこの辺りまででしたわよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
The previous "Cat's Paw" could only grab things
in your vicinity, right?

fields.EN:
Hehe. This "Juu's Hand" can extend even
further~
fields.JP:
ふふん、『ジュウの手』ならば、
もっと遠くまで伸ばす事が可能です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. This "Toh's Hand" can extend even
further~

fields.EN: Then try getting that cup farthest from you Kaguya.
fields.JP:
じゃあ、かぐやから一番遠い場所に
置いてある、あのコップを取ってみせてよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then try getting that cup farthest from you Kaguya.

fields.EN:
No, it's too far. It can't go that far could it? Look how 
long the device is...
fields.JP:
それはさすがに無理ではありませんの？
本体の長さから考えたら、届かないのでは……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's too far. It can't go that far could it? Look how 
long the device is...

fields.EN:
Hehehe. Let's give it a shot to see if it can.
Let's try.
fields.JP:
ふっふっふっ、無理かどうかは、
試してみればすぐにわかることです～
では、早速──
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. Let's give it a shot to see if it can.
Let's try.

fields.JP: ほら、これならどうです～？

fields.EN:
Wow it's stretching out pretty far. It may reach the 
cup.
fields.JP:
まぁ、どんどん本体が伸びてますわね。
本当にコップまで届いてしまいそうですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow it's stretching out pretty far. It may reach the 
cup.

fields.EN:
The inside is like a cylinder. Normally it's stored within 
the parts of the contraption.
fields.JP:
これは、内側が筒状になっていて、
普段は本体の一部を収納してるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
The inside is like a cylinder. Normally it's stored within 
the parts of the contraption.

fields.EN: So it is able to extend or retract.
fields.JP:
だから、手を伸ばすことも、
逆に縮ませることもできるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED: So it is able to extend or retract.

fields.EN: I see. It's great how it's compact.
fields.JP: なるほど、コンパクトなのもいいじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: I see. It's great how it's compact.

fields.EN: Yes, that's amazing. I am honestly impressed.
fields.JP:
ええ、本当にすごいですわね。
わたくしも素直に感心しましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, that's amazing. I am honestly impressed.

fields.EN:
Hehe. That's not all. It's not just the length
that's amazing.
fields.JP:
ふふん、驚くのはまだ早いです。
便利なのは、長さだけじゃないです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. That's not all. It's not just the length
that's amazing.

fields.EN:
I can control the tip with my hands and I can freely 
bend it.
fields.JP:
更に先端も手元で操作出来て、
自由に曲げられるようになったんです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can control the tip with my hands and I can freely 
bend it.

fields.EN: So I can not only grasp the cup...
fields.JP:
だから、こうやって、
コップをただ取るだけじゃなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED: So I can not only grasp the cup...

fields.EN: I can do it while laying down.
fields.JP: なんと、寝そべりながらだって取れるんです～
fields.LOCALIZED: I can do it while laying down.

fields.EN:
Whoa. You can grab something while sleeping... How 
much convenience did you pack this thing with?
fields.JP:
うわ、寝たまま飲み物まで取れるとか……
どんだけ便利機能を詰め込んでるのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. You can grab something while sleeping... How 
much convenience did you pack this thing with?

fields.EN:
This is truly like you. You're giving it your all so that 
you can be lazy. What a great function.
fields.JP:
グータラをするためには全力を出される、
実にかぐやさんらしい機能だと思いますわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is truly like you. You're giving it your all so that 
you can be lazy. What a great function.

fields.EN: You have a point there. This is perfect for you.
fields.JP:
確かにね。
あんたにピッタリの道具じゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: You have a point there. This is perfect for you.

fields.EN: Yes, Juu-san said the same thing.
fields.JP: ええ、ジュウさんもそう仰っていました～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, Toh said the same thing.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
This functionality does it all for you. Truly,
the new and improved addition to my seven
tools!
fields.JP:
まさに、至れり尽くせりの便利機能。
これぞ、『新サボり七つ道具』です～
fields.LOCALIZED:
This functionality does it all for you. Truly,
the new and improved addition to my seven
tools!

fields.EN:
You truly look lively right now Kaguya. You really must 
have been excited about this device.
fields.JP:
今のかぐやさん、すごく生き生きとしてますわ。
よっぽどこの道具が嬉しかったんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You truly look lively right now Kaguya. You really must 
have been excited about this device.

fields.EN:
It's rare for Kaguya to call us in to show us something 
like this.
fields.JP:
確かにわざわざかぐやがこんな場所まで来て、
お披露目するのはかなりレアだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's rare for Kaguya to call us in to show us something 
like this.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Juu-san sure is a sinner. He's going to enhance 
Kaguya's laziness.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、ジュウさんも罪作りですわね。
かぐやさんのグータラに磨きが掛りそうですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Toh sure is a sinner. He's going to enhance 
Kaguya's laziness.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
But he made this device for you though. I am kind of 
envious.
fields.JP:
でも、それくらい、貴女のことを考えて作られた
道具ですのね、何だか羨ましいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But he made this device for you though. I am kind of 
envious.

fields.EN: Right? I am very happy with my device.
fields.JP:
でしょう？
わらわもこの道具がとても気に入ってます～
fields.LOCALIZED: Right? I am very happy with my device.

fields.EN:
Now, what kind of new 'Seven Tools for Slacking Off'
should we develop next together, Juu-san~?
fields.JP:
さて、ジュウさんと一緒に、次はどんな
『新サボり七つ道具』を開発しましょう～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, I wonder what other of my seven tools
I can upgrade with him next.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Just thinking about it excites me. 
I'll only be able to sleep for 10 hours!
fields.JP:
考えただけで、ワクワクして
ほんの１０時間しか眠れなくなりそうです～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just thinking about it excites me. 
I'll only be able to sleep for 10 hours!

fields.JP: いやもう、それだけ寝たら十分すぎるってば
むしろ寝過ぎなくらいですわ

fields.EN:
(If Kaguyahime's satisfied... Perhaps my efforts
weren't a waste.)
fields.JP:
（かぐや姫がそこまで気に入ったのなら……
　僕の労力も無駄じゃなかったみたいだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If Kaguya's satisfied... Perhaps my efforts
weren't a waste.)

fields.EN:
(Seems like there are a few unique plants
that never existed underground...)
fields.JP:
（どうやら地下監獄にはない
　個性的な植物がいくつかあるが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like there are a few unique plants
that never existed underground...)

fields.JP:
（擬態化前の植物を考えれば地下監獄時の知識でも
　ある程度はどんな用途の植物か見えてくるということか）

fields.EN:
(So that means if I observe this plant closely,
I may be able to find its trait...)
fields.JP:
（この鉢の植物もよく観察することによって、
　何か特徴的なことがわかるかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(So that means if I observe this plant closely,
I may be able to find its trait...)

fields.EN: A circle cylinder... It's too small for a telescope but...
fields.JP:
小さな丸い筒……
望遠鏡にしては小さすぎだが……
fields.LOCALIZED: A circle cylinder... It's too small for a telescope but...

fields.JP:
お待ち下さい～
持っていかないで～

fields.EN:
(That's Cinderella. She's desperately running over 
here.)
fields.JP:
（あれはシンデレラ。
　必死になってこっちに近づいてくるな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's Cinderella. She's desperately running over 
here.)

fields.EN: What are you in a rush for?
fields.JP:
そんなにあわてて
どうしたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you in a rush for?

fields.EN:
O-ohohoho.
I totally am not in a rush.
fields.JP:
お、おーほっほっほっほ。
あわててなんていませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
O-ohohoho.
I totally am not in a rush.

fields.EN:
A-Anyways, that device you have is mine.
Could you give it back to me?
fields.JP:
それよりも、そちらのモノは
わたくしのモノですの。
返してくださる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A-Anyways, that device you have is mine.
Could you give it back to me?

fields.EN:
I... don't know what this is... But is there proof that it's
yours?
fields.JP:
これが……何かはわからないが……
君のモノという証拠はあるのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... don't know what this is... But is there proof that it's
yours?

fields.EN: Why don't we ask everyone just in case?
fields.JP:
念のために一度全員に聞いた方が
いいだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't we ask everyone just in case?

fields.EN:
You're exactly right and I have no room for a rebuttal 
but...
fields.JP:
その通りですし、
反論する余地はございませんけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're exactly right and I have no room for a rebuttal 
but...

fields.EN: Even then! I am certain that is mine.
fields.JP:
でもですわ！　
それは間違いなくわたくしのものですの
fields.LOCALIZED: Even then! I am certain that is mine.

fields.EN: Th-that is a "lipstick" and I have fond memories of it!
fields.JP:
そ、それはとても大切な思い出が
詰まった'口紅'ですの！
fields.LOCALIZED: Th-that is a "lipstick" and I have fond memories of it!

fields.EN:
Oh, you're right. If I take off the cap there is lip coloring
 inside.
fields.JP:
ああ、本当だな。
フタを外したら、中に紅が入っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you're right. If I take off the cap there is lip coloring
 inside.

fields.EN: Right? I know what's inside so that means it's mine.
fields.JP:
そうでございましょう？
中身を知ってるのですから
わたくしのものということですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right? I know what's inside so that means it's mine.

fields.EN:
(She has a point. She knew what was inside so there is 
a high chance that it's hers.)
fields.JP:
（確かに何かわかっているんだから
　シンデレラ本人のモノの可能性が高いな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She has a point. She knew what was inside so there is 
a high chance that it's hers.)

fields.JP: 納得していただけまして？

fields.EN:
I'm glad that you handled it with care. Now please, 
give it back to me.
fields.JP:
慎重に取り扱って頂き助かりましたわ。
では、早速返してくださいまし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm glad that you handled it with care. Now please, 
give it back to me.

fields.EN: W-well no, let's ask everyone first.
fields.JP:
いや、やっぱり
一度みんなに聞いてからの方がいい
fields.LOCALIZED: W-well no, let's ask everyone first.

fields.JP:
はっ！？　もしかして
わたくしを疑っていますのね？

fields.EN:
That is horrible of you! You think that I would be a 
THIEF?
fields.JP:
ひどいですわ！
このわたくしが人のモノを
盗むとでもおっしゃるの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That is horrible of you! You think that I would be a 
THIEF?

fields.EN: I would never do such an ugly thing!
fields.JP: そんな美しくない行為はしませんわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I would never do such an ugly thing!

fields.EN:
No, I wasn't doubting you. I'd do the same with
anyone.
fields.JP:
いや、疑っているというわけではない。
誰にでもこういう対処をする
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I wasn't doubting you. I'd do the same with
anyone.

fields.EN: Juu-san... You're a lot stiffer than you appear to be.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんって……
想像以上の堅物ですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh... You're a lot stiffer than you appear to be.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: I'm just trying to take the usual measures.
fields.JP: 普通の手続きを取ろうしてるまでだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm just trying to take the usual measures.

fields.EN:
But it's truly my lipstick. What can I do for you to 
understand?
fields.JP:
でも、それは本当にわたくしの口紅なんですの。
どうしたらわかってもらえるのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it's truly my lipstick. What can I do for you to 
understand?

fields.EN: Hm...? It has something written on it...
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm...? It has something written on it...

fields.EN: (...Cin...derella... Oh, her name is written on it.)
fields.JP:
（……シン……デレラ……。
　なんだ。ちゃんと記名してあるじゃないか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (...Cin...derella... Oh, her name is written on it.)

fields.EN:
(Then this is definitely Cinderella's. I don't have to 
check.)
fields.JP:
（なら、みんなに確かめるまでもなく、
　これはシンデレラのものだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Then this is definitely Cinderella's. I don't have to 
check.)

fields.EN:
(I thought she was restless, but I never knew
she was this meticulous.)
fields.JP:
（落ち着きがないと思ったら、
　こんな几帳面な一面もあるのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought she was restless, but I never knew
she was this meticulous.)

fields.EN: Oh, what can I do to prove it?
fields.JP:
ああ、どうやって
証明したらいいのでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, what can I do to prove it?

fields.EN:
It's fine. I get it. I saw your name on it.
This is truly yours.
fields.JP:
もう、いい。わかった。
名前が書いてあった。
これは君のモノだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. I get it. I saw your name on it.
This is truly yours.

fields.EN: Huh?! Oh! Thank you! Yes! I did write my name on it.
fields.JP:
えっ！　ああっ！　ありがとうですわ！
そうです！
名前はしっかりと書いていましたの
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh?! Oh! Thank you! Yes! I did write my name on it.

fields.EN:
You should have told me your name was
written on it. Then I would have given it
to you immediately...
fields.JP:
初めから名前が書いてあるといえば
直ぐに渡せたのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You should have told me your name was
written on it. Then I would have given it
to you immediately...

fields.EN:
Why did you lose such an important thing in 
the first place?
fields.JP: そもそもなぜそんな大事なものを落としたんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why did you lose such an important thing in 
the first place?

fields.EN:
I'm embarrassed to say I do have a clumsy side... 
I knew it was important to me.
fields.JP:
わたくしお恥ずかしいことに、
そそかっしいところがありまして……
大事なモノでしたのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm embarrassed to say I do have a clumsy side... 
I knew it was important to me.

fields.EN: (Hm... She's exactly as she portrays herself to be.)
fields.JP: （ふむ……イメージ通りではあるな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Hm... She's exactly as she portrays herself to be.)

fields.EN: Hehehe. It's not bad to wear it from time to time.
fields.JP:
ふふふ、久しぶりに付けてみるのも
悪くないですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehehe. It's not bad to wear it from time to time.

fields.EN:
(I guess she really must have an emotional tie to it. She
 didn't even want to check.)
fields.JP:
（なんにしても確認を取る時間が惜しいほど
　思い入れが強いものだったのだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess she really must have an emotional tie to it. She
 didn't even want to check.)

fields.EN:
Juu-san, why are you staring at me suddenly?
It's rude to stare at a lady.
fields.JP:
ちょっとジュウさんいきなり
じろじろ見てどうしたんですの。
レディに対して失礼ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh, why are you staring at me suddenly?
It's rude to stare at a lady.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: Anyways, thank you for picking this up.
fields.JP:
なんにしても拾って頂いて
ありがとうございますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyways, thank you for picking this up.

fields.EN:
(I thought Akazukin was pretty restless but so 
is Cinderella.)
fields.JP:
（うむ、赤ずきんも騒がしいと思ったが、
　シンデレラも騒々しい奴だったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought Red Riding Hood was pretty restless but so 
is Cinderella.)

fields.EN:
(Is she that clumsy to lose something so
important to her?)
fields.JP:
（そんな思い出が詰まった大事なモノを
　無くすとは相当そそっかしいのだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she that clumsy to lose something so
important to her?)

fields.EN:
(Well, I wouldn't be talking. I have forgotten a part of 
my wife...)
fields.JP:
（いやいや、妻の一部を
　忘れている僕も人の事は言えないな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, I wouldn't be talking. I have forgotten a part of 
my wife...)

fields.EN: Thank you for the meal. I'll be excusing myself.
fields.JP:
ごちそうさまでございますわ
では、失礼いたします
fields.LOCALIZED: Thank you for the meal. I'll be excusing myself.

fields.EN:
Hold on a minute. Cinderella, today should be your 
turn to clean up.
fields.JP:
ちょっと待て。
今日は僕とシンデレラが
片付け当番のはずだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on a minute. Cinderella, today should be your 
turn to clean up.

fields.JP:
あらっ……？
そうでしたか？
わたくしとしたことが失礼いたしましたわ

fields.EN:
You may not like to clean, but rules are rules.
You have to do it.
fields.JP:
片付けが嫌なのかもしれないが、
ルールならばしっかりやらないといけないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not like to clean, but rules are rules.
You have to do it.

fields.EN: Of course! I'm great at cleaning! Leave it to me!
fields.JP:
もちろんですわ！
わたくし、お片付は得意ですもの！
まかせてくださいまし！
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course! I'm great at cleaning! Leave it to me!

fields.EN:
(I thought she hates cleaning because she was a 
noble.)
fields.JP: （お嬢様のようだから、嫌いだと思っていたが意外だな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought she hates cleaning because she was a 
noble.)

fields.EN:
Well let's get started then. We can't have a moment of 
it not being clean.
fields.JP:
では、早速始めましょう。
一刻も汚い状態をそのままには
しておけませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well let's get started then. We can't have a moment of 
it not being clean.

fields.JP: 汚れは抹殺しなければなりませんもの！
（汚れをあまり抹殺とは言わないが……）
ふんぬっ、ふんぬうっ、ふんぬうっですわ！

（さっきからずっと皿を
　一心不乱にこすってる）

fields.EN:
Not yet... it's not clean yet... It won't become clean... 
The filth isn't leaving...
fields.JP:
まだっ、まだっ……綺麗にならない……
汚れが落ちない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not yet... it's not clean yet... It won't become clean... 
The filth isn't leaving...

fields.EN:
(Yeah... Looking around, she must've
scrubbed every germ here to death.)
fields.JP:
（うむ……そこまですれば、
　ばい菌はこそぎ取れていると思うが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Yeah... Looking around, she must've
scrubbed every germ here to death.)

fields.JP: シンデレラ、もういいのではないか？

fields.EN: No, not yet. Look. There are fingerprints here...
fields.JP:
いえ、まだまだですわ。
ほら、ここにまだ指紋が……
fields.LOCALIZED: No, not yet. Look. There are fingerprints here...

fields.JP: ふんっ、ふんっ、ふんっですわ！

fields.EN: Just a little more. A little more.
fields.JP: あと少し、もう少しですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Just a little more. A little more.

fields.EN:
Hm...? Cinderella? Your right earring's about
to fall out.
fields.JP:
ん……シンデレラ？
右のイヤリングが外れそうだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm...? Cinderella? Your right earring's about
to fall out.

fields.EN: I-I'm sorry. I've put it on so I'm fine now.
fields.JP:
し、失礼いたしましてよ。
もうつけ直したので大丈夫ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I-I'm sorry. I've put it on so I'm fine now.

fields.EN:
Now I must continue the washing... 
Hnrg nrgh hnrgh!
fields.JP:
さあ、洗い物の続きをしなくては……
ふんっ、ふんっ、ふんっですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now I must continue the washing... 
Hnrg nrgh hnrgh!

fields.EN:
(Oh, I see. She dives into things obsessively,
at risk of losing everything precious to her.)
fields.JP:
（ああ、そうか……。
　こうやって夢中になっているうちに
　大切なモノでもなくすのか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I see. She dives into things obsessively,
at risk of losing everything precious to her.)

fields.EN:
Why don't you just take off your earrings
while you clean?
fields.JP:
洗い物のあいだだけでも
イヤリングを外せばいいのではないか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you just take off your earrings
while you clean?

fields.EN:
Thankfully I noticed in time, but you were
about to drop it.
fields.JP:
今回は気付いたからいいが
落とすとこだった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thankfully I noticed in time, but you were
about to drop it.

fields.EN:
Oh, of course not! If I did such a thing,
my beauty would disappear.
fields.JP:
まあ、とんでもありませんわ！
そんなことをすれば
わたくしの美しさが消えてしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, of course not! If I did such a thing,
my beauty would disappear.

fields.JP: それはとても恐ろしいことですの

fields.EN: Of course. Nothing is as horrific as losing your beauty.
fields.JP:
もちろんですわ。
美しさを損なう以上に
恐ろしいことはありませんもの
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. Nothing is as horrific as losing your beauty.

fields.EN:
(Come to think of it, Cinderella's Blood Libido
is the "desire to be beautiful.")
fields.JP:
（そう言えば確かシンデレラの血式リビドーは
　『綺麗でありたい』だったな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Come to think of it, Cinderella's Blood Libido
is the "desire to be beautiful.")

fields.EN:
(It makes sense why she's so focused on
her scrubbing.)
fields.JP: （洗い物に異常に集中するのも納得だ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It makes sense why she's so focused on
her scrubbing.)

fields.EN:
(As much as it pains me to say, it appears
she indulges in unhealthy obsession.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても申し訳ないが、
　ハッキリ言って不要な執着だろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(As much as it pains me to say, it appears
she indulges in unhealthy obsession.)

fields.EN:
Cinderella, can I ask you something?
Hear me out while you do the dishes.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、質問をしていいか？
洗い物を続けながらでいい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella, can I ask you something?
Hear me out while you do the dishes.

fields.EN: Sure thing. I can't afford to rest.
fields.JP:
ええ、どうぞ。
手は休ませるわけにはいきませんけど
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure thing. I can't afford to rest.

fields.JP: 君が思う『美しさを感じる定義』とはなんなんだ？
美しさに……定義……がありますの？

fields.EN:
Well, your Blood Libido is a desire to be
beautiful. You must have found ways to
satisfy it, no? Both in want and need?
fields.JP:
美しくありたいという血式リビドーの
欲求を満たすには「自らを美しい」と感じる
瞬間がなければ満たされないだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, your Blood Libido is a desire to be
beautiful. You must have found ways to
satisfy it, no? Both in want and need?

fields.EN:
True. As they say, beauty is in the eye of
the beholder.
fields.JP:
確かに美しいという感情は
自分でも決められなくもないが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
True. As they say, beauty is in the eye of
the beholder.

fields.EN:
This might be hard to hear, but I think you're
too tough on yourself.
fields.JP:
君はこういってはなんだが
自らに自信があまりないと見る
fields.LOCALIZED:
This might be hard to hear, but I think you're
too tough on yourself.

fields.EN:
So, given our circumstances, I thought I'd ask
you, just how do we fulfill that need for you?
fields.JP:
そんな君の場合だとどういう
基準を定めているんだろうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, given our circumstances, I thought I'd ask
you, just how do we fulfill that need for you?

fields.EN: There must be someone who could help.
fields.JP: なにか指針があるのかと思っただけだ
fields.LOCALIZED: There must be someone who could help.

fields.EN:
In other words, are you asking me if there is 
someone I'd want to be beautiful for?
fields.JP:
つまり、わたくしが美しいと思われたい相手が
いるのかどうか、というお尋ねですの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
In other words, are you asking me if there is 
someone I'd want to be beautiful for?

fields.EN: I guess that would be the case.
fields.JP: ありていに言えばそうなる
fields.LOCALIZED: I guess that would be the case.

fields.JP: （ずいぶん考えこまれてしまったな）

fields.EN:
You mentioned that tube of lipstick that
meant so much to you, didn't you? Does it
have something to do with that?
fields.JP:
この間、僕が見つけた口紅のことを
思い出の詰まったモノだと言ってただろう？
そういうことは関係してないのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mentioned that tube of lipstick that
meant so much to you, didn't you? Does it
have something to do with that?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: (Her face is as red as a tomato.)
fields.JP: （顔がトマトのように赤いぞ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Her face is as red as a tomato.)

fields.EN: N-nothing! Let's stop talking about this.
fields.JP:
な、なんでもありませんわ！
それにこの話は終わりにしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: N-nothing! Let's stop talking about this.

fields.EN: We're ending this talk! See? I have dishes to do!
fields.JP:
と、ともかく終わりですの！
このように洗い物が残っていますでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: We're ending this talk! See? I have dishes to do!

fields.EN: My current job is to finish cleaning these dishes.
fields.JP:
本日のわたくしたちの使命は
洗い物を片付けることですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: My current job is to finish cleaning these dishes.

fields.EN: It's not coming off. It isn't. Ei. Ei. EIIII!
fields.JP:
落ちない、落ちないですわ。
えいっ、えいっ、ええいっ！ですわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not coming off. It isn't. Ei. Ei. EIIII!

fields.EN:
(She's so focused on the dishes.
What did she blush for?)
fields.JP:
（もう洗い物に没頭してる。
　さっきの照れはなんだったんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's so focused on the dishes.
What did she blush for?)

fields.JP: （しかしコロコロと感情が変わる）

fields.EN:
(I didn't expect myself to want to verify what's written 
on that book again.)
fields.JP:
（またあの本に書いてあることを
　確かめたくなるとはな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I didn't expect myself to want to verify what's written 
on that book again.)

fields.EN: (I shouldn't have returned to Shirayukihime so fast.)
fields.JP: （白雪姫に返すのが早すぎた）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I shouldn't have returned to Snow White so fast.)

fields.EN:
(I feel bad asking so many times but I'm going to find 
her and ask her to lend it to me again.)
fields.JP:
（何度も頼むのは忍びないが、
　彼女を探して、また貸してもらおう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel bad asking so many times but I'm going to find 
her and ask her to lend it to me again.)

fields.JP: シンデレラさん準備はいかがですか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: Cinderella-san, I will make you pretty this instant.
fields.JP:
シンデレラさん、
今、綺麗にしてあげますからね
fields.LOCALIZED: Cinderella, I will make you pretty this instant.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: (...There she is. Oh she's with Cinderella.)
fields.JP:
（……いた。
　シンデレラと一緒だったのか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (...There she is. Oh she's with Cinderella.)

fields.EN: Shirayukihime, I was looking for you.
fields.LOCALIZED: Snow White, I was looking for you.

fields.EN: What...? You were looking for me?
fields.JP:
えっ……？
白雪をですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What...? You were looking for me?

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
*gasp*! I'm sorry! I've tangled your hair!
Let me brush it all out!
fields.JP:
はっ！　すみません。
髪の毛が絡まってしまいましたね。
今、ブラシから髪の毛を解きます！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*gasp*! I'm sorry! I've tangled your hair!
Let me brush it all out!

fields.EN: I'm sorry! I made you all dusty!
fields.JP:
すみません。
埃を落としてしまいました。
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry! I made you all dusty!

fields.EN: It's okay. I was already covered in dust.
fields.JP:
仕方ありませんわ。
わたくしが埃だらけですもの
fields.LOCALIZED: It's okay. I was already covered in dust.

fields.EN:
(Hm... Why is Cinderella all dusty?
And her dress is dirty here and there.)
fields.JP:
（うむ……
　なぜシンデレラは埃だらけなんだ？
　髪もドレスも、あちこちが汚れてる）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm... Why is Cinderella all dusty?
And her dress is dirty here and there.)

fields.EN:
Did something happen? I remember Cinderella always 
dressing clean. What's gotten into you?
fields.JP:
なにかあったか？
シンデレラはいつも綺麗にしてると記憶しているが
何をしていてそうなったんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did something happen? I remember Cinderella always 
dressing clean. What's gotten into you?

fields.EN: W-well... There's a reason for it.
fields.JP: そ、それは……ちょっと事情があるんです
fields.LOCALIZED: W-well... There's a reason for it.

fields.EN: I went out on a search myself.
fields.JP: わたくし、ひとりで探索に出かけてましたの
fields.LOCALIZED: I went out on a search myself.

fields.EN: Yes I am. And I found this...!
fields.JP:
はい、本当ですわ。
それで、実はこれを……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes I am. And I found this...!

fields.EN: Why did you risk going out on your own?
fields.JP:
なぜひとりで探索に行くなど
わざわざ危険なマネをした？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why did you risk going out on your own?

fields.EN:
(W-was that too cold? But I have to be clear with 
her...)
fields.JP:
（少し冷たく言い過ぎたか？
　だが、これはきちんと言わなければ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(W-was that too cold? But I have to be clear with 
her...)

fields.EN:
Juu-san! It's not like Cinderella-san carelessly made this 
decision!
fields.JP:
ジュウさん！　シンデレラさんは不用意に
そんな行動をとったわけではっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh! It's not like Cinderella carelessly made this 
decision!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san; ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime, stay out of this. I'm talking to Cinderella 
right now.
fields.JP:
白雪姫、少し黙っててくれないか。
今はシンデレラと話してるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White, stay out of this. I'm talking to Cinderella 
right now.

fields.JP: シンデレラ、分かっているのか？

fields.EN:
What were you going to do if you had gone into Blood 
Skelter mode? Then, you not only put yourself in 
danger but cause trouble for the others.
fields.JP:
もしブラッドスケルター化でもしたら
自分だけじゃなくて、
みんなに迷惑が掛かる
fields.LOCALIZED:
What were you going to do if you had gone into Blood 
Skelter mode? Then, you not only put yourself in 
danger but cause trouble for the others.

fields.EN:
You went off on your own, came back dirty and you 
are even using Shirayukihime's precious time. How 
meaningful of a thing were you doing?
fields.JP:
勝手に自分で行って汚れて帰ってきたのに
白雪姫の大事な時間まで使わせて
それほど意味のあることをしたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You went off on your own, came back dirty and you 
are even using Snow White's precious time. How 
meaningful of a thing were you doing?

fields.EN: That's not it! Let me explain!
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not it! Let me explain!

fields.JP: い、いいんですの。白雪姫さん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 白雪姫さん => Snow White-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I'm sorry. This is my fault.
fields.JP:
申し訳ありません。
わたくしの過ちですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm sorry. This is my fault.

fields.EN:
So long as you understand that you were in the wrong 
we're good. You be more careful in the future.
fields.JP:
間違っていたという自覚があればいい。
今後は慎重に行動してくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
So long as you understand that you were in the wrong 
we're good. You be more careful in the future.

fields.EN:
Understood. I will refrain from taking irresponsible 
actions.
fields.JP:
わかりましたわ。
軽率なことは控えますの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Understood. I will refrain from taking irresponsible 
actions.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.JP: 白雪姫さんいいんですの……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 白雪姫さん => Snow White-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I'm going to return to my own room. Good day, 
everyone.
fields.JP:
それでは、わたくし自分のお部屋に戻りますわ。
みなさま、ごきげんよう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm going to return to my own room. Good day, 
everyone.

fields.JP:
（うむ……僕はそんなに間違ったことは
　言ってないはずだが……）

fields.EN:
(But why do I feel a pang of pain in my heart? 
Was I wrong...?)
fields.JP:
（なぜか今も胸がちくちくする
　何か間違っていたのだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But why do I feel a pang of pain in my heart? 
Was I wrong...?)

fields.EN:
Did Cinderella drop this? I don't remember seeing this
in her hair...
fields.JP:
シンデレラが落としていったのか？
髪にはついていなかったようだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Did Cinderella drop this? I don't remember seeing this
in her hair...

fields.JP:
それはシンデレラさんのモノではありませんよ
ジュウさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san; ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
No. Cinderella-san went alone to go pick up that gold 
barrette.
fields.JP:
違います。その金色のバレッタを拾いに
シンデレラさんはひとりで出ていったんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
No. Cinderella went alone to go pick up that gold 
barrette.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Cinderella-san happened to hear that your wife 
wears a... gold barrette and Haru-san said that he 
found it somewhere.
fields.JP:
シンデレラさんはハルさんからたまたま聞いた、
奥さんが付けていた髪飾り……金色のバレッタの
ようなものを見つけたと言って来たんです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella happened to hear that your wife 
wears a... gold barrette and Haru said that he 
found it somewhere.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san; ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.EN: So she went to go look for it and retrieve it herself.
fields.JP: それでひとりで探索して取りに行ってたんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: So she went to go look for it and retrieve it herself.

fields.EN: By me telling Haru about it...
fields.JP: 僕がハルに話してたことでか……
fields.LOCALIZED: By me telling Haru about it...

fields.EN:
Yes... I think seeing how desperate you were,
Juu-san, gave her the courage to go.
fields.JP:
はい……。　ジュウさんが必死になっているのを
見て勇気を出して行ったんだと思います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes... I think seeing you desperate, she found the 
courage.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: これは妻のモノではない

fields.EN: I have to apologize about this.
fields.JP: これは確かに謝らなくてはいけないな
fields.LOCALIZED: I have to apologize about this.

fields.EN:
All things considered, I think you're pretty
impatient too, Juu-san.
fields.JP: なんだかんだジュウさんもせっかちだと白雪は思います
fields.LOCALIZED: I think you did jump to conclusions.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Phew... You have a point there. I apologize
to you too, Shirayukihime.
fields.JP:
ふう……。
確かにそうだな。
白雪姫もすまなかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew... You have a point there. I apologize
to you too, Snow White.

fields.EN: (I guess I jumped to conclusions too soon...)
fields.JP: （僕はまた答えを急ぎすぎてしまった……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I guess I jumped to conclusions too soon...)

fields.EN:
(And by doing that I didn't even give Cinderella a 
chance. That's not right for me to scold her like that.)
fields.JP:
（思い込みだけで話しも聞かずに
　シンデレラを責めていいわけがない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And by doing that I didn't even give Cinderella a 
chance. That's not right for me to scold her like that.)

fields.EN:
I'll apologize to Cinderella the next time. Sorry for the 
trouble.
fields.JP:
今度シンデレラには謝る。
世話をかけたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll apologize to Cinderella the next time. Sorry for the 
trouble.

fields.EN: Right. I think that's the best course of action.
fields.JP:
そうですね。
白雪もそれがいいと思います
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. I think that's the best course of action.

fields.EN:
I think I may have stepped out of bounds...
I hope she forgives me.
fields.JP:
流石に言い過ぎたかもしれない……
許してくれるといいが
fields.LOCALIZED:
