I think I may have stepped out of bounds...
I hope she forgives me.

fields.EN: Knowing Cinderella-san, she will! I guarantee it!
fields.JP:
シンデレラさんなら許してくれます！
白雪が保証しますよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Knowing Cinderella, she will! I guarantee it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN:
Cinderella-san already knows by now that you don't
speak with malicious intent, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
シンデレラさんだって、もうジュウさんが
悪意を持って話していないことくらい知ってますから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella already knows that you never mean
any harm.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): シンデレラ => Cinderella-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: ...I see. Thank you. I'll try approaching her.
fields.JP:
……そうか。
ありがとう。言ってみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: ...I see. Thank you. I'll try approaching her.

fields.JP: ふふ、頑張ってください

fields.EN:
Cinderella I have to speak to you. Do you have a 
moment?
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、用事がある。
今大丈夫か？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella I have to speak to you. Do you have a 
moment?

fields.EN: Oh, Juu-san. It's rare for you to have business with me.
fields.JP:
あら、ジュウさんがわたくしに
用事なんて珍しいですわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Toh. It's rare for you to have business with me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP:
おーほっほっほっほ。
それで、なんですの？
（どこか無理をしているような……）

fields.EN: ...Sorry. I went too far the other day.
fields.JP:
……すまない。
この間は言い過ぎた
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Sorry. I went too far the other day.

fields.EN: I wanted to apologize about it.
fields.JP: そのことを謝りたくて来た
fields.LOCALIZED: I wanted to apologize about it.

fields.EN: Oh, about that. You didn't have to worry about it.
fields.JP:
まあ、そのことですの。
気になさらなくても大丈夫でしたのに
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, about that. You didn't have to worry about it.

fields.EN:
But I have to admit I was at fault here.
I know for certain I unnecessarily hurt
your feelings.
fields.JP:
しかし、あれは僕が全面的に悪かった。
君を不用意に傷つけたのは間違いない
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I have to admit I was at fault here.
I know for certain I unnecessarily hurt
your feelings.

fields.EN: I made assumptions. I do feel horrible about it.
fields.JP:
自分の思い込みと先走りが
出たと反省している
fields.LOCALIZED: I made assumptions. I do feel horrible about it.

fields.JP:
そうですわね。
ジュウさんは口が悪いですわ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
But I also understood that you said that because you 
were worried about me.
fields.JP:
でも、わたくしたちのことを
心配してのことと分かっていますの
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I also understood that you said that because you 
were worried about me.

fields.EN: So I did feel bummed but I'm fine.
fields.JP:
ですから、少しは落ち込みましたけど
大丈夫ですわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: So I did feel bummed but I'm fine.

fields.EN: Of course. It's not a matter of forgiveness.
fields.JP:
もちろんですわ。
許すも許さないもありませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course. It's not a matter of forgiveness.

fields.JP: 怒ってもないのですから

fields.EN:
I heard that you went to go get that golden
barrette because you thought it may have 
belonged to my wife, right?
fields.JP:
君は金色のバレッタを
僕の妻のものかもしれないと
ひとりで取りに行ってくれたのだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard that you went to go get that golden
barrette because you thought it may have 
belonged to my wife, right?

fields.EN: You knew about the gold barrette.
fields.JP:
ちゃんと金色のバレッタに
気付いてくれたんですのね
fields.LOCALIZED: You knew about the gold barrette.

fields.EN:
I intended to give it to you personally,
but then things unfolded as they had.
fields.JP:
直接お渡しするつもりが、
あんなことになってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I intended to give it to you personally,
but then things unfolded as they had.

fields.EN: I wanted you to notice so I left it behind.
fields.JP:
気付いてくれますようにと
あそこに置いたんですの
fields.LOCALIZED: I wanted you to notice so I left it behind.

fields.EN:
So, did that golden barrette belong to your wife,
Juu-san?
fields.JP:
それで、あの金色のバレッタは
ジュウさんの奥様のものでしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: So was that golden barrette your wife's?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
そうですか……。
それは残念なことでしたわ

fields.EN:
Oh, honestly... I risked danger to retrieve it even
though it wasn't something precious to you,
Juu-san...
fields.JP:
ああ、わたくしったら、
ジュウさんの大事なモノでもないのに
危険を冒して取りに行くなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Awww. Gosh, what am I doing? It wasn't even
your wife's, and I put myself in danger to get
it...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
It wasn't a good move for anyone.
All I did was cause people trouble...
fields.JP:
誰のための行動にもなりませんでしたわね。
ただ、みなさんに迷惑をかけるだけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It wasn't a good move for anyone.
All I did was cause people trouble...

fields.EN: And it wasn't even a hint to find your wife Juu-san.
fields.JP:
ジュウさんの奥様探しの
手がかりにもなりませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED: And it wasn't even a hint to find your wife Toh.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: I gave you false hopes. I feel bad.
fields.JP:
無駄な期待を抱かせてしまう結果に
なるなんて申し訳ありませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I gave you false hopes. I feel bad.

fields.EN: No... This is where I'm horrible.
fields.JP:
いいえ……
これはわたくしの駄目なところです
fields.LOCALIZED: No... This is where I'm horrible.

fields.EN:
When I thought I found it... I didn't consult with 
anyone...
fields.JP:
もしやあれは……っと思った瞬間に、
誰にも相談せず先走ってしまい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I thought I found it... I didn't consult with 
anyone...

fields.EN: And in the end I even troubled Shirayukihime-san.
fields.JP:
しまいには、
白雪姫さんの手まで煩わせてしまいました
fields.LOCALIZED: And in the end I even troubled Snow White.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 白雪姫さん => Snow White-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I shouldn't have let that level of dirtiness bother me.
fields.JP:
あの程度の汚れなんて
気にしなければ良かったですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I shouldn't have let that level of dirtiness bother me.

fields.EN:
Well it's true that it was your bad for going out to 
search alone despite it being nearby.
fields.JP:
確かにシンデレラが一人で
近場とはいえ探索にでていったのは悪い
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well it's true that it was your bad for going out to 
search alone despite it being nearby.

fields.JP:
……その通りですわ。
わたくし、浅はかでしたの

fields.EN:
However, I don't think it's bad for you to be 
pristine.
fields.JP: ただ君が綺麗にしてたのは悪いとは思わない
fields.LOCALIZED:
However, I don't think it's bad for you to be 
pristine.

fields.EN: I think you're the most emotional in the group.
fields.JP:
僕はこの中でシンデレラが
一番感情に振り回される人間だと思っている
fields.LOCALIZED: I think you're the most emotional in the group.

fields.EN:
And when you fail, you hate yourself and then 
make similar mistakes again.
fields.JP:
しかも、それが理由で失敗しては
自分を嫌悪して、また似たような失敗をする
fields.LOCALIZED:
And when you fail, you hate yourself and then 
make similar mistakes again.

fields.EN: In that sense, I honestly think you were foolish.
fields.JP: その点は正直、愚かだと思っている
fields.LOCALIZED: In that sense, I honestly think you were foolish.

fields.EN:
R-right. I am me after all. I wouldn't blame you 
for thinking that way.
fields.JP:
そ、そうですわよね。
このようなわたくしですもの、
そう思われて無理もありませんわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
R-right. I am me after all. I wouldn't blame you 
for thinking that way.

fields.JP: わたくし……消え入りたい心境ですわ

fields.EN:
Every time you get emotional and push yourself 
to the limit, it's always for someone else.
fields.JP:
君が感情に振り回され無理をするときは
大体が『人のため』だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Every time you get emotional and push yourself 
to the limit, it's always for someone else.

fields.EN:
So you overwork yourself, and the way you 
balance that to maintain yourself is...
fields.JP:
そんな無理をしてる君が
自分を保つためにバランスをとる行動が……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you overwork yourself, and the way you 
balance that to maintain yourself is...

fields.EN:
...by boosting your ego through expressions of 
"beauty," right?
fields.JP:
唯一エゴを出す行為が
『綺麗』にすることなんだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
...by boosting your ego through expressions of 
"beauty," right?

fields.EN: Your kindness is born from your ego.
fields.JP:
君のやさしさは
君のエゴから生産されている
fields.LOCALIZED: Your kindness is born from your ego.

fields.EN:
We'll ignore your lack of planning for now. But in this 
situation, I find it very touching that you had gone to 
look for my wife's hint for my sake.
fields.JP:
計画性のなさはさておき、今回の件で
僕のために妻の手がかりを
探してくれたことはとてもうれしい
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll ignore your lack of planning for now. But in this 
situation, I find it very touching that you had gone to 
look for my wife's hint for my sake.

fields.EN:
To know that someone would go that far
for me relieves me emotionally.
fields.JP:
一人でもそんな風に親身になってくれることは
精神的に救われるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
To know that someone would go that far
for me relieves me emotionally.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
And if your kindness is driven by your desire
to be "beautiful," then I think that act is
wonderful.
fields.JP:
その君のやさしさの原動力が「キレイになりたい」
というモノならば、僕はその行為は
素晴らしいものだと思う
fields.LOCALIZED:
And if your kindness is driven by your desire
to be "beautiful," then I think that act is
wonderful.

fields.EN:
Hehe... Juu-san, you really do think too seriously 
about things.
fields.JP:
ふふ……。
ジュウさんは本当に難しく考える人ですのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe... Toh, you really do think too seriously 
about things.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
But it makes me happy that you thought
so much about me...
fields.JP:
でも、嬉しいですわ
わたくしのことをそこまで考えてくれて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it makes me happy that you thought
so much about me...

fields.EN:
And the fact that you have accepted me. 
That makes me happy too. Truly...
fields.JP:
そして、認めてくださったこと、
嬉しく思いますわ。
とても……
fields.LOCALIZED:
And the fact that you have accepted me. 
That makes me happy too. Truly...

fields.EN:
(Although we had a little altercation,
 I'm glad I was able to understand Cinderella...)
fields.JP:
（わずかな行き違いはあったが
　シンデレラのことを理解出来てよかった……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Although we had a little altercation,
 I'm glad I was able to understand Cinderella...)

fields.EN:
(I guess this is another one of those 
"slow and steady wins the race" situations.)
fields.JP:
（たぶん、これもひとつの
　『急がば回れ』なのだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I guess this is another one of those 
"slow and steady wins the race" situations.)

fields.EN:
(Heh... Although she's a troublemaker, I could
learn a thing or two from her work ethic.)
fields.JP:
（ふっ……。　色々と世話は焼けるが、
　その感情に一生懸命な姿は見習わなきゃな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Heh... Although she's a troublemaker, I could
learn a thing or two from her work ethic.)

fields.EN:
(It's almost time to go on exploring, but...
Cinderella and Oyayubihime haven't
come out yet.)
fields.JP:
（そろそろ今日の探索の時間だが……
　シンデレラと親指姫が来ていない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's almost time to go on exploring, but...
Cinderella and Thumbelina haven't
come out yet.)

fields.EN: (Very well, I'll go check on this...)
fields.JP:
（仕方ない。
　様子を見に行くか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Very well, I'll go check on this...)

fields.EN: Cinderella it's time to go exploring. I've come for you.
fields.JP:
シンデレラ、
もう探索の時間だ。
迎えにきた
fields.LOCALIZED: Cinderella it's time to go exploring. I've come for you.

fields.EN: I'm going to open the door. Is that okay?
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm going to open the door. Is that okay?

fields.JP:
あらジュウさん！？
だ、大丈夫ですわよ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP: ああ、親指姫もいたのか

fields.EN: Oh, it's already that time? We must hurry.
fields.JP:
あら、もうそんな時間なのね
いそがなきゃだわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's already that time? We must hurry.

fields.EN: We're almost done Juu-san. Will you wait?
fields.JP:
ジュウさんあと少しなので、
お待ち頂けます？
fields.LOCALIZED: We're almost done Toh. Will you wait?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN:
Please wait a moment. I'm contemplating
which bracelet to wear for today.
fields.JP:
ちょっと待ってくださいませね。
今手首につけるブレスレットを
どれにするかで悩んでますの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please wait a moment. I'm contemplating
which bracelet to wear for today.

fields.EN: Yeah, it's hard to decide which shape to wear.
fields.JP: どの形状にするか迷うところよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, it's hard to decide which shape to wear.

fields.EN:
(Bracelets, gloves, and hair ties are all over the
place. They all look the same to me...)
fields.JP:
（ブレスレットや手袋、髪留めが散乱してるな。
　どれも大きな違いを感じないが……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Bracelets, gloves, and hair ties are all over the
place. They all look the same to me...)

fields.EN:
I think this hairtie will pair nicely with this
bracelet.
fields.JP:
このブレスレットなら
髪飾りはこちらがかわいいですわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think this hairtie will pair nicely with this
bracelet.

fields.JP:
そうね。
センス良いわね

fields.EN: Ohoho. It's an honor to receive your praise.
fields.JP: おほほ、お褒めいただき光栄ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohoho. It's an honor to receive your praise.

fields.EN: Then I'm going to prepare in this style.
fields.JP: では、今日はこの形で揃えますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then I'm going to prepare in this style.

fields.EN: Okay. Then I'll do the hair.
fields.JP:
オッケー。
それじゃ最後に髪をセットするわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay. Then I'll do the hair.

fields.EN: Hehe. I learned how to do it fast so I'll try it out.
fields.JP:
ふふ、髪結いの早技を覚えたから
試してあげるわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I learned how to do it fast so I'll try it out.

fields.EN:
Amazing. Oyayubihime-san, you're so 
good with your hands.
fields.JP:
さすがですのね。
親指姫さんは手先が器用ですわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Amazing. Thumbelina, you're so 
good with your hands.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Man, getting ready sure seems to 
be a chore for Cinderella.
fields.JP: やはりシンデレラは色々準備が大変そうだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Man, getting ready sure seems to 
be a chore for Cinderella.

fields.EN: Of course I'll make it in time.
fields.JP:
も、もちろん
間に合いますわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course I'll make it in time.

fields.JP: ありがとうございますわ

fields.EN: Oh, this is different than I imagined.
fields.JP: あら、想像と違ったわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, this is different than I imagined.

fields.EN:
I thought you were going to say,
"It's a waste of time, it's not efficient."
fields.JP:
わたしはてっきりジュウだから時間の無駄だ、
効率的じゃないって言われると思ったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought you were going to say,
"It's a waste of time, it's not efficient."

fields.EN: Well, I would have said that.
fields.JP: うむ、確かに今までの僕だったらそうだったろう
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, I would have said that.

fields.EN:
But I also understand these things that seem 
mundane is an important routine.
fields.JP:
ただ、こういう一見無意味に見えることも
大事なルーティンだとわかってる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I also understand these things that seem 
mundane is an important routine.

fields.EN: This is an important way of getting ready right?
fields.JP: これも重要な準備と言うことだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED: This is an important way of getting ready right?

fields.EN: That makes me happy if you put it that way.
fields.JP:
そう言ってもらえると、
嬉しいですわ
fields.LOCALIZED: That makes me happy if you put it that way.

fields.EN:
You're more understanding than you let off.
So how do you think Cinderella looks?
fields.JP:
思ったより理解があるじゃない。
ちなみに今日のシンデレラの格好はどうかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're more understanding than you let off.
So how do you think Cinderella looks?

fields.EN: Hm... I don't know. I would know if it's about my wife.
fields.JP:
うむ……わからない
妻のことならわかるのだが
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm... I don't know. I would know if it's about my wife.

fields.EN: Hehe. I thought you'd say that.
fields.JP: ふふ、そういうと思ってましたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I thought you'd say that.

fields.EN: That part of you doesn't change huh?
fields.JP: そこは相変わらずなのね
fields.LOCALIZED: That part of you doesn't change huh?

fields.EN:
Well, I'm going to do your hair for real now. No more 
talking, we're going to focus!
fields.JP:
まっ本格的に髪結いしていくわ！
おしゃべりはおしまい。集中するわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm going to do your hair for real now. No more 
talking, we're going to focus!

fields.EN: Juu-san, please give me one moment.
fields.JP:
ジュウさん、
あと少しだけお待ちくださいませ
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh, please give me one moment.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.JP:
そうね。
１００秒で仕上げるんだから！

fields.EN:
Heh... I'll wait outside. Just come out when you're 
done.
fields.JP:
ふっ……僕は外で待ってるから、
準備を終えたら来てくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Heh... I'll wait outside. Just come out when you're 
done.

fields.JP: ふふ、色々ご理解ありがとうございますわ
（誰かの楽しそうな声が聞こえてくるな）
わたくしだと思いますの
完全にわたしだとおもうけどね

fields.EN:
I'm not as confident as before but I would say me if it's 
between the three of us.
fields.JP:
前より自信はないけど、
あんたたち二人ならあたしじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not as confident as before but I would say me if it's 
between the three of us.

fields.EN:
(That's Akazukin, Oyayubihime, and Cinderella... 
They seem to be debating something.)
fields.JP:
（あれは赤ずきん、親指姫にシンデレラ……
　なにやら主張しているようだが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's Red Riding Hood, Thumbelina, and Cinderella... 
They seem to be debating something.)

fields.EN: (Whatever. I'm going back to my room.)
fields.JP:
（まぁいい。
　自分の部屋へ戻ろう）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Whatever. I'm going back to my room.)

fields.EN: Juu! You came at a perfect time.
fields.JP:
ジュウ！
ちょうどいいところに来たね
fields.LOCALIZED: Toh! You came at a perfect time.

fields.EN: Now we can finally have someone judge this!
fields.JP: ようやくこれでジャッジができるわね！

fields.EN:
(Judge...? I don't know what it is, but I can
already sense it'll be a headache.)
fields.JP:
（ジャッジ……？
　よくわからないが面倒ごとな気はするな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Judge...? I don't know what it is, but I can
already sense it'll be a headache.)

fields.JP: でも、ジュウさんはお忙しそうですわ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: It will only take a few minutes. You're good right?
fields.JP:
ほんの２、３分の用事よ。
いいよね？
fields.LOCALIZED: It will only take a few minutes. You're good right?

fields.EN:
I'm sure you won't let me go until I answer.
So hurry up and tell me what you want.
fields.JP:
どうせその言い分じゃ答えると言うまで
聞いてくるのだろう。
早めに要件だけ聞く
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you won't let me go until I answer.
So hurry up and tell me what you want.

fields.EN:
Hehe. You're starting to understand Akazukin-san
pretty well, Juu-san.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ジュウさんも大分赤ずきんさんが
わかってきましたわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. You're starting to understand Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): 赤ずきん => Red Riding Hood-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: (I don't know if that's a good thing... Well, I guess it is.)
fields.JP:
（それが良い事かどうかわからないが、
　まぁ良いことか）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I don't know if that's a good thing.)

fields.EN:
This is a very important question. This matters with 
our identity.
fields.JP:
とても大事な質問があるの。
あたしたちのアイデンティティーに関わることよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is a very important question. This matters with 
our identity.

fields.EN:
Who among us is better served to be the
older sister-type? Could you rank us?
fields.JP:
三人の中で誰が一番お姉さんっぽい？
順番をつけてほしいんだけど？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who among us is better served to be the
older sister-type? Could you rank us?

fields.EN: Hey what do you mean by that?!
fields.JP: ちょっとくだらないってなによ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey what do you mean by that?!

fields.EN: This is very important for us!
fields.JP: わたし達の中じゃ結構重要なのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is very important for us!

fields.EN: (Really? They don't seem to have the kind of relationship where knowing that would put one above the others.)
fields.JP:
（そうなのか？
　それが分かったことで優劣が付くような
　関係性には見えないが）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Really? None of them are special enough for
me to draw any distinctions.)

fields.EN: You don't plan to answer, do you?
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't plan to answer, do you?

fields.EN:
I'm thinking. Something tells me you'd pester
me if I didn't.
fields.JP:
いや考えているのだ……
どうせ答えねば解放してくれないのだろうし
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm thinking. Something tells me you'd pester
me if I didn't.

fields.EN:
Gotta admit, I didn't think you'd play along.
So who is it?
fields.JP:
思ったより乗り気ね
で、誰？　誰？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gotta admit, I didn't think you'd play along.
So who is it?

fields.EN: I told you I'm thinking didn't I?
fields.JP: 今考えていると言ったろう
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you I'm thinking didn't I?

fields.JP:
そうですわよ。
赤ずきんさんはせっかちすぎますわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, you're too hasty Red Riding Hood.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: I would say Oyayubihime is number one.
fields.LOCALIZED: I would say Thumbelina is number one.

fields.JP:
そ、そんな！
うそですわ！

fields.EN: Why would I lie about something so dumb?
fields.JP: こんなつまらない嘘をつく理由がない
fields.LOCALIZED: Why would I lie about something so dumb?

fields.JP:
ふふん
まあ、当然よね

fields.EN: That's not a real answer! What's your reasoning?
fields.JP:
納得いかないなー！
理由は？
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not a real answer! What's your reasoning?

fields.EN:
At first, she didn't seem like much of an older
sister.
fields.JP:
初めは見た目的にまったく姉に
見えなかったのだが……
fields.LOCALIZED:
At first, she didn't seem like much of an older
sister.

fields.EN:
Disrespecting me from the get-go! Where
do you get off?!
fields.JP:
って、いきなり落とすわね！
見た目的にってどういうことよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Disrespecting me from the get-go! Where
do you get off?!

fields.EN: Hold on, Oyayubihime-san. He said, "at first."
fields.JP:
お待ちください、親指姫さん。
初めは、と言ってますのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Hold on, Thumbelina. He said, "at first."
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 親指姫さん => Thumbelina-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
But once I finally spoke to her, her maturity
shone through.
fields.JP:
実際に接してみれば、
中身は思ったより姉だと感じた
fields.LOCALIZED:
But once I finally spoke to her, her maturity
shone through.

fields.JP: ふふ、まあ、そうでしょうね

fields.EN: How do you feel that though?
fields.JP: どこでそう思ったわけ？
fields.LOCALIZED: How do you feel that though?

fields.EN:
She always looks out for her younger sisters,
and acts decisively when the moment calls.
fields.JP:
よく年下の面倒をみているし、実は決断力もある
白雪姫がいるのも要素としては大きい
fields.LOCALIZED:
She always looks out for her younger sisters,
and acts decisively when the moment calls.

fields.EN:
Juu-san's words are so convincing,
it's hard to refute them...
fields.JP:
ジュウさんの言葉は説得力あって
反論しづらいですわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Toh's words are so convincing,
it's hard to refute them...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジュウさん => Toh-san | source-gated Toh => Juu

fields.EN: (Oh god I have to come up with the 2nd too...)
fields.JP: （２番目も決めなければならないのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh god I have to come up with the 2nd too...)

fields.JP:
な、なんでですのー！
理由はなんでですの！？

fields.EN:
Well she takes the initiative to lead the group. She's 
always trying to gather people together.
fields.JP:
理由は率先して相手の立場になろうとしたり、
取りまとめようとがんばっている様子がある
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well she takes the initiative to lead the group. She's 
always trying to gather people together.

fields.EN: Right?! But why aren't I number one then?
fields.JP:
でしょ！
って、なんでそれで一番じゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED: Right?! But why aren't I number one then?

fields.EN:
...Well the way she thinks is more like an older brother
than older sister. And she's an unreliable older 
brother.
fields.JP:
……ただ思考が姉というよりも兄のようにみえる。
それも頼りにならない兄だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Well the way she thinks is more like an older brother
than older sister. And she's an unreliable older 
brother.

fields.EN:
What do you mean older brother?! We've changed 
genders here!
fields.JP:
兄ってどういうこと！
性別変わってるじゃない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean older brother?! We've changed 
genders here!

fields.EN: Um, so why am I not like an older sister?
fields.JP:
あの、わたくしはどうして
お姉さんらしくないのでございましょう？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, so why am I not like an older sister?

fields.EN:
What do you mean? You act in a manner
more fitting for the youngest sibling.
fields.JP:
そもそもシンデレラは
お姉さんらしいもなにも末っ子の要素が強いだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean? You act in a manner
more fitting for the youngest sibling.

fields.JP: そ……そんな……末っ子ですの？

fields.EN: So that means all of my hard work was for nothing.
fields.JP:
今までの努力はすべて実を結んで
いなかったということですのね
fields.LOCALIZED: So that means all of my hard work was for nothing.

fields.EN: (What kind of work did she put in...?)
fields.JP:
（いったいどんな努力を
　してきたのだろうか……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What kind of work did she put in...?)

fields.JP:
ドンマイ！
シンデレラ！

fields.EN: Yeah, who's older sister material doesn't matter.
fields.JP: そうよ、姉かどうかなんて重要じゃないわよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, who's older sister material doesn't matter.

fields.EN: Ugh! You guys are making fun of me!
fields.JP:
もう！
お二人共からかってますわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh! You guys are making fun of me!

fields.JP: （うむ、更に騒がしくなってきたな……）

fields.EN:
(I don't understand what the big deal over
being the older sister is. But I hesitate to ask,
knowing the answer wouldn't satisfy me.)
fields.JP:
（なぜそんなに姉に見えることが重要かわからないが……
　これ以上聞いても実のある答えは返ってこないだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't understand what the big deal over
being the older sister is. But I hesitate to ask,
knowing the answer wouldn't satisfy me.)

fields.EN: (I'm going to return to my room while I can.)
fields.JP: （いまのうちに自分の部屋に戻ろう）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'm going to return to my room while I can.)

fields.JP: （他に会っておきたい人いるかな……？）

fields.EN: Oh, I know. I'll see what Charlotte-san's up to.
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ。
今のうちにシャーロットさんに
会いに行ってみようかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I know. I'll see what Charlotte's up to.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: I'd love to pick her brain a little bit.
fields.JP: いろいろと聞いてみたいこともあるんだよね
fields.LOCALIZED: I'd love to pick her brain a little bit.

fields.JP: ジャックくーん、いるかしらー？

fields.EN: Oh, Charlotte-san? Hold on a minute!
fields.JP:
えっ、シャーロットさん？
ちょっと待っててください！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, Charlotte? Hold on a minute!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP: こんにちは。来ちゃった

fields.EN:
Wow... I was just thinking that I wanted to see you
too, Charlotte-san.
fields.JP:
すごいな……。
たった今、僕もシャーロットさんに
会いたいと思ってたところなんですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Perfect timing. I was meaning to
talk to you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Really? I had the strangest feeling that
might be the case.
fields.JP:
驚いた？
ちょうどこの前を通りかかったとき、
なんとなくそんな感じがしたのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I had the strangest feeling that
might be the case.

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's more than perfect timing.
She seems pretty intuitive.)
fields.JP:
（タイミングがいい……というより、
　ものすごく勘の鋭い人だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's more than perfect timing.
She seems pretty intuitive.)

fields.EN:
Um, how've you been? Fitting in well
with everyone?
fields.JP:
えーと、調子はどうですか？
慣れない環境で体調を崩したり
してませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, how've you been? Fitting in well
with everyone?

fields.EN:
Oh, is that what you wanted to talk about?
How thoughtful of you.
fields.JP:
あら、そんなことだったのね。
そのためだけに会いに来ようとしてたなんて、
優しいのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, is that what you wanted to talk about?
How thoughtful of you.

fields.EN:
I can see why Alice thinks so highly of you.
Hehe.
fields.JP:
アリスが大好きになっちゃうのも
納得できるわ、ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can see why Alice thinks so highly of you.
Hehe.

fields.EN:
Huh? What's this got to do with Alice?
I wanted to talk to you, Charlotte-san.
fields.JP:
へっ？
あ、アリスは今関係ないじゃないですか。
僕はシャーロットさんのことを……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? What's this got to do with Alice?
I wanted to talk to you, Charlotte.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Hehe. Right you are. Well, I'm just peachy.
Thanks for asking.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そうだったわね。
おかげさまで私は元気よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Right you are. Well, I'm just peachy.
Thanks for asking.

fields.EN:
Right. Good to know. You're not having
a hard time adjusting at all?
fields.JP:
そ、そうですか。よかった……。
生活で不便に感じていることなんかは
ありませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Good to know. You're not having
a hard time adjusting at all?

fields.EN:
Hm. Nothing comes to mind. I wouldn't
call myself comfortable, but we're all in
the same boat. No complaints here.
fields.JP:
そうね、特には……。
快適とはいかないけど、それは他の人たちと
同じ条件だもの。文句なんてないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Nothing comes to mind. I wouldn't
call myself comfortable, but we're all in
the same boat. No complaints here.

fields.JP: ジャックくんだって同じでしょ？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN: Yeah, that's true. Since we're managing to get by like this, we can't really ask for comfort too.
fields.JP:
まあ、それもそうですね。
こうしてなんとか暮らしていけてるんだから、
快適さまでは求められませんよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, I'd say the same. Having each other's
what matters now.

fields.EN:
You're an enigma, Charlotte-san. You seem
to see through us all.
fields.JP:
……シャーロットさんは不思議な人ですね。
僕たちのことをなんでもお見通しみたいだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're an enigma, Charlotte. You seem
to see through us all.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
I've wanted to ask you this, Charlotte-san. How do
you know things you shouldn't know?
fields.JP:
一度、聞いてみたかったんです。
どうしてシャーロットさんは
知らないはずのことを知っているんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been meaning to ask you. How exactly
do you know so much?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
You even know some of our companions
you haven't met yet. Stuff only we'd know.
It's like you've seen it all.
fields.JP:
ここにいないメンバーのことや、
僕たちしか知らないはずのことまで……。
まるで見てきたみたいに知っているなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
You even know some of our companions
you haven't met yet. Stuff only we'd know.
It's like you've seen it all.

fields.EN: It's not like I can see everything. But "as if you've seen it" is a pretty perceptive way to put it.
fields.JP:
なんでもお見通しってわけじゃないわ。
でも見てきたみたいっていうのは、
なかなか鋭い表現ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, that's not quite correct. You make
me sound like some kind of psychic.
It's a little more complicated than that.

fields.EN: It's hard to explain, it's a kind of vision.
fields.JP: なんていうか、私、見えちゃうのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's hard to explain, it's a kind of vision.

fields.EN:
When I shut my eyes, it feels like I can
see the world through a bird's eye view.
fields.JP:
こう、目をつぶるとね？
世界が俯瞰的に見えたり、人の視界を
自分の視界のように感じたりするの
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I shut my eyes, it feels like I can
see the world through a bird's eye view.

fields.EN:
For example, that time you happened to see
Oyayubi-chan putting on her first bra, Jack-kun...
fields.JP:
たとえばジャックくんが前に、
親指ちゃんが初めてのブラをつけるところを
たまたま目撃しちゃった光景とか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kinda like how I can see that memory of
you accidentally seeing Thumbelina in her
bra.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Or when you fell asleep with Rapu-chan biting your
arm, Jack-kun. And then...
fields.JP:
ジャックくんがラプちゃんに腕を噛まれたまま
一緒に寝ちゃったこととか。
あとはそれから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Or how you fell asleep with Rappy biting
your arm, and...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
H-How do you know all that?!
None of that was my fault! Um...!
fields.JP:
な、な、なんでそれを！？
き、基本それは不可抗力で、その……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
H-How do you know all that?!
None of that was my fault! Um...!

fields.EN:
No need to panic, Jack-kun. I know you didn't mean
for any of it to happen.
fields.JP:
慌てなくても大丈夫よ。
ジャックくんが意図したわけじゃ
ないってわかっているから
fields.LOCALIZED:
No need to panic. I know you didn't put
yourself in those situations, per se.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(I can't lie. I know she didn't mean to, but
she freaks me out.)
fields.JP:
（こ、この人に嘘はつけないぞ。
　いや、つく気もないけど。
　やっぱり不思議な人だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't lie. I know she didn't mean to, but
she freaks me out.)

fields.EN:
Oh...! Charlotte-san, can you see what the others
are doing right now?
fields.JP:
あ……そうだ！　シャーロットさんなら
他のメンバーが今どうなってるかとかも
わかったりしませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh...! Charlotte, can you see what the others
are doing right now?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: That's the thing... I don't remember whether it started after we came to the surface, but lately that ability has been weakening.
fields.JP:
それがねぇ……地上に出てきてから
なのかはよく覚えていないんだけど、
最近はその能力が衰えてきちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's the thing. Since we got here,
I've been out of touch with my vision.

fields.EN:
I only have a faint idea of what's going on,
unlike before.
fields.JP:
前と違って、すごくふわっとしたことしか
わからなくなっちゃったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I only have a faint idea of what's going on,
unlike before.

fields.EN: I wonder why that is. Inconvenient, isn't it?
fields.JP:
ホントなんでかしらねぇ？
困っちゃうわよねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder why that is. Inconvenient, isn't it?

fields.JP:
（なんだか他人事みたいなノリだな。
　深刻そうにされるよりはいいけど……）

fields.EN: But meeting Alice here feels like some kind of fate.
fields.JP:
でもね、ここでアリスと出会えたことは
一つの運命のような気がするの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Something tells me that my path will
cross with Alice's soon.

fields.EN:
It's hard to explain, but it's as though
I've fallen into a fairy tale. But that
would be preposterous, wouldn't it? Hehe.
fields.JP:
なんていうか、今まで見てた本の世界に
入っちゃったみたいな……。
メルヘンすぎるかしらね、ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hard to explain, but it's as though
I've fallen into a fairy tale. But that
would be preposterous, wouldn't it? Hehe.

fields.EN:
I suppose we are in a story of sorts.
Not that I mind.
fields.JP:
まあ、当事者っていうのかしら？
なんにせよ、嫌な気分じゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I suppose we are in a story of sorts.
Not that I mind.

fields.EN: Hahaha. That's a funny way of looking at things.
fields.JP: あはは……なんか変わった表現ですね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha. That's a funny way of looking at things.

fields.EN:
(Charlotte-san has no idea what the scope of
her power is.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、シャーロットさん自身も
　自分の能力についてよくわかっている
　わけじゃなかったのか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Charlotte has no idea what the scope of
her power is.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Sorry for all the questions. I understand
if you don't want to talk about it.
fields.JP:
話しづらいことかもしれないのに、
ずかずか聞いちゃってすみませんでした
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for all the questions. I understand
if you don't want to talk about it.

fields.EN:
It's fine, don't hold back. If you have more,
I'm all ears.
fields.JP:
いいのよ。
これからも聞きたいことがあれば
遠慮せず聞いてね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine, don't hold back. If you have more,
I'm all ears.

fields.EN:
I'm happy to be here, Jack-kun. Mary and I look
forward to getting to know you better.
fields.JP:
私はジャックくんたちと仲間になれて
よかったって思ってるわ。
メアリーともども、よろしくね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm happy to be here, Jack. Mary and I look
forward to getting to know you better.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Alice, what do you think of this dish?
I changed the recipe a bit.
fields.JP:
アリス、この料理はどうかしら？
調理方法をちょっと工夫したんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, what do you think of this dish?
I changed the recipe a bit.

fields.EN: Oh, it's delicious! Jack, try it.
fields.JP:
ん、これおいしい！
ジャックも食べてみて
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, it's delicious! Jack, try it.

fields.EN:
*nom nom*... Oh!
That is really tasty.
fields.JP:
もぐもぐ……うん！
すごくおいしいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*nom nom*... Oh!
That is really tasty.

fields.EN:
Glad you like it. We don't have much in
the way of ingredients, but I hoped it'd
have a little flavor.
fields.JP:
口に合ってよかったわ。
食材はあまり多くないけど、作り方を
工夫すれば飽きずに食べられると思って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Glad you like it. We don't have much in
the way of ingredients, but I hoped it'd
have a little flavor.

fields.EN: Wow. That's real nice of you, Charlotte-san.
fields.JP:
なるほど。
シャーロットさんはすごいなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. That's real nice of you, Charlotte.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: ...Jack, do you like a woman who can cook?
fields.JP: ……ジャックは料理ができる女の人がいいの？
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Jack, do you like a woman who can cook?

fields.EN:
Huh? Everyone loves a good cook, but it
shouldn't be a requirement.
fields.JP:
え？　まあ男でも女でも
できたほうがいいとは思うけど、
できなきゃいけないとも思わないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? Everyone loves a good cook, but it
shouldn't be a requirement.

fields.EN:
Hehe. Alice, you'll pick it up in no time.
I can teach you.
fields.JP:
ふふ、アリスだって料理くらい
できるようになるわよ。
私がいつだって教えてあげるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Alice, you'll pick it up in no time.
I can teach you.

fields.EN:
But don't let dinner get cold. Dig in.
We've got bread too.
fields.JP:
それより今は料理が冷めないうちにどうぞ。
おかわりもあるわよ。
パンもあるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But don't let dinner get cold. Dig in.
We've got bread too.

fields.JP: すごいや、パンなんて作ったんですか？

fields.EN:
It's not leavened, so I wouldn't call it bread.
But with what we got, it's close enough.
fields.JP:
ちょっと不格好で、パンと呼んでいいのか
わからないけどね。作り方を試行錯誤して、
どうにかパンに近いものを作ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's not leavened, so I wouldn't call it bread.
But with what we got, it's close enough.

fields.EN: The fruits of all your hard work. Thank you.
fields.JP:
シャーロットの努力の結晶というわけね。
ありがたくいただくわ
fields.LOCALIZED: The fruits of all your hard work. Thank you.

fields.EN:
Alice, there's water too.
Don't rush to eat and choke, okay?
fields.JP:
アリス、お水もあるわよ。
慌てて食べて、喉に詰まらせないようにね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, there's water too.
Don't rush to eat and choke, okay?

fields.JP: さすがにそこまで慌てて食べないわよ……

fields.EN:
(Charlotte-san's generous, but she seems to
baby Alice sometimes.)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさんって面倒見がいいけど、
　特にアリスに対しては異様に世話を
　焼きたがるんだよな。なぜか……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Charlotte's generous, but she seems to
baby Alice sometimes.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(Man, this bread is yummy! Charlotte-san
played it down. I could eat this all day.)
fields.JP:
（……あ、このパンおいしい！
　さっきシャーロットさんは謙遜してたけど、
　全然イケるじゃないか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, this bread is yummy! Charlotte
played it down. I could eat this all day.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Hey Alice, you've got crumbs. Want me
to wipe them?
fields.JP:
あらアリス、口の端が汚れちゃってるわ。
拭いてあげましょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Alice, you've got crumbs. Want me
to wipe them?

fields.EN: I'll do it myself. I'm fine!
fields.JP: じ、自分で拭くから大丈夫よ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll do it myself. I'm fine!

fields.EN:
Hey Charlotte, you don't have to treat
me like a kid. Why are you so worried
about me?
fields.JP:
もう、シャーロット。
あまりわたしを子ども扱いしないで。
どうしてそこまで心配するの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Charlotte, you don't have to treat
me like a kid. Why are you so worried
about me?

fields.EN:
Hm. I wonder... For some reason, I feel
this need to protect you.
fields.JP:
うーん、なぜかしらね……。
なんだかアリスのことは
無性に構いたくなっちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. I wonder... For some reason, I feel
this need to protect you.

fields.EN: It's instinctual. I can't place it.
fields.JP:
こう、本能に訴えかけるなにかがあるのよ。
なにかが
fields.LOCALIZED: It's instinctual. I can't place it.

fields.EN:
That doesn't say much. But if it's okay,
I'd like you to tone it down.
fields.JP:
なにかって、ずいぶんふわっとしてるわね。
あまり構い倒されても困るから、
ほどほどにしてほしいわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That doesn't say much. But if it's okay,
I'd like you to tone it down.

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san, this bread is incredible.
Mind if I get seconds?
fields.JP:
シャーロットさん、このパンおいしいですね。
もう一個もらってもいいですか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, this bread is incredible.
Mind if I get seconds?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Sure. Go ahead. Pleased you like it.
fields.JP: ええ、どうぞ。喜んでもらえてうれしいわ。
fields.LOCALIZED: Sure. Go ahead. Pleased you like it.

fields.EN:
You stuffed your mouth with bread just
then, didn't you? It's not THAT delicious.
fields.JP:
今、パンを手にとって
そのまま口に運ぼうとしたでしょ。
あまり美しい食べ方じゃないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You stuffed your mouth with bread just
then, didn't you? It's not THAT delicious.

fields.EN: You should cut them into bite-size pieces.
fields.JP: ちゃんと一口サイズにちぎって食べないとダメよ
fields.LOCALIZED: You should cut them into bite-size pieces.

fields.JP: そ、そうなのね。ごめんなさい……

fields.EN:
(I was doing the same thing, but she's
not looking out for it. Guess she's got
a favorite.)
fields.JP:
（僕もそのまま普通に食べてたんだけど
　注意されなかったな……。
　やっぱりアリスが特別ってことか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was doing the same thing, but she's
not looking out for it. Guess she's got
a favorite.)

fields.EN: (Still, the way those two interact feels like more than just companions... Um, what do you call something like that...?)
fields.JP:
（それにしてもこの二人のやりとりって、
　仲間っていうよりも……えーと、
　こういうの、なんていうんだっけ……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(They seem pretty close...
What's going on here?)

fields.EN:
(The way she's acting makes me think
Blood Libido, but I wonder if that could
be triggered by a specific person.)
fields.JP:
（アリスを構いたくて仕方ないっていうのは
　血式リビドーっぽいけど、こんな特定の個人に
　向けられるリビドーなんてあるのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The way she's acting makes me think
Blood Libido, but I wonder if that could
be triggered by a specific person.)

fields.EN: (Hm. Or is it a Charlotte-san thing? Think, think.)
fields.JP:
（うーん……単にシャーロットさんの性格？
　でもそれにしては……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Hm. Or is it a Charlotte thing? Think, think.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Jack-kun, you stopped eating. Everything okay?
fields.JP: ジャックくん、手が止まってるけど大丈夫？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, you stopped eating. Everything okay?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: え、ああ……ちょっと考え事をしてました
もしかして悩み事とか……？

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Not at all. Don't worry so much,
Alice.
fields.JP:
はは、そんなんじゃないよ。
アリスは心配性だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Not at all. Don't worry so much,
Alice.

fields.EN: But I can't help it around you.
fields.JP: ジャックのことなら心配するのは当然でしょ
fields.LOCALIZED: But I can't help it around you.

fields.EN: My, my. Is Jack-kun all you think about?
fields.JP:
あらあら、相変わらずアリスは
ジャックくんのことが……
fields.LOCALIZED: My, my. Is Jack all you think about?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Anyway Jack, you're always caught up in
something. Just enjoy your meal.
fields.JP:
……とにかく。
ジャックはいつもいろんなことを考えていて
偉いけど、今は食事を楽しみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway Jack, you're always caught up in
something. Just enjoy your meal.

fields.JP: うん、せっかくの食事なんだしね

fields.EN: (But when the three of us eat together like this, sometimes I feel kind of embarrassed...? I wonder why.)
fields.JP:
（だけどこの三人で食事をしていると、
　たまに気恥ずかしい気分になるような……？
　なんでだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(For some reason, I feel like the third
wheel here.)

fields.EN:
Alice, do you know how to eat this fruit?
Want me to peel it for you?
fields.JP:
アリス、この果物は食べ方わかる？
皮剥いてあげましょうか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, do you know how to eat this fruit?
Want me to peel it for you?

fields.EN: I said I'm fine, honestly! You're throwing me off...
fields.JP:
だから大丈夫よ、本当にもう！
調子狂っちゃうじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED: Seriously, again? You're driving me nuts.

fields.EN:
(Alice acts playfully around Charlotte-san.
It's cute to watch.)
fields.JP:
（シャーロットさんといるときのアリスは、
　普段見せない表情をするから
　ちょっとおもしろいんだよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice acts playfully around Charlotte.
It's cute to watch.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(Maybe Alice has a soft spot for Charlotte-san
too.)
fields.JP:
（アリスにとってもシャーロットさんは
　特別ってことなのかもな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Alice has a soft spot for Charlotte
too.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(I feel dizzy all of a sudden.
Maybe I'm anemic. I'll rest a little...)
fields.JP:
（急にめまいが……貧血かな。
　ちょっとだけ休もう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel dizzy all of a sudden.
Maybe I'm anemic. I'll rest a little...)

fields.EN:
Phew. I'm tired. I'm glad this wasn't
during a battle...
fields.JP:
ふぅ……しんどい……。
でも戦闘中とかじゃなくてよかった……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. I'm tired. I'm glad this wasn't
during a battle...

fields.EN: Jack-kun? What are you doing here?
fields.JP:
ジャックくん？
そんなところでどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack? What are you doing here?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Oh! You look pale.
Are you sick?
fields.JP:
！　顔色がよくないわ。
もしかして具合が悪いんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! You look pale.
Are you sick?

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san, Alice...
I just feel a little dizzy.
It's not a big deal.
fields.JP:
シャーロットさん、アリス……。
ちょっと貧血気味でめまいがしただけだから、
大したことないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, Alice...
I just feel a little dizzy.
It's not a big deal.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Not a big deal? You need to take care of
yourself. What if you faint?!
fields.JP:
大したことないだなんて……
あなたはもっと自分の体を大事にして。
無理して倒れたらどうするの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not a big deal? You need to take care of
yourself. What if you faint?!

fields.JP: ジャックくん、ちょっと失礼するわよ
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Whoa Charlotte-san!
You don't have to carry me!
fields.JP:
うわわっ、シャーロットさん！
な、なにも抱っこしなくても！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa Charlotte!
You don't have to carry me!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(She's princess-holding me. I'M the
princess here!)
fields.JP:
（しかもこれはいわゆる
　お姫様抱っこというやつでは？
　まさか僕が抱っこされる側になるなんて！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's princess-holding me. I'M the
princess here!)

fields.JP:
ちょっ、シャーロット！
ジャックならわたしが……！

fields.EN: I only need a bit. Here we are.
fields.JP:
ちょっとそこまで運ぶだけよ。
はい、とうちゃーく
fields.LOCALIZED: I only need a bit. Here we are.

fields.EN:
You'll feel better if you lie down. There
you go. Head on my lap.
fields.JP:
横になったほうが気分もよくなるかも
しれないわ。はい、横になって。
頭は私のお膝にね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll feel better if you lie down. There
you go. Head on my lap.

fields.JP:
（お姫様抱っこから流れるように
　膝枕されてしまった……）

fields.EN:
Um. You really don't have to do all this.
This happens all the time.
fields.JP:
あ、あの、ここまでしてもらわなくても
大丈夫なんで。よくあることだし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. You really don't have to do all this.
This happens all the time.

fields.EN:
Oh, don't hold back. You're a little anemic because
you work so hard for everyone, Jack-kun, aren't you?
fields.JP:
あら、遠慮することないのよ。
ジャックくんが貧血気味なのだって、
みんなのためにがんばってくれてるからでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, shush. You're exhausted because you
spend all day worrying.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
This is my way of repaying you. I'd prefer
it if you relaxed.
fields.JP:
これはほんのお礼の気持ちよ。
受け取ってくれると嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my way of repaying you. I'd prefer
it if you relaxed.

fields.EN:
Just in case, should I ask the medical team
to do a check-up?
fields.JP:
念のため、医療班に診てもらいに
行ったほうがいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just in case, should I ask the medical team
to do a check-up?

fields.JP: いえ、そこまでするほどじゃないんで……

fields.EN:
Jack, are you thirsty at all?
You want me to bring you water?
fields.JP:
ジャック、喉かわかない？
お水もってくる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, are you thirsty at all?
You want me to bring you water?

fields.JP: ありがとう、大丈夫だよ

fields.EN: How about a fever? Let me see.
fields.JP: 熱は？　ちょっと測らせてね
fields.LOCALIZED: How about a fever? Let me see.

fields.EN: Hm. You're not hot. That's a good sign.
fields.JP: ……ん、熱はなさそうね。よかった
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm. You're not hot. That's a good sign.

fields.EN: How about your pulse? Give me your wrist.
fields.JP:
脈はどうかしら？
ちょっと手首を失礼……
fields.LOCALIZED: How about your pulse? Give me your wrist.

fields.EN:
Let's get you back to the tent. You can
rest there. I'll take you.
fields.JP:
もうテントに戻ってゆっくり休みましょ。
そのほうがいいに決まってるわ。
わたしが送っていくから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's get you back to the tent. You can
rest there. I'll take you.

fields.EN:
That's something for Jack-kun to decide.
What's the good in making the choice
for him?
fields.JP:
それはジャックくんが決めることでしょ？
あなたが強引に決めてどうするの
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's something for Jack to decide.
What's the good in making the choice
for him?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Isn't it a little insensitive not to consider
Jack-kun's condition or wishes?
fields.JP:
ジャックくんの体調も意志も考えないなんて、
少し無神経じゃないかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You must consider his wants and needs.
Doing otherwise is insensitive, no?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(Huh? I wonder what's wrong with Alice.
Is she panicking?)
fields.JP:
（？　アリス、どうしたんだろう。
　なんだか焦っているような……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Huh? I wonder what's wrong with Alice.
Is she panicking?)

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san, I don't mind.
Alice is only looking out for me...
fields.JP:
シャーロットさん、僕は気にしてません。
アリスは僕を心配してくれただけで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, I don't mind.
Alice is only looking out for me...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP:
（え？
　な、なんでアリスが泣きそうに？）

fields.EN:
(Alice is normally calm and collected.
I've never seen her like this.)
fields.JP:
（いつも冷静なアリスのあんな顔、
　初めて見たかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice is normally calm and collected.
I've never seen her like this.)

fields.EN: I wonder what's gotten into Alice.
fields.JP: どうしたのかしらね、アリスは
fields.LOCALIZED: I wonder what's gotten into Alice.

fields.EN: You were there the whole time.
fields.JP: いや、そんな他人事みたいな……
fields.LOCALIZED: You were there the whole time.

fields.EN:
Whole time...? Oh, that's right.
It's my fault, wasn't it?
fields.JP:
他人事……？
ああ、そうだったわね。
たしかにこれは私も当事者だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whole time...? Oh, that's right.
It's my fault, wasn't it?

fields.EN: That can be such a bother sometimes.
fields.JP: 当事者というのは難しいものね
fields.LOCALIZED: That can be such a bother sometimes.

fields.EN:
(What can be a bother...? Where is her
head at half the time?)
fields.JP:
（当事者が難しい？
　うーん、独特な感覚だな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What can be a bother...? Where is her
head at half the time?)

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, if you won't see the doctors,
then will you be okay to rest here alone?
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、医療班に行かないなら
しばらくこのまま休んでいる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, if you won't see the doctors,
then will you be okay to rest here alone?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
(I wonder if Alice is okay. I'm worried
she might break down.)
fields.JP:
（アリス、大丈夫かな。
　泣きそうな顔してたけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder if Alice is okay. I'm worried
she might break down.)

fields.EN:
(Just hope things don't get awkward
between her and Charlotte-san.)
fields.JP:
（このままアリスとシャーロットさんが
　気まずくならないといいんだけどな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Just hope things don't get awkward
between her and Charlotte.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(I'm so curious. Why does Charlotte-san
always seem so aloof?)
fields.JP:
（気になるな……。
　どうしてシャーロットさんは自分のことでも
　当事者意識が薄いんだろう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm so curious. Why does Charlotte
always seem so aloof?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
(And why's she so protective of Alice?
She hovered over her like a hawk the
other day.)
fields.JP:
（それに、アリスのことも……。
　いつもは過保護なくらいなのに、この間は
　諭すような感じで少し厳しくて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(And why's she so protective of Alice?
She hovered over her like a hawk the
other day.)

fields.EN:
(I hope Alice is okay... Charlotte-san scolded her,
and she looked about to cry...)
fields.JP:
（アリスは大丈夫かな……。
　シャーロットさんに注意されて、
　泣きそうになっていたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I hope Alice is okay. She was just about
ready to cry the other day...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Think I need some fresh air. It's better
than moping all day. Some exercise
should do the trick.
fields.JP:
……外に出ようかな。
一人で考えこんでいるより、
外をブラブラしてるほうが健康的だよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Think I need some fresh air. It's better
than moping all day. Some exercise
should do the trick.

fields.EN:
I... I came to see you. I wanted to
apologize for the other day.
fields.JP:
わたし……ジャックに会いに来たの。
あのときのことを謝りたくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I... I came to see you. I wanted to
apologize for the other day.

fields.EN: Without considering your condition, I tried to decide everything on my own... and in the end I left you behind while you were anemic.
fields.JP:
あなたの体調も考えず、自分で勝手に
決めようとして……。あげくのはてに、
貧血のジャックを置いていってしまったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hadn't considered your health, and I was
trying to make decisions for you. I left you
in your condition.

fields.EN:
I'm so sorry. Charlotte was right.
I hope you can find it in your heart
to forgive me.
fields.JP:
ごめんなさい。
シャーロットの言う通り、
わたしは無神経だったわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm so sorry. Charlotte was right.
I hope you can find it in your heart
to forgive me.

fields.EN: I don't mind. I know it was out of concern.
fields.JP:
僕は気にしてないよ。
アリスが僕を心配してくれたことは
よくわかっているから
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't mind. I know it was out of concern.

fields.EN:
In fact, I was more worried that things
would heat up between you and Charlotte-san.
fields.JP:
むしろ、アリスがシャーロットさんと
気まずくなったんじゃないかって
気になってたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I was more worried that things
would heat up between you and Charlotte.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
No worries there. She's acting like nothing
ever happened.
fields.JP:
そんなことないわ。
シャーロットはあれからも全然態度を
変えずに接してくれているの
fields.LOCALIZED:
No worries there. She's acting like nothing
ever happened.

fields.EN:
I see. I wonder if Charlotte-san isn't bothered by
it. She's so mature.
fields.JP:
そうなんだ。
シャーロットさんは気にしていないのかな。
さすが大人だなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Weird. I wonder how she gets over stuff
so quickly. Must be a maturity thing.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
It's hard to explain. Whenever you compliment
Charlotte, I get this pang of jealousy.
fields.JP:
……自分でもよくわからないの。
シャーロットがジャックに褒められると、
なんだか複雑な気分になってしまって
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's hard to explain. Whenever you compliment
Charlotte, I get this pang of jealousy.

fields.EN: I can't help but feel competitive around her.
fields.JP:
シャーロットに張り合おうとする気持ちが
湧いてくる、という感じかしら……
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't help but feel competitive around her.

fields.EN:
(Alice never gets worked up about stuff
like this. Charlotte-san must be something...)
fields.JP:
（普段のアリスなら、そんな感情的で
　無意味なことなんてしなさそうなのに。
　シャーロットさんだけは特別なんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice never gets worked up about stuff
like this. Charlotte must be something...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: See, I feel connected to her sometimes.
fields.JP:
なんかこう、シャーロットとは
似たものを感じるときがあるの
fields.LOCALIZED: See, I feel connected to her sometimes.

fields.EN:
Because of that, whenever I feel her
encroaching or calling me out, I get
irritated.
fields.JP:
そのせいか、なにかで先を越されたり、
言い当てられたりすると、ムッときちゃって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because of that, whenever I feel her
encroaching or calling me out, I get
irritated.

fields.EN: Especially in matters close to heart.
fields.JP: ……大事な人に関することだと、特に
fields.LOCALIZED: Especially in matters close to heart.

fields.EN: No, it's nothing. Maybe I'm just jealous of Charlotte.
fields.JP:
ううん、なんでもない。
わたしはシャーロットに嫉妬してる
だけかもしれないわね

fields.EN: (Jealousy... That doesn't quite fit. It feels more like a little quarrel between people who are much closer...?)
fields.JP:
（嫉妬か……。なんかしっくりこないな。
　それよりも、もっと身近な関係の
　ちょっとしたケンカみたいな……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Jealousy... That doesn't make much sense.
How can they possibly be so close?)

fields.EN:
I think Charlotte-san was just looking out for
you.
fields.JP:
あのときシャーロットさんが
アリスを叱ったのは、
たぶんアリスのためだったと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I think Charlotte was just looking out for
you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP: ええ、そうなんでしょうね

fields.EN:
I don't want to admit it, but she's too
protective of me. Meddling, almost.
fields.JP:
認めたくはないけど、シャーロットはいつも
わたしのためを思ってくれているわ。
……おせっかいなんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't want to admit it, but she's too
protective of me. Meddling, almost.

fields.EN:
I don't even want to bring up what
happened the other day.
fields.JP:
でもこの間注意されたことを
今さら蒸し返すのもどうかと思うと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't even want to bring up what
happened the other day.

fields.JP: アリスは気にしすぎなのよ

fields.EN: Were you listening the whole time, Charlotte?
fields.JP: ……シャーロット、今の話聞いていたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Were you listening the whole time, Charlotte?

fields.EN: Yes. I saw you pacing in front of Jack-kun's door.
fields.JP:
ええ、アリスがジャックくんのテントの前で
そわそわしていたときから見守っていたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I saw you pacing in front of Jack's door.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
What? Really Alice? You could've just
walked in if you wanted to.
fields.JP:
え、アリスそうだったの？
用があるならさっさと声をかけて
くれればよかったのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Really Alice? You could've just
walked in if you wanted to.

fields.EN:
I-I was practicing what I was gonna say!
I mean...! Keep your mouth shut, Charlotte!
fields.JP:
だ、だって心の準備が……じゃなくって！
余計なことを言わないで、シャーロット！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I was practicing what I was gonna say!
I mean...! Keep your mouth shut, Charlotte!

fields.EN:
Charlotte-san, your timing is always impeccable.
It's unreal.
fields.JP:
シャーロットさんって神出鬼没っていうか、
ここぞというタイミングによく出くわして
ませんか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Charlotte, your timing is always impeccable.
It's unreal.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Hey, wait till I get to you next, Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
あら、それを言うならジャックくんだって
そういう場面がよくあるんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, wait till I get to you next, Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: （なんか鋭いんだよなぁ、シャーロットさん……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Alice, don't worry about the other day.
Your heart was in the right place. 
I'm telling you, you take things too seriously.
fields.JP:
アリス、この間のことは気にしなくていいのよ。
私が言ったことを真面目に考えてくれるなんて、
あなたはいい子ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, don't worry about the other day.
Your heart was in the right place. 
I'm telling you, you take things too seriously.

fields.EN:
You've got a lot to learn, but you're
blossoming into a beautiful woman.
I'm excited for your future, Alice.
fields.JP:
まだまだ幼いところもあるけど、
きっとこれから素敵に成長していくわ。
そんなアリスの未来が楽しみで仕方ないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've got a lot to learn, but you're
blossoming into a beautiful woman.
I'm excited for your future, Alice.

fields.EN: I told you! Stop treating me like a kid!
fields.JP:
わ、わたしはあなたに子ども扱い
されるほどは幼くないわ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you! Stop treating me like a kid!

fields.JP:
もう、シャーロットといると
調子が狂っちゃうじゃない……！

fields.EN:
Aw. Alice stormed off again... I was looking
forward to petting her.
fields.JP:
あん、アリスが行っちゃった……。
もっとぐりぐり撫でまわして
かわいがりたかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw. Alice stormed off again... I was looking
forward to petting her.

fields.EN:
(Seems like Alice told off Charlotte
because she felt threatened again.)
fields.JP:
（それを察知したからアリスは
　逃げ出したんだと思います……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like Alice told off Charlotte
because she felt threatened again.)

fields.EN:
(Still, seeing Alice pout at Charlotte-san is
unusual... and kind of cute.)
fields.JP:

too much.)

fields.EN:
(In that other world, she kept putting me
before herself.)
fields.JP:
（前の世界でも僕なんかのことで、
　自分を追い詰めすぎちゃって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In that other world, she kept putting me
before herself.)

fields.EN: You scared me. Didn't expect you there.
fields.JP:
びっくりしちゃった。
こんなところにいると思わなかったから
fields.LOCALIZED: You scared me. Didn't expect you there.

fields.EN:
Neither did I. I thought I'd pop by, but
here you are.
fields.JP:
僕もびっくりしたよ。
アリスに会おうかなって思ってたところで、
ちょうど本人が出てくるなんて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Neither did I. I thought I'd pop by, but
here you are.

fields.EN:
Huh? You came to see me? I was just about
to see you.
fields.JP:
え、わたしに会いに……？
実はわたしも、ちょうどジャックに
会いに行こうと思っていたところなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Huh? You came to see me? I was just about
to see you.

fields.EN: What a coincidence. Must be fate.
fields.JP:
すごく奇遇ね。
なんだか以心伝心みたい
fields.LOCALIZED: What a coincidence. Must be fate.

fields.EN: Did you need to talk to me?
fields.JP: アリスはなにか僕に用があったの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Did you need to talk to me?

fields.EN: Weren't you the one who had something to talk to me about, Jack?
fields.JP: ジャックこそ、わたしに用があったんじゃないの？

いや、アリスからお先にどうぞ。
こういうときは女の子を優先しないと

わたしは後でいいわ。
ジャックのほうこそお先にどうぞ
いやいや、僕はいいから

fields.EN:
(Whoa. Now we're finishing each other's
sentence.)
fields.JP: （うわ、遠慮しすぎて結局被った……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa. Now we're finishing each other's
sentence.)

fields.EN:
It's nice that we're both being considerate,
but this is starting to get freaky for me.
fields.JP:
気が合うのは嬉しいけど、
以心伝心すぎるのもちょっと困るわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's nice that we're both being considerate,
but this is starting to get freaky for me.

fields.EN:
Could you go first, Jack? I want to hear
what you've got to say.
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャックからお願い。
あなたの話を聞きたいの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Could you go first, Jack? I want to hear
what you've got to say.

fields.JP: えーと、それじゃあお言葉に甘えて……

fields.EN:
Honestly, I didn't have something in mind.
I just wanted to check in.
fields.JP:
といってもこれといった用事はなくて、
アリスがどうしているか気になったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Honestly, I didn't have something in mind.
I just wanted to check in.

fields.EN:
We're not exactly in the Liberated District
anymore, so I worried you weren't getting
enough sleep.
fields.JP:
前みたいに解放地区があるわけじゃないから、
ゆっくり休めているか心配で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're not exactly in the Liberated District
anymore, so I worried you weren't getting
enough sleep.

fields.EN:
Thanks for your concern, but I promise you
I'm rested.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、心配してくれて。
でもわたしは平気よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for your concern, but I promise you
I'm rested.

fields.EN:
Really? I know you like playing it cool in front
of the others, but you've got a lot on your plate.
fields.JP:
本当？　アリスは冷静に見えて
自分を追い込んじゃうところがあるから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? I know you like playing it cool in front
of the others, but you've got a lot on your plate.

fields.EN: Hehe. You're the only one who really watches me like that, Jack. But I'm really fine.
fields.JP:
ふふ、そんな風にちゃんと見てくれるのは
ジャックだけね。だけど本当に大丈夫よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. Of all the people in the world.
I swear! I'm great, really.

fields.EN: If you're going to say that, are you okay? You tend to push yourself too hard, Jack, so I'm worried you're driving yourself into a corner.
fields.JP:
それを言うなら、そっちこそ大丈夫なの？
ジャックは気負いすぎるところがあるから、
自分を追い詰めていないか心配だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How about you, Jack? You look stiff as a
board. I'm half-worried you're gonna pass
out any day now.

fields.EN:
I'm doing fine. Taking care of myself here
and there. I won't overdo it.
fields.JP:
僕だって大丈夫だよ。
無理しすぎないように、体調管理くらい
ちゃんとしてるからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm doing fine. Taking care of myself here
and there. I won't overdo it.

fields.EN: But for your friends, you'll push yourself even when you're anemic, won't you? Even if you're hurt, you'll put yourself last, won't you?
fields.JP:
でも仲間のためなら、
貧血気味でも無理しちゃうでしょ？
怪我をしても自分は後回しにしちゃうでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know how much you care about everyone,
but don't push yourself too much. You're no
good to us dead.

fields.EN: That's why I'm always worried about you.
fields.JP: そういうところが心配なのよね
fields.LOCALIZED: That's why I'm always worried about you.

fields.EN:
That's exactly how I feel, you know?
I see you feeling the pressure.
fields.JP:
で、でもアリスこそ、
すごい無理してるときあるよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's exactly how I feel, you know?
I see you feeling the pressure.

fields.EN:
Am not. I have everything under control.
It's just pain.
fields.JP:
わたしのは無理してるんじゃないの。
つらくてもがんばってるだけなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Am not. I have everything under control.
It's just pain.

fields.EN:
That's no excuse not to take care of yourself.
You'll put yourself out acting strong all the
time. That's no different from not sleeping.
fields.JP:
いや、同じことだよね？
がんばりすぎて倒れたら
無理してるのと変わんないよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's no excuse not to take care of yourself.
You'll put yourself out acting strong all the
time. That's no different from not sleeping.

fields.EN: You're the one putting yourself out, Jack!
fields.JP: ジャックのほうが無理してるでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're the one putting yourself out, Jack!

fields.JP: いーや、アリスのほうが無理してる！

fields.EN: (Huh? This is weird. Why are we glaring?)
fields.JP:
（あ、あれ？　変なの。
　なんで僕とアリスでにらみ合ってるんだ？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Huh? This is weird. Why are we glaring?)

fields.EN:
Hehe. Got a little defensive there.
Real mature of us there.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、ちょっとムキになっちゃった。
わたしたち、子供みたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Got a little defensive there.
Real mature of us there.

fields.EN: Haha. I know, right? How embarrassing.
fields.JP:
はは、そうだね。
そう思うとちょっと恥ずかしいな
fields.LOCALIZED: Haha. I know, right? How embarrassing.

fields.EN: No. I quite enjoyed it actually. Thanks.
fields.JP:
ううん、嬉しかったわ。
ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: No. I quite enjoyed it actually. Thanks.

fields.EN:
(Looks like I worried for nothing. Seems
like Alice is holding up. In fact, she's the
one who cheered me up.)
fields.JP:
（少し心配してたけど、
　なんだかんだでアリスが元気そうでよかった。
　逆に僕のほうが元気づけられたかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like I worried for nothing. Seems
like Alice is holding up. In fact, she's the
one who cheered me up.)

fields.EN:
I get we're in a predicament right now,
but let's keep finding time for one another.
fields.JP:
こんな状況になってしまったけど、
諦めずに一緒にがんばりましょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I get we're in a predicament right now,
but let's keep finding time for one another.

fields.JP: うん。こっちこそよろしくね！

fields.EN: You've come at a perfect time.
fields.JP: ちょうどいいところに来たわね
fields.LOCALIZED: You've come at a perfect time.

fields.JP: ちょうどいいところ、ですか？

fields.EN:
Listen Jack! Tea party! We're having a tea
party!
fields.JP:
聞いて、ジャック！　お茶会よ！
お茶会が開けるかもしれないの！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Listen Jack! Tea party! We're having a tea
party!

fields.EN:
(I'm happy to see Alice so excited, but
she got real up close and personal.)
fields.JP:
（アリスが喜んでいるのは
　すごくいいことなんだけど……。
　きょ、距離が近い……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm happy to see Alice so excited, but
she got real up close and personal.)

fields.EN:
Alice, repeating yourself won't help him
understand. Look at the poor boy.
He looks lost.
fields.JP:
アリス、いきなりお茶会と連呼しても
事情がわからないでしょ？
ジャックが戸惑っているわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, repeating yourself won't help him
understand. Look at the poor boy.
He looks lost.

fields.EN: Hehe. Look at Alice go. She's beaming.
fields.JP:
ふふ、アリスったらはしゃいじゃって。
よっぽど嬉しいのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. Look at Alice go. She's beaming.

fields.EN: I found some tea leaves on our journey.
fields.JP:
実は、私が探索中にお茶の葉を
見つけてきたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I found some tea leaves on our journey.

fields.EN:
I didn't recognize the leaves, so I asked
Miko-san to analyze them.
fields.JP:
最初はなんの葉っぱかわからなかったから、
視子さんに分析してもらったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't recognize the leaves, so I asked
Miko to analyze them.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
That's how we found out it's tea. I guess
they used to process these into drinks.
fields.JP:
そうしたらお茶の葉だってわかったのよ。
かつて地上ではこれを加工してお茶を
作っていたんですって
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's how we found out it's tea. I guess
they used to process these into drinks.

fields.EN:
They may be old, but I'm more worried
about whatever contaminants they may
carry.
fields.JP:
だけどこれが昔の茶葉だとしても、
こんな環境で育った植物だから
なにかと心配なところもあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
They may be old, but I'm more worried
about whatever contaminants they may
carry.

fields.EN:
We'll have to examine the samples further
to see if they're fit for consumption.
Hopefully they're okay...
fields.JP:
だから本当に茶葉として
食用にできるかどうかは分析結果次第ね。
まあ、大丈夫じゃないかとは思うけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We'll have to examine the samples further
to see if they're fit for consumption.
Hopefully they're okay...

fields.EN:
When Alice found out, she entered Blood
Libido. That's why she's acting like this.
fields.JP:
そんな話をしていたら、
ちょうどアリスが聞いていたの。
血式リビドーが騒いで、ずっとこの調子よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
When Alice found out, she entered Blood
Libido. That's why she's acting like this.

fields.EN:
Right! Just thinking about having a tea
party has me jumping for joy!
fields.JP:
そうなの！
お茶会が開けるかもって思ったら、
もう嬉しくって嬉しくって！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! Just thinking about having a tea
party has me jumping for joy!

fields.EN: You can say that again, Alice.
fields.LOCALIZED: You can say that again, Alice.

fields.EN:
We need snack platters, don't we?
Oh, but where will I ever find biscuits
in these circumstances?
fields.JP:
お茶会にはやっぱりお菓子かしら。
でもお菓子を用意するのは難しいから、
代わりに乾パンをかわいく盛り付けて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
We need snack platters, don't we?
Oh, but where will I ever find biscuits
in these circumstances?

fields.EN:
Hey Jack, are you hungry? What kind of
snacks do you want? Wanna plan with me?
fields.JP:
ねえ、ジャックはなにが食べたい？
どんなお茶会がいいと思う？
一緒に考えてくれる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Jack, are you hungry? What kind of
snacks do you want? Wanna plan with me?

fields.EN:
(Man, her Blood Libido is off the charts.
She's usually so mellow.)
fields.JP:
（す、すごいな、血式リビドー。
　いつもはクールなアリスがぐいぐい来る……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, her Blood Libido is off the charts.
She's usually so mellow.)

fields.EN:
My, my. Alice, you sure are set on this
tea party with Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
あらあら、まあまあ。
アリスはジャックくんと一緒に
お茶会がしたくてたまらないのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
My, my. Alice, you sure are set on this
tea party with Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Oh... Sorry, Jack. I think I got ahead of myself.
Now I've done it.
fields.JP:
あ……っ。ご、ごめんなさい、ジャック。
ちょっと興奮しすぎたみたい。
恥ずかしいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh... Sorry, Jack. I think I got ahead of myself.
Now I've done it.

fields.EN:
Sorry Miko-san and Charlotte, too. I got carried
away.
fields.JP:
視子さんとシャーロットも、ごめんなさい。
こんな状況なのに浮かれちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry Miko and Charlotte, too. I got carried
away.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
Who cares? Why deny ourselves the few
pleasures we have in this world?
fields.JP:
いいんじゃない？
こんな状況だからこそ、
楽しいことも考えなきゃ心がもたないもの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who cares? Why deny ourselves the few
pleasures we have in this world?

fields.EN:
She's right. If we do, then we will become
as dry as these tea leaves.
fields.JP:
そうね。
余裕がなければ思考力も鈍ってしまうし
fields.LOCALIZED:
She's right. If we do, then we will become
as dry as these tea leaves.

fields.JP: （相変わらず、アリスはお茶会に目がないな）

fields.EN:
Alice, I'll look around and see if there's more
tea we can use too.
fields.JP:
アリス、僕もお茶の葉とか
お茶会に使えそうなものがないか
気をつけてみるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice, I'll look around and see if there's more
tea we can use too.

fields.EN: Hopefully we'll throw a soiree to remember.
fields.JP: お茶会、できるといいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hopefully we'll throw a soiree to remember.

fields.EN: Right. Thank you. I'm sure it certainly will be.
fields.JP:
ええ……ありがとう。
ジャックと一緒なら、素敵なお茶会になりそうね
fields.LOCALIZED: Right. Thank you. I'm sure it certainly will be.

fields.EN: (Rapunzel... Oh I see. This is a dream...)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェル……。
　そっか、これは夢なんだな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Rapunzel... Oh I see. This is a dream...)

fields.EN: Hey, hey, let's play together! There are sooo many things I wanna play with Jack!
fields.JP:
ねーねー、いっしょにあそぼ！
じゃっくとあそびたいこと、
いーっぱいあるんだよー！！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, let's play! Come on, after me!

fields.JP:
ジャックよ！
ワレ、しゃんじょうっ！

fields.EN: (Ah, Hameln. Even in my dreams, you slur...)
fields.JP:
（ああ、ハーメルン……。
　夢の中でまで舌を噛んでる……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ah, Hameln. Even in my dreams, you slur...)

fields.JP: ふはーっはっはっはーっ！

ジャックさん、ごきげんよう。
それで、その、あの……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
What do I do?! I've completely forgotten
what I wanted to say!
fields.JP:
どど、どうしましょう。
わたくしったら、なにを言えばいいか
ど忘れしてしまいましたわ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do I do?! I've completely forgotten
what I wanted to say!

fields.EN:
(Cinderella-san hasn't changed either.
She's always got her head in the clouds.)
fields.JP:
（シンデレラさんも相変わらずだな。
　気にすることないのに）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Cinderella hasn't changed either.
She's always got her head in the clouds.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シンデレラさん => Cinderella-san

fields.EN: Hey Jack! Why the long face?
fields.JP:
やっほー、ジャック！
なんか辛気臭い顔しちゃってるねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Jack! Why the long face?

fields.EN:
I find exercise helps get the blood pumping!
Really clears the mind! Come on! Let's go!
fields.JP:
そんなときは体を動かすといいよ。
運動してれば嫌なことなんて忘れちゃうから！
さっ！　一緒に行こ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I find exercise helps get the blood pumping!
Really clears the mind! Come on! Let's go!

fields.EN: (That's exactly something that Akazukin-san would say... I'm dreaming, right?)
fields.JP:
（赤ずきんさんがいかにも言いそう……。
　これ、ホントに僕の夢だよね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's exactly something that Red Riding
Hood would say... I'm dreaming, right?)
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Ah... I'm far too tired to comment.
fields.JP:
はあ～。
めんどうくさいので、わらわからの
コメントはパスということで～
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah... I'm far too tired to comment.

fields.EN: (Who in the world is tired in a dream?)
fields.JP:
（夢の中でまでそんな感じ！？
　いや、かぐや姫らしいんだけどね？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Who in the world is tired in a dream?)

fields.EN:
(If only I could see everyone for real.
I hope you're all safe.)
fields.JP:
（……みんな、今頃どうしているんだろう。
　無事でいるといいんだけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If only I could see everyone for real.
I hope you're all safe.)

fields.JP: （ああ……また、みんなの夢を見てたんだ……）

fields.EN:
(It's been happening more and more often.
Maybe my dreams are telling me something.)
fields.JP:
（最近多いな。夢にみんなが出てくること。
　心配だからかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's been happening more and more often.
Maybe my dreams are telling me something.)

fields.EN:
(Seeing all of them in my dreams is sweet,
but I can never sleep afterward.)
fields.JP:
（夢でみんなに会えるのは嬉しい。
　だけど、みんなの夢を見たあとは
　目が冴えちゃうんだよなぁ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seeing all of them in my dreams is sweet,
but I can never sleep afterward.)

fields.EN: Well, guess I'll get fresh air.
fields.JP:
仕方ない……。
ちょっと外の空気でも吸って来ようかな
fields.LOCALIZED: Well, guess I'll get fresh air.

fields.EN:
Alice. What are you doing up?
You can't sleep?
fields.JP:
アリス。こんな夜遅くにどうしたの？
眠れないとか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice. What are you doing up?
You can't sleep?

fields.JP: お手洗いに行ってきただけよ

fields.EN:
(Oops. That was an invasive question.
Come on, Jack.)
fields.JP:
（お、女の子に変なこと言わせちゃった。
　デリカシーなさすぎだったかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oops. That was an invasive question.
Come on, Jack.)

fields.EN: What are you doing up at this hour?
fields.JP: ジャックこそ、こんな時間にどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you doing up at this hour?

fields.EN:
Had some weird dreams, and couldn't
fall back asleep.
fields.JP:
……夢を見て、目が覚めたんだ。
一度目が覚めちゃったら、なかなか寝付けなくて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Had some weird dreams, and couldn't
fall back asleep.

fields.EN: No, it wasn't. It was just...
fields.JP:
ううん、そうじゃないんだ。
ただ……
fields.LOCALIZED: No, it wasn't. It was just...

fields.EN:
(Telling Alice the truth might just worry
her. Come on, think of something.)
fields.JP:
（本当のことを言ったら、
　アリスは僕を心配するかもしれない。
　余計な心配はかけたくない……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Telling Alice the truth might just worry
her. Come on, think of something.)

fields.EN:
(Wait. If I were in her shoes, I'd want her
to tell me.)
fields.JP:
（……でも僕が逆の立場だったら、
　アリスに悩みを打ち明けてほしいと
　思うだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait. If I were in her shoes, I'd want her
to tell me.)

fields.EN: (Shutting myself away alone like before won't solve anything... I should talk to Alice after all.)
fields.JP:
（前みたいに一人でふさぎ込んでいても
　なんにもならない……。
　やっぱりアリスに話してみよう）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Bottling stuff up is pointless. I should
trust her.)

fields.EN: I saw all of our friends together.
fields.JP:
離れ離れになったみんなが出てくる
夢を見たんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I saw all of our friends together.

fields.EN: Rapunzel, Hameln, Cinderella, Akazukin-san, and Kaguyahime. They all looked happy.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルも、ハーメルンも、シンデレラも、
赤ずきんさんも、かぐや姫も……。
みんな元気そうにしていた
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel, Hameln, Cinderella, Red Riding
Hood, and Kaguya. They all looked happy.
fields.notes: Source honorific restoration with whitespace-flexible multiword-name matching.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
But whenever I dream about them, I can't
sleep. Haha. Weird, right?
fields.JP:
でもみんなの夢を見たあとは
決まって寝付けないんだ。
はは、困ったもんだよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But whenever I dream about them, I can't
sleep. Haha. Weird, right?

fields.EN:
Jack, you're as kind as ever. You're always
worrying about everyone.
fields.JP:
ジャックは相変わらず優しいわね。
みんなのことを、いつも心配している
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: It's not worry, really. I'm a coward.
fields.JP:
優しいというか、
僕は単に臆病で小心者なだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's not worry, really. I'm a coward.

fields.EN:
I don't know how or where they are.
I get anxious thinking about it. Maybe
that's why the dreams keep happening.
fields.JP:
みんなが今どこでどうしているかわからない。
でもどうか元気でいてほしいっていう想いが、
あんな夢を見させたのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know how or where they are.
I get anxious thinking about it. Maybe
that's why the dreams keep happening.

fields.EN:
I feel the same way.
I really hope everyone is safe...
fields.JP:
わたしも同じ気持ちよ。
みんなに無事でいてほしい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I feel the same way.
I really hope everyone is safe...

fields.JP: だけど……そうね。困ったわ……

fields.EN:
There's not much either of us can do.
It's frustrating, to say the least.
fields.JP:
あなたが悩んでいるのに、この件ばかりは
わたしでは力になれないって思ったら、
歯がゆくなってしまって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's not much either of us can do.
It's frustrating, to say the least.

fields.EN:
Well Alice, I'm glad you know where
I'm coming from. I feel much better
after talking with you about it.
fields.JP:
そんな、アリスは十分僕の力になって
くれているよ。今も話を聞いてもらえて
だいぶ気が楽になったし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well Alice, I'm glad you know where
I'm coming from. I feel much better
after talking with you about it.

fields.EN: That's sweet. I'm happy you feel that way.
fields.JP:
ありがとう。
そう言ってもらえると嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's sweet. I'm happy you feel that way.

fields.EN:
(She seems sullen. I'm glad we could air
our feelings out, but now she's concerned.)
fields.JP:
（……なんだか悲しそうだな。
　僕は相談できてよかったけど、
　アリスにはかえって心配かけちゃったかも）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She seems sullen. I'm glad we could air
our feelings out, but now she's concerned.)

fields.EN: (It is out of our control, isn't it? Man...)
fields.JP:
（自分たちだけじゃどうにもならない状況か……。
　もどかしいな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It is out of our control, isn't it? Man...)

fields.EN:
You look pensive. Feeling okay?
Have you slept?
fields.JP:
なんだか疲れてるみたいだけど、大丈夫？
もしかして寝不足なんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You look pensive. Feeling okay?
Have you slept?

fields.EN: Oh... Kind of. Don't worry about me.
fields.JP:
ああ、うん……ちょっとね。
でも大したことないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh... Kind of. Don't worry about me.

fields.EN:
I'll probably feel better with some rest.
I'm gonna hit the hay, okay?
fields.JP:
少し寝たら元気になると思うから、
僕はもう休むことにするね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll probably feel better with some rest.
I'm gonna hit the hay, okay?

fields.EN:
Sure. If you need anything, you know where
to find me.
fields.JP:
そう……。
わたしにできることがあったら
なんでも言ってね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. If you need anything, you know where
to find me.

fields.JP:
ありがとう。
じゃあ、おやすみ……

ほらジャック！
しっかりしなさいよね！
（親指姫だ……。また夢を見てるのかな……）

いつまでも腑抜けた顔してるんじゃないわよ。
まったくもう……

fields.EN:
Jack-san, are you okay?
Are you hurt at all?
fields.JP:
ジャックさん、大丈夫ですか？
お怪我はしてませんか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, are you okay?
Are you hurt at all?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP:
（ああ、白雪姫……。
　なんだかすごく懐かしい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, Snow White...
Ah I miss them...)

fields.JP: あまり無理はしないでくださいね……

fields.EN:
Mm... Jack...
You want to sleep together...?
fields.JP:
ん……ジャック……。
一緒に、寝る……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm... Jack...
You want to sleep together...?

fields.EN: (Haha, though technically this is inside my dream.)
fields.JP: （はは、一応これは僕の夢の中なんだけどね）

fields.EN: Jack, I have an experiment with you in mind.
fields.JP: ジャック、私の実験に協力してちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, I have an experiment with you in mind.

fields.EN:
I'm studying concentration patterns on
subjects with sleep deprivation, and you
are the perfect subject.
fields.JP:
寝不足の人間の集中力に関する実験よ。
今のあなたはちょうどいい被験者になれるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm studying concentration patterns on
subjects with sleep deprivation, and you
are the perfect subject.

fields.EN: Jack! Get on your knees and worship me!
fields.JP:
ジャック！
ワレの尊い姿を拝んで感涙にむせぶがよいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack! Get on your knees and worship me!

fields.JP:
はーっはっはっぶへっ、ぼへっ！
うえっほ！

（かと思ったらむせた！
　変な笑い方をするから……）

fields.EN:
(If only we could meet face to face.
Wish I could talk to them now.)
fields.JP:
（みんな今頃どうしているのかな……。
　早く現実でもみんなに会いたいよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If only we could meet face to face.
Wish I could talk to them now.)

fields.EN:
(Oh. When did I wake up? Did I talk
in my sleep again?)
fields.JP:
（あ……いつの間にか起きてた。
　寝言、声に出ちゃってたかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. When did I wake up? Did I talk
in my sleep again?)

fields.JP:
（またみんなの夢を見て……。
　今日もあんまり眠れないかも……）

fields.EN: I hear you in there. Can't sleep again?
fields.JP: なにか声が聞こえたけど、また眠れないの？
fields.LOCALIZED: I hear you in there. Can't sleep again?

fields.JP: うん……そうだね。今日もあんまり……
え、なに？　どうしたの？

fields.EN: What?! Why are you climbing into my bed?!
fields.JP:
ええっ？
な、なんで僕の布団にもぐりこんで……！？
