fields.LOCALIZED: What?! Why are you climbing into my bed?!

fields.JP: どう？　少しは落ち着く？

fields.EN:
(Uncomfortable? How could I not be?
But Alice is so warm...)
fields.JP:
（お、落ち着くってよりも、
　アリスのぬくもりを感じて
　むしろ落ち着かないような……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Uncomfortable? How could I not be?
But Alice is so warm...)

fields.EN: We used to do this all the time, remember?
fields.JP:
昔は、ほら、こういうふうに
一緒に寝ていたでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: We used to do this all the time, remember?

fields.EN:
I thought that maybe if we cuddled like
old time's sake, you'd fall asleep.
fields.JP:
昔と同じようにしたら、
ジャックも落ち着いて眠れるんじゃ
ないかって思ったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
I thought that maybe if we cuddled like
old time's sake, you'd fall asleep.

fields.EN:
(When we were kids, we only had each
other. We'd huddle together and sleep
in the corner of an abandoned building.)
fields.JP:
（小さい頃は身寄りがなかったから、
　壊れそうなビルの隅っこで
　二人で肩を寄せ合って寝たりしたっけ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When we were kids, we only had each
other. We'd huddle together and sleep
in the corner of an abandoned building.)

fields.EN:
Thanks Alice. Here you go again, taking
care of me.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、アリス。
また心配させちゃったみたいだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks Alice. Here you go again, taking
care of me.

fields.EN:
Well, I couldn't sleep either. So this works
for the two of us.
fields.JP:
わ、私も眠れなかったから……。
久しぶりにあなたと一緒に寝たかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I couldn't sleep either. So this works
for the two of us.

fields.JP: それでも、僕は嬉しいんだ

fields.EN: (Whatever comes next, we're in this together.)
fields.JP:
（これからも大変なことはたくさんあるだろうし、
　解決しなきゃいけない問題だって山積みだ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Whatever comes next, we're in this together.)

fields.EN:
(Alice always has my back, sun and moon,
rain or shine.)
fields.JP:
（でも、そのたびにアリスがこうして一緒に
　悩んで、支えてくれるなら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice always has my back, sun and moon,
rain or shine.)

fields.JP: （きっと、僕は立ち向かっていける）

fields.EN: Nice... It took some doing, but I'm glad I did.
fields.JP:
よかった……。
ちょっと恥ずかしかったけど、
やった甲斐があったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Nice... It took some doing, but I'm glad I did.

fields.EN:
Jack-kun, it's morning. You still asleep?
I'm coming in.
fields.JP:
ジャックくん、もう朝よ。
まだ寝ているの？
テント、開けるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, it's morning. You still asleep?
I'm coming in.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Alice and Jack-kun are snuggled up asleep.
They're so cute in there together.
fields.JP:
ジャックくんったらアリスとくっついて寝ちゃって。
こうして見ると二人とも子供みたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice and Jack are snuggled up asleep.
They're so cute in there together.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.EN:
Whoa. What the heck? What's the deal?
Why are they together...?
fields.JP:
わ、なんだこいつら。
ヤッたのか？　デキてんのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. What the heck? What's the deal?
Why are they together...?

fields.EN:
Hmph. Whatever. Since they're sleeping,
I'm goin' back to bed too.
fields.JP:
けっ、どーでもいいけど。
まだ寝てるなら、俺もテントに引きこもるからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. Whatever. Since they're sleeping,
I'm goin' back to bed too.

fields.JP: よかったわね、アリス。……ふふ
コホッ！　んー、コホン！

fields.EN: Oh, a letter. What's it say...?
fields.JP: あれ、紙切れが……。なにか書いてあるな
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, a letter. What's it say...?

fields.EN:
Let's see. "You're cordially invited to my
tea party. I would love for you to come.
Alice."
fields.JP:
なになに、「お茶会の招待状」……？
「ぜひいらしてください。アリス」
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's see. "You're cordially invited to my
tea party. I would love for you to come.
Alice."

fields.EN:
Right. Finally time for that tea party, huh?
Bet Alice is over the moon.
fields.JP:
そっか。ついにお茶会が……。
アリス、喜んでるだろうなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Finally time for that tea party, huh?
Bet Alice is over the moon.

fields.EN:
Well, since I've got this, I guess I should
head over.
fields.JP:
招待状ももらったんだし、
さっそく行ってみようっと
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, since I've got this, I guess I should
head over.

fields.JP: ジャック！　来てくれたのね

fields.EN:
Thanks for the invite. You finally got around
to it.
fields.JP:
招待してくれて、ありがとう。
やっとお茶会が開けるようになったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for the invite. You finally got around
to it.

fields.EN: All thanks to everyone's help, of course!
fields.JP: これも協力してくれたみんなのおかげよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: All thanks to everyone's help, of course!

fields.EN:
Remember those tea leaves you found?
They're perfect!
fields.JP:
前にジャックが見つけてきてくれた
葉っぱがあったでしょ？
あれも茶葉として使えたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remember those tea leaves you found?
They're perfect!

fields.EN:
Really? They look different from the ones
Charlotte-san found.
fields.JP:
え、本当？
なんかシャーロットさんが見つけてきた茶葉と
違う感じだったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Really? They look different from the ones
Charlotte found.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Yours is an herbal tea. Perfect for relaxation.
fields.JP:
ジャックの茶葉ではハーブティーという
お茶を淹れられるの。
リラックス効果があるんですって
fields.LOCALIZED: Yours is an herbal tea. Perfect for relaxation.

fields.EN: No kidding. Should help us unwind.
fields.JP:
へー、そうだったんだ。
ストレスが多い今の僕たちにぴったりだね
fields.LOCALIZED: No kidding. Should help us unwind.

fields.EN: Now then, once again: welcome to Alice's tea party!
fields.JP:
それでは改めまして。
アリスのティーパーティーにようこそ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Now, let's begin. Welcome to my tea party!
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP says アリスのティーパーティー, not generic 'my'.

fields.JP: わあ……って、そういえば他の人はいないの？

fields.EN: No one. Just you and me, today.
fields.JP: 今日はわたしとジャックだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED: No one. Just you and me, today.

fields.EN: Partly because I still haven't secured enough tea leaves for everyone, but... more than anything, I wanted our first memory like this to be just you and me, Jack...
fields.JP:
まだ全員分の茶葉が確保できていないって
いうのもあるけど、やっぱり最初は
ジャックと二人きりの思い出を作りたくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wasn't able to get enough for everyone else,
so I thought you and I could celebrate the
occasion together.

fields.EN:
Er, I mean... Would you rather everyone
else was here too, Jack?
fields.JP:
あ……そ、それとも、ジャックはみんなで
わいわいやったほうがよかったりする？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Er, I mean... Would you rather everyone
else was here too, Jack?

fields.EN:
Group parties are always fun, but I'm
more than happy to sit and drink tea
with you.
fields.JP:
みんなでやるのも楽しそうだけど、
アリスと二人でゆったりしながら
っていうのも好きだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Group parties are always fun, but I'm
more than happy to sit and drink tea
with you.

fields.EN: Really? You're not just saying that?
fields.JP: 本当に？　気を遣ってない……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Really? You're not just saying that?

fields.EN:
(Alice doesn't remember the past much,
and this is her first tea party in a while.
I bet she can't wait to get started.)
fields.JP:
（アリスには前の記憶はないんだから、
　これが初めてのお茶会になるんだよね。
　きっと大切な思い出にしたいだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice doesn't remember the past much,
and this is her first tea party in a while.
I bet she can't wait to get started.)

fields.EN:
Here we are, finally on the surface.
Isn't it amazing that we found time
for this?
fields.JP:
せっかく地上に出られたっていうのに
こんな状況だけど、それでもこうして二人で
お茶会ができるなんて、すごいことだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Here we are, finally on the surface.
Isn't it amazing that we found time
for this?

fields.EN: I've been looking forward to it forever.
fields.JP: 初めてのお茶会、僕も楽しみにしていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED: I've been looking forward to it forever.

fields.EN:
I was sad I couldn't use that tea set
you got me, since I lost it...
fields.JP:
前にあなたからもらった大事なティーセットを
今回の件でなくしてしまって、
もう無理かと思っていたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was sad I couldn't use that tea set
you got me, since I lost it...

fields.EN: But I'm glad I didn't give up. I'm truly happy I can be here with you like this.
fields.JP:
でも諦めなくてよかった。
あなたとこうして一緒にいられて、
わたしは本当に幸せね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm glad I never gave up. It's all
worth it for right now.

fields.EN:
I don't know what I'd do without...
No, we don't need to dwell on that.
fields.JP:
もしもあなたがいなかったらって思うと……
ううん、今はこんな話はやめましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't know what I'd do without...
No, we don't need to dwell on that.

fields.EN: I'm so happy I got to have a tea party with just the two of us today.
fields.JP:
今日はあなたと二人でお茶会ができて、
とっても嬉しいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd rather focus on this marvelous time
with you now.

fields.EN:
It'll be the first of many. And they'll be
bigger and better every time. We'll have
to invite the others too.
fields.JP:
わたしね、次も、その次も、
この先何回でもお茶会を開いていきたいの。
そのときはみんなも一緒に
fields.LOCALIZED:
It'll be the first of many. And they'll be
bigger and better every time. We'll have
to invite the others too.

fields.EN: Totally. Let's get the others involved.
fields.JP:
そうだね。
早くみんなと合流して、
にぎやかなお茶会を開きたいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Totally. Let's get the others involved.

fields.EN: Yes. I like where your head's at!
fields.JP: ええ。今の一番の目標よ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I like where your head's at!

fields.EN: Hey, I said it isn't like that! Seriously!
fields.JP:
だ、だから全然そういうのじゃないのよ！
本当に！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, I said it isn't like that! Seriously!

fields.EN: Yeah. It's undeniable. It's all over your face.
fields.JP: 否定したってぜんっぜん説得力ねーしなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. It's undeniable. It's all over your face.

fields.EN: Hey, stop ganging up on me!
fields.JP: もう、からかわないでってば……！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, stop ganging up on me!

fields.JP: やあ。みんなでなに話してるの？

はっ！？
ジャック、そ、その……

fields.EN:
We were talking about what happened before we met up
with you, Jack-kun. It wasn't long ago, but it feels
like ages.
fields.JP:
ジャックくんと合流する前のことを話してたのよ。
まだ少ししか経っていないのに、
ずいぶんと昔のことみたいに感じるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We were talking about what happened
before we all found each other. It wasn't
that long ago, but it feels like ages.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Alice had a really hard time back then without you,
Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
あの頃のアリスは、ジャックくんが
いなくて大変だったんだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Alice was a mess without you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: That's not true. You know, um...
fields.JP: ち、違うの。別になんていうか、そのっ
fields.LOCALIZED: That's not true. You know, um...

fields.EN:
She was losing it. I thought she'd pull
her hair out.
fields.JP:
情緒不安定っていうのか？
ふとジャックの名前をつぶやいて、
しょっちゅう泣きそうな顔してたり
fields.LOCALIZED:
She was losing it. I thought she'd pull
her hair out.

fields.EN:
Every night, she'd toss and turn thinking
about you.
fields.JP:
毎晩、ジャックが心配で眠れないとか
言ったりしてたっけな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Every night, she'd toss and turn thinking
about you.

fields.EN:
We were just talking about how much Alice really
loves you, Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
アリスはホントにジャックくんのことが
好きなのね～、って話してたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So we were just discussing how much
she adores you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Hang on a second. I don't adore him.
I mean, I like him. But not like-like him.
Wait, um, wait...
fields.JP:
ちが、ちがっ、いえ、違わなくはないけど、
もちろんジャックは好きなんだけど、
ああ、えっと、待って。ちょっと待って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hang on a second. I don't adore him.
I mean, I like him. But not like-like him.
Wait, um, wait...

fields.JP: ……いったん落ち着きましょう。ね？

fields.EN:
(Alice is the one who needs to rein it in.
She's red all over her face. I've never seen
her so flustered.)
fields.JP:
（むしろアリス以外は全員落ち着いてるけどね。
　いつもはクールなアリスが
　こんなに取り乱すなんて珍しい……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Alice is the one who needs to rein it in.
She's red all over her face. I've never seen
her so flustered.)

fields.EN:
Oogh! You're not supposed to see this
side of me, Jack. It's all a misunderstanding.
fields.JP:
うぅ、ジャックに変なとこ見せちゃったわ。
こんなはずじゃなかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh! You're not supposed to see this
side of me, Jack. It's all a misunderstanding.

fields.EN:
See? You're adorable, Alice. Head over
heels for Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
ね？　アリスってばかわいいでしょ。
ジャックくん一筋なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
See? You're adorable, Alice. Head over
heels for Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: けっ。おせっかいな茶番かよ……
もう、そういうこと言わないの

fields.EN:
(It's true though. We've been close for
so long that it never occurred to me.
Alice really is cute.)
fields.JP:
（でも、たしかに……。
　昔から一緒にいたから普通に思ってたけど、
　アリスってかわいい……よね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It's true though. We've been close for
so long that it never occurred to me.
Alice really is cute.)

fields.EN:
(Maybe she does really care about me.
Oh... Am I blushing?)
fields.JP:
（しかもこんなに僕のことを
　大事に思ってくれていると思うと……。
　あ、あれ？　なんか僕まで照れてきた）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe she does really care about me.
Oh... Am I blushing?)

fields.EN: Jack, are you maybe fed up with me? Because I'm still so childish...
fields.JP:
ジャック、もしかして呆れちゃった？
わたしがまだまだ子供っぽくて……
fields.LOCALIZED: Did I embarrass you? Should I disappear...?

fields.EN:
Not at all! I'm just touched is all.
It's so sweet of you to feel that way.
fields.JP:
そ、そんなことない！
むしろそこまで想ってくれているなんて、
すごく嬉しいよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not at all! I'm just touched is all.
It's so sweet of you to feel that way.

fields.JP: だって僕も同じ気持ちだから！

ふぇっ？
あの、え？　わたし、その

fields.EN:
(Hm? Did I just say what I think
I said...?)
fields.JP:
（……ん？
　よく考えたら今のセリフ、
　けっこう大胆だったような……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm? Did I just say what I think
I said...?)

fields.EN:
Oh dear. Teehee. Good for you,
Alice.
fields.JP:
あらあら、うふふ。
よかったわね、アリス
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh dear. Teehee. Good for you,
Alice.

fields.EN:
Let's leave these two lovebirds be.
Far be it from us to interrupt.
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、あとは若い人たちに任せて、
邪魔者は退散しようかしらね～
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's leave these two lovebirds be.
Far be it from us to interrupt.

fields.JP: あ、あなただって十分若いでしょう！？

fields.EN: Blech. Barf city. Get a room, you two.
fields.JP: わざとくせー。茶番劇で腹いっぱいだぜ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Blech. Barf city. Get a room, you two.

fields.EN:
Now now, Mary. Let's go. Don't want to
intrude.
fields.JP:
ほらほら、メアリーも行きましょうね。
お熱い二人の邪魔しちゃ悪いでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now now, Mary. Let's go. Don't want to
intrude.

fields.JP: そそそ、そんな、お気遣いなく！

fields.EN:
Hey, come back! We're not lovebirds!
That's not what this is about!
fields.JP:
お、お熱いだなんて……。
ジャックとわたしが、お熱い……
お似合いカップルだなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, come back! We're not lovebirds!
That's not what this is about!

fields.JP: いや、そこまで言ってねーから

fields.EN:
Hehe. Alice, maybe you should learn to
trust what your heart's telling you.
fields.JP: ふふ、アリスの本音が駄々洩れね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Alice, maybe you should learn to
trust what your heart's telling you.

fields.EN: *sigh*... What I'd give to light up a match.
fields.LOCALIZED: *sigh*... What I'd give to light up a match.

fields.JP: つう？　ちょっと待ってて
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Didn't expect to see you. Make yourself
comfortable.
fields.JP:
君のほうから訪ねてくるなんて珍しいね。
とりあえず適当に座って
fields.LOCALIZED:
Didn't expect to see you. Make yourself
comfortable.

fields.EN:
(She sure is taking her time. Didn't she
want to tell me something...?)
fields.JP:
（な、なんだろう、この沈黙は。
　つうはなにか用があって来たんじゃないのか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She sure is taking her time. Didn't she
want to tell me something...?)

fields.EN:
(Oh, I see. She's gathering her thoughts.
I should be patient.)
fields.JP:
（……ああ、そうか。
　つうは自分の心を整理したいのかな。
　これはそのために必要な沈黙なのかも……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I see. She's gathering her thoughts.
I should be patient.)

fields.EN: Sorry for being so quiet. I...
fields.JP: ごめん、黙っちゃって。なんかさ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry for being so quiet. I...

fields.EN:
So much has happened since we made
it to the surface.
fields.JP:
地上に出てから、いろんなことが
起きすぎたなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So much has happened since we made
it to the surface.

fields.EN: Yeah, you're telling me. You seem upset.
fields.JP:
本当、いろいろあったよね。
つうはなにか不安なことがあるんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, you're telling me. You seem upset.

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Always so perceptive.
I can't hide from you, Jack.
fields.JP:
はは……すごいな。
ジャックの目は誤魔化せないね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Always so perceptive.
I can't hide from you, Jack.

fields.EN:
Well, we go way back. Try me.
I'm all ears.
fields.JP:
長い付き合いだから、それくらいはね。
僕でよければ話を聞くよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, we go way back. Try me.
I'm all ears.

fields.EN:
I'm still gathering my thoughts. I feel dread.
Or perhaps, melancholy. Helpess, more than
anything.
fields.JP:
自分でも気持ちの整理ができていないんだ。
不安というか、落ち込んでるというか……。
自分の無力さを思い知らされたっていうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still gathering my thoughts. I feel dread.
Or perhaps, melancholy. Helpess, more than
anything.

fields.EN:
I can't shake our encounter with Genocide
Pink from my mind.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女との戦いで、
全然太刀打ちできなかったことが
堪えてるのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't shake our encounter with Massacre
Pink from my mind.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
My legs froze. The difference in power
was stark. It gnaws at me.
fields.JP:
僕はあの瞬間、恐怖で足がすくんでしまった。
圧倒的な力の差に絶望してしまったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
My legs froze. The difference in power
was stark. It gnaws at me.

fields.EN:
I promised to protect my princess, but
I failed her.
fields.JP:
姫を守ると言っておいてこのザマだ。
こんなことじゃ、姫の王子失格だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I promised to protect my princess, but
I failed her.

fields.EN:
I don't think Ningyohime-san would approve
of you feeling this way.
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんは、君のことを
そんなふうには思わないんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't think Little Mermaid would approve
of you feeling this way.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Probably not. She has such a kind heart.
But I can't forgive myself. I feel so useless.
So ashamed.
fields.JP:
うん。姫は優しいから。
でも僕が僕を許せないんだ。
ふがいなくて、情けなくて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Probably not. She has such a kind heart.
But I can't forgive myself. I feel so useless.
So ashamed.

fields.EN:
Sure, but it's not your fault. Genocide Pink
are unlike anyone we've faced before.
fields.JP:
いきなりのことだったんだから仕方ないよ。
たしかに処刑台少女たちは強かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure, but it's not your fault. Massacre Pink
are unlike anyone we've faced before.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
But does that mean we should give up?
If you beat yourself up, you let them win.
fields.JP:
でもだからって諦めるのかい？
心まで折れちゃったら、
それこそなにもかもおしまいだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But does that mean we should give up?
If you beat yourself up, you let them win.

fields.EN:
There's still time. If we're alive, it's not
over, right?
fields.JP:
僕らにはまだ時間がある。
僕らが生きているうちは、
まだまだ終わりじゃないだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's still time. If we're alive, it's not
over, right?

fields.JP:
次までにもっと強くなって、
全員で力を合わせて挑もう！

fields.EN:
Right you are, Jack. Now I feel silly.
I was letting the negativity cloud my
judgment.
fields.JP:
……そうだね。ジャックの言う通りだ。
僕としたことが、慣れないことばかりで
弱気になっていたみたいだな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right you are, Jack. Now I feel silly.
I was letting the negativity cloud my
judgment.

fields.EN: Thanks Jack. I feel much more at ease.
fields.JP:
ありがとう、ジャック。
なんだか気持ちが楽になったよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Thanks Jack. I feel much more at ease.

fields.EN:
Together, you say. Hopefully the others
are safe.
fields.JP:
全員で力を合わせて、か……。
他のみんなは、今頃どうしてるのかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Together, you say. Hopefully the others
are safe.

fields.EN:
I'm worried about them too. I can't explain
it, but something tells me they're just fine.
fields.JP:
心配だね。
……だけど、なんて言えばいいのかな。
心配だけど大丈夫な気もするんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm worried about them too. I can't explain
it, but something tells me they're just fine.

fields.EN:
I bet they're just like us, or maybe it's
just wishful thinking.
fields.JP:
みんなは無事でいるって。
そう思いたいだけなのかもしれないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I bet they're just like us, or maybe it's
just wishful thinking.

fields.EN: What a coincidence. I actually feel the same. It's vague, but... I get the feeling everyone is safe.
fields.JP:
奇遇だな。実は僕も同じだよ。
漠然となんだけど、
みんなは無事でいるような気がする
fields.LOCALIZED:
That makes two of us. I have a feeling.
It's not much, but I choose to have faith.

fields.EN: If both of us feel that way, maybe it isn't just our imagination.
fields.JP:
二人ともそう思ってるなら、
ただの気のせいじゃないかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're both in the same boat, then
perhaps we can be each other's keeper.

fields.EN:
When you put it like that, we owe it
to ourselves to do so.
fields.JP:
つうにそう言ってもらえると、
そんな気がしてきたな
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you put it like that, we owe it
to ourselves to do so.

fields.EN:
To tell you the truth, I'm most worried
about Akazukin-san. She was betrayed
by her own father...
fields.JP:
今の状態で一番心配なのは、
赤ずきんさんかもね。信頼していた育ての親に
裏切られたわけだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
To tell you the truth, I'm most worried
about Red Riding Hood. She was betrayed
by her own father...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 赤ずきんさん => Red Riding Hood-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
I can't imagine how much pain she's in.
But I have a feeling she'll pull through.
fields.JP:
つらいだろうね。
でも、赤ずきんなら乗り越えられると思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't imagine how much pain she's in.
But I have a feeling she'll pull through.

fields.EN:
She might not be here, but we're with
her in spirit. I hope she can feel it.
fields.JP:
僕たちは側にいてあげられないけど、
きっと他の誰かが手を差し伸べてくれる。
……そう、願っている
fields.LOCALIZED:
She might not be here, but we're with
her in spirit. I hope she can feel it.

fields.EN: Let's believe everyone is safe and go search for our friends. For now, we have to start with what we can do.
fields.JP:
みんなが無事だと信じて、
仲間を探していこう。
とにかくまずはできることからだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's believe in our friends, and soon
good things will manifest in kind.

fields.EN:
But we must do whatever it takes to
defeat Genocide Pink when that day
comes.
fields.JP:
処刑台少女にリベンジするためにも、
僕ももっと強くならないといけないしね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But we must do whatever it takes to
defeat Massacre Pink when that day
comes.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: You said it. With you every step of the way.
fields.JP:
がんばろう。
僕たちなら、きっとできるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You said it. With you every step of the way.

fields.EN:
(I haven't seen Tsuu since she holed
herself up in her tent. Doesn't seem
like she's left.)
fields.JP:
（つうが自分のテントにこもって、早数時間。
　一向に出てくる気配がない）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't seen Otsuu since she holed
herself up in her tent. Doesn't seem
like she's left.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(She told me not to peek while she
works, but I'm dying to know.)
fields.JP:
（「作業中は絶対に中を見ないように」とは
　言われたけど、中でなにをしているのか
　すごーく気になる……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She told me not to peek while she
works, but I'm dying to know.)

fields.EN:
Hey Tsuu, how you doing in there?
Feeling okay? You haven't fainted, have you?
fields.JP:
あのー、つう？　中でなにしてるの？
体調が悪くて倒れてたりしない？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey Otsuu, how you doing in there?
Feeling okay? You haven't fainted, have you?
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
(No response. I hear some commotion
in there.)
fields.JP:
（……返事はない。
　でも中でなにかやってる気配はする）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No response. I hear some commotion
in there.)

fields.EN:
Hey, what've you been up to? I'm coming
in if you don't answer.
fields.JP:
ねえ、さっきからなにやってるの？
返事してくれないなら、開けちゃうよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, what've you been up to? I'm coming
in if you don't answer.

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Oh, she's sewing. Look at her go!
That's what she's been doing?!
fields.JP:
って、縫い物？　しかもすごい速さ！
さっきから聞こえてた謎の音が
まさかの縫い物する音だったなんて！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, she's sewing. Look at her go!
That's what she's been doing?!

fields.JP: はっ、ジャック？　いつの間に！

fields.EN:
Sorry for barging in. I called you, but it
doesn't sound like you heard me.
fields.JP:
ごめん、勝手に入っちゃって。
声をかけたんだけど気づかなかった
みたいだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for barging in. I called you, but it
doesn't sound like you heard me.

fields.EN:
Hold on just a moment. Don't look in
here. I'll put it all away!
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっと待ってくれ。
これ見ないで、すぐにしまうから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hold on just a moment. Don't look in
here. I'll put it all away!

fields.EN:
Sorry. I know you wanted it to be a surprise,
but I see everything. Were you tailoring
something?
fields.JP:
隠そうとしてるところ悪いんだけど、
だいたい見えちゃってるんだよね……。
布でなにか作っていたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry. I know you wanted it to be a surprise,
but I see everything. Were you tailoring
something?

fields.EN:
Agh. Can't be helped if you saw already.
Yes, I was making an outfit.
fields.JP:
くっ……見られてしまったからには仕方ない。
そうさ、僕は服を作ろうとしていたんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agh. Can't be helped if you saw already.
Yes, I was making an outfit.

fields.EN: What gives...? I didn't know you could sew.
fields.JP:
どうしてまた急に……。
そもそも服なんて作れたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED: What gives...? I didn't know you could sew.

fields.EN:
Well, I am a prince after all. Altering
clothing is nothing to a prince.
fields.JP:
まあ僕は王子だからね。
服の一着や二着、楽勝さ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I am a prince after all. Altering
clothing is nothing to a prince.

fields.EN:
Truthfully, I damaged my outfit the other
day.
fields.JP:
実は先日、探索のときにうっかり
かすり傷を負ってしまって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Truthfully, I damaged my outfit the other
day.

fields.EN: Then Charlotte-san swiftly patched me up.
fields.JP:
そうしたらシャーロットさんが手際よく
手当てをしてくれたんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then Charlotte swiftly patched me up.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN: Wow, just what I'd expect from Charlotte-san.
fields.JP: へー、さすがシャーロットさん
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
I felt like I owed her in some way, so I
hoped to repay her with a new outfit.
Something that suits her.
fields.JP:
手当てしてくれたことに恩を感じてしまったら、
なんていうか、こう、恩返しとして似合う服を
プレゼントしたくてたまらなくなったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I felt like I owed her in some way, so I
hoped to repay her with a new outfit.
Something that suits her.

fields.EN:
Long ago, I found that gifting people
outfits is a great way to show appreciation.
fields.JP:
なんか昔と違って、恩を感じると無性に服が
作りたくなるんだよな。なぜか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Long ago, I found that gifting people
outfits is a great way to show appreciation.

fields.EN:
If possible, I prefer to work from scratch.
Even when it comes to weaving. It's a hobby
of mine.
fields.JP:
できることなら布から作りたいくらいだ。
機織り。いつかやってみたい……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If possible, I prefer to work from scratch.
Even when it comes to weaving. It's a hobby
of mine.

fields.EN: (Weaving? Is this a Blood Libido thing?)
fields.JP:
（服？　機織り？　変わってるなぁ。
　つうの新しい血式リビドーなのかな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Weaving? Is this a Blood Libido thing?)

fields.EN:
But try as I might, I can only do so much
without materials. I had to make do with
hair accessories before.
fields.JP:
でも服を作りたくてもろくな素材がなくて、
仕方ないから、せめてもの気持ちで
髪飾りを作っていたところなんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But try as I might, I can only do so much
without materials. I had to make do with
hair accessories before.

fields.EN:
Take this hairpin, for instance.
Well-made, don't you think?
Making a whole outfit is the true goal.
fields.JP:
ほら、このシュシュなんて
なかなかよくできてるだろ？
本当は服を作りたかったんだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Take this hairpin, for instance.
Well-made, don't you think?
Making a whole outfit is the true goal.

fields.EN:
Wow, incredible! That's so neat!
I bet Charlotte-san's gonna love it.
fields.JP:
わー、すごい！　かわいい！
これならシャーロットさんも
絶対喜んでくれるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow, incredible! That's so neat!
I bet Charlotte's gonna love it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san
Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: 姫！　どうしたんだい？

fields.EN:
I heard cheerful voices from the tent, so I peeked
in. What were you doing alone with Jack-san?
fields.JP:
テントから楽しそうな話し声が
聞こえたから、覗いてみちゃった。
ジャックさんと二人でなにしてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard some lively voices coming from
this tent, so I poked my head in.
What are you up to?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Hey Otsuu-chan, what's that? In your hands!
fields.JP:
あっ、おつうちゃんそれなに？
その手に持ってるやつ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Otsuu, what's that? In your hands!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Oh. Just a hairpin I made...
fields.JP: ああ、これは今作ったばかりのシュシュで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Just a hairpin I made...

fields.EN:
Princess, this is the culmination of my
love. Fashioned by my own hands with
thoughts of you.
fields.JP:
……姫。
これはあなたのためにひと針ひと針、
想いを込めて作った僕の愛の結晶です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Princess, this is the culmination of my
love. Fashioned by my own hands with
thoughts of you.

fields.JP: どうか受け取っていただけますか？

fields.EN:
(Putting feeling into every stitch... that's a lie,
right? It was really for Charlotte-san, wasn't it?
She always puts on a good face for Ningyohime-san.)
fields.JP:
（ひと針ひと針想いを込めてって、嘘だよね？
　本当はシャーロットさん用だよね？
　人魚姫さんにはいい顔しちゃうんだから）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Fashioned with thoughts of her? Didn't
she say it was for Charlotte? Typical Otsuu.)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): シャーロット => Charlotte-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Oh, you made this for me?
I can really have this?
fields.JP:
え、わたしのために作ってくれたの……？
本当にもらっちゃっていいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, you made this for me?
I can really have this?

fields.EN:
Of course, my dear. Seeing my trinkets
adorn your fine hair makes my heart sing.
fields.JP:
もちろんですよ。
僕が作った品で姫の髪を飾ることができれば、
この上ない幸せです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course, my dear. Seeing my trinkets
adorn your fine hair makes my heart sing.

fields.EN: Wow. You're so romantic. Thanks Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
嬉しい……！
ありがとう、おつうちゃん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. You're so romantic. Thanks Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Oh, no problem! Ha ha ha!
fields.JP: いやいや、はっはっはっ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, no problem! Ha ha ha!

fields.EN: Oh, right. I need to see Miko-san. Pardon me.
fields.JP:
あ、そうだ。
私ちょっと視子さんに用事があったんだ。
もう行かなくちゃ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, right. I need to see Miko. Pardon me.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.EN:
See you two around. Thank you for the
beautiful hairpin, Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、またね。
おつうちゃん、このシュシュ大事にするね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
See you two around. Thank you for the
beautiful hairpin, Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: ...Was that okay? Wasn't it for Charlotte-san?
fields.JP:
……よかったの？
あれ、シャーロットさんにあげるために
作っていたんでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: ...Was that okay? Wasn't it for Charlotte?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.EN:
Hehe. You think I regret that, Jack?
I made my beloved princess smile.
Nothing can stop me now.
fields.JP:
ふふ、ジャック。僕が後悔するとでも？
愛しの姫にプレゼントを差し上げられたんだ。
今この胸は喜びに満ちている！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. You think I regret that, Jack?
I made my beloved princess smile.
Nothing can stop me now.

fields.EN:
There is no greater feeling than bringing
her joy. Now I have the motivation to make
one hundred hairpins for Charlotte-san.
fields.JP:
姫の笑顔を見られたのだから、
シャーロットさん用にもう一度お礼の品を
作り直す手間くらいまったく苦ではない！
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is no greater feeling than bringing
her joy. Now I have the motivation to make
one hundred hairpins for Charlotte.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シャーロットさん => Charlotte-san

fields.JP: あ、やっぱり手間だとは思ってるんだ……

fields.EN:
This was all a ploy to impress Ningyohime-san,
wasn't it?
fields.JP:
人魚姫さんにいいとこ見せようとして、
ちょっと調子に乗っちゃったね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was all a ploy to impress Little Mermaid,
wasn't it?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: 愛に生きるのも辛いものなのさ
ふんっ！　ふんっ！　ふんっ！

fields.EN:
Ningyohime-san, what's gotten into Tsuu?
I've never seen her train so hard.
fields.JP:
人魚姫さん、つうはどうしたの？
すごい気合い入った素振りをしてるけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid, what's gotten into Otsuu?
I've never seen her train so hard.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Oh Jack-san, that's how Otsuu-chan's always been.
fields.JP:
あ、ジャックさん……。
そうなの。おつうちゃんってば、
もうずーっと訓練しっぱなしなんだよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh Jack, that's how Otsuu's always been.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Ever since she vowed to become stronger,
she's been up from dawn until dusk training.
fields.JP:
強くならなきゃいけないんだって、
この頃はしょっちゅうあんな感じで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ever since she vowed to become stronger,
she's been up from dawn until dusk training.

fields.EN:
I'm worried Otsuu-chan will work herself sick from
pushing so hard...
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんががんばりすぎて
体を壊しちゃわないか、心配だな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
She puts so much on her shoulders. I fear
she'll overwork herself.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: I gotta match her work ethic.
fields.LOCALIZED: I gotta match her work ethic.

fields.EN:
There are limits. Even I can see Tsuu's
pushing it.
fields.JP:
困ったわね。ここ最近のつうは、
明らかにオーバーワーク気味だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are limits. Even I can see Otsuu's
pushing it.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Can't you tell her to stop, Miko-san?
fields.JP:
視子さんからやめるように言ってもらう
わけにはいかないんですか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Can't you tell her to stop?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
You think I haven't? But she won't listen.
She's been at it for two hours now.
fields.JP:
とっくに言っているわ。
でもなかなかやめないのよ。
今日も、もう二時間近くあの調子で
fields.LOCALIZED:
You think I haven't? But she won't listen.
She's been at it for two hours now.

fields.EN:
(Blood Maiden or not, everyone tires out
eventually. Hopefully she's okay.)
fields.JP:
（いくら血式少女でも、無理をしすぎたら
　体によくないに決まってるよね。
　大丈夫かな、つう……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Blood Maiden or not, everyone tires out
eventually. Hopefully she's okay.)

fields.JP: ふんっ！　ふんっ！　……っく！

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.
Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: はぁ……はぁ……、だ、大丈夫ですよ、姫

fields.EN: Of course you're not. You're gaunt!
fields.JP:
大丈夫なわけないよ。
もうふらふらじゃないか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Of course you're not. You're gaunt!

fields.EN:
No, I'm not done yet. No matter how sore
I may feel, I must overcome.
fields.JP:
いや、まだだ。
たとえ体力の限界が来ようと、
無理にでも限界を乗り越えてやる
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, I'm not done yet. No matter how sore
I may feel, I must overcome.

fields.JP: 僕はもっと強くならないと……！

fields.EN: Why are you putting yourself through this?
fields.JP: どうしてそこまでして……
fields.LOCALIZED: Why are you putting yourself through this?

fields.EN: Simply put, I can never lose again.
fields.JP:
……二度と、負けられないから。
ただそれだけだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Simply put, I can never lose again.

fields.EN:
(Ah. She's still upset about losing to
Genocide Pink.)
fields.JP:
（ああ……処刑台少女に敗れたことを
　ずっと気にしていたんだ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ah. She's still upset about losing to
Massacre Pink.)
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
(She seemed so positive when we talked
about it last time.)
fields.JP:
（みんなで力を合わせて戦おうって言って、
　この間は前向きになれたみたいだったけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She seemed so positive when we talked
about it last time.)

fields.EN:
(Tsuu feels a tremendous sense of duty to
Ningyohime-san, and to her friends as well.)
fields.JP:
（つうは責任感が強いから、
　人魚姫さんや仲間のこととなると、
　やっぱり自分を責めちゃうのかな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Otsuu feels a tremendous sense of duty to
Little Mermaid, and to her friends as well.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, you're as reliable as it gets.
Please don't hurt yourself.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんは十分頼もしいし、強いよ。
だからこれ以上無理しないで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, you're as reliable as it gets.
Please don't hurt yourself.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
If you collapse from overdoing it, Otsuu-chan,
I... I...
fields.JP:
もしも無理をしておつうちゃんが
倒れちゃったら、わたし、わたし……
fields.LOCALIZED: If you pass out from fatigue, I... I...
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Not to worry, my lady. I'm fine.
fields.JP:
ご心配には及びません、姫。
僕は平気ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Not to worry, my lady. I'm fine.

fields.EN:
I would hate to be the reason a frown
wraps upon your tender face.
fields.JP:
ですから、どうかその愛らしい顔を
曇らせないでください
fields.LOCALIZED:
I would hate to be the reason a frown
wraps upon your tender face.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Tsuu, at this rate, you won't get stronger.
You'll just burn out.
fields.JP:
つう。そんな無理をしたら、
強くなるどころか体を壊すだけだよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, at this rate, you won't get stronger.
You'll just burn out.
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
But how do you expect a prince to protect
his princess? Don't stop me.
fields.JP:
今のままじゃ姫を守れる王子にはなれない。
止めないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But how do you expect a prince to protect
his princess? Don't stop me.

fields.EN: Then let me be the voice of reason.
fields.LOCALIZED: Then let me be the voice of reason.

fields.EN:
I've been watching you. You're at your limit.
Doctor's orders.
fields.JP:
さっきから観察していたけど、
やっぱりあなたの体は限界だわ。
これ以上はドクターストップよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been watching you. You're at your limit.
Doctor's orders.

fields.EN:
Otsuu-chan, please no more. Listen to Miko-san.
Please.
fields.JP:
これ以上はやめて、おつうちゃん。
視子さんの言うことを聞いて。
お願い……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu, please no more. Listen to Miko.
Please.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan; 視子さん => Miko-san

fields.JP:
……わかりました。
姫がそこまで言うのなら

fields.EN:
Phew. I'll see myself to a nice nap then.
Please call me if you need me. I'll be
there as soon as I can.
fields.JP:
ふぅ……、僕は少し体を休めてきます。
なにかあれば呼んでください。
すぐに姫のもとへはせ参じましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. I'll see myself to a nice nap then.
Please call me if you need me. I'll be
there as soon as I can.

fields.JP: よかった、やめてくれて……

fields.EN:
Knowing her, she's going to sneak in some
exercises when she's out of sight.
fields.JP:
でもあの調子じゃ、一人になっても
筋トレくらいはしていそうだけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Knowing her, she's going to sneak in some
exercises when she's out of sight.

fields.EN:
I wonder why Otsuu-chan's putting the burden
on herself.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんはなんであそこまで
自分を追い詰めてるのかな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder why Otsuu's putting the burden
on herself.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
(Must be because she came so close to
losing Ningyohime-san. She's lit a fire under
herself.)
fields.JP:
（……人魚姫さんを失いたくない、
　仲間を失いたくないっていう気持ちが、
　つうをがむしゃらにさせるんだろうな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Must be because she came so close to
losing Little Mermaid. She's lit a fire under
herself.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(I see where she's coming from, but
it's not healthy.)
fields.JP:
（気持ちはわかる。だけど……。
　このままじゃいけない気がする……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I see where she's coming from, but
it's not healthy.)

fields.EN:
(I don't see Tsuu anywhere. I've looked
all over the camp.)
fields.JP:
（つうの姿が見当たらない……。
　テントも、行きそうなところも、
　あらかた見て回ったんだけどな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I don't see Otsuu anywhere. I've looked
all over the camp.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: (I hope she's not overdoing it again.)
fields.JP: （またどこかで無茶していないだろうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I hope she's not overdoing it again.)

fields.EN:
Hm? Where's that sound coming from?
Over here...?
fields.JP:
ん？　なんだろう、今の音……。
あっちかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm? Where's that sound coming from?
Over here...?

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
Oh Jack, it's you. Just dropped my sword.
That's all.
fields.JP:
ああ、ジャックか……。大丈夫だ。
少し剣を落としてしまっただけだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh Jack, it's you. Just dropped my sword.
That's all.

fields.EN:
You've been practicing your swings again,
haven't you?
fields.JP: ……また素振りをしていたんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've been practicing your swings again,
haven't you?

fields.EN:
(The other day, it took Ningyohime-san and
Miko-san to stop Otsuu from training. But she's
back at it again.)
fields.JP:
（この間は人魚姫さんと視子さんの
　制止もあって訓練をやめてくれたけど、
　やっぱり隠れて続けていたんだな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The other day, it took Little Mermaid and
Miko to stop Otsuu from training. But she's
back at it again.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; 視子さん => Miko-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(If she continues like this, she'll just hurt
herself. But I...)
fields.JP:
（こんなことを続けていたらつうが体を
　壊してしまう……。でも、僕は……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(If she continues like this, she'll just hurt
herself. But I...)

fields.EN:
Sorry, but I have no intention of stopping.
Nothing will change my mind.
fields.JP:
悪いけど、訓練をやめる気はないよ。
止めないでくれ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, but I have no intention of stopping.
Nothing will change my mind.

fields.EN: Yeah. I don't plan on it.
fields.JP: うん。そんなつもりはないよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. I don't plan on it.

fields.EN:
What? Oh, I see. Then we're good.
I expected otherwise.
fields.JP:
え？　ああ……そうか。なら、いいけど。
てっきり止められるかと思った
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? Oh, I see. Then we're good.
I expected otherwise.

fields.EN:
You thought you'd just train outside of
the camp by yourself?
fields.JP: キャンプ地の外れで、ずっと一人で訓練を？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You thought you'd just train outside of
the camp by yourself?

fields.EN:
Yeah. If I do it where everyone can see, I'll just
worry Princess and Miko-san again.
fields.JP:
ああ。みんながいるところでやると、
また姫や視子さんを心配させてしまうからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. I hoped not to draw attention, or
concern for that matter.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Dear me. I know it's more trouble than it's
worth, but the fear of failing is too hard to
ignore.
fields.JP:
……まいったな。
本当は、自分でも無理しているのはわかっている。
でもなにもしていないと怖くなるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dear me. I know it's more trouble than it's
worth, but the fear of failing is too hard to
ignore.

fields.EN:
If I were to lose my princess, and my friends,
I would be beside myself.
fields.JP:
もしも姫を……仲間を失うことになったらと
考えると、怖くてたまらない
fields.LOCALIZED:
If I were to lose my princess, and my friends,
I would be beside myself.

fields.EN: I don't want to end up regretting that I could've protected everyone if only I'd trained more. That's why I can't stop training.
fields.JP:
そのときになって、もっと訓練していれば
みんなを守れたはずなのにって後悔したくない。
……だから訓練せずにはいられないんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I will stop at nothing to make sure it's not
a question of preparedness. That's why...
I have no choice.

fields.EN: Your heart's in a good place.
fields.LOCALIZED: Your heart's in a good place.

fields.EN:
I'm sure you feel the same. So, what can
I do for you, Jack?
fields.JP:
こ、これくらい、別に普通だろ。
それよりジャックはなんでここに？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure you feel the same. So, what can
I do for you, Jack?

fields.EN:
I didn't see you around, so I started to worry.
Can you blame me?
fields.JP:
つうの姿が見当たらないから、気になって。
また無茶をしているかもしれないと思ってさ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't see you around, so I started to worry.
Can you blame me?

fields.EN:
I told you. I'm not here to stop you.
But I want to tell you something.
fields.JP:
だから止める気はないよ。
ただ、つうに教えてほしいことがあるんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I told you. I'm not here to stop you.
But I want to tell you something.

fields.JP:
ねえ、つうは処刑台少女の誰と戦ったか
覚えてる？

fields.EN: Why would you ask? You saw, didn't you?
fields.JP:
なんでそんな質問を……？
ジャックだって見ていたろ
fields.LOCALIZED: Why would you ask? You saw, didn't you?

fields.EN:
...Her name was Guillotine. She seemed
confident, but demented. A twisted soul
who overwhelmed me.
fields.JP:
……ギロチンというやつだ。
涼しい顔して、平気で残虐なことをしていた。
そして圧倒された…。
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Her name was Guillotine. She seemed
confident, but demented. A twisted soul
who overwhelmed me.

fields.EN: But what about her overwhelmed you?
fields.JP: その子の、なにに圧倒されたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: But what about her overwhelmed you?

fields.EN:
Everything. She moved at lightning speed,
and her technique was a sight. She may as
well have been toying with me.
fields.JP:
なにもかもだ。特に速さは格段に上だった。
そしてなにより、あの独特な剣捌き……
あれに翻弄されてしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everything. She moved at lightning speed,
and her technique was a sight. She may as
well have been toying with me.

fields.EN: So what exactly about her scares you?
fields.JP:
それじゃあ、一番怖いと感じたのは
どういうところ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So what exactly about her scares you?

fields.EN:
It was the dead bodies. Seeing them is one
thing, but her ruthlessness scares me most.
fields.JP:
人の遺体……。
あまりにも数多くの遺体にも恐怖を覚えたけど、
一番はあいつの残虐なところだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was the dead bodies. Seeing them is one
thing, but her ruthlessness scares me most.

fields.EN:
She shows no remorse. She's a machine.
Everything about her frightens me.
fields.JP:
人を殺すことにまったく躊躇がない異常さ、
すさまじい殺気……そのすべてが怖かった
fields.LOCALIZED:
She shows no remorse. She's a machine.
Everything about her frightens me.

fields.EN:
Right... Thanks for opening up to me about
it.
fields.JP: わかった……。話してくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right... Thanks for opening up to me about
it.

fields.EN: So what's the meaning of this?
fields.JP: こんなことを聞いてどうするつもりだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: So what's the meaning of this?

fields.EN: Listening to you made me think: if that's the case, continuing the same training probably won't do much good.
fields.JP:
君の話を聞いて思ったんだけど、
それなら今と同じ訓練を続けていても
あまり意味はないんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
I got to thinking. If you're scared of her,
then training all day won't do you much good.

fields.EN: I don't think simply swinging a sword will solve her speed or brutality. That's no different from running away from reality.
fields.JP:
速さや残虐性への解決策も
ただ剣を振るうだけじゃ、
現実逃避と同じだと思うんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Swinging your sword harder won't make
the fear go away.

fields.JP: ……いや、ジャックの言う通りだ

fields.EN: Saying it was to get stronger was just an excuse. Maybe I kept pushing my body because I was afraid to remember what happened back then.
fields.JP:
強くなるためなんていうのは方便で、
あのときのことを思い出すのが怖くて、
ひたすら体を動かしていたのかもな
fields.LOCALIZED:
My resolve is just an excuse, but perhaps
I have been running from the problem this
whole time.

fields.JP: どうしたらいいんだろうな、僕は……

fields.EN:
Believe in yourself, Tsuu. If you're feeling
overwhelmed, then tell me so we can think
of a way forward together!
fields.JP:
つう、落ち込まないで。
一人でいい考えが浮かばなくても、
二人なら違ってくるかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
Believe in yourself, Otsuu. If you're feeling
overwhelmed, then tell me so we can think
of a way forward together!
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: だから一緒に考えよう！

fields.EN: (Phew. Got worked up. Look at the time.)
fields.JP:
（ふぅ。つい話し合いに熱中しちゃった。
　もうこんな時間か……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Phew. Got worked up. Look at the time.)

fields.EN:
(I'm glad I could clear the air with Tsuu.
We're gonna need each other to stand up
to Genocide Pink.)
fields.JP:
（でもつうとじっくり話せてよかったな。
　処刑台少女にどう対抗すればいいのか、
　どういう訓練をすべきなのかって）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad I could clear the air with Otsuu.
We're gonna need each other to stand up
to Massacre Pink.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.JP: （だいぶ前に進めた気がするぞ）
……なんていうか、意外だったな

fields.EN: I didn't expect you to approve of my training.
fields.JP:
僕が訓練することに対して、
ジャックがこんなに協力的だなんて
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't expect you to approve of my training.

fields.EN: I was frustrated that we lost too. I understand feeling anxious—and feeling even more anxious when you're doing nothing.
fields.JP:
僕だって負けて悔しかったからね。
不安な気持ちも、なにもしていないと
もっと不安になる気持ちもわかるよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I hate what happened to us too, so I get
feeling anxious about it.

fields.EN:
But if we're going to fight, we're fighting
to win. And the only way we're winning is
if we take care of ourselves.
fields.JP:
どうせ戦うなら、勝ちに行きたい。
だからこそ、無理をするなら意味のある無理を
したほうがいいなって思ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if we're going to fight, we're fighting
to win. And the only way we're winning is
if we take care of ourselves.

fields.EN:
Haha. A rare show of wisdom from you,
Jack.
fields.JP:
ははっ。温厚なジャックから
そんな好戦的な言葉が聞けるなんてな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. A rare show of wisdom from you,
Jack.

fields.EN:
But you're absolutely right. I've been
reckless, but you opened my eyes.
fields.JP:
でも、そうだな……。
たしかに僕はやけくそになっていたみたいだ。
おかげで目が覚めたよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you're absolutely right. I've been
reckless, but you opened my eyes.

fields.EN:
Jack. It seems I need you more than I
thought. Let us continue consulting
with one another.
fields.JP:
ジャック、どうやら僕には君が必要らしい。
これからも色々と相談に乗ってくれよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack. It seems I need you more than I
thought. Let us continue consulting
with one another.

fields.EN:
Of course. I look away for one second,
and you're already back training.
fields.JP:
もちろんだよ。
つうは放っておくと、がむしゃらに
がんばっちゃうから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. I look away for one second,
and you're already back training.

fields.EN:
But even princes need a break sometimes.
Do it for Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
王子様なら、努力するにも
もっとスマートにやらなくちゃ。
人魚姫さんのためにもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But even princes need a break sometimes.
Do it for Little Mermaid.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Right, well... I guess I owe you one.
fields.JP:
う、うん……、まあ……。
これはまたジャックに借りを作っちゃったなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right, well... I guess I owe you one.

fields.EN: Siblings don't keep track of who owes who, right?
fields.JP: 兄弟に貸し借りなんてなしでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: We're brothers. You don't owe me nothing.
fields.notes: B12 P0 gender-neutral 兄弟 restored as sibling(s)

fields.EN: Oh my, Jack. That was smooth, even for you.
fields.JP:
お。
ジャックのくせに格好いいこと言うじゃないか
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh my, Jack. That was smooth, even for you.

fields.EN: Hey! I was trying to be nice!
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey! I was trying to be nice!

fields.EN:
(Man, it's quiet. Not peaceful maybe,
but days like this are rare.)
fields.JP:
（なんか、平和だなぁ……。
　いや、全然平和な状況ではないんだけど、
　久々にまったりした時間というか）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, it's quiet. Not peaceful maybe,
but days like this are rare.)

fields.EN: (I can't wait till things are quiet for good.)
fields.JP: （こんな時間がしばらく続けばいいなぁ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I can't wait till things are quiet for good.)

fields.JP: ……さようなら、僕のまったり時間
メルヒェンが来たぞー！！

fields.EN: What?! That's trouble! I gotta go!
fields.JP: えっ。本当に大変だ！　行かないと！
fields.LOCALIZED: What?! That's trouble! I gotta go!

fields.EN:
Jack, a Marchen!
It broke the gate and came in!
fields.JP:
ジャック、メルヒェンだ！
柵を壊して侵入してきやがった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack, a Marchen!
It broke the gate and came in!

fields.EN:
I'm sure Alice and the others will hear it
soon! Let's hold it off until then!
fields.JP:
この騒ぎを聞きつけたら、
じきにアリスたちが駆けつけるだろ。
それまでは俺たちで食い止めるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm sure Alice and the others will hear it
soon! Let's hold it off until then!

fields.JP: うん、やるしかなさそうだね……！

fields.EN:
Tch. It's quicker than it looks!
Let's fan out.
fields.JP:
チッ！
こいつ、デカい図体のくせして動きが速い！
どうにか隙をついて……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tch. It's quicker than it looks!
Let's fan out.

fields.EN: (All I can do is dodge. But I can't just run away...!)
fields.JP:
（避けるだけで精いっぱいだ。
　でも逃げるわけには……！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That was a close one. We're boxed in.)

fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Sorry to keep you waiting. You two did well to hold out this long.
fields.JP:
待たせてごめん。
二人とも、よく持ちこたえてくれたね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry for keeping you. Thank you for your
valiant effort.

fields.EN:
Agh. Always with the fancy entrance!
Thanks for that!
fields.JP:
くっ、なんだそのかっこよすぎるセリフは！
でも助かった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agh. Always with the fancy entrance!
Thanks for that!

fields.EN: Leave this to me. Stand back, you two!
fields.JP: ここは僕に任せて、二人は下がって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Leave this to me. Stand back, you two!

fields.JP: つう、みんなが来るまで無理は……っ
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Whoa. Down in one swoop. Amazing!
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa. Down in one swoop. Amazing!

fields.EN:
(She hacked down that Marchen in one
swing. Looks like her training's paid off.)
fields.JP:
（たった一撃で敵を真っ二つに……。
　訓練を続けてここまで腕を上げていたなんて）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She hacked down that Marchen in one
swing. Looks like her training's paid off.)

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: よかった。みんな怪我はなさそうね
アリス、来てくれたんだね

fields.EN:
I heard a Marchen stormed in, but it looks
like Otsuu-san's got it under control.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンが出たって聞いて、
急いで駆けつけたの。
でもおつうさんが片付けてくれたみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard a Marchen stormed in, but it looks
like Otsuu's got it under control.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
Inspiring performance, Otsuu-chan! I saw you
just in time. You were like ZOOM! BAM!
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、今のすごかったね！
ここに来る途中から見えてたよ。
シュッてやって、パッとやっつけちゃった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Inspiring performance, Otsuu! I saw you
just in time. You were like ZOOM! BAM!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.JP: スマートでかっこよかったよ！

fields.EN:
It's an honor coming from you.
I only did what was natural.
fields.JP:
お褒めにあずかり光栄です。
姫の王子として、これくらいは当然ですよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's an honor coming from you.
I only did what was natural.

fields.EN:
(All of Tsuu's hard work came in handy.
Hope that gives her some confidence.)
fields.JP:
（つうの努力が実を結んだってところかな。
　この調子で自信を取り戻せるといいな）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(All of Otsuu's hard work came in handy.
Hope that gives her some confidence.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Otsuu-chan, brilliant job. You worked hard for this.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃん、よかったね。
ずっとがんばってたもんね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Otsuu, brilliant job. You worked hard for this.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Hahaha, no, no. For Hime, it was nothing. Besides, it wasn't just my effort...
fields.JP:
ははは、いやいや。
姫のためなら大したことはありません。
それに僕だけのがんばりというか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahahaha. You flatter me. It's all in a day's
work. Just happy to help.

fields.EN: Hm? How does Hime know about that...?
fields.JP: ん？　なんで姫がそのことを知って……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Do you mean you've been watching me?

fields.EN:
(Oh. Ningyohime-san knows Tsuu's been
sneaking off to train.)
fields.JP:
（あー、つうの秘密の訓練のこと、
　人魚姫さんにはお見通しだったんだ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. Little Mermaid knows Otsuu's been
sneaking off to train.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ふふふ、わたしになにか隠し事でもあるの？

fields.EN:
No, my princess! I just thought it would be
more impressive not to mention it!
fields.JP:
ち、違いますよ姫！
でも多くを語らないほうがスマートと
いいますか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, my princess! I just thought it would be
more impressive not to mention it!

fields.JP: これじゃあ白状したも同然だなぁ……

fields.EN:
Either way, well done Otsuu-chan. I'm proud of
you. The proudest princess to ever live!
fields.JP:
お疲れさま、おつうちゃん。
すごく頼もしかったよ。
やっぱりわたしの王子様は世界一だね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Either way, well done Otsuu. I'm proud of
you. The proudest princess to ever live!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: I see... The proudest princess. Hehehe.
fields.JP: そ、そっか、世界一……。えへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I see... The proudest princess. Hehehe.

fields.EN:
Look at Otsuu. She's blushing.
Not so cool anymore, are we?
fields.JP:
おつうのやつ、デレデレしやがって。
さっきのかっこよさがどっか行っちまったぜ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look at Otsuu. She's blushing.
Not so cool anymore, are we?

fields.JP: ふふ、おつうさん嬉しそうね
fields.LOCALIZED: I think she's got everything she needs.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Yeah. They're suited for one another.
fields.JP: うん。あの二人はお似合いだね
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. They're suited for one another.

fields.EN:
(Argh. I'm exhausted. That's what I get
for exploring all day. I need a break.)
fields.JP:
（あー、眠い……。
　気を抜くとすぐ眠くなっちゃうなぁ。
　疲れてるのかな？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Argh. I'm exhausted. That's what I get
for exploring all day. I need a break.)

fields.EN: (*sigh* So tired. I'm running on empty.)
fields.JP:
（はー、眠い……。
　って、考えがループしてるし）
fields.LOCALIZED: (*sigh* So tired. I'm running on empty.)

fields.EN: Jack, you look awful. Are you sick?
fields.JP:
ジャック、ぼんやりしてどうしたの？
もしかして具合が悪いとか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Jack, you look awful. Are you sick?

fields.EN:
Classic Alice. Can't go two minutes without
doting on Jack-kun.
fields.JP:
あらあら、相変わらずアリスは
ジャックくんのこととなると
心配性になるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Classic Alice. Can't go two minutes without
doting on Jack.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックくん => Jack-kun

fields.JP: ちょっ、からかわないで！

fields.EN: Ooh, what have we here? Did I hear love?
fields.JP: 楽しそうだね～。なんの話してたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ooh, what have we here? Did I hear love?

fields.JP: ふふ、それならわたしも混ざっていいですか？

fields.EN:
(Before I knew it, the girls were wrapped
up in familiar conversation again...)
fields.JP:
（な、なんかあっという間に
　女子会みたいな雰囲気になっちゃった。
　ちょっと居づらい感じ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Before I knew it, the girls were wrapped
up in familiar conversation again...)

fields.JP: （うわ、すごい勢いで走ってくる！）
姫、こちらにいらしたのですね！

fields.EN: Why do you look so happy?
fields.JP: そんなに嬉しそうにしてどうしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why do you look so happy?

fields.JP: ついに、ついに完成したんです！

決まってるだろう？
姫のドレスがさ！
なんて凝った作りのドレスなの……！

fields.EN:
Putting together an ensemble like this
is as romantic as it gets.
fields.JP:
この状況でこれだけの大作を作るなんて、
愛以外のなにものでもないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Putting together an ensemble like this
is as romantic as it gets.

fields.EN:
(It sure is pretty, but it's a little too frilly,
don't you think?)
fields.JP:
（たしかにすごい。
　でもなんていうか、ガチガチのフリフリで、
　着るのに勇気がいりそうな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(It sure is pretty, but it's a little too frilly,
don't you think?)

fields.EN:
(Maybe it's a girl thing. I could never see
myself in something like that.)
fields.JP:
（いやいや、でも女の子はこれくらい
　フリフリのドレスを着てみたかったり
　するのかもな。うん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe it's a girl thing. I could never see
myself in something like that.)

fields.JP: えっと……これをわたしに？

fields.EN:
Please accept my token of love!
A gesture befitting my affection!
I put everything into this dress.
fields.JP:
姫へのほとばしる恩！
溢れんばかりの愛！
そういったものを込めて作ったんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Please accept my token of love!
A gesture befitting my affection!
I put everything into this dress.

fields.EN:
Dare I say, it might be my masterpiece.
The materials were hard to come by,
given the situation.
fields.JP:
いや～、我ながらよくできているな。
まず布地の確保が大変だった。
なにしろこんな世界だからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dare I say, it might be my masterpiece.
The materials were hard to come by,
given the situation.

fields.EN:
I did my best to keep it under wraps from
everyone, sewing it bit by bit in secret. Hehe.
fields.JP:
みんなにバレないように隠れて作るのも
大変だったなぁ。そして少しずつせっせと
ちくちくちくちく縫ったわけだよ。ふふ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I did my best to keep it under wraps from
everyone, sewing it bit by bit in secret. Hehe.

fields.EN:
The design took me forever, but I knew it
had to be special for my princess.
fields.JP:
デザインもかなり悩んだな。
姫にプレゼントするなら特別な服じゃないと
いけないからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The design took me forever, but I knew it
had to be special for my princess.

fields.EN:
But, my, keeping something like this hidden
is almost as big of a task as making it.
Chalk it up to love, I suppose.
fields.JP:
姫に内緒でサイズを知るのも大変だったな。
どうやって測ったかは企業秘密さ。
まあ愛の力とでも言っておこうか
fields.LOCALIZED:
But, my, keeping something like this hidden
is almost as big of a task as making it.
Chalk it up to love, I suppose.

fields.JP: （発言のはしばしが王子っぽくない……）

fields.EN: I've never seen Otsuu-san so cocky...
fields.JP:
こ、こんなに饒舌なおつうさんを見るのは
初めてだわ……
fields.LOCALIZED: I've never seen Otsuu so cocky...
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.JP: 愛が煮詰まってるわね

fields.EN:
Thank you, Otsuu-chan. But I'm not used to
clothes like these. Are you sure it fits me?
fields.JP:
あ、ありがとう、おつうちゃん……。
でもわたし、こんな服着たことないから
似合わないかも……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank you, Otsuu. But I'm not used to
clothes like these. Are you sure it fits me?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I'm certain you'll look dazzling in it.
In fact, I guarantee it!
fields.JP:
いいえ、これは必ず姫に似合います。
この僕が保証します！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm certain you'll look dazzling in it.
In fact, I guarantee it!

fields.EN:
This soft lace! It compliments your figure!
All for you, Princess!
fields.JP:
このやわらかなフリル！
愛らしいシルエット！
そのすべてが姫のイメージにぴったりです
fields.LOCALIZED:
This soft lace! It compliments your figure!
All for you, Princess!

fields.EN: You think? I'm almost embarrassed to try.
fields.JP:
そ、そうかなぁ。
でもちょっと恥ずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED: You think? I'm almost embarrassed to try.

fields.EN:
Don't be modest. Would you please grace
us with a glimpse?
fields.JP:
そう言わずに。
このドレスを身に着けた可憐な姿を、
どうか見せていただけませんか？　姫
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't be modest. Would you please grace
us with a glimpse?

fields.JP: （うーん、人魚姫さんも戸惑ってる……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Why don't you try it on yourself, Otsuu-san?
fields.JP:
……ちょっと思ったんだけど、
そのドレス、おつうさんが着ても
いいんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: Why don't you try it on yourself, Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうさん => Otsuu-san

fields.EN:
You seem really attached to that dress, Otsuu-san,
so I wondered if maybe, deep down, you wanted to
wear it too...
fields.JP:
だってそのドレスにすごく思い入れが
あるみたいだから、もしかしたら無意識に
おつうさんも着たいのかな、って……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, you seem pretty attached to it.
Maybe you subconsciously want it more
for yourself.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
That could be! I bet it fits you perfectly,
Otsuu-chan!
fields.JP:
たしかに！
華やかでおつうちゃんに似合いそう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That could be! I bet it fits you perfectly,
Otsuu!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Wait one minute. This isn't what I intended.
fields.JP:
いやいや、待て待て。
なんか話が変な方向に行ってるぞ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait one minute. This isn't what I intended.

fields.EN: I'm a prince. Such garments don't fit me.
fields.JP:
僕は王子なんだから、そんな姫っぽい衣装を
自分で着てみたいなんて思うわけがないだろう？
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm a prince. Such garments don't fit me.

fields.EN:
But you're my prince, Otsuu-chan. Don't you
know how much I love pretty things?
fields.JP:
でもおつうちゃん、わたしのために王子様で
いてくれているけど、かわいいものとか
きれいなものも大好きだよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you're my prince, Otsuu. Don't you
know how much I love pretty things?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN: Don't hide from your feminine side, Otsuu-chan.
fields.JP:
おつうちゃんの女の子らしいとこ、
わたしは知ってるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't hide from your feminine side, Otsuu.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Agh! While it's true I'm no stranger to
such luxuries...
fields.JP:
う……。た、たしかに、そういう服に
全然興味がないわけではないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Agh! While it's true I'm no stranger to
such luxuries...

fields.EN:
I made this dress specifically for you, Princess.
Plus it doesn't fit my chest.
fields.JP:
そのドレスは姫のサイズに合わせて作ったから、
僕じゃ胸とか全然入らないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I made this dress specifically for you, Princess.
Plus it doesn't fit my chest.

fields.EN:
Ah, right. You and I aren't the same size,
Otsuu-chan, so we can't wear the same dress.
fields.JP:
……ああ、そうだよね。
おつうちゃんとわたしじゃ、
同じドレスは着られないよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, right. We're not the same size, are we?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Which means it'd probably fit me better,
right?
fields.JP:
ということは、わたしなら着られるということね。
胸のサイズ的に
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means it'd probably fit me better,
right?

fields.EN: Oh boy, Tsuu-kun. You opened up Pandora's Box.
fields.JP:
あらあら、つうくんったら二人の地雷を
踏み抜いちゃったみたいねぇ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh boy, Otsuu. You opened up Pandora's Box.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: つうくん => Otsuu-kun | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN: Must be nice to have a great pair, eh Otsuu-chan?
fields.JP: おつうちゃんは胸がおっきくてよかったね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Must be nice to have a great pair, eh Otsuu?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
I didn't mean to compare! If anything,
they're an inconvenience! Yours are
perfect! Perfectly compact!
fields.JP:
そ、そういうわけじゃなくて！
大きいのも大変で全然よくないし！
姫のコンパクトな胸が僕は大好きだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't mean to compare! If anything,
they're an inconvenience! Yours are
perfect! Perfectly compact!

fields.EN:
Small, I mean. Precious even. I vow to be
your biggest fan until the end of time.
fields.JP:
貧にゅ……いや、愛らしいサイズの胸は
希少価値であり、全世界の僕が熱狂的に
支持するとここに誓います！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Small, I mean. Precious even. I vow to be
your biggest fan until the end of time.

fields.EN:
(Ugh. I can't watch this. She's digging herself
into a deeper hole. It's too late now...)
fields.JP:
（あああ、見ていられない。
　なにを言っても墓穴掘ってるよ。
　もう這い上がれないくらいの深さだよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ugh. I can't watch this. She's digging herself
into a deeper hole. It's too late now...)

fields.EN:
(In times like these, it's best to stay quiet.
Sorry Tsuu. You're on your own this time.)
fields.JP:
（こういうときは静かに去るに限るな。
　助けてやれなくてごめんよ、つう。
　ふがいない僕を許してくれ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In times like these, it's best to stay quiet.
Sorry Otsuu. You're on your own this time.)
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.JP: （あとで骨くらいはひろってあげるからね……）

fields.EN:
Sorry Otsuu-chan. I didn't mean to dump all
of that on you.
fields.JP:
ごめんね、おつうちゃん。
愚痴を聞かせちゃって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry Otsuu. I didn't mean to dump all
of that on you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
That's what I'm here for, Princess.
You needn't hold back in front of me.
fields.JP:
姫の愚痴なら喜んで聞くよ。
僕の前では我慢しなくていいんだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I'm here for, Princess.
You needn't hold back in front of me.

fields.JP:
（人魚姫さんが愚痴だなんて、珍しい……。
　ちょっと声をかけづらい雰囲気だな）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It's not often that Little Mermaid vents.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: 人魚姫さん => Little Mermaid-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: It's pointless to worry, but I can't help it.
fields.JP:
悩んでばかりいても仕方ないのはわかってるの。
でもわたし、どうしても心配で
fields.LOCALIZED: It's pointless to worry, but I can't help it.

fields.EN:
It's getting to the point where all I think
about is if our friends are safe.
fields.JP:
離れ離れになっちゃったみんなや、
一緒に来た他の人たちは無事でいるかなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's getting to the point where all I think
about is if our friends are safe.

fields.EN:
I'm certain they are. Look at us. We're safe.
They have to be too.
fields.JP:
きっと無事でいるさ。
こうして僕たちが無事でいるんだから。
僕はそう信じている
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm certain they are. Look at us. We're safe.
They have to be too.

fields.EN: The alternative seems too difficult to bear.
fields.JP:
そうじゃないと、
不安な気持ちが大きくなりすぎて
持て余してしまうからね

You saved me, and I went off by myself.
I regret it all. It was poor judgment.

この間はわたしを助けてくれたのに、
さっさと一人で帰っちゃって……。
すごく失礼だったなって後悔してたんだ

You saved me, and I went off by myself.

Pretty much good as new. It was just

もうほとんど治ったよ。

fields.LOCALIZED:
Pretty much good as new. It was just
a scratch, promise.

fields.EN: Wonderful... Thanks again for saving me.

よかった……。
あのときは助けてくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED: Wonderful... Thanks again for saving me.

fields.EN:
But don't be so reckless, okay? One wrong
move, and things could've been much worse.

でも、もうあんな無茶はしないでほしいな。
運が悪ければ、もっとひどい怪我を
負っていたかもしれないんだもん

But don't be so reckless, okay? One wrong
move, and things could've been much worse.

I can take a little damage, but you can't,
Jack-san...
fields.JP:
わたしなら多少のダメージは大丈夫だけど、
ジャックさんはそうじゃないし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can handle myself. I wouldn't want you
to risk yourself for me.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: I appreciate the concern. I won't overdo it.
fields.JP:
心配してくれてありがとう。
できるだけ無茶はしないようにするよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I appreciate the concern. I won't overdo it.

fields.EN:
But it wasn't a you thing. I'd do the same
if it was anyone.
fields.JP:
でもやっぱり目の前で女の子が危険な目に
遭っていたら、同じことをするだろうな
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it wasn't a you thing. I'd do the same
if it was anyone.

fields.EN:
You're so kind, Jack-san. But if anything happened
to you, everyone would be in trouble.
fields.JP:
ジャックさんは優しいもんね。

みんなが困っちゃうよ

You're so kind. But I don't know how our
group would fare without you.

You're far more important to the Blood Maidens than
someone like me, Jack-san...

わたしなんかより、
ジャックさんのほうがよっぽど
血式少女にとって必要な存在なんだから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're integral to us Blood Maidens.
Far more than I am.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
That's not true. Being useful has nothing to
do with it. We're friends.
fields.JP:
そんなことないよ。
仲間内でどっちのほうが必要だとか、
優劣なんてないと思うな
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not true. Being useful has nothing to
do with it. We're friends.

fields.EN:
No. Someone can replace me, but no one can replace
you, Jack-san. You're more important to everyone.
fields.JP:
ううん。わたしの代わりはいるけど、
ジャックさんの代わりはいないもん。
みんなにとってジャックさんのほうが大事だよ
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
So you don't need to try to save someone like me
anymore, Jack-san. Okay?
fields.JP:
だからジャックさんはもうわたしのことなんか
助けようとしなくていいよ。ね？
fields.LOCALIZED: So stop putting me before you, okay?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
No, if you're in danger, I'm going to swoop

fields.JP:
ダメだよ、君が危険な目に遭っていたら
絶対にまた助けるよ。
いくら言ったって無駄だからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, if you're in danger, I'm going to swoop
in. No ifs, ands, or buts. That's final.

fields.EN: Grrr, Jack-san, you just don't get it!
fields.JP: む～、ジャックさんのわからずや！
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: 人魚姫さんこそ、意地っ張り！
fields.LOCALIZED: Guess who I learned it from!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Aw... I can be stubborn, can't I?
fields.JP:
……あーあ、なんか変な意地張っちゃった。
ごめんね
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw... I can be stubborn, can't I?

fields.EN:
I'm sorry too. But you're surprisingly stubborn,
Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
こっちこそ、ごめん。
でも人魚姫さんって意外に頑固だったんだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So can I. Sorry. Maybe you're more stubborn
than me, but I'll let it slide.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Hehe. You could say the same about yourself,
Jack-san, couldn't you?
fields.JP: ふふ、それを言うならジャックさんもでしょ？
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
That was the first time I argued with you like that,
Jack-san. My heart was pounding, but I'm glad I said
what I wanted to say!
fields.JP:
ジャックさんとこんな風に言い合いしたの
初めてだったな。ちょっとドキドキしたけど、
言いたいことを言えてよかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
This was our first quarrel. It got my heart
racing, but to me, it's growth.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Normally Otsuu-chan's with us. But being here
with you now makes me realize we have
more in common than I thought.
fields.JP:
いつもおつうちゃんがいるから
気づかなかったけど、わたしたちって
けっこう似た者同士なのかもね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Normally Otsuu's with us. But being here
with you now makes me realize we have
more in common than I thought.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: おつうちゃん => Otsuu-chan

fields.EN:
Maybe. But I don't think I'm as stubborn as you,
Ningyohime-san.
fields.JP:
そうかもしれないね。
でも僕は人魚姫さんほど頑固じゃないと
思うけどなぁ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah, you're onto something. But don't
forget. You're the stubborn one.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN: Oh. One more thing before you go.

fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. One more thing before you go.

fields.EN:
If you and I are alike, Jack-san, maybe we have the
same taste in people too.
fields.JP:
わたしとジャックさんが似た者同士なら、
好きになる人の好みも同じかもしれない
fields.LOCALIZED:
If we're as similar as we think, there's a chance
we could fall for the same person.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
That means you might fall for Otsuu-chan too,
Jack-san! What would I do then?!
fields.JP:
それってジャックさんがおつうちゃんを
好きになるかもしれないってことだよ？
そうなっちゃったらどうしよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Which means you may fall for Otsuu.
What do we do if this is the case?

Never has the thought crossed my mind.

そ、その発想はなかったな……。
それは絶対ありえないから大丈夫だよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never has the thought crossed my mind.
That would NEVER happen, so don't worry.

fields.JP: ふふ、そうだと思ってた

fields.EN: Hey, Ningyohime-san, you were teasing me!

fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Anyway, I'm glad Ningyohime-san is feeling

fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: やあ、人魚姫さん。どうしたの？

ジャックさんとお話しがしたくって。
今、ちょっといい？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wanted to speak with you, Jack.
You have a moment?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

I wanted to thank you, Jack-san. Thanks for what you

ジャックさんにお礼を言いたかったの。

fields.LOCALIZED:

I was really worried because Otsuu-chan kept pushing

おつうちゃんが無理な訓練を続けてたから、

The thought of her driving herself mad

fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

much.)

……だけど、たまに無理してるんじゃないかって

fields.LOCALIZED:
But...sometimes I worry she may be digging

Thanks to you, Jack-san, I'm not as worried about

ジャックさんのおかげで、
そっちは前ほどは心配じゃなくなったかな。
むしろ精神面が気になるっていうか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I'm not as worried as I was, but it's

She keeps being my prince for my sake, but I'm

わたしのためにずっと王子様でい続けて

Sometimes she acts regally for my sake,
but that only makes me feel like a burden.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

あれは無理も演技もしてないって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because she's madly in love with you.
Even I blush at the thought. Don't think
for one second she doesn't.

fields.EN:
Her princely duties might be a lot sometimes,

王子様でいるために努力はしているかも
しれないけど、それはつうが好きで
やってることだと思うよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her princely duties might be a lot sometimes,
but I think it's a duty she takes on willingly.

fields.EN:
If anything, being Ningyohime-san's prince may

fields.JP:
むしろ人魚姫さんの王子様でいることは、
つうのアイデンティティーなんじゃないかな
fields.LOCALIZED:
In fact, I think being your prince is something
she's massively proud of.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10). | Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oof! I might've said too much!

fields.EN:
You're amazing, Jack-san. Otsuu-chan's lucky she has

……ジャックさん、すごい。
おつうちゃんのことちゃんとわかってて、
本当のお兄さんみたい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're amazing, Jack. Otsuu's lucky she has
someone who understands her like you.

fields.JP: そう言われるとなんか照れるなぁ…

fields.EN:
If you're Otsuu-chan's big brother, Jack-san, then
since I'm her wife... does that make you my
brother-in-law?
fields.JP:
ジャックさんがおつうちゃんのお兄さんなら、
おつうちゃんと夫婦のわたしにとっては、
……義理のお義兄さん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you're Otsuu's big brother, does that
mean when I marry her, you'll become
my brother-in-law?
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): おつう => Otsuu-chan on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2 Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
え、え！？
そ、そういうことになる……のかな？

fields.EN: Whoa Tsuu! Where'd you come from?

うわ、つう！
どうしてここに！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa Otsuu! Where'd you come from?

I saw you enter Jack's tent, so I snuck

姫がジャックのテントに入っていくのが見えて、
こっそり様子をうかがっていた！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I saw you enter Jack's tent, so I snuck
around back.

fields.JP: （なんでちょっと誇らしげなんだ？）

Anyway, Jack's my big brother, eh?
Don't make me laugh. If anything, I'd
be the older sibling.
fields.JP:
それはそうと、ジャックが兄だって？
冗談じゃない。僕たちが兄弟だったら、
間違いなく僕が兄だね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, Jack's my big brother, eh?
Don't make me laugh. If anything, I'd
be the older sibling.

fields.EN:
I've been carrying Jack on my back this
whole time!
fields.JP:
ずっとジャックの面倒を見てきたのは、

fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been carrying Jack on my back this
whole time!

fields.EN:
What do you mean? I'd totally be the older

proven myself by now!
fields.JP:
なに言ってるのさ、兄弟だとしたら兄は僕だよ！
昔はどうであれ、今はどう考えても
僕のほうがしっかりしてるだろ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean? I'd totally be the older
brother! The past is the past, but surely I've
proven myself by now!

fields.EN:
Hehe, you two really get along.

fields.JP:
ふふっ、二人とも仲がいいんだから。
やっぱり兄弟みたいだね

...But both of you are giving off younger

...But both of you are giving off younger

(Oh, I hear Ningyohime-san singing...

Whoa! Watch where you're goin'!

Whoa! Watch where you're goin'!

話しかけるんなら、まず声かけてからに

べ、別に、隠れてこそこそ人魚姫の歌を

This is her Blood Libido. Encoded in her

ん……。

Maybe she secretly sees us as allies

Or perhaps she has other targets in mind.

fields.JP: ！　ネムさん、近づいたら危ないっす！
（ネムさんがシラさんを抱きしめたっす……？）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Shira, do your best~!
Rapunzel will give you her favorite snack later, so do your best!
fields.JP:
シラ、がんばってー！
ラプンツェルのすきなおやつあとであげるから、
がんばって！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hang in there! Take my favorite snack!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: もとのシラにもどってぇ……！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
Looks like she's in stable condition.
Do you know where you are?
fields.JP:
どうやら落ち着いたみたいね。
ここがどこだかわかる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Looks like she's in stable condition.
Do you know where you are?

fields.JP: よ、よかったぁ～！　よかったよ～！

fields.EN:
What a relief! You have no idea!
Nicely done, Nemu and Rapu-san!
fields.JP:
うぅ、よかったっす！
本当によかったっす……！
ネムさんとラプさん、すごいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What a relief! You have no idea!
Nicely done, Sleepy and Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
You too, Shira-san! I can't believe you were
able to keep your Blood Libido down!
fields.JP:
なにより、血式リビドーに理性で耐えた
シラさんが一番すごいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You too, Pyre! I can't believe you were
able to keep your Blood Libido down!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: A Blood Libido that makes her want to kill people is fascinating, but it's equally fascinating that she suppresses it through reason.
fields.JP:
人を殺したいという血式リビドーも
興味深いけれど、それを理性で抑えつけている
ことも非常に興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm curious as to what triggers your Blood
Libido, and how you seem to suppress it.

fields.EN:
You may well be the Blood Maiden who
suffers the worst of us all.
fields.JP:
もしかすると彼女は、血式少女の中で
誰よりも苦しんでいるのかもしれないわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may well be the Blood Maiden who
suffers the worst of us all.

fields.EN: (For her Blood Libido to be something she doesn't want to do... that's just too cruel...)
fields.JP:
（自分がやりたくないことが
　血式リビドーだなんて、
　そんなのかわいそうすぎるっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I can't imagine how much pain she's in.)

fields.JP: わっ、シラさん！　大丈夫っすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
Oh, thank goodness. Let's get her back
to her tent.
fields.JP:
ほっ、よかった……。疲れたんっすかね。
このままテントに運んで寝かせてあげるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, thank goodness. Let's get her back
to her tent.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルもてつだう！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
I'll accompany you. In case her Blood
Libido reignites.
fields.JP:
一応、私も付き添うわ。
また血式リビドーが発動してもいけないから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll accompany you. In case her Blood
Libido reignites.

fields.EN:
(You're in good hands, Shira-san.
We've all got your back.)
fields.JP:
（シラさん、よかったっすね。
　シラさんの周りには、優しい人たちが
　たくさんいるっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(You're in good hands, Pyre.
We've all got your back.)
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): シラ => Pyre-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2 | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(Doing laundry is fun, fun, fun!
Maybe not that fun, but fun enough!)
fields.JP:
（洗濯、洗濯、楽しいな～。
　とはいかないっすけど、がんばるっすよ～）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Doing laundry is fun, fun, fun!
