Maybe not that fun, but fun enough!)

fields.EN:
(Everyone's out searching for food and
water. Gotta help where I can!)
fields.JP:
（みんなは食料調達に行ったり、
　新しい水場を探しに行ったりで忙しいっす
　からね。ちょっとでもお手伝いっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone's out searching for food and
water. Gotta help where I can!)

fields.JP: なんか楽しそうなことやってるわね

fields.EN:
Oh, Shira-san. Gotta stay positive even when
stuck with tedious work.
fields.JP:
あ、シラさん。
別に楽しいわけじゃないっすよ？
地味に重労働っすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Pyre. Gotta stay positive even when
stuck with tedious work.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: Is that what the humming's about?
fields.JP: でも鼻歌うたってたじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that what the humming's about?

fields.EN: It's a little trick to make hard labor more enjoyable. A bit of wisdom for living.
fields.JP:
重労働を少しでも楽しくするための
工夫っす。生きる知恵っすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It helps keep me focused. Think of it as
a welcome distraction.

fields.JP: ……あれ？　ちょっとあんた、その手の傷跡は
え？　ああ、これっすか

fields.EN: (Yikes. Boss's tie got loose during the washing.)
fields.JP:
（あちゃー、洗濯してるうちに
　手に巻いてた師匠のネクタイが
　ほどけちゃってたっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Yikes. Boss's tie got loose during the washing.)

fields.JP: そんな傷、いつ作ったのよ

fields.EN:
(Should I not tell her? That Shira-san was hurt by
her older sister...)
fields.JP:
（っと、言わないほうがいいっすかね？
　シラさんのお姉さんにやられたなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. Should I tell her that her sister's
the one who hurt me?)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: ……まさか、あのとき姉さんたちにやられたの？

fields.EN:
Um, yeah... But it's healing up just fine.
Nothin' to worry about.
fields.JP:
あー……そうっす。
ま、もうほとんど治ってるんっすけどね。
ぜんぜん痛くもなんともないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, yeah... But it's healing up just fine.
Nothin' to worry about.

fields.EN: Got it. Why'd you wrap it up then?
fields.JP:
そう……。
でも、それならどうして包帯なんて巻いてたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it. Why'd you wrap it up then?

fields.JP: これは師匠のネクタイなんっす

fields.EN:
I was his apprentice weapon-maker.
I wanna be just like him. He's the best
man I know.
fields.JP:
もともと自分は武器製造士の助手をしていて、
その師匠にずっと憧れていたんっす。
師匠にはずいぶん世話になったっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was his apprentice weapon-maker.
I wanna be just like him. He's the best
man I know.

fields.EN:
But when we got to the surface...
I got hurt sticking my neck out for him.
fields.JP:
でも地上に出たときに、
その……師匠を助けようとしたら
自分のほうが怪我しちゃったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
But when we got to the surface...
I got hurt sticking my neck out for him.

fields.EN:
I passed out, and when I came to,
the tie was in my hand.
fields.JP:
怪我で意識を失って、目が覚めたときに
握りしめていたのがこのネクタイだったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I passed out, and when I came to,
the tie was in my hand.

fields.EN:
For now, it's my only connection to him.
So I look at it as my good luck charm!
fields.JP:
今では師匠を感じられるのは
このネクタイだけっすから、
大切なお守りみたいなものっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
For now, it's my only connection to him.
So I look at it as my good luck charm!

fields.EN:
How are you smiling? Didn't you almost die
trying to save him?
fields.JP:
……なんで、そんなふうに笑ってられるのよ。
あんたはそいつを助けようとしたから
怪我したんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
How are you smiling? Didn't you almost die
trying to save him?

fields.JP: え？　まあ、そうっすけど

fields.EN: Helping someone even when it gets you hurt is crazy. If you hadn't helped them, you wouldn't have been injured...
fields.JP:
自分が怪我してまで助けるなんて、
どうかしてる。そいつを助けなければ
あんたが怪我することもなかったのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're a nutcase. If you never risked your
neck, you wouldn't have gotten hurt.

fields.JP: 助けなきゃ……、よかったのに

fields.EN: Take that back. That's low, even from you.
fields.JP:
その言葉は撤回してくださいっす。
いくらなんでも聞き逃せないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Take that back. That's low, even from you.

fields.EN:
Boss means the world to me. He gave me
hope when I had nothing!
fields.JP:
師匠は自分にとってかけがえのない人なんっす。
なんにもなかった自分に希望をくれたんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Boss means the world to me. He gave me
hope when I had nothing!

fields.EN:
I'd give my life a thousand times if it
means keeping his safe!
fields.JP:
師匠が助かるなら、
怪我なんていくらでもしてやるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'd give my life a thousand times if it
means keeping his safe!

fields.EN: (Oh no! I think I upset Shira-san...)
fields.JP: （！　シラさんが泣きそうに……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh no! I think I upset Pyre...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
What is your problem?! Blech!
What do YOU know?
fields.JP:
なによ！　なによ！
あんたなんかになにがわかるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What is your problem?! Blech!
What do YOU know?

fields.EN: I'm totally not jealous of you, Clara!
fields.JP:
くららを……うらやましいなんて
思ってないんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm totally not jealous of you, Clara!

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
...I lost my temper and said too much. It ended up
feeling like I bullied Shira-san.
fields.JP:
……ついカッとなって、言いすぎたっす。
シラさんをいじめたみたいに
なっちゃったっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I lost control of my emotions for a bit.
Maybe I responded harshly.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Could she really be jealous of me...?
fields.JP:
でも、うらやましいとかどうとか、
どういう意味だったんっすかね？
fields.LOCALIZED: Could she really be jealous of me...?

fields.JP:
自分にはシラさんの気持ちが
わからないっすよ……
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP:
んー……。
うらやましい、うらやましい……？

fields.EN:
(I can't stop thinking about where I left
things with Shira-san. Does she envy me?)
fields.JP:
（この間のシラさんが言ったこと、
　やっぱり自分にはよくわからないっす。
　うらやましいってどういうことっすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't stop thinking about where I left
things with Pyre. Does she envy me?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(Shira-san looked like she was about to cry back
then...)
fields.JP:
（あのときのシラさんは泣きそうな顔を
　してたっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She was on the verge of tears.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Just gotta talk it out with her. All it takes
sometimes is a little courage.
fields.JP:
やっぱりちゃんと話さなきゃダメっすよね。
最初だって勇気を出して話したから、
打ち解けられたんだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just gotta talk it out with her. All it takes
sometimes is a little courage.

fields.EN: Gotta hurry! I need to find Shira-san.
fields.JP:
善は急げっす！
シラさんに会いに行くっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Gotta hurry! I need to find Pyre.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira
Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: You came outta nowhere! Watch out!
fields.JP:
い、いきなり出てくるんじゃないわよ！
びっくりするでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You came outta nowhere! Watch out!

fields.EN: I'm just as surprised as you are.
fields.JP:
いや、こんな出口のすぐ近くにいるなんて
自分も思わなかったっすから……
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm just as surprised as you are.

fields.EN:
Huh? By the way, Shira-san, why were you standing
right in front of the tent?
fields.JP:
ん？　ところでなんでシラさんは
テントの真ん前にいたんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? What are you doing near this tent?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: （えーと……なんか気まずい沈黙っすね）

fields.EN:
I kept a little Marchen as a... What do you
call them, pets?
fields.JP:
小さなメルヒェンを飼ってたことがあるの。
そういうの、ペットっていうんでしょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kept a little Marchen as a... What do you
call them, pets?

fields.EN: Wait. You had a Marchen for a pet?
fields.JP:
そうっすね。
メルヒェンをペットにするっていうのが、
さすがっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Wait. You had a Marchen for a pet?

fields.EN:
I took good care of it, but Kubitsuri-neesan found it
and told me she was jealous of it.
fields.JP:
……しばらく隠れて飼ってたんだけど、
首吊り姉さんに見つかって、
「うらやましい」って言われて
fields.LOCALIZED:
I took good care of it, but my sister found it
and told me she was jealous of it.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN: So she took it from me...and killed it.
fields.JP: 取り上げられて……殺されちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED: So she took it from me...and killed it.

fields.EN:
That's just who Kubitsuri-neesan is. She takes what
she wants, and tosses it away when she's
done.
fields.JP:
首吊り姉さんはそういう人なの。
他人のものをすぐに欲しがって、
手に入ったら興味がなくなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's just who Gallows is. She takes what
she wants, and tosses it away when she's
done.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: 首吊り姉さん -> Kubitsuri-nee-san

fields.EN:
That Marchen was precious to Shira.
But to her, it was just a plaything.
fields.JP:
あのメルヒェンはシラには大事な存在
だったけど、首吊り姉さんにとっては
ただのオモチャと同じだったのね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That Marchen was precious to me.
But to her, it was just a plaything.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Mei-neesan laughed at me, called me dumb
for keeping my pet. I asked Guillotine-neesan
for help, but...
fields.JP:
メルヒェンを飼うなんて馬鹿みたいだって、
メイ姉さんにも笑われたわ。ギロチン姉さんは
助けてくれるって言ったけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sister Mei laughed at me, called me dumb
for keeping my pet. I asked my oldest sister
for help, but...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ギロチン姉さん -> Guillotine-nee-san; メイ姉さん -> Mei-nee-san

fields.EN:
When she tried creating another Marchen
using a core, she... Never mind.
fields.JP:
核の力で似たようなメルヒェンを生み出して、
……ううん、もういいわ。こんな話
fields.LOCALIZED:
When she tried creating another Marchen
using a core, she... Never mind.

fields.EN: I... I'm so stupid. The truth is, I was just jealous of Clara for having a family she could cherish.
fields.JP:
ば……馬鹿みたい。
本当はくららがうらやましかっただけなのよ。
大切に思える家族がいて
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is so dumb. Forget I said anything.
Just be happy you've got people in your
corner.

fields.EN:
Shira has no friends, no family. No memories
she wants to cherish, no mementos. When Shira
thought she had nothing...
fields.JP:
シラには家族とか仲間なんていない。
大事にしたい思い出や、思い出のモノもない。
なんにもないんだと思ったら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I have no friends, no family. Not even
memories. I have nothing at all.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
So that's why I'm jealous. Hope that
explains the outburst. Um...
fields.JP:
くららがうらやましくて、
この間はひどいこと言っちゃって……
その……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So that's why I'm jealous. Hope that
explains the outburst. Um...

fields.JP:
なんでそういうことを言って
くれないんっすか～！！

fields.EN: Huh? Why are YOU the one crying?!
fields.JP:
えっ？
ちょっと、どうしてあんたが泣くのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Why are YOU the one crying?!

fields.EN:
That's awful! What a terrible older sister! I had no
idea Shira-san went through that! Waaaah!!
fields.JP:
ひどいっすー！　ひどいお姉さんっすー！
シラさんがそんな目に遭ってたなんてー！
うわーん！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's awful! Your sisters are so cruel!
I had no idea! WAAAAH!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: こ、こら！　勝手にくっつかないでよ……！

fields.EN:
It's okay, Shira-san. No one's gonna hurt you
here.
fields.JP:
もう大丈夫っすよ、シラさん。
ここにはそんなひどいことする人は
いないっすからね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's okay, Pyre. No one's gonna hurt you
here.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
I won't forgive them! I won't forgive anyone who
bullies Shira-san! They'll get a Clara Attack!
fields.JP:
許さないっすよ！
シラさんをいじめる人は許さないっす！
くららアタックをお見舞いしてやるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll never forgive! I won't let anyone bully
you ever again! Unless they want a Clara
Body Slam!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Hehehe. A Clara Body Slam, huh?
You'll need more than that.
fields.JP:
ふふっ、くららアタックだって。
弱そうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. A Clara Body Slam, huh?
You'll need more than that.

fields.JP:
わ、笑わないでくださいっす！
自分、気合いだけは本物っすからね！

fields.EN: Hey, Clara, what do you think of Shira?
fields.JP: ねえ、くららはシラをどう思ってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you really think of me, Clara?
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
What do you mean? We spend every day
together. Eating, sleeping, and exploring.
We're friends as far as I'm concerned.
fields.JP:
なに言ってるんすか。毎日一緒にご飯を食べて、
話して、笑って、同じ時間を過ごしてる時点で、
もう大事な仲間に決まってるっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What do you mean? We spend every day
together. Eating, sleeping, and exploring.
We're friends as far as I'm concerned.

fields.EN: I see... There's someone who'll cry for Shira...
fields.JP:
そっか……。
シラのために泣いてくれる人がいるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Maybe I do have someone in my
corner.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: へ？　なんか言ったっすか？

fields.EN: Phew. I'm stuffed. That was delicious.
fields.JP:
ふ～、食った食ったっす。
ごはんおいしかったっす～
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew. I'm stuffed. That was delicious.

fields.EN:
(Oh. Shira-san and Nemu are napping.
Those two seem close.)
fields.JP:
（おっと、あんなところでシラさんと
　ネムさんがお昼寝してるっすよ。
　仲良しさんっすねー）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh. Pyre and Sleepy are napping.
Those two seem close.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
(Don't wanna wake them on the way
back to my tent.)
fields.JP:
（でもテントに戻るには二人のすぐ近くを
　通らなきゃいけないっすよ。起こさないように
　静かに通り抜けるっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Don't wanna wake them on the way
back to my tent.)

fields.EN: (Oh shoot. I hid. Now I'm stuck.)
fields.JP:
（あ～、まずいっす。
　とっさに近くの物陰に隠れちゃったっすよ。
　これじゃあ出ていきづらいっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh shoot. I hid. Now I'm stuck.)

fields.EN:
Napping with Nemuri ain't half bad.
I've needed some shut-eye.
fields.JP:
眠りと一緒にお昼寝すると気持ちよくて、
ついぐっすり寝ちゃうのよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Napping with Sleepy ain't half bad.
I've needed some shut-eye.

fields.EN:
Nemuri's a keeper. It's nice to hang with
someone who can keep their trap shut.
fields.JP:
すごいわね、眠りって。
寝てばっかりでなに考えてるのか
わかんないとこもあるけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy's a keeper. It's nice to hang with
someone who can keep their trap shut.

fields.EN:
But I do feel comfy around her...
I bet everyone loves her.
fields.JP:
でも優しくて、一緒にいると癒されて……。
みんなに好かれるはずだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I do feel comfy around her...
I bet everyone loves her.

fields.JP:
……寝てるのね。
寝たままでいいわよ

fields.EN: Nemuri isn't the only one. Everyone here is kind. I'd never been treated kindly before, so at first I didn't know how to react.
fields.JP:
眠りだけでなく、ここのみんなは優しいわね。
前は優しくされたことなんてなかったから、
最初は戸惑っちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleepy's not the only nice one. They're
all nice here. I don't get these people.
What's their motive...?
fields.notes: B12 source-form character identity restoration; B31 exact-paired meaning fidelity

fields.EN: But after coming here and having everyone help me, I started to think being treated like that isn't so bad.
fields.JP:
だけどここに来て、みんなに助けられて、
そういうのも悪くないって思えたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe there isn't more to it. Maybe this
is how they really are. Maybe I judged them
too soon.

fields.JP:
（シラさん……。
　そんなふうに思ってくれてたんっすね）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's a spoiled brat. Hence why
we butt heads..
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはわがままで子供っぽいわよね。
だからすぐケンカしちゃう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's a spoiled brat. Hence why
we butt heads..

fields.EN:
But she's a riot. Is this what it's like
to have a little sis?
fields.JP:
でも一緒にいるのは楽しいの。
妹がいたらこんな感じなのかなって、
ちょっと思ったりするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But she's a riot. Is this what it's like
to have a little sis?

fields.EN:
(A little sis... If Rapu-san heard her, she'd
probably pick a fight. That'd be cute.)
fields.JP:
（妹、っすか。ラプさんが聞いたら
　またケンカになりそうっすね。
　かわいいケンカっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(A little sis... If Rappy heard her, she'd
probably pick a fight. That'd be cute.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Gretel's intimidating, but she's no jerk.
She's got her act together.
fields.JP:
グレーテルはなんか怖いけど、
悪いやつじゃないし、
なんだかんだで頼りになるのよね。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel's intimidating, but she's no jerk.
She's got her act together.

fields.EN: (You don't ever really get used to it.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (You don't ever really get used to it.)

fields.EN: Hameln is stupid, clumsy, and always stumbling over her words, but she's absurdly cheerful. Being with her makes me feel like I could forget my worries.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンはバカでドジで言葉かみかみだけど、
なんかバカみたいに明るくて、一緒にいると
悩みを忘れちゃえそうになるの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln's a clumsy buffoon, but I can't
deny she's got charm. Even if she gets
on my nerves sometimes.

fields.EN: (Tell us how you really feel. Haha.)
fields.JP: （バカって二回も言ったっす……はは）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Tell us how you really feel. Haha.)

fields.EN:
Takumi's flamboyant, Itsuki's a stiff, and
Kaede's a nag.
fields.JP:
タクミはちょっとオネエっぽいし、
イツキはなんかカタブツだし、カエデは
うっとーしーくらいおせっかいだし
fields.LOCALIZED:
Takumi's flamboyant, Itsuki's a stiff, and
Kaede's a nag.

fields.EN:
But...they're all so genuine. This place
feels safe. *yawn* Man, I'm sleepy again.
fields.JP:
でも……みんなみんな優しくて、
あったかい……。いい、ところ……ふあぁ。
また、眠くなって……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...they're all so genuine. This place
feels safe. *yawn* Man, I'm sleepy again.

fields.EN:
(Hey, how about me? Are you really going
back to sleep?)
fields.JP:
（あれ、自分はなしっすか？
　そこで寝ちゃうんっすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hey, how about me? Are you really going
back to sleep?)

fields.EN:
(I can't hear her! What'd she say?!
What about me?!)
fields.JP:
（聞き取れなかったっす！
　最後はなんて言ったんっすか？
　自分のことどう思ってるっすかー！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I can't hear her! What'd she say?!
What about me?!)

fields.EN: (...What am I even doing? Eavesdropping and then getting all worked up by myself... This is just pathetic on so many levels.)
fields.JP:
（……って、なにしてるんっすかね、自分は。
　立ち聞きした上に一人で盛り上がるって。
　なんかいろいろと残念すぎるっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(What's gotten into me? I should head to
bed. Too bad.)

fields.EN:
(*sigh* Time to sneak into my tent
without waking anyone.)
fields.JP:
（はぁ……。二人を起こさないように、
　このまま静かにテントに帰るっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(*sigh* Time to sneak into my tent
without waking anyone.)

fields.JP: 今……シラの声、聞いたような……

くらら……シラのためにいつもありがとう……。
大好き……？

……きっと、くららも……
シラのこと……大好きだよ……

fields.EN: (Ah, there it is! Keep it comin'!)
fields.JP: （そう、自分っす！　あともうちょいっすよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Ah, there it is! Keep it comin'!)

fields.EN: What! Ugh! Rapu, you're so difficult!
fields.JP:
なによ！　なによ！
ラプのわからずや！
fields.LOCALIZED: What! Ugh! Rappy, you're so difficult!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
シラのほうがわからずやだもん！
べー！

fields.EN:
What are you guys arguing about?
Gotta play nice.
fields.JP:
あー、こらこら、ケンカっすか？
仲良くしないとダメっすよー
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you guys arguing about?
Gotta play nice.

fields.JP: だってシラがわかってくれないのー！

fields.EN:
Shira told you again and again that she's the
older sister!
fields.JP: 何度もシラのほうが姉だって言ってるでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you again and again, I'm the big sister!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: No, no! Rapu wants to be the older sister too!
fields.JP: やだやだ！　ラプも姉がいいー！
fields.LOCALIZED: No no no! I wanna be the big one!
fields.notes: B19 source nickname self-reference ラプ -> Rapu

fields.EN:
(Oh, I see. They're bickering about which
of them gets to be the older sister.)
fields.JP:
（ははーん。
　二人が姉妹みたいだって話になって、
　どっちが姉かでもめてるんっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I see. They're bickering about which
of them gets to be the older sister.)

fields.EN:
(I remember Shira-san calling Rapu-san her
little sister before...)
fields.JP:
（そういえば前にシラさんが、ラプさんを
　妹ができたみたいって言ってたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember Pyre calling Rappy her
little sister before...)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: (They both thought they were the one in the older-sister position. Honestly, I think they're pretty similar...)
fields.JP:
（どっちも自分のほうが姉ポジションだと
　思ってたっすね。どっちも似たようなものだと
　思うんっすけどねぇ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Looks like they both have a lot to prove.
Those two are more alike than they think.)

fields.EN:
Now, now, simmer down, you two. Why don't we just say
Clara's the older sister to both of you?
fields.JP:
まあまあ、二人とも落ち着いて。
もういっそのこと、このくららが二人のお姉さん
ってことでいいじゃないっすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now now, simmer down. Why don't
I take the older sister role?
fields.notes: B18 self-reference: JP self-reference is このくらら; ordinary older-sister relation remains translated.
シラ・ラプンツェル => Shira & Rapunzel

fields.JP: ふたりのもんだいなの！

fields.EN: Shira's older, so she's the big sister!
fields.JP: シラのほうが年上だから姉なの！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm older, so I get to be the big sister!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP:
ちがうもん！
ラプンツェルのほうがとしうえだもん！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
ラプンツェルのほうが、
かみがなが～いよ！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: ただ切ってないだけでしょ！

fields.EN: What about you, Shira? What's your excuse?
fields.JP:
なら、シラはどうなの！
なんでシラのほうがおねーさんだっていうの？
fields.LOCALIZED: What about you, Pyre? What's your excuse?

fields.EN: Because I'm more mature! And stronger!
fields.JP:
しっかりものだもん。
それにラプより強いんだから！
fields.LOCALIZED: Because I'm more mature! And stronger!

fields.JP: え～！？　ラプンツェルだってつよいよ！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: What's your deal? Show your proof!
fields.JP: なによ！　じゃあ証拠見せなさいよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What's your deal? Show your proof!

fields.EN:
Uu~! Rapunzel will show you!
She'll show you Rapunzel's strength~!
fields.JP:
う～、やってやる～！
ラプンツェルのちから、みせてやる～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Grrr I will! I'll show you how strong I am.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっとシラさん、ラプさん！
本気でやり合ったらダメっすよ！？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(Oh no. This is getting out of hand.
They might come to blows soon.)
fields.JP:
（あわわ、なんか物騒な流れになってきたっす。
　このままじゃ仲間同士で流血沙汰っすよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh no. This is getting out of hand.
They might come to blows soon.)

fields.EN: (I'll bring some sweets. Whoever goes for them first is the childish one—so we'll make her the younger sister. Problem solved!)
fields.JP:
（お菓子を持ってきて、
　先に食いついたほうがお子ちゃま。
　つまり妹ってことにすれば解決っすよ！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'll bring a snack. Whoever wants it first
is more immature. That'll solve things!)

fields.JP: （急いでお菓子を持ってくるっす！）

fields.EN: I'll be right back, so you two wait here without fighting, okay? Got it?!
fields.JP:
自分はすぐ戻るんで、
二人ともケンカしないで待ってるんっすよ？
いいっすねー！？
fields.LOCALIZED: I'll be right back. Just give me a sec, okay?!

fields.EN: *pant, pant* I ran all the way here, so I'm out of breath... Did you two wait quietly?
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ……。
走ってきたから息が切れるっす……。
二人ともおとなしく待ってたっすかー？
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant* Sorry, I'm out of breath.
You guys haven't killed each other, right?

fields.EN:
What qualifies anyone as a "big sister"
anyway?
fields.JP: そもそも『姉』の定義とはなにかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What qualifies anyone as a "big sister"
anyway?

fields.EN:
(Oh, Gretel-san's here. Shira-san and Rapu-san seem
quiet now...)
fields.JP:
（あれ、いつの間にかグレーテルさんも
　来ていたっすね。シラさんとラプさんの
　げっそりっぷりが気になるっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, Gretel's here. Pyre and Rappy seem
quiet now...)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
There is nary a distinction in age or maturity
between you, so we must first discuss criteria
if we want to continue.
fields.JP:
あなたたちが言う姉の定義とは非常に曖昧だわ。
まずはそこをはっきりさせなければ議論は
始まりさえしないのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There is nary a distinction in age or maturity
between you, so we must first discuss criteria
if we want to continue.

fields.EN:
So Shira, you posed the questions earlier
of who, what, when, where, and why with
regards to Earth's rotations, didn't you?
fields.JP:
さっきシラは姉の定義を確定する必要性について
「そんなの必要なんていつどこで誰が言ったの？
　地球が何回まわった日？」と聞いたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
So Pyre, you posed the questions earlier
of who, what, when, where, and why with
regards to Earth's rotations, didn't you?

fields.EN:
Your question is nonsense. Have YOU
any idea how old this planet is? Could
you even seek out that information?
fields.JP:
その質問自体がナンセンスよ。
あなたは地球が何回まわったのか
知っているの？　知るすべはあるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Your question is nonsense. Have YOU
any idea how old this planet is? Could
you even seek out that information?

fields.EN:
And have you any proof the Earth's still
spinning?
fields.JP:
そもそも今の地球が正しく自転していると
証明できる？
fields.LOCALIZED:
And have you any proof the Earth's still
spinning?

fields.EN:
(Ooh. Looks like Gretel-san's dissecting her
arguments one strand at a time.)
fields.JP:
（あー……だいたいわかったっす。
　グレーテルさんにずっとこの調子で話されたら、
　そりゃげっそりもするっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Ooh. Looks like Gretel's dissecting her
arguments one strand at a time.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Yeah... Guree talks about hard stuff...
fields.JP: うん……。ぐれーのはなし、むずかしい……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah. Gretty, I don't get it...
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
I'm merely using your logic.
Back to the topic at hand...
fields.JP:
私は単純なことしか話していないわ。
話を戻すわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm merely using your logic.
Back to the topic at hand...

fields.EN:
Shira, for you, whoever's stronger gets to
be the big sister, which leads us to the
topic of Nightmares...
fields.JP:
シラの言い分では強いほうが姉ということ
だったけど、その理屈だったらナイトメアも
入ってこないとおかしいわよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre, for you, whoever's stronger gets to
be the big sister, which leads us to the
topic of Nightmares...

fields.EN:
(Seems like all this discussion discouraged
them from fighting. Guess it all worked out.)
fields.JP:
（もう二人ともケンカどころじゃないっすね。
　これはこれで結果オーライっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Seems like all this discussion discouraged
them from fighting. Guess it all worked out.)

fields.EN: Hm? Why are you all gathered?
fields.JP: む？　貴様らなにをしておるんだ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Why are you all gathered?

fields.JP: ぐれーのはなし、ながい～！
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Hm. Need me to rescue from another one
of Gretel's lectures, do you? I see...
fields.JP:
ふむ、グレーテルの長話から救出するか……。
なるほどなるほど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Need me to rescue from another one
of Gretel's lectures, do you? I see...

fields.EN:
Sorry! I can't help you. Gretel's tyough
to deal with at times like this.
fields.JP:
すまぬ！　ワレには無理だ。
こーゆーときのグレーテルは
めんにょくさいのでな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry! Can't help you. Gretel's a tyough
cyookie.

fields.EN: (Whoa. Clean getaway. Even with her slur.)
fields.JP:
（うわぁ、すがすがしいほどの逃げっぷりっす。
　そしてやっぱり言葉噛んだっす）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Whoa. Clean getaway. Even with her slur.)

fields.EN:
Enough of your tangents. I want you two
to settle your nonsensical debate.
fields.JP:
さ、邪魔が入ったけど続きを話しましょう。
あなたたちの曖昧な定義の上で成り立つ
真剣な対立は、実に興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enough of your tangents. I want you two
to settle your nonsensical debate.

fields.EN: I won't let you go until it's settled.
fields.JP:
私が納得するまで、
最後まで付き合ってもらうわね
fields.LOCALIZED: I won't let you go until it's settled.

fields.EN:
What's your deal?! I'm done fighting!
Just let me go!
fields.JP:
な、なんなのよ、なんなのよぉ……！
もうケンカしないからゆるしてー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's your deal?! I'm done fighting!
Just let me go!

fields.JP: わーん！　ごめんなさいー！

fields.EN:
(Hm. Seems like Gretel-san's got everything
under control.)
fields.JP:
（うーむ。ケンカしてる子も黙らせる。
　グレーテルさん、さすがっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hm. Seems like Gretel's got everything
under control.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: やったっすー！　ついに完成っすよー！！

fields.EN: Ugh. What is? You're so noisy.
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. What is? You're so noisy.

fields.JP: ねーねーくらら、かんせいってなにがー？
てぃーしゃつ？　なにそれ

fields.EN:
It's an article of clothing that can be worn
casually. People used to put patterns on it.
fields.JP:
服の種類っすよ。
簡単に着られて、かつシンプルな形ゆえに
いろんな模様を入れることができるんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's an article of clothing that can be worn
casually. People used to put patterns on it.

fields.EN: Personally, I love to design shirts. Hehe.
fields.JP:
実は自分、Ｔシャツのデザインが
趣味なんっすよねー。でへへ
fields.LOCALIZED: Personally, I love to design shirts. Hehe.

fields.JP: しー……。らぷ、言っちゃダメ……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I've been keeping an eye out for shirts
throughout our journey, and now I've got
one for each of us!
fields.JP:
これまでの冒険の中で
ちまちまとＴシャツを探し続けて、
ようやく五人分のＴシャツが揃ったんっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've been keeping an eye out for shirts
throughout our journey, and now I've got
one for each of us!

fields.EN: So I remade them as Clara originals!
fields.JP:
で、そのＴシャツを
くららオリジナルデザインに
リメイクしたんっすよー！
fields.LOCALIZED: So I remade them as Clara originals!

fields.EN: Is that excitement I detect over here?
fields.JP: なにやら興味深い話が聞こえてきたわね
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that excitement I detect over here?

fields.JP: ワレ抜きで楽しい話は禁止だぞ！

fields.EN:
Perfect timing, you see...
(Blah blah blah)...
fields.JP:
ちょうどいいところに来たっす！
実はＴシャツがかくかくしかじかで
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect timing, you see...
(Blah blah blah)...

fields.EN: I see. I understand everything, from start to finish.
fields.JP: なるほど。一から百まですべて理解したわ

fields.EN: Easy to understand, even for me!
fields.JP: 実にわかりやすかったぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Easy to understand, even for me!

fields.EN:
Ta-dah! This is the shirt I designed.
Made the prints myself. Enjoy!
fields.JP:
じゃーん！　これがそのＴシャツっす。
全部手書きの力作っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ta-dah! This is the shirt I designed.
Made the prints myself. Enjoy!

fields.EN:
Not too shabby! It's not quite the Demon
King aesthetic, though.
fields.JP:
なかなかイカすではないか！
魔王っぽさは足りんがな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Not too shabby! It's not quite the Demon
King aesthetic, though.

fields.JP: ふふん、それほどでもっすよ！

fields.EN:
I'm not one to judge for aesthetics.
I have no taste for art.
fields.JP:
デザインの良し悪しは私には
よくわからないけれど、
芸術性もよくわからないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm not one to judge for aesthetics.
I have no taste for art.

fields.EN:
Well, I guess it's better than if you hated
it. Glad to see you approve.
fields.JP:
結局なにもわからないってことっすね……。
まあ、嫌そうじゃないのはよかったっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I guess it's better than if you hated
it. Glad to see you approve.

fields.JP: シラさんはどうっすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: ふ、ふん。ガキっぽいデザインね

fields.EN:
Hahaha. Tell me how you really feel.
Now I know we're friends.
fields.JP:
あはは、ひどいっすよー。
これは自分たちが仲間である証なんっすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha. Tell me how you really feel.
Now I know we're friends.

fields.EN:
See, Shira-san? You said before that you wanted
something to remember things by.
fields.JP:
ほら、シラさん前に言ってたでしょ。
思い出のモノが欲しいって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I remember you telling me you wanted
to make memories.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
It's something I'm interested in, yes.
Surprised you remember.
fields.JP:
そ、そんなこともあったけど。
……よく覚えてたわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's something I'm interested in, yes.
Surprised you remember.

fields.EN:
You told me about it, Shira-san. There's no way I'd
forget!
fields.JP:
シラさんが話してくれたことなんっすから、
忘れるわけないっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Duh! I'd never forget anything you tell me!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Ugh. How am I supposed to be a hater if
you keep accommodating me?
fields.JP:
……っ、な、なによ。
そんなこと言われたら
文句つけられないじゃない……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. How am I supposed to be a hater if
you keep accommodating me?

fields.EN: With that said, try it on, ladies!
fields.JP:
そんなわけなんで、このＴシャツを
みんなで着てみてほしいっす！
いいっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: With that said, try it on, ladies!

fields.EN:
This is my first time wearing "casual" attire,
but there's a first time for everything.
fields.JP:
たしかにこういったシンプルな服装は
したことがなかったわね。
何事も経験だわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
This is my first time wearing "casual" attire,
but there's a first time for everything.

fields.JP: じゃあ、さっそくみんなでお着替えっす！

fields.EN: How do they fit...? Huh, wait.
fields.JP:
みんな着替え終わったっすかー？
……って……あれ？
fields.LOCALIZED: How do they fit...? Huh, wait.

fields.JP:
（なんかみんなのサイズ感が、
　思った感じと違うような……）

fields.EN: This is something. It's a little big...
fields.JP:
な、なかなかの着心地ね。
ちょっと大きいけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: This is something. It's a little big...

fields.EN: Hahaha! So biiiiig! Like a dress! Fun!
fields.JP:
あはは、ぶかぶかだー！
ずりおちちゃうー！　たのしー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hahaha! So biiiiig! Like a dress! Fun!

fields.EN:
Be careful, Rapu! Stop bouncing or it'll
slip off!
fields.JP:
ラプ、気をつけなさいよ！
あんまり動いたら脱げちゃうわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be careful, Rappy! Stop bouncing or it'll
slip off!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Fuahahaha! Fits me perfectly, don't you
think?
fields.JP:
ふははははっ！
ワレは今、サイコーにＴシャツを
着こなちておるじょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fuahahaha! Fits me perfectly, don't you
think?

fields.EN:
Whaddya say? I look super extra handsome,
don't I?
fields.JP:
どうだ？　どうだ！？
似合っているだろう！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaddya say? I look super extra handsome,
don't I?

fields.EN:
Right, this will do. I can live with this.
It's comfortable enough. Now I have
loose-fitting pajamas.
fields.JP:
ええ、普通ね。私も普通。
着やすいという利点は魅力ね。
寝間着にしてもよさそうだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right, this will do. I can live with this.
It's comfortable enough. Now I have
loose-fitting pajamas.
Sleeping Beauty, on the other hand...

fields.EN:
(Nemu's chest is all smushed. Looks kinda
racy.)
fields.JP:
（ネムさんのおムネがぱっつんぱっつん……。
　こ、これじゃあ目のやり場に困るっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sleepy's chest is all smushed. Looks kinda
racy.)

fields.EN: Sorry, I think I goofed up with sizing.
fields.JP:
す、すみません。自分としたことが
サイズを間違えちゃったみたいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry, I think I goofed up with sizing.

fields.EN: Mm... It's fine. I like it...
fields.JP:
ん……大丈夫……。
ボク、気に入った……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... It's fine. I like it...

fields.JP:
だって……くららが作ってくれたから……。
嬉しい……

fields.EN:
This shirt is too big. Try again with your
sizes. Maybe get a better design too.
fields.JP:
このＴシャツ、サイズが大きすぎよ。
ちゃんと大きさくらい考えなさいよね。
それにデザインもガキっぽすぎるし
fields.LOCALIZED:
This shirt is too big. Try again with your
sizes. Maybe get a better design too.

fields.EN:
But...I'll take good care of it. Thanks!
That's all!
fields.JP:
でも……だ、大事にしてあげるわ。
ありがと！　それだけよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...I'll take good care of it. Thanks!
That's all!

fields.EN:
Shira-san...
I'm glad you like it.
fields.JP:
シラさん……。
こっちこそ、気に入ってもらえて嬉しいっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre...
I'm glad you like it.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: I hope you had fun trying it on!
fields.JP:
これからもいい思い出を
たくさん作っていきたいっすね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I hope you had fun trying it on!

fields.JP: 待ちなさい！　待ちなさいってばー！
かけっこたのしー！　あははははっ！
ふへ～、待ってくださいっす～！

fields.EN:
Their enthusiasm is almost infectious.
Don't you want to play with them, Hameln?
fields.JP:
単に体力が有り余ってるだけよ。
ところであなたは混ざらなくていいの？
ハーメルン
fields.LOCALIZED:
Their enthusiasm is almost infectious.
Don't you want to play with them, Hameln?

fields.EN: I don't wanna play kid games!
fields.JP: ワ、ワレはあんな子供のような遊びはせぬ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't wanna play kid games!

fields.EN:
Oh. Then why are you fidgeting? You seem
antsy, as if you're awaiting an invitation.
fields.JP:
あら、じゃあその貧乏ゆすりはなに？
さっきから遊びたくてソワソワしている
ように見えたんだけど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Then why are you fidgeting? You seem
antsy, as if you're awaiting an invitation.

fields.EN:
Just shaking in anticipation! Excited to
see who wyins this gyame of tyag!
fields.JP:
こ、これはアレだ。武者震いだ！
目の前で行われているかけっこに
興奮ちてちまっただけにゃのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just shaking in anticipation! Excited to
see who wyins this gyame of tyag!

fields.EN: You want to join them, don't you?
fields.JP: やっぱり遊びたいのね
fields.LOCALIZED: You want to join them, don't you?

fields.EN:
*pant, pant* Shira-san and Rapu-san are full of
energy. I'm at my limit.
fields.JP:
はぁ、はぁ……。
シラさんもラプさんも元気いっぱいっすねー。
自分はもう限界っすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
*pant, pant* I can hardly keep up with
those two. I can't do it anymore.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Phew. I want to lay down and rest.
fields.JP: ふー。ちょっと横になって休憩っす
fields.LOCALIZED: Phew. I want to lay down and rest.

fields.JP: まったく、だらしないわね……
つまんなーい！　もっとあそぼうよー！

fields.EN:
Rapu...? Clara is tired...
Don't force her... Bad girl.
fields.JP:
らぷ……？　くらら、疲れてる……。
無理させちゃ……めっ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy...? Clara is tired...
Don't force her... Bad girl.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Oh. Want me to lay on it?
fields.JP: え？　あ……膝枕してくれるんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Want me to lay on it?

fields.EN: You sure? I'll take you up on that.
fields.JP:
わー、いいんっすか？
それじゃあ遠慮なく……
fields.LOCALIZED: You sure? I'll take you up on that.

fields.EN:
(Man, she's got a soft lap. I don't know if
I've ever been this relaxed before.)
fields.JP:
（ふへぁ～、すっごい癒されるっす～。
　絶妙な柔らかさ、高さ、そしてネムさんの
　ぬくもりがじんわりと……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, she's got a soft lap. I don't know if
I've ever been this relaxed before.)

fields.EN:
(Is this some kind of...childish instinct?
I've never rested on a lap before. I could
get used to this!)
fields.JP:
（これが圧倒的な母性ってやつっすかね……？
　初めて膝枕してもらったっすけど、
　やみつきになっちゃいそうっす～）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is this some kind of...childish instinct?
I've never rested on a lap before. I could
get used to this!)

fields.JP: いいなー。ラプンツェルもー
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
You're childish, Rapu. Do you really
want her to baby you?
fields.JP:
ラプはやっぱりガキね。
あんなふうに子ども扱いされたいなんて……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're childish, Rappy. Do you really
want her to baby you?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
いいのー！？　やったー！
ほら、シラもいっしょに！

fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Gosh. Fine. If you insist, I guess...
fields.JP:
もう……しょうがないわね。
そんなに言うなら付き合ってあげる
fields.LOCALIZED: Gosh. Fine. If you insist, I guess...

fields.JP: 二人とも、いいこ……、いいこ……

fields.EN:
(Hehe. Shira-san knows she wanted to.
At least she's enjoying herself.)
fields.JP:
（ふふ、シラさんも素直じゃないっすね。
　嬉しそうなのはバレバレっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hehe. Pyre knows she wanted to.
At least she's enjoying herself.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(Hameln-san's eyes are fixed on them.
Is she jealous?)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンさんもガン見してるっすね。
　うらやましいんっすか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hameln's eyes are fixed on them.
Is she jealous?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Fascinating. I wonder how she can get them
so relaxed with such a mundane gesture?
fields.JP:
不思議だわ。
彼女は普通にしているだけなのに、
なぜ誰もがこんなにも癒されるのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fascinating. I wonder how she can get them
so relaxed with such a mundane gesture?

fields.EN: Her two other sisters don't have that kind of aura...
fields.JP:
姉二人のほうには、そんな力がある様子を
見たことがないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED: Her two other sisters don't have that kind of aura...

fields.JP: ねむねむはね～、甘くてふかふかなの～

fields.EN:
Remarkable. I wonder why that is?
Could it possibly have to do with her
enormous chest?
fields.JP:
興味深いわね。
なにか……そう、胸囲の大きさが
関係していたりするのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Remarkable. I wonder why that is?
Could it possibly have to do with her
enormous chest?

fields.EN:
Enormous chest... Is it a case of womanhood?
Does the size of your chest affect maternal
instincts?
fields.JP:
胸の大きさ……女性ホルモン……？
もしくは大きな胸に母性を感じさせる
秘密があるとか……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Enormous chest... Is it a case of womanhood?
Does the size of your chest affect maternal
instincts?

fields.EN:
Would the Demon King like to experience
sweet, fluffy comfort as well?
fields.JP:
魔王様も甘くてふかふかの癒しが
ほしいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Would the Demon King like to experience
sweet, fluffy comfort as well?

fields.EN: Nya?! What are you basing that on?!
fields.JP: にゃっ！？　にゃにを根拠に！？

fields.EN:
Oh, am I mistaken? You were staring.
If I am, then ignore me.
fields.JP:
あら、違ったの？
さっきから凝視しっぱなしだったから。
まあ違うなら別にいいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, am I mistaken? You were staring.
If I am, then ignore me.

fields.JP: ラプンツェル、ちょっと失礼
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプンツェル -> Rapunzel; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: （あ、ラプさんが引きはがされたっす）
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Seeing is believing. That healing of yours that has everyone captivated... I've decided to experience it myself.
fields.JP:
百聞は一見に如かず。
みんなが魅了されるあなたの癒しとやら、
私も体験させてもらうことにしたわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seeing is believing. I must experience it
myself.

fields.EN:
My... I see. I can verify how nice it is.
I may just doze off.
fields.JP:
ふぅ……なるほど……。
たしかにこれは気持ちいいわ。
うっかり眠ってしまいそう
fields.LOCALIZED:
My... I see. I can verify how nice it is.
I may just doze off.

fields.EN: Uu... Guree took Nemu-Nemu away from Rapunzel...
fields.JP: うぅ、ぐれーにねむねむとられちゃった……
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Oh, does Nemurihime belong to you?
I hadn't realized.
fields.JP:
眠り姫はあなたのものではないでしょう？
私のものでもないけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, does Sleeping Beauty belong to you?
I hadn't realized.

fields.EN:
Grr, Gretel! Weren't you an adyult?
Why are you clinging to Nemurihime like that?!
fields.JP:
ぐぬぬ、グレーテルよ……！
貴様はおとにゃではにゃかったのか？
なぜ堂々と眠り姫にくっちゅいておる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr, Gretel! Be matyure! Why do you get
to cuddle her?!

fields.EN:
Because life is ephemeral. That is my
final answer. Envious?
fields.JP:
何事も経験だから、とだけ言っておくわ。
うらやましいの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because life is ephemeral. That is my
final answer. Envious?

fields.JP: そっ、そんにゃわけにゃいわ！

fields.EN:
Anyway Nemurihime, there's something
urgent I must tell you. Visit my tent later!
fields.JP:
……それはそうと、眠り姫よ。
ワレは貴様に大事な用事を思い出した。
あとでワレのテントに来るがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway Sleeping Beauty, there's something
urgent I must tell you. Visit my tent later!

fields.JP:
（たしかにそうなんっすけど、
　シラさんに言われたらおしまいっすよ……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
(Not that I have any complaints. I feel
like I'm resting under a great oak tree.)
fields.JP:
（でも、なんか……幸せな気分っす。
　まるで大きな樹に抱かれて、
　みんなでくつろいでるみたいな……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Not that I have any complaints. I feel
like I'm resting under a great oak tree.)

fields.EN: (I think I'll stay like this a little while...)
fields.JP:
（もうちょっとだけ、
　このままでいさせてもらうっす）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I think I'll stay like this a little while...)

fields.EN:
What the?! What was that?! It's coming
from Rapu-san's tent.
fields.JP:
な、なんっすか？　このただならぬ声は！
ラプさんのテントの中からっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
What the?! What was that?! It's coming
from Rappy's tent.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Something may have happened to Rapu-san!
fields.JP:
ラプさんの身になにか起きたの
かもしれないっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Something may have happened to Rappy!
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: ラプさん、大丈夫っすか！？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
ラプさんが倒れてる……！
し、しっかりするっす！

いったいなにがあったっすか！？
誰かに襲われたっすか！？

fields.EN:
"I'm Hungry" attacked you?! Got it!
Wait...
fields.JP:
お腹空いたにやられたんっすね！？
わかったっす！　……ん？
fields.LOCALIZED:
"I'm Hungry" attacked you?! Got it!
Wait...

fields.EN: Um. Did you pass out from hunger?
fields.JP:
えーと……まさかお腹空いたから
倒れてたんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Um. Did you pass out from hunger?

fields.JP: うん……。おなかぺこぺこだよー……

fields.EN:
(I thought it was so much worse. All that
for nothing... But I guess a hungry Rapu-san
is an emergency.)
fields.JP:
（もっと深刻な事態かと思ったっすよ。
　人騒がせな……って、ラプさんにとって
　空腹は一大事なんっすよね。たぶん）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought it was so much worse. All that
for nothing... But I guess a hungry Rappy
is an emergency.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Dinner's not for a while, so hang in there.
fields.JP:
夕飯はもう少し先っすよ。
それまでは我慢するっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Dinner's not for a while, so hang in there.

fields.EN:
(I feel bad keeping Rapu-san from whetting
her appetite...)
fields.JP:
（こんなにお腹を空かせてるラプさんに
　我慢させるなんて、かわいそうっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I feel bad keeping Rappy from whetting
her appetite...)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
あ、そういえば……！
ラプさん、ちょっと待ってるっすよ！
ラプさん、お待たせしたっす！
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
I brought you some candy. Eat this and
charge up.
fields.JP:
あめ玉を持ってきたっすよ。
これを食べて元気を出すっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I brought you some candy. Eat this and
charge up.

fields.JP:
わーい！　わーい！
あめだま！　あめだまー！

fields.EN:
(Candy's the door to her heart.
Thanks for the advice, Jack-san.)
fields.JP:
（お菓子で大喜びっすね。
　前にジャックさんから聞いた通りっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Candy's the door to her heart.
Thanks for the advice, Jack.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
Whoa. Are you swallowing them whole?!
Wait!
fields.JP:
わわっ、いきなり噛んじゃうっすか！？
ちょっと待つっすー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. Are you swallowing them whole?!
Wait!

fields.EN:
Um. Candy's best when savored. Don't
just wolf it down. Suck on it for a little bit.
fields.JP:
あ、あのっすね、
あめ玉はかみ砕くものじゃないっすよ。
ゆっくり舐めて甘さを楽しむものなんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. Candy's best when savored. Don't
just wolf it down. Suck on it for a little bit.

fields.JP: そーなの？　わかった！
ちゅぱ、ちゅぱ……。ん～、あま～い！

（ほっ。貴重なあめ玉が一瞬で
　なくなるところだったっす……）

fields.EN: (But that's such a happy smile... It's making me feel happy too.)
fields.JP:
（でもすごく幸せそうな笑顔っすね。
　なんかこっちまで幸せな気分になるっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That should tide her over. At least she's
content.)

fields.EN:
Mmm... Huh? I stopped swallowing like
you said. Now they're gone.
fields.JP:
ちゅぱ……あれ？
たべてないのにきえちゃったよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mmm... Huh? I stopped swallowing like
you said. Now they're gone.

fields.EN:
Yeah. That's how it should be. It melts in
your mouth.
fields.JP:
そういうものなんっすよ。
あめ玉は舐めてると、
溶けてなくなっちゃうんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah. That's how it should be. It melts in
your mouth.

fields.EN:
(Rapu-san's got such a pleasant heart.
She hides nothing behind her eyes. It's cute.)
fields.JP:
（ラプさんは言ったことをちゃんと
　わかってくれて、素直でいい子っすね。
　なんかかわいくなってきちゃうっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rappy's got such a pleasant heart.
She hides nothing behind her eyes. It's cute.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: I'm still hungry, but I can wait.
fields.JP:
まだおなかすいてるけど、
ゆうごはんまでがまんする
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm still hungry, but I can wait.

fields.EN: It's 'cuz I can't eat everyone like rations!
fields.JP:
みんなはひじょうしょくじゃないから、
たべちゃだめだもんね！
fields.LOCALIZED: It's 'cuz I can't eat everyone like rations!

fields.EN:
Well, yes, you're right. You shouldn't
think of us as your back-up food.
fields.JP:
みんなは非常食じゃないって、
たしかにその通りなんっすけど
怖い発想っすね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, yes, you're right. You shouldn't
think of us as your back-up food.

fields.EN:
(I remember Jack-san telling us that Rapu-san
tried to eat him once out of desperation.)
fields.JP:
（そういえば、これも前にジャックさんから
　聞いたっす。ラプさんは最初の頃、
　ジャックさんを非常食扱いしてたって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I remember Jack telling us that Rappy
tried to eat him once out of desperation.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Looks like she's finally growing up.
fields.JP:
その頃に比べたら成長したってこと
なんっすかね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Looks like she's finally growing up.

fields.EN: Oh, nothing. Just please, don't eat me.
fields.JP:
いや、なんというか……。
これからも自分を食べないように、
よろしくお願いするっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, nothing. Just please, don't eat me.

fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Wha? What haff you goffen yourshelf
into?!
fields.JP:
ふえ？
ひょくじちゅーにひきなりろーひたんっふか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wha? What haff you goffen yourshelf
into?!

fields.EN: Ugh. Don't talk with your mouth full.
fields.JP: もう、話すなら飲み込んでからにしなさいよね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ugh. Don't talk with your mouth full.

fields.JP: 慌てて飲み込んで喉に詰まらせるんじゃないぞ
んで、ラプちゃんはなにを決めたんでやんすか？
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: WHY THE HELL YOU SPITTIN' YOUR FOOD?!
fields.JP: いいい、いきなりなんば言い出しとっと！？
fields.LOCALIZED: WHY THE HELL YOU SPITTIN' YOUR FOOD?!

fields.EN: That was so unexpected, I couldn't help it.
fields.JP:
あまりにも予想外すぎて、
僕としたことがつい噴き出してしまった……
fields.LOCALIZED: That was so unexpected, I couldn't help it.

fields.EN:
(Make babies? Oh, her Blood Libido.
Should've seen that coming.)
fields.JP:
（こ、子作り……。そういえばラプさんは
　そんな血式リビドーだったっすね。
　最近なかったから忘れてたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Make babies? Oh, her Blood Libido.
Should've seen that coming.)

fields.EN:
Rapu, what's the meaning of this?
Aren't you too young to think of that?
fields.JP:
ラプってばいきなりなに言ってんのよ。
子供作りたいなんて、ヘンなの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, what's the meaning of this?
Aren't you too young to think of that?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
That's Rapu-san's Blood Libido. You'll get
used to it.
fields.JP:
これがラプさんの血式リビドーなんっすよ。
初めて聞くとびっくりするっすよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's Rappy's Blood Libido. You'll get
used to it.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: I wanna make babies! Babies! Me!
fields.JP: こどもつくる！　こどもー！　つくりたいー！
fields.LOCALIZED: I wanna make babies! Babies! Me!

fields.EN: Ahem! I think that's our cue to leave.
fields.JP:
コホン！
あー、僕たちは席を外したほうがよさそうだな
fields.LOCALIZED: Ahem! I think that's our cue to leave.

fields.EN: Y-yeah. Uh... Sounds like girl talk to me.
fields.JP:
そ、そーよねー。
ガールズトークに男子はいらないわよねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Y-yeah. Uh... Sounds like girl talk to me.

fields.EN: Bastards made a run for it.
fields.JP: 逃げたか、ヤロウどもめ
fields.LOCALIZED: Bastards made a run for it.

fields.EN: Aw. I want a baby! I WANT A BABY!
fields.JP:
うぅ～、こどもほしいよ～。
こども～、ほ～し～い～！
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. I want a baby! I WANT A BABY!

fields.EN:
We heard you. Do you even know how
that stuff works?
fields.JP:
子供がほしいのはわかったわよ。
でもどうすればいいかわかってるの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
We heard you. Do you even know how
that stuff works?

fields.EN: I ask everyone, but they always tell me hard stuff, so I don't really get it.
fields.JP:
みんなにきくんだけど、
なんかいっつもむずかしいこといわれて、
よくわかんない
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I ask people, they tell me I'm too
young! I don't get it.

fields.EN:
I heard a, what's it called, stalk's gonna
come and bring me one...
fields.JP:
こーのとり？　が、あかちゃんをはこんで
きてくれるってきいたんだけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I heard a, what's it called, stalk's gonna
come and bring me one...

fields.JP: こーのとり？　こー……わかった！

fields.EN: A stalker! A stalker's bringing you a baby!
fields.JP:
ごーもんきぐ！
拷問器具が赤ちゃんを運んでくるのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: A stalker! A stalker's bringing you a baby!

fields.EN:
No, it's a stork. Stork, stalker...
Talk about a mix-up.
fields.JP:
違うっすよ。コウノトリっす。
コウノトリと拷問器具って、
すごい聞き間違いっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's a stork. Stork, stalker...
Talk about a mix-up.

fields.EN:
Hey, I was just following her. Everyone
makes mistakes.
fields.JP:
な、なによ。
ちょっと音が似てるんだから、
間違えることくらいあるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, I was just following her. Everyone
makes mistakes.

fields.EN: I want babies. Babies. Babies, babies, babies.
fields.JP:
こどもほしいよー。
こどもつくりたいよー。
こどもこどもこどもー
fields.LOCALIZED: I want babies. Babies. Babies, babies, babies.

fields.EN:
Rapu-chan hardly knows how to take care of
herself. What is she thinking...?
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんは「子供がほしい」って
言うわりには、その手の欲求が
あるってわけでもなさそうだね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy hardly knows how to take care of
herself. What is she thinking...?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Wait, Gretel-san. You joined the conversation so naturally...
fields.JP:
って、グレーテルさん。
すごい自然に会話に入ってきたっすね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B31 exact-paired meaning fidelity

fields.EN: Maybe it's because Rapunzel is still young. Her desire to have a child is still vague.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルは幼いせいかしらね、
子供が欲しいという欲求が漠然としているのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chalk it up to her naivety. She has no idea
what a burden children can be.

fields.EN: Things may change once she gets her first period, but for now there's no sexual desire involved at all.
fields.JP:
初潮を迎えればまた変化があるかも
しれないけれど、今のところは
性欲という視点はまったくないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps when her body changes, she will
understand what it entails. But for now her
knowledge of such things is undeveloped.

fields.JP: （す、すごい話になってきたっすね）

fields.EN:
I once gave Rapunzel a doll to simulate
her child-rearing desires, but it had no effect
on her Blood Libido.
fields.JP:
以前ラプンツェルに子供を模した人形を
与える実験をしてみたことがあったけれど、
血式リビドーは満たされなかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I once gave Rapunzel a doll to simulate
her child-rearing desires, but it had no effect
on her Blood Libido.

fields.EN:
Perhaps a live baby would be different.
There are too many variables to draw conclusions.
fields.JP:
生物であればいいのか、
それとも血の繋がりも必要なのか……
まだ不明なことが多くて興味深いわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps a live baby would be different.
There are too many variables to draw conclusions.

fields.JP: いつの間にそんなことしてたっすか

fields.EN:
Everyone's talking about hard stuff again!
Whenever Rapunzel talks about babies, it's always like this.
fields.JP:
またみんなでむずかしいはなししてる！
ラプンツェルがこどものはなしすると、
いっつもそう
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't get any of it! I just want a baby!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Forget you guys! Let's play torture, Shira!
fields.JP:
もういいもん！
シラ、あっちでごーもんおままごとしよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Forget you guys! Let's play torture, Pyre!

fields.EN: (Torture...? What kind of game is that?)
fields.JP:
（拷問おままごと……？
　なんか不穏な感じの遊びっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Torture...? What kind of game is that?)

fields.EN:
Never saw this coming though. I didn't
expect a lesson on reproduction, Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
それにしても、ちょっと意外だったっす。
グレーテルさんなら、もっとストレートに
生殖について語りだすかと……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Never saw this coming though. I didn't
expect a lesson on reproduction, Gretel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Jack warned me. He told me not to explain
it to her for at least another year.
fields.JP:
ジャックに口止めされているのよ。
一年間は真実を教えないようにって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jack warned me. He told me not to explain
it to her for at least another year.

fields.EN:
In exchange for my discretion, he promised
me a month's worth of treats.
fields.JP:
スイーツ一か月分と引き換えに
取り引きが成立したわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
In exchange for my discretion, he promised
me a month's worth of treats.

fields.EN:
Hahaha, I see! Jack's always two steps
ahead!
fields.JP:
あはは、そういうことか！
ジャックはしっかりしてるね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hahaha, I see! Jack's always two steps
ahead!

fields.EN: I am a woman of my word.
fields.LOCALIZED: I am a woman of my word.

fields.EN: (Seems like Jack-san really knows his stuff.)
fields.JP:
（なんていうか、ジャックさんの
　苦労がうかがえる話っす）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Seems like Jack really knows his stuff.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(I'm afraid of what'll happen once Rapunzel-san
learns the truth though.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルさんが真相を知るのは、
　もうしばらく先になりそうっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm afraid of what'll happen once Rapunzel
learns the truth though.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.JP: ねーねー、シラ、どうしたの？

fields.EN:
(I wonder what's going on between Rapu-san
and Shira-san. Shira-san seems sad...)
fields.JP:
（ラプさんとシラさん、どうしたんっすかね。
　シラさんが落ち込んでるみたいっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what's going on between Rappy
and Pyre. Pyre seems sad...)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Shira, you okay? Did you remember your
sisters again?
fields.JP:
シラ、だいじょうぶ？
またおねえさんのことおもいだしちゃったの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre, you okay? Did you remember your
sisters again?

fields.JP: あ……あんたには関係ないでしょ！

fields.EN:
(Who wouldn't feel that way in her shoes?
I bet Shira-san's been through so much.)
fields.JP:
（あのおっかないお姉さんたちのことを
　思い出してたら、そりゃ元気もなくなるっすよ。
　シラさんもいろいろあったんっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Who wouldn't feel that way in her shoes?
I bet Pyre's been through so much.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
Shira's already one of Rapunzel's friends.
You don't need to remember that scary older sister!
fields.JP:
シラはもうラプンツェルたちのなかまだよ。
あんなこわいおねえさんなんて
おもいださなくていいんだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We got your back, Pyre! Forget your
scary sisters!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Rapunzel wants Shira to smile!
An older sister who makes Shira look sad is bad!
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはシラにわらっててほしいの！
シラにかなしそーなかおさせるなんて、
シラのおねえさんはわるいやつ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want Pyre to laugh! No sad faces!
They're evil!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Rapunzel will beat someone like that to a pulp!
fields.JP:
そんなやつは、ラプンツェルが
ぎったんぎったんにやっつけてやる！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: I know! Maybe they've forgotten you.
fields.JP:
そうだ！
おねえさんたちは、もうシラのこと
わすれちゃってるかも！
fields.LOCALIZED: I know! Maybe they've forgotten you.

fields.EN:
I mean, they're meanies. They don't play
nice. They don't even think about you!
fields.JP:
だってひどいおねえさんたちなんだもん。
シラのことだいじにしないし。
だからシラのこともわすれてるよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I mean, they're meanies. They don't play
nice. They don't even think about you!

fields.EN: SHUT UP SHUT UP SHUT UP!
fields.JP: うるさいうるさいうるさい！
fields.LOCALIZED: SHUT UP SHUT UP SHUT UP!

fields.EN:
Ugh! They mopped the floor with you
guys! You're all weak! Stop blabbering!
fields.JP:
なによ、あんたなんか姉さんたちに
負けたじゃない！　弱っちいくせに
ごちゃごちゃうるさいのよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh! They mopped the floor with you
guys! You're all weak! Stop blabbering!

fields.JP: もうシラにかまわないで……！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Clara, what should I do?
Shira's mad at me.
fields.JP:
くらら、どうしよう……。
シラがおこっていっちゃった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Clara, what should I do?
Pyre's mad at me.

fields.EN:
I just said people who bully her are meanies.
Why'd she get mad...?
fields.JP:
シラをいじめるわるいやつを
わるいっていっただけなのに、
なんでおこっちゃったんだろう……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just said people who bully her are meanies.
Why'd she get mad...?

fields.EN:
...I'm sure Shira-san thinks of them as her sisters,
even with her trauma.
fields.JP:
……たぶんシラさんにとっては、
怖いお姉さんたちでも『家族』なんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
...I'm sure Pyre thinks of them as her sisters,
even with her trauma.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN: It's complicated. Even if you're afraid of them and don't like them, you still can't hate them... I think that's what it is.
fields.JP:
複雑っすけどね。
怖いし好きじゃなくても、憎めない……。
そんなところじゃないっすかね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Love's complicated, isn't it? She might
not like them, but they're family. Some
people have a hard time with that.

fields.EN:
(Maybe Shira-san is sad because she really wanted to
get along with her older sisters, but couldn't...)
fields.JP:
（本当はお姉さんと仲良くなりたかった、
　それなのにできなかったっていう悲しさが、
　シラさんの中にあるのかもっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I bet she just wants to bond with her
sisters, but can't. That's why she's down.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: ラプンツェルには……わかんないよ……
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Rapu-san. Is there anyone you're, uh, afraid
of?
fields.JP:
ラプさんは、えーっとこう、苦手……というか
ちょっと怖いなーって人はいるっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy. Is there anyone you're, uh, afraid
of?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy
B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
But how would you feel if someone said they hated
Gretel-san and wanted to beat her up?
fields.JP:
でも、誰かがグレーテルさんのことを嫌いとか、
それこそやっつけてやるーなんて言ってたら、
どう思うっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
But how would you feel if someone hated
her and threatened to beat her up?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: No! You cannot beat up Guree!
fields.JP: それはやだ！　ぐれーやっつけちゃだめ！
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Maybe that's how it is for Shira-san when it comes
to her older sisters.
fields.JP:
つまりそういうことかもしれないっすよ？
シラさんにとっての、お姉さんたちは
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe that's where her head's at!
She loves her sisters through it all.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Aw. So I can't beat up the meanies?
fields.JP:
うー……？
こわいけど、やっつけちゃだめ……？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw. So I can't beat up the meanies?

fields.JP:
ちょっとだけ、わかるけど……。
でも……やっぱり……

fields.EN:
(Eventually we'll have to make a decision.
But I know Rapu-san truly cares about Shira-san.)
fields.JP:
（そう簡単には納得できないっすよね。
　ラプさんは純粋にシラさんを心配して、
　ああ言ったんっすから……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Eventually we'll have to make a decision.
But I know Rappy truly cares about Pyre.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(I've never seen Rapu-san so upset. It worries
me.)
fields.JP:
（あんなに落ち込んだラプさんを見るのは
　初めてっす。……心配っすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I've never seen Rappy so upset. It worries
me.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: まって！　まってってばー！

fields.EN: Oof. What do you want?! Enough!
fields.JP: なんなのよ、しつこいわね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oof. What do you want?! Enough!

fields.EN: (Hmm. They don't look like they're fighting.)
fields.JP: （あれは……ケンカではなさそうっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Hmm. They don't look like they're fighting.)

fields.JP: もう！　いつまでついてくる気よ！
シラをつかまえるま……でっ！
や、やっとつかまえたー！

fields.EN: Shira told you to leave her alone! Let go!
fields.JP:
シラにかまわないでって言ったでしょ！
離しなさいよね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I said leave me alone! Let go of me!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Rapunzel said something mean to Shira before.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェル、このまえシラに
いやなこといっちゃった
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
She's Shira's older sister, but Rapunzel said she'd beat her up...
So Rapunzel's sorry.
fields.JP:
シラにとってはおねえさんなのに、
ラプンツェルがやっつけてやるーって……。
だからごめんなさい
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shouldn't say I wanna beat up your
sisters. I'm sowwie...
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
You know, even if Clara or Guree did something bad,
Rapunzel would hate it if someone else said they'd beat them up.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルはね、もしもくららやぐれーが
わるいことしても、ほかのひとがふたりを
やっつけてやるっていったら、いやだもん
fields.LOCALIZED:
If someone said they'd beat up Clara
or Gretty, I'd be real mad.
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
So even if your sisters are scary,
I get why you wanna protect them.
fields.JP:
シラもおねえさんがこわくても、
ほかのひとにわるくいわれたら
かなしくなっちゃうよね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So even if your sisters are scary,
I get why you wanna protect them.

fields.EN:
(Sounds like my words got through to
Rapu-san.)
fields.JP:
（ラプさん、この間の自分のたとえ話を
　わかってくれたんっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Sounds like my words got through to
Rappy.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Shira...?
Was what Rapunzel said wrong?
fields.JP:
シラ……？
ラプンツェルがいったこと、ちがった？
fields.LOCALIZED: Pyre...? Did I get it wrong?
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Shira doesn't understand either... Even though
they're her own feelings...
fields.JP:
シラだってわかんないわよ……。
自分の気持ちなのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I don't understand...my own feelings
sometimes.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
But after our separation, I've started to
realize how cruel they are.
fields.JP:
でもここに来て初めて、
ひどい姉さんたちだったってことに
気がついたわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But after our separation, I've started to
realize how cruel they are.

fields.EN:
But still, I can't bring myself to hate them.
What's wrong with me...?
fields.JP:
……だけど、どうしても憎み切れない。
なんでこんな気持ちになるのか……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But still, I can't bring myself to hate them.
What's wrong with me...?

fields.JP: シラにだってわからないの！
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: くらら、シラがないちゃった……

fields.EN:
*hiccup* *whimper*...
I wanted to be close with my sisters.
I wanted them to adore me...
fields.JP:
ひっく、うぅ……。
本当は姉さんたちと仲良くしたかった。
かわいがってほしかったの……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*hiccup* *whimper*...
I wanted to be close with my sisters.
I wanted them to adore me...

fields.EN:
But Shira can't be like her sisters. She's a
useless, unwanted child, so they abandoned her...
fields.JP:
でもシラは姉さんたちみたいにできない。
出来損ないのいらない子だから、
見捨てられたのよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I'm not them. I'm useless, so they
abandoned me.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
So, even after coming here, I started to
freak out...
fields.JP:
だから……ここに来てからも、
いつも不安で……
fields.LOCALIZED:
So, even after coming here, I started to
freak out...

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
Let's ask how your sisters feel the next
time you see them!
fields.JP:
つぎにおねえさんにあったときに、
きもちをちゃんときこう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Let's ask how your sisters feel the next
time you see them!

fields.EN:
Until then, Rapunzel won't say bad things
about your older sister either!
fields.JP:
それまではラプンツェルも
おねえさんのこと、わるくいわない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Until then, I won't talk bad about your sisters!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration
B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
No matter what happens, Rapunzel is on Shira's side!
Forever!
fields.JP:
どんなことになったって、
ラプンツェルはシラのみかただよ！
ずーっとだよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No matter what happens, I'm on your side,
Pyre. Forever!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Rapunzel remembers, even if it's a little hazy.
When Rapunzel first met Shira.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルね、
ぼんやりだけどおぼえてるんだ。
シラとはじめてあったときのこと
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
Shira was an enemy, but she hesitated because
she didn't want to kill Rapunzel. So she didn't!
fields.JP:
シラはてきだったけど、
ラプンツェルをころしたくないってまよってた。
それでころさなかった！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were my enemy, but you didn't
kill me. I saw you were confused!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Since then, I knew you were a good girl!
fields.JP:
そのときから、シラはわるいこじゃないって
ちゃんとしってたよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Since then, I knew you were a good girl!

fields.JP:
シラがほんとはなきむしだってことも、
ちゃんとしってる！

fields.EN: You didn't have to say that...
fields.LOCALIZED: You didn't have to say that...

fields.EN: But you've never killed anyone, Shira-san.
fields.JP:
シラさんは地上に出てからだって、
誰にも手を出さなかったっすよね
fields.LOCALIZED: But you've never killed anyone, Pyre.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
Actually, you seemed worried about everyone around
you. You're a kind person, Shira-san.
fields.JP:
それどころか周りの人を
心配している感じだったっす。
シラさんは優しい人なんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You've always put others first. You're kinder
than you give yourself credit.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
The more time we spend together, the
more I love you, Shira! Friends forever!
fields.JP:
いっしょにいたら、
シラのこともっとだいすきになったよ！
だからこれからも、ずーっとなかま！
fields.LOCALIZED:
The more time we spend together, the
more I love you, Pyre! Friends forever!

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: シラも、ラプンツェルのこと大好き……！
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプンツェル -> Rapunzel; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: えへへ～。よしよし、いいこいいこ！

fields.EN:
It's not just me and Rapu-san. Everyone else already
thinks of you as an important companion too,
Shira-san.
fields.JP:
自分やラプさんだけでなく、
他のみんなだってもうシラさんのことを
大事な仲間だと思ってるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy and I aren't the only ones.
Everyone adores you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
You always have a place here, Shira-san. You don't
need to feel anxious.
fields.JP:
シラさんの居場所なら
いつだってここにあるっす。
不安になる必要なんてないんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll always have a place here. No need
to feel anxious.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
It'd be nice if everyone could get along
like Rapunzel and the others do.
fields.JP:
みんなみんな、ラプンツェルたちみたく
なかよくなればいいのにね
fields.LOCALIZED: If only everyone was like us!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Marchens and Nightmares talking
instead of fighting.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンやナイトメアだって、
おたがいにおはなしできるんだから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Marchens and Nightmares talking
instead of fighting.

fields.JP:
そうっすね。
そうなればいいっすね……

fields.EN:
(Rapunzel-san's sharper than I thought.
Maybe one day we'll all be friends.)
fields.JP:
（ラプンツェルさんは、たまに鋭いことを
　言うっすね。たしかにみんなが仲良くなれたら
　それに越したことはないっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rapunzel's sharper than I thought.
Maybe one day we'll all be friends.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.EN:
But...sometimes, wishes aren't enough.
The world laughs when we plan.
fields.JP:
ただ……それだけじゃ
どうにもならないこともあるっすからね。
世の中うまくいかないっす……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...sometimes, wishes aren't enough.
The world laughs when we plan.

fields.EN:
(I'm just relieved they made up.
At first, I thought of Shira-san as nothing
more than a merciless killer.)
fields.JP:
（なんにせよ、二人が仲直りできて一安心っす。
　初めのうちはシラさんを戦力として見てる
　ところがあったのも事実っすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm just relieved they made up.
At first, I thought of Pyre as nothing
more than a merciless killer.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: （今はもう、かけがえのない仲間っすからね）
ねーカエデー。おなかすいたよー

fields.EN: Yeah yeah, hold on. I'm almost done.
fields.JP:
はいはい、ちょっと待ってな。
今作ってるからねー
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah yeah, hold on. I'm almost done.

fields.JP: カエデさん忙しそうっすね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN: Dinner rushes happen! Just be patient!
fields.JP:
まあそういうときもあるってことよ。
もうちょい待ってて！
fields.LOCALIZED: Dinner rushes happen! Just be patient!

fields.EN:
What's wrong with Kaede? Dinner's
usually done now.
fields.JP:
くらら、カエデはどうしたんだろう。
いつもならもうごはんのじかんなのに、
きょうはまだできてないんだよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What's wrong with Kaede? Dinner's
usually done now.

fields.EN:
Maybe she got backed up with another task.
Kaede-san's always up to something.
fields.JP:
なにか別の作業で時間が押しちゃったの
かもしれないっすね。
カエデさんも忙しい人っすから
fields.LOCALIZED:
Maybe she got backed up with another task.
Kaede's always up to something.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN: Oh. Guess busy is as busy does.
fields.JP:
そっかー。
ほかのしごとでいそがしかったから、
いまもいそがしくしてるんだ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh. Guess busy is as busy does.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's hungry, but she'll wait.
Kaede's having a hard time!
fields.JP:
おなかすいたけど、
ラプンツェルがまんする。
カエデがたいへんなんだもん！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm hungry, but I'll wait! Thank you Kaede!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: おー、ラプンツェルさん偉いっすね！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.EN:
If that's the case, so be it. I'll endyure
my hunger too.
fields.JP:
そういう事情なら仕方あるまい。
ワレも空腹を我慢しゅるじょ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If that's the case, so be it. I'll shall endyure
my hynger.

fields.EN:
I shouldn't be so massively petulant. I shan't
press my servant. Aren't I kind?!
fields.JP:
食事の時間が遅れても、家来を責めたりせん。
ワレは心が広いのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I shouldn't be so massively petulant. I shan't
press my servant. Aren't I kind?!

fields.EN:
Oh, that's generous of Hameln-san. Whether Kaede-san
is actually her servant is another matter.
fields.JP:
おー、ハーメルンさんも偉いっす。
カエデさんが家来かどうかはともかく
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. How generous, Hameln. Apart from
the servant comment.
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): ハーメルン => Hameln-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=1 Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Kaede's got her hands full. Maybe I
should help her...
fields.JP:
……カエデ、ひとりでたいへんそう。
ひとりじゃなかったら、
ちょっとはたいへんじゃないかな？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede's got her hands full. Maybe I
should help her...

fields.JP: （お。ラプンツェルさんどう出るっすかね？）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ラプンツェルさん => Rapunzel-san

fields.JP: お、なんだいラプちゃん
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプちゃん -> Rapu-chan; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Are you okay?
Should Rapunzel do something too?
fields.JP:
だいじょうぶ？
ラプンツェルもなんかしよっか？
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Oh my... Want to be my sous chef?
fields.JP:
おやおや……それならお手伝い
してもらってもいいかな？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh my... Want to be my sous chef?

fields.EN:
Why don't you set the tables? Careful
not to break them. Watch your step!
fields.JP:
それじゃあみんなの分の食器を出して。
壊さないようにそっとね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why don't you set the tables? Careful
not to break them. Watch your step!

fields.EN: Oh Nemu, just wait a little.
fields.JP:
あ、ネムさん。
今日はもう少しかかるみたいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh Sleepy, just wait a little.

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: そうなんっす。偉いっすよね

らぷ……偉い……。
ボクも……お手伝い……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: じゃ、自分も手伝うっすかね！
いやー、みんな手伝ってもらっちゃって悪いねぇ
みんなでおてつだい！　たのしー！

fields.EN: Now I feel awkward for sitting around...
fields.JP:
な、なんかワレだけふんぞり返ってるのも
気まずくなってきたぞ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Now I feel awkward for sitting around...

fields.EN:
Fine then! I'll bless the staff with my
bountiful effort! Praise me!
fields.JP:
よーし、今日はこの魔王が直々に
食事の用意を手伝ってやる！
感謝するがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fine then! I'll bless the staff with my
bountiful effort! Praise me!

fields.JP: ついにハーメルンさんも動いたっすね！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Of cyourse! I'm a White Demon King who
cares about my servants!
fields.JP:
と、とーじぇんだ！
ワレは家来を思いやれるホワイト魔王だからな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of cyourse! I am Saint Demon King, the
patron saint to my servants!

fields.EN: Okay, Saint Demon King. Grab the salt.
fields.JP:
それじゃあそこのホワイト魔王さん、
あっちから塩とってきてー
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay, Saint Demon King. Grab the salt.

fields.EN: Roger! There is nothing I CAN'T do!
fields.JP: 了解だ！　ワレにできぬことはない！
fields.LOCALIZED: Roger! There is nothing I CAN'T do!

fields.EN:
All your help is making dinner prep much
more efficient. Thanks!
fields.JP:
ラプちゃんたちが手伝ってくれるおかげで
早くできそうだよ。ありがとね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
All your help is making dinner prep much
more efficient. Thanks!

fields.JP:
えへへ～、ほめられちゃった！
もっとがんばるぞー！

fields.EN:
(Rapu-san never fails to bring a smile to
everyone's faces. Her special gift.)
fields.JP:
（ラプさんがいると、
　いつの間にかみんなが笑顔になってるっす。
　これもラプさんの特別な才能っすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Rappy never fails to bring a smile to
everyone's faces. Her special gift.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Huh? Why are you guys so quiet?
fields.JP: あれ？　二人とも黙ってなにして……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Why are you guys so quiet?

fields.EN:
We're trying not to make any noise,
so pipe down!
fields.JP:
せっかく音立てないようにしてるんだから、
大きな声出さないでよね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're trying not to make any noise,
so pipe down!

fields.EN:
(Oh, I see. Nemu's napping, and Rapu-san and
Shira-san don't want to disturb her.)
fields.JP:
（あ、よく見ればネムさんが昼寝中っす。
　ラプさんとシラさんは起こさないように
　気を遣っていたんっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh, I see. Sleepy's napping, and Rappy and
Pyre don't want to disturb her.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP:
（くぅ～、感無量っす！
　あのお子ちゃま二人がこんなにも
　成長したなんて……！）

fields.EN:
Rapu-san, Shira-san, this way. Let's not wake
her up.
fields.JP:
ラプさん、シラさん、ちょっとこっちに。
ネムさんを起こしちゃ悪いっすからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rappy, Pyre, this way. Let's not wake
her up.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Just wanted to say how proud I am
of you two. So I think a treat is in order.
fields.JP:
自分は二人のおりこうさんっぷりに
感激したんっす。だから特別に
ご褒美をあげようと思うっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Just wanted to say how proud I am
of you two. So I think a treat is in order.

fields.JP: ごほうび？　なになにっ？
あめだま！　やったー！

fields.EN:
You're such a child for getting excited over
candy. Well, Shira doesn't hate sweets either...
fields.JP:
あめ玉なんかで喜ぶなんて子供ね。
まあ、シラもお菓子は嫌いじゃないけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. You're too easily amused.
I guess I could try one though...
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: You two share it nicely between you, okay?
fields.JP: 二人で仲良く食べるっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Let me know what you think.

fields.JP: はーい！　ありがとう！
あら、あめ玉……。おいしそうね

fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN: (Rapu-san's acting defensive all of a sudden.)
fields.JP: （ラプさん、すごい警戒っぷりっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Rappy's acting defensive all of a sudden.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Th-This is something Rapunzel and Shira got!
fields.JP:
こ、これはラプンツェルとシラが
もらったんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: This is for me and Pi!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
I know. I merely thought you were childish
for accepting it.
fields.JP:
わかってるわ。
あめ玉一つで喜ぶなんて、
まだまだお子ちゃまだと思っただけよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know. I merely thought you were childish
for accepting it.

fields.EN:
S-Shira's different, okay? She didn't want this,
but Clara said she'd give it to her, so...
fields.JP:
シ、シラは違うわよ？
別にこんなのいらなかったけど、
くららがくれるっていうから仕方なく……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-It wasn't my idea. I didn't want it,
but Clara insisted.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Oh, you don't want it? I'll take it.
fields.JP:
あらいらないの？
なら私がいただくわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, you don't want it? I'll take it.

fields.EN:
(Gretel-san snatched it away from her!
What a bully!)
fields.JP:
（ひえー、取っちゃったっす！
　グレーテルさん、大人げない……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel snatched it away from her!
What a bully!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: I didn't say...I didn't want it still...
fields.JP: い、いらないとは……言ってないのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: I didn't say...I didn't want it still...

fields.EN: You don't want yours either, right Rapunzel?
fields.JP:
……ラプンツェルも、
あめ玉いらないんじゃない？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't want yours either, right Rappy?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプンツェル -> Rapunzel; removed localization-only Rappy
