fields.EN: I do! It's mine! No staring! Look away!
fields.JP:
い、いるもん！　だいじだもん！
じーっとみたって、だめなんだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: I do! It's mine! No staring! Look away!

fields.EN:
G-Guree, why do you want the candy?
There has to be a reason, right?!
fields.JP:
ぐ、ぐれーはなんであめだまほしいの？
きっとりゆうがあるんでしょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretty, why do you want candy?
Explain!
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN:
Well, it's my Blood Libido. I crave
sweets from time to time.
fields.JP:
……そうね、私の血式リビドーだもの。
甘いものが欲しくなるのは当然よね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it's my Blood Libido. I crave
sweets from time to time.

fields.EN:
You may not notice this, but I suffer from
constant desire.
fields.JP:
普通にしているように見えるかも
しれないけれど、これでも私は
強い欲求を堪えているのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not notice this, but I suffer from
constant desire.

fields.EN: Yes. You are a Blood Maiden. You should know.
fields.JP:
ええ。
あなたも血式少女ならわかるでしょ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. You are a Blood Maiden. You should know.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Rapunzel's Libido makes Rapunzel feel like
she wants children too. So Rapunzel understands
how hard it is for Gretel.
fields.JP:
うん……。ラプンツェルも、リビドーで
こどもほしいーってきもちになるもん。
ぐれーがたいへんなのもわかるよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah... Like when I crave babies.
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.JP: リビドーだから、ぐれーは……

fields.EN:
I-If Guree will give Rapunzel some sweets back
when her Libido calms down, Rapunzel can give her this candy...!
fields.JP:
も、もしも、ぐれーがリビドーないときに
ラプンツェルにおかしをかえしてくれるなら、
このあめだまあげてもいいよ……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you promise to repay me later, then
have my snack!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: あと！　シラのあめだまもだよ！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
No fair that you took Shira's candy too.
Be nice and give it back!
fields.JP:
シラがいらないってはっきりいうまえに、
ぐれーがとっちゃったから。ずるいもん。
シラにもかえすってやくそくして！
fields.LOCALIZED:
No fair that you took Pyre's candy too.
Be nice and give it back!

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: That's fair. I'll return the sweets to both of you when my Libido isn't acting up. All right?
fields.JP:
たしかにその通りね。
私にリビドーが出ていないときに
二人にお菓子を返す。それでいいわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure thing. I will offer you snacks when
my Libido dies down. Fair?

fields.EN: Then it's settled. Pleasure doing business.
fields.JP:
交渉成立ね。
いい取り引きができたわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Then it's settled. Pleasure doing business.

fields.EN: Enjoy it! Don't eat it right away!
fields.JP:
ちゃんとあじわってたべるんだよ。
すぐかんじゃだめだからね！
fields.LOCALIZED: Enjoy it! Don't eat it right away!

fields.EN:
Uu, Rapunzel's leaving now!
She'll forget all about the candy! Let's go, Shira!
fields.JP:
うぅ、ラプンツェルはもういく！
あめだまのことなんてわすれる！
いこう、シラ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oogh! I'm leaving! Forget the candy!
Come on, Pyre!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
...Rapu, thanks for speaking up about Shira's
candy too.
fields.JP:
……ラプ、シラのあめ玉のことも
言ってくれて、ありがとう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thanks for sticking up for me and the candy,
Rappy.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Impressive from Rapu-san to strike a deal
with Gretel-san. She's learning.
fields.JP:
はー、ラプさんもやるっすね。
グレーテルさん相手に交渉するなんて。
どんどん賢くなるっすねー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Impressive from Rappy to strike a deal
with Gretel. She's learning.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Indeed. She almost seems intelligent now.
fields.JP:
たしかにあの子は意外に論理的な
考え方ができるみたいね
fields.LOCALIZED: Indeed. She almost seems intelligent now.

fields.JP:
しっかりとした教育の場を与えれば、
そこそこ伸びるんじゃないかしら

fields.EN: That's high praise coming from you, Gretel-san.
fields.JP:
おお、グレーテルさんが褒めるなんて
予想外っす
fields.LOCALIZED: That's high praise coming from you, Gretel.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: I always give a fair assessment. That is all.
fields.JP:
評価できるものは適切に評価する、
ただそれだけよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I always give a fair assessment. That is all.

fields.EN:
So you think of Rapu-san as an equal now?
What kind of candy are you going to give them?
fields.JP:
ラプさんを対等に扱ってるってことっすね。
ところでさっきの約束のお菓子は、
どんなお菓子を返す予定なんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
So you think of Rappy as an equal now?
What kind of candy are you going to give them?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: 私の血式リビドーは２４時間３６５日よ

fields.EN:
The condition I stated earlier was to give
them candy once my Libido died down.
fields.JP:
さっきの条件は、
私のリビドーが出ていないときに、
だったからね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The condition I stated earlier was to give
them candy once my Libido died down.

fields.EN: So you don't intend to give them candy?
fields.JP:
そ、それじゃあ最初から返すつもりは
なかったと……？
fields.LOCALIZED: So you don't intend to give them candy?

fields.EN:
I didn't say that. Perhaps one day my urges
will suppress. Only then will I honor my
debt.
fields.JP:
そうは言っていないわ。なにかの弾みで
私の血式リビドーが出ない日がないとも
限らないから、そのときに返すつもりよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't say that. Perhaps one day my urges
will suppress. Only then will I honor my
debt.

fields.JP: （そんな日って、まずないっすよね？）

fields.EN:
(That's so sly of her. I hope Rapu-san and Shira-san
don't grow up to be like that.)
fields.JP:
（うーわー、ホント大人げないやり方っす。
　ラプさんとシラさんには、
　あんなふうには育ってほしくないっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(That's so sly of her. I hope Rappy and Pyre
don't grow up to be like that.)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(I better give them another piece of
candy just in case.)
fields.JP:
（でもこのままじゃ二人がかわいそうっすから、
　今度また別のお菓子を用意してあげるっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I better give them another piece of
candy just in case.)

fields.EN: (I'll sneak it to 'em so Gretel-san won't notice.)
fields.JP:
（そのときは
　グレーテルさんに見つからないように、
　こっそりあげるっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'll sneak it to 'em so Gretel won't notice.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、こんにちはーっす。
いるっすかー？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Come in if you need to talk.
fields.JP: 用があるなら入ってちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED: Come in if you need to talk.

fields.EN: I just came to see how you're doing.
fields.JP:
まあ要件っていうか、
ちょっと顔を見に来たんっすよ。
調子はどうかなーって
fields.LOCALIZED: I just came to see how you're doing.

fields.EN:
You know, I thought you might be struggling.
Are you okay?
fields.JP:
ほら、慣れない環境でいろいろ大変だったり
するかもしれないじゃないっすか。
大丈夫っすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You know, I thought you might be struggling.
Are you okay?

fields.JP: ふふ、あなたジャックのようなことをするのね

fields.EN:
(She's sharp. There are parts I copied from the way
Jack-san used to do it...)
fields.JP:
（流石鋭いっす。
　ジャックさんがよくやってたから
　真似たところはあるっす……）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Compared to before, this is inconvenient.
fields.JP: 環境に関しては不自由で過ごしにくいわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Compared to before, this is inconvenient.

fields.EN:
Of course. My old life was much better.
This is all a bother.
fields.JP:
当然でしょう
前はあんなに優遇された環境にいて、
今の環境が過ごしやすい訳がないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. My old life was much better.
This is all a bother.

fields.EN: But there's not much I can do about it.
fields.JP:
ただその件に関しては解決できない事柄だと
わかっているから問題はないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: But there's not much I can do about it.

fields.EN: (I wonder if I could help her somehow.)
fields.JP: （なにか自分が力になれることはないっすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I wonder if I could help her somehow.)

fields.EN:
If there's anything you want me to make,
let me know. I can make almost anything!
fields.JP:
そうだ、なにか作ってほしいものがあれば、
自分に言ってくださいっすね。
大抵のものは作れるっすから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
If there's anything you want me to make,
let me know. I can make almost anything!

fields.EN: If there's anything else you need, call me.
fields.JP:
他にも気になることがあったら
ドンと言ってほしいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: If there's anything else you need, call me.

fields.EN: Oh, perfect. Just who I wanted to see.
fields.JP:
それは、ちょうどよかった。
あなたのことが気になっていたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, perfect. Just who I wanted to see.

fields.EN:
You are one of the few Blood Youths.
Fascinating.
fields.JP:
血式少年の血を手に入れた
珍しい人間なんて他にいないもの。
実に興味深いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
You are one of the few Blood Youths.
Fascinating.

fields.EN:
The idea of creating more Blood Youths
with Jack's blood is tempting.
fields.JP:
ジャックの血を輸血しただけで
浄化能力を持つ人間が増えるとすれば、
とても便利なことよね
fields.LOCALIZED:
The idea of creating more Blood Youths
with Jack's blood is tempting.

fields.EN:
We Blood Maidens can drench ourselves
in blood, but we cannot purify ourselves.
fields.JP:
私たち血式少女はこれまでにも
彼の血を浴びたり飲んだりしているけれど、
穢れを浄化する力はないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We Blood Maidens can drench ourselves
in blood, but we cannot purify ourselves.

fields.EN:
Perhaps transfusion is the key. Or maybe
you're just special. So much to learn.
fields.JP:
やはり輸血というのが重要なポイントなのか、
それともあなた自身が特殊だったのか、
知りたいことは山積みよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps transfusion is the key. Or maybe
you're just special. So much to learn.

fields.EN: (Why is she eyeing me like that?)
fields.JP:
（心なしか、実験動物でも見るような目を
　向けられているような……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Why is she eyeing me like that?)

fields.EN: I don't understand the complicated stuff either, but maybe it's because I'm just an ordinary human—not a Blood Maiden or anything...?
fields.JP:
難しいことは自分にもわかんないっすけど、
もしかしたら血式少女でもなんでもない
ただの人間だったから、とか……っすかね？
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't know much. Maybe because I'm human?

fields.JP: ただの人間だから……ふむ……

fields.EN:
And the power I got from Jack-san's blood only lets
me do some of it. I still can't tell the Jail's mood
or anything.
fields.JP:
それにジャックさんから血をもらって
できるようになったのは一部の力だけで、
ジェイルの機嫌とかはわからないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can only do some of the stuff he can.
I can't sense much in Jail or anything.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
But I can purify, and that's good enough
for me!
fields.JP:
ま、それでも浄化の力を
得られたんっすから、
すごくありがたいことっすけどね！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I can purify, and that's good enough
for me!

fields.EN: Your human hypothesis could be accurate.
fields.JP:
ただの人間だからというあなたの仮説、
あながちあり得ないとも言い切れないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Your human hypothesis could be accurate.

fields.JP:
なかなか鋭い視点を持っているようね。
くらら

そ、そうっすか？
えーっと、お役に立てたならなによりっす！

fields.EN:
No ordinary person could receive Jack's
blood in a transfusion. I would like to look
into it more soon.
fields.JP:
そもそも普通の人間はジャックの血を
輸血される機会なんてないでしょうし、
実験の機会があればぜひ試してみたいわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No ordinary person could receive Jack's
blood in a transfusion. I would like to look
into it more soon.

fields.EN:
We must conduct an experiment
with Jack's blood.
fields.JP:
ジャックと輸血可能な人間……。
何件か実験データが欲しいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We must conduct an experiment
with Jack's blood.

fields.EN: You've got a scary look on your face.
fields.JP: その笑い、ちょっと怖いっすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED: You've got a scary look on your face.

fields.EN:
Put into practice, we could expand the
scope of the Blood Youths and resolve
our purification dilemma.
fields.JP:
もし実用化できれば、血式少年の力を持つ
人間を大量に人工生成して浄化の問題が解決できる
fields.LOCALIZED:
Put into practice, we could expand the
scope of the Blood Youths and resolve
our purification dilemma.

fields.EN:
I wonder what your blood can do as well.
If we were to give it to another host...
fields.JP:
……その実験をあなたの血でやってみたら
どうなるのかしら？　輸血された側の人間も
あなたと同じ能力が身に着くのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what your blood can do as well.
If we were to give it to another host...

fields.EN:
Ah, the possibilities. First things first,
we should examine your blood.
fields.JP:
ああ、興味が尽きない……。
まずは手始めにあなたの血を研究するのも
おもしろそうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ah, the possibilities. First things first,
we should examine your blood.

fields.EN:
I happen to have a syringe here.
May I extract some blood?
fields.JP:
偶然にもちょうどここに注射器があるの。
血をもらってもいいかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I happen to have a syringe here.
May I extract some blood?

fields.EN: Where in the world did that come from?!
fields.JP:
な、なんでそんな自然に注射器が
出てくるんっすかー！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Where in the world did that come from?!

fields.JP:
ぴゃー！
ち、血を抜くのはカンベンっすー！

fields.EN:
Oh, this may end up saving your life in
the long run. How unfortunate.
fields.JP:
あら、今は機材がないけど将来的に
あなたのリスクを軽減する案だったのに残念ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, this may end up saving your life in
the long run. How unfortunate.

fields.EN:
It was supposed to be my way of thanking
you for saving me.
fields.JP:
助けてくれたことへの感謝の気持ちも
あったのだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
It was supposed to be my way of thanking
you for saving me.

fields.EN: Hehe Clara, I look forward to the future.
fields.JP:
ふふ、くらら。
これからが楽しみ、ね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe Clara, I look forward to the future.

fields.JP: くんくん、なんか甘い匂いがするっすね

fields.EN: Ohhh. It smells good! Is there a shnack somewhere?
fields.JP:
おお～、うまそうなニオイだぞ！
どこかに菓子でもあるのではにゃいか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohhh. It smells good! Is there a shnack somewhere?

fields.EN: But it also smells a little burnt too...?
fields.JP:
でも微妙に焦げたニオイも
混ざっているような……？
fields.LOCALIZED: But it also smells a little burnt too...?

fields.EN:
Oh, Gretel-san. You seem calm considering
the sweet aroma.
fields.JP:
あれ、グレーテルさん。
こんなに甘い匂いがしてるのに
ずいぶん落ち着いてるっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Gretel. You seem calm considering
the sweet aroma.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: そんな真剣な顔でなにを読んでるんっすか？

fields.EN:
Doesn't seem like she hears us.
She seems intensely focused.
fields.JP:
聞こえておらんようだな。
すごい集中力だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Doesn't seem like she hears us.
She seems intensely focused.

fields.EN:
*gasp* If she's this focused, maybe it's a fun 
manga! I want to read it too!
fields.JP:
ハッ。それだけ集中するとは、
さてはおもしろいマンガだな！？
ワレも見たいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
*gasp* If she's this focused, maybe it's a fun 
manga! I want to read it too!

fields.EN: We've been here a while now.
fields.JP: さっきからけっこうしゃべってたっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: We've been here a while now.

fields.EN:
I was so focused I didn't notice.
Just reading a recipe.
fields.JP:
集中していて気づかなかったわ。
このレシピを確認していたところだったから
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was so focused I didn't notice.
Just reading a recipe.

fields.EN:
Yes, for cookies. I have the recipe, but
not the ingredients.
fields.JP:
ええ、クッキーのレシピ。
レシピだけは以前手に入れていたんだけれど、
材料がなくて製作に着手できなかったの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, for cookies. I have the recipe, but
not the ingredients.

fields.EN:
But I found just what I need soon after
reaching the surface.
fields.JP:
地上に出てきてたまたま使える材料が
揃ったから、実際に作ろうとしていたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I found just what I need soon after
reaching the surface.

fields.EN:
It's a tough one, though. The instructions
are vague.
fields.JP:
だけど難しいものね。
レシピには曖昧な表現が多くて
なかなかうまくいかないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's a tough one, though. The instructions
are vague.

fields.EN:
There's a lot of smudges on this page,
Gretel. A whole bunch.
fields.JP:
よく見れば、グレーテルの横に
黒い……なんというか、ダークマター的な
物体がいくつも転がっておるぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
There's a lot of smudges on this page,
Gretel. A whole bunch.

fields.EN:
The relics of failed cookies. Explains the
sweet aroma.
fields.JP:
失敗したクッキーの残骸っすね……。
甘い匂いの正体はあれだったっすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
The relics of failed cookies. Explains the
sweet aroma.

fields.EN:
I didn't want to waste them, so I picked
off the burnt areas and left the edible bits.
fields.JP:
もったいないから、焦げた部分は取って
食べられる部分はあとで食べるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I didn't want to waste them, so I picked
off the burnt areas and left the edible bits.

fields.EN:
*sigh* I thought this would satisfy my
sweet tooth. What a shame.
fields.JP:
はぁ……やっと甘いお菓子が食べられると
思ったのに、残念ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* I thought this would satisfy my
sweet tooth. What a shame.

fields.EN: Don't be sad! I'll make you cookies!
fields.JP:
がっかりするな！
クッキーくらいワレが作ってやる
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't be sad! I'll make you cookies!

fields.EN:
I read all about them in a manga!
I've practically mastered it!
fields.JP:
クッキーの作り方なら前にマンガで読んだからな。
ほぼマスターしたも同然だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I read all about them in a manga!
I've practically mastered it!

fields.EN:
But those are just pictures. Recipes are
much better for actual baking.
fields.JP:
それってイメージだけってことじゃ……。
でもせっかくレシピもあるんだし、
やってみる価値はあるっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
But those are just pictures. Recipes are
much better for actual baking.

fields.EN: I love making stuff too, so let me help!
fields.JP:
自分もものづくりは好きっすから、
一枚噛むっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I love making stuff too, so let me help!

fields.EN:
I'll warn you now that I intend to eat
all of the finished product.
fields.JP: 言っておくけど、完成品は全部私が食べるわよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll warn you now that I intend to eat
all of the finished product.

fields.EN: Rgh... Fine. That's your Blood Libido talking.
fields.JP:
く……だが仕方あるまい。
それがグレーテルの血式リビドーだからな
fields.LOCALIZED: Rgh... Fine. That's your Blood Libido talking.

fields.EN:
Hameln-san, that's big of you! You're not
the Demon King for nothing!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさん、大人っす！
さすが魔王っすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, that's big of you! You're not
the Demon King for nothing!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Hehe. Damn right! Besides, I've always
wanted to bake cookies. This is a good
chance to learn, even if I can't eat them.
fields.JP:
ふふん、まあな！　それにクッキー作りは
マンガを読んでからやってみたかったのだ。
食べれなくともよい機会だ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Damn right! Besides, I've always
wanted to bake cookies. This is a good
chance to learn, even if I can't eat them.

fields.EN: Oh, and if you fail, I'll kill you.
fields.JP: あと失敗したら殺すわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, and if you fail, I'll kill you.

fields.EN: I told you. These ingredients are rare.
fields.JP:
言ったでしょ甘いものにありつける
貴重な食材なのよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I told you. These ingredients are rare.

fields.JP: グレーテルも失敗してるではないか！

fields.EN:
I found them, so I have the right.
You, on the other hand, would be
on borrowed time.
fields.JP:
私が見つけて私が失敗したものだもの
その失敗に対して文句を言う対象がいないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I found them, so I have the right.
You, on the other hand, would be
on borrowed time.

fields.JP:
ど、どうするっすか！？
ハーメルンさん
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
D-Don't underestimate me! I'm not scawed
to make cookies!
fields.JP:
わ、我をなめるでない！
グレーテルが怖くてクッキーが作れないなど
あってはにゃらないのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
D-Don't underestimate me! I'm not scawed
to make cookies!

fields.JP:
（こっちはこっちで変なスイッチが
　入ってるっす……）

fields.EN: J-Just show me the recipe! Let's see...
fields.JP:
と、ともかくレシピを見せよ！
どれどれ……
fields.LOCALIZED: J-Just show me the recipe! Let's see...

fields.EN: Got it! Little girl, do exactly as I say!
fields.JP:
……よしわかった！　小娘！
今からワレの指示する通りに
調理を開始するのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Got it! Little girl, do exactly as I say!

fields.JP: が、がってんしょうちっす！

fields.EN:
(I listened intently to Hameln-san's instructions,
moving my hands swiftly on her command.)
fields.JP:
（それからハーメルンさんの指示のもと、
　自分はテキパキと調理を進めたっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I listened intently to Hameln's instructions,
moving my hands swiftly on her command.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
(Before I knew it, I had done almost all
the work.)
fields.JP:
（そしていつの間にか自分が
　ほぼ作っていたっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Before I knew it, I had done almost all
the work.)

fields.EN: I finished the cookies with the frying pan!
fields.JP: フライパンで作るクッキー完成っすー！
fields.LOCALIZED: I finished the cookies with the frying pan!

fields.EN: We did it! Just what the recipe called for!
fields.JP:
やったぞー！
というかちゃんとレシピ通りに作れば
できるのではないかー！
fields.LOCALIZED: We did it! Just what the recipe called for!

fields.EN:
It smells incredible. I've been waiting for
this day.
fields.JP:
なんておいしそうな匂いなの……。
私はこのときを待っていたんだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It smells incredible. I've been waiting for
this day.

fields.EN:
How is it? Delicious, right?! Super duper
yummy?!
fields.JP:
うまいのか？　うまいのだな！？
うまくてうまいのだなー！？
fields.LOCALIZED:
How is it? Delicious, right?! Super duper
yummy?!

fields.EN:
I've never seen Gretel-san make that face
before. We did it, Hameln-san!
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんのこんな笑顔、
初めて見たっすよ！
やったっすね、ハーメルンさん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I've never seen Gretel make that face
before. We did it, Hameln!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: HAHA! Victory is ours, little one!
fields.JP:
はっはっはっ！
これは我と小娘の勝利だ！
fields.LOCALIZED: HAHA! Victory is ours, little one!

fields.JP:
……素人が作ったにしては及第点ね
もぐもぐもぐ

fields.EN:
You can't hide your satisfaction behind
a harsh grade.
fields.JP:
そんなにっこにこで食べながら
辛口評価されても説得力ないっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can't hide your satisfaction behind
a harsh grade.

fields.JP: なにかおいしいにおいがする！
そうね美味しそうなお菓子の匂いだわ！

fields.EN:
Oh, Rapu-san, Shira-san! We made cookies.
Want some?
fields.JP:
あ、ラプさんにシラさん！
今クッキーを作ってたんっすよ！
１つ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, Rappy, Pyre! We made cookies.
Want some?
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: ひ、ひとつくらいいいでしょ！

シ、シラ
こういうときのぐれーはこわいんだよ

…………。
そんなに食べたいのかしら？
ねえ？

シ、シラ！
あっちにいこ！
ま、まったく容赦がないっす……
ふふ、これで続きが食べられるわね

もぐもぐもぐ
おいしい……！

fields.EN: (Where are you, Boss? Are you safe?)
fields.JP:
（師匠……今ごろどこにいるんっすかね？
　ちゃんと無事でいるっすか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Where are you, Boss? Are you safe?)

fields.EN:
(I know he's alive somewhere, but
I miss him so much.)
fields.JP:
（もちろん、生きてるって信じて……
　自分に言い聞かせてるっすけど、
　やっぱり……会いたいっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I know he's alive somewhere, but
I miss him so much.)

fields.JP: さっきからため息ばかりね

あ、グレーテルさん……。
自分、ため息ついてたっすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Yes. Even I notice. It's rare to see you
so sad. You're normally so positive.
fields.JP:
ええ。私が気づくくらいには。
そんなに意気消沈するなんて、いつも前向きで
明るいあなたにしては珍しいことね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes. Even I notice. It's rare to see you
so sad. You're normally so positive.

fields.JP: 自分はそんなに明るいっすかね……？

fields.EN: Yes, almost as much as Hameln.
fields.JP: そうね、ハーメルンくらいには
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes, almost as much as Hameln.

fields.EN:
I-I'm not that cheerful. Hameln-san's level of
cheerfulness is something normal people can't even
compete with!
fields.JP:
さ、さすがにそこまでは明るくないっすよ？
ハーメルンさんレベルって、もう普通の人じゃ
太刀打ちできない明るさじゃないっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I'm not THAT energetic. Hard to think
of many people who could top her!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Positivity is qualitative, not quantitative,
so the point is moot.
fields.JP:
性格の明るさなんて数値化できないものを、
これ以上論じていても仕方がないわ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
Positivity is qualitative, not quantitative,
so the point is moot.

fields.EN:
Still, it's unlike you to sigh. What's got
you down?
fields.JP:
だけど普段はため息をつかないあなたが、
何度もため息をついていたのは事実よ。
なにをそんなに落ち込んでいたの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Still, it's unlike you to sigh. What's got
you down?

fields.JP:
それは……、ちょっと、寂しいって
思ってたんっす

fields.EN:
Lonely? Are you unsatisfied with the
amount of people in our party?
fields.JP:
寂しい？　周りにいる仲間の人数が
少なく感じて寂しいということ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lonely? Are you unsatisfied with the
amount of people in our party?

fields.JP:
いや、そうじゃないっす。
師匠に会いたいなって思って……

fields.EN: It's the same with our other friends, but when I wonder whether Boss is really alive somewhere... I get worried and depressed...
fields.JP:
他の仲間もそうっすけど、師匠は本当に
どこかで生きているのかなって思うと、
心配で、暗い気分になっちゃったっすよ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I miss everyone else too, but it's been
so long since I've seen him. My heart's
heavy thinking about it.

fields.EN: Ah. So you're concerned for his well-being.
fields.JP: なるほど、生存の可能性の問題ということね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah. So you're concerned for his well-being.

fields.EN:
Considering the state of things, it's unlikely
he's still alive.
fields.JP:
今の世界の状況を考えれば、
生存している可能性は低いでしょうね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Considering the state of things, it's unlikely
he's still alive.

fields.EN: What...? Why would you say that?
fields.JP: え……っ。そ、そんな言い方って……
fields.LOCALIZED: What...? Why would you say that?

fields.EN: Th-The situation might be bad, sure. But I have a feeling Boss is alive! I dunno... I just do!
fields.JP:
た、たしかに状況は厳しいかもしれないっす。
でも自分は師匠が生きてるって気がするんっすよ！
なんとなくっすけど！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Chances might be slim, but I know he's
alive somewhere. He must be!

fields.EN: Must be? Sounds like wishful thinking.
fields.JP:
「なんとなく」、「気がする」……。
すべて希望的観測ね
fields.LOCALIZED: Must be? Sounds like wishful thinking.

fields.EN:
Haru's not a Blood Maiden, nor does he
bode well on the battlefield.
fields.JP:
ハルは私たちのように特殊な力を
持っているわけでもなく、
戦闘には不向きだわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haru's not a Blood Maiden, nor does he
bode well on the battlefield.

fields.EN: It's hard to imagine someone like that acting alone and surviving in a world in this state.
fields.JP:
そんな人間が一人で行動したとして、
こんな状態の世界で生き延びられるとは
考えにくいわね
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems like a stretch to think a mere
human would excel in such conditions.

fields.EN: I know all that! But even then... I...
fields.JP:
そんなこと、本当は自分でもわかってるっす！
それでも……それでも自分は……っ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I know all that! But even then... I...

fields.EN: ...She ran off before I could finish.
fields.JP: ……話の途中なのに行ってしまうなんて
fields.LOCALIZED: ...She ran off before I could finish.

fields.EN:
(Man, Gretel-san's so mean. She didn't have
to say all that.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんはひどいっす。
　なにもあんな言い方しなくたって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Man, Gretel's so mean. She didn't have
to say all that.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
(But... what Gretel-san said is true. If I think
calmly about it, the chance Boss is still alive is
already...)
fields.JP:
（……だけど、グレーテルさんの言ったことは
　事実っす。冷静に考えれば、師匠が生きてる
　可能性なんて、もう……）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(I was afraid of contemplating the worst,
so I kept my head turned in the other
direction.)
fields.JP:
（自分は現実に向き合うのが怖くて、
　都合のいい希望に縋っていただけなのかも
　しれないっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was afraid of contemplating the worst,
so I kept my head turned in the other
direction.)

fields.JP:
（もしも、もしも本当に師匠が……
　もう、いなかったりしたら……）

fields.EN: Boss... I miss you so much...
fields.LOCALIZED: Boss... I miss you so much...

fields.EN:
(Speaking with Gretel-san really bummed me
out. It's hard to go on.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんと話して以来、
　ふと気を抜くとやる気が一気に減退して
　力が出ないっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Speaking with Gretel really bummed me
out. It's hard to go on.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
(Before, I had faith that Boss was alive.
That kept me going. But after what Gretel
said...)
fields.JP:
（師匠は生きてるって信じてたから、
　今までがんばってこられたっすよ……。
　それをあんな風に言われたら……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Before, I had faith that Boss was alive.
That kept me going. But after what Gretel
said...)

fields.EN: Whoa. Gretel-san? Wh-what do you want?!
fields.JP:
うわっ、グレーテルさん？
い、いきなりなんなんっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa. Gretel? Wh-what do you want?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: I need a new bookshelf. Will you make me one?
fields.JP:
新しい本棚が必要になったの。
作ってもらえるかしら
fields.LOCALIZED: I need a new bookshelf. Will you make me one?

fields.EN:
(Of course. Gretel-san is unphased by our last
conversation...)
fields.JP:
（さすがはグレーテルさん……。
　この間のことを、これっぽっちも
　気にしてないみたいっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Of course. Gretel is unphased by our last
conversation...)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
(But I'm still upset. Seeing her act like this
pisses me off.)
fields.JP:
（こっちはずっと気にしてるのに、
　こんな態度を取られると、なんか、
　こう……むかむかしてくるっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I'm still upset. Seeing her act like this
pisses me off.)

fields.EN:
Why...?! Obviously because you said something mean,
Gretel-san!
fields.JP:
なぜって……！　そんなの、グレーテルさんが
意地悪なこと言ったからに決まってるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why...?! Because you were being so mean!
Duh!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: 意地悪？　心当たりがないわ

fields.EN:
About my Boss the other day! 
You said there's no way he's alive.
fields.JP:
この間の師匠の話っす！
い、生きてる可能性がない、みたいなこと
言ったじゃないっすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
About my Boss the other day! 
You said there's no way he's alive.

fields.EN:
You were so mean. It made me want to
be mean too.
fields.JP:
あんな意地悪なこと言われたら、
こっちだって意地悪したくなっても
仕方ないっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You were so mean. It made me want to
be mean too.

fields.EN:
What are you talking about? You're the
one who stormed off while I was talking.
fields.JP:
なにを言っているの？
あの話ならまだ続きがあったのに、
あなたが勝手にいなくなったんじゃない
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you talking about? You're the
one who stormed off while I was talking.

fields.EN:
What I stated earlier was the truth.
It's unlikely that Haru would survive on his
own.
fields.JP:
あのとき私が言ったことは事実よ。
今の世界の状況を考えれば、ハルが一人で
生き残っている可能性は低いわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
What I stated earlier was the truth.
It's unlikely that Haru would survive on his
own.

fields.EN:
But there's no proof he's dead, so it could
go either way.
fields.JP:
ただ、逆に生き残っていない証拠もないわ。
それならまだ生きている可能性だってあると
言いたかったのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
But there's no proof he's dead, so it could
go either way.

fields.EN:
(That's true... Ah, I jumped to conclusions about
what Gretel-san was trying to say...)
fields.JP:
（たしかに……。ああ、自分は
　グレーテルさんが言おうとしていたことを
　早とちりしてたんっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That's true. I jumped to conclusions there.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: And it's been confirmed that there are multiple cores now, right?
fields.JP:
それに、今は複数の核があることが
確認されているでしょう？
あ、はい……。それがどうしたんっすか？

fields.EN: We've destroyed one core. But somewhere we don't know about, another core is being destroyed.
fields.JP:
私たちの壊している核は一つ。
だけど私たちの知らないところで
別の核が破壊されているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
We've only destroyed one core. But other cores 
were destroyed in areas we haven't been.

fields.EN: So if someone else is destroying cores...
fields.JP:
私たち以外にも意図的に核を破壊している
誰かがいるとすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED: So if someone else is destroying cores...

fields.EN: Oh...! Think it could be Boss?
fields.JP:
まさか……！
師匠がやってるかもしれないってことっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh...! Think it could be Boss?

fields.EN:
It's just a theory. Others could be reuniting
as well.
fields.JP:
あくまでも私の仮説だけど、私たちが
こうして出会えたように、他の人たちだって
合流できている可能性はあるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's just a theory. Others could be reuniting
as well.

fields.EN:
If Haru's alone, his chances are slim.
But if he's with our friends, then his
chances improve.
fields.JP:
ハル一人なら絶望的な生存率も、
仲間がいるならだいぶ上がるはずよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If Haru's alone, his chances are slim.
But if he's with our friends, then his
chances improve.

fields.EN:
Yeah... Good point. That makes me feel
better. Thanks!
fields.JP:
そ、そっか……そうっすよね。
うわぁ、なんだかすごく希望が出てきたっす！
ありがとうっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yeah... Good point. That makes me feel
better. Thanks!

fields.EN:
Gretel-san, why were you so pessimistic
last time?
fields.JP:
グレーテルさんってば、なんでこの間は
あんな絶望的な感じの言い方したんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel, why were you so pessimistic
last time?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Everything I said was hypothetical. We can't even start until we first confirm the current situation those assumptions are based on.
fields.JP:
私の話はすべて仮定だったのよ。
まずは前提となる現状の確認をしなければ
なにも始められないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I spoke in theory. But that was pure
conjecture.

fields.EN: Theories with no basis are unproven.
fields.JP:
現状を把握していない仮定は、
ただの妄想になってしまうのだから
fields.LOCALIZED: Theories with no basis are unproven.

fields.EN: ...You're right. I mistook wishful thinking for hope and turned a blind eye to what scared me.
fields.JP:
……たしかにその通りっす。
自分はただの妄想を希望だと信じて、
怖いことは見ないふりをしていたんっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Well said. I let my imagination run wild.

fields.EN: Sorry Gretel-san. I took out my fear on you.
fields.JP:
グレーテルさん、ごめんなさいっす。
意地悪されたって勘違いして、
キツく当たったりして……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry Gretel. I took out my fear on you.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: I don't mind. Your moods do not affect me.
fields.JP:
別に構わないわ。
最初から気にしていなかったから
fields.LOCALIZED: I don't mind. Your moods do not affect me.

fields.EN:
But...your relationship with Haru intrigues
me.
fields.JP:
……それにしても、興味深いわね。
あなたにとってのハルという存在が
fields.LOCALIZED:
But...your relationship with Haru intrigues
me.

fields.EN: I can tell he means a lot to you.
fields.JP:
あなたの反応から、
あなたにとってハルが非常に大きな存在だと
いうことがわかったわ
fields.LOCALIZED: I can tell he means a lot to you.

fields.EN: And there's far more than a twelve-year age gap between you...
fields.JP:
年齢だって、ひと回りどころではなく
離れているというのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: He's more than twice your age.

fields.EN: A-Age has nothing to do with it! I mean, look, I was only worried about my master's well-being as his apprentice!
fields.JP:
ね、年齢なんて関係ないっすよ！
あのー、ほら、そもそも、ただ弟子として
師匠の身を案じただけなんっすから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Age doesn't matter! Our relationship is
purely professional!

fields.EN: You don't see him as a partner?
fields.JP: 異性としてまったく意識していないの？
fields.LOCALIZED: You don't see him as a partner?

fields.EN: WHAT?! OF COURSE NOT! Not really!
fields.JP:
いっ！？　……せい、としてなんて、
別に……いや、すこーし、だけっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: WHAT?! OF COURSE NOT! Not really!

fields.JP:
……まあ、いいわ。
その気持ちは理解できなくもないから

fields.EN:
Now that we've cleared the air, let's get
back to the original topic. Will you make
my bookshelf?
fields.JP:
さ、誤解が解けたところで本題に戻るわよ。
本棚は作ってもらえるのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now that we've cleared the air, let's get
back to the original topic. Will you make
my bookshelf?

fields.EN:
Sure. I'll make you one as an apology for
my attitude earlier!
fields.JP:
了解っすよ。
誤解してたお詫びも兼ねて、
腕によりをかけて作るっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sure. I'll make you one as an apology for
my attitude earlier!

fields.EN:
(I thought Gretel-san muttered something...
Oh well, I guess I won't let it bother me!)
fields.JP:
（さっきグレーテルさんがなにか
　ボソッと言った気がしたっすけど……。
　ま、細かいことは気にしないっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I thought Gretel muttered something...
Oh well, I guess I won't let it bother me!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP: くらら、ちょっといいかしら
ん？　なにかご用っすか？

fields.EN:
Nothing bad. Hameln wants to talk to you.
Deal with her.
fields.JP:
私がではなく、
ハーメルンがあなたに用があるみたい。
相手をしてあげて
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nothing bad. Hameln wants to talk to you.
Deal with her.

fields.EN: Oh, little girl! There you are!
fields.JP: あっ、小娘！　ここにいたのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, little girl! There you are!

fields.JP: ハーメルンさん、自分に用ってなんっすか？
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: I want to read some manga, but I can't find any!
fields.JP: マンガを読みたいのに、マンガがないのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: I want to read some manga, but I can't find any!

fields.JP: ……そりゃ、こんな状況っすからね

fields.EN:
I want to read! I want to read manga!
GAH!
fields.JP:
読みたい読みたい！　マンガを読みたいのだー！
うがーーーーっ！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I want to read! I want to read manga!
GAH!

fields.EN:
...Gretel-san? Why is Hameln-san telling ME that
she wants to read manga?
fields.JP:
……グレーテルさん。
ハーメルンさんはマンガが読みたいってことを、
なんで自分に向けて訴えてるんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
...Gretel? Why is Hameln telling ME that
she wants to read manga?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
She must have thought you could go find it.
Or maybe she thought you could draw her one.
fields.JP:
あなたならマンガを探してこられる、
もしくは、器用なあなたならマンガも
描くことができると考えたのかしらね
fields.LOCALIZED:
She must have thought you could go find it.
Or maybe she thought you could draw her one.

fields.EN: Yeah! Exactly! Little girl, draw manga for me!
fields.JP:
そう！　そにょとーりだ！
小娘よ、ワレのためにマンガを描くのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah! Exactly! Little girl, draw manga for me!

fields.EN:
What?! That's a bit much!
Gretel-san, do something about it!
fields.JP:
ひー、無理言わないでほしいっすー！
グレーテルさん、なんとかしてくださいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! That's a bit much!
Gretel, do something about it!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
*sigh*...I can't have her making a fuss
forever. Very well.
fields.JP:
ふぅ……。
いつまでもうるさくされても困るし、
仕方ないわね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh*...I can't have her making a fuss
forever. Very well.

fields.JP: ハーメルン。ちょっと失礼……

（グ、グレーテルさんが、
　ハーメルンさんのこめかみにキスを……！？）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP: にゃっ！？　にゃにをしゅるのだ！？

fields.EN:
I kissed your temple. I thought this was the
best thing to do to a petulant child...
fields.JP:
あなたのこめかみにキスをしたのよ。
駄々をこねる子供にはこうするのが
一番だと思ったのだけれど
fields.LOCALIZED:
I kissed your temple. I thought this was the
best thing to do to a petulant child...

fields.EN:
Who are you calling child?! We're almost
the same age!
fields.JP:
だ、誰が子供だ！
貴様と同じくらいの歳だろーが！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who are you calling child?! We're almost
the same age!

fields.EN: Oh? You were throwing a tantrum, demanding that I make the impossible possible. That's the sort of thing children do.
fields.JP:
あら、不可能な事象を可能にしろと言って
駄々をこねていたじゃない。
ああいうのは子供のすることよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, but you were whining. As a child does.

fields.JP: 駄々なんてこねてないぞ！

fields.EN:
Then stop asking for someone to draw you
manga. Do you want to push such an
impossible task on someone else?
fields.JP:
じゃあ、もうマンガを読みたいと言って
不可能な事象を押し付けたりしないわね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then stop asking for someone to draw you
manga. Do you want to push such an
impossible task on someone else?

fields.JP: するわけがないだろう！

fields.EN: Wow. You settled her down real quick.
fields.JP:
す、すごいっす……。
あっという間に丸め込んじゃったっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Wow. You settled her down real quick.

fields.EN:
Ah, Clara!
Merun and Guree are here too!
fields.JP:
あー、くららだー！
めるんとぐれーもいる！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh look, it's Clara! There's also Hammy
and Gretty!
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.EN: Hey, we're playing chain tag! Play with us!
fields.JP:
ねーねー、てつなぎおに、ってゆー
あそびがあるんだよ！
いっしょにやろー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey, we're playing chain tag! Play with us!

fields.EN:
What?! You hold hands?! And play tag?!
I've never heard of such a thing.
fields.JP:
なにっ、手を繋ぐ遊び！？
手つなぎ鬼とな！？
聞いたことのない遊びだぞ。
fields.LOCALIZED:
What?! You hold hands?! And play tag?!
I've never heard of such a thing.

fields.JP: ねむねむが知ってるんだってー！
うむ、ぜひやってみたいぞ！
くららと……グレーテルは……？

fields.EN: Oh, I'm busy. I'll join another time!
fields.JP:
あー、自分はちょっと忙しいんで、
また今度ってことで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, I'm busy. I'll join another time!

fields.EN: Then Rapunzel, Merun, and Nemu-Nemu can do it together!
fields.JP:
じゃあ、ラプンツェルとめるんとねむねむの
さんにんでやろー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Then Hammy and Sleepy, let's play!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP:
あはは……。ハーメルンさん
大喜びで行っちゃったっすね
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP: やはり子供だったということね

fields.EN:
Um, Gretel-san. You've done it to Nemu before
too, remember? What is that about?
fields.JP:
……あの、グレーテルさん。
さっきの、前にネムさんにもやってたっすよね？
あれってなんなんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um, Gretel. You've done it to Sleepy before
too, remember? What is that about?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: こめかみにキスするやつっすよ

fields.EN:
Hehe... When I was a child, when things
didn't go my way, I threw a fit.
fields.JP:
ふふ……私も幼少期の頃は、
自分の思い通りにならないときに
ぐずったことがあったわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe... When I was a child, when things
didn't go my way, I threw a fit.

fields.EN:
I had trouble reading these big words in a
book I had been reading...
fields.JP:
本の内容が理解できなかったり、
難しい字を読めなかったり……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had trouble reading these big words in a
book I had been reading...

fields.EN:
So my brother Hansel-niisan calmed me with a
kiss on the head.
fields.JP:
そんなとき、ヘンゼル兄さんが
さっきのようにしてあやしてくれたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
So my brother Hansel calmed me with a
kiss on the head.
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.EN:
(Gretel-san had a normal childhood.
How unexpected.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんでも、
　普通の子供みたいな時期があったんっすね。
　ちょっと意外だったっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Gretel had a normal childhood.
How unexpected.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Based on my own experience, I thought that might work on children who sulk or get depressed, so I tried it.
fields.JP:
自分の経験から、ぐずったり落ち込んだり
している子供には、ああすれば効果が
あるのかと思って試してみたのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
The technique works especially well
for all children who throw tantrums.

fields.EN: I don't know why it works, but it certainly seemed to have an effect.
fields.JP:
なぜ効くのかはわからないけれど、
実際に効き目はあったようね
fields.LOCALIZED: I can't explain how or why.

fields.JP: たしかに効果絶大だったっす

fields.EN:
(Maybe Gretel-san's not as heartless as I
thought.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんはドライで、
　人の気持ちにも鈍い気がしてたっすけど、
　普通に家族愛とかも知ってたんっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe Gretel's not as heartless as I
thought.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: (She may be a little odd, but that doesn't mean she's cold-hearted...)
fields.JP:
（少し変わってるってだけで、
　情が薄いってわけじゃないみたいっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Seems like her family meant a lot to her.)

fields.EN: You're staring. Did you want a kiss too?
fields.JP:
あら。私のことをじっと見てるけれど、
あなたもキスしてほしいのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: You're staring. Did you want a kiss too?

fields.EN: Wha?! No! I'm no child! No thanks!
fields.JP:
ふえっ！？
じ、自分は子供じゃないっすから！
遠慮するっすー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Wha?! No! I'm no child! No thanks!

fields.EN: Hehe. I wonder if Hansel-niisan felt this way too...
fields.JP:
ふふ……。
ヘンゼル兄さんもこんな気持ち
だったのかしらね……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hehe. I wonder if Hansel felt this way too...
fields.notes: Preserved source kinship/address form: ヘンゼル兄さん -> Hansel-nii-san

fields.JP: なるほど……とても興味深いわ

fields.EN: Aww. What are you looking at? Go away.
fields.JP:
うぅ、なに見てんのよぉ……。
離れなさいよねぇ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Aww. What are you looking at? Go away.

fields.EN: Oh, little girl. What are you doing?
fields.JP: 小娘ではないか何をそこで立ち止まっておるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, little girl. What are you doing?

fields.EN:
Seems like Gretel-san and Shira-san are up to
something.
fields.JP:
いやグレーテルさんとシラさんが
何かやってるんっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Seems like Gretel and Pyre are up to
something.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP:
いや、なんかやけに真剣そうなんで
邪魔しちゃ悪いかと……

fields.EN:
Genocide Pink... Blood Maidens. 
What's the difference?
fields.JP:
処刑台少女……血式少女とは
どんな違いがあるのかしら？
基本的には変わりなさそうだけれど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Massacre Pink... Blood Maidens. 
What's the difference?
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
You feel the same here. But a little more. *tap tap* 
*rub rub*...
fields.JP:
ここまでは私たちと変わらないわね。
まだまだもう少し。
ぺたぺた、さわさわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You feel the same here. But a little more. *tap tap* 
*rub rub*...

fields.JP:
ひゃあああっ！
触るんじゃないわよ～っ！
（やっぱりシラさんは困ってるようっすね……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: ちょちょちょ、ストップっすー！！

fields.EN:
Oh, I didn't see you guys.
Perfect timing. Hold her down.
fields.JP:
あら、いたの。ちょうどよかった。
この子を押さえていてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, I didn't see you guys.
Perfect timing. Hold her down.

fields.EN: What are you doing?! We won't help you!
fields.JP:
なにナチュラルに加担させようと
してるんっすか！？　ダメっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you doing?! We won't help you!

fields.EN: Oh Hameln, come here. Hold her down.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンでもいいわ。
この子を取り押さえていてちょうだい
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh Hameln, come here. Hold her down.

fields.JP:
だからダメっすからね！？
シ、シラさんこっちにくるっす！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
Shira's about to cry. What did Gretel do
to you?
fields.JP:
シラ、半泣きではないか！
グレーテルに嫌なことをされたのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre's about to cry. What did Gretel do
to you?

fields.EN: Hey Gretel! What did you do to Shira?
fields.JP:
やい、グレーテル！
貴様シラになにをしたのだ！？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Gretel! What did you do to Pyre?

fields.JP:
なにをしたって、
ただのスキンシップレベルの実験よ

スキンシップ？　実験？
良くわからぬが、それなら仕方ないか……

fields.EN:
You touched her all over. What kind of
experiment is that?
fields.JP:
あんな一方的に触ったりして、
一体全体なんの実験っすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You touched her all over. What kind of
experiment is that?

fields.EN:
Why are you acting like I performed surgery
on her?
fields.JP:
解剖したわけでもないのに非難されるなんて、
ひどい話ね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you acting like I performed surgery
on her?

fields.EN:
I just wanted to examine someone from
Genocide Pink. I thought it could lead us
to some answers.
fields.JP:
ここで処刑台少女について少しでも情報を
得ることができれば、敵の弱点もはっきりする
かもしれないのよ？　研究は必要よ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I just wanted to examine someone from
Massacre Pink. I thought it could lead us
to some answers.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN:
But you need to respect Shira-san's feelings.
She's our friend!
fields.JP:
そ、それでもさっきみたいにシラさんが
嫌がることはよくないっす。
シラさんは仲間なんっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
But you need to respect Pyre's feelings.
She's our friend!
fields.notes: Restore source honorific on surviving localized name mention(s): シラ => Pyre-san on 1 surviving EN mention(s); source occurrences=2 | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.EN:
All the more reason for us to examine her.
Shouldn't she offer herself to our cause?
fields.JP:
仲間ならなおのこと、体でもって
有益な情報を提供してもいいんじゃないの？
fields.LOCALIZED:
All the more reason for us to examine her.
Shouldn't she offer herself to our cause?

fields.JP: いやいや、なんかその理屈はおかしいっす！

fields.EN:
Shira, Clara and Gretel are arguing over you.
What's your opinion?
fields.JP:
シラ、貴様のためにくららが
グレーテルと言い争っているぞ。
貴様はどうなのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre, Clara and Gretel are arguing over you.
What's your opinion?

fields.EN: It's your body. Break the tie.
fields.JP:
もうらちが明かないから、
貴様が決めてしまえ
fields.LOCALIZED: It's your body. Break the tie.

fields.EN: Whatever... I guess it's best to let her decide.
fields.JP:
……まあ、いいわ。
本人に決めさせるのは道理ね。
fields.LOCALIZED: Whatever... I guess it's best to let her decide.

fields.EN:
Either you continue to drench yourself with 
Marchen blood, or you let me lick you. 
Let Shira decide.
fields.JP:
メルヒェンの血を浴び続けるか
私に舐められ続けるか、シラに決めてもらいましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Either you continue to drench yourself with 
Marchen blood, or you let me lick you. 
Let Pyre decide.

fields.JP: （なぜその二者択一なんすか……？）

fields.EN:
I-I don't want Marchen blood or to be licked! 
Waaaah!
fields.JP:
メ……メルヒェンの血も舐められるのもやだー！！
うわーん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I-I don't want Marchen blood or to be licked! 
Waaaah!

fields.JP:
グレーテルさん
つまりこういうことっすよ。
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Rationally speaking, information on Genocide Pink will be necessary going forward. I haven't changed my mind about that. And yet you people...
fields.JP:
合理的に考えれば、処刑台少女の情報は
今後のためにも必要よ。その意見は変わらないわ。
それなのにあなたたちときたら……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You're doing us a disservice by not
cooperating. But so be it.

fields.EN: You're really too softhearted. I suppose it can't be helped.
fields.JP:
本当、甘いのだから。
仕方ないわね

fields.EN:
Shira, you could also just, you know,
talk to us.
fields.JP:
……シラ。
せめて、今度話を聞かせてちょうだい。
それならいいでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Pyre, you could also just, you know,
talk to us.

fields.EN: Oh, good idea! Tell us everything, Shira!
fields.JP:
お、いいなそれ！
ワレもシラの話が聞きたいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, good idea! Tell us everything, Pyre!

fields.EN: If you're dying to know, I guess I'll talk!
fields.JP:
まぁ、それなら……。
そんなにどうしても聞きたいっていうなら、
聞かせてあげてもいいけど！
fields.LOCALIZED: If you're dying to know, I guess I'll talk!

fields.JP: じゃあ、そういうことで

fields.EN:
(I'm relieved we found a solution both Gretel-san
and Shira-san can accept.)
fields.JP:
（グレーテルさんもシラさんも
　納得できる形になって一安心っす）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'm relieved that we found a happy medium.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Hey Clara! Let me stay with you tonight.
fields.JP:
ちょ、ちょっとくらら！
今日は眠くなるまで一緒にいてあげるわよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey Clara! Let me stay with you tonight.

fields.EN:
(And you're still a little scared even now, aren't
you, Shira-san...)
fields.JP: （そして今もちょっと怖いんっすねシラさん……）
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: Mm. We might be running out of room.
fields.JP: う～ん、やっぱり収納も必要っすかねぇ……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm. We might be running out of room.

fields.EN: Y-You scared me! If you're going to call out to me, do it normally!
fields.JP:
い、いきなりびっくりするじゃないっすか！
声かけるんなら普通に頼むっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: You scared me! What were you thinking?!

fields.EN:
I'll watch out next time. So answer my
question.
fields.JP:
うむ、覚えていたらな。
それで貴様はなにをやっておったのだ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll watch out next time. So answer my
question.

fields.EN:
I'm making a desk. It should help with
organization and crafting.
fields.JP:
机を作ってたんっすよ。
ほら、なにか作業するときとか
机があったほうが便利じゃないっすか
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm making a desk. It should help with
organization and crafting.

fields.EN:
I was hoping we could also organize
some supplies inside.
fields.JP:
どうせ作るなら引き出しもつけて、
ちょっとした収納にもできるように
しようとしてたんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was hoping we could also organize
some supplies inside.

fields.EN: Whoa! You can make something like that?!
fields.JP:
なんかすごいぞ！
貴様そんなものが作れりゅのか！？

fields.EN:
I guess? I've always been good with my
hands, so this is a piece of cake.
fields.JP:
まあ、作れるっちゃ作れるっすよ。
もともと手先が器用なんで、
これくらいの物つくりは朝飯前っす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I guess? I've always been good with my
hands, so this is a piece of cake.

fields.EN: I work on Blood Weapons, you know. Hehe.
fields.JP:
「血式武器」だって少しくらいは
いじれるんっすよ～。えっへん
fields.LOCALIZED: I work on Blood Weapons, you know. Hehe.

fields.EN:
Ohh, impressive! Cyan't judge a book
by its cover!
fields.JP:
おおー、やるではないか！
人は見た目によりゃにゅにゃ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohh, impressive! Cyan't judge a byook
by its cover!

fields.EN:
Uh, don't mention it. By the way,
you're slurring a lot. You okay?
fields.JP:
いやー、それほどでもっす。
あとすごい噛んでるっすけど、
大丈夫なんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Uh, don't mention it. By the way,
you're slurring a lot. You okay?

fields.EN: I'm fine! I'm used to this much!
fields.JP: 大丈夫だ！　この程度は慣れておりゅ！
（それは大丈夫っていうんすかね？）

fields.EN:
It's amazing I don't remember you. What
did you do around Dawn?
fields.JP:
そんなにすごいのに、なぜか印象が薄いな。
貴様はれいめーでなにをしておったっけ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's amazing I don't remember you. What
did you do around Dawn?

fields.EN:
Aw, come on! I'm Haru-san's assistant.
I worked at the shop! Remember?
fields.JP:
ひ、ひどいっす！
ハルさんの助手やったり、物資販売所で店番
したりと地味に活躍してたじゃないっすかー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Aw, come on! I'm Haru's assistant.
I worked at the shop! Remember?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハルさん => Haru-san

fields.JP:
む？　そうか？
言われてみればそんな気もしてきたぞ

fields.EN:
Sorry, sorry. I joined the group kinda right
before we came up, so everything's hazy.
fields.JP:
いやー、すまぬ、すまぬ。
ワレもあそこに来てじきに地上に来たから、
記憶がふわふわしておるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sorry, sorry. I joined the group kinda right
before we came up, so everything's hazy.

fields.EN:
(Wait a second. It's not just Hameln-san.
A lot of the other Blood Maidens weren't
at Dawn either.)
fields.JP:
（考えてみればハーメルンさんだけでなく、
　今一緒にいる他の血式少女の人たちも、
　元々は黎明のメンバーじゃなかったっすよね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait a second. It's not just Hameln.
A lot of the other Blood Maidens weren't
at Dawn either.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP:
（元からメンバーだったのは
　ネムさんくらいで……）

fields.EN:
(Maybe I should strike up a friendship.
Ugh. But I get so nervous...)
fields.JP:
（ああ～、それを考えると、ここらで一つ
　親睦を深めたりしといたほうがいいんすかね？
　自分はそういうの苦手なんっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Maybe I should strike up a friendship.
Ugh. But I get so nervous...)

fields.EN: Hey, little one. Why'd you suddenly go quiet? Hungry? Does your stomach hurt?
fields.JP:
おい小娘、急に黙り込んでどうしたのだ？
腹が減ったのか？　腹が痛いのか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey little one, why are you so quiet?
Feeling hungry? Is your tummy growling?

fields.EN: Haha... Those are both about my stomach...
fields.JP: はは、全部お腹じゃないっすか……

fields.EN:
Fuhahaha! Don't let the small things bother you! 
You'll be forever small!
fields.JP:
ふははははっ！　細かいことは気にするな！
大きくなれぬぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fuhahaha! Don't let the small things bother you! 
You'll be forever small!

fields.EN:
I'm still going through puberty! I'll get
taller than you, Hameln-san!
fields.JP:
じ、自分は成長期っす！
いつかハーメルンさんよりは大きくなるっすよ！
たぶん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm still going through puberty! I'll get
taller than you, Hameln!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP: （まったく、テキトーでおおざっぱな人っすね）

fields.EN:
(But I could learn a thing or two from
her.)
fields.JP:
（……でも、この明るさは
　ちょっと見習いたいっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I could learn a thing or two from
her.)

fields.EN:
(If there's nothing I can do by worrying, it's
better not to worry. I'll learn from Hameln-san...)
fields.JP:
（悩んでもどうしようもないことなら、
　悩まないほうがいいに決まってるっす。
　自分もハーメルンさんを見習って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's right. It's pointless to stress.
I can't let those thoughts win.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Everything happens for a reason, but
you always seem to roll with the punches
Hameln-san.
fields.JP:
ま、なるようになるってことっすかね。
ハーメルンさんはこんな状況でも動じなくて、
大物かもしれないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everything happens for a reason, but
you always seem to roll with the punches
Hameln.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Ohhh, yes, praise me more! I yearn
for your approval!
fields.JP:
おお、ワレの偉大さに気がついたか！
よくわからぬが、ワレに任せるがよいじょ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ohhh, yes, praise me more! I yearn
for your approval!

fields.EN:
Now, march in rhythm!
One two! One two!
fields.JP:
さあ、足をそろえて！
いっちにー、いっちにー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Now, march in rhythm!
One two! One two!

fields.JP: いっちにー！　いっちにー！

fields.EN:
(Huh, what are they doing? Hameln-san, Rapu-san, and
Nemu-san look like they're walking in a line.)
fields.JP:
（あれ、なにしてるんっすかね？
　ハーメルンさんとラプさんとネムさんが
　一列になって歩いてるように見えるっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I wonder what they're doing. They're
all marching in a line.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
おっ、小娘ではないか！
貴様もやるか？
やるって……。それ、なんっすか？

fields.EN:
Hehe. Let me tell you!
We're marching in a line!
fields.JP:
ふふ、教えてやろう！
並んで歩いてるところなのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehe. Let me tell you!
We're marching in a line!

fields.EN: Don't ask me why. I just wanted to.
fields.JP:
なんだかなー、ムショーに並んで歩きたい
気分だったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't ask me why. I just wanted to.

fields.JP:
だからねー、いまからみんなで
おさんぽいくのー

fields.EN:
You want to march in a straight line?
That's kinda weird.
fields.JP:
並んで歩きたい、っすか……。
なんか不思議な衝動っすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
You want to march in a straight line?
That's kinda weird.

fields.JP: うむ！　理屈では説明できぬものなのだ！
ふーん。そういうものなんっすね

そういうものなのだ。
さあ、貴様も並ぶがよい！

fields.EN:
Because the myore the myerrier!
Be thankful I extended an invitation!
fields.JP:
人数が多いほうが並びがいがあるではにゃいか！
喜べ、貴様も我が配下に加えてやりょう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Because the myore the myerrier!
Be thankful I extended an invitation!

fields.JP: わーい！　くららもいっしょー！

fields.EN:
*grunt*...Okay, fine.
You want me to join, I will.
fields.JP:
う……わかったっすよ。
付き合えばいいんでしょ、付き合えば
fields.LOCALIZED:
*grunt*...Okay, fine.
You want me to join, I will.

fields.JP: よーし、ハーメルン隊出動だー！

fields.EN: (Since when did we form a Hameln Corps?)
fields.JP:
（自分たち、いつの間にか隊員になってる
　みたいっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Since when did we form a Hameln Corps?)

fields.EN:
Oh! Look there! Something's on the
floor!
fields.JP:
あ！　あそこみて、あそこ！
なんかおもしろそーなのおちてるー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh! Look there! Something's on the
floor!

fields.JP: ああっ、コラ！　列を乱すでない！

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Okay! Wait, something's here!
I wanna see!
fields.JP:
はーい！　……あっ、こっちにもなんかある！
みてこよーっと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Okay! Wait, something's here!
I wanna see!

fields.EN:
Nuaaaa! Stop wandering! You're messing
up the line!
fields.JP:
ぬああっ、うろちょろするな！
列が乱れるー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Nuaaaa! Stop wandering! You're messing
up the line!

fields.EN: ARGH! Rapunzel! Can you not walk in a line?!
fields.JP:
ええい、ラプンツェルよ！
貴様はちゃんと一列になって歩けんのか！
fields.LOCALIZED: ARGH! Rapunzel! Can you not walk in a line?!

fields.EN: Boo. It's boring just walking. Boo boo!
fields.JP:
ぶー。だってただあるいてるだけじゃ
つまんないよー。ぶーぶー
fields.LOCALIZED: Boo. It's boring just walking. Boo boo!

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
(I'm getting bored too, but I don't want
to ignore Hameln-san's Blood Libido.)
fields.JP:
（たしかにラプさんが退屈するのも頷けるっす。
　でもハーメルンさんの血式リビドーも
　満たしてあげたいし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm getting bored too, but I don't want
to ignore Hameln's Blood Libido.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: Oh! Why don't we play train?
fields.JP:
あ、そうっす！
電車ごっこをしたらいいんじゃないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh! Why don't we play train?

fields.JP: でんしゃごっこ？　なんだそれは

fields.EN:
First, we make a big circle with strong string,
then we form a straight line inside it.
fields.JP:
そういう遊びがあるんっすよ。
長いひもで輪っかを作って、何人かで
その中に入って一列になるんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
First, we make a big circle with strong string,
then we form a straight line inside it.

fields.EN:
Then we all walk the same pace and
move to the next spot.
fields.JP:
んで、みんなでひもを持って歩調を合わせて、
目的地まで一緒に移動するって感じっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then we all walk the same pace and
move to the next spot.

fields.EN: Is that supposed to be fun?
fields.JP: おもしろいのか？　それ
fields.LOCALIZED: Is that supposed to be fun?

fields.EN:
Well, it might be better than marching
in a straight line.
fields.JP:
ただ一列に並んで移動するよりは
楽しいと思うっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, it might be better than marching
in a straight line.

fields.JP: おもしろそー！　それやりたーい！

fields.EN:
Hmph. I had a whole vision, but I suppose
I can be patient and play along.
fields.JP:
むぅ。
ワレが思い描く姿とビミョーに違う気もするが、
まあ、広い心で付き合ってやるか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hmph. I had a whole vision, but I suppose
I can be patient and play along.

fields.EN:
Oh, that vine will do. Let's stretch it
into a circle.
fields.JP:
あ、ここにちょうどいい長さの蔓があったっす。
これをわっかにして、みんなで入れば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, that vine will do. Let's stretch it
into a circle.

fields.JP: じゃーん！　あっという間に電車ごっこっすー！

fields.EN: Hameln-san, you're the head. All aboard!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさんが先頭っすよ。
はい、出発進行ー！
fields.LOCALIZED: Hameln, you're the head. All aboard!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: Okay let's go. You all follow me!
fields.JP: うむ、行くぞ。ワレについてくるのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Okay let's go. You all follow me!

fields.EN: Choo choo chuga chuga choo choo.
fields.JP: がたんごとーん、がたんごとーん
fields.LOCALIZED: Choo choo chuga chuga choo choo.

fields.EN: Choo choo chuga chuga choo choo!
fields.JP: がたんごとーん、がたんごとーん！
fields.LOCALIZED: Choo choo chuga chuga choo choo!

fields.EN:
That's what I mean by train.
Actually, I've never seen a real one before.
fields.JP:
電車ごっこのときの掛け声みたいなものっす。
ま、自分も本物の電車は見たことないっすけどね
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's what I mean by train.
Actually, I've never seen a real one before.

fields.EN:
Oh. Our line won't break if we stay in this
formation. Not bad.
fields.JP:
おお、たしかにこの蔓があれば
列は乱れぬな。悪くないぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh. Our line won't break if we stay in this
formation. Not bad.

fields.JP: あははっ、なんかたのしー！

fields.EN:
(I'm glad they're enjoying themselves.
I'm happy we suggested this.)
fields.JP:
（喜んでもらえてよかったっす。
　電車ごっこを提案した甲斐が
　あったってものっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm glad they're enjoying themselves.
I'm happy we suggested this.)

fields.EN:
(Wait a second... Train's a kid's game.
We probably look pretty...)
fields.JP:
（……でも、ちょっと待つっすよ。
　電車ごっこなんて小さい子がやる遊びっす。
　今の自分たちの姿って……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wait a second... Train's a kid's game.
We probably look pretty...)

fields.EN: (D-Don't we look pretty embarrassing? Eek! I absolutely don't want anyone else to see us!)
fields.JP:
（か、かなり痛いんじゃないっすか？
　ひー、他の人たちには
　絶対に見られたくないっすー！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(...Pathetic, huh? Aah! I hope no one sees
us!)

fields.EN: (Oh no. Nemu looks a little embarrassed!)
fields.JP:
（うわ、よく見たらネムさんも
　恥ずかしそうにしてるっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh no. Sleepy looks a little embarrassed!)

fields.EN:
(But she's still doing it for Hameln-san and
Rapu-san! What an angel!)
fields.JP:
（恥ずかしくてもハーメルンさんと
　ラプさんに付き合ってあげるなんて、
　ネムさんマジ天使っす……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But she's still doing it for Hameln and
Rappy! What an angel!)
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプさん -> Rapu-san; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
Choo choo. Chugga chugga choo choo!
Hahaha. I'm getting the hang of this!
Look at me go!
fields.JP:
がたんごとーん、がたんごとーん！
はははっ、ノッてきたぞ！
なかなか愉快ではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Choo choo. Chugga chugga choo choo!
Hahaha. I'm getting the hang of this!
Look at me go!

fields.EN:
Very well. Time to demonstrate our gallant
side!
fields.JP:
よーし、この雄姿を他の者どもにも
見せてやりに行くぞー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. Time to demonstrate our gallant
side!

fields.JP: そ、それは勘弁してほしいっすー！

fields.EN:
Phew. I feel much better after using the
bathroom!
fields.JP: ふい～、用を足してスッキリっすー
fields.LOCALIZED:
Phew. I feel much better after using the
bathroom!

fields.EN:
Oops. That's not too ladylike of me.
My bad.
fields.JP:
って、独り言とはいえうら若き乙女が
言うことじゃなかったっすね。
反省反省……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oops. That's not too ladylike of me.
My bad.

fields.EN:
(Oh...? Hameln-san is sitting over there.
What is she doing?)
fields.JP:
（……あれ？
　ハーメルンさんがあんなところに……。
　一人でなにしてるんっすかね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oh...? Hameln is sitting over there.
What is she doing?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP:
（なんかいつもと様子が違うっす。
　どことなく元気がないっていうか……）
（早くテントに戻って寝たいっすけど……）

fields.EN:
(No...! Jack-san wouldn't leave her be.
Gotta be a good leader.)
fields.JP:
（いや……！
　ジャックさんならきっとほっとかないっす。
　自分も変わらなきゃいけないっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(No...! Jack wouldn't leave her be.
Gotta be a good leader.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.JP: ハーメルンさん、こんばんはっす
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: What are you doing up at this hour?
fields.JP:
こんな時間に起きてるなんて、
どうしたんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: What are you doing up at this hour?

fields.EN:
Hm. I had the strangest dream. I can't
seem to fall back asleep.
fields.JP:
うむ……。
変な夢を見て、目が冴えてしまったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. I had the strangest dream. I can't
seem to fall back asleep.

fields.EN:
I had a dream where I needed to
rescue our friends, but it felt so real.
fields.JP:
夢の中でワレは、
なぜか仲間を守ると誓っておった。
それが夢とは思えぬほどリアルでな……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I had a dream where I needed to
rescue our friends, but it felt so real.

fields.EN:
I wonder what it means. My brain's
all foggy.
fields.JP:
あの夢はなんだったのだろうな。
目が覚めてからも、
ずっと気持ちがモヤモヤしておるのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I wonder what it means. My brain's
all foggy.

fields.EN:
That's unlike you, Hameln-san. It was just
a dream.
fields.JP:
らしくないっすよ、ハーメルンさん。
それはだだの夢なんっすから、
気にすることないっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's unlike you, Hameln. It was just
a dream.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP:
だが……あの夢はワレの願望が見せた
ものかもしれぬ

fields.EN:
Meeting Jack and the others was one of
the greatest things that's ever happened
to me. I hope our friendship lasts forever.
fields.JP:
ワレはジャックたちと出会って、
仲間ができて、楽しかったのだ。
できることならずっと一緒にいたかった
fields.LOCALIZED:
Meeting Jack and the others was one of
the greatest things that's ever happened
to me. I hope our friendship lasts forever.

fields.EN: But now that we've been separated...
fields.JP: だが、今は離れ離れになってしまった……
fields.LOCALIZED: But now that we've been separated...

fields.EN: I feel like my wish to keep having fun with my friends and protect them took shape in that dream.
fields.JP:
仲間と一緒に楽しくやっていたかった、
守ってやりたかったという想いが、
夢として現れたような気がするのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
It seems my desire to live outside of all
this crap feels so distant from me right
now, hence my dream.

fields.EN:
(Hameln-san hasn't slurred once so far... not that
that matters. She looks depressed.)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンさん、今のところひと言も
　噛んでない……ってのはどーでもよくて、
　落ち込んでいるみたいっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She hasn't slurred once so far... That doesn't 
matter though. Seems like she's bummed.)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
I can't pass off my desire to protect others
as a simple dream.
fields.JP:
皆を守りたいという想い。
それをただの夢などという言葉で
片付けるなど、ワレにはできぬ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I can't pass off my desire to protect others
as a simple dream.

fields.EN:
U-Um... please don't be so down. You protect your
companions properly, Hameln-san!
fields.JP:
そ、そのー、落ち込まないでくださいっす。
ハーメルンさんはちゃんと仲間を守れて
いるじゃないっすか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hey, don't be so upset. Look at you.
You're one of the most reliable people
I know.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
現に自分はハーメルンさんに
すごく守ってもらっているっすから！
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Little girl, do you plan to make a fool of
me?
fields.JP: ……小娘よ。ワレを愚弄する気か
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little girl, do you plan to make a fool of
me?

fields.JP: へ？　な、なんでそうなるんっすか！

fields.EN:
Don't patronize me with undeserved praise.
I was no match for Genocide Pink.
That much is true.
fields.JP:
余計な気遣いは侮辱だ。
ワレは処刑台少女どもになすすべもなく
翻弄された。それは事実だ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't patronize me with undeserved praise.
I was no match for Massacre Pink.
That much is true.
fields.notes: B12 source-gated 処刑台少女 → Genocide Pink terminology

fields.EN: I failed to protect my friends again...!
fields.JP: ワレはまた、仲間を守れなかった……！
fields.LOCALIZED: I failed to protect my friends again...!

fields.EN: Um, sorry if I offended you.
fields.JP:
あ、あの、気分を悪くさせたなら
申し訳なかったっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, sorry if I offended you.

fields.EN:
But this isn't something you have to bear
alone. Trust in us too.
fields.JP:
でも一人で背負いすぎるのはよくないっす。
もっと周りを頼ってもいいんじゃ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But this isn't something you have to bear
alone. Trust in us too.

fields.EN:
You don't get it! You never will!
Because of my weakness, my friends
were hurt!
fields.JP:
それが余計な気遣いだと言っている！
ワレは負けた。
仲間を守れぬほど弱かったのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
You don't get it! You never will!
Because of my weakness, my friends
were hurt!

fields.EN:
You'll never understand what kind of pressure
I suffer!
fields.JP:
自尊心を傷つけられたこの痛み、
貴様にはわかるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
You'll never understand what kind of pressure
I suffer!

fields.EN: In the end, you're not a Blood Maiden!
fields.JP:
しょせん貴様は血式少女では
ないのだからな……！
fields.LOCALIZED: In the end, you're not a Blood Maiden!

fields.EN:
Anyway, the noble Demon King cannot be
understood by some girl. Mind your own
business!
fields.JP:
と、とにかくだ。気高き魔王たるワレを
小娘ごときに理解できるわけがないのだ。
余計な口出しをするでないぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, the noble Demon King cannot be
understood by some girl. Mind your own
business!

fields.EN:
...I made Hameln-san angry. She's odd, but she's
usually so bright and kind...
fields.JP:
……ハーメルンさんを怒らせちゃったっす。
変わった人だけど、いつもはあんなに明るくて、
優しいのに……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I angered her. She might be odd, but she's
one of the brightest people I know.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(Guess I can't do it like Jack-san can.
I'm in over my head.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱり自分じゃジャックさんみたいに
　できないんっすかね……。
　身の程知らずだったかもしれないっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Guess I can't do it like Jack can.
I'm in over my head.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
(In the end, I'm not a Blood Maiden... Hameln-san is
right...)
fields.JP:
（しょせん血式少女じゃない、かぁ……
　たしかにハーメルンさんの言う通りっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(In the end, I'm not a Blood Maiden.
She is absolutely right...)
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: (I'm just a kid with a Mary Gun. Fine.)
fields.JP:
（自分はメアリガンを持ってるだけの、
　ただのガキっすよ。どーせ）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I'm just a kid with a Mary Gun. Fine.)

fields.EN:
(But... I'm doing the best I can. I thought
I was doing my part.)
fields.JP:
（……でも、自分にできることは
　精一杯やってるはずっす。
　少しはみんなの役にだって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But... I'm doing the best I can. I thought
I was doing my part.)

fields.JP: （……ちゃんと、わかってほしいっす）

fields.EN:
I'm driving myself nuts. But not eating or
drinking anything is getting to me too.
fields.JP:
もうずっと頭の中ぐるぐるしっぱなしっす……。
こんなことしてても、お腹は空くし喉は乾くし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm driving myself nuts. But not eating or
drinking anything is getting to me too.

fields.EN:
Aargh! This is ridiculous! Moping around forever
like this isn't like me!
fields.JP:
ぬあ～っ！　もうっ、バカバカしいっす！
いつまでもうじうじめそめそするなんて、
そんなの自分らしくないっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED: ARGH! This is stupid. I'm not a moaner!
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN: I know, I'm gonna talk to Hameln-san!
fields.JP:
なんかこのままじゃダメな気がするっす！
ハーメルンさんに会いにいくっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: I know, I'm gonna talk to Hameln!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san
Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: Perfect timing. Take a look at my desk!
fields.JP:
ちょうどいいところに来たっす。
ちょっとあの机を見てほしいっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: Perfect timing. Take a look at my desk!

fields.JP: あれは自分が作ったんっす！

fields.EN:
That's not it. I made this chair.
This windbreaker, this gate, all of it!
fields.JP:
それだけじゃないっす。
あの椅子だって、風よけだって、柵だって、
ぜーんぶ自分が作ったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
That's not it. I made this chair.
This windbreaker, this gate, all of it!

fields.EN:
I made your pillow and sleeping bag, Hameln-san! And
I'm the one who finds the manga you like too!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさんの枕もシュラフも、
作ったのは自分っす！　それにハーメルンさんが
好きなマンガとかも拾ってきてるっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I also made your pillow and sleeping bag!
And I'm the one who's been picking up that
manga you love!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
(Well, maybe that was good luck, but she
doesn't need to know!)
fields.JP:
（マンガはたまたま見つけただけっすけど、
　そんなの言わなきゃバレないっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Well, maybe that was good luck, but she
doesn't need to know!)

fields.EN:
I know I'm not a Blood Maiden. Just a
carpenter. But I contribute too, you know?
fields.JP:
自分は血式少女じゃないし、
ただの大工娘かもしれないっすけど、
これでもけっこう役に立ってるんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I know I'm not a Blood Maiden. Just a
carpenter. But I contribute too, you know?

fields.EN:
I make all kinds of things because I want you,
Hameln-san, and everyone else to be comfortable and
have fun!
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさんやみんなが快適に
楽しく過ごせるといいなーと思って、
いろいろ作ってるんっす！
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm always thinking of ways to cheer you up!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
What about you, Hameln-san? How do you feel when
you're being the 'Demon King'?
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさんはどうっすか？
どんな気持ちで『魔王』をやってるんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whaddya say? Wanna help me see what
it's like to be the Demon King?
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Whyat's up with you?! Where'd this come
from?!
fields.JP:
い、いきなりにゃんにゃのだ！？
トートツすぎるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whyat's up with you?! Where'd this come
from?!

fields.EN:
You're the one who said a mere girl like me could
never understand the noble Demon King, Hameln-san.
fields.JP:
気高き魔王たるワレを小娘ごときに
理解できるわけがない、って言ったのは
ハーメルンさんっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A girl like me won't know what it's like to
be the noble Demon King. You said so yourself.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN: And it's true. I don't. Hence why I asked.
fields.JP:
たしかに自分にはわからないっす。
それならちゃんと聞けばいいと思ったんっす
fields.LOCALIZED: And it's true. I don't. Hence why I asked.

fields.EN:
But if you want me to know, better to
hear it from the horse's mouth. That's
why I said my piece first.
fields.JP:
でも話を聞きたいなら、
まずはこっちから話すのが筋っすよね？
だから自分の気持ちを説明したんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
But if you want me to know, better to
hear it from the horse's mouth. That's
why I said my piece first.

fields.EN:
Haha. Clever of you. Then I too must share
my truth.
fields.JP:
……はは、貴様は意外と律儀だな。
ワレも本音を話さねばなるまい
fields.LOCALIZED:
Haha. Clever of you. Then I too must share
my truth.

fields.EN:
I was beside myself. I don't know what got
into me. I was uncaring to you.
fields.JP:
あのときは感情的になって、
ワレもどうかしていたのだ。
貴様にずいぶんひどいことを言ってしまった
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was beside myself. I don't know what got
into me. I was uncaring to you.

fields.EN: In truth, you've always been a useful ally.
fields.JP:
思えば、小娘はワレらのために
十分すぎるほど尽くしてくれていると
いうのに……
fields.LOCALIZED: In truth, you've always been a useful ally.

fields.EN: I, um, stepped over the line. Forgive me.
fields.JP:
その……あのときは言いすぎた。
すまなかったな
fields.LOCALIZED: I, um, stepped over the line. Forgive me.

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
You may not believe me, but I actually came
here to apologize. I've been pacing around
your tent all day.
fields.JP:
信じぬかもしれぬが、本当は今も
貴様に謝りたくて、テントの周りを
うろうろしておったのだ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may not believe me, but I actually came
here to apologize. I've been pacing around
your tent all day.

fields.EN:
I believe you, Hameln-san. I know you're really a
kind person!
fields.JP:
信じるっすよ。
ハーメルンさんが本当は優しい人だって、
自分は知ってるっすから！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I believe you. I know you're a good person
deep down!
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP:
う、うむ……。
そう言われると、なんかこそばゆいな

fields.EN:
I'm just an ordinary person, so unless someone strong
like you explains it, Hameln-san, I can't understand
how you feel.
fields.JP:
自分は平凡で普通の人間なんで、
ハーメルンさんみたいに強い人の気持ちは
説明してもらわないとわからないんっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm ordinary, so I need someone powerful
like you to explain things to me.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
So tell your servant how you feel when you're the
Demon King and when you fight, Hameln-san.
fields.JP:
だからハーメルンさんがどんな気持ちで
魔王をしたり、戦ったりしているのか、
家来に教えるように話してほしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
So I wanna hear all about the life of the
Demon King and how best to serve you.
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.EN:
Oh-hoooo! I see. How best to serve me, eh?
You know just what I want to hear.
fields.JP:
ほほう！
なるほどなるほど、家来に教えるようにか。
よくわかっておるではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh-hoooo! I see. How best to serve me, eh?
You know just what I want to hear.

fields.EN:
First things first, there can only be one
Demon King! I can't blame you for not
understanding!
fields.JP:
たしかに魔王は唯一無二の存在だ。
凡人に理解できぬのは当然のこと！
fields.LOCALIZED:
First things first, there can only be one
Demon King! I can't blame you for not
understanding!

fields.EN:
It's foolish to submit to my grumpiness with
my subjects looking to me for inspiration.
Thank you for enlightening me!
fields.JP:
独りよがりになって家来がついて来られぬなら
本末転倒だからな。家来のレベルに合わせて
説明してやるのも大事なことだ。うんうん！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's foolish to submit to my grumpiness with
my subjects looking to me for inspiration.
Thank you for enlightening me!

fields.EN:
Then please step inside my tent.
We have much to discuss, Demon King!
fields.JP:
それじゃ、自分のテントにどうぞっす。
たっぷり語ってもらうっすよ。魔王ってやつを！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then please step inside my tent.
We have much to discuss, Demon King!

fields.JP:
（あ、ハーメルンさんたち
　楽しそうにおしゃべりしてるっすね）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP: はっはっはっ、過ぎたことを気にするな！
あんたがそれ言っちゃう？
こっちは死にかけたんだぞ
あ、くららちゃ～ん。やっほー

fields.EN: Hey. What were you guys talking about?
fields.JP:
どうもっす。
みんなでなにを話してたんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. What were you guys talking about?

fields.JP: 昔話だ。よい思い出を語り合っておったのだ

fields.EN:
More specifically, we were talking about
some horrid memories. At least for us.
fields.JP:
訂正だ。
昔話は昔話でも、いい思い出ではない。
少なくとも僕たちにとってはな
fields.LOCALIZED:
More specifically, we were talking about
some horrid memories. At least for us.

fields.EN: Yeaaaah. Like Hame-chan almost murdering us.
fields.JP:
わてら、危うくハメちゃんに殺されるとこ
やったからね～
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeaaaah. Like Hammy almost murdering us.

fields.JP: 殺すんじゃないぞ。鬼ごっこだぞ

fields.EN:
Like there's any difference. Your brand of
tag involves killing prisoners.
fields.JP:
結果的には同じでしょーが！
ハーメルンの言う鬼ごっこは、
捕まった鬼を問答無用で殺すじゃないの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Like there's any difference. Your brand of
tag involves killing prisoners.

fields.EN: In the end, we made it out, but just barely.
fields.JP:
結果的にみんな無事だったから
よかったものの……
fields.LOCALIZED: In the end, we made it out, but just barely.

fields.EN: Hame-chan truly is the Demon King.
fields.JP:
あんときのハメちゃんは
ほんまもんの魔王やったで
fields.LOCALIZED: Hammy truly is the Demon King.

fields.EN: Heh. You flatter me. I'm blushing.
fields.JP: ふふ、褒めるにゃ。照れるであろうが
fields.LOCALIZED: Heh. You flatter me. I'm blushing.

fields.EN:
A game of tag with the ultimate stakes.
Has anyone ever played with you willingly?
fields.JP:
命懸けの鬼ごっこっすか……。
そんなの一緒にやってくれる相手なんて
いなかったんじゃないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
A game of tag with the ultimate stakes.
Has anyone ever played with you willingly?

fields.EN:
Hm. The Marchens, for one. They can be
surprisingly obedient.
fields.JP:
ん？　鬼ごっこの相手ならメルヒェンがいたぞ。
メルヒェンはワレの言うことを聞いたからな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. The Marchens, for one. They can be
surprisingly obedient.

fields.EN:
What? You can get the Marchens to obey you?
How'd that happen?
fields.JP:
えっ。
メルヒェンに言うことを聞かせられるんっすか？
本当にそんなことが……？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What? You can get the Marchens to obey you?
How'd that happen?

fields.EN:
It's true. Merun could control the Marchens.
Saw it myself.
fields.JP:
たしかにハーメルンはメルヒェンを従えていた。
それは僕たちも実際に見たから、間違いない
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's true. Hammy could control the Marchens.
Saw it myself.

fields.EN:
But I never want to think about that game 
of tag again. I got as far away from Hameln
as I could. I thought my heart would give.
fields.JP:
だがあの鬼ごっこはもう思い出したくもない。
ハーメルンから逃げるために走って走って、
心臓が破れるかと思った……
fields.LOCALIZED:
But I never want to think about that game 
of tag again. I got as far away from Hameln
as I could. I thought my heart would give.

fields.JP: あんたは体力なさすぎなの

fields.EN: That was a long time ago! Cut me slack!
fields.JP: 若気の至りとゆーやつだ。許せ！
fields.LOCALIZED: That was a long time ago! Cut me slack!

fields.EN: (How can they talk about this casually...?)
fields.JP: （若気の至りで済ましていいことっすかね……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (How can they talk about this casually...?)

fields.EN:
Anyway, being able to control Marchens
must be pretty cool.
fields.JP:
それはそうと、メルヒェンを操れるなんて
すごいっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Anyway, being able to control Marchens
must be pretty cool.

fields.EN:
Does that mean you can control ones on
the surface, and tell them not to attack us?
fields.JP:
それなら、ここにいる地上のメルヒェンも
同じように操れないっすか？
自分たちを襲ってこないようにって
fields.LOCALIZED:
Does that mean you can control ones on
the surface, and tell them not to attack us?

fields.EN:
Hm. I don't know. The Marchens under my
command were obedient from the get-go.
fields.JP:
んー、どうだろうな。
操っていたというより、あの下僕たちは
自然とワレに従っていただけなのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. I don't know. The Marchens under my
command were obedient from the get-go.

fields.EN:
They recognized my strength and offered
themselves as my loyal subjects.
fields.JP:
たぶんあやつらはワレの圧倒的な強さを
目の当たりにし、従うことを選んだのだろう
fields.LOCALIZED:
They recognized my strength and offered
themselves as my loyal subjects.

fields.EN: How could they know that? I don't get it.
fields.JP:
ふーん、本能ってことっすかね？
よくわかんないっすけど
fields.LOCALIZED: How could they know that? I don't get it.

fields.EN: Looking back, I was always alone and bored back then. I played with the Marchens, and before I knew it, they had started obeying me.
fields.JP:
今思えば、あのときはいつも一人で
退屈していた。メルヒェンを相手に遊んでいたら、
いつの間にか従うようになっておったのだ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Back then, life was so boring. I played with
the Marchens to give myself something to
do.

fields.EN:
But it was chotally pyointless because they
heeded my every word. But nyow I have real
fwiends!
fields.JP:
だが従わせちぇているだけでは、
にゃんの意味もなかったのだ。
仲間ができた今にゃらよくわきゃる
fields.LOCALIZED:
But it was chotally pyointless because they
heeded my every word. But nyow I have real
fwiends!

fields.EN: (That would be touching...if she didn't slur.)
fields.JP:
（いいこと言ってるのに、
　急にすごい噛んでるっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (That would be touching...if she didn't slur.)

fields.EN:
Who needs Jack when I have all you servants
to entertain me?!
fields.JP:
今はジャックたちとはぐれてしまったが、
貴様ら家来と一緒でワレはあの頃より
ずっと楽しいぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Who needs Jack when I have all you servants
to entertain me?!

fields.JP: へ？　おいらたち家来だったの？
家来になった覚えはないんだがな

fields.EN:
(Hehe. For all she says, it looks like Hameln-san
really does trust us.)
fields.JP:
（ふふ。なんだかんだ言って
　ハーメルンさんは、自分たちを信頼して
　くれているみたいっすね）
fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
(I'm glad we've gotten closer than we were at
first. It's embarrassing, so I won't tell her that,
though...)
fields.JP:
（最初の頃より仲良くなれたみたいで
　嬉しいっす。照れくさいから本人には
　言わないでおくっすけど……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(But I won't be the one to tell her that we're
not her subjects...)
