fields.notes: B15 major meaning drift / omission restoration; exact JP source

fields.EN:
Very well. Then I must live up to my title
as Demon King to inspire you into servitude!
fields.JP:
よーし、わかった。
貴様らが家来になりたくなるには、
ワレがもっとすごい大魔王になればよいのだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Very well. Then I must live up to my title
as Demon King to inspire you into servitude!

fields.EN:
I'll train and train and train until I become
the greatest Demon King ever! Just wait!
fields.JP:
ワレは特訓に特訓を重ねて、
最強の大魔王へと成長していくのだ！
今に見ておれー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll train and train and train until I become
the greatest Demon King ever! Just wait!

fields.EN: Ohh little girl, you're here too!
fields.JP:
おお、小娘ではないか！
貴様もこちらに来るがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED: Ohh little girl, you're here too!

fields.JP: みんな揃ってなにしてるんっすか？
ごはんだよ！　おそとでごはん！

fields.EN: Yeah, I can see that, but...
fields.JP:
外で食事をしようとしてるっていう
状況はわかるんっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah, I can see that, but...

fields.EN:
Eating outside is the most splendiferous
thing in the universe!
fields.JP:
外で食べると、いつもと違った感じで
楽しいのだ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Eating outside is the most splendiferous
thing in the universe!

fields.EN: (Are picnics that big of a deal...?)
fields.JP:
（なるほど。ピクニックみたいなことを
　したいんっすかね？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Are picnics that big of a deal...?)

fields.EN:
Kaede wanted family-style dinner and
put it all on a big plate!
fields.JP:
みんなでたべるならって、
カエデがおっきいおさらに
たべもののっけてくれたのー！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaede wanted family-style dinner and
put it all on a big plate!

fields.EN:
Well, of course you'd prepare it for Shira!
Hehe...
fields.JP:
まあシラのために用意するのは当然よね！
えへへ……
fields.LOCALIZED: But it's all for me, of course! No touching!
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN: Aw Shira-san, are you having fun?
fields.JP: とか言って、シラさん嬉しそうっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED: Aw Pyre, are you having fun?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: シラさん => Pyre-san | source-gated Pyre/Pi => Shira

fields.JP: ななっ、そんなわけないでしょ！

fields.EN: There's plenty to eat. You should join us!
fields.JP:
食い物はたくさんあるぞ。
小娘も一緒に食べるがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED: There's plenty to eat. You should join us!

fields.EN: Yeah? Hehe. Don't mind if I do~
fields.JP:
そうっすか？
へへ、じゃあお言葉に甘えるっす
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah? Hehe. Don't mind if I do~

fields.EN:
Hehehe. What should I start with...?
I'll start with this big piece of meat!
fields.JP:
ふふふ、どれから食べるか……。
よし、ワレはこのでかい肉をいただくぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hehehe. What should I start with...?
I'll start with this big piece of meat!

fields.JP: はむ！　はむはむはむ……。うむ！
ラプンツェルはこっちのもらう！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN:
Um, um... Then Shira will eat this cute-shaped
one.
fields.JP:
えっと、えっと、じゃあシラは
このかわいい形のやつを食べるわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Um, um... Then I'll take this tiny piece.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.EN:
Um. It's passable I guess. I'll take another
one just to be sure.
fields.JP:
ま、まあまあおいしいんじゃない？
もう一ついただくわ……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. It's passable I guess. I'll take another
one just to be sure.

fields.EN:
Wow. You've outdone yourself! Eating outside
is sublime!
fields.JP:
いやー、すごくうまいぞ！
外で食べるって最高だな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wow. You've outdone yourself! Eating outside
is sublime!

fields.EN:
Delicious! But you'll get sick if you gorge
yourselves.
fields.JP:
おいしいっすねー！
でもちょっとみなさん、好きなものばっかり
食べてちゃバランスが偏るっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Delicious! But you'll get sick if you gorge
yourselves.

fields.EN:
Hm. Good point. I was merely picking pieces
which looked most appetizing.
fields.JP:
む……。たしかに好きなものにしか
目が行っていなかったんだぞ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hm. Good point. I was merely picking pieces
which looked most appetizing.

fields.EN:
Look. These veggie and mushroom dishes
are great too.
fields.JP:
ほら、こっちの野菜やキノコの料理も
おいしいっすよ？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look. These veggie and mushroom dishes
are great too.

fields.JP:
え～、やさい～？
にがいのキライ～
なんか……おいしそうじゃない

fields.EN:
They're not yucky. You haven't even tried
them yet.
fields.JP:
そんなことないっすよ。
食わず嫌いはもったいないっす。
食べてみたらおいしいかもしれないっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
They're not yucky. You haven't even tried
them yet.

fields.JP: そ、そんなの食べたくなーい！

fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Little girl, you've shown me the light.
Kaede worked so hard for this meal.
It would be a shame to waste it.
fields.JP:
小娘よ、貴様のおかげで目が覚めた。
せっかくカエデが作ってくれたのだから、
ちゃんと食べねば失礼だな
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little girl, you've shown me the light.
Kaede worked so hard for this meal.
It would be a shame to waste it.

fields.EN:
I'll eat it... I might not be the biggest fan
of mushrooms, but I'll try my best!
fields.JP:
ワレは食べるぞ。
……キ、キノコの形とか食感は嫌いだが、
がんばって食べるぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'll eat it... I might not be the biggest fan
of mushrooms, but I'll try my best!

fields.EN: What do you think? Is it gross?
fields.JP: だ、大丈夫？　まずくない？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you think? Is it gross?

fields.JP: むぐむぐむぐ……ごっくん

fields.EN: Oh! Hameln-san got over being a picky eater!
fields.JP:
おおっ、ハーメルンさんが
食わず嫌いを克服したっす！
fields.notes: Restore source address/honorific with natural English grammar; close Finale address pass (B10).

fields.JP: こっちの野菜も、ぱくっ！

fields.EN:
Mm. Another smash hit! Kaede, you certainly
know your way around a spice cabinet!
fields.JP:
うん、うまいではないか！
カエデのやつめ、味ちゅけがぜちゅみょーだぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Mm. Another smash hit! Kaede, you certainly
know your way around a spice cabinet!

fields.EN:
...It's starting to look tasty. Shira will have a
bite too.
fields.JP:
……なんか、おいしそうに見えてきたわ。
シラもひと口
fields.LOCALIZED: It looks good... Maybe I'll take a bite.
fields.notes: Restored source-characteristic third-person self-reference / Shira–Hiaburibashira identity distinction from JP.

fields.JP: ラプンツェルも、あじみする！
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.EN: Mm! Yummy! Not bitter at all!
fields.JP:
ん……！　おいしい！
全然苦くないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm! Yummy! Not bitter at all!

fields.JP: おいしー！　これならたべれる！

fields.EN:
Wonderful! I'm proud of you guys for trying
something new!
fields.JP:
ちゃんと食べられたっすね！
食わず嫌いが治ってよかったっす！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wonderful! I'm proud of you guys for trying
something new!

fields.EN: This is all thanks to your courage, Hameln-san.
fields.JP:
これもハーメルンさんが勇気を出して
嫌いな物を食べてくれたおかげっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: This is all thanks to your courage, Hameln.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Of course. We're comrades. If Kaede made
it for us, we oywe it to her not to waste it!
fields.JP:
当たり前だろう。我らは仲間だ。
仲間のカエデが作ってくれたものを
粗末にできるはずもにゃい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Of course. We're family. If Kaede prepared
it, we oywe it tyo her not to wayste it!

fields.EN:
(Color me shocked! Hameln-san's becoming a
good role model.)
fields.JP:
（ハーメルンさん、偉いっす。
　年長者として、年下の二人にお手本となって
　くれているんっすね……！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Color me shocked! Hameln's becoming a
good role model.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN: Whoa Gretel-san! Where did you come from?!
fields.JP: わ、グレーテルさん！　いつの間に！
fields.LOCALIZED: Whoa Gretel! Where did you come from?!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Hameln, this is a rare sight.
fields.JP:
ハーメルン。
あなたにしては珍しく学習していたのね
fields.LOCALIZED: Hameln, this is a rare sight.

fields.EN:
You mentioned that it would be a waste not
to eat food made by Kaede, but didn't Nemurihime tell you that first?
fields.JP:
今あなたは、『仲間のカエデが作ってくれた
ものを粗末にしてはいけない』と発言したけど、
それは以前あなたが眠り姫に言われた言葉よね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
You mentioned that it would be a waste not
to eat food made by Kaede, but didn't Sleeping
Beauty tell you that first?

fields.JP:
う、うぐ……。
そうだったような、そうでないような……？

fields.EN:
I was there. You called the mushrooms slimy.
I remember it like it was yesterday.
fields.JP:
私はその場で聞いていたわよ。
『キノコはぬるぬるしてて嫌なのだー』と
一語一句覚えているわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I was there. You called the mushrooms slimy.
I remember it like it was yesterday.

fields.EN: Merun, you copied Nemu-Nemu? Did you?
fields.JP:
めるん、ねむねむがいったこと、まねしたの？
まねっこしたの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hammy, you copied Sleepy? Did you?

fields.EN:
Grr. Damn you, Gretel! I did a good thing,
and you came and just stepped all over it!
fields.JP:
うぐぐ、グレーテル貴様。
せっかくワレがいいこと言った感じだったのに、
ぶち壊しおって……！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Grr. Damn you, Gretel! I did a good thing,
and you came and just stepped all over it!

fields.EN: Classic deflection. What did I do?
fields.JP:
あら、ひどい言いがかりね。
私がなにをしたというのかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED: Classic deflection. What did I do?

fields.EN:
It's fine. Hameln-san, you're all good in my book.
Praise the great Demon King!
fields.JP:
だ、大丈夫っすよ。
ハーメルンさんは十分すごいっす！
よっ、大魔王！
fields.LOCALIZED:
It's fine. Hameln, you're all good in my book.
Praise the great Demon King!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.EN:
Dyamn you... Dyamn you, Gretel!
Give me back my cool image!
fields.JP:
おにょれ……、おにょれグレーテル～！
ワレのかっこよさを返せ～！！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Dyamn you... Dyamn you, Gretel!
Somebody tell me how cool I am!

fields.EN:
(Oof. I feel dizzy. I've been using a lot of
blood lately.)
fields.JP:
（あ～、ちょっとくらくらするっす……。
　最近はなにかと血を消耗してるっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Oof. I feel dizzy. I've been using a lot of
blood lately.)

fields.EN:
(Explains why Jack-san always looked pale.
But he never complained. He just put
in the work.)
fields.JP:
（ジャックさんもいつもこんな感じで
　貧血気味だったんっすかねぇ。
　それなのに弱音も吐かずがんばって……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Explains why Jack always looked pale.
But he never complained. He just put
in the work.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN: (I've got a newfound respect for the guy.)
fields.LOCALIZED: (I've got a newfound respect for the guy.)

fields.EN:
*sigh* Finally back at my tent.
I can't wait to doze off.
fields.JP:
はぁ……やっと自分のテントに着いたっす。
こんなときは早く休むに限るっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sigh* Finally back at my tent.
I can't wait to doze off.

fields.EN:
Oh, why's Nemu in my tent? She must've
made a mistake.
fields.JP:
あれ、なんでネムさんが自分のテントに……。
間違えたんっすかね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, why's Sleepy in my tent? She must've
made a mistake.

fields.EN: (Oh no. I'm in the wrong! This is her tent!)
fields.JP:
（って、テント間違えたのは自分のほうっす！
　ここネムさんのテントじゃないっすか！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Oh no. I'm in the wrong! This is her tent!)

fields.EN:
(Whoa. I can't believe I mistook my own tent.
I must be exhausted.)
fields.JP:
（うわ～、テントを間違えるなんて、
　これはいよいよ末期っすよ。
　ちゃんと休まないとやばいっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Whoa. I can't believe I mistook my own tent.
I must be exhausted.)

fields.EN:
(Lucky her. She sleeps so soundly.
Wish that was me.)
fields.JP:
（いいなぁ……。
　ネムさん気持ちよさそうに寝てるっすね。
　いつもながらいい眠りっぷりっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Lucky her. She sleeps so soundly.
Wish that was me.)

fields.EN:
(Watching her sleep is comforting.
Man, I'm so tired. I don't...think I'll make
it to my tent...)
fields.JP:
（ネムさんを見てたら安心して……
　なんか、ドッと眠気が……来たっす……。
　自分のテントまでもたなさそうっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Watching her sleep is comforting.
Man, I'm so tired. I don't...think I'll make
it to my tent...)

fields.EN:
*yawn* Hope you don't mind me sleeping
here, Nemu. I'll leave right after...
fields.JP:
ふあぁ……。ネムさん、
ちょっとここで休憩させてほしいっす。
少し休んだら、すぐに行くんで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
*yawn* Hope you don't mind me sleeping
here, Sleepy. I'll leave right after...

fields.JP: ちょっとだけ……ちょっとだけ、っす……

fields.EN:
(Wow. This is the life. Maybe it's because
I've got Nemu next to me...)
fields.JP:
（なんか……すごく安心するっす。
　すぐ近くでネムさんが寝ているから
　なんっすかね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Wow. This is the life. Maybe it's because
I've got Sleepy next to me...)

fields.EN:
(I haven't felt this safe since I last saw
Boss...)
fields.JP:
（こんなに安心して眠れるのは、
　師匠と別れてからは初めてかも
　しれないっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I haven't felt this safe since I last saw
Boss...)

fields.EN:
(Hopefully one day...we'll all find each
other again...)
fields.JP:
（師匠やみんなと一緒に楽しく過ごせる日々は、
　また……戻ってくるんっすかね……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Hopefully one day...we'll all find each
other again...)

fields.EN: Hm? Oh. I must've passed out.
fields.JP:
ん……？　あー……、いつの間にか
ぐっすり寝ちゃってたっす……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hm? Oh. I must've passed out.

fields.EN: Huh? Someone tucked me in. Who was...
fields.JP:
あれ、毛布がかかってたっす。
誰が……
fields.LOCALIZED: Huh? Someone tucked me in. Who was...

fields.EN:
Oh, must've been Nemu. She made sure
I didn't freeze.
fields.JP:
……そっか、ネムさんがかけてくれたんっすね。
おかげで寝冷えしないで済んだっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, must've been Sleepy. She made sure
I didn't freeze.

fields.EN: I should tuck her in too.
fields.JP:
お返しに、この毛布はネムさんに
かけてあげて、っと……
fields.LOCALIZED: I should tuck her in too.

fields.EN:
Oops. Did I wake you? I'm so sorry.
I didn't mean to.
fields.JP:
ありゃ、起こしちゃったっすか？
すまないっす、睡眠を邪魔するつもりは
なかったんっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oops. Did I wake you? I'm so sorry.
I didn't mean to.

fields.JP: くらら……。毛布……ありがとう……

fields.EN: Right back at ya, Nemu. That nap was great.
fields.JP:
ネムさんこそ、ありがとうっす。
おかげで快適に眠れたっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Right back at ya, Sleepy. That nap was great.

fields.JP:
ん……。くらら、疲れてる……。
もっと、休んで……

fields.EN:
No, it's fine. I'm heading back to my tent.
Don't mind me.
fields.JP:
いやいや、そんな。
自分のテントに戻って休むっすから、
お気遣いなく
fields.LOCALIZED:
No, it's fine. I'm heading back to my tent.
Don't mind me.

fields.JP:
（お、おお。ネムさんが意外と
　ぐいぐい来るっすよ）

fields.EN:
(Aah! Soft and fragrant... *sniff*...
Is that Nemu's perfume?)
fields.JP:
（ああ……ふんわりといい匂いが……。
　くんくん、ふがふが……。
　ネムさんの香りっすかね……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Aah! Soft and fragrant... *sniff*...
Is that Sleepy's perfume?)

fields.EN: (It's soothing... I'm gonna knock out again.)
fields.JP:
（……なんか、すごく癒されて……
　また眠くなってきたっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (It's soothing... I'm gonna knock out again.)

fields.EN: (Nemu, were you worried about me resting?)
fields.JP:
（ネムさん、自分が疲れてるのを
　心配してくれてるんっすか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Sleepy, were you worried about me resting?)

fields.EN:
(She might not say much, but she more than
makes up for it.)
fields.JP:
（無口だけど、ネムさんはやっぱり
　優しい人っすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She might not say much, but she more than
makes up for it.)

fields.JP: ん？　なんっすかね、今の音

fields.EN:
Oh, there it is again. I didn't imagine it.
It came from over here...
fields.JP:
あ、また聞こえたっす。
空耳じゃないっすね。
この辺りから聞こえたっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Oh, there it is again. I didn't imagine it.
It came from over here...

fields.EN: This is Nemu's tent. What's going on...?
fields.JP:
って、ここはネムさんのテントじゃないっすか。
いったい中でなにを……
fields.LOCALIZED: This is Sleepy's tent. What's going on...?

fields.JP: ネムさん、失礼するっす

fields.EN:
Whoa. There's plants everywhere in here!
What are you doing?
fields.JP:
わっ、テントの中が植物でいっぱいっす！
なにしてるんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. There's plants everywhere in here!
What are you doing?

fields.EN: Um, as you can see, it looks like Nemu-san is trying to fill the whole tent with plants...
fields.JP:
えーと、見ての通りっすと、
ネムさんが草木をテントの中いっぱいに
敷き詰めようとしてるとしか……
fields.LOCALIZED: Uh. Planting a garden in your tent...?

fields.EN:
Are you telling me you lug all these plants
around every time we move camp?
fields.JP:
ま、まさかキャンプ地を移動するたびに、
これだけの量の植物をテントの中に
敷き直してるんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you telling me you lug all these plants
around every time we move camp?

fields.JP: これがないと……よく眠れない……

ひょえー。
ネムさんの睡眠へのこだわりは
伊達じゃないっすね

夜、ちゃんと眠れないと……
昼間……どこでも、眠くなっちゃう……

fields.EN: At Dawn, my sisters helped me...
fields.JP:
黎明にいた頃は……、
姉さまたちも、手伝ってくれた……
fields.LOCALIZED: At Dawn, my sisters helped me...

fields.EN: (Now I get it. She really misses her sisters.)
fields.JP:
（淡々としているように見えても、
　親指さんや白雪さんのことが
　心配なんっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Now I get it. She really misses her sisters.)

fields.EN:
Right! Then let me help you arrange your
plants.
fields.JP:
よーし、それなら自分も一肌脱ぐっす！
植物を置くのを手伝うっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right! Then let me help you arrange your
plants.

fields.EN:
We can't have you losing sleep.
That puts you and everyone in danger
during battle!
fields.JP:
ネムさんが睡眠不足になって、
戦闘中とかに寝ちゃったりしたら
困るっすからね
fields.LOCALIZED:
We can't have you losing sleep.
That puts you and everyone in danger
during battle!

fields.JP: ネムさんは一人じゃないっすよ

fields.EN: Let's get started. Where's this planter going?
fields.JP:
さっそく始めるっすよ。
この鉢植えはこっちでいいっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Let's get started. Where's this planter going?

fields.EN: There we go. Think these flowers fit here?
fields.JP:
よいしょっと。
それじゃあこのお花はこの辺りでどうっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED: There we go. Think these flowers fit here?

fields.EN:
Perfect. Oof, this one's tricky. Where should
it go?
fields.JP:
よっこらせっと。
えーと、次はこの変わった植物っすね。
どこに置けばいいっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perfect. Oof, this one's tricky. Where should
it go?

fields.EN: Oh, got it. It's coming together.
fields.JP:
ああ、これはネムさんが置くんっすね。
了解っす
fields.LOCALIZED: Oh, got it. It's coming together.

fields.EN:
(Actually, it's a little chaotic, but she's got
her preferences.)
fields.JP:
（適当に置いているようで、
　けっこうこだわりが強いんっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Actually, it's a little chaotic, but she's got
her preferences.)

fields.EN: Ahhh! We're finally done. That was an ordeal.
fields.JP:
はー、やっと終わったっすー！
意外と重労働だったっすね
fields.LOCALIZED: Ahhh! We're finally done. That was an ordeal.

fields.JP:
ん……。
手伝ってくれて……ありがとう……

へへっ、自分なんかでよければ
いつでも手伝うっすよ！

fields.EN:
Go get some rest. I've got stuff to do, so
don't mind me.
fields.JP:
がんばったら眠くなっちゃったんっすね。
自分もしばらくここにいるんで、
ゆっくり休むといいっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Go get some rest. I've got stuff to do, so
don't mind me.

fields.JP: おやすみなさいっす、ネムさん

fields.EN:
*sniff sniff* I smell something delicious. 
It may be time for dinner soon.
fields.JP:
くんくん、
おいしそうなにおいがしてきたっす。
そろそろ食事の時間っすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
*sniff sniff* I smell something delicious. 
It may be time for dinner soon.

fields.EN:
Everyone's gathered...
Oh? Nemu isn't here yet.
fields.JP:
みんな揃って……あれ？
ネムさんがまだ来てないっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
Everyone's gathered...
Oh? Sleepy isn't here yet.

fields.EN: She may still be sleeping. I'll go wake her.
fields.JP:
また寝ちゃっているのかもしれないっす。
起こしに行ってあげるっすか
fields.LOCALIZED: She may still be sleeping. I'll go wake her.

fields.EN:
(Is she at her tent? If she's sleeping somewhere 
else, I gotta find her.)
fields.JP:
（ネムさんはテントにいるっすかね？
　他の場所で寝てたら探しに行かなきゃっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Is she at her tent? If she's sleeping somewhere 
else, I gotta find her.)

fields.EN: (Uh oh. Sounds like she's having a nightmare.)
fields.JP:
（なんだか苦しそうな声っす……。
　悪い夢でも見てるんっすか？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Uh oh. Sounds like she's having a nightmare.)

fields.JP: ネムさん、大丈夫っすか……？
親指姉さま……、白雪姉さま……

fields.EN: (She's crying. I've never seen her like this.)
fields.JP:
（泣いてるっす……。
　こんなネムさんは見たことないっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (She's crying. I've never seen her like this.)

fields.EN:
(She's always taking care of the others.
She must be worried sick about her sisters.)
fields.JP:
（普段はみんなに気を遣っているだけで、
　本当はお姉さんたちのことが
　心配でたまらないんっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(She's always taking care of the others.
She must be worried sick about her sisters.)

fields.EN: (What can I say during a time like this?)
fields.JP: （こんなとき、どう声をかければ……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (What can I say during a time like this?)

fields.EN: Ah! Clara... I didn't see you.
fields.LOCALIZED: Ah! Clara... I didn't see you.

fields.JP:
あ……えーと……。
ご、ごはんができたっす……

fields.EN: Sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt.
fields.JP:
す、すみませんっす。
別に盗み聞きするつもりじゃ
なかったんっすけど……
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry. I didn't mean to interrupt.

fields.EN:
Why are you apologizing? You have every
right to be worried.
fields.JP:
どうして謝るんっすか。
ネムさんがお姉さんたちのことを
心配するのは当然っすよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why are you apologizing? You have every
right to be worried.

fields.EN: Mm... No... We're all...in the same situation.
fields.JP:
んー……んー……。ダメ……。
今……みんな、大変……
fields.LOCALIZED: Mm... No... We're all...in the same situation.

fields.JP:
小さい……ラプや、シラのほうが……
ボクよりずっと……寂しい……。
だから……悪い……
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN:
We're...in the same predicament...
But they have it tougher.
fields.JP:
えーと……。つまり今はみんな大変なときで、
ネムさんより小さい子たちのほうがもっと
つらい思いをしているはずだ、と
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're...in the same predicament...
But they have it tougher.

fields.EN:
Do you feel like you have to be strong
because you're the eldest?
fields.JP:
だからネムさんは年長者として、
寂しいなんて言ったら悪いと思っている……
ってことっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Do you feel like you have to be strong
because you're the eldest?

fields.EN:
I try not to think...about my sisters.
Must be strong...for Rapu and Shira.
fields.JP:
できるだけ、姉さまたちのこと……
考えないようにしてる……。
ラプやシラの……力になりたいから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I try not to think...about my sisters.
Must be strong...for Rappy and Pyre.
fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.JP: でも……たまに……心が痛くなる……

姉さまたちを、心配する気持ちが……、
溢れて……くる……

fields.EN: (No... No matter what I say, I can't help Nemu-san...)
fields.JP:
（ダメっす……。
　自分がなにを言ったって、ネムさんを
　助けることはできないっす……）

ごめんね……。
これは……一時的なもので……
すぐに、戻る……
少ししたら、ごはん……いく……

……わかったっす。
待ってるっすね

fields.EN: (I had no idea Nemu was in so much pain.)
fields.JP:
（いつもネムさんに助けられているくせに、
　ネムさんがこんな苦しみを抱えていたなんて
　知らなかったっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I had no idea Sleepy was in so much pain.)

fields.EN: (I should think of a way to cheer her up.)
fields.JP:
（こういうときこそ、自分もなにか
　ネムさんの力になれないっすかね……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (I should think of a way to cheer her up.)

fields.EN:
(*sigh*...  Ever since that night, I haven't
gotten the sight of Nemu out of my head.)
fields.JP:
（はぁ……。
　あれ以来、ネムさんの悲しそうな顔が
　頭から離れないっすよ）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(*sigh*...  Ever since that night, I haven't
gotten the sight of Sleepy out of my head.)

fields.EN:
(Why couldn't I cheer her up? Everything
I said sounded so dumb. I don't wanna make
things worse.)
fields.JP:
（あのとき、もっと気の利いた言葉でも
　かけてあげられれば……いや、自分の
　安っぽい慰めの言葉なんか逆効果っす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why couldn't I cheer her up? Everything
I said sounded so dumb. I don't wanna make
things worse.)

fields.JP: （ああ、つくづく自分は無力っす……）

fields.EN:
Hey, what's with that huge sigh?
Something stwessing you out?
fields.JP:
なんだなんだ、盛大なため息だな！
なにかにゃやみごとか？
fields.LOCALIZED: Hey. What's with the sigh?! You stwessing out?!

fields.EN: Hameln-san, Gretel-san... Yeah. I'm stwessed out.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンさん、グレーテルさん……。
そっすね、にゃやみごと、っす
fields.LOCALIZED: Hameln, Gretel... Yeah. I'm stwessed out.
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san; グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN:
Happens more often than not nowadays.
Maybe you're a masochist.
fields.JP:
あなたはいつもなにかしらの悩み事を
抱えているように感じるわ。
苦労性というのかしら
fields.LOCALIZED:
Happens more often than not nowadays.
Maybe you're a masochist.

fields.EN:
Don't hold back! Tell me everything!
I'll solve your predicament!
fields.JP:
遠慮せずワレに相談するがよい！
たちまち解決してくれよう！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Don't hold back! Tell me everything!
I'll solve your predicament!

fields.EN:
(I was going to ask Kaede-san, but maybe these
two have advice.)
fields.JP:
（カエデさん辺りに相談しようかと
　思ってたっすけど、この二人も一応
　年上の人なんっすよね。一応）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I was going to ask Kaede, but maybe these
two have advice.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: カエデさん => Kaede-san

fields.EN:
(The more suggestions, the better. Might
as well ask them.)
fields.JP:
（知恵は少しでも多いほうがいいっす。
　どうせだからちょっと相談してみるっす）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(The more suggestions, the better. Might
as well ask them.)

fields.JP: 実は、ネムさんのことで……

fields.EN:
Right. Sounds like being separated from her
sisters has taken its toll on her.
fields.JP:
なるほど……。
肉親と離れたせいで精神が不安定に
なるということは珍しくはないわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Right. Sounds like being separated from her
sisters has taken its toll on her.

fields.EN:
Ugh, Nemurihime... Worrying all by yourself
is pretty col... cold of you!
fields.JP:
くぅ、眠り姫のやつめ、
一人で悩むとは水くしゃいではないか！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Ugh. Damn it, Sleeping Beauty. She's in quite
biyind.
fields.notes: B12 source-form character identity restoration; B17 Hameln speaker fidelity pair 092

fields.EN: This can't stand! I'll put a stop to it!
fields.JP:
こうしてはおれん！
ちょっとそこまで行ってくる！
fields.LOCALIZED: This can't stand! I'll put a stop to it!

fields.JP: は、速い……。もう行っちゃったっす

fields.EN: Anyway, forget about Hameln. Let's go.
fields.JP:
仕方ないわね……。
ハーメルンは放っておいて、
私たちも行きましょう
fields.LOCALIZED: Anyway, forget about Hameln. Let's go.

fields.EN:
Are you dim? Where else could I be talking
about?
fields.JP:
あら、案外勘が鈍いのね。
この状況で行くといったら、
決まっているでしょう？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Are you dim? Where else could I be talking
about?

fields.EN: (Nemu's in a heavier daze than usual.)
fields.JP:
（ネムさんがいつも以上にぼんやりしてる
　感じっす……）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Sleepy's in a heavier daze than usual.)

fields.EN:
Getting straight to the point. Have you been
worried about Oyayubihime and Shirayukihime?
fields.JP:
眠り姫、単刀直入に聞くわ。
あなたは今、親指姫や白雪姫のことで
悩んでいるんですって？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Getting straight to the point. Have you been
worried about Thumbelina and Snow White?

fields.JP:
悩んでいるあなたのことで、
くららが悩んでいたわよ
いえ、自分のことなんかどうでも……

姉さまたちのこと……今、寝て……
忘れようとしてた……

fields.EN:
Why do you have to ignore it? They're
important to you.
fields.JP:
なぜ忘れようとする必要があるのかしら？
あなたにとって大切な人たちのことなのに
fields.LOCALIZED:
Why do you have to ignore it? They're
important to you.

fields.JP: だ、って……。悲しくなる……から……

無事なのかなって……思うと……。
それに、白雪姉さま……怪我してたし……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Worrying...and knowing Snow White...
is hurt.

fields.EN:
I worry...my anxiety...will impede me...
in battle.
fields.JP:
姉さまたちのこと、考えると、不安になって……
ちゃんと……戦えなく……なりそうで……
fields.LOCALIZED:
I worry...my anxiety...will impede me...
in battle.

fields.EN:
(Crazy to think Nemu's the youngest out
of her sisters. She must be so worried.)
fields.JP:
（ネムさん……。やっぱり末っ子さんっすね。
　いつもは忘れがちっすけど、本当はずっと
　お姉さんたちが恋しかったんっすね……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Crazy to think Sleepy's the youngest out
of her sisters. She must be so worried.)

fields.JP: 眠り姫の考えはよく理解したわ

fields.EN: (Did Gretel-san pat her back and kiss her forehead?!)
fields.JP:
（えっ。グレーテルさんが
　背中をポンポンしながら、
　こめかみにちゅーを……！？）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Did Gretel pat her back and kiss her forehead?!)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: Have you any idea where your sisters are?
fields.JP: あなたは姉たちが死んでいると知っているの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Have you any idea where your sisters are?

fields.EN: Then do you think they're dead?
fields.JP: なら、死んでいると思うの？
fields.LOCALIZED: Then do you think they're dead?

fields.EN:
Then believe that. Hold onto that feeling.
Manifest their survival, and it'll come true.
fields.JP:
だったらそれを信じなさい。
人は信じたいことを信じ、
その方向に物事を進めていく思考になるわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
Then believe that. Hold onto that feeling.
Manifest their survival, and it'll come true.

fields.EN:
No point in dwelling on the unknown.
Your mind is a powerful thing.
fields.JP:
わかりもしないことで悩む必要はないわ。
今はまだあなたの信じたいことを信じればいいのよ
fields.LOCALIZED:
No point in dwelling on the unknown.
Your mind is a powerful thing.

fields.EN: My sisters are safe. My sisters are safe...
fields.JP:
……姉さまたちは、無事……。
姉さまたちは……無事……
fields.LOCALIZED: My sisters are safe. My sisters are safe...

fields.JP: そればかりは私にもどうしようもないわ

（たしかにグレーテルさんの言うことも
　一理あるっす。……でも）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: You can trust me too, Nemu...
fields.JP: ……自分はネムさんに頼ってほしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED: You can trust me too, Sleepy...

fields.EN:
We're friends. Whenever you're feeling
overwhelmed, you can count on me.
I want you to.
fields.JP:
せっかく仲間がいるんっす。
頼ったからって解決できないことだとしても、
やっぱり頼ってほしいっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
We're friends. Whenever you're feeling
overwhelmed, you can count on me.
I want you to.

fields.EN:
If you feel lonely, I'll be right beside you
until the feeling passes.
fields.JP:
ネムさんが寂しければ、
寂しくなくなるまでずっと一緒にいるっす！
だから、その……っ
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you feel lonely, I'll be right beside you
until the feeling passes.

fields.EN:
(Nothing I say seems to get through.
Should I let her be? There's gotta be
something.)
fields.JP:
（ネムさん、少し寂しそうっす……。
　やっぱり自分じゃどうしようもないんっすか？
　どうしたら元気づけられるっすか……？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Nothing I say seems to get through.
Should I let her be? There's gotta be
something.)

fields.EN: Sorry for keeping you! Here it is!
fields.JP: 待たせたな！　持ってきたぞ！
fields.LOCALIZED: Sorry for keeping you! Here it is!

fields.JP: うわ、なんっすかそのおっきい木は！

fields.EN:
Nemurihime loves plants. Which is why
I brought her this tree. This'll cheer you up!
fields.JP:
眠り姫は植物が好きだからな。
とにかくでっかい木を取ってきてやったのだ！
これで元気を出すがよい！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty loves plants. Which is why
I brought her this tree. This'll cheer you up!

fields.EN:
Um. Do you really think this is going to
work on—
fields.JP:
いや、さすがにそれで元気が出るなんて
単純すぎないっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Um. Do you really think this is going to
work on—

fields.EN: (Wait. She's got a glimmer in her eye!)
fields.JP: （あれ？　なんか元気が出てるっぽいっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Wait. She's got a glimmer in her eye!)

fields.EN:
Hameln, how exactly do you plan on fitting
that tree in her tent? It's enormous.
fields.JP:
で？　ハーメルン。
明らかにテントよりも大きいその木を
どうやって中に入れるつもりかしら？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln, how exactly do you plan on fitting
that tree in her tent? It's enormous.

fields.EN: You didn't think that far ahead, did you?
fields.JP: 考えてなかったんっすね……
fields.LOCALIZED: You didn't think that far ahead, did you?

fields.EN:
I meant to splyt it in half!
I had thought this through!
fields.JP:
……は、半分に折りょうと思っておったのだ！
ちゃんと考えていたんだからなー！
fields.LOCALIZED: I meant to splyt it in hyalf! Don't tempt me!

fields.JP: ハメルンちゃん……木、うれしい……

姉さまたちは……きっと無事……。
信じる……

fields.EN:
Thank goodness, Nemu! And thank you,
Hameln-san and Gretel-san!
fields.JP:
ネムさん、よかったっす……！
これもグレーテルさんとハーメルンさんの
おかげっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thank goodness, Sleepy! And thank you,
Hameln and Gretel!
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.EN:
Yes, yes! I don't know what you all talked
about, but leave it to me! I can fix anything!
fields.JP:
そうかそうか！
よくわからんが、ワレに任せておけば
だいたい解決ということだな！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yes, yes! I don't know what you all talked
about, but leave it to me! I can fix anything!

fields.EN: Don't thank me. I merely stated the obvious.
fields.JP:
私はただ当たり前の話をしただけよ。
特別なことはなにもしていないわ
fields.LOCALIZED: Don't thank me. I merely stated the obvious.

fields.JP:
みんながいれば……もう、大丈夫……。
ボク、元気……

fields.EN:
Yay! Let's stick together, and find our friends
as soon as possible!
fields.JP:
やったっすね！
この調子で一緒にがんばって、
絶対にみんなと合流するっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
Yay! Let's stick together, and find our friends
as soon as possible!

fields.EN:
(Makes me smile to see Nemu feel like
herself again.)
fields.JP:
（ネムさんが少しでも元気になってくれて
　よかったっす！）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Makes me smile to see Sleepy feel like
herself again.)

fields.EN:
(I'm surprised Gretel-san of all people was
the one to cheer her up.)
fields.JP:
（それにしても、あのグレーテルさんがネムさんに
　あんな励まし方をしたのは驚いたっす。
　なにか意味があったんっすかね？）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I'm surprised Gretel of all people was
the one to cheer her up.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP:
（ま、グレーテルさんも変わったって
　ことっすかね……）
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.JP:
この花は……、ここ……。
こっちには、この子……

fields.EN: In this planter here, right? I'll set it down.
fields.JP:
この鉢植えはこっちっすよね。
んで、この植物はここに置いて、っと
fields.LOCALIZED: In this planter here, right? I'll set it down.

fields.EN:
How's it look? I think I'm getting the hang
of how you like it.
fields.JP:
どうっすか？
ネムさん好みの植物の配置、
自分もだいぶわかってきたっすよ！
fields.LOCALIZED:
How's it look? I think I'm getting the hang
of how you like it.

fields.JP: ふー、やっと終わったっす
えへへ、どういたしましてっす！

fields.EN:
I'm quite liking this routine we've got.
Arranging plants, taking naps.
fields.JP:
それにもうこの流れがルーチンみたいに
なってるっすしねー。テントの中に植物を
配置して、ネムさんとお昼寝するって
fields.LOCALIZED:
I'm quite liking this routine we've got.
Arranging plants, taking naps.

fields.EN: I look forward to our naps every day.
fields.JP:
実はネムさんと一緒にお昼寝するの、
最近の楽しみになってるんっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I look forward to our naps every day.

fields.EN:
Whoa. That tree's huge huh? Is it your
favorite?
fields.JP:
ま、さすがにあの木はでかくて
運ぶのも大変だったっすけど……。
ネムさんのお気に入りなんっすよね？
fields.LOCALIZED:
Whoa. That tree's huge huh? Is it your
favorite?

fields.JP:
ハメルンちゃんが……くれたやつ……。
おっきくて、好き……

fields.EN: (It's certainly a magnificent tree, but... people's tastes really are hard to understand.)
fields.JP:
（うーん、たしかに立派な木っすけどね。
　人の好みはわからないものっすねー）

fields.EN: Lately... I don't have scary dreams anymore...
fields.JP: このごろ……怖い夢、見なくなった……
……前は見てたってことっすか？

fields.EN: Yeah...but since our last talk...I've managed.
fields.JP:
ん……。
でも、この間から……大丈夫になった……
fields.LOCALIZED: Yeah...but since our last talk...I've managed.

fields.EN:
The thought of...seeing everyone...gives
me hope.
fields.JP:
がんばって……姉さまたちと……みんなと
合流しよう、って……前向きに、なれたから……
fields.LOCALIZED:
The thought of...seeing everyone...gives
me hope.

fields.EN: (Glad I consulted with Gretel-san and Hameln-san.)
fields.JP:
（やっぱりグレーテルさんとハーメルンさんに
　相談して正解だったっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED: (Glad I consulted with Gretel and Hameln.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; ハーメルンさん => Hameln-san

fields.JP:
ありがとう……。
おかげで……元気になった……
自分はなんにもできなかったっすよ

fields.EN: You said... we'd definitely reunite with everyone... Seeing how earnest you are... always doing your best, Clara... gives me so much strength...
fields.JP:
絶対、みんなと合流するって……言った……。
いつもまっすぐで……一生懸命なくららの姿……
すごく、元気出る……
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gave me hope. You're...so nice.
It gave...me strength.

fields.EN: It made me...want to try harder.
fields.JP: ボクもがんばろうって……思えた……
fields.LOCALIZED: It made me...want to try harder.

fields.JP: ちょ、ちょっと照れるっすね

fields.EN:
When I get sad...I'll look at Hameln's tree,
and I'll...talk with Gretel.
fields.JP:
もしも……また、つらくなったら……、
ハメルンちゃんがくれた……木を見たり……、
グレーテルや、他の大人に……相談する……
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I get sad...I'll look at Hameln's tree,
and I'll...talk with Gretel.

fields.EN: Hey... Clara, what do you do...when things are hard...? Don't you get anxious...without everyone here...?
fields.JP:
ね……。
くららは、つらいとき……どうしてる……？
みんながいなくて……不安にならない……？
fields.LOCALIZED: What do you do...when you're sad...Clara?

fields.EN:
Well, I mean. I can't help but worry about
Boss and the others. It keeps me up too.
fields.JP:
そりゃまあ、
師匠やはぐれたみんなのことは心配っすよ。
早く会いたいっていつも思ってるっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Well, I mean. I can't help but worry about
Boss and the others. It keeps me up too.

fields.EN:
But stress makes me hungry. And crying
makes me thirsty.
fields.JP:
でも悩みすぎてもお腹が空くだけだし、
泣きすぎても喉が渇くだけっす
fields.LOCALIZED:
But stress makes me hungry. And crying
makes me thirsty.

fields.EN:
When I lost my family, I learned not to stay
fixed on that feeling for too long.
fields.JP:
昔身内がいなくなって
一人ぼっちになったとき以来、
あんまり深く悩むことはなくなったっすね
fields.LOCALIZED:
When I lost my family, I learned not to stay
fixed on that feeling for too long.

fields.JP: ま、ただアホなだけっすよ
くららは、かしこい……。すごいね……

fields.EN:
(Something about what she says makes me
feel like all that pain is worth something.)
fields.JP:
（今みたいに褒められると驚くっす。
　でもそう言ってもらえると、自分の苦労も
　全部意味があったって思えてくるっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Something about what she says makes me
feel like all that pain is worth something.)

fields.EN: (Back then, after my whole family was killed by Marchens, all I had was despair... I never thought those feelings would be useful in a way like this.)
fields.JP:
（家族がみんなメルヒェンに殺されて、
　絶望しかなかったあの頃の気持ちが
　こんな形で役に立つなんて……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(When my family was killed by Marchens,
I fell into a slump. But it hardened me.)

fields.EN:
(Life, no matter how hard it gets, is worth
living.)
fields.JP:
（どんなにつらくても、
　やっぱり生きてみるものっすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Life, no matter how hard it gets, is worth
living.)

fields.JP: あー忙しい忙しい。忙しいっすー
くらら、なにしてんのー？

fields.EN:
Delivering everyone's laundry. I made sure
to sort them all.
fields.JP:
乾いた洗濯物を、それぞれのテントに
お届けしてるところっすよ。
間違えないように配るのは大変っす
fields.LOCALIZED:
Delivering everyone's laundry. I made sure
to sort them all.

fields.EN: I'm heading to Nemu's tent next.
fields.JP:
次はネムさんのテントにお届けに
行くところっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: I'm heading to Sleepy's tent next.

fields.EN:
You're going to Nemu-Nemu's?
Rapunzel's coming too!
fields.JP:
ねむねむのとこいくの？
ラプンツェルもいっしょにいくー！
fields.LOCALIZED: You're going to Sleepy's? I want to go too!
fields.notes: B19 exhaustive Finale Rapunzel own-name self-reference restoration

fields.JP: 遊びに行くわけじゃないんっすけどねぇ

fields.EN: Hi! I'm here to deliver laundry...
fields.JP: ちわーっす。洗濯物をお届けに……
fields.LOCALIZED: Hi! I'm here to deliver laundry...

fields.JP:
あら、ご苦労様。
その辺においておいて

fields.EN:
(Why is Gretel-san in Nemu's tent?
Nemu is sound asleep...?)
fields.JP:
（……なんでネムさんのテントに
　グレーテルさんがいるんっすかね？
　ネムさんはぐっすり寝てるし……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Why is Gretel in Sleepy's tent?
Sleepy is sound asleep...?)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san; B12 source-form character identity restoration

fields.JP: ひいっ！　なんでぐれーがいるのー！
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.JP: （あ、自分の後ろに隠れたっす）

fields.EN:
What are you doing here, Gretel-san?
Shooing away people who disturb her rest?
fields.JP:
それで、グレーテルさんはなにを？
ネムさんの睡眠を邪魔する人を
追い返してるんっすか？
fields.LOCALIZED:
What are you doing here, Gretel?
Shooing away people who disturb her rest?
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: グレーテルさん => Gretel-san

fields.EN: I am observing her sleep mechanism.
fields.JP:
眠り姫と彼女の睡眠のメカニズムについて
実験しているの
fields.LOCALIZED: I am observing her sleep mechanism.

fields.EN:
Her sleeping correlates with her Blood Libido,
but I suspect it might be a secondary effect.
fields.JP:
彼女の睡眠の多さは血式リビドーで説明がつくわ。
さらにそれによる副次的な作用があるのでは
ないかと仮説を立ててみたの
fields.LOCALIZED:
Her sleeping correlates with her Blood Libido,
but I suspect it might be a secondary effect.

fields.EN:
It affects her sleep talking, her personality,
her capacity for corruption, and her soothing
aura.
fields.JP:
まず彼女の普段の寝言のような口調や人間性、
彼女だけ穢れが人より溜まりづらい理由、
周りから『癒し』と言われる理由
fields.LOCALIZED:
It affects her sleep talking, her personality,
her capacity for corruption, and her soothing
aura.

fields.EN: And if Blood Libido also shapes a person's personality...
fields.JP:
また血式リビドーにより人間性が
構築されるとすれば……
fields.LOCALIZED:
Perhaps Blood Libido can have an external
effect as well.

fields.JP: なるほど、めっちゃよくわかったっす！

fields.EN: (Now I understand perfectly that I don't understand at all. She's still a bundle of curiosity.)
fields.JP:
（全然わかんないってことが、
　よくわかったっすよ。
　相変わらず好奇心の塊みたいな人っすね）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(I think I'm following. Man, Gretel's a ball
of curiosity.)

fields.EN: Muu~! Guree is being loud too~!
fields.JP: むー、ぐれーだってうるさくしてるー！
fields.notes: B19 source nickname ぐれー -> Guree; removed localization-only Gretty and restored whole-line JP meaning where needed

fields.JP: あちゃー、起こしちゃったっすね

fields.EN:
If she awoke this easily, perhaps it was a light
slumber, or...
fields.JP:
この程度の声でも目が覚めるということは
眠りが浅かったということかしら。
もしくはそれとも……
fields.LOCALIZED:
If she awoke this easily, perhaps it was a light
slumber, or...

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: Yes. I came to deliver laundry.
fields.JP:
はいっす。
乾いた洗濯物をお届けしたっすよ
fields.LOCALIZED: Yes. I came to deliver laundry.

fields.JP:
ん……、そっか……。
いつもありがとう……
へへっ、お安いご用っす！
ねむねむ、おこしちゃってごめんね……？

fields.notes: B19 source-form nickname restoration: ラプ/らぷ -> Rapu; removed localization-only Rappy

fields.EN: For now, I've collected today's sleep data on Nemurihime. Good work. I'm going back to do some research.
fields.JP:
とりあえず今日の分の眠り姫の
睡眠データはとれたわ。おつかれさま。
私は戻って調べものをするわ
fields.LOCALIZED:
I collected enough data on your sleep
patterns. Well done. I'll analyze it now.

fields.EN: (They really do things entirely at their own pace. Not that that's anything new...)
fields.JP:
（なんていうか、
　強烈にマイペースな人たちっすねー。
　今に始まったことじゃないっすけど）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Everyone's doing their own thing.
Brings a tear to my eye.)

fields.EN: Ahaha. No thanks. I still have to take laundry.
fields.JP:
あはは、自分は遠慮しとくっす。
まだ洗濯物を運んでる最中だったんで……
fields.LOCALIZED: Ahaha. No thanks. I still have to take laundry.

fields.EN:
(Keeping everyone happy can be quite
the task. Now I know how Jack-san feels.)
fields.JP:
（マイペースな人たちに囲まれてると
　苦労するっすね。今になってジャックさんの
　大変さがわかってきたっすよ……）
fields.LOCALIZED:
(Keeping everyone happy can be quite
the task. Now I know how Jack feels.)
fields.notes: Direct source honorific restoration: ジャックさん => Jack-san

fields.EN:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.
fields.JP: 物資販売所では、アイテムを売買できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can buy or sell items at the
general store.

fields.EN:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.
fields.JP:
アイテムは物語の進行に応じて変更されるため、
時折り確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Items are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to stop by
periodically.

fields.EN:
Check the Commissions to accept quests from the 
civilians. Give out work orders or plant/harvest 
Blood Flowers.
fields.JP:
依頼所では、拠点の住人からの
依頼を受けたり、逆に依頼を出して
血花の植付や、収穫を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Check the Commissions to accept quests from the 
civilians. Give out work orders or plant/harvest 
Blood Flowers.

fields.EN:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.
fields.JP:
依頼を達成すると報酬が得られるため、
積極的に受けてみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can obtain various rewards by
completing work orders, so take on
as many as you can.

fields.EN:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.
fields.JP:
依頼は物語の進行に応じて追加されるため、
時折確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Work orders are added as the story
progresses, so be sure to check on
them from time to time.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.
fields.JP:
研究室では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の能力を強化できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen Blood Maidens'
abilities at the Laboratory with
Blood Crystals gained in battle.

fields.EN:
Select "Expand Slot" to add Skill slots,
and "Change Jobs" to switch between jobs.
fields.JP:
『スキル枠拡張』ではセットできるスキル数の増加、
『職業変更』では現在の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Select "Expand Slot" to add Skill slots,
and "Change Jobs" to switch between jobs.

fields.EN:
Lower then increase Blood Maidens'
levels once more with "Blood Devolution."
fields.JP:
『血式退化』では、血式少女のレベルを下げて
再び育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Lower then increase Blood Maidens'
levels once more with "Blood Devolution."

fields.EN:
You can also appraise any blood
packs you own and inject blood packs
you've appraised.
fields.JP:
また、所持しているユ血液の鑑定を行い、
鑑定したユ血液の注入も行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also appraise any blood
packs you own and inject blood packs
you've appraised.

fields.EN: Expanding Skill slots consumes Blood Crystals.
fields.JP:
スキル枠拡張では『血晶』を使用して
セットできるスキル数を増やすことができます
fields.LOCALIZED: Expanding Skill slots consumes Blood Crystals.

fields.EN:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.
fields.JP:
スキル枠を拡張したら、
メニューの『スキルセット』で忘れずに
スキルをセットしましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you expand your skill slots,
select "Set Skills" from the menu
to confirm.

fields.EN:
By using the Blood Crystals,
you can change the jobs which
have been unlocked.
fields.JP:
『血晶』を使用することで、
解放されている職業に
変更することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By using the Blood Crystals,
you can change the jobs which
have been unlocked.

fields.EN:
Use Job Rights and Blood Crystals
to change a Blood Maiden's job.
fields.JP:
職業変更では、『職業解放権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女の職業を変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Job Rights and Blood Crystals
to change a Blood Maiden's job.

fields.EN:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the chosen job.
fields.JP:
職業を変更すると、レベルを保持したまま
職業に応じたステータスに変化します
fields.LOCALIZED:
When you change jobs, you retain
the same level, but stats change
according to the chosen job.

fields.EN:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".
fields.JP:
また、その職業で習得可能なスキルが
新たに追加されるため、『スキルメイク』を
確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Various skills are available to
each job, and can be viewed via
"Skill Creation".

fields.EN:
You gain Job Rights each time you
raise the Blood Maiden's level to
a certain point.
fields.JP:
職業解放権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Job Rights each time you
raise the Blood Maiden's level to
a certain point.

fields.EN:
Once you've unlocked a job,
you can freely change it any time.
fields.JP:
一度職業解放した職業には、
いつでも自由に変更できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once you've unlocked a job,
you can freely change it any time.

fields.EN:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.
fields.JP:
血式退化では、『退化権利』と『血晶』を
使用して、血式少女のレベルを下げられます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can lower a Blood Maiden's
level with Devolution Rights and
Blood Crystals.

fields.EN:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.
fields.JP:
血式退化を行うと、
項目に書かれた数値分、レベルが下がります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Select the preset amount of levels
to devolve when executing Blood
Devolution.

fields.EN:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.
fields.JP:
また、下げたレベルに応じて、
ＣＰやステータス上昇ボーナスが得られます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Depending on the chosen amount
to devolve, you gain CP and stat
bonuses.

fields.EN:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.
fields.JP:
血式退化することで、強さを底上げした状態で
血式少女を育て直すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
By executing Blood Devolution, you
can level a Blood Maiden again
with boosted stats.

fields.EN:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.
fields.JP:
退化権利は、
一定レベル上がるごとに入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You gain Devolution Rights each
time you raise the Blood Maiden's
level to a certain point.

fields.EN:
Blood Packs are used to learn
Blood Pack Skills.
fields.JP:
ユ血液は、血式少女に注入すると
『ユ血液スキル』を習得させることができる
特殊なアイテムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Packs are used to learn
Blood Pack Skills.

fields.EN:
"Appraise" is used to
appraise and determine the
content of Blood Packs.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液鑑定』を行うと、
選択したユ血液のスキルの内容を
鑑定することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Appraise" is used to
appraise and determine the
content of Blood Packs.

fields.EN:
Select "Transfuse" to
learn skills. Blood Packs used
are disposed of afterward.
fields.JP:
『ユ血液注入』を行うと、
鑑定済みのユ血液を消費し、
血式少女にスキルを習得させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Select "Transfuse" to
learn skills. Blood Packs used
are disposed of afterward.

fields.EN:
Up to 99 Blood Packs can be
transfused. The more used,
the stronger the skill's effect.
fields.JP:
同じユ血液は最大９９個まで注入でき、
注入した分、スキルの効果が強化されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Up to 99 Blood Packs can be
transfused. The more used,
the stronger the skill's effect.

fields.EN:
You can gain Blood Packs through
Blood Farming and Blood Flowers.
fields.JP:
ユ血液は、
『ブラッドファーム』や『血花代行』で
入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain Blood Packs through
Blood Farming and Blood Flowers.

fields.EN:
You can strengthen gear at the "Factory" with
Blood Crystals obtained in battle.
fields.JP:
血式武器製造所では、戦闘で手に入る『血晶』を
使用して、装備品を強化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can strengthen gear at the "Factory" with
Blood Crystals obtained in battle.

fields.EN: Equipment can be improved up to a max rank of 20.
fields.JP: 装備品の強化は、最大＋20まで行えます
fields.LOCALIZED: Equipment can be improved up to a max rank of 20.

fields.JP:
浄化では、ナイトメア・ジャックの血液を
使用して、血式少女に溜まった
『穢れ』を浄化することができます

浄化を行うと、ナイトメア・ジャックの精神が
不安定になり、限界に達すると
浄化は行えなくなります

浄化すると、『穢れ耐性』がアップするほか、
ＨＰかＳＰの上限値にボーナスが付与されます

浄化の効果は、血式少女が戦闘不能になる、
もしくは次にダンジョンから帰還するまでの間
持続します

浄化は、Ｌスティックで画面を動かし、
血式少女に振りかけたジャックの血液を
タッチパッドを通じて塗り込むことで行います

制限時間内に全て塗り込むことができれば、
浄化成功です

一度成功した血式少女は、次回から
行為を省略して浄化することができます

省略浄化は、複数の血式少女にまとめて
行うこともできるので、活用しましょう

フリー浄化は、時間制限なしで
じっくり浄化できるフリーモードです

ただし、成功しても
『穢れ耐性』アップなどの恩恵は得られません

ただし、成功しても
『穢れ耐性』アップなどの
恩恵は得られません

fields.EN:
You can select
"Affection," "Manage Storage," and
"Library" from the Protagonist's Room.
fields.JP:
主人公の部屋では、
『友情度チェック』、『格納庫整理』、
『ライブラリ』を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can select
"Affection," "Manage Storage," and
"Library" from the Protagonist's Room.

fields.EN:
View "Affection" to see
the affection level between the
protagonist and the Blood Maidens.
fields.JP:
『友情度チェック』では、主人公に対する
血式少女の友情度を確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
View "Affection" to see
the affection level between the
protagonist and the Blood Maidens.

fields.EN: "Manage Storage" lets you deposit and retrieve items, as well as sell them.
fields.JP:
『格納庫整理』では、
格納庫にアイテムを預けたり、取り出したり、
アイテムの売却ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
View "Manage Storage" to store and
remove items from your inventory.

fields.EN:
View "Library" to view the Jail
encyclopedia, work orders,
character profiles, and the tutorial.
fields.JP:
『ライブラリ』では、依頼、ジェイル内生物図鑑、
キャラクターのプロフィール、チュートリアルを
確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
View "Library" to view the Jail
encyclopedia, work orders,
character profiles, and the tutorial.

fields.EN:
You can also view work orders, the Jail
monster list, profiles, and the tutorial
from "Library" in the Main Menu screen.
fields.JP:
依頼、ジェイル内生物図鑑、プロフィール、
チュートリアルは、メニューにある
『ライブラリ』でも確認することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also view work orders, the Jail
monster list, profiles, and the tutorial
from "Library" in the Main Menu screen.

fields.EN:
You can give a "gift" to any of the
Blood Maidens in their rooms.
fields.JP:
血式少女の部屋では、
『プレゼント』を渡すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can give a "gift" to any of the
Blood Maidens in their rooms.

fields.EN:
There are two types of gifts- 
surprise and interior items.
fields.JP:
プレゼントには、
『サプライズアイテム』と
『インテリア』の２種類あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are two types of gifts- 
surprise and interior items.

fields.EN: Giving gifts raises a Blood Maiden's affection, and you receive items in return as thanks.
fields.JP:
プレゼントを渡すことで、好感度がアップし、
プレゼントのお礼として、アイテムが貰えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can raise a Blood Maiden's
affection by gifting them items
and maybe receiving a gift in return.

fields.EN: Raising a Blood Maiden's affection can trigger various events, let her learn skills, and affect her individual scenario.
fields.JP:
好感度を上げるとさまざまなイベントが発生し、
スキルを習得したり、
ヒロインの個別シナリオに影響を与えます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Raising a Blood Maiden's affection
can trigger various events, and
can affect the ending as well.

fields.EN:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.
fields.JP:
また、インテリアは、
血式少女の部屋が実際に模様替えされます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Interior items change a Blood
Maiden's room décor.

fields.EN: Once you've given an interior item, you can freely use it to redecorate.
fields.JP:
一度渡したインテリアであれば、
自由に模様替えを楽しむことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Customize any Blood Maidens' room
with interior gifts.

fields.EN:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンには、宝箱や採取ポイントなど
アイテムを入手できる場所が存在するほか、
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are various treasures and
collection points within a dungeon
where you can obtain items.

fields.EN: There are also various Gimmicks, such as doors opened by levers and traps that deal damage.
fields.JP:
レバーで開く扉やダメージを受けるトラップなど、
さまざまなギミックが存在します
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are also various gimmicks,
such as levers to open portals,
and perilous traps.

fields.EN:
Previously-visited areas will display in the Minimap. 
Press the Left Stick to toggle Minimap display.
fields.JP:
歩いた場所の情報は、画面左の『ミニマップ』に表示
され、Ｌスティックボタンを押すと、
ミニマップの表示切替ができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Previously-visited areas will display in the Minimap. 
Press the Left Stick to toggle Minimap display.

fields.EN: Press the Y Button + Down Button to view the Detailed Map.
fields.JP:
また、Ｙボタン＋下ボタンで
『詳細マップ』の確認もできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the Y Button or the Down Button
to view a detailed map.

fields.EN:
You can access Auto-Pilot in the
Detailed Map by selecting the
location you wish to move to.
fields.JP:
詳細マップで開示済みの場所を指定すると、
その場所まで自動で移動ができる
オートパイロットを実行できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can access Auto-Pilot in the
Detailed Map by selecting the
location you wish to move to.

fields.EN:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.
fields.JP:
オートパイロットは階層をまたいで
使用可能なため、うまく活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can even use Auto-Pilot
across different floors.

fields.EN:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、イベントが起こるポイントや
アイテムが採取できるポイントなど
さまざまなアイコンがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are icons in the dungeon
marking events, items, tips, and
more.

fields.EN:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるアイコンを見極め、
スムーズに探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to check the icons on the
map to help you on your journey.

fields.EN:
All areas are connected through this
mysterious orb.
fields.JP:
全てのエリアは、
謎の球体によって繋がっております
fields.LOCALIZED:
All areas are connected through this
mysterious orb.

fields.EN: For example, the Judgment Tower Area connects to the Eiserne Tower Area, which can be reached from somewhere within the dungeon.
fields.JP:
例えば『裁きの監獄塔エリア』は、
『アイゼルネ監獄塔エリア』へつながり、
ダンジョン内のどこかから行くことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
For instance, Judgement Tower connects to Eiserne 
Tower. Thus you can view the previous area in your Minimap.

fields.EN: Once you've reached an area, you can travel directly to it from the overall map.
fields.JP:
また、一度たどり着いたエリアは、
全体マップから直接移動できるようになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once an orb is discovered, players can
travel to it from the overall map.

fields.EN:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.
fields.JP:
ジェイルには、『食欲』『性欲』『睡眠欲』の
三つの欲求があり、満たしてやることで
さまざまな恩恵を受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail has 3 desires: Hunger,
Libido, and Sleep. Satisfying them
yields various benefits.

fields.EN:
Each desire's gauge is displayed
at the top-right corner, and
change as they are fulfilled.
fields.JP:
三つの欲求は画面右上に表示されており、
欲求が満たされると徐々にゲージが溜まって
いきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Each desire's gauge is displayed
at the top-right corner, and
change as they are fulfilled.

fields.EN:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.
fields.JP:
『食欲』は、戦闘中に敵の弱点を突くなどして
『血しぶき』を発生させることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Hunger" is satisfied by attacking
enemy weak points and causing
Blood Splatters during battle.

fields.EN:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.
fields.JP:
『性欲』は、ダンジョン内にある
宝箱や採取ポイント、エモーションポイントを
調べることで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Libido" is satisfied by finding
treasure, collection points, and
emotion points.

fields.EN:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.
fields.JP:
『睡眠欲』は、まれに発生するジェイルの
睡眠タイム中に、ダメージを受けずに
行動することで上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Sleep" is satisfied by taking
action without incurring damage
while the Jail is sleeping.

fields.EN:
When any of the 3 desires reaches
its limit, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.
fields.JP:
いずれかの欲求のゲージがＭＡＸになると
『ジェイルボーナス』が発生し、
ボーナス内容のルーレットが開始されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
When any of the 3 desires reaches
its limit, a "Jail Bonus"
roulette activates.

fields.EN: You receive various benefits depending on where the roulette stops.
fields.JP:
ルーレットが止まった項目の内容によって、
さまざまな恩恵を受けることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Spinning the roulette increases the chances of 
different kinds of blessings you may receive.

fields.EN:
The moon icon on the left of the
desire's gauge shows which one will
be filled faster during that time.
fields.JP:
また、三大欲求の左にある月のアイコンは、
ジェイルが最も求めている欲求を表しており、
満たすことで多めにゲージが上昇します
fields.LOCALIZED:
The moon icon on the left of the
desire's gauge shows which one will
be filled faster during that time.

fields.EN:
The Jail has mood shifts, which
is represented on the top right
during dungeon crawling.
fields.JP:
ジェイルには機嫌があり、
ジェイルの機嫌は、メーターとして、
探索画面の右上に表示されています
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Jail has mood shifts, which
is represented on the top right
during dungeon crawling.

fields.EN:
Fighting increases the mood gauge,
and filling the Hunger, Libido,
and Sleep gauges lowers the gauge.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌は戦うたびに上昇していき、
『食欲』『性欲』『睡眠欲』を満たすと減少します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Fighting increases the mood gauge,
and filling the Hunger, Libido,
and Sleep gauges lowers the gauge.

fields.EN:
As the Jail's mood gauge
increases, so does the difficulty
of the enemies that appear.
fields.JP:
ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなっていくと、
出現する敵が強くなっていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
As the Jail's mood gauge
increases, so does the difficulty
of the enemies that appear.

fields.EN:
Filling the mood gauge may
summon a Nightmare without
any notice.
fields.JP:
さらに、ジェイルの機嫌が悪くなりすぎると
ナイトメアが突然現れることもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Filling the mood gauge may
summon a Nightmare without
any notice.

fields.EN:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、
床の先に鎖が伸びている場所があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may come across areas within
a dungeon that are linked by a
chain.

fields.EN:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to cross to
the other side.
fields.JP:
その鎖に乗ると、不安定な足場を進んでいく
『綱渡りギミック』が発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Going onto the chain activates
Tightrope Walking to cross to
the other side.

fields.EN:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.
fields.JP:
綱渡り中は自動で前進していきますが、
常に『Ｒスティック』でバランスを取る必要が
あります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will automatically move
forward, but will need to balance
yourself using the Right Stick.

fields.EN:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.
fields.JP:
画面上に表示されるバーの中心に
ポイントが来るようにＲスティックを傾けながら
進んでいきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Tilt the Right Stick to keep the
balance point at the center of the
bar on the screen.

fields.EN: In dungeons, press the ZL Button to use Blood Farm: bury "+type" Blood Crystals in the ground to grow Blood Flowers.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内では、ＺＬボタンで
『＋系』の血晶を地面に埋めて血花を育てる
『ブラッドファーム』を行うことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Press the ZL Button in the dungeon to call out the 
"+type" Blood Crystals. Use Blood Farms to plant Blood 
Flowers to harvest Blood Crystals.

fields.EN:
An area of 3 x 5 squares can be
planted, and battles will make the
Blood Flowers grow.
fields.JP:
正面３列、距離５マスの範囲に埋めることができ、
埋めた状態で戦闘をこなすことで、
『苗』→『蕾』→『花』と血花が成長します
fields.LOCALIZED:
An area of 3 x 5 squares can be
planted, and battles will make the
Blood Flowers grow.

fields.EN:
Covering these squares with Blood
Toss will change the Blood Flower
color and increase its rank.
fields.JP:
血花に、『血投げ』などで
血を付着させると、色が変化し、
血花がランクアップします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Covering these squares with Blood
Toss will change the Blood Flower
color and increase its rank.

fields.EN:
Once bloomed, you can harvest them
by searching them or by using
Hameln's "Magnetic Piccolo."
fields.JP:
『花』に成長した血花は、直接調べるか
血式能力『磁力ピッコロ』を使用して
収穫することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once bloomed, you can harvest them
by searching them or by using
Hameln's "Magnetic Piccolo."

fields.EN:
You will gain various items and
equipment based on the rank and
the Blood Crystal planted.
fields.JP:
収穫すると、埋めた血晶の種類に応じた、
アイテムや装備品が手に入ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You will gain various items and
equipment based on the rank and
the Blood Crystal planted.

fields.EN:
Use Magnetic Piccolo to harvest
them at once for a chance to
get better equipment.
fields.JP:
『磁力ピッコロ』で２つ以上まとめて収穫すると、
装備品がよくなる可能性がある
『アップデートチャンス』が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Magnetic Piccolo to harvest
them at once for a chance to
get better equipment.

fields.EN: You can grow only up to 15 Blood Flowers per floor, so be careful where you plant them.
fields.JP:
１フロアにつき、１５個までしか
血花を育てることはできませんので、
埋める際には注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you can only plant up
to 15 squares each dungeon floor.

fields.EN:
Some areas have sparkling squares.
These are called Blood Farm Zones.
fields.JP:
また、独房エリアには
フロア毎に『ブラッドファームゾーン』という
キラキラと光る特殊なマスがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some areas have sparkling squares.
These are called Blood Farm Zones.

fields.EN: Blood Flowers grown in Blood Farm Zones yield different items when harvested.
fields.JP:
『ブラッドファームゾーン』で成長した血花は、
収穫できるアイテムも変わります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The items and equipment gained
using these squares are different
from normal equipment.

fields.EN:
Look for these special squares on
the map. They are colored purple,
so check them out.
fields.JP:
マップ上でも、紫色のマスで表示されるので、
見つけたら血花を育ててみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Look for these special squares on
the map. They are colored purple,
so check them out.

fields.EN: There are doors in dungeons that are locked with keys and similar means.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内には、
鍵などで閉じられた扉があります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You may come across portals
that can only be accessed by
using items.

fields.EN:
These can be opened by using
Action Items.
fields.JP:
そういった扉は、
『アクションアイテム』を使用して突破します
fields.LOCALIZED:
These can be opened by using
Action Items.

fields.EN: Find the appropriate item among the items you have to open the door.
fields.JP:
所持しているアイテムから
扉を開けるのに適したアイテムを
見つけ出しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Using the wrong item incur various
penalties, such as taking damage
and encountering enemies.

fields.EN:
If you don't have the right item,
search the area well as it is
likely somewhere in the area.
fields.JP:
開錠に必要な『アクションアイテム』を
持っていない時は、
ダンジョン内から探し出しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you don't have the right item,
search the area well as it is
likely somewhere in the area.

fields.EN:
Jail Manage lets you, to an
extent, control the results
of the Jail Bonus roulette.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』とは、
『ジェイルボーナス』のルーレットの効果を
ある程度制御できる機能です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Control lets you, to an
extent, control the results
of the Jail Bonus roulette.

fields.EN:
Use Jail Pieces in Jail Manage to activate the
 roulette.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』では、
ルーレットの効果が設定された『ジェイルピース』
という特殊なアイテムを使用します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Jail Pieces in Jail Management to activate the
 roulette.

fields.EN: View the effects of each piece in Jail Manage.
fields.JP:
『ジェイルマネージ』で、
『ジェイルピース』を設定することで、その効果が
ルーレットの項目に選ばれる可能性があります
fields.LOCALIZED: View the effects of each piece in Jail Management.

fields.EN: Jail Pieces can be obtained in dungeons.
fields.JP: 『ジェイルピース』は、ダンジョン内で入手できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Pieces are found within dungeons. Pieces can 
only be claimed within the dungeon in which they are
found.

fields.EN:
TriJail can increase your
risks, but returns a greater
reward in battle.
fields.JP:
『トライジェイル』とは、
敵を強くするなど探索に縛りを設けることで、
代わりに多大な恩恵を受けられるシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trials can increase your
risks, but returns a greater
reward in battle.

fields.EN: TriJail restrictions and benefits apply only while exploring the area you set out for.
fields.JP:
『トライジェイル』の縛りと恩恵は、
出発先のエリア探索中にのみ適応されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The limits placed through Jail
Trial apply only to the dungeon
area you are currently in.

fields.EN:
Beware as you can add limits
during your expedition, but can't
remove them until you leave.
fields.JP:
探索中はメニューから追加の設定ができますが、
縛りの追加のみで、縛りの解除はできませんので
注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Beware as you can add limits
during your expedition, but can't
remove them until you leave.

fields.EN: While exploring, you can add restrictions from the menu, but you can't remove them. In return, you'll receive substantial benefits.
fields.JP:
探索中に、メニューから追加の設定ができますが、
縛りの追加のみで、縛りの解除はできません
代わりに多大な恩恵を受けられるシステムです
fields.LOCALIZED:
Jail Trial lets you to add limits
during your expedition so that
you can gain greater rewards.

fields.EN:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities which Blood Maidens
can use inside the dungeon.
fields.JP:
『血式能力』は、血式少女がダンジョン内で
発動できる特殊能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Abilities are special
abilities which Blood Maidens
can use inside the dungeon.

fields.EN: Available abilities are shown at the bottom left of the screen. Switch between them with the Right Stick, and press the B Button to activate.
fields.JP:
使用できる能力は画面左下に表示されており、
Ｒスティックの左右で切り替え、
Ｂボタンで発動できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Selected abilities will display in the bottom-left of the 
screen. Toggle the R Stick and press the B Button to begin.

fields.EN:
Note that activating each Blood
Ability consumes SP.
fields.JP: また、能力の発動にはＳＰを消費します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that activating each Blood
Ability consumes SP.

fields.EN:
Some dungeons require certain
Blood Abilities in order to progress.
fields.JP:
ダンジョンを進むために『必須な能力』も
ありますので、探索に行き詰まったら
能力を見直してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Some dungeons require certain
Blood Abilities in order to progress.

fields.EN:
Tsuu can create an orb with her
power, "Bamboo Weaver."
fields.JP:
つうの血式能力【バンブーウィーバー】は
目の前に球体を出現させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Otsuu can create an orb with her
power, "Bamboo Weaver."
fields.notes: Source-gated canonical name: つう => Tsuu.

fields.EN:
The orb can be used to fill holes
to create a path, or to activate
floor gimmicks.
fields.JP:
丸い穴が開いた床に、球体を落して
道を作ったり、床のスイッチに
球体を置いて作動させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
The orb can be used to fill holes
to create a path, or to activate
floor gimmicks.

fields.EN:
It can also be used to block
Nightmares, so use it to your
advantage.
fields.JP:
また、ナイトメアに対して障害物としても
利用できるので、活用してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It can also be used to block
Nightmares, so use it to your
advantage.

fields.EN:
Ningyohime can unleash a blast
of cold with "Frozen Tear."
fields.JP:
人魚姫の血式能力【フローズンティアー】は、
目の前に冷気を放つ能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Little Mermaid can unleash a blast
of cold with "Frozen Tear."

fields.EN: Use this on a flame to extinguish it.
fields.JP:
燃え盛る炎に使うことで、
炎を消すことができます
fields.LOCALIZED: Use this on a flame to extinguish it.

fields.EN:
If you get stuck while exploring,
look around for places where you can use it.
fields.JP:
探索に行き詰まった場合は、
使用できる場所がないか探してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you can't find a way through a
dungeon, see if Little Mermaid's
power can help get you through.

fields.EN:
Alice can use her power, "Rabbit
Jump" to jump across 5 squares.
fields.JP:
アリスの血式能力【ラビットジャンプ】は、
前方５マス分ジャンプできる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice can use her power, "Rabbit
Jump" to jump across 5 squares.

fields.EN:
It is best used when trying to
jump over gaps and chasms.
fields.JP:
行く手にある大きな溝を超える時に
使用することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
It is best used when trying to
jump over gaps and chasms.

fields.EN:
If you come across an area you
need to get across, try using
her power to get through.
fields.JP:
探索中、他の能力でも乗り越えられない
溝があった時に活用してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
If you come across an area you
need to get across, try using
her power to get through.

fields.EN:
Alice's Blood Ability, "Wonder Hole," creates a point
where you can save and escape from the dungeon.
fields.JP:
アリスの血式能力【ワンダーホール】は、
『セーブ』『ダンジョンからの脱出』ができる
ポイントを設置する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Alice's Blood Ability uses "Rabbit Hole."
This creates a save point and an
escape route out of the dungeon.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ワンダーホール → Wonder Hole; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Save points in dungeons can only be placed in
certain locations, so use Wonder Hole saves
to help you progress through your exploration.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン内のセーブポイントは配置場所が
限られているため、ワンダーホールでのセーブを
活用して探索を進めましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can only set save points in
certain areas, so create save
points whenever you can.

fields.EN:
Placing a new Wonder Hole automatically removes
the one you placed previously.
fields.JP:
新たなワンダーホールを設置すると、
以前に設置したものは自動的に消滅します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that setting a new Rabbit
Hole will erase any previous
Rabbit Hole that was set.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ワンダーホール → Wonder Hole; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Akazukin can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.
fields.JP:
赤ずきんの血式能力【ボディニッパー】は
さまざまなものを切ることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Red Riding Hood can use "Body
Nipper" to sever and cut through
various parts of the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.
fields.JP:
切れそうな対象の前でボディニッパーを使うと、
新しい道を開くことができたり、
アイテムを入手できたりします
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it in front of objects and
places you think can be severed
to access new areas or items.

fields.EN:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.
fields.JP:
探索に行き詰まった場合には、
ボディニッパーで切れる場所を探してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Body Nipper ability may be
useful if you can't seem to find a
way through the dungeon.

fields.EN:
Shirayukihime uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.
fields.JP:
白雪姫の血式能力【ポイズンボム】は、
時限式の毒爆弾を設置することで、
爆発を発生させる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Snow White uses "Poison Bomb."
Using it will set a poison time
bomb on the floor.

fields.EN:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to inflict direct damage
onto Nightmares.
fields.JP:
壊せそうな壁を吹き飛ばしたり、
ナイトメアに直接ダメージを与えることもできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can use it to destroy certain
walls, or to inflict direct damage
onto Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.
fields.JP:
ただし、爆発時に近くにいると、
自分たちもダメージや毒を受けてしまうため
十分に注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you will take damage
or be poisoned if you're too close
to the bomb when it activates.

fields.EN:
Nemurihime uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.
fields.JP:
眠り姫の血式能力【ローズアロー】は、
前方７マス先に向かって、
イバラの矢を放つことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Sleeping Beauty uses "Rose Arrow,"
which shoots an arrow 7 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.
fields.JP:
行けない場所にあるスイッチを押したり、
遠くから何かを狙わなければならない場合
などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to activate switches you
can't normally reach, or when you
need to aim from afar.

fields.EN:
Oyayubihime uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.
fields.JP:
親指姫の血式能力【プチプリンセス】は
所持している特定のアイテムを小さくする
ことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Thumbelina uses "Tiny Princess,"
which allows you to shrink certain
items.

fields.EN:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.
fields.JP:
何かを小さくする必要があったり、
小さくすることで便利になりそうなアイテムが
ある場合に発動してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Try using it on items you need to
shrink, or when the item works
better when shrunk.

fields.EN:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.
fields.JP:
また、小さくしたアイテムは、
元の大きさに戻すことも可能です
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also return the shrunk
item back to normal size.

fields.EN:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.
fields.JP:
シンデレラの血式能力【１２ダッシュ】は、
１２秒間、自分たちの速度を上げることが
できる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Cinderella uses "Twelve Dash."
This gives the party the ability
to move quickly for 12 seconds.

fields.EN:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.
fields.JP:
急ぐ必要がある場合や、普段のスピードでは
通れない場所がある場合に試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you're in a rush, or
when you need to access places you
can't normally walk to.

fields.EN:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.
fields.JP:
ただし、壁や物にぶつかってしまうと、
少しの間、動けなくなるため注意しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Note that you'll be stunned for a
short while if you run into a wall
or any objects, so be careful.

fields.EN:
Kaguyahime uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.
fields.JP:
かぐや姫の血式能力【タケプロテクター】は、
１０秒間だけ、あらゆるトラップのダメージを
無効化する能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Kaguya uses "Bamboo Guard." This
will allow you to nullify damage
from traps for 10 seconds.

fields.EN:
You also have a chance of
nullifying attacks from a
Nightmare during "Chase."
fields.JP:
また、『虐殺鬼ごっこ』中に、ナイトメアからの
攻撃をたまに無効化することができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You also have a chance of
nullifying attacks from a
Nightmare during "Chase."

fields.EN:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.
fields.JP:
ダメージを受けずに進みたい場合や
ナイトメアから逃げ切りたい場合などに
能力を活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it when you want to avoid
damage from traps, or when you
need to escape from Nightmares.

fields.EN:
Rapunzel's Blood Ability, "Hair!," extends her hair
5 squares ahead and lets her grab objects.
fields.JP:
ラプンツェルの血式能力【ヘアー！】は、
前方５マス先に向かって髪を伸ばし、
物をつかむことができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Rapunzel's Blood Ability "Hair Flair" can grab 
things up to 5 spaces away.
fields.notes: B12 source terminology: ヘアー/ヘアー！ → Hair!; B12 source-effect tutorial restoration

fields.EN:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, activate things, or
when you need to grab onto things.
fields.JP:
手が届かない場所にある宝箱を開けたり、
何かを作動させたり、つかまったりしなければ
ならない場合などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use it to open treasure chests you
can't reach, activate things, or
when you need to grab onto things.

fields.EN:
Gretel's Blood Ability, "Bread Portal," lets her throw
breadcrumbs 3 squares ahead and use them to warp.
fields.JP:
グレーテルの血式能力【ブレッドポータル】は
前方３マス先に向かってパンくずを投げ、
それを利用してワープする能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Gretel uses "Bread Portal." This
creates a warp point 3 squares
in the direction you're facing.

fields.EN:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.
fields.JP:
能力を発動してパンくずを投げた後、
もう一度能力を発動することで
パンくずの場所にワープできます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use the ability once to toss the
bread crumbs, and use it again to
warp to where you tossed it.

fields.EN:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.
fields.JP:
歩きでは行けない場所に
渡りたい場合などに活用しましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
This can be helpful when you need
to access locations you can't
normally get to.

fields.EN:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.
fields.JP:
ハーメルンの血式能力【磁力ピッコロ】は、
笛の音色で磁力を発生させ、
物を引き寄せることができる能力です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Hameln uses "Magnetic Piccolo."
This attracts items using her
pipe's magnetic powers.

fields.EN:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 5 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.
fields.JP:
正面の３列、距離５マスに効果があります
引き寄せられそうな物を見つけた場合に
試してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
It affects any items within 3 rows
and 5 squares in your direction.
Use it to drag items towards you.

fields.EN:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.
fields.JP:
ダンジョン探索中に
メモの形をしたアイコンに触れると
戦闘が始まります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Coming in contact with an icon
shaped like a memo in the dungeon
will initiate a battle.

fields.EN:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.
fields.JP:
戦闘に勝利することで、
ダンジョンを進む際のヒントが書かれた
『メモ』を手に入れることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win the battle to gain a memo with
tips on clearing the dungeon.

fields.EN:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."
fields.JP:
手に入れたメモは、アイテムの
『その他』のタブでいつでも確認できます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can view memos you've found
through the "Others" tab under
"Item."

fields.EN:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.
fields.JP:
放浪商人は、ダンジョン探索中に
まれに出会う商人です
fields.LOCALIZED:
Wandering Merchants are merchants
that you may encounter during
your dungeon expedition.

fields.EN: The merchant sells equipment and rare items unavailable at the General Store. Check the stock when you meet one.
fields.JP:
購入できる品々は、物資販売所では買えない
装備品や珍しいアイテムばかりです
遭遇した際には、商品を確認してみましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
The merchant sells rare items that
can't normally be purchased at the
store.

fields.EN: Defeat all enemies to win a battle. If every party member is KO'd, it's game over.
fields.JP:
戦闘では、全ての敵を倒すと勝利、
パーティメンバー全員が戦闘不能になると
ゲームオーバーになります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Win battles by defeating all
enemies. The battle ends if
everyone in your party is KO'd.

fields.EN: Once a battle starts, all characters act in order from highest AGI to lowest.
fields.JP:
戦闘が始まると、全キャラクターで
ＡＧＩの高い順に行動がまわってきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once a battle starts, the highest AGI
character will go first.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.
fields.JP:
血式少女には、
『攻撃』『スキル』『防御』『逃げる』の
コマンドがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maidens have 4
commands: Attack, Skill, Defend,
and Escape.

fields.EN:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.
fields.JP:
『攻撃』は通常攻撃、
『スキル』はＳＰを使用した特殊攻撃
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Attack" conducts normal attacks.
"Skill" conducts special attacks
that consume SP.

fields.EN:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" may
let you escape from battle.
fields.JP:
『防御』は敵からのダメージ軽減、
『逃げる』は逃走を試みるコマンドです
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Defend" reduces damage from
enemies, and "Escape" may
let you escape from battle.

fields.EN:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.
fields.JP:
敵をすべて倒して勝利すると、
『経験値』や『血晶』が手に入るほか、
アイテムや武器が手に入ることもあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can gain EXP, Blood Crystals,
items, or weapons when you win
battles.

fields.EN: A basic battle technique is to hit enemy weaknesses with elemental attacks.
fields.JP:
戦闘の基本要素に
『属性攻撃で敵の弱点を突く』という
テクニックがあります
fields.LOCALIZED:
Be sure to target enemy weak points
in battle.

fields.EN:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Wind > Earth > Water > Fire
fields.JP:
属性は火、風、土、水の４種類あり、
『火は風に強い』『風は土に強い』
『土は水に強い』『水は火に強い』関係です
fields.LOCALIZED:
There are 4 elements, each with
their own weakness.
Fire > Wind > Earth > Water > Fire

fields.EN:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."
fields.JP:
敵を弱点属性で攻撃すると、
大きなダメージを与えられるだけでなく、
『血しぶき』を発生させることができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Attacking an enemy's weak point
not only increases damage, but
may also cause "Blood Splatters."

fields.EN:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生すると、
血式少女の『返り血アイコン』が少しずつ
満たされていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Causing Blood Splatters will fill
the Blood Maidens' Blood Splatter
icon.

fields.EN:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Genocide" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンがＭＡＸになると、次の行動順に
強力な『ジェノサイドモード』に変身します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Once the icon is filled, the Blood
Maiden will enter "Massacre" mode.

fields.EN:
During Genocide mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードでは、ステータスが上昇し、
強力な専用スキルも使用できるため、
積極的に狙っていきましょう
fields.LOCALIZED:
During Massacre mode, the Blood
Maiden's stats increase, and they
can access powerful skills.

fields.EN:
They will exit Genocide mode after
a set amount of turns.
fields.JP:
ジェノサイドモードは、
数回行動すると解除されます
fields.LOCALIZED:
They will exit Massacre mode after
a set amount of turns.

fields.EN:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."
fields.JP:
血しぶきは、
大ダメージを与えて倒す『オーバーキル』や
『クリティカル』などでも発生します
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can also make Blood Splatters
by causing Criticals, or by
defeating enemies with "Overkill."

fields.EN: When Blood Splatter has built up in a Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter icon, you can "Lick" the blood.
fields.JP:
血しぶきが発生し、血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』が溜まっている場合に、
それを『舐める』ことができます
fields.LOCALIZED:
You can "Lick" a Blood Maiden when
their Blood Splatter icon has
surpassed a certain threshold.

fields.EN:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."
fields.JP:
『誰の血を舐めるのか』を選択することで、
その血式少女の『魂血スキル』が発動します
fields.LOCALIZED:
Selecting whom you want to lick
will activate that Blood Maiden's
"Blood Soul Skill."

fields.EN:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.
fields.JP:
『魂血スキル』は、
基本的に補助回復系の癒しの技です
fields.LOCALIZED:
"Blood Soul Skills" are skills
that offer healing and other
restorative properties.

fields.EN:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.
fields.JP:
血を舐められた血式少女の
『返り血アイコン』は、０に戻ります
fields.LOCALIZED:
The Blood Maiden's Blood Splatter
icon is emptied once they are
licked.

fields.EN:
Use Genocide mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.
fields.JP:
『ジェノサイドモード』で強くなるか、
『魂血スキル』で態勢を立て直すか
fields.LOCALIZED:
Use Massacre mode to gain power,
or use Blood Soul Skills for
restorative effects.

fields.EN:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.
fields.JP:
血しぶきを戦況によってどう使い分けるかが
戦闘のカギを握っています
fields.LOCALIZED:
How you use Blood Splatter will be
key in determining victory or
defeat.

fields.EN:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.
fields.JP:
血式少女は、パーティメンバーの戦闘不能、
大ダメージを受けるなど、心が乱れることで
『穢れ』が溜まっていきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
Corruption builds up in Blood
Maidens when someone is KO'd,
takes massive damage, or more.

fields.EN:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.
fields.JP:
『穢れ』が溜まると、
返り血アイコンが次第に『濁った色』へと
変化していきます
fields.LOCALIZED:
As Corruption fills, the Blood
Splatter icon slowly changes to a
murky color.

fields.EN:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンが濁った状態でＭＡＸになると、
暴走状態である『ブラッドスケルターモード』に
変身してしまいます
fields.LOCALIZED:
If the Blood Splatter icon fills
while murky, the Blood Maiden will
enter "Blood Skelter" mode.

fields.EN:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードの血式少女は、
敵・味方の見境なく攻撃を行います
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Maidens in Blood Skelter
will randomly attack both enemies
and allies.

fields.EN:
Blood Skelter can be ended using
Life Purge, when the battle ends,
or when you are KO'd.
fields.JP:
ブラッドスケルターモードは、
『命がけ浄化』『戦闘終了』『戦闘不能』
でしか解けることはありません
fields.LOCALIZED:
Blood Skelter can be ended using
Life Purge, when the battle ends,
or when you are KO'd.

fields.EN:
The murkier the Blood Splatter
icon, the greater your chances of
entering Blood Skelter mode.
fields.JP:
返り血アイコンの濁りが濃いほど
